question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na adwene a wɔde si biribi so di wɔ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina biribi ano ne asetra mu nsɛnnennen a wogyina ano no mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu nsusuwii kyerɛkyerɛ wo sɛ fa ahoɔden kɛse di nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba ho dwuma denam adwene a ɛma wogye tom, wotumi sesa, na wohyɛ nkate mu nhyehyɛe so. Adwene a wode bedi dwuma daa no hyɛ ntini akwan a ɛbata ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho no mu den, na ɛma wutumi san san ntɛmntɛm fi akwanside ne amanehunu mu. Ɛdenam mprempren bere mu nhumu a wunya so no, adwene mu nhumu boa wo ma wode pefeeyɛ ne adwene di nsɛnnennen ho dwuma, na ɛtew nkɛntɛnso a osuahu ahorow a enye nya wɔ wo yiyedi so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmɔdenbɔ bɛn na akasamafo kuo ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛboa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ne nnwuma a wonya ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmɔdenbɔ a ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ bɔ de gyina nkurɔfo akyi no twe adwene si nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛboa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden hokwan ahorow ne nnwuma a wobenya so. CBO ahorow gyina nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu kyerɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmara a ɛbɔ awo hokwan ahorow ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma a wobenya ho ban, na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma sika a wɔde bɛma SRH ayaresabea ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa no akɔ soro. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔmanfoɔ nsɛm ho ɔsatuo mu, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔka wɔn ho, ne nnipa a wɔboaboa wɔn ano de ma nkurɔfoɔ te SRH nsɛm ho asɛm, wɔkasa tia gyinapɛn ne nneyɛeɛ a epira, na wɔhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa mmabun akwahosan ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun kuo bɛn na ɛko tia adwene mu yareɛ nyiyimu a metumi adɔm?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Mmabun dwumadie. Kasamafo kuo. Kyerɛ w'adwene. Hwehw3 abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Hwehwɛ intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na metumi ahunu apɔmuden asoɛeɛ anaa adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔde mmoa a ɛfata mmabun ma wɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ahunu apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔpɛ mmabun asɛm. Bɔ mmɔden kɔ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea.  wo sukuu nɛɛse a wo ne no bɛkasa, anaa nkurɔfoɔ a wogye wɔn di te sɛ abusuafoɔ, nnamfo, anaa sukuu mu afotufoɔ a wobɛbisa wɔn ama wɔakyerɛ wo kwan. Wubetumi nso ne mmabun akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun apɔmuden so no adi nkitaho ama wɔakyerɛ wo kwan na wɔama wo nimdeɛ ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛtaa de nipadua ho mfonini ho nsɛm ba mmaabun mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛtaa ma nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm ba mmabun mu ne ɔmanfo nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔnyɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkɛntɛnso, atipɛnfo a wɔde wɔn toto ho, asisifo anaa fɛwdi, ne ankorankoro osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nipadua mu nsakrae ho. Nea ɛka nsɛm yi ho dwuma a wobedi ho ne nipadua mu adwene a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, akasa atia nsusuwii hunu, atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ ama wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nipadua mu nsakrae ho, na wɔde mmoa ama wɔ adwene mu apomoden ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi social media so yie?
answer_twi_source: Privacy Settings: yɛ nsakrae wɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe mu. Be Selective: yɛ nnamfo ne nkurɔfoɔ a wonim wɔn nko ara. Think Before Posting: susuw nsɛm ho ansa na wode akɔto gua . Protect Info: bɔ wo ho nsɛm ho ban. Respect Others: Bu afoforo. Report Abuse: bɔ ayayade ho amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa asetra mu akwanside ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛka ɔpɛ anaa tumi a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no wɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho amanneɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne asetra mu akwanside ahorow te sɛ asodi a wɔde to nea wɔayɛ no bɔne so, animtiaabu, ne suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛtua wɔn so ka no betumi aka ɔpɛ a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no wɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho amanneɛ. Wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma denam nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsakra ɔmanfo adwene ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ nyinsɛn ne awo mu nneɛma a wɔpaw ho no haw me gyinasie akwan?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Gyidi: Amammerɛ mu su betumi anya sɛnea wobu nyinsɛn ne awo a wɔpaw wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no so nkɛntɛnso. Abusua Akwanhwɛ 'family expectations': Ebia abusua akwanhwɛ ne atetesɛm di dwuma wɔ gyinaesi mu. Animtiaabu anaa Mmoa: Amammerɛ anaa aman bi betumi abu nneɛma bi a wɔpaw no animtiaa, bere a afoforo nso betumi de mmoa ama. Gyidi ne Gyidi: W’ankasa wo gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo nya so nkɛntɛnso no betumi anya wo gyinaesi no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ masiesie me ho ama nna, na dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho ansa na mede me ho ahyɛ nna mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu dwumadi a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu no de mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow ba na ɛsɛ sɛ wusiesie wo ho yiye na wusiesie wo ho. Nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: So woasiesie wo ho wɔ nkate fam? Susuw wo nkate ne w’akɔnnɔ ho. So wopɛ sɛ woyɛ saa, anaasɛ obi foforo nhyɛso nti? So wunim nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho asɛm? Nea ɛka eyi ho ne ahobammɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma de asiw nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STI) ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ano. So wowɔ ɔhokafo bi a obu w’ahye na ɔka sɛ yiw wɔ ahofadi mu? Kae sɛ, sɛ wotwɛn kosi sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ woasiesie wo ho koraa a, ɛnyɛ hwee koraa. Fa w’adwene si wo ho ne wo hokafo a wubehu so ansa na woatu anammɔn biara akɔ nna mu dwumadi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kokoam nsɛm ho mmara bɔ mmabun kokoam hokwan ahorow ho ban bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔayɛ kokoam nsɛm ho mmara sɛ wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun kokoam hokwan ahorow ho ban bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no. Saa mmara yi taa bara akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm a ɛho hia a ɛfa ɔbabun akwahosan ho nkyerɛ a wɔmpene so, gye tebea pɔtee bi a mmara kyerɛ mu (te sɛ ayayade anaa ɔhaw a ɛreba ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma). Mmara a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho boa ma mmabun te ahobammɔ ne ahotɔ nka sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn nsɛm a wɔmpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn de ada wɔn ahiade, wɔn ahye, ne wɔn akɔnnɔ adi wɔ nyɔnkofa nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn wɔ tie pa a wɔde bedi dwuma, ada wɔn adwene adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ katee so nanso wɔkyerɛ obu mu, "Me" nsɛm a wɔde bedi dwuma de ada nsusuwii ne atenka adi, nsɛmmisa a ɛma emu da hɔ a wobebisa, ne aso a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu no so. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne ahwɛfoɔ bɛtumi aboa saa nimdeɛ yi nkɔsoɔ denam nkitahodiɛ a ɛyɛ papa a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ, hokwan a wɔde bɛma wɔ dwumadie anaa dwumadiɛ a egyina tebea so, ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛyɛ den a wɔbɛfa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn mu wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan Ho Asiane: Mmabun nyinsɛn betumi de akwahosan ho asiane aba ɛna no ne akokoaa no nyinaa so. Nhomasua mu anotwetwa: Mmabun nyinsɛn betumi ama wagyae sukuu. Asetra mu haw: Ebia ɛnanom a wonnii mfe aduonu behyia asetra mu animtiaabu ne sikasɛm mu haw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow boa ma wɔkyekye aman a wotumi gyina tebea ahorow ano, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛtena hɔ daa, a wɔde hokwan ahorow ne yiyedi a mmabun di kan?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow boa ma wɔkyekye aman a wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛtra hɔ daa denam: Ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne asetena mu nyiyim a wɔtew so wɔ nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ mu, a mmabun ka ho, denam sika a wɔde ma a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, asetra mu pɛnhyen, ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so boa sika a wonya so. Asetena mu biakoyɛ, mpɔtam hɔfo a wotumi gyina ano, ne biakoyɛ nkitahodi a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den denam ahobammɔ afiri a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro ne mmusua wɔ ɔhaw anaa sikasɛm mu ahokyere bere mu no so. Nnipa kapital nkɔso, akwahosan mu nsunsuanso, ne adwumayɛ mu mfaso a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun benya nnwuma a ɛho hia te sɛ nhomasua, akwahosan, ne aduan pa a wɔde bɛma wɔn no so. Asetena mu atɛntrenee, nnipa hokwan ahorow, ne demokrase nniso a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam pɛyɛ, akontaabu, ne kyɛfa a wobenya wɔ asetena mu ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo a ɔbɛboa me yiye, na dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho berɛ a merepaw bi no?
answer_twi_source: Ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo a ɔfata wo yiye a wubenya no hwehwɛ sɛ wutu anammɔn pii. Wubetumi afi ase denam nyansahyɛ ahorow a wubebisa afi mpanyimfo a wugye wɔn di te sɛ w’awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa abusua oduruyɛfo hɔ no so. Wubetumi nso ahwehwɛ intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma ahorow mu anaasɛ wode adwenemyare ho abɛɛfo nkitahodie ahorow adi dwuma de ahwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Sɛ worepaw ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo a, susuw nneɛma te sɛ wɔn ahwehwɛde, osuahu a wɔne mmabun yɛ adwuma, ɔkwan a wɔfa so sa yare, ne nipasu ho. Ebetumi aboa sɛ wobɛyɛ nhyehyɛe akɔ anim a wodi kan frɛ wo anaasɛ wobɛfrɛ wo wɔ telefon so de abisa nsɛm na woanya adwene sɛ ebia wo ho tɔ wo na wote ase anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bedi adwene mu apomoden ɛfa animtiaabuo ne nyiyimu wɔ mmabun no dwuma, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ankorankoro atumi anya afotuo, mmoa akuo, ne nnwuma foforɔ a wɔde bɛgyina saa ɔhwan yi ano?
answer_twi_source: Aboafo nneɛma ahorow ne nneɛma ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ hɔ a wɔde bedi adwene mu apomoden yare ho nkɛntɛnso a animtiaabu ne nyiyim de ba mmabun so no ho dwuma. Afotuo dwumadie, mmoa akuo, ne mmoa nhama de kokoamu mmoa a ɛnyɛ atemmuo ma ankorankoro a wɔrehyia ahoyeraw anaa nyiyim a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomodenn ho. Adwene mu apomoden ho adwumayɛfo de nneɛma a egyina adanse so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ adwene mu nneyɛe ho ayaresa, adwennwen a wɔtew so a egyina adwene so, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ma, de boa mmabun ma wogyina nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba a ɛfa animtiaabu ho ano na wɔma wotumi gyina tebea horow ano. Bio nso, ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow de nhomasua ho nneɛma, nneɛma a wɔde boa wɔn ho, ne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow ma de ma mmabun tumi ma wotumi di animtiaabu ne nyiyim ho dwuma yiye na wonya mmoa a wohia na ama wɔadi yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne animhwɛ, nsusuwii, anaa adwene mu mfomso "cognitive errors" ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba a ebetumi anya me gyinaesi nhyehyɛe so nkɛntɛnso "influence", na ɔkwan bɛn so na gyinaesi nhwɛso ahorow betumi aboa me ma madi saa adwene mu afiri yi so na mapaw nneɛma a ntease wom kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Animhwɛ, nsusuwii, ne adwene mu mfomso a wɔtaa nya no betumi anya gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no so nkɛntɛnso na ama wɔapaw nneɛma a ntease nnim. Gyinaesi nhwɛso ahorow boa mmabun ma wohu na wodi saa adwene mu afiri yi so denam: Wɔhyɛ nkuran sɛ wonsusuw akwan horow a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa ho yiye sen sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto atemmu a ɛba ara kwa anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea wotumi hu so. Nhumu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ animhwɛ ho, te sɛ animhwɛ a wɔde si so dua anaasɛ asetena mu akɔnnɔ ho animhwɛ, ne nsusuwii ahorow a ɛyɛ den a ɛhyɛ gyinaesi ase. Adwene ahorow a wɔde bɛka ho na wɔasusuw nkɛntɛnso a animhwɛ betumi anya wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no so. Ɛdenam gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow a mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen so no, wobetumi abrɛ nea efi nkate mu animhwɛ mu ba no ase na wɔapaw nneɛma a ntease wom kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmerɛ anaa mmeae pɔtee bi wɔ sukuu mu a metumi anya ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow taa wɔ mmeaeɛ a wɔakyerɛ te sɛ afotuo adwumayɛbea anaa akwahosan asoɛeɛ a asuafoɔ bɛtumi anya ahokyere mu dwumadie ho dwumadie. Ebia ɛsono sɛnea wobetumi anya saa nnwuma yi, nanso mpɛn pii no sukuu ahorow bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma wɔatumi anya bi wɔ sukuu bere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow, suban ahorow, ne gyidi ahorow a ɛma  ɔhye ne nhyɛso kɔ so tra hɔ, te sɛ anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarimayɛ, ɔbeayɛ, ne nna mu hokwan ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow, suban ahorow, ne gyidi ahorow a ɛma nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso a ɛkɔ so tra hɔ denam atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow, nsusuwii hunu, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmarimayɛ, ɔbeayɛ, ne nna mu hokwan ahorow ho a wobegye ho kyim no so. Eyi hwehwɛ anansesɛm ahorow a emu yɛ den a ɛde mmarimayɛ bata tumidi, basabasayɛ, anaa nna mu nkonimdi ho, na wɔde ɔbeayɛ bata biribiara a wɔnyɛ hwee anaasɛ wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase ho. Ɛdenam mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, obu a wɔde ma ankorankoro ahofadi, ne nna ho nsɛm a wɔda no adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so no, mmabun betumi akasa atia ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a epira a ɛboa ma wɔhyɛ wɔn na wɔde nhyɛso ba abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo akwahosan ho nsiakyibaa "insurance" a ɛka obiara ho a edi wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade soronko ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako wɔ ɔkwab bi te sɛ: Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hokwan ahorow ne akwan a wobetumi afa so atua ho ka a ɛwɔ hɔ no so. Mmabun a wɔkamfo akuw a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no twee adwene sii akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya so. Wɔn suahu ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ne wɔn a wɔde insurance ma. Ɔsatu ne nnwuma a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn mu kyɛfa a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama akwan horow a wɔfa so tew animtiaabu so nka nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua nhyehyɛe ne apɔwmuden ho nnwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama akwan horow a wɔfa so tew animtiaabu so nka ho denam: Wɔn a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, sukuu so ahwɛfo, ne apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo bedi nkitaho de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wodi animtiaabu ho dwuma wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma mu no so. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo, adesrɛ ahorow, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa akwan a ɛkɔ akyiri, ɛka obiara, na egyina hokwan ahorow so wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho mu kyɛfa a wobenya. Ankorankoro nsɛm, osuahu, ne adwene a wɔbɛkyɛ de akyerɛ nkɛntɛnso a animtiaabu ne nyiyim nya wɔ mmabun yiyedi so na wɔako ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne nhyehyɛe mu nneyɛe a ɛde animtiaabu a wɔbɛtew so di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea broni ka no 'intersections' a ɛda nna mu pene ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareɛ a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a wɔpaw, ne awo hokwan ahorow ntam, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ aka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho?
answer_twi_source: Nea broni ka no 'intersections'  a ɛda nna mu pene ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo ntam no si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mũ ho no so dua. Mpene a wɔpene so no ne nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a wɔpaw, ne awo hokwan ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ kɛse, efisɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛnea ankorankoro tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho a wɔde bɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛtrɛw ho so no, akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate abusuabɔ a ɛda pene, ahofadi, nipadua mu nokwaredi, ne yiyedi nyinaa ntam ase. Saa kwan yi hyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho ntease a edi mũ ho nkuran a ɛma mmabun tumi fa nna mu abusuabɔ mu dwoodwoo, obu mu, na wɔpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya no ka tumi a mmabun betumi anya apɔwmuden, asua nhoma, de wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadie ahorow a ɛsow aba mu, na wɔanya nea wobetumi ayɛ nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan a enye a eba a broni ka no 'Poor health outcomes': Sɛ mmabun nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a, wobetumi anya akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔansa, wɔbɛkyɛ a wobehu, yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne a emu yɛ den, ne nsɛnnennen, na ɛde wɔn nipadua akwahosan ne wɔn adwene mu yiyedi ato asiane mu. Nhomasua mu akwanside ahorow: Akwahosan ho nsɛm, a nyarewa a enni sabea, adwenemyare, anaa aduruyɛ mu ahiade ahorow a wonni ho dwuma ka ho, betumi asɛe mmabun adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ, wɔn a wɔkɔ sukuu, wɔn adwene a wɔde si biribi so, ne wɔn nhomasua nyinaa mu nkɔso, na asiw wɔn daakye hokwan ahorow ne sikasɛm mu anidaso ahorow ano. Sikasɛm mu nsunsuanso: Ayaresa ho ka a ɛfa yare ho, adwumayɛ a wɔhwere, adwuma anaa sukuu a onni, ne sika a wobetumi anya a ɛso tew esiane akwahosan ho anohyeto nti betumi de sikasɛm mu adesoa ato mmabun ne wɔn mmusua so, na ama ohia ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kyinhyia akɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi abom ate amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe ase wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Nya ahotoso, tie yiye, bue w’ani ma adesua, di nkitaho pefee, fa nsɛm asekyerɛfo di dwuma sɛ ɛho hia a, na bu nsonsonoe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amanneɛ ne amammerɛ ma mmabun (rites of passage) a wɔyɛ no sesa mmabun nneyɛe wɔ nna mu nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkurow bi so no, woahu sɛ saa tete amanne no atwam nti ɛsɛ sɛ wogyae na wɔfa nneyɛe ahorow a aba no ma obiara gye to mu. Yetumi ayɛ wei se ebia yɛbɛko atia mmra bi ɛmmma wontumi nka nna mu ho nsɛm. Wei boa mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ kasa pa a ɛgye nnipa a wɔadi dɛm tom na ɛbu wɔn wɔ akwahosan ho beaeɛ no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Fa Onipa no Di Kan (Person-First Language): Di kan fa onipa no din anaa ne bɔberɛ kyerɛ ansa na woaka ne dɛm ho asɛm; fa nsɛmfua te sɛ "onipa a ɔwɔ dɛm" na mmɔ "onipa dɛmfoɔ."Si Tumi a Ɔwɔ So Dua (Focus on Ability): Fa w'adwene si tumi ne ahoɔden a onipa no wɔ so, na mfa w'adwene nsi ne dɛm no so dodo.Kwati Aduroyɛ mu Nsɛm a Ɛyɛ Den (Avoid Medical Jargon): Fa nsɛmfua a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ mmerɛ kyerɛaseɛ a obiara bɛtumi ate aseɛ mmerɛ biara.Bisa Nsɛmfua a Wɔpɛ (Ask for Preferred Terminology): Ma mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔwɔ dɛm kwan na wɔankasa wɔnkyerɛ nsɛmfua a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho ne wɔn dɛm no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiade ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne wɔn ahorow ahorow ho nkuran no, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ntetee: Tete adwumayɛfo ne atuhoamafo ma wɔate mpɔtam ahorow amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nneyɛe ase na wɔabu wɔn. Ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ: Hwɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no mu nneɛma, adwumayɛfoɔ, ne atuhoamafoɔ bɛda mpɔtam ahodoɔ a wɔsom no adi, . Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ: Yɛ akwan a wɔfa so kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn a wɔde wɔn ani si nnipa a wɔnnya mmoa yie so titire, te sɛ mmabun a wɔte mmubuafoɔ anaa atubrafoɔ mpɔtam, na wɔde nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho bɛma. Nkɔmmɔdie a wɔbom yɛ: Wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, amammerɛ mmeaeɛ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a egyina gyidie so yɛ adwuma bom de kɔ nnipa ahodoɔ nkyɛn na wɔdi wɔn ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma. Ahobanbɔ ho nhyehyɛe: Fa nhyehyɛe ne akwankyerɛ ahorow si hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ beae a obiara bɛka ho a wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔama wɔn akwaaba na wobu wɔn, a wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa amammerɛ mfa ho. Kasa a wobetumi anya: Fa nneɛma ne nnwuma ma wɔ kasa ahorow pii mu na ama mmabun a wɔka kasa afoforo a ɛnyɛ Borɔfo kasa no atumi, ahwɛ ahu sɛ mpɔtam ahorow betumi anya nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmaabun ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nna mu apomoden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne nna mu nkitahodi ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii te sɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, obu a wɔwɔ ma adwene ahorow, ne atinka a wɔwɔ wɔ ankorankoro osuahu ahorow ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm fibea ahorow a agye din a ɛma wɔka nsɛmti yi ho asɛm kɔ akyiri na ɛnyɛ atemmu, kwati sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a epira anaasɛ wɔbɛma akɔ so, na wɔde tema ne adwene a emu abue bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow. Ankorankoro kokoamu nsɛm  a wobebu wɔn nso ho hia bere a wɔresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wosusuw nea wɔpɛ ne nea wohia ho bere a wɔrenya ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ma no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobesusuw nea wɔpɛ ne wɔn ahiade ho bere a wɔrenya ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho amanneɛbɔ ma denam ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen na wɔaka nea wɔpɛ akyerɛ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo no so. Wobetumi akamfo hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, wɔde kokoamsɛm, na wɔadi wɔn ho so wɔ gyinaesi mu. Bio nso, mmabun betumi de nsɛm ama apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow wɔ wɔn suahu ne nea wɔpɛ ho, na aboa ma ɔhwɛ adwuma a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ma no yiyedi ne sɛnea wɔyɛ ho biribi no atu mpɔn. Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ ɔhwɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ amammerɛ mu na wosi so dua a wobu wɔn nipasu ne osuahu ahorow a wɔatra ase no nso betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ɔhwɛ a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho na obu wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mihia mmoa a mede befi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase ne m’awofo afa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho, te sɛ nhomasua nneɛma, intanɛt so nneɛma, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma wɔ awofo ne mmabun nkitahodi ho a?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa a wɔde befi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase ne wɔn awofo afa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho no bi ne: Nhomasua nneɛma: Nhoma, nsɛm, nkratawa, ne intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛ mmabun kwan wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho. Intanɛt so nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, ne nkɔmmɔbɔbea ahorow a mmabun betumi anya nsɛm, afotu, ne mmoa a efi abenfo, atipɛnfo, ne adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn hɔ. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ: Mpɔtam hɔ mmabun asoɛeɛ, akwahosan ayaresabea, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde nhyiamu, mmoa akuo, anaa afotuo dwumadie ma mmabun ne wɔn awofoɔ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nkitahodiɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn sɛ Sɛ obi rehyɛ me so anaa ɔretan me ani a?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mmoa. Kasa kyerɛ panyin. Twerɛ nea ɛresisi no (Document). Hu sɛ wo nko ara nni hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaa ahosan asoɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so, mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, mmebun ayaresabea ahorow, akwaa ahosan akuw a wɔde fa baabiara, ne ɔhwɛ ho nhyehyɛe foforo betumi ama nna ne awo akwaa ahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmebun nya no atu mpɔn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, ne aban mpanyimfo ntam fekubɔ betumi ahyɛ nnwuma a wɔde ma ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ ho nhyehyɛe foforo betumi ama mmebun anya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn: Akwaahosan Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Sukuu So: Akwahosan asoɛe a ɛwɔ sukuu mu no ma asuafo nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, na wɔde kokoam hwɛ ma wɔ beae a wonim. Saa mmeae yi betumi de nnwuma ahorow pii ama, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, afotu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ hɔ ka ho. Mpɔtam Ayaresabea ahorow: Mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ne bo nyɛ den a wɔde ma mmabun mu, titiriw wɔn a wonni insurance anaasɛ wɔn a wonni ayaresa a edi kan daa no. Saa ayaresabea ahorow yi taa de sika a ɛkɔ fam ne nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ma. Akwahosan Asoɛe a Wɔde kɔ  mmea mmea: Akwahosan akuo a wɔde kɔ baabiara de akwahosan ho dwumadie ba mpɔtam a wɔnnya mmoa yie tẽẽ, a nkuraaseɛ, mmeaeɛ a wɔhwɛ nnipa a wɔnni afie, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu ka ho. Saa akuw yi ma wotumi yɛ nsakrae na wɔde kɔ nnipa dodow a wonni akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no nkyɛn. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfasoɔ wɔ so, ne aban nnwumakuo ntam nkitahodiɛ bɛtumi ahyɛ dwumadie a wɔde ma ne nkitahodiɛ mu den: Ɔhwɛ a wɔbom yɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ: Nkitahodiɛ a wɔbom yɛ no bɛtumi ama nsakraeɛ a ɛnyɛ den wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ ntam, te sɛ akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu mu a ɛde asuafoɔ kɔ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea kɔhwɛ ɔhwɛ titire anaa dwumadie a ɛdi akyire. Ɔsom a Wɔde Ma a Wɔaka abom: Ɔsom a wɔde ma ho nhwɛsoɔ a wɔaka abom, baabi a wɔyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ, nwomasua, asetena mu nnwuma, ne mmoa foforɔ no bom no bɛtumi adi mmabun ahiadeɛ a ɛwɔ afã ahodoɔ ho dwuma na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn titiriw na yɛde susu mmabun awoasɛm ho apɔmuden ho  nkɔsoɔ, na ɛkwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔ tebea ahorow ne nnipa dodow ahorow mu ?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw a wɔde kyerɛ ne nsusuwii a wɔde susuw mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso no bi ne: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a abu so: Mmabun a wɔde nna mu agodie di dwuma ɔha biara mu nkyem a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano de siw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da. Mmabun nyinsɛn dodow: Nyinsɛn dodow a mmeawa a wonnii mfe aduonu 1,000 biara a wɔadi mfe 15-19. Nna mu yarewa (HIV/AIDS) a abu so: Mmabun dodow a wɔwɔ nna mu yarewa (HIV/AIDS ) anaa wɔn a wɔahu foforo wɔ mmabun mu. Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma a ɛkɔ akyiri: Mmabun dodow a wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata wɔn mfe, a egyina adanse so. Awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya Nnwuma te sɛ awo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛnanom akwaahosan nhyehyeɛ  ne STI nhwɛhwɛmu  a ɛwɔ hɔ na wɔde di dwuma. Saa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ yi betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ tebea ahodoɔ ne nnipa dodoɔ mu ɛnam amammerɛ, asetena, ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma nti, na ɛsi hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔfa akwan pɔtee a wɔfa so susuw ASRH nsunsuansoɔ no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan foforo bɛn na yɛde kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan wɔ amamere ahorow mu (ASRH)?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunu adesua? Abɛɛfo ntentan nkitaho,Mpɔtam nkabom
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi ntawntawdi anaa adwene a enhyia so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so a memfa basabasayɛ anaa nhyɛso nni dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ntawntawdi yɛ adebɔ mu ade wɔ abusuabɔ biara mu, nanso ɛho hia sɛ wosiesie adwene a enhyia wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ ne obu so. Fa nnamyɛ tie ade na bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte wo hokafo no adwene ase. Fa "Me" nsɛm da wo nkate adi na kwati sɛ wobɛbɔ wo hokafo sobo anaasɛ wobɛkasa atia. Sɛ nkate mu yɛ den a, gye w’ahome na san kɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu bere a mo baanu nyinaa te nka sɛ mo ho adwo mo no. Fa w’adwene si ano aduru a mobɛbom ahwehwɛ so sen sɛ wobɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ wubedi nkonim anaasɛ wubedi akyinnyegye no so. Mfa basabasayɛ, nhyɛso, anaa nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so nni dwuma da mfa nsiesie ntawntawdi, efisɛ saa nneyɛe yi pira na wontumi nnye ntom wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛfata mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di di wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu anaasɛ wɔatwa no mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi adi dwuma a ɛboa denam nkate fam mmoa a wɔde ma, boa a wɔbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no mu, sɛ wɔpɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛkɔ bere a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ, ne obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ahofadi ne kokoam nsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara kwan so nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so di kɔmputa so ayayade anaa Intanɛt so ayayade ho dwuma? (akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ, nea efi mmara mu ba) .
answer_twi_source: Mmeae pii wɔ mmara a ɛko tia kɔmputa so ayayade, na akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ denam: Social media platforms: Mmeae dodow no ara wɔ amanneɛbɔ nnwinnade a wɔde bɔ ayayade ho amanneɛ. Mmarahyɛ baguafo: Wubetumi abɔ polisifo amanneɛ wɔ kɔmputa so ayayade ho, titiriw sɛ ɛfa ahunahuna anaa akyidi ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de ɛhye a ɛyɛ papa ne nkitahodi nneyɛe asi hɔ wɔ intanɛt so ayɔnkofa ne nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi: Ka w’ahye ne nea wohwɛ kwan ho asɛm fi twaka 'relationship' no mfiase. Bu Ahye: Bu ahye a afoforo de asi hɔ no na ka w’ankasa de ho asɛm pefee. Gye Bere: Gye bere hu obi ansa na woaka n’ankasa ho nsɛm anaa nea ɛfa wo ho. Ahobammɔ Ho Nneɛma: Kwati sɛ wobɛka w’ankasa ho nsɛm dodo kosi sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho bɛtɔ wo na wowɔ ahobammɔ. Fa Wo Gyi Wo Gut So: Sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛnyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ ɛnteɛ a, fa wo ho to wo nkate so na yɛ nneɛma bi de bɔ wo ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmeae anaa afã horow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔhyɛda yɛ ma mmabun sɛ wɔtumi twɛn wɔ wɔ ayaresabea ahorow mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Apɔmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow bi a ɛfata mmabun wɔ mmeae a wɔtwɛn anaa afã horow a wɔyɛ ama mmabun titiriw. Wɔayɛ mmeae yi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma ayarefo nkumaa anya ahotɔ ne akwaaba, a wɔatew wɔn ho afi ayarefo a wɔanyinyin ho, na ebia nneɛma a ɛfata wɔn mfe te sɛ nsɛmma nhoma, agodie, anaa nhomasua nneɛma bɛka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotu betumi adi atorɔ adwene  anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ HIV ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Afotu betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ adwene a ɛnteɛ a wodi ho dwuma ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu yarewa  a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ho a wɔbɛtew so denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso no so. Afotufo betumi abɔ anansesɛm a wɔtaa ka no agu, akasa atia gyidi bɔne, na wɔama ntease ne tema ama ankorankoro a wɔwɔ STI anaa HIV no ho nkuran. Ɛdenam baabi a ahobammɔ ne atemmu nnim a wɔyɛ so no, afotu boa ankorankoro ma wogyina animtiaabu ano, nya ahotoso, na wonya nna mu akwahosan ho adwene a ɛyɛ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa 'peer group network' nkitahodibea ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow di wɔ afotu ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ nna mu akwahosan 'sexual health' ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ma mmabun ne afoforo a wɔwɔ osuahu ne nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn a ɛte saa ara di nkitaho. Ɛma obi te nka sɛ ɔyɛ ne dea na ɔte ase. Nnipa a Wɔmmɔ Wɔn Din: Intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow ma wɔmmɔ wɔn din, na ɛma ankorankoro tumi bisa nsɛm anaa wɔkyɛ osuahu ahorow a wɔnda wɔn ho adi. Eyi betumi atew aniwu anaa aniwu atinka so. Nsɛm a Wɔbɛkyɛ: Atipɛnfo betumi akyɛ nsɛm a ɛsom bo, nneɛma a wɔde boa, ne afotu a ɛbɛma wɔatumi agyina ano. Ɛma wonya baabi a wobetumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na wɔasua biribi afi afoforo suahu mu. Nkate mu Mmoa: Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow de nkate mu mmoa ne nea wogye tom ma. Sɛ wunim sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ wo suahu ahorow mu a, ebetumi akyekye wo werɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wohyia wɔ dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔahwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wohyia wɔ dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ fibea ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so no, mmabun betumi de akwan horow te sɛ nsɛm a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ mmeae a agye din, akyerɛwfo adansedi nkrataa ne ne nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, da a wotintimii anaa nea etwa to a wɔyɛɛ no foforo, a wosusuw wɛbsaet no atirimpɔw ne animhwɛ ho, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa akyerɛkyerɛfo a wogye wɔn di a wobesusuw ho de ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadi anaa nneɛma ahorow bɛn na wɔtaa nya wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa akuw a wɔboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no?
answer_twi_source: Mmeae a ahobanbɔ wɔ ma wonya nneɛma ne dwumadi ahorow: Atipɛnfo Mmoa Akuw: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa abusuabɔ, nna, ne dɛmdi ho. Adwumayɛbea ahorow: Nhyiam ahorow a ɛma ahokokwaw nya nkɔso a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ ankasa ho a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, nkitahodi, anaa abusuabɔ pa ho. Ayɔnkofa mu Dwumadi: Nsɛm a esisi te sɛ anadwo  sini, agodie anadwo, anaa abɔnten so a wɔde hyɛ ayɔnkofa ne adamfofa ho nkuran. Mentorship Programs: Mmabun a wɔde bɛka mpanyimfo a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan "sexual and reproductive health" ho ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa dɛmdi ho no gu ahorow a egyina ɔman ne ɔmantam no so. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu yiye na wohwehwɛ mmoa fi adwumayɛfo hɔ wɔ baabi a ɛho hia. "Ghana Health Service" (GHS) wɛbsaet no de nneɛma ma mmabun, a wɔn a wɔadi dɛm ka ho. Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di nkasa mfa w’ahiade pɔtee ne hokwan ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛfa digital nneɛma ne nhyiamu a ɛde nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Digyital nneɛma ne akwan a ɛde nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho ma mmabun ho nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Wɛbsaet: GHS, Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana, MSIG Mobile Apps: YMK (Ɛsɛ sɛ Wohu), Social Media Platforms: Facebook Instagram, TikTok, Twitter (a akontaabuo ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔtumi de ho to so) Online Forums and Chat Helplines: Planned Parenthood Chat Yenkasa, MarieFrɛ, Agoo ƆNE +
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma mu nimdeɛ ne nimdeɛ bɛn na ɛho hia ma mmabun akanni a etu mpɔn wɔ ASRH mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya saa nimdeɛ yi na wɔama anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Adwuma mu nimdeɛ ne nimdeɛ a ɛho hia ma mmabun akanni a etu mpɔn wɔ ASRH mu no bi ne: Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛka mmabun ahiade ne nea wɔde di kan, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no di nkitaho, na wɔanya nhyehyɛe ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow so nsunsuanso. Nsusuwii a ɛmu yɛ den ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ ASRH nsɛm a ɛyɛ den mu, ayɛ ano aduru foforo, na wɔadi akwansideɛ ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nhyehyɛe ne nimdeɛ so. Nkɔmmɔdie ne akuo adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma yie ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ahodoɔ, yɛ nkabom anaa ne afoforɔ nkabom, na wɔaboaboa nnipa dodoɔ ano ama nsakraeɛ pa. Nneyɛe a wɔde gyina ano ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ so de adi akwansideɛ ho dwuma, akura nkannyan ne anigyeɛ mu, na wɔakɔ so de wɔn ho ahyɛ ASRH akannifoɔ dwumadie mu akyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛ yɛ dɛn aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu na mahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Fa tema tie wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no a wonni atɛn. Fa wo mmoa ma na gye wɔn suahu ahorow di. Bu wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahofadi ne gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa amanneɛbɔ anaa mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ho. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnnya nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa a. Kasamafo nhyehyeɛ ne nnwuma a ɛde wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no hokwan, mmoa dwumadie, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw ano di kan wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Hyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne nhumu ho nkuran na wɔasiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔayɛ amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ne tumi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛmdibea adwumayɛfoɔ, wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ afoforo so, ne afoforo a wɔyɛ nsɛm ma amansan no, asɛdeɛ bɛn na ɛda wɔn so sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ama nsɛm a wɔka fa nna ho akwahosan ho no ayɛ nokware na agyina nnyinasosɛm a ɛtene so?
answer_twi_source: Asɛmdibea adwumayɛfoɔ, wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ afoforo so, ne afoforo a wɔyɛ nsɛm ma amansan no, asɛdeɛ fa nna mu apɔwmuden ho no yɛ nokware. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a wotumi gye di ansa na wɔakyekyɛ, wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa anaasɛ wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse de anya adwene anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔda anigyede biara a ɛbɔ abira anaasɛ sika a wɔde boa a ebetumi anya wɔn nkrasɛm so nkɛntɛnso adi, na wɔhyɛ nneyɛe ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a egyina adanse so ho nkuran ma wɔn atiefo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma me telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, intanɛt so mmoa akuw, ne wɛbsaet ahorow a ebetumi de nsɛm ama na ɛde mmabun ne adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho.
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo, kasa kyerɛ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bi wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm ho nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ, frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee), UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn, Marie frɛ wɔ 0302242517
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkitahodie ne adwumayɛkuo bɛn na ɛho hia na ama nwomasua ne tumi a wɔde bɛma ASRH mmɔdenbɔ akɔ soro wɔ ɔman ne wiase nyinaa, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no atumi abom ayɛ adwuma de anya nkɛntɛnsoɔ ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa?
answer_twi_source: Nnwumakuw ahodoɔ mu Nkɔmmɔdie: Aban ahodoɔ, NGO ahodoɔ, UN nnwumakuo, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ, ne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma ntam adwumayɛ ho hia paa wɔ nneɛma a wɔboaboa ano, nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ mu. Wiase Nyinaa Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Nsɛm a wɔka fa wiase nyinaa hwɛ hu sɛ ASRH da so ara yɛ ade titiriw wɔ amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, ɛma wonya sika ne amammui mu mmoa ma nhomasua ne tumi a wɔbɛma ayɛ adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya apomoden                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             ho ɔyaresafo a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ na ɔboa mmabun nna ne awo apomodenn ho ahiade ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ɔdemafoɔ a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Nhwehwɛmu: Hwehwɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa wɔ mmabun apomoden  anaa awoɔ ho dwumadie mu. Nyansahyɛ: Hwehwɛ nyansahyɛ fi nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa sukuu afotufo hɔ. Intanɛt so Nsɛmma Nhoma: Fa Intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma a ɛkyerɛw wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun apomoden  ho no di dwuma. Ayaresabea Nhwehwɛmu: Kenkan ayaresabea anaa wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma ho nsɛm na hwɛ sɛnea wɔyɛ no ne ayarefo abotɔyam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmere ne tebea ahorow bɛn na ɛfata a mede bɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho asɛmti no akyerɛ m’awofo?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ akwan ahorow bere a wo ne w’awofo nkutoo wɔ hɔ na mowɔ kokoam nsɛm, te sɛ bere a mote kar mu, bere a mobom reyɛ nnwuma, anaa bere a morekɔ nantew no. Kwati sɛ wobɛka asɛmti no wɔ adwennwen mmere mu anaa abusua no mufo afoforo anim na ama woanya baabi a ahotɔ wɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asuadeɛ bɛn na yɛbɛtumi asua afiri amanaman ntam sika ne nneɛma a wɔkyekyɛ ma ASRH ho nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdi mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbɛtumi de yeinom adi dwuma de ama daakye nnwuma atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdi mu a ɛfa amanaman ntam sika a wɔde ma ASRH ho no si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde sika bɛto mu daa, nnwuma ahodoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma bom, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi de nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a egyina adanse so di kan, hwɛ hu sɛ amammerɛ mu nkate, na wɔde mmabun ahiade di kan. Asuadeɛ a wɔasua no bi ne hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ nsakraeɛ, nsakraeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ wurayɛ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no a wɔde bedi dwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka asiane ahorow ho asɛm a memmu afoforo atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ anka wobɛbɔ sobo no, fa kasa a ɛfoa so di dwuma. Nhwɛso: ‘Sigaretnom betumi aseɛ nyinsɛn’ sen sɛ ‘Sɛ wonom sigaret a, wopira abofra no’. Dɔkota boa wo nso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdwuma bɛn na ayaresabea nnwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mmara hyɛfoɔ, ne mpasua so akannifoɔ die wɔ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho, aniwu ne animtiaabu a mmabun hyia no mu, na ɛkwan bɛn so na wɔbɛtumi ama pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ne atɛntrenee aba ɔmanfoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea nnwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mmara hyɛfoɔ, ne mpasua so akannifoɔ wɔ dwumadie titiriw bi a wɔdie wɔ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho aniwu ne animtiaabu a mmofra hyia no mu. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahyɛ pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee kɛse ho nkuran denam, obu a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm so, Wɔbɛtumi nso agyina pintinn ama mmara a ɛbɛyi akwansideɛ a ɛmma nnipa nsa nka ayaresa pa no afiri hɔ. Akyerɛkyerɛfo bɛtumi de nna ne awoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ a ɛgye obiara tom ba. Eyi bɛgye obiara suban ne ne su tom, asɔre atia nsɛmhun a wɔka fa nnipa ho, na wɔahyɛ obuo ama ankorankoro kwan ne wɔn gyinaesi ho nkuran. Mmara hyɛfo bɛtumi ahyɛ mmara a ɛbɛbɔ mmofra kwan ho ban na ama wɔanya nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan dwumadie ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ. Wɔbɛtumi nso asiesie ntontono a ɛwɔ ɔmanfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na wɔakyɛ nneɛma ama nkyɛmu a wɔagye wɔn atom no anya mmoa. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ bɛtumi ama tebea a ɛka nnipa nyinaa boa na wɔboa denam nkɔmmɔdie a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, wɔbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔbɛboaboa ano de adi animtiaabuo ne nyiyim ho dwuma yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi ahyɛ adwenemyare pa ho nkuran na wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛbɛboa mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Adwene ne akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛma, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde bu animtiaa, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso. Nnwuma a Wɔbɛnya: Afotuo dwumadie a wɔde ma wɔ beaeɛ hɔ, adwenemyareɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma so. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa Nhyehyɛeɛ: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ, afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ, anaa adwenemyareɛ akuo a asuafoɔ di anim a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahyɛ nkitahodie ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ ho nkuran. Yiyedi Dwumadie: Akwahosan dwumadiɛ, adwene mu nneyɛeɛ, ne adwennwene ano aduru ho akwan a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ne adesua akyi nhyehyɛeɛ ho. Awofoɔ ne Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwenemyareɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ, adwumayɛbea, ne mmoa akuo mu de ayɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma bom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kokoamsɛm  ho nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ bere a wɔde abɛɛfo ntentan apɔmuden ho nneɛma redi dwuma de asiw  nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ano na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan apɔmuden ho nneɛma de kokoamsɛm  di kan de bɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ankasa nsɛm ho ban na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛboa. Ebia nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ no bi ne: Nkitahodi akwan a ahobammɔ wom na wɔabɔ no kokoam, te sɛ nkrasɛm anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔabɔ no kokoam, a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no nkɔmmɔbɔ ne data ho ban. Ahintasɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den ne adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobedi wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ho nsɛm ho dwuma, de asie, na wɔabɔ ho ban. Nneɛma a wɔpaw ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔmmɔ wɔn din anaasɛ wɔmfa din foforo nni dwuma, baabi a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa a wɔrenna wɔn nipasu ankasa adi. Akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ ne nhyehyɛe a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛfata ho a wɔde besiw ɔhaw, ayayade, anaa nneyɛe a ɛmfata ano na wɔakura intanɛt so nnipa a wobu wɔn na wɔka wɔn nyinaa ho. Access controls ne kwan a ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi hwɛ wɔn kokoam nsɛm so, hwɛ wɔn a wobetumi ahwɛ wɔn profile anaa nkrasɛm, na ɛto data a wɔde kyɛ wɔn a wɔto so abiɛsa ano hye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya afotuo wɔ awoɔ mu nsɛm denam abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hu awoɔ mu nsɛm no bi ne sɛ wobedi brayɛ akyi, wɔbɛhwɛ nsakrae a ɛba awotoa mu nsu anaa nipadua a ɛwɔ ase no mu, na wɔahu nna a wɔde bɛwo awo de asiw nyinsɛn ano anaasɛ wobenya. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ, akwankyerɛ, ne mmoa ama wɔ akwan a wɔfa so hu awoɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma yie na wɔayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmabun nya nna mu nsɛm ho nimdeɛ 'CSE' anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aman pii wɔ bi ne ahyɛde no. Ghana nni bi seesei.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ mfe a wɔadi ho mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho a aborɔfo ka no 'age of consent laws'?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ mfe a wɔadi ho mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho no betumi akɔ nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow so akɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ. Ebia eyinom bi ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu afotufoɔ, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmerante ne mmabaa titiriw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛtumi agye amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nneyɛe pɔtee bi atom bere a wɔreyɛ aduruyɛ anaa nhwehwɛmu ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi agye amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nneyɛe pɔtee bi atom bere a wɔreyɛ aduruyɛ anaa nhwehwɛmu bere tenten a ennya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no so nkɛntɛnso denam: Ayarefo a wobebisa wɔn amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ne nneyɛe ne sɛnea ebetumi anya wɔn akwahosan so nsusuaso no so. Ahobrɛase ne kokoamsɛm ho akwan horow a wɔde bɛma bere a wɔreyɛ sɔhwɛ ahorow, te sɛ ntade a wɔde hyɛ wɔn ho anaasɛ abusua mufo a wɔbɛma wɔn kwan ma wɔaba hɔ sɛ wɔpɛ a. Akwankyerɛ anaa ayaresa nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛsakra no ma ɛne amammerɛ anaa nyamesom apɛde ahyia bere a ɛbɛyɛ yiye na ɛfata no. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akannifo anaa nsɛm asekyerɛfo a wo ne wɔn besusuw ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde obu ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfata bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na wɔhyɛ ɛhwɛ ntoasoɔ ase bere a w'agye haw mmoa 'crisis intervention' akyi?
answer_twi_source: Ɛgyina tebea/hiade no so. Wɔhyɛ aseɛ ntɛm ara de ma mmoa/si ano/ si ano sɛ ɛbɛ ba biom ano..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ Ɛfa wɔn awo akwahosan ne gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn nipadua ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan ahorow pii a ɛho hia wɔ wɔn awo apomoden ho, sɛnea amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan nhyehyɛe te sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Apam a Ɛfa Mmofra Hokwan Ho (UNCRC) ne apam afoforo kyerɛ no: Hokwan a Wɔwɔ sɛ Wonya Amanneɛbɔ: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata wɔn mfe. Hokwan a Wɔwɔ sɛ Wɔyɛ Nnwuma: Wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, a ɛfata mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa. Hokwan a Wɔpene So: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wosi wɔn ankasa nipadua ho gyinae, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene ayaresa so anaasɛ wɔpow ka ho. Hokwan a Wɔde Sie: Wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ mu, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn nsɛm sie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mpɔtam mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow (outreach programs) bɛtumi ne sukuu ne ayaresafoɔ ayɛ adwuma bom?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu nkabom adwumayɛ (School partnerships): wɔkɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu. Ayaresafo ne ahyehyɛde afoforo nkabom (Healthcare partnerships): Ne dɔkotafoɔ nyɛ adwuma na ma wɔntete wɔn. Mpɔtam kuw ahorow (Community organizations): Ne asɔre/kramo ne mmabun kuo nyɛ adwuma. Aban kuw (Government): Ne aban nyɛ adwuma hwehwɛ sika ne mmara pa. Nhwehwɛmu (Research): Yɛ nhwehwɛmu de hwɛ sɛ dwumadie no rekɔ yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa awofo anaa ahwɛfo ma wɔate mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ase yiye na wɔaboa wɔn mma yiyedi? (Nkyerɛkyerɛ wɛbsaet ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ ma awofo)
answer_twi_source: sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ne awofo akasa afa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. wobetumi anya mmoa afiri GHS-YMK fotufoɔ bi hɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (toll free) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a wonya fi atipɛnfo hɔ sen mpaninfo anaa tumidifoɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛwɔ so no bi ne: Nkitahodie: Atipɛnfoɔ betumi anya tema ama wɔn atipɛnfoɔ osuahun ahorow, na ama wɔanya beae a ahobammɔ wɔ na wommu atɛn. Ahotoso: Ebia mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm afi atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ wɔn mu ahotoso hɔ, na ɛbɛtew animtiaabu ne suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn no so. Atipɛnfo nhwɛso: Atipɛnfo betumi ayɛ nhwɛso pa, ahyɛ nneyɛe pa ne adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho nkuran. Tumi a Wɔma: Ebia mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi kɛse sɛ wɔbɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow no wɔ wɔn nsam bere a atipɛnfo a wɔte wɔn adwene ase boa wɔn no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetra mu nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso betumi aboa ma wɔadi asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsɛnnennen a ɛtrɛw te sɛ ohia a wɔbɛtew so, mmabun adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso boa ma wodi asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsɛnnennen a ɛtrɛw ho dwuma: Ohia a wɔtew so: Sɛ wɔde ahokokwaw a wobetumi atɔn, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya sika hyehyɛ mmabun a, ɛma wotumi yi wɔn ho fi ohia mu, boa wɔn mmusua, na wɔboa ma mpɔtam hɔ sikasɛm nya nkɔso. Mmabun adwuma a wonnya nyɛ: Ahokokwaw mu nsonsonoe a wɔbɛto mu, nsakrae a efi nhomasua mu kɔ adwumayɛ mu no a wɔbɛto ano, na wɔbɛhyɛ nnwumayɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa mu no tew adwuma a wonnya nyɛ so, brɛ asetra mu basabasayɛ ase, na ɛma sikasɛm mu ahotɔ. Mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ a enni hɔ: Mmabaa ne mmea a wɔde nhomasua, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow ma wɔn tumi no ma nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam wɔ sika a wonya, adwumayɛ, ne gyinaesi mu no so tew, na ɛma mmarima ne mmea nyinaa yɛ pɛ ne mmea tumidi. Nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ so daa: Sika a wɔde bɛto asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔsoɔ mu no ne Nkɔsoɔ a Ɛkɔ so Daa Botaeɛ (SDGs) no hyia, ɛhyɛ sikasɛm mu nkɔsoɔ a ɛka obiara ho, adwuma pa, ne asetena mu nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ so daa ma obiara ho nkuran, na ɛhwɛ sɛ obiara renka akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea ahorow yɛ kokoamsɛm ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Aane adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea ahorow taa yɛ kokoamsɛm ma mmabun. Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ahorow akyekyere wɔn a wɔde adwenemyare ma no sɛ wɔmfa kokoamsɛm nsie wɔ wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn no nsɛm ho, a mmabun ka ho. Nanso, nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛnyɛ kokoamsɛm, te sɛ bere a ɔhaw ahorow bi wɔ ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa afoforo ahobammɔ ho no. Wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔne wɔn adwenemyare ho ɔyaresafo no nsusuw kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ho na ama wɔate hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ ne anohyeto biara a ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm mu no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi de adi dwuma de aka me gyinaesi ne m’ahye ho asɛm yiye akyerɛ m’atipɛnfo ne me hokafo, a egyina nsusuwii a ntease wom ne m’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wugyina nsusuwii a ntease wom ne w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow so ka wo gyinaesi ne wo hye (boundaries) ho asɛm yiye akyerɛ w’atipɛnfo ne w’ahokafo a, fa nkitahodi a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ den di kan. Fa "Me" nsɛm no da wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate adi, na kyerɛkyerɛ nsusuwii a ɛwɔ wo gyinaesi ahorow akyi no mu. Bu afoforo adwene bere a wosi ahye ne nea wopɛ so dua denneennen no. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne ntease a ɛfa wɔn ho wɔn ho ho nkuran, na nya ɔpɛ sɛ wobɛdi nkitaho na woagyae mu bere a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na dijitaal akwan, abɛɛfo ntentanfidie, ne mfiridwuma di wɔ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Digitals platform ahorow ma akwan a wotumi kɔ so kyɛ nsɛm, nneɛma, ne osuahu ahorow. Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie ma mmabun tumi di nkitaho, hyehyɛ, na wɔboaboa wɔn ho ano twa nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho nyinaa ho hyia. Mfiridwuma betumi ama nhyiam ahorow a wɔyɛ no ntentanfidie ne ɔsatu ahorow ayɛ, na wɔadi asase mu akwanside ahorow so. Saa nneɛma yi ma mmabun nne yɛ kɛse, ɛma wotumi hu wɔn yiye, na ɛma wɔbom yɛ ade wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho. Ɛma mmabun a wofi asase ne amammerɛ ahorow mu tumi di nkitaho sɛnea ɛte biara na wɔkyɛ nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: STI nhwehwɛmu adwumayɛbea ahorow no yɛ kokoamsɛm dɛn, na mmabun betumi anya bi a awofo mpene so?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, STI nhwehwɛmu adwumayɛbea ahorow de kokoamsɛm di kan de bɔ ankorankoro kokoam nsɛm ho ban, a mmabun ka ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de kokoamsɛm ho mmara a emu yɛ den akyekyere wɔn, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wontumi mfa nsɛm biara a ɛfa STI nhwehwɛmu anaa nea efi mu ba ho nna adi a ɔyarefo no mpene so pefee, gye sɛ wɔ mmara mu tebea horow bi mu (te sɛ ɔyare mmoawa bi a wɔbɛbɔ amanneɛ akyerɛ ɔmanfo akwahosan mpanyimfo). Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun betumi anya STI nhwehwɛmu dwumadibea ahorow a awofo mpene so, titiriw sɛ wobu wɔn sɛ mmofra nkumaa a wɔn ho akokwaw anaasɛ mmara anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi ma kwan ma wɔyɛ kokoam akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ma mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ tema ne ntease ho nkuran wɔ ntease ahorow a ɛma obi yɛ mmerɛw no ho.
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ yɛkae sɛ mmerɛwyɛ taa fi tebea horow a obi ntumi nyɛ ho hwee mu. Ɔkwan a wobɛfa so anya tema ni: Hunu sɛ sɛ ɛnka ɛyɛ wo a: Hwɛ amaneɛ a wɔfam ne sɛnea ebetumi aka sɛnea wobetumi abɔ wɔn ho ban no ho. Fa w’adwene si tebea no so, na ɛnyɛ onipa no so: Nnyina baabi a obi fi anaa n’adwuma so mmu atɛn. Hu asetra mu nneɛma: Ohia, nyiyim, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a onnya betumi anya obi so nsunsuansoa kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ nna ne nna mu nneyɛe 'sexual behaviour' ho nya mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ho so nkɛntɛnso ' influence'?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Nkɛntɛnso 'Cultural influence': Amammerɛ mu Su: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ nna ho betumi akyerɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ho. Wɔ aman a wɔyɛ katee kɛse mu no, ebia mmara a emu yɛ den bɛba a ɛfa nna ho, bere a aman a wonya nkɔso kɛse no betumi anya mmara a ɛde ankorankoro ahofadi ne pene a wɔpene so di kan. Nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu: Ɔmanfoɔ gyinapɛn: Ɔmanfoɔ gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie, abusuabɔ, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho bɛtumi anya mmarahyɛ baguafoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo na wɔma nkurɔfo hu no betumi aboa ma wɔakasa atia amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow a epira a ɛma nyiyim kɔ so tra hɔ anaasɛ ɛto nna mu hokwan ahorow ano hye. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no yɛ adwuma de sesa amammerɛ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho de nya mmara mu nsakrae so nkɛntɛnso. Nnwumakuw a ɛwɔ fam ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe betumi ama nsakrae aba mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛda adwene ne ahiade ahorow adi yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ m’ani nnye amanne kwan so agumadi anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ho bere a meyɛ mmabun mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ amammerɛ mu agumadi anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ dwumadi ahorow n’ani nnye ho a, akwan foforo pii wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so akɔ so ayɛ nnam: Hwehwɛ Dwumadi Ahorow a Ɛnyɛ Amanne kwan so: Sɔ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ asaw adesua, akodi, abotan so foro, 'yoga', 'parkour', 'skateboarding', anaa 'rollerblading' hwɛ. Abɔnten so Akwantu: Nantew, sakre so akwantu, 'geocaching', anaa abɔde mu nantew betumi ayɛ akwan a ɛyɛ anigye a wobɛfa so ayɛ nnam wɔ abɔde mu. Fitness Adesua: Susuw ho sɛ wobɛsɔ kuw apɔwmuden adesua te sɛ 'Zumba', 'Pilates', 'kickboxing', anaa 'spin' adesua ahwɛ wɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa mpɔtam hɔ beae bi. Turoyɛ anaa wode wonsa yɛ biribi 'DIY' Nnwuma: Turo mu adwuma, adansi adwuma, anaa ofie nnwuma a wobɛyɛ no betumi ayɛ honam fam adwuma a ɛyɛ nwonwa. Anigyede a Ɛyɛ Den: Fa wo ho hyɛ anigyede ahorow a ɛfa kankyee ho, te sɛ mfoninitwa nantew, nnwom a wɔsaw, anaa video so agodie a ɛyɛ nnam mu. Adwuma a Wotu Wɔn Ho Ma: Hwehwɛ hokwan ahorow a wode betu wo ho ama wɔ mmeae a wɔyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ ahotew anaa mmoa atrae. Ofie Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Di apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ video anaa app ahorow a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so a ɛfa w’anigye ho di akyi, sɛ́ ɛyɛ asaw, akodi, anaa nipadua mu duru apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ. Agumadi a Ɛma Wotumi Yɛ nsakrae: Sɛ wowɔ nipadua mu sintɔ anaa dɛmdi ahorow a, hwɛ agumadi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma wotumi sesa wo ho a ɛfa tumi ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asetena ne amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma nkorɔfo nnya nna mu yiedie a ɛfata no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ: Suban a ɛnteɛ ne nsɛm a edi mu a wonnya betumi ama adwene atu afra ne aniwu. Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wobetumi anya kakraa bi: Sukuu pii mfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ mma, na ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa nnya nimdeɛ. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom hyeɛto ahorow: Amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ mmara a emu yɛ den wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho, na ebetumi apira obi. Mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a enni hɔ: Tumi a ɛnkari pɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmarima ne mmea ntam no betumi ama wɔanya nna mu osuahu ahorow a ɛnyɛ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔanya akatua a ɛfata afiri wɔn adwuma mu, na akwan bɛn na wɔbɛfa so sɛ wosusuw sɛ wɔrentua wɔn ka yie?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn nsa bɛka akatua a ɛfata denam: sɛ yɛnyim akatua kitiwaa no ho nimdeɛ: Obu a wɔbɛde ama akatua kitiwaa a mmara ahyɛ da ama wɔn mfeɛ anaa mpɔtam hɔ. Akatua nhoma a wɔbɛhwɛ mu: Akatua nhoma a wɔbɛhwɛ mu daa de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔatua wɔn sika pɛpɛɛpɛ ama nnɔnhwerew a wɔadi adwuma ne overtime biara. Nsɛm a wɔbɛsusu ho: Sɛ mmabun susue sɛ wɔntua wɔn sika pɛpɛɛpɛ a, wɔbɛtumi ne wɔn wura anaa nnipa ho nsɛm dwumadibea asusu ho, deɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔadi adwuma nnɔnhwerew dodoɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔadi dwuma.Mmara ho afotuo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ wɔne adwuma wura no nsusu ho a, mmabun bɛtumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afiri adwumayɛfoɔ kuo ho mmara ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa mmara ho mmoa bea de asiesie akatua mmara sobu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na CSE di wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira a wɔsɔre tia no mu?
answer_twi_source: CSE di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu denam mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira a wɔkasa tia ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa ahorow ahorow ne nnipa a wɔka bom a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Ɛhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wonnye atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho kyim na ɛhyɛ ntease a ɛne sɛ obiara, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho, fata hokwan ahorow, hokwan ahorow, ne obu a ɛyɛ pɛ no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛka obiara ho na asuafo nyinaa betumi anya bi, a wɔn fibea, wɔn nipasu, anaa nea wotumi yɛ mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahodoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka SRH nwomasua ho denam: Adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsɛm ne nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama adesua akwan ne ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ ahyia. SRH nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛfata mfeɛ a wɔadi, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛda asuafoɔ nyinaa nokwasɛm ne suahunu adi. Mmeae a ahotɔ ne mmoa bɛbɔ a asuafo bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbisa nsɛm, wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi, na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa. Nneɛma foforo a wɔde bɛma, te sɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, afotu adwuma, anaa nneɛma a wobetumi anya wɔ kasa anaa akwan horow pii mu, de adi ahiade ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na sɛ nsabuo berɛ ɛrebɛ so a na meyem hyehye me?
answer_twi_source: Yie ɛnyɛ ade foforɔ koraa. Ɛyɛ berɛ a nsakraeɛ ba wɔ honam fam ne nkate fam nyinaa, na ɛyɛ ahosu a sɛ wosuro a ɛnyɛ nwanwa. Ebia wobɛhaw wo ho wɔ sɛnea afoforɔ behu wo afa, sɛdea wo nipadua bɛsesa, anaa sɛdea wobɛfa osuahunu foforɔ mu no ho. Kae sɛ obiara fa saa nsabuo yi mu, na aka mpaninyɛ ho. Sɛ wo ne mpanyimfoɔ anaa wo nnamfo a wogye wɔn di bɛkasa ɛfa saa nsabuo yi ho betumi aboa ma dadwen so ate.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi wɔ nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ ne ahokokwaw nkɔso a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ mmabun mu ɛfa wɔn ASRH nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ a Wɔkyɛ: Atipɛnfo nhomasua ma mmabun tumi sua biribi fi wɔn ho wɔn ho hɔ wɔ tebea a wobetumi aka ho asɛm na wɔboa wɔn mu. Afotufoɔ de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma, wɔkyɛ osuahu na wɔma atipɛnfoɔ tumi ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ. Ahokokwaw Nkɔso: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ne afotufo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, gyinaesi, ne asɛm a wɔka no denneennen, na aboa mmabun ma wɔadi ASRH ɔhaw ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛ digital citizenship ba ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛyɛ ahokokwaw a ɛho hia a wɔde fa intanɛt wiase no mu?
answer_twi_source: Adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ (digital citizenship) kyerɛ sɛ nipa bɛfa ɔkwan a ɛfata na ɛyɛ nokware so de afidie nimdeɛ adi dwuma; eyi bi ne abɛɛfo ntentan, ntanɛt, ne afidie ahorow a yɛde nante nkitahodi mu. Abasɛm ntentan mu nhwehwɛmu (media literacy) nso kyerɛ sɛ obi bɛnya tumi de anya nsɛm, ayi mu ateetee, asusuw ho, na wakyerɛw nsɛm ahorow wɔ ntentan no so. Saa nimdeɛ yi ho hia paa na ama yɛatumi anante ntentan yi so wɔ ahobammɔ, asɛyɛdeɛ, ne nkɔsoɔ mu. Eyi boa nnipa, titiriw mmabun, ma wɔtumi yi nsɛm mu teetee, wɔde wɔn ho bom yɛ ntentan so adwuma, na wɔboa ma ntentan so nkabom yɛ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho anaa nna mu adwumadi a wɔtwentwɛn so no boa ma asiane so tew?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi nna mu anaasɛ wɔtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase a, ɛboa ma asiane nso tew denam asiane a ɛwɔ STI ne HIV a ɛbata nna ho a woyi fi hɔ anaasɛ wɔkyɛ so. Sɛ obi twe ne ho fi ho a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbɛkwati nna mu dwumadi biara, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a ɔde ne ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu, awotwaa mu, ne anom nna ka ho. Sɛ wopaw sɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi nna ho anaasɛ wobɛtwentwɛn nna mu kosi sɛ wubesiesie wo ho na wo ne ɔhokafo a onni ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu yare ne HIV nni ɔyere biako ntam abusuabɔ so no, wotew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya ɔyare no so kɛse. Bio nso, twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho no ma ankorankoro nya bere sua nna mu akwahosan ho ade, nya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, na wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu nneyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi abɛɛfo ntentan (social media) nhyɛso ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini a ɛnyɛ nokware ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kasa tia nea wuhu: Mpɛn pii no, abɛɛfo ntentan da abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware adi. Fa w’adwene si w’ankasa abusuabɔ so: Mfa w’abusuabɔ ntoto afoforo a ɛte sɛ nea wɔyɛ pɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no ho. Gye w’ahome wɔ sohyial media so: Sɛ ɛrema wote nka bɔne wɔ w’abusuabɔ no ho a, san w’akyi. Wo ne wo hokafo nkasa: Munsusuw sɛnea mfonini ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ sohyial media so ka wo ne mo abusuabɔ no ho. Fa w’adwene si asetra mu nkitahodi ankasa so: Fa bere pa ma wo hokafo na fa w’adwene si fapem a emu yɛ den a wobɛkyekye so wɔ w’abusuabɔ mu. To nsɛm dodow a wokyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so a ɛfa mo abusuabɔ ho no ano hye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de ntetee a wɔde siesie ntawntawdi ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow ahyɛ wɔn adesua nhyehyɛe, dwumadi ahorow a ɛnyɛ adesua akyi, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔma mmabun tumi de ahokokwaw ne ahotoso a wɔde bedi atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi mu nsɛnnennen ho dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahodoɔ, mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de ntawntawdie ano aduru nteteeɛ ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ ahyɛ wɔn adesua nhyehyɛeɛ, adesua akyi dwumadiɛ, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔka wɔn ho denam: Ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka ho: Ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua ho denam adesua a wɔatu ho ama, adwumayɛbea, anaa module ahorow so. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo a wɔde bɛma: Hokwan a wɔbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo anaa afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si ntawntawdie ano aduru ne gyinaesie ho nimdeɛ so. Ntetee adwumayɛfoɔ: Nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mmabun adwumayɛfoɔ, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ akwan a wɔfa so siesie ntawntawdie ho de boa mmabun yie wɔ atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ ne gyinaesie nsɛnnennen ho dwumadie mu. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ntawntawdie ano aduru nhyiamu, mmoa akuo, anaa nhyiamu a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmabun so bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ pene a mɛpene so sɛ, me ne ɔhokafo bi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, wowɔ ho kwan sɛ wopene so sɛ wɔnyɛ nna mu kyɛfa. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wo ne wo hokafo pene so sɛ, wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma. Nhyɛso a wode bɛda anaasɛ woremfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano nni dwuma bere a wopɛ no nyɛ nea wogye tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho no mu na wɔasusuw ho yiye, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akamfo ananmusifo a egu ahorow, ɛka obiara, na ɛma tumi kyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho no mu na wɔasusuw ho yiye denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wobenya so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wobegye nkrasɛm a wohyia no ho kyim, wobesusuw nea ɛkanyan wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm akyi, na wɔahu animhwɛ ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛwɔ hɔ. Wobetumi akamfo ananmusifo a egu ahorow, ɛka obiara, na wɔma tumi denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔbɛboa a ɛkyerɛ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no suahu ahorow pɛpɛɛpɛ, afrɛ nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyim a epira, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nkuranhyɛ mu na ama nsakyeraeɛ kɛseɛ aba, a ɛbɛdi nnuane ne adan pa a mmofra nnya no ntini anaa nnyinasoɔ ho dwuma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsɛm a wɔka de hyɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛfa nea ɛde aduan ne adan mu ahobammɔ a enni hɔ ba no ntini ho nkuran denam: Nhwehwɛmu ne nhomasua: Nsɛm a wɔbɛboaboa ano, nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ne ɔmanfo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea aduan ne adan mu ahobammɔ a enni hɔ abu so ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so no betumi ama wɔanya mmoa ama nhyehyɛe ano aduru. Nkabom-kyekye: Wɔne ahyehyɛde afoforo a wɔko ma afoforo, mpɔtam hɔ akuw, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bɛyɛ apam de ama nne ayɛ kɛse, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔako ama nhyehyɛe a wɔde di kan a wɔbom yɛ. Mmarahyɛ bagua: Aban mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn, nhyehyɛe ho nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔkyerɛw, na wɔadi adanse wɔ asɛnnibea ahorow de akamfo mmara ne sika a wɔde bedi aduan anhweatam, adan a ne bo yɛ den a ɛho yɛ na, ne nsɛm a ɛfa ho ho dwuma. Nnipa a wɔboaboa wɔn ano: Nhyiam ahorow, ɔsɔretia, nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw ɔsatu, anaa sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de aboaboa ɔmanfo mmoa ano na wɔahyɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo sɛ wɔnyɛ ho biribi wɔ aduan ne adan a enni hɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na nyinsɛn ne awo ho hwɛ a edi mũ hwehwɛ ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka nyinsɛn ne awo ho hwɛ a edi mũ a wɔde ma mmabun ho ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde hwɛ mmabun ansa na wɔawo, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn daa, wɔhwehwɛ wɔn mu, na wɔboa no wɔ aduruyɛ mu de hwɛ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn ne akokoaa no nyinaa apɔwmuden. Ɛsan nso ka nhomasua, afotu, mmoa adwuma, ne awo akyi hwɛ a wobenya de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a ɛfata, awo, ne nsakrae akɔ awofoyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside bɛn na ɛmma ankorankora ntumi mfa wɔn ho nnye mu sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi akwanside ahorow yi so de ayɛ ho biribi?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow a ɛmma ankorankora ntumi mfa wɔn ho nnye mu sɛ ahwɛfo wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho mu no betumi ayɛ aweredi ho suro, sɛnea wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu yiye ho adwenem naayɛ, ankorankoro ahobammɔ ho dadwen, asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛmma wɔmfa wɔn ho nnye mu, ne anibiannaso a wɔn a wɔhwɛ no anaa asɛyɛde a wɔtrɛw mu. Mmabun betumi adi akwanside ahorow yi so denam wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛfa wɔn a wɔhwɛ no ho, sɛnea wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen ne ahotoso a wɔde bedi dwuma, nkitahodi ahorow a ɛboa a wɔbɛkyekye, ne amammerɛ mu su horow a wɔkasa tia a ɛma wɔyɛ komm anaasɛ wɔnyɛ hwee no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi akwahosan ho nsaiakyibaa (insurance) a wonni ma mmabun mmusua mu aba, te sɛ sikasɛm mu ahokyere, ɛka a wɔboaboa ano, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia a wontumi ntua ho ka?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu ahokyere: Sɛ wonni akwahosan ho nsiakyibaa (insurance) a, mmusua betumi ahyia ɛka kɛse a efi wɔn kotoku mu wɔ ayaresa, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu yare, nnuru, ne ayaresabea a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ ho, na ebetumi ama wɔaboaboa ɛka ano anaasɛ wɔabɔ ka. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia a wobetumi anya kakraa bi: Mmabun a wonni nsiakyibaa (insurance) betumi akyɛ anaasɛ wɔagyae ayaresa a ɛho hia, ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano, anaa nhwehwɛmu esiane ɛka ho haw nti, na ɛde wɔn akwahosan mu aba ne wɔn yiyedi nyinaa ato asiane mu. Asiane a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu mu: Nyarewa a emu yɛ den, opira, anaa akwanhyia betumi de ayaresa ho ka kɛse ne sikasɛm mu ahokyere aba mmusua a wonni nsiakyibaa (insurance) so, na ama ayɛ den sɛ wobetua ayaresa a egye ntɛmpɛ anaa ayaresa titiriw ho ka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun yɛ kokoamsɛmu? Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbɔ kokoamu nsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun de kokoamusɛm di kan de hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda no adi. Wɔnam akwan horow te sɛ: Ahintasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so bɔ kokoamu nsɛm ho ban: apomoden ho adwumayɛfo di kokoamunsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den ne mmara kwan so mmara ahorow so, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde mmabun ankasa apomoden ho nsɛm sie. Mpene a wɔde ma ne nea wɔda no adi: Wɔbɔ mmabun amanneɛ wɔ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie ho ansa na wɔanya ɔhwɛ, na wonya wɔn pene ansa na wɔde nsɛm biara akyerɛ afoforo. Ankorankoro nkɔmmɔbɔ: Mmabun nya hokwan ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo kasa wɔ kokoam nkɔmmɔdi adan mu, baabi a nkɔmmɔbɔ yɛ kokoamsɛmu na afoforo ntumi nte. Kyerɛwtohɔ a ahobammɔ wom: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow de ɛlɛtrɔnik akwahosan ho kyerɛwtohɔ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma de bɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ban na amma obiara antumi ankɔ anaasɛ wɔremfa nkyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na social media ka mmabun adwene wɔ nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipadua ho?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo Nkɛntɛnso (nsɛm a wɔkyɛ). Ntotoho (a ɛnsɛ). Amanneɛbɔ Fibea (ebia ɛnyɛ nokware). 'Body Image' (sɛdeɛ yehu yɛn ho).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ kwan bɛn na yɛfa so hwɛ adwene mu apɔmuden (mental health) ma mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ pii wɔ akwan a wɔfa so boa  hwɛ adwene mu apɔmuden. ebi ne: Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ ne abusuafoɔ. Abɛɛfo ntentan ne sɛ wobisa amanfoɔ mpanyimfoɔ ne ahenfo hɔ nsɛm
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi adi de aboa mmabun a wɔapira wɔn anaa wɔayɛ basabasa no?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, ahwɛfo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi de atenka fam mmoa ama, atie a wonni atɛn, aboa ma wɔanya nneɛma ne nnwuma, akamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow, na wɔayɛ tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn suahu ahorow adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahu na wɔakasa atia nsɛm a epira anaa nnaadaa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti a wɔda no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan ahorow adi dwuma de ahu na wɔakasa atia nsɛm a epira anaa nnaadaa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, te sɛ: Adwene ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ ne nsɛm foforo a wobenya afi mu. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo adebɔfo atirimpɔw ne wɔn nhyehyɛe ahorow a wogye ho kyim. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a nkrasɛm ne gyinabea ahorow a ɛwɔ ase no mu nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛkyɛ ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛko atia denam mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ de gyina nkurɔfo akyi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔbea ahorow a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho a ɛhyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini a edi mu na obu wom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho bere a, meresisi nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho gyinae no? (ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, tebea horow, daakye botae ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Eyi yɛ obi ankasa gyinaesi, na nneɛma pii betumi anya so nkɛntɛnso (Influence). Nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Wo Gyidi ne Wo Gyidi: Susuw wo gyidi wɔ nyinsɛn, awofoyɛ, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho. Wo Tebea: Susuw sɛnea wotena ase mprempren, sika fam ahonyade, ne sɛnea wubetumi ahwɛ abofra no ho. Wo Daakye Botae Ahorow: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn ne awofoyɛ betumi aka wo nhomasua nhyehyɛe anaa adwuma a wopɛ sɛ woyɛ?
