Wo Atinka Mu Yiyedi: So woasiesie wo ho ama nkate fam nsɛnnennen a ɛba nyinsɛn anaa awofoyɛ mu no? Nyinsɛn no Akwahosan: Sɛ wunim a, susuw akokoaa no akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na intanɛt anaa mfiridwuma a obi tumi kɔ anaa ontumi nkɔ ho nsonsonoeɛ ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no ka mmabun tumi a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa bɔbeasu ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden (SRH) ho mu, wɔ intanɛt so nkuranhyɛ, mpɔtam a wɔbɛbom ayɛ, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt anaa mfiridwuma a obi tumi kɔ anaa ontumi nkɔ ho nsonsonoeɛ ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no betumi asiw mmabu kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ intanɛt so nkuranhyɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho a ɛfa bɔbeasu ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden (SRH) ho mu: Akwan a ɛsiw kwan; Telefon anaa kɔmputa anaa intanɛt a obi ntumi nnya no siw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ intanɛt so nsɛm mu na wɔanya SRH ho nsɛm. Sikasɛm mu nsonsonoeɛ: Mmabun a wɔfiri mpɔtam a wɔnhwɛ wɔn yie anaa sikasɛm mu nni yie no na saa nsonsonoeɛ yi ka wɔn paa, na ɛma SRH ho nimdeɛ ne mmoa a wɔbɛnya no mu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no mu yɛ den koraa. Baabi a obi wɔ ho nsɛm: Baabi a ɛwɔ akyiri (kyerɛ sɛ nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri) betumi anya intanɛt anaa mfiridwuma ho nneɛma a enni mu koraa, na ɛno nso siw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ intanɛt so nkuranhyɛ ne mpɔtam a wɔbɛbom ayɛ ho dwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuanso bɔne anaa asiane ahorow bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan ahorow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no wɔ nsunsuanso bɔne ne asiane ahorow a ebetumi afi mu aba. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Akwan a ɛma nipadua no yɛ adwuma te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano anaa nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano no betumi de ɔhaw ahorow te sɛ nausea, tiyaa, anaa su mu nsakraeɛ. Ebia nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wotumi dannan mu a ɛyɛ adwuma bere tenten (LARC) te sɛ IUD ahorow no wɔ asiane ahorow a ɛbata nea wɔde hyɛ mu ho, te sɛ ɛyaw anaa ɔhaw ahorow. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo susuw nsunsuanso bɔne ne asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ho ansa na woapaw ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano de hwehwɛ nea ɛfata w’ankorankoro ahiade ne w’akwahosan ho nsɛm yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, atipɛnfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo di wɔ mpɔtama egye "LGBTQ+" mmabun no to mu?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ mmabun betumi anya mmoa afi akyerɛkyerɛfo, atipɛnfo, awofo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ wɔ wɔn akwahosan, atinka ne asetra mu ahiade ahorow mu. Nanso, esiane sɛ saa dwumadi ahorow yi yɛ nsɛmmɔnedi nti, wɔabara sɛ wɔkamfo nkurɔfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na skuul yɛ de bɔ asuafoɔ ho ban na ama wɔanya baabi a wɔbɛtumi aka wɔn adwenem haw ho asɛm na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa a wɔnsuro sɛ obi bɛbu wɔn atɛn anaa wɔbɛka wɔn anim?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoamu (afutufo). Ko tia animka anaa nyinyimu 'stigma'. Nnamfo mmoa (peer support). Nkyerɛkyerɛ. Bammɔ a ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Telehealth so akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, telehealth so akwahosan ho dwumadie pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ahiadeɛ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛkasa afa awoɔ ano aduru ho afotuo ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn. STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa akwankyerɛ. Nyinsɛn ho afotu ne mmoa. Adwene mu akwahosan ho afotu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa brayɛ, nkitahodie pa, ne pene a wɔpene so ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ebetumi afi nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a wonni a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ama mmabun mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Nea ebefi mu aba no bi ne: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STIs). Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobehu awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho sɛnkyerɛnne anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ aduruyɛ mmoa wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu. Nkɛntɛnso bɔne a ɛba adwene ne nkate mu yiyedi so esiane adwene mu naayɛ, ehu, anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nti. Suban a epira a nsɛm a ɛnteɛ nya so nkɛntɛnso, te sɛ nna a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔmfa ahobammɔ nni dwuma anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho to akwan a entu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano so. Mmabun nyinsɛn a ɛkɔ soro, nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho a ɛkɔ soro ne owu a ɛba mmeawa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔn nnipadua atɔ sin?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ahwehwɛ intanɛt so ahwehwɛ akuw a wɔhwɛ nnipadua ho sintɔ ahorow so wɔ Ghana. Wubetumi nso akɔ amanaman ntam akuw te sɛ ‘International Disability Alliance’ ne ‘CBM’a wɛbsaet ahorow so akɔhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so anya nsɛm ne mmoa, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun apomoden ho Intanɛt so nneɛma ne wɛbsaet Afotu dwumadie ne mmoa akuo Atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrepere abusuabɔ ho nsɛm anaasɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔne wɔn ntam ɛpene wɔ abusuabɔ mu, a atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, afotu adwuma, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma, te sɛ sukuu afotufo, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow. Saa nneɛma yi ma kokoam mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne beae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asusuw abusuabɔ ho nsɛm anaa asetra mu nkitahodie a atwa ho atenka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitirie a ɛwɔ media nimdeɛ mu a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho, te sɛ ntease a ɛwɔ animhwehwɛ mu, nimdie farabae ho nhwehwe mu, ne nkrɔfo adwenekyerɛ mu nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Ntease a ɛfa animhwehwɛ ho: Mmabun sua sɛ wobehu na wɔasusu animhwɛ a ɛwɔ media nyikyerɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho mu, a amammerɛ, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna, ne adwene mu animhwehwɛ ka ho. Nneɛma a wobetumi agye adi a wobehu: Wɔnya ahokokwaw a wɔde behu nsɛm a wobetumi agye adi, te sɛ akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din, nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu, ne aban website ahorow, de ahwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so. Akwan a wɔfa so twetwe nkorɔfo adwene mu nhwehwɛmu: Media ho nimdeɛ kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun akwan a wɔfa so twetwe nkorɔfo adwene a wɔde di dwuma wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ, social media, ne media ahorow mu de nya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho so nkɛntɛnso. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne atenka mu anigyede, adansedi, ne nkamfo a wɔte ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nhyɛso fa obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne sɛnea obi bu ne ho animu, titiriw wɔ mmaabun mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi anya nhyeso bi wɔ mmabun no ho nkɔso ne sɛnea wosusuw wɔn ho no so denam adwene a wɔsakra wɔ asetra mu gye a wogye wɔn tom ne nea wɔfata ho no so. Ebia mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ nea wɔn atipɛnfo hwɛ kwan na ama wɔagye wɔn atom anaasɛ wɔagye atom, na ebetumi ama wɔn ankasa nipasu a ɛyɛ nokware no asɛe. Obu pa a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne adwene a emu yɛ den a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔyɛ ne ho no betumi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛbɔ ne ho ban fi atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye a obegyae ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ ankorankoro ahyeɛ a wode besi hɔ ne obu ama afoforo ahyeɛ wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ nea broni ka no 'intimate' mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Ka w’ahyeɛ ahorow a ɛfa honam fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, nkitahodi, ne nkate fam a wode wo ho hyɛ mu ho no ho asɛm pefee. Bu wo hokafo no ahye na tie wɔn haw anaa wɔn ho a ɛnyɛ dɛ. Sɛ wotwa ɔhyeɛ bi a, ka senea ɛyɛ wo na hyɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔbu wo wɔ abusuabɔ no mu dendennnden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wɔtu gu wɔ ayaresabea a ahobammɔ nnim mu? (asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya ɔyare mmoawa, nsɛnnennen, akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den) .
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea ahorow a ahobammɔ nnim, a mpɛn pii no wonni tumi krataa a ɛfata ne adwumayɛfo a wɔfata no betumi de akwahosan ho haw ahorow a emu yɛ den aba: Asiane a Ɛkɔ Anim a Ɛwɔ Nyarewa Mu: Tebea horow a ɛho ntew betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ɔyare mmoawa no akɔ soro. Nsɛnnennen: Aduruyɛ a ɛmfata betumi ama mogya atu, atu nyinsɛn a enni mũ, anaasɛ awo akwaa asɛe. Akwahosan Ho Nsɛnnennen a Anibere wom: Wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu no, saa nsɛnnennen yi betumi ama obi akɔ ayaresabea anaasɛ obewu mpo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ mmoa akuo (CBOs), mmoa adumayɛfoɔ a wɔboa wɔ ahokyere mu (humanitarian agencies), ne mpɔtam hɔ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ di wɔ awo mu apɔmuden (SRH) nnwuma ne mmoa a wɔde ma mbabaa a wɔwɔ mbeaeɛ a ɔko rekɔ so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadie a wɔde ma: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ, nnipa mmoa adwumakuo, ne mpɔtam hɔ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ di dwuma titire wɔ SRH dwumadie ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeaeɛ a ntawntawdie aka no mu. Wɔtaa yɛ adwuma wɔ baabi a ɛbɛn mpɔtam a ɛka wɔn no na wɔne mpɔtam hɔfo anya ahotoso ne abusuabɔ, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya SRH ho nsɛm, afotu, ne ɔhwɛ. Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ: Saa ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nnwumakuo yi tumi sesa wɔn dwumadie no ma ɛne mmabun ahiadeɛ pɔtee ne amammerɛ tebea hyia wɔ mmeaeɛ a ntawntawdie wɔ, hwɛ sɛ SRH dwumadie no yɛ nea ɛfata mmabun, ɛyɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛyɛ nea wotumi nya. Tumi a wɔbɛma: Wɔsan nso de wɔn ho hyɛ tumi a wɔbɛma ayɛ adwuma mu de atete mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛfoɔ, ahyɛ SRH dwumadie ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ mpɔtam a ntawntawdie aka wɔn no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm a wɔka de si so dua anaasɛ kasasin pa a mede ka me ho a metumi de adi dwuma de ama obuo a mewɔ ma me ho no ayɛ kɛse na makyerɛ sɛ mewɔ ahotoso kɛse wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ woka wo ho so dua anaa nsɛmfua pa a wode ka wo ho di dwuma na ama wo ho a wobu no ayɛ kɛse na fa ahotoso kɛse si wo ho so wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu. Tia nsɛm a wɔde si so dua te sɛ "Mewɔ hokwan sɛ misi m'ahye so dua" anaa "adwene ne m'atenka yɛ nokware" de hyɛ wo gyidi a wowɔ wɔ wo ho ne wo tumi a wode di nkitaho denneennen no mu den. Fa nsɛm pa a wɔde si so dua si ankasa ho asɛm a enye ananmu de twa ankasa ho adwenem naayɛ ho kyim na woanya ahotoso wɔ wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ mintumi ntua ayaresa anaa afotuo nsoɛ a - so akwan fofro bi wɔ hɔ a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka  so wɔ  fam? (mpɔtamu hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, sukuu nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: adwene mu apomoden yareɛ ho dwumadie no, ɔman no akwahosan ho insurance na ɛtua ho ka. kɔ w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfoɔ adesua, nnwuma a mmabun di anim, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so betumi adi wɔ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn pa a ɛfa pene, nipadua mu ahofadi, ne nna mu obuo ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu akuo a ɛtrɛ a ɛhwehwɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee betumi aboa mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi na wɔahyɛ no den?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, nnwuma a mmabun di anim, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ so di dwuma titire wɔ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn pa a ɛfa pene, nipadua mu ahofadie, ne nna mu obuo ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam: Mmabun Akannifoɔ: Wɔma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa tumi ma wɔmfa akannifoɔ dwumadie wɔ nhyehyɛɛ ne dwumadie a ɛhyɛ pene ne abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa Nkitahodiɛ: Hyɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ a mmabun bɛtumi akyɛ osuahu, nimdeɛ, ne nneɛma a ɛfa pene, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Nsɛm a Wɔkamfo ne Nhumu: Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu mu de kasa tia amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, animtiaabu, ne nyiyim a ɛma basabasayɛ ne pɛyɛ a enni mmarima ne mmaa ntam no kɔ so tena hɔ. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Yɛne asetena mu akuo a ɛtrɛ a ɛhwehwɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee nyɛ biako de hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn pa a ɛfa pene ne nna mu obu ho nkuran no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenepa betumi aboa me ma me ne afoforɔ anya abusuabɔ a mfaso wɔ so kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a wode bedi dwuma no ma nnipa ntam nkitahodi tu mpɔn denam sɛnea wutumi tie asɛm yie, nya afoforɔ tema, na wode ayamye ne nokware boa no tu mpɔn no so. Ɛdenam mprempren bere mu nhumu a wode bedi dwuma so no, wubetumi ama wo ne afoforɔ ntam abusuabɔ ayɛ kɛse denam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne osuahun ahorow a wobɛkyɛ mu, a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu koraa no so. Adwene mu nsusuii ma su horow te sɛ boasetɔ, gye a wogye tom, ne atɛn a wonni, a ɛho hia na ama wɔanya abusuabɔ a ahotoso ne ntease wom no nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Awansideɛ anaa sɛ ɔhaw bɛn na ɛwom sɛ worehwɛ ahunu sɛ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no reyɛ adwuma na wɔredi so pɛpɛɛpɛ nso?
answer_twi_source: Akwansideɛ a ɛwɔ hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bedi dwuma yiye no bi ne hokwan ahorow a wonni ho nimdeɛ, nneɛma a ɛnnɔɔso mma nnwumakuw a wodebɛhwɛ woredi mmra so, akuw ahodoɔ a wɔsɔre tia, nneɛma anaa akadeɛ ɛbɛma wɔtumi de wɔn ani adi akyire yie a ɛrennɔɔso, ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ ntetee a wɔde ma mmara ho adwumayɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow betumi adi nneɛma a ɛtaa de adwennwen ne nsɛmdenden a sukuufo fa mu, te sɛ adesua mu nhyɛso, asetena mu ntawntawdi, anaa abusua mu nsɛm ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi adi adwennwen ne nsɛnnennen a ɛtaa ba a asuafo hyia ho dwuma denam akwan horow te sɛ: Adesua mu mmoa dwumadie te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ, adesua ho nimdeɛ nhyiamu, ne berɛ a wɔde di dwuma ho nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma de aboa asuafoɔ ma wɔadi adesua mu nhyɛsoɔ ho dwuma. Ntawntawdi ano aduru nhyehyɛe, atipɛnfo ntamgyinafo, ne asetena atinka mu adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma de ahyɛ atipɛnfo abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran na wɔatew asetra mu ntawntawdi so. Abusua mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma, awofoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma so de di abusua nsɛm ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ abusua ne sukuu fekubɔ mu den. Adwennwen a wɔtew so dwumadi ahorow, adwene mu nneyɛe, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome a wɔde bedi dwuma de aboa asuafo ma wɔagyina adwennwen ne dadwen ano. Sukuu amammerɛ a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho a ɛde adwene mu apomoden ne yiyedi di kan, na ɛhyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nneyɛe a ɛhwehwɛ mmoa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nokwasɛm ne ayɛsɛm ntam bere a nsɛm no fa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛm a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so anaa nea efi nnamfo hɔ ba. Afotu bi a ɛbɛma woahu nokwasɛm afi ayɛsɛm mu ni: Fibea: Hwehwɛ info fi ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din hɔ. Nyansahu mu adanse: Nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ka nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu ahorow ho asɛm. Cross-checking: Fa nsɛm toto nneɛma ahorow a wogye di ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ sɛ mmubuafo a wohu wɔn, wogye tom, ne hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ me sukuu, mpɔtam, ne akyirikyiri?
answer_twi_source: Kyervkyerɛ anaa Trɛw Nhumu: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa abɛɛfo ntentan ɔsatu ahorow de ma nkurɔfo hu hokwan ahorow a mmubuafo wɔ. Nsɛnnennen Ho Nsusuwii Ahorow: Kasa tia nsusuwii hunu a enye a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho. Boa Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Hokwan Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Fa wo bere ma anaasɛ fa ntoboa ma ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo mmubuafo hokwan ahorow kyerɛ. Lobby for Inclusive Policies: Kamfo nhyehyeɛ a ɛboa ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wo sukuu, mpɔtam, ne aban mu no tumi kɔ hɔ na wɔka wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna mu nyarewa "STI" ne HIV a wɔansa no betumi aka obi akwahosan wɔ bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nyarewa "STI" ne "HIV" a wɔansa no betumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba obi akwahosan so wɔ bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu. Wɔ bere tiaa mu no, nna mu nyarewa "STI" ahorow a wɔansa no betumi de nsɛnnennen te sɛ "pelvic inflammatory disease" (PID), awo a wontumi nwo, ɛyaw a enni sabea, ne asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya "HIV" no aba. "HIV" a wɔansa no betumi ama nipadua no mu tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa no ayɛ mmerɛw, na ama nipadua no ayɛ mmerɛw kɛse sɛ obenya ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde hokwan ne kokoram ahorow bi. Wɔ bere tenten mu no, "HIV" a wɔansa no betumi akɔ so abɛyɛ AIDS, tebea a ɛma nipadua no tumi ko tia nyarewa a emu yɛ den na asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obenya ɔyare mmoawa ne nyarewa a ɛde ne nkwa to asiane mu. Enti,  Nna mu nyarewa "STI" ne "HIV" a wobehu ntɛm na wɔasa no ho hia na ama wɔakora akwahosan so na wɔasiw ɔyare mmoawa a ɛbɛkɔ so no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden aboafo nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɛna mu apomoden ho haw ahorow so na wɔanya nnwuma ne mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow de adi ɛnamu apomoden ho haw ahorow ho dwuma: Sukuu afotufo anaa ayarehwɛfo betumi de nsɛm ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ama. Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow taa de awo apomoden ho nnwuma ne afotu ma. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne intanɛt so nneɛma te sɛ Anidaho sɛ wobɛyɛ awofo 'Planned Parenthood' de awo akwahosan ne baabi a wobenya nnwuma ho nsɛm ma. Mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow ma mmabun kwan ma wɔne afoforo a wɔrehyia tebea horow a ɛte saa ara di nkitaho. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa abusuafo betumi de mmoa ama na wɔaboa ma wɔafa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho bere a yɛrepaw nna ho nneɛma? (sɛ nhwɛso no, nkate fam ahosiesie, asiane ahorow, nkitahodi) .
answer_twi_source: Nkate ne honam fam ahosiesie: So wote nka sɛ wɔahyɛ wo anaasɛ wuntumi nsi pi? Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛtwɛn akosi sɛ wubesiesie wo ho wɔ nkate ne honam fam. Nkitahodi: So wubetumi ne wo hokafo aka w’ahiade ne w’ahye ho asɛm pefee? Asiane: So wunim asiane a ɛwɔ STI ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da mu? Siw nyinsɛn ano: So wowɔ nhyehyɛe bi a wode besiw nyinsɛn ano sɛ wopaw sɛ wo ne obi bɛda a? Ahobammɔ: So wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ na wo ho tɔ wo wɔ wo hokafo nkyɛn?
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan anaa nneɛma a etu mpɔn a afotufo betumi de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsusuwii a emu dɔ, ahotoso wɔ wɔn ho, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI ano a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ pa ho wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso anim?
answer_twi_source: Akwan anaa nneɛma a etu mpɔn a afotufo betumi de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsusuwii a emu dɔ, ahotoso wɔ wɔn ho, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI ano a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ pa ho wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso anim no bi ne: Nsɛm a ɛfa dwumadi a wɔde di dwuma: Afotufo de wɔn ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow mu de di nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den, pow a wɔpow ho nimdeɛ, ne gyinaesi a wɔyɛ wɔ tebea horow a ɛyɛ nokware mu. Nsɛm a wɔde ma: Afotufo de nna mu akwahosan, abusuabɔ, ne hokwan ahorow ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma, na ɛma mmabun tumi ma wogyina nokwasɛm ahorow so paw nneɛma a ɛfata sen sɛ wobegyina atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso so. Nsusuwii a ɛhyɛ nkuran: Afotufo hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wonsusuw wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, botae ahorow, ne ahye ahorow ho, na ɛboa wɔn ma wonya wɔn ho adwene a emu yɛ den ne ahotoso wɔ wɔn gyinaesi tumi mu. Sɛ wɔkyekyere ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano: Afotufo boa mmabun ma wɔkyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano denam sɛnea wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn sɛnea wogyina ano, akwan a wɔfa so di adwennwen ano, ne akwan pa a wɔfa so ka wɔn ho asɛm de di haw ne akwanside ahorow so nkonim no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi agyina pintinn na wɔapɛ mmoa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ pii a ɛfa sika dwumadie ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ne wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi agyina pintinn apɛ mmoa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ pii a ɛfa sika dwumadie ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔ, denam nneɛma a edidi soɔ yi so: Sɛ wɔbɛma nnipa pii ahunu sɛ sika ho nimdeɛ ho hia paa. Sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ animdefoɔ abira na wɔde sika dwumadie ahyɛ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn ankasa nsɛm ne osuahu a wɔanya de akyerɛ sɛ sika ho nkyerɛkyerɛ hia obiara, a abusua a wofi mu anaa asetra mu sikasɛm tebea mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa di wɔ 'STI ne HIV' a wosiw ano mu, na ɛhe na mmabun betumi anya nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa di dwuma titiriw wɔ 'STI ne HIV' a wosiw ano mu efisɛ ɛma ankorankoro hu wɔn tebea na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔhwehwɛ ayaresa wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu. Mmabun betumi anya nhwehwɛmu dwumadie wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ, a ayaresabea, mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛeɛ, abusua nhyehyɛeɛ ayaresabea, ne 'STI' ayaresabea ahodoɔ ka ho. Ebia sɔhwɛ dwumadie bi nso nam sukuu, mmabun mmeaeɛ, anaa akwahosan asoɛeɛ a wɔde fa baabiara so nso bɛnya. Bio nso, wobetumi anya afie mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hwɛ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ahorow bi te sɛ 'HIV ne chlamydia' a wobetumi atɔ wɔ nnurutɔnbea anaa Intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nna mu apɛwmuden ho nhwehwɛmu ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ no kokoam?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde nna mu apɛwmuden ho nhwehwɛmu ne nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam ma mmabun wɔ mmeae a wɔde akwahosan ho nnwuma ma. Wubetumi akɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea biara a ɛyɛ mmabun de mu kwa akɔyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, afotu ne akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo a ebia wubehia. wɔtaa de nnwuma no ma a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee. Sukuu ayaresabea ahorow: Sukuu ahorow bi wɔ ayaresabea ahorow a ayarehwɛfo anaa afotufo a wobetumi de nnwuma ama anaasɛ wɔde wɔn akɔma nkurɔfo wɔ hɔ. Telehealth services: Akwahosan nhama bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma wotumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ kasa wɔ intanɛt so anaa telefon so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne bɔbea dwumadi 'gender roles' ahorow ne abusuabɔ ho no nya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso wɔ mmabun so?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Nsunsuanso 'Cultural Impact': Bɔbeasu mu gyinapɛn "Gender norms": Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn a ɛhyɛ atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow mu den no betumi asiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne pene a wɔpene so ho ano. Ebia mmeawa behyia animtiaabu esiane sɛ wɔhwehwɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe nti. Abusuabɔ mu Akwanhwɛ: Amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa abusuabɔ ho, te sɛ aware a wodi ntɛm anaa nhyɛso a wɔde bɛwo mma no betumi anya nyinsɛn ano aduru ne awo a wɔpaw no so nkɛntɛnso. Mmarimaa betumi anya nkrasɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ne asɛyɛde ho. Nsunsuanso a Ɛnya wɔ Nea Efi Mu Ba So: Akwanside ahorow: Ebia amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow besiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne nyinsɛn ano ho no kwan. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔansua wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho no betumi de ntease a ɛnteɛ ne nneyɛe a epira aba. Tumi a wɔde ma: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkasa tia atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow na ɛma mmeawa tumi ma wɔpaw nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ a ɛfata paw no betumi ama nneɛma pa afi mu aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔn a wɔwɔ social media so no fa asɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwɛso ama mmabun wɔ wɔn nna mu nneyɛe, nipadua mfonini, ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini mu no so?
answer_twi_source: Social media fo yɛ asɛdeɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwɛso ma mmabun no mu denam: Suban pa, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nipadua mfonini, ne abusuabɔ ho a wɔyɛ ho nhwɛso so. Wɔn ankasa osuahun ahorow, apereperedi, ne nkɔso a wɔbɛda no adi pefee, bere a wɔhyɛ obu ma wɔn ho, ahyeɛ, ne gyinaesi a ɛfata nso ho nkuran. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛmu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ ASRH nsɛmti mu ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu, ahyɛ wɔn atiefo no adwene a ɛyɛ katee ne wɔn ho a wosusu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔadu wiase nyinaa akwahosan ne nkɔso botae ahorow a ɛtrɛw te sɛ amansan akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyeɛ ne nhyehyeɛ boa ma wɔnya wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ne nkɔsoɔ botaeɛ a ɛtrɛ, te sɛ amansan akwahosan ho dwumadie ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ, denam mmabun a wɔma wɔnya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie pa, tumi a ɛma wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho, ne nnipa hokwan ne asetena mu atɛntrenee nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔma ɛkɔ anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɔkwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ sikasɛm mu mmoa de hwehwɛ nhomasua ne ntetee no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɔkwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ sikasɛm mu mmoa de hwehwɛ nhomasua ne ntetee no mu: Sukuu afotufo: Sukuu afotufo betumi de nsɛm a ɛfa sika a wɔde ma, mmoa, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wobetumi apaw a ɛwɔ hɔ ho ama, aboa wɔ akwammisa nkrataa ho, na wɔde akwankyerɛ ama wɔ ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa fata ho. Intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔkora so: Wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔkora so, te sɛ mfiri a wɔde hwehwɛ sika a wɔde boa adesua ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma no ma mmabun tumi hwehwɛ sika hokwan ahorow a egyina wɔn adesua mu anigye, wɔn tebea, ne sikasɛm mu ahiade so. Nhyiamu: Nhomasua asoɛeɛ, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne nnwumakuo a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ taa yɛ nhyiamu, anaa nsɛm ho nhyiamu a ɛfa sikasɛm mu mmoa ne sika a wɔde di dwuma ho akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ sika ho. Sikasɛm mu mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow: Mpɛn pii no, kɔlege ahorow, sukuupɔn ahorow, ne adwumayɛ sukuu ahorow wɔ sikasɛm mu mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de mmoa a ɛfata ama wɔ sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe no mu, ntease a ɛfa fata a wɔfata ho, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wobenya ho. Atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ: Mmabun nso bɛtumi ahwehwɛ afotuo ne mmoa afiri atipɛnfoɔ a wɔatumi abisa sika fam mmoa anaa sika a wɔde bɛboa wɔn no hɔ na ebia wɔbɛtumi akyɛ afotuo, nneɛma, ne nhumu a ɛfiri wɔn ankasa suahunu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo ne m’abusuafo aka hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu ho asɛm wɔ obu mu? (nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho hia) .
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho asɛm a wo ne nnamfo ne abusuafo bɛka ho asɛm no betumi ayɛ nea emu yɛ den. Sɛnea wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a obu wom ni: Nkitahodi a Wɔabue Mu: Fa asɛnka agua no si hɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ komm na ɛda adi pefee. Ma wonhu sɛ wopɛ sɛ woka biribi a ɛho hia ho asɛm. Fa W’adwene Si Kyɛfa So: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea enti a nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho hokwan ahorow ho hia wo wɔ ɔkwan a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tiawa so. Yɛ asotie: Tie wɔn adwene a wontwa mu. Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte wɔn adwene ase, sɛ wo ne wɔn adwene nhyia mpo a. di nkitaho yiye denam ɔkwan a ɛfata so Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Obu: Fa w’adwene si nsɛm a wobɛkyɛ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom so. Mma nnya obi ho asɛm anaa mfa edin bɔne mfrɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa ne biakoyɛ di wɔ asetra mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ osuahu ahorow, ahwehwɛ afotu, na wɔasua biribi afi wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene mu. Dwumadi ahorow a wɔbom yɛ no hyɛ kuw adwumayɛ, nkitahodi, ne tema ho nkuran, na ɛhyɛ nnipa ntam nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ mu den. Atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow ma mmabun a wɔn mfe akɔ anim tumi som sɛ nhwɛsofo na wɔde akwankyerɛ ma atipɛnfo nkumaa, na ɛma wonya mpɔtam hɔfo ne abusuabɔ ho adwene. Mmabun te nka sɛ atipɛnfo a ebia wɔrehyia ɔhaw a ɛte saa ara no agye wɔn atom na wɔte wɔn ase, na ɛtew atenka a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho no so na ɛma wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi de akwankyerɛ ama me wɔ sɛnea me ne m’awofo befi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase afa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afi ase de biribi te sɛ, "Maame/Papa, mewɔ nsɛmmisa bi fa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere/ brayɛ/nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho, na na mewɔ anidaso sɛ yebetumi abom aka ho asɛm." Sɛ wo ho yera wo a, wubetumi nso adi kan akyerɛw wo nsɛmmisa no na wode aba nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mepɛ sɛ mebɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa mmonnaato ho amanneɛ a, dɛn akwan a metumi afa so?
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wode nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa mmonnaato ho amanneɛ kyerɛ polisifo. Wobetumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔabu nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no ho akontaa. Wubetumi nso abɔ ho amanneɛ wɔ sukuu mu sɛ esii wɔ hɔ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akuo bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun di anim a wɔkasama  mmebun nna ne awo akwaahosan kankorɔ ahorow ho a metumi akɔka ho? (Akwan a ɛfata mfe a obi adi a wobɛhwehwɛ a wobɛfa so de wo ho ahyɛ mu)
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo kasa kyerɛ akwaa apɔmuden adwumayɛbea bi betumi aboa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔada nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu yiye, na ɛyɛ nokware, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛtete saa?
answer_twi_source: Ebia nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini, a eye na ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, nsɛm a wobisabisaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nsɛm a efi akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din so. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛtete saa denam akwahosan ho ahyehyɛde ahorow a wotumi gye di a wobedi akyi wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so, wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din a wɔde ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛkɔ, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadi ahorow anaa nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔ "television" anaa nsɛm a wɔde fa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ahyɛ awo ho atɛntrenee ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ awo mu atɛntrenee ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu no bi ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow, intanɛt so nneɛma, ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim, ne fekubɔ a wɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a edi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a edi mu wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ akwan a wotumi nya mu, atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow, mmubuafo ahyehyɛde ahorow, intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, ne telefon so akwahosan ho nnwuma so. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nsɛm ma wɔ akwan horow a ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ahorow betumi anya so, te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Braille, nkyerɛwee akɛse, ɔdio, ne mum kasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ agyinaeɛsie ahodoɔ a ɛto wɔn wɔ nna ne awoɔ ho akwanya mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi: Dɔm 'youth advisory councils'. Kɔ mpɔtam nhyiamu (meetings). Yɛ volunteer. Yɛ 'advocacy'. Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ (feedback).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan ne kɔmputa so akwahosan mmoa a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ (STI) ne HIV ho no, yɛbɛtumi de yɛn ho ato so anaa yɛbɛtumi anya mu ahotosoɔ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware deɛ?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan ne kɔmputa so akwahosan mmoa a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ (STI) ne HIV ho no, ne nokware ne ne mu ahotosoɔ gyina baabi a asɛm no firi ne nea ɛwɔ mu. Ɛho hia pa ara sɛ wode wo ho to mmoa a ɛfiri mmeaeɛ a ahotosoɔ wɔ, te sɛ aban akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow, nnuruyɛ fapem, ne akwahosan ntentan ahorow a agye din so. Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet ne app ahorow a: Wɔgyina nyansahu mu nnyinaso ne nhwehwɛmu a animdefoɔ apene so so na ɛyɛe.Wɔakyerɛ nea ɔkyerɛwee ne baabi a sika a wɔde yɛe no firiiɛ pefee.Wɔde nhoma ne nsɛm a wɔatwe aka ho na ama nkyerɛkyerɛ no anya nnyinaso.Wɔma nsɛm foforo a wɔasusu ho mpɛn pii a ɛne nnɛ yi akwahosan mmara ne akwan pa a wɔfa so si STI ne HIV kwan hyia..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwene mu nhumu ne me ho a mehu betumi aboa me ma mahu atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye na mayɛ ho biribi yiye?
answer_twi_source: Dua sɛnea wobɛte wo ho so: Nya wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne wo nipadua mu nkate horow ho nimdeɛ, na ama woatumi ahu berɛ a worehyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛnyɛn a wode w’adwene bua. Gyina kakra na susuw ho: Gye berɛ kakra na susuw tebea no ho ansa na woabua, na ma wo hokwan sɛ wubesusuw ho sɛ ebia adeyɛ a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa no ne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia anaa. Fa adwene mu gyinaesi di dwuma: Fa wo ho hyɛ adwene mu nneyɛe te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa adwennwen mu de si wo ho so na fa pefeeyɛ ne adwene di atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɛnanom akwaa apɔmuden, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun te ase?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnanom akwahosan kyerɛ nnipa akwahosan wɔ nyinsɛn, awo, ne awo akyi bere. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun te ase efisɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn ankasa yiyedi nko na ɛka, na mmom ɛka wɔn mma a wɔbɛba daakye nso. Ɛnanom akwahosan a wɔte ase no boa mmabun ma wɔpaw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho na esiesie wɔn ma nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom bere a wɔasiesie wɔn ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) ne nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun a wɔde bɛma no bɛtumi abrɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔ bɔne a ntawntawdie nya wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ so no ase?
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ a wɔde ma: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) ma mmabun nya wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛma wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata na wɔfa nneyɛe pa wɔ nsɛnnennen a ɛfa ntawntawdi ho mpo mu. Nnwuma a wobenya: Nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun ma mmabun nya kwan a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ kokoam, a ɛnyɛ atemmuo mu, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, nyinsɛn a wɔyi gu a ahotɔ nnim, ne nna mu nyarewa (STI) a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu no so. Adwene ne asetra mu mmoa: Saa nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu yi nso de adwene ne asetra mu mmoa ne afotu ma de di mmabun a ntawntawdi aka wɔn no nkate ne adwene mu akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ho dwuma, na ɛhyɛ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne yiyedi ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ne mmabun adi anim ayɛ a ɛkyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ sɛnea wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm mu yie, na ɛsan ka kyerɛ nsɛmtwerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnyɛ wɔn adwuma yie wɔ awoɔ ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne blog ahodoɔ a mmabun di anim, sohyial media ɔsatuo, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ a wɔyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm, wɔyɛ nhyiamu, anaa wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde ko ma nsɛm mu de ma nkurɔfoɔ te nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho na wɔhyɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, a ɛka obiara ho nkuran. Nnwuma a ɛwɔ fam nso betumi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, sukuu ahorow, ne apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo ayɛ biako de ahyɛ wɔn nkrasɛm no mu den na wɔako ama nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe mu na ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔka ho asɛm no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de mfiridwuma, social media, ne digital akwan adi dwuma de ama wɔn kasa adu akyire, na w'ate internet so akuokuo, ama wɔn a w'annyaa wɔn ti annini (victims of sexual violence) mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu, a wɔn asasesin anaa baabi a wofi mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de mfiridwuma, social media, ne dijitaal platforms adi dwuma ama nne akɔ akyiri, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔakyekye virtual communities a ɛde nsɛm, validation, ne mmoa ma wɔn a w'annyaa wɔn ti annini mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu, a wɔn asasesin anaa baabi a wofi mfa ho. Wobetumi ayɛ intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, nkɔmmɔbɔ akuw, anaa social media nkratafa a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛka nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano, wɔn a w'annyaa wɔn ti annini mu mmoa, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho. Ɛdenam tumi a ɛwɔ social mu basabasayɛ mu a wɔde bedi dwuma so nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ɔsatu, hashtag, ne intanɛt so dwumadi, mmabun betumi ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akasa atia animtiaabu, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no hokwan ne yiedi Bio nso, wobetumi ne mpɔtam hɔ akuo ahorow ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɛ biako de ayɛ intanɛt so nneɛma, website ahorow, ne nsɛm a esisi a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu ne wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho no tumi yɛ adwuma. mmabun betumi ayɛ mmeae a obiara ka ho na wotumi kɔ hɔ ma ayaresa, mpɔtam a wɔbɛkyekye, ne asetena mu nsakrae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nna ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe yɛ kokoamsɛm ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm yɛ ade titirie a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔde ma mmabun mu. Bere a kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo anaa adwumayɛbea biara mu no, mpɛn pii no mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya kokoam hwɛ. Mpɛn pii no, mmara ne adwumayɛfo nneyɛ pa gyinapɛn ahorow kyekyere akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo sɛ wɔmfa kokoamsɛm nsie wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm ho, a nsɛm a ɛho hia a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ka ho. Nanso, wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nsusuw kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔte hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm mu no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ sɛ wɔwɔ asɛmmisa fa SRH ho nanso wɔtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔbɛgye mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyɛseɛ agye nsemnsem efiri abɛɛfo ntetan a yetumi de yehu to wonso anaa nwoma sua nneɛma. Ɔmobetumi nso agye mmoa wɔ mpanyinfo a wogye wɔn di, tesɛ ahwɛsofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa ayaresamafoɔ aa wobetumi aboa na akyerɛkyerɛ aa wɔnmmu wo fɔ. Ebiom, kokuamu atorɔfo ahoma ne abɛɛfo so kasa betumi awɔ baabi a mmabun betumi abisa nsem aa obiara ehu sɛ ɛyɛ ɔmo, broni bɛkasɛ 'anonymously'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena mu nsɛm anaa nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu a media ho nimdeɛ ama mmabun tumi ako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso, akasa atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a epira, na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn asua biribi afi nhwɛso ahorow yi mu de ama me media ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu tebea ɛwɔ media nimdeɛ boa ma mmofra tumi gyina wɔn mfɛfo nhyɛso ano, di media nneyeɛ a ɛyɛ hu ho dwuma, na wɔsi gyinaeɛ a emu da hɔ wɔ nna ne nyinsɛn ho no bi ne sɛ, wɔbɛhu sɛ nnipa a wɔhyɛ nnipa ho nkuran wɔ nkratafa ho nsɛm mu ne wɔn a wɔagye din no de ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn a ɛmfata a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no, na wɔrempene so. Wɔreboa ama nnipa soronkoyɛ aba adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu a emu yɛ den wɔ Intanɛt so de hu sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho nsɛm wɔ hɔ, na wɔhwehwɛ adanse ahorow a edi mu a wɔde gye di de si gyinae wɔ nyinsɛn a wɔkwati, STI a wɔkwati, ne ɔbaa ne ɔbarima nna mu nsɛm ho. Wɔde nkratafa a wɔde di dwuma de hyɛ nsɛm ho nkuran na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛsesa amanyɔsɛm a ɛfa mmofra ne mmabun nna ho nsɛm ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So tebea pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɔ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun so amanneɛ wɔ ɔbabun bi akwahosan ho nsrahwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebia tebea pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɔ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn so amanneɛ wɔ ɔbabun bi akwahosan ho nsrahwɛ ho, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho haw ahorow mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no, sɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi gye di sɛ ɔbabun bi wɔ asiane mu sɛ wobepira no anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ no ayayade a, ebia mmara bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ eyi ho amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata anaasɛ wɔbɔ ɔbabun no awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ no amanneɛ na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔbabun no ahobammɔ bɛba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so hwehwɛ nsunsuanso ne nea efi atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ba wɔ mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden so?
answer_twi_source: Fa botae ahorow a emu da hɔ si hɔ: Kyerɛkyerɛ botae pɔtee ne nea ebefi mu aba ama afotu nhyehyɛe no, te sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, adwuma ho ahosiesie ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn, anaasɛ sohyial network ahorow a wɔbɛtrɛw mu. Boaboa nsɛm ano: Bisa nsɛm fi afotufoɔ ne wɔn a wɔrekyerɛ wɔn kwan no hɔ daa de hwɛ wɔn suahunu, kyerɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtu mpɔn, na susu sɛdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no tu mpɔn wɔ ne botaeɛ a wɔdi ho dwuma mu. Di nkɔsoɔ akyi: Hwɛ nkɔsoɔ a wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no nya wɔ berɛ mu denam nhwehwɛmu, nsɛmbisa, ne wɔn ankasa nhwehwɛmu so, di nsakraeɛ a ɛba wɔ nimdeɛ, ahokokwaa, suban, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dawurubɔ ɔsatu ahorow a eye na ɛma tumi a ɛhyɛ suban, nneyɛe, ne nkitahodie a ɛfata a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nkuran no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Dawurubɔ ɔsatu ahorow a ɛyɛ papa na ɛma tumi hyɛ suban, nneyɛe, ne nkitahodie a ɛfata a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ho nkuran denam animtiaabu a wɔkasa tia, nnipa a wɔka bom a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde ma so. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne ɔsatuo a ɛtwe adwene si pene a wɔpene so, nipadua mu nneɛma pa, ne nkɔmmɔdie a ɛbu animtiaa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm te sɛ STI ne nyinsɛn ano aduru ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ a enni apɔwmuden anaa ayayade wɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkitahodie a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade bi ne: Suban a wɔbɛhyɛ so, te sɛ baabi a wɔhwɛ so anaasɛ wɔbɛtew wɔn ho afi nnamfo ho Nsɛm anaa nkate mu ayayade, te sɛ animtiaabu, ahunahuna, anaa nsakrae Nipadua mu basabasayɛ, te sɛ ɔhwe, piapia, anaa siw ano Nna mu nhyɛso anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ ɔhokafo no nkate ne osuahu ahorow a wɔma ɛyɛ mmerɛw anaasɛ wɔbɛma ayɛ ketewaa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma m’awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow, efi me pɛ mu, na nhyɛso anaa nyiyim biara nni mu?
answer_twi_source: Nwomasua: Sua nneɛma foforo dabiara fa awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ho, a emu bi ne kwan a wɔfa so si awoɔ ano, nna mu nyarewa, ne wo ho kwan ahorow. Hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ firi mmoaedua a wotumi de wo ho to soɔ so te sɛ ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, wɛbsait a ɛyɛ nokware, anaa mpanyimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm so. Bisa nsɛmmisa; sɛ wonnim biribi a, mma w’aba mu mmu, bisa dɔkta anaa afotufoɔ.Gye w’adwene di: Sɛ wote nka sɛ biribi nnante yie a, tie wo koma na hwehwɛ mmoa anaa hwehwɛ dɔkta foforo biara. Hu wo ho kwan ahorow; sɛ wuhu wo ho kwan a, ɛbɛma woanya ahoɔden na woatumi agyina hɔ ama wo ho, na woahu berɛ a obi rebu wo ho kwan so.Hwehwɛ mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ obi rehyɛ wo sɛ yɛ biribi a wompɛ a, hwehwɛ mmoa firi obi a wogye no di, afotufoɔ, anaa akuo a wɔgyina hɔ ma nnipa ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ama atipɛnfo a ebia wɔ rebrɛ wɔ wɔn adwenemyare no?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ma wɔn aso a etie, ma tema, na si w’atipɛnfo atenka so dua. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔnka wɔn adwene a wonni atɛn na kae wɔn sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Fa mmoa a mfaso wɔ so ma wɔ nneɛma a wobɛkyɛ anaasɛ wo ne wɔn bɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nna mu apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ne nea ɛnyɛ atemmu de asusuw nna mu ɔhaw ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam Hɔ Nna mu Akwaahosan Ayaresabea: Saa ayaresabea ahorow yi yɛ nna mu akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw na wɔde kokoam nnwuma ma. Wɔde nhwehwɛmu, afotu, ne ayaresa ma wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ho. Sukuu anaa sukuu pɔn Akwaahosan Dwumadibea: Nhomasua asoɛe pii wɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ma. Mpɛn pii no, wɔwɔ adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi adi nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma. abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so Nneɛma: Telemedicine dwumadie ma wo kwan ma wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ di nkitaho wɔ akyirikyiri. abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow bi de kokoam nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ma wobisa nna ho nsɛmmisa. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa abɛɛfo beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) betumi aboa ma wɔadi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma Mpɔtam Ayaresabea anaa Mpɔtam Akwahosan Asoɛe ahorow: Saa mmeae yi taa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ayaresabea anaa animdefo. Wɔde nnwuma ahorow ma wɔ kokoam tebea mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na wɔn ankasa aduruyɛ di wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ adwenemyare mu, na dɛn ne akwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔfa so gyina ano?
answer_twi_source: Ankasa aduruyɛ kyerɛ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma de gyina adwenemyare anaa sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ano. Mmabun a wɔwɔ adwenemyare betumi adan akɔ nnuru so sɛ ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so abrɛ ahoyeraw ase anaasɛ wɔadi sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow te sɛ dadwen anaa adwenemhaw ho dwuma. Nanso, obi ankasa aduruyɛ betumi apira obi na bere kɔ so no, ebetumi ama adwenemyare no mu ayɛ den. Akwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔfa so gyina ano no bi ne: Ɔfotufo, ɔyaresafo, anaa adwenemyare ho oduruyɛfo a wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ de adi adwenemyare a ɛda adi no ho dwuma. Sɛ woresua na wɔde apɔwmuden a wɔde gyina ano ho nimdeɛ te sɛ ahomegye ho akwan, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, apɔ mu ateneatene, ne adebɔ mu nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma. Nnamfo, abusuafo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de nkate fam mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ama no mmoa nkitahodi a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛkyekye. Dwumadi ne anigyede ahorow a ɛde anigye ne abotɔyam ba mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, na ɛhyɛ yiyedi nyinaa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen ne akwanside bɛn na wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuw hyia wɔ ASRH botaeɛ a ɛkɔ anim mu, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔatumi adi yeinom so de ahwɛ sɛ nkitahodiɛ ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛtu mpɔn wɔ wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no ntam?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen a wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuw ahorow hyia wɔ ASRH botae ahorow a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu no bi ne nneɛma a ɛsono nea wɔde di kan wɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no mu, nneɛma a wonni, ne amammui mu nkate a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi saa nsɛnnennen yi so no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no de nkɔmmɔbɔ, adwene a ɛwɔ hɔ, ne obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho di kan. Nkitahodi akwan a emu da hɔ (nkitahodi ho mfoniniyɛ ho hia), nhyiam a wɔyɛ no daa, ne nhyiamu ahorow a wɔkyɛ de sesa nsɛm betumi ama nkitahodi ne biakoyɛ a etu mpɔn aba ahokafo ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne deɛ wɔde boa nkurɔfo wɔ hɔ 24/7, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya bi wɔ ahohia bere mu, a anwummere, nnawɔtwe awiei, anaa nnapɔnna ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Ɛwɔ Hɔ ne ɔkwan wɔ ho: Mpɛn pii no, ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne deɛ wɔde boa nkurɔfo wɔ hɔ 24/7, na ɛhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun betumi anya mmoa bere biara a wohia, sɛ ɛyɛ anwummere, nnawɔtwe awiei, anaa nnapɔnna. Mmabun betumi anya wɔn wɔ bere ɔfrɛ nɔma a wontua hwee, text message a wɔde bɛmena, anaasɛ wɔafi ase abɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ Intanɛt so denam wɛbsaet dwumadie anaa mobile app so. Nhwɛso bi ne, AgooSHE + platform
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Meyɛ dɛn aboa asi nkabomde ne amammerɛ mmuae kwan fa 'culturally responsive approach' wɔ nna mu akyerɛkyerɛ ne awoɔ apɔmmuden wɔ mpɔtam no mu?
answer_twi_source: Kasa ma a aborɔfo ka no sɛ 'advocacy': Kasa ma nna mu nkyekyerɛ dwumadie wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hyia mu beae. Yɛ Nhyehyeɛ ma adwumadi bea 'organize workshops': Yɛ nhyehyeɛ ma dwumadie a epia nteaseɛ ne obuo ma adwen ahorow. Tu wo ho si hɔ: Tu wo ho si hɔ ne nkuo aa w'aa adwen si nna mu apɔmmuden ne ahokwan ma nnipa dodow a wɔn mmu wɔn. Twe adwen si: Fa abɛɛfo ntetan, posita, ne mpɔtam dwumadie twe adwen si nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ. Mmoa akwan ahorow a aborɔfo frɛ no 'Support Initiatives': mmoa kwan ahorow aa botae ne sɛ wobɛ ma ammamerɛ kwan pa nna mu adesua ne awoɔ apɔmmuden dwumadie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya akwan a mɛfa so agyina abɛɛfo ntentan so nsɛnnennen ne asiane ahorow ho dwuma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Gyae na dwen ansa. Kasa kyerɛ obi. Te bere a wode to nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba so. Yɛ nneɛma wɔ fie (offline) a ɛma w'ani gye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ, nhyɛso, ne ayayade ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow no di nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ, nhyɛso, ne ayayade ho dwuma denam nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ pene, ahye, ne nkitahodie pa ho no so. Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun ma wohu na wɔkasa tia nneyɛe a epira, wɔte hia a obu ne ahofadi ho hia wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu ase, na wosua akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa sɛ wonya nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ɔhaw anaa wohu a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mɛte mmerɛ a medi wɔ me telefon so ne abɛɛfo mfidie so wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Set Limits: Fa mmere pɔtee a wode bedi dwuma wɔ mfidie no so na di so. Yɛ Mmeae a Tech-Free: Kyerɛ mmeae te sɛ pia mu na yi mfidie a ɛbɛgye wo mmerɛ fi hɔ. Fa  Apps te sɛ screen time a ebetumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma. Gye Ahomegye: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma wogye w’ahome daa fi screen ahorow so na ama w’ani ne w’adwene agye w’ahome. Fa Wo Ho Hyehyɛ Dwumadi Ahorow a Ɛnyɛ Intanɛt So Mu: Wobetumi ne wo nnamfofoɔ apue akɔ abɔnten adi dwuma nnhia mfidie. Ma nna ho nhia wo, mmannsɛe wo mmerɛ wɔ smart phone so ansaana w'ada.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asotwe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma ayaresafoɔ a wɔyi kokoam nsɛm adi?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wobu kokoam nsɛm so anaasɛ wontumi nni kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ so no betumi asotwe (disciplinary action), aban mu nsɛm (legal consequences), anaa tumi krataa a wɔbɛhwere. Ahintasɛm a wobu so no sɛe ahotoso na ebetumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa daakye
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anammɔn a ɛwɔ hɔ ma adwuma bi a woafi ase, na nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa saa nhyehyɛe yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a wɔfa so fi adwuma bi ase no bi ne: adwuma ho adwene anaa hokwan bi a wobehu, gua so nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ de asusuw ahwehwɛde ne akansi ho, adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a ɛkyerɛ botae ahorow, akwan ahorow, ne sikasɛm ho nkɔmhyɛ, sika anaa sika kɛse a wɔde bɛto mu, adwumayɛkuw no a wɔbɛkyerɛw wɔn din na wɔanya tumi krataa anaa tumi krataa a ɛho hia, wɔde adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛho hia, na wɔahyɛ nneɛma anaa nnwuma no ho nkuran, ne adwuma no a wɔde refi ase. Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow te sɛ adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe, incubators, accelerators, ne mentorship networks de aboa wɔn ma wɔafa saa nhyehyɛe yi mu na wɔanya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a ɛsom bo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho asɛdeɛ bɛn na aban, nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ wɔ wɔ hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm, amammerɛ mu nkateɛ, ne nneyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so hyia?
answer_twi_source: Aban, nhyehyeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ wɔ abrabɔ pa ho asɛdeɛ wɔ hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm, amammerɛ mu nkateɛ, ne nneyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so hyia denam: Nnipa hokwan a wɔbɛkura mu: Hwɛ sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ no bu hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ nsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ahofadie, ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ ho no yɛ adeɛ a ɛho hia paa. Amammerɛ mu nkateɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Amammerɛ mu gyidie, nneyɛeɛ, ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ a wɔhunu na wɔbu no wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ mu no boa ma wɔhwɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no yɛ nea wɔgye tom na ɛtu mpɔn wɔ amammerɛ tebea ahodoɔ mu. Nneyɛe a egyina adanse so a wɔboa: Sɛ wɔde nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a nyansahu mu adanse ne nhwehwɛmu boa di kan a, ɛma nhyehyɛe no tu mpɔn na ɛma nneɛma pa a efi mu ba no yɛ kɛse ma mmabun. Akontaabuo a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nneɛma a ɛda adi pefee, ahwɛ so, na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu no ma wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no tumi hwehwɛ abrabɔ pa ne nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ ASRH nnwuma mu, na ɛma wɔn a wɔhwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no so no bu akontaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu na ɛyɛ nkateɛ wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi a ɛkyerɛ obu ma me gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nipasu?
answer_twi_source: nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ a ɛfata na ɛyɛ nkate a wobenya wɔ amammerɛ mu no hwehwɛ sɛ: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ho: Hwehwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ɛyɛ pɛ, etu mpɔn, ɛfata na obu wom ma obiara a nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi mfa ho. Nsɛmmisa a Wobɛbisa: Wɔ wo nkɔmmɔdie anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi kan no mu no, bisa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ no suahunu a wɔanya wɔ berɛ a wɔne ankorankoro a wɔfiri amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu yɛ adwuma. W’ahiade a Wobɛda no Adi: Ka wo gyinapɛn ahorow, wo gyidi, ne wo nipasu kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no pefee, a amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii biara a ɛho hia wo ka ho. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ woyɛ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom kuo pɔtee bi moni a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akannifo a ebia wobetumi de akwankyerɛ anaa nyansahyɛ ahorow ama wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wubetumi aka asetra mu nsɛm nhwesoɔ ahodoɔ a ɛyɛ abrabɔ mu nimdeɛ ho adesua a mfaso wɔ so akyerɛ mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ntawntawdi ano aduru: Sua sɛnea wo ne nnamfo anaa abusua mufo siesie ntawntawdi wɔ asomdwoe mu na wɔde katee. Gyinaesi: Paw a wɔbɛpaw sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu anaasɛ wɔremfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu na wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma yiye. Nkitahodi: Ne ɔhokafo nni nkɔmmɔ fa ahyeɛ ne ɔpenee ho. Adwennwen a wogyina ano: Dadwen anaa nhyɛso nkate a ɛfa adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ anaa asetra mu tebea horow ho a wobedi ho dwuma. Ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru: Ɔhaw a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a wobedi ho dwuma, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru a wobenya anaasɛ ayaresa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ de ayɛ STI nhwehwɛmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo adi nkitaho yiye wɔ m’ahiade, m’akɔnnɔ, ne nneɛma a ɛha me ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wobue Mu: Ka w'atenka, w’ahiade, ne w’akɔnnɔ ahorow ho nsɛm pefee na ka nokware. Tie wo hokafo adwene yiye na si wɔn atenka horow no mu den. Fa "Me" Nsɛm Di Dwuma: Fa "Me" nsɛm kyerɛ adwene ne w'atenka na ama woakwati asodi. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Ɛnyɛ Asɛmfua: Hwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu te sɛ nipadua kasa ne nne so. Wɔn a Wɔbɛkɔ Daa: Mommɔ nkɔmmɔ daa mfa nhwɛ sɛnea mo ho mo ho te nka ne n’ahiade. Nsiesiei: Nya ɔpɛ sɛ wobɛgyae wo ho mu na woanya ano aduro a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma ama mo baanu nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amaneɛ bɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmoa kwan a wɔde boa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aboa mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Amaneɛ bɔ nhyehyɛeɛ anaa ahohia berɛ mu mmoa ntentan (Hotlines ne Helplines) yɛ dwumadie a ɛma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa mmoa a ɛho hia ntɛm pa ara wɔ berɛ a wɔahyia ahohia a ɛfa wɔn bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu akwahosan (ASRH) ho.Wɔn dwumadie no yɛ kokoam deɛ a wɔmmu obi fɔ, na wɔma afutuo, nkyerɛkyerɛ, kwan a wɔfa so kɔhwɛ adɔkotafoɔ, ne mmoa titiriw wɔ ahohia berɛ mu. Wei boa mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ma wɔtumi di wɔn haw ho dwuma na wɔanya mmoa a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka nkate ne asetra mu haw a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn mu ma mmabun ho asɛm na fa nneɛma a wɔde boa ma.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ wubenyinsɛn bere a woyɛ ɔbabun no betumi ayɛ den. Ebia wobehyia asetra mu animtiaabu, nsakrae a ɛba abusuabɔ mu, aduan pa a wunni, ohia ne wo nhomasua a wobɛtoa so ho dadwen. Sɛ wowɔ nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo a, wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn  so nneɛma anaa mmeae bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma ne mmeae pii wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so. Abɛɛfo ntentan te sɛ Ghana Health Service, Planned Parenthood de nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri ma wɔ nsɛmti ahorow pii a ɛfa nna mu akwaahosan, nyɔnkofa nkitahodie, ne pene a wɔpene so ho. Bio nso, ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO) ne Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) de nsɛm ne nneɛma a egyina adanse so a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titiriw ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfo ne adesua nhyehyɛe ayɛfo betumi afa so de adwene ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne nnipa dodoɔ adwennpɔw a wɔde bɛka nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne dwumadi ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no bi ne: Ahiadeɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nkɔmmɔdie a wɔne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ahodoɔ bɛyɛ de ahunu nneɛma a ɛhia titire, nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene, ne deɛ wɔpɛ. Mpɔtam hɔ akuo, amammerɛ, ne media ho nkitahodiɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ amammerɛ fata na ɛwɔ atenka. Kasa a ɛka obiara ho, mfonini, ne nhwɛso ahorow a ɛda nnipa a wɔyɛ, abusuabɔ, ne osuahu ahorow adi a wɔde bedi dwuma. Ntamgyinafoɔ adwene a ɛhunu nneɛma a ɛhyehyɛ ankorankoro SRH nsunsuansoɔ no nkitahodiɛ a ɛyɛ den a wɔde bɛka abom. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ama asuafo de wɔn adwene aba, nsɛm a wɔbɛka, ne adesua nneɛma ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔbɛbom ayɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ yɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun mmonnaato ho nsɛm  ne  ho nsunsuansoɔ ?
answer_twi_source: :Ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛnea nna mu ɔbrasɛe abu so ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so efisɛ:Nhumu: Nna mu ɔbrasɛe a abu so no ntease boa mmabun ma wohu sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm a atrɛw a ebetumi aka obiara. Asiane a Wɔtew So: Sɛ mmabun nim nneɛma a ɛde nna mu ɔbrasɛe ba a, ɛma wotumi tu anammɔn de bɔ wɔn ho ne afoforo ho ban. Atosɛm a Wɔbɔ no Bum: Sɛ wosua anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho a, ɛboa ma woyi gyidi ne suban a epira fi hɔ. Mmoa: Nhomasua ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no nya adansedi, mmoa, na wonya nneɛma a wɔde bɛsa yare na wɔn ho atɔ wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm atenka sɛ wɔka ho bi na wowɔ tumi wɔ wɔn mmusua, atipɛnfo kuo, ne mpɔtam  mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Akwannya  Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ mmusua ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ fa mmubuafoɔ hokwan ne hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔka ho. Anuanom Mmoa Akuw: Yɛ mmoa akuw ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anuanom na ama wɔanya ntease ne tema. Nhwɛso Pa: Kyerɛ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm a wɔadi yiye no ho nsɛm ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ de akanyan mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ mmabun a wɔyɛ mmea ho nhwehwɛmu daa so, na mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ nhyehyɛe ma saa bere yi?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛwɔ mmea ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa ma mmabun so no bi ne: Awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wobehu ntɛm na wɔadi ho dwuma. Nhomasua ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu akwahosan, ne asetra a ahoɔden wom a wɔpaw ho. Awotwaa mu kokoram ne nna mu nyarewa (STIs) a wosiw ano na wɔhwehwɛ mu. Hokwan a wɔde bɛka awo akwahosan ho haw anaa nsɛmmisa biara ho asɛm wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛboa mu. Mpɛn dodow a wɔhwɛ mmea mu no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ankorankoro nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wɔadi, nna mu dwumadi, ne awo akwahosan ho abakɔsɛm so. Mpɛn pii no, wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ yɛ nhyehyɛe kɔhwɛ mmea ho afe biara bere a woanya nna mu kyɛfa anaasɛ woadu mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, anaasɛ sɛnea w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo de afotu ma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ateka mu nsɛm bɛn na ɛwɔ Nneɛma a ɛka adwene awoɔ/abusua mu ma  mmabun ho asɛm yɛ dɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Anigyeɛ, Dadwen, Awerɛhoɔ. Nhyɛsoɔ fri ewieyɛ nhwehwe. Siesie denam: Mmoa, Afotu (Counseling), ne Nnamfo mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi adi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nka wɔn ho wɔ sikasɛm mu no so, te sɛ ahotoso a wobenya wɔ sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow mu, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ firi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, anaasɛ sikakorabea ano aduru foforo a wɔde bedi dwuma no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi akwanside ahorow yi so denam: Ahotoso a wobenya ne sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow denam nkitahodi a wɔbɛyɛ daa ne sikasɛm mu nneyɛe a ɛfata so. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ firi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ sikasɛm ho no hɔ. Sikakorabea ano aduru foforo te sɛ sikakorabea akuw a egyina mpɔtam hɔ anaa sikakorabea dwumadie a wɔde fa telefon so a ɛdi wɔn ahiadeɛ ho dwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteeyɛ a  ɛnnyɛ nokware anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne asiane a wɔde to wɔn ho so ho a ebetumi aka asiane ho adwene a mewɔ no, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so na mayi ntease a ɛnteɛ afi hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ na ɛnyɛ nokware  anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna mu apomoden ne asiane a wɔde to wɔn ho so a ebetumi aka asiane ho adwene no bi ne: Gye a wogye di sɛ nna mu dwumadi ahorow bi nkutoo na ɛde asiane ba, na ɛma wobu asiane ahorow a ɛbata nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaa ahokafo pii ho no adewa. Sɛ yɛfa no sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma no yi asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn ne nna mu yareɛ mu nyinaa fi hɔ a, yebu yɛn ani gu nneɛma te sɛ nea wɔde di dwuma a ɛnkɔ so daa anaasɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye so. Abusuabɔ a ɛda nsa anaa nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ne nna mu asiane a wɔde wɔn ho to so ntam a wɔnte ase, a nea ɛka ho ne atemmu a entumi nyɛ yiye ne mmerɛwyɛ a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ obi anaasɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ obi so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so na woyi ntease a ɛnteɛ fi hɔ a, fa wo ho to nneɛma a wotumi gye di te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nna mu akwahosan ho akyerɛkyerɛfo, wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din, ne nhoma ahorow a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu so. Bisa nsɛm, hwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware, na fa adwene a ɛda adi na ɛyɛ katee di nna mu apomoden ho nsɛmti ho asɛm na ama woanya ntease a edi mu wɔ asiane ne ahobammɔ ho akwan horow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya GBV mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam?
answer_twi_source: GHS-YMK App (cyber counsellors). Kasa kyerɛ 'school nurse'(sukuu mu ɔyarehwɛfo) anaa 'school counsellor' (sukuu mu ɔfotufo).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnwumadie ahorow a wɔde bɛka abom no hwɛ hu sɛ wobedi mmabun ahiade ahorow ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa biribiara ho so?
answer_twi_source: Nkabom hwɛ hu sɛ ɛnyɛ mmabun awo apomoden ho ahiade pɔtee nko na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo susuw ho, na mmom wɔn nipadua, adwene, ne asetra mu yiyedi a ɛtrɛw nso. Ɛdenam nnwuma ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe biako mu so no, mmabun betumi anya ɔhwɛ a edi mũ a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ankorankoro ahiade. Saa kwan yi gye tom sɛ nneɛma te sɛ adwenemyareɛ, asetena mu mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔbɛnya nyinaa di dwuma wɔ mmabun awoɔ apomoden mu nsunsuansoɔ mu, na ɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛdi saa afã yi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa biribiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na akwantu ho nsɛnnennen ka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn apɔwmuden mu daa?
answer_twi_source: Akwansideɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛnya no berɛ mu, a ɛbɛma wɔakyɛ wɔ bere a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn anaa bere a wɔankɔ koraa no so. Ɔhwɛ a ɛbɛma wɔagyae ɔhwɛ a ɛbɛkɔ soro, a ebetumi anya apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso so nkɛntɛnso bɔne na ama apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ayɛ kɛse. Adwennwen ne dadwen a ɛkɔ soro ma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua, a ebia wɔbɛpere sɛ wobenya kar a wotumi de ho to so a wɔbɛfa so akɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu. Ɛboa ma nsonsonoe ba apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wonya ne akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu, titire ma mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wonnya sika pii anaasɛ wonnya mmoa pii a wohyia akwantu mu akwanside akɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya akuw anaa mpɔtam a wɔboa nnipa a wɔayi nyinsɛn agu? (ahintasɛm telefon so telefon so, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow)
answer_twi_source: mprempren mmoa akuw a ɛte saa nni Ghana nanso wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni betumi aboa wo ma wo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ  ahyɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nkuran
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi de dijitaal akwan horow adi dwuma de adu mmabun nkyɛn na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi de digyital akwan adi dwuma de adu mmabun nkyɛn na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne dwumadie mu denam: Nkyerɛkyerɛ mu nsɛm te sɛ video, infographics, ne nkitahodiɛ ho nsɛmmisa a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiadeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ. Virtual workshops, webinars, anaa Q&A sessions a mmabun betumi abisa nsɛm na wɔanya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware afi mmeae a wogye di. Social media akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ nsɛm foforo, nneɛma, ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun ntam. Telehealth providers anaa mobile health apps a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛyɛ mmerɛw ama, a afotuo a wɔde ma wɔ virtual, nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔde ma, ne STI nhwehwɛmu ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na dijitaal mfiridwuma ne abɛɛfo ntentan di wɔ nna ne nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde kyekyɛ mu wɔ akwan a, ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi abrɛ asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba te sɛ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne kokoam nsɛm a wobu so no ase?
answer_twi_source: Digitals mfiridwuma ne social media platforms di dwuma titire wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde kyekyɛ mu wɔ akwan a, ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho denam: Mfiridwuma a wɔde ma a wotumi nya bi: Digitals mfiridwuma ma ASRH ho nsɛm du nnipa pii nkyɛn, a mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaa wɔnyɛ adwuma yiye ka ho. Nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu a wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Wobetumi ayɛ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛne amammerɛ ahorow, kasa horow, ne nea wɔpɛ, na ama nea ɛfa ho ne nea ɛne ne ho hyia no ayɛ kɛse. Nkitahodi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran: Social media platform ahorow ma nkitahodi a ɛfa akwan abien so no yɛ mmerɛw, na ɛma mmabun tumi bisa nsɛm, kyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wonya mmoa wɔ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm wom so. Asiane ahorow a wɔbɛtew so: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtew asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba te sɛ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne kokoam nsɛm a wobu so no so no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nneɛma te sɛ nokwasɛm a wɔhwehwɛ, kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe, ne nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so di dwuma. Bio nso, adwuma a wɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din ne abenfo yɛ biako no betumi ama wogye wɔn di na wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nea me nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa me bɔbeasu yɛ? (nhwehwɛmu, ankasa ho a wosusuw, bere nhyehyɛe a ɛteɛ anaasɛ ɛnteɛ biara nni hɔ)
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Ɔkwan biako biara nni hɔ a wobɛfa so ate wo Nna mu Nkitahodi ase. Gye bere susuw wo nkate ne nneɛma a ɛtwetwe wo ho no ho. wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo betumi aboa wo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma nnipa a wɔahyia nna mu atirimɔdensɛm (sexual violence survivors)?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam-yɛ (Privacy) hokwan. Pɛyɛ (Justice) - bɔ kɔkɔ, bammɔ nkrataa, mmara mu mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ne mfiridwuma foforo bɛn na wɔde redi dwuma de adi nhyehyɛe ho ɔhaw so nkonim na wɔde nna ne awo ho nsem  ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ama mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae a ntawntawdi yɛ den sɛ wobedu hɔ?
answer_twi_source: abɛɛfo nhyehyerɛ  a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Mobile health (mHealth) dwumadie: Ahomatorɔfo ne  abɛɛfo ntentan wɔde bedi dwuma de nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH ho nsɛm, afotuo, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔma nkurɔfoɔ no bɛtumi adi nhyehyɛeɛ ho haw so na adu mmabun a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri anaa ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛduru hɔ a ntawntawdie aka no. Mpɔtam akwahosan adwumayɛfoɔ: Mpɔtam akwahosan adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbɛtete na wɔaboaboa wɔn ano ma wɔde nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH ) nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotuo, ne mfitiaseɛ nnwuma ama wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no bɛtumi atrɛ ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun mu, titire wɔ mmeaeɛ a akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ sua. Nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ne mmabun akannifo a wɔma wɔn tumi ma wɔkyekyɛ nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH ) ho nsɛm, ma mmoa akuw no yɛ mmerɛw, na wɔkamfo nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun, ma atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow nya nkɔso na ɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH ) nneyɛe pa ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu wɔ mmeae a ntawntawdi wɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ne awo ho akwahosan ho nnwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aboa ma nsakrae pa aba wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri?
answer_twi_source: Kwan a yɛfa so pere ma atentenenee: Ɔsatu a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu: Mmabun betumi de abɛɛfo ntentan ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a esisi adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia. Nhyehyɛeɛ mu kyɛfa: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu no hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne wɔ gyinaesie a ɛka wɔn akwahosan mu. Nkabom ne Nkitahodi: Ahyehyɛde ne nkitahodi ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo so a wɔbɛka ho no ma wɔn nkɛntɛnso yɛ kɛse. Nhomasua Nhyehyɛe: Mmabun betumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow ama wɔn mfɛfo, na ahyɛ gyinaesi a wɔde nimdeɛ asi ho nkuran. Ntoboa pa: Mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nhyiam ahorow a wodi anim wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ so no, mmabun betumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho aba. Mmoa a Wɔde Ma Atipɛnfo: Mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma atipɛnfo a ebia wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa wohia mmoa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm mu. Wiase Nyinaa Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Amanaman ntam mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne wɔn yɛ biako no ma wotumi bɔ mmɔden wɔ wiase nyinaa sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nna mu akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho ban. Nkɛntɛnso: Afoforo a Wɔma Wɔn Tumi: Mmabun betumi akanyan afoforo ma wɔakasa ama wɔn hokwan ahorow na wɔakamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pa akyerɛ. Nhyehyɛeɛ mu Nkɛntɛnso: Ɛnam sɛ wɔbom yɛ adwuma so no, wɔbɛtumi anya nhyehyɛeɛ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne amanaman ntam, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri bedi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkyerɛkyerɛ ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahyɛ suban pa ne nneyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodie pa, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Adesua Nhyehyɛe a Ɛkɔ Akyiri: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no bi ne module ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, pene, nkitahodie pa, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho, na ɛma ntease ne adwene pa nya nkɔso. Nhwɛso a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Apɔ mu ateneatene a wɔde di agoru ne asetra mu nsɛm ankasa boa mmabun ma wɔde obu di nkitaho, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne gyinaesi wɔ nkitahodie mu. Atipɛnfo Nhyɛso: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne mmoa akuw a atipɛnfo di anim no ma mmabun nya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔkyɛ osuahu ahorow, kasa tia nsusuwii hunu a ɛha, na wɔhyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn dwuma na nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia (context) di wɔ sɛnea yɛte nkitahodie mfidie (media) so nsɛm a ɛfa mmaninyɛ ne mmaa-yɛ ho akwahosan (sexual and reproductive health) ase, ne mfasoɔ anaa nsunuansoɔ a saa nsɛm no de ba no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia (Context) wɔ tumi kɛseɛ wɔ sɛnea wɔte nkitahodie mfidie (media) so nsɛm a ɛfa mmaninyɛ ne mmaa-yɛ ho akwahosan ase, ne mfasoɔ anaa nsunuansoɔ a saa nsɛm no de ba mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa so. Saa nneɛma yi bi ne:Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne nneyɛeɛ pa.Sika ne asetena mu gyinaberɛ ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a obi bɛtumi de adi dwuma.Abakɔsɛm ne amanyɔsɛm mu nsɛm.Sɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa te nneɛma a atwa wɔn ho ahyia yi ase a, ɛboa wɔn ma wɔtumi hwehwɛ nkitahodie mfidie mu nsɛm mu yie, na wɔahunu mfasoɔ anaa bɔne a ɛwɔ saa nsɛm no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmerɛ bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehyɛ aseɛ kɔ akatua (prenatal care), na mpren dodoo bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehunu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ berɛ a menyinsɛn no?
answer_twi_source: Efiriaseɛ ne Sɛnea Wɔkɔ (Start and Frequency)Efiriaseɛ (Start): Nea ɛyɛ koraa ne sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ wofiri ayaresabea kɔ (prenatal care) ase mmerɛ a wosusu sɛ woanyinsɛn pɛ, anaa ne nyinaa akyi no, wɔ bosome mmiensa a ɛdi kan no mu.Sɛnea Wɔkɔ (Frequency): Mpɛn pii no, ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ tu fo sɛ wokɔ hɔ bosome biara kɔsi adapɛn aduonu nwɔtwe (28 weeks), ɛno akyi no adapɛn mmienu biara kɔsi adapɛn aduɔsa nsia (36 weeks), na afei dapɛn biara kɔsi sɛ wobɛwo. Wobɛtumi akɔ hɔ mpɛn pii sɛ ɛhia, a ɛgyina maame no apɔwmuden anaa sɛnea nyinsɛn no teɛ so.Nyinsɛn mu Asiane (Danger Signs)Wɔhyɛ wo nkuran sɛ ma w’ani nna hɔ na hwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne bɔne anaa asiane biara a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn mu (danger signs), na fa amanneɛbɔ kɔma w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ ntɛm pa ara.Ayaresabea Kɔ Ntɛm (Early Care)Ayaresabea kɔ ntɛm ma kwan ma wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛhia (screenings) ne mmoa ahorow (interventions) a ɛfata mmerɛ a ɛsɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahyɛ nkitahodie pa ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa nkitahodie pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw basabasayɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyɛ nkitahodie pa ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa nkitahodie pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw basabasayɛ ano denam: - Nhumu a wɔbɛma akɔ soro: Nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ nkitahodie pa mu nkɔso ne ayayade ho kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne ho. - Nkyerɛkyerɛ ho Kamfoo: Sukuu mpanyimfo anaa nhyehyeɛ ayɛfo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmfa nkitahodie ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri nka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho, a nsɛmti te sɛ pene, nkitahodi, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ka ho. - A woboa Survivor dwumadie: Wotu wo ho ma anaa wogye sika ma nnwumakuo a wɔde mmoa ne nneɛma ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nkitahodie mu basabasayɛ ne ayayadeɛ mu. - Sɛ woreko atia amammerɛ: Wɔkasa tia suban anaa nneyɛe a epira wɔ wɔn asetena mu akuo anaa intanɛt so, na wɔhyɛ nkrasɛm a ɛkyerɛ obuo, pɛyɛ, ne pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran. - A wode wo ho bɛhyɛ Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa mu: Mmoa akuo anaa nkitahodiɛ a atipɛnfoɔ di anim a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a mmabun bɛtumi akyɛ osuahu, ahwehwɛ afotuo, na wɔde mmoa ama wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nkitahodie a ɛyɛ papa a wɔbɛfa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
