question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyimu so bere a wɔrehwehwɛ adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim so bere a wɔrehwehwɛ adwenemyare ho nnwuma denam: Wɔn ankasa ne afoforo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn adwenemyare ho de akasa atia adwene a ɛnteɛ ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛwɔ hɔ no so. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo, nnamfo, anaa abusua mufo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de nkuranhyɛ ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo ama wɔn hɔ. Adwene mu akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpaw wɔn a wɔn amammerɛ ho akokwaw, wonni atɛn, na wosi nnipa ne osuahu ahorow so dua. Kokoam akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa te sɛ intanɛt so ayaresa anaa telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfoɔ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Hokwan ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, a kokoam nsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne obu a wɔde ma ka ho. Nkitahodie a wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a wobetumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow na wɔanya nokwaredi ne mmoa afi afoforo a wohyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Nneɛma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔn ho titiriw wɔ animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wodi ho dwuma wɔ adwenemyare mu, te sɛ akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo ne adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so a wɔde bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho (egyina beae so).
answer_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow a wubehu no betumi ama wo tumi. Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛma mmara kwankyerɛ wɔ Ghana (ɛgyina sɛnea ɛwɔ hɔ so): social media handles of the adolescent health program, YMK App, FHM App Ghana Legal Aid Commission: Wɔde mmara mu afotuo a wontua hwee ma, a mmofra nkumaa a wɔwɔ tebea bi mu ka ho. Hwɛ wɔn wɛbsaet (https://www.lac.gov.gh/) na woanya nkitahodi ho nsɛm ne sɛnea wobɛfata. Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): Di wɔn ho nkɔmmɔ (telefon: +233 (0) 244 350 200 anaa email: [email protected]) na bisa sɛ wɔde nneɛma anaa akwankyerɛ ma wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ho anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie ne asɛdeɛ bɛn na awofoɔ, sukuu, mpɔtam, ne aban nnwumakuo bɛn na wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛdi mmabun a wɔfiri abusua nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmusua ahodoɔ mu ahiadeɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Dwuma ne asɛdeɛ a awofoɔ, sukuu, mpɔtam, ne aban nnwumakuo di wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no wɔ afã ahodoɔ. Awofo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔn mma mu, bere a sukuu ahorow betumi de nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a egyina adanse so a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a ɛfa abusua nhyehyɛe ne mmusua ahorow ahiade ho ama. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi de nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ ama mmabun ne mmusua, berɛ a aban nnwumakuo bɛtumi ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma mmabun nyinaa anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nsɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ, a wɔn abusua nhyehyɛeɛ anaa asetena mu sikasɛm tebea mfa ho na wɔde adi dwuma. Ɛdenam adwuma a wɔbom yɛ so no, saa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu yi betumi ayɛ abɔde a nkwa wom nhyehyɛe a ɛboa a ɛhyɛ nna mu akwahosan pa a efi mu ba ho nkuran ma mmabun nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ sutie na mate afofoɔ suahunu ase yie wo nsabuo berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa w’adwene si Ɔkasafoɔ no so: Fa w’adwene nyinaa si so, na Gyae nneɛma a aha w’adwene. Fa kasa foforo: Ka dea wɔaka no bio wɔ w’ankasa wo nteaseɛ mu. Bisa Nsɛm: Hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu sɛ biribi mu nna hɔ a. Tema: Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wubehu nneɛma sɛdea ɛte, na te wɔn atenka ase. Nipadua Kasa: Kɔ so hwɛ w’ani, na fa wo ti gye so fa kyerɛ sɛ woretie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho di wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛfata mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Obu a obi wɔ ma ne yɔnko yɛ fapem wɔ abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom mu. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛbu wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene, wɔn ahye, ne wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ ɛsom bo. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhwɛ ahu sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ no, di nkitaho pefee na fa nokwaredi di nkitaho, tie wo hokafo no adwene denneennen, na fa ayamye ne ntease di mo ho mo ho. Kwati nneyɛe te sɛ wo hokafo nkate a wubebu no animtiaa, wobɛhyɛ so, anaasɛ wobɛpow no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akwati opira bere a mereteɛteɛ m’apɔw mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no?
answer_twi_source: Ma wo ho yɛ hyew, fa ɔkwan a ɛfata di dwuma, ma dwumadi no nkɔ soro nkakrankakra, gye w’ahome wɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ntam, trɛw wo ho, nom nsu, hyɛ ahobammɔ nneɛma, na sɛ wote ɛyaw nka a, gyae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ne nea wontumi mfa ho nto so ntam wɔ Intanɛt so?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nsɛm firi mmeaeɛ a ɛwɔ nidi na yɛtumi de yɛn ho to so, te sɛ aban apɔmuden ho wɛbsait (government health websites), ayaresa ahyehyɛdeɛ a agye din, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mmeaeɛ (educational institutions). Hwɛ onipa a ɔkyerɛwee no abodin ne ne nimdeɛ (credentials), berɛ a wɔyii asɛm no fii adi, ne mmeaeɛ a wɔnyaa nsɛm no firiiɛ (citations) na woahu sɛ asɛm no yɛ nokware na ɛyɛ nea yɛtumi de yɛn ho to so. Hwɛ yie wɔ nsɛm a wɔatintim de hwehwɛ agyegyebe nko ara anaa asɛm ti a wɔayɛ no kɛseɛ de twe nnipa (clickbait), na fa nsɛm no toto mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ pii a yɛtumi de yɛn ho to so ho ansa na woagye atom sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea sukuu a wɔto mu ne nhomasua a wɔsɛe no no kyerɛ, ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan, a nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a edi mũ a wobenya ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Aban ne nnipa mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma bɛkɔ so ama mmabun denam telefon so aduruyɛ ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde fa telefon so a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Saa nnwuma yi de mfiridwuma di dwuma de kokoam nnwuma a wotumi nya te sɛ afotu, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ma. Ɛdenam saa mfiridwuma yi a wɔde bedi dwuma so no, mmabun da so ara tumi nya ɔhwɛ a wohia wɔ ahokyere bere mpo mu. Wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ mu no, sɛ wɔto sukuu ahorow mu na wɔsɛe nhomasua a wɔyɛ no daa a, mmabun betumi ahwere nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so. Nhomasua a wonnya yi betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, asiane a ɛkɔ soro, ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wɔde asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ne wɔn yiyedi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ntorɔ bi a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ biako a wɔtaa nya ne sɛ kommyɛ anaa ɔsɔretia a wonni kyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so. Nanso, ɛsɛsɛ wɔde nsiyɛ na wɔka pene a wɔpene so no ho asɛm pefee. Adwene a ɛnteɛ foforo ne sɛ pene a wɔde ma pɛnkoro no di dwuma daa. Nokwarem no, pene a wɔpene so yɛ adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so na wobetumi atwa mu bere biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya ɔhaw ho afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din, a wɔremma wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm nkyerɛ, anaasɛ so akwan horow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so kyerɛw wɔn din anaasɛ wɔfa so na ama wɔanya mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a Wɔmmɔ Wɔn Din: Mpɛn pii no, mmabun tumi nya ɔhaw ho afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din, a wɔmfa wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm nkyerɛ. Ebia nnwuma bi wɔ akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛw wɔn din anaasɛ wɔfa so de di dwuma a wɔde di dwuma ho nsɛm akyi anaasɛ wɔde mmoa a wɔde di akyi ma, nanso mpɛn pii no, mmabun betumi apaw sɛ wɔremmɔ wɔn din sɛ wɔpɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn ne akodie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmaabun sɛ wobetu mpon wɔ intanɛt so nimdeɛ 'digital literacy' na woatumi abɛyɛ ɔmanfo hwesopa wɔ intanɛt so , de ɛka ho ne wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔde ma adesua, intanɛt so adesua ne kɔmputa nnwuma ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa ne akodie ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmaabun ma wonya kɔmputu nnwuma ho nimdeɛ na wɔabɛyɛ ɔmanfo  digital hwesopa ne nea ɛka ho ne: Wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔde ma adesua ne intanɛt so adesua a ɛtwe adwene si kɔmputa nnwuma ho nimdeɛ, media nnwuma ho nimdeɛ, ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ so. 'Digital literacy ' nnwuma ho nhyehyɛe a sukuu ahorow, adekandan, ne mpɔtam kuo de ma. Intanɛt so nkyerɛkyerɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne adwumayɛ ho nhyiam ahorow a ɛkata nsɛmti ahorow te sɛ adwene a emu da hɔ, intanɛt so ahintasɛm, kɔmputa so ahobammɔ, ne intanɛt so suban pa so. Agorɔdi ahorow a wɔde nkitahodi a ɛbɛkyerɛkyerɛ digital literacy wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ anigye na ɛwɔ nkitahodi so. Intanɛt so akyinnyegye akuw ahorow a mmaabun betumi de osuahu ahorow akyekye wohowoho, abisa nsɛm, na wɔasua nneɛma afi afoforo hɔ afa digital ɔmanibapa  ne dawurubɔ nnwuma ho nimdeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo sika a wɔde bɛto nneɛma a ɛko tia wim tebea ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu de aboa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo sika a wɔde bɛto nnwuma a ɛtumi gyina wim tebea ano ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu de aboa wɔn SRH ahiade denam wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ wim tebea ho adeyɛ akuw a mmabun di anim mu, wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate abusuabɔ a ɛda wim nsakrae ne SRH ntam no ase, wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne mpɔtamfo akannifo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho, na wɔahwehwɛ sɛ wobu akontaa wɔ bɔhyɛ ahorow a ɛfa wim tebea ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi ayɛ adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata, de botae ahorow a ɛfata asi wɔn ani so, ahwɛ sikasɛm so, adi ɛka a wɔbɔ akyi, na wɔasusuw sɛnea wɔn adwumayɛ ho adwene ahorow no bɛtumi ayɛ yiye na mfaso wɔ so no ho?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ aguadiɛ ho nhwehwɛmu (Conduct market research): Hu nnipa a wopɛ sɛ wotɔn nneɛma ma wɔn (target markets), nnipa a wɔtɔn nneɛma no ahiadeɛ, nnipa anaa adwumakuo a wɔne wo resi akan (competitors), ne nsakraeɛ a ɛrekɔ so (trends) na ama woasi adwuma ho gyinaeɛ a ɛfata na wode nneɛma anaa nnwuma pa ama.Si botaeɛ a ɛfata (Set realistic goals): Kyerɛ botaeɛ a ɛfa berɛ tiaa ne berɛ tenten, sika ho botaeɛ, adwuma yɛeɛ ho nteaseɛ, ne nkɔsoɔ ho nsusuiɛ pɔtee (milestones) mu na ama woatumi asusu nkɔsoɔ na woahwɛ sɛ woadie nkunim.Hwɛ sika so (Manage finances): Yɛ sika ho nhyehyɛeɛ (budgets), sika a ɛfiri hɔ ne nea ɛba ho nsusuuiɛ (cash flow projections), ne sika ho daakye nsusuuiɛ (financial forecasts) de atoto nneɛma a ɛhia, ahwɛ sika a ɛkɔ, na woahwɛ sika a ɛwɔ hɔ no so yie.Di sika a ɛkɔ so (Track expenses): Kyerɛw sika a ɛba, sika a ɛkɔ, ne nnwuma a wɔde sika yɛ (transactions) to hɔ, fa sika ho nnwuma yɛ adwuma (accounting tools), software, anaa apps de asie sika ho nkrataa na woahwɛ adwuma no yɛeɛ.Susu sɛ wubetumi ayɛ adwuma no anaa (Assess feasibility): Susu sɛ wubetumi ayɛ adwuma no na anya mfasoɔ denam adwuma no ho nhwehwɛmu (feasibility studies), sika a ɛkɔ ne nea ɛba ho nsusuuiɛ (cost-benefit analysis), ne asiane ho nhwehwɛmu (risk assessments) so na ama woatumi ateka anaa woayi mmerehyɛmu a ɛbɛtumi aba no afiri hɔ na woanya mfasoɔ a ɛdɔɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ ASRH dwumadie no bɛka obiara ho na akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua, a aborɔfoɔ, atubrafoɔ, aguanfoɔ, ne mmabun a wɔte nkuraaseɛ anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔnnya mmoa pa efa ka ho, bɛtumi anya bi saa?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ASRH dwumadie no bɛka obiara ho na akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no betumi anya bi no, akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ adwuma no bi ne: Akwan a wɔayɛ ama wɔn: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛdi nnipa ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ ho dwuma, a aborɔfoɔ mpɔtamu, atubrafoɔ, aguanfoɔ, ne mmabun a wɔte nkuraaseɛ anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔnnya mmoa yie ka ho. Mpɔtamu hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mpɔtamu hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, ne ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ no mu nhwehwɛmu mu de ahwɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no fata, wɔgye tum, na ɛbɛtena hɔ daa. Akwanside ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma: Akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ, te sɛ kasa mu akwanside ahorow, akwantu ho nsɛm, animtiaabu, ne nyiyimu a wobehu na wɔadi ho dwuma, denam nkɔmmɔ a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, ɔsom adwuma a wɔde ma ho nhwɛso ahorow, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bɛn na ɛtaa ba a atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi asɔre, titiriw nea ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ?
answer_twi_source: Nhyɛso a wɔde bɛma obi de ne ho ahyɛ nna mu na wate nka sɛ wasiesie ne ho anaasɛ ne ho atɔ no. Nkuranhyɛ a wɔde ma sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu, te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔrehyia nna mu. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛbɛma ɛne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsusuwii hunu anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho no ahyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho no ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow mu de ama mmabun tumi na wɔde nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu yiye wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho no asiesie wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho no ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, adwenemyareɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ mu denam: Nsɛmti a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛka ho: Nea aborɔfo ka no 'Module' anaa nhyiamu a ɛfa ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde bɛka nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no ho. Nneɛma a Wɔde Ma: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nea aborɔfo ka no'video, ne nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔn a wɔhwɛ no de wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho na ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu yiye bɛma. Atipɛnfo Mmoa a Wɔbɛhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛma mmabun ne wɔn atipɛnfo asusuw ho na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho nimdeɛ mu, te sɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow. Abenfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma: Yɛne adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ wɔde nneyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so ne akwan a wɔfa so de adwenemhaw ho nsɛm bɛbɔ ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛnea wɔsɛe sika no na wɔahwɛ sɛnea wɔrenya nkɔso wɔ wɔn sikakorabea botae ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi wɔn ka akyi na wɔahwɛ nkɔso a ɛrekɔ so wɔ wɔn sikakorabea botae ahorow ho denam: Kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛyɛ: Sika a wonya fi sika ne sika a wɔsɛe no nyinaa a wɔbɛkyerɛw ato hɔ, sɛ́ wɔde wɔn nsa bɛkyerɛw wɔ nsɛmma nhoma mu anaasɛ wɔde sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ho apps anaa spreadsheets a wɔde di dwuma wɔ dijitaal so. Ka a wɔkyekyɛ mu: Wɔhyehyɛ ɛka a wɔbɔ no akuw ahorow te sɛ aduan, kar, anigyede, ne sika a wɔde sie, na ama wɔahu sika a wɔsɛe no ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn. Sikakorabea botae ahorow a wɔde besi hɔ: Sikakorabea botae pɔtee bi a wɔde besi hɔ, te sɛ sika pɔtee bi a wɔbɛkora so ɔsram biara anaasɛ sika a wɔde asie a wobedu ho ansa na da pɔtee bi adu, na ama wɔahu nkɔso a wɔanya na wɔakɔ so anya ɔpɛ. Daa a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu: Bere ne bere mu a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ sɛnea wɔsɛe sika, sikakorabea nkɔso, ne sikasɛm mu botae ahorow de asusuw adwumayɛ ho, asiesie akwan horow, na wɔadi nea wɔatumi ayɛ ho afahyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ; nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ pa ho? (Wɛbsaet, ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma)
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. nya mmoa firi "GHS-YMK" fotufoɔ bi frɛ "PPAG" yenkasa wɔ (0800202010) (wɔntua hwee) "UNICEF Agoo SHE+" wɔ (5100) wɔ "mtn" "Marie" frɛ (0302242517).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ebia mihia berɛ a masi nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho gyinae awie no, ɛmfa ho nea mɛpaw? (nkate fam mmoa, afotu) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛmfa ho nea wobɛpaw no, ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya nkate horow a adi afra. Akwan a wobɛfa so anya mmoa ni: wo ne w’adamfo, abusua muni, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo, ɔyaresafo, anaa ɔfotufo di nkitaho. wɔbɛma wo adwene ne asetra mu mmoa a wubehia
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodibea bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu mu yie na madi dadwen anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ebia mewɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu akwahosan so: Sukuu Afotufo anaa Ayarehwɛfo: Wobetumi de nsɛm, nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ, ne mmoa ama. Mpɔtam Hɔ Ayaresabea: Planned Parenthood anaa mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow de nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma ma. Ntrɛwmu: Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Planned Parenthood anaa The American Sexual Health Association de telefon a wɔde boa a ɛyɛ kokoam ma. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet te sɛ TeenHealth, Scarleteen, anaa AMAZE de nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma. Mmoa Kuo: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ mmoa akuo a mmabun bɛkyɛ suahunu na wɔasua biribi afiri afoforɔ hɔ. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa anaa nsɛm bere a ɛho hia wo no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu ahyɛde anaa animtiaabu bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, brayɛ, anaa nna mu nyarewa bi ho?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ anaa bisa mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ fa ahyɛde anaa animtiaabu biara a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, brayɛ, anaa STI ho. Hu sɛ ebia ɛsono ahyɛde ne animtiaabu wɔ amammerɛ ne ɔsom ahorow mu, na ebetumi asesa bere ano bere ano. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho ne afoforo nyansahu mu nokwasɛm ahorow a ɛwɔ saa nsɛmti yi akyi no ho na aboa ma wɔayi anansesɛm afi hɔ na wɔatew animtiaabu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ medru mmabun berɛ so a, aduane nnuro pɔtee bɛn na ahia ma me, na menya no wɔ he?
answer_twi_source: Aduane nnuro bi tesɛ Calcium boa ma wo nnompe mu yɛ den. Wobenya bi wɔ nufo nsuo aduane mu, ahaban mono, nkateɛ, ne fortified food mu. Nnuane bi te sɛ nam kɔkɔɔ, nkokɔnam, nsuom nam, eduwa, na ma ɔkeka ho boa ma mogya nkwammoa pii 'red blood cells'. Dɔktafoɔ so betumi ama wo Iron na folic acid nnuro. Vitamin D, Proteins ne Fibres so bɛboa wo. Bio so mmanni adɔkɔdɔkɔdeɛ bebree. Na yɛ wo nipadua ho adwuma dabia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔhaw bɛn na mmebun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne nnipa kakraa bi hyia wɔ nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwuma a wobenya mu, wɔ aman a wofi mu ne aman a wɔagye wɔn no nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne nketewa taa hyia ɔhaw pii wɔ nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwuma a wobenya mu, wɔ aman a wofi mu ne aman a wogye wɔn no nyinaa mu. Saa nsɛnnennen yi betumi ayɛ kasa mu akwanside ahorow, nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni, amammerɛ mu animtiaabu anaa bara a wɔabara a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho, akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ amammerɛ mu a wonni, ne mmara anaa nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛfa atubrafo tebea anaa ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa tenabea ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'social protection programs' (ahobanbɔ/ asetena mu mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ) bɛboa mmabun wɔ wiase a ɛresesa yi mu (te sɛ kɔmputa ne intanɛt dwumadie (digitalization), nkuropɔn mu tɛna (urbanization), ewiem nsakraeɛ (climate change), ne wiase nkabom (globalization)?)?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ asetena mu mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ (social protection programs) no mu sesa. Digitalization: Wɔmfa intanɛt ne phones so mmoa. Urbanization: Wɔnnhwɛ mmabun a wɔte nkuropɔn mu hia (te sɛ fie ne transport). Climate change: Wɔmmoa mmabun ma wɔnnyina asiane (te sɛ nsuoyiri) ano. Globalization: Aman mmoa wɔn ho nsiw 'trafficking' (nkurɔfoɔ tɔn) ne asiane a ɛfa atukɔ (migration) ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛm bɛn na ehia na ama yɛate nkɛntɛnso a ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow nya wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so no ase yiye, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛm a wɔde ma ho hia na ama yɛate nkɛntɛnso a ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ nya wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so no ase yiye, a sɛnea saa nneɛma yi ne asetra mu nneɛma afoforo a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan te sɛ abusuakuw, abusuakuw, asetra mu sikasɛm tebea, ne asasesin a ɛwɔ hɔ ka ho. Mmabun betumi aboa saa mmɔdenbɔ yi denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi denam wɔn ankasa suahu ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛkyɛ, nhwehwɛmu adesua ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne nhwehwɛmufo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ahu nneɛma atitiriw a ɛho hia ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ mu no so. Wobetumi nso akamfo sika ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbeasu, nna, ne akwahosan ntam nkitahodi ho, na wobetumi de nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu adi dwuma de abɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo ne nhyehyɛe ho nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔama nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso atu mpɔn ama mmabun nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ mu anaasɛ wɔatu wɔn ho ama de aboa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔbɛboa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow denam mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so a broni ka no 'community outreach programs' no betumi: Di mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so adi nkitaho na wɔabisa hokwan ahorow a wɔde tu wɔn ho ma ho asɛm. Fa wɔn nimdeɛ ne wɔn anigyede te sɛ atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, nhyiam ho nhyehyɛe, anaa 'sohyial media' so nkɔmmɔ ma. Fa wo ho hyɛ ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nhyehyɛe ahorow de ma mu na woasua nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ne akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn. Fa wo ho hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a nna ne awo akwahosan ho hia wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkyerɛwde anaa nkrataa bɛn na ebehia na ama manya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Ebia wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ fa ID kyerɛ de hwɛ sɛ wo mfe ne wo nipasu. Insurance: Sɛ wowɔ akwahosan ho insurance a, ebia ɛbɛbɔ ka a wɔbɔ wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun ne wɔn adamfo bi a wodwene ne ho a ɛhaw wɔ wɔn adwenem ne wɔn yiyedi ho atumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobebisa seneɛ wɔn adwene tẽẽ na wɔde mmoa ama?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wone Nnamfo a wɔdwnene wo ho redi nkɔmmɔ : Mmabun betumi ne wɔn adamfo bi a wodwene wɔn ho adi nkɔmmɔ afa wɔn adwene mu apɔmden ho ne asentena abrabɔ mu wɔ berɛ worekyerɛ sɛ wodwene wɔn ho, tie wɔ berɛ wommu wɔn atɛn biaa na woaboa wɔn. Wɔbetumi abisa afa susu a susu sɛ ɔbɛ ku ne ho na wɔhwɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔn kɔhwehwɛ mmoa mfi ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo bi a ɔwɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so ahokwan ahorow, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hu ho wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow kyerɛ hokwan ahorow ne ahobammɔ a mmara de ma ankorankoro. Wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no, mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow no ka hokwan ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mu ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, pene a wɔpene so, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ne ahobammɔ a wonya fi nyiyim ne basabasayɛ ho ho. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hu wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobetumi asi gyinae a ɛfata, akasa ma wɔn ho, na wɔanya nnwuma a ɛho hia a wonhyia akwanside anaa nyiyimu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Su ne ahokokwaw bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ atipɛnfo afotufo nya, na ama wɔatumi aboa wɔn atipɛnfo yie wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho mmɔdenbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Tema ne nteaseɛ: Atipɛnfoɔ afotufoɔ pa da tema ne nteaseɛ adi wɔ wɔn atipɛnfoɔ suahunu, nsɛnnennen, ne wɔn apɛdeɛ ho, na ɛma tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmuo ba ma adesua ne nkɔsoɔ. Nkitahodi ne atie a wɔyɛ no denneennen: Afotufo wɔ nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a emu yɛ den na wɔde nsiyɛ tie wɔn atipɛnfo haw, nsɛmmisa, ne nsɛm a wɔka, na ɛma nkitahodi a etu mpɔn ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease. Akannifoɔ ne nhwɛsoɔ: Afotufoɔ nam nhwɛsoɔ so di anim, wɔyɛ suban pa, suban, ne adwumayɛ ho su pa ho nhwɛsoɔ ma wɔn atipɛnfoɔ suasua, na ɛkanyan wɔn ma wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛyɛ papa na wɔde boasetɔ adi wɔn botaeɛ akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ mu ahyɛde anaa animtiaabu bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho a ebetumi aka sɛnea mmabun hwehwɛ mmoa na wonya wɔ ɔhaw bi mu no?
answer_twi_source: Aane, amammerɛ mu ahyɛde anaa animtiaabu betumi ayɛ nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho, nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ayayade a wɔbɛda no adi, ne nyinsɛn ano aduru anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya. Saa nneɛma a wɔabara yi betumi de akwanside ahorow aba wɔ mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu na ebetumi aboa ma wɔate aniwu, ehu, anaa ankonam ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi de nhwɛso ahorow ama sɛnea wɔde amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ka apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ apomoden ho dwumadie mu ma mmabun ne: Kasa nkyerɛaseɛ dwumadie a wɔde ma ayarefoɔ a wɔnka Borɔfo kasa na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛdi nkitaho yie. Nhomasua nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ nna mu apomoden, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nna mu yareɛ ano a wosiw ho. Nyamesom anaa amammerɛ mu apɛde ahorow a ɛfa ahobrɛase ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho bere a wɔreyɛ sɔhwɛ anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow no ho a wobebu. Atetesɛm mu ayaresa nneyɛe anaa nnuruyɛ akwan foforo a wɔde bɛka ho sɛ ɔbabun no pɛ na ɛne ɔhwɛ a egyina adanse so hyia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ adesua tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho a ɛhyɛ adwene mu yiyedi ho nkuran berɛ a wɔredi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho dwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ adesua tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, obu a wɔbɛma anya adwene ahorow, ne nkate ne adwene mu afa horow a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti mu a wobegye atom so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ, wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ atemmu bɛma, na wɔadi animtiaabu ne animhwɛ ho dwuma. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nneɛma a wɔde ka ho, te sɛ afotu adwuma anaa mmoa akuw a wobenya no betumi aboa asuafo yiyedi bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi sikasɛm mu haw te sɛ ɛka a wɔnhwɛ kwan anaa nneɛma a egye ntɛmpɛ ho dwuma, bere a wɔma sikasɛm mu ahotɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi sikasɛm mu haw ho dwuma wɔ  sikakorabea a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de atua ɛka a wɔnhwɛ kwan, nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de atua ka a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu anaasɛ sɛ wontumi nni sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde ahorow ho dwuma a, wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ka no bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ, wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi abusua anaa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma hɔ, na wɔasua sɛnea wɔbɛsakra wɔn sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ma ɛne tebea horow a ɛresakra no ahyia. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nso di kan na wɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa sikasɛm ho abenfo hɔ bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wim nsakrae ma mmerɛwyɛ ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ dedaw a ɛfa ASRH ho no yɛ kɛse, titiriw ma mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahotɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔabu wɔn animtia(Marginalized Populations):Wiemu nsakraeɛ ma nneɛma a ɛhyɛ nnipa ho nyunu ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ a nnipa nni no yɛ kɛse kɔ anim. Eyi nya mbabaa a wɔn ho nni kyɛfa na wɔwɔ asetena mu haw ahorow mu no so nsunsuansoɔ kɛse. Eyinom bi ne wɔn a wɔwɔ hia mu, wɔn a wɔwɔ mbeaeɛ a ɔko rekɔ so, ne wɔn a wɔte mbeaeɛ a ɛne nkuropɔn ntam kwan ware.Mmaa ne Mmarima ntam Pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ a Enni hɔ (Gender Inequality):Mmaa ne mmarima ntam nsonsonoeɛ wɔ sɛdeɛ nneɛma ne gyinaesi nsa ka no ma wiemu nsakraeɛ nya ASRH so nsunsuansoɔ kɛse. Mmabaayewa na wɔtaa hyia asiane kɛseɛ esiane amammerɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔmanfoɔ hwɛ kwan sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn adeɛ nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm mu mmoa, sikasɛm nketewa ho nnwuma, anaa sika a wɔde hyɛ adwuma ase de aboa wɔn asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso ne adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm mu mmoa ama asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso ne adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow denam akwan horow so, a mmabun nhyehyɛe ahorow a aban boa, adwumakuo a wɔmma siak mfasoɔ, sikasɛm asoɛe nketewa, ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, ne nnipadɔm sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow ka ho. Sikasɛm nketewa dwumadibea ahorow de bosea nketewa, sikakorabea, ne sikasɛm ho ntetee a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ahorow ma, na ɛma wotumi de wɔn sika hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wɔn ahokokwaw nya nkɔso, adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow, nnwinnade a wɔtɔ, adwumayɛ nkɔso, anaa nnwuma a ɛma wonya sika mu. Sika a wɔde befi ase adi dwuma no nam sika mu mmoa, akansi, incubator nhyehyɛe, anaa mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe so, a ɛbɛma mmabun anya aba sika a wɔde befi ase anaa wɔatrɛw wɔn nnwuma mu na wɔadan wɔn nimdeɛ ayɛ asetene hokwan ahorow a ɛtra hɔ daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmɔden a wɔbɔ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ne botae ahorow a ɛtrɛw a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun akwahosan, yiyedi, asetra ne nkate mu adesua, ne ɔmanfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ nnɛyi tebea a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo pii wom no mu no hyia?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ne botae ahorow a ɛtrɛw a ɛbɛma mmabun akwahosan, yiyedi, asetra-nkate mu adesua, ne ɔmanfo de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu wɔ nnɛyi tebea a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo pii wom no mu no hyia denam: Asuafo a wɔbɛma wɔn adwene a ɛyɛ den, abɛɛfo ntentan mu nimdeɛ ne tumi ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde yɛ nneɛma a ɛma wɔn tumi a wɔde fa abɛɛfo ntentan mmeae ahorow na wɔboa wɔ asɛyɛde ne abrabɔ pa mu no yɛ kɛse. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛboa ankasa ho mfonini pa, abusuabɔ pa, ne gyinaesi a ntease wom a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan, nipadua mfonini, ne ayɔnkofa ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso. Asuafoɔ a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔmanfoɔ kyɛfa, nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi, ne mpɔtam hɔ dwumadie mu denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ananmusifoɔ a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ yie, nne ahodoɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛseɛ, ne asɛm a epira ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔbɛkasa atia so. Asetra-nkate mu adesua ho nimdeɛ te sɛ tema, adwene a wɔfa, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nkɔmmɔbɔ, nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a ɛtwe adwene si nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nhwehwɛmu ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ nna mu dwumadi mu (sɛ nhwɛso no, nna mu yarewa (STIs), nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, atenka fam nsunsuanso)?
answer_twi_source: Nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STI): Eyinom yɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so fi onipa biako so kɔ foforo mu. STI ahorow bi betumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba sɛ wɔansa a. Nyinsɛn: Sɛ woamfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano nni dwuma a, hokwan wɔ hɔ sɛ wubetumi anyinsɛn, na ɛde ɔbabun no ne akokoaa no to asiane mu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn ne awo mu nsɛnnennen Atenka mu nsunsuanso: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna betumi ayɛ osuahu a tumi wom na ebetumi ama woanya atenka horow a w'ansusu, te sɛ ahonu, afobu, anaa dadwen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn na de meho adi anaa aboa beae ɛhodwo adebɔ mu anaa kuo ɛboa mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi wɔ sukuu no mu anaa mpɔtam no?
answer_twi_source: kasa mma: bɔ asem noho dawuru. mmoa tee a aborɔfo ka no sɛ ́direct support': tu wo ho si hɔ anaa kyerɛkyerɛ. Nea eka ho: kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wɔbɛfaso annya bi. Fa wo nimdeɛ  di dwuma ('art/tech').
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa m’adamfo bi a ebia ɔrehyia GBV nanso osuro sɛ ɔbɛkasa? (atie a wɔde nsiyɛ, mmoa a wɔde ma, wɔde wɔn bata aboafo nneɛma ho) .
answer_twi_source: Tie a Wode Nna: Tie a wunmmu atɛn na gye nea wɔka kyerɛ wo no di. Fa Mmoa Ma: Ma wonhu sɛ wudwen wɔn ho na wowɔ hɔ ma wɔn. Fa wɔn bata Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma ho: Fa nsɛm a ɛfa ahomotrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, wɛbsaet, anaa afotufo a wobetumi aboa ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛbɔ mmabun SRH hokwan ahorow ho ban wɔ ntawntawdi ne ntawntawdi akyi tebea horow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahyɛ mu den de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobebu akontaa na wɔadi so?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw: Amanaman ntam apam ne apam ahorow te sɛ Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam ne Amanaman Ntam Nhyiam a Ɛfa Nnipa Dodow ne Nkɔso Ho no ka nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow ho ban wɔ ntawntawdi ne ntawntawdi akyi tebea horow mu. Akwan a wɔfa so hyɛ mmara: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ saa hokwan ahodoɔ yi ase akɔ nhyehyɛɛ a wɔbɛtumi ayɛ ho adwuma, a akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi dwuma na wɔabu akontaa wɔ ɔman ne amanaman ntam nyinaa. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Mmabun, ne ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, bɛtumi ako ama mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ yi a wɔde bedi dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma, na wɔabu aban ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no ho akontaa sɛ wɔbɛdi SRH hokwan ahodoɔ so wɔ mmeaeɛ a ntawntawdie wɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo mu nneɛma bi a ebetumi anya abusuabɔ ho adwene so nkɛntɛnso na aboa ma nneɛma a ɛnyɛ papa aba "unhealthy dynamics", na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfoɔ mu nneɛma a ɛbɛtumi anya abusuabɔ ho adwene so nkɛntɛnsoɔ na aboa ama nkɔsoɔ a ɛnyɛ papa aba no bi ne: - Bɔbeasuo Ho Akwanhwɛ: Amammerɛ mu mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ ankorankoro bɛyɛ wɔn ade wɔ abusuabɔ mu a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu "gender identity" so. - Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ Nkɛntɛnso: Abusuabɔ ho mfonini a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, a sini, "TV" so dwumadi, ne abɛɛfo ntentan "social media" ka ho, a ebetumi ama nneyɛe a ɛmfata ayɛ ɔdɔ anaasɛ ɛbɛma adwene a ɛnyɛ nokware akɔ so atra hɔ. - Abusua mu Nkɔsoɔ: Osuahu a ɛwɔ abusua mu, te sɛ adansedie anaa ayayadeɛ a wɔhunu no, bɛtumi akyerɛ mmabun adwene wɔ deɛ wɔbu no sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata anaa wɔgye tom wɔ abusuabɔ mu. - Atipɛnfoɔ Nhyɛsoɔ: Nkɛntɛnso a ɛfiri atipɛnfoɔ ne asetena mu akuo mu, a nhyɛsoɔ a ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛdi abusuabɔ mu gyinapɛn anaa nneyɛeɛ bi so, a ɛbɛtumi ama agye din anaa dibea adi kan asen obuo ne pɛyɛ. - mmabun betumi akasa atia gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira denam atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi "gender roles" ahorow a wobegye ho kyim, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow mu yiye, ne nkrasɛm a ɛfa pɛyɛ ne obu ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔne afoforo nkitahodi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde anaa nnwumakuw bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde akwankyerɛ anaa afotu a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ sika fam mmoa wɔ nhomasua ne ntetee mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow ne nnwumakuw bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde akwankyerɛ anaa afotu a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ sika fam mmoa wɔ nhomasua ne ntetee mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne sukuu afotufo, kɔlege kwan a wɔfa so nya nhyehyɛe, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, ne aban ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ nhomasua ne mmabun adwuma titiriw. Wɔde mmoa ma wɔ sika a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ adesua mu, sikasɛm mu mmoa akwammisa, kɔlege a wɔgye nkurɔfoɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ, adwumayɛ ho afotuo, ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ho adesua mu de boa asuafoɔ ma wɔhwehwɛ wɔn akwan mu na wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nwomasua ne daakye ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no betumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ahyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den, atrɛw nea wɔde ma no mu, na ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ papa, nea wobetumi anya, ne nea ne bo yɛ den a wɔde ma mmabun no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae: Fa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun akwahosan di kan, ɛtrɛw akwahosan ho sika a wɔde tua ho ka mu, ɛhyɛ insurance nneyɛe ho mmara, na ɛkyekyɛ nneɛma ma mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa, nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua, ne akuw a wonni ahobammɔ. Nnwumakuo ahodoɔ ntam nkitahodiɛ: Ɛbɛma aban, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, insurancefoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ, mmabun akuo, ne amanaman ntam nnwumakuo ntam adwumayɛ akɔ so de adi nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ ho dwuma, akyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa, na wɔaboaboa nneɛma ano ama mmabun akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ. Tumi a wɔbɛma: Fa sika hyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntetee, nnwuma a wɔyɛ, mfiridwuma a wogye tom, ne nkɔso a ɛbɛma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ayɛ yiye, na ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no atu mpɔn wɔ mmabun ahiade ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma mu. Nsɛm a wɔka fa ho ne akontaabuo: Ma nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, insurancefoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bu akontaa wɔ wɔn bɔhyɛ a wɔde ama mmabun akwahosan ho, hwɛ nkɔsoɔ a ɛrekɔ so wɔ akwahosan ho botaeɛ ho, na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nnoɔma a ɛda adi pefee, pɛyɛ, ne akontabuo wɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nneɛma a wɔkyekyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na aduan pa ho hia wɔ resi sɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Aduan pa ho hia kɛse paa ma wɔn a wɔresi sɔ no mu efisɛ eyi yɛ bere a onyin na onyin ntɛmntɛm. Wo nipadua hia aduannuru a ɛho hia a ɛbɛboa nsakrae te sɛ nnompe nyin a ɛkɔ soro, ntini nyin, ne nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae. Aduan a wodi boro so betumi ama obi ayɛ kɛse mmoroso na asiane kɛse wom sɛ obenya koma ne ntini mu nyarewa ne asikreyare. Sɛ woannye aduan mu ahoɔdennuru a ɛfata a ebetumi ama wo mu duru so atew, woakyɛ, mogya a ɛtɔ wo so, wo adwene so tew na woataa nya ɔyare mmoawa esiane nipadua mu ahoɔden a ɛko tia nyarewa a ɛso atew nti
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ aduroyɛ bi a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho a ɛne wɔn pɛ nhyia a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun: kyerɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔwɔ nipadua mu ahofadi na wɔpow adeyɛ no sɛ wɔmpene so a Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔhwɛfo, ɔfotufo anaa akwahosan ho ɔkamfofo hɔ. Serɛ adwenekyerɛ foforɔ anaasɛ wone akwahosan ho ɔbenfo foforo nsusu ho. Bɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso ho amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ anaa mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛhwɛ na wɔasusuw nsusuaso a fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo bɛyɛ wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a efi mu ba  broni ka no 'outcomes' ma mmabun so no ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ nneɛma so ne nhwehwɛmu no bi ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano, ne adwumayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔde bɛhwɛ nkɔsoɔ ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ayɔnkofa nya wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a ɛfiri mmabun mu ba no so. Nkitahodi betumi ayɛ boayikuw ahorow a wɔhwɛ so, ayɛ nhwehwɛmu, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛmu no ka ho mu de ahwɛ sɛnea nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no tu mpɔn na wɔakyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔhaw pɔtee bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ ntawntawdi ne ntawntawdi akyi tebea horow mu wɔ wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow, ahofadi, ne yiyedi ho?
answer_twi_source: Basabasayɛ ne Nneɛma a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae a ntawntawdi ne ntawntawdi akyi no hyia asiane a ɛkɔ soro a ɛne basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so (GBV), nna mu basabasayɛ, aware ntɛm ne aware a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ, ne nna mu ɔbrasɛe, a ɛde asiane kɛse ba wɔn 'SRH', ahofadi, ne yiyedi so. Nnipa a wotu wɔn fi wɔn afie mu ne wɔn a wɔsɛe wɔn a broni ka no 'Displacement and Disruption': Nnipa a wotu fi wɔn afie mu, atutra, ne aguanfo tebea sɛe mmabun kwan a wɔfa so nya 'SRH' nnwuma a ɛho hia, nhomasua, ne asetra mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow, na ɛma mmerɛwyɛ ahorow no yɛ kɛse na ɛma asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, nna mu yareɛ, 'STI', ne ɛnanom a wowuwu mu no yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mehyia  nsɛnnennen anaa nneɛma bi a ɛhaw me wɔ me nyinsɛn mu, te sɛ mogya a ɛretu, ɛyaw, anaa awotwaa no a ɛso tew a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wotu (Steps to Take)Kasa kyerɛ w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ (Contact Healthcare Provider)Sɛ wohu nsɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛnyɛ fɛ anaa biribi haw wo a, kasa kyerɛ w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ ntɛmpa. Wɔbɛtumi ahwɛ tebea a wowɔ mu no na wɔakyerɛ wo kwan a ɛsɛ sɛ wofa so.Kɔ "Emergency" Room (Go to the Emergency Room)Sɛ wowɔ ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, mogya pii a ɛretue, anaa sɛ wohu sɛ baabi a abofra no woso ne ho no so ate a, kɔ ayaresabea mmerɛ a ɛsɛ mu (emergency room) anaa awoɔ dan mu (labor and delivery unit) ntɛm.Hwɛ Nsɛnkyerɛnne no Yie (Monitor Symptoms)Kyerɛw nsɛnkyerɛnne biara a wohu to hɔ, mmerɛ a ɛbaa ne sɛnea emu yɛ den fa. Saa amanneɛbɔ yi bɛboa w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ kɛse.Saa amanneɛbɔ yi bɛboa w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ kɛse. Nom Nsuo na Home Nom nsuo pii na nya ahomegyeɛ a ɛfata.Ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a, nsuonom ne ahomegyeɛ tumi ma ɔhaw ne ɛyaw bi so tew.Hwehwɛ Nkuranhyɛ ne Mmoa Nyinsɛn mu haw tumi de adwendwene ba.Hwehwɛ nnamfo pa, abusuafoɔ, anaa afotufoɔ (counselor) a wobɛtumi akasa akyerɛ wɔn na wɔahyɛ wo den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw (contraception), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: videos ne quizzes. Forums ne social media ahorow. Nkabom a yɛne sukuu ne 'influencers' bɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ ahye ahorow, te sɛ honam fam, nkate fam, ne nna mu ahye, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka ho asɛm yiye akyerɛ afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa ahyeɛ ahodoɔ ho ne honam fam (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, ankorankoro atenaeɛ, honam fam nsa a wɔde ka), nkateɛ mu (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, nkateɛ a wɔda no adi, kokoamsɛm), ne nna (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, pene a wɔpene so, nna mu dwumadiɛ). Sɛ wobɛka ahye ho asɛm yiye a, fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tee di dwuma, da w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ adi denneennen, na fa nhwɛso anaa tebea pɔtee bi ma de kyerɛkyerɛ w’ahye mu. Fa nnamyɛ tie ne tema di dwuma na ama woate afoforo adwene ase, na bue w’ani ma nkitahodi na wogyae wo ho mu bere a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Gyinaesi akwan, anaa akwan horow bɛn na metumi de adi dwuma de ama me gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ ne ahotoso a mewɔ wɔ m’atipɛnfo nsunsuanso bɔne a mɛko atia ne paw a mɛpaw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Akwan horow pii wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so si gyinae a mmabun betumi de adi dwuma de ama wɔn gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ ne ahotoso a wɔwɔ wɔ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso bɔne a wɔbɛko atia no ayɛ kɛse: Gyinaesi matrices anaa grids: Hyehyɛ nsɛm na hwehwɛ akwan foforo a egyina gyinapɛn anaa gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ so. Mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ: Kyerɛw mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔkwan biara a wobɛfa so no so na ama ntotoho ne gyinaesi ayɛ mmerɛw. Dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma: Fa nkitahodi a ɛyɛ ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ di dwuma wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow a wɔayɛ no sɛnea ɛte mu. Adwene ne nsusuwii: Gye bere susuw w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, nkate horow, ne botae ahorow ho ansa na woasi gyinae. Mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a wobɛhwehwɛ: Fa ankorankoro a wɔboa wo a wobetumi de nkuranhyɛ ne akwankyerɛ ama wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu twa wo ho hyia. Ɛdenam nnwinnade ne akwan yi a wɔde bɛka gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow ho so no, mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw ne ahotoso a wɔde bɛpaw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nea wɔpɛ bere a wɔko tia atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso bɔne no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ananmusifo a wonni hɔ wɔwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no boa ma wɔn nna ho?
answer_twi_source: Ananmusifo ahorow a wonni no betumi ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ate nka sɛ wontumi ma wɔn adwene tu fra: Nimdeɛ kakraa bi: Sɛ wɔanhu sɛ wɔda wɔn ho adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu a, ebia mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadi dɛm no benya nna ne dɛmdi ho nsɛm kakraa bi. Te a Wɔte nka sɛ Wɔayi Wɔn afi Mu: Ebia wɔbɛte nka sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho no mfa wɔn ho. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛhyehyɛ Abusuabɔ: Ebetumi ayɛ den sɛ wobɛfa abusuabɔ mu bere a wunhu nhwɛso pa a mmubuafo ka ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata denam: Aduan ho mmoa a wɔde ma ntɛm, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ dan a wɔbɛtɔ ho, anaa mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho ka de siw afie a wonni ano. Asɛm ho dwumadie, afotuo, ne dwumadie a wɔde kɔma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua a, wɔde bɛka adan ho nneɛma, sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mmoa dwumadie ho. Nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne sika a wɔde bɛma de adi nhyehyɛe mu nsɛm a ɛboa ma aduan a wonnya ne afie a wonni wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ SOGI-a ɛka ho mu de nnwuma a ɛfata na obuo ma LGBTQ+ mmabun so dua.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwannya ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma biakoyɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ aman ntam de ama nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH)nsunsuanso atu mpɔn na wɔakyɛ nneyɛe pa?
answer_twi_source: Akwannya ahorow a ɛbɛma aman no ayɛ biako na wɔasesa nimdeɛ wɔ hɔ de ama nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) aba no atu mpɔn na wɔakyɛ nneyɛe pa. Nhyiamu te sɛ amanaman ntam nhyiamu, nhyiamu, ne nkitahodiɛ ma adesua, adwumayɛkuo, ne akwan foforɔ a wɔfa so sesa de di nsɛnnennen a wɔbom di ho dwuma na wɔadu botaeɛ a wɔkyɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ me no aka matenka ne nneɛma a ɛhaw me ho asɛm wɔ me mpanyin afe so?
answer_twi_source: Afotu bi ni: Paw mmere a wo ne wo awofoɔ nyinaa ho dwo mo na mobɛtumi anya kokoam nkɔmmɔbɔ. Pae wo mu ka sɛnea wote nka no nokorɛ mu. Ma wɔnhu nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so wɔ w’asetena mu ne mmoa a wopɛ. Fa wo ho yɛ mfatoho: Mma ɛnyɛ dɛ na worebɔ wɔn soboɔ, na mmom fa wo ho yɛ mfatoho kyerɛ sɛnea wote nka. Te sɛ, 'Mete nka sɛ nsesaeɛ a ɛrekɔ so wɔ me honam mu yi abu me so.' Serɛ Wɔn Mmoa. Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie a, kyɛ nneɛma anaa nsɛm biara a ɛbɛboa wɔn na wɔate nnyinuo (puberty) ne ne haw ahorow ase. Kae sɛ awofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo pɛ sɛ wɔboa wo, nanso ebia wɔnnnim ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so aboa wo gye sɛ woaka wo hia a wohia mmoa akyerɛ wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na obuo a ɛwɔ nkitahodie di na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛfa so akyerɛ obuo ama wɔn ho ne afoforɔ na aboa asi ɔhaw a ɛwɔ nna mu ano na aboa nkitahodie pa?
answer_twi_source: Obuo na ɛyɛ nkitahodie pa fapem. Ɛsi basabasayɛ a ɛwɔ nna ho kwan. Nya denam: Bu ahyeɛ. Yaa aso tie, na bu afoforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nneɛma a agye din te sɛ; aban akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, nnuruyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow ahwehwɛ nsɛm a wohyia a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm a wohyia a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu nokwasɛm denam mmeae a wɔagye din te sɛ aban akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow (sɛ nhwɛso no, Ministry of Health, Ghana Health Service), aduruyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow (sɛ nhwɛso no, Society of Obstetricians and Gynecologists), ne adesua asoɛe ahorow (sɛ nhwɛso no, sukuupɔn ahorow a akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow a agye din wom) a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ no so. Wobetumi ahwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware wɔ ɔkwan bi sei; de toto aban akwankyerɛ ahorow, nhwehwɛmu nsɛm a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu, ne nsɛm a abenfo adwene hyia ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wotu fi wɔn afie mu esiane ntawntawdi, abɔde mu asiane ahorow, anaa wim nsakrae nti nya mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ahiade ne hokwan ahorow so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wotu fi wɔn afie mu esiane ntawntawdi, abɔde mu asiane, anaa wim nsakrae betumi aka mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ahiade ne hokwan ahorow kɛse. Ebetumi asɛe awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe pa a wobenya, a nyinsɛn ano aduru ne ɛnanom hwɛ ka ho, ama nna mu basabasayɛ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ho asiane ayɛ kɛse, na ama wɔaware ntɛm ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi de ayɛ nkitahodi a ntease wom na makura mu wɔ atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow mu, te sɛ m'atie wn yie, m'anya tema, kokoamsɛm, ne obuo a wɔde ma afoforɔ adwene, osuahu, ne ahyeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Atie ne tema a wɔde di dwuma denneennen bere a wɔne atipɛnfo redi nkitaho, ada anigye ne ntease ankasa adi wɔ wɔn suahu ne wɔn adwene ho. Ahintasɛm ne kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔ kuw no mu, beae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma kuomma akyerɛ wɔn adwene na wɔadi nokware a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda no adi. Afoforo adwene, wɔn suahun, ne wɔn ahyeɔ a wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛsom bo na wobu wɔn, de amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe no mu no ho nkuran. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ato wɔn so na wɔaboa wɔn mfɛfo asɔremma, de mmoa, nkuranhyɛ, ne biakoyɛ ama berɛ a ɛho hia, ahyɛ abusuabɔ ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ kuo no mu mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow atu mpɔn na ama wɔadi mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ho dwuma yiye, a nea ɛka ho ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ama akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow atu mpɔn na ama wɔadi mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) ahiade ahorow ho dwuma yiye denam ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛfa so a nea ɛka ho ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde 'SRH' dwumadie bɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no ho, atete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ma wɔde nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun bɛma, ahwɛ sɛ 'SRH' nneɛma a ne boɔ yɛ den na ɛyɛ mmerɛ bɛnya, na wɔde nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa 'SRH' hwɛ a ɛfata mmabun bɛdi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sikasɛm mu mfaso ahorow a ebetumi afi mmarima ne mmea akatua mu nsonsonoe a wɔbɛto mu mu, te sɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ a ɛkɔ soro, sika a adetɔfo sɛe, nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ GDP a ɛkɔ soro, ne ohia a wɔbɛtew so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔto nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea akatua mu ntam a, ebetumi ama wɔanya sikasɛm mu mfaso pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adwumayɛ a ɛkɔ soro: Akatua a ɛfata na ɛyɛ pɛ kanyan adwumayɛfo ma wɔyɛ adwuma yiye, na ɛde adwumayɛ a ɛkɔ soro ba. Adetɔfo Sika a Wɔsɛe no: Sɛ wɔto nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea akatua mu ntam no mu a, ebetumi ama afie mu sika a wonya no akɔ soro, na ama adetɔfo sika a wɔsɛe no akɔ soro na wɔanya sikasɛm mu nkɔso. Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ GDP Nkɔso: Akatua mu nsonsonoe a wobeyi afi hɔ no betumi aboa ma sikasɛm mu nkɔso nyinaa aba denam adwumayɛfo no tumi nyinaa a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Ohia a Wɔtew So: Akatua a ɛfata ma ankorankoro tumi hwɛ wɔn ho ne wɔn mmusua, na ɛtew ohia ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a abu so wɔ ɔmanfo mu no so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛkyerɛ me nnamfo ne meatipenfo sukuufo GBV ne hia a abusuabɔ pa ho hia? (nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔabue ano, nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyɛ)
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wobue Mu: Fi ase ne nnamfo bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛnyɛ aniberesɛm fa abusuabɔ pa, pene a wɔpene so, ne obu ho. Nneɛma a Wɔbɛkyɛ: Kyɛ abɛɛfo ntetan intanɛt so nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa GBV ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Adebɔ Ɔsatu: Yɛ akansi a wɔde yɛ poster anaa adwinni adwuma a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa ne GBV a wosiw ano ho nhyehyɛe (a mpanyimfo hwɛ so).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ kasamafoɔ wɔ digital mfidie so de adi asetena mu nsɛm ho dwuma na w'akanyan soronkoyɛ, nkabom na w'ako atia adwenbɔne wɔ internet so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho asetena mu nsɛm ho na wɔde digital akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔakamfo nsakrae pa akyerɛ. Wobekanyan nne, ne adwekyerɛ a w'apo denam wɔn nsɛm ne osuahun ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ intanɛt so no so. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ intanɛt so ɔsatu, adesrɛ, ne nnipa a wɔte ase no mu de di asetena mu ntɛnkyea ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ ahorow ahorow ne nnipa a wɔka bom ho nkuran. Ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ adwene koro a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ama nhyiam ahorow wɔ intanɛt so, sika a wɔboaboa ano, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow. Wɔn digital akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de akasa atia asɛm a epira, nsusuii hunu, ne nyiyim na wɔhyɛ asetena mu atɛntrenee ne pɛyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn mɛfaso atumi ne me hokafo ahwɛ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, anaa botae ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Ntease: Gye bere te wo hokafo adwenepɔ ne nea enti a wogyina wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow akyi no ase. Nsiesiei: Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛma woagyae wo ho mu a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi nyinaa. Nkitahodi a Obu womu: Ka mo ntam nsonsonoe ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na fa obu mu. Fa W’adwene Si Nea Mobom Yɛ So: Hu gyinapɛn ne botae ahorow a mobom yɛ na ama mo ntam abusuabɔ mu ayɛ den. Hwehwɛ Ntamgyinafo: Sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi ɔfotufo anaa ntamgyinafo hɔ na ama woatumi ahwɛ nsonsonoe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu sɛ obi foforo rehyia GBV a, dɛn na metumi ayɛ aboa? (bystander intervention akwan, mmoa a wɔde ma) .
answer_twi_source: Akwankyere ahorow a yɛbɛfa so akɔ atia wɔn a wogyina ho kɛkɛ wɔ mbere bɔne mu: Distract: Yɛ biribi a ɛbɛma woatumi atwitwa tebea no mu. Ɔnanmusifo: Srɛ obi foforo ma ɔmfa ne ho nnye mu anaa frɛ mmrɛ mmoa. Tee Sɛ ahobammɔ wɔ a, hyia nea ɔyɛ ayayade no tee (sɛ nhwɛso no, "So biribiara ye wɔ ha?"). Fa Mmoa Ma: Ma onipa no nhu sɛ wudwen ne ho na wowɔ hɔ ma no. Boa wɔn ma wɔne ɔpanyin anaa mmoa ahomotrofu a wogye no di nni nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne asetra mu nsesae mmɔdenbɔ di nsɛm a ɛfa ntam te sɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, mmusuakuw mu nyiyim, ne asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow mu ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Hu nnipa a wɔyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho a ɛka bom: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkasa ama nhyehyɛe ahorow no hwɛ nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea a ɛyɛ den a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nkitaho wɔ sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ mu no tom. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho: Wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ahorow pii ho, a ne botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no so na wɔama wɔanya sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne ahyehyɛdeɛ ne akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ, mmusuakuo mu atɛntrenee, ne asetena mu sikasɛm mu tumidi so nyɛ adwuma de ma nkɛntɛnsoɔ no yɛ kɛseɛ na wodi nsɛm a ɛtwam ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside anaa nyiyim bere a wɔrehwehwɛ ayaresa mu mmoa a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wonya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata na obu wom?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside anaa nyiyim bere a wɔrehwehwɛ ayaresa mu mmoa a, ɛsɛ sɛ wohu hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ na wɔka wɔn ahiade ahorow ho asɛm denneennen. Ebia eyi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wo ne adwuma sohwɛfo bi bɛkasa, wode anwiinwii akɔdan aban, anaasɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi ɔmanfo su ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no so bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa ne ɔhwɛ so ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa ɔmanfo suban ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no so bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa ne ɔhwɛ denam apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoamu ne nea ɛnyɛ atemmu a wobenya, nnamfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa wɔn a wɔbɛkae wɔn ho, na wɔakae wɔn ho sɛ wɔn gyinaesi no yɛ nokware na ɛfata obu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na mɛtumi ayɛ sɛ mekyima (menstruation) ba pii anaa mete yaw (pain) wɔ kyima mmere no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ne ɔyaresafo kasa. Wɔbetumi aboa ma wɔahu sɛ ebia asɛm bi wɔ ase anaa na wɔde ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ama. Anamɔn bi a wubetumi ayɛ ni: Sɛ wo kyima (menstruation) ba pii ma ɛfɔ mpaade (pads) anaa tampons dɔnhwere biara, anaa sɛ ɛyaw no mu yɛ den paa a, kɔhu dɔkota anaa ayaresafoɔ. Nnuru: Ebia wo duruyɛfo bɛkyerɛw nnuru a ɛbɛboa ma mogya a ɛba brayɛ mu no so atew anaasɛ wadi ɛyaw no so. Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, patches, anaa 'hormonal IUDs' bɛtumi aboa ama wo kyima (menstruation) aba yie na ɛte yafunu yaw (cramps) so. Iron Supplements (Aduro a ɛma mogya): Sɛ wo kyima ba pii a, ɛbɛtumi ama wo mogya so ate (anemia). Wo dɔkota bɛtumi akyerɛ wo 'iron' aduro a ɛfata sɛ ɛho hia a. Kae sɛ ɛhia sɛ wohwɛ wo kyima ne w’akwahosan so yie; mmoa ne ayaresafoɔ pii nso wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛtumi aboa wo wɔ ɔhaw biara a wowɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, mpɔtamfo akannifo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɛ biako de anya sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɛ biako denam nkabom a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, nhyehyɛe nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ, ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Ɛnam abusuabɔ ne apam a wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu titiriw no benya so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse, ama wɔn nkɛntɛnso akɔ soro, na wɔayɛ adwuma de anya ano aduru a egyina adwene a wɔahyia so a ɛbɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde ma mmerante ne mmabaa nyinaa anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na me nufuɔ reyɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Nufu a nyin yɛ mmeawa a wodi kan kyerɛ sɛ wɔakɔ mpanyin mfe so no mu biako. Honam nkwammoa (Hormone) ahorow ka kyerɛ wo nufu mu ntini sɛ efi ase nnyin. Ebia wɔbɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho yɛ wɔn yaw anaasɛ wɔnyɛ pɛ mfiase no, nanso ɛno nso yɛ ade a ɛfata. Nufu bɛkɔ so anyin na anyin wɔ mfe kakraa bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wofi ase anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mpɔtam nnwuma ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ aseɛ anaa wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodiɛ dwumadiɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho mu no bɛtumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ te sɛ: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ mmabun adamfofa, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkorɔfoɔ, ne intanɛt so akwan a ɛma adesuade, nkamfo, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ma wɔ ASRH nsɛmti ho. Nhyehyeɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔn tumi, mmoa, ne fekubɔ a ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim, NGOs, ne nnwumakuo a wɔde mmoa ma de boa mmabun ahoɔden ne nnwuma a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban. Afotuo hokwan ahorow, nkitahodi nhyiam ahorow, ne nhyiam ahorow a mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwene koro, afotufo, ne abenfo a wɔyɛ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho abenfo adi nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam akuo ahorow anaa mmoa akuo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma awofo anaa mmabun abusua a wodi nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne mmoa akuo ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma awofo anaa mmabun abusua mufo a wodi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma. Saa ahyehyɛde ahorow yi de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, afotu, ne atipɛnfo mmoa ma de boa awofo ma wɔhwehwɛ nsɛmti a ɛho hia mu na wɔboa wɔn mma yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkitahodi nhyehyɛe pa ho nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ nyɔnkofa  bi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne atie a wɔyɛ no nnam, tema, ne ahofadi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de saa nimdeɛ yi ahyɛ wɔn ankasa nyɔnkofa nkitahodie mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ papa wɔ nyɔnkofa mu bi ne: - Atie a ɛyɛ nnam: Tie wɔn hokafo no nsusuwii, ne nkate, ne ne haw ahorow yiye a wɔrentwitware mu anaasɛ wɔremmu atɛn. - Empathy: Wɔkyerɛ tema ne nteaseɛ wɔ wɔn hokafoɔ suahunu ne ne nkateɛ ho, na wɔma wɔn atenka yɛ nokware. - Kasa fann: Wɔn ankasa adwene, wɔn atenka, ne wɔn ahiade a wɔde nokwaredi ne obu da adi. - Ntawntawdi ano aduru: Ntawatawdi anaa adwene a enhyia a wobesiesie asomdwoe mu denam apam, nkitahodi, ne ano aduru a wobegye atom a wobenya. - Nkitahodi a Ɛnyɛ Asɛmfua: Wobehu nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa ne nipadua mu kasa, na wode nkate ne tema bua. - mmabun betumi de saa nimdeɛ yi ahyɛ wɔn ankasa abusuabɔ mu denam - a wɔde bedi dwuma denneennen atie, atenka a wɔbɛda no adi, ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔne wɔn hokafo di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi ntawntawdi anaa adwene a enhyia wɔ nkitahodie bi mu ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ ne obu so, na akwan horow bɛn na wɔfa so siesie ntawntawdi wɔ asomdwoe mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi ntawntawdi anaa adwene a enhyia wɔ nkitahodie bi mu ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ na obu wom so denam: Kommyɛ a Wɔbɛkɔ So: Nkate horow a wɔbɛma ayɛ komm na wɔde adwene a ɛyɛ komm na ntease wom abɛn ntawntawdi ahorow. Tie a Wɔde Nnama Yɛ: Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ de te ɔfoforo no adwene ase ansa na woabua. "Me" Nsɛm a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Nsusuwii ne nkate a wɔde "Me" nsɛm bedi dwuma de akwati asodi anaa sobo. Nsiesiei: Ano aduru a wɔn baanu nyinaa gye tom a wɔbɛhwehwɛ na wɔagyae wɔn ho mu bere a ɛho hia na wɔasiesie ntawntawdi ahorow. Ahomegye a Wogye: Sɛ nkate mu yɛ den a, wubegye w’ahome afi nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu, na woasan ahwɛ asɛm no bere a ahokafo baanu no nyinaa ho adwo wɔn no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne aboafo nneɛma anaa mmoa dwumadie bi a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makɔ mmea hwɛ mu na madi nsɛnnennen anaa dadwen biara ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Aboafo nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛbɛboa ama wɔatumi akɔ mmea hwɛ mu no bi ne: Mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛeɛ anaa ayaresabea a wɔde awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titire ma. Hotlines anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a wubetumi anya kokoam nsɛm, afotu, anaa mmoa a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho. Nhomasua nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa akuw a wɔboa a wɔde wɔn adwene sii mmea akwahosan ne awo hokwan ahorow so. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔyɛ mmabun apomoden ne awoɔ ho atɛntrenee ho adwuma titiriw. Apomoden asoɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so a ɛde apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ma, a mmea hwɛ ka ho, wɔ tebea a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ahotoso sɛ wɔbɛdi me nsɛm ne me kokoam nsɛm so berɛ a merehwehwɛ mmoa afiri ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ sukuu mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi anya ahotoso sɛ wobebu wo nsɛm ne wo kokoam nsɛm bere a sukuu mu ahokyere ho nhyehyɛe ahorow yɛ adwuma wɔ kokoam akwankyerɛ ne mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow ase de bɔ asuafo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Nanso ɛho hia sɛ wode nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo wɔ kokoamsɛm ho no kyerɛ adwumayɛfo a worehwehwɛ mmoa afi wɔn hɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So tebea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a mmra hwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo da ɔbabun bi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm adi kyerɛ afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Tebea bi betumi aba a mmra kwan so hwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo da nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho adi kyerɛ afoforo, te sɛ: Bere a nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene wɔ ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho, te sɛ ayayade a wosusuw sɛ ɔyɛ anaasɛ ɔpira ne ho Bere a mmara hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ tebea anaa nneyɛe bi ho amanneɛ, te sɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) anaa nyinsɛn a mmofra nkumaa wom Bere a asɛnnibea ahyɛde anaa mmara kwan so asɛyɛde wɔ hɔ sɛ wɔda no adi asɛm
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsɛmti bi wɔ nna mu akwahosan mu a ɛsɛ sɛ metwɛn sua ho ade kosi sɛ mɛnyin?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ebia nsɛmti bi a ɛyɛ den. Fa w’adwene si nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI ano a wosiw so, di kan pene so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ nuanced akyiri yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho nimdeɛ ne ntease ho nkuran wɔ mmabun ne mpanyimfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Tete mmerante ne mmabaa na wɔma wɔn tumi ma wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfo awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho ade. Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow kyerɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho. Mpɔtam Adwumayɛbea: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma nhyiamu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ de ma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ na wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ Ɔsatu: Fa sohyial media, posters, ne media platform afoforo di dwuma de kyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho. Mpanyimfo Fa Wɔn Ho Nhyɛ Mu: Yɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ ma awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo na ama wɔn ntease ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ saa hokwan ahorow yi ho no akɔ soro. Yɛ adwuma bom: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, ne sukuu ahorow nyɛ adwuma mfa nyɛ mmoa ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi dadwen anaa ahobammɔ a minni a ebia mewɔ wɔ me nipadua a ɛresakra ho no ho dwuma ne wo?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afi ase denam bere a wobɛyɛ komm na woanya kokoam de akasa akyerɛ ɔpanyin bi a wugye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔhwɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo. Da wo nkate adi pefee ne nokwaredi mu, na srɛ wɔn mmoa ne akwankyerɛ. Kae sɛ wodwen wo yiyedi ho na wɔwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛboa wo ma woafa w’asetra fã yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ama yɛn sukuu kuw anaa agumadi akuw no agye LGBTQ+ asuafo fɛw so? (adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛka obiara ho a wɔkamfo kyerɛ)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu yarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akyɛ wɔn suahu, nsɛnnennen, ne nkonimdi ho nsɛm a ɛfa asetra mu nimdeɛ nkɔso ho de akanyan wɔn atipɛnfo na wɔaboa wɔn na wɔaboa nhyehyɛe no mu nneɛma foforo ne mmɔdenbɔ a ɛkɔ so a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyɛ wɔn suahunu, nsɛnnennen, ne nkonimdie ho nsɛm a ɛfa asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔsoɔ ho denam akwan ahodoɔ so, a sohyial media, mmabun nhyiamu, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, ne atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ ka ho. Atipɛnfoɔ adesua nsakraeɛ, afotuo abusuabɔ, ne alumni nkitahodiɛ ma mmabun nya hokwan de kanyan na wɔboa wɔn atipɛnfoɔ, kyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa, de akwankyerɛ ma, na wɔdi nkɔsoɔ ho afahyɛ. Abakɔsɛm, ne adansedi betumi ama mmabun nne ayɛ kɛse, asi nea wɔatumi ayɛ so dua, na wɔakamfo sika kɛse a wɔde bɛto asetra mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, na ama mmerante ne mmabaa anya amammerɛ a ɛfa nneɛma foforo a wɔyɛ, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne adwumayɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asennibea ne mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ayɛ abɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ/hyɛ mmara ase. Bu nsɛm a ɛfa mmara so bu ho atɛn. Ma atumfoɔ bu akontaa. Hyehyɛ mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma nhomasua ne ntetee no akɔ so atra hɔ na anyin denam wɔn suahu ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa ma sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma nhomasua ne ntetee no akɔ so atra hɔ na anyin denam wɔn suahu ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nhyehyɛe no so ahwɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde sika ma no so. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe no mu nhwehwɛmu, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, ne nhwehwɛmu mu de wɔn adwene ama wɔ nhyehyɛe no mu mmɔdenbɔ, nea wobetumi anya, ne nkɛntɛnso ho, na wɔakyerɛ nkɔso anaa nkɔso a egyina wɔn ahiade ne wɔn suahu so. Ɛdenam nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ne nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen so no, mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow no di wɔn ahiade ho dwuma na ɛkɔ so nya nkɔso na ɛkɔ so nya nkɔso bere a bere kɔ so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne nipadua mu adwempa (Body Positivity) a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nipadua mu nneɛma pa, a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nipadua mfonini ho, boa mmabun ma wonya nsusuwii a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛpaapae nkrasɛm yi mu na wɔayɛ mu nhwehwɛmu. Nipadua mfonini a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde bɛma, a wosi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wogye wɔn ho tom, nneɛma ahorow, ne obu ma nipadua ahorow nyinaa so dua. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho adesua a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam, adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nipadua mfonini, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Nipadua ho mfonini su ne nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛso, ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ ho gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne ahotoso a obi wɔ wɔ ne ho ne ne ho a ɔsom bo a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran a sɛnea ɔte biara mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow bɛn na ɛfa kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛne nsɛm a ɛfa pene ne tumi ho no di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow mu no ho hia sen biara de bɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow, ahotoso, ne yiyedi ho ban. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di kokoamsɛm ho mmara ne adwumayɛfo abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun kokoam hokwan ahorow ho ban no so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Kokoamsɛm a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛkora so wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm ho, a wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan tebea ka ho, gye sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wɔda no adi na ama wɔasiw ɔhaw ano anaasɛ wodi mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow so. Mmabun pene a wobenya ansa na wɔada wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm adi akyerɛ nnipa foforo te sɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn so, gye sɛ tebea horow a asiane wom sɛ wobepira ɔbabun no anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ no ayayade. Ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den a wɔde bedi dwuma de abɔ kɔmputa so akwahosan ho kyerɛwtohɔ ne nsɛm a ɛho hia ho ban afi nnipa a wɔmma ho kwan sɛ wɔbɛkɔ hɔ, wɔada no adi, anaasɛ wɔabu mmara so ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wɔde kokoamsɛm sie berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma ne kokoamsɛm denam hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn, nsɛmmisa a wobebisa, nea wɔpɛ ne nea ɛhaw wɔn a wɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun a wobu mmabun ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm so. Wobetumi nso abisa nsɛm a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛka ho wɔ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mu a, ɛho hia sɛ wodi abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ: Obuo a wɔde ma ahofadi: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu kyɛfa a wonya ho, a wosusuw wɔn onyin ne wɔn tumi ho sɛnea ɛsɛ. Ahintasɛm: Mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban, titiriw wɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛho hia ho, ne pene a wonya fi nimdeɛ mu wɔ wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ dwumadi ahorow mu no ho. Nyiyim a wɔnyɛ: Wɔbɛhyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne nnipa ahorow ahorow ho nkuran, na wɔakwati nyiyim anaa animtiaabu biara a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a obi adi, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa amammerɛ so. Mfaso ne nea ɛnyɛ bɔne: Mmabun yiyedi ne ahobammɔ a wɔde bedi kan, bere a wɔtew ɔhaw so na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no gyina adanse so na ɛfata amammerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi nipadua ho mfonini ho haw ahohorow ho dwuma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere de nipadua mu nsakrae ba, na ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ ɛtɔ mmere bi a wobɛte nka sɛ wo hwɛ wo ho. Afotu bi a ɛbɛma wo nipadua mfonini ayɛ kɛse ni: Fa w’adwene si nea wo nipadua betumi ayɛ so: Di w’ahoɔden, boasetɔ, ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa a wo nipadua ma wo kwan ma woyɛ nyinaa ho afahyɛ. Fa wo ho toto wo ho: Fa w’adwene si w’ankasa nkɔso ne nkɔso so, na ɛnyɛ afoforo so. Fa nkɛntɛnso pa twa wo ho hyia: Kwati nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛhyɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu ho nkuran. Fa nipadua mu adwempa di dwuma: Kyerɛ wo nipadua no ho anisɔ wɔ nea ɛte nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi kokoamsɛm a wobu so mu aba ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi abrɛ eyinom ase?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm a wobu so betumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba mmabun so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahotoso a wɔsɛe no: Ahintasɛm a wobu so betumi asɛe ahotoso a ɛwɔ mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntam, na ebetumi ama wɔakwati akwahosan ho nnwuma. Nkate mu ahoyeraw: Mmabun betumi anya nkate fam ahoyeraw sɛ wɔda nsɛm a ɛho hia adi a wɔmpene so a. Mmara ne asetra mu nsunsuanso: Ahintasɛm a wobu so no betumi anya mmara ne asetra mu nkɛntɛnso, titiriw wɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a emu yɛ den mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔabrɛ nea efi mu ba yi ase no, ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de kokoam nsɛm di kan, di kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den so, na wɔne ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no di nkitaho pefee wɔ hokwan ahorow ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho no ho. Bio nso, mmabun betumi ayɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no ntɛm de akamfo wɔn kokoam hokwan ahorow na wɔahwehwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho asɛyɛde ahorow a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma, ne aguade ho dawurubɔfo wɔn wɔ pene a wɔpene so ne nna mu nneyɛe ho mfoniniyɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, asɛyɛde wom, na ɛka obiara ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma mu?
