answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma, ne aguade ho dawurubɔfo wɔ abrabɔ pa ho asɛyɛde ahorow wɔ pene a wɔpene so ne nna mu nneyɛe ho mfonini a wɔkwati denam nsusuwii hunu a epira, nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa, ne basabasayɛ a wɔde yɛ fɛ a wɔkwati so. Mmabun betumi akamfo ananmusifo a wɔyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, asɛyɛde wom, na ɛka obiara ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma mu denam mfonini ahorow a ɔhaw wom a wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm a wɔka di kan, ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne aguade ho dawurubɔfo bu akontaa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma a wɔbɛma wɔabu akontaa wɔ nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ ɔmanfo so no so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea a ɛda osuahu ahorow adi na ɛhyɛ adwene pa a ɛfa pene ne abusuabɔ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔman ne ankorankoro nnwuma ntam fekubɔ betumi aboa ma  mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH)  dwumadie no akɔ soro, atrɛw mfiridwuma foforɔ a wɔbɛnya mu, na wɔahyɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Ɔmanfoɔ ne ankorankoro nnwumakuo ntam nkitahodiɛ bɛtumi aboa kɛseɛ ama  mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) dwumadie no akɔ soro wɔ nnwumakuo biara ahoɔden a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Ankorankoro adwumayɛkuo bɛtumi de mfiridwuma foforɔ, nimdeɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ aguadi ne nkyekyɛmu mu, ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden aba de aboa ASRH nnwuma. Saa bere yi nyinaa, ɔman adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ akontaabu, pɛyɛ, na ɛyɛ papa wɔ ɔsom adwuma a wɔde ma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo ahorow bɛn na wɔde nna ne awo ho akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ahodoɔ de nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie  ma mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mpɔtam akwahosan ayarehwɛfoɔ anaa Mfitiaseɛ ayarehwɛfoɔ. Awo ne mmea ho animdefo (OB/GYNs). Ayarehwɛfo a wɔyɛ adwuma anaa oduruyɛfo aboafo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho. Ayarehwɛfo-awogyefo a wɔwɔ adansedi krataa. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akwahosan ho akyerɛkyerɛfo anaa afotufo. Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe anaa awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Akwahosan asoɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow a egyina sukuu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ a nimdeɛ wom wɔ wɔn nna mu apɔmuden ne suban ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri boa mmabun ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ a nimdeɛ wom wɔ wɔn nna mu apɔmuden ne suban ho denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛfata mfeɛ a wɔbɛma afa nna mu nipadua, awoɔ, nna mu nyarewa 'STI', ne awoɔ nnwura ho 'contraception'. Ɛhyɛ adwene mu nhwehwɛmu ne gyinaesio tumi nkuran sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mmabun betumi asusu asiane, mfasoɔ, ne nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ nna mu dwumadie ho. Nhyehyɛeɛ no si nkitahodiɛ pa, nteaseɛ, ne pɛ a wɔpene so so dua wɔ nnamfofa mu, bere a ɛhyɛ gyidie te sɛ obu, asɛdeɛ, ne ayamhyehyeɛ nkuran. Ɛma akwankyerɛ pa nso wɔ sɛnea wɔhyehyɛ ahyeɛ, kwati nhyɛsoɔ anaa ɔhyɛ, na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ehia. Ne nyinaa mu no, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri yɛ adesua tebea a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo, na atemmuo nnim baabi a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ banbɔ a wɔbɛkasa afa nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho na wɔabisa nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ awofoɔ ne abusuafoɔ boa mmofra anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ ahokyere mu wɔ bɔbeasu ne awoɔ ho nsɛm mu a, mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛde ba?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ anaa abusuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛgye mu no betumi ama obi anya nkuranhyɛ ne awerɛkyekye, mmoa a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛhia ho, ne akwankyerɛ wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu. Wobetumi ama wo ɔdɔ a ɛni bɛbiara, ntease, ne mmoa na woanya ano aduru a ɛfata ama wo dadwen ahorow no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwanside anaa nsɛnnennen bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobenya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ, te sɛ ɛka, animtiaabu, anaasɛ nea enni hɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow te sɛ ɛka, animtiaabu, anaasɛ nea wonnya bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobenya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm no. Ebia nnurutɔnbea ahorow bi bɛpow sɛ wɔde bɛma esiane wɔn ankasa gyidi anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow nhyehyɛe nti. Bio nso, amammerɛ anaa asetra mu akwanside ahorow betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaa nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ sɛ me intɛnet adwene kyerɛ 'digital advocacy' kyerɛ obu na ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Kae sɛ obiara suahunu yɛ soronko. Dwen sɛ obiara wɔ n'adwene kyerɛ. Gye tom sɛ amammerɛ ne nyamesom sesa nkurɔfoɔ suahunu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoeɛ bɛn na ɛda bɔbeasu mu anigye ne bɔbeasu mu su ntam? (obi a w'ani gye ne ho ne sɛnea obi te nka wɔ ne mu ankasa)
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu mu Anigye: Eyi fa nnipa ko a w’ani gye wɔn ho wɔ ɔdɔ mu anaasɛ wote nka wɔ wo mu sɛ wopɛ wɔn asɛm. Bɔbeasu mu Su: Eyi ne nkateɛ a ɛwɔ wo mu sɛ woyɛ ɔbarima anaasɛ ɔbaa. Eyi fa nea woyɛ ankasa ho, na ɛnyɛ nnipa ko a w’ani gye wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ akwantu ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun ma wɔakɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ akwantuo ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun ma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma denam: Sukuu akwantuo dwumadie a ɛma asuafoɔ de kar kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ sukuu berɛ mu. Wɔn a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa akwantuo adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwantuo ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ ama asuafoɔ wɔ sukuu berɛ akyi. Asuafoɔ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn akwantuo a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛnya akwahosan ho dwumadi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Nhyehyɛe ne sika a wɔde bɛboa akwantuo ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi de mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ adi nkitaho ama kar a wɔde bɛfa mmabun akɔ akwahosan asoɛeɛ wɔ dsys ne berɛ pɔtee bi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awo ne abusua a wɔbɛkyekye ho nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe ama wɔn daakye awo botae ne wɔn apɛde ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua a ɛfa awo ne abusua a wɔbɛkyekye ho no ma mmabun tumi denam nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a ɛma wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ma wɔn daakye botae ne wɔn apɛde ahorow no so. Ɛdenam sɛnea awo yɛ adwuma, nneɛma a ebetumi aka no, ne abusua kyekye ho akwan horow a ɛwɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛte ase so no, wobetumi ayɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no ntɛm de abɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho ban na wɔanya awo mu aba a wɔpɛ. Nhomasua nso boa mmabun ma wonya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ pefee, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne wɔn ho a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban, a ɛho hia na ama wɔatumi afa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwumayɛ mu suahun a mfaso wɔ so na wɔakyekye wɔn adwumayɛfo nkitahodi ahorow de ama wɔn adwuma ho anidaso ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ no anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya adwumayɛ mu suahu a mfaso wɔ so na wɔakyekye wɔn adwumayɛfo nkitahodi denam adwumayɛ ho ntetee, atuhoama, bere fã nnwuma, ne mpɔtam hɔ som nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Adwumayɛ mu adwumayɛ ma wonya nsaanodwuma a ɛsom bo osuahu, adwumayɛbea mu nkɔso a wohu, ne nkitahodi hokwan ahorow a wɔne nnwuma mu adwumayɛfo, wɔn a wobetumi afotu wɔn, ne daakye adwumawuranom nya nkitahodi. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi, mmabun akuw, ne nkitahodi ho nhyiam ahorow mu no ma mmabun tumi trɛw wɔn asetra mu kapital mu, ne wɔn atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwene koro di nkitaho, na wonya mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne adwumayɛ mu nkɔso ho nneɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ nyinsɛn a wobetumi ayiyi bi , na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Atorsɛm: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ nea asiane wom na epira bere nyinaa. kwan pa: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ aduruyɛ mu adeyɛ a ahobammɔ wom bere a apomoden ho ɔyaresafo a ɔfata yɛ no wɔ beae a ɛfata no. Nsɛnnennen a emu yɛ den ntaa mma. Atrosɛm: Abofra a wɔbɛfa no ayɛ wɔn ba no kyerɛ sɛ wobegyae hokwan ahorow nyinaa na wɔrenhu abofra no bio. kwan pa: Agyede ahorow ahorow wɔ hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma a wɔabue ano a awofo a wɔwo no betumi ne abofra no ne awofo a wɔagye wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma no adi nkitaho. Atrosɛm: Ɔwofoyɛ nkutoo ne ade a "ɛfata" a obi a onyinsɛn betumi apaw. kwan pa: Paw "a ɛteɛ" no gyina onipa no tebea ne nea eye ma no so. Atrosɛm: Awo ano aduru yɛ adwuma 100%, enti mintumi nyinsɛn. kwan pa: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano no wɔ sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye, na emu biara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ nkwaseasɛm 100%. Atrosɛm: Sɛ mekɔ akyiri dodo wɔ nyinsɛn no mu a, mintumi nyi nyinsɛn ngu. kwan pa: Mmara kwan so no, wobetumi atu nyinsɛn agu wɔ nyinsɛn anohyeto pɔtee bi mu, nanso ebia ɛsono nea wobetumi apaw wɔ beae biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔyem betumi akamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, mmara kwan so ahobammɔ, ne asetra mu mmoa dwumadi ahorow a wobenya wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ, ɔman, ne ɔman no mu ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem betumi akamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, mmara kwan so ahobammɔ, ne asetra mu mmoa nnwuma a wobenya denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam, ɔman, anaa ɔman no mu ɔsatu ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, nnwumakuo ahorow a mmabun di anim, anaa afotu bagua ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm so de ma nkurɔfo hu, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔakamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe mu. Wɔn a wɔne mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bedi nkitaho de asusuw akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho, de ano aduru ho nyansahyɛ ma, na wɔkamfo mmara anaa sikasɛm mu nneɛma a ɛho hia a ɛfa mmabun a wɔyem ne awofo nkumaa ahiade ho dwuma. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne asetena mu nnwumakuo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, a ɛfata mmabun ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛdi mmabun a wɔyem ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho mmra bɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow ho ban bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho mmra bɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow ho ban bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow denam: Wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm ne wɔn ayaresa ho kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban na wɔamfa wɔn ho anhyɛ mu a wɔmma ho kwan no so. Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi nkyɛ ɔbabun bi nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔmpene so, gye sɛ wɔ tebea pɔtee bi te sɛ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobepira wɔn ho anaa afoforo mu. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn awerɛhyem sɛ wobetumi ahwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ kokoam, a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wobefi mu aba. Saa mmra yi boa mmabun ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn kɛse sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe na ɛhyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nya ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene a wɔpene so di wɔ nna mu anigye ne nkitahodieɛ a emu yɛ den?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so yɛ "yiw" a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ anigye wɔ nna mu dwumadi ho. Wɔde ma kwa, a nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso biara nni mu. Wobetumi atwe bere biara, wɔ dwumadi bi mfinimfini mpo. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu anigye ne nkitahodi a emu yɛ den ntumi nsi a wɔmpene so. Sɛ obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no te nka sɛ ɔwɔ ahobammɔ na wobu no a, nna mu osuahu ahorow betumi ayɛ anigye kɛse. Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so nie: Mpene a wɔde ano ka: "Yiw" a ɛda adi pefee wɔ nea ɛrekɔ so no ho. Nipadua kasa: Nipadua kasa a ɛyɛ ahomegye, a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔn ani agye nea ɛrekɔ so no ho. Anigye: Ɛte sɛ nea wɔn ani agye na wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na CSE ma fa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ twa ndoro/ kwan ho?
answer_twi_source: Condoms (bammɔ). Honam mu nkwammoa  nnuro. Akwan a ɛsiw kwan (Barrier methods). LARCs (deɛ ɛkyɛ). Mpofirim awoba aduru (Emergency contraception).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma pa bɛn na mmabun ayɛ de adi nnamfo nhyɛsoɔ anaa tebea a emu yɛ den ho dwuma na wɔasi gyinaeɛ pa wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aka wɔn suahu ahorow de aboa afoforo na wɔahyɛ wɔn nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun de nneyɛe ahorow pii a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho ne akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano adi dwuma de adi atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho dwuma na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa binom kyerɛw wɔn nsusuiɛ ne wɔn nkateɛ ho dwuma, boa wɔn ma wɔte wɔn suahunu ase, wɔhunu deɛ ɛkanyan wɔn, na wɔdwene mmuaeɛ a ɛyɛ papa ho. Afoforo nso de adwene mu akwan horow te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa adwennwen di dwuma de tra hɔ komm, de wɔn adwene si biribi so, na wogyina wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow so bere a wohyia tebea horow a emu yɛ den no. Mmabun pii nso nam atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, anaa sohyial media so kyɛ wɔn akwan horow, a ɛboa ma wɔkanyan afoforo, nya biakoyɛ, na ɛde akwankyerɛ a mfaso wɔ so, asetra mu ankasa a ɛboa ma wɔpaw nea ahoɔden wom ne nsakrae pa wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, mmara mu nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne asetena ne sikasɛm tebea horow nya mmabun a wobenya sika, hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wuranom, ahofadi a wɔde si gyinae, ne sikasɛm mu dwumadi ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, mmara mu nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne asetena ne sikasɛm tebea betumi anya sika a mmabun anya ne nnwuma nketewa nkɔso so nkɛntɛnso denam: Nsusuwii a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ adwumayɛ ho: Amammerɛ mu adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ asiane a wɔde wɔn ho to, mmarima ne mmea dwumadi, ne mmabun adwumayɛ ho no betumi aka mmabun anigye a wɔwɔ wɔ adwumayɛ ho ne sɛnea wobetumi anya sikasɛm mu nneɛma. Mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow a wɔde bɛba: Mmara kwan so anohyeto ahorow a ɛfa adwuma a obi wɔ, agyapade hokwan ahorow, ne apam a wɔde di dwuma ho no betumi asiw mmabun a wontumi mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ sikasɛm mu dwumadi ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ mu na wɔanya sikasɛm mu nnwuma ano. Asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe a wobedi ho dwuma: Asetena ne sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ betumi aka mmabun a wobenya nhomasua, ahokokwaw ho ntetee, ne social network ahorow a ɛho hia na ama wɔadi yie wɔ adwumayɛ mu, titiri ma akuo a wɔato wɔn hsntidua no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahoɔden a yɛde gyina ano wɔ nkitahodi mu, titiriw wɔ ɔhaw anaa akwanside ahorow mu, na eyi aboa yɛn adwene ne nipadua mu yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi mu ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛsan afi nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside ahorow mu na woakura adwempa mu. Fa di dwuma sɛ wobɛsan ahyehyɛ osuahu ahorow a enye ma ayɛ adesua hokwan ahorow, hwehwɛ nsɛm a wobɛka de ama nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ atu mpɔn, na woakura nkɔso adwene mu. Nya wo ho ayamhyehye na kae wo ho sɛ akwanside yɛ adebɔ mu ade wɔ adesua nhyehyɛe no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔn anaa wɔn adamfo bi resusuw sɛ wobekum wɔn ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ, na ɛhe na wobetumi akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa ntɛm ara?
answer_twi_source: Adeyɛ a Wobɛyɛ Ntɛm ara wɔ Adwene a Ɛma Wobekum Wɔn Ho: Sɛ mmabun anaa w’adamfo bi renya adwene sɛ obekum ne ho a, ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ ho biribi ntɛm ara. Wobetumi ahwehwɛ mmoa ne awerɛkyekyerɛ denam ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di a wɔbɛkɔ so adi nkitaho, telefon a wɔde frɛ telefon a wɔde kum wɔn ho, a wɔbɛtra onipa no nkyɛn kosi sɛ mmoa bɛba, anaa akwahosan asoɛe a ɛbɛn no a wɔbɛkɔ so. Ɛho hia sɛ wofa asɛm biara a wɔka fa wo ho a wokum ho no aniberesɛm na wohwehwɛ mmoa ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔako atia akwan ahorow a wɔfa so di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so, te sɛ clickbait, sensationalism, ne algorithmic bias, a ebetumi anya wɔn gyidi ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu na wɔako atia akwan horow a wɔfa so di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so denam: Wɔkasa tia nsɛmti ne emu nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa anaasɛ wɔayɛ no ma ɛboro so no so. Nsɛm a efi mmeae pii a wotumi de ho to so a wobɛhwɛ ansa na woagye atom sɛ ɛyɛ nokware. Sɛ wunim algorithmic bias na wohwehwɛ adwene ahorow ne nsɛm fibea ahorow. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso de ahu nsɛm a wotumi gye di ne clickbait anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ntam. Wɔn adwene a wɔde besi wɔn intanɛt so nneyɛe ne nkɛntɛnso a algorithms betumi anya wɔ wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nyansahyɛ ahorow so no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akasamafoɔ akuo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa ma wɔ apɔwmuden ho hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana: Ɛde nneɛma ne mmoa ma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden hokwan ho. Ɔman Mmabun Bagua: Wɔkamfo hokwan ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa wɔ, a akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ka ho. Mmabun Akwahosan Hokwan Dwumadie: Ɛde nsɛm ne mmoa ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔrefa apɔwmuden nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Mmara mmoa akuo ahorow anaa mmabun akasamafoɔ akuo a wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ nso betumi de nneɛma ne mmoa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi akamfo nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho denam: Asuafo akuw anaa akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔkama ne nkyerɛkyerɛ so a wobɛka ho anaasɛ wobɛhyehyɛ. Nkrataa anaa adesrɛ a wɔkyerɛw kɔma sukuu so ahwɛfo, mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔka ma nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a wobetumi anya. Nhomasua nhyiam ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, anaa nsɛm a wɔka fa awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho nhyehyɛe wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. W’ankasa wo suahu ne adansedi a ɛfa hia a awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne nneɛma a wobenya ho hia a wobɛkyɛ. Ɔsatuo a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfoɔ, sohyial media nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate ase na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛtwe adwene si mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi so, a nna ne awo akwahosan ka ho? (Nhwɛso ahorow: Apam a Ɛfa Hokwan a Abofra Wɔ Ho, Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botae ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow pii di mmabun akwahosan ho dwuma, a ASRR ahorow ka ho. Nneɛma atitiriw abien ni: Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam (CRC): Ɛma mmofra a wonnii mfe 18 nyinaa nya hokwan atitiriw a nnipa wɔ, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ne nsɛm ka ho. Nkɔsoɔ a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botaeɛ (SDGs): Wiase nyinaa botaeɛ ahodoɔ bi a aman de asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛdu ho wɔ afe 2030 mu, a botaeɛ a ɛfa akwahosan, nwomasua/nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho ka ho, a ne nyinaa nya ASRR ahodoɔ so nsunsuansoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya abusuabɔ anaa twaka a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi aboa mmabun denam: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde nsɛm a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa, pene, ne obu ho bɛma Afotu dwumadie ne mmoa akuo a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ, a wɔrehyia abusuabɔ ho nsɛm anaa ayayadeɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi ayɔnkofa mu basabasayɛ ne ayayadeɛ ho dwuma Nteteeɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ɔsatuo ne nsɛm a ɛsisi a ɛma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ wɔ abusuabɔ pa ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho ne adwumayɛfoɔ sɛ wɔbɛhunu ayayadeɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ na wɔayɛ ho biribi sɛdeɛ ɛfata ama asuafoɔ a wohia mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi nom PrEP aduro no pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛnea dɔkota akyerɛ no a, ɛbɔ ne ho ban firi HIV mmoawa no ho bɛyɛ sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔnom sɛnea wɔkyerɛw ma no a, PrEP tu mpɔn kɛse wɔ HIV a wɔde ma no ano a wosiw mu. Nhwehwɛmu ada no adi sɛ PrEP betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya HIV no so bɛboro 90% bere a wɔfa no daa no. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ yɛkae sɛ PrEP bɔ obi ho ban fi HIV nkutoo ho na ɛnyɛ nyarewa afoforo a wonya fi nna mu (STIs) ho. Enti, ɛda so ara hia sɛ mmabun de kɔndɔm di dwuma na wɔde nna ho nhyehyɛe afoforo a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma de bɔ wɔn ho ban fi STI ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi ahu na wɔako atia nkrasɛm a epira a ɛhyɛ basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, nhyɛso, ne abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa a ɛkɔ so wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi mu mu den?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu nkrasɛm a epira wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi mu na wɔako atia denam nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wobenya so. Wobetumi agye nkrasɛm ahorow a ɛwɔ ase, nsusuwii hunu, ne tumi a ɛkɔ so wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow mu no ho kyim, akasa atia mfonini ahorow a epira, na wɔakasa ama nna mu apomoden ho mfonini ahorow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ nokware kɛse kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammerɛ ka nya nsakrae tumi wo nna mu apɔmmuden 'SRH' nsɛm, na mmabun bɛyɛ dɛn asesa saa nsem yi?
answer_twi_source: Nya nsakrae tumi 'influence'. Ɛhyehyɛ  adwen. Hyɛ nyiyimu/mmusuo kena. Ko ma nsɛm pa, 'yɛ wo ankasa 'content', fa woho hyɛ 'activism'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea efi atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ a ɛnyɛ a obi de ne ho hyɛ mu, titiriw wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no mu ba berɛ tenten?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi gyae ne ho mu ma atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛnyɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu a, ebetumi ama wanyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, nna mu nyarewa (STIs), anaa atenka mu ahodwiriw aba. Sɛ obi de ne ho hyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu esiane atipɛnfo nhyɛso nti a, ebetumi de ɔhaw a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ aba nipadua mu akwahosan, adwene mu yiedi, ne daakye abusuabɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Intanɛt so nneɛma anaa akuw bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde boa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane, intanɛt so nneɛma wɔ YMK app, social media nkratafa a ɛwɔ mmabun akwahosan ne nkɔso nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ Ghana Health Service no so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi benya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe papa a ɛfa dɛmdi ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛka mmubuafoɔ ho hwɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no bɛnya nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri, afotuo, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI ano aduru, abusua nhyehyɛeɛ, ne awoɔ hokwan ahodoɔ ho pɛpɛɛpɛ. Wɔayɛ saa nnwuma yi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛma wɔadi ahiade ne tumi ahorow ho dwuma, ahyɛ ahofadi ho nkuran, na wɔakyerɛ obuo ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nidi ne hokwan ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ megye bere adwen nneɛma asi wɔ m'abrabɔ mu ansa na masi gyinaeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wogye bere dwen a, wosisi gyinaeɛ pa. Ɛboa ma wohu wo ho yie na wonyɛ biribi basabasa (impulsive). Wotumi sua adeɛ firi wo suahunu mu na wopaw deɛ ɛbɛboa wo daakyene wɔn bra.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi akɔhwehwɛ mmoa sɛ mewerɛho boro so a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ woayɛ basaa, anaasɛ wowerɛ boroso a, ɛho hia sɛ wobɔ wo nsa hwehwɛ mmoa. Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa ɔyaresafo betumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama. Frɛ ɔhaw hotline: Hotlines wɔ hɔ 24/7 a ebetumi ama mmoa ntɛm ara. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ wɔ Intanɛt so. Text a crisis line: Crisis lines pii ma texting options nso, te sɛ YMK App a Ghana Health Service yɛ. Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ: Oduruyɛfo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wo akwan a wobɛfa so agyina haw ano na waboa wo ma woanya atenka mu su horow a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia na wɔadi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm a ɛha ho dwuma wɔ wɔn da biara da asetra mu, te sɛ denam ananmusifo a wogu ahorow na ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛboa, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan pa a wɔbɛfa so asi ananmu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a epira denam: Wɔnam abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so ɔsatu ahorow, adesrɛ ahorow, ne nkrataa a wɔde kɔma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nnwumakuw so a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ananmusifo ahorow pii na wɔka ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛboa wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ de ama atipɛnfo ne awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba daakye tumi wɔ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee mu. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran a ɛhyɛ nneɛma ahorow, nipadua mu nneɛma pa, ne nkitahodie pa ho afahyɛ, te sɛ sini ahorow a ɛde ne ho, nhoma ahorow, ne intanɛt so nsɛm ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne nnamfo, abusuafo, ne intanɛt so mpɔtam hɔfo bɛbɔ mu de ama nkurɔfo ate nsunsuanso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a epira nya no ase na wɔahyɛ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma a ɛho hia ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so siw nna mu ɔhaw ano na wɔhyɛ nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Asetra a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Di aduan a ɛfata na yɛ apɔwmuteɛteɛ. Da sɛnea ɛsɛ na di adwennwen ho dwuma. Kwati nsanom mmoroso ne nnubɔne a mmara mma ho kwan. Akwahosan Ho Nhwehwɛmu Daa: Kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn kɔhwɛ wo daa, a nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Di akwahosan tebea biara a ɛda adi no ho dwuma ntɛm ara. Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna Ho Nneyɛe a Ahobammɔ: Fa kɔndɔm ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw kwan di dwuma de siw STI ano. Wo ne ahokafoɔ nni nkitaho pefee fa STI nhwehwɛmu ne ne tebea ho. Nhomasua: Fa nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so so sua wo nipadua ne nna mu akwahosan ho ade. Te pene a wɔpene so, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa ase. Nkitahodi: Wo ne ahokafo nka akɔnnɔ, ahye, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Sɛ nsɛmnsɛm sɔre a, mobom hwehwɛ mmoa. Wo Ho a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Te nea ɛde anigye brɛ wo no ase na ka eyi kyerɛ ahokafo. Masturbation betumi aboa ma woakɔ so ayɛ nna mu dwumadi ne wo nipadua ho ntease.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de ahye asi hɔ na wɔakura mu wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu, na sɛ wotwa wɔn ahye so anaa wobu so a, anammɔn bɛn na wobetumi atu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de ahye asi hɔ na wɔakura mu wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu denam: - Ahye a wɔbɛkyerɛ: Wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, ahotɔ dodow, ne anohyeto ahorow a wobesusuw ho de ahu wɔn ankasa ahye so. a wode di nkitaho ahye: Wode wo ahye a wobeka no pefee akyere won hokafo no wo obuo ne ahopere kwan so. - a wode hyehye: Wobesi won ho so na woaye ho biribi se wotwa won ahye anaase wobu so a, te se se wobeka se dabi, wobegyae tebea no, anaase wobehwehwe mmoa afiri mpaninfoo a wogye won di mu. - a wobesan asusuw ahye ho: Daa a wobesan asusu na woasesa ahye sedee ehia a egyina tebea a esesa anaase ankorankoro nkɔsoɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka hia a ɛho hia sɛ yedi aduan pa, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne nna a ɛfata bere a wo anyinsɛn no.
answer_twi_source: Asetena a ahoɔden wom boa kɛse wɔ nyinsɛn ne awo a ahoɔden wom mu: Aduandi: Di nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, ne protein a ɛnyɛ den pii na ama wo ne wo ba no anya aduannuru a ɛho hia. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛnyɛ den pii te sɛ nantew anaa asuguare a wɔyɛ no daa no ma ahoɔden, adwene, na ɛboa ma wotumi di mu duru a ɛkɔ soro ho dwuma. Dae: Da a wobɛda sɛnea ɛsɛ ( nnɔnhwerew 7-8 anadwo biara) ho hia kɛse ma w’akwahosan nyinaa ne akokoaa no nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm a ɛbɔ abira fi mmeae ahorow a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtaa ba sɛ wubehyia nsɛm a ɛbɔ abira, titiriw bere a wonya fibea pii no. Wɔ saa tebea horow yi mu no, ɛyɛ papa sɛ wubegye nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, aban akwahosan ho abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow, anaa nnuruyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu ahotoso. Sɛ wunnim a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ ɔpanyin anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkyɛn ma wama wo mu ada hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu mmara kwan so anohyeto ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nsɛm ne ɛhokwan a wobenya wɔ mmeae bi ho.
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so anohyeto biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔanya nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ Ghana ha.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wim nsakrae nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae ahorow nya no so nsusuaso?
answer_twi_source: Wim nsakrae ka SRH dwumadie a mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ nya no so nsusuasoɔ denam akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhaw adwene, akwahosan ho asiane a ɛma ɛyɛ kɛseɛ, nyarewa a ɛyɛ mmerɛ a ɛkɔ soro, ne akwansideɛ a ɛde ba wɔ SRH nneɛma a ɛho hia te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, ɛnanom hwɛ, ne nyinsɛn a wɔtu gu ho dwumadie a asiane biara nni ho a ɛde ba no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne amanaman apam anaa nhyehyeɛ ahorow di wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ no ho banbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne amanaman apam anaa nhyehyeɛ ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wɔbɔ ho ban mu denam mmara nhyehyɛe, gyinapɛn, ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔde si hɔ a ɛfoa saa hokwan ahorow yi so no so. Ebia mmara a ɛma mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nsɛm, nhomasua, ne akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, ne nneyɛe a epira a woyi fi hɔ ho nkuran. Amanaman apam anaa nhyehyeɛ ahorow te sɛ CRC, ICP ne DPA  ma akwankyerɛ ne gyinapɛn foforo a wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow ho ban wɔ saa mmeae yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi yɛ osisifo, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn adi nsɛm a ɛda adi a ɛde asisifo suban ba no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Suban a ɛyɛ basabasa/a ɛhyɛ so. Tema a wonni. Pattern(nhyehyɛeɛ) a wɔde si wɔn ani so. Tumi a wɔde di dwuma. Di ho dwuma denam tema/obu, afotu, amammerɛ a ɛka obiara ho a wobɛhyɛ ho nkuran so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea mmara mu nkɔso anaa nsakrae a aba nnansa yi no kyerɛ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea mmara mu nsakyeraeɛ foforɔ ka mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa no gu ahorow; ɛgyina nsakyeraeɛ ko a ɛbaeɛ ne baabi a ɛsiiɛ.Nsakyeraeɛ pa, te sɛ mmara mu nkyekyereɛ a wɔbɛyi afiri hɔ anaa nhyehyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den, bɛtumi ama akwantuo a wɔbɛfa so anya ayaresa atu mpɔn na ayi mmaayewa ho kwan adi. Nanso, nsakyeraeɛ bɔne, te sɛ mmara a ɛhyɛ nnipa aniwu anaa sika a wɔbɛtew so afiri nna mu apɔwmuden nhyehyɛeɛ mu, bɛtumi de akwansideɛ afoforɔ aba na ɛatumi agye mmaayewa kwan afiri ayaresa pa ho. Ɛhia paa sɛ mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ bɛma wɔn ani adna hɔ (stay informed) afa mmara mu nsakyeraeɛ ne sɛnea ɛbɛtumi aka nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa, na ama wɔatumi apere ama wɔn ho kwan ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya ayaresa pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne osuahu ahorow a ankorankoro a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu no nya wɔ sɛnea wopue, nsakrae, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛyɛ mmaratidie wɔ Ghana nti, nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee biara nni hɔ a wɔde bɛboa wɔn a wɔasesa wɔn nipadu (transgender) ne wɔn a wɔmmu wɔn ho sɛ mmarima anaa mmaa (non-binary) nkutoo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmabun betumi adi wɔ "HIV" ano aduru nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a, wɔdebɛko akyerɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne sukuu ahorow mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama "HIV" ano aduru nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne sukuu ahorow mu denam nhumu a wɔbɛma anya, animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wɔbɛkasa atia, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu, wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn di nkitaho, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mɛtumi agyina hɔ apere ama wɔada LGBTQ+ nnipa su ahorow ne nneyɛe pa adi kɛse wɔ amanneɛbɔ mmeae? (a wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu yiye, wɔbɛboa nsɛm a ɛka obiara ho)
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛni bɛne wo abɔ bɔbeasu mu nneyɛe ne su ho nkɔmmɔ. Wɔbu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne adwumayɛfo afoforo di wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma na wɔne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔka nkurɔfo ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no yɛ biako mu?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ foforɔ di dwuma titire wɔ mmoa ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛne mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ mu denam nimdeɛ, nneɛma, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn, ne nso denam som a wɔsom sɛ ahɔhoɔ akasafoɔ anaa adwumayɛbea kwankyerɛfoɔ so. Wobetumi aboa ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm ne nnwuma a nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn de ma no gyina adanse so, ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ntam biakoyɛ hyɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so no mu den na ɛhyɛ mmoa a edi mũ a wɔde ma mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ahiade ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na akɔ yie wɔ nna mu nsɛm nnuma ho fa mmabun ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ayaresabea. Mpɔtam ayaresabea a wɔyɛ biribiara. 'Telemedicine' a ɛyɛ intanɛt so ayaresa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi de adi dwuma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde bɛma mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua nneɛma te sɛ nkratawa, nokwasɛm nkrataa, ne nhomawa a ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ GHS, WHO, UNFPA, ne Planned Parenthood de ma. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a wɔde adesua ahorow a ɛma wotumi ne afoforo di nkitaho, video ahorow, ne nneɛma a wobetumi atwe a wɔayɛ ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ma. Mobile apps a wɔayɛ no titiriw ama nkyerɛkyerɛ a atipɛnfo di anim, a ɛde nsɛm, nsɛmmisa, ne atipɛnfo mmoa nneɛma ma. Nteteeɛ nwoma ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan, nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so ma nneɛma kɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm di dwuma betumi adi adwenemhaw ne nneɛma afoforo te sɛ abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ a ɛwɔ mmabun mu no ntam?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa a ɛhyɛ amanehunu nso (Trauma-informed care) bɛtumi adi amanehunu ne nneɛma foforɔ te sɛ abusua (race), bɔbeasu (gender), ne ɔpɛ a obi wɔ wɔ n'asɛm mu (sexual orientation) ho dwuma wɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa mu. Wei yɛ nea wɔyɛ denam obiara nea ɔfamu ne n'ankasa n'asɛm a wɔgye tom na wɔsi so dua.Wei kyerɛ sɛ yɛbɛhu sɛnea asetena mu nyiyim ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛnyɛ pɛ ne amanehunu bɔ mu, na ɛbɛtumi aka kwan a obi bɛfa so anya ayaresa, kwan a ɔfa so di ne haw so, ne ne ho a ɛbɛtɔ no. Ayaresa a ɛdwene amanehunu ho yi bɛtɛm de amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ, obiara a wɔde no bɛfra mu, ne asetena mu atɛntenenee ho nimdeɛ afra mu, na ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa nyinaa anya mmoa a ɛfata na ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmra kwan so nsusuwii anaa ahobammɔ foforo bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebia wɔwɔ tebea horow a ɛyɛ mmerɛw mu, te sɛ nea ɛfa nhyɛso anaa wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔwɔ tebea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerɛw mu, te sɛ nea ɛfa nhyɛso anaa nea wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho no betumi anya mmara kwan so ahobammɔ foforo wɔ mmara a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ayayade, anaa ayayade ho no ase. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, atumfoɔ, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa hɔ sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wonni ahobammɔ anaasɛ wɔayɛ wɔn ayayade a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuanso bɛn na nna ho nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nya wɔ mmabun ankasa ho mfonini, nipadua mu ahotoso, ne adwenemyare so, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwehwɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu ne nsusuwii ahorow a epira mu yiye na yɛakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanneɛbɔ mu no betumi anya mmabun ankasa ho mfonini, nipadua mu ahotoso, ne adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Ahoɔfɛ ne nna ho mfonini ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa no betumi ama mmabun ate nka sɛ wɔmfata, nipadua mu abotɔyam a wonni, ne obu a ɛba fam mma wɔn ho. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm mu yiye na wɔkasa tia ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn a ɛnyɛ nokware ne adwene a epira denam gyinabea ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ne nipadua mu nneɛma pa ne wɔn ho a wogye tom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkate mu ateneatene nhyehyɛe, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma adwene mu yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Nkate mu nhyehyɛe kyerɛ tumi a obi tumi di nkate horow ho dwuma na ɔyɛ ho biribi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata na ɛma nkɔso so. Nea ɛka ho ne sɛ obi behu n’ankasa nkate horow, ate ase adwen, na wadi so yiye. Nkate mu nhyehyɛe ho hia kɛse ma adwene mu yiyedi efisɛ ɛboa ankorankoro ma wodi asetra mu nsɛnnennen so, ma wonya abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ den, wogyina adwennwen ano, na wosisi gyinae pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a wɔtaa yɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ  akatua mu nsonsonoe a, ɛwɔ mmarima ne mmea mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka mmabun sikasɛm mu ahotɔ ne daakye anidaso?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow a wɔtaa de kyerɛ sɛ akatua mu nsonsonoe a egyina mmarima ne mmea so no bi ne mmea a wonya akatua a ɛba fam sen mmarima esiane sɛ wɔyɛɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛte saa ara nti, wonni ananmusifo pii wɔ nnwuma anaa dibea ahorow a akatua kɛse wom mu, na wohyia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya adwuma mu nkɔso te sɛ ahwehwɛ a wɔde si dan atifi. Saa nsonsonoe ahorow yi bɛtumi ama mmabun sikasɛm ayɛ basaa, na aka sɛnea wobetumi anya sikasɛm mu ahofadi, akɔ sukuu akɔ akyiri, anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn daakye ho nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasafo ma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne tumi a wɔde bɛma sɛ awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow no fã?
answer_twi_source: Adesua: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho ne afoforo fa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne sɛnea ɛne awo akwahosan di nkitaho ho. Fa saa nimdeɛ yi kyerɛ atipɛnfo. Nsɛnnennen Ho Nsusuwii hunu: Kasa tia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ ne nyiyim. Wobetumi ayɛ eyi denam nkɔmmɔbɔ, sohyial media, anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe so. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa: Kɔka ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma ma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne awo hokwan ahorow ho anaa boa. Wɔtaa yɛ ɔsatuo ne nnwuma a wobɛtumi de wo ho ahyɛ mu Kasa a ɛka obiara ho: Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho a ɛma pɛyɛ ne obuo ma mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa di dwuma. Ma Afoforo Tumi: Boa ankorankoro a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne na ma wɔn nne so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammerɛ, amaneɛ ne mpotam nneyɛeɛ tumi kɛntɛn sɛnea yɛda nna mu ne awoɔ apɔmmuden etifi asem wɔ intanɛt no so, na sɛn na intanɛt nimdeɛ tumi boa mmabun akwantuo wɔ saa nkɛntɛnsoɔ yi?
answer_twi_source: Amanmerɛ, amaneɛ ne mpɔtam nneyɛeɛ siesie sɛnea yɛkyerɛ nna mu ne awoɔ mu apɔmmuden wɔ intanɛt no so, ɛkɛntɛn nea wɔfa no sɛ peneeɛ anaa akyiwadeɛ. Intanɛt nimdeɛ boa mmabun to wɔn bo yɛ nhwehwɛ mu na wobusa saa nkɛtensoɔ wɔ hunu sɛnea ammamerɛ nnoɔma a ɛwɔ mu siesie intanɛt annamusi, ɛma kwan ma wɔ tumi hu nea ɛda asem a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'stereotypes' ne 'misconceptions' a yɛka wɔ akan kasa mu sɛ nsɛm aa enni mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidie ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ soronko wɔ atubrafo ne nnipa kakraa bi ne ɔmanfo a wɔdɔɔso no ntam?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse wɔ atubrafo ne nnipa kakraa bi ne ɔmanfo a wɔtrɛw mu esiane amammerɛ ahorow, atetesɛm, ne nyamesom gyidi ahorow nti. Wɔ atubrafo ne nnipa kakraa bi mpɔtam bi no, ebia adwene wɔ nna ho ne mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so a wodi so katee, bere a afoforo nso betumi anya adwene a ɛma ahofadi anaasɛ ɛkɔ so kɛse. Nneyɛe a ɛfa awaregyae, aware, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nso betumi ayɛ soronko, na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya so nksunsuanso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow kyerɛ ma akuw a wɔayi wɔn afiri mu anaa wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ, te sɛ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm anaa wodi hia?
answer_twi_source: Akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no taa hyia akwanside akɛse wɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu esiane, nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne sikasɛm mu nsɛnnennen nti. Akwahosan mu Nsonsonoe: ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia akwahosan mu nsonsonoe pɔtee bi, ne ɔhwɛ a wonnya. Nkitahodi: Ebia akuw a wɔde wɔn ato nkyɛn no behyia nyiyimU ahorow pii , na ama nsɛnnennen a wohyia no ayɛ kɛse. Hia a Ɛho Hia sɛ Wɔbɛka Wɔn Ho: Awoɔ akwahosan a wɔbɛhwɛ ama obiara no kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi saa ahiadeɛ pɔtee yi ho dwuma na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn nyinaa ho wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie mu. Tumi a wɔde ma: Awo akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ho hia kɛse ma akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebia wɔrebrɛ nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsunsuanso ama ayɛ kɛse no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔrebrɛ wɔ nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsunsuanso ama ayɛ kɛse ho no betumi anya nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Afotu adwuma ne mmoa akuw a sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de ma. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nhyiam horow ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa, wɔn ho a wogye tom, ne adwene mu yiyedi ho nkuran. Nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow, nhoma ahorow, ne nsɛm a ɛde nsɛm ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so ama nipadua mfonini ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho atu mpɔn ma. Telefon ne mmoa telefon a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi de kokoam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ ne abakɔsɛm mu adwene enisuadehuno a ɛfa nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne wagye wɔn a tomu ɛwɔmpɔtam hɔ, wɔ Atɔe famfo aman mu ne wɔn akyi nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne wagye wɔn a tomu ɛwɔ LGBTQ+ mpɔtam hɔ no wɔ amammerɛ ne abakɔsɛm mu adwene ahorow. Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu, te sɛ Abibifo amammerɛ ahorow bi mu no, atetesɛm ahorow a akyɛ a ɛne sɛ wobegye ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow atom. Nanso, wɔ aman afoforo mu, a Atɔe Famfo aman pii ka ho no, LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ahyia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne ɔtaa wɔ abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu. Saa adwene ahorow yi ntease betumi aboa ma wɔanya tema ne nimdeɛ kɛse wɔ LGBTQ+ osuahu ahorow a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama wɔn ho na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ho ban bere a wohyia ɔhaw bi a ɛfa wɔn nna anaa awo apɔwmuden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama wɔn ho denam: Wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ ne mmara kwan so akwan horow ho. Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no a wɔbɛka. Wɔn ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ mmara ho adwumayɛfo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no pefee. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ wohyia akwanside anaa nyiyim a. Sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nnam wɔ ano aduru a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu na wɔadi wɔn botae ahorow akyi de asiesie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no kɔ so na ɔbabun no kyerɛ kwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho anigye a, siesie wo ho sɛ wubesusuw saa akwan horow no nso ho.
answer_twi_source: sɛ w’ani gye awo ano aduro afoforo ho a, yebetumi ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asusuw ho Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn a wubetumi apaw bi. Kae sɛ wo na wudi wo nipadua ne nea wopaw so. Saa nneɛma yi betumi de mmoa ne nsɛm foforo ama wɔ kwan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛtumi sa nna mu nyarewa (STIs) buruburoo, anaa ɛtena onipa ho daa?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nyarewa bi te sɛ 'chlamydia', 'gonorrhea' yɛtumi de aduro (antibiotics) sa buruburoo. Nanso, virus nna mu nyarewa no (STIs) te sɛ 'HIV', 'herpes', 'HPV' yɛntumi nsa, na ɛtena onipa ho daa. Nanso, yɛtumi fa ayaresa so hwɛ so yie ne asetena pa ma obi tena ase a ɔnhaw, na ɔmfa nsan afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɔhwɛ ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, te sɛ ayaresabea anaa ofie nsɔhwɛ ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, STI sɔhwɛ ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ kokoam. Aban ayaresabea ne ayaresabea ahorow taa yɛ nhwehwɛmu a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua. Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG) de kokoam sɔhwɛ ne ayaresa ma mmabun. Ankorankoro ayaresabea ahorow bi nso de kokoam nnwuma ma, ɛwom sɛ ebia wɔbɛbɔ ka kɛse de. Wɔnnya nnyaa sɔhwɛ ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ fie no kɛse
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua ade pii afa nna mu anigye ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ papa na wɔpene so?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ nna mu akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no mu kɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu anigye, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne STI ano a wosiw ho. Ayaresabea ahorow taa de afotu ahorow ma wɔ nna a ahoɔden wom ho. Nhomasua Wɛbsaet: Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din te sɛ Planned Parenthood. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfa nna ho nsɛmti ho. Kyerɛw wo din wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ asueyɛ a wɔma nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow. Saa adesua ahorow yi ka nsɛmti te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodi, ne anigye a wonya wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ ne nhomasua wom mu ho asɛm. Kɔka intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa mpɔtam a wɔatu wɔn ho ama nna mu akwahosan ne anigyeɛ ho. Platforms te sɛ Reddit r/sex anaa Scarleteen message boards ma kwan ma nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nsɛmmisa a wɔmmɔ din. Afotu anaa Ayaresa: Susuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ mu. Ayaresa ho animdefo betumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho ama de ahwehwɛ nna mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata na wɔpene so so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow, nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, ne asetra mu akuw ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakasa atia animtiaabu ne nyiyim, akyɛ wɔn nsɛm, na wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa mmabun nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, nnwumakuo a wɔkamfo nkurɔfoɔ, ne asetena mu akuo di dwuma titire wɔ tumi a wɔma mmabun ma wɔkasa tia animtiaabuo ne nyiyim, ka wɔn nsɛm, na wɔyɛ tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa mmabun nyinaa. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ma mmabun nya baabi a ahotɔ wɔ sɛ wɔbɛdi nkitaho, akyɛ suahunu, na wɔanya nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no yɛ adwuma de di nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow ho dwuma, hyɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ho nkuran, na wɔma mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne yɛ kɛse na ama nsakrae pa aba. Asetra mu akuw ne hokwan ahorow a wɔkamfo, mmubuafo hokwan ahorow ho adwumayɛfo, ne awo ho atɛntrenee akuw, boaboa ankorankoro ne mpɔtam hɔfo ano ma wɔkasa tia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne ntɛnkyea, na wɔkamfo pɛyɛ kɛse ne nnipa a wɔka ho wɔ ɔmanfo afã horow nyinaa akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi ahu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa frankaa kɔkɔɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi wɔ asiane mu sɛ obehyia nna mu basabasayɛ, na anammɔn bɛn na wobetumi atu de wɔn ho agye mu yie?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa frankaa kɔkɔɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi betumi akɔ asiane mu sɛ obehyia nna mu basabasayɛ denam nsakrae a ɛba suban, nipadua mu kasa, anaa adwene mu a wɔbɛhwɛ so, te sɛ ahoyeraw, ne ho nyɛ no dɛ, anaa kwati ho sɛnkyerɛnne so. Wobetumi nso atie wɔn atenka so sɛ ɛte sɛ nea biribi ayɛ basaa anaasɛ ɛhaw adwene a. Sɛ wosusu sɛ obi wɔ asiane mu a, mmabun betumi abos denam tebea no a wobedi ho dwuma, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi afoforo hɔ, anaasɛ sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔn atumfoɔ a wɔbɛpɛ wɔn hɔ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyehyɛe anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a, ɛbɛboa me ma matɔ sika a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano? (sɛ nhwɛso no, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde nsenia a ɛtwetwe, insurance a wɔde tua ho ka) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ hɔ! Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔ ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ nyinsɛn ano ho: Ebia ɔmanfo akwahosan adwumayɛbea pii de nnuru a, wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔatew so anaasɛ wontua hwee ama mmabun. ɔman no akwahosan ho nsiakyibaa (insurance) nso tua nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔyɛ wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow no ho ka. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu bɛn na wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo, na so ɛho hia ma mmaabun a wɔyem nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo no yɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu anaasɛ wɔde hwehwɛ mu wɔ nyinsɛn mu de hwɛ sɛnea onyinsɛn no ne wɔn ba no apomoden te. Nhwehwɛmu bi a wɔtaa yɛ ansa na wɔawo no bi ne: Ultrasound scans Mogya mu nhwehwɛmu (sɛ nhwɛso no, mogya kuw, Rh factor, mogya dodow a edi mu, widal nhwehwɛmu, nna mu yareɛ   nhwehwɛmu s.e. syphylis nhwehwɛmu, HIV nhwehwɛmu) Awosu mu nhwehwɛmu (sɛ nhwɛso no, sickle cell nhwehwɛmu, G6PD nhwehwɛmu, awotwaa mu DNA nhwehwɛmu a nkwammoaa nnim) Nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hwehwɛ nyinsɛn mu asikreyare Kuo B streptococcus (GBS) nhwehwɛmu, Nsu mu nhwehwɛmu Ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu ansa na wɔawo no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a ɛna no adi, aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm, abusua abakɔsɛm, ne asiane ahorow a wɔahu wɔ nyinsɛn mu so. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ne mmabun a wɔyem asusuw nhwehwɛmu a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ ansa na wɔawo no ho na wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma me mmeammea a metumi akɔgye afotu a ɛyɛ kokoam.
answer_twi_source: Mariestopes Ghana: 030 2241517. YMK App a wode bɛhu  kɔmputa so fotufoɔ (cyber counsellor), sukuu mu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ayaresafoɔ a wɔbɛboa wo kokoam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhaw ne akwannya ahorow a ɛbata mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne nna mu hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam a amammerɛ ahorow gu ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne nna mu hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam a amammerɛ ahorow gu ahorow mu no betumi ayɛ ɔhaw esiane mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow a agye ntini, amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, ne nsakrae a wɔsɔre tia nti. Nanso, ɛsan nso de akwannya ahorow ma nkɔmmɔbɔ, nhomasua, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nneyɛe a epira so na wɔhyɛ adwene pa a wɔwɔ wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne nna mu hokwan ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛkasa akyerɛ awofoɔ anaa adɔkotafoɔ afa 'puberty' ho?
answer_twi_source: Paw bere pa a nnipa baanu no nyinaa dwo na wɔwɔ  adagyew. Ka wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate ho asɛm nokwarem, sɛ ɛyɛ wo yaw mpo a. Bisa nsɛm na ama woate nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ase yiye. Fa “Me” nsɛm di dwuma fa ka w’atenka ho asɛm a womfa sobo no nto obiara so. Sɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛkasa a, bisa ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi ma ɔmmoa no.sa pefee. Bisa Nsɛm: Bisa deɛ wonte aseɛ. 'I' Statements: Ka sɛdeɛ wote nka (Mete nka sɛ...). Mmoa: Hwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛyɛ den a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atenka, nnipadua, ne mmara mu nneɛma a efi nna mu basabasayɛ mu ba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn akwahosan, ahobammɔ, ne ahofadi adi kan bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa na wɔredi atɛntrenee akyi no?
answer_twi_source: Nea efi nna mu basabasayɛ mu ba no betumi ayɛ nea emu yɛ den na ɛwɔ afã horow pii, na ɛka victims atenka, nnipadau, ne mmara mu. Wɔ atenka afam no, victims no betumi anya aniwu, afobuo, ehu, ne ahodwiriw, na ebetumi aka wɔn adwenem apɔwmuden ne wɔn yiedi. Wɔ nipadua mu no, wobetumi apirapira anaasɛ wɔanya nna mu nyarewa (STIs). Wɔ mmara kwan so no, wobetumi abɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no sobo sɛ wɔyɛ nsɛmmɔnedi, na wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmara mu nsɛm mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de wɔn akwahosan, ahobammɔ, ne ahofadi di kan denam ayaresa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, afotu anaa ayaresa a wobenya, ne hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so akɔ mmara kwan so a wɔbɛte ase bere a wɔrekɔ amanneɛbɔ ne atɛntrenee hwehwɛ nhyehyɛe no mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu borɔ ho betumi aboa ma wɔakasa atia adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔde asodi a wɔde to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no so, aboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu, na wɔama amammerɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔpene so, obu wɔn, na wobu akontaa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu ɔborɔ ho no betumi akasa atia adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔde asodi to nea wɔato no mmonnaa so denam: Mpene a Wobesi So dua: Ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so a wobesi so dua na wɔama emu ada hɔ sɛ nna mu borɔ nyɛ nea wɔato no mmonnaa no mfomso da. Tie a Wɔde Tema Yɛ: Tie a wɔde tema ma wɔn ho nkuran na wɔboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no, sen sɛ wobebu atɛn anaasɛ wonnye nni. Akontaabu: Wɔma wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no bu akontaa wɔ wɔn nneyɛe ho na wɔhyɛ amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ne akontaabu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya tema "empathy" ne obu ama afoforo ahye bere a mekamfo m’ankasa ahiade ne gyinapɛn ahorow kyerɛ wɔ ayɔnkofa ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wunya tema "empathy" ne obu a wubenya ama afoforo ahye bere a worekamfo w’ankasa ahiade ne wo gyinapɛn "values" ahorow kyerɛ no hwehwɛ sɛ wubehu na woabu afoforo ahofadi ne wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no sɛ ɛsom bo. Fa nnamyɛ tie ne adwene a wobɛfa no di dwuma na ama woate afoforo adwene ase, agye wɔn suahu ahorow atom, na woabu wɔn ahye. Bere koro no ara mu no, fa ahotoso ne obu si w’ankasa ahye so, ka w’ahiade ne w’akwanhwɛ ho asɛm pefee, na hwehwɛ ano aduru a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wo yɔnko wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahyɛ 'mindfulness' (Sɛ wobenya adwene pa fa biribi ho) ase da biara?
answer_twi_source: Berɛ tiaa bi (Short sessions). Fa hyɛ wo nneɛma mu (te sɛ aduane die). Fa 'apps' (intanɛt so dwumadie ahodoɔ) di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu adwene ahorow ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu adwene ahorow. Kamfo adesua nhyehyɛe nkɔso a egye gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ tom na ɛkyerɛ obu ma. Wo ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mpɔtam akannifoɔ, ne nnwumakuo nyɛ adwuma bom de hyɛ nhumu ne nteaseɛ a ɛfa hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’abusua ahyehyɛ ahyeɛ de abɔ m’adwene mu akwahosan ho ban berɛ a meda so ara kura abusuabɔ pa mu?
answer_twi_source: Ka w’ahiade ne w’ahyeɛ ho asɛm pefee wɔ obuo mu. Fa hyetɛo ahorow to nsɛmti anaa nneyɛe a ɛka w’adwene akwahosan wɔ ɔkwan a enye so no so. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa  ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di hɔ sɛ wobu wo hyeɛ so a. Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow di dwuma na ama w’adwene akɔ so ayɛ yie na woanya ahoɔden bio berɛ a ɛho hia no. Fa w’adwene si nkitahodi pa ne abusuabɔ pa a wobɛhyehyɛ wɔ abusua no mu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun akannifo sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma tumi, afotu nhyehyɛe, ne atipɛnfo adesua nsakrae mu de hyɛ wɔn akannifo ho nimdeɛ ne nkitahodi mu den?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a mmabun akannifoɔ de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadiɛ a ɛma wɔn tumi yɛ adwuma, afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ, ne atipɛnfoɔ adesua nsakraeɛ mu de hyɛ wɔn akannifoɔ nimdeɛ ne wɔn nkitahodiɛ mu den no bi ne: Akannifoɔ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun so, sukuupɔn, ne ɔmanfoɔ akuo a wɔde nimdeɛ nkɔsoɔ ma wɔ nsɛm a wɔka de boa, nkitahodiɛ, ne adwuma no sohwɛ mu de ma. Afotuo nhyehyeɛ a ɛde mmabun akannifoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa anaa afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ ASRH adwuma mu bom de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne nkitahodiɛ hokwan ma. Atipɛnfoɔ adesua nsakraeɛ ne nkitahodiɛ nhyiamu a ɛka mmabun akannifoɔ a wɔfiri mpɔtam ne mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ bom ma wɔkyɛ suahunu, nneyɛeɛ pa, ne asuadeɛ a wɔasua. Intanɛt so adesua, webinars, ne virtual nhyiamu a ɛma mmabun akannifoɔ nya hokwan nya nneɛma ne nteteeɛ module a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa ASRH ho nsɛm, nhyehyɛeɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna mu ɔhaw ne akwahosan 'health' ho nsɛm ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua Ɔsatu 'Educational Campaigns' : Yɛ anaa boa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ho nkuran. Ma nkurɔfo nhu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nsɛmti te sɛ nna mu ɔhaw, pene a wɔpene so, ne twaka 'relationship' pa ka ho. Kasa: Kɔ sukuu baguafo nhyiam horow na ka hia a ehia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ no nne. Kyerɛw nkrataa kɔma nhomasua mpanyimfo anaa mpɔtam hɔ ananmusifo a wɔkamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho kyerɛ. Kɔka Akuw a Wɔkamfo Ho: Kɔka ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ne nhomasua so no ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ nhyiam anaa ɔsatu ahorow a saa akuw yi hyehyɛ de ma nkurɔfo hu no mu. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Yɛ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ de kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri. Hyɛ awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmmoa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu. Fa Social Media Di Dwuma: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛma nsɛm pii, video ahorow, anaa nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri ho. Fi ase bɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ Intanɛt so fa hia a ehia sɛ wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan foforo anaa nneɛma afoforo bi wɔhɔ a wobetumi apaw ama mmabun a wontumi ntua akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so wɔ nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wontumi ntɔ atetesɛm akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi ahwehwɛ akwan foforo anaa nneɛma foforo a wobetumi afa so: Wɔde ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so a wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn ho afotu di dwuma. Nya aban mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow, a ɛma mmabun nya sikasɛm mu mmoa ma wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den a wonni nea broni ka no 'insurance' anaasɛ wonni sika pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm nea broni ka no 'trauma-informed care' ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho nea broni ka no 'trauma-informed care'  a wɔde ma mmabun denam beaeɛ a ahotɔ ne mmoa a wɔde ma a wɔde bɛkyɛ osuahu ahodoɔ, agye atom ne tema, ne nneɛma ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn a wɔbɛnya. Wɔhyɛ atipɛnfo nkitahodi, ntease, ne tumidi ho nkuran, a ɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia a ɛma obi ho tɔ wɔn no wɔ ahodwiriw mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma wɔatumi agyina ano, anya tema, ne obu ama nneɛma ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho mu denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛma afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ adwene ne suban so ho nkuran. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ sɛnea wɔbɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nsɛm mu na wɔahu nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a epira ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nneyɛe a ɛho hia a wɔde di dwuma ho nhwɛso ne tema, obu, ne obiara a wɔbɛka ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu paw mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua ne abusua nkɔmmɔbɔ ho de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu na wɔakyerɛ ase. Mmabun a wɔboa ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow, nnwuma a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ dwumadi ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho mfonini pa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmara nsesaeɛ ka mmabun SRH 'insurance'?
answer_twi_source: Ɛbue kwan anaa ɛto mu gyina amanyɔsɛm so. Nhyehyɛeɛ foforo (te sɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ/abortion). Hwɛ nsɛm mu na ko ma 'insurance' a ɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me hokafo akasa afa ahobammɔ a mede bedi dwuma ama nna a ahobammɔ wom ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee yɛ ade titiriw! Afotu bi ni: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea enti a wote saa mu: Ka ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wobɛda a ahobammɔ wom ne nea enti a ahobammɔ abien ho hia wo ho asɛm. Tie wɔn haw ahorow: Bue w’ani ma wɔn adwene na di nsɛmmisa biara a ebia wɔwɔ ho dwuma. Fa w’adwene si mfaso a obiara benya so: Si sɛnea ahobammɔ abien so ba ahokafo baanu no nyinaa akwahosan so dua. Susu nnɛma: Susu nnɛma a mobɛbom bɛtumi de mo ho ato so a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho. Kae: Nkitahodi yɛ adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so daa. Ka wo hokafo no pefee na ka nokware wɔ w’abusuabɔ nyinaa mu wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho ahiade ne nea wopɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow hyehyɛ suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow kyerɛ suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmabun mu kɛse. Ebia amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow bɛkyerɛ akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow, nna mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wɔ mpɔtam bi mu no, wobetumi abu nna a edi aware anim no animtiaa, bere a wɔ mmeae afoforo no, wobetumi agye atom kɛse. Nyamesom mu gyidi, atetesɛm, ne ahyɛde ahorow nso di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo ho no so nkɛntɛnso mu. Saa amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi betumi anya nsɛm a mmabun nya, ahotɔ a wonya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ mu, ne sɛnea wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi de amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne atinka ahyɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu de asom mmabun a wogu ahorow yiye?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi de amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne nkateɛ ahyɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden nhyehyɛeɛ mu de asom mmabun dodoɔ yie denam: Nteteeɛ ne adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ hokwan a wɔde bɛma adwumayɛfoɔ ama wɔn nteaseɛ akɔ anim wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ ho, animhwɛ a ɛda adi pefee, ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahodoɔ nya wɔ apomoden nneyɛeɛ so. Akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata kasa ho a wɔbɛfa so de nna ne awo apomoden ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ama, a nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛda kasa, gyidi, ne amanne ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu ka ho. Ahotoso ne abusuabɔ a wɔne ayarefo ne asuafo besi hɔ denam obu a wɔbɛda no adi ama amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe, ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne nea wɔpɛ a wobegye atom, ne ahofadi ne wɔn ankasa gyinaesi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ gyinaesi mu no so. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, amammerɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne nyamesom ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛdi amammerɛ akuo pɔtee bi ahiadeɛ soronko ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan ho dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma. Ɔsom a wɔde ma ho nhwɛsoɔ a ɛtumi sesa na ɛka obiara ho, te sɛ akuo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nhyiamu a wɔde bɛma, de agye amammerɛ ahodoɔ ne nea wɔpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ me ho yie sɛ mepɛ sɛ meyinsɛn a (preconception care)?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wubenya nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom na asiane nnim a, wo ne oduruyɛfo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo nkasa ansa na woanyinsɛn na woasua sɛnea wubesiesie wo nipadua. Di aduan a ahoɔden wom, teɛteɛ w’apɔw mu sɛnea wo duruyɛfo tu fo no, na da sɛnea ɛsɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa ama me ho ne m’ankasa SOGI ahiade ahorow wɔ mmeae ahorow (sukuu, abusua, oduruyɛfo adwumayɛbea)? (nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, asɛm a wɔka sie) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu mmaa ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da a broni ka no 'LGBTQ+' sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa me hokafo no honam ne n'atenka yiedi wɔ abusuabɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo hokafo no honam ne atenka yiyedi a wobɛboa no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛda tema, ntease, ne ayamhyehye adi. Tie wɔn atenkasem ne wɔn haw ahorow denneennen a wunsusu ho. Fa nkuranhyɛ, adansedi, ne awerɛhyem ma bere a wɔrefa mmere a emu yɛ den mu no. Bu wɔn ahofadi ne nea wɔpaw, na tra hɔ de mmoa a mfaso wɔ so bɛma bere a ɛho hia no. Hyɛ suban pa ho nkuran, te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, aduan pa a wobedi, ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ so, na ma w’adwene nkɔ wɔn adwenemyare so denam ahoyeraw ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a wubehu ne mmoa a wode bɛma anaasɛ sɛ ɛho hia a wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo (antenatal care) ho hia?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ abofra no nyin. Hu asane ntɛm. Ma akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na pɛ a wɔpene so ne mfeɛ, mpanin mu kɔ, nsa a wɔabow 'intoxification', ne nneɛma foforo a ebetumi aka ankorankoro tumi a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛpene so anaa wɔrennyigye ntom no di?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow te sɛ mfe, mpanin mu kɔ, nsa a wɔabow, ne adwene mu tumi ka pɛ a wɔpene so, a ebetumi aka ankorankoro tumi a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛpene so anaa wɔrennyigye ntom. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun te aseɛ sɛ pɛ a wɔpene so hia sɛ wonya tumi a wɔde bɛte nna mu dwumadie no ne ne nsunsuansoɔ ase yiye, wɔbɛsi gyinaeɛ a nimdeɛ wom, na wɔaka wɔn ahyeɛ pefee. Nsa a wɔabow, titiriw sɛ ɛma adwene no mu yɛ dɔm anaa ɛma obi ntumi nyɛ hwee a, betumi ama obi antumi ammene so yiye. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔdi kan hwehwɛ pɛ a wɔde anigyeɛ ne adwene a emu da hɔ pene so na wɔtwe wɔn ho fi nna mu dwumadie a wɔne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔntumi nnyɛ hwee anaa wɔntumi mpene so bɛyɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mehyia ɔhaw ɛfa akwamoa mu nsakrae ho a, dɛn na metumi ayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɛyɛ den ma wo sɛ wubegyina nkwamoa mu nsakrae ano a, nneɛma bi a wubetumi ayɛ ni: Wo ne Obi Kasa: Susu watenka ho kyerɛ ɔwofoɔ, ɔhwɛfoz, sukuu fotufoɔ, anaa ɔpanyin a wogye no di a, ebetumi aboa wo kɛse. Wobetumi de mmoa, nteaseɛ, ne akwankyerɛ ama. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sɛ wosua pii afa nsabuo, nkwamoa ahodoɔ ho, ne nsakrae a ɛrekɔ so wɔ wo nipadua mu ho a, ebetumi aboa wo ama woate nka sɛ woasiesie wo ho na woanha wo ho kɛse. Adwene ne Ahomegye: Nneyɛɛ te sɛ adwene mu nhunu mu, apɔ-mu-ateneatena a wɔde home a emu dɔ, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome betumi aboa ama w’adwene ne w’ahome ayɛ komm wɔ berɛ a wowɔ adwendwen mu. Suban a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Fa w’adwene si suban pa te sɛ apɔw-mu-ateneatene a wobɛyɛ no daa, nnuane a ahoɔden wom a wubedi, ne nna a ɛfata so. Saa suban ahodoɔ yi betumi anya nsunsuanso pa wɔ woatenka mu ne wo nipadua akwaa nyinaa mu. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛsrɛ mmoa berɛ a wuhia no. Nkwammoaa mu nsakrae a wubegyina ano no ɛnyɛ ade foforɔ biaa ɛka mpaninyɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wubetumi afa so aboa me wɔ m’atenka fam bere a merefa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu nsɛnnennen ne nneɛma a wonhyɛda nnye nni mu.
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi aka wo dadwen anaa nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho akyerɛ me bere nyinaa. Metie, mate w’atenka ase, na mede mmoa ama. Yɛbɛbom abɔ wo haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ, ahwehwɛ nsɛm, na yɛahwehwɛ ɔhaw biara ano aduru.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn mu haw anaa eyikyereɛ ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuanso a ɛtaa ba: Anɔpa Yare: Akisikuru ne ɔfe, titiriw anɔpa. Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ so: Di nnuan nketenkete a wotaa di, kwati hua a ano yɛ den, na kɔ so nya nsu pii. Ɔbrɛ: Ɔbrɛ a wɔte nka, titiriw wɔ ɔsram abiɛsa a edi kan ne abiɛsa mu. Sɛnea wɔhwɛ so: Gye w’ahome pii, da bere a ɛho hia, na di aduan a ɛkari pɛ mu. Akyi yaw: Esiane nsakrae a ɛba wɔ sɛnea obi gyina hɔ ne sɛnea wɔkyekyɛ mu duru mu nti. Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ so: Fa wo ho to wo ho so yiye, fa nipadua no mfiridwuma a ɛfata di dwuma, na susuw yoga a wobɛyɛ ansa na woawo anaasɛ wobɛtrɛw wo ho brɛoo ho. Nsu a Wɔtaa To: Nhyɛso a ɛba akisikuru no so fi awotwaa a ɛrenyin no mu. Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ so: Fa aguaree no di dwuma sɛnea ɛho hia, yɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛwɔ wo akyi berɛmo mu, na kwati caffeine. Komayare: Acid a ɛsan kɔ nipadua no mu esiane nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu ne nhyɛso a ɛba yafunu no so nti. Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ so: Di nnuan nketenkete, kwati nnuan a ɛyɛ nnuhwam anaa srade, na da a wo ti so. Anan ne Anansoro a Ɛhonhon: Nsu a ɛkɔ nipadua no mu, titiriw wɔ ɔsram abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa mu. Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ so: Ma wo nan so bere a wote ase no, hyɛ mpaboa a ɛyɛ fɛ, na kwati sɛ wubegyina hɔ bere tenten. Nsɛnkyerɛnne Afoforo: Akisikuru Adwene mu Nsakrae Nufu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw Ɔhome a ɛyɛ tiaa Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtrɛw Nan mu akisikuru Nneɛma a ɛnyɛ dɛ a Wobedi ho dwuma: Suban a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Kura aduan pa mu, kɔ so nya nsu, na teɛteɛ w’apɔw mu daa (a wo duruyɛfo no pene so). Yoga anaa Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ansa na Wɔawo: Ebetumi aboa wɔ ahomegye, nsakrae, ne ɔhaw a wodi ho dwuma mu. Fa suniɛ boa: Fa suniɛ di dwuma de gyina akyi bere a wote ase anaa woada no. Ntade a Ɛyɛ Fɛ: Hyɛ ntade a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛmma wo yafunu a ɛrenyin no ntwitwiw. Nkitahodi a wo ne Ɔdemafo no bɛyɛ: Bere nyinaa wo ne w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nsusuw sɛnkyerɛnne foforo anaa nea ɛhaw adwene biara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun da nea ɛfata ne wɔn ahwehwɛde adi bere a wɔrebisa sika fam mmoa de ahwehwɛ nhomasua ne ntetee no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun da nea ɛfata ne wɔn a wɔfata adi bere a wɔrebisa sika fam mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nhomasua ne ntetee ho denam nkrataa a wɔhwehwɛ te sɛ adesua ho nkrataa, nkrataa a wɔde kamfo wɔn, sika fam mmoa nkrataa, ne wɔn ankasa nsɛm a wɔde bɛmena no so. Ebia ɛho behia nso sɛ wɔde sikasɛm mu ahiade ho adanse ma, te sɛ ofie sika ho nsɛm anaa adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔfata ma aban mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow. Dwumadie binom betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ adwuma no kɔ nsɛmbisa anaa wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ akwan a wɔfa so paw wɔn mu de kɔ so hwɛ wɔn ahwehwɛdeɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɛfata sɛ wɔnya sika.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di nkɛntɛnso bɔne a animtiaabu a ɛbata STI ho nya wɔ nnipa apɔwmuden ne yiyedi so no ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu betumi anya nkɛntɛnso bɔne a anibere wom wɔ nkurɔfo apɔwmuden ne yiyedi so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Sɔhwɛ ne ayaresa a wɔtwentwɛn so: Atemmu ho suro betumi asiw nkurɔfo kwan sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu, na ɛde nsɛnnennen aba. Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya ɔyare no: Ebia nnipa a wonnim wɔn tebea no bɛtrɛw ɔyare no mu a wonnim. Adwene mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm: Aniwu ne tew a obi tew ne ho betumi ama wayɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, na wabu ne ho a ɛba fam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn  na wɔfa so nya ahotoso na wɔma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ho wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa akuo a wɔboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ: Fa nnyinaso mmara a emu da hɔ a ɛhyɛ obu, kokoamsɛm, ne atie a wɔde nsiyɛ ho nkuran si hɔ. Osuahu a Wɔkyɛ: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nsɛnnennen ne nkonimdi ahorow a ɛtaa ba a ɛfa dɛmdi ho ho nkuran. Nhyɛso Pa: Di ankorankoro ne kuw nkɔso ho afahyɛ na ama wɔanya mpɔtam hɔfo ho adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a wɔyɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wogye nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm, asɛm a wɔka, ne mfoni ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, nipadua mfoni, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm ho kyim, nkasa tia, na wɔsɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a ɛkɔ so wɔ sukuu ahorow mu hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wonnye nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm, asɛm a wɔka, ne mfoni ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, nipadua mfoni, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm ho kyim, nkasa tia, na wɔsɛe no denam: Nnwinnade ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛma asuafo de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea mu na wɔahu nsusuwii hunu, animhwɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahintaw so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ asuafo nkuran ma wɔhwehwɛ sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfoni ahorow nya adwene, suban, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho so nkɛntɛnso no mu yiye. Asuafo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a ɛkanyan wɔn ma wosusuw wɔn ankasa gyidi, gyinapɛn, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no ho. Asuafoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ adwene foforɔ, asɛm a ɛne ne ho bɔ abira, ne nne ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na wɔkasa tia ɔkasa ne tumi nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi mu. Asuafoɔ a wɔma wɔn tumi ma wɔyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a ɛde nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipadua mfoni ho mfoni a ɛka obiara ho, ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛma tumi ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so asusuw nsɛm a wonya fi Intanɛt so ho yiye na wɔahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nsɛm a wotumi gye di ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa atoro nsɛm ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan a edidi so yi adi dwuma de asusuw nneɛma a wonya fi Intanɛt so ho yiye: Hwɛ sɛnea ɔkyerɛwfo anaa fibea no gye di. Fa nsɛm pii a agye din di nsɛm ho adanse. Hwɛ sɛnea nsɛm no yɛ nokware, ɛyɛ sika, na ɛfa ho. Susuw animhwɛ anaa adwene a ɛwɔ fibea no ho. Hwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛmti a ɛyɛ anigye anaasɛ clickbait ho. Hwɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ nokwasɛm ahorow mu ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye di.
