attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na dijitaal nsɛm a wɔyɛ no nea broni ka no 'digital content creation' ho hia ma mmabun, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ nya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Digitals nsɛm a wɔbɔ no nea broni ka no 'digital content creation' ho hia kɛse ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ nya nkɔso, na ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ nneɛma mu, susuw ho yiye, na wɔyɛ nneɛma wɔ nnɛyi dijitaal tebea mu. Ɛhyɛ dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen ho nkuran, ɛhyɛ adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho nkuran, na ɛma nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ kɔ anim, na ɛma mmabun tumi de wɔn ho hyɛ intanɛt so ɔkasa ne mpɔtam hɔfo mu wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So bere bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ metwɛn ansa na matumi ayi nyinsɛn agu?
answer_twi_source: Bere biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wotwɛn ansa na woayi nyinsɛn agu wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ama wɔayɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, de adi dwuma, na wɔasusuw ho denam fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo bɛyɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, de adi dwuma, asusuw ho denam nsɛm a wɔde bɛma, wɔn adwene ne wɔn suahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Wobetumi asom wɔ afotufoɔ bagua, mmabun agyinatukuo, ne adwuma boayikuo mu, akamfo wɔn ahiadeɛ ne wɔn nneɛma a ɛhia paa, na wɔaboa ama wɔayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛne wɔn anigyeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ obu ama sɛ bi dɛmdifoɔ, bere a mere nyin yi?
answer_twi_source: mofa ɔbu ma obiara
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ho, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom yɛ mmeae a nyiyimu anaa atemmu biara nni mu. Wɔho hia kɛse ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm efisɛ: Asetena mu Nkitahodi: Wɔma hokwan ahorow de ne atipɛnfo a wɔte wɔn suahu ase no di nkitaho. Wɔn Ho a Wɔhwehwɛ: Wɔma wonya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi ahwehwɛ wɔn nna ne wɔn nipasu mu a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛpow wɔn. Tumi a wɔde ma: Wobetumi ama wɔanya wɔn ho mu ahotoso na wɔama wɔanya asɛnka agua a wɔde bɛkamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a wɔfa so yɛ wɔn ade wɔ asisifo ho, sen sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ aweredie anaa basabasayɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Akwan pa bi a wobɛfa so ayɛ ayayade ho biribi ne: Wobegyina wo ho akyi denneennen na wo ne ayayade no ahye (boundariea) ato hɔ. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu afotufo hɔ de adi tebea no ho dwuma. Bu a wubebu w’ani agu osisifo no so anaasɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi ho bere biara a ɛbɛyɛ yiye na amma tebea no ankɔ so anyɛ den. Sɛ wobɛnya ahoɔden a wode bɛgyina ano na woanya wo ho mu ahotosoɔ denam dwumadiɛ ne anigyeɛ a ɛde anigyeɛ ne abotɔyam brɛ wo so. Abusuabɔ pa a wode w’adwene besi so na wode nnamfo ne atipɛnfo a wɔboa wo a wɔma wo so na wɔhyɛ wo nkuran atwa wo ho ahyia. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛkae sɛ aweredi anaa basabasayɛ betumi ama tebea no ayɛ kɛse na ebia ɛrensiesie nsɛm a ɛwɔ ase no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi ne obi nya nna a ahobammɔ biara nnim a, dɛn na ɛbɛtumi afiri mu aba wɔ nyarewa a yɛnya no nna mu (STIs) ne HIV mmoawa no nkyekyɛmu ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban, anaa nna a wɔmfa akwanside akwan te sɛ kɔndɔm nni dwuma no betumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba wɔ STI ne HIV a wɔde ma ho. Sɛ ankorankoro nni ahobammɔ a, asiane kɛse wom sɛ wobenya STI ahorow, a HIV, akisikuru, chlamydia, akisikuru, ne HPV ka ho. Saa nyarewa yi betumi de akwahosan ho haw ahorow aba, a nea ɛka ho ne akyi berɛmo mu yare, awotwaa mu kokoram, awotwaa mu akisikuru, ne HIV/AIDS. Bio nso, nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban betumi ama wanyinsɛn a wɔnhyɛ da, na ebetumi anya asetra, nkate, ne sikasɛm mu nkɛntɛnso kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw nneɛma, nnwinnade, anaa nhyiam ahorow bi a mmabun betumi anya, te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ nokwasɛm mu, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ app ahorow, intanɛt so adesua ahorow, anaa atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow, a ebetumi aboa ma wɔn nsusuwii a ɛyɛ pintinn ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim?
answer_twi_source: Digitals media akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nneɛma, nnwinnade, anaa nhyiam ase a mmabun betumi anya bi ne: Fact-checking websites te sɛ Snopes anaa FactCheck.org a ɛboa ma wɔhwɛ sɛ intanɛt so nsɛm yɛ nokware na wɔko tia nsɛm a ɛnteɛ. Media akenkan ne akyerɛw apps te sɛ NewsGuard anaa MediaSmarts’ Reality Check a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ den na ɛma nnwinnade a wɔde bɛsɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ fibea ne intanɛt so nsɛm ahwɛ. Intanɛt so adesua anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ a ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ Common Sense Media anaa UNESCO de ma a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa digyital ɔman bayɛ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ho. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a mmabun bɛtumi akyɛ osuahu, abisa nsɛm, na wɔasusu nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho wɔ tebea a ɛboa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnea broni ka no 'complications' anaa nsunsuanso bɔne a ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi betumi aboa ma wɔahu na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: broni ka no 'complications'  anaa nsunsuanso bɔne a ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu no bi ne: Mogya a ɛba dodo. Nsaneɛ. Ntini a wɔakora so. Nkate fam ahokyere anaa adwenemyare ho haw adwendwen. Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi no betumi aboa ma wɔahu nsɛnnennen yi na wɔadi ho dwuma denam: Mogya a ɛretu dodo, ɔyare mmoawa, anaa nipadua mu nsɛnnennen afoforo ho sɛnkyerɛnne a wɔbɛhwɛ so. Ayaresa a wɔde bɛma ntɛm ara sɛ nsɛnnennen sɔre a. Afotu ne nkate fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma de adi adwene anaa nkate fam ahokyere biara ho dwuma. Ɔhwɛ titiriw anaa nnwuma foforo a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so sɛ ɛho hia a, te sɛ afotu anaa adwenemyare ho hwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nkate mu nneyɛe a emu yɛ den ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi de nnyinasosɛm bi asi hɔ de asusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho, te sɛ obu a yebebu yɛn ho yɛn ho kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm a yɛbɛkora so?
answer_twi_source: Mmara titiriw a wɔde besi hɔ de asusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no betumi aboa ma wɔanya tebea a ahobammɔ ne obu wom ama afã abien no nyinaa. Ebia mmara a ɛwɔ fam no bi ne sɛ wobebu wɔn ho wɔn ho kokoam nsɛm, wɔbɛkora kokoam nsɛm so wɔ abusua no mu, na wɔakwati atemmu anaa ɔkasatia. Mommom nnye mmara a ɛwɔ fam yi ntom na mohyɛ bɔ sɛ mobɛkura mu wɔ mo nkɔmmɔbɔ nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma pɔtee bɛn na ɛde nsonsoeɛ ba mmabun SRH apɔwmuden mu?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyimu (Discrimination). Sikasɛm ne asetena mu nsonsoeɛ (Socioeconomic inequalities). Amammerɛ (Cultural differences). Wei nyina tumi ha ayaresa ne nimdeɛ a wɔnya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na wɔde twɛn adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi agyina ano bere a wɔretwɛn mmoa no?
answer_twi_source: Mmere a wɔde twɛn adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma bi te sɛ beaeɛ, dwumadie ko a ɛhia, ne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no wɔ hɔ. Nea ɛyɛ awerɛhow no, wɔ mmeae bi no, ebia bere tenten bɛtwɛn esiane nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ kɛse anaasɛ nneɛma kakraa bi nti. Bere a mmabun retwɛn mmoa no, wobetumi agyina ano denam akwan horow a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ, adwene a wɔde bedi dwuma, wɔne nnamfo anaa abusua mufo a wɔboa wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ so anya abusuabɔ, anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a wɔn ani gye ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne Intanɛt so nneɛma anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ de aboa wɔn ntɛm ara no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɛhyeɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ mmara anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow ho wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi a wɔne atipɛnfo, nnamfo, ne ɔdɔ ahokafo nya mu?
answer_twi_source: ɛhyeɛ yɛ anohyeto ne akwankyerɛ a yɛde si hɔ ma yɛn ho wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi a yɛne afoforo nya mu. Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea yɛpɛ sɛ wɔne yɛn di ne nneyɛe a yehu sɛ ɛyɛ nea wogye tom anaasɛ ennye ntom mu. Nea ɛnte sɛ mmara anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow, a ebia abɔnten so nneɛma anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow de bɛba no, ahye yɛ ankorankoro de na ɛda yɛn ankorankoro ahiade, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nea yɛpɛ adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nea broni ka no 'social media' ne dijitaal akwan afoforo adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔakamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de nea broni ka no 'social media'  ne dijitaal akwan afoforo adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔakamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm denam nkyerɛkyerɛ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ, hashtag ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso ne wɔn a wosi gyinae a wɔne wɔn di nkitaho, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ intanɛt so ɔsatu ne adesrɛ nea broni ka no 'petition' ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aka mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho so nkɛntɛnso, na ebetumi aka sɛnea mmabun nya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Ebia animtiaabu, aniwu, anaa nneɛma a wɔabara a ɛfa saa nsɛmti yi ho no bɛma wɔn abam abu sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ anaasɛ ɛbɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo anya atemmu ayaresa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmaabun atumi anya sika de aboa nhomasua ne ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sika fam mmoa ama nhomasua ne ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow denam akwan horow so: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ho: Wobetumi ahwehwɛ intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔkora so, akɔsra sikasɛm mu mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow, na wɔne sukuu afotufo asusuw ho de ahu sika a wɔde bɛboa wɔn, sika a wɔde ma, ne sika a wɔde ma a ebia wɔfata. Sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔbɛbisa: Mmabun betumi de akwammisa krataa a wɔde hwehwɛ sika a wɔde bɛboa wɔn, mmoa, ne sika a wɔde bɛma no akɔma ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde sika no ma no tee, na wɔadi wɔn akwammisa ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee ne bere a wɔde ama no akyi. FAFSA anaa nkrataa a ɛte saa a wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Wɔ tebea bi mu no, ebia ɛho behia sɛ mmabun hyehyɛ Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) anaa nkrataa a ɛte saa na ama wɔafata ama aban anaa ɔman no sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe. Mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ: Wobetumi ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa afi sukuu afotufo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, anaa abusua mufo hɔ de ahwɛ akwammisa nhyehyɛe no so na wɔama hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wobenya sika fam mmoa no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ anaa ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde boa mmabun a wɔrehyia adwene sɛ wobekum wɔn ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya saa nnwuma yi wɔ kokoam a wɔremmu atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔde Ma Mmoa ne Mmoa: Nneɛma pɔtee bi ne mmoa nhama wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔrenya adwene sɛ wobekum wɔn ho, te sɛ ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔde kum wɔn ho (GHANA’S NATIONAL SUICIDE PREVENTION HELPLINE: 0800678678), ɔhaw ho nsɛm a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm, anaa intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadibea anaasɛ mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea a wɔkɔsra wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea. Saa nnwuma yi de mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛnyɛ atemmu fi adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa wɔn atinka mu na wɔanya nneɛma a ɛfata a wɔde bɛboa wɔn hɔ ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mfiridwuma betumi ama nkitahodi a ɛda mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntam no ayɛ mmerɛw, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoam ne kokoamsɛm sie wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma betumi ama nkitahodi a ɛda mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntam no ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ akwan horow so: Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Telemedicine platforms: Video so nkɔmmɔbɔ, nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadi ahorow, ne telefon so nhyiam ma mmabun tumi hwehwɛ kokoam afotu, afotu, ne ayaresa mmoa wɔ akyirikyiri. Mobile health (mHealth) apps: Nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom ma mmabun tumi bisa nsɛm, bisa nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, anaasɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ma wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛkɔ bere a wɔhwɛ kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm so. Intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a wɔyɛ no sɛnea ɛte ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔhwɛ so ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ osuahu ahorow, ahwehwɛ afotu, na wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔmfa wɔn ho nkyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ nyinsɛn ne awofoyɛ so di wɔ ɔhwɛ a wobenya ansa na wɔawo ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsunsuanso a Ɛwɔ Nneɛma a Wonya So: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo adwene wɔ nyinsɛn ne awofoyɛ ho betumi anya ɔhwɛ a wobenya ansa na wɔawo no so nkɛntɛnso. Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ abusua mmoa nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den, bere a afoforo nso betumi anya animtiaabu anaa akwanside ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a ɛnyɛ aware ho. Nsɛnnennen a Wobedi So: Hu amammerɛ mu nsɛm a ɛfa ho nanso hwehwɛ nso sɛ wobɛkasa atia nsusuwii hunu a epira anaa akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya ɔhwɛ. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ de hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem ho nkuran. Mmoa a Wɔhwehwɛ: Sɛ amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene de nsɛnnennen ba a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa ankorankoro a wɔyɛ amammerɛ ho nkate na wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛka obiara ho ma. Kae sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ wode kokoam ne obu hwɛ wo a amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na ɛyɛ mbaeyɛ nhye so berɛ 'mandatory reporting', na ɛkwan ben so na ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomuden bɔ ho sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so adwuma a ɛbɛma wɔakɔ so akyerɛ adwene a ɛfa ɔhaw a ɛbɛba daakye no mu no mu ayɛ kɛse. Botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛbɔ mmabun ho ban..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne 'rights-based approach' wɔ mmabun nna mu nsɛm  'ASRH' mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsi so dua sɛ mmabun wɔ hokwan (nimdeɛ/ahofadi/ayaresa). Yɛbu wɔn sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan. Yɛma wɔn mmoa a obu wom na nea ehia wɔn biara wonya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ nya nkɛntɛnso wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ na wɔsa wɔ mmabun mu no so?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ nya nkɛntɛnso nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ na wɔsa wɔ mmabun mu denam: Hwɛ a wɔhwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo te amammerɛ mu nsɛm ne gyidi ahorow a ebetumi aka mmabun adwene wɔ nna, nyinsɛn ano aduru, ne awo akwahosan ho ase. Afotu ne nhomasua a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de adi amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ahyɛde ahorow, ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma. Ɔhwɛ a ɛfata amammerɛ na ɛyɛ nkate a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun gyinapɛn ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne ahofadi wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔde bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ne dwumadie ahodoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so anya abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ne dwumadie ahodoɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo: Mmabun betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe akɔhu nnuruyɛfo, ayarehwɛfo, anaa mmea ho animdefo a wɔdi abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma. Awo akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow: Mpɔtam pii wɔ ayaresabea ahorow a wɔdi awo akwahosan ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho adwuma titiriw, baabi a mmabun betumi anya afotu na wɔanya akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano. Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow: Nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae betumi de abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ne nneɛma ama mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ma mmabun kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ di dwuma titire wɔ mmabun kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛhwɛ mu denam: Akontaabuo ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so akyerɛkyerɛ mu akyerɛ ayarefoɔ a wɔrebɛn mpaninfoɔ Hokwan a mmabun no wɔ sɛ ɔnya kokoamsɛm berɛ a wɔrebisabisa ne nhwehwɛmu Aduroyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ ne nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban afiri kwan a wɔmma ho kwan anaa wɔbɛda no adi a wɔbɛnya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ahyɛ mu ansa na wɔde kokoam nsɛm akyerɛ nnipa foforɔ. Beae a ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm wom a wɔde bɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asiane wɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya STI afi nna mu agoro a wɔde ano di anaa nna mu nkitahodi afoforo mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu agoro a wɔde ano di betumi de STI ahorow bi aba, , ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛtumi afa ano nna agorodie so anya STI. Afotu bi a ɛbɛma asiane no so atew ni: Fa aduru a wɔde yɛ nsensan (latex krataa a ɛyɛ tratraa) di dwuma bere a wode ano agorodie bɛka ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no. Kwati sɛ wobɛka akuru anaa akuru a ɛwɔ wo hokafo no awotwaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ne mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nneɛma afoforo te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne abusuabɔ a ɛfata di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow a ɛfa nna ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ne mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nneɛma afoforo di nkitaho denam hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, ne abusuabɔ pa a ɛkɔ so yiye a wosi so dua no so. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ntease boa mmabun ma wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho no di dwuma yiye, na ɛma wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata na wonya adwene pa wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de anansesɛm, nsano dwuma, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm afoforo adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔakasa ama nsakrae pa a ɛbɛba nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛdenam abasɛm a wɔka so no, mmabun betumi akyɛ wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow, ɔhaw, ne apɛde ahorow, na ama wɔanya tema ne ntease. Adwinni mu nsɛm te sɛ adwinni a wɔde aniwa hu, anwensɛm, nnwom, ne agoru betumi akanyan nkate, akasa atia nsusuwii hunu, na akanyan nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee. Dawurubɔ abɛɛfo ntentan dwuuma, blogs, podcasts, ne online forums a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyekyɛ nkrasɛm, ama nkurɔfo ate ase, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama ɔkasa ama ɔsatu ahorow. Wɔn a wɔne adwumfo, siniyɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ anigye a ɛne atiefo ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Apommuden kwan bɛn na mefa so agyina adwen mu brɛ ano a ɛnyɛ nnubɔne?
answer_twi_source: apɔmmuden hyehyeɛ yɛ adwuma sen nnuru bɔne. ebi ne: ɛyɛ ahome gyeɛ nneɛma te sɛ ahomeɛ denden, anaa dompe mu ahomegyeɛ a etumi te te brɛ ne tu atenka mpɔw.  Ɛda atenka adi wɔ nwom ne atwerɛw mu. Ɛhwehwɛ mmoa firi nnamfo, abusua ne mpanyinfo a wogyi wɔn di na ka watenka ne wonsemisa adi. Fa woho hyɛ anigyie nneɛma mu tesɛ nea wo yɛ wɔ w'ahome gyeɛ mu anaa wotu woho si hɔ. Wodi apɔmmuden pa nhyehyeɛ wɔ daadaa abrabɔ, mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔ siesie wɔ adwen mu brɛ aa wɔn kɔ nom nnuru bɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo a megye no di akasa afa m’adwene mu akwahosan "mental health" ho osuahu ne nsɛm a ɛhaw me wɔ Intanɛt so ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ne ɔpanyin anaa adwenem ahokwasan ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di akasa afa wo intanɛt so adwenemyare ho osuahu ne nea ɛhaw wo ho denam: Bere ne beae a wobɛpaw a wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na ahobammɔ wom sɛ wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ, sɛ́ ɛyɛ ankasa, telefon so, anaa video so frɛ so. Wo atinka ne wo suahu ahorow a wobɛda no adi pefee ne nokwaredi mu, na woama wɔahu sɛnea intanɛt so adwenemyare ho nneɛma anya wo so nkɛntɛnso. Wɔn akwankyerɛ, afotuo, anaa mmoa a wobɛbisa wɔ intanɛt so nneɛma a wobɛfa so, adi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma, anaa mmoa anaa ayaresa foforɔ a wobɛnya sɛ ɛho hia a. Kae a wobɛkae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa afi mpanyimfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso hɔ, na wɔwɔ hɔ sɛ wobetie, aboa, na wɔaboa wo ma woanya mmoa a wuhia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnumakuo ahorow anaa mmoa akuw bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ a wobetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nnwumakuo ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne mmoa akuw bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no so. Saa nnwumakuo ahorow yi betumi de: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho ntetee ama akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo. Nnwuma a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu. Nkerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛfa akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a mmabun betumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow na wɔanya akwankyerɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wobenya wɔ amammerɛ mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsunsuanso a ebetumi afi nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a wohyia nsɛnnennen anaa animtiaabu?
answer_twi_source: Nea ebetumi afi nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛbata ho anaasɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi ho no mu aba no gu ahorow gyina ankorankoro tebea ne mpɔtam hɔ tebea horow so. Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔbata ho no betumi ama ankorankoro ate nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea, abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmoa, nanso ebetumi nso de nsɛnnennen aba, te sɛ ntawntawdi a ɛda ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ntam a wɔbɛfa so anaasɛ wobehyia animtiaabu esiane sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho nti. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, sɛ obi twe ne ho fi nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a, ebetumi ama wate nka sɛ watwe ne ho afi ne mpɔtam hɔfo ho anaasɛ ɔne ne mpɔtam hɔfo ntam atwa, nanso ebetumi ama ankorankoro tumi nso akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ ahofadi na wɔakamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ. Mmabun a wohyia nsɛnnennen anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa wɔn nyamesom gyidi anaa nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho no betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpaninfo, afotufo, anaa nyamesom akannifo a wogye wɔn di a wɔresi wɔn suahu ahorow so dua na wɔte ase hɔ. Wobetumi nso anya nneɛma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛde nsɛm, afotu, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina wɔn akyi a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade ahorow ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ayaresafoɔ bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun fa nna mu nsɛm 'SRH' ho, na mmabun bɛyɛ dɛn abisa?
answer_twi_source: Wɔma afotu a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛnni atɛmmuo. Wɔma nimdeɛ fa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ne nna mu nyarewa 'STI' ho. Wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu (screenings). Mmabun betumi abisa nsɛm, adi nokware fa wɔn nneyɛeɛ ho, na wɔahwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ ohia, adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, ne nhomasua ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya no nya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so wɔ mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ ohia, adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, ne nhomasua ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya betumi anya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso kɛse wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a ahye to wom betumi ahyɛ mmabun ma wɔakɔ tebea horow a ɛyɛ mmerɛw kɛse sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn basabasa, wɔhyɛ wɔn, anaasɛ wɔbɛware ntɛm, na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, STI, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ayɛ kɛse. Sikasɛm a entumi nnyina nso betumi aka mmabun a wobenya nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nyinsɛn ano aduru, efisɛ ebia wobehyia sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow anaasɛ wonni kar a wɔde bɛkɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Bio nso, nhomasua pa a wontumi nnya no betumi asiw mmabun nimdeɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ano, na ɛde adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nneyɛe a asiane wom aba. Sɛ wodi asetena ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe ho dwuma denam nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, te sɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nhyehyɛe, nhomasua nhyehyɛe, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn so a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔabrɛ saa nneɛma yi ase na wɔahyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan mu nkɔso pa ama mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ne akwankyerɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara bom nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na asuafo betumi akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma na wɔmfa nni dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyeɛ ne akwankyerɛ betumi ayɛ: SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ho, a ɛfa nnipa ahodoɔ, nkitahodie, ne awoɔ hokwan ahodoɔ ho. Nhyehyeɛ a ɛnyɛ nyiyim a ɛbɔ asuafoɔ ho ban firi ɔhaw anaa nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, nna ho akɔnnɔ, abusuakuo, anaa sebi dɛmdiɛ so. Kokoam afotuo, akwahosan dwumadie, ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛnya ama asuafoɔ a wɔwɔ SRH haw. Asuafoɔ bɛtumi akamfo denam: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ anaa wɔbɛka akuw a asuafoɔ di anim a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ase na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, sukuu mpaninfoɔ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnye SRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne adesua nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho ntom na wɔmfa nni dwuma. Nhyiam ahorow, ɔsatu ahorow, anaa adesrɛ ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho so dua na wɔama asuafo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaransɛm ne nsakrae foforɔ wɔ mmara mu no betumi aboa ma mmabun a wɔwɔ me man anaa m'amantam no anya ntetee a ɛfata wɔ awoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmarasɛm nsakrae a wɔyɛ no betumi aboa ma mmabun anya nteteɛ a ɛma wɔn ho tɔ wɔn denam akwan a wɔfa so di atemmusɛm, mmara anaa nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ nsonsonoe ho dwuma, ne nsakraeɛ ɛhwɛ mmabun fahodie ne yiedie. Eyi betumi akyerɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ adwuma de sesa mmara a ɛyɛ akwansidie , wobɛhyɛ amanyɔsɛm a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatumi anya ayaresa ho mmoa ho nkuran, wobɛhwehwɛ sika ne ahonyade a wɔde bɛtrɛ ɔsom ahorow mu, wobɛboa ama wɔahu nsɛm a ɛfa mmara ho a ɛfa mmabun apɔwmuden ho, na wo ne atumfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔfa akwan horow so ayɛ adwuma ama wɔatumi ayɛ nsakrae ahorow a ɛbɛboa ama mmabun anya hokwan a ɛteɛ wɔ awo mu apɔwmuden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aka nyisɛn yi gu 'abortion' ho asɛm akyerɛ nnamfo a nyiyimu nni mu?
answer_twi_source: Nteaseɛ 'Empathy'. Hwɛ nneɛma wɔ wɔn ani so sɛ mpo wo ne wɔn nyɛ adwene a. Obu: Kasa yie. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi dɔkota anaa nurse hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔsɛe no, te sɛ kwaesɛe ne efĩ, nya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (Sexual health) so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔsɛe no no betumi ama nsu pa ho ayɛ den ama no aka ahotew, ɛde apɔmuden ho haw ahorow ba efisɛ efĩ sɛe awo akwahosan (reproductive health), na ɛhyɛ nkurɔfo ma wotu esiane wim nsakrae nti, na ɛma atoyerɛnkyɛm te sɛ basabasayɛ ne nnwuma atitiriw a wɔhwere yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akannifo di nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nyinsɛn ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ne mmoa a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wohyia nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da anaasɛ nna mu nyarewa "STI" ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nyamesom asoɛe ne akannifo nam akwan horow so di nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nyinsɛn ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ne mmoa a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wohyia nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da anaasɛ nna mu nyarewa "STI" ho dwuma. Nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow bi de nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mũ a ɛka nyamesom gyinapɛn ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a egyina adanse so a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho ma. Ebia afoforo bɛkamfo nhomasua a wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu nkutoo ho nkuran anaasɛ wɔbɛhyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe ho akwan horow a efi awosu mu a egyina nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ so ho nkuran. Bio nso, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nyamesom mu betumi de awo ho akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛne wɔn nyamesom gyidi ahorow hyia ama, bere a wɔkyerɛ obu ma ayarefo ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm nso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu sɛ obi rekye obi ho mpoa anaa ɔretwa obi apapo ɛnam ne bɔbeasu anaa ne su (SOGI) nti a, akwan bɛn na mɛfa so aboa ?
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔama mmeawa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nnwumayɛfo, nnwumawuranom, ne sikasɛm mu akannifo wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔama mmeawa a wonnii mfe aduonu tumi denam: Sikasɛm mu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ani asi so a wɔde bɛma: Sikasɛm nketewa ho nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ a wɔayɛ ama mmeawa a wonnii mfe aduonu ahiade, te sɛ bosea a wɔde ma mmarima ne mmea, sikakorabea, ne insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow. Adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wɔde bɛma: Ntetee ne afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa akwanside ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, ɛma ahotoso, na ɛma mmeawa adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ kɔ anim a wɔde ma. Mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Mmoa akuo a mmaa di anim, nkitahodiɛ, ne adwumayɛ a wɔde bɛsi hɔ a mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so bɛtumi akyɛ osuahu, anya nneɛma, na wɔadi nyiyim a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho so nkonim. Nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ: Ɔsatuo a wɔbɛyɛ de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho ne mmara mu nsakraeɛ a ɛhyɛ hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ, sikasɛm, ne sikasɛm mu akwanya a mmeawa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so nya wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu nnyinasosɛm ntetee dwumadi ahorow (life skills education programs) kyerɛkyerɛnea obi bɛtumi agyina ne nan so a suro nnim (assertiveness), ne nkitahodi a ɛma kwan ma nteaseɛ ba (negotiation), ne sɛnea obi bɛhyehyɛ nnyinasosɛm anaa hyeɛ a ɛbɛbɔ ne ho ban wɔ n'adamfofa anaa ne nneyɛe mu (setting boundaries)?
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no de dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di agoru, kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu ka ho de kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛnea wobesi wɔn ahiade ahorow so dua na wɔadi nkitaho yiye wɔ nnipa ntam abusuabɔ mu. Mmabun sua sɛnea wobehu wɔn ahye, aka wɔn ho asɛm pefee, na wɔde katee ada wɔn adwene, wɔn akɔnnɔ, ne anohyeto ahorow adi. Wɔhwehwɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so di atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho dwuma, ka sɛ dabi wɔ nneyɛe a asiane wom ho, na wɔkamfo hokwan ahorow ne nea wɔpɛ wɔ ɔdɔ, abusua, ne asetra mu nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwom ne: nnipadua akwaa  ne dwuma adi. Awo ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano. nna mu yareɛ (STI) a wosiw ano ne ne di. Mpene, ahye, ne nyɔnkofa nkitahodie pa. Bɔbeasu ne nna ho akɔnnɔ. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne gyinaesi. Akwannya ne asɛyɛde ahorow. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi ɔbabun bi kokoam nsɛm anaa nea broni ka no 'confidentiality' a wɔabu so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbabun bi kokoamsɛm anaa kokoamsɛm a wobu so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no betumi de nneɛma pii aba, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahotoso a ɛyera wɔ ɔbabun ne akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo ntam Nkɛntɛnso bɔne a ɛba ɔbabun no adwene ne nkate mu yiyedi so Animtiaabu anaa nyiyim a efi abusua, atipɛnfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe daakye esiane ehu anaa ahotoso a wonni nti Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsunsuanso a ɛde ba akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wohu sɛ ɛto kokoam nsɛm ho mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na yɛnnim fa abɛɛfo ntentan (social media) ne mmabun awoasɛm ho apɔmuden (sexual reproductive health) ho a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu mu nsonsonoe wɔ nteaseɛ a ɛfa nkitahodiɛ a ɛda Abɛɛfo ntentan nsunsuanso, ne mmabun  nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH) nsunsuansoɔ ntam: Nsunsuansoɔ a ɛkyɛ: Nhwehwɛmu kakraa bi hwehwɛ nsunsuanso a abɛɛfo ntentan nya wɔ mmabun  nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH) nneyɛeɛ, suban, ne akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ so. Kuw nketewa mu nhwehwɛmu: Nhwehwɛmu pii ho hia de ahwehwɛ sɛnea abɛɛfo ntentan tumi ahorow gu ahorow wɔ nnipa dodow akuw ahorow mu. nea ɛka ho ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbea, mfe a obi adi, nna, ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmu di abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii te sɛ kokoam nsɛm a wɔpene so, ne ɔhaw ahorow a ebetumi aba a ɛbata intanɛt so a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ SRH nsɛmti mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne abusua mufo anaa mpɔtam hɔ akannifo abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho wɔ obu ne ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ebia ɛbɛyɛ den. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne ɔpanyin a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso (sukuu fotufo/ɔyarehwɛfo) a wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano a wobenya, nyinsɛn a wo yi gu a ahobammɔ wom, anaa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu a wɔde ma mmabun ho dwuma? (Amanaman ntam nyansahyɛ ne akwankyerɛ ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nhyehyeɛ de nyansahyɛ ne akwankyerɛ ma: Nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano: Ɛsɛ sɛ aman hwɛ hu sɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa nya akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano. Nyinsɛn a Wotu a Ahobammɔ wom: Ɛsɛ sɛ aman hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom wɔ tebea horow bi mu, di ɔman mmara ahorow akyi. Nna Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ a Ɛkɔ Akyiri a broni ka no 'Comprehensive Sexuality Education': Ɛsɛ sɛ aman de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi na egyina adanse so ma mmabun nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nneɛma a w’ani gye ho, nneɛma a wopɛ, ne akyɛdeɛ di wɔ wo ho, obu ne woanuoyam a wohu a ɛnyɛ nipadua ho ɔhwɛ nko ara mu?
answer_twi_source: Botaeɛ a Wɔde Ma: Dwumadie a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛne obi anigyeɛ ne nneɛma a ɔpɛ hyia ma nkaeɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔwɔ botaeɛ ne ahotɔ. Tumi a Wɔhyɛ: Nimdeɛ ne aben a wɔbɛben wɔ nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho anaa wɔpɛ mu ma wo ho ahotosoɔ ne wo ho obu yɛ kɛse. Nkitahodiɛ a Wɔne Afoforo Di: Nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho anaa wɔpɛ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ma mmabun kwan ma wɔne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ adwene koro di nkitaho na wɔhyehyɛ asetena mu nkitahodiɛ a, ɛnyɛ nipadua ho ɔhwɛ nko ara. Wo Ho a Wohu a Wɔhyɛ: Nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho ne wɔpɛ boa ma wɔnya wo ho nteaseɛ ne wo ho a woda no adi a ɛkɔ akyiri sen nipadua ho ɔhwɛ, a ɛhyɛ wo ho a wohu a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛka obiara ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na nkitahodie a ɛmu tew na nokwarewom bɛtumi anya wɔ awerɛhyɛmu ne nnamfofa a ɛmu yɛ den a yɛbɛsi ho, titiriw wɔ berɛ a yɛrebɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ mmerɛ (sensitive topics) ho nkɔmmɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokwaredi ho hia kɛse ma ahotoso a yebenya na yɛahyɛ yɛn abusuabɔ mu den, titiriw berɛ a yɛresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate te sɛ abusuabɔ, nna, ne awo akwahosan ho no. Ɛma yetumi ka yɛn nsusuwii, nkate, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw yɛn ho asɛm pefee, na ɛma yenya ntease, tema, ne abusuabɔ. Ɛdenam nkitahodi a yɛda no adi pefee so no, yebetumi adi ntease a ɛnteɛ ho dwuma, asiesie ntawntawdi, na yɛabom ayɛ adwuma de ahwehwɛ nsɛnnennen ano aduru.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun susu ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu ahwɛ sɛ ebia wɔanya ɔbarima ne ɔba nna mu nyarewa?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wɔyɛ STI nhwehwɛmu ma mmabun no gyina nneɛma ahorow so, a wɔn nna mu dwumadi, nna mu ahokafo dodow, ne ankorankoro asiane ahorow ka ho. Sɛ́ akwankyerɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu no susu ho sɛ anyɛ yie koraa no wɔbɛyɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu pɛnkoro afe biara, sɛ wonni sɛnkyerɛnne biara mpo a. Nanso, ebia ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nna mu ahokafo pii, wɔwɔ abakɔsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho, anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane kɛse wom mu no behia sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn nhwehwɛmu mpɛn pii, te sɛ asram abiɛsa kosi asia biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi ama nna ne awoɔ ho nsɛm a mmabun anya no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Aban ne nhyehyeɛ a wɔyɛ no bɛtumi: Wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri adi dwuma wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu a ɛfa nsɛmti ahodoɔ pii a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Fa sika ma nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne mmoa ma mmabun. Hwɛ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a nsɛm a wobenya ka ho no yɛ nea ne bo nyɛ den, ɛyɛ nea wobetumi anya, na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun. Boa nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛhwɛ sɛnea nsɛm a wɔde kyekyɛ ho akwan no tu mpɔn na wɔakyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn. Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow nyɛ adwuma mfa nyɛ nhyehyɛe ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛhyɛ nneyɛe a egyina adanse so ne abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotuo mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ aban ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ intanɛt so akwan a wɔbɛkyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, na mmabun betumi anya bi
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛhyɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, agye wɔn atom, na wɔayɛ pɛ wɔ Ghana, Afrika, ne wiase nyinaa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu Pere (Policy Advocacy):Pere ma mmara a ɛbɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm (disability) ho ban, a wɔn nna ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ho kwan ka ho.Mpɔtam Nkabom (Community Mobilization):Hyehyɛ nteteeɛ ne mpɔtam nhyiamu ahorow de kanyan amansan na ama nkabom aba nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ho.Amanaman Ntam Nkabom (International Cooperation):Ne amanaman ntam akuo a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ho kwan ne nna ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ho mmɔ mu nyɛ adwuma.Nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛwɔ Ghana (Examples in Ghana):Ghana Federation of Disability Organizations (GFD) pere ma nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ho kwan.Wobɛtumi asiesie Nna mu Nkyerɛkyerɛ (Sexuality Education) a wɔde ma wɔ Ghana sukuu ahorow mu no ama ɛafa mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔwɔ dɛm ho yie.Kae sɛ, sɛ yɛbɛyɛ baabi a nkabom pa ara wom a, ɛhyehyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛnnii nnyaeɛ firi ankorankoro, mpɔtam, ne aban hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nna ne awo apɔmuden nsɛm adi nkitaho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi, kokoam nsɛm, ne gyinaesi tumi so?
answer_twi_source: Apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nsɛm adi nkitaho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi, kokoam nsɛm, ne gyinaesi tumi denam: Kasa ne mfonini ahorow a emu da hɔ na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyerɛkyerɛ aduruyɛ ho adwene, akwan horow, ne ayaresa a wobetumi apaw mu. Nsɛm a wɔde bɛma wɔ kokoam mmeae a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wobebisa nsɛm na wɔasusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho a wonsuro atemmu anaa aniwu. Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi mu denneennen denam wɔn adwene, nea wɔpɛ, ne nea ɛhaw wɔn wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ so. Nneɛma a wɔakyerɛw, intanɛt so nneɛma, anaa multimedia nnwinnade a ɛhyɛ nsɛm atitiriw mu den na ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔpaw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔde bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na mmabun betumi anya mmoa sɛ wohyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyimu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di akasa, akɔ ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa de, akɔka mpɔtam hɔfo anaa intanɛt so mmoa akuw ho, anaa wɔafrɛ telefon a wɔde boa wɔn. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm de nnwuma a ɛfa obiara ho di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam no fa so du mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa yiye, wɔn a wofi atubrafo, nnipa kakraa bi, nkuraase, anaa wɔn a wonnya sika pii ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadu mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa pii, a wɔn a wofi atubrafo, nnipa kakraa bi, nkuraase, anaa wɔn a wonnya sika pii ka ho nkyɛn no, ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so de akwan horow di dwuma. Ebia eyinom bi ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde wɔn ani asi so sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfo wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ne mmeae afoforo a mmerante ne mmabaa nya adamfofa su; fekubɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma a wɔsom saa nnipa yi bɛyɛ; nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ no nkɔso; ne mobile anaa nhwehwɛ dwumadie a wɔde bɛma de akɔ ankorankoro nkyɛn wɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaa ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkɔ hɔ. Bio nso, "CBOs" betumi ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ "influence" adi nkitaho de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ase na wɔadi amammerɛ mu ahyɛdeɛ anaa animtiaabuo a ɛfa  awo ne nna mu akwahosan"SRH" nsɛm ho no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen titiriw ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya amanaman ntam sika a wɔde bɛyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow, titiriw ma ahyehyɛde ahorow ne aman a wonni sika pii anaa amammui mu mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma kakraa bi ne amammui mu mmoa de nsɛnnennen kɛse ba ahyehyɛde ahorow ne aman a wɔrehwehwɛ amanaman ntam sika a wɔde bɛyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no so. Akwankyerɛ ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ den, gyinapɛn a emu yɛ den a wɔde fata, ne akansi a ɛfa sika kakraa bi ho no betumi asiw kwan bio, titiriw ama ahyehyɛde nketewa anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ mmeae a wonni sika pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hwan na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ 'hotlines' (telefonyɛbea/ ahomatrofo), na nteteeɛ/ nimdeɛ nkrataa bɛn na wɔwɔ?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛfoɔ ho nkrataa: Wɔyɛ 'counselors' (afotuofoɔ), 'mental health professionals' (adwene mu pa nimdeɛfoɔ) anaa 'volunteers' (afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho ama) a wɔatete wɔn. Nteteeɛ: Wɔnya nteteeɛ wɔ sɛdeɛ wɔboa wɔ haw bere mu, sɛdeɛ wɔtie asɛm yie, na wɔma nimdeɛ pa ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuwii hunu, atorɔ adwene , ne nsɛm a ɛhaw a wɔtaa ka fa pene a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo de kɔ so no bi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia saa sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow yi
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii hunu: Kommyɛ kyerɛ pene a wɔpene so, nsiyɛ yɛ ɔdɔ, pene a ntadehyɛ fa no. Hu denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nnam a wubegye ho kyim, akyerɛ obu a wonni, pene a wɔde anigye asusuw ho so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho wɔ wɔn sukuu, mmusua, ne atipɛnfo akuw mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wobefi ase, nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛkasa atia, tema ne ntease a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, ne tebea horow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔboa wɔ sukuu ahorow, mmusua, ne atipɛnfo akuw mu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ minni akwahosan ho insurance nso ɛ, so akwan horow a ne bo nyɛ den da so ara wɔ hɔ a mede besiw nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wonni insurance mpo a, akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ne bo nyɛ den: Akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow bi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔatew so anaasɛ wontua hwee ma mmabun. Kɔndɔm nhyehyɛe a wontua hwee: Nnumakuo pii de kɔndɔm a wontua hwee anaasɛ ne bo nyɛ den ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nsunsuansoɔ na ebetumi afi atipɛnfo nhyɛso a yɛbɛ di akyerɛ mu aba wɔ yɛn adwene mu yiyedi so?
answer_twi_source: Adwennwen a  ɛkɔ soro: Adwennwen ne dadwen a ɛkɔ soro a wɔte nka esiane mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobedi atipɛnfo akwanhwɛ ahorow ho dwuma anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ so agye wɔn atom wɔ asetra mu nti.  Ɛkwan bɔne wo hu wo ho: Sɛ obi nya ne ho mfonini a enye anaasɛ obu a ɔba fam a obenya afi ne ho a ɔde toto mfɛfo ho anaasɛ ɔte nka sɛ ɔmfata sɛ ondu gyinapɛn ahorow a wosusuw sɛ onnya ho. Afobu ne Aniwu: Ɛfɔbu, aniwu, anaa anuho atenka a wubenya wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wogyaee mu anaa nneyɛe a ɛne ankorankoro gyinapɛn anaa gyidi ahorow nhyia mu. Asane a ɛwɔ sɛ Wobepira: Sɛ obi de ne ho hyɛ nneyɛe anaa dwumadi ahorow a asiane wom mu wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ase a ebetumi ama wapira obi wɔ nipadua mu, wahaw wɔ atenka fam, anaasɛ obefi mu aba a enye. Abusuabɔ a Ɛyɛ Den: Ɔhaw anaa ntawntawdi a obenya wɔ abusuabɔ a ɔne n’atipɛnfo wɔ mu anaasɛ ɔte nka sɛ ɔne ne ho ne afoforo ntam abusuabɔ atwa esiane nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ ɔne afoforo bɛyɛ nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa betumi aboa me ma makɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den anaa atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi anaa abusuabɔ ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ afotu ne mmoa: Dan kɔ atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ afotu ne mmoa bere a worehyia tebea horow a emu yɛ den anaa atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi anaa abusuabɔ ho no. Wɔn akwankyerɛ ne nkuranhyɛ betumi aboa wo ma wode ahotoso ne pefeeyɛ akɔ gyinaesi ahorow a emu yɛ den mu. Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Wo ne mfɛfo ka w’ahye ho asɛm pefee na fa pintinn, na hwɛ hu sɛ wo gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no ne wo gyinapɛn ne w’awerɛkyekye dodow hyia. Atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa bɛkyerɛ obu ama w’ahye na wɔaboa wo ahofadi wɔ gyinaesi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔyem betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ awo ho nhyehyɛe a ɛne wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ hyia?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ awo nhyehyɛe a ɛne wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ hyia wɔ nea wobetumi apaw a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ, asusuw nea wɔpɛ wɔ beae a wɔwo, ɛyaw ano aduru, awo akyi mmoa, ne awo akyi hwɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛw, ne wɔn apɛde a wɔbɛkyerɛw wɔ awo nhyehyɛe mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetra, sikasɛm, ne mpɔtam hɔ mfaso horow a ebetumi aba afi mmabun adwumayɛ mu, te sɛ adwumayɛ, ahonyade a wobenya, nneɛma foforo a wɔyɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ sikasɛm mu nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ ma wonya asetra, sikasɛm, ne mpɔtam hɔ mfaso pii. Ɛboa ma wonya adwumayɛ, efisɛ mmabun a wɔyɛ nnwuma taa fa mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛfo anaasɛ wɔne nnwuma afoforo yɛ biako. Ɛkanyan ahonyade awo ntoatoaso denam hokwan ahorow a ɛma wonya ahonyade a wɔboaboa ano ne agyapade a wɔbɛkyekye so. Adwumayɛ ma wɔyɛ nneɛma foforo, berɛ a mmabun de adwene foforo, adebɔ, ne nsusuwii foforo ba gua so no. Bio nso, nnwuma a mmerante ne mmabaa di anim betumi akanyan mpɔtam hɔ sikasɛm mu nkɔso wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛma wɔanya ahoɔden foforo, sikasɛm a wɔbɛtwetwe, ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso a wɔbɛma aba so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn ne nhyehyɛeɛ ne ntetee dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa 'adwene-ne-akoma-mu-pira' (trauma-informed) ho a edi nkunim wɔ mmonnaatoɔ so tew mu, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne bɛnya ayaresa ne mmoa, na ɛsan boa ma mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nya ahoɔden ne kanyan kɔ ayaresa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ pii wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nnwuma, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho a adi nkonim wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ dodoɔ so tew mu, na ɛma ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no atu mpɔn, na wɔama wɔatumi agyina ano na wɔasa wɔn yareɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Nhwɛsoɔ baako ne nteteeɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho a wɔde ma adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ mu, te sɛ akwahosan, nwomasua, mmarahyɛ bagua, ne asetena mu nnwuma. Saa ntetee ahorow yi boa adwumayɛfo ma wɔte nkɛntɛnso a adwenemhaw nya wɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no ase yiye ne sɛnea wɔbɛyɛ ho biribi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛboa na ɛyɛ nkate so. Nhwɛso foforo ne mmeae a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔanya adwenemhaw ho nsɛm anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri ma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no, a ayaresa, afotu, mmara mu nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne akuw a wɔboa ka ho. Saa mmeae yi de wɔn a wɔanya wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no ahofadi, ahobammɔ, ne yiyedi di kan na wɔde akwan a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔfa so sa yare na wɔn ho tɔ wɔn ma. Bio nso, nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne asoɛeɛ ahodoɔ mu no, bɛtumi aboa ama wɔbue akwan a ahobanbɔ ne mmoa kɛseɛ wɔ mu ama wɔn wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no denam nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsɛm te sɛ asodie a wɔde to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne, animtiaabuo, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ akwansideɛ a ɛmma wɔmfa amanneɛbɔ ne mmoa hwehwɛ dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano yɛ adwuma yie fa?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛyɛ  adwuma yie paa (>99%): IUDs, Implants. Yie (91-99%): nnuru, Paneɛ. Kakra (71-86%): kɔndom. Fam (40-85%): Yi (Twe-firi-mu).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho ban anaa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho ban. Ebia eyinom bi ne: Mmara ahorow a ɛhwɛ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no bɛkora kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm so. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu. Mmara a ɛbara nyiyim a egyina mfe a obi adi, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa nneɛma afoforo so wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Mmara a ɛma mmabun kwan ma wɔpene nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma bi so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔmmɔ wɔn amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma mmabun nya kwan nya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a atipɛnfo a wɔatete wɔn wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no de ma. Atipɛnfo betumi akyekyɛ nsɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na wɔfa so ka ho, adi adwene a ɛnteɛ ho dwuma na wɔde akwankyerɛ a egyina adanse so ama wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareɛ  ano (STI) a wosiw, pene a wɔpene so, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sɛnea yebetumi asusuw yebedi tebea horow a ebia mɛte nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ anaasɛ mɛtwentwɛn me nan ase sɛ mɛka nsɛmti bi ho dwuma bere a yɛrekɔ hɔ daa no ho, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn abom adi akwanside ahorow yi so?
answer_twi_source: Gye tum sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ yɛbɛte nka sɛ yɛn ho nyɛ yɛn dɛ anaasɛ yɛbɛtwentwɛn yɛn nan ase sɛ yɛbɛka nsɛmti bi ho asɛm bere a yɛrekɔ hɔ daa no. Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran denam awerɛhyem a mɛma wo sɛ mewɔ ha sɛ merebɛboa wo na matie a memmu atɛn no so. Mommɔ mu nsusuw akwan horow a wobɛfa so adi akwanside ahorow so, te sɛ asɛmti no a wobɛkyekyɛ mu nketenkete a wotumi di ho dwuma yiye, anaasɛ atie a wode nsiyɛ ne tema sua de yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na metumi akamfo mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ ahiade ahorow a ɛfa mmabunbere ne nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam Nhyiamu/'Durbars': Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu na kasa fa hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔsua mmabunbere ne nna mu akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya. Adesrɛ: Yɛ adesrɛ a ɛkamfo mmabunbere ho adesua a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu anaasɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Abɛɛfo so Ɔsatu: Fi ase yɛ social media ɔsatu ahorow de ma nkurɔfo hu nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔboa no. Ahyehyɛde Ahorow a Wobɛka Ho: Kɔka ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo mmabun a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan so no ho na ama wo nne ayɛ kɛse wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nnepa mu no boa ma wonya mmeae a wɔboa a ɛma mmabun nya nna mu apɔwmuden ho adwene ne nneyɛe pa?
answer_twi_source: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom, a obiara ka ho a wɔbɛma mmabun te nka sɛ wobu wɔn, wɔsom bo, na wɔama wɔn tumi a wɔde besisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Nkitahodi a ɛmu da hɔ, ahotoso, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun ne mpɔtam hɔfo ntam, a ɛbɛtew animtiaabu, aniwu, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho no so. Mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a wɔbɛkyekye, a atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di ka ho, a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, nsɛm, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ne nneɛma a wɔde ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ ne mmoa ansa na wɔawoɔ bere a wɔyem?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo wɔ nyinsɛn mu denam nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ ama apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn daa, akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawoɔ ho akyi, ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mmoa adwumayɛbea anaa mpɔtamu hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ, na wɔne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho pefee wɔ wɔn ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa nnamfo anaa mfɛfo a ebia wɔgye wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa wɔn bɔbeasu ho kyim?
answer_twi_source: Tie a Wonni Atemmu: Fa aso a ɛboa ma wɔn na ma wɔnka wɔn nkate ne wɔn suahu ahorow. Bu Wɔn Kokoam Nsɛm: Ma wɔnbue wɔn ano wɔ wɔn ankasa ahoɔhare so; nhyɛ wɔn so. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ade de ma wɔ nimdeɛ hwehwɛ mmoa Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA ahorow Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne 'YMK app' no betumi aboa ama woanya nsɛm a mfasoɔ wɔ so. Gyina hɔ tia nyiyim
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ahokokwaw a mede bɛda m’ahiade, nea mepɛ, ne m’ahyeɛ adi wɔ ahotoso mu wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ mɛko atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye na m'ahwehwɛ nhyɛso pa a ɛne me gyinapɛn ne me botae ahorow hyia?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wonya  ahokokwaw a wode bɛda w’ahiade, nea wopɛ, ne w’ahye adi wɔ ahotoso mu wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye a wobɛko atia na woahwehwɛ ahoɔden pa a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia no hwehwɛ sɛ: Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den: Fa nkitahodi akwan a ɛda adi pefee di dwuma, te sɛ kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tẽẽ a wode bedi dwuma, a wobɛkɔ so de w’ani ahwɛ, na woagyina pintinn wɔ wo gyidi ne anohyeto ahorow mu, bere a woreda wo ho adi wɔ mu no asetra mu nkitahodi ahorow. Dwumadi a wodi: Wo ne wo nnamfo anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di di tebea horow a ɛsono emu biara a wode wo ho hyɛ mu sɛ wobɛka w’ahye so denneennen na woayɛ w’atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho biribi wɔ ahotoso ne obu mu. Ahotoso a wɔbɛma wo ho so: Nya wo ho mu ahotoso denam wo ho a wubesi so dua, wo ho a wobɛka wɔ ɔkwan pa so, ne w’ahoɔden ne w’ahoɔden a wubehu so, a ebetumi ama woanya tumi de asi wo ho so akɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu na woahwehwɛ ahoɔden pa a ɛboa wo yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔn nnamfo anaa wɔn atipɛnfo a ebia wɔrefa adwenemyare mu no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa nnamfo anaa atipɛnfo a wɔrehyia adwenemyare denam: Tie: Aso a ɛnyɛ atɛn a wɔde bɛma na wɔagye wɔn nkate atom so. Nnwumayɛfo Mmoa a Wɔhyɛ Ho Nkuran: Wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di hɔ. Mmoa a mfaso wɔ so a wɔde ma: Da biara da nnwuma a wɔbɛboa, wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔn ho akɔ mmeae a wɔahyɛ, anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛma de aboa wɔn. Adwene ne Atenka mu Akwahosan a Wɔbɛma Ɛyɛ Nea Ɛfata: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa adwenemyare ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔatew animtiaabu so. Wɔn Ho a Wɔbɛhwɛ: Wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho a wɔde bedi dwuma na wɔde ahye ato hɔ na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛhyew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na  mpɔtamfoɔ betumi afa so adi animtiaabu anaa nyiyim a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie de akasa atia nsusuwii hunu na wɔahyɛ nteaseɛ pa ho nkuran. Nteteeɛ Nhyiamu: Nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne awofoɔ wɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛdi animtiaabuo ho dwuma. Mmeae a Ahobammɔ: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde besi hɔ wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a mmabun betumi asusuw mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho a ehu biara nnim).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfoɔ 'community outreach' yɛ de siw STI/HIV kwan?
answer_twi_source: Wɔyɛ ɔkasa ahorow fa kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, sɛnea STI/HIV trɛw, ahobammɔ a wɔbɛtra, ne abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho. Wɔkyekyɛ nhomawa, nkrataa, ne kɔndɔm wɔ sukuu ne ayaresabea ahorow mu. Wɔsan nso yɛ nhyiam ahorow yɛ nhwehwɛmu, tu fo, boa ayaresa a wontua hwee. Mmabun anaa mpɔtam hɔfo kyerɛkyerɛ na wɔboa wɔn atipɛnfo. Nhyehyɛe ahorow ne sukuu ahorow yɛ adwuma kyerɛ nna mu akwahosan, de nneɛma ma asuafo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkonimdi ho nsɛm anaa adansedi ahorow bi a efi mmebun a wɔanya mfaso afi afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wodi so nkonim, nyɔnkofo pa a wɔbɛkyekye, ne wɔn nna ne awo asetra so tumi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa osuahu ahorow yi betumi  akanyan mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo ma wɔahwehwɛ afotu ne mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Nkonimdie ho nsɛm anaa adansedie a ɛfiri mmabun a wɔanya mfasoɔ afiri afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ a wɔdi so nkonim, abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛkyekyere, ne wɔn nna ne awoɔ asetena a wɔbɛdi so no bɛtumi akanyan mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa foforɔ ma wɔahwehwɛ afotuo ne mmoa wɔ: Ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ: Mmabun bɛtumi akyɛ wɔn ankasa suahunu ne nhumu a ɛfa sɛdeɛ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ aboa wɔn ma wɔafa wɔn atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ mu, ama wɔanya nimdeɛ gyinaesi ahorow, na wodu wɔn botae ahorow ho wɔ asetra mu. Abɛɛfo ntentan ɔsatu a wɔbɛyɛ: Mmabun betumi ayɛ Abɛɛfo ntentan ɔsatu, te sɛ abɛɛfo ntentan dwuma ahorow a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ video, blog, ne abɛɛfo ntentan so nsɛm, de akyerɛ nsunsuanso pa a afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow nya wɔ wɔn asetra so na wɔahyɛ afoforo nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa a ɛte saa ara. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mmabun bɛtumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo mu a wɔbɛtumi akyɛ wɔn suahunu, asesa afotuo ne nkuranhyɛ, na wɔabom adi wɔn nkonimdie ho afahyɛ, na ama wɔanya nkabom ne tumi. Som sɛ afotufo: Mmabun a wɔanya mfaso afi afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no betumi atua ho ka denam som a wɔbɛsom sɛ afotufo ama mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo, wɔn nimdeɛ, wɔn ahokokwaw, ne osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ de aboa wɔn atipɛnfo ma wɔafa atipɛnfo nhyɛso so na wɔasisi gyinae pa wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahu bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso renya yɛn adwene mu akwahosan so nsunsuanso bɔne?
answer_twi_source: Te a Wɔte nka sɛ Wɔayɛ Den: Nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔnyɛ nea wɔn atipɛnfo hwɛ kwan anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe bi mu no ahyɛ wo so anaasɛ wɔadwennwen. Ahofadi a Wobɛhwere: Te a wobɛte nka sɛ w’atipɛnfo na wosisi gyinae ahorow ma wo sen sɛ wubegyina w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, w’anigyede, anaa nea wopɛ so. Nsakrae a Ɛba Suban Mu: Nsakrae a ɛba suban, adwene, anaa atenka mu a wohu esiane mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛfata wɔn atipɛnfo anaasɛ wɔbɛsɔ wɔn ani nti. Afobu anaa Anuonyam: Afobu anaa ahonu a wobɛte nka bere a wagyae ne ho mu ama atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaasɛ ɔde ne ho ahyɛ nneyɛe a ɛne ankorankoro gyinapɛn anaa gyidi ahorow nhyia mu akyi. Nkɛntɛnso a Enya wɔ Bu a Wobu Ho: Sɛ obi nya obu a ɔwɔ ma ne ho anaa ne ho a ɛsom bo a ɛso tew esiane ntotoho a ɔne mfɛfo yɛ nti anaasɛ ɔte nka sɛ ɔmfata sɛ ontumi nni nea wosusuw sɛ ɔhwɛ kwan no ho dwuma nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mete nka sɛ mewɔ atenka na meyɛ basaa saa bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere?
answer_twi_source: Honam mu nkwammoa ahorow, titiriw nea yɛ frɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ estrogen (mmeawa) ne testosterone (mmarimaa) nya wo atenka so nsunsuanso kɛse wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Saa nkwaadɔm yi betumi aka nnuru a ɛwɔ w’amemene mu a ɛhwɛ wo nkate so no. Ebia wubehu sɛ w’ani begye bere bi na afei mpofirim ara woadi awerɛhow, wo bo afuw, anaa wo bo afuw bere a edi hɔ no. Eyi nyinaa yɛ nsesae a ɛrekɔ so wɔ wo nipadua mu no, na ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata koraa. Akwan a wofa so gyina ano no bi ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛyɛ daa, turoyɛ, nnwom, akenkan, ahomegye ne nna a ɛfata, aduannoa ne aduan pa a wubedi .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ayaresafoɔ bɛsua mmabun w4 hwɛ w4n amammerɛ ne baabi a wofi?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ nteteeɛ ho adesua(Training). Sua nneɛma daa. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ firi mpanyimfoɔ hɔ. Tie mmabun yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no nya ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn ankasa nipasu, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho so nkɛntɛnso, na haw bɛn na wohyia wɔ saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi a wɔbɛfa so akɔ so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho betumi anya ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn nipasu, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Ebia mmabun bɛte nhyɛso nka sɛ wɔnyɛ mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow, na ɛde wɔn mu ntawntawdi ne adwene mu naayɛ bɛba sɛ wɔn suahu anaa wɔn nipasu ne akwanhwɛ ahorow yi nhyia a. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nso sɛ, mmofra nketewa a wɔyɛ LGBTQ+ no tumi hyia animtiaabu ne nyiyim wɔ abɔdeɛ mu mmarahyɛ ne mmaa suban a ɛda nsow ho, na yei de ankonamyɛ ne adwene mu haw ba. Saa nnyinasoɔ yi so di tumi yɛ den paa, ɛfiri sɛ saa mmofra yi tumi nya suro sɛ wɔn mfɛfoɔ, wɔn mmusua, anaa mpanyimfoɔ bɛpo wɔn anaa wɔbɛbu wɔn atɛn sɛ wɔda wɔn ankasa suban ne wɔn bɔbeasu adi a ɛne atetesɛm mu deɛ nhyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna mu nneyɛe ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: kwati nna mu tebea horow a ɛbɛma woayɛ basaa, ma w’adwene mu da hɔ (kwati nnubɔne ne nsa) na ma w’ani da hɔ, hwɛ hu sɛ wo ne wo hokafo nkutoo nni mmeae a wɔakora so. sua pii fa wo nipadua ho ne sɛnea wobɛkɔ so ayɛ thealthy. Anisɔ wo nipadua no Nnye, hwehwɛ akyɛde, adom mfi mmarima anaa mmea a wɔn mfe akɔ anim hɔ. Sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ a, ɛnde ka kyerɛ w’awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo no Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa nna a ahobammɔ wom, nyinsɛn ano aduru ahorow (kɔndɔm, awo ano aduru, nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ ne nea ɛkeka ho) ne sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma ho. Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa na ama woanya akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hunu nkitaho a emu yɛ den a ɛda adwene mu apɔmuden ne asetena mu nkitahodiɛ ntam wɔ mmabunberɛ mu.
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no, abusuabɔ a wo ne wo nnamfo, abusuafo, ne wɔn a wo ne ayɔnko pa anaa wo dɔfo tumi nya wo nkwa ne w'apɔmuden so tumi kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan a mfaso wɔ so bɛn na metumi afa so de adwene a wɔde si biribi " incorporate mindfulness"so ahyɛ me sukuu dwumadi anaa adesua su mu?
answer_twi_source: Gye w’ahome wɔ w’adwene mu wɔ adesua bere mu na woagyina kakra, home, na woasan de w’adwene asi w’adwene so. Fa w’adwene di dwuma ansa na woayɛ sɔhwɛ anaasɛ wobɛka nsɛm akyerɛ na ama ntini ahorow no adwo na ama w’adwene akɔ so yiye. Fa adwene mu nhumu ka sukuu dwumadi te sɛ agumadi, akuw, anaa kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ ho na ama kuw adwumayɛ ne adwennwen ano aduru ho nkuran. Fa nkaebɔ ahorow sisi wo ahomatrofo "phone" so anaa yɛ bere a wode bɛhyɛ w’adwene mu ho nhyehyɛe wɔ wo da biara da dwumadi mu na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛkɔ so daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ asetena mu nnwuma ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ de gyina nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden so ne nnwuma wobenya ho nkuran mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ asetena mu dwumadi ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ de gyina ASRH hokwan ahorow ne nnwuma a wobenya ho nkuran wɔ akwan horow so: Wɔbɛka ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene asi ASRH nsɛm so no ho anaasɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkorɔfo, ɔsɔretia, ne nhyiam ahorow mu de ma nkurɔfo hu na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ho biribi wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH ho. Social media platforms a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nne ayɛ kɛse, akyɛ nsɛm, na wɔakamfo nsakrae. Ɛnam nkrataa, adesrɛ, nhyiamu, ne ɔmanfoɔ adansedie so ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ di nkitaho de kamfo nhyehyɛɛ a ɛboa ASRH hokwan ne dwumadie. Nsiesiei a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu, ne ɔsatuo a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn de hyɛ ASRH ho nimdeɛ ne ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ bere tiaa ne bere tenten bɛn na nnubɔne nom de ba adwene mu ahoɔden, nteaseɛ ne nneyɛeɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Ebia nsunsuansoɔ bere tiaa bi no bi ne: Nsakrae a ɛba ntɛm ara wɔ adwene, ne nneyɛe mu. Atɛn ne gyinaesi a asɛe. Nneɛma a wɔde to asiane mu ne akwanhyia a ɛkɔ soro. Asetra ne nnipa ntam haw ahorow. Nkɛntɛnso bere tenten no betumi ayɛ: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obenya adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa adwene mu yare ne nkae mu haw. Nsakrae a ɛkɔ so wɔ adwen no nhyehyɛe ne ne dwumadi mu. Asetra ne adwumayɛ mu dwumadi a asɛe. Asetra pa ne yiyedi nyinaa so tew. Ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa sɛ wo anaa obi a wunim no rehyia ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyare ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛmfua ne nsusuiɛ ahorow a wɔtaa de di dwuma a ɛfa nna mu akɔnnɔ ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu?
answer_twi_source: Heterosexual: Nnipa a ɔpɛ wɔn bɔbeasu so no no deɛ. Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna: Homosexual: Nnipa a wɔne wɔn bɔbeasu yɛ pɛ ho anigye. Bisexual: Nnipa a wɔboro bɔbeasu biako anigye ne ho. Pansexual: Ɔpɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔba mfa ho. Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ kakraa bi anaasɛ enni hɔ koraa. Queer: Asɛmfua a ɛyɛ nkatanim a ebinom de kyerɛkyerɛ akɔnnɔ a ɛnyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne/anaasɛ nnipa a wɔnyɛ cisgender. Nsɛmmisa: Obi a onnye nni anaasɛ ɔhwehwɛ ne nna ho akɔnnɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me ho ban afi kɔmputa so ayayade ne Intanɛt so aniɛyaa ho ?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛbɛyɛ na woabɔ wo ho ban afi kɔmputa so ayayade ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔnso ayayade ho no, susuw nea edidi so yi ho: Hwɛ yiye wɔ nea wokyɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so, a w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm ne mfonini ka ho. Fa kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma de hwɛ nea obetumi ahu wo nsɛm ne wo nsɛm. Susuw ho ansa na wode biribiara ahyɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so anaa wode akyɛ, na kwati sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nsɛm a enye anaasɛ ɛyɛ yaw mu. Siw ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ kɔmputa so ayayade mu no kwan anaasɛ yi wɔn akyi, na bɔ nneyɛe a ɛyɛ ayayade ho amanneɛ kyerɛ asɛnka agua anaa wɛbsaet no so ahwɛfo. Sɛ wuhyia kɔmputa so ayayade anaa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ayayade a, wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di nkasa, na hwehwɛ wɔn mmoa ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahobammɔ kwan a m’ankasa mɛfa so ahwehwɛ me nipadua ne me nna mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo nipadua a w’ankasa wobɛhwehwɛ mu no yɛ nna mu nkɔso fã a, ahoɔden wom. Akwan a ahobammɔ wom bi ni: Hwɛ wo nipadua wɔ ahwehwɛ mu: Hyɛ sɛnea wo nipadua resakra na ɛrenya nkɔso no nsow. Ka wo ho: Hwehwɛ wo honam ani akwaa (genitals) mu a worenhyɛ wo ho anaasɛ wunsusuw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow ho hia ma mmabun bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ne wɔn ho kwan (ASRR) ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ wiase nyinaa? (Sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nneɛma a ɛkɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ na wobu akontaa wɔ aman nyinaa mu)
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nhyehyeɛ ho hia ɛfiri sɛ: Nhyiamu a ɛkɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ: Ɛhwɛ sɛ aman nyinaa bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛdu botaeɛ korɔ ho ama mmabun bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ne wɔn ho kwan (ASRR) ahodoɔ. Akontaabu: Wɔma aman asɛyɛde sɛ wobedi saa hokwan ahorow yi akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atetesɛm mu guasodeyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔde di dwuma no hyɛ nsɛntitiriw atitiriw agyirae wɔ mmabun nna ne awo mu nkɔso mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ amanne ahorow yi mu de ahyɛ akwahosan mu nkɔso pa ne tumidi ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Amanne kwan so guasodeyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔde twa kwan di dwuma titiriw wɔ nsɛntitiriw atitiriw a wɔhyɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo mu nkɔso mu, na ɛma wonya hokwan ahorow ma mpɔtam hɔfo gye tom, mmoa, ne akwankyerɛ. Wobetumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ saa amanne ahorow yi mu de ahyɛ akwahosan mu nkɔso pa ne tumidi ho nkuran denam nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow, ne nnipa hokwan ahorow ho adwene a wɔde bɛka ho no so. Nhwɛso yɛ sɛ, wobetumi atrɛw atetesɛm mu amanne ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ mfe a obi nyin mu no mu ma ɛka nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho, na ama mmabun tumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne nkitahodie ho. Ɛdenam atetesɛm mu nneyɛe a wɔbɛma ne nnɛyi akwahosan ho nkɔso ho akwan horow ahyia so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi ama wɔanya adwene pa wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho bere a wɔkora amammerɛ agyapade ne nipasu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛbɛtumi afiri mu aba sɛ yɛde akwan a ɛma nnipa hyɛ mu den na wɔne wɔn ho di nkitaho hyɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu(CSE).
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde akwan a ɛma nnipa hyɛ mu den na wɔne wɔn ho di nkitaho hyɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu a, ebetumi ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu na wɔanya adesua mu nkɔso. Akwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho, te sɛ kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, dwumadi a wɔyɛ, nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa nkitahodi ho no ma asuafo de wɔn ho hyɛ wɔn adesua mu denneennen na wɔde nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw foforo di dwuma wɔ asetra mu nsɛm ankasa mu. Akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu no betumi ama wɔanya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ, na ama wɔanya tema, abodwokyɛre, ne obu ama adwene ahorow. Ɛnam sɛ asuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no mu denneennen nti, nkitahodiɛ ne kyɛfa a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no bɛtumi aboa ama wɔanya adesua tebea a ɛma tumi na ɛka obiara ho ma asuafoɔ nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ anaa awo ntoatoaso mu nneɛma bi a ebetumi anya sɛnea awofo ne wɔn mma a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi nsonsonoe ahorow yi ho dwuma bere a meda so ara kura nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne obu a mewɔ ma m’awofo gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow mu no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa awo ntoatoaso mu nneɛma a ebetumi anya sɛnea awofo ne wɔn mma a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho no bi ne: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne nkitahodi ho wɔ abusua ne mpɔtam hɔ. Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ awo ntoatoaso ahorow mu wɔ suban, gyidi, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna, mfiridwuma, ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho. Asetra mu sikasɛm mu nneɛma a ebetumi aka nneɛma, nhomasua, ne mmoa nnwuma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nkitahodi ho a wobenya. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi nsonsonoe ahorow yi so bere a wɔkura nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne obu a wɔde ma awofo gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow mu no, mmabun betumi: Agye awofo amammerɛ ne awo ntoatoaso mu adwene atom na wɔagye atom bere a wɔkamfo wɔn ankasa ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ nso kyerɛ no. Hwehwɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ na woate wɔn ho wɔn ho ase, na ama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nsusuwii a wɔde obu sesa wɔn ho wɔn ho. Wo ne awofoɔ nyɛ adwuma mfa nhwehwɛ adwene ne ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so adi nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ adwene anaa akwan a wɔfa so di nna mu akwahosan ne nkitahodiɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhyɛso, atenka a wɔhwehwɛ, anaa nkate a wɔkwati di wɔ sɛnea mihu tebea horow a asiane wom anaa mfɛfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna ho na mayɛ ho biribi no mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn anya me ho a mɛte ase ne me ho nhyehyɛe wɔ saa su ahorow yi a midi ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Atenka, nkate a wɔhwehwɛ, anaa nkate a wɔkwati betumi anya sɛnea wuhu tebea horow a asiane wom anaa atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna ho na woyɛ w’ade no so nsunsuanso denam: Asiane a wode bɛto wo ho suban a wobɛma ayɛ kɛse: Nneɛma a ɛma wo ho yɛ hyew ne nkate a wobɛhwehwɛ no betumi ama woanya ɔpɛ kɛse sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu a wunsusuw nea ebetumi afi mu aba ho yiye anaasɛ wobɛkari asiane ne mfaso horow a ebefi mu aba no ho. Asiane ahorow a wɔkwati: Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, nkate-kwati su ahorow betumi ama wɔanya asiane ho adwene kɛse na wɔakwati osuahu ahorow a ebetumi ayɛ nea mfaso wɔ so esiane ehu anaa ahotɔ nti. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na woanya ankasa ho nimdeɛ ne wo ho nhyehyɛe wɔ saa su ahorow yi a wobedi ho dwuma mu no, fa adwene mu nhumu ho akwan horow di dwuma, yɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano a wɔde bedi nkate horow ho dwuma, na sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Susuw osuahu ahorow a atwam ne nea efii mu bae ho na ama woate asiane a wode wo ho to mu no ase yiye na woasua sɛnea wobɛhyɛ da na wubesi gyinae ahorow a ɛfata daakye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na mɛtumi ayɛ wɔ me honam a ɛresesa no ho, te sɛ nsaa anaa honam ani sradeɛ pii a ɛwɔ me honam ani?
answer_twi_source: Afotu bi a ɛbɛboa ni: Fa samina a ɛnyɛ den anaa ade a wɔde tew w’anim hohoro w’anim brɛoo da biara, na ama ngo ne efĩ a ɛboro so no afi hɔ. Kwati sɛ wobɛhohoro wo ho denneennen dodo. Fa nnuru a wɔde hwɛ honam ani a ngo nnim anaasɛ ɛnyɛ comedogenic (ɛrensiw pores) di dwuma. Kwati sɛ wode wo nsa bɛka w’anim, efisɛ eyi betumi de ngo ne mmoawa akɔ baabi foforo. Sɛ wowɔ nsaasaa a, kwati sɛ wobɛtetew anaa wobɛpiapia, efisɛ eyi betumi ama woanya akuru. Sɛ worepere wɔ akisikuru/ nsaasaa ho a, wo ne honam ani yare ho oduruyɛfo nkasa. Wobetumi akamfo ayaresa ahorow te sɛ nnuru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua no so, gel, anaa nnuru a wɔde gu nipadua no so akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nhomasua, ntetee 'training', ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho ahyɛ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe , mmabun nhyehyɛe "youth programs", awofo nhyiam "parent workshops", ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow mu de ama mmabun anya nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔadi ho dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nhomasua, ntetee, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho ahyɛ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe, mmabun nhyehyɛe, awofo nhyiam, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow mu de ama mmabun anya nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔadi ho dwuma yiye. Eyi betumi ayɛ: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe "comprehensive sexual education" a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ahye, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne nea ɔhwɛ no de ne ho gye mu ho. Adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, anaa ahɔho akasafo nhyiam ahorow a ɛma nkurɔfo hu nna mu basabasayɛ, basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu.
