Nteteeɛ a wɔde ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ foforɔ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔbɛhunu, wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ho mmuaeɛ a wɔde nkateɛ bɛma, ne mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ ne mmoa bɛba. Nneɛma a atipɛnfo di anim, akuw, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ pene a wɔpene so amammerɛ ho nkuran, ɛkasa tia mmonnaato amammerɛ, na ɛma nneɛma ne mmoa ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu, anaa adwinni ho adwuma a ɛma mmabun bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ne asetra mu nsakrae a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Edinnsiananmu bɛn na nnipa a ɛsono wɔn bɔbeasu taa de di dwuma, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛde redi dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana mu no, amanmmra no gye binary gender nkutoo tom a she/he edinnsiananmu nkutoo na ɛka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ kyerɛ wɔ apɔmuden ho nsɛm mu, titiriw ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa mu amammere mu nimdeɛ ne sɛ, ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi ate wɔn ayaresafoɔ amammere, kasa, ne asetena mu ahiadeɛ ase, na wɔabu no dɛ, na wɔayɛ wɔn adwuma nso wɔ kwan a ɛbɛma saa ahiadeɛ yi anya mmuaeɛ pa. Sɛ ɛfa mmabun ho a, amammere mu nimdeɛ kyerɛ sɛ ayaresabea bɛma wɔn ayaresa a ɛgye wɔn asetena, wɔn gyidie, wɔn nneyɛeɛ, ne nnoɔma a wɔafa mu wɔ wɔn abrabɔ mu tom, na wɔadi ho ni.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bi a wɔko ma nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a amammerɛ ahorow ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ghana Health Service de nnwuma a ɛnyɛ nyiyim ma, Marie stopes, PPAG ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde afoforo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenepa ne ahomegye akwan te sɛ ahomegyepa anaa adwennwenpa betumi aboa ma adwennwen so ate na ama obi anya adwene mu yiedi?
answer_twi_source: Adwene ne ahomegyepa, nhyehyɛeɛ te sɛ adwennwenpa, ne ntini mu ahomgyeɛ 'muscle relaxation techniques' betumi aboa ma adwennwen so ate denam nervous system a adwo ho. Mmabun betumi de saa nneyɛe yi ahyɛ wɔn da biara da dwumadi ahorow mu denam bere a wɔde besi hɔ ama adwene mu apɔw-mu-tentennee ne ahomegye mfidie ahorow anaa ahomgyeɛ mu akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyerɛ pene a wɔpene so wɔ nkitahodie  a me ne afoforɔ a ɛsono wɔn amamere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi yɛ ade titiriw: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware ho hia wɔ nyɔkonfa biara mu, ɛmfa ho sɛnea obi fi mu. Fa nnyinasosɛm koro no ara a ɛfa pene a yɛadi kan aka ho asɛm no di dwuma (anigye "yiw," hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wosakra w'adwene, obu ma ahye). Bu amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe: Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛsono wɔ nkitahodi ne honam fam nsa a wɔde ka obi ho. Gye bere sua wo hokafo no asetram nsɛm na ka nea wɔhwɛ kwan ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Fa w’adwene si obu a wobɛma wo ho wo ho so: Wɔde abusuabɔ pa si hɔ wɔ obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho nkate ne wɔn ahye so, a amammerɛ a wofi mu mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ amammerɛ ahorow ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ntease ho nkuran de hyɛ obuo ma adwene ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Akwankyerɛ a wɔde hyɛ kasa ne ntease a ɛwɔ aman horow ntam ho nkuran de hyɛ adwene ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔbea ne ɔbarima nna ne awosu ho nkuran no bi ne: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amammerɛ mu, nhomasua dwumadi, ne nhomasua dwumadi ahorow a ɛde nnipa a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu ba fa nimdeɛ, amanne, ne nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbaa ne ɔbarima nna ne awosu ho no ho kyɛfa. Wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ma wɔn a wɔretete wɔn no sua ade, na wɔyɛ nneɛma bi te sɛ anansesɛm, nnwonto, nnwonto, ne sini. Wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ma wɔn a wɔretete wɔn ho no hu ade a ɛsono wɔn su ne wɔn su ahorow. Akyerɛkyerɛfo, apɔwmuden ho ahwɛfo, ne nnipakuw animdefo ntam ahobrɛase ho nkuran, na wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔn ho wɔn ho atew na wɔnsua sɛnea wobegye atom na wɔasiesie atetesɛm ne atetesɛm a ɛwɔ amammerɛ ntam no. Wɔne amammerɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, nnipakuw animdefo, ne nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow bom yɛ adwuma de atetew akwan a ɛfa nna ne nyinsɛn ho ho ho ho a ɛfata so, na wɔagye atom na wɔbu amammerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nnipa ahonyade ne ankorankoro ahonyade mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahoɔden a mede gyina ano ne nkate fam nyansa nea broni ka no 'resilience and emotional intelligence' a mede bɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu nkɔso a ɛkɔ soro ne nea ɛba fam no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nya wo ho a wobɛte ase denam wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne sɛnea woyɛ w’ade wɔ tebea horow ho na wobɛte ase no so. Fa w’adwene ne wo ho a wobɛdwennwen di dwuma na ama woakɔ so atra hɔ na woadi nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba no ho dwuma yiye. Nya ahokokwaw a ɛfata a wode begyina ano, te sɛ ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, wo ho a wobɛka ho asɛm pa, ne mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Gye ɔhaw tom sɛ hokwan a wode benyin na woasua ade, na nya asetra ho adwene pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ mu amanne anaa guasodeyɛ ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ahyɛ ɔhaw ahorow mu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mmoa mu na ama wɔadi mmabun a wofi amammerɛ pɔtee bi mu ahiade ho dwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wobetumi de amammerɛ mu amanne anaa guasodeyɛ ahorow ahyɛ ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mmoa dwumadi ahorow mu a yɛde hyɛ mmabun no amammerɛ atetesɛm anuonyam, de awerɛkyekye ama, na wɔahyɛ ayaresa ho nkuran. Nhwɛsoɔ betumi ayɛ mpaebɔ, adwendwene, abasɛm, nnwom, asaw, anaa guasodeɛ a amammerɛ mu mpaninfoɔ anaa akannifoɔ di anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi ne apomoden ho ɔyaresafo bi akasa wɔ kokoamu denam apomoden ntetan so?
answer_twi_source: Kokoamusɛm yɛ ade titiriw a ɛwɔ ahomatrofo telefon so apomoden ho dwumadie mu, na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ di ayarefoɔ kokoamsɛm gyinapɛn ahodoɔ so, te sɛ ankorankoro nsrahwɛ. Mpɛn pii no, mmabun betumi ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo akasa wɔ kokoam denam telefon so apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so, nanso ɛho hia sɛ wodi kan ma kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no mu da hɔ. Bio nso, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ hu sɛ wɔwɔ baabi a kokoam na ahobammɔ wɔ bere a wɔrekɔhwɛ apomoden wɔ telefon so no na ama wɔakora kokoamsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi anya intanɛt so afotu anaa mmoa dwumadie a ɛfa 'STI/HIV' ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wobɛtumi anya intanɛt so afotuo anaa mmoa dwumadie a ɛfa 'STI/HIV' ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho denam akwan ahodoɔ so, a nea ɛka ho ne: nea broni ka no 'Telemedicine' dwumadie a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa ayaresabea ahodoɔ de ma, baabi a wobɛtumi ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ama afotufoɔ anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ akɔ virtual appointments ama kokoam nkɔmmɔdie ne mmoa. Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa nkrasɛm a ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw de ma, te sɛ Planned Parenthood, baabi a wubetumi ne afotufo a wɔatete wɔn anaa atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo abɔ nkɔmmɔ a wommɔ wo din. Mobile application anaa wɛbsaet a ɛma virtual afotuo, mmoa akuo, anaa atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ma ankorankoro a wɔwɔ 'STI anaa HIV', te sɛ woka no borɔfo mu sɛ 'TheBody.com anaa Healthvana.'
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: STI nhwehwɛmu ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, na dɛn na ɛka ho ma me?
answer_twi_source: STI nhwehwɛmu betumi ayɛ: Mogya mu Nhwehwɛmu: Hwehwɛ antibodies anaa antigens a nipadua no yɛ de bua STI ahorow bi, te sɛ HIV, syphilis, ne hepatitis B ne C. Nsu mu Nhwehwɛmu: Hwehwɛ nsu a wɔde yɛ nhwehwɛmu mu na woahu STI te sɛ chlamydia ne gonorrhea. Swab Tests: Boaboa nhwɛsode ahorow fi mmeae a ɛwɔ awotwaa, ano, anaa akyi berɛmo mu de sɔ STIs te sɛ chlamydia, gonorrhea, ne trichomoniasis hwɛ. Sɔhwɛ pɔtee a wobɛyɛ no begyina wo nna ho abakɔsɛm, wo yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne, ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nyansahyɛ ahorow so nsoo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ 'media literacy' adi dwuma de ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa, a wɔpene so a wɔayɛ ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ne nneɛma a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade "abusive dynamiccs", te sɛ nhyɛso, nsakrae, ne basabasayɛ ntam, na masi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ m’ankasa abusuabɔ anaa twaka "relationship" ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ "media literacy" adi dwuma de akyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa, a wɔpene so a wɔayɛ ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ne nkɔso a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade ntam denam: Frɛmfrɛ kɔkɔɔ anaa kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛfa abusuabɔ mu nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ papa ho a wubehu, te sɛ tumidi, nsakrae, anaa pene a wonni so. Nkitahodi, obu, ne ne yɔnko pene a wɔpene so ho hia wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu a wɔbɛte ase. Hwehwɛ nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow de sua abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom mu nkɔso ne akwan a wɔfa so di tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu ho ade. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ pa mu pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛhyɛ nkitahodi pa, pene a wɔpene so, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ho nkuran a wɔkamfo kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a ɛfa m’amammerɛ pɔtee ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Ebia ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu fotufo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo bi wɔ nneɛma a ɛfa w’amammerɛ ho. Hwehwɛ intanɛt so databases(Amannebɔ korabea): YMK app, social media hndle os Mmabun akwahosan ne nkɔso nhyehyɛe no. Mmabun akwahosan akuw, Mmabun ne mmabun frindly akwahosan asoɛe a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ anaa akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhomakorabea adwumayɛfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho abenfo nea broni ka 'media specialists', ne sukuu so ahwɛfo di wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, adwumayɛkuw a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne adwumayɛfo nkɔso a wɔboa wɔ saa asɛm yi mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, nwomakorabea adwumayɛfoɔ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho abenfoɔ nea broni ka 'media specialists', ne sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ di dwuma titire wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, wɔhyɛ adwumayɛkuo mu nkɔsoɔ ho nkuran, na wɔboa adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaa ka wɔn adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ho wɔ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ nsɛm ahodoɔ mu, na ɛma asuafoɔ nya hokwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm mu yie na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma mu. Nhomakorabea adwumayɛfo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho abenfo hwɛ nneɛma so na wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw nsɛmti ho, boa asuafo ma wɔhwehwɛ dijitaal nsɛm fibea ahorow mu, hwɛ sɛnea wogye di, na wonya nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ kyekyɛ nneɛma, hyehyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, na wɔyɛ tebea a ɛboa a ɛde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ di kan sɛ adeɛ a ɛho hia wɔ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. Mmɔdenbɔ a adwumayɛfoɔ bom yɛ no hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa ɔkwan a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a ɛfa biribiara ho, a dwumadie biara boa ma asuafoɔ no adwene a ɛyɛ den, nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne digyital ɔman bayɛ nya nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo da pene a wɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ ahorow mu, a odɔ mu nhyiam, nnamfofa, ne nkitahodi a ɛda nnipa a wɔyɛ sini, TV so dwumadi ahorow, ne aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow mu ka ho adi?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa da pene a wɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ mu adi denam akwan ahorow te sɛ sini, TV so dwumadi ahorow, ne aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow so. Wɔ odɔ mu nhyiam ahorow mu no, ebetumi akyerɛ nnipa a wɔda no adi pefee sɛ wɔpene so, wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nkitahodi a obu wom mu, na wɔde ahye sisi hɔ. Nanso, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nso betumi ama nsusuwii hunu a epira akɔ so denam ɔdɔ a wɔde bɛkɔ so ayɛ akyidi, a wobebu wɔn ani agu nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde ano anaa nea wɔmfa ano nka so, ne nhyɛso a wɔbɛda no adi sɛ odɔ ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa nneyɛe ne kankabi ahorow a ɛwɔ nyamesom akuo mu no nya suban ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho so nkɛntɛnso wɔ ɔkwan a ɛtrɛw so, na hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔayɛ adwuma wɔ saa tebea horow yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa nneyɛe ne kankabi a ɛkɔ so wɔ nyamesom akuo mu no betumi anya suban ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, na akyerɛ baguam kasa, asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne aban nhyehyɛe ahorow. Hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu na wɔayɛ adwuma wɔ saa tebea horow yi mu no nam kyɛfa a wonya wɔ nyamesom mmabun akuo, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkasa kyerɛ, ne nyamesom ahorow ntam nkitahodi ahorow a ɛhyɛ nkɔso gyinapɛn ahorow, nnipa hokwan ahorow, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran no so. Mmabun betumi de kuro abɛɛfo ntentan akwan, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ nnipa ase adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse, akasafo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nsɛm te sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu, nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow, wɔ nyamesom akuw mu ne wiase nyinaa. Ɛdenam ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne wɔn yɛ biako so no, mmabun a wɔyɛ adwumaden no betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ akwan horow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom, ɛyɛ pɛ, na egyina hokwan ahorow so wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho wɔ wiase nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran wɔ atipɛnfo mu na wɔhyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nhyiamu anaa Nhyiamu: Yɛ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu ho nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ. Nhomasua Ɔsatu: Yɛ ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm ne nkɛntɛnso a enya ho nkuran. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Tete atipɛnfo ma wɔnyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ananmusifo a wobetumi akyɛ nsɛm ne afotu ama afoforo. Dwumadie a Wɔde Di Dwuma Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadie a wɔde di dwuma mu a atipɛnfoɔ hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm mu na wɔsusu ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nhwehwɛmu: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mfonini ahorow ho wɔ adesuadan anaa kuw tebea mu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho wɔ edinnsiananmu a wɔde di dwuma wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu, te sɛ nnianim nsɛm, din a wɔde kyerɛw, ne din a wɔde kyerɛw wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so?
answer_twi_source: nsusuwyɛ bi se ɛni ho wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow nya kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm a wobenya ho wɔ mpɔtam bi so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akuw binom betumi anya nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn anaa akasa tia nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔde di dwuma ntɛm a egyina gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, anaa nna mu abrabɔ pa ho. Ɛho hia sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ te nka wɔ ankorankoro amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidie ho berɛ a wɔreka nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano ntɛm ho asɛm na wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmuo ne obuo a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma ayarefoɔ gyinapɛn ne ahofadie ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma me kokoam mmoa akuw anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wobetumi de nkate fam mmoa ama wɔn a wodi STI ho dwuma no.
answer_twi_source: Kokoam mmoa akuo anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ a ɛbɛtumi de nkateɛ mu mmoa ama nie: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG Helpline): 0244312151 (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8am-5pm). Saa mmoa telefon yi nso betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa mmoa akuo ho. Ghana AIDS Commission Helpline: 0800123456 (Toll-Free). Ebia saa mmoa telefon yi betumi ama wo ne mmoa akuo nso adi nkitaho. Marie Frɛ: 03002241517 UNICEF Agoo Ɔno + wɔ 0540118999 GHS-YMK Mobile app
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne nnyinan-din broni bɛka 'pronouns', na adɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana, amansan mmara no gye mmarima ne mmaa nko ara tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobetumi akyerɛkyerɛ amanneɛbɔ ho akwan 'media techniques' bi te sɛ 'framing', 'stereotyping' ne nna mu nsɛm 'sexualization' a ɛfa nna mu ne awo mu nhyehyɛe ho ne nsunsuanso a yenya wɔ mmabun suban ne w4n abrabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Framing: Sɛdeɛ wɔyi asɛm bi kyerɛ. Stereotyping: Adwene koro a yɛde hu nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa. Sexualization: Sɛ wɔma biribi yɛ nna nna. Normalization: Sɛ wɔma biribi yɛ daadaa ade 'normal'. Wei ka mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra a wɔwɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow mu betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya adwene pa wɔ wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne nna ho, na wɔama wɔn nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wohia na wɔde asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo ne ahwɛfo a wɔwɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow mu betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya adwene pa wɔ wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne nna ho denam nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a wɔde bɛma, ne nneyɛe ne suban pa a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ so. Eyi betumi ayɛ nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua mfonini, mpeneso, abusuabɔ pa, nyinsɛn ho nnuro, ne STI a wosiw ano a wɔbɛka ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a wotumi bɛn na ɛnyɛ atɛn so. Bio nso, awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no betumi ahyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔasusuw nneɛma ho yiye na wɔama mmabun tumi ma wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho denam wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne gyinaesi mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma wɔ ayaresa ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ma mmebun?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛde ayarefo ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, ne obu a wɔde ma ankorankoro hokwan ahorow di kan na ɛkyerɛ kwan ma wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma wɔ ayaresa ho, a nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho. Wɔ mmabun fam no, wobetumi de nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi adi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan soronko so a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Mpɛn pii no, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun te ayaresa a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa no su ase, asane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so, akwan foforo a wobetumi afa so, ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba no ase ansa na wɔanya wɔn pene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ me mu duru anaa me nipadua ho asɛm haw me bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, na mɛyɛ dɛn akɔ so adidi yiye?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtaa ba sɛ mmabun hu wɔn nipadua yiye bere a wɔadu mpanyin afe so no. Sɛnea wobɛ kura aduane pa ni: Fa w’adwene si Akwaahosan so: Sɛ́ anka wobɛma wo mu duru no, fa w’adwene si so sɛ wode nnuan a ahoɔden wom bɛma wo nipadua no ahoɔden na ama woanyin na woanya ahoɔden. Nipadua Mfonini Pa: Di nea wo nipadua betumi ayɛ ho afahyɛ mmom sen sɛnea ɛte. Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho mu, sɛ́ ɛyɛ agumadi, asaw, anaa akwantu. Kwati sɛ wubedi aduane ɛbɛma wo mu duru so atew  (Fad Diets): aduane ɛbɛma wo mu duru so atew anaa adidi a ɛtra so nyɛ nea ahoɔden wom. Fa yɛ wo botae sɛ wubedi aduan a ɛkari pɛ na woayɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa. Wo Ho Mmɔborohunu: Da ayamye adi kyerɛ wo ho. Sɛ worepere a, wo ne ɔpanyin, ɔwofo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ɔfotufo a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka wo nkate ho asɛm. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Kɔ so yɛ nnam ma akwaahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa. Hwehwɛ dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, sɛ́ ɛyɛ kuw agumadi, yoga, asaw, anaa sakre so. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ woayɛ basaa a , wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo, ɔfotufo, anaa aduan ho ɔbenfo nkasa. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abusuabɔ pa a me ne me nipadua wɔ?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ pa a wo ne wo nipadua benya no kyerɛ sɛ wubebu no na woakyerɛ ho anisɔ wɔ nea ɛyɛ nyinaa ho. Ɛfa sɛnea wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho ye wɔ w’ankasa wo honam ani na woate ase sɛ wo nipadua yɛ soronko na ɛsakra berɛ nyinaa, titiriw wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Afotu bi ni: Fa w’adwene si sɛnea wo nipadua te nka ne nea ebetumi ayɛ so: So wubetumi atu mmirika, ahuruw, asaw, anaa woayɛ adwinni? Di wo nipadua ahoɔden ne nea wotumi yɛ ho afahyɛ. Gye tom sɛ nipadua ahorow no wɔ nsusuwii ne akɛse nyinaa: Nipadua biara nni hɔ a "ɛyɛ pɛ". Nea ɛho hia kɛse ne sɛ wobɛhwɛ wo ho denam adidi pa a wubedi na woakɔ so ayɛ nnam so. Da ayamye adi kyerɛ wo ho: Kwati sɛ wobɛka wo ho nsɛmmɔne. Mmom no, fa w’adwene si nea w’ani gye ho wɔ wo nipadua ho so, na yɛ nneɛma a wopɛ sɛ wutu mpɔn wɔ ɔkwan a ahoɔden wom so (te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa adidi pa) ho adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mfiridwuma betumi aboa ma wɔadi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya ASRH nnwuma so, titiriw ma nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri no?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma betumi aboa ma wɔadi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya ASRH nnwuma so, titiriw ma nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri, denam: Akyirikyiri afotu a wɔde bɛma: Nea abrofo taa frɛ no Telemedicine ma mmabun a wɔwɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a wonnya mmoa pii no tumi kɔ apomoden ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn a enhia sɛ wotu kwan tenten. Nnwuma a wɔde anifere ma: Abɛɛfo ntetan anaa Intanɛt so dwumadibea ne mobile app ahorow ma mmabun hwehwɛ SRH ho nsɛm ne nnwuma wɔ kokoamu, a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa anaa atemmu afi wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Nhumu a ɛkɔ soro: Asetena mu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ɔsatu ne abɛɛfo nkitahodi mmɔdenbɔ ma nkurɔfo hu SRH nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ na ɛhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ bere a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na afotufoɔ yɛde boa si nna mu mmoawa a wɔde nyarewa ba ano?
answer_twi_source: Ɔma nimdeɛ anaa akwankyerɛ. Ɔkyerɛ sɛdeɛ yɛte nneɛma bi so. Boa so adwenemhaw ne animtiabuo ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atetesɛm mu amanne, amanne, ne guasodeyɛ ahorow a ɛbata onyin anaa mmabunbere ho wɔ yɛn amammerɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na amanne ahorow a yɛde twa kwan yi hyehyɛ yɛn adwene wɔ yɛn nipadua, nna, ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Amanne kwan so amanne, amanne, ne guasodeyɛ ahorow a ɛbata mfe a obi nyin anaa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho no gu ahorow wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu nanso mpɛn pii no ɛfa amanne pɔtee bi a ɛkyerɛ nsakrae a efi mmofraase kɔ mpanyin afe so ho. Ebia amanne ahorow yi bi ne amanne ahorow te sɛ amanne ahorow a wɔde hyɛ obi ase, twetiatwa, anaa ahotew ho guasodeyɛ ahorow, a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea onipa no asiesie ne ho ama mpanyimfo asɛyɛde ahorow. Ɛdenam saa amanne ahorow yi so no, wɔde mmerante ne mmabaa ka amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne awo akwahosan ho, na ɛsakra wɔn suban ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ saa mmeae yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmara mu mmoa sɛ obi bu wɔn asumasɛm ho faahodie nimtia anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmabun wɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmara mu mmoa. Wobenya afotuo ne mmoa afi lawyerfoɔ ne mmara kuo a wɔhwɛ apɔwmuden so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi ntawantawadi anaa adwene a enhyia wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu no ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi ntawantawadi anaa adwene a enhyia ho dwuma wɔ akwan a ɛfata so denam: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nokwaredi mu ne wɔn hokafo Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ ne tema Bu wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene ne wɔn nkate a wɔbɛbom ahwehwɛ apam ne ano aduru a wɔbɛbom ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ ɛho hia a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa amanfoɔ adwenepɔ fa anigye ne ɔdɔ die ho nya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ nna mu agodie so ?
answer_twi_source: Amammrɛ bi hu no sɛ nna mu agodie yɛ musu, na mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ ara ne awoɔ. Adwene bi saa tumi ha ɔdɔ die ne mu anigye. Media ne ɔman no so tumi nya adwenpɔ bi saa ɛmmoa. Wobetumi ayɛ kasamafoɔ ako atia saa adwenpɔ. Nanso hyɛ ne nsew sɛ kuro bia wɔ ne gyedie, wo hokafoɔ so saa, nsti sɛ ɛbɛ boa a, gye wɔn tum.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn  na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm fa so nya nna mu nkitahodie a ɛfata, ɛma abotɔyam, na wɔpene so?
answer_twi_source: Fa nkitahodi di dwuma: Ka w’ahiade ne w’akɔnnɔ ahorow ho asɛm pefee na ka nokware. Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Hu nea wo ho tɔ wo wɔ ho na nsuro sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo hokafo: Boa wo hokafo ma ɔnte wo dɛmdi ne sɛnea ebetumi aka mpa mu nkitahodie a emu yɛ den no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodie ahorow hyɛ nkuran ma obiara ka ho, ahorow ahorow, ne obuo ma ankorankoro nsonsonoe wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ, amammerɛ mu nsɛm, ne ankorankoro gyidi ahorow mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn aboa ma wɔayɛ tebea a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔma akwaaba wɔ saa nkitahodie ahorow yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodie hyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ahodoɔ, ne obuo a wɔde ma ankorankoro nsonsonoeɛ wɔ nna ho bɔbea, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nipasu, amammerɛ, ne ankorankoro gyidie ho nkuran denam: Wɔbɛma tebea a ɛma akwaaba na ɛnyɛ atemmuo a asɔremma nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔgye wɔn tom na wɔsom boɔ wɔ onipa ko a wɔyɛ ho. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ankorankoro akyɛ wɔn osuahu ne wɔn adwene soronko, ntease ne tema a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ atipɛnfo mu. Hwɛ sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne dwumadie no bɛka obiara ho na ɛfa ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ ne nnipa a wɔgyina hɔ ma wɔ kuw no mu no ho. Asɔremma a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho fa nnipa ne osuahu ahodoɔ ho, hyɛ nhumu ne ayɔnkofa ho nkuran wɔ nkitahodiɛ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔsɛe no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adebɔ, ne nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu dwumadi, de akasa atia nkrasɛm a epira na wɔde nsakrae pa aba wɔn mpɔtam ne intanɛt so mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛkasa atia nkrasɛm a epira na wɔde nsakrae pa aba denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu deconstruction akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu na wɔakasa atia, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobehu nsusuwii hunu, animhwɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahintaw. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adebɔ adwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ayɛ asɛm afoforo ne gyinabea ahorow a ɛhyɛ ahorow ahorow, nnipa a wɔka ho, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo dwumadi ɔsatu ahorow ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo wɔ intanɛt so mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ama nkurɔfo ate asetena mu nsɛm ho asɛm, akasa atia asɛm a epira, na wɔakamfo nsakrae. Yɛne atipɛnfoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔyɛ adwuma bom de hyehyɛ nhyiamu, adwumayɛbea, ne dijitaal ɔsatuo a ɛma nne a wɔato wɔn hintidua no yɛ kɛseɛ na ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ananmusifoɔ pa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wobefi ase akora sika so wɔ wɔn mmofraase, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de mfaso a ɛkɔ soro no adi dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wofi ase sie sika wɔ wɔn mmofraase a, ɛde mfaso pii ba, a nea ɛka ho ne: Tumi a ɛwɔ mfɛntom a ɛka bom mu a wɔde bedi dwuma: Sɛ́ wɔbɛma sika a wɔde asie no anya nkɔanim bere tenten wɔ mfɛntom anaa sika a wɔde asie so mfaso a wɔboaboa ano so, na ɛma ahonyade a wɔboaboa ano no yɛ kɛse kɛse. Sikasɛm mu su a wɔde nteɛso ma a wobenya: Sikakorabea ho su a wubenya ntɛm no hyɛ nteɛso, asɛyɛde, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, na ɛto fapem a emu yɛ den ma sikasɛm mu yiyedi wɔ nkwa nna nyinaa mu. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyekye: Sikakorabea, sika a wɔde hyɛ mu, ne sika a wɔde di dwuma ho sua a wosua ntɛm no ma sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ nya nkɔso, na ɛma mmabun tumi paw nneɛma a wofi nimdeɛ mu. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛfa: Sika a wɔboaboa ano no ma mmabun nya hokwan ahorow a wɔde di dwuma bere a ɛsɔre no, te sɛ sika a wɔde bɛto nhomasua mu, adwuma bi a wobefi ase, anaa agyapade a wɔbɛtɔ, a ɛma sikasɛm mu nkɔso ne nkonimdi ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a wɔfa so da abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den adi, a wɔnyɛ nna mu kyɛfa?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho hyɛ nkitahodi a emu da hɔ na nokwaredi mu ne wo hokafo mu na ama woanya atenka fam abusuabɔ ho. Da ɔdɔ adi denam nsaanodwuma te sɛ atuu, nsa a wokura mu, ne mfeano. Mommɔ bere pa, momfa mo ho nhyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma mo ani gye na ɛhyɛ mo abusuabɔ mu den mu. Kyerɛ anisɔ nma mo ho mo ho daa, na gye nneɛma pa a ɛwɔ mo abusuabɔ mu no tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mebetumi ate akokoaa no kɔmfɛm (heartbeat) wɔ berɛ a mekɔ afuru mu nhwehwɛmu (prenatal care) no mu anaa? (mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ berɛ a afuru no anyini kakra)?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, wubetumi ate wo ba no koma bɔ akyiri yi wɔ nyinsɛn mu, bɛyɛ dapɛn a ɛto so 16 kosi 20.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsakrae bɛn na ɛtaa ba nipadua ne atinka mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aka yɛn adwenem ahokwasan "mental health"?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛtaa ba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no bi ne onyin a ɛba ntɛmntɛm, nna mu su a ɛto so abien a ɛba (te sɛ nufu a enyin wɔ mmea mu ne anim nhwi nyin wɔ mmarima mu), nsakrae a ɛba nipadua no nsusuwii mu, ne brayɛ a efi ase. Atinka mu nsakrae betumi ayɛ adwene a ɛsakra, asetena mu tebea horow ho nkate a ɛkɔ soro, ne ho a obehu kɛse, ne obu a ɔsakra wɔ ne ho mu. Saa nsakrae yi betumi aka adwenemyare denam adwennwen, dadwen, adwene a ɛyɛ basaa, ne ahobammɔ a wonni ho nkate a ɛde bɛba so bere a mmabun reyɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn nipadua a ɛresakra no mu na wɔfa asetra ne atinka mu osuahu foforo mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adutoɔ akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmarima-ne-mmarima anaa mmaa-ne-mmaa nkitahodiɛ (same-sex couples) a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔsiw awoɔ kwan?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, awoɔ ho asɛm mma mmarima-ne-mmarima anaa mmaa-ne-mmaa nkitahodiɛ mu, nanso ebia nnipa bi bɛpɛ sɛ wɔsiw nyarewa a ɛnam nna so ba (STIs) kwan. Akwan ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ bi nie:Banbɔ nneɛma (Barrier methods): "Condoms" ne "dental dams" (banbɔ nkatia) yɛ akwan pa a wɔfa so siw nna mu nyarewa (STIs) kwan wɔ nna mu.Mmaa "Condoms" (Internal condoms): Wɔyɛɛ eyi maa mmaa na wɔahyɛ wɔ nna mu; ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban firi nna mu nyarewa ho.Nkitahodiɛ a ɛda hɔ (Partner communication): Sɛ wone wo dɔfo bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛmu da hɔ afa nna mu akwahosan ne nyarewa ho nhwehwɛmu (STI testing) ho no hia paa wɔ nkitahodiɛ biara mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun adwuma nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee so ba adwumawuranom ne ahyehyɛde ahorow so mfaso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne ho ntetee boa adwumawuranom ne ahyehyɛde ahorow wɔ akwan horow pii so: Talent a wobenya: Adwumawuranom nya kwan kɔ mmerante ne mmabaa talente ahorow a wɔwɔ adwene foforo, nsusuwii foforo, ne nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ foforo a ebetumi aboa ma ahyehyɛde no anya nkɔso na asi yiye. Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu nhyehyɛeɛ: Adwumayɛ mu nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu a ɛtu mpɔn, na ɛma ahyehyɛdeɛ tumi hunu ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ na wɔsiesie wɔn ma daakye adwumayɛ hokwan ahodoɔ wɔ adwumakuo no mu. Adwumayɛ a ɛkɔ anim: Adwumayɛfo nkumaa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwumayɛ ho ntetee anaa adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no betumi ama adwumayɛ akɔ anim denam wɔn ahoɔden, anigye, ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wobesua ade a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Nneɛma ahorow ne nea wɔka ho: Mmabun adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu kyɛfa a wonya no kyerɛ sɛ ahyehyɛde bi de ne ho ahyɛ nneɛma ahorow, pɛyɛ, ne nkabom mu, na ɛma ne din kɔ anim na ɛma adetɔfo, sikakorafo, ne adwumayɛfo ani gye ho. Asetena mu asɛdeɛ: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔboa no ne nnwumakuo asetena mu asɛdeɛ botaeɛ hyia, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto sika a wɔde bɛto daakye adwumayɛfoɔ mu na wɔaboa ama mpɔtam nkɔsoɔ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow mu na ama wɔn atipɛnfo tumi anya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wohia na wɔde afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso ahorow so wɔ wɔn da biara da asetra mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua  wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow mu wɔ : Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow a asuafo di anim mu de ma nkurɔfo hu hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn ɔman bayɛ ho hia. Wɔne akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bɛyɛ biako de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ aka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi ho. Adwumayɛbea ahorow abɛɛfo ntentan , nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nsɛmti so, te sɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn ahobammɔ,  so abrabɔ pa, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛho hia ho nhyehyɛe. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn ne abɛɛfo ntentan so akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ nneɛma, de atipɛnfoɔ ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie mu, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi mu wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ, na asuadeɛ bɛn na yɛbɛtumi asua afiri mu?
answer_twi_source: Y-Peer nkitahodi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ aman ahorow so no tete mmerante ne mmabaa ma wɔbɛyɛ atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo na wɔkasa ama nna ne awoɔ apomoden hokwan ahorow kyerɛ. Asuadeɛ no bi ne hia a mmabun akanni ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho hia. Atipɛnfo Apomoden Nsesa nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ United States no tete kɔlegefo ma wɔde apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow ma wɔ ntoaso sukuu ahorow mu, na esi mfaso a ɛwɔ atipɛnfo adesua ne adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛfa amammerɛ ho so dua. Asuadeɛ a wɔasua no bi ne hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔnya nteteeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, mmoa a ɛkɔ so ma atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔne sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ na ama wɔadu atiefoɔ a wɔdɔɔso nkyɛn yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, nyamesom, ne asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya abrabɔ pa ahye ne gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ, nyamesom, ne asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya abrabɔ pa ahye ne gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso. Saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi betumi akyerɛ nea wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ nea wogye tom anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea wɔabara, na ɛbɛka nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, kasa, ne mfonini a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ma wɔn adwene si nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi so na wɔde wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow susuw nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ho yiye. Ɛdenam adwene ahorow a wohu na wobu amammerɛ mu nkate horow so no, mmabun betumi afa abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow mu wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma mu no mu yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mɛma mpanyimfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa ayaresafoɔ aboa me ma menya me nna mu nsɛm nsɛmmisa ho mmuae?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobegye adwenkyerɛ wɔ mpanyinfo, ayaresafo no boa ma wonya nna mu nsɛm no ho mmuae: Hwehwɛ afotu ne nimdeɛ. Hwehwɛ mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ. Ma wɔnnhwɛ wo nneyɛeɛ so. Wei boa ma wodi nkonim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow ne mprempren adwumayɛfo gua so ahwehwɛde a ɛrekɔ so no hyia na ama wɔanya adwumayɛ ho anidaso ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan ahorow a wɔde benya adwuma mu osuahu ne ahokokwaw a mfaso wɔ so denam adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwumayɛ a wɔde sua adwuma, anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ adwumam so. Saa osuahu ahorow yi ma wotumi de adesuadan mu adesua di dwuma wɔ wiase ankasa tebea horow mu, nya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a ɛsom bo, kyekye adwumayɛfo nkitahodi, na wɔhwehwɛ adwumayɛ akwan mu. Mmabun betumi anya saa hokwan ahorow yi denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so, wɔn a wɔde adwumayɛ ho ntetee ma, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne adwumawuranom fekubɔ a wɔde nsaano adesua mu osuahu ahorow ma wɔ nnwuma ne nnwuma ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotufoɔ bɛtumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nneɛma, dwumadie, ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awoɔ apomoden so?
answer_twi_source: Afotufoɔ boa mmabun ma wɔnya nneɛma a ɛfata, dwumadie, ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ, te sɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awoɔ apomoden so denam: Nsɛm ne awoɔ apomoden a wɔde ma: Afotufoɔ de mmabun bata mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne dwumadie ho denam nsɛm a wɔde ma, wɔde wɔn kɔ, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn no so. Wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wobenya hokwan: Afotufo kamfo kyerɛ sɛ mmabun nya nna ne awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw , nna mu yareɛ  nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne afotu, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wobenya mmoa a wohia na wɔde asi gyinae a ɛfata. Nkitahodi a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw: Afotufo boa mmabun ma wɔkyekye mmoa nkitahodi denam wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa akuo, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ankorankoro afoforo a wɔwɔ osuahu ne dadwen a ɛte saa ara a wɔde bɛka wɔn ho no so. Akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma: Afotufoɔ de akwankyerɛ, nkuranhyɛ, ne nkateɛ mu mmoa a ɛkɔ so ma mmabun berɛ a wɔrefa nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nneɛma ne dwumadie a wɔbɛnya na wɔde adi dwuma no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne pene na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ bere a wɔreyɛ di nna mu agoro? (anigye, amanneɛbɔ, enidaho, kɔ so)
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so yɛ kwan anaa apam a wɔde ma kwa sɛ wɔbɛyɛ biribi anaasɛ biribi asi. Wɔde pene ma kwa a wɔmfa kommyɛ, nsusuwii, anaa nhyɛso biara nka ho. Nsɛntitiriw a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔpene so ni: Anigye: "Yiw" kyerɛ yiw, anaa "ebia" anaa kommyɛ kyerɛ dabi. Hwehwɛ anigye ne ɔpɛ a wɔde ano ka ne nea wɔmfa ano nka ho. Amanneɛbɔ: Ɛsɛ sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa hu nna mu dwumadi ko a ɛrekɔ so na wɔn ho tɔ wɔn wɔ ho. N’adwene mu da hɔ: Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔhokafo no mu biara nom nnubɔne anaa nsa, na ɛno betumi asɛe n’adwene. Kɔ so: Wobetumi atwe pene a wɔpene so no afi hɔ bere biara, bere a wɔrenya nna mu agoro mpo. "Dabi" anaa gyae a ɛda adi pefee kyerɛ sɛ gyae ɛmfa ho baabi a woadu. Wɔ abusuabɔ a obu wom mu no, pene a wɔn baanu nyinaa pene so wɔ nna ho dwumadi ho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nhumu a ɛkɔ soro na wɔanya akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun wɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛpere ama nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmeaeɛ a wɔhwɛ mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) apɔwmuden so adɔɔso no fa anamɔn yi ho:Ma Nnipa Nhunu Ho Asɛm (Raise Awareness): Kyerɛkyerɛ wo nnamfo, awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtamfoɔ fa sɛnea ayaresabea mmoa a ɛfata mmaayewa som bo ne sɛnea ɛboa wɔn asetena. Fa abɛfo ntentan (social media), mpɔtam nhyiamu, ne sukuu mu nteteeɛ trɛw saa amanneɛbɔ yi mu.Ne Mpanyimfoɔ Ndi Nkitaho (Engage with Policymakers): Kyerɛw nkrataa, "emails," anaa bɔ mmɔden bi de kɔma mpɔtam mpanyimfoɔ na pere ma wɔmfa sika ne nneɛma pii mmoa mmaayewa ayaresabea hwɛ. Kɔ mpɔtam nhyiamu ahorow na kɔka nea ɛhaw wo ne nea ɛhia wo fa mmaayewa apɔwmuden ho.Ne Akuo Afoforɔ Nyɛ Adwuma (Collaborate with Organizations): Ne mpɔtam adɔkotafoɔ, mmeranteɛ ne mmaayewa akuo, ne sukuu ahorow mmɔ mu nyɛ adwuma na mopere ma mmaayewa nya ayaresabea hwɛ a ɛfata. Mommɔ mu nyɛ nteteeɛ ne nhyiamu ahorow a ɛfa mmaayewa apɔwmuden ho.Kyɛ Wo Ho Abakɔsɛm (Share Personal Experiences): Kyɛ wo ho abakɔsɛm fa sɛnea wo nsa aka ayaresabea hwɛ mmerɛ a woyɛ ababaawa anaa aberanteɛ; kyerɛ nea ɛyɛɛ papa ne nea ɛnyɛɛ papa. Wo ho asɛm pɔtee bɛtumi akanyan afoforɔ na ɛde nsakyeraeɛ aba.Boa Nhyehyɛeɛ a Ɛwɔ Hɔ (Support Existing Initiatives): Hwehwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a ɛrebɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛtu mmaayewa apɔwmuden mpɔn na boa wɔn. Fa wo mmerɛ, wo nyansa, anaa wo nneɛma boa na ama wɔn adwuma no akɔ yie.Denam mmaayewa apɔwmuden mmoa ho pere a wobɛpere no so no, wobɛtumi aboa ama mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ nyinaa anya hwɛ ne mmoa a ɛhia na wɔanyini yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammrɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow di wɔ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nna a edi aware anim, nyinsɛn ho nnuro, nyinsɛn yi guo, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho a wɔhyehyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛma de ate nna mu nneyɛe ase na wɔadi ho dwuma, awo a wɔpaw, ne abusua asetena. Ahotew, abrabɔ pa, ne su pa ho adwene ahorow a ɛka akwanhwɛ ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho a wɔhyɛ mu den.Ban a wɔde bɛhyɛ nneyɛe bi a wobu no sɛ ɛne nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow bɔ abira, te sɛ nna a edi aware anim, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam abusuabɔ, anaa nnuru a wɔde sɛe nyinsɛn a wɔde di dwuma no so. Akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro ne mpɔtamfo a wɔredi nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu abrabɔ pa, awo akwahosan, ne nnipa ntam abusuabɔ ho wɔ wɔn gyidi atetesɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asuade bɛn na yebetumi asua afi nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabiara a wɔwɔ wiase mmeae ahorow no nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu nkɔso atu mpɔn no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a edi mu a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforo a broni ka no 'mobile adolescents'  no nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso atu mpɔn no asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ mpɔtam hɔfo de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ne nnwuma ahorow pii a wɔbom yɛ so dua. Asuadeɛ a yɛasua no bi ne hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛdi mmabun ahiadeɛ nyinaa ho dwuma,tumi a wɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, ne mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ fekubɔ a ɛwɔ aban, 'NGO', ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan anaa dwumadie ahorow bi a mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu wɔ mmere a wɔwɔ adwennwen anaa dadwen a emu yɛ den mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmere a adwennwen anaa dadwen a emu yɛ den mu no, mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome mu de hyɛ kommyɛ ne yiyedi ho nkuran. Ebia eyinom bi ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde home a emu dɔ, ntini a wɔde gye wɔn ahome nkakrankakra, mfonini a wɔkyerɛ kwan, nsɛmma nhoma a wɔkyerɛw, anaa bere a wɔde tra abɔde mu. Dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigyie ne ahomegye ba, te sɛ nnwom a wotie, nnwom, mfoniniyɛ, anaa yoga a wubenya no nso betumi aboa ma adwennwen so atew na ama asomdwoe ate nka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ no betumi adi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma sikasɛm mu tumidi ho dwuma, te sɛ nyiyim, sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wonnya, ne adwuma hokwan a enni hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankorɛ nnwumakuo ne amansan nnwumakuo nkabom bɛtumi atew ɔhaw a ɛsi akwan no so. Wɔbɛtumi ayɛ eyi denam mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma obiara nya kwan fua, obu, ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ wɔ adwumayɛ mu, sika mmoa mu, ne adwumahwehwɛ mu. WWɔbɛtumi nso akasa de apia ama nsesaeɛ aba aban mmara ne ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na wɔayere nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ nnipa biase afiri hɔ, na wɔayɛ baabi pa a obiara bɛtumi anya sika mu mfasoɔ ne nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo tu de kura kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm mu bere a wɔrehwɛ mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam mmeae a wɔbɛma wɔabisabisa nkorɔfo nsɛm na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu. Ɛlektrɔnik akwahosan ho nkrataa nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma ne kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛkora so. Mmabun pene a wobenya ansa na wɔde wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm akyerɛ obiara, a awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn ka ho, gye sɛ mmara hwehwɛ anaasɛ wɔ nsɛm a ɛreba a ɛbɛpira wɔn no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusu ho bere a merepaw ayaresabea a woyi nyinsɛn gu no? (tumi krataa, ahwehwɛde, ayarefo nhwehwɛmu) .
answer_twi_source: kɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa mmabun akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn na ɔmfa wo nkɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow a woyi nyinsɛn gu a ahobammɔ wom no ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bɛn na ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo ho mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔtete nhwehwɛmufo ma wodi ɔhaw yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo ho no bi ne: Mpene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo nya pene a wofi wɔn pɛ mu, a wɔde nimdeɛ ma fi mmabun ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn hɔ, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no te nhwehwɛmu no atirimpɔw, asiane ahorow, ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ so no ase. Ahintasɛm ne kokoam nsɛm: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo bɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho ban denam data a wɔde sie yiye ne nsɛm a wɔmmɔ wɔn din so na amma wɔanhu wɔn. Ɔhaw a wɔbɛtew so: Ɛsɛsɛ nhwehwɛmufo tew ɔhaw a ebetumi aba wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no so denam akwan a ɛnyɛ nhyɛso a wɔfa so gye nnipa, mmoa a wɔde ma, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ mmeae a ɛfata a wɔde bɛma no so. Amammerɛ mu nkateɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufoɔ bu amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ berɛ a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu, hwɛ sɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no fata amammerɛ na ɛkyerɛ obuo ma mpɔtam hɔ gyidie ne nneyɛeɛ. Nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so: Nhwehwɛmu abrabɔ pa ho boayikuo ne ahyehyɛdeɛ nhwehwɛmu bagua hwɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadiɛ so de hwɛ sɛ wɔdi abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne gyinapɛn so, na wɔde ɔhwɛ ne akwankyerɛ ma nhwehwɛmufoɔ wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobetumi aka nhwɛso ahorow a efi w’ankasa osuahu ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea wodi atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho dwuma ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Meserɛw, mintumi nkyɛ m’ankasa osuahu ahorow, nanso metumi de nhwɛso ahorow a ɛyɛ nsusuwii hunu anaa anansesɛm ahorow ama de akyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobetumi adi atipɛnfo nhyɛso so yiye. Nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛyɛ nsusuwii hunu a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobedi atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho dwuma ni: Tebea 1: Nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma Wowɔ apontow bi ase, na wo nnamfo fi ase kyɛ nsa. Ɛmfa ho sɛ wote nka sɛ wompɛ sɛ wobɛnom nsa no, wotwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkasa efisɛ wompɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ te sɛ nea wo ne no nyɛ adwene anaa sɛ montɛm nnwo. Nanso, wokae wo bo a woasi sɛ wobɛma w’adwene mu da hɔ na wusi gyinae sɛ wode nidi bɛpow anonne no, na woka sɛ, "Meda wo ase, nanso merepaw sɛ merennom anadwo yi." Tebea 2: Adesua ase a wonkɔ ase na wo nnamfo ahyɛ sɛ nkɔ beaeɛ a wɔrekyerɛ adeɛ na kɔbɔ fekuw wɔ aguadidan mu mmom. Wobu wo nhomasua sɛ ɛsom bo na wunim sɛ adesua a wobɛtum no betumi aha wommɛdenbɔ. Woda wo haw ahorow adi kyerɛ wo nnamfo, na woka sɛ, "Ɛsɛ sɛ mede madwene si madesua so ankasa nnɛ. Momma yɛnkɔ akyiri." Tebea 3: Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so Nhyɛso, W’atipɛnfo hyɛ wo sɛ fa wo ho hyɛ social media so nneɛma a ɛtrɛw a ɛfa nneyɛe a asiane wom ho mu. Ɛmfa ho sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔsɔ wo hwɛ sɛ wobɛka wo ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛfata no, wuhu asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba na wusi gyinae sɛ wobɛpaw sɛ wobɛkɔ, na woka sɛ, "Mempɛ sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ asɛnnennen yi mu. Minsusuw sɛ ɛfata sɛ wode wo ho to asiane mu." Tebea 4: Adesua mu Nokwaredi, Wo mfɛfo sukuufo yɛ adwene ne sɛ wonsisi sɔhwɛ bi mu na ama wɔn wɔn mmɔ. Wokyerɛkyerɛ wo gyinabea mu, na woka sɛ, "Mepɛ sɛ menam mankasa mmɔdenbɔ so nya me abasobɔde. Nsisi ne me gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia." Wɔ tebea biara mu no, onipa no hu nhyɛso a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn anaa wɔn botae ahorow bɔ abira mu. Wɔyi ano yie, na wɔde wɔn yiyedi di kan, na wɔka wɔn ahye ho asɛm yiye. Saa nhwɛso ahorow yi da sɛnea wotumi gyina ano bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye no adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa akuo a wɔboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Hokwan Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Ebia saa akuw yi benya nsɛm a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ mmoa akuw a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ intanɛt so mpɔtam anaa nhyiamu a ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho (fa adwempa di dwuma ɛnam anohyetoɔ a ɛbɛtumi aba nti). . Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Adwumayɛfo: Ebia ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo a wonim dɛmdi ho nsɛm benya nyansahyɛ ahorow ama akuw a wɔboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ manya nna mu ateetee a broni ka no 'abuse' anaa basabasayɛ a, hena na metumi ne no akasa?
answer_twi_source: Ɔpanyin a wogye no di: Oyi betumi ayɛ ɔwofo, ɔhwɛfo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, anaa ɔpanyin foforo a wote nka sɛ woho tɔ wo. Wobetumi atie wo, aboa wo, na wɔaboa wo ma woanya nneɛma a wode bɛyɛ adwuma. wubetumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn mmabun a ɔwɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn hɔ no akasa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahooden bɛn na ɛwɔ abusua nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow mu a ɛboa mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Mma a wɔnyini wɔ awofoɔ baako abusua mu no tumi hyɛ wɔn ho so na wɔnya ahoɔden, mmerɛ a abusuasanten nso tumi de mmoa kɛseɛ ne mpanyinsɛm pa ma. Abusua a wɔaka abom (Blended families) boa ma Nkabom. Abusua nketewa (Nuclear families) ma Ahotɔ. Abusua biara wɔ ahooden a ɛde boa mmabun (dɛmdifoɔ ka ho).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na sikasɛm mu ahokyere, a bɔtom kabɔ, ɛboɔ, kar ho ka, ne sika a wɔhwere ka ho, ha tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata wɔ bere ano?
answer_twi_source: Ebia mmabun a wofi mmusua a wonnya sika pii mu bɛpere sɛ wobetua akwahosan ho adwuma esiane ɛka kɛse a wɔbɔ nti, a nea ɛka ho ne ka a wɔbɔ wɔ ayaresa ho, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu yare, nnuru, ne ayaresa ho ka. Ka a akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow gye wɔ wɔn a wɔhwe wɔn  ho no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛnya ɔhwɛ, titiriw wɔ nnwuma a wɔde siw ano anaa tebea horow a ɛnyɛ ntɛmpɛ ho, na ɛde ayaresa a ɛkyɛ anaasɛ wɔkwati akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia. Kar ho ka: Mmabun a wɔte nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu esiane akwantu akwanside ahorow nti, a nea ɛka ho ne akwantu a ne bo nyɛ den a wonni, akwan tenten, anaa akwan a ɛnyɛ papa. Sika a wɔhwere: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ no taa hwehwɛ sɛ mmabun anaa wɔn abusua mufo gye akwamma fi adwuma anaa sukuu mu, na ɛde sika a wɔhwere, adwumayɛ so tew, anaasɛ nhomasua hokwan ahorow a wɔhwere, titiri ma adwumayɛfo a wɔnyɛ nhyehyɛe anaasɛ wɔn a wonya dɔnhwerew biara akatua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de kasa a ɛfa obiara ho adi dwuma bere a me ne nnipa a wofi mmusua ahorow mu reka nna ne abusuabɔ ho asɛm no?
answer_twi_source: Fa neutral terms te sɛ "ɔhokafo" di dwuma sen sɛ wode "boyfriend/girlfriend" bedi dwuma. Kwati sɛ wobɛfa no sɛ obiara yɛ heterosexual anaa cisgender (ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔne awo mu ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna). Fa nsɛmfua a amammerɛ gye tom di dwuma ma nipadua akwaa ne nna mu nneyɛe. Sɛ wonnim a, bisa! "Asɛmfua bɛn na wopɛ?" kyerɛ sɛ wodwen wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuasoɔ a efi mmabun a wɔbara wɔn kwan ma nya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no mu ba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔbara mmabun kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a, ebetumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba. Ebetumi ama: - nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ nnim no dodow akɔ soro. - a wotwentwɛn so sɛ wɔbɛhunu nna mu yare 'STIs' na wɔasa. - a wobetumi anya nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, a ɛde nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ba ne asiane a ɛkɔ soro wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow mu. - a enya nsusuaso bɔne wɔ mmabun nipadua ne adwene mu yiyedi so esiane mmoa ne nneɛma a wonni nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ wɔn adwuma mu asɛde ne wɔn nhomasua botae ne wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ adwuma mu asɛde ne nhomasua botae ahorow mu denam: Nhomasua a wɔde bedi kan: Adwuma nnɔnhwerew a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhyehyɛe atwa adesua bere, ne sɔhwɛ ho ahwɛ ahu sɛ adesua mu nkonimdi da so ara yɛ ade titiriw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so. Ahyeɛto: Nkitahodi a wɔne adwumawuranom bedi nkitaho wɔ adesua mu bɔhyɛ ahorow ne hyeɛto ahorow a ɛwɔ adwumayɛ nnɔnhwerew mu ho de asiw ntawntawdi ano na wɔadi akwanhwɛ ahorow ho dwuma. Bere nhyehyɛe: Bere nhyehyɛe ho akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de akyekyɛ bere a ɛdɔɔso ama adwuma ne adesua nyinaa, a nhyehyɛe a wobedi kan ayɛ na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛtwentwɛn so ka ho. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ: Nneɛma te sɛ adesua ho afotufoɔ, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔakari pɛ wɔ adwuma ne nwomasua ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ pa bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akannifo anaa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ si LGBTQ+ ankorankoro so dua na wɔboa wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuw bɔɔ LGBTQ+ a ɛne amansan mmara nhyia ho ban sɛnea wɔn gyidi atitire ne nneyɛe nnyinaso kyerɛ no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ sika fam mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nhomasua ne ntetee mu no so?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛwɔ sika fam mmoa a wonya de boa nhomasua ne ntetee so no dɔɔso: Nhomasua a wobenya a ɛkɔ soro: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow ma mmabun tumi tua adesua ho ka, nhomasua nneɛma, ne ɛka afoforo a ɛbata nhomasua a ɛkɔ anim anaa adwumayɛ ho ntetee ho. Sikasɛm mu adesoa a ɛso tew: Sika fam mmoa betumi abrɛ sikasɛm mu ahokyere a ɛwɔ mmusua ne ankorankoro so no ase, na ama wɔde wɔn adwene asi wɔn adesua so na wɔadi wɔn nhomasua botae ahorow akyi a wonhaw wɔn ho wɔ sikasɛm mu ahokyere ho. Hokwan ahorow a ɛkɔ anim: Ɛdenam nhomasua ne ntetee a mmabun nya so no, wobetumi anya ahokokwaw, nimdeɛ, ne adansedi nkrataa a ɛma wotumi yɛ adwuma, sika a wobetumi anya, ne sikasɛm mu anidaso a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ. Ohia kyinhyia a wobegyae: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔagyae ohia kyinhyia no denam nneɛma ne hokwan ahorow a wohia a wɔde bɛma wɔn na ama wɔn asetra ne sikasɛm tebea atu mpɔn na wɔanya sikasɛm mu ahofadi no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na me nufoɔ/bo reyɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Nkwammoaa te sɛ estrogen ne testosterone ma nsakrae ba bere a obi renyin no. Eyi yɛ ade a ɛfata. Ebia mmarimaa koko bɛhonhon bere tiaa bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow bɛn na ɛka adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, ne nna mu dwumadi ho wɔ atubrafo "migrant" ne nnipa kakraa bi mpɔtam hɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyinom yɛ soronko wɔ ɔmanfo gyinapɛn atitiriw ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛwɔ atubrafo ne nnipa kakraa bi mu no nya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, ne nna ho so nkɛntɛnso. Ebia nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, atetesɛm mu nneyɛe "traditional practices", abusua nhyehyɛe, ne mpɔtam hɔ akwanhwɛ na ɛbɛhyehyɛ saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ebia mpɔtam binom de nneɛma a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho bedi kan ansa na wɔaware, bere a afoforo nso betumi asi hia a abusua ne awo ho hia so dua. Amammerɛ mu nsɛm nketenkete yi a wɔbɛte ase na wɔabu no ho hia ma nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛfata ne amammerɛ mu nneɛma a ɛfata ama mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne mmabun nketewa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun a wɔyem atumi anya awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nsɛm sɛ wɔresusuw saa nneɛma a wɔpaw no ho ara ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho akwan horow ho denam apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow, mmeae a wɔboa nyinsɛn, ahomatrofo a wɔde boa, ne abɛɛfo ntetan intanɛt so nneɛma so. Wobetumi ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa wɔn a wɔkasa ama akwankyerɛ kyerɛ nso asusuw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhefa na metumi anya kokoam mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrepere wɔ adwenemyare ho? (ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Kokoam mmoa akuw ne intanɛt so mpɔtam wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrepere wɔ adwenemyare ho. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛtwe adwene si adwenemyare ne nna mu apɔmuden nyinaa so. "Hotlines: kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bi wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm ho nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517".
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asane bɛn na ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa (STIs) mu ma  ankorankoro wɔdi nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiw ano?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ ankorankoro wɔ asane mu sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ɛwɔ nna mu dwumadi so, a anom, trumu, ne sɛ bi ɔbea ɛtwɛ mu nna ka ho. Kɔndɔm ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw akwanside ano, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, ne ɔyere biako anaa nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔne wɔn ahokafo yɛ no betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ no so. Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) yɛ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw HIV nyarewa ano na wɔkamfo kyerɛ ma ankorankoro a asane kɛse wom, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro bi ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusua mufo, ne mpanyimfo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so abɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu abue a egyina adanse so a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nsɛmti ho de akasa atia nsɛm a ɛnteɛ na wɔama ntease a edi mu anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusua mufo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di abɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu abue a egyina adanse so a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nsɛmti ho de akasa atia nsɛm a ɛnteɛ na wɔahyɛ ntease a edi mu ho nkuran. Wobetumi afi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase denam nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a wobenya afi mmeae a agye din a wɔbɛkyɛ, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne adwenem naayɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmu a wɔbɛma wɔabɔ nkɔmmɔ, ne nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu pefee anaa nsɛm foforo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Afotu adwuma ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, na nsɛm anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene bɛn na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Afotuo pii wɔ hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ankorankoro Afotuo: Nhyiamu a wɔne ɔfotufoɔ yɛ mmiako mmiako de di ankorankoro haw ho dwuma na wɔhwehwɛ nkateɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Kuw mu Afotu: Kuw nhyiam ahorow a mmabun betumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow, asua biribi afi wɔn atipɛnfo hɔ, na wɔanya mmoa wɔ kuw tebea a wɔboa mu. Abusua Afotuo: Abusua mufoɔ a wɔde wɔn bɛka afotuo nhyiamu ho de adi abusua mu nkɔsoɔ, nkitahodiɛ, ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwuma. Intanɛt so Afotu: Virtual afotu nhyiam ahorow denam nkɔmmɔbɔ, telefon, anaa video so ma wɔn a wɔpɛ akyirikyiri kwan. Afotuo dwumadie tumi di nsɛm ne haw ahodoɔ pii ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna mu nipasu ne nea ɛkyerɛ ne ho Abusuabɔ ne dating Mpene ne ahyeɛ Nyinsɛn mu akwan ne gyinaesie STI a wɔsiw ano ne ne di Nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔde di dwuma ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so Nipadua mfonini ne obuo a obi wɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi so dua anaa ahu sɛ manyinsɛn, na akwan horow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔfa so yɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Fie Nyinsɛn Ho Nhwehwɛmu: Wobetumi anya bi a wɔmfa nnuru nhyɛ mu, na saa nhwehwɛmu ahorow yi hu nyinsɛn mu nkwaadɔm 'hormones' a ɛwɔ nsu mu. Di akwankyerɛ ahorow no akyi yiye na ama woanya nea efi mu ba no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mogya mu Nhwehwɛmu: Mogya mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo adwumayɛbea nso betumi akyerɛ sɛ wanyinsɛn, efisɛ ɛma wohu nyinsɛn mu nkwaadɔm a ɛwɔ mogya no mu. 'Ultrasound': 'Ultrasound' betumi ama aniwa ahu sɛ woanyinsɛn na woabu baabi a wo ne no akɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so de mpɔtam ahorow di dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma ɛne nnipa ahorow ahiade soronko adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so de mpɔtam ahorow adi nkitaho wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ho no bi ne: Nkrasɛm ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ a ɛne nnipa ahorow gyinapɛn, gyidi, ne osuahunu ahorow hyia. Nkitahodi a wɔne mpɔtam akannifo, ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso a wobetumi aboa ma wɔakyekyɛ nsɛm, anya ahotoso, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano. Nkitahodi akwan ne akwan horow a wɔde bedi dwuma, a sohyial media, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔbea ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ pɔtee bi ho ka ho. Nkitahodi ne kyɛfa a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ abasɛm, adwinni, nnwom, ne drama a wɔde bɛka ho, na ama atiefo ahorow ahorow agye wɔn adwene na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuran. Kasa nkyerɛase a wɔde bɛma, dabere a wobetumi anya, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfo akɔ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa kɛse no nkyɛn. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi sɛ wɔmfa mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw ano no nyɛ wɔn dea denam wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa akuw anaa afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔagyina nkate ne adwene mu afã horow a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu no ano?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmoa akuw ne afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔagyina nkate ne adwene mu afã horow a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu no ano. Saa dwumadie yi betumi ayɛ kokoam telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ, intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ mmoa, afotuo a wɔne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn, ne mmoa akuo a mmabun bɛtumi ne afoforo a wɔanya osuahu a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhwɛ a wɔaka abom ma nna mu nyarewa (STI) anaa "HIV" ano aduru ne nhomasua a wobenya ama nnipa a wonnya mmoa yiye, te sɛ "LGBTQ+" mmerante ne mmabaa anaa mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no tu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a wɔaka abom ma kwan a wɔfa so nya nna mu nyarewa (STI)anaa "HIV" siw ano ne nkyerɛkyerɛ tu mpɔn ma nnipa a wonnya mmoa yiye denam: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛma aba so: Ɔhwɛ tebea a wɔaka abom a ɛde amammerɛ mu ahoɔden, nkate a ɛfa nneɛma ahorow ho, ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ di kan no ma ahotoso ne wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ "LGBTQ+" mmabun ne mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua a ebia wobehyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim wɔ atetesɛm akwahosan tebea horow mu no mu. Nnwuma a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata ahiade soronko: Ɔhwɛ ho nhyehyɛe a wɔaka abom ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔde nnwuma titiriw ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so a ɛfa akwahosan ho asiane pɔtee ne haw ahorow a ɛwɔ nnipa a wonnya mmoa no ho, te sɛ "LGBTQ+" ɔhwɛ a ɛfoa so, afotu a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm, anaa kasa nkyerɛase dwumadie ma. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ fekubɔ a wɔbɛkyekyere: Ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔaka abom no taa fa adwumayɛkuo a wɔne ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ, akuo a wɔkamfo wɔn ho, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔde abusuabɔ ne ahotosoɔ asi hɔ wɔ mpɔtam a wɔnsom no yie mu, a ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔka wɔn, wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, na wɔanya nnwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne 'ovulation' (nkosua-gu), na ɛba mmere bɛn wɔ kyima (menstrual cycle) mmere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkosua-gu (ovulation) ne mmere a nkosua a ɛmabun firi ɔbaa nkosua-dan mu. Mpɛn pii no, eyi kɔ so wɔ kyima (menstruation) mmere no mfinimfini, bɛyɛ nnafua dunan (14) ansa na kyima a ɛreba no ahyɛ aseɛ. Ɔkwan a ɛfa so: Wɔ nkosua-gu mmere mu no, nkosua-dan no yi nkosua baako a ɛmabun kɔ 'fallopian tube' no mu kɔ awotwaa (uterus) no mu. Sɛ nkosua yi ne mmarima ho nsuo (sperm) hyia na ɛyɛ yie a, ɛneɛ nyem (pregnancy) bɛba. Sɛ ɛne mmarima ho nsuo anhyia a, nkosua no bɔne na awotwaa no ho nwiwiriwii (lining) no siesie ne ho sɛ ɛbɛpue kyima beremu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di kokoamsɛm ho haw ne ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe a, wɔbɛyɛ ama mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wɔbɛbɔ bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) ho amanneɛ no ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wode kokoamsɛm sie bere a worebɔ bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) ho amanneɛ no. Hotlines ne mmoa dwumadie renkyɛ wo ho nsɛm a wo mpene so (gye ebinom, te sɛ asiane a wobɛbɔ wo ho amanneɛ akyerɛ wo ho anaa afoforo). Ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Frɛ fi baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ: Hwɛ hu sɛ wowɔ baabi a obiara ntumi nte wo nkɔmmɔbɔ no. Yɛ ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛe: Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di anaa ɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ nhyehyɛe a wode bɛkɔ so anya ahobammɔ ho asɛm. Kyerɛw ayayade no: Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, yɛ nsɛm biara a esisii ho kyerɛwtohɔ, a nna, mmere, ne nea esii no ho nsɛm ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsono hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde kokoamsɛm sie wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe mu, te sɛ: Tebea ahorow a ɛhaw adwene wɔ ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho. Mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa tebea anaa nneyɛe bi a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ, te sɛ STI anaa nyinsɛn a mmofra nkumaa mu. Asɛnnibea ahyɛde anaa mmara kwan so asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm adi
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛfa ahye ahorow a ɛfa nipadua ahofadi ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mihu?
answer_twi_source: Ahye ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne sɛ wubesi nea obetumi de ne nsa aka wo nipadua ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so asi gyinae, wode w’ankasa ahunmu ahye besi hɔ, na wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka dabi wɔ honam fam nkitahodi biara a ɛma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee ne nnwuma a ɛtrɛw a wɔde asi wɔn ani so, sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nkuran na wɔatew mmabun adwuma a wonnya nyɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee ne nnwuma a ɛtrɛw a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nkuran na wɔatew mmabun adwuma a wonnya nyɛ so denam: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya adwuma a wɔde bɛma: Nhyehyɛe ahorow boa mmabun ma wonya adwumayɛ mu osuahu, nya nimdeɛ, na wɔkyekye adwumayɛfo nkitahodi a ɛma wɔn adwumayɛ ne sika a wobenya no yɛ kɛse. Ohia kyinhyia a wobegyae (Breaking Poverty Cycle): Ɛdenam ahokokwaw ne nneɛma a wohia a wɔde ma mmabun na ama wɔanya adwuma a ɛyɛ den so no, nnwuma a wɔyɛ no boa ma sikasɛm mu ahotɔ ne sikasɛm mu ahotɔ bere tenten. Nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma: Nneɛma a wɔayɛ no botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛdi nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ a ɛmma adwumayɛ ho dwuma, te sɛ nwomasua a wɔnnya, nyiyim, ne sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ, na ama mmabun nyinaa anya hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena mu nneɛma bi te sɛ sigaretnom, nsanom, ne nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma, a ebetumi aka nyinsɛn mu aba, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛwɔ Nyinsɛn So: Sigaretnom: Ɛma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛwo awo ntɛm, awo mu duru a ɛba fam, ne awo mu dɛmdi yɛ kɛse. Sigaretnom a wobegyae no ho hia kɛse na ama nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom. Nsã: Ebetumi ama awotwaa mu nsa a ɛyɛ den (FASDs), adwene mu dɛmdi, ne onyin ho haw ahorow aba. Kwati nsa koraa bere a wonyinsɛn no. Nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Nnuru a mmara mma ho kwan betumi anya awotwaa no nyin so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Hwehwɛ mmoa na woagyae nnubɔnenom ntɛm ara bere a woahu sɛ woanyinsɛn no. Address: Gyae Sigaretnom: Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde gyae sigaretnom ne mmoa ho. Kwati Nsã: Kwati nsa koraa bere a woanyinsɛn no. Gyae Nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu na ama woagyae nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔka mmoa akuw anaa afotu ho de di nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho dwuma. Nneɛma a Ɛfa Akwahosan Ho: Hwehwɛ akwan foforo a wobɛfa so agyina adwennwen anaa dadwen ano, te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, nsusuwii, anaa ayaresa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ meka kyerɛ m’ahokafo a me ne wɔn da sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ STI a? (hyɛ asɛyɛde a wɔda no adi ho nkuran) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wowɔ STI a, ɛho hia sɛ wobɔ wo nna mu ahokafo (wɔn) amanneɛ. Wɔfrɛ eyi sɛ asɛyɛde a wɔda no adi na ɛboa ma wɔasiw nyarewa a ɛtrɛw ano. Nea enti a ɛho hia ni: Ɛbɔ Wo Mhokafo Ho Ban: Sɛ wohu yare no ntɛm na wosa yare a, ebetumi asiw apɔwmuden ho nsɛnnennen a emu yɛ den ano ama wo hokafo no. Siw Ntrɛwmu Kɔ akyiri Siw: Sɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ ntɛm ara a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔagyae nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɛde nsɛm no kɔ no. Kyerɛ Obu: Sɛ woka nokware na woka w’ahokafo pefee a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ wudi obu ma wɔn apɔwmuden. W’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so akɔ ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛbɔ nkyɛn. Wobetumi de ahokafo amanneɛbɔ adwuma a wɔmmɔ din ama sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wo ne no bedi nkitaho tẽẽ a. Kae: Sɛ wobɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu na woasa wo ho wɔ STI ho a, ɛyɛ gyinaesi a ɛyɛ asɛyɛde a ɛbɔ wo ne w’ahokafo ho ban. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi apɔwmuden ho ɔbenfo a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nyiyim a egyina STI tebea so ɛfwɔ mmeae te sɛ adwumayɛ, nhomasua, ne adan ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae bi no, mmara bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI) ho ban, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obiara ntumi ntan wɔn anaa ɔnhyɛ wɔn so wɔ adwumayɛ mu, sukuu kɔ mu, anaa baabi a obi bɛtena. Saa mmara yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛsi kwan na nnipa ammu wɔn a wɔwɔ saa yareɛ yi animtiasɛe anaa wɔanyi wɔn amfi nnipakuo mu. Nanso, saa mmara yi mu kyereɛ betumi asesa kɛseɛ gyina mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ ɔman anaa mantam biara mu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔboa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ nnwuma a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm, mmoa, ne nneɛma bɛma ankorankoro a wɔwɔ mpɔtam bi mu. Wɔde wɔn adwene asi mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) so titiriw, na nhyehyɛe ahorow yi botae ne sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ, ama wɔn tumi, na wɔaboa mmerante ne mmabaa ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho. Wɔtaa yɛ adwuma wɔ atetesɛm akwahosan tebea horow akyi, du mmabun nkyɛn wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, mmabun akuw,beae a ɛhɔ yɛ hyew, ne afie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛyɛde bɛn na ɛwɔ abofra a wɔbɛtete no mu? (nkate fam, sikasɛm, bere mu ahofama) .
answer_twi_source: Nkate fam: Ɔdɔ, mmoa, ne akwankyerɛ a wode bɛma wo ba no ma wanya nkate fam yiyedi. Sikasɛm: Wo ba ahiade atitiriw te sɛ aduan, ntade, dabere, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wubedi ho dwuma. Bere a Wɔde Bɛma: Abofra ntetee hwehwɛ bere ne adwene a ɛho hia kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua pii afa peneeɛ ne nkitahodie a ɛyɛ papa wɔ abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Sukuu pii de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ma. Wɛbsaet ne Apps: Wɛbsaet te sɛ nea broni ka no'Planned Parenthood, Scarleteen, anaa Amaze' de nneɛma bi ma. Apps te sɛ nea broni ka no 'YMK ne "iConsent"' ma nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho. Ntrɛwmu: Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ National Sexual Assault Hotline de mmoa ma. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a mfaso wɔ so Mpɔtam Hɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ne nyamesom akuw betumi de nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔahu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm a epira na wɔaboa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛfata na ɛyɛ nokware?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun tumi ma wɔpaapae na wɔkasa tia nsɛm a epira wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu, na ɛma wonya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, tema, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho nimdeɛ. Ɛdenam nsusuwii hunu, animhwɛ, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wogye ho kyim so no, mmabun betumi akamfo nnipa a wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa ne osuahu ahorow wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ho mfonini a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛka obiara ho, na egu ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsa ne nnubɔne ka pene ne nkitahodi wɔ nna mu nkitahodi 'sexual consent' mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛe: Nsa ne nnubɔne betumi asɛe atemmu ne gyinaesi.Asiane betumi aba sɛ obi bɛda a wɔmmɔ ho ban na nea efi mu ba te sɛ nna mu nyare 'STIs', ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyehyɛ. Mpene a Wɔde Amanneɛ Ma: nsa a wɔnom (asanom ne nsa a wɔnom) betumi asiw pene a wɔde ma pefee na wɔde nimdeɛ ahyɛ mu no ano. Asiane a Ɛwɔ Nhyɛso Mu: Ebia nkurɔfo de ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm bedi dwuma. Ahwɛyiye: Kwati nna mu dwumadi bere a woabow nsa na ama woanya nkitahodi a emu da hɔ na wɔpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn din?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ na wohwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ efisɛ saa a wobɛyɛ no betumi ama woanya mmoa, atɛntrenee, ne ayaresa. Amanneɛbɔ ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no nya ayaresa, afotu, ne mmara kwan so mmoa, bere a wɔma wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no nso bu wɔn nneyɛe ho akontaa. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ no yɛ anammɔn titiriw a ɛbɛma wɔn ho atɔ wɔn na ebetumi ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no tumi asan anya wɔn asetena so tumi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mete nka sɛ wɔhyɛ me sɛ mɛyɛ nea m’atipɛnfo hwɛ kwan anaasɛ mehwehwɛ sɛ mɛgye atom denam nneyɛe a asiane wom so, te sɛ afotu adwuma, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne nkuranhyɛ ama?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wo ne atipɛnfo akwanhwɛ hyia anaasɛ wohwehwɛ sɛ wogye tom denam nneyɛe a asiane wom so a, nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow pii wɔ hɔ ma wo: Afotu adwuma: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi sukuu afotufo, adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, anaa ayaresa ho animdefo a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne nkate fam mmoa ama de akɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso so na woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo: Wo ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo anaa mmabun nnwumakuo a ɛma ahotɔ ne nteaseɛ beaeɛ a wɔde bɛkyɛ osuahu, ahwehwɛ afotuo, na wɔanya nkuranhyɛ afiri atipɛnfoɔ a wɔrehyia ɔhaw a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di: Kɔ mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo anaa afotufo nkyɛn, a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, awerɛhyem, ne nkuranhyɛ ama ma wɔako atia nsunsuanso bɔne na woasi gyinae ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo yiyedi hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛe a etu mpɔn a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a LGBTQ+ mmabun betumi de ahyɛ wɔn da biara da asetra mu de ahyɛ adwene mu yiyedi ho nkuran pa?
