answer_twi_source: Adwene mu Nsusuwii ne Ahomegye Ho Akwan: Fa adwene mu nsusuwii, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a emu dɔ a wɔde home, anaa ntini mu ahomegye a ɛkɔ so nkakrankakra di dwuma na ama adwennwen so atew na ama woanya ahomegye. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Fa wo ho hyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu daa, te sɛ nantew, yoga, anaa asaw, na ama wo adwene atu mpɔn, atew dadwen so, na ama woanya obu ama wo ho. Adebɔ mu Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Da wo ho adi denam adebɔ ho akwan te sɛ adwinni, nnwom, anaa akyerɛw so, a ebetumi ayɛ cathartic akwan a wɔfa so da ho adi na wogyae nkate mu. Su a Ɛma Akwahosan: Fa dwumadi ahorow a wode hwɛ wo ho te sɛ nna a ɛfata, nnuan a ahoɔden wom a wubedi, ne nsu a wobɛkɔ so anya de aboa adwene ne nipadua mu yiyedi nyinaa di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hena na osi nsɛmti a wɔde ka nna ne awo akwahosan ho adesua ho gyinae, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wosi gyinae ahorow yi? Mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ adesua nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, nwomasua ho mmara-yɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ-yɛfoɔ, ne akuo a ɛhia te sɛ aban adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ, apomuden nnwumakuo, ne mmoa-kuo na wɔsisi gyinaeɛ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛba nna ne awogyeɛ ho apomuden nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Saa gyinaesie kwan yi bɛtumi agye afutuo afiri animdefoɔ a wɔhwɛ mmerante ne mmabaa apomuden ho, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, na ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a mmerante ne mmabaa no ankasa hɔ. Ɛwom sɛ ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na mmerante ne mmabaa no ankasa nya kwan de wɔn nsa si nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ so tɛɛ deɛ, nanso mmerɛ biara wɔreyɛ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn adwene abom nso denam mpasabuasuo, nsɛmbisa krataa, ne mmabun ankasa mmoa-kuo ahodoɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuwii hunu, anansesɛm, ne atorɔ adwene a wɔtaa de kɔ so wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ho mu, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahu na yɛakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho taa ma nsusuwii hunu, anansesɛm, ne atorɔ adwene  kɔ so tra hɔ, te sɛ: Bɔbeasu ho gyinapɛn ahorow: Atetesɛm mu dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ho a wɔhyɛ mu den. Nna mu nneyɛe: Suban ahorow bi a wɔde bata abrabɔ pa anaa asetra mu dibea ho. STI ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw: Ankorankoro a wogyina wɔn nna mu akwahosan tebea so bu wɔn animtiaa. Mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia saa nsusuwii hunu ahorow yi denam nea ɛyɛ nokware a wobegye ho kyim na wɔakamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛka obiara ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw, ahotoso, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano de akasa atia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, animhwɛ, ne nyiyim wɔ adwumam na wɔama amammerɛ a ɛfa obu, nnipa ahorow ahorow, ne nnipa a wɔka ho ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw, ahotoso, ne ahoɔden a wɔde bɛkasa atia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, animhwɛ, ne nyiyim wɔ adwumam denam: Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ animhwɛ a wonnim, mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, ne nhyehyɛe mu nyiyim ho. Wɔn nkitahodi, nkitahodi, ne asɛm a wɔka no denneennen ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyekye de akamfo wɔn ho ne afoforo. Hwehwɛ afotufoɔ ne nhwɛsoɔ a wɔda akannifoɔ a wɔka obiara ho adi na wɔboa wɔn adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ. Atipɛnfoɔ ne ayɔnkofoɔ a wɔkyɛ wɔn botaeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne adwumayɛbea mu atɛntrenee ho no nkitahodiɛ a ɛboa a wɔbɛkyekyere. Wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho mu de adi adwennwen ho dwuma, agyina akwanside ahorow ano, na wɔakura wɔn yiyedi mu bere a wɔkamfo nsakrae kyerɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛnya ahotosoɔ ne gyedie wɔ mmeaɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa a ɛkasa fa nna ne awoɔ apɔmden ho?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mmaeɛ a wo wɔ mu gyedie bi te sɛ wiase apɔmden nkabomkuo a wɔtwa no tia kase 'WHO' ne GHS. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi dɔkotafoɔ anaa afutufoɔ hɔ. Wobetumi adwene ho yie anaa sɛ ma woani nna hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɔhaw ho afotuo dwumadie no yɛ "LGBTQ+"-a ɛka obiara ho na ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ɛhunu na ɛsi mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔfiri mmusua ahodoɔ mu nipasu ahodoɔ, wɔn suahunu, ne wɔn ahiadeɛ so dua?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+-Nnwuma a ɛka obiara ho na ɛfa amammerɛ ho: Ɔhaw mu afotuo dwumadie bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛyɛ "LGBTQ+"-a ɛka ho na ɛfa amammerɛ ho, a ɛhunu na ɛsi mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔfiri mmusua ahodoɔ mu nipasu ahodoɔ, wɔn suahunu, ne wɔn ahiadeɛ so dua. Afotufoɔ nya nteteeɛ wɔ "LGBTQ+" nsɛm ne amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho de ma ɔhwɛ a ɛsi so dua na ɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nna mu apɔwmuden ho nhwehwɛmu yɛ de boa nna mu agodie ho nsɛm, STI ahorow a wosiw ano, ne awoɔ mu haw ahorow a wohu ntɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu agodie ho nhwehwɛmu ho hia na ama nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm anya nkɔsoɔ denam: STI a wosiw ano: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa boa ma wohu nyarewa ntɛm, na ɛma wotumi sa yareɛ ntɛm sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ ɛnnkɔ afoforo so. Sɛ obi hu ne STI tebea a, ɛhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho nkuran, a kɔndɔm a wɔde bedi dwuma ne nkitahodi a wɔne ahokafo di ka ho. Awo Akwahosan Ho Dadwen a Wobehu: Nhwehwɛmu betumi w'ahu awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm te sɛ awotoa mu kokoram, Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID), anaa boninyareɛ (infertility), na wode wɔn ho ahyɛ mu ntɛm na w'adi ho dwuma. Ankorankoro a Wɔma Wɔn Tumi: Ɛdenam wɔn nna mu tebea a wobehu so no, ankorankoro betumi asi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne awoɔ daakye ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono ɔkwan a egyina  akwannya ahorow so wɔ akwan afoforo a wɔfa so di nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛnte sɛ akwan afoforo a ebia wɔde wɔn adwene besi aduruyɛ ho nnwuma anaa nneyɛe a wɔde sesa nneyɛe nkutoo so no, ɔkwan a egyina akwannya ahorow so de mmabun si gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow no mfinimfini na egye tom sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nnwuma a edi mu, nsɛm, ne nhomasua. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔma mmabun tumi ma si nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne nna ho, a nhyɛso, nyiyim, ne basabasayɛ nni mu so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho ama nkonimdi wɔ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho ama nkonimdi wɔ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu denam: Ahokokwaw a ɛfata a wobenya: Ahokokwaw a wobenya na wɔayɛ no yiye te sɛ nkitahodi, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, bere a wɔde di dwuma, ne kuw adwumayɛ denam adesua mu adwuma, atuhoama osuahu ahorow, anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua ho. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ahyehyɛde, adwumayɛkuw, anaa dwuma a wɔn ani gye ho ho na ama wɔanya nhumu wɔ akwanhwɛ, ahwehwɛde, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nkɔso ho. Nkitahodi: Adwumayɛfoɔ nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛkyekyere denam nsɛmbisa, nnwuma mu nsɛm a ɛsisi, anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu so de ne adwumayɛfoɔ adi nkitaho na wɔahwehwɛ adwumayɛ akwan mu. Afotuo a wɔhwehwɛ: Akwankyerɛ ne afotuo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afiri akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, abusua mufoɔ, anaa adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ wɔn anigyeɛ mu de anya afotuo, mmoa, ne nhumu wɔ adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ ho. Botae ahorow a wɔde besisi hɔ: Botae ne botae ahorow a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ ama wɔn adwumayɛ ho ntetee anaa adwumayɛ mu osuahu, te sɛ ahokokwaw pɔtee a wobenya, nnwuma mu nimdeɛ a wobenya, anaa adwuma mu anigye a wɔbɛhwehwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sikakorabea ne nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, te sɛ sikakorabea, boseabɔ akuw, ne akwan a wɔfa so tua sika wɔ Intanɛt so, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn apaw anaa ahwɛ akwan a ɛfata ma wɔn ahiade?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun nya sikasɛm asoɛe ne nnwuma ahorow, a sikakorabea ahorow, boseabɔ akuw, Intanɛt so sikatua akwan, ne mobile sikakorabea "app" ahorow ka ho. Sɛ mmabun repaw akwan a ɛfata ma wɔn ahiade a, ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw nneɛma te sɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ɛka a wɔbɔ, mfɛntom, sɛnea wobetumi anya, ne nnwuma ahorow a wɔde ma ho. Wobetumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu, de wɔn afɔrebɔ ahorow atoto ho, na wɔahwehwɛ nyansahyɛ ahorow afi mpanyimfo anaa atipɛnfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ de asi gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na obi bɛtumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda mmabun adwene a ɛsakra a ɛtaa ba ne adwenemyare bi ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ntam?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoe a ɛda mmabun adwene mu nsakrae a ɛtaa ba ne adwenemyare ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ntam no hwehwɛ sɛ wosusuw mpɛn dodow a sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no ba, sɛnea emu yɛ den, ne bere tenten a egye, ne nsusuaso a enya wɔ da biara da dwumadi so no ho. Bere a adwene mu nsakrae taa ba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu esiane nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae ne nkɔso mu nsɛnnennen nti no, adwenemyare ho sɛnkyerɛnne kɔ so tra hɔ bere tenten na ɛsɛe adwumayɛ kɛse. Sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no siw da biara da asetra kwan anaasɛ ɛde ahoyeraw ba a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di hɔ ma ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a, ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔama wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim na wɔafa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛyɛ den mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ama wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim na wɔafa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛyɛ den mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua nhyiam ahorow, intanɛt so adesua ahorow, ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ nokwasɛm ne nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm yɛ nokware anaa. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛma wotumi ne afoforo di nkitaho, "video" ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Yɛne atipɛnfoɔ ne afotufoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm mu yie na wɔakyɛ nhumu ne adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa me hokafo no nkate fam yiyedi ne nkɔso wɔ abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Tie a Wode Yɛ Nsi: Tie wo hokafo nkate ne nea ɛhaw no yiye. Tema: Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte wo hokafo adwene ase na woada tema adi. Nkuranhyɛ: Fa nkuranhyɛ ne mmoa ma wɔ wɔn botae ne wɔn apɛde ho. Obu a Wode Ma Ahye: Bu wɔn ahye na hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran. Wɔn Ho a Wɔhwɛ: Hyɛ suban pa ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho ho nkuran. Yɛ Kuw: Monkɔ nsɛnnennen ho dwuma sɛ kuw, na mommoa mo ho mo ho wɔ nsɛnnennen mu. Adwumayɛfoɔ Mmoa: Hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ adwumayɛfoɔ mmoa sɛ wɔrepere wɔ nkate fam a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie bɛn na ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi adi de aboa mmofra a wɔrenyin na ama wɔanya mmoa firi aban ne mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo hɔ, te sɛ afutuo, sika mmoa, ne asetena mu mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi adi dwuma titire wɔ mmabun a wɔde bɛbata asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa dwumadie ho denam wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn, nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho a wɔde bɛma, ahiadeɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ, ne adwuma a wɔne asetena mu adwumayɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ahorow gu mu ahorow ma nnwuma ahorow  fa ayaresa dwumadie bi te sɛ awoɔ ho nhyehyɛe nnuru, nna mu yadeɛ, awoɔ wɔ tu gu, ne adwene mu haw ho afutuo ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛfa awofo pene ne amanneɛbɔ ho no betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho. Shɛ nhwɛso yi nso: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano: Wɔ aman pii mu no, mmabun betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ kokoam a awofo mpene ho ɛrinhia, titiriw sɛ wɔadu awo mfe mu na wɔrehwehwɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a. STI Nhwehwɛmu ne Ayaresa: Mmara a ɛfa STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho betumi ayɛ soronko, nanso wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi wɔ kokoam a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu de abɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban, na wɔahyɛ nkuran sɛ wonhu STI ntɛm so na wɔsa. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu: Mmara ahorow a ɛfa awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho gyinaesi mu no gu ahorow kɛse, na tumidi ahorow bi hwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so, anaasɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ, na afoforo nso ma mmabun kwan ma wɔhwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma wɔ kokoam a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu wɔ tebea horow bi mu. Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Afotu: Ebia mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho afotu wɔ kokoam a awofo mpene so wɔ aman pii mu, titiriw sɛ wobu wɔn sɛ wɔn ho akokwaw a wobetumi asi wɔn akwahosan ho gyinae a ɛfata a. Nanso, mmara a ɛfa adwenemyare ho afotu a wɔde ma mmofra nkumaa ho no betumi ayɛ soronko, enti ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmara pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma bi te sɛ ohia anaa ofie a wonni betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya STI no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Ohia ne afie a wonni betumi ama STI ho asiane ayɛ kɛse esiane: Asetena tebea a entumi nnyina: Nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ ahotew ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu nti. Kondom ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw ano a wobetumi anya kakraa bi. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde di gua de nya ahiade atitiriw: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya nna a ahobammɔ nnim esiane abasamtu nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔma ayaresa hohia sɛ wɔnka nsem a efa ntɛmtɛm kwan a yefa so si nyinsɛn ano ma mmabun anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresamafo deɛ wɔn hohia sɛ wɔnka ntɛmtɛm nyinsɛn ano sie hosem ma mmabun sɛ adeɛ eka wɔn asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔmma awoɔ apɔmmuden asem a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nea ebetumi aka nkyerɛkyerɛɛmu a efa nea ewɔ hɔ, a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'availability, effectiveness,' ne nea yebetumi ennya efiri ntɛmtɛm kwan a yɛfaso si nyinsɛn ano, ne akwankyerɛ wɔ senea ne bere a ɛwɔ sɛ wodi di dwuma. Ebiom, ayaresamafo wɔ sɛ wonnya nkitahodie wɔ akwan foforo a yedi si nyinsɛn ano na wɔma nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nyinsɛn ano sie ne nna mu apɔmmuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sika a wɔde boa nhomasua ne ntetee betumi atua ɛka a ɛboro adesua ho ka te sɛ adesua nhoma, akwantuo sika, anaa dabere?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, sika a wɔde boa nhomasua ne ntetee betumi atua ɛka a ɛboro adesua ho ka te sɛ adesua nhoma, akwantuo sika, dabere, ne nhomasua ho ka afoforo. Dwumadie binom betumi de mmoa anaa sika a wɔde bɛboa asuafoɔ ama wɔatua asetena mu ka berɛ a afoforo nso betumi de mmoa ama wɔ adesua nwoma a wɔbɛtɔ, sukuu a wɔbɛkɔ, anaa adan a ne boɔ yɛ den a wɔbɛnya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow betumi ayɛ adesua tebea horow a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a asuafo nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ wobu wɔn, wɔsom bo, na wɔde wɔn ka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi ayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ denam: Nhyehyɛe a wɔde ko tia ayayade a wɔde bedi dwuma ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa ahorow ne nnipa a wɔka bom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Nteteeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ nkabom, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho. Kokoam mmoa dwumadie a wɔde besi hɔ, te sɛ afotuo anaa atipɛnfoɔ afotuo, ama asuafoɔ a wɔwɔ SRH haw. SRH nwomasua a egu ahodoɔ na ɛka obiara ho a ɛgye na ɛsi nnipa ahodoɔ, osuahu, ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ so dua. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne atie a wɔde nsiyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ SRH nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, obu a wɔde bɛma asuafo ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi kokoam nsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho nsɛm mu bere a wɔrehwehwɛ ayaresa a wɔde besiw ano anaa ayaresa ama awo akwahosan ho nsɛm no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ bɛtumi ahwɛ na wɔn nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkitahodie ayɛ kokoam asɛm:Te wo ho kwan ase fa kokoamsɛm ho: Te wo ho kwan ne mmara a ɛbɔ wo ho ban fa kokoamsɛm ho ase, te sɛ HIPAA mmara (wɔ United States) anaa mmara a ɛte saa wɔ aman afoforɔ so (te sɛ Ghana apɔwmuden mmara).Hwehwɛ ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ kokoam adwuma: Hwehwɛ adɔkotafoɔ anaa nɛɛsefoɔ a wɔasiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ kokoam adwuma ama mmaayewa titiriw, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wo ho nsɛm bɛyɛ kokoam mmerɛ biara.Di kokoamsɛm ho nkɔmɔ ntɛm: Kasa kyerɛ w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ fa kokoamsɛm ho mfiase pɛ, na bisa wɔn nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa awofoɔ mmoa ne wɔn tumidie ho.Hwehwɛ mmeaeɛ a wɔyɛ kokoam adwuma: Hwehwɛ akwan a wobɛtumi afa so anya nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa wɔ kokoam mu, te sɛ sukuu mu ayaresabea, mpɔtam aduyɛbea, anaa "telehealth" (apɔwmuden mmoa a wɔnya no abɛfo ntentan so).Hu sɛ ɛyɛ adwumayɛ mu bra kwan: Hu sɛ ɛyɛ ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔde wo nsɛm bɛsie kokoam mu, gye sɛ wohu sɛ asiane bi bɛtumi ato wo anaa afoforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akura me ho mfoni a ɛfata mu, sɛ merepere wɔ adwenemyare ho nkɛntɛnso a STI bi de aba no ho a?
answer_twi_source: STI a wohu no nkyerɛ wo bo a ɛsom: Fa w’adwene si w’ahoɔden so: Dɛn na ɛma woyɛ onipa kɛse? Fa ayamhyehye yɛ wo ho: Da ayamye kyerɛ wo ho wɔ saa bere yi mu. Kae sɛ ɛyɛ nea wobetumi asa: Sɛ wɔsa wo yare a, wo ho bɛtɔ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun rehyia ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔatumi ahwehwɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa afotufo hɔ, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no nso hɔ. Wobetumi nso ne nea broni ka no 'helplines online platform' adi nkitaho denam 5100, YENKASA ne nea broni ka no 'The toll-free number'(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho, anaa ne nea broni ka no 'hotlines' a wɔbɛfrɛ so ama mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ, sɛ wɔde nna mu ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm bɛka apɔwmuden nnwuma nyinaa ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde nna mu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden nnwuma bɛka apɔwmuden nyinaa nnwuma ho a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde apɔwmuden ho nneɛma pii te sɛ ayaresa, adwenemyareɛ, ne asetram nneɛma bɛhyɛ baakoyɛ mu. Saa kwan yi ma wohu sɛ mmabun a wɔwɔ mmabun ho apɔwmuden mu ahiade no nyɛ ade a wɔayi no nko ara asi nkyɛn, na mmom ɛyɛ ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe a ehwɛ obia II a ɛka ɔfã ahorow a wɔhwɛ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho ne adwuma a wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe ho a ɛbɛboa mmabun ne obia bom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi abom ayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wom na ɛka obiara bom a obiara te nka sɛ wɔama no tumi sɛ ɔmfa ne hokwan ahorow, ahye, ne ahofadi a ɔwɔ, ne baabi a wɔmma nna mu basabasayɛ ho kwan anaasɛ wɔmfa anoyi mma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ayɛ tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom na ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho denam: Mpɔtam a Wɔboa a Wɔbɛkyekye: Sɛ wɔbɛma obiaa atenka sɛ wowɔ akyitaafo na wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho, baabi a obiara te nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wobu no, na wɔama no tumi sɛ ɔbɛkasa atia nna mu basabasayɛ. Mpene so Amammerɛ a Wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ pene, obu, ne nkitahodie pa ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Nsakrae a Wɔkamfo: Wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, nneɛma a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn, ne mmoa a eye ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ nhomasua asoɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ. Atipɛnfo Mmoa a Wɔde Ma: Fa atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe anaa nnamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun betumi ne wɔn ho wɔn ho akɔhwɛ, de mmoa ama, na sɛ wohu tebea horow a ebetumi apira wɔn a, wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ma. Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde di anim: Yɛ suban a obuo wom, ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu denneennen, ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛyɛ katee wɔ nkitahodiɛ nyinaa mu ho nhwɛsoɔ, kyerɛ afoforo sɛ sɛ wɔbɛgyina nna mu basabasayɛ ano no yɛ obiara asɛdeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛma mmabun tumi, ma wɔadi mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nyiyim a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma ne nhyehyeɛ ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun, tumi ma wɔadi mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne nyiyim ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmabun akannifoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ so. Kamfo ɔsatuo ne nhyiamu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nteteeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho. Afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyɛ adwumaden. Nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛe a ɛfa me ho a mede hwɛ me ho a ebetumi aboa me ma mate nka sɛ mewɔ tumi kɛse na manya tumi wɔ me nna ne awo akwahosan ho? (nkyerɛkyerɛ, asɛm a wɔka pintinn) .
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Sɛ wosua wo nna ne awo akwahosan ho ade a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woate nka sɛ wotumi di wo ho so kɛse. Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya wɔ Intanɛt so ne ayaresabea ahorow so. Asɛm a Woka: Fa ahotoso ka w’ahiade ne w’akɔnnɔ ho wɔ abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na beae a ɛye bɛtumi aboa ma mmabun anya yiyedi ne wɔn adwene mu akwaa apɔmuden?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔboa no betumi ama mmabun yiyedi ne wɔn adwenemyare atu mpɔn kɛse denam atenka a ɛbɛma wɔate nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea, wɔagye atom, na wɔanya ahobammɔ no so. Sɛ ankorankoro te nka sɛ wogye wɔn tom na wɔboa wɔn a, ɛda adi sɛ wobedi yiye na wɔanya adwenemyare pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so asɛyɛde ahorow bɛn na wɔn a wɔrehwɛ, adansefo, ne amanneɛbɔfo a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no wɔ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ mu, na dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba bere a wɔammɔ amanneɛ anaasɛ wɔamfa wɔn ho annye tebea horow yi mu no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔrehwɛ, adansefo, ne amanneɛbɔfo a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no wɔ mmara kwan so asɛyɛde wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ mu, titiriw sɛ nea onyaa ne ti didii mu no yɛ abofra kumaa a. Wɔ mmara kwan so asɛyɛde sɛ amanneɛbɔfo a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔyɛ, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, bɔ nsɛm a wosusuw sɛ wɔyɛ ayayade anaa basabasayɛ a ɛfa mmofra nkumaa ho no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata. Sɛ wɔammɔ amanneɛ anaasɛ wɔamfa wɔn ho annye tebea horow yi mu a, ebetumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba, a nea ɛka ho ne mmara mu nsunsuanso ne asodi a ebetumi aba sɛ obepira nea onyaa ne ti didii mu no bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, ebetumi ahaw mmabun gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya mmabun gyinaesi ahorow a, ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Saa gyidi ahorow yi betumi akyerɛ adwene a nkurɔfo wɔ wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo, ne abusua a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a me ne no bɛkasa no betumi aboa me ma m'agyina adwenemyare a nna mu yareɛ de ba no ano?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkasa a, ebetumi aboa wo. Wobetumi: Di wo haw ahorow ho dwuma: Wobebua wo nsemmisa na ama woanya awerɛhyem. Fa nkate fam mmoa ma: Wɔte nkate mu nkɛntɛnso a nna mu yareɛ nya no ase. Fa wo ne nneɛma di nkitaho: Wobetumi akamfo mmoa akuw, nsɛm a ɛfa ho, anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a mmabun fa so kasa ma hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ nea broni ka no  'informed consent' ma na wɔde kokoamsɛm sie wɔ akwahosan ho mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ nea broni ka no  'informed consent' bɛma ne kokoamsɛm wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu denam: Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ho, a mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ a ɛfa ho a ɛbɔ wɔn ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm ho ban wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu ka ho. Atipɛnfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ, nneɛma, ne baakoyɛ ama wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛfa so akɔ so ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Wɔn ankasa suahu ne wɔn adwene a wɔde bɛma nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun, a egyina hokwan ahorow so. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kasa ma nkurɔfo, adesrɛ ahorow, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmara mu nsakrae, ahyehyɛde mu nsakrae, ne nneyɛe pa a ɛde hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, wɔde kokoamsɛm, ne ɔhwɛ pa adi kan wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo nnwinnade ne mfiridwuma betumi ama mmabun tumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo nnwinnade ne mfiridwuma ma mmabun tumi ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ nsɛm a edi mu na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde ma, de wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodibea ne adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di bata wɔn ho, a wɔde kokoam kwan a wɔfa so nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛyɛ mmerɛw ma, na wɔhyɛ ahofadi ne ahofadi ho nkuran wɔ gyinaesi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi afa so adi ayayade, anaa nyiyim a egyina nipadua kɛse, ne honam ani hwɛbea, anaa nipadua su so wɔ sukuu tebea horow mu ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi adi ayayadeɛ, anaa nyiyim a egyina nipadua kɛseɛ, ne honam ani hwɛbea, anaa nipadua mu su so ho dwuma wɔ sukuu tebea mu denam nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔde ko tia asisifoɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma, nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ ayayadeɛ nneyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhunu na wɔayɛ ho biribi, tema ne obuo a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ wɔ asuafoɔ mu, ne amammerɛ a ɛfa nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho na wɔagye wɔn atom ho. Mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ ama wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa, hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma wɔn a wɔhwɛ no de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, ne awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw ano mu nso yɛ akwan a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ne nnwuma yɛ kokoamusɛm anaa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ne nnwuma taa yɛ kokoamusɛm. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo de ayarefo kokoam nsɛm di kan na wobu hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie bere a wɔrehwehwɛ awo ne nna mu apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ka ho no. Ahintasɛm hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun betumi asusuw wɔn awoɔ apomoden ho haw ahorow ho pefee na wɔanya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, sɛ wɔpɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina nnamfo nhyɛsoɔ a ɛfa nna mu anaaa nneyɛeɛ bɔne ho ano?
answer_twi_source: Nnafofoɔ nhyesoɔ tumi yɛ den, nanso wei ne nneɛma bi: Hu baabi a wontumi ntoaso, broni bɛkasɛ 'limits' na tare ho.Yɛre ketee: Ka "Daabi" pintinn na emu dahɔ. Wo ne nnamfo pa nnam. Fa woho bɔ nkorɔfoɔ a woboa wo. Sua sɛdeɛ yɛka daabi. Kasa kyerɛ panyin a wogyi no di sɛ wobrɛ a, anaa kasa kyerɛ mmabun ne nea ɔma ayaresa a n'anim te wɔ wo sukuu anaa ayaresabea a ɛbɛn. Kae dabiara sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka daabi wo biribiara a enma woho ntɔwo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn abɔ me ho ban afiri mmoawa awɔde nyarewa ba ho?
answer_twi_source: Twe wo ho firi nna ho. Bɔ wo ho ban. Nom aduro. Yɛ nhwehwɛmu dabiaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu nkyerɛase ne nea efi nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu ba, a mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, mfe a wɔadi a wɔpene so, ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ ka ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmebun betumi ate akwannya ne asɛyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho ase?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nkyerɛase ne nea efi nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu ba no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu, nanso mpɛn pii no ɛfa mmara ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, mfe a obi adi sɛ ɔbɛpene so, ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmebun te wɔn akwannya ne wɔn asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho ase, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmara a ɛfa Mpene Ho: Wɔte ase sɛ nna mu dwumadi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa pene so pefee, wɔma wɔn nimdeɛ, na wofi wɔn pɛ mu. Mfe a Wɔde Mpene So: Mfe a ankorankoro betumi apene so wɔ mmara kwan so sɛ wɔnyɛ nna mu dwumadi wɔ wɔn tumidi mu wɔ mmara kwan so a wonim. Amanneɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe: Ɔkwan a wɔfa so bɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho amanneɛ kyerɛ mmarahyɛ baguafo anaasɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ a wobehu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ nimdie a menya no gyina adanseɛ so na ɛnnyɛ tete nsɛm nkoa?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛbɛyɛ na woahwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm a wubehu no gyina adanse so na ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ foforo no, susu afotu a edidi so yi ho: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban apɔwmuden adwumayɛbea ahorow, nnuroyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow hɔ. Hwɛ da a wotintim nsɛm no na hwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nnansa yi ara na ɛda aduruyɛ ho nimdeɛ ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren adi. Hwɛ sɛ akyerɛwfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde nsɛm no ma no adansedi nkrataa no yɛ nokware na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Cross-reference nsɛm a efi mmeae pii de si so dua sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na ɛne ne ho hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi de nnyinasosɛm ne ahokokwaw a masua denam nteteeɛ pa so adi dwuma wɔ m’asetra mu nneɛma afoforo te sɛ adesua, adwumayɛ, anaa m’ankasa nkitahodie mu, na ama me mmɔdenbɔ ne nkonimdi nyinaa ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow mu nko na adwenekyerɛ ho hia, na mmom wɔ asetra mu nneɛma afoforo nso mu. Wɔ adesua tebea horow mu no, ka a wobɛka woadwene no betumi aboa wo ma wo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo ne w’atipɛnfo adi nkitaho yiye, akamfo wo ho wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu, na woadi w’ahiade ho nkitaho. Wɔ adwumayɛfo tebea horow mu no, ka a wobɛka woadwene ho hia kɛse na ama woasi wo ho so dua wɔ adwumam, wode ahotoso ada w’adwene adi, na woadi ntawntawdi ho dwuma wɔ aman ntam nkitahodi kwan so. Wɔ ankorankoro nkitahodie mu no, asɛm a wɔka no denneennen ma wutumi ka w’ahiade ne w’ahye ho asɛm pefee, siesie ntawntawdi ahorow wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ so, na wukura nkitahodie pa a egyina obu ne ntease a wowɔ ma wo ho wo ho so. Ɛnam nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka no denneennen ne ahokokwaw a woasua denam ntetee so a wode bedi dwuma wɔ mmeae ahorow yi so no, wubetumi ama wo mmɔdenbɔ nyinaa, ahotoso, ne nkonimdi wɔ asetra mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa ɔsom mu nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aka sɛnea awofoɔ ne abusuafoɔ bu sabi dɛmdi ne nna mu dwumadie, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Emu Da Hɔ: Wo ne wo ba no nkasa wɔ amammerɛ ne ɔsom gyidie a ɛfa nna ho a obu wom. Fa W’adwene Si Gyidie So: Hwehwɛ nneɛma a mobom gye di denam gyidie te sɛ obu, dɔ, ne nnamfofa pa a wobɛsi so dua. Hwehwɛ Akwankyerɛ: Ne ɔsom mpanyimfoɔ a wogye wɔn di a wɔwɔ ɔpɛpa sɛ wɔbɛkasa afa nna ne dɛmdi ho nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa kasa a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu di dwuma na kwati nsɛm a ɛkasa tia bere a woresusuw nyinsɛn ho no.
answer_twi_source: Yɛde nsɛmfua a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu bedi dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ yi nyinaa mu. Nhwɛso ahorow bi ni: Nyinsɛn: Tebea a wosoa akokoaa a ɔrenyin wɔ wo nipadua mu. Nyinsɛn a wogyae (nyinsɛn a woyi gu): Aduruyɛ mu kwan a wɔfa so de nyinsɛn ba awiei.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de bɛɛfo ntentan mmaeɛ, abɛɛfo ntentan so abakɔsɛm, ne ɔman mma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adi dwuma de ahyɛ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne, osuahu, ne apereperedi mu den, akamfo nnipa hokwan ahorow, na wɔaboaboa nnipa a wɔbom yɛ ade atwa ASRH ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm a ɛtrɛw ho ahyia?
answer_twi_source: Amanneɛbɔ a ɛma nne a wɔahyɛ wɔn so so: Mmabun betumi de abɛɛfo ntentan mmaeɛ (social media), abɛɛfo anansesɛm (digital storytelling), ne mpɔtam amanneɛbɔ (citizen journalism) adi dwuma de ama nne, osuahu, ne amanehunu a nnipa a wɔahyɛ wɔn so nam mu no so atre. Eyi bɛboa ma wɔagye atene ama nnipa nyinaa kyɛfa, na wɔabom ayɛ adwuma fa barima ne ɔbaa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan (ASRH) ne nsɛm afoforo a ɛfa atɛntrenee ho. Denam wɔn ankasa abasɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ, nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de akanyan nkurɔfoɔ adwene, ne ntentan so nneyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ so no, mmabun betumi ama nnipa a wɔn nne nni dudoɔ mu no adwene ada adi pefee, na wɔahyɛ baakoyɛ ne nkabom nkuran wɔ mpɔtam ahorow nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn awo hokwan ahorow ase na wɔakamfo akyerɛ obi ?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn awo hokwan ahorow ase na wɔakamfo wɔn, a nea ɛka ho ne: nna mu akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛfata mmabun ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔde nsɛm ne mmoa ma. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim no twee adwene sii awo ho atɛntrenee ne nna mu akwahosan hokwan ahorow so. Nhomasua nneɛma ne adwumayɛbea ahorow a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow de ma. Mmara mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmabun akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho titire.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asotwe bɛn na wɔde ma obi a ɔde ne ho hye ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu basabasayɛ neyɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛnea bɔne no mu yɛ den?
answer_twi_source: Asotwe a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho no gu ahorow a egyina sɛnea bɔne no mu yɛ den so na ebetumi ayɛ afiasenna, asotwe, sɔhwɛ, ne kyɛfa a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siesie nkurɔfo mu. Wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a emu yɛ den anaasɛ mfomso a wɔyɛ no mpɛn pii mu no, asotwe taa yɛ nea emu yɛ den kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra betumi aboa mmabun, ma wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn betumi: Wɔama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee aba, na wɔayɛ tebea a ɛboa ma wɔasusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Fa nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a wadi a egyina ɔbabun no nkɔso fã so ma. Hyɛ nsɛmmisa ho nkuran na di nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma a wunsusuw ho. Kyerɛ mmabun kwan kɔ mmeae a agye din te sɛ; akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow, ne nhoma ahorow. Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ sukuu ahorow ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmusuakuw, adesuakuw, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛma obi yɛ onipa no ntam nkitahodi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfoni ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no di nkitaho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa nhyiam ahorow yi hyehyɛ mmabun osuahu ne wɔn nsusuwii ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho mfoni ahorow no ne abusuakuw, adesuakuw, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛma obi yɛ onipa no di nkitaho wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ den so. Saa nhyiam ahorow yi hyehyɛ mmabun osuahu ne wɔn nsusuwii denam sɛnea wohu wɔn ho ne afoforo a wɔda wɔn ho adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no so nkɛntɛnso so. Nhwɛsoɔ, ankorankoro a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu betumi ahyia gyinabea ahorow a anohyeto wom anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ katee a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ a enni hɔ dedaw ne tumi mu nkɔso mu den. Saa nhyiam ahorow yi a wobehu no ho hia na ama yɛate sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea betumi ada asetra mu nhyehyɛe ne nsonsonoe adi na ama akɔ so atra hɔ no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho nsɛm a wɔda no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no nya mmabun adwene wɔ abusuabɔ, pene, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho nsɛm a wɔda no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no betumi anya mmabun adwene wɔ abusuabɔ, pene a wɔpene so, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho nkɛntɛnso denam: Nna mu dwumadi a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata na wɔayɛ no fɛ, a ebetumi ama wɔanya akwanhwɛ ne nhyɛso a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ asetra mu abusuabɔ ankasa mu. Ankorankoro a wɔbɛma wɔn ho atɔ wɔn wɔ nna ho mfonini ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ nneɛma ho, a ebetumi asɛe tumi a wotumi hu na wobu ahye ne pene a wɔpene so no. Ɛboa ma wonya ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a ɛboro so ho amammerɛ, baabi a wobu ankorankora sɛ ɛsom bo esiane wɔn nipadua ne wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ titiriw nti, sen sɛ wobebu wɔn nipasu anaa wɔn suban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho akamfofo betumi ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim wɔ mmabun mu na wɔadi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Fa sika a wɔde bɛyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun na wɔakyekyɛ. Boa ma wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho, na hwɛ hu sɛ ɛfata mfe a obi adi, egyina adanse so, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Kamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmabun nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ animhwɛ, a akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a wobenya ka ho. Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo nyɛ biako na ama woadu mmabun a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa kɛse mu nkyɛn na wɔadi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ne nnwuma a wobenya mu no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa dwumadie foforɔ bɛn na wɔtaa de ma wɔ ɔhaw mu mmoa telefon so, te sɛ afotuo, nsɛm a wɔka de boa, aduruyɛ mu ayɔnkofa, mmara kwan so mmoa, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a wɔde kɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ nkate fam mmoa ne ɔhaw mu mmoa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu akyi no, ɔhaw ho mmoa telefon ahorow betumi de mmoa foforo ahorow ama wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no. Saa dwumadie yi betumi ayɛ afotuo anaa ayaresa nhyiamu a wɔne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn, nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi na wɔka ho kɔ aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu, polisifoɔ nsɛmbisa, anaa asɛnnibea nsɛm, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ mmara kwan so nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛfa so na wɔanya mmara mu nneɛma, ne wɔde kɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ anaa nnwuma titire te sɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛeɛ ho dwumadie akuo anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔhwɛ adwenemhaw so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi akwansidie ahorow te sɛ animtiaabu anaa suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn so bere a wɔrenya STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma so denam: - Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ kokoam ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ atemmufo. - a wobekyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan hokwan ne nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. - a wode intanɛt so nneɛma anaa telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so di dwuma de nya nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔmmɔ din. - a wohwehwe mmoa firi nnamfo a wogye wo di, abusua mufoo, anaase sukuu afotufoɔ hɔ. - a wobekamfo afa nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne animtiaabu a ɛfa STI ne HIV ho a wɔbɛtew so wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusuafo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom afa abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma mu ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusuafo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom afa abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma mu ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ wɔn ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho so denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔabue ano na obu wom a wofi ase no so. Wobetumi akyɛ wɔn adwene, wɔn haw, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, de tema ne ntease atie afoforo adwene, na wɔabom ahwehwɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nneyɛe a ɛfata ho nkuran. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkitahodi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm ho no ayɛ kɛse na wɔabom adi ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow di nkɛntɛnso a sohyial media, mfiridwuma, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow nya wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan so no ho dwuma, a nsɛm a ɛfa kɔmputa so ayayade, nna ho nsɛm a wɔde mena, ne dijitaal pene a wɔde ma ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow di nkɛntɛnso a sohyial media, mfiridwuma, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow nya wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan so no ho dwuma denam nsɛmti a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho ne dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Asuafoɔ sua nneɛma bɔne ne nneɛma pa a ɛwɔ nkitahodie a ɛkɔ so wɔ intanɛt so no ho, a ɛbi ne: ayayadeɛ a wɔyɛ obi wɔ intanɛt so (cyberbullying), nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho a wɔde nkitahodie mfidie mane (sexting), ne dijitaal pene so ka ho. Wɔhwehwɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ wɔn ho ban, senea wɔbɛfa nnamfo pa wɔ intanɛt so wɔ obu mu, ne senea wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa sɛ obi rehyɛ wɔn so anaa ɔrepira wɔn wɔ intanɛt so a. Denam nteaseɛ ne akokoduru a wɔde hyɛ mmabun mu wɔ abɛfo mfidie ne intanɛt ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no, nwomasua nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmabun tumi si gyinaeɛ pa na wɔde abɛfo mmeaeɛ dwumadie di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na abusuabɔ pa boa wo na woatumi ahyɛ wo nkateɛ (emotions) so yie?
answer_twi_source: Wɔma wote nka sɛ wɔte wo ase. Wɔyɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa. Wɔhyɛ wo nkuran. Wɔma bammɔ. Wɔkasa kyerɛ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na mɛfa so ada anisɔ adi ama mfɛfo a wɔanya me nna ne awo ho gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso pa?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ada aseda ne anisɔ adi ama atipɛnfo a wɔanya wo nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso pa denam: Da wɔn a wobɛda wɔn ase tee no so: Gye bere de kyerɛ w’anisɔ kyerɛ atipɛnfo a wɔaboa wo na wɔahyɛ wo nkuran wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfata wɔ wo nna mu apomoden ho. Wɔn mmɔdenbɔ a wobɛboa: Kyerɛ sɛ woboa atipɛnfo a wɔkamfo nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu kyerɛ denam wɔn nhyehyɛe ahorow a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔn nhyiam ahorow a wobɛkɔ, ne wɔn nkrasɛm a wobɛma ayɛ kɛse no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na awofoɔ bɛnya fa intanɛt ho de aboa mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so akwankyerɛ. Beae wɔ ahomatrofo no so a wɔkyerɛ ade. De hwɛ nea mmabun yɛ 'Parental control apps'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka m’ahye (boundaries) ne nea mepɛ akyerɛ me hokafo bere a merenya nna mu kyɛfa no?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wobɛbue Mu: Da wo boundaries adi pefee na da obu adi ansa na woanya nna mu kyɛfa ne bere a woreyɛ. Fa "Me" Nsɛm di dwuma: "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ..." "Mepɛ..." Nkitahodi: Hwehwɛ nea ɛne ne ho hyia denam nea wopɛ; ani nnye, ne ahye a mobɛbom asusuw ho no so. Mpene a Wɔpene So Yɛ Nkɔso: Mpene so tumi sesa, enti te nka sɛ wɔama wo tumi sɛ wobɛkasa sɛ w’ahye sesa a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ wɔ adwene mu yaresafo 'mental health' dɔkota ho?
answer_twi_source: Krataa a ɛma ne ho kwan sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ wo (Licensure). Suahunu ne mmabun. Amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ (Cultural competence). Nkamfo pa (Recommendations).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusuw adwenemyare ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ papa ne nea etu mpɔn ho ansa na wɔde wɔn ho agye mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛnea adwenemyare ho nnwuma ye na etu mpɔn denam nneɛma pii a wobesusuw ho so. Wobetumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo te sɛ ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo ahwehwɛde ne wɔn adansedi nkrataa ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔanya ntetee ne osuahu a ɛfata. Ɛbɛtumi nso aboa sɛ wobɛkenkan nsusuiɛ anaa adansedie a ɛfiri afɛfoɔ foforɔ hɔ, sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a. Bio nso, mmabun betumi abisa nsɛm afa ayaresa kwan a ɔyarehwɛfo no de di dwuma ne sɛnea ɛne wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ hyia ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne ɔyarehwɛfoɔ no bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware fa botaeɛ a ɛwɔ ayaresa ho na wosusu nkɔsoɔ ho daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmerante ne mmabaa betumi abu wɔn aban ahorow ho akontaa sɛ wɔadi wɔn asɛde ahorow ho dwuma wɔ amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ASRR ahorow ho? (Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo, nkɔso a wɔbɛhwɛ so)
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ama aban ahorow abu akontaa denam: Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ ɔsatu ahorow, adesrɛ ahorow, anaa wɔbɛkasa afa nsɛm a ɛka ASRH kwan a wɔfa so nya ho. Nkɔsoɔ a Wɔbɛhwɛ: Hwɛ sɛdeɛ aban no de amanaman ntam akuo redi dwuma yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si so dua sɛ akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a sikasɛm tebea mfa ho na hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di anaa nna mu akwahosan ho telefon so.
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hu sɛ akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔn sikasɛm tebea mfa ho. Hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ mma wɔmmoa wɔn wɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee ho. Mmara a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho bɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no, na ɛma wotumi nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a awofo mpene so wɔ nsɛm pii mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ adwenemyare ho haw ahorow ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no betumi atew animtiaabu so na ahyɛ mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ nneyɛe ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu so?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ adwenemyare ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no betumi atew animtiaabu so na ahyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔahwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia. Wobetumi ayɛ eyi denam adwenemyare ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma, nneɛma a ɛtaa haw ne nsɛnnennen a wɔbɛka ho asɛm, ne wɔn ankasa nsɛm a ɛfa mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ ho a wɔbɛkyɛ so. Sɛ wɔyɛ tebea a ɛboa a asuafoɔ te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka adwenemyareɛ ho asɛm a, ɛma wɔbue wɔn ani na ɛma mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ no yɛ animtiaabuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnuane bi wɔ hɔ a ɛboa ma ‘pimple’ anaa adwene mu nsakrae ba?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nnuan ne aduannuru bi betumi aboa wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho: Nnuan a ɛko tia yare mmoawa pii te sɛ nnuaba ne nhabannuru betumi aboa ma ɔfe a ɛbata pimples ho no so atew. Omega-3 srade a ɛwɔ mpataa, flaxseeds, ne walnuts mu nso betumi aboa honam ani akwahosan. Tumeric betumi aboa ma wɔadi yare a ɛba ansa na brayɛ ne pimples so.   Adwene mu Nsakrae: Nnuan a ɛboa amemene akwahosan, te sɛ mpataa a srade wom (salmon, mackerel), walnuts, ne chia aba no wɔ omega-3 pii na ebetumi aboa ma wɔasiesie adwene no. Bio nso, carbohydrates a ɛyɛ den te sɛ aburow a wɔayam ne atoko betumi aboa asikyire dodow a ɛkɔ soro wɔ mogya mu, na ebetumi aka adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ asɛm bi a ɛhia paa a mepɛ sɛ yɛka ho asɛm, nanso ɛnyɛ yɛn mmere a yɛahyɛ so a, ɛwan kwan so na mɛtumi ne wo adi nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ asɛm bi a ɛhia paa a wopɛ sɛ yɛka ho asɛm a ɛnyɛ yɛn mmere a yɛahyɛ so no a, wo bɛtumi ne me adi nkitaho berɛ biara. Wo bɛtumi aba me nkyɛn ankasa, anaa woatwerɛ me mɛsegye (text message), na sɛ asɛm no yɛ ntɛm kɛse a, yɛbɛtumi ahyia mpo prɛko pɛ. Mewɔ hɔ sɛ mɛboa wo berɛ biara a wobɛhia mmoa, na mɛhwehwɛ kwan m’adagyie mu de ayɛ wo dadwen ne wo nsɛmmisa ho adwuma ntɛm paa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmu ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm ano no betumi aboa ma wɔate sɛnea asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no tu mpɔn wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu nsunsuanso a ɛkɔ anim no ase yiye?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano mmɔdenbɔ boa ma wɔhwɛ sɛnea asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no tu mpɔn wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu nsunsuanso a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn mu denam akwan a wɔfa so nya, sɛnea wɔde di dwuma, abotɔyam, nkɛntɛnso a wonya wɔ suban mu nsakrae so, ne apomoden ho nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ a wɔhwehwɛ mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa edinnsiananmu a mede bedi dwuma so akyerɛ sɛ meboa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam nsonsonoe ne nea ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana mu no, constitutition no gye binary gender nkutoo tom a mmarima ne mmaa she/he edinnsiananmu nkutoo na ɛka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ wim nsakrae tebea ho adeyɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkamfo a ɛde ASRH di kan, te sɛ nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa, ahoɔden a wɔyɛ no foforo, ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ wim nsakrae tebea ho adeyɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu denam nhyiam ahorow a ɛde ASRH di kan, a ɛko ma nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa, ahoɔden a wɔyɛ no foforo, ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm. Nnwuma a mmabun di anim: Nnwuma a mmabun di anim mu kyɛfa a wonya no ma mmabun tumi de wɔn nne, wɔn adwene, ne wɔn nneyɛe boa nnwuma a ɛfa wim tebea ho a ɛne ASRH di nkitaho, na ɛma tumi ne akannifo ho nimdeɛ nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmusua, mpɔtam, ne asetena nkitahodi (Social Network) ahorow di wɔ asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔredi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmusua, mpɔtam, ne asetena mu nkitahodi (social network) ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrefa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen mu denam nkate fam mmoa, sikasɛm mu mmoa, akwantu, akwankyerɛ, ne nneɛma ne nsɛm a wobenya so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwehwɛ m’ankasa nna mu bere a mibu m’amammerɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Wo ho a wubehu no yɛ ade titiriw: Hwehwɛ wo nkate, w’anigye, ne w’akɔnnɔ mu wɔ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ. Hwehwɛ intanɛt so nneɛma te sɛ YMK app no mu na woanya nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a obi adi, a ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Kɔsra akwahosan ho dwumayɛni a ɔpɛ mmabun wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no anaa wo ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo nka wo akwansideɛ anaa w’adwene mu naayɛ ho asɛm
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nipadua mfonini a ɛte apɔw wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu sɛ meyɛ transgender anaasɛ menyɛ binary a? (
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusu nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ kuo a  yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ United Nations anaa World Health Organization  adi nkitaho de anya wiase nyinaa nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ASRH ho so nsunsunaso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ kuo a  yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ United Nations anaa World Health Organization Ahyehyɛde adi nkitaho de anya wiase nyinaa nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) ho so nsunsuanso wɔ: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatu ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde bɛkamfo nkurɔfo a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ahu ASRH nsɛm na wɔahyɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ho nkuran wɔ wiase nyinaa. Amanaman ntam nhyiamu, nhyiamu, ne nkɔmmɔdie a wɔkɔ a wɔresi gyinaeɛ wɔ ASRH ho na wɔakamfo akwan a ɛfa mmabun nyinaa ho. Social media ne digital platforms a wɔde bedi dwuma de ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma titire a wɔwɔ amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ mu adi nkitaho na wɔama mmabun nne ne wɔn adwene ayɛ kɛseɛ. Wɔne nkitahodi ahorow a mmabun di anim ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako de ayɛ adwuma abom de adi mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nnipa bom no adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka akwan horow a wɔaka abom a wɔfa so bɔ ahobammɔ abien ne nea eye ne nea enye ho asɛm.
answer_twi_source: Dual protection combos a wɔtaa de di dwuma ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ni: Kɔndɔm + Awoɔ ntentenee aduro: Nea eye: Ɛyɛ adwuma yie paa; ɛbɔ wo ho ban firi nyinsɛn ne nna mu nyarewa nyinaa ho. Nea ɛnyɛ: Ɛhyehyɛ wo sɛ wobɛnom aduro no da biara; aduro no betumi de nsunsuansoɔ bɔne aba wo nipadua mu. Kɔndɔm + Aduro a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu: Nea eye: Ɛsiw nyinsɛn kwan yie paa koraa; kɔndɔm no nso ma ahobammɔ foforo firi nna mu nyarewa ho.Nea ɛnyɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ wokɔhu dɔkota na wode ahyɛ wo ho anaasɛ wayi afiri hɔ. Spermicide + Akwan a wɔfa so siw kwan: Nea eye: Ɛma ahobammɔ foforo de siw nyinsɛn kwan ka akwan afoforo no ho. Nea ɛnyɛ: Spermicide betumi ayɛ nwini na ayɛ nnipa bi yaw; ɛmmɔ obi ho ban firi nna mu nyarewa ho. Kae sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ wo dɔkota na woahu akwan mmienu a wobɛbom afa so abɔ wo ho ban a ɛfata w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya mmoa ne afotuo ama awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow, a afotu a wɔde ma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so nyinsɛn ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi anya mmoa ne afotuo wɔ awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho, a nyinsɛn ho afotu a wɔde ma ka ho, denam abusua nhyehyɛe ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so. Nyinsɛn ho afotu ma mmabun nya nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa a wɔde besisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nyinsɛn ho, a akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ awofo, agyede, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de afotu a ɛnyɛ atemmu, kokoamsɛm a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne awo hokwan ahorow ma. Mmabun betumi ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi asusuw wɔn haw ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne nsɛmmisa ho na wɔanya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne osuahu ne nsɛnnennen a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm taa hyia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu no bi?
answer_twi_source: Honam fam Akwanside ahorow: Ntrɛwmu a ɛnsɛ, apon teateaa, anaasɛ aguaree a wotumi kɔ hɔ a enni akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Nkitahodi Akwanside: Mum kasa asekyerɛfo, mfiridwuma a ɛboa, anaa nkyerɛwee akɛse akyerɛw a wonni. Animhwɛ a Wonnim: Ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kura adwene a ɛnteɛ wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ho, na ɛde ɔhwɛ a ɛnfata ba. Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm ho Nimdeɛ a Wonnya: Ebia wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nnim ahiade pɔtee bi a ɛfa dɛmdi ahorow bi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne animtiaabu a ɛfa adwene mu apomoden ho, na ɛka mmaabun dɛn? (aniwu, tew a wɔtew wɔn ho, suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa) .
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu yɛ adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa gyidi a ɛma nkurɔfo ani wu anaa wɔn ani wu wɔ biribi ho. Sɛ ɛba adwene mu apomoden ho a, animtiaabu betumi ama mmaabun ate nka sɛ biribi asɛe wɔ wɔn ho esiane dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa nsɛnnennen afoforo a wohyia nti. Nkɛntɛnso a Aniwude De Ba: Aniwu ne Tew a Wɔtew Wɔn Ho: Ahobammɔ betumi ama wɔate aniwu ne tew a wɔatew wɔn ho, na ama ayɛ den ama mmabun sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn nsa akɔhwehwɛ mmoa. Suro a Wosuro sɛ Wɔbɛhwehwɛ Mmoa: Suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔrente wɔn ase yiye no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa a ebia wobehia afi adwumayɛfo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nna mu akwahosan pa?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma no ho hia na ama wɔakura nna mu akwahosan pa mu efisɛ ɛboa ma wosiw STI ne HIV a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu no ano, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, ɛhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ɛfata ho nkuran, na ɛma wonya ahotoso ne nkitahodi wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu. Ɛdenam nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a ankorankoro betumi abɔ wɔn ho ban ne wɔn ahokafo ho ban afi nneɛma bɔne a efi STI ne HIV mu ba te sɛ awo a wontumi nwo, akwahosan ho haw a enni sabea, n'atenka ho haw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ɔsatu ahorow, hashtags, ne asetra mu akuw ahorow a ɛde nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho, ama wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu tumi, na wɔaboaboa mpɔtam hɔfo ano ma wɔayɛ ho biribi atia nna mu basabasayɛ ho nhwɛso ahorow bi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔ mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi mu bi ?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ɔsatu, hashtags, ne asetena mu akuw a ɛde nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne #yolo #noyawa #atuoa. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no anya so tumi, ama nkurɔfo ate nna mu basabasayɛ a abu so no ase, na aboaboa mpɔtam hɔfo ano ma wɔayɛ ho biribi atia wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma wotumi yɛ ayayade no. Mmabun betumi aboa saa mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi denam nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔbɛkyɛ, intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔahyɛ pene amammerɛ ho nkuran so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ananmusifo di wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ wɔ ntetan so, ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nkɔso a ɛba wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a wɔka fa amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo a wɔyɛ papa betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nkɔso mu: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm nhwehwɛmu a wobehunu wo ne ho: Sɛ wuhu sɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm rehwehwɛ wɔn nna mu a, ebetumi ama adeyɛ no ayɛ nea ɛfata na ama woate nka sɛ wɔagye atom. Nnipa a Wobu Wɔn Ho Nkɔanim: Mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ papa betumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu na ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm tumi ahu wɔn ho sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu nnipa. Ahotoso a Wobɛma: Sɛ wuhu nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu a, ebetumi ama ahotoso a wɔwɔ wɔ tumi a wotumi nya ɔdɔ mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na nkurɔfo fa so nya osuahu na wɔda wɔn bɔbeasu "gender identity" adi?
answer_twi_source: Nkurɔfo nya wɔn bɔbeasu "gender identity" ho osuahu na wɔda no adi wɔ akwan horow so. Ebia ebinom bɛte nka sɛ wɔwɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den wɔ atetesɛm mu nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima anaa ɔbea ho no ho, bere a afoforo de wɔn ho hyɛ abien no nyinaa afã horow anaasɛ wɔn mu biara nni mu no ho. Ebia nnipa binom bɛpaw sɛ wɔbɛsakra wɔ asetra mu, aduruyɛ mu, anaa mmara mu de ama wɔn bɔbeasu a ɛne wɔn asetra mu osuahu ahyia, bere a ebia afoforo rente nka sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wɔsakra koraa. Ɛho hia sɛ yehu sɛ ɔkwan pa biako biara nni hɔ a wɔfa so nya ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu osuahu anaa wɔda no adi, na onipa biara akwantu yɛ soronko. Kae sɛ wɔ tumidi bi mu no, ɔmanfo ne amammerɛ na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛda ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama sika mmoa ama SRH dwumadie wɔ mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Kasa ma/krataa-twerɛ 'campaign'. Ne Dɛmdifoɔ kuo 'NGOs/OPDs' nyɛ adwuma. Nhwehwɛmu. Si Nkabom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ awo hokwan ne ahofadi a mmabun wɔ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya wɔ awo hokwan ne ahofadi a mmabun wɔ ho no bi ne gyidi ahorow a ɛne sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa ntumi nsi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ho anaasɛ awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ hyɛ nna mu dwumadi ho nkuran. Wobetumi afa nhomasua so adi saa anansesɛm ahorow yi ho dwuma, de nsɛm a edi mu ama wɔ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wobenya nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na aban ahorow, ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ankorankoro adwumayɛkuo ahorow ntam fekubɔ betumi aboa ma apɔwmuden mu nsonsonoe so atew na wɔahyɛ pɛyɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu?
answer_twi_source: Aban ahorow, ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ankorankoro adwumayɛkuo ahorow ntam nkitahodi betumi aboa ma akwahosan mu nsonsonoe so atew na ama pɛyɛ anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu denam mmoa mu nneɛma a wɔbɛka abom, mmɔdenbɔ ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne mmabun nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔka wɔn ho nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ a ɛde awo apomoden ho nnwuma ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wohunu mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛde awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie ma mmabun a, susuw anammɔn a ɛdidi soɔ yi ho: Abɛɛfo ntentan anaa Intanɛt so hwehwɛ: Fa nhwehwɛmu mfiri ne intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma hwehwɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtwe adwene si mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden so wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow: Kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ apomoden dwumadibea anaa ɔmanfo apomoden adwumayɛbea hɔ na bisa mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde si mmabun so ho asɛm. Fa wo nsa ka adwumayɛfoɔ akwankyerɛ wɔ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ te sɛ 0540-118-999, PPA’s Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) Sukuu anaa kɔlege nneɛma: Hwɛ wo sukuu anaa kɔlege fotufoɔ, ɔyarehwɛfoɔ, anaa apomoden asoɛeɛ na hwɛ sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ma mmabun yɛ adwuma bom anaa. Mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, mmabun akuw, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene asi mmabun nkɔso so no nkyɛn na bisa awo apomoden nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔde ma ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na apomuden ho nimdeɛ a enni hɔ (limited health literacy) ka SRH mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛde nteaseɛ bɔne ba. Wɔnnya mmoa ntɛm. Nyinsɛn ne STIs kɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛkyerɛ awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie ma mmabun wɔ me man anaa me mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe pɔtee a ɛfa awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun no gu ahorow wɔ ɔman anaa ɔmantam biara mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne mmara ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so sɛ wɔbɛsa wɔn yare, apomoden ho nsɛm a wɔde sie, nyinsɛn ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma a wobenya, awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ahwehwɛde ahorow, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no yiye na ama woate hokwan ahorow a wowɔ ne nnwuma a wubetumi anya ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn adi dadwen anaa ɔsɔretia a efi ankorankoro a ebia wonnim adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔde edinnsiananmu di dwuma a ɛboro ɔno so no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana mu no, amanmmra no gye binary gender nkutoo tom a she/he edinnsiananmu nkutoo na ɛka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’abusua akasa afa nna ne abusuabɔ ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛkyerɛ obu ama yɛn amammerɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ aseɛ kakra. Hwɛ sɛ wɔpɛ anaa. Hwehwɛ nkabom (obu). Fa 'me' nsɛmfua di dwuma.'. Nya aboterɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa ka mmarima ne mmaa nna ho nsusuwii ho asɛm, na adwene a ɔmanfoɔ wɔ fa mmarima su ne mmaa su ho no sɛe nsɛmfua a yɛde ka yɛn ho ne afoforo ho asɛm no sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Kasa da amammerɛ mu anidasoɔ (mmarima su/mmaa su) adi/hyɛ mu den. Etumi hyɛ nyiyimu 'stereotypes'/nna dwumadie mu den. Saa nteaseɛ yi boa ma yɛkasa yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu kyɛfa a mmabun nya tumi ma wɔkasa wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ne wɔn anigyede ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu kyɛfa a wonya no ma mmabun tumi wɔ nne a wɔma wɔn, wɔn suahu ahorow a wogye tom, na wɔma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wuranom ne wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho asɛyɛde. Ɛma wotumi kamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow kyerɛ, kasa tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim, hwehwɛ nnwuma a ɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun, na ɛma wɔn a wosi gyinae no bu akontaa sɛ wobedi wɔn ahiade ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ kwan bi wɔ afotu a wɔde ma wɔ STI/HIV ano a wosiw ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ afotuo a ɛfa STI/HIV ano aduro ho mu no, wobɛtumi ahwɛ kwan sɛ: Ahintasɛm: Wɔbɛdi wo kokoam nsɛm so, na nkɔmmɔdie nyinaa bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoamsɛm. Nhwehwɛmu: Ɔfotufo no bebisa nsɛm afa wo nna ho abakɔsɛm, wo nneyɛe, ne nea ɛhaw wo ho de asusuw asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ wo ho no ho. Nhomasua: Wo nsa bɛka nsɛm a ɛfa STIs, HIV, akwan a wɔfa so nya ɔyare no, akwan a wɔfa so siw ano, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Botae a wode besisi w’ani so: Wo ne ɔfotufo no bɛbom ahu botae ahorow na moayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛma woatumi asiw ano a egyina w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ so. Mmoa: Wubenya hokwan abisa nsɛm, ada nea ɛhaw wo adi, na woanya nkate fam mmoa wɔ tebea a ɛnyɛ atemmu mu. Di akyi: Ɛgyina w’ahiadeɛ so no, wobɛtumi ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ama akyire ahwɛ de ahwɛ nkɔsoɔ, adi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma, na woayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ wo nhyehyɛeɛ a wode siw ano no mu sɛdeɛ ɛhia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonya no yɛ nea obu wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonya no yɛ nea obu wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn denam: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ osuahu a wɔne mmerante ne mmabaa yɛ adwuma na wɔatete wɔn wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu no so. Nkitahodi a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bedi nkitaho pefee na wɔadi nokware afa wɔn ahiade, nea ɛhaw adwene, ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm ne ahofadi di dwuma a wɔbɛka akyerɛ, na sɛ wohyia atemmu anaa animtiaabu biara a, wɔmfa obu nni dwuma. Nsɛm a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mmeae ahorow wɔ wɔn suahu ahorow ho, a ɛyɛ papa ne nea enye nyinaa, de aboa ma ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma mmabun nyinaa no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no, nya ɔmanfo adwene ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmarimayɛ, ɔbeayɛ, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho di dwuma titiriw wɔ ɔmanfo adwene ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ no mu. Wɔhyɛ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmarimayɛ, ɔbeayɛ, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho mu den, na wonya sɛnea ankorankoro bu wɔn ho ne afoforo so nkɛntɛnso. Saa gyinabea ahorow yi boa ma wɔhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsusuwii hunu ne "heteronormativity" mu den, na ɛhyehyɛ suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne abusuabɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkate mu nsakrae a ɛtaa ba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no bi ne dɛn, na mɛyɛ dɛn agyina ano?
answer_twi_source: Nsesaeɛ a ɛba obi suban ne ne nkaeɛ mu wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ mu no bi ne; sesaeɛ a ɛba n’anigyeɛ ne ne werɛhoɔ mu mpo prɛko pɛ, nkateɛ a emu yɛ den paa, ne fɛreɛ a obi bɛfɛre ne ho wɔ afoforɔ anim. Kwan a yɛbɛtumi afa so agyina ano no bi ne; sɛ wobɛne anyɔnkofoɔ anaa abusuafoɔ a woboa wo abɔ nkɔmmɔ, wobɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo te sɛ apɔmuden ntentene anaasɛ adeɛ bi a w’ani gye ho yɛ, na sɛ ɛho hia nso a, wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri afotufoɔ anaa adwene mu nyarewa ho animdifoɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa bi a wɔfa so di adwennwen ne dadwen a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho hyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu daa, te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa yoga, na ama adwennwen so atew na ama woanya ahomegye. Fa akwan horow a wɔfa so gye w’ahome te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ, adwennwen, anaa ntini a ɛma wo ho dwo nkakrankakra di dwuma. Hwehwɛ asetena mu mmoa fi nnamfo, abusuafo, ne mmoa akuw hɔ na woakyɛ wo haw ahorow na woanya adansedi ne nkuranhyɛ. Tow nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba, te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma boro so anaa nkɛntɛnso bɔne a wɔde di dwuma no ano hye, na fa w’adwene si dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigye ne abotɔyam brɛ wo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne atemmu ho suro a efi apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo anaa abusuafo hɔ no ha ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no so nkɛntɛnso, na dɛn na wobetumi ayɛ de ayɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma akwaaba, ɛnyɛ atɛn, na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne atemmu ho suro betumi aka ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe no kɛse. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛboa obia, ɛnyɛ atemmu, na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi: de Ahintasɛm Ama: Wɔama mmabun awerɛhyem sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm ne kokoam ahobammɔ so na ama suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ abusua mufo no so atew. Fa nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade soronko ne nea wɔpɛ ma, a nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔbɛyɛ de apaw wɔn, kokoam nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne nhomasua nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ka ho. Ntetee a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma: Fa ntetee ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ sɛnea wobedi animtiaabu ne nyiyim ho dwuma, ɔhwɛ nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne abusuabɔ a ahotoso wom a wɔbɛma wɔne ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no anya nkɔso ho. Mpɔtam hɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Fa wo ho hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ mpɔtam hɔfo mu de ama nkurɔfo ate nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho ase na wɔatew animtiaabu a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a wɔhwehwɛ ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ano aduru biara a wode siw nyinsɛn ano se yɛ edwuma fa?
answer_twi_source: Etu mpɔn kɛse paa (>99%): IUD, yɛde hye wɔ mu ' Implant ', Awoɔ-twa mpɔn kɛse paa 'Sterilization Effective' (91-98%): Awo ano aduru a wɔde siw ano, Patch, Ring, nnea yɛde wura wɔ mu Injectables a etu mpɔn kɛse (71-88%): Nea abrofo fre no 'Diaphragm, Cervical Cap'. Nea Ɛnyɛ Ntu mpɔn (79%): Mmarima Kɔndɔm (Wɔtaa de di dwuma) .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase adeye ne nkabom (global initiatives and partnerships) bɛboa atia amammerɛ mpaepaemu a ɛwɔ yen mmabun ho wɔ nna apomuden nhyehyeɛ na mbraye ho?
answer_twi_source: Wiase adeye ne nkabom (global initiatives and partnerships) bɛtumi aboa atia amammerɛ mpaepaemu a ɛwɔ yen mmabun ho wɔ nna apomuden nhyehyeɛ na mbraye ho sɛ wɔbetumi ama  ɛfa 'technical' ho, sika (funding), nteteeɛ (capacity-building), ne nimdeɛ. na ɔkyerɛ obu ma mpɔtam no tumidifo (autonomy) na wɔma wɔn kwan ma wɔdi anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na mmerante ne mmabaa bɛtumi afa adwenem-nsɛmpɛ (reflection), nsɛm a wɔkyerɛw gu nhoma mu (journaling), ne adwene-mu-sa (therapy) so anya ntease pa wɔ sɛnea wɔn nkae ne wɔn nneyɛe kɔ ne sɛnea ɛsesa?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii: Bere a wobegye de asusuw wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn nkate, ne wɔn nneyɛe ho wɔ tebea horow mu de ahu nhwɛso ahorow ne nea ɛkanyan wɔn. Atwerɛ mu Mpuntuo: Nsusuwii, nkate, ne osuahu ahorow a wɔkyerɛw gu nhoma mu de di nhwɛso ahorow akyi, nya nhumu, na wodi nkate ahorow ho dwuma. Ayaresa: Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo hɔ de ahwehwɛ nkate horow mu, anya wo ho nimdeɛ, na woayɛ akwan horow a wobɛfa so agyina ano a wode bedi nkate horow ho dwuma. Adwene mu Nneyɛe: Adwene mu nsusuwii anaa dwumadi ahorow a egyina adwene so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ahwɛ nkate ahorow a ɛnyɛ atemmu na ama wo ho a wohu no akɔ soro. Nsɛm a wɔka a wobetie: Mmabun betumi asan ahwɛ wɔn nkate mu denam nsɛm a wobegye afi abusuafo ne nnamfo hɔ na wɔayɛ ho adwuma no so. Saa nneyɛe yi boa mmabun ma wohu nneɛma a ɛkanyan nkate, te nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ ase ase, na wonya akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano a wɔde bedi nkate mu nhyehyɛe so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ amanaman ntam mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kasa ma nna ne awo hokwan ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ amanaman ntam mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban denam ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, amanaman ntam nhyiam ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ, wiase nyinaa ɔsatu ne akuw a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔne amanaman ntam 'NGO' ahorow ne 'UN' nnwumakuw a wɔyɛ biako, dijitaal nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ ɔman ne amanaman ntam no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkabom ne biakoyɛ bɛn na ɛda nhwehwɛmufoɔ, mmara hyehyɛfoɔ, akwahosan adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mbabaa ntam a ɛhwɛ ma nhwehwɛmu mu nsunsuansoɔ dan dwumadi ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛboa mmofra?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔdie ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛda nhwehwɛmufoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mmabun ntam no ho hia na wɔakyerɛ nhwehwɛmu mu nsɛm ase akɔ akwan ne dwumadie a wɔbɛtumi de adi dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhyehyɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔdie ne nkabom a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no yɛ adwuma bom de kyekyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu, ma nkurɔfoɔ te ASRH nsɛm so, na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so. Nhwehwɛmu nkitahodi a egyina nneyɛe so: Adwumayɛfo ne nhwehwɛmufo ne mmabun di nkitaho de kyerɛ nhwehwɛmu nneɛma a ɛho hia, wɔbom yɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, na wɔde ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma na wɔsɔ hwɛ wɔ wiase ankasa tebea horow mu. Mmabun ne mpanyin fekubɔ: Mmabun ne mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo a nhwehwɛmufo ne nnuruyɛfo ka ho yɛ adwuma de bom yɛ nimdeɛ, yɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a ɛfata mmabun, na wɔkamfo akwan a ɛfa mmabun ho a wɔfa so yɛ ASRH.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsakrae ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ nnam, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ nneɛma, ne wɔn a wɔko ma asetra mu nsakrae pa kyerɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne akyirikyiri?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua wɔ sukuu ahorow mu ma mmabun tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ nnam, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ nneɛma, ne wɔn a wɔko ma asetra mu nsakrae pa kyerɛ denam: Hokwan a wɔbɛma asuafo anya hokwan ayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa asetra mu nsɛm ho, ɛma nne ahorow a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye, na ɛma tema, nkabom, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran. Asuafoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne digyital nhyiamu nni dwuma mfa nko ma nneɛma a ɛdwene ho, mma nkurɔfoɔ te nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho nsɛm ase, na wɔnhyɛ ɔsatuo a ɛwɔ fam ase mma nsakraeɛ pa. Asuafoɔ a wɔhunu wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛtumi ama nsakraeɛ aba wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne akyirikyiri no mu atenka a ɛbɛma wɔatumi apaw nea wɔpɛ, wɔn ankasa tumidi, ne ɔmanfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Ɛdenam tumi a wɔma mmabun ma wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ di dwuma sɛ adwinnade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, nsɛm a wɔka, ne asetra mu nsakrae so no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho adesua ma awo ntoatoaso a ɛyɛ ɔman mma a wɔpɛ asetra mu nsɛm na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔmanfo mu no nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi anya ahoɔden ne akwan a mɛfa so agyina adwennwen kɛse, ehu, anaa adwene mmienu mmienu a ɛfa nna mu ahoɔden ho, a mmoa a mɛhwehwɛ afiri mpanyimfoɔ a megye wɔn di hɔ, akwan a mɛfa so asiesie m'ahaw, ne home-gyeɛ a mɛyɛ ho nteteeɛ ka ho?
