answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛma wotumi agyina ano na woatumi agyina adwennwen kɛse, ehu, anaa adwene mmienu mmienu a ɛfa nna mu ahoɔden ho gyina wɔ: Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ: Kɔ mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn ma wonya akwankyerɛ, awerɛhyem, ne nokwasɛm ho nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne asiane ahorow a wodi ho dwuma ho. Akwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano a wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Fa ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ, wo ho a wobɛka no yiye, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa adwene a wɔde si biribi so di dwuma de tew adwennwen so na di dadwen a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma. Wo ho a wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ: Sua nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti, akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so siw STI ano ho ade na ama ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ tumi a wode besisi gyinae a ɛfata na woabɔ wo yiyedi ho ban no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asiane ho adwene, na ɔkwan bɛn so na enya gyinaesi ahorow a misi wɔ me nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Asianeɛ ho nteaseɛ (Risk perception) kyerɛ sɛnea ankorankoro hu na wɔsusu asianeɛ anaa nneɛma bɔne a ebetumi afiri nneyɛeɛ bi mu aba. Wɔ nna mu ne awoɔ ho akwahosan mu no, asianeɛ ho nteaseɛ nya gyinaesi a mmabun si fa nna mu nneyɛeɛ, awoɔ ntotoeɛ nnuru (contraception) a wɔde bɛdi dwuma, ne nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho banbɔ so tumi.Ɛka sɛnea wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ banbɔ nneyɛeɛ mu, te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde bɛdi dwuma, na ɛkyerɛ nso sɛ wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ asianeɛ mu a ebetumi aka wɔn honam fam akwahosan, wɔn adwene mu yiyedi, anaa nkitahodie a wɔne afoforo wɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ne kwan so sɛ nna mu nsesaeɛ bɛba bere a mereyɛ anyin?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Honam mu nkwammoa nsakrae ahorow (hormonal changes) , ɔbrɛ, bere a wɔde tra telefon so (screen time), ne kɔfe (caffeine) nso haw nna.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo ho no di mmabun ahiade ahorow nyinaa ho dwuma, a wɔn nipadua, nkate, ne asetra mu yiyedi ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkabom di mmabun ahiade ahorow nyinaa ho dwuma denam: Ɔhwɛ a edi mũ a wɔde ma a wosusuw honam fam, nkate fam, ne asetra mu akwahosan a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nkitahodie ho. Nneɛma a ɛhyɛ aseɛ te sɛ adwenemyareɛ, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa a ɛka STI/HIV asiane ne ne siw ano a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma. Mmoa dwumadie te sɛ afotuo, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, ne adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn kɔma mmabun a wɔrehyia nkateɛ anaa adwene mu haw. Nkitahodie pa, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam nhomasua ne tumidi dwumadi ahorow so. Tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmu a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho nkɔmmɔ na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛyɛde ahorow bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne aguade ho dawurubɔfo wɔ wɔ nipadua mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware na egu ahorow a wɔyɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aboa ma nipadua ho mfonini pa anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne aguade ho dawurubɔfo wɔ asɛyɛde ahorow wɔ nipadua mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware na egu ahorow ho mfoniniyɛ mu denam: Wɔbɛkwati mfonini a wɔde abɛɛfo afidie asesa no kwan so anaa mfonini a ɛnyɛ nokware a ɛhyɛ ahoɔfɛ bi a obiara ntumi nnya ho nkuran, na ɛma nkurɔfoɔ nya abasamtuo wɔ wɔn nipadua ho. Wɔbɛda nnipa nipadua ahorow, mmusuakuo, mmarima ne mmaa, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ahorow adi wɔ abasɛm ntentan so de akyerɛ sɛ obiara ka ho. Wɔbɛhyehyɛ dawurobɔ ne dwa ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhyɛ nipadua ho nkuran na wɔakwati nnipa mmerɛwyɛ a wɔde bɛdi dwuma anaa amanneɛmmoɔ a ɛpira nkurɔfoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn na abɛɛfo amanneɛbɔ bɛtumi aboa mmebun a w'adi dɛm awoasɛm ho apɔmuden?
answer_twi_source: ɛma nkurɔfo  hu wɔn haw. ɔnam nsɛm so sesa gyinapɛn ahorow. Wɔde ko hwehwɛ mmra  nsesae .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo adwene ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne awo akwahosan ho boa ma wɔyɛ animtiaabu ne nyiyimu tia ankorankora, titiriw wɔn a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ LGBTQ + anaasɛ wɔwɔ awo mu osuahu ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ɔmanfo adwene ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne awo akwahosan ho no boa kɛse ma wɔyɛ animtiaabu ne nyiyim tia ankorankora, titiriw wɔn a wohu anaa wɔwɔ nna ne awo mu osuahu ahorow. Nsusuwii hunu te sɛ atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow, heteronormativity, ne nna ho adwene abien betumi ato ankorankoro a wɔn nipasu ne wɔn osuahu ahorow ne saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi nhyia no ato nkyɛn na wɔayi wɔn afi mu. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo ho mfonini a enye a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm mu no hyɛ animtiaabu ne nyiyim mu den bio, na ɛma animhwɛ ne adwemmɔne a epira kɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina 'peer pressure' (nnamfo nhyɛsoɔ) ano wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho to wo nkate ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow so, sɛ ɛsono w’atipɛnfo anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow mpo a. Fa nnamfo a wɔboa wo gyinaesi ahorow na wobu w’ahye ahorow no twa wo ho hyia. Hwehwɛ nhwɛso pa a wɔde gyinaesi a asɛyɛde wom ne adwene pa a wonya wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ, a afotu, mmara kwan so mmoa, ne mmoa akuo ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔanya nna mu basabasayɛ no bi ne afotu adwumayɛbea, ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, mmara kwan so mmoa, ne mmoa akuo. Ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ asetena mu yiedie dwumadibea, DOVSU, akuo a wɔkasa ama wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasayɛ, ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ de kokoamu mmoa ne mmoa ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, na ɛboa wɔn ma wɔsa yareɛ na wɔdi ɔhaw a ebia wɔbɛhyia no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn  anya ayersa mmoa  bere a wapɔn adwuma  anaa sɛ anim anim ayersa mmoa wɔ mmabun akwaa apɔmuden beae, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma awo akwaa apɔmuden ho ahiade ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nnɔnhwerew akyi hwɛ anaa anim anim ayaresa mmoa a wobenya wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun mu no hwehwɛ akwan horow pii: Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔhwɛ wɔn a ɛyɛ ogya so : Akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow pii de ɔhwɛ a egye ntɛm ntɛm  ma wɔ adwumayɛ bere a wɔtaa yɛ no akyi ma aduruyɛ mu haw ahorow a ɛnyɛ nea ɛde nkwa to asiane mu, a awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ka ho. Dwumadibea ahorow a wɔhwɛ ntɛm so: Ayaresabea ahorow wɔ dwumadibea ahorow a wɔhwɛ ntɛmpɛ so a wɔhwɛ tebea horow a emu yɛ den anaa ɛde nkwa to asiane mu, a awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a egye ntɛmpɛ ka ho. Nhyehyɛ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Telehealth dwumadie: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ binom de telehealth dwumadie ma, na ɛma wo kwan ma wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ bi susuw ho wɔ akyirikyiri wɔ nneɛma a ɛhaw wo ntɛm te sɛ STI sɛnkyerɛnne anaa nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen, anohyeto, ne hokwan ahorow bi a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee bɛka nhomasua nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so, adesua tebea a ɛnyɛ mmara kwan so, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ awo ne nna akwahosan (ASRH), nnipa hokwan ahorow, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen ne Hokwan a ɛwɔ Nhomasua mu: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee a wɔde bɛka nhomasua nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so, adesua tebea a ɛnyɛ ɔkwan pa so, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim ho no de nsɛnnennen te sɛ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no anohyeto, ɔsɔretia a efi wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no hɔ, asetra mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow renboa ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ba. Nanso, ɛma hokwan ahorow nso de ma mmabun tumi sɛ wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho yiye, ɔman mma a wɔyɛ nnam, ne nsakrae ho adwumayɛfo. Ɛnam sɛ wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ahodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔafa nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan foforɔ so no, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ adesua tebea a ɛka obiara ho a ɛma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee wɔ awo ne nna akwahosan (ASRH) nhomasua mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma m'afa abusuabɔ pa mu?
answer_twi_source: Planned Parenthood: https://www.plannedparenthood.org/learn/relationships Scarleteen: https://www.scarleteen.com/ (Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ne abusuabɔ ho afotu a ɛfata) Love is Respect: https://www.loveisrespect.org/ (Abusuabɔ ho telefon a ɛma apɔwmuden) The Trevor Project: https://www.thetrevorproject.org/ (Ma LGBTQ+ mmabun) YMK App a Ghana Akwahosan Dwumadibea yɛe wɔ Google Playstore so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sika fam mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatua nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ka?
answer_twi_source: Ebia sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatua nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ka. Ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ahu ni: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): Ebia wɔde sika fam mmoa bɛma anaasɛ wonim nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ saa. wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔwmuden ho ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔwɔ apɔwmuden adwumayɛbea hɔ no nni nkitaho na woanya mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ yiye wɔ ho wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ayɔnkofa anaa ayɔnkofa tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ yiye wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ayɔnkofa anaa ayɔnkofa tebea horow mu no bi ne: Nhyɛso a wɔbɛhyɛ wo ma woakyɛ w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm anaasɛ wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu yɛ den ntɛmntɛm dodo. Wo hye a wobɛbu w’ani agu so anaasɛ wobɛma woate nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ. Suban a ɛne ne ho nhyia anaasɛ ɛyɛ adwenem naayɛ a ɛma adwenem naayɛ sɔre wɔ onipa no adwene anaa ne nipasu ho. Adagyaw mfonini ne nguamansɛm mu nsɛm a wobebisa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na metumi ayɛ de ada me bɔbeasu adi wɔ ɔkwan a mɛte nka sɛ eye ma me so? (ntade, edinnsiananmu, asetra mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm mu ahorow ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma ahorow bɛn na wɔn a wɔrehwɛ no betumi adi wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano, te sɛ nea wɔde wɔn ho gye mu denneennen, adwene a wɔde twetwe, nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ obi nsa, anaa mmoa a wɔde ma nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu mmuae a ɛfata wɔ tebea bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔrehwɛ no betumi adi dwuma ahorow wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano mu, a egyina tebea no ne wɔn ahotɔ dodow so. Saa dwumadie yi bi ne sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen de asɛe nneyɛeɛ a epira anaasɛ wɔyi deɛ ɔbɛtumi ayɛ no bɔne no afiri tebea no mu, wɔde biribi a ɛtwetwe adwene bɛba de atew nhyɛsoɔ so anaasɛ wɔbɛtwe adwene afiri tebea no so, wɔde asɛdeɛ bɛhyɛ atumfoɔ anaa mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di a wɔbɛtumi de wɔn ho agye mu yie nsa, anaasɛ wɔde mmoa ne awerɛkyekyerɛ bɛma nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no wɔ asɛm no akyi. Mmabun betumi ahu mmuae a ɛfata sen biara denam asane dodow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, wɔn ankasa ahobammɔ ne nea wobetumi asusuw ho, na wɔapaw adeyɛ a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne ahotɔ dodow hyia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na metumi de akyerɛ wɔn a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔbesua pii afa nyinsɛnyiguo ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu no wɔka no sɛ 'PPAG website', 'Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health' a wotwa no tia sɛ (GYARH) ne WHO website.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na obu ne awerɛhyɛmu a obiara wɔ ne yɔnko mu di wɔ pene a wɔde besi hɔ na wɔakura mu wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Fapem: Obu ne ahotoso ne nyɔnkofa pa fapem. Mpene ne Obu: Wɔde pene a wɔma wɔn ho wɔn ho di dwuma ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye so. Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ma wonya ahotoso na ɛma ahokafo baanu no nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔate wɔn asɛm. Ahobammɔ: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wobu no na wogye no di a, ɛma wonya tebea a ahobammɔ wom a wobetumi ahwehwɛ nna mu. Ahotoso a Wobɛma Anya: Sɛ wodi ahye so bere nyinaa a, ɛma wonya ahotoso bere kɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me ne me nnamfo ne m’abusuafo ntamu abusuabɔ betumi asesa wɔ nyinsɛn mu ne bere a manyinsɛn akyi?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn betumi aka abusuabɔ a ɛda wo ne nnamfo ne abusuafo ntam: Nsakrae a ɛba wɔ Asetena mu: Ebia wunni ahoɔden pii mma fekubɔ dwumadi ahorow na ebia w’anigyede bɛsakra. Nneyɛe bɔne: Ebia nnamfo anaa abusuafo binom bɛyɛ wɔn ade wɔ ɔkwan a enye so wɔ wo nyinsɛn no ho. Fa wo ho to adɔfo a wɔboa wɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun de abɛɛfo ntetan abasɛm, mfoninitwa, video, podcasting, blogging, social media, ne dijitaal media akwan afoforo di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu, hyɛ nhomasua ho nkuran, na ɛkanyan nkɔmmɔbɔ fa ASRH nsɛmti ho?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo abasɛm: Ankorankoro asɛm, osuahu, ne adansedi a wɔbɛkyɛ de ama ASRH nsɛm ayɛ nnipa na wɔama tema ne ntease anya nkɔso. Mfoninitwa ne video mfonini: Asɛm a wɔde aniwa hu a wɔbɛkyere, mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛw, na wɔada ASRH nsɛnnennen no mu nokwasɛm ahorow adi. Podcasting ne blogging: Nkɔmmɔbɔ, nsɛmbisa, ne animdefoɔ nhumu a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho a wɔbɛgye, de nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a wɔtumi nya na ɛyɛ anigyeɛ ma. Dawurubɔ kuro ntetan ɔkasamafodwumayɛ: Wɔde platform ahorow bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akasa atia animtiaabu, na wɔakasa ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, a ɛbɛma nne ne adwene ahorow ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi anya ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow betumi anya ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom ho no so nkɛntɛnso. Nhwɛsoɔ, gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, tumi a ɛkɔ so, nkitahodi akwan, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho no betumi akyerɛ mmabun gyidi ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka wɔn nkate fam ahiade ahorow ho asɛm akyerɛ afoforo yiye, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahwehwɛ mmoa bere a wɔpere sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔn ho wɔ nkate fam no?
answer_twi_source: Nkate a Wobehu: Wɔn nkate horow a wobehu na wɔakyerɛw wɔn din pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ahiadeɛ a Wɔda no adi: Wɔn nkateɛ ne wɔn ahiadeɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm denneennen, de "Me" nsɛm ne nhwɛsoɔ pɔtee bi adi dwuma. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di te sɛ nnamfo, abusuafo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ. Ahye a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Wɔn nkate fam yiyedi a wɔbɛkasa ama, asisi ahyeɛ a wɔde besi hɔ ne bere a wohia baabi anaa mmoa a wɔbɛda no adi so. Nneɛma a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ te sɛ telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so, mmoa akuw, anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a wode bedi dwuma ama mmoa foforo ne nea wɔagye atom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ yɛde tema di dwuma na yesusuw afoforo ntenka ho bere a yɛrebɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛkyekyere nkitahodeɛ: Tema ma yɛte yɛn ho ase na ɛtwe yɛn bɛn yɛn ho. Sɛ wote deɛ obi foforɔ dwen ho ase a, ɛboa ma mansotwe biara ano brɛ ase.. Obu: Sɛ yegye afoforo nkate tom a, ɛkyerɛ obu na ɛma na ɛma gyidie kɛseɛ ba mo ntam. Asetena mu Nimdeɛ: Tema yɛ asetra mu nimdeɛ titiriw a ɛboa wɔ abusuabɔ ahorow nyinaa mu. Ɛma nkyerɛaseɛ bɔne so tew: Sɛ wodwen obi foforɔ atenka ho a, ɛma nkitahodeɛ bɔne ne akasakasa so tew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahobammɔ abien na dɛn nti na wɔkamfo kyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ahobammɔ abien kyerɛ sɛ wɔde akwan soronko abien a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma bere koro mu. Wɔkamfo kyerɛ efisɛ ɛma ahobammɔ a ɛkorɔn kɛse fi nyinsɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STI) nyinaa ho sen sɛ wɔde ɔkwan biako pɛ bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe anaa amanaman ntam mmoa a wɔde ma ASRH no so tew mu aba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no betumi abom adi saa nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma na wɔakura ahoɔden a wɔde bedu wiase nyinaa ASRH botae ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe anaa amanaman ntam mmoa a wɔde ma ASRH a wɔbɛtew so no betumi de nea efi mu ba a anibere wom aba, a nea ɛka ho ne nnwuma a ɛho hia a wɔbɛtew so, nhyehyɛe no yiyedi a ɛbɛsɛe, ne mmerɛwyɛ a ɛkɔ soro wɔ mmabun mu. Wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no bɛtumi adi saa nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma denam sika a wɔbɛka akyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya sika a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa, sika a wɔbɛnya no ahodoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ tumi a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den, ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔbɛma ayɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma, aban, ɔmanfoɔ, ne ankorankoro adwumayɛkuo ntam. Saa mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom yɛ yi betumi aboa ma wɔakɔ so anya nkɔso a ɛbɛma wɔadu wiase nyinaa ASRH botae ahorow ho ɛmfa ho sɛ sikasɛm mu ahokyere wɔ hɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛmfua bɛn na mede bɛkyerɛ obu ama obi a ɔyɛ a wasesa efri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbaa anaa obarima 'transgender', ne ne dea ɔsɛ ɔnyɛ emu biara 'non-binary'?
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu mmaa anersifo adwumayɛfoɔ anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛka nneɛma a ɛfa apɔnkye ne bɔbe ho asɛm akyerɛ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ menipadua ne obu a mewɔ ma me ho so yie wɔ berɛ a nna mu nsɛm rekɔ soro?(nipadua ho ɔkasa pa, a wɔde wɔn adwene si akwahosan nyinaa so).
answer_twi_source: Nipadua Ho Nkɔmmɔbɔ Pa: Fa w’adwene si nea wo nipadua betumi ayɛ so, na ɛnyɛ sɛnea ɛte ara kwa. Fa wo ho bɔ wɔn a wanisɔ senea wote biaa. Fa W’adwene Si Akwahosan Nyinaa So: Di nnuan a ahoɔden wom, da sɛnea ɛsɛ, na tenetene w’apɔw mu daa na ama woate nka sɛ wo ho ye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea efi animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna (bɔbeasu), ne nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho ba wɔ "LGBTQ+" mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan so?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho no betumi de nsunsuanso a emu yɛ den aba "LGBTQ+" mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan so. Ebetumi ama obi atew ne ho afi afoforo ho, adwenemyare ho nsɛm, okum ne ho, akwahosan ho nnwuma a wɔbɛtew so, a "HIV" a wosiw ano ne nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ka ho, ne asiane a ɛwɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ nnim ne nna mu basabasayɛ a ɛkɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛma mmabun a wɔfi mmeae ahorow anaa mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua bɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu mu?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nnipa nyinaa ka ho na wɔyɛ ahorow ahorow wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu kyɛfa a wonya mu so dua, titiriw ma mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo de gyina pintinn de hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde mmabun a wɔfi mmeae ahorow bɛka nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no ho, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde ananmusifo na wɔde wɔn nyinaa bɛka adesua nhyehyɛe, nnipa a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu, ne nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu nhwehwɛmu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mewɔ hokwan sɛ menya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a nyiyim biara nni ho a egyina nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa asetra ne sikasɛm mu tebea so? (Pɛyɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu) .
answer_twi_source: Saa pɛpɛɛpɛ! Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a nyiyim biara nni ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo akasa afa STI nhwehwɛmu ne nna mu akwahosan ho, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa yɛn ho yɛn ho denam sɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe no so?
answer_twi_source: Fi aseɛ bɔ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ atemmuo fa STI nhwehwɛmu ne nna mu akwahosan ho, na si obuo ne ahotosoɔ a wowɔ ma wo ho wo ho so dua. Monkyerɛkyerɛ Bom: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa STIs, sɔhwɛ akwan, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ho de ma wɔn ho wɔn ho tumi ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata. Mobom Yɛ Nhyehyɛe: Munsusuw bere ne baabi a mobɛsɔ ahwɛ ho, na ka sɛ mobɛka mo ho mo ho akɔ sɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu de ahwehwɛ mmoa. Mmoa Wɔn Ho Mo ho: Yɛ mmoa na te ase wɔ sɔhwɛ no nyinaa mu, a nea ebefi mu aba mfa ho. Fa nkate fam mmoa ne awerɛhyem ma mo ho mo ho, na hyɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi di kan ma ahokafo baanu no nyinaa mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua, a mmaa ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da a broni ka no 'LGBTQ+' mmerante ne mmabaa, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, ne mmabun a wɔte mmeae a wɔboa nnipa ka ho no anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan nhyehyɛe betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata denam akwan horow a wɔde wɔn ani asi so a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfo ne ɔsom a wɔde ma so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a wotumi kɔ hɔ na wɔma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, ne wɔn a wɔte mmeae a wɔboa nnipa. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛtete wɔn ma wɔatumi ayɛ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ na wɔate nnipa ahorow ahiade ase no ho hia yiye. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow nso ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akuw a wɔkamfo wɔn a wogyina mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua ananmu di nkitaho de hu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya na wɔyɛ ano aduru a ɛfata. Nsɛm ne dwumadie a wɔde bɛma denam nea broni ka no 'mobile clinics' so, 'brailles', akenkan a ɛnyɛ den, atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mum kasa asekyerɛfoɔ,ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ akɔka wɔn ho nhyehyɛeɛ so a broni ka no 'community outreach programs' nso bɛtumi aboa ama wɔadu akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua nkyɛn wɔ baabi a wɔwɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mpeneso mfeɛ ho, awofoɔ penebɔ amanneɛ, kokoamsɛm, ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho no ka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow bedi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa mfeɛ a wɔpene so, awofoɔ penebɔ amanneɛ, kokoamsɛm, ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ho no bɛtumi aka mmabun tumi a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahodoɔ mu denam: Akwansideɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛho hia, titire ama mmofra nkumaa ne ankorankoro a wɔfiri mmeaeɛ a mmoa nni hɔ mu. Mmabun kokoam nsɛm, ahofadi, ne kokoamsɛm a wɔsɛe no wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, na ɛde ehu, animtiaabu, ne ɔpɛ a wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ aba. Nsusuii hunu a epira, mmarima ne mmaa ho gyinapɛn, ne tumi a ɛkɔ so a ɛto mmabun awoɔ ho nhyehyɛe ano hyeɛ na ɛma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ wɔ nsɛm ne nnwuma a wonya mu no kɔ so yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotuo nhyiam ahorow betumi aboa me ma mayɛ akwan horow a m’ankasa mɛfa so ayɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom?
answer_twi_source: Afotuo nhyiamu no fa nkɔmmɔdie a wɔbom bɔ wɔ ankorankoro ne afotufoɔ ntam de yɛ akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so yɛ nna mu nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ mu. Afotufoɔ bɛtumi de akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so siw ano ho nsɛm ama, te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, 'PrEP', ne 'STI' nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa. Wobetumi nso aboa ankorankoro ma wɔahu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nyɛ nna a ahobammɔ wom na wɔahwehwɛ ano aduru a wɔde bedi so. Ɛdenam nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔyɛ ma ɛne ankorankoro ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ so no, afotu nhyiam ahorow ma ankorankoro tumi ma wɔfa akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw ano a ɛne wɔn asetra kwan hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛe a asɛyɛde wom?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Obu a wɔde ma kokoam nsɛm ne ankorankoro a wɔayɛ wɔn ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no pene. Kwati sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛkamfo nsɛm a ɛdaadaa nkurɔfo anaa epira. Nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma betumi anya wɔ ankorankoro gyidi, suban, ne nneyɛe so a wobehu. Wobetumi akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛe a asɛyɛde wom denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ ne nhyiam asefo a wɔbɛma wɔabu akontaa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti a wɔde gyina hɔ ma a edi mu na obuo wom ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛe a ɛyɛ abrabɔ pa ho nkuran mu kyɛfa a wobenya. Nnwuma a ɛboa nnwuma a ɛhyɛ dijitaal ɔman bayɛ ne intanɛt so nneyɛe a asɛyɛde wom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa kuo ahwɛfo di wɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no sow aba, ɛkyerɛ obuo, na ɛboa?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa kuo ahwɛfo di dwuma titiri wɔ ahobammɔ ne mmoa tebea a wɔbɛma aba no mu. Wɔkyerɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ kwan, wɔhwɛ sɛ obiara benya hokwan akasa, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔde wɔn ho gye mu de di ntawntawdi ho dwuma anaasɛ wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wobedi kuo akwankyerɛ ahorow so. Ahwɛfoɔ nso de atenka mu mmoa ma, wɔde nneɛma ma, na wɔma nkitahodie a ɛda kuo no mufoɔ ntam no yɛ mmerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu so wɔ STI, HIV, ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da a wobesiw ano ho?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛwɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu so no bi ne: STI ahorow a wɔtew so, a HIV ka ho, denam nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ soro wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano ne akwan a wɔfa so tew asiane so no so. Nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da no dodow so tew denam nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛma so. Nkitahodi ne abusuabɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim, na ɛma wɔne ahokafo di nkitaho yiye na obu wom. Ntease a ɛkɔ soro wɔ pene ne ahye ho, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ nna mu nhyɛso ne basabasayɛ mu no so. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne wɔn yiyedi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ankorankorɔ nteteeɛ ne suahunu ka sɛdeɛ yehu puberty?
answer_twi_source: Abusua ne amammerɛ. Media ne ɔman. Suahunu. Nwomasua. Nyamesom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so asiw nyinsɛn a yɛnhwehwɛɛ ne nyinsɛnyiguo a asane wɔ mu ho kwan bere a asɛm kɛseɛ aba?
answer_twi_source: Akwan ne: sɛ yɛbɛhwɛ ama obiara anya ayaresabea mu kwan. Ayaresa kwan a ɛfa mfideɛ so.  Sɛ yɛ bɛ kora aduru a ɛsi nyinsɛn ho kwan  pii. Apomuden  nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔ mpɔtam mpɔtam
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na asɛm a wɔka no denneennen ho hia na ama wɔatumi ahwɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso so na wɔapaw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ ayɛ bi ?
answer_twi_source: Ka a wobɛka no denneennen ho hia ma atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wobɛfa so akɔ so na woapaw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfata efisɛ ɛma wonya tumi a wode bɛka wo hye, nea wopɛ, ne anohyeto ahorow ho asɛm yiye. Ɛdenam ka a wobɛka no pen so no, wubetumi ako atia nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛne wo gyinapɛn anaa w’awerɛkyekye nhyia mu, akamfo w’ankasa yiyedi, na woasisi gyinae ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu nhyɛso na mɛyɛ dɛn akwati no?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nhyɛso yɛ nhyɛso, ahunahuna, anaa ahoɔden a wɔde di dwuma de ma obi ne no da. Ɛyɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe bi na wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ nsɛmmɔnedi wɔ Ghana. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ obi: Ɔte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ no anaasɛ wɔahunahuna wo. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wunni ahobammɔ anaasɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi. Sɛ obi bow nsa anaasɛ ontumi mpene so. Sɛ wohyia nhyɛso a: Twe wo ho fi tebea no ho. Ka kyerɛ ɔpanyin a wogye no di, wo cal bɔ adolesnet adamfofa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo amanneɛ Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo ntɛm ara kɔhwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu ne akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo. Fa amanneɛbɔ kɔ polisifo adwumayɛbea anaa DOVSU kuw a ɛbɛn wo no nkyɛn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene ne nkate fam nsunsuanso bɛn na ɛwɔ animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho bere a ɔyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi bu obi animtiaa wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho a, ebetumi ma: Aniwu, afobu, ne adwenem naayɛ wɔ ne ho nka, a ɛka obu a ɔwɔ ma ne ho ne adwene mu yiyedi. Dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne fekubɔ a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi afoforo ho esiane suro a wosuro sɛ afoforo bɛpow wɔn anaasɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn nti. Animtiaabu a wɔde hyɛ wɔn mu, baabi a ankorankoro gye gyidi bɔne tom wɔ wɔn ho, na ɛma wobu wɔn ho animtiaa na wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ anaa mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a, wobetumi afa so ayɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu, na sɛ ɛho hia a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya bi a awofo mpene so?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn Sɔhwɛ ne Afotuo 'pregnanc testing': Ayaresabea ne Akwahosan Asoɛeɛ: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ awoɔ akwahosan ayaresabea, abusua nhyehyɛeɛ mmeaeɛ, anaa akwahosan dwumadibea ahodoɔ kɔhwɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu wɔ kokoam. Akwahosan Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Sukuu So: Sukuu ahorow bi de nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu ma. Nnurutɔnbea ahorow: Wobetumi anya nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ho nneɛma a wɔde yɛ fie a wɔtɔn wɔ nnurutɔnbea ahorow. Sɛ Wobɛkɔ a Worennya Awofoɔ Mpene: Kokoamuyɔ: Ayaresabea pii de kokoam nnwuma ma, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔremmɔ w’awofoɔ anaa w’ahwɛfoɔ amanneɛ a wonnyaa wo kwan. Mmara kwan so Hokwan ahorow: Ɛdenam beae a wowɔ so no, mmara betumi ama mmofra nkumaa apene so sɛ wɔnyɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne nnwuma a ɛfa ho a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa mmabun awoɔ hokwan ahorow ne ahofadi ho?
answer_twi_source: Aman pii wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun awoɔ hokwan ahorow ne ahofadi ho pɔtee. Eyinom betumi ayɛ: - Mmara a ɛma mmofra nkumaa kwan ma wɔpene awoɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma bi so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu. - nhyehyeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu. - mmara a ebo mmabun ho ban firi nhyɛsoɔ anaa nhyɛsoɔ a wɔhyɛ wɔn. - Mmara a ɛbɔ kokoamsɛm ho ban wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ awoɔ apɔwmuden ho dwumadie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa akuo anaa intanɛt so akuo betumi adi wɔ nkuranhyɛ ne ntease a wɔde ma mmabun a wohyia adweneho nsɛ mu apomodennnennen no mu?
answer_twi_source: Osuahu a Wɔbɛkyɛ: Asɛnka agua a wɔbɛma mmabun anya wɔn suahu, apereperedi, ne nkonimdi ahorow akyerɛ afoforo a wɔte ase. Gyetum ne moborhun: Wɔde gyetum, tema, ne mmoa a ɛnyɛ atemmuo a ɛfiri atipɛnfoɔ a wɔwɔ osuahu a ɛte saa ara hɔ bɛma. Nsɛm ne Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ: Nsɛm, nneɛma, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne afotu a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a ɛfa adwene mu apomden yareɛ ne yiyedi ho a wɔbɛkyɛ. Tew a Tew Wɔn Ho a Wɔtew So: Tew a wɔatew wɔn ho ho nkate a wɔbɛko atia denam mmabun a wɔde bɛka atipɛnfo kuw bi a wɔboa wɔn a wobetumi ne wɔn suahu ahorow adi nkitaho no so. Nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Anidasoɔ, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne ahotɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nkɔsoɔ ne nsɛnnennen a wɔdi so nkonim ho nsɛm a wɔkyɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na me mmadwoa bɛsiane koraa?
answer_twi_source: Mmarimaa dodow no ara mmadwoa sian kɔ awotwaa no mu ansa na wɔawo wɔn anaasɛ ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi. Sɛ woanhyɛ no nsow sɛ wɔasian koraa mprempren a, wo ne wo duruyɛfo nkasa. Wobetumi ahwɛ biribiara mu na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nneɛma rekɔ so sɛnea ɛsɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodie di wɔ abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodie di dwuma titiriw wɔ abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu denam: Ahokafo a wɔma wɔn kwan ma wɔda wɔn ahiade, nkate, ne wɔn haw adi pefee Ntease, tema, ne apam a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw Ntawantawadi a wɔbɛsiesie wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ ne asomdwoe mu Ahotoso ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛhyehyɛ Ahye ne akwanhwɛ a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔ  bɛfa so de afotuo ne mmoa dwumadie aka nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu mu Afotuo: Fa afotuo a ɛwɔ beaeɛ hɔ a adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi krataa de ma. Fa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu ka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho. Fa baabi a wɔakyerɛ wɔ sukuu no mu ma afotuo nhyiamu. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa Nhyehyɛeɛ: Fa atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo anaa afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ sisi hɔ. Tete asuafo a wɔn mfe akɔ anim ma wɔmfa mmoa ne akwankyerɛ mma atipɛnfo nkumaa. Fa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne adwene mu yiyedi ho ka atipɛnfo mmoa dwumadi ahorow ho. Awofoɔ a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Fa nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu ma awofoɔ na wɔate hia a nna mu akwahosan ho afotuo ho hia ase. Fa nneɛma ne akwan a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma awofoɔ ma wɔanya afotuo dwumadie ama wɔn mma. Mpɔtam Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, anaa adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow nyɛ biako. Yɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a afotuo ka ho. Yɛ mmoa dwumadie ahodoɔ a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi anya. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Yɛ na fa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nhyiamu anaa apps di dwuma na ama woanya virtual afotuo. Nhwɛsoɔ YMK app Fa nsɛm a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ afotuo dwumadie ho ma wɔ sukuu abɛɛfo ntentan anaa mpɔtam hɔ beae so. Ma mmabun kyerɛ baabi, bere ne ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ mmoa. Ma telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so ma afotuo dwumadie a ɛfa awoɔ ne nna mu akwahosan ho te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), ne PPA’s Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) Awareness Campaigns: Yɛ ɔsatuo de hyɛ adwenemyareɛ ho nimdeɛ ne afotuo a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nkuran. Fa nkrataa wɔde kyereɛ nsɛm,  ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn  di dwuma de trɛw afotu adwuma ho nsɛm mu. Ntetee a Wɔde Ma Akyerɛkyerɛfo: Kyerɛkyerɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo ne adwumayɛfo wɔ sɛnea wobehu ahoyeraw ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow wɔ asuafo mu ho. Tete akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ sɛdeɛ wɔde asuafoɔ bɛkɔ afotuo adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ mu yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so fi ase ne wɔn atipɛnfo anaa wɔn ahokafo fi nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho ase wɔ obu ne atemmu mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so fi ase ne atipɛnfo anaa ahokafo bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho wɔ obuo ne atemmu mu no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛpaw bere ne tebea a ɛfata ama nkɔmmɔbɔ no, wɔde nsɛmmisa a wɔabue ano afi ase de ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuran, na wɔde nsiyɛ atie onipa foforo no adwene a wontwa n’ano anaasɛ wommu atɛn. Fa tema, ntease, ne ɔpɛ sɛ wubetie na woasua biribi afi wo ho wo ho no bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden aboafo neɛma anaa mmoa ntam nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makɔ intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow mu na mahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a?
answer_twi_source: Ahomatrofo: Aman pii wɔ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo anaa telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo titiriw wɔ Intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho nsɛm te sɛ kɔmputa so ayayade anaa Intanɛt so ayayade. Wɛbsaet: Wɛbsaet te sɛ "NetSmartz" ne "StaySafeOnline" de afotuo ne nneɛma a ɛfa intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ho ma.  Amanneɛbɔ nteten kuro: Amanneɛbɔ nteten kuro platform dodow no ara wɔ amanneɛbɔ nnwinnade a ɛfa ahobammɔ ho nsɛm ahorow ho. Sukuu Afotufoɔ: Sukuu ayarehwɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ho. Awofo Mmoa: Awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn so betumi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛsom bo; ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wo ne wɔn bɛkasa afa biribiara a ɛhaw wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ bere a wɔrebɔ amanneɛ a ɛfa monaato anaa ayayade ho ?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ amanneɛbɔfo a wɔbɔ amaneɛ a ɛfa monaato anaa ayayade ho deɛ asi pɔtee te sɛ sɛnea ɔhaw no te ne baabi a ɛkɔ, nnipa biara a wɔka ho (te sɛ nea wɔayɛ no bɔne ne nea wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔne no), ne nsɛm biara a ɛfa ho a ɛho hia na ebetumi aboa nhwehwɛmu. Nanso, nsɛm pɔtee a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne amanneɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ebetumi afi mu aba sɛ wɔbɛfa akwan ahorow so wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ ankorankoro, mpɔtam hɔfo, ne ɔmanfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ebetumi afi ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so a wɔbɛfa so anya so no bi ne: Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔapaw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na ɛbɛma akwahosan mu nkɔso ne yiyedi atu mpɔn. Mpɔtamfo ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne asetra mu biakoyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den denam mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, nnipa hokwan ahorow, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn a ɛbata mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛtew so, na ama wɔagye atom kɛse na wɔaka obiara ho. Akontaabuo, nnoɔma a ɛda adi pefee, ne mmuaeɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ ne ne de ma mu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ. Nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛma akɔ anim wɔ wiase nyinaa nkɔsoɔ botaeɛ a wɔadu ho, te sɛ Nkɔsoɔ a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botaeɛ (SDGs) ho, denam hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔrennya obiara wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ akwahosan ne yiedie ho nkuran ama obiara no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne  ɔsom mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne  ɔsom mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho so nsunsuanso wɔ akwan ahorow so. Amammerɛ ne ɔsom ahorow bi si nneɛma a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho ansa na wɔaware so dua, bere a afoforo nso betumi apene akwan pɔtee bi a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano so anaasɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmusua akɛse nkuran. Adwene a wokura wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no betumi ayɛ soronko koraa, efi bara a wɔbara denneennen so kosi gye a wogye tom wɔ tebea horow bi mu, te sɛ bere a ɛna no nkwa da asiane mu anaa wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmonnaato anaa abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da ho. Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no ɛyɛ ahyɛde sɛ wɔbɛka nsɛmti a ɛfa nna ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho asɛm
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛtaa da adi wo STIs mu, na bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun susuw ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: STI a ɛtaa ba no betumi ada sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi adi, nanso ebinom betumi ayɛ nea enni sɛnkyerɛnne biara, titiriw wɔ ne mfiase. Nsɛnkyerɛnne no betumi ayɛ: Nsuo a ɛyɛ soronko a ɛfiri ɔbarima ne ɔbea baabi baabi (genitals) mu a ɛyɛ wɔn yaw aba anaa ɔhyew a ɛba bere a ɔredwonso mu ne ade. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun susuw ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu sɛ wohu saa sɛnkyerɛnne yi bi, wɔanya nna mu kyɛfa a wɔammɔ ho ban, wɔ berɛ a wɔ ne obia ada a woammɔ ne ho ban, anaasɛ wɔ ne nipa beberee na ɛda anaa wɔwɔ nna mu akwahosan ho dadwen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun wɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm a wɔde bedi dwuma ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛsɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun wɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔde di dwuma ntɛm ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Wɔne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo kasa: Mmabun betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe akɔhwɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi, te sɛ oduruyɛfo, ayarehwɛfo oduruyɛfo, anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, na wɔasusuw wɔn nsɛmmisa ho na wɔanya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho. Kɔ nnuruyɛfo nkyɛn: Wɔatete nnuruyɛfo ma wɔde nnuru ho nsem ama, a nea ɛka ho ne nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm, na wobetumi adi nsemmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho no ho dwuma. Hwehwɛ kokoam mmoa: Mmabun betumi akɔ kokoam telefon so telefon so, telefon a wɔde boa, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw so akɔhwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛho nhia sɛ wɔda wɔn ho adi. Hwɛ mmeae a agye din: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so na egyina adanse so a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ho fi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow, nnuruyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhomasua nneɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu gyidi ne atetesɛm ahorow a ɛka mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae ahorow nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhwɛso ahorow bi?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidie ne atetesɛm a ɛka mmabun SRH wɔ mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ ho nhwɛsoɔ bi ne nneyɛeɛ te sɛ awareɛ a wɔware ntɛm, mmaa awotwaa a wɔtwa, nyamesom amanne a ɛkyerɛ nna mu nneyɛeɛ, ahyɛdeɛ a ɛfa brayɛ ho, animtiaabuo, ne atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie a ɛwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ SRH ho nsɛm ne dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn na wopɛ sɛ wofa so di nkitaho fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho - denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ, adwen nkyerɛakyerɛ, anaa intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro ne abusua biara yɛ soronko, enti ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ nkitahodiɛ kwan a ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma wo ne wo awofoɔ nyinaa. Abusua bi betumi apɛ anim ne anim nkɔmmɔbɔ ma nsɛm a ɛyɛ den, bere a afoforo betumi ahunu sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔnam nkyerɛwee anaa intanɛt so bɛdi nkitaho. Wo ne wo awofoɔ nsusu kwan a ɛyɛ ma wɔn na yɛ krado sɛ wobɛsakra a egyina wɔn apɛdeɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: .Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne ntetee betumi aboa ama wɔanya SDG 3 (Akwahosan) ne SDG 4 (Nhomasua) aba mu ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan boa Goal 3 denam yare ne owu a wosiw ano so, ne Goal 4 denam nimdeɛ a wɔde ma de si gyinae pa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, ahwɛfo wɔn, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi adi aboa mmabun sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nkɔso mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔda sika ho su pa adi, wɔka sika a wɔde di dwuma ho asɛm pefee, wɔma hokwan ahorow ma wɔsua firi wɔn hɔ, na wɔboa kyerɛ sikasɛm mu pa ahorow kwan. Wɔnam da biara da dwumadi ahorow so nso kyerɛkyerɛ sika ho nimdeɛ, te sɛ; abusua sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sikasie a ɛwɔ botae, ne nea enti a sika ho hia ne sɛnea wɔbɛyɛ daakye ho sikasɛm nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: dɛn ne nna ho akɔnnɔ na dɛn ne ahorow ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Awiei koraa no, sɛnea obi hu ne nea wɔte nka sɛ wɔtwetwe wɔn ho wɔ ɔdɔ anaa nna mu na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho akɔnnɔ mu. Wɔde nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene a nea ɛka ho ne: Heterosexual: Atwetwe a ɛba ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a ɛne no bɔ abira so na ɛkyerɛ. Mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ. Bisexual: Ɔpɛ a ɛtwetwe ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɛboro biako. Pansexual: Ɔtwetwe adwene a ɔbarima anaa ɔbea mfa ho. Asexual: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ a enni hɔ. Nnipa a Wɔkyerɛ Wɔn Ho:
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so ahu nsɛm a esisi mprempren ne mmara mu nkɔso a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a obi wɔ sɛ wotu nyinsɛn gu ho? (a wodi akuo ahorow a agye din akyi) .
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ayarehwɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ adamfofa su ma mmabun wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn hɔ no nsɛm a ɛfa nea a esisi mprempren ho ma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne mmoa dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na wɔde obu ma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo denam hia a amammerɛ mu nkate ho hia wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde boa nnwuma mu a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔn ankasa osuahu ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛkyɛ, wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔbɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata amammerɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma amammerɛ a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfoɔ mu nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma atipɛnfo nhyɛso dodow a mmabun nya no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow na ɛkyerɛ su horow a wɔwɔ nea ɛne ne ho hyia, ahofadi, ne asetra mu akwanhwɛ ahorow ho. Ɔmanfo nhyɛso te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini a amanfo afa sɛ eno na ɛyɛ fɛ ahorow anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ahoɔfɛ ne nkonimdi ho no betumi ama atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔne nneyɛe anaa asetra kwan ahorow bi hyia no ayɛ kɛse. Abusua mu nkɔso, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne mpɔtam hɔ nkɛntɛnso nso boa ma atipɛnfo nhyɛso dodow ne sɛnea mmabun hyia no ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ mebɔ kɔkɔ fa bɔbea ho basabasayɛ 'GBV' ho sɛ ɛrekɔ so wɔ fie anaa?
answer_twi_source: Bammɔ nni kan (Safety First). Kasa kyerɛ panyin. Frɛ  mmoa 'helpline'. Kɔkɔbɔ tumi siw ano. Mmara bɔ wo ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ mmea ho ayaresa a wobenya ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: nea ɛka ho ne: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, a nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɔ ne ayaresa ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow ka ho. Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho, a nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma ne nna mu dwumadi ka ho. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wonya ɔhwɛ a obu wom na ɛnyɛ nyiyim, a mfe a wadi, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa awo a wɔpaw mfa ho. Sɛ wobɛka hokwan ahorow a wowɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu: Hu mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho a ɛfa mmabun akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ho, te sɛ kokoam mmara ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ahwehwɛde a wɔhwehwɛ. Kamfo w’ankasa akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow kyerɛ denam nsɛm a wubebisa, nsɛm a ɛhaw wo a wobɛda no adi, ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen no so. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa mmara kwan so akamfofo hɔ, sɛ wuhyia nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wunnya mmea ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro wɔ yɛn man mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro no gu ahorow wɔ ɔman anaa ɔmantam biara mu. Wɔ mmeae bi no, mmara ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbara nyiyimu a egyina nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so no pefee, bere a wɔ mmeae afoforo no, ebia ahobammɔ ahorow yi sua anaasɛ enni hɔ. Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ho nhwɛso betumi ayɛ mmara a ɛko tia nyiyimu, nsɛmmɔnedi ho mmara a ɛfa ɔtan ho, ne mmarima ne mmea ntam abusuabɔ a wogye tum denam aware anaa ɔmanfo nkabom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya haw ewɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so mmoa bere biara anaa?
answer_twi_source: Pii yɛ adwuma da mu nu nyinaa. Ebi wɔ bere pɔtee. Hwɛ abɛɛfo ntentan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun no ka nhwɛsoɔ ne nhwehwɛmu 'monitoring and evaluation' a amanehunu berɛ dwumadie a ɛboa nhyehyɛeɛno mu yɛyɛ anaa? Sɛ ɛyɛ saa a, kwan bɛn so?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmabun bɛtumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu denam; ayɔnkofa mu nnwuma anaa afotuo kuo mu ka ho. Amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa nhwehwɛmu anaa anohyetoɔ mu. Wɔn osuahunu ne nsusuiɛ a wɔde bɛma ama adwuma no atu mpɔn.Ne dwumadie ahyehyɛdeɛ adwumayɛfoɔ bɛka bom ayɛ nhwehwɛmu nnwuma ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so yɛ adwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anohyeto ne animhwɛ a ɛbata nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi eyinom ho dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden (ASRH) ho no taa hu amane wɔ anohyeto ne animhwɛ ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nsɛmti a ɛho hia a wɔmmɔ ho amanneɛ yiye anaasɛ wɔmmɔ no yiye esiane asetra mu animtiaabu, amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, ne suro a wosuro sɛ ebefi mu aba nti, na ɛde nsɛm a enni mũ anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nokware ba. Nhwɛsode a ɛfa animhwɛ a ebia ɛbɛma nnipa binom, te sɛ mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wobenya wɔn, afi nhwehwɛmu ahorow mu, na ɛde nsonsonoe ba wɔn ASRH ahiade ne osuahu ahorow ntease mu. Akwan a wɔfa so boaboa nsɛm ano ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a enni hɔ wɔ nhwehwɛmu ahorow nyinaa mu, a ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔde nea wɔahu bɛtoto ho na wɔasusuw nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so wɔ ASRH aba mu bere tenten no ho. Saa anohyeto ahorow yi a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ: Wɔde akwan a wɔadi afra a wɔde dodow nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛmbisa a ɛfa su ho anaa nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu bom di dwuma de kyere adwene ne osuahu ahorow. Abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma de aboaboa nsɛm ano a ɛde mmabun kokoam nsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma di kan. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, a mmabun ankasa ka ho, a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ no mu de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ho ano. Nkɔsoɔ ne akontaabuo a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ data amanneɛbɔ ne nhwehwɛmu mu de abrɛ animhwɛ ase na ama nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no agye adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wɔtew wɔn ho fi afoforo ho anaa ankonamyɛ nya adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso, na dɛn na mmabun betumi ayɛ de ako atia ankonamyɛ ho nkate na wɔama wɔate nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea?
answer_twi_source: Ankonamyɛ: Sɛ obi tew ne ho fi afoforo ho na ɔyɛ ankonam a, ebetumi ama wanya adwenemhaw, adwennwen, ne obu a ɛba fam wɔ ne ho. Mmabun betumi ako atia ankonamyɛ denam wɔn nnamfo anaa wɔn abusuafo a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn, akuw a wɔbɛkɔ mu, nyamesom dwumadi anaa akuw a wɔn ani gye ho a ɛte saa ara a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, atuhoama a wobetu wɔn ho ama, anaasɛ sɛ ɛho hia a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mekwati sɛ mɛbu afoforo atɛn anaasɛ mɛka wɔn ho asɛm wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii hunu betumi de atemmu a ɛnteɛ ne nneyɛe a ɛyɛ yaw aba. Obiara yɛ soronko, na ɛho hia sɛ wuhu nnipa sɛ ankorankoro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mefa amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow a ebetumi anya m’awofo adwene wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Gye w’awofo amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow tom na bu wɔn, bere a woda w’ankasa hia a wuhia sɛ wunya nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nso adi. Wubetumi ayɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no wɔ gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔkyɛ mu, te sɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho, nkitahodi, ne nkitahodie pa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wone w'ahokafo nni nkitaho a ɛmu da hɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne STI ho haw ahorow nhyɛ ho nkuran.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a emu da hɔ na wofi nokwaredi mu ho hia ma abusuabɔ pa, titiri bere a ɛfa nna ho no. Afotu bi ni: Ka wo nna mu akwahosan ne nneɛma a ɛhaw wo ho asɛm pefee. Ka akwan a wopɛ sɛ wofa so bɔ wo ho ban (kɔndom) ho asɛm. Tie wo hokafo haw ahorow na bu wɔn ahye. Bisa nsɛm na bom nya nna mu akwahosan ne STI ho nsɛm. Kae sɛ, abusuabɔ pa hwehwɛ sɛ obiara bu ne yɔnko ne nkitahodi. Nsuro sɛ wobɛkasa ama wo nna mu akwahosan ne ahobammɔ!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛyɛ 'health insurance' (apɔmuden nsi-akyire) ma adi mmabun a wɔhia mmoa no ahiasɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya ‘health insurance’ yiye nam akwan horow a te sɛ sukuu ne wɔn mpɔtam adesua dawuro. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛkyerɛw wo din, na wɔmfa nkrataa pii nyɛ adwuma na wɔde kasa ahorow nso di dwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ insurance tua ɔhwɛ a ɛho hia te sɛ adwenemyare, awo ho ayarehwɛ, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho ayaresa, ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa. Ɛsɛ sɛ ayarehwɛfo no de ayamye hwɛ mmabun na wobu wɔn amammerɛ nso. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmara a ɛfata bɔ obiara ho ban na ɛde mmabun ka gyinaesi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua pii afa ahye a wɔde si apɔwmuden, asɛm a wɔka de hyɛ wɔn ho so, ne wɔn ho a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woasua pii afa ahye a wɔde si apɔwmuden, asɛm a wɔka de hyɛ wɔn ho so, ne wɔn ho a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi ho. Eyinom bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ wɛbsaet, nhoma, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne nkitahodie pa so, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne afotu adwuma a sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow de ma. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu afotufo nso betumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ wo hye a wode besi hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wobɛma anya nkɔso no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nyamesom di wɔ abrabɔ pa ho adwene a wɔde hyehyɛ nsubuo ne nna mu akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ Pa: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ taa de abrabɔ pa ho nhyehyɛe ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛɛ ne nkitahodie ho ma. Kwati: Ɔsom ahodoɔ bi bra nna wɔ berɛ wonwareɛ, na ɛka sɛdea ankorankorɛ susu nna mu akwahosan ho gyinaeɛ. Nyinsɛn a wosi ano: Adwene a yɛ wɔ fa nyisɛn a wosi kwan ne nneɛma a yɛde bɔban wo nna mu da nson wɔ asore nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Animtiabu: Nyamesom di mu akotene wɔ animtiabuo ho sɛ aba no nsɛm bi te sɛ LGBTQ+ nipasu anaa nyinsɛn a woyi guo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ama m’awo nhyehyɛe no ate apɔw?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan Ho Nhwehwɛmu Daa: Kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn daa kɔyɛ awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne awotwaa mu kokoram ho nhwehwɛmu (Pap smears), nufu mu nhwehwɛmu, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ toatoaso. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho no ye efisɛ ahobammɔ wom 100% wɔ nyinsɛn a wɔmpɛ ne STI ahorow a wosiw ano no mu. Fa Ahobammɔ Di Dwuma: Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye bere nyinaa anaasɛ fa akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma na ama woatumi asiw nyinsɛn a wɔmpɛ ano na woatew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yare no so. Fa Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ahobammɔ wɔ mu Di Dwuma: Wo ne wɔn a wɔne wɔn da no nni nkitaho pefee wɔ STI ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho. Yɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu daa, titiriw sɛ wowɔ ahokafo pii a. Asetra a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Di aduan a ɛkari pɛ, teɛteɛ w’apɔw mu daa, ma wo mu duru nyɛ nea ɛfata, na kwati sigaretnom ne nsa a wɔnom boro so. Saa suban ahorow yi hyɛ akwahosan nyinaa ho nkuran, a awo akwahosan ka ho. Hu Wo Nipadua: Hu wo brayɛ, nsakrae a ɛba wo nipadua mu, ne sɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛyɛ soronko. Eyi boa ma wohu nsɛm a ebetumi aba ntɛm. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua awo akwahosan, akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, ne STI ho ade. Nimdeɛ ma wutumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ w’akwahosan ho. Yɛ aso hwɛ wo nipadua no ho nsɛnkyerɛnne. Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkasa. Saa anammɔn ahorow yi betumi aboa wo ma woakura awo nhyehyɛe a ɛfata ne yiyedi nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia na wɔako atia nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna bɔbeasu a broni ka no 'gender-based' so, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne mmea ho tan wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu ahorow, ne asetra mu, na wɔahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ kɛse ne wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho nyinaa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa atia na wɔako atia nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna bɔbeasu so, mmarima ne mmea ho tan, ne mmea ho tan wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu ahorow, ne asetra mu akuw ahorow mu denam mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ kɛse ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Eyi betumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia nyiyim su ne nneyɛe, wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran, na wɔaboa ankorankoro a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn so esiane wɔn bɔbeasu anaa nsɛm a wɔda no adi nti. Mmabun nso betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhomasua ne nhumu dwumadi ahorow mu de ahyɛ ntease ne gye a wogye tom wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ne osuahu ahorow ho. Ɛdenam tema, obu, ne obiara a wɔbɛka ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛboa kɛse a obiara betumi adi yiye a ne bɔbeasu mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn akamfo  ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow a ɛwɔ nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ mpɔtam hɔ no anuonyam?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ nnyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua wɔ Ghana  enti wonnye ntom wɔ mmara kwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi akyerɛkyerɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma de siw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ne STI ano no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho nnuro hia na ama wɔasiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ano denam; ankorankoro a wɔbɛma wɔadi nkunim wɔn awo egyinasie ahorow a wɔpaw so no so. Bio nso, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, titiriw kɔndɔm, betumi aboa ma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STI) no so atew denam akwanside a ɛbɛma wɔasiw nipadua mu nsu a wɔbɛsesa bere a wɔrenya nna mu kyɛfa no ano no so. Ɛho hia sɛ wode nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ de bɔ w’awo akwahosan ne wo yiyedi nyinaa ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔreteetee wɔn wɔ SRH mu?
answer_twi_source: Clinics a ɛfata mmabun. Helplines (SHE+, YENKASA, GHS-YMK). Intanɛt so mmoa. Mmara mu mmoa (Legal aid). Ɔpanyin a wobɛtumi de wo ho ato no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛwɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ na wɔde adi dwuma no ho?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuiɛ wɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ na wɔde adi dwuma no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛbu nnipa hokwan, nidi, ne ahofadie, pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, na wɔakwati ɔhaw anaa nyiyim a wɔbɛyɛ atia kuw biara. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no gyina adanse, nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne kyɛfa a wonya so, na wɔde akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ, a mmeawa ne mmabaa a wonnii mfe aduonu ka ho, ahiade ne wɔn anigye di kan, bere a wosusuw nea ɛbɛka ɔmanfo nyinaa ho kɛse no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun bɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nokware ne atoro nsɛm a wɔka fa nna mu nsɛm 'SRH' ho wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan no so nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ baabi a ɛfiri. Hwehwɛ adanseɛ. Fa toto nsɛm afoforo ho (Consult multiple sources). Hwɛ kasa no yie. Bisa panyin.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na wode ntetan bɔ bea kuo  'digital content creation platforms and online communities' bɛyɛ adwuma de apagya mmaabun ano so, na wɔni wɔ mfefo ne nkyerɛkyerɛfo, na wɔayɛ mmoa nsrahwɛbea ama nkabom ne kasa, adwumayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi de nneɛma a ɛboa wɔn, te sɛ social media, online forums, ne digital storytelling websites adi dwuma de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn osuahu, ne wɔn a wɔnnya mmabun afoforɔ, ne mmoa a ɛwɔ online no atu kwan. Online communities ne mentorship programs ma mmabun no kwan ma wɔn ho akokwaw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu tema betumi aboa ma wɔanya ahotoso ne abusuabɔ a ɛda mmabun ne apɛwmuden ho adwumayɛfo anaa akyerɛkyerɛfo ntam bere a wɔresusu nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate ho no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu tema ma wonya ahotoso ne abusuabɔ denam: Obu, tema, ne adwene a enni atemmu a wɔda no adi wɔ mmabun amammerɛ mu nipasu, osuahu ahorow, ne wɔn haw ahorow ho. Tebea ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔma ho akwaaba a ɛhyɛ mmusua, kasa ahorow, ne nkitahodi akwan horow anuonyam. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a enni animhwɛ a egye amammerɛ ahorow tom na edi ahiade pɔtee ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow, ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe, ne botae ahorow a wɔde besisi wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho mu denneennen. Ahofama a wɔde bɛma sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so asua ade, wɔbɛdwene wɔn ho, na wɔanya nkɔsoɔ wɔ amammerɛ mu ahoɔden mu de ama ɔhwɛ ne nwomasua a ɛyɛ papa na ɛyɛ adwuma yie no akɔ anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ankorankoro ahye (boundaries), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi mu, titiriw wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ho?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankora ahye ne anohyeto ne mmara a ankorankoro de si hɔ de bɔ wɔn honam, nkate, ne adwene mu yiyedi ho ban wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi mu. Wɔho hia kɛse ma ahofadi, obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho, ne ahobammɔ a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu, titiriw wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wobesiw ano no mu. Ahye kyerɛkyerɛ nea onipa biara te nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no na ɛgye tom na ɛboa ma wɔde obu ne ntease to wɔn ho wɔn ho so wɔ abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi asakra yɛn nhyehyɛe ne ɔkwan a yɛfa so kɔ hɔ daa bere a merenyin na m’ahiade ne nea m’ani gye ho sesa no?
answer_twi_source: Bere a worenyin na w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ sesa no, yebetumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ yɛn nhyehyɛe a yɛde kɔ hɔ daa ne ɔkwan a yɛfa so kɔ hɔ no mu ma ɛne no ahyia. Munsusuw nsakrae biara a ɛbɛba wo nhyehyɛe mu anaa nneɛma a ɛho hia a ebetumi aka yɛn check-ins ho, na yɛ nsakrae wɔ yɛn nhyehyɛe mu sɛnea ɛho hia na ama yɛatumi. Yɛ nsakraeɛ na di w’ahiadeɛ a ɛrekɔ so no ho dwuma, na hwehwɛ akwan foforɔ a wobɛfa so adi nkitaho na wode abɔ a ɛne wo mprempren nkɔsoɔ gyinabea hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So lɔɔre nhyehyɛe anaa mmoa bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya mmeae a wɔyɛ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn nhyehyɛe ahorow bi betumi de lɔɔre ho nhyehyɛe anaa mmoa ama  aboa mmabun ma wɔakɔ mmeae a wɔwɔ. Eyi betumi ayɛ:  Ɛhyɛn nhyehyɛe anaa  lɔɔre ho nkrataa a ɛbɛma akwantu ayɛ mmerɛw akɔ mmeae a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe no na wɔasan aba. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde kar ma no de kar ka a wɔatew so anaa akwan titiriw a wɔbɛfa so ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dwumadi no mu no. adrɔbafo a wotu wɔn ho ma anaasɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛkyɛ kaa a dwumadi no ayɛ ho nhyehyɛe de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun betumi anya kaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi ahyehyɛ ahyeɛ a emu da hɔ wɔ m'abusuabɔ mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn na matumi aka ho asɛm yie kyerɛ m'adamfo anaa me hokafoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Hu wo hye: Honam fam nsa a wode bɛka wo ho bɛn na wo ho tɔ wo? Dwumadi ahorow bɛn na wɔmfa anohyeto mma? Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: "Mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ bere a..." anaa "Minsiesiee me ho mmaa..." boa ma wɔkwati asodi. Kasa tẽẽ na emu nna hɔ: Mfa asikre nhyɛ so anaasɛ nnyaw baabi mma nkyerɛase a ɛnteɛ. Siesie wo ho sɛ wobɛsan aka wo ho asɛm bio: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi mpɛn pii. Bu wo hokafo ahye nso: Nkitahodi kɔ akwan abien no nyinaa so! sɛ woredi nkitaho a, hwɛ hu sɛ wo nipadua mu nsaanodwuma ne nea woreka no hyia
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ nipa bi hyɛ me so anaa ɔyɛ me basabasa ɛnam nsakyeraeɛ a ɛba me honam mu wɔ m’ababunbere mu nti a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Asisifo anaa ayayade esiane nsakrae a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho nti on no nyɛ nea wogye tom na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔma ho kwan. Nea wubetumi ayɛ ni: Nya akokoduru na kasa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ a, ka kyerɛ onipa no denneennen sɛ onnyae suban no.Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, asisifo san wɔn akyi bere a wohyia wɔn. Yɛ nea wubetumi biara sɛ wubedi abufuw no ho dwuma sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a worenyɛ basabasa.Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu fotufo, anaa obi foforo a ɔwɔ tumi nkasa.Wobetumi de wɔn ho agye mu na wɔde mmoa ama. Kyerɛw Nsɛm a Esisii: Yɛ ayayade anaa ayayade no ho kyerɛwtohɔ, a nna, mmere, ne nea esii no ho nsɛm ka ho.Sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ ho biribi foforo a, eyi betumi aboa. Tena Nnamfo nkyɛn: Bata wo nnamfo anaa w’atipɛnfo a wɔboa wo no ho. Ahobammɔ wɔ dodow mu. Hu Hokwan a Wowɔ:Hu wo sukuu nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ayayade ne ayayade ho no yiye. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wonya adesua tebea a ahobammɔ ne obu wom. Kae sɛ asisifo nyɛ wo mfomso da, na ɛfata sɛ wɔde obu ne nidi di wo ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmusua betumi akasa afa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma, a ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, nyiyimu, ne nhomasua ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a wonnya ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmusua betumi akasa ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho dwuma denam mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu, ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne aban mpanyimfo so. Ebia eyi ka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛkasa ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, nyiyimu, ne nhomasua ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a wonnya, a wonim sɛ ɛka nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu nsunsuanso ho dwuma. Ɛdenam wɔn nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse ne nsakrae a wɔkamfo kyerɛ so no, mmusua betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛyɛ pɛ na ɛka obiara ho a ɛboa mmabun nyinaa yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ahorow ne asɛyɛde a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so na wɔkasa tia so, titiriw bere a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun kari pɛ wɔ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ahorow ne wɔn asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛnom nneɛma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so na wɔkasa tia so, titiriw wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi nsunsuanso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm betumi anya wɔ wɔn ankasa ne afoforo so no ho, asusuw ahotoso ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ fibea ahorow ho, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkitahodi a obu ne asɛyɛde wom mu wɔ intanɛt so. Ɛdenam abrabɔ pa a wɔde di dwuma denneennen ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛe a asɛyɛde wom a wɔkamfo kyerɛ so no, mmabun betumi afa dijitaal asase no so yiye bere a wɔhyɛ nneɛma pa a ebefi mu aba ama wɔn ho ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo ho nkuran no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ nna mu yareɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusu ho de ahu mpɛn dodow a wɔyɛ me nhwehwɛmu no?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wɔyɛ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu no gyina ankorankoro asiane ahorow, nna mu nneyɛe, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nyansahyɛ ahorow so. Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho bi ne: Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna mu Dwumadi: Sɛ wowɔ nna mu ahokafo pii, wo ne obi da a wommɔ wo ho ban, anaasɛ wowɔ ɔbarima foforo a, yɛ nhwehwɛmu daa. Mfe a wɔadi: Ebia mmabun benya nna mu yareɛ dodow a ɛkɔ soro na wobetumi anya mfaso afi nhwehwɛmu a wɔtaa yɛ no mu. Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna Ho Akwankyerɛ: Nna mu nneyɛe bi betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya nna mu yareɛ ahorow bi no ayɛ kɛse, na ama ɛfata sɛ wɔtaa yɛ nhwehwɛmu.  nna mu yareɛAbakɔsɛm: Sɛ woanya nna mu yareɛbere bi a atwam a, ebia nea ɔde ma wo no bɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu mpɛn pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛfifiri anim nhwi anaa honam nhwi?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun pii fi ase fifiri anim nhwi ne nipadua mu nhwi wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu. Eyi fi honam mu nkwammoa (hormone) ahorow, titiriw testosterone ma mmarimaa ne estrogen ma mmea. Testosterone betumi ama nhwi anyin wɔ w’anim (te sɛ abɔgyesɛ), w'amotuom, ne wobaa anaa bɛɛma ho. Mmabaa nso fi ase nyin ti nhwi wɔ wɔn awotwaa mu ne wɔn nsa ase esiane estrogen nti. Ɛka onyini ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ bɛn na ebetumi aboa ma wɔasiesie ntawntaw wɔ abusuabɔ bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Ma wo ho dwo na kwati sɛ wode kasa ho asodi bɛto wo so: Fa w’adwene si asɛm a woresusuw ho no so, na ɛnyɛ w’ankasa ntua so. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma de da wo nkate adi: "Mete yaw bere a..." Tie wo hokafo adwene: Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wubehu nneɛma wɔ wɔn adwene mu. Mommɔ mu nyɛ adwuma hwehwɛ ano aduru: Munsusuw nneɛma a wubetumi apaw a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma ama mo baanu nyinaa ho. Ebia ɛho behia sɛ wogyae nneɛma mu: Nya ɔpɛ sɛ wubehyia mo ho mo ho wɔ kwan no fa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara bɔ 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro ho ban fi nyiyim ho wɔ adwumayɛ, adan, ne ɔmanfo dabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛwɔ aman pii so bɔ nea broni ka no 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro ho ban fi nyiyim ho wɔ mmeae ahorow, a adwumayɛ, adan, ne ɔmanfo dabere ka ho. Saa mmara ahorow yi taa bara nyiyim a egyina nna ho bɔbea ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so wɔ adwumayɛfo a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu, woyi wɔn fi adwumam, wɔma wɔn dibea, ne adan ne ɔman nnwuma a wobenya mu. Wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro benya hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ na wɔne wɔn adi no yiye wɔ asetra mu nneɛma nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ obu ama nnipa a ɛsono anaa wɔ dansɔ fri me wɔ kwan ni te sɛ abusuakuw, abusuakuw, anaa amammerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ ahweɛ yie nea na sua amammerɛ danso ahorow ho adeye. Kwati nsusuwii hunu. Kyerɛ anigye ne obu ma atetesɛm, amanne, ne kasa ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛwɔ mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔanya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Nea wosusuw ho wɔ abrabɔ pa ho ne: Obu a mmabun wɔ ahofadi ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne apomoden ho. Kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛhwɛ ahu bere a woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma a wɔmfa ankorankoro gyidi anaa gyinapɛn ahorow nhyɛ wɔn so. Amammerɛ, nyamesom, ne abusua mu ntinka horow a wɔde nkate ne obu bedi ho dwuma. Nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim a wɔnyɛ ne nea wɔde bɛka obiara ho a wobedi akyi, a ɔbabun no bɔbeasu, nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa baabi a ofi mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ yebu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda nnipa ntam?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yɛkyerɛ obu ma nsonsonoeɛ a, ɛma wonya ntease, ayamye, ne ngyetum. Ɛboa ma wɔtumi kyekyerɛ mpɔtam a nsonsonoeɛ wom nanso ɛka obiaa bom sɛ nipakuo baako a wɔn mu biaa sombo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ mɛte ehu anaa aniwu nka bere a mahu sɛ mewɔ STI?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata koraa sɛ wobɛte ehu anaa aniwu nka bere a woahu sɛ wowɔ STI. Saa atenka ahorow yi yɛ adebɔ mu mmuae a wɔde ma wɔ tebea no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wonya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn, wobu wɔn, na wɔboa wɔn wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho a wɔbɛka ho asɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Safe space anaa baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ dwo yɛ beaeɛ a obiara te nka sɛ ne honam ne ne nkateɛ mu nyinaa wɔ banbɔ, obu, ne mmoa mu na ama watumi aka nsɛm a ɛyɛ den te sɛ nna ho mmonnaatoɔ. Saa mbea yi ho hia pa ara efisɛ ɛma wɔn a asiane no ato wɔn ne wɔn a wɔboa wɔn no nya ahotoɔ ne asɛm-sie, na ɛhyɛ nkuran ma nkɔmmɔbɔ pa ne osuahu a wɔbɛkyɛ a ehu biara nnim sɛ obi bɛbu wɔn atɛn anaa wɔbɛyɛ wɔn bɔne bi. Beaeɛ a ɛhɔ yɛ dwo yi ma nnipa te nka sɛ wɔn asɛm yɛ nokorɛ, ɛboa ma nkateɛ mu nyadeɛ sa, na ɛma ayɔnkofa ne nkabom mu yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔde redi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma so no gyina adanseɛ so, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛka adwene ahodoɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma so no gyina adanseɛ so, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛka obiara ho ne: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hyehyɛ nneɛma: Sɛ wɔte asetena ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm, nsɛm a wɔhia, ne nea mmabun dodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so no pɛ ase denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hyɛ mu no so no kyerɛ kwan ma wɔyɛ digyital nsɛm ne dwumadie a wɔayɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛfata, a ɛfata amammerɛ. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, nyamesom akannifoɔ, ne mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɔnkofa hwɛ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina mfiridwuma so no yɛ nea ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn, gyinapɛn, ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Nsunsuansoɔ ne mfasoɔ a wɔsɔ hwɛ: Nhwehwɛmu nhwehwɛmu a emu yɛ den hwehwɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔ, baabi a wɔduru, ne sɛdeɛ wɔgye tom a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma so wɔ nnipa ahodoɔ mu, na ɛma nhumu wɔ wɔn mmɔdenbɔ ne mmeaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma pɔtee bɛn na amammerɛ mu ahutasɛm dide boa mmabun ma wonya ahotosoɔ ne gyedie wɔ wɔnkitahodie wɔ  adɔkotafoɔ ntam wɔ ɔhaw berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ ne gyidie. Mmabun te nka sɛ yɛte wɔn ase. Ɛma ahotosoɔ ne nkabom ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nipadua mu haw ahorow a, ɛtaa ba a ebia mehyia bere a manyinsɛn no, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi ho dwuma? (akyi yaw, komayare, ɔbrɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a ɛtaa yɛ haw ne afotu a, wɔde bedi ho dwuma ni: Akyi yaw: Kɔ so gyina hɔ yiye, fa abɔso a ɛboa nyinsɛn di dwuma, na trɛw wo ho brɛoo. Koma a ɛyɛ yaw: Di nnuan nketenkete mpɛn pii, kwati nnuan a ɛyɛ nnuhwam anaa asikre wom, na da a wo ti so. Ɔbrɛ: Gye w’ahome pii, tie wo nipadua, na da bere a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mɛyɛ m’atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa na makasa ma nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumuu wɔ m’atipɛnfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, hokwan pii wɔ hɔ ma wo sɛ wobɛyɛ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa na woakasa ama nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu wɔ w’atipɛnfo mu: Fi ase bɔ nkɔmmɔ: Fi ase ne w’atipɛnfo nsusuw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, na si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wusi gyinae wɔ nimdeɛ mu, pene so, ne abusuabɔ pa so dua. Fa nhwɛso di anim: Yɛ suban pa ne suban pa ho nhwɛso wɔ wo ne w’atipɛnfo nkitahodi mu, da obu, tema, ne nea ɛka obiara ho adi. Fa wo ho hyɛ mu: Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam anaa sukuu nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu ho nkuran mu, na hyɛ w’atipɛnfo nkuran sɛ wɔmmɛka wo ho wɔ mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, ɔmanfo, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi anya adwene ne a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa nneɛma yi hyehyɛ ankorankoro osuahu, mmuae, ne mmoa ne nneɛma a wobenya?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ, ɔmanfo, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya adwene a wɔwɔ  nna mu basabasayɛ ho so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, na ɛkyerɛ ankorankoro osuahu, mmuae, ne mmoa ne nneɛma a wobenya. Saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi kyerɛ akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, tumi a ɛkɔ so, nna, ne abusuabɔ ho, a ebetumi ama nsusuwii hunu a epira, animtiaabu, ne nyiyim akɔ so. Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow a ɛfa mmarimayɛ, ɔbeayɛ, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho betumi anya sɛnea wohu nna mu basabasayɛ, wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ, na wodi ho dwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no so nkɛntɛnso. Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa asodi a wɔde to nea wɔayɛ no bɔne so, kommyɛ, ne aniwu ho no betumi asiw wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa na wɔanya mmoa nnwuma. Mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne tumi a ɛnkari pɛ ma nna mu basabasayɛ ho mmerɛwyɛ yɛ kɛse, titiriw ma akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua te sɛ mmea, , mmusuakuw bi mufo, ne nnipa a wɔadi dɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
