question_twi_source: So mmoa nkitahodi anaa atipɛnfo akuw bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua a wɔbom redi adwenemyare ho akwantuo ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyareɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ, mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ, anaa ayaresabea a wɔde mmoa akuo anaa nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua. Hwehwɛ intanɛt so nneɛma ne nhyiamu a mmusua bɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔrehyia haw a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ suahunu. Susuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔka atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene asi mmabun adwenemyare ho nsɛm ne mmoa so no ho. Kɔ adwuma nhyiamu, anaa nhyiamu a adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ hyehyɛ na sua pii fa akwan ne nneɛma a wɔde gyina ano ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun tua sika ansa na wanya adwenemhaw mu mmoa anaa sɛ sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyeɛ bi wɔ hɔ anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtɔ da a wɔgye sika. Nanso sikapɛ mu mmoa wɔ hɔ ebi ne ankorakora nnwumakuo ahodoɔ a wɔma mmoa a yɛntua ka. Sukuu mu nnwumakuo ahodoɔ nso taa boa kwa. Nnwumakuo ahodoɔ nso betumi atua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a mede bedi dwuma no betumi ama ayɛ den sɛ mɛnyinsɛn bere a mepɛ sɛ mewo mma mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awoɔ ano dodow no ara yɛ nea wotumi dannan. Sɛ wugyae de di dwuma pɛ a, mpɛn pii no w’awoɔ san ba sɛnea na ɛte kan no. Nanso, tebea horow bi te sɛ endometriosis betumi aka awoɔ, enti wo ne w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nsusuw biribiara a ɛhaw wo ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsofo anaa nnipa bɛn na wɔagye din a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ no bi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+  nyɛ mmara kwan so na mprempren nhwɛsofo biara nni hɔ a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama 'sexual health screenings' ne nkyerɛkyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ma Nhumu (ɔsatu ahorow). Adesrɛ krataa. Wo ne akannifo nyɛ biako. Kasa wɔ nhyiam horow ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akari pɛ wɔ m’atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa nsunsuanso ne m’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow mu bere a meresisi me nna mu akwahosan ho gyinae no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wokae sɛ bere a atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa betumi de nhumu a ɛsom bo ama wo, ɛsɛ sɛ w’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow kyerɛ wo gyinaesi ahorow wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho bere nyinaa. Gye bere susuw nea ɛho hia wo kɛse ne sɛnea nneɛma ahorow a wobɛpaw no ne saa gyinapɛn ahorow no hyia no ho. Sɛ wo ne mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di susuw wo nsusuwii ne wo haw ahorow ho a, ebetumi ama woanya adwene a ɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw mu bere a wɔde toto mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ fi mmeae afoforo ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw mu a, ɛde mfaso pii ba sɛ wɔde toto mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ fi mmeae afoforo ho a: Atipɛnfo nkitahodi a  broni ka no 'Peer connection': Mmabun betumi ne afoforo a wɔte wɔn suahu ase na wɔde tema mmoa ama. Gyidi a broni ka no 'Validation': Osuahu ahorow a wɔkyɛ wɔ tebea a wɔboa mu no boa mmabun ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔagye atom na wɔnyɛ ankonam pii wɔ wɔn apereperedi ahorow mu. Afotu a mfaso wɔ so: Atipɛnfo betumi de afotu a mfaso wɔ so, akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne nneɛma a egyina wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow so bɛma, a ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛsom bo wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma mu. Animtiaabu a ɛso tew: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ma wonya baabi a ɛnyɛ atemmu a mmabun betumi asusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ho a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa anaa nyiyim. Tumi a wɔde ma: Sɛ́ obi yɛ mpɔtam a wɔboa no fã a, ebetumi ama mmabun tumi akamfo wɔn ahiade ahorow, asi gyinae a ɛfata, na wɔatu anammɔn pa a ɛbɛma wɔasa wɔn yare na wɔn ho atɔ wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ sɛnea etu mpɔn dodow a wɔakyerɛw ama akwan horow a wɔfa so siw awoɔ ano no ntam? ("de di dwuma sɛnea wɔtaa de di dwuma" vs. "de di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ")
answer_twi_source: Wɔtaa kyerɛw sɛnea nyinsɛn ano a wosiw no tumi yɛ adwuma yiye wɔ akwan abien so: Sɛ wode di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ: Eyi da sɛnea ɔkwan bi di dwuma a mfomso biara nni ho bere biara a wo ne obi bɛda a, etu mpɔn no adi. Nea wɔtaa de di dwuma: Eyi da sɛnea ɔkwan bi tu mpɔn wɔ asetena ankasa mu adi, bere a wosusuw mfomso a ebetumi aba sɛ nnipa betumi ayɛ anaasɛ sɛnea wɔde di dwuma a ɛnkɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ ho no. "Typical use" yɛ mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware kɛse a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea ɔkwan bi bɛyɛ nea etu mpɔn ama wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnuru ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛyɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔsan frɛ no awo ano aduru di dwuma de siw nyinsɛn ano. Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi apaw wɔ Ghana, eyinom bi ne, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nea wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, kɔndɔm, ne mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu ne afoforo. Wɔtaa gyina sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma so kyekyɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano mu akuwakuw. 1. Akwan a wɔfa so siw kwan: Eyinom yɛ adwuma denam honam fam a esiw mmadwoa no kwan sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu no so. Eyinom bi ne kɔndɔm (ɔbarima ne ɔbea), nnuru a  ekum  barima ho nsuo  (krim anaa ahuru a ekum mmadwoa), ne awotwaa mu sponges/caps. Kɔndɔm ma ahobammɔ mprenu fi nyinsɛn ne STI ho. 2. Akwan a ɛyɛ adwuma tiawa a wotumi dannan (SARC): Saa akwan yi de hormone ahorow di dwuma de siw ovulation (nkwaa a ɛba) ano anaasɛ ɛma awotwaa mu nsu yɛ den de siw mmadwoa ano. Mpɛn pii no, ɛtra hɔ bere tiaa bi na wobetumi agyae bere biara. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nnuru a wɔde sa yare, aduru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua no mu, ne awotwaa mu mpɛtea. 3. Siw nyinsɛn ano a wotumi dannan no bere tenten (LARC): Saa akwan yi tu mpɔn yiye na ɛtra hɔ mfe pii. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne IUD ahorow (a ɛnyɛ hormone ne hormone) ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano daa a ɛne vasectomy ne tubal ligationNyinsɛn ano a wobɛpaw: Nyinsɛn ano aduru a eye ma wo no gyina nneɛma pii so, te sɛ wo mfe, w’akwahosan, w’asetra kwan, ne nna mu su. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ bɛkasa akɔhwehwɛ nsɛm foforɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ama woasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi nna ho hu anaa nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ mɛyɛ nna ho adwuma wɔ ayɔnkofa mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ma Nkɔmmɔbɔ Yɛ Nea Ɛfata: Kae sɛ nnipa pii nya adwumayɛ ho dadwen; ɛyɛ ade a ɛyɛ daa. Nkitahodi: Wo ne wo hokafo nka wo atenka ne nea ɛhaw wo ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Kyɛ sɛ wubu abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den sen adwumayɛ. Fa w’adwene si Anigye so: Dan adwene fi agoru so kɔ anigye ne abusuabɔ a obiara nya so. Hwehwɛ nsa a ɛnyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu kyɛfa ne akwan foforo a wobɛfa so ne obi abɛn obi, a nhyɛso biara nka ho. Akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome: Fa akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa adwene a wɔde si biribi so di dwuma. Nnwumayɛfo Mmoa: Sɛ dadwen kɔ so a, susuw ho sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo, ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo bɛkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne m’atipɛnfo anaa m’ahokafo adi nkitaho afa nna mu nkɔso ne ahyeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Da w’adwene mu, di nokware, na kyerɛ obu. ahyeɛ ho nkitahodie, pene a wɔpene so, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ho. Tie wo hokafo nkate na ka w’ankasa de ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so ne awofo di nkitaho a emu da hɔ bere mpo a wɔresusu nsɛmti a emu yɛ den anaasɛ ɛnyɛ den ho, te sɛ berɛ a wɔde besi hɔ ama nkɔmmɔbɔ, nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa a wɔde bedi dwuma de ada atenka adi, anaasɛ hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa ɔfotubɔfoɔ a wogye no di hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ne awofo adi nkitaho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛda adi pefee so, bere mpo a wɔresusuw nsɛmti a emu yɛ den anaasɛ ɛnyɛ den ho no, nea ɛka ho ne: Bere a wɔde besi hɔ ama nkɔmmɔbɔ: Yɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ daa na ama wɔanya hokwan ahorow ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na woadi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ebetumi asɔre ho dwuma. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa a wɔde bedi dwuma de ada atenka adi: Tie nipadua kasa, w’anim yɛbea, ne nne a wode bɛda atenka a ebia ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ wode ano bɛka no adi. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ɔpanyin anaa ɔfotufo a wogye no di hɔ: Sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wo ne awofo bɔ no bɛyɛ den dodo anaasɛ ɛyɛ den dodo a, hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di a obetumi de mmoa ne nneɛma ama wɔn hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no yɛ kokoamusɛm a me ne ayaresabea anaa apomoden ho ɔyaresafo no bɔ? (kyerɛkyerɛ HIPAA kokoamu nsɛm ho mmara mu sɛ ɛfata a)
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nkɔmmɔ a wo ne ayaresabea anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ tumi krataa wɔ Ghana bɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no yɛ kokoamusɛm. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Ghana Mmara: ayarefo kokoamusɛm yɛ nnyinasosɛm titiriw a ɛwɔ aduruyɛ mu abrabɔ pa mu wɔ Ghana. Wei kyerɛ sɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wo kokoamu nsɛm ho ban. Adwumayɛfoɔ Mmara: Aduruyɛ ne ayarehwɛfoɔ fekuo a ɛwɔ Ghana wɔ abrabɔ ho mmara a ɛsi ayarefoɔ kokoamusɛm so dua. Nneɛma a ɛka ho: Ebia nneɛma kakraa bi wɔ hɔ a ɛntaa nsi wɔ baabi a wobetumi asɛe kokoamsɛm, te sɛ: Asiane kɛse a ɛbɛba w’apomoden anaa ahobammɔ so Bɔ amanneɛ sɛ wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ mmofra ayayade anaasɛ wɔabu wɔn ani agu so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe a pɛyɛ enni mu ne tumi mu nsakyeraye sia ɛfa wɔ a wɔn adi dɛmdi ne nna di nkitaho ma ɛde hokwan ne nhyɛso ho osuahu ahorow ba?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe a pɛyɛ enni mu ne tumi mu nsakyeraye tee anaasɛ ɛnteɛ ka biribiara a ɛyɛ nwonwa a sɛ asasesin no te mfa ho. Wɔ mmeae a mmara boa oprehyɛn ahorow no no, anka hokwan ahorow a wobenya ne nhyɛso bɛba wɔ baabi a mmara no ntumi mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na matumi asɛe nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsusuwii hunu, anansesɛm, ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ho, nna ho akɔnnɔ, nipadua mfonini, ne pene a ebetumi aboa ma atipɛnfo nhyɛso aba na anya me gyinaesi nhyehyɛe so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔahu na wɔasɛe nsɛm ho amannebɔfo nsusuwii hunu, anansesɛm, ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna ho akɔnnɔ, nipadua mfonini, ne pene a wɔpene so ho no, mmabun betumi: Ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne abusuabɔ ho mu yiye, na wɔde wɔn adwene asi nsɛmti, tropes, ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛsan ba bio so. Gye nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ nokware ho kyim, na susuw nnipa osuahu ahorow ne nnipa a wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛnea wɔyɛ no ahorow ahorow ho. Hwehwɛ nsɛm ne adwene foforo a ɛbɛkasa atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛm atitiriw na ɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini a ɛka obiara ho, a ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu ne w’atipɛnfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm ne nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi anya wɔ suban, gyidi, ne nneyɛe so ho. Kamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔyɛ ne nea wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nkuran, titiriw nea ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ "wobɛpue," na dɛn nti na nkurɔfo paw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa?
answer_twi_source: "Coming out" yɛ kwan a obi fa so da ne nna ho gyinabea (sexual orientation) adi kyerɛ afoforɔ mu fann. Yei yɛ kwan a obi fa so kyerɛ sɛnea ɔte nka wɔ ne mu, na ɛboaboa nkabom ano wɔ ɔne afoforɔ ntam. Denam saa su yi a obi bɛkyɛ no so no, wobɛtumi ahwehwɛ nteaseɛ, nnyigyeiɛ, ne nkuranhyɛ afiri wɔn a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na beae a apɔmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ no ka nnwuma/ mmoa a wobetumi anya ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Beae a apɔmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ no betumi anya nnwuma a wobetumi anya ama mmabun, titiriw wɔn a wɔwɔ nkuraase anaa akyirikyiri no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Nneɛma te sɛ akyirikyiri, kar akwan a wobetumi afa so, ne apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe dodow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi aka sɛnea mmabun betumi anya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia, a nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe ka ho. Apɔmuden ho mmeae a wobetumi akɔ no kakraa bi no betumi ama wɔakyɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ mu, wɔatew nnwuma a wɔde siw yare ano a wobenya so, na nsonsonoe aba apɔmuden mu aba a mmabun nya wɔ mmeae yi mu. Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma nneɛma a wonya no akɔ soro, te sɛ ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde telefon so, aduruyɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ akyirikyiri, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no ho hia na ama wɔadi nsonsonoe ahorow yi ho dwuma na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata ma mmabun nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo mu nneɛma bi a ebetumi anya adwene a mewɔ wɔ ahye ne pene a mepene so so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi afa saa nkɛntɛnso yi mu ahyehyɛ hyeɛ a ɛne me gyidi ne m'abrabɔ pa hyia?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo mu nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam gyinapɛn, nyamesom mu gyidi, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔda abusuabɔ adi no betumi anya ahye ne pene a wɔpene so ho adwene so nkɛntɛnso. Sɛ wobɛfa saa nkɛntɛnsoɔ yi mu na wode ahyehyɛ ahyeɛ a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidie hyia asi hɔ a, sɔ amammerɛ ne mpɔtam mu nsɛm ho yiye, abisa gyidi ne nsɛm a nnipa aka ato hɔ a nnyinasoɔ biara nni ho, na hwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa afiri adwene ahodoɔ mu. Dwene w’ankasa w’amammerɛ ne w’ankasa osuahu ahorow ho, na susuw sɛnea ɛka wo nsusuwii wɔ ahye ne pene a wopene so ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛfa mmabun a wɔbɔ ban siw nyinsɛn ano, a mfe a wɔadi ne awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ahorow a ɛfa kwan a mmabun betumi de asiw nyinsɛn ano ho no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu. Mmeae bi wɔ a wɔde nhyehyeɛ to mfe a wɔadi ho anaasɛ ɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu ma mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, bere a afoforo ma mmabun nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ kokoam a awofo mpene so. Wɔ aman pii mu no, wɔma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kwan ma wogyina wɔn ankorankoro tebea ne wɔn onyin dodow so kyerɛw nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma mmofra nkumaa, na wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun awo mu ahofadi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso boa si mperewa nyinsɛn ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛ awoɔ ne adoption ho mfaso pa ne bɔne wɔ nokware mu.
answer_twi_source: Ammuayɛ baako nni hɔ. Ne nyinaa yɛ akwan a mfasoɔ ne haw wɔ mu. Kasa kyerɛ nimdefoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata nyehyeɛ a wɔfrɛ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ telehealth services a wɔde bedi dwuma ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu insurance a wɔde tua ho ka?
answer_twi_source: Nyehyeɛ a wɔfrɛ broɔfo kasa mu sɛTelehealth dwumadie no betumi ama wɔabɔ ka a ɛte sɛ akwahosan ho nsrahwɛ a wɔtaa yɛ no, a ɛka ho ne sika a wɔbɔ wɔ animtiaabuo ho ne ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ nnwuma foforɔ ho. Insurance a wɔde tua ho ka wɔ telehealth appointments ho no gu ahorow wɔ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma ne akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ wɔn insurance adwumakuw no mu hwɛ sɛnea wɔbɛbɔ wɔn insurance ho ka pɔtee wɔ telefon so akwahosan ho nnwuma ho. Insurers binom atrɛw telehealth ho sika a wɔde tua ho ka mu wɔ COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no mu, nanso sika a wɔde tua ho ka ho nhyehyɛe betumi asesa bere a bere kɔ so no, enti ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ sɛnea sika a wɔde tua ho ka no ho nsɛm mu ansa na woayɛ nhyehyɛe akɔ telehealth ho nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusuabɔ pa betumi aboa yɛn adwenemyare, na abusuabɔ a enni apɔmuden anaa awuduru ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ yiye wɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ pa ma atenka fam mmoa, obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ahotoso, ne nkitahodi a etu mpɔn, na ɛma wonya ahobammɔ ne anigye ho nkate. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ awuduru wom no bi ne: ahotoso a wonni, nkate mu nsakrae, obu a wonni, nneyɛe a wodi so, ɔkasatia a ɛkɔ so daa, ne te nka sɛ ne ho atɔ no anaasɛ ne ho yeraw no wɔ onipa no anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛfa so ne wɔn adɔkotafoɔ akasa afa nna mu yareɛ a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no sɛ 'Prophylaxis'  a wɔanya bi no wɔ mmerɛkuro a na wɔnnim ne sɛ abɛkasa afa nna mu bammɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Di nokware. Bisa nsɛm fa deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔtwa so tia sɛ 'PrEP' ho. Di nkitaho kyerɛ deɛ nti a. Kyerɛ nea wopɛ. Hwehwɛ dɔkota foforo sɛ ɛhia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'stigma' ne nyiyimu siw mmabun mmoa kwan?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtu obi mpaaba sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ ayaresa Fɛreɛ. Siesie denam: CSE, nteteeɛ, ne mmara nsesaeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw me wɔ nna mu nkɔso ho nanso mete nka sɛ me ho ntea me sɛ me ne mpanyimfo bɛkasa a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Wo ne w’adamfo anaa wo nua panyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a ebia ɔwɔ osuahu a ɛte saa ara nkasa. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet  'website' ahorow a agye din te sɛ Planned Parenthood anaa Scarleteen de nsɛm ma a wɔmmɔ wɔn din. Sukuu Nneɛma: Wɔatete sukuu mu afotufo anaa ayarehwɛfo ma wɔaboa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmmisa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a ne bo nyɛ den, titiriw ma nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Ebia mmara anaa nhyehyeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a ne boɔ yɛ den, titire ama nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wɔnsom no yie. Saa mmara ne nhyehyeɛ yi betumi ayɛ sika a wɔde bɛma nna mu yareɛ ayaresabea ahorow, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho, anaa ahwehwɛdeɛ a ɛfa insurance a wɔde tua nnwuma a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ ho. Nanso, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a ne bo nyɛ den a wobetumi anya ne nea wobetumi anya no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ beae a ɛwɔ, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne apomoden ho nhyehyɛe so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ sɛ me nna mu apɔmuden nhwehwɛmu yɛ kɔkoam, na hokwan bɛn na mewɔ wɔ kokoam ne kɔkoamu nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔnya kokoamunsɛm bere a ɛfa nna mu apɔmuden mmoa ho: Mmara hyɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnkora wo nsɛm so kɔkoam, a awofoɔ anaa ɔhwɛfoɔ ka ho, gye sɛ dadwen wɔ hɔ wɔ wo banbɔ ho. Wubetumi aserɛ sɛ wɔnkora wo nsɛm so kɔkoam. Bere a worehyehyɛ bere a wobɛkɔ no, bisa kɔkoamunsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ ho asɛm de hwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wo kokoamunsɛm ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe betumi aboa mmabun denam: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛma apɔwmuden a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa a wɔde bɛma so. Apɔwmuden asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam ma a wɔde ma. Mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, wɔ sukuu tebea no mu ne akyi nyinaa ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmuo a asuafoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asiane ahorow a ɛtaa ba wɔ Intanɛt so a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so mmoa a wɔkyere mmoa we: Yɛ ahwɛyiye bere a wo ne ahɔho redi nkitaho wɔ Intanɛt so, titiriw wɔ nhyiam ahorow anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ dan ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ atoro anaa adaadaa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho betumi ama nkurɔfo adwene atu afra anaa apira wɔn. Intanɛt so asisifo "cyberbullying": Ayayade anaa ayayade a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho betumi aba wɔ sohyial media so anaasɛ ɛnam nkrasɛm a wɔde mena tẽẽ so. Kokoam nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene: Sɛ wode wo ho nsɛm kyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so a, ebetumi ama woabu kokoam nsɛm so anaasɛ wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu sika a wɔde boa, sika a wɔde ma a ɛfa wɔn nhomasua botae ne wɔn anigyede ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu sika a wɔde ma, mmoa, ne sika a wɔde ma a ɛfa wɔn nhomasua botae ne wɔn anigyede ho denam: Intanɛt so nhwehwɛmu nnwinnade a wɔde bedi dwuma so: Wɛbsaet ne bea ahorow a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Fastweb, Scholarships.com, anaa College Board’s Scholarship  ma asuafo kwan ma wɔhwehwɛ sika hokwan ahorow a egyina gyinapɛn ahorow so, a adesua mu ade titiriw, beae, anaa nnipa dodow a wofi mu ka ho. Nhomasua asoɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu: Kɔlege ahorow, sukuupɔn ahorow, ne adwumayɛ sukuu ahorow taa de asoɛe ahorow no sika a wɔde boa adesua anaa mmoa a egyina adesua mu nkɔso, sikasɛm mu ahiade, anaa gyinapɛn afoforo so ma. Sukuu afotufoɔ a wɔbɛsusu ho: Sukuu afotufoɔ bɛtumi de nsɛm a ɛfa mpɔtam, ɔman, ne ɔman no mu sika a wɔde ma adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ho ama, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwammisa nhyehyɛeɛ no ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu nhwehwɛmu: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, mpɔtam hɔ fapem ahorow, ne nnwuma betumi de sika a wɔde boa adesua anaa mmoa ama de aboa asuafo a wɔrekɔ sukuupɔn anaa adwumayɛ ho ntetee wɔ nnwuma pɔtee bi anaa nnwuma pɔtee bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsonsonoe wɔ abofra a wɔbɛtete no sɛ ɔwofo a, onni ɔhokafo ne ɔhokafo a wobenya ntam?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoe wɔ ɔwofo a obiako na ɔyɛ ne awofo a wɔbom yɛ no ntam: Ɔwofo a obiako na ɔtete abofra no: Wo nkutoo na wotete abofra no, wusi gyinae nyinaa na wudi asɛde ahorow nyinaa ho dwuma. Awofo a Wɔbom Yɛ: Wo ne wo hokafo, ɔhokafo anaa agya a ɔwoo no no kyɛ asɛde ahorow a ɛne sɛ wobɛtete abofra no. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbom hwɛ mmofra anaa asetena ho nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so boa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu a ebia wɔbɛtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔfa ahomatrofo a wɔde boa wɔ ɔhaw mu, te sɛ intanɛt so mmoa akuo, wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu nhyiam ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde boa wɔn ho, ne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa foforɔ a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no bɛtumi ayɛ atetesɛm mu mmoa nhomatrofo na ama akwan foforɔ a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ mmoa ne ayaresa: Intanɛt so Mmoa Akuo: Fa wo ho hyɛ intanɛt so mmoa akuo anaa nhyiamu a wɔyɛ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu titire mu, baabi a ankorankoro bɛtumi akyɛ suahunu, anya adansedie ne tema, na wɔanya nneɛma ne afotuo afiri wɔn atipɛnfoɔ hɔ. Nkwagyefoɔ Nhyiamu: Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu a ɛfa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ho a ɛma nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nkɔmmɔdie a wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu di anim wɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne ayaresa ho. Nneɛma a Wɔde Boa Wɔn Ho: Nya nneɛma a wɔde boa wo ho te sɛ nhoma, nsɛm, podcast, anaa telefon apps a ɛma akwankyerɛ wɔ sɛnea wogyina adwenemhaw ano, nneɛma a ɛkanyan adwene a wobedi ho dwuma, sɛnea wobɛhwɛ wo ho, ne sɛnea wobɛma wotumi agyina ano wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ akyi no ho. Atipɛnfo Mmoa Nkitahodi: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo, abusua mufo, anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de aso a etie, nkate fam mmoa, ne mmoa a mfaso wɔ so ama wɔ nneɛma a wobenya anaasɛ tebea horow a emu yɛ den a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho a wobɛfa mu no hɔ. Adebɔ mu Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ adebɔ mu akwan te sɛ adwinni, nnwom, akyerɛw, anaa nsɛmma nhoma kyerɛw sɛ ayaresa nnwinnade a wɔde di atinka ho dwuma, da nsusuwii ne nkate adi, na wɔsan nya ahofadi ne wɔn ho a wɔda no adi wɔ ayaresa akwantu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mede kɔndɔm ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma yiye de abɔ me ho ne me hokafo ho ban  wɔ mpa so agodie?
answer_twi_source: Kɔndɔm: Hwɛ da a ɛbɛtwam ne nea wɔde ahyɛ mu no sɛ ebia biribiara asɛe anaa. Sɛ bere atwam anaasɛ wɔatow wrapper no mu a, mfa nni dwuma. Fa ahwɛyiye bue na yi kɔndɔm fi wrapper no mu. Mfa sẽ mmue kɔndɔm. Pae ano no ma gyaw baabi ma mmadwoa na bue kɔndɔm no mu nyinaa kɔ fam wɔ ɔbarima no akyi a ɛteɛ no so. Fa kɔndɔm foforo di dwuma ma adeyɛ biara a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu wɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo mu, anaa anom. Mfa kɔndɔm bɛboro biako bere koro mu na mfa srade foforo biara nka kɔndɔm no ho efisɛ eyi betumi ama kɔndɔm no apae. Sɛ woto wo ho a, yi wɔ bɛɛma no  na yi kɔndɔm no yiye. Fa kɔndɔm a wode adi dwuma no kyekyere na tow gu toa mu anaasɛ fa sie . Mma nnhyerɛn wɔ nwura mu. Akwan Afoforo a Wɔfa so Siw Akwanside (sɛ nhwɛso no, nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Dental Dams): Fa akwanside no to ano anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ntam na kɔ so yɛ nna a wɔde ano ka. Hwɛ sɛ wobɛkata so yiye na kwati sɛ wobɛdannan anaasɛ wobɛsan de adi dwuma bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ kɔndɔm bubu anaa ɛtwetwe berɛ a meredi mpa mu agorɔ a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Si abotrɛ, mɛmmpre wo ho. Ntɛm ara mu, yi bɛrima no fi ɔbaa no ase. Afei fa eduro a asi nyinsɛnba ho kwan, nea yɛfrɛ not emergency contraception. Afei wo ne w'ahokafo mbom nkɔyɛ test nhu sɛ obia nni nna mu yareɛ bia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow de di dwuma de ma sika fam mmoa ma nhomasua ne ntetee?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde anaa asoɛe ahorow de gyinapɛn ahorow di dwuma de boa sika fam ma nhomasua ne ntetee, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adesua mu nkɔso: GPA, sɔhwɛ mu nkontaahyɛde a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, ne adesuakuw mu dibea. Adesua akyi a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu: Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ akuw, agumadi, mpɔtam hɔ som, anaa akannifo dwumadi ahorow mu. Sikasɛm mu ahiade: Ofie sika, agyapade, ne abusua dodow. Nnipa dodow: Bɔbeasu, abusuakuw, ɔman a wofi mu, anaa su afoforo. Adesua no fã: Ebia sika a wɔde boa adesua anaa mmoa bi yɛ nea ɛfa adesua mu nteɛso anaa adwumayɛ akwan bi ho pɔtee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen bɛn na ɛtaa hyia mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ Ghana, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi saa nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhaw ahorow a mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔwɔ dɛm (disability) taa hyia mmerɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ ayaresabea hwɛ ne: mmeaeɛ a ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛtumi afa hɔ, afidie ne nneɛma a ɛmfata wɔn dɛm no, ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ a wonnyaa nteteeɛ a ɛdɔɔso fa wɔn ahiadeɛ ho, nkitahodie mu akwansideɛ, aniwu (stigma) ne nyiyim, ayaresa boɔ a ɛyɛ den, ne baabi a ahobammɔ anaa kokoamsɛm nnɔɔso mmerɛ a wɔregye ayaresa. Afotufoɔ (counsellors) ne mmoa ahorow bi wɔ hɔ ma obiara a ɔhyia ɔhaw biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na amammerɛ mu nkate ho hia bere a wɔresusuw nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nkate ho hia bere a wɔresusuw nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho ho asɛm efisɛ: Egye amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho tom na ɛkyerɛ obu ma. Ɛma ahotoso ne abusuabɔ ba apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu ntam. Ɛhyɛ nkitahodi, ntease, ne biakoyɛ a etu mpɔn ho nkuran wɔ nna mu apɔwmuden ho ahiade ne nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a wobedi ho dwuma mu. Ɛboa ma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔde Atɔe Famfo anaa mmusuakuw ho adwene a ebia wobebu wɔn ani agu amammerɛ ahorow so anaasɛ wɔde bɛto nkyɛn a wɔanhyɛ da no so tew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa nkuran na wɔakasa ma nsakrae na wɔnyɛ amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ne abusuabɔ pa.
answer_twi_source: Wo nne ho hia! Wubetumi ayɛ obi a ɔwɔ tumi a wobegyina ama wo mpɔtam hɔ. Kasa fa nsakyerae ho, hyɛ nidi ho nkuran, na ma nkurɔfo ahu mfaso a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ pa mu. Wo nkoaa nnim saa ko yi mu. Ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nnipa pii gyina w’akyi boa wo. Sɛ woyɛ biribi, sɛ ɛyɛ kɛse anaa ketewa o, wubetumi ama nsakrae aba!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ebetumi aba sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto "dijitaal" akwan nkutoo so de anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne mmoa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase?
answer_twi_source: Asiane ahorow bi a ebetumi aba sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto didyitaal akwan nkutoo so de anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne mmoa ne: Nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ nnaadaa a ɛde gyinasi ahorow a wonni nimdeɛ ba. Akwankyerɛ a ɛfa ankorankoro anaa nsɛm a ɛfa ho pɔtee a wɔayɛ ama ankorankoro ahiade a wonni. Kokoam nsɛm ne ahobammɔ ho nsɛm te sɛ "data" a wobu so anaa nsɛm a ɛho hia a wɔda no adi a woanhyɛ da. Wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ho a wɔde hwehwɛ yare ne wnɔ ankasa so dodo a wonkɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn. Mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase te sɛ: Nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae pii a agye din de ahwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so. Ahwɛyie a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ ne nkitahodi akwan a ahobammɔ wom a wdɔe bedi te sɛ ankorankoro nkmɔmɔbɔ a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛka ho bere a ɛho hia no. Nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee ne nsɛmmisa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu bere a wɔresusuw nneɛma a ɛwɔ intanɛt no so ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ soronko wɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi adi ni na wɔagye nsonsonoe ahorow yi atom wɔ wɔn nneyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse wɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu, na anya ankorankoro suban, wɔn nneyɛe, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ so nsunsuanso. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu na wogye nsonsonoe ahorow yi tom wɔ wɔn adeyɛ mu denam ɔkwan a wɔfa so fa ɔyarefo so a wosusuw ɔbabun biara amammerɛ soronko ne nea ɔpɛ ho no so. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wobebisa nsɛm a wɔabue ano de ate amammerɛ mu nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn ayarefo akwahosan ho gyidi ne nneyɛe ho ase, de nhomasua ne nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho bɛma, na wɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne amammerɛ mu aguadifo a wɔyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde ɔhwɛ bɛma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata amammerɛ so. Ɛdenam amammerɛ ahorow a wogye tom na wobu so no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi anya ahotoso wɔ wɔn ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no mu na ama akwahosan mu nkɔso atu mpɔn wɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi aboa mmabun a, ebia wobehyia akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ akwansideɛ a ɛmma mmabun nya akwahosan ho dwumadie no so nkonim wɔ ɔkwan te sɛ: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔde bɛba mpɔtam hɔ tẽẽ, titire wɔn a wɔnnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ atetesɛm no. Nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne mmeae a wɔde bɛma a ɛbɛma wɔadi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma, te sɛ sukuu akyi nnɔnhwerew anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa baabiara. Nnwuma a ɛfata amammerɛ na ɛfata mmabun a ɛfa mmabun ahiade soronko ne wɔn haw ahorow ho a wɔde bɛma. Nhomasua nhyiamu ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo afoforo anaa asetra mu nnwuma a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn titiriw sɛnea ɛho hia a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So atipɛnfo mmoa akuo betumi de nneɛma foforo a wɔde bɛma mmabun abɔ anaasɛ wɔde wɔn akɔ nnwuma afoforo a ebia ɛbɛboa wɔ wɔn ahiade ahorow ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, atipɛnfo mmoa akuo taa yɛ ɔpon a wɔde kɔ nneɛma foforo ne nneɛma a wɔde kɔma mmabun mu. Kuo mu ahwɛfoɔ bɛtumi de nsɛm a ɛfa adwene mu apomoden ho dwumadie, mpɔtam hɔ mmoa dwumadie, afotuo akwan, ahomotrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde mmoa titire ma wɔ ahiadeɛ pɔtee bi ho bɛma. Wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ bi no nso betumi aka wɔn ankasa suahu ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛbɛboa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne nipasu nya osuahu ne adwene a wonya wɔ adwenemyare ho wɔ mmabun mu no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ kyerɛ sɛdeɛ yɛte adwenemyare 'mental health' ase. Ɛka sɛdeɛ nkurɔfoɔ hwehwɛ mmoa anaa wɔgye ayaresa tom. Ɛsɛ sɛ ayaresafoɔ kyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no di nhyɛso ahorow  te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan, ne mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan a ɛde nna mu basabasayɛ ba no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no di nhyɛso ahorow  ho dwuma denam akwan horow a tumi ne hokwan nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan, ne mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan fa so ne nna mu basabasayɛ di nkitaho a wogye tom so. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi gye tom sɛ ankorankoro a wofi akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn so no betumi ahyia basabasayɛ ho asiane kɛse esiane asetra mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nyiyim nti. Enti, wɔde akwan a wɔfa so twa kwan a: Wɔde wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wofi mmeae ahorow no suahu ne wɔn nne si mfinimfini, na wogye nsɛnnennen soronko a ebia wobehyia ne ahoɔden a wɔda no adi no tom. Kasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne suban a epira a ɛma nyiyim ne basabasayɛ kɔ so tra hɔ, na ɛma mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa nya tema, ntease, ne biakoyɛ. Fa nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma ma wɔ sɛnea nhyɛso ahorow no twam na ɛboa ma wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ ho, na ɛma adwene a ɛyɛ katee ne adeyɛ a wɔbom yɛ de hwehwɛ asetra mu nsakrae. Kamfo nhyehye ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ho na ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ, atɛntrenee, ne nkabom ho nkuran ma ankorankoro nyinaa, a wɔn nipasu anaa wɔn tebea mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn betumi aka m’ankasa nipadua mu nkɔso bere a na meyɛ ɔbabun no? (onyin, nnompe a ɛyɛ den, aduannuru a wohia) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn betumi aka wo nipadua mu nkɔso wɔ akwan kakraa bi so: Onyin: Ebia wo nipadua no de n’adwene besi akokoaa no aduan a wɔbɛma so, na ebetumi ama w’ankasa wo nyin brɛoo. Nnompe a Ɛyɛ Den: Calcium a wodi no kɔ wo ba no nkɔso mu. Nnuan a calcium wom a wobedi ne vitamin ahorow a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo a calcium ka ho no ho hia yiye. Aduannuru a Wohia: Wo nipadua hia aduannuru pii a ɛbɛboa wo ne wo ba no nyinaa. Fa w’adwene si aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, ne protein a ɛnyɛ den pii wom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi akasa kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu nka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho de ahyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, abɛɛfo akenkan ne akyerɛw, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔkasa  kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ Sukuu Adesua Nhyehyɛe mu: Mmabun betumi akasa ama akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a ɛkɔ akyiri nka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe mu de ahyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nkuran. Wobetumi ne sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ adi nkitaho de asi hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho hia wɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔbɛsiesie wɔn ama dijitaal berɛ no mu nsɛnnennen ne ASRH nsunsuansoɔ pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnyinasosɛm atitiri bi a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo di akyi bere a wɔne mmabun reyɛ adwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Nnyinasosɛm atitiriw bi a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ma ho ne sɛ wɔbɛma tebea a ahobammɔ wom na wɔde wɔn ho ato so, wɔde ɔbabun no ahofadi ne tumi a wɔde bɛma no bedi kan, amammerɛ mu tema ne nea ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, biakoyɛ ne nea wɔpaw a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm asie. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nso de tema, atie a wɔde nsiyɛ, ne nkitahodi a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so akasa atia nsusuwii ne gyidi a enye wɔ wɔn nipadua ho na wɔanya wɔn ho adwene a ɛyɛ papa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa atia nsusuwii ne gyidi bɔne a ɛfa wɔn nipadua ho wɔ wɔn ho a wɔde bedi dwuma, nsusuwii a wɔakyinkyim a wobehu na wɔakasa atia, wɔn ho ayamhyehye ne gye a wogye tom a wɔde bedi dwuma, de wɔn adwene asi ahoɔden ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ so sen sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi sintɔ ahorow a wosusuw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ so, nsunsuanso pa a wɔde atwa wɔn ho ahyia, ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ne yiyedi ho nkuran a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun sua sɛ wɔbɛdɔ wɔn ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a mede bɛkyerɛkyerɛ me ho wɔ "LGBTQ+" akwahosan ho nsɛm ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, mɛte nka sɛ mewɔ nsɛm pii wɔ oduruyɛfo nsrahwɛ mu? (wɛbsaet ahorow, nhomasua nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu "LGBTQ+" sɛ mmra mmma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nokwasɛm ne atorɔ  nsɛm  a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no ntam? (hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya fibea ahorow a wotumi gye di) .
answer_twi_source: Nsɛmti a Ɛma Atenka: Hwɛ yiye wɔ kasa a ɛkanyan atenka anaa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nwonwa ho. Beae a biribi firi ba: Hena na otintim nsɛm no? So ɛyɛ ahyehyɛde a agye din anaasɛ ankorankoro abɛɛfo ntentan? Adanse a Ɛfa Nsɛm a Wɔka Ho: So nsɛm no de adanse a ɛfoa nea wɔka no so ma? Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wɔafa aka afi mmeae a wotumi gye di.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ ntentanfidie so a ɛboa mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ adwenemyare?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ntentanfidie nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ adwenemyare ho mmoa, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adwene mu akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nsɛm ma, nneɛma a wɔde boa wɔn ho, ne nnwinnade a wɔde di adwenemyare ho dwuma. Mobile apps a ɛde akwankyerɛ nsusuwii, adwene mu apɔ mu ateneatene, su a wɔde di akyi, ne adwenemyare ho nneɛma afoforo ma. Ntentanfidie so adwenemhwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔnam mmra kwan so di wɔn dwuma de afotu nhyehyeɛ ahodoɔ a anam sɛ woredi nkitaho wo video ne ahomatrofo so ma. Social media akuw anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo adi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ osuahu ahorow a ɛfa adwenemyare ho haw ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ wɛbsaet ne video ahorow a ɛde adwene mu nkyerɛkyerɛ ma wɔ adwenemyare ho nsɛmti ahorow ne akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no di nsɛm te sɛ akatua mu nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam, adwuma mu mpaapaemu, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ sikasɛm mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no di nsɛm te sɛ akatua mu nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam, adwuma mu mpaapaemu, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ sikasɛm mu no ho dwuma denam akwan horow te sɛ akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ho mmara a wɔde bedi dwuma, adwumayɛfo a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ nyiyim a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmofra hwɛ ne adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata abusua no so. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛyi nyiyim afiri hɔ, ahyɛ hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ ho nkuran, na ayɛ tebea a ɛbɛma mmaa, mmabaa, ne PWD foɔ anya kyɛfa koraa wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ pɛyɛ mu ne mmarima.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi reyɛ kasatia anaa nkate fam ayayade a, so ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobegyae adamfofa? (ahye a wode besi hɔ, wo yiedi a wode bedi kan) .
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wo ne obi a ɔka nsɛm anaa nkate mu ayayade begyae adamfofa. Wofata abusuabɔ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yebetumi asusu sɛnea yɛbɛgyina nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa tebea a ɛyɛ den a ɛsɔre bere a yɛrebu kɔkoamunsɛm, te sɛ sɛnea yɛbɛbu mehyeɛ bere a m’adamfo ne me nam anaa bere a me ne abusuafoɔ afoforo resusu kɔkoamunsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Yebetumi asusu akwan a yɛbɛfa so agyina nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa tebea a ɛyɛ den a ɛsɔre bere a yɛrebu kɔkoamunsɛm no ho. Eyi betumi aka wo ahyeɛ a wɔbɛbu bere a wone wo nnamfo nam, kɔkoamu nsɛm a wɔnka wɔ badwam, ne bere a ɛyɛ kɔkoam a wɔbɛhwehwɛ de asusu nsɛm a ɛhia wɔ abusua no mu. Yebetumi nso ahyehyɛ akwankyerɛ a yɛde bɛkora kɔkoamunsɛm so bere a yɛne abusuafoɔ afoforo anaa nkurɔfoɔ a wɔnni abusua no mu resusu kɔkoamunsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mete nka sɛ me ho ayɛ me yaw anaasɛ me bo afuw saa sɛ mannya nna a ɛdɔɔso wɔ mmarimabere ne mmabaabere mu a?
answer_twi_source: Dae a wonnya no ka adwene, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, ne ahoɔden dodow. Nsakrae a ɛba nkwadɔm mu no betumi ama saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi ayɛ kɛse wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abusua mu nkɔso, a awofo akwanhwɛ, awo ntoatoaso ntam ntawntawdi, ne mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow ka ho di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho osuahu ahorow a mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne kakraa bi nya mu?
answer_twi_source: Abusua mu nkɔso, a awofo akwanhwɛ, awo ntoatoaso ntam ntawntawdi, ne mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow ka ho, di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho osuahu ahorow a mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne kakraa bi nya no mu. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne atetesɛm ahorow a ɛwɔ mmusua mu betumi anya gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne awo a wɔpaw ho no so nsunsuansoɔ. Ebia mmabun behyia nhyɛso sɛ wobedi atetesɛm mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow so, na ebetumi aka wɔn ahofadi ne tumi a wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ hu nsunsuansoɔ a abusua mu nkɔsoɔ nya na wɔde awofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no ka nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔdie mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛboa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodi a wɔmfa ano nni dwuma di wɔ nkitahodie a etu mpɔn mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua Kasa: Sɛnea wogyina hɔ, wo nsa a wode yɛ adwuma, ne w’anim yɛbea betumi ahyɛ wo nsɛm no mu den anaasɛ ɛne no bɔ abira. Anim Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Sɛ obi serew a, ɛkyerɛ ɔnwu, n’anim a wobɛbɔ no betumi akyerɛ sɛ ɛhaw wo, na n’ani a wobɛhwɛ no kyerɛ sɛ ɔde ne ho ahyɛ mu. Ɛnne: Ɔkwan a wofa so ka biribi no betumi asesa nea ɛkyerɛ koraa, enti ma w’adwene nkɔ wo nne so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmara a ɛyɛ nyiyimu (gender/religion/income) betumi ɛnnya nsusuaso wo mmabun nna mu ne wo ahokwasan apommuden 'SRH', sɛ mmabun bennya ayaresa ho kwan?
answer_twi_source: Mmaa ne mmarima nyiyimu: nyinsɛn ano sie nnuru bo yɛ den. Nsakrae tumi wo Nyamesom: Siw mmoa bi kwan. Ohia: Wontumi ntua ka. Ɛde nyinsɛn/nna mu yareɛ 'STIs' ba. Mmara pa ma apɔwmuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de "Me" nsɛm ne kasa a wɔde si so dua "assertive statements" adi dwuma de akyerɛ me hiade, nea mepɛ, ne ahye wɔ nna mu tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Me' nsɛm ne kasa a wɔde si so dua yɛ nnwinnade a etu mpɔn a wɔde di ahiade ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne ahye ahorow ho asɛm wɔ nna mu tebea horow mu. Sɛ anka wode asodi bɛto wo so anaasɛ wobɛbɔ sobo no, fa nsɛmfua te sɛ "Mete nka..." anaa "Mepɛ..." da wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate adi Eyi boa ma wofa wo nkate no wura na ɛkwati sɛ wode onipa foforo no bɛto ahobammɔ so. Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tẽẽ di dwuma fa ka w’ahye ne w’akwanhwɛ ahorow ho asɛm denneennen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ma nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛtrɛw mu anaasɛ wɔbɛma atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ma sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri mu anaasɛ wɔbɛma atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Wɔbɛka akuw a wɔbɛkasa ma akuw a sukuufo di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene asi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm so a wɔbɛka ho anaasɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ no so. Nkrataa anaa adesrɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛw akɔma mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne sukuu so ahwɛfo de ahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a edi mu nni kan. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, kuropɔn mu nhyiamu, anaa baguam atiefoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de aka wɔn haw ho asɛm na wɔakyɛ wɔn suahunu a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan a wɔbɛnya ho. Nhomasua nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase ho nhyehyɛe de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho nhyehyɛe. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nnwumakuw a wɔsom mmabun a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔadi nsonsonoe ahorow a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie mu ama mmabun ho dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne Abofra gyeɛ a aborɔfo frɛ no 'adoption', na kwan bɛn so na mmofra a wafa wɔn sɛɛ wɔn mma nhyenhyeɛ yɛ dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Abofra gyeɛ a aborɔfo frɛ no 'adoption' yɛ mmara kwan a yɛfa so gye abofra yɛ yɛn ba. Ɛkɔ so sɛn: mmra ankasa apene so: Awofo a woankasa wɔwo no wɔse wopene so wo mmra kwan so se ye gye neba. Efie Nhwehwɛmu: wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔrebɛgye abofra no fata anaa: wɔwɔ hwɛso bere a wɔde abofra kotena nkorɔfo naa wɔpɛsɛ wogye abofra no. Awie: abofra gye no fa mmra nhehyɛe so ma edi mu wɔ mmra kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmabun a wɔanya mfaso afi sikasɛm nketewa ne nnwuma nketewa nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne wiase nyinaa no nkonimdi ho nsɛm ne nneyɛe pa?
answer_twi_source: Nkonimdie ho nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun a wɔnya mfasoɔ firi sikasɛm nketewa ne nnwuma nketewa nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu no bi ne ɔbabun bi a ɔwɔ nkuraaseɛ a ɔde bosea ketewa bi hyɛɛ kuayɛ adwuma ketewa bi ase, na ɔnam saayɛ so maa ofie sika kɔɔ soro na ɔboaa s maa mpɔtam hɔ aduane nya. Aberanteɛ a ɔyɛ adwuma a ɔrefi nsaanodwuma adwuma bi ase a ɔde sikasɛm nketewa mmoa, a ɛma n’atipɛnfoɔ nya adwumayɛ hokwan na ɔhyɛ amammerɛ a wɔkora soɔ ho nkuran. Mmabun kuw bi reyɛ adwumakuo bi de ayɛ adwumakuo a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, a wɔreboaboa nneɛma ano de adi nsɛnnennen a ɛtaa ba ho dwuma na wɔama sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano. Nneyɛe pa bi ne: Sikasɛm mu nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wɔde bɛma: Wɔde boseabɔ ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, sika a wɔde sie, ne sikasɛm ho ntetee a wɔde bɛma de adi mmabun ahiade ne wɔn apɛde ahorow ho dwuma. Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Afotu, ntetee, ne nkitahodi hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ama mmabun anya adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ, nneɛma foforo a wɔyɛ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ. Abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom a ɛboa a wɔbɛkyekyere: Yɛne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma, a aban, NGO ka ho, bɛyɛ adwuma abom. ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, sɛ wɔbɛbɔ tebea a ɛbɛma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adwumayɛ ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden aba Nanso, sikasɛm nketewa a wɔde ma Asotifoɔ ne Anifuraeɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho dwumadie a egyina mpɔtam hɔ di wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie a wɔde bɛduru mmabun nkyɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbɛtumi ahyɛ saa dwumadie yi mu den na ama wɔanya nkɔsoɔ ne gyeɛ a wɔgye tom no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan dwumadie a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so di dwuma titire wɔ nea   wotwa no tia ka sɛ SRH ho nsɛm ne dwumadie a wɔde bɛduru mmabun nkyɛn, titire wɔ mmeaeɛ a akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ no sua. Saa dwumadie yi taa ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ yɛ adwuma bom kɛseɛ na ɛbɛtumi ayɛ ayaresabea a wɔde fa nnipa, atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, mmabun mmeaeɛ, ne nnwuma a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ saa nnwuma yi mu den no, akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de ntetee ne mmoa ama mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan adwumayɛfo, ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya sika ne nneɛma a ɛfata, na wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ayɛ biako.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amanmere anaa mpɔtam abrabɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛtumi sesa sɛnea nkurɔfoɔ te 'pene' aseɛ?
answer_twi_source: Amanmere ne mpɔtam abrabɔ tumi sesa sɛnea nkurɔfoɔ te ‘pene’ (consent) aseɛ kɛse paa, na egyina nsesaeɛ a ɛda mmarima ne mmaa nnwuma, nna ho nneyɛeɛ, ne tumi mu nkyikyɛm mu. Amanmere bi wɔ hɔ a wɔn gyinapɛn a ɛfa ‘pene’ ho yɛ den paa, berɛ a afoforɔ nso ma obiara kwan ma ɔsi ne dodo ne ne pɛ ho gyinaeɛ. Ɛhia paa sɛ wo bɛhunu na woasusu saa amanmere mu nsunsuansoɔ yi ho yie, na woahunu sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ‘pene’ gyina obu, nteaseɛ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda nnipa mmienu ntam so berɛ biara, mpo sɛ amanmere anaa mpɔtam abrabɔ no nte saa a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ obi bɛtra ɔyere biako abusuabɔ mu de asiw nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ano?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ ɔyere biako abusuabɔ mu a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo ne wo hokafo no ne mo ho mo ho nna nkutoo na wɔayɛ mo baanu nyinaa nhwehwɛmu sɛ ebia nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV anaa. Mfaso a ɛwɔ ɔyere biako a wɔbɛware wɔn ho wɔn ho so de asiw STI/HIV ano no bi ne: Asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV  no so tew efisɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa ne wɔn ho wɔn ho akɔ nna mu nkutoo. Ahotoso ne nkitahodi a ɛkɔ soro wɔ ahokafo ntam, na ɛde nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ kɛse ba wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye sɛ wobenya STI anaa HIV wɔ abusuabɔ no mu no so tew, bere tenten a ahokafo baanu no nyinaa kɔ so di nokware na wɔkɔ so de nna a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko atia nyiyimu ne animteasebu ne amammerɛ akyiwade fa nna mu nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asiw saa kwan ɛhaw yi ano ne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ho dahuruw akyerɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo nnamfo de yi atoro firi hɔ. Mpɔtam nkitahodi 'community dialogue': Yɛ nhyiamu wɔ mpɔtam de ma nteaseɛ. Social media/Arts: Fa intanɛt ne 'arts' di dwuma de ka wo suahunu. Nkabomyɛ 'Collaboration': Ne NGOs nyɛ adwuma. Empowerment: Gyina wo hokwan so na hwehwɛ obu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a broni ka no 'digital media literacy skills' betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakasa atia asɛm a epira, ako atia animtiaabu, na wɔahyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran wɔ Intanɛt so?
answer_twi_source: dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ a broni ka no 'digital media literacy skills' ma mmabun tumi ma wɔkasa tia asɛm a epira, ko tia animtiaabu, na wɔhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran wɔ intanɛt so denam ma a ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ emu nsɛm mu yiye, hu animhwɛ ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, de wɔn ho hyɛ nokwasɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu ne nokwaredi ho nhyehyɛe mu, na wɔma nne ahorow a ɛkamfo nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, nnipa ahorow ahorow, ne obu ma wɔn no yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan a edi mu a wɔfa so siw STI/HIV ano a wɔde adi dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a ɛdi mu a wɔfa so siw STI/HIV ano a wɔde adi dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa no bi ne: Nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fa STI/HIV a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu, akwan a wɔfa so siw ano, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma ho nkuranhyɛ ne kɔndɔm a wɔde ma kwa anaasɛ wɔde sika boa no kyekyɛ denam akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn, ne asetra mu aguadi ɔsatu ahorow so. HIV nhwehwɛmu ne afotuo dwumadie a wɔde ma denam akwan ahodoɔ so, a akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea, ayaresabea a wɔde fa nnipa, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ wɔn ankasa nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛtew ɔhaw so ama nnipa a wɔde nnubɔne gu wɔn mu, a nhyehyɛe a wɔde sesa nnade, ayaresa a wɔde si opioid ananmu, ne nnwuma a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ka ho a wɔde bedi dwuma. HIV ano aduru a wɔde bɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo te sɛ abusua nhyehyɛe, ɛnanom akwahosan, ne awotwaa mu kokoram ho nhwehwɛmu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akatua pa anaa mfaso a efi mfɛfo hɔ, te sɛ ayeyi, gye a wogye tom, agye din, anaa akatua a wotumi hu no hyehyɛ ɔpɛ a mewɔ sɛ mɛyɛ nea ɛne nneyɛe anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow bi hyia, a nea ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Akatua pa anaa mfaso a wunya fi atipɛnfo hɔ, te sɛ ayeyi, gye a wogye tom, agye din, anaa akatua a wotumi hu betumi akyerɛ ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wobɛyɛ nea ɛne nneyɛe anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow bi hyia, a nea ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan "sexual health" ho ka ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, sɛ wonya nkamfo anaa wogye tom fi atipɛnfo hɔ esiane nna mu nneyɛe bi a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu nti no betumi ama hokwan a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛsan ayɛ saa nneyɛe no bio na ama wɔakɔ so agye wɔn atom wɔ asetra mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛka sɛnea mmabun te nka na wɔte nsakraeɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn nipadua ne afoforɔ nipadua mu wɔ nsabuo mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii ka sɛnea mmabun hu na wɔte nka wɔ nsakraeɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn nipadua ne afoforo nipadua mu wɔ nsabuo mu: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne amammerɛ: Hwɛtie, ntentanfidie, ne nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ betumi aboa nsesa adwene wɔ ahoɔfɛ, mmarimayɛ, ne mmaayɛ ho. Nnamfoɔ: Sɛ wode wo ho toto wo nnamfo anaa nneɛma a ɔmanfoɔ hwɛ kwan ho a, ebetumi asakra sɛnea wote nka wɔ wo nipadua ho. Sukuu: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ pa boa ma wote nsakraeɛ no ase yie. Abusua: Sɛ wo ne abusua kasa pefee a, ebetumi ama wo akwankyerɛ ne nteaseɛ. Amammerɛ: Amammerɛ mu gyidie a ɛfa sɛnea nipadua teɛ, mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie, ne nna ho ka sɛnea wohu nsakraeɛ no. Ahoɔden a wonya wɔ wo ho: Sɛ wote nka yie wɔ wo ho a, ɛka sɛnea wogye wo nipadua tom na wote ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasua atinka mu nhyehyɛe ho nimdeɛ na wɔde adi dwuma, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa bio?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Adwene ne nneyɛe ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa atinka mu nhyehyɛe, adwennwen ano aduru, ne sɛnea wogyina ano ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛma denam sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow so. Afotuo Dwumadie "Counseling": Sukuu afotufoɔ, adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa mmoa akuo a wɔde ma mmabun kwan ma wɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa Nhyehyɛeɛ: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ, afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ, anaa akuo a asuafoɔ di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si nkateɛ mu yiedie ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa so a wɔde bedi dwuma. Awofo a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ atinka mu nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ fie denam adwumayɛbea ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde boa, ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee so. Mpɔtam Nneɛma: Mmabun a wɔde bɛka mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma te sɛ adwenemyareɛ ayaresabea, mmabun mmeaeɛ, anaa intanɛt so mmoa nkitahodiɛ ho ama mmoa ne dwumadie foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba ma mmabun nnya sikasɛm mu nnwuma, te sɛ nkrataa a wonni, sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wonni, nyiyim, beebia wɔte, anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow a ɛtaa ba mmabun so no bi ne: Nwoma te sɛ identification nkrataa a wonni. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a anohyeto wom anaa sikakorabea ho adwene ho ntease. Nyiyim a egyina mfe a obi adi, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna, anaa asetena ne sikasɛm tebea so. Bea wɔte, titiri wɔ nkuraase. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛmma obi nnya sikasɛm mu ahofadi anaasɛ ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atenka  fam haw  a ebia mehyia wɔ ɔkwan biara a mɛfa so (awofoyɛ anaa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma) mu no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ɔwofoyɛ: Ebia wubehyia atenka mu ɔhaw te sɛ adwennwen, dadwen, anaa atenka a ɛne sɛ wobɛtew wo ho afi afoforo ho. Abofra a Wogye Wo: Ebia wobɛte atenka ahorow bi nka, a awerɛhow, adehwere, ne anigye ama abusua a w'ati wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmɔden bɛn na wɔrebɔ sɛ wɔbɛsɔ nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a etu mpɔn wɔ yɛn nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu ahwɛ na wɔatu mpɔn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wosusuw mmabun ahiade ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a etu mpɔn wɔ nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu ahwɛ na wɔatu mpɔn no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so, akwan a wɔfa so ma mmuae, ne nhwehwɛmu adesua. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi afa nhwehwɛmu, akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene asi so, anaa nsɛmmisa a wɔmmɔ din so aboaboa nsɛm ano afiri asuafoɔ hɔ de ate wɔn suahunu, nea wɔpɛ, ne adesua ahiadeɛ ase. Bio nso, akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu te sɛ sɔhwɛ a edi kan ne akyi, adesuadan mu nhwehwɛmu, ne nhyehyɛe mu nhwehwɛmu hwehwɛ nkɛntɛnso a adesua nhyehyɛe no nya wɔ nimdeɛ, suban, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Mmabun adwene ho hia kɛse wɔ adesua nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa ho, ɛka obiara ho, na etu mpɔn no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu kokoam nsɛm so, na sɛ ɛte saa a, ɛyɛ dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu kokoam nsɛm so wɔ tebea horow bi a asiane a ɛreba sɛ wobepira ɔyarefo no anaa afoforo wɔ hɔ no mu. Eyi betumi ayɛ tebea horow a ɛfa ahunahuna a ɛne sɛ wobepira wɔn ho, apira afoforo, mmofra a wɔyɛ wɔn ayayade, anaa mpanyimfo ayayade ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankoro paw wɔn edinnsiananmu, na nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi ahaw wɔn gyinaesi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana mu no, constitutition no gye mmea ne mmarima "binary gender" nkutoo tom a "she/he" edinnsiananmu nkutoo na ɛka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔhwɛ ma mmabun kokoam sie wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe mu: Ɛhyɛ ahotoso ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran wɔ mmabun ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ntam Ɛhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata na ɛfata a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban Bɔ mmabun ahofadi ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne apomoden ho Mmoa wɔ apomoden nyinaa mu nea efi mu ba denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a nokwaredi wom ne yareɛ no a wobehu na wɔasa no pɛpɛɛpɛ a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, sɛ mihyia basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa wɔ hɔ firi Ghana Polisifoɔ Ofie Basabasayɛ Dwumadibea, mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no. Wobetumi abisa nsɛm asekyerɛfo anaa nnwinnade a wɔde boa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi pene aduruyɛ bi so a ɔnte ase yiye a, dɛn na ebetumi asi?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde pene a wɔde ma a wɔnte nea aduruyɛ anaa ayaresa bi kyerɛ ase yiye a, ebetumi ama: - Nea ebefi mu aba anaa ɔhaw ahorow a wɔanhyɛ da na aba. - atenka a ewo ahonuo, dadwen, anaase abotɔyam a wonni wɔ nea ebefi mu aba no ho. - a ɛyɛ den sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ a wɔde di akyi anaa mmoa dwumadie. - a ehwe ase ahotoso a ewo akwahosan ho dwumadiefoo anaase akwahosan ho nhyehyeee mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow, mmabun akuo ahorow, ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi betumi adi dwuma wɔ akwahosan ho nimdeɛ, ɔhwɛ ahorow, ne akwahosan hwehwɛ nneyɛe a asɛde wom a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi de akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ahyɛ wɔn adesua nhyehyɛe mu, a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ awoɔ apwmuden, adwenemyare, nnuro a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so anosie, ne asetena kwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔpaw ho. Mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ nhyiam ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a atipɛnfo di anim wɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabun ho, na ama wɔanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛmu da hɔ ne nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ. Atipɛnfo nkitahodi betumi ahyɛ akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a wɔbɛkyekyɛ, ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano ho nneyɛe a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne atipɛnfo mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma a wobenya ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfiridwuma foforo bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, te sɛ mobile apps, telemedicine, anaa mfiri a wɔhyɛ, a wɔde bɛboa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma foforo a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan no bi ne: Mobile apps: Apps te sɛ period trackers, nyinsɛn ano nkae apps, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ apps ma wonya nsɛm ne akadeɛ a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ankasa de aboa mmabun ma wɔadi wɔn awo akwahosan ho dwuma. Telemedicine platforms: Virtual healthcare services ma mmabun kwan ma wotumi kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn wɔ akyirikyiri, wonya nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, na wonya kokoam hwɛ wɔ SRH ho haw ahorow ho. Mfiri a wɔhyɛ: Nneɛma a wɔhyɛ a nyansa wom a wɔde akwahosan ho nneɛma a wɔde di akyi ahyɛ mu no tumi hwɛ brayɛ kyinhyia, di apɔ mu ateneatene akyi, na ɛma wonya akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa ho nhumu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na media ho adesua a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ, wɔwɔ nhumu, na wɔde asɛde di dwuma wɔ nnɛyi digitall bere yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wohia a wɔde bɛma wɔn de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm, gyinabea ahorow, ne emu nsɛm mu yie na wɔakyerɛ ase wɔ nhyiam ahorow ne akwan horow so. Akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho, a nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, nsɛmmɔnedi, nsɛm a epira, kɔmputa so ayayade, ne asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so a wɔbɛda no adi ka ho bɛhyɛ wɔn. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu asɛm, nsusuii hunu, animhwɛ, ne ɔkasa ahorow a ɛwɔ tumi mu ho kyim, nsɔ nhwɛ, na wɔnsɛe, na wɔnhwehwɛ adwene ahorow, nne, ne osuahu ahorow wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow mu. Wɔn tumi a wɔde susu nneɛma ho a wɔde wɔn ho, gyinaesi a wonya nimdeɛ, ne ɔman ba a wɔwɔ asɛde a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, na ama wɔatumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmeae a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo pii wɔ mu denneennen, de wɔn ho ahyɛ baguam kasa mu wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so, na wɔaboa wɔn mpɔtam ne ɔmanfo yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahokokwaw a wɔde hyehyɛ obu a wosua wɔ ne mmabaabere mu betumi aboa ma wɔanya yiyedi nyinaa, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne abusuabɔ pa wɔ asetena nyinaa mu, a mpanyin afe so ne adwumayɛfo tebea horow ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhye a wɔde si hɔ ne obu a wɔde hyɛ mu ho nimdeɛ a wosua wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no hia ma yiyedi nyinaa, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne abusuabɔ pa wɔ asetena nyinaa mu, a mpanyin afe so ne adwumayɛfo tebea horow ka ho. Sɛ mmabun sua sɛnea wobehu wɔn ahye, adi nkitaho, na wɔakura mu a, wonya adwene a emu yɛ den a ɛma wohu wɔn ho, wobu wɔn ho, na wɔkamfo wɔn ho. Saa nimdeɛ yi ma ankorankoro tumi ma wotumi fa asetra mu nkitahodi ahorow mu, si wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ so dua, na wɔde ahye a ɛfata si hɔ wɔ ankorankoro ne adwumayɛfo abusuabɔ mu. Ɛdenam obu ne ntease a wɔbɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho anya so no, ankorankoro betumi anya abusuabɔ a ɛboa na ɛma abotɔyam ne afoforo nya, na ama wɔanya nkate fam yiyedi kɛse na wɔatumi agyina asetra mu nsɛnnennen ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne nna mu yareɛ, na ɛfa sɛn na aba?
answer_twi_source: STIs' nkeyrɛkyerɛ mu: nnam mu yareɛ a aborɔfoɔ ka no sɛ 'STIs' yɛ nyarewa a ɛfa nna so ba. Yetumi nya no firi nna a yeda fa ɔbaa akosua kumaa, yetrumu, anaa y'ano, ena yetumi nya firi ɔbaa ne ɔbarima nna ekabom a. Nna mu yareɛ a ɛtaa yɛ: nea aborɔfoɔ frɛ no Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, Syphilis, Herpes, HPV, HIV, Hepatitis B ne nea ekekaho. Akwan a yetumi nya firi honam ho nsuo: (nhwɛso., nkwammoa, nsu a efiri awotwaa no mu, mogya). Mmaa awotwaa ne mmarima dua nkitahodie a etumi de yareɛ tesɛ nea aborofo frɛ no 'herpes' ne 'HPV' ɛba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na tumi a ɛnkari pɛyɛ ne mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow boa ma nsɛnnennen ba wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wodi ho dwuma ne mmabun nna mu hokwan ahorow a wɔbɔ ho ban mu? (Asɛm no ntini a yɛbɛte ase)
answer_twi_source: Tumi a ɛnkari pɛyɛ ne atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow betumi ama ayɛ den sɛ wobedi nna mu basabasayɛ ho dwuma: Tumi a ɛnkari pɛyɛ: Nnipa a wɔwɔ tumidi dibea (mpanyimfo sen mmabun) betumi ahyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa ma wɔayɛ nna mu nneyɛe a wɔmpɛ. Bɔbeasu Ho Gyinapɛn: Gyinapɛn ahorow bi hwɛ kwan sɛ mmarimaa bɛyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ katee na mmeawa nso nyɛ hwee, na ɛma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛka sɛ dabi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama mmɔden a wɔbɔ wɔ nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano, wɔhwɛ so, ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɔ no atu mpɔn na ama wɔate nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen a mmabun hyia wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho ntɛmpɛ mu no ase yiye na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ama mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm ano, wɔbɛhwɛ so, na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu no atu mpɔn na ama wɔate nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen a mmabun hyia wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho ntɛmpɛ mu no ase yiye na wɔadi ho dwuma. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm a wɔakyekyɛ mu afa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ano, wɔbɛhwɛ sɛnea nnwuma ahorow wɔ hɔ ne sɛnea ɛyɛ papa, na wɔahwɛ nkɛntɛnso a nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu no nya. Ɛdenam akwan a egyina adanse so a wɔde di dwuma so no, nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no betumi asiesie nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ma wɔadi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuaso bɔne a ɛba wɔ yɛn atinka ho, wɔ bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu nyinaɔa?
answer_twi_source: Bere Tiaa: Wɔ bere a  ɛyɛ tiaa mu no, nkate mu nhyehyɛe a ɛnteɛ betumi ama nnipa ntam ntawntawdi, ahopere, adwene a ɛsakra, na ayɛ den sɛ wobegyina nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba ano. Bere Tenten: Nea ebefi mu aba bere tenten no betumi ayɛ adwennwen a enni sabea, abusuabɔ mu nsɛnnennen, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, adwenemyare, ne adesua anaa adwuma mu dwumadi a asɛe. Atnka mu nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn a wubenya wɔ mmofraase no betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase na ama wɔatumi agyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena kwan a ahoɔden wom a metumi apaw de aboa nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom? (aduan a wodi, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, nna) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ahoɔden wom a wubetumi apaw ama nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom ni: Adidi: Di aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, ne protein a ɛnyɛ den pii wom. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Wɔkamfo apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛnyɛ kɛse te sɛ, nantew anaa asuguare a wɔyɛ no daa kyerɛ. Dae: Fa si w’ani so sɛ wobɛda nnɔnhwerew asɔn kosi awotwe (7-8) anadwo biara. kwati nsa ne sigaretnom , nom nnuru a wɔakyerɛw ama wo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kasa ma nkurɔfo no ka nnipa nyinaa ho na egyina hɔ ma nne ne osuahu ahorow a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn kasama mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban no bɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ nne ne osuahu ahorow ananmusifo wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Nea broni ka no 'intersectionality'a wɔde bedi kan na wɔahu haw soronko a akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua, atubrafo, aguanfo, aborɔfo, ne nnipa a wɔadi dɛm hyia no so. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ankorankoro a wofi mmeae ahorow de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu na wɔadi akannifo a ntease wom wɔ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Wɔn a 'ASRH' nsonsonoe aka wɔn kɛse no nne ne osuahu ahorow a wɔde besi mfinimfini, adwene a wɔde to nkyɛn a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, ne asɛm a ɛwɔ tumi ne tumi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛkasa tia. Obu, tema, ne biakoyɛ tebea horow a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmeae a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, adwene ahorow a wobetie, ne ntawntawdi ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ so. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsusuwii ne wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so mu de hu animhwɛ, hokwan, ne anifuraefo, ne bɔhyɛ a wɔde bɛma sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so asua ade na wɔanya nkɔso sɛ wɔn a wɔkasa ma asetra mu atɛntrenee ne pɛyɛ wɔ 'ASRH' mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwannya ne asodie  bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn awo akwaa apɔmuden  ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua betumi ama wɔn tumi ama wɔabɔ wɔn akwannya ahorow ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Akwannya ne asɛyɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho no bi ne: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya wɔn nipadua, nna, ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛkɔ akyiri. Akwannya a Wɔpene So: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu, ne nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw. Akwannya a Wɔde Sie: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmoa a wɔde sie a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda no adi. Akwahosan Ho Asɛyɛde: Mmabun wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn awo akwahosan so denam nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛyɛ, ayaresa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia, ne wɔn ankasa yiyedi a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so. Nhomasua betumi ama mmabun tumi ma ako ama wɔn akwannya ahorow wɔ: Nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn akwannya ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho a wɔde bɛma, a sɛnea wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ ahofadi na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa ka ho. Ahokokwaw a wɔbɛkyekye wɔ nkitahodi a etu mpɔn, asɛm a wɔka de hyɛ wɔn ho so, ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo mu de afa akwahosan ho tebea horow mu na wɔakyerɛ nea wɔpɛ ne wɔn ahiade ahorow. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne asetra ne mmara mu akwanside ahorow a ebetumi asiw awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne hokwan ahorow a wobenya ano hye no ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso. Wɔhyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn, nnwuma a mmabun di anim, ne nhyehyɛe ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛhyɛ awo hokwan ahorow ne nnwuma a mmabun nyinaa nya ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ akwan pa a wɔfa so hyɛ mu den a atu mpɔn wɔ nneyɛe pa ne gyinaesi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu wɔ nhwehwɛmu anaa wiase tebea ahorow ankasa mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn de nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi adi dwuma wɔ m’ankasa asetra ne me nyonkofa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa akwan pa a wɔfa so hyɛ mu den a ɛtu mpɔn wɔ suban pa ne gyinaesie a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu no bi ne: Atipɛnfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn tom nhyehyɛeɛ: Suban pa ne nkɔsoɔ a wɔhunu na wɔ kamfo wɔ atipɛnfoɔ akuo mu, amammerɛ a wɔde boa na wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran. Nsɛm pa a wɔde ma: Nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde bɛma atipɛnfo wɔ nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho asɛyɛde a wɔbɛpaw ho, ahyɛ nneyɛe ne suban a wɔpɛ mu den. Nhwɛsoɔ: Suban pa ne gyinaesie a wobɛyɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ wɔ w’ankasa nneyɛeɛ ne nkitahodie mu, ayɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa ama afoforo a wɔbɛsuasua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yebetumi afa so de adi aduan a ɛbɛboa ma yɛatumi adi nyinsɛn ho nsɛnnennen te sɛ awo ntoatoaso a enni mũ anaa awo mu ahoɔyaw ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohwɛ sɛnea wobɛhwɛ w'ahoɔfɛ ho yiye a, hwɛ sɛ wobɛnya nnuan a ɛsom bo wɔ magnesium mu (te sɛ nnuaba, aburow, aburoo, nnuaba) a ɛbɛboa wo ama woagyina yare no so. Sɛ wunya aduan a ahoɔden wom te sɛ nnuaba, nnuaba, aburoo a, ɛbɛboa wo nso ama woahyɛ wo ho so na ama woahyɛ wo ho so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ahotoso sɛ m’ankasa me ho nsɛm, te sɛ nna ho nsɛm  anaa suahu ahorow, aka abusua no mu woberɛ a ɛrenkɔ abɔnte?
answer_twi_source: Mɛpɛ sɛ w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm, a nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm anaa osuahu ahorow ka ho, bɛka abusua no mu. Yebetumi de ahotoso aba denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a yɛbɛkɔ so akura mu, obu a yebebu ahye, ne adwempa a yɛbɛda no adi bere a yɛresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ebetumi afi afotuo nhyehyɛe ahorow so ama mmabun wɔ wɔn ho a wobu, asetra mu nimdeɛ, adesua mu nkɔso, adwenemyare, ne yiyedi nyinaa a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asusuw nea efi mu ba yi ho na wɔasusuw ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asusu mfasoɔ a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ so ama mmabun wɔ wɔn ankasa obuo, asetena mu nimdeɛ, adesua mu nkɔsoɔ, adwenemyareɛ, ne yiedie nyinaa mu nkɔsoɔ na wɔasusu ho denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔreyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no ne ɛno akyi: Afotufoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no ne akyire de asusu nsakraeɛ a ɛba mmabun wɔn ho, wɔn asetena mu nimdeɛ, wɔn adesua mu nkɔsoɔ, ne adwene mu akwahosan so berɛ. Nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛmbisa: Afotufoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔabisabisa mmabun nsɛm de aboaboa wɔn suahunu, adwene, ne nea efiri mu ba a ɛfa afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ ho no ho nsɛm a ɛfa su ho ano. Adesua mu nkɔsoɔ ho kyerɛwtohɔ: Afotufoɔ tumi di mmabun adesua mu nkɔsoɔ ne wɔn a wɔbaa sukuu no ho kyerɛwtohɔ akyi ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ mu ne berɛ a wɔawie no de ahwɛ nkɔsoɔ anaa nsakraeɛ biara a aba. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no bere tenten: Nhwehwɛmufo betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde bere tenten ayɛ de ahwɛ nkɛntɛnso a afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow nya wɔ mmabun yiyedi so bere tenten, a wɔn nhomasua mu nkɔso, adwuma a wɔpɛ, ne asetra mu abotɔyam nyinaa ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa Intanɛt so nneyɛe ho no ne nneyɛ pa ho nsusuii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no hyia?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa Intanɛt so nneyɛe ho, te sɛ kɔmputa so ayayade, ɔhaw, ne kokoam nsɛm, ne nneyɛ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no hyia denam: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde ma ankorankoro fi Intanɛt so ayayade ho, a nea ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ka ho. Akwankyerɛ ne asotwe a wɔde besi hɔ wɔ afoforo kokoam hokwan ahorow a wobu so, nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a wɔde kyɛ a wɔmmpene so, anaa nneyɛe a epira a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ Intanɛt so ho. Hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho wɔ digital mmeae, a wɔn nkitahodi ne akwahosan ho nkrataa ka ho, a wɔbɛkura mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyiam ase anaa abɛɛfo ntentan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde intanɛt so ahokyere ho dwumadie a wɔayɛ ama mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nhyiam horow ne abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔde intanɛt so ahokyere ho dwumadie a wɔayɛ ama mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan bɛma. Ebia eyinom bi ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw, nna mu akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow, mmoa telefon a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun so, anaa aban akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde mmoa nneɛma a wɔatu ho ama wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so ma. sɛ ebia. Agoo SHE + abɛɛfo ntentan denam 5100 a wobɛfrɛ so, YENKASA Nnɔmba a wontua hwee(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ne mmoa kuw betumi ahyɛ wɔn ho a wɔda no adi, adebɔ, ne ankorankoro nkɔso ho nkuran ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm
answer_twi_source: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ betumi ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ankasa nkɔso ayɛ kɛse: Adebɔ Dwumadi ahorow: Ma adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfa adwinni, nnwom, akyerɛw, anaa adebɔ ho aguadidan afoforo ho.
