Akannifoɔ Nteteeɛ: Ma mmabun nya hokwan nnya akannifoɔ nimdeɛ na wɔkamfo wɔn ho ne afoforo. Afotuo Dwumadie: Fa mmabun bata afotufoɔ a wɔbɛtumi akyɛ wɔn suahunu na wɔde adwuma ho akwankyerɛ ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo ne wɔn a wɔdɔ wɔn ho no anya nkitahodie pa wɔ wɔn nsabuo berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ nkitahodi ne ntawatawadi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn. Munsusu Ahyeɛ Ho: Kasa fa ahyeɛ a wopɛ sɛ woto na wobu wɔ wonkitahodie ho. Dwuma-Nhwɛsode nkitahodie a Ɛma Apɔmuden: Kyerɛ su pa ahodoɔ wɔ wonkitahodie ho. Hyɛ Ahofadi Ho Nkuran: Boa mmabun ma wɔn ankasa nsi gyinae berɛ a wɔde akwankyerɛ ma no. Deɛ ɛnsɛsɛ wɔyɛ Ho Nimdeɛ: Kasa fa nkitahodie bɔne ho te sɛ animtea ne ɔhyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na ankorankoro ne nnwumakuo ahorow betumi atu de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho ne afoforo wɔ LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho na wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛboa kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Wɔabara LGBTQ+ dwumadie wɔ Ghana enti nhyehyɛeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛboa a ɛka wɔn nnipa hokwan titire ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye na mahu nsonsonoe a ɛda ne nsunsuanso pa ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye no fa nhyɛso, nsakrae, anaa nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow anaa awerɛkyekye dodow bɔ abira mu ho. Nsunsuanso pa hyɛ onyin ho nkuran, ɛkyerɛ obu ma ankorankoro ahye, na ɛboa gyinaesi a ɛfata, bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye bu ani gu ankorankoro ahye so na ebetumi de nneɛma a epira aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de dijitaal nnwinnade anaa 'app' ahorow adi dwuma de ahu me nkate, me nkate tebea, ne adwenemyare ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de dijitaal nnwinnade anaa app ahorow adi dwuma de adi adwene, nkate, ne adwenemyare ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow akyi denam: Adwene mu nneyɛe akyi app anaa da biara da nsɛm a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyerɛw da biara da nkate, nkate tebea, ne dwumadi ahorow, a ebetumi aboa ma wɔahu nhyehyɛe ne nea ɛkanyan adwene mu nsakrae. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde di dwuma wɔ adwenemyare ho app ahorow mu a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwɛ nsakrae a ɛba sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow mu bere tenten na wɔadi nkɔso a aba wɔ adwenemyare ho haw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma mu. Nkaebɔ anaa kɔkɔbɔ ahorow a wɔde besi hɔ na ama wɔatumi akɔhwɛ sɛnea obi te nka ne yiyedi daa da mũ no nyinaa. Nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ adwene mu a wɔde bɛka dijitaal platform afoforo anaa mfiri a wɔhyɛ ho de aboaboa nsɛm foforo ano afa asetra mu nneɛma, nna, ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ebetumi aka adwenemyare ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ mu no, amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛtumi nya wɔn so tumi wɔ wɔn ahofama ne kokoamsɛm, nna ne awoɔ ho ayaresa mu no te sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Aane, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii betumi anya hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom ahorow bi betumi asi abusua a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akwahosan ho gyinaesi mu so dua kɛse anaasɛ ebia wɔbɛka nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho animtiaa. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ saa nsusuwii ahorow yi so bere a wɔda so ara kura hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie no akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ama mmabun ate nsɛmkaeɛ bi asɛ ansa wagye atum wɔ berɛkuro a adɔkotafo ɛreboa anaa sɛ wɔregye ayarehwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Bisa nsɛm. Hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ. Ne panyin a wogye no di nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara bom a ɛma mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm akwaaba na ɛsi wɔn so dua?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wɔbɛyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara bom ni: Nneɛma a wobetumi anya ho Nhwehwɛmu: Daa hwehwɛ honam fam mmeae ne nkitahodi akwan mu fa hu na wodi akwanside ahorow ɛwɔ hɔ ma nneɛma a wobetumi anya ho dwuma. Nteteeɛ a ɛfa nneɛma ahodoɔ ho: Fa nteteeɛ a ɛkɔ so ma akwahosan adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ sebi dɛmdi, nna, ne amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho. Akwan a Wɔfa so Ma Ayarefo Nsɛm: Fa akwan horow a mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm bɛfa so de wɔn akwahosan ho osuahu ahorow ho mmuae ama. Nsɛnkyerɛnne Pa: Fa nkrataa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ nnipa a sebi wɔadi dɛm wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bɛn na mmabun ɛtaa hyia wɔ asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wobenya ama wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow a wɔtaa hyia no ne animtiaabu, sika a wonni, kaa a wonnya, amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow, ne mmara mu ahyeɛ nhyehyeɛ ahorow. Wobetumi adi eyinom ho dwuma denam nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, mpɔtam hɔ dwumadie ahodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho behyɛm bi, sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma anaa akuo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde boa mbusua a wodi adwene mu apomoden yare ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ adwene mu apomoden kuo ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ a wɔde mmoa akuo anaa nhyiamu ma mbusua. Hwehwɛ intanɛt so nneɛma ne nhyiamu a mbusua bɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔrehyia ɔhaw a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ suahunu. Wo ne adwene mu apomoden yareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ abusua ayaresa anaa mmoa dwumadie mu nkɔbisabisa akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow betumi de apomoden ho nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ahyɛ wɔn adesua nhyehyɛe mu de ahyɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ntease pa ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ka apomoden anaa nyansahu ho adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ho. Ma hokwan ahorow ma nkitahodi ne kyɛfa a wonya adesua dwumadi ahorow. Di nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti ahorow pii ho dwuma, a nipadua akwaa, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nnaa mu yareɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ka ho. Fa nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛfata wɔn mfeɛ a ɛda asuafoɔ ahiadeɛ ne wɔn suahunu ahodoɔ adi ma. Fa ntetee ma akyerɛkyerɛfo na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw na wɔadi nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ sɛn sɛ wobɛka mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi kuo ho a, na mɛyɛ dɛn aboa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ worefa mpanyinyɛ kwan so nanso wohyia ɔhaw bi te sɛ 'stigma', nyiyimu ne mmeammea a wontumi nkɔ. Sɛdeɛ wubeboa: Tie wɔn haw wɔ adwenepa mu. Bu wɔn ahofadi. Boa ma wɔnya mmeammea a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asɛyɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho wɔ mmeae a mmabun adamfofa, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ me nsrahwɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan ne asɛdeɛ fa wɔn akwahosan ho wɔ mmeaeɛ a mmabun wɔ adamfofa su, a nea ɛka ho ne: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm ho, a nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ bɛka ho. Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde nimdeɛ pene so: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wogyina tumi a wotumi te nsɛm a wɔde ama no ase so sisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho, a ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ne akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ ka ho. Asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware bɛma: Ɛyɛ mmabun asɛyɛde sɛ wɔde wɔn akwahosan ho abakɔsɛm, yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo. Asɛde a ɛne sɛ wobebisa nsɛm: Wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wommisa nsɛm na wɔnhwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho, a ayaresa nhyehyɛe, nnuru, ne asiane anaa nsunsuanso bɔne a ebetumi aba ka ho. Asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wobedi ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow akyi: Ɛyɛ mmabun asɛyɛde sɛ wodi ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kamfo kyerɛ no akyi na wɔkɔ bere a wɔde bedi akyi sɛnea ɛho hia. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokyerɛ sɛ wowɔ hokwan ahorow bere a worekɔsra akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun a, wubetumi: Akamfo wo ho: Ka nea wopɛ, nea ɛhaw wo, ne nsɛmmisa akyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no pefee. Bisa kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe: Bisa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho ne sɛnea wɔbɛbɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Bisa nsɛm: Hwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wubetumi apaw ho nsɛm, a ayaresa foforo, asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba, ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ so ka ho. Kyerɛ nea wopɛ: Kyerɛ nea wopɛ wɔ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ayaresa ho gyinaesi, ne kokoamsɛm ho kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Sɛ wuhyia nsɛnnennen a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wowɔ hokwan ahorow a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin, ɔkamfofo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda adwene mu nsakrae a ɛtaa ba "Typical Mood Influctuations" ne adwenemyare a emu yɛ den kɛse ntam?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu nsakrae a ɛtaa ba no taa ba na ebia nea ɛka ho ne awerɛhow, adwennwen, anaa dadwen a wobɛte nka bere ne bere mu. Nanso, sɛ saa atinka ahorow yi kɔ so kyɛ anaasɛ ɛka da biara da asetena kɛse a, ebetumi ayɛ adwenemyare a emu yɛ den kɛse ho sɛnkyerɛnne. Sɛ wunnim a, ɛbɛyɛ papa bere nyinaa sɛ wo ne ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso bɛkasa na wanya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo sika, nneɛma, ne mmoa a wɔbɛma akɔ soro ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi adi ama sika, mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɔ mpɔtam hɔ nsi-ano-kwan dwumadie a ɛfa nna ho mmonnaatoɔ ho no akɔ anim denam:Asetenam nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔbɛma akɔ anim (Raising awareness): Wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ hia a nna ho mmonnaatoɔ nsi-ano-kwan hia ne mfasoɔ a saa dwumadie yi de ba ankorankorɛ, afie, ne mpɔtam ahodoɔ so.Mfɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛka wɔn abom (Mobilizing): Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛboa nsi-ano-kwan mmɔdenbɔ yi na wɔade sika a wɔahyɛ ama nsi-ano-kwan dwumadie adidi kan wɔ mpɔtam hɔ sika ne amammue nhyehyɛeɛ mu.Dwumadie a wɔde di ama, nkyerɛwee a wɔde srɛ mmoa, ne amansan nhyiamu (Advocacy campaigns): Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma wɔn nne so, wɔakyɛ wɔn asɛm, na wɔatumi apia wɔn a wɔsi gyinaeɛ wɔ mpɔtam, mantam, ne ɔman mu nyinaa.Mmofra ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nkabom akuo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma (Collaborating): Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ nkabom dwumadie, wɔakyɛ nneɛma, na wɔabom anya ahoɔden de de asetenam nsakyeraeɛ aba.Intanɛt ne mfonini so dwumadie (Social media): Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma asetenam nkyerɛkyerɛ akɔ anim, wɔahwehwɛ mmoa, na wɔayɛ dwumadie wɔ intanɛt so a ɛfa nna ho mmonnaatoɔ nsi-ano-kwan ne mpɔtam hɔ nkabom dwumadie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan, dwumadi ahorow, ne nneɛma a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu pene "consent" wɔ sukuu ahorow, mmabun nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ tebea horow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo pene a wɔpene so ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu pene wɔ sukuu ahorow, mmabun nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ tebea horow mu no bi ne nkitahodi nhyiam ahorow, dwumadi ahorow a wɔyɛ, kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ akwan horow so a ɛhwehwɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pene 'consent", ahye 'boundaries', nkitahodi 'communication", ne obu ho. Mmabun betumi akamfo nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛka obiara ho denam ɔsatu "campaigns" a wɔbɛyɛ de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔbɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe mu, wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe mu, na wɔne akyerɛkyerɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ayɛ biako de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛka adesua nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ho. Wɔbɛtumi nso aboa nnwuma a ɛde akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma yie no nne ne wɔn suahunu di kan, di amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfoɔ akwansideɛ a ɛmma wɔpene nkyerɛkyerɛ ho dwuma, na wɔhyɛ akwan a ɛka obiara ho ne nea ɛfa nnipa ntam a wɔfa so te pene a wɔpene so ase no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnuru ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano "contraception", na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn ano a wosiw kyerɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano. Ahodoɔ ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Akwan a wɔfa so siw akwansideɛ te sɛ kɔndɔm, a ɛma akwansideɛ bi siw mmadwoa kwan sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua mu. - nkwaadom (hormone) akwan te se awo ano aduru, aduru, anaase paanen wɔ (injections), a esiw nkosua a efiri adi (ovulation) anaase awotwaa mu nsuo a ewo mu den ma siw mmadwoa ano. - a wode siw nyinsɛn ano a ɛyɛ adwuma bere tenten a wotumi dannan no (LARCs) te sɛ mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUDs) anaasɛ nea wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, a ɛma nyinsɛn ano a ɛkɔ so siw ano bere tenten. - a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, a wɔtaa frɛ no "anɔpa-akyi aduru," a ebetumi asiw nyinsɛn ano wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adweneyiehwe ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔne wɔn nipadua ne wɔn ho anya abusuabɔ pa?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn Ho a Wohu a Ɛkɔ Anim: Nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho no boa mmabun ma wohu wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn atinka, ne wɔn nipadua mu atinka horow yiye a wonni atɛn. Gye a Wogye Ho Nkɔso: Nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho no ma obi nya ayamhyehye ne wo ho a wogye tum, a ne nipadua ne ne sintɔ ahorow ka ho. Adwennwen a Wɔbɛte So: Nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ wɔn ho no boa mmabun ma wodi adwennwen ne atinka bɔne so, na ɛma wonya yiyedi nyinaa. Nipadua Mfonini a Wobɛma Atu Akɔ Anim: Ɛdenam mprempren bere a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so na wɔde wɔn ho a wɔbɛtete wɔn ho denam dwumadi ahorow a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho so so no, mmabun betumi anya adwempa ne ayamhyehye kɛse wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ amanneɛbɔfo a wɔhyɛ sɛ, wɔnyɛ so bere a wosusuw sɛ ɔbabun bi rehyia nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ no so no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ amanneɛbɔfo a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ susuw sɛ ɔbabun bi rehyia nna mu ɔbrasɛe, anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ no so a, mpɛn pii no wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn adwenem naayɛ no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ mmofra ahobammɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa mmarahyɛ bagua ahorow a wɔakyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ. Mpɛn pii no, saa asɛyɛde yi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde ayayade a wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ no ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri bɛma, a adanse biara anaa nea wɔahu a ɛfoa adwenem naayɛ no so ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn anansesɛm anaa atorɔsɛm  a  ɛwɔ nna  gyinaesi ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: Obiara reda. Nteɛso: Mmabun pii paw sɛ wɔbɛtwɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi nna ho. Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ w’ankasa wobɛpaw nea wopɛ. Atosɛm: Kɔndɔm ntumi nyɛ adwuma yiye. Nteɛso: Kɔndɔm tu mpɔn kɛse wɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI ) ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw mu. Kyɛ akontaabu ne nsɛm a efi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so. Atosɛm: Ɛnyɛ anigye sɛ wobɛka nna mu akwahosan ho asɛm. Nteɛso: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no yɛ nea asɛyɛde wom na ɛho akokwaw. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuran na ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no nyɛ nea ɛfata. Atosɛm: Awo ano aduru yɛ ɔbea hokafo no nkutoo asɛyɛde. Nteɛso: Ɛsɛ sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa fa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho asodi to wɔn ho so. Si hia a asɛyɛde a wɔkyɛ ho hia wɔ nna mu akwahosan mu so dua. Atosɛm: Sɛ wufi ase da a, wuntumi nnyae. Nteɛso: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wugyae nna anaasɛ wotwe wo ho fi ho bere biara. Hyɛ no mu den sɛ pene a wɔpene so no kɔ so na wobetumi atwe afi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nyɔnkofa nkitahodie a ɛyɛ ayayade anaa nea ɛnyɛ papa mu a yɛbɛkɔ so atra mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi tra  nyɔnkofa nkitahodie a ɛyɛ ayayade anaa ɛnyɛ papa mu a, ebetumi de nea efi mu ba a emu yɛ den aba, a nea ɛka ho ne: Honam fam ne nkate mu ɔhaw a ɛkɔ so Tew ne ho fi nnamfo ne abusua ho Nkɛntɛnso bɔne a ɛwɔ adwenemyare ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho so Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obenya adwenemhaw a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ ne nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  PTSD Ɛyɛ den sɛ ɔbɛhyehyɛ  nyɔnkofa nkitahodie pa daakye
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa di wɔ PMTCT mu, na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru a wɔde ko tia ɔyare mmoawa no di dwuma titiriw wɔ PMTCT mu denam HIV mmoawa no a ɛmma ɛna no nipadua mu no so, na ɛnam so ma mmoawa no dodow ne asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛkɔ akokoaa no mu no so tew. Ebia nnuru yi bi ne nnuru ahorow a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a wɔaka abom, te sɛ nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NRTIs), non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NNRTIs), protease inhibitors (PIs), ne integrase inhibitors (INSTIs). Aduru pɔtee a wɔde di dwuma no gyina nneɛma te sɛ ɛna no akwahosan tebea, ɔyare mmoawa dodow, ne ayaresa ho abakɔsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen a broni ka no 'dilemmas' bɛn na ebetumi aba bere a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm de nsɛm anaa gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛbɔ abira a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi saa nsɛm a emu yɛ den yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen betumi asɔre bere a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm de nsɛm anaa gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛbɔ abira a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma no. Mmabun betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ abirabɔ ahorow yi a wɔbɛpata na wɔakyerɛ nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya mu ahotoso no mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi saa nsɛm a emu yɛ den yi mu no, mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ adwene ahorow, asusuw ahotoso ne nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ nneɛma a wonya fi mu no ho, na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe anaa animhwɛ a ɛwɔ ase no mu nhwehwɛmu yiye. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ a wobue mu a wɔde wɔnho hyɛ mu na wosusuw adwene ahorow pii ho so no, mmabun betumi asi gyinae ahorow a ntease wom kɛse na wɔapaw abrabɔ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu wɔn ankasa ahye na wɔaka ho asɛm yiye wɔ tebea ahorow mu, a nnamfofa, ayɔnkofa, ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu wɔn ahye na wɔaka ho asɛm yiye wɔ wɔn ankasa ahiade, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne ahotɔ dodow a wobedi kan asusuw ho no so. Afei wobetumi de nkitahodi akwan a ɛyɛ den adi dwuma de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ahye mu pefee, te sɛ "Me" nsɛmfoa a wɔde di dwuma de kyerɛ nea wɔpɛ ne anohyeto ahorow. Ahye a wɔde besi hɔ no hwehwɛ sɛ woka nea ɛyɛ papa ne nea ɛnyɛ papa mma wɔn wɔ tebea horow mu ho asɛm pɔtee, sɛ́ ɛyɛ nnamfo, ɔdɔ ahokafo, anaa afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nna mu mmra hyɛ so fo a ɛbu mmaa (gender-responsive policies) boa mmabun mmea wɔ nna mu nsɛm ho 'SRH'?
answer_twi_source: Ɛboa ma wɔnya nna mu nsɛm ho 'SRH' mmoa (contraception, maternal care). Ɛma pɛyɛ wɔ ayaresa ne nwomasua mu. Ɛma mmaa ahooden ma wɔsisi gyinaeɛ fa wɔn nipadua ho na wɔyɛ adwuma de ka wɔn ho kɔ nneama a ɛkɔso wɔ kurow no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho ne afoforo awo hokwan ahorow ne ahofadi ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho ne afoforo awo hokwan ne ahofadi ho denam: - Nsɛm a wɔtumi de ho to so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din, nhoma ahorow, ne nhomasua nneɛma so. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwumayɛbea, nhyiamu, anaa webinars a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu ne atipɛnfoɔ, abusua mufoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ase na wɔayi anansesɛm afiri hɔ. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu, te sɛ adesrɛ a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ sukuu ahorow mu anaasɛ wɔbɛboa mmara a ɛbɔ awo hokwan ahorow ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam abusuabɔ ho di ɔhwɛ ne ofie adwuma ho adesoa a mmaa ne mmeawa soa wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no gye adesoa a ɛnsɛ a ɛfa ɔhwɛ ne ofie adwuma a wontua ho ka a mmea ne mmeawa soa no tom na edi ho dwuma denam nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛsan kyekyɛ ɔhwɛ ho asɛyɛde ahorow mu, ɛma mmofra hwɛ ne asetra mu nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den a wobenya no tu mpɔn, na ɛma adwuma a wontua hwee no bo yɛ den na wogye tom no so. Wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ awofo akwamma, adwuma nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ne asetena mu ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa adwuma ne asetra kari pɛ na ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ ɔhwɛ ho asɛyɛde ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, ne ankorankoro nnwumakuw di wɔ sika a wɔde ma na wɔboa mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu?
answer_twi_source: Aban nnwumakuw, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, ne ankorankoro nnwumakuw di dwuma titiriw wɔ sika a wɔde ma na wɔboa mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu. Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de sika ama adwumayɛfo nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow, de mmoa ama mmabun akatua, anaasɛ wɔde nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkanyan nnwumakuw ma wɔfa adwumayɛfo nkumaa bedi dwuma. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso taa di mmabun adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so, de adwuma ho ntetee ne adwuma a wɔde ma ho nnwuma ma, na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa mmabun adwumayɛ kyerɛ. Ankorankoro nnwumakuw betumi aboa adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adesua, anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe, de afotu ne adwumayɛfo nkɔso hokwan ahorow ama, na wɔne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow ayɛ biako de asiesie mmabun ama adwumayɛfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ka yɛ ahe?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ Ghana no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ayaresabea, beae, ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no so. Nea enti a ɛyɛ den sɛ wode ɛka pɔtee bi bɛma ni: Ayaresabea Ho Ka: Ayaresabea ahorow wɔ sika ahorow a wɔbɔ wɔ nnwuma ho. Ɔkwan a Wɔfa so Yɛ: Mpɛn pii no, nnuru a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu no bo sua sen nyinsɛn a wɔde oprehyɛn (0peration) gu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi rebrɛ wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyare ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn de mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ama no?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi rebrɛ nnubɔne a ɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyare ho nsɛm bi ne: Nsakrae a ɛba suban, adwene, anaa nipasu mu, te sɛ abufuw a ɛkɔ soro, adwene a ɛsakra, anaasɛ ɔtwe ne ho fi asetra mu dwumadi ahorow ho. Honam fam sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde nnuru di dwuma, te sɛ aniwa a mogya ayɛ no ma, nsakrae a ɛba aduan ho akɔnnɔ anaa nna mu, anaasɛ opira a wontumi nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Adesua anaa adwuma mu mmɔdenbɔ a ɛso tew. Tew a wɔbɛtew wɔn ho afi nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa asetra mu dwumadi ahorow ho anaasɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi afoforo ho. Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma anaa adwenemyare ho nsɛm a wɔde sie anaasɛ wɔbɔ wɔn ho ban a ɛkɔ soro. Sɛ wuhu saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi wɔ obi a wunim no mu a, fa mmoa, nkuranhyɛ, ne mmoa ma wɔ hwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa a ɛfa adwumayɛfo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛkyerɛ woadwene amammerɛ/nyamesom a ɛfa nna mu nsɛm ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkyerɛ obu so na wɔka nokware nso?
answer_twi_source: Gye adwene ahorow to mu. Ma nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ nokware. Ma kwan ma yɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ. Ne mpanyimfoɔ nyɛ adwuma. Kyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun adwene nyin wɔ atinka mu nhyehyɛe ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya nneyɛe ne gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Atinka a Ɛkɔ Anim: Mmabun betumi anya atinka a ɛkɔ soro na wɔayɛ wɔn ade esiane "limbic system" a ɛyɛ atinka ho adwuma no nkɔso nti. Ahosodi a Wobenya: "Prefrontal cortex" a ɛhwɛ atinka so ne gyinaesi so no kɔ so nyin wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na ɛma nkate mu nhyehyɛe ne ahosodi mu nkɔso bere kɔ so. Asiane a Wɔde To Ho Su: Nkate mu beae a ɛrenya nkɔso ne mmeae a wosi gyinae a ɛda so ara nyin ntam a ɛnkari pɛ no betumi ama asiane a wɔde to wɔn ho so nneyɛe akɔ soro na ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso bɛba. Amemene no nyin kosi mfe aduonu-anum (25). Sɛ mmabun te nkɔso ho nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ase a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔafa wɔn atinka mu na wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So intanɛt anaa dijitaal nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi asua nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe na wɔanya bi?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, intanɛt ne dijitaal nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi asua nna ne awo akwahosan ne nnwuma a wobetumi anya ho ade. Eyinom bi ne wɛbsaet ahorow, 'app' ahorow, nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadi ahorow, ne nhomasua nneɛma a ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne aban adwumayɛbea ahorow de ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma mmabun a wɔyem anya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoamu, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu, a awofo mpene so/mmɔ wɔn amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobanbɔ wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma mmabun a wɔyem anya nna ne awo apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoamu, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu, a awofo pene/mmɔ amanneɛ, denam: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe mu, a ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ na wonya nnwuma a ɛho hia a wonsuro sɛ wɔn nsɛm no bɛyɛ a wɔda no adi kyerɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔmpene so. Apomoden ho akwan a ɛyɛ kokoam anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛ wɔde bɛsom mmabun a wɔde besi hɔ, baabi a wobetumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ tebea a ɛnyɛ atemmu ne mmoa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛba anaa ɛkɔ so bere a obi rekɔ brayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ yɛ sɛ nyinsɛn ansi a, w’awotwaa (awotwaa) no ntama a ɛbɛhwie agu. Ɛba efisɛ wɔanhyɛ ɛmo no mu, na honam nkwammoa (hormone) dodow so tew. "Lining" no hwie gu sɛ mogya (bere) a ɛfa wo akosua kumaa (vagina) mu. Eyi taa di nnafua abiesa kosi nson (3-7).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm anaa ɔhaw ahorow bɛn na wɔtaa ka ho asɛm wɔ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi adi nsɛm ne ɔhaw ahorow pii ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw, ne gyinaesi. STIs (nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu) ne ne siw ano, ne nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa. Akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, sɛnea etu mpɔn, ne sɛnea wobetumi anya. Nkitahodie mu nsunsuanso, a pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodi, ne ahye a ɛfata ka ho. Nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayade, ne ahodwiriw ne ahotɔ a wogyina ano. Nipadua ho mfonini, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo abɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a nokwaredi wom a wo ne wo hokafo benya no yɛ ade titiri a ɛbɛma woanya abusuabɔ pa. Afotu bi ni: Hwehwɛ baabi a wobɛkɔ akɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ na ɛhɔ yɛ fɛ. Ka wo gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho. Tie wo hokafo haw ahorow na bu wɔn ahye. Ka sɛnea mobɛbom ayɛ nhwehwɛmu ho asɛm, sɛ wususuw sɛ wowɔ STI anaasɛ wo ne wo hokafo di nokware na wo ne no hyia a. Kae sɛ, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee betumi asiw ntease a ɛnteɛ ano na ama wɔanya ahotoso. Ɛdenam adwuma a yɛbom yɛ so no, yebetumi ayɛ wiase bi a obiara bɛte nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no sɛ ɔbɛka nna mu akwahosan ho asɛm na wayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STI ho a onsuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ no animtiaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmere bɛn na mmara ma kwan sɛ wɔde bɔne a ɛfa mmonnaatoɔ ho amanneɛbɔ kɔto gua wɔ yɛn amansin yi mu? Na saa mmere a wɔahyehyɛ yi nya nkɛntɛnso bɛn wɔ obi a wɔayɛ no bɔne no tumi, a ɔde bɛhwehwɛ mmara mu mmoa, akɔbɔ amanneɛ, na wadi ne bammɔ ho asɛm anim nso?
answer_twi_source: Mmere a mmara ma kwan sɛ wɔde mmonnaatoɔ (sexual violence) ho amanneɛbɔ kɔto gua no gu ahorow, egyina amansin a wowɔ mu ne bɔne ko a wɔayɛ no so.Saa mmere yi na ɛkyerɛ mfe dodoɔ a obi a wɔayɛ no bɔne wɔ de bɛbɔ amanneɛ anaa ɔde bɛkɔ asennibie atia nea ɔyɛɛ no bɔne no. Mmara a wɔde ma no betumi afi mfe kakraa bi kosi mfe du du pii, ɛnya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ sɛnea wɔn a wɔayɛ no bɔne no wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ atɛntrenee no. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔn awɔayɛ no bɔne no te bere a wɔahyɛ yi ase na wɔhwehwɛ mmara mu afotu ntɛm ara sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkɔ mmara kwan so de kɔhwehwɛ nna mu basabasayɛ atɛntrenee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnea mɛyɛ na mabɔ me ho ban wɔ ntentan so wɔ berɛ a merekasa afansɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan kyerɛ no? (Sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔde din atoro bedi dwuma, abɔ nsɛm a ɛmfata ho amanneɛ).
answer_twi_source: Afotu foforo bi ni berɛ a worekamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho asɛm ni: Hu W’atiefo: Fa wo nkrasɛm no ma asɛnka agua ne atiefo a worekɔ wɔn nkyɛn no. Fa w’adwene si Tumi ne Nhomasua so: Kasama nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na ɛnyɛ mfonini mu nsɛm. Bɔ Nsɛm a Ɛmfata Ho Amanneɛbɔ: Sɛ wuhu nsɛm a ɛyɛ nyiyim anaa epira a, bɔ amanneɛ kyerɛ asɛnka agua no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina nna ho nhyɛsoɔ ano?
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka daabi. Kyerɛ deɛ wopɛ. Ɔhokafoɔ pa bu wo gyinaesiɛ ahorow. Firi hɔ. Hwehwɛ mmoa sɛ wote asiane nka a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahobanbɔ ho nsusuwii a ɛho hia bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusu ho bere a wode digital akwan horow redi dwuma de akamfo ASRR ahorow no? (Kokoam nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho ban, Intanɛt so ɔhaw)
answer_twi_source: Sɛ worekamfo nsɛmti a ɛho hia a, ahobammɔ ho hia kɛse. Kae: Nsɛm a Ɛfa Kokoam Nsɛm Ho: Susu ho sɛ wode edin hunu bedi dwuma sɛ ɛma wo ho tɔ wo a. Hwɛ Yie wɔ Intanɛt so Ɔhaw Ho: Nea ɛyɛ awerɛhow no, ɛba saa. Bɔ nsɛm a ɛmfata ho amanneɛ na siw wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wɔhaw wo no kwan. Nokwasɛm Hwɛ Ansa na Wobɛkyɛ: Bere nyinaa hwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware ansa na wode akyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so na woakwati sɛ wobɛtrɛw nsɛm a ɛnteɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ekuo bi wɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmebun nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ekuo no bi ne nea wɔfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ: Planned Parenthood,  Advocates for Youth ne  Guttmacher Institute.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sika fam mmoa ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun na ama wɔatumi anya nhomasua ne ntetee akwanya ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun nya sika fam mmoa ahodoɔ a wɔde bɛdi nwomasua ne nteteeɛ akwanya ahodoɔ akyi, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma asuafoɔ: Sika a wɔde ma asuafoɔ a egyina adesua mu nkɔsoɔ, adesua akyi a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, talente, anaa gyinapɛn foforɔ so. Mmoa: Sika a wɔde ma ankorankoro anaa nnwumakuo ahorow de yɛ atirimpɔw pɔtee bi, te sɛ adesua ho ka, nhwehwɛmu adwuma, anaa nhyehyɛe no ho ka a wɔbɔ. Bursaries: Sika fam mmoa a wɔde ma sukuufo a egyina sikasɛm mu ahiade so, mpɛn pii no de boa ma wotua adesua, nhoma, anaa asetra mu ka. Boa: Sika bosea a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtua esane nso tua so nsiho, mpɛn pii no bere a wɔawie nhomasua anaa ntetee akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bu ankorankoro gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow, nanso si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wosi gyinae pa a ɛfata ma ɔkwan biara a wɔapaw so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono obiara gyidi ne ne gyinapɛn ahorow. Ɛho hia sɛ wudi w’ankasa gyidi ahorow bere a woresisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nyinsɛn no ho no. Susuw nea wubetumi apaw nyinaa ho, nya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, na fa wo nsa ka mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Kae: Eyi yɛ gyinaesi a ɛyɛ den, na ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa. Ɛmfa ho ɔkwan a wobɛfa so no, hwɛ hu sɛ egyina nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne nea ɛte sɛ nea ɛfata wo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abusua nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho mmara, apam, ne ahye betumi adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho suban pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ahotoso a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne ntawntawdi a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ fie no mu a wɔbɛtew so?
answer_twi_source: Abusua mu mmara, nkyerɛmu, ne hyeɛ a wɔhyehyɛ fa abɛɛfo ntentan ho no tumi hyɛ abɛɛfo ntentan nneyɛeɛ pa nkuran na ɛtew ntentennee so denam: Abusuafoɔ nyinaa bɛbom adwen koro mu ahyehyɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛda abusua no nneyɛeɛ pa, nneɛma a ɛhia wɔn, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn adi; te sɛ berɛ a wɔde hwɛ mfoni (screen time) so hyeɛ a wɔbɛto, mmaeɛ anaa mberɛ a wɔremfa afidie nni dwuma a wɔbɛsi ho gyinaeɛ, ne nkitahodi a ɛfa nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ ntentan so ho.Sɛ yɛne mmabun bɛkasa pefee na yɛada nsɛm adi fa abusua mmara a ɛfa abasɛm ntentan ho, na yɛasi nsɛm tebea a ɛyɛ pɛ (balance), nea ɛfata (moderation), ne sɛnea yɛde ntentan di dwuma yiye (responsible use) so dua. Sɛ yɛbɛma mmabun no kwan nso ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaeɛ nsiesie mu na wɔde wɔn adwene ne nsusuiɛ aba ama yɛanya fie a abasɛm ntentan ho mmara teɛ.Sɛ yɛbɛma mmabun kwan ma wɔade wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaeɛ si mu, na wɔade wɔn adwene ne nsusuiɛ aba na ama yɛayɛ fie a abasɛm ntentan ho nhyehyɛeɛ teɛ. Bio nso, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛdi abusua mmara no so daa na yɛasan ahwɛ mu bio berɛ a mmabun no renyini na nneɛma a wɔhia ne wɔn nneyɛeɛ wɔ ntentan so resesa; ɛsɛ sɛ yɛma kwan ma nsakraeɛ ba sɛnea onipa biara tebea ne ne nyini teɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na me nkitahodiɛ ne afoforɔ (relationships) betumi anya nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ m'adwene mu yiedie (mental well-being) so? (nkitahodiɛ a ɛnyɛ papa, mmoa a obi nnya, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ mu nsɛnnennen)?
answer_twi_source: Adeɛ bi a wɔ fre no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ (toxic relationship): Sɛ wo ne obi a ɔma wo brɛ ase, odi wo so, anaa opira wo ho a, ebetumi asɛe w’adwene. Mmoa a Wonnya: Sɛ wote nka sɛ ankonam anaa nnamfo ne abusuafo nte wɔn ase a, ebetumi ama obi anya adwenemhaw ne dadwen. Nkitahodi Ho Nsɛm: Sɛ obi ntumi mmɔ nkɔmmɔ pefee na odi nokware a, ebetumi de adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ (frustration) ne abufuw aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, asetena ne sikasɛm mu tebea, anaa nyamesom betumi ne me "SOGI" atwa na anya m’asetena so nkɛntɛnso (influence)? (sɛ nhwɛso no, mmusua mu nyiyim a wohyia wɔ LGBTQ+ kuw no mu)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni, ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu "LGBTQ+" sɛ mmra mmma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nipadua mu akwaa ho ayaresa a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu na ɛyɛ nkate a ɛkyerɛ obu ma me gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nipasu?
answer_twi_source: Akwaa ayarehwɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ nkate a wobenya no hwehwɛ sɛ: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne nkate di kan wɔ wɔn dwumadi mu. Sɛ wobɛbisa nyansahyɛ afiri ankorankoro a wɔgye wɔn di, mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo, anaa amammerɛ/nyamesom akannifoɔ a wɔte wo tebea ne wo gyinapɛn ase. Wo amammerɛ anaa nyamesom ahiade pɔtee ne nea wopɛ a wobɛka akyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobebu wɔn wɔ bere a wɔrehwɛ wo no. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm asekyerɛfo adwuma sɛ kasa mu akwanside ahorow wɔ hɔ a. Wo ho a wobɛkamfo denam w’anidaso ne w’adwene a wobɛda no adi wɔ amammerɛ mu nkate ho wɔ bere a woahyɛ wo ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de kɔndɔm adi dwuma yiye de ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma yiye paa ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛhwɛ sɛ kɔndɔm no yɛ adwuma a, di anammɔn yi akyi: - Hwɛ da a ɛbɛtwam ne sɛnea wɔde ahyɛ mu no mudi mu ansa na wode adi dwuma. - fa kondom foforo di dwuma ma nna mu adeyɛ biara. - bue condom wrapper no na woakwati sɛ wode nneɛma a ano yɛ nnam anaa nsateaa nnadewa bɛsɛe condom no. - fa condom no to 'penis' a egyina hɔ no so ansa na ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nkitahodi biara aba. - 'pinche' condom no ano ma gyaw baabi ma mmadwoa na wobobɔw no kɔ fam wɔ ɔbarima no akyi a ɛteɛ no tenten nyinaa mu. - a woto wo ho akyi no, kura condom no ase bere a woretwe ɔbarima no akyi na amma mmadwoa no anhwe ase na anhwie agu. - to kondom a wode adi dwuma no gu yie. - kwati sɛ wode sradeɛ a wɔde ngo ayɛ a wode latex kɔndɔm bɛdi dwuma, ɛfiri sɛ ɛbɛtumi ama adeɛ no ayɛ mmerɛ na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛbubu no ayɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi afa oduruyɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho ɔyaresafo bi a minim no dedaw so ayi nyinsɛn agu? (nea ebeɔtumi aba no gyina beae a ɛwɔ so)
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wubetumi ayi nyinsɛn agu denam akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wunim no dedaw so no gyina wɔn ankorankoro nneyɛe ne wɔn gyidi so. Ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo binom remfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma mma nanso wɔde wo bɛbata nea otu nyinsɛn a ahobammɔ wom ho. .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ nsakrae a merehyia wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no yɛ nea ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono sɛnea mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ka obiara, enti ɛtaa ba sɛ nsakrae ba ntɛmntɛm ne mmere ahorow mu. Nanso, sɛ wowɔ wo nkɔso ho dadwen anaasɛ wohyia ɔhaw kɛse a, ɛho hia sɛ wo ne ɔpanyin anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso kasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de adi dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn adwumayɛfo no da mpɔtam a wɔsom wɔn no amammerɛ ahorow adi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi boa ma apomoden mu nkɔso tu mpɔn ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de akwan horow pii adi dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn adwumayɛfo no da mpɔtam a wɔsom wɔn no amammerɛ ahorow adi. Eyi betumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne adwumayɛfo a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu a wɔde nsiyɛ bɛfa wɔn na wɔafa wɔn adwuma mu, de amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho ntetee ne adwumayɛ mu nkɔso a ɛkɔ so ama adwumayɛfo nyinaa, ne adwumayɛ tebea a ɛboa a ɛbɛma ahorow ahorow ne nnipa a wɔka ho no sɛ ɛsom bo. Ɛdenam adwumayɛfo a wogu ahorow so no, apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ate wɔn ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no amammerɛ mu ahiade soronko ne nea wɔpɛ ase yiye na wɔadi ho dwuma, na ama nkitahodi, ahotoso, ne apomoden mu nsunsuanso atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nnwuma anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nhomasua tebea horow mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa nhwɛsoɔ bi nie (ebia deɛ wɔbɛtumi akɔ Ghana no sua): 'UNESCO’s Inclusive Sex Education Guidelines': Hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a mmubuafoɔ ka ho ho nkuran. Demdi Ahokwan Nkyerɛkyerɛ, nea broni ka no 'Disability Rights Education &Training': Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtete akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma wɔyɛ adesua tebea a ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛho hia sɛ metwitwi me se mprɛ pii wɔ mpanin mu kɔ mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akora me se ne m'anom apɔmuden so?
answer_twi_source: Aane, efisɛ hormone nsakraeɛ betumi aka esidan ne se no. Sɛnea wɔyɛ no nie: Twitwi Wo Se Mprɛ Mmienu Da Biara: De fluoride samina twitwi annyɛɛ mprɛ mmienu da biara (anɔpa ne anwummere), titiriw wɔ aduane akyi. Kwan Pa a Wɔfa So: Fa Se-twitwi-dua a ɛyɛ mmerɛ di dwuma na popɔ wo se bɔkɔɔ wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa so. Hwɛ sɛ wobɛtwitw wo se anim, akyi, ne deɛ wode we ade no. Tew Aduane a Asikyire Wom So. Tew dodoɔ a wodi so na hore w'ano ne nsuo sɛ wowe nneɛma a asikyire wom akyi. Kɔhwɛ dɔketa ma wɔnhwehwɛ wo se mu na wɔnhohoro daa, a ɛtaa yɛ bosome nsia biara. Kwati Tawa. Di aduane a nneɛma a ɛma apɔmuden wom de boa wo se ne w'anom apɔmuden. Hunu sɛ nduannuru. bi a ɛho hia a wɔnnya ntumi de se ne anom yareɛ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wonyi mmara ne nhyehyɛe akwanside ahorow a esiw wɔn kwan sɛ wobenya HIV ano aduro ne ayaresa a edi mũ no afi hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wonyi mmara ne nhyehyɛe akwanside ahorow a esiw wɔn kwan sɛ wobenya HIV ano aduro ne ayaresa a edi mũ no afi hɔ denam nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu, wɔn ankasa nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔbɛyɛ biako de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneyɛɛ pa anaa sɛ nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ wɔ berɛ a yɛretu anammɔn de aboa nna ne awoɔ mu ho kwan deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no sɛ 'sexual and reproductive rights' no?
answer_twi_source: Bu ahofadie ne kwan a yɛgye. Di dwuma kokoam. Pɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ anaa sɛ ɛnyɛ nyiyimu. Hwehwɛ asetena pa mpɔtam a wɔn nya mmoa biaa. Twe wo ho firi nneɛma a ɛha afoforɔ ho na di nokware. Mmabun a sabi wɔn ho ato kyema kakra nhwe dɛ mabobosoɔ yi mu yie na wɔnte ase ansana watu anammɔn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama wɔn ho na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobedi wɔn ahiade ho dwuma bere a wɔrehwehwɛ dabere ne adan ho mmoa no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama wɔn ho denam: Wɔn ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ pefee akyerɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ dabere anaa wɔn a wɔde adan ho adwumayɛfo ma no so. Nsɛm a wobɛbisa fa nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ, gyinapɛn a wɔde fata, ne hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔtefoɔ ho. Dabere anaa nsakrae a egyina wɔn ankorankoro tebea so a wɔbɛsrɛ, te sɛ kokoamu nsɛm a wɔpɛ anaa ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, wɔn a wɔkasa kyerɛ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ sɛ wohyia akwanside anaa nyiyimu wɔ nnwuma a wobenya mu a. Nkitahodi, apam, ne nkrataa a ɛho hia a ɛfa wɔn adan tebea ho ho kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ bere a wɔde adwenemyare ho nneɛma a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so redi dwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so adwenemyareɛ ho nneɛma taa wɔ kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde asi hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Data a wɔde mane a ahobanbɔ wom: Encryption protocols a wɔde bɛbɔ ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔde fa intanɛt so de mane no kokoamsɛm ho ban. Ahintasɛm ho nhyehyɛe: Nsɛm a emu da hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wɔboaboa nea ɔde di dwuma no data ano, sie, na wɔbɔ ho ban, a nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔammɔ wɔn din ne data ahobammɔ ka ho. Mpene so nhyehyɛe: Mpene a wonya fi wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no hɔ ansa na woaboaboa w’ankasa ho nsɛm ano anaasɛ wode data ama nnipa foforo. Mmara ahorow a wodi so: Kokoam nsɛm ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho a wobedi so, te sɛ HIPAA (wɔ United States) anaa GDPR (wɔ Europa Aman Nkabom no mu), de abɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kokoam hokwan ahorow ho ban. Ɔdefo a wɔhwɛ so: Nneɛma a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi apaw sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn kokoam nsɛm so, ahwɛ kwan a wɔfa so kɔ wɔn nsɛm so, na wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔbɛboaboa data ano anaasɛ wɔbɛkyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmra a ɛfa nna ho dwuma sesa gyina mfeɛ a ɛwɔ mu so?
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ a wɔpene so ho nsusuhoɔ. Mmara mu ntɔkwa (sɛ obi nnyaa mfeɛ pau a). Mfe a ɛbɛn mu nsakraeɛ ('Romeo ne Juliet' mmara). Asotweɛ ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wususu sɛ ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma te sɛ fĩ, nsuo a ɛyɛ fi, anaa tenabea bɔne betumi aka mmabun apɔmuden, anya nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa a ɛfata, anaa wɔatena baabi a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma Titiri a Wɔbɛnya: Nneɛma a wɔsɛe no ne fĩ betumi aka mmabun kwan a wɔbɛnya nsuo pa, ahotew, ne tenabea a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo, a ɛka wɔn nna ne awoɔ hokwan ne wɔn yiedie nyinaa. Apɔmuden Asane: Fĩ betumi de awoɔ mu apɔmuden haw te sɛ awoɔ a wɔnnya, awoɔ mu dɛmdi, ne awoɔ mu akwaa yareɛ aba, a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ nneɛma so de bɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ kokoam afotuo dwumadie a ɛbɛtumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama denam gyinaesie so.
answer_twi_source: Ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea nyinaa wɔ nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wo kokoam afotuo, kɔ w’akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ nkyɛn wɔ mmabun asoɛeɛ, sukuu ayaresabea anaa akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo kɔhwehwɛ afotuo dwumadie. kae sɛ kokoamsɛm yɛ ɔsom adwuma no fã titiriw ma nnipa nyinaa a mmabun ka ho. YMK app no atete cyber afotu bere nyinaa nso. Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG Helpline): (Nnɔmba a wɔde ama wɔ atifi hɔ). Wɔde kokoam afotu adwuma ma (ebia ɛsono sɛnea wobetumi anya). Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health (GYARH): [https://ghanasrhralliance.org/] Wɔn wɛbsaet no betumi akura nneɛma a wɔde boa mmabun wɔ kokoam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abusua nhyehyɛeɛ nnuru a ɛnyɛ nnuru a ɛsakra nipadua (non-hormonal) no bi ne hɛn, na sɛn na ɛyɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Abusua nhyehyɛeɛ a nnuru nnim no yɛ adwuma sɛ akwansideɛ (barrier). Eyi kyerɛ sɛ ɛsi nkabom a ɛda mmaa nkesua ne mmarima ahaba (sperm) ntam kwan na ama nyinsɛn amma. Akwansideɛ akwan (Barrier methods): Mmarima kɔndɔm si mmarima ahaba (sperm) kwan na ankɔhyɛ awodeɛ mu. Mmaa kɔndɔm nso tɛ sɛ mmarima deɛ no, nanso wɔhyɛ no wɔ mmaa kwan (vagina) no mu. Diaphragm anaa cervical cap (awo-ano-kataeɛ) no kata awodeɛ ano na awura hɔ, na eyi si mmarima ahaba (sperm) kwan na ankɔhyɛ awodeɛ mu. Kɔbere IUD: Abusua nhyehyɛeɛ a nnuru nnim (IUD): Ɛgye kɔpa (copper) gu mu na ama mmarima ahaba (sperm) ntumi nnyɛ adwuma na ankɔhyia nkesua (egg) no. Eyi kyɛ paa: ɛbɛtumi ayɛ adwuma akɔsi mfeɛ du (10).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhaw ne mrɛyo bɛn na wɔn a wɔwɔ obi manso ne mmabun hyia wɔ wɔn nna ne ahokwasan apɔmmuden?
answer_twi_source: Kasa haw. Ayaresa a wɔnnya. Nyiyimu. Ateetee (abuse). Mmoa kuo a enni hɔ. Mmara mu haw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua nkitahodie nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, kwati a wɔkwati, ne kommyɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho ka ho no ka mmabun a wobenya nsɛm a edi mu, mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Abusua nkitahodi nhyehyɛe nya mmabun a wobenya nsɛm a edi mu, mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan no kɛse. Nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee, a nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ atemmu na ɛda adi no ma wonya ahotoso a ɛhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ mfi awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn hɔ bere a ɛho hia no. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, kwati anaa kommyɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no betumi de akwanside ahorow aba wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia ne mmoa a wobenya mu, na ama mmabun ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho to atipɛnfo anaa mmeae afoforo a wontumi mfa wɔn ho nto so so de hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho amammerɛ a wobenya wɔ mmusua mu no betumi ama mmabun anya nna mu akwahosan pa aba na aboa ma wɔn yiyedi nyinaa aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ayaresa ahorow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma, te sɛ ankorankoro, kuo, anaa abusua ayaresa, na sɛn na wɔde toto ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ayaresa ahorow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma, a ankorankoro, kuo, ne abusua ayaresa ka ho. Sɛnea wɔde toto ho ni: Ankorankoro Ayaresa: Ɛfa nhyiam a wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo yɛ mmiako mmiako, na wode w’adwene si w’ankasa wo nsusuwii, wo atinka, ne osuahu ahorow so. Kuo Ayaresa: Ɛfa nhyiam ahorow a wɔne nnipa kuw ketewaa bi a wɔwɔ dadwen anaa nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara yɛ, de mmoa, mmuae, ne adwene a efi afoforo hɔ ma. Abusua Ayaresa: Ɛfa nhyiam ahorow a wɔne abusua mufo yɛ de di abusuabɔ mu nkɔso, nkitahodi nhyehyɛe, ne ntawntawdi a ɛwɔ abusua nhyehyɛe no mu ho dwuma. Ayaresa biara wɔ n’ankasa mfaso na wobetumi agyina w’ahiade pɔtee ne nea wopɛ so akamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi akasa afa LGBTQ+ wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma obiara anya deɛ ɔhia wɔ amansan no mu, mpo sɛ yɛn mmiranim anaa yɛn asetena yɛ soronko a? (a ɛde nne ahorow a wɔatoto nkyɛn no si mfinimfini) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nsem aa efa peneeɛ, abusuabo pa, ne nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie. Nea abroni ka no ' educational Websites' (odo yɛ obuo). Nwoma. Workshops ne mmoa kuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔne mmabun nyɛ adwuma wɔ mmeae yi, na akwan bɛn na wɔfa so de ɔhwɛ a ɛyɛ nkate na ɛnyɛ atɛn ma?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛfata mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) no nya nteteeɛ titiriw na ama wɔate mmaayewa no ahiadeɛ ne mmerɛ a wɔresakyera mu no ase.Saa nteteeɛ yi fa nsɛm te sɛ mmaayewa adwene ne wɔn nkateɛ (psychology), nkitahodie ho nyansa, kokoamsɛm, nna ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden, ne amammerɛ mu obu ho. Ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ yi fa akwan te sɛ aso a wɔbɛyɛ no mmerɛ de atie asɛm, mmɔborohunu, ne obu a wɔde ma mmaayewa gyinaeɛ so de ma ayaresabea hwɛ a emu dɔ na atentenenee wom.Wɔyɛ asetena pa a mmaayewa bɛtumi ate wɔn ho yie de adi nkɔmɔ fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho, wobisa nsɛm a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu, na wɔbu mmaayewa no asetena mu nsɛm ne wɔn nkateɛ sɛ asɛm a ɛsom bo, a wɔmfa wɔn ankasa gyidie anaa wɔn ankasa nsusuieeɛ nhyɛ wɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mpɔtam a ɛbɛboa me nna ho akɔnnɔ ne me bɔbeasu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam pii wɔ hɔ a wɔboa wɔn wɔ hɔ! Akwan bi a wobɛfa so abɔ no bi nie: Intanɛt so mpɔtam: Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne akuo pii wɔ hɔ a wɔde ma LGBTQ+ mmabun pɔtee. Mpɔtam hɔ LGBTQ+ ahyehyɛdeɛ: Hwehwɛ LGBTQ+ mmeaeɛ anaa mmabun akuo wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Akuw a wɔboa: Saa akuw yi betumi ama woanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wo ne afoforo a wɔte wo suahu ahorow ase no adi nkitaho. Sukuu/dwumadi ahorow a ɛka obiara ho: Hwehwɛ sukuu anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua ho a ɛhyɛ ahorow ahorow ho afahyɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na etu mpɔn wɔ mmarimaa ne mmerante a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ayɔnkofo wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw GBV ano na wɔhyɛ mmarimayɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam a ntawntawdi aka wɔn no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne Nteaseɛ (Education and Awareness):Ntetee ne amanneɛbɔ dwumadi a wɔde ma mmarima mbabaa fa awudie a ɛfa mmaa ne mmarima ntam (GBV), ayɔnkofa pa, ne mmarimayɛ pa ho no tumi kanyan wɔn ma wɔsesa amammerɛ mu nneyɛe bɔne na ɛhyɛ wɔn den ma wɔboa mmaa.Mpɔtam Nkabom (Community Involvement):Mmarima mbabaa a wɔde wɔn bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ dwumadi ahorow mu, te sɛ ntetee sukuu (workshops), nkɔmmɔbɔ akuo, ne ntetee a mbabaa ankasa di anim no, ma wɔnya kyɛfa kɛseɛ wɔ akwan a wɔfa so si GBV kwan na wɔhyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran.Nhwɛsodeɛ Pa (Role Modeling):Mmarima a wɔyɛ nhwɛsodeɛ pa wɔ mpɔtam a ɔko rekɔ so, a wɔda obu ne basabasa-enni-mu nneyɛe adi no, ma mmarima mbabaa hu nhwɛsodeɛ a ɛyɛ den a wobetumi asuasua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma mmabun ntumi nkɔ nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, te sɛ awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ, mfe a wɔadi, bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwɛn, ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ nea yɔ frɔ no insurance ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn no betumi adi nhyehyɛe mu nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow betumi asiw mmabun kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow: Awofo Mpene so Ahwehwɛde: Aman bi hwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene anaasɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ ma mmofra nkumaa na wɔanya nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu, a ebetumi ayɛ akwanside ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ kokoamu hwɛ. Mfe a Wɔadi ho Anohyeto: Mfe a wɔadi ho anohyeto ahorow a mmara ma ho kwan no betumi asiw mmabun ahofadi ano wɔ nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden a wobenya a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, titiriw wɔ nnwuma te sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu anaa nna mu apomoden nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho. Mmere a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wɔtwɛn: Aman bi de bere a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa twɛn anaa afotu ho ahwehwɛde ahorow to hɔ ansa na mmabun atumi anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma, na ɛno betumi atwe ɔhwɛ akyɛ na ama nhyehyɛe mu ɔkwan akɔ soro. Anohyeto Ahorow a Ɛwɔ nea wo taa frɛ no Insurance Ho Katua Ho: Insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de anohyeto ahorow ama wɔ sika a wɔde tua ho ka wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow bi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, akuw a ɛwɔ fam, ne ɔmanfo akuw di wɔ wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuw a wɔhyɛ mu den ma 'ASRH' ho nsɛm a wɔka ne adeyɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ, akuo a ɛwɔ fam, ne ɔmanfoɔ akuo di dwuma titire wɔ wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔhyɛ mu den ma 'ASRH' kasa ma ne dwumadie. Saa ahyehyɛdeɛ yi yɛ ntamgyinafoɔ wɔ wiase nyinaa nnwuma ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ntam, na wɔde nhumu a ɛsom boɔ ma wɔ mmabun ahiadeɛ ne nokwasɛm a ɛwɔ fam no ho na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔde 'ASRH' nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie a ɛfata nsɛm a ɛfa ho no bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa STI, HIV, ne nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho wɔ Intanɛt so? Sɛ saa a, ɛhe na metumi anya fibea ahorow a wotumi gye di?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wubetumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa STIs, HIV, ne nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho wɔ intanɛt so afi mmeae a wotumi gye di te sɛ: Aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow, te sɛ Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) anaa Wiase Akwahosan Dwumakuo (WHO). Aduruyɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ, Adesua asoɛeɛ, a sukuupɔn ne aduruyɛ sukuu ka ho, a ɛde nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma. Intanɛt so akwahosan ho nsɛm anaa nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a ɛhwɛ nneɛma a agye din ne nsɛm a ɛfa STI/HIV ano a wosiw ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne telehealth so akwahosan adi dwuma de ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm nya no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne akwahosan wɔ telehealth so adi dwuma de ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nya no atu mpɔn denam intanɛt so nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛma, afotu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so, aduruyɛ a wɔde ma wɔ telehealth so, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telehealth so a ɛwɔ nneɛma a ɛma wotumi nya bi, ne mmoa akuw a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ boa mmabun ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma wonya: Wɔn nipadua ne wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu. Ahokokwaw a wɔde di nkitaho yie na wɔde anohyeto ahorow si hɔ wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Nimdeɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne STI. Ntease a ɛfa mpeneso ne obu a wɔwɔ ma afoforo ahofadi ho. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea efi ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ a ɛyɛ katee mu ba ma ankorankoro a wɔne atetesɛm gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, nnipa a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nna ne awoɔ ho nipasu ahorow ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ a ɛyɛ katee betumi anya nea efi mu ba a ɛho hia ama ankorankoro a wɔne atetesɛm mu gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, nnipa a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nna ne awoɔ ho nipasu ahorow ka ho. Saa ankorankoro yi betumi ahyia nyiyimu, animtiaabu, ne nnipa a wɔbɛtow wɔn agu nkyɛn wɔ wɔn asetena mu nneɛma ahorow mu, a nhomasua, adwumayɛ, apomoden ho nhyehyɛe, ne fekubɔ ka ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, LGBTQ+ mmabun betumi anya ayayade ne ayayade wɔ sukuu tebea horow mu, na ɛde adwene mu apomoden yare te sɛ adwenemhaw ne dadwen bɛkɔ soro. Ankorankoro a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu betumi apere sɛ wobenya apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna na wɔahyia ɔhaw wɔ sɛnea wɔbɛma ɔmanfo ahu wɔn nipasu na wɔabu wɔn no mu. Wɔn a wɔwɔ nna ne awoɔ ho nipasu ahorow no betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nna ne awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho a edi wɔn ahiade soronko ho dwuma. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ a ɛyɛ katee betumi asiw hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma ankorankoro a wɔne atetesɛm gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia no ada wɔn ho adi, ankorankoro nkɔso, ne asetena mu nkabom ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ minnim sɛ ebia wobu tebea bi sɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so nso ɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wunnim sɛ ebia tebea bi yɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so a, fa wo ho to wo nkate so na susuw nea edidi so yi ho: So suban no maa wotee nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ, wosuroe, anaasɛ wɔato wo so? So na pene a wɔmpene so anaa nhyɛso a wɔanhyɛ no ka ho? So suban no ne nkyerɛase ahorow a wɔtaa de ma wɔ ɔhaw anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so ho no hyia?
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusuabɔ ho adesua a obu womu betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi nsɛm te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nhyɛso, ne nsakrae a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔdɔ ne nna mu nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ ho adesua a obu wom ma mmabun nya ahokokwaw a wɔde behu atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nsakrae wɔ ɔdɔ ne nna mu nsɛm mu na wɔayɛ ho biribi. Saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi si hia a nkitahodi, ahye a wɔde besi hɔ, ne pene a wɔte ase ho hia so dua, na ɛma mmabun tumi paw nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ paw na wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ merebrɛ wɔ m’adwene mu akwaahosan ho na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ? (adwenemhaw, dadwen, ɛyɛ den sɛ obegyina ano ho sɛnkyerɛnne) .
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow no ara a wobɛte nka sɛ obi ayɛ basaa anaa anidaso biara nni mu: Eyi betumi ayɛ adwenemhaw ho sɛnkyerɛnne. Adwennwene anaa Dadwen a Ɛboro So: Dadwen betumi asiw da biara da asetra kwan. Ɛyɛ den sɛ Wobegyina Adwennwen ano: Akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano ho hia ma adwene mu yiyedi. Nsakrae a ɛba wɔ Adidi anaa Dae Mu: Nsakrae a ɛho hia betumi ayɛ frankaa kɔkɔɔ. Adwene a Ɛfa Wo Ho a Wobɛpira Ho: Sɛ worenya saa nsusuwii yi a, hwehwɛ mmoa ntɛm ara. kɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa mmabun adamfofa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn na woanya mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na akwan a egyina nnipa hokwan ahorow so a wɔfa so yɛ ASRH betumi aboa ma wɔama asetena mu atɛntrenee anya nkɔso na wɔadi pɛyɛ a enni akwahosan, nhomasua, ne nneɛma a mmabun nya wɔ wiase nyinaa no ho dwuma
answer_twi_source: kwan a egyina nnipa hokwan ahorow so a wɔfa so yɛ ASRH no si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyɛ asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran na wodi pɛyɛ a enni akwahosan, nhomasua, ne nneɛma a mmabun nya wɔ wiase nyinaa no ho dwuma so dua. Ɛdenam nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔde besi ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so no, aban ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ adwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nyinaa, a wɔn fibea anaa wɔn nipasu mfa ho, benya hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ sɛ wobenya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi anya afotu ne mmoa  wɔ nyinsɛn mu, te sɛ aduan pa ho afotu ne atenka fam mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun a wɔyem betumi anya afotu ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow de adi ahiade ahorow ho dwuma bere a wɔyem no. Ebia saa nnwuma yi bi ne: Aduandi ho afotu a wɔde ma de hyɛ adidi pa ho nkuran na wodi aduan ho ahiade pɔtee bi ho dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn mu. Atenka mu mmoa ne afotu a wɔde bɛfa nipadua ne nkate mu nsakrae a ɛbata nyinsɛn ho no so, adi adwennwen ne dadwen ho dwuma, na wɔadi dadwen anaa ehu biara a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awofoyɛ ho ho dwuma. Adwene ne nneyɛe ho animdefo a wɔwɔ ayaresabea taa de adwene mu ayaresa ma mmabun a wɔyem Asetra mu mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow, te sɛ mmoa akuw anaa atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow, baabi a mmabun a wɔyem betumi ne afoforo a wohyia osuahu ahorow a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ afotu, nkuranhyɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔde boa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ankasa ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow a wɔde di akyi ne nea wɔhwɛ akyi no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ahiade ahorow denam wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa afotufo a wɔne wɔn di nkitaho pefee, a wɔbɛka nea wɔpɛ wɔ ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow ho, abisa nsɛm, sɛ ɛho hia a wɔbɛhwehwɛ adwene a ɛto so abien, na wɔaka hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya ɔhwɛ a obu wom na egyina ɔyarefo so no so dua. Wobetumi nso de mpanyimfo anaa wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn a wogye wɔn di no ahyɛ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi no mu sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wonni ahotoso anaasɛ wɔayɛ basaa a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ahwɛ kwan wɔ afotuo anaa mmoa kuw nhyiamu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne awoɔ nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm: Nhyiam ahorow no yɛ kokoamsɛm, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nea wɔka ho asɛm no da so ara yɛ kokoamsɛm wɔ wo ne ofotufo no ntam. Sɛ asiane bi wɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛpira wo ho anaa afoforo a, wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛnyɛ saa. Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia a Ɛnyɛ Atemmu: Afotufo ma wonya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ, a ɛnyɛ atemmu a wobetumi de akyɛ nsusuwii ne nkate. Obu a wɔde ma ahorow ahorow a ɛwɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne gyidi ahorow mu. Nhwehwɛmu ne Botae a Wɔde Si Hɔ: Nhyiam a edi kan no taa fa nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ wo haw ne wo botae ahorow ho. Wo ne ofotufo no bɛbom ayɛ nhyehyɛe bi a wode bedi nsɛm yi ho dwuma. Tie ne Akwankyerɛ a Wode Nsiyɛ: Ɔfotufo no de nsiyɛ tie wo haw ahorow na ɔde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa bɛma. Ebia wobebisa nsɛm de aboa wo ma woahwehwɛ nsusuwii ne ahorow mu. Ahokokwaw a Wobɛma Ayɛ: Wubetumi asua ahokokwaw a mfaso wɔ so, te sɛ nkitahodi ho akwan anaa akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano. Dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma de di nkitahodi a ahoɔden wom ho dwuma wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma ne Nneɛma a Wɔde Kɔma: Afotufoɔ bɛtumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, wɛbsaet, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ama. Sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ adwumayɛfoɔ anaa nnwuma foforɔ nkyɛn, te sɛ nnuruyɛfoɔ anaa mmoa akuo. Kae sɛ afotu a wobɛhwehwɛ anaasɛ wobɛkɔ kuw bi a wɔboa mu no yɛ anammɔn pa a wobɛfa so ahwɛ wo nna mu akwahosan ne wo yiyedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ ɔyɔnko pa ama me LGBTQ+ nnamfo ne mfɛfo sukuufo, a ebia wɔrehyia nyiyim anaa ɔhaw? (ntie a wɔde nsiyɛ, mmoa a wɔde ma, kasa tia adwemmɔne) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no asɛde ahorow wɔ sɛnea ɔhwɛ sɛnea ɔbabun bi betumi de pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ama na wahwɛ ahu sɛ pene a wɔpene so no fi ne pɛ mu na enni nhyɛso anaa nkɛntɛnso a ɛnsɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ asɛyɛde ahorow pii wɔ tumi a ɔbabun bi betumi de pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ama no ho nhwehwɛmu mu na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ pene a wɔpene so no fi ne pɛ mu na enni nhyɛso anaa nkɛntɛnso a ɛnsɛ. Saa asɛde ahorow yi bi ne: Ɔbabun no ntease a ɔwɔ wɔ ayaresa anaa ɔkwan a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa no ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, a n’atirimpɔw, asiane ahorow, mfaso horow, ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so yɛ no ka ho. Sɛnea ɔbabun no tumi si gyinae wɔ ne ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, a wosusuw nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wadi, ne ho akokwaw, n’adwene mu nkɔso, ne amammerɛ a ofi ho. Tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wobebisa nsɛm, ada nea ɛhaw wɔn adi, na wɔasusuw nea wɔpɛ ho a wɔbɛbɔ. Hokwan a ɔbabun no wɔ sɛ ɔpow anaasɛ ɔtwe ne ho fi ho bere biara a wobebu no na wɔama hokwan ahorow ama wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm foforo anaasɛ wɔne ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di asusuw ho ansa na wɔasi gyinae. Mpene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye atom ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛkyerɛw, a nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne ɔbabun no bɔ, nsɛm biara a wɔde ama, ne ɔbabun no gyinaesi ka ho, na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee na wɔabu akontaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔkamfo akwannya ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nipadua mu fahodi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmoa ntam nkitahodi ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔkyereɛ  akwannya ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nipadua mu ahofadi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akuw a wɔkamfo mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo hokwan ahorow so Mmara mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe titiriw ne nnipa hokwan ahorow Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so ne NGO ahorow a wɔkamfo awo mu atɛntrenee ne nipadua mu fahodi te sɛ Maries stopes support center (030 224 1517) Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne ayaresabea ahodoɔ a wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa ayarefoɔ ho ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma nhwɛsoɔ GHS-YMK intanɛt so atenaeɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa tebea horow a wɔte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn so anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔpene so wɔ nna mu dwumadi anaa awo akwahosan ho gyinaesie ahorow no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wohyia nhyɛso ma wɔpene so wɔ nna mu dwumadi anaa awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow no betumi de akwan horow pii adi dwuma de abɔ wɔn yiyedi ho ban: Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nyamesom akannifo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, akamfo, ne nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wɔn ama wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata. Wɔn ahye ne hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛsi so dua denam wɔn pow anaa wɔn ho a ɛnyɛ dɛ wɔ tebea no ho a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee so, a asetra anaa atipɛnfo nhyɛso mfa ho. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam anaa afotuo a wɔbɛnya wɔ baabi a wɔbɛtumi asusu wɔn haw ho, anya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, na wɔahwehwɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so wɔ baabi a ahotɔ ne mmoa. Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛ wɔde bɛboa mmabun a wɔrehyia nhyɛso, ayayade, anaa ayayade wɔ nna anaa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu a wɔde bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmɔden bɛn na wɔrebɔ sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata amammerɛ na ɛfata mmabun a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, ne nidi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata amammerɛ na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, ne nidi. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛtete wɔn wɔ akwan horow a ɛfata mmabun so, ayaresabea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔde ma mu de adi wɔn ahiade soronko ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ me ne obi nna daa nso a, metumi asua kwan a wɔfa so si nyisen ano kwan de adi dwuma daakye?
answer_twi_source: Saa pɛpɛɛpɛ! Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ nnam wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho, sɛ mpo wo ne obia nnyaa nna daa mprempren a. Sɛ woresua akwan a wɔfa so de si nyisen ano mprempren boa ma wotumi si gyinaeɛ pa daakye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahokokwaw ahorow bɛn na mmabun betumi anya afi mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw ahorow pii afi mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya adwuma pɔtee bi ho nimdeɛ ne nimdeɛ a ɛfa adwuma anaa nnwuma a wɔapaw ho, te sɛ kɔmputa so nhyehyɛe, mfoniniyɛ, adetɔfo som, anaa aduruyɛ mu mmoa. Soft skills: Internship ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe boa ma wonya soft skills te sɛ nkitahodi, kuo adwumayɛ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, nsakrae, ne akannifo, a ɛho hia na ama asi yie wɔ adwuma biara mu. Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ: Mmabun sua adwumayɛfo abrabɔ pa, bere nhyehyɛe, ne wɔn ho a wɔde di dwuma ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia kɛse ma adwumam akwantu ne wɔn mfɛfo adwumayɛfo, adwuma so ahwɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔkra nneɛma no nkitahodi. Adwuma ho nimdeɛ: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya nhumu wɔ nnwuma mu nkɔso, nneyɛe pa, ne adwumayɛ akwan ho, na ɛma wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn daakye nhomasua ne adwumayɛ botae ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ayaresafoɔ bɛboa mmabun a wɔyinsɛn, na mmabun bɛyɛ dɛn akasa?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresafoɔ: Afotu, nhwehwɛmu, nkyerɛkyerɛ. Wɔtumi kasa: Bisa nsɛm, ka wo haw, di nokware. Adwumayɛfoɔ boa, wɔmmu atɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so yɛ na wɔkyekyɛ nsɛm foforo, a ɛne ne ho bɔ abira de twa nna mu akwahosan ho sɛnkyerɛnne atitiriw a ɛwɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi mu no mpoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ na wɔakyekyɛ nsɛm foforo, a ɛne ne ho bɔ abira de akasa atia nna mu akwahosan ho mfonini atitiriw a ɛwɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi mu denam wɔn ankasa nsɛm a wɔbɛyɛ, wɔn ankasa nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne adwuma a wɔbɛbom ayɛ wɔ adebɔ ho nnwuma mu no so. Wobetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan ahorow adi dwuma, a sohyial media(Ntentan so nkitahodi), blog(Intanɛt so nsɛmkrɛɛ), ne podcast(Intanɛt so kasaba) ahorow ka ho, de ada osuahu ahorow adi, akasa atia nsusuwii hunu, na wɔahyɛ suban ne nneyɛe pa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen a broni fre no 'dilemmas' anaa ntawntawdi a ebetumi asɔre wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm: Ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo behyia nsɛnnennen broni fre no 'dilemma' bere a wɔkari pɛ wɔ hia a ehia sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie ne mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow anaa awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no. Nnwuma a Wonya: Abrabɔ pa ho ntawntawdi betumi aba bere a wɔmma ankorankoro kwan sɛ wɔnkɔ nnwuma bi mu esiane mfe a wɔadi, aware tebea, anaa nneɛma afoforo nti. Amammerɛ mu Nkate: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbɛkari pɛ ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho adesua a edi mũ no betumi ayɛ asɛnnennen. Mpene a Wɔde Amanneɛ Ma: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ ankorankoro wɔ nsɛm ne tumi a wɔde bɛma pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ama wɔ ayaresa anaa ayaresa ahorow ho. Ɔsom a ɛnyɛ nyiyim: Mmabun nyinaa ahiadeɛ a ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ka ho a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ahwɛ na wɔasusuw sɛnea sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mbaa ho no tu mpɔn wɔ wɔn botae ahorow a wobedu ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwɛ na wɔasusu sɛnea sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no tu mpɔn no bi ne sɛ wɔde nsɛnkyerɛnne ne botae pɔtee bi besi hɔ, wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm a wɔakyekyɛ mu wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ano, wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa, na wɔde wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi boa nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ ma wɔsusu nkɔsoɔ ho, hunu nsonsonoeɛ ne ɔhaw , na wɔsi gyinaeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so de ma nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma no tu mpɔn na wɔadu mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ botaeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho hia ma mmabun, na mfaso bɛn na ebetumi afi mu aba sɛ wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho hia kɛse ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma wonya nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea a ɛyɛ den no mu yiye. Mfaso ahorow bi a ebetumi afi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho no bi ne: Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm, nneɛma a wonya fi mu, ne emu nsɛm mu nhwehwɛmu na wɔasusuw ho yiye, na ama wɔatumi asi gyinae a ɛfata na wɔanya adwene a wɔde wɔn ho. Mmabun digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔsɛe no, nneɛma a wɔyɛ, intanɛt so nhwehwɛmu, ne dijitaal ɔman bayɛ nneyɛe a ɛyɛ abrabɔ pa, a ɛho hia ma nkonimdi wɔ nnɛyi dijitaal bere yi mu ka ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran sɛ adwinnade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asetra ne ɔmanfo mu, a ɛbɛma mmabun atumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ demokrase nhyehyɛe mu denneennen, akamfo asetra mu atɛntrenee, na wɔaboa wɔn mpɔtam ne ɔmanfo yiye. Mmabun ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne yiyedi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho, te sɛ nsɛm a epira a wɔbɛda wɔn ho adi, kɔmputa so ayayade, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so a wɔde bɛhyɛ wɔn mu no so. Mmabun a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔanya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne nkwa nna nyinaa adesua su a ɛho hia ma adesua mu nkonimdi, adwumayɛ mu nkɔso, ne ankorankora nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nneyɛe a mede hwɛ me ho aka me da biara da dwumadi ho, bere mpo a sukuu ne dwumadi afoforo nni me ho adagyew? (bere a wɔde di dwuma, sɛnea wɔde wɔn ho di kan) .
answer_twi_source: Bere a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Wobetumi de bere  nketewa mpo adi dwuma de ahwɛ wɔn ho. Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma ahomegye bere tiaa bi wɔ wo da mũ no nyinaa mu na ama woanya ahoɔden bio. Fa Wo Ho Di Kan: Fa wo ho hwɛ sɛ sika a wode bɛto wo yiyedi mu. Ɛboa wo ma woda wo ho adi yiye ma sukuu, dwumadi ahorow, ne abusuabɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na mɛtumi akyerɛ nnipa koro, a m'ani gye wɔn ho paa?
answer_twi_source: Enni bere pɔtee bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wode hu nnipa ko a w’ani gye wɔn ho. Nnipa bi hu firi mmofraase, na afoforo nso gye bere pii ansa na wɔahu. Ɛyɛ kwan a ɛkyɛ a obi fa so hu ne su ankasa. Hwɛ wo nkate ne wɔn a wopɛ wo ho asɛm yiye, nanso nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛkyerɛw wo ho din ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde kyerɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no nna ho titiriw wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kwanma (anaa pɛne) ho?
answer_twi_source: Fa w’adwene si ankorankoro nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn asetena ho so ((sɛ ɛfata a). Sɛ wo anaa obi a wonim no pɛ sɛ ɔka ne ho asɛm (mpo sɛ ɔmpɛ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ne din a), fa ne nne ne nea ɔpɛ di kan wɔ dwumadi no nyinaa mu. Berɛ a worekasa afa dawurubɔ nneɛma ho no, si nea ɛhia sɛ wɔbɔ ankorankoro ahintasɛm ho ban so dua, titiriw wɔ intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ mmabun a yɛde wɔn hyɛ SRH nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ 'relevant' (ɛfa wɔn ho) na ɛtena hɔ kyɛ. Ɛma mmabun te nka sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ wɔn deɛ (ownership). Ɛma nteaseɛ ba mpanyimfoɔ ne mmabun ntam. Ɛhyɛ mpɔtam mmoa so den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛde adwene mu apomoden yare ɛ ba, na so ɛyɛ abɔde mu nneɛma nkutoo anaasɛ nneɛma afoforo te sɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ne ntetee a wonya so nsusuaso?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a efa adwene mu apomoden yareɛ, adwene mu, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔaka abom na nya adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso. Bere a awosu ne amemene mu nnuru di dwuma ma ankorankoro nya ɔhaw ahorow bi no, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ adwenemhaw, adwennwen, abusua mu nkɔso, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne nneɛma a wonya nso boa ma wonya nkɔso. Adwene ne apomoden ho ntease a edi mũ susuw abɔde a nkwa wom ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia nkɛntɛnso nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsa ne nnubɔne die di wɔ sɛnea obi si gyinaeɛ wɔ nna ho, na sɛn na mɛtumi asi gyinaeɛ pa wɔ saa mberɛ yi mu?
