answer_twi_source: Atemmu a Ɛnsɛe: Nsa ne nnuru a wode di dwuma betumi asɛe w’adwene ne wo gyinaesi. Ebetumi ama woanya nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom anaa tebea horow a ebia wubenu wo ho. Nsɛm a Ɛfa Mpene Ho: Sɛ wonom nsa a, ebetumi ama wo tumi a wode bɛma anaasɛ wubenya pene a emu da hɔ no ayɛ mununkum. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔpene so wɔ adwempa, anigye, na wɔde ma kwa. Asiane a Ɛbɛtew So: Kwati sɛ wode nsa anaa nnubɔne bɛfrafra nna mu dwumadi mu. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wonom nsa a, fa asɛyɛde ne nea ɛfata yɛ saa. Nkitahodi: Wo ne wo hokafo nsusuw ahye ne nea wɔhwɛ kwan ho ansa na woanom nsa. Yɛ nhyehyɛe bi a ɛbɛma woanya ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom a wobɛfa so akɔ fie sɛ woafi adi a. Hu Wo Anohyeto: Hu sɛnea nsa ka w’ankasa. Hu bere a wunni adwene tebea a ɛfata mu ma nna mu dwumadi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun pɛ a, ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbɛma wɔn woawofoɔ anaa woahwɛfoɔ aboa wɔberɛ a woregye ayarehwɛ wɔ adwenemhaw ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔpɛ a wɔbetumi ama woawofoɔ anaa sɛ woahwɛfoɔ aboa wɔ mmerɛkuro a ɛmfa ɔhaw biaa mma. Ɛho behia sɛ wɔbɛma mpanyimfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn die abɛboa wɔn wɔmmerɛ a wɔhia mmoa.Mmabun betumi ne woawofoɔ anaa sɛ woahwefoɔ adi nkitaho afa adwenemhaw mu mmoa ho wommerɛ a wɔhia mmoa.Wɔbetumi ne wɔn abom aso ɔhaw yi ano wɔ mmerɛkuro a wɔreboa ama wakɔ hu adɔkotafoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nipadua mu kasa ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa di wɔ berɛ a hia wote biribi ase na wopene so?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua Kasa: Nsɛnkyerɛnne pa: Nipa bɛsere, na ɔnnyɛ kuntann, ɔbɛ dwo, na w'atwe abɛn wo. Na moani kosua bɛtaa ahyia.  Nsɛnkyerɛnne a enye: Nipadua a ayɛ basaa, ɛɔbɛtwe ne ho, ɔnnhwɛ wo anim, ɔmmpene so ma wombɛn no bebree. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Ɛnyɛ Asɛmfua: Saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi betumi akyerɛ sɛ nipa mmpɛ saa tebea no. Nea ɛho hia: Nipadua mu kasa betumi ama woanya wo hokafoɔ atenka ne ahotɔ dodow ho nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛho hia. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Wode Bu: Sɛ wo hokafoɔ no da saa nsɛnkyerɛnne ahorow yi bi adi a, gyina kakra na bisa no yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwene mu nneyɛe betumi ama meho yiedi nyinaa atu mpɔn, a nipadua mu akwahosan ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe a adwen da ho a wɔde tew nneɛma ne brɛ adwennwen ase na ɛma obi nya ahomegye, na ɛno betumi anya nipadua mu akwahosan so nsusuaso pa denam mogya mmoroso a ɛbɛtew so, atew ɛhuhuo so, na ama nipadua no tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa no ayɛ adwuma yiye no so. Adwene mu yiyedi a ɛkɔ anim denam adwene a wɔde si biribi so so boa ma akwahosan nyinaa mu nkɔso yɛ papa, efisɛ adwene ne nipadua mu akwahosan wɔ abusuabɔ kɛse. Adwene a wode bɛdi dwuma no betumi ama wo ne aduan ne adidi ntam abusuabɔ ayɛ kɛse denam adidi ho nneyɛe a ɛwɔ adwene mu a wobɛma anya nkɔso so, na ebetumi ama woadi adidi a ahoɔden wom na woayɛ aduan a ɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan foforo bi a mɛfa so ahwehwɛ ahoɔden pa afi atipɛnfo hɔ sɛ nea ɛma wogye tom, te sɛ nkannyan a ɛwɔ nipadua mu "intrinsic motivation" a menya, me ho a mɛgye atom, ne me ho ayamhyehye, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyekye saa su ahorow yi wɔ me mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma foforo a wubetumi afa so ahwehwɛ ahoɔden pa afi atipɛnfo hɔ sɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma woagye atom anaasɛ wogye tom no bi ne: Nkannyan a ɛwɔ wo mu a wubenya: Fa w’adwene si so sɛ wubenya abotɔyam ne abotɔyam afi wo mu, wode w’ankasa botae ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne w’apɛde ahorow hyia sisi w’ani so, na wubenya adwene a ɛne sɛ woatumi ayɛ biribi afi saa botae ahorow no akyi a wubedi mu a abɔnten so adansedi mfa ho. Wo ho a wobɛma ayɛ nokware: Fa di dwuma sɛ wubehu na woakyerɛ w’ankasa wo bo a ɛsom, w’ahoɔden, ne nea woatumi ayɛ, agye wo mmɔdenbɔ ne wo nkɔso atom, na si wo ho so dua sɛ woapaw nneɛma a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo yiyedi hyia. Wo ho a wobɛtete wo ho: Fa ayamye ne ntease di wo ho dwuma, titiriw wɔ mmere a nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside wom mu, hu sɛ mfomso ne sintɔ yɛ onipa osuahu fã, na trɛw ayamhyehye mu ma wo ho bere a worekɔ asetena mu nkɔso ne ɔhaw ahorow mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo bebu hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo bebu wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ no so na wokura mu denam hokwan ahorow a wonim, nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔbɛma wɔabu akontaa wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛka obiara ne nea ɛnyɛ nyiyim a wɔde ma ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ kokoamu a obi mbu me atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi anya nyinsɛn ano a wosiw yi aduru wɔ kokoamu na wunnim atɛn denam: - Apomoden ho ɔyaresafo a wobɛkɔ akɔsra no so: Wubetumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe akɔhwɛ apomoden ho ɔyaresafo bi, te sɛ oduruyɛfo, ɔyarehwɛfo, anaa mmea ho ɔyaresafo, a obetumi de afotu ne nnwuma a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a ɛyɛ kokoam ne nea ɛnyɛ atɛn ama. - a wode awo apomoden ho ayaresabea ahorow bedi dwuma: Ayaresabea bebree ye awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie titire ma mmabun na wode kokoamu hwɛ ma wɔ tebea a ɛboa mu. - abɛɛfo ntetan so nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ mu: abɛɛfo ntetan so akwan bi de nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano  a wosiw ho ma na ebetumi ama akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so akra nneɛma a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ anifere ne kokoamsɛmu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma madi asetra ne atenka fam ɔhaw a ɛba wɔ mmabun nyinsɛn mu no so? (akuw a wɔboa, afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woadi ɔ haw no mu: Mmoa Akuw: Sɛ wo ne mmabun afoforo a wɔyem di nkitaho a, ebetumi ama woate ntease ne mmoa. Afotu Dwumadibea: Sɛ wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo bɛkasa a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woadi wo nkate so na woanya nimdeɛ a wode begyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de intanɛt adi dwuma de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfo na wɔadi nkitaho ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akɔka nhyiam ahorow ho, abɔ nkɔmmɔ, ɔsatu ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim, na wɔakyekyɛ nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkrasɛm mu na wɔakyerɛ ase?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so adesua ne nhyiamu: Nya nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu a ɛde adesua a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma, a "module" ahodoɔ a ɛtwe adwene si nna ne awoɔ akwahosan so titire ka ho. Nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow: Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔde ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, a ɛtaa de nnwinnade a wɔde di nkitaho, nsɛm, ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ma. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow: Hwehwɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, a ebia wɔde nnwinnade, akwankyerɛ, ne adwumayɛbea ahorow bɛma mmabun. Nhomakorabea nneɛma: Fa nhoma, nsɛm, ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a ɛwɔ nhomakorabea ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na aguadi ho horow boa ma wɔsakra adwene a mmabun kura wɔ nna mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nneyɛe, ne nnipa a wɔyɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so di gua boa ma wɔsakra mmabun adwene wɔ nna mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nneyɛe, ne wɔn nipasu ho denam adwene horow bi, apɛde ahorow, ne asetena kwan ahorow bi a ɛbata nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma anaa nnwuma ho a wɔde ma no so. Ɛdenam aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi so no, nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no betumi ahyɛ gyinapɛn pɔtee bi a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛyɛ fɛ, nea wɔpɛ, ne nkonimdi ho a ɛne nna mu apɔwmuden ho nneyɛe wɔ abusuabɔ ho nkuran, na anya mmabun ankasa adwene ne asetena mu akwanhwɛ ahorow so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan bɛn na mmabun wɔ fa kokoam-yɛ (confidentiality) ho bere a wɔhwehwɛ mmoa afiri ayaresafo hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan sɛ wɔkora wo nsɛm so. Hokwan sɛ wopene/po mmoa a awofoɔ nnim wei gyina mmra a woahyɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, ahwɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi adi wɔ atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔbɛkasa atia, na wɔaboa mmabun ma wɔahwehwɛ wɔn nipasu, wɔn anigyede, ne wɔn apɛde ahorow mu a wontua hwee?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, ahwɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔkasa tia na wɔboa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ wɔn nipasu, wɔn anigyede, ne wɔn apɛde ahorow mu kwa. Wobetumi ayɛ tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛsi so dua a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi na wɔabisa nsɛm afa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya nneɛma ahorow ne nhwɛsode ahorow a ɛda ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ ahorow adi, akasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ, na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho nkuran. Awofoɔ, ahwɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nso bɛtumi akamfo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne wɔn a wɔka bom ho nkuran wɔ sukuu, adwumayɛbea, ne mpɔtam, na ɛboa ma wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔgye tom na wɔboa ankorankoro nyinaa, a wɔn bɔbeasu mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya abusua a ɔdɔ wom a wɔbɛfa me ba no ayɛ wɔn mma? (adwumakuw ahorow a wɔfa mmofra sɛ wɔn mma, intanɛt so nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu yiyedi dwumadibea no di mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho dwuma wɔ Ghana, di wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔwmuden ho dwumayɛni ho nkɔmmɔ na ɔmmoa wo ma wodi nkate ho dwuma na woasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen anaa anohyeto ahorow bi a ebetumi aba wɔ gyinaesi nhwɛso ahorow mu wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ den na ɛwɔ afa horow pii a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nna mu nneyɛe, ne mmabun nkɔso ho a wobedi ho dwuma mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi nsɛnnennen yi so?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen anaa anohyeto ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ gyinaesi nhwɛso ahorow mu wɔ nsɛm a emu yɛ den a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu nneyɛe ho a wobedi ho dwuma mu no bi ne: Gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw dodo, nkate ne asetra mu nkɔso a ɛka ho wɔ asetra mu tebea horow ankasa mu a wobu ani gu so. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛka nea ebefi mu aba a wɔnhwɛ kwan anaa abɔnten so nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi aka gyinaesi mu aba no ho akontaa anaasɛ wobebu ho akontaa. Amammerɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ebetumi anya gyinaesi nhwɛso ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma anaasɛ etu mpɔn wɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Sɛ wobɛdi saa nsɛnnennen yi so a, ɛho hia sɛ wode adwene a ɛyɛ katee, wo ho a wobɛhunu, ne mmoa a ɛkɔ so a ɛfiri ankorankoro a wɔgye wɔn di a wɔte wo tebea soronko ase bɛka gyinaesie nhwɛsoɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so nyinsɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a wɔ fa so nyinsɛn (Fertilization) yɛ bere a mmadwoa nkwammoaa bi hyia na ɛne nkesua nkwammoaa bi bom. Eyi taa ba wɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu. Sɛ wɔwo mma wie a, ɛmo nkwammoaa no fi ase paapae na ɛbɛyɛ awotwaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmusua, mpɔtamfo, ne amammerɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ mmabun suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔhyehyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmusua, mpɔtam, ne amammerɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe a wɔhyehyɛ mu denam: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, atetesɛm, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo dwumadi ahorow ho a wɔde ma denam fekubɔ ne ntetee so. Akwankyerɛ, ɔhwɛ, ne abrabɔ fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma mmabun bere a wɔrekɔ nna mu nkɔso, abusuabɔ, ne awo ho gyinaesi ahorow mu no. Asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, asotwe ahorow, anaa amanne ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe, aware, ne mma awo mu den anaasɛ ɛhwɛ so wɔ amammerɛ mu tebea mu a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma ama nhomasua, afotu, ne kyɛfa a wobenya wɔ amammerɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ nkɔso a edi mũ ne nipasu a wɔhyehyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusueɛ ahorow bi a ɛfa ahoɔden pa a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ atipɛnfo nkitahodi mu, te sɛ obu a wɔde ma ankorankorɔ ahofadi, nnipa nyinaa nkabom ne nneɛma ahorow a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne sɛnea wɔbɛkwati nhyɛso, na mɛyɛ dɛn akura nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi mu wɔ m’ankasa nneyɛe ho ne afoforo nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusueɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusu ho bere a wode nhyɛso pa redi dwuma wɔ atipɛnfo ntam no bi ne obu a wubebu wɔn ahofadi ne gyinaesi, hwɛ hu sɛ wo nkuranhyɛ anaa ayeyi no yɛ nokware, na woakwati mmɔden biara a wobɛbɔ sɛ wobɛdannan wɔn anaasɛ wobɛhyɛ wɔn ma wɔayɛ biribi a ɛne wɔn pɛ nhyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nsɛm ama anaa wɔaka wɔn suahu ahorow ama ɔhaw ho afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow, aboa ama nkɔso akɔ so na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ saa nnwuma yi kɔ so yɛ nea mmerante ne mmabaa a wohia mmoa no kɔ so nya, ɛyɛ adwuma, na etu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a Wɔde Ma ne Osuahu a Wɔbɛkyɛ: Mmabun betumi de nsɛm ama anaasɛ wɔde wɔn suahu ama ɔhaw ho afotu adwuma denam akwan horow so, te sɛ nhwehwɛmu, nsɛm a wɔde ma ho nkrataa, anaa nkitahodi tẽẽ a wɔne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma no di. Saa nsɛm a wɔka yi boa ma nkɔsoɔ kɔ so na ɛhwɛ sɛ nnwuma kɔ so yɛ nea mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wohia mmoa no kɔ so nya, ɛyɛ adwuma, na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na metumi ayɛ de atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ menya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne nyinsɛn a manhyɛ da ?
answer_twi_source: Fa Kɔndɔm Di Dwuma: Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye bere nyinaa na fa di dwuma bere nyinaa bere a wode wo ho hyɛ ɔbea awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo mu, ne anom nna mu. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo hɔ ntɛm ara sɛ condom no sɛe bere a wo ne obi reda a. To Nna mu Ahokafo ano hye: Tew wɔn a wɔne wɔn ho da no dodow so, efisɛ eyi ma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya STI ahorow no so tew. Wo ne Ahokafo nni Nkitaho: Wo ne wɔn a wɔne wɔn da no mmɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na fa nokwaredi fa STI, sɔhwɛ, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho. Yɛ Sɔhwɛ: Yɛ nhwehwɛmu daa sɛ wowɔ STIs, titiriw sɛ wowɔ ɔhokafo foforo anaa ahokafo pii a. Susuw Awo ano aduro ho: Fa awo ano aduro a wotumi de ho to so, te sɛ akwan a wɔfa so de hormone anaa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ɛyɛ adwuma bere tenten (LARC) di dwuma na asiw nyinsɛn a woanhyɛ da ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amannebɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia de ahwehwɛ sohyial media nkɛntɛnsofo nsɛm mu na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ ASRH ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi aboa mmabun wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a wɔbɛnya de ahwehwɛ sohyial media nkɛntɛnsoɔfoɔ nsɛm mu na wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ ASRH ho denam: Akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma de asɔ nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ social media akwan so no mu ahotosoɔ ne ahotosoɔ ahwɛ. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkɛntɛnso, ASRH nsɛmti, ne dijitaal ɔman bayɛ ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw, ahyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne intanɛt so nneyɛe a asɛyɛde wom ho nkuran. Adwumayɛbea ahorow, nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne intanɛt so adesua ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne ASRH nkyerɛkyerɛ so a wɔde ma, na ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔwɔ nhumu na wɔkamfo wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me ho ahyɛ nsɛm a m’adwene mu abue mu na m'ahwehwɛ adwene foforo mu bere a meresisi gyinae wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Asɛmbisa a wobue mu ne adwene foforo a wɔhwehwɛ mu yɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia wɔ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee mu bere a wɔresi gyinae wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no. Fa nsiyɛ hwehwɛ adwene ahorow ne nsɛm a egu ahorow fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, a nea ɛkasa tia nsusuwii ahorow a woadi kan anya no ka ho. Fa tema di dwuma na susuw sɛnea adwene ahorow betumi ama woanya nhumu a ɛsom bo anaa akwan foforo a wɔfa so si nna mu akwahosan ho gyinae no ho. Ɛnam adwene ne nsɛm foforo a wobɛkɔ so abue w’ani so no, wubetumi apaw nneɛma a wunim na woayɛ no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma pɔtee bɛn na wɔtaa de ma wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa de nnwuma ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano. Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nnwuma, a afotu ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adwennwen ka ho. Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho afotu ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma. Akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ abusuabɔ pa, mmabunbere, ne nna mu akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsusuansoɔ bɛn na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo nsusuiɛ wɔwɔ awo ne abusua kyekye ho gyinaesi ahorow so ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo nsusuiɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ awo ne abusua kyekye ho gyinaesi ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ ma mmabun no mu. Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, atetesɛm, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa aware, awo, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho betumi anya mmabun adwene wɔ awo ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho so nsusuanso. Ɔmanfo mu nneɛma te sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nhomasua, ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma a wobenya nso nya nsusuanso wɔ mmabun gyinaeɛ si ho wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wosusuw saa nsusuanso ahorow yi ho na wɔde awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛka obiara ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so anya nsasae anaa nsɛm foforo a aba wɔ awoɔ nhyehyɛe ho, nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔayɛ wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a wobɛkɔ so anya: Aban abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow: Kɔ aban akwahosan dwumadibea abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow so na woanya nhyehyɛe foforo a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi abɔ wo amanneɛ wɔ nsakrae a aba wɔ nnwuma ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma mu ho. Mpɔtam Dwumadie: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtwe adwene si awoɔ akwahosan so na woanya nsɛm foforɔ. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so Nneɛma: Abɛɛfo ntentan ne nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a wotumi de ho to so ma wonya abusua nhyehyɛe ho nhwehwɛmu ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho nsɛm foforo. Nea ɛho hia: Nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ: Sɛ wunim nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a, ɛma wutumi kamfo abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma a ɛkɔ anim kyerɛ. Ankorankoro Gyinaesi a Wosi: Kɔ so nya nsɛm a ɛfata na wusi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ w’awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si sɛ nsuo bɛfi ɔbaa dwam mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛtaa si na ɛkyerɛ apɔmuden ma ɔbaa. Ɛyɛ nsuo fitaa a ɛho tew a ɛboa ma ɔbaa dwam ho tew na ɛyɛ den.. Nsuo no dodoɔ ne ne kɔla betumi asakra wɔ wo bosome bosome awoɔ bere no mu. Sɛ nsuo no bɔne hwam, ɛkeka wo, anaa ɛhyehye wo a, kɔhu dɔkota.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra betumi aboa ma mmabun anya asetra mu nimdeɛ wɔ fie?
answer_twi_source: Awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra betumi aboa asetra mu nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun mu denam hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma wɔn ma wɔafa asɛyɛde ahorow na wɔasi gyinae ahorow no so. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, tie yie , ne ɔhaw ahorow ano mmuaeɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ abusua no mu no ma asetra mu nimdeɛ a ɛho hia te sɛ nkitahodi a etu mpɔn ne ntawntawdi ano mmuaeɛ ba. Awofo betumi de mmabun ahyɛ ofie nnwuma, sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu de ahyɛ ahokokwaw te sɛ bere nhyehyɛe, sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ, ne gyinaesi ho nkuran. Suban pa ne gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔyɛ ho nhwɛso, akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma, ne nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ a wɔde ma no boa mmabun ma wohu wɔn ho, wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, na wonya tema.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmaabun betumi afa so ne wɔn atipɛnfo adi nkitaho yiye wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso ho, te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛka ho asɛm, adwene ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow pii adi dwuma de ne atipɛnfo adi nkitaho yiye afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso ho, te sɛ: Kuo nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu, akyɛ adwene, na wɔasusuw nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm nya wɔ suban ne nneyɛe so ho. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a wobegye ho kyim, animhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, ne adwene ahorow a wosusuw ho so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow so, baabi a mmabun kyɛ nimdeɛ, nneɛma, ne ahokokwaw a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu nhwehwɛmu ne nkyerɛase ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma a wɔbom yɛ a ɛfa nsɛmti ne nsɛm a ɛfa ho, a ɛma mmabun tumi da wɔn adwene adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwonwa so bere a wɔhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nsusuwii a ntease wom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan horow bɛn na wɔfa so yɛ tebea horow a ɛka obiara bom na ɛsi so dua ma mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan bi a wobɛfa so ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ayɛ nea ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho kɛse ni: Sɛnea wobetumi akɔ hɔ: Hwɛ sɛ akwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ, aguaree a wotumi kɔ hɔ, ne sɔhwɛ pon ahorow wɔ hɔ. Nkitahodi: Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tiawa ne mfidie a ɛboa te sɛ mum kasa asekyerɛfo anaa nneɛma a wɔde hwɛ ade di dwuma. Nteteeɛ: Tete adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ sebi mmubuafoɔ abrabɔ pa, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, ne sebi dɛmdi ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ pɔtee ho. Su a Ɛkyerɛ Obu: Fa nidi ne obu di ayarefo nyinaa ho dwuma, a sebi dɛmdi mfa ho. Ɔyarefo Paw: Ma mmabun tumi ma wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn hwɛ ho mu. Afotu Foforo: Fa bere a wode behyia a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ma. Fa akwankyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ma. Ma bere foforo a wode behyiam ayɛ nhyehyɛe. Wo ne mmubuafo akuo ahorow nyɛ adwuma bom ma nteteeɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo di wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun, ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ di dwuma titire wɔ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ mu denam: Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ nneyɛeɛ ne suban a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa pɛ ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmarima ne mmaa ho nsɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ ho. Adwene a ɛyɛ katee ne tema a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Basabasayɛ ne ayayadeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma. Tebea a wɔbɛma wɔanya obuo ne pɛyɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nyiyim bɛn na abɛɛfo amanneɛbɔ taa de ba ɛwɔ sɛnea obi hu ne nipadua ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a wɔtaa da no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu wɔ nipadua mfonini ho no bi ne: Teateaa sɛ ahoɔfɛ ho nhwɛso ma mmea. Ntini ne agumadi mu nkɔso sɛ nea eye ma mmarima. Nipadua ahorow, ne kɛse, ne nea wotumi yɛ ho mfonini a anohyeto wom. Saa nsusuwii hunu yi betumi aboa ma mmabun ate nka sɛ wɔmfata anaasɛ wɔn ani nnye wɔn ankasa nipadua ho sɛ ɛne saa nsusuwii  yi nhyia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a mmaa ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da 'LGBTQ+' mmabun anaa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ? (Akwahosan ho adwumayɛ ne akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo ka ho) .
answer_twi_source: Wobu mmaa ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da 'LGBTQ+' sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu no kyerɛ, na dɛn ne mmra a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ yɛn mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu no kyerɛ sɛ wobetumi apaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wogyae nyinsɛn no. Mmra kwan so mmra a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no gu ahorow wɔ ɔmantam biara mu. Wɔ mmeae bi no, nyinsɛn a woyi gu betumi ayɛ nea mmra ma ho kwan wɔ tebea horow bi mu, te sɛ bere a nyinsɛn no de asiane ba ɔbabun no akwahosan so anaasɛ efi mmonnaato anaa abusuafo a wɔne no da mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne pene a wɔpene so, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ nna mu dwumadi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛase: Mpene a wɔpene so kyerɛ sɛ wopɛ na w'ani gye ho sɛ wodi mpa so agorɔ. Nea ɛho hia: Ɛhwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, na ɛboa nkitahodie pa a obu ne apɔwmuden wom. Sɛ wɔmpene so a, wobu nna mu dwumadi sɛ ɛnyɛ nea wɔpene so anaasɛ nna mu dwuma a woabra.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuaso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ mmabun akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ne wɔn nneyɛe so?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuaso a ɛbɛkyɛ no betumi ayɛ nimdeɛ ne nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ soro wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho, na ɛde nneyɛe ne gyinaesi a ɛyɛ papa aba. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim mu no betumi anya ahotoso kɛse na wɔatumi ayɛ wɔn ho yiye wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen a wobedi ho dwuma mu. Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow yi mu no betumi de nkate fam mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ a ɛkɔ so ama, na aboa ma adwene ne nkate mu yiyedi atu mpɔn bere tenten. Dwumadi ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim mu kyɛfa a wonya nso betumi akanyan mmabun ma wɔabɛyɛ wɔn a wɔkasa ma nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow na wɔakɔ so ahyɛ nsakrae pa ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne atipɛnfo nsunsuanso wɔ Intanɛt so a ɛfa nna ho nsɛm a wɔde mena, Intanɛt so ayɔnkofa, ne nneyɛe afoforo a asiane wom ho?
answer_twi_source: Hu Wo Ahye (boundaries): Te w’ankasa wo hye ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa saa nneyɛe yi ho no ase. Susuw Ho Ansa na Woayɛ Ade: Ansa na wode mfonini anaa nkrasɛm biara a ɛbɛn wo bɛmena no, susuw nea ebetumi afi mu aba no ho. Bu Afoforo: Bu afoforo ahye ne wɔn kokoam nsɛm, na nhyɛ obi da sɛ ɔmfa nna ho nsɛm nkɔma obi anaa ɔmfa nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee nkyɛ. Hwehwɛ Afotu: Sɛ wunnim biribi ho yiye a, wo ne ɔpanyin anaa oduruyɛfo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa na ama woanya akwankyerɛ. Nneɛma a Wotumi De Ho To So: Fa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ di dwuma de hu nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nna ho nsɛm a wɔde mena ne Intanɛt so ayɔnkofa mu ho. Sɛ wudi saa akwan yi akyi a, wubetumi abɔ wo ho ban wɔ Intanɛt so, akura wo kokoam nsɛm mu, na woasi gyinae a ɛfata bere a wuhyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa nneyɛe a asiane wom wɔ Intanɛt so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahyehyɛ 'boundaries' ama kokoam-yɛ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ pa?
answer_twi_source: Gye tom sɛ kokoam-yɛ anaa 'privacy' ho hia. Kyerɛ wo 'boundaries' twaka. Monka deɛ mobɛkasa ho ne deɛ monnkasa ho. Monya obuo ne nteaseɛ ma obia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano betumi de akwan a wɔfa so de adwenemhaw ho nsɛm aka ho de aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no na wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛsa yare na wɔasan anya ahoɔden?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadie a wɔde siw ano no betumi de akwan a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho a wɔde bɛboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no aka ho na wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ ne nea ɛka obiara ho a wɔde bɛsa yare na wɔasan anya ahoɔden denam: Hu a wobehu sɛnea adwenemhaw abu so ne nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no asetra so, a akwan horow a basabasayɛ ho osuahu betumi afa so aka ankorankoro honam fam, nkate fam, ne adwene mu yiyedi ka ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ntetee a wɔde bɛma wɔ ɔhwɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, te sɛ ahobammɔ, ahotoso, nea wɔpaw, adwumayɛkuw, ne tumi a wɔde ma ho, de hwɛ hu sɛ nnwuma ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no yɛ nea ɛfa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛde wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahofadi, nidi, ne wɔn ankasa gyinaesi di kan, a ɛbɛma wɔatumi apaw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn ankasa ayaresa akwantu ne mmoa nnwuma a wobenya ho. Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ne nneɛma a ɛfa adwenemhaw pɔtee bi ho, te sɛ afotu, mmoa akuw, ne ayaresa akwan a ɛfa biribiara ho a wɔde ma, a edi wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahiade a emu yɛ den ho dwuma na ɛhyɛ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne ahotɔ ho nkuran. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne mmuae a wɔde ma a ɛkɔ so mu de ahwɛ sɛnea akwan a wɔfa so hu adwenemhaw no tu mpɔn na wɔahu hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔso na wɔayɛ nneɛma foforo wɔ mmoa a wɔde bɛboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ne basabasayɛ a ɛbɛba daakye a wobesiw ano no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nna mu basabasayɛ ne nna mu nneyɛe a wɔpene so ntam, titiri berɛ a nneɛma te sɛ mfe a obi adi, ne nhyɛso,ka ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mpenesoɔ so ne ade titiri a ɛma nsonsonoe da nna mu dwumadi a wɔpene so ne nna mu basabasayɛ ntam. Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna a wɔpene so no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa pene so a wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, wɔde anigye, na wɔde nimdeɛ ma, a wɔrenhyɛ wɔn, wɔmfa nhyɛso biara mma. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, nna mu basabasayɛ ba bere a ɔfã biako anaa nea ɛboro saa de wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu a onipa foforo no mpene so pefee na ofi ne pɛ mu, anaasɛ bere a wɔde ahunahuna, nhyɛso, ne ndaadaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ebetumi aboa nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ ma wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban afi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde bɛma nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ den nie: Akwahosan adwumayɛbea taa hyehyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeɛ de du nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ den "Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana" (PPAG): "https://www.ppag-gh.org/nu/" de kokoam nnwuma ma mmabun. "Ghana Ɔman AIDS Bagua": "https://www.ghanaids.gov.gh/" de nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ma. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ: Nneyɛeɛ a ɛde nwomasua ne dwumadie kɔ nnipa pɔtee bi a wɔn ho yɛ den nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na ASRH dwumadie ahodoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛ obuo na wɔde aborɔfoɔ nimdeɛ, nneyɛeɛ, ne ayaresa atetesɛm ahyɛ wɔn akwan mu berɛ a wɔdi nnipa hokwan gyinapɛn ne nneyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so nso akyi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ ne temanmufoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom: Abibifoɔ mantɔw a wɔbɛkyekyere no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde mpɔtam hɔfoɔ de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ mu denneennen. Abibifoɔ ayaresa nneyɛeɛ, amammerɛ mu guasodeɛ, ne abasɛm a wɔka a wɔde bɛka ASRH dwumadie ho no bu na ɛhyɛ aborɔfoɔ nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ anuonyam na ɛhyɛ amammerɛ mu nkɔsoɔ ho nkuran. Nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde nimdeɛ pene so: Mmabun ahofadi ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho a wobebu wɔn no bi ne sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛfata amammerɛ bɛma na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔte ase na wɔpene so. Sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ ASRH nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no di nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow akyi, a wɔnyɛ nnyiyim, na pɛyɛ, ne obuo a wɔde ma amammerɛ ahorow ka ho no ho hia wɔ adwuma a wɔ ne temanmufoɔ bɛyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na "abusuabɔ a obu wom" kyerɛ, titirie wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ a obu wom kyerɛ nnipa ntam abusuabɔ a w' wɔasi obuo, pɛyɛ, ahotoso, ne nkitahodi so. Wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden (ASRH) mu no, ɛka obuo ne nneyɛe a wɔde ma obi ne afoforo ho, titirie wɔ nna agodie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina adwendwene anaa sɛ fɛreɛ a ɛde ba wɔ berɛ a wɔ hu nsakra wɔ wɔn nipadua mu wɔ berɛ a wabu wɔn sa ano?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yɛ ma nipadua mu nsakraeɛ nyɛ yɛn ade foforɔ, wɔ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu no ɛyɛ 'normal': Hu sɛ nipadua mu nsakraeɛ nyɛ ade foforɔ na ɛto obiara na ɛberɛ no na asesa. Gye wo ho to mu: Fa w'adwene si nne pa a ɛwo nipadua mu, ahoɔden ne deɛ wo betumi ayɛ so na ɛnyɛ deɛ yɛde aniwa hu nko ara. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Kasa kyerɛ nnamfo anaa awofoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ wo den. Ka nsɛm pa kyerɛ wo ho: Ka nsɛm pa kyerɛ wo ho anaa sɛ dwene adwenpa na yi adwene bɔne firi hɔ. Wode wo ho hyɛ dwumadie bi mu: Fa wo ho hyɛ agorɔ anaa nneɛma a ɛma w'ani gye anaa sɛ ɛhyɛ wo nkuran mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnyinasosɛm atitiri bɛn na egyina hokwan ahorow so wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nnyinasosɛm atitiri no bi ne: Nyiyim a wɔnyɛ: Wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun nyinaa, a wɔn bɔbeasu, nna ho akɔnnɔ, asetena ne sikasɛm tebea, anaa su afoforo mfa ho, benya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kyɛfa: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, wɔde bedi dwuma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu. Akontaabu: Aban ahorow, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu afoforo a wɔbɛma wɔabu akontaa wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma akɔ so na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nnwuma pa ho. Tumi a wɔde ma: Mmabun a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔde wɔn hokwan ahorow adi dwuma, asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho, na wɔakamfo wɔn ankasa ahiade ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan. Nneɛma a wobetumi anya: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nsɛm, ne nhomasua wɔ hɔ, ne bo nyɛ den, na mmabun nyinaa betumi anya bi wɔ nipadua ne amammerɛ mu, a wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn sintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa kɛse ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe  ma mmabun hu wɔn ho na wobu wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛdenam dwumadi ahorow te sɛ wɔn ho a wosusuw ne botae a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so no, mmabun sua sɛnea wobehu wɔn ahoɔden, wɔn mmerɛwyɛ, ne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow. Wɔhwehwɛ wɔn atinka, nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho, ne wɔn nipasu mu wɔ tebea a wɔboa wɔn mu. Ɛdenam mmabun a wonya wɔn ho so denneennen ne wɔn ho nsɛm pa a wonya so no, wonya ahotoso wɔ wɔn tumi ne nea wɔpaw mu. Wonya nsɛm ne nkuranhyɛ fi wɔn atipɛnfo ne afotufo hɔ, na ɛhyɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔsom bo na wɔyɛ wɔn dea no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho nkuran na ɛbɔ mmabun ho ban fi Intanɛt so a wɔfa kotikwan so gye wɔn adeɛ ne ɔhaw ho?
answer_twi_source: Ma Nhumu: Trɛw nhumu mu wɔ intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho nsɛm mu wɔ atipɛnfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne awofo mu. Adesrɛ ne Ɔsatu: Fi ase anaa fa wo ho hyɛ adesrɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe pa wɔ intanɛt so. Frɛ Atumiwɔfo: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ atumfoɔ anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si intanɛt so ahobanbɔ so na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔatu mpɔn kyerɛ. Boa mmra hyɛ: Boa mmara a ne botae ne sɛ ɛbɛbɔ mmofra nkumaa ho ban afi Intanɛt so dwumadie ne ɔhaw ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Wo ne intanɛt so mpɔtam ne nhyiamu ahodoɔ nni nkitaho de da nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene adi na wɔkamfo nsakraeɛ kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wɔn awofo adi nkitaho afa wɔn atenka ne nea ɛhaw wɔn wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Paw bere a ɛfata a awofo ne abofra nyinaa nni hwee yɛ na obiara ho mpere no. Di nokware: Ka w’atenka no pefee  sɛ ɛyɛ wo yaw mpo a, ka. Bisa kokoam nsɛm sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobɛka w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm. Fa “me” nsɛm te sɛ “Mete nka” di dwuma fa kyerɛkyerɛ w’atenka mu a wommɔ obiara sobo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ ohia, adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, ne nhomasua a wonnya no nya tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow bedi dwuma no so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Asetena ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ ohia, adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, ne nhomasua a wonnya betumi asiw mmabun a wobenya nsɛm, nnwuma, ne nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho dwuma no ano. Nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no boa ma nsonsonoe ba akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonya, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, ne ahofadi a wosi gyinae mu, na ɛma mmerɛwyɛ ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn no kyinhyia kɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ no fa so de mmoa ma ansa na biribi asi 'bystander intervention' , na ɛboa sɛn ma wɔkwati nna mu basabasayɛ na wɔma mpɔtam hɔ yɛ asomdwoe?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔn ho nka ho tee yɛ biribi. Ɛsi basabasayɛ kwan denam mmoa a wɔde ma (bystanders) ma wohu/yɛ biribi no so. Ɛma nneyɛe bɔne gyae, ɛboa wɔn a wɔadi wɔn haw, na ɛma baabi yɛ asomdwoe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne digital akwan adi dwuma de asiw nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua nya mu no ano?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne digital akwan adi dwuma de asiw nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua nya mu no ano denam kokoam nneɛma a ɛfata mmabun a wɔde bɛma, aduruyɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so, UNICEF Safeguarding chatbot, Interactive Apps “Pocket Guide” intanɛt so mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow, mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaa wɔn a wohyia animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wɔde bɛma wɔn no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow gu ahorow wɔ mpɔtam ne aman ahorow mu, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛma nsakrae yi ba?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow gu ahorow wɔ mpɔtam ne aman ahorow mu esiane nneɛma te sɛ: Abakɔsɛm, asasesin, ne asetra ne sikasɛm tebea horow a ɛkyerɛ amammerɛ atetesɛm, nneyɛe, ne wiase adwene nti. Nkitahodi ne nsakrae a wɔne amammerɛ ne aman afoforo di, a ɛde gyidi ne nneyɛe bi a wogye tom, wɔyɛ nsakrae, anaa wɔpow bere kɔ so no ba. Amammerɛ akuw ahorow mu ne wɔn ntam, a nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ kasa, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, ne asetra mu kuw mu ka ho, a ɛka adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna ne awo ho. Asetra ne amammui mu nkɔso a ɛresakra, a nea ɛka ho ne kuw ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa yɛ pɛ, ne awo ho atɛntrenee, a ɛkasa tia anaasɛ ɛhyɛ atetesɛm mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na ASRH nsɛm bi a amanaman ntam mmoa ne wɔn a wɔde sika ma no de di kan no nya wiase nyinaa ASRH mmɔdenbɔ nhyehyɛe ne akwankyerɛ nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no betumi de ASRH nsɛm bi adi kan a egyina sɛnea wosusu sɛ ɛho hia anaasɛ ɛne wɔn ahyehyɛde no botae ahorow hyia so. Eyi betumi aka nneɛma a wɔkyekyɛ, nhyehyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe akwankyerɛ wɔ wiase nyinaa ASRH mmɔdenbɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa nkyerɛwee pɔtee bi wɔ yɛn som mu a ɛde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nna mu nneyɛe, mpenesoɔ, anaa mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Sua nyamesom nkyerɛwee anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ ahorow a akwankyerɛ a efi ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ hɔ wɔ wo nyamesom mpɔtam hɔ. Hwehwɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa obuo, mpeneso, ne asɛde ho a ebetumi akyerɛ wo nneyɛe kwan wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodi mu. Wo ne afoforɔ nsusu nkyerɛkyerɛ yi nkyerɛase ahorow ho na ama woanya ntease a emu dɔ wɔ sɛnea ɛfa nnɛyi nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu berɛ a botae bi nsom me yiedie bio anaasɛ ɛne me gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia na manya akokoduru ne ahoɔden a mede bɛsakra anaasɛ mɛgyae, ahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a, na mahwehwɛ nneɛma foforo a ebetumi aba ama nkɔso ne yiedie?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔso a wubesusu ho: Daa susu nkɔso a woanya wɔ botae ahorow ho na hwɛ sɛ ebia ɛkɔ so ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a wode di kan, ne wo yiedi hyia anaa.  ma nsakrae ho kwan: Hu sɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia ne tebea horow betumi asakra bere a berɛ nyina mu, na wobɛsakra anaa wubegyae botae ahorow a ɛmmoa wo bio. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ: Kohu ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ nnamfo, abusua mufo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, na woanya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ nsakrae ahorow a wobɛfa so akɔ so na woahwehwɛ nneɛma foforo a ebetumi aba ama nkɔso ne yiedi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ atɛntrenee a ɛma nkabom ho adwene mu kɔm (a ɛsi ayaresa ne akontabuo so dua) sɛ kwan foforo a wɔfa so siesie nsɛm sen amanne kwan so mmaranim nneyɛeɛ wɔ tebea horow bi mu.
answer_twi_source: Tebea horow bi mu no, atɛntrenee a ɛsiesie abusuabɔ betumi ayɛ kwan foforo a wɔfa so siesie nsɛm sen amanne kwan so asɛnnibea nneyɛeɛ. Eyi si ayaresa ma nea asɛm no ato no so dua, ɛhyɛ nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no ma ohu ne mfomsoɔ, na ɛsiesie ɔsɛeɛ a ɛbaeɛ no. Kae sɛ: ɛnyɛ wonnko na wuwɔ hɔ. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wopɛ w'asɛm na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa wo. Sɛ wobɛbɔ bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) ho amanneɛ a, ɛyɛ akokoɔdu nneyɛeɛ kɛseɛ. Ɛhiahia akokoɔdu, nanso ebetumi aboa wo ma woanya ayaresa na woasiw basabasayɛ biara a ebetumi aba daakye kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahokafo, abusuafo, ne mmoa afoforo di wɔ ɛnanom akwahosan 'health' a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔboa no di dwuma titiriw wɔ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn akwantu mu: Ahokafo: Wobetumi de atinka fam mmoa ama, akɔ nhyiam ahorow ase, na wɔaboa wɔ nnwuma a mfaso wɔ so mu. Abusua Mufo: Fa nkuranhyɛ, mmoa wɔ mmofra hwɛ mu, ne mmoa bere a wɔrewo. Nnamfo: Fa ntease, fekubɔ, ne mmoa ma. Nnipa a wɔboa nso betumi aboa wɔ ɔkwan bite sɛ: Suban pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ne adesua a wɔkɔ ansa na wɔawo no so. Ofie nnwuma a wɔboa bere a wɔyem ne awo akyi. Sɛ́ wobɛtra hɔ abɛkasa na watie bere a ɔbabun a onyinsɛn no hia mmoa no. Sɛ obi nya mmoa nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den a, ɛma ɛnanom akwahosan nya nkɔso, ɛtew adwennwen so, na ɛma mmoa a ɛsom bo wɔ nyinsɛn ne awo akyi bere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea wim nsakrae de ba mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan so bere tenten, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nhyehyɛe ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ, sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban adi nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nea wim nsakrae de ba mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) so bere tenten no bi ne asiane ahorow a ɛkɔ soro wɔ awo mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔsɛe no, aduan pa a wonnya nni, nnipa a wotu wɔn fi wɔn afie mu, ne asetra mu tebea a entumi nnyina. Saa nsɛnnennen yi a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔayɛ abom de abrɛ wim tebea mu nkɛntɛnso ase, ahyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den, ahyɛ nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa ho nkuran, na wɔabɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) hokwan ahorow ho ban ama awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba daakye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ nna mu ateetee bammɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ne suban pa, amamerɛ pa epia pia, ne kwan ben so na mmabun de wɔn ho behyɛ saa mmɔdenmɔ yi?
answer_twi_source: Peneeɛ dwumadibeae. Tipɛnfo nwomasua. Nea broni bɛkasɛ 'Social Media Campaigns'. Mpɔtam dwumadie. Mmabun betumi adi anim/aka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi adi nkɛntɛnso a aguade ho dawurubɔ, aguadi, ne aguadi mu nhyɛso betumi anya wɔ mmabun adwene, wɔn akɔnnɔ, ne wɔn nneyɛe so no ho dwuma denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ne nkɔmmɔbɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi adi nkɛntɛnso a aguade ho dawurubɔ, aguadi, ne aguadi mu nhyɛso betumi anya wɔ mmabun adwene, wɔn akɔnnɔ, ne wɔn nneyɛe so no ho dwuma denam: Mmabun a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ma wɔahu na wɔasusuw ho yiye wɔ akwan a wɔfa so gye nkurɔfo adwene a wɔde di dwuma wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi mu, te sɛ nkate mu anigye, nnipa a wɔagye din a wɔkamfo wɔn, ne asetra mu nkɛntɛnso ho akwan horow. Aguadi ho atirimpɔw ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm akyi a wɔbɛka ho asɛm na wɔahyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wonsusuw sɛnea aguade ho dawurubɔ ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ wɔn din betumi anya nea wɔpɛ, adetɔ ho gyinaesi, ne adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ wɔn ho a wɔsom bo ho no so nkɛntɛnso ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔkasa tia adetɔ ho adwene, ko tia atipɛnfo nhyɛso, na wogyina wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, ahiade, ne wɔn apɛde ahorow so paw nneɛma a ntease wom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Nhyehyɛe ne mmara ahorow a ɛhyɛ nhumu, akontaabu, ne abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow ho nkuran wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi nneyɛe mu a wɔbɛboa, ne nnwuma a ɛboa ma wohu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne adetɔfo tumi wɔ mmabun ne mmusua mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne Nnipa hokwan bɛn na ɛfa 'migrants' ne mmabun nya a wɔ nya SRH dwumadi hokwan, te sɛ peneeɛ, kokoam asem diɛ.?
answer_twi_source: Kwan-gye . Kokoam-yɛ (ayarehwɛ pɛ). Pɛyɛ. Kokoam-yɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi akɔgye mmoa wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ a wɔn dwumadie ne sɛ wɔbɛboa wɔn a wɔwɔ ɔhaw mu wɔ mmerɛkorɔ a wɔmmɔ m'awofoɔ anaa sɛ m'ahweɛfoɔ amanneɛ anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, titiri sɛ ɛyɛ kokoam anaa bammɔ asɛm. Nanso, sɛ awofoɔ ba mu bi ayɛ woberɛ ne nkwa da esane mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm atitiriw bi a ɛfa 'ASRH' ho a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw a broni ka no 'media literacy' a wɔkasa ma kyerɛ betumi adi ho dwuma, te sɛ anansesɛm a wɔbɛpow, nsusuwii hunu a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: ASRH Nsɛm Titiriw a Wobedi Ho Dwuma: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ betumi adi nsɛm atitiriw a ɛfa 'ASRH' ho ho dwuma, te sɛ anansesɛm a wɔbɛma ayɛ nokware, nsusuwii hunu a wɔkasa tia, ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne abusuabɔ ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɛfa saa nsɛmti yi ho pɔtee so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn atipɛnfo tumi ma wɔasusuw nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm ho yiye na wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a wɔfa so gyina ano anaa akwan pa a wɔfa so di atipɛnfo nhyɛso "peer pressure" ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mmeae a ahoɔden wom "seek healthy outlets": Fa adwennwen anaa dadwen kɔ dwumadi pa te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, nsɛmma nhoma kyerɛw, anaa adwene mu nneyɛe mu. Da nkate adi: Wo ne ɔpanyin anaa w’adamfo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka wo atinka ne osuahu ahorow ho asɛm, na nya adwene ne mmoa. Fa botae ahorow sisi w’ani so: Fa w’adwene si w’ankasa botae ne w’apɛde ahorow so, na kura atirimpɔw ne akwankyerɛ ho adwene a ɛnyɛ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso mu. Sua biribi fi akwanside ahorow mu: Gye huammɔdi anaa akwanside ahorow tom sɛ adesua hokwan ahorow, yɛ nsakrae na nya ahoɔden wɔ amanehunu anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm ne ɔhaw a ɛreba, te sɛ dijitaal akwahosan, wim nsakrae, ne atutra ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam 'ASRH' nhyehyeɛ ne nhyehyeɛ ahodoɔ di nsɛm ne nsɛnnennen a ɛreba te sɛ digyital akwahosan, wimu nsakraeɛ, ne atutena ho dwuma denam mfiridwuma foforɔ a wɔde bɛka ho, akwan a wɔfa so de gyina ahoɔden ano a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne hokwan a mmabun a wɔtu kɔtena baabi foforɔ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforɔ wɔ wɔ tebea a ɛresakra no anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya no ho hia ma mmabun apɔwmuden ne yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya no ho hia kɛse ma mmabun apɔwmuden ne yiyedi efisɛ: Aduan a ahoɔden wom ma wonya aduannuru a ɛho hia ma onyin, adwene mu nkɔso, ne apɔwmuden nyinaa, na ɛboa nipadua ne adwene mu yiyedi. Adan a ɛfata ma wonya ahotɔ, ne ahobammɔ, na ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na ɛma mmabun tumi de wɔn adwene si wɔn nhomasua ne wɔn ankasa nkɔso so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ transgender, non-binary, anaa genderqueer
answer_twi_source: Transgender: Obi a ɛsono ne bɔbeasu wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde maa no bere a wɔwoo no no ho. Non-Binary: Ankorankoro a wɔnkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ mmarima anaa mmea nkutoo. Genderqueer: Wei ne non-binary nyinaa yɛ pɛ. Ɛkyerɛ obi a ne su nnyina faako; ebetumi asakra bere biara anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nea ɛne mmarima ne mmaa su a amammere agye atom no hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne nna mu anigye 'orgasm' na ɛte sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu anigye 'orgasm' yɛ anigyeɛ kɛseɛ a ɛba nna mu awieeɛ. Obiara deɛ yɛ soronko. Ebi te nka sɛ anigyeɛ, anaa wɔn ho wosow. Ebinom te nka sɛ ahometeɛ anaa hyeɛ bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan (sexual health) ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho a wɔde bɛma. Munsusuw Gyinapɛn Ho: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa gyinapɛn ne abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya: Hwɛ sɛ mmabun benya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam. Hyɛ Nkitahodi Ho Nkuran: Ɛsɛ sɛ awofo si hia a nkitahodi ho hia wɔ abusuabɔ mu so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma a wobenya ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow bɛtumi anya tumi wɔ adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma a wobenya wɔ mpɔtam bi mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Ankorankoro binom bɛtumi ahyia amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nhwehwɛ nna mu apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne animtiaabu, aniwu, anaa abusua akwanhwɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ yɛ atenka wɔ amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu nsusuiɛ ho na wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfata amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma ayarefoɔ gyidie ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ kokoamsɛm a wɔde sie wɔ akwahosan ho, titire ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ kokoamsɛm a wɔde sie wɔ akwahosan ho, titiriw ma mmabun. Nhwɛso; Ayarehwɛfo mmara no de gyinapɛn ahorow si hɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ ayarefo ayaresa ho kyerɛwtohɔ ne wɔn ankasa akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ban, a mmofra nkumaa de ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsi nna mu nkyekyɛmu sesayɛ (conversion therapy) anaa nneyɛeɛ bɔne foforɔ a wɔde tia LGBTQ+ foɔ kwan?
answer_twi_source: Aman ne mpɔtam binom wɔ mmara a ɛbara nsakraeɛ ayaresa anaa nneyɛeɛ foforɔ a epira a wɔde wɔn ani si LGBTQ+ ankorankoro so. Nsakraeɛ ayaresa a wɔsan frɛ no "reparative therapy" anaa "nna mu akɔnnɔ nsakraeɛ mmɔdenbɔ," kyerɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsesa obi nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ne bɔbeasu denam adwene anaa nyamesom mu dwumadie so. Saa nneyɛe yi agye din kɛse wɔ aduruyɛ ne adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow mu esiane nkɛntɛnso bɔne a enya wɔ LGBTQ+ ankorankoro adwenemyare ne wɔn yiyedi so nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm a egyina adanse so di wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a mesisi wɔ nna mu akwaa apɔmuden  ho no mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw ahotoso a ɛwɔ nsɛm a wonya fi mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a egyina adanse so yɛ fapem a wɔde si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho. Ɛma wonya nimdeɛ a wotumi de ho to so, a nyansahu agye atom a ebetumi akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ nea wobɛpaw wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ (STI ) a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ ho. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohwɛ sɛnea nneɛma a wonya fi mmeae ahorow no tumi gye di a, susuw nneɛma te sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no ahwehwɛde, din a nhoma no wɔ, ne sɛ ebia nhwehwɛmu nhwehwɛmu na ɛfoa nsɛm no so anaasɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ nnuruyɛ fekuw anaa ɔmanfo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow foa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn ahye ase na wɔasi so dua, ama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee anya nkɔso, na wɔahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ne pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun ma wɔte wɔn ahye ase na wɔasi so dua no mu. Wobetumi ama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee anya nkɔso denam tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wɔbɛma aba a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn nkate, ne wɔn haw ahorow adi no so. Mpanyimfo betumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa mu nkɔso, pene a wɔpene so, ne ahye ho denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne nhomasua nneɛma so. Ɛdenam suban a obu wom ho nhwɛso ne aso tie mmabun haw ahorow so no, mpanyimfo betumi aboa ma mmabun tumi ma wɔde ahotoso asi wɔn ahye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sukuu mmoa dwumadie no tumi kyerɛ kwan ma wɔkɔ mmeammea foforo anaa sɛ apɔmdenbea foforɔ ho akɔ pɛ mmoa afa nna ne awoɔ apɔmden ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Wɔkyerɛ kwan kɔ dɔkotafoɔ, ayaresabea ahodoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne mpɔtam kuo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So afotuo ne ayaresa yɛ kokoamsɛm, na hyeɛto 'limits' bɛn na ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Afotuo ne ayaresa nhyiam ahorow yɛ kokoamsɛm, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nea wo ne wo afotumafoɔ anaa ɔyaresafoɔ bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ no yɛ asumasm na wɔrenka nkyerɛ afoforoɔ. Nanso, hyeɛto ahorow bi wɔ kokoamsɛm mu, te sɛ sɛ asiane wɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛpira wo ho anaa afoforɔ, sɛ wosusu sɛ wɔayɛ ayayade anaa wɔabu ani agu wo so, anaasɛ sɛ mmara hwehwɛ sɛ wɔda no adi. Wo afotumafoɔ anaa ɔyaresafo bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hyeɛto ahorow yi mu akyerɛ wo wɔ ayaresa no mfiase, na sɛ wunnim kokoamsɛm a, wubetumi abisa nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnɔnhwerew ne tebea horow bɛn na mmara kwan so de ma adwumayɛfo, na sɛ wɔkakyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma ntra anohyeto a, ɛdɛn na broni ka no 'recourse' na wɔwɔ fa ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebia adwuma nnɔnhwerew ne tebea horow a mmara ma ho kwan ma adwumayɛfo a wonnii mfe aduonu no bi ne anohyeto ahorow a wɔde bɛma wɔ da biara da ne dapɛn dapɛn adwuma nnɔnhwerew ho, ahomegye a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔde bɛma, ne anohyeto ahorow a wɔde bɛma wɔ nnwuma a asiane wom ho. Sɛ wɔka kyerɛ mmabun sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma ntra saa anohyeto ahorow yi a, wobetumi: Hu wɔn hokwan ahorow: Wɔate mmara kwan so adwumayɛ dɔnhwerew anohyeto ne ahomegye bere a wɔhwehwɛ ma mmabun adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ wɔn tumidi mu no ase. Ma nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho asɛm so: Sɛ wɔka kyerɛ wɔn adwumawura sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma ntra mmara kwan so a, fa nidi ka kyerɛ wɔn adwumawura, na fa adwumayɛ ho mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ka ho asɛm. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Sɛ wɔanni nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma a, mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi adwumayɛfo mpanyimfo, mmabun adwumayɛ adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa mmara mu akamfofo hɔ de adi mmara so bu ho dwuma na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi adwumayɛ ho mmara so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bra pa bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mebɔ bere a meyinsɛn?
answer_twi_source: Aduane pa. Yɛ nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ wo nipadua den (Exercise). Nna a ɛdɔɔso. Twe wo ho fi nneɛma bɔne (sigaret/nsa) ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ wɔberɛ a wɔnnim sɛ ebia wɔbehia daberɛ ne adan anaa sɛ wobetumi afa akwan foforɔ so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔnkasa nkyerɛ panyin a wogye no di te aɛ awofoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ mfa wɔn haw ho. Wɔnfrɛ mpɛ mmoa mfiri mpɔtamkuo ahodoɔ ho. Nimdefoɔ yei bɛtumi ahwɛ wɔn tebea na wɔakyerɛ wɔn deɛ ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛdɛn haw ne nsusuaso aa ani nndaso nya wɔ nea broni bɛkasɛ 'technology' a yɛde di dwuma wɔ ASRH mu, te sɛ abɛɛfo so ateetee anaa abɛɛfo nsem bone?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so doko ateetee(adwen mu nsusuaso). Nneɛma bɔne a ɛnsie (Atorɔ nsɛm). Kokoam/ nsɛm banmɔ (kokoam korɔno).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ no betumi aboa ma wɔabɔ mmɔden kɛse sɛ wobedu nkɔso botae ahorow a ɛtra hɔ daa a ɛfa ohia a wɔbɛtew so, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne asetena mu nkabomu ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ no boa ma wɔbɔ mmɔden kɛse sɛ wobedu nkɔso botae ahorow a ɛtra hɔ daa a ɛfa ohia a wɔbɛtew so, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne asetena mu nkabom ho denam nneɛma, nimdeɛ, ne nkitahodi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma de di ɔhaw a emu yɛ den ho dwuma so. Wɔbɛtumi aboa nnwuma a ɛhyɛ sikasɛm mu nkɔsoɔ a ɛka obiara ho nkuran, ɛma nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua tumi, na ɛma adwumayɛkuo ahodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bɛyɛ adwuma de anya nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi adi wɔ amammerɛ mu nkate ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔde wɔn bɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ amammerɛ mu nkateɛ ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka ho wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu denam: Atenaeɛ a wɔbɛma mmabun a wɔfiri amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu akyɛ wɔn suahunu, nsɛnnennen, ne adwene a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn a ɛfa amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuw ahorow ahiade pɔtee ne wɔn haw ahorow ho a wɔde bɛma. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛma mmabun nyinaa nya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie. Asetra ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛfa nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu wɔ nnipa a wɔn amammerɛ gu ahorow mu, a mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtew animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ so ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de akwan a wɔfa so de adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow, afotuo adwuma ahorow, ne nneɛma afofor a wɔde ma mmabun mu, de ahyɛ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ahoɔden, ne akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de akwan a wɔfa so de adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow, afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne nneɛma afoforo a mmabun betumi de ahyɛ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano no ho nkuran. Eyi betumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne kasa ne emu nsɛm a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho a wɔde bɛka ho, nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ pene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho, ahokokwaw a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ de adi adwennwen ne nkate ho dwuma, atipɛnfo mmoa ne biakoyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne mmeae a ahobammɔ ne nea ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no te nka sɛ wɔate wɔn asɛm, wogye di, na wɔboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STI ho? (ayaresabea ahorow, awofoyɛ a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, sɔhwɛ ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ fie) .
answer_twi_source: Mmeae pii wɔ hɔ a wobɛtumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STI ho wɔ Ghana: Ayaresabea: Aban ayaresabea ne ayaresabea bebree de kokoam STI nhwehwɛmu ma. Mpɛn pii no, eyinom ne nea ne bo nyɛ den sen biara, na ebia ebinom mpo de sɔhwɛ a wontua hwee bɛma. Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): PPAG de kokoam nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho dwumadie ma, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho, ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa. Wubetumi ahu ayaresabea bi a ɛbɛn wo wɔ wɔn wɛbsaet https://www.ppag-gh.org/nu/. Ankorankoro Ayaresabea: Ankorankoro ayaresabea ahorow bi nso de STI nhwehwɛmu ma. Ebia eyinom bɛbɔ ka kɛse asen nea aban no betumi apaw, nanso wɔda so ara yɛ nea wɔahyɛ ho bɔ sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm so. Fie sɔhwɛ: Bere a wonnya nnyaa bi kɛse wɔ Ghana de, nanso ebia STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔde yɛ wɔ fie no bɛyɛ nea wobetumi apaw daakye. Nanso, mprempren de, nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ayaresabea ne ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so ahwɛ ahu sɛ nea efi mu ba no yɛ nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Apɔmuden  ho adwumayɛfo bɛn na wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra ho animdefo: Dɔkotani a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmofra ne mmabun akwahosan ho. Abusua Nnuruyɛfo: Nnuruyɛfo a wɔhwɛ akwahosan so a wobetumi adi akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma. Mmea ho animdefo: Wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmea awo akwahosan ho. Ntini ho animdefo: Wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmarima awo akwahosan ho. Dɔkotafo a yɛfrɛ wɔn wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Endocrinologists: Wɔ honam mu nkawmmoa ho nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛe pa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa dɛmdi ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe pa a ɛwɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho dwumadie a ɛfa mmubuafoɔ ho a wɔde ma mmabun no bi ne apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛtumi anya, atete apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ mmubuafoɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nnipa ntam nkitahodiɛ mu, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛma, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw so, ne fekubɔ a wɔne mmubuafoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔwofo a obi yɛ mu? (sikasɛm, atenka, bere mu ahofama) .
answer_twi_source: Ɔwofo a obi bɛyɛ no yɛ nkwa nna nyinaa mu bɔhyɛ a ɔdɔ ahyɛ mu ma nanso asɛyɛde a ɛho hia nso: Sikasɛm: Abofra ntetee hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ka kɛse wɔ aduan, ntade, akwahosan, nhomasua, ne mmofra hwɛ ho. Atenka fam: Mmofra hia ɔdɔ, adwene, ne nkate fam mmoa bere nyinaa. Bere a Wobɛhyɛ: Ɔwofoyɛ hwehwɛ sɛ wode wo bere ne w’ahoɔden kɛse di dwuma. Ebetumi aka wo nhomasua, w’adwuma, ne wo fekubɔ asetra.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so di akɔnnɔ ne nhyɛso se fa nnuru bɔne ho dwumadi, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyekyere nnamfo ne afotufo a woboa kuo?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so di akɔnnɔ ne nhyɛso se fa nnuru bɔne dwumadi ho dwuma no bi ne: Nneɛma a ɛkanyan no a wobehu na wɔakwati tebea horow a asiane kɛse wom anaa nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbata nnuru  bɔne a wɔde di dwuma ho. Ahokokwaw a efata a wɔde gyina ano ne dwumadi afoforo a wɔde betwetwe adwene afi akɔnnɔ te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, anigyede, anaa akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome a wobenya. Nnamfo, abusua, ne afotufoɔ a wɔboa nkitahodiɛ a wɔkyekyere a wɔhyɛ nkuran na wɔhyɛ nneɛma pa a wɔpaw mu den na wɔma akontabuo ne nteaseɛ wɔ mmerɛ a emu yɛ den mu. Afotufo, ayaresa ho animdefo, anaa mmoa akuw a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho ahotɔ ne nea wɔde siw yare a ɛsan ba no ano a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ. Mmoa nkitahodi a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛkyekye no betumi ama wɔanya nkuranhyɛ, agye atom, ne mmoa a mfaso wɔ so wɔ ahwɛyiye a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu ne yiyedi nyinaa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii 'ethical considerations' a ɛfa mmabunbere ne nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a Wɔde Amanneɛ Ma: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ ankorankoro wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ansa na wɔasi gyinae wɔ wɔn nipadua ne akwahosan 'health' ho. Ahintasɛm: Bu a wobu kokoam nsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm bere a woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho no. Ahofadi: Hokwan a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wosi wɔn ankasa gyinae wɔ wɔn nipadua ne nna mu dwumadi ahorow ho a wogye tom. Obu a Wobu Ma Nneɛma Ahorow: Adwene ahorow, nnipa a wɔyɛ, ne osuahu ahorow a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛsom bo wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a edii yiye a ama mmabun anya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nsɛm atu mpɔn, na asuade bɛn na yebetumi asua afi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne: Ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su nea broni ka no 'Youth-friendly clinics' a wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ne nsɛm ma wɔ tebea a ɛnyɛ atemmu mu. Nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔkyerɛkyerɛ na wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Nea broni ka no 'Digitals platform' ahorow a ɛde nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ma. Wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri kaa sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho, na ɛkaa nsɛmti ahorow te sɛ pene, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI ano a wosiw ho dwuma. Asuade ahorow a yenyae: Fa nsɛm ne nnwuma ma ɛne mmabun ahiade soronko, nea wɔpɛ, ne wɔn amammerɛ hyia. Hyɛ adwumakuo a ɛda akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no ntam de adi nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ ho dwuma. Gye mfiridwuma nea broni ka no 'technology' tom sɛ adwinnade a wɔde yɛ nneɛma foforo na wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn, bere a wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun nyinaa bɛka wɔn ho na wɔanya bi. Fa kokoamsɛm, obu, ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ di kan na ama wɔanya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ama mmabun a wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso pa bi a ɛfa ahye a wɔde si hɔ wɔ adeyɛ mu ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn asua biribi afi nhwɛso ahorow yi mu de anya abusuabɔ a abotɔyam ne obu wom kɛse ne mfɛfo, nnamfo, ne ɔdɔ ahokafo?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso pa a ɛfa ahye a wode besi hɔ ho ne sɛ wode honam fam ɔdɔ bɛda w’awerɛkyekye dodow adi, wobɛka sɛnea wuhia w’ankasa baabi anaa bere a wo nkutoo na wubenya no ho asɛm, na woasi w’ahye ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi anaa abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ho no so dua. Wubetumi asua biribi afi nhwɛso ahorow yi mu denam sɛnea ankorankoro de obu ne katee ka wɔn ahye ho asɛm, de wɔn yiyedi di kan, na wokura obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu a wobɛhwɛ so. Fa atie a ɛyɛ nnam, tema, ne nkitahodi ho akwan a ɛyɛ katee di dwuma na ama wo ne w’atipɛnfo, nnamfo, ne wɔn a wɔne wo dɔ no anya abusuabɔ a ɛma abotɔyam na obu wom kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na nnubɔne (substance use) tumi de adwene mu haw te sɛ 'anxiety' anaa 'depression' ɛba?
answer_twi_source: Nnubɔne tumi sɛe adwene no ne ne dwumadie ahorow a adi 'brain chemistry'. Nneɛma bi te sɛ nsa, wee, ne pii a ɛkeka ho tumi kata haw no so kakra, nanso ɛma obi tumi de ne ho to so. Nnubɔne tumi ma adwene mu haw yɛ kɛseɛ, na ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛsa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ animhwehwɛ anaa ɛdaadaa wɔ media nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ animhwɛ anaa ɛdaadaa nnipa ntam wɔ media nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mu denam: Nsɛm no fibea a wɔbɛhwɛ na wɔasusu sɛnea wogye di no ho.  Adanse a wɔde ma de foa nsɛm a wɔka no a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Sɛ́ wobɛhwɛ yiye wɔ kasa a ɛkanyan atenka a ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ animhwɛ ho. Adwene ahorow a wosusu ho na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nea ɛyɛ kurukuruwa na ɛyɛ nea ntease a adi mu wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi abom adi nnuro a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyare ho nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma, na wɔahyɛ ahokokwaw pa a wɔde gyina ano ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wotumi gyina ano no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi abom adi nnuro a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma denam: Nsiesiei a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde siw ano ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma ntɛm wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ntetee a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ sɛnea wobehu nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde nnuru di dwuma ne adwenemyare ho, ne mmabun a wɔde bɛka nneɛma a ɛfata ho. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nnwuma a wotumi nya na ɛne amammerɛ hyia a wɔde ma, a afotu, ayaresa, ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow ka ho. Ahokokwaw pa a wɔde gyina ano ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wotumi gyina tebea horow ano a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde yɛ adesua akyi, atipɛnfo afotu, ne nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so. Yɛne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔbɛyɛ biako de akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa mmabun adwenemyare ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma a wosiw ano. Ɛdenam adwuma a wɔbom yɛ so no, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no betumi ayɛ mmeae a wɔboa na wɔama mmabun tumi ma wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata na wɔadi yiye wɔ wɔn asetra mu nneɛma nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma anaa akadeɛ ma ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde kokoam sie, awofoyɛ mmeae a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi abua nsɛmmisa na wɔde mmoa ama.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde boa kokoam nie: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG Helpline): 0244312151 (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8am-5pm) Saa mmoa telefon yi de kokoam afotuo ma na ebia ɛbɛtumi ne wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ abɔ. Akwahosan Ho Ɔdemafo a Wogye Di: Oduruyɛfo, ɔyarehwɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔbenfo foforo betumi abua wo nsɛmmisa na ɔde mmoa ama wɔ kokoam tebea bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm bi a wotumi de wo ho to so a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a obi wɔ sɛ oyi nyinsɛn gu ne mmara ahorow ho? (wɛbsaet ahorow, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔbea ahorow)
answer_twi_source: YMK App, Mariecall: 030 2241517, PPAG 0800202010 akwahosan facilities wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ wɔ nneɛma a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu hokwan ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow boa ankorankoro ma wɔsusuw nea wobetumi apaw ho, asusuw mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ mu, na wodu gyinaesi ahorow a ntease wom na wonya nimdeɛ pa ho wɔ tebea ahorow a ɛfa atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso ne nna mu nneyɛe ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow boa ankorankoro ma wɔhwehwɛ nea wobetumi apaw denam tebea horow a emu yɛ den a wɔkyekyɛ mu ma ɛyɛ anammɔn a wotumi di ho dwuma no so. Wɔma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobehu nsɛm a ɛfata, te sɛ asiane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ nneɛma ahorow a wɔpaw mu, na wɔhyɛ nsusuwii a emu yɛ den a ɛfa sɛnea ɔkwan biara a wɔbɛfa so ne ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a ɛho hia no hyia ho nkuran. Ɛnam mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔkwan biara a wɔbɛfa so asi ananmu no a wɔbɛkari so no, ankorankoro betumi asi gyinae a ntease wom na wɔanya nimdeɛ pa wɔ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso ne asetra mu nhyɛso ahorow a efa nna mu nneyɛe ho mpo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne abusuabɔ pa na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛwɔ obu, ahotosoɔ, nkitahodie, ne mmoa. Obiara te nka sɛ ɔsom bo na ɔwɔ bammɔ. Wohu denam ayamye, pɛyɛ, ne nteaseɛ a moda no adi. Ɛgyina nokware ne nneɛma a mokabom yɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na SRH hokwan ne nipa hokwan, te sɛ kwan a yɛ wɔ sɛ yɛbenya apɔwmuden pa na y'ade yɛn ho di nsra?
answer_twi_source: Right to Health: SRH ka apɔwmuden ho nti ehia sɛ yɛhwɛ yɛ ho so yie. Autonomy: Wowɔ ho kwan sɛ wotumi de wo nipadua yɛ nea wopɛ. Non-Discrimination: Pɛyɛ a nyiyimu nni mu. Education: Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wonya nimdeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wohia mmoa a wɔde bɛfa akwahosan nhyehyɛe no mu na wɔanya ayaresa mmoa adwuma a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow hɔ, a sukuu afotufo, mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, nna mu akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun akwahosan ho adwuma titire ka ho. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ama akwankyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe no mu akwantuo ne ayaresa mmoa dwumadie a ɛfata a wɔbɛnya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ne kwan so sɛ megyae me hokafo sɛ ɔmmpɛ 'safe sex' (nna a bammɔ wom)?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛyɛ ne kwan so paa. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wobɔ wo ho ban. Sɛ obi bu wo a, ɔbɛte w'ase.  ɔdɔ a ɛgyina nna nko ara so nnyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anammɔn a wɔfa so bɔ GBV ho amanneɛ kyerɛ polisifo anaa atumfoɔ? (anwiinwii krataa a wɔde kɔdan aban, adanse a wɔboaboa ano) .
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ kwan ni: Anwiinwii a wode bɛkɔ: Wubetumi abɔ GBV ho amanneɛ akyerɛ polisifo anaa obi a wɔapaw no wɔ wo sukuu anaa w’adwumam. Adanse a Wɔboaboa Ano: Polisifoɔ bɛtumi aboaboa adanseɛ te sɛ adansefoɔ nsɛm, aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ, anaa mfonini (sɛ ɛfata a). w’awofo anaa ɔpanyin a wogye no di betumi aboa wo ma woabɔ GBV ho amanneɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nsusuwii a adi mu betumi aboa me ma masusuw sɛnea ɛyɛ nokware no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ pefee boa wo ma wohwehwɛ sɛnea adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware denam adanse a ɛfoa so anaasɛ ɛbɔ agu a wobɛhwehwɛ mu no so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wubetumi de nneɛma a agye din ahwehwɛ nsɛm a wɔka no mu nokwasɛm, ahwehwɛ nsusuwii ahorow a ɛwɔ ase no mu yiye, na woasusuw ho sɛ ebia nsɛm no ne nyansahu mu adwene a wɔagye atom a wɔagye atom no hyia anaa. Ɛdenam adwene a ɛnteɛ a wubegye ho kyim na woakasa atia so no, wubetumi asi gyinae a ɛfata na ama w’atipɛnfo anya ntease a edi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw anaa botae ahorow a wɔde gyina akyi wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw a wɔde gyina akyi anaa botaeɛ a ɛwɔ ASRH adwuma mu no bi ne: Sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛfata mfeɛ a obi adi. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den na ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho hwɛ. Awo hokwan ne nipadua mu ahofadi a mmabun wɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne awo daakye ho ka ho. Asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ ASRH nsonsonoe, te sɛ ohia, nyiyim, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya no ho dwuma a wobedi. Nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛ obu na ɛbɔ mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ hokwan ahorow ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu dae na so ɛyɛ ade a ɛyɛ daadaa ade? (Ma mmarima) .
answer_twi_source: Nna mu dae a broni ka no 'wet dream'yɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔtow (mmadwo a wɔma ɛba) a wɔmpɛ a ɛba bere a wɔada, na mpɛn pii no nna ho dae ka ho. Ɛyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere fã a ɛyɛ daa na enhia sɛ wɔyɛ ho biribi. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo hɔ sɛ dae a ɛyɛ nsu de nea edidi so yi ba a: Ɛyaw Dadwen ne aniwu Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛyɛ soronko te sɛ mogya a ɛwɔ mmadwoa mu ne dwonsɔ a ɛyɛ yaw
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
