question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka sɛ daabi wɔ nna mu nkɔso a mempɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ DAABI, bere nyinaa! ɛmfa ho nea ɔrenya nkɔso a wɔmpɛ no. Ka DAABI bere a wufi ase te nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ wɔ tebea biara mu ɛmfa ho sɛnea nneɛma akɔ akyiri no. Ma emu nna hɔ na ka tẽẽ bere a woka sɛ DAABI no, enhia sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ nea enti a woka DAABI no mu. Sɛ woka sɛ ‘DAABI’ a, ɛsɛ sɛ wufi baabi a asiane no sii no ntɛm ara anaasɛ woteɛm hwehwɛ mmoa sɛ onipa no si n’anim a. Fa wo ho to wo dwensɔtwaa so: Sɛ wote nka sɛ biribi anyɛ yiye a, ebia ɛte saa. Nsuro sɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi tebea no ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a, wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, w’awofo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw sɛnea nsɛm a mehu wɔ Intanɛt so bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no mu nea broni ka no 'credentials' ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ Fibea no: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow, nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye di. Ɔkyerɛwfo no Adansedi: Hwɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no ahwehwɛde ne ne nimdeɛ wɔ asɛm no mu. Da a Wotintim: Hwɛ hu sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nea aba so foforo na ɛnyɛ nea ne bere atwam. hwɛ biom: Fa nsɛm a efi mmeae pii a wotumi de ho to so toto ho na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛne ne ho hyia. Bias Awareness: Hu animhwɛ a ebetumi aba wɔ nsɛm no mu na susuw adwene ahorow ho. Kenkan Nhwehwɛmu: Sɛ ɛyɛ ade anaa adwuma bi a, kenkan nsusuwii a efi afoforo a wɔde di dwuma hɔ. Twe woho firi nea broni ka no 'Clickbait': 'Clickbait' nsɛmti taa ma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa ma wohu, enti hwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware ansa na woagye adi. Nhomasua Wɛbsaet: Fa nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din te sɛ nea broni ka no ''UNESCO, Planned Parenthood, anaa akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛma wɔagye dɛmdifoɔ atom yie wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ (Workshops): To nsa frɛ afotufoɔ. Safe Spaces: Yɛ mmeammea a obiara tumi kɔ. Awareness Campaigns: Fa social media ne posters yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ. Policy Advocacy: Ko ma mmara a ɛka obiara ho. Di afahye ma dɛmdifoɔ (International Day). Ma wɔnka dwumadie biara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea nneɛma bo a ɛkɔ soro ne sika bo a ɛkɔ fam no kyerɛ ma mmabun a wɔ kora sika so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi abɔ wɔn sika a wɔde asie no bo ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bo a ɛkɔ soro ne sika bo a ɛkɔ fam betumi asɛe tumi a wɔde tɔ sika a wɔde sie bere kɔ so no, na aka tumi a mmabun a wɔde sie sika no betumi adu wɔn sikasɛm botae ahorow ho. Mmabun betumi abɔ wɔn sika a wɔde asie no bo ho ban denam: Sika a wɔde bɛto agyapade a ɛboro nneɛma bo a ɛkɔ soro so mu: Sika a wɔbɛpaw, te sɛ sikakorabea anaa adan ne afie, a abakɔsɛm mu no ɛma wonya mfaso a ɛboro nneɛma bo a ɛkɔ soro so. Sika a wɔde bɛto mu a wɔbɛkyekyɛ mu a broni ka no 'diversifying investments': Sika a wɔde bɛto mu a wɔbɛtrɛw mu wɔ agyapade ahorow mu de atew nkɛntɛnso a nneɛma bo a ɛkɔ soro nya wɔ sikakorabea no nyinaa so no so. Nneɛma bo a ɛkɔ soro a wɔbɛhwɛ so: Sikasɛm mu nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔbɛhwɛ so na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ sikakorabea ne sikasɛm mu nhyehyɛe ahorow mu sɛnea ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so hyɛ mmabun adwene mu yiyedi ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho nkuran na wɔasi adwenemyare a efi ase no ano?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu yiyedi ne ahoɔden a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu no ho hia na wɔasiw adwenemyare a efi ase no ano. Ebia akwan horow no bi ne abusua ne atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ a ɛboa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ahokokwaw a wɔde gyina ano ne atenka mu nhyehyɛe ho akwan horow a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, asetra mu su horow a ahoɔden wom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran (te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa, nna a ɛfata, ne aduan a ahoɔdennuru a wobedi), hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ama adwennwen so atew na wɔagye wɔn ahome, obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho ne sɛnea wotumi yɛ adwuma yiye, ne ɔhaw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ. Bio nso, adwenemyare ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛbu wɔn animtiaa no betumi ama mmabun tumi ahwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia na wɔatumi agyina adwenemyare ho nsɛnnennen ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ Intanɛt so ayayade anaa kɔmputa so ayayade a ɛfa nna anaa nna ho amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Social media platform ne wɛbsaet dodow no ara wɔ akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ wɔ ɔhaw anaa kɔmputa so ayayade ho. Fa amanneɛbɔ nnwinnade yi di dwuma de bɔ nsɛm a ɛfa Intanɛt so ayayade anaa kɔmputa so ayayade a ɛfa nna anaa nna ho ho amanneɛ. Fa nsɛm pii ma bere a woreyɛ amanneɛbɔ no, a screenshots anaa nsɛm a ɛhyɛ abufuw no ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'online learning' boa mmabun wɔ nwomasua mu?
answer_twi_source: Adesua pii wɔ hɔ. Sɛ wobesua wɔ wo berɛ mu. Nkabom ne afotu wɔ intanɛt so. Wo ne nkurɔfoɔ di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu sɛnea gyinaesi yi mu duru yɛ ma mmabun, na si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wosusuw akwan ahorow nyinaa ho yiye so dua.
answer_twi_source: Eyi yɛ paw a ɛho hia, na ɛfata sɛ wunya bere de susuw nneɛma ho yiye. Susuw nneɛma a wubetumi apaw nyinaa ho, na nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛpere wo ho asi gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn na mmra nsosuasuo kyerɛ fa peneeɛ ɛwɔ nna abusuabɔ ahohorow a aborɔfo ka no sɛ 'sexual relationships' ne kwan bɛn so na mmra ahokwan ahohoro nwomasua a yɛka no wɔ pɔtokasa mu sɛ 'legal rights education' boa mmabun te aseɛ na wɔ si wɔn ahokwan so dua wɔ tebea bi sei mu?
answer_twi_source: Peneeɛ wɔ nna abusuabɔ ahohorow ne sɛ wɔfiri wopɛ mu, y'abɔ wo amaneɛ, na ɔde ahosɛpɛ agye atum sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nna adwumadie. Seisieara ɛwɔ Ghana mu, mfeɛ a mmara ma nna ho kwan ne mfeɛ du nsia.  mmra ahokwan ahohoro nwomasua a yɛka no wɔ pɔtokasa mu sɛ 'legal rights education' boa mmabun te aseɛ na wɔ si wɔn ahokwan so dua wɔ saa tebea wɔ:  Ɛɛkyerɛ ɔmo wɔ sɛdeɛ peneeɛ ho hia ne nea mmra ɛbusa fa nna abusuabɔ. Ɛma nimdeɛ fa wɔn ahokwan sɛ wɔka sɛ daabi anaa wotwe wɔn peneeɛ san bere biara. Ɛma wɔn nyansa a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'skills' a wode hu na wɔ yi ano wɔ nhyɛsoɔ, ndaadaa, anaa nna akokobirisem tebea mu. mmra ahokwan ahohoro nwomasua a yɛka no wɔ pɔtokasa mu sɛ 'legal rights education' hyɛ mmabun den ma wɔ si wɔn hyeɛ ho dua, yɛ okyigyinafo ma wɔn ho, na wɔ hwehwɛ mmoa sɛ nna abusuabɔ bu wɔn ahokwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na nnamfo anaa adofoɔboafoɔ adesua kuo 'peer education' betumi boa HIV bammɔ ne ayeresa ho mpaemuka nimdie wɔ yenmmabun no tɛm?
answer_twi_source: Fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ ma. Boa ma nnipa nkabom nsɔre. Ma nnipa tumi yɛ gyinaesiɛ a wɔnim no yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nyamesom mu gyidi ne nneyɛe di wɔ su horow a wɔkyerɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nyamesom mu gyidie ne nneyɛe di dwuma titiriw wɔ su horow a wɔsakra wɔ mmabun SRH ho no mu. Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi anya adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nna a edi aware anim, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow ho so nkɛntɛnso, na ɛbɛka SRH ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya na aboa ma amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne animtiaabu a ɛfa saa nsɛmti yi ho aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya woho mmɔbɔ na wɔkyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina a broni ka no 'building resilience' ano wɔ animtiaabu a ebetumi aba no anim so dua.
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho a Ɛsom bo: Ɛnyɛ nea wopaw na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wosom bo. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wode wo yiyedi bedi kan na woasisi wo nipadua ho gyinae. Sɛnea Wobɛma Woatumi Agyina Ano a broni ka no 'Self Resilience': Fa w’adwene si wo ho a wobɛhwɛ so, fa nnipa a wɔboa wo ho twa wo ho hyia, na kae sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ abɛɛfo ntentan nkɛntɛnsofo susuw ho bere a wɔreyɛ na wɔrekyekyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH ho, a nsɛm a ɛfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, atenka, nkabom, ne pene a wɔpene so ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Pɛpɛɛpɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔfoɔ hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔkyɛ fa ASRH nsɛmti ho no yɛ nokware, egyina adanseɛ so, na nsɛm a ɛwɔ din pa na ɛfoa so. Atenka: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn adwene si sɛnea ASRH nsɛmti no yɛ nkate so na wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛma ayɛ nkate anaasɛ wɔbɛma ayɛ ade ketewaa bi ama wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu. Nnipa a wɔka ho: Ɛsɛ sɛ emu nsɛm no ka nnipa a wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛ, osuahu ahorow, ne adwene ahorow ho, na egyina hɔ ma nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne amammerɛ ahorow. Mpene: Ɛsɛ sɛ nkɛntɛnsofo nya pene fi ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wɔn nsɛm mu no hɔ, titiriw bere a wɔresusuw wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow ho anaasɛ wɔrekyɛ nsɛm a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ayɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow di akuw ahorow, a mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua ka ho, ahiade soronko ne wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi de nteteeɛ pɔtee ama wɔ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho de ahwɛ sɛ atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ asiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛdi akuo ahodoɔ ne wɔn a wɔato wɔn hintidua ahiadeɛ soronko ne wɔn haw ho dwuma. Dwumadi ahorow no betumi de kasa a ɛka obiara ho, ananmusifo ahorow ahorow wɔ nhomasua nneɛma mu, ne nkate a wɔde ma wɔ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua ho ka ho. Atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nso bɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɛ adwuma abom ama wɔanya nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔayɛ ama akuo pɔtee bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de ahye asi hɔ na mabu no anaa adi so wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka ahye a wode besi hɔ ho ne sɛ wubehu w’anohyeto "limits" ahorow, w’ahiade ahorow, ne w’akɔnnɔ ahorow, na woaka ho asɛm pefee akyerɛ wo hokafo. Bu w’ankasa ahye denam ahotoso a wode besi so dua na sɛ wobu so a, nea ebefi mu aba a wode bɛhyɛ mu den no so. Saa ara nso na bu wo hokafo no ahye denam tie a wubetie n’ahiade ne n’akɔnnɔ na woadi wɔn anohyeto ahorow ni no so. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma wɔate wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye ase na wɔabu wɔn ho wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de ASRH nsusuwii ahorow a wɔde bɛka wim nsakrae ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛbrɛ ase, akwan a wɔbɛfa so atew asiane so, ne nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no adi kan?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ a Wɔkamfo: Wɔbɛkamfo ASRH ho nsusuiɛ a wɔde bɛka wim nsakraeɛ ho nhyehyɛɛ, ɔman no mu nsakraeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so atew atoyerɛnkyɛm so wɔ aban ne amanaman ntam. Nnwumakuo ntam Nkɔmmɔdie: Apɔmuden, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ne nkɔsoɔ nnwumakuo ntam adwumayɛkuo a wɔbɛma ayɛ adwuma de ahwɛ sɛ wɔde ASRH bɛka wim nsakraeɛ a ɛtrɛ a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbrɛ aseɛ no ho. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mmabun ne mmabun ananmusifo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn adwene ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan no bɛda adi wɔ wim nsakrae ho nhyehyɛe ne nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi ne nyamesom akuw adi nkitaho wɔ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho so de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho ama?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ne nyamesom akuo adi nkitaho wɔ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho so de nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho ama denam nkɔmmɔdie, nteaseɛ, ne adwumayɛkuo a obuo wom a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ so. Wobetumi afi ase denam gye a wobegye hia a nyamesom mu gyidi ne nneyɛe ho hia wɔ ankorankoro asetra mu atom na wɔahu nyamesom mu adwene ahorow a egu ahorow wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no so. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔne nyamesom akannifo ne mpɔtam hɔfo nya ahotoso ne abusuabɔ denam wɔn haw ahorow a wobetie, adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa ehu a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wobedi ho dwuma, ne nsɛm a egyina adanse so a wɔde bɛma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu so no so. Wobetumi nso asiesie wɔn kwan no ma ada nyamesom akuw gyinapɛn ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow adi, bere a wodi nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, ne obu a wɔde ma ankorankoro hokwan ahorow nso akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛmma mmabun ntumi nnya awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ akwansideɛ bɛtumi asiw mmabun kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie ano, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Awofoɔ amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ anaa mmara a wɔpene so wɔ nnwuma bi ho, a ɛbɛtumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ. - anohyeto ahorow a ewo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, a ɛto mmabun kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware no ano hye. - a wonnya sika anaase sika a wode bɛyɛ awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun wɔ mpɔtam a wɔnnya mmoa yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɔsom anaa amammerɛ mu nsusuwii bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono ɔsom ne amammerɛ ahorow adwene wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wote w’ankasa wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ase bere a wubu afoforo de no. Nyamesom anaa amammerɛ mu nsusuwii ahorow bi betumi ayɛ: - ɔsom ahorow bi betumi anya nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa akwankyerɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ho a ɛka ankorankoro gyidi ne nneyɛe. - Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne atetesɛm betumi akyerɛ su a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho, na aka akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya ne nea wogye tom. - a ehia se wo ne ankorankoro a wogye wo di, te se nyamesom anaa mpɔtam akannifoɔ bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛda adi pefee, de ahwehwɛ sɛdeɛ ɔsom anaa amammerɛ mu gyidie ne gyinaesie a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho no di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no akasa afa brayɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo bɛkasa afa brayɛ ho a, ebetumi ate nka sɛ ɛyɛ hu, nanso kae sɛ wodwen wo yiyedi ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa. Afotu bi a wode befi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase ni: Paw Bere a Ɛfata: Hwehwɛ bere a ɛyɛ komm, kokoam a wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ bere a obiara ho adwo no na ɔmfa ahopere nkasa no. Fa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Di Dwuma: Sɛ wunnim sɛnea wubefi ase a, wubetumi de nhomasua nneɛma anaa nsɛm adi dwuma sɛ nea wubefi ase. Ebia wobɛka sɛ, "Mekenkan brayɛ ho asɛm, na mewɔ nsɛmmisa bi." Di Nokware: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubegye atom sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ. Wubetumi aka sɛ, "Mete nka sɛ ɛyɛ fɛre kakra sɛ mɛka eyi ho asɛm, nanso mepɛ sɛ misua pii." Bisa Kokoam Nsɛm: Sɛ wopɛ a, wubetumi abisa kokoam nsɛm bi bere a ɛfa wo bra a wobɛhwɛ so ho no. Ebia wobɛka sɛ, "M'ankasa mɛpɛ sɛ midi me nna ho dwuma, nanso ebia mihia wo mmoa na ama manya nnuru a wɔde ma brayɛ."
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneyɛ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem berɛ a wɔredi media mu dwuma, wɔrebɔ, na wɔrekyekyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa pene mpeneso, kokoam nsɛm, obuo, ne tema ho no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun susuw abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ pene, kokoam nsɛm, obuo, ne tema ho berɛ a wɔredi mdia mu dwuma, wɔrebɔ, na wɔrekyekyɛ no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ pene a ɛda adi pefee ansa na wɔde afoforo ho nsɛm, mfonini, anaa nsɛm a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so akyɛ na wɔkyerɛ obuo ma ankorankoro kokoam hokwan ahorow. Sɛ mmabun reyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ na wɔrekyekyɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn adwene si nkɛntɛnso a wɔn nkrasɛm betumi anya wɔ afoforo so no so na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nkitahodi pa, ɛfa obiara ho, na obuo wom ho nkuran. Tema ho hia wɔ afoforo a wɔda wɔn adwene ne osuahu ahorow adi na wɔbɛkwati adwen bɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na mpɔtam mpanyimfoɔ ne abɔfoɔ anaa akasamafoɔ di de boa mmabun awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ, ɛde hwehwɛ nsakraeɛ, na wɔma nkurɔfoɔ te mu ase?
answer_twi_source: Wɔgyina mu yɛ adwuma kɛseɛ de boa mmabun. Wɔtumi yɛ nhyiamu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ de ma nimdeɛ pa, na wɔko tia adwene bɔne. Wɔsan tumi hwehwɛ mmara nsesaeɛ a ɛbɛma mmabun anya nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata wɔ sukuu, na wɔanya ayaresa a ɛfata na wɔtumi ku nyinyimu nso. Sɛ wɔma mmabun nne so a, ɛma nsakraeɛ pa ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsusuanso bɛn na mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia wɔ mpɔtam a wɔyɛ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom a ɛyɛ katee mu, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn anya mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm taa hyia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne pow esiane amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow a akɔ soro nti. Ebia wɔbɛpere sɛ wobegye wɔn atom afi abusua, atipɛnfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ, na ɛde atenka a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho ne adwenemyare ho haw aba. Mmoa ne si a wobesi so dua a wobenya no ho hia yiye. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wo ne akuw a wɔboa no bɛbɔ, ahwehwɛ afotu afi ayaresa ho animdefo hɔ, na woakyekye abusua a wɔapaw a nnamfo ne ayɔnkofo a wɔboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu asotwen ahorow a ɛwɔ nhyɛso mu wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu, na hokwan bɛn na mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpow nkɔso a wɔmpɛ, na sɛ wonya nhyɛso a wɔhwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto wɔn so?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so asotwen a ɛwɔ nhyɛso mu wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu no gu ahorow gyina tumidi so, nanso mpɛn pii no, ankorankoro wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔpow nkɔso a wɔmpɛ na sɛ wonya nhyɛso a wɔhwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto wɔn so. Mmara ahorow a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ɔhaw, ne pene a wɔpene so ho no gu ahorow wɔ ɔman ne ɔman biara mu, nanso mmabun wɔ hokwan wɔ mmara kwan so sɛ wodi wɔn ho so na wodi nipadua mu nokware. Wobetumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa mmarahyɛfo hɔ, na wɔanya nneɛma te sɛ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo anaa mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow de anya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anammɔn a ɛwɔ microfinance, a nea ɛka ho ne eligibilty criteria, ɛma obi fata sika mmoa application nhyehyeɛ, boseabɔ ho nhyehyɛe, 'repayment schedules' (nhyehyɛe a wɔde tua sika), ne asiane ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Eligibility criteria: Mfeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ, mmara kwan so gyinabea, tenabea, ne boseabɔ ho gyinapɛn a sikasɛm nketewa a ɔde ma no de asi hɔ no a wobedi ho dwuma. Akwan a wɔfa so de akwammisa krataa: Nkrataa a wɔhwehwɛ, te sɛ adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi hu obi, adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, sikasɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛbɔ ho ban, sɛ ɛfata a, denam akwan a wɔakyerɛ so de bɛmena. Bosea ho nsɛm: Boseaa no dodow, bere a wɔde betua, mfɛntom, nneɛma a wɔde bɛbɔ bosea a wɔhwehwɛ, ne nsɛm afoforo a egyina nea ɔde bosea no ahiade ne nea obetumi ayɛ so ho nkitahodi. Mfaso: Ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ boseabɔ ho ntease, a mfɛntom a wɔbɔ no din ne nea etu mpɔn, sika a wɔbɔ, ne sika a wɔbɔ wɔ bosea nketewa ho ka ho. Nhyehyɛe a wɔde tua ka: Wɔpene so wɔ sika a wɔde tua no fã bi, mpɛn dodow a wɔde tua (sɛ nhwɛso no, dapɛn biara, ɔsram biara), adom bere, ne asotwe a wɔde ma wɔ sika a wotua akyi no ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobetua bosea no wɔ bere ano. Asiane ho dwumadie: Asiane ahodoɔ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, te sɛ boseabɔ, gua, adwumayɛ, ne mmara mu asiane, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so abrɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛtumi ahwere no ase na wɔahwɛ sɛ sikasɛm nketewa adwumayɛ bɛkɔ so atra hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ kokoam HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi saa hokwan ahorow yi so dua bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nnwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyɛ HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa wɔ kokoam, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔdi wɔn kokoam nsɛm so, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔda wɔn HIV tebea adi a wɔmpene so. Wobetumi asi saa hokwan ahorow yi so dua denam nnwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su mu, nim wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ kokoam a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no tu mpɔn dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ano Tu mpɔn: Ɛsono sɛnea akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no tu mpɔn. Akwan bi te sɛ LARC ahorow no tu mpɔn kɛse wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano mu, bere a afoforo te sɛ kɔndɔm no tumi yɛ adwuma a ɛba fam nanso ɛda so ara yɛ kɛse. Ɛho hia sɛ wode nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma yiye na ɛkɔ so daa na ama woanya hokwan a eye sen biara a wode besiw nyinsɛn ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ mede akwan abien no nyinaa a ɛfa ahobammɔ abien ho redi dwuma yie na ɛkɔ so daa?
answer_twi_source: Afotu bi a ɛbɛma woatumi de adi dwuma daa na ɛteɛ ni: Kenkan na di akwankyerɛ ahorow akyi yiye: Ɔkwan biara wɔ akwankyerɛ pɔtee a wode bedi dwuma. Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma: Ansa na wo ne wo hokafo de bedi dwuma no, sua sɛnea wode bɛhyɛ na woayi no yiye. Wo ne w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nkasa: Munsusuw nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen biara a wowɔ wɔ ɔkwan abien no mu biara a wode bedi dwuma ho. Fa akwan a wɔfa so de sie no to wo nsam: Sɛ wowɔ kɔndɔm foforo a wubetumi anya ntɛm a, ebetumi aboa ma woahwɛ ahu sɛ wode bedi dwuma bere nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfe ahe na mmabun betumi anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmara kwan so a awofo mpene so?
answer_twi_source: Mfe a mmabun betumi anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmara kwan so a awofo mpene so no gu ahorow a egyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Wɔ mmeae bi no, ebia mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nyinsɛnyiguo ho mmoa a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu bere a wadi mfe pɔtee bi a mmara kyerɛ no. Nanso, wɔ mmeae afoforo no, ebia ɛho behia sɛ awofo pene so anaa wɔka mfe a wadi ansa. Ɛho hia sɛ wote mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam pɔtee a ɛfa mmabun kwan a wɔfa so nya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma pɔtee bi anaa mmoa akuo bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun wɔ apɔwmuden asoɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmabun apɔwmuden ho mmeae pii de nneɛma foforo ne mmoa ma mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne: Wɔde wɔn kɔ adwenem apɔwmuden ho afotu anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wohyia atenka mu haw anaa adwene mu nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan anaa nsɛm afoforo ho. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuo anaa nhomasua nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene sii nsɛmti te sɛ nna mu akwahosan, abusuabɔ pa, ne wɔn ho a wɔhwɛ so. Nsɛm a wɔde ma, nhoma, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛfa STI/HIV ano aduru, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a wobenya, te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkorɔfo, anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde mmoa ne nsɛm ma mmabun wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne yiedie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛyɛ 'normal' sɛ mennim me bɔbea 'sexuality' yie anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛyɛ etumi ba ne saa. Ɛyɛ bere a yɛrenyin na yɛresua yɛn ho. Nhyɛ wo ho. Gye bere.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ 'physical activity' ho hia wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ho hia kɛse wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu esiane nneɛma pii nti: Onyin a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Ɛboa ma nnompe, ntini, ne akwaa nyin yiye na enyin yiye. Mu duru a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Ɛboa ma obi mu duru ne nipadua no mu duru a ɛfata kɔ so tra hɔ. Nnompe Akwahosan: Nneɛma a wɔde soa mu duru te sɛ mmirikatu, ahuruhuruw, ne agumadi betumi ahyɛ nnompe mu den, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya nnompe mu yare akyiri yi wɔ nkwa nna mu no so. Adwene mu Akwahosan: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ma 'endorphins', nnuru a "ɛte nka sɛ wo ho ye" a ebetumi ama adwene atu mpɔn na ɛtew adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw so. Koma Akwahosan: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔyɛ no daa no hyɛ koma no den na ɛma koma ne ntini no yɛ adwuma yiye. Nna a Ɛtu Mpɔn: Ebetumi ama obi ada yiye, na ɛno ho hia wɔ saa bere a obi nyin yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anammɔn a wɔfa so hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu wɔ adwene a ɛne sɛ obekum ne ho anaa adwenemyare ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ ne ayaresa ho animdefo, adwene ho nimdefo, anaa adwenemyare ho animdefo akɔhwɛ, na wɔasusuw ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a Wɔbɛfa Ahwehwɛ Mmoa a Ɛfa Mmoa a Wɔyɛ no Ho: Sɛ́ wobɛhwehwɛ adwumayɛfo mmoa wɔ adwene a ɛne sɛ obekum ne ho anaa adwenemyare ho no hwehwɛ anammɔn pii, a nea ɛka ho ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ ne ayaresa ho animdefo, adwene ne nneyɛe ho animdefo, anaa adwenemyare ho animdefo akɔhwɛ, ayaresa a wobetumi asusuw ho, ne ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de adi ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma. Mmabun betumi akɔ mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ adwumayɛfo mmoa a wobenya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn asusuw ahotoso a ɛwɔ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso a ɛwɔ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ɔkyerɛwfo anaa nnwumakuo a ɛwɔ emu nsɛm no akyi ne wɔn nimdeɛ wɔ adwuma no mu no so. Nhwehwɛmu a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu anaa nnwumakuo ahorow a agye din a wɔafa aka sɛ fibea ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Nsɛm a wɔde fi mmeae pii a wotumi de ho to so so hwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na ɛne ne ho hyia. Ahwɛyiye a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ fibea ahorow a ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee anaasɛ ɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi ho nkuran a wonni mmoa a egyina adanse so ho. Wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔde hwehwɛ nokwasɛm ahorow mu a wɔde bedi dwuma anaasɛ abenfo a wobebisabisa wɔn nsɛm de ahwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware bere a w’adwene mu yɛ wo naa no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi de hokwan ahorow so aka nna ne awoɔ apɔwden ho adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nwomasua asoɛeɛ bɛtumi de ɔkwan a egyina hokwan so ahyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu denam: Nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm te sɛ nidi, pɛyɛ, nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, ne kyɛfa a wɔde bɛhyɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no mu nsɛm, akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ, ne adesua nneɛma mu. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a ɛfata mfe a obi adi a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a wɔde bɛma, a nsɛmti te sɛ mpeneso, nyinsɛn anosie, STIs, nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw, ne mmarima ne mmaa ntam nsonsonoe ka ho. Nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa tumi, hokwan, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran sɛnea ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no. Adesua tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa a asuafoɔ nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔsom boɔ, wɔbu wɔn, na wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔbɛbisa nsɛm, ada wɔn adwene adi, na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa berɛ a ɛhia. Asuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ wɔn ankasa adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen, hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ wɔn hokwan, asɛdeɛ, ne wɔn apɛdeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ahyɛ obi a ɔnim mfididwuma ho nyansa (digital citizenship)  nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ: Wo ankasa da suban pa adi wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so. Dawuro: Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu. Mmebun Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo nnamfo fa kɔkoam ne adeɛ  bi a wo frɛ no wo borɔfo kasa mu sɛ 'cyberbullying'  ho. Nneyɛɛ Pa: Kasa yie kyerɛ afoforo. Nhyehyɛeɛ: Di abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn mmara so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɔkwan biako di nkogu wɔ nna mu (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm bubu) a, dɛn na ɛsɛsɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mma wo ho nnpopo! Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ni: Kɔndɔm bubu anaa ɛhwe ase: Sɛ kɔndɔm bubu anaa ɛhwe ase bere a wo ne obi reda a, gyae nna ntɛm ara. Twe wo ho na fa kɔndɔm foforo di dwuma de wie. Bu nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm (EC) sɛ nea wode bɛboa wo sɛ nyinsɛn ho asɛm haw wo a. Ɔkwan foforo di nkogu: Sɛ ɔkwan foforo di nkogu (te sɛ awo ano aduru a ɛyera) a, wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa ahwɛyiye foforo anaa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu ayayade ne basabasayɛ ahorow ɛwɔ hɔ (sɛ nhwɛso no, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ayayade, ayɔnkofa mu basabasayɛ)?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu ayayade ne basabasayɛ ka nneyɛe ahorow ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nna mu ɔbrasɛe: Nna mu nkitahodi anaa nneyɛe biara a wɔmpɛ, a mmonnaato ka ho. Ɔhaw: Nkɔso a wɔmpɛ, nsɛm a wɔka, anaa nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ho. Abusuabɔ mu basabasayɛ (Dating violence): Ayayade anaa basabasayɛ wɔ ɔdɔ anaa dating abusuabɔ mu, a honam fam, nkate fam, anaa nna mu ayayade ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwenem apɔwmuden mmoa ho bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so a wobetumi anya wɔ kasa ahorow pii mu anaasɛ wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ pɔtee bi?
answer_twi_source: Aane, adwenem apɔwmuden ho mmoa bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so a wobetumi anya wɔ kasa ahorow pii mu anaasɛ wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ pɔtee bi. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ayɛ: Website ne App ahorow a wɔka kasa pii a ɛde adwene apɔwmuden ho nsɛm, mmoa dwumadie, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ kasa foforɔ a ɛnyɛ Borɔfo kasa mu ma de som nnipa ahodoɔ yie. Nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a adwenem apɔwmuden akuo, mpɔtam akuo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ayɛ de adi amammerɛ mpɔtam ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ soronko ho dwuma. Intanɛt so nhyiamu, mmoa akuo, ne mmoa nhama ;helplines a atuhoamafoɔ a wɔka kasa mmienu anaa amammerɛ ahodoɔ a wɔbɛtumi de mmoa ama wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu na wɔyɛ adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne wet dream na so ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Wet dream yɛ mmadwoa (nsu a mmadwoa wom) a ɛba bere a wɔada. Ɛyɛ mmarima mmabunbere fã a ɛfata na ɛba bere a nipadua no yɛ mmadwoa a ɛsɛ sɛ woyi fi mu no. Dae a ɛyɛ nsu nyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ aniwu!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo ntentan nneɛma a wɔyɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakyɛ wɔn adwene, nsɛm, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom na ɛyɛ nokware so?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan mu adwumadie ma mmabun tumi ma wɔkyɛ wɔn adwene, nsɛm, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mmabunu nna ne awo akwaahosan ho wɔ nokware ne ntease mu. Ɛma wonya atenaeɛ a wɔbɛte nne a wɔayi wɔn ato nkyɛn, ɛhyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ho nkuran, na ɛkasa tia animtiaabuo ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa mmabunu nna ne awo akwahosan nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma minnya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, te sɛ ɛka, akwantu, anaa animtiaabu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhyia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wunnya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a, anammɔn ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wubetumi atu: Hwehwɛ akwan a ne bo nyɛ den mu: Hwehwɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee a wobetumi anya denam mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, abusua nhyehyɛe ayaresabea ahorow, anaa aban nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Fa Insurance Coverage Di Dwuma: Hwɛ sɛ w’akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe no tua nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano na hwehwɛ akwan a ne bo nyɛ den a wo insurance no tua ho ka. Akwantuo a Wɔde Kɔ: Fa ɔmanfoɔ kar, kar a wɔde fa nnipa, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akwantuo nhyehyɛeɛ di dwuma de kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea anaa ayaresabea a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma. Hwehwɛ Ahintasɛm Dwumadie: Sɛ animtiaabu yɛ ade a ɛhaw adwene a, hwehwɛ awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam wɔ mmabun ne mmabun adamfofa dwumadie a ɛnam mmeaeɛ a ɛntena hɔ, nkɔmmɔdie anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu a ɛde kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm di kan. Fa Wo nsa ka Mmoa: Wo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, anaa nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn na wɔadi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no nkasa. Ntrɛwmu te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ma wonya nhumu a mfaso wɔ so wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi asua piii afa amammerɛ mu nkate ne obu ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma te sɛ: Nhomasua wɛbsaet, intanɛt so adesua, ne nkitahodi module ahorow a ɛma nsɛm ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ mu nkate ne obu ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu. Nhoma, nsɛm, ne 'multimedia' nneɛma a ɛhwehwɛ amammerɛ mu adwene ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, anaa akuw a wɔboa a wɔde atipɛnfo afotu, hokwan ahorow a wɔde gyina nkurɔfo akyi, ne nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ma. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, adwumayɛbea, anaa amammerɛ mu nsakraeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma amammerɛ ahodoɔ ntam nteaseɛ, nkɔmmɔdie, ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ mbere tenten mu sɛ wɔde nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho bɛka mmaabun asetena ho, te sɛ wɔn ho a wohu, tema, nkitahodi, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne gyinaesi tumi a ɛkɔ anim, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de saa nimdeɛ yi adi dwuma wɔ wɔn ankasa ne adwumayɛ asetra afã horow mu wɔ  mmaabunbere akyi
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛtena hɔ kyɛ a ɛwɔ nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho a wɔde bɛka mmabun asetena ho no trɛw kɔ akyiri sen mmerantebere ne mmabaabere na ɛkɔ mpanyin afe so. Ɛdenam nneyɛe a ɛma mmabun nya ahokokwaw a ɛsom bo a ɛho hia ma wɔn ankasa ne wɔn adwuma mu nkonimdi. Saa nimdeɛ yi ma mmabun tumi di asetra mu nsɛm a ɛyɛ den so, di ntawntawdi ho dwuma yiye, na wotumi paw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn asetra mu nneɛma ahorow mu, a abusuabɔ, nhomasua, adwuma, ne apomoden ka ho. Bio nso, sɛ obi nya su a ɛne sɛ obesusuw ne ho na wahwɛ ne ho a, ɛboa ma wotumi gyina tebea horow ano wɔ wɔn nkwa nna nyinaa mu, wonya yiyedi, na wonya abotɔyam, na ɛma ankorankoro tumi yɛ nsakrae wɔ ɔhaw mu na wodi yiye wɔ wiase a ɛsakra bere nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma pɔtee anaa su pɔtee bɛn na ɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea bi "yɛ nea ɛfata mmabun"?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pɔtee anaa su ahorow a ɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea bi yɛ nea ɛfata mmabun no bi ne: Ahintasɛm: Hwɛ sɛ wodi mmabun kokoam nsɛm so, na wɔde wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm sie. Sɛnea Wotumi Kɔ hɔ: Hyɛ berɛ pa, mmeae, ne nhyehyɛe a ɛfata a wɔde bɛma na ama mmabun bere nhyehyɛe a adagyew nnim ne kar ho ahiade ahorow ahyia. Tebea a wɔma akwaaba: Tebea a ahotɔ ne atemmu nnim a wɔbɛma obiara ka ho, agye akwaaba, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie ho nhyehyɛɛ, wɔde ma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne ne wɔn adwene na wɔabu no sɛ ɛsom boɔ. Nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri: Nnwuma ahorow a ɛfa mmabun ahiade ahorow ho a wɔde ma, a nna ne awo akwahosan, adwenemyare, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano ka ho. Adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne adwumayɛfo a wonim mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm, wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nkitahodi a wɔne mmerante ne mmabaa di nkitaho mu, na wɔde wɔn ho ama ɔhwɛ a ɛfa mmabun ho a wɔde wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnuru ahorow bɛn na wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma mmabun, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛdi adwuma de siw nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwan a Wɔfa so Siw Akwanside: te sɛ kɔndɔm ne diaphragms, a nipadua mu siw mmadwoa kwan sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu. Honam mu nkwammoa Akwan: te sɛ awo ano aduru, aduru a wɔde siw awo ano, nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua no mu, nea wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  hormone IUD ahorow, a honam mu nkwammoa ahorow a esiw nyinsɛn ano anaasɛ ɛma awotwaa mu nsu a ɛyɛ den ma mmadwoa ntumi nkɔ nkesua no mu wom. Mfiri a Wɔde Fa Awotwaa Mu (IUD): mfiri nketewa a ɛte sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ T-shaped devices a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa no mu, a ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛyɛ honam mu  nkwammoa anaasɛ ɛnyɛ honam mu nkwammoa na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nyinsɛn anaa ɛmo a wɔde ahyɛ mu a esiw ano so. Nyinsɛn a Wosiw Ano Ntɛmntɛm: wɔsan frɛ no anɔpa-akyi aduru, a wotumi nom bere a wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban a wɔammɔ wɔn ho ban akyi de asiw nyinsɛn ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmaabun betumi afa so akyekye nkabom, apam, ne fekubɔ de ahyɛ wɔn sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nsɛm a wɔka de hyɛ mu den?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyekye nkabom denam ahyehyɛde afoforo a mmabun di anim, mpɔtam hɔ akuo, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi a wɔwɔ botae ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛte saa ara a wɔbɛkɔ so. Sɛ wɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔatew wɔn ho a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso ayɛ apam a, ebetumi ama wɔanya nneɛma foforo, nimdeɛ, ne ahotoso wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban no mu. Nkitahodi a wɔne mpɔtamu hɔ akannifo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne nnwumayɛfo bɛyɛ no betumi aboa ma mmabun nne ayɛ kɛse na ama nkɛntɛnso a wɔn nsɛm a wɔka de kyerɛ no nya wɔ sikasɛm mu tumidi ho nsɛm so no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" di wɔ sɛnea yetumi de yɛn ho hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu na yenya so mfaso no mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan "mental health" nya tumi a yɛtumi de yɛn ho hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu na yenya so mfaso no so nkɛntɛnso. Adwene mu akwahosan pa boa adwene a wobue, anigye a ɔwɔ sɛ obehu nneɛma pii, ne ɔpɛ a ɔwɔ sɛ obesua ade, bere a adwenemyare a enye te sɛ dadwen anaa adwenemhaw betumi asiw ayɔnkofa kwan esiane aniwu, aniwu, anaa anigye a wonni nti. Adwene mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma ne adesua tebea a ɛboa a wɔde bɛma no ho hia ma nhomasua a etu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ahyehyɛde mu nsakrae, ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa nhyehyɛe mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan, asetra mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne nhyehyɛe mu basabasayɛ a ɛka mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ne yiyedi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe mu Nsakrae ne Asoɛe mu Nsakrae a Wɔkamfo: Mmabun betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ahyehyɛde mu nsakrae, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a ɛfa nhyehyɛe mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan, asetra mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne nhyehyɛe mu basabasayɛ a ɛka mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ne yiyedi ho dwuma. Ɛdenam nhumu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano, ne wɔn nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan so no, mmabun betumi apia nsakrae a ɛbɛma asetra mu atɛntrenee anya nkɔso na ama ASRH aba no atu mpɔn ama obiara. nanso, ɔman mmara no mma ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa afotu nhyiam ahorow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya denam sukuu mu ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun a wodi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma no so?
answer_twi_source: Aane, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu a egyina sukuu so no de atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa afotu nhyiam ahorow a ebetumi adi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma ma. Saa nhyiam ahorow yi ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow, anya mmoa, na wɔasua akwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ako ama SRH mmara nsesaeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nkabom ne fekubɔ ahorow (coalitions). Yɛ nhwehwɛmu (research) de hwehwɛ data (nsɛm). Ka abasɛm (storytelling) de kyerɛ sɛdeɛ asɛm no te. Hyehyɛ mpɔtamfoɔ (mobilizing grassroots). Fa media di dwuma. Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ (lobbying). Hwɛ sɛ wɔredi wɔn bɔhyɛ so (monitoring).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi akasa afa nna ne awoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛgye obiara tom na ɛhyɛ yɛn nyinaa nsonsonoeɛ animuonyam ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo ne awofo nkasa: Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔmmoa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu. Kyɛ nneɛma: Fa wɛbsaet ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna a ahoɔden wom ne nneɛma ahorow ho nkuran ma wɔn. Fi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase: Wo ne w’atipɛnfo nka hia a ɛho hia sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho no ho asɛm. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa: Fa ntoboa anaa fa wo ho ma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna mu apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛtumi afa so adi nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ebetumi ayɛ akyiwadeɛ wɔ amammerɛ bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Fi ase ne nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den: Fa nnamfofa pa, nkitahodiɛ, anaa sɛnea nipadua teɛ ho nkɔmmɔbɔ hyɛ nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ase. Fa w'adwene si deɛ obiara pɛ so: Hwehwɛ nna pa afa a obiara betumi apene so, te sɛ obu ne nkitahodiɛ. Fa nsɛmmisa a emu da hɔ di dwuma: Bisa wɔn adwene na hwɛ sɛnea wɔte nka. Ma pɛ a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhunu nneɛma nyɛ ade a ɛyɛ: Ma wɔnhunu sɛ nna ho nsɛmmisa yɛ ade a ɛtaa si. Bu ahyeɛ: Sɛ obi nte nka yiye a, sesa nkɔmmɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn atorɔ anaa anansesɛm ahorow na wɔtaa nya wɔ dɛmdi ho abakɔsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔkasa ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: Mmofra a w'adi dɛm ho yɛ na: Nokwasɛm: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm abu so, na nnipa pii behyia dɛmdi bi wɔ wɔn asetra mu bere bi. Atosɛm: Nnipa a W'adi  dɛm Ntumi Nnya Ahofadi: Nokwasɛm: Nnipa pii a wɔadi dɛm no bɔ wɔn ho so, na wɔma wɔn asetra a abotɔyam wɔ hɔ a wɔde mmoa ne dabere a ɛfata ma. Atosɛm: Mmofra a W'adi M dɛm Nkutoo Ho Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Nokwasɛm: Obiara a ogye di sɛ pɛyɛ ne nnipa hokwan ahorow betumi aboa nsɛm a wɔka de kyerɛ no. Aman a wɔyɛ apam no di dwuma titiriw wɔ kuw no mu. Atosɛm: Mmofra a W'adi M dɛm Kyerɛkyerɛ Obi Nipasu Nyinaa Mu: Nokwasɛm: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nneɛma ahorow a wɔn ani gye ho, wɔn talente, ne wɔn nipasu ahorow a ɛboro wɔn dɛmdi so. Atosɛm: Nkɔso a Wɔayɛ wɔ Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ Apopa Akwanside Nyinaa: Nokwasɛm: Bere a wɔanya nkɔso kɛse no, akwanside ne nsɛnnennen pii da so ara wɔ hɔ, na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔkɔ so kamfo na wɔyɛ ho biribi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow de adi mmabun akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wɔn ho nni asɛm, te sɛ mmeawa, aguanfo, atubrafo, mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadi dɛm, anaa mma ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro ahiade ne mmerɛwyɛ pɔtee ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asiesie asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ama akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua denam: Fata a wɔka ho a wobegye atom na wɔde wɔn ani asi akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adu nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ ho, a mmeawa, aguanfo, atubrafo, mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadi dɛm, ne mma ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro ka ho. Nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata nsɛm a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛma, te sɛ kasa mu mmoa, nneɛma a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛbɔ, de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛtumi anya bi na wɔagye atom. Nneɛma titiriw a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, te sɛ adwene ne asetra mu mmoa, mmara mu mmoa, ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wɔde bɛma de adi mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua ahiade pɔtee ne wɔn mmerɛwyɛ ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ asetena mu nimdeɛ a mmabun benya so, te sɛ wɔn adwuma a wobetumi anya, sika a wobetumi anya, adwuma mu abotɔyam, asetena mu nkɔso, ne sikasɛm mu ahodwiriw a wotumi gyina ano no so?
answer_twi_source: Asetena ho nimdeɛ a wobenya no de mfaso pii ba mmabun so: Adwuma a wobetumi anya a ɛkɔ soro: Ahokokwaw ne ahwehwɛde ahorow a wɔma ɛkɔ anim no ma mmabun anidaso a ɛne sɛ wobenya adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, ama wɔn adwuma anya nkɔso, na wɔanya nnwuma a akatua kɛse wom no tu mpɔn. Sika a wobetumi anya: Ahokokwaw a wobetumi atɔn ne nimdeɛ titiriw a wobenya no ma mmabun tumi hyɛ akatua a ɛkɔ soro, wodi adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe pa ho nkitaho, na wodi adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow akyi, na ɛma wonya sika a wobetumi anya ne sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ a ɛkɔ soro. Adwuma mu abotɔyam: Sɛ wɔde ahokokwaw ne anigyede hyia adwuma akwan a ɛne ankorankoro gyinapɛn, apɛde, ne n’anigyede hyia a, ɛma adwuma mu abotɔyam, nkannyan, ne adwuma mu kyɛfa a wonya no yɛ kɛse, na ɛma yiyedi ne abotɔyam nyinaa nya nkɔso. Asetra mu nkɔso: Sɛ wɔde ahokokwaw, nhomasua, ne ntetee ma mmabun tumi a, ɛma wotumi tu kɔ asetra mu, na ɛma wotumi tu kɔ soro wɔ asetra mu sikasɛm mu, ɛma ohia kyinhyia no gyae, na ɛtew nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ hokwan ahorow a wobenya mu. Sikasɛm mu ahodwiriw a wotumi gyina ano: Ahokokwaw ne sika a wonya fi mu a egu ahorow no ma wotumi gyina sikasɛm mu ahokyere, adwuma a wɔhwere, anaa gua so basabasayɛ ano, na ɛma mmabun tumi yɛ nsakrae, wɔn ho tɔ wɔn, na wodi yiye wɔ sikasɛm tebea a ɛresakra mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa atutra a ɛfa aman horow so ho no ka mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, HIV a wosiw ano, ne ɛnanom apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa atutra a ɛfa ahye so ho no betumi aka mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe. Atubrafo ho nhyehyɛe a anohyeto wom betumi asiw atubrafo a wobetumi anya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ano, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, HIV a wosiw ano, ne ɛnanom apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe. Suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛpam wɔn anaasɛ wɔde wɔn bɛto afiase no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ SRH nnwuma a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na metumi anya de asua pii afa abusuabɔ pa ho nsakyereɛ? (adesua intanɛt so, nhyiamu ahodoɔ)
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet (Love is Respect, Gottman Institute). Nhyiamu (sukuu/mpɔtam). GHS-YMK app.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so ma asuafo tumi gyina tebea horow ano, ne nkate fam yiedi ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow hyɛ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne nkate mu yiyedi ho nkuran wɔ asuafo mu denam: Asetra mu nkate mu adesua 'SEL' nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ ahokokwaw te sɛ ankasa ho a wohu, ankasa ho a wodi, asetra mu nimdeɛ, abusuabɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne gyinaesi a ɛyɛ asɛyɛde. Suban pa boa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛboa asetra, nkate mu nhyehyɛe, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ mu den. Hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ adesua akyi, akannifo nkɔso, ne mpɔtam hɔ som a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho mu ahotoso, obu ama wɔn ho, ne atirimpɔw ho adwene. Atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ ne asuafoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ a ɛma nkitahodiɛ, tema, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ asuafoɔ mu. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛhyɛ yiyedi a edi mũ ne asetra kwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔpaw ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbu m’ankasa amammerɛ ne me gyidie na wɔbu no sɛ ɛsom boɔ wɔ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan 'SRH' ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: W'ankasa nya fapem : Yɛ pintinn wɔ wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a wobɛda no adi wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu no mu. Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo wo amammerɛ ne wo gyidi ahorow ho ade, na boa wɔn ma wɔnte baabi a wufi no ase. Tie Afoforo: Fi obu mu tie adwene a egu ahorow, sɛ ɛsono w’ankasa de mpo a. Hwehwɛ Nea Wogyina So: Hwehwɛ gyinapɛn anaa botae ahorow a ɛne ne ho hyia a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a ebetumi asiw amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe ano. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wonni obu mma w’amammerɛ anaa wo gyidi ahorow a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wugye di no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So intanɛt so nsɛm anaa nneɛma a wɔde boa a awofoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun so bɛtumi anya de aboa mmabun adwene mu ahoɔden ne wɔn yiedie wɔ hɔ anaa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, intanɛt so nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a nea ɛka ho ne: Wɛbsaet ne blog ahorow a ɛde nsɛm, akwankyerɛ, ne wɛbsaet dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa awofoyɛ ho akwan, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne afotu a wɔde bɛboa mmabun adwenemyare ho ma. Intanɛt so mpɔtam ne nhyiamu a awofoɔ bɛtumi ne ahwɛfoɔ foforɔ adi nkitaho, akyɛ suahunu, na wɔahwehwɛ afotuo wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛnnennen a wɔbɛfa so. Awofoyɛ app ahorow a ɛma nnwinnade a wɔde bedi mmabun nneyɛe akyi na wɔadi ho dwuma, ahyɛ awofo ne mmofra nkitahodi pa ho nkuran, na wɔanya nneɛma a ɛfa adwenemyare ho nsɛmti ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahyia abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obu wom no ma ɛne mmabun a wofi amammerɛ, wɔn nipasu, ne mpɔtam ahorow ahiade ne osuahu ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asiesie abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obu wom ma ɛne mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow, wɔn nipasu, ne mpɔtam ahorow mu ahiade ne osuahu ahorow adi denam nsɛm a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔde bɛka ho, kasa mu kwan a wɔde bɛma, abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ahorow ne abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wogye tom, ne nhyɛso ahorow a ɛtwam te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nyiyim, ne mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan a wobedi ho dwuma no so. Sɛ wo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, amammerɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ananmusifo a wofi akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu di nkitaho a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nhomasua bɛka obiara ho abom na ɛfa mmabun nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛtumi afa so adi amammere ne kasa mu akwanside ahorow a ɛsi nna ne awoɔ ho nkitahodiɛ kwan no so? Te sɛ kasa ahodoɔ mu nneɛma a yɛde bɛma, amammere mu nsɛmfua a ɛfata a yɛbɛdie, anaasɛ kasa asekyerɛfoɔ ne amammere mu ntamgyinafoɔ a yɛbɛfa wɔn
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yɛbɛtumi adi amammere ne kasa mu akwansideɛ a ɛwɔ nna ne awoɔ ho nkitahodiɛ mu no so nkunim a, yɛbɛtumi afa saa akwan yi so: Yɛbɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nhoma nketewa, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so wɔ kasa ahodoɔ pii mu, na ama obiara a ɔka kasa biara anya ho kwan atie na wate aseɛ. Yɛbɛdi kasa ne nsɛmfua a ɛne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ amammere ne wɔn gyinapɛn hyia no adi dwuma. Yɛbɛkwa abɛɛfo nsɛmfua a emu yɛ den anaasɛ nsɛm a ɛbɛtumi de nteaseɛ bɔne aba anaasɛ ɛbɛfom obi. Yɛbɛfa afotufoɔ anaa asekyerɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn yie, na wɔnim kasa no ne amammere no mu nsɛm nyinaa yie, na wɔaboa wɔ nkitahodiɛ a ɛda ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ ne ayarefoɔ ntam. Kasa nkyerɛaseɛ dwumadie a yɛde bɛma: Yɛbɛma kasa asekyerɛfoɔ aba hɔ anaa wɔnam tɛlɛfɔon so aboa berɛ a dɔkota ne oyarefoɔ no rekasa, na ama obiara a ɔnte Borɔfo kasa yie no atumi ate asɛm biara ase na wanya kyɛfa wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmɔdenbɔ bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde to gua na ama mmabun nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan (SRH) anya nkyekyɛmu titiriw wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa amanehunu bere ho, na sɛn na yɛbɛtumi ama mmabun nso tumi ne anigyeɛ na ama wɔatumi apere wɔn ankasa hokwan ne deɛ ɛhia wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Yɛhia sɛ yɛbɛpae ho nimdeɛ (awareness) wɔ mpanyimfoɔ ne sika-boafo (donors) ne akuo a wɔboa nnipa wɔ amanehunu mberɛ mu (humanitarian actors) nkyɛn fa mmabun hia a wɔhia mmoa ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde SRH hyɛ amanehunu berɛ mu nhyehyɛeɛ mu (emergency plans) na yɛde sika a ɛfata ato hɔ de aboa saa mmɔdenbɔ yi. Mmabun ankasa so betumi ako denam: mmabun-ankasa-kannyan dwumadie (Youth-led campaigns), gyinaesie a wɔbɛka ho, ne nkabom a wɔne aban-ankasa-mmoa akuo (CSOs) ne wiase nyinaa mmoa akuo bɛyɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo nkitahodi di wɔ adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a, mmabun nya no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkitahodi yɛ nsɛm ne nkitahodi fibea a ɛsom bo, na ɛma mmabun tumi sua adwuma hokwan ahorow, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow ho ade denam anom asɛm a wɔde kɔma wɔn ne nkitahodi so. Afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ mu no bɛtumi de nhumu, nyansahyɛ, ne nnianim nsɛm ama wɔn a wɔbɛtumi ayɛ adwuma, afotufoɔ, ne nhomasua asoɛeɛ, na ama hokwan a wɔbɛnya ama ahokokwaa nkɔsoɔ ne adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ ayɛ mmerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi de da anaa bere pɔtee bi asi hɔ dapɛn biara ama yɛn a yɛbɛkɔ hɔ daa no na ama yɛahwɛ ahu sɛ nneɛma bɛyɛ pɛ na yɛde nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow yi adi kan?
answer_twi_source: Yebetumi de da ne bere pɔtee bi asi hɔ dapɛn biara ama yɛn a yɛbɛkɔ hɔ daa no na ama yɛahwɛ ahu sɛ nneɛma bɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na yɛde saa nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow yi adi kan. Paw da ne bere a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma yiye ama yɛn baanu no nyinaa, na susuw yɛn nhyehyɛe ne bere a yɛwɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn betumi aka sɛnea mɛyɛ me ho ne sɛnea meyɛ sɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn betumi aka sɛnea wote nka wɔ wo ho ne wo nipasu ho. Eyi yɛ akwantu no fa a ɛfata. Fa w’adwene si wo ho a wobɛhwɛ so, gye bere yɛ dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, na nsuro sɛ wobɛsrɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya aduannuru ho mmoa anaa nneɛma a wɔde ma bere a meyɛ ɔbabun, na ɛhe na metumi akɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea mɛma m’aduan atu mpɔn ama awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afi ase denam akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo te sɛ oduruyɛfo, ɔyarehwɛfo, anaa aduan ho ɔbenfo a wɔakyerɛw ne din a obetumi de akwankyerɛ a ɛfata ama wɔ w’aduan a wobɛma atu mpɔn ama awo akwahosan ho ama wo no so. Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow a egyina sukuu ahorow so, ne nnwuma a ɛma mmabun adamfofa su nso betumi de aduannuru ho afotu ne nneɛma ama. Intanɛt so nneɛma a efi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wotumi gye di a wɔatu wɔn ho ama mmabun akwahosan betumi de nsɛm a ɛsom bo ne nnwinnade a ɛbɛma w’aduan atu mpɔn ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho ma mmabun a wofi amammerɛ, mmusuakuw, kasa, ne asetena mu sikasɛm mu tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛwɔ so no bi ne: Nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne ahotoso a ɛkɔ soro wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu. Nkitahodie ne gyinaesi tumi a ɛkɔ anim a ɛfa abusuabɔ, pene a wɔpene so, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI ano a wosiw ho. Nnipa animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne asetra mu tew a wɔtew wɔn ho a ɛfa SRH nsɛm ho no so tew. Nkate a ɛkɔ anim sɛ obi yɛ obi a ɔka ho, gye tom, na obu ma nneɛma ahorow wɔ sukuu mpɔtam hɔ. Tumi a wɔde bɛma wɔn de akamfo wɔn ankasa hokwan ne ahiade ne wɔn atipɛnfo de.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ mewɔ aduruyɛ mu tebea bi a ebetumi aka sɛnea mede nnuru ahorow bi a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma nso ɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa mu tebea horow bi betumi aka nnuru ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a asiane biara nni ho ma wo. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ni: Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa: Wobetumi asusuw w’ayaresa ho abakɔsɛm na wɔakamfo nyinsɛn ano aduru a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn sen biara ama wo. Nsuro sɛ wubebisa nsɛm: W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa wo ma woasisi w’akwahosan ho gyinae a ɛfata. Kae: Mpɛn pii no, ɔkwan bi a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn wɔ hɔ a obiara betumi afa so asiw nyinsɛn ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho sɛ meresusuw saa kwan no ho a?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wobɛtumi asua pii afa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho wɔ Ghana nie: Department of Social Welfare: https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/ Ebia wɔn wɛbsaet no wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ne wɔn a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho adwumayɛbea a agye din ho. ma wo mmoa nipa no nkɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni nkyɛn na ɔmfa wo nkɔka youup witht he social welfare department wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ma akwan pii a wobɛfa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba a mmabun hyia berɛ a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow a ɛtaa ba ne: Ahintasɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ a wonni. Nnwuma a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su a ɛwɔ hɔ kakraa bi. Sikasɛm mu ahokyere anaa insurance a wonnya. Animtiaabu, nyiyim, anaa atemmu a efi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ. Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe anohyeto ahorow, te sɛ mfe a obi adi anaa awofo pene ho mmara. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea apɔwmuden nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den no kyerɛ ma mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden wɔ wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ te sɛ ɔyaredɔm, abɔde mu asiane ahorow, anaa nnipa mmoa ho haw ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den wɔ wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ho tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ te sɛ ɔyaredɔm, abɔde mu asiane ahorow, anaa nnipa mmoa ho haw ahorow mu no ho hia kɛse ma mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu na wɔama atu mpɔn. Wɔ saa ɔhaw ahorow yi mu no, apɔwmuden nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahyia ɔhaw ahorow wɔ ɔsom adwuma a wɔde ma mu, nneɛma a wɔde ma no mu ɔhaw ahorow, ne apɔwmuden ho nnwuma a wɔhwehwɛ kɛse. Ɛho hia sɛ apɔwmuden nhyehyɛe ahorow de ASRH dwumadie di kan na wɔhwɛ sɛ mmabun bɛkɔ so anya nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nnwuma a ɛho hia, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom. Ɛsɛ sɛ apɔwmuden nhyehyɛe ahorow nso di mmabun a tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ aka wɔn adwene ne asetra mu ahiade ahorow ho dwuma, a adwenemyare ho mmoa ne afotu ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa nnamfo anaa mefɛfo a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn nna ho bɔbea anaa wɔn bɔbeasu mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa nsiyɛ ne tema tie wɔn suahu ahorow a wonmmu atɛn. Fa awerɛhyem ma sɛ wugye wɔn tom na woboa wɔn ɛmfa ho sɛnea wɔyɛ wɔn ho. Fa nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛfa 'LGBTQ+' mmoa akuo, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ, ne intanɛt so mpɔtam ho ma. Bu wɔn kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn kokoam nsɛm, na ma wɔn kwan ma wɔda wɔn ho adi wɔ wɔn ankasa nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na adwenem-gye-tom anaa wo ho a wuhu di wɔ nkae-kyere mu, na ɛkwan bɛn so na mmerante ne mmabaa bɛtumi suasua saa nyansa yi?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu nhumu anaa wɔn ho a wohu kyerɛ sɛ wohu wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn nkate, ne wɔn nipadua mu nkate horow kɛse wɔ mprempren bere yi mu. Hyɛ Nneyɛe Ho Nhyehyɛe: Ɛdenam adwene a mmabun nya so no, wobetumi de nkate horow a emu da hɔ kɛse na wɔabɔ wɔn tirim ayɛ wɔn ade sen sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ade ntɛm ara. Ma Nkonimdi Nkɔanim: Adwene mu a wɔde si nneɛma ano ma ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano no yɛ kɛse denam gye a wogye tom, mmubu atɛn, ne ayamhyehye a ɛma obi nya ne ho wɔ nkate horow a emu yɛ den anim no so. Mmabun betumi anya adwene ne wɔn ho a wohu denam nneyɛe te sɛ adwennwen, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde home a emu dɔ, nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu, anaa adwene mu kankyee dwumadi ahorow te sɛ yoga so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu na mede di dwuma ma nkɔso foforo yi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no, ahotew pa ho hia. Wubetumi de samina a ɛnyɛ den ne nsu a ɛyɛ hyew adi dwuma na ama wo nipadua ho atew. Wɔ mmeawa a wɔrekɔ brayɛ fam fam no, nneɛma ahorow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya te sɛ pads anaa tampons usage. Wubetumi ne wo duruyɛfo anaa ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso akasa afa nea ebia ɛfata wo ho. Kae: Ɛyɛ papa bere nyinaa sɛ wobɛkɔ oduruyɛfo nkyɛn ansa na wode aduru foforo biara adi dwuma wɔ wo nipadua a ɛrenyin no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi aka w’ankasa osuahu anaa nhumu a ɛfa gyinaesi wɔ nyɔnkofa nkitahodie mu ne sɛnea anya wo nna ne awo akwaahosan so nsunsuanso no ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Dwennwen wo gyinapɛn ahorow, wo hye, ne botae ahorow ho wɔ abusuabɔ mu, na wo ne wo hokafo no nka ho asɛm pefee. Fa obu, ahotoso, ne nkitahodi di kan wɔ mo abusuabɔ mu, na bom nsi gyinae a ɛne ahokafo baanu no nyinaa ahiade ne wɔn akɔnnɔ hyia. Hu sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛfata hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkɔ so di nkitaho, wɔma wɔn ho wɔn ho to wɔn ho so, na wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho, a nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw STI/HIV ano no gu ahorow mu wɔ aman ne mpɔtam ahorow mu wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw STI/HIV ano no gu ahorow wɔ aman ne mpɔtam ahorow mu esiane nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne ɔyaredɔm ho nsɛm mu nti. Aman binom betumi de nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ adi kan wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ, bere a afoforo nso betumi de wɔn adwene asi nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so ama nnipa atitiriw te sɛ nna ho adwumayɛfo, mmarima a wɔne mmarima da (MSM), ne nnipa a wɔde nnubɔne gu wɔn mu so. Nnwinnade a wɔde siw ano te sɛ kɔndɔm, pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), ne HIV nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ nso betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ sika a wonya ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho no bi ne: Atosɛm: "Wɔrentumi nnyinsɛn bere a edi kan a wo ne obi bɛda no." Nokwasɛm: Nyinsɛn betumi aba bere biara a mmadwoa behyia nkosua, ɛmfa ho sɛ ɛyɛ bere a edi kan anaasɛ ɛtwa toɔ. Atosɛm: "Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano ma obi ntumi nwo." Nokwasɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano mma obi ntumi nwo na asiane biara nni ho sɛ mmea dodow no ara de bedi dwuma. Atosɛm: "Worentumi nnya STI sɛ wo ne obi a onnyaa nna da da a." Nokwasɛm: Wobetumi afa nna mu nneyɛe ahorow so anya STI, a nna a wɔde ano ne akyi nna ka ho. Nokwasɛm :Condom a wobɛbɔho abien no yɛ NSƐM KƐSE; fa kɔndɔm biako pɛ di dwuma bere biara a wobɛda. Nea ɛka saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi ho dwuma a wobedi ho ne sɛ wɔde nsɛm a edi mu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛma wɔ awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi agyina ahotɔ dodow ne sɛnea wotumi kɔ hɔ so apaw ɔkwan a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔfa so di nkitaho de afotu ma wɔ ɔhaw ahorow ho, te sɛ telefon so frɛ, text message, video so nkɔmmɔbɔ, anaa anim ne anim nhyiam?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a Wɔpɛ sɛ Wɔfa so Di Nkitahodi: Mpɛn pii no, mmabun tumi paw ɔkwan a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔfa so di nkitaho de afotu ma wɔ ɔhaw ahorow ho, te sɛ telefon so frɛ, nsem a yɛkyerɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpvn so,brɔfo kasa a yɛfrɛ no video so nkɔmmɔbɔ, anaa anim ne anim nhyiam, a egyina wɔn ahotɔ ne sɛnea wobetumi anya bi so. Ebia nnwuma bi de akwan horow pii bɛma de afata nea ankorankoro pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodie ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu a epira, akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow a egu ahorow, na wɔahyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho mfonini pa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodie ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu a epira, akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow a egu ahorow, na wɔahyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho mfonini pa ho nkuran, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so nhyiam ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran. Social media akuw ne nhyiam ahorow a mmabun betumi ne ankorankoro a wɔwɔ adwene koro adi nkitaho, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔasusuw akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo pa ho nkuran. Nhomasua nneɛma ne nnwinnade a akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ de aboa mmabun ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea mu nhwehwɛmu na wɔakasa atia. Adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, ne ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmabun nya ahokokwaw ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm na wɔkamfo nsakrae a ɛba nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa referrals bi wɔ hɔ a ɛnam ntentenfidie so nhyehyeɛ anaa dwumadie wodi de boa wɔ ɔhaw berɛ mu de boa mmubun ma wonya mmoa anaa dwumadie bio?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow pii de nneɛma ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn a wɔde bɛka mmabun abom ne mmoa anaa nnwuma foforo, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, afotufo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw. Wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ho ama anaasɛ wɔde virtual referrals ama ma wɔaboa afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wɔadi dɛm akamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow ne wɔn a wogye tom wɔ abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm akamfo hokwan ahorow ne gye a wogye wɔn tom bere tenten wɔ abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu, na mpɛn pii no wohyia amanehunu kɛse. Saa nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi yi afa akwan horow so, a nea ɛka ho ne ɔsɔretia ne ɔyɛkyerɛ a asomdwoe mu yɛ, mmara mu nsɛnnennen, aban mpanyimfo a wɔhwehwɛ wɔn, nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ fam, mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyekye mpɔtam hɔfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nhomasua a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase. Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ako ama hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ, ahobammɔ a wobenya afi nyiyim ho, nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya, na wɔahu wɔn wɔ ɔmanfo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu akyerɛ denam hia a ɛho hia a wɔbɛma wɔn atipɛnfo, awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ate ase no so. Wobetumi akɔka anaa wɔafi ase abɔ ako a asuafo di anim a wɔkasa de wɔn ho ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow mu, na wɔne sukuu mpanyimfo anaa mpɔtam hɔ aban ananmusifo adi nkitaho de akyerɛ wɔn mmoa a wɔde ma CSE. Ankorankoro nsɛm, akontaabu, ne nhwehwɛmu a egyina adanse so a wɔbɛkyɛ no betumi aboa ma wɔakyerɛkyerɛ nkɛntɛnso pa a CSE nya wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kasa fa sɛnea metumi de 'confidentiality' (kokoam-yɛ) adi dwuma wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu mu.
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ kokoam nsɛm a ɛho hia. Wɔnka wo nsɛm nkyerɛ obiara. Mmara bɔ wo ho ban. Kasa kyerɛ dɔkota.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahwehwɛdeɛ ne nteteɛ bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ wɔ ɔfotubɔfoɔ anaa mmoa kuo kwankyerɛfoɔ a ne ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nna mu apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi krataa: Hwehwɛ afotubɔfoɔ a wɔhwɛ adwenemyareɛ tumi krataa anaa license. Ɛsɛ sɛ wonya ntetee pɔtee wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne awo ho nsɛm ho. Adwuma titiriw: Hwehwɛ afotubɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ osuahun anaasɛ wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nna mu apɔwmuden ho. Ebia ebinom wɔ adansediɛ wɔ nkrataa wɔ so a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ akukudam saa nsɛm yi mu. Nteteɛ: Hwɛ sɛ ɔfotubɔfoɔ no anya nteteɛ wɔ ayaresa akwan a egyina adanse so ho. Hwehwɛ adansedie nkrataa te sɛ "Certified Sexuality Educator" anaa "Sex Therapist" , Osuahu: Hwɛ sɛ wɔwɔ suahun a ɛsɛ fata. Gye referrals anaa reviews fi mmabun a saa adwumayɛfoɔ yi ahwɛ wɔn. Wei bɛma w'ahu sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma no yie anaa sɛ wɔnnyɛ no yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi, nsusuw nsɛmmisa anaa ɛhaw biara a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma ho.
answer_twi_source: Aniwu biara nni ho sɛ wubenya nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a, ɛhaw wo wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho! Nea enti a ɛho hia sɛ wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkasa ni: Wɔyɛ abenfo: Wobetumi abua wo nsɛmmisa, adi wo haw ahorow ho dwuma, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobɛte akwan ahorow a wubetumi afa so no ase. Wobetumi ayɛ wo nhyehyɛe no sɛnea wopɛ: Wobetumi agyina w’akwahosan ne nea wopɛ so akamfo ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so akyerɛ wo. Wobetumi adi mfomso a ɛhaw wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ho dwuma: Wobetumi de afotu ama na wɔabua nsɛmmisa de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wode ɔkwan a woapaw no bedi dwuma yiye. Kae: W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa wo nna mu akwahosan akwantu no. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ pefee na woadi nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne ahwɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka 'media literacy skills' a ɛma wotumi de wɔn ho hyɛ atipɛnfo nkitahodi a ahoɔden wom, obu wom, na ɛka obiara ho mu wɔ intanɛt so ne intanɛt so nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun bɛtumi aboa mmabun wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka 'media literacy skills' a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ mu denam: Akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nsɛmti ho, te sɛ deɛ wɔbɛhunu fibea a wɔgye di, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, ne digyital mmeaeɛ a wɔbɛfa asɛdeɛ kwan so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm, atipɛnfo nkitahodi, ne intanɛt so osuahu ahorow ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ahyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne dijitaal ɔman bayɛ ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ suban pa a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛso ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma a ɛfata a wɔbɛda no adi wɔ wɔn ankasa nkitahodi a wɔne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo di mu. Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho nkuran na wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wom, a ɛka obiara ho ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan anaa nhyehyɛeɛ horow bi bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de wɔn ho agye mu sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ, ɔhaw, anaa nhyɛso ho, te sɛ anikann, adwene a wɔtwetwe, anaa mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ fi atumfoɔ anaa nnipa a wogye wɔn di mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow adi dwuma de wɔn ho agye mu sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ, ɔhaw, anaa nhyɛso ho mu. Eyinom bi ne: Akasakasa Tẽẽ: Ɔkasa kyerɛ nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no anaa nea obetumi ayɛ no no tee de ada ne haw adi na wabu nneyɛe a epira no abam. Adwene a ɛtwetwe adwene: Ade a wɔde bɛtwetwe adwene a ɛbɛma wɔatwa tebea no mu na ama nea obetumi ayɛ no bɔne no anya hokwan afi hɔ anaasɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Mmoa a Wɔhwehwɛ: Atumfoɔ anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, anaa ahobammɔ adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ma wɔde wɔn ho agye mu yiye na wɔde mmoa ama. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Nnamfo anaa atipɛnfo mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ma wɔabom de wɔn ho agye mu na wɔada biakoyɛ adi atia nneyɛe a epira.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ayɔnkofa di wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔbɛka wɔn ho na wɔagye wɔn atom no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ayɔnkofo betumi aboa wɔn atipɛnfo paa?
answer_twi_source: Ayɔnkofa ho hia ma nkabom: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho: Sua mmubuafo hokwan ne nsɛm ho ade. Twa adwene a ɛnteɛ: Kasa bere a wote nsusuwii bɔne a ɛfa dɛmdie ho no. Boa atipɛnfo a wɔadi dɛm: Fa mmoa ma na yɛ tebea a ɛma akwaaba. Ɔyɔnko Pa a Wobɛyɛ: Tie, gye osuahu ahorow di, na ma mmubuafo tumi ma wɔmfa nkamfo wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo afotu ne mmoa adwuma a mmabun anya wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne awo ho haw ahorow ho ma akɔ soro?
answer_twi_source: Ma Nnipa Nhu: Kyerɛkyerɛ w’atipɛnfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo hia a nna mu akwahosan ho afotu ho hia. Kyɛ nneɛma ne nsɛm wɔ social media anaa sukuu platforms so. Adesrɛ anaa Lobby: Fi ase hwehwɛ adesrɛ anaa ɔsatu a ɛbɛma wɔanya sika ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho afotu a ɛkɔ soro wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Kyerɛw nkrataa kɔma mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya bi yie. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa Kuo: Fa atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo si hɔ wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ de kyerɛ hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ saa dwumadie yi. To nsa frɛ afotufoɔ anaa adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ ma wɔnkasa wɔ nhyiamu anaa adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ ase. Wo ne Ahyehyɛde ahorow nyɛ biako: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ akuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so anaasɛ akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan so nyɛ adwuma. Mommɔ mu nyɛ adwuma mfa nhu ɔsatu ahorow anaasɛ mmɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe mu. Ka Ankorankoro Nsɛm: Sɛ woka ankorankoro osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mfaso a ɛwɔ afotu so ho a, ebetumi atew animtiaabu so. Kasa wɔ nhyiam ahorow ase anaa kyerɛw nsɛm de si nkɛntɛnso a saa nnwuma yi nya so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmerante ne mmabaa betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ amanaman ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa mmabun bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ne wɔn ho kwan (ASRR) ahorow ho mu na wɔde wɔn adwene akyerɛ? (Mmabun nkɔmmɔbɔ, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Aane! Sɛnea wobetumi ate mmerante ne mmabaa asɛm ni: Mmabun Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow pii yɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ma mmerante ne mmabaa titiriw. Intanɛt so Nhyiamu: Nhyiamu te sɛ UN Youth Envoy adwumayɛbea no ma mmeaeɛ a mmabun bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ mmabun bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden (ASRH) nsɛm ho. (https://www.un.org/mabun a ɔyɛ ɔbadwemma/)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ahyɛ tema, ayamye, ne obiara a yɛbɛka ho nkuran wɔ yɛn ayɔnkofa mu de ayɛ tebea a ɛboa na yɛwɔ adwene mu apɔwmuden ama yɛn ho ne afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyɛ tema, ayamye, ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ho nkuran wɔ ayɔnkofa mu denam afoforo a wɔde aso pa tie wɔn, obu a wɔde ma wɔ adwene horow a egu ahorow ho, na wogyina nyiyim anaa nyiyim a wɔayi wɔn afi mu no ano so. Adɔe nneyɛe nketenkete te sɛ mmoa a wɔde ma anaa aso a wɔde tie no boa ma obi nya tebea a ɛboa na ɛma obi nya adwene mu apɔwmuden ma ne ho ne afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so kasa tia nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho a egyina sɛnea ɛte anaa sɛnea wɔda no adi so, titiriw bere a ɛfa asɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma ho no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana amansan mmara mu no, nnipa mma mmienu pɔtee (ɔbarima ne ɔbaa) nko na wɔgye tom, na asɛmfua a wɔde gyina wɔn ananmu nso ne 'ɔno' (ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa nko).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɛba mfonini anaa nneɛma a wɔde kɔ intanɛte so kyerɛ afoforɔ a, ɛkwan bɛn so na yɛhu sɛ obi apene so (consent) paa
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka pene a wɔpene so ho ne sɛ wobefi wɔn pɛ mu apene so sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ mfonini anaa nsɛm a wɔrenhyɛ wɔn so anaasɛ wɔrenhyɛ wɔn. Ɛsɛ sɛ afã abien no nyinaa ka wɔn ahye ho asɛm pefee na wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho gyinaesi ahorow. Ma w’adwene nkɔ nea ebetumi afi mu aba ne asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm a ɛbɛn wo a wobɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmra bi wɔ hɔ a ɛka awofo pene anaa amanneɛbɔ ho mmara ahorow ho wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu ayayade, nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, anaa nhyɛso ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɛn pii no, mmra bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayi afi awofo pene anaa amanneɛbɔ ho mmara mu wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu ayayade, nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, anaa nhyɛso ho. Mpɛn pii no, wɔahyɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo yɛ amanneɛbɔfo, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmara hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ayayade anaa wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata, a awofo mpene so mpo. Wɔ nsɛm a awofo pene a wɔbɛhwehwɛ anaasɛ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no betumi de ɔbabun no ato asiane mu anaasɛ ama tebea no ayɛ kɛse mu no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de kokoam hwɛ ama anaasɛ wɔde wɔn akɔ mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔfata amammerɛ mu, bere a meresusuw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no?
