answer_twi_source: Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata a wɔyɛ mmabun adamfofa su wɔ hɔ. Wɔtete sukuu ayarehwɛfo nso, wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo afotu adwuma ama mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi akamfo afotu adwuma ama mmabun a wɔwɔ wo mpɔtam anaa wo mantam mu no denam: Wobɛma nkurɔfo ate hia a adwenemyare ne afotu adwuma ho hia denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a esisi so. Nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw kɔma mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo, sukuu so ahwɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma sika ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ mmabun afotu adwuma no akɔ soro. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa kurow no mu nhyiamu a wɔbɛyɛ de asusu hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ afotuo a ɛyɛ mmerɛ na ne boɔ yɛ den ma mmabun ho. Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow, mmabun akuw, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkitahodi ahorow a wobɛyɛ biako de ama wo nne ayɛ kɛse na woakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛde mmabun adwenemyare di kan. W’ankasa wo suahunu ne adansedie a ɛfa mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ afotuo dwumadie so a wobɛka de asi so dua a ɛbɛtumi anya nsunsuanso pa wɔ mmabun yiedie so .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow, te sɛ nsɛmma nhoma, aguade ho dawurubɔ, television so dwumadi, sini, ne sohyial media boa ma wɔyɛ mmabun nipadua ho mfoni?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow, te sɛ nsɛmma nhoma, aguade ho dawurubɔ, television so dwumadi, sini, ne sohyial media boa ma wɔyɛ mmabun nipadua ho mfoni denam: Wɔde mfoniyɛfo ne nnipa a wɔagye din mfoni a wɔayɛ no yiye na wɔtaa de di dwuma wɔ dijitaal so kyerɛ. Nneɛma ne asetra kwan a ɛbata nipadua "a ɛyɛ pɛ" a wobenya ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Nipadua ahorow bi a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata bere a wɔde afoforo to nkyɛn, a wɔhyɛ ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne nnipa a ɛsono wɔn nna mu osuahun anaa wɔn adwenemu akɔ abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ka w’anidaso, w’akɔnnɔ, ne ahyeɛ ahorow ho asɛm pefee wɔ nokware mu. Bu nsonsonoe: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobenya osuahu ahorow, nanso bu wɔn ho wɔn ho ahiade, nea wɔpɛ ne ahotɔ dodow. Nya ɔpɛ sɛ wubegyae wo ho mu: Hwehwɛ nea mo adwene hyia ne dwumadi ahorow a mo baanu nyinaa ani gye ho. Monkyerɛkyerɛ mo ho mo ho: Sɛ mo ma mo ho kwan, mobetumi asua biribi afi mo ho mo ho osuahu ne adwene mu. Wobetumi akɔsra akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So telefon a wɔde frɛ nkorɔfo ne telefon a wɔde boa LGBTQ +- na ɛfa LGBTQ + mmabun ahiade ne osuahu soronko ho, de mmoa a ɛnnyɛ atemmu ma?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ Nkabom: Ntrɛwmu ne mmoa nhama pii yɛ LGBTQ+ nkabom na ɛte nka wɔ LGBTQ+ mmabun ahiade ne osuahu soronko ho. Wɔde mmoa na ɛnyɛ atemmuo ma, a afotufoɔ a wɔatete wɔn a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho na wɔbɛtumi de mmoa a wɔayɛ ama onipa no nipasu ne ne suahunu ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun nimdeɛ ne ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden (SRH) ho nsɛm ho no ayɛ kɛse wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Adesua Nhyehyɛe a Ɛkɔ Akyiri: Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma no de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Nkitahodi Adesua: Adwumayɛbea ahorow, atipɛnfo nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne multimedia nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ SRH ho adesua mu denneennen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena ne sikasɛm tebea nya ɔbabun tumi a obenya aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Asetena ne sikasɛm tebea nya tumi a ɔbabun betumi anya aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata so nkɛntɛnso kɛse denam: Sɛnea wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobetumi atɔ: Asetena mu sikasɛm tebea a ɛkorɔn taa ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden kɛse wɔ abusuabɔ, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ obetua aduan a ahoɔden wom na wanya adan a ɛyɛ den. Mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ so nkɛntɛnso: Ebia mpɔtam a asetena ne sikasɛm tebea nye no renkɔ sotɔɔ ahorow a wɔtɔn nnuan a wɔayɛ no foforo wom mu na wɔwɔ adan a ɛnyɛ papa dodow a ɛkɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi atete atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ma wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm akɔma wɔn atipɛnfo wɔ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn so?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee no betumi ayɛ: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu na ama wɔanya nimdeɛ a edi mu. Nkitahodi ne nneɛma a wɔde ma ho nimdeɛ a ɛbɛma atipɛnfo de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu yiye. Ahintasɛm ne tema ntetee a wɔde bɛma tebea a ɛboa. Akwankyerɛ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia a wobedi ho dwuma ne nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen a efi atipɛnfo hɔ a wobedi ho dwuma ho. Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ahorow ahorow, ne obu ho nkuran wɔ atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa afa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ denam: Akuo a sukuufo di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu apomoden ne nhomasua so a wɔbɛhyehyɛ anaa wɔbɛka ho. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, nhyiam ahorow, anaa nhyiam dwumadie a wɔbɛyɛ de ahyɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ho nkuran. Nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw kɔma sukuu so ahwɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ananmusifo a wɔkasa ama nna mu apomoden ho adesua ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho kyerɛ. Sukuu bagua nhyiamu anaa baguam nhyiamu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de akyerɛ wɔn mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ho na wɔakyɛ wɔn ankasa suahunu anaa adansedie. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, sukuu afotufoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nnwuma a ɛdi asuafoɔ dodoɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma. Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan akuo ne aɛɛfo ntetan so bɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔaboaboa atipɛnfo ano atwa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ho asɛm no ho ahyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu sɛnea ɛyɛ den sɛ wubehu bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) na woayɛ ho biribi, na si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ mmerɛw bere nyinaa sɛ wubehu bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV), nanso kae sɛ, mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no yɛ ahoɔden ho sɛnkyerɛnne, na ɛnyɛ mmerɛwyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ka aduannuru a mehia?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere ma wo nipadua hwehwɛ aduannuru a ɛbɛboa ma woanyin, nipadua mu nsakrae, ne awo mu nkwammoa ahorow a ɛkari pɛ no yɛ kɛse. Saa bere yi mu no, ebia wubehia nea broni fre no 'calorie, protein, vitamin, ne mineral' pii na ama woatumi adi wo nipadua ahiade ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne STI ahorow ahorow no? (chlamydia, akisikuru, akisikuru, HPV, HIV, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer_twi_source: STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba no bi ne: Chlamydia Gonorrhea, Syphilis, Nnipa papillomavirus (HPV), Herpes simplex virus (HSV), Nnipa nipadua mu nkwammoaa a ɛko tia nyarewa (HIV), Trichomoniasis, Hepatitis B ne C.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛyɛ ayaresabea 'safe space' ama dɛmdifoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Accessibility (kwan a ɛbue ma wɔn). Nteteeɛ (Training) ma dɔkotafoɔ. Ma wɔnka gyinaesie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan a ɛyɛ anigye na  wobɛfa so akɔ so ayɛ nnam wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wokɔ so yɛ nnam a, ebetumi ayɛ anigye bere a wunya dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho: Akuw Agumadi: Bɔɔlbɔ, ne   nea agodie a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ basketball, volleyball, ne softball ma wonya adamfofa ne akansi. Asaw Adesua:   nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Jazz, hip-hop, ballet, anaa Zumba adesua betumi ayɛ akwan a ɛyɛ anigye a wobɛfa so ayɛ nnam na woasua nneɛma foforo. Akodi: Karate, taekwondo, anaa judo ma nipadua mu ahoɔden ka nteɛso ne adwene a wɔde si biribi so ho. Abɔnten So Akwantu: Nantew, sakre, abotan so foro, anaa kayak betumi ayɛ anigye na ama wo ne abɔde anya abusuabɔ. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa Parkour: Nya ahokeka, kari pɛ, ne nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so wɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu anaasɛ sɔ parkour hwɛ ma nkurow akɛse mu nhwehwɛmu ne kankyee. Asuguare: Sɛ́ ɛyɛ ɔtare anaa mpoano no, asuguare yɛ nipadua nyinaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛma ahoɔden na ɛyɛ anigye. Agodie a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Skateboarding anaa Rollerblading: Saa dwumadi ahorow yi ma obi nya ahofadi a ɔde bɛkɔ baabiara na wanya anigye. Agodie a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Yoga anaa Pilates: Ma sɛnea wotumi yɛ nsesae, kari pɛ, ne ahoɔden tu mpɔn bere a wode w’adwene si adwene ne nipadua nkitahodi so no. Bea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Trampoline Parks: ahurihuri wɔ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ trampolines so betumi ayɛ anigye ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ kɛse ama wo ntini. Agodie Agodie: Wo ne wo nnamfo hyehyɛ agodie te sɛ tag, fa frankaa, anaa akwanside akwan wɔ abɔnten so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu(CSE) ma mmabun nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛma wɔn tumi ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne daakye ho. Ɛma wonya asetra mu nimdeɛ a ɛho hia te sɛ nkitahodi, ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, a ɛho hia kɛse ma nna mu tebea horow ne abusuabɔ ahorow a wɔde di dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minyinsɛn na mempɛ sɛ mɛtete abofra no a, dɛn ne akwan foforo a mɛfa so? (adoption, awofoyɛ ho nneɛma).
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wonyinsɛn na wompɛ sɛ wobɛtete abofra no a, wowɔ akwan horow a wobɛfa so: ma wo mmoa nipa no nkɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo nkyɛn na ɔne wo ne asetena mu yiedi dwumadibea a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no nnya nkitahodi pii. Eyi yɛ gyinaesi a ɛyɛ den, na ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa. Sɛ wo ne ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di bɛkasa a, ebetumi ama woanya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ saa bere yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi nya gyinaesi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho so nnsunsuanso, na mɛyɛ dɛn ama saa gyidi ahorow yi ne m’ankasa gyinapɛn ne nea m’ani gye ho ahyia?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi betumi akyerɛ suban, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Dwene w’ankasa wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho, na susuw sɛnea ɛne amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ hyia ho. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di wɔ w’amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mpɔtam hɔ a wobetumi de nhumu ne mmoa ama. Kae sɛ ɛyɛ yie sɛ wobɛma amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidie ne ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne nea wopɛ ahyia denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne wo ho a wobɛdwennwen so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa digital media ho nsɛm anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ media ho nimdeɛ ne intanɛt so nneyɛe a asɛde wom ho nkuran yie wɔ mmabun mu fa nna mu agodie ho?
answer_twi_source: Digitals media ɔsatu anaa nnwuma a ɛma digital media ho nimdeɛ ne intanɛt so nneyɛe a ɛyɛ asɛde nya nkɔso yie wɔ mmabun mu wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne nkitahodi nkyerɛkyerɛ websites ahorow, social media ɔsatu ahorow a ɛwɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a atipɛnfo di anim ne animdefo afotu, intanɛt so nhyiam ne website so, adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde di agoru, ne nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ wɔ mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow ne digital media creators ntam de ayɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ anigye na ɛma nimdie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa, amammerɛ, ne asetena ne sikasɛm tebea nya mmabun akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Kasa mu akwanside betumi asiw mmabun ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu no kwan, titiriw wɔ wɔn a ɛsono wɔn kasa titiriw wɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no de ho no. Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nneyɛe betumi akyerɛ sɛnea mmabun kura wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na anya wɔn suban ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso. Asetena ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ nhomasua, akwahosan ho nnwuma, ne nsɛm a wobenya betumi anya mmabun tumi a wɔde te nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ase na wɔyɛ ho adwuma no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne nneɛma a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban fi wɔn ho kum ho, te sɛ ayɔnkofa a emu yɛ den a wobenya, dwumadi ahorow a ntease wom a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia no?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔde Gyina Ano ne Nneɛma a Ɛbɔ Wɔn Ho Ban: Mmabun betumi akyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne nneɛma a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban fi wɔn ho kum ho denam asetra mu abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a wobenya, dwumadi ahorow a ntease wom a wobenya, wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho adesua, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia no so. Ahokokwaw a ɛbɛma wɔatumi agyina ano, a wobɛma wanya atenka sɛ ɔyɛ obi a ɔka ho, ne akwan pa a wobɛfa so adi adwennwen ho dwuma a wubesua nso betumi aboa ma woatumi agyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano te sɛ, w’adamfo a wogye no di, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo a wo ne no bɛkasa ho asɛm.
answer_twi_source: Akwan a ɛfata a wobɛfa so agyina ano a wobɛfa so adi wo atinka ahorow ho dwuma ni: Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Sɛ woka w'atinka ho asɛm kyerɛ obi a ɔboa wo a, ebetumi aboa kɛse. Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu: Oduruyɛfo anaa ɔfotufo betumi ama woanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobɛda wo haw ahorow adi na woanya nimdeɛ a wode begyina ano. Kɔka kuw bi a wɔboa wɔn ho: Sɛ wo ne afoforo a wɔte wo tebea ase no bɛbɔ a, ebetumi ayɛ ahoɔden fibea kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛ yɛ dɛn atumi anya abusua a wɔagye wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma a ɛbɛma me ba no anya ofie a ɔdɔ wom?
answer_twi_source: Nea broni ka no 'Department of Social Welfare': https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/ betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma wɔ Ghana ho. Wo nea broni frɛ no 'social worker' wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi ayɛ kɛse abɛyɛ biribi a epira anaa asiane wom?
answer_twi_source: Te a wɔte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔrehunahuna wɔn ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom anaa epira mu. Nhyɛso a ɛkɔ so tra hɔ a wubehyia ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔda no adi sɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ anaasɛ ɔpow no. Atipɛnfo nneyɛe a ɛrekɔ soro a wɔbɛhwɛ, te sɛ nhyɛso akwan horow a ɛkɔ soro mpɛn pii anaasɛ emu yɛ den. Nneɛma bɔne a efi atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ba, te sɛ nkate fam ahokyere anaa honam fam opira a wohu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ma hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu denam: Wɔn suahu ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka ho asɛm no so. Mmɔden a wɔbɔ de gyina mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho ban no mu den. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔahyɛ nsakrae pa ho nkuran. Ahyehyɛde anaa ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ bere a wɔde ntentanfidie anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow redi dwuma de resusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun de ntentanfidie anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow redi dwuma de resusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ obuo ama afoforo kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn ahye, kwati nsɛm a ɛbɛma obi ahu nipakro a wɔyɛ, ne ahwɛyiye a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛho hia yie a wɔbɛbɔ wɔ baguam a atiefo betumi anya nsɛm no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo, ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔahyɛ animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ho no mu den anaasɛ asɔ ahwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Kasa, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo, ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi: Ahyɛ animtiaabu mu den denam nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne mfonini a enye a wɔbɛma akɔ so atra hɔ no so. Fa suban ne nneyɛe a ɛyɛ animtiaabu nyɛ nea ɛfata, na ma ɛnyɛ den mma mmaabun sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia anaasɛ wɔbɛko atia. Twa animtiaabu denam kasa a ɛka obiara ho, gyinabea a edi mu, ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm pa a ɛfoa nnipa ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne paw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amannebɔfo nkrasɛm boa ma mmabun adwene wɔ pene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa ho, na nkɛntɛnso bɛn na eyi nya wɔ wɔn nneyɛe ne gyinaesi so?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm kyerɛ mmabun adwene wɔ pene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa ho denam: Suban ahorow bi anaa abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata denam nea wɔda no adi mpɛn pii so. Su horow a wonya wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho nkɛntɛnso, a wɔtaa da no adi sɛ nea emu nna hɔ anaasɛ wobu wɔn ani gu so koraa. Akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne tumi a ɛkɔ so wɔ abusuabɔ mu a wɔbɛhyehyɛ mu. Gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho a ɛbɛka. Ɛsi hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a ɛho hia na ama wɔahu gyinabea a ɛyɛ papa ne nea enni apɔwmuden ho a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nhyehyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow betumi ama mmabun anya nhumu ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran de ako atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsunsuanso bɔne ne nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow betumi ama mmabun anya nhumu ne nsusuwii pa ho nimdeɛ wɔ: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho dwumadi ahorow a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, te sɛ aguade ho dawurubɔ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm, ne sohyial media so nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu hwɛ sɛ wɔwɔ animhwɛ ne nsusuwii hunu. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔayɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛkasa tia nsɛm a epira na ɛhyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran. Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho adesua aka nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere tenten ahe na bere a wɔde di akyi ne nea wɔde hwɛ akyi no taa di, na so nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi anya bere tenten a egye so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Bere tenten a wɔde di akyi ne bere a wɔde hwɛ no akyi no gu ahorow gyina ɔbabun no ahiade pɔtee ne ne tebea horow so. Ebetumi atra hɔ adapɛn pii, asram pii, anaa nea ɛboro saa mpo, a egyina sɛnea nsɛm no mu yɛ den, mmoa dodow a wɔhwehwɛ, ne nkɔso a ɔbabun no nya wɔ ne ho a ɔsan nya mu so. Nneɛma te sɛ nsɛnnennen a ɛkɔ so, asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi bɛsan anya ɔyare no bio, ne sɛnea nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu no tu mpɔn no betumi anya bere tenten a wɔde hwɛ obi akyi no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛ ne w'ankasa wo ho a wɔbɛhwɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma adwenemyare, titiriw bere a woredi nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma no? (adwennwen ano aduru, nkate fam yiyedi) .
answer_twi_source: Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ nyinaa ne sɛ wobɛhwɛ wo ho wɔ nipadua, adwene, ne atenka fam. Ɛte sɛ nea wode ɔhwɛ a ɛfata ama w’adwene ne wo nipadua no! Dɛn nti na ɛho hia? Titiriw wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no, woredi nsakrae pii ho dwuma, a nna ne awo mu nkɔso ka ho. Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ no boa wo ma wudi adwennwen so, ɛma wo nkate tu mpɔn, na wote nka sɛ woanya tumi kɛse sɛ wobɛfa nsakrae ahorow yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua ne nhumu so adi ho dwuma yi?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ne: Atosɛm: "Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano ma wo mu yɛ duru kɛse paa." Nokwasɛm: Bere a ebia ankorankoro binom mu duru bɛsakra nketenkete no, nyansahu mu adanse nkyerɛ sɛ wɔn mu duru kɔ soro kɛse esiane nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano nti. Atosɛm: "Sɛ wo ne obi da wɔ wo nna mu a, wuntumi nnyinsɛn." Nokwasɛm: Bere a ɛbɛyɛ yiye no sua no, ɛda so ara yɛ yiye sɛ wubenyinsɛn bere a worekɔ brayɛ mu, titiriw sɛ brayɛ no yɛ tiaa anaasɛ ɛnkɔ so daa a. Atosɛm: "Worentumi nnya STI mfi anom nna mu." Nokwasɛm: STI betumi afa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde ano, awotwaa, ne akyi berɛmo mu, enti ahobammɔ ho hia ɛmfa ho nna mu dwumadi ko a wɔyɛ no. Nea ɛka anansesɛm ahorow yi ho dwuma a wobedi denam nhomasua ne nhumu so no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm a edi mu bɛma, wɔma adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no nyɛ nokware, na wɔhyɛ awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ntease a edi mũ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne awo ho atɛntrenee ho nsɛm a, mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ho nhwɛso ahorow bi?
answer_twi_source: Ebia awo ho atɛntrenee ho nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun ho no bi ne; nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wontumi nnya, akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nsiw nyinsɛn ano ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma, nyiyim ne animtiaabu ho osuahu ahorow, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata a wonni wɔ amammerɛ mu, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛto awo ho ahofadi ano hye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa nnwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma madi nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ayaresabea anaa ayaresabea ahorow kɔhwehwɛ kokoam afotu ne nnwuma a ɛfa mmabunbere ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Hwɛ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a ebia wɔde adwumayɛbea ahorow, afotu, anaa mmoa akuw bɛma mmabun. Sukuu afotufoɔ bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ama na wɔde wo akɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ sukuu no mu (Adolescent corner) anaa mpɔtam hɔ.  Nya telefon a wɔde frɛ anaa mmoa nhama a wɔde ama mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi na woanya kokoam mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na adwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ dabere ne wɔn a wɔde adan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun bere a wɔtra hɔ no mu, na akwanhwɛ bɛn na ɛsɛsɛ mmabun nya wɔ nnwuma a wɔde ma no ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔhwɛ dabere ne wɔn a wɔde adansiɛ ma no di dwuma titire wɔ mmoa ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ wɔn tena mu no mu. Nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ nnwuma a wɔde ma ho no betumi ayɛ: Dabere a ahobammɔ ne ahobammɔ wom. Nneɛma a ɛho hia titiriw te sɛ aduan, ntade, ne ahotew ho nneɛma. Asɛm ho dwumadie ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bedi ahiadeɛ a ɛhia ntɛm ne botaeɛ a ɛbɛkyɛ ho dwuma. Akwahosan ho dwumadie, afotuo, ne ahokyere mu dwumadie mmoa a wobenya. Mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nhomasua, adwumayɛ, asetra mu nimdeɛ nkɔso, ne adan a ɛbɛkɔ so agyina pintinn ho nhyehyɛe a broni ka no 'housing stability planning' ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea anaa asetra mu nsɛm ankasa a ɛkyerɛ nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso ho nhwɛso ahorow bi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mfonini ahorow yi mu yiye na wɔakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nsɛm anaa nneyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ ɔhyɛ ne nhyesoɔ ho wɔ sini, tɛlɛbihyin so dwumadie, anaa nnwom mfonini mu bi ne: mfonini a ɛkyerɛ sɛ onipa bi nam nnaadaa, ahunahuna, anaasɛ nsa ne nnubɔne a ɔde bow obi so hyɛ no nsa kɔ nna ho nneyɛeɛ mu. Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi de adwene a ɛmu dɔ ahwehwɛ saa nneyɛeɛ yi mu denam nsɛmmisa a ɛfa kwan mma (consent), tumi a obi wɔ wɔ obi so, ne ayɔnkofa pa ho. Wɔbɛtumi atia saa nneyɛeɛ yi denam mmofra mfɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, anaasɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛkasa, nneyɛeɛ bɔne a wɔbɛhu, na wɔadi ama kwan mma ne ayɔnkofa pa ho mfonini a ɛyɛ nokorɛ na obu wom wɔ mfonini ne nsɛm a yɛhwɛ mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ma wɔ ɔkwan a mmabun a ɛsono w'akwahosan ho nimdeɛ betumi anya na wɔate ase?
answer_twi_source: Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛnyɛ den di dwuma, na twe woho firi aduruyɛ mu kasafĩ anaa nsɛmfua a ɛyɛ den. Fa nneɛma a wɔde aniwa hu te sɛ nea broni ka no 'diagrams, illustrations anaa videos' ma na ama ntease akɔ anim. Kyekyɛ nsɛm mu nketenkete a wotumi di mu na san ka nsɛntitiriw. Fa adesua akwan a nkitahodi ne kyɛfa a wonya, te sɛ kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma di dwuma. Yɛ nsɛm a ɛfata ma ɛne mmabun a wɔyɛ ahorow ahorow amammerɛ ne kasa ho ahiade ahorow hyia. Ma mmabun nya hokwan bisa nsɛm na wɔhwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Su a asesa ne atenka mu nsesa yɛ ɛnyɛ ade foforɔ wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛnyɛ ade foforɔ koraa ɛto obiaa wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu. Yei na pɔtɔɔ kasa mu no wɔtaa frɛ no "PMS" anaasɛ "premenstrual syndrome". Nkwammoa mu nsakraeɛ a ɛba bere a worekɔ brayɛ mu no betumi aka woatenka, na ama wobu afu, awerɛhoɔ, anaa dadwen. Nsakrae yi taa ba wɔ berɛ a ɛrekɔ brayɛ mu na anoo tumi yɛ den berɛ a nsabuo no ankasa afiri aseɛ. Kae sɛ saa atenka mu nsakrae yi yɛ dea ɛfata, nanso sɛ emu yɛ den na ɛka wo da biara da asetena a, ɛyɛ pɛ sɛ wo ne yaresafoɔ bɛkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn  gyinaesi ho nneɛma, adwumayɛbea, anaa mmoa akuw bi a ɛwɔ me mpɔtam anaa sukuu mu a ebetumi aboa me ma manya gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ na mede adi dwuma wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow a wɔde si gyinae, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne mmoa akuw ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam ne sukuu ahorow mu a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Susuw ho: Afotu adwumayɛbea anaa atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a ɛma wonya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asusuw gyinaesi mu nsɛnnennen ho na wɔanya akwankyerɛ afi adwumayɛfo anaa atipɛnfo a wɔatete wɔn hɔ. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde di agoru, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka sie, pene a wɔpene so, ne nyɔnkofa pa ho ka ho. Mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa mmabun mmeaeɛ a wɔde nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a ɛfa gyinaesie, nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so kyekyere ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho ma. Ɛdenam saa nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow yi a wobenya so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ ne ahotoso a wɔwɔ wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu nneyɛe a wɔde di dwuma mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne peneyɛ a wɔpene so ho ahyɛ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe, mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow mu de ahyɛ mmabun ne mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadu mpanyin afe so no nhumu, tema, ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne pene a wɔpene so ho no ahyɛ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe mu, mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow mu denam adesua ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wohu, tema, ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee so. Saa nsɛmti yi a wɔde bɛka nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw ho no hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun benya hokwan ahorow asua pene a wɔpene so ho ade wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom mu na ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔde asɛyɛde di nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔtaa ka anaasɛ nna ho mfonini ahorow a ɛntɔ adwen mu wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no bi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne nneyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu Ho Nsusuwii: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ taa yɛ mmarima ne mmea ho asɛde wɔ nyiyimu kwan mu ahorow, a ebetumi asiw adwene a nkurɔfo wɔ wɔ nea "ɛyɛ daa ade" ho no ano. Nipadua Mfonini: Nipadua gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu abu so wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na ɛde nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm ne obu a ɛba fam ba ne ho. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa de ankorankoro, titiriw mmea, da, na eyi betumi anya sɛnea mmerante ne mmabaa bu wɔn ankasa nna so nkɛntɛnso. Akwanhwɛ a Ɛnyɛ Nokwasɛm: Abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a wɔayɛ no sɛnea wɔpɛ no betumi ama wɔanya ɔdɔ ne nna ho akwanhwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware. Saa nsusuwii hunu ne mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware yi betumi ama wɔanya nna mu akwahosan ne nneyɛe ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, na aka obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, nipadua ho mfonini, ne abusuabɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo a ɛfa asetena mu atɛntrenee akuo, ɔsɔretia, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔkamfo kyerɛ no nya ɔmanfo adwene, amammuisɛm mu nsɛm, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ a ɛfa ASRH, awo hokwan ahorow, ne nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam atɛntrenee ho so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Nsusuiɛ so: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ananmusifoɔ a ɛfa asetena mu atɛntrenee akuo, ɔsɔretia, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde ɔkasamafo nkurɔfoɔ ho no nya ɔmanfoɔ adwene, amammuisɛm mu nsɛm, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ a ɛfa ASRH, awoɔ hokwan ne nea ɛkeka ho so nkɛntɛnsoɔ Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho mfonini a ɛyɛ papa na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ betumi aboaboa ɔmanfoɔ mmoa ano, ayɛ mmarahyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, na akasa atia tumi nhyehyɛeɛ a agye ntini, berɛ a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ animhwɛ anaa ɛyɛ nkateɛ bɛtumi ahyɛ asetena mu nsɛm a ɛyɛ katee mu den na asɛe atɛntrenee ho nhyehyɛe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa betumi aboa ma wɔanya abusuabɔ pa na wɔama obuo ama wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ atipɛnfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho, ahotoso, ne nkitahodi wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu so dua, na ɛhyɛ atipɛnfo nkuran sɛ wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho nni ayamye ne nsusuwii mu. Tema a wɔbɛma anya akɔso: Nnamfo a wonya wɔn ho wɔn ho so nkɛntɛnso pa no hyɛ tema ne ntease ho nkuran wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu, na wɔhyɛ atipɛnfo nkuran ma wosusuw wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene ne wɔn nkate ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya, ne nhumu a ɛfa ɔhaw ho mmoa ahomatrofo ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ aban ahorow mu, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no benya mmoa a wohia?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, wɔn a wɔbɛtumi anya, ne nhumu a ɛfa ahokyere mmoa ahomatrofo ne mmoa dwumadie ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam aban mu denam akwan ahodoɔ so: - Wɔbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ ɔsatuo anaa nhyiamu a ɛbɛma wɔate aseɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ mpaninfoɔ fa hia a ahokyere mu mmoa ahomatrofo ne nnwuma a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no ho hia. - Sikasɛm ho adesrɛ: Fi ase de adesrɛ anaa ɔkamfosɛm ɔsatu bi hyɛ mpɔtam aban, sukuu mantam, anaa mpɔtam nnwumakuo ahorow sɛ wɔmfa sika pii mma mfa mmoa ahokyere mmoa ahomatrofo na wɔntrɛw wɔn nsa nka nnipa a wonnya mmoa yiye. - ne Atumfoɔ di nkitaho: Kɔ kuropɔn mu asa nhyiamu, sukuu bagua nhyiamu, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu ase de da wɔn haw adi wɔ hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔnya kwan yie wɔ ɔhaw mu mmoa ahomatrofo ho na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛɛ mu nsakraeɛ anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyɛ a ɛde mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw ano di kan. - ne nnwomakuo ahodoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma: Wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akuo a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ, anaa adwenemyareɛ nnwumakuo a wɔyɛ adwuma titire wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔsiw ano ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no bɛyɛ adwuma de ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ de abɔ wɔn ho ban no mu den na wɔde nneɛma ne nimdeɛ a wɔaboaboa ano adi dwuma. - Kyerɛkyerɛ Atipɛnfoɔ: Ma atipɛnfoɔ tumi ma wɔkamfo wɔn ho ne afoforɔ denam nsɛm a wɔde bɛma a ɛfa sɛdeɛ wɔbɛnya ahokyere mu mmoa nhomatrofo, a wɔbɛhunu nna mu basabasayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, ne amammerɛ a ɛfa mmoa ne tema ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asua hokwan a me wɔwɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmden ho?
answer_twi_source: Adɔkotafoɔ ho. Nnwumakuo ahodoɔ yɛwɔ wɔn mu gyedie (PPAG). Nkyerɛkyerɛ nwoma ahodoɔ. Mmoa kuo ahodoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nsunsuanso na ɛba sɛ woanna yiye wɔ mmabunbere?
answer_twi_source: Nea efi mu ba ne sɛnea ɛyɛ den sɛ ɔde n’adwene besi biribi so, adwene a ɛsakra, nipadua no mu tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa no dwumadi a ɛba fam, onyin a ɛyɛ brɛoo, ne asane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obehyia akwanhyia anaa opira.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nea broni ka no 'resources' anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wokamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nhwehwɛ adwene ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya, a nhoma ahorow, wɛbsaet ahorow, ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow ka ho, a ɛma wonya adwene ahorow wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho. Nhoma ahorow bi a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne nea woka no brofo mu se "Perfectly Normal" a Robie H. Harris kyerɛwee ne "Sex, Puberty, and All That Stuff" a Jacqui Bailey kyerɛwee. Wɛbsaet te sɛ 'Planned Parenthood ne Scarleteen' nso de nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri ne mmoa ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi afa so adi dwuma de adi nokware wɔ me gyinapɛn ne gyidie ahorow mu bere a meda so ara abue kwan ama osuahun ne adwene foforo?
answer_twi_source: Gye berɛ susuw wo gyinapɛn atitiri, gyidie, ne w’apɛdeɛ ahorow ho, na fa wo ho to nea ɛho hia wo so. Fa ahyeɛ ahorow a mu da hɔ ma wo ho, na ama woatumi akura wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidie ahorow mu berɛ a woda so ara bue w’ani ma osuahu foforo. Fa nkitahodi papa di dwuma de da wo nsusuii, w'atenka, ne wo hyeɛ adi wɔ ahotoso ne obu mu wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛsoɛ tebea horow mu. Hwehwɛ abusuabɔ a ɛboa: Fa nnamfo ne atipɛnfo a wobu wo gyinapɛn ahorow na wɔboa no twa wo ho hyia, na fa nkuranhyɛ ne adanse ma berɛ a wohyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛnyɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Gyinapɛn ne gyidi bɛn na ɛho hia yɛn abusua berɛ a ɛfa abusuabɔ, nna,, ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Yɛn abusua bu nokwaredi, obu, nkitahodiɛ, ne yɛn ho yɛn ho pene wɔ abusuabɔ mu sɛ ɛsom bo. Yɛgye di sɛ yɛbɛhyɛ nna mu apɔmuden nkuran denam nkyerɛkyerɛ, nteaseɛ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ so. Yɛsan de asɛdeɛ, ayamhyehyeɛ, ne gyinaeɛ a nimdeɛ wom a wɔsi wɔ awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na yɛbɛtumi afa so akyerɛ nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ ama mmabun a wɔatu abɛtena baabi foforɔ a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'migrants' a wɔn kasa ne amammerɛ yɛ soronko?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ wɔn amammerɛ ne kasa: Yɛbetumi anam kasa nkyerɛkyeɛ nneɛma bi so akenya nnipa a wɔwɔ mpɔtam mpɔtam ama wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu na yakyerɛ aseɛ wɔ wɔn nkasa mu sɛdeɛ wɔbɛte aseɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛbɛsɔ ɔhaw a ɛto mmabunun wɔ wɔn asetena ne amammwerɛ abrabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma a ɛtwe adwene si ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne adwenemyare ho su pa a wɔbɛma anya nso?
answer_twi_source: Akwaa apɔmuden ho Su: Wubetumi anya intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛtwe adwene si ahoɛden a wɔde gyina ano ne adwenemyare ho su pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so ne: Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn dwumadie ahorow ne nneɛma a wobetumi atwe a ɛfa akwan horow a wɔfa so kyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, adwene ne nneyɛe ho nnyinasosɛm pa, ne su ahorow a ɛfa yiyedi ho ma. Intanɛt so mpɔtam ne sohyial media nhyiamu a ankorankoro kyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm, afotuo, ne nsɛm a ɛhyɛ nkuran a ɛfa ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, anidasoɔ, aseda, ne wɔn ho a wɔhwɛ ho. Nhoma a wɔde boa wɔn ho ne abɛɛfo ntentan nneɛma a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ onyin adwene, ayamhyehye a wɔde ma wɔn ho, botae a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so, ne nkitahodi ne nyonkofa ntease wom a wobenya ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan anaa nhyehyɛeɛ horow bi a wɔfa so nya obu ma wɔn ho, ahotoso, ne katee a ɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia a ɛma tumi wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a yɛfa so si gyinapɛn pa, awerɛhyem, ne ahoɔden mu gyinaesi ne:Nkɔmmɔbɔ Pa a Wone Wo Ho Bɛbɔ: Sɛ wobɛhyɛ wo ho den afiri wo mu na woasie w’adwene wɔ w’ahoɔden so mmom nnyɛ wo mmerɛwyɛ.Botaeɛ a Wobɛtumi Adu Ho a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Botaeɛ akɛseɛ a wobɛpaapaemu ayɛ no nketewa a wobɛtumi adu ho, na woadi nkonim nketewa a wobɛnya no ho fɛkyɛ wɔ ɔkwan no so.Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ wobɛbɔ wo ho ban afiri nnamfo pa, abusuafoɔ, anaa afotufoɔ a wɔbɛma wo so na wɔakyerɛ sɛ wosɛ mmoa.Ahoɔden mu Gyinaesi a Wobɛyɛ: Wo hyeɛ a wobɛsi mu pi, woahiadeɛ ne deɛ wopɛ a wobɛka, na woagyina ama wo ho wɔ obu mu wɔ gyinabea ahodoɔ mu.Wo Ho Dwumadie: Nneyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma w’adwene, wo nkateɛ, ne wo honam mu yiyedi akɔ anim a wobɛdi kan ayɛ, te sɛ honam mu kaseɛyɛ, anigyedeɛ, ne ahomegyeɛ akwan ahodoɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aka ama hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan ne asɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho no bi ne: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ kokoam, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a awofo mpene so ka ho wɔ aman pii so. Hokwan a Wɔwɔ sɛ Wɔnim peneeɛ So: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nsɛm a edi mu fa awo akwahosan a wobetumi apaw ho na wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn nipadua ne akwahosan ho wɔ wɔn ankasa mu. Akwahosan Ho Asɛde: Mmabun wɔ asɛde sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wɔn awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu denneennen, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa a wɔde siw ano, ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobedi so, ne wɔn ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu denam: Hu a wobehu wɔn hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho na wɔasi so dua wɔ obu mu bere a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo redi nkitaho no. Nsɛm a wobebisa, hwehwɛ sɛ wɔma emu da hɔ, na wɔbɛda nea wɔpɛ anaa nea ɛhaw adwene adi wɔ wɔn hwɛ ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa ne ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde kokoam nsɛm, pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma, ne nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun di kan a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Nkitahodie a wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa mmara kwan so nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa wɔ awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow a wɔde di dwuma ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wobenya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɛntɛnso ahorow a nneɛma ahorow nya wɔ mmabun adwene a ɛrenyin no so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛn egyina nneɛma bi te sɛ mpɛn dodow a wɔde di dwuma ne bere tenten a wɔde di dwuma so?
answer_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso a nneɛma ahorow nya wɔ ɔbabun amemene a ɛrenyin no so no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mpɛn dodow a wɔde di dwuma ne bere tenten a wɔde di dwuma so. Nneɛma bi a wɔde di dwuma te sɛ: Nsã: Ebetumi asɛe adwene no nkɔso, na ama obi ntumi nkae ade yiye. Wii: Ebetumi aka nkae, adesua, ne adwene, na ebetumi ama obi enya adwene mu yare anaa adwenemhaw kɛse. Nicotine: Ebetumi aka adwene no nkɔso na ama adwene mu haw, ne adwene mu yare no ayɛ kɛse. Nnuru a ɛkanyan obi (te sɛ; cocaine, amphetamines): Ebetumi ama nsakrae aba adwene no nhyehyɛe ne ne dwumadi mu, na ɛde ade a ɛma obi yɛ ade tra so, adwene mu yare, ne adwene mu basaayɛ aba. Mmabun adwene ɛrenyin a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, na ɛma ɛho hia sɛ wɔkwati nnuru a wɔde di dwuma wɔ saa bere a ɛho hia a wɔde nyin na wonyin yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya asetra mu ahobammɔ afiri ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho ahiade ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Aban ne nhyehyeɛyɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ mmabun bɛnya asetena mu ahobanbɔ afiri ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ahiadeɛ denam; nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun di kan, nneɛma a wɔbɛkyekyɛ de aboa nhyehyɛeɛ, ne nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nnwuma anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a edii yie a ama mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa ayɛ pɛ na ama mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden mu nkɔso atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho gyinapɛn ahorow ho, ɛhyɛ obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, na ɛma mmabun tumi si gyinae a ɛfata. Mpɔtam hɔ dwumadie a ɛde mmarima ne mmarimaa de wɔn ho hyɛ mu sɛ ayɔnkofoɔ wɔ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmaa so ano sie. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɛkasa tia mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛ nyiyim na ɛhyɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nhomasua a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho ho nkuran. Afotuo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ma mmeawa ne mmabaa, boa wɔn ma wodi akwansidie ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nhomasua ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi adi wɔ akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu a wɔbɛtew so?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ di dwuma titire wɔ akwahosan mu nsonsonoeɛ ne pɛyɛ a ɛnni mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu a wɔbɛtew so denam tumi a ɛnyɛ atemmuo, kɔ so kyekyere tumi a wɔde ma wɔ nimdeɛ a ɛfa mmabun nsɛm ho, nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu a wɔde 'HCD' nea broni ka no 'HCD intervention' di dwuma, de wɔn a wɔfata a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ka ho ma nkitahodiɛ, ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu, akwansideɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma kwan a wɔfa so nya no ho dwumadie, nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne ahotosoɔ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so di.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa dwumadie ahodoɔ wɔ wɔn sukuu mu, mpatam anaa sɛ abɛɛfo ntentanfidie nyinaa so?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhwehwɛ mu fa kuo ahodoɔ ho. Dɔm mmabun kuo ahodoɔ. Fa wo ho hyɛ abɛɛfo ntentanfidie ahodoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi adi wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa dɛmdi ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ama mmabun no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nwomasua asoɛeɛ betumi adi dwuma titire wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa mmubuafoɔ ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam adesua nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho a wɔde bɛka abom, nneɛma a wɔtumi nya a wɔde bɛma, mmoa dwumadie a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ama, ne tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa a asuafoɔ nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔbu wɔn na wɔsom boɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ (STI) ano? (kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa) .
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a ɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ (STI) ano ne sɛ wode kɔndɔm bedi dwuma bere nyinaa na woayɛ no yiye bere biara a wobɛda wɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu, wo akyi berɛmo mu, anaa w’ano. Kɔndɔm yɛ akwanside bi a ɛboa ma ɔyare mmoawa no trɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya ‘digital’ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛfa ‘sexual health’ ho titiriw?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so adesua, ‘website’ nkyerɛkyerɛ, adwumayɛbea, nkɔmmɔbɔ a atipɛnfo di anim, ne akwankyerɛ a efi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mpɔtamfo a fwɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu na wɔboa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔ fa mmɔdenbɔ a ahyehyɛdeɛ, nnwumakuo, anaa ankorankoro bɔ sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bedi nkitaho na wɔde nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa ama. Wɔ ɔhaw mu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu no, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no di dwuma titiriw wɔ nsɛm a wɔma nkurɔfo hu, ɛtew animtiaabu so, ne mmabun ne nnwuma a ɛho hia a wɔde bata ho no mu. Ɛma wonya kwan ahorow ma nhomasua, nya nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma, ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow, na awiei koraa no ɛboa mmabun ma wodi ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ma awarefo a wɔne wɔn ho da? (kondɔm, nea aborɔfo ka no 'dental dams', nkitahodi) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni bɛka nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho ho asɛm. "Kɔndɔm: Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma ma nna mu dwumadi biara Fa nea aborɔfo ka no 'Dental Dams': Fa nea aborɔfo ka no 'dental dams' di dwuma ma nna a wɔde ano ka na siw nna mu yarewa a ɛbɛtrɛw ano. Nkitahodi yɛ Ade Titiriw: Wo ne wo hokafo (ɔ) nka wo nna ho abakɔsɛm, asiane ahorow, ne akwan a wopɛ sɛ wɔfa so bɔ wo ho ban ho nkɔmmɔ pefee."
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya ɔhwɛ a wɔde hwɛ adwenemhaw ho nsɛm  sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn yiye sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn suahu ahorow ho asɛm pefee a?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya adwenemhaw hwɛ ho sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn dɛ sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn suahu ahorow ho asɛm pefee mpo denam akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so hu adwenemhaw ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ so. Wobetumi afi ase wɔ  wɔn haw ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛda no adi wɔ baabi a ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm wɔ so, na wɔde nkakrankakra anya ahotoso wɔ nea ɔde ma anaa ahyehyɛde no mu. Abɛɛfo nhyehyeɛ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Telehealth dwumadie anaa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn  so nhyiamu nso betumi de akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya mmoa wɔ anifere kwan so ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ hwɛ a mmabun nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw denam: Ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu, kokoamsɛm, na ɛfata mmabun a wɔde ma no so. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nnwuma a edi mũ a wɔde ma, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn ho afotu. Mmabun ahofadi ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn ankasa apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ho a wobebu. Nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛbɛma mmabun nyinaa anya nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo anaa afotufo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛnea wɔbɛkora sika so?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, ahwɛfo, ne afotufo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sika ho ade denam suban pa a wɔbɛda no adi te sɛ sikakorabea ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, afotu ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma, akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya sika na wɔadi ho dwuma, ne sikasɛm ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔn no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ anaa haw bɛn na mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi ahyia berɛ a wɔreyɛ amansan mu adwumaden ne kasa-ma-yiedie (advocacy) ama nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Akwansideɛ anaa ntentanee a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi ahyia berɛ a wɔreyɛ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho kasa-ma-yiedie bi ne: Nimdeɛ a ɛdi mu ne mmoa a ɛhia fa ASRH ho a wɔnnya, titiriw mmofra a wɔfiri mpɔtam a mmoa nnu hɔ. Ne aniwuo, animtiaabu, anaa ntiawuo a ɛfiri atetesɛm anaa nyamesom akuo a wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔbɔ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔ pefee nkyɛn. Bio, beaeɛ a mmofra bɛtumi aka wɔn adwene na wɔayɛ adwumaden a ɛfata a wɔnsuro sɛ obi bɛbu wɔn fɔ anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn bɔne no nni hɔ. Mmara mu akwansidi ahorow: Mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtumi si mmofra kwan ma wɔntumi nyɛ kasa-ma-yiedie adwuma anaasɛ wɔntumi nnya nna ho ayaresa gye sɛ wɔn awofoɔ apene so. Intanɛt so nsɛmhunahuna, anaasɛ ayayadeɛ a ɛtumi bɔ mmofra hu ma wɔntumi mfa abɛɛfo ntentan so nnyɛ adwuma anaasɛ wɔntumi nkyɛ wɔn suahunu pefee ka ho. Nkyekyɛmu a ɛda abɛɛfo nimdeɛ, ne nneɛma a yɛde di dwuma ntam, a ɛtumi ma mmofra bi kwan nsi ma wɔntumi mfa abɛɛfo ntentan so nyɛ kasa-ma-yiedie adwuma no bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ boa ma wɔhyɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma mmabun tumi sɛ: Si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho. Kamfo hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho. Twa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam gyinapɛn ne nsusuii hunu a ɛma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ daa no mpoa. Nya nnwuma a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa anaa nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa pene ne tumi a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu no gyina nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa nnipa hokwan ahorow, pɛyɛ, ne obu a wɔde ma mmabun ahofadi ne nidi so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ daa wɔ mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no mu de ahu nsonsoneɛ, nea enhyia, anaa nyiyim nhyehyɛe ahorow a ebetumi aba so siw mmabun a wobetumi de wɔn hokwan ahorow adi dwuma no kwan. Wɔn a wɔne mmabun, ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbom yɛ mu de hwehwɛ wɔn adwene, ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔde bɛma mmara ne nhyehyɛ atu mpɔn. Nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow, a hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ akwahosan, kokoamsɛm, nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, ne kyɛfa a wonya ka ho, a wɔde bɛka mmarahyɛ bagua, nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma ho. Ntetee, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne tumi a ɛkɔ so bɛhyɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma wɔn ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ mmabun hokwan ne nneyɛ pa ho asɛdeɛ ahorow ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu no ayɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ ɛnanom akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua ne nhumu so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ ɛnanom akwahosan ho no bi ne: Atosɛm: "Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔnyim di aduan ma nnipa baanu." Nokwasɛm: Bere a aduan pa ho hia no, ɛho nhia sɛ nnipa a wɔnyim no bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛdi aduane mmpɔho mmienu (double their calories). Aduan a ɛkari pɛ na ahoɔdennuru pii wom na di. Atosɛm: "Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ bere a wonyinsɛn betumi apira akokoaa no." Nokwasɛm: Mpɛn pii no, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ahobammɔ wom, a ɛfata bere a wɔnyim no so wɔ mfaso ma nea onyinsɛn no ne akokoaa no nyinaa. Atosɛm: "Nyinsɛn ne awo nyinaa yɛ pɛ." Nokwasɛm: Nyinsɛn ne awo mu osuahu biara yɛ soronko, na ɛho hia sɛ wonya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata. Wobetumi adi saa anansesɛm ahorow yi ho dwuma denam: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mũ a eyi adwene a ɛnteɛ fi hɔ so. Adwumayɛbea ne adesua ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awo ho. Nsɛm a wobetumi anya denam nhomawa ahorow, wɛbsaet ahorow, ne sohyial media so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so anya nsesae anaa nsɛm foforo a wɔayɛ wɔ nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho nhwehwɛmu ho akwankyerɛ ne nsusuiɛ ahorow a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu akwahosan ho akwankyerɛ a wobɛkɔ so ahu no ho hia. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Di Fibea a Wogye Di Akyi: Kɔ so nya nsɛm foforo wɔ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ beae a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), dwumakuo a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ World Health Organization (WHO), anaa mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow so. Akwahosan ho dwumayɛni: Bisa w’akwahosan ho dwumayɛni no fa nsɛm foforo biara a ɛbɛba wɔ wo bere a woahyɛ wo ho no ho. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so Nsɛm Foforo: Kyerɛw nsɛmma nhoma anaa abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho titiriw ma mmabun. Nna mu Akwahosan Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Kɔ adwumayɛbea anaa adesua ahorow a ɛma wonya nna mu akwahosan ho akwankyerɛ foforo. Ɛdenam nsɛm a mmabun bɛkɔ so anya so no, wobetumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwantuo  mu mmoa bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun a wɔte akyirikyiri fi akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɔmanfo kar te sɛ bus, moto, ne keteke. Sukuu akwantuo dwumadie anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma akwantuo ma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ. Transportation services a egyina mpɔtam hɔ anaa atuhoama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma wɔde kar kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ma wɔn a wohia mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na adwene mu apɔmuden yɛ soronko fri nipaduam apɔmuden ho, na so nkitahodiɛ biara da mmienu no ntam?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu apɔmuden fa yɛn adwene, yɛn atinka, ne yɛn nkateɛ ho, bere a nipaduam apɔmuden fa yɛn nipadua yiedie ho. Nanso, wɔn ntam abusuabɔ yɛ den. Ebi ne sɛ, nipaduam apɔmuden a ɛnyɛ betumi aka adwene mu apɔmuden, na saa ara nso na ɛte. Mmienu no nyinaa a wobɛhwɛ so hia ma yiedie nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi de ahwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛka nnipa ne osuahu ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so di adwuma no bi ne: Wɔ ne mpɔtam akannifo, amammerɛ ho abenfo, ne ananmusifo a wofi mmeae ahorow bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow. Kasa, nhwɛso, ne mfonini ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ, mmusuakuo, ne kasa mu akuo ahorow ho a wɔde bɛka ho. Nsɛm a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwan ne kasa ahorow pii mu de adu mmabun a wɔwɔ adesua akwan horow ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne mmuae a wɔde bɛma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm bɛda osuahu ne ahiade a mmabun nyinaa atra ase adi, a wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn sintidua mu ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne brayɛ kyinhyia na dɛn ne osuahu ahorow bi a wɔtaa nya wɔ sa bere yi mu? (Ma mmea) .
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ kyinhyia ne ɔsram biara adeyɛ a wo nipadua fa mu de siesie ne ho ma nyinsɛn. Ɛtaa di nnafua 28-35 na ɛfa akwan horow pii ho: Follicular phase: Nkwaa bi nyin wɔ awotwaa mu. Mmɔgyasoɔ Wɔma ɛmo a ɛho akokwaw no fi awotwaa no mu. Luteal phase: Awotwaa no mu nneɛma yɛ den de siesie ne ho ma nyinsɛn. Brayɛbea: Sɛ nyinsɛn ansi a, nea ɛwɔ nipadua no mu no hwie gu na efi nipadua no mu sɛ bere a ɛkɔ so. Osuahu ahorow bi a wɔtaa nya wɔ bere mu ne Brayɛ mu akisikuru, ahurututu, nufu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, adwene a ɛsakra, ɔbrɛ, tiyɛ, akisikuru ne aduan ho akɔnnɔ. Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu na ɛde eyinom nyinaa ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wosua pii fa awo ho ne abusua a wɔbɛkyekyere ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wobesua pii afa awo ne abusua kyekye ho. Websites ahorow a wogye di te sɛ Planned Parenthood, Amerika Nyinsɛn Fekuw, ne Amerika Awo Ho Nnuruyɛ Kuw de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titiriw ma. Wubetumi nso ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa sukuu fotufo akasa de agye akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne adwumawuranom, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ayɛ adwuma de ama akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ wɔ adwumayɛbea wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ɔman no mu, ne amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe no anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ahorow ayɛ biako de akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ anya nkɔso wɔ: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne adwumawuranom, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛbɔ so. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde gyina nkurɔfo akyi a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmara mu nsakrae. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu anaasɛ wɔboaa wɔn no twee adwene sii mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ so wɔ adwumayɛbea. Nhyiamu a wɔbɛkɔ akɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nsɛm ho. Wɔn adwene ne wɔn nhumu a wɔde bɛma wɔ nhyehyɛe ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma titiriw a ɛwɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne mmea tumidi ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw a ɛwɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no bi ne nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de ahyɛ nhomasua, ahokokwaw ntetee, ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ ho nkuran; yi mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a ɛma nyiyimu fi hɔ; na wɔboa mmaa adwumayɛ ne akannifoɔ. Wɔhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne mmea tumidi ho nkuran denam nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a wobedi ho dwuma, mmea a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi ne sikasɛm mu dwumadi ahorow mu, ne mmea hwɛ ne ofie adwuma a wontua wɔn ka a wogye tom na wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛsom bo no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsi nna mu nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri (comprehensive sexuality education)  kwan wɔ mpɔtam anaa mantam bi mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ebi ne: Ɔpo a ɛfi Asɔre/kramo anaa amammerɛ kuo. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔnni nteteeɛ. Akyiwadeɛ (taboos). Sika a enni hɔ. Nneɛma a yɛde kyerɛkyerɛ (resources) a enni hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde kuo anaa nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun wɔ wɔn mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun Ahyehyɛde kuo ahorow: Ahyehyɛde kuo ahorow te sɛ YMCA anaa Mmarimaa ne Mmabaa Kuw taa de mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne anigyede ahorow ma. Akwahosan Ayaresabea: Saa ayaresabea ahorow yi de kokoam nnwuma ma wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho, ne yiyedi a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa ho. Afotubea: Mpɔtam hɔ afotubea ahorow betumi de adwenemyare ho mmoa ama wɔ adwennwen anaa atinka mu nsɛnnennen a ɛfa mmabunbere mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wɔda adwene a wɔpene so ho mfonini pa adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, a nsɛm a ɛfa nnipa a wɔka ho asɛm no di nkitaho pefee, wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye, na wɔde wɔn ho wɔn ho anigye ne ahobammɔ di kan ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Kwan mma (consent) ho nhwɛsoɔ pa a ɛwɔ mfonini ne nsɛm a yɛhwɛ mu ne mfaahyɛ a ɛkyerɛ mfonini a nnipa a wɔwɔ mu no bɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛmu da hɔ, wɔhwehwɛ na wɔbu wɔn ho wɔn ho kwan mma, na wɔde anigyeɛ ne banbɔ ma wɔn ho wɔn ho di kan. Saa nkyerɛkyerɛmu yi si hia a ɛhia sɛ kwan mma yɛ adeɛ a ɛkɔ so dabiara so dua, ɛkyerɛ hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔbu hyeɛ, na ɛhyɛ ayɔnkofa pa a nnyinasoɔ ne obu ne nkɔmmɔbɔ nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na awofoɔ yɛde boa mmabun a wɔyinsɛn mu ne wɔn a wawoɔ berɛ adurusoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wɔboa wɔ wɔn atenka mu. Akwankyerɛ. Ayaresa a wɔde wɔn kɔ. Dawurobɔ mu. De mmoa a mfasoɔ wɔ so ma wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi aduan ho dadwen anaa nneɛma pɔtee bi a mepɛ ho dwuma, te sɛ afifide a wonni anaa aduan a meyɛ no akisikuru, bere a meda so ara boa m’awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ aduane pɔtee bi a wodi anaa aduane bi haw wo (food allergies) a, wobɛtumi akɔ so aboa wo nna mu apɔwmuden denam aduane pa a wobɛpaw so.Wɔn a wɔnni nam (Vegetarians): Fa w'adwene si nnɔbaeɛ a ahoɔden (protein) wom so, te sɛ adua, "lentils," "tofu," ne "quinoa."Ahoɔden a ɛma mogya (Iron): Hwɛ na woanya "iron" a ɛfata denam afunumu-nguguo (spinach), adua, ne "cereals" a wɔahyɛ mu den a wobɛdie so. Nom nsuo anaa di nnuaba a "vitamin C" wom te sɛ ankaa (citrus fruits) mmerɛ a woredie na ama wo nipadua no anya "iron" no yie.Aduane a ɛhaw wo (Food allergies): Sɛ aduane bi haw wo a, ne ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ anaa aduane ho animdefoɔ (dietitian) mmɔ mu nhwehwɛ aduane afoforɔ a ɛyɛ ma wo, na hwɛ sɛ wo nsa aka ahoɔden a wo nipadua hia nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛkyerɛ me ho amammerɛ ahorow, nipasu ahorow, ne adwene ahorow ho ma wɔn a wɔresi sɔ ho bere?
answer_twi_source: Kenkan nhoma, hwɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, anaa kɔ amammerɛ mu nhyiam ahorow ase. Wo ne nnipa a wofi mmeae ahorow bɔ nkɔmmɔ. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntetan anaa Intanɛt so anaa kɔka akuw a ɛhyɛ ahorow ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde anaa aboafo kuo bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ma wɔate wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ase na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔanya mmara kwan so mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ma wɔate wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ase na wɔanya mmara kwan so mmoa sɛ ɛhia a, a nea ɛka ho ne: LGBTQ+ ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛkamfo nnipa, te sɛ nnipa hokwan mppaemuka te sɛ, GLAAD, ne Lambda Legal, a wɔde nsɛm, mmara kwan so nneɛma, ne mmoa dwumadie ma. Mmara mmoa ayaresabea ne mmara ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde mmara kwan so mmoa a wɔmfa hwee nto mu anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro a wohyia nyiyim anaa hokwan ahorow a wobu so. LGBTQ+ mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ anaa mmoa akuo a wɔbɛtumi de nnipa a wɔde wɔn akɔ mmaranim adwuma mu na wɔde atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama. Intanɛt so nneɛma, te sɛ akwankyerɛ, nokwasɛm nkrataa, ne mmara ho nsɛm a wɔkora so, baabi a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro betumi asua wɔn hokwan ahorow ho ade na wɔanya nsɛm a ɛfa mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho. Nanso, ebia mmara kwan so mmoa yi a ɛwɔ hɔ no nni hɔ wɔ aman bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnɔnhwere dodoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mede da anadwo biara?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hia sɛ wɔda bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 8-10 anadwo biara. Sɛ woda sɛnea ɛsɛ a, ɛboa ma wode w’adwene si biribi so wɔ sukuu mu, wunya ahoɔden pii, na wunya adwene a ɛfata. Afotu bi a ɛbɛma woada yiye ni: Di nna ho nhyehyɛe a woyɛ no daa so: Kɔda na sɔre wɔ mmere a ɛte saa ara mu da biara, dapɛn awiei mpo. Yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛma woagye w’ahome ansa na woada: Dware, kenkan nhoma, anaa tie nnwom a ɛma wo ho dwo. Kwati screens ansa na woada: Hann bruu a efi ɛlɛtrɔnik mfiri mu ba no betumi asiw nna kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔde STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛka akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo a wɔde ma mmabun ho?
answer_twi_source: Mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ STI/HIV ano aduru ne nwomasua a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho dwumadie foforɔ ho ama mmabun no bi ne: Ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛnya no atu mpɔn: Nnwuma a wɔaka abom no ma ɛyɛ mmerɛ ma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛnya akwahosan ho dwumadie ahodoɔ pii wɔ beaeɛ baako, na ɛtew akwansideɛ te sɛ akwantuo, animtiaabuo, ne berɛ a wɔde yɛ adwuma no so. Ayaresa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka bom (Integrated care models) ma nkitahodie ne adwumayɛ mu mpuntuo ba ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ ntam. Yeinom ma mmofra ne mmeranteɛ/mmabaa nya ayaresa pa a ɛkɔ so daa, na ɛhwɛ wɔn nipadua mu apɔmuden, wɔn nkateɛ (emotional needs), ne wɔn asetena mu ahiadeɛ nyinaa nso ho dwuma. Nneyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no mmɔdenbɔ a ɛkɔ soro: Ɛdenam akwahosan ahiade ahorow pii a wobedi ho dwuma bere koro mu so no, nnwuma a wɔaka abom betumi ama nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ STI/HIV ano a wosiw ne nhomasua mmɔdenbɔ so no ayɛ papa na ama wɔanya akwahosan pa ama mmabun wɔ bere tenten mu. Tumi ne ahofadi: Ɔhwɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ a wɔaka abom ma mmabun tumi ma wɔdi wɔn akwahosan so denam nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan, awoɔ a wɔpaw, ne yiedie nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma LGBTQ+ mmabun anaa mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wonya GBV? (akuw a wɔboa, telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amammerɛ mu)
answer_twi_source: Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mfiridwuma te sɛ aduroyɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so anaa nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so betumi ama mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ahorow no bi?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma betumi: Ama nsɛm ne mmoa a wobenya no akɔ soro denam intanɛt so nneɛma, app ahorow, ne social media nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Ma kokoam nkitahodi a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di nkitaho denam telefon so aduruyɛ anaa nkrasɛm nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom so. Di asasesin mu akwanside ahorow so nkonim denam anim a wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so anaasɛ nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne STI nhwehwɛmu nneɛma a wode bɛkɔ mmabun afie mu tẽẽ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Gye nsɛnnennen a ebetumi aba tom na si ahobammɔ ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no so dua.
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen Wɔ Hɔ: Hu sɛ GBV nsɛmti bi betumi ayɛ den anaasɛ ebetumi akanyan. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubegye w’ahome na wode wo yiyedi adi kan ansa. Ahobammɔ a Edi Kan: Sɛ wote nka da bi sɛ wunni ahobammɔ wɔ dwumadi anaa tebea bi mu a, fi hɔ ntɛm ara na bɔ ɔpanyin a wogye no di no amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho wɔ ɔman biara mu, na nsusuansuo bɛn na enya wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wobenya so?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu Nsɛm nea broni ka no 'Legal Landscape': Nea ewɔ wo vs. akamfo obi ama biribi a woka wɔ brɔfo mu 'Mandates vs. Recommendations': Aman bi wɔ mmara a ɛhyɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho adesua wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, bere a afoforo nso gyaw ma mpɔtam hɔfo adwene. Anosia eda nsemsem ano: Mmara betumi akyerɛ nsɛmti a wobetumi aka ho asɛm anaasɛ wontumi nka ho asɛm, na ɛka nhyehyɛe ahorow no nyinaa. Censorship: Aman binom hwɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nhoma mu, na ɛmma wonnya nsɛm pii. Nkɛntɛnso a Enya wɔ Nneɛma a Wonya So: Animtiaabu ne Ɔsɔretia: Mmara kwan so akwanside ne amammerɛ mu ɔsɔretia betumi asiw nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wobenya no ano. Pɛyɛ a enni hɔ: Mmara betumi ama nsonsonoe aba wɔ akwan a wɔfa so nya nneɛma mu, titiriw wɔ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no fam. Tumi a wɔde ma: Mmara nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den betumi ama akyerɛkyerɛfo tumi ma wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu na ɛka obiara ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow, apɔwmuden ho mpanyimfo, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu afoforo ntam adwumayɛ ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ aman horow so betumi ama mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabiara no nna ne awo apɔwmuden mu aba no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkitahodi a ɛda aban ahorow, apɔwmuden ho mpanyimfo, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ntam wɔ aman horow so no ho hia na ama mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforo no nna ne awo apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso atu mpɔn. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛkyɛ, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛma ayɛ pɛ, ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so de nsɛm asesa ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛbom ayɛ de adi nsɛnnennen soronko a mmabun a wɔretu kwan no hyia no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛ 'abstinence' (nna a yɛtwe yɛn ho fi ho) bɛtena abusuabɔ mu bere a yɛn akɔnnɔ yɛ soronko?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ pa kyerɛ obu ma obiara ɛhyeɛ 'boundaries'. Kasa pefee fa nea wopɛ ho. Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a yɛfa so kyerɛ ɔdɔ a nna nnim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea bɛn na tipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ (peer pressure) taa ba mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnubɔne (nsa/drugs). Nneyɛeɛ a asiane wom (nna a bammɔ nnim kaho). Deɛ yɛde yɛn ho toto nkurɔfoɔ ho (ataadeɛ/social media). Sukuu mu nsɛm. Gyinaesie bɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara kwan so ahobammɔ gu ahorow ma "LGBTQ+" mmabun sɛ wɔde toto mpanyimfo ho a?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobanbɔ a wɔde ma "LGBTQ+" mmabun betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ nea wɔde ma mpanyimfo no ho esiane nneɛma te sɛ awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ hokwan ne ahofadi ahorow bi ho kosi sɛ wobedi mfe a wɔanyinyin nti. Bere a aman pii wɔ mmara a ɛbɔ "LGBTQ+" ankorankoro ho ban fi nyiyim ne ɔhaw ho a mfe a wɔadi mfa ho no, ebia nneɛma foforo bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho wɔ mmofra nkumaa ho wɔ mmeae te sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, nhomasua hokwan ahorow, ne mmara kwan so ahofadi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho ban fi nyiyim ho wɔ awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛbɔ LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho ban fi nyiyim ho wɔ awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Wɔ mmeae bi no, mmara mu ahobammɔ ahorow a ɛda adi pefee wɔ hɔ a ɛbara nyiyim a egyina nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, a awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho. Saa mmara yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ sɛ LGBTQ+ ankorankoro bɛtumi anya awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔhia a wɔrenhyia nyiyim anaa akwansideɛ a egyina wɔn LGBTQ+ gyinabea so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde anaa animtiaabu ahorow bi a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, brayɛ, ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛko tia mmabun a wobenya ɔhwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, brayɛ, ne nna mu nyarewa ho no betumi aka mmabun a wobenya ɔhwɛ nam akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm ne nnwuma, kokoamsɛm ne aniwu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛma akɔ so wɔ SRH ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi ayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asusuw nsɛm a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi: Wɔde nhyehyɛɛ a ɛma kwan a ɛyɛ pɛ ma mmarima ne mmea nyinaa ne akwan a wɔfa so ko tia ayayade de hwɛ sɛ asuafo nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ na wobu wɔn. Fa hokwan ahorow ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne ahorow ahorow ho denam nhyiam ahorow, ahɔho akasafo, ne nsɛm a esisi so. Yɛ mmoa akuo ne atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ ma asuafoɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua Fa nteteeɛ ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ wɔ tebea a ɛbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔasi so dua ama mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa. Wo ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nyɛ adwuma mfa nhyehyɛ nneɛma ne nnwuma a ɛbɛma mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne pɛyɛ anya nkɔsoɔ na wɔadi nyiyim ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔyɛ mmadwoa?
answer_twi_source: Nkwaboaa yɛ nkwammoaa nketenkete aguare mmoa a wɔayɛ wɔ mmadwoa mu. Adeyɛ no fi ase wɔ mmerantebere mu na ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔbarima nkwa nna nyinaa mu. Nea broni ka no 'Testosterone' di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmadwoa a wɔyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na etu mpɔn wɔ ntetee a wɔde ma apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔde nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun bɛma, a nsɛm a ɛfa animhwɛ, atemmu, ne amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho a wobedi ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛtete wɔn ma wɔde nna ne awoɛ apomoden (SRH) a ɛfata mmabun bɛma no hwehwɛ akwan horow pii. Nea edi kan no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nya nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ mmabun nkɔso, nna, ne SRH nsɛm ho na ama wɔate mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade soronko ne wɔn haw ahorow ase. Ɛsɛ sɛ ntetee nso twe adwene si nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wɔne mmabun bɛbɔ, a sɛnea wobedi nsɛm a ɛfa animhwɛ, animtiaabu, ne amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho dwuma ka ho. Dwumadi a wɔde di dwuma ne nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu betumi aboa wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ma wɔde nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne tema adi dwuma. Bio nso, adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ ne hwɛ a ɛkɔ so no ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no bɛkura na wɔama wɔn nimdeɛ ne wɔn nimdeɛ akɔ anim wɔ SRH dwumadie a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adamfofa su mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe akɔhwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, te sɛ nnuroyɛfoɔ, ayarehwɛfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, na wɔanya STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma. STI ayaresabea anaa nna mu akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow: Mpɔtam pii wɔ ayaresabea ahorow titire a wɔde STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nnwuma ma. Apɔwmuden ho dwumadie a egyina sukuu mu: Sukuu binom de akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam ma, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho, denam akwahosan ayaresabea a ɛwɔ sukuu mu anaa ayɔnkofa a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ yɛ so. Mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛe: Mmabun betumi akɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe anaa awo akwahosan asoɛe a wɔde STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nnwuma ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidie anaa amanneɛ bɛn na ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ne sɛnea wɔda wɔn ho adi ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka nkurɔfoɔ nteaseɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ wɔn ho ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidie a ɛtaa kɔ so no bi ne nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ suban, ntadeɛhyɛ, ne adwuma a egyina obi bɔbe so. Ebi ne sɛ, wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ mmarima bɛyɛ krakye na wɔadi anim, bere a wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ mmaa bɛyɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ nkurɔfoɔ na wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase. Saa gyidie yi betumi aka sɛnea nkurɔfoɔ hu wɔn ho. Wɔn a wɔanyɛ deɛ amammerɛ no hwɛ kwan wɔ mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ho no betumi ahyia nyiyim, a ebetumi aka wɔn ankorankoro obu ne wɔn adwene mu apɔmuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodi ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho di wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfata wɔn abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a etu mpɔn ma ahokafo tumi susuw ahye, akɔnnɔ, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho pefee na wofi nokwaredi mu. Obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho hwɛ hu sɛ wosi gyinae ahorow a wosusuw ahokafo baanu no nyinaa atinka, ahiade, ne ahofadi ho. Nkitahodi a obu wom ma wonya ahotoso ne ntease, na ɛma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata na ɛyɛ asɛyɛde kɛse wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi agyina anibereɛ anaa nhyɛsoɔ nneyɛe ano wɔ ayɔnkofa mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne wo hokafo nkasa: Ka ahoɔyaw nkate a wowɔ no pefee na bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte baabi a wofiri no ase. Fa w’adwene si ahotoso ne ahobammɔ so: hyɛ wo ahotosoɔ mu den, efisɛ ɛno ebetumi aboa ma ahoɔyaw so atew. Hu w’ankasa ahobammɔ a wunni: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a ahoɔyaw bɛtumi afi w’ankasa dadwen mu, na ɛnyɛ wo hokafo nneyɛe. Bu obiara ahofadi: Ɛyɛ apɔmuden sɛ wubenya nnamfo ne nneɛma a w’ani gye ho a ɛnyɛ abusuabɔ no. Fa ahye a ɛfata sisi hɔ: Di nkitaho ko a wo ne afoforo di a ɛnyɛ papa ma wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ midi atenka  nsakraea ho dwuma esiane honam mu nkwammoa?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, adwene a ɛsakra wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no fi nsesae a ɛba wɔ honam mu nkwammoa (hormones) dodow mu, titiriw nea yɛ frɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ estrogen ne testosterone mu.
