Saa nkwaadɔm yi betumi aka nnuru a ɛwɔ w’adwene mu a ɛhwɛ sɛnea wote nka no so, na ama nkate mu nsakrae mpofirim. Ebia wobɛte anigye nka bere bi na afei mpofirim ara woadi awerɛhow, wo bo afuw, anaa wo bo afuw. Eyi yɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere fã a ɛfata, nanso akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so adi adwene a ɛsakra ho dwuma, te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛteɛteɛ daa, akwan a wobɛfa so agye w’ahome, ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wobɛkasa afa sɛnea wote nka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea efi mu ba ma nhwehwɛmufo a wonni abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ahorow so wɔ nhwehwɛmu a, wɔyɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmufo a wɔanni abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ so wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no, betumi ahyia nea efi mu ba ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhwehwɛmu ho sika a wɔhwere anaa mmoa a efi nnwumakuw ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde sika ma no hɔ. Nhwehwɛmu nhoma ahorow a nhomasua ho nsɛmma nhoma anaa adwumayɛfo fekuw ahorow pow. Adwumayɛfo din ne ahotoso a wɔsɛe no wɔ nhwehwɛmu kuw no mu. Mmara kwan so nsunsuanso, te sɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa asotwe a mmarahyɛ bagua anaa abrabɔ pa ho boayikuw ahorow de ma. Ɔpira a ɛba wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu no so, a honam fam, adwene mu, asetra mu, anaa mmra mu asiane ahorow a ɛbata nneyɛe a ɛmfata ho ka ho. Ahotoso ne ahotoso a ɛso tew wɔ nhwehwɛmu asoɛe ahorow ne nyansahufo kuw no mu, na ɛkaa daakye nhwehwɛmu mmɔdenbɔ ne adwumayɛkuw ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe a ɛhyɛ nhomasua ne nsa-ano-nnwuma a ɛfata ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu, ne adwumayɛbea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de ‘social media’ ne mpɔtam hɔ Nhumu Ɔsatu ahorow (campaigns) adi dwuma, wɔbɛfa mpɔtam hɔ nkannifo so ne mmara nhyehyɛeyɛfo akasa. Wɔ ne ‘NGO’ ne mpɔtam hɔ akuwakuw bɛyɛ biako (alliance) abom ayɛ adwuma na afei wɔanam sukuu agyinatukuw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so akyɛ wɔn adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa anaa adwenem naayɛ wɔ me nna ho akɔnnɔ ne nneyɛe anaa me bɔbeasu ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Du mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, a wobetumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn mu no nkyɛn. Susuw ho sɛ wo ne akuw ahorow a wɔboa nna ho akɔnnɔ, intanɛt so mpɔtam, anaa mmoa nhama a wubetumi anya ntease ne gye a wogye tom no bɛbɔ. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛnya nsɛmmisa anaa adwenem naayɛ, na mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no yɛ anammɔn a ɛho hia, a ɛbɛma woate wo ho ase na woagye atom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka sɛnea yareɛ  ahorow a na ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw anaa adwenemyare ahorow betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔpaw no so nsunsuanso ho asɛm.
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa tebea horow bi anaa adwenemyare betumi anya awo ano aduru a wɔpaw so nsunsuanso. W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛhwɛ w’akwahosan ho abakɔsɛm mu na waka ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn sen biara a wobɛfa so akyerɛ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ tumidi nhyehyɛe anaa ɔsatu ahorow a edi mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wobesiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔama mmabun abɔ wɔn ho ban na wɔaka wɔn ho denneennen, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛte saa ara mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Ahobammɔ Adzesua: Hyehyɛ ahobammɔ ho adesua anaasɛ nhyiamu a wɔayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa wɔ sukuu mu, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu mbea, anaasɛ mmofra adɔyekuo mu.Asetenam Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Hyehyɛ dwumadie ahodoɔ a ɛbɛma nkuranhyɛ, kwan mma (consent), ne ayɔnkofa pa anya mpon, te sɛ "Manya Tumi" anaasɛ "Gyina Pintinn."Mmoa Akuo: Dom mmoa akuo anaasɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔasi wɔn bo sɛ wɔbɛsi nna ho nhyɛsoɔ kwan na wɔahyɛ nkuranhyɛ mpon, te sɛ sukuu mu banbɔ akuo anaasɛ mmofra ankasa wɔn akwankyerɛ.Intanɛt So Dwumadie: Fa wo ho hyɛ intanɛt so dwumadie a ɛma nkurɔfoɔ hu nna ho nhyɛsoɔ ne bɔne ho asɛm, kyɛ nkuranhyɛ afotu, na ma wɔn a wɔatumi agyina saa asiane yi ano no nne so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔn nnamfo, wɔn atipɛnfo, anaa wɔn mfɛfo sukuufo a wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ "sexual violence" denam atinka fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma, nneɛma a wɔde bɛma, ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔn sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ anaa mmra kwan so mmoa so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa nnamfo, atipɛnfo, anaa mfɛfo sukuufo a wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ denam atinka fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma, atie a wobetie a wonni atɛn, ne wɔn suahu ahorow a wobegye atom so. Sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmra kwan so mmoa a, ebetumi ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no anya nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛkyerɛ obu ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahofadi ne nea wɔpaw bere a wode mmoa ma no na w’adwene si wɔn kokoam nsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sikasɛm mu nnwuma, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne sikasɛm mu yiedi?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho adwumayɛ kyerɛ nneɛma ne ano aduro ahorow a sikakorabea ahorow, boseabɔ akuo, ne sikasɛm asoɛe afoforo de ma de boa ankorankoro ma wɔhwɛ wɔn sika so, nya boseabɔ, na wɔbɔ wɔn ho ban fi sikasɛm mu asiane ahorow ho. Saa nnwuma yi ho hia ma mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne sikasɛm mu yiedi efisɛ ɛma nnwinnade ne nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔakora sika, de wɔn sika hyɛ mu, na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe ama wɔn daakye sikasɛm botae ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, ne mpanyimfo afoforo betumi aboa mmabun, ma wɔate wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ase na wɔde adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpanyimfo afoforo betumi aboa mmabun wɔ ɔkwan bi sei: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛnyɛ atemmu a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata wɔn mfe so. Nkitahodi akwan a wɔabue na ɛboa a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wobebisa nsɛm, ahwehwɛ afotu, na wɔasusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho a wɔbɛbɔ. Mmabun kokoam nsɛm, ahofadi, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn ankasa nipadua ne abusuabɔ ho a wobebu wɔn. Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ, ne obu a wɔde ma nneɛma ahorow ho nkuran. Su pa ne suban pa ho nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa pene, nkitahodi, ne abusuabɔ pa a ɛwɔ abusua ne mpɔtam hɔ ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛboa ma wɔanya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun ne nneɛma a ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔpaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na awofoɔ fa so de nsɛm a edi mu fa mmabunbere ne nna mu akwahosan ho ma wɔn mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Fa Kasa a Ɛfata Mfe Di Dwuma: Fa nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow ma ɛne wo ba no ntease hyia. Fa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Ma: Fa nhoma, wɛbsaet, anaa video ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ma. Bua Nsɛmmisa no Nokwaredi Mu: Ɛsɛ sɛ awofo bua nsɛmmisa no nokware mu a wonni atɛn. Munsusuw Mpene Ho: Kyerɛkyerɛ pene, ahye, ne obuo wɔ abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔsa STIs, na dɛn ne ɔhaw anaa nsɛnnennen a ebetumi afi ayaresa no mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Wɔtaa de nnuro a ekum yare mmoawa, nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, anaa nnuru afoforo a wɔkyerɛw ma obi sa STI ahorow, a egyina ɔyare mmoawa pɔtee no so. Ayaresa no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛsa ɔyare mmoawa no, abrɛ yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne ase, na asiw ɔyare mmoawa no ano. Nsunsuanso bɔne a ebetumi afi STI ayaresa mu aba no bi ne akisikuru, ɔfe, akisikuru, akisikuru, anaasɛ nnuru afoforo a ɛne no di nkitaho. Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, STI ahorow a wɔansa no betumi de nsɛnnennen a emu yɛ den aba, te sɛ awo a wontumi nwo, ɛyaw a enni sabea wɔ akyi berɛmo mu, nyinsɛn mu nsɛnnennen, anaasɛ asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya HIV.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nsɛm ho amannebɔ ho nimdeɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔde bɛka atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, nnwuma a mmabun di anim, ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ, tumi, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde Wɔn Ho Bɛka Atipɛnfo Nhomasua Nhyehyɛe Ho: Mmabun betumi akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow nka atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, nnwuma a mmabun di anim, ne nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ, tumi, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho nkuran. Ɛnam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛka nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw ho so no, wobetumi ama wɔn mmɔdenbɔ no atu mpɔn na wɔama wɔn atipɛnfo tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm mu denneennen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ m’adwene mu akwaahosan so bere a midi nsɛm te sɛ nna mu nhyɛso anaa nipadua mfonini ho dadwen ho dwuma wɔ abusuabɔ bi mu no? (ahye a wɔde besi hɔ, ayamhyehye a wɔde ma wɔn ho) .
answer_twi_source: Ahye a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Sɛ wuhu wo sintɔ  ahorow na woka ho asɛm pefee a, ɛbɔ w’adwene ho ban wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Wo Ho Mmɔborohunu: Da ayamye adi kyerɛ wo ho. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi wɔ nna mu nhyɛso ho na wode wo yiyedi adi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahu nsɛm a nokware wɔm ne nea ɛyɛ ntrɔ bere a mede intanɛt ne digital akwahosan ho nneɛma redi dwuma de asiw STI/HIV ano na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ahu nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ne nea wontumi mfa ho nto so denam: Fibea a wobɛhwɛ mu: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din na wotumi gye di te sɛ aban akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow, nnuroyɛ akuo ahorow, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow hɔ. Kwati mmeae a enni akyerɛwfo a emu da hɔ anaasɛ da sika a wonya fi mu adi. Adansedie nkrataa a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu: Hwɛ akyerɛwfoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔde mmoa maeɛ no ahwehwɛdeɛ ne wɔn nimdeɛ de hwɛ sɛ wɔwɔ nimdeɛ a ɛfata wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne aduruyɛ mu. Nsɛm a wɔde gyina hɔ ma: Hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔde ama no yɛ nokware denam mmeae pii a wobɛhwehwɛ mu na wode atoto akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ, nhwehwɛmu nhwehwɛmu, anaa nsɛm a animdefo adwene hyia ho. Sika a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ: Hwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nea ɛyɛ foforo na ɛda mprempren akwankyerɛ, nyansahyɛ ahorow, ne nyansahu mu adanse a ɛfa STI/HIV ano a wosiw ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho adi. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wode bedi dwuma: Fa nsusuii pa hwehwɛ sɛnea nsɛm a wɔde ama no yɛ nokware, ɛnnyɛ nea ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛyɛ animhwɛ, na susuw adwene anaa adwene foforo ho ansa na wode atu anamɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia wɔ obiara a wɔbɛka wɔn ho na wɔagye wɔn atomu na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow a ɛtaa ba ne: Honam fam Akwan a Wotumi Kɔ: Ntrɛwmu a ɛnyɛ papa, apon teateaa, anaasɛ aguaree a wontumi nkɔ hɔ a wonni. Nkitahodi Akwanside: Mumu kasa asekyerɛfo, mfiridwuma a ɛboa, anaa nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw so a wonni. Animhwɛ a Wonnim: Nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho a apomoden ho adwumayɛfo kura. Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm ho nimdeɛ a wonni: Ebia apomoden ho adwumayɛfo nnim mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiade pɔtee bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛtumi aboa wɔ yɛsi mpotam a ɛhodwo, a obiara ka ho wɔ ntanɛt so de ɛde nkɔmmɔ na esua adeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apommuden ho afa wɔn asem ho amane bɔ nkyerekyere so a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'digital media literacy skills'?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi: Abɔ ɔhaw mu nsem Kɔkɔ -  Ahyɛ ateetee anaa nsem a enni mu ho nso. ɔho. Pia anpa yɛ mu nsem: Kyɛ nsem a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na obiara ka ho bi. Sua kasa Pa: Da suban pa edi. Kyerɛ wotipɛn: Boa Afoforo na wɔnte intanɛt so bammɔ ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mfonini ahorow a ɛkyerɛ mpeneso wɔ media mu no nya suban, gyidi, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu nkitahodi, ahyeɛ, ne nkitahodi a ɛwɔ mmabun ne mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadu mpannin mfeɛ so mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mfonini ahorow a ɛkyerɛ mpeneso wɔ media mu betumi anya suban, gyidi, ne nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso wɔ mmabun ne mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadu mpannin afe so mu denam ntease a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ nea ɛyɛ nneyɛe a wogye tom wɔ abusuabɔ mu no so. Media ahorow betumi ama nneyɛe a ɛde ɔhaw ba te sɛ nhyɛso anaa nnaadaa a wɔyɛ no ayɛ nea ɛfata, na ɛde adwene a ɛyɛ basaa wɔ mpeneso ho na ɛma nsusuii hunu a epira a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne nna mu nkɔso ho no akɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa aboafo nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mate ase na makasa ama hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woate wo mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ase na woakasa ama wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, Ɔmanfo Akuo (CSOs), akuo a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow so no betumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so nneɛma, ne ɔkasafo ɔsatu ahorow a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛma mmabun tumi na wɔahyɛ ho nkuran ama mmara kwan so hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow ho nimdeɛ. Apomoden adwumayɛbea a egyina sukuu so, mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, ne apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmabun adamfofa kwan so no betumi de nsɛm, afotu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ a ɛfa mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow, apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ mmaeɛ nhyehyɛe ne aguade ho dawurubɔ nneyɛe betumi anya mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nkrasɛm a wɔde di gua na ebetumi apira wɔn a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipadua mfonini ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi bɛbea algorithms(akontaabu nhyehyɛeɛ) ne aguade ho dawurubɔ nneyɛe betumi akyerɛ sɛnea mmabun bɛda nneɛma a ɛfa SRH ho adi: Nkrasɛm a wɔde di gua: Algorithms betumi de nneɛma a ɛne aguadi mu anigye hyia adi kan na ahyɛ ho nkuran, na ama mmabun ahu aguade ho dawurubɔ ne nsɛm a wɔboa a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipadua mfonini ho. Nneɛma a ebetumi apira: Nkrasɛm a wɔde di gua na ebetumi apira obi a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu dodo no betumi ama wɔanya akwanhwɛ a enni mu, nipadua ho mfonini ho nsɛm, ne nna ho adwene a ɛnteɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya me nipadua ho mfonini pa ɛmfa ho sɛ mewɔ ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Afotu bi a wode w’adwene si w’ankasa wo hu soronko so ni: Fa w’adwene si nea wo nipadua betumi ayɛ so: Susuw nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa a wo nipadua ma wo kwan ma woyɛ nyinaa ho, te sɛ mmirikatu, asaw, agumadi, anaa adwinni a wɔ.bɔ. Fa nkɛntɛnso pa twa wo ho hyia: Di social media akontaabu ahorow a ɛhyɛ nipadua ahorow a egu ahorow ho afahyɛ na ɛhyɛ wo ho dɔ ho nkuran no akyi. Twa adwene a ɛnteɛ ho mpoa: Sɛ wowɔ wo nipadua ho adwene a ɛnteɛ a, bɔ mmɔden sɛ wode adwempa besi ananmu. Fa w’adwene si akwahosan so, na ɛnyɛ kɛse: Nnuan a ahoɔden wom a wubedi ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛyɛ daa no ye ma w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi nyinaa, ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛtew wo mu duru so kɛkɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn  na wɔfa so kasa fa ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ho nsɛm a egu ahorow na ɛka obiara ho kyerɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ atitiriw mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa w’adwene si Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm a Wɔka Ho So: Kasa ma  nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nnyina ma wɔn da dɛmdifo tebea ne ananmu ahorow adi  . Eyi hyɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔde wɔn bɛka ho no ho nkuran wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so, efisɛ wɔka mmubuafo kuw a ɛtrɛw no ho. Di Nneɛma Ahorow Ho Afahyɛ: Boa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ Ghana mmabun ahorow ahorow ho afahyɛ, a wɔn a wɔadi dɛm ka ho. Eyi betumi ayɛ talente ho ɔyɛkyerɛ, adwinni ho ɔyɛkyerɛ, anaa sohyial media nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow a ɛwɔ nneɛma ahorow no nyinaa mu kyerɛ. Hyɛ Nhwɛsoɔ Pa ho nkuran: Twe adwene si Ghana mpaninfoɔ a wɔadi dɛm a wɔabue wɔn ani wɔ wɔn nipasu ho (sɛ ɛfata a). Eyi betumi akanyan mmerante ne mmabaa na akasa atia nsusuwii hunu. Boa Nnwuma a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Dedaw: Hwehwɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ mmubuafo hokwan anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa bere tenten nsunsuanso ɛwɔ awofoyɛ ne  mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma? (nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa awofoyɛ ne mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho) .
answer_twi_source: di w’akwahosan ho dwumayɛni anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ a ɔbɛma wo nsɛm a ɛhia ne mmoa a ɛfa mmofra hwɛ anaa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa me nnamfo anaa mfɛfo a wɔahu sɛ wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nnamfo anaa atipɛnfo a wɔahu sɛ wɔwɔ nna mu yarev a wɔbɛboa wɔn no fa: - atinka fam mmoa ne awerɛhyem a wɔde bɛma a wonni atemmu anaa animtiaabu. - a wode nsie ne tema tie won haw ne won atinka. - a wode bu won kokoamu nsɛm ne kokoamsɛmu a ɛfa wɔn apomoden tebea ho. a wode nsɛm a ɛfa sɔhwɛ, ayaresa, ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ho bɛma , a wobɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ ayaresa na wɔde ma sɛ sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛka wɔn ho akɔ nhyiamu. - a wobɛkasa atia animtiaabu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ denam ntease ne gye a wogye tom a wobɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wo asetena mu kuw no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de ntentanfidie, mfiridwuma, ne dijitaal akwan adi dwuma ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo adi nkitaho na wɔama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de ntentanfidie, mfiridwuma, ne dijitaal akwan adi dwuma ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo adi nkitaho na wɔama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho denam: Hashtags, intanɛt so ɔsatu, ne ɔhaw a ɛrekɔ so a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akyɛ nsɛm, na wɔakasa atia animtiaabu a atwa ASRH ho ahyia no so. Multimedia nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ na wɔakyɛ, te sɛ video, infographics, ne blog posts, a ɛka wɔn atipɛnfo na ɛkanyan nkɔmmɔbɔ fa pene, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI ano a wosiw, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ intanɛt so nhyiamu, webinars, ne virtual events a CBOs, nnwumakuo a mmabun di wɔn anim, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ hyehyɛ de susuw ASRH nsɛmti ho, bisa nsɛm, na wɔne abenfoɔ ne atipɛnfoɔ di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nhyɛso ntase betumi aboa me ma mayɛ obi a ɔde ne ho na ɔwɔ ahotoso kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma obi hu ne ho yiye: Sɛ wuhu nkɛntɛnso a atipɛnfo nhyɛso nya a, ɛma wutumi si gyinae ahorow a ɛfata a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia. Ɛhyɛ ahofadi ho nkuran: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wobɛte ase no ma wunya tumi a wode si w’ahofadi so dua, na wode ahotoso fa asetra mu tebea horow ne gyinaesi mu. Ɛma ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano: Sua a wosua sɛ wobɛko atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɔne no ma wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, na ɛma wotumi di ɔhaw ne akwanside ahorow so nkonim wɔ asetra mu nneɛma ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia na wɔasesa asɛm a ɛfa nipadua mfoni ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu denam, mfoni ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na ɛyɛ nokware kɛse a ɛda nnipa nipadua ahorow adi a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa atia na wɔasesa asɛm a ɛfa nipadua mfoni ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu denam gyinabea ahorow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ nokware kɛse a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ denam: Abɛɛfo ntentan akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nne ayɛ kɛse, akyɛ ankorankoro nsɛm, na wɔahwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ahorow ahorow ne nokware kɛse wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu. Ɔsatu ahorow, adesrɛ ahorow, ne ɔsɔretia a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae wɔ nnwuma mu na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae de hyɛ nipadua ho mfonini pa ho nkuran na wɔko tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkɛntɛnso a epira mu kyɛfa a wobenya. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔbɔ, wɔn a wɔnya nkɛntɛnsoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn nyinaa ka ho, ahodoɔ, ne nipadua mu nneɛma pa di kan wɔ wɔn nsɛm ne nkrasɛm mu a, wɔbɛboa na wɔahyɛ wɔn ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yebetumi afa so adi ayayade anaa ayayade a wɔyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan bi so a ɛbɛbɔ me ne nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no ho ban? (amanneɛbɔ akwan horow, de-escalation akwan horow).
answer_twi_source: Bɔ Wo Ho Ho Ban: Mma wo ne osisifo no nni nkitaho. Siw wɔn kwan na kwati sɛ wubebua wɔn nkrasɛm. Bɔ Ayayade Ho Amanneɛbɔ: Mpɔtam dodow no ara wɔ nnwinnade a wɔde bɔ amanneɛ wɔ ɔhaw ahorow ho. Bɔ ayayade no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ asɛnka agua a ɛrekɔ so no. Boa Nea Wɔayɛ no Ayayade no: Sɛ wuhu sɛ wɔreyɛ obi foforo ayayade a, fa kokoam nkrasɛm mena no de boa no, na hyɛ nyansa sɛ wɔmfa ayayade no ho amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa adwen mu dwumadie ne kwan a mmabun a wɔyinsɛn besiesie wɔatenka apɔmmuden.
answer_twi_source: PPAG (akyerekyer). 'Ghana Psychological Association'. adwen mu apɔmmuden mpanyinfo (0800678678). Sukuu ayaresanii. 'Coping': Ahomegyeɛ, Mmoa kuo, 'Therapy'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ afoforo te sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde twe wɔn ho fi ho nkutoo ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu yɛ soronko wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho nkutoo ho wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yare, ne nkiotahodi pa ho a wɔde ma de ka ho a wosi so dua sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho sɛ ɔkwan biako no so. Nea ɛnte sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde twe wɔn ho fi ho nkutoo no, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ gye tom sɛ mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu na wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ ɛbɛma wɔanya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛpaw nneɛma a ɛfata na wɔatew asiane so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ ɛnanom apɔwmuden nsɛm ho, na kwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma nyinsɛn a ɛyɛ papa fi mu ba?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka ɛnanom apɔwmuden nsɛm ho ne hwɛ a wonya no berɛ a wɔnyem mu, a nea ɛka ho ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn daa bere a wɔyem no. Nea ɛka ɔhwɛ yi ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ onipa a onyinsɛn ne akokoaa a ɔrenyin no nyinaa apɔwmuden so, wɔde aduannuru a ɛho hia ne nneɛma a wɔde ka ho bɛma, na wɔahwehwɛ ɔhaw anaa yareɛ biara a ebetumi aba no mu. Aduan pa a wonya, vitamin ahorow a wonya ansa na wɔawo, ne aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa nyinaa boa ma nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom na ɛte asiane a ɛwɔ awoɔ mu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ a ɛne wɔn ahiade, wɔn anigyede, ne wɔn amammerɛ hyia, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔafa mpɔtamfo ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadi ne Nneɛma a Wɔayɛ no Foforo a Wɔkamfo: Mmabun bɛtumi akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ a ɛne wɔn ahiadeɛ, wɔn anigyeɛ, ne wɔn amammerɛ hyia, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na ɛfa mpɔtam ahodoɔ ho. Wobetumi ne akyerɛkyerɛfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako ayɛ nneɛma a ɛda osuahu ne adwene a mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow atra ase adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi adwenemyare a wɔansa bere tenten mu aba wɔ mmabunyɛberɛ?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu yare a wɔansa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no betumi de nneɛma a emu yɛ den aba berɛ tenten mu, a nea ɛka ho ne adesua mu haw, asetena mu abusuabɔ a asɛe, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, obi a obepira ne ho, ne asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obi bekum ne ho. Adwene mu haw ahorow nso betumi aka nipadua mu akwahosan, adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow, ne asetena pa nyinaa wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ so sɛ wɔansa a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ mpɔtam nkitahodie (community engagement) so wɔ SRH mu daakye?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankorɛ: Mmabun a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ. Mpɔtam: Nkabom ne ahoɔden. Apɔwmuden: Nkɔsoɔ ne pɛyɛ. Aban: Nniso pa ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne ɔhokafo bi adi nkitaho yiye afa pene, ahye, ne akɔnnɔ ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Bue ne Nokwaredi: Ka wo nkate, w’akɔnnɔ, ne wo hye ho asɛm pefee na tẽẽ. Tie a Wode Nsi So: Tie wo hokafo no yiye na bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte n’adwene ase. "Me" Nsɛm: Fa "Me" nsɛm kyerɛ wahiade a womfa asodi no nto wo hokafo so (sɛ nhwɛso no, "Mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ bere a wo..." sen sɛ wobɛka "Wo bere nyinaa..." ). Nkitahodi a obu wom: Kwati sɛ mobɛbɔ mo ho din, mobɛteɛteɛm, anaa mobɛtwa mo ho mo ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abu afoforo anaa nnnipa kokoam nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so, titiriw wɔ nna ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Bu afoforo kokoam nsɛm denam wɔn kokoam nna ho nsɛm a, wobɛkyɛ anaa wobɛkyekyɛ a wompene so no so. Kwati sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nsɛmmɔnedi mu anaasɛ wobɛtrɛw afoforo nna mu nneyɛe anaa wɔn abusuabɔ ho nsɛm mu. Hwɛ yiye bere a worekyɛ anaa woresan de nna ho nsɛm akɔ Intanɛt so de abɔ ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no, kokoam nsɛm ne nidi ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na pɛyɛ a enni mmarima ne mmea ntam no haw mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ a enni hɔ betumi ahaw mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow denam nsɛm, nnwuma, ne tumi a wɔde besi gyinae a wɔbɛto ano hye so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ abusuabɔ mu no betumi ama wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wonni nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma so, na atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow betumi asiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan anaa awo ho paw ho no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow ne mpɔtamfo betumi abom ayɛ nneɛma a ɛhyɛ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya ahofadi fi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ mu no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi ayɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ tebea horow a ɛhyɛ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya ahofadi fi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ mu ho nkuran denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne siw ano nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma, mmoa a wɔde ma ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔn, amammerɛ a wɔde bu ne pene a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛhyɛ ase ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a ɛboa ma basabasayɛ ba no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma na wɔadi ahye a ɛwɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu no ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Obu ne nkitahodi yɛ ade titiriw a ɛma obi nya nna a ahoɔden wom na ahobammɔ wom. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Mpene a Wɔde Amanneɛbɔ Ma: Ansa na wɔbɛyɛ nna mu adeyɛ biara no, ɛsɛ sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa de pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ wobɛpene nea ɛrekɔ so no so wɔ ahofadi mu a nhyɛso anaa nsakrae biara nni mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mo baanu nyinaa te nka sɛ mo ho tɔ mo na mote asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ mu no ase (te sɛ STI ne nyinsɛn). Ahye a Wobu: Obiara wɔ nna mu ahye, a ɛyɛ nea ɔte nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no wɔ honam ne nkate fam no ntam. Ɛho hia sɛ woka w’ahye kyerɛ wo hokafo na wubu wɔn de. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nneɛma te sɛ nsa a wɔde ka wo ho ahorow a ɛnyɛ hwee, nea wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ, ne ahobammɔ (condom) a wode bedi dwuma. Kae: Bere biara wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi wɔ nna mu dwumadi biara ho, berɛ biara. Mma nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛyɛ biribiara a ɛnyɛ wo dɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, ɔsom, ne asetena mu gyidie ka awoɔ hokwan ne nipadua so tumi ho nkɔmɔbɔ?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ, ɔsom, ne asetena mu gyidie betumi aka awoɔ hokwan ne nipadua so tumi ho nkɔmmɔbɔ kɛse. Saa gyidie yi betumi ahyɛ: - Adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ awoɔ nnwura, mpopɔ, ne nna ho. - Nteaseɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ne nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ awoɔ mu gyinaesie ho. - Nna mu apɔmuden dwumadie a wɔbɛnya anaa wɔbɛgye atom wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. - Animguase anaa nyiyim a nkurɔfoɔ a wɔrehwehwɛ awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makɔ amammerɛ ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Afotufoɔ: Sukuu afotufoɔ anaa adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama. Mpɔtam Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow so no taa de nneɛma ne mmoa ma de fa amammerɛ mu nsusuwii ahorow mu. Intanɛt so Nhyiamu: Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nhyiamu ne mpɔtam bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛtumi asusu saa nsɛmti yi ho wɔ kokoam na woanya afotuo afiri w’atipɛnfoɔ hɔ. Ntrɛwmu: Nna mu akwahosan ho telefon ahorow betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama, a akwankyerɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ne abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm ka ho. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa abɛɛfo ntentan beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so. Nhoma ne Nsɛm: Nhoma ne nsɛm pii wɔ hɔ a wɔakyerɛw afa amammerɛ, abrabɔ pa, ne nna mu akwahosan ntam a ebetumi ama yɛanya nhumu a ɛsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mede edinnsiananmu a ɛnteɛ di dwuma ma obi wɔ akwanhyia mu a, akwan bi bɛn na mɛfa so asiesie mfomso no ?
answer_twi_source: Wɔmma eyi ho kwan wɔ Ghana ha
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tiawa di dwuma de bu anansesɛm a wɔtaa ka fa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no gu.
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano ma obi mu duru yɛ kɛse. Nokwasɛm: Nyansahu mu adanse ntumi nnye asɛm a wɔka sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano ma obi mu duru yɛ kɛse no ntom. Atosɛm: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm abien bedi dwuma a, asiane biara nni ho sen sɛ wode biako bedi dwuma. Nokwasɛm: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm abien di dwuma a, ɛma ne mu pae ntɛm ɛnam sɛ nneɛma mmienu no bɛtwitwi wɔn ho  nti, na ɛno ma adwuma pa a ɛyɛ no so tew. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wode kɔndɔm biako bedi dwuma yiye. Atosɛm: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano ma obi ntumi nwo. Nokwasɛm: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano pii mma obi nyɛ bonini. Mpɛn pii no, awo san ba bere a wɔagyae awoɔ ntentenee aduro a worenom anaasɛ woayi aduro a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu (IUD) no afiri hɔ. Atosɛm: Twe a wɔtwe firi ɔbaa no mu yɛ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano. Nokwasɛm: Saa kwan yi nyɛ adwuma yie kɛseɛ de siw nyinsɛn kwan na ɛmmɔ obi ho ban mfi STI ho. Atosɛm: Mmaa nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ awoɔ ntentenee. Nokwasɛm: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano wɔ hɔ ma mmarima ne mmea nyinaa, a kɔndɔm ne sterilization ka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Intanɛt so amansan nkitahodie anaa mmoa akuo bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ne afoforo a wɔrehyia adwene mu akwahosan ho haw a ɛse fɛ adi nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne mmoa akuo ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔrehyia adwenemyareɛ a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Reddit mpɔtam te sɛ r/Anxiety, r/Depression, ne r/TeenageSuicide a ankorankoro bɛtumi akyɛ osuahu na wɔahwehwɛ afotuo ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan bɛn na wɔn a wɔwɔ mental health haw wɔ ne kwan bɛn so na wobetumi akasa ama wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam-yɛ. dwumadie ahokwan. Ayaresa. Kasa ma woho wɔ w'adesua mu, hwehwɛ mmoa, kasa w'ahiade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ho wɔ abusuabɔ ahorow mu, te sɛ mfe a wɔadi mu nsonsoe, tumi a ɛkɔ so, ne pene a wɔpene so no so?
answer_twi_source: Mfe a a Wɔadi Mu Nsonsonoe: Mmara taa kyerɛkyerɛ mfe a mmara ma kwan so de pene so ma nna mu kyɛfa. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mfe a mmara kwan so adi wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ na wohwɛ hu sɛ ahokafo nyinaa adi mfe a mmara ma ho kwan. Tumi a Ɛyɛ Nkɔso: Abusuabɔ a ɛda tumi a ɛnkari, te sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne osuani anaa adwumawura ne odwumayɛni ntam no ma mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho haw ahorow sɔre. Wobetumi agye pene a wɔpene so wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa mu ho kyim esiane nhyɛso anaa ayayade a ebetumi aba nti. Mpene: Mpene a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ anigye a wobɛte ase na woanya no ho hia. Nkitahodi ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho yɛ nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma obi nya abusuabɔ pa. Abrabɔ Pa Ho Nsusuwii: Nea ɛka abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ho ne sɛ wobebu ahofadi, kwati sɛ wɔbɛpira, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ tumi yɛ pɛ wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Akwankyerɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ no betumi aboa ma wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm a emu yɛ den ho dwuma. Mmara kwan so afã horow a ɛfa nna ho no ho ntease ho hia kɛse na ama wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow a mmabun a wonni akwahosan ho insurance betumi afa so anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wonni akwahosan ho a broni ka no 'insurance' no wɔ akwan pii a wɔbɛfa so anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe: Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ne ayaresabea ahorow taa de nnwuma a ɛho ka sua anaasɛ wontua hwee ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ fam so a egyina sika a wonya so. Nhyehyɛe ahorow bi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nnaa mu yareɛ a broni ka no 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ma mmabun a wontua hwee anaasɛ wɔ ate so, te sɛ  a broni ka no 'Title X' ayaresabea ahorow. Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow betumi de nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ama a wɔatew ka so anaasɛ wɔrentua hwee. Nea broni ka no 'Planned Parenthood' ayaresabea ahorow de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow pii ma, mpɛn pii no wɔde sika a ɛkɔ fam anaasɛ wontua hwee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu adwene bɛn na ɛfa sebi dɛmdi ho wɔ Ghana ne amanone amanman ahodoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ dɛmdi ho gu ahorow kɛse: Ghana Nsɛm a Ɛfa Ho: Wobetumi aka sɛ sebi dɛmdi fi nneɛma a ɛboro nnipa de so anaasɛ wobehu no sɛ adesoa. Wiase nyinaa: Adwene ahorow fi nea wɔde ka ho so kosi tew a wɔtew wɔn ho ne ehu so. Nteaseɛ a Ɛho Hia: Amammerɛ mu gyidie betumi anya nhomasua, adwuma, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm nya no so nsusuanso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na nkyerɛkyerɛ ne anidahɔ anammɔntuo aboa ayi gyedie hunu, atoro ne adwene bɔne a ɛboa ma wɔde bu nna ne awoɔ apɔmden ho animtia, deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ ' stigma surrounding sexual and reproductive health'?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔmden ho a ɛnam nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie mapa so. Ɛnam nkɔmmɔtwetweɛ ne nkitahodie ahodoɔ so ko tia adwene bɔne ne gyedie hunu . Hyɛ mmabun nkuran wɔ nimdeɛ mapa mu ne adwene a mmabun debetumi abisa nsɛm afa amammerɛ ako atia animtiabuo na aboa ama wɔsisi gyinaeɛ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mbaa ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ atetesɛm sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho yɛ nhyehyeɛ ne dwumadie a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sikasɛm mu hokwan ahodoɔ, nea ɛfiri mu ba, ne gyinaesie mu. Wɔyɛ soronko wɔ atetesɛm sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ho denam mmarima ne mmea ntam nkɔso, tumi abusuabɔ, ne nkɛntɛnso soronko a nhyehyɛe ahorow nya wɔ mmarima ne mmea so a wosusuw ho pefee, ne mmea ne mmeawa ahiade ne wɔn anigye a wɔde di kan wɔ nhyehyɛe, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa anaa mmoa nkabom ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛtumi aboa me ma masua pii afa nna a ɛhɔ yɛ asomdwoe ne nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu  apomoden mmoa. Dɔkotafoɔ. Dwumadie. Akwahosan Mmoafoɔ. Intanɛt so Nneɛma (PPAG/YMK/TeenHealthSource). Hotlines (0540-118-999). Mmoa Kuo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo, Sɛn na mɛtumi, m’abusuafoɔ, ana afoforo a mɛtumi de me ho ato wɔn so abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa akwan horow a mɛtumi afa so wɔ me nyinsɛn ho na ama manya mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Kasa a Wo Werɛ Hyɛ Mu: Fa nokorɛyɛ ne ahofama na ɛnkɔ nkɔmɔdie no mu.Hwɛ Bea a Ɛfata: Hwehwɛ beaeɛ a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo na obiara nhyia mo wɔ hɔ na moadi nkitaho no.Da Wo Atenka Adi: Ka wo nsusuieeɛ, wo nkaeɛ, ne nea ɛhia wo fa nyinsɛn no ho kyerɛ afoforɔ.Tie Afoforɔ: Ma afoforɔ nso kwan na wɔnka wɔn nsusuieeɛ ne sɛnea wɔhu nneɛma kyerɛ wo.Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ ɛhia a, mma w’akyi nnwiri wo sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri nnipa a wode wo ho to wɔn so hɔ, te sɛ afotufoɔ (counselors).Kasa kyerɛ w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ: Bisa wɔn fa ahobammɔ afiri nhyehyɛe a ɛma mmoa ma ɔbabun a onyinsɛn no ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi afa so ayɛ adesua tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛboa ma wɔasusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho wɔ CSE mu?
answer_twi_source: Ground Rules: ɛwɔ sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ hyehyɛ mmara ma nkɔmmɔbɔ ne obu. Trust: Ma ahotosoɔ ntena hɔ. Inclusive Language: Kasa wɔ kwan a ɛka obiara ho. Accurate Info: Ma nimdeɛ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛm bɛn na ehia na ama yɛate nkɛntɛnso a animtiaabu ne nyiyim nya wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so no ase yiye, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne amanneɛbɔ hia na yɛate sɛnea amuo ne nyiyim ka mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ase yiye, na ama yɛanya nkyerɛkyerɛmu a nnyinasoɔ nokwafoɔ wɔ ho ne mmara mu nsakyeraeɛ.Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi aboa saa mmɔdenbɔ yi denam nhwehwɛmu ne gyinaesi a wɔbɛyɛ bi mu. Wobɛtumi akyɛ wɔn osuahu, wɔn adwene, ne deɛ wɔhunu, na wɔade wɔn ho ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛmmisadeɛ mu, na wɔagyina ama mmeranteɛ nne so na wɔaka wɔn adwene wɔ nhwehwɛmu ne mmara ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu.Denam nhwehwɛmu ne gyinaesi a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛfa wɔn ho ahyɛ mu yiye no, wobɛtumi aboa ma yɛahu baabi a nimdeɛ nnɔɔso, wɔatwetwe adwene akɔ mpɔtam a wɔbu wɔn abamfoɔ hĩadeɛ so, na wɔagyina ama mmara ne dwumadie a ɛbɛdi amuo ne nyiyim nnyinasoɔ titiriw ho dwuma, na ama akwahosan mu pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ne asetenam atɛntrenee anya mpon.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔde nhwehwɛmu adwuma a mmabun di anim ne akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu redi dwuma de anya adanse, abɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ho amanneɛ, na wɔahyɛ akontaabu ho nkuran wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde nhwehwɛmu adwuma a mmabun di anim ne akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu redi dwuma de anya adanse, abɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ho amanneɛ, na wɔahyɛ akontaabu ho nkuran wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma mu denam: Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa wɔn nneɛma a ɛho hia ne wɔn anigyede a ɛfa ASRH ho no so. Akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu te sɛ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so a mmabun di anim, nhwehwɛmu, ne nsɛmbisa a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ mmabun nne ne wɔn suahu yɛ ade titiri wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu. Ahyehyɛde ne nkitahodi ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔ ne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de atrɛ nhwehwɛmu mu nsɛm mu na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a egyina adanse so. Nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔdie ne nimdeɛ a wɔkyɛ mu de ama nhwehwɛmu a mmabun di anim ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛbɛtumi anya wɔ ASRH nsunsuansoɔ so no ho nimdeɛ akɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na apɔmuden ho insurance ho hia ma mmabun, titiriw wɔ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Apɔmuden ho insurance ho hia ma mmabun, titiriw wɔ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho, efisɛ: Ɛma sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ fi ayaresa ho ka kɛse a ɛbata apɔmuden ho nnwuma te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo, ne awo apɔmuden ho nhwehwɛmu ho. Ɛma mmabun nya akwan horow pii a wɔfa so siw ano, a nea ɛka ho ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, nnuru a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban, ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ STIs, awotwaa mu kokoram, ne awo mu akwahosan ho tebea afoforo ho. Ɛhyɛ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nsɛm a wohu ntɛm na wɔsa no bere ano ho nkuran, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ haw mu so na ɛma apɔmuden mu nsunsuanso tu mpɔn. Boa ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so ne aduruyɛ ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so a wobenya ama tebea horow a enni sabea anaa apɔmuden ho ahiade ahorow a emu yɛ den a ebetumi aka nna ne awo apɔmuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn na 'mfɛfoɔ-ne-mfɛfoɔ' akwankyerɛ dwumadi (peer-to-peer mentorship) bɛtumi afa so aboa mmabun a wɔrepɛ sika mu ahofadi ne nkunimdie, na ama wɔanya nkabom, baabi a wɔbɔ, ne baakoyɛ adwene, na ɛyɛ deɛn na wɔbɛtumi anya saa nimdeɛ yi?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma mmabun te nka sɛ ɔmu wɔ nkabomu. Afotufoɔ ne wɔn a wɔretie no bɔ adamfo, boa wɔn ho, na wɔdi wɔn nkonimdie ho fɛw. Wei ma wɔnya nkɔsoɔ. Esiane sɛ wɔn nyinaa fa tebea koro mu nti, wɔtumi gye wɔn ho di, te wɔn ho ase, na wɔhyɛ wɔn ho den de gyina akwansideɛ ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wone obi a wonduru mfi a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi nna mu dwumadie da a wɔ mmra kwan so nsunsuanso bɛn na ɛwom?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi ne obi a onnii mfe a obetumi apene so de wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu a, ebetumi de mmara mu nsunsuanso a emu yɛ den aba, te sɛ sobo a ɛne sɛ wato mmonnaa wɔ mmara kwan so. Ebia nea ebefi mu aba yi bi ne nsɛmmɔnedifo a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ asɛnnibea, wɔde no bɛto afiase, na wɔatwerɛw ne din wɔ nna mu mmaratofo a wɔtwerɛw wɔn din mu, a ebetumi anya obi asetra so nsunsuanso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi de ahye ne kokoam apam "agreements" ahorow asi hɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ me ho tɔ me sɛ mɛka m’adwene ne me atinka akyerɛ wo?
answer_twi_source: Yebetumi de ahye a emu da hɔ ne kokoam apam ahorow asi hɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wobɛka w’adwene ne wo atinka  akyerɛ me. Ebia nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wubebu wo kokoam nsɛm, worenkyɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia a wompene so, na woayɛ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ a worenbu atɛn anaa wokasa tia. Ɛdenam saa apam ahorow yi a midi so no, mede asi m’ani so sɛ mɛma tebea a ɛbɛboa wo a wobɛte nka sɛ wosom bo, wobu wo, na wotie wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun besidɛn ehu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda 'needs' (deɛ ehia) ne 'wants' (deɛ wopɛ) ntam?
answer_twi_source: Needs: Nneɛma a wonni a, wonntumi ntena ase anaa wonnya asetena pa. Wants: Nneɛma a wopɛ nanso ɛnyɛ 'compulsory'. Fa 'needs' di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, nhwehwɛmu, anaa akwan foforo a wɔfa so ma mmuae mu sɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no fã?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu denam: Akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so a wobetumi akyɛ wɔn suahu ne nyansahyɛ ahorow. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛboaboa nsɛm ano wɔ nnwuma a etu mpɔn ne sɛnea wobetumi anya ho. Nneɛma a wɔde ma mmuae te sɛ nyansahyɛ nnaka anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na STI ahorow fi onipa so kɔ onipa foforo so? (nna mu nkitahodi, nnade a wɔkyɛ, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer_twi_source: Titiriw ne nna (ɛtwɛɛ, ɛto, anaa ano). Nneɛma te sɛ nsuo-wɔ-adeɛ (needles) a yɛkyɛ tumi de HIV ne Hepatitis B ba. Ebi te sɛ Herpes ne HPV tumi fa honam ne honam nkitahodie (skin-to-skin) so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu anaa aniwu (stigma) betumi ama ayɛ den ama nnipa sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔyɛ nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho nhwehwɛmu anaa wɔanya ho ayaresa?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu betumi ama ayɛ den ama nkurɔfo sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa STIs efisɛ ebia wobesuro: Atemmu: Sɛ afoforo bebu wɔn atɛn. Kokoam nsɛm a wɔhwere: Wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene. Pow: Sɛ nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa ɔdɔfo a wɔpow wo. Eyi betumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba sɛ wɔansa STI ahorow no yare a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɛfata wɔ wo mantam mu a, di mmara mu nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nyinsɛn ho te sɛ awofo pene anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ Mpene: Wɔ Ghana no, mpɛn pii no, ɛho nhia sɛ awofoɔ pene na abofra kumaa bi bɛtumi anya akwahosan ho dwumadie, a ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ka ho. Nanso, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, ɛbɛyɛ papa sɛ wo ne w’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo no bɛbɔ wo nyinsɛn no ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobetumi de mmoa a ɛsom bo ama wo wɔ wo nyinsɛn akwantu no nyinaa mu. Akwahosan Ho Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Mmofra nkumaa a wɔwɔ Ghana wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a awofo mpene so. Hyɛ no nsow: Kae: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa akɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, sukuu ɔfotufo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn ma waboa wo. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa. Ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ saa akwantu yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ me ho a mɛhu ne me ho a mehwɛ de ahu na mede m’ankasa m’ahiadeɛ ne ahyeɛ adi kan wɔ asetena ne nnipa ntam tebea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo ho a wobɛhu ne wo ho a wobɛhwɛ a wode bedi dwuma no ho hia kɛse na ama woahu na wode w’ankasa w’ahiade ne ahye (boundaries) adi kan wɔ asetra ne nnipa ntam tebea horow mu. Gye bere susuw wo nkate, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne anohyeto ahorow ho, na hu tebea horow anaa nneyɛe ahorow a ɛma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ. Fa wo ho hwɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ adwene mu nhumu, akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome, ne anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigye ne abotɔyam ba mu a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu no di dwuma. Fa wo yiyedi di kan na tie wo nkate bere a ɛfa ahye a wode besi hɔ ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na botaeɛ hyehyɛeɛ boa ma manya ahoɔden a mede gyina haw mu, obu ma me ho, ne ahotosoɔ de pow mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ bɔne, agyina me hyeɛ (boundaries) so den, na manya me ho so tumi wɔ m’ankasa me nipadua ne me nna mu nneyɛeɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Botae ahorow a wode besisi w’ani so no boa ma wonya ahoɔden a wode gyina haw ano, obu ma wo ho, ne ahotoso wɔ wo ho wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɔne a wobɛko atia ne ahye a wosi so dua denam: Wo ho a wobɛhyɛ mu den: Botae ahorow a wode besisi w’ani so na woadu ho no ma wuhu wo ho na wunya ahotoso wɔ wo tumi mu, na ɛma wunya tumi a wode si wo hye ne nneɛma a ɛho hia kɛse so dua denneennen. Asɛm a wɔka no denneennen a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse: Botae ahorow a emu da hɔ ma wonya fapem ma nkitahodi a ɛyɛ pintinn ne gyinaesi, na ɛboa wo ma wode ahotoso kamfo w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa abɔnten nkɛntɛnso ahorow anim. Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ a wobɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Botae ahorow a ɛboa wo yiyedi ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow a wode di kan no ma wunya obu ma wo ho na wutumi gyina tebea horow ano, na ɛma wutumi de ahotoso ne wo ho awerɛhyem di tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu  kɔkɔbɔ anaa kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ nyɔnkofa nkitahodie  a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade?
answer_twi_source: Suban a wubedi so: Wo hokafo bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ nea wobɛhyɛ, onipa ko a wuhu, anaa nea woyɛ. Ahoɔyaw ne nneɛma a obi wɔ: Sɛ wo ne nnipa afoforo kasa anaa wopɛ sɛ wo nkutoo nya bere a, wo hokafo no bo fuw. Nnipa a wɔde wɔn to fam ne ahohorabɔ: Wo hokafo di wo ho fɛw, ɔkasa tia wo, anaa ɔma wo to fam. Ahunahuna ne ahunahuna: Wo hokafo no hunahuna wo sɛ sɛ woanyɛ nea wɔpɛ a, obepira wo anaa n’ankasa ho. Honam fam basabasayɛ: Sɛ obi bɛbɔ obi, ɔbɛpia obi, anaa obepira obi wɔ honam fam a, ɛnyɛ hwee da. Nhyɛso a wɔhyɛ wo wɔ nna mu: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wote nka da sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛyɛ nna mu biribiara a ɛnyɛ wo dɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔde akwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ka nna ne awo akwahosan nkyerɛkyerɛ ho na ama akwahosan ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, dwumadi a wɔde di dwuma, ne agodie a wɔde di nkitaho no hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen, na wosusuw nneɛma ho yiye. Saa akwan yi ma nna ne awo akwahosan ho adesua yɛ anigye na ɛyɛ nea wɔkae ma mmabun, na ɛma nsɛm a wɔkora so no yɛ kɛse. Ɛdenam wɔn adesua nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen so no, mmabun nya akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia, te sɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne gyinaesi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛfa so si gyinaeɛ papa?
answer_twi_source: Hu asɛm no (Identify). Hwehwɛ nsɛm ne nimdeɛ (Gather info). Susu ho hwɛ sɛ kwan foforɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa anaa (Evaluate). Si gyinaeɛ (Choose). Yɛ (Implement).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ, na wɔafa dijitaal wiase no mu nsɛm a ɛyɛ den no so dwoodwoo ne asɛyɛde mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw nkɔsoɔ na wɔboa wɔn ma wɔfa digyital wiase no mu dwoodwoo: Wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ intanɛt so nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ asɛdeɛ ho, a kokoamsɛm ho banbɔ, nkitahodiɛ a obuo wom, ne kwati a wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛhaw wɔn wɔ kɔmputa "computer" so ne intanɛt so ayayadeɛ. Nneɛma ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma a ɛtwe adwene si dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw, intanɛt so ahobammɔ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ so wɔ sukuu ahorow, Mmabun kuw, mpɔtam, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛkɔ so ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu afa wɔn intanɛt so osuahu ahorow, wɔn haw ahorow, ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa dijitaal ɔman bayɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho. "Digitals" suban pa ho nhwɛsoɔ ne som sɛ nhwɛsoɔ ma asɛdeɛ ne abrabɔ pa wɔ intanɛt so nneyɛeɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ transgender', genderqueer, anaasɛ genderfluid? (nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wodi adwene a enhyia anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ a ebetumi aba bere a wɔresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no ho dwuma, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn asiesie wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ so a broni ka no 'constructively'?
answer_twi_source: Fa boasetɔ, tema, ne ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubetie wɔn ho mo ho adwene, bɛn adwene a enhyia anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ. Fa nnamyɛ tie ade na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ afã abien no nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ wɔate wɔn na wɔate wɔn ase. Fa w’adwene si nsɛm a emu biako a wubenya na woahwehwɛ ano aduru a obiara begye atom so. Sɛ ɛho hia a, gye w’ahome fi nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu na ama wo ho adwo wo na woasan akɔ so akyiri yi a w’adwene mu da hɔ na woabɔ wo ho ban foforo sɛ wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a biribi firi mu ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mete nka sɛ mepɛ sɛ mihu anaa m’ani gye nna ho nsɛmti ho bere a mewɔ mmabunbere?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ awosu sɛ wobɛpɛ sɛ wuhu wo nipadua a ɛresesa ne wiase a atwa wo ho ahyia no. Nkwammoaa mu nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu nso betumi ama nna ho nsɛm ho anigye ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ nya ɔkwan a nkurɔfoɔ fa so nya mmabunbere so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua Mfonini: Amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛfa ahoɔfɛ ho betumi anya sɛnea ankorankoro hu wɔn nipadua a ɛresakra no so nkɛntɛnso. Bɔbeasu Dwumadi: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow kyerɛ akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nneyɛe ne sɛnea obi te ho a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so. Abusua mu Nkɔso: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe a ɛfa abusua a wɔbɛn wɔn ho wɔn ho anaa ahofadi ho no betumi aka nkitahodi. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna: Amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ adwene a ɛyɛ kateee anaasɛ ɛda adi pefee wɔ nna ho nsɛm a wɔka ho asɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nwomasua, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ɔsatu ahorow betumi adi wɔ ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛhyɛ mmabun a wɔde behu nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ na wɔako atia no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ɔsatu ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ ahokokwaw a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔde behu nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ na wɔako atia no mu. Nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a edi mu na akyerɛkyerɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee de ahu nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so fi nea wontumi mfa ho nto so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama akwan a mfaso wɔ so a wɔbɛfa so asɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ intanɛt so ahwɛ na wɔafa digital nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nsase so wɔ asɛyɛde mu. Ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ɔsatu ahorow betumi ama nkurɔfo ate anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya, de nsɛm a edi mu ama, na ahyɛ mmabun nneyɛe a wɔde hwehwɛ nokwasɛm ahorow mu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nhyɛso "peer pressure" betumi ahaw yɛn gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho so nkɛntɛnso, na nkɛntɛnso "impact" bɛn na eyi nya wɔ yɛn adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" so?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso "peer pressure" betumi anya gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho so nkɛntɛnso bi te sɛ: Nneyɛe a asiane wom te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaa nna mu dwumadi a wodi kan hyɛ nkuran ma ɛne gyinapɛn ahorow a wosusuw sɛ ɛne no hyia anaasɛ ɛne no hyia. Adwene a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ ɛnyɛ papa a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipadua mfonini ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso anaa abɛɛfo ntentan so. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ adwenemyare so no betumi ayɛ: Afobu, aniwu, anaa ahonu ho atinka bere a ɔde ne ho ahyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ase akyi. Dadwen, adwennwen, anaa adwene a ɛyɛ basaa wɔ nna ho gyinaesi ne abusuabɔ ho esiane atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛbɔ abira nti. Nsɛm a enye a ɛfa ne ho anaa obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho a efi ntotoho a ɔne mfɛfo yɛ anaasɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ no ma odu gyinapɛn ahorow bi ho. Ebia eyinom benya nkɛntɛnso a ɛyɛ hu bere tenten wɔ w’asetra so sɛ ɔbabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ama wɔn akwahosan ho nimdeɛ atu mpɔn na ama wɔate nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ase yiye?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so fi ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din anaa beaeɛ a yɛtumi de yɛn ho to so, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow hɔ. Bisa nsɛm na hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa akyerɛkyerɛfo hɔ. Fa wo ho hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ahorow pii ho mu. Nya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee de hwɛ sɛnea nsɛm a wohyia wɔ intanɛt so anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no yɛ nokware na wotumi gye di. Fa hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wo ne w’atipɛnfo, abusua mufo, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo abɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na wofi nokwaredi mu di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua pii afa nyɔnkofa a ɛyɛ papa ho na mahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Afotufoɔ: Sukuu afotufoɔ bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛfa nyɔnkofa papa ne baabi a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa ama. Mpɔtam Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ mmabun mmeae anaa mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow betumi de nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa ho ama. abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so Nneɛma: abɛɛfo ntentan ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nsɛm te sɛ YMK de nsɛm a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa, ntawntawdi ano aduru, ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ma. Ahomatorofo ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Ahomatorofo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) na wobetumi de kokoam mmoa ne afotuo ama wɔ abusuabɔ ho nsɛm ho. Nhoma ne Nsɛm: Sɛ yɛkenkan nneɛma a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa, nkitahodi, ne atenka mu nyansa ho a, ebetumi aboa. Mmoa Akuo: Mpɔtam hɔ mmoa akuo anaa nkɔmmɔdie a atipɛnfoɔ di anim ma baabi a ahotɔ wɔ a wɔbɛkyɛ suahunu na wɔasua biribi afiri afoforɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, ahwɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra no betumi aboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ma wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun bɛtumi aboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nsɛm a wɔbɛnya mu denam nkitahodiɛ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, nkateɛ mu mmoa a wɔde bɛma, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwahosan ho dwumadi a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, ne mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne amammerɛ mu atenka akyerɛ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Kɔ so nya amammerɛ mu adwene ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Hyɛ Nhomasua Ho Nkɔso: Hyɛ sukuu anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow nkuran sɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa nkate ho mma. Atipɛnfo Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Fi ase ne atipɛnfo nkɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ fa hia a amammerɛ mu nkate ne obu ho hia ho. Nsɛnnennen a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Kasa tia nsusuwii hunu anaa animhwɛ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, na hyɛ adwene a emu abue ho nkurae. Kasa a Ɛboa: Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma osuahu ahorow na ɛkwati nsɛm a wɔka no nyinaa di dwuma. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Fa wo ho hyɛ anaa boa nnwuma a ɛma amammerɛ ahodoɔ ne nnipa nyinaa ka ho wɔ nwomasua mu. Mpɔtam Hɔ a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Kɔka amammerɛ ahorow akuw anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi akɔ abɛɛfo ntetan so dwoodwoo bere a wɔkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ne afoforo kokoamu nsɛm ne hokwan ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akɔ abɛɛfo ntetan so mmeae dwoodwoo denam: Ahwɛyiye a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ ho na wɔato wɔn dwumadi ahorow a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no ano hye denam kokoamu nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ din pa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu. Sɛ wobɛhwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware ansa na woakyɛ anaasɛ woadi ho dwuma. Nsɛm biara a ɛmfata anaa epira a wɔbɛbɔ ho amanneɛ na sɛ wohyia abɛɛfo ntetan anaa ayayade wɔ Intanɛt so a, wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa nsɛm bɛn na ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne ahomatrofo a wɔde boa wɔn betumi de ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa foforo, te sɛ afotu adwuma, ayaresa, mmra mu mmoa, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho adwuma titiriw?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔde Kɔma Wɔn: Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne telefon a wɔde boa wɔn betumi ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa foforo no anya nneɛma ahorow a wɔde bɛkɔ, a afotu adwuma, ayaresa, mmra kwan so mmoa, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw ka ho. Afotufoɔ bɛtumi de nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ ama wɔ saa nneɛma yi a wɔbɛnya ho a egyina onipa no ahiadeɛ ne ne tebea so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛdeɛ ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ne STI nhwehwɛmu ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ ho kwan wɔ ayaresabea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ: Wɔde wɔn asumasɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie wɔ wɔn nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho. Nya nna mu agodie mu nimdie a ɛyɛ nokware, a STI ne nsɔhwɛ ahorow a wobetumi apene so ayɛ anaa apo ka ho. Asɛdeɛ: Mmabun asɛdeɛ ne sɛ: Wɔbɛdi nokware na wɔaka wɔn nna mu abakɔsɛm adi pefee akyerɛ ayaresafoɔ ne nea ɛkyer wɔn adwen nyina. Akwankyerɛ ahorow a kyerɛ wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ne siw ano ho nsɛm a wobedi akyi. Wɔn ankasa nna mu apɔwmuden mu ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa berɛ a ɛho hia mu. Sua na nya nimdie fa wo faahodie a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden nsɛm ho ne STI nhwehwɛ mu. Sɛ biribi ha wo na wonnte aseɛ, bisa na wɔnkyerɛ wo mu yie. Na hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanifoɔ, akasamafoɔ ne akuo wɔhwɛ mmabun apɔwmuden nsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne dɛmdi ho osuahu ahorow a wɔada no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, nhoma, ne amammerɛ a agye din mu no bi?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea yɛyi nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm (disability) adi no renya mpɔntuo, nanso ɔhaw bi da so wɔ hɔ:Ndaadi a ɛnɔɔso (Limited portrayals): Mpɛn pii no, yɛnhu nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm pii wɔ amanneɛbɔ mu, anaasɛ yɛhu wɔn wɔ akwan a ɛkyerɛ nsusuieeɛ bɔne ahorow mu.Adwene a ɛsi nkuranhyɛ so (Focus on inspiration): Mpɛn pii no, amanneɛbɔ si sɛnea obi adian ne dɛm so nkonim so dua, na wɔmfa wɔn adwene nsi nneyɛeɛ ne asetena mu nsɛm a wɔfa mu mmerɛ biara so.Ndaadi a ɛmfata (Inaccurate portrayals): Ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a, wɔkyerɛkyerɛ dɛm a obi wɔ mu wɔ kwan a ɛmfata anaa ɛyɛ nwanwa dodo so.Ahiadeɛ a ɛhia ma ndaadi pa (The Need for Positive Representation): Ndaadi pa a yɛde bɛkyerɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm bɛtumi apopa nsusuieeɛ bɔne na ɛama nteaseɛ ne mmɔborohunu aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nea broni ka no 'mobile apps' anaa dijitaal nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛde nsɛm ne mmoa ma wɔ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nea broni ka no 'mobile app' ahorow ne dijitaal nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛma nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa mmabun nna mu akwahosan ho. Saa nea broni ka no 'apps' yi betumi ama nneɛma bi te sɛ: Nhomasua nsɛm ne nea broni ka no 'video' ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho Nkitahodi ho nsɛmmisa ne nnwinnade a wɔde bɛsɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ahwɛ Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nea broni ka no 'virtual' a wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa nna mu akwahosan ho akyerɛkyerɛfo Nkaebɔ a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne nhyehyɛe afoforo a ɛfa akwahosan ho Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne nea broni ka no 'Planned Parenthood Direct app, Amaze app, ne Bedsider app'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dabere ne adan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi anya dabere ne adan ho nnwuma ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mpofirim banyɛbea: Ɛma mmabun a wohyia asiane ntɛm ara anaasɛ wonni afie esiane nna mu ayayade, ofie basabasayɛ, anaa ɔhaw afoforo nti no dabere.Berɛ tiawa mu atenaeɛ mmoa (Transitional housing): Ɛma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa baabi a wɔbɛtena mberɛ tenten kakra ne mmoa nneɛma biara a ɛbɛma wɔn asetena agyina yie na wɔatumi asiesie wɔn ho atena wɔn nkoara.Atenaeɛ a wɔhwɛ so (Group homes anaa residential facilities): Ɛyɛ atenaeɛ a mpanyimfoɔ hwɛ so na wɔma mmoa nneɛma ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔhia hwɛ ne mmoa a emu yɛ den pa ara.Afei, abusuafoɔ mmoa anaa mmofra-hwɛ atenaeɛ (Host families anaa foster care): Wei ne berɛ a wɔde mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa kɔtena mmusua bi a wɔatete wɔn nkyɛn mberɛ kakra, na saa ahwɛfoɔ yi aboa wɔn na wɔakyerɛ wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn ahiadeɛ pɔtee ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun a wɔyem betumi atu de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ne asɛde ahorow ho, ahwehwɛ mmara kwan so afotu anaa ananmusifo sɛ ɛho hia a, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛka wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi ne wɔn ba yiyedi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem betumi atu anammɔn pii de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow ho, ahwehwɛ mmara kwan so afotu anaa ananmusifo sɛ ɛho hia a, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛka wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi ne wɔn ba no de mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn, awofoyɛ, akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow, ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de ate wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ no ase. Akwankyerɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ abusua mufo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa sukuu afotufo hɔ, a wobetumi de nsɛm, mmoa, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn akɔ mmara ne asetra mu nnwuma mu ama. Nkitahodi a wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem bɛkyɛ osuahu ahorow, asesa nsɛm, na wɔanya nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim a wɔkasa ma ne tumidi nhyehyɛe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na madi mfomso a ntease wom anaa nsusuwii a ɛnteɛ ho dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wubehu na woadi mfomso a ntease wom anaa nsusuwii a ɛnteɛ ho dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu a, hu mfomso a ɛtaa ba te sɛ ad hominem ntua, mpanyin adesrɛ, ne atoro mpaapaemu. Sɛ worebɔ nkɔmmɔ a, ma w’ani da hɔ wɔ saa mfomso ahorow yi ho wɔ nsusuwii mu na fa animtew kyerɛ mu bere a ɛsɔre no. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ a egyina adanse ne akyinnyegye a ntease wom so ho nkuran sen sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto nkate mu anigye anaa ntease a mfomso wom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a mɛfa so ada m’ahiade, nea mepɛ, ne m’akɔnnɔ adi wɔ abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Hu wo ho: Gye bere fa te nea wopɛ fi abusuabɔ bi mu, nea wo nna ho akɔnnɔ yɛ ne nea wo daakye botae ahorow yɛ ase. Ma emu nna hɔ na kyerɛ tẽẽ: Nhwɛ kwan sɛ wo hokafo no bɛkenkan w’adwene. Ka w’ahiade ne w’akɔnnɔ ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na emu da hɔ wɔ obu mu. Hyɛ nneyɛe pa mu den. Fa nsɛmfua a ɛyɛ papa di dwuma: Fa w’adwene si nea w’ani gye ho ne nea wopɛ so, sen sɛ wode w’adwene besi nea w’ani nnye ho so. Ma w’adwene nsi “yɛn” so: Kyerɛ nea wopɛ wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma woahu wo hokafo nso ahiade. Nhwɛsoɔ, “M’ani bɛgye ho sɛ mɛsɔ... ahwɛ.”
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔe sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo ne mmara mu nsakrae a edii nkonim a ɛma mmabun nya nna ne awo hokwan ahorow wɔ ɔman ne wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow a ɛfa mmɔdenbɔ a edii nkonim a wɔde bɛkamfo wɔn ne mmara mu nsakrae a ama mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow anya nkɔso wɔ ɔman ne wiase nyinaa no bi ne: Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nyinsɛn a woyi agu no ayɛ bɔne, atwa mmara a ɛto anohyeto ahorow mu, na wɔatrɛw kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom na mmara kwan so ma mmabun wɔ aman a wɔabara nyinsɛn a woyi gu kɛse anaasɛ mmara mma ho kwan mu. Nnwumakuw a ɛwɔ fam ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim de hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, awo ho atɛntrenee, ne LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow ho nkuran, na ɛde nsakrae ba sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne ɔmanfo nsɛm ho ɔsatu ahorow mu. Mmara mu nsɛnnennen ne asɛnnibea akwan a wɔfa so kasa tia mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ nyiyim, te sɛ mfe a obi adi ho mmara, awofo pene/mmɔdebɔ ahwehwɛde ahorow, ne anohyeto ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho. Mmɔdenbɔ a aban ahorow, ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛbom de nneɛma a egyina adanse so, te sɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ adamfofa su ma mmabun, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde tew ɔhaw so, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so bedi dwuma, de ama nna ne awo akwahosan mu nkɔso a efi mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa pii ne nea wɔmfa nni dwuma no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne asiane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ sikasɛm mu nneɛma ne nnwuma ahorow te sɛ sikakorabea, sika a wɔde gye sika, ne boseabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sikakorabea ahorow ma ahobammɔ ne sika a wɔde di dwuma nanso ebia mfɛntom a ɛba fam. Credit card ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛkyekye credit abakɔsɛm nanso sɛ wɔamfa anni dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu a, ebetumi ama woabɔ ka. Boa ma kwan ma wɔtɔ nneɛma akɛse nanso wɔde mfɛntom ne asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wobetua ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi de bere tiaa ne bere tenten botae ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwɛso ahorow ama, te sɛ nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma, ahyeɛ a wɔde besi hɔ wɔ abusuabɔ mu, nyinsɛn ano aduru a wobenya, STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ daa, ne ankorankoro nyin ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ akyi?
answer_twi_source: Bere tiaa ne bere tenten botae ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne: Bere tiaa mu botae ahorow: Fa nna a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma denam kɔndɔm a wode bedi dwuma bere nyinaa bere a woreyɛ nna mu dwumadi no so. Wo ne wɔn a wɔne wɔn da ndi nea wopɛ ansa na wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi ahorow. Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔfa afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano anaasɛ wobɛnya akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano te sɛ awo ano aduru anaa kɔndɔm. Botae ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ bere tenten: Kɔ so yɛ STI nhwehwɛmu daa ne nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu afe biara. Munnya abusuabɔ pa a egyina obu, nkitahodi, ne ahotoso so. Fa ankorankoro nyin ne wo ho a wobɛhwɛ di kan denam ayaresa anaa afotu a wobɛhwehwɛ de adi adwenemyare a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho ho dwuma no so. Kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ mma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ de hyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ne nna mu akwahosan pa a ebefi mu aba ama mmabun nyinaa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no akasa, afa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛda adi pefee na ɛkyerɛ obu so, sɛ ɛsono wɔn adwene mpo a? (Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den a wɔde fa kwan so)
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi yɛ ade titiriw, sɛ ɛsono adwene mpo a: Paw Bere a Ɛfata: Hwehwɛ bere a wo ho dwo na woyɛ kokoam bere a, mo baanu nyinaa betumi de w’adwene asi nkɔmmɔbɔ no so. Fa Asɛm a Wobom Fi Ase: Fa w’adwene si pɛ a wopɛ sɛ wohwɛ w’akwahosan so na wopaw nneɛma a ɛfata. Fa "Me" Nsɛm Di Dwuma: Sɛ anka wobɛbɔ asodi no sobo no, ka nsɛm te sɛ "Mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ sɛ mɛka eyi ho asɛm, nanso..." Da Obu: Sɛ wo ne no nyɛ adwene mpo a, tie wɔn adwene a wunmmu atɛn. Siesie Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Ma wɛbsaet anaa nkratawa a nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so wom a wɔasiesie sɛ wobɛkyɛ sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afiri aseɛ anaa wɔade wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow a emu botaeɛ ne sikasɛm mu tumi hyɛden mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afiri aseɛ anaa wɔade wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow a emu botaeɛ ne sikasɛm mu tumi hyɛden mu denam; wɔn atipɛnfo, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, sukuu ahorow, anaa mmabun akuw a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn de akyerɛ wɔn anigye ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Wɔbɛtumi nso ahwehwɛ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no mu denam intanɛt so nhyiamu, sohyial media akuo, anaa mpɔtam nkitahodiɛ so na wɔabisa hokwan a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu sɛ afotumafoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔregye afotu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo anaa abusuafoɔ betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ade na ama wɔatumi aboa wɔn mma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ anaa abusuafoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho denam nsɛm a wɔtumi de ho to so a wɔbɛnya, nhyiamu anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu a wɔbɛkɔ, ne nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛbɔ so. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa mmoa akuw a wɔyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho titiriw hɔ. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, tema, ne ntease a wɔde bedi kan no yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma wɔaboa wɔn mma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan horow bɛn na wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw a ɛma mmabun tumi hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho yiye na wɔsɔ hwɛ, hu frankaa kɔkɔɔ ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ayayade, na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛka obiara, na ɛma tumi?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw betumi ama mmabun tumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho yiye na wɔasusuw ho denam kyerɛkyerɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ma wɔahu tropes a wɔtaa de di dwuma, nsusuwii hunu, ne nsɛmti a ɔhaw wom a ɛfa pene ne nna mu nneyɛe ho no so. Wobetumi asua sɛnea wobehu frankaa kɔkɔɔ ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ayayade, te sɛ nsakrae, nhyɛso, ne asodi a wɔde to nea wɔayɛ no bɔne so, na wɔanya ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛkasa atia saa nsɛnkyerɛnne a epira yi. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi de nneɛma, te sɛ nkɔmmɔdie akwankyerɛ, nkitahodiɛ dwumadiɛ, ne asetena mu nsɛm a wɔayɛ no ankasa ama, de ama nkɔmmɔdie a nteaseɛ wom ayɛ mmerɛ na ahyɛ gyinaesie a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛfata sɛ obi ntumi nnya nna mu anigyeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri no bere biara a ɔne obi bɛda?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛfata koraa sɛ wonnya nna mu anigyeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri bere biara a wone obi bɛda. Nneɛma pii betumi aka saa asɛm yi, te sɛ adwene mu haw, ɔbrɛ, anaa ɔkwan pɔtee a mopɛsɛ mo fa so de gye mo ani. Ma w’adwene nsi anigyeɛ a wobenya ne sɛnea wobɛte nka yie so, na mmom ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛnya anigyeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri bebere.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na mako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna anaa nneyɛe a asiane wumu ho?
answer_twi_source: hyehyɛ ahye: Si nea wo ho tɔ wo wɔ nna mu ho gyinae na bata ho. Yɛ pintinn: Ka "DABI" pintinn na emu da hɔ. Womfa nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara ka obiara. Fa nnipa a wɔboa wo no twa wo ho hyia: Gya bere ne nnamfo a wobu wo gyinaesi ahorow. Twe wo ho fi tebea horow a ɛnyɛ dɛ ho: Sɛ obi mmu w’ahye a, fi hɔ kɔ. Sɛ wote nka sɛ obi rehyɛ wo ma wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu nneyɛe mu a, wo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di nsusuw ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sikasɛm anaa nhyehyɛe ho nsusuwii bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu bere a wɔrenya nnwuma a wɔde di akyi ne nea wɔhwɛ akyi no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu ɛka a ebetumi aba wɔ adwuma a wɔde di akyi ne nea wɔhwɛ akyi ho, a afotu ho ka, akwantu ho ka, ne apɔwmuden ho insurance a wɔbɔ ka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ te sɛ sliding scale fees, ayaresabea ahorow a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow na ama sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ mu no so atew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahyɛ m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no nkuran ma wɔaboa me kɛse wɔ m’adwene mu akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ho? (nkitahodi ho afotu, nneɛma a wɔde kyɛ).
answer_twi_source: Wo ne w’awofoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo no nni nkitaho bere a wo ho adwo wo na woaboaboa wo ho ano no. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo nkate ne sɛnea mmoa a wɔde bɛma wo no so bɛba wo mfaso. wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo betumi aboa wo ma wo ne w’awofo adi nkitaho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, asetra mu su horow, ne tumi a ɛkɔ so nya nkɔso wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim no tu mpɔn no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne asetra mu su ahorow na ɛkyerɛ adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu ho na ebetumi anya mmoa anaa ɔsɔretia dodow a mmabun hyia no so nsunsuanso. Tumi a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔmanfo mu no betumi aka sɛnea wotumi hu ne nsunsuanso a mmɔden a mmabun di anim a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no nya, na akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no hyia akwanside akɛse a ɛbɛma wɔanya nsunsuanso. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, asetra mu su horow, ne tumi mu nkɔso ho ntease ne kwankyerɛ ho hia na ama wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ho nsɛm mu yiye na wɔanya nsakrae a ntease wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
