question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya awoɔanosie mmoa aa obu ne nkabom wo me nna mu apɔmuden?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresafoɔ boa obiara. Hwehwɛ nea aborɔfo ka no 'disability-friendly' ayaresabea. Kyerɛ deɛ wopɛ. Bisa nsɛm. Ma nea aborɔfo ka no 'feedback' sɛ wɔanyɛ no yie a. Hwehwɛ mmoa wɔ intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmra nhyehyɛe bi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛka awodeɛ ano nsisi a ɛho hia ntɛmtɛm wɔ yɛ mmaabun a wɔresi sɔ abrabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu nsɛm ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa awodeɛ ano nsisi a ɛho hia ntɛm ho:Mmara mu nsɛm ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa awodeɛ ano nsisi a ɛho hia ntɛm a wɔnya ho no gu ahodoɔ wɔ ɔman, ɔmantam, ne mpɔtam hɔ. Mmara mu nsusuhoɔ a ɛtaa ba bi ne: Mfeɛ a wɔde siw kwan: Mmara a ɛfa awodeɛ ano nsisi a ɛho hia ntɛm a wɔtɔn wɔ agyananmu ho no betumi agu ahodoɔ wɔ mfeɛ ho, na mmara bi ma mmofra a wɔn mfeɛ nkɔ anim pɛn no kwan ma wɔtɔeɛ a wonhwehwɛ dɔkota kyerɛwtohɔ. Aduruyɛfoɔ no atɛntre: Mmara bi ma aduruyɛfoɔ kwan ma wɔde awodeɛ ano nsisi a ɛho hia ntɛm ma a wonhwehwɛ dɔkota kyerɛwtohɔ wɔ tebea pɔtee bi mu, bere a afoforɔ nso hwehwɛ dɔkota kyerɛwtohɔ ma obiara. Insurance coverage: Mmara betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ insurance nhyehyɛeɛ si awodeɛ ano nsisi a ɛho hia ntɛm no ka so, ɛwom sɛ insurance ne nneɛma a ɛho hia nso betumi agu ahodoɔ. Sukuu mu apɔwmuden ho nnwuma: Mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa sukuu mu apɔwmuden ho nnwuma ho no betumi aka mmofra a wɔn mfeɛ nkɔ anim a wɔnya awodeɛ ano nsisi a ɛho hia ntɛm no ho asɛm denam sukuu mu nnwuma anaa apɔwmuden asoɛeɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi ho nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu no?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow benya pene afi ankorankoro a wɔda wɔn ho adi wɔ aguadi ɔsatu ahorow mu hɔ, titiriw bere a wɔreyɛ nsɛmti a ɛho hia a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mfonini no. Pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nokware: Sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔka wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma anaa nnwuma ho no yɛ nokware na wɔasiw nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne atoro akwanhwɛ ano. Obu a wɔde ma nneɛma ahorow: Nnipa ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne tebea horow a egu ahorow ho mfonini a ɛka obiara ho na obu wom ho nkuran wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ mu na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nsusuwii hunu mu den anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ akuw bi animtiaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ ne mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo te sɛ nna mu akwahosan, abusuabɔ, ne pene a wɔpene so ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wobenya wɔ Intanɛt so no di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ ho hia ma mmabun sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, abusuabɔ, ne pene a wɔpene so ho wɔ intanɛt so: Ɛdenam adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye a wobenya so no, mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ intanɛt so nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akwahosan ho no ho. Abɛɛfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ma mmabun tumi kɔ intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a wobetumi ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi mmeae a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow ne adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ din pa hɔ. Sɛnea wɔte sɛnea wɔkyerɛ sɛ nsɛm yɛ nokware na wohu nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ase no boa mmabun ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔte pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa mu nkɔso ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nkɛntɛnsoɔ a animtiaabuo, aniwuo, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho na ebetumi anya wɔ adwen apɔmuden so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma wɔ nhomasua mu?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu, aniwu, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no betumi anya nkɛntɛnso bɔne wɔ nea efi adwene apɔwmuden so, a adwennwen a ɛkɔ soro, dadwen, ne obuo a obi nni ma ne ho a ɛba fam ka ho. Saa akwansidie ahorow yi betumi ama wɔakwati akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia, nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom, anaa atenka sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho. Animtiaabu ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wobedi ho dwuma wɔ nhomasua mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmeae a ɛnyɛ atemmu ho nkuran, wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, na wɔama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee de akasa atia gyidie ne suban ahorow a epira.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo anaa abusuafoɔ betumi ahyɛ nkitahodi a emu da hɔ ne ahotoso a wɔne mmabun nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran, sɛ ɛyɛ asɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate mpo a?
answer_twi_source: Awofo anaa abusuafoɔ betumi ama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ahotoso anya nkɔso denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wobefi ase wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ akasakasa ne atemmu so so. Beae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛbɔ ama nkɔmmɔbɔ denam obu a wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm so. Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ tie na wɔma wɔn mmabun nkate ne osuahu ahorow yɛ nokware. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma ne nsɛmmisa a wɔde nokwaredi abua. Sɛ́ wobetumi abɛn wɔn na wɔatumi asusuw ho bere biara a wɔn mmabun behia mmoa. Tema, ntease, ne ɔdɔ a enni nnyinaso a wɔbɛda no adi, a asɛmti no mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi akyerɛ nsɔano a ɛda nea mesusu sɛ ɛyɛ asiane (perceived risks) ne asiane ankasa a ɛbɛtumi aba (actual risks) ntam, berɛ a merehwehwɛ m'akwan horow mu na meresusu nea ɛbɛtumi afiri m'asiandisɛm mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wuhu nsonsonoe a ɛda asiane ahorow a wosusuw sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ (asiane ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ wɔn tirim) ne asiane ankasa (botae a ɛyɛ nea ebetumi aba sɛ ɔhaw bɛba) ntam a, susuw ho: Adanse a ɛwɔ botae mu: Hwɛ nsɛm a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu ne nyansahu mu adanse a ɛfa sɛnea ebetumi aba ne sɛnea emu yɛ den a ebetumi afi mu aba a ɛbata nneyɛe anaa tebea pɔtee bi ho no mu. Ankorankoro animhwɛ: Hu na kasa tia ankorankoro animhwɛ anaa adwene mu nsɛm a wɔakyinkyim a ebetumi anya asiane ho adwene a wubenya so nkɛntɛnso, te sɛ sɛnea wubebu asiane a ebetumi afi mu aba dodo anaasɛ wubu no adewa. Animdefo a wo ne wɔn bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa afotufo hɔ, a wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama na wɔaboa wo ma woakyerɛ asiane ahorow ase na wode nsɛm a ɛfa ho no atoto ho. Nsɛm a ɛfa ho a wobesusuw ho: Fa tebea horow, ankorankoro nsonsonoe, ne nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛsakra a ebetumi anya asiane ankasa a ɛwɔ suban anaa tebea bi mu so nkɛntɛnso, a ɛboro w’adwene mu nsusuwii so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya LGBTQ+ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔka ho a wobetumi de ɔhwɛ a obu wom na ɛkɔ akyiri ama so dua.
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛni bɛne wo abɔ bɔbeasu mu nneyɛe ne su ho nkɔmmɔ. Wɔbu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ anaa akuw a ɛwɔ fam a wɔreyɛ adwuma de ama mmabun anya nnuan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow pii a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne akuw a ɛwɔ fam no atu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun anya nnuan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya no atu mpɔn, a nea ɛka ho ne: Aduankorabea ne nneɛma a wɔkora so: Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Feeding America, Nkwagye Asraafo, ne mpɔtam hɔ aduankorabea ahorow de aduan mmoa a egye ntɛmpɛ ma ankorankoro ne mmusua a wohyia ɔkɔm. Wɔn a wɔkamfo adan a ne bo yɛ den: Akuw te sɛ Habitat for Humanity, National Low Income Housing Coalition, ne mpɔtam hɔ adan ho mpanyimfo yɛ adwuma de ma ankorankoro ne mmusua a wonnya sika pii nya adan a ahobammɔ wom na ne bo nyɛ den no kɛse. Mpɔtam hɔ turo ne nkuropɔn mu mfuw: Nnwuma te sɛ Growing Power, Urban Harvest, ne mpɔtam hɔ turo nkabom ahorow hyɛ nkurow akɛse mu kuayɛ ne nnuan a wɔyɛ a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so ho nkuran na ama wɔanya nnuan a ɛyɛ foforo a ahoɔden wom wɔ mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa yiye. Youth Harvest Foundation Ghana: Saa ahyehyɛdeɛ yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛma aduane a wɔbɛnya na ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ Ghana asetena atu mpɔn denam kuayɛ ho nteteeɛ, aduane pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne aduane a ahoɔden wom a wɔbɛnya so. Street Children Empowerment Foundation: Saa kuo a ɛwɔ fam yi yɛ adwuma de dabere ne mmoa dwumadie ma mmabun a wɔnni afie ne wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ den wɔ Ghana, a aduane a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛyɛ den ka ho. Aduan ma Afrika Nyinaa: Saa ahyehyɛde yi de ne ho ama sɛ ɛbɛtew ɔkɔm ne aduan pa a wonnya nni so wɔ Ghana denam aduan a ɛboro so a wɔbɛsan akyekyɛ ama wɔn a wohia mmoa, a mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ ka ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotu bi a ɛbɛma wɔatumi adi nkitaho yiye afa STI ne sɔhwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ onipa a ɔfata: Paw obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔhwɛfo, mmabun akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa adamfo a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso. Susuw sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo kɛse sɛ wo ne obi a ne bɔbeasu yɛ pɛ anaa obi a ne ho akokwaw wɔ aduruyɛ mu no ho. Yɛ wo nhwehwɛmu: Sua STI ne nhwehwɛmu ho ade ansa na woadi kan ayɛ. Eyi bɛboa wo ma woanya ahotoso na woabisa nsɛm pɔtee bi. Siesie nea wopɛ sɛ woka: Di kan kyerɛw wo nsɛmmisa anaa nea ɛhaw wo no to hɔ. Eyi betumi aboa wo ma woate nka sɛ woayɛ nhyehyɛe na woahwɛ ahu sɛ wobɛkata biribiara a wopɛ so. Wɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu: Fi ase de asɛm bi a ɛfa biribiara ho: Wubetumi aka biribi te sɛ, "Meresua STI ne nna mu akwahosan ho ade, na mewɔ nsɛmmisa bi." Ma tẽẽ na emu nna hɔ: Fa kasa a ɛnyɛ den na ɛyɛ tẽẽ ka nea ɛhaw wo ho asɛm. Bisa nsɛm: Sɛ woante ase a, nsuro sɛ wobɛbisa sɛ wɔmma wɔn mu da hɔ anaa wobɛsan aka biribi bio. Fa ɔkwan a wopɛ sɛ wofa so di nkitaho di dwuma: Sɛ wode mum kasa di dwuma a, hwɛ hu sɛ wo hokafo a wo ne no di nkitaho no nim na obetumi adi w’ahiade ho dwuma. Ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya wɔ akwan foforo so, te sɛ video ahorow a wɔakyerɛw nsɛm anaa mfonini ahorow wom. Fa w’adwene si wo nkate so: Ma onipa foforo no nhu sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho yeraw wo, w’ani awu, anaa woredwennwen a. Kae sɛ ɛyɛ w’akwahosan: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wubisa nsɛm na wunya nsɛm a wuhia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔpene so sɛ  wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma  na wɔakora kokoamsɛm so bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔpene so sɛ  wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma ne kokoamsɛm denam nsɛmmisa a wobebisa fa kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ho, wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ, na wɔahwehwɛ ɔhwɛ afi wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wobu wɔn ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm hokwan ahorow no hɔ. Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun wɔ hokwan wɔ mmara kwan so sɛ wɔpene nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkɔ so wɔ nyinsɛn ahorow a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe biara mu? (nsɛm tiawa, nsɛm a wɔaka abom) .
answer_twi_source: Nnuru a Wotu gu: Wobɛnom nnuru wɔ apomoden ho ɔbenfo bi hwɛ ase. Aduru no bɛma akisikuru na mogya atu de atu nyinsɛn no mu ntini no. Ebia ɛho behia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde di akyi na ama wɔatumi ayi nyinsɛn agu koraa. Oprehyɛn a Wotwa Nyinsɛn gu: Apomoden ho ɔbenfo bɛyɛ oprehyɛn ketewaa bi de ayi nyinsɛn no mu ntini no afi hɔ. Wɔtaa yɛ saa adeyɛ yi wɔ aduru a wɔde kum nipadua no mu (nnuru a ɛma obi ho dwiriw no) anaasɛ aduru a ɛma obi dwo kakra ase. Ɛda adi sɛ wo ho bɛtɔ wo wɔ ayaresabea bi bere tiaa bi ansa na woakɔ fie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ katee de ako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ennye a meremfa me nnamfo ntwe me ho anaasɛ meremfa mesɛe m’abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobenya pintinnn nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ na wode ako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ennye a worentwe wo ho mfi wo nnamfonom ho anaasɛ worensɛe w’abusuabɔ, de ahotoso ne wo ho a wubenya no adi dwuma, de odwo ne ahotoso si w’ahye so dua, na wode nipadua mu kasa a ɛyɛ den te sɛ w’ani a wobɛkɔ so ahwɛ ne nne a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ den a wode bɛkasa. Fa w’adwene si wo nsusuwii a wobɛda no adi wɔ obu mu bere a wugyina pintinn wɔ wo gyinaesi ahorow mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔahyia ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ wɔ nyɔnkofa nkitahodie anaa nna mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔapirapira anaa basabasayɛ wɔ nyɔnkofa nkitahodi anaa nna mu no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne mmara ahorow a ɛko tia ofie basabasayɛ, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ayayade, ne mmofra a wɔto wɔn mmonnaa, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ahobammɔ ho ahyɛde, afotu adwuma, ne mmara mu nsɛm ho. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mmarahyɛfo, mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no hɔ de aboa wɔn na wɔanya hokwan ahorow ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bɛn na mmeawa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so betumi ahyia wɔ nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden  ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Asetena ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛde mmarimaa nhomasua di kan na ɛto mmeawa a wontumi nkɔ baabiara ne wɔn ahofadi ano hye. Animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, a ɛma wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛpam wɔn afi hɔ. Nnwuma ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni, titiriw wɔ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu. Saa akwanside ahorow yi a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ: Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho adesua a edi mũ na ama mmeawa anya nimdeɛ wɔ wɔn nipadua, hokwan ahorow, ne nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ kokoamusɛm ma yɛde hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛtumi anya bi. Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo akasa atia mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow a epira ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu no kɔ so tra hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi de m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ me no ahyɛ m’afotu anaa ayaresa dwumadi ahorow mu, na mfaso ne sintɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ so?
answer_twi_source: W’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo a wode wɔn ho bɛhyɛ w’afotu anaa ayaresa mu no betumi anya mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow nyinaa. Mfaso ahorow no betumi ayɛ mmoa a ɛkɔ soro, nkitahodi pa wɔ abusua no mu, ne hokwan a awofo anaa ahwɛfo benya wo suahu ne wo haw ho nhumu. Nanso, sintɔ ahorow nso betumi aba, te sɛ kokoamsɛm ho dadwen anaasɛ te a wɔte nka sɛ wɔasiw wɔn kwan wɔ nsɛmti bi ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu. Awiei koraa no, ɛsɛ sɛ gyinae a wubesi sɛ wode w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo bɛka ho no gyina wo awerɛkyekye dodow ne sɛnea wo ne wɔn ntam nkitahodie te so. Wubetumi ne wo fotufo anaa wo ɔyaresafo asusuw nea wopɛ ho na moabom asi ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so asi gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ne mmoa kuo betumi adi nsɛm a ɛfa mmusuakuo ne dɛmdi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ no di nsɛnnennen soronko a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wofi mbusuakuo ahorow mu hyia no ho dwuma: Mmoa a ɛfa amammerɛ ho: Hwɛ sɛ ahwɛfo anaa kuo akannifo te wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no amammerɛ ase. Kasa Ahorow mmoa: Fa mmoa akuw a ɛwɔ kasa ahorow pii mu ma sɛ ɛho hia a. Di Nneɛma Ahorow Ho Afahyɛ: Yɛ beae a ɛma mbusuakuo ahorow ahonyade wɔ mmubuafo mpɔtam hɔ no som bo na ɛhyɛ ho afahyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mfiridwuma ne dijitaal akwahosan ho dwumadie betumi adi wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm, ne dwumadie a wɔde bɛma mmabun a wɔtu kɔtena mmeaeɛ foforɔ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabiara no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma ne digyital akwahosan ho dwumadie betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie a wɔde bɛma mmabun a wɔtu kɔtena mmeaeɛ foforɔ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforɔ, a "mobile apps", ahomatrofo so nnuru (telemedicine), ne intanɛt so nneɛma ka ho. Saa nnwinnade yi betumi adi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ no so na ɛde mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛfa amammerɛ ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na abɛɛfo mfidie 'technology' boa SRH nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Websites (nimdeɛ pa). Apps (de hwehwɛ nneɛma). SMS (nkɔmmɔbɔ mfidie). Telemedicine (intanɛt so ayaresa).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma kokoam ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo anaa wɛbsaet ahorow ma mmabun na ama wɔanya mmoa wɔ abusuabɔ mu nsɛnnennen anaa ɛhaw ho.
answer_twi_source: Hotlines: kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie bi nya mmoa firi "GHS-YMK" fotufoɔ frɛ "PPAG" yenkasa wɔ (0800202010) (wɔntua hwee) "UNICEF Agoo SHE+" wɔ (5100) wɔ "mtn" "Marie" frɛ (0302242517). "GHS-YMK app" afotufoɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nipadua ho mfonini a ɛnteɛ ne obu a wonni mma wɔn ho mu aba, na sɛ wɔrepere a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi ahwehwɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Nsɛm: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obi benya adwenemhaw, dadwen, adidi mu haw, ne ne ho a obepira. Asetra mu Tew a Wɔtew Wɔn Ho: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi asetra mu dwumadi ahorow ho ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu. Adesua mu Nkɔso a Ɛnyɛ Yiye: Nkannyan a ɛso tew, adwene a ɛyɛ den sɛ obi de n’adwene si biribi so, ne adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ a ɛnkɔ yiye. Nipadua mu Akwahosan Ho Nkɛntɛnso: Adidi mu nneyɛe a ɛnteɛ, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ne akwahosan ho su a enye. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa denam: Ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu fotufo a wɔbɛkasa afa wɔn apereperedi ho. Mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ɔyaresafo anaa adwene ne nneyɛe ho ɔbenfo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ nipadua mfonini ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ho nsɛm mu. Mmoa akuo anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔbɛtumi ne atipɛnfoɔ a ebia wɔrehyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara a wɔbɛka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneyɛe nya su ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ pene a wɔpene so, nna mu ahofadi, ne nipadua mu nokwaredi ho wɔ mpɔtam ne aman ahorow mu so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidi, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛe nya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ pene a wɔpene so, nna mu ahofadi, ne nipadua mu nokwaredi ho so nkɛntɛnso "influence" kɛse: Amammerɛ mu Ahorow: Amammerɛ ahorow wɔ adwene soronko wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho, a abakɔsɛm, nyamesom, ne asetra mu nneɛma nya so nkɛntɛnso "influence". Amammerɛ ahorow bi si ankorankoro ahofadi ne pene a wɔpene so so dua, bere a afoforo de ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow ne abusua akwanhwɛ di kan wɔ gyinaesi mu. Nnipa a wɔbom yɛ adwuma vs. Ankorankoro: Amammerɛ a ɛde nnipa dodow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu di kan no betumi asi abusua ne mpɔtam hɔ akwanhwɛ so dua kɛse, na anya tumi a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔn ankasa pene so na wɔwɔ ahofadi so nkɛntɛnso. Nyamesom mu Nkɛntɛnso: Nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi akyerɛ adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna ne pene a wɔpene so ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, amammerɛ ahorow a nyamesom ho nkyerɛase ahorow a ɛyɛ katee anya so nkɛntɛnso no betumi anya adwene a emu yɛ den wɔ nna a edi aware anim ne nna mu ahofadi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwennwen, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka yɛn adwene ne yɛn nipadua akwahosan wɔ berɛ a yɛyɛ babun?
answer_twi_source: Adwennwen yɛ sɛnea nipadua no si gye ɔhaw anaa nneɛma a ɛhwehwɛ, na ɛkanyan nipadua ne adwene mu nneyɛe. Wɔ berɛ a woyɛ babun no, adwennwen betumi aka adwenemyare denam dadwen, abufuw, ne adwene a ɛba fam ho nkate a ɛkɔ soro no so. Ebetumi anya nipadua akwahosan nso so nsunsuanso, na ama nsakrae aba woaduan ho akɔnnɔ mu, nna a ɛyɛ basaa, ne tiyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma nnwumakuo ahorow a agye din a wɔkamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu na wɔma hokwan ahorow ma mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ mu.
answer_twi_source: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): Ebia wɔwɔ mmabun ho nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu. Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health (GYARH): Ebia wɔn wɛbsaet no wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu. Mariesopes Ghana, Ghana Akwahosan Dwumadibea
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na me nteteɛ ne gyidie di de to ahyeɛ na ɛboa ayɔnkofa mapa ?
answer_twi_source: Ahyeɛ fapen no nyinaa gyina wo gyidie ne wonteteɛ. Ɛboa ma wohu deɛ ɛyɛ ne deɛ ɛnyɛ. Sɛ wonim wo gyidie a, wotumi ka deɛ ɛhia wo yie na ɛboa ma wotumi gyina pintinn woberɛ a woresi agyina yɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛma adwene (feedback) fa mmoa dwumadie ho?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhwehwɛmu (surveys). Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ. Dɔm mpaninfoɔ akuo anaa mmoa bagua (boards' anaa 'councils).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehyia aduane a wonnya nni anaasɛ wonni afie wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Aduane Ho Mmoa Nhyehyɛe: Aduankorabea, soup kitchen, ne mpɔtam hɔfo aduan ho nhyehyɛe ma wonya ahotɔ ntɛm ara. Dabere ne adan a wɔde ma bere tiaa mu no ma wonya bere tiaa mu adan ano aduru. Mpɔtam hɔ asetena mu dwumadie adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ bɛtumi de afotuo, asɛm no ho dwumadie, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma nneɛma foforɔ. Nnwuma a ɛfa mmabun pɔtee ho: Ahyehyɛde ahorow bi yɛ wɔn ho titiriw wɔ mmabun a wonni afie anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ asiane mu som mu, de dabere, mmeae a wɔde wɔn kɔ, afotu, ne mmoa akuw a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade ahorow ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ayeresa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔfɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ insurance boa nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano?
answer_twi_source: Ɔman insurance (NHIS) tua nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano wɔ ayaresabea. Kasa kyerɛ dɔkota na hu nea wɔtua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow, suapɔn ahorow, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow tumi di de boa mmabun ma wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ho adwuma mu, de ma sika ho tumi?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ sika nsɛm. Ma nteteeɛ/afotu. Ne mpanyimfoɔ nyɛ adwuma. Ne mmreayɛfo ndi dwuma a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpanyimfoɔ bɛn na wɔbetumi aboa me wɔ tipɛnfo nhyɛso mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ/Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wogyin won di. Adwen mu hwɛfo nea broni bɛkasɛ 'Mental health professionals'. atorofo ahoma nea broni bɛkasɛ (0800678678).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina nsakraeɛ a ɛba me nipadua mu ne nna ho atenka a ɛba mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne ɔpanin anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu gyedie nka w'atenka ho asɛm. Sua nimdeɛ a ɛfa mmabunyɛ ho, ne nna apɔwmuden mu ho nsɛm. Kae sɛ obiara fa nsakraeɛ yi mu, na ɛnyɛ bɔne sɛ wobenya nsɛmmisa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a epira a abu so ne nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ mmabun so nsunsuanso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahyɛ amammerɛ mu atenka ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛm a epira a abu so ne nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ mmabun so nsunsuanso kɛse wɔ adwene a ɛwɔ ahoɔfɛ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne abusuabɔ ho a ɛsakra no so. Amammerɛ mu atenka ne ahorow ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo mu no hwehwɛ sɛ: Wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nnipa ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne adwene ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ahorow mu mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware na obu wom. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, aguade ho dawurubɔfo, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔhyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa nkabom, ananmusifo, ne pɛyɛ nni kan wɔ wɔn abasɛm ne nkrasɛm mu. Nnwuma a wɔboa a ɛma nne ahorow a wonni gyinabea pa no yɛ kɛse na ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a egyina abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ onipa so. Amammerɛ ahodoɔ ntam nkɔmmɔdie ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de asiw amammerɛ mu mpaepaemu ano, ahyɛ tema, na wɔama nteaseɛ akɔ so wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkamfo nkurɔfo no ka nnipa nyinaa ho na egyina hɔ ma nne ne adwene ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nnipa nyinaa ka ho na ɛyɛ nne ne adwene ahorow ananmusifo denam nsiyɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua hɔ nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, mmeae a ahobammɔ ne nnipa nyinaa ka ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, akwan horow a wɔfa so de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ a wobedi ho dwuma, na wɔde wɔn a nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsonsonoe aka wɔn kɛse no nne adi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na honam mu nkwammoa 'hormone' ahorow di wɔ nna mu nkɔso ma wɔn a wɔresi sɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Honam mu nkwammoaa te sɛ testosterone (mmarimaa deɛ) ne estrogen (mmeawa deɛ) kanyan nipadua mu nsakrae ne nna ho nkate. Wɔsan nya adwene ne nea ɛtwetwe nkurɔfo so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔpɛsɛ wosua pii fa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho na wɔyɛ ho biribi de hyɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma no bi ne: Nhomasua nneɛma ne nnwinnadeɛ a ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne mmabun ahoɔden so de ama. Intanɛt so nhyiam horow ne nhyiam ahorow a mmabun betumi anya nsɛm, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwene koro adi nkitaho. Ahyehyɛde ne akuw a wɔkamfo mmabun di anim a wɔde akannifo ntetee, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma ma. Mmoa nhama, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehyia nyiyimu anaa basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so. Nhoma, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ afoforo a ɛhwehwɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsɛm mu na ɛhyɛ ntease ne tema ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee na efi nokwaredi mu a ɛfa nna mu anigye ne abotɔyam a me ne me hokafo nya ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ Beae a Ahobammɔ: Fa tebea bi si hɔ a ahokafo baanu no nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbɔ akɔnnɔ ne ahiade ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ. Hyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔabue ano a wɔde bedi nkitaho a wonni atemmu ho nkuran. Bisa Nsɛm: Bisa wo hokafo no nea n’ani gye ho ne nea ɛma ne ho tɔ no. Ka w’ankasa w’anigye ne w’akɔnnɔ ahorow ho asɛm pefee a wunsuro. Nea broni ka no 'Feedback Loop': Fa nsɛm pa ma bere a wo hokafo reyɛ biribi a w’ani gye ho no. Nya nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ no tom na nya ɔpɛ sɛ wubegyina mmuae a mo ho mo ho bɛma so ayɛ nsakrae. Nea broni ka no Check-Ins: Mo ne mo ho mo ho nkɔhwɛ nea ɛreyɛ adwuma ne nea wobetumi ama atu mpɔn daa. Fa nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu de di dwuma bere a woreda nna mu de ka anigye anaa ɔhaw a ɛwɔ wo ho adi. Nna mu Yiyedi Ho Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Mommɔ nkɔmmɔ a wɔahyira so a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, anigye, ne abotɔyam ho wɔ bere a ɛbɛn wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ hwee sɛ me ne wo bɛkasa afa nsakrae ahorow yi ho?
answer_twi_source: Pɛpɛɛpɛ! Mmabunbere yɛ asetena mu ade a ɛfata, nanso ebetumi ama obi adwene atu afra nso. Nsakrae yi ho asɛm a wobɛka no yɛ ɔkwan a ɛfata na ɛho hia a wobɛfa so ate nea ɛrekɔ so wɔ wo nipadua so no ase. Mewɔ ha sɛ merebɛbua mo nsɛmmisa wɔ ɔkwan a ahotɔ ne nsɛm wom so, nanso nneɛma akɛseɛ foforɔ nso wɔ hɔ. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di a wubetumi ne wɔn akasa ni: Awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn Oduruyɛfo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo Ɔfotufo Onua panyin anaa adamfo a wogye no di
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atutra ne displacement boa ma amammerɛ ahorow ba na ɛka mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Atutra ne displacement boa ma amammerɛ ahorow ba denam nnipa a wofi mmeae ahorow ne atetesɛm ahorow a ɛka bom no so. Saa su anaa amammerɛ ahorow yi betumi anya mmabun akwahosan so nsunsuanso denam nna ne awo ho nnwuma, asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a wobenya so nsunsuanso so. Ebetumi nso de ɔhaw aba wɔ anammɔntuo a wɔretu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn amammerɛ ne amanneɛ ho ban ne wɔn nipasu wɔ aberɛ a wɔreadapte to tebea foforɔ mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔhaw ahorow bɛn na ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a sukuu mu nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no taa di ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi taa di ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma, a nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho dadwen, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho dadwen, nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so ho osuahu ahorow, nkitahodie ho nsɛm, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene, ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ahiade ahorow ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama nna mu nsɛm ho adesua 'CSE' ne nna mu nsɛm mu 'SRH' mmoa wɔ me mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne dahurubɔ (Education). Dɔm kuo. Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ. Yɛ mpɔtam dwumadie (Community events).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho berɛ a wɔde mmabun ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa de wɔn pɛ firi wɔn fa ma ho kwan ansa na wɔayɛ biribi, na wɔabu wɔn anidie, wɔn kokoam nsɛm, ne wɔn tumi a wɔde si gyinaeɛ no nni. Wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata mfeɛ a wɔadi ma wɔn, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔte aseɛ yie, ɛnna wɔanhyɛ wɔn anaa wɔandaadaa wɔn kwan biara so.Wɔbɔ wɔn ho ban firi bɔne biara a ebetumi ato wɔn ho, te sɛ aniwuo, nyiyimu, anaa nneɛma bɔne a wɔanhwɛ kwan a ɛbɛba. Wɔhyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ne nnipa nyinaa baakoyɛ ho nkuran, na wɔgye nnipa nyinaa gyinapɛn ne wɔn ahiadeɛ to mu. Wɔdi mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa yiedie ne wɔn apɔmuden kan, na wɔahwɛ sɛ obiara kwan a ɔwɔ sɛ osi gyinaeɛ ne dɔm nyinaa botaeɛ bɛhyia pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya tumi a wɔde behu, ate ase, na wɔadi ntawntawdi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ ne obu so, bere a wosusuw nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa adwene, nkate, ne ahiade ahorow ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya tumi a wɔde behu, ate ase, na wɔadi ntawntawdi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ ne obu so denam: Wɔn ankasa ho a wɔde bedi dwuma: Wɔn ankasa nkate, gyinapɛn, ne ahiade ahorow a wobesusuw ho wɔ ntawntawdi tebea horow mu no so. Tie a yɛde nsiyɛ: Yɛ atie afoforo adwene, wɔn nkate, ne wɔn dadwen a worentwitware wɔn ntam anaa wommu atɛn. Tema a yɛbɛda no adi: Afoforo nkate ne osuahu ahorow a wobehu na wɔagye atom, sɛ ɛsono wɔn ankasa de mpo a. Nkitahodi a wɔde asi wɔn ani so: Wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn nkate, ne wɔn ahye a wɔbɛda no adi pefee na wɔkyerɛ obu. Hwehwɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ sɛ wogyae nneɛma mu: Wo ne afoforo bɛyɛ biako ahwehwɛ ano aduru a wɔn nyinaa gye tom a ɛfa obiara ahiade ne n’adwennwen ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ na m'abu m’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne botae ahorow  bere a meresisi nna ho gyinae no?
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho Adwennwen 'Self Reflection': Gye bere fa te wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no ase. Susuw sɛnea wo gyinaesi ahorow ne w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow hyia ho. 'Journaling': Yɛ 'journal' na susuw wo nkate ne wo nsusuwii wɔ nna ho. Kyerɛw wo botae ne daakye ho apɛde ahorow to hɔ. Hwɛ Ankorankoro a Wogye Wɔn Di: Wo ne ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa ɔfotufo bi a wogye no di mfa wo gyinapɛn ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ. Hwehwɛ afotu fi obi a wubu no na ɔte wo gyidi ase hɔ. Fa w’adwene bu Daakye: Susuw sɛnea gyinaesi ahorow a wubesisi nnɛ no betumi aka wo daakye botae ahorow ho hwɛ. Susuw sɛ ebia wo nneyɛe ne onipa a wopɛ sɛ woyɛ no hyia anaa. Di Wo Ho Nokware: Fa wo ho to wo nkate ne wo nkate so wɔ nea ɛfata wo ho. Mma nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wo ne afoforo akwanhwɛ nhyia sɛ ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa wɔ apɔwmuden asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu anaa mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu pii de akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam ma, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho, denam akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ beae hɔ anaasɛ fekubɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo yɛ so. Mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow ne awoɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow nso de STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa adwuma ma wɔ bere soronko mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ obiara benya nna ho akɔnnɔ wɔ ɔkwan koro so?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa sɛ obi bɛpɛ sɛ ɔne obi foforɔ nya nkitaho pɛfee, yɛ soronko ma obiara. Nneɛma te sɛ "hormones," obi nteɛm (emotions), n'asetena mu suahu, ne nneɛma a n'ani gye ho betumi anya nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ saa akɔnnɔ yi so. Nnipa bi nya akɔnnɔ a ɛyɛ den berɛ biara, berɛ a afoforɔ nso nnya saa daa. Baabiara nni hɔ a wɔakyerɛ sɛ ɛhɔ na ɛsɛ sɛ obi akɔnnɔ duru, na mfomsoɔ biara nni mu sɛ wo deɛ no bɛsesa wɔ berɛ bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a, ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a ɛwɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ amammerɛ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi ayɛ: Animtiaabu anaa aniwu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho, a ɛde kommyɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ba. Akwanhwɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so anaa gyinapɛn abien a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe, ahofadi, ne awo mu dwumadi ahorow ho. Atosɛm anaa anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa brayɛ, awo, ne awo ho a ɛma kokoamsɛm anaa nimdeɛ a wonni.Wobetumi akasa atia eyinom denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee, nhomasua, ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu a ɛfa atosɛm anaa anansesɛm, adwene a ɛnteɛ, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira ho nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di wɔ sukuu ne fie ho nkuran na ama wɔakyekye mmoa nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den.
answer_twi_source: Ɔpanyin a wogye no di a wo ne no bɛkasa wɔ sukuu anaa fie no betumi ayɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so akyekye mmoa nhyehyɛe na woanya nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma. Nsuro sɛ wobɛtene wo nsa!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne afotufo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nhumu a ɛyɛ katee ho nimdeɛ, anya tema, fekubɔ, ne biakoyɛ a wɔne akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no ayɛ, na wɔayɛ ade de ahyɛ asetra mu nsakrae ne atɛntrenee ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a ɛfiri Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne Afotufoɔ hɔ: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, mpɔtam akannifoɔ ne afotufoɔ bɛtumi aboa mmabun wɔ wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne wɔn nhumu a ɛho hia a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ denam tema, ayɔnkofa, ne baakoyɛ a wɔbɛma wɔne akuo a wɔato wɔn agu nkyɛn no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wɔbɛma hokwan ahorow ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee, wɔbɛhyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran, wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abrabɔ pa ho nhwɛso, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ne dwumadi ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya denam telehealth platform ahorow so de asua pii afa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, telehealth so akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pii de nneɛma, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, ne nkitahodi ahorow a ɛkɔ wɛbsaet ahorow a wogye di anaa intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔkora so a mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfata wɔn mfe ma. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ayɛ nsɛm, nokwasɛm nkrataa, video ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde di nkitaho, ne nkrata a ɛso a wobetumi atwe a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STIs, brayɛ, nsabuo akwahosan, nyinsɛn, ne nea ɛkeka ho ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ nso bɛtumi ne ayarefoɔ akyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma wɔ berɛ a wɔrehyia akwahosan wɔ telehealth so de aka wɔn nkɔmmɔdie ho na wɔde mmoa ne nsɛm foforɔ ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahohorow betumi atu de ayɛ tebea a ɛma ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no akwaaba na ɛnyɛ atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ayɛ mmeae a mmabun betumi akɔ, a mmeae a wɔtwɛn a akenkan nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛfata wɔn mfe ka ho. Adwumayɛfo betumi anya ntetee a ɛfa nkate ho na ama wɔate ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow ase yie. Sɛ wɔma mmabun nya kwan kɔ kokoam nsɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm bɛto hɔ bere a wɔahyiam a, ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ. Ɛnsɛ sɛ bere a mmabun de twɛn no yɛ tenten wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, wɔn akɔnnɔ, ne nea wɔn ani gye ho ne nea gua so, adetɔnfo, wɔn a wɔde wɔn sika hyɛ mu, anaa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu  aborɔfo ka no 'stakeholders' no hwehwɛ a broni ka no 'demand'?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, wɔn akɔnnɔ, ne nea wɔn ani gye ho ne nea gua so nneɛma hwehwɛ ne nea wɔhwɛ kwan denam wɔn nnwuma a wɔbɛma ne nneɛma a wogye di no ahyia na wɔafa aguadi ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛda wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow adi no so. Wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee, nokwaredi, ne nokware adi kan wɔ wɔne adetɔfo, sikakorafo, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nkitahodi mu, na wɔahwehwɛ fekubɔ ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ adwene koro a wɔne wɔn bo a wɔde ma wɔ asetra ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho asɛde.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo ne ahwɛfo betumi ayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛbɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa abusuabɔ a obu wom ho nkɔmmɔ wɔ sukuu, mpɔtam, ne afiefie mu?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne ahwɛfo bɛtumi ayɛ mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ ne nnipa nyinaa ka ho a wɔbɛsusu nsɛmti a ɛfa abusuabɔ a obuo wom ho denam nkitahodiɛ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, mmara a ɛwɔ aseɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama nkɔmmɔdie a obuo wom, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛfata mfeɛ a wɔadi na ɛka obiara ho a wɔde bɛma, ne nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene anaa nsɛmmisa biara a wɔde tema ne nkateɛ bedi ho dwuma. Nneɛma te sɛ ahɔho akasafo, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma nso betumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ akɔ anim na ama mmoa foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛeɛ bɛn na ɛhwɛ kɔkoamunsɛm ne kokoam banbɔ so ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ ahokyere mmoa ama nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ kɔkoamunsɛm ne kokoam banbɔ so ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ ahokyere mmoa ama nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden nsɛm no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi mu. Wɔ Ghana no, mmara mu nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtaa kɔ so te saa no bi ne adɔketafoɔ nsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ ne ɔyarefoɔ mmara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne osi akwan ahorow a ɛwɔ dabere ne adan ho nnwuma mu, na sɛ wɔn ahiade boro nea nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ no tumi so a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya mmoa anaa nneɛma foforo?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama wɔn ho wɔ: Wɔn ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ pefee akyerɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ dabere anaa wɔn a wɔde adan ho adwumayɛfo ma no so. Nsɛm a wobɛbisa fa nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ, gyinapɛn a wɔde fata, ne hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔtefoɔ ho. Dabere anaa nsakrae a egyina wɔn ankorankoro tebea so a wɔbɛsrɛ, te sɛ kokoam nsɛm a wɔpɛ anaa ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ sɛ wohyia akwanside anaa nyiyim wɔ nnwuma a wobenya mu a. Nkitahodi, apam, ne nkrataa a ɛho hia a ɛfa wɔn adan tebea ho ho kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔasiesie no pɔtee sɛ wobedi ɔhaw soronko a mmabun hyia, te sɛ adesua mu nhyɛso anaa asetra mu nhyɛso ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔasiesie no titiriw sɛ wobedi ɔhaw soronko a mmabun hyia, te sɛ adesua mu nhyɛso anaa asetra mu nhyɛso ahorow ho dwuma. Sukuu ahorow bi de afotu anaa mmoa akuw ma de boa asuafo ma wogyina adwennwen ano boa asetra mu nkitahodie mu. Bio nso, nhyehyɛe titiriw anaa ayaresabea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde wɔn adwene si nsɛm a mmabun taa hyia te sɛ adidi mu haw, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, anaa wɔn ho a wopira so. Saa nnwuma yi taa susuw mmabun nkɔso fã ne wɔn ahiade pɔtee ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dwumadi ahorow a ɛnyɛ adesua, anigyede, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akuw a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no boa ma nnamfofa ne adwene mu yiyedi nya mpontu wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi, nneɛma a wɔde gye wɔn ani, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akuw mu no ma wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo a wɔn ani gye nneɛma koro ho di nkitaho, na ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wɔboa wɔn wɔ asetra mu. Dwumadi ahorow a ɛtete saa mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nso ma wonya hokwan ahorow ma ankorankoro nyin, ahokokwaw mu nkɔso, ne adwennwen ano brɛ ase, na awiei koraa no ɛboa ma obi nya adwene mu yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu sɛ ebia wohia ayaresa ntɛm ara anaasɛ wobetumi atwɛn akɔhwɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ wɔ adwumayɛbea bere a wɔtaa yɛ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun bi nnim sɛ ebia ohia ayaresa ntɛm ara anaasɛ obetumi atwɛn akɔhwɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ adwumayɛbea bere a wɔtaa yɛ mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw sɛnea wɔn sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no mu yɛ den no ho. Sɛ wɔrete ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, mogya retu wɔn, ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛhome, anaa sɛnkyerɛnne foforo biara a emu yɛ den a, ɛsɛsɛ wɔhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a egye ntɛmpɛ ntɛm ara. Sɛ ɛnte saa a, mpɛn pii no wobetumi atwɛn akɔhwɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ adwumayɛbea bere a wɔtaa yɛ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ɛwɔ ankorankoro ho nsɛm anaa adagyaw mfonini a wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no mu? (sexting) .
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro ho nsɛm anaa adagyaw mfonini a wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no betumi de asiane ahorow pii aba, a nea ɛka ho ne: Kokoam nsɛm a wobu so: Wobetumi de ankorankoro ho nsɛm akyɛ a wɔmmpene so, na ɛde aniwu anaa ɔhaw aba. Nna mu apoo: Ankorankoro betumi de adagyaw mfonini adi dwuma de abɔ afoforo sobo anaasɛ wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa. Mmara kwan so nsunsuanso: Mmofra nkumaa a wɔda adagyaw mfonini a wɔbɛkyɛ no betumi de mmara mu nsɛm aba, a mmofra nguamansɛm ho sobo ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔ kyerɛkyerɛ adwenemyareɛ ho nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie ɛkyerɛ asuafoɔ, awofoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔde?
answer_twi_source: Wɔnam akwan ahodoɔ so de adwenemyareɛ ho nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie ma asuafoɔ, awofoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Sukuu wɛbsaet, nsɛmma nwoma, ne sohyial media akwan a ɛma nsɛm fa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ, mmoa akuo, ne nsɛm a ɛreba ho. Nkratawa, nkrataa, ne amanneɛbɔ kyerɛwpon a wɔde akyerɛ wɔ mmeae a wɔtaa de di dwuma de hyɛ adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ ne mmoa adwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nkuran. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu nhyiamu anaa awofoɔ anadwo a adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ de nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ne mmoa a wɔbɛtumi apaw ho ma. Nneɛma a wɔde kɔma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma asuafoɔ ne mmusua ne adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie a ɛfata ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛkuo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de atrɛ adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛnya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmra kwan so hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun a wɔnyem wɔ wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho, a ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, akwan a wɔbɛfa so awo, ne awo akyi hwɛ ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔnyem wɔ mmra kwan so hokwan ahorow wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ansa na wɔawo, akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so awo, ne awo akyi hwɛ, a mfe a wɔadi, aware tebea, anaa awofo pene mfa ho. Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobetumi apaw, asiane ahorow, ne mfaso horow ho wɔ kasa ne ɔkwan a wɔte ase mu, na ama wɔatumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nyinsɛn ne awo ho. Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpow ayaresa anaa akwan horow a wɔbɛyɛ, sɛ wɔwɔ tumi a wɔde bɛte nea ebefi nea wɔpaw mu aba no ase na wonsusuw sɛ wɔwɔ asiane mu ntɛm ara sɛ wobepira wɔn anaasɛ wɔde wɔn akwahosan anaa wɔn ba a ɔhyɛ yafunu mu no akwahosan bɛto asiane mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn anya saa nimdeɛ ahorow yi de ada m’ahiade, nea mepɛ, ne ahyeɛ adi yiye?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den mu no bi ne kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tẽẽ a wode bedi dwuma, wo nsusuwii ne wo atenka a wobɛda no adi wɔ ɔkwan a so nan w'asi w'adwene pii nso obu mu, w’ani a wode bɛhwɛ wo ho ne nipadua mu kasa a ɛfata a wode bɛkɔ so, ne afoforo adwene a wode nsiyɛ tie. Sɛ wobɛnya saa nimdeɛ yi a, fa nkitahodiɛ akwan a ɛyɛ den te sɛ "Me" nsɛm (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, "Mete nka..."), nipadua kasa a ɛyɛ den (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, gyinabea tenten, aniwa a wode bɛhwɛ), ne atie a ɛyɛ nnam (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ, nsɛm a wɔka no foforɔ, adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho) di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen bi wɔ kokoamsɛm ho wɔ akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun a wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ kokoamsɛm ho wɔ akwahosan ho no betumi ayɛ: Ahintasɛm telefon anaa intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ adwumayɛbea a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn na wɔyɛ adwuma. Mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho. Nhomasua nneɛma anaa wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa kokoam hokwan ahorow ne akwahosan ho kokoam nsɛm ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahomatrofoɔ anaa internet so mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔyinsɛn?
answer_twi_source: YMK App. Kasa kyerɛ 'school nurse' anaa ayaresafoɔ a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ na wɔakyerɛ wo kuo ahorow a ɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minyinsɛn, na misi gyinae sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne ɔkwan a ɛfata ma me a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Wo nsɛmmisa a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho mmuae ni: 11. Akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so ayɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu, na sɛ ɛho hia a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya bi a ɛnhia awofo mpene so? Nyinsɛn Sɔhwɛ ne Afotuo: Ayaresabea ne Akwahosan Asoɛeɛ: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ awoɔ akwahosan ayaresabea, abusua nhyehyɛeɛ mmeaeɛ, anaa akwahosan dwumadibea ahodoɔ kɔhwɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu wɔ kokoam. Akwahosan Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Sukuu So: Sukuu ahorow bi de nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu ma. Nnurutɔnbea ahorow: Wobetumi anya nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ho nneɛma a wɔde yɛ fie a wɔtɔn wɔ nnurutɔnbea ahorow. Sɛ Wobɛkɔ a Worenhia Awofoɔ Mpene: Ahintasɛm: Ayaresabea pii de kokoam nnwuma ma, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔremmɔ w’awofoɔ anaa w’ahwɛfoɔ amanneɛ a wonnyaa wo kwan. Mmara kwan so Hokwan ahorow: Ɛdenam beae a wowɔ so no, mmara betumi ama mmofra nkumaa apene so sɛ wɔnyɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne nnwuma a ɛfa ho a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu. 12. Sɛ minyinsɛn na misi gyinae sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne ɔkwan a ɛfata ma me a, mɛyɛ dɛn anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow? Nyinsɛn a Wotu Gu Ho Dwumadie a Wobɛnya: Ayaresabea ne Akwahosan Asoɛeɛ: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea anaa akwahosan asoɛeɛ a wɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho dwumadie ma. Telehealth Services: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow bi de aduruyɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so ma de kɔhwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma nkurɔfo. Hotlines ne Support Groups: Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Planned Parenthood de nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho ma. Mmara mu Nsusuwii: Hu Mmara no: Hwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara a ɛwɔ wo man anaa wo mantam mu no mu na woate hokwan ahorow a wowɔ ne akwan horow a wubetumi afa so no ase. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ Mmoa: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ dwumadie no mu, a mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma ho nsɛm ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ntentanfidie so dwumadibea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm titiriw?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ntentanfidie dwumadibea ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔhwehwɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm. Saa beaeɛ ahorow yi taa de nneɛma a edi mu na ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI, nkitahodie pa, ne pene a wɔpene so ho. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Planned Parenthood "Teen Talk" wɛbsaet a ɛko ma mmabun, nna, ne ade. "website TeensHealth website by Nemours Children’s Health System Scarleteen" wɛbsaet a wɔde ma mmabun ne mpaninfoɔ nkumaa wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu, Ghana akwahosan adwumayɛbea Mmabun akwahosan ne nkɔsoɔ wɛbsaet
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu nsunsuanso bɔne a animtiaabu nya wɔ mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu no so.
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu betumi anya mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu no so nsunsuanso bɔne kɛse. Ebetumi ama: Tew ne Aniwu: Te nka sɛ ankonam na afoforo bu no atɛn. Ɔhwɛ a Wɔkyɛ: Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan. Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Nsɛm: Dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne afobu nka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Apɔmuden ho insurance (Aban apɔmuden banbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ) nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, te sɛ ɔman insurance, ankorankoro insurance, insurance a adwumawura boa, insurance a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, ne asetra mu apɔmuden ho ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ɔman insurance(Aban apɔmuden banbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ): Insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow a aban de sika boa, te sɛ Medicaid anaa Mmofra Apɔmuden Insurance Nhyehyɛe (CHIP) ma mmabun ne mmusua a wɔfata a wonnya sika pii no tua ho ka, na ɛma wonya mfaso a edi mu a wɔatew so anaasɛ wontua hwee. Ankorankoro insurance: Aguadi insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow a ankorankoro nnwumakuw anaa adwumawuranom de ma no ma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua tua ho ka, mpɛn pii no ɛnam sika a wotua, sika a wɔde bom tua, sika a wɔtew fi mu, ne anohyeto ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe so. Insurance a adwumawura boa: Mmabun pii nya apɔmuden ho insurance denam wɔn awofo anaa wɔn ahwɛfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a adwumawura boa so, a ebetumi ama wɔanya mfaso ahorow, a aduruyɛ, nsensan, anisoadehu, ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn ka ho. Insurance a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so: Fekuw ahorow a wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho, mpɔtam apɔmuden sikakorabea, anaa insurance nketewa nhyehyɛe ahorow ma apɔmuden ho insurance a ne bo nyɛ den a wɔayɛ ama mpɔtam pɔtee bi ahiade, a wɔboaboa nneɛma ano na wɔkyɛ asiane ahorow wɔ asɔremma mu. Asetra mu apɔmuden ho banbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow: Asetra mu ahobammɔ afiri, te sɛ sika a wɔde ma wɔ tebea bi mu, asetra mu apɔmuden ho insurance, anaa apɔmuden ho sika a wɔde ma no, de wɔn ani si nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ so, a mmabun ka ho, na ama apɔmuden ho nnwuma a ɛho hia ne sikasɛm mu asiane ho ahobammɔ a wobenya no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akasa ama nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nyinaa benya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ntetee, ne mmoa nnwuma de anya asane ho adwene a etu mpɔn ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ  wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ no ne sɛ: Wɔma nkurɔfo hu: Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ afoforo hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ma wɔ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom, abusuabɔ pa, ne yiyedi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun mu no ho. Mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano: Wo ne sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, mpɔtam akannifoɔ, ne awofoɔ nni nkitaho mfa nkamfo sɛ wɔmfa nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so a ɛdi mmabun ahiadeɛ ne suahunu ahodoɔ ho dwuma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, mmabun akuw, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛyɛ biako de aboa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, nneɛma, ne mmoa nnwuma a mmabun nyinaa nya mu. Ankorankoro nsɛm a wobɛkyɛ: Ka w’ankasa osuahu ne w’adwene wɔ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma wɔ tumi a wɔde ma mmabun ma wɔpaw nea ɛfata na wɔadi nna mu akwahosan ho asiane ahorow ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so (GBV) ne nna mu basabasayɛ a ɛba bere a ntawntawdi rekɔ so no kyerɛ wɔ mmabun SRH, adwenemyare, ne asetra mu biakoyɛ wɔ ntawatawdi akyi tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ne Adwene mu Akwahosan: GBV ne nna mu basabasayɛ bere a ntawatawdi rekɔ so no nya nsunsuanso kɛse wɔ mmabun nipadua ne adwene mu akwahosan so, na ɛde opira, nyinsɛn a wɔmpɛ, nna mu yarerɛ  (STI), ahodwiriw, ne adwene mu haw ba. Asetra mu Nkabom: Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ GBV ne nna mu basabasayɛ mu no betumi ahyia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne asetra mu nyiyim, na asiw wɔn asetra mu nkabom ne SRH nnwuma ne mmoa a wobenya wɔ ntawatawdi akyi tebea horow mu no kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ mfiridwuma mu nneɛma foforo ma ɛne mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ne asetra ne sikasɛm mu tebea horow mu ahiade ahorow ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asiesie mfiridwuma foforo ma adi mmabun ahiade ahorow ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma denam: Wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so no a wɔbɛbom ayɛ nhyehyɛe: Mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ne asetra mu sikasɛm mu tebea ahorow mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ne nkɔso nhyehyɛe no mu no hwɛ hu sɛ mfiridwuma ano aduru no yɛ nea ɛfata sɛ wɔde di dwuma, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛne wɔn ahiade hyia. Nneɛma a wotumi sesa no a wɔde ma: Kasa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma a nea ɛka ho ne nsɛmti nketewa, emu nsɛm a wɔpɛ, ne kokoam nsɛm a wɔhwɛ so no ma mmabun tumi yɛ wɔn dijitaal osuahu ahorow no sɛnea wɔpɛ na wonya ASRH ho nsɛm wɔ akwan horow a ɛne wɔn amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow hyia so. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no nsɛm a wɔka ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho sɔhwɛ a wɔbɛyɛ: Nsɛm a wɔbɛboaboa ano afi mmabun a wɔde di dwuma awiei no hɔ denam nhwehwɛmu, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho sɔhwɛ ahorow so no boa ma wohu nsɛm a ɛfa dwumadie ho, nea wɔpɛ, ne nyansahyɛ a wɔde bɛma ASRH dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma so no a wɔbɛtumi anya ne nea wɔgye tom no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne ɔmanfo adwene nya tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ (HIV) ano aduru ne ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne ɔmanfo adwene betumi anya mmabun a wobenya nna mu yareɛ  (HIV) ano aduru ne ayaresa ho nnwuma a edi mu wɔ animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ so nsunsuanso so. Saa akwanside ahorow yi a wobedi so no hwehwɛ sɛ mpɔtam hɔfo nkɔmmɔbɔ, nhomasua ɔsatu ahorow, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ne nea ɛnyɛ atemmu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa bɛma mmabun a wɔwɔ nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoam ahobammɔ ho wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ne mmoa tebea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nneɛma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa bɛma mmabun wɔ kokoam nsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ ho. Ebia eyinom bi ne akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne kokoam mmoa nhama a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ kokoam hokwan ahorow ne akwahosan ho abrabɔ pa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so nya ahotoso wɔ gyinaesi mu, ka a meyɛ katee, ne ahoɔden a mede gyina ano wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne abɔnten nkɛntɛnso ahorow a ebetumi aka me nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" a mepaw no anim?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so nya gyinaesi mu ahotoso, katee "assertiveness", ne ahoɔden "confidence" a wɔde gyina ano wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso anim no bi ne: Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ katee ne akwan a wɔfa so hyehyɛ ahye a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ dwumadi ahorow anaa asetra mu tebea horow ankasa mu. Ahotoso a wubenya wɔ wo ho ne obu a wubenya wɔ wo ho denam wo ho a wobɛka pa, wo ho a wobɛhwɛ, ne gyidi ahorow a wubesi so dua wɔ tumi a wubetumi apaw nneɛma a ɛfata so. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di anaa atipɛnfo akuw a wobu wo gyinaesi ahorow na wɔde nkuranhyɛ ne nea wogye tom ma no hɔ. Akwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano a wɔbɛfa so adi adwennwen, dadwen, anaa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho dwuma no kanyan yiye na ɛma obi dwo wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun bi di nkitaho wɔ ɔhaw ho mmoa telefon so a, mmoa bɛn na wususuw sɛ anka obenya, na nsɛm bɛn na ebia wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ fa kyɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi aboa wo?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wofrɛ telefon a wɔde boa wɔ ɔhaw mu a, odwumayɛni bi a wɔatete no bebua na watie wo. Wobebu wo nkate aniberesɛm na wɔde afotu anaa mmoa a egyina nea wuhia so bɛma wo. Ebia wobebisa nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den te sɛ mfe a woadi, baabi a wote, ne nea enti a worefrɛ, nanso enhia sɛ woka biribiara a wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ. Wubetumi akɔ so abɔ wo din sɛ wopɛ a. Biribiara a wobɛka no yɛ kokoam de, na wɔremmu wo atɛn anaa wɔrenhyɛ wo sɛ wonyɛ biribiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahobanbɔ bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde si hɔ de bɔ mmabun ho ban fi nhyɛso, ayayade, ne ateetee ho wɔ 'ASRH' nnwuma mu, titiriw ma wɔn a ebia wɔbɛyɛ mmerɛw esiane wɔn mfe, wɔn bɔbeasu, anaa asetra mu sikasɛm tebea nti?
answer_twi_source: Ahobanbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afiri nhyɛsoɔ, ayayadeɛ, ne ayayadeɛ ho wɔ ASRH dwumadie mu no bi ne: Nteteeɛ ne hwɛ: Nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ abrabɔ pa ho nneyɛeɛ, mmabun hokwan, ne ahobanbɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho, a wɔhwɛ so daa na wɔboa wɔn de hwɛ sɛ wɔdi so. Nhyehyɛeɛ a emu da hɔ: Nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, kokoamsɛm, ne amanneɛbɔ akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi nsɛm a ɛfa nhyɛsoɔ, dwumadie, anaa ayayadeɛ ho dwuma. Mpɔtam a wɔboa: Mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm a ɛho hia adi na sɛ wohyia nhyɛso anaa ayayade a, wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Akwan a wɔfa so de kɔma: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so de wɔn akɔ nnwuma titiriw bi mu ama mmabun a wɔanya nhyɛso, ayayade, anaa ateetee, a wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya awerɛhyem sɛ intanɛt so nneɛma anaa mmoa nhama a menya no yɛ LGBTQ+ nyinaa na ɛbɛbɔ me kokoam nsɛm ho ban yiye? (Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔayɛ ama LGBTQ+ mmabun titiriw na ɛwɔ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu da hɔ.)
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu yarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'advocates' ɔkasamafoɔ bɛboa dɛmdifoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Raising Awareness: Kyerɛkyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ fa mmara a ɛfa dɛmdifoɔ. Legal Reforms: Ko hwehwɛ mmara nsesaeɛ. Empowering Communities: Ma mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi ahoɔden ma wɔnkasa mma wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ sɛnea wubehu kɔkɔbɔ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ abusuabɔ a enni apɔwmuden pa mu anaa ayayade ho?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaa ayayade ho kɔkɔbɔ betumi ayɛ nneyɛe a wubedi so, ahoɔyaw, nsakrae, obu a wonni mma ahye, honam fam anaa atinka fam basabasayɛ, tew a wobɛtew wo ho afi nnamfo ne abusuafo ho, ne wo hokafo a wobɛte nka sɛ wusuro. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wugye wɔn di hɔ sɛ wote nka sɛ wunni ahobammɔ anaasɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ wɔ w’abusuabɔ mu a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan horow bɛn na wɔfa so de ahye sisi hɔ na wɔhyɛ mu den wɔ nkitahodie, nnamfofa, ne fekubɔ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka wɔn ahye ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a emudɔ na etu mpɔn so?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so de ahye ahorow si hɔ na wɔhyɛ mu den wɔ nkitahodie, nnamfofa, ne ayɔnkofa mu no bi ne: Wo Ho a Wosusuw Ho: Gye bere susuw ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, awerɛkyekye dodow, ne ahye ahorow ho na ama woate nea ɛte nka sɛ ɛyɛ nea wogye tom ne nea ɛnyɛ nea wogye tom no ase. Nkitahodi a Ɛda Hɔ: Ka ahye ahorow ho asɛm tẽẽ, fa kasa a ɛma wotumi si so dua ne nhwɛso pɔtee bi di dwuma na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ emu da hɔ. Nsɛm a ɛkɔ so daa: Hwɛ sɛ ahye ahorow no yɛ adwuma aberɛ biaa na ka nsakrae biara ho asɛm pefee na ka ho asɛm ntɛm ara. Nipadua Kasa: Ma wo nneyɛɛ nkasa mma te sɛ aniwa a wobɛkɔ so ahwɛ, gyina a wobɛkɔ so atenten, ne nsa a wode bɛkyerɛ ahotoso a wode bedi dwuma, di dwuma de hyɛ nsɛm mu ahye mu den. Ka sɛ Dabi: Di agoru a wobɛka sɛ dabi wɔ tebea horow mu na ama woanya ahotoso wɔ ahye ahorow a wobɛka mu. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ nnamfo, abusua mufo, anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn ma wonya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ ahye a wɔde besi hɔ na wɔakura mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛm (nipasohaw) bɛtumi afa na wɔatumi apɛ mmoa ama wɔn apomuden ne wɔn bɔbeasu ho hia (sexual health) wɔ ayaresabea ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ wo nhwehwɛmu: Sua wo dɛmdi ne sɛnea ebetumi aka wo nna mu akwahosan ho ade. Siesie nkɔmmɔ: Kyerɛw nea wopɛ sɛ wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo susuw ho. Ka w’asɛm: Nsuro sɛ wubebisa nsɛm na woaka w’ahiade ahorow ho asɛm. Fa w’adamfo anaa obi a ɔkamfo wo bra: Obi betumi aboa wo ma woate nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na wɔboa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mũ a efi wiase nyinaa no di yiye, na asuade bɛn na yebetumi asua afi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne ɔkwan a Netherlands fa so yɛ adwuma a ɛmu dɔ na nteaseɛ wom, a esi so dua ntɛm, a ɛfata mfe a obi adi a wobɛkyerɛkerɛ no, awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobetumi anya mu kwan. Asuadeɛ no bi ne hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔhyɛ aseɛ ntɛm, de stakeholders dodoɔ naa nso behyɛm, na wɔka nkyerkyerɛ ne akwahosan ho dwumadie abom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa nnipa betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ama mmabun wɔ wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ mu, a nea ɛka ho ne denam telefon so aduruyɛ ne apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde fa telefon so so?
answer_twi_source: Aban ne nnipa mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nnwuma bɛkɔ so ama mmabun denam telefon so aduruyɛ ne apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde fa telefon so a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Saa nnwuma yi de mfiridwuma di dwuma de kokoam nnwuma a wotumi nya te sɛ afotu, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne STI nhwehwɛmu ma. Ɛdenam saa mfiridwuma yi a wɔde bedi dwuma so no, mmabun da so ara tumi nya ɔhwɛ a wohia wɔ ahokyere bere mpo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo di nkitaho pefee, de susuw ankorankoro ahiade ne aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm (history) ho so dua.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho hia kɛse na ama wɔapaw nneɛma a wonya fi nimdeɛ mu. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Ankorankoro ahiade: Munsusuw nna mu akwahosan ho ahiade pɔtee ne nea wopɛ ho. Aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm: Ka aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm biara a ɛfata ho asɛm na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔapaw ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom, na etu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano. Bisa nsɛm: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa nsɛm afa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw anaa nna mu akwahosan ho afã biara ho. Kae sɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de abɛɛfo ntentan ne "digital" akwan adi dwuma de akamfo mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔama nkurɔfo ate ase?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan ne digyital nhyiamu ma nnwinnadeɛ a tumi wom a wɔde bɛkamfo na wɔama nkurɔfoɔ ate mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan (ASRH) ho nsɛm denam: Wɔde akwan a wɔbɛfa so akyɛ nsɛm, ankorankoro nsɛm, ne osuahu a ɛfa (ASRH) ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛduru atiefoɔ dodoɔ so. Nkitahodi ne adwumayɛ a ɛbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ adwumayɛfo, ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ankorankoro a wɔn ani gye (ASRH) ho no ntam. Akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua, atubrafo, ne aborɔfo mpɔtam hɔfo nne ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, a ebia wobehyia nsɛnnennen soronko wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkitahodi a ɛfa (ASRH) nsɛmti ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, animtiaabu a wɔbɛsɛe no, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano ama ɔsatuo, adesrɛ, ne nneyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛbɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban de ahyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ ne (ASRH) dwumadie a ɛbɛma wɔatu mpɔn. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ wɔn ankasa nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ne ahiade ahorow ho akamfofo, na wɔama wɔanya mpɔtam hɔfo ne biakoyɛ ho adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bɛn na ɛtaa ba a mmabun hyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛkora anaa wɔresie sika so no, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn adi nsɛnnennen yi so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛkora anaa wɔbesie sika so no, a nea ɛka ho ne: Sika a wonnya kakraa bi: Sika a wonnya a ɛdɔɔso mfa ntua ɛka anaasɛ wɔde sie ma daakye. Sika a wɔsɛe no denneennen: Sɔhwɛ anaa atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ma wɔasɛe sika wɔ nneɛma anaa osuahu ahorow a ɛho nhia ho. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wonni: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sikakorabea, ne sikasɛm mu nnyinasosɛm ahorow ho ntease kakraa bi, na ɛde sikasɛm ho gyinaesi a enye. Sikasɛm mu ntɛmpɛ: Ka a wɔnhwɛ kwan anaa ntɛmpɛ a ɛma sika a wɔde sie no sa anaasɛ ɛhaw sika a wɔde sie ho nhyehyɛe. Mmabun betumi adi nsɛnnennen yi so denam: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ: Sika a wonya ne ɛka a wɔbɔ akyi, ahiade ahorow a wɔde bedi kan sen nea wɔpɛ, ne sika a wonya no fã bi a wɔde bɛkɔ sikakorabea botae ahorow so. Nteɛso a wobenya: Ahosodi a wɔde bedi dwuma na wɔko tia ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛtɔ nneɛma a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔtɔ nneɛma, a wɔde wɔn adwene besi sikasɛm mu botae ahorow a ɛbɛkyɛ so. Nhomasua a wɔhwehwɛ: Ankorankoro sikasɛm ne sikasɛm mu nsɛmti a wobesua wɔ nhoma, adesua, anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow so de ama sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ atu mpɔn. Sikakorabea a wɔde sika a egye ntɛmpɛ besi: Sika a wode besie a wode besi nkyɛn de atua ɛka anaa tebea ahorow a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔnhwɛ kwan, na ama wɔanya sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ ne asomdwoe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsakraeɛ kwan horow so a mɛfa so asi me ho so dua pefee bere a menpɛ nna mu nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a wɔde ano ka: Ka "dabi" pefee na pintinn. Nipadua Kasa: Kɔ so hwɛ w’ani na emu yɛ den ne nipadua mu kasa a ɛyɛ den. Yi Wo Ho: Sɛ ɛho hia a, fi tebea no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne akadeɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ a egyina adanseɛ so ne tumi a wɔde bɛma ASRH ho dwumadie mu?
answer_twi_source: Nteteeɛ Nneɛma: Nhomasua nneɛma, akadeɛ, ne intanɛt so adesua ma akwankyerɛ ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ wɔ ASRH nkyerɛkyerɛ ne dwumadie a egyina adanseɛ so a wɔde bɛma ho. Mfiridwuma mu Mmoa: Animdefoɔ ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔyɛ adwuma titire wɔ ASRH mu a wɔbɛnya no bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛba bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu no, na bere tenten ahe na egye ansa na wɔanya nea efi mu ba no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe mu no, mmabun betumi ahwɛ nea edidi so yi kwan: - Afotu a wɔde ma ansa na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛka nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no ho asɛm, abua nsɛmmisa, na wɔadi biribiara a ɛhaw wɔn ho dwuma. - nhwehwɛmu kwan: Ɛgyina nhwehwɛmu ko a wɔyɛ so no, wobetumi agye mogya, nsuo, anaa swab. Nhwehwɛ mu ahorow bi ma wonya nea efi mu ba ntɛmntɛm, bere a afoforo nso betumi agye nna kakraa bi ansa na wɔadi ho dwuma. - nhwehwɛmu akyi afotu: Nhwehwɛ mu no akyi no, mmabun benya afotu wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, asiane a wɔbɛtew so, ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ bere a wɔretwɛn nea ebefi mu aba no ho. - Nea efi mu ba: Bere a egye na woanya aba no gu ahorow gyina nhwehwɛmu ko ne beae a wɔsɔ nhwehwɛmu no so. Ebia nhwehwɛmu ahorow a wɔyɛ no ntɛmntɛm bɛma wɔanya nea efi mu ba wɔ simma kakraa bi mu, bere a afoforo nso betumi agye nna kakraa bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ na wobu mmabun nna ne awoɔ ho ahiade ahorow? (LGBTQ+-adamfofa a wɔde ma ho akwankyerɛ nhoma ahorow, Planned Parenthood nneɛma)
answer_twi_source: wɔatete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa sɛ wɔmfa akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛnyɛ nyiyim mma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ kwan bere a yɛrekɔhwɛ ɔhwɛ wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi no, na ho nsɛm te sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ bere mu no, mmabun betumi ahwɛ kwan sɛ: Aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔde bɛhwɛ sɛ akyire nsusuansoɔ bi wɔ ho anaa. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛbɔ fa sɛnkyerɛnne anaa nneɛma biara a ɛhaw wɔn ho. Afotu anaa nkate fam mmoa a wɔde di nkate mu ahokyere anaa adwene mu haw biara ho dwuma. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma ho. Nsɛm a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho ne bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkɔ ayaresabea sɛ ɛho hia a. Akwan no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no ne onipa no ahiade ne ne tebea pɔtee so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya Intanɛt so nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention' dwumadie a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya intanɛt so nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention' ho nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho denam wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛfa ho a wɔbɛkɔ, nea aborɔfo ka no 'mobile app' ahorow titiriw a wɔbɛtwe, anaasɛ ɔhaw ho telefon anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadi ahorow a wɔde ama saa nsɛmti yi a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Mpɛn pii no wobetumi anya saa nneɛma yi denam intanɛt so hwehwɛ anaasɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di a wɔde kɔma wɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmea ho adwumayɛbea bere a meyɛ ɔbabun, na ɛhe na metumi akɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi anya mmea ho ayaresa bere a woyɛ ɔbabun denam: Apomodenho ɔyaresafo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun mmea ho, te sɛ mmea ho oduruyɛfo, abusua oduruyɛfo, anaa mmofra oduruyɛfo a wobɛkɔ akɔsra no so. Awoɔ apomoden ayaresabea ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ apomoden asoɛe ahorow, anaa akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu a wɔde nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ma a wɔde bedi dwuma. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, anaa sukuu afotufo hɔ, a wobetumi aboa wo ma woanya nneɛma ne mmoa a ɛfata. Wubetumi anya nsɛm pii afa mmea ho dwumadie ho denam telefon a ɛdidi soɔ yi so, 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ),ne PPA's Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa nkurɔfo ma wɔatumi agyina STI a wɔahu no ano? (akuw a wɔboa, telefon a wɔde di dwuma) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa nkurɔfo ma wɔatumi agyina STI a wɔahu no ano: Mmoa Akuw: Sɛ wɔne afoforo a wɔte ase di nkitaho a, ebetumi aboa. Di Planned Parenthood anaa Ghana AIDS Commission ho nkɔmmɔ na woanya mmoa kuw ho nsɛm. Hotlines: Wo ne obi a onim adwuma no nkasa a wommɔ wo din. Susuw telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a yɛadi kan aka ho asɛm (PPAG Helpline & Ghana AIDS Commission Helpline) no ho. Nnwuma a wɔde ma wɔ YMK app no so no yɛ nneɛma a ɛboa wɔ Mmabun Nna ne adwenemyareɛ nyinaa Wubetumi anantew akɔ mmabun ne mmabun adamfofa beae biara mu akɔhwehwɛ kokoam nnwuma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma kokoam ahomatorɔfo anaa abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow a ebetumi de asane ne haw a ɛbata nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe ho nsɛm ama.
answer_twi_source: YMK App, Maristopes Ghana: 0302241517, PPAG Yenkasa 0800202010.eyinom ma wonya nneɛma a mfaso wɔ so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam (CRC) di wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wɔbɔ ho ban na wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wiase nyinaa no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam (CRC) di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa no bɔ ho ban na wɔhyɛ ho nkuran denam hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm a ɛfata, nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wogye tom, hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi nneyɛe a epira te sɛ mmofra aware ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho, ne wɔn kyɛfa a wobenya wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛka wɔn mu, .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de ahye asi hɔ na makura mu wɔ me ne m’atipɛnfo ntam nyonkofa mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ ahoɔden pa a wɔde hyɛ me den no ma me yiyedi tu mpɔn na ɛboa me botae ahorow, sen sɛ mɛsɛe me gyinapɛn ahorow anaasɛ mɛsɛe m’apɔmuden ne m’ahobammɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ahye a wode besi hɔ na woakura mu wɔ wo ne w’atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ mu no ho hia na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ ahoɔden pa a wode bɛhyɛ wo mu den no ma wo yiyedi tu mpɔn na ɛboa wo botae ahorow: Ka ahye ahorow ho asɛm: Ka wo hye, nea wopɛ, ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ w’atipɛnfo, si so dua sɛ wowɔ fahodi na si akwannya a wowɔ sɛ wusi gyinae a ɛne wo yiyedi hyia no so dua. Asɛm a Woka: Fa nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den di dwuma de hyɛ ahye ahorow mu den na gyina w’ankasa akyi bere a wuhyia nhyɛso anaa nsakrae a efi w’atipɛnfo hɔ no. Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ: Fa wo ho a wobɛhwɛ ne yiyedi di kan denam wo ho a wobɛtwe afi abusuabɔ anaa tebea horow a ɛbɛma wo gyinapɛn ahorow asɛe anaasɛ ɛde w’akwahosan ne ahobammɔ to asiane mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm betumi aka nnuru afoforo anaa akwahosan tebea horow ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Ɛtumi sɛe no. Kasa kyerɛ dɔkota sɛ wowɔ yareɛ bi, titiriw sɛ tebea no ahyɛ ase foforo a anaasɛ worenom nnuru afoforo a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne ayɔnkofa ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran de akasa atia nyiyim na wɔayɛ tebea a ɛma akwaaba kɛseɛ.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ menna mu yare "STI" nhwehwɛmu no yɛ kokoamsɛm, na dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nna mu nyarew "STI" nhwehwɛmu wɔ kokoam: Paw akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm di kan. Bisa kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe ho asɛm ansa na woayɛ sɔhwɛ. Bisa sɛ wɔmfa wo sɔhwɛ mu aba ne ayaresa ho nsɛm nsie na wɔmmfa nkyɛ a wo mpene so. Hokwan ahorow a wowɔ wɔ kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina beae a wowɔ ne mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ so.
