Wɔ aman pii mu no, mmabun wɔ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a ɛhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm bɛto akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi mu, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun betumi de pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ama, titiriw sɛ wɔyɛ mmofra nkumaa anaasɛ wonni aduruyɛ mu nsɛmfua ho ntease pii a?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho dwumadiefoɔ hwɛ sɛ mmabun tumi de nimdeɛ pene so denam: - Wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn nteaseɛ wɔ nsɛm a wɔde ama no ho. - a wode kasa ne nkyerekyere a efata mfee a woadi di dwuma de hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte aseɛ. - a wobɛhyɛ nkuran ma nsemmisa ne nkɔmmɔdie de adi biribiara a ɛnsi pi anaasɛ ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma. - a wode awofoɔ anaa ahwɛfoɔ bɛka ho sɛdeɛ ɛfata berɛ a wɔdi mmabun ahofadie ne kokoamu hokwan ahodoɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu na ama wɔatumi agyina ano na wɔagyina nkɛntɛnso a ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ de ba wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ne wɔn yiyedi nyinaa so no ano?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano na wɔagyina nkɛntɛnso a ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ de ba wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa ano denam mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotu anaa ayaresa nnwuma a wobenya, wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho nneyɛe mu, wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde bɛma tumi ne ahokokwaw a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu kyɛfa a wobenya so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun de wɔn adwene ne nkate fam akwahosan di kan na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma me ne me abusua ne me nnamfo akasa afa me nyinsɛn ho? (nkitahodiɛ akwankyerɛ, mmoa akuo)
answer_twi_source: Wo ne w'abusua ne nnamfofoɔ kasa. ebetumi ayɛ den. Mmoa a ɛbɛtumi aboa wo no bi nie: Mmoa Akuo: Wo ne mmabun afoforo a wɔyɛ awofoɔ a wobɛdi nkitaho betumi ama wo afotu ne mmoa wɔ sɛnea wo ne wo dɔfo bɛkasa ho. Akuo yi wɔ apɔmuden asoɛeɛ a ɛbɛn wo. Ne wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nkasa na wɔmmoa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de saa nneyɛe yi ahyɛ wɔn da biara da asetra mu na ama wɔanya adwene, na wɔahu wɔn ho kɛseɛ wɔ wɔn nsusuwii, nkate, ne wɔn nneyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a obi de ne ho bɛhyɛ mu no hwehwɛ sɛ ɔde adwempa hwɛ ne nsusuwii, ne nkate, ne ne nneyɛe mu nhwehwɛmu wɔ tebea horow mu. Mmabun betumi de saa nneyɛe yi ahyɛ wɔn da biara da asetra mu denam bere a wɔde bɛsi hɔ de asusuw wɔn ho, akyerɛw wɔn din wɔ nsɛmma nhoma mu, anaasɛ wɔne ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di a wɔbɛka wɔn suahu ahorow ho asɛm no so. Akwan te sɛ adwene mu adwennwen, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a wɔkyerɛ kwan, anaasɛ da biara da nsɛm a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a wɔkyerɛw nso betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya adwene kɛse na wɔahu wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, mmarima ne mmaa ho gyinapɛn a ɛyɛ den, ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ahobanbɔ ho nneyɛeɛ ho nkuran.
answer_twi_source: Kwan nkyɛn mmoa: Sua sɛnea wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu dwoodwoo sɛ wuhu GBV a. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma ne adwumayɛbea ahorow pii betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wo saa nimdeɛ yi. Bɔbeasu Ho Nhyɛso a Ɛyɛ haw: Bisa atetesɛm mu ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsusuwii hunu a ɛhyɛ tumidi anaa tumidi ho nkuran wɔ abusuabɔ mu no ho kyim. Intanɛt so Ahobammɔ Ho Nneyɛe: Hu asiane a ebetumi aba wɔ Intanɛt so na fa di dwuma ahobammɔ mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'media literacy' (dɛwuro mu nimdeɛ) boa mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma wɔsisi gyinaeɛ pa. Wɔko tia nnamfo nhyɛsoɔ. Wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm mu (critical thinking). Wɔko tia nsɛm bɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amanaman ntam apam, apam, ne nnipa hokwan ho nnwinnade atitiriw a ɛbɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho ban na ɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ ewiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam apam, apam, ne nnipa hokwan ho nnwinnade pii bɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho ban na ɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wiase nyinaa. Ebi ne: Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam (CRC): Ɛgye hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ akwahosan, nsɛm, ne kokoam nsɛm ho tom. Amanaman Ntam Nhyiam a Ɛfa Nnipa Dodow ne Nkɔso Ho (ICPD) Dwumadi Nhyehyɛe: Si hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ so dua. Beijing Mpaemuka ne Adeyɛ Nhyehyɛe: Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ woyi nyiyim a egyina mmarima ne mmea so fi hɔ na wɔhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu. Apam a ɛfa nyiyim a wɔ yɛ tia mmea nyinaa a wobeyi afi hɔ ho (CEDAW): Ɛgye hokwan a mmea wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ka ho tom
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnuru ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde si nyinsɛn ano, na ɛyɛ adwuma bɛn?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a Ɛfa Akwanside: Kɔndɔm (Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea): Si mmadwoa kwan sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu. Diaphragm/Cervical Cap: Ɛmma mmadwoa ntumi nkɔ awotwaa no mu. Nkwammoa Akwan: Awo ano aduru: Ɛwɔ nkwammoa ahodoɔ a ɛmma wonto nkosua. Birth Control Patch/Ring: Ɛma nkwammoa ahodoɔ fi mu na amma wonto nkosua. Nnuru a Wɔde Si Nyinsɛn Ano a Ɛyɛ Bere Tenten (LARCs): Mfidie a Wɔde Fa Awotwaa Mu (IUD): Ɛmma mmadwoa ntumi mfa awoɔ mma. Implant: Ɛma nkwammoa ahodoɔ fi adi na amma wonto nkosua na ɛma awotwaa mu nsu yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi de gyinaesi ho nhwɛsoɔ adi dwuma de ahwehwɛ nokorɛ ne awerɛhyem a ɛwɔ amanneɛbɔ fibea horow a ɛfa nna mu ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho, te sɛ wɛbsait, amansan nkitahodie (social media), anaa mfɛfoɔ nkitahodie mu, ansa na masi gyinaeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de gyinaesi ho nhwɛsoɔ (decision-making models) adi dwuma de ahwehwɛ nokorɛ ne awerɛhyem a ɛwɔ amanneɛbɔ fibea horow a ɛfa nna mu ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho ansa na woasi gyinaeɛ. Sɛ mmabun rehwehwɛ amanneɛbɔ mu firi wɛbsait, amansan nkitahodie (social media), anaa mfɛfoɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu a, wobetumi:Ahunu atirimpɔw ne adwene a ɛwɔ amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ato dwa no akyi.Ahwehwɛ fibea no nokorɛdie a egyina nteteeɛ, nimdeɛ titiriw, ne animia-hwɛ (biases) so.Asusu nokorɛ ne berɛ a amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ama no kura ho.Afatam amanneɛbɔ firi mmeaeɛ horow na woanya nteaseɛ a ɛmu dɔ.Denam gyinaesi ho nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde bɛdi dwuma so no, mmabun betumi asi gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom a egyina amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ nokorɛ ne awerɛhyem so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nipadua akwaa ne nipadua ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna mu akwahosan 'SRH' ne nneyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a Wosiw Ano Ho Ntease: Sɛ wuhu sɛnea akwan horow no yɛ adwuma a, ɛboa ma wopaw nea ɛfata. Asiane Nhwehwɛmu: Sɛ wunim akwan a nna mu nyarewa 'STI' fa so nya a, ɛboa ma wopaw nneɛma a ahobammɔ wom. Nsɛmpɔw Ho Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Wobehu: Sɛ wote nipadua no mu nneɛma ase a, ɛboa ma wohu akwahosan ho haw ahorow. Mpene ne Ahye: Sɛ wuhu nipadua mu nneɛma a, ɛboa ma wɔte ankorankoro ahye ase. Abusuabɔ Pa: Nipadua ho ntease ma nkitahodi a obu wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ no, di nsɛm a ɛfa ahokokwaw nkɔso, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne adwumayɛ ho dwuma wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ boa ahokokwaw nkɔso denam ntetee nhyehyɛe, adesua, ne afotu hokwan ahorow a ɛma mmabun nya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wohia ma adwumayɛ ne adwumayɛ so. Wɔhyɛ adwumayɛ ho nkuran wɔ sikasɛm, gua, ne adwumayɛ mmoa dwumadie a wɔde ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ma wɔhyɛ wɔn nnwuma ase na wɔnya nkɔsoɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aka tumi a ɔbabun bi wɔ sɛ ɔde pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma no, te sɛ mfe a wadi, ne ho akokwaw, n’adwene mu nkɔso, amammerɛ a ofi mu, ne osuahu ahorow a wadi kan anya?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii betumi aka tumi a ɔbabun bi wɔ sɛ ɔde pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma no, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mfe a wɔadi: Ebia mmabun nkumaa benya adwene mu nkɔso ne asetra mu osuahu kakraa bi na ama wɔate aduruyɛ ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ase yiye. Onyin: Mmabun nkate mu onyin, gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ, ne tumi a wotumi kari asiane ne mfaso horow no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ankorankoro nkɔso so. Nkate mu Nkɔso: Mmabun adwene mu tumi te sɛ nkae, nsusuwii, ne atemmu betumi anya tumi a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛte aduruyɛ ho nsɛm ase na wɔasi gyinae ahorow a ɛfata so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ mu Nsɛm: Amammerɛ mu gyidi, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛe betumi akyerɛ mmabun adwene wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, pene a wɔpene so, ne ahofadi ho, na ɛbɛka sɛnea wotumi fa aduruyɛ ho gyinaesi akwan so. Osuahu ahorow a atwam: Osuahu ahorow a atwam a ɛfa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, adwenemhaw, anaa nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ho no betumi aka ahotoso a mmabun wɔ wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo mu ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔde nimdeɛ so mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi ntawntawdi a ɛda m’amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow ne m’ankasa nkate anaa osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtaa ba sɛ wubenya ntawntawdi wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ankorankoro gyidi anaa osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ho ntam. Hwehwɛ hokwan ahorow ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nhomasua na ama woate adwene abien no nyinaa ase yiye na woanya adwene a ɛne ne ho hyia. Hwɛ afotufo, anaa nyamesom akannifo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ ntawntawdi ahorow yi a wobedi ho dwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nya bi ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nyinsɛn ano aduro (sɛ nhwɛso no, awo ano aduru, kɔndɔm, nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu). STI nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne siw ano ho nkyerɛkyerɛ. Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu, afotu, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so boa. HIV nhwehwɛmu ne afotuo. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu. Nnwuma a ɛfa brayɛ, awo, ne mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho dwumadie a ahotɔ ne mmara kwan so a wɔbɛnya wɔ baabi a mmara ma ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so kura kokoamsɛm mu wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa akuw a wɔboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ no nya akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho: Nsɛm a Wɔda no Adi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nkɔmmɔbɔ no sie kokoam wɔ kuw no mu. Nneɛma a Wɔayi afi Mu: Ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayi afi mu wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa obi a obepira ne ho anaasɛ asiane a ɛde ba afoforo so ho. Nkitahodi a Wɔabue Mu: Ɛsɛ sɛ kuw akannifo kyerɛkyerɛ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe mu pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nneɛma a ɛho hia di kan wɔ ahyeɛ a meto ama me ho wɔ asetena anaa abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu tebea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nneɛma a ɛho hia di dwuma titiri wɔ ahyeɛ wobɛto  ama wo ho wɔ asetena anaa abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu. W’ahyeɛ da nea ɛho hia wo ne nea wopɛ wɔ wo nkitahodie mu adi. Susu sɛnea wo gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa obu, pene, ne ahofadie ho no nya ahyeɛ a wode besi hɔ no so nkɛntɛnso no ho, na yɛ w’adwene sɛ wobɛka ho asɛm na woakura mu wɔ wo ne afoforo nkitahodi mu. W’ahyeɛ yɛ wo ho a wosom bo ho adanse na ɛfata sɛ afoforo bu wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sikasɛm nketewa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a mmabun nya?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm nketewa kyerɛ sikasɛm mu nnwuma, te sɛ bosea nketewa, sikakorabea, insurance, ne sikatua ho nnwuma, a wɔde ma ankorankoro a mpɛn pii no wonni sikakorabea nnwuma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no. Sikasɛm nketewa boa sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a mmabun nya denam: Ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya sika kɛse: Sikasɛm a wɔde bɛma de afi nnwuma nketewa ase anaasɛ wɔbɛtrɛw mu, de sika ahyɛ nhomasua anaa adwumayɛ ntetee mu, anaasɛ wɔayɛ nnwuma a ɛma wonya sika. Sikasɛm mu nkabom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Sikakorabea adwuma a wɔde bɛma nnipa a wonnya mmoa pii, a mmabun ka ho, a ebia wobehyia akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Mmabun a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn sikasɛm ho adwene atitiriw, sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sikakorabea, ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ na ama wɔn sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne gyinaesi tumi atu mpɔn. Adwumayɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔanya adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ, wɔmfa akwanya ahorow nni dwuma, na wɔboa ma sikasɛm mu nkɔso ne ohia so tew wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun nnwuma bɛn na adu mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden ho na ɛyɛɛ yie, na asuadeɛ bɛn na yɛbɛtumi anya afiri ɔkwan a wɔfa so de saa nnwuma no yɛɛ adwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden ho a ɛyɛɛ yie bi ne: Baabi a mmabun a wɔatetee wɔn kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mfɛfoɔ nokware nsɛm, wɔboa ma nkomɔdie kɔ anim, na wɔyɛ nhyiamu ahorow wɔ sukuu mu, mmabun atraeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ. Nhyehyɛeɛ a mmabun akannifoɔ di anim de ma nimdeɛ dɔre, wɔko tia aniwuo ne nkurɔfoɔ animpaapaa, na wɔgyina pintinn pɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ mmara mu a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho mmara ne apɔwmuden mmoa ho. Akwan a mmabun ankasa ayɛ na wɔhwɛ so wɔ "social media" so de hyɛ nsɛmpa mu, de kyɛ wɔn osuahu ahorow, na wɔboaboa mmoa ano ma nna. Asuadeɛ a yɛanya afiri saa nnwuma yi mu ne sɛ: Ɛhia paa sɛ mmabun di anim, wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm mu yie, wɔne mpanyimfoɔ a wɔpɛ wɔn yiedie bɔ mu yɛ adwuma, na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma adwuma no atena hɔ akyɛ na ama anya mfasoɔ daane awoɔ ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehyia anaa wɔwɔ abusuabɔ a basabasayɛ wɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wohyia anaa wɔwɔ abusuabɔ bɔne mu no betumi anya nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa adwuma ahorow. Ebia eyinom bi ne sukuu afotufoo, telefon a wɔde boa, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadi ahorow, mmoa akuo, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmoa wɔ basabasayɛ ho. Bio nso, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, asetena mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi de kokoam mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nkamfo a ɛfata ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nipadua ho kankyee ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu boa ma wɔkasa tia atetesɛm mu ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow na wɔhyɛ nipadua ahorow a egu ahorow a wogye tum ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ho kankyee ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no boa ma wɔkasa tia atetesɛm mu ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow na wɔhyɛ nipadua ahorow a wogye tom ho nkuran denam: Nipadua ahorow a wodi ho afahyɛ ne ahoɔfɛ ho adwene teateaa a wɔkasa tia, kamfo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nnipa nyinaa ka ho, gyina hɔ ma, na wogye nipadua no nsusuwii, ne kɛse, ne ne hwɛbea nyinaa tom. Nne a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne mpɔtam a wonni gyinabea pa a wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn suahu ahorow, a wɔbɛhyɛ tumi, nea wohu, ne wɔn ho a wogye tomu ho nkuran. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔahu nkɛntɛnso bɔne a nipadua mfonini gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware de ba no ho nkuran, amammerɛ a ɛma wogye nipadua tom, ɔdɔ wɔn ho, na wotumi gyina tebea horow ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛhwehwɛ sika wɔ ɔpɛpɛ mu bere a wɔda so hia afotu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi ahwehwɛ sika nanso wɔngye afotu. Wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri awofoɔ anaa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ hɔ. Kasa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ boa. Hwɛ yie wɔ sika kwan a ɛnyɛ (get-rich-quick schemes) a ebi yɛ mmara-to.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi de botae ahorow adi dwuma de anya kuro ntetan dwumadi a ɛyɛ papa na ɛboa, a nnamfo, mfɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo nneɛma ka ho, a ɛhyɛ me bo a mede ma wɔ nneyɛe pa ho mu den, ɛhyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran, na ɛma obu ne gye a wogye wɔn ho wɔn ho tum no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de botae ahorow adi dwuma de anya kuro ntetan a ɛyɛ na ɛboa denam: Nkitahodi a wobɛda no adi pefee so: Ka wo botae ahorow ho asɛm kyerɛ wo nnamfo, w’atipɛnfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔboa w’apɛde na wɔhyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkuran. Ankorankoro a wɔwɔ adwene koro a wobɛhwehwɛ: Fa nnamfo ne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a ɛho hia wɔ nneyɛe pa ne obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ abusuabɔ mu no twa wo ho hyia. Mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu: Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe, mmoa akuo, anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran na ɛma hokwan sɛ wo ne w’atipɛnfo ne afotufo a wɔboa no di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ di wɔ nsusuwii, suban, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ho, a mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH), mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, 'LGBTQ+' hokwan ahorow, mmusuakuw mu pɛyɛ, ne sikasɛm mu atɛntrenee ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ yɛ adwuma sɛ adwinnade a tumi wom a wɔde hyehyɛ ɔmanfo adwene ne adwene wɔ asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ho, a ASRH, mmusuakuw mu pɛyɛ, ne sikasɛm mu atɛntrenee ka ho. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow te sɛ television, sini, aguade ho dawurubɔ, nea woka no borɔfo sɛ social media, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ so no, wɔkyekyɛ nsɛm ne nkrasɛm a ɛfa saa nsɛm yi ho, na ɛka sɛnea ankorankoro hu, te ase, na wɔyɛ wɔn ade wɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ  daakye sɛ mede aduannuru di kan ma awoɔ akwaa apɔmuden wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn akura suban pa mu akosi mpanyin afe so?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ne Yiyedi Nyinaa: Aduan pa a wɔde di kan wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no to fapem ma nkwa nna nyinaa akwahosan ne yiyedi, a nea efi awo akwahosan mu ba ka ho. Aduan a ɛfata boa ma honam mu nkwammoa kari pɛ, brayɛ a ɛkɔ so daa, ne awo, na ɛboa ma awo yɛ adwuma yiye. Nyarewa a Wosiw Ano: Aduan a ahoɔden wom a ahoɔden  nnuru a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  vitamin, mineral, ne nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa pii wom betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyarewa a enni sabea akyiri yi wɔ asetra mu, te sɛ kɛseyɛ mmoroso, asikreyare, ne koma ne ntini mu nyarewa, a ebetumi aka awo akwahosan so. Su a Ɛma Akwahosan Kosi Mpanyimfo: Ɛdenam adidi pa a wode besi hɔ wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu so no, wubetumi anya asetra nyinaa mu nneyɛe a ɛboa awo akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa. Kɔ so nya aduannuru ho akwankyerɛ ahorow ho nsɛm na kɔ so paw nnuan a wunim bere a woredan akɔ mpanyin afe so no, na hwɛ hu sɛ wobɛkɔ so aboa awo akwahosan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔadi amammerɛ akwansideɛ so na wɔanya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, mpɔtam hɔfo nya nneɛma ne mmoa adwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa amammerɛ akwanside ahorow so na wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ayɛ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, ayaresabea ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene asi nnipa ahorow ahorow a wɔbɛsom so titiriw. Bio nso, ebia ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina amammerɛ anaa gyidi so a wɔde mmoa, nhomasua, ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ma. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow nso betumi de nsɛm a ɛsom bo ne mmoa ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde akuo anaa mmabun mmeayɛ di wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa mmabun asoɛeɛ taa di dwuma titire wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ma mmabun denam: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu, nhyiamu, anaa mmoa akuo a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti ho. Nna ne awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua a wɔbɛma wɔanya, te sɛ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, ne nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu. Ɛsom sɛ beae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa a mmabun betumi anya nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ne nnwuma a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ho nkuran a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔfo afoforo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nhyɛso nya gyinaesi so nsusuansoɔ, titiriw bere a ɛfa nna anaa nyonkofa ho?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu ntɛm anaasɛ wonni ahobammɔ a ɛfata, na ama asane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ebefi mu aba  te sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da anaa nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu no ayɛ kɛse. Ebia ebenya abusuabɔ mu nkɔso so nkɛntɛnso, na ama ankorankoro de atipɛnfo gye a wogye tom di kan sen wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn anaa ahye. Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔbɛko atia no hwehwɛ sɛ obi yɛ katee, onya ne ho mu ahotoso, na otumi gyina n’ankasa gyinapɛn ne ne gyidi so sisi gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ mewɔ nna mu yareɛ, na berɛ bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Nsɛnkyerɛnne no betumi ayɛ soronko na ebi nso worenhu koraa. Hwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ nsu a ɛyɛ soronko fi nipadua no mu, akuru, akisikuru, ɛyaw a ɛba berɛ a woredwon sɔ no, ɛyaw, anaa sɛnkyerɛnne ahodoɔ a ɛte sɛ atiridiinini. Sɔhwɛ Akwankyerɛ: Yɛ sɔhwɛ: Sɛ wone obi da woberɛ a woammɔ woho ban a. Sɛ wuhu sɛnkyerɛnne ahodoɔ anaa sɛ wuhu nsakrae biara wɔ wo honam mu a . Akwan a Wɔfa so Yɛ Sɔhwɛ: Mpɛn pii no, nhwehwɛmu no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ dwon sɔ, mogya, anaa swab nhwehwɛmu a egyina nna mu yarekro no so. Wobetumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ ayaresabea ahodoɔ, akwahosan asoɛe ahodoɔ, anaasɛ wɔde nneɛma a wɔde yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ fie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw m’ankasa nsusuanso ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nna mu yareɛ no ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi asusuw w’ankasa asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nna mu yareɛ denam nneɛma te sɛ: - Nna mu ahokafo dodow - Mpɛn dodow a wɔde kɔndɔm di dwuma - nna mu yareɛ ho abakɔsɛm - Ɔhokafo no nna mu yareɛ tebea - Nnubɔne a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu - Nna mu dwumadi bere a nnubɔne anaa nsa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nkɛntɛnso ase Sɛ wususuw saa nneɛma yi ho a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woate asiane dodow a wowɔ no ase na woasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ akwan horow a wobɛfa so asiw ano ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi afa amammerɛ ahorow so, de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi afa amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu de nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) ho dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata ama mmabun denam ɔkwan a ɛfa ayarefoɔ ho a wɔbɛfa so, obuo ama amammerɛ mu gyidie ne nneyɛeɛ, wɔne mpɔtam akannifoɔ ne nsɛm asekyerɛfoɔ a wɔbɛdi nkitaho, ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmuo a wɔde bɛma, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotuo a wɔayɛ ama wɔn. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ntetee nso betumi ama wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no tumi a wɔde bedi amammerɛ mu nneɛma ho dwuma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) hwɛ mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na madi nkitahodi mu akwanside anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ a ebetumi aba bere a meresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ te sɛ nna ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛhunu na woadi akwansideɛ anaa nteaseɛ kɔntɔnkyɛ a ɛba berɛ a morebɔ nkɔmmɔ fa nsɛm a emu yɛ duru anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ (taboo topics) te sɛ nna ho asɛm ho no, fa atiepa, tema, ne abotare di dwuma.Hwɛ yiye wɔ amammere anaa ankorankoro nsonsonoeɛ a ebetumi aka nkitahodie ho, na yɛ ɔpɛfoɔ sɛ wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu anaa wobɛsesa wo nsɛm mu nsɛm sɛnea ɛho hia. Hyehyɛ baabi a bammɔ wɔ na atɛmmuo biara nni hɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ, na hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ nkuran denam obiara adwene a wobɛgye atom na woakyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bɛn ɛma mmabun kwan ma wotumi bue wɔn adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Permits ne licenses. Business registration (wɔtwerɛ adwuma no din). Tax (toɔ). Insurance. Labor laws (adwumayɛ mmara). Wɔbetumi ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ firi mmara nimdefoɔ anaa Business Advisory Centers (BAC) so hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma bi wɔ hɔ a yɛbɛtumi anya de aboa wɔn a wɔresi sɔ  ma wɔayɛ digital ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ asɛyɛdeɛ sɛ wɔredi ama ASRRs ho asɛm anaa? (Te sɛ intanɛt so nsɛm a ɛyɛ safe ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne digital adesua ho nneɛma).
answer_twi_source: Ampa ara! Nneɛma ahorow bi wɔ ha a ɛbɛboa wo ma woanya asɛyɛdeɛ wɔ intanɛt so wiase mu:Digital ɔmanfoɔ ho mmoa: Common Sense Media - www.commonsensemedia.org (Ɛma intanɛt so bammɔ ho afotuo ne mmoa a ɛfata ma mmabun). ConnectSafely - connectsafely.org (Ɛma nsɛm a ɛfa cyberbullying, nsɛm a ɛyɛ ahunta ne akwahosan pa ho). Intanɛt so bammɔ ho nsiesie:Amanneɛbɔ anaa akenkendan pii, sukuu ahorow, ne mmabun akuw pii boa ma intanɛt so bammɔ ho nsiesie kɔ so. Hwehwɛ intanɛt so nsɛm bi a ɛfata wo mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusuabɔ pa, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne pene a wɔpene so ho adesua betumi aboa ma wɔanya adwenemyare pa na wɔanya ahye a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ pa, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne pene a wɔpene so ho adesua boa ma wonya adwenemyare pa denam wɔn ho a wohu, tumi a wɔde ma, ne ahye a ɛfata a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso no so. Mmabun nya nnwinnade a wɔde bɛfa abusuabɔ mu, akamfo wɔn ahiade ahorow, na wɔde ahye a ɛbɔ wɔn nkate ne nipadua mu yiyedi ho ban si hɔ. Sɛ wɔte hia a ɛho hia sɛ wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho, ahotoso, ne pene a wɔpene so no ase a, ɛma abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a ɛfata nya nkɔso na ɛma wotumi gyina nkate fam ahoɔden ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahye a ɛfata a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde si hɔ wɔ nna mu nkitahodie mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahye yɛ akwan ahorow a wode si hɔ na ama woate nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ na wobu wo. Eyinom betumi ayɛ honam fam (nneɛma bi a wode wo nsa ka), nkate fam (nea wokyɛ), anaa dwumadi ahorow a wo ho tɔ wo wɔ ho. Ahye a ɛfata a wode besi hɔ: Hu wo anohyeto ahorow: Hwehwɛ nea ɛte nka sɛ ɛfata wo ne nea ɛnsɛ. Ka wɔn ho nkɔmmɔ pefee: Wo ne wo hokafo nka wo hye ho asɛm pefee na bu wɔn nso de. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wopow nna mu nneyɛe biara bere biara, sɛ mpo woadi kan apene so a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a ɛfa Intanɛt so nkitahodi a obuo wom a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ne kɔmputa so ayayade a wobesiw ano ho? (ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu, ahobammɔ ho afotu wɔ Intanɛt so)
answer_twi_source: Awareness Campaigns: Kɔka anaa yɛ intanɛt so ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ obuo ne ayamye ho nkuran wɔ intanɛt so. Intanɛt so Ahobammɔ Ho Afotu: Hwehwɛ ahobammɔ ho afotu wɔ Intanɛt so fi akuo ahorow a wotumi de ho to so ma mmabun hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi ahu wɔn sikasɛm botae ahorow na wɔayɛ sikakorabea nhyehyɛe a wɔde benya?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyerɛ wɔn sikasɛm botae ahorow na wɔayɛ sikakorabea nhyehyɛe denam: Botae ahorow a wobehu: Botae pɔtee, a wobetumi asusuw, wobetumi adu ho, ɛfata, na wɔde bere ahyɛ mu (SMART) a wɔde besi hɔ a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, wɔn apɛde, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan no hyia. Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma no mu nhwehwɛmu: Sika a wonya, ɛka a wɔbɔ, agyapadeɛ, ne ɛka a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu de ate mprempren sikasɛm tebea ase na wɔakyerɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtu mpɔn. Nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔde besi hɔ: Botae ahorow a egyina ntɛmpɛ, hia a ɛho hia, ne nea wobetumi ayɛ so a wɔde bedi kan, a wosusuw bere tiaa mu ahiade ne bere tenten mu apɛde ahorow ho. Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ: Sikakorabea nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛkyerɛ sika dodow a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkora so, bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkora sika, ne baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkora so, na wɔyɛ nsakrae bere a tebea horow sesa anaa botae ahorow resakra no. ɔpanyin bi betumi ahwɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa na wɔako ama akuw a, wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonni ananmusifo pii a wohyia akwanside afoforo a ɛmma wonnya akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ wɔ adwumam no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonni ananmusifo pii a wohyia akwanside afoforo a ɛmma wontumi nnya akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛ denam: Wɔn nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a, ɛka obiara ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ne adwumayɛbea ahorow mu no so. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ayɔnkofa nhyehyɛe anaa abusuabɔ akuw a ɛhyɛ biakoyɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu. Wɔn ankasa ne afoforo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ nkitahodi ne nsɛnnennen soronko a ankorankoro hyia wɔ mmeae a, mmarima ne mmea, abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, dɛmdi, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea hyia no. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de afotu, nkitahodi hokwan ahorow, ne ahokokwaw nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow ama mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua. Adwumawuranom ne nhyehyeɛyɛfoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa nnwuma ahodoɔ ne nkabom nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi nhyehyɛeɛ mu pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ ho dwuma na ɛhyɛ hokwan ahodoɔ a wɔbɛnya pɛpɛɛpɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwenemyare a ɛtaa ba mmebun a wɔ nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ hyia, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu?
answer_twi_source: Adwenemhaw ne Dadwen: nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+  mmabun wɔ asiane kɛse mu sɛ wobenya adwenemhaw ne dadwen esiane animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan anaa transphobia a ɛwɔ wɔn mu nti. Adwene ne Suban a Ɛma Wokum Wɔn Ho: Mmabun a wɔyɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+  taa susuw ho anaasɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wobekum wɔn ho, mpɛn pii no esiane ayayade, pow, anaa mmoa a wonni nti. Nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Mmabun binom a wɔdi nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+  betumi adan akɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so so sɛ ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina adwennwen ano anaasɛ wɔbɛkata wɔn nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho ne ɛyaw so no so. Nanso, mmoa wɔ hɔ ma saa nnipa yi wɔ yɛn asoɛeɛ ahodoɔ no mu - ɔsom akannifoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ne asetena mu akuo foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne 'vaginal orgasm' na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛyɛ soronko wɔ mmea ‘clitoral orgasm’ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnam nkanyan a ɛwɔ awotwaa no mu so na ɛba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwantu ho nhyehyɛe nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden ho nhyehyɛe no ahiade ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mpɔtam bi no, ebia akwantu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe no ahiade ahorow ho dwuma. Saa dwumadie yi betumi ayɛ: akwantuo ho nkrataa anaa mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a nna ne awoɔ apomoden ayaresabea anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ de ma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma wɔde kar kɔ nna ne awo apomoden ho nhyiam ahorow anaa bere a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ama mmabun na wɔasan aba. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ne akwantu adwumayɛbea ahorow ntam adwumayɛ a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ akwantu ho akwan horow wɔ hɔ na mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo apomoden ho nnwuma betumi anya bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so nsusuwii ne ahobammɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, te sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmubuafo ho ne mmara a ɛko tia nyiyimu ho?
answer_twi_source: Apam a Ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa a Wɔadi dɛm Wɔ Ho (CRPD): UN apam a ɛkyerɛ hokwan ne ahofadi a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ, a nhomasua, akwahosan, ne adwumayɛ ka ho. Amanaman Nkabom Apam Hokwan a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ho: Mmara betumi ahyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo sɛ wɔmfa nnwuma a wobetumi anya ne dabere a ɛfata mma ayarefo a wɔadi dɛm. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow sɛ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ pɔtee wɔ Ghana ACT 715 wɔ constitutition no mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm mu de ahwehwɛ nkrasɛm a ɛwɔ ase, adwene, tumi mu nkɔso, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahintaw a ebetumi ahyɛ asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, tumi nhyehyɛe, ne nniso ahorow a ɛfa mmabunu nna ne awo akasahodie ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm afoforo ho mu den anaasɛ akasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm fibea, ahotoso, ne animhwɛ a ebetumi aba mu, na susuw wɔn a wɔhyɛ nkrasɛm no akyi no adwene ne wɔn anigye ho. Kyerɛ nsusuwii hunu, nyiyimu, ne asɛm a epira a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow mu, na susuw sɛnea ɛhyɛ asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow ne tumi mu nkɔso mu den anaasɛ ɛkasa tia no ho. Hwehwɛ kasa, mfonini, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm mu de hu adwene a ɛwɔ ase, tumi nhyehyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahintaw. Fa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ fibea ahorow toto ho na fa nsonsonoe toto ho na ama woanya ntease a ɛtrɛw wɔ asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho na woahu adwene ne osuahu ahorow. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ, akyinnyegye, ne dwumadi mu de ma nkurɔfo hu, twa nsɛm a epira ho mpoa, na kamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsakrae ne ananmusifo a ɛne asetra mu atɛntrenee ne pɛyɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow hyia kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na awofoɔ ne ahwɛfoɔ bɛboa mmabun wɔ amammerɛ ne SRH mu?
answer_twi_source: Tie wɔn a wummu wɔn atɛn. Ɛwɔ sɛ awofoɔ kyerɛ wɔn amammerɛ. Kasa yie a obuo wɔ mu, na wɔboa wɔn ma wɔnkɔhu ayaresafoɔ a wɔte wɔn ase. Ko ma nkyerɛkyerɛ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnwuma bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun di anim reyɛ adwuma de adi GBV ho dwuma a metumi akɔka ho? (ɔkwan a ɛfata mfeɛ a obi bɛfa so de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu afotufoɔ anaa sickbay ɔyarehwɛfoɔ bɛtumi aboa wo wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ GBV ho wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nea wɔpɛ nya mmabun adwene ne osuahu ahorow wɔ asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ayɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho kɛse na wɔayɛ ho biribi?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nea wɔpɛ betumi akyerɛ mmabun adwene ne osuahu ahorow wɔ asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho denam nkɛntɛnso a wobenya so: Adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ nneyɛe, asetra mu mmoa, ne aban a ɛde ne ho bɛhyɛ kokoam nsɛm te sɛ abusua sikasɛm anaa akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu ho. Bɔbeasu dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔhwɛ ho asɛde ahorow, sikasɛm mu kyɛfa a wonya, ne gyinaesi tumi wɔ fie anaa mpɔtam hɔ. Animtiaabu anaa nyiyim a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mmusuakuw, nyamesom, abusuakuw, anaa asetra mu gyinabea so, a ebetumi aka asetra mu ahobammɔ nnwuma a wobenya ne nea wɔde di dwuma. Wobetumi ama asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho kɛse na wɔayɛ ho biribi denam: Mpɔtam hɔfo, nyamesom akannifo, ne amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnsofo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de ahyɛ asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu nhumu, agye atom, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu. Nsɛm, nneyɛe, ne nkitahodi akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔde bɛka nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe, nneɛma a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn, ne akwan a wɔfa so de ɔsom adwuma ma ho. Ahotosoɔ, abusuabɔ, ne ayɔnkofa a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no bɛnya de ahwɛ sɛ asetena mu ahobanbɔ mu dwumadie ahodoɔ no bu na ɛda mpɔtam hɔ amanne, atetesɛm, ne gyinapɛn adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asetra mu nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aka sɛnea akwan horow bi tu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, asetra mu nneɛma bi betumi aka sɛnea akwan horow bi tu mpɔn: Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano a ɛyera: Sɛ wotaa kyɛ a, nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano no nyɛ adwuma yiye. Nsã/nnubɔne: Nsã anaa nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma kɛse betumi asiw akwan bi te sɛ awo ano aduru a wɔde hormone di dwuma no kwan. Sɛ wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so: Sɛ wɔde kɔndɔm di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so a, ɛtew sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye no so. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa fa kɔndɔm a wode bedi dwuma yiye ho. Kae: Sɛnea wɔde di dwuma daa na ɛteɛ ne ade titiriw a ɛbɛma ɔkwan biara atu mpɔn yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so kamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛka obiara ho a ɛde adwenemyare ne yiyedi di kan ma mmabun nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛka obiara ho a ɛde adwenemyare ne yiyedi di kan ma mmabun nyinaa no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔde wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bɛka ho, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne ɔman no mu. Eyi betumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ɔmanfo ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobedi nkitaho, ne ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ de akyerɛ hia a adwenemyare ho hia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔhyɛ pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran no ma wɔakyerɛ obu na wɔada mpɔtam hɔfo amammerɛ ahorow adi, bere a wɔkasa tia nneyɛe ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira a ɛma basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so kɔ so no nso?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔahyɛ pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran ma wɔabu na wɔada amammerɛ ahorow adi bere a wɔrekasa atia nneyɛe ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira denam: Amammerɛ mu Atenka: Wɔasiesie nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no ma wɔabu amammerɛ mu gyidi, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa pene ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ho akontaa. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Fa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, akannifoɔ, ne amammerɛ ho abenfoɔ ka ho wɔ nhyehyɛɛ ne dwumadie a wɔde siw ano no mu de hwɛ sɛ ɛfa ho na wɔgye tom wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu. Akwan a Ɛfa Ntam: Di nyiyim ahorow a ɛtwam te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nyiyim, ne kuw mu nyiyim a ɛboa ma nna mu basabasayɛ yɛ mmerɛw kɛse wɔ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu no ho dwuma. Tumi ne Nhomasua: Ma mmabun tumi ma wonya nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛkasa atia amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, akyerɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so, na wɔkamfo mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a ɛfa nyɔnkofa nkitahodi pa ho ama nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun anaa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm? (adwumayɛbea ahorow, abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: Wobu nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So STI a wobehu no betumi anya m’adwene mu akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso bere tenten mu? (adwenemhaw, dadwen) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, STI a wohu no betumi de adwenemyare a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ te sɛ dadwen anaa adwenemhaw aba, titiriw sɛ wɔansa a. Nanso, sɛ wonya mmoa ne ayaresa a ɛfata ma STI ne w’adwene nyinaa a, wubetumi ate nka sɛ wo ho atɔ wo paa. Kae: Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara. Nnipa pii di STI ne ne nkate fam nkɛntɛnso ho dwuma. Sɛ wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso bɛkasa na woahwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ a, ebetumi ama nsakrae kɛse aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmra a ɛfa pene wɔ nna mu 'age of consent' yɛ soronko fi nyinsɛn ne awoɔ ne sɛnea ɛhaw mmabun a woawo no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nna no yɛ mmara kwan so anaa. Ɛka awoɔ hokwan. Sɛ wonsi mfeɛ a, ɛyɛ asɛm. Ghana mfeɛ no yɛ du nsia (16)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mene den na etumi kyere me akwasie na menyi me bo nkyerɛ me nipa me ne ne wde menhia wo me abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Dwen wo values ho. Ma wo partner nhu wo nneɛma a ɛhia wo. Yɛ confident (ka dabi). Bu wo partner adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de abɛɛfo ntentan akwan, dijitaal abasɛm, ne intanɛt so dwumadi adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse, akyɛ wɔn suahu ahorow, na wɔabɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne awo ne nna akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm ho ban wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo Ntentan ne "Online Activism" a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Mmabun betumi de abɛɛfo ntentan dwumadi, "digital storytelling", ne "online activism" adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse, akyɛ wɔn suahu, na wɔabɔ media ho nimdeɛ ne awo ne nna akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm ho ban wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri. Wobetumi ayɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, akyɛ nhomasua nneɛma, na wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso adi nkitaho de ama nsakrae aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetra ne sikasɛm mu mfaso horow a ebetumi afi agyapade a wɔboaboa ano mu aba ama mmabun ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo?
answer_twi_source: Agyapadeɛ a wɔboaboa ano no bɛtumi de asetena ne sikasɛm mu mfasoɔ ahodoɔ aba mmabun ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfoɔ so, te sɛ: Sikasɛm mu ahobanbɔ: Agyapadeɛ a wɔbɛsi no ma sikasɛm mu ahobanbɔ ma ntɛmpɛ, ɛka a wɔnhwɛ kwan, anaa sika a wɔde bɛto hɔ daakye. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɔ: Agyapade a wɔboaboa ano no bue apon ma hokwan ahorow te sɛ nhomasua a ɛkɔ anim, adwumayɛ, ofie wurayɛ, ne sika a wɔde sie berɛ a wɔakɔ pɛnhyen. Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔso: Sika a wɔde hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma, afie wurayɛ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma mu no boa ma mpɔtam ne mpɔtam hɔfo sikasɛm nya nkɔso na ɛyɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ algorithms ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so dwumadibea ahorow di wɔ sɛnea mmabun nya abɛɛfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ algorithms ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so dwumadibea ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ sɛnea mmabun nya abɛɛfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denam nsɛm a wɔde yɛ wɔn ankasa de a egyina nea ɔde di dwuma no pɛ, abakɔsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ, ne nkitahodi so no so. Eyi betumi ama nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ filter bubbles anaa nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  echo chambers aba, na asiw adwene ahorow a wɔde di dwuma no ano na ahyɛ gyidi anaa animhwɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a metumi de adi dwuma de adi nkate fam adwennwen a efi STI mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so gyina nkate mu adwennwen a STI de ba no ano ni: Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Ka wo nkate kyerɛ w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, mmabun friednly health acre provider, anaa ɔfotufo. Fa w’adwene si nokwasɛm ahorow no so: Sua wo STI pɔtee ne ayaresa a wubetumi apaw ho ade. Saa nimdeɛ yi betumi ama wo tumi. Fa hwɛ a wobɛhwɛ wo ho di dwuma: Fa adidi pa, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome hwɛ wo nipadua ne w’adwene akwahosan so. Twa nsusuwii bɔne ho mpoa: Mfa asodi nto wo ho so. STI ahorow sisi, na wotumi sa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nhwehwɛmu, nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu, ne akyinnyegye a egyina adanse so adi dwuma de abɔ wɔn nhyehyɛe a wɔkasa ma wɔ sikasɛm mu nsɛm ho amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛm a wɔde hwehwɛɛ mu no de adanseɛ ma de boa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛkasa ama mmɔdenbɔ, a ɛkyerɛ hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛbɛtumi anya wɔ mmabun so. Mmabun betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu, aboaboa nsɛm ano, na wɔayɛ nea wɔahu mu nhwehwɛmu de ahu nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so, nsonsonoe, ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa nya mu. Akyinnyegye a egyina adanse so a egyina nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu so no betumi ahyɛ nkrasɛm a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo no mu den, anya nhyehyɛeyɛfo so nkɛntɛnso, na anya mmoa ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛboa mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina obuo ne ne yɔnko pene so akyekye abusuabɔ pa?
answer_twi_source: Di nkitaho pefee wɔ nokwaredi mu: Ka w’ahiade, nea wopɛ, ne w’ahye ho asɛm. Hwehwɛ obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho: Ɛsɛ sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔsom bo na wobu wɔn. Mpene a wɔpene so yɛ ade titiriw: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nna ma kwa na wɔde anigye yɛ. Fa w’adwene si gyinapɛn ahorow a wokyɛ so: Hwehwɛ obi a obu wo ne wo gyinaesi ahorow. Abusuabɔ pa gye bere ne mmɔdenbɔ: Nya ahotoso ne nkitahodi bere tenten.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mehu sɛ m’atipɛnfo bi rehyia nna anaa awo ho haw wɔ sukuu mu a, anammɔn bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ metu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhu sɛ w’atipɛnfo bi rehyia nna anaa awo akwahosan ho haw wɔ sukuu mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Wode mmoa ne awerɛhyem ma. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di anaa nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu a egyina sukuu so no hɔ. Bɔ tebea no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa sukuu adwumayɛfo foforo a obetumi de mmoa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wobenya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Kar a wonnya. Sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow (ɛka/insurance). Stigma/aniwu/atemmu ho suro. Nimdeɛ/nhumu a anohyeto wom. Ahintasɛm ho dadwen. Amammerɛ/nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow. Nkitahodi mu akwanside ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn apaw ɔkwan a ɛfata a mɛfa so asi nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Ebetumi agyina nea ɛho hia wo so. Sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw mu. Sɛnea wɔde di dwuma. Hormone a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano: nea efi mu ba ne asiane ahorow. Nyinsɛn a wɔmfa hormone nni dwuma: nea efi mu ba ne asiane ahorow. Nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ nna so. Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho: Sɛnea etu mpɔn, ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma, ɛka a wɔbɔ, nea efi mu ba, STI a wosiw ano. Hwɛ Akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo: Munsusuw akwan horow a wubetumi apaw, aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm, nea wopɛ ho. Nya nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa wo ho a egyina akwahosan ne asetra kwan so. Sɔhwɛ ne Mfomso: Ebia ebegye sɛ wobɛsɔ akwan horow ahwɛ na woanya nea ɛfata sen biara. Akwan a Wɔfa so Bom: Ankorankoro binom de ahobammɔ abien (kɔndɔm + hormone akwan) di dwuma ma ahobammɔ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka sɛ daabi wɔ nna mu nkɔso a menpɛ ho wɔ ɔkwan a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ katee so?
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka dabi wɔ nna mu nneyɛe biara a ɛma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ ho, bere biara. Ma emu nna hɔ na tẽẽ broni bɛkasɛ 'direct': "Daabi" a ɛnyɛ den no dɔɔso. Mma nte nka sɛ ɛyɛ w’asɛyɛde sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ wo ho mu. Fa nipadua mu kasa a emu yɛ den di dwuma: Kɔ so hwɛ w’ani, gyina hɔ tenten, na ma wo nne yɛ den. Fa ɛhyeɛ sisi hɔ: Sɛ obi mmu wo dabi a, fi baabi a wowɔ no ntɛm ara na ka kyerɛ ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso. Fa yɛ wo ho sɛ dabi wɔ tebea horow mu: Eyi betumi aboa wo ma woanya ahotoso kɛse wɔ saa bere yi mu. sɛ wote nka sɛ wonni ahobammɔ a, frɛ ntɛm ara ma wɔmmoa wo na kwati sɛ wo ne nnipa a wɔte saa bɛtra mmeae a atew ne ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me nneyɛe ne gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa mmabunbere ne nna mu akwahosan (SRH) ho no yɛ nea ɛfata wɔ abrabɔ fam?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi a Wode Anim Si: Boaboa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fi mmeaemmeae ansa na woapaw nneɛma bi wɔ wo nipadua ne w’akwahosan ho. Susuw Gyinapɛn Ho: Susuw sɛnea wo nneyɛe ne w’ankasa wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi hyia ho. Obu a Wobɛma Afoforo: Hwɛ hu sɛ wo gyinaesi ahorow no kyerɛ obu ma wo ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no hokwan ne yiyedi. Hwehwɛ Akwankyerɛ: Sɛ wunnim a, hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa nnipa a wɔwɔ din pa hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: M’akwahosan ho insurance bɛtua nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ka? (egyina nhyehyɛe no so) .
answer_twi_source: wo ne wo chool ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ di nkitaho na woanya nsɛm pii afa ɛka ne sikatua module pɔtee no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho haw ahorow bi a ɛfa sɛnea mmabun nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho? (sɛ nhwɛso no, asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe, nyamesom mu gyidie ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ni: Asetra ne Sikasɛm mu Nsonsonoe: Wɔn a wonni sika pii no betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya mu. Nyamesom mu Gyidi: Ebia ɔsom ahorow bi wɔ anohyeto ahorow wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho. Wowɔ hokwan wɔ wo gyidi ahorow ho, nanso wowɔ hokwan nso sɛ wusi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ w’akwahosan ho. Awofo a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Bere a mpɛn pii no ɛho nhia sɛ awofo de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no, ebinom ka sɛ ɛho hia ma nkitahodi ne gyinaesi a asɛde wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam dwumakuo ahorow ko ma  nhyehyɛe mu nsesae anaasɛ wɔyɛ adwuma de ma nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no atu mpɔn? (Wɔn kasamafo dwumadi  ntease
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam dwumakuo ahorow pii ko ma nsesae : Nhyehyɛe mu Nsakrae: Ebia wɔbɛhwehwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Mpɔtam hɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Ebia wɔbɛyɛ adwuma de akyerɛkyerɛ mpɔtam hɔfo  afa mmebun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nyiyim a egyina bɔbea nna so anaa pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ akwahosan ho mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nyiyim a egyina bɔbea nna so wɔ akwahosan ho mmeae ahorow wɔ akwan horow so: Ayaresa a ɛnsɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde mmarimaa akwahosan ho haw di kan sen mmeawa de. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna mu nneyɛe anaa awo ho paw a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu so, na ɛde ɔhwɛ a ɛmfata anaasɛ ɛyɛ animhwɛ ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne digital akwan adi dwuma de asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne digital akwan horow adi dwuma denam apps, website ahorow, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow so de ama mmabun anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm, telefon so ayaresa ho nkɔmmɔbɔ, akuo a wɔboa wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetena mu mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama mmara nsesaeɛ fa 'sexual assault' ho na ama wɔatumi abɔ wɔn a wɔatumi wɔn so no ho ban, na wɔakye wɔn a wɔyɛ saa nsɛmmɔne no ama wɔatwe wɔn aso?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi ayɛ 'awareness' (npaemu-ka). Wɔbɛdɔm 'campaigns'. Wɔne mpanyimfoɔ bɛkasa hwehwɛ nsakraeɛ. Wɔbɛboa ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛko ama 'survivors' hokwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na awoɔ nsiano yɛ adwuma na ɔkwan ahorohow b3n na 3wɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsiw nyinsɛn kwan. Akwan: kɔndɔm, Hormones (Pills/Injections), IUDs, Sterilization, Emergency Contraception. Kasa kyerɛ dɔkota.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abu afoforo amammerɛ ahodoɔ wo berɛ a merebu mensa?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Anigye: Fa si wani so sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohunu na wosua deɛ ɛwɔ afoforɔ amammerɛ mu nso.Tie yie: Yɛ aso tie afofoɔ wɔ berɛ wɔrekyɛ wɔn amammerɛ mu suahunu, kyerɛ obuo ne anigye. Kwati Nsusuwiɛ: Hu sɛ ankorankorɛ a wofi amammerɛ koro mu wɔdeɛ wɔgyedi. Nsɛmmisa a Ɛkyerɛ Obu: Bisa nsɛm wɔ obu mu na ama woate ase mmom sen sɛ wobɛbu atɛn anaa wobɛyɛ nyiyimu. Fa wo ho hyɛ mu: Fa wo ho hyɛ amammerɛ mu nhyiam anaa dwumadi ahodoɔ mu wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ fa kyerɛ sɛ w'ani sɔ. Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Kasa tia nsusuwiɛ hunu anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛwɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ ho berɛ a worɛhyia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de abrɛ nkɛntɛnso bɔne a wim nsakrae de ba nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) so no ase, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ wim tebea mu, na wɔabɔ mmɔden sɛ wobegyina ano?
answer_twi_source: Wim Tebea Nsakraeɛ: Akwan a wɔfa so brɛ aseɛ no bi ne akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtumi gyina wimu tebea ano a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) a wɔde bɛka atoyerɛnkyɛm ho ahosiesie nhyehyɛeɛ ho, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie wɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛhia ntɛm. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔ wim tebea mu nsakrae ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde gyina ano no mu denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) di kan wɔ wim tebea ho dwumadie nhyehyɛe mu a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nsakraeɛ ho nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so, ne wim nsakraeɛ ne awoɔ akwahosan ntam nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛma wɔate ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hena na ɔde ɔhaw ho afotu adwuma ma mmaabun, na ahwehwɛde, ntetee, anaa adansedi bɛn na wɔwɔ wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔrehyia nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho haw ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a Wɔde Ma ne Wɔn a Wɔfata: Afotufo a wɔatete wɔn anaa adwene mu apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ osuahu wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔrehyia nna ne awoɔ mu apomoden ho haw mu na wɔde ɔhaw ho afotu ma mmabun. Wobetumi anya ahwehwɛde, ntetee, anaa adansedi krataa wɔ afotu, ɔhaw mu dwumadie, anaa nnwuma a ɛfa ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akɔ wo nkyɛn akɔbɔ nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate a ɛfa nna anaa awo akwahosan ho ho nkɔmmɔ a mente aniwu nka anaasɛ wɔ mbu me atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Hu sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛte aniwu anaa wo ho yeraw wowɔ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, nanso kae sɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma woate ase na woadi ho dwuma. Fi ase denam wo nkate a wobegye atom akyerɛ wo ho na wuhu sɛ nea ɛhaw wo no yɛ nokware no so. Bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no wɔ bere a wo ne w’awofo nyinaa ho adwo mo na mowɔ kokoam nsɛm, ebia bere a mobom yɛ dwumadi bi anaa bere a moyɛ komm wɔ fie no. Da ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ pefee na wofi nokwaredi mu adi, na si so dua sɛ wobu wɔn mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wode ma no sɛ ɛsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛtumi aboa me, ma metumi akyere mpanimfoɔ a wɔwɔ me mpɔtamu, a ebi te sɛ m'awofoɔ anaa akyerekyerefoɔ efa GBV ho nsem ne eho nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ ma wɔn a wɔresi no. (mpɔtam adesua, nhoma a yɛdi kyerɛ adi?
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔnrersinyi anaa  wo sukuu ɔfutufonyi betumi ama wo nneɛma a ɛbɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow ma mmabun nya ahotoso wɔ wɔn ho, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne akannifo ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mfɛfoɔ (peer-to-peer mentorship) ma wonya baabi pa a mmoa wom. Ɛhɔ na wobetumi anya nkuranhyɛ ne afutuo afiri wɔn mfɛfoɔ nkyɛn, na eyi ma wɔn ahotosoɔ ne sɛnea wobu wɔn ho yie no kɔ anim Afotufoɔ yɛ nhwɛsoɔ na wɔhyɛ wɔn a wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔn no nkuran sɛ wɔnfiri wɔn ahotɔ mmeaeɛ, wɔnyɛ akannifoɔ dwumadie, na wɔnnya nimdeɛ a ɛho hia te sɛ nkitahodiɛ, ɔhaw ano aduru, ne gyinaesie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so nneyɛe mu, a nsɛm a ɛfa kɔmputa so ayayade, ɔhaw, ɔtan kasa, ne Intanɛt so basabasayɛ ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nneyɛe wɔ mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu: Intanɛt so ayayade, ɔhaw, ɔtan kasa, ne Intanɛt so basabasayɛ betumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba ankorankoro ne mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa so na ebetumi abu mmara ne intanɛt so dwumadibea akwankyerɛ so. Obu a wɔde ma kokoam nsɛm hokwan ahorow, adwene mu agyapade hokwan ahorow, ne dijitaal pene ho hia wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ mu. Sɛ yɛte nkɛntɛnso a intanɛt so nneyɛe betumi anya wɔ afoforo ne ɔmanfo so ase a, ɛboa mmabun ma wosi gyinae wɔ abrabɔ pa ho na wɔboa yiye ma dijitaal mpɔtam hɔfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhaw bi a aman hyia wɔ akwannya ahorowa wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a wokura mu no mu? (Amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow, nneɛma a wonnya, amammui mu ɔpɛ)
answer_twi_source: Aman hyia ɔhaw wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma mu: Amammerɛ mu Akwanside ahorow: Ebia amammerɛ binom wɔ atetesɛm mu gyidi ahorow a esiw mmebun nna ne awoɔ akwaahosan (ASRH) nnwuma a wobenya no kwan. Nneɛma a Wonnya: Akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhomasua a ɛfata a wɔde bɛma no betumi ayɛ nea ne bo yɛ den. Amammui mu Apɛde: Ebia aban ahorow remfa ASRH nsɛm nni kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di nsɛnnennen ne nokwasɛm ahorow a ɛwɔ awofoyɛ ne mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma nyinaa mu ho dwuma sɛ akwan foforo a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn a woyi gu.
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen: Abofra ntetee hwehwɛ sɛ wode sika, nkate, ne honam fam ahofama kɛse. Ebia ɛbɛhia sɛ woyɛ nsakrae wɔ wo nhomasua botae ahorow anaa daakye nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde boa no ho hia yiye. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma: Department of social welfare bɛboa wo wɔ adeyɛ no nyinaa mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asua biribi afi huammɔdi, akwanside, anaa mfomso ahorow a wodi wɔ wɔn adwumayɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de osuahu ahorow yi adi dwuma sɛ hokwan a wɔde benyin na wɔasua ade?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asua asuade ahorow a ɛsom bo afi huammɔdi, akwanside, anaa mfomso ahorow a wodi wɔ wɔn adwumayɛ mu denam nkɔso ho adwene a wobenya so. Wobetumi abu huammɔdi sɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde sua ade na wonyin, ahwehwɛ nea enti a wɔadi nkogu no akyi, akyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso, na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn akwan horow mu sɛnea ɛfata. Ɛdenam huammɔdi a wobegye atum sɛ adwumayɛ akwantu no fa ɛyɛ awosu so no, mmabun betumi anya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, boasetɔ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia na ama asi yiye
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na pɛyɛ ho hia wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu pɛyɛ ho hia wɔ abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom mu. Mmabun betumi aboa denam nsusuwii hunu a wɔbɛkasa atia, asɛyɛde ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho ahofadi, ne pene a wɔbɛpene so ne obu a wɔbɛkyerɛ ama wɔn ho wɔn ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa ankorankoro a wohia mmoa de fa Partner Notification ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa ankorankoro a wohia mmoa de fa partner notification ho, a abi ne: Partner Notification Services a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ de ma. Hotlines, mmoa, anaa intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadie a afotufoɔ a wɔatete wɔn anaa atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔbɛtumi de nsɛm, mmoa, ne akwankyerɛ ama. STI anaa HIV mmoa akuo ne mpɔtam hɔ akuo a wɔde atipɛnfoɔ mmoa, afotuo, ne nneɛma ma ankorankoro a wɔde partner notifications di dwuma mu na wɔte saa tebea yi mu. Mmara mmoa ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔbɛtumi de nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan, asɛdeɛ, ne nneɛma a ɛfa ahokafoɔ amanneɛbɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asane ne anohyeto ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ hia a ehia sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn ho ban ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa atumfoɔ a wogye wɔn di hɔ bere a ɛho hia no mu?
answer_twi_source: Asane ne anohyeto ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano mu no bi ne: Nipadua mu Asiane ahorow: Honam fam akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no betumi ama tebea no ayɛ kɛse anaasɛ ɛde asiane ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔapirapira aba, titiriw sɛ ɔtowhyɛfo no sõ anaasɛ ɔwɔ tumi kɛse a. Mmara mu Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Honam fam ahoɔden a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ tebea horow a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban mu no betumi de mmara mu nsunsuanso aba na ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho yiye. Atenka mu Nsuonsa: Honam fam akasakasa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no betumi ahaw adwene wɔ nkate fam na ebia ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na ɛbɛyɛ mmuae a etu mpɔn sen biara anaasɛ ahobammɔ wom sen biara. Fa W’adwene Si Siw Ano Siw Ano So: Bere a ahokokwaw a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban no som bo no, siw ano denam nhumu, asɛm a wɔka denneennen, ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ fi mpanyimfo anaa atumfoɔ a wogye wɔn di hɔ so no da so ara yɛ ade titiriw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me hokafo adi nkitaho yiye afa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne m'ahye ho?
answer_twi_source: Kasa pefee: Munsusuw nneɛma a wohwɛ kwan, w’akɔnnɔ, ne w’ahye ho ansa na woanya nna mu kyɛfa biara. Ma nea ɛte nka sɛ ɛyɛ papa ne nea ɛnte nka no nna adi pefee. Tie no denneennen: Tie wo hokafo (hokafo) nsɛm a wɔde ano ka ne nea wɔmfa ano nka ho. Bu wɔn ahye sɛnea wopɛ sɛ wobu wo de no. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: Da w'ahiade ne wo nkate adi a womfa asodi no nto wo hokafo (hokafo) so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, "Mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ bere a wo..." Yɛ pintinn: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi! Sɛ wote nka sɛ biribi anyɛ yiye, ahobammɔ nni mu, anaasɛ wunsiesiee wo ho a, ka saa asɛm no ho asɛm pefee na emu yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara bɔ mmofra nkumaa ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ, wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ne ahosiesie a mpanyimfo yɛma, atipɛnfo, anaa tumidifo ho, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmofra nkumaa a wohyia ayayade anaa nhyɛso?
answer_twi_source: Mmara bɔ mmofra nkumaa ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ, wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ne ahosiesie a mpanyimfo, atipɛnfo, anaa tumidifo yɛ ho. Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ betumi ayɛ mfe a obi adi ho mmara, mmonnaato ho mmara a mmara ma ho kwan, ne mmara a ɛko tia mmofra a wɔto wɔn mmonnaa ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so. Mmofra nkumaa a wohyia ayayade anaa nhyɛso no betumi anya nneɛma te sɛ mmeae a wɔkasama mmofra, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne afotu adwuma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade pɔtee. Bio nso, mmara ahorow hyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mmofra nkumaa a wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ wɔn ayayade anaa wɔabu wɔn ani agu wɔn so ho amanneɛ nkɔ mmofra ahobammɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow no mu ma wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ bɛn na ɛfa nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛ nkurɔfo so ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ na wɔate ase no betumi akasa atia gyidi ahorow a epira yi?
answer_twi_source: Atesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛ nkurɔfo so ho no bi ne gyidi ahorow a ɛne sɛ: Wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no ankasa na wɔde wɔn a wɔtow hyɛ wɔn so no ho asodi to wɔn so sɛ na wɔabow nsa a. Ahɔho anaa amannifo nkutoo na wobetumi ayɛ saa ntua yi, na wɔabu wɔn ani agu nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ saa no betumi ayɛ nnamfo, ahokafo, anaa abusua mufo mpo so. Nnubɔne a wɔde di bɔne no yɛ nokware na nipakuo bi na ɛtaa yɛ wɔn.Wɔn a wɔde nnubɔne ahyɛ wɔn so no bɛda sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛda adi pefee adi bere nyinaa sɛ wɔabow nsa anaasɛ wɔanom nnubɔne. Nkyerekyerɛ ne nhumu mmɔdenbɔ betumi akasa atia saa gyidi ahorow a epira yi denam nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde bɛma wɔ sɛnea nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo so no abu so ne sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma ho na wosi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so na wobu wɔn wɔ nkitahodi nyinaa mu so dua so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a epira ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛka mmaabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden te sɛ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso, abusua mu nkɔso, asetena ne sikasɛm tebea, ne amammerɛ a efi mu ba no di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn nne ne wɔn atenae ahorow adi dwuma de ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm pa mu den, akasa atia asɛm a epira, na wɔahyɛ asetena mu atɛntrenee, pɛyɛ, ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ananmusifo mu ho nkuran denam: aɛɛfo kuro ntetan ye se , blog, vlog, ne ab nhyiam afoforo a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm, akamfo nneɛma a wodwen ho, na wɔama nne ne adwene ahorow ayɛ kɛse. Nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ na wɔakyɛ a ɛhyɛ nipadua ho mfonini pa, abusuabɔ pa, pene amammerɛ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne amammerɛ ahorow ho gyinabea a ɛka obiara ho nkuran. Intanɛt so ɔsatu ahorow, hashtags, ne nhyiam ahorow a ɛkasa tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a epira mu kyɛfa a wonya, ɛma nkurɔfo hu asetena mu nsɛm, na wɔkasa ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne nnwuma mu nsakrae kyerɛ. Yɛne atipɛnfoɔ, wɔn a wɔnya nkɛntɛnsoɔ, wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ama nnipakuo nne ayɛ kɛseɛ na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama asetena mu nsakraeɛ pa ho nhyehyɛeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen anaa ɛhaw a "LGBTQ+" mmabun hyia wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no bi?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no bi betumi ayɛ: 1. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔayɛ, ama wɔn ahiade ne wɔn ahoɔden pɔtee a wonni. 2. Nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfata na ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wobenya. 3. Nkitahodi akwanside ahorow a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa akyerɛkyerɛfo nya wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ahiade ahorow ho. 4. Adwene a ɛnteɛ ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm nna ho tumi ne wɔn akɔnnɔ ho. 5. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛfa asetra mu abusuabɔ ne fekubɔ mu esiane honam fam anaa nkitahodi mu akwanside ahorow nti. 6. Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wɔbɛto wɔn mmonnaa anaa wɔbɛfa wɔn adi dwuma esiane mmerɛwyɛ ahorow a ɛbata wɔn dɛmdi ho nti. 7. Mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wonnya mfi abusua mufo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn hɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. 8. Awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛsua, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru anaa nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu, a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiadeɛ pɔtee. 9. Animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa wɔn nna ho, a ebetumi aka wɔn ho a wobu ne ahotoso. 10. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ankasa nna mu akwahosan ahiade ne hokwan ahorow akyerɛ esiane ɔmanfo adwene ne tumi a wonni nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa akuw anaa atipɛnfo nkitahodi ahorow wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔapira wɔn anaa woakɔ basabasayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa akuw ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi ahorow de nneɛma a ɛsom bo ma mmabun a, wɔahyia ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ. Saa akuo yi ma beaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ a wɔbɛkyɛ osuahu, anya mmoa ne adansedie, anya nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma ne dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ho, na wɔayɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata mmara kwan so mmoa ne nnwuma a wɔde gyina nkurɔfo akyi a wobenya ho, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so ama mmabun a ebia wonni sika a wɔde bɛtua saa ka yi?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka a ɛbata mmara kwan so mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de boa nkurɔfo ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ahyehyɛde no, mmoa ko a wohia, ne sika a ɛwɔ hɔ so. Nneɛma bi a mmabun a ebia wonni sika betumi afa so ne: Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde mmara kwan so mmoa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ne bo nyɛ den ne nnwuma a mmara ho adwumayɛfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso nni so de ma a wɔmfa hwee nto mu. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a aban de sika boa a ɛde mmara kwan so mmoa ma ankorankoro a wohia mmoa, te sɛ ɔmanfo a wɔbɔ wɔn ho ban anaa mmara kwan so mmoa fekuw ahorow. Akwankyerɛ, mmoa, anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛ wɔde bɛtua mmara kwan so ka a wɔbɔ ma nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ, a mmabun no ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bi wɔhɔ a ɛhwɛ mmabun nipaduamu faahodie so a ɛfa wɔn nna mu na awusɔ apɔwmudzi ho?
answer_twi_source: .Aane, mmara a ɛfa apam a wɔde ama ho, ahintasɛm, ne hokwan a wowɔ sɛ woka daabi kyere ayaresatweso no bɔ hwɛ saa fahodie yiho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa abusuabɔ ne ayɔnkofa mu sɛ ɔbaabun a wadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne obi a wadi dɛm twe mpena a, ebetumi ama woanya abotɔyam, afotu bi ni: Fa w’adwene w'anigye so: Hwehwɛ obi a wo ne a ɔni wo ka kɔakyiri. Di nkitaho pefee na fi nokwaredi mu: Ka wo dɛmdi ne nea wohwɛ kwan ho asɛm. Nya ahotoso: Wo dɛmdi no yɛ onipa ko a woyɛ no fã, nanso ɛnkyerɛkyerɛ nea woyɛ. Twe mpena a mo mmienu ka, ɛnnyɛ mmɔbɔ hu: Hwehwɛ obi a obu wo sɛ ɛsom bo ma wo. Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm mpena twe wɛbsaet ne app' ahorow betumi ayɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so ne afoforo a wɔte dɛmdi ase adi nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ne sukuu ahorow, mmabun mmeae, ne ahyehyɛde afoforo a egyina mpɔtam hɔ di nkitaho de du mmabun a wohia mmoa nkyɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ ne sukuu ahodoɔ, mmabun mmeaeɛ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ so di nkitaho denam fekubɔ, adwumayɛkuo, ne nnwuma a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn so. Wobetumi ayɛ nhyiam, nsɛm a wɔka, anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ne wɔn anigye ho nhyehyɛe, na wɔne akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, ne mmabun akannifo ayɛ biako de adu atiefo a wɔdɔɔso nkyɛn. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi taa de sohyial media, nkrataa, ne asɛm a wɔde ano ka di dwuma de hyɛ wɔn nnwuma ho nkuran na wɔne mmabun di nkitaho wɔ baabi a wɔwɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Amanaman Nkabom (United Nations), Wiase Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO), ne UNESCO nam nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ne nea wɔkamfo kyerɛ so boa na wɔhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ Amanaman Nkabom (United Nations), Wiase Akwahosan Ahyehyɛdeɛ (WHO), ne UNESCO boa na wɔhyɛnna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho nkuran denam ɔmanfoɔ nimdeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ ne nsɛm a wɔka fa ho denam mfiridwuma ho mmoa a wɔde ma, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ, nsɛm a wɔkyekyɛ, hwɛ ne nhwehwɛmu ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔma ɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ aban, ɔmanfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a yɛbɛfa so agyina dadwen, adwendwen, anaa ankonamyɛ ho nkate a ebetumi afi atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea ahorow mu aba no ano?
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Twe wo nnamfo, abusuamufo, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di a wɔboa wɔn no nkyɛn ma wɔbɛgye wo nkuranhyɛ, akwankyerɛ, ne ntease. Ahomegye Akwan a Wɔde Wo Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Fa ahomegye akwan te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ, adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho, anaa adwennwen di dwuma na ama adwennwen so atew na ama nkate fam yiyedi anya nkɔso. Nneɛma a Ɛma Adwene a Ɛma Apɔwmuden a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Fa wo ho hyɛ nneɛma a wode gye w’ani, dwumadi ahorow, anaa nneɛma a w’ani gye ho a ɛde anigye, abotɔyam, ne nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene a efi atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu ba no mu. Nkate a Wobɛda no Adi: Fa nneɛma a wɔde bɔ nneɛma te sɛ adwinni, akyerɛw, anaa nnwom so da nkate adi, anaa wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka nea worehyia no ho asɛm. Ahyeɛ a wode besi hɔ: Fa ahyeɛ ne anohyeto ahorow di nkitaho wɔ w’atipɛnfo mu denneennen, na fa dwumadi ne abusuabɔ a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo yiyedi hyia di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛma ɔhaw mu afotu danso fi afotu a wonya no daa anaa adwenemuhwɛ, na dɛn nti na edi dwuma yie wɔ berɛ ɔhaw bi aba ne atenka mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhaw berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ Afotu a Wɔde Ma Daa Mu: Ɛsono afotu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhaw mu anaa ayaresa a wɔde ma daa no ho efisɛ ɛtwe adwene si nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ntɛm ara a wobedi ho dwuma ne nkate fam mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhaw bere mu so. Ebia ɛbɛfa bere tiaa mu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma onipa no agyina pintinn na wɔde wɔn abata mmoa adwuma a ɛkɔ so ho. Afotuo a wɔde ma daa Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ankorankoro, Mmabun ne ɔfotufoɔ a wɔatete no a ɔyɛ adwumaden hyia bɛka nsɛm ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ a wɔrehyia wɔ wɔn abrabɔ mu ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara bom a ɛhyɛ nneɛma ahorow ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne w’akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, anaa sukuu ayarehwɛfo nkasa mfa hia a nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ, nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhaw wɔn mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm de wɔn ho hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhaw wɔn ho nhyehyɛe ne ne di mu denneennen. Wɔn ho a wɔde hyɛ mu no hwɛ hu sɛ wɔayɛ nnwuma no ma ɛne wɔn ahiade, nea wɔpɛ, ne nea wɔde di kan, na ɛde nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn na ɛka obiara ho ba. Eyi betumi aba denam kyɛfa a wobenya wɔ afotu akuw, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, nhwehwɛmu, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi atu wɔn ho ayamhyehye, wɔn ho a wogye tom, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano mpɔn nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho so, denam gye a wobegye wɔn ahoɔden 'strengths", wɔn sintɔ 'limitations', wɔn mfomso "mistakes', ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonyin, ne osuahu ahorow a eye ne nea enye nyinaa mu a wobesua afi mu no so?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho ma mmabun nya ayamhyehye, wɔn ho a wogye tom, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano denam nkuranhyɛ a ɛhyɛ wɔn ma wogye wɔn ahoɔden, anohyeto, mfomso, ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonyin no tom no so. Ɛdenam nsusuwii so no, mmabun sua sɛnea wɔde ayamye ne ntease bedi wɔn ho dwuma, na wohu sɛ mfomso a wodi yɛ adebɔ mu ade wɔ adesua nhyehyɛe no mu. Ɛdenam osuahu pa ne nea enye nyinaa a wogye tom sɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde benyin na wɔasua ade so no, mmabun nya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano na wɔne wɔn ho nya abusuabɔ pa, na ɛma wotumi di nsɛnnennen "assertiveness" ne akwanside ahorow ho dwuma a ahotoso ne anidaso kɛse wom no yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu wɔ CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane, CSE nhyehyɛe pii de atipɛnfo nhomasua ne afotu hokwan ahorow ka ho, na wohu hia a ɛho hia sɛ mmabun sua biribi fi wɔn ho wɔn ho hɔ na wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho. Atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi akyɛ wɔn ankasa suahunu, ama nkɔmmɔdie ayɛ mmerɛ, na wɔde nsɛm ne nneɛma ama wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa ho na ɛnyɛ atemmuo so. Atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi de asuafoɔ a wɔn mfeɛ akɔ anim ne atipɛnfoɔ nkumaa abɔ mu de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne nkuranhyɛ ama wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛdi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu  ɔhaw a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya mu esiane mfe a wɔadi, mmara a awofo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu, anaa sikasɛm mu anohyeto nti.
answer_twi_source: Yehu ɔhaw a mmaabun betumi ahyia: Mfe a wɔadi ho anohyeto: Mmara ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea wobenya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a awofo mpene so ho no gu ahorow wɔ mmeae ahorow. Sikasɛm mu anohyeto: Ebia ne bo nyɛ den, nanso nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobetumi atɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu yarewa bi te sɛ STI ne HIV, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wonya?
