answer_twi_source: STI, anaa nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu yɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so titiriw, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu, awotwaa mu, ne anom ka ho. HIV, anaa mmoawa a ɛma nipadua no tumi ko tia nyarewa no yɛ mmoawa a ɛtow hyɛ nipadua no mu tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa no so, na ɛde n’ani si CD4 nkwammoaa, mogya mu nkwammoaa fitaa bi a edi dwuma titiriw wɔ nipadua no tumi a ɛde ko tia nyarewa no mu titiriw. HIV tumi nam nipadua mu nsu bi te sɛ mogya, mmadwoa, awotwaa mu nsu, ne nufusu a wɔsesa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsu a ɛwɔ nipadua no mu di boa m’apɔmden nsɛm ho woberɛ a merebu mensa na nsuo dodoɔ sɛn na menom?
answer_twi_source: Nsu a wɔde ma ho hia kɛse ma akwahosan nyinaa, titiriw wɔ nsabuo mu berɛ a worenyin ntɛntɛm. Nsu di dwuma wɔ aduan a wɔyam, mogya a ɛkɔ nipadua no mu, ɔhyew a wɔhwɛ so, nnuane nnuru a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo ne dwensɔtwaa mu. Sɛnea wobɛkɔ so anya nsu ni: Nom Nsu Da Nyinaa: Fa si w’ani so sɛ wubenya nsu bonsua 8-10 (64-80 ounces) da biara, anaa dea ɛboro saa sɛ woyɛ nnam anaa sɛ ɔhyew de wo a. Tie Sukɔm: Sɛ sukɔm de wo a, ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo nipadua hia nsu. Susuw Nnuan ho: Nnuane te sɛ nnuaba, atosodeɛ, ne nkwan nso boa ma nipadua no nya nsu. Hwe wo dwonso nhosuo: Dwoso a nahosuo yɛ akɔkɔsradeɛ yɛ ade pa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nsu wɔ nipadua no mu. Na sɛ dwonso no ahosuo yɛ tuntum a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wuhia nsu pii. Hwɛ sɛnea honam ani hwɛbea te: honam ani a awoɔ na ɛyɛ nwininwini betumi akyerɛ sɛ nsu nni wo honam mu. Yamtim nso betumi  akyerɛ sɛ nsuo ni nipadua no mu. Na sɛ woretenetene wapɔm a: Ɛyɛ a nom nsuo ansa, anaa sɛ saa berɛ no mu ankasa anaa sɛ wowie a na wanom nsuo de asi deɛ ɛnam mfifire so afiri nipadua no mu berɛkro a na woretenetene wapɔm anan mu. Kwati Nsã a Asikyire wom: Te anomnomdeɛ a asikyire wom pii so. Fa nom nsuo ne anomnomdeɛ a ɛfiri nnuaba mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na mmabun bɛyɛ de ako ama nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma obiara nya nna mu nsɛm ho nimdeɛ 'sexual health' mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Afotu no bi ne: Npaemu-ka fa nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata ho. Wɔbɛkɔ so abɔ dawuru wɔ nna mu nsɛm ho 'campaigns'. Wɔne mpanyimfoɔ bɛkasa. Wɔbɛdɔm mmabun kuo. Wɔbɛka wɔn suahunu akyerɛ afoforo de hwehwɛ nsakraeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na Mmabun bɛtumi aboa wɔ mmara ho nkanyan dwumadi mu de ahyɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmonnaatoɔ siwbɔ, mmoa, ne atɛntrenee ho den, de anam nhwɛsoɔ be te sɛ wɔbɛka mmabun akuw ho, wɔbɛyɛ bagua mu nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadi, na wɔade wɔn ho ahyɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi aboa wɔ mmara ho nkanyan dwumadi mu de ahyɛ mmara, nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mmoa dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa mmonnaatoɔ siwbɔ ne atɛntrenee ho den wɔ akwan pii so. Wɔbɛtumi aka mmabun akuw ne nkabom horow a wɔn ani kuta mmonnaatoɔ siwbɔ ne nkanyan dwumadi ho, wɔade wɔn ho ahyɛ bagua mu nkyerɛkyerɛ mu de ama nkurɔfo ate mmonnaatoɔ ase na wɔahyɛ 'peneɛ' (consent) amammerɛ ho nkuran. Bio nso, wɔbɛtumi aka nhyehyɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkanyan dwumadi ho de aboa ma wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ mmara mu na wɔama mmonnaatoɔ ho mmara ayɛ adwuma yiye. Denam amanneɛbɔ, wɔn suahunu a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ so no, mmerantebayerɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi aboa ma wɔahyehyɛ mmara kwan a ɛbɛbɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no ho ban na ahyɛ wɔn den yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow, akwahosan mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ne ahyehyɛde afoforo betumi ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛne sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔama wɔn tumi wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nnwuma a ɛkyerɛ obu ma kokoam nsɛm na wɔne mmabun kasa ayamye mu. Fa mmerante ne mmabaa ka nhyehyɛe ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Boa wɔn ma wɔnnya nimdeɛ mfa akanni ne nkitahodi ho. Ma mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi akasa pefee na wɔanya mmoa, bere a wobu wɔn hokwan ahorow no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a ebia wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu kokoam nsɛm so, na sɛ ɛte saa a, ebi ne?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebia wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu kokoam nsɛm so wɔ tebea horow bi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ayayade a wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ: Sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bi wɔ nea obegyina so agye adi sɛ wɔreyɛ ɔbabun bi ayayade anaasɛ ɔwɔ asiane mu a, ebia ɛbɛyɛ wɔn asɛyɛde sɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata. Ɔhaw a ɛreba: Sɛ ɔbabun bi de asiane ba sɛ obepira n’ankasa anaa afoforo a, ebia ɛho behia sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo da nsɛm adi na wɔasiw ɔhaw ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bere a meyɛ ɔbabun, na ɛhe na metumi akɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ ɔbabun no, wubetumi anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho nhyehyɛe denam: W’akwahosan ho Ɔhwɛfo a Wobɛkɔ Asɛm no so: Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a oyii nyinsɛn no gui no anaa akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wo. Awo Akwahosan Ayaresabea a Wɔkɔ: Awo akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow taa de ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi ma, a afotu ne aduruyɛ mu akyi a wodi ka ho. Mmoa a Wɔhwehwɛ fi Planned Parenthood anaa Ahyehyɛde Ahorow a Ɛte Saa Ho: Planned Parenthood ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛtete saa de awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a edi mu, a nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ka ho, ma mmabun wɔ baabi a wɔyɛ kokoam na wɔboa wɔn. Mpɔtam Hɔ Akwahosan Dwumadibea Ahorow a Wobɛkɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow betumi de ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi bɛma anaasɛ wobetumi de wɔn akɔma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata. Wubetumi anya nsɛm pii afa nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho denam telefon a edidi so yi so, 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ),ne PPA's Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akasa ma meho na m'ahwehwɛ adwen mu apɔmmuden mmoa a atɛmmuo nni mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa mmabun apɔmmuden kuo so. Sukuu ayaresanni/ayaresamani betumi akasa ama wo. Ka wo hia (Assertiveness) pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nipadua ahorow, mmusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea, ne tumi ahorow ho mfonini ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no nya mmabun nipadua mfonini ho adwene ne sɛnea wɔte nka sɛ wɔka obiara ho no so nsusuaso?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ahorow, mmusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea, ne tumi ahorow ho mfonini ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no betumi anya mmabun nipadua mfonini ho adwene ne nkate a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔka wɔn ho no so nsusuaso pa denam: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛda ankorankoro a wɔwɔ asetra mu ankasa ahorow ahorow adi a wɔde bɛma, nipadua a wogye tom ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn a wɔne atetesɛm mu ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow so no mu. Nnipa a wɔyɛ katee a wɔkasa tia na wɔhyɛ nipadua no nsusuwii, ne kɛse, ne ne hwɛbea ahorow a wogye tom ho nkuran, na ɛma ɔmanfo a wɔka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔma afoforo ho kwan kɛse. Mmabun a wɔboa wɔn ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔahu wɔn na wɔagye atom, na ɛtew nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔyɛ ahɔho anaasɛ wɔmfata a egyina ahoɔfɛ ho adwene a ɛnyɛ nokware so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen titiriw ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ ɔman ne mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: ɔhaw a ɛwɔ amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ ɔman ne mpɔtamu hɔ no bi ne nneɛma a enni hɔ, amammerɛ ne nyamesom akwanside ahorow, amammui mu ɔpɛ a wonni, animtiaabu, nyiyimu ne tumi a ɛnnɔɔso. Hokwan ahorow no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛma nhumu ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo bɛkɔ soro, wɔbɛboaboa nneɛma ano, wɔbɛkyekye fekubɔ, ne akwan foforo a wɔbɛfa so adi ASRH nsɛm ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ mu sɛnea nnipa su ahorow a ɛbom ka onipa biako ho kyerɛ nkitahodi a ɛda asetena mu su ahorow ntam, ne nsunsuansoɔ a eyi nya wɔ onipa no amanehunu so..
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛni bɛne wo abɔ bɔbeasu mu nneyɛe ne su ho nkɔmmɔ. Wɔbu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu mu nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ ntawntawdi, atutra, ne mmabun SRH ntam nkitahodi ntease mu, na mmeae bɛn na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mu bio na wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu na ama wɔahu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina adanse so?
answer_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ a ɛbɛtena hɔ akyɛ: Ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu foforɔ na ama yɛate nsunsuansoɔ a ɛkyɛ a ntawntawdie ne atutra nya wɔ mmabun SRH nsunsuansoɔ so, a adwene mu apomden, awoɔ akwahosan, ne basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbaa so ka ho. Nneɛma a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ho: Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm a ɛfa ho, te sɛ amammerɛ mu gyidie, asetena mu gyinapɛn, ne nneɛma a wɔnya, nya wɔ mmabun SRH mmerɛwyɛ so wɔ ntawntawdi tebea mu a, ɛbɛtumi ama wɔahu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn ani asi so. Nhwehwɛmu: SRH dwumadie a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ mmeaeɛ a ntawntawdie aka no mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee ho hia na ama wɔahu akwan a ɛtu mpɔn, asusu nhyehyɛeɛ no nkɛntɛnsoɔ ho, na wɔabɔ akwan a egyina adanseɛ so a wɔfa so di mmabun SRH ahiadeɛ ho dwuma wɔ nnipa mmoa tebea mu no amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo aka m’ahye ne nea mepɛ a ɛfa nna a ahobammɔ wom ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wobɛbue Mu: Wo ne wo hokafoɔ nkasa pefee ne nokwaredi mu fa wo hyeɛ ne nea wopɛ wɔ nna a ahotɔ wom ho. Fa "Me" Nsɛm di dwuma: Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma de kyerɛ w'ahiade, te sɛ "Mete nka sɛ me ho tɔ me kɛse sɛ mede kɔndɔm bedi dwuma." Bu Wo Ho Wo Ho: Bu wo hokafo no ahye ne nea ɔpɛ nso, na ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu ma obiara ba. Di Kan Yɛ Adesua: Sua wo ho sɛ wo ne wo nnamfo anaa ahwehwɛ anim bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ yi na ama woanya ahotoso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene anaa nsɛmbisa bɛn na dodoɔ no a wɔ fa edinsiananmu ho na kwan bɛn so na yɛbɛyi ano?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana amanmmara mu no, mmarima (he) ne mmaa (she) nko yɛgye tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe (international frameworks)  na ɛfa ASRR ho sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ wiase nyinaa nhyehyɛeɛ. Ɛkyerɛ obu, bɔ nnipa ho ban na wɔdi nnipa akwannya ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ kotoku mu wɔ nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden ho nnwuma ho no ka sɛnea mmabun de saa nnwuma yi di dwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Ka a wɔbɔ wɔ kotoku mu wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ho no betumi anya mmabun a wɔde saa nnwuma yi di dwuma no so nkɛntɛnso: Ebia sika a wɔbɔ kɛse no asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata, na ɛbɛma wɔakyɛ sɛ wobehu nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho tebea horow na wɔasa. Mmabun a wofi afie a wonnya sika pii anaa ankorankoro a wonni insurance mu no betumi ahyia sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya akwanside a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awo apomoden ho afotu, na ɛde nsonsonoe bɛba wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma ne apomodenn mu nsunsuanso mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsunsuanso bɔne anaa asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina wɔn ankorankoro akwahosan ahiade ne tebea ahorow so asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebia nsunsuanso bɔne a ebetumi afi nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ano ntɛm so aba ne akisikuru, ɔfe, ɔbrɛ, tiyɛ, ne nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mogya a ɛba bere mu. Mmabun betumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma ho denam akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobebisabisa wɔn nsɛm, asusuw wɔn ankorankoro akwahosan ahiade ne tebea ahorow ho, na wɔakari mfaso a ɛwɔ so ne asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun susuw sɛ wɔn adamfo anaa wɔn atipɛnfo bi wɔ ayayade mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun susuw sɛ wɔn adamfo anaa wɔn atipɛnfo bi wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ ayayade mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Wɔde ahwɛyiye ne dadwen kɔ wɔn adamfo no nkyɛn, kyerɛ mmoa ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛboa Tie a wonni atɛn na gye wɔn adamfo no suahu ahorow di Fa nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ne mmoa a wobetumi apaw ho Hyɛ wɔn adamfo no nkuran sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so te sɛ Agoo SHE+ intanɛt so dwumadibea a wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn 5100, . YENKASA The toll-free number(0800202010), GHS-YMK etc. Ka sɛ wobɛka wɔn adamfo no ho akɔhwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wobɛbɔ ayayade ho amanneɛ sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho bere a wo ne oduruyɛfo anaa nna mu akwahosan ho ayaresabea rekasa afa me SOGI ne nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho no? (nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, nsɛmmisa a wobisa) .
answer_twi_source: Ka nokware: Dodow a woka nsɛm pii no, dodow no ara na wobetumi aboa wo yiye. Bisa nsɛm: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa biribiara a ɛhaw wo, nsɛmmɔne biara nni hɔ. wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mpɔtam mmoa kuo bɛboa me ma manya nnamfo bere a mereyɛ anyin?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho hyɛ mmabun dwumadie mu (youth programs). Dɔm agorɔ kuo (sports teams). Yɛ adwuma a yɛnnye ka (volunteer). Wei bɛboa wo ma woanya nnamfo a wɔpɛ ade korɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma, sohyial media, ne intanɛt so akwan adi dwuma de ahyɛ nhumu, nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna mu pene ho nkuran, na dɛn ne asiane ne hawa ebetumi aba a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho wɔ dijitaal tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma, sohyial media, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow betumi ayɛ nnwinnade a ɛsom bo a wɔde hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna mu pene a wɔpene so ho no ho nkuran. Wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔde di nkitaho, mobile apps, social media ɔsatu ahorow, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow betumi ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ sɛ wobesua pii afa pene a wɔpene so ho nneɛma, nsɛm, ne mmoa a wotumi nya na ɛyɛ anigye. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ wodi asiane ne haw a ebetumi aba wɔ dijitaal tebea horow mu ho di dwuma, te sɛ intanɛt so ɔhaw, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, kokoam nsɛm ho haw, ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛfata mfe a obi adi na ɛfa amammerɛ ho di dwuma. Mmabun betumi akamfo intanɛt so mmeae a ahobammɔ ne nnipa nyinaa ka ho, de wɔn ho ahyɛ dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, na wɔde mfiridwuma adi dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ntease wom a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na obu di wɔ nyɔnkofa  mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me ne me hokafo no bu yɛn  ho yɛn ho?
answer_twi_source: Obu Fapem: Obu yɛ nyɔnkofa papa fapem, baabi a ahokafo baanu no nyinaa bu wɔn ho wɔn ho. Tie na Gye Din: Tie wo hokafo adwene a wunsusuw ho na si wɔn suahu ahorow no mu den. Ahye: Munnya obu mma mo ho mo ho ahye na mommɔ ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Pɛyɛ: Momfa mo ho mo ho nni sɛ nnipa a wɔyɛ pɛ, na momma wɔn adwene yɛ pɛ wɔ gyinaesi ne asɛyɛde ahorow mu. Ntawntawdi Ho Nsiesiei: Fa obu siesie ntawntawdi, a womfa wo ho nto animtiaabu anaa animtiaabu so. Tebea a Ɛboa: Yɛ tebea a ɛboa a ahokafo baanu no nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ na wɔsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ me nyinsɛn a, faahodie ne asɛdeɛɔ bɛn na mewɔ, na afei so mesi dɛn ako ama me ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wusi gyinae wɔ wo nipadua ne nyinsɛn ho. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wobenya ayaresa papa. Saa mmerɛ yi mu no, ɛyɛ wo asɛdeɛ ne sɛ wobɛɔhwɛ wo ho so yie na w'akɔ ayaresabea mpɛn pii. Mmanntu anamɔn bia gye wonim sɛ ɛbɛɔ boa wo. Ma adɔktafoɔ nkyerɛ wo nea ahia nyina na bisa nea ɛkyere w'adwen. Wo ne abusuani anaa adamfoɔ betumi akɔ hu dɔkta. Hotlines a adidi soɔ yi so betumi aboa wo; 0540-118-999, 5100 (ma MTN foɔ), PPA's Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-024118008) ne YMK App so ka ho. Wo ne dɔktafoɔ nkasa mfa safety net programme no so ho efi sɛ ɛboa mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔahyia ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya, a nea ɛka ho ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, afotu adwuma, mmoa akuw, dabere, mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu, a ne nyinaa betumi de mmoa ne mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ nkitahodie pa ne ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun de bɛkae na wɔhunu saa nneyɛɛ pa yei nyinaa wɔankasa nkitahodie mu?
answer_twi_source: Obuo, ahotosoɔ, nkɔmmɔbɔ, pɛyɛ. Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wote nka anaa sɛ ahyeɛ. Fa nkitahodie a ɛdi adi pefee so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛboa ma yesua edinnsiananmu  (pronouns) ne nna mu su (gender identity) ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, mmara no gye edinnsiananmu mmienu pɛ a ɛyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa (binary gender).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a ɛda aban ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de (NGOs) ntam no, hyɛ ASRH nnwuma a wɔde ma, mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban, ne nnwuma a wɔde bɛhyɛ tumi a wɔde bɛma wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne ɔmantam mu no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda aban ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ aban ntam no, hyɛ ASRH dwumadie mu den denam wɔn ho wɔn ho nimdeɛ, wɔn ahodeɛ, ne nkitahodiɛ a wɔde di dwuma no so. NGO ahorow taa nya nkitahodi a ɛwɔ fam ne nsakrae a wɔde bɛyɛ nneɛma foforo, bere a aban ahorow betumi de nhyehyɛe mmoa, sika, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ama de ama nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a edi mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na mmabun betumi ayɛ sɛ biribi kyer wɔn adwene fa SRH mmoa hwehwɛeɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo dɔkota. Kɔ clinics a wɔbɛka w'asɛm kokoam. Fa adamfo ka wo ho. Bɔ kɔkɔ sɛ wɔyi wo asɛm adi a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow de asiw nyinsɛn a manhyɛ da ano daakye?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Sukuu pii de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ma. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo: Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa awo ano aduru ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho. Abusua Nhyehyɛe Ayaresabea: Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw de nnwuma te sɛ awo ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne afotu ma. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ahorow a wotumi de ho to so de nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho nsɛm ma. Nhomatrofo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Ahyehyɛde ahorow bi de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim ma. Ɛdenam saa nneɛma yi a wode bedi dwuma so no, wubetumi aboaboa nsɛm ano, ahwehwɛ mmoa, na woasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nyinsɛn mu akwan horow ne daakye awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Aboafo nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho gyinaesi ahorow mu na madi nsɛm a ɛhaw me anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ebia mewɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo: Wo duruyɛfo anaa ayaresabea betumi de abusua nhyehyɛe akwan ho nsɛm ama na wɔabua nsɛmmisa. Ahomotrofo anaa Aboafonhwehwɛbea: Frɛ ahomatrofo anaa Aboafonhwehwɛbea a wɔde ama nna mu apomoden ne abusua nhyehyɛe na woanya kokoam afotu. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo no bi ne 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA’s Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) Wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so: Wɛbsaet ahorow a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ Planned Parenthood de nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri ma wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe, mmabun apomoden nhyehyeɛ wo abɛɛfo kurontenten so 'Adolescent Health program social media platforms', YMK app Support Networks: Atipɛnfo mboayɛ: Wo ne wo nnamfo anaa w’atipɛnfo nka abusua nhyehyɛe ho osuahu ne afotu ho asɛm. Abusua ne Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di: Abusua mufo anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama. Afotu Dwumadibea: Hwehwɛ afotu adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw na ama woanya akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmu de asusuw gyinapɛn ne gyidie ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ a ɛda yɛn abusua mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee nam nkuranhyɛ a wobɛhyɛ obiara nkuran ma waka ne nsusuwii ne ne nkate horow a onsuro sɛ wobebu no atɛn no so. Si tema, ntease, ne ne yɔnko adwene a wogye tom so dua. Fa abusua amanne anaa mmere a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a obiara betumi de ne ho ahyɛ mu kwa. Na kae sɛ wode ɔdɔ, obu, ne bɔhyɛ a ɛne sɛ wobɛte wo ho ase bɛbɛn saa nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asetena mu nimdeɛ ho adesua gyinabea ahorow anaa afã ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun nkɔso ahiade?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wɔtaa yɛ asetra mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma ɛne mmabun nkɔso ahiade hyia na wobetumi de ama wɔ gyinabea anaa mmere ahorow mu: Mmabunbere mfiase mfe du kosi du-nan (10-14): Fa w’adwene si fapem nimdeɛ te sɛ ankasa nimdeɛ, nkitahodi, ne gyinaesi so. Mfinimfini mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mfe du-anum kosi du-nsɔn(15-17): Wosi nnipa ntam nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano a ɛfa atipɛnfo abusuabɔ ne nipasu nkɔso ho so dua. Mmabunbere a ɛba akyiri, mfe du-nwɔtwe kosi aduonu-biako (18-21): Ahokokwaw a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ nneɛma te sɛ botae a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne nsakrae a wɔyɛ kɔ mpanyin afe so, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de me sukuu, dwumadie foforo, ne nnamfofoɔ ntam nkitahodie bɛyɛ adwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ, na saa mberɛ no ara nso matumi anya nna a ɛdɔɔso wɔ mmabun-berɛ (puberty) mu?
answer_twi_source: Ma nna ho nhia wo. Nya bere a woda daa. Yɛ nneɛma ntem. Sua sɛdeɛ yɛka daabi sɛ wobrɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ papa ho nsusuwii ne nnipa hokwan ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma bɛma mmabun wɔ mmeae a ɔhaw ahorow aka wɔn, a nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, kokoamsɛm, ne kokoam nsɛm ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae a ɔhaw wɔ hɔ no ma abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ nnipa hokwan ahorow ho sɔre. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wodi hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpene so, kokoamsɛm, ne kokoamsɛm so no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma no nya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ahyɛ mu ma, wɔkora kokoamsɛm so, na wɔyɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛnyɛ atɛn ma mmabun betumi anya ɔhwɛ. Akwan ahorow yi a wobekura mu no ho hia kɛse na ama mmabun akwahosan ne wɔn yiyedi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nneɛma na ɛbetumi ayɛ den ama mmabun sɛ wobenya akwaa apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho? (Akwanside ahorow a ɛfa ɛka a wɔbɔ, asasesin a wonni, nimdeɛ a wonni)
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii nti na mmabun betumi ahyia ɔhaw : Sikasem akwanside : Akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe, kokoam nnwuma mpo betumi ayɛ nea ne bo yɛ den. Asasesin mu Anohyeto: Ebia ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde ASRH ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam ma no rentumi nnya ntɛm wɔ mmeaeɛ nyinaa. Nhumu a Wonnim: Ebia mmabun pii nnim sɛ kokoam adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneyɛe anaa nneyɛe bi a wɔde bu no sɛ nsɛmmɔnedi betumi aka mmabun a wobenya nnwuma ne wɔn yiyedi nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: mmara a ɛbu nneyɛe bi te sɛ LGBTQ+ dwumadie anaa abusuafoɔ ntam nna ho kwan sɛ bɔne no ma mmofra suro sɛ wɔbɛkɔ ayaresabea. Suro a wɔsuro sɛ wɔbɛkyere wɔn anaa wɔbɛgu wɔn anim ase no tumi ma wɔyɛ nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ fɛ, na ɛde yadeɛ ne afoforɔ ba, na ɛbu mmofra ahofadie kwan nso so. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsesa mmara no na ama yɛagyae saa nneyɛe yi bu sɛ bɔne, na ama mmofra anya kwan akɔ ayaresabea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ wiase nyinaa nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔbɛsakra, te sɛ 'COVID-19' ɔyaredɔm anaa wim nsakrae, wɔ amanaman ntam sika a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nea wɔde bɛkyɛ ama 'ASRH' no so?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa nneɛma a ɛho hia te sɛ 'COVID-19' ɔyaredɔm anaa wim nsakrae a wɔbɛsakra no betumi aka amanaman ntam sika a wobenya ne sika nea broni ka no 'International funding'  a wɔde bɛma 'ASRH'. Saa nsɛm yi betumi adan nneɛma afi 'ASRH' nhyehyɛe ahorow so, na ɛde sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe aba na mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nnwuma a ɛho hia ho no so atew. Nanso, wɔsan nso de hokwan ahorow ma sɛ wɔde 'ASRH' bɛka akwahosan ne nkɔso ho nhyehyɛe a ɛtrɛw ho, na wosi akwahosan ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nsɛm a ɛka bom no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi adi wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun ma wɔanya nna ho ntease a ɛho hia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ne nea efi mu ba ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun ma wɔte nna ho nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ne nea efi mu ba no ase denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wofi ase fa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, nipadua mfonini, ne nna a ahoɔden wom ho no so. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ yiye, obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho ne nipadua mu nneɛma pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ a obu wom ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara mu nsusuwii nsusuasoɔ nya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi anya ne nea wobetumi anya so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nsusuwii betumi anya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe anya nsusuasoɔ kɛse wanya nsusuasoɔ kese mmabun. Sɛ nhwɛso no, mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom betumi asiw mmabun kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ahwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so wɔ akwan horow bi ho, anaasɛ ɛde akwanside ahorow aba wɔ kokoam hwɛ ho. Nea ɛne no bɔ abira no, mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa a ɛde hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne kokoamsɛm mu di kan no betumi ama nnwuma a wobenya no ayɛ mmerɛw na ama mmabun awo akwahosan ne yiyedi anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ntam bere a merehwehwɛ akwankyerɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ti ho no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohu nsonsonoe a ɛda nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ntam bere a worehwehwɛ akwankyerɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a, susuw sɛnea wogye fibea no di, sɛnea nsɛm a wɔde ama no yɛ nokware na ɛyɛ sika, ne sɛ ebia nsɛm pii a ɛwɔ din pa foa nsɛm no so anaa. Hwɛ yiye wɔ nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa anaasɛ ɛyɛ animhwɛ ho na fa nsɛm a efi akwahosan ho ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din, nnuruyɛfo, ne mmeae a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu hɔ di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abue abɛɛfo ntentan (online) kuo anaa nnamfonom mmoakuo a wɔbɛtumi akyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokwarɛ, na wɔahyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa a ɛfa nna mu apɔmuden ne awoɔ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so no, hwehwɛ mmoakuo anaa nhyiamu mmaeɛ a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokwarɛ, obu mu nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne suban pa a ɛfa nna mu apɔmuden ne awoɔ ho di kan. Wo bɛtumi de wo ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, na woakyɛ nhoma anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ biara a ɛbɛboa afoforɔ wɔ kuo no mu a wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen bi. Hwɛ wo ho yie wɔ nsɛm a wo ankasa wode bɛto gua ho, na hwɛ na wankyɛ nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokwarɛ anaa wobɛyɛ nneyɛeɛ biara a ɛbɛtumi apira afoforɔ wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan no so. Fa wo ho bɔ nnamfonom a mo nneyɛeɛ ne mo gyinapɛn yɛ pɛ, na mo mmienu mmom mmɔ mmɔden sɛ mobɛbue baabi a ɛbɛboa obiara na ayɛ anigyeɛ wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ ne tɛknɔlɔji foforo a ɛfa akwahosan ho di, wɔ sɛnea ɛbɛma mbabun anya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayaresa a ɛfa mmawoɔ ne nna mu akwahosan ho a obiara nni hɔ a yɛbɛyi no afiri mu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nkitahodie ne ayaresa ho tɛknɔlɔji foforo di dwuma titiriw paa wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayaresa a ɛfa mmawoɔ ne nna mu akwahosan ho a mbabun nya denam: Wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma, te sɛ mmawoɔ ho nhyehyɛe, sɛnea yɛbɛbɔ yɛn ho ban afi STI ho, mpanyinfie kɔ, ne nnamfofa pa. Wɔyɛ saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi wɔ kwan a mbabun bɛtumi ate aseɛ ntɛm. Wɔyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ te sɛ intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ, anaa ayaresa a ɛnam tɛlɛfoni so, baabi a mbabun bɛtumi abisa nsɛm na wɔanya mmoa ne afutuo afi ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ hɔ a wɔnsuro sɛ obi bɛbu wɔn animtiasɛe. Wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛboa ma nnipa ahodoɔ nyinaa nya mmoa, te sɛ kasa horow pii a wɔde twerɛ nsɛm no, nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛne yɛn amammerɛ hyia, ne mmoa pɔtee a wɔde ma mbabun, nnipakuo a wɔabu wɔn animtiasɛe, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ dɛm bi wɔ wɔn nipadua mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi anya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, a awo ano aduru, kɔndɔm, ne nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ (LARC) ka ho, sɛ ɔbabun?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn ano aduro a wobenya: Ayaresabea ne Akwahosan Asoɛe ahorow: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ awo akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow, abusua nhyehyɛe mmeae, anaa akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow. Akwahosan Ho Dwumadifo: Yɛ nhyehyɛe kɔhwɛ mmea ho oduruyɛfo, oduruyɛfo titiriw, anaa mmabun akwahosan ho ɔbenfo. Nnurutɔnbea ahorow: Nnuru bi a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano te sɛ kɔndɔm ne nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ wɔ nnurutɔnbea ahorow a wɔtɔn. Intanɛt so Nnwuma: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow bi de akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so ma de nya nnuro a wɔde siw awo ano a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka m’ankasa m’adwene, atenka, ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho akyerɛ m’awofo wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma wɔanya ntease, ahotoso, ne obu ama wɔn ho wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwene, atenka, ne nsemmisa a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho a wɔbɛka akyerɛ awofo wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma wɔanya ntease, ahotoso, ne obu ama wɔn ho wɔn ho no hwehwɛ sɛ: Sɛ wodi nokware na wodi nokware wɔ nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene, osuahu ahorow, ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho ho asɛm tẽẽ, bere a wogye tom nso sɛ asɛmti no yɛ atenka. Anisɔ a wɔda no adi wɔ ɔpɛ a awofo wɔ sɛ wobetie na wɔde akwankyerɛ ama no ho, na wosi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔboa na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw yi a wodi mu no so dua. Nsɛm, afotu, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wobɛbisa wɔ nsɛmti anaa nsɛm pɔtee bi ho, a ɛkyerɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so sua ade na wosi gyinaeɛ. Sɛ wobɛbue w’ani ama nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfiri awofoɔ hɔ, sɛ mpo wɔn adwene yɛ soronko wɔ w’ankasa de ho a, na wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛma denhyɛ mu de adi nsonsonoeɛ anaa nteaseɛ a ɛntene biara ho dwuma. Awofoɔ ahyeɛ ne ahotɔ dodoɔ a wɔbɛhunu na wɔabu wɔn, adwene a wɔde bɛsi wɔn nneyɛeɛ ne mmuaeɛ so, na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ nkitahodiɛ akwan mu sɛdeɛ ɛfata na ama nkɔmmɔdie pa na ɛsow aba akɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan a etu mpɔn wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so de intanɛt so nnwinnade te sɛ adesrɛ anaa sika a wɔboaboa ano ɔsatu ahorow di dwuma de gyina ASRR ahorow akyi? (internet so nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho akwan horow ase) .
answer_twi_source: Nnwinnade a ɛwɔ Internet so betumi ayɛ nea tumi wom wɔ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi. Sɛnea wode bedi dwuma yiye ni: Adesrɛ ahorow: Hwehwɛ adesrɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no mu wɔ nsɛm a ɛbɛn wo ho na boaboa wɔn nsaano nkyerɛwee ano. Hwɛ sɛ adesrɛ krataa no wɔ botae ahorow a emu da hɔ na ɛde n’ani si wɔn a wosi gyinae a ɛfata so. Sika a Wɔboaboa Ano Ɔsatu: Sɛ worekamfo ade pɔtee bi a ehia sika kyerɛ a, hwehwɛ nhyiam ahorow a agye din mu na nya nhyehyɛe a emu da hɔ a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde sika no bedi dwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm a wonya no ne nneɛma afoforo te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, asetra mu sikasɛm tebea, ne asasesin a ɛwɔ, di nkitaho wɔ nkɛntɛnso a wonya wɔ mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi: Bɔbeasu: Asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi asiw nsɛm a mmeawa anaa mmarima ne mmea kakraa bi nya no ano, na ɛde nsonsonoe aba nimdeɛ ne nnwuma mu. Asetra ne sikasɛm tebea: Mmabun a wofi mmusua a wonnya sika pii mu betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow wɔ nsɛm a ɛfata a wobenya ho esiane nneɛma a wonni anaasɛ nhomasua hokwan ahorow a wonni nti. Beae a ɛwɔ: Ebia nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no ntumi nkɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ne nhomasua ho nneɛma pii, na ɛbɛka mmabun a wobenya nsɛm ne nnwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow, akuo a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, ne ayɔnkofa nhyehyɛe ahorow di wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a ankorankoro betumi ne afoforo a wɔwɔ osuahu a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho, akyekye biakoyɛ, na wɔabom ayɛ adwuma de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔahyɛ asetena mu nsakrae ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, akuo a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, ne ayɔnkofa nhyehyɛeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ a ankorankoro bɛtumi ne afoforo a wɔwɔ suahunu a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho, akyekye biakoyɛ, na wɔabom ayɛ adwuma de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔahyɛ asetena mu nsakraeɛ ho nkuran. Saa nkitahodibea ahorow yi ma atinka fam mmoa, nokwaredi, ne tumi ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu, bere a ɛsan nso kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ ayɔnkofo no fa nna mu basabasayɛ a ɛyɛ nnam ne dwuma a wodi wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ho. Ɛnam adwumayɛkuo ne biakoyɛ a wɔma ɛkɔ so no , atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ boa ma wɔyɛ mpɔtam a ahotɔ wɔ mu na ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda mfonini ahorow a wɔde abɛɛfo ntetan dwuma ne nipadua mfonini a wɔde gyina hɔ ma ankasa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda mfonini ahorow a wɔde abɛɛfo ntetan ayɛ ne nipadua mfonini a wɔde gyina hɔ ma ankasa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ntam denam: Ahwɛyiye a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nsusuwii a ɛnyɛ nokware, honam ani hwɛbea a mfomso biara nni ho, ne nneɛma a ɛne ne ho hyia, a ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ abɛɛfo ntetan so no so. Mfonini ahorow a wɔde toto mmeae ahorow ne nhyiam ase de hwɛ sɛnea ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛyɛ nokware. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a wobenya de agye nipadua mfonini a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ho kyim na wɔakasa atia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a mede bɛma abusuabɔ anaa twaka (relationship) ho afotu anaa mmoa a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu fotufo anaa ɔyaresafo: Wobetumi de kokoam mmoa ne afotu ama wɔ abusuabɔ ho. Ayarehwɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa su wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea, anaa sukuu ayarehwɛfo betumi de afotu mmoa ama. "YMK app" (android app) a "Ghana Health Service" yɛ, atete intanɛt so afotufoɔ ma wɔde adwumayɛfoɔ mmoa ama
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe a ebetumi aka sɛnea mmabun hu ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho na sɛn na wɔ gye so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne adwene ahorow a ɛsonosonoe wɔ nna ho, mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow, abusua mu nkɔso nea broni ka no 'family dynamics', nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, ne atetesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe betumi anya ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa, mmoa nhyehyɛe a wɔpɛ, ne sɛnea wosi gyinae wɔ ɔhaw bi mu no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho betumi ama mmabun anya tema, ayamhyehye, ne obu ama wɔn ho wɔn ho, a nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ abusua a wofi mu anaa onipa ko a wofi mu mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma obiara betumi ama mmabun anya tema, ayamhyehye, ne obu ama wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ ntease ne gye a wogye tom wɔ adwene ahorow, nipasu, ne osuahu ahorow ho no so. Ɛnam nsɛmti te sɛ pene, ahye, ne nyɔnkofa papa ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ma so no, nhomasua a ɛka obiara ho hyɛ asuafo nkuran ma wonya tema ma afoforo ne obu ma ankorankoro nsonsonoe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne ahye a ɛfata ho nkuran sɛ nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ pa mu.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi Ho Nimdeɛ: Fa nnamyɛ tie na woda w’ahiade ne wo nkate adi pefee. Ahye: Sɛ wode anohyeto ahorow si hɔ a, ɛbɔ w’adwene ho ban denam nea wogye tom ne nea wonnye ntom wɔ abusuabɔ mu a wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ nna ne abusuabɔ ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no yɛ nokware, na wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow yi: Akuo ahorow a wɔwɔ din pa: Nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a efi aban akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow, nnuroyɛ asoɛe ahorow, anaa nna mu akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔatew hɔ no yɛ nea wotumi de ho to so kɛse. Adansedi: Hwɛ sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no yɛ akwahosan ho ɔbenfo anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔfata anaa. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ foforo: Hwehwɛ da a etwa to a wɔayɛ no foforo na hwɛ hu sɛ nsɛm no ne mprempren aduroyɛ mu ntease hyia. Botae: Nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so kwati atemmu anaa nhyɛso a ɛbɛma wɔahyia na wɔde nsɛm a ɛkari pɛ ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna mu basabasayɛ nya ankorankoro honam fam, nkate fam, ne adwene mu akwahosan, ne wɔn abusuabɔ, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne wɔn yiyedi nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu basabasayɛ nya honam fam, nkate fam, ne adwene mu akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no so, na ɛde nsunsuanso titiriw ba wɔn abusuabɔ, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne yiyedi nyinaa so. Wɔ nipadua mu no, wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no betumi apirapira, wɔanya nna mu nyarewa (STIs), ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da esiane nna mu basabasayɛ nti. Wɔ nkate ne adwene mu no, wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no betumi anya adwenemhaw, dadwen, adwenemhaw, adwenemhaw a ɛba wɔ ahodwiriw akyi (PTSD), ne aniwu, afobu, anaa asodi a wɔde to wɔn ho so. Nna mu basabasayɛ nso betumi asɛe wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no ne abusua, nnamfo, ne wɔn a wɔdɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho ntam abusuabɔ, na ɛde tew a wɔtew wɔn ho fi afoforo ho, ahotoso a wonni, na ɛyɛ den sɛ wobenya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den. Bio nso, wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no betumi adi apere wɔ obu a ɛba fam wɔ wɔn ho, nipadua ho mfonini ho nsɛm, ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ ahye a wɔhyɛ na wɔkamfo wɔn ahiade ahorow ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nkyerɛkyerɛ ne npaemu-ka dɛworo bɛtumi ate 'stigma' (aniwusɛm/ dɛm/ animguaseɛ/nnipa mu nyiyimu) so wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtumi te so denam: - Nkyerɛkyerɛ pa fa STIs (nna mu yareɛ) ne HIV ho de yi atoro ne adwene a emu ɛnda hɔ firi hɔ. - Ayɛsɛm ne nkurɔfoɔ abrabɔ mu nsɛm a yɛbɛte de anya nteaseɛ ama wɔn a wɔwɔ yareɛ no. - Kasa pa ne obu a yɛde bɛkasa fa sexual health (nna mu apomuden abrabɔ) ho. - Nhyiamu a yɛne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne awofoɔ bɛyɛ de akasa  fa nna mu pene ne emu twen ho. - Mmabun a yɛbɛma wɔadi anim de ako atia nyiyimu na wɔahyɛ apɔwmuden ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow a wɔfa so pene so, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ pene a wɔpene so no kɔ so ne ahosɛpɛ?
answer_twi_source: Anom Mpene: Bisa pei 'ask directly', "So wo ho ye wɔ eyi ho?" Mpene a Ɛnyɛ Anom: Nipadua mu kasa pa te sɛ serew, nsa a wɔde ka obi, anaa nea wɔde fi ase. Anigye: Hwehwɛ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ w’ani gye ho ankasa. Nkitahodi a Ɛkɔ So: Hwɛ mu wɔ nhyiam no nyinaa mu ne nsɛmmisa te sɛ "So eyi ye?" anaa "Wopɛ sɛ wotoa so?"
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan a obu wom bɛn na yebetumi afa so ne nnipa a wofi mmusua ahorow mu abɔ nna ho nkɔmmɔ?
answer_twi_source: Afotu a ɛbɛma woatumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ a obu wom ni: Fi ase de pene a wopene so: Bisa sɛ obi te nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no sɛ ɔbɛka nna ho asɛm ansa na woakɔ mu Fa w’adwene si nea wohyia so: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna yɛ ankorankoro osuahu, nanso obiara fata obu ne nkitahodie pa. Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho di dwuma: Kwati nsɛmfua a ɛfa no sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna pɔtee bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nna mu nneyɛe, pene a wɔpene so, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho mfonini ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no yɛ nokware na ɛyɛ nea asɛyɛde wom, anaasɛ ɛma anansesɛm, nsusuwii hunu, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira kɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu dwumadi, pene a wɔpene so, ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho mfonini ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ne asɛyɛde mu. Bere a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo binom bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ saa nsɛmti yi mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware na obu wom so no, afoforo betumi ama anansesɛm, nsusuwii hunu, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira akɔ so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa yɛ nna mu nkitahodi ho mfonini a wonni nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho dwuma anaasɛ wɔnyɛ akwanhwɛ a enni mu a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne sɛnea etu mpɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun di mfe pɔtee bi ansa na wɔanya nnwuma wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun no di mmabun a wɔadu mpanyin afe so ho dwuma, na mpɛn pii no wofi mmabunbere kosi mfe aduonu mfiase. Bere a ebia mfe a obi adi ho anohyeto a emu yɛ den nni hɔ no, ebia ankorankoro a wonni mfe a wɔadi yi mu da so ara nya nnwuma nanso ebia wobehu sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ nea ɛfata ayarefo nkumaa kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwahosan ho ahiade soronko ne nneɛma a ɛho hia ma mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ, fie, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmofra atɛntrenee nhyehyɛe mu, wɔte ase a wɔadi dɛm, anaasɛ wɔyɛ aborɔfo anaa mmusuakuw nketewa mufo ka ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no ma ɛne wɔn ahiade ahorow adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua na wɔyɛ mmerɛw no wɔ akwahosan ho ahiade soronko: Mmabun a wonni afie: Mmabun a wɔrehyia afie a wonni betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu esiane adan a ɛyɛ den, akwantu, ne sikasɛm a wonni nti. Nsiesiei ahorow a wɔayɛ ama nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ne akwahosan akuw a wɔde fa telefon so betumi de nnwuma aba nnipa dodow yi nkyɛn tee, na wɔadi wɔn ahiade ahorow a ehia ntɛm ara ho dwuma. Mmofra Atɛntrenee Nhyehyɛe: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmofra atɛntrenee nhyehyɛe mu no taa nya akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a wonnya nnii ho dwuma, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ka ho. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛka mmofra a wɔde wɔn gu afiase ho na wɔde nnwuma a edi mu ama bere a wɔayi wɔn afi afiase no betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ahwɛ nnipa yi. Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu esiane honam fam a wobetumi anya, nkitahodi mu nsɛnnennen, ne nyiyim nti. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie yɛ nea ɛka obiara ho, ɛma dabere ne mmoa na ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anya kwan pɛpɛɛpɛ. Abibifo anaa Mmusuakuw Kakraa: Mmabun a wɔyɛ aborɔfo anaa mmusuakuw nketewa mufo betumi ahyia amammerɛ ne kasa mu akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata kasa mu, a ɛnam mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi a ɛfa amammerɛ ho so de ma no betumi adi nnipa dodow yi ahiade ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo adi nkitaho de akamfo nsakrae a ɛbɛma pɛyɛ ne nnipa nyinaa abom wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo adi nkitaho denam ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, baguam atiefo a wɔbɛkɔ, ne wɔn ananmusifo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔda wɔn haw ahorow adi no so. Wobetumi nso ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim ne mpɔtam hɔ akuw ayɛ biako de ahyɛ wɔn nne mu den na wɔakamfo nsakrae a ɛbɛma pɛyɛ ne nnipa nyinaa abom wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahomatrofo anaa ahomatrofo mmoa a wɔde boa nkurɔfo bi a metumi ne wɔn adi nkitaho de anya kokoam nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo wɔ hɔ a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma. Ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ "Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana" (PPAG), "Marie stopes Hotline", ne "UNICEF Agoo SHE hotlines" a mmabun bɛtumi afrɛ anaa wɔde akyerɛ  nkrato akɔma akwankyerɛ, nsɛm, ne mmoa. Saa dwumadie yi yɛ kokoamsɛm, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛtumi asusu wo haw ho a wɔremfa wo ho nsɛm nkyerɛ afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene di wɔ amammerɛ ne abrabɔ pa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ne nkitahodie ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Obu a Wɔde Ma Ahofadi: Mpene a wɔde ma no fa obu a wɔde ma ankorankorɛ ahofadi ne hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ osi gyinae wɔ ne nipadua ho no ho. Amammerɛ mu Nsɛm: Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔpene so no betumi ayɛ soronko. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde pene a wɔde ma kwa, a wɔrenhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔrenhyɛ wɔn so. Abrabɔ Pa Nhyehyɛe: Mpene yɛ abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm titiri wɔ nna mu dwumadi ne nkitahodie mu, a ɛhwɛ hu sɛ afã horow no nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa pene a wɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ a me ne nnipa a ɛsono wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ ne wɔn bɔbeasu yɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene so kɔ so: Esiane sɛ wopenee biribi so pɛnkoro nti, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wopene so bio. Bu ahye: Yɛ aso ma wo hokafo no nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɔde ano ka ne nea ɔmfa kasa. "Dabi" kyerɛ dabi, a nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Nkitahodi yɛ ade titiriw: Ka w’akɔnnɔ, wo hye, ne w’awerɛkyekye dodow ho asɛm pefee. Fa w’adwene si anigyede so: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna yɛ anigye ma obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnipa dodow pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so,  sɛ mpɔtam hɔ fo de akwan a wɔde siw nna mu nyarewa "STI"ne "HIV"bɛtoa wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de wɔn ani asi nnipa dodow pɔtee bi anaa nnipa dodow bi a  nna mu nyarewa "STI", "HIV", anaa akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no ka wɔn wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmabun ne mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadu mpanyin afe so a ebia wonni nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a edi mũ. "LGBTQ+" ankorankoro a wohyia nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonya ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma mu. Abusuakuw ne mmusuakuw nketewa a wonya nna mu nyarewa "STI" ne "HIV" dodow a ɛkɔ soro esiane nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan nti. Nnipa a wɔrehyia afie a wonni, ohia, anaa adan tebea a entumi nnyina a ebia wobehyia akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde siw ano. Ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe a asiane kɛse wom mu, te sɛ nnubɔne a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu a wɔde di dwuma, nna ho adwuma a wɔde di gua, anaa nna mu ahokafo pii, a wobetumi anya mfaso afi nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so ne mmoa a wɔde ma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔyɛ mpɔtam asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi ahiade ne nsɛnnennen pɔtee a mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu hyia no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔayɛ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛdi ahiadeɛ ne nsɛnnennen pɔtee a mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu hyia no ho dwuma denam nneɛma te sɛ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn, kasa a wɔpɛ, asetena mu sikasɛm tebea, ne apɔwmuden ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya a wɔbɛsusu ho no so. Wobetumi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, sukuu ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ayɛ biako de ahu nsɛm atitiri na wɔayɛ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔfa so kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ. Dwumadi ahorow nso betumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn nneɛma ne nkrasɛm mu ma ɛne nnipa ahorow a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so no ahyia na wɔadi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ma akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho nka wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ma sɛ wɔmfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho nka wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam nhumu a wɔbɛma anya, wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow te sɛ dwumadi a wɔyɛ, mfoniniyɛ, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔte amammerɛ mu nsɛm ase a wɔbɛyɛ biako so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo di wɔ nsusuwii hunu ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe ho a wɔma ɛkɔ so tra hɔ no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya mmabun yiyedi so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa ma nsusuwii hunu ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe ho kɔ so tra hɔ wɔ   mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ animhwɛ anaasɛ ɛyɛ nwonwa so. Nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti te sɛ nna mu yare ( STI)  anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mfonini a ɛyɛ animtiaabu betumi de akwanside ahorow aba wɔ nsɛm ne nnwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, na ɛde akwahosan ho nneɛma bɔne aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sika a wɔde ma, nea broni frɛ no 'grants', ne 'bursaries', na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔn ho wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Sika mmoa a broni ka no 'Schorlarships': Sika mmoa a broni ka no 'Schorlarships' yɛ abasobɔde a egyina mmɔdenbɔ so a wɔde ma asuafo a egyina adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ, agumadi mu nkɔso, adwinni ho nimdeɛ, akannifo su, anaa gyinapɛn afoforo so. Ɛho nhia sɛ wotua wɔn ka. Mmoa: Mmoa yɛ sikasɛm mu abasobɔde a wɔde ma ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow de boa nnwuma pɔtee bi, nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaa nhomasua. Ebia egyina ahiade so anaasɛ egyina mfaso a ɛfata so na enhia sɛ wotua. Nea broni ka no 'Bursaries': 'Bursaries' yɛ sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma asuafo a egyina sikasɛm mu ahiade so, mpɛn pii no ɛboa ma wotua adesua, nhoma, anaa asetra mu ka. Nea ɛnte sɛ boseabɔ no, ɛho nhia sɛ wotua broni ka no ' bursaries'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ m’ankasa m’akwahosan ho nsɛm yɛ kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ bere a mede telefon so akwahosan ho nnwuma redi dwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ sɛ 'app' no yɛ 'secure'. Passwords a ɛyɛ den. Private Wi-Fi. Kasa fa kokoam-yɛ ho. Tena baabi a obiara nte wo nne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho atɛntrenee nhyehyɛe mu, te sɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wodi wɔn asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so, hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wotie wɔn, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wogyina mmara kwan so ananmu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no betumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow yi bere a wɔrekɔ mmara mu nsɛm a emu yɛ den mu no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho atɛntrenee nhyehyɛe mu no wɔ akwan ahorow, a nea ɛka ho a wɔwɔ sɛ wodi wɔn asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so, hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wotie wɔn asɛm, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wogyina mmara kwan so. Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no betumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow yi denam mmara mu nsɛm a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, adanse a wɔde bɛma, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa anaa mmaranimfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho nsɛm mu hɔ no so. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo mmara kyerɛ no betumi de mmara mu nnwuma a wontua hwee anaasɛ ne bo nyɛ den ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no, na aboa wɔn ma wɔafa mmara nhyehyɛe no mu nsɛm a emu yɛ den no mu na wɔakamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow ne wɔn yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ nyamesom ahyehyɛde7 ahorow, sukuu ahorow, atipɛnfo akuo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akuo ahorow boa ma mmabun te nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ase?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ nyamesom akuo ahorow, sukuu ahorow, atipɛnfo akuw, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di dwuma titiri wɔ ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no mu. Nyamesom akuokuo ahorow betumi de abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna ho ama, bere a sukuu ahorow betumi de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛsono ne kɛse ne emu nsɛm a egyina mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so ama. Atipɛnfo akuw ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow nso betumi anya mmabun gyidi ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛnyɛ kwan biara so, mmoa nkitahodi ahorow, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na sukuu ne dɔkotafoɔ bɛyɛ de ahyɛ STI/HIV bammɔ den?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbɛtumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ sukuu mu hɔ. Wɔbetumi de ahyɛ adesua mu so. Wɔbetumi ayɛ 'health fairs' ne workshops de atete akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne ahomatrofo a wɔde boa nkurɔfo yɛ kokoam nsɛm, na so mmabun betumi anya ahotoso sɛ wobebu wɔn kokoam nsɛm bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm: Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne ahomatrofo a wɔde boa nkurɔfo de kokoam nsɛm di kan, na mmabun betumi anya ahotoso sɛ wobedi wɔn kokoam nsɛm so bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no. Wɔde kokoamsɛm ho apam ne abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ kyekyere afotufo ne adwumayɛfo sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn a wɔfrɛ wɔn no kokoam nsɛm ho ban, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn nsɛm bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoamsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔfo mu no betumi aboa nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua na wonnya mmoa pii, a ɛhɔfo a wɔyɛ aborɔfo, ne mmabun a wɔte nkuraase anaa akyirikyiri ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no bɛtumi aboa nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wɔnsom wɔn yie denam: Nnipa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, ne wɔn a wɔbɛtumi anya bi a wɔde bedi kan wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛɛ, akwan a wɔfa so kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn, ne ɔsom a wɔde ma ho nhwɛsoɔ mu. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, mpɔtam akannifoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ fam a wɔwɔ nkitahodiɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dada ne nimdeɛ a wɔde som nnipa pɔtee bi, te sɛ aborɔfoɔ mpɔtam, ne mmabun a wɔwɔ nkuraase anaa akyirikyiri. Nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn, nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo a ɛdi akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no ahiadeɛ ne suahunu soronko ho dwuma, a nyiyim, animtiaabuo, ne asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma atenka mu nsɛnnennen a ɛbata nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no nyɛ nea ɛfata na fa nneɛma a wɔde boa ma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano no ma.
answer_twi_source: Atenka mu Nsɛnnennen: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobenya nkate ahorow bi bere a woatu nyinsɛn agu akyi, te sɛ awerɛhow, anaa ahotɔ. Akwan a Wofa so Gyina Ano: Sɛ wo ne ɔyaresafo,sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo kasa a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woadi wo atenka ho dwuma na woanya akwan a ɛfata a wobɛfa so agyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa animtiaabu a, wɔtaa nya wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ Ho Anansesɛm: Amammerɛ ahorow bi ma anansesɛm a ɛfa brayɛ ho fĩ anaa aniwu ho no kɔ so tra hɔ, na ɛno betumi ama wɔabɔ nkurɔfo animtiaa. Bɔbeasu Ho Nsusuwii 'gender stereotyprs': Ebia amammerɛ ahorow wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam dwumadi ahorow a ɛyɛ katee, te sɛ mmarimayɛ a wɔde bata 'stoicism' ho na wɔde ɔbeayɛ bata biribiara a wɔnyɛ ho hwee ho. Nna mu Kommyɛ: Animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔda no adi pefee ho no betumi ama wɔanya adwene a ɛnteɛ ne nhomasua a wonnya. Adwene a ɛnteɛ a wobedi ho dwuma: Nhomasua ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee betumi aboa ma wɔayi anansesɛm ne animtiaabu a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho afi hɔ. Amammerɛ mu Nkate: Hyɛ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho nkuran wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma mu de di gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho dwuma. Mpɔtam Nhomasua: Nhyiam ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkɔ so wɔ mpɔtam hɔ betumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu na ama ntease anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi ahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ wonnim sɛ wɔbɛbɔ tebea bi ho amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wonnim sɛ wɔbɛbɔ tebea bi ho amanneɛ no betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Wobetumi nso akɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔkasa ma wɔanya kokoam afotu ne mmoa a wɔde besisi gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wim tebea a ɛma atutra ne displacement nya nsunsuanso wɔ mmabun kawn a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne asetra mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow so, na nneɛma bɛn na ehia na wɔde adi akwansideɛ yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya: Wim tebea a ɛma wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne atutra betumi asɛe mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne asetra mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow, na ɛde mmerɛwyɛ ne akwahosan ho asiane ahorow a ɛkɔ soro aba. Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de adi saa akwansideɛ yi ho dwuma, te sɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔde fa telehealth so, dwumadie ahodoɔ a wɔbedi no wɔ mpɔtam, ne adwene ne nneyɛeɛ mu mmoa a wɔde bɛbrɛ nsunsuansoɔ bɔne a ɛfiri atutra mu ba wɔ ASRH so no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow nya nsunsuanso wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne awo nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Nsunsuanso: Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ ahyɛde anaa gyidi ahorow a emu yɛ den wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho. Adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ abusua kɛse, dwuma a mmarima ne mmea di, ne nna ho no betumi aka suban ahorow. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi bɛhyɛ mmusua akɛse nkuran na asɔre atia nyinsɛn ano a wosiw. Nyamesom Nkɛntɛnso: Ɛsono nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow kɛse na ebetumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma so nkɛntɛnso. Ɔsom ahorow bi wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ pɔtee a ɛfa abusua nhyehyɛe ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho. Ebia ɔsom akuw bi boa akwan bi so bere a wɔsɔre tia afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so anohyeto anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi a ɛwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ a ebetumi asiw nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom ano? (Mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne mfe a obi adi ho anohyeto ahorow a wɔbɛte ase)
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo, kasa kyerɛ apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo bi wɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru ho. nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ bi, frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn, Marie frɛ 0302242517.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ sɛ nna mu apɔmuden nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma fata amammerɛ na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ sɛ nneɛma no gyina hɔ ma mmusua ahodoɔ na amammerɛ gye tom. Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho di dwuma: Kwati kasa a emu yɛ den anaa kasa a nkurɔfoɔ bi nko ara na wɔka. Fa w'adwene si nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware so: Kyerɛ nna ne apɔmuden ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nyansahu mu, na ɛnyɛ amammerɛ mu adwene. Fa mfoni a ɛkyerɛ nnipa ahodoɔ: Fa nkurɔfoɔ a wofi mmeae ahodoɔ mfoni di dwuma. Fa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ka ho: Gye adwene fi mpɔtam hɔfoɔ hɔ de hwɛ sɛ nneɛma no fa ho na ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa frankaa kɔkɔɔ bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia tebea bi nnyɛ nea ahobammɔ wom anaasɛ ebetumi de nna mu basabasayɛ aba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ato wɔn nkate so na wɔatu anammɔn a edi kan de abɔ wɔn ho ne afoforo ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa frankaa kɔkɔɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia tebea bi nyɛ nea ahobammɔ wom anaasɛ ebetumi de nna mu basabasayɛ aba no bi ne: Nhyɛso anaa Nneɛma a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ wɔahyɛ no, wɔhyɛ no, anaasɛ wɔadan no ma ɔde ne ho ahyɛ nna mu a ɔmpɛ. Mpene a Wonnya: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu kyɛfa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa nnye pene a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ anigye. Ahyeɛ a Wobu So: Ankorankoro ahye a wobu ani gu so anaasɛ wobu wɔn ani gu so, sɛ́ ɛyɛ honam fam, nkate fam, anaa kasa mu. Intuition: Obi a ɔde ne ho to ne nkate anaa ne gut nkate so bere a biribi te nka sɛ ɛyɛ basaa anaasɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ wɔ tebea bi mu no. Nsa anaa Nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Sɛ obi bom nsa anaa nnubɔne, na ɛma obi ntumi mmu atɛn na ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ yɛ mmerɛw kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi atu de ama mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu akwaaba ?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ tebea a ɛma akwaaba na ɛka obiara ho denam: Ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu a wogye tom na ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ayarefo dodow no so. Nhomasua nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ kasa ne akwan horow pii mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobetumi anya bi. Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔfiri amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu a wɔbɛfa wɔn na wɔde amammerɛ ho nteteeɛ ama adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa. Amammerɛ mu nkate a wɔde bɛhyɛ ɔhwɛ afã horow nyinaa mu, a nkitahodie, ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe, ne gyinaesi ka ho. Mmeae a wɔbɛbɔ wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea no mu a ɛda mpɔtam hɔfo amammerɛ ahorow adi na ɛma ayarefo te nka sɛ wɔsom bo na wobu wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne nna ho no nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun nya no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne nna ho betumi aka SRH ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun nya. Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, pɛyɛ a enni mmarima ne mmea ntam no betumi asiw mmeawa kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ano, bere a atetesɛm mu adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ho no betumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa SRH nsɛmti ho no abam, na ɛde nimdeɛ ne nneɛma kakraa bi aba ama mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ́ ne ɔbabun a sebi wadi dɛm no, sɛ mihu sɛ manyinsɛn a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne ɔwofo, ɔpanyin a wogye no di, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa. Ɔhwɛ a Wɔde Ma Ansa na Wɔawo: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ntɛm na wɔyɛ no daa ansa na wɔawo no ho hia kɛse ma nyinsɛn a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden. Akuw a Wɔboa: Sɛ wo ne mmabun afoforo a wɔyem anaa awofo a sebi wɔadi dɛm bɛbɔ a, ebetumi aboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahotoso wɔ me ho de asi gyinae wɔ me nipadua, ne nna mu akɔnnɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Sua wo nipadua ho ade: Sɛ wote wo nipadua ase a, ɛma wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata. Fa botae ahorow sisi w’ani so: Fa w’adwene si nkɔso so, na ɛnyɛ pɛyɛ so. Di nea woatumi ayɛ ho afahyɛ: Fa wo ho hoahoa wo ho sɛ woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata. Fa hwɛ a wobɛhwɛ wo ho di dwuma: Yɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo wɔ nipadua ne atenka fam. Nya nneɛma a w’ani gye ho: Fa w’adwene si dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho na ɛma wonya obu ma wo ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wobenya awo akwahosan (SRH) ho hokwan ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun taa hyia akwansideɛ ahorow a ɛsiw wɔn kwan sɛ wɔbɛdi wɔn awoɔ mu apɔmuden hokwan so:Nnipa pii nnya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu na ebia wonnim akwan horow a wobetumi afa so.Atirimɔdensɛm: Nna ho adwemmɔne betumi asiw mmerante ne mmabaa kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaa nsɛm.Mmabun Mmoa a Enni Hɔ: Ebia apɔmuden mmoa no nyɛ deɛ wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiadeɛ, a kɔkoamunsɛm a enni hɔ, adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔmmu ade, anaa bere a ɛnyɛ na ɛka ho, ne tebea a ɛmmoa.Mmara bi siw nyinsɛn ano anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu a wonnya awofo pene. Amammerɛ anaa gyidie tumi siw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛsi wɔn ankasa nipadua ho gyinaeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wɔde afotu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhaw mu no yɛ nea wontua hwee, anaasɛ so anaa sika bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata afotu nhyiam ahorow ho, na sɛ ɛho hia a, ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abisa sikasɛm mu mmoa anaa insurance a wɔde tua ho ka ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma Ho Ka: Wɔtaa de afotu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhaw mu no di dwuma kwa a, na wontua sika anaasɛ wontua sika biara wɔ afotu nhyiam ahorow ho. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ mmabun bisa sikasɛm mu mmoa anaa insurance a wɔde tua ho ka ho asɛm sɛ ɛho hia a, efisɛ ebia nnwuma titiriw bi anaa ɔhwɛ a wɔde di akyi no wɔ ɛka a ɛbata ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Awannya ne ahobammɔ bɛn na wɔde ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ankasa hokwan ahorow ne yiyedi akyi wɔ amanneɛbɔ ne ahotɔ nhyehyɛe no nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no wɔ akwannya ne ahobammɔ a wɔde ma wɔn wɔ mmara no ase, a akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie, ayaresa, afotu, ne mmara kwan so mmoa ka ho. Mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ankasa hokwan ne yiyedi wɔ amanneɛbɔ ne ahotɔ nhyehyɛe no nyinaa mu denam hokwan ahorow yi a wobehu, nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ hɔ, ne sɛ wɔanni wɔn hokwan ahorow so a wɔbɛkasa so. Bio nso, wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma mmoa adwuma atu mpɔn, ama nkurɔfo ate ase, na wɔabu ahyehyɛde ahorow ho akontaa wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wobedi ho dwuma yiye ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ yɛn abusua no adwene wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Yɛn abusua no amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi betumi anya sɛnea yɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho dwuma no so nkɛntɛnso. Saa gyidi ahorow yi betumi akyerɛ yɛn adwene wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ nna a edi aware anim, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho. Ɛho hia sɛ yegye tom na yɛbu saa amammerɛ ne nyamesom adwene yi bere a yɛsan nso hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ bɛn na ɛsɛsɛ mmabun di akyi bere a wɔne afoforo redi nkitaho wɔ Intanɛt so, titiriw wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mu no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun ne afoforo redi nkitaho wɔ Intanɛt so, titiriw wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Bu afoforo kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn ahye denam wɔn ho a wɔbɛkwati sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm anaa nsɛm a ɛho hia a wɔmpene so no so. Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho, ɛnyɛ atɛn, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma adwene ne osuahu ahorow di dwuma. Kwati sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ebetumi apira afoforo anaa abɔ hu te sɛ kɔmputa so ayayade,ahurohuro a broni ka no 'trolling', anaa ayayade mu. Susuw nsusuaso a wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn nneyɛe betumi anya wɔ afoforo yiyedi ne wɔn adwene mu akwahosan so no ho. Hwehwɛ pene ansa na woasusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho anaasɛ woakyɛ nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee, na hwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn na ahobammɔ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me hokafo asusu nyinsɛn ano aduro ho pefee na madi nokware?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a emu da hɔ na efi nokwaredi mu, a wo ne wo hokafoɔ bɛbɔ no yɛ ade titiri a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosi ho. Afotu bi ni: Paw bere ne baabi a wo ho bɛtɔ wo a wobɛkasa. Kyerɛkyerɛ nea w’ankasa wopɛ, awo akwahosan botae ahorow ne nea ɛhaw wo wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho mu. Tie nea wo hokafo (hokafo) pɛ ne nea ɛhaw wo no denneennen. Mommɔ mu nyɛ adwuma hwehwɛ ɔkwan a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma ama obiara. Monnya obu mma mo ho mo ho ahye ne ahotɔ dodow. Kae: Nkitahodi yɛ ade titiri wɔ abusuabɔ pa biara mu, a nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a en taasi sɛ obi adwene bɛsakra bere a woadu mpanyin afe so?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaai si koraa sɛ wubenya adwene a ɛsakra bere a woadu mpanyin afe so no. Hormone ahorow te sɛ estrogen ne testosterone resakra kɛse wɔ saa bere yi mu, na ebetumi aka sɛnea wote nka. Ebia w’ani begye bere bi na afei mpofirim ara woadi awerɛhow anaasɛ wo bo afuw. Eyi nyinaa yɛ wo nipadua no fã a ɛreyɛ nsakrae wɔ nsakrae ahorow yi mu. Ɛho hia sɛ woka obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso (a awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne atipɛnfo afotufo ka ho) kasa fa sɛnea wote nka ho. Wubetumi nso de wo ho ahyɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ akenkan, turoyɛ, nnwom a wotie, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, aduannoa mu de aboa ma woadi wo nkate a ɛsakra no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ mesan yɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu wɔ nna mu ɔhokafo foforo biara akyi?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho nhia sɛ wosan sɔ wo hwɛ wɔ nna mu ɔhokafo foforo biara akyi. Nanso, ɛyɛ papa sɛ wobɛsɔ wo ahwɛ: Ansa na wobɛhyɛn abusuabɔ foforo mu: Susuw ho sɛ wo ne wo hokafo foforo no bɛbom asɔ ahwɛ ansa na woanya nna mu kyɛfa. Sɛ wohu STI ho sɛnkyerɛnne biara a: Kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ayaresabea hɔ ma wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Sɛ wo hokafo no hu sɛ ɔwɔ STI a: Ɛho behia sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu hwɛ sɛ wo nso wo nyaa bi anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nyamesom mu gyedie ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ka nna ne awoɔ ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Abstinence (sɛɛ yɛbɛtwe yɛn ho efi nna ho). Family Planning (abusua nhyehyɛeɛ). Modesty (ataadeɛ krɔn a yɛbɛhyɛ). Values (obu/ɔdɔ).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ obu ama obi foforo amammerɛ bere a meredi nna ho nkitahodie?
answer_twi_source: Tie no denneennen: Ma nkurɔfo nka wɔn adwene a wonni atɛn. Twe woho firi nsusuwii hunu ho: Obiara yɛ ankorankoro, na ɛnyɛ amammerɛ mu asɛm kayɛ kɛkɛ. Bisa nsɛm a emu da hɔ: Kyerɛ anigye ankasa sɛ wobɛte ase. Bu ahye: Sɛ ɛte sɛ nea obi ho nyɛ no dɛ a, gyae nkɔmmɔbɔ no. Hu nsɛmfua a wogye tom wɔ amammerɛ mu yiye
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw a ɛho hia a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, te sɛ nkitahodi, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne kuo adwumayɛ, na ama wɔadi yie wɔ nhomasua ne adwumayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsano dwoma nimdeɛ te sɛ nkitahodi, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne kuo adwumayɛ denam osuahu ne dwumadi ahorow so. Kuo mu nnwuma, dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi, atuhoama adwuma, adwumayɛ a wɔde sua adwuma, betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya saa nimdeɛ yi. Bio nso, STEM ntetee nhyehyeɛ taa de module anaa adwumayɛbea a wɔde wɔn adwene si soft skills a ɛho hia ma nkonimdie wɔ adwumayɛbea a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ so ka ho. Atipɛnfo adesua, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde di dwuma, ne akwan a wɔfa so ma mmuae betumi ama mmabun tumi a wɔde saa nimdeɛ yi bedi dwuma wɔ nhomasua ne adwumayɛ mu no ayɛ kɛse bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na dawurubɔ ho adesua betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔahu na wɔadi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ na ɛfata so wɔ nna ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a ɛboa nkurɔfoɔ a wɔnni nipadua mu ahoɔden ne wɔn a wɔboa wɔn no hyɛ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔnni nipadua mu ahoɔden no ma wɔn mmarima ne mmaa ahoɔden ho adwuma mu den, denam ahyɛdeɛ a ɛboa nkurɔfoɔ, nsakraeɛ a ɛbɛba mmara mu, nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri fa mmara ne mmoa ho asɛm, ne kuo a ɛboa mmabun a wɔnni nipadua mu ahoɔden no ma wɔn ho akokwaw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfiridwuma nea broni ka no 'innovative technologies' ne akwan foforo bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ama wɔ mmeae a wim tebea aka no?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mfiridwuma nea broni ka no 'innovative technologies' ne akwan foforo, te sɛ akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa telefon so, aduruyɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde ma wɔ mfiri a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ne akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so, adi dwuma de SRH nnwuma ama wɔ mmeae a wim tebea aka a ebia akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no bɛhaw anaasɛ wontumi nkɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na wobetumi ayɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no di mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma, a nea ɛfa nkitahodi, akwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ, ne dabere ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ no di mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiadeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ ho dwuma no bi ne: Nneɛma a wɔbɛtumi anya: Wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ ASRH ho nsɛm ne dwumadie no bɛtumi ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm denam dabere te sɛ nsano kasa nkyerɛaseɛ, akwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ, ne mfiri a wɔde boa a wɔde bɛma so. Nkitahodi a ɛka obiara ho: Sɛ wɔde kasa a ɛka obiara ho ne nkitahodi akwan a ɛfa nkitahodi ahiade ahorow ne nea mmabun a wɔadi dɛm pɛ di dwuma a, ɛma ntease ne wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Tumi a wɔde ma ne nea wɔde yɛ adwuma: Sɛ wɔma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho denam nsɛm, mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn so a, ɛma wonya ahofadi ne ahofadi. Nkitahodi a wɔne mmubuafo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ: Wɔne mmubuafo ahyehyɛde ahorow ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɔnkofa hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no nimdeɛ ne osuahu ahorow bɛma ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no ahu na wɔadi wɔn ahiade soronko ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi de akwan pa a wɔfa so hyɛ mu den adi dwuma de aboa m’atipɛnfo ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho, te sɛ nkamfo a mede bɛma wɔ nneɛma a ɛfata a wɔpaw ho, nkate fam mmoa a mede bɛma wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu, ne obu ne tema amammerɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ m’asetra mu kuo no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan pa a wɔfa so hyɛ mu den a wode bedi dwuma de aboa w’atipɛnfo ma wɔasisi gyinae a ntease wom na ɛyɛ asɛyɛde wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no hwehwɛ sɛ: Kamfo a wode bɛma wɔ nneɛma a ɛfata a wɔpaw ho: Gye w’atipɛnfo tom na si so dua sɛ wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna mu apomoden ho, te sɛ nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde di dwuma, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano a wobenya, anaasɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ. Nkate mu mmoa a wode bɛma: Fa tema, ntease, ne atie a ɛnyɛ atemmu ma atipɛnfo a wohyia nsɛnnennen anaa adwenem naayɛ a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho, na ama tebea a ɛboa a wɔbɛte nka sɛ wɔate wɔn na wɔsom bo. Obu ne tema amammerɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, obu ma mo ho mo ho, ne tema ho nkuran wɔ mo asetra mu kuo no mu, na hyɛ atipɛnfo nkuran sɛ wɔmmoa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ paw a wɔde wɔn apomoden, yiyedi, ne ahofadi di kan no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
