question_twi_source: Sɛ me ne obi da a ɔmmɔ me ho ban anaasɛ minya nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne obi da a wommɔ wo ho ban anaasɛ wunya nyinsɛn ano aduru a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye a, susuw anammɔn a edidi so yi ho: Fa nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ sɛ ɛfata na ɛwɔ hɔ a, di akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama no akyi.hwehwe aduruyɛ mu afotuo ntɛm ara de nsusu hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔsiw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nyinsɛn a ɛbɛtumi aba. di wo ho so na wohwehwe mmoa firi ankorankoro a wogye wo di, te se akwahosan ho dwumadie, fotufoɔ, anaa ɔpanin a wogye no di, de di nkateɛ anaa adwene mu haw biara ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔkwan bɛn so na beae a ahobammɔ wɔ betumi aboa mmebun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Sua sɛdeɛ yɛkasa ma yɛho  (Self-Advocacy). Wɔko tia adwene bɔne. Wɔhwehwɛ nsakraeɛ. Hyehyɛ mmoa kuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe, atetesɛm, ne gyidi bɛn na ɛboa ma mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ ne tumi a ɛnkari pɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ adwuma de akasa atia na wɔasesa saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe, atetesɛm, ne gyidi ahorow taa boa ma mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ ne tumi a ɛnkari pɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi betumi akyerɛ mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ a emu yɛ den, na ɛto hokwan ne ahofadi a ankorankoro wɔ a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu so no ano hye. Mmabun betumi ayɛ adwuma de akasa atia na wɔasesa saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi denam mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ne atetesɛm mu gyidi ahorow a wɔbɛkasa atia denam nhomasua, nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so. Ɛdenam ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ahu, nhyiam horow, ne mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ so no, mmabun betumi ama nkurɔfo ate nneɛma bɔne a nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so de ba no ase na wɔakasa afa nneyɛe a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛyɛ pɛ akyerɛ. Wobetumi nso de nhwɛso adi anim denam mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛkasa atia wɔ wɔn ankasa nneyɛe ne abusuabɔ mu, obu ne pɛyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ atipɛnfo mu, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔboa ma ankorankoro a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa tumi no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan foforo ne nneyɛe pa a wɔfa so de mmabun hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano, te sɛ atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, kuro ntentan dawurubɔ ɔsatu ahorow, ne adebɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan foforɔ ne nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔfa so de mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano mu no bi ne: - Atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtete mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ma wɔsom sɛ atipɛnfoɔ akannifoɔ na wɔkasa ama abusuabɔ pa ne pene amammerɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. - dawurubɔ kuro ntetan ɔsatuo ne abɛɛfo ntetan abasɛm a wɔka ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde intanɛt so akwan di dwuma de ma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ, kasa tia nsusuwii hunu, na ɛhyɛ nkrasɛm pa a ɛfa pene ne obuo ho nkuran. - adebɔ adwini adwuma, te sɛ agoprama so dwumadi, nsɛmfua a wɔka, ne adwinni a wɔde aniwa hu, a ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa nya hokwan da wɔn adwene adi, kyɛ wɔn suahu, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano mu. - nhwehwɛmu a mmabun di anim ne adeyɛ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔhunu mpɔtam hɔ ahiadeɛ, yɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw ano, na ɛkamfo nsakraeɛ a wɔne mpaninfoɔ ayɔnkofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no bom yɛ. Sukuu mu nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ka adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw, dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi, ne sukuu nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, na ɛde mmɔdenbɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛkɔ so daa ba sɛ wɔbɛma abusuabɔ pa anya nkɔso na wɔasiw basabasayɛ ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside ahorow bi a ɛtaa siw nkitahodi a etu mpɔn a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi so nkonim?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow a ɛtaa siw nkitahodi a etu mpɔn a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no bi ne animtiaabu, aniwu, suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu no atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛpow, ne nimdeɛ anaa nsɛmfua a onni a ɔde bɛda n’adwene adi. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubedi akwanside ahorow yi so no, yɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn ma nkɔmmɔbɔ, kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, de atie a ɛyɛ nnam ne tema di dwuma, na hwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa nneɛma a wogye wɔn di hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ obi fata sɛ ɔkyerɛw ne din wɔ akwahosan ho insurance mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wodu saa ahwehwɛde ahorow yi ho?
answer_twi_source: Mfe a wɔhwehwɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun du mfe a wɔadi a akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow akyerɛ no ho, na ebetumi ayɛ soronko a egyina insurance nhyehyɛe ko ne mpɔtam hɔ mmara ahorow so. Sika a wonya: Akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow bi de sika a wonya so di dwuma, na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea obi fata ma sika a wɔde tua ho ka anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa a egyina ofie sika dodow a wɔde toto ɔman no ohia ho akwankyerɛ ahorow ho. Ɔman ba tebea: Ebia wɔbɛfata ama ɔmanfo insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow bi ama U.S. ɔman mma, wɔn a wɔte hɔ daa wɔ mmara kwan so, anaa atubrafo a wɔfata a wodu ahwehwɛde pɔtee bi a ɛfa tenabea ne nkrataa ho nkutoo. Nneɛma afoforo a ɛma obi fata: Nneɛma foforo a ɛbɛma obi afata no betumi ayɛ tenabea tebea, nhomasua anaa adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi a ɔde ne din hyɛ mu, awofo tebea, dɛmdi tebea, anaa asraafo a obi wɔ, a egyina nhyehyɛe no mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka akwan pa a wɔfa so gyina adwennwen, dadwen, ne nkate mu nsakrae ano ho asɛm.
answer_twi_source: Akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina adwennwen, dadwen, ne nkate mu nsakrae ano ni: Akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome: Yɛ apɔmutene a emu dɔ a afa home a worehome, dwennwen nneɛma ho, anaa yoga. Journaling: Kyerɛw wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate ahorow to hɔ na ama woadi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so. Wo ne Obi a Wogye No Di Nkasa: Sɛ woka wo haw ahorow kyerɛ w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, ɔyaresafo, anaa ɔfotufo a ɔboa wo a, ebetumi aboa no kɛse. Wo Ho Hwɛ: Gye bere ma dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, te sɛ nnwom a wubetie, aguare a wode w’ahome, anaa bere a wode bɛtra abɔde mu. Su a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Di nna ho nhyehyɛe a wodi daa, di aduan pa, na teɛteɛ w’apɔw mu daa (sɛnea wo duruyɛfo apene so no).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na "hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom" ase kyerɛ ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ wom na ɛyɛ papa no kyerɛ sɛ mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔyɛ abusuabɔ, a basabasayɛ, nhyɛso, ne ɔhaw biara nni ho. Nea ɛka ho ne abusuabɔ a ɛda nsow ne obu, ahotoso, nkitahodi, ne pene a wɔpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma anaa akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wubesua pii afa nipadua no ahofadi ne sɛnea wɔbɔ ho ban ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhoma te sɛ (My Body Belongs to Me)"Me Nipadua Yɛ Me Dea" a Jill Starishevsky kyerɛwee anaa "Wo Nipadua Yɛ Wo Dea" a Cornelia Spelman kyerɛwee no betumi ama nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a obi adi afa nipadua ahofadi ne ahye ho. Abɛɛfo ntentan sɛ KidsHealth.org anaa Planned Parenthood "Teen Talk" de nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa nipadua ahofadi ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho ma. Nsɛm a wo ne wo nnamfo anaa w’abusua mufo di agoru no betumi aboa wo ma woasua nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den ne ahye a wɔde si hɔ ho nimdeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi akasa na amansan anya mmoa ne nneɛma pa ama nnipa akuo bi a wɔhia mmoa titiriw?(wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔne wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe no adi nkitaho)
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛtumi apia ama wɔanya nneɛma pa ne sɛ: Ma nkurɔfo nhu: Wo ne nnamfo, mfɛfo sukuufo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo nkasa fa hia a ehia sɛ wɔboa wɔn a wɔanya GBV no mu pii, titiriw wɔ mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu. Di Mmarahyɛfoɔ a Wɔyɛ Nkitahodiɛ: Twerɛ nkrataa, email, anaa kɔ baguam nhyiamu ko ma nhyehyɛɛ a ɛbɛma obiara anya mmoa dwumadie atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ a ɛkyerɛ akwan a mmabun bɛtumi afa so de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu nam adwene a wɔde bɛma wɔ ahiade nhwehwɛmu mu, nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ, ne som a wɔbɛsom wɔ afotu bagua anaa mmabun agyinatukuw ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan so no so. Wobetumi nso de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkamfo nkurɔfo de anya nhyehyɛe, mmara, ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma a ɛho hia a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne amanaman ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma bi?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: Atosɛm: Nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma obi mu duru yɛ kɛse bere nyinaa. Nokwasɛm: Ɛnyɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano nyinaa na ɛma obi mu duru yɛ kɛse; ɛsono ankorankoro biara. Atosɛm: Nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wode bedi dwuma no betumi ama woatumi awo. Nokwasɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano dodow no ara nnya awo so nkɛntɛnso bere a wɔagyae pɛnkoro no. Address: Nhomasua: Fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a efi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), ne PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) betumi aboa wo ma woanya nsɛm a ɛma nhumu. Hwɛ Akwahosan Ho Dwumadifoɔ ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ nsusu nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo anaa nsɛmmisa biara ho na woanya nsɛm a ɛteɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa me nnamfo anaa mfɛfo a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnamfo anaa atipɛnfo a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ mu a wɔbɛboa wɔn no hwehwɛ sɛ: Tie a worensusuw ho na wɔama wɔanya baabi a ahobammɔ ne mmoa a wɔde bɛda wɔn adwene adi. Wɔn kokoam nsɛm a wobu na wɔrenhyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnda nneɛma pii adi nsen sɛnea wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ. Wo ho a wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne mmoa dwumadie ho no ma wonya mmoa a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ. Kamfo a wobɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ obiara bɛka nnipa nyinaa abom na wɔagye wɔn atom wɔ wo sukuu, mpɔtam, ne asetra mu akuw mu de ayɛ mmeae a ɛma mmabun nyinaa akwaaba
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a atwam a ɛfa asetra mu dwumadi ahorow anaa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛfa mmebun nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa asetena mu dwumadie akuo anaa ɔsatuo a atwam a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) ho no bi ne: sista’ club initiative, YAM Action Movement,  Awoɔ ho atɛntrenee kuo, a ɛkamfo hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔwo mma, ɔnwo mma, ne ɔwofoɔ wɔ mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ ne mmoa. Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wobenya mu wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, te sɛ "ma Obiara" ɔsatu ahorow no. Nkabom ahorow a wɔde bɛbu nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho animtiaa na wɔakamfo awo hokwan ahorow. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bedi basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene ho ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mpanyimfoɔ bɛboa mmabun a wɔrekɔ ayayaade mu 'bullying'?
answer_twi_source: Ma bammɔ. Fa asɛm no anibere so 'serious'. Ma natenka mu mmoa. Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ boa bammɔ. Kyerɛ nkabomyɔ ne asomdwoe abrabɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so di nkitaho na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amannebɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodie ne kyɛfa a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi ayɛ kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, dwumadi a wɔde di dwuma, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow a mmabun hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu yiye na wɔpaapae mu. Nnwuma a wɔde nsa yɛ, te sɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛyɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho nkuran nso betumi ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ wiase ankasa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so nkɛntɛnso a nnwuma a mmabun di anim, te sɛ adwumayɛ, ahonyade a wonya, mpɔtam hɔ nkɔso, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa, ne nnwumakuw asetra mu asɛyɛde?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a mmabun di anim no betumi anya asetra ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adwumayɛ ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso: Adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma, sika a wobenya, ne ahonyade a wɔbɛboaboa ano ama mmabun ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo, a ɛboa ma ohia so tew na sikasɛm mu nkɔso. Mpɔtam nkɔsoɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ sikasɛm, nnwuma, ne asetena mu kapital a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den denam sika a wɔde bɛto nwomasua, akwahosan, ne ɔman nnwuma mu, a ɛbɛma asetena mu biakoyɛ ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa: Nneyɛe a ɛmma nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ahoɔden a wɔyɛ no foforo ano aduru, ne mfiridwuma a ɛmma nneɛma nsɛe pii wɔ adwumayɛ mu, a ɛbɛtew nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so na wɔatew wim nsakrae nkɛntɛnso ase. Nnwumakuw asetena mu asɛdeɛ: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwumayɛ mu asɛdeɛ a ɛfa asetena mu, nneɛma a wɔde ma a ɛyɛ abrabɔ pa, ne mpɔtam hɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi asetena, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ne nnisoɔ nsɛnnennen ho dwuma, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔsoɔ botaeɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mede m'ahoɔfɛ, m'abrabɔ, ne nea mepɛ sɛ meyɛ si eni kani a, mɛyɛ dɛn ahu abusua nhyehyɛe kwan a ɛfata me?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wosusuw Ho: Akwahosan: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusuw ho mfa nsusuw akwahosan tebea anaa nnuru biara ho. Asetra kwan: Susuw mpɛn dodow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu, sɛnea wɔde ɔkwan no di dwuma daa, ne sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma no ho. Nea wɔpɛ: Ankorankoro ahotɔ dodow a ɛwɔ akwan horow so (sɛ nhwɛso no, hormone vs. non-hormonal).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde mma ansa na wɔawo no ho hia dɛn wɔ nyinsɛn mu asiane ahorow a, wɔbɛtew so no mu? (ɛho hia paa) .
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde mma ansa na wɔawo no ho hia kɛse wɔ nyinsɛn mu asiane ahorow a wɔbɛtew so no mu. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ma w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no hu ɔhaw ahorow a ebetumi aba na odi ho dwuma ntɛm, na ɛma nea efi mu ba no tu mpɔn kɛse ma wo ne wo ba no nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ obi bɛkɔ afirikyirikɔ mu yaw na mɛyɛ dɛn adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛtaa ba paa sɛ obi benya mfikyirikɔ mu yaw 'period cramps', a wɔsan frɛ no 'dysmenorrhea'. Nea ɛde ɔyaw no ba ne awotwaa no a ɛtwetwe ma ɛboa ma ne ntini no hwie gu. Akwan bi a wobɛfa so adi bere mu akisikuru ho dwuma ni: Ɔhyew: Sɛ wode ɔhyew a wɔde hyɛ wo yafunu ase anaa nsu a ɛyɛ hyew toa mu a, ebetumi aboa ma ntini ahorow no adwo na ɛyaw no so atew. Nnuru a wɔde ma ɛyaw a wɔtɔn: Nnuru te sɛ ibuprofen anaa naproxen betumi aboa ma akisikuru no so atew. Di akwankyerɛ a ɛwɔ krataa no so no akyi bere nyinaa na wo ne ɔwofo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa ansa na woanom aduru biara. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ brɛoo te sɛ nantew, yoga, anaa ntrɛwmu betumi aboa ma akisikuru so atew na ama obi adwene atu mpɔn. Akwan a Wofa so Gye Ahome: Ahomegye a emu dɔ, adwennwen, anaa aguare a ɛyɛ hyew betumi aboa ma wo nipadua no adwo na ama akisikuru no so atew. Aduan a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Sɛ wudi aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, ne aburow pii wom a, ebetumi aboa ma woadi akisikuru so. Kwati kɔfe efisɛ ebetumi ama akisikuru no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a, wɔaka abom de abɔ wɔn ho ban abien? (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm + nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wɔaka abom a agye din na etu mpɔn ni: Kɔdɔm ne Nnuru a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ano (Condom + Birth Control Pills): Eyi yɛ combo a wotumi de ho to so yiye a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STI) ahorow bi ano. "Kɔndɔm + IUD/Implant": Saa akwan a ɛkyɛ yi ma nyinsɛn ho ahobammɔ a eye kyɛn so, na kɔndɔm ma nna mu nyarewa (STI) ahobammɔ foforo. "Spermicide + Barrier Methods" (diaphragm, cervical cap): "Spermicide" yɛ "spermicidal" gel anaa foam a wobetumi de adi dwuma ne akwanside akwan de abɔ nyinsɛn ho banbɔ foforo. Nanso, ɛmmɔ obi ho ban mfi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi akyerɛkyerɛ gyinaesi ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun taa de di dwuma, te sɛ gyinaesi a ntease wom, suban ho gyinaesi nhwɛso, anaa asetra mu gyinaesi nhwɛso mu, ne sɛnea ɛfa asetra mu tebea horow  ho?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun taa de di dwuma no bi ne: Gyinaesi nhyehyɛe a ntease wom: Saa nhwɛso yi si nsɛm a ɛfata a wɔbɛboaboa ano, akari mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔkwan biara so, na wɔapaw ɔkwan foforo a ɛma mfaso kɛse ne asiane ahorow so tew so dua. Egyina nsusuwii a ntease wom ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔhyɛ da yɛ so. Suban ho gyinaesi nhwɛso: Saa nhwɛso yi gye nkɛntɛnso a nkate, awosu, ne asetra mu nneɛma nya wɔ gyinaesi so tom. Egye tom sɛ ebia ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na ankorankoro paw nneɛma a ntease wom katee na ɛde nkate ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow bi ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho. Asetra mu gyinaesi nhyehyɛe: Saa nhwɛso yi twe adwene si sɛnea asetra mu nkɛntɛnso te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, abusua mu nkɔso, ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow hyehyɛ gyinaesi so. Ɛsi nsunsuanso a obi paw nya wɔ afoforo so ne asetra mu tebea a ɛtrɛw no a wobesusuw so dua. Wobetumi de saa nhwɛso ahorow yi adi dwuma wɔ asetra mu tebea horow ankasa a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu nneyɛe ho denam mmabun a wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔn kwan wɔ nhyehyɛe bi a wɔde bɛsɔ nneɛma a wobetumi apaw mu, asusuw nea ebetumi afi mu aba ho, ne nneɛma a wɔpaw a wɔde wɔn yiyedi ne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow di kan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nhomasua a ahoɔden wom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran)
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛkasa atia nneɛma bɔne a ɛfa nna ne awo ho ni: Hyɛ Nhomasua ho nkuran: Kamfo nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ nea broni ka no 'Planned Parenthood' anaa 'National Sexual Health Resource Center' kyerɛ. Fa Nhwɛso Di Anim: Da w’adwene adi wɔ obu ne nokwasɛm mu. Fa w’adwene si Nsakrae Pa so: Twe adwene si sɛnea ASRH nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya no so ba obiara so mfaso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa sɛ wɔte nka sɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfo anaa afoforo abu hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nipadua mu ahofadi no so a?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa sɛ wogye di sɛ wɔabu hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wodi wɔn ho so wɔ nipadua mu no so a. Wobetumi ne mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow asusuw ho, ahwehwɛ afotu afi mmaranimfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ apomoden ho mmara mu, anaasɛ wɔabɔ mmara so bu ho amanneɛ akyerɛ mmarahyɛ bagua anaa atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ne nhyɛso a ɛfa nneyɛe ne abusuabɔ a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di nsusuw amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ne sɛnea ɛne ankorankoro gyidi ahorow hyia ho. Hwehwɛ sɛnea wobɛkari pɛ wɔ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a wubedi ne paw a wubenya nimdeɛ, a ɛyɛ nea ɔpɛ wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne abusuabɔ ho no ntam. Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho sɛ wode nimdeɛ ne nkate bɛfa tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de (NGOs), ne amanaman ntam nnwumakuw ne fekubɔ betumi ahyɛ SRH nnwuma ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ntawantawa ne ntawantawadi akyi tebea horow mu no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔdi: Aban, NGO, ne amanaman ntam nnwumakuo ntam nkitahodiɛ bɛtumi ama nkitahodiɛ, nneɛma a wɔboaboa ano, ne dwumadie a wɔde ma mmabun SRH wɔ ntawntawdie ne ntawntawdie akyi tebea mu no ayɛ yie. Tumi a wde bhy mu: Sika a wde bhy ntetee ne tumi a wde bhy mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛfo mu no hyɛ SRH dwumadie ne mmoa a wɔde ma no mu den, hwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ amammerɛ mu nkateɛ, ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho, na ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ho. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom bɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban no betumi ama wɔate hia a mmabun SRH ho hia wɔ nnipa mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ntawntawdi ho no mu, akamfo sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, nhyehyɛe mmoa, ne nhyehyɛe mu adwene a wɔde besi mmabun ahiade pɔtee ne hokwan ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma ma nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ kokoam afotuo dwumadie a ɛbɛtumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama denam nsakraeɛ yi so.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wode bɛyɛ kokoam afotuo ni: Wo ne w’apɔwmuden sohwɛfoɔ nkasa wɔ apɔwmuden adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ. Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG Helpline): 0244312151 (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, 8am-5pm). Wɔde kokoam afotu ma na wobetumi ne oduruyɛfo bi abɔ (egyina sɛnea ɛwɔ hɔ so). Ghana Psychological Association: https://gpaghana.org/ Wɔn wɛbsaet no wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a ebia wɔde kokoam afotuo dwumadie bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ntetee ne adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ hokwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔde bɛma wɔn tumi a wɔde bɛma nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛboa obiara ho no ayɛ kɛseɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nteteeɛ ne adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ hokwan ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔn tumi a wɔde bɛma nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho no ayɛ kɛseɛ. Ebia eyinom bi ne adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, adesua ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so, ne adansedi nkrataa a nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfasoɔ wɔ so, ne aban nnwumaku de ma. Ntetee nhyehyɛe taa fa nsɛmti te sɛ adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneyɛe a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, ne nkitahodi akwan a etu mpɔn ho yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔkwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de wɔn nneɛma a ɛho hia, nea ɛhaw wɔn, ne nyansahyɛ ahorow akyerɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ne wɔn a wosi gyinae yiye?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne adanseɛ: Mmabun tumi boaboa nsɛm, nhwehwɛmu nokwasɛm, ne akontabuo ano de foa wɔn akyinnyegyeɛ ne nyansahyɛ ahodoɔ so, na ɛma wɔn nkitahodiɛ adanseɛ gyina,ɛyɛ nea ɛkanyan adwene na ɛyɛ nea wotumi gye di. Asɛm a wɔka: Ankorankoro nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ no betumi ama nsɛm ayɛ nnipa na ama wɔayɛ nea ɛfa nhyehyɛeyɛfo ho, na ama wɔanya tema ne ntease. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Sɛ wɔne atipɛnfo, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne abenfo bɛyɛ adwuma abom a, ebetumi ama mmabun nne ayɛ kɛse na ahyɛ wɔn mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn no mu den, na ada biakoyɛ ne mmoa a wɔbom boa ma wɔn nneɛma a ɛho hia ne nea ɛhaw wɔn adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnuro bɛn saa na wɔde yɛ 'sexual assault' (nna mu basabasayɛ)?
answer_twi_source: Nsa, nnuro a ɛma nna (sedatives) ma woda, w'ani so tɔ wo, wowerɛ fi. Wuntumi nsi gyinaeɛ anaa wompene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na asuafoɔ de wɔn ho ahyɛ adwenem ahokwasan ho nimdeɛ "mental health awareness" a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ ne adwenem ahokwasan ho nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn sukuu mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Asuafoɔ bɛtumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ adwenem ahokwasan ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ ne adwenem ahokwasan ho nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn sukuu mpɔtam hɔ denam: Adwene mu akwahosan akuo anaa akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a asuafoɔ di wɔn anim a wɔbɛka ho anaa wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Nhyiam ahorow, ɔsatu ahorow, anaa dwumadi ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a ɛfa adwenemyare ho nsɛmti ho. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ anaa nnamfo nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de ama nkateɛ mu mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ama mfɛfoɔ asuafoɔ. Ntetee anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de anya akannifo ho nimdeɛ na wɔasua nkitahodi akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔde bɛma adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ anya nkɔso. Sukuu mpanyimfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne adwumayɛfo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde asuafo adwenemyare ne yiyedi di kan na wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ nna mu yareɛ ho so dua, sɛ mpo sɛnkyerɛnne biara nni hɔ a.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛyɛ nna mu yareɛ ho nhwehwɛmu a, ɛyɛ nna mu an fa titiri apomoden sɛ wunni sɛnkyerɛnne biara mpo a nna mu yareɛ ahorow pii betumi akɔ so bere tenten a obiara nhu. Mmeae pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ kokoamu na ne bo nyɛ den, te sɛ apomoden mmeae, sukuu ayaresabea ahorow, mmabun apomoden a ɛfa nnaanfo kwan asoɛe
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ yɛkasa tia adwemmɔne ne nyiyim wɔ ne su nyinaa mu wɔ mmarimabere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwenmmɔne ne nyiyim pira ankorankoro ne mpɔtam hɔfo. Ɛdenam saa nneyɛe yi a wobɛkasa atia so no, woboa ma wɔbɔ wiase a ɛfata na ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwan ahorow so adi nsɛm a ɛfa animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne animtiaabu a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so di animtiaabu, nyiyimu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn ho dwuma denam hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ awosu mu wɔ ahofadi, nidi, ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan afã horow nyinaa mu a wogye tom na wosi so dua no so. Ɛsi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkasa tia gyinapɛn, suban, ne nneyɛe a ɛma animtiaabu ne nyiyim kɔ so gyina nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne mfe a obi adi so no so dua. Ɛdenam nhumu, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran so no, ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so hwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛma tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wobenya nsɛm, nnwuma, ne mmoa a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho adwemmɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me yiye anaa ahobammɔ nnim sɛ me ne m’awofo anaa m’abusua mufo bɛbɔ me nna anaa awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo yiye anaasɛ wunnya ahobammɔ sɛ wo ne w’awofo anaa w’abusua mufo bɛbɔ wo haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo afoforo a wugye wɔn di te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw hɔ. Wobetumi de kokoam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔayɛ ama w’ahiade ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow a metumi afa so awo, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ awo nhyehyɛe ne nea mepɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea Awo: Ɔkwan a wɔtaa fa so a sɛ ɛho hia a. Awobea: mmeae a ɛte sɛ ofie a awogyefo hwɛ wo. Mpɛn pii no, hɔ yɛ ma nyinsɛn a asiane nnim. Ofie Awo a awogyefo bɛ wɔhɔ. Ɛyi hia nhyehyɛe yiye na ahobammɔ ho susuw. Nsuo mu Awo: Wobɛ wo wɔ nsuo a ɛyɛ hyew mu. Ɛma ɛyaw ano brɛ ase na ɛma ankorankoro binom gye wɔn ahome. Oprehyɛn (C-Section): Oprehyɛn a wɔde ma awo bere a wontumi mfa ɔbea awotwaa mu awo. Gyinaesi a Wonya a Wonim: Kɔ Awo Adesua: Saa adesua ahorow yi de nsɛm a ɛfa awo akwan horow, akwan a wɔfa so di ɛyaw ano, ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ kwan bere a wɔrewo ho ma. Wo ne W’akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo Kasa: Munsusuw nea wopɛ, nea ɛhaw wo, ne ayaresa tebea biara a ebetumi aka w’awo nhyehyɛe no ho. Susuw Nea Ɛpɛ Awo Ho: Susuw akwan horow a wobɛfa so asiw ɛyaw ano, wɔn a wopɛ sɛ wɔba wɔn nkyɛn bere a wɔrewo, ne nea wopɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ awo akyi no ho. Kyerɛw Awo Nhyehyɛe: Yɛ krataa bi a ɛkyerɛ nea wopɛ wɔ awo, awo, ne awo akyi hwɛ ho. Fa eyi kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo ne kuw a wɔboa wo. Yɛ Nsakrae: Bere a eye sɛ wubenya nhyehyɛe bi no, siesie wo ho ma nsakrae a wɔnhwɛ kwan. Awo ne awo betumi ayɛ nea wontumi nhu, enti bue w’ani ma nsakrae ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na puberty boa awoɔ (fertility) wɔ mmarima ne mmaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima: Asabo (sperm) ba. Wɔtumi ma nyinsɛn. Mmaa: Nkosua (eggs) ba. Bosome-buo hyɛ aseɛ. Wɔtumi yinsɛn. Puberty ma awoɔ kwan bue.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama SRH mmara adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ. Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɛ. Advocacy dɛwurobɛ. Fa mmara kwan so (bɔ kɔkɔ).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa wɔ kokoam denam akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe afoforo a ɛfata mmabun so no ?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, mmabun betumi anya STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa wɔ kokoam denam akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe afoforo a ɛfata mmabun so. Wɔayɛ saa mmeae yi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔde kokoam ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu bɛma, na ama mmabun atumi ahwehwɛ STI ho dwumadie a awofoɔ mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu sɛ wɔpɛ a. Ahintasɛm ho ahobammɔ hwɛ hunu sɛ wodi hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho no so, na ɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛho hia a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya afotu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhaw ahorow ho, a nea ɛka ho ne telefon a wɔde telefon so, telefon a wɔde boa, Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe, nea broni ka no 'mobile apps', anaasɛ ankorankoro a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔ afotu mmeae anaa akwahosan ho mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a Wɔbɛma nea broni ka no 'Acessing Services': Mmabun betumi afa akwan ahodoɔ so anya ɔhaw ho afotuo dwumadie, a nea ɛka ho ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ, telefon a wɔde boa, intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ akwan, nea broni ka no 'mobile apps', anaa ankorankoro a wɔbɛhyia wɔ afotuo mmeaeɛ anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ. Nnwuma pii ma akwan horow pii a wobɛfa so ne wɔn adi nkitaho na ama wɔadi ankorankoro apɛde ne ahiade ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde asiane ahorow yi toto nyinsɛn a wɔtoa so ho a, abu so dɛn? (mpɛn pii no asiane a ɛba fam wɔ akwan horow a ahobammɔ wom so) .
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, asiane ahorow a ɛbata nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan mu no sua. Nyinsɛn a wɔtoa so nso de n’ankasa asiane ahorow ba, a nea ɛka ho ne: Apɔmuden mu Nsɛnnennen: Nyinsɛn bɛtumi de apɔmuden ho haw aba ankorankoro binom so. Asiane a Ɛwɔ Awo mu: Awo de asiane ahorow a efi awosu mu te sɛ mogya a ɛtɔ, ɔyare mmoawa, ne owu mpo ba. asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛwo no kɔ soro wɔ mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mɛtumi ahyɛ nso na magyina akwan a nkurɔfoɔ fa so daadaa mmofra anaa mmeranteɛ wɔ intanɛte so de pɛ sɛ wɔne wɔn nya nna mu kyɛfa no ano?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ ahwɛyiye bere a wo ne ahɔho redi nkitaho wɔ Intanɛt so, titiriw wɔn a wɔkyerɛ w’ankasa asetra ho anigye dodo anaasɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wobenya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ntɛm no. Hwɛ kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm a wobɛsrɛ, nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ woaka, anaa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsakra wo anaa wobedi wo so no yiye. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubesiw ankorankoro a wɔma wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ wonni ahobammɔ no kwan anaasɛ wobɛbɔ amanneɛ. Sɛ wususuw sɛ Intanɛt so ahosiesie anaa nneyɛe a ɛyɛ hu reto wo so a, wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ahorow ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho? (wɔabue, wɔato mu, ɔman no mu, amanaman ntam)
answer_twi_source: Agyede nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ: Open Adoption: Ɛma wo ne abusua a wɔagye wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma no di nkitaho kodu baabi. Agyegye a Wɔatoto Mu: Nkitahodi biara nni wo ne abusua a wɔagye wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma no ntam. Domestic Adoption: Sɛnea yɛaka wɔ atifi hɔ no, abofra a wɔde no bɛto abusua bi mu wɔ Ghana mu. Amanaman Ntam Agyede: Abofra a wɔde no bɛto abusua bi nkyɛn wɔ ɔman foforo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ mmabun ne nna ho akwaa apɔmuden  (ASRR ) nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ me mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Social Media  (hashtags, videos). Mpɔtam dwumadie (workshops, school initiatives).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow adi dwuma de ahwehwɛ aguadi ho akwan horow, nneɛma a wɔde si hɔ, ne aguadi ho anigye a ɛwɔ dawurubɔ, nsɛm a wɔkasa ma, ne sika a wɔde boa a ɛfa nna ho nneɛma, nnwuma, ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmabun so no akyi?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwehwɛ aguadi ho akwan horow, nneɛma a wɔde si hɔ, ne aguadi ho anigye a ɛwɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow a wɔde wɔn ani si mmabun so akyi no hwehwɛ sɛ: Akwan a wɔde gye nkurɔfo adwene ne akwan horow a wɔfa so di dwuma wɔ aguadi ho dawurubɔ mu, te sɛ nkate mu anigye, nnipa a wɔagye din a wɔpene so, ne mfonini ahorow a wɔayɛ no yiye a wobehu. Dawurubɔ ho nsɛm a wɔka no mu ahotoso ne ahotoso a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu na wɔasusuw animhwɛ a ebetumi aba anaasɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahintaw wɔ nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran akyi no ho. Nkɛntɛnso a aguade ho dawurubɔ nya wɔ adetɔfo nneyɛe ne gyinaesi so, titiriw wɔ nna ho nneɛma, nnwuma, ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ nneɛma ho a wobehu. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ a ɛka ho ne aguade ho dawurubɔ ne adetɔfo amammerɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a emu yɛ den de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔapaw nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ ayɛ na wɔako atia aguadi ho akwan a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmoa ne nneɛma afi me mpɔtam hɔ berɛ a meyɛ bra?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam Hɔ: Kɔ mpɔtam asoeɛ anaa sɛ mmubun beaɛ kɔ hwehwɛ nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa dwumadie ahodoɔ a worebedi anaa sɛ wodi ho nsɛm. Akwahosan Ayaresabea: Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ayaresabea pii yɛ nsabuo ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ sane nso tufo. ntentanfidie so Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ ntentanfidie so anaa app ahodoɔ a agye din a ɛtwe adwene si nsabuo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa so. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nhomakorabea: Nhomakorabea ahodoɔ taa wɔ nhoma ne nneɛma a ɛfa nsabuo, nna, ne adwenemyareɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So aban nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛde sika fam mmoa ma mmabun ma wonya nna ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nnyɛ den?
answer_twi_source: Aban nhyehyɛe anaa nnwuma pii botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma ɔmanfo nyinaa sikasɛm mu mmoa a mmabun ka ho ma wɔanya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den: National Health Insurance Scheme no de sika hyɛ nyinsɛn nnuro mu, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ akwahosan ho afotu ma mmabun a wɔfata a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din wɔ nhyehyɛe no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na tema "empathy" ne adwene a wɔde di dwuma di wɔ osuahu ne adwene ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan "sexual health" ho a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye a wɔma ɛkɔ so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Tema ne adwene a wɔde di dwuma di dwuma titiriw wɔ osuahu ahorow ne adwene ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan "sexual health" ho a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye no mu. Fa wo ho to afoforo mpaboa mu na susuw sɛnea wɔn akyigyina, wɔn gyidi, ne osuahu ahorow betumi asakra wɔn adwene wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no ho. Fa atie a wode nsiyɛ di dwuma na hwehwɛ sɛ wode tema ne ayamhyehye bɛte adwene ahorow ase. Ɛdenam adwene ahorow a wubegye atom na woabu no so no, wubetumi atrɛw wo ntease mu na wode nkate kɛse adi nna mu akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahotoso ne nokwaredie wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso ne nokwaredi a wobenya no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi nkitaho daa, wotumi de ho to so, na wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛda adi pefee. Di wo hokafo no nokware wɔ wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne osuahu ahorow ho, na hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ saa ara. Di mo bɔhyɛ ahorow akyi, bu mo ho mo ho ahyeɛ, na di nsɛm biara a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma pefee na ɛma nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ tebea ahorow a ɛma edinnsiananmu a wɔkyɛ na wobu, no yɛ nea ɛfata ma obiara, a wɔn bɔbeasu "gender identity" mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Nya Ahoɔden a Wobɛtumi Agyina Ano: Nya ahokokwaw a ɛbɛma woatumi agyina ano, te sɛ adwene a wɔde si biribi so, sɛnea wobɛka wo ho denneennen, ne ɔhaw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma, na ama woadi adwennwen ho dwuma na woadi tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ atinka fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a woredi nyiyim anaa ayayade ho dwuma no. Hu Wo Hokwan "Legal Rights": Hu wo ho yiye wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ sɛ "LGBTQ+" ankorankoro na sɛ wuhyia nyiyim anaa ɔhaw a, kamfo wo ho. Fa w’adwene si nneɛma pa so: Fa nneɛma pa ne nneɛma a ɛsi so dua a ɛhyɛ nneɛma ahorow ne gye a wogye tom ho afahyɛ twa wo ho hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na kokoamsɛm di wɔ animtiaabu ne nyiyim ntesoɔ so wɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho hia wɔ animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ntesoɔ so bere a ɛma mmabun nya tebea a ahobammɔ wom ma wɔhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda wɔn ho adi no. Nim a wonim sɛ wɔde wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm bɛhyɛ kokoamsɛm mu no hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔda nsɛm a ɛho hia adi na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho ahiade ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa ɔkwan a wɔfa so de akwahosan ho insurance di dwuma de nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bere a wɔkora kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm so no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akura kokoamsɛm mu denam: Wɔn hokwan ahorow a wobehu: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ wɔn mantam mu a ɛfa kokoamsɛm a wɔde ma akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛho hia a wɔbɛte ase. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛpaw wɔn yiye: Hwehwɛ adwumayɛfo a wobu ayarefo kokoam nsɛm na wɔde di kan. Nkitahodi a wobɛka akyerɛ nea wopɛ: Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne insurance nnwumakuw susuw kokoam nsɛm ho na wobisa kokoam nkitahodi, te sɛ kɔmputa so amanneɛbɔ mmom sen nkrataa a wɔde mena.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nna mu abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa na ahobammɔ wom a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma me SOGI ne me hokafo SOGI? (nkitahodi, pene, ahye) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so nkyerɛase a ɛfa nna mu nhyɛso anaa nna mu mmonnaatoyɛ ho, na sɛ mihyia anaa mihu saa nneyɛe yi a, mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na mabɔ saa nneyɛe yi ho amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nhyɛso: Nea ɛka nna mu nhyɛso ho ne nna mu nkɔso a wɔmpɛ, nna mu adom a wɔsrɛ, anaa kasa anaa honam fam nneyɛe foforo a ɛfa nna ho. Ebetumi aba wɔ sukuu ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa ɔmanfo mmeae. Nna mu mmonnaatoyɛ: ɛyɛ nna mu nkitahodi anaa nneyɛe biara a wɔmpɛ, a mmonnaato ka ho. Ɛyɛ nsɛmmɔnedi a anibere wom na ebetumi de mmara mu nsunsuanso a emu yɛ den aba nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no so. Hu a Wohu: Hu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔahaw obi wɔ nna mu anaa wɔatow ahyɛ obi so, te sɛ obi a ɔde ne nsa ka obi a ɔmpɛ, nsɛm a ɔka, anaa nkɔanim. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so; sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛnteɛ anaasɛ ɛnyɛ dɛ a, ɛda adi sɛ ɛte saa. Amanneɛbɔ: Sɛ wuhu anaa wuhu nna mu nnhyɛso anaa mmonnaato a, bɔ ɔpanyin, sukuu fotufo, anaa obi a ɔwɔ tumi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso. Wɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow, sukuu ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow mu no, mpɛn pii no, nhyehyɛe ne akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔ nsɛm a ɛtete saa ho amanneɛ wɔ hɔ. Mmoa: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa telefon so telefon so sɛ wuhyia nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ wo so a. Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ RAINN (wɔ U.S.) de mmoa ne nneɛma ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a yebetumi afa so akyerɛ obu ama nnipa a wɔwɔ ɔsom ahorow anaa gyidie nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Bu wɔn nneyɛe ne wɔn gyidi ahorow. Fa obu bisa nsɛm na ama woasua pii. Di nnapɔnna ne afahyɛ ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asuadeɛ bɛn na yɛbɛtumi asua afiri nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdi mu a ɛfa ASRH dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma nea broni ka no 'technology-based ASRH intervention' so ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa nhumu yi bɛtumi ama daakye nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛɛ ne dwumadie ahunu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdi mu a ɛfa ASRH dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma so nea broni ka no 'technology-based ASRH intervention' no ma nhumu a ɛsom boɔ ma daakye nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛɛ ne ne di denam kyerɛ a ɛbɛda no adi so: Hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛɛ a ɛfa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ho: Sɛ wɔsiesie dwumadie no ma ɛne mmabun pɛ, ahiadeɛ, ne mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ hyia a, ɛma wɔgye tom kɛseɛ na ɛyɛ adwuma yie. Mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma so: Digitals platform ahodoɔ a wɔde bɛka abom, te sɛ mobile apps, social media, ne online forums, ma kwan ma mmabun dodoɔ a wɔdɔɔso na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛma nkitahodi na ɛyɛ anigye di dwuma: Sɛ wɔde nkitahodi nneɛma, agodie, ne multimedia nneɛma ka ho a, ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no nya nkɔso na ɛma suban mu nsakrae a ɛkɔ so daa ho nkuran. Nkitahodi ho hia: Sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma, a aban, NGO, ne mfiridwuma nnwuma nea broni ka no 'tech companies' ka ho, yɛ adwuma bom a, ɛma nkɔsoɔ, nkɔanim, ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa wɔ mfiridwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nea broni ka no 'technology-based  intervention' no yɛ mmerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ayɛ de akasa atia animtiaabu a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no? (nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, nsɛm a wɔkyɛ, wɔkasa kyerɛ sɛ wobenya bi)
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wubetumi ayɛ nsakrae nne ni: Nkitahodi a Wobue: wo ne wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafo di nkitaho pefee na wodi nokware fa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho. Nsɛm a Wobɛkyɛ: Fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ nokware a efi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho ne afoforo. Kasa ama nyinsɛn a woyi gu wɔ mmara kwan so denam sukuu ayarehwɛfo so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛbɛtumi ama sukuu, mpɔtam, ne asetena mu mmeae ayɛ dwoodwoo na yɛahyɛ nnamfofa pa a wɔbu obiara pɛ a wɔpene so nkuran? (ndwumadie ne adesuade a eseɛ wɔn a wotaa gyina ho kɛkɛ wɔ amaneyɛ bere mu)
answer_twi_source: Ha yɛ sɛnea yɛbɛtumi de amammerɛ a pɛ a wɔpene so wom aba nie: Nkurɔfoɔ a Wɔtumi Sɔre Boa Dwumadie: Dwumadie yi kyerɛkyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ sɛnea wɔbɛfa kwan a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo so aboa bere a wɔahunu sɛ obi rehyɛ obi foforo nna mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ Nhyiam: Nhyiam betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nnamfofa pa, nkitahodiɛ akwan, ne pɛ a wɔpene so ho hia a ɛhia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako  akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nnipa nyinaa ka ho na ɛfa nipadua pa ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, aguade ho dawurubɔ, ne amammerɛ a agye din mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ka ho na wɔyɛ nipadua pa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, aguade ho dawurubɔ, ne amammerɛ a agye din mu wɔ nsunsunaso bɔne a ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware de ba no ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya, nsusuwii hunu a wɔbɛkasa atia, ahyɛnsode ahorow ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔboa nneɛma ahorow a egu ahorow na ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho nkuran, ne abɛɛfo ntentan nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nne ahorow a wɔato wɔn hintidua ayɛ kɛse na wɔahwehwɛ nsakrae no so. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dwumadi mu, wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ adesrɛ nkrataa ase, wɔpow nnwumakuw a wɔwɔ nneyɛe a epira, ne ɔsatu ne akuw a wɔkamfo nipadua a wobegye atom mu kyɛfa a wonya no yɛ akwan a etu mpɔn a mmabun fa so ma wɔte wɔn nne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nhyɛso ho, ahyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene ho ho nkuran, na wɔaboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne ɔmanfo a ɛtrɛw mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nhyɛso"coercion" ho, ahyɛ pene a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran, na wɔaboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu denam wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ dwumadi mu, ɔsatu "campaigns" ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn so. Wobetumi ne asuafoɔ agyinatukuo, mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akuo ayɛ adwuma abom de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so, akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri nka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na wɔaboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no denam afotuo dwumadie, mmoa akuo, ne mmara kwan so nneɛma a wɔbɛma wɔanya no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidie ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde di kan, ne wɔn botae ahorow ho, ne sɛnea saa nneɛma yi nya wɔn gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ne sɛnea wɔyɛ wɔn ade wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho boa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidie ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde di kan, ne wɔn botae ahorow mu denam nkuranhyɛ a ɛhyɛ wɔn ma wɔhwehwɛ sɛnea saa nneɛma yi nya wɔn gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso no so. Ɛdenam nsusuwii so no, mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe biara a ɛda wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn nneyɛe ntam, na ama wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛne wɔn ankasa nnyinasosɛm ne wɔn apɛde ahorow hyia kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma atipɛnfoɔ afotufoɔ na ama wɔn nimdeɛ ne wɔn mmɔdenbɔ akɔ anim wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa wɔn atipɛnfoɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden mu?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee ne nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ: Atipɛnfoɔ afotufoɔ bɛtumi anya nteteeɛ nhyiamu, adwumayɛbea, ne nhyiamu ahodoɔ de ama wɔn afotuo ho nimdeɛ, nkitahodiɛ tumi, ne nimdeɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nsɛmti ho no akɔ anim. Afotufoɔ nkitahodiɛ: Atipɛnfoɔ afotufoɔ bɛtumi akɔka afotufoɔ nkitahodiɛ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ho, na wɔne afotufoɔ foforɔ adi nkitaho, akyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa, na wɔahwehwɛ afotuo ne mmoa afiri adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa hɔ. Mmoa dwumadie: Atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi de mmoa dwumadie te sɛ afotuo, nteteeɛ, ne ɔhwɛ ama de aboa afotufoɔ ma wɔadi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma, adi ntawntawdie ho dwuma, na wɔakura wɔn yiedie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no ho dwuma wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔagye wɔn fɛw so, na wobu wɔn bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, wɔ akwahosan (healthcare) ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no ho dwuma denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia nyiyim a wɔde bedi dwuma, ntetee a ɛfa atinka ho a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wobetumi anya mmeae ahorow no honam fam, nkitahodi mmoa a wɔde bɛma, ne amammerɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya obu ne obiara a wɔbɛka wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe bi a yɛde bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ yɛn ho yɛn ho daa wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yebetumi adi nsɛm a ɛhaw yɛn anaa nsɛmmisa biara bere a ɛsɔre no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wode nhyehyɛe bi si hɔ a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho daa a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔanya tebea a ɛboa na ɛbue ma nkitahodi. Fa bere a ɛho hia so si hɔ sɛ wobɛbɔ saa nkɔmmɔ a wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wo ho yi, sɛ ɛyɛ dapɛn biara, dapɛn abien biara, anaa ɔsram biara, a egyina nea wopɛ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Fa saa nhyehye yi di dwuma sɛ hokwan ahorow a wode bɛka nsɛm a ɛhaw wo, nsɛmmisa, anaa nkɔso foforo biara a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ho asɛm wɔ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛnyɛ atɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, a wɔfa so di aduan ne adan ho ahobammɔ a enni hɔ wɔ mmabun a wogu ahorow mu ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ a wɔfa so di aduane ne adan a enni hɔ ho dwuma wɔ mmabun a wɔgu ahodoɔ mu no betumi ayɛ: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mmabun ne wɔn mmusua a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ aduane ne adan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ na wɔde adi dwuma mu no hwɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no fa amammerɛ ho, ɛbu atetesɛm, na ɛdi mpɔtam hɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma. Kasa mu kwan: Nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde ma wɔ kasa ahorow pii mu na wɔde nkitahodi akwan a ɛfata amammerɛ di dwuma no betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nyinaa benya mmoa nnwuma ne nsɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ: Sɛ wohu amammerɛ mu apɛde soronko, aduan ho atetesɛm, ne adan ho ahiade a ɛwɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu a, ɛma wotumi yɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a, wɔde wɔn ani asi so ne ano aduru a ɛne mmabun ne wɔn mmusua hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo mu nneɛma nya akwan horow a mmabun fa so kyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm ase na wɔyɛ ho biribi wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo nkitahodi mu no so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de amammerɛ mu nkate aka nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ  ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ na ɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm ase na wɔyɛ ho biribi wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo nkitahodi mu no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Yɛbɛtumi de amanneɛ mu nteaseɛ ne ahwɛyiye (cultural sensitivity) afra abasɛm ntentan mu nhwehwɛmu (media literacy) nkyerɛkyerɛ mu denam: Sɛ yɛbɛgye atom na yɛahwehwɛ amanneɛ ahorow (cultural diversity) a ɛwɔ mmabun nnamfokuo mu, te sɛ nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ wɔn gyidie, nneyɛeɛ, ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so nkitahodi mu. Bio nso, yɛbɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu na yɛakyerɛ ɔkwan a nsɛm a wɔde to dwa wɔ abasɛm ntentan so no tumi sesa gyina amanneɛ ne mpɔtam ahorow so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nsusuwii hunu, ne tumi mu nkɔso ho a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛka obiara ho a ɛda amammerɛ ne osuahu ahorow adi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no fa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne dwumadie mu de adi nsɛm a ɛka wɔn yiedie ho dwuma. Wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) mu no, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ho hia paa ɛfiri sɛ: Ɛhwɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ɛfa ho, na ɛdi mmabun ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ahiadeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ ho dwuma. Ɛma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, a mmabun, mmusua, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ka ho no yɛ wɔn wurayɛ, ahotosoɔ, ne adwumayɛkuo, na ɛde nsunsuansoɔ a ɛtena hɔ daa na ɛtu mpɔn ba. Ɛhyɛ asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow mu nsakrae, tumi, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho nkuran, na ɛkasa tia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aboa me ma madi nkate fam nkɔso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛba wɔ nna mu nkɔso mu no so? (adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: wobɛtumi ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ, sukuu ɔfotufoɔ anaa mmabun apɔwmuden ho dwumadiefoɔ adi nkitaho ama mmoa, anaa wode saa Hotlines yi adi dwuma: kasa kyerɛ apɔwmuden ho dwumadie bi nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne haw anaa akwanside atitiriw a ɛmma wontumi nsiw STI/HIV ano yiye wɔ wiase nyinaa no bi?
answer_twi_source: Haw ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nsiw STI/HIV ano yiye wɔ wiase nyinaa no bi ne: Animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia nnipa a wɔwɔ STI ne HIV, a ebetumi ama wɔabu nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne tebea a wɔbɛda no adi no abam. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛsua, a nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, sɔhwɛ, ayaresa, ne nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde siw ano ka ho, titire wɔ mmeaeɛ a nneɛma kakraa bi na ɛwɔ hɔ ne mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa yie. Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nnipa hokwan ahorow a wobu so a ɛma mmea, mmeawa, ne nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua yɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya nna mu nkate ne HIV. Sika a ɛnnɔɔso, amammui mu ahofama, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw yare ano no ayɛ kɛse na wɔadi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no ho dwuma no ho nhyehyɛe. STI ne HIV ahorow a nnuru ntumi nsɛe no a ɛba, ne nsamanwaw, mmerɛbo mu yare, ne nyarewa afoforo a wɔde yare mmoawa ba a ɛka bom nya, a ɛde nsɛnnennen foforo ba mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw ano ne ayaresa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afi nyiyim, nhyɛso, ne basabasayɛ a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho paw ne wɔn nneyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afi nyiyim, nhyɛso, ne basabasayɛ a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan a wɔpaw ne wɔn nneyɛe ho no ho. Ebia eyinom bi ne mmara ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, kokoamsɛm, awo hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne mmofra ahobammɔ ho, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho a wo ne ahokafo bɔ no nyɛ nea ɛfata na hyɛ gyinaesi a wɔbom si ho nkuran.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne ahokafo bɛbɔ no ho hia. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Gyinaesi a wɔbom yɛ: Munsusuw nyinsɛn ano aduru ho pefee na momfa nokwaredi hwehwɛ ɔkwan a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma ama mo baanu nyinaa. Bu ahye: Nsusuw ho na munnya obu mma nea mo ho mo ho pɛ wɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru ho. Abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho no yɛ abusuabɔ pa fapem. Kae: Wo nna mu apɔwmuden ho hia, na ɛsɛ sɛ wo hokafo no bu w’ahiade ne gyinaesi ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ m’akwaa apɔmuden ho adwumayɛni no bu me dɛmdi no na ɔsi me bɔbeasu ne nna ho akɔnnɔ so dua bere a wɔahyɛ me no?
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho a Wobɛka Abɔ: Ka wo nna ho akɔnnɔ ne wo bɔbeasu ho asɛm pefee na ka no pen. Bisa Nsɛm: Bisa suahu a ɔdemafo no wɔ bere a ɔne mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ne nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun yɛ adwuma no ho asɛm. Fa Ahye Si Hɔ: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, da wo haw ahorow adi na bisa nsakrae wɔ anim a wobisabisa no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wotua ho ka ne nea wontua ho ka ntam, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛhaw mmabun osuahu ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wotua ho ka no hwehwɛ sɛ wotua wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no adwuma ho akatua anaasɛ sika a wɔde boa, bere a adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wontua ho ka no mfa sika mma. Mpɛn pii no, adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wotua ho ka de sika fam mmoa ma de tua wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no asetena mu ka, akwantu ho ka, ne ɛka afoforo a ɛfa ho, bere a adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wontua ho ka betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no tua wɔn ankasa ka. Mpɛn pii no, adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wotua ho ka no yɛ nea akansi kɛse wom na ebetumi ama wɔanya osuahu ahorow a ɛkorɔn, afotu, ne nkitahodi hokwan ahorow sɛ wɔde toto adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wontua ho ka ho a. Ebia adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wontua ka da so ara ma adesua mu osuahu a ɛsom bo ne adwumayɛfo nkitahodi, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no susuw aguadi mu nsakrae ahorow no ho yiye, wɔ sikasɛm mu akatua ne bo a ɛsom nyinaa mu bere a, wɔresusuw adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho no mma mmabun nnya mmoa a wɔhia? (atemmu ho suro, nneɛma a wonni) .
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu betumi asi mmabun kwan sɛ wobenya mmoa a wohia esiane nneɛma pii nti: Atemmu ho Suro: Suro a wosuro sɛ wɔn atipɛnfo, abusuafo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo mpo bebu wɔn atɛn no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Nneɛma a Wonnya: Animtiaabu betumi ama wonni nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ adwenemyare ho haw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛrma bɛsore kwa 'erections'?
answer_twi_source: Aane, erections yɛ ade a ɛfata wɔ mmarima mmerantebere mu. Ebetumi asi a ntease biara nnim, esiane hormone ahorow anaasɛ bere a woada mpo nti. Eyi ne ɔkwan a wo nipadua fa so siesie ne ho ma nna mu dwumadi daakye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ nhyehyɛe kɔ ayeresabea anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn ma ɔhwɛ nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Wonhia sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ, wotumi  kɔ ayeresabea a wosiw nyinsɛn ano bere biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne animtiaabu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛha mmabun a wonya nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu kyerɛ gyidi, suban, ne nsusuii hunu a ɛnteɛ a ɛde nyiyim ne asetena mu nyiyim ba ankorankoro anaa akuo mu a egyina su anaa nneyɛe bi so. Animtiaabu a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi: Asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm a edi mu, mmoa, ne nnwuma esiane suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, wɔbɛpow wɔn, anaa wɔbɛtwe wɔn aso nti. To nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛho hia a wobetumi anya ano hye, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ho nnuro, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu, na ɛde akwahosan mu nsunsuanso bɔne ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ba. Wei boa ma wɔte aniwu, afobuo, ne obuo a wonni ma wɔn ho, a ebetumi asi nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne gyinaesi a ɛfata a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene mu animhwɛ "cognitive biases" anaa 'heuristics' bi a ebetumi akyinkyim "distort" asiane ho adwene, te sɛ anidaso mu animhwɛ, availability bias, anaasɛ conformity bias, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na masɔ saa animhwɛ ahorow yi ahwɛ de apaw nneɛma a ntease wom na ɛwɔ nimdeɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu animhwɛ "cognitive biases" anaa nsusuwii a ebetumi akyinkyim asiane ho adwene a wowɔ no bi ne: Anidaso mu animhwɛ: Su a ɛne sɛ wubebu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye sɛ ebefi mu aba no adewa na woabu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye sɛ ebefi mu aba no adewa dodo. 'Availability bias': Nsɛm a wobetumi anya ntɛm anaasɛ ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkae no mu duru kɛse a wɔde ma, na ɛma wogyina nsɛm a esisii nnansa yi anaa nea ɛda adi pefee so bu asiane ahorow bi ho akontaa dodo. Conformity bias: Sɛ́ wobɛte nka sɛ wɔahyɛ wo sɛ wobɛma asiane ho adwene a wowɔ no ne w’atipɛnfo anaa asetra mu kuw de ahyia, sɛ ebia ɛnkyerɛ asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ botae mu pɛpɛɛpɛ mpo a. Sɛ wubehu na woakasa atia saa animhwɛ ahorow yi a, fa nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne wo ho a wubehu di dwuma. Gye wo nsusuwii ahorow ho kyim, hwehwɛ adwene ahorow, na susuw nsɛm a egyina adanse so ho sen sɛ wode wo ho bɛto w’ankasa osuahu anaa asetra mu nkɛntɛnso nkutoo so. Fa wo ho hyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho mu de hwehwɛ sɛnea animhwɛ betumi anya wo gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso mu na fa adwempa twa wɔn mpoa sɛ wɔnpaw nneɛma a ntease wom na wonya nimdeɛ pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nnwuma ma mmabun, nanso akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ne ayaresabea ahorow pii de saa nnwuma yi ma sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ no fã. Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔhwehwɛnna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa wɔ wɔn ankasa mu, na ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu ne kokoamsɛm ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Bio nso, tumidifoɔ binom betumi anya mmara anaa akwankyerɛ a ɛhyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie mma, titire wɔ mmeaeɛ bi te sɛ akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu mu anaa ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan ayaresabea.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa nnamfo a wɔrehyia nna mu nsɛm 'SRH' ho haw?
answer_twi_source: Tie wɔn. Ma wɔn nimdeɛ. Ka wɔn ho kɔ ayaresabea. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran. Kyerɛ wɔn baabi a wɔbɛnya mmoa (hotlines/PPAG). Ma wɔn bammɔ na yɛ obi a otie wɔn wɔ biribiara mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkitahodi a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛko ama wɔn ho mu de ahyɛ nna ne awo apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkitahodi ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina amammerɛ mu denam: Ahotoso ne abusuabɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfo benya denam atie a wɔde nsiyɛ, tema, ne obu a wɔde ma amammerɛ ahorow so. Nkrasɛm, akwan horow, ne nneɛma a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ma ɛne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn pɔtee, kasa horow, ne nkitahodi akwan horow ahyia. Yɛne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, gyidie akannifoɔ, ne akuo a ɛwɔ fam no bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ama nne ayɛ kɛseɛ, adi mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma, na wɔako ama nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ. Atipɛnfo tumi a wɔbɛma wɔabɛyɛ atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo, akomafo, ne akannifo wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no mu. Social media, dijitaal abasɛm, ne adebɔ ho adwinni a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akasa atia animtiaabu, na wɔaboaboa nnipa a wɔbom yɛ ade ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa akuw a wɔboa atipɛnfo, na wɔde mmoa ama wɔn atipɛnfo wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa atipɛnfo mmoa akuw wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen, atie a wɔde tema bɛma, wɔn suahu ne nhumu a wɔbɛka, ne nkuranhyɛ ne adanse a wɔde bɛma wɔn atipɛnfo no so. Wobetumi nso de afotu a mfaso wɔ so ama, akyɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano, na wɔaboa ma wɔasusuw nsɛnnennen a kuw no mufo hyia ho ano aduru ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetra mu nimdeɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu nimdeɛ yɛ tumi ne nneyɛe a ɛma ankorankoro tumi di da biara da asetra mu ahwehwɛde ne ɔhaw ho dwuma yiye. Nea ɛka ho ne ahokokwaw a ɛfa nkitahodi, gyinaesi, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, asɛm a wɔka no denneennen, tema, ne adwennwen a wogyina ano ho. Asetra mu nimdeɛ ho hia mmabun bere a wɔdan kɔ mpanyin afe so no efisɛ ɛma wɔn tumi ma wotumi fa asetra mu tebea horow mu, sisi gyinae a ɛfata, nya abusuabɔ pa, wogyina nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba ano, na wodu wɔn botae ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu nneyɛe ne atetesɛm pa a ɛhyɛ nna a ɛfata, bɔbea pɛyɛ "gender equality", ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu ho nhwɛso ahorow bi?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe pa ne atetesɛm a ɛhyɛ nna a ahoɔden wom, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne: Amanne ne amanne ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna mu onyin ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛntitiriw ho afahyɛ, a ɛma hokwan ahorow ma nhomasua, mmoa, ne tumidi. Amammerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow a esi obu, nkitahodi, ne pene so dua wɔ abusuabɔ mu, na ɛma wonya adwene pa wɔ nna ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho. Nnwuma ne nhyehyeɛ a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ di anim a ɛka atetesɛm mu nimdeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ ne nnɛyi akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne dwumadie bom. asetena mu nkitahodi "Social network" ahorow a ɛboa ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛma mmabun nya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wosusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho, nya nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na wɔkamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow kyerɛ. Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom bɔ wɔ amammerɛ akannifo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ntam de yɛ akwan a ɛfata amammerɛ a wɔde bedi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma wɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mfiridwuma nea aborɔfo ka no 'technology ne social media' betumi adi wɔ tumi a wɔde bɛma mmabun akannifo ma wɔaboaboa wɔn atipɛnfo ano, ama nkurɔfo ate ase, na wɔakamfo wɔn hokwan ne wɔn ahiade ahorow wɔ 'ASRH' mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma, nea aborɔfo ka no 'technology ne social media' ma mmabun akannifoɔ tumi ma wɔboaboa wɔn atipɛnfoɔ ano, ma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ, na wɔkasa ma wɔn hokwan ne wɔn ahiadeɛ wɔ 'ASRH' mu denam: Wɔde nhyiamu a mmabun di anim, intanɛt so adesrɛ, ne digyital abasɛm ka nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛduru wiase nyinaa atiefoɔ nkyɛn na wɔakanyan nkɔmmɔdie wɔ 'ASRH' nsɛm ho. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne intanɛt so mpɔtam a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi akyɛ nsɛm, nneɛma, ne suahunu a ɛfa 'ASRH' ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ. Mmabun nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse denam nea broni ka no 'social media' ɔsatu, 'hashtags', ne nsɛm a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔyare mmoawa a ɛma nkurɔfo hu 'ASRH' nsɛm ho na ɛkasa tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim so. Mmɔdenbɔ a mmabun di anim a wɔde bɛbɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban no a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ denam nnwinnadeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma ama intanɛt so nhyehyɛeɛ, nea broni ka no 'data visualization', ne digyital abasɛm a wɔbɛka de agye wɔn a wɔboa no na wɔaboaboa wɔn ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu, animhwɛ, ne adwemmɔne a ɛboa ma wɔyɛ nyiyimu ne nnipa a wɔadi dɛm a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn no?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Hyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu ne nhyiam ahorow ho nkuran de kasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho. Ankorankoro biom hwɛ: Hyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne ankorankoro nkuran ma wonsusuw wɔn ankasa animhwɛ ne nsusuwii ahorow ho. Nsɛnkyerɛnne Pa: Kyerɛ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm a wɔadi yiye no nsɛm ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ de ako atia nsusuwii hunu a ɛnteɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ (abɛɛfo ntentenfidie) ho nimdeɛ ahyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow mu de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔasusuw intanɛt so nsɛm ho yiye na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ (abɛɛfo ntentanfidie) ho nimdeɛ aka ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de ama mmabun tumi ma: Wɔbɛsɔ nsɛm a ɛwɔ intanɛt so ahwɛ yiye: Sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛnea wɔbɛhwɛ sɛnea dijitaal nsɛm no yɛ nokware, ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛfa ho a, ɛboa wɔn ma wohu nsonsonoe a ɛda ASRH nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so fi nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ animhwɛ mu. Kɔ kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ mu: Akwankyerɛ a wode ma wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde besi hɔ, intanɛt so nsɛm a wobɛhwɛ so, ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛfa Intanɛt so ahunahuna ho a wubehu ho no ma mmabun digyital ahobammɔ ne ahobammɔ yɛ kɛse. Hu na yɛ ho biribi: Sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nsunsuanso a kɔmputa so ayayade nya, akwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina ɔhaw ano, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ mmoa no hyɛ Intanɛt so tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bi betumi agyina wɔn nyamesom anaa abrabɔ fam gyidi ahorow so apow sɛ wɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma bɛma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae bi no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi anya hokwan sɛ wogyina wɔn nyamesom anaa abrabɔ fam gyidi ahorow so pow sɛ wɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma bɛma. Wɔtaa frɛ eyi sɛ "ahonim mu a wɔpow" anaasɛ "ɔdemafo a ɔpow." Nanso, mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa pow a wɔpow ayarefo ho no gu ahorow kɛse, na ebia mpɔtam bi wɔ ahwehwɛde pɔtee bi a ɛfa sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di pow a wɔpow ho dwuma na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ayarefo betumi anya ɔhwɛ no ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu kwan ahorow a wowɔ sɛ ɔyarefo na wote sɛnea nea ɔde ma no pow betumi aka wo tumi a wode benya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no ase. Ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi begyina ne gyidi so apow nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwuma bere a ɔwɔ kokoam adwuma mu sen ɔmanfo adwuma mu bere a nsɛnkyerɛnne pa wɔ hɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotuo ne mmoa dwumadi ahorow boa mmabun ma wɔfa nna ho nipasu, abusuabɔ, ne awo ho gyinaesi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne Ntease: Afotufoɔ ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔhwehwɛ wɔn nna mu nipasu mu. Wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam ntease ahorow ho. Nkitahodi Ho Nimdeɛ: Sua nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn a wode besusuw nna ho nipasu ho a wo ne w’atipɛnfo ne w’abusua bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ. Fa akwan pa a wobɛfa so ada ahiade ne ahye adi wɔ abusuabɔ mu di dwuma. Gyinaesi Mmoa: Nya nsɛm a enni animhwɛ a ɛfa awo akwan horow ne nea ɛkyerɛ ho. Hwehwɛ nkate, gyinapɛn, ne botae ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw anaa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho. Nkate mu Mmoa: Di nkate ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nipasu, abusuabɔ, anaa awo ho gyinaesi ahorow ho dwuma. Yɛ akwan a wobɛfa so agyina ano na woagyina ano a wode bedi adwennwen ne nsɛnnennen ho dwuma. Nhomasua ne Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Nya nimdeɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nipadua akwaa, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI a wosiw ano ho. Te nka sɛ wɔama wo tumi sɛ wubesi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyekye nnamfo ne abusuafo a emu ye den na wɔde mmoa ma m’adwene mu yiyedi wɔ ɔkwan pa so? (ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛka ho asɛm, akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔde besi hɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Ahiade Ho Nkitahodi: Ma nnamfo ne abusuafo nhu mmoa ko a wohia. Nneɛma a Wɔhwɛ kwan a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Ma suban ko a wohwɛ kwan fi nnipa a wɔwɔ w’asetra mu hɔ no mu nna hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuufo ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho a, wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, asuafoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim bɛtumi: Wɔde atipɛnfoɔ mmoa, nsɛm, ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) ho ama wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmuo na ɛfa ho. Kamfo nhyehyeɛ, nhyehyeɛ, ne dwumadie a ɛfa obiara ho a ɛdi asuafoɔ dodoɔ ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma. Hyɛ nhyiamu, nhyiamu, ne ɔsatuo a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate nna ne awo akwahusan (SRH) nsɛm ho nkuran na wɔahyɛ obuo suban ne nneyɛeɛ ho nkuran. Yɛ mmeae a ahobanbɔ wɔ ma asuafoɔ bɛsusu nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) nsɛmti ho, akyɛ suahunu, na wɔanya mmoa ntam nkitahodiɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu hokwan ahorow a wɔ ko ma sɛ ɛbɛdi dwuma, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia? (nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ ho ban) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu hokwan ahorow a wɔ ko ma sɛ ɛbɛdi dwuma,ne ɔko a wɔko de hwɛ hu sɛ obiara a ohia nyinsɛn a woyi gu no bɛtumi anya ahobammɔ wɔ mmara kwan so. Nea enti a ɛho hia ni: Nipadua mu Ahofadi: Obiara wɔ hokwan sɛ osi gyinae wɔ n’ankasa nipadua ho, a n’awo apɔmuden ka ho. Ɔmanfo Apɔmuden: Nnwumakuw a wɔyɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ ne mmara kwan so de ma asiane ahorow a ɛbata akwan horow a ahobammɔ nnim ho no so tew. Pɛyɛ: Nyinsɛn a wotu gu a wobenya no boa ma wɔhwɛ hu sɛ ankorankoro nyinaa, ɛmfa ho sɛnea wofi mu no, bɛtumi asi gyinaeɛ afa wɔn daakye ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Awo akwahosan 'reproductive healthcare' ho nhyehyɛe bɛn na mmabun betumi anya, na mɛyɛ dɛn anya bi?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a Ɛwɔ Hɔ: Nyinsɛn a Wosiw 'contraception': Akwan ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya, te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, kɔndɔm, ne nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ɛyɛ adwuma bere tenten (LARCs). Nna mu nyarewa 'STI' Nhwehwɛmu ne Ayaresa: Nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa sɛ wohu sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a. Nyinsɛn mu Nhwehwɛmu ne Afotu: Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn ho akwan horow a wobetumi apaw ho. Nna mu Akwahosan Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nipadua akwaa, mmabunbere, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Mmea Ho Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔyɛ akyi berɛmo mu nhwehwɛmu, Pap smears, ne nufu mu nhwehwɛmu de hwɛ awo akwahosan. Nkɔsoɔ: Mpɔtam Hɔ Ayaresabea: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ awoɔ akwahosan ayaresabea, abusua nhyehyɛeɛ beaeɛ, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a ne ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho. Ayaresabea Ahorow a Ɛhwɛ Sukuu So: Sukuu ahorow bi wɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a wɔde awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ma. Telehealth: Virtual anaa telehealth services betumi de kokoam afotu ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mihia awofo mpene na ama manya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, awofo mpeneso yɛ nea ɛyɛ  nanso sɛ wunnii mfe 18 a, ɛnyɛ ahyɛde. Wɔ Ghana no, mmara kwan so mfeɛ a wɔde bɛpene so no yɛ mfeɛ 18 nanso, Wɔde Contraceptive services bɛma wo sɛ wowɔ awofoɔ pene anaasɛ wo nni hɔ. Sɛ wohia mmoa a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ beae a mmabun adamfofa su wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ anaa akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn nea ɔde ma no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na  asomdwoe kuo ne mmoa nkabom kuo  ahorow boa ma mmabun a wɔ  yɛ dɛmdifoɔ a etumi yɛ adwuma no nya adwene mu apomoden pa?
answer_twi_source: Ma wonya baabi a wɔbɛbom atra (belonging). Si self-esteem (confidence). Ma adwene mu haw so te (supportive environment). Kwan a wobɛfa so anya mmoa (professionals)..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw bɛn na ɛwɔ ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ no sɛnea wɔpɛ de adi wɔn ahiade pɔtee ne nea ɛkanyan wɔn ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma Titiriw ne Ankorankoro: Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe mu no betumi ayɛ nea ɛka nneɛma a ɛkanyan ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wobehu, akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ne nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene a wɔbɛkyerɛw, ankorankoro a wɔbɛboa wɔn a wobetumi ne wɔn adi nkitaho, ne adwumayɛfo nneɛma a wɔbɛkyerɛw de aboa wɔn. Mmabun betumi ayɛ wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no sɛnea wɔpɛ de adi wɔn ahiade pɔtee, nea ɛkanyan wɔn, ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Intanɛt so nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a wotumi de ho to so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ Ghana Health Service,m Planned Parenthood ne World Health Organization (WHO) wɛbsaet ahorow. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe te sɛ PPAG Yenkasa mmoa beae, Marie Stope mmoa beae, UNICEF Agoo SHE+ ne aduruyɛ wɛbsaet afoforo a ɛde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ahwɛ mu ma. Aban akwahosan dwumadibea wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛde nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ma. Apps te sɛ "Ɛsɛ sɛ Wohu (YMK)" a ɛde nkitahodi nnwinnade, nsɛm, ne video ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnneɛma a ɛma ayɔnkofa kɔ soro, nkitahodi ne ɔhye bɔ boa siw bɔbea ntawantawa ho nsɛm 'GBV' ano.
answer_twi_source: Ayɔnkofa pa boa ma bɔbea ho ntawantawa  'GBV' to twa. Kasa pefee. Obu. Pɛyɛ. Hyehyɛ 'Boundaries' (ka 'daabi').
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de ahu sɛ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoamsɛm?
