answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi atu anammɔn pii de ahu sɛ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoamsɛm, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobebisa wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne wɔn nneyɛe ho asɛm a wɔbɛsrɛ kokoam nnwuma na wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asusu kokoamsɛm ho haw ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ayaresabea anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiri na wɔde kokoam nnwuma ma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so de kokoam nkitahodi, te sɛ nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔmmɔ wɔn din
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akɔ so agyina bere a wɔresesa wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Sua sɛdeɛ yɛgyina haw ano. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi nkurɔfoɔ hɔ. Hu sɛ nsesaeɛ yɛ ade a ɛba. Hwehwɛ Mmoa Bere a Ɛho Hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na aduru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano putupuru yɛ adwuma ne bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde di dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ahorow:Aduru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano putupuru (ECP): Ɛwɔ honam mu nkwammoa (hormones) a ɛsi nyinsɛn ano. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde di dwuma ntɛm ara a wɔbɛtumi wɔ nna a banbɔ nni mu anaa awoɔ nnuru a anyɛ adwuma akyi. Ɛyɛ adwuma yiye bere a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nnɔnhwere aduasuon-abien (72) mu, nanso nnuru no bi yɛ adwuma kɔsi nna anum (5) akyi. Kɔpa IUD: Wɔbetumi de adi dwuma sɛ nuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano putupuru wɔ nna anum mu wɔ nna a banbɔ nni mu akyi. Ɔkwan a Ɛfa So Yɛ Adwuma: Eyi siw nkosua  a ɛde nyinsɛn ba no ano. Nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde saa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano yi di dwuma daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe bɛtumi aboa ma wɔde nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nnwuma abom ne apɔmuden ho nnwuma afoforo a ɛho hia, te sɛ HIV a wosiw ano ne ayaresa, adwenemyare ho mmoa, ne nyarewa a entumi nkɔ nnipa mu a wosiw ano?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ bɛtumi aboa ma wɔde nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden ho dwumadie abom ne apɔmuden ho dwumadie foforɔ a ɛho hia, te sɛ HIV a wɔsiw ano ne ayaresa, adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa, ne nyarewa a ɛntumi nkɔ yareɛ a wɔde siw ano denam: Apɔmuden ho nhyehyeɛ ne akwan a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛma dwumadie a wɔaka abom di kan na wɔahyɛ ɔkwan a ɛfa mmabun aapɔmuden ne yiedie ho a ɛfa biribiara ho. Mmara ne mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow a esiw nnwuma a wɔde bɛka abom no a wobeyi afi hɔ, te sɛ tumi krataa a wɔde anohyeto ma anaasɛ sika a wonnya mma nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔaka abom. Nkɔsoɔ ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛbɛhyɛ nnwumakuo ahodoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ apɔmuden ho dwumadie mu, a aban nnwumakuo, apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne ɔmanfoɔ akuo ka ho. Ntetee ne tumi a wɔde bɛma apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ nnwuma a wɔaka abom a wɔde bɛma ho, a nea ɛka ho ne animtiaabuo, nyiyim, ne kokoamsɛm ho haw a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma. Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɛda mmabun ahiadeɛ a ɛrekɔ so adi na ɛyɛ aapɔmuden ho nsɛnnennen a ɛreba, te sɛ abɛɛfo ntentan apɔmuden ho mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma, yareɛ adesoa a ɛresakra, ne asetena mu gyinapɛn ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛresakra.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na mmabun a wɔyem wɔ wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo, awoɔ, ne awo akyi hwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu ansa na wɔawo, awoɔ, ne awoɔ akyi hwɛ ho, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛpaw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu ansa na wɔawo, awoɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛpaw a ɛne wɔn pɛ ne wɔn ahiade hyia, na wɔanya awoɔ akyi hwɛ ho nnwuma ama wɔn ankasa ne wɔn a wɔawo no foforo. Wobetumi nso ne helplines online platform adi nkitaho denam 5100, YENKASA The toll-free number(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho a wɔbɛfrɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ me ho yie wɔ Intanɛt so na makwati kɔmputa so ayayade anaa ɔhaw a ɛfa basabasayɛ a ɛfa 'GBV'?
answer_twi_source: Fa kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe di dwuma fahwɛ kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ no so na bɔ Intanɛt so ayayade ho amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛhia sɛ m'awofo penee so na manya awoɔso ano nsii nne, na mene me awofo bɛkasa ho sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Saa dwumadie no yɛ nea obiara de yɛ adwuma a ebi nni ho. Kɔ asukɔ kɛse so. Kasa kyerɛ obi a wo trust n'asɛm ho. Ma wo awofo nkyerɛkyerɛ wo deɛ ɛbɛyɛ ma wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ adi nsakrae a ɛba me nipadua mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtaa ba sɛ nipadua no nsɛso sesa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na ebetumi agye bere kakra ansa na ayɛ nsakrae. Afotu bi a wode bedi nsakrae yi ho dwuma ni: Fa w’adwene si nea wo nipadua betumi ayɛ so sen sɛnea ɛte ara kwa. Wo nipadua renyin na ɛreyɛ den, na ɛno yɛ nwonwa! Hyɛ ntade a ɛma wo ho tɔ wo na wowɔ ahotoso. Ntade a ɛfata yiye betumi aboa wo ma wo ho atɔ wo wɔ wo nipadua a ɛresakra no ho. Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka sɛnea wote nka ho asɛm. Sɛ́ ɛyɛ ɔwofo, ɔhwɛfo, adamfo, anaa ɔfotufo no, wo nkate a wobɛka akyerɛ no betumi aboa wo kɛse. Kae sɛ obiara fa eyi mu. Ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ nsakrae yi mu, sɛ ɛtɔ mmere bi mpo a ebia ɛbɛte nka saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenem apɔwmuden a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no boa ma nyiyimu fi sukuu mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nkɔsoɔ wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu boa ma wɔyɛ adesua tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho denam: Amammerɛ a ɛfa tema, nteaseɛ, ne adwenem apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ. Nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ de adi adwenemyareɛ ho dwuma na wɔanya nnwuma a ɛfata. Ahokokwaw pa a wɔde gyina ano, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne atenka mu nkuranhyɛ. Animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛbata adwenemyare ho a wɔbɛtew so, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia no. Asuafoɔ tumi a wɔde bɛma wɔn ma wɔakamfo wɔn ankasa adwenem apɔwmuden ahiadeɛ na wɔaboa wɔn atipɛnfoɔ ma wɔayɛ saa ara. Hokwan ahorow ne asetena mu mmoa wɔ sukuu mpɔtam hɔfo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ LGBTQ+ apɔwmuden ahiade ho na obu no? (bisa nyansahyɛ ahorow, hwɛ intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma ahorow mu)
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛni bɛne wo abɔ bɔbeasu mu nneyɛe ne su ho nkɔmmɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Fa akwankyerɛ ma: Fa afotu ne akwan ahorow a wobɛfa so adi atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow ho dwuma yiye na woasi gyinae a ɛfata ma. Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee: Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛnyɛ atɛn ma mmabun a wɔbɛda wɔn haw adi na wɔahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ. Gye nkate ahorow tom: Gye nhyɛso anaa ɔhaw a mmabun te nka na gye tom, na ma wɔn awerɛhyem sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobegyina wɔn ho akyi. Kamfo tumi a wɔde ma: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔmfa wɔn ho nto wɔn nkate so, nsi wɔn ahye so dua, na wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nipadua mfonini ne nna mu akwahosan ho a, ebetumi aba esiane "SOGI" nti no ho dwuma? (akuw a wɔboa, nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ahorow ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa asetra mu akwanhwɛ ahorow betumi akasa atia me gyinapɛn ne me gyidi ahorow, na mɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ ho biribi denneennen?
answer_twi_source: Ebia tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa asetra mu akwanhwɛ ahorow bɛkasa atia wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow. Wɔ saa tebea yi mu no, ɛho hia paa sɛ wobua wɔ kwan a ɛkyerɛ awerɛhyem so denam brɛoo ne akokoduru a wobɛda no adi de apere wo ahyeɛ.. Wubetumi de nidi apow sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia mu, de nyansahyɛ foforo a ɛne wo gyidi ahorow hyia ama, anaasɛ sɛ ɛho hia a, woayi wo ho afi tebea no mu. Sɛ wo ne nnamfo a wɔboa wo a wobu wo gyinapɛn ahorow atwa wo ho ahyia a, ebetumi ama woanya ahoɔden na woagye atom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn a wɔfa so de nea broni ka no 'social media' di dwuma de hyɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Kyɛ Nsɛm a Wotumi De Ho To So: Fa nsɛm fi nnipa a wɔwɔ din pa hɔ to gua. Nkrasɛm Pa: Fa w’adwene si nipadua no ahofadi, awo hokwan ahorow, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wobenya so. Obu a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Bua nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ wɔ obu mu, fa nokwasɛm ahorow ma na kwati sɛ wobɛtow ahyɛ wo ho so. Adebɔ mu Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Yɛ adwinni, nnwom, anaa nea broni ka no 'video' ahorow na ama nkurɔfo ate ase wɔ ɔkwan pa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ nhyehyɛe ma yɛkɔ hɔ daa na yɛasusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia a ɛfa me nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wobɛkɔ hɔ daa no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina sɛnea wo ho tɔ wo ne sɛnea nsɛmti a wɔresusuw ho no gye ntɛmpɛ so. Susuw ho sɛ wobɛyɛ nhyehyɛe a wode bɛba dapɛn abien biara mfiase no, na gyina nea wopɛ ne ahiade ahorow a ɛresakra so yɛ nsakrae wɔ mpɛn dodow a wobɛba no mu sɛnea ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na lɔre a wonnya kakraa bi, akwahosan ho nsiakyibaa "insurance" a wonnya, ne kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho dadwen ka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi de aba de adi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Lɔre a wonnya pii, akwahosan ho nsiakibaa "insurance" a wonnya, ne kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho dadwen betumi asiw mmabun kwan kɛse sɛ wobenya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe: Lɔre akwantu: Mmabun a wɔwɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a wonnya mmoa pii no betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛkɔ mu esiane kar akwan a wonnya, akwan tenten, anaa ɔmanfo kar a wonnya nti. Eyi betumi ama wɔakyɛ anaasɛ wɔapa bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nnwuma a ɛho hia. Akwahosan Ho Insurance: Ebia mmabun a wonni akwahosan ho insurance no bɛpere sɛ wɔbɛtua akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho ka, a ayaresabea nsrahwɛ, nnuru, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ka ho. Sɛ wonni insurance a, wobetumi agyae ɔhwɛ a ɛho hia anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto nnwuma a egye ntɛmpɛ a mpɛn pii no ɛho ka yɛ den na ɛnyɛ nea ɛkɔ akyiri so. Ahintasɛm ne Kokoam Nsɛm: Ahintasɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho dadwen betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, titiriw sɛ wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no a. Kokoam ahobammɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni anaasɛ osuahu ahorow a ɛfa animtiaabu ne nyiyim a efi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ ho no betumi ama saa dadwen ahorow yi ayɛ kɛse bio. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma no, akwan horow no betumi ayɛ: Mmoa a wɔde fa akwantu ho: Wɔde akwantu ho nnwuma anaa mmoa a wɔde bɛma mmabun ma wɔanya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne fekubɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde tra kar mu, anaa sukuu akwantu ho dwumadie. Akwahosan Insurance a Wɔde Wɔn Di Dwuma: Mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwahosan insurance a wɔde kyerɛw wɔn din ho ama mmabun a wɔfata nanso wɔankyerɛw wɔn din wɔ "Medicaid", "CHIP," anaa ɔman insurance nhyehyɛe afoforo mu, na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtrɛw sika a wɔde tua ankorankoro ne mmusua a wonnya sika pii no mu. Ahintasɛm Ho Banbɔ: Hwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow no wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho ban, a nea ɛka ho ne nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a wɔde sie ne akwan a wobetumi afa so ayɛ kokoam nnwuma ho. Sukuu mu Dwumadie: Akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu anaa ayaresabea a wɔde fa baabiara a wɔde nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam ma wɔ beaeɛ hɔ no bedi dwuma, a ɛbɛtew akwansideɛ a ɛfa akwantuo ne kokoamsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ, a telefon so akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, telefon so dwumadi ahorow, intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, ne abɛɛfo ntentanfidie ka ho adi dwuma de ama mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, afotu, ne mmoa, titiriw wɔ mmeae a wɔmfa mmoa nyɛ adwuma yiye anaasɛ ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mfiridwuma, a telehealth services, mobile apps, ne ntentanfidie so dwumakuo ka ho adi dwuma de ama mmabun kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, afotu, ne mmoa atu mpɔn: Telehealth Services: Ntentanfidie so a wohyia so di dwuma fa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ma mmabun atumi anya ɔhwɛ wɔ akyirikyiri, titire wɔ mmeaeɛ a wɔmfa mmoa mma anaa akyirikyiri a wɔmma wɔn kwan pii de kɔ nnwuma a wɔyɛ wɔ ankasa mu. Mobile Apps ne Online Platforms: Mobile applications ne online platforms a wɔreyɛ a ɛma nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, nneɛma a wɔde di nkitaho a wɔde di brayɛ anaa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma akyi, ne kokoam nkrasɛm a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo. Social Media ne Online Communities: Social media platforms ne online communities a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyekyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, ayɛ atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow, na ama mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde ntentanfidie di. Digitals Counseling and Chat Services: Digitals counseling services, chatbots, anaa text-based helplines a ɛma kokoam mmoa, afotu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho, a ɛma mmabun pɛ ntentanfidie so nkitahodi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya ayaresa ho animdefo, anaa afotufo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun adwenemyare ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa betumi aboa wo ma woadi w’adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma anaasɛ ɔne oduruyɛfo titiri bi adi nkitaho de aboa wo bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow ne ahyɛde ahorow nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho mfonini a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu no so nsunsuanso, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ gyinabea ahorow a obu wom, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛnyɛ nea wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow ne ahyɛde ahorow nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho mfonini a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu no so nsunsuanso. Ebia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ binom bɛda amammerɛ mu su ne gyidi ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw adi na wɔahyɛ mu den, bere a afoforo nso betumi akasa atia anaasɛ asɛe no. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ananmusifo a obu wom, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛnyɛ nea wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho nkuran no, ɛsɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo de nneɛma ahorow ne ananmusifo di kan, wɔne mpɔtam ahorow di nkitaho de hwɛ hu sɛ mfonini ahorow no yɛ nokware, na wɔkasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a epira. Bio nso, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no bɛtumi aboa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn hyia, de nsɛm ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ abɔfoɔ ne nhyiamu ahodoɔ, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde obuo ne ananmusifoɔ ka nnipa nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn pɔtee na twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho kyerɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛkwati sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nkitahodi ho a ɔne ɔhokafo bi bɛka ho. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu, akyi berɛmo, ne ano, ne dwumadi afoforo a ɛbɛn a ebetumi ama obi anya nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa akɔhyɛn mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nnuru a wɔde si nyinsɛn ano bere a meyɛ ɔbabun, na akwan bɛn na metumi afa so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so anya nnuru a wɔde si nyinsɛn ano, a nea ɛka ho ne: ɔyaresafo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔsra, te sɛ oduruyɛfo titiriw, anaa awoɔ ho ayaresabea, baabi a wobetumi anya afotuo, nhwehwɛmu, ne nnuru a wɔde si nyinsɛn ano. Apɔwmuden asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu anaa ayaresabea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔdi awoɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam,  afotuo ne nnuru a dɔkta atwerɛ. Nnuru a wɔde si nyinsɛn ano a wɔtɔn a wɔmfa nnuru nhyɛ mu, te sɛ kɔndɔm anaa nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ, a wɔbɛtɔ wɔ nnurutɔnbea anaa sotɔɔ ahorow mu a dɔkta annkyerɛ ho krataa. Internet so nneɛma ne telefon so apɔwmuden ho nnwuma a ɛde nsɛm, anim a wobisa, ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde anifere de kɔ wɔn afie mu no mu nhwehwɛmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo "healthcare providers" ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma no betumi ayɛ mmeae a ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu den na ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma ankorankoro bɔbeasu ne nea wɔpɛ, na wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ama mmabun nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma no bɛtumi ayɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛsi ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam na ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma ankorankoro bɔbeasuo "gender identity" ne wɔn a wɔpɛ denam nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛhyɛ nidi, obuo, ne ahofadie ho nkuran ma ayarefoɔ nyinaa a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Eyi ka ho ne ɔhwɛ ne dwumadie a ɛsi ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam a ɛdi mmabun nyinaa ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma, a ɛfa ahiadeɛ pɔtee a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ahodoɔ ho Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi anya nteteeɛ a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ne amammerɛ mu ahobrɛaseɛ ho de ate nnipa ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ ase yie na wɔadi ho dwuma, na wɔbɛtumi de kasa ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho a ɛsi ankorankoro bɔbeasuo ne wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛmu so dua. Bio nso, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de nhyehyɛe ne akwan horow a nyiyim nnim a ɛbɔ ayarefo ho ban fi nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna anaa nea wɔda no adi so adi dwuma. Mmabun betumi akamfo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde si ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so dua na ɛka obiara ho denam nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfa mmabun ankorankoro nyinaa ahiade ho, wɔbɛkamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe mu na ama ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna tu mpɔn, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛka obiara ho ma a wɔbɛboa no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako tia nneyɛeɛ a enni obu (te sɛ victim-blaming) ne wɔn wɔyɛ basabasa?
answer_twi_source: Kasa, ma nkurɔfo nhu, hyɛ obu ho nkuran, na da tema adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛko tia nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, a adwuma a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ, mmofra adwuma, ne nnipa a wɔtɔn wɔn ka ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi ahu ayayade a ɛte saa na wɔabɔ amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ahobammɔ a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, a adwuma a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ, mmofra adwuma, ne wɔn a wɔtɔn wɔn ka ho no bi ne: Mmara kwan so bara: Mmara ne amanaman ntam apam ahorow bara adwuma a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ, mmofra adwuma, ne wɔn a wɔtɔn wɔn, na wɔde asotwe a emu yɛ den to wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no so na wɔde ahobammɔ ma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no. Amanneɛbɔ akwan: Mmabun bɛtumi ahu na wɔabɔ ayayade a ɛte saa ho amanneɛ denam: Hokwan ahorow a wonim: Adwumayɛ ho mmara, nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow, ne sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn di dwuma, te sɛ akwantu a wɔabara, akatua a wontua, anaa nhyɛso a wɔbɛte ase. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ: Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akyerɛkyerɛfo, asetra mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo, anaa mmarahyɛ baguafo a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne ahobammɔ sɛ wosusuw sɛ wɔde wɔn di dwuma anaasɛ wɔtɔn wɔn a. Mmoa nhama a wɔde bedi dwuma: Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, telefon a wɔde boa, anaa mmoa adwuma a aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, NGO ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nnipa a wɔtɔn wɔn ne mmofra adwumayɛ ho nsɛm mu na wɔhwɛ so no a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so, na emu nea ɛwɔ he na mmabun betumi anya bi wɔ kokoam?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma ahorow a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so ne nea mmabun betumi anya wɔ kokoam nso gu ahorow gyina mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔman anaa ɔmantam no mu so. Mpɛn pii no, nnwuma a ɛfa aduruyɛ mu akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaa aduruyɛ mu asiane akɛse te sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu anaa oprehyɛn ahorow bi ho no betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so. Nanso, ebia wobetumi anya nnwuma te sɛ afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne adwenemyare ho afotu wɔ kokoam ama mmabun a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ aman pii mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ nipadua mfonini ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia saa gyidie ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya wɔ nipadua mfonini ho no bi ne: Atrosɛm: "Nipadua a ɛyɛ tratraa anaa ntini nkutoo na ɛyɛ fɛ." Atosɛm: "Sɛ obi sesa ne honam ani hwɛbea a, ɛbɛma wanya anigye ne abotɔyam." Atrosɛm: "Obiara wɔ nipadua a ɛyɛ." Mmabun betumi akasa atia gyidi ahorow yi denam: Nsusuii a Ɛyɛ Katee: Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne ahoɔfɛ ho adwene a wɔda no adi wɔ media mu a wobegye ho kyim ne gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu a wɔbɛkasa atia no so ho. Ne Ho a Wogye Tom: Ankorankoro nsonsonoeɛ a wogye tom na wobu su horow a ɛboro honam ani hwɛbea so. Media ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso de ahu na wɔakasa atia ahoɔfɛ ho mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ media so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de akyerɛkyerɛ me nna ho akwahosan ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun akwahosan ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa ayarefo hokwan ahorow ne akwahosan ho mmara ho ma. Nhomasua nneɛma ne nkratawa a akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ne ahyehyɛde ahorow de ma. Mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa mmabun akuw a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔde nneɛma ne mmoa a ɛfa akwahosan ho akwan ahorow ho ma. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne nhyiamu a wobɛtumi abisa nsɛm na wo ne akwahosan ho mmara ho abenfoɔ adi nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me hokafo, m’abusua, anaa nnipa afoforo a megye wɔn di ahyɛ mu wɔ berɛ mayi nyisen aguo na meregye ayeresa, sɛ mepaw sɛ mɛyɛ saa a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopaw sɛ wode wo hokafo, w’abusua, anaa nnipa afoforo a wogye wɔn di bɛka wo nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ne wo ho a wobɛsan anya ho a: Ka W’ahiade Ho asɛm: Ka w’ahiade, wo nkate, ne ahyeɛ ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ wɔn. Hwehwɛ Nkate mu Mmoa: Sɛ wuhia nkate fam mmoa anaa obi a wo ne no bɛkasa afa wo suahu no ho a, ma wɔnhu. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wɔn: Fa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne ɔhwɛ a wɔhwɛ wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔn na aboa wɔn ma wɔate nea worefa mu no ase. Bisa Mmoa: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛsrɛ mmoa a mfaso wɔ so wɔ nnwuma anaa asɛyɛde ahorow ho bere a wode w’adwene si wo ho a wobɛsan ayɛ so no. Bu Wo Kokoam Nsɛm: Ka nsɛm a wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wobɛka ne nea wopɛ sɛ wode sie no pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔde digital akwan horow redi dwuma de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ama mmabun, na mfaso ne anohyeto ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ saa kwan yi so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde digital akwan di dwuma de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ (CSE) ma mmabun denam: Intanɛt so adesua ahorow so: Interactive e-learning modules ka nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua mu nkwaadɔm, mmabunbere, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne nna mu akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho asɛm. Webinars ne live chats: Virtual sessions a akyerɛkyerɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di anim no ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa SRH nsɛmti ho no yɛ mmerɛw, bua nsɛmmisa, na ɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ bere ankasa mu. Multimedia nneɛma: Video, infographics, nsɛmmisa, ne agodie ma adesua yɛ nea ɛyɛ anigye na ɛyɛ nea wotumi nya, na ɛma adesua akwan horow ne nea wɔpɛ di dwuma. Nsɛnnennen ne anohyeto ahorow: Bere a dijitaal akwan ma wotumi yɛ nsakrae na wotumi sesa no, nsɛnnennen no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, wobedi kokoam nsɛm ho haw ahorow ho dwuma, na woadu mmabun a wonni intanɛt anaa dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ kakraa bi nkyɛn. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma: adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛwɔ SRH so nyinaa a wɔbɛhunu afiri digyital platform ahodoɔ no so na wɔadi ho dwuma denam akwan korɔ no ara so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya sika a wɔde di ho asɛde mu na wɔatwe wɛnho efiri sɛɛ wɔbɛtɔ ɛka mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sika a wɔde di ho asɛde sɛ ɛnam sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ, ɛka a wodi akyi, nsonsonoe a ɛda ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ntam, atwe wɔn ho efiri atotɔ atotɔ mu, sika a wɔbɛdi ho nhyehyeɛ ahorow a wɔde besi hɔ, ne ka a wobetua wɔ bere ano no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde sika a wɔde sie ne nea broni ka no 'emergency funds' nso di kan na wɔatwe wɔn ho efiri sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto boseabɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wobetumi de anansesɛm, kasamafo, ne social media adi dwuma sɛ nnwinnade a wɔde bɛma nkorɔfo ate ase, akasa atia animtiaabu, na waɔhyɛ ngyetom ne nkabom wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm, kasamafo, ne social media betumi: Ama nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ayɛ nea nnipa tumi te ase denam ankorankoro asɛm, osuahun, ne adwene a wɔde bɛkyɛ so, a ɛbɛma wɔanya tema, abusuabɔ, ne ntease wɔ atiefo ahorow mu. Kanyan nnipa a wɔte ase, ma nne a wɔato wɔn sintidua no nyɛ kɛse, na fa intanɛt so dwumadi, hashtag ɔsatu, ne digital abasɛm a wɔka ho nhyehyɛe so twa animtiaabu ho mpoa. Ma atipɛnfoɔ mmoa, mpɔtam a wɔbɛkyekyere, ne nnipa a wɔbom yɛ adwuma no ayɛ mmerɛ, ma mmabun tumi ma wɔde asetena mu nsakraeɛ pa aba, hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbu akontaa firi nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ no hɔ, na wɔkamfo wɔn hokwan ne wɔn yiedie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkɔso ho akwan horow a ɛko tia wim tebea na ɛtra hɔ daa betumi aboa ma mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH)aba no atu mpɔn, a mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtew ɛnanom a wowuwu so, asiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, na wɔama mmabun yiyedi ho nkuran ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan Nhyehyɛeɛ: Sika a wɔde bɛto akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnwuma a ɛtumi gyina ano mu de hwɛ sɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH)  dwumadie bɛkɔ so wɔ asiane ne wim tebea a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛ di ani kɔ ho. Mpɔtam Hɔ Tumi: Wɔboa nnwuma a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ di anim ma kuayɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa, ahoɔden a ɛho tew, ne nsuo a wɔde di dwuma, a ɛboa ma ASRH nsunsuansoɔ tu mpɔn denam asetena mu nneɛma a ɛhyɛ akwahosan ho a wɔdi ho dwuma no so. Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Wim nsakrae ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH)  nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de ama mmabun anya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw tumi ma wɔatumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia mu nsakrae mu na wɔabɔ wɔn akwahosan ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ, wɔn mmusua, mpɔtam hɔfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bebu wɔn awo ho gyinaesi ahorow na wɔaboa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi wɔn awo ho gyinaesi ahorow so na wɔboa wɔn wɔ ɔkwan bi sei: Nkitahodi a wɔne wɔn mmusua, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bedi nkitaho pefee ne nokwaredi mu afa wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Nneɛma a ɛbɛboa ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo mmabun awo hokwan ahorow kyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛka ho asɛm na wɔakamfo wɔn ho sɛ wohyia akwanside anaa nyiyim a. Abusuabɔ a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde ɔhwɛ a egyina ayarefo so di kan na wobu mmabun ahofadi no benya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow bi a abu so wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho, na kwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔ mpɔtam ne amammerɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no bi ne: Adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ ahokatasie ho ne nna mu ahotew ho. Bɔbeasu dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa aware ne abusua ho. Nkwa mu kronyɛ ne bere a efi ase. Amanneɛ kwan so nneyɛe a ɛfa awo ne mmofra ntetee ho. Saa gyidi ahorow yi betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse wɔ mpɔtam ne amammrɛ ahorow mu, a nneɛma te sɛ asase ho nsɛm, abakɔsɛm, ne nyamesom nkyerɛwee ahorow a wɔkyerɛ ase nya so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan foforo bɛn na mmabun fa so nya sika anaasɛ wonya agyapade a ɛboro sikakorabea anaa sika a wɔde asie a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so anya sika anaasɛ wɔbɛkyekye agyapade a ɛboro sikakorabea anaa sika a wɔde asie a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adwuma ketewa bi a wobefi ase: Ahokokwaw anaa anigyede a wɔde bedi dwuma de nneɛma anaa nnwuma bi ama, te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ, nsaanodwuma, anaa adwuma a wɔyɛ a wɔde wɔn ho. Gig sikasɛm mu kyɛfa a wode bɛhyɛ mu: Bere tiaa mu nnwuma anaa freelance hokwan ahorow a wobɛfa denam platform ahorow te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  TaskRabbit, Fiverr, anaa Uber so. Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Crowdfunding: Abɛɛfo ntentan so akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de aboaboa sika ano ama ankorankoro nnwuma, adebɔ mmɔdenbɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma. Atipɛnfoɔ boseabɔ anaa sikasɛm nketewa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Sika a wɔde bɛto anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ bosea afiri mpɔtam hɔ boseabɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu de aboa nnwumayɛbea anaa ankorankoro nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu wɔn ahoɔden, wɔn anigye, ne adwuma a wɔ pɛ de akyerɛ wɔn ahokokwaw nkɔso mmɔdenbɔ kwan?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu wɔn ahoɔden, wɔn anigyede, ne adwuma a wɔpɛ denam wɔn ankasa nhwehwɛmu apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, adwuma a wɔhwehwɛ mu dwumadi ahorow, ne akwankyerɛ a efi afotufo anaa adwuma ho afotufo hɔ so. Sɛ mmabun susuw osuahu ahorow a atwam, nneɛma a wɔde gye wɔn ani, adesua mu nsɛm, dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua ho, ne wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow ho a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔahu mmeae a wɔn anigye ho ne akwan a wobetumi afa so ayɛ adwuma. Nsɛm a wobisabisa nkurɔfo, adwuma ho sunsuma, anaa adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wɔyɛ wɔ nnwuma ahorow mu no ma mmabun nya nnwuma ne adwuma ahorow ho nimdeɛ, na ɛboa wɔn ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn daakye adwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa mpaninfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya dabere ne adan ho nhyehyɛe bere a wohyia ɔhaw bi, bere a wɔkyerɛ obuo ma wɔn ahofadi ne kokoam nsɛm nso?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔhwɛ dabere ne wɔn a wɔde adansiɛ ma no di dwuma titire wɔ mmoa ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ wɔn tena mu no mu. Nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ nnwuma a wɔde ma ho no betumi ayɛ: Dabere a ahobammɔ ne ahobammɔ wom. Nneɛma a ɛho hia titiri te sɛ aduan, ntade, ne ahotew ho nneɛma. Asɛm ho dwumadie ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bedi ahiadeɛ a ɛhia ntɛm ne botaeɛ a ɛbɛkyɛ ho dwuma. Akwahosan ho dwumadie, afotuo, ne ahokyere mu dwumadie mmoa a wobenya. Mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nhomasua, adwumayɛ, asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso, ne adan a ɛbɛkɔ so agyina pintinn ho nhyehyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na nipadua ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a broni ka no 'media' mu no nte sɛ me de?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa da nipadua kakraa ahohorow ne senea w'anim ɛte adi. Eyi nyɛ nokware kɛkɛ! Nnipa gu ahorow, wɔn kɛse, mmusuakuw, nea wotumi yɛ, ne mmarima ne mmea nyinaa. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa de ne broni ka no 'editing, makeup, ne casting' pɔtee a wɔpaw di dwuma de yɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware. Nea wohu wɔ TV so anaa Intanɛt so no nyɛ sɛnea ahoufɛ yɛ wɔ nnipa ahohorow nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛfaso atoto wɔn dwumadie wɔ sukuu ne sika mmoa nhwehwɛyɛ mu yie?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nsiesie to hɔ ma daakye (Plan ahead). Hwehwɛ mmoa (Seek support). Di nneɛma ehia kan. Hyehyɛ wo nneɛma yie (Stay organized).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mɛko atia nsusuiɛ hunu a amammerɛ anaa ankornkorɔ wɔ fa mmabunyɛ mmerɛ ne nna mu agorɔ ho apɔwmuden nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Sua nwoma ɛda amammerɛ biara ne ne nkyerɛkyerɛ adi fa saa nsɛm yi ho. Bisa santi a binom wɔ nsusuiɛ bi na hwehwɛ noware a ɛwɔ mu. Ka nsɛmpa a ɛhyɛ nkuran. Sɛ wote nsɛm bi a ɛnnyɛ nokware a, fa ahobrɛaseɛ da nokware no adi. Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte obia ase. Fa wo suahunu hyɛ nkuran, na pɛ sɛ dodoɔ no ara adwene mu bɛdɔ wɔ amammerɛ ne nea amaneɛbɔfo ne sinitwafoɔ yi kyerɛ nyinaa. Ko tia nyiyimu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ne mpaninfoɔ ayɛ adwuma abom de ahyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a ɛkyerɛ obuo na ɛka atetesɛm mu nimdeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ bom ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ne mpaninfoɔ ayɛ adwuma abom de ahyɛ u amammerɛ a ɛfata nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne dwumadie ho nkuran denam nkɔmmɔdie, obuo a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne ahotosoɔ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ so. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔde atetesɛm mu nimdeɛ ne nneyɛe bɛka nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ho, ahwɛ ahu sɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma no yɛ nea wotumi nya, ɛnyɛ atɛn, na wobu amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow. Ɛnam sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom so no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi asiesie nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ama wɔadi mmabun ahiadeɛ pɔtee ne wɔn apɛdeɛ ho dwuma berɛ a wɔrehyɛ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ pa ne tumidi ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne abusua betumi aboa wɔn mma a wɔadi dɛm wɔ abusuabɔ, ayɔnkofa, ne nna mu akwahosan a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi aboa wɔn mma denam: Nhomasua a Ɛfata Mfe a Wɔde Ma: Wɔbɛka nna mu nkɔso, abusuabɔ pa, ne pene a wɔpene so ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a wobetumi anya so. Nneɛma a Ɛhaw Wo Ho a Wobedi Ho Dwuma: Bue w’ani ma nsɛmmisa na di ho dwuma nokwaredi ne nkate mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wɔbɛhyɛ Ho Nkuran: Boa ɔpɛ a wo ba wɔ sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ abusuabɔ mu, sɛ ɛnyɛ nea ɛde aniberesɛm bi mma mpo a. Ankasa Ho Nsɛm a Wɔbɛhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ba no ma ɔnka n’ahiade ne n’ahye ho asɛm wɔ abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa nsɛm te sɛ ohia, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a enni hɔ (gender inequality), ne ntawntawdi ha nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awoɔ ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun nya?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyina afa mu no, ohia tumi yɛ akwansidie ma nkyerɛkyerɛ papa mmabun nya fa nnamu agodie ne awoɔ ho. Sɛ mmoa nni hɔ sukuu pii noa nntumi nnyɛ saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi bi. Gender inequality so tumi si mma kwan ma wonnya nimdie a ɛfata. Amammerɛ bi wɔ hɔ, ɛnam sɛ mmaa awareɛ hyɛ ase ntɛm nti mmabun nntumi nnkɔ sukuu ɛnnu akyire. Bio so, mmea a ako taa si wɔ no tumi de saa ɔhaw yi bi ba, efi sɛ ntɔkwa no ma wodwane fi wɔn kuro mu 'displacement'. Wei so ha adesua. Nhyehyɛeɛ te sɛ Girls in Poverty, betumi aboa ma akwasidie yi efi hɔ. Mobile clinics ne mpɔtam nhyehyɛeɛ betumi aboa wɔn ntɔkwa nti w'ayera. Yebetumi so akanya mmaa denam sika dwadie mu nhyehyɛeɛ ma ɔmo anya nkyerɛkyerɛ a ahia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ aman a wɔde nneɛma mena ne nea wogye nyinaa mu betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ahwɛ mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforo no na wɔanya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ aman a wɔde kɔ ne aman a wokra nyinaa mu no betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ahwɛ na wɔanya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nnwuma ama mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforo denam nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu a wɔde bɛma, akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn kɔ mmeae foforo a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den, ntetee a wɔde ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ, te sɛ kasa ne nkrataa a wɔhwehwɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na ɛfata sɛ nnuruyɛfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ mu kyerɛ mmabun na ama wɔate nea wɔrepene so ho asɛm no ase yie pɛpɛɛpɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn nsa aka nsɛm a ɛho hia nyinaa denam: Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw anaa pene nkrataa a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de ama a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɔe ne nsɛmmisa biara a wobisa ho kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛyɛ. Adwene a ɛto so abien a wɔbɛhwehwɛ anaasɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo afoforo a wobesusuw ho sɛ ɛho hia a na ama wɔanya ntease a edi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho adesua nhyehyɛe no di nnipa a wɔyɛ, osuahu ahorow, ne ahiade ahorow ho dwuma, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, ne mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma yiye ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho adesua nhyehyɛe no bɔ mmɔden sɛ edi nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, osuahu ahorow, ne ahiade ahorow ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, ne mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonni mmoa yiye. Saa nkabom yi ho hia na ama asuafo nyinaa ate nka sɛ wohu wɔn, wɔte wɔn, na wobu wɔn. Adesua nhyehyɛe no betumi de nsɛm a egye nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ na esi so dua bɛka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛka nsɛnnennen soronko ne akwanside ahorow a mmabun hyia wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu nso ho dwuma. Bio nso, adesua nhyehyɛe no betumi asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔka kasa a ɛka obiara ho, nkitahodi a obu wom, ne mmeae a wɔboa ma wɔhyɛ asuafo nyinaa yiyedi ho nkuran no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu ɔhaw, na nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia no bi ne dɛn a?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu haw kyerɛ nsɛnnennen a ɛba wɔ nna mu mmuae kyinhyia no fã biara mu, na ɛka tumi a obi tumi nya anigye anaasɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu. Nneɛma a ɛtaa ba: Erectile Dysfunction: Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobenya ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna anaasɛ wobɛkɔ so akura mu. Premature Ejaculation: Nsuo a ɛba ansa na wɔpɛ. Delayed Ejaculation: Ɛyɛ den anaasɛ wontumi nnya mma. Low Libido: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho anigye a ɛso tew. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a ɛyɛ yaw: Ɛyaw a ɛba bere a obi renya nna mu kyɛfa anaa bere a obi renya nna akyi. Orgasmic Disorders: Ɛyɛ den sɛ obedu orgasm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aka mmabun ntease ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wodi wɔn nipadua mu ahofadi no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya mmabun ntease ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wodi wɔn ho so wɔ nipadua mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Nhwɛsoɔ, wɔ amammerɛ anaa ɔsom ahorow bi mu no, ebia akwanhwɛ anaa gyinapɛn ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa ahobrɛase, ahotew, anaa osetie a wɔyɛ ma atumfoɔ ho, na ebetumi aka sɛnea mmabun hu na wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ nipadua mu ahofadi no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛfa pene, obuo, ne abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuo, sukuu ahorow, intanɛt so mpɔtam, ne ɔmanfo a wɔtrɛ mu, na nhyehyɛe anaa ɔsatu bɛn na wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔakamfo nsakrae?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛfa pene, obu, ne abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw, sukuu, intanɛt so mpɔtam, ne ɔmanfo a wɔtrɛw mu denam: - Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe anaa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛma nkurɔfo hu nna mu basabasayɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa mu. - a wobegye adwumayɛbea, nkɔmmɔbɔ, anaa nsɛm a esisi de akyerɛkyerɛ atipɛnfo wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wobehu na wɔasiw ano ho. - a wokasa tia nsusuii hunu, suban, ne suban a epira a eboa ma basabasayɛ ne nyiyim amammerɛ ba. - a wode boa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no denam tie a wɔbɛtie a wonni atemmuo, tema ne validation a wɔde bɛma, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛka nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie ho. Nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu ne ahyehyɛdeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a ɛde siw ano, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no ho akontabuo di kan a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mate ase na makyerɛ hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so, anaa nhyɛso ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woate wo mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ase na woakyerɛ wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so, anaa nhyɛso ho: Asetra mu yiyedi dwumadibea ahorow, anaa mmoa akuw betumi de kokoam afotu, nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi, ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ mmara adwumayɛbea ahorow ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm, mmoa, anaa mmoa wɔ mmara mu nsɛm mu. Mmara mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, anaa nnwuma a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun so betumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow, pene a wɔpene so, ne mmara kwan so akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi ɔhaw anaa ɔtowhyɛ ho dwuma ama. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne mmoa ama wɔ mmara kwan so nneɛma a wobenya, nsɛm a esisi ho amanneɛbɔ, ne mmara kwan so nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛfa so bere a wɔde w’ahobammɔ, yiyedi, ne hokwan ahorow di kan no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so hu nsɛm a ɛhaw  anaa ɛdaadaa  nna mu apɔmuden ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ Fibea no: Hwehwɛ mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow, nnuruyɛ adwumakuo ahorow, ne nsɛm a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu. Hwɛ Abenfo: Sɛ wunnim nsɛm a, kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa nna mu akwahosan ho akyerɛkyerɛfo nkyɛn. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa abɛɛfo ntentan beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so. Nsɛmmisa a Wɔka: Bisa nsɛm a ɛho hia fa nsɛm a wɔka wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm mu ho. So wɔde adanse gyina akyi? Nhwehwɛmu: Gye bere hwehwɛ nsɛmti mu kɔ akyiri na ama woanya ntease a ɛkɔ akyiri. Kyɛ Nsɛm a Ɛyɛ Nokware: Sɛ wuhu nsɛm a ɛdaadaa nkurɔfo a, kyɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware kyerɛ afoforo na ama woatumi ako atia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔbɛka wɔn ho na wɔagye wɔn atom wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahohorow mu no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ: Tete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ animhwɛ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho a wɔbɛhunu na wɔadi ho dwuma. Nsɛnkyerɛnne Pa: Fa nkrataa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu kyerɛ. Dɛmdifo Ahantan Afahyɛ: Di Amanaman Ntam Nnipa a Wɔadi M dɛm Da (December 3rd) de ma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ na wɔhyɛ nkabom nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne ahotoso a obi wɔ wɔ ne ho di wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso na ɛkwan bɛn so na ɛbɔ adwene mu akwahosan ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Ma obi nya ne ho anidie ne nteaseɛ a ɛyɛ den, na ama ɔtumi agyina amanneɛ anaa mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ ano. Ɛma obi nya ne ho anidie ne nea ɔyɛ ho nteaseɛ a emu yɛ den, na ɛte nea ɛbɛtumi atwe no afiri ne kwan so.Ɛma nnipa tumi nya akokoduro ka wɔn hyeɛ anaa nneɛma a ɛyɛ asiane ho asɛm, na wɔtumi si wɔn gyinaeɛ: Ɛma nnipa nya ahoɔden a wɔde ka wɔn hyeɛ anaa nneɛma a wɔn ani nnye ho asɛm, na wɔtumi si wɔn gyinaeɛ a obiara nhyɛ wɔn, na wɔtumi gyina mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ a ɛbɛma wɔayɛ nneɛma bɔne ano.Ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban firi adwenemhaw, anihaw anaa ne ho anidie a ɛba fam a ɛfiri mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ mu ba : Ɛbɔ nnipa ho ban firi adwenemhaw, anihaw, anaa ne ho anidie a ɛba fam a ɛfiri mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ mu ba no ho.Ɛma obi nya ahoɔden ne akokoduro a ɔde gyina nsɛnnennen, aperepereɛ, ne asetena mu nhyɛsoɔ ano a ɛmfa ne adwene mu yiyedi nsi
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow, afotuo nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wotumi yɛ adwuma mu de ama wɔn nimdeɛ, ne ahotoso a wɔwɔ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, intanɛt so nhyiamu, anaa mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛma wonya atenaeɛ a wɔde bɛkyɛ osuahu, nneɛma, ne afotuo a wobɛka ho. Afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun a wɔn mfe akɔ anim anaa mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo de akwankyerɛ, nkuranhyɛ, ne hokwan ahorow ma wɔ ahokokwaw nkɔso mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nhyiamu, ntetee, ne nhyiamu a wɔkɔɔ no twee adwene sii nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi, akannifoɔ, ne nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmti so. Nnwuma ne ɔsatu a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo bom yɛ de di nsɛnnennen a ɛtaa ba ho dwuma, bɛhyɛ wɔn nne mu den, na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Mmabun akwahosan akuw a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na ɛwɔ nimdie a ɛmu dɔ ɛfa nna ho nkyerekyere (comprehensive sex education) mu na aden nti na ɛho hia sɛ yɛbɛ sua ɛnnɛma yi?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a emu dɔ kata nsɛm ahorow pii so. Nea ɛka ho titiriw ne:Onipa nipadua ne sɛnea awo ne nna ho akwahosan yɛ adwuma. Amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ ahorow (STIs), HIV/AIDS, ne nna ho nsɛm afoforo ho. Akwan a yɛfa so si nna ano, ne sɛnea yɛde di dwuma yie. Abusuabɔ mu nkakakyerɛ ho akwan, nea ɛfata ne nea ɛmfata a yebesi ho gyinaeɛ. Ase hwehwɛ a ɛfa apene, ahyeɛ, ne abusuabɔ pa ne deɛ ɛnnye ho ho. Sɛnea yɛbɛyɛ den na yɛampo nsɛm a mmofra afoforo de ba sɛ wɔnyɛ. Yɛn ankasa gyinapɛn ne adwene a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho a yɛbɛhwehwɛ mu.Ɛho hia sɛ yesua nsɛm yi na yɛatumi asi gyinaeɛ a emu da hɔ, abɔ yɛn ho ban, na yɛanya nna ho suban a ɛfata na ɛyɛ asɛyɛdeɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ada nea efi nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu mu aba adi akyerɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn a ɔbabun no mpene so?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi nka nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu mu aba nkyerɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn a ɔbabun no mpene so, titiriw sɛ wobu ɔbabun no sɛ mmara kwan so fata sɛ osi gyinae wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho a. Mmara a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho bɔ ankorankoro a wɔreyɛ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa no kokoam nsɛm ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa adwuma anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔahyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmoa dwumadi ahorow te sɛ afotu, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛ wɔde bedi mmabun a wɔahyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim wɔ akwahosan ho mmeae ahorow no ahiade ahorow ho dwuma wɔ hɔ. Saa nnwuma yi de nkate fam mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nneɛma a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa wɔn suahu ahorow mu na wɔanya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anammɔn a wɔfa so de siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ nea broni ka no 'emergency contraception' di dwuma yie, na sɛ wɔwɔ nsemmisa anaa dadwen wɔ sɛnea etu mpɔn anaa osuahu a wonya bere a wɔanom akyi a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a wɔfa so de siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ nea broni ka no 'emergency contraception'  di dwuma yiye no gu ahorow gyina ɔkwan a wɔpaw so (sɛ nhwɛso no, aduru, aduru a wɔde fa awotwaa mu). Ɛsɛsɛ mmabun di akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama aduru no akyi na sɛ wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ sɛnea etu mpɔn anaa osuahu a wonyae bere a wɔanom akyi a, kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, ne nnwuma a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn de adi nna mu basabasayɛ ho dwuma wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne akyirikyiri, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no anya mmoa ne nneɛma a wohia na wɔasa yareɛ na wɔahwehwɛ atɛntrenee?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa afa nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, ne nnwuma a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn a wɔde bedi nna mu basabasayɛ ho dwuma denam: Nhumu a wɔbɛma akɔ so: Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, adesrɛ ahorow, ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de ama ɔmanfo ahu sɛnea nna mu basabasayɛ abu so ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so no na wɔakamfo mmara kwan so adeyɛ. Mmarahyɛ Baguafo a Wɔbɛhwehwɛ Wɔn: Aban mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ, kurow no mu asa ahorow nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de abɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe mu, sika a wɔde boa mmoa adwuma a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina adanse so a wɔde siw ano a wɔde bedi dwuma. Wɔn a wɔanya nkwa mu a wɔbɛboa wɔn: Mmoa ne biakoyɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu denam wɔn nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛka wɔ obu ne abrabɔ pa mu, ne nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a ɛfa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so. Wɔn a wɔne Apamfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom: Yɛne akuo foforɔ a wɔkamfo nsɛm, mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bɛyɛ adwuma abom de akyekye nkabom, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔama mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban no nkɛntɛnsoɔ ayɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina nneyɛe a ɛnteɛ anaasɛ ɛnyɛ mmoa a m’awofo anaa m’abusua mufo de ma wɔ me bɔbeasu ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no ano?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa mmoa akuw a wobetumi de ntease, adansedi, ne akwankyerɛ ama hɔ. Fa wo ho hwɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ adwene mu nhumu, nsɛmma nhoma kyerɛw, apɔ ateneatene, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi di dwuma na ama woadi adwennwen ho dwuma na woakura nkate mu yiyedi mu. Fa ahye hyehyɛ wo ne abusua mufo sɛ nkitahodi ahorow no bɛyɛ nea epira anaasɛ ɛhaw adwene wɔ nkate fam a, na fa w’ankasa ahobammɔ ne w’adwene mu akwahosan di kan sen mmɔden a wobɛbɔ sɛ wobɛsakra wɔn suban. Hwehwɛ ayaresa anaa afotu akwan a wobɛfa so ne adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo a ɔwɔ osuahu a ɔne mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ne mmusua yɛ adwuma de di nkate horow ho dwuma na wɔyɛ akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo mu nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi anya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodi mu so nkɛntɛnso anaa?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo mu nneɛma betumi anya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodi mu nkɛntɛnso. Ebia eyinom bi ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho, tumi a ɛkɔ so, ne adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ basabasayɛ ho. Bio nso, animtiaabu, aniwu, ne suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wɔbɛka wɔn suahu ahorow ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ ebia adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe bi a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no yɛ nea wotumi gye di na egyina adanse so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wuhu sɛ ebia adwenemyare ho ade a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no yɛ nea wotumi gye di na egyina adanse so a, susuw nneɛma a edidi so yi ho: Fibea a wogye di: Hwɛ akyerɛwfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde nsɛm no ma no adansedi nkrataa. Hwehwɛ adwenemyare ho asoɛe ahorow a agye din, aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa abenfo a wogye tom wɔ adwuma no mu. Adanse a wɔde gyina so: Hwehwɛ nyansahu mu nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresabea nhwehwɛmu a ɛfoa sɛnea nsɛm anaa nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu a wɔde ma no tu mpɔn ho nsɛm. Nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee: Ɛsɛ sɛ nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so da wɔn sika fibea, samufo nhyehyɛe, ne biribiara a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho bɔ abira adi pefee. Nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe: Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ sɛ adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔfata ahwɛ emu nsɛm no mu anaasɛ wɔapene so. Nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea nneɛma te: Hwɛ sɛnea emu nsɛm no nyinaa te, a emu da hɔ, ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ɛfa w’ahiade pɔtee anaa w’adwennwene ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidie ahorow, ne nneyɛe nya mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ sika, sikakorabea, boseabɔ, ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ho so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nneyɛe ahorow nya mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ sika ho so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu no, sika a wɔkora so ma daakye ahiade ahorow no som bo kɛse, bere a wɔ afoforo mu no, ebia wɔ pɛ sɛ wɔsɛe sika de nya abotɔyam ntɛm ara. Sɛ wɔte amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi ase a, ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasisi sikasɛm ho gyinae a ɛfata a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn botae ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanya bɛn na yɛbɛtumi afa so ahyehyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie de abɔ nyarewa a ɛfiri nna mu (STIs) ho ban wɔ m’afɛfoɔ ne me mpɔtamfoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Fi ase bɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ nnamfo ne atipɛnfo ntam fa STI, nna a ahobammɔ wom, ne sɔhwɛ ho. Nhomasua Ɔsatuo: Yɛ nhyiamu, nhyiamu, anaa ɔsatuo ho nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ. Media a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Fa social media, posters, anaa video ahorow di dwuma de kyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware. Nneɛma a Wobɛnya: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ STI sɔhwɛ mmeaeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma ho. Sɔhwɛ a Ɛhyɛ Nkuran: Ma STI nhwehwɛmu nyɛ nea ɛfata sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ no daa no fã. Hyɛ nnamfo nkuran ma wɔnsɔ wɔn hwɛ, titiriw ansa na wɔafi nna mu abusuabɔ foforo ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mede meho bɛhyɛ STI/HIV nkyerɛkyerɛ ɛkɔ so wɔ me mpɔtam ho?
answer_twi_source: Kɔhu wɔn wɔ  di ho dwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ . Kɔ nteteeɛ (workshops). Yɛ adwuma a yɛnnye sika (Volunteer). Yɛ kasamafo 'advocacy' wɔ sukuu/mpɔtam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amannebɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛpaapae na wɔayɛ aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua nhyehyɛe: Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titiriw ma, na ɛde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ dawurubɔ ne aguadi nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu na wɔasɛe no ho. Intanɛt so nnwinnade: Wɛbsaet, blog, ne sohyial media akontaabu a wɔde ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma afotu, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne nhwɛso ahorow a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee na wɔafa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm mu yiye. Adwumayɛbea ne nhyiam ahorow: Nhyiam ne nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho taa yɛ nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow, nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu de ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ sɛnea wobesua sɛnea wɔbɛpaapae aguadi ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu na wɔayɛ mu nhwehwɛmu mu. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ: Mmabun bɛtumi anya mfasoɔ afiri atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛtumi akyɛ nhumu, asusu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm ho, na wɔayɛ adwuma abom wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ adwuma a wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ suban pa ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw asiane ne mfaso horow a ɛbata nna mu dwumadi ahorow ne nea wɔpaw ho?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho (aduru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano/STIs). Susuw Nea Efi Mu Ba (honam fam/nkate fam) ho. Wo ne Akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo nkasa. Nhwehwɛmu (nneɛma a agye din). Hwɛ Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ abɛɛfo ntetan abakɔsɛm ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo mu de ama nkurɔfo ate SRH nsɛm ho asɛm, akasa atia animtiaabu, na wɔama mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne ayɛ kɛse, wɔ mpɔtamu hɔ ne wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ abvvfo ntetan abasɛm ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ɔsatu ahorow mu de ama nkurɔfo ate SRH nsɛm ho asɛm na wɔakasa atia animtiaabu: Ankorankoro asɛm a wɔka: Kyɛ ankorankoro osuahu ne nsɛm de ma SRH nsɛm yɛ nnipa, nya tema, na wɔama biakoyɛ aba atipɛnfo ne mpɔtamu hɔfo ntam. Hashtag ɔsatuo: Fa wo ho hyɛ hashtag ɔsatuo ne intanɛt so akuo mu de hyɛ SRH nkasa ama mmɔdenbɔ mu den, kɔ atiefoɔ dodoɔ nkyɛn, na boaboa mmoa ano ma nhyehyɛeɛ nsakraeɛ. Nnwuma a wɔbomu yɛ: Yɛne atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ, mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne SRH akamfofoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ abɛɛfo ntetan  ɔsatuo a ɛfa mpɔtamu hɔ SRH nneɛma a ɛhia paa ho na ɛma nne a wɔato wɔn hintidua no yɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow boa ma wɔtew animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛm ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma wonya nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nhomasua a ɛda adi pefee, na ɛboa ma wɔsɛe adwene a ɛnteɛ na wɔhyɛ ntease ho nkuran. Atipɛnfo a wɔka wɔn suahu ne wɔn nimdeɛ kyerɛ no betumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ayɛ nea ɛfata. Atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ a wɔboa ma ankorankoro nya baabi a ahotɔ wɔ ma wɔkyɛ wɔn haw na wɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ a wɔnsuro sɛ wɔbɛbu wɔn atɛn, na ɛtew animtiaabu ne nyiyim so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ nna mu 'sexual health' nhwehwɛmu mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwansideɛ no bi ne: Nimdeɛ a enni hɔ, Fɛreɛ (Stigma), Sika haw, Kokoam-yɛ. Siesie denam: Nkyerɛkyerɛ, nneɛma a yɛbɛyɛ no daadaa, sika a yɛbɛte so, ne kokoam a yɛbɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ akwannya a mewɔ sɛ menya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a awofo mpene so anaasɛ wɔmmmɔ me amanneɛ no ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ akwannya a wowɔ sɛ wubenya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a awofo mpene so anaasɛ wommɔ wo amanneɛ ho ban: Ahintasɛm ho mmara a ɛwɔ aman pii mu ma kwan ma mmofra nkumaa nya akwahosan ho nnwuma bi, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, Nna mu yare (ST) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu, a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, hwɛ hu sɛ wobɛyɛ kokoamsɛm na wɔanya ɔhwɛ. Saa mmara ahorow yi gye akwannya a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho si gyinae wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho tom na wɔbɔ wɔn kokoamsɛm ho ban de hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛho hia a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ sɛ yɛde Intanɛt hwehwɛ awoɔ ne nna ho akwahosan ho amanneɛbɔ ne mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Wobɛtumi anya mmoa mmerɛ biara ne baabiara Anonymity (ahintasɛm/ kokoam-yɛ). Nneɛma ahorow pii (videos/articles). Ahooden (Empowerment).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ meredi aduan pa na manya aduannuru a mehia na ama nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom?
answer_twi_source: Aduane a Ɛma Apɔwmuden Ho Afotu: Ahorow: Fa nnuaba ahorow, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, protein a ɛnyɛ den, ne nufusu mu nneɛma ka ho. Nea broni ka no 'Folic Acid': Ɛho hia ma awotwaa no nyin. Wohu wɔ nhaban momono, aburow a wɔahyɛ no den, ne nnuru a wɔde ka ho mu. Nea broni ka no 'Calcium': Ɛho hia ma nnompe nyin. Wohu wɔ nufusu mu nneɛma, nnuan a wɔahyɛ no den, ne nhaban momono mu. Dade: Ɛho hia na ama wɔanya mogya mu nkwammoaa kɔkɔɔ. Wohu wɔ nam kɔkɔɔ, bankye, atoko, ne aburow a wɔahyɛ no den mu. Nea broni ka no 'Protein': Ɛho hia ma onyin ne nkɔso. Nneɛma a wonya fi mu no bi ne nam a ɛnyɛ den, nkokɔnam, mpataa, nkesua, ne atoko. Srade a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Nea broni ka no 'Omega-3' srade so wɔ mfaso ma amemene ne anisoadehu nkɔso. Wohu wɔ mpataa, nnuaba, ne aba mu. To Nnuan a Ɛnyɛ Den ano hye: Tew nnuan a asikre wom, nea wɔayɛ, ne anonne a wobɛnom so. Nsu a Ɛma: Nom nsu pii da mũ no nyinaa. Nnuru a Wɔde Ma Ansa na Wɔawo: 'Folic Acid': Ankorankoro a wɔyem dodow no ara hia ea broni ka no 'microgram' 400-800 a wɔde ka ho da biara. Vitamins a Wɔde Ma Ansa na Wɔawo: Hwɛ hu sɛ worenya nnuane nnuru nea broni ka no  'vitamin ne mineral ahorow a ɛho hia nyinaa. Akwankyerɛ: Wo ne Wo Demafo no nkasa: Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo nsusuw w’aduan ho na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ woredi w’ahiade ho dwuma. Aduan a Ahobammɔ: Kwati mpataa a wɔannoa, nam a wɔannoa no yiye, nufusu a wɔmfa nnuru nhyɛ mu, ne mpataa bi a mercury pii wom. Tie Wo Nipadua: Didi bere a ɔkɔm de wo, na hwɛ akɔnnɔ ne akyide ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mu ahofadi ho no gu ahorow wɔ aman ne mantam ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mu ahofadi ho no betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse wɔ aman anaa amantam ahorow mu. Ebia aman binom wɔ mmara nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den a ɛbɔ hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wonya nipadua mu ahofadi ho ban, bere a afoforo nso betumi anya mmara a anohyeto wom paa anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛto ahofadi ano hye, titiriw ma mmabun ne akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua. sɛ ebia,
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi anya nna akyi aduro a ɛsiw awo kwan (emergency contraception) wɔ sukuu mu ayaresabea (sickbay) anaa mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea (community clinics)?
answer_twi_source: Daabi, wɔtaa wunya bi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea (community clinics) ne awoɔ ho akwahosan mmeaeɛ (reproductive health centers). Ayaresabea akɛseɛ (hospitals) nso ma bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena kwan a ahoɔden wom, te sɛ aduanpa die, apɔw-mu-tentennee, nna, ne fekubɔ betumi anya adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Asetena pa a ɛfata betumi anya adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso pa denam: Adwene a Ɛma Atu mpɔn: Apɔw-mu-tentennee a wɔyɛ no daa no ma endorphins fi adi, na ebetumi ama adwene atu mpɔn na atew adwennwen so. Nna nkanyanee: Nna a ahia a wobenya no ho hia na ama obi anya adwene mu dwumadi ne atenka mu yiyedi. Aduan a Ɛkari pɛ: Nnuane a ahoɔden wom a wodi no ma wonya aduannuru a ɛho hia ma adwene no. Fekuwbɔi: Fekuwbɔ a ɛboa a wobɛkɔ so akura mu no betumi ate ankonam atenka so. Sɛ yɛde asetena mu nneɛma yi di kan a, ebetumi aboa ma obi anya adwene mu yiyedi nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam ne dea ɛnyɛ atɛmmu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ Akwahosan adwumayɛbea: Kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ a ebi ne ayaresabea, CHPS, akwahosan asoɛe anaa ayaresabea kɔpɛ kokoam nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Ankorankorɛ Ayaresabea: Ankorankorɛ ayaresabea pii yɛ kokoam nnwuma. Ntentanfidie so Nneɛma: Ntentanfidie so dwumadibea ahodoɔ yɛ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛ mu wɔ kokoam. Awofo a Wɔayɛ Ho Nhyehyɛe ne Ahyehyɛde Ahorow a Ɛte Saa: Saa dwumakuo ahodoɔ yi de nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛnyɛ atɛn ma. Sukuu Akwahosan Asoɛeɛ: Sukuu ahodoɔ bi wɔ akwahosan asoɛe a ayɛ nna mu nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a ɛyɛ kokoamsɛm. Testing Apps: Apps bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma wotumi yɛ nna mu nhwehwɛmu wɔ kokoam na wo nsa ka dea efi mu ba wɔ ntentanfidie no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛma ɛtena yɛn adwenem mu bere a yɛreyɛ anaa wɔrekyekyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ne abusuabɔ ho no?
answer_twi_source: Kokoamusɛm: Bu ankorankoro kokoamu nsɛm bere a woreka wɔn ankasa nsɛm anaa osuahu ahorow ho asɛm no. Pɛpɛɛpɛ: Hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔde kyɛ no yɛ nokware, wɔahwɛ nokwasɛm mu, na efi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so. Nnipa a wɔka ho: Gyina hɔ ma adwene ahodoɔ ne nnipa a wɔda wɔn ho adi, hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho wɔ nsɛm a wɔde yɛ adwuma mu. Kwati Nkate: Kwati sɛ wode nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate bedi dwuma anaasɛ wode bedi dwuma de ahwɛ anaasɛ wobɛkliki. Mpene: Sɛ woreka w’ankasa osuahu anaa nsɛm a ɛfa afoforo ho a, di kan gye wɔn pene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne a wɔde di dwuma no fata amammerɛ, kasa mu kwan a wɔfa so nya, na ɛka adwene ne osuahu ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan "SRH" ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no fata amammerɛ, kasa mu kwan a wɔfa so nya, na ɛka adwene ne suahunu ahodoɔ ho denam mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn bɛka wɔn nkɔsoɔ ne wɔn nhwehwɛmu ho no so. Eyi betumi ayɛ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so anaasɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne mmabun ne mmusua a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu bɛyɛ de aboaboa wɔn adwene ano wɔ emu nsɛm, kasa, ne mfonini ahorow ho. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nso betumi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne amammerɛ ho abenfo ayɛ biako de ahwɛ ahu sɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma no da amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nea nnipa a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so no pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akura wɔn ho a wɔde hyɛ 'ASRH' mu ne wɔn dwumadi mu bere tenten, na mmoa nhyehyɛe ne nkitahodi ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔadi ɔhyew nea aborɔfo ka no 'burnout', ɔbrɛ, ne abasamtu nea aborɔfo ka no 'disillusionment' so nkonim?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛkɔ so de wɔn ho ahyɛ 'ASRH' mu ne wɔn dwumadi mu bere tenten no, mmabun betumi: Wɔde wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ne yiyedi adi kan denam ahye a wɔde besi hɔ, adwene a wɔde bedi dwuma, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ no so. Fa wo ho hyɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim a ɛma hokwan ma nkitahodie, adwumayɛkuo, ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔbom yɛ mu. Gye w’ahome bere a ɛho hia na fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛnyɛ dwumadi mu na ama woanya ahoɔden bio na woasiw ɔhyew ano. Kasa ma ahyehyɛdeɛ mmoa ne mmabun akannifoɔ a wɔgye tom wɔ 'ASRH' mu denam sika a wɔde bɛma, nnwuma a wɔde bɛma wɔn tumi, ne hokwan a wɔde bɛnya kyɛfa a nteaseɛ wom wɔ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me ho a mɛhwɛ adi kan na mahwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu sɛ mihyia nna mu ɔhaw anaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfa ho a?
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho Hwɛ: Fa dwumadi ahorow a ɛma obi nya yiyedi nyinaa, te sɛ apɔ mu ateneatene, adidi pa, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome di kan. Fa wo ho hyɛ anigyede ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigye ba na ɛtew adwennwen so mu. Hu Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Hu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi ntumi nyɛ adwuma yiye na mmu w’ani ngu nsɛm a ɛkɔ so daa so. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so sɛ wote nka sɛ biribi nteɛ a. Adwumayɛfo Mmoa: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔ. Hwehwɛ ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna mu ɔhaw mu. Ahintasɛm: Te ase sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kura kokoamsɛm mu, titiriw wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm mu. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wode kokoam nsɛm sie na wode kokoam nsɛm sie bere a woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no. Mmoa Nkitahodi: hwehweɛ mmoa fi akuw anaa intanɛt so ma ankorankoro a wɔrehyia nna mu ɔhaw ahorow. Sɛ wo ne afoforo a wɔafa osuahu a ɛte saa mu bɛkasa a, ebetumi ama yɛanya awerɛkyekye ne ntease. Animtiaabu so nkonimdi: Hu sɛ mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no yɛ ahoɔden ho sɛnkyerɛnne, na ɛnyɛ mmerɛwyɛ. Di aniwu anaa aniwu nkate biara so denam w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi a wode w’adwene besi so no so. Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA’s Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) de akwankyerɛ a ɛma nhumu ma Sɛ wode wo ho hwɛ a wode di kan hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛhunu berɛ a biribi nteɛ na woatu anammɔn a ɛyɛ nnam de adi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ anaa telefon a wɔde boa a mmabun betumi de ahyɛ wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe mu de aboa wɔn ntɛm ara na wɔaboa wɔn wɔ ɔhaw bi mu, te sɛ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wokum wɔn ho anaa nhama a wɔde ma wɔ adwenemyare ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde boa ntɛm ara: Mmabun betumi de nneɛma te sɛ telefon a wɔde kum wɔn ho  dwumakuw a yɛfrɛ no sɛ(GHANA NATIONAL SUICIDE PREVENTION HELP LINE: 0800678678), adwenemyareɛ ho haw nhama, anaa mmoa dwumadie a egyina nsɛm so ahyɛ wɔn ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu ama mmoa ntɛm ara wɔ ɔhaw bi mu. Saa nneɛma yi de mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛyɛ ntɛm ara fi adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔagyina atenka anaa tebea horow a emu yɛ den ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mesusuw asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi ɛba wɔ nneɛma ahorow a wɔpaw a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi, abusuabɔ, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nna mu nyarewa "STI" ano a wosiw ho, bere a mihyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso "peer pressure" anaa asetena mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow no ho?
answer_twi_source: Asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba wɔ nneɛma ahorow a wɔpaw a ɛfa nna ho dwumadi ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wosusuw nneɛma ahorow ho: Nea ebefi mu aba no ntease: Hwɛ nea ebetumi afi nneɛma ahorow a wɔpaw mu aba, te sɛ asiane a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn, nna mu nyarewa "STI", atinka mu ahokyere, anaa abusuabɔ mu nsunsuanso mu. Mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a wobɛkari: Susuw mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔkwan biara a wobɛfa so no so, a bere tiaa mu abotɔyam ne nea ebefi mu aba bere tenten ka ho. Ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow a wubesusuw ho: Dwen sɛnea wo gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a wode di kan no nya wo gyinaesi kwan so nkɛntɛnso na ɛkyerɛ wo kwan kɔ nneyɛe a ɛne wo gyidi ne wo botae ahorow hyia no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi anya nna ne awoɔ akwaa apɔmuden mmoa a awofoɔ nnim anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛgyina mfeɛ/mmara so. Mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam wɔ hɔ (nyinsɛn a wosi ano, nna mu yarewa , nyinsɛn, afotu).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia nsusuwii bɔne anaa kasa a ɛyɛ animhwɛ a ɛfa SOGI ho no a mihu wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no? (wɔfrɛɛ adwemmɔne, nneɛma pa a wɔde besi ananmu a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɔhaw anaa asiane pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata mpeneso ma wɔ Intanɛt so, te sɛ nkitahodi a ɛnteɛ, nhyɛso, anaa nhyɛso mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛnteɛ: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa ne nne a enni hɔ wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu no betumi ama wɔnte ase anaasɛ wɔakyerɛ ase wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so wɔ mpeneso ho. - Nhyɛso: Ankorankoro betumi ate nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔpene dwumadi anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ so wɔ intanɛt so esiane atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nsakrae, anaa suro a wosuro sɛ ebefi mu aba nti. - Anonymity: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din no betumi ahyɛ ankorankoro nkuran ma wɔabu wɔn ani agu ahye so anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛmfata mu a wonsusu nea ebefi mu aba no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene a wɔpene so di wɔ tebea ahorow a ɛfa nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ho mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankoro betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna mu nkitahodi nyinaa yɛ nea wɔpene so na ɛkyerɛ obu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene da so ara ho hia wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ho mu. Asabow mma hia a ehia sɛ wɔpene so pefee, kɔ so wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ ankorankoro hwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa betumi de pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ne anigye bɛma ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara mu. Sɛ obi bow nsa araa ma ontumi mpene so anaasɛ ɔne no nni nkitaho pefee a, wobu nna biara a ɔne no bɛbɔ no sɛ ɛnyɛ nea wɔpene so ma enti ɛyɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe "sexual assult". Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde obu ne ahobammɔ di kan wɔ nna mu nkitahodi nyinaa mu, a nnuru a wɔde di dwuma mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔagyina nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a epira te sɛ nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm, atipɛnfo nhyɛso, ne adwenemyare ho nsɛnnennen a ɛde ba no ano?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow de agyina nkɛntɛnso bɔne a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a epira de ba no ano denam: Akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de mmoa ne afotu ama hɔ. Nkitahodi a wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, ne mmoa nhama a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wobedi nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm, adwenemyare ho nsɛnnennen, ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho dwuma. Nhomasua nneɛma, nhoma ahorow a wɔde boa wɔn ho, ne nnwinnade a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so a ɛma wobu wɔn ho, sɛnea wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, ne nipadua ho mfonini pa a wɔde bedi dwuma. Adwene mu nneyɛe, anigyede, ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ ankasa ho hwɛ ne yiyedi ho nkuran, te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, adebɔ adwinni, ne bere a wo ne nnamfo ne abusuafo a wɔboa wɔn no nya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛkɔ  ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ m’abusua mu, a nsɛmti te sɛ pene, akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, STI ano a wosiw, ne abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛka ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata mfe a obi adi na ɛfa amammerɛ ho so ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ase. Ma awofoɔ nimdeɛ. Hyɛ workshops nkuran. Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi de gyinaesi nhyehyɛeɛ adi dwuma sɛ ɛkwan a mɛfa so ahwɛ me ho mu, ahyehyɛ me botaeɛ, na manya nkɔsoɔ wɔ m’abrabɔ mu na ama manya nna mu nneyɛeɛ pa, nnamfofa pa, ne yiedie nyinaa sɛ ɔbabun?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de gyinaesi nhyehyɛeɛ adi dwuma sɛ ɛkwan a wobɛfa so ahwɛ wo ho mu, ahyehyɛ wo botaeɛ, w'anya nkɔsoɔ wɔ w’abrabɔ mu denam: Botae ne adwene a emu da hɔ a wode besi hɔ a ɛfa wo nna ne awo akwahosan, abusuabɔ, ne yiyedi nyinaa ho no so. Gyinaesi ahorow a atwam a wobesusuw ho na wɔakyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso anaa nsakrae a egyina nea wɔpɛ so. Nsɛm a wɔka a ɛfiri ankorankoro anaa adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di hɔ a wɔde bɛka ho de asiesie gyinaesie akwan na wɔama adwumayɛ atu mpɔn. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so si gyinae a wɔbɛkɔ so asan asusuw ho na wɔasakra no ma ɛne gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a ɛho hia, ne asetra mu tebea horow a ɛresakra no ahyia. Ɛdenam gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow a wode bɛka wo ho a wususuw ne botae a wode besisi w’ani so ho so no, wubetumi ahyɛ nna mu nneyɛe pa, abusuabɔ pa, ne yiyedi nyinaa ho nkuran sɛ ɔbabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene ne nkitahodi di wɔ nna mu akwahosan "sexual heath" mu ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm? ?
answer_twi_source: Mpene ne nkitahodi ho hia ma obiara nna mu akwahosan: Mpene so: Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara de ne ho na ɔde anigye pene nna mu dwumadi so. Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee boa ma obiara te nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no, obu no, na ɔwɔ ahobammɔ. Ka akɔnnɔ, ɔhye, ne nneɛma biara a ɛhaw wo anaa wo hokafo ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntetan anaa Intanɛt so a ɛma wonya nsɛm a ɛfa adwene a wɔde si biribi so, nsusuwii, anaa akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome ho?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a ɛfa asɛm fa adwene mu nsɛm , adwendwene, ne ahomegye akwan ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adwendwene apps a wɔkyerɛ kwan a ɛde ɔdio anaa video nhyiamu a akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa di anim ma de boa wo ma wogye w’ahome, de w’adwene si biribi so, na wonya adwene mu nhumu. YouTube akwan a ɛkyerɛ adwene mu apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔkyerɛ kwan, akwan a wɔfa so home, ne ntini mu ahomegye a ɛkɔ so nkakrankakra de gyae adwennwen ne ahomegye. Wɛbsaet ne blog ahorow a ɛde nsɛm, podcast, ne nneɛma a wobetumi atwe a ɛfa adwennwen a wɔtew so a egyina adwene so (MBSR), adwene mu nneyɛe, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome ho ma.
