Intanɛt so adesua anaa webinar ahorow a ɛfa adwennwen, yoga, ne ayaresa a egyina adwene so a akyerɛkyerɛfo a wɔwɔ adansedi krataa, adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, anaa adwene ho ahyehyɛde ahorow de ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma adi dwuma de adu mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ na wɔato wɔn hintidua, a aguanfo, atubrafo, ne mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔte mmeae a wɔboa nnipa ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a egyina telefon so (SMS nkaebɔ). Telehealth/telecounseling (afotu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so). Digyital nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho (kasa pii mu nsɛm).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔtaa de bata mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma wɔyɛ nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia nsusuwii hunu a ebetumi ama wɔayɛ nyiyim: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wonni: Adwene a wɔkuram sɛ mmubuafo ani nnye nna mu abusuabɔ ho anaasɛ wontumi nyɛ ho hwee. Mmɔborɔhunu ne Nnipa a Wɔbɛboa wɔn: sɛ wɔhu wɔn sɛ wɔyɛ mmofra na wontumi nnya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den. Ahobanbɔ a ɛboro so: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔne afoforo bɛbɔ ne wɔn ayɔnkofa a wɔbɛto ano hye. Saa nsusuwii hunu yi boa ma wɔyɛ nyiyim, na ɛma ɛyɛ den ma wɔn sɛ: Wobenya Abusuabɔ Pa: Gyidi a ɛne sɛ wɔmpɛ no betumi ama wɔatew wɔn ho na wɔayɛ ankonam. Nna ne Awo mu Akwahosan Ho Nhwehwɛmu a Wobenya: Nyiyim a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo yɛ no betumi asiw wɔn kwan sɛ wonnya ɔhwɛ a wohia. Kamfo Wɔn Ho: Sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wontumi nhu wɔn na wɔnte wɔn a, ebetumi ama ayɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔman mmara ne nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe ahorow gu ahorow wɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nhomasua, ne nnwuma a edi mũ a wogye tom na wokura mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔman mmara ne nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe ahorow gu ahorow wɔ sɛnea wogye mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow tom na wokura mu no mu. Nneɛma a ɛka nsakrae yi bi ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, amammui mu nsusuwii ahorow, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ. Bere a aman bi wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a ɛde hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm, nhomasua, ne nnwuma di kan no, ebia afoforo nso wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom anaasɛ wonni akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so de di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiri a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wonkitahodie yɛ deɛ ayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woretie yie: Yɛ aso na te wohokafoɔ ase yie. Sɛ worekyerɛ woadwene:Kyerɛ woadwene na ka deɛ ehia wo. Kasa a Obuo wom: Kasa yie na gyae kasatia. Nteaseɛ a wɔma emu da hɔ: Siesie ntawantawa na pɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Ahyeɛ a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Ahyeɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee na bu wobiaa ahyeɛ nso. Ɔhaw nsiesie: Yɛ baako fa hwehwɛ anoyie anaa fa siesie ntawantawa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wɛbsait anaa mmoa mmeaeɛ pa bɛn na mebetumi anya nimdeɛ a ɛfata afa nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun ne mmabun adamfofa beae a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ anaa akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo. YMK app no, social media handle nyinaa a ɛwɔ Mmabun Akwahosan ne Nkɔsoɔ Dwumadie a ɛwɔ Ghana Akwahosan Dwumadibea, FHMAPP
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ne atetesɛm betumi anya nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe so nsunsuansoo?
answer_twi_source: Atetesɛm te sɛ mmea awotwaa (FGM), mmofra aware betumi apira nna mu akwahosan. ɔsom mu gyidi betumi anya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw anaa nna a edi aware anim ho no so nsunsuanso. Saa nneyɛe yi betumi aka nna mu akwahosan wɔ ɔkwan a enye so anaasɛ ɔkwan pa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm berɛ a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne mmara kwan so nsɛm no?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no bi ne nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn ahobammɔ ne wɔn kokoamsɛm bere a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne mmara kwan so nsɛm no. Ebia nea ɛka eyi ho ne ahyɛde ahorow a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban, kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe, ne dabere a wɔde bɛma ahodwiriw so atew bere a wɔrekɔ asɛnnibea no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na "twe-fi" kwan no siw nyinsɛn ano yiye?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ saa koraa! "Pul-out" kwan a wɔsan frɛ no coitus interruptus no nyɛ nea wotumi de ho to so koraa. Pre-ejaculate fluid betumi akura mmadwoa, enti saa kwan yi de nyinsɛn ho asiane kɛse ba. Paw ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so a wɔde siw awo ano te sɛ kɔndɔm, nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, anaa IUD.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa ɔpanyin foforo a megye no adi akyerɛ m’adwene mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho? (nkitahodi ho afotu) .
answer_twi_source: Ebetumi ayɛ den sɛ wubebue w’ano, nanso afotu bi ni: Paw Obi a Wobɛboa: Paw obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso na wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wo ne no bɛkasa. Da nna mu akwahosan ho dadwen a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa adi na hwɛ sɛnea wɔyɛ wɔn ade. Fa W’adwene Si W’ahiade So: Kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wote nka ne nea enti a wususuw sɛ ebia wubehia mmoa no mu. Fa di dwuma: Sɛ wudi kan bɔ nkɔmmɔ no ho dwuma a, ebetumi ama woanya ahotoso kɛse. wobɛtumi ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfoɔ adi nkitaho akɔhwehwɛ mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me gyinapɛn ne me gyidie ahorow aka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow a wode bɛka gyinaesi akwan a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wobɛpene so, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho no hwehwɛ sɛ wobesusuw sɛnea nea wopaw no ne nea ɛho hia wo kɛse no hyia ho wɔ adwempa mu. Ansa na wubesi gyinae no, gye bere susuw sɛnea ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow hyia no ho, susuw nneɛma te sɛ obu a wubenya ama wo ho ne afoforo, nkitahodi, ne w’ankasa ahofadi ho. Hwehwɛ nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware a wode bɛma wo gyinaesi ahorow ahu, na fa wo ho to wo nkate so sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛ wo kwan akɔ nneɛma a wobɛpaw a wote nka sɛ ɛfata wo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔn asetena ne sikasɛm mu tebea anaa asasesin a wɔwɔ mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔn asetra ne sikasɛm mu tebea anaa asasesin a wɔwɔ mfa ho denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde pɛyɛ ne nnipa a wɔka bom di kan a wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wɔbɛkamfo sika a ɛyɛ pɛ ama sukuu ahorow ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee mmeae a ɛwɔ mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa pii, sika a wɔde ma, mmoa a wɔde ma, ne mmoa a wɔde ma a wɔde bedi dwuma de asiw sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow ano, na wɔakamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nhomasua nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma mu wɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri. Bio nso, mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase mu de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ obiara nya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a ɛyɛ pɛ no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa ne biakoyɛ mmoa betumi adi wɔ mmabun dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso na wɔhyɛ nkitahodi pa a ɛwɔ intanɛt so a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa ne adwumayɛkuw betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun digital nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ne nkitahodi pa a ɛwɔ intanɛt so a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Mmabun betumi asua biribi afi wɔn ho wɔn ho suahu mu, akyɛ afotu ne akwan horow a wɔfa so fa dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan so, na wɔbom kamfo nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, obiara a wɔbɛka ho, ne obu ama wɔ intanɛt so mmeae ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdi mu a ɛfa ɔsatuo anaa nnwuma a wɔde gyina sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetena mu nsakraeɛ so a mmabun di anim ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow: Ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim a ɛkamfo adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ ntetee nhyehyɛe, ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a mmabun bɛma no anya nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a ɛkɔ soro so nkɛntɛnso yiye. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow: Mmɔden a mmabun di anim sɛ wɔbɛma sikasɛm ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akenkan ne akyerɛw anya nkɔso wɔ atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo mu no aboa ma nkurɔfo ahu sikasɛm mu nneɛma pii na wɔanya sika. Abusuakuw ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ: Ɔsatu ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa di anim a wɔde di nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a egyina abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nnipa afoforo so ho dwuma no ama wɔabɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe mu de ahyɛ pɛyɛ ne nnipa a wɔka bom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So "LGBTQ+" akuw bi wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ a, metumi de me ho ahyɛ mu de ahyɛ nkabom ho nkuran? (hokwan ahorow a wɔde tu wɔn ho ma, nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni, ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu "LGBTQ+" sɛ mmra mmma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, hokwan ahorow, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho di nkitaho wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima ne Mmarima Pɛyɛ: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow ho no betumi anya nkurɔfo nhomasua ne mmoa a wobenya so nkɛntɛnso. Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuranhyɛ ho hia na ama obiara anya awo akwahosan a ɛyɛ pɛ.Hokwan ahorow: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi betumi de nyiyim aba, na asɛe akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne hokwan ahorow a wobenya.Nneyɛe a Ɛteɛ: Ɛyɛ atɛntrenee asɛm sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ obiara, mpo a ofi abusua anaa ne su biara mpo, anya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a emu dɔ ne ayaresa a ɛfata.Nneɛma a Ɛtaa Ba: Ɛho hia sɛ yehu sɛ amammerɛ, abrabɔ pa, ne asetra mu nneɛma nyinaa twam de kyerɛ sɛnea yɛhyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnipa hokwan ahorow a obiara wɔ mu den
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho bɔ ankorankoro ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ ahorow, a mmonnaato, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ne nhyɛso ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho mmara botae ne sɛ ɛbɛbɔ ankorankoro ho ban afi nna mu basabasayɛ ahorow a mmonnaato, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ne nhyɛso ka ho. Wɔde ahye a emu da hɔ si hɔ wɔ nea ɛyɛ nneyɛe a wonnye ntom ho na wɔkyerɛ nea ebefi mmara mu aba ama wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnuan ne nnuan a ahoɔden wom a metumi adi wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ nnuan a ahoɔden wom ne nnuan a wodi wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ma aduannuru a ɛkari pɛ na ɛboa onyin ne ahoɔden dodow. Adwene ahorow bi ni: Nnuan a wɔde di agoru: Nnuaba a wɔayɛ no foforo te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, banana, nnuaba, anaa akutu Nnuadewa a wɔde hummus anaa guacamole ayɛ Helafo yogurt a wɔde nnuaba ne ɛwo a ɛtɔ gu fam Nnuadewa ne aba (wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so) te sɛ almond, walnut, anaa akutu aba Whole-grain crackers with cheese anaa nut butter, roasted maize and groundnut, Millet ne yoghurt drink (Wɔtaa frɛ no Brukina wɔ Ghana) Smoothies a wɔde nnuaba, nhabannuru, yogurt, ne protein powder scoop, "Sobolo" Aduan: Akokɔ anaa tofu a wɔayam a wɔde quinoa ne nhabannuru a wɔayam ayɛ Pasta a wɔayam no nyinaa a wɔde marinara sauce ne broccoli a wɔayam no afã bi Stir-fry with lean protein (akokɔ, shrimp, tofu) ne a nhabannuru ahorow a ɛwɔ aburow a ɛyɛ bruu so Salmon anaa trout a ɛmo a ɛyɛ dɛ ne bankye a ɛyɛ ahabammono afã bi ka ho Nnuadewa ne bankye chili a wɔde abodoo a wɔde aburow ayɛ anaa tortillas ka ho Salad a wɔde ahabammono a wɔadi afra, akokɔ a wɔayam, nnuaba, aba, ne vinaigrette dressing a wɔde ayɛ nhabannuru soup a wɔayɛ wɔ fie a wɔde abodoo a wɔayam ayɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di ahyɛ me gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu na m'ahwehwɛ wɔn akwankyerɛ bere a mihyia nneɛma a ɛyɛ den sɛ mɛfa biako?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛ mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne adwene ama wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho. Fa obu ne nhumu kɔ wɔn nkyɛn, na nya ɔpɛ sɛ wobetie wɔn afotu ne wɔn nhumu. Susuw ho sɛ wode wɔn bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu bere a wohyia nneɛma a, na sɛɛ ɛsom bo ma wɔn nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔde ma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusuw nsɛmfua, ɛnne, ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so de nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no mu de ahyɛ adwene biara a ɛnteɛ, nsɛm a wɔka wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so ne nea ɛkanyan nkate biara nsow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asɔ saa nsɛm yi ahwɛ denam nkate mu kasa, kasa a ɛyɛ den anaa nsɛm a wɔka a ɛboro so a wɔde di dwuma a wɔbɛhwɛ so. Ebia eyinom bɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ animhwɛ anaa adwene a ahintaw. Bio nso, wobetumi ahwɛ sɛnea adwene ahorow a ɛwɔ emu nsɛm no mu no gu ahorow na ɛka obiara ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔayɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkari pɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo de mfiridwuma redi dwuma de ahyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma so, ne apomoden ho nsɛnkyerɛnne atitiriw a wɔhwɛ so no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Aban ne nhyehyeɛyɛfoɔ de mfiridwuma di dwuma de hyɛ ASRH nhyehyeɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma so, ne nhwehwɛmu mu den denam: Abɛɛfo apomoden ho nsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma: Ɛlektrɔnik apomoden ho kyerɛwtohɔ, mobile amanneɛbɔ akwan, ne abɛɛfo ntetan registries ma wotumi boaboa nsɛm ano, hwehwɛ mu, na wɔbɔ amanneɛ wɔ ASRH nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ho wɔ berɛ ankasa mu. Telemedicine ne e-apomoden dwumadie a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ: Nea abrof taa fr noTelefonconconsultations, mobile health apps, ne online platforms trɛw ASRH nsɛm, afotuo, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛnya mu, titire wɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaa wɔnyɛ adwuma yie. Abɛɛfo ntetan nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu ɔsatu a wɔboa: Aban ahorow de sohyial media, wɛbsaet, ne mobile apps di dwuma de kyekyɛ ASRH ho nsɛm, hyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran, na wɔma nkurɔfo hu nnwuma ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aka mental health (adwene apɔwmuden) ho asɛm ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ase?
answer_twi_source: Personal Stories: Ɛne ɔmo nkyɛ wo suahunu (kokoam) hyɛ afoforo den. Positive Content: Yɛ nneɛma pa wɔ social media so a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ ne kwan so sɛ yɛhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛsɛ mmabun ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem bere a wɔreyɛ nneɛma na wɔrekyekyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so, a nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔkyerɛw nneɛma, adwene mu agyapade, ne nneyɛe a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ma wɔn adwene si abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow so bere a wɔreyɛ nneɛma na wɔkyekyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no, a nea ɛka ho ne: Obu hokwan a wɔde yɛ adwuma ne adwene mu agyapade hokwan ahorow a wobebu denam kwan a wobenya de afoforo adwuma adi dwuma na wɔagye atom so. Woho a wobɛ twe efiri sɛ wobewia nneɛma denam fibea ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔafa aka a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛm ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ wɔn nsɛm mu no so. Sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee na wɔadi nokware wɔ wɔn intanɛt so nkitahodi ne wɔn ananmusifo mu. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde sie kokoam nsɛm a wobedi so na woagye pene ansa na wode w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm anaa afoforo mfonini akyɛ. Wo h o a wobɛtwe efiri sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw atoro nsɛm anaa nsɛm a epira a ebetumi de apira anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie anaa nhyehyeɛ titiriw bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ mu ma LGBTQ+ mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɛn pii no, nnwuma anaa nhyehyeɛ titiriw bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ mu ma LGBTQ+ mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne: LGBTQ+ a ɛfoa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo so a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ akwahosan ahiade soronko ne LGBTQ+ ankorankoro haw ahorow ho. Ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, a nea ɛka ho ne hormone ayaresa, nnuru a wɔde siw brayɛ ano, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ beaeɛ a woyɛ oprehyɛn de kyerɛ bɔbea sua. Afotuo ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔayɛ ama LGBTQ+ mmabun, a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ worefim, nipasu a wɔsi so dua, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi nkitahodie. STI nhwehwɛmu ne bammɔ dwumadie a wɔdi ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro nna mu akwahosan ahiadeɛ. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔpɛ LGBTQ+, mmoa akuw, ne adwenemyare ho nnwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu sɛ wɔhaw obi anaa wɔreyɛ no ayayade wɔ baguam a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me ho ahyɛ mu dwoodwoo? (akwan a wɔfa so twetwe adwene, mmoa a wɔde ma nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhu sɛ wɔrehaw obi a, afotu bi ni: Akwan a wɔfa so de nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene: Yɛ biribi a ɛbɛtwetwe adwene na ama nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no atetew, te sɛ nea wubebisa nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no asɛm bi. Fa Mmoa Ma: Bisa nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no sɛ ne ho ye anaa, na ohia mmoa na ama watumi afi tebea no mu anaa. Nya Mmoa: Sɛ nneɛma te sɛ nea asiane wom a, hwehwɛ ɔpanyin anaa ɔwɛmfo bi hwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwan a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so, betumi aboa nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so wɔ nimdeɛ a edi mũ ne adwene pa a wobenya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so no betumi aboa nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so bi ne: Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ama wɔde nsa asua ade "hands-on learning", atipɛnfo mmoa, ne ahokokwaw a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam nhyiam ahorow, nkɔmmɔbɔ a atipɛnfo di anim, ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a esisi so. Nimdeɛ ne nteaseɛ mu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛbɛtumi aba ɛnam anohyetoɔ a ɛwɔ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu anaa amammerɛ mu nkateɛ nti no ho dwumadie. Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpɔtam hɔfo afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ayɔnkofo wɔ nkrasɛm pa a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no mu. Nneɛma foforɔ, dwumadie, ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ foforɔ a wɔde bɛma a ɛboro deɛ ɛwɔ sukuu tebea mu, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn kɔ anaa mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adamfofa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa ama me ho ne me nna ne awo nna ne awo apɔmuden berɛ a me ne apɔmuden  ho adwumayɛfo, awofo, anaa ahokafo rekasa no? (Ɔkwan pa a wɔfa so ne nkurɔfoɔ bɔ nkɔmmɔ ne akokoduru a wɔde da wɔn adwene adi) .
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ ho kwan sɛ wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ na wobu wo: Nkitahodi Ho Nimdeɛ: Fa di dwuma sɛ wobɛda w’ahiade ne w’ahye adi pefee na woanya ahotoso. Assertiveness(Gyina wo nan so): Sua sɛ wobɛka "daabi" wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ pintinn nanso ɛkyerɛ obu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi aguare na mahohoro me nipadua yiye wɔ me mpanyin afe so?
answer_twi_source: Afotu a wode bɛhohoro wo nipadua yiye wɔ wo babunbere mu ni: Fa Samina a Ɛnyɛ Den Di Dwuma: Fa samina a ɛnyɛ den a huam nnim. Samina a ano yɛ den betumi ayi abɔde mu ngo afi honam ani. Nsu a Ɛyɛ Ɔhyew: Fa nsu a ɛyɛ hyew (ɛnyɛ hyew) di dwuma de guare. Nsu a ɛyɛ hyew betumi ama wo honam ani awo. Fa W’adwene Si Mmeae Titiriw So: Hwɛ yiye wɔ honam ani a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne mmeae a fifiri ne mmoawa boaboa ano te sɛ abasa ase, asen, ne anan so. Nsa ne Anan: Hohoro wo nsateaa ne wo nansoaa ntam, ne wo nnadewa ase nso. Sɛ Wohohoro Wo honam ani brɛoo: Fa ntama a wode hohoro wo honam ani anaa loofah hohoro wo honam ani brɛoo, titiriw mmeae a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛhohoro wo honam ani. Hohoro Yiye: Hwɛ hu sɛ wobɛhohoro samina ne shampoo a aka nyinaa afi hɔ na amma wo ho anyɛ wo yaw. Popa wo ho: Sɛ woguare wie a, fa mpopaho a ɛho tew bɔ wo honam ani ma ɛnyɛ hyew. Kwati sɛ wobɛpetepete wo honam ani a ebetumi ahyɛ wo honam ani abufuw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ tumi a obi tumi nya, hwehwɛ mu, hwehwɛ mu, na ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu. Ɛho hia ma mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden efisɛ ɛma wotumi de nsɛm ne nkrasɛm pii a wohyia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, a kuro abɛɛfo ntentan , television, sini, ne aguade ho dawurubɔ ka ho no mu yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na community outreach programs hyehyɛ wɔn nnwuma ma ne boa mmabun a wɔn ahiadeɛ ne abakɔsɛm yɛ soronko?
answer_twi_source: Community outreach programs fa kwan pii so mammoa nyiyimu bia nnim. Cultural competence: Nhyehyɛ no de obuo ma obia amammerɛ ne wɔn gyedie wɔ mmoa wde ma mu. Language accessibilty: Nwoma wosua no wɔ kasa ahorow mu na ɛnnyɛ borɔfo nkoa. Customized outreach: Mmoa no tumi ba fa beebia mmabun no ani gye ho te sɛ ebia social media, mpɔtam ne sukuu mu nhyehyɛeɛ. Inclusive environments: Wonngyina obi gyedie, abusua, akɔnnɔ anaa ne sikasɛm so mma mmoa. Nyiyimu ne atenbuo bia nni mu. Na wɔnne mpɔtam akuo, sukuufoɔ, ayaresafoɔ ne amammerɛ mu mpaninfoɔ ka bom boa mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene mu mfonini anaa nsusuuye a nnipa kura wɔ afoforo ho (stereotypes), na ɛkwan bɛn na eyi ka mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ dɛm bi wɔ wɔn nipadua mu no asetena?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuieeɛ bɔne (Stereotypes) yɛ gyidie a emu nnu anaa emu nkyerɛ adeɛ fa nnipa akuo bi ho. Sɛnea ɛka mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔwɔ dɛm ne:Adwenem a Obi Nnya Nna Ho Akɔnnɔ Koraa (Asexuality): Nnipa taa susuu sɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ dɛm nyɛ mmerɛ anaa wontumi nnya nna mu abusuabɔ.Mmɔborohunu ne Anuonyam a Wɔmfa Mma Wɔn (Pity and Patronization): Wɔbu wɔn sɛ mmofra anaa wɔnyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ abusuabɔ a emu dɔ.Banbɔ a Ɛboro So (Overprotection): Wɔsi wɔn kwan ma wonnya kwan mfa wɔn ho mmɔ nnipa anaa wɔnnnya nnamfo ne nna mu abusuabɔ pa.Saa nsusuieeɛ bɔne yi tumi de nneɛma yi ba:Mpɔtam mu Twatua (Social Isolation): Ɛyɛ den ma wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nnamfo anaa wɔbɛnya abusuabɔ.Ho Bu a Ɛso Tew (Low Self-Esteem): Wɔte nka sɛ nnipa nhunu wɔn anaa wonni bo.Adwene mu Haw (Depression and Anxiety): Adwene mu apɔwmuden mu ɔhaw a ɛfiri sɛ nnipa nyi wɔn mma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata afotu anaa ayaresa ho, na so akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so de sika fam mmoa anaa insurance a wɔde tua ama?
answer_twi_source: Ebia ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata afotu anaa ayaresa ho, a egyina nneɛma te sɛ ɔyarehwɛfo ko, wo insurance a wotua, ne ɛka biara a wobɛbɔ wɔ wo kotoku mu so. Ayaresa ho animdefo binom de sika a ɛkɔ fam a egyina sika a wonya so ma, na insurance nhyehyɛe pii tua adwenemyare ho ka. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne wo insurance dwumayɛni no hwehwɛ sɛnea wobɛte wo insurance ne ɛka biara a ebetumi aba no ase. Sɛ wohaw wo ho wɔ sika a wobɛtumi atɔ ho a, ebia akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so de sika fam mmoa anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina mpɔtam a ɛde nnwuma a ɛho ka sua anaa wontua hwee ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie, te sɛ atorɔfo ahoma a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ, wɛbsaet, anaa mmoa nkitahodiɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe no mu. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ ɔhaw nhama anaa telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo betumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama ntɛm ara wɔ ɔhaw bere mu. Wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo anaa nnwuma a wɔde ma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Biom nso, atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ne intanɛt so mpɔtam wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi ne afoforo a ebia wɔrehyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nso betumi de nsɛm ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ama. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ nneɛma ahorow mu na wɔhwehwɛ nea edi wɔn ahiade ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mɛtumi ahyɛ me ho den na manya akɔkɔduo ma matumi agyina me nan so abisa mmoa a ɛhia me wɔ me nna ho akwahosan (sexual health) mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne Nsɛm: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ nna mu akwahosan, hokwan ahorow, ne mmoa a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Kɔ so nya hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wubetumi afa so wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm. Nkitahodi Ho Ahokokwaw: Nya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ den a wode bɛda w’ahiade ne nea ɛhaw wo adi. Fa yɛ wo ho sɛ wo ne nnipa a wogye wɔn di sɛ wobɛbɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho nkɔmmɔ. Wo Ho a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Dwennwen wo gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne ahye ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no ho. Te w’ankasa wo nkate ne w’akɔnnɔ ase, na ka ho asɛm pefee. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Yɛ nnamfo, abusuafoɔ, anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di boa. Fa wo nsa kɔ afotufoɔ anaa mmoa akuo nkyɛn berɛ a ɛhia. Adwene ne Adwennwen Ho Dwumadi: Sua akwan a wɔfa so di adwennwen ho dwuma, te sɛ adwene mu nhumu, yoga anaa adwennwen. Saa nimdeɛ yi betumi aboa wo ma woagyina nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ano. Ahokokwaw a Wɔde Ka Nsɛm: Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo anaasɛ wɔma nkurɔfo hu wɔ nna mu akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho. Fa wo nne hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ho nkuran. Ɔhye a Wɔde Si Hɔ: Fa ahye a ɛfata sisi hɔ wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Te berɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ woka sɛ dabi ne sɛnea wobɛka pene a wɔpene ho no ase. Wo Ho Hwɛ: Fa wo ho hwɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma adwene ne nkate fam yiyedi di kan. Eyi betumi ayɛ nneɛma a wɔde gye wɔn ani, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome. Nimdeɛ a Ɛfa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Ho: Hu nneɛma a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne intanɛt so a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne afotu ho. Sɛ wunim baabi, bere ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a, ebetumi ama woanya tumi a wode bɛhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Meyɛ dɛn ne m’atipɛnfo aka m’ahye ho asɛm yiye?
answer_twi_source: W’ahye a wo ne w’atipɛnfo bɛka ho asɛm yiye no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛma emu ada hɔ, woayɛ tẽẽ, na woanya ahotoso. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma de kyerɛ sɛnea wote nka ne nea wuhia. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wubetumi aka sɛ, "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ saa asɛm yi ho," anaasɛ "Mepɛ sɛ meremfa me ho nhyɛ eyi mu." Yɛ pintinn nanso kyerɛ obu, na nte nka sɛ ɛyɛ w’asɛyɛde sɛ wubu wo hye ahorow no bem anaasɛ wobɛpa kyɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a wɔtu nyinsɛn no?
answer_twi_source: Susuw ho sɛ wobɛyɛ nhyehyɛe akɔ bere a woakɔ sukuu anaa adwuma bere akyi sɛ ɛhaw wo sɛ obi behu a. wo kokoamsɛm yɛ hiasem mmere a woyi nyinsɛn a gu nhyehyɛe sɛnea mmara a ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama  akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya sikasɛm mu nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den, ɛda adi pefee, na ɛka obiara ho a edi wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa afa  akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya sikasɛm mu nnwuma wɔ: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akuw a mmabun di anim a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si sikasɛm mu nkabom so no ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow anaa kurow no mu asa ahorow nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ama nkurɔfo ahu hia a ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya sikasɛm. Nkitahodi a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne mmarahyɛ baguafo bɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa mmabun sikasɛm mu tumi. Abɛɛfo ntentan a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn suahu na wɔama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa sikasɛm mu nkabom ho no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abababunbere mu nsakyeraeɛ bɛn na ɛhia ayaresafoɔ anaa animdifoɔ akwankyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ mu Nsakrae:Nsakyeraeɛ a ɛba bra (afikyireko) mu: mogya a ɛba dodo anaa yafunu ase yaw a ɛmu yɛ den paa. Nna mu Akwahosan: Nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI, anaa nna mu dwumadi ho. Nkate mu Yiyedi: Awerɛhow, dadwen, anaa adwene a ɛsakra a ɛkɔ so daa. Nipadua mu Nsakrae: Dadwen a ɛfa nyini, mpuntuo, anaa nsakyeraeɛ a ɛba nipadua mu ho. Ɛyaw anaa mmerɛyɛ: Ɛyaw a ɛkɔ so, titiriw wɔ nufu anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu mmeae. Honam ani Nsɛm: Mfeɛ (acne) a ɛyɛ basabasa anaa ɛdɔɔso paa wɔ anim a nnuru a yɛtɔ no kwa (over-the-counter) ntumi nsa. Aduandi Ho Nsɛm: Nsakyeraeɛ kɛseɛ a ɛba wo mu-durue mu anaa sɛnea wodidi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka yɛn adwenem apɔwmuden ho ahiadeɛ akyerɛ yɛn nnamfo, abusuafoɔ, ne mmoa fekuw wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma nteaseɛ ne tema aba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woreka adwenem apɔwmuden ho ahiade ho asɛm a, ɛho hia sɛ wodi nokware, emu da hɔ, na wowɔ tema. Fi ase denam paw a wobɛpaw baabi a ahotɔ ne kokoam de, afei fa "Me" nsɛm da w'atenka ne wo ahiade adi brɛoo. Fa nhwɛso pɔtee ne nyansahyɛ ahorow, na si so dua sɛ worehwehwɛ ntease ne tema, na ɛnyɛ atemmu anaa ɔkasatia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ nnamfofa anaa ɔdɔ abusuabɔ bi yɛ papa na nidi wom?
answer_twi_source: Obu a Wobɛma Wo Ho Wo Ho: Wote nka sɛ wo hokafo som bo na wotie wo. Wɔboa wo gyinaesi ahorow na wobu w’ahye. Nokwaredi ne Ahotoso: Wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wobɛbue w’ano na woadi nokware akyerɛ wo ho mo ho. Wubetumi anya wo hokafo no mu ahotoso sɛ ɔbɛka nokware na wotumi de ho to no so. Nkitahodi Pa: Wubetumi ada wo nkate, w’ahiade, ne w’akɔnnɔ adi pefee. Motie mo ho mo ho denneennen na mobɔ mmɔden sɛ mobɛte mo ho mo ho adwene ase. Ahye a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Mo baanu nyinaa te nka sɛ mo ho tɔ mo sɛ mobɛka sɛ dabi na moabu mo ho mo ho ahunmu. Wonte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛyɛ biribiara a ɛnyɛ wo dɛ. Pɛyɛ ne Mmoa: Wote nka sɛ woyɛ pɛ wɔ abusuabɔ no mu. Moboa mo ho mo ho botae ne adaeso. Ahofadi: Wubetumi akura w’ankasa wo nipasu ne w’anigyede mu wɔ abusuabɔ no akyi. Woda so ara nya bere ne wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam no ka nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a wobenya, na dɛn ne nea efi mu ba wɔ mmabun apomoden mu nsunsuanso ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam no nya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma ne nsɛm a wobenya esiane ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow, amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ, ne tumi a ɛkɔ so nti. Mmabaa ne mmabaa betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow te sɛ animtiaabu, nyiyimu, ahofadi a wonni, ne basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, a ɛto wɔn tumi a wɔde nya nnwuma na wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no ano hye, na awiei koraa no ɛbɛka wɔn apomoden mu nsunsuanso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnuru a wɔde di dwuma no ha adwenem apɔwmuden, na asiane bɛn na ebetumi afi mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru a wɔde di dwuma betumi anya adwenem apɔwmuden so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Ebetumi asɛe adwene no mu nnuru ne ntini mu nkwaadɔm dwumadie, na ama nsakrae aba adwene, ne nneyɛe mu. Asiane a ebetumi aba ne nea efi nnuru a wɔde di dwuma mu ba wɔ adwenem apɔwmuden so no bi ne: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obi benya adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adwene mu yare. Adwene mu akwahosan tebea horow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ho sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛresɛe. Atemmu ne gyinaesi a asɛe, na ɛde nneyɛe ne akwanhyia a asiane wom ba. Asetena ne nnipa ntam ɔhaw ahorow, a abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ne tew a wɔtew wɔn ho ka ho. Nkɛntɛnso bɔne a ɛwɔ adesua anaa adwumayɛ mu dwumadi ne asetra pa nyinaa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhyehyɛe anaa nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛhyɛ bɔ a efi aman afoforo so a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ eyinom na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛhyɛ bɔ a efi aman afoforo so no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho ayaresabea ahorow a mmubuafo ka ho, atipɛnfo mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, nhomasua nneɛma a wobetumi anya, ne ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma ama akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo. Wobetumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ saa nnwuma yi mu na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ denam mmubuafoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nyamesom anaa amammere mu nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ ansa na yɛakasa afa awoɔ ntotoeɛ ho afutuo ne ne nnwuma ho anaa??
answer_twi_source: Aane, nyamesom anaa amammere mu nneɛma bi bɛtumi aba a ɛfa awoɔ ntotoeɛ ho afutuo ne ne nnwuma ho. Nyamesom anaa amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow bi betumi anya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, awo, ne abusua kɛse ho no so nkɛntɛnso. Ɛsɛ sɛ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ ayarefo nyamesom ne amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow so na wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn gyinapɛn ne nea wɔpɛ ma. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun ne wɔn apɔmuden ho ɔyaresafo susuw nyamesom anaa amammerɛ ho nsusuwii biara ho de hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ a ɛne wɔn gyidi hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔresusuw wɔn bɔbeasu ho kyim anaa wɔrehwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: kasa kyerɛ sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ɔpanyin a wogye no di a obetumi ne wo ne afotufo anaa adwene ne nneyɛe ho abenfo abata ho ama mmoa a wohia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmara ho nkyerɛkyerɛ boa mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ɛboa denam: Ɛma nimdeɛ fa mmara kwan ne hokwan ho. Ɛde wɔn kɔhu 'legal aid' (Mmoa akuw nkitahodie/ mmara mmoa). Ɛkyerɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔgye adanseɛ (evidence) na wɔko ma wɔn hokwan. Ɛma wɔn ahooden de hwehwɛ nsakraeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu nna mu akwahosan ho ahiade soronko ne nneɛma a, wosusuw ho ma mmabun a wɔwɔ SOGI ahorow.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ahorow ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne ɔman no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne ɔman no mu denam ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim mu kyɛfa a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu, wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn di nkitaho, wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, na wɔaka wɔn suahu ahorow ho asɛm akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne ahwɛfo betumi adi wɔ boa a wɔbɛboa mmaabun ma wɔafa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a epira mu na wɔako atia, a nea ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw, nsɛm a ɛfa ho ne adwene a wɔde bɛma, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nneyɛe a ɛho hia a wɔde di dwuma ho nhwɛso?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo betumi aboa mmaabun ma wɔafa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a epira mu na wɔako atia denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ne nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi anya wɔ mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe so ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw so. Nsɛm a ɛfa ho ne adwene a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow ho, a abakɔsɛm ne amammerɛ mu nneɛma a ɛka ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuakuo, ne nna ho mfonini ahorow ka ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nneyɛe a ɛho hia a wɔde di dwuma ho nhwɛso, te sɛ nsusuwii hunu a wogye ho kyim, fibea ahorow a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ, ne adwene ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ. Sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyiam ahorow a ɛma mmabun a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ tumi ma wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a ɛfata di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na afotu ne adwumayɛ ho akwankyerɛ di wɔ boa a, wɔboa mmabun ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nhomasua ne adwumayɛ akwan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi?
answer_twi_source: Afotu ne adwumayɛ ho akwankyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ boa a, wɔboa mmabun ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nhomasua ne adwumayɛ akwan ho. Afotufoɔ betumi de nhumu a ɛsom boɔ, afotuo, ne mmoa a egyina wɔn ankasa suahunu ne wɔn nimdeɛ so ama, aboa mmabun ma wɔahwehwɛ adwuma ahodoɔ mu, de botaeɛ asisi wɔn ani so, na wɔanya nimdeɛ a ɛfata. Mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi denam afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, adwumayɛfo nkitahodi ahorow, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛka wɔn ne afotufo a wɔwɔ wɔn anigyede mu no di nkitaho so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmti bɛn na wɔka ho asɛm wɔ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔyɛ ma mmabun no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ma mmabun mu no, wobetumi aka nsɛmti ahorow ho asɛm, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nyinsɛn ano aduru a wobetumi apaw ne afotu. STI a wosiw ano, sɔhwɛ, ne ayaresa. Brayɛ akwahosan ne brayɛ mu ahotew Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne options counseling. Abusuabɔ pa ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nipadua ne nipadua mu nkwaadɔm. Mpene, ahye, ne nna ho gyinaesi. Awo nipadua ne nipadua mu nkwaadɔm. Nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu anigye, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, ne pene a wɔpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka sa ma LGBTQ+ -nkabom nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛwɔ akwahosan asoɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Ghana wɔ mmara ano sie ahorow a ɛfa LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho, .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na "hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛtumi gyina wim tebea ano na ɛtra hɔ daa" kyerɛ ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a ɛwɔ sɛ mmabun nya nna ne awoɔ apomoden (SRH) a ɛtumi gyina wim tebea ano na ɛtra hɔ daa no kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya SRH hwɛ pa a ɛbɛtumi agyina wim nsakraeɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔ ano na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ mu. Ɛfa apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔbɛma atra hɔ daa ho nkuran, na wɔadi mmabun SRH ahiade soronko ho dwuma wɔ ɔhaw a ɛfa wim tebea ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nneɛma a ɛhaw haw a mmabun nya wɔ mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nea ɛhaw adwene a wɔtaa nya wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho no betumi ayɛ: Kokoam nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn: Mmabun betumi ahaw wɔn ho sɛ wɔn kokoam nsɛm bɛsɛe sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn mu a, titiriw sɛ wɔka nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho asɛm anaasɛ wɔda wɔn ankasa nsɛm adi a. Animtiaabu: Atemmu anaa animtiaabu a wosuro a efi atipɛnfo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho mu. Ahintasɛm a wonni: Ahintasɛm ho dadwen betumi asɔre, titiriw sɛ mmabun nnim sɛ ebia dwumadi no mu adwumayɛfo de wɔn ho nsɛm bɛsie anaa. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a etu mpɔn: Ebia mmabun binom begye sɛnea nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no tu mpɔn wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a wodi ho dwuma anaasɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde ma mu no ho kyim. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow: Ɛbia mmabun a wofi amammerɛ anaa nyamesom a ɛyɛ katee mu no haw wɔ sɛnea dwumadi no mu nsɛm ne wɔn gyidi ne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow hyia no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa hokwan ahorow "legal rights" a mewɔ wɔ mmara kwan so ne akwan horow a metumi afa so a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi anya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa wo mmara kwan so hokwan "rights" ahorow ne akwan a wubetumi afa so afa awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho bere a woyɛ ɔbabun no denam mmeae ahorow so, a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔagye din a wɔyɛ mmabun akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow ho adwuma titiriw, aban wɛbsaet anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne akuw a wɔkamfo mmara kwan so ka ho. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ama wo nsɛm a ɛfa mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho, hokwan ahorow a wowɔ sɛ wobɛhwɛ wo wɔ kokoam na wopene so, ne nnwuma a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yebetumi afa so adi nkitaho pefee na yɛadi nokware afa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti ho bere a yɛda so ara bu yɛn ho yɛn ho kokoamu nsɛm ne ahye?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a afa abien no nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn nsusuwii ne wɔn haw adi. Bu wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye denam nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti a wobɛka ho asɛm bere a nnipa baanu no nyinaa ayɛ krado na wɔwɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nkutoo so. Fa kasa a ɛnyɛ atɛn, obu, na ɛte nka wɔ mo ho mo ho nkate ne kokoam nsɛm ho di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mibisa obi a obetumi ayɛ yaresafo anaa ɔfotufo wɔ bere a edi kan a merekɔ no? (osuahu, nneɛma titiriw, ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma) .
answer_twi_source: Bisa wɔn ayaresa ho kwan (sɛ nhwɛso no, ɔkasa ayaresa, adwene mu nneyɛe ho ayaresa) na hwɛ sɛ ɛte sɛ nea ɛfata wo yiye anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina m’ahiade ne nea mepɛ so, asi akwan a mɛfa so abɔ ho ban abien ho gyinae?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a eye sen biara ma wo no gyina w’ankorankoro ahiade ne nea wopɛ so. Susuw nneɛma yi ho: Ahobammɔ dodow a wopɛ: So wode nyinsɛn a wosiw ano anaa STI ahobammɔ (anaa n’abien nyinaa) di kan? Ɛnyɛ den sɛ wode bedi dwuma: Paw akwan a wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wode bedi dwuma bere nyinaa. Nneɛma bɔne a ebetumi afi mu aba: Wo ne wo duruyɛfo nsusuw nneɛma bɔne a ebetumi afi mu aba ho. Ɛka: Susuw ɔkwan biara ho ka ne insurance biara a wɔde tua ho ka ho. Kae: Wo ne w’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo nkasa. Wɔbetumi aboa wo ma woahwehwɛ akwan a wubetumi afa so, abua nsɛmmisa, na woakamfo ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so abɔ wo ho ban abien ama wo tebea pɔtee no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie bɛn na suadeɛ mu nimdeɛ (academic performance) ne nneyɛe foforɔ a mmofra yɛ (extracurricular activities) di wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so paw nnipa ma wɔn sika mu mmoa (financial support)?
answer_twi_source: Adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ ne adesua akyi dwumadi ahorow betumi adi dwuma wɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔde paw sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow no mu, efisɛ ebetumi ada osuani bi ahofama, ne tumi a obetumi adi nkonim wɔ wɔn nhomasua mu adi. Dwumadie binom betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wonya GPA a ɛba fam koraa anaa sɔhwɛ mu nkontabuo a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, berɛ a afoforo nso bɛtumi asusu ho sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadiɛ a ɛka adesua akyi, akannifoɔ dwumadie, mpɔtam hɔ som, anaa talente/ akyɛdeɛ soronko ne nkɔsoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda anansesɛm ne nokwasɛm ahorow ntam bere a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ yie na woannnye nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ dodo anaa obi ankasa asɛm a ɔka fa ne ho nnye nni prɛko pɛ. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ mmuaeɛ ne adansie gyina akyi, na apɔmuden mmoakuo a agye din nso pene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔ wɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no betumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔwɔ nkuraase anaa akyirikyiri betumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma denam akwan horow so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so nneɛma ne nhomasua nneɛma a ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ din ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de ma a wɔde bedi dwuma. Nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, mpɔtam akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow, anaa Ɔmantam akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow hɔ. Fa wo ho bɛhyɛ telefon so aduruyɛ nea broni ka no 'telemedicine' nhyehyɛe a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde akyirikyiri afotu ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho no mu. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ anaa mmabun akuw a ebia wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow, mmoa akuw, anaasɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan so bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua pii afa nkitahodi a etu mpɔn a ɛfa adwenemyare ho? (adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so akwankyerɛ ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔwmuden ho ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa no wɔ nneɛma a wode bedi nkitaho yiye wɔ adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden ne nsusuansoɔ efiri mu ba sɛ yɛdi nitaho ɛwɔ mmra ho adwuma a wɔbɛyɛ ama mmaabun ho sikakora, na sɛnea wɔbɛtumi ama ne ho nhia pii?
answer_twi_source: Ahobammɔ (amumɔyɛfoɔ). Mmara mu nsusuhoɔ. Atinka mu akɔtia. Fa ahobammɔ sie kan, hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ, na hwɛ woho yie
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasiesie wɔn ho ama adwumayɛ mu, a ebi ne sɛnea wɔkyerɛw adwumahwehwɛ krataa, akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ adwuma, adwumahwehwɛ mu nsɛmmisahyia ho nteteeɛ, ne nimdeɛ a wɔbɛnya de ayɛ adwuma kɛseɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma pii de asiesie wɔn ho ama adwumayɛ mu, a ebi ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde kyerɛw adwumahwehwɛ krataa, intanɛt so mmeaeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ adwuma, adwumahwehwɛ mu nsɛmmisahyia ho nteteeɛ, ne adesua ahorow a ɛma obi bɛyɛ obibiara wɔ n’adwuma mu. Sukuu mu adwumahwehwɛ mmoabea, mpɔtam mu ahyehyɛdeɛ ahorow, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ intanɛt so ma nnwinnadeɛ ne akwankyerɛ a ɛsom bo de boa mmabun ma wɔtumi kyerɛw wɔn resume, wɔhyehyɛ akwan pa a wɔfa so hwehwɛ adwuma, wɔyɛ wɔn ho fɛre wɔ nsɛmmisahyia mu, na wɔma wɔn nimdeɛ ne wɔn hoakyerɛ wɔ adwumayɛ mu kɔ anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ masiesie me ho a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo anaa m’abusuafo aka me nna ho akɔnnɔ ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma, mmoa nhama, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛn na wɔde nsɛm, mmoa, ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne ntetee a wɔde ma mmabun ne mpanyimfo wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wobesiw ano ho no bi?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma, mmoa ahomatrofo, ne nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔde mmoa ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ a wobesiw ano ho no bi ne: Mmonnaato Ho Ahokyere ho Asoɛe: Nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔde ahokyere mu de wɔn ho gye mu, afotu, mmoa akuw, ne nnwuma a wɔde kamfo wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu ma. Ɔman Ntrɛwmu: Mmoa a wɔde kokoam mmoa, nsɛm, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ne wɔn adɔfo, te sɛ Ofie Basabasayɛ ne Wɔn a Wɔayɛ Wɔn Basabasayɛ Mmoa Dwumadibea (DOVVSU). Nkyerɛkyerɛ Nhyehyɛe ahorow: Nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ntetee a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodie a ahoɔden wom, ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ma mmabun ne mpanyimfo nyinaa ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na mmaabun betumi afa so akora sika so, na mfaso ne sintɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ ɔkwan biara so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so akora sika so, na emu biara wɔ mfaso ne ne bɔne: Sikakorabea a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so: Ɛma ahobammɔ ne sika a wɔde di dwuma nanso mpɛn pii no ɛma mfɛntom a ɛba fam, na ɛto mfaso a ebetumi aba no ano hye. Certificates of deposit (CD): Ma mfɛntom a ɛkɔ soro sen sikakorabea nanso ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔto sika mu bere pɔtee bi, na ɛmma wontumi nnya sika. Pɛnhyen akontaabu (sɛ nhwɛso no, IRAs, 401(k)s): Ma towtua mu mfaso ne bere tenten nkɔso a ebetumi aba nanso ɛwɔ anohyeto ahorow wɔ sika a woyi fi mu ho na ebetumi de asotwe aba bere a wotumi kɔ hɔ ntɛm no. Sikakorabea akontaabu (sɛ nhwɛso no, aguadifo akontaabu): Ma tumi a ɛbɛma wɔanya mfaso kɛse nanso ɛde sika a wɔde asie ho asiane ba na ebia ebehia nimdeɛ na wɔatumi adi ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me hokafo no ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nhwehwɛmu ho mu na mahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn baanu nyinaa de yɛn nna mu apomoden di kan?
answer_twi_source: Wo hokafo a wode no bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho mu no betumi ahyɛ mo abusuabɔ ne mo ho mo ho ntease mu den. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Nkitahodi a Wobue: Fi ase bɔ nkɔmmɔ fa nna mu akwahosan ho, na si so dua sɛ ɛfa wo baanu nyinaa yiyedi ho. Mommom Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Monkɔ nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow sɛ awarefo. Mommom Nsɔ Nhwɛ: Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ mobɛbom asɔ ahwɛ, ma adeyɛ no ayɛ nea ɛfata na kyerɛ sɛ mo nyinaa boa. Munsusuw Siw Ano: Ka akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a ɛyɛ adwuma ma mo baanu nyinaa ho asɛm. Daa Nkɔhwɛ: Ma ɛnyɛ wo daa sɛ wobɛka nna mu akwahosan ne biribiara a ɛhaw wo ho asɛm pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie anaa nnwuma ahodoɔ bɛn na wɔtaa de di dwuma denam ayɔnkofa a ɛda ankorankoro ne ɔmanfoɔ ntam de boa sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde ma mmabun so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe: Nkɔmmɔbɔ boa nnwuma te sɛ adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adesua, ne adwuma a wɔde ma a ɛma mmabun nya nimdeɛ a mfaso wɔ so ne adwumayɛ mu osuahu. Adwumayɛfoɔ mmoa: Dwumadie ahodoɔ ma nteteeɛ, afotuo, ne sikasɛm mu kwan ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔyɛ adwuma ma wɔhyɛ wɔn nnwuma ase na wɔnya nkɔsoɔ. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne nea wɔde ka ho: Nneɛma a wɔyɛ no hyɛ sikasɛm ho adesua, sikakorabea, sikasɛm nketewa ho nnwuma, ne bosea a mmabun nya de nya sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne ahofadi ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛ pa ho nsusui a ɛwɔ digital mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛ pa ho nsusuii a ɛfa digital mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa mu no bi ne: Mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm a wobebu denam nkitahodi akwan a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma so, pene a wobenya wɔ nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛboaboa nsɛm ano, ne nsɛm a ɛho hia a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban so. Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ intanɛt so no yɛ nokware, egyina adanse so, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ nsɛm a epira anaasɛ ɛkasa tia. Abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ, nokwaredi, ne obu ho a wobedi akyi wɔ nkitahodi a wɔne mmabun di wɔ Intanɛt so nyinaa mu, a ahye a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu ne kwati a wɔbɛkwati sɛ wɔde wɔn di dwuma anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mfe a obi adi ho mmara fa abusuabɔ a nnipa baanu no nyinaa yɛ mmofra nkumaa no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, mfe a obi adi ho mmara no fa nna mu abusuabɔ a anyɛ yiye koraa no obiako a ɔnyɛ abofra kumaa ka ho. Sɛ nnipa baanu no nyinaa yɛ mmofra nkumaa a, ebi tumi anya mmara anaa akwankyerɛ pɔtee bi a ɛkyerɛ saa abusuabɔ ahorow yi, te sɛ mfe a wɔbɛn wɔn a wɔayi wɔn afi mu anaa nsɛm a ɛfa mfe a wɔadi ho nsonsonoe a ɛda ahokafo ntam ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asane pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ ma nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ma nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna bi? (ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom) .
answer_twi_source: Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ nna mu no betumi anya nna mu yare (STI.) Ebia nna mu nneyɛe bi de asiane kɛse bɛba, a nna mfa ho. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom te sɛ kɔndɔm ne ntini a wɔde yɛ nsensan ho hia kɛse na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya STI no so atew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na abɛɛfo ntetan dae mmabun nkyinamayɛ awoɔ ahokwasan apɔmmuden de nyiyimu ba, na mmabun bɛyɛ dɛn ako atia saa nyiyi mu yi?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntetan hyɛ nyiyimu den. Mmabun betumi akasa wɔ: Abɛɛfo ntetan adesua, ahwehwɛ mu, ayɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm, na wɔakasa akyerɛ Abɛɛfo ntetan adwumayɛfoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahyehyɛ ahyeɛ pa wɔ m'abusuabɔ mu de asi GBV kwan(ka daabi, kyerɛkyerɛ w'ahiade)?
answer_twi_source: hyeɛ pa hia sɛ yedi si GBV ano: Eka daabi: Wubetumi aka daabi sɛ wompɛ sɛ eni woho nnye, anikanso anaa wantenka. Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ hiade: Wo wɔ ho kwan sɛ woka deɛ wopɛ wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Obuo ma ahyeɛ: Sɛ obi hyɛ woso anaa ɔmmu wo hyeɛ a, ɛyɛ asiane.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo aka nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ahye a mewɔ ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma ne ho atɔ me  wɔ obu kwan so?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi yɛ ade titiriw wɔ abusuabɔ biara mu, titiriw bere a ɛfa nna ho no. Sɛ wo ne wo hokafo ka w’akɔnnɔ ne w’ahye ho asɛm ansa na woayɛ nna biara a, ɛboa ma obiara te nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no na wobu no. Afotuo bi a ɛbɛma woatumi adi nkitaho yie nie: Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: "Me te nka yie sɛ woka me..." anaa "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ..." Fa adwene si osetie so: Tie wo hokafoɔ akɔnnɔ ne n'ahyeɛ nso. Obu kyerɛ sɛ "dabi" a wobɛka no nyɛ hwee: Sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛnyɛ dɛ a, wo anaa wo hokafo wɔ hokwan sɛ woka dabi anaasɛ wogyae bere biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi animtiaabu anaa nyiyim so nkonim bere a, wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan (ASRH) ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi: Ahwehwɛ ayaresabea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a, wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne ɔhwɛ a wɔmfa atemmu nni dwuma di kan. Kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho nhyehyɛe na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa obu nni dwuma. Fa intanɛt so nneɛma anaa telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ahomatrofo (telephone) so di dwuma ma kokoam nsɛm ne mmoa. Wo ne atipɛnfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa a wɔhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho nkuran no nni nkitaho na wodi animtiaabu ne nyiyim ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ nneɛma ahorow a wɔde bɛka ho na wogye tom wɔ m’atipɛnfo kuw anaa mpɔtam hɔ ho nkuran wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Ma obiara nka wo dwumadi ne wo nnamfofa ho. Di ahorow ahorow ho afahyɛ denam amammerɛ ne atetesɛm ahorow a wubesua so. Gyina hɔ tia asisifo anaasɛ wɔayi wɔn afi afoforo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a wɔfa so gyina adwennwen ano, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya na yɛde adi dwuma wɔ yɛn daadaa asetra mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina adwennwen ano no bi ne sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu, wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwene mu anaasɛ wodwennwen nneɛma ho, wɔbɛhwehwɛ asetrena mu mmoa afi nnamfo ne abusuafo hɔ, na wɔakura asetra a ɛkari pɛ mu a nna ne aduan pa a ɛfata wom. Saa akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano yi a wobɛhyehyɛ no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛsɔ akwan horow ahwɛ de ahu nea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma wo na wode ahyɛ wo da biara da dwumadi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na saa akwansideɛ a ɛbɔ abira de bɛba apɔmden nsɛnsɛm ne nneɛma ahodoɔ a ɛde mpuntuo ba mmabun nna mu apɔmuden ho nsɛm so daakye?
answer_twi_source: Ayarehwɛ nkyekyemu. Adwene mu haw. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ fam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma ne mmoa bi a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebia wɔrehyia anaa wɔrehu abusuabɔ a ɛnnyɛ papa anaa ɛyɛ ayayadeɛ, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛtumi anya mmoa anaa afotuo?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehyia anaa wɔhunu abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaa wɔyɛ ayayadeɛ no bi ne:  Afotuo Dwumadie: Afotuo anaa ayaresa dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ama ankorankoro anaa awarefoɔ afotuo de adi abusuabɔ ho nsɛm ho dwuma na wɔayɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano. - Hotlines ne Helplines: Mmoa telefon anaa hotlines a wɔyɛ titire wɔ abusuabɔ ho afotuo anaa mmoa a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔrehyia ayayadeɛ anaa nkɔsoɔ a ɛnyɛ papa mu a wɔbɛdi nkitaho. - Mmoa Kuo: Wɔbɛka mmoa akuo anaa nkɔmmɔdie a atipɛnfoɔ di anim de ne afoforɔ a wɔwɔ suahunu a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho na wɔanya adansedie ne mmoa. Sukuu Afotufoɔ: Wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa afiri sukuu afotufoɔ anaa mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ, nneɛma, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ nnwuma a ɛfata mu ama. - Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Intanɛt so nneɛma, wɛbsaet, ne nhyiamu a wɔde ama abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa, pene so nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne ayayadeɛ anaa nhyɛsoɔ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔhunu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na makyerɛ su pa ne ahoɔden a ɛwɔ me ne afoforo mu a ɛboro abɔnten so adansedie anaa pene a mfɛfo gye tom so, te sɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛwɔ nipadua mu, ankorankoro nkɔso, ne suban su ahorow, na mɛyɛ dɛn anya adwene a ɛne sɛ mesom bo ne abotɔyam a ɛnyɛ nea efi abɔnten so nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Su pa ne ahoɔden a ɛboro abɔnten adansedi so a wobehu na wɔakyerɛ ho anisɔ no hwehwɛ sɛ: Gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛwɔ nipadua no mu: Fa w’adwene si ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nkannyan ahorow a ɛwɔ nipadua no mu so sɛ nea ɛma wonya mmamu ne ntease fibea, sen sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ sɛ wogye atom afi abɔnten so nneɛma nkutoo mu. Ankorankoro nkɔso: Di wo nkɔso, wo talente, ne nkɔso a woanya wɔ wo botae ahorow ho no ho afahyɛ, na hu mmɔdenbɔ ne ahofama a egyee na ama woadu ho. Suban su ahorow: Bu su ahorow te sɛ ayamye, tema, ahoɔden a wotumi gyina ano, ne nokwaredi sɛ nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ ankorankoro nkɔso ne nkɔso, a ɛnyɛ abɔnten so pene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyekye nnamfo ne abusuafo a wɔte nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ase mmoa nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den?
answer_twi_source: Nnamfo: Hwehwɛ nnamfo a wɔn adwene abue na wɔkyerɛ obu bere a woresusuw nna mu akwahosan ho no. Abusua: Susuw ho sɛ wo ne ɔwofo, wo nua, anaa abusua mu no foforo a wogye wɔn di bɛkasa. wo sukuu fotufo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔde mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun, na mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma me?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm: Nkɔmmɔbɔ, nneɛma a wɔatintim, video ahorow, intanɛt so nneɛma. Mmoa: Afotuo, atipɛnfoɔ akuo, nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ, adwumayɛbea, nyinsɛn ano aduru/STI dwumadie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ayɛ na ama ɔkwan a mapaw sɛ mede siw nyinsɛn ano no atu mpɔn kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛma ɔkwan a woapaw a wode siw nyinsɛn ano no atu mpɔn kɛse ni: Fa di dwuma daa na ɛteɛ bere biara a wo ne obi bɛda. Eyi ne ade a ɛho hia sen biara a ɛbɛma wɔatu mpɔn yiye. Di akwankyerɛ no akyi yiye: Kenkan nsɛm kratasin a ɛka ɔkwan a woapaw no ho na bisa w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo sɛ biribiara mu nna hɔ anaa. Fa wo nyinsɛn ano aduru sie yiye: Ɔhyew, owia hann, anaa nsu betumi asɛe akwan bi (te sɛ ekum mmadwoa). Susuw ho sɛ wode ɔkwan a wode bɛbɔ wo ho ban bedi dwuma: Sɛ wo kwan titiriw no di nkogu (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm a abubu) a, sɛ wowɔ kɔndɔm wɔ wo nsam a, ɛma wunya ahobammɔ foforo. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa: Wobetumi adi nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo ho dwuma na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wode ɔkwan a woapaw no redi dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a mmabun fa so kamfo hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam no kyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam denam: Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hokwan ahorow ne mmara a ɛfa akwahosan ho kokoamsɛm ho no so. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ kokoam anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Nneɛma te sɛ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, telefon a wɔde boa, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de anya nsɛm ne mmoa. Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo de ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ho ban no ho nkuran. Nkitahodi a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bedi nkitaho pefee na wɔaka no pen afa nea wɔpɛ ne wɔn ahiade ahorow a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ abusua mufo afoforo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa afotufo hɔ, de adi tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu na wɔakamfo akyerɛ yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa hokwan ho nnyinasosɛm fa nsɛm te sɛ mmawoɔ ne nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne ayaresa dwumadie a mbabun hia ho?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow no fa nsɛm te sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne ayaresa dwumadie a mmabun nya ho denam: Hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛnyɛ nyiyim, na ɛfata wɔn mfe a wɔadi no so dua. Mmabun ahofadi ne wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn ho a wobegye atom wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne daakye ho no mu. Hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne nipadua mu nokwaredi ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe nyinaa mu a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuo ahorow adi nkitaho na wɔanya so nkɛntɛnso de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde wɔn nne, osuahu ahorow, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan no gyina hɔ ma na wɔde di kan wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuo ahorow mu denam ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim, afotufo akuo, ne nhyiam ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so. Ɛdenam wɔn suahu, nhumu, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan a wɔbɛkyɛ so no, mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔasusuw wɔn adwene ho wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, na ɛde ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bo mu na ɛyɛ nea wɔyɛ ho biribi kɛse aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me hokafo (sɛ ɛfata a) ne me ba anya abusuabɔ pa?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛkyekye no yɛ ade titiri: Ɔhokafo: Nkitahodi a ɛmu da hɔ, asɛde ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye ho hia yie. Akokoaa: Wo ne wo ba no nya abusuabɔ fi ase bere a wonyinsɛn no. Wo ne wo ba no nkasa, to nnwom, na kenkan nsɛm. Kae: Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛtrɛw wo nsam akɔhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ nsusuansso a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi anya adwene mu yareɛ, na sɛ wɔn anaa obi a wonim no wɔ ahokyere mu a, anammɔn bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun tu?
answer_twi_source: Nsususanso a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi anya adwenem mu yare no bi ne sɛ adwene a ɛsakra kɛse, ɔtwe ne ho fi nneɛma a ɔtaa yɛ ho, nsakrae a ɛba suban anaa ne nipasu mu, adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛne sɛ obekum ne ho, ne ho a obepira, nnuru a ɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, anaa adwene mu yare. Sɛ ɔbabun anaa obi a wonim no wɔ ahokyere mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nneɛma ntɛm ara de hwɛ hu sɛ ahobammɔ wɔ hɔ, te sɛ ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di a wɔbɛkɔ, ahomotrofo a wɔbɛ frɛ ɛfa ɔhaw ho, anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ayaresa a egye ntɛmpɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛfa asɛm biara a ɛfa wo ho a wokum anaa wo ho a wobɛpira ho no aniberesɛm na woahwehwɛ mmoa a wontwentwɛn wo nan ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Su anaa nneɛma bɛn na ɛma akwahosan ho beae bi "yɛ mmabun adamfofa su," na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma wonya akwahosan ho osuahu pa?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun no wɔ su ahorow a edidi so yi: Nea wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun so: Nnwuma ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ a ɛfa mmabun ahiade pɔtee ho. Ahintasɛm: Kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho awerɛhyem a wɔde bɛma de ayɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom ama mmabun a wɔbɛka nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho asɛm. Su a ɛnyɛ atemmu: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔda ntease, tema, ne obu adi kyerɛ mmabun a wɔmfa wɔn ankasa gyidi anaa gyinapɛn ahorow nhyɛ wɔn so. Nneɛma a wobetumi akɔ hɔ: Beae a ɛfata, nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ne nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den a ɛbɛma mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow atumi akɔ hɔ. Nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri: Awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ahodoɔ pii a wɔde bɛma, a nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, afotu, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ka ho. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Hokwan ahorow a mmabun nya de wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ne ɔsom adwuma a wɔde ma ho mu. Saa nneɛma yi boa ma wonya akwahosan ho osuahu pa denam ahotoso, nkitahodi, ne tumi a ɛma mmabun nya so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ sukuu tebea no mu a ɛbɛboa asuafoɔ adwenemyareɛ ahiadeɛ, te sɛ afotuo dwumadie, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, anaa apɔmuden mmeaeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahodoɔ taa de nneɛma ahodoɔ bi ma de boa asuafoɔ adwenemyareɛ ahiadeɛ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Afotuo dwumadie a sukuu afotufoɔ anaa adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ de ma. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo anaa afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a asuafoɔ bɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔrehyia ɔhaw a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Akwahosan mmeae anaa adan a wɔde nneɛma ma a nsɛm, nneɛma, ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa adwenemyare ne yiyedi ho wom. Wɔde wɔn kɔ mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛbea anaa abɔnten so ayarehwɛfoɔ nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ mmoa titire kɛseɛ. Ɔhaw mu dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi adwenemyareɛ a ɛhia ntɛm ho dwuma. Nhomasua nneɛma ne nhyiamu a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ ne awofoɔ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa adwenemyareɛ ho nimdeɛ ne wɔn ankasa hwɛ ho. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwankyerɛfo, anaa sukuu ayarehwɛfo a wobetumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama asuafo a wohia mmoa a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no di kan, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ saa nneyɛe a ɛfa ahodwiriw ho yi wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so nkitahodi ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa a egyina wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu so no de wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no fahodi, ahobammɔ, ne yiyedi di kan. Saa akwan yi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no tumi ma wɔasi wɔn ankasa gyinaeɛ wɔ amanneɛbɔ ho, wɔde mmoa akwan ahodoɔ a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahiadeɛ bɛma, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔde nidi, obuo, ne ayamhyehyeɛ bedi wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ho dwuma wɔ adeyɛ no nyinaa mu. Mmabun betumi aboa saa nneyɛe a ɛfa ahodwiriw ho yi denam nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so nkitahodi ahorow mu no so. Ebia nea ɛka eyi ho ne hokwan ahorow a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya, nneɛma a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu di anim a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, na wɔakasa atia su ne nneyɛe a wɔde bɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wohyia nsohwe anaa animhwɛ bere a worehwehwɛ ofie anaa tenabea a, dɛn na wobɛtumi ayɛ de akasa ama wo ndinoɔ na woahwɛ sɛ wobɛnya mmoa a ɛteɛ na obu wom?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wonnim sɛ wuhia mmoa wɔ ofie anaa tenabea ho a, fi ase ne panyin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ awofoɔ, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, anaa apɔmuden nkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nkasa. Wubetumi nso ne mpɔtam hɔ mmoa ntelefon anaa akuo a wɔboa mmabun a wɔwɔ amanehunu mu no akasa. Wɔbetumi ama wo afotu na wɔaboa wo ma woahunu mmoa a ɛyɛ papa a egyina wo tebea wo wɔ mu ne w’ahiadeɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na me nipadua resesa esiane hormones 'honam mu nkwammoa' ahorow nti?
answer_twi_source: Hormone ahorow na ɛma nsakrae pii a worehyia wɔ wo mmabunyɛ berɛ mu no ba. Wɔn nti na woreyɛ tenten, worenya nna mu su a ɛto so abien, worenya adwene mu nsakrae, ne nea ɛkeka ho. Hormone ahorow te sɛ nipadua no mu "switches" a ɛdannan nyin ne nkɔso afã horow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofoɔ, ɔhwɛfoɔ, ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ betumi adi de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya intanɛt so su pa ne mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Emu Da Hɔ: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ fa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so banbɔ ne mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran. Nkyerɛkyerɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ: Sukuu betumi de mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ aka wɔn adesua ho. Afidie a ɛbɔ nkae : Awofoɔ ne ɔhwɛfoɔ betumi de afidie a ɛbɔ nkae adi dwuma de ahwɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so dwumadie a wɔremmu kɔkoamunsɛm so. Ahyeɛ a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Hyehyɛ mmara ne ahyeɛ a emu da hɔ ma abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so dwumadie, te sɛ bere a wɔde hwɛ skreen. Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ ma wɔn: Ɛsɛ sɛ awofoɔ, ɔhwɛfoɔ, ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ da abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so suban pa adi ma mmabun suasua. Awofoɔ, ɔhwɛfoɔ, ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ di dwuma titiriw wɔ akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma mmabun kɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so suban pa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no akyerɛ ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di wɔ wɔn mmoa nhyehyɛe no mu, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛboa wɔ mmere a wohia mmoa mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no akɔma ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛmu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛbɔ afa wɔn ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow ho no so. Wobetumi akyɛ nkitahodi ho nsɛm a ɛho hia, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛbɛboa afoforo ma wɔahu bere a ebia wobehia mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wohu ankorankoro ahiade ahorow, na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a ɛte sɛ nea wotumi di ho dwuma na etu mpɔn so dua.
answer_twi_source: Hu w’ahiade ahorow: Nneyɛe bɛn na ɛma wote nka sɛ wo ho adwo wo, wowɔ tumi, na wutumi di wo ho so? Daa a Wotumi Di Ho Dwuma: Yɛ nhyehyɛe a wode bɛhwɛ wo ho a, wubetumi abata ho ankasa na woanya so mfaso kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi akyɛ abusuabɔ pa ho nhwɛsopa ahorow a efi w’ankasa osuahun ahorow anaa nea woahu mu?
answer_twi_source: Ampa, abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom betumi ayɛ te sɛ ahokafo a wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho botaeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ, di nkitaho pefee na wodi nokware, wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho ahyeɛ, na wɔbom yɛ adwuma de di haw so. Wodi wɔn ho wɔn ho nkonimdi ho afahyɛ, wotie wɔn ho wɔn ho haw ahorow, na wɔbom sisi gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne asetra mu nsunsuanso betumi aboa ma wɔde nnubɔne adi dwuma, na mɛyɛ dɛn ako atia nhyɛso ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne asetra mu nsunsuanso betumi aboa ma wɔde nnuru adi dwuma denam mmabun suban, wɔn gyidi, ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso so. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na mmabun ako atia nhyɛso ahorow yi no, wobetumi: Wɔka wɔn ahye ne wɔn pow ho nimdeɛ ho asɛm denneennen bere a wohyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔmfa nnuru nni dwuma no. Fa nnamfo a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn koro na wɔboa asetra kwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔpaw no twa wɔn ho hyia. Fa asɛm a wɔka no penpen ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ di dwuma de ko tia atipɛnfo nhyɛso na paw nneɛma a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn botae ahorow hyia. Hwehwɛ nhwɛso pa ne afotufo a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ atipɛnfo abusuabɔ a wɔbɛfa so akɔ so ne nkɛntɛnso bɔne a wɔbɛko atia no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata ayaresa mmoa a wobenya ho, na akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebia wonni ayaresa-ho-banbɔ (insurance) anaa sika a wɔde bɛtua saa ka yi?
answer_twi_source: Ebia ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata aduruyɛ mu mmoa a wobenya ho, nanso mpɛn pii no akwan horow bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun a ebia wonni ayaresa-ho-banbɔ (insurance) anaa sika a wɔde bɛtua saa ka yi betumi apaw. Eyi betumi ayɛ ayaresabea ahorow a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua, aban mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaasɛ akwan a wɔfa so tua sika a ɛkɔ fam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma mmabun mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aboa ma me yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no de mfasoɔ pii ba mmabun so: Nhomasua a ɛmu dɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔ awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, na ɛma mmabun tumi si gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho. Atipɛnfo mmoa: Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ma wonya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo adi nkitaho, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔanya mmoa afi afoforo a wohyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no ma wonya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ (STI )  nhwehwɛmu, ne afotu, a ebia wontumi nnya ntɛm wɔ mmeae afoforo. Tumi a wɔde ma: Ɛdenam dwumadi ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn so no, mmabun nya ahotoso, akannifo ho nimdeɛ, ne ahofadi ho adwene wɔ wɔn ankasa akwahosan ne yiyedi ho. Animtiaabu a ɛso tew: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no yɛ adwuma de tew animtiaabu a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no so, na ɛma tebea bi a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa. Akwahosan mu nsunsuanso a ɛkɔ anim: Ɛdenam nneyɛe a wɔde siw ano ne nea wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ntɛm a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran so no, nhyehyɛe ahorow yi boa ma awo akwahosan mu nkɔso pa ne yiyedi nyinaa ba mmabun mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nsɛm a egyina adanse so ne nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wogyina nsɛm a egyina adanse so a efi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nnumakuo ahorow a wɔwɔ din pa, ne nhwehwɛmu a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu so na asi nna mu akwahosan ho gyinae. Kwati sɛ wode wo ho bɛto anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho so, efisɛ ebetumi de nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, adwene atu afra, ne nea ebetumi ɛha aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na dawurobɔ nwomanim a abroɔfɔ fre no 'media literacy' ne kuru atɛntrenee'social justic' di nsia, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia ma wɔn a wɔresi soɔ sɛ wobɛ dwenyie afa dawurobɔ atrrɔnsem enfri kuru atɛntrenee enso?
answer_twi_source: Dawurobɔ nwomanim 'Media literacy' boa wɔn a wɔresi soɔ ma yehu nyiyimu na pɛyɛnkɔ a ɛwɔ dawurobɔ atrrɔnsemu. Sɛ yɛdwene ho yi paa wɔ dawurobɔ efafri atɛntrenee ani hwɛ a, yɛtumi ko tia adwene bɔne, yakasa ma ndianimfo na yapae pɛpɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso horow bɛn na ɛtra hɔ kyɛ a wonya fi ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a emu yɛ den a wobenya ama mmabun, te sɛ obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, nkitahodi, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne akannifo tumi a ɛkɔ anim, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de saa nimdeɛ yi adi dwuma wɔ wɔn ankasa ne adwumayɛ asetra afã horow mu wɔ babun akyi?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ a ɛwɔ ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a emu yɛ den a wobenya ama mmabun so no bi ne: Obu a wonya ma wɔn ho a ɛkɔ anim: Ntawntawdi a wosiesie no yiye betumi ama mmabun anya ahotoso ne wɔn ho a ɛsom bo kɛse, na ama wɔn yiyedi nyinaa ayɛ kɛse. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim: Mmabun nya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn, a nea ɛka ho ne atie a wɔde nsiyɛ, ka a wɔka denneennen, ne tema, a ɛsom bo wɔ ankorankoro ne adwumayɛfo ntam nkitahodie mu. Ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a eye: Ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun tumi de adwene a ɛfa ano aduru ho di nsunsuanso ho dwuma, na ɛma wotumi siesie ɔhaw ahorow a etu mpɔn kɛse.
