Akannifo tumi a ɛkɔ soro: Mmabun a wɔyɛ adwuma yiye wɔ ntawntawdi ano aduru mu no taa da adi sɛ abɔde mu akannifo, a wotumi yɛ ntamgyinafo wɔ ntawntawdi mu na wɔma wɔn atipɛnfo yɛ biako. Nsunsuanso  pa a ɛwɔ nkitahodie so: Ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a emu yɛ den boa ma wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusua mufo, ne ɔdɔfo nya nkitahodie a ɛyɛ papa na ɛyɛ biako, na ɛma wonya abotɔyam kɛse wɔ asetra mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wobenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwanside ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a ebetumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wobenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a nea ɛka ho ne: Kaa a ɛnyɛ pii, titiriw wɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a wonnya mmoa pii. Kaa ho ka, a amansan kaa ho ka anaa ɛka a ɛbata rideshare nnwumadie ho ka ho. Kaa a ɛnni wɔ berɛ a worenyɛ adwuman anaa berɛ a wɛnfa nyɛ adwuma anaa sɛ nnawɔtwe awieeɛ bere a ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow abue no. Afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn kaa so, te sɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, a ebia wɔwɔ nneɛma bi yɛ a ehia paa yie a ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ anaa sɛ wonni berɛ koraa esane wɔ nnwuma a ɛdɔɔso nti. Nipadua mu sebi dɛmdi anaa akwahosan tebea horow a ɛntumi ma ɔno nkoaa ntu kwan anaasɛ ɔrentumi mfa akwan foforɔ bi so ɛnkɔ. Akwan bɔne nso betumi ayɛ akwanside, efisɛ kaa kakraa bi na ɛbɛfa saa kwan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn atosɛm ne nyiyim bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mihu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛtaa yɛ animhwɛ ne mmusuakuw mu nsusuwii hunu, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow, ne nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa tumi ahorow ho. Twa eyinom ho mpoa wɔ ade a wobesua no pii, nsɛmmisa a wobebisa, ne adwene a wobɛma abue so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan horow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so aboaboa nsɛm ano afi mmabun a wɔde ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu nhyehyɛe no adi dwuma no hɔ? Sɛ yiw a, ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔde saa nsɛm a wɔka yi di dwuma de nya nkɔso pa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwan a wɔfa so de mmuae ma no bi ne: Abotɔyam ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ bere a wɔde ɔsom adwuma no ama akyi. Nkrataa a wɔde ma mmuae anaa nyansahyɛ nnaka wɔ mmeae a wɔyɛ ɔsom adwuma. Hotlines anaa intanɛt so akwan a wɔfa so nya nsɛm a wɔmmɔ wɔn din. Akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so anaa nsɛm a wobisabisa wɔn a wɔadi kan ayɛ wɔn adwuma. Wɔde nsɛm a wɔde ma no di dwuma de kyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn, di nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, na wɔma nnwuma no yɛ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de anwiinwii akwan anaa mmra kwan so akwan adi nyiyim anaa ayayade a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de anwiinwii akwan anaa mmra kwan so akwan, te sɛ anwiinwii a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma nnipa hokwan ahorow ho bagua ahorow anaasɛ mmra kwan so ananmusifo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ hɔ, adi dwuma de adi nyiyim anaa ayayade a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho dwuma. Saa akwan yi boa ma wobu wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no akontaa na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wosiesie mmara so bu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na awofo betumi afa so de akwankyerɛ, nsɛm, ne afotu a mfaso wɔ so ama de aboa mmabun ma wɔafa atipɛnfo nhyɛso so, asi wɔn ahye so, na wɔapaw ayɔnkofa, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a awofo betumi afa so de akwankyerɛ, nsɛm, ne afotu a mfaso wɔ so ama de aboa mmabun ma wɔafa atipɛnfo "peer pressure" nhyɛso so na wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ abusuabɔ, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no bi ne: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne awo nipadua ho a wɔde bɛma. Sɛnea ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so, nkitahodi, ne obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ abusuabɔ mu ho nkɔmmɔbɔ. Nneɛma ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu na wɔaka sɛnea etu mpɔn, mfaso horow, ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba ho asɛm. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ ahokokwaw a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka sie, ahye a wɔde si hɔ, ne gyinaesi akwan ho de boa mmabun ma wɔfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso so na wɔpaw nneɛma a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn botae ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn amammerɛ anaa ɔsom mu nsusuwii ahorow na ebɛtumi aka nna ne awoɔ ho hwɛ ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi eyinom ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkate ne Ade Titiriw: Amammerɛ ne  ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya ɔhwɛ a wobenya so nsunsunaso kɛse. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wo ne ɔpanyin anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wogye no di a ɔte wo tebea ase no ho hia. Fa w’adwene si akwannya ahorow so: Obiara wɔ hokwan sɛ onya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a dɛmdi mfa ho. Hwehwɛ akwan a wobɛfa so akyerɛ obu ama w’amammerɛ ne wo nyamesom bere a wode w’akwahosan ahiade di kan no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na afotubɔfoɔ, mpanyimfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, anaa nhwɛsofoɔ betumi adi de aboa me ma madi ntawntawdi a ɛda atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛso ne m’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ntam no so?
answer_twi_source: Afotubɔfoɔ, mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, anaa nhwɛsofoɔ betumi adi dwuma titiri wɔ boa a wɔbɛboa wo ma woadi ntawntawdi a ɛda atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛso ne w’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ntam no so. Wɔde akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne adwene soronko ma wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den ho. Hwehwɛ mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di na wobu wɔn, na wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wo ne wɔn bɛbɔ wo ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobetumi de afotuo ama, agye wo atenka atom, na wɔaboa wo ma woanya akwan horow a wobɛfa so asi wo gyinapɛn ahorow so dua wɔ atipɛnfo nkitahodi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nna ne abusuabɔ ho mfoni ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho, obu wom, na wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nna ne abusuabɔ ho mfoni ahorow a ɛka obiara ho, obu ma, na ɛnyɛ nea wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, denam nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛda no adi denam nsɛm a wɔka so, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow hyia a wɔbɛboa, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadi mu de akasa atia mfonini ahorow a epira. Wobetumi nso ayɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm a ɛhyɛ adwene ahorow ho nkuran na wɔakyekyɛ, ɛkamfo pene ne obu kyerɛ, na ɛko tia nna ho nsusuwii hunu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adɔ mu sukɔ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'critically analyze' nna apɔmden mu nsɛm a wɔka no wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan fidie nyinaa so?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ kasa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ntentanfidie so wɔ berɛ a wɔrekasa afa nna mu apɔmden ho. Hwehwɛ baabi a asɛm no firi na pɛ mu ahotosoɔ. Bisa dɛn nti na wɔreka saa asɛm no na hunu obiaa adwenkyerɛ ne suahunu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi akari pɛ wɔ amansan nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne obu a wɔde ma amammerɛ mu ahofadi ne wɔn ankasa gyinaesi wɔ mpɔtam pɔtee bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhyehyeɛ no bɛtumi akari pɛ wɔ amansan nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ obuo a wɔde ma amammerɛ mu ahofadie ne wɔn ankasa gyinaesie wɔ mpɔtam pɔtee bi mu denam: Ɔkwan a egyina hokwan so: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm a wɔgye tom wɔ amanaman ntam, te sɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya akwahosan, ahofadie, ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ. Amammerɛ mu ahobrɛase: Amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe a wɔde ahobrɛase, abue, ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wobesua ade afi adwene ahorow mu abɛn. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu a ɛfata amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obuo ama mpɔtam hɔ amanne, gyidie, ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ berɛ a wɔdi nnipa hokwan gyinapɛn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho wɔ Intanɛt so nkitahodi mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wɔabɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so ho amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne nna mu ɔbrasɛeɛ ho wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ mu, te sɛ: Intanɛt so ayayadeɛ ho Mmara: Aman pii wɔ mmara a ɛbara kɔmputa so ayayadeɛ ne intanɛt so ayayadeɛ, a ɛbɛtumi aka nneyɛeɛ a ɛnyɛ pene ne ahyeɛ a wɔbu so ho. Nna mu Ɔhaw Ho Mmara: Mmara a ɛko tia nna mu ɔbrasɛe betumi afa Intanɛt so nkitahodi ho, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu nkɔso a wɔmpɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee ho. Amanneɛbɔ Akwan: Mpɛn pii no, platform ahorow no wɔ amanneɛbɔ akwan a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no de bɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade anaa wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so ho amanneɛ, a ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛfa platform nhyehyɛe anaa mmara mu mmara ahorow a wobu so ho. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wɔabɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ intanɛt so ho amanneɛ denam: Mmoa a Wɔde Di Dwuma wɔ Asɛnka agua so: Amanneɛbɔ ho nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ intanɛt so de abɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade anaa ayayade ho amanneɛ. Mmara mu Afotu a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Wo ne mmara ho adwumayɛfo anaa nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ Intanɛt so ayayade anaa nna mu basabasayɛ mu besusuw ho de anya akwankyerɛ wɔ mmara kwan so akwan horow ne mmoa ho. Amanneɛbɔ a Wɔde Ma Atumfoɔ: Sɛ ɛho hia a, nsɛm a anibere wom a ɛfa ayayade anaa nnipa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so ho a wɔbɛbɔ ho amanneɛ akyerɛ mmarahyɛ baguafo, titiriw sɛ ɛfa nsɛmmɔnedifo nneyɛe ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ahotoso 'confidence' ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo ho nimdeɛ de asi wɔn ahye so yiye, wɔ tebea ahorow a emu yɛ den anaa nhyɛso kɛse mpo mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya ahotoso ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo ho nimdeɛ de asi wɔn ahye so yiye denam adeyɛ, wɔn ho a wobehu, ne nhomasua so. Nea ɛka ahotoso a wobenya ho ne sɛ wobehu wɔn ankasa bo a ɛsom, wɔn adwene, ne wɔn atinka na wɔabu no sɛ ɛsom bo. Wobetumi de nkitahodi ho akwan a ɛyɛ katee 'assertive' adi dwuma, te sɛ wɔn ho a wɔbɛkasa brɛoo na wɔaka tẽẽ, nipadua mu kasa a wɔka no denneennen a wɔde bedi dwuma, ne ahye a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ a wɔmpa kyɛw anaasɛ wɔntwentwɛn wɔn nan ase. Nsɛm a wɔde di agoru ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ fi nnamfo, abusua mufo, anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahotoso wɔ wɔn ahye a wɔbɛsi so dua mu, wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den anaa nhyɛso kɛse mpo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so fa nna mu agorɔ ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu wɔ me mmabunyɛɔ berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm ahorow no bi ne: "Worentumi nyinsɛn bere a edi kan," "Ɔbea ntumi nnyinsɛn sɛ ɔne ɔbarima da wɔ ne brayɛ mu a" "Mmabaa nkutoo na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhaw wɔn ho wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho," "STI ahorow da adi." Ɛho hia sɛ wunya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ den na yɛtumi anam abasem ne abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so ama obiaa ate mmabun nne ne abrabɔ mu sua hunu a ɛfa wiem nsakraeɛ ho na atumi aboa nkomodidie mu, nhunu mu ne yɛn anamɔmtuo wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman mu ne wiase afanaa nyinaa ho?
answer_twi_source: Abasɛm ho dɛwuro bɔ: kyɛ wo suahunu wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan fidie nyinaa so ma nkurɔfoɔ nte aseɛ ɔhao wiem nsakraeɛ deba mmabun abrabɔ mu. Abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so nkutahodie: Wo ne nsɛm-twerɛfoɔ nni adwuma mfa mmabun suahunu wo wiem nsakraeɛ ho na atumi aboa nkomodidie ne nsɛm a wɔka de tae nkrɔfoɔ akyi mu. Abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so nsɛm a wɔka de tea nkrofoɔ akyi: Fa abɛɛfo ntentan fidie amanneɛbɔ so hwehwɛ mmoa ne nhunu mu so pɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ mmara a ɛkasa fa wiem nsakaraeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔde di dwuma ne nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho paw a wonya fi nimdeɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi nhyehyeɛ yɛ nhyehyeɛ a wɔahyehyɛ a ɛkyerɛ ankorankoro kwan wɔ akwan a wɔfa so paw nneɛma mu. Wɔho hia kɛse ma atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔde di dwuma na wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho efisɛ ɛma wonya ɔkwan a wɔahyehyɛ a wɔfa so susuw nneɛma a wobetumi apaw ho, asusuw nea ebefi mu aba ho, na awiei koraa no, ɔpaw nneɛma a ɛne obi gyinapɛn ne ne botae ahorow hyia. Saa nhwɛso ahorow yi boa mmabun ma wɔkwati nneyɛe a wɔyɛ no ntɛmntɛm anaasɛ asiane wom denam nea ɛhyɛ nkuran ma wosusuw nneɛma a ebetumi afi wɔn nneyɛe mu aba no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn atenka ne adwene mu nsusuansoɔ na wonya sɛ ɔbabun a woadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: ɔbabun a wodi dɛm no, wobetumi anya atenka ne adwene mu nsunsuanso ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: 1. Wo ho a wobu no a ɛba fam na wosom bo 2. Tete a wote nka sɛ wobɛtew wo ho na woayɛ ankonam 3. Adwenemhaw ne dadwen 4. Abasamtu ne abufuw 5. Aniwu ne aniwu 6. Suro a wusuro sɛ wɔbɛpow wo na wɔagyaw wo 7. Nipadua mfonini ne wo ho a wogye tom 8. Atenka a wote nka sɛ wontumi nyɛ hwee na wonni tumi 9. Animtiaabu ne asetra mu animtiaabu 10. Ahodwiriw ne adwenemhaw akyi adwenemhaw (PTSD) Bio nso, wubetumi anya osua hu nso:- nyiyim a woanka wɔ ma wo ho (abam buo kasa ne wo ho adwenem naayɛ) - Suro a wosuro sɛ wobɛyɛ adesoa ama afoforo - Ɛyɛ den wɔ asetra mu abusuabɔ ne nnamfofa mu - Te nka sɛ obi a ofi abɔnten anaasɛ not belonging - Worebrɛ wɔ fahodie ho - Te nka sɛ wote wiase a wɔannwene amma wo mu Ɛho hia sɛ wokae sɛ saa atenka yi yɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ wo nko ara. Sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa fi adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, akuw a wɔboa, ne w’adɔfo hɔ a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woafa saa atenka horow yi so na woanya akwan horow a wobɛfa so agyina ano na ama woadi yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, nkɛntɛnsofo, ne nsɛm a wɔyɛ no betumi adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛe a asɛde wom, abrabɔ pa ho nsɛmka, ne asetra mu nsakrae pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔbɔ, wɔn a wɔnya nkɛntɛnsoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no bɛtumi adi dwuma titire wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa asɛdeɛ ho, abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm a wɔka, ne asetena mu nsakraeɛ pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, titire wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho denam: Nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ na wɔakyɛ a ɛda osuahu ahodoɔ adi, ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a ɛyɛ hu, na ɛhyɛ tema, nteaseɛ, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran. Wɔn a wɔne abenfoɔ, wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛyɛ nkateɛ, na ɛka ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ gyinabea a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne atiefo bɛbɔ, hwehwɛ mmuae, na wosusuw nsusuaso a emu nsɛm nya wɔ atiefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no adwene, wɔn suban, ne wɔn nneyɛe so ho. Wɔn nkɛntɛnso ne wɔn nhyiam ase a wɔde bedi dwuma de akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, nnwuma mu nsakrae, ne nnwumakuw asɛyɛde ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun yiyedi ne hokwan ahorow di kan wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma, ne kyekyɛ, ne mmarahyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔhaw anaa tebea horow bɛn na ɛtaa ma ɛfata sɛ wohia dabere ne adan ho nnwuma, te sɛ afie a wonni, asetra mu tebea horow a ahobammɔ nnim, anaasɛ guan a woguan fi tebea horow a ɛyɛ ayayade ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ dabere ne adan ho nnwuma wɔ ɔhaw tebea ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ofie a wonni: Dabere anaa asetra ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ den a wonni esiane abusua mu ntawntawdi, tu a wotu fi wɔn afie mu, anaa sikasɛm mu ahokyere nti. Asetra mu tebea horow a ahobammɔ nnim: Ayayade, anibiannaso, basabasayɛ, anaa nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma wɔ fie a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Guan a wobeguan afi ayayade tebea horow mu: Ofie basabasayɛ, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, aguadi, anaa akwan foforo a wɔfa so de wɔn di dwuma a wobeguan na wɔahwehwɛ ahobammɔ ne ahobammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Atesɛm: "Sɛ wɔanka sɛ daabi; a, ɛnyɛ hwee." "Wɔbɛtumi akyerɛ pene a wɔpene so denam ntadeɛ hyɛm anaa nneyɛeɛ so." "Ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so ma nna a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu nkutoo." Nteɛso: Mpene a wɔpene so yɛ "anaa" a ɛyɛ anigye, a ɛkɔ so. Kommyɛ anaa ɔsɔretia a wɔnyɛ no nkyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so. Ɔpenee firi ɔpɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmbeun ne mpɔtam hɔfo betumi ayɛ biako de ayɛ nna ne awo akwaa  ahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata amammerɛ na ɛka obiara ho a ɛda mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan adi?
answer_twi_source: Mmebun ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nna ne awoɔ akwaa ahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata amammerɛ na ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ahiadeɛ ne wɔn a wɔde di kan. Saa adwumayɛkuo yi bɛtumi ayɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ahiadeɛ nhwehwɛmu de ahunu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ nnwuma ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma mu, wɔne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ahodoɔ bɛsusu ho de aboaboa wɔn adwene ne nsɛm a wɔbɛka ano, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛbom ayɛ a ɛne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ amammerɛ tebea ne wɔn apɛdeɛ hyia. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ne dwumadie mu denneennen no bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no fata, ɛde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, na ɛtu mpɔn. Ɛdenam fekubɔ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔsom mmabun, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu ahorow, akuw a egyina gyidi so, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ntam so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi de nimdeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔaboaboa ano adi dwuma de ayɛ akwan a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a edi mũ a ɛfa mmabun nyinaa ahiade ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bɛn na ɛfa awofoɔ mpeneso fa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho dwumadie wɔ yɛn man anaa mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ahorow a ɛfa awofo mpene so sɛ wobenya nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho no gu ahorow kɛse a egyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Wɔ mmeae bi no, ebia ɛho behia sɛ awofoɔ pene so wɔ nnwuma bi ho, bere a wɔ mmeae afoforo no, mmabun betumi anya hokwan sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn wɔ kokoam a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu. Ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu na wote mmara ne nhyehyɛe pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo man anaa wo mantam mu a ɛfa awofoɔ mpeneso ma nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ho no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de akasa ama awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu, a nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ka ho, wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu, a nyinsɛn a wotu gu ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ka ho, wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ wɔ nkurɔfo a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu, wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa a wɔhyɛ awo hokwan ahorow ne ɔhwɛ a wobenya ho nkuran no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow ne nnɛyi akwaa ahosan ho gyinapɛn ahorow ahyia no ho, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a saa nneyɛe yi betumi de asiane aba mmebun akwaa ahosan ne yiyedi so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow a ɛne nnɛyi akwaa ahosan ho gyinapɛn ahorow hyia no ma mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a emu yɛ den sɔre, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a saa nneyɛe yi betumi de asiane aba mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi so no mu. Bere a atetesɛm mu nneyɛe pii agye ntini kɛse wɔ amammerɛ agyapade ne nipasu mu no, ebinom betumi ne nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa aduruyɛ mu abrabɔ pa, hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ, ne mmofra ahobammɔ ho bɔ abira. Wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo kari pɛ wɔ obu a wɔde ma wɔ amammerɛ mu ahofadi ne hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ wɔ akwahosan, ahobammɔ, ne nipadua mu nokwaredi ho a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban no ntam. Ebia ɛho behia sɛ wɔyɛ mmara nhyehyɛe ne akwankyerɛ ahorow de hwɛ nneyɛe a ɛde asane kɛse ba mmebun akwaa ahosan so, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma, aduruyɛ mu kokoamsɛm, ne ɔhwɛ a egyina adanse so so. Abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen betumi aba bere a wobu atetesɛm mu nneyɛe sɛ ɛyɛ nea epira anaasɛ ɛyɛ nyiyim, a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wosusuw amammerɛ mu atenka, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so tew ɔhaw so no ho yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun yɛ STI nhwehwɛmu daadaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun yɛ STI nhwehwɛmu daa esiane nneɛma pii nti. Nea edi kan koraa no, STI pii betumi ayɛ nea enni sɛnkyerɛnne biara, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia ɛremma sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛda adi, titiriw wɔ ɔyare no mfiase. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ma ankorankoro hu STIs ntɛm, ansa na sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no ada adi mpo, na ɛno ho hia kɛse ma ayaresa a ɛba bere ano na wɔasiw nsɛnnennen bi ano. Bio nso, ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobetumi de nna mu nneyɛe a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a efi ɔbea no awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo, ne anom, ne honam ani honam ani honam ani hwɛbea ka ho. Ɛdenam wɔn STI tebea a mmabun nim so no, wobetumi ayɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no ntɛm de abɔ wɔn ho ne wɔn ahokafo ho ban, te sɛ nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛda ne ayaresa a ɛfata a wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan ho nnwinnade ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛbɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de hokwan ahorow yi adi dwuma na wɔakura mu wɔ ɔman ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan ho nnwinnade ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban no bi ne: Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam (CRC). Amanaman Ntam Nhyiam a Ɛfa Nnipa Dodow ne Nkɔso Ho (ICPD) Dwumadi Nhyehyɛe. Apam a ɛfa nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmea nyinaa a wobeyi afi hɔ ho (CEDAW). Wobetumi de saa hokwan ahorow yi adi dwuma na wɔakura mu wɔ ɔman ne mpɔtam hɔ denam mmara kwan so akwan, nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ nkurɔfo ho ban a ɛbɛma wɔadi amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan gyinapɛn ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde kuo ahorow wɔ a ɛbɛboa mmerante ne mmabaa ma wɔate ahobammɔ ne ahotɔ nka bere a wɔrenya wɔn nnwuma anaa wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn dwumadi ahorow mu no? (Ntetee a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtamu hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow de tebea a ahobammɔ ne ahotɔ wom di kan. Akwan bi a wɔfa so yɛ yei ni: Mpene so Ntetee: Wɔtete adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ pene a wɔpene so de hwɛ sɛ nkitahodiɛ nyinaa yɛ obuo. Mmeae a Ahobammɔ: Wɔyɛ mmeae a wɔakyerɛ sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn na wɔboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho no nya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ mmarimayɛ, ɔbeayɛ, ne abusuabɔ ho so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa da atetesɛm mu mmarimayɛ adi sɛ ɛyɛ nea edi tumi, ɛyɛ basabasa, na ɛtwe ne ho fi atenka fam, na eyi betumi ahyɛ mmarimaa ne mmarima ma wɔayɛ wɔn ade wɔ saa nsusuwii ahorow yi ho. Mmea: Wɔtaa ka mmea ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛ wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase, wɔnyɛ hwee, na wɔde wɔn adwene si wɔn honam ani hwɛbea so, na ɛno betumi ahyɛ nsusuwii hunu a epira mu den. Abusuabɔ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ abusuabɔ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ho mfonini no betumi ama wɔanya akwanhwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware, na ɛde abotɔyam a wonni wɔ asetena mu abusuabɔ ankasa mu aba. Saa gyinabea ahorow yi betumi anya sɛnea ankorankoro bu wɔn ho ne afoforo so nkɛntɛnso, na asiesie wɔn adwene wɔ mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne abusuabɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So tebea bi wɔ hɔ a wɔma ho kwan ma amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ no nnyɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Bere a amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ mmara taa hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ wɔ doka anaa animjahyɛ a wɔsusu ho, tebea bi betumi ama kwan anaa ahyeɛ a wɔde bɛto so. Saa tebea yi betumi ayɛ bere a amanneɛbɔ bɛde onipa a ɔafa mu no banbɔ ato asiane mu anaa abɔ mmara mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so no abira. Nanso, tebea pɔtee biara bɛgyina mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ tumidi a ɛfata no mu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So abrabɔ pa anaa abrabɔ pa ho asɛyɛde bi wɔ hɔ sɛ wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma wɔ tebea horow bi mu? (sɛ nhwɛso no, nna a wɔde di dwuma kwa, nna mu yareɛ ahorow a wɔde bɛkɔ nnipa mu a wosiw ano) .
answer_twi_source: Mmuae biako biara nni hɔ, efisɛ egyina wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi so. Adwene ahorow bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ahobammɔ ne Asɛyɛde: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ma wotumi yɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ɛfata na ɛboa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ne nna mu yareɛ ahorow ano. Wo Hokafo a Wobɛma Wo Bu: Sɛ wo ne wo hokafo susuw nyinsɛn ano aduru ho na wopene ɔkwan bi so a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ wubu wɔn yiedi nso. Ankorankoro Paw: Awiei koraa no, gyinae a wubesi sɛ wode nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma no yɛ w’ankasa de a egyina w’awerɛkyekye dodow ne tebea horow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Intanɛt so mmoa a wode ma mpotam bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ SRH haw mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane, intanɛt beae beae wɔhɔ a wɔma mpɔtam ne nwomasua mmoa ma mmabun a wɔfa nna mu ne awoɔ apɔmmuden haw mu. Ebi ne abɛɛfo ntetan, atorɔfo ahoma, ne intanɛt kuo ɛboa yedi agya ma nsem ma mu. Ekuo bi tesɛ bantan yɛ nhyehyeɛ, 'scarleteen, na 'Trevor' dwumadi ma mmabun mmoa ne nneɛma a ɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi atenka horow a ɛfa ankonamyɛ  ho anaa ankonamyɛ a ɛfa me bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Nya Ahoɔden a Wobɛtumi Agyina Ano: Nya ahokokwaw a ɛbɛma woatumi agyina ano, te sɛ adwene a wɔde si biribi so, sɛnea wobɛka wo ho denneennen, ne ɔhaw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma, na ama woadi adwennwen ho dwuma na woadi tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a woredi nyiyim anaa ayayade ho dwuma no. Hu Wo Hokwan: Sua mmara noyie fa hokwan ne ahobammɔ sɛ LGBTQ+ ankorankoro na sɛ wuhyia nyiyim anaa ɔhaw a, kamfo wo ho. Fa w’adwene si nneɛma pa so: Fa nneɛma pa na si so dua na ma w'ani ngye wo tebea ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nnwumakuw a wɔsom mmabun betumi de nneɛma, ntetee, ne mmoa ama de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya wɔn abɛɛfo nneɛma a wɔbɔ ho nimdeɛ na wɔde adi dwuma ama asetra mu nkɛntɛnso pa?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua ho a ɛtwe adwene si abɛɛfo abasɛm ne nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu a wɔyɛ so ama. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nnwumakuo a wɔsom mmabun bɛtumi ayɛ nhyiamu, ama wɔanya nnwinnadeɛ ne adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛsoftware, na wɔde afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ ama mmabun a wɔn ani gye abɛɛfo nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho. Abɛɛfo ntentan mmaeɛ ne nimdeɛ nkyekyɛmu mmeaeɛ (resource hubs) betumi ama nteteeɛ ne akwankyerɛ de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nimdeɛ na wɔahunu ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so asusuw abrabɔ pa ne nokwaredie (ethical considerations) ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de adi nsɛm a ɛfa nipadua ne adwene mu nsakrae ho dwuma yiye bere a wɔrenyin no, Ɛbi te sɛ, nnkyeɛ na wa tinka ɛsesa, ne neɛma ɛma homam mu nkwammoa kɔ soro?
answer_twi_source: Akwan Pa a Wɔfa so di Nsɛm Ho Dwuma (dwumadie/adwene). Di Dwuma Da Biara Da (da/aduan). Hwehwɛ Mmoa (ka kyerɛ nnamfo/abusuafoɔ). Kyerɛ Adwene (kyerɛw nkrataa). adwene si so nneyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfo betumi atu de atew animtiaabu a ɛwɔ 'STI ne HIV' ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi atu anammɔn ahodoɔ bi de atew animtiaabuo a ɛwɔ 'STI ne HIV' ho so, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Wɔbɛma nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, tema, ne adwene a ɛntene wɔ STI ne HIV ho. - a wobeye mmeae a ahobanbo ne nnipa nyinaa ka ho a ankorankoro a 'STI anaa HIV' aka won no te nka sɛ wɔboa wɔn na wobu wɔn. - a wobɛhyɛ ɔsatuo ne nnwuma a ɛkasa tia animtiaabuo, yi anansesɛm firi hɔ, na ɛma nkurɔfoɔ te nokwasɛm a ɛwɔ 'STI' anaa 'HIV' a wɔte mu no ho nkuran. - a wobeboa mmɔden a wɔbɔ de di nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ho dwuma, te sɛ nyiyim wɔ akwahosan anaa adwumayɛ mu, a ɛboa ma wɔyɛ animtiaabu. - a wobɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee ne nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, pene, ne animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so wɔ mmusua, sukuu, adwumayɛbea, ne mpɔtam hɔ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wanafa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow so wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a emu da Ho nkuran: Awofo betumi ama tebea bi a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ bere a wɔresusuw atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho no ho nkuran. Nsɛm a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Sɛ wosua sɛnea wɔyɛ wɔn ade wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow ho a, ebetumi ama mmabun anya tumi. Kyerɛkyerɛ Assertiveness: Boa mmabun ma wɔnte ase sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔka sɛ "dabi" na wɔde ahye sisi hɔ. Munsusuw Asetra mu Nhwɛso Ahorow Ankasa Ho: Nsɛm anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho a wobɛka no betumi akanyan nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya sukuu mu ɔhaw mmoa ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nhyehyɛe no mu sɛ merehyia nna anaa awo apɔwmuden ho haw a?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi anya ɔhaw mmoa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so no denam sukuu adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ afotufo, ayarehwɛfo, anaa adwumayɛfo a wɔapaw wɔn sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mmoa mu no nkyɛn. Wobetumi de mmoa ama ntɛm ara anaasɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛfata abɔ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔako atia nipadua mfonini ho nkrasɛm a enye na wɔne wɔn nipadua anya abusuabɔ pa na wogye tom kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔako atia nipadua mfonini nkrasɛm a enye na wɔanya abusuabɔ pa na wogye tom kɛse wɔ wɔn nipadua ntam denam: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a ɛfa nipadua mfonini ho mu na wɔasɔ ahwɛ, nhumu a wobenya wɔ gyinabea ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware ne nea ɛyɛ nea ɛfata ntam. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔsɛe no ne nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuranhyɛ de kasa tia nsusuwii hunu a epira na wɔhyɛ nipadua ahorow ne gye a wogye tom ho nkuran. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔde adwene adi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, agye ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ ho adwene, na wɔde ayamhyehye ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ adi kan sen gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyekye abusuabɔ pa na me ne afoforo anya ahye wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Di Nkitahodi: Wo ne afoforo nka wo nkate ne wo hye ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na fi nokwaredi mu. Obu: Bu afoforo ahye na tie wɔn nkate. Gye Wo Ho Di: Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛyɛ biribiara a ɛnyɛ wo dɛ. Sua: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ abusuabɔ pa ne pene a wɔpene so ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛreba ne daakye akwankyerɛ wɔ mfiridwuma ne nnoɔma foforɔ mu ama mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH), na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no atumi akɔ so anya nsɛm na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn a ɛrenya nkɔsoɔ ntɛmntɛm no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛreba ne daakye akwankyerɛ a ɛfa mfiridwuma ne nnoɔma foforɔ a wɔbɛyɛ ama ASRH no bi ne: Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma (AI) ne mfiri adesua a wɔde bɛka abom: Abɛɛfo ntentan n njyiaaa Chatbots a AI na ɛyɛ adwuma, virtual aboafoɔ, ne mmuae nhwehwɛmu ma ASRH dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma so no yɛ ankorankoro ne mmuaeɛ a ɛyɛ den. Telemedicine ne telehealth dwumadie a wɔbɛtrɛ mu: Telefonconconsultations, akyirikyiri afotuo, ne digyital akwahosan platforms trɛw ASRH dwumadie no mu kɔ nnipa a wɔnnya mmoa yie so na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya kokoam ɔhwɛ a wɔmfa animtiaabuo biara nni mu. Data kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ a wosi so dua: Sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ data ho banbɔ ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den ne abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow a wobedi so wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano, wɔkora so, na wɔde mena mu no ho hia kɛse na ama wɔakura ahotoso ne kokoamsɛm mu. mHealth nnoɔma foforɔ a wɔbɛgye atom: Akwahosan ho mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so, te sɛ akwahosan ho nkrasɛm a egyina SMS so, mobile apps a wɔde di nyinsɛn ano aduru akyi, ne digyital da biara da nsɛm a wɔde kyerɛw brayɛ akwahosan kɔ so dɔɔso sɛ nnwinnadeɛ a wɔtumi nya na ɛho ka sua a wɔde hyɛ ASRH nkɔsoɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma ne adebɔ a wɔbom yɛ a wɔbɛgye atom: Nhyiamu a ɛma mmabun tumi yɛ na wɔkyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm, nsɛm, ne suahunu ma wɔn tumi sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ nnam wɔ wɔn SRH akwantuo mu na ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wuranom ne wɔn dea wɔ digyital mmeaeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn na wopɛ sɛ yɛfa so kɔ hɔ daa yɛ nhwenhwɛm, te sɛ wo nie ne me nie nkɔmmɔbɔ, telefon so frɛ, anaa text message?
answer_twi_source: Meyɛ nsakrae wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so kɔ yɛn daa nhwehwɛ mu, nea broni ka no 'check-ins' no ho na mɛyɛ afa nea wopɛ. Wo nie ne me nie nkɔmmɔbɔ ma wonya hokwan nya nkitahodi ne ntease a emu dɔ, nanso telefon so frɛ anaa text message nso betumi atu mpɔn ama nsɛm foforo a wɔyɛ no ntɛmntɛm anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a egye ntɛmpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ STI anaa HIV a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ? Ɔkwan bɛn so na Partner Notification Services betumi aboa me ma mabɔ me hokafo amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wowɔ STI anaa HIV a, ɛho bɛhia sɛ: Hwehwɛ ayaresa na wodi w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ nyansahyɛ a ɛfa ayaresa ne dwumadie ho akyi. Bɔ wo hokafo a wo ne wɔn da anaa wɔde nnade kyɛ no amanneɛ wɔ ɔyare mmoawa no a wobetumi anya ho. Partner Notification Services betumi aboa wo ma woabɔ wo ahokafo amanneɛ wɔ kokoam na wɔmmɔ wo din. Wɔbɛtumi de mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛbɔ ahokafoɔ amanneɛ, a mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ nkɔmmɔdie, nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa wɔn yareɛ ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo, m’abusuafo, ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo akasa afa me nna ho akɔnnɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo nna ho akɔnnɔ a wo ne wo nnamfo, abusuafo, ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ no betumi ayɛ den, nanso nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho hia na ama woanya ahotoso, mmoa, ne ntease. Afotuo bi a ɛbɛboa wo ama woabɔ nkɔmmɔ yi nie: Nnamfo ne Abusua: 1. Paw bere ne beae a ɛfata: Susuw bere ne tebea a wobɛfa so bere a wode w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm yi rekyɛ no ho. 2. Nya ahotoso na fa ahantan: Gye wo nipasu tom na da wo nsusuwii adi nokwarem. 3. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: Fa "Me" nsɛm ka wo nkate ne wo nsusuwii, kwati nsusuwii anaa akwanhwɛ. 4. Siesie wo ho ma nsɛmmisa ne sɛnea wobɛyɛ w’ade: Hwɛ anigye a wubenya, mmoa, anaa mpo mfiase no a ɛnyɛ wo dɛ. 5. Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Fa nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nsɛmmisa ka w’awerɛkyekye dodow no ho asɛm pefee. apomoden ho adwumayɛfo: 1. Di nokware na bue w’ani: Ka wo nna ho akɔnnɔ ho asɛm na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wobɛhwɛ wo na woanya ntease a ɛfata. 2. Fa nsɛmfua a wopɛ di dwuma: Fa nkyerɛwde ne kasa a wopɛ di nkitaho. 4. Ka apomoden ho haw ne nhwehwɛmu ho asɛm: Ka apomoden ho haw anaa nsɛmmisa pɔtee biara ho asɛm. 5. Hwɛ sɛ wode kokoamusɛm sie: Si wo kokoam nsɛm ne wo kokoamu nsɛm so dua. Kae sɛ wo nna ho akɔnnɔ yɛ ade titiriw a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea woyɛ obi. Di wo ho nokware, na ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ ɛho hia a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkɔ so wɔ afotu anaa ayaresa bere mu, na dɛn na metumi ahwɛ anim?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ afotu anaa ayaresa bere mu no, wo ne wo fotufo anaa ɔyaresafo behyia wɔ kokoam ne kokoam tebea mu. Wɔbɛtie wo a wɔremmu atɛn, wɔbɛbisa nsɛm de ate wo haw ase yie, na wɔaboa wo ma woahwehwɛ wo nsusuiɛ ne wo atenka mu. Mobɛbom ayɛ adwuma de botae ahorow asisi hɔ ama ayaresa ne akwan horow a mobɛfa so adi mo nsɛnnennen ho dwuma. Nhyiam ahorow no betumi ayɛ ɔkasa, dwumadi ahorow, ahokokwaw foforo a wɔde sua, anaasɛ adebɔ ho akwan te sɛ adwinni anaa nsɛmma nhoma a wɔde bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama  nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano  ntɛm ntɛm wɔ wɔn mpɔtam mu atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama nyinsɛn ano a wosiw  nnuru  a wobenya no atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Nhumu a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn: Atipɛnfo, awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hia a nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ ho hia sɛ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ano. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm a wobenya no akɔ soro, te sɛ wɔbɛma kwan ma wɔanya nnuru a wɔtɔn a wɔmfa nnuru nhyɛ mu a wɔmfa mfe a obi adi anaasɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nea wobetumi anya mu denam akwahosan ho nnwuma a egyina sukuu so ne mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow so. Mmoa a wɔboaboa ano: Ɔsatu a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo, adesrɛ ahorow, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhyehyɛe anaa wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔanya mmoa a ɛbɛma wɔanya nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm no atu mpɔn. Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Yɛne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahunu akwansideɛ a ɛmma wontumi nnya na wɔyɛ ano aduru a ɛdi mmabun ahiadeɛ ho dwuma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahwɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den anaa adwene a enhyia a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusuafo, anaa tumidifo bɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho nsɛmti ho, bere a wɔde wɔn adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" nso di kan?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho nsɛmti ho denam nkitahodi a ɛyɛ katee "assertive communications" a wɔde bedi dwuma, ahye a wɔde besi hɔ, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa nneɛma a wogye wɔn di hɔ no so. Ɛho hia sɛ wode adwenemyare di kan denam bere a nkɔmmɔbɔ bi bɛyɛ den anaasɛ ɛkanyan adwene a wubehu na sɛ ɛho hia a wubegye w’ahome anaasɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi ho no so. Sɛ wode nsiyɛ tie, tema, ne nkitahodi a obu wom nso betumi aboa ma wɔadi adwene a enhyia a wɔne w’atipɛnfo, abusua mufo, anaa tumidifo ntam no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na metumi ayɛ de me ho ahyɛ nkɔmodidie nwuma a wɔka si so dua na aboa ama m'anya akokoduro na m'atumi de aso atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ ano?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yɛreyɛ yɛn afam deɛ: woreka daabi, woreto ahyeɛ a wɔde si so dua, ka wo ahiasɛm. Akwan ahodoɔ a wɔbɛfa so de adi dwuma: ka si so pi sɛ me, ma wo nipadua nkasa ɛma wo, na yɛ aso tie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ka adwennwen ne adwene mu apɔwmuden nyinaa, na afotuo bɛn na ɛbɛma nna mu ahotew atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nna di dwuma titiriw wɔ adwennwen ano aduru ne adwene mu apɔwmuden nyinaa mu. Da a ɛnkɔ yie betumi ama adwennwen ayɛ kɛse na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen ne adwenemhaw no ayɛ kɛse. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na mmabun ahotew atu mpɔn wɔ nna mu no, wobetumi ayɛ nna ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so daa, ayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛma ahomegye ansa na wɔada, ahyɛ berɛ a wɔde hwɛ screen ansa na wɔada no ano hyeɛ, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ baabi a wɔda no yɛ nea ahotɔ wom na ɛfata ma ahomegye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ botae ahorow a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ pɔtee 'specific" a yɛde besisi yɛn ani so bere a yehyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe 'sexual behaviours", abusuabɔ, ne awo ho paw ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛwɔ botae ahorow a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ pɔtee a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so bere a wohyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe, twaka "relationship", ne awo ho nneɛma a wɔpaw ho no bi ne: Sɛ wɔma emu da hɔ "Providing Clarity": Botae a emu da hɔ boa mmabun ma wɔte nea wɔpɛ sɛ wodi ne nea enti a wɔyɛ no ase, na ɛma wotumi si gyinae ahorow a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a ɛho hia titiriw hyia. Sɛ wɔkyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano: Botae pɔtee bi a mmabun benya no ma wotumi ko tia atipɛnfo nhyɛso denam wɔn ankasa botae ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si so sen sɛ wɔbɛbrɛ wɔn ho ase ama abɔnten so nkɛntɛnso ahorow so. Gyinaesi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Botae ahorow a emu da hɔ yɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛkyerɛ kwan, na ɛboa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ akwan horow a wobetumi apaw mu na wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata a ɛboa wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobɛtumi akyerɛ me nneɛma  a  ɛbɛboa me bammɔ wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so?
answer_twi_source: abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn banbɔ nneɛma  a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Antivirus. VPN. 2FA (bammɔ mmɔho mmienu).  Nnwinnade a  awofo di so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro a wɔwɔ abusuabɔ ne mmusua mu, te sɛ aware mu pɛyɛ ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono ɔman biara. Wɔ Ghana no, LGBTQ+ yɛ mmara so; enti mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a ɛte saa nni hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun nya animtiaabu anaa nyiyim fi apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo anaa ɔmanfo hɔ esiane wɔn sɛ nyinsɛn nti a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔrehyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim no hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnipa a wogye wɔn di te sɛ abusua mufo, nnamfo, anaa afotufo hɔ. Wobetumi nso ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo anaa akuw a wɔboa ayarefo no adi nkitaho de ahwehwɛ mmoa wɔ nyiyim a wobedi ho dwuma ne apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛnyɛ atemmu ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ebetumi ama obi afikyire ankɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ/ daa?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii betumi ama obi afikyire (period) ankɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ, ebi ne:: Adwene mu haw anaa dadwen, Awoɔ ntentenee nnuru a worehyɛ aseɛ anom anaa woagyae nom,Wo mu duru a ɛsesa, Yadeɛ bi a ɛwɔ nipadua mu (sɛ wosusuw sɛ asɛm bi wɔ hɔ a, kɔhu dɔkota) .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne asɛyɛde ahorow a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, wɔn a wɔyɛ, ne asɛnka agua so wɔ wɔ nna ne awo apomoden u ho nsɛm a wɔyɛ ho mfonini, ankorankoro nidi ne kokoamu nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho ban, ne kwati a wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛka nkate anaasɛ wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so no mu?
answer_twi_source: amanneɛbɔ ho bɔfo a wɔbɔ, wɔn a wɔyɛ, ne nhyiam ase wɔ abrabɔ pa ho asɛyɛde bere a wɔreyɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ho mfonini no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, atinka, ne obu a wɔde ma ankorankoro nidi ne kokoamuu nsɛm di kan. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne pene a wobegye atom bere a wɔde ankorankoro nsɛm rekyerɛ no, kwati a wɔbɛkwati nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa anaasɛ wɔde bedi dwuma, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma de anya nsɛm foforo anaa mmoa. Ɛsɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nso da adwene ne osuahu ahorow adi, kwati nsusuwii hunu na wɔhyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ho nkuran. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhyiam ase di mpɔtam hɔ akwankyerɛ ahorow so na wɔasiw nneɛma a epira a wɔbɛtrɛw ano na wɔabɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma, titiriw mmabun, ho ban afi nneɛma a ɛmfata anaasɛ ɛhaw adwene ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mpeneso ho nimdeɛ ma, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ apɔwmuden ho, titiriw wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma ne kwan a wɔfa so de nsɛm a ɛfata ma ankorankoro, a mmabun ka ho, a ɛfa aduroyɛ kwan, ayaresa, anaa adeyɛ bi a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho. Ɛho hia wɔ apɔwmuden ho dwumadie mu ɛfiri sɛ ɛhwɛ sɛ ankorankoro te asiane, mfasoɔ, akwan foforɔ, ne nea ɛbɛtumi afiri wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesie mu aba no ase ansa na wɔde pene ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun bɛtumi afa so ahyɛ wɔn adwene mu apɔwmuden mu den bere a wɔrefi mmabun bere mu akɔ mpanyin bere mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛhia sɛ wɔn adwene ne apɔwmuden begygyina pintin (resilience), na wobedi dwuma a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatumi atena ase yie (coping skills), na bio so wɔehu sɛneɛ wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn apɔwmuden so yie (healthy habits) na ama wɔn adwene mu anya ahoɔden bere tenten.Nneyɛɛ bi te sɛ: apɔw-mu-nsakraeɛ (regular exercise), adwene a wɔde si baabi pɔtee so (mindfulness/meditation practice), abusua ne nnamfo ne nkitahodie a wɔbɛkora so, afei ehia sɛ wobnya aniso adehun a wobetumi ayɛ, na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa bere a ehia mu, ne akwan pa a wɔbɛfa so adi haw ahodoɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi adi wɔ hokwan ne ahobammɔ a mmabun adwumayɛfo wɔ no a wɔbɛkasa ma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi akasa ama hokwan ne ahobanbɔ a mmabun adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ denam: Wɔbɛma wɔate aseɛ: Mmabun a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn adwuma hokwan ahodoɔ, ahobanbɔ ho mmara, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ mmoa anaa wɔasiesie sɛ wɔabu mmara so a. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛma: Mmara kwan so nsɛm, nnwuma a wɔde kɔma mmabun, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma mmabun a wohyia adwumayɛbea nsɛm, a nyiyim, ɔhaw, anaa ayayade a ɛnteɛ ka ho. Ɔsatu a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo: Wɔboaboa ɔsatu ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa di anim, adesrɛ ahorow, anaa ɔsɔretia ahorow ano de ama ɔmanfo ate ase, anya nhyehyɛeyɛfo so nkɛntɛnso, na wɔahwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae wɔ mmara mu na ama adwumayɛ tebea ne ahobammɔ a wɔde ma adwumayɛfo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wode bɛko atia atetesɛm mu nneyɛe a epira "harmful traditional practices" te sɛ mmea awotwaa a wotwitwa, aware a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔware, ne mma a wɔwo wɔn wɔ wɔn mmofraase, bere a wobu amammerɛ mu atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so di atetesɛm mu nneyɛe a epira ho dwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho no hwehwɛ sɛ wonya mpɔtam hɔ gyidi ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne tumi mu nkɔso ho ntease nketenkete. Sɛ anka wɔbɛhyɛ abɔnten so nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ mmɔdenbɔ yɛ nea wɔbom yɛ na wɔkyerɛ obu ma mpɔtam hɔfo atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahorow. Ebia eyi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, mpanyimfo, ne nyamesom atumfoɔ bedi nkitaho sɛ ayɔnkofo de ahyɛ amanne foforo a wɔde twa kwan a ɛhyɛ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ, ahofadi "autonomy", ne yiyedi so dua no ho nkuran. Nhomasua ne nhumu nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi akasa atia gyidi ne nneyɛe a epira bere a esi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkora amammerɛ so na wɔsakra no so dua no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de wɔn ahiade, nea wɔpɛ, ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho akyerɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne stakeholders?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ nhyiam, adwumayɛbea, anaa focus groups ho nhyehyɛe de asusu wɔn haw ne wɔn ahiade ho. Wobetumi akyerɛw nkrataa, adesrɛ, anaa nsɛm ama mpɔtam hɔ atesɛm nkrataa de ama nkorɔfo ate ase. Social media platforms a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔadu nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nkyɛn. Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde hwehwɛ nkorɔfo hɔ sika mu, baguam atiefo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, anaasɛ mmabun afotu boayikuo ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Wɔn a wɔne mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi no bɛyɛ biako de ahyɛ wɔn nkrasɛm ne nkɛntɛnso mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu ahwehwɛde ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho bere a wɔrehwehwɛ STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa sɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow: Mmara ahorow gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu, nanso amantam pii wɔ mmara ahorow a ɛbɔ aduruyɛ mu kokoamsɛm ho ban, na ɛma mmabun tumi yɛ STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a awofo mpene so. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko sɛ ɔbabun no wɔ asiane mu sɛ obepira no a. Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii: Wɔde abrabɔ pa ho nnyinasosɛm ahorow kyekyere akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo sɛ wɔbɛkora ayarefo kokoamsɛm so, a mmabun ka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkari pɛ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afi asiane ho, te sɛ sɛ ɔbabun no wɔ asiane mu sɛ obepira ne ho anaasɛ afoforo apira no a, wɔbɛbɔ atumfoɔ amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ ayaresa fi nnuruyɛfo a wɔfata hɔ na ama asiane ahorow so ate so dua.
answer_twi_source: ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ ayaresa fi adwumayɛfo a wɔfata hɔ. Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa mmabun akwahosan ho yaresafo betumi aboa wo ma woanya adwene a ɛfata a ehia
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside anaa nyiyimu bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wonya mmoa a ɛfata na obu wom?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside anaa nyiyim bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa a, wobetumi: Wɔakyerɛw nyiyim anaa ayayade biara a wohyiae wɔ adeyɛ no mu. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wonim mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow no hɔ. Fa anwiinwii anaa amanneɛbɔ kɔma atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho, te sɛ mmaranimfo ahyehyɛde ahorow, ɔmanfo hokwan ahorow ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔhwɛ so. Kasa ma wɔn hokwan ahorow kyerɛ denam ka a wobɛka sɛ wohia mmoa a ɛfata na obu wom ne pow a wobɛpow sɛ wobegye nyiyim atom no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akyi a wodi ne akyi hwehwɛ ' follow-up and aftercare' bere a wɔanya ɔhaw mu mmoa ne nea wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho akyi?
answer_twi_source: Akyidi ne ɔhwɛ akyi no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkɔ so de mmoa ne nea wɔde ma mmabun bere a wɔanya ɔhaw mu mmoa wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ma. Saa mmoa yi botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma yiedi a ɛkɔ so, adi haw foforo anaa nea ɛda so ara wɔ hɔ biara ho dwuma, na ama ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛsan anya ahoɔden bere tenten na wɔatumi agyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so de si hɔ nanso wɔde di dwuma wɔ aman ntam nkitahodi mu, titiriw bere a wohyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi anaa nneyɛe a ɛma me ho nyɛ me dɛ mu no?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so de hye nsisi hɔ dendeenden nanso wɔ aman nkitahodi no bi ne sɛ wode kasa a ɛyɛ katee ne nipadua kasa bedi dwuma, wobɛkɔ so ayɛ komm na wowɔ ahotoso, na wode w’adwene asi w’ahiade ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow so. Fa nkitahodi akwan a ɛyɛ den te sɛ "kyerɛwtohɔ a abubu" (wo hye a wobɛsan ayɛ no brɛoo na woayɛ no daa), akwan foforo a wobɛfa so ayɛ saa anaasɛ wobɛgyae wo ho so, ne nipadua mu kasa a ɛyɛ den te sɛ aniwa a wobɛkɔ so ahwɛ na woagyina anaa wobɛtra hɔ tee no di dwuma. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wode wo yiyedi bedi kan na woasi w’ahye so dua, sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wubehyia bere tiaa mu ɔhaw anaa adwene a enhyia mpo a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmerante ne mmabaa betumi akɔ so ayɛ den na wɔadi nsɛnnennen a ɛfa wɔn awo akwahosan ho ho dwuma bere a wɔma wɔn ho yɛ den na wɔte nka sɛ wɔn nyinaa ye no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne sɛnea wogyina ano de di awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔakura wɔn yiyedi nyinaa mu denam: Nnamfo, abusua mufo, afotufo, ne mpanyimfo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobetumi de nkate fam mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde boa wɔn ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛhyehyɛ so. Akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho te sɛ adwene a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma so, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔka de di adwennwen, dadwen, ne nkate mu ahokyere ho dwuma a wɔde bedi dwuma. Nsɛm ne nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, ayaresa a wobetumi apaw, ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow ho na ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi na wɔanya nsɛm. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyekye de ada ahiade, ahye, ne dadwen adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ den na etu mpɔn so wɔ abusuabɔ ne akwahosan ho tebea horow mu. Wɔn ho adwene pa, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne nipadua mu ahotoso a wobenya de adi ɔmanfo nhyɛso, nsusuwii hunu, ne animtiaabu a ɛfa awo akwahosan ne nna ho no so. Sɛ wohu sɛ mmoa ne mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no yɛ ahoɔden ho sɛnkyerɛnne, ɛnyɛ mmerɛwyɛ, na wowɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ bere a ɛho hia, te sɛ afotu anaa ayaresa. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina awo akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow, ɔhwɛ a wobenya, ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛbu ho animtiaa wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ho no gu ahodoɔ wɔ tumidi mu. Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmara kwan so asɛyɛde ahorow anaa ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ahyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ankorankoro a wɔahu sɛ wɔwɔ nyarewa bi no bɔ wɔn ahokafo a wɔne wɔn da anaa wɔde nnade kyɛ no amanneɛ wɔ nea ebetumi aba ho. Nanso, saa mmara ahorow yi taa kari pɛ wɔ hia a ehia sɛ wɔbɔ ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ban ne hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ wɔ kokoam ne kokoamsɛm ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara ne nhyehyɛe pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa ɔhokafo amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa STI anaa HIV ho no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ wiase nyinaa, na nsɛmti anaa akwan horow a wɔtaa fa so di dwuma wɔ aman anaa mmeae ahorow bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoe: Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ Adesua nhyehyɛe mu: Ɛsono nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow kɛse wɔ wiase nyinaa wɔ emu nsɛm, mfe a obi adi, ne nea wosi so dua no ho. Aman binom wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua akwaa, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne STI ho, bere a afoforo nso betumi de wɔn adwene asi akwan a wɔfa so twe wɔn ho fi ho nkutoo so kɛse. Amammerɛ mu Nkate: Dwumadi ahorow taa da amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow adi. Sɛ nhwɛso no, aman binom betumi asi atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho kosi sɛ wɔbɛware so dua. Dwumadie: Akwan a wɔfa so de ma nso gu ahodoɔ, ɛfiri nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina sukuu so so kɔsi mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma ne intanɛt so nneɛma so. Nsɛmti a Wɔtaa Ka: Nkitahodie a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Dwumadi ahorow pii si hia a nkitahodie pa, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne obu ho hia so dua. Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne STI: Wɔtaa de nsɛmti te sɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, STI ano a wosiw, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ka ho. Mpene so: Nnɛyi nhyehyɛe ahorow pii de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne nna mu hokwan ahorow ho reka ho kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde nnipa a wɔadi dɛm suahu ahorow ka amanneɛbɔ, nhoma, ne amammerɛ a agye din mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a Wɔde Ma Adebɔfo a Wɔadi dɛm: hwehwɛ na boa adebɔfoɔ a wɔadi dɛm wɔ amanneɛbɔ ne adwinni mu. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm ho Afotufoɔ: Fa mmubuafoɔ afotufobɔfoɔ ka wo amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔyɛ mu na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔayɛ mfonini no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nsɛm Ahorow: Hyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa dɛmdi ahorow ne osuahu ahorow a wɔatra ase ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a me ne awofoɔ di no betumi aboa me ma mate wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, akwanhwɛ, ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa me nneyɛe ne gyinaesi ho wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu ase?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔne awofoɔ di no boa mmabun ma wɔte wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, akwanhwɛ, ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa nneyɛe ne gyinaesi ho wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu ase denam: Asɛnka agua a wɔbɛma awofoɔ anya wɔn gyidi, gyinapɛn, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho, a wɔboa mmabun ma wɔte ntease a ɛwɔ awofo akwankyerɛ ne mmara akyi no ase. Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔada wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn nkate, ne wɔn nsɛmmisa adi pefee, na wɔama awofo ne mmofra anya obu ne ntease a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho wɔn ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkɔ so wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw, ama awofo ne mmabun atumi adi nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, akyerɛkyerɛ ntease a ɛnteɛ mu, na wɔabom ahwehwɛ ano aduru a ebetumi aba. Ahotoso ne abusuabɔ a wɔbɛma awofo ne mmabun anya, de tebea a ɛboa a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne afotu afi wɔn awofo hɔ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu  toto nyinsɛn a wɔtoa so ho a, asane ne mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwaahosan ho ɔbenfo susuw asane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nyinsɛn no a wobɛtoa so nyinaa so. Nsɛm a wɔaka abom ni, nanso nsɛm pɔtee bi bɛsono a egyina wo tebea so. Nyinsɛn no a Wobɛtoa So: Mfaso a ɛwɔ so: Wode nyinsɛn no kɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu na wowo abofra. Asiane: Akwahosan ho asiane ahorow bi wɔ nyinsɛn ne awo mu. Saa asiane ahorow yi betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina w’akwahosan ne ɔhwɛ a wubenya ansa na woawo so. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu: Mfaso a ɛwɔ so: Ebetumi ama nyinsɛn a wompɛ aba awiei na ama woatumi de w’adwene asi wo nhomasua ne daakye botae ahorow so. Asane ahorow: Asane ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aba wɔ aduruyɛ biara mu, ɛwom sɛ mpɛn pii no eyinom sua wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan a akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a ɔfata yɛ ho de. Kae: Ɛho hia sɛ wode w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi di kan. Akwahosan ho ɔbenfo betumi ama wo nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfa wo ho a ɛfa asiane ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ wo tebea no ho pɔtee ho. Nneɛma bi a wode bɛboa ne nsɛm a ɛwɔ kokoam ni: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo nkasa na mmua wo nsɛmmisa na fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho akwan horow, asiane ahorow, ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so wɔ Ghana mmara mu. Ɛho hia sɛ wunya nsɛm fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so na wusi gyinae a ɛfata a wobɛte nka sɛ ɛfata wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Twaka bɛn na nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔ fa nkɔmmɔbɔ kɛse a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne asɛde ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono ɔsom ne amammerɛ ahorow adwene wɔ nyinsɛn ho nnuro. Ɛho hia sɛ wote w’ankasa wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ase bere a wubu afoforo de no. Nyamesom anaa amammerɛ mu nsusuii ahorow bi betumi ayɛ: - Nyamesom ahorow bi betumi anya nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa akwankyerɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ho a ɛka ankorankoro gyidi ne nneyɛe. - Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne atetesɛm betumi akyerɛ su a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho, na aka akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya ne nea wogye tom. - a ehia se wo ne ankorankoro a wogye wo di, te se nyamesom anaa mpɔtam akannifoɔ bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛda adi pefee, de ahwehwɛ sɛdeɛ nyamesom anaa amammerɛ mu gyidie ne gyinaesie a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho no di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na awofo ne mmabun betumi asusu ahyeɛ ne kokoam nsɛm ho wɔ wɔn mmabunberɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mo mfa nkitahodie nni kan, na monni nkɔmmɔ mfa saa nsɛm yi ho. Awofoɔ mmu mmabun hyeɛ ne ɔmo adwenkyerɛ. Monni mmara ne mfidie ho aboboo, na mongye nea ɛbɛboa no nto mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na bra pa ho nsɛm te sɛ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'reproductive justice' ne asane ntesoɔ ne ade betumi aboa ama mpɔntuo ne nhyehyɛeɛ aboa pɛyɛ, obuo ne mmabun nyinaa fahodie a ɛfa  deɛ wɔtwa no tia kasɛ 'ASRH' ho?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ mu fahodie: Siesie mpɔtam haw. Asane ntesoɔ: Te asane ne animtiabuo so na bu adwenkyerɛ. Intersectionality: Hu nneɛma pii a ɛka bom di dwuma. Hwehwɛ pɛyɛ ne obu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi anya nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfa mmubuafo pɔtee ho: Akuo pii de wɔn adwene si dɛmdie ne nna so. Hwehwɛ akuw a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam anaa wo man mu wɔ intanɛt so. Planned Parenthood: Planned Parenthood de intanɛt so nneɛma ma na ebia ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea a adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn wɔ mmubuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn bɛka ho ho Scarleteen website. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di: Wo ne ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotubɔfɔo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebɛtumi afi nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a wobegye adi na wɔatrɛw mu, ankorankoro ne mpɔtam a ɛtrɛw nyinaa mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a wobegye adi na wɔatrɛw mu no betumi de nea efi mu ba ahorow aba, ankorankoro ne mpɔtam a ɛtrɛw nyinaa. Ankasa betumi ama wasisi gyinae a wonni nimdeɛ wɔ nna mu nneyɛe, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, anaa ayaresa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ho, a ebetumi ama wanyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, nna mu yareɛ 'STI', anaa akwahosan mu nsɛnnennen afoforo aba. Wɔ mpɔtam a ɛtrɛw no, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛtrɛw no betumi aboa ma wɔakɔ so anya nsusuwii hunu a epira, abɔ akuw bi animtiaa, na wɔasɛe ahotoso a wɔwɔ wɔ nsɛm a wotumi gye di mu, na awiei koraa no asiw mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran no kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wofi mmusua a wonni ahotɔ anaa mpɔtam a wonni ananmusifo anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wofi mmusua a wonni ahobammɔ anaa mpɔtam a wonni ananmusifo. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi betumi ayɛ sika a wɔde ma, mmoa, adesua ho mmoa nhyehyɛe, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a aban ahorow, nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, ne ankorankoro fapem ahorow de ma. Wɔn botae ne sɛ wobedi akwanside ahorow a nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa yie hyia wɔ nhomasua ne ntetee mu no ho dwuma, na wɔhyɛ nhomasua hokwan ahorow a ɛfata ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ meresusuw ho sɛ mɛfa mmofra ayɛ me ba anaasɛ mɛyɛ awofo sɛ nneɛma a mɛpaw ama me nyinsɛn a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ, na mɛyɛ dɛn anya nsɛm ne mmoa a mede besi gyinae ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ne Mmoa: Sɛ woresusuw ho sɛ wobɛfa wo ayɛ wo ba anaasɛ wobɛtete wo a, hwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa fi mmeae a wugye di. Eyi betumi ayɛ: Aban Asoɛe a Wɔfa Wɔn sɛ Wɔn mma: Di nkitaho wɔ mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔhwɛ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma no nkyɛn na woanya nsɛm a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho nhyehyɛe, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ahorow, ne mmoa adwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Awofoɔ Adesua: Hwehwɛ awofoɔ adesua anaa adwumayɛbea wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Eyinom betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo a ɛfa sɛnea wɔhwɛ abofra a wɔawo no foforo, mmofraberem nkɔso, ne awofoyɛ ho nimdeɛ ho. Afotu Dwumadibea: Susuw afotu ho de hwehwɛ wo nkate ne akwan horow a wubetumi apaw mu. Ɔfotufo betumi aboa wo ma woafa gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no mu. Mmoa Akuw: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ kuw a wɔboa ankorankoro a wɔyem anaa awofo nkumaa mu a, ebetumi ama woanya mpɔtam hɔfo ho adwene ne afotu a ɛsom bo. Nsɛm a Wobɛnya: Fa nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow, adwumakuw a agye din a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, ne awofoyɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma. Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nkasa. Wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛfa honam fam ne nkate fam afã horow a ɛfa nyinsɛn, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, ne awofoyɛ ho ama. Nneɛma a Wobɛpaw a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Gye wo bere hwehwɛ akwan mmienu no nyinaa mu. Susuw nneɛma te sɛ sɛnea woasiesie wo ho sɛ wobɛyɛ ɔwofo, mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ, sikasɛm mu nsusuwii, ne w’ankasa botae ahorow ho. Wo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ abusua mufo, afotufo, anaa sukuu afotufo a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama no nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ sɛ mɛnya afotuo a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ nkateɛ a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma me gyinapɛn, gyidie, ne nipasu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhwɛ sɛ wo nsa bɛka afotuo a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ nkateɛ a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma wo gyinapɛn, wo gyidie, ne wo nipasu no, wobɛtumi: Ahwehwɛ afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ osuahu ne nteteeɛ wɔ adwuma a wɔne nnipa ahodoɔ bɛyɛ mu na wɔte nkitahodiɛ a ɛda nnipa ahodoɔ ntam ase. Bisa wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ afotufo no ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne nkate ho, a sɛnea wɔde amammerɛ mu nneɛma ka wɔn nneyɛe ho ka ho. Wo ne wo fotufo no nni nkitaho pefee fa w’amammerɛ, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne gyidi ahorow ho, na susuw amammerɛ pɔtee biara a ɛho hia wo ho. Ka ma wo ho na kyerɛ nea wopɛ ne w’ahiade wɔ afotu nhyiam ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wubedi dadwen anaa ɔhaw biara a ɛfa amammerɛ mu nkate a wonni ho dwuma. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa nkitahodibea ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ afotu adwuma a ɛfata a wɔde ma mmabun a wofi mmusua ahorow mu no hɔ. Fa nsɛm ma wo fotufoɔ anaa afotufoɔ beaeɛ fa wo suahunu ne nyansahyɛ biara a ɛbɛma amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne nkateɛ atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn dwumadie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nneyɛe a ɛfata, a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, te sɛ nokwasɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu, fibea ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, ne adwene ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ mu, de abrɛ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛretrɛw ase na wɔahyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma, a ɛfata mu de abrɛ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛtrɛw ase na wɔahyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ho nkuran. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nokwasɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu ansa na wɔakyekyɛ, sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛnea nneɛma a wonya fi mmeae ahorow no yɛ nokware, hwehwɛ adwene ahorow a egu ahorow fi mmeae pii, na wɔhwehwɛ emu nsɛm no mu yiye hwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata. Ɛdenam nneyɛe yi a mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen so no, wobetumi aboa ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo tebea a asɛyɛde wom kɛse na wɔama wɔn ho ne afoforo tumi denam nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de ahotew pa adi dwuma ama m’akyi akwaa , nea abrofo frɛ no "genitals"?
answer_twi_source: W’akwaa a wobɛma ho atew no ho hia ma w’akwahosan ne w’awerɛkyekye. Adeyɛ a ɛnyɛ den ni: Guare anaa aguare daa: Da biara da ye, titiriw bere a wo ho fifiri pii bere a woreyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ awie no. Fa nsu a ɛyɛ hyew ne samina a ano yɛ brɛoo di dwuma: Kwati samina a ano yɛ den anaa srab a ebetumi ahyɛ honam ani a ɛyɛ mmerɛw no abufuw. Hohoro awotwaa no brɛoo: Hohoro honam ani akyi mpopaho a atwa awotwaa no ho ahyia (ma mmea) anaa ɔbarima akyi berɛmo (ma mmarima) no ho. Ɛho nhia sɛ wobɛhohoro wo mu – wo nipadua no fi awosu mu tew ne ho. Fa mpopaho a ɛho tew bɔ beae no ma ɛyow. Hyɛ ntade ase a ɛnyɛ den na ɛma ahome: "Cotton" yɛ ade pa a wubetumi apaw. Ntade a ɛyɛ den betumi akyere nsu na ahyɛ honam ani abufuw. Sesa ntade ase da biara da, titiriw bere a wo ho fifiri anaasɛ wo ho fifiri awie no. Wɔ mmea fam no: Ebia wubehu sɛ nsu a efi awotwaa mu ba. Eyi yɛ ade a ɛfata na ɛma apɔwmuden. Ebetumi asesa ne kɔla ne ne dodow wɔ wo kyinhyia no nyinaa mu. Sɛ nsu a ɛretu no hua a ano yɛ den, ɛyɛ no yaw, anaasɛ ɛrehyew a, wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa. Wɔ mmarima fam no: Twe awotwaa no (sɛ wontwaa twetia dedaw a) brɛoo na ama ɛho tew ase. Afei, fa si ananmu wɔ awosu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo no yɛ nea wontua hwee, anaasɛ so sika anaa sika bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata mmoa anaa afotu a wɔhwehwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka: Mpɛn pii no, wɔmfa ahomotrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne ahomotrofo a wɔde boa nkurɔfo nni dwuma kwa, na wontua hwee anaasɛ wontua hwee wɔ mmoa anaa afotu a wobɛhwehwɛ ho. Mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi a wɔrenhaw wɔn ho wɔ sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow ho, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ mmoa wɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wohia mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ntetee nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛyɛ de adi animtiaabu ne nyiyimu a wɔyɛ tia mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ntetee nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde wɔn adwene si amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfata mmabun so. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi botae ne sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nsɛnnennen pɔtee bi a mmabun hyia ne sɛnea wɔde ɔhwɛ a obu ne nyiyim nnim bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mpɔtam dɔkotafoɔ boa STI/HIV nkyerɛkyerɛ boa wɔ mmabunu nkwa ho nhyehy3?
answer_twi_source: Wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa (Routine screenings). Wɔma afotu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ (Counseling/education). Wɔkyerɛ sɛdeɛ yɛte asane so (Risk assessment). Wɔde wo kɔ ayaresa (Linkage to care).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo ne ahwɛfo betumi ahyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ne obu a wɔwɔ ma mmabun ho nkuran wɔ mmeae a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ ne fie?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ama nipadua mu adwempa ne obu ama mmabun wɔ nwomasua tebea mu denam kasa a ɛka obiara ho na ɛsi so dua a wɔde bɛka ho, nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nipadua ahodoɔ ho a wɔde bɛma, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nipadua mfonini ne ne ho a wɔgye tom ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ, ne adesuadan mu tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ. Wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no betumi ahyɛ nipadua mu adwempa ne obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho ho nkuran wɔ fie denam nipadua ho mfonini pa ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛso, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nipadua ho, mmɔdenbɔ ne suban su ahorow a wɔbɛkamfo mmom sen sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho, ne ɔdɔ ne mmoa a enni nnyinaso a wɔde bɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛdɛn ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛyɛ adwuma de siw nyinsɛn ano bere a obi ne nna a wɔammɔ ho ban anaasɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no adi nkogu?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ara yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano bere a wɔne wɔn ho da a wɔammɔ wɔn ho ban anaasɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no adi nkogu akyi. Ɛyɛ adwuma denam ɔbaa honam nkosua a mmɔgyasoɔ bosume biara  a ɛkyɛ anaasɛ esiw ano, ɛmma ɛwo no ntumi nkɔ nyinsɛn mu, anaasɛ ɛmma ɛnkɔ awotwaa no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wunim telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so, ayaresabea ahorow, anaa mmeae bi a mmerante ne mmabaa betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bi a enhia wɔn awofo kwan?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan adwumayɛbea/mmabun mmeae. Sukuu mu ɔyarehwɛfo. YMK App (ahintasɛm). Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene ho mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wonsusuw sɛnea wɔbɛma tebea a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛyɛ pɛ ama nna mu akwahosan ho yie.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ ɔbabun no, wubetumi adi dwuma bi wɔ baabi a obiara bɛka ho kɛse no mu: Yɛ ɔyɔnko: Boa wo nnamfo ne wo mfɛfo sukuufo, a wɔn nna anaa abusua a wofi mu mfa ho. Twa adwene a ɛnteɛ ho mpoa: Mma anansesɛm anaa nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa akuw ahorow ho nkɔ so. Hyɛ obu ho nkuran: Fa nidi ne obu di obiara nni, ɛmfa ho sɛnea ɔpaw ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna. Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ kyerɛ: Kasa ma nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna ne nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Kae Tema a yɛbɛma, a yɛbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma obiara anya mmoa a ɛyɛ pɛ, ne tebea a yɛbɛma obiara aka ho kɛse so no, yebetumi ayɛ adwuma de akɔ daakye a obiara betumi abɔ ne nna mu akwahosan ho ban na wate nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn asɛnka agua, wɔn nne, ne wɔn adebɔ adi dwuma de ayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛhyɛ pene amammerɛ ho nkuran, ɛma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu nne yɛ kɛse, na ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔwɔ wɔn nna mu basabasayɛ ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn nhyiam ase, nne, ne adebɔ adi dwuma de ayɛ na wɔakyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛhyɛ peneeɛ amammerɛ ho nkuran denam video ahorow a ɛma nsɛm, nea broni ka no 'podcast', 'blog', ne 'social media' so nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ a ɛka hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so, obu, ne abusuabɔ pa ho asɛm. Wobetumi ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no nne ayɛ kɛse denam nsɛm a ɛfa sɛnea wotumi gyina tebea horow ano ne tumi a wɔde ma ho a wɔbɛkyɛ ne nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho a wɔbɛkasa atia denam adwinni, abakɔsɛm a wɔka, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi so. Ɛdenam wɔn adebɔ ne dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔasakra ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow na wɔama amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so na wobu wɔn so no anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ nokware sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, ma wo mu duru yɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Eyi yɛ anansesɛm anaa atosɛm a wɔtaa ka. Bere a nnipa binom bɔ amanneɛ sɛ wɔn mu duru kɔ soro bere a wɔafi awo ano aduru ase akyi no, nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ adanse a ɛdɔɔso nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ pefee sɛ ɛma wɔn mu duru yɛ kɛse. Sɛ wo mu duru kɔ soro a, ɛtaa nnu kilogram 2 wɔ afe a edi kan no mu. Sɛ ɛhaw wo a, wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛma ɛtra yɛn adwenem bere a yɛresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ atenka a ɛfa nna anaa awo akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a ɛfa nna anaa awo akwahosan ho ho asɛm a, ɛho hia sɛ wususuw amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ne nneyɛe biara a ebetumi anya adwene ahorow so nkɛntɛnso ho. Fa obuo gye tom na hwehwɛ saa amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii ahorow yi mu, na hu sɛ ebetumi akyerɛ suban, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akannifo anaa nneɛma a ebetumi ama woanya nhumu wɔ sɛnea wobɛfa saa nsɛmti yi mu wɔ wo amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Therapy' (afotu) akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ na nsonsoeɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: CBT (adwene/nneyɛeɛ). Psychodynamic (kane nsɛm anaa suahunu). Humanistic (sɛdeɛ wonyin). Family Therapy (afotu a yɛdema abusua). DBT. Dɔkota bɛboa wo ma wehu deɛ ɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mmabun nne ne wɔn adwene ahyɛ nnipa mmoa nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde wɔn SRH hokwan ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan no bedi kan na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kyɛfa: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnipa mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nhyehyɛe, ne di, ne ne nhwehwɛmu mu denneennen no hwɛ hu sɛ wobesusuw wɔn nne, wɔn adwene, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan ho na wɔada no adi wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Nnwuma a mmabun di anim: Nnwumakuo ne akuw a mmabun di anim a wɔboa no ma mmabun tumi kamfo wɔn SRH hokwan ahorow, nnwuma a wobenya, ne kyɛfa a ntease wom wɔ nnipa mmoa nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ mu. Nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Nkɔmmɔdie ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne nnipa mmoa adwumakuo ntam no ma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmabun SRH ahiadeɛ ne hokwan ahodoɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde besiw ayayade a wɔde yɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ano?
answer_twi_source: Aman pii wɔ mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde asiw LGBTQ+ mmabun a wɔyɛ wɔn basabasa ne wɔn a wɔhaw wɔn wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ano. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛɛ a ɛko tia ayayade nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho titire, nteteeɛ a wɔde ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ LGBTQ+ a wɔde wɔn bɛka ho, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde ma asuafoɔ a wɔhyia ayayadeɛ anaa nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na metumi atu de abɔ me mmra kwan so hokwan "legal rights" ahorow ho ban sɛ obi a wadi dɛm, titiriw sɛ mihyia nyiyim anaa ɔhaw a?
answer_twi_source: Hu Wo Hokwan: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa mpɔtam hɔ ne ɔman no mmra a ɛbɔ nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ho ban fi nyiyim ne ayayade ho wɔ mmeae ahorow, a adwuma, adan, akwahosan, ne nhomasua ka ho.
