Kyerɛw Nsɛm a Ɛsisii: Yɛ nyiyim anaa ɔhaw biara ho kyerɛwtohɔ, a nna, mmere, ne nsɛm a esisii no ho nsɛm ka ho, na sɛ wusi gyinae sɛ wobɛfa mmara kwan so a, ebetumi ayɛ nea mfaso wɔ so. Hwehwɛ Mmra Mmoa "Seek Legal Support": Sɛ wuhyia nyiyim anaa ɔhaw a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmra kwan so afotu anaa mmoa afi ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, mmra kwan so ayaresabea ahorow, anaa mmaranimfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ mu hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi ahyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a egye nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nnipadua ho sintɔ ho tom no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho. Nneɛma a wotumi nya. Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ahobammɔ/ɛboa. Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a emu yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne ankorankora ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow adi nkitaho de akamfo wɔn sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow ne hokwan ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow adi nkitaho de akamfo wɔn sikasɛm mu hokwan ne hokwan ahorow denam mmabun agyinatukuw, afotu bagua ahorow, ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Wobetumi nso ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ayɛ adwuma abom ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, de nsɛm ama wɔ nnwuma a wɔayɛ ho, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn ahiade ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan ho.(biribiara nni hɔ ma wɔn a wonni hɔ)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanya bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mesusu sɛ mayem (nyinsɛn) a?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ Nyinsɛn Nhwehwɛmu: Ade a edi kan a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ne sɛ wobɛyɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu de akyerɛ sɛ woanyinsɛn anaa. Hwehwɛ Afotu: Sɛ sɔhwɛ no yɛ papa a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ afotu anaa mmoa de asusuw akwan horow a wubetumi afa so ho. Susuw Nea Wobɛpaw Ho: Nea wubetumi apaw ne sɛ wobɛtoa nyinsɛn no so na woayɛ awofo, agye wo ayɛ wo ba, anaa woatu nyinsɛn agu. Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) na ɛno betumi aboa ama wɔanya nsɛm a mfasoɔ wɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma manya nkɔso na mahyɛ me nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woanya nkɔso na ahyɛ wo nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no mu den. Eyinom bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ websites ne App ahorow a ɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nkitahodie ho, atipɛnfo mmoa akuo anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee ne nna mu apɔwmuden so, ne nhoma anaa nsɛm a abenfoɔ a wɔwɔ adwuma no mu kyerɛwee. Bio nso, mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotubɔfoɔ, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ betumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ wo nsusuiɛ mu adɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛmma wontumi nnya nnuru a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu, te sɛ mifepristone ne misoprostol?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeaeɛ bi no, mmara betumi asiw kwan anaa ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ obi bɛnya nnuro a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu, te sɛ mifepristone ne misoprostol. Ebi ne sɛ mmara bɛhwehwɛ sɛ dɔkta na watwerɛ krataa ansa na woatumi anya saa nnuro yi, anaa nhyehyɛeɛ afoforo a ɛbɛyɛ den. Saa mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ yi betumi aka kwan a nnipa fa so nya afunutu nnuro, ɛne sɛ ɛyɛ kwan titiriw a nnipa pii pɛ sɛ wɔfa so tu abaeɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara biara a ɛsiw kwan anaa nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wodua so ansa na woanya afunutu nnuro wɔ wo mpɔtam, na woate aseɛ sɛnea ɛbɛtumi aka wo kwan a wobɛfa so anya ayaresa a wuhia..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ hokwan a mewɔ sɛ menya nna ho adesua a edi mũ wɔ sukuu mu no ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wunya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu mu ho ban: Wɔ mmeae pii no, nhomasua ho mmara ne adesua nhyehyɛe hwehwɛ sɛ sukuu ahorow de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata mfe a obi adi na ɛyɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nnipa nipadua, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI, pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne awo hokwan ahorow ma. Saa mmara ahorow yi taa si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nhomasua a obiara ka ho na ɛnyɛ nyiyim so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhomasua di wɔ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne nyiyim a wɔko tia mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ne nyiyim a wɔko tia mu denam: Nimdeɛ ne nhumu a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmarima ne mmea nsɛm ho. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne animhwɛ a wɔde ma ne tema a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ. Ankorankoro tumi a wɔde bɛkamfo wɔn hokwan ne afoforo hokwan ahorow ho Mma a wɔbɛhyɛ tebea horow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho a wɔhyɛ nnipa ahorow ahorow ho afahyɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asetena mu nneɛma bi te sɛ aduane anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ 'diet or exercise' betumi aka me brayɛ mu apɔmuden?
answer_twi_source: Aane, asetena mu nneɛma pii betumi aka brayɛ mu apɔmuden: Aduane: Aduane pa a wodi a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow, ne nam a sradeɛ nni mu wom betumi aboa apɔmuden nyinaa, a brayɛ mu apɔmuden ka ho. Nnuaneduru bi te sɛ (iron) ne 'magnesium' ho hia ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔbu bra. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔyɛ daa boa apɔmuden nyinaa na ebetumi aboa ma wɔadi brayɛ mu sɛnkyerɛnne ho dwuma. Nanso, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔboro so, titiriw sɛ wɔn nipadua mu duru sua a, betumi ama brayɛ ayɛ basabasa anaa atwa (amenorrhea). Dadwen: Dadwen a ɛkɔ soro betumi aka hormone dodoɔ na ama brayɛ ayɛ basabasa anaa sɛnkyerɛnne ayɛ den. Akwan a ɛyɛ a wɔfa so di dadwen ho dwuma, te sɛ adwene ne suban mu nsakraeɛ, 'yoga', anaa nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho, ho hia. Nna: Nna pa a wɔda a ɛdɔɔso ho hia ma hormone nhyehyɛeɛ. Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛda nnɔnhwere  asɔn kosi nkron (7-9) anadwo biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na mmabun nyɛ sɛ wɔwɔ nna mu nyarewa a 'STI'?
answer_twi_source: Di ayaresa akyi na nom aduro. Bɔ wo nnamfo anaa wohokafo amanneɛ. Kɔsra dɔkota. Bɔ wo ho ban (condoms).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asua biribi afi nnipa a ɛsono wɔn asetena tebea anaa osuahu ahorow a ɛsono me, de sen me bere a na merekɔ mpanyin mfe so no hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wen woaso bere a afoforo ka wɔn suahu ahorow no. Fa obu bisa nsɛm na ama woasua pii. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu na hwehwɛ adwene ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so de adwene si nneɛma so anaa apɔw-mu-tentennee a ɛfata mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ahomegye apɔw-mu-tentennee: Fa w’adwene si wo home so, home na gye ahome nkakrankakra. Nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu: Hwɛ wo nipadua no afã horow yie, na hyɛ nhyɛso anaa atenka biara nsow. Adwene mu kankyee: Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ yoga, tai chi, anaasɛ wo ho a wobɛtrɛw. Atenka anum a wode sua ade: Hyɛ nneɛma anum a wubetumi ahu, nneɛma anan a wubetumi de wo nsa aka, nneɛma abiɛsa a wubetumi ate, nneɛma abien a wubetumi ahua, ne ade biako a wubetumi asɔ ahwɛ nsow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'self-esteem' (obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho) ka wo sexual health  (nna ho apɔmuden) nkitahodie ne abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobu wo ho a, wosisi gyinaeɛ pa. Wohyehyɛ ɛhyeɛ 'boundaries'. Wotumi kasa yie. Wohwɛ wo ho yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛkyerɛ awofoɔ ne abofra nkitahodiɛ akwan a ɛdi mu ne abusua nsɛm ho amannebɔ nneyɛeɛ a ɛma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho su pa, obuo a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne ahotosoɔ a ɛwɔ awofoɔ ne mmabun ntam?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ ne abofra nkitahodiɛ akwan a ɛdi mu ne abusua nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛeɛ a ɛma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho su pa, obuo a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne ahotosoɔ wɔ awofoɔ ne mmabun ntam no betumi ayɛ: Nkitahodiɛ akwan a ɛbue a wɔde besi hɔ firi wɔn mmofraase na wɔama tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmuo a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene, wɔn nkateɛ, ne wɔn haw wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adi. Mmabun adwene, wɔn anigye, ne osuahu ahorow a wɔde nsiyɛ tie wɔn wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na wɔma wɔn nkate ne wɔn adwene yɛ nokware bere a wɔde akwankyerɛ, nkuranhyɛ, ne nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ ma no. Mmabun a wɔne mmabun bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ abusua nsɛm ho amannebɔ akwankyerɛ, mmara, ne apam ahorow a ɛda gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔkyɛ, nneɛma a wɔde di kan, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu wɔ fie hɔ adi. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dwumadi ahorow a wɔbom yɛ, te sɛ sini hwɛ, agodie, anaa intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔbom hwehwɛ mu, sɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛbom, osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ntease wom a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ne ne nkɛntɛnso ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ suban pa ne dijitaal ɔman ba gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ sɛ awofo, denam tema, obu, ne nokwaredi a wɔbɛda no adi wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu, ne denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma a ɛho hia ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adebɔ nneyɛe a asɛyɛde wom a wɔne mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam biakoyɛ ne fekubɔ betumi adi wiase nyinaa ɔhaw a wim nsakrae de ba ne nea ɛkyerɛ ma 'ASRH', a nneɛma a wɔbɛboaboa ano, nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne nnwuma a wɔde bɛhyɛ tumi a wɔde bɛma ka ho ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma nea aborɔfo ka no 'Resource Mobilization': Wɔne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ, aban, ne 'NGO' ahodoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de anya sika a wɔde bɛyɛ wim nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛtumi asiesie ne 'ASRH' nhyehyɛeɛ. Nimdeɛ a Wɔkyɛ: Nsesaeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, adwumayɛbea, ne nhyiamu a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de akyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa ne asuadeɛ a wɔasua wɔ wimu nsakraeɛ ne 'ASRH' ntam nkitahodiɛ no ho dwumadie mu. Tumi a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Mfiridwuma a broni ka no 'technology' ho mmoa ne nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma de akyekye mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ tumi a wɔde bedi 'ASRH' nsɛm ho dwuma wɔ wimu nsakraeɛ tebea mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya sika, mmoa, bosea, anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa foforo de afi wɔn nnwuma ase anaasɛ wɔatrɛw mu, na asiane ne akatua bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ adwumayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sika, mmoa, bosea, anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa foforo de afi wɔn nnwuma ase anaasɛ wɔatrɛw mu denam akwan horow so. Ebia eyi bɛka sika a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi abusuafo ne nnamfo hɔ, mmoa anaa sika a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔyɛ adwuma so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, nnipadɔm sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, abɔfo a wɔde wɔn sika hyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn sika hyɛ mu a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn, anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ bosea afi sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow anaa sikasɛm nketewa ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ. Bere a adwumayɛ ma wotumi nya sikasɛm mu akatua ne adwumayɛ mu nkɔso no, ɛde asiane ahorow te sɛ sikasɛm mu adehwere, ɛka a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ, ne mfaso a wontumi nsi pi wɔ sika a wɔde asie mu mfaso ho nso ba. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun de ahwɛyiye susuw asiane ne akatua a ebetumi aba a ɛbata adwumayɛ ho no ho na wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ sikasɛm a wɔde bɛma wɔn nnwuma no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ a ɛwɔ mmabun a wɔma wɔn tumi denam nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so, wɔ ankorankoro yiyedi ne asetra mu nsakrae a ɛtrɛw nyinaa so?
answer_twi_source: Ɛboa ma mmabun tumi si gyinaeɛ pa, wɔhunu wɔn ho so hwɛ yie, na wɔnya ahoɔden pa. Ɛhyɛ ayɔnkofa mu den wɔ mmabun ntam ne nkyirimma nyinaa mu, na ɛma nkurɔfoɔ boa wɔn ho wɔn ho. Ɛma nkurɔfoɔ nimdeɛ kɔ anim wɔ wɔn kyɛfa ne wɔn kwan so mmara ho, na ɛsesa amanneɛ ne suban bɔne biara a ɛfa saa nsɛm yi ho. Ɛma aban ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ ayaresabea nsɛm so yɛ wɔn adwuma yie, na ɛma wɔyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa. Ɛma pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, atɛntrenee, ne nnipa kyɛfa mu yɛ den wɔ awarene ne awoɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ amansan nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasua pii afa pene a wɔpene so wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu, a intanɛt so adesua, adwumayɛbea, nsɛm, ne mfoni ahorow ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasua pii afa pene a wɔpene so wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu no bi ne: Intanɛt so Adesua: Wɛbsaet ne nhyiam ahorow a ɛde intanɛt so adesua anaa module ahorow a ɛfa dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw, intanɛt so ahobammɔ, ne pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma. Nhyiamu ne nea broni ka no 'Webinars': Ahyehyɛdeɛ ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔyɛ nhyiamu anaa webinar a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa intanɛt so ahobanbɔ, pene a wɔpene so, ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔsiw ano ho. Nsɛm ne Akwankyerɛ: Intanɛt so nsɛm, akwankyerɛ, ne nokwasɛm nkrataa a ɛde nsɛm ne afotu a ɛfa sɛnea wobɛfa intanɛt so nkitahodi mu dwoodwoo ne obu mu ma. Nea aborɔfo ka no 'Video ne Podcast': Nhomasua 'video', 'podcast', ne nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, intanɛt so ayayade, ne dijitaal ɔman ba ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ kwan bere a merekɔsra akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo 'healthcare provider' bi wɔ nneɛma a ɛhaw me a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ɔyarehwɛfo no bebisa w’ayaresa ho abakɔsɛm, sɛnkyerɛnne anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo, ne nsakrae a woahyɛ no nsow. Nipadua mu Nhwehwɛmu: Ebia nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ, wɔbɛhwɛ ne tenten, ne mu duru, ne mogya mmoroso, na ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔbɛyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nhwehwɛmu. Nsɛmmisa: Siesie wo ho sɛ wobɛka wo brayɛ kyinhyia 'menstral cycle' (sɛ ɛfata a), nna mu dwumadi, w’adwene mu akwahosan, ne wo haw anaa nsakrae biara ho asɛm. Nhomasua: Wo ɔyarehwɛfo no bɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu mu, adi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, na ɔde akwankyerɛ ama wɔ suban pa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wohu GBV ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow, na wohu baabi a wobenya mmoa so dua.
answer_twi_source: GBV betumi asi wɔ akwan horow pii so. Nsɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ yie ni: Nipadua mu Ayayade: Ɔbɔ, pia, anaa honam fam opira biara. Atenka mu Ayayade: Ahunahuna, ahohorabɔ, nsɛm a wɔde to fam, nneyɛe a wodi so. Nna mu Ayayade: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna biara a wɔmpɛ, a nhyɛso anaa ahoɔden ka ho. Intanɛt so Ayayade: Intanɛt so ayayade, ɔhaw, anaa ahunahuna a wɔde mena wɔ kɔmputa so. Sɛ wonya eyinom mu biara wɔ abusuabɔ mu a, ɛnyɛ hwee. Baabi a Wobɛnya Mmoa: DOVVSU Hotline (Ghana): Frɛ a wontua hwee wɔ 0800 122122 na woanya mmoa ntɛm ara. Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana Helpline: Frɛ kokoam wɔ 0244312151 (Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-awia 5). Wobetumi de mmoa ama anaasɛ wɔde nneɛma bɛka wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na botae a mede besisi m’ani so boa me ma m’adwene mu da hɔ, hu akwanside anaa ɔhaw\ a ebetumi aba, na mayɛ nhyehyɛe anaa akwan horow a mɛfa so adi so bere a meresisi gyinae wɔ nna mu dwumadi, pene a mɛpene so, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho no?
answer_twi_source: Botae a wɔde besisi hɔ boa ma adwene mu da hɔ, hu akwanside ahorow a ebetumi aba, na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma de adi so bere a woresisi gyinae wɔ nna mu dwumadi, pene a wɔpene so, ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho denam: Botae pɔtee a wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu: Botae ahorow a emu da hɔ a wode besi hɔ no ma wutumi ka nea wopɛ sɛ wudu ho wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi ho. ɔhaw anaa  a wobɛhwɛ kwan: Akwanside ahorow a ebetumi aba a wubehu no boa wo ma wusiesie akwan horow a wobɛfa so adi ho dwuma ntɛm, te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma woatumi asiw nyinsɛn ano. Adeyɛ nhyehyɛe a wobɛyɛ: Adeyɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wobɛyɛ no kyerɛ anammɔn a ɛsɛ sɛ wutu na ama woadu wo botae ahorow ho, na ɛma gyinaesi yɛ nea wɔahyehyɛ no yiye na wotumi di ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam sika boa ma mmabun nna ne awo apomoden (ASRH) nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma tu mpɔn wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam sika a wɔde ma no di dwuma titiriw wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a ɛbɛma atu mpɔn wɔ wiase nyinaa denam sika fam mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nnwuma a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya, nna mu yareɛ a wosiw ano ne ayaresa, ɛnanom apomoden ho nnwuma, ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so a wosiw ano no so. Saa sika yi ma wɔtumi yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so na wɔde di dwuma, tumi a wɔde ma apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ, nnwuma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkɔ mpɔtamu hɔfoɔ nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo yɛ no di akwanside pɔtee a mmabun akuo a wɔato wɔn sintidua hyia wɔ sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a wobenya mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ di akwanside ahorow a mmabun akuo a wɔato wɔn sintidua hyia no ho dwuma denam nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, te sɛ ahokokwaw ntetee nhyehyɛe, adwuma a wɔde ma ho nnwuma, ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ ade a ɛma wogye tom a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Wɔde akwan a wɔfa so ka nnipa nyinaa bom, amammerɛ mu tema, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu di kan de hwɛ sɛ sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow bɛkɔ wɔn a wohia mmoa kɛse no nkyɛn na wohyia akwanside akɛse a ɛmma wontumi mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwahosan "healthcare" ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun yɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi mmabun ahiade soronko ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma. Wɔma tebea a ahobammɔ wom, ɛma akwaaba, na ɛnyɛ atɛn a mmerante ne mmabaa betumi anya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛyɛ nea ɛkɔ akyiri. Saa nnwuma yi ho hia mmabun efisɛ ɛhwɛ hu sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa nya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔn mfe a wɔadi a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ahofadi, di wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma, na ɛma wɔn nipadua, atinka, ne adwene mu yiyedi nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ obi apene so sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ nna dwumadie mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Ɛda Hɔ pefee: Hwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde ano ka ne deɛ ɛnyɛ ano kasem a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wowɔ ɔpɛyɛ womu. Anom Mpene: Tie nsɛmfua te sɛ "yiw anaa aane," "Mepɛ eyi," anaa "Me ho tɔ me." Nipadua Kasa: Tie nneyɛe pa te sɛ anigye a wode bɛhyɛ mu, aniwa a wode bɛhwɛ, ne suban a ɛma wo ho dwo no so. Ahye a Wobebu: Sɛ wunnim a, bisa tẽẽ na fa obu mu ma wɔmfa nsi so dua. Ɛyɛ mmara so bu sɛ obi de ne ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔhyɛ obi ma ɔnyɛ nea wɔpene so mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nya yɛn adwene mu yiyedi so nkɛntɛnso wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ adwene mu yiyedi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no mu denam nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde ma, suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfata a ɛma wonya nkɔso, ne tumi a ɛma ankorankoro tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho no so. Sɛ obi nya nna mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a, ebetumi atew dadwen, ehu, ne adwenem naayɛ so, na ama wanya ahotoso ne obu kɛse ama ne ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside anaa animhwɛ a ebetumi aba a wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no betumi ahyia bere a wɔrehwehwɛ atɛntrenee denam mmara nhyehyɛe so, te sɛ asodi a wɔde to wɔn a wɔato wɔn mmonnaa, mmonnaato ho anansesɛm, nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ho akamfofo ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi adi nsɛm yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ebia wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no behyia akwanside ahorow ne animhwɛ ahorow bere a wɔrehwehwɛ atɛntrenee denam mmara nhyehyɛe so no. Eyinom betumi ayɛ adwene a ɛfa mmonnaato ho asodi, mmonnaato ho anansesɛm (te sɛ gyidi a ɛne sɛ wɔn a wɔato wɔn mmonnaa no "bisaa no" anaasɛ nneyɛe bi kyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so), nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a egyina abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, asetra mu sikasɛm tebea, anaa nneɛma afoforo so, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu huammɔdi te sɛ nneɛma anaa ntetee a ɛnnɔɔso mma mmarahyɛfo ne mmaranimfo. Mmara ho akamfofo ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi adi saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma denam mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm bɛma, wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate nna mu basabasayɛ abu so ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so no ase, wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ de ama mmara kwan so mmuae a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho no atu mpɔn, ne adwuma a wɔbɛyɛ de atutu nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ne animhwɛ a ɛwɔ mmara nhyehyɛe no mu no afi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu sɛ bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) betumi aka mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow nyinaa, nanso nnipa binom hyia asiane ne nsɛnnennen a ɛkɔ soro.
answer_twi_source: Kae sɛ bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) betumi aka obiara, nanso nneɛma te sɛ abusuakuw, nna, dɛmdi, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea betumi ama asiane ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ mmoa a wobenya mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne STI ne HIV ho sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtaa ba, na kwan bɛn so na ebetumi ayɛ soronko wɔ ankorankoro mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtaa ba wɔ STI ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina yare mmoawa no so nanso ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne awotwaa mu akuru anaa akuru, nsu a ɛyɛ soronko a efi ɔbarima asi anaa ɔbaa no awotoa mu ba, ɛyaw anaa ɔhyew bere a ɔreto nsu, ɛyaw anaa yaw wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ase, ne ɛyaw a ɛba bere a ɔne obi reda. HIV ho sɛnkyerɛnne nso betumi ayɛ soronko nanso ebetumi ayɛ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛte sɛ flu, ɔbrɛ, ntini a ɛho ahonhon, ne menewa mu yaw, ne sɛnkyerɛnne a emu yɛ den kɛse wɔ ɔyare no fã a edi akyiri mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a mɛfa so ayɛ password ahorow a emu yɛ den na ahobammɔ wom de abɔ me ntentanfidie account ahorow ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛyɛ den: Fa nkyerɛwde (nkyerɛwde akɛse ne nketewa nyinaa), nɔma, ne agyiraehyɛde ahorow afrafra di dwuma. Kwati Nsɛmfua a Wɔtaa Ka: Kwati sɛ wode nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wubesusuw ho te sɛ awoda, din, anaa nsɛmfua a ɛnyɛ den bedi dwuma. Passwords Soronko: Fa password ahorow di dwuma ma account ahorow na amma account pii ansɛe. Password Managers: Susuw ho sɛ wode password manager bedi dwuma de asie password ahorow a ɛyɛ den na woayɛ no yiye. Daa Nsakrae: Sesa password bere ne bere mu, titiriw sɛ hokwan wɔ hɔ sɛ wɔasɛe no a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ama tebea a ɛboa na ɛtew ɛfa adwennwen so a ɛba wɔn afie, sukuu, ne mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛboa na ɛtew adwennwen so wɔ wɔn afie, sukuu ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, tema ne ntease a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne adwene mu apomoden ho nneɛma ne mmoa nnwuma a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so. Abusuabɔ pa a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ayamye ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ne mpɔtam hɔ dwumadi ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nso betumi aboa ma wɔanya mmeae a wɔboa a ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔsom bo na wɔboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho nhyehyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a edii yiye a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ atipɛnfo nkitahodi pa ho nkuran, ahyɛ abɛɛfo ntentan ɔman bayɛ ho nkuran, na wɔako atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkɛntɛnso bɔne?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a atipɛnfoɔ di anim a ɛdi mu ne ɔsatuo a wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ pa ho nkuran no bi ne: Nhyiamu a asuafoɔ di anim a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne abɛɛfo ntentan ɔman mma ho a wɔahyehyɛ wɔ sukuu anaa mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ mu. Atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a asuafoɔ a wɔn mfeɛ akɔ anim anaa mmabun akannifoɔ a wɔatete wɔn de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma atipɛnfoɔ nkumaa wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho. amanneɛbɔ kuro ntetan ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun fi ase de ma nkurɔfo hu kɔmputa so asisifo, de hyɛ Intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho nneyɛe ho nkuran, anaasɛ wɔkasa tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adwene a ɛnteɛ. Nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ a atipɛnfoɔ akuo ka ho de yɛ na wɔkyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛhyɛ ahodoɔ, nkabom, ne asetena mu nsakraeɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so nya obu ne ahotoso wɔ wɔn ho, ɛmfa ho sɛnea nipadua te?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so nya obu ne ahotoso wɔ wɔn ho no bi ne: Ahoɔden a Wobehu: Ankorankoro ahoɔden, nimdeɛ, ne nkɔso a wobehu na wɔakyerɛ ho anisɔ. Botae a Ɛyɛ Nokware a Wode Besi Hɔ: Botae ahorow a wubetumi adu ho a wode besisi w’ani so na woadi nkɔso ne nneɛma a woatumi ayɛ ho afahyɛ. Kasa pa a wode kyerɛ wo ho: Wɔn ankasa ho a wosi so dua a wɔde bedi dwuma na wɔde nkrasɛm pa na ɛhyɛ nkuran akasa atia ankasa ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a enye. Wɔn Ho a Wɔhwɛ: Dwumadi ahorow a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a ɛma nipadua, nkate, ne adwene mu yiyedi di kan. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa afotufo, a wɔde nkuranhyɛ ne nea wogye tom ma no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛma nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ nea asiane biara nni ho na mmara ma ho kwan? (ayaresabea ahorow a wɔ wɔ tumi krataa, wɔn a wɔfata a wɔde mmoa ma, a wodi aduruyɛ ho akwankyerɛ akyi)
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan yɛ nea akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔfata yɛ wɔ ayaresabea a wɔwɔ tumi krataa a edi aduruyɛ ho akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ akyi. Eyi hwɛ hu sɛ: Animdefo: Adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wɔwɔ ahokokwaw ne nnwinnade a wɔde bɛtew asiane ahorow so. Ahobammɔ Ho Nneɛma: Nnwinnade a wɔmfa nnuru nni dwuma wom a wɔde di dwuma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ɔyare mmoawa ano a wodi so. Ayarefo Hwɛ: Tebea a ɛboa a ɛde w’akwahosan ne wo yiedi di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So woanya animtiaabu bi a, ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho pɛn? (sɛ ɛfata ma ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no a) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no, mintumi nka m’ankasa osuahu ahorow mfa mmɔ me kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Nanso, minim sɛ nnipa pii ahyia animtiaabu a, ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wokae sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Aboafo nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodibea bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu na mahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ sɛ ɛho hia a?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Afotufo: Wo ne sukuu fotufo bi nkasa fa nna ho gyinaesi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ama. Nna mu Apomoden Ayaresabea: Kɔ nna mu Apomoden ayaresabea kɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne nna mu yarae ano a wosiw ho. Wɔtaa de afotu ne mmoa ma wɔ nna mu Apomoden ho haw ahorow ho. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Fa wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din te sɛ Planned Parenthood anaa Scarleteen di dwuma. Saa wɛbsaet ahorow yi de nna mu apomoden, pene a wɔpene so, ne gyinaesi ho nsɛm ma. Atipɛnfo Mmoa Akuw: Kɔka atipɛnfo mmoa kuw bi a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan so no ho. Atipɛnfo akuw betumi de nhumu, osuahu ahorow, ne mmoa a ɛnyɛ atemmu ama. Ntrɛwmu ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Frɛ nna ho apomoden ho telefon so na woanya kokoam afotu. Wɔde adwumayɛfo a wotumi bua nsɛmmisa na ɛwɔ saa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo yi mu. Nhoma ne Nhoma: Kenkan nhoma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne gyinaesi ho. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a abenfo a wɔwɔ adwuma no mu akyerɛw ama mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛn na ɛboa mmabun nna ho akwahosan (SRH) mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ ne nna ho mmoa ayaresabea (Planned Parenthood clinics). Mmabun ho dɔm a wɔka wɔn kyɛfa. Guttmacher Institute. Mpɔtam mmabun kuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ hwee sɛ wubebisa obi ne edinnsiananmu ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Pɛpɛɛpɛ! Ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so akyerɛ obu na woakyerɛ sɛ wodwen sɛ wobɛkasa akyerɛ obi yie. Sɛnea ɛte ni: Nhwɛso: "Hi [Edin], me ne [Wo Din]. Wo edinnsiananmu ne dɛn?" Ma no nyɛ nea ɛfata: Obiara betumi akyɛ ne edinnsiananmu, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi afa so asi m’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow so dua na mako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye no yie?
answer_twi_source: Fa ahye (boundaries) a emu da hɔ si hɔ: Kyerɛkyerɛ w’ankasa gyinapɛn ne ahye ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu, na fa ka kyerɛ w’atipɛnfo denneennen. Fa pow a wobɛpow ho nimdeɛ di dwuma: Di agoru anaa susuw tebea horow a ebia wubehyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye ho wɔ w’adwene mu, na nya mmuae a ɛyɛ katee de pow nkɔso a wompɛ. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Fa nnamfo a wobu w’ahye na wɔboa wo gyinaesi ahorow twa wo ho hyia, na fa atipɛnfo nkitahodi a ɛboa wo ma. Fa akwan foforo ma: Fa dwumadi foforo anaa akwan foforo a wobɛfa so de bere abom a ɛne w’abrabɔ ne w’anigyede hyia ho nyansahyɛ ma, na fa w’adwene si nneyɛe a asiane wom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de asetra mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ho abom de ahyɛ mmabun nkɔso a edi mũ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de asetra mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ho abom de ahyɛ mmabun nkɔso a edi mũ ho nkuran. Asetra mu nimdeɛ te sɛ nkitahodi, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, gyinaesi, kuw adwumayɛ, ne adwennwen ano aduru ma mmabun ankasa tumi gyina ano, nkate fam yiyedi, ne asetra mu nimdeɛ kɔ anim, na ɛboa wɔn adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ. Awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma mmabun nya nimdeɛ, suban, ne nneyɛe a ɛho hia ma wɔpaw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na ɛma abusuabɔ pa nya nkɔso, gyinaesi a asɛyɛde wom, ne nneyɛe pa a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho na wɔde atipɛnfo akwankyerɛ ama wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ne akuo a wɔboa wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ: Nsɛnnennen a wɔkyɛ: Fa asɛnka agua ma mmabun a wɔbɛkyɛ osuahun ne afotuo a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho. Hokwan a Wɔde Ma Afotuo: Mmabun a wɔn mfe akɔ anim a wɔadi dɛm betumi akyerɛ nkumaa afotuo, na ama wɔanya mpɔtam hɔfoɔ mmoa. Asetena mu Dwumadi ahorow: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma ayɔnkofa mu nhyiam ahorow a ɛma atipɛnfo nkitahodi nya nkɔso na ɛma wonya nnamfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomode'n mu ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, aman pii wɔ mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no ho ban. Saa mmara ahorow yi taa ma mmofra nkumaa kwan ma wɔpene apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, a nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɔfra no nyin wɔ nyinsɛn akwantuo no  mu? (awotwaa no nkɔso fã ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Wo ba no fa nkɔso a ɛyɛ nwonwa mu wɔ nyinsɛn no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne ɔkwa  a wɔpaapae mu: ɔsram abiɛsa a ade kan (First Trimester ): Nkwaboaa no de ne ho hyɛ w’awotwaa mu na efi ase nya akwaa atitiriw. Afe Abiɛsa a Ɛto so Abien (asram 4-6): Abɔfra no nyin ntɛmntɛm, na ebia wubefi ase ate nka sɛ ɔkeka ne ho (ɔbɔ ne nan anaasɛ ɔbɔ). Afe a Ɛto so Abiɛsa (asram 7-9): Abɔfra  no kɔ so nyin na onyin, na osiesie ne ho ma awo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ me hokafo pow sɛ ɔde ahobammɔ bedi dwuma nso ɛ? Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi atra ase dwoodwoo?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ na wɔbu wo bere a wo ne obi reda. Sɛ wo hokafo pow sɛ ɔde kɔndɔm bedi dwuma a, wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi wɔ nna no ho. Nneɛma bi ni: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea ɛhaw wo wɔ STI ho ne nea enti a ahobammɔ ho hia no mu. Fa akwan foforo a wɔfa so nya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a ɛnyɛ nea ɛfa asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya STI ho nyansahyɛ ma. Sɛ wo hokafo no rehyɛ wo a, ɛho hia sɛ wufi hɔ na wode w’ahobammɔ di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: amammerɛ anaa amammerɛ mu nnuan bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aboa ma maboa m’aduannuru ahiade wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane, amammerɛ anaa amammerɛ mu nnuan betumi ama wɔanya nnuan a ahoɔden wom a wobetumi apaw wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Nhwɛso ahorow bi a efi amammerɛ ahorow mu ni: Mediterranea Aduan: Nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, ngodua ngo, nnuaba, ne mpataa pii wom. Wonim no sɛ ɛwɔ mfaso a ɛma koma nya ahoɔden. Asiafo Aduan: Mpɛn pii no, nea ɛka ho ne stir-fries a wɔde nhabannuru ne protein a ɛnyɛ den te sɛ tofu anaa mpataa ka ho. Aburow ne noodles betumi ama wɔanya ahoɔden. Mexicofo Aduan: Ɛmo, atoko, avocado, ne tomato yɛ nneɛma a wɔtaa de di dwuma. Taco a wɔde nam a ɛnyɛ den, bankye, ne nhabannuru ayɛ no betumi ayɛ nea ahoɔden wom. Afrikafo Aduan: Nnuan a wɔde bankye, atoko, nhabannuru, ne aburow te sɛ atoko anaa atoko ayɛ. Nnuan a wɔde nam ne nhabannuru a ɛnyɛ den ayɛ no yɛ nea ahoɔden wom. Indiafo Aduan: Lentils, chickpeas, nhabannuru, ne nnuhuam yɛ aduan titiriw. Nnuan te sɛ dal (lentil stew) a wɔde aburow ka ho no ma protein ne fiber. Mfinimfini Apuei Aduan: Hummus, falafel, tabbouleh (parsley salad), ne nam a wɔayam anaa mpataa a wɔde nhabannuru ayɛ no yɛ aduan a ahoɔden wom a wobetumi apaw. Sɛ wowɔ amammerɛ anaa amammerɛ mu nnuan a ɛka w’agyapade ho a, susuw ho sɛ wode bɛka w’aduan ho. Wobetumi ama abusuabɔ bi aba w’amammerɛ mu bere a wɔde aduannuru a ɛsom bo ma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda akwan pa a wɔfa so hyɛ mu den a ɛyɛ papa, tesɛ nkuranhyɛ, mmoa, ne nneɛma pa a wɔpaw a wɔsi so dua, ne akwan bɔne te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nhyɛso, anaa nsakrae, ntam wɔ m’ayɔnkofa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoe a ɛda akwan pa a ɛwɔ ahoɔden a wɔde hyɛ mu den ne akwan bɔne ntam wɔ ayɔnkofa mu nkitahodi mu no hwehwɛ sɛ: Nhyɛso pa a ɛyɛ papa: Nhyɛso, mmoa, ne nea wosi so dua wɔ nneɛma pa a wobɛpaw a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow, botae ahorow, ne wo yiedi hyia ho. Saa akwan horow a wɔfa so hyɛ wo den yi ma wo so na ɛma wo tumi sɛ wusi gyinae ahorow a ɛma w’akwahosan ne w’ani gye. Akwan a enye a wɔfa so hyɛ mu den: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nhyɛso, anaa nsakrae a ebia ɛbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ wo ma wo ne nneyɛe anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow bi hyia, a w’ankasa gyinapɛn anaa ahye mfa ho. Saa akwan horow a wɔfa so hyɛ mu den yi betumi ayɛ nhyɛso, nsakrae, anaasɛ apira w’ahofadi ne wo yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ne "akontaabu" hwehwɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwannya a ɛwɔ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ne akontaabu wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu no kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne akwan horow asi hɔ de abɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, nnwuma, ne nyinsɛn ano aduru ho ban. Ɛsan nso hwehwɛ sɛ wɔma ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bu akontaa sɛ wɔkyerɛ obu ma saa hokwan ahorow yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hu sɛ ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ reto obi foforo a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hu sɛ obi foforo apira anaa basabasayɛ rekɔ so a, ɛho hia sɛ wɔde ahobammɔ di kan na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa ntɛm ara. Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, wobetumi de wɔn ho agye mu ahobammɔ mu, te sɛ denam frɛ a wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn ma wɔaboa anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ atumfoɔ kɔkɔ, na wɔde mmoa ama nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no a wɔremfa wɔn ho nkɔto asiane mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wonya nsɛm pii fa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛma mmabun a wɔregye wɔn bɔbeasu "gender identity" ho kyim wɔ sukuu ahorow, akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, nyamesom akuw, mpɔtam, intanɛt ne afoforo pii mu. Afotufo a wɔatete wɔn wɔ hɔ a wɔde nhumu ne akwankyerɛ a ɛsom bo bɛboa mmabun a wɔte saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano yɛ akwan anaa mfiri a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano denam mmadwoa a wɔde siw nkesua a ɛwo no ano anaasɛ wosiw nkesua a wɔahyɛ no den a wɔde bɛhyɛ awotwaa mu no ano. Ɛho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma ankorankoro tumi paw nea ɛfata wɔ sɛ ebia wɔpɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ awofo ne bere a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ awofo ho, na ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔyɛ wɔn daakye ho nhyehyɛe, di nhomasua ne adwumayɛ botae ahorow akyi, na wɔkura wɔn honam ne nkate fam yiyedi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛkyerɛ nnwuma a mmabun di anim ne ɔsatuo a ɛdi mu a aboa ama yarewa a yɛfrɛ no ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ, ne hokwan ahodoɔ anya nkɔsoɔ wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nnwuma a mmabun di anim ne ɔsatuo a ɛdi mu wɔ brofo a yɛfrɛ no ASRH mu no bi ne: Youth Advocacy Network (YAN), a ɛde mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa wɔ wiase nyinaa kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔbɛnya, ne awoɔ hokwan ahodoɔ. "Me Nipadua, Me Hokwan" ɔsatu a mmabun a wɔyɛ adwumaden wɔ aman pii so di anim, a ɛma nkurɔfo hu nna ne awo hokwan ahorow na ɛkasa tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim. HIV Asiw ne Ayaresa Dwumadi a Mmabun di anim wɔ Kenya, baabi a wɔtete mmerante ne mmabaa sɛ atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo de hyɛ HIV nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa a wodi so, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mfɛfo mu. "Youth Voices Count" nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ Asia-Pacific mantam mu, a ɛkamfo LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ne ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akora sika so, de sikasɛm botae ahorow asi wɔn ani so, adi ɛka ahorow akyi, na wɔde dijitaal nnwinnade, app ahorow, anaa Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow asi sika a wɔsɛe no ho gyinae a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de dijitaal nnwinnade adi dwuma de ayɛ: Sikasɛm mu botae ahorow a wɔde besisi hɔ ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ. Ka a wɔdi akyi wɔ bere ankasa mu de te sika a wɔsɛe no ase. Sika a wɔkora so denam automatic transfer anaa round-up features so. Sika a wɔsɛe no ho gyinaesi a ɛfata denam nneɛma bo a wɔde toto ho ne adetɔ ho abakɔsɛm a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔhaw anaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ahorow bɛn na wɔtaa di ho dwuma denam aduruyɛ mu mmoa dwumadi ahorow so, te sɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn ho haw ahorow, anaa adwenemyare ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ?
answer_twi_source: Aduruyɛ mu mmoa dwumadie taa di ɔhaw anaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm te sɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛeɛ anaa ayayadeɛ, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn ho haw a ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano ntɛm, nyinsɛn a wɔyi gu ne ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo, ne adwenemyareɛ a ɛhia ntɛm te sɛ adwenemhaw, mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkum wɔn ho/adwene ne dadwen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahoɔden a mede gyina ano ne ahokokwaw a mede begyina asetra mu nhyɛso, akwanside, anaa ntawntawdi ahorow a ɛwɔ atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ mu, a akwanside anaa ɔkasatia ka ho, bere a mekura adwene pa a ɛfa me ho a mesom bo ne ahotoso a mewɔ wɔ tumi a mede paw nneɛma a ntease wom no mu?
answer_twi_source: Aboteryɛ ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina nsɛm ano (coping skills) a wobɛnya na woafa so anya amansan nhyɛsoɔ ne akasagesee ho nteaseɛ no fa:Ahonim a wobɛhyehyɛ (Building self-esteem): W’ankasa wo ho mfonini pa ne nea wo ho yɛ den a egyina wo mu ahoɔden ne su horow so, sen sɛ ɛbɛgyina nnipa afoforo nkamfoɔ anaa apene so na woanya ho nteaseɛ.Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ (Seeking support): Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afiri mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, afotugyefoɔ, anaa mfɛfoɔ hɔ wɔ berɛ a haw anaa mmanisɛm wɔ hɔ, na woahunu akwan pa a wobɛfa so adi adwene mu haw (stress) ne amanehunu so.Nneɛma bɔne mu adesua (Learning from setbacks): Nneɛma bɔne ne mmanisɛm a wobɛhwɛ no sɛ akwan a wobɛfa so anyin na woasua adeɛ, na woasusu nea w’ahyia mu na woahunu adesua ne ahoɔden a ɛbɛboa wo de agyina nsɛm a ɛda so ara reba anim ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu ma adi mmabun ahiade ahorow ho dwuma, a wɔn a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ mu ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Tailoring no bi ne: Wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ amammerɛ mu nkateɛ ne nnipa nyinaa bɛka adesua nhyehyɛeɛ nkɔsoɔ ho. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ kasa ne akwan horow pii mu. Nsɛmti te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne awo hokwan ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma. Nkitahodi ne kyɛfa a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ akwan a wɔde bɛka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akannifo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de adu akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne aduan a ɛkari pɛ na kwan bɛn so na ɛka nna mu apɛwmuden ho ?
answer_twi_source: Aduan a ɛkari pɛ yɛ nea ɛma wunya aduannuru a ɛho hia, a carbohydrates, protein, srade, vitamin, ne minerals ka ho, wɔ dodow a ɛfata mu na ama woanya akwahosan na aboa nipadua no dwumadi ahorow.Sɛ wodi aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, ne protein a ɛnyɛ den pii wom a, ɛma wo nipadua nya aduannuru a ehia na ama woanya nna mu nkɔso ne dwumadi a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi atipɛnfo nhyɛso so na wɔakura wɔn adwene yiyedi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodie a Wɔabue Mu: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa atipɛnfo nkitahodi, nkate, ne nsɛnnennen ho nkuran, na ma aso a etie a ɛnyɛ atɛn. Fa Akwankyerɛ Ma: Fa akwankyerɛ, afotu, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so di atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow ho dwuma yiye na wosisi gyinae a ɛfata ma. Hyɛ Wo Ho Nidi Ho Nkɔso: Hyɛ wo ho adwene pa ne obu a wubenya wɔ wo ho denam ahoɔden, nneɛma a woatumi ayɛ, ne su soronko a wubegye atom no so. Model Healthy Behavior: Fa nhwɛso di anim denam akwan a ɛfata a wobɛfa so agyina ano, ahokokwaw a wode bɛka wo ho denneennen, ne nkitahodi a obu wom a wobɛda no adi wɔ w’ankasa nkitahodi mu no so. Fa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Ma: Ma wo kwan ma wonya nneɛma te sɛ nhoma, nsɛm, anaa adwumayɛfo mmoa adwuma ma wonya nsɛm foforo ne mmoa a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne adwenemyare ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asua pii afa akwahosan ho hokwan ne asɛde ahorow a mewɔ sɛ ɔbabun no ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asua pii afa w’akwahosan hokwan ne w’asɛyɛde ahorow ho denam: Nsɛm a wubebisa na woahwehwɛ nsɛm afi w’akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo hɔ no so. Nhomasua nneɛma a akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa Intanɛt so mmeae a agye din de ma a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu. Akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, anaa sukuu afotufo a wo ne wɔn besusuw ho. Akwahosan ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun ho a wobehu no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetra mu nneɛma bi te sɛ aduan a wodi, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, a ebetumi aka ɛnanom akwahosan so nsusuaso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Asetra kwan so nneɛma di dwuma titiriw wɔ ɛnanom akwahosan mu: Aduandi: Aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow nnuane, ne nea broni ka no 'protein' pii senea wobenya nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom. Sɛ wɔ twa nnuan a ɛnyɛ ne anonne a asikre wom dodo a, ɛboa ma wo mu duru kɔ so yɛ kɛse sɛnea ɛsɛ. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔyɛ no daa a ɛkɔ fam bere a wɔyem no betumi ama akwahosan atu mpɔn na atew asiane a ɛwɔ nyisɛn mu sɛ wobenya ɔhaw ahorow no so. Mpɛn pii no, dwumadi ahorow te sɛ nantew, asuguare, ne 'yoga' a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo no yɛ nea asiane biara nni ho. Nnuru a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Nsã, tawa, ne nnubɔne a wɔde gye wɔn ani a wɔbɛtwa woho efiri mu bere a wɔyem no ho hia. Saa nneɛma yi betumi apira nea onyinsɛn no ne akokoaa no nyinaa. Sɛ wɔrepere wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ mmoa fi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa akuw a wɔboa wɔn hɔ. Mmabun betumi adi saa nneɛma yi ho dwuma denam: Wɔn a wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkasa afa nyinsɛn mu aduan pa ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ahobammɔ wom ho. Kwati sigaretnom, nsa, ne nnubɔnenom, ne mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ na sɛ ɛho hia a, woagyae. Adesua ahorow a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asetra kwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔpaw wɔ nyinsɛn mu ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahotoso ne ka a mepɛ sɛ megyina mfɛfo nhyɛso ano a mente nka sɛ meyɛ fɛre anaasɛ metew me ho?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho si so dua: Kae wo ho w’ahoɔden, wo gyinapɛn ahorow, ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wudi wo ho nokware. Dwumadi a wɔde di dwuma: Fa w’adamfo anaa w’abusua muni bi a wowɔ mu ahotoso sua sɛnea wɔde mmuae a ɛyɛ den ma wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow ho. Fa botae nketenkete sisi w’ani so: Fa nkakrankakra twa wo ho mpoa sɛ si w’ahye so dua wɔ tebea horow a ɛnyɛ den mu, na bere kɔ so no, nya ahotoso. Susuw nkonimdi ahorow a atwam ho: Kae nsɛm a esisii a wutumi gyinaa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ano, na ɛhyɛɛ tumi a wutumi si gyinae ahorow a wode wo ho no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmpɛn sɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun kɔhwɛ wɔn awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nsɔhwɛ a ɛte saa no taa gyina ankorankorɔ so esansɛ obia ahiasɛm yɛ soronko. Nanso dɔktafoɔ taa hwɛ sɛ, obia betu da kor wɔ afe bia mu akɔyɛ 'checkup'. Saa nsɔhwɛ yi hwɛ sɛ biribi atɔkyema wɔ nipadua ne mu anaa?
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkonimdi ho nsɛm ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nnwuma a ɛwɔ fam, ɔsatu ahorow, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim de ko tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm a epira na wɔhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetra mu nsakrae ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nnwuma a ɛwɔ fam, ɔsatuo, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim de ko tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a epira na wɔhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetena mu nsakraeɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ne: mmofra kasakuo ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim a ɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ video, blog so nsɛm, ne  Abɛɛfo ntentan ɔsatuo de di nsɛm te sɛ nipadua mfonini, adwenemyareɛ, ne pene a wɔpene so ho dwuma. #MediaWeLike, Abɛɛfo ntenta ɔsatu a mmabunuo kyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ ahorow ahorow, nnipa nyinaa a wɔka ho, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nhwɛso ahorow. Adesuakuwfo a w'akyerɛ kuw bi a ɛwɔ sukuu mu a wɔyɛ sini a wɔde kyerɛ, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ bagua mu, ne nhyiam ahorow de hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran wɔ asuafo mu. Youth Advocates for Change, mmabun a wɔyɛ adwumaden a wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe mu na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ nnwuma mu de adi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nneyɛe a epira ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ mmabun ho gyinabea pa ho nkuran wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi kyerɛ sɛnea mmabun betumi aboaboa wɔn adebɔ, wɔn anigye, ne dijitaal nimdeɛ ano de akasa atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nsɛm a epira, ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ anya nkɔso, na wɔakamfo asetra mu nsakrae wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na sukuu ne mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ adwuma abom ama sexual health (nna mu apomuden pa) nkyerɛkyerɛ adi mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahodoɔ betumi: Ne mpɔtam kuo ne ayaresabea ayɛ nkabom. Wɔbɛto ato nsa afrɛ 'experts' (nimdefoɔ) ma wɔabɛkasa. Wɔbɛhyeyɛ 'field trips' (nsrahwɛ) anaa 'internships' (som-adesu nnwuma) ama asuafoɔ. Wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nsusuadeɛ (surveys) de anya nsɛm firi sukuufoɔ, mmusua, ne mpɔtamfoɔ hɔ wɔ SRH nsɛm titire (priorities) ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Wɔbɛdɔm kuo kɛseɛ a ɛko ama nkyerɛkyerɛ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa apɔmuden ho haw ahorow te sɛ ɔyaredɔm anaa yare a ɛtrɛw  no nya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awo ho apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun no so nsusuansoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wiase Nyinaa Akwaahosan Ho Nsunsuanso: Nnwuma a Wɔsɛe no: Wɔ ɔyaredɔm anaa akwaahosan ho haw mu no, wobetumi adan nneɛma ne adwene afi nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma so. Nnipa a wɔatoto mu ne anohyeto ahorow betumi asiw ayaresabea ahorow, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma no ano. Nsakraeɛ a ɛkɔ Intanɛ so: Ebia nsakraeɛ bɛba akɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so, a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ mfasoɔ nanso ɛbɛtumi nso ayi wɔn a wɔnni intanɛt afiri mu. Mmerewa a Ɛkɔ Anim: Ebia mmabun betumi ahyia mmerɛwyɛ a ɛkɔ soro wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ho wɔ ɔhaw bere mu. Akwan a Wɔfa so Dwuma: Nnwuma a Wɔbɛsakra: Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no betumi ayɛ nsakrae denam aduruyɛ a wɔde ma wɔ akyirikyiri a wɔde bɛma de abisabisa nkurɔfo, intanɛt so nneɛma, ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so no so. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa nnipa ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn betumi akɔ so, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ da so ara nya nnwuma. Ɔmanfo Akwahosan Ho Nkrasɛm: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ɔsatu ahorow no de nna ho akwahosan ho nkrasɛm ka ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmabun amanneɛ ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔhaw ahorow aba no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi ama mmaabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ katee, abɛɛfo ntentan ɔman mma a wɔwɔ abrabɔ pa, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔwɔ asɛyɛde a wɔboa wɔn mpɔtam ne ɔmanfo yiye?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ katee, abɛɛfo ɔman mma a wɔwɔ abrabɔ pa, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ asɛyɛde a wɔboa wɔn mpɔtam ne ɔmanfo yiye denam: Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔayɛ nsɛmmisa, nhwehwɛmu, na wɔasusuw nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm, fibea, ne gyinabea ahorow ho, na wɔasusuw asetena, amammerɛ, ne abrabɔ pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm nya wɔ wɔn ankasa ne afoforo ho no so. Hokwan a wɔbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adebɔ, nneɛma a wɔyɛ, ne nkyekyɛmu dwumadi ahorow mu, te sɛ abɛɛfo ntetan nneɛma a wɔyɛ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne wɔn adwene, wɔn adwene ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔde bɛma atiefo a wɔdɔɔso. Mmabun a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔanya abɛɛfo ntentan akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ, te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔsɛe no, nneɛma a wɔyɛ, intanɛt so adwumayɛ, ne abɛɛfo ntetan dwumadi, ne boa a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔafa abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntetan mmeae ahorow so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, abɛɛfo ntetan ɔman ba, ne asetena mu asɛyɛde ho nkuran, na wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nni dwuma mfa nkamfo asetena mu atɛntrenee, pɛyɛ, ne asetena mu nsakrae pa wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne ɔmanfo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhaw a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so no betumi aboa ma wɔadi nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade, anaa nyiyim a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadi no betumi adi saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma denam: Afotu ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no so. Nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde ko tia ayayade a wɔde bedi dwuma. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase de ahyɛ obu ne nkabom ho nkuran. Ntetee a wɔde bɛma adwumayɛfoɔ ne asuafoɔ wɔ ayayadeɛ ne nyiyim a wɔbɛhunu na wɔadi ho dwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na awofoɔ bɛtumi aboa ama dawurubɔ ho nimdei ho nnwoma   adesua akyerɛkyerɛ akɔ sɔ wɔ sukuu mu, amanfoɔ mu, ne mmabun abɔdeɛ mu, de ahwɛ yie sɛ  wɔn a wɔresi sɔ bɛnya mmoa emu dɔ ne akwankyerɛ a adi mũ wɔ intanɛt so ho nsɛmnsɛm  a ɛka afofro?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ bɛtumi aka wɔn ho abɔ mu de akyerɛkyerɛ nnipa nnwoma adesua wɔ skuul mu, amanfoɔ mu, ne mmabun akuw mu, na wɔahwɛ yie sɛ mmabun bɛnya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ nsɛm a wɔka fa intanɛt so nsɛm ho. Yɛne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, skuul so hwɛfoɔ, din nnipa, akofoɔ, akwankyerɛfoɔ, mpɔtam so nipa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mmara hyɛfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma bom de akyerɛkyerɛ nnipa nnwoma adesua ho mfasoɔ ne nneɛma a ɛho hia a adi mũ. Wɔbɛka wɔn ho abɔ mu wɔ nnwuma ahorow mu, amanfoɔ mu nhyiam mu, ne mpubaa mu nhyiam mu de akyerɛkyerɛ nnipa nnwoma ho mmara, sika deɛ a wɔbɛma ama adesua ho nnwuma, ne adesua botaeɛ foforo mu. Wɔbɛboa nnipa nnwoma ho akuw, mmabun akuw, ne nnwuma foforo a wɔka bom de kyerɛkyerɛ nnipa nnwoma mu, de boa mmabun ma wɔanya nimdeɛ, nneɛma, ne mmoa a ɛho hia. Yɛne sukuufoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ akuw bɛyɛ adwuma bom de aka nnipa nnwoma adesua ho nsɛm ne nea wɔde yɛ adwuma abata adesua nhyehyɛeɛ, ahomegyeɛ dwumadie, ne mmabun nkɔsoɔ ho dwumadie ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw ho, na yɛama akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mmabun akannifoɔ, ne awofoɔ mmoa ne nteteeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa akuo anaa abɛɛfo ntetaan so mpɔtamu wɔ hɔ ma LGBTQ+ mmaabun a wɔbɛka nna mu apomoden ho nsɛmti ho asɛm? (ahintasɛm a wɔde bɛboa atipɛnfo) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ama tebea a ɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wɔn nneyɛe mu no akwaaba na ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛma ɔyaresafo bi yɛ obi a ɔgye dɛmfoɔ na ɔhwɛ wɔn yiye ne sɛ: Adan ne Mpɔtam a Wɔtumi Kɔ Mu: Hwɛ sɛ dɛmfoɔ bɛtumi akɔ ayaresabea hɔ a ɔnyɛ den, sɛ ɛnam akwan a wɔayɛ ama mmifia (ramps), mfiri a a wɔde foro abansoro, ne nneɛma a wɔasiesie wɔ aguarebia mu a dɛmfoɔ bɛtumi de adi dwuma. Nkitahodi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtete wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no wɔ nkitahodi a emu da hɔ mu na wobisa sɛ wuhia mfiri biara a ɛboa te sɛ mum kasa asekyerɛfo anaa. Obu a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Ɛsɛ sɛ adwumayɛfo no de nidi ne obu di wo, na wodi wo haw ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ  mpɔtam kuo a wɔn botae ne sɛ wobedi nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ  mpɔtam kuo  a wɔn botae ne sɛ wobedi nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma mu denam ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde nnwuma a ɛtete saa ma a wobetu wɔn ho ama no so. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo a wɔde wɔn adwene asi nna mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn atipɛnfo so. Bio nso, mmabun betumi akɔka mmabun afotufo bagua ahorow ho, aboa ma wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ayɛ, anaasɛ wɔayɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe de ama nkurɔfo ate nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ayaresabea a woyi nyinsɛn gu a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan a ɛbɛn me? (kyerɛ wɔn kwan kɔ mmeae a agye din te sɛ Planned Parenthood anaa ɔman akwahosan dwumadibea wɛbsaet ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wode ayaresabea a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan a woyi nyinsɛn gu bedi dwuma. Nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wo ma woanya bi ni: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): Wɔbɛtumi de nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ ayaresabea a ahotɔ ne mmara kwan so a wɔyi nyinsɛn gu no ama. Frɛ wɔn mmoa telefon no kokoam wɔ 0244312151 (Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8am-5pm). Mariestopes Ghana ma mmara kwan so a woyi nyinsɛn gu ho adwumayɛbea. Ɔmanfoɔ akwaahosan asoɛeɛ de nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho dwumadie ma, kɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa mmabun adamfofa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ nkyɛn ma ɔne wo nni nkitaho Eyi yɛ gyinaesie a ɛyɛ den, na ɛnyɛ wo nko ara. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ anaasɛ biribi hyɛ me so bere a yɛrebɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa asɛmti bi a ɛho hia ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ woayɛ basaa bere a worebɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no, nanso ɛho hia sɛ wodi saa atenka ahorow yi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ so. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, home yie na kae wo ho sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobegyina nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu kakra na woasan akɔ so akyiri yi bere a wote nka sɛ woasiesie wo ho kɛse no. Susu ho sɛ wobɛda wo nkate adi akyerɛ w’awofo wɔ odwo ne obu mu, na woasi so dua sɛ wuhia bere kakra na wode adi nsɛm anaa nkate horow no ho dwuma. Sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotosoɔ hɔ na waboa wo ma woafa wo atenka ne wo haw ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi de nhwɛso ahorow a ɛfa gyinaesi tebea horow anaa nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu a mmabun betumi de gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow adi dwuma de asusuw nea ebetumi afi wɔn nneyɛe mu aba, te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, anaa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwanbɔne so, wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow adi dwuma wɔ tebea horow a mmabun fa atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ho no mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Tebea 1: Nnamfo kuw bi hyɛ wo sɛ fa wo ho hyɛ nna mu a wommɔ ho ban. Sɛ wode gyinaesi nhyehyɛe di dwuma a, wubetumi asusuw nea ebetumi afi mu aba, te sɛ asiane a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa anaa nyinsɛn a wonhyɛ da mu, asusuw mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ akwan horow a wobɛfa so (sɛ nhwɛso no, wosi so dua sɛ wode ahobammɔ bedi dwuma anaasɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi nna mu dwumadi ho), na woapaw nea ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a ɛho hia wo titiriw hyia. Tebea 2: W’atipɛnfo hyɛ wo nkuran sɛ sɔ nnubɔne anaa nsa nsɔ hwɛ wɔ apontow ase. Gyinaesi nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma so, asusuw w’ankasa gyinapɛn ne botae ahorow ho, na woasi gyinae a wode w’akwahosan ne w’apomoden di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na awofoɔ, anaa ahwɛfoɔ betumi ayɛ de aboa mmabun a ebia wobehyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden mu mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, ne ahwɛfoɔ wɔn no betumi de atenka fam mmoa ama, ahyɛ nkitahodie a ɛmu da hɔ ho nkuran, na wɔakamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔn mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a obuo wom na wɔmfa mmu wɔn atɛn. Wobetumi nso akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho afa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔakasa atia animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛwɔ wɔn ankasa mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi ntawntawdi a ɛda wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ne nea wɔn amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akuw de hyɛ wɔn so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ntam no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii/nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ katee. Hwehwɛ info fi mmeae a wogye di. Kamfo hokwan ahorow/ahofadi bere a wobu mpɔtam hɔfo. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi afotufo/akannifo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ amammerɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu, adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodie ahorow mu de ahyɛ ntease, tema, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho nkuran, na wɔama mmabun tumi na wɔadi dwuma denneennen wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ne ahobammɔ ne obu a wɔde ma obiara no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho no ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, adwenemyareɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ mu de ahyɛ nteaseɛ, tema, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho nkuran denam: Akwan a Wɔde Amanneɛbɔ a Ɛfa Adwennwene Ho a Wɔde Bɛka Ho: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm bɛma de aboa mmabun ma wɔate nkɛntɛnsoɔ a nna mu basabasayɛ nya wɔ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ase na wɔanya tema ne atenka wɔ wɔn nkitahodiɛ mu. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa a Wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo ne nkitahodiɛ a mmabun bɛtumi akyɛ wɔn suahunu, ahwehwɛ afotuo, na wɔanya adansedie ne mmoa afiri wɔn atipɛnfoɔ hɔ wɔ baabi a ahobanbɔ ne kokoamsɛm wɔ mu. Nkonimdie a Wɔbɛhyɛ Ho Nkɔsoɔ: Dwumadie a ɛma ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho a wɔde bɛma de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya akwan a ɛfata a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano na wɔadi nkateɛ mu nsɛnnennen a ɛbata nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛeɛ ho no ho dwuma. Nneɛma a Wotumi Nya a Wɔde Ma: Hwɛ sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nneɛma, ne mmoa dwumadie no yɛ nea wotumi nya, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho de di mmabun a wɔfiri mmusua ne wɔn nipasu ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nhwehwɛdeɛ ano sɛ dɛmdifoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Fa w'apɔwmuden di kan. Hwehwɛ mmeammea a wɔgye wo tom. Kasa kyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wogye wɔn di (nnamfofoɔ, abusua anaa akyerɛkyerɛfo). Wo anigyeɛ ho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde anaa nnwumakuw pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a, wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ dabere ne adan a wɔde ma mmabun mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow ne nnwumakuw bi wɔ hɔ a, wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ dabere ne adan ho nnwuma a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu no mu. Mmabun betumi ahu wɔn wɔ: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma ahorow, databea ahorow, anaa nneɛma a wɔakyerɛw mpɔtam hɔ dabere, mmabun adwumayɛbea, ne adan ho mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow din so. Ɔman anaa ɔmantam ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne wɔn di nkitaho no twee adwene sii mmabun yiyedi, afie a wonni ano a wosiw ano, anaa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ so de hwehwɛɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn ne nsɛm. Nyansahyɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di, mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, anaa asetena mu nnwuma ho adwumayɛfo a wonim nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho bere a wɔrekyekyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔayɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no kɔma ɔmanfo anaa nhyehyɛeyɛfo no?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho bere a wɔrekyekyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho akyerɛ ɔmanfo anaa nhyehyɛeyɛfo no bi ne: Hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛda adi pefee, na wobu akontaa wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu ho amanneɛbɔ mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobegye anohyeto ahorow ne animhwɛ a ebetumi aba wɔ nhwehwɛmu akwan horow mu atom. Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no kokoamsɛm ne kokoam hokwan ahorow a wobedi denam nea broni ka no 'data' a wobeyi afi hɔ na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm a ɛho hia anaasɛ wotumi hu wɔn ankasa adi a wɔmmpene so no so. Nhwehwɛmu mu nsɛm a wɔde bɛka ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a emu da hɔ, ɛyɛ mmerɛw, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma adwene ahorow na ɛtew animtiaabu anaa nyiyim so. Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛfa ho, a mmabun, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ka ho, a wɔbɛdi nkitaho, de ayɛ nkɔmmɔdie a nteaseɛ wom ne gyinaesie a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ a egyina nhwehwɛmu adanseɛ so. Pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔkyekyɛ mu, hwɛ hu sɛ nea wɔahu no boa ma asetra mu nsakrae pa ba na di nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu wɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atoro anaa adwen aa eni mu bɛn na ɛwɔ mmaa yareɛ mmoa ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbɛtumi adi ho dwuma denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nimdeɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Atoro ne nea adwene a ɛnnim a ɛfa mmaa yareɛ mmoa ho betumi ayɛ: Atoro: Mmaa yareɛ nhwehwɛmu yɛ yaw anaa ɛnyɛ dwoodwoo bere nyinaa. Nokware: Ɛwom sɛ ebia wonti nka kakra de, nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ yaw kɛse. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ a wo ne w’apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ bɛkɔ so betumi aboa ma wɔadi dadwen ho dwuma na wɔate ehu so. Atoro: Nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu nko ara na wɔhia mmaa yareɛ mmoa. Nokware: Mmaa yareɛ mmoa ho hia ma obiara a ɔwɔ awoɔ mu akwaa, sɛ wɔne obi da anaa wɔne obi nna mpo a. Ɛka awoɔ mu ne apɔmuden afa horow nyinaa ho. Atoro: Mmaa yareɛ haw bɛkɔ a enhia ayaresa. Nokware: Mmaa yareɛ tebea bi hwehwɛ adɔketafoɔ mmoa na wɔahunu nea ɛwɔ hɔ na wɔasa. Sɛ wobu w’ani gu sɛnkyerɛnne so a, ebetumi de nsɛnnennen aba. Sɛnea wɔbɛdi adwene bɔne yi ho dwuma ne: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛma afa mmaa yareɛ mmoa ho denam nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nhyiam, ne intanɛt so nneɛma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ntam de atu atoro ase na wɔama nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam de ama awoɔ mu apɔmuden nteaseɛ atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi asasesin mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe no so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi asasesin mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe no so, a nea ɛka ho ne: akwantu ho mmoa nhyehyɛe anaa nnwuma a mpɔtam hɔ aban ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, anaa akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow de ma. Mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde sika a wɔde tua ho ka a ɛkɔ fam, nnwuma a wɔtew ka so, anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow ma wɔn a wohia mmoa. Mmebun ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔbɛtumi de mmoa, nneɛma, ne nsɛm a ɛfa akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ho bɛma. Lɔɔre ho nhyehyɛe anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina atuhoamafo so a ɛma wɔde kar kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ma mmabun a wonni kar.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwehwɛmu akwan horow a wafa so ayɛ efa amammerɛ mu nhwehwemu a ɛfata adesua fa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ho nhwɛso ahorow bi?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔfa so sua ASRH nsɛm a ɛfa amammerɛ ho no bi ne: Mfonini a yɛde ka asɛm 'Photovoice': Nhwehwɛmu kwan a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no tumi kyere na wɔkyɛ wɔn suahunu a wɔatena ase denam mfoninitwa so, na ɛma wɔtumi de aniwa gyina hɔ ma wɔn adwene ne nneɛma a ɛhia titire a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho wɔ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Mpɔtam hɔ mfoniniyɛ: Nhwehwɛmu kwan a ɛfa su pa ho a ɛfa sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahunu na wɔde aniwa akyerɛ nneɛma, akwansideɛ, ne agyapadeɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ tebea mu, na ɛma nhumu a ɛsom boɔ ma dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyekyɛ. Asɛm a wɔka ne asɛm a wɔka fa asɛm no mu: Nhwehwɛmu akwan a ɛfa su pa ho a ɛtwe adwene si mmabun asɛm ne osuahu ahorow a wɔatra ase so, na ɛma wotumi kyɛ wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn adwene wɔ ASRH ho wɔ akwan a ntease wom wɔ amammerɛ mu na ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ho so, bere a ɛsan nso hyɛ tumi ne wɔn ho a wɔda no adi ho nkuran. Nhwehwɛmu ne nsenia a wɔayɛ no amammerɛ mu: Nhwehwɛmu nnwinnadeɛ dodoɔ a wɔayɛ mu nsakraeɛ anaa wɔagye atom sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ amammerɛ tebea pɔtee bi mu, a ɛhwɛ sɛ nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde boaboa nsɛm ano no fata kasa mu, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ho ma nnipa dodoɔ a wɔresua ho adeɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de me ho ahyɛ mpɔtam asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow mu sɛ ɔbabun, na dwumadi bɛn na metumi adi wɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a mɛboa mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun no, wubetumi de wo ho ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ akwan horow so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Atuhoama: Fa wo bere ne w’ahokokwaw ma de boa asɛnka dwumadi ahorow te sɛ nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wobɛkyekyɛ, anaa atipɛnfo mmoa a wode bɛma. Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ: Fa wo ho hyɛ ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na woabɛyɛ atipɛnfo kyerɛkyerɛfo na boa ma kyerɛkyerɛ w’atipɛnfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔsatu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde gyina akyi a wɔde wɔn adwene si awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛkamfo ho. Mmabun akannifoɔ: Fa akannifoɔ dwumadie wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ, mmabun agyinatukuo, anaa afotuo bagua mu de nya nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu so nkɛntɛnsoɔ. Adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔka: Fa adwinni, nnwom, akyerɛw, anaa dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu awo akwahosan ho nsɛm na fa mmabun afoforo bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Ɛnam sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ mu nti, wobɛtumi aboa ama nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ pa a ɛbɛba wo ho ne w’atipɛnfoɔ anya nkɔsoɔ berɛ a worenya ahokokwaa ne osuahu a ɛsom boɔ wɔ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ne akanni mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu, de tema, agye atom, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma, na wɔaboa ma wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no te nka sɛ wɔate wɔn asɛm, wogye di, na wobu wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu denam: Tema a Wɔde Ma: Atie a tema wɔm a wɔde bɛma, agyetom, ne nkate fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔremmu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔmfa asodi nto wɔn so. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no hokwan ahorow, nneɛma a wobenya, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔaboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no ho kamfo. Ahobammɔ Beae a Wɔbɛbɔ: Mmeae a ahobanbɔ ne mmoa a wɔbɛbɔ na wɔahwɛ so a wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no te nka sɛ wɔate wɔn asɛm, wogye di, na wobu wɔn, ne baabi a wobetumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa anaa nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na matumi akasa atia me ho asɛmmɔne "negative self-talk", m’adwenem naayɛ, anaa gyidi ahorow a ɛwɔ me mu a ebetumi asɛe me ka a meyɛ den ne ahotoso a mewɔ sɛ megyina m’ankasa me ho na masi gyinae a tumi wom no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ wobehu wɔn ho nsɛmmɔne "negative self-talk" ne wɔn ho adwenem naayɛ a wobehu na wɔakasa atia no ho hia na ama wɔakɔ so ayɛ katee. Fi ase denam wo mu nkɔmmɔbɔ a wubehu na woahyɛ bere a nsusuwii bɔne sɔre no nsow so. Twa saa nsusuwii ahorow yi mpoa denam ne mudi mu a wubegye ho kyim na wode nsɛm a eye na ɛma tumi kɛse a wɔde si so dua besi ananmu no so. Kae sɛ ka a wobɛka no denneennen no fa wo ho a wubegye adi na woagyina w’ankasa akyi ho, enti ahotoso a wubenya wɔ wo ho ne ayamhyehye a wubenya wɔ wo ho no yɛ ade titiriw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ sɛ mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ ASRR ho no yɛ nea wotumi de ho to wɔn so na wɔde nnwuma bɛma wɔ kokoamsɛm ne obuo kwan so? (Abisade a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne nnwumakuo ahorow ho)
answer_twi_source: Ansa na wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu no, hwɛ hu sɛ wotumi de wo ho to dwumakuo no so. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Ahintasɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe: Bisa wɔn nhyehyɛe a ɛfa wo nsɛm a wode besie ho. Ahwehwɛde: Bisa ntetee ne osuahu a adwumayɛfo a wɔde nnwuma ma no wɔ ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmara mu afotu anaa ananmusifo sɛ migye di sɛ wɔabu me hokwan ahorow so wɔ nna anaa awo akwahosan ho asɛm mu a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wogye di sɛ wɔabu wo hokwan ahorow so wɔ nna anaa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu a, wubetumi afa akwan horow pii so anya mmara mu afotu anaa ananmusifo: Mmara kwan so mmoa nnwumakuo ahorow, akuw a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, anaa mmara adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔmfa hwee nto mu betumi de mmara kwan so mmoa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ama ankorankoro a wohyia nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow, nyiyim, anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho. Akwankyerɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, a wobetumi de mmoa ama na wɔde wo ne mmara kwan so nneɛma anaa adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho mmara mu no abɔ. Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde nsɛm, nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔma afoforo, anaa mmoa ma wɔ mmara mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho a wobɛkɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsakrae bɛn na ɛba mmabun nipadua mu wɔ nna mu nkɔso (sexual development) mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabaa betumi ahu wɔn nufu a enyin, wɔn asen mu bɛtrɛw, na wɔafi ase akɔ brayɛ mu. Ebia mmarimaa behu sɛ wɔreyɛ tenten, wɔn ntini nyin, wɔn nne mu dɔ, na wɔn awotwaa nyin. Nsakrae a ɛba nkwaadɔm mu no nso betumi ama pimples ne nipadua hua a ɛda nsow aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka me nna ho akɔnnɔ ne/anaasɛ me bɔbeasu ho asɛm akyerɛ ɔhokafo (hokafo)?
answer_twi_source: Gye wo bere na te nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo bere a woasiesie wo ho no. Paw bere ne beae a ɛfata: Hwehwɛ kokoam bere bi a wubetumi akasa pefee na woadi nokware. Ma emu nna hɔ na tẽẽ: Wubetumi aka biribi te sɛ, "M'ani gye [mmarima/mmea/abien/ne nea ɛkeka ho]" anaa "Mekyerɛ sɛ meyɛ [nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+.]" kɛkɛ. Ka kyerɛ sɛ wubebua nsɛmmisa: Ebia wo hokafo no bɛpɛ sɛ ohu nneɛma pii na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔte ase pii. Bue w’ani ma nsɛmmisa ho mmuae wɔ obu mu. Bu sɛnea wɔyɛ wɔn ade: Ɛsono sɛnea obiara yɛ n’ade. Ebia ebinom regye atom, na afoforo nso adwene atu afra anaasɛ wobehia bere de ayɛ nsakrae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma wɛbsaet anaa app ahorow a ɛde afotu a ɛfa sɛnea wobɛhwɛ wo ho, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, anaa adwene mu apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ma.
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet ahorow: National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI): https://www.nami.org/ (adwene mu apɔmuden ho nneɛma) Apps: Kommyɛ (adwendwene ne adwene mu nsusuwii) Headspace (nsusuwii a wɔkyerɛ kwan) Youper (adwene a wɔde di akyi ne nnwinnade a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmu, ne nhwehwɛmu mmɔdenbɔ betumi aboa ma wɔasusuw nkɛntɛnso, mmɔdenbɔ, ne sɛnea sikasɛm nketewa ne nnwuma nketewa nkɔso mu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no, nya wɔ mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso na wɔaboa wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden mu aba no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu, ne nhwehwɛmu mmɔdenbɔ betumi ahwɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔ, mmɔdenbɔ, ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛwɔ sikasɛm nketewa ne nnwuma nketewa nkɔsoɔ mu dwumadie mu denam: Nsunsuansoɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ: Sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛeɛ mu aba wɔ mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden, sikasɛm mu nkabom, ne yiedie a wɔde nhwehwɛmu akwan a ɛfa dodoɔ ne su ho bɛsɔ ahwɛ. Dwumadie no dwumadie a wɔbɛhwɛ so: Dwumadie no dwumadiɛ, nea ɛfiri mu ba, ne nea ɛfiri mu ba a wɔbɛdi akyi de ahwɛ sɛ wɔdi nhyehyɛeɛ no botaeɛ so, ahunu nsɛnnennen, na wɔabɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no mu nsakraeɛ ho amanneɛ. Wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mmabun, wɔn a wɔnya nhyehyɛeɛ no mu mfasoɔ, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ no mu de ahyɛ akontabuo, nnoɔma a ɛda adi, ne adesua ho nkuran wɔ sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ ananmusifo wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, a ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ ananmusifo denam wɔn adwene ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a asɛyɛde wom ho nhwɛso pa a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn  so, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nimdeɛ ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔde hyɛ mu no mu. Bio nso, wobetumi aboa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔde nneɛma ahorow, nea ɛka ho, ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ di kan wɔ wɔn gyinabea ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
