question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a wɔ fa so di nipadua mfonini a ɛsakra no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere betumi de nsakrae aba wo nipadua mu a ebia worenhwɛ kwan. Afotu bi a ɛbɛma woanya nipadua mfonini a ɛte apɔw ni: Fa w’adwene si sɛnea wo nipadua te nka ne nea ebetumi ayɛ so, sen sɛ wode w’adwene besi sɛnea ɛte ara kwa. Di nnuan a ahoɔden wom a ɛma wo nipadua nya ahoɔdennuru a ehia na ama ayɛ den. Nya apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa a w’ani gye ho. Fa nnipa a wɔwɔ adwempa a wɔbɛboa wo twa wo ho hyia. Te bere a wode hwɛ mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na beaeɛ a wobi wɔ ne nkuraase ne nkurow akɛse mu atrae nya nsunsuanso wɔ sɛ mmabun wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Beaeɛ a obi wɔ, a nkuraase ne nkurow akɛse mu atrae ka ho, betumi anya mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma so nsunsuanso kɛse. Mmabun a wɔwɔ nkuraase betumi ahyia akwasideɛ te sɛ akwan tenten a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, nnipa a wɔatete wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wonnya, ne amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow, na ɛde nsonsonoe bɛba wɔ akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya mu bere a wɔde toto wɔn mfɛfo a wɔwɔ nkurow akɛse mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmaabun a ebia wɔbɛte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn so wɔ nna ho nkrasɛm ne mfonini ahorow a wohyia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔte nka sɛ nna ho nkrasɛm a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ahyɛ wɔn so anaasɛ wɔahyɛ wɔn so no betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Wobetumi nso anya nneɛma a adwene mu apomoden ho ahyehyɛde ahorow, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, ne mmoa nhama a wɔde ama nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne nna a ahoɔden wom de ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo media a wɔde nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho mfonini a ɛwɔ nneyɛ pa ne nea ɛka obiara ho akyerɛ, sɛ adetɔfo ne sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ media mu nsɛm nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo media a wɔde nneyɛ pa ne nea ɛka ho kɛse a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho akyerɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm di dwuma ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nyinaa. Wobetumi aboa nnwuma a ɛhyɛ ahorow ahorow, pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, ne obuo ho nkuran wɔ media mfoniniyɛ mu, akamfo  amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho adesua wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ, na wɔde wɔn nhyiam ase ama nne ahorow a wɔato wɔn sintidua no ayɛ kɛse na wɔakasa atia nsusuii hunu. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔma wobu akontaa wɔ abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow ho so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea a ɛyɛ asɛde kɛse na ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa ma akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni mmabun mu no so atew, titiriw wɔ nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhyehyeɛ ne nhyehyeɛ bɛtumi aboa ama akwahosan mu nsonsonoeɛ ne pɛyɛ a ɛnni mmabun mu no so ate, titiriw wɔ nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ den mu, denam nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛnya pɛpɛɛpɛ, asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma, ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne nnipa hokwan a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm (emergency contraceptives), na sɛ ɛho hia a, mɛyɛ dɛn anya bi?
answer_twi_source: Emergency contraceptives yɛ nnuro a yɛfa no mmerɛ a nna mu agodie bi akɔ so a ahobammɔ biara nnim, anaa sɛ wɔ mmerɛ a contraceptive a wode di dwuma no annyɛ adwuma (failure). Ebi ne: Emergency Contraceptive Pills (ECPs) a yɛfa no asiane bi nti. Wobenya bi atɔ wɔ nnurotɔnbea (over-the-counter pharmacies) mpo sɛ dɔkta amma wo ho akwankyerɛ mpo. Dwuma adie ne sɛ asi kosua no kwan ma no nnyini, na etwa sɛ wofa no ntɛm soɔ,dɔnhwerew aduanu-nan ne adausɔn-mmienu (3 days after sex) ntam na atumi ayɛ adwuma. Copper Intrauterine Devices (Cu-IUDs) so boa si nyinsɛn ano. Wei yɛde hyɛ ɔbaa no ase wɔ nna nnum ntam. Sɛ wodi nna mu agorɔ a ahobammɔ nnimu a, kɔ pharmacy, hu wo dɔktafoɔ anaa abusau nhyehyɛeɛ yaresabea na wɔ mboa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nsunsuansoɔ na ɛwɔ  mmara mu  sɛ wobɛpue sɛ wɔdi nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ wɔ  abusuabɔ  mu ne awofo hokwan ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛda adi sɛ sɛ wobɛpue sɛ LGBTQ + a, ɛbɛnya mmara mu nsunsuansoɔ ano yɛ denh wɔ onipa no so firi asetena mu tew a wɔayi no afiri nnipa mu kɔsi kyere ne asɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ asɛnnibea ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ mmara so bu wɔ Ghana. Nea ɛne no bɔ abira no, wɔ aman afoforo so no, wobetumi ama ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina awerɛhow anaa adwenemhaw nkate horow ano wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu sɛ awerɛhow anaa abasamtu a wobɛte nka bere ne bere mu no yɛ ade a ɛfata, titiriw wɔ bere a nsakrae pii wɔ mu no mu. Nanso, sɛ saa nkate ahorow yi kɔ so na ɛtwetwe wo da biara da asetra a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa. Akwan bi ni: Wo ne Obi Kasa: Ka wo nkate kyerɛ ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo. Wobetumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama. Kɔ so Yɛ Nna: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa agumadi betumi ama adwene atu mpɔn na ama awerɛhow nkate so atew. Hwehwɛ Nneɛma a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Fa wo ho hyɛ nneɛma a w’ani gye ho mu, te sɛ nneɛma a wode gye w’ani, adwinni, nnwom, anaa bere a wo ne wo nnamfo benya. Fa Hwɛ Wo Ho Di Dwuma: Da sɛnea ɛsɛ, di aduan a ɛkari pɛ, na gye bere de gye w’ahome na hwɛ wo ho. Hwehwɛ Mmoa a Ɛma Oduruyɛfo: Sɛ awerɛhow anaa adwenemhaw ho nkate kɔ so a, susuw ho sɛ wo ne obi a ɔyɛ adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo bɛkasa. Ayaresa anaa afotu betumi ama wɔanya mmoa a ɛsom bo ne akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ hia a ehia sɛ wonya asetra mu abusuabɔ ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ho na wɔma wɔn nkutoo bere na wɔakura adwenem apomuden mu na wɔasiw ɔhyew ano no mu?
answer_twi_source: Bere a asetra mu abusuabɔ ho hia no, ɛho hia saa ara sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ne bere a wɔde ma wɔn nkutoo di kan na ama wɔakura adwenemyare mu na wɔasiw ɔhyew ano. Wobetumi anya saa kari pɛ yi denam anohyeto ahorow a wɔde besi hɔ, wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho dwumadi ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ daa, ne ankorankoro ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nnamfo ne abusuafo no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nipadua ho mfonini a enye betumi aka obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne adwene mu yiyedi wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ho mfonini a enye wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu betumi anya obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne adwene mu yiyedi so nsunsuanso kɛse. Mmabun betumi ate nka sɛ wɔmfata, aniwu, anaa mfaso nni so, na ɛde dadwen, adwenemhaw, adidi mu nneyɛe a ɛnkɔ yiye, ne wɔn ho a wonni mu ahotoso aba. Nipadua ho mfonini a enye nso betumi aboa ma wɔanya akwan a ɛmfata a wɔfa so gyina ano, te sɛ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so anaa nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama m’awofo anaa m’abusuafo de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ me nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho haw ahorow ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de w’awofo anaa w’abusuafo aka ho wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ na wofi nokwaredi mu a wobɛka afa nneɛma a ɛhaw wo ho no so. Da wo hia wɔn mmoa adi na hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wontie a wommu wɔn atɛn. Wubetumi nso de nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa ho ama wɔn na woahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mmoa hwehwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun betumi de 'coping mechanisms' aka wɔn da biara da dwumadi ho de ahyɛ wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe mu den, na aboa wɔn atenka fam akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Eyi betumi ayɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ (exercise), adwene a wɔde si biribi so (mindfulness), adwinni dwumadie ahorow (creative expressions), bere a wɔde bɛtra nnamfo anaa abusua mu adi nkɔmmɔ ne adwumayɛfo mmoa a wobenya bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ me hwɛ ho bere a meresisi nna ho gyinae no?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua mu Ahosiesie 'Physical Readiness': Susuw ho sɛ ebia woasiesie wo ho wɔ nipadua mu ama nna mu dwumadi te sɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne ahobammɔ a wobɛte ase. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ne sɛnea wobɛbrɛ ase ho. Atinka mu Ahosiesie: Dwennwen sɛnea woasiesie wo ho wɔ nkate fam ama abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ho. Susuw sɛnea wote nka wɔ wo hokafo ho ne ahotɔ a wowɔ wɔ wɔn ho no ho. Abusuabɔ mu Nkɔso 'Relationship Dynamics': Hwɛ sɛnea w’abusuabɔ no te yiye, a nkitahodi ne ahotoso ka ho. Wo ne wo hokafo nsusuw wɔn akwanhwɛ ne wɔn ahye ho. Gyidi ne Gyidi: Susuw w’ankasa wo gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no ho. Si gyinae sɛ ebia nea wopaw no ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow hyia na sɛ wo ho tɔ wo wɔ nea ebetumi afi mu aba ho anaa. Atipɛnfo Nhyɛso ne Nkɛntɛnso: Hu atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nea ɔmanfo hwɛ kwan. Gyina nea wote nka sɛ ɛfata wo so si gyinae, na ɛnyɛ nea afoforo hwɛ kwan. Daakye Botae: Susuw sɛnea nna mu dwumadi betumi aka wo daakye botae ahorow, te sɛ nhomasua anaa adwuma ho nhyehyɛe ho. Paw nneɛma bi a ɛboa wo yiyedi a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetrade ho nimdeɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne wɔn ho a wɔde hyɛ wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Ahokokwaw/tumi a wɔde nya adwuma/sika a wobenya. Mfiridwuma/soft/adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ. Ɛma adwumayɛ gua ne sikasɛm mu yiyedi ho akwantu ho nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu no mfa nneɛma ahodoɔ a wɔde si nyisen ano nni dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a wɔka de tae akyi: Nhumu: Ma nkurɔfo nhu hia a nyisen mu ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ho hia ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so ma mmabun. Sesa adwene a ɛnteɛ na di animtiaabu a ɛfa nyisen ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma ho no ho dwuma. Nhomasua Ɔsatu: Yɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ anaa nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe de hyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nyisen ho bammɔ nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma a wobenya ho nkuran. Fa Atumfoɔ Di Dwuma: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ mpayinfoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe no kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nyisen mu ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma: Mmoa akuw: Kɔka anaa yɛ mmoa akuw a wɔkamfo awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow kyerɛ. Ahyehyɛde Ahorow a Wɔnnyɛ Mfaso: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ne nyisen mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo so no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ ASRH nhwehwɛmu no ka nnipa nyinaa ho na egyina mmabun ahorow a wofi nkuraase, nkurow akɛse mu nkuraase, anaa mmusuakuo nketewa mu ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmufoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ ASRH nhwehwɛmu no bɛka mmabun dodoɔ ho na ɛyɛ mmabun dodoɔ ananmusifoɔ denam: Wɔde akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so gye adwumayɛfoɔ bedi dwuma: Nhwehwɛmufoɔ bɛtumi de akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so fa nnipa, te sɛ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn, atipɛnfoɔ a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ, ne nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde atirimpɔw ayɛ, de akɔ mmabun a wɔfiri mmeaeɛ ne mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ nkyɛn. Nhwehwɛmu nnwinnadeɛ a ɛsakra amammerɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsesa nhwehwɛmu nnwinnadeɛ, te sɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛmbisa akwankyerɛ, wɔ amammerɛ mu na wɔkyerɛ aseɛ kɔ mpɔtam hɔ kasa mu na ama wɔate aseɛ na ɛfata ama nnipa ahodoɔ. Mpɔtam hɔ apon ano ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Abusuabɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, awoɔfo, ne apon ano ahwɛfo afoforo benya no betumi ama ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya mmabun a wɔato wɔn sintidua no na ama ahotoso ne kyɛfa a wonya wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi de wɔn din ahyɛ akwahosan ho  nsiakyibaa (insurance) nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, na wɔate wɔn hokwan ahorow, mfaso horow, anohyeto ahorow a wɔde tua ho ka, ne ɛka a efi wɔn kotoku mu no ase?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu akwan: Mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi ahwehwɛ akwahosan ho nsiakibaa (insurance) nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ wɔn mantam mu, de toto sika a wɔde tua ho ka, ɛka a wɔbɔ, wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nkitahodi, ne mfaso ahorow ho de ahu ɔkwan a ɛfata sen biara ma wɔn ahiade. Akwankyerɛ nhyehyɛe: Hyehyɛ nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw wo din no ma, fa nkrataa a ɛho hia ma (sɛ nhwɛso no, adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ onipa, sika a wonya ho adansedi), na fa akwammisa nkrataa no fa intanɛt so nkitahodibea ahorow, mmeae a wɔkyerɛw wɔn din, anaa mpɔtam hɔfo nhyiam ahorow so mena. Te hokwan ne mfasoɔ ase: Hwɛ nsiakyibaa (insurance) nhyehyɛeɛ, asɔremma nwoma, anaa mfasoɔ a wɔaboaboa ano no mu na woate anohyetoɔ a ɛwɔ sika a wɔde tua ho ka, sika a wɔbom tua, sika a wɔtwa, nea wɔayi afiri mu, ahwehwɛdeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ ansa na wɔama tumi krataa, ne akwan a wɔfa so de asɛm kɔdan asɛnnibea wɔ sika a wɔpow ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Hwɛ nsiakyibaa (insurance) adwumayɛfo, akwahosan ho akwankyerɛfo, mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa asetra mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn na woanya akwankyerɛ wɔ sɛnea wobɛfa ɔkwan a wɔfa so kyerɛw wɔn din no so, sɛnea wobɛte nsiakyibaa (insurance) nsɛmfua ase, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobenya ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn apaw ɔkwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Susuw ho hwɛ: Nea etu mpɔn, Nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw, Nea efi mu ba, Asetra kwan, ɛka a wɔbɔ, Awo ho botae ahorow. Wo ne dɔkota nkasa na ama woanya akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mprempren mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ yɛn man anaa yɛn mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Mprempren mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no gu ahorow kɛse, na egyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Mmeae bi wɔ mmara a ɛma kwan ma woyi nyinsɛn gu wɔ tebea horow bi mu, te sɛ nea wɔde bɛbɔ onyinsɛn no nkwa anaa n’akwahosan ho ban, wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa awotwaa mu a ɛnteɛ ho, anaa mmonnaato anaa abusuafo a wɔne no da. Mmeaeɛ afoforo nso wɔ hɔ a, mmara mu yɛ den kɛse na ɛbra nyinsɛn a woyi gu, gye mpo wɔ tebea a ɛyɛ hu kɛse mu ansa. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara ne nhyehyɛe pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneyɛe anaa suban pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a mfɛfo a wɔ wɔ adwempa da no adi a metumi asuasua de ama m’ankasa gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa da obuo adi ma ahyeɛ ne pene a wɔpene so, a ɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfata mu wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu. Suasua wɔn suban a ɛkyerɛ obu no na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wo nneyɛe ne wo gyinapɛn ne wo ahye hyia. Nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee: Atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa de wɔn ho hyɛ nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware mu wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, na ɛma tebea bi a wobetumi aka nsɛmmisa, dadwen, ne osuahu ahorow a wonni atɛn ho nkuran. Fa nnamyɛ tie na da wo nsusuii adi wɔ nokwaredi mu wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahokokwaw te sɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru de adi tebea horow a emu yɛ den a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Bisa nsɛm ne fibea ahorow no yiye, susuw ahotoso, animhwɛ, ne ahotoso ho. Hwehwɛ adwene ahorow ne nsɛm fibea ahorow na ama woanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho ntease a edi mu. Suasua gyinaesi ne kwan a wɔfa so siesie nsɛm (problem-solving) nam nneyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ de kyerɛ sɛdeɛ asɛm bi si (role-playing), nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nsɛm a asi ho (case studies), ne nsɛm a ɛsi wɔ asetena mu ankasa mu. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ berɛ a wuhyia tebea horow a emu yɛ den anaa emu yɛ den a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi de Nea broni ka no 'Social media' akwan adi dwuma de ne mmabun adi nkitaho, de 'SRH' ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, na wɔadi wɔn nsɛmmisa ne wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom na ɛboa so?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a wɔkyekyɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi de Nea broni ka no 'social media platforms' adi dwuma de akyɛ 'SRH' ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, adi nsɛmmisa ne haw a wɔtaa bisa ho dwuma, na wɔahyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa ho nkuran. Nkitahodi nsemmisa&mmuae nhyiamu: Nsɛmmisa ne mmuaeɛ nhyiamu a wɔyɛ no tee anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu a wɔyɛ no ma mmabun tumi bisa nsɛm a wɔmmɔ wɔn din na wɔnya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ankasa firi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ hɔ. Digyitaal ajorow ɔsatuo: Digyitaal ahorow ɔsatuo a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ ne nkitahodiɛ te sɛ wɔ 'YMK' so no, 'GHS' digyital platforms a wɔde bɛma mmabun wɔ social media handles nyinaa so wɔ 'SRH' nsɛmti ho no bɛtumi adu mmabun atiefoɔ dodoɔ bi nkyɛn, ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ase, na wɔahyɛ akwahosan ho nneyɛeɛ pa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho no so wɔ apɔwmuden mu mfaso bi?
answer_twi_source: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho nkutoo ne ɔkwan a etu mpɔn 100% a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ne Nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu ano. Ɛma asiane a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden ho haw a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho no fi hɔ. Wubetumi de w’adwene asi w’abusuabɔ ne w’ankasa wo nkɔso afã afoforo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔyɛ adwuma sɛ, ɔkwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu na wɔboa mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo yɛ ankorankoro a wɔboaboa wɔn ho ano a wɔwɔ osuahu, nsɛnnennen, anaa dadwen a ɛte saa ara na wɔbom de mmoa, nteaseɛ, ne nkuranhyɛ ma. Wɔ ɔhaw mu dwumadie ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun mu no, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa nya baabi a, ahotɔ wɔ sɛ wɔne afoforo a wɔrehyia nsɛm a ɛte saa ara bɛdi nkitaho, akyɛ osuahu ahodoɔ, na wɔanya tema ne adansedie afiri atipɛnfoɔ a wɔbɛtumi ne wɔn aperepereɛ adi nkitaho. Saa akuw yi taa yɛ adwuma sɛ nkate fam mmoa fibea, afotu a mfaso wɔ so, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano, na ɛboa mmabun ma wodi ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ na obu nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ ayarefo? (bisa nyansahyɛ, hwɛ intanɛt so nkyerɛwde ahorow a LGBTQ+ ka ho filters)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana. wɔatete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔde akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛnyɛ nyiyim bɛma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ menya nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu na ɛyɛ nkate a ɛkyerɛ obu ma me gyinapɛn ne me gyidi ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ na woanya nna mu apɔwmuden mu nhwehwɛmu a emu dɔ na obu amammerɛ:Paw Ayaresabea Hwɛfoɔ a Ɔfata: Hwehwɛ ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ a ɔnim nneɛma pii na ɔbu amammerɛ ahorow, gyidi, ne sɛnea nnipa teɛ.Ka Nea Ɛhia Wo Kyerɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea wosusu sɛ ɛyɛ papa, wo gyidie, ne nea wopɛ kyerɛ ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ no mu fann, a amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsɛm biara ka ho.Bisa Nsɛm: Mma w’akyi nnwiri wo sɛ wobɛbisa nsɛm fa nhwehwɛmu no ho, nhwehwɛmu ko a wɔbɛyɛ, ne sɛnea wɔbɛka nhwehwɛmu no aba a wobɛnya no akyerɛ wo.Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wohu sɛ obi mmu wo anaa ɔne wo anni no yie wɔ nhwehwɛmu no mu a, hwehwɛ mmoa firi nnipa a wode wo ho to wɔn so hɔ, te sɛ abusuafoɔ, nnamfo, anaa akuo a wɔgyina ma afoforɔ (advocacy organizations).Ma Wɔn wo Nsusuieeɛ: Ma ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ no anaa aduyɛbea hɔfoɔ no nte sɛnea woahu wo ho wɔ hɔ, na kyerɛ wɔn akwan a wɔbɛfa so atu mpɔn wɔ amammerɛ mu obu ne obu a wɔde ma afoforɔ mu.Denam wo ho a wobɛgyina ama ne nea ɛhia wo a wobɛka kyerɛ wɔn no so no, wobɛtumi ahwɛ na woanya nna mu apɔwmuden mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛbu wo gyidie, ne w’amammerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na adwumawuranom ne nnwuma bɛtumi adi wɔ akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ adwumayɛbea, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so de adi dwuma de ayɛ adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛyɛ pɛ?
answer_twi_source: Adwumawuranom ne nnwumakuo bɛtumi ahyɛ akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ adwumayɛbea denam: Akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ daa de ahunu na wɔadi nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ akatua mu no ho dwuma. Nhwehwɛmu a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ botaeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu, wɔma wɔn dibea, ne akatua ho gyinaesie ho. Ntetee a wɔde bɛma wɔ animhwɛ a wonnim ne nnipa ahorow ahorow ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛma adwuma so ahwɛfo a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu ne wɔn a wosi gyinae. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata abusua tesɛ adwuma nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, awofo akwamma, ne mmofra hwɛ mmoa a wɔde bɛma. Afotuo ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de aboa mmaa ne akuo foforɔ a wɔnni ananmusifoɔ yie adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu anaa mihyia kɔmputa (computer) so ayayade anaa Intanɛt so ayayade a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ? (akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ, hwehwɛ mmoa) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a wotu gu ho ntease: Basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so (GBV) ntease 6. Intanɛt so ayayade ne Intanɛt so ayayade: Intanɛt so ayayade ne intanɛt so ayayade a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho betumi ayɛ yaw na ɛyɛ hu. Nea wubetumi ayɛ ni: Mma Mmuae: Sɛ wo ne osisifo no di nkitaho a, ebetumi ahyɛ wɔn nkuran. Bɔ Ayayade Ho Bɔ: Abɛɛfo Ntentan (Social media): abɛɛfo ntentan dodow no ara wɔ akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ. Bɔ ayayade no ho amanneɛ kɔ asɛnka agua no so na fa screenshots sie sɛ adanse. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa w’adamfo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa mfa nea ɛrekɔ so no ho. Wobetumi de mmoa ama na wɔaboa wo ma woayɛ ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe. Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛbɔ kɔmputa so asisifo ho amanneɛ wɔ Ghana ni: "Ghana National Commission" for "UNESCO" (NATCOM-Ghana): "https://unescoghana.gov.gh/". Ebia wɔwɔ nsɛm a ɛfa kɔmputa so ayayade ho amanneɛbɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so adi ntawntawdi a ɛda wɔn amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow ne wɔn ankasa ahyeɛ ntam no ho dwuma, asi hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so, na wɔne wɔn ahokafo, atipɛnfo, ne abusua mufo adi nkitaho a ahobammɔ wom na obuo wom?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow pii adi dwuma de adi ntawntawdi a ɛda wɔn amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow ne wɔn ankasa ahye ntam no ho dwuma: Wɔn ho a wosusuw ho: Gye bere fa te ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, ahyeɛ, ne amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow ase wɔ adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ ho no ase. Nkitahodi a Wobue: Fi ase ne ahokafo, atipɛnfo, ne abusua mufo bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛyɛ nokware na obu wom a ɛfa ahye, akwanhwɛ, ne amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe ho. Nea woka no borɔfo mu se 'Assertive Skills': Fa nkitahodi akwan a ɛyɛ den di dwuma de da w’ankasa ahye ne nea wopɛ adi wɔ ahotoso ne obu mu. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa mmoa akuw a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne afotu wɔ amammerɛ mu ntawntawdi a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ ho no ho dwumadie mu. Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ obi ho fa hokwan ahorow, pene a wɔpene so ho mmara, ne abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho na ama wasisi gyinae a ɛfata na ɔkamfo ankorankoro ahofadi akyi. Ɔhyeɛ a Wɔde Si Hɔ: Fa ahye a emu da hɔ si hɔ na si hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ mu, na si obu ne ntease a obi wɔ so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi a wɔbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow di ahiade ne ɔhaw soronko a mmabun a wɔte mmeae a wɔboa nnipa, a aguanfo, nnipa a wɔatu afi wɔn man mu, ne nnipa a wotu kɔtra mmeae afoforo ka ho hyia no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu a Wɔapaw a aborɔfo ka no 'Tailored Intervention': Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ mmeae a wɔboa nnipa no susuw mmabun a wɔatu afi wɔn afie mu ahiade pɔtee te sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ahobammɔ a wobenya afi nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ho, ne adwene ne asetram mmoa ho. Amammerɛ mu Nkateɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bu amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne atetesɛm berɛ a wɔde 'ASRH' ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne dwumadie a wɔayɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛfata a ɛfa atutena ho no ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asɛe nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware, anaasɛ wɔayɛ no yiye wɔ aguadi ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi mu na wɔakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee: Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔahwehwɛ aguadi ho dawurubɔ nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mu yiye denam nsusuwii ahorow a ɛwɔ ase, nea ɛkanyan wɔn, ne akwan a wɔfa so de nkrasɛm pɔtee bi ma a wobegye ho kyim no so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ: Nnwinnade a wɔde bɛma mmabun de asɛe nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ wɔayɛ no yiye denam nhomasua ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase so na wɔakasa atia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔwɔ SOGI ananmusifoɔ pa, ne LGBTQ+ akyigyina akuo a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ma.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsiesiei bɛn na metumi de adi dwuma wɔ nea broni ka no 'social media' so de ahwɛ nea ohu me nsɛm no so?
answer_twi_source: nea broni ka no 'Social media platform' ahorow de kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow ma de hwɛ onii a obehu wo nsɛm no so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Profil visibility a wobɛsesa: Tow nea obetumi ahwɛ wo profile anaa nsɛm a wode bɛto gua no ano hye. Nnamfo abisade a wobɛsan ahwɛ mu: Gye adamfofa adesrɛ a efi nnipa a wunim wɔn na wogye wɔn di nkutoo. Ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wobetumi anya ano hye: Tew ankorankoro ho nsɛm dodow a wɔde kyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so na afoforo hu no ano so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awoɔfo, sukuu ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama sikasɛm ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ akyiri akyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔfo, sukuu ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a mmabun nya nkɔso mu. Awoɔfo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ sika a wɔde di dwuma ho nimdeɛ denam ofie nnwuma, sika a wɔde ma ho nhyehyɛe, ne sikasɛm ho gyinaesi ho nkɔmmɔbɔ so. Sukuu ahorow betumi de sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ahyɛ adesua nhyehyɛe no mu denam adesua ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama anaa adesua ahorow a wɔaka abom wɔ adesua ahorow mu so. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, anaa afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow ama de aka nhomasua a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so ho. Mmabun betumi akamfo sikasɛm ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri akyerɛ denam sukuu so ahwɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho so, na wɔasi hia a sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ho hia ma wɔn daakye nkonimdi ne yiyedi so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuo atumi ahyɛ ASRH a wɔde bɛka apɔwmuden ne nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtrɛ mu, te sɛ Nkɔsoɔ a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botaeɛ (SDGs) ne Amansan Apɔwmuden a Wɔkatua (UHC) ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuo betumi akamfo ASRH a wɔde bɛka apɔwmuden ne nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtrɛ te sɛ SDGs ne UHC ho denam abusuabɔ a ɛda nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ne yiedie afã foforɔ a wɔbɛsi so dua so. Saa nkabom yi hwɛ sɛ ASRH nya adwene ne nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ so daa ne amansan apɔwmuden ho dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na ɛde apɔwmuden ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛtu mpɔn ma mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na mmabun bɛyɛ na wɔate aseɛ na wɔadi afoforo ahyeɛ so, a nea ɛka ho ne nsɛm a wɔka ne deɛ wɔnka, pene so nsrɛ, ne sɛ wobɛkwati sɛ wobɛhyɛ anaa woanya afoforo so tumi ma wɔayɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ den ama wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Obu a wɔde ma afoforɔ hyeɛ anaa deɛ wɔmpɛ ho hia pa ara na ama wɔasi nna ho nhyɛsoɔ ne ntia kwan, na ɛboa ma nnamfofa pa ne ayɔnkofa a ahoɔden wom kɔ so. Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi ahu na wɔabu afoforɔ hyeɛ mu denam nneyɛeɛ ne nsɛm a afoforɔ kã so, tie nea wɔn abɔfoɔ pɛ ne deɛ wɔmpɛ yiye, na wɔabisa kwan pefee ansa na wɔayɛ biribiara. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho firi afoforɔ nhyɛsoɔ anaa nnaadaa ho kɔyɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛmma obi nnya ahotoɔ, na mmom wɔde obu ne kwan mma di kan wɔ biribiara a wɔbɛyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammerɛ siw mmabun kwan wɔ SRH mmoa mu titiriw wɔn a wɔfiri kuo ketewa mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔnya. Ɛka ayaresa dwumadi. Ɛde nea broni ka no 'stigma' ne akyiwadeɛ ba. Ɛte mmabun ahofadi so. Ɛma nyiyimu yɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ HIV ano aduru ho nnwuma a wobenya mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow te sɛ nimdeɛ a wonni wɔ nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho, animtiaabu, nyiyim, kokoamsɛm ho haw, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wontumi nnya, amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, ne awofo anaa ɔmanfo a wɔmpene so. Wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma denam nhomasua, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobebu animtiaabu, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyiyim a ɛtaa ba a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so a ebia mmabun behyia?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyim a ɛtaa ba a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so a mmabun betumi ahyia no bi ne: Basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so (te sɛ ofie basabasayɛ anaa nna mu ɔbrasɛe). Nhomasua anaa adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛnyɛ pɛ. Ayɛyɛde a ɛyɛ katee ne ayayade a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so. Anohyeto ahorow a ɛfa awo hokwan ne nea wɔpaw ho. Amammerɛ anaa asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛma ɔbarima ne ɔbea bi di kan sen foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atie a yɛde nsiyɛ di wɔ nkitahodie a etu mpɔn mu, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn anya saa ahokokwaw yi de aboa adwenemyare?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka atie a wɔde nsiyɛ yɛ ho ne sɛ wode w’adwene besi nea ɔfoforo no reka so koraa, ate wɔn nkrasɛm no ase, na woasusuw ho yiye. Saa ahokokwaw yi ho hia ma nkitahodie a etu mpɔn efisɛ ɛda obu adi, ɛma wonya ahotoso, na ɛma wonya tema. Yebetumi anya atie a ɛyɛ nnam denam yɛn ani a yɛbɛkɔ so de yɛn ani ahwɛ, nea yɛate no a yɛbɛka no foforo, na yɛabisa nsɛm a ɛma emu da hɔ de hwɛ hu sɛ yɛte ase no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a m’awofo nnim (a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne mfe a obi adi so)?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm titiriw a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Wɔ Ghana no, wubetumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛbɛn wo a w’awofo nnim efisɛ ɛnyɛ ahyɛde sɛ wobɛnya peneeɛ so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenemyare ho nsɛm te sɛ dadwen anaa adwenemhaw betumi anya nna mu akwahosan ne dwumadi so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Dadwen: Adwennwene betumi ama adwumayɛ ho dadwen aba, .ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛgye w’ahome na woanya nna mu anigye. Suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛpow wɔn anaasɛ wobedi nkogu no betumi ama wɔakwati nna mu nkitahodi. Adwenemhaw: Adwenemhaw betumi atew akɔnnɔ ne nna ho anigye so. Nnuru a wɔde sa adwenemhaw nso betumi aka nna mu dwumadi. Nkɛntɛnso Dadwen ne adwenemhaw nyinaa betumi aka nna ho akɔnnɔ, nkannyan, ne tumi a obi tumi nya nna mu ɔbrasɛe. Nkitahodi ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a wɔne ahokafo nya nso betumi aka
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfe a obi adi ho anohyeto anaa anohyeto bi wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi a menya no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ anohyeto anaa anohyetoɔ a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie mu no gu ahodoɔ gyina dwumadie ko ne mpɔtam hɔ mmara so. Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, mmabun betumi anya hokwan sɛ wɔpene akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa mmabun akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ho no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe betumi ama mmabun atumi agyina ahoɔden ano, anya tema, obu, na wɔaka wɔn nyinaa ho, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔatumi akasa atia mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, nsusuwii hunu, ne nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ma mmabun tumi gyina tebea horow ano, wonya tema, obu, ne wɔn nyinaa ka ho denam gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa pɛyɛ, ahorow ahorow, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ adesua tebea no nyinaa mu no so. Sukuu ahodoɔ bɛtumi de nnwuma te sɛ atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ, akuo a asuafoɔ di anim, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho adi dwuma de ayɛ mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ ne mmoa ama asuafoɔ nyinaa. Adesua nhyehyɛe mu nsɛm si nkitahodi pa, apɔ mu ateneatene a ɛma wonya tema, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔbom siesie ɔhaw ahorow a ɛkasa tia mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, nsusuwii hunu, ne nyiyim so dua. Ɛdenam obu ne nnipa nyinaa ka ho amammerɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran so no, nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma mmabun tumi ma wogye nneɛma ahorow tom, kasa tia ntɛnkyea, na ɛboa ma wɔyɛ mpɔtam a pɛ na wɔwɔ ayamhyehye kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔapo wɔn anaasɛ wɔayi wɔn afi asetra mu no ano wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma wɔakora obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho ne adwene mu yiyedi so?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu Yiyedi: Pow a wobɛpow anaasɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi afoforo ho no betumi ayɛ yaw, nanso ɛho hia sɛ wokae sɛ ɛnkyerɛ sɛnea wosom bo. Mmabun betumi agyina ano denam wɔn ahoɔden a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so, dwumadi ahorow a wɔn ani gye ho a wɔde bedi dwuma, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne wɔn ho mmɔbɔhunnu a wɔde bedi dwuma no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofoɔ betumi afa so ada nneyɛɛ pa adi wɔ amannneɛbɔ fidie so debɛboa bɛhyɛ wɔn mmabun nkuran na watumi atie abɛɛfo ntenten fidie so nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ betumi ada su pa adi ama wɔmma apɛ dwumadie a wodi no wɔ abɛɛfo mfidie so: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnya berɛ ma hwɛtie ne dwumadie a wɔnni no ntentanfidie so nyinaa na wɔsane nso ama woani kɔ daada nkitahodie ho so. Sɛ wɔreda anibue su adi: Kyerɛ obu ne suban pa wɔ ntentanfidie so na woaboa ama ɔdɔ ne tema akɔ so. Sɛ wɔrehwehwɛ ntentanfidie so nsɛm mu yei: Hwehwɛ nsɛm mu ansa na woagye adi anaa sɛ wakyɛ ama afoforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia ɛho behia sɛ mehwehwɛ ayaresa ntɛm anaa ɔgye bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyaw a ɛkɔ so daa anaasɛ emu yɛ den a sɛ obi gye n’ahome anaa onya ofie nnuru a, ɛnkɔ yiye. Ɛhonhon a ɛho mpofirim. Ɔhome a Ɛyɛ Den. Mogyatuo a ennyae bere a wɔde nhyɛso ahyɛ mu simma kakraa bi akyi no. Atiridii a ɛyɛ 100.4°F (38°C) anaa nea ɛboro saa, titiriw sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne afoforo te sɛ ɔfe ka ho. Sɛ wunya akisikuru a, kɔ ayaresabea ntɛm ara. Sɛ obi to n’adwene mu anaasɛ ɔyera wɔ adwendwen mu. Opira a emu yɛ den, te sɛ ti a opira a obi ntumi n hwee anaasɛ nnompe a abubu. Adwene a Ɛfa Sɛ Wokum Wo Ho. Saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi kyerɛ akwahosan ho nsɛm a ebetumi ayɛ aniberesɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn kɔ ayaresabea ntɛm ara. Sɛ wuhyia eyinom mu biara a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a egye ntɛmpɛ anaasɛ wofrɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ ntɛmpɛ so. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so bere nyinaa na ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya afotu ne mmoa nnwuma sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ sɛ me ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no bɛkasa afa nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho a?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Afotufo: Sukuu afotufo betumi de kokoam afotu ne mmoa ama. Wɔatete wɔn ma wɔadi nsɛm ahorow ho dwuma, a nna mu akwahosan ka ho. Mpɔtam Akwahosan Asoɛe: Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow taa de nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ma mmabun. Wubetumi anya afotu a womfa w’awofo nka ho. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Intanɛt so ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow de afotu a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri ma a ɛyɛ kokoamsɛm. Wubetumi ne ɔfotufo bi adi nkitaho denam text, nkɔmmɔbɔ, anaa video so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu. Ntrɛwmu ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Nna mu akwahosan ho nhama de mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔmmɔ din ma. Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA;s Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) de kokoam mmoa ma Wubetumi abisa nsɛm anaa woasusuw nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho a worenda wo ho adi. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Hwehwɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a wubetumi ne afoforo a wohyia nsɛm a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow pii ma wɔmmɔ wɔn din na wɔte ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma nya mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV" ano wɔ wiase mmeae ahorow so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma nya mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV" ano wɔ wiase mmeae ahorow no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛdeɛ a ɛfa nna ne animtiaabuo a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa "STI" ne "HIV" ho no betumi asiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne dwumadie a wɔde siw ano a wɔbɛnya wɔ mpɔtam bi kwan. Asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna mu nneyɛe, ne tumi a ɛkɔ so ho no betumi anya ankorankoro tumi a wɔde di nkitaho wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho ne nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya no so nkɛntɛnso. Sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no betumi asiw akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nhomasua, ne nnwinnade a wɔde siw ano a nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nya ano, na ama nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV" a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe ne akwansideɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano ne nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforo no nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoe ne akwansideɛ wɔ mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabi foforo no nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano no mu esiane nneɛma te sɛ akwantu, kasa mu akwanside, ahotoso a wonni wɔ atumfoɔ mu, ne asetra mu amammerɛ mu akwanside nti. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi eyi ho dwuma no, nhwehwɛmufo betumi de akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho adi dwuma, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ayɛ biako, na wɔde mfiridwuma adi dwuma de aboaboa nsɛm ano, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia bvbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ, na mako ama nsakrae? (ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa) .
answer_twi_source: yɛ nhyehyɛe ma ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ko tia bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) wɔ wo sukuu mu de kamfo nsakrae kyerɛ Mmoa Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Fa wo ho ma ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔreyɛ adwuma de asiw bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) ano. Wɔtaa hia mmoa wɔ nsɛm a esisi, asɛnka, anaa sohyial media mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow bɛn na ɛka ho wɔ nkadom a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo bɛyɛ de ahyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde bɛma mmabun ho nkuran no ho?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛwɔ nkabom a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo nnwumakuo ahorow bɛyɛ mu no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛda adi pefee, wobu akontaa, na ɛne mmabun yiyedi hyia. Ɛsɛ sɛ fekubɔ ahorow de mmabun yiyedi ne tumidi di kan, kwati akasakasa, na wodi abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ obu a wɔde ma nnipa hokwan ahorow, nidi, ne ahofadi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmɔden bɛn na wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ kasa a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na obu wom ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkitahodi mu, a nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de akasa atia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne nsusuwii hunu a epira ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ kasa a ɛka obiara ho na obu wom ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkitahodi mu no bi ne: Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ahu: Ɔsatu ahorow a wobefi ase de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde kasa a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom di dwuma na w'ako animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne nsusuwii hunu a epira a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Ntetee nhyehyeɛ: Nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ wɔ kasa a wɔde di dwuma a ɛka obiara ho, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, ne nkateɛ a ɛfa nnipa ne osuahu ahodoɔ ho. Nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwankyerɛ a ɛhyɛ kasa ne amammerɛ mu ahoɔden a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkitahodiɛ mu wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ, sukuu, ne mpɔtam mu a wɔkamfo kyerɛ. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Ɛne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛbom ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛda adwene ne suahunu ahodoɔ adi, ahwɛ sɛ kasa a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ obuo na ɛka ankorankoro nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa mmabun wɔ wɔn da biara da asetena ne daakye mmɔdenbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ boa mmabun wɔ wɔn da biara da asetena mu denam boa a ɛboa wɔn ma wɔhwɛ wɔn sika so yiye, wosi adetɔ ho gyinae a ɛfata, na wɔkwati sikasɛm mu afiri te sɛ ɛka ne sika a wɔsɛe no boro so. Wɔ bere tenten mu no, sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa ma sikasɛm mu ahotɔ, ahofadi, na asi yiye, na ama mmabun atumi adu wɔn sikasɛm botae ahorow ho, sɛ́ ɛyɛ sika a wɔbɛkora so ama kɔlege, lɔre a wɔbɛtɔ, anaa nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de akɔ pɛnhyen no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa nnamfofa, ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ, ne asetena mu nkɔso ho no kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun adwene ne akwanhwɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ atipɛnfo nkitahodi ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa nnamfofa, ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ, ne asetena mu nkɔso ho no kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun adwene ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ atipɛnfo nkitahodi ho no kɛse. Nnamfofa ne ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ ho mfonini a wɔayɛ no yiye wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no betumi ama wɔanya akwanhwɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware, na ɛde atinka a ɛne sɛ wɔmfata anaasɛ wɔn ani nnye ho wɔ asetra mu abusuabɔ ankasa mu. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nso betumi ama nsusuwii hunu ne "tropes" a ɛfa atipɛnfo nkitahodi ho a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuakuw, anaa nipasu afoforo so akɔ so, na anya sɛnea mmabun hu asetra mu nkɔso na wɔde di dwuma wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw mu no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ne nsɛnnennen bɛn na mmabun hyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ ASRH ho, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hyia akwansideɛ ne nsɛnnennen pii berɛ a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔdie ne gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nsɛm, nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne hokwan a wɔnnya sua sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ ɔkwan a nteaseɛ wom so, titire no mmabun a wɔato wɔn sintidua ne wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm. Animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne mfe a obi adi ho animhwehwɛ a ɛbrɛ mmerante ne mmabaa ahotoso ne nkɛntɛnso ase wɔ ASRH advocacy ho. Tumi a ɛnkari pɛ ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde mpaninfo adwene ne tumidi di kan sen mmabun nne ne adwumayɛbea ahorow mu. Nhumu ne nteaseɛ a ɛnni nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no mu wɔ hia a mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔde mmabun adwenemu bɛka ASRH nhyehyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ me mmɔreɛ so bere a merewura mmabunbere?
answer_twi_source: Twitwa  mmɔreɛ : Ma wo  mmɔreɛ no ntwa nkɔ tenten a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo na amma efĩ ankɔ soro. Hohoro  mmɔreɛ Ase: Fa  mmɔreɛ brɔs di dwuma anaasɛ fa  mmɔreɛ hyɛ wo  mmɔreɛ ase hohoro wo  mmɔreɛ ase brɛoo na ama efĩ ne mmoawa afi hɔ. Kwati  mmɔreɛwe:  mmɔreɛ a wobɛka no betumi ama mmoawa akɔ w'anom na ama woanya yare mmoawa. Fa nsuo: Fa nsuo a ɛyɛ nwini gu wo nsa ne wo mmɔreɛ so na ama nsuo akɔ mu na ayɛ nnwunu. Hyɛ nsateaa: Sɛ woreyɛ ofie nnwuma anaa woreyɛ turo a, hyɛ nsateaa na abɔ wo mmɔreɛ ho ban na amma ansɛe. Kwati Nnuru a Ɛyɛ Den: Mfa nnuro a ɛyɛ den nka wo mmɔreɛ, ebetumi ama no ayɛ mmerɛ. Nnwumayɛfo a Wɔyɛ Nsa: Sɛ wopɛ a, susuw ho sɛ wubenya obi a ɔyɛ onimdefo a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mmere titiriw bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi pae obi foforo nna mu yadeɛ (STI) anaa HIV ho asɛm a ɔnnyee ho tumi a, mmara kwan so asotwe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ mmara-to (Violates privacy). Wɔbetumi de wo akɔ kɔɔto (Civil/criminal charges). Ɛde aniwuo ne haw ba. Mmara ma kwan wɔ tebea bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛho hia ma mmabun, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbetumi anya mfaso afi akwahosan tebea horow a wohu ntɛm, wohu, na wɔsa mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, nnuro a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban, akwahosan tebea horow a wɔhwehwɛ mu (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɛseyɛ mmoroso, mogya mmoroso), afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nneyɛe pa ho (sɛ nhwɛso no, aduan pa, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ), ne nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia na ama mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi anya nkɔso. Ayaresa dwumadi: Aduruyɛ, nnuru, ayaresa, ne ahosiesie dwumadie a wɔbɛnya wɔ berɛ mu no ho hia paa na wɔadi nyarewa a emu yɛ den, tebea a enni sabea (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, ayamtu, asikreyareɛ), opira, ne adwenemyareɛ a ɛwɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma. Awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe: Awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn ho hwɛ, ayaresa a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho no ho hia na ama wɔadi mmabun ahiade soronko ho dwuma na wɔaboa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan mu aba. Adwene mu akwahosan ho dwumadie: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, afotuo, ayaresa, adwenemyareɛ ho hwɛ, ɔhaw mu dwumadie, ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkum wɔn ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya no ho hia na ama wɔadi mmabun nkateɛ mu yiedie ho dwuma, adi adwennwene, dadwen, adwenemhaw, adwenemhaw, ne nneyɛeɛ a wɔde siw wɔn ho a wɔbɛpira anaasɛ wɔbɛkum wɔn ho ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nwumakuo a ɛhwɛ banbɔ ne kokoamsɛm betumi afa so aboa mmabun wɔ berɛ a wɔreyɛ wɔn nhwehwe mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛyɛ den.Wɔmmɔ din anaa sɛ wobɛ kora din so. Wɔgye anaa sɛ wɔserɛ kwan ansa. Adwumayɛfoɔ nteteeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ma mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow, asɛyɛde ahorow, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa tumi ma wɔpaw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ma mmabun nya nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow, asɛyɛde ahorow, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi denam nsɛm a ɛfata a wɔde ka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho na ɛma hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne nsusuwii ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ den so. Asuafo sua gyinaesi mu ahofadi a ɛfa wɔn nipadua ne abusuabɔ ho. Wɔhwehwɛ adwene ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nipadua mu ahofadi, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho, na wonya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wohia na wɔde asi wɔn hokwan ahorow so dua na wɔakamfo nsakrae. Ɛnam nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow, akyinnyegye, ne nnwuma so no, wɔma mmabun tumi ma wogye asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho kyim, kasa tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim, na wɔhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo aka ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuabɔ, ne m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Paw bere pa. Hyɛ aseɛ bɔkɔɔ na ɛnyɛ aniberesɛm so. Da anigye a wowɔ sɛ wubesua ade adi. Fa kasa a ɛfata mfe a obi adi di dwuma. Nya abotare.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahoɔden a wɔde hyɛ mu den, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka me suban ne gyinaesi wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu, titiriw bere a mihyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso no?
answer_twi_source: Nkuranhyɛ pa (Positive reinforcement) yɛ adwene mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔpɛ bɛhyɛ den anaa wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nneɛma pa anaa akatua a wɔde bɛka ho so. Wɔ nkitahodie mu, titiriw berɛ a worehyia mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ no, nkuranhyɛ pa betumi anya wo suban ne wo gyinaesi so tumi denam nneyɛeɛ anaa nneɛma a wobɛpaw a ɛbɛma ayɛ dɛ anaa akatua bɛwom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama amanaman ntam sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow no adi mmabun ahiade ahorow, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan wɔ amammerɛ ne asetra ne sikasɛm tebea ahorow mu no ho dwuma kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ama amanaman ntam sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ nea ɛfata kɛse, wɔ mmabun ahiade ahorow ho denam sikasɛm ho akwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔbɛfa so, akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no so. Sikasɛm ho nhyehyeɛ, akwammisa ahwehwɛdeɛ, ne amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛfata nsɛm a ɛfa ho ne nneɛma ahodoɔ a ɛhia paa no hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔatu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ adeyɛmu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no hyɛ nhumu, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne nea wɔde siw ano nhyehyɛe ahorow no hyɛ nhumu, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho ho nkuran denam: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde ma wɔ sɛnea nna mu basabasayɛ abu so, nea efi mu ba, ne nea ɛde ba ntini ho, anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔpopa, ne tema ne ntease a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma ma nkɔmmɔbɔ, nsusuwii, ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee wɔ asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, suban, ne nneyɛe a ɛboa ma wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ ne nhyɛso ho. Ankorankoro a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔayɛ ade de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ, sɛ ebia ɛnam atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ no a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, anaa nhyehyɛe a wɔkamfo kyerɛ so. Amammerɛ a ɛfa akontaabu ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, baabi a wɔde tema, gye a wogye tom, ne nneɛma ne nnwuma a ɛfata a wobenya no hyia nsɛm a wɔda no adi. Mmoa ne biakoyɛ nkitahodi ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔfo ntam, a wɔbom yɛ adwuma de kasa tia nhyɛso nhyehyɛe ahorow na wɔhyɛ pɛyɛ, atɛntrenee, ne ahobammɔ ho nkuran ma obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛta si sɛ mɛte nka sɛ me ho yɛ me den wɔ me nipadua a ɛresakra no ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si koraa sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ wo nipadua  ɛresakra wɔ wɔn mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ho. Wo nipadua no refa nsakrae pii mu, na ɛno betumi ayɛ nsakrae kɛse. Ɛtaa ba sɛ wode wo ho bɛtoto afoforo ho na woahaw wo ho wɔ wo honam ani hwɛbea ho. Kae sɛ obiara fa eyi mu, na ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛte nka saa. Afotu bi a wode bedi nkate a ɛfa wo ho ho dwuma ni: Fa w’adwene si nneɛma a w’ani gye ho wɔ wo ho so. Obiara wɔ su horow a ɛyɛ soronko na ɛyɛ soronko. Kae wo ho sɛ obiara nipadua sesa wɔ ne babunbere mu, na ɛyɛ awosu mu ade a ɛma obi nyin. Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka sɛnea wote nka ho asɛm. Sɛ́ ɛyɛ w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, anaa ɔfotufo no, wo nkate a wobɛka akyerɛ no betumi aboa. Fa wo ho hwɛ ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wote nka sɛ wo ho ye, sɛ́ ɛyɛ agumadi, anigyede, anaa bere a wo ne wo nnamfo nya no di dwuma. Ɛho hia nso sɛ yɛkae sɛ ahoɔfɛ wɔ nsusuwii ne akɛse nyinaa mu. Ɛnyɛ sɛnea wo ho yɛ fɛ na ɛkyerɛ wo bo a ɛsom. Wosom bo sɛnea wosom bo no ara pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na amanneɛbɔfoɔ taa ka fa mpa mu agorɔ ne mpenatwe anaa awareɛ ho, na ɛka yɛn sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Wɔkyerɛ ɔdɔ a agyina anigye ne atenka so (romanticized/sensationalized). Wɔsanso ma yɛhu mmarima ne mmaa asɛdeɛ wɔ ɔman yi mu 'gender roles' ne 'stereotypes'. Ɛka sɛdeɛ yehu yɛn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmmabun a adi dem wɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔnya ayaresa mpo sɛ wɔakɔyɛ abortion awie anaa? Wɔn asɛdeɛ ne sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi wɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔbɛnya ayaresa mpo sɛ wokoyi ba gu a (abortion), a ebi ne: Kɔkoamunsɛm: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun wɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔbenya awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho mmoa a ɛyɛ kɔkoam, abortion akyi ayaresa ka ho, a awofoɔ nntumi nnsi ho kwan. Pene a Nimdeɛ Wom: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔnya wɔn ayaresa ho nsɛm na wɔde nimdeɛ apene ayaresa anaa dwumadie biara so. Obu Mu Nhwɛsoɔ: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ne wɔn di no obu kwan so, animuonyam, ne nteaseɛ mu. Hunu sɛ wowɔ ho kwan: Hwehwɛ wo mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmabun awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho mmoa ho. Kasa Ma Wo Ho: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔribu wo faahodie so anaa worennya mmoa a ehia wo a, kasa na gyina wo ho akyi. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wohyia nsɛnnennen wɔ wo ndinoɔ a wobɛgyina so a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfoɔ, akuo, anaa mmara mu mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ apɔmuden ho insurance a wɔde tua nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a awofo pene ho ɛnhia ansa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun taa wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya kokoam nnwuma: Mmeae pii wɔ mmara a ɛma mmofra nkumaa kwan ma wɔpene apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi so, a nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe ka ho, a awofo mpene so ho ɛnhia ansa. Apɔmuden ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow nso betumi de kokoam ahobammɔ ama nnwuma a ɛho hia, na ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun te mmara ne nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ wɔn mantam mu a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ne pene a wɔpene so ma apɔmuden ho nnwuma ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo betumi adi tumi a ɛnkari pɛ ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ fekubɔ a ɛfata a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya ho nkuran wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmufoɔ bɛtumi adi tumi a ɛnkari pɛ ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ ayɔnkofa a ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ no mu no ho nkuran denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a egyina mpɔtam hɔ (CBPR) akwan a ɛde adwumayɛkuo di kan, gyinaesie a wɔkyɛ, ne obuo a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ntam. Nkitahodi akwan a emu da hɔ ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so de nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛma afi mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔdi dwuma no hɔ, a nhyiam a wɔyɛ no daa, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, anaa mpɔtam hɔ afotufo bagua ahorow ka ho. Tumi mu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ntam a wɔbɛgye atom na wɔadi ho dwuma, te sɛ denam nsiyɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn ananmusifoɔ nni hɔ no nne ayɛ kɛseɛ na wɔahwɛ sɛ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛka obiara ho na ɛda adi pefee. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ama mpɔtam hɔfo anya tumi ne ahokokwaw nkɔso, a ntetee a wɔde bɛma wɔ nhwehwɛmu akwan, abrabɔ pa, ne nsɛm a wɔde hwehwɛ mu ka ho, de ama wɔn tumi ma wɔadi dwuma denneennen wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotu betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔapaw nneɛma a nyansa wom wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Afotufo de nsɛm a ɛteɛ ma, wɔboa ma wɔhwehwɛ gyinapɛn ahorow mu, kyerɛkyerɛ asiane ne mfaso horow mu, wɔkyekye nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, na wɔde mmoa ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsusuwii wo ankasa ho nya wɔ ankorako ho mpɔtum a wonya wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii ne ankoranko ahweyie di dwuma titiriw wɔ nsusuwii a emu yɛ den a wobenya wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu. Gye bere susuw wo gyidi, gyinapɛn, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no ho, na susuw sɛnea ɛka wo gyinaesi ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ wo ho mu nhwehwɛmu mu na ama woahu animhwɛ anaa nsusuwii biara a ebetumi aka wo nsusuwii. Ɛdenam wo ho a wubenya so no, wubetumi de pefeeyɛ ne w’adwene akɔ gyinaesi mu, na woapaw nneɛma a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya baabi pa a ahobammɔ wɔ a me ne afoforo bɛka me nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa me bɔbeasu ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Ɔpanyin a wogye no di: Sɛ wo ne awofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa ɔpanyin foforo a wogye no di a ɔboa wo bɛkasa a, ebetumi ayɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so ahwehwɛ wo nkate mu. Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no na wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ mmabun adamfofa su no nkasa . Fa wo ho to wo gut so - se space bi nnte nka se ahotɔ wɔ hɔ a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛkɔ w’anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ nipadua mu mfonini pa ne obu kɛse a obi nya wɔ ne mmabunbere mu so bere tenten, wɔ nipadua ne adwene mu apomode a efi mu ba nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ho mfonini pa ne obu kɛse a obi nya wɔ ne ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no betumi ama wɔanya mfaso pii a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ ama nipadua ne adwene mu apomoden nyinaa. Wɔ nipadua mu no, ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nipadua ho mfonini pa no taa de wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe pa te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa, aduan a ɛkari pɛ, ne ayaresa a wɔhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia mu, na ɛma wonya apomoden nyinaa mu nkɔso pa. Wɔ adwene mu no, obu kɛse a obi wɔ ma ne ho no ne dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adidi mu haw a ɛba fam, ne sɛnea wotumi gyina tebea horow ano ne ahotoso a ɛkɔ soro wɔ asetena mu ɔhaw a wodi mu no wɔ abusuabɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de sohyial media, nkitahodi, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nsɛm ase na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nsakrae pa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de sohyial media, nkitahodi, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe adi dwuma de: Akyɛ nsɛm ne akontaabu a ɛfa akatua mu nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam ne pɛyɛ a enni adwumayɛbea ahorow ho. Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma ɔsatu ahorow, adesrɛ ahorow, anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase wɔ Intanɛt so. Wo ne ankorankoro a wɔwɔ adwene koro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ kyerɛ no nni nkitaho. Ma wɔn nne nyɛ kɛse denam wɔn ankasa nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ so. Boaboa mmoa ano ma mmara anaa nhyehyeɛ mu nsakraeɛ de adi akatua mu nyiyim ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahotew ho nneyɛe pɔtee ben na ewɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mihu mprempren a merefa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, bere a wo nipadua sesa no, ɛho hia sɛ wukura ahotew ho nneyɛe pa mu. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne aguare da biara da, deodorant a wode bedi dwuma, ntade a ɛho tew a wobɛhyɛ, ne anom ahotew a ɛfata denam wo se a wobɛhohoro daa so. Bio nso, wɔ mmeawa fam no, ɛho hia sɛ wosua brayɛ mu ahotew ne sɛnea wobedi brayɛ ho dwuma dwoodwoo na ahotɔ wom ho ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ahwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyiamu ase no bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoamsɛm na wɔrenka ho asɛm gye w'apene so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔayɛ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe de abɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ho ban wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nhyiam ahorow ase. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ nneyɛ pa ne mmara mu asɛde ahorow so sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ nhyiam ahorow ase no nyɛ kokoamsɛm gye sɛ asiane bi wɔ hɔ sɛ ebepira ɔbabun no anaa afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛwɔ ɔdɔpa a ɔhaw bia nnim mu?
answer_twi_source: Ͻdɔ a ɛte saa so wɔ  Ahotosoɔ (Trust). Obu (Respect). Nkitahodie (Communication). Pɛyɛ (Equality).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mfonini ahorow a media no yi a ɛfa mpenso, nhyɛso, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho no boa ma wonya adwene a ɛnteɛ ne asodi a wɔde to victims so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ adwuma de ako atia saa nsɛm a ɛha yi?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a ɛnyɛ papa a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata ne aniberesɛm a ɛwɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu a wɔbɛma ayɛ ketewaa so. Victims ho mfonini a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ akwan horow so a ɛma nsusuii hunu kɔ so tra hɔ anaasɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔn na wɔde wɔn ayayade no ba. Mmabun betumi ako atia saa nsɛm a epira yi denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa, mpeneso, ne ahyeɛ ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nna mu basabasayɛ ho mfonini a edi mu na obu wom a wɔbɛkamfo wɔ media mu. Victims a wɔbɛboa wɔn ne su horow a wɔde to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no so a wɔbɛkasa atia wɔ wɔn mpɔtam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahu mpɔtam mmoa kuo  nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afa akwan ahodoɔ so ahunu mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ɔmantam akwaahosan dwumadibea anaa mpɔtam akwaahosan asoɛeɛ a wobɛdi nkitaho. Akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe anaa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ho nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so a wobɛhwɛ. Akwankereɛ a wobebisa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow anaa akwahosan ho guasodeyɛ ahorow a wobetumi agyina hɔ ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no a wɔbɛkɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na Honam mu nkwammoa ahorow di wɔ awo nhyehyɛe no nyin ne ne dwumadi mu?
answer_twi_source: Honam mu nkwammoa ahorow boa ma ɔbea nna su ahorow nya nkɔso na ɛkɔ so tra hɔ na edi dwuma titiriw wɔ awo, nyinsɛn, ne brayɛ mu. Mmarima awo mu honam mu nkwammoa te sɛ testosterone boa ma mmarima nna su nya nkɔso na ɛkɔ so tra hɔ na ɛboa ma wɔyɛ barima ho nsuo nkwaboa wɔ hwaa no mu.Testosterone: Barima honam mu nkwammoa a ɛboa ma wɔyɛ barima ho nsuo nkwaboa na ɛma barima su pue. Estrogen ne Progesterone: Mmea honam mu nkwammoa a ɛka ho ma nkesua nyin, brayɛ, ne nyinsɛn. honam mu nkwammoa ahorow kyerɛ nipadua no ma enya nna mu su ahorow a ɛto so abien, te sɛ nipadua mu nhwi, nufu a enyin, ne nne a ɛsakra.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so no, mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔhwehwɛ SRH mmoa a awofoɔ nnim?
answer_twi_source: Ɛgyina mmara no so. Nanso mmabun taa nya hokwan sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa (contraception, STI, abortion) kokoam a awofoɔ nnim, gyina wɔn mfeɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nyiyim a ɛda mmarima ne mmaa ntam no nya akatua ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔrekɔ adwuma mu no nya so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu mu nyiyim betumi aka akatua ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔrekɔ adwuma mu no nya so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Nneyɛe a ɛkyerɛ nyiyim te sɛ mmaa akatua a ɛba fam sen mmarima wɔ adwuma koro no ara ho, wɔpow wɔn nkɔanim anaa akannifo dibea a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna so, anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw ne animhwɛ mu wɔ adwumam no, betumi asiw wɔn sika a wobetumi anya no ano, na asiw wɔn adwumayɛ mu nkɔso kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na mɛnya mmoa nkrataa anaa 'apps' a ɛbɛboa me na mayɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛma me ho atɔ me na manya akwahosan pa?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu nɛɛse. GHS-YMK afutugyefoɔ. Nhomatrofoɔ a wotumi frɛ kwa (PPAG, UNICEF).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ meda dae bɔne anaa nna mu basaa bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ? Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ sɛ menya daesone basaabasaa (nightmares) anaa ɔhaw wɔ me nna mu wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa akwan a wɔfa so gye ahome di dwuma ansa na woada. Yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛma wo ho dwo ansa na woada. Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ pa ma wo nna mmere ... Twitwa caffeine, nsa, ne sigaret (titiriw wɔ awiabere). Fa wo ho hyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu daa awiabere — nanso nnyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ansa na woada. Sɛ daesone basaabasaa no kɔ so a, kasa kyerɛ wo hwɛfoɔ na wɔaboa wo asiesie adwene mu nhyɛsoɔ anaa dadwen biara a ɛde ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ media ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, nkabom, ne ɔsatuo a ɛdi mu wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu a ɛde media ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia, media ho nimdeɛ a wɔnim, ne media nneyɛeɛ pa a ɛwɔ mmabun mu no anya nkɔsoɔ yie?
answer_twi_source: media ho nimdeɛ ho nhyehyɛe, nkabom, ne ɔsatu ahorow a edi mu wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no bi ne: Nnwuma a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nnwumakuo ahorow, akuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔyɛ adwuma bom de yɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa asetra, amammerɛ, ne akwahosan ho nsɛmti a ɛfata ho. Nhumu ɔsatu ne nsɛm a esisi a ɛma wohu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nsɛm, ɛhyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ den ho nkuran, na ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nkuran wɔ asuafo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mmusua mu. Nhyiamu a atipɛnfoɔ di anim, nsɛm a wɔka, ne nteteeɛ a asuafoɔ de wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne wɔn nimdeɛ ma wɔn atipɛnfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ. Digitals ɔman ba nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asuafoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛfa abrabɔ pa ho nsunsuanso, kokoamsɛm ho haw, ne intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ho asiane mu berɛ a wɔde digyital nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne mfiridwuma redi dwuma. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi kyerɛ tumi a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sɛ ɛma asuafoɔ tumi, kyekye mpɔtam hɔ fekubɔ, na ɛde nsakraeɛ pa ba sukuu ne mpɔtam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ bi wɔ hɔ ma GBV ho nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Wɔmo ma nteteɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ deɛ yebesi ano kwan (prevention workshops). Na afei so wɔyɛ  nkyerɛkyerɛ de bɔ ho dawuro (awareness campaign).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apɔwmuden mu nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no ka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho na wɔde wɔn hokwan ahorow adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden mu nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ betumi asiw mmabun a wobetumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho na wɔde wɔn hokwan ahorow adi dwuma no kwan. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wonnya pii, apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu, ne mmeae a wɔboa no betumi asiw mmabun paw, ahofadi, ne wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ biribiara wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɛhɔfo nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne atetesɛm mu ayaresa nneyɛe di wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a wodi ho dwuma wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanfoɔ a wɔfiri tete nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne amammerɛ ayaresa nneyɛeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ mmofra a wɔrenyin nna ne awogyee ahoosan ahiadeɛ ho asɛm a wɔbɛdi mu wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu denam ahoosan ne asetena pa ho akwan a ɛdɔɔso a wɔde ma, amammerɛ atetesɛm, gyinapɛn, ne honhom mu nneɛma a wɔde ka ayaresa nneyɛeɛ ho, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahoɔden ne wo ho mmara a ɛbɛma ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo anaa abusua mufo betumi ayɛ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn ma wɔne mmabun susuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo anaa abusua no mufo betumi ama tebea a ɛboa wɔn denam: Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ a wɔrensusuw ho no so. Sɛ́ wobɛma n’adwene abue na woate ase. Obu a wɔde ma kokoam nsɛm. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma na wɔadi adwene a ɛnteɛ ho dwuma. Nsɛmmisa a ɛhyɛ nkuran ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔabue ano. Tema ne ɔdɔ a enni nnyinaso a wɔbɛda no adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammere anaa nnipa mu gyinapɛn ahorow tumi kyerɛ nea nnipa bu no sɛ ɛyɛ ayɔnkofa pa?
answer_twi_source: Amammere mu gyinapɛn ahorow tumi kyerɛ dwuma pɔtee a ɛsɛ sɛ mmarima ne mmaa di wɔ ayɔnkofa mu.. Abusua Gyinapɛn: Amammerɛ mu nsɛm betumi anya akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa abusua no ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu ne gyinaesi ho so nkɛntɛnso. Nkitahodi Akwan: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi akyerɛ sɛnea ankorankoro da natenka adi na wodi nkitaho. Nyamesom mu nkyerɛkyerɛ tumi kyerɛ sɛnea nnipa bu awareɛ, nna ho nsɛm, ne sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ ayɔnkofoo ne wɔn ho bɔ. Akwanhwɛ a Wobɛfa So: Wo ne wo hokafo nsusuw sɛnea amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ahorow nya mo abusuabɔ so nkɛntɛnso no ho na hwehwɛ akwan a wobɛfa so abom afa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so ka mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm no adwenemyare ne wɔn yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyim betumi aka mmabun a wɔadi dɛm adwenemyare wɔ ɔkwan a enye so: Dadwen ne Adwenemhaw: Sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔayi wɔn afi nnipa mu na wɔnte wɔn ase yiye a, ebetumi de adwenemyare ahorow aba. Obu a Ɛba Fam: Nsusuwii hunu betumi ama wɔate nka sɛ mfaso nni wɔn so na wɔnfata. Nipadua Mfonini Ho Nsɛm: Ɔmanfo nkrasɛm a enye betumi ama nipadua ho sɛeɛ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm ho amannebɔ ahorow a wɔtaa nya a ɛka mmabun adwene ne wɔn suban wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Social media platforms, instagram, facebook, TikTok, ne Snapchat ka ho, baabi a influencers ne atipɛnfoɔ kyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nso ka ho. Television so dwumadi ahorow, sini ahorow, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde fa nsɛm so a ɛkyerɛ ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ, nna mu nkitahodi, ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne blog ahorow a ankorankoro kyɛ wɔn ankasa osuahu, afotu, ne adwene wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ di wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotu, ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ (family planning) ho?
answer_twi_source: Dwuma a Adɔkotafo Di: Nhwehwɛmu: Fa abakɔsɛm a edi mũ a mmabun no awo botae ka ho. Yɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu na ama woatumi de afotu a ɛfa afɛfo ho ama. Nsɛm: Fa abusua nhyehyɛe akwan horow ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri ma. Afotu: Fa afotu ma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, sɛnea etu mpɔn, nea efi mu ba, ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho. Mmoa: Boa gyinaesi, di nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, na ma mmoa a ɛkɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ aduannuru ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ aduannuru ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no mu. Wobetumi asusuw w’aduannuru tebea ho, ahu aduan a wunni anaa nea ɛhaw wo biara, de aduannuru ho afotu a ɛfa wo ho ama, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛkyerɛ wo ama wokɔ animdefo nkyɛn. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ama wɔn ani akɔ woso yie asane nso ayɛ nsakraeɛ krakra wɔ woakwankyerɛ mu ama aboa w'apɔmden ne nipadua akwaa nkayɛ no nyinaa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma adwenem apomuden anya nkɔsoɔ no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ɛka obiara ho, na asuafoɔ nyinaa bɛtumi anya bi, ɛmfa ho sɛdeɛ wɔfiri mu anaa onipa kuw a wɔfiri mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwɛ sɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma adwenem apomuden anya nkɔsoɔ no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ɛka obiara ho, na asuafoɔ nyinaa bɛtumi anya bi ne: Wɔde adwene ahodoɔ, osuahu, ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm bɛka adwenemyareɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ ho. Nneɛma, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu de agye asuafoɔ a wɔfiri kasa ahodoɔ mu. Afotuo dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ adwuma, mmoa akuo, ne atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛma. Sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ ne adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbɛtete wɔn wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne ahobrɛaseɛ mu ama wɔate asuafoɔ dodoɔ a ɛsono wɔn mu biara ahiadeɛ soronko ase yie na wɔadi ho dwuma. Mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama asuafoɔ akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔnni gyinabea pa no sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nyiyim anaa atemmuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho denam: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde bɛma so. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Asuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn bɛka nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie te sɛ sukuu ayarehwɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa mpɔtam akwahosan ayaresabea ahodoɔ ho. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔahyɛ asuafo nkuran ma wɔagye nsusuwii hunu ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ho kyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ahwɛ mmabun wɔ wɔn nkwa nna nyinaa mu, a bere a wɔsakra fi mmofra akwahosan ho kɔ mpanyimfo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ahwɛ mmabun wɔ wɔn nkwa nna nyinaa mu, a bere a wɔresakra afi mmofra akwahosan so akɔ mpanyimfo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so ka ho. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ nnam na wɔyɛ biako wɔ mmofra ne mpanyimfo akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntam na ama nsakrae a ɛkɔ so yiye no ayɛ mmerɛw na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun bɛkɔ so anya SRH nnwuma ne mmoa a ɛho hia bere a wɔresakra akɔ mpanyin afe so no. Akwahosan nhyehyɛe betumi de nsakrae nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ka ho wɔ gyinaesi mu adi dwuma, de nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ wɔn ankasa akwahosan a wɔhwɛ so ho, na wɔde akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi nkitaho a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmofra ne mpanyimfo akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntam no asi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya kwan pa a mɛfa so ne afoforo adi nkitaho, titiriw sɛ mete nka sɛ matew me ho anaasɛ me nkutoo na mewɔ hɔ a? (wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ akuw mu, atuhoama, intanɛt so mpɔtam hɔfo)
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ woyɛ ankonam a, ebetumi ama adwenemyare aba wo so. Ɔkwan a wobɛfa so abɔ nie: Kɔka Kuo anaa Dwumadie bi ho: Hwehwɛ akuo a wɔn ani gye ho wɔ sukuu anaa wo mpɔtam hɔ. Tuhoama: Sɛ wutu wo ho ma a, ɛboa afoforo na ɛma wuhu atirimpɔw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi asɛe na wɔabisabisa nkrasɛm a ɛwɔ ase, tumi mu nkɔso, ne animhwɛ a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho no ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ma mmabun tumi ma wɔpaapae nkrasɛm a ɛwɔ ase, tumi mu nkɔso, ne animhwɛ a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho no mu na wobisabisa wɔn nsɛm denam: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu na wɔahu nsusuwii hunu, animhwɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahintaw. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛhyɛ nkuran a ɛfa nsunsuanso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo nya wɔ ankorankoro adwene, wɔn suban, ne wɔn nneyɛe so ho. Hokwan a wɔbɛma asuafoɔ de ayɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu na ɛhyɛ ahodoɔ ne nkabom ho nkuran.
