Sɛ wosi hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho hia wɔ asetra mu atɛntrenee, pɛyɛ, ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun nya animtiaabu anaa atemmu fi wɔn mfɛfo ne abusua mufo hɔ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, nnamfo, anaa mmoa akuw a wobetumi de ntease ne adanse ama hɔ. Wobetumi nso akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfo ne wɔn abusuafo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm de akasa atia animtiaabu na wɔama ntease anya nkɔso. Sɛ ɛho hia a, wobetumi anya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam wɔ baabi a wobetumi anya ɔhwɛ a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu mu nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho ahiade ne osuahu ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ no ntease mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi saa nsonsonoe ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi adi nhwehwɛmu mu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho ahiade ne osuahu ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ ntease mu no ho dwuma denam; sika a wɔde bɛma de ayɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa mmubuafo ho, adwumayɛkuw a wɔne mmubuafo ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ, ne nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nne yɛ kɛse a wɔde di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun tumi ma wɔn adwene anaa nyansahyɛ de boa ma wɔyɛ nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ mmoa telefon nkyerɛwee no yɛ papa na obiara tumi kɔ bi, na ayɛ nea ɛbɛma mmoa a wɔde ma no akɔ so ara adi nneɛma foforo a ɛhia mmofra ne su ahorow a wɔwɔ no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Adwene ne Nyansahyɛ Ma: mmabun tumi ma wɔn adwene anaa nyansahyɛ de boa ma wɔyɛ nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ mmoa telefon nkyerɛwee no yɛ papa na obiara tumi kɔ bi. Nnwuma pii wɔ akwan a wɔfa so gye adwene, te sɛ nsɛmmisa krataa anaa nkyerɛwee krataa a wɔde ma nyansahyɛ, baabi a ankorankoro betumi akyɛ nea wɔahunu ne nyansahyɛ a ɛbɛma nkɔso aba. Saa nyansahyɛ yi boa ma wɔahu sɛ nnwuma no kɔ so ara di mmofra ahiade a ɛsesa da biara ne wɔn amanehunu ahorow no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ahorow, ne nsɛm a esisi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no ma wonya hokwan ahorow de hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ne nhomasua ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ahorow, afahyɛ ahorow, ne nsɛm a esisi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no ma wonya hokwan ahorow a ɛsom bo a wɔde hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ne nhomasua ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu. Wobetumi de saa nhyiam ahorow yi adi dwuma de akyekyɛ nsɛm, ama wɔanya nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ anigye so. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de saa mmere yi adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ase, ahyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran, na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnwuma a sukuu mu ahokyere ho nhyehyɛe ahorow de ma no yɛ kokoamusɛm?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nnwuma a sukuu mu ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nhyehyɛe ahorow de ma no taa yɛ kokoamsɛm. Nanso, tebea horow bi betumi aba a ɛsɛ sɛ wobu kokoamu nsɛm so sɛ wo ahobammɔ anaa afoforo ahobammɔ ho dadwen bi wɔ hɔ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho wɔ tebea horow a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne nneyɛe betumi ne mmara a ɛfa mfe a wɔde pene so ho mmara a ɛwɔ mmara mu no bɔ abira, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wubetumi adi nsɛm yi ho dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmabun ho ban na wɔanya hokwan ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho wɔ tebea horow a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow ne mmara a ɛfa mfe a wɔde pene so ho mmara bɔ abira no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde ahwɛyiye fa so: Mmara mu nhwehwɛmu: Yɛ mmara mu nhwehwɛmu de te sɛnea amammerɛ mu nneyɛe ne mmara kwan so mfe a wɔde pene so ho mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no hyia na woahu ntawntawdi anaa nsonsonoe a ebetumi aba. Abrabɔ Pa Ho Akwankyerɛ: Hwehwɛ abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ fi mmara ho abenfo, abrabɔ pa ho animdefo, ne mpɔtam hɔ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu hɔ na ama woanya akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔfa so pene so a ɛfoa hokwan ahorow ne ahobammɔ a mmabun wɔ so. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛdi nkitaho de ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie ne adwene a ɛwɔ mu a ɛfa amammerɛ nneyɛeɛ, pene, ne mmara nhyehyɛeɛ ho de ahwɛ sɛ ɛne nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mfoni ho no gu ahorow wɔ mpɔtam ne mpɔtam ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi nsonsonoe ahorow yi so?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mfoni ho gu ahorow wɔ mpɔtam ne mpɔtam ahorow mu, na ɛka sɛnea mmabun kura wɔ ahoɔfɛ ne wɔn ho a wɔsom bo ho. Mmabun betumi adi nsonsonoe ahorow yi so mu denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye, ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a epira a wobehu na wɔakasa atia, amammerɛ ahorow a wogye tom, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne nipasu ho adwene a egyina ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow so a wobenya so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene a wɔpene so di wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛaseɛ a ɛfa Mpene ho: Mpene yɛ apam a emu da hɔ, ɛyɛ anigyeɛ, na ɛkɔ so sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma kwa a nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso biara nni ho. Nkitahodi: Wo ne wo hokafo nkasa pefee mfa pene a wobɛpene so ansa na woanya nna mu kyɛfa ne bere a woreyɛ no ho. Hwɛ mo ho mo ho mu na ama moanya awerɛkyekye ne ɔpɛ. Bu Ahye: Bu wo hokafo ahye bere nyinaa, sɛ mpo woadi kan de asi hɔ mpo a. Sɛ wo hokafo no twe ne ho fi pene so wɔ bere biara mu a, gyae ntɛm ara. Dabi Kyerɛ Dabi: Te ase sɛ "dabi" kyerɛ dabi, na sɛ wɔntwentwɛn wo nan ase biara ma no nyɛ aniberesɛm. Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara pene so na wɔde anigye yɛ. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Ɛnyɛ Asɛmfua: Hwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu, te sɛ nipadua mu kasa ne w’anim yɛbea. Sɛ w’adwene mu yɛ wo naa a, bisa sɛ wɔmfa ano nkyerɛ sɛ wopene so. Nsã ne Nnubɔne: Sɛ obi anom nsa anaa nnubɔne a, wontumi mfa pene mma. Hwɛ hu sɛ afã abien no nyinaa adwene mu da hɔ na wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata koraa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ amanaman  mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) ntam nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, wɔde adi dwuma, na wɔahwɛ so de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔadi wɔn ahiade ne akwannya ahorow ho dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ amanaman  nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) ntam nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, wɔde adi dwuma, na wɔahwɛ so denam wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne wɔn a wosi gyinae, wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nhyiam ahorow mu, na wɔabu aban ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no akontaa sɛ wɔadi wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a wɔde ama ASRH no so. Wɔn ho a wɔde hyɛ mu no hwɛ hu sɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow no di wɔn ahiade ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛma atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw nna mu yareɛ ano ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe pii ma hokwan ahorow ma atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ wɔn nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw nna mu yareɛ ano ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Saa hokwan ahorow yi betumi ayɛ: Nhyiamu a atipɛnfoɔ di anim, nsɛm a wɔka, ne nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, nna mu yareɛ a wɔsiw ano, ne abusuabɔ pa wɔ sukuu, mmabun mmeaeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu. Atipɛnfo afotu ne mmoa akuo a wɔde ma ankorankoro a nna mu yareɛ aka wɔn, a atipɛnfo ka wɔn suahu ahorow, de atinka fam mmoa ma, na wɔde afotu a mfaso wɔ so ma wɔ wɔn tebea no ano a wobedi ne sɛnea wobedi ho dwuma ho. Atipɛnfoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn ne wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ nsakraeɛ akannifoɔ ne ananmusifoɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam denam nna mu apomoden ho nimdeɛ, animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so, ne nneɛma ne nnwuma a wɔbɛnya so. Atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a mmabun akannifoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa anaa ankorankoro a wɔte nna mu yareɛ no de afotuo na wɔboa atipɛnfoɔ nkumaa wɔ a ɛfa nna mu apomoden, nsɛm a wɔda no adi, ne wɔn ho a wɔhwɛ ho no ho dwumadie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ denam mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ so de asua STI/HIV a wɔsiw ano ne nna mu nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ mu ho adeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ de nneɛma ne nneɛma ahodoɔ a wɔde bɛsua STI/HIV ano aduru ne nna ho nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ho ma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhomasua nkratawa, nwoma nketewa, ne nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm a ɛfa STI, HIV/AIDS, nyinsɛn ano aduru, kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm foforɔ ho. Intanɛt so nneɛma, te sɛ wɛbsaet, blog, ne nkitahodi nnwinnade, a ɛde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ foforo ma wɔ akwan a wɔfa so siw STI/HIV ano, sɔhwɛ ahorow a wobetumi apaw, ne ayaresa nnwuma ho. Multimedia nneɛma, a video, podcast, ne infographics ka ho, a ɛma atiefo nya adwene titiriw a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn. Nteteeɛ nhoma, nnwinnadeɛ, ne adesua nhyehyɛeɛ akwankyerɛ ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ de boa ma nhyiamu, nsɛm a wɔbɛka, ne nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene a ɛtaa ba wɔ mfomso a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no di ne sɛnea wɔbɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da mu no so ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Mfomso a ɔde di dwuma no yɛ ade a ɛtaa haw, nanso akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so atew asiane no so: Kenkan akwankyerɛ no yiye: Gye wo bere na te anammɔn biara ase ansa na wode ɔkwan a woapaw no adi dwuma. Bisa nsɛm! Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛma adwenem naayɛ biara a wowɔ wɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo ho no mu ada hɔ. Adeyɛ ma ɛyɛ pɛ: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm redi dwuma a, sua sɛ wode bɛhyɛ ansa na woahia. Fa nkaebɔ ahorow sisi hɔ: Fa alarm(dɔn a ɛbɔ) anaa app ahorow di dwuma de kae wo ho sɛ wobɛnom nnuru a wɔde kum yare anaa sesa akwan a ɛsɛ sɛ wode sesa daa. Susuw ɔkwan a wobɛfa so akora so ho hwɛ: Sɛ wowɔ kɔndɔm wɔ wo nsam a, ebetumi ama woabɔ wo ho ban kɛse sɛ wo kwan titiriw no di nkogu a. Sɛ wusiesie wo ho na wudi akwankyerɛ ahorow akyi a, wubetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ nea ɔde di dwuma no bedi mfomso ne nyinsɛn a woanhyɛ da no so kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobedi wɔn nna mu akwahosan ahiade ahorow ho dwuma wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe a ebia ɛkyerɛ nkabom anaasɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Kasa ma w’ankasa: Ka w'ahiadesɛm kyerɛ wo ɔyaresafo no pefee na emu da ho. Yɛ wo nhwehwɛmu: Sua wo dɛmdi pɔtee no ho ade ne sɛnea ebia ɛne nna mu akwahosan wɔ abusuabɔ. Hwehwɛ ɔyarehwɛfoɔ a wowɔ ne mu ahotosoɔ: Hwehwɛ obi a ɔwɔ osuahu wɔ adwuma a ɔne nnipa a wɔadi dɛm yɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm anaa nneɛma a ɛtaa ba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiw ano anaa wɔasa no?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ mu Nsɛnnennen: Nsɛm te sɛ bra a ɛnkɔ so daa, mogya a ɛtɔ kɛse (menorrhea), bra a ɛyɛ yaw (dysmenorrhea), ne bra a enni hɔ (amenorrhea) betumi aba. Ɛsono ayaresa ahorow a egyina asɛm no so na ebetumi ayɛ nnuru, hormone ayaresa, asetra mu nsakrae, anaa oprehyɛn. Nea broni frɛ no 'Polycystic Ovary Syndrome' (PCOS): PCOS yɛ hormone mu yare a ɛka mmea awo nhyehyɛe. Ebetumi ama obi akɔ nna a ɛnkɔ so daa, ne ti nhwi anyin dodo, akisikuru, ne awotwaa mu akisikuru. Nea ɛka sɛnea wɔhwɛ so no ho ne asetra mu nsakrae (aduan ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ), nnuru a wɔde ma nipadua mu nkwaadɔm a ɛma nipadua no yɛ adwuma yiye, ne sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a wɔhwɛ so. Nea broni frɛ no 'Endometriosis': Eyi yɛ tebea a ntini a ɛte sɛ awotwaa no mu nkataso no nyin wɔ awotwaa no akyi, na ɛde ɛyaw, nna a emu yɛ duru, na ontumi nwo. Ayaresa a wobetumi apaw bi ne nnuru, oprehyɛn a wɔde yi ntini no, ne hormone ayaresa. Nea broni frɛ no 'Erectile Dysfunction': Wɔ mmarima mu no, eyi ne sɛnea wontumi nnya ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna anaasɛ wontumi nkura mu. Nea ɛde ba no betumi ayɛ nipadua mu nsɛm, adwene mu nneɛma, anaa akwahosan tebea horow a ɛhyɛ ase. Ebia ayaresa ahorow no bi ne nnuru, asetra mu nsakrae, ayaresa, anaa oprehyɛn. Awo a wontumi nwo: Nyinsɛn a ɛyɛ den no betumi afi nneɛma ahorow a ɛwɔ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa mu. Ayaresa a wobetumi apaw no gyina nea ɛde ba no so na ebia nea ɛka ho ne nnuru, oprehyɛn, awo ho mfiridwuma a wɔboa (te sɛ IVF), anaa asetra mu nsakrae. STIs: Sɛnea yɛadi kan aka no, siw ano yɛ ade titiriw denam nna a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho, nokwaredi a wɔn nyinaa bɛkɔ so ama wɔn hokafo a wɔne no da, nna mu ɔyere biako a wɔbɛtra mu bere tenten, kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma yiye na ɛkɔ so daa, nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ daa, ne nkitahodi a wɔne wɔn a wɔne wɔn da. Vaccinations a wɔde ko tia Nea broni frɛ no 'HPV ne Hepatitis B' yɛ ho hia yiye. Sɛ obi nya nna mu yarewa, 'STI' a, wobetumi anya ayaresa, mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa (ma ɔyare mmoawa) anaa nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa (ma ɔyare mmoawa). Ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ aduruyɛfo afotu sɛ wuhyia awo akwahosan ho nsɛm anaa dadwen biara a. Mpɛn pii no, sɛ wohu ntɛm na wɔsa yare a, ebetumi ama nneɛma a eye. Kae bere nyinaa sɛ wobɛnom nnuru a wɔakyerɛw ama wo no awie na woakɔ akɔhwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ aka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw, sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔka mpɔtam hɔfo ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mmara kwan so hokwan ho adesua aka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw, sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmɔdenbɔ ho denam: Mmara kwan so hokwan ho nsɛmti a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛe module ahorow, adesua nhyehyɛe, ne nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mmabun akannifoɔ a wɔbɛtete wɔn ama nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa mmara kwan so hokwan ahodoɔ, pene, kokoamsɛm, ne dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ho no ayɛ mmerɛ. Mmara ho abenfoɔ, ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkamfo nkurɔfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahokafoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛfata mfeɛ. Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ayɔnkofo wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho nimdeɛ ne ntease a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ayaresabea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde fa ahomatrofo "telephone" so anaasɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn a wɔde nnwuma ma wɔ mmeae a wontumi nkɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow pii mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa nnipa ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn wɔ hɔ, a wɔde nnwuma ma wɔ mmeae a wontumi nkɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow pii mu, a nkuraase anaa mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa pii ka ho. Saa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa nnipa yi taa de akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ma, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho, na wobetumi akɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, anaa mmeae afoforo de ama mmabun ne mpɔtam hɔfo afoforo anya kwan akɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so ma wotumi gyina abusuabɔ anaa ayɔnkofa ano, titiriw wɔ nsakrae anaa amanehunu bere mu, de boa adwenem ahokwasan "mental health"?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ mu ahoɔden "Building Resillience" a wɔde gyina ano no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi nkitaho a etu mpɔn, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ, ne tumi a wotumi yɛ nsakrae ma ɛne nsakrae hyia. Wɔ amanehunu mmere mu no, mmabun betumi ama wɔatumi agyina ano denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di hɔ, wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn, ne wɔn adwene a wɔde besi akwan pa a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛfa sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa, mmarima ne mmaa ho a wɔde di dwuma wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne amanaman ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ: Nkuropɔn betumi de adetɔ ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a ɛde apam a wɔne nnwumakuw a mmea na wɔyɛ no di kan anaasɛ ɛboa sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛe ahorow ma mmea a wɔyɛ adwuma no adi dwuma. Ɔman: Aban ahodoɔ bɛtumi agye sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho atom de akyekyɛ nneɛma ama nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda mmarima ne mmaa ntam wɔ nwomasua, akwahosan, ne sikasɛm mu hokwan ahodoɔ ho dwuma. Amanaman ntam: Aman ahodoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi aboa nnwuma te sɛ aguadi ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho a, ɛhyɛ mmaa sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nkuran denam gua so, sikasɛm mu nnwuma, ne mfiridwuma mu nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ soro so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow di wɔ mpɔtam mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere Ho Nhomasua: Sukuu ahorow taa de mmabunbere ho adesua ma, na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nipadua ne atenka mu nsakrae ho ade. Afotu Dwumadibea: Sukuu afotufo betumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nipadua ho mfonini, ne atenka fam yiyedi ho. Mmoa Akuw: Sukuu ahorow bi wɔ mmoa akuw ma asuafo a wɔrefa nsɛnnennen a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho mu. Akwahosan Dwumadibea: Sukuu ayarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow betumi de kokoam nnwuma ama wɔ akwahosan ho haw ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho. Mpɔtam Akwahosan Ayarehwɛfoɔ ne Coommuity Healh Atuhoamafoɔ boa sukuu ahodoɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ dwumadie/dwumadie a wɔyɛ daa no mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ obu ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe anaa nnwuma a edi mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na anya mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa obuo mu abusuabɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nnwuma a ɛdi mu ho ne "Ɔdɔ Yɛ Obu" ɔsatuo, a ɛma nneɛma ne mmoa ma mmaabun a wɔrehyia ayɔnkofa basabasayɛ, ne "Hwɛ Buo kwan" nhyehyɛeɛ, a ɛhyɛ abusuabɔ pa ne ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi anya mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛeɛ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ denam abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa a ɛma wɔte aseɛ, mmabun a wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔhunu ayayadeɛ na wɔyɛ ho biribi, na wɔama amammerɛ a ɛfa obuo ne pɛyɛ ho wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yebetumi anya nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛkɔ so daa wɔ me suahunu a menya wɔ intanɛt so, a dadwen anaa nsɛmmisa biara a mewɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden nsɛm ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne wo awofoɔ nkasa fa wo su a woda no adi wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan  so ho, a dadwen anaa nsɛmmisa biara a wowɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden nsɛm ho ka ho. Kɔ so ne wɔn kasa na hyɛ wo awofoɔ nkuran ma wɔntie a wɔremmu wo fɔ anaa wɔrenkasa nkyerɛ wo. Fa wo nkɔmmɔbɔ no di dwuma sɛ akwannya a wode bɛkyɛ nsɛm, ahwehwɛ afotu, na woadi haw anaa asɛm biara a wohyia wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ho dwuma. Kae sɛ wo awofoɔ wɔ hɔ sɛ wɔrebɛboa wo na wɔama wo akwankyerɛ bere a worefa abɛɛfo  wiase no mu na woresusu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ahobammɔ ne akwahosan wom ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi afa so ahwehwɛ wɔn nna ne wɔn akɔnnɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Afotu bi a ɛbɛma woatumi ahwehwɛ nneɛma a ahobammɔ wom na ahoɔden wom ni: Wo ho a wobɛhwehwɛ: Sua wo nipadua ne nea wote nka sɛ eye denam wo ho a wode bɛhyɛ wo ho ne wo ho a wode bɛka wo ho so. Nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee: Wo ne ɔpanyin anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa mfa wo nsɛmmisa ne wo haw ahorow ho. Hwehwɛ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a ɛnyɛ honam fam de mu: Dada, atuu, ne nkate mu abusuabɔ nyinaa yɛ nna mu nneɛma a ɛho hia. Mpene: Bere nyinaa gye pene a anigye wom ansa na woayɛ nna biara. Kae sɛ nna mu asetra a ahoɔden wom fa anigye, nkitahodi, ne obu ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbabun no te nka sɛ wɔama no tumi sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn nna mu wɔ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom na wɔboa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ me ne me duruyɛfo susu ho fa m’akwahosan ho ansa na mafi ase asiw nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Ansa na wobefi awo ano aduru biara ase no, ka w’akwahosan ho abakɔsɛm akyerɛ wo duruyɛfo no pefee na ka nokware. Nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusu ho ni: Ayaresa tebea biara a wowɔ Nnuru a worenom W’abusua akwahosan ho abakɔsɛm W’asetra kwan ne nna mu nneyɛe
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo betumi abom ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun nyinaa tumi ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ahwɛ sɛ mmabun nyinaa bɛnya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie pɛpɛɛpɛ denam: Wɔbɛboa nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan hokwan ne nnwuma a wɔbɛnya di kan. Sika ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa, akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ a ɛsom mmabun. Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ foforɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom bɔ mu de di akwansideɛ a ɛmma wontumi nnya na wɔhyɛ nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ ho dwuma. Mmabun tumi a wɔde bɛma wɔn ma wɔakamfo wɔn ankasa ahiade ne wɔn hokwan ahorow denam nhomasua, akannifo nkɔso, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim so. Akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmabun ahiade ne osuahu ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi sika boɔ wɔ nyinsɛn ne mmofra hwɛ ho no ho? (aban mmoa, sika a wɔde ma wɔ adesua mu) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛboa sikasɛm ni: Ebia Ghana aban nam asetena mu yiedi dwumadibea no so de nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛma mmusua a wonnya sika pii, a wɔn a wɔwɔ mma ka ho. Ahyehyɛde ahorow bi de sika a wɔde boa awofo a wonnii mfe aduonu titiri ma. Yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ Intanɛt so na hwɛ nea ebia ɛwɔ hɔ. ɔman no akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe no nso tua nyinsɛn ne awo ho ka ma nnipa nyinaa a mmabun ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu mu ɔyarehwɛfo/ɔfotufo. GHS-YMK App (cyber afotufo).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne nsɛnnennen bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahohorow yi ase?
answer_twi_source: Bere a mpɛn pii no nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ adeyɛ a ahobammɔ wom bere a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn na wɔyɛ wɔ ayaresabea no, asiane ne nsɛnnennen a ebetumi aba te sɛ ɔyare mmoawa, mogya a ɛtɔ dodo, anaa awotwaa no mu opira wɔ hɔ. Mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase denam ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi wɔn a wɔfata hɔ, akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ ayaresa akyi a wobedi akyi, ne bere a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn akyi senea wɔkamfo kyerɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔhyɛ me sɛ memfa me ho nhyɛ nna mu agodie a ahobammɔ bia nni mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ma obia nhu wo nhyehyɛeɛ a w'ayɛ ama wo ho 'boundaries' na si gyinaeɛ sɛ bammɔ ho hia ma wo. Gye afotuo ne mmoa fi w'abusuafoɔ anaa afotubɔfoɔ bi hɔ. Sɛ nhyɛ no boro wo so a, dwen wo yieyɛɔ ne wo bammɔ ho na twe wo fo fi wɔn nkyɛn. Kai sɛ wo ho kwan sɛ wo bɛɔka daabi akyerɛ nea ɛmmɔ wo ho ban biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de obu adi nkitaho wɔ adwene ahorow a ɛsonosonoe demu wɔ nna ne awo apomoden ho wɔ mea ankasa amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Tie: Fi ase denam adwene ahorow a wubetie a wunni atɛn so. Bisa Nsɛm: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wuhu anaa wonte ase a, bisa nsɛm wɔ obu mu na ama woanya nhumu. Ka W’adwenkyerɛ: Da w’ankasa wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow adi wɔ obu mu, na gye tom sɛ ebia ɛsono afoforo adwene. Hwehwɛ Gyinabea baako: Hwehwɛ gyinapɛn anaa botae ahorow a ɛne ne ho hyia a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow ho a mubetumi asusuw ho na moasi so dua. Nhomasua: Ka sɛ wobɛkyɛ nna mu akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow ho nsɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ akasakasa so, na si hia a nhomasua ho hia ma obiara so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atoro anaa adwene bɔne bɛn na ɛtaa kɔ so wɔ ahokyere mmoa wɔ telefon so 'crisis helplines', na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔatu atoro yi ase na wɔahyɛ mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ho nimdeɛ nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Atoro anaa adwene bɔne no bi ne sɛ pii noa nni gyidie ɛwɔ 'crisis helpline'; gye sɛ ahokyere a "emu yɛ den" nko ara. Pii so gyedi sɛ hotline adwumayɛfoɔ nni nteteeɛ pa. Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔatu atoro yi ase denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛka afa crisis hotlines ho, te sɛ wɔn kɔkoam nhyehyɛeɛ, nteteeɛ ne nimdeɛ a adwumayɛfoɔ no wɔ, ne nsɛm ahorow a wɔbetumi ama mmoa wɔ ho. Wɔbetumi nso aka ankorankoro nsɛm anaa adanseɛ a efi nkurɔfoɔ a wɔfrɛɛ mmoa ntelefon na ɛboaa wɔn hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua ne nhumu so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Nnipa Taa Fom Dwene Fa Nyinsɛn-Tu Akyi Hwɛ (Post-Abortion Care) Ho: Atoro (Myth): Nyinsɛn-tu akyi hwɛ ho hia mma nipadua mu ahomegyeɛ nko ara.Atoro (Myth): Nyinsɛn-tu akyi hwɛ nsom bo ɛfiri sɛ nyinsɛn-tu yɛ nneyɛeɛ a asiane biara nnim.Atoro (Myth): Sɛ wope nyinsɛn-tu akyi hwɛ a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo nsa aka nea woayɛ no.Wobɛtumi de nteteeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ asiesie saa atoro nsɛm yi denam:Amanneɛbɔ a ɛdi mu a wɔde bɛma fa sɛnea nyinsɛn-tu akyi hwɛ som bo ma nipadua mu ahoɔden ne adwene mu nkateɛ yiedie (emotional well-being).Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde bɛma sɛ, nyinsɛn-tu akyi hwɛ a obi hwehwɛ no yɛ gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom de hwɛ na obi nsa aka ayaresa ne mmoa a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi nsɛnnennen te sɛ animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akyigyina ho dwuma bere a wɔko ama nna ne awo hokwan ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen te sɛ animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akyigyina bere a wɔko nna ne awo hokwan ahorow no. Sɛ wɔbɛtumi adi saa nsɛnnennen yi so a, wɔbɛtumi ayɛ nkitahodiɛ a ɛboa, de abasɛm ne ankorankoro asɛm adi dwuma de ayɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nnipa ho, de nkitahodiɛ akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma adi dwuma, ne ayɔnkofoɔ ayɛ adwuma abom, na wɔde sohyial media ne digyital nhyiamu adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛseɛ na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a me de besua pii afa ayɔnkofa ho nneyɛe a ɛfata ne nneyɛe a mɛkwati sɛ mɛhyɛ obi so ho? (adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu fotufoɔ anaa nea broni ka no 'sickbay' ɔyarehwɛfoɔ bɛtumi aboa wo wɔ nneɛma a ɛfa GBV ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne gyidi ahorow boa ma nsonsonoe ba nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu wɔ mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne gyidi ahorow boa ma nsonsonoe ba nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu wɔ mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu wɔ  suban, nneyɛe, ne nnwuma a wobenya so. Amammerɛ mu nneɛma te sɛ animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ho, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho no betumi aka sɛnea mmabun tumi hwehwɛ nsɛm, nya nnwuma, na wosi wɔn akwahosan ho gyinae wɔ wɔn ankasa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nhwɛsoɔ na ɛkyerɛ nnwuma anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi mu a ɛhyɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛboa mmabun  a wɔdi  nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Kan no na mmoa ahorow bi wɔ hɔ ma nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ akuw nanso bere a wɔapene nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Anti-gay mmara no akyi no, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn dwumadi ahorow no yɛ nea mmara mma ho kwan. Nanso, saa nnipa yi betumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ adwumayɛbea biara akasa bere nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛ mmra kwan so anammɔntuo  ahodoɔ bi a watu a awie pɛyɛ anaa sɛ wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmabun ho ban wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwanya, deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'sexual and reproductive right' ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne: Mmara bɔne a wɔyi firi hɔ. Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma mmabun nya ayaresa. Nhwɛsoɔ: wɔbɔ dawuro foa nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ so, kwan a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nneɛma a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ berɛ a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔdi mpa so agorɔ, ɛko tia nyisɛnyiguo mu nyiyimu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmrakofoɔ ne mpɔtamfoɔ ne mmabun bom yɛ adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow bom yɛ adwuma de di STI/HIV ano a wosiw ho dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Aban ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ bom yɛ adwuma de di STI/HIV ano aduru ho dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa denam akwan ahodoɔ so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ɔman no HIV/AIDS ho nhyehyɛeɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛne wiase nyinaa botaeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛho hia a ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa HIV/AIDS ho (UNAIDS) de asi hɔ no hyia na wɔde bedi dwuma. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, mfiridwuma ho mmoa, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ tumi a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu den, atrɛw akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nnwuma a wɔde siw ano, na ama nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano ne nea wɔhwɛ so no atu mpɔn. Nnipa hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ nnyinasosɛm atitiriw a wɔde siw STI/HIV ano, a mmara ne nhyehyɛe akwanside ahorow a ɛmma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nyiyim a wobedi ho dwuma ka ho. Ɔmanfoɔ nnwumakuo, mpɔtam akuo, ne nnipa a ɛka wɔn a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de ahwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesie, nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu a nteaseɛ wom. Nhwehwɛmu, nnoɔma foforɔ, ne nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ de ama akwan a egyina adanseɛ so a wɔfa so siw STI/HIV ano no anya nkɔsoɔ na wɔadi nsunsuanso ne hokwan a ɛreba wɔ abɔnten so no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyɛ me botae ne suahunu akyerɛ afoforɔ, te sɛ ɛnam atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, sohyial media, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu so, de ahyɛ afoforo nkuran na akanyan wɔn, ahwehwɛ afotuo anaa nsɛm a wɔka, na manya atenka sɛ meyɛ obiako ne baakoyɛ wɔ akwahosan botaeɛ a wɔbom di akyi?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so kyɛ botaeɛ ne suahu ne afoforɔ bi ne: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo a wɔde wo ho bɛka ho: Fa wo ho hyɛ mmoa akuo a atipɛnfoɔ di anim anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu a wobɛtumi akyɛ osuahu, ahwehwɛ afotuo, na wode mmoa ama afoforɔ a wɔredi akwahosan botaeɛ a ɛte saa ara akyi. Social media a wode bedi dwuma: Kyɛ wo botae ne nkɔso wɔ social media platform ahorow so de kanyan afoforo na kanyan afoforo, fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ntease wom mu, na wo ne ankorankoro a wɔwɔ adwene koro di nkitaho. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu: Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a ɛtwe adwene si nna ne awoɔ akwahosan so mu de kyɛ osuahu, sesa adwene, na nya biakoyɛ ho adwene wɔ akwahosan botaeɛ a wɔbom di akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na abusua mu haw te sɛ ntɔkwaw anaa awaregu ka mmabun, na mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛde adwene mu haw, ehu, ne gyerɛgyerɛyɛ ba. Mmoa: Afotu (Counseling), Mmoa kuo, Mpɔtam mmoa ne beae a asomdwoe wɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so di adwene a enhyia anaa ntawntawa ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho dwuma wɔ obu ne nkɔso kwan so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ worefa adwene a enhyia anaa ntawntawdi a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho a, ɛho hia sɛ wode tema, pefeeyɛ, ne obu bɛma adwene ahorow bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne afoforo adwene a wɔde nsiyɛ tie, kwati sɛ wobesusuw nneɛma ho anaasɛ wobebu atɛn, na wɔahwehwɛ nea wobegyina so abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛma denhyɛ. Ɛboa nso sɛ wode "Me" nsɛm bedi dwuma de ada ankorankoro nkate ne osuahu ahorow adi sen sɛ wode asodi bɛto hɔ anaasɛ wobɛka nsɛm a ɛfa biribiara ho. Ntamgyinafoɔ anaa mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afiri ahwɛfoɔ anaa afotufoɔ a wɔatete wɔn hɔ nso bɛtumi ayɛ mfasoɔ wɔ ntawntawdie a wɔbɛsiesie wɔ obuo kwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nsɛm a edi mu fi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ fa akwan horow a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn gu ne asiane ahorow ho so dua.
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a wo ne no bɛkasa no ho hia na ama woanya nsɛm a edi mu afa akwan horow a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn gu ne asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ho. Wobetumi abua wo nsɛmmisa, asusuw w’ankorankoro tebea ho, na wɔaboa wo ma woahu ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom sen biara a wobɛfa so. Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana betumi ayɛ mfiase, nanso wobɛtumi nso ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ, anaa akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ a ɔwɔ teh youth center anaa health facility akasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Kaa a wonni, Sikasɛm mu anohyeto ahorow, Animtiaabu ne nyiyimu, Nim a wɔ nnim nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho, Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow (sɛ nhwɛso no, mfe a wɔadi anohyeto, awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn anaa atetesɛm ahorow bi a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Awareɛ a Wɔhyehyɛ: Amammerɛ bi mu no, awareɛ a mmaninfoɔ hyehyɛ ma wɔn mma na ɛdɔɔso; ɛha no, mmusua na wɔgye ba panin wɔ obi a wɔbɛware no ho. Mmarima ne Mmaa Dwumadie: Amammerɛ pii wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ nea ɔbarima ne ɔbaa biara fɛre sɛ ɔyɛ; te sɛ mmarima a wɔbu wɔn sɛ wɔne ntifi, na mmaa nso yɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase.Abaawa-di (Anaa Ababun-di): Amammerɛ bi bu aware-anim nna-apaemam kɛse; eyi hyɛ nnipa pii so ma wɔtwentwɛn wɔn ho firi nna ho kɔsi awareɛ mu.Anuonyam ne Aniwuo: Amammerɛ bi si abusua anuonyam so dua yie; wɔbu nna mu nneyɛeɛ sɛ ɛno na ɛbɛkyerɛ sɛ abusua bi din bɛsɛe anaa ɛbɛhyerɛ.Mmarima ne Mmaa mu Atirimuoden: Amammerɛ bi mu no, nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ atirimuoden firi ɔbarima kɔ ma ɔbaa (anaa ɔbaa kɔ ma ɔbarima) ho no, wɔbu no sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee; eyi sɛe awareɛ mu nkitahodeɛ ne apɔwmuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm te sɛ nsusuwii hunu, asɛm a wɔka, ne animtiaabu, wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow, a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mu denam sɛnea saa gyinabea ahorow yi betumi ama nsusuwii hunu akɔ so atena hɔ, ayɛ ankorankoro asɛm, anaasɛ abɔ akuw bi animtiaa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu no so. Wobetumi agye akyinnye sɛ ebia mfonini no yɛ obu ne nokware, sɛ ebia ɛhyɛ gyinapɛn ahorow anaa animhwɛ a epira mu den, ne sɛ ebia ɛma wonya adwene a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛkari pɛ. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu yiye so no, mmabun betumi abɛyɛ adetɔfo a wɔwɔ nhumu kɛse na wɔakamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho mfonini ahorow a ɛfata akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyɛso nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtwam te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nyiyim, ne kuw mu nyiyim nya awo ho atɛntrenee a mmabun nya no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nhyɛso nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtwam te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nyiyim, kuw mu nyiyim, ableism, ne mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan no ma akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi mmu awo ho atɛntrenee mma mmabun no yɛ kɛse. Saa tumi horow a ɛhyɛ nkurɔfo so yi ma nsonsonoe ba nneɛma a wonya, apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe, nhomasua, ne hokwan ahorow a wobenya mu, na ɛka akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na media ho nimdeɛ te sɛ nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔsɛe no, fibea a wɔhwehwɛ mu, ne adwene a wɔfa so boa mmabun ma wohu na wɔsɛe asɛm a epira, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne nsɛmmɔnedi a ɛma asetena mu ntɛnkyea ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kɔ so no?
answer_twi_source: Asɛm a Ɛpira a Wɔhaw: media nimdeɛ te sɛ nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔsɛe no, fibea a wɔhwehwɛ mu, ne adwene a wɔde fa nneɛma mu ma mmabun tumi hu na wɔsɛe asɛm a epira, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne nsɛmmɔnedi a ɛma asetena mu ntɛnkyea ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kɔ so no. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu yie so no, mmabun betumi ahu animhwɛ, akasa atia nsusuii hunu, na wɔahu tumi a ɛhyɛ ase a ɛma asetena mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu "bystander intervention" di wɔ amammerɛ a ɛfa pene, obu, ne akontaabu "accountability" ho a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu, mpɔtam, ne asetra mu tebea afoforo mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ denam wɔn nneyɛe so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔhwɛ no a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu di dwuma titiriw wɔ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so, obu, ne akontaabu "accountability" ho bi ne nneyɛe a epira " harmful behaviours" a wɔkasa tia, wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa a wɔboa wɔn, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no a wobu akontaa no so. Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ denam wɔn nneyɛe so denam obu a wɔde yɛ nneyɛe ho nhwɛso, kasa a wɔbɛkasa atia basabasayɛ ne ɔhaw ahorow, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛboa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ pene a wɔpene so ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ntetee ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ mmabun adwenemyare ho nsɛm ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ awofo nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ nsɛm mfi mmeae a agye din te sɛ adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow hɔ. Fa nyansahyɛ ma sɛ awofo nkɔ nhyiam ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, anaa awofo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ ne mmoa so. Kamfo adwenemyareɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ na ama nhumu ne nteaseɛ akɔ soro wɔ awofoɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ho kwan na ne wɔ sɛ ɔyarefo 'patient'?
answer_twi_source: Obu ne pɛyɛ. Gyinaesie (consent). Kokoam-yɛ (Privacy). Nimdeɛ a emu da hɔ. Wubetumi aka wo haw. Hwɛ adwenkyerɛ foforo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfeɛ ho mmara anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmofra a wɔn mfeɛ rekɔ anim (adolescents) nya ansa na wɔatumi anya mmoa wɔ intanɛt so (online crisis intervention)?
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ anohyetoɔ anaa ahwehwɛdeɛ a ɛfa intanɛt so ahokyere mu dwumadie a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no gu ahodoɔ gyina asɛnka agua anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛde mmoa no ma no so. Ebia nnwuma bi wɔ mfe a wɔadi a ɛba fam koraa ho nhyehyɛe anaasɛ awofo pene ho nhyehyɛe, bere a afoforo nso betumi abue ama mmabun a wɔadi mfe ahorow nyinaa a anohyeto biara nni ho. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hwɛ sɛnea wɔfata wɔ ɔsom biara a wosusuw sɛ wobenya mu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na nnipa binom bɛyɛ mmabun ntɛm sen afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Bere a obi babunbere bɛhyɛ ase yɛ soronko ma onipa biara, na nneɛma pii betumi anya bere a efi ase no so nkɛntɛnso: Awosu mu nneɛma (genetics): Wo genes di dwuma titiriw wɔ bere a ababunbere befi ase. Sɛ w’awofo bɛyɛɛ mmabun ntɛm anaa akyiri a, ɛda adi wɔ womu. Aduandi ne Apɔwmuden: Aduan pa wodie ne w'apɔwmuden nyinaa betumi aboa onyin ne nkɔso a ɛfata. Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia: Sɛ obi de ne ho hyɛ nnuru bi mu, adwennwen, ne nneɛma afoforo a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a, ebetumi atwe bere a obi bɛyɛ babun akɔ akyire. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛkae sɛ nneɛma ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata. Sɛ bere a wobɛyɛ wo babun ho asɛm haw wo a, etwa sɛ wo ne ɔyaresafo bɛkasa, ebetumi ama woanya awerɛhyem ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa STI nhwehwɛmu ho, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua ne nhumu so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm no bi ne sɛ; STI nhwehwɛmu hia wɔ mmerɛ a yareɛ no nnsɛnkyerɛnee da adi pɛ. Yareɛ no de animguase ne aniwu ba. Bio so wɔn a wɔ taa ne nkorɔfo deda na anya bi. Nwomasua ne nhumu betumi ate saa anansesɛm bebree yi so. Etwa animtaibu soɔ, na ɛma obia hu sɛ STI yareɛ ho hia ma obia. Akanyan nkɔmmɔdidie fa nhwehwɛ mu no ho ma obia te aseɛ sɛ animguasesɛm biara nnim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa aboafo nneɛma ma nnwuma a mmabun di anim, atuhoama hokwan ahorow, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase.
answer_twi_source: sukuu sickbay ayarehwɛfoɔ anaa Sukuu afotufoɔ bɛtumi de mmoa ama wɔ nneɛma a ɛfa GBV ho sɛ ɛno ne deɛ wopɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na awofoɔ ne abusua mmoa kyerɛ wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nna ho, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Mmusua a wɔboa no di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm asetra mu: Ahobammɔ Beae: Ma tebea a ahobammɔ ne ɔdɔ wom a mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ wɔn nna mu a wonni atɛn. Ahotoso ne Ne Ho a Wobu: Mmoa a abusua de ma no ma ahotoso ne obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho no yɛ kɛse, na ɛma mmabun tumi di yiye. Nsɛm a Wɔkamfo ne akwannya a Wɔwɔ: Mmusua betumi ayɛ wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn mma akwannya  ahorow ne wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔn ho akyerɛ wɔn denneennen. Abusua mmoa a wonnya no betumi de ɔhaw ahorow aba ɔbabun yiyedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So kɔndɔm a mede bedi dwuma no betumi atew anigye a m’ani gye wɔ nna mu no so?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa binom hu sɛ kɔndɔm brɛ anigye ase kakraa bi, bere a afoforo nhu nsonsonoe biara. Kɔndɔm ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya; sɛ wuhu sɛ biako nyɛ wo dɛ a, wo ne wo hokafoɔ betumi asɔ afoforo ahwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mmabun sɛ wobetumi asua pii afa nna ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ho wɔ Ghana?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebi ne nhoma, intanɛt so nsɛm, nsɛm, ne nea ɛkeka ho ka ho de nya nna ho nsɛm. Biribi te sɛ, application foforɔ bi wɔ hɔ te sɛ YMK, Yenkasa ne Agoo she+, ne nyinaa wɔ PlayStore ne App Store.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa kwati a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho kyerɛ sɛ ɔkwan a ɛfata a mmabun paw a wonni atemmu.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ wɔbɛpaw sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi ho no yɛ gyinaesi a emu yɛ den na ɛho akokwaw. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛtwɛn akosi sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ woasiesie wo ho ama nna. Mma nte nka sɛ afoforɔ rehyɛ wo - ɛyɛ wo nipadua, wo paw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho ama mmara kwan so mmoa a wɔbɛpaw anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔbɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na nsɛm bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma mmaranimfo anaa wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya mmoa a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho ama mmara kwan so mmoa a wɔbɛpaw wɔn anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔbɔ wɔn ho ban denam: Nwoma a ɛfata a wɔbɛboaboa ano, te sɛ adansedi krataa, mmara mu nkrataa, ne adanse biara a ɛfa wɔn nsɛm ho. Nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wodi ho dwuma wɔ bere a wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe no mu a wɔbɛkyerɛw ato hɔ. Wɔn tebea ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛma, a nna, din, ne akyi nsɛm biara a ɛfata ka ho. Nokware ne wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔn ahiade, botae ahorow, ne nea wɔpɛ wɔ mmara mu mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Awoɔ ho nhyehyeɛn ahorow sɛn (birth control) na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ family planning mu?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne: Akwan a ɛsiw kwan (Condoms). Hormones (Nnuro, ne nea yɛwɔ ho paneɛ 'injections'). Deɛ ɛtena hɔ kyɛ (IUDs, implants). Deɛ ɛyɛ buruburoo (Sterilization). Emergency contraception (Sɛ asiane aba a). Afotufoɔ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔehu nea ɛyɛ ma wɔn .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo me ho na masi gyinae wɔ me nipadua ho, a mente nka sɛ wɔabu me atɛn? (hia a ɛho hia sɛ obi bu ne ho) .
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho a Wofata: Kae wo ho sɛ ɛnyɛ nea wopaw na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wosom bo. Ɛfata sɛ wusi gyinae wɔ wo nipadua ho a wommu wo ho atɛn. Fa w’ahiade ne w’ahye a wobɛka akyerɛ afoforo pefee no di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya obuo a ɛfata ma me ho ne ahotoso a mede besisi gyinae wɔ m’ankasa me nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa w’adwene si w’ahoɔden ne nea woatumi ayɛ so: Dɛn na wo yɛade wɔ mu? Di wo nkonimdi ahorow ho afahyɛ! Fa botae ahorow sisi w’ani so: Twa wo ho mpoa nanso nsiesie wo ho mma huammɔdi. Nya abusuabɔ pa: Fa nnipa a wɔwɔ adwempa na wɔboa wo ho twa wo ho hyia. Fa hwɛ a wobɛhwɛ wo ho di dwuma: Hwɛ wo nipadua ne w’adwene mu akwahosan so. Gye wo ho di: Wofata obu na wowɔ hokwan sɛ w’ankasa wopaw nea wopɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kasa bɛn na intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow, a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow boa de hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun a wɔyɛ ahorow ahorow betumi anya bi?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow taa boa kasa ahorow pii de hwɛ hu sɛ, mmabun a wɔyɛ ahorow ahorow betumi anya bi. Wobetumi de mmoa ama wɔ kasa horow a wɔtaa ka wɔ ɔmantam no mu mu anaasɛ wɔde nsɛm asekyerɛ adwuma anaa adwumayɛfo a wɔka kasa ahorow bɛma de agye ankorankoro a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde kasa foforo a ɛnyɛ kasa titiriw a ɔsom no de di dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma awofo abɔ mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwuma no amanneɛ anaasɛ wɔpene so?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa awofo amanneɛbɔ anaa pene a wɔpene so ma mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no gu ahorow gyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Wɔ mmeae bi no, ebia wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwuma no bɔ awofo amanneɛ anaasɛ wɔpene so, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no amanneɛ anaa wonya kwan ansa na wɔayɛ oprehyɛn no. Nanso, wɔ mmeae afoforo no, ebia mmofra nkumaa betumi anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe wɔ kokoam a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu. Ɛho hia sɛ wote mmara ne nhyehyɛe pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa awofo amanneɛbɔ anaa pene a wɔpene so ma mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo anaa abusua mufo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɔhaw a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareɛ wosiw ano, ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ano?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ anaa abusua mufoɔ bɛtumi aboa denam: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano, nna mu yareɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛboa, a nyinsɛn ano aduru ne nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Gyinaesi a asɛde wom ne nneyɛe a ɛfata a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Mmabun ahofadi ne nea wɔpaw wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛkyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehyia twaka "relationship" mu nsɛnnennen anaa ayayade?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wohyia abusuabɔ mu nsɛnnennen anaa ayayade. Eyinom bi ne ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, afotu adwuma, mmoa akuw, ne intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmerante ne mmabaa titiriw. Ahyehyɛde te sɛ "Planned Parenthood" de kokoam mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa, pene, ne sɛnea wobehu ayayade na wɔadi ho dwuma ho ma. Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nso betumi de akwankyerɛ ama na wɔaboa ma wɔde nneɛma a ɛfata abɔ mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoeɛ bɛn na ɛda mmarima ne mmaa awoɔ ho akwahosan mfiridwuma (reproductive system) ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima ne mmea awo nhyehyɛe wɔ nhyehyɛe ne dwumadi ahorow: Mmarima Awoɔ Ho Akwaa: Ɛbi ne hwowa (testes), 'vas deferens', 'prostate gland', ne kɔtɛ (penis). Ne dwumadie titiriw ne sɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ɛde maba (sperm) akɔ baabi a ɛsɛ.Mmaa Awoɔ Ho Akwaa: Ɛbi ne nkosua-dan (ovaries), 'fallopian tubes', awotwaa (uterus/womb), ne twɛ (vagina). Ne dwumadie titiriw ne sɛ ɛbɛyɛ nkosua, ɛbɛma baabi ama maba ne nkosua ahyia (fertilization), na ɛbɛboa ma akokoaa (fetus) anyini wɔ yafunu mu wɔ nyem (pregnancy) mmere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa atia ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw mu  wɔ : Suban ne kasa a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho nhwɛso a wɔbɛka atia aseresɛm anaa nsɛm a wɔka a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho nkuran a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsonsonoe ahorow ho mfonini pa a wɔbɛboa atipɛnfo a wɔda wɔn ho adi nokwarem na wɔkasa tia mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ afotu ne apomoden wo adwenemu ho di wɔ afotu adwuma a mmabun betumi anya mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfoɔ adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ afotuo ne adwenemyareɛ ho no bɛtumi anya afotuo dwumadie a mmabun nya so nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ denam: Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho a wɔbɛbu wɔn animtiaa, a ɛbɛma wɔmpɛ anaa aniwuo wɔ afotuo dwumadie a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛma atra hɔ wɔ adwenemyare ne afotu ho, te sɛ nea wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛwyɛ anaa huammɔdi ho sɛnkyerɛnne. Nkɛntɛnso a wobenya wɔ afotu adwuma a ɛfata na ɛyɛ atinka a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nipasu ahorow. Nhyehyɛe ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma a wɔde di kan a ebia ɛbɛma nipadua akwahosan adi kan sen adwenemyare anaasɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ nneɛma a ɛnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ a egyina ɔmanfo animhwɛ so. Mmoa hwehwɛ nneyɛe ne nea wɔpɛ a ɛbɛka wɔn, a amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo akuw binom taa nya afotu adwuma a egyina amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne suban so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya kokoam mmoa dwumadi ne nneɛma a wɔde boa? (sɛ nhwɛso no, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, mmeae a wɔhwɛ ɔhaw ahorow, ayaresa ho animdefo)
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm dwumadi bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ 24/7 a ɛbɛboa, te sɛ YMK app, a ɛde intanɛt so afotufoɔ a wɔatete wɔn a wɔanya ntɛm. Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo na wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ mmabun adamfofa su no nkasa Ayaresafo: Wobetumi de mmoa a ɛfa adwumayɛfo ho ama na wɔaboa wo ma woadi nea esii no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no betumi ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ, nhomasua, ne nhumu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ pene, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, 'STI' ano a wosiw, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no bɛtumi ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie, nwomasua, ne nhumu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ pene, nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano, STI a wɔsiw ano, ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran denam: Nhyiamu, nhyiamu, ne nkɔmmɔdie a atipɛnfoɔ di anim a ɛbɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a ɛfata mfeɛ a wɔadi na ama mmabun anya adwene a ɛyɛ den. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, sini a wɔyi, ne adwini ho ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛhwehwɛ 'ASRH' nsɛm mu firi adwene ahodoɔ mu na ɛkasa tia adwene a ɛnteɛ ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔyɛ. Nhomasua nneɛma, nhomawa, ne nkrataa a wɔde bɛkyekyɛ wɔ kasa ne akwan horow pii mu de akɔ atiefo ahorow nkyɛn na wɔadi akwanside ahorow a ɛfa akenkan ne akyerɛw ne akwan a wɔfa so nya nneɛma ho dwuma. Awo ntoatoaso ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ mmabun, awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpanyimfo ntam a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran de ahyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease, tema, ne mmoa a ɛfa 'ASRH' nsɛm ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ media mu nneɛma a wɔyɛ, abasɛm a wɔka, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkorɔfo akyi a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma nne ne osuahu ahorow a wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu yie a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu akwahosan akuo, dwumadi ahorow a ɛnyɛ adesua, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si media adwuma, anaa kasamafo. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne social media ɔsatuo a ɛto nsa frɛ ntoboa firi mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa hɔ na ɛma hokwan sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn adwene. Afotuo nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, ne akuo a wɔkamfo nkorɔfo a wɔde ntetee ne mmoa ma wɔ media adwuma ahorow a mmabun di anim de ma. Nnwuma a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ adwumfo, siniyɛfo, mediafo, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma bom yɛ a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho na ɛhyɛ asetena mu nsakrae ho nkuran denam media so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka a wobesusuw ho anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde benya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ nea wɔde yɛ, beae, ne insurance a wɔde tua ho ka so. Nanso, mpɛn pii no, sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde boa ankorankoro ma wonya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm a wɔtew so anaasɛ wontua hwee. Ebia nhyehyɛe ahorow yi bi ne: Medicaid anaa ɔmanfo apomoden ho insurance a wɔde tua nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ ho ka. Nnuru a wɔtew so anaasɛ coupon ahorow a nnwumakuw anaa nnurutɔnbea ahorow de ma. Abusua nhyehyɛe ayaresabea anaa awo apomoden asoɛe ahorow a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ ma wɔ bo a wɔatew so anaasɛ wotua a ɛkɔ fam a egyina sika a wonya so. Ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa adɔe akuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ ma ankorankoro a wohia mmoa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nyinsɛn a woyi gu wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ baabi a mete no? (Eyi ho hia sɛ wobua a, egyina beae a wowɔ so)
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ mmara kwan so wɔ Ghana wɔ tebea ahorow bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne osi akwan ahorow a ɛwɔ mmara kwan so mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi, na sɛ wɔn ahiade boro nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ no so a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya mmoa anaa nneɛma foforo?
answer_twi_source: Osi akwan a ɛwɔ mmara mu mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfoɔ ho dwumadie mu no bi betumi ayɛ: Nnwuma a wontua hwee anaa ɛho ka sua a ɛwɔ hɔ kakraa bi, titire wɔ mpɔtam a wɔmfa mmoa mma anaa mmara mu nsɛm titire ho. Tumi osi akwan ahorow a ebetumi aka tumi a mmara ho adwumayɛfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo wɔ sɛ wɔde mmoa a edi mũ bɛma ankorankoro a wohia mmoa nyinaa. Mmabun betumi anya mmoa anaa nneɛma foforo wɔ: Akwan foforo a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa, te sɛ intanɛt so nneɛma, akwankyerɛ a wɔde boa wɔn ho, anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmara ayaresabea ahorow. Hwehwɛ a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn afiri mmeaeɛ a wɔgye wɔn di, te sɛ asetena mu adwumayɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, a ebia wɔbɛtumi de wɔn abata mmoa dwumadie foforɔ ho. Sika a wɔde bɛma, nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nkɔanim wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ de adi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ mmara mu mmoa ne nnwuma a wɔde gyina nkurɔfo akyi no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a asiane bi ato wɔn anaa wɔwɔ dɛmdi bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Guidelines for Integrating ASRH in Humanitarian Action. Ɛsi pɛyɛ (equity) ne nkabom (inclusion) so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no kokoam nsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmara bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no kokoamsɛm ho ban, te sɛ:  akwaahosan adwumayɛbea no nhyehyɛe, Ghana Akwaahosan Dwumadibea no gyinapɛn ne nhyehyɛe ahorow, a ɛde gyinapɛn ahorow si hɔ ma akwaahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi hu ankorankoro no ho ban. awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe nso wɔ hɔ, a ɛhwɛ ma wɔde kokoamsɛm sie mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ awoɔ nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wodwene sɛ adɔkotafoɔ betumi afa ama woate nneɛma ahodoɔ a wobetumi ayi bi afiri mu sɛ ɛba no nyinsɛn mu a asane nso aboa ama woayi deɛ ɛyɛ a ɛbɛboa wo wɔ woapɔmden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ ne afutuo (nyisɛnyiguo/ bateɛ/bahwɛ). apɔmden mu akwankyerɛ(ɔhaw ne mfasoɔ). Bammɔ. Mmeammea a wɔbɛma wo mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma na wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho sika a edi mu ama?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, insurance nhyehyɛe pɔtee biara nni hɔ ma mmabun, nanso, wɔ mmeae afoforo no, Akwahosan insurance nhyehyɛe anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi betumi de sika titiriw bi ama a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho. Ebia eyinom bi ne Medicaid, CHIP (Mmofra Akwahosan Insurance Dwumadi), ne gua so nhyehyɛe ahorow bi a ɛma wonya sika a wɔde tua ho ka nyinaa ma nnwuma a wɔde siw yare ano, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ka ho. Bio nso, aman bi wɔ nhyehyɛe anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun anya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran wɔ apomoden ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobedi nea yɛ frɛ no LGBTQ+ mmabun ne wɔn a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu ahiade ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne ahodoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ apomoden ho mmeaeɛ a ɛfata mmabun no fa akwan ahodoɔ bi ho: Amammerɛ mu ahoɔden nteteeɛ: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ nya nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nteaseɛ ne obuo a wɔde ma wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu, a LGBTQ+ nipasu ka ho. Kasa ne nkitahodi: Hwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de kasa a ɛka obiara ho ne nkitahodi akwan a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun nyinaa nipasu ne osuahu ahorow bedi dwuma. Nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ho: Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa na ɛsi LGBTQ+ mmabun so dua pefee, te sɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa yɛ ne obuo a wɔde ma wɔ edin ne edinnsiananmu a wɔapaw no a wɔde bedi dwuma. Nnanmusifo ne nea wotumi hu: Tebea a wɔma akwaaba a ɛda mmabun dodow a egu ahorow adi denam nsɛnkyerɛnne, nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm, ne adesua nneɛma a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛbɔ. Ɔhwɛ a wotumi nya: Nnwuma a mmabun a wofi mmusua ahorow nyinaa mu betumi anya bi a wɔde bɛma, a wɔn a wɔadi dɛm, wɔn kasa mu akwanside, anaa sikasɛm mu ahokyere ka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ fekubɔ: Wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no bɛyɛ adwuma abom de adi akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no ahiadeɛ pɔtee ho dwuma na wɔahwɛ sɛ apomoden ho dwumadie no bɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ pɛ. Ɛdenam saa akwan yi a wɔde bedi dwuma so no, apomoden ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun betumi adi LGBTQ+ mmabun ne wɔn a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu ahiade ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ anaa sɛ ɔhaw ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛbetumi ato mmabun wɔberɛ a ɔrebɔ amanneɛ afa nna mu basabasayɛ ho anaa sɛ ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbetumi adi ɔhaw ahodoɔ yei nyinaa so nim na aboa ma wɔnya mmoa ne atɛntenenee?
answer_twi_source: Wɔhyia nsɛnnennen te sɛ: Ehu te sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn bɔne, aniwuo, anaa sɛ nkurɔfoɔ rennye wɔn nni. Ebia mmoa a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnya no nni hɔ anaa wɔsuro sɛ wɔn asɛm bɛba abɔnten. Sɛ wɔbɛgyina ano a, ɛhia akokoduro, ahoɔden, ne mmoa firi nkurɔfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Susu akwan a wobɛfa so agye obi a ɔnam ahokyere mu ne sɛnea wobɛyɛ ɔboafoɔ pa a ogyina afoforo akyi ho.
answer_twi_source: Asɛm no ano tew: Sɛ wuhu sɛ wɔrehaw obi wɔ Intanɛt so a, bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛtew tebea no so denam osisifo no adwene a wobɛtwetwe anaasɛ wobɛkyerɛ sɛ woboa nea wɔayɛ no basabasa no so. Fa Mmoa Ma: Kɔ nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no nkyɛn wɔ kokoam na fa mmoa ne nneɛma ma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na bere a wɔde hwɛ sini ne mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma 'technology' di wɔ sɛnea ɛka me nna wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere  mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Screen ahorow no ma hann bruu a ebetumi asiw nna mu ahoɔdennuru kwan. Anyɛ yiye koraa no, to screen bere ano hye dɔnhwerew biako ansa na woada, fa anadwo 'mode' di dwuma, anaa susuw ahwehwɛ bruu a esiw hann ano ho. Sɛ wode telefon a wokura kyin si kommyɛ so a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔasiw nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene ano bere a wɔada no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Henanom ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di a, metumi ne wɔn akasa afa nna mu akwahosan ho haw ne osuahu ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo/Ahwɛfo: Ebia wɔbɛyɛ nea eye sen biara, nanso sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, susuw akwan foforo a wubetumi afa so ho. Sukuu Ayarehwɛfoɔ/Afotufoɔ: Wɔyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn a, wɔbɛtumi de kokoam mmoa ne nneɛma ama.Mmabun adamfofa akwahosan ho dwumadie wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn hɔ: Wɔde kokoam nna mu akwahosan ho dwumadie ne afotuo ma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ adesua ne nsusuwii a ɛkɔ so mu de anya wɔn ntease wɔ intanɛt ne dijitaal abrabɔ pa ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ adesua ne nsusuwii a ɛkɔ so mu de anya wɔn ntease wɔ intanɛt ne digyital abrabɔ pa ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw adwumayɛbea ahorow, ntetee nhyiam ahorow, ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a sukuu ahorow, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow de ma mu, a ɛka nsɛmti te sɛ kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ, pene a wɔpene so, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne ɔman ba a wɔyɛ wɔ intanɛt so a wɔde asɛde di dwuma ho asɛm. Wɔn ankasa intanɛt so nneyɛe ne nsusuaso a enya wɔ afoforo so a wobesusuw ho, a wosusuw abrabɔ pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛwɔ wɔn nneyɛe, wɔn suban, ne nkitahodi akwan mu, ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso anaa nkɔso a wɔbɛkyerɛ. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi atipɛnfo, afotufo, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ wɔ wɔn intanɛt so nneyɛe ho, wɔde nsiyɛ tie adwene ne osuahu ahorow, na wɔde ɔkasatia a ɛma denhyɛ ka wɔn kwan a wɔfa so di dijitaal nkitahodi ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban ho. Nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so, nkɔsoɔ, ne akyinnyegyeɛ a ɛreba wɔ digyital abrabɔ pa ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛkɔ so anya, nhwehwɛmu, nwoma, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, na wɔasesa wɔn nneyɛeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛfata de ahyɛ nsakraeɛ pa ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bɛn na mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobenya adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛyɛ awerɛhow no, akwanside ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi ahyia berɛ a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobenya adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe no. Eyinom betumi ayɛ animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho, nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni, sikasɛm mu ahokyere, akwantu ho nsɛm, ne kokoamsɛm ho dadwen. Bio nso, ebia berɛ tenten bɛtwɛn ansa na wɔapaw wɔn anaasɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ho ayɛ na wɔ mmeae bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu ne nyiyimu ka ankorankora a wɔwɔ STI ne HIV, na dɛn na wobetumi ayɛ de ako atia animtiaabu wɔ ɔmanfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne nyiyimu betumi anya nkɛntɛnso bɔne kɛse wɔ ankorankoro a wɔwɔ STI ne HIV so, a aniwu, afobu, ehu, ne tew a wɔtew wɔn ho, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ne mmoa nnwuma ka ho. Sɛ yɛbɛko atia animtiaabuo wɔ ɔmanfoɔ mu a, ɛho hia sɛ wɔma nkurɔfoɔ te nka wɔ STI ne HIV ho, wɔkasa tia adwene a ɛntene ne adwene a ɛnteɛ, hyɛ tema ne nteaseɛ ho nkuran, de nsɛm ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛyɛ nokware ma, wɔkamfo nhyehyɛɛ ne mmara a ɛbɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ STI ne HIV hokwan ho ban, na wɔhyɛ tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa a obiara te nka sɛ ɛsom bo na wɔbu no a ne STI anaa HIV gyinabea mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wobu sɛ ɛfata ma me mfe?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ wo mfe mu no, ɛfata sɛ wusua mmabunbere, awo nipadua, brayɛ akwahosan (sɛ ɛfata a), nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wobɛpene so, abusuabɔ a ɛfata, ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne 'HIV' ano a wosiw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbetumi abisabisa yɛn ho yɛn ho daa de ahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn baanu nyinaa ho yɛ wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho wɔ yɛn abusua nkɔso mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa nhyehyɛe bi si hɔ a yɛde bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ yɛn ho yɛn ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn baanu nyinaa ho bɛtɔ yɛn wɔ sɛnea wɔredi kokoam nsɛm ho dwuma wɔ yɛn abusua mu nkɔso mu. Fa saa check-ins yi di dwuma sɛ hokwan a wode susuw nsɛm a ɛhaw wo anaa nsakrae biara a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho ahye ho, na di nsɛm biara a ebetumi asɔre ho dwuma. Kura nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nsakrae mu, na yɛ nsakrae wɔ yɛn kwan a yɛfa so yɛ no mu sɛnea ɛho hia na ama yɛahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi wo kokoam nsɛm so na wokura mu wɔ yɛn abusua no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ mepaw sɛ mɛtwe me ho fi nna dwumadi ho mprempren nanso mepɛ sɛ me ne obi da akyiri yi nso ɛ? Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ nsakrae dwoodwoo?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopaw sɛ wobɛtwe wo ho fi nna dwumadi ho mprempren nanso wusi gyinae sɛ wobɛda akyiri yi a, ɛho hia sɛ wode wo nna mu akwahosan ne wo yiyedi di kan. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, a kɔndɔm, awo ano aduru, ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ka ho, na ama woatumi asiw nyinsɛn a wonhyɛ da na woabɔ wo ho ban afi nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho. Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no mu kɔsusu akwan a wobɛfa so, nya akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wo ho, na nya akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛho hia, te sɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne afotuo a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano. Wo ne wo hokafo nni nkitaho pefee na fa nokwaredi di nkitaho fa w’adwene, wo hye, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ho, na hwɛ hu sɛ mo nyinaa te ase na mopene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow "support networks", na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka me gyinaesi nhyehyɛe, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ yɛ ankorankoro akuo a wɔkyɛ osuahu, nsɛnnennen, anaa anigyeɛ a ɛte saa ara na wɔbom de atinkayɔ mu mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nkuranhyɛ ma wɔn ho wɔn ho. Wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) ho no, atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow betumi anya gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso denam baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma mmabun asusuw nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn ho, akyɛ nsɛm, na wɔanya adansedi ne afotu afi atipɛnfo a wɔte wɔn suahu ase hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea efi akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ fam mu ba wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan mu nsunsuanso ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛba fam betumi ama wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho ntease a ɛnim anaasɛ nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nkorɛ, na ɛde nneyɛe a asane wom, nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ nnim, STI, ne awo mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow aba. Mmabun a wonnim akwahosan ho nimdeɛ pii no betumi ahyia ɔhaw wɔ akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ne nea wɔde fa so no mu, na ɛde ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ anaa ayaresa a ɛfata a wɔbɛkyɛ a ebetumi akum wɔn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso bɛn na awofo hwɛ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn so nya wɔ mmabun nna mu nneyɛe, asiane a wɔde to wɔn ho so, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbata so no so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo  bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne animhwɛ abɔ mu pɛpɛɛpɛ ama wɔn mma?
answer_twi_source: Awofo hwɛ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn so betumi anya mmabun nna mu nneyɛe, asiane a wɔde to wɔn ho so, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wodi so so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ mmabun a wohu sɛ awofo hwɛ wɔn so kɛse no ntaa mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu na wɔtaa de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma bere nyinaa. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ awofo kari pɛ wɔ hia a ehia sɛ wonya ahofadi ne ahofadi ne akwankyerɛ ne ɔhwɛ mu, bu mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne ahofadi bere a wɔde mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ma bere a ɛho hia no. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ahotoso a awofo ne mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho mu ho hia na ama wɔatumi adi saa nneɛma a ɛyɛ den yi so yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so ayɛ nnam bere a merenyin?
answer_twi_source: Anɔpa Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Fa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ntɛmntɛm te sɛ wo ho a wobɛtrɛw, yoga, anaa mmirikatu tiawa fi da no ase. Akwantu a Ɛyɛ Nna: Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, nantew, fa sakre, anaa skateboard kɔ sukuu. Ahomegye: Fa sukuu ahomegye bere di dwuma ma wo ne wo nnamfo nni agoru anaa di agoru denneennen. Sukuu Akyi Dwumadi: Kɔka agumadi akuw, asaw adesua, akodi, anaa dwumadi afoforo a ɛka adesua ho. Ofie Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Di apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ video anaa app ahorow a wɔde yɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ wɔ fie, te sɛ nipadua mu duru apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, yoga, anaa asaw nhyehyɛe ahorow akyi. Abusua Dwumadi: Mommom ntwa abusua, monkɔ nantew, nni agorɔ anaa mommom nguare. Breaks from Screens: yɛ jumping jacks, anaa saw nnwom a w’ani gye ho. Nnwuma: Ofie nnwuma te sɛ vacuum, popa, anaa turoyɛ betumi ayɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ. Dapɛn Awiei Akwantu: Yɛ abɔnten dwumadi ahorow te sɛ nantew, sakre so tena, anaa wo ne wo nnamfo anaa w’abusuafo mpue.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no mu, na wɔyɛ no foforo de hwɛ hu sɛ ɛda so ara fata na etu mpɔn, wɔ wɔn ahiade ne tebea ahorow a ɛresakra no ho dwuma a wodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe no mu a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu na wɔayɛ no foforo: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no mu na wɔyɛ no foforo daa de hwɛ hu sɛ, ɛda so ara fata na etu mpɔn wɔ wɔn ahiade ne tebea horow a ɛrekɔ so no ho dwuma a wodi mu. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛsan akɔ nhyehyɛe no so wɔ ayaresa bere mu, bere a asetra mu nsakrae kɛse aba akyi, anaasɛ anyɛ yiye koraa no afe biara no ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde adwenem akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ka nea wɔyɛ daa no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sikasɛm mu akwanside bi wɔ hɔ a ɛmma mmebun ntumi nnya awo ho akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow te sɛ insurance a wonnya anaasɛ wontumi ntua ka a wofi wɔn kotoku mu no betumi asiw mmebun kwan sɛ wobenya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Nanso, nhyehyeɛ ne nnwuma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛdi saa akwansideɛ yi ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Ayaresabea ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɔman no tua ho ka a ɛde awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛho ka sua anaa wɔmfa mma mmabun. - ankorankoro ne akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyeɛ foforɔ a aban boa a ɛbɛtumi atua awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ho ka ama mmabun a wɔfata. - ahyedee a wonnye mfasoo ne nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛde sika fam mmoa anaa nnwuma a wɔde boa ma wɔn a wohia mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Menstrual products (bosome-buo nneɛma) bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, na mɛyɛ dɛn apaw deɛ ɛfata me?
answer_twi_source: Pads (wɔhyɛ underwear mu). Menstrual Cups (silicone cups). Sɛdeɛ wopaw: Gyina wo mogya no dodoɔ (flow) ne deɛ ɛma wo ho tɔ wo so. Pads taa yɛ ma obiara. Menstrual cups yɛ ma wɔn a wɔyɛ 'active'. Cups ntaa nni Ghana; pads na wɔde di dwuma pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow no bɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na mmabun nyinaa betumi anya bi, a wɔn asetra ne sikasɛm mu tebea, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nnwuma a ɛne ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ ahyia, wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu bɛma, wɔde nnwuma a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa bɔbeasuo bɛma de ayi sikasɛm mu akwansideɛ afiri hɔ, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛnyɛ nyiyim a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ dwumadie a wɔde ma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow bi a metumi anya de anya ɔhwɛ a edi mũ sɛ ɔbabun a sebi wadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a Wɔyɛ no Kɛse: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ho hia kɛse ma w’akwahosan nyinaa. Abusua Nhyehyɛe: Ɛdenam w’ahiade so no, wubetumi ahwehwɛ nea wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano anaa nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wubenya daakye ho. STD/STI Nhwehwɛmu: Wobetumi agyina wo nna mu nneyɛe so akamfo eyinom akyerɛ. Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Dwumadibea: Sɛ wo ne ɔyaresafo bɛkasa a, ebetumi aboa wo sɛ worehyia ɔhaw a ɛfa wo nna mu akwahosan anaa sebi dɛmdi ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnamfo ne abusuafo betumi de mmoa ama obi a worebrɛ wɔ adwenemhaw?
answer_twi_source: Nnamfo ne abusuafoɔ betumi de mmoa ama obi a ɔrepere wɔ adwenemyare bi ho denam tie a wobetie a wɔremmu atɛn, tema ne ntease a wɔde bɛma, na wɔahyɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ no so. Ɛho hia sɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ ne ho wɔ adwenemyare ho, ɔma onipa no suahu ahorow no yɛ nokware, na ɔkwati sɛ ɔbɛbrɛ ne nkate ase anaasɛ ɔbɛpow. Wɔn ayaresa nhyehyɛe a wɔboa, mmoa a mfaso wɔ so a wɔde bɛma, ne tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso nso betumi ama nsakrae kɛse aba wɔn ahotɔ akwantu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, ne nkitahodi ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ womu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Ebia ne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa wo bɛhyɛ wɔn ho wnkuran sɛ wɔmfa kɔndɔm nni dwuma bere nyinaa, wɔnyɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu sɛ ebia wɔanya nna mu nyarewa (STIs), na wɔde nna a ahobammɔ wom adi dwuma de abɔ wɔn apomoden ho ban. Mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu: Nnamfo betumi de nkate fam mmoa ne mmoa a mfaso wɔ so ama wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wobenya anaasɛ apomodenn ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Nsusuwii hunu a epira a wɔkasa tia: Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne suban a epira wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna, ne abusuabɔ ho, na wɔhyɛ nnipa nyinaa ka ho ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa ahorow ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di nkate mu haw a ɛbata nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho a wosusuw ho no ho dwuma na fa nneɛma a wɔde begyina ano ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde boa ma.
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛte nkate ahorow bi te sɛ adwene a ɛyɛ basaa, ehu, anaa awerɛhow nka. Akwan a wobɛfa so agyina ano no bi ni: Wo ne Obi Kasa: Sɛ woka wo nkate ho asɛm kyerɛ ɔpanyin, w’adamfo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo, ɔfotufo, anaa ɔyaresafo a wugye no di a, ebetumi ayɛ adesoa kɛse afi wo mmati so. Suban a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Hwɛ wo ho yiye denam adidi a ɛfata a wubedi, nna a ɛfata a wobɛda, ne apɔmtene a wobɛyɛ daa no so.
