Akwan a Wɔfa so Gye Ahome: Sɛ obi home kɔ akyiri anaa odwennwen nneɛma ho a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔadi adwennwen ne dadwen so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adesua ne nkyerɛkyerɛ dawurubɔ betumi atew animtiaabu so na ama ntease a ɛfa adwenemyare ho wɔ mmabun ne ɔmanfo  no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne  nkyerɛkyerɛ dawurubɔ ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ animtiaabu a wɔtew so ne ntease a ɛkɔ soro wɔ adwenemyare ho wɔ mmabun ne ɔmanfo mu. Saa  nkyerɛkyerɛ dawurubɔ ahorow yi betumi ama wɔanya adwenemyare ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, akasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne atorɔ adwene, akyɛ ankorankoro nsɛm a ɛfa ahotɔ ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho, ahyɛ nneyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ mmoa ho nkuran, na ama wɔanya tema ne mmoa ama ankorankoro a wɔwɔ adwenemyare. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔma nkurɔfo hu, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa adwenemyare ho a wɔma ɛyɛ nea ɛfata so no, nhomasua ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu so no boa ma mmabun nya tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm / akuo wɔde wɔn asi nkɛn betumi ahyɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ne yiedie ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne wɔn atipɛnfo akuo mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Yɛ nhyiamu, nkyerɛkyerɛ, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ akuo a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmubuafoɔ / akuo a wɔato wɔn aguo. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Yɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ wɔ wo mpɔtam anaa atipɛnfo kuo mu a mmabun betumi asusuw akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho pefee, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔde mmoa ama wɔn ho wɔn ho. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Kamfo nhomasua wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobenya, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ akwahosan ne yiedi ho nkuran wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sika ho ka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obi tua ansa na wanya mmoa firi mpɔtam hɔ nkabom dwumadie mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkabom dwumadie (community outreach programs) pii de wɔn nnwuma ma kwa anaa wɔgye sika kakraa bi, na ama obiara atumi atua na wɔanya mmoa no, titiriw wɔn a wonni bi. Nanso, sɛ wobɛnya mmoa a wontua hwee no gyina sika a saa dwumadie no nsa ka firi mmoafoɔ hɔ ne nneɛma a wɔwɔ so. Ɛho hia paa sɛ wobisa sika a wobɛtua anaa ɛka biara a ɛbɔ ho bere a worepɛ mmoa afiri saa nnwumakuo yi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ kyerɛ atoro anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔtrɛw mu, mpɛn pii no wɔanhyɛ da, na ɛde adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ ba. Wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu no, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ betumi ayɛ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔka fa nyinsɛn ano aduru a etu mpɔn, STI a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu, anaa awo mu nipadua ho. Nanso nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware de, adanse, nhwehwɛmu, ne nsɛm a agye din na ɛfoa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a yɛbetumi de aboa ama obiaa bɛte ɔhaw a ɛwɔ nna mu ase ne ɔkwan a mɛfa so a menya saa nneɛma yi wɔ berɛkuro a mentua sika keseɛ biaa?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan so nimdeɛ. Nkyerɛkyerɛ nwuma ahodoɔ. Pɛ afutuo firi afutofoɔ hɔ.Pɛ mmoa firi atipɛnfoɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan a ahobammɔ wom bɛn na mɛfa so ahwehwɛ me nna mu? (sɛ ɛfata nkɔsoɔ a) .
answer_twi_source: Wo nna ho nhwehwɛmu yɛ ade a ɛfata wɔ onyin mu. Ɛfa sɛnea wubehu sɛnea wote nka sɛ ɛtwetwe wo ne nea ɛte sɛ nea eye ma wo no ho. Akwan a ahobammɔ wom a wobɛfa so ahwehwɛ mu ni: Sua wo ho ade: Kenkan nhoma anaa nsɛm a ɛfa nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Wo ne wo nnamfo nkasa: Ka wo atenka ne osuahu ahorow ho asɛm kyerɛ wo nnamfo a wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso (sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a). Fa w’adwene si abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ nna mu kyɛfa so: Hu obi wɔ bere a mobɛbom, abɔ nkɔmmɔ, na moanya abusuabɔ so. Bu w’ahye: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi wɔ biribiara a wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ ho, na ɛsɛ sɛ wo hokafo no bu saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua aka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakasa atia nna ho nsɛm wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu na wɔahyɛ nna ho mfonini pa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua aka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakasa atia nna ho nsɛm wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu na wɔahyɛ nna ho mfonini pa ho nkuran denam nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nhwehwɛmu akwan, ne abrabɔ pa ho gyinaesi a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ho a wɔde ka ASRH nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw ho no boa mmabun ma wonya ntease nketenkete wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsunsuanso wɔ nna ho su ne nneyɛe so, na ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu wɔ asɛyɛde mu na wɔkamfo nsakrae kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wɔtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da a broni twa so ka no 'LGBTQ+'  akwahosan ho nsɛm mu? (ɛhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfata na obu wom) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da a broni twa so ka no 'LGBTQ+' sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan anaa dwumadi ahorow bi a mmabun betumi de aka wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ho de aboa wɔn ma wɔn ho adwo wɔn na wɔagyina atenka a emu yɛ den ano wɔ ahokyere bere mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano wɔ Ahobammɔ Nhyehyɛe no mu: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano anaa dwumadie ahorow aka wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no ho de aboa wɔn ma wɔn ho adwo wɔn na wɔagyina nkate horow a emu yɛ den ano wɔ ɔhaw bere mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne ahomegye a emu dɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛne ntini ahorow ntam abusuabɔ, anigyede ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, akwan horow a wɔfa so de wɔn adwene si nneɛma so, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, nneɛma a wɔde bɔ nneɛma, anaasɛ mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi nnipa a wogye wɔn di hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrepere sɛ wobegyina nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ano, a abɛɛfo ntentan so mmoa akuw, afotu adwuma, ne nhomasua nneɛma ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so Mmoa Akuo: Intanɛt so nhyiamu, nkɔmmɔbɔ dan, anaa mmoa akuo a mmabun bɛtumi ne wɔn atipɛnfoɔ adi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ suahunu a wɔbɛkɔ. Afotu Dwumadibea: Ankorankoro anaa kuw afotu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nkɔso ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho no hɔ. Nhomasua Nneɛma: Nhoma, wɛbsaet, anaa nhomasua nneɛma a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛ wɔde bɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne mmoa ama mmabun a wɔrekɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu a wɔde bedi dwuma. Mmoa a Egyina Sukuu So: Mmoa dwumadie a sukuu afotufoɔ, ayarehwɛfoɔ, anaa adwene ne nneyɛeɛ ho animdefoɔ a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ nsɛnnennen a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ano a wɔbɛnya. Helplines: Mmoa telefon anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi de mmoa, nsɛm, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn ama nneɛma ne nnwuma foforo a wɔde di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneyɛ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wosusu ho bere a wɔrebɔ media nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Obu a wɔde ma kokoam nsɛm ne mpeneso: Hwɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm bu ankorankoro kokoam nsɛm na wonya pene a wɔde bɛyɛ mfonini wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm mu. Pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nokware: Fa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma, na kwati nsɛm a ɛkanyan atenka anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ. Nnipa a wɔka ho ne ahorow ahorow: Gyina hɔ ma adwene ne osuahu ahorow, a akuo a wɔato wɔn sintidua de ka ho, na wɔakwati sɛ wobɛma nsusuwii hunu anaa nnipa a wɔayi wɔn afi mu no akɔ so. Kwati sɛ wobɛpira: Yɛ ahwɛyiye na ama ɔhaw no ayɛ ketewaa, titiri wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho, denam emu nsɛm a wode bɛma fa asɛde ne abrabɔ pa mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma nkorɔfo kum wɔ wɔn ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi saa gyidi ahorow yi so bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa ama wɔn adwenem apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne Nyamesom Nkɛntɛnso: Ebia amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma nkorɔfɔ kum wɔn ho, te sɛ animtiaabu anaa ahyɛde a ɛfa adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho. Mmabun betumi afa saa gyidi ahorow yi so denam mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ amammerɛ mu a wɔte wɔn amammerɛ anaa nyamesom adwene ase na wobu wɔn no hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmerante ne mmabaa betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu ako ma nyinsɛn yi gu hokwanno mu? (ɔsɔretia, atuhoama, abɛɛfo ntentan dwumadi)
answer_twi_source: Mmabun yɛ tumi a tumi wom a ɛma nsakrae ba nyinsɛn a woyi gu kuw a wɔhwehwɛ hokwan ahorow no mu! Akwan bi a wobɛfa so de wo ho ahyɛ mu ni: Fa sukuu no mmabun akwahosan akuw, akyerɛkyerɛfo ne ahyehyɛde afoforo a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no so kamfo kyerɛ Ɔsɔretia ne Nhyiam ahorow: Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow a, asomdwoe wom mu de ma nkurɔfo hu na kyerɛ sɛ wɔboa. Atuhoama: Boa ahyehyɛde ahorow denam sika a wobɛboaboa ano, ahomatrofo so sikakorabea, anaa wɔn a wɔtow aba a wobɛkyerɛw wɔn din so. Abɛɛfo Ntentan Dwumadi "Social Media Activism": Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛma nsɛm pii, fa "hashtag" ahorow a ɛfata di dwuma, na fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ kwan sɛ mehu bere a merekɔhyia dɔkota fa awo ho, na dɛn na m’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛyɛ wɔ saa nsrahwɛ ahorow yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Ansa na Wɔawo 'Parental Appointments': Nipadua mu Nhwehwɛmu: Wo ɔyarehwɛfo no bɛyɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu de ahwɛ w’akwahosan ne akokoaa no nyin. Mogya ne Nsu mu Nhwehwɛmu: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hwɛ sɛ ɔyare mmoawa, mogya a ɛtɔ kɔ nipadua mu, ne akwahosan ho nsɛnkyerɛnne afoforo anaa. Ultrasounds: Mfoninitwa nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hwɛ awotwaa no nyin na wohu biribiara a ɛnteɛ. Mogya Nhyɛso a Wɔhwɛ So: Wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa de hwɛ tebea horow te sɛ nyinsɛn mu mogya mmoroso anaa. Nnuru a wɔde siw ano ne nnuru a wɔde bɔ wo ho ban: W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛma wo nnuru a wɔde besiw asramma ano ne nnuru a wɔde bɛbɔ wo ne akokoaa a ɔhyɛ yafunu mu no ho ban afi tetatnus ne diphtheria ho. Wobetumi de nnuru afoforo a wɔde siw ano ama a egyina asiane anaa nhyehyɛe a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ so, sɛ nhwɛso no, dewormer. Akwahosan Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa aduan pa,awo ho ahosiesie, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, awo, awo, ne awo akyi hwɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ yɛ teetee, na dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi foforo rehyia ayayade?
answer_twi_source: Ebia worehyia asisifo sɛ wote nka bere nyinaa sɛ wo hyɛ wo ho, wohunahuna wo, anaasɛ wobrɛ wo ase a. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ayayade no betumi ayɛ: Honam fam opira anaa nneɛma a ɛsɛe Mmeae anaa dwumadi ahorow bi a wɔkwati Nsakrae a ɛba adwene anaa nneyɛe mu, te sɛ obi a ɔtwe ne ho fi ne ho anaasɛ ɔyɛ basaa Bu a obi wɔ ma ne ho anaa ahotoso a ɛso tew Ɛyɛ den sɛ wode w’adwene besi biribi so anaasɛ wobɛyɛ adwuma wɔ adesua mu Nsakrae a ɛba nna anaa adidi mu Saa ara nso na ebia wubehu nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔreyɛ obi foforo basabasa, te sɛ nsakrae a ɛba mpofirim wɔ ne suban mu, bere a ɔtwe ne ho fi ho efi asetra mu dwumadi ahorow mu, anaasɛ ahoyeraw ho sɛnkyerɛnne a wotumi hu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahobanbɔ ho nsusuwii ahorow bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wode sie w’adwenem bere a wode wo ho hyɛ intanɛt so anaa intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔka de gyina ASRR ahorow so no mu? (Sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔn ma wɔ yiedi ɛndi kan)
answer_twi_source: Ahobammɔ ne ade titiriw! Ɔkwan a wobɛfa so abɔ wo ho ban ni: Fa Wo Yiyedi Di Kan: Sɛ ɛma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛkyɛ wo ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so. Nea broni ka no 'Stay Anonymous' (sɛ ɛho hia a): Fa edin a ɛnyɛ nokware di dwuma wɔ nea broni ka no 'social media platform' ahorow so sɛ ɛboa wo ma wote ahobammɔ nka a. Hwɛ Yiye wɔ Intanɛt so nea broni ka no 'Harassment' ho: Bɔ nsɛm a ɛmfata ho amanneɛ na siw wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wɔhaw wo no kwan. Paw Baguam Mmeae a Wobɛkasa ama Wɔ Intanɛt So: Sɛ worekɔ nhyiam ahorow anaa nhyiam ahorow ase a, yɛ saa wɔ mmeae a hann pa wɔ hɔ a nnipa dɔɔso wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛnya sika mmoa (microfinance)?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kura mu yie wɔ Ghana. Ebia ɛbɛhwehwɛ awofoɔ mmoa. Kasa kyerɛ panyin anaa afutumafoɔ (counsellor).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na wiase mmara te sɛ (CRC/ICPD) boa mmabun wɔ nna mu nsɛm 'SRH' hokwan?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsi pɛyɛ (nondiscrimination), ahofadi (autonomy) ho kwan, ne mmoa a yɛnya so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne tumi a mewɔ wɔ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ animhwɛ a menya ho? (Ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho adesua a edi mu) .
answer_twi_source: Pɛpɛɛpɛ! Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wunya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ animhwɛ. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne: Nneɛma ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne sɛnea etu mpɔn ho adesua. Abusuabɔ pa ne pene a wɔpene so ho ntease. Nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STIs) ho nimdeɛ ne sɛnea wobesiw ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara mu nkyerɛase anaa asotwe ahorow wɔhɔ a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho a egyina mfe a nea wɔato no mmonnaa ne nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no adi so?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho mmara taa kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda mpanyimfo a wɔyɛ bɔne ne wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn basabasa, ne nea ɛfa mmofra nkumaa ho no ntam. Ebia abɔnefo a wɔto mmofra nkumaa mmonnaa no behyia asotwe a ɛkɔ soro esiane sɛnea nea wɔato no mmonnaa no yɛ mmerɛw ne sɛnea ɔhaw a wɔato wɔn mmonnaa no mu yɛden nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw bi a ɛma nkitahodi a etu mpɔn wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a etu mpɔn hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nnamyɛ tie, wɔde nokwaredi ne obu bɛda nsusuwii ne nkate adi, na wɔabue wɔn ani ama wɔn ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wodi nkitaho pefee fa ahiade, akɔnnɔ, ne dadwen ho, na wogye wɔn ho wɔn ho nkate tom. Sɛ wɔkwati asodi, ɔkasatia, ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban a, ɛma wonya tebea a ɛboa ma nkitahodi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwenemyare ho nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wodi nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho haw ahorow ho dwuma titiriw? (adwumayɛbea ahorow, mmoa akuw) .
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔwmuden ho ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa no wɔ nneɛma a ɔde bedi nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho dwuma yiye
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ nneɛma pa a ebetumi afi awofo nkitahodi a etu mpɔn a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho, te sɛ ahotoso a ɛkɔ soro, awofo ne wɔn mma ntam nkitahodie a ɛkɔ anim, ne ahotoso kɛse a wonya wɔ nneɛma a asɛyɛde wom a wɔbɛpaw mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pa a ebetumi afi awofo nkitahodi a etu mpɔn a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho aba no bi ne: Ahotoso ne nsɛm a wobue ano a ɛkɔ soro wɔ awofo ne mmabun ntam, na ɛde nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ nokware na ntease wom kɛse a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho aba. Ɔwofo ne abofra ntam nkitahodie a ɛkɔ anim a nea ɛda nsow ne obu, ntease, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho. Ahotoso kɛse ne wɔn ho a wɔde di dwuma yiye wɔ tumi a mmabun betumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so nsunsuanso a efi mu ba bere a wɔanka STI a wowɔ ho asɛm ankyerɛ wɔn a wone wɔn da no?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nsunsuanso a efi STI a wowɔ sɛ wɔanka ho asɛm nkyerɛ wɔn a wone wɔn da mu no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no mmara so. Wɔ mmeae bi no, sɛ wɔanka STI ho asɛm a wowɔ ankyerɛ obi a wone no da no betumi ayɛ criminal case, te sɛ ɔyare mmoawa a wonya fi nna mu a wɔde ma a obi ampene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea yɛ nfrɛ no microaggressions, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛma nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyimu a wɔyɛ tia mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no kɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Microaggressions yɛ adansi a ɛyɛ brɛoo a wotumi de kasa anaa nea ɛnyɛ kasa kyerɛ obi. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Nsɛm a yɛka a ɛntu mpɔn: "W’apɛ adeɛ akɛseɛ paa wɔ obi a ɔwɔ..." Susu fa mmɔdenbɔ ho: Mmbisa ansa na woasusu sɛ ehia sɛ woka. Microaggressions yi boa ma nnipa susuu adefoɔ ho na ɛboa ma asetena mu yɛ asɛmpatrew adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan anaa akwankyerɛ horow a metumi de adi dwuma de ayɛ m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho biribi denneennen, de ahye asi hɔ na makura mu, na mede obu ada m’adwene ne m’adwene adi?
answer_twi_source: Akwan horow bi a wobetumi afa so agyina wo gyinabea so pintinn de abua mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ, ato ahyeɛ na woakura mu, na woaka wo nsɛm ne wo nkaeɛ wɔ obu mu bi ne:Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma (Using "I" statements): Fa "Me" nsɛm kyerɛ w’adwene ne wo nkaeɛ (mfatoho: "Mete nka sɛ me ho ntɔ me berɛ a...").Atiepa (Active listening): Fa atiepa sua afoforo adwene berɛ a worepere ama nea wope nso.Honam fam nneyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ awerɛhyem (Assertive body language): Te sɛ obi ani mu a wobɛhwɛ na woagyina anaa woatena hɔ tɛɛ.Ahyeɛ ho asotwe (Consequences): Hwɛ sɛ wobɛkyerɛ asotwe a ɛmu da hɔ berɛ a obi bɛbu wo ahyeɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa me hokafo ma wada wɔn ahye ne wɔn akɔnnɔ adi bere a wɔrenya nna mu agorɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Ma wo hokafo no nhu sɛ obetumi adi nkitaho pefee a onni atɛn. Yɛ aso wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde ano ka ne nea wɔmfa ano nka ho. Check-In: Bere ne bere mu check-in bere a woreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a nsɛmmisa te sɛ "So wo ho ye?" Bu wɔn ahye ne wɔn akɔnnɔ, sɛ wɔsakra mpo a. Hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte ahobammɔ ne ahotɔ nka sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn atenka ne nea wɔpɛ ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmebun bɛkasa ama ntease a ɛkɔ akyiri, nneɛma, ne mmoa ama adwene mu apɔmuden nsɛm wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ a Wɔbɛhyɛ: Dwumadie, ɔsatuo, anaa nhyiam a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de ahyɛ adwene mu apɔmuden nsɛm ho nimdeɛ nkuran, atew animguase so, na wɔahyɛ mmoa hwehwɛ suban nkuran. Mmoa mfaso  a Wɔ kyerekyerɛ: Sukuu mpanyimfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ aban, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔbɛsrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmma sika pii ne adwene mu apɔmuden mmoa a wɔbɛnya. Mmeae a Ɛboa a Wɔbɛyɛ: Nnamfo mmoa akuo, adwene mu apɔmuden akuo, anaa mmeae a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo a mmabun betumi akasa afa adwene mu apɔmuden ho pefee na wɔanya mmoa a wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Nnamfo a Wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ Wɔn: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nteteeɛ a wɔbɛma wɔ adwene mu apɔmuden nimdeɛ, wo ho nhwɛhwɛmu akwan, ne sɛnea wɔboa nnamfo a wɔwɔ ahokyere mu ho. Nhyehyɛeɛ Mu Nsakraeɛ a Wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛkamfo wɔ mpɔtam anaa ɔman mu de ama adwene mu apɔmuden mmoa, ayaresa a wɔbɛnya, ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ ama mmabun atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de ahu na wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu a ɛha, animhwɛ, ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi ho mfonini a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de ahu na wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu a ɛha, animhwɛ, ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi ho mfonini a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye de ahu nsusuwii hunu ne trope ahorow a ɛwɔ atipɛnfo nkitahodie ho mfonini ahorow mu no so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware ne nokware a wogye ho kyim bere a wɔde toto asetra mu osuahu ahorow ankasa ne adwene ahorow ho no. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne atipɛnfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mpɔtam akannifoɔ ne awofoɔ bɛbɔ afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nsunsuansoɔ wɔ atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ so na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ, ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛka obiara ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm foforo a ɛda osuahu ahorow adi na ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a ɛha a wɔbɛbɔ na wɔakyɛ, ahyɛ tema, ntease, ne asetra mu nkɔso pa ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asiane ahohorow bi wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi ho gyinae a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Bere a nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo no betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo a ɛfa nea onyinsɛn no ne wɔn ba no akwahosan ho no, ɛho hia sɛ yɛte ase sɛ nhwehwɛmu ahorow bi kura asiane ne anohyeto ahorow. Asiane ahorow a ɛbata nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo ho no betumi ayɛ: Nea efi mu ba a ɛyɛ atoro anaa atoro a enye Dadwen anaa adwennwen a ɛfa nea efi sɔhwɛ mu ba ho Nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu (sɛ nhwɛso no,nea broni ka no 'amniocentesis, chorionic villus sampling') betumi de asiane ketewaa bi aba sɛ nyinsɛn betumi asɛe, Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔyem ne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo susuw mfaso, asiane, ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo mu no ho ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata sɔhwɛ ahorow a ɛfata ma wɔn ankorankoro tebea horow. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa mmabun a wɔyem ma wɔn kwan ma wɔafa wɔn hwɛ akwantu a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ansa na wɔawo no mu. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo taa tu mmabun a wɔyem fo sɛ wɔmma wɔn bo dwo ansa na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi a ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ ebia adwennwen anaa dadwen a efi mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no rekeka kɔ adwenemyare, na bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Nsakrae a ɛba suban mu, te sɛ kommyɛ, abufuw, anaa adwenemhawNipadua mu haw te sɛ tipae, yafunu mu yaw, nna mu haw, anaa nsakrae a ɛba wɔ adidi muWɔnyɛ ade wɔ anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi biribi soNnamfo anaa dwumadi ahorow a na wɔn ani gye ho a wɔbɛkwatiSɛ saa nneɛma yi kɔ so da biara a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee adi dwuma de asusuw nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm anaa aguade ho dawurubɔ betumi anya wɔ me suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee adi dwuma de asusuw nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm anaa aguade ho dawurubɔ betumi anya wɔ wo suban ne wo nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ho no ho. Sɛ woda nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm adi a, susuw fibea, atirimpɔw, ne animhwɛ a ebetumi aba wɔ nkrasɛm no akyi no ho. Hwehwɛ kasa, mfonini, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma nsɛm mu, na gye akyinnye sɛ ebia nna mu akwahosan ho mfonini no ne nneyɛe a egyina adanse so ne adwene ahorow a ɛsonosonoe so no hyia anaa. Fa wo ho hyɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛma nteaseɛ wɔ abɛɛfo nkitahodie (media literacy) ho mu, na eyi bɛhyɛ wo nkuran ma woasusu ho yiye wɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ nkitahodie mmeaeɛ no ho, ne sɛnea saa nneɛma yi nya suban ne nneyɛeɛ so tumi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu nsɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ me brayɛ mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhu nsɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ wo brayɛ mu a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ wo nipadua no yiye na sɛ ɛho hia a, woyɛ ho biribi. Nea wubetumi ayɛ ni: ma w'ani nni wo brayɛ akyi: Hyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛyɛ soronko te sɛ mogya a ɛtɔ kɛse, ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, bere tenten, anaa nsu a ɛyɛ soronko nsow. Wo ne dɔktafoɔ nni ho nkɔmmɔ: Wobetumi aboa ma wɔahu sɛ ebia asɛm bi wɔ ase anaa na wɔakamfo ayaresa a ɛfata akyerɛ wo. Emergency situations: Sɛ ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, adwenemhaw, totɔ piti, anaa mogya tu kɛse a ennyae a, hwehwɛ aduruyɛ ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nyamesomsɛm mu nneyɛɛ anaa amanneɛ ahodoɔ di wɔ akwan a wofa hu nsabuo ne nna mu apɔmden sifa sɛ ɛba no amammerɛ mu a?
answer_twi_source: Amanneɛ : Amammerɛ ahodoɔ bi wɔ amanneɛ ahodoɔ a wɔdedi dwuma wɔ bragorɔ mu a ɛkyerɛ wɔn su ne nipako a wɔyɛ. Amammerɛ mu Gyidi: Amammerɛ mu amanneɛ no bi ne ɔkwan wofa so kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu apɔmden, awoɔ, ne nkitahodie. Mpɔtam Mmoa: Mpɛn pii no, amanneɛ ahodoɔ yi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔboa mpɔtam hɔfo na wɔkyerɛ wɔn akwankyerɛ, na ɛma mmabun nya te nka sɛ wɔnyɛ anyɛ ankonam na wɔwɔ akyitaafoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛba bere a worekɔsra dɔkotani a ɔhwɛ mmofra ansa na wɔawo no? (nhwehwɛmu, "ultrasounds") .
answer_twi_source: Nsrahwɛ a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu te sɛ: Nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu: Wo mu duru, wo mogya mmoroso, ne w’akwahosan nyinaa a wobɛhwɛ. Nsu mu nhwehwɛmu: W’akwahosan ne akokoaa no nkɔso a wobɛhwɛ. Mogya mu nhwehwɛmu: Hwɛ tebea horow bi ne nipadua mu ahoɔden a ɛko tia nyarewa. "Ultrasound": Mfonini ahorow a wɔyɛ de hu akokoaa no nyin ne ne nyin.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ebetumi aba sɛ obi de botae a ɛmfata a ɛfa ɔbaa ne ɔbarima nna ho, ne nipadua ho mfonini, anaa abusuabɔ ho , na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de ɛhyeɛ  a ɛfata asi hɔ na ama matumi adi botae a mede asi m'ani so no so ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Asiane anaa afiri a ebetumi aba berɛ a wode botae ahorow a ɛmmfata, a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe, nipadua mfonini, anaa abusuabɔ ho no bi ne: Nhyɛso a ɛkɔ soro: Botae ahorow a enni mu betumi ama woate nka sɛ womfata anaasɛ wodi nkogu, titiri sɛ wuntumi nyɛ ho hwee esiane ne den nti a. Wo ho adwene a ɛnteɛ: Botae ahorow a ɔbra mu nhyɛsoɔ anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow na ɛkanyan akyi a wubedi akyi no betumi ama obi ani nngye ne nipadua ho anaasɛ woabu wo ho fam. Abusuabɔ mu nhyɛso: Botae ahorow a egyina abɔnten so akwanhwɛ nkutoo so de si hɔ no betumi asɛe abusuabɔ sɛ wɔde nea ɛne ne ho hyia di kan sen obu ne ntease a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho a. Sɛ wode ahye besi hɔ na woakari pɛ wɔ apɔwmuden mu a, fa w’adwene si botae ahorow a ɛfata, ntease wom, na ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo yiedi hyia so. Ma ayamhyehye ma wo ho na hu sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛsakra botae ahorow sɛnea ɛho hia na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wubetumi adu ho na aboa w’akwahosan ne w’anigye nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne suban pa a metumi agye atom na ama m’adwene mu yiyedi nyinaa atu mpɔn? (apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, nna pa, aduan a ɛkari pɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Te sɛ wo nipadua no, w’adwene hia suban pa na ama atumi ayɛ yiye! Nneyɛe atitiriw bi ni: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ma endorphins, abɔde mu nneɛma a ɛma obi nya adwene a ebetumi ako atia adwennwen ne dadwen no fi adi. Dae a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Da a ɛfata (bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 8-10 ma mmabun) ho hia kɛse ma nkate mu nhyehyɛe ne adwene a wɔde si biribi so. Aduan a Ɛkari pɛ: Nnuan a ahoɔden wom a wudi no ma wo nipadua ne amemene no nya pɛtro a ehia na ama ayɛ adwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nsɛm ne mmoa sɛ meresusuw ho sɛ mɛfa obi no ayɛ me ba anaasɛ mɛyi nyinsɛn agu?
answer_twi_source: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): https://www.ppag-gh.org/nu/ betumi de nsɛm a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho dwumadie ho ama anaasɛ wɔde wo bɛka nneɛma ho sɛ woresusu ho sɛ wobɛtu nyinsɛn agu (ɛgyina mmara kwan so wɔ Ghana). Mariestopes Ghana, de nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmoa ma na ɔmanfo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea nso de akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ mmabun adamfofa ma, wo ne w’akwahosan ho dwumayɛni Ghana Social Welfare Department kasa: https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/ betumi ama nsɛm a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi?
answer_twi_source: deɛ ɛfa ARH ho ma obiara. Nsɛm a ɛfa social media/mmabun adamfofa ntwea so. Platform (simpie) ahorow ma obiara boa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodibea bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mate nna mu nneyɛe ho mmara mu ase na makɔ so na mahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a?
answer_twi_source: Mmara Mmoa Ahyehyɛde: Aman pii wɔ mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde mmara mu afotu ne mmoa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma. Eyi betumi aboa ma wɔate nna ho mmara, hokwan ahorow, ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so. Nna mu akwahosan ho ayaresabea ahorow taa wɔ nneɛma ne adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu hokwan ahorow, mmara, ne baabi a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa ho ama. Wɛbsaet ahorow nso te sɛ Planned Parenthood, Sexetc.org, ne Scarleteen de nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mũ ma, a mmara mu nsɛm ka ho. Hotlines ne Helplines: Mmoa ne hotlines bi wɔ hɔ a wubetumi afrɛ anaa wobɛkyerɛw text akɔhwehwɛ kokoam afotu wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne mmara mu nsɛm ho. Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), ne PPA's Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) Community Centers: Sukuu Afotufoɔ: Sukuu afotufoɔ bɛtumi de nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho ama na ebia wɔbɛtumi akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ mmara mu nso. Kae sɛ, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubebisa nsɛm na woahwehwɛ mmoa. Sɛ wote mmara mu afã horow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ho ase a, ɛma wutumi si gyinae a ɛfata na wokamfo wo ho ne afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan pa bɛn na awofo betumi afa so akari pɛ wɔ mfaso ne asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma so bere a wɔhyɛ mmabun yiyedi, adwenemyare, ne asetra mu nkɔso nyinaa ho nkuran no?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi aka mfaso ne asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma so a bom bere a wɔhyɛ mmabun yiyedi nyinaa, adwenemyare, ne asetra mu nkɔso ho nkuran denam: Wɔrehyɛ wɔn nkran ama wode wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadie ahodoɔ bi te sɛ abɔnten so agodie, apɔ mu ateneatene, adebɔ akyidi, ayɔnkofo nkitahodi, ne adesua akyi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, aka bere a wɔde hwɛ sini ho.Sɛ woreto ahyeɛ na wode ate berɛ a wodi dwuma wɔ ntentanfidie a egyina mmabun mfe, wɔn onyin dodow, nkɔso ahiade, ne abusua gyinapɛn ahorow so, bere a wɔma kwan ma wɔyɛ nsakrae na ama nneɛma mu ayɛ mmerɛw. Sɛ wode wɔ ani bɛdi mmabun dwumadie a wodi wɔ media no so akyi te sɛ nneɛma a wɔpɛ, ne Intanɛt so dwumadi ahorow a wɔbɛhwɛ so, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔ a ɛkɔ so a ɛfa wɔn suahu ahorow, wɔn anigyede, ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho mu. Wɔbɛbom ahwehwɛ media akwan pa a wɔbɛfa so asi ananmu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛne mmabun anigyede, wɔn akɔnnɔ, ne wɔn apɛde hyia, na wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu osuahu ahorow a ɛma denhyɛ na ɛma wonya mfaso mu. Sɛ woreyɛ media su a ɛyɛ papa ne dijitaal ɔman ba nneyɛe ho nhwɛso sɛ awofo, denam screen a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu, nsusuwii a ɛmu dɔ, ne abrabɔ pa wɔ intanɛt so nneyɛe a wɔda no adi wɔ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfoɔ adwene wɔ nna ho nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔka ho asɛm no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmusuo ne Animtiaabu: Amammerɛ ahorow ne musu anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ho no betumi ama wɔaka nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho asɛm kakraa bi anaasɛ wɔayɛ no animhwɛ. Tete suban a broni ka no 'Conservatism': Mpɔtam a wɔwɔ tete adwen kyere wɔ nna mu betumi afɛre efiri saa nsɛmsɛm ho kasa pefee. Bɔbeasu Ho Nhyehyɛe: Amammerɛ mu mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn betumi anya sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo da nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm adi, te sɛ mmea awo dwumadi ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si so no so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ mu Nkate a broni ka no 'Cultural Sensitivity': Ebia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo bedi amammerɛ mu su horow a ɛwɔ hɔ no ho dwuma, na ebetumi aka sɛnea nsɛm a wɔka no mu dɔ na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya akokuduro ne obu ame ho wɔ me mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Self talk; ɛne wo ho nni nkɔmmɔ. Ka nsɛmpa kyerɛ wo ho. Hyɛ wo mbrɛwyɛ ne w'ahoɔden nso. Ma w'ani ngye wo nneyɛɛ pa ho. Fa botae a wobetumi ayɛ si w'ani so. Di dwuma pa ɛbɛboa ma woanya akokuduro. Hwɛ apɔwmuden so yiye. Hu sɛ woyɛ soronko na hu ne saa so ma obia. Saa nti ɛmmfa wo ho ntoto obia ho. Gye wo ho di.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesem anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua ne nhumu so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho no bi ne: Atosɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma obi mu duru yɛ kɛse bere nyinaa. Nokwasɛm: Bere a ankorankoro binom betumi anya nsakrae wɔ wɔn mu duru mu bere a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, a wɔde awokwammoa anosie nnuru di dwuma no, mu duru a ɛkɔ soro nyɛ amansan nyinaa nkɛntɛnso bɔne na mpɛn pii no wobetumi afa asetra mu nsakrae so adi ho dwuma. Atosɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma awo so tew anaasɛ epira awo a ɛbɛba daakye. Nokwasɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano dodow no ara yɛ nea wotumi dane, na mpɛn pii no, awo san ba bere a wɔagyae a wɔde di dwuma no akyi bere tiaa bi, na ennya awo a ɛbɛba daakye so nkɛntɛnso bere tenten. Atosɛm: Kɔndɔm ntumi nsiw nyinsɛn ano. Nokwasɛm: Sɛ wɔde kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye na wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa a, etu mpɔn kɛse wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano mu na ɛma ahobammɔ foforo fi nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho. Atosɛm: Mmea nkutoo na wobetumi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano adi dwuma. Nokwasɛm: Bere a wɔayɛ nnuru bi a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ama mmea titiriw, te sɛ awo ano aduru anaa hormone a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu no, mmarima nso betumi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, a kɔndɔm ne vasectomy ka ho adi dwuma. Wobetumi adi saa anansesɛm ahorow yi ho dwuma denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu a wɔde bɛma so denam nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde bɛma, adwene a ɛnteɛ a wobeyi afi hɔ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛka afa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, sɛnea etu mpɔn, ne dwuma a edi wɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da a wosiw ano ne awo akwahosan a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ obi benya social network a ɛboa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne afoforo anya abusuabɔ a mfaso wɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi: Sɛ wowɔ social network a ɛboa a, ebetumi ama woanya mmoa, atew adwennwen so, na ama atenka a ɛne sɛ obi nnyɛ ankonam ayɛ kɛse. Mmabun betumi anya nkitahodie a ntease wom denam atie a wɔde nsiyɛ, tema a wɔde bɛma, dwumadi anaa nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne nkitahodie a ɛmu da hɔ wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'human rights' (onipa hokwan) bɛboa mmabun a wɔn nni ahobammɔ, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, ne mmabun a wɔte mmeae a ohia anaa ntawntawdi aka no hyia no ho?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mmara a ɛka obiara ho. Hwɛ sɛ aban bedi ne bɔhyɛ so. Ma mmabun ahoɔden. Yɛ nkabom de siesie haw no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn anaa akyiwade ahorow bi a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mihu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ nneyɛe ne nneyɛe a wɔayɛ titiriw atia mmea ne mmeawa wɔ mpɔtam ne aman bi mu bere tenten araa ma wobu no, anaasɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no de kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ amammerɛ mu nneyɛe a wogye tom no fã. Ahobrɛase ne Kokoamsɛm: Amammerɛ ahorow bi si ahobrɛase so dua, na ebetumi anya nipadua mu nsakrae ne ankorankoro ahotew ho nkɔmmɔbɔ so nkɛntɛnso. Bɔbeasu Dwumadi 'Gender Roles': Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi akyerɛ dwumadi pɔtee anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow a mmarimaa ne mmeawa bedi wɔ wɔn mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na aka nneyɛe ne nkitahodi. Nneɛma a Wɔbara: Wobetumi abu nsɛmti bi te sɛ brayɛ anaa nna mu dwumadi sɛ ɛyɛ ahyɛde wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu, na ama wɔammɔ nkɔmmɔ pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm wɔ abusuabɔ mu, a aware, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, ne mmofra a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho nhyehyɛe ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne ahobammɔ a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm wɔ abusuabɔ mu no anya nkɔso bere tenten. Wɔwɔ hokwan koro no ara a obiara wɔ, sɛ wɔware nea wɔdɔ no, wɔgye mmofra ntetee, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔhwɛ wɔn mma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na ɛfa nkuranhyɛ pa a mɛtumi ahyia wɔ me ne me mfɛfoɔ nkitahodeɛ mu, a ɛfa gyinaeɛ a mɛsi wɔ nna mu nneyɛeɛ, nnamfofa, nyinsɛn ho bammɔ, ne nna mu yadeɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nhyɛsoɔ pa a wobɛtumi ahyia wɔ ayɔnkofa a wo ne w’atipɛnfoɔ di mu wɔ gyinaesie a ɛfa nna mu dwumadiɛ, abusuabɔ, nyinsɛn ano aduru, ne STI ano aduru ho no bi ne: Nkamfo anaa anigyeɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu dwumadiɛ mu, nna mu agodeɛ a wɔde di dwuma anaa ahokafoɔ dodoɔ a wowɔ ho. Gye a wogye tom anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ka ho wɔ asetra mu akuw anaa akuw mu a egyina abusuabɔ anaa nna mu gyinapɛn ahorow bi a wɔyɛ so. Akatua a wotumi hu anaa nneɛma a ɛkanyan obi ma ɔde ne ho hyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu, te sɛ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma anaa nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban mu. Ebia nea wɔfrɛ no nneɛma pa a wɔde hyɛ mu den yi bɛsɛe w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmti bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛka ho asɛm bere a yɛrekɔ hɔ daa no, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ yebedi nsɛm a ɛhaw me anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ɛho hia a ebia mewɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yɛn nsrahwɛ a yɛkɔ daa no betumi aka nsɛmti ahorow a ɛfa wo nna ne awo akwaahosan ho, a nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ebia wowɔ ka ho. Nsɛmti no betumi ayɛ wo nipadua ne nkate fam yiyedi ho nsɛm foforo, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwaahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa osuahu ahorow ho, nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw anaa STI ano a wosiw ho, anaa nsɛm foforo biara a ɛfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔsa STI ahorow? (nnuro a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono sɛnea wɔsa STIs a egyina ɔyare mmoawa no ko ne sɛnea sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no mu yɛ den so. Wobetumi de nnuro a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo akyerɛw ama no asa ɔyare mmoawa pii a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu te sɛ chlamydia, akisikuru, ne akisikuru. Wɔde nnuro a ekum ɔyare mmoawa di ɔyare mmoawa a ɛde ɔyare mmoawa ba te sɛ HIV ne herpes ho dwuma de siw sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ano na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ɔyare no so, nanso ebia wontumi nsa. Ebia HPV yare no ankasa befi hɔ a wɔansa no yare, nanso wobetumi de nnuro anaa akwan horow adi sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna mu akisikuru ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ ɔyere biako abusuabɔ mu nanso wɔansɔ wɔn baanu nyinaa anhwɛ a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi atena ase dwoodwoo? (nkitahodi ne sɔhwɛ a wɔbom yɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ ɔyere biako abusuabɔ mu nanso wɔansɔ mo baanu nyinaa anhwɛ a, ɔkwan a wobɛfa so anya ahobammɔ ni: Nkitahodi: Wo ne wo hokafo nkasa pefee na wo nokwaredi mu mfa sɛnea mobɛbom asɔ ahwɛ ho. Sɔhwɛ a Wɔbom Yɛ: Sɛ mobɛbomu asɔ ahwɛ ansa na woanya nna mu kyɛfa a, ɛno ne ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so ahwɛ ahu sɛ obiara nya ahobammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ahorow a wobu no boa mmabun a wɔyɛ kakraa bi ma wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ ahotosoɔ den. Te akwansideɛ so. Ɛma nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no tumi.  Ma wote nka sɛ wɔgye wo tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu bere a m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso rehyia no?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi ada adi wɔ akwan horow so, te sɛ nhyɛso a wobɛte nka sɛ wo ne afoforo nneyɛe, gyidi, anaa akwanhwɛ hyia, ɔhaw anaa ahotɔ a wubenya wɔ tebea horow bi mu, anaasɛ wote nka sɛ ɛyɛ w’asɛyɛde sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ mu. Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wubehu no hwehwɛ sɛ wuhu w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, ahye, ne nkate horow wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma pa bi a ɛwɔ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm a wobegye wɔn atom no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wogye w’ankasa wo dɛmdi tom na woka ho asɛm a, ɛma afoforo tumi na ebetumi akanyan wɔn ankasa ma wɔaka wɔn ankasa haw anaa wɔn ankasa dɛmdi ho asɛm na ebetumi akanyan wɔn ma wɔadi wɔn apereperedi so. Mpɔtam ne Mmoa: Sɛ wunya afoforo a wɔwɔ nipasu a ɛte saa ara a, ɛma wonya mmoa ne ntease. Nneɛma a Wotumi Hu a Ɛkɔ Anim:  ɛma gyinabea a wotumi hu no kɔ soro. Ɛhyɛ Gye a Wogye Ho Nkɔso: Ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm a wobegye wɔn atom no ma wonya ɔman a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔwɔ ayamhyehye kɛse
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmti anaa nsɛm bɛn na wɔka ho asɛm wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu anaa nsɛm a wɔka wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua nhyiamu ne nsɛm a wɔka fa mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ so de ma no ka nsɛmti ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa, nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano, nna mu nyarewa (STI) a wɔsiw ano, abusuabɔ pa, pene, nipadua mu nneɛma pa, ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ te sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayadeɛ a wɔde di dwuma. Saa nhyiamu yi nso betumi aka adwenemyareɛ, ankasa hwɛ, nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ate me nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa bɔbea su wɔ berɛ a merebu mensa?
answer_twi_source: Ma wo ho bere hwehwɛ woatenka mu. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ kyerɛ onii a w’ani gye ne ho (te sɛ mmarimaa, mmabaawa, anaa mmienu no nyinaa). Bɔbeasu ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu fa sɛdea wote nka wɔ wo mu ho (abarimaa, abeawa, mmienu no no nyinaa, emu biara). Wo ne aboafoɔ nkasa na sua nnipa su ahodoɔ. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛhia berɛ na woahwehwɛ mmoa a wohia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ada me bɔbeasu adi wɔ ɔkwan a, mɛte nka sɛ ɛfata me so?
answer_twi_source: Mmuae biara nni hɔ a ɛfata obiara! Akwan bi a wobɛfa so ahwehwɛ mu ni: Edinnsiananmu: Paw edinnsiananmu (ɔno, ɔno, wɔn/wɔn, ne nea ɛkeka ho) a, ɛda wo nipasu adi. Ntade: Hyɛ ntade a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo na woanya ahotoso. Ti yɛ (Hairstyle): Sɔ ntade ahorow hwɛ de da wo nsusuwii adi. Edin: Susuw sɛ ebia edin foforo bi te nka sɛ ɛne wo bɔbeasu hyia kɛse anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama tebea ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔboa a ɛma wogye mmofraberem "diverse experiences" osuahu ahorow tom na wɔte ase?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua a Wɔbɛhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Mmabunbere mu osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔakamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nipadua ahorow ne gye a wogye tom ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Ɛhyɛ nkuran: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne asetra mu akuw ahorow mu de anya ntease ne gye a wogye tom. Nsusuwii hunu a Ɛyɛ Nsɛnnennen "Challenging Stereotypes": Kasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne animtiaabu a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nipadua ho mfonini ho, na wɔhyɛ nkrasɛm ahorow a ɛfa nnipa nyinaa ho na wogye tom ho nkuran. Atipɛnfoɔ a Wɔboa: Mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ne mmoa akuo a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ suahunu ne wɔn tebea ahodoɔ bɛtumi akyɛ wɔn nhyiamu na wɔaboa wɔn ho wɔn ho. Nsakraeɛ a Wɔhwehwɛ wɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu "Seeking Policy Changes": Nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnwuma a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam a ɛhyɛ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun ho nkuran s.e. mmubuafo adamfofa nhyehyɛe, tow a wɔayi afi hɔ ma ahotew pads.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Osuahu ahorow bɛn na nnipa a sebi wɔadi dɛm a wofi amammerɛ, nyamesom, anaa ɔmanfo tebea ahorow mu nya?
answer_twi_source: Osuahu a ɛfa sebi dɛmdi ho no gu ahorow kɛse gyina: Amammerɛ: Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi gye sebi dɛmdi tom sen afoforo. Ebia atetesɛm mu gyidi ahorow anya sɛnea wobu nnipa a sebi wɔadi dɛm no so nsusuanso. Nyamesom: Nyamesom mu gyidi betumi de mmoa ama anaasɛ ɛde ɔhaw aba nnipa a sebi wɔadi dɛm so. Ɔmanfoɔ Nsɛm: Asetena mu sikasɛm tebea di dwuma wɔ nwomasua, akwahosan, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔbɛnya mu. Nkitahodi ho hia: Sɛ yɛte sɛnea saa nneɛma yi bom di dwuma a, ɛboa ma wɔyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmoa nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow nya mmabun suban, nneyɛe, ne wɔn adwene wɔ nna, brayɛ, awo, ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm afoforo ho no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow taa nya mmabun suban, wɔn nneyɛe, ne wɔn adwene wɔ nna, brayɛ, awo, ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm afoforo ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Mpɛn pii no, wɔde amammerɛ mu ntease ne gyinapɛn ahorow ahyɛ saa nneyɛe yi mu ma, na ɛkyerɛ mmabun ntease wɔ wɔn nipadua ho, mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, amanne ahorow a wɔde hyɛ mmabunbere agyirae no betumi ayɛ nsakrae a ɛkɔ mpanyin mfe so ho sɛnkyerɛnne na ɛde nkrasɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna mu asɛyɛde ne amammerɛ mu nipasu ho ama. Saa ara nso na amanne ahorow a ɛfa awo ho no betumi asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔboa mpɔtam hɔfo ne atetesɛm mu ayaresa nneyɛe so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia nneyɛe bɔne anaasɛ menya ayaresa a enye wɔ akwaa apɔmuden ho adwumayɛbea a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛw Osuahu no: Kyerɛw asɛm a esii no ho nsɛm, a da, bere, ne nea esii ka ho. Bɔ Asɛm no Ho Amanneɛbɔ: Bɔ asɛm no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ adwumayɛbea no sohwɛfo anaa nea ɔhwɛ so no. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne ɔpanyin a wogye no di, ahyehyɛde a ɛhwɛ mmubuafo hokwan ahorow so, anaa kuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ. Susuw Ho sɛ Wobɛbɔ Anwiinwii: Ɛnam sɛnea emu yɛ den so no, wubetumi asusuw ho sɛ wode nsɛm bɛkɔ atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho no anim wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so betumi aboa ma mmabun anya tumi wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so ma mmabun tumi denam nsɛm a edi mu, nhomasua, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no so. Ɛsi mmabun ahofadi a wɔwɔ, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛka wɔn asetra mu so dua. Ɛdenam mmabun a wogye tom sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow so no, saa kwan yi hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, ne mmoa a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi wɔn awo ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wonsuro nyiyim anaa nhyɛso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi de akwankyerɛ anaa mmara asi hɔ ama me nneyɛe wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔnso a ɛfa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛmti ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne w’awofo nyɛ adwuma na fa akwankyerɛ anaa mmara a emu da hɔ si hɔ ma wo nneyɛe wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so a ɛfa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Munsusuw nsɛmti a wogye tom a wɔde bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ, kasa a obu wom, ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma afoforo a wo ne afoforo bedi nkitaho wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ho. Ka hia a ɛho hia sɛ wokora kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm so bere a worekyɛ w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm anaasɛ worebɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛho hia wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ me hokafo po sɛ ɔde kɔndɔm bedi dwuma nso ɛ? Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo hokafo pow sɛ ɔde kɔndɔm bedi dwuma a, ɛho hia sɛ wode w’ahobammɔ di kan. Nneɛma bi ni: Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Dadwen mu: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea ɛhaw wo wɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho ne nea enti a kɔndɔm a wode bedi dwuma ho hia no mu pefee. Fa Nneɛma Foforo Ho Ho nyansahyɛ ma: Fa akwan foforo a wɔfa so nya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a ɛnyɛ nea ɛfa asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nyansahyɛ ma. Nantew Kɔ: Sɛ wo hokafo no rehyɛ wo anaasɛ ɔrema wo ho atɔ wo a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛkɔ. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi wɔ nna ho, na ɔhokafo a obu wo no bɛte ase. Kae sɛ, nkitahodi ne obu yɛ ade titiriw a ɛma obi nya abusuabɔ pa. Nsuro sɛ wobɛkasa ama wo nna mu akwahosan!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne brayɛ, na bere bɛn na ebefi ase ama me?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ yɛ ɔbaa awo nhyehyɛe no fã a efi awosu mu. Ɛyɛ berɛ a nipadua no hwie awotwaa (awotwaa) no ntama fa ɔbaa no awotwaa mu no. Yei taa si  nna miɛnsa de kɔpem nna nson wɔ bosome biaa mu. Sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, brayɛ berɛ tenten yɛ nnafua aduonu nnwɔtwe, nanso mpɛn pii no yie gu ahodoɔ wɔ ɔbaa biara mu . Kyinhyia a wɔyɛ no daa a ɛware anaa ɛyɛ tiaa sen yie, efi nnafua aduonu baako kosi aduasa nnum no yɛ dea ɛfata. Mpɛn pii no, brayɛ fi ase berɛ a wɔadi mfe nkron kosi du nsia, nanso ɛsono obiara. Mmabaa dodoɔ no ara bu wɔn nsa fi mfeɛ du nsia kosi du nnwɔtwe. Awosu, nipadua mu duru,aduan pa ne nneɛma afoforɔ nya nsusuansoɔ wɔ nsabuo so. Ebia wubehu nsɛnkyerɛnne bi te sɛ nufoɔ a ɛrenyin, awotwaa so nhwi, ne nsakrae a ɛba wɔ awotwaa mu ansa na wabu wo nsa a edi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi mu den?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nwomasua asoɛeɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Wɔma mmerante ne mmabaa nya hokwan ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ de sua nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua akwaa, mmabunbere, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na wɔboa mu ho ade. Wobetumi ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi mu den denam hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ gyina adanse so, ɛfata mfe a obi adi, na ɛka osuahu ahorow ne nipasu ahorow ho. Sukuu ahorow nso betumi ama wɔanya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun, a afotu ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ka ho, na wɔama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee wɔ asuafo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne awofo ntam wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Ɛdenam nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho na wɔde ntetee a ɛkɔ so ama akyerɛkyerɛfo so no, sukuu ahorow betumi aboa ma mmabun tumi asi gyinae a ɛfata na wɔde ahotoso afa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne ɔhwɛ a wodi akyi wɔ akyirikyiri, te sɛ denam ahomatrofo (telephone) so akwahosan ho dwumadibea anaa intanɛt so afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi anya mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne ɔhwɛ a wodi akyi wɔ akyirikyiri denam telehealth services, intanɛt so afotu nhyehyɛe, mobile apps, ne virtual mmoa akuw te sɛ "Agoo SHE+" intanɛt so kwan so denam (5100, YENKASA) Nnɔmba a wontua hwee(0800202010), "GHS-YMK" ne nea ɛkeka ho a wɔbɛfrɛ so. mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn kwan ma wɔanya mmoa afi wɔn ankasa fie anaa baabi a wɔpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no di ahiade ne haw pɔtee a mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so hyia no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no di ahiade ne haw pɔtee a mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so hyia no ho dwuma denam wɔn suahu soronko, wɔn mmerɛwyɛ, ne wɔn apɛde ahorow a wohu no so. Wɔde wɔn ani si akwanside ahorow te sɛ nhomasua ne ntetee a wonnya pii, adwumayɛfo gua so nneyɛe a ɛyɛ nyiyim, akatua ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛnyɛ pɛ, sikasɛm mu nnwuma a wonnya, ne ɔhwɛ ne ofie adwuma a wontua hwee ho adesoa a ɛnsɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan horow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so asiw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm  wɔ awoɔ nhyehyɛe adwumayɛbea ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, abusua nhyehyɛe adwumayɛbea ahorow taa de akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ka ho. Akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm te sɛ nnuru a wɔfrɛ wɔ broɔfo kasa mu  Lydia (levonorgestrel) ne Ella (ulipristal acetate) betumi aboa ma wɔasiw nyinsɛn ano bere a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban anaasɛ nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma akyi bere tiaa bi no. Saa akwan yi wɔ hɔ a wɔtɔn wɔ nnurutɔnbea ahorow na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nso betumi de ama bere a wɔrekɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ nsɛm anaa adwenekyerɛ a ɛbɔ abira a efi mmeae a wogye di ne mfɛfo hɔ bere a mekura ɔkwan a ɛho hia a wɔfa so si gyinae mu no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wohyia nsɛm anaa adwene a ɛbɔ abira a efi mmeae a wogye di ne w’atipɛnfo hɔ a, kura ɔkwan a ɛho hia a wobɛfa so asi gyinae mu wɔ adanse ne nsusuwii a ɛwɔ adwene biara akyi a wobɛhwehwɛ mu yiye no so. Susuw sɛnea wotumi gye fibea ahorow no di ne sɛnea nsɛm no ne nokwasɛm ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ hyia no ho. Hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaa nsɛm foforo a wode besiesie nsɛm a ɛne ne ho nhyia, na bue w’ani sɛ wubegyina adanse anaa nhumu foforo so ayɛ nsakrae wɔ w’adwene mu. Fa wo ho to w’ankasa w’atemmu so na fa nsɛm a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho hyia di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya nkɛntɛnso wɔ nsusuwii ne adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ mmaabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ hyehyɛ adwene ne adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho denam nneyɛe, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne gyinapɛn ahorow bi a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho a wɔda no adi so. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dwumadibea ahorow te sɛ television, sini, ab, ne aguade ho dawurubɔ so no, wɔma mmabun nya nkrasɛm ahorow pii a ɛfa nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, a ebetumi anya wɔn gyidi, wɔn suban, ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a obuo wom a wɔfa so ka nna ne abusuabɔ a wɔne LGBTQ + nnipa wɔ ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛkasa wɔ obu mu ni: Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho di dwuma. Bisa nsɛm a emu da hɔ: Sɛ anka wobɛfa no sɛ obi suahu ahorow no, bisa nsɛm na ama woate wɔn adwene ase. Fa w’adwene si pene a wɔpene so so: Ɛho hia ma obiara, a nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Yɛ otiefo a ɔyɛ nnam: Yɛ aso na bue w’ani ma osuahu ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen bɛn na aguanfo, atubrafo, ne mmabun a wɔatu afi wɔn afie mu hyia wɔ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Kasa mu akwanside ahorow. Mmara kwan so anohyeto ahorow. Nyiyimu. Nwoma a wonni. Ɔhwɛ a anohyeto wom a ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Nneɛma a entumi nnyina pintinn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asiesie m’ankasa me gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ne m’amammerɛ anaa mpɔtam hɔ de bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere?
answer_twi_source: Wo ho Nsusuwii: Gye bere fa te w’ankasa wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne akwahosan ho no ase. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wobue: Wo ne mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne adwene ama no nni nkitaho. Nhomasua: Sua adwene ahorow a ɛwɔ w’amammerɛ mu ho ade na hwehwɛ sɛnea ɛne w’ankasa de hyia anaasɛ ɛsono. Adwene a Wonni Wɔ Obu Mu: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubenya adwene a ɛsono emu biara, nanso fa obu ne tema di nkɔmmɔbɔ ho dwuma. Hwehwɛ Nea Wogyina So: Hwehwɛ gyinapɛn ne nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔbom yɛ a ebetumi de ankorankoro gyidi ahorow ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow abɔ mu. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ akasakasa a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi afotufo anaa mpɔtam hɔ akuw a wɔhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea ahorow mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun? (ankorankoro ayaresa nkitahodie, kuw ayaresa nkitahodie anaa intanɛt so ayaresa nkitahodie)
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro Aaaresa ((wo ne dɔkota nko ara). Kuw Ayaresa (ne afoforo) . Abɛɛfo ntentan so Afotu ayaresa  (virtual).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nnwuma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ mu nkate ne obu ho nkuran wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛbɛdi nkonim no bi ne: atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a mmabun di anim na ɛma mmabun a wɔfiri amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu de wɔn ho hyɛ nhyiamu, nkɔmmɔdie, ne nnwuma a wɔde kɔma nkurɔfoɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔayɛ no amammerɛ kwan so a ɛde kasa nkyerɛaseɛ, nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ fekubɔ ka ho na ama wɔanya nkɔsoɔ ne gyeɛ a wɔgye tom no tu mpɔn. Nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ntam de ayɛ nna mu akwahosan ho adesua a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ntetee nhyehyɛe, ne mmoa nnwuma. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɛkyerɛ hia a amammerɛ mu nkate ne obu ho hia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe mu, na ɛde nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne nkɔso ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ahobammɔ abien ho hia na ama wɔatumi asiw nyinsɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STI) ahorow ano no so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ahobammɔ abien ma wo ahobammɔ nyinaa kɔ soro kɛse wɔ nyinsɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STI) nyinaa ho. Fa no sɛ sɛ wode "seatbelt" ne "airbag" bɛhyɛ lɔre mu – abien no nyinaa ma ahobammɔ kɛse sen biako nkutoo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaahosan ho nnwuma ho ka nya mmabun a wobenya kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne akwan ahorow a wɔfa so yɛ awo nhyehyɛe no so nsunsunaso?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho ka a wɔbɔ no nya mmabun a wobenya kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ abusua nhyehyɛe no so nsunsuanso: Ka kɛse a wɔbɔ wɔ kotoku mu wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, te sɛ, mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUD), nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwan yi. Insurance a wonnya anaasɛ sika a wɔmfa mma nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata no betumi de sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow aba wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya mu, na ɛde nsonsonoe aba wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma mu wɔ mmabun a wofi asetra ne sikasɛm mu tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ pene a mepene so sɛ menya ayaresa, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛdefa aduruyɛ a wɔpene so, a nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho no, hokwan ahorow a wowɔ no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so: Wɔ aman pii mu no, mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔpene so ma ayaresa bi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, titiriw sɛ wobu wɔn sɛ mmofra nkumaa a wɔn ho akokwaw anaasɛ sɛ wɔrehwehwɛ nnwuma a ɛfa akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu ho a. Mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ma nyinsɛn a woyi gu, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina mfe a woadi, onyin, ne tebea pɔtee bi so, enti ɛho hia sɛ wote wo hokwan ahorow ase na wohwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mmara ho abenfo hɔ sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ mihia afotu anaa ayaresa?
answer_twi_source: Awerɛhow/dadwen/abufuw a ɛkɔ so daa. Ɔhaw a wogyina ano. Dae/aduan ho akɔnnɔ sesa. Anidaso a wonni. Nsusuwii a wonya sɛ wobepira wo ho. Abusuabɔ mu apereperedi. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wode w’adwene besi biribi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛtaa ma mmabun ntumi nnhu nipadua no yiye na wonnya obu mma wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu kuro Ntotoho: Sɛ ɔde ne ho toto atipɛnfo anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware ho. Atipɛnfo Nhyɛso: Nhyɛso a wɔte nka sɛ wo ne ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow hyia anaasɛ wɔne w’atipɛnfo nhyia. Abusua Nkɛntɛnso: Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abusua mufo ka wɔ sɛnea wɔn ho yɛ fɛ ho. Asisifo anaa Nsisi: Ayayade anaa fɛwdi a ɛfa nipadua mu hwɛbea ho a wubehyia. Ahodwiriw anaa Ayawyade: Osuahu ahorow a atwam a ɛfa adwenemhaw anaa ayayade a ɛka obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne nipadua mfonini ho. Nipasu Su: Pɛpɛpɛyɛ, ahotoso a ɛba fam wɔ ne ho, anaa dadwen a ɛma nipadua ho mfonini ho dadwen yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ayaresa adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛyɛ na wɔate mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔfiri aman foforɔ so ne mmusuakuo nketewa mu nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ahiadeɛ ne nea wɔpɛ ase yie, bere a wɔresusu kasa, amammere, ne nyamesom ho?
answer_twi_source: yaresa adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ate mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔfiri aman foforɔ so ne mmusuakuo nketewa mu nna ne awoɔ ho ahiadeɛ ase yie. Eyi bi ne sɛ wɔbɛma kasa asekyerɛfoɔ aba, wɔapre ntetee nneɛma wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu, na wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ne amammere mu ntamgyinafoɔ abɔ mu ayɛ adwuma na nteaseɛ aba. Amammere mu ntetee a wɔde bɛma ayaresa adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no bɛboa ama wɔanya nimdeɛ afa amammere mu gyidie, nneyɛeɛ, ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho. Bio nso, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ayaresabea bi a ɛgye obiara, a obiara mmu obi fɔ, na mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa anya awerɛhyem sɛ wɔbɛtumi aka nea ɛhia wɔn na wɔabisa nsɛm a ɛha wɔn adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na tu a wotu fi wɔn afie mu, atutra, ne aguanfo tebea ka mmabun SRH aba ne nnwuma a ɛho hia te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne HIV/AIDS ano a wosiw ne ayaresa a wonya?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a Wonya: Nnipa a wotu wɔn fi wɔn afie mu, atutra, ne aguanfo tebea taa ma wonnya SRH nnwuma a ɛho hia te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne HIV/AIDS a wosiw ano ne ayaresa, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nsɛm ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa SRH ho. Mmerewa a Ɛkɔ Anim: Mmabun a wɔwɔ tebea horow yi mu no betumi ahyia asiane ne aware a wɔhyɛ ntɛm, nna a wɔde di gua, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ne basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, na ɛbɛma wɔn SRH aba ne wɔn yiyedi asɛe bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ me nna mu apɔwmuden ne me abusuabɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Sua nna mu apɔwmuden , nyinsɛn ano aduru, abusuabɔ, ne nkitahodi ho ade, fi wɛbsaet ahorow a wogye di te sɛ YMK app no so. ɛho hia sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow sɛ ɛnyɛ asɛm an w'anigye no ho nsɛm nyinaa na ɛteɛ. Susuw wo gyinapɛn ahorow ho: Dɛn na ɛho hia wo wɔ abusuabɔ mu ne w’awerɛkyekye dodow wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu? Susuw asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ mu no ho: Susuw nea ebetumi afi nna mu dwumadi mu aba, te sɛ STI ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ho. Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a w’awofo ka ho, ɔfotufo bi a ɔwɔ sukuu mu anaasɛ ɔhwɛfo a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa su wɔ apɔwmuden adwumayɛbea no nsusuw wo nsɛmmisa ne wo haw ahorow ho. Kari mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwom: Susuw tebea bi afã horow nyinaa ho ansa na woasi gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no anya ahobammɔ wɔ adwumayɛbea, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama adwumayɛbea ahorow a ahobammɔ wom?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no ahobammɔ wɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow no bi ne: Adwumayɛ mu akwahosan ne ahobammɔ ho mmara: Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow di mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa adwumayɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom, ntetee a ɛfata, ne asiane ahorow a wosiw ano wɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow no di dwuma. Ahobammɔ ho ntetee: Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ adwumawuranom de ahobammɔ ho ntetee a edi mu ma adwumayɛfo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so, a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nnwinnade a wɔde di dwuma, akwan a wɔfa so di dwuma ntɛm ara, ne ergonomics ho. Amanneɛbɔ akwan: Mmabun betumi akamfo adwumayɛbea ahorow a ahobammɔ wom denam: Asiane anaa ahobammɔ ho nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho amanneɛ akyerɛ adwuma so ahwɛfo, adwumayɛfo dwumadibea ahorow, anaa atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho no so. Adwumayɛbea ahobanbɔ boayikuw anaa adwumayɛfo agyinatukuw mu kyɛfa a wobenya de ama nkurɔfo ate ahobammɔ ho nsɛm ase na wɔahyɛ ano aduru ho nyansa. Akuw a mmabun di anim a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ adwumayɛbea ahobammɔ ho nkuran na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ahobammɔ ho mmara nni dwuma denneennen a wɔbɛka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa afotufo betumi ahyɛ mmabun nkuran na wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔanya nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho sɛ ahokokwaw a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛma wɔn gyinaesi tumi akɔ anim, anya wɔn ho mu ahotoso, na wɔama ankorankoro nyin na wɔatumi agyina ano?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne afotufoɔ bɛtumi ahyɛ mmabun nkuran na wɔaboa wɔn wɔ nneyɛeɛ a wɔde dwene nneɛma ho a wɔbɛnya denam saa nneyɛeɛ yi a wɔn ankasa bɛyɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ ne hokwan a wɔde bɛdwene nneɛma ho wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu no so. Wobetumi ahyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔayɛ nantenante, ayɛ adwene mu apɔ mu ateneatene, de wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow mu, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfo nkɔmmɔbɔ mu. Nsɛm pa a wɔde ma ne nea wogye tom no hyɛ mmabun mmɔdenbɔ mu den na ɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔntoa wɔn nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho no so. Bio nso, mpanyimfo betumi ayɛ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn nkate, ne osuahu ahorow mu pefee. Ɛnam hia a wohu hia a nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho ho hia wɔ gyinaesi tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ahotoso a wɔbɛma anya wɔn ho, ne ankorankoro nkɔso ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so no, mpanyimfo betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔanya saa ahokokwaw a ɛho hia yi a wɔde bɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi mu wɔ wɔn asetra mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na asɛm a wɔka no pintinn di wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔde di dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ka a wobɛka no pintinn ho hia wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wobɛfa so no mu efisɛ ɛma wutumi ka w’ahye ho asɛm pintinn na obu mu. Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ pintinn hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛda wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne w’ahiade adi pefee na woakyerɛ a emu da hɔ, bere a wodi afoforo hokwan ahorow nso. Ɛma wotumi gyina w’ankasa akyi a wonyɛ basabasa anaasɛ wonyɛ hwee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛte aniwu anaa fɛre nka bere a wobisa nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata koraa sɛ wobɛte aniwu anaa fɛre nka bere a woresusuw nsɛmti yi ho no, titiriw sɛ ɛyɛ wo bere a edi kan a. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛte nka saa, na bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛkae wo ho sɛ nsɛmmisa a wubebisa no yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛma wosua ade na wunyin.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmarimaa ne mmerante a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so di wɔ sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho a wɔhwehwɛ, na wɔde di dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmarimaa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so di dwuma titire wɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho a wɔhwehwɛ,na wɔde adi dwuma denam mmarima ne mmaa ho adwene ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ a wɔbɛkasa atia, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne abusuabɔ a obuo wom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne mmea tumidi nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔboa no so. Wobetumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛboa mmarima ne mmea nyinaa, akasa atia suban ne nneyɛe a epira a ɛma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kɔ so, na wɔayɛ sɛ ayɔnkofo ne ahokafo wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So Partner Notification Services yɛ kokoamsɛmu? Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbɔ kokoamu nsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Partner Notification Services de kokoamsɛmu di kan de hyɛ ankorankoro nkuran ma wɔbɔ wɔn ahokafo amanneɛ a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka. Wɔtaa bɔ kokoamsɛmu ho ban denam akwan horow te sɛ: -Abɔde a wɔde bɛbɔ amanneɛ a wɔmmɔ wɔn din a wɔde bɛma, baabi a ankorankoro betumi abɔ wɔn ahokafo amanneɛ a wɔrenkyerɛ wɔn nipasu. - a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛfa nea ɛbɛtumi ada no adi ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛ ho no sie na wɔde bɛma apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔama wɔn tumi anaa ɔmanfoɔ apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ nko ara. -Mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro a wɔrefa ɔhokafo amanneɛbɔ mu, a mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia a wɔbɛka ho asɛm na wɔadi kokoamu nsɛm ho haw ahorow ho dwuma ka ho. - a wobedi mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ a ɛfa ayarefo kokoamsɛmu hokwan ahorow ho, te sɛ HIPAA mmara a ɛwɔ United States anaa mmara a ɛte saa ara wɔ aman afoforo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛmma nhoma kyerɛw, adwene mu apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, adwennwen a wɔkyerɛ kwan, nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ wɔn ho mu, anaa atipɛnfo nkɔmmɔbɔ betumi adi wɔ nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw na wɔahyɛ wɔn ho a wobehu, wɔn ho a wɔda no adi, ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nninnade ne akwan horow pii betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasusu nneɛma ho yiye (reflective practices) na ama wɔahu wɔn ankasa su, wɔada wɔn ho adi, na wɔanya tumi.Adwene mu nkyerɛwee (Journaling): Eyi ma kwan ma wɔtumi kyerɛw wɔn adwene ne wɔn nkaeɛ ato hɔ, wɔahu nneɛma a ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn asetena mu, na wɔanya nteaseɛ wɔ kwan a wɔfa so si gyinaeɛ ho.Adwene mu nkyerɛkyerɛ (Mindfulness exercises): Akwan te sɛ mframa a wode bɛhome wɔ adwene mu anaa wo nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu (body scans) boa mmabun ma wɔhunu nea ɛrekɔ so saa berɛ yi ara, na wɔahu wɔn adwene ne wɔn nkaeɛ a wɔmmu wɔn ho atɛn.Adwene mu nteteeɛ (Guided meditation): Eyi bɛtumi ama wɔanya mmoa a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛeɛ pa ma adwenedwene, berɛ a ankasa-ho-nhwehwɛmu nninnadeɛ (self-assessment tools) nso ma mmabun kwan ma wɔsusu wɔn ahoɔden, wɔn mmerɛwyɛ, ne mmeaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnyini wɔ ho.Mfɛfoɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ (Peer discussions): Eyi hyehyɛ baabi a mmoa wɔ ma suahunu ne adwene horow a wɔbɛkyɛ, na ɛhyɛ adesua ne ogyeɛ a wɔgye wɔn ho tom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So kwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so di nna mu agorɔ a ɛte asiane so te sɛ: oral sex ne anal sex?
answer_twi_source: Aane, akwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so tew asiane so a wɔayɛ ama nna mu dwumadi ahorow: - Wɔ nna a wɔde ano ka ho: Kɔndɔm anaa nsensan a wɔde di dwuma de tew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya STI no so, titire wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho akɔnnɔ mu anaa ano ne akyi berɛmo mu nkitahodi ho. -  anal sex: Kondom a wode srade a nsuo anaa silicone afra mu bedi dwuma de atew friction so na asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ condom bɛbubu no so atew. Sɛ wɔde kɔndɔm a ɛyɛ den a wɔayɛ ama ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna wɔ akyi berɛmo mu di dwuma a, ebetumi ama ahobammɔ nso ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu nsɛm bi a ɛka mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan Ho Nnwuma a Wonya: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi anya ne nea wobetumi anya so nkɛntɛnso. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔkamfo nkurɔfo na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ saa nnwuma yi bɛka obiara ho na wobetumi anya bi. Nhomasua ne Amanneɛbɔ: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow hwɛ hu sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛka obiara ho na wɔayɛ no sɛnea mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiade te. Nsɛm a wontumi nnya no betumi asiw mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo ho no kwan. Mmara kwan so Ahobammɔ: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow bɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho ban fi ayayade ne nyiyim ho. Mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a wɔde bedi dwuma denneennen na wɔayɛ ahobammɔ foforo a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no ho hia yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ayɛ ma mmoa ne nkabom aba wɔ me mpɔtam ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Bɛyɛ ɔkasamafoɔ na ko ma nkabom adekyerɛ mmra wɔn sukuu mu, na afei ko tia nyiyimu so ka ho. Yɛ anaa sɛ fa wo ho dɔm mmabun kuo a ɛma ɔmo kwan ma wɔkyerɛ wɔn adwene ne suahunu. Hwɛ sɛ obia benya obou ama ne mfɛfoɔ. Fa wo ho adesua dwumadie ahorow mu a agyina mmabun nsɛm soɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ bɛn na mmabun a wofi abusua ahorow mu hyia wɔ nna ne awo mu nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya no mu, a akwanside ahorow no bi ne; sikasɛm, awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ, ne animtiaabu anaa nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wofi abusua ahorow mu betumi ahyia ɔhaw ahorow wɔ nna ne awo mu nsɛm. Akwansideɛ no bi ne, mmabun a wowɔ ɔwofo baako anaa ɛfie a ɔnni sika no betumi ahyia sikasɛm mu ahokyere a ɛntumi ma wɔn nnya nna ne awo mu nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe mmoa, te sɛ aduru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano anaa nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu, bere a wɔn a wofi mmusua a wɔyɛ katee anaa ɔsom mu no betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen a ɛfa awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ anaasɛ animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho. Bio nso, mmebun a wɔte nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no betumi ahyia ɔhaw ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho esiane sɛ wonni hɔ anaasɛ kar a wobetumi afa so nti. Saa akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma a wobedi hwehwɛ akwan a ɛkɔ akyiri a wosusuw mmabun a wofi abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ahiade ne tebea soronko ho na wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata a mmerante ne mmabaa nyinaa nya di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanhyia ahorow bi a ɛtaa si nna mu anigye ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wonnya: Nkitahodi mu akwanside ahorow betumi de ntease a ɛnteɛ anaa ahiade ahorow a wonnya nnii ho dwuma aba. Di dwuma denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne atie a wɔde nsiyɛ a wobɛma anya nkɔso so. Nipadua Mfonini Ho Nsɛm: Nipadua ho mfonini a enye betumi asiw nna mu ahotoso ne anigye kwan. Ko denam wo ho dɔ a wode w’adwene besi so, sintɔ ahorow a wubegye atom, ne nea wo nipadua tumi yɛ a wobɛkyerɛ ho anisɔ no so. Adwennwen ne Dadwen: Adwennwen a efi da biara da asetra anaa abusuabɔ ho nsɛm mu no betumi asiw abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den kwan. Di adwennwen ho dwuma denam akwan a wobɛfa so agye w’ahome, adwene a wode bedi dwuma, anaa mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi animdefo so. Nipadua mu Ɔhaw: Ɛyaw anaa ahotɔ a ɛba bere a ɔne obi reda no betumi ayɛ akwanside. Di ho dwuma denam srade a wode bedi dwuma, gyinabea ahorow a wobɛsɔ ahwɛ, anaasɛ sɛ wokɔ so a, hwehwɛ nnuruyɛfo afotu so. Ahodwiriw a atwam: Ahodwiriw a atwam no betumi aka ahobammɔ ne ahotoso a obi wɔ wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu ho atenka. Hwehwɛ ayaresa anaa afotu a wode bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ osuahu ahorow a atwam mu na woanya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa me ma masusuw nkrasɛm, mfonini, ne nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho a wɔda no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow te sɛ TV so dwumadi ahorow, sini ahorow, aguade ho dawurubɔ, sohyial media, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow mu no mu yiye na mahwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa wo ma woasusuw nkrasɛm, mfonini, ne nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho a wɔada no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu no mu yiye denam: Akwan ne akwan horow a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo fa so de nkrasɛm pɔtee bi ma anaasɛ wonya atiefo adwene so nkɛntɛnso no ase. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, ahotoso, ne animhwɛ a ebetumi aba ho kyim. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho a wɔbɛkyerɛ ase wɔ wɔn amammerɛ, asetra, ne abakɔsɛm mu nsɛm mu. Nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya wɔ suban, gyidi, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne gyinaesi ho a wɔhyehyɛ so a wobehu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwumakuo anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn hokwan ne ahobammɔ ase sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu mu?
