answer_twi_source: Nnwumakuo ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn hokwan ne ahobanbɔ ase sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Asoɛeɛ nhwehwɛmu bagua (IRB) anaa abrabɔ pa ho boayikuo a wɔhwɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ mu na wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔdi abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne mmara gyinapɛn so. Nhwehwɛmu abrabɔ pa ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ne intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun atiefo, a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa nhwehwɛmu hokwan ahorow, pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma, kokoamsɛm, ne amanneɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe ma. Nnwumakuo ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne akuw a wɔboa a wɔde wɔn adwene si abrabɔ pa ho nhwehwɛmu nneyɛe a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ho ban wɔ nhwehwɛmu tebea horow mu. Nhwehwɛmu asoɛe ne sukuupɔn a wɔde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu, a nsɛm a ɛfa nhwehwɛmu adesua ho, nkrataa a wɔde pene so, ne akwan a wɔfa so ma nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene anaa anwiinwii sɔre ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na aban nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow di wɔ hwɛ a wɔbɛma mmabun anya nnuan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata ma ɔmo mu?
answer_twi_source: Aban nhyehyeɛ ne nhyehyeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ hwɛ a ɛbɛma mmabun anya aduane a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata denam: Aduan mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ: Te sɛ nea broni atwaso ka no 'SNAP, WIC', ne sukuu aduane nhyehyɛeɛ de sikasɛm mu mmoa ne aduane ho nneɛma ma mmusua a wɔn sikasɛm tebea nye. Adan a ne bo nyɛ den ho nhyehyɛe: Nea ɛka ho ne adan a wɔde sika boa, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde boa dan ka, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw afie a wonni ano a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya adan a ahobammɔ wom na ne bo nyɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea bi mmu LGBTQ+ nipasu so no anaasɛ wɔyɛ nyiyimu, na dɛn na metumi ayɛ wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo anaa akuo ahorow bi rentumi mmue mma nnipa binom esiane nneɛma ahorow nti. Ɛda adi sɛ eyi nyɛ nea ɛyɛ efisɛ wɔatete wɔn sɛ wɔmfa nnwuma a adwemmɔne biara nni mu mma efisɛ ɔman mma nyinaa fata sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nanso, obi betumi abɔ osuahu ahorow a ɛnyɛ dɛ ho amanneɛ akyerɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow no mpanyimfo anaasɛ ɔbɛpɛ ɔhwɛ wɔ beae foforɔ. Wubetumi nso ama oduruyɛfo no ahu sɛ w'ani nngye nea ɔmo yɛ no. .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛkwan bɛn so na metumi de dwumadi ahorow anaa adeyɛ tebea ahorow adi dwuma  ama me nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne ahotoso a mewɔ wɔ m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu asɛm ho gyinaesi ahorow ho  ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadi ahorow a wode di dwuma anaa sɛ wode sua ade betumi ama wo nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu nsɛm ho gyinaesi no ayɛ kɛse.  Sua sɛdeɛ yɛka daabi wɔ obuo mu,  a wobɛka no pefee, ne mmoayɛ foforo anaa nea wobɛma wo ho atɔ so di dwuma. Dwumadi a wodi no ma wutumi yɛ asetra mu tebea horow ankasa ho mfonini wɔ baabi a ahobammɔ ne nea wɔahyɛ so, na ɛboa wo ma wunya ahotoso ne ahokokwaw wɔ nkitahodi a ɛyɛ katee mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma a metumi apaw bi? (wɔabue, wɔato mu, ɔman no mu, amanaman ntam)
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ-gye-ayɛ-wo-deɛ a ɛda hɔ (Open Adoption): Eyi ma kwan ma nkitaho (nkrataa, "emails") anaa nsrahwɛ kɔ so wɔ awofoɔ a wɔawo abofra no ne abusua foforɔ a wɔagye no no ntam.Awoɔ-gye-ayɛ-wo-deɛ a ɛyɛ kokoam (Closed Adoption): Nkitaho biara mma wɔ awofoɔ a wɔawo abofra no ne abusua foforɔ no ntam wɔ berɛ a wɔde abofra no ama akyi. Eyi tumi ma obiara nya ne kokoamsɛm yie.Ɔman mu Awoɔ-gye-ayɛ-wo-deɛ (Domestic Adoption): Eyi yɛ abofra a wɔgye no wɔ U.S. (anaa ɔman a wowɔ mu no) mu. Eyi bɛtumi ayɛ ntɛm na ne boɔ nso nyɛ den sɛ wɔde toto amanaman ntam deɛ ho a.Amanaman ntam Awoɔ-gye-ayɛ-wo-deɛ (International Adoption): Eyi yɛ abofra a wɔgye no firi ɔman foforɔ mu. Saa kwan yi bɛtumi ayɛ den kakra na agye berɛ tenten.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a mmabun betumi afa so akura wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no ne kokoam nsɛm mu, titiriw sɛ ɛhaw wɔn sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia akyerɛ afoforo a?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm a Wɔbɛkora So: Mmabun betumi akura wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no ne kokoamsɛm mu denam nnipa a wogye wɔn di a wɔbɛpaw sɛ wɔne wɔn bɛkyɛ na wɔaka nea wɔpɛ wɔ kokoamsɛm ho no ho asɛm pefee so. Wobetumi nso de akwan a ahobammɔ wom a wɔfa so de nsɛm a ɛho hia sie, te sɛ dijitaal nkrataa a wɔde password abɔ ho ban anaasɛ honam fam nhoma a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm a wɔde asie wɔ baabi a obiara nni hɔ nso adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ nhwɛso pa ama me nnamfo wɔ abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ne basabasayɛ a wosiw ano no mu?
answer_twi_source: Di anim denam Nhwɛso so (kyerɛ abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa). Kasa (frɛ GBV/obu a wonni).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu nneɛma hyehyɛ adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ pene so, nhyɛso, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi nsɛm yi ho dwuma wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneɛma na ɛkyerɛ adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ ɔpene so, nhyɛso, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho denam adwene a wonya wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow, tumi a ɛkɔ so, ne nna ho so nkɛntɛnso so. Saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma a wobedi wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ pene ne abusuabɔ pa ho, wɔkasa tia mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, wɔhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran, na wɔde mmoa ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma anaa nneɛma ahorow bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfo deboa mmabun wɔ awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi aboa ama mmabun nneɛma ahodoɔ a ɛboa wɔ ahiadeɛ a ɛfa awoɔ akwahosan ho. Eyinom bi ne: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhyiam ahorow: Nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STIs, pene a wɔpene so, ne nkitahodie pa ho. Afotu ne mmoa: Kokoam afotu adwuma a wɔde ma de di mmabun nsɛmmisa, wɔn haw ahorow, ne nkate fam ahiade ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho dwuma. Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya: Kɔndɔm, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo a wɔbɛkyekyɛ, ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma ho. STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa: STI nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne afotu a wɔde besiw nna mu nyarewa ano na wɔadi ho dwuma a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Nnipa wɔkamfo ne nkitahodie a ɛda ɔhwɛ ntam: Kamfo a wobɛkamfo baeɛ pa ama mmabun ama wakɔ adwumayɛfo ne ayaresabea ahorow akɔyɛ nhwehwɛ mu nnwuma ahodoɔ te sɛ, akwaa hwɛ, abusua nhyehyɛe, ne nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu . Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛma mmabun asusuw awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔanya atipɛnfo mmoa. Nsɛm a wɔka de tae akyi ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde ma: Mmabun a wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔkamfo wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow, di animtiaabu ne nyiyim ho dwuma, na wonya nnwuma a ɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atenka nya yɛn da biara da asetra, abusuabɔ, ne yɛn adwenemyare nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Daa Asetra: Atenka nya yɛn nsusuwii, yɛn nneyɛe, ne yɛn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso, na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea yɛyɛ yɛn ade wɔ tebea horow ho na yɛne afoforo di nkitaho. Abusuabɔ: Nkate ka sɛnea yɛne afoforo di nkitaho, di nkitaho, na yɛne afoforo di nkitaho. Nkate a ɛfata a wɔda no adi no ma wonya tema, ntease, ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Adwene mu Akwahosan Nyinaa: Nkate a wɔanhwɛ so anaasɛ emu yɛ den betumi ama adwennwen, dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adwenemyare afoforo aba. Sua a wobesua sɛnea wɔbɛhyehyɛ nkate horow yiye no ho hia na ama woakɔ so anya adwene mu yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aka deɛ ɛkeyre m'adwene akyerɛ m'awofoɔ bere a meekɔ mmabun berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Tie (Listen). Kasa (Express) - nya abotrɛ ka wo nsɛm. Bisa (Ask) - bisa nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya wɔ apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nna ne awoɛ apomoden ho ade?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su taa de nneɛma ahorow ma de kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhomawa ahorow, nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm, nkratawa, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho. Intanɛt so nneɛma ne nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun atiefo titiriw. Nhyiam ahorow, kuo nhyiam ahorow, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene sii nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti so, a mpɛn pii no apomoden ho adwumayɛfo anaa akyerɛkyerɛfo a wɔatete wɔn na wodi anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn kwan pa ho nsusuwii ahorow na ɛka ho wɔ akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu a wobedi ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Kwan pa ho nsusuiɛ a ɛwɔ akwahosan mu nsonsonoeɛ ne pɛyɛ a ɛnni mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛpene so wɔ nimdeɛ mu, wɔbɛkyerɛ obuo ama mmabun ahofadie ne kokoamsɛm, wɔbɛkwati kasa ne nneyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa, wɔde wɔn adwene si nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ den so,ne tumi a ɛkɔ so ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ wɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie mu a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a abu so wɔ awo ne abusua a wɔbɛkyekye ho a ɛsɛsɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: Mpanyimfo a wɔn mfe akɔ anim nkutoo na awo so tew. Nokwasɛm: Bere a awo so tew bere a obi nyin no, mmabun da so ara tumi nya awo ho nsɛm esiane nneɛma ahorow nti. Atosɛm: Sɛ obi da pɛnkoro pɛ a, ebetumi ama wanyinsɛn. Nokwasɛm: Ɛnyɛ sɛ obi bɛda nyinsɛn a wɔammɔ ho ban biako pɛ so. Atosɛm: Awo ho ayaresa yɛ adwuma bere nyinaa. Nokwasɛm: Awo ho ayaresa betumi ayɛ nea emu yɛ den na ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na edi mu. Ɛho hia sɛ wodi akwanhwɛ ahorow ho dwuma na wohwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ayaresa ahorow no antumi anyɛ yiye a. Atosɛm: Bere nyinaa awo a wontumi nwo no yɛ ɔbea no mfomso. Nokwasɛm: Nneɛma a ɛka mmarima ne mmea nyinaa betumi de awo a wontumi nwo aba, na ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na ɛfi biribi a obi yɛe anaa wanyɛ mu ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ ASRH ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo hwɛ hu sɛ akwan a wɔfa so boaboa nsɛm ano no yɛ nea ɛfata na ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun hokwan ne kokoam nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmabun SRH ho no bi ne akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ dodow ne su nyinaa, te sɛ nhwehwɛmu, nsɛmbisa, FGD, nea wɔahu, ne nkrataa mu nhwehwɛmu. Nhwehwɛmufoɔ hwɛ sɛ akwan a wɔfa so boaboa nsɛm ano no yɛ abrabɔ pa na ɛkyerɛ obuo ma mmabun hokwan ne kokoamsɛm denam: Mpene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye: Wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no te nhwehwɛmu no atirimpɔw, asiane, ne mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ so no ase na wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho bere biara. Ahintasɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no ho nsɛm ne wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban denam data a wɔbɛkora so yiye na wɔammɔ nea efi mu ba no din so. Ahofadi a wobebu: Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn kwan ma wɔafi wɔn pɛ mu de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, a wɔrenhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ afoforo nhyɛ wɔn so, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya sikakorabea akontaabu anaa sikasɛm mu nneɛma afoforo na wɔabue, na nkrataa anaa krataa bɛn na wobehia anaa ebia wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛw?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, mmabun betumi abue sikakorabea akontaabu anaasɛ wɔanya sikasɛm mu nneɛma afoforo denam: Sikakorabea baa dwumadibea anaa sikakorabea a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ a wɔbɛkɔ na wɔne ananmusifo bi akasa so. Nkrataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ obi te sɛ karka tumi krataa, akwantu tumi krataa, anaa awo ho adansedi krataa a wɔde bɛma. Mfe a ɛsɛ sɛ obi adi a, ɛba fam koraa a sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow de asi hɔ no a wobedi ho dwuma, a mpɛn pii no wɔadi mfe 18 ma akontaabu a ɛde ne ho. Sikakorabea ahorow bi de akontaabu anaa nhyehyɛe titiriw bi ma mmofra nkumaa, a ebia ɛbɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɔwofo anaa ɔhwɛfo bi de ne ho hyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na  mɛkasa akyerɛ ayaresafoɔ fa me sexual health ho bere a mewɔ 'disability' (dɛmdi) bi?
answer_twi_source: Di nokware: Ka biribiara kyerɛ wɔn na wɔatumi aboa wo. Siesie wo ho: Twerɛ wo nsɛmmisa sie ansa na woakɔ. Fa obi ka wo ho: Wubetumi so ne adamfo anaa abusuanii a wogye no di akɔ ma ɔakoama wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so akwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho sɛ ɔbabun?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun no, wowɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, a nea ɛka ho ne kwan a wowɔ sɛ wunya kokoam nnwuma a ɛnyɛ nyiyimu, wusi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ w’akwahosan ho, na wopene so sɛ wakwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛsa wo yare.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim ma wɔasua hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ ho nsɛm pii na wɔakasa ama wɔn nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim ma wɔasua pii afa nnipa hokwan ahorow ho na wɔakasa ama wɔn nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow, blog ahorow, ne kuro dawurubɔ ntetan akwan horow, a ɛde nsɛm, nnwinnade, ne nneɛma a ɛfa nnipa hokwan ahorow, nna mu apomoden, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so kamfo nkurɔfo ma. Ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim, akuo a wɔkamafo kyerɛ, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ a ɛma nteteeɛ, adwumayɛbea, ne afotuo hokwan ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔyɛ adwuma ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nsakraeɛ. Nhomasua nneɛma, nhoma ahorow, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow a amanaman ntam nnwumakuw, ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de, ne adesua asoɛe ahorow ayɛ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa nnipa hokwan ahorow, nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmabun tumidi ho. Ntrɛwmu, ahomatrofo a wɔde boa, abɛɛfo ntentan anaa intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma kokoamu mmoa, afotu, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ mmabun a wɔrehyia nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm, hokwan ahorow a wobu so, anaa tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so abɔ dawuro afa nkɔmmɔdidie a obu wom a ɛfa nna ne apɔmden ho nsɛm so wɔ amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu nsonson yɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: hwehwɛ beaɛ a ahobanbɔ ho nsɛn yɛ. Yɛ no sɛ deɛ obiaa ho bɛto no na aboa ama moatumi aka ahuntasɛm woberɛ wonsuro ntenbuo biaa. Amammerɛ mu ahuntasɛm ntete yɛ: Yɛ nkyerɛkyrɛ fa amammerɛ ne nyamesom ho mma obiaa nteaseɛ. Tipɛnkro nkyerekyerɛ. Tete mmabun and hyɛ wɔn kena na atumi aboa ama wadi nkɔmmɔ afa nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' ho na atumi aboa ama obiaa de ne ho ahyɛm. Fa abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so: Nam abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so ka abasɛm ne nsɛm a ɛboa ma nkɔmmɔdidie kɔ so. Gyedie ahodoɔ mu nkɔmmɔdie: Bɔ dawuro fa kyerɛ yɛ a ɛyɛ sɛ agyedifoɔ nyinaa bɛtwetwe nkɔmmɔ abom na aboa ama yɛtumi ahunu sɛdeɛ agyedifoɔ ahodoɔ te nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' ho nsɛn si fa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nsɛm a ɛfata na ɛboa ne nsɛm a ebia ɛkɔ anim dodo anaasɛ ɛso ma me mfe no ntam?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ w’adwene atu afra anaasɛ w'ani nngye nsɛm a worenya no ho a, ebia ɛkɔ akyiri dodo ma wo mprempren mmerɛ mu. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛde kasa ne nsusuii ahorow a wubetumi ate ase na woanya abusuabɔ di dwuma, na susuw ho sɛ wo ne ɔpanin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo anaa sukuu fotufo bi besusu nsɛm biara a ɛhaw adwene ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi asua sɛnea wɔbɛkamfo sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne tebea horow a ɛfata bere a wɔreyɛ apam, ɛrekɔ tipɛnkrom, anaa adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asua sɛnea wɔbɛtumi akasa na wɔakamfo sikasɛm mu nhyehyɛe ne tebea horow a ɛfata bere a wɔreyɛ apam, tipɛnkro, anaa adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe denam wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hokwan ne wɔn asɛyɛde ahorow so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ahwɛyiye hwɛ sikasɛm mu apam biara mu nsɛm mu, hwehwɛ nsɛm a emu nna hɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔyɛ nsakrae ho nkitahodi. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nso siesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi apam biara a ɛne wɔn ahiade nhyia anaasɛ ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia no ho. Ahotoso a wobenya wɔ nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ mu no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya sikasɛm mu nkitahodi a eye na wɔabɔ wɔn anigye ho ban wɔ tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan anaa nhyehyɛeɛ horow a wɔtaa fa so a ankorankoro betumi afa so ahyɛ afoforo anaa wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔde nna ho akɔnnɔ mu no bi ne dɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi?
answer_twi_source: Akwan bi a nkurɔfoɔ taa fa so hyɛ afoforɔ so anaa wɔhyɛ wɔn nsa kɔ nna ho nneyɛeɛ mu bi ne: adwene mu nnaadaa, obi animguaseɛ anaa afodibɔ, ahunahuna ne ehu, ntia, ne mmerɛwyɛ a obi wɔ a wɔde di dwuma bɔne. Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi ahu saa nneyɛeɛ yi denam obi suban a ɛsesa so. Ebi ne sɛ obi bɛkɔ so ara apɛ sɛ ɔne wo nya nna ɛmfa ho sɛ woaka no pefee sɛ wompɛ, mmɔden a obi bɛbɔ sɛ ɔbɛbu wo hyeɛ so anaasɛ ɔbɛma woate nka sɛ woadi mfomsoɔ kɛseɛ anaa animguaseɛ aka wo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛyɛ nea ɔpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee nea broni ka no 'critical thinking skills\' de asɔ sikasɛm ho nsɛm ahwɛ na wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ sikasɛm tebea a emu yɛ den mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee wɔ sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ mu nea broni ka no 'critical thinking skills' denam sua a wobesua sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ sikasɛm ho nsɛm mu, asusuw asiane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ sikasɛm mu nneɛma ne nnwuma so, abisa nsɛm, ahwehwɛ adwene ahorow pii, na wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata a egyina adanse ne nsusuwii so. Akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi ama nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ sikasɛm ho adesua mu denam nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, asetra mu nsɛm ankasa, ne nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, gyinaesi, ne sikasɛm ho nsɛm a wosusuw ho nkuran a wɔde bɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho banbɔ insurance di wɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ma mmabun nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den na ɛyɛ papa, a nea ɛka ho ne anim a wobebisabisa wɔn, nnuru, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ aduruyɛdan mu, ne ayaresabea a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ: Akwahosan ho banbɔ insurance bɔ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ho ban fi sikasɛm mu adesoa a ɛbata akwahosan ho ka ho, a aduruyɛ mu nkɔmmɔ, nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, aduruyɛdan mu nhwehwɛmu, ayaresabea a wɔde wɔn kɔ, ne oprehyɛn ka ho. Nneɛma a wobetumi atɔ: Akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow, sɛ́ ɛyɛ ɔman anaa ankorankoro no, de sika a wɔatew so a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ma, na ɛma ayaresa ho nnwuma a ɛho hia no yɛ nea ne bo yɛ den na mmabun betumi anya bi, a wɔn asetra ne sikasɛm tebea mfa ho. Nneɛma a wɔde tua ho ka nyinaa: Akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow taa de mfaso horow a edi mũ ma, a nea ɛka ho ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw yare ano, ɔhwɛ a edi kan, animdefo a wobisabisa wɔn nsɛm, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu yare, nnwuma a egye ntɛmpɛ, ayaresabea hwɛ, ne adwenemyare ho nnwuma, na ɛhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun nya ayaresa a ɛfata na ɛfata ma wɔn akwahosan ahiade. Ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so: Akwahosan ho insurance ma mmabun tumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nya abusuabɔ, nya ayaresa a ɛkɔ so, di ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow akyi, na wonya nnwuma a ɛho hia a wɔde di akyi, na ɛma ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so ne akwahosan mu nsunsuanso a eye sen biara bere kɔ so no nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na intanɛt so nneɛma betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun afa STI ne HIV ho?
answer_twi_source: Videos ne quizzes. Forums ne social media ahorow. Nkabom a yɛne sukuu ne 'influencers' bɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna ho mmonnaatoɔ a nsa ne nnubɔne bow na ɛde ba no dɔɔso sɛn wɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa mu, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛde saa nneyɛeɛ yi ba?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono sɛnea nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛ mmabun so abu so, nanso nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ nea ɛntaa nsi. Nneɛma a ɛma ɛba no bi ne asetra mu tebea horow a nsa ne nnubɔne wɔ hɔ ntɛm, atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma mu, asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nsa a wɔnom mu, awofo anibiannaso, sohyial media nkɛntɛnso ne nsɛmmɔnedifo a wɔde ankorankoro a wonni ahobammɔ a ebia wontumi nyi wɔn ho ano anaasɛ wontumi nsi wɔn ahye so kɛse bere a wɔanom nsa no di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nneyɛ pa mu haw a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru a wobenya ho na hyɛ ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow ho adwene a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran.
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a Wobesiw Ano: Nneyɛ pa ho nsɛm bi wɔ hɔ, te sɛ hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ ma obiara anya bi a ne bo nyɛ den na ɛyɛ kokoam, a asetena ne sikasɛm mu tebea anaa nyamesom mu gyidi mfa ho. Nsusuwii a Ɛyɛ Den: Susu adwene ahorow ho na kari mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano mu na ama woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata a ɛne w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi afa so akyekyɛ botae akɛse mu ayɛ no anammɔn nketewa anaa nsɛntitire a wotumi di ho dwuma, adi me nkonimdi ahorow ho afahyɛ wɔ kwan so, na makɔ so akanyan na matumi agyina akwanside anaa akwanside ahorow ano?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wobɛfa so akyekyɛ botae akɛse mu ayɛ no anammɔn nketewa a wotumi di ho dwuma, adi nkonimdi ho afahyɛ, na woakɔ so anya ɔpɛ wɔ akwanside ahorow anim no bi ne: Nneɛma atitiriw a wode besi hɔ: Botae ahorow a wobɛkyekyɛ mu ayɛ no nsɛntitiriw nketenkete a wubetumi adu ho no ma wutumi di nkɔso akyi na wudi nea woatumi ayɛ wɔ kwan so no ho afahyɛ. Nneɛma a wɔatumi ayɛ a mfaso wɔ so: Nkonimdi ho afahyɛ a wodi, ɛmfa ho sɛnea ɛyɛ ketewaa, hyɛ nneyɛe pa mu den na ɛkanyan nkɔso a ɛkɔ so de du botae akɛse ho. Sɛ wubenya ahoɔden a wode begyina tebea horow ano: Sɛ wubu akwanside ahorow sɛ adesua hokwan ahorow na wosakra akwan horow no sɛnea ɛho hia a, ɛboa ma wokɔ so gyina tebea horow ano na wode w’adwene si botae ahorow a wode besi bere tenten so, ɛmfa ho nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside ahorow no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na matwa nsɛm a ɛfa aguaman a wɔhyɛ wɔn aniwu, wɔde asodi a wɔde to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa so, anaa su afoforo a epira a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ho ma ɛkɔ so no ho mpoa?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho sɛnea nguaman aniwu ne victim-blaming te wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm mu. Frɛ no: Sɛ wuhu anaa wote nsɛm a ɛfa aguaman a wɔhyɛ wɔn aniwu anaasɛ wɔbɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo ho a, kasa na kasa tia saa su ahorow no. Hyɛ Tema Ho Nkɔso: Hyɛ afoforo nkuran ma wonsusuw nkɛntɛnso a wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn nneyɛe nya wɔ ankorankoro yiyedi so no ho. Kyɛ Nkrasɛm Pa: Kyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛhyɛ obu, tema, ne adwene a ɛfata wɔ nna ho nkuran. Mmoa Ankorankoro a Aka Wɔn: Fa mmoa ne biakoyɛ ma wɔn a saa su horow a epira yi de wɔn ani asi wɔn so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun ne awofoɔ bɛkasa fa nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmden ho na ɔkwan bɛn so na abusuafoɔ betumi aboa nkitahodie mapa a ehu ne suro biaa nim wɔ berɛ a wɔrekasa fa nsɛm bi te yie ho?
answer_twi_source: Pɛ berɛ anaa baabi pa. Kyerɛ sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokasa pefee. Bisa nsɛm anaa yɛ aso tie yie. Awofoɔ mma nkuranhyɛ ne nimdeɛ pa, na wɔmmu mmabun kokoam yɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔde nsa anaa aduro bɔne ma wo de sɛe wo , na wobɛyɛ dɛn abɔ wo ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi wɔ asiane mu sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ obi so wɔ nsa anaa nnubɔne a wɔde ma no so no bi ne: Wɔhyɛ no nkuran anaa wɔhyɛ no ma ɔnom nsa mmoroso anaasɛ ɔmfa nnubɔne nni dwuma a ɛboro wɔn ahotɔ so. Sɛ obi te nka sɛ n’adwene atu afra, ne ho yɛ no basabasa, anaasɛ wabow nsa wɔ ɔkwan soronko so bere a wanom nsa anaa nnubɔne awie no. Sɛ obi nni nkae a  bere a wanom nsa anaa wanom nnubɔne awie no. Tebea horow a wɔte nka sɛ wɔn ahobammɔ anaa fahodi a wɔwɔ  asɛe mu a wɔbɛtra, te sɛ mmeae a atew ne ho anaasɛ wonnim. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na ankorankoro abɔ wɔn ho ban afi ɔhaw a ebetumi aba ho no, wobetumi: Wɔde ahye a emu da hɔ ato nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔnom ho na wɔde akyerɛ afoforo denneennen. Kwati sɛ wubegyaw anonne a obiara nhwɛ wɔn anaasɛ wubegye anonne afi ahɔho anaa amannifo a wonni wɔn mu ahotoso hɔ Tena nnamfo a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ wɔn yiyedi so na sɛ ɛho hia a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu. Fa wo ho to wɔn atenka so na yi wɔn ho fi tebea horow a wɔte nka sɛ wonni ahobammɔ anaasɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn yiye no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna mu nyarewa (STI) bɛn na wobetumi ahwehwɛ mu, na nhwehwɛmu bɛn na wɔtaa yɛ berɛ a wɔreyɛ nna mu agodie ho nhwehwɛmu no?
answer_twi_source: STI ahorow a wɔtaa hwehwɛ mu no bi ne: Chlamydia: Wɔnam dwonsɔ so yɛ nhwehwɛ mu. Gonorrhea so saa. Syphilis: Mogya mu nhwehwɛmu. HIV: Mogya mu nhwehwɛmu anaa anom aduru. HPV: Wɔnam Pap smear anaa HPV nhwehwɛmu so hu. Bere a wɔreyɛ nna mu agodie ho nhwehwɛmu no, ayaresafoɔ nso betumi ayɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu, Wɔhwɛ pelvic ne cervix ne mu sɛ atɔ kyema anaa. Saa nhwehwɛmu ahorow yi nyina ho hia ma mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara kwan so akwannya ahorow ho adesua betumi ama mmabun tumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so akwannya ahorow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma mmabun tumi ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ: Akwannya ne hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ mmara ase ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma akɔ soro no so. Nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ sɛnea wobenya wɔn hokwan ahorow na wɔde adi dwuma yiye ho. Ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔde bɛfa mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na wɔabɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ho ban bere a ɛho hia no. Ɛnyɛ mmerɛw a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn di dwuma, wɔhyɛ wɔn, ne wɔn hokwan ahorow a wobu so no so tew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi akɔ akɔfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano na me ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo asusuw akwan horow a mɛfa so ho?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo kɔka nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano ho nkɔmmɔ. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkɔmmɔbɔ yɛ kokoam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene bɛn na ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ awo mu atɛntrenee ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ adwuma de akyerɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ nokware?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ adwuma de Demystify adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya wɔ awo mu atɛntrenee ho denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛkyɛ, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛho hia mu, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛkasa atia, mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase a ɛfa anansesɛm ne nsusuwii hunu ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi abɔ wɔn din bere a wɔrekɔ telefon so telefon so ne telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo no, anaasɛ wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm te sɛ wɔn din, mfe a wɔadi, anaa baabi a wɔ wɔ ma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a Wɔmmɔ Wɔn Din a broni ka no 'Anonymity': Mmabun betumi ammɔ wɔn din bere a wɔrekɔ telefon so telefon so ne telefon a wɔde boa wɔn no, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm te sɛ wɔn din, mfe a wɔadi, anaa baabi a wɔwɔ ma. Saa din a wɔmfa nni dwuma yi ma mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn na wɔwɔ ahobammɔ bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no, a wonim sɛ wɔn nipasu bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoamsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ bi wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho ne; gyidi ahorow sɛ nna mu dwumadi ahorow bi "ahobammɔ" anaasɛ STI ne HIV ka nnipa akuw bi nkutoo. Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware denam; nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, te sɛ; akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nna mu akwahosan ho akyerɛkyerɛfo, wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din, ne nhoma ahorow a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu no so. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛsɔ nsɛm ahwɛ yiye, bisa nsɛm, na wo ne mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di adi nkitaho pefee wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho. Bio nso, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mũ betumi ama mmabun anya nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho nsɛm a edi mu na ɛfata wɔn mfe na aboa ma wɔayi anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ afi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no mu denneennen?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa ho mu denam wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe, ne di, ne nhwehwɛmu mu, nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ho, akannifo ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛte ama wɔate wɔn nne so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no nya mmabun mmerɛwyɛ so, asian nkɛntɛnso a wim nsakrae de ba ASRH so, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa a egyina mpɔtam ne tumidi nhyehyɛe ahorow so adi saa nneɛma yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie ne akwan a wɔfa so de kasa tia mmarima ne mmaa gyinapɛn a epira, na wɔahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa wimu nsakraeɛ a wɔde bɛsakra, ne ASRH ho. Tumi Dwumadie: Tumi nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho a wɔde bedi dwuma ama mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so, a nwomasua, nsa anodwuma sua, ne akannifoɔ nteteeɛ ka ho, de ama wɔn tumi a wɔde gyina asiane ne mmerɛwyɛ a ɛfa wim tebea ho no ayɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahodoɔ bɛn na wobɛfa so adi adwenedwene ne ntenka nnɛmma bi a etumi ha nna mu apɔmden ne ho nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kwan a wobɛfa so agye woahome: Fa wo ho hyɛ anomegyeɛ nwuma bi te sɛ woretwe mframa keseɛ akɔ wo mu ne ade. Ma woani nku nwumadie ɛbɛboa wo ho bi te sɛ ahomegyeɛ ne nneɛma ɛma wanigyeɛ. Apɔmben mu nneɛma: Mfa nnubɔne nni dwuma anaa sɛ twe wo ho fire nnubɔne ne nsa ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi abusuafoɔ ne ayɔnkofoɔ anaa afutufoɔ ho. Nkitahodie: Kasa kyerɛ wo hokafoɔ. Mmerɛ nhyehyeɛ: kyekyɛ wo berɛ mu sɛdeɛ wommerɛ na ma w'ani nkɔ wasɛdeɛ ho. Sɛ woyɛ yei nyinaa ɛbɛboa woasetena abrabɔ mu na ɛsane nso benya nsunsuanso pa wo nna apɔmden ne dwumadie nyinaa mu.Hwehwɛ mmoa firi wɔn a wonimde ho: Hwehwɛ dɔkotafoɔ a woabene wɔ adwenemhaw ho akyiri kwan na wɔmmoa sɛdeɛ m'abobo so yi bi anyɛ adwuma a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkitahodi a ɛda mfiridwumayɛfo, ɔmanfo apɔwmuden ho abenfo, ne mmabun mpɔtam ntam betumi ama wɔayɛ nneɛma foforo na ama ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma ho abenfoɔ, ɔmanfoɔ apɔwmuden ho abenfoɔ, ne mmabun mpɔtam ntam nkitahodiɛ ma nnwuma foforɔ na ɛma ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ no tu mpɔn denam: Nimdeɛ ahodoɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma: Mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛka mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ animdefoɔ a wɔwɔ ASRH mu no abom no hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ digyital ano aduru a egyina adanseɛ so, a ɛfa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma ho. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma awiei no a wɔbom yɛ ade: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ adebɔfo ne ahokafo wɔ nkɔso nhyehyɛe no mu no ma ASRH dwumadie a egyina mfiridwuma so no wurayɛ, mfasoɔ, na ɛkɔ so tra hɔ daa. Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a ɛdi mu a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛseɛ: Aban nnwumakuo, NGOs, ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom no ma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma ASRH dwumadie a wɔada no adi sɛ egyina mfiridwuma so no ayɛ kɛseɛ na wɔakyekyɛ na ama wɔadu nnipa dodoɔ a wɔdɔɔso nkyɛn na wɔanya nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa ntetee hokwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma nhwehwɛmufo a wɔde bɛma wɔn amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ akɔ anim wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu mu so?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne ntetee hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nhwehwɛmufo sɛ wɔbɛma wɔn amammerɛ mu ahoɔden ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim wɔ ASRH nhwehwɛmu mu no bi ne: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ntetee nhyehyɛe: Nhyiam, nhyiam, ne intanɛt so adesua a ɛma nhwehwɛmufo nya nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmeae ahorow a ɛsono amammerɛ, a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ amammerɛ mu ahobrɛase, amammerɛ ahorow ntam nkitahodi, ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu. Nhwehwɛmu nkitahodiɛ a wɔbom yɛ: Nkitahodiɛ ne nkitahodiɛ a wɔbom yɛ a ɛma nkitahodiɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa wɔ nhwehwɛmufoɔ, mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma wɔ ASRH nsɛm ho no ntam, na ɛma nhwehwɛmufoɔ tumi sua biribi firi adwene ne suahunu ahodoɔ mu. Afotuo nhyehyeɛ: Afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ mmara kwan so a ɛde nhwehwɛmufoɔ a wɔdi kan wɔ adwuma mu ne afotufo a wɔn ho akokwa a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne mmuae ama wɔ amammerɛ mu nsɛnnennen a wɔbɛfa so akɔ ASRH nhwehwɛmu mu, ne hokwan ahodoɔ a wɔde bɛma adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ ne nkitahodiɛ. Amammerɛ mu ahokokwaw ho nneɛma: Intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔkora so, nnwinnade, ne akwankyerɛ a ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Wiase Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO), Guttmacher Asoɛe, ne Amanaman Ntam Awofo a Wɔayɛ Nhyehyɛe Fekuw (IPPF) ayɛ, a ɛma akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a mfaso wɔ so ma nhwehwɛmufo a wɔreyɛ ASRH nhwehwɛmu wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de adwinni "arts", abasɛm a wɔka "storytelling", ne adebɔ mu nsɛm "crative expressions" adi dwuma sɛ nnwinnade "tools" a wɔde sa yare, wɔma wɔn tumi, na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa adwinni mu nneyɛe yi betumi ama wɔanya tema "empathy", ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne asetena mu nsakrae a ɛtrɛw?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de adwinni , abasɛm, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm "creative expressions" adi dwuma sɛ nnwinnade a wɔde sa yare, wɔma wɔn tumi, na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ. Ɛnam adwinni mu nneyɛe te sɛ akyerɛw, mfoniniyɛ, nnwom, anaa agodie so no, wobetumi ahwehwɛ wɔn atinka, osuahu, ne wɔn nipasu "identities" mu, na wɔne afoforo a wɔwɔ apereperedi anaa dadwen a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Saa adebɔ mu aguadidan "creative outlets" ahorow yi betumi ama wɔanya tema, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne asetra mu nsakrae denam nhumu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, nsusuwii hunu a wɔkasa tia, ne nne ahorow a wɔto nkyɛn a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse so. Mmabun betumi de wɔn adwinni ho nimdeɛ akamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no wɔ, ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so ho nkuran, na wɔhyɛ asetra mu adeyɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ ɔkwan a ɛtrɛw so, sɛ́ ebia ɛnam baguam agoru ahorow, ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow, anaa intanɛt so ɔsatu ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so asusuw nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wogye di na wotumi de ho to so no ho yiye berɛ a wɔredi nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu denam nneɛma te sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no nimdeɛ, abasobɔdeɛ ne nhomasua, nhoma a wɔatintim anaa asɛnka agua no din a ɛwɔ hɔ, nsɛm a wɔafa aka ne nsɛm a wɔde gyina so, ne ɛnne ne kasa a wɔde di dwuma a wosusuw ho no so. Wobetumi nso de nsɛm ne mmeae a agye din abɔ mu, asusuw sɛnea emu nsɛm no yɛ nea ɛfata ho, na wɔahwehwɛ nneɛma a ebetumi ayɛ animhwɛ anaa nea ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho bɔ abira. Ɛdenam akwan horow yi a wɔde di dwuma so no, mmabun betumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ ahotoso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo fibea ahorow wɔ bere a wɔredi nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnwuma anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a wɔde ɔkwan a egyina akwannya ahorow so adi dwuma de ama mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan mu nkɔso atu mpɔn ho nhwɛso ahorow bi?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nnwuma a ɛdi mu a wɔde ɔkwan a egyina akwannya so adi dwuma ho ne: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun a ɛde kokoam ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmuo ne nsɛm a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiadeɛ ma. Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a esi nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne obu a wɔde ma nneɛma ahorow so dua. Mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛma mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom. Nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛma mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu denneennen, a nhyehyɛe ho nhyehyɛe, ne di, ne nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim a ɛma nkurɔfo hu nna ne awo hokwan ahorow, kasa tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim, na ɛboaboa mmoa ano ma nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne asetra mu atɛntrenee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛka apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe atitiriw a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ saa nkabom yi yiye na ama wɔadu mmabun pii nkyɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛka apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe atitiriw a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw ho no de nsɛnnennen ne hokwan ahorow nyinaa ba. Nsɛnnennen betumi ayɛ ɔsɔretia a efi apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo a wonnim anaasɛ wontumi nni SRH nsɛm ho dwuma, nneɛma kakraa bi a wɔde bɛma ntetee ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho di asi wɔ apɔwmuden nhyehyɛe no mu. Nanso, nkabom nso betumi ama nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no ayɛ papa, ama ɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ no biako atu mpɔn, na ama SRH nnwuma a mmabun anya no ayɛ kɛse. Akwan titiriw a wɔbɛfa so ama nkabom ayɛ papa no bi ne ntetee a edi mũ a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra titiriw wɔ SRH dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun adamfofa, akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn kɔ ne nkitahodie a wɔne SRH dwumadiefoɔ titire bɛhyehyɛ, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔde SRH dwumadie bɛka ayarehwɛ mfitiaseɛ nsrahwɛ a wɔyɛ daa ma mmabun ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wubetumi ama akwankyerɛ wɔ sɛnea mɛsi gyinaeɛ wɔ me nna mu apɔmuden ho a ɛne yɛn abusua gyidie hyia?
answer_twi_source: Sua nna mu apɔmuden ho ade, ne nsɛm a ɛfa awoɔ ho, STI banbɔ, ne nnamfofa pa ka ho. Susu sɛnea wo gyinaeɛ no ne abusua gyidie a ɛfa obu hyia. Sɛ worepaw biribi a, dwene nsunsuansoɔ a ebetumi aba ne sɛnea ɛne deɛ wogye di sɛ ɛyɛ ma wo ne yɛn abusua no hyia ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma nea broni ka no 'confidential hotlines' a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo anaa wɛbsaet ahorow ma mmabun na ama wɔanya adwenemyare ho mmoa.
answer_twi_source: Nea broni ka no 'Hotlines': kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie bi nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmabun betumi adi wɔ nsakrae a wɔbɛkasa ama akyerɛ wɔ mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne aban nhyehyɛe ahorow mu de aboa sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a mmabun anya mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne aban nhyehyɛe ahorow mu denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ, nhyehyɛe ho nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛw, wɔne mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn ahyia, ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu kyɛfa a wobenya so. Wobetumi nso de wɔn nne ne osuahu ahorow a wɔatra ase adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate nkɛntɛnso a sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow nya wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa asetra so no ase na wɔahyɛ nsakrae a ɛde wɔn ahiade ne wɔn anigyede di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔpo ayaresa anaa nneyɛe bi a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ne nna mu yiyedi (ASRH) ho anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔka daabi. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun no ankasa pene so ansa(Consent).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe "media literacy" ne nnwuma boa mmabun ma wonya nimdeɛ a wɔde hwehwɛ nkrasɛm ne mfonini ahorow a wohyia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no, na wɔkyerɛ ase, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nhyehyɛe ahorow yi aka sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so mmeae ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ boa mmabun ma wonya nimdeɛ a wɔde hwehwɛ nkrasɛm ne mfonini ahorow a wohyia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, bisabisa nsɛm, na wɔkyerɛ ase. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi kyerɛkyerɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, "digital citizenship" ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ te sɛ "deconstruction" ne "decoding". Wobetumi de wɔn ahyɛ sukuu ahorow mu denam adesua ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi so. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow nso betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho ntetee ama, na intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow betumi ama mmabun anya nneɛma ne nnwinnade a wɔde benya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ wɔ dijitaal mmeae "digital spaces" ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so betumi aboa ma wɔadi asetra mu nneɛma a ɛtrɛw a ɛkyerɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma, te sɛ ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne mmarima ne mmea nyiyimu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so gye tom sɛ asetra, sikasɛm, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛtrɛw, a ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne mmarima ne mmea mu nyiyimu ka ho na nya nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so nkɛntɛnso. Ɛdenam saa nneɛma a ɛhyɛ ase yi a wobedi ho dwuma so, te sɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, asetra mu ahobammɔ, nhomasua, ne sikasɛm mu tumidi ho nkuran so no, ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so betumi ama tebea horow a ɛbɛma mmabun atumi de wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow adi dwuma kɛse na wɔanya nnwuma ne nsɛm a ɛfata. Ɛsan nso hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe mu ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛde asetra mu ntɛnkyea ba ntini ho dwuma na ɛhyɛ akwahosan mu pɛyɛ ho nkuran ma mmabun nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bɔne a ebetumi afi PrEP mu aba, na kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Te sɛ nnuru biara no, PrEP betumi de ɔhaw ahorow aba nnipa binom so. Ebia nneɛma bɔne a ɛtaa ba ne akisikuru, ne tipaeɛ. Wɔ tebea horow a ɛntaa nsi mu no, PrEP betumi aha asaabo dwumadi anaa nnompe ne dene. Mmabun betumi adi saa nsunsuanso bɔne yi ho dwuma denam wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wɔne wɔn bɛkasa so. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ sɛnea wɔbɛtew nsunsuanso bɔne so anaasɛ sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛsakra dodow a wɔde ma no ho. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun ne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo ka ɔhaw biara a wohyia ho asɛm sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi adi ho dwuma yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ a mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobekum wɔn ho anaasɛ wɔpira wɔn ho nya wɔ mmabun adwenemyare so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne ɔhwɛ a edi akyi de asiw daakye ɔhaw ahorow ano?
answer_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛtra Hɔ Bere Tenten ne Mmoa a Ɛkɔ So: Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobekum wɔn ho anaasɛ wobepira wɔn ho no betumi anya mmabun adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso kɛse berɛ tenten, a nea ɛka ho ne asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmɔden daakye, ahodwiriw akyi adwennwen, ne adwenemhaw. Mmabun betumi anya mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne ɔhwɛ a edi akyi afi adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, mmoa akuw, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma hɔ de asiw daakye ɔhaw ahorow ano na wɔadi adwenemyare a ɛhyɛ ase no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden  nteteeɛ ne nimdeɛ kyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bea bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛtumi aboa apomoden adwumayɛfoɔ ama wɔahu sɛnea tebea nsisanyɛ ne nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho bɔm?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee ne ahoɔden-bɔ ho akwan a ɛwɔ hɔ ma ayaresafoɔ de gyina tebea horow a ɛfa wim nsakrae ne SRH ho ano. Eyinom bi ne nteteeɛ a ɛfa wim tebea ho ayaresa a ɛbɛma ɔhaw a ɛbɛba daakye no mu ayɛ kɛse, ɔhaw a ɛbɛba, adwene mu ayaresa a ɛyɛ foforo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ayaresa a ɛbɛma SRH ho adwuma no ayɛ yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow (ASRRs) ho wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (Intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma ahorow, a wobɛkɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow nkyɛn)
answer_twi_source: Ne w’akwahosan ho dwumayɛni anaa sukuu sickbay ɔyarehwɛfo nni nkitaho, wobetumi aboa ma woanya nnwumakuo ahorow wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ, mede ɔkwan a mapaw no redi dwuma yiye bere biara?
answer_twi_source: Afotu bi a ɛbɛma woahwɛ ahu sɛ wode ɔkwan a woapaw no redi dwuma yiye bere biara ni: Kenkan akwankyerɛ no yiye: Eyi ho hia na ama woate sɛnea wɔde di dwuma yiye no ase. Bisa w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nsɛm: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛma adwenem naayɛ biara a wowɔ no mu ada hɔ. Fa nkaebɔ sie: Fa "alarm" anaa ahomatrofo (telephone) so amanneɛbɔ bi si hɔ a ɛbɛkae wo sɛ fa nnuru a wɔde kum yare anaa sesa "patches/rings". Fa nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔde siw ano sie: Sɛ wowɔ kɔndɔm wɔ wo nsam a, ebetumi aboa sɛ wo kwan titiriw no di nkogu (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm a abubu). Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm redi dwuma a, fa yɛ wo ho sɛ wode bɛhyɛ banana anaa ade a ɛte saa so na ama wo ho atɔ wo wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so di amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nkate ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma wɔ mpɔtam a wɔsom no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnwumadie ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so di amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nkate ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mpɔtam a wɔsom wɔn no mu ho dwuma denam akwan horow a ɛfata amammerɛ a wɔde di dwuma so. Wɔde mpɔtam hɔfoɔ de wɔn ho hyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu ne ne di mu denneennen, wɔbu mpɔtam hɔ atetesɛm ne gyidie berɛ a wɔhyɛ SRH ho nsɛm ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran. CBO ahorow no yɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhwehwɛmu de te amammerɛ mu nsɛm nketenkete ase na wɔsiesie nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no sɛnea ɛfata, hwɛ hu sɛ nkrasɛm ne nnwuma ahorow no ne atiefo ahorow hyia. Wɔsan nso de mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, mpaninfoɔ, ne nyamesom mu nnipa di dwuma sɛ akamfofoɔ ne ayɔnkofoɔ wɔ animtiaabuo a wɔkasa tia ne nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa SRH nsɛm ho a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nguammoa ne mmaa nkesua (ova) hyehyɛ, na ɛhe na wɔyɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Nguammoa ho yɛ: Wɔnam adeyɛ bi a abrofofo taa fre no spermatogenesis so na ɛyɛ mmadwoa wɔ awotwaa mu. Ɛfa mmoawa nkwammoaa a wɔkyekyɛ mu na wɔn ho nyin ma ɛbɛyɛ mmadwoa nkwammoaa ho. Afei wɔkora mmadwoa so na ɛyɛ kɛse wɔ epididymis no mu. Nkesua a Wɔyɛ: Wɔnam adeyɛ bi a wɔfrɛ no oogenesis so na ɛyɛ nkesua anaa mmadwoa wɔ mmadwoa no mu. Bere a awotwaa no nyin no, nkesua mpempem pii a ennyinii wɔ awotwaa no mu. Wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere akyi no, woyi nkesua biako fi awotwaa no biako mu ɔsram biara, na ɛsesa wɔ mmadwoa abien no ntam ɔsram biara. Wɔfrɛ saa adeyɛ yi ovulation. Nkwaboaa ne nkesua nyinaa yɛ awo nkwammoaa titiriw a wɔfrɛ no gametes. Chromosome dodow a ehia ma onipa asetra foforo no fã wɔ emu biara mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asiw awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ano denam asetra kwan a wɔbɛpaw, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw ano no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asiw awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ano denam: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma, a kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ ka ho de siw STI ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ano ka ho. Nyinsɛn nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde bedi dwuma bere nyinaa na wɔayɛ no yiye de asiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ano. Nea wubetumi apaw bi ne kɔndɔm, nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, nnuru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, ne mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUD). Aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ daa ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ STIs, awotwaa mu kokoram (Pap smears), ne awo akwahosan ho haw afoforo ho. Asetra pa a wobɛkɔ so akura mu denam aduan a ɛkari pɛ, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa, nna a ɛfata, ne adwennwen a wobedi so de aboa awo akwahosan nyinaa so. Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ awo akwahosan ho, a brayɛ, awo ho nimdeɛ, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ka ho, de asi wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahokyere ho afotu adwuma wɔ hɔ 24/7, a anwummere, dapɛn awiei, nnapɔnna, anaa tebea ahorow a egye ntɛmpɛ ka ho, a wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun betumi anya mmoa bere biara a wohia?
answer_twi_source: Ahokyere ho afotuo a ɛwɔ hɔ: Ahokyere ho afotuo dwumadie taa wɔ hɔ 24/7, a anwummerɛ, dapɛn awieeɛ, nnapɔnna, ne ntɛmpɛ ka ho, na ɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun bɛtumi anya mmoa berɛ biara a wɔhia. Ebia telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, nnwuma a egyina nsɛm a wɔ kyerɛw so, ne Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow de mmoa bɛma dɔnhwerew ne anadwo afi afotufo a wɔatete wɔn hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na ɛyɛ  sɛ wobɛyɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, bere ɛyɛ  sɛ woyɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne adapɛn biako kosi abien wɔ bere a woayera akyi. Nanso, nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ahorow bi ka sɛ ɛma wonya nea efi mu ba no pɛpɛɛpɛ ntɛm, ansa na bere a wɔantumi ankɔ no mpo. Ɛho hia sɛ wokenkan akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama wɔ nyinsɛn nhwehwɛmu kratasin no ho na wudi akyi na ama woanya nea efi mu ba no pɛpɛɛpɛ sen biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wohyia nyiyim anaa hokwan ahorow a wobu so a egyina wɔn nna ho bɔbea anaa wɔn bɔbeasu so a, anammɔn bɛn na 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro betumi atu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro nya nyiyim anaa hokwan ahorow a wobu so a egyina wɔn nna ho bɔbea anaa wɔn bɔbeasu so a, wobetumi ayɛ nneɛma a edidi so yi: Wɔkyerɛw nsɛm a esisii a ɛfa nyiyim anaa ɔhaw ho, a nna, mmere, ne adansefo ka ho, de foa wɔn asɛm no so. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afiri 'LGBTQ+' ahyehyɛdeɛ, mmaranimfoɔ, anaa akuo a wɔkasa ma wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn ho titire wɔ nyiyim a wɔdi ho dwuma ne 'LGBTQ+' hokwan ahodoɔ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no hɔ. Anwiinwii a wɔde bɛkɔ aban nnwumakuo a ɛfa ho, te sɛ nea broni ka no 'Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)' anaa 'Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)', sɛ nyiyim no sii wɔ adwumayɛ anaa adan mu a. Mmara kwan so ayaresa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, te sɛ asɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ asɛnnibea anaasɛ ntamgyinafo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, de abu wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no akontaa na wɔanya ɔhaw a wɔde aba no ho nhyehyɛe. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma ama nkateɛ mu mmoa ne akwankyerɛ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi nyiyim ho dwuma na wɔahwehwɛ atɛntrenee no nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛma nsonsonoe ba nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun a wofi asetra ne sikasɛm tebea ahorow mu nya mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma te sɛ sika a wonya, nhomasua, adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow, ne apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no betumi anya nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun a wofi asetra ne sikasɛm mu tebea horow mu nya mu so nkɛntɛnso. Mmabun a wofi asetra ne sikasɛm tebea a ɛwɔ fam mu betumi ahyia sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow, kar a wonni, beae a wɔwɔ, ne apɔwmuden ho nimdeɛ a wonni, na asiw wɔn kwan sɛ wobenya nnwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atutra, nkurow akɛse mu a wɔtu kɔtra, ne wiase nyinaa a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no nya atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔkora so, wɔsakra, anaasɛ wogyae wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Atutra, nkurow akɛse mu a wɔbɛtra, ne wiase nyinaa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔkora so, wɔsakra wɔn ho, anaasɛ wogyae mu wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu no so. Bere a mpɔtam hɔfo renya asetra ne nnipa dodow mu nsakrae no, atetesɛm mu amanne ahorow betumi asakra anaasɛ ɛbɛkɔ fam esiane amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛresakra, sikasɛm mu nhyɛso, ne abɔnten nkɛntɛnso ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nti. Ebia mmabun a wotu kɔ nkurow akɛse mu anaa amannɔne aman mu no ama wɔanya nsusuwii foforo, asetra kwan, ne akwahosan ho nneyɛe foforo, na ɛde nsakrae aba wɔ adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ho no mu. Wiase nyinaa ayɔnkofa a mfiridwuma ne nkitahodi mu nkɔso na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw no betumi ama atetesɛm mu nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkora so no ayɛ mmerɛw na aboa ma nsakrae aba denam amammerɛ ahorow ntam nkitahodi ne afrafra so. Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ nnam a ɛda atetesɛm ne nnɛ yi nneɛma ntam no ntease ho hia na ama wɔadi mmabun ahiade ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan a ɛrekɔ so wɔ mmeae a ɛsono amammerɛ ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na "hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔpene so na osi gyinae" kyerɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu no kyerɛ sɛ ankorankoro wɔ ahofadi a wɔde paw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn ankasa nipadua ne awo asetra ho. Ɛka hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ osi gyinae wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, awo, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, ne nsɛm afoforo a ɛfa ho ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mɛtumi afa so adi tebea a me kokoamsɛm ne m'abusua mmara anaa nnyinasoɔ bɔ abira mu, te sɛ berɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ meduru fie anaa m'awofoɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ me so?
answer_twi_source: Te ase sɛ ntawntawdi a ɛda wo kokoam nsɛm ho ahiade ne abusua mmara anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow ntam no abu so na wobetumi afa nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ntamgyinafo so asiesie. Wo ne me nsusuw wo haw ahorow ho wɔ odwo ne obu mu, na kyerɛ sɛnea mmara anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow bi betumi asɛe wo kokoam nsɛm. Di nkitaho wɔ apam anaa ano aduru foforo a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wo kokoam nsɛm ahiade ne abusua no mmara anaa akwanhwɛ nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmfua bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mekwati sɛ mede bedi dwuma bere a mereka nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho asɛm no? (kwati kasa a ɛhyɛ abufuw anaa nea ne bere atwamu) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi akyɛ ɔbabun bi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm akyerɛ wɔn awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔmpene so?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi mfa nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbabun bi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛ wɔn awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no a wɔmpene so. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ tebea horow a ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho dadwen wɔ hɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm anaa dadwen ahorow bɛn na mmabun betumi ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne telefon a wɔde boa a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho asusuw ho, te sɛ nsɛmmisa a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STIs, nyinsɛn, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, pene a wɔpene so, anaa osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ayayade anaa ayayade ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm Ahorow: Mmabun betumi de telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne telefon a wɔde boa a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho asusuw nsɛm anaa nneɛma ahorow pii ho. Ebia eyi bɛka nsemmisa a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna ho akɔnnɔ, nyinsɛn, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ayayade ho. Wɔatete afotufo ma wɔde mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛfa saa nsɛmti yi ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛfa ASRR ahorow ho a wɔtaa de ka amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow ho? (Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya nsɛm, apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a obenya, ahofadi a ɔwɔ fi nyiyim ho)
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow taa si saa ASRR ahorow yi so dua: Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wunya nsɛm: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wunya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fa wo nipadua, nna, ne awo apomoden Apomoden a Wonya: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wunya apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoamu na ne bo nyɛ den a ɛfa wo nna ne awo appmoden ho. Ahofadi a Wɔde Ma Wɔ Nyiyim Ho: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wogyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa gyinae a osi sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo ho apomoden so na ɛyɛ nyiyim tia obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu mu bɛtumi ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛ ase akɔ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata amammerɛ mu ma mmabun no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu mu no hyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no nkyerɛaseɛ mu kɔ nneyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata amammerɛ mu ma mmabun denam: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmu akwan ne nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde boaboa nsɛm ano no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa ho, na ɛma kwan ma wɔboaboa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na nteaseɛ wom a ɛbɛtumi ama wɔahu nkɔsoɔ ne dwumadie a ɛfa nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ama amammerɛ ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma, a mmabun, mmusua, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ka ho, a wɔbɛbom ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ na wɔde adi dwuma a ɛda amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn, wɔn a wɔpɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan wɔ nnipa dodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so no adi. Boa a wɔbɛboa nsakraeɛ ne nsakraeɛ a ɛfa adanseɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne nneyɛeɛ pa a ɛbɛfata amammerɛ tebea ne ahiadeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu, na ɛnam so ama nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ho hia, agye atom, na ɛyɛ adwuma yie wɔ 'ASRH' nsɛm ho dwumadie mu. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ne amammerɛ ho abenfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ dwumadie no nkɔsoɔ ne dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no fã nyinaa mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, a ahiadeɛ nhwehwɛmu, nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu ka ho, de ahwɛ sɛ nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ tebea soronko ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ agyapadeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na etu mpɔn wɔ mmra a ɛbu ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ anaa twaka, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ afã afoforo a ɛka mmabun wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so no mu a wɔbɛpopa anaasɛ wɔbɛsakra mu?
answer_twi_source: Asɛmmisa: Akwan bɛn na etu mpɔn wɔ mmra a ɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a ɛka mmabun wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so no a wobetwa anaasɛ wɔbɛsakra mu? Akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so kamfo mmra a ɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm yɛ nsɛmmɔnedi no mu anaasɛ wɔnyɛ mu nsakrae no bi ne: Wɔma nkurɔfo hu: Kyerɛkyerɛ ɔmanfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo wɔ nkɛntɛnso a mprempren mmara a ɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm yɛ nsɛmmɔnedi no nya ho. Fa ankorankoro nsɛm ne akontaabu di dwuma de kyerɛ ɔhaw ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛnsɛ a ɛwɔ nnipa dodow yi so. Yɛ Nkabom: Wo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow nyɛ adwuma ne akuo a wɔkamfo mmubuafoɔ hokwan, mmofra atɛntrenee mu nsakraeɛ, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee de ma wo nkrasɛm no yɛ kɛseɛ na wɔkyekyere mmoa nkabom a emu yɛ den Boaboa Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ma ɔmanfoɔ mmoa a wɔde bɛtwa anaa wɔbɛsesa mmara a ɛka mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ ahokafo amanneɛ wɔ sɛnea wobetumi anya nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV" ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ ahokafoɔ amanneɛ wɔ nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV" a wɔbɛtumi anya ho ɛfiri sɛ: - Ɛma ahokafoɔ tumi hwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne mmoa dwumadie ntɛm ara, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ nsɛnnennen ne ɔyareɛ foforɔ a ɛbɛba no so. - boa ma wobubu nyarewa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no denam ankorankoro a ebia wonnim wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu anaa ɔyare mmoawa tebea a wobehu na wɔasa wɔn yare no so. - hyɛ ahotoso, nkitahodi, ne asɛyɛde ho nkuran wɔ nna anaa nnade a wɔde kyɛ abusuabɔ mu, na ɛma nneyɛe a ɛyɛ papa na ahobammɔ wom ba. - di abrabɔ pa ne mmara mu asɛdeɛ so sɛ ɛbɛbɔ ahokafoɔ amanneɛ wɔ asiane a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔn akwahosan ne wɔn yiedie so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya ɔhaw wɔ nna mu anaasɛ wobɛkɔ so ada bere a woadu mpanyin afe so no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛtaa ba. Nsesaeɛ wɔ honam mu nkwammoa (hormones) mu, adwene mu nhyɛsoɔ (stress), abɛɛfo mfiridwuma (screen time) a yɛde di dwuma, ne nna mmere a ɛnnyina baako bɛtumi aka wo nna. Ɔbabun adwene (brain) yi aduro bi a ɛde nna ba a yɛfrɛ no 'melatonin' anadwo dɔnn koraa sene mmɔfra ne mpanyimfoɔ. Eyi ma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun no sɛ wɔbɛda.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahyɛ mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ me mpɔtamu hɔ, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, anaa nhyehyɛeyɛfo nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ ASRR ahorow ho akansifo? (Nsɛm ne data a wɔkyɛ, fekubɔ a wɔbɛkyekye)
answer_twi_source: Mpanyimfo betumi ayɛ ayɔnkofo a wɔwɔ tumi! Sɛnea wobɛma wɔakɔ hyɛn no mu ni: Kyɛ Nsɛm: Fa nsɛm ne akontabuo a ɛfa hia a ASRRs ho hia ne mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ so ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ho ma. Data Kanyan Gyinaesi: Fa nsɛm di dwuma de si nkɛntɛnso pa a ɛwɔ ASRH nhomasua ne nnwuma a wobenya ho nkuran no so dua. Si Nkɔmmɔbɔ: To nsa frɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma bom wɔ nnwuma anaa nsɛm a ɛsisi a ɛhyɛ ASRR ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wohyia nsɛm a ɛyɛ yaw anaa ɛhaw adwene wɔ amanneɛbɔ mu, wonya kɔmputa so ayayade anaa Intanɛt so ayayade, anaasɛ wɔwɔ nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wohyia nsɛm a ɛyɛ yaw anaa ɛhaw adwene wɔ  amanneɛbɔ mu no betumi anya nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa adwuma ahorow de anya mmoa. Wobetumi akɔ mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Ahyehyɛde pii de telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so, nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadi ahorow, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛ wɔde bedi kɔmputa so ayayade, Intanɛt so ayayade, anaa nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma ma. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de wɔn adwene ne nkate fam yiyedi di kan na sɛ wɔte nka sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ahyɛ wɔn so anaasɛ ɛhaw wɔn a, wɔhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na peneeɛ ne ahofadi di wɔ abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene ne ahofadi ho hia wɔ abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom mu efisɛ: Bu ankorankoro hokwan ne ahye. Hyɛ nkitahodi ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease ho nkuran. Ma ankorankoro tumi ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho. Siw nhyɛso, nsakrae, ne ayayade ano
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho asɛyɛde bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, aguade ho dawurubɔfo, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no wɔ berɛ a wogyina hɔ ma nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, aguade ho dawurubɔfo, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma no wɔ abrabɔ pa ho asɛyɛde bere a wogyina hɔ ma nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no. Eyinom bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware, wɔde nsɛm a ɛkari pɛ na egyina adanse so bɛma, wɔbɛkwati nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa anaasɛ wɔde bedi dwuma, ne nkɛntɛnso a wɔn nsɛm no betumi anya wɔ atiefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no a wobesusuw ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde mmabun yiyedi ne nidi di kan, wɔkyerɛ obu ma hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ kokoam nsɛm ne gyinaesi a wonya nimdeɛ mu, na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu na ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo anaa m’abusua afi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase afa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase denam bere ne beae a ɛfata a wobɛpaw a wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na wowɔ ahobammɔ no so. Di nokware na di nsɛm a ɛhaw wo no ho asɛm tee, na kyerɛ sɛnea wuhia wɔn mmoa. Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na obu wom di dwuma, na hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran denam wɔn mmuae a wode nsiyɛ tie ne nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wɔn a wubedi ho dwuma no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de dijitaal akwahosan ho mfiridwuma ne ahomatrofo (telephone) so aduruyɛ aka akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow ho na ama mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma atu mpɔn, titiriw wɔ mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaasɛ wɔmfa mmoa pii mma?
answer_twi_source: Digitals akwahosan ho mfiridwuma ne ahomatrofo (telephone) so aduruyɛ a wɔde bɛka akwahosan nhyehyɛe ho no betumi ama mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma atu mpɔn, titiriw wɔ mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaasɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma yiye. Eyi ka ho bi ne ahomatrofo akwahosan (mHealth), "apps" ne wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔbɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nna ne awo mu akwahosan (SRH) nsɛmti ho, nnwinnade a wɔde di nkitaho a wɔde bɛyɛ asiane nhwehwɛmu ne gyinaesi, ne kokoam akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ afotu ne mmoa. "Telemedicine" mmeae ahorow betumi ama mmabun atumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asusuw ho wɔ akyirikyiri, anya afotu ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho, na wɔanya ɔhwɛ a edi akyi a enhia sɛ wotu kwan tenten. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm a mmabun de bɛba na wɔayɛ digyital akwahosan ho dwumadie no na wɔadi nsɛm a ɛfa kokoamsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne akwan a wɔfa so nya ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛba bere a wɔreyɛ STI nhwehwɛmu no? (kyerɛkyerɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ sɔhwɛ mu) .
answer_twi_source: Sɔhwɛ pɔtee a wobɛyɛ no begyina asiane ahorow ne wo nsɛnkyerɛnne ahorow so. Akwan bi a wɔtaa fa so ni: Nsu mu Nhwehwɛmu: Nsu a wɔde yɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛnyɛ den betumi ahu STI ahorow bi te sɛ Chlamydia ne Gonorrhea. Swab Test: Swab a efi ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu no tumi hu STIs te sɛ Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, ne Trichomoniasis. Mogya mu Nhwehwɛmu: Mogya mu nhwehwɛmu tumi hu STIs te sɛ HIV, Hepatitis B, ne Syphilis. Mpɛn pii no, sɔhwɛ ahorow no ankasa yɛ ntɛmntɛm na ɛnyɛ yaw. Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no bedi kan akyerɛkyerɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no mu na wabua nsɛmmisa biara a ebia wowɔ. Kae: Sɛ wobɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu ahwɛ sɛ wowɔ STI a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ wode wo nna mu akwahosan ho asodi to wo ho so. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ ayaresabea bi akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a efi kokoam ne adwumayɛfo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Recourse' bɛn na mmabun wɔ se wɔfa nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow so te sɛ nnwuma a wɔpow, wɔhyɛ wɔn, anaa wɔyɛ wɔn ayayade a broni ka no 'denial of services, coercion, anaa abuse'
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hu wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow a wɔabu so, te sɛ nnwuma a wɔpow, nhyɛso, anaa ayayade a a broni ka no 'denial of services, coercion, anaa abuse', wɔwɔ nea broni ka no 'recourse options' a nea ɛka ho ne: Wɔbɛbɔ mmara so bu no ho amanneɛ akyerɛ atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho, te sɛ sukuu so ahwɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa mmarahyɛ baguafo. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, anaa mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho titiriw hɔ. Kokoam telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo anaa mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ anaa awo mu nhyɛso mu a wobenya. Mmara kwan so asɛm a wobedi akyi anaasɛ wɔbɛfa mmara kwan so anwiinwii, a egyina sɛnea mmara so bu no su ne sɛnea emu yɛ den so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow fa polisifo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo ho de siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: Ma nnwumakuo ahodoɔ ntam nkitahodiɛ nyɛ mmerɛ. Fa ntetee ma. Fa akuw a wɔyɛ adwuma ahorow pii si hɔ. Kyɛ data/info. Ma obu/ahotoso mma mo ho mo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ada ɔbabun bi nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm adi akyerɛ wɔn awofo a wɔmpene so?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo ntumi mfa nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbabun bi nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛ wɔn awofo a wɔmpene so, titiriw sɛ wobu ɔbabun no sɛ ne ho akokwaw a obetumi asi apɔwmuden ho gyinae ahorow a ɔde ne ho a. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ tebea horow a ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho dadwen wɔ hɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw me wɔ nsrahwɛ a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawoɔ ntamu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ? (wɔ ne oduruyɛfo, ɔyarehwɛfo ahomotrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo no di nkitaho)
answer_twi_source: Mmentwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ w’apomoden ho ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔwɔ apomoden adwumayɛbea no ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo no nkyɛn sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ nsrahwɛ ahorow ntam a. Ɛyɛ papa bere nyinaa sɛ wubenya ahobammɔ sen sɛ wobɛpa wo kyɛw. Kae sɛ, ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo no yɛ nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom fa titiriw. Ɛdenam wo nsrahwɛ a wobɛkɔ na woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata so no, wubetumi ama hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wubenyinsɛn yiye na woawo anigye no akɔ soro kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛ amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow ase kɔ nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa amammerɛ ne nsɛm a ɛfa ho mu ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so akyerɛ amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ase akɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ne nsɛm a ɛfa ho mu ama mmabun no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa tebea pɔtee bi ho, wɔde mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no bɛka ho, wɔbɛsesa nneɛma ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ ne kasa ahodoɔ mu, na wɔbɛhyɛ mmabun kyɛfa ne wɔn wurayɛ ho nkuran wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no nhyehyɛɛ ne ne di mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ m’abusua abu me atɛn anaasɛ wɔ nte m’adwene mu akwahosan ho ase, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Da wo nkate adi brɛoo na fa pintinnyɛ di dwuma, fa "Me" nsem di dwuma de di sɛnea wɔn nsɛm anaa wɔn nneyɛe ma wote nka no ho asɛm. Kyerɛkyerɛ w’abusua adwenemyareɛ ho asɛm denam nsɛm ne nneɛma a wobɛkyɛ de aboa wɔn ma wɔate wo suahunu ase yie no so. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo a wogye wɔn di, abusua mufo afoforo, anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de adansedi ne akwankyerɛ ama hɔ. Susuw abusua ayaresa anaa ntamgyinafo ho de di ntease a ɛnteɛ ho dwuma na ama nkitahodi atu mpɔn wɔ abusua no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi anya afotu anaa nsɛm a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so si STI/HIV ano ho wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa de afotu ne nsɛm a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw STI/HIV ano ho ma sɛ wɔn nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri no fã. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwankyerɛ ama wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma yiye na ɛkɔ so daa Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano, te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, kɔndɔm, anaa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma bere tenten (LARCs) PrEP (Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis) a wɔde si HIV ano HPV vaccination for cervical cancer prevention Screening and testing for cervical cancer prevention Screening and testing for STIs and HIV Risk reduction akwan horow, a nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne nkitahodie akwan ka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So "LGBTQ+" abɛɛfo ntentan (social media) akuo anaa akwan bi wɔ hɔ a metumi adi akyi de anya mmoa ne nsɛm? ( Abɛɛfo Ntentan (social media) akuw ne akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wɔde ma "LGBTQ+" mmabun titiriw.)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu "LGBTQ+" sɛ mmra mmma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sikakorabea nketewa, ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, adwumayɛkuw ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de di wɔ sikasɛm nketewa ho nnwuma a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm nketewa asoɛe (MFIs), ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ (CBOs), adwumayɛkuw ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de (NGOs) di dwuma titiriw wɔ sikasɛm nketewa ho nnwuma a wɔde ma mmabun mu denam: Sikasɛm mu nneɛma a wɔde ma: Sikakorabea, boseabɔ, insurance, ne sikasɛm mu nnwuma afoforo a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade, titiriw wɔn a wɔayi wɔn afi sikakorabea nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no mu. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyekye: Ntetee nhyehyɛe, adwumayɛbea, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de ama mmabun ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ sikasɛm ho adwene, adwumayɛ, ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ho no ayɛ kɛse. Nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ: Wɔde nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfoɔ, sikakorabea dwumadie a wɔde fa telefon so, ne sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so bɛsi hɔ de adu mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔ akyirikyiri a wɔnnya kwan pii nkɔ sikasɛm asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no nkyɛn. Adwumayɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Nnwuma a mmabun di anim, nnwuma a wɔrefi ase, ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wonya sika wɔ afotu, mfiridwuma mu mmoa, ne gua so nkitahodi a wɔde bɛma asetra a ɛtra hɔ daa ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde bɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw nkrasɛm ne nsɛm a wɔka a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu yiye na wɔayɛ mu nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun tumi susuw nkrasɛm a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu yiye na wɔhwehwɛ mu. Mmabun betumi asua sɛ: Wobehu nna, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ animhwɛ anaasɛ ɛyɛ nkate. Hu berɛ a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ma nsusuwii hunu, animtiaabu, anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ kɔ so tra hɔ. Hwɛ sɛnea wotumi gye nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm fibea ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no di na wotumi de ho to so. Te nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya wɔ wɔn gyidi, wɔn suban, ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ho nhwɛso ahorow bi a ebetumi aka me paw a mepaw wɔ nkitahodie, nkitahodie a emu yɛ den, ne nna mu dwumadi ho?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow gu ahorow kɛse wɔ mmabun mu nanso ebia nea ɛka ho ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne afoforo, ahofama a ɔde bɛma nokwaredi ne nkitahodi wɔ ayɔnkofa mu, gyidi ahorow a ɛfa bere ne tebea a ɛfata a wɔde di nna ho dwumadie, ne adwene a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne nna ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bi wɔ akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ mmeae anaa aman ahorow mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ no betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ aman ahorow mu esiane nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ mmara, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu nti. Ebia mpɔtam bi wɔ mmara anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi a ɛfa mmabun akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ho, bere a afoforo nso betumi de wɔn ho ato nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa ayarefo ahofadi ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma so. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu akwahosan ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ wo mantam anaa ɔman pɔtee bi mu no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhaw mu dwumadie nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention' nhyehyɛeɛ no hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi mmabun akuo ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma denam nhwehwɛmu ne nea aborɔfo ka no 'evaluation process' no so?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadie no hwɛ hu sɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ bɛba denam: Nnipa dodoɔ su ho nsɛm a wɔbɛboaboa ano de ahunu nsonsonoeɛ. Akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ nneɛma mu a wɔbɛhyehyɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedu nnipa ahorow ahorow nkyɛn. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛyɛ ama akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa kɛse.
