Nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu a ɛfata amammerɛ ne kasa a wɔde bedi dwuma. Nea aborɔfo ka no 'community stakeholders' a wɔbekyerekyere hiade pefee ne akwasideɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ ne wɔn ho a wobesiw ano wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, anaa Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, na ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔatew animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Nhumu a Wɔkasa ma: Mmabun betumi akamfo adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ ne wɔn ho a wobesiw ano wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow denam wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ, nneɛma ne mmoa nnwuma a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu anaa nsɛm a esisi a wɔde ma nkurɔfo ho asɛm mu, ne animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho a wɔbɛkasa atia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ nnipa a wɔne wɔn bɔbeasu yɛ pɛ, wɔn a ɛsono wɔn bɔbeasu, anaa n’abien nyinaa ani begye wo ho?
answer_twi_source: Nokwarem no, obi a ɔne wo bɔ abira anaasɛ ɔne wo bɔ abira a wobɛpɛ no yɛ ade a ɛfata koraa. nnipa betumi ahu sɛ wɔn ani gye nnipa a wɔne wɔn bɔbeasu koro, mmarima ne mmea afoforo, anaa nnipa a ɛsono wɔn bɔbeasu ho. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ yɛ spectrum. Ade biako a ɛda nsow na ɛyɛ abɔde mu ade wɔ nnipa nna ho ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow a egu ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa nsusuanso te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, mfiridwuma, ne wiase nyinaa a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no nya amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa mmebun nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho so  nsusuanso?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa nsusuanso, te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, mfiridwuma, ne wiase nyinaa ayɔnkofa, nya amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho so nkɛntɛnso denam: Ahoɔfɛ, nna, ne abusuabɔ ho adwene a wɔhyehyɛ denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo atitiriw mfonini ahorow, aguade ho dawurubɔ, ne anigyede nnwuma so, nya amammerɛ mu suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nipasu ho so nsusuanso. Nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw denam dijitaal akwan, sohyial networking sites, ne mobile applications so, hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛtrɛw mu ama nhomasua, mmoa, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ama amammerɛ ahorow ntam nkitahodi ne nkɔmmɔbɔ denam amanaman ntam adwumayɛ, atutra, ne wiase nyinaa ayɔnkofa so, a ɛbɛma ankorankoro ahu adwene ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho.  ɔhaw foforo ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛba ama amammerɛ mu nsakrae ne nkitahodi, bere a mmabun refa nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nnipa a wɔyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho, amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ, ne wiase nyinaa nkɛntɛnso ahorow ho wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ mu no. Amammerɛ mu nkate ne mmuae a wɔde ma wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a wosi so dua, a wohu amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow a enya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so nkɛntɛnso wɔ tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma anaa mmoa dwumadie bi a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makɔ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne siw ano?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde boa ne mmoa dwumadie bi ne: Akwahosan adwumayɛbea a mmabun ne Awoɔ akwahosan ayaresabea ka ho: Kɔ akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ, ayaresabea anaa abusua nhyehyɛeɛ mmeaeɛ a wɔde STI nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne afotuo dwumadie ma. Ntrɛwmu ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Di nkitaho wɔ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo anaa mmoa nhama a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi de nsɛm, mmoa, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa mu ma. Ntrɛwmu bi ne 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), ne PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228). Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Kɔ wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so nhyiamu a agye din a ɛma nsɛm fa nna mu yareɛ, mmeaeɛ a wɔsɔ hwɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano. Mmoa Akuo: Kɔka mmoa akuo anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu a ankorankoro bɛtumi akyɛ osuahu, abisa nsɛm, na wɔde mmoa a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne siw ano ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn paa na ɛyɛ sɛ ɔpimfo a wayɛ mma mu yareɛ (HIV) ho sɔhwɛ na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔwɔ bi no hyɛ ART aduro no ase, na amma yareɛ no ammɔ ne ba no?
answer_twi_source: Bere a ɛsɛ sɛ apimfoɔ hyɛ ART aduro no ase na amma wanfa HIV no amma ne ba no gyina nneɛma pii so, te sɛ; ɔmaame no ho gyinabea, ne CD4 dodoɔ, mmoawa dodoɔ a ɛwɔ ne mogya mu, ne yafunu no mfeɛ. Nanso, nea ɛyɛ paa ne sɛ ɔhyɛ aduro no ase ntɛm ara bere a ɔnyem no. Sɛ ɛbɛtumia, ɛyɛ sɛ ɔhyɛ ase ansa na wakyim awo mpo, anaa yafunu no mfitiaseɛ abosome mmiɛnsa no mu. Eyi bɛma aduro no ayɛ adwuma yiye paa na ama ne ba no annya HIV yareɛ no bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa kyerɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu no kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun bɛnya nneɛma, nnwuma, ne mmoa a ɛboa wɔn nipadua, nkate, ne sikasɛm mu yiyedi bere a wɔredi nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma wɔ intanɛt so nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma yiye ho (sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a).
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛyɛ intanɛt so nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma yiye ho ni: Planned Parenthood: https://www.plannedparenthood.org/ de nneɛma ahorow ma, a video nkyerɛkyerɛ bi ka ho: nna mu akwahosan na ɛde nneɛma te sɛ: YMK App wɔ nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma yiye ma. Kae: Bere a intanɛt so nneɛma betumi aboa no, kɔ w’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn ma ɔmma wo akwankyerɛ a ɛfata na hwɛ hu sɛ wote nsɛm a wɔde ama no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn nipasu ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne wɔn adwene ahorow adi dwuma de ako ama nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛyɛ pɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn nipasu ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne wɔn adwene ahorow adi dwuma de akamfo nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛyɛ pɛ denam: Ankorankoro nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow a wɔatra ase a wɔbɛkyɛ de asi mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ahorow ne nokwasɛm ahorow so dua. Wɔn a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo a wofi mmeae ahorow bɛyɛ biako de ama nne ne adwene a wɔtaa bu no to nkyɛn anaasɛ wobu wɔn ani gu so no ayɛ kɛse. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyiamu a wɔde gyina akyi a ɛgye nyiyim ne pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ a ɛka bom a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nipasu ahodoɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua hyia no mu. Nkabom ne apam a wɔne asetena mu atɛntrenee akuw afoforo bɛhyehyɛ de ako ama nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛka obiara ho a ɛfa pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm a ɛtrɛw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So masiesie me ho sɛ mɛyɛ awofo wɔ m’asetena fa yi mu? (sɛ wosusuw mfe a obi adi, onyin, ahonyade ho) .
answer_twi_source: Mfe ne Onyin: Hwɛ sɛ wote nka sɛ woasiesie wo ho wɔ atinka, nipadua ne adwene mu ama awofoyɛ anaa. Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: So wowɔ mmoa ntam nkitahodi ne kwan a wobɛfa so anya nneɛma a wode bɛtete abofra?
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi adwennwen ne nhyɛso ho dwuma bere a wɔ resi sɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Adwennwen ne nhyɛso a wobedi ho dwuma wɔ berea wɔresi sɔ no mu no ho hia ma yiyedi nyinaa. Akwan bi ni: Ɔhome a emu dɔ: Yɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛma wohome kɔ akyiri na ama w’adwene ne wo nipadua adwo. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ betumi atew adwennwen so na ama adwene atu mpɔn. Su a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Da sɛnea ɛsɛ, di aduan a ahoɔden wom a nnuaba ne nhabannuru ka ho , na kwati caffeine anaa asikre a ɛboro so. Bere a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Fa nnwuma di kan na kyekyɛ mu nketenkete a wubetumi adi ho dwuma. Akwan a Wɔfa so Gye Ahome: Sɔ akwan te sɛ adwennwen, yoga, anaa nnwom a ɛma obi dwo a wutie hwɛ. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa w’adamfo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa mfa nea ɛde adwennwen reba no ho. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Aduruyɛ mu mmoa ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Aduruyɛ mu mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi ayɛ nnwuma te sɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu nhwehwɛmu ne mmoa, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ akwan horow a wobetumi afa so, nyinsɛn ano a wobenya, adwenemyare ho mmoa, ne sɛ ɛho hia a wɔde wɔn kɔhwɛ adɔkotafoɔ a wɔnim saa yadeɛ no ho dwuma titiriw, sɛ ɛho hia a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi anaa woako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne tebea horow a asiane wom mu yiye?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, asetena mu nimdeɛ ho adesua ma mmabun nya nnwinnade ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so ako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu. Ɛdenam dwumadi ahorow ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde di nkitaho so no, mmabun sua sɛnea wɔbɛhwehwɛ asiane ahorow mu, wɔhwɛ nea ebefi mu aba kwan, na wonya ahokokwaw a ɛbɛma wɔatumi agyina nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu no ano. Wɔde pow a wɔpow ho nimdeɛ di dwuma, sua sɛnea wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, na wɔhwehwɛ akwan foforo a wɔbɛfa so abɔ fekuw na wɔanya abusuabɔ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nsɛm anaa nyansahyɛ ahorow ama akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no adamfofa su a ɛfa mmabun ho no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de nsɛm anaa nyansahyɛ ahorow ama wɔ akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun a wobɛma atu mpɔn wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ denam: Wo suahu ahorow a wobɛka akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea adwumayɛfo. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ ayarefo abotɔyam mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Mmabun afotufo akuw anaa boayikuw ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene sii akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so a wɔbɛka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam anaa nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa mmabun akwahosan ho a wɔbɛkɔ. Akwahosan mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wobɛkɔ akɔka wo haw ahorow ho asɛm. Social media platforms a wode bedi dwuma de akyɛ wo nsusuwii na wo ne mmabun afoforo adi nkitaho. Wo nsɛm a wode bɛma no som bo wɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wobɛhyehyɛ no mu sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛdi mmabun a wɔwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho mu yiye de ahu mfonini ahorow a edi mu, nsusuwii hunu a epira, ne asɛm a ɛma tumi?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho mu yiye denam nokware, sɛnea ɛyɛ den, ne sɛnea nnipa ne nsɛm a wɔka no gu ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu no so. Wobetumi ahu mfonini ahorow a edi mu, nsusuwii hunu a epira, ne asɛm a ɛma tumi denam nneɛma te sɛ gyinabea, tumi a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne nsɛm a ɛfa nnipa ntam a wosusuw ho no so. Ɛdenam asɛm a wɔka no titiriw a wogye ho kyim, nsusuwii hunu a wɔkasa tia, ne adwene ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ so no, mmabun betumi anya ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho ntease a ɛyɛ nketenkete kɛse wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne ɔmanfo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ sika ne sikasɛm ho a mmabun betumi ahyia, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ sika ne sikasɛm ho a mmaabun betumi ahyia no bi ne gyidi ahorow te sɛ "Sika ne anigye yɛ pɛ," "Ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ɔdefo na wode sika ahyɛ mu," anaa "Credit card yɛ sika a wontua hwee." Wobetumi afa nhomasua so adi saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi ho dwuma denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma, nokwasɛm ahorow a egyina adanse so a wɔde bɛma anansesɛm ahorow ayɛ nokware, ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso de asɔ sikasɛm ho gyinaesi ahorow a egyina ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, botae ahorow, ne tebea horow so ahwɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mawofoɔ twentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔnka nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm nkyɛrɛ me a, ɛdeɛn na memayɛ? Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi ahyɛ wɔn nkuran na ama yɛatumi abɔ saa nkɔmmɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Bu wɔn hyeɛ na mmpusu wɔn anaa mnhyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkasa sɛ wohu sɛ wɔnte nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahotɔ a. Ma wɔnhu sɛ woate wɔn ase sɛ wohia berɛ a wɔde bɛsusu ho anaa sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔka nsɛm bi ho asɛm wɔ berɛ foforo a ɛreba. Ma wɔn awerɛhyem sɛ wubu wɔn nsɛm a wɔka no sɛ ɛsom bo na wowɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wubetie wɔn adwene nso
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam ne amammerɛ mu mpanyimfo di de boa mmabun wɔ wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam ne amammerɛ mu mpanyimfoɔ betumi ama mmoa a ɛsom bo denam akwan a ɛfata amammerɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran de adi ahokyere ho dwuma, animguase ne nyiyimu a wɔbɛsɔre atia, nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛma akɔ so wɔ mmabun ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ntam, ne nnwuma a ɛfata amammerɛ mu a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti mmabun betumi agyina wɔn ankorankoro ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ so ayɛ wɔn nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi akyi ne nea wɔbɛhwɛ akyi no sɛnea wɔpɛ?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nya hokwan gyina wɔn ankorankoro ahiade, nea wɔpɛ, ne botae ahorow so sakra wɔn nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi akyi ne nea wɔde hwɛ akyi no. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa afotufo bɛyɛ biako de ahu nneɛma a ɛfata sen biara a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne mmoa adwuma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn tebea soronko no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obu wom ho hia mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obu wom ho hia mmabun efisɛ ɛma wonya nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne suban ahorow a ɛho hia na ama wɔatumi afa abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom na ɛma abotɔyam mu. Ɛhyɛ obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, nkitahodi, tema, ne pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran, na ɛboa mmabun ma wonya abusuabɔ mu nkɔso pa na wɔpaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afi ase ne m’awofo abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a meremfa aniwu mu anaa me ho to me?
answer_twi_source: Kae sɛ ɛyɛ ade daa sɛ wobɛte ehu nka kakra, nanso hu sɛ nsɛmti yi ho asɛm a wobɛka no betumi aboa na ɛho hia ama w’akwahosan. Pɛ bere bi a wo ne w’awofo nyinaa ho adwo mo na momfa ahopere, na fa odwo ne obu bɔ nkɔmmɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho haw bɛn na ɛsɔre bere a wɔde nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wobedi amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow anaa atetesɛm mu nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo ho dwuma no redi dwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho haw sɔre bere a mmabunu nna ne akwahosan  nhyehyɛe ahorow no botae ne sɛ wobedi amammerɛ mu nneɛma a wɔabara anaa atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ho dwuma: Obu a wɔde ma amammerɛ mu ahofadi: Obu a wɔde ma amammerɛ mu ahofadi a wɔbɛkari pɛ ne amansan nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, te sɛ nipadua mu ahofadi ne gyinaesi a wɔde nimdeɛ asi. Ɔhaw a ebetumi aba: Nneyɛe a epira a wobedi ho dwuma bere a wobu amammerɛ mu nkate, kwati animtiaabu, na wɔkora ahotoso so wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛɛ ne ne di mu de adi amammerɛ mu nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔahwɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no yɛ nea wɔgye tom na ɛtu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so de wɔn ho ahyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔreyɛ adwuma de asiw bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) ano na wɔhyɛ abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran no mu? (atuhoama, adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔkɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Atuhoama: Ahyehyɛde pii gye atuhoamafo akwaaba ma wɔboa wɔ nhyiam ahorow, sika a wɔboaboa ano, anaa adwumayɛ ho nnwuma mu. Nhyiamu: Kɔ nhyiamu anaa nteteeɛ a ɛfa ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, abusuabɔ pa, anaa bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) ano aduru a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ asetra mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow ma ɛne mmabun akuw ahorow a mmeawa, mmarimaa, mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔato wɔn hintidua, nkuraasefo, anaa aguanfo ka ho, ahiade pɔtee ne wɔn anigyede ahorow adi?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asiesie asetena mu ahokokwaw nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow no ma adi mmabun akuw ahorow ahiade ne anigye pɔtee ho dwuma: Mmabaa: Fa ntetee a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, afotu, ne akannifo nhyehyɛe ma; di akwanside ahorow a ɛmma mmea mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mfuw a mmarima na wɔdɔɔso mu no ho dwuma; hyɛ sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne adwumayɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmeawa mu. Mmarimaa: Ma mmarimaa nya hokwan ahorow ma wonya ɔhwɛ, nnipa ntam nkitahodi, ne nkate mu nyansa ho nimdeɛ; kasa tia mmarimayɛ ho adwene a ɛnteɛ na wɔhyɛ mmarimaa nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ adwumayɛ akwan a ɛnyɛ atetesɛm mu. Mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua: Fa nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ani asi so a wɔde ma, afotu, ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wohyia asetra ne sikasɛm mu ɔhaw ahorow, nyiyim, anaa basabasayɛ di dwuma; de ntetee a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wobetumi apaw ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma ma. Nkuraasefoɔ: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ nteteeɛ akuo a wɔde fa baabiara, satellite sukuupɔn, anaa akyirikyiri adesua nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛduru nkuraaseɛ mpɔtam; de kuayɛ, kuayɛ adwuma, ne nkuraase nkɔsoɔ afa ahodoɔ bɛka nteteeɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ho. Aguanfo: Wɔne nnipa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow, NGO ahorow, ne aban adwumayɛbea ahorow bɛyɛ biako de kasa ho ntetee, adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne asetra mu mmoa ama aguanfo mmabun; de adwene ne asetram mmoa ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mbere bɛn na nsakrae yi begyae?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono obiara mmerantebere ne mmabaabere akwantu! Nnipa binom nyin ntɛmntɛm sen afoforo. Nipadua mu nsakrae dodow no ara bɛbrɛ ase wɔ wo mmaabunbere mfinimfini kosi n’awiei.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi nkitaho yie na yɛakyerɛ obu wɔ tebea horow a afoforo nni yɛn adwenemyare ho ahiade ahorow ho dwuma anaasɛ wɔnte ase mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ tebea horow a wontumi nni w’adwene mu akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ho dwuma anaasɛ wɔnte ase mu no, nkitahodi a ɛyɛ hu ne ade titiriw. Da wo nkate ne w’ahiade ahorow adi pefee wɔ obu mu ma afoforo no. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma fa kyerɛ sɛnea wote nka ne nea wuhia, na yɛ aso ma afoforɔ adwenekyerɛ ho. Sɛ ɛho hia a, fa ahye sisi hɔ na kamfo mmoa a wuhia no kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate nsakrae a ɛba bere a wɔadu mpanyin mfe so no ase na wɔagyina ano?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a obiara kyerɛ n'adwene: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔhyɛ wɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ho nkuran no ma wonya ntease. Tie: Ɛsɛ sɛ awofo tie wɔn ba no nsɛmmisa ne nea ɛhaw no yiye a wonsusuw ho. Gyinaesi: Wɔn nkate ne osuahu ahorow a wogye tom no boa mmabun ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔte wɔn ase na wɔboa wɔn. Nsɛm a Wɔhwehwɛ: Awofo betumi abom ahwehwɛ nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so de asua mmabunbere ho ade pii. Ahiade: awofo betumi de honam fam ahiade a ɛresakra no ama ɔbabun no ma watumi afa nsakrae bere no mu yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun a ɛne wɔn nkɔso ahiade soronko, nea wɔpɛ, ne hokwan ahorow hyia?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛtete wɔn ma wɔne mmabun adi nkitaho yie na wɔabu wɔn ahofadi ne hokwan ahorow so. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔbɛyɛ ama mmabun titiri, a nneɛma te sɛ mmeae a wɔatew wɔn ho a wɔtwɛn, nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔde siesie hɔ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Kokoam nnwuma a wɔde bɛma ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun betumi apaw sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a awofo mpene so sɛ wɔpɛ a. Nsɛm a ɛmu dɔ a wɔde bɛma wɔ SRH nsɛmti ho wɔ akwan horow a mmabun betumi anya bi, na ɛyɛ nea wɔn ani gye ho, te sɛ nkitahodi nhyiam ahorow, nkɔmmɔbɔ a atipɛnfo di anim, ne intanɛt so nneɛma. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ SRH dwumadie no nhyehyɛɛ ne ne nhwehwɛmu mu de ahwɛ sɛ wɔdi wɔn ahiadeɛ ne wɔn apɛdeɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam sika a wɔkyekyɛ no de ASRH nsɛm pɔtee bi di kan, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano asɛm a wobenya, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu, anaa HIV/AIDS a wosiw ano ne ayaresa?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam sika a wɔkyekyɛ no de ASRH nsɛm pɔtee bi di kan a egyina wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nneɛma a ɛho hia, ɔyaredɔm ho nsɛm, ne nsɛnnennen pɔtee a abu so wɔ mpɔtam ahorow so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wobetumi de sika akɔma nyinsɛn ano aduru a wobenya akɔ soro wɔ mmeae a ahiade a ennya nnii ho dwuma kɛse, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse wɔ aman a nhomasua ho nneɛma sua mu, anaasɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw HIV/AIDS ano ne ayaresa mu den wɔ mmeae a ɛtrɛ kɛse no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛkora sika so ama daakye ne wɔn sikasɛm mu ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ntɛm ara no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ sikakorabea a wɔbɛkora so daakye ne sikasɛm mu ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ntɛm ara a wobedi ho dwuma denam: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ: Sika a wobenya no fa bi a wɔbɛkyekyɛ de asie bere a wobu ɛka a ɛho hia ne sika a wɔsɛe no wɔ wɔn ankasa pɛ mu ho akontaa no so. Botae ahorow a wɔde bedi kan: Sikasɛm botae ahorow a wɔde besi bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu a wobehu na wɔakyekyɛ nneɛma mu sɛnea ɛfata. Sikakorabea a wɔde besi hɔ ntɛm ara: Sika a wɔde besie a wɔde besi hɔ de atua ɛka a wɔnhwɛ kwan anaa tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ, na ama wɔatumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe mu. Kari pɛ a wode bedi dwuma: Sika a wobɛkora so ama daakye ne mprempren asetena mu anigye a wobɛkari pɛ, a wubehu hia a abien no nyinaa ho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw a broni ka no 'media literacy education' ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔahu, ahwehwɛ abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm mu, na wɔayɛ ho biribi wɔ nsɛm ho amannebɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw a broni ka no 'media literacy education'  ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔahu, ahwehwɛ mu, na wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm ho dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu denam adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye, nimdeɛ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, ne abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma wɔn so. Ɛnam saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi so no, mmabun sua sɛnea wobehu nsɛm a ɛyɛ animhwɛ anaa ɛdaadaa, wɔhwehwɛ mmeae a wonya fibea mu hwɛ sɛ wobetumi agye adi na wotumi de ho to so, na wɔte nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm betumi anya wɔ ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo so no ase. Ɛdenam saa nimdeɛ yi a mmabun nya so no, wɔbɛyɛ adetɔfo a wɔwɔ nhumu kɛse ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm, a wotumi di abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔkamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛe a asɛde wom kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn digital akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔmanfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, dwumadi, ne mpɔtam a wɔbɛkyekye mmɔdenbɔ mu wɔ intanɛt ne intanɛt so nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔmanfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, dwumadi, ne mpɔtam a wɔbɛkyekye mmɔdenbɔ mu: Wɔbɛkamfo asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase denam dijitaal akwan ne sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow so. Wɔn a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfoɔ, ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ yɛfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de adi mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma na wɔde nsakraeɛ pa aba. Mfiridwuma a wɔde bedi dwuma de ayɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe, sika a wɔboaboa ano, ne mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano ama mpɔtam hɔ ne wiase nyinaa nhyehyɛe ahorow. Digitals nkitahodi ne intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔbɛkyekye de akyɛ nneɛma, aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho, na wɔama nne a wɔato wɔn hintidua no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mpɔtamfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen de akamfo wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ne hokwan ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mpɔtamfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen denam: Mmabun afotu akuw, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, anaa nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan so a wɔbɛka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, nhyiamu, ne ɔsatuo a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ anaa wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ase, akyɛ nsɛm, na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa ASRH nsɛm ho nkuran. Social media, digital platforms, ne nkitahodi akwan foforɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛseɛ, akyɛ wɔn suahunu, na wɔakamfo wɔn hokwan ne wɔn ahiadeɛ. Nkitahodi ne nkabom a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne aban adwumayɛbea ahorow bɛhyehyɛ de akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, nhyehyɛe mu nkɔso, ne nneɛma a wɔbɛkyekyɛ ama ASRH.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔde nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu di dwuma de kyerɛ nhyehyɛe, ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden mu nkɔso atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu wɔ mmabun SRH ho no di dwuma de kyerɛ nhyehyɛe, ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so sɛ wɔbɛma SRH aba no atu mpɔn denam: Adanse a wɔde ma wɔ gyinaesi ho: Nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne nhyehyɛe ho nhyehyɛefo de nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu di dwuma de te mmabun ahiade ne nea ɛho hia titiriw ase na wɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so. Nsakraeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne wɔn a wɔko ma afoforo de data di dwuma de ma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ, boaboa mmoa ano, na wɔko ma nhyehyɛɛ mu nsakraeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔbɛkyekyɛ de adi SRH nsɛm ho dwuma. Nhwehwɛmu: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no yɛ nsusuiɛ a wɔde bɛhwɛ nkɔsoɔ, ahwehwɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛwɔ nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne mmeaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnya nkɔsoɔ wɔ SRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akasamafo akuo, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim ayɛ biako de ama nkorɔfo ate nkɛntɛnso a media nya wɔ ASRH so no ase na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa mediafo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmabun tumidi?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam Hɔ Ahyehyɛdeɛ a Wɔyɛ: Mmabun bɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, akasamafo akuo, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim ayɛ adwuma abom de ama nkorɔfoɔ ate nkɛntɛnsoɔ a media nya wɔ Mmabun Nna ne Awoɔ Akwahosan (ASRH) so denam nhyiamu a wɔbɛyɛ, nhyiamu a wɔbɛyɛ, nnipa a wɔagye din no a wɔde bedi dwuma de akamfo nsakraeɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛboa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmabun a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so tumi a wɔde ma. Ɛdenam ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ adwene koro a wɔbɛka abom so no, wobetumi ama wɔn nkrasɛm no ayɛ kɛse na wɔadu nnipa pii nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmebun betumi anya adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so anya adwenemyare ho nnwuma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nnuruyɛfo a wɔhwɛ mmofra titiriw anaa mmofra ho animdefo a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn. Sukuu mu afotu adwuma anaa adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe. Mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyare ho mmeae anaa ayaresabea ahorow. Ankorankoro ayaresa ayaresa anaa afotufo. Ahomatorɔfo anaa ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn ayaresa so nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde afotu a wɔde ma wɔ akyirikyiri ma. Nsɛm a wɔde kɔma mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa abusua mufo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Su bɛn na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea bi mu sɛ "ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun"?
answer_twi_source: Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa no su ne: Mmeae asomdwe wɔ na wɔmfa atɛn mma a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ. Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn sɛ wɔbɛte akwaahosan ho ahiadeɛ soronko ne mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa haw ase na wɔadi ho dwuma. Nnwuma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun nkɔso fa ne nea wɔpɛ, a nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne nneɛma a ɛfata wɔn mfe ka ho. Ahintasɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho ahobammɔ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun hokwan ahorow ne ahofadi. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a wobenya, ne akwahosan ho ahiade afoforo a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛfɛ amaneɛ bɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmoa kwan a wɔde boa nkurɔfo, te sɛ nsɛm a ɛfata a wɔbɛboaboa ano, baabi a ahobammɔ ne kokoam de a wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛfrɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw nsɛm, anaasɛ wɔne ɔpanyin anaa adamfo bi a wogye wɔn di a wobedi kan asusuw wɔn haw ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Siesie Wo Ho Ma Mmoa Hwehwɛ: Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi asiesie wɔn ho ansa na wɔafrɛ anaa wɔatwerɛ mmoa ntentan (hotlines/helplines) no. Wɔbɛtumi ayɛ wei denam nsɛm a ɛhia a wɔbɛboaboa ano, te sɛ nsɛmmisa anaa nneɛma a ɛha wɔn adwene, ansa na wɔayɛ nea ɛhia no.Baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ dwoodwoo na ɛyɛ kokoam a wɔbɛnya de ayɛ saa mmoa frɛ no bɛma wɔanya ahotɔ sɛ obiara rente wɔn asɛm. Bio nso, sɛ wɔne panin bi anaa adamfo bi a wɔgye no di di kan dwene ho a, ɛbɛma wɔanya mmoa ne awerɛkyekyerɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so de mmabun ahyɛ 'peer-led' (wɔn atipɛnfoɔ) nkyerɛkyerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan ne: nteteɛ ma mmabunu nkyerɛkyerɛfo (ma wɔn nimdeɛ). Yɛ baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ asomdwoeɛ a, wɔn ho bɛtɔ wɔn. Akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ a ɛma obiara tumi de ne ho ka ho: agorodie ne nkɔmmɔdie. Ma Mmoa (Support) - nteteɛ ma mmabunu nkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nim nea wɔpɛ wɔ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu ho na wɔabu wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nim nea wɔpɛ wɔ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho na wɔabu wɔn denam: Wɔbɛka nea wɔpɛ ne nea ɛhaw wɔn ho asɛm pefee wɔ akwahosan ho nsrahwɛ mu. Nsɛm a wobisa fa kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun akwahosan mu na wɔde kokoamsɛm di kan a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Ɔpanyin anaa ɔtemmufoɔ a wɔgye no di a wɔde bɛba akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛboa no na wɔahyɛ no den. Nanso, ɛnyɛ ɔbabun no asɛyɛde sɛ ɔbɛma akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no ahu akwan horow a wobetumi afa so. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo no nam wɔn ntetee so hu hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu no nnya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi akamfo sɛ mmabun nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano "contraceptive" a ɛkɔ soro denam: Nhumu a wobɛma akɔ soro: Wobɛma nkurɔfo ahu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi so denam nhomasua, sohyial media, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a esisi so. Wo ne Wɔn a Wɔsi Gyinae no Nkitahodi: Wo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ nni nkitaho mfa nkamfo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde nyinsɛn ano aduru a ɛfata mmabun di kan na ɛyi akwansideɛ a ɛmma wonnya kwan no fi hɔ. Mmabun Nnwuma a Wɔboa: Boa awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun no nkɔsoɔ ne ntrɛmu, a afotuo a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛyɛ mmerɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nkyekyɛmu ka ho. Akuw a Wɔkamfo Wɔn Ho a Wɔbɛka Ho: Kɔka akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim, anaa awo hokwan ho ɔsatu ahorow a ɛtwe adwene si nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri a mmabun nya so no ho anaa boa. Ankorankoro Nsɛm a Wɔbɛkyɛ: Kyɛ ankorankoro osuahu, adansedi, anaa nsɛm a ɛfa hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nkɛntɛnso pa a enya wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne tumi a wɔde ma so de ma nkurɔfo hu na wɔkanyan wɔn ma wɔyɛ ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kokoamsɛm nhyehyɛebɛn na wɔ de di dwuma ɛwɔ adwene mu ahoɔden ho ayaresa mu ma mmabun, na dɛn ne mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ obi kokoamsɛm ho ban
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔde ma mmabun yɛ kokoamsɛm, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ nhyiamu ase no sie kokoam wɔ mmabun no ne nea ɔde ma no ntam. Nanso, nkyekyem bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma kokoamsɛm nhyehyɛe no gyae, te sɛ berɛ a ɔbabun no bɛtumi apira ne ho anaa afoforo ntɛm ara, anaa sɛ adwenkyerɛ bi wɔ hɔ sɛ wɔreyɛ no ayayade anaa wɔnhwɛ no yiye. Wɔ saa nsɛm yi mu no, ebia ɛho behia sɛ nea ɔde mmoa ma no de adwumayɛfo afoforo ka ho na ama wahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔbabun no enya ahobammɔ. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun bisa kokoam ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ho asɛm bere a wɔrehwehwɛ adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ nwee "normal" sɛ menya mpɔmpɔ (acne) bere a mereyɛ anyin?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛtaa si esiane honam akwammoa 'hormones' nti. Ɛyɛ bere tiaa bi. Hwɛ nnuru a wode bɛhohoro w'anim yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na wobu no sɛ basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so? (honam fam, nna mu, nkate fam, Intanɛt so ayayade) .
answer_twi_source: Basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna so (GBV) yɛ basabasayɛ a wɔde kyerɛ obi esiane ne bɔbeasu, anaasɛ ɛka ɔbarima anaa ɔbea biako sen foforo. Ebetumi ayɛ: Honam fam: Ɔbɔ, akuturuku, piapia, anaa honam fam opira biara. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna biara a wɔmpɛ, a mmonnaato, tow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so, anaa obi a wɔhyɛ no ma ɔne no da ka ho. Nkate mu anaa Asɛm a Wɔde Ka: Nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho to fam, animtiaabu, ahunahuna, animguase, anaa suban a wodi so. Intanɛt so Ayayade: Intanɛt so ayayade, ɔhaw, ahunahuna, anaa kokoam nsɛm a wɔde ma a wɔmmpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi ne obi a ɛsono nna ho ahiade anaa akɔnnɔ ahorow benya abusuabɔ pa ne obu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi yɛ ade titiriw: Ka w’akɔnnɔ ne w’ahiade ho asɛm pefee. Nsiesiei: Hwehwɛ akwan a mobɛfa so adi mo ho mo ho ahiade ho dwuma sɛnea wubetumi biara. Fa w’adwene si abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den so: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so anya nkitahodi a ɛnyɛ nea ɛfa nna ho. Bu ahye: Nhyɛ wo hokafo no ma ɔnyɛ biribiara a ne ho nyɛ no dɛ. Yɛ adebɔ: Hwehwɛ akwan horow a wobɛfa so abom anya anigye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya afotu anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛbea sɛ merepere wɔ nkate fam bere a manyinsɛn a?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ayarehwɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa su wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn hɔ no de afotu mmoa ma mmabun a wɔanyinsɛn. Adwene ne Nkate Ho Akwahosan Dwumadibea no de adwenemyare ho mmoa ma; Fa telefon a wontua hwee yi di wɔn ho nkɔmmɔ: 0800678678. Ghana Psychological Association: https://gpaghana.org/
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nsusuanso a ɛfa ntiase ahorow a wobu no adewa anaasɛ wobu no boro so wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, nna mu apomoden, atinka fam opira, anaa abusuabɔ a wɔsɛe no mu aba, na mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw nea ebefi mu aba yi ho bere a meresusuw nneɛma a metumi apaw ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nea ebetumi afi asiane a ɛwɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu a wobu no adewa anaasɛ wobu no dodo mu aba no bi ne: Nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛhyɛ: Sɛ wobu asiane a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn mu no adewa a, ebetumi ama nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no adi nkogu anaasɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma bere nyinaa, na ɛbɛma nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ne a ɛbata ho no ayɛ kɛse. nna mu yareɛ: Sɛ wobu asiane a ɛwɔ nna mu yareɛ mu boro so anaasɛ wobu no adewa a, ebetumi ama wɔde kɔndɔm adi dwuma a ɛnkɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ anaasɛ wɔanhwehwɛ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu daa, na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ɔyare no ne apomoden mu nsunsuanso a ebetumi aba bere tenten no ayɛ kɛse. Atinka mu ɔhaw ahorow: Nkate mu asiane ahorow a ɛbata nna mu no ho atɛn a ɛnteɛ betumi ama wanya ahonu, afobu, anaa ahoyeraw, na aka adwene mu yiyedi ne abusuabɔ. Abusuabɔ a ɛsɛe: Sɛ wɔantumi ansusuw nea ebetumi afi nna ho gyinaesi mu aba no ho pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ebetumi ama abusuabɔ asɛe, na ɛde ntawntawdi, ahotoso a wonni, anaa nkitahodi mu asɛe aba. Sɛ wobɛkari nea ebefi mu aba yi bere a woresusuw akwan horow a wubetumi apaw ho a, susuw nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi aba bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu a wo gyinaesi ahorow benya wɔ wo nipadua akwahosan, nkate fam yiyedi, ne abusuabɔ so no ho. Hwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa a wotumi de ho to so na ama woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a wode di kan hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw soronko a mmabun hyia bere a, ɛfa atinka ne asetena mu nkɔso ho wɔ nyinsɛn mu no.
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hyia nsɛnnennen soronko wɔ nyinsɛn mu: Atinka mu Nkɔso: Woda so ara renya w’ankasa atinka mu onyin bere a woredi nyinsɛn mu nkate mu ɔhaw no ho dwuma no. Asetena mu Nkɔso: Ebetumi ayɛ den sɛ yɛbɛkari pɛ wɔ nnamfofa, asetena mu dwumadi ahorow, ne asɛde foforo a yɛwɔ mu. "Identity Formation": Nyinsɛn betumi anya wo ho nkate ne daakye botae ahorow so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi adwennwen ne dadwen a ɛfa mmabunbere ne nna ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere ne nna ho akɔnnɔ betumi ama  adwennwen. Afotu bi a wode bedi saa atenka ahorow no ho dwuma ni: Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Sɛ woka wo dadwen ho asɛm kyerɛ w’adamfo, wo wofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa ɔyaresafo bi a, ebetumi ama wo ho atɔ wo. Sua akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome: Ahome a emu dɔ, adwennwen, nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  yoga nyinaa betumi aboa ma adwennwen ne dadwen so atew. Kɔ so yɛ nnam: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ yɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so adi adwennwen so na ama wo atenka atu mpɔn. Fa w’adwene si wo ho a wobɛka ho asɛm pa so: Twa nsusuwii bɔne mpoa na fa nsɛm a wosi so dua si ananmu. Da sɛnea ɛsɛ: Sɛ wugye w’ahome yiye a, ɛboa ma wugyina adwennwen ano yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso a ɛwɔ mmeae a ɛde nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ma, a wɛbsaet ahorow, social media akontaabu ahorow, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm, ne Intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow ka ho no mu yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso a ɛwɔ mmeae a ɛde nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ma no mu yiye denam nneɛma te sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no nimdeɛ ne ne fata a wosusuw ho, nhoma no din ne ne samufo gyinapɛn ahorow, nsɛm a wɔafa aka ne nyansahu mu adanse a wɔatwe adwene asi so, sɛnea nsɛm a wɔde ama no yɛ nokware na emu da hɔ, ne biribiara a ebetumi ayɛ animhwɛ anaa nea ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho bɔ abira a wobesusuw ho no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsan nso hwɛ sɛ ebia nsɛm no ne aduruyɛ ho akwankyerɛ a wɔde asi hɔ ne adwene a ɛwɔ nyansahufnuo kuw no mu hyia anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsakraeɛ bɛn na me nipadua bɛfa mu bere a mereyɛ anyin?
answer_twi_source: Mmaa (8-13), Mmarima (9-14). Wonyin ntɛm. Nufoɔ fifiri/ Hwaa nyini. Bɔn nwi. Mpɔmpɔ (Acne). Nipadua so sesa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na sukuu ahorow betumi afa so adi animtiaabu a ɛfa adwene mu apomoden no ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nneyɛe a ɛhwehwɛ mmoa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi adi animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho no ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne suban a wɔhwehwɛ mmoa ho nkuran denam: Adwene ne nneyɛe ho nimdeɛ ne nhumu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nhomasua, ɔsatu, ne ahɔho akasafo nhyiam ahorow a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu na ɛhyɛ ntease ho nkuran no so. Mmeae a ahotɔ ne mmoa a wɔbɛbɔ ama asuafoɔ a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn suahunu, ahwehwɛ mmoa, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa adwene mu apomoden ho. Sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ ne asuafoɔ a wɔbɛtete wɔn wɔ atiefoɔ a wɔyɛ nnam, tema, ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛboa mu na ama wɔanya amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔgye wɔn tom na wɔte tema. Abakɔsɛm, ankorankoro asɛm, ne adanse a efi atipɛnfo a wɔanya adwene mu apomoden ho nsɛnnennen mu a wɔde bɛka ho na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ nea ɛfata na wɔatew animtiaabu so. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛntitiriw ne nkɔsoɔ, te sɛ Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Nhumu Ɔsram, a wɔde nsɛm a ɛsisi, dwumadiɛ, ne asuafoɔ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛhyɛ yiedie ho nkuran a wɔgye tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna ho mmuae ahorow no fã ahorow? (arousal, plateau, orgasm, resolution) [Fa nsɛmfua a ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma nhwɛso].
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw anan na ɛwɔ nna mu mmuae kyinhyia no mu, ɛwom sɛ ɛnyɛ obiara na onya ne nyinaa mu osuahu anaasɛ onya nnidiso nnidiso de. Nsɛmfua bi a ɛfata mfe a obi adi ni: Anigye: Eyi ne bere a wufi ase te nka sɛ wokanyan, te sɛ nea wo nipadua resiesie ne ho ama biribi a ɛyɛ anigye. "Plateau": Ɔkanyan no mu yɛ den, na wo nipadua siesie ne ho ma "orgasm" (climax). Ebia wobɛte nipadua mu nsakrae kɛse mpo nka te sɛ mogya a ɛkɔ soro ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nsakrae. Gyinaesi: Eyi ne ade a ɛma obi dwo bere a wanya nna mu ɔbrasɛe akyi (sɛ ɛba a) anaasɛ nna mu dwumadi akyi. Wo nipadua no dwo, na wo home ne wo koma bɔ san ba sɛnea na ɛte kan no. "Orgasm" (Climax): Eyi ne nna mu anigye a ɛsen biara, nhyɛso a wogyae a ɛma wote nka sɛ eye yiye. Ɛsono obiara, na ɛnyɛ obiara na onya mu osuahu bere biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhomasua di wɔ tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi ko ma wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow kyerɛ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua di dwuma titiriw wɔ tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi ako ama wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow wɔ nimdeɛ, adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye, ne ahotoso a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔde bɛka wɔn ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow ho asɛm no so. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ma mmabun nya nsɛm ne nnwinnade a wɔde besisi gyinae a ɛfata, akasa atia gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo/ahwɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nhyehyɛefo di wɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ma mmabun nya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ/ahwɛfoɔ: Wɔbɛtumi akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfata mfeɛ, amammerɛ ne kasa a ɛfata wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu, ne wɔn mma abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛboa, na wɔde nneɛma ne akwankyerɛ foforɔ ama. Akyerɛkyerɛfo: Wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a egyina mfe a obi adi, amammerɛ ne kasa a ɛfata adesua nhyehyɛe so ma, hwɛ hu sɛ ɛfata mfe a obi adi, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛfa nsɛmti ahorow pii ho, a nea ɛka ho ne pene a wɔpene so, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareɛ 'STI', ne abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo: Wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, afotu, ne a wɔde kɔma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho adwuma no so de ka nhomasua a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so no ho. Wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe: Wobetumi ahyɛ mmara a ɛhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, kyekyɛ sika ma nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho, na wɔhwɛ ma akyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee ne adesua nhyehyɛe gyinapɛn ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu adwene bi wɔ dɛmdie ho wɔ Ghana?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ transgender ne non-binary identities ho no gu ahorow kɛse wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu ne abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu. Amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ atetesɛm a akyɛ a ɛne sɛ wogye ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam nsonsonoe tom, nanso afoforoɔ nso wɔ mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛte saa daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ m’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidie ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu nneɛma di dwuma titiriw wɔ ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidie ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔhyehyɛ no mu. Ebia w’amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow besi nsusuwii ahorow te sɛ twe a wobɛtwe wo ho afi ho ansa na woaware, ahobrɛase, anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi pɔtee bi so dua, a ebetumi anya wo suban ne wo gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asotwe bɛn na wɔde ma ankorankoro a woyi nyinsɛn gu a mmara mma ho kwan anaasɛ wɔboa afoforo ma wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Asotwe a wɔde ma ankorankoro a woyi nyinsɛn a mmara mma ho kwan anaasɛ wɔboa afoforɔ ma wɔyɛ no gu ahorow a egyina mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ so. Wɔ amantam pii mu no, nyinsɛn a woyi gu a mmara mma ho kwan a wɔyɛ anaa wɔboa no betumi de nsɛmmɔnedi ho sobo ne asotwe aba, a asotwe, afiasenna, anaa mmara mu nsunsuanso afoforo ka ho. Saa asotwe ahorow yi botae ne sɛ ebesiw ankorankoro kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu a mmara mma ho kwan mu na wɔadi mmara nhyehyɛe a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma ho no akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma nna mu akwahosan wɔ telefon anaa ayaresabea ahorow a mmabun betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa wɔn yare wɔ STI ho wɔ kokoam.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛyɛ kokoam STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ Ghana ni: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG Helpline): 0244312151 (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-5pm) Ghana AIDS Commission Mmoa-nfrɛ: 0800123456 (Toll-Free) Ministry of Health Website: https://www.moh.gov.gh/ (Saa wɛbsaet yi wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ no sɛnea ɔmantam biara te). akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ nyinaa de kokoam STI nhwehwɛmu ma mmabun Kae sɛ, sɛ wobɛyɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu a, ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wode wo nna mu akwahosan ho asodi to wo ho so. Ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ saa nneɛma yi so akɔhwehwɛ kokoam ne adwumayɛfo mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ a edi mũ?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, aman pii wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ a edi mũ. Ebia eyinom bi ne mmara ahorow a ɛhyɛ sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo, bara a wɔbara nyiyim a egyina mfe a obi adi so, ne ahobammɔ a wɔde ma wɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wosi wɔn akwahosan ho gyinae ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me nne adi dwuma de ahyɛ ntease, ne tema ama nnipa a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu no ho nkuran? (ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔkyɛ, nneɛma pa a wɔyɛ)
answer_twi_source: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so ama ntease ne tema anya nkɔso ama nnipa a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu: Kyɛ Ankorankoro Nsɛm (sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a): Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a, w’ankasa w’asɛm anaa osuahu ahorow a, wobɛka (a wunni w’ankasa ho nsɛm) betumi ayɛ nea tumi wom. Ebetumi aboa afoforo ma wɔate nka sɛ wɔn nkutoo na wɔwɔ hɔ. Yɛ Nsɛm Pa: Fa abɛɛfo ntentan (social media) akwan (sɛ ɛfata mfe a obi adi a) anaa akwan foforo a wɔfa so yɛ nneɛma foforo di dwuma de trɛw nkrasɛm pa a ɛfa awo akwahosan ne nipadua mu ahofadi ho. Kyerɛkyerɛ Afoforo: Kyɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu ne nea wobetumi anya wɔ Ghana ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wowɔ nnamfofa pa a obu wom wɔ wo ne obi a ɔwɔ nna mu ahiadeɛ anaa apɛdeɛ foforo ntam?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ pefee: Kasa pefee na di nokware wɔ w’apɛdeɛ ne w’anisoadeɛhu ho. Fa w'adwene si anigyeɛ a mobom nya so: Hwehwɛ akwan a mobɛfa so anya nna mu anigyeɛ abom, sɛ mo apɛdeɛ nyɛ pɛ mpo a. Pene so sɛ wobɛsakra: Hwehwɛ nneɛma a mo mmienu nyinaa ani gye ho, sɛ ɛnyɛ deɛ wopɛ paa mpo a. Obu ma ahyeɛ: Bu obiara "daabi" bere biara na yɛ krado sɛ wobɛka sɛ daabi. Fa w'adwene si nnamfofa a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛnka nna nko ara so: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so kyerɛ nnamfofa a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛnyɛ nna nko ara. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi panyin hɔ: Sɛ worebrɛ sɛ wobɛnya nteaseɛ a, susu sɛ wo ne nna mu ɔyaresafoɔ bɛkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ me de benya afotu ho mmoa 'counseling' a ebebua me nnsɛmisa no ano?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu counselors. Mpɔtam ayaresabea. ahomatrofo so mmoa 'hotlines'. (GHS-YMK app). Mmoa kuo. Adwene mu ayaresa mpanyinfo 'Mental Health Authority'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awoɔ mu nkwammoa ka me nna ho nkate ne me akɔnnɔ?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ mu nkwammoa ahorow betumi anya wo nna ho nkate ne w’akɔnnɔ so nkɛntɛnso wɔ wo babunbere mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Nea broni frɛ no 'Estrogen': Saa awoɔ mu nkwammoa yi betumi ama mmeawa ate nka sɛ wɔtwetwe wɔn na wɔpɛ wɔn asɛm. Ɛsan nso di dwuma wɔ srade a wɔde hyɛ ɔbea no awotwaa mu no mu. Nea broni frɛ no 'Testosterone': Mpɛn pii no, saa hormone yi ne nna ho akɔnnɔ wɔ mmarimaa ne mmeawa nyinaa mu. Ebetumi ama ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho anigye akɔ soro na akanyan obi. Hormone ahorow nso betumi aka nkate ne adwene, na ebetumi anya nna ho nkate so nkɛntɛnso wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so. Ɛho hia sɛ wokae sɛ nna ho nkate ne akɔnnɔ yɛ ade a ɛfata wɔ onyin mu na ebetumi ayɛ soronko wɔ onipa biara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde kokoamusɛm  sie bere a wɔkyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne abusua mu nkɔso nso?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ hu sɛ kokoamusɛm sie bere a wɔkyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne abusua mu nkɔso denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne ayarefo ne mmusua bɛbɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ho haw ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Kokoamu nnwuma a wɔde bɛma ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔremfa nsɛm a ɛho hia nkyɛ a wonnyaa kwan. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa abusua a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow mu a wobu bere a wosi hia a ayarefo ahofadi ne kokoamu nsɛm ho hia nso so dua. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ayarefo de ne wɔn apomoden ho ɔyaresafo asusuw nsɛm a ɛho hia ho mmiako mmiako sɛ wɔpɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahobammɔ ho nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ obi rehyia GBV wɔ ofie a wɔyɛ ayayade mu, titiri sɛ ofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn sintidua mu a? (ahintasɛm, mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm: Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow de kokoamsɛm di kan. Wubetumi anya mmoa a obiara nhu. Mmeae a Ahobammɔ: Hwehwɛ mmeae a wɔdeda anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a ɛma ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ GBV mu, titiri wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn sintidua mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de ahye ato hɔ na wɔakasa ma wɔn ho wɔ abusuabɔ ne ayɔnkofa mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de ahyɛ hyeɛ hɔ denam wɔn anohyeto ne wɔn ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛda no adi pefee no so. Fa nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den di dwuma denam ahye a wobɛka no obu mu na sɛ wɔkasa tia a, wubegyina pintinn so. Kasa ma wo ho kyerɛ denam kasa a wobɛkasa bere a wonni w’ahye so na sɛ ɛho hia a, wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so asusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no mu ahotoso ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ mu no ho yiye?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ sɛ fibea no yɛ nokware: Hwɛ sɛnea wogye fibea no di denam nsɛm a wobɛhwehwɛ a ɛfa ɔkyerɛwfo anaa nnwumakuo no ho, wɔn a wɔfata, ne biribiara a ebetumi akasakasa wɔ wɔn adwene mu no so. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wogye tom: Hwɛ mmeae pii na fa nsɛm a wɔde gyina hɔ ma no hyia na hwɛ hu sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so. Hwɛ adanse a ɛfoa so: Hwehwɛ adanse a ɛfoa so, te sɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔatwe adwene asi so, abenfo adwene, anaa nsɛm a wɔde mae, na ama woahwɛ sɛnea nsɛm a wɔde ama no yɛ nokware. Susuw nsɛm a ɛfa ho no ho: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa ho a wɔde nsɛm no ma no mu, a ɛnne, atirimpɔw, ne animhwɛ a ebetumi aba wɔ fibea no ho ka ho, na ama woahu sɛnea wogye di na ɛfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ merehyia ɔhaw bi a ɛfa nna anaa awo akwahosan ho a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na awofo anaa abusuafo atumi aboa me yiye?
answer_twi_source: Awofo anaa abusuafo betumi aboa wo yiye denam tema a wobetie, wo nkate a wobegye atom, ne ɔdɔ ne mmoa a enni nnyinaso a wɔde bɛma wo no so. Wobetumi aboa wo ma woanya nneɛma a ɛfata, a akwahosan ho nnwuma, afotu, ne mmoa akuw ka ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wo yiyedi di kan na wɔkyerɛ obu ma wo ahofadi ne nea wopaw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn atipɛnfo anaa wɔn adɔfo aka wɔn ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ho, ama tebea a ɛboa no anya nkɔso na wɔakyekye ayɔnkofo a wobetumi de mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ama?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo ne Adɔfo a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Mmabun betumi de wɔn atipɛnfo anaa wɔn adɔfo ahyɛ wɔn ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe mu denam wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn, wɔn adwene a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, na wɔasrɛ wɔn mmoa so. Ayɔnkofoɔ a wɔbɛtumi de mmoa, nkuranhyɛ, ne nteaseɛ ama a wɔbɛhyehyɛ no bɛtumi ama tebea a ɛboa na ama ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa 'sexting', nkrasɛm 'sending and receiving' anaa mfonini ahorow a ɛda adi pefee a wɔde mena anaa wogye ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me nkitahodi wɔ intanɛt so no yɛ mmara kwan anaa pene so?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a Ɛfa Nna Ho: Mmara a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, titiriw nea ɛfa mmofra nkumaa ho no betumi ayɛ nea emu yɛ den na ɛsono emu biara. Mmofra nkumaa mfonini a ɛda adi pefee a wɔde bɛmena, agye, anaa obi a obekura no yɛ mmara so bu na ebetumi de ɔhaw a emu yɛ den aba, a mmofra nguamansɛm ho sobo ka ho. Mmara kwan so Mfe a Wɔde Ma Nsɛm a Wɔada no Adi: Sɛ woadi mfe a mmara ma ho kwan a, nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a wode bɛma mpanyimfo afoforo a wɔpene so no taa yɛ mmara kwan so de. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ wunya pene a ɛda adi pefee ansa na wode nsɛm biara a ɛda adi pefee amena anaa wo nsa aka. Mpene so: Hwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa de anigye ne anigye pene so sɛ wɔde nna ho nsɛm bɛmena. Bu afoforo ahye ne wɔn kokoam nsɛm; nkyɛ nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a wonnyaa kwan. Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe: Yɛ nsakrae wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ sohyial media ne nkrasɛm app ahorow so na ama woahwɛ nea obetumi ahu wo nsɛm no so. Hwɛ yiye wɔ w’ankasa ho nsɛm a wode bɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no ho, titiriw wɔ kokoam nkrasɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere a woreka nyinsɛn ho gyinaesi ahorow ho asɛm no, kyerɛ nea ɛteɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na mfa nyiyim nnim. Fa w'adwene si nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne mmoa nneɛma a wobɛma so.
answer_twi_source: Yɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ yɛbɛma wo nkyerɛkyerɛmu a emu tew na nyiyim biara nnim, na yɛasi mmoa nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wo ma wasi gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom so dua. Wo na asɛm no fa wo ho, enti wo na wowɔ kwan sɛ wosi gyinaeɛ a etwa toɔ fa wo nyinsɛn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne animtiaabu a ɛbata nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho, na ɛhaw nnipa dɛn? (adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so, atemmu, nnipa a wɔtew wɔn ho fi afoforo ho) .
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu te sɛ nkyerɛwde a enye a wɔde bata nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho. Ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛfa: Nsusuwii hunu: Sɛ wususuw sɛ obiara a oyi nyinsɛn no nni asɛde anaasɛ onnwen afoforo ho. Atemmu: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ obi a ɔpaw sɛ obeyi nyinsɛn no fata asotwe anaa aniwu. Asetena mu Tew a Tew Wɔn Ho: Suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛtew wɔn ho anaasɛ wɔbɛpow wɔn afi nnamfo ne abusuafo nkyɛn esiane sɛ wosusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma dɛmdifoɔ wɔ sukuu mu, te sɛ banmmo firi nyiyimu ne ateetee?
answer_twi_source: mmara a ɛko tia nnipa ateetee. Asotwe (asotweɛ a yɛde ma mmratofo).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam mmoa dwumadie ahorow no betumi ama nkurɔfoɔ anya kwan akɔ sɔhwɛ, ayaresa, ne afutuo dwumadie a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ (STI) ne HIV ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mpɔtam mmoa dwumadie pii ma kwan ma nkurɔfoɔ nya nna mu yareɛ (STI) ne HIV sɔhwɛ, ayaresa, ne afutuo denam ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa telefon so, amansan nhyiamu ahorow, ne ayɔnkofa a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ne nnuruyɛfoɔ wɔ. Saa nnwuma yi bi ne: HIV sɔhwɛ ne afutuo a wɔyɛ no hɔ ara: Na ama nkurɔfoɔ anya wɔn sɔhwɛ mmuaeɛ hɔ ara, na wɔatumi akyerɛ wɔn kwan akɔ sɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ne hwɛ a ɛkɔ so daa mu. STI afoforo sɔhwɛ ne nhwehwɛmu: Te sɛ nna mu yareɛ te sɛ chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, ne hepatitis, denam dwonsɔ mu nhwehwɛmu, mogya sɔhwɛ, anaa nna mu akwaa ho mmoawa a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Akwan kyerɛ kɔ mpɔtam ayaresabea: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nkurɔfoɔ bɛnya STI ne HIV ayaresa, nnuru, ne hwɛ a ɛkɔ so daa. Nea ɛka ho ne kwan a wɔfa so ma wɔnya ayaresa, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn na wɔafa wɔn nnuru pɛpɛɛpɛ, ne adwene mu akwahosan ho mmoa. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so tew yareɛ nya ho, kondom deɛ, PrEP (nnuru a wɔnom de si HIV kwan), ne akwan afoforo a wɔfa so tew nna mu yareɛ (STI) ne HIV trɛw so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahokokwaw bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nya na ama wɔatumi ayɛ dijitaal nneɛma a ɛkorɔn, te sɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, adebɔ, dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akwan horow?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee: Nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu, hwehwɛ fibea ahorow mu, na wohu emu nsɛm a wotumi gye di. Adebɔ: Mfitiase adwene a wɔde ba, akwan a wɔfa so ka abakɔsɛm, ne mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ anigye. "Digitals literacy": Digyital nnwinnade, "platforms", ne "media production software" a wɔde di dwuma yiye. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ: Adwenkyerɛ ahorow a wɔka no yiye, nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu a wɔsakra ma atiefo ahorow, na wɔma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nneɛma: Nsiesiei, siniyɛ, ɔdio a wɔkyere gu kasɛt so, ne mfoniniyɛ ho nimdeɛ a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no mu, akɔhwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den na edi wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwahosan nhyehyɛe no mu akɔhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ, a mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, ayaresabea ahorow a egyina sukuu so, abusua nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde mmoa a wɔde boa anaasɛ wɔde ma mmabun ka ho. Nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ fa fata a wɔfata, akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛw wɔn din, ne ɔsom a ɛwɔ hɔ ma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a aban de sika boa, te sɛ "Medicaid", "CHIP", ne " X Family Planning Program". Intanɛt so nnwinnadeɛ, "mobile apps", ne "telehealth platforms" a wɔde bedi dwuma de anya akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ankasa, ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔahyia, na wɔde ɛka ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so atua ho ka toto ho. Insurance a wɔbɛtrɛw mu, sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛfa nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nea wobetumi atɔ ama nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ no ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi ho akwan horow nya yɛn adwene ne  mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (sexual health) ho so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Dawurubɔ betumi ada nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, ne nneɛma bi adi wɔ akwan pɔtee bi so, na ebetumi anya suban ne gyidi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ho bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no so so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun no, ɛyɛ awosu sɛ wobɛte nhyɛso nka afi ɔmanfo hɔ wɔ wo nna ho. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ osuahu yi mu. Fa nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔboa wo a wɔbɛma wo nsɛm a ɛteɛ na wɔaboa wo ma woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata a ɛbɛboa wo daakye no twa wo ho hyia. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi afotufo hɔ, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma sɛ worepere wɔ ɔmanfo nhyɛso ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Aboafo nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔrehwehwɛ mmara mu afotu anaa mmoa wɔ mmara mu nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmara mu afotu anaa mmoa wɔ mmra mu nsɛmsɛm a wɔbɛfa mu no betumi anya nneɛma ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: ahomatrofo: 5100 (MTN), 0540118999. Ahomatrofo no bi so yɛ (Other networks), 0800202010 (Toll free), Applications: BOAME App, She+ . Mmeae nso wɔ hɔ a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa te sɛ Pearl Safe Haven, Ark foundation, ne nea ɛkeka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi ahyɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ tema, ntoboaseɛ, ne obu ho nkuran wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne amansan nkitahodie mu denam nneyɛe pa a wɔde siesie ntawntawdi ho nhwɛso, a wɔboa ahorow ahorow, ne nsusuwii hunu ne adwemmɔne a ɛde ntawntawdi ne mpaapaemu ba a wɔbɛkasa atia no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi ahyɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ tema, ntoboaseɛ, ne obu ho nkuran wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne amansan nkitahodie mu denam:Nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛda no adi (Modeling positive behavior): Tema a wɔbɛda no adi, atiepa, ne nkitahodie a ɛwɔ obu mu wɔ afoforo ne wɔn ntam.Akwansideɛ a wɔbɛpo (Challenging stereotypes): Ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so aka asɛm atia animguaseɛ anaa nyiyim a ɛde akasagesee ne mpaepaemu ba, na wɔahyɛ nnipa horow ne wɔn ankasa nsonsonoeɛ ho nkuran.Mfɛfoɔ adesua (Educating peers): Nteteeɛ anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa akasagesee ho siesie, nnipa horow, ne tema ho na ama nnipa anya nteaseɛ kɛseɛ.Baabi a bammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ (Creating safe spaces): Baabi a ankorankoro betumi ada wɔn ho adi a wonsuro atɛmbuo anaa nyiyim biara.Mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma (Engaging in community service): Ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma mu a ɛhyɛ tema, ntoboaseɛ, ne nteaseɛ a ɛda nnipa horow ntam ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu hia a abusuabɔ a egu mu ahorow na ɛka obiara ho ho hia wɔ adwenem apɔwmuden a wɔboa na wɔma wɔn ankasa ne afoforo te nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn de no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi agye wɔn atipɛnfo atom sɛnea wɔte na wɔkyerɛ obu ama obia abakɔsɛm ne wɔn gyedie. Eyi yɛ nsakrae a ɛho hia wɔ amammerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow mu a ɛho hia sɛ yɛte afoforoɔ ase na yɛboa yɛn ho yɛn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mesesa nneɛma a mede kɔ brayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a ɛsɛ sɛ wosesa wo brayɛ nneɛma no gyina wo nsu a ɛsen so: Pads: Sesa wo pad nnɔnhwerew 4-6 biara, anaasɛ mpɛn pii no sɛ ɛyɛ ma anaasɛ ɛnyɛ dɛ a. Tampons: Sesa wo tampon nnɔnhwerew 4-8 biara, anaasɛ mpɛn pii no sɛ ɛyɛ saturated a. Ɛho hia sɛ worennyaw tampon wɔ mu bɛboro nnɔnhwerew 8 na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya toxic shock syndrome (TSS) no so atew. Brayɛ Kuruwa: Fa wo brayɛ kuruwa no mu da mpan na hohoro mu nnɔnhwerew 6-12 biara, a egyina wo nsu a ɛsen so. Ɛho hia sɛ wosakra wo brayɛ aduru no daa na ama wo ho atew yiye na woansiw hua ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ewiase nyinaa adwene wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho betumi aboa ma wɔama nnipa hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ wiase nyinaa no anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Tumi a wɔde ma: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ma mmabun nya nimdeɛ wɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ho, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wodi wɔn ho so wɔ nipadua mu na wɔpene so ka ho. Mmarima ne Mmarima Pɛyɛ: Ɛdenam mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔbɛkasa atia so no, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi ama pɛyɛ anya nkɔso wɔ abusuabɔ ne gyinaesi mu. Nnipa a wɔka ho: Dwumadie a ɛka LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho no hyɛ gye a wɔgye tom ne obuo ma nnipa ahodoɔ. Asetra mu Atɛntrenee: Nsonsonoe a Wodi Ho Dwuma: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi adi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nsɛm ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu ho dwuma, na ama asetra mu atɛntrenee anya nkɔso. Nsɛm a Wɔka ma: Mmabun a wɔasua nhoma no asiesie wɔn ho yiye sɛ wɔbɛkamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa nna ne awo akwahosan. Ebi animtiawa: Nhomasua brɛ animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ase, na ɛde mpɔtam a wobue wɔn ani na wɔboa wɔn no ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn kwan so na yɛn amammere ne yɛn gyinapɛn ahorow kyerɛ sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbu/ yehu mmarimayɛ ne mmaayɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne gyidi ahorow kyerɛ sɛnea nnipa bu mmarimayɛ ne mmaayɛ, denam: Wɔhyɛ atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛe, su ahorow, ne dwumadi ahorow bi ma mmarima ne mmea wɔ ɔmanfo mu no mu den. Asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea su a wɔda no adi ho a wɔkyerɛ, a adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo ho asɛyɛde ahorow ho ka ho. Tumi mu nkɔso ne nniso ahorow a ɛma mmarimayɛ ahorow bi hokwan bere a wɔde afoforo to nkyɛn no so nkɛntɛnso, na ɛboa ma pɛyɛ a enni nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu ba. Ankorankoro ankasa adwene ne wɔn nipasu nkɔso a ɛbɛka wɔn, ne wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo, ahokafo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho so. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛbɔ de akasa atia na wɔasan akyerɛkyerɛ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbeayɛ ho de ahyɛ ntease a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne asɛyɛde ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a sɛbi wɔadi dɛm a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu apɔmuden ho nsɛm, nhwehwɛmu, ne mmoa dwumadie?
answer_twi_source: Apɔmuden mmeae nyinaa a ɛwɔ Ghana ma mmabun mmoa biara a enfaho sɛ sɛbi woadi dɛm. Wɔwɔ hokwan pɛ wɔ apɔmuden ho nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ wɔ adwumam?
answer_twi_source: Akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ kyerɛ nnyinasosɛm a ɛne sɛ wobetua ankorankoro ka pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ adwuma a ɛyɛ pɛ ho, a wɔn bɔbeasu mfa ho. Ɛho hia paa ma mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ wɔ adwumayɛbea ɛfiri sɛ ɛhwɛ sɛ mmaa ne mmarima bɛnya akatua a ɛfata wɔ adwuma korɔ anaa adwuma a ɛsom boɔ a wɔyɛ no ho. Akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ boa ma wotu nyiyim a egyina mmarima ne mmea so fi hɔ, ɛhyɛ sikasɛm mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran, na ɛboa ma wɔkyekye adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛka obiara ho na egu ahorow
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn suahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ ho adi a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya mmoa a efi kokoam na wɔmfa atemmu mma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn suahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔhaw anaa basabasayɛ ho adi no betumi anya mmoa a efi kokoam na ɛnyɛ atɛn afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ sukuu afotufo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo hɔ. Wɔatete saa adwumayɛfoɔ yi sɛ wɔmfa mmoa, nsɛm, ne nneɛma mma berɛ a wɔbu kokoamsɛm na wɔma baabi a ahotɔ wɔ a wɔbɛsusu nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ akwaa apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo di akyi bere a wɔde awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nnwuma rema mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde awo akwaahosan ho nnwuma ma mmabun no di mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa kokoamsɛm, pene, kokoam nsɛm, ne ɔhwɛ a ɛyɛ papa ho no so. Eyi betumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobenya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye afi mmabun hɔ ansa na wɔde nnwuma ama, ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ kokoamsɛm ayɛ, ɔhwɛ a ɛfata mfe a obi adi na ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔde bɛma, na wɔadi mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho no so. Bio nso, ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nya hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ mmara kwan so no ho nimdeɛ na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma tebea a ɛbɛboa wɔn na wɔammu wɔn atɛn ama wɔn ayarefo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma basabasayɛ a ɛgyina mbarima anaa mmaa so (GBV)?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu nɛɛse anaa akwahosan so hwɛfoɔ.  GHS-YMK afutugyefoɔ (counsellor). Nsɛm a wɔde kɔ DOVVSU anaa Social Welfare.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho, betumi aboa ma wɔabɔ mmɔden kɛse sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ asetena mu atɛntrenee, pɛyɛ, ne nnipa hokwan ahorow ho nkuran ama mmabun nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka nnipa nyinaa boa ma wɔbɔ mmɔden kɛse sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ asetra mu atɛntrenee, pɛyɛ, ne nnipa hokwan ahorow ho nkuran ama mmabun nyinaa denam animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔkasa na woako tia no so. Ɛdenam nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne ahofadi a wɔde ma mmabun tumi wɔ wɔn nipadua ne akwahosan so no, nhomasua a ɛka obiara ho boa hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nipadua mu ahofadi, wɔn ankasa gyinaesi, na wonya akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wosua pii fa wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ne sɛnea wɔbɛkamfo ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun ne: Intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma ne wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow ho, te sɛ UNFPA "Me Nipadua, Me Hokwan" ɔsatu anaa Planned Parenthood "TeenTalk" wɛbsaet. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa ne ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde kokoam afotu, mmoa, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho. Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, mmabun akuw, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɛma mmabun nya hokwan sua biribi fi wɔn ho wɔn ho hɔ na wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu. Nhomasua nneɛma, nnwinnade, ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow ho, a ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ UNESCO, WHO, ne Guttmacher Institute na ɛyɛe. Ntrɛwmu, telefon a wɔde boa, ne mmoa adwumayɛbea a ɛde kokoam afotu, nsɛm, ne afotu ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodi di wɔ abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn de ada wɔn ahiade, wɔn ahye, ne wɔn nkate adi?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi di dwuma titiriw wɔ abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu denam: Ahiade ne Ahye a Wɔda no adi: Ahokafo a wɔma wɔn kwan ma wɔda wɔn ahiade, ahye, ne wɔn nkate adi pefee ne nokwaredi so. Atie a Wɔde Yɛ Nsi: Atie a wɔde yɛ nnam ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma de ate wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene ase na wɔagye atom. Ntawntawdi Ho Nsiesiei: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw de adi ntawntawdi anaa adwene a enhyia ho dwuma wɔ obu mu. Tema: Tema ne ntease a wɔda no adi wɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho suahu ne wɔn nkate ho. Nkitahodi a Ɛnyɛ Asɛmfua: Sɛ́ wubehu nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu de, te sɛ nipadua kasa ne nne a wɔde kasa, na ama ntease ne nkitahodi akɔ anim. Mmabun betumi anya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn denam adeyɛ, wɔn ho a wobehu, ne akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa abusuabɔ ho afotufo hɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ada m’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho adi bere a meda so ara bu afoforo de no?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ada wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi adi denam wo nsusuwii, wo atinka, ne osuahu ahorow a wobɛka akyerɛ yɛn pefee no so. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛde obu bedi nkitaho na yɛtie yɛn ho yɛn ho adwene a yɛrenmmu atɛn. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ a yɛde yɛn ho bɛhyɛ mu so no, yebetumi asua biribi afi yɛn ho yɛn ho hɔ na yɛama yɛn ntease a yɛwɔ wɔ adwene ahorow ho no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkwaadɔm 'hormones' mu nsakrae, mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, ne nipadua mu akwahosan 'physical health' tebea di wɔ nna mu akwahosan 'sexual health' ne dwumadi a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsakrae a Ɛma Nkwammoaa Mu 'Hormonal Changes': Wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no, nkwaadɔm 'hormones' a ɛsakrasakra no betumi aka nna ho akɔnnɔ 'sexual desire' ne ne dwumadi. Nkwammoaa a ɛnkari pɛ betumi de nsɛm te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a ɛnyɛ adwuma yiye anaasɛ nna a ɛnkɔ so daa aba. Mmabun: Mmabun betumi anya dadwen anaa adwene a ɛyɛ basaa wɔ wɔn nipadua a ɛresakra no ho, na ɛno betumi aka nna mu ahotoso. Nsakrae ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase na wɔagye atom ho hia ma nna mu nkɔso a ɛfata. Nipadua mu Akwahosan Tebea: Tebea horow te sɛ asikreyare, 'thyroid' yare, anaa komayare betumi aka nna mu akwahosan. Ɛyaw anaa ɔbrɛ a enni sabea nso betumi aka nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ne dwumadi. Asɛm a Wodi: Ho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ ayaresa ma nipadua mu akwahosan tebea horow a ɛda adi pefee. Sɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ ne ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu nsakrae a ɛfata ho a, ebetumi atew dadwen so. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wɔn ahokafo bɛbɔ no yɛ ade titiriw. Saa nneɛma yi a wɔte ase no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔahu nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔadi ho dwuma. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛkae sɛ nna mu ɔhaw abu so na mpɛn pii no wobetumi de mmoa ne nneɛma a ɛfata asa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ awoɔ akwahosan a wɔaka abom ne akwahosan ho nnwuma a edi mũ a wɔde ma mmabun no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nnwuma a wɔaka abom a wɔde ma mmabun no mu. Wɔn asɛde ne sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmabun ahiade mu, wɔde ayaresa a ɛfata ma, wɔde afotu ne mmoa ma, na wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo afoforo yɛ biako na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde ɔhwɛ a edi mũ bɛma. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtete wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ma, wodi mmabun ahiade soronko ne wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma, a nsɛm a ɛfa awo akwahosan, kokoamsɛm, ne pene a wɔpene so ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔn a wɔwɔ sohyial media so nkɛntɛnso nya adwene ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden, abusuabɔ, ne awo ho a wɔpaw wɔ mmabun mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Social media nkɛntɛnsofoɔ nya nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden, abusuabɔ, ne awoɔ a wɔpaw ho denam: Wɔsom sɛ nhwɛsoɔ ne wɔn a wɔde nneɛma kɔ so a wɔhyehyɛ suban ne gyinapɛn a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛeɛ ne apɔwmuden ho nneyɛeɛ ho. Nsɛm a ɛfa ho na ɛkanyan adwene a ɛka atiefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so na ɛka wɔn gyidi ne wɔn nneyɛe. Suban ahorow bi a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ne abusuabɔ ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata denam wɔn nsɛm a wɔde to gua, nsɛm a wɔka, ne nkitahodi ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so kamfo ASRR ahorow kyerɛ wɔ kwan a ɛkyerɛ obuo ne nea ɛkanyan adwene so, bere mpo a wɔne nnipa a ɛsono wɔn adwene rekasa no? (Atie, de data ne adanse di dwuma)
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ adwene a ɛsono biara de mpo a, nkitahodi yɛ ade titiri: Tie: Tie na woate wɔn haw ahorow ase a wunsusu ho. Data & Evidence: Fa nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so di dwuma de gyina w’akyinnyegye no akyi na fa nokwasɛm ahorow di wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma. Fa W’adwene Si Asɛm a Wobom Yɛ So: Kyerɛ mmeae a wopene so na fa saa nsɛntitiri no si so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene anaa nsusuiɛ bɔne bɛn na mmabun taa nya fa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho ayaresa a wɔgye ho?
