answer_twi_source: Wɔtaa suro sɛ wɔn nsɛm bɛba abɔnten (privacy), anaa ayaresafoɔ no bɛbu wɔn atɛn (judgment). Ebi nso fɛre sɛ wɔbɛkasa afa nneɛma bi ho anaa mpo mmoa  pɔtee a wɔbetumi anya no, ɔmonnim. Sika ho nsɛmsɛm ne ayaresa ho amammerɛ nso tumi ha wɔn. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayaresa pa a ɛfata mmabun na ɛbɛtumi ayi ehu yi afiri hɔ na ama mmabun no anya ayaresa ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no bɛkasa na wɔn a wɔrehwɛ no de wɔn ho agye mu na waboa wɔn so dua.
answer_twi_source: Kasa: Ma wo nnamfo nhu sɛ woremma GBV ho kwan na hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ sɛ wonya bi a, wɔnkasa. Yɛ Ɔyɔnko a Ɔboa: Tie na mmu wɔn atɛn na gye wɔn di. Boa wɔn gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ anaa tebea no a wɔbɛbɔ ho amanneɛ ho. Kae: Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa, wɔ Intanɛt so ne nea ɛnyɛ Intanɛt so. Wonyɛ ankonam. Beae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛbɔ ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ne wɔn a wɔrehwɛ no ho hia kɛse wɔ GBV a wobegyae mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Popa
answer_twi_source: Sika a wɔbɛnya: Bɔ bosea fa hyɛ adwuma ase anaa trɛ adwuma nketewa mu, kɔ sukuu anaa nsa-ano-adwuma nteteeɛ a wɔbɛkɔ, anaa sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ adwuma a ɛma sika mu. Sika ho nimdeɛ nteteeɛ: Sua sika ho nimdeɛ, sika nhyehyɛeɛ ho nimdeɛ, sika kora ho su, ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛsua de asi sika ho gyinaeɛ a nimdeɛ wom na wɔahwɛ nneɛma so yie. Adwuma mpontuo mmoa: Akwankyerɛ, afutuo, ne mfididwuma mmoa a wɔbɛnya de aboa adwuma nhyehyɛeɛ, edwadi akwan, ne adwuma sohwɛ de ahyɛ adwuma a wɔbɛyɛ no den. Nkitahodiɛ hokwan: Nnamfofa, afotufoɔ, adwuma afotufoɔ, ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde sika hyɛ adwuma mu a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de ahyɛ nnamfofa den, asusu nsɛm, na wɔanya edwadi, nneɛma, ne hokwan a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma abom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan horow bɛn na yɛbɛtumi afa so mmerɛ tenten de ahwɛ nipadua a ɛfata obuo  (self-esteem), bere a mmerante ne mmabaa renyin akɔ mpanyinfɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe a Wɔde Hwɛ Wɔn Ho: Dwumadi ahorow a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a ɛma nipadua, nkate, ne adwene mu yiyedi di kan. Ɔhye a Wɔde Sisi hɔ: Ɔhye a wɔde besi hɔ atwa nhyɛso ahorow a ɛfa ne honam ani hwɛbea ho ahyia na obi akyerɛ ne gyinapɛn ne ne gyidi ahorow. Adesua a Ɛkɔ So: Obi a ɔbɛkɔ so akyerɛkyerɛ ne ho wɔ nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm, ɔmanfo nkɛntɛnso, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so hyɛ ne ho a wogye tom ho nkuran. Mmoa a Wɔhwehwɛ: Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro, afotufo, anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ bere a wohyia nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nipadua mfonini anaa obu a obi wɔ ma wo ho ho no. Ahoɔden a Wobɛtumi Agyina Ano: Sɛ wobɛnya ahoɔden a ɛbɛma woatumi agyina ano denam ahokokwaa a wobɛnya de agyina ano, ɔhaw ano aduru ho tumi, ne adwene a emu yɛ den a ɛbɛma woanya sɛ wosom bo ne nipasu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de amammerɛ mu nkate ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa ne osuahu ahorow aka mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtew animtiaabu so wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de amammerɛ mu nkate ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow aka mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtew animtiaabu so denam: Mpɔtam ahorow amammerɛ gyinapɛn, gyidi, ne nneyɛe a wobegye atom na wɔabu no sɛ ɛsom bo, hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ka obiara ho, ɛfata, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma ankorankoro ahofadi ne dwumadibea. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ne nyamesom nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim a efi wɔn mu no ho dwuma, nkɔmmɔbɔ, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow mu nsakrae a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a ɛha na ɛhyɛ gye a wogye tom na ɛka obiara bom ho nkuran. Wɔne nhyiamu akuo a wɔkamfo wɔn ne mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwan a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a ɛdi ankorankoro a wɔrehyia animtiaabuo ne nyiyim ahodoɔ pii ahiadeɛ ne suahunu ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ayaresa adwumayɛfo akwankyerɛ ho hia wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan a Wɔhwɛ So: Adwumayɛfo betumi aboa ama wɔahwɛ nipadua ne atenka mu nsakrae, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛwɔ baabi a ɛfata. Nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene a wobedi ho dwuma: Wobetumi adi nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene te sɛ onyin, nkɔso, nna mu akwahosan, ne atenka mu yiyedi ho dwuma. Siw a Wosiw Ano: Adwumayɛfo de akwankyerɛ ma wɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a ebetumi asɔre wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu a wobesiw ano anaasɛ wɔadi ho dwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛ yɛ dɛn anya ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun adwenemyare ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Bisa w’akwahosan ho dwumadifoɔ a ɔwɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa sukuu ɔfotufoɔ ma ɔmma wo nyansahyɛ ne nkitahodie
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan so akwankyerɛ bɛn na mɛtumi anya a ɛbɛboa me ama manya nsɛm a ɛfa ababunbere mu nsakyeraeɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan so Nhyiam ne Mmoa Akuw: Kɔka intanɛt so nhyiam ne mmoa akuw a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrefa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu titiriw ho. Nhomasua Abɛɛfo ntentan: Hwehwɛ abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow a agye din a wɔde ama mmabunbere ho adesua ne nna mu akwahosan, a mpɛn pii no wɔde dwumadi a ɛma nkitahodi kɔ so a ɛma wo ne afoforo di nkitaho. Abɛɛfo mfidie so nhyehyɛe:Abɛɛfo mfidie so nhyehyɛe ahorow bi de nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, brayɛ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho ma, a wɔayɛ ama mmabun.Abɛɛfo kwan so ayaresa gyinabea: Abɛɛfo kwan so ayaresa gyinabea ahorow ma wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo susuw nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so. Abɛɛfo nkitahodi akwan horow akwan horow: Di ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa abenfo a wogye wɔn di akyi wɔ abɛɛfo nkitahodi  so na woanya nsɛm foforo ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na bra (afikyireko) kwan no ka nipa adwene ne n’aniagyeɛ, n’ahoɔden, ne n’apɔmuden nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Bra kwan no afa horow (Menstrual Cycle Phases): Bra (afikyireko): Eyi ne bere a awodeɛ (uterus) no nwoma a ɛhyɛ mu no firi aseɛ pae na ɛba sɛ mogya; eyi kɔ so bɛyɛ nnafua mmiɛnsa kɔsi nson. Nkesua siesie bereɛ (Follicular phase): Eyi ne berɛ a nkesua (egg) no firi aseɛ nyini wɔ ababaawa-ba (ovary) no mu, na nipadua mu nnuru a yɛfrɛ no 'estrogen' no firi aseɛ kɔ soro. Nkesua pue bere (Ovulation): Eyi ne bere a nkesua (egg) no pue firi ababaawa-ba (ovary) no mu; eyi sisi bɛyɛ bra kwan no mfinimfini hɔ. Awodeɛ siesie bere (Luteal phase): Eyi ne bere a awodeɛ (uterus) no nwoma a ɛhyɛ mu no firi aseɛ yɛ mmerɛmmerɛ na ɛyɛ kɛseɛ, na nipadua mu nnuru a yɛfrɛ no 'progesterone' no firi aseɛ kɔ soro. Awodeɛ siesie bere (Luteal phase): Eyi ne bere a awodeɛ (uterus) no nwoma a ɛhyɛ mu no firi aseɛ yɛ mmerɛmmerɛ na ɛyɛ kɛseɛ, na nipadua mu nnuru a yɛfrɛ no 'progesterone' no firi aseɛ kɔ soro:  Eyi ne bere a nkaeɛ a ɛsakyera basabasa, abofufu, ne mmerɛyɛ ba ansa na bra (afikyireko) no afiri aseɛ.  Brayɛ mu Akisikuru: Ɛyaw wɔ yafunu ase ne akyi. Nsakrae a Ɛba Ahoɔden Mu: Ebia ebinom bɛte ɔbrɛ anaa ɔbrɛ kɛse nka berɛ a wɔrekɔ brayɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyamesom mu gyidi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ sesa obi suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmabun mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nyamesom mu gyidi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nya suban ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho so tumi wɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa mu denam abrabɔ pa ho nnyinasoɔ, akwankyerɛ, ne amammere mu gyinapɛn a ɛboa ma nnipa te saa nsɛm yi ase. Mpɛn pii no, nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ si gyinapɛn ahodoɔ te sɛ abrabɔ pa, ahotew, ne awoɔ so dua, na eyi bɛtumi aka mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa adwene wɔ nna ho nneyɛeɛ, kwan a wɔfa so si awoɔ kwan, ne mmofra-gu (abortion) ho. Bio koraa no, nyamesom akuo taa di dwuma kɛseɛ wɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa ntetee ne wɔn nipasu mu, na eyi ma gyinapɛn ne deɛ wɔhwɛ kwan firi wɔn hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho no yɛ den
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ sɛ afotuo ne mmoa dwumadie no yɛ nea obuo ne nyiyimu biara nnim?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Nteteeɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ afotubɔfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔboa wɔn no nya nteteeɛ wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ yɛbɛhu nnipa ahorow, tebea ahorow, abakɔsɛm ne ne osuahun ahorow ɛwɔ wiase. Kasa ne Nsɛmfua a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Fa kasa ne nsɛmfua a obu wom di dwuma. Fa nkyerɛase anaa kasa asekyerɛfoɔ ma wɔn a wɔnnte kasa 'language' bi ase. Yɛ  beaɛ a bammɔ wɔ hɔ a nnipa bia betumi akɔ, na nyiyimu bia nni hɔ. Fa afotuo a obu wom ma obiara. Sesa akwan ahorow a wɔfa so de afotuo ma sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛte amammerɛ ahorow ase. Ananmusifoɔ: Hwɛ sɛ afotubɔfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔboa wɔn no bɛda mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ahodoɔ adi. Nya nneɛma ɛda nnipa ne osuahun ahorow adi. Akwan a wɔfa so de nsɛm ma: Yɛ krado sɛ wobɛma kwan ma nkorɔfoɔ abɔ wo amaneɛ fa nea ɛnnyɛ bia ho. Sɛ obi yɛ nhwehwɛanim tia obi, ka ho asɛm. Ne akuo bi te sɛ, LGBTQ+ kuo, amammerɛ kuo ne akasamfoɔ nnyɛ adwuma mmom nnko ntia nyiyimu. Na afei gye afotuo fa kwan a mobetumi ama ndwumapa saa akɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso bɛn na mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne nna mu nneyɛe ho mfoni a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ epira wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu betumi anya wɔ mmabun obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, wɔn nipadua ho mfonini, ne wɔn abusuabɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun dwumadi ne nna mu nneyɛe ho mfoni a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ epira wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu betumi anya mmabun obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, wɔn nipadua ho mfoni, ne wɔn abusuabɔ so nkɛntɛnso bɔne. Sɛ obi de ne ho hyɛ ahoɔfɛ ne ɔbarima/ɔbea gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ na wontumi nnya ho mu a, ebetumi ama nipadua no ani nnye ho na wabu ne ho a ɛba fam. Bio nso, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛhyɛ ɔbarima/ɔbea a awuduru wom ho nkuran no betumi ama nneyɛe a epira ayɛ nea ɛfata na aboa ma abusuabɔ mu ntawntawdi ne basabasayɛ aba mmabun mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina ahoɔden ano de ako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛnnyɛ na yɛabɔ yɛn adwene apɔwmuden ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, n’anigyede, ne ahye ahorow a wɔbɛte ase de asi gyinae ahorow a ɛfata a ɛne ankorankoro gyidi ne botae ahorow hyia. Ahokokwaw a Wɔde Yɛ Asɛm: Sua a wobesua sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛka ahyeɛbɔ, nea wɔpɛ, ne gyinaesi ahorow ho asɛm akyerɛ atipɛnfo a wɔrente nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wodi so. Mmoa Nkitahodi a Wɔbɛkyekye: Ne nnamfo, abusua, anaa afotufo a wɔboa obi a wobu ankorankoro na wɔde nkuranhyɛ ne akwankyerɛ ma. Obu a Wobu Ma Wɔn Ho a Wɔbɛhyɛ Mu Den: Sɛ́ wubenya wɔn ho mfonini pa ne sɛnea obi bo yɛ den denam nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho, nsɛm pa a wɔka si so dua, ne ankorankoro ahoɔden ne nea watumi ayɛ a wobehu so. Nsusuii a Ɛyɛ Den: Nsusuii a ɛyɛ den a wobenya de asɔ atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso ahwɛ, agye asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho kyim, na wogyina ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow so asi gyinae ahorow a ɛde ne ho. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ Bere a Ɛho Hia: Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa adwenem apɔwmudefoɔ adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɛyɛ kɛse anaasɛ ɛde adwenemyare ba a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa te dɛn, titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhyɛso a wɔde ma wɔ nneɛma a ɛfata a wɔpaw ho: Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa hwehwɛ sɛ nnamfo boa wɔn ho wɔn ho ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata na ɛyɛ asɛyɛde wɔ nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne awo akwahosan ho. Obu a wɔde ma ahye: Atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso pa bu wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye ne ahofadi, na wɔhyɛ pene ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu ho nkuran. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee: Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa ma nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛnyɛ atɛn wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, na ɛma mmabun tumi susuw nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn ho, bisa nsɛm, na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi wɔn nnamfo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyinam ama mmubuafo adamfofa nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛwɔ me sukuu, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: 1. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho: Sua hokwan ahorow a mmubuafo wɔ, nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea wobetumi anya bi ho. 2. Hu akwanside ahorow: Hu mmeae a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nkɔso wɔ wo sukuu, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. 3. Yɛ nkabom: Boaboa mmoa ano fi ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm, abusua mufo, ayɔnkofo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ. 4. Wo ne wɔn a wɔsi gyinaeɛ nhyia: Hyehyɛ nhyiamu ne adwumayɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne akwahosan ho akannifoɔ na wɔasusu nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ne ano aduru a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa ho. 5. Yɛ nhyehyɛe a emu da hɔ: Kyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe mu nsakrae pɔtee a wopɛ sɛ wode di dwuma. 6. Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho di dwuma: Si tumi ne sɛnea wobetumi anya bi so dua, sen sɛ wode bedi dɛm. 7. Kyɛ ankorankoro nsɛm: Twe adwene si nkɛntɛnso a nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho nya wɔ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm so. 8. Fa nneɛma ne mmoa ma: Fa ntetee, adwumayɛbea, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ ma na ama ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma. 9. Di nkonimdi ho afahyɛ: Hu nkɔso a woatumi ayɛ na di ho afahyɛ. 10. Kɔ so hwɛ na tu mpɔn: Daa hwehwɛ akwanside ne nsɛm a ɛreba no mu na di ho dwuma. Bio nso, susuw ho: - Wo ne mmubuafo ahyehyɛde ne akuw a wɔkamfo wɔn ho asɛm bɛyɛ biako - Sohyial media a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔakyekye mmoa - Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ho afotu boayikuw a wɔbɛhyehyɛ - Nkitahodi nneɛma a wobetumi anya bi a wɔbɛhyehyɛ - Dabere ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm Kae sɛ, nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi yɛ adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔkɔ so yɛ adwuma, wonya tema, na wɔyɛ biako. Ɛdenam adwuma a mobom yɛ so no, mubetumi ayɛ tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho kɛse a ɛma ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm som bo na wɔboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade pa sɛ meho bɛte mfifire bebree, na kwan bɛn so na metumi atu honam kankan ase?
answer_twi_source: Aane mfifireteɛ yɛ ade pa ma mmabun. Nea ebetumi atu honam kankan ase bi ne; adwareɛ, sɛ wode deodorant begu wo ho anaa ankatwadeɛ anaa nsoo bɛyɛ wo ho ansaana w'adware. Tɔ nneɛma a ɛnnha w'apɔwmuden 'allergies'. Na afei taa si wo ntarefi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotu anaa ayaresa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa mmabun wɔ wɔn adwenemyare ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Afotu anaa ayaresa yɛ adeyɛ a wo ne oduruyɛfo a wɔatete no kasa fa wo nsusuwii, atenka, ne osuahu ahorow ho wɔ baabi a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ. Ebetumi aboa mmabun wɔ wɔn adwenemyare ho denam baabi a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ahwehwɛ wɔn nkate mu na wɔate ase, asua sɛnea wogyina ano, ma nkitahodi ne abusuabɔ tu mpɔn, na wɔyɛ akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi nsɛnnennen te sɛ adwennwen, dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa adwenemhaw ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo nhomasua ne atipɛnfo mmoa betumi adi wɔ abusuabɔ a obu wom a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso na wɔasiw basabasayɛ ano wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa di dwuma titiriw wɔ abusuabɔ a obu wom a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso ne basabasayɛ a ɛba mmabun mu a wosiw ano no mu. Atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ nhyiamu, nkɔmmɔdie, ne nhumu ɔsatuo wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam, de atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama wɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa pene, nkitahodiɛ, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo ne afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmabun mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn suahunu, ahwehwɛ afotuo, na wɔanya mmoa afiri wɔn atipɛnfoɔ hɔ, na ɛma wɔnya atenka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wɔma wɔn tumi wɔ abusuabɔ mu a wɔbɛfa so na wɔadi basabasayɛ anaa ayayadeɛ ho nsɛm ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ne kwan so sɛ menya atenka bi anaa m'ani gye nipadua ahorow ho anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Sɛ wopɛ biribi a, agyina nneɛma pii so (suban, nimdeɛ). Sɛ w'ani gye ahoɔfɛ ahorow ho a ɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi advocate(Okasamafoɔ) adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi advocate (ɔkasamafoɔ) adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ anim wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Wɔnam nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatuo, sohyial media, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu a wɔbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ wɔ hia a adwenemyareɛ ho hia ho. Ankorankoro nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ de atew animtiaabu so na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa adwenemyare ho ho nkuran. Adwene ne nneyɛeɛ ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo akuo anaa nnwuma a wɔde wɔn adwene si nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ ne sika a wɔde bɛma adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie ho nhyehyɛeɛ anaa wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw kɔma mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, sukuu so ahwɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya adwenemyare ho nneɛma ne mmoa a ɛkɔ soro. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, kuropɔn mu nhyiamu, anaa baguam atiefoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de aka wɔn haw ne nyansahyɛ ahodoɔ a ɛbɛma adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie atu mpɔn. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, sukuu, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ adwenemyareɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim na wɔde adi dwuma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa kuw anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔyɛ awofo titiriw?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebia mmoa akuw anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔyɛ awofo wɔ Ghana. Sɛnea wobɛhu wɔn ni: Ghana Health Service Mmabun Akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ no de ahobanbɔ afiri nhyehyɛeɛ no di dwuma ma mmabun a wɔyem. Wo ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ nkasa na ɔne wo ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no abɔ. Asetra mu yiyedi dwumadibea nso betumi aboa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi akura hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma akyi bere a wogye nsunsuanso a abusua mu nkɔso ne mpɔtam hɔfo akwanhwɛ nya wɔ gyinaesi so nso tom?
answer_twi_source: ASRH nhyehyeɛ no bɛtumi akura hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm, ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye atom mu berɛ a wɔgye abusua mu nkɔsoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ akwanhwɛ nsunsuansoɔ tom denam: Ahintasɛm dwumadie a wɔde bɛma: ASRH dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoamsɛm a wɔde bɛma a mmabun bɛtumi anya nsɛm ne ɔhwɛ a wɔnsuro sɛ wɔbɛbu wɔn atɛn anaa wɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ abusua mufoɔ anaa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ. Obu a wɔde ma ahofadi: Hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wosi wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinae a ɛfata denam nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde bɛma, akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so asusuw ho, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi mu no so. Nkitahodi a ɛka obiara ho: Nkitahodi a wɔne mmabun bedi nkitaho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi so, a wosusuw wɔn ankorankoro ahiade, nea wɔpɛ, ne ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ ASRH nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwenem yare a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia, na dɛn ne wɔn sɛnkyerɛnne ne ayaresa?
answer_twi_source: Akyinnye biara nni ho, momma yɛnhwehwɛ nsɛmmisa yi mu: Adwene mu haw ahorow a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia no bi ne dɛn, na dɛn ne wɔn sɛnkyerɛnne ne ayaresa ahorow? Adwene mu haw a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia no bi ne: Adwenemhaw: Nsɛnkyerɛnne no betumi ayɛ awerɛhow a ɛkɔ so, dwumadi ahorow ho anigye a wɔhwere, aduan ho akɔnnɔ anaa nna mu nsakrae, nkate a wɔte nka sɛ mfaso nni so, ne adwene a ɛne sɛ wobepira wɔn ho. Ebia ayaresa no bi ne ayaresa, nnuru, ne asetra mu nsakrae. Ayemhyehyeɛ nnyɛ: Nsɛnkyerɛnne no betumi ayɛ dadwen a ɛboro so, ahomegye a enni mu, ɛyɛ den sɛ ɔde n’adwene besi biribi so, ntini a ɛyɛ den, ne ehu a ɛba obi so. Ebia ayaresa no bi ne ayaresa, nnuru, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome. 'Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder' (ADHD): Nsɛnkyerɛnne no betumi ayɛ den sɛ obi de n’adwene besi biribi so, ɔyɛ n’ade boro so, ɔyɛ obi a ɔyɛ ade ntɛmntɛm, ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ nnwuma mu. Ebia ayaresa no bi ne ayaresa, nnuru, ne nneyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Adidi mu Nsɛnnennen: Nsɛnkyerɛnne no betumi ayɛ adidi a anohyeto wom, adidi mmoroso, nneyɛe a ɛma obi tew nneɛma ho, nipadua mu duru anaa ne nsusuwii a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu, ne nipadua mfonini a akyinkyim. Ebia ayaresa no bi ne ayaresa, aduannuru ho afotu, ne aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun a wɔrenya adwenemyareɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne no hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyareɛ ho ɔbenfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di hɔ ma wɔhwehwɛ mu na wɔboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne dijitaal akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow adi dwuma de ama 'STI/HIV' ano aduru ne nhomasua a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo a wɔde ma mmabun ho no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo Mfiridwuma betumi: Ɛbɛma aduruyɛ nea broni ka no 'Telemedicine' a wɔde ma afutuo ne ɛhwɛ so ama 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu, afotu, ne ayaresa. Fa intanɛt so nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nkitahodi nnwinnade, ne ankasa nhwehwɛmu nsɛmmisa ma na ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn akwahosan mu. Boa atipɛnfo ntam nkitahodi, nea broni ka no 'virtual support groups', ne 'moderated forums' a mmabun betumi ne afoforo adi nkitaho, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔanya nsɛm a wɔmmɔ wɔn din. Ma nea broni ka no 'data' akyi di, nhwehwɛmu, ne nnipa dodow akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ntumi nhu nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so, hwɛ nea efi mu ba, na siesie nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ma ɛne ahiade pɔtee ne nea wɔpɛ. Hyɛ akwahosan ho nimdeɛ, ankasa ho dwumadie ho nimdeɛ, ne suban mu nsakraeɛ ho nkuran denam agodie, sohyial 'media' ɔsatuo, ne nea broni ka no 'mobile health apps' so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobetumi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ ano a wɔmfa nnuru nhyɛ mu, anaasɛ ɛhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw nnuru ma?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi anya nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔtɔn wɔ aduruyɛdan mu ne nea wɔkyerɛw ma wo, egyina ɔkwan pɔtee a wɔfa so yɛ no so: Wobetumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm a wɔde Levonorgestrel ayɛ (te sɛ lydia, Postinor) a wɔtɔn a wɔmfa nnuru nkyerɛw mma ankorankoro a wɔadi mfe biara. Ulipristal acetate Ɛhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw ma obi na wobetumi anya afi apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na aduan pa di wɔ adwennwen ano aduru mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi apaw nnuan a ahoɔden wom de aboa wɔn adwenem ahokwasan :"mental health"?
answer_twi_source: Aduan pa di dwuma titiriw wɔ adwennwen ano aduru mu efisɛ nnuan bi betumi ama ahoɔden a ɛwɔ nipadua mu no ayɛ kɛse anaasɛ asɛe na aka adwene. Mmabun betumi apaw nnuan a ahoɔden wom de aboa wɔn adwenem ahokwasan denam aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, "protein" a ɛnyɛ den, ne srade a ahoɔden wom a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so no so. Sɛ woto nnuan a asikre wom, caffeine, ne nnuan a wɔayɛ no ano hye a, ebetumi aboa ma adwene ne ahoɔden a ɛwɔ nipadua no mu no agyina.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm ahorow bi a wɔtaa ka fa nyinsɛn ano a ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ yiye ni: Atosɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano ma obi ntumi nwo. (Atoro) Sɛ wugyae nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano a, ɛrenka sɛnea wubetumi anyinsɛn daakye. Atosɛm: Kɔndɔm brɛ anigye ase. (Atoro) Nnipa pii hu sɛ kɔndɔm ma anigye yɛ kɛse denam atenka a ɛkɔ soro so. Atosɛm: Ɔkwan a wɔfa so "twe fi mu" (withdrawal) yɛ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw awo ano. (Atoro) Sɛ obi twe ne ho fi ho a, entu mpɔn kɛse na ebetumi ama wanyinsɛn. Atosɛm: Sɛ worekɔ nna mu a, wuntumi nyinsɛn. (Atoro) Ɛda so ara yɛ yie sɛ wobɛnyinsɛn wɔ wo nna mu, titiriw sɛ wo kyinhyia no nkɔ so daa a. Kae: Sɛ wote biribi fa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho a, kɔ obi a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo no nkyɛn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abusuabɔ bɛn na ɛda nkate mu nhyehyɛe ne adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa nipasu mu ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhye so ntam?
answer_twi_source: Adwennwene: Ebia ankorankoro a wɔwɔ dadwen yare no bɛpere sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ehu ne dadwen so, na ama wɔanya nkannyan kɛse na wɔakwati nneyɛe. Adwenemhaw: Nkate mu nhyehyɛe a ɛnkɔ yiye na ɛma obi nya adwenemhaw ho sɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ awerɛhow a ɛkɔ so, anidaso a enni hɔ, ne ɛyɛ den sɛ obenya nkate pa. Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD): Nkate a emu yɛ den na entumi nnyina, ɛyɛ den sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ nkate so, na ɛde nnipa ntam ntawntawdi ne nneyɛe a ɛsɛe wɔn ho ba. Nkate mu nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn ho hia na ama wɔadi sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ho dwuma na ama nea efi mu ba no atu mpɔn wɔ ankorankoro a wɔwɔ saa ɔhaw ahorow yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛnya ahooden ne gyidie wɔ wɔnho de ati wɔn ho afiri abusuabɔ bɔne ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi esi  akomatenten ne ahofadi akyekyere wɔn akoma ne wɔn ho denam: Amanfoɔ mmoa kuo a ɛyɛ den a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, a ɛfa nnamfo ne abusuafoɔ ho. Nnwuma ne agrodie a wɔpɛ, na wɔyɛ mu nnwuma pa mu de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Botaeɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama wɔn ho, na wɔadu ho. Asɛnnka ne ahyeɛ hyehyɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛsua na wɔde ayɛ adwuma. Nsusuiɛ anaa ayaresa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ de asiesie amanehunu a atwam anaa wɔn ho akyere wɔn ho ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so akasa atia na wɔako atia animtiaabu ne nyiyim wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ na wɔakamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nhomasua a ɛka obiara ho na obu ma no?
answer_twi_source: Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi afa akwan ahodoɔ so atia amuo ne nyiyim wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, na wɔagyina ama wɔn kwan sɛ wɔbɛnya nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a obu wom. Saa akwan yi bi ne:Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ani-kanyan (Education and awareness-raising): Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie mu na kyerɛ amuo ne nyiyim bɔne a ɛde ba onipa akwahosan ne ne yiyedi so. Hyɛ amanneɛbɔ nokwafoɔ nkuran na paapaa nna, mmarima ne mmaa su, ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho anansesɛm ne nteaseɛ a ɛnyɛ nokorɛ mu.Mpɔtam nkabom (Community mobilization): Hyehyɛ mfɛfoɔ mmoa akuo, dwumadie a wɔde gyina ma afoforɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu ahodoɔ na ama moanya beaeɛ a banbɔ wom ama nkɔmmɔbɔ, nkuranhyɛ, ne nkabom. Ka mmoafoɔ ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ bom na wɔasuama nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara bom a ɛhyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa animuonyam, wɔn ho so tumi, ne nyiyim-nnim nneyɛeɛ mu den.Mmara mu gyinaesi (Legal advocacy): Gyina ama nsakyeraeɛ ba mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu a ɛbɛbɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa kwan ho ban na wɔanya nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho amanneɛbɔ, nnwuma, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ. Tia mmara ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛma nyiyim ne amuo kɔ so, na hwehwɛ asodie firi aban adwumayɛbea ne ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ hɔ.Akwan a ɛka asɛm ahodoɔ bom (Intersectional approaches): Hu na di nyiyim ahorow a ɛba onipa so gyina n'abusua, ne honam aduru, dɛm biara a ɔdi, anaasɛ ne sika gyinabea so. Wo ne nnipa ahodoɔ a asɛm no fa wɔn ho nyinaa mmom nyɛ adwuma na moayɛ akwankyerɛ a ɛka obiara bom, ɛbu amammere, na ɛde pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, atɛntrenee, ne nnipa kwan di kan.Wo ho dwumadie ne akokoduro (Self-care and resilience): Yɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛhyɛ wo ho den na ama watumi agyina amuo ne nyiyim ano yiye. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi mmoafoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ a wotumi de wo ho to wɔn so hɔ, na fa w’adwene mu akwahosan ne wo yiyedi di kan wɔ amanehunu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me hokafo, m’abusua mufo, anaa afoforo a wɔboa me no ahyɛ me hwɛ ne nyinsɛn akwantu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm a Wodi Ho Dwuma: Atosɛm: Ɔhwɛ a Wɔde Ma Ansa na Wɔawo no Ma Nsɛnnennen Nkutoo: Nokwasɛm: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo no ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ wo ne wo ba no nyinaa akwahosan so, wɔ nyinsɛn a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden mpo mu. Ɛboa ma wohu nsɛm a ebetumi aba ntɛm na wodi ho dwuma. Atosɛm: Nnuru ne Ayaresa no Pira: Nokwasɛm: Nnuru ne ayaresa pii yɛ nea asiane biara nni ho wɔ nyinsɛn mu bere a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi kyerɛw ma no. Kwati sɛ wobɛsa wo ho yare na bere nyinaa kɔ wo duruyɛfo nkyɛn. Atosɛm: Ofie Ayaresa Dodow: Nokwasɛm: Bere a ofie nnuru bi tumi ma obi nya awerɛkyekye no, ɛnyɛ nea wɔde besi ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ananmu. Hwehwɛ nnuruyɛfo afotu bere nyinaa wɔ biribiara a ɛhaw wo ho. Atosɛm: Wuntumi Nteɛteɛ Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ Bere a Wonyinsɛn: Nokwasɛm: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ brɛoo so wɔ mfaso ma ankorankoro a wɔnyem dodow no ara. W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo betumi akamfo dwumadi ahorow a ahobammɔ wom a egyina w’akwahosan so akyerɛ. Atosɛm: Nyinsɛn yɛ mmerɛw na ɛnyɛ den bere nyinaa: Nokwasɛm: Ɛsono nyinsɛn biara, na ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya ɔhaw anaa nsɛnnennen. Ɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ no daa ansa na wɔawo no boa ma wodi nsɛm yi ho dwuma na wodi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ mmabun ho ban fi ayayade anaa abusuabɔ a ɛmfata ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, aman pii wɔ mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun ho ban fi ayayade anaa abusuabɔ a ɛmfata ho, a mmara a ɛko tia ofie basabasayɛ, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ne ayayade ka ho. Saa mmara ahorow yi betumi ama wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no anya mmara kwan so ahobammɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔde besiw ano na wɔaboa wɔn. sɛ wopɛ nsɛm pii a: Ghana fie basabasayɛ Mmara 2007(732), .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ m’adwene mu akwahosan so bere a midi nsɛnnennen anaa ɛhaw a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma no? (nipadua mfonini, abusuabɔ, nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe ho dadwen) .
answer_twi_source: Nipadua Mfonini Dadwen: Fa w’adwene si apɔwmuden a wubenya so, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wubenya hwɛbea pɔtee bi. Fa nipadua mfonini ho nkrasɛm pa twa wo ho hyia. Abusuabɔ mu Nsɛnnennen: Sua abusuabɔ pa ho ade, na fa ahye sisi hɔ. Nyinsɛn a Wɔanhyehyɛ: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woafa tebea a emu yɛ den yi mu. wo ne wo sukuu fotufoɔ, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ obi ani gye me ho wɔ ɔdɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkurɔfo da wɔn ho adi wɔ akwan horow so, nanso nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtaa kyerɛ sɛ obi ani begye ho ni: Nipadua kasa: Wɔde wɔn ani hwɛ wo, serew kyerɛ wo, anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho to mu bere a worekasa no. Ahwɛyiye: Ɛte sɛ nea wɔyɛ nea wobetumi biara sɛ wɔne wo bɛkasa anaasɛ wɔne wo benya bere. Nkamfo: Wɔkamfo wo wɔ wo honam ani hwɛbea, wo nipasu, anaa biribi a woatumi ayɛ ho. Initiation: Wɔdi kan kyerɛw wo nsɛm wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn, ka kyerɛ wo sɛ wo ne wo nkɔbɔ, anaa wɔto nsa frɛ wo sɛ mommɛbom nyɛ nneɛma. Kae: Saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi nyɛ nkwaseasɛm, na ɛtɔ mmere bi a nkurɔfo yɛ adamfofa su ara kwa. Ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so ahu no yiye ne sɛ wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ wɔn ani gye ho!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden dwuma na atipenfo mmoa kuo   ne ɔkasama nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ahyehyɛdeɛ di wɔ mpontu akwanya wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ndwuma ma mmaabun a sɛbi wadi dem aboa mmofra a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a ɛboa nkurɔfoɔ a wɔnni nipadua mu ahoɔden ne wɔn a wɔboa wɔn no hyɛ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔnni nipadua mu ahoɔden no ma wɔn mmarima ne mmaa ahoɔden ho adwuma mu den, denam ahyɛdeɛ a ɛboa nkurɔfoɔ, nsakraeɛ a ɛbɛba mmara mu, nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri fa mmara ne mmoa ho asɛm, ne kuo a ɛboa mmabun a wɔnni nipadua mu ahoɔden no ma wɔn ho akokwaw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuw betumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ no gyina adanse so, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na wɔayɛ no sɛnea mmabun a wofi wiase nyinaa ahiade ahorow hyia?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛ boa ma wɔhwɛ ma ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no tu mpɔn na ɛyɛ amammerɛ mu nkate denam nneyɛe a egyina adanse so, nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu, ne nneyɛe pa a wɔde bedi dwuma a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Wɔma amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu adesua yɛ mmerɛ, wɔdane nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma ɛne mpɔtam hɔ tebea hyia, na wɔkɔ so hwɛ ne nhwehwɛmu de hwɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔ na wɔkyerɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtu mpɔn, hwɛ sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ no di mmabun ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ ho dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa. Wɔsan nso de mfiridwuma ho mmoa ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu ɔbea ne barima ayɔnkofa 'dating' bere a mewɔ dɛmdi?
answer_twi_source: Mmaa ne ɔbarima ayɔnkofa wv nna mu tumi yɛ den kakra fa mmabun a woadi dɛm ho.Ka wo dɛmdi ho asɛm bere a woasiesie wo ho. Hwehwɛ mmeammea a wɔgye obiara tom. Fa w'adwene si nkurɔfoɔ a wɔpɛ wo suban so. Hu wo bo a wosom, na paw hokafoɔ a ɔbu wo na ɔte w'ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na aguade ho dawurubɔfo fa so de nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awoɔ apomoden ho si mmabun so?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo kuro ntetan a wɔde wɔn ani si so: Dawurubɔfo de Abɛɛfo kuro ntetan mmea ahorow a mmaabun agye din di dwuma de nkrasɛm a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a egyina nnipa dodow a wɔde di dwuma ne wɔn anigye so ma. Influencer marketing: Wɔne abɛɛfo kuro ntetan nhyɛfo a wɔwɔ mmabun akyidifoɔ kɛseɛ a wɔyɛ adwuma bom de hyɛ nneɛma anaa nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nkuran. Nneɛma a wɔde si hɔ: Nneɛma anaa nneɛma a wɔde yɛ nneɛma a wɔde besisi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a mmabun di, te sɛ sini, TV so dwumadi, ne Intanɛt so video ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nkate ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da no so?
answer_twi_source: Akwan bi a wobɛfa so atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya STI ne nyinsɛn a woanhyɛ da so ni: Fa kɔndɔm, ne sẽ a wɔde hyɛ wo sẽ mu di dwuma yiye na daa bere biara a wobɛda wɔ wo honam ani, wo akyi, anaa w’ano. Yɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu daa, titiriw ne ɔhokafo foforo. Wo ne wo hokafo (hokafo) nni nkitaho pefee na fa nokwaredi mu. Bu wo hokafo no ahye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa atipɛnfo a ebia wɔrehyia nhyɛso wɔ abusuabɔ mu, na nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔadi tebea horow yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa atipɛnfo a ebia wɔrehyia nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso wɔ abusuabɔ mu denam atemmu a wɔde bɛma, wɔn nkate a wobegye atom, ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔn sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa so. Wobetumi nso de nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ no ama, te sɛ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, telefon a wɔde boa, afotu adwumayɛbea, anaa akuw a wɔboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu. Atipɛnfo a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔakɔ mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu afotufo nkyɛn no nso betumi ayɛ nea mfaso wɔ so wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den yi a wobedi mu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo tebea nya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wɔn adwene mu apomoden nsusuanso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ aka nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo tebea nya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nea efi wɔn adwene mu apomoden yareɛ mu ba no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ aka nwomasua nhyehyɛeɛ ho denam amammerɛ mu gyidie, gyinapɛn, ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ a wɔbɛgye atom, ne nkateɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mu. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛfa amammerɛ ho bɛma, wobu ankorankoro nsonsonoe, na wobedi amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow anaa akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nsɛm ne nnwuma ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ayɛ adwuma abom de ama awoɔ ho atɛntrenee ho nhyehyɛe ahorow anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ayɛ biako de ama awoɔ ho atɛntrenee ho nhyehyɛe ahorow anya nkɔso denam afotu bagua ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nkabom ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, wɔn adwene a wɔde bɛma wɔ nhyehyɛe no nkɔso ho, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ne sika a wɔbɛkyekyɛ ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na Intanɛt so ɔhaw mu mmoa nnwuma hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun a wɔhwehwɛ mmoa no nya ahobammɔ ne yiedi?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so ahokyere mu dwumadie hwɛ ma mmabun ahobanbɔ ne wɔn yiedie kɔ so denam kokoam mmoa a wɔde ma a ɛnyɛ atemmuo, mmoa wɔde ma, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde di dwuma de di ntɛmpɛ anaa tebea a ɛhia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ntɛm ara ho dwuma. Ebia wɔde akwan horow a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho ne akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ho nsɛm nso bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm a ɛfa pene, nhyɛso, ne basabasayɛ ho dwuma wɔ mmabun abusuabɔ mu, na akwan bɛn na wɔayɛ de asiw basabasayɛ ne ayayade a egyina mmarima ne mmaa so ano, na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ a ɛkyerɛ mfeɛ a obi adi sɛ ɔpene so ma nna mu dwumadiɛ na ɛbu nhyɛsoɔ, nna mu basabasayɛ, ne ayayadeɛ wɔ akwan nyinaa so sɛ nsɛmmɔnedi. Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a nsɛm a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa, mpenesoɔ, ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho a wɔde bɛma de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔapaw nea ɛfata na wɔahu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ayayade. Nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran, ɛkasa tia mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, na wodi nneɛma a ɛde basabasayɛ ba mmabun, te sɛ ohia, nyiyim, ne asetra mu a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn no ho dwuma. Mmoa dwumadie a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ basabasayɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho, a afotuo, mmara kwan so mmoa, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛnya ka ho, na wɔahwɛ sɛ saa dwumadie yi yɛ nea ɛfata mmabun, kokoamsɛm, na ɛnyɛ atemmuo. Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma denam mmara pa a wɔde di dwuma, a ntetee a wɔde bɛma polisifo, atemmufo, ne afoforo a wɔfata wɔ akwan horow a ɛfa mmabun ho, a wɔfa so di basabasayɛ ne ayayade ho dwuma ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow, ɔmanfo nnwumakuo ahorow, nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, ne amanaman ntam nnwumakuw ntam nkabom ne biakoyɛ betumi ahyɛ asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den na ama mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetra mu nkabom anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne adwumayɛ a ɛda aban ahorow, ɔmanfo nnwumakuo ahorow, nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, ne amanaman ntam nnwumakuw ntam no ho hia na ama wɔahyɛ asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den na wɔama mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetra mu nkabom anya nkɔso. Aban ahorow betumi ne NGO ahorow, mmabun nnwumakuo ahorow, ne akuw a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so ayɛ biako de atrɛw nkitahodi mu, ama ɔsom a wɔde ma no atu mpɔn, na wɔama asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ adwuma yiye wɔ mmabun ahiade ahorow ho. Adesua asoɛe ahorow betumi de nimdeɛ, nhwehwɛmu tumi, ne nhwehwɛmu mmoa ama de asusuw sɛnea asetra mu ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no tu mpɔn ne nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ mu no ho na wɔabɔ nhyehyɛe a egyina adanse so amanneɛ. Amanaman ntam nnwumakuo ne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no bɛtumi de mfiridwuma ho mmoa, sika, ne mmoa a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ adwuma ama de ahyɛ asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu den, ahyɛ nnisoɔ pa ho nkuran, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔde mmabun hokwan ne wɔn yiedie bedi kan. Nhyiamu a nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, adwumayɛkuo, anaa adwumayɛkuo bɛtumi ama nkɔmmɔdie, nkitahodiɛ, ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa wɔ nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma mmabun mu no ayɛ mmerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama LGBTQ+ nnipa a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wohyia nyiyimu ahorow pii? (akuo a wɔboa, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asɛyɛde ahorow a sukuu ahorow, sukuu pɔn ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde afoforo wɔ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow ho mmuaema mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abu saa ahyehyɛde ahorow yi ho akontaa sɛ wɔde mmoa ne ahobammɔ a ɛfata ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu ne wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn kyerɛ no wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu, ɛfata, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow, sukuu pɔn ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde afoforo wɔ asɛyɛde ahorow wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow ho mmuaema mu. Eyinom bi ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ bere ano na ɛfata, nhwehwɛmu a ɛfata na edi mũ a wɔbɛyɛ, akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so asiw ɔhaw foforo ano a wɔde bedi dwuma, na wɔabu wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no ho akontaa. Mmabun betumi abu saa asoɛe ahorow yi ho akontaa denam amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, ahyehyɛde no nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛma, ne hokwan ahorow a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no ho nsɛm a wɔbɛma anya so. Ɛdenam adwuma a wɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow bom yɛ so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no benya mmoa ne ahobammɔ a wohia na wɔasa yare na wɔahwehwɛ atɛntrenee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa ma wɔayɛ mmeaɛ a ɛma mmoa a nnyiyimu biara nni hɔ wɔ m’atipɛnfo kuo a obu ma obia soronkoyɛ womu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ wobɛboa atipɛnfo kuo a nnyiyimu nni mu a, hwehwɛ sɛ wobu ankorankoro nsonsonoe ne soronkoyɛ. Ma w’adwene nkɔ kasa ne nneyɛe a ebetumi ayi afoforo afi mu anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ato nkyɛn a egyina nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna anaa amammerɛ so. Tie w’atipɛnfo adwene denneennen na kamfo kyerɛ sɛ obiara bɛka wo kuw no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde anaa nnwumakuw pɔtee bi a wɔakokwaw wɔ mmara kwan so mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de ma mmabun mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow ne nnwumakuw bi wɔ hɔ a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmara kwan so mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de ma mmabun mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo mmabun a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun hokwan ne nsɛm so, te sɛ ACLU Mmabun Hokwan Dwumadi anaa Mmabun Mmara Asoɛe. Mmara kwan so mmoa fekuw anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde mmara mu nnwuma a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma ankorankoro a wohia mmoa, a mmabun a wohyia ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ka ho. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔatu wɔn ho ama awo ho atɛntrenee ne nna mu akwahosan, a ebetumi de mmara kwan so mmoa ama wɔ nsɛm te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ wotu nyinsɛn, anaa awo akwahosan ho nyiyimu ho. Mpɔtam hɔ mmaranimfo fekuw anaa mmara kwan so adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn a wobetumi de mmabun ne mmaranimfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmara mu nneɛma a ɛfa ho mu, te sɛ abusua mmara, ɔmanfo hokwan ahorow, anaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔka de boa wɔn no abɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hwan na metumi ne no akasa afa nyinsɛnyiguo agyinasie ho? (panyin a meggye no di, adamfo, ofotufoɔ)
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu nɛɛseni anaa apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔpɛ mmabun asɛm wɔ apɔmuden asoɛeɛ a ɛbɛn wo anaa mpɔtam hɔ. Wubetumi ne Adamfo akasa: Adamfopa betumi ama mmoa. Ofotufoɔ: Ɔyaresafoɔ anaa ofotufoɔ betumi ama tebea a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo a wobɛkasa afa woatenka ho na woahwehwɛ w'akwan mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansidie ahorow bɛn na ɛtaa ba a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi so?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua mu Nneɛma a Wobɛtumi Akɔ: Hwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi akɔ ayaresabea anaa ayaresabea hɔ, a ɛwɔ akwan a ɛkɔ soro, mfiri a wɔde foro abansoro, ne aguaree a wotumi kɔ hɔ. Nkitahodi Akwanside: Sɛ wowɔ nkitahodie ho ahiade a, bisa wɔn a wɔde mum kasa asekyerɛfo anaa nkitahodi akwan foforo a ɛboa di dwuma no ho asɛm. Nhumu a Wonnya: Ebia wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no binom nni nimdeɛ pii wɔ nna ne dɛmdi ho. Siesie wo ho sɛ wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn w’ahiade pɔtee bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ahwɛ kwan wɔ ayaresa anaa afotu bere mu? (ahintasɛm, ɔkwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho, botae ahorow a wɔde besisi hɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm: Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ ɔyaresafo anaa akwaahosan ho ɔyaresafo ma wo nkɔmmɔbɔ no yɛ kokoamsɛm gye nneɛma bi a ɛka ho (te sɛ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wo ho anaa afoforo). Nkitahodi kwan: Hwɛ sɛ nkitahodi kwan no ma wo ho tɔ wo na ɛma wutumi da wo nsusuwii adi pefee anaa. Botae a Wode Besi Hɔ: Wo ne wo fotufo no bɛbom de botae ahorow asisi w’ani so wɔ ayaresa ho, te sɛ adwennwen a wubedi ho dwuma anaasɛ wubenya ama wo ho a wobɛma atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na nhwi refu wɔ mmeae ahorow wɔ me ho?
answer_twi_source: Honam mu nkwammoa (hormones) nti. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ worenyin. Ɛyɛ ne kwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene bɛn na ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atesɛm a wɔtaa ka no bi ne: CSE hyɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔyɛ ntɛm ho nkuran (wɔdi ho dwuma denam twe a wosi so dua sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu sɛ ɔkwan a wobetumi afa so na wɔde wɔn adwene asi ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛtwentwɛn nna mu debut ase so). CSE hyɛ aguamammɔ ho nkuran (a wodi ho dwuma denam gyinaesi a asɛyɛde wom ne nkitahodie pa a wosi so dua so). CSE sɛe awofo tumidi (a wodi ho dwuma denam awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkyerkyerɛ nhyehyɛe no mu ne obu a wɔde ma amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow so).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ te sɛ atie a wɔde ma afofro, tema, ne ahofadi adi dwuma de ne m’awofo abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu apomoden ho, bere mpo a ebia yɛwɔ adwene anaa osuahu ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ te sɛ atie a wɔde bɛma, tema, ne wɔn ho a wɔde to wɔn ho so betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔne wɔn awofo abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom afa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho, bere mpo a ebia ɛsono wɔn adwene anaa osuahu ahorow no. Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa sɛdeɛ wɔde saa ahokokwaa yi bedi dwuma no bi ne: Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ: Tie asɛm a awofoɔ reka a wɔntwa mu, bisa nsɛm a ɛma emu da hɔ, ne wɔn nsɛntitiriw a wɔbɛbɔ mua de ada nteaseɛ adi. Tema: Ɔde ne ho to awofo mpaboa mu na ɔde ntease ne ayamhyehye gye wɔn atinka, wɔn dadwen, ne wɔn adwene tom. Nsiesiei: Nkitahodi a wobehu na wɔahwehwɛ ano aduru a ɛfa awofo ne mmabun nyinaa ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na tumi a wɔde ma kyerɛ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosi ano ho, na kwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa ankorankoro ma wɔakyerɛ sɛ wodi wɔn nipadua, wɔn ahye, ne wɔn abusuabɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Tumi a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano no mu kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma ankorankoro nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne ahotoso a wɔde bɛkyerɛ sɛ wodi wɔn nipadua, ahyeɛ, ne abusuabɔ ahorow so. Nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ ahofadi, wɔn ankasa gyinaesi, ne tumi a wɔde paw nneɛma a wonya fi nimdeɛ mu ho nkuran, na wɔnam saayɛ so atew mmerɛwyɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobepira wɔn na wɔde wɔn adi dwuma no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɔmanfo di wɔ su horow a wɔhyehyɛ ɛfa wɔn mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Nteten ho  dawurubɔ anaa amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo: Ntentenho amanneɛbɔ taa nya ɔmanfo adwene so nkɛntɛnso, enti nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a egu ahorow na ɛyɛ papa ho hia yiye. Mmara ne Nhyehyɛe: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ne hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ no betumi akyerɛ ɔmanfo suban. Nhomasua: Nhomasua a ɛka obiara ho boa ma wɔko tia animtiaabu. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne atetesɛm a ɛhyɛ gye a wogye tom ho nkuran na ɛhyɛ nea ɛde nyiyim ba no abam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ nsɛnnennen bɛba bere a woyem no ayɛ kɛse? (sigaretnom, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ɔhwɛ a wonnya ansa na wɔawo) .
answer_twi_source: Suban ahorow bi betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔhaw ahorow bɛba wɔ nyinsɛn mu no ayɛ kɛse: Sigaretnom: Sigaretnom ma oxygen a ɛkɔ akokoaa no mu no so tew na ɛma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛwo ntɛm na ne mu duru a ɛba fam no yɛ kɛse. Nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Nnubɔne ne nsa betumi apira akokoaa a ɔrenyin no. Ɔhwɛ a Wonnya Ansa na Wɔawo: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ho hia na ama wɔahu asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba na wɔadi ho dwuma. adidi a enye ma mogya a ɛtɔ kɔ nipadua no mu ne nsɛnnennen afoforo ba
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔfɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow ho no nya adwene a yɛwɔ wɔ yɛn nipadua ho no so nsusuanso?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ahoɔfɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa kamfo ahoɔfɛ ho adwene a ɛyɛ teateaa na ɛnyɛ nokware ho nkuran, na ebetumi aka sɛnea ankorankoro si hu wɔn nipadua ho fa wɔ ɔkwan a enye so. Sɛ wotaa hu teateaa, honam, na ɔyɛ no yie bere nyinaa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dwumadibea ahorow te sɛ nsɛmma nhoma, television, ne abɛɛfo ntentantfidie so a, ebetumi ama wayɛ ntotoho, ate nka sɛ ɔmfata, na n’ani nnye n’ankasa ne honam ani hwɛbea ho. Eyi betumi ama mmabun anya nipadua ho mfonini a enye, obu a wonni mma wɔn ho, ne adwenemyare ho apereperedi wɔ mmabun mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de adi dwuma wɔ mmeae ahorow, te sɛ sukuu ahorow, apomoden ho mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow, de aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no na wɔahyɛ ayaresa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ho no bi ne ahobammɔ, ahotoso, paw, biakoyɛ, tumi a wɔde ma, ne amammerɛ mu ahobrɛase. Wobetumi de nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi adi dwuma wɔ mmeae ahorow, te sɛ sukuu ahorow, apomoden ho mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow, de aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no na wɔahyɛ ayaresa ho nkuran. Sɛ nhwɛso no, tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom wɔ nipadua ne atinka mu, abusuabɔ a ahotoso wom a wɔne wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no benya, obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahofadi ne nea wɔpaw, wɔne wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no a wɔbɛyɛ biako wɔ gyinaesi mu, tumi a wɔbɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no tumi asan anya wɔn asetena so tumi, na wogye tom na wobu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no amammerɛ ne ankorankoro mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsakraeɛ bɛn na wayɛ wɔ anammɔmtuo dwumadie a wɔde so ɔhaw ano a ne fapen gyina nhwehwɛmu so? Sɛ ebi wɔ ho saa a ka bi kyerɛ me?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Sɛ woresesa mmoa kwan no. Wɔyɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ akwan ahodoɔ so. Wɔtrɛ mmoa no mu. Wɔde akwan foforo ɛɛba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara kwan so hokwan ho adesua betumi aboa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkasa ama adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho na egyina adanse so?
answer_twi_source: MmaAbun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu (CSE) wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nnipa nkɔso, abusuabɔ, pene a wɔpene so, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu yareaɛ, ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow ho. Mmara kwan so hokwan ho adesua boa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkasa ama adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho na egyina adanse so denam: Ɛma mmabun bɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ CSE ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkasa ama adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛka obiara ho kyerɛ. Nimdeɛ a ɛfa mmara, nhyehyeɛ, ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa ho a ɛfa CSE dwumadie ho a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛhyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛkamfo nkurɔfo, adesrɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ, na wɔahwehwɛ akontaabu afi nhomasua asoɛe ahorow hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ mmabun 'health insurance' ho nsɛm ne mmra a ɛfa wɔn nna mu nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi ahwɛ 'NHIS' intnet no so. Mpɔtam apɔwmuden asoɛeɛ (District health departments) nso boa ma mmabun te 'insurance' ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya atipɛnfo mmoa akuo anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Ebia akwankyerɛfo anaa akyerɛkyerɛfo nim nhyehyɛe anaa akuw a egyina sukuu so ho asɛm. Intanɛt so Hwehwɛ: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabunbere, mmabun akwahosan, anaa adwene mu yiyedi so. Mmabun Asoɛe: Hwɛ mmabun mmeae anaa akuw a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ma atipɛnfo mmoa akuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛe pa bi a wɔde hwɛ sɛnea atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow no tu mpɔn ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ, nneɛma pa a efi mu ba, te sɛ nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim, suban, nneyɛe, ne akwahosan mu nsunsuanso a ɛkɔ anim, na mɛyɛ dɛn aboa ma wɔakɔ so abɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ nneɛma so na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe pa a wɔde hwɛ sɛnea atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow no tu mpɔn ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so no bi ne: Adwenkyerɛ a wɔgye fi afoforo hɔ a wɔbɛboaboa ano denam nhwehwɛmu, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, anaa nsɛmbisa so de ahwɛ abotɔyam, mfaso a wosusuw sɛ ɛwɔ so, ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso. Nsusuwii titiriw te sɛ nnipa a wɔba, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu dodow, a wɔbɛhwɛ so de asusuw sɛnea nkitahodi dwumadi ne nhyehyɛe ahorow no adu ne nea etu mpɔn. Nsakraeɛ a ɛba wɔ nimdeɛ, suban, nneyɛeɛ, ne akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ a ɛba wɔ nkitahodiɛ mufoɔ mu wɔ berɛ mu, a wɔde nhwehwɛmu nnwinnadeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔagye atom di dwuma. Wɔn a wɔne abɔnten so nhwehwɛmufoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nhwehwɛmu a emu yɛ den wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no mu nsunsuansoɔ ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ ho, a wɔde akwan a ɛfa su ne dodoɔ ho nyinaa bedi dwuma. Asɔremma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛkɔ so wɔ nhwehwɛmu, ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛfa akontaabuo, nnoɔma a ɛda adi, ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ so wɔ nkitahodiɛ no mu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ ne asetra mu nsakrae ahorow bi a anya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ho bere tenten no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne mpɔtam nsusuieeɛ fa nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm (people with disabilities) ho asesa kɛseɛ mmerɛ bi a atwam mu. Nsakyeraeɛ titiriw no bi ne:Firi Ayamyɛ so kɔ Ho Kwan so (From Charity to Rights): Kan no, na nnipa bu nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm sɛ maseɛ huni a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn mɔborɔ na wɔkyɛ wɔn nneɛma. Nneɛma asesa, na seesei yɛbu no sɛ ɛhia sɛ wɔnya pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ wɔ ho kwan ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya mpɔntuo mu.Aduroyɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ ne Asetena mu Nhyehyɛeɛ (Medical vs. Social Model): Aduroyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no bu dɛm a obi wɔ sɛ apɔwmuden mu ɔhaw a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ ano aduro. Asetena mu nhyehyɛeɛ no nso kyerɛ sɛnea mpɔtam mmoa a wonnya mma nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm no na ɛsi wɔn kwan. Yei ama yɛade yɛn adwene asi akwansideɛ a yɛbɛyi afiri hɔ ne akwan a yɛbɛbue ama obiara atumi afa so.Ahunu a Nnipa Hu Wɔn Pii (Increased Visibility): Seesei yɛhu nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm pii wɔ amanneɛbɔ (media), adwumayɛbea, ne mpɔtam ahorow mu. Yei boa ma yɛyi nsusuieeɛ bɔne afiri hɔ na ɛma nteaseɛ ba.Kae sɛ, saa nsakyeraeɛ yi gu so rekɔ so. Adwuma pii da so wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ na ama pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ a edi mu aba ama nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hena na ɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ma, na ɛhe so na mmabun betumi anya nhyehyɛe ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ama denam wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma ahorow so, a sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow ka ho. Mmabun betumi anya nhyehyɛe ahorow yi denam sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma so. Aman binom hwɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ nyɛ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe no fã, bere a wɔ afoforo mu no, wobetumi afa ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so de ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na metumi ne dɔkotafo anaa nɛɛse akasa afa me awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho na mahwɛ sɛ wɔate m’ahiadeɛ ne me dadwen ase na wɔafa no aniberesɛm?
answer_twi_source: Akwan ahorow: Siesie Wo Ho Di Kan: Kyerɛw wo nsɛmmisa ne wo dadwen to hɔ ansa na woakɔ. Di Nokware: Kasa fa wo nna, wo dadwen, ne w’apɛdeɛ ho kyerɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ no pefee. Bisa Nsɛm: Ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛbisa awoɔ nnwura (contraceptives) ahorow, nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu, anaa dadwen foforo biara ho asɛm. Kyerɛ W’apɛdeɛ: Kyerɛ awoɔ nnwura anaa nhwehwɛmu ko a wopɛ pefee. Kyerɛ Kɔkoamunsɛm Mu: Bisa ayaresabea no kɔkoamunsɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ de hwɛ sɛ wo nsɛm bɛyɛ kɔkoam. Mmoa: Tumi: Kae sɛ, ɛyɛ wo nipadua ne w’apɔmuden. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wosi gyinaeɛ a nimdeɛ wom. Hwehwɛ Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Sɛ biribi mu nna hɔ a, bisa nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaa nsɛm pii. Adwene Foforo: Ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ adwene foforo sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔnni wo dadwen no ho dwuma yiye a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ me no aka me nna ho haw ahodoɔ ho asɛm wɔ berɛ a merebu mensa?
answer_twi_source: Pɛ berɛ a ɛho dwo na ka ho asɛm. Di nokware wɔ sɛdea wote nka ne nsusuansoɔ a ɛdeba wasetena mu.Wɔwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa ama wɔnya ahomegyeɛ a wohia nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amanne anaa nneyɛe pɔtee bɛn na ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ yɛn amammerɛ anaa yɛn som mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa ɔsom ahorow bi wɔ amanne anaa amanne ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma atitiriw te sɛ brayɛ, aware, anaa awo ho. Nneyɛe betumi ayɛ soronko koraa, efi ahotew ho guasodeyɛ so kosi amanne ahorow a ɛyɛ awo anaa ahobammɔ bere a wɔyem ne awo ho sɛnkyerɛnne so. Saa amanne ahorow yi taa kura nea ɛho hia wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo ho a wɔhyɛ mu den no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔfa so hwɛ na wɔsɔ nkɛntɛnso a wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuo nya wɔ ASRH nsunsuansoɔ so no ahwɛ, na kwan bɛn so na wɔbɛtumi de asuadeɛ a wɔanya no adi dwuma de ahyɛ daakye mmɔdenbɔ mu den?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ na wɔsɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ a wiase nyinaa fekubɔ nya wɔ ASRH nsunsuansoɔ so no bi ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ den a wɔde boaboa nsɛm ano, adwumayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, ne nkɔsoɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa. Asuadeɛ a wɔnya firi saa nhwehwɛmu yi mu no bɛtumi ama yɛahu akwan a wɔfa so di dwuma a ɛtumi sesa, mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛhyɛ tumi, ne nhyehyɛeɛ kwan a wɔbɛsiesie de ahyɛ daakye ASRH nnwuma mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔde Partner Notification Services adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi aboa mmabun ma wɔde Ɔhokafoɔ Amanneɛbɔ Dwumadie adi dwuma denam: Kokoam nhwehwɛmu, afotuo, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma wɔ STI ne HIV ho. Nsɛm ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ ɔhokafo amanneɛ ne dwuma a edi wɔ ɔyare mmoawa a wɔasiw ano no ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn hokafo amanneɛ, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛka akwan horow a wobetumi afa so, wɔadi nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma de aboa. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ Partner Notification Services anaa ɔmanfo akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde mmoa titiriw ne mmoa ma wɔ ahokafo amanneɛbɔ mmɔdenbɔ ho. Nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne siw ano ho nnwuma a wobenya de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔadi wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi so a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma ne abɛɛfo akwan adi dwuma de ayɛ nkitahodi, nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne biakoyɛ a ɛda wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wiase nyinaa ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma ne abɛɛfo ntetan nhyehyeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ nkitahodiɛ, nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ, ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wiase nyinaa ASRH nnwuma mu no mu. Nnwinnade te sɛ intanɛt so nhyiamu, webinars, ne abɛɛfo ntetan ma wotumi di nkitaho wɔ bere ankasa mu, nneɛma a wɔde kyɛ, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔyɛ no biako wɔ asasesin ahye so. Inforgraphics a wɔde di dwuma nso betumi aboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnamfo anaa akuo bi wɔ hɔ ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ yiye wɔ wɔn ho sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔnhyɛ me so?
answer_twi_source: Hia wɔ hɔ sɛ woma w'adwene mu bue, ama wannyɛ nyiyimu, nanso hwɛ yiye wɔ nnamfo a wɔma afotuo bɔne a ɛde ɔhaw ba. Sɛ wohu sɛ wɔmmoa wo a, twe wo fi wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wobetumi asiw STI ne HIV ano, na sɛ ɛte saa a, akwan bɛn na etu mpɔn sen biara a wɔfa so siw ano?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wobetumi asiw STI ne HIV ano. Akwan a etu mpɔn sen biara a wɔfa so siw ano no bi ne nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔde kɔndɔm bedi dwuma bere nyinaa na wɔayɛ no yiye bere a moredi mpa so dwumadie, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde fa ɔbea awotwaa mu, to, ne ano ka ho. Akwan afoforo a wɔfa so siw ano ne nna mu dwumadi a wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi ho, wɔne wɔn hokafo a onni ɔyare no bi a wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho bɛbɔ, na wɔde nnuru a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban afi ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nyarewa bi te sɛ HPV ho. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobesiw HIV ano no, wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw HIV ano ansa na wɔanya (PrEP) ama ankorankoro a asiane kɛse wom sɛ wobenya HIV na nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛnom aduru bi da biara de atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya HIV no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na apue me bo sɔ yi? Meyɛ ɔbarima, adɛn nti na me nufoɔ reyɛ kɛseɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima bi tumi nya nufoɔ kakra bere a wɔreyɛ anyin no. Adea ɛde ba yɛ honam mu nkwammoa a abroɔfo tai frɛ no "Hormones" a ɛresesa wo nipadua no. Ɛya ɛyɛ mbere tiaawa bipɛ, na enkoara, akɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho mmara a eye ne nkrasɛm a ɛma apɔmuden?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi apia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ papa denam ka a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo sɛ wɔnhyehyɛ mmara mma nneɛma a ahobammɔ wom na ɛyɛ asɛyɛde, nnwumakuw a wɔhyɛ nneɛma ahorow ne atɛntrenee ho nkuran a wɔbɛboa, ne ɔsatu ne adesrɛ ahorow a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase wɔ nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu nna mu basabasayɛ ahorow, a kasa, honam fam, ne atinka fam ayayade ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu basabasayɛ kyerɛ nna mu nkitahodi anaa nneyɛe biara a wɔmpɛ a ɛba a nea wɔato no mmonnaa no mpene so pefee. Mmabun betumi ahu nna mu basabasayɛ ahorow ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so: Nna ho nsɛm a ɛmfata, aseresɛm, anaa ahunahuna a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛbɔ hu anaa wɔhyɛ nkurɔfo. Nipadua mu Ɔtow: Wɔde wɔn nsa ka, wɔde wɔn nsa ka, anaa nna mu nneyɛe a wɔmpɛ a wɔyɛ a ɛne nea wɔato no mmonnaa no mpɛ. Atinka mu Ayayade: Suban a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, nhyɛso, anaa adwene mu nhyɛso a wɔde di dwuma de di nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no so anaasɛ wɔde di dwuma wɔ nna mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na 'reproductive justice'(Ɔman mmara mu ahofadie) kyerɛ ma mmofra a wɔrenyin, na dɛn na ɛma ɛyɛ soronko firi 'reproductive rights(Atɛntenenee a ɛfa awogyee ho)' ho?
answer_twi_source: Awo ho atɛntrenee a wɔde ma mmabun no kɔ akyiri sen awo hokwan ahorow denam nneɛma, hokwan ahorow, ne tumi a wɔde besi gyinae a ɛfata a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo asetra ho a wosi so dua no so. Ɛgye abusuakuw, adesuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne nipasu afoforo ntam nkitahodi tom wɔ mmabun osuahu ne ahiade ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm bɛn na ɛda asɛm yi adi? (egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara so) .
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu asɛm ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuiɛ a ɛfa wo gyinaeɛ ahodoɔ ho no gyina Ghana mmara so. Ɛho hia paa sɛ wonya amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ firi mmeaeɛ a wɔn ho yɛ nifa. Kasa ne w’aapɔmuden ho adwumfoɔ (dɔkota anaa nɛɛse) na ama woanya nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛmu dɔ ne nhwehwɛmu a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Suban pa a metumi agye atumu mprempren a ɛbɛboa me akyiri yi no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Suban pa a wowɔ mprempren no betumi asiesie wo ama daakye a ahoɔden wom. Kakraa bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Di aduan a ɛkari pɛ: Sɛnea yɛaka wɔ atifi hɔ no, eyi ma wunya aduannuru a wo nipadua hia na ama ayɛ yie. Kɔ so yɛ nnam: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛyɛ no daa ma wunya apɔwmuden na ɛboa ma wudi adwennwen so. Da sɛnea ɛsɛ: Sɛ wubegye w’ahome yiye no ho hia kɛse ma nipadua ne adwene mu yiyedi. Di adwennwen ho dwuma: Hwehwɛ akwan pa a wobɛfa so agyina ano te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, bere a wo ne w’adɔfo benya, anaa akwan a wobɛfa so agye w’ahome. Nya abusuabɔ pa: Fa nnipa a wɔboa wo na wɔhyɛ wo nkuran twa wo ho hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso pa bi a ɛfa internet so dwumadibea anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mpeneso ne ahobammɔ di kan wɔ wɔn nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa na wɔama mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ pa a ɛfa internet so nhyiamu anaa nnwuma a ɛde pene ne ahobambɔ di kan wɔ wɔn nhyehyɛɛ ne nhyehyɛɛ mu no bi ne: - Ayɔnkofa Apps a ɛfa Mpene so: Dating apps a ɛde nneɛma bi ka ho a ɛbɛma nkitahodie ne pene a ɛda adi pefee wɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ntam, te sɛ pene a wɔhyɛ no pefee ne amanneɛbɔ akwan a ɛfa nneyɛeɛ a ɛnyɛ pene a wɔpene so ho. - Internet so Mpɔtam a ɛwɔ Moderation a Ɛyɛ Den: Intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa mpɔtam a ɛwɔ moderation nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ den a ɛde nsiyɛ di nsɛm a ɛfa ayayadeɛ anaa ɔhyeɛ a wɔbu so ho dwuma. - Nhomasua Website ne Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Wɛbsaet ne internet so nneɛma a wɔde ama sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ pene nkyerɛkyerɛ ne digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkuran, a ɛma nsɛm, nnwinnade, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛfa intanɛt so nkitahodi mu dwoodwoo. - Ɔsatuo ne Nneyɛeɛ: Ɔsatuo ne nnwuma a akuw a wɔkamfo wɔn, wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ, anaa aban nnwumakuo di anim a ɛma nkurɔfoɔ te pene ne intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ho, na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ahobanbɔ ne ahofadie di kan. Mmabun betumi aboa na wɔama saa mmɔdenbɔ yi ayɛ kɛse denam: - Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ internet so ɔsatu anaa nnwuma a wɔde wɔn adwene asi so sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ pene ne ahobammɔ ho nkuran, ne nneɛma anaa nsɛm a ɛfata a wɔde bɛma wɔn atipɛnfo. - Nsɛm a Wɔde Ma: Nsɛm a wɔde bɛma internet so nhyiamu ne nnwuma a ɛfa wɔn nhyehyɛɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa pene ne ahobammɔ ho, ne nkɔsoɔ anaa nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ baabi a ɛhia. - Nhumu a Wɔtrɛw mu: Nhumu a wɔbɛtrɛw mu wɔ nhwɛso pa a ɛfa akwan anaa nnwuma a wɔde pene so ho denam sohyial media, blog, anaa intanɛt so akwan foforo so de ahyɛ wɔn a wogye tom kɛse ne mmoa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mede deodorant anaa antiperspirant di dwuma berɛ a merebu mensa na emu deɛ awɔhe na ɛyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de deodorant ne antiperspirant nyinaa adi dwuma wɔ berɛkro a worebu wonsa de aboa ate mfifire ne nka bɔne so. Sɛdea wɔbɛyi baako ni: Deodorant: Deodorants ko nka bɔne sane so kum mmoawa a wɔde nka bɔne ba. Pɛ deodorant a wopɛ ne pampan. Nnuro a ɛko tia mfifire: antiperspirants kura aluminium nneɛma a esi mfifire kwan na ɛte mfifire so. Wɔsan nso wɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ deodorant mu. Yi antiperspirant sɛ woyɛ obiaa mfifire tae te wo paa a. Nneɛma a wɔaka abom: Nneɛma no bi di dwuma a Deodorant ne antiperspirant edi no nyinaa bi. Fa ankatwade ne nson di dwuma sedeɛ yɛyɛ no mpɔtam anaa sɛ yɛn ankasa deɛ mu sima bɛyɛ du dekɔ pem du nnum so ansa woadware. Wora a honam: Sɛ wowɔ honam ani mu haw a, yi deodorant anaa antiperspirant a wato din sɛ "hypoallergenic" anaa "ma honam ani a ɛyɛ mmerɛ." Fa gu so yie: Fa deodorant anaa antiperspirant fa di wo ho nni,gu honam ani a awo so. Twɛn simma kakraa bi ma ɛnwo ansa na woasiesie wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm te sɛ nyinsɛn ho nnuro, STI ano sie, ne nyinsɛn ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow taa di nsɛm te sɛ nyinsɛn ne STI ano sie, ne nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw ho dwuma denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde ma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma, ne sɛnea etu mpɔn ho no so. Wɔsan nso ka nsɛmti a ɛfa STI anosie ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa, ne nkitahodi a wɔne ahokafo di. Bio nso, CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi asusuw nyinsɛn akwan horow ho, a awofoyɛ, adoption, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho, na wɔde nsɛm a ɛfa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmoa a ɛfa ho a wobenya ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ awofo di wɔ boa a wɔboa mmabun ma wonya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ hɔ ne sɛnea wobenya bi. Fa Nsɛm Ma: Kyɛ nkitahodi ho nsɛm ma mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo. Ma wɔn akwankyerɛ: Sɛ mmabun no pɛ a, ka wɔn ho kɔ beaeɛ a wɔne nnuruyɛfoɔ ahyia no, anaa boa wɔn na wɔnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata na wɔatumi akɔ. Ahintasɛm: Hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun no te aseɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔnya akwahosan mu mmoa a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo na obiara nnante nka nnkyerɛ afoforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa ba sɛ obi mu duru bɛkɔ soro bere a yɛadu mpanyin afe so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛyɛ ade a ɛwɔ sɛ wo mu bɛyɛ duru bere a woadu mpanyin so. Wo nipadua no refa nsakrae pii mu, a nea ɛka ho ne nyin a ɛyɛ ntɛm ntɛm, ntini a enyin, ne srade a ɛsan kyekyɛ. Eyi betumi ama wo mu duru ayɛ kɛse, titiriw wɔ w’asen, wo srɛ, ne wo yafunu ho. Kae sɛ ɛsono obiara nipadua, na sɛ obi mu duru yɛ kɛse wɔ ne mmabunbere mu a, ɛyɛ onyin  a ɛfata na ɛyɛ. Sɛ wudi aduan pa na wokɔ so yɛ nnam a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woanya apɔwmuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ kokoamu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ kokoam afi apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, abusua nhyehyɛe ayaresabea ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow hɔ. Saa mmeae yi de kokoam sɔhwɛ dwumadie ma, na ɛhwɛ ma wɔyɛ kokoamsɛm ne adwempa wɔ sɔhwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie ama LGBTQ+ ankorankoro a wɔrepere wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛwom sɛ LGBTQ+ nhyia wɔ Ghana deɛ, nanso afotufoɔ ne nneɛma a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛnya bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa obiara a ɔwɔ adwenemyareɛ a ɛfa nna ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi adi akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den no mu, a nea ɛka ho ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ berɛ a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ, nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, ne ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobedi akyi?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ, ayarefo a wɔde wɔn kɔ, ne ayarefo a wɔde wɔn kɔ mmeae ahorow adi dwuma de ahwehwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ahwɛ wɔn adansedi nkrataa mu, na wɔakenkan ayarefo nsusuwii anaa adansedi nkrataa. Wobetumi afa intanɛt so nhyehyɛe a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm, mobile apps, anaa telefon so frɛ a wɔde kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so ayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de akɔhwɛ, a wobetumi apaw bere a wɔde bɛkɔ a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne nkaebɔ ahorow. Ebia nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma obi a wobenya no bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔ kɔmputa so anaa nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔ krataa so, a wobetumi ahyɛ no ma wɔ nnurutɔnbea ahorow anaasɛ wɔde amena denam nnwuma a wɔde mena so. Ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobedi akyi no hwehwɛ sɛ mmabun di nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so, kɔ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn akyi, wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hu yare sɛnea wɔkamfo kyerɛ no, na wɔka nea ɛhaw wɔn anaa nsakrae biara a ɛba wɔn akwahosan tebea mu no kyerɛ wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahobammɔ anaa akwankyerɛ foforo bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa kokoamsɛmu ho wɔ telehealth anaa abɛɛfo ntetan so apomoden ho dwumadie mu?
answer_twi_source: Telehealth ne abɛɛfo ntetan so apomoden ho dwumadie taa wɔ ahobanbɔ anaa akwankyerɛ foforɔ a ɛfa kokoamsɛmu ho. Ebia eyinom bi ne akwan a ahobammɔ wom a wɔfa so di nkitaho, data a wɔde sie, ne kokoamu nsɛm ho mmara te sɛ GDPR Data Protection right ne CCPA kokoamu hokwan a wodi so Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ kokoamusɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ hɔ ansa na wɔde telehealth anaa  abɛɛfo ntetan anaa intanɛt so nnwuma adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm pii afa nipadua ho adesua ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet ne Apps: Planned Parenthood (plannedparenthood.org) Sex, Etc. (sexetc.org) Scarleteen (scarleteen.com) Mpɔtam Hɔ Akwahosan Asoɛe: ma nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nkɔmmɔdie. Sukuu Nhyehyɛe. Mpɔtam Hɔ Asoɛe: Ebinom yɛ nhyiam ahorow ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow. Nhoma ne Nwoma: "Ɛyɛ Ade a Ɛyɛ Pɛpɛɛpɛ" a Robie H. Harris kyerɛwee "Akwankyerɛ a ɛbɛma woanya no" a Paul Joannides kyerɛwee Hotlines ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Ɔman Nna mu Akwahosan Hotline: 1-800-232-4636 Mmabun Akwahosan ne Yiyedi: teenhealthandwellness.com
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia amammerɛ mu nneyɛe anaa gyidi ahorow a ɛbetumi ɛnya nsunsuansoa bɔne wɔ nea efi mmabunbere mu ba no?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Fa nokwasɛm ne adanse kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho ne afoforo wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nneyɛe anaa gyidi ahorow bi mu ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne abusua mufo, mpanyimfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bɔ nkɔmmɔ a obu wom de da nea ɛhaw adwene adi na hyɛ akwan foforo a ahoɔden wom ho nkuran. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Boa nnwuma anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wobedi nneyɛe a epira ho dwuma na wɔkamfo amammerɛ mu atenka  wɔ akwaahosan ne nhomasua mu. Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Ma wo ho ne w’atipɛnfo tumi ma wogye gyinapɛn ahorow a epira ho kyim na wokasa tia bere a wohyɛ obu a wɔde ma amammerɛ ahorow ho nkuran no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan a wɔfa so si nyinsɛn ano betumi abɔ obi ho ban afi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho?
answer_twi_source: Kɔndɔm nkutoo na ɛbɔ ho ban yiye fi nyinsɛn ne STI nyinaa ho. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɔ wo ho ban wɔ STI ho koraa a, fa kɔndɔm di dwuma daa na ɛfata bere biara a wobɛda no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ mewɔ nna mu akɔnnɔ pɔtee bi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛhwehwɛ na m'ate me nna mu akɔnnɔ ase?
answer_twi_source: Sexual orientation; nna mu akɔnnɔ; yɛ akɔnnɔ pɔtee bi obi wɔ afoforɔ. Sɛ wobɛte wei ase yiye a, ɛsɛ sɛ wohu sɛdeɛ w'atenka teɛ, ne wo nea pɛ. Dwen wei nyina ho yiye na hu obia woyɛ. Nna mu akɔnnɔ tumi yɛ 'fluid' sɛ nsuo, na etumi sesa. Nneɛma te sɛ books, websites ne mmoa ku 'support groups' betumi ama wo hi nimdiɛ. Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna mu nyarewa "STI" ahorow bɛn na wɔtaa yɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, na dɛn ne saa nyarewa yi ho sɛnkyerɛnne?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nyarewa "STI" ahorow a wɔtaa sɔ hwɛ no bi ne "chlamydia", akisikuru, ne "HIV".
