Saa nyarewa yi ho sɛnkyerɛnne betumi ayɛ soronko, nanso ebetumi aba sɛ: - Nsu a ɛyɛ soronko a efi ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu - Ɛyaw anaa ɔhyew a ɛba bere a ɔreto nsu - Awotwaa mu a ɛyɛ yaw anaasɛ ɛyɛ abufuw - Akuru, akisikuru, anaa akisikuru a ɛwɔ awotwaa mu - Ntini a ɛyɛ yaw anaasɛ ɛho ahonhon (wɔ mmarima mu) - Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛte sɛ atiridii (wɔ HIV yare no mfiase)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne tebea horow bi a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi anya atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa atenka ahorow a ɛbɔ abira a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, anaa awo a wɔpaw ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho betumi aboa wɔn ma wɔate saa haw yi ase na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa atenka ahorow a ɛbɔ abira a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe, nyɔnkofa nkitahodie, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, anaa awoɔ ho gyinasei ho wɔ tebea horow te sɛ fekubɔ mu nhyiam, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkɛntɛnso a wohyia mu. Nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho betumi aboa wɔn ma wɔate saa haw yi ase na wɔadi ho dwuma wɔ baabi a wɔbɛma wɔahwehwɛ wɔn nsusuwii ne wɔn atenka mu, asusuw nea ebetumi afi nneɛma ahorow a wɔpaw mu aba ho, na wɔasusuw sɛnea wɔn nneyɛe ne wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn botae ahorow hyia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na akwahosan ho nnwuma bi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no bo yɛ den anaasɛ mmabun ntumi ntua?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no bɛtumi ayɛ nea ne boɔ yɛ den anaasɛ ɛnyɛ den mma mmabun ɛnam nneɛma ahodoɔ nti: Nnwinnadeɛ titire ne aduruyɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔhia ma akwan anaa ayaresa bi. Ɛka a ɛbata nhwehwɛmu, nkɔso, ne nnuru a wɔde yɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne awo ho mfiridwuma ho mmara a wɔhyehyɛ ho. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔatete wɔn wɔ akwahosan ho ahiade pɔtee a ɛfa mmabun ho a wonni hɔ pii, na ɛma wɔbɔ ka kɛse wɔ ɔhwɛ titiriw ho. Nneɛma a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe mu te sɛ gua so akansi, akwahosan nhyehyɛe a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a mfaso wɔ so a ɛde sikasɛm mu mfaso di kan sen nea wobetumi atua ne nea wobetumi anya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia nsɛm a ɛmfata anaa ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho bere a merehwehwɛ Internet so no a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhyia nsɛm a ɛmfata anaa ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ Intanɛt so a, to wɛbsaet krataafa no mu anaa twe wo ho fi nsɛm no ho ntɛm ara. Susu ho sɛ wobɛbɔ emu nsɛm no ho amanneɛ akyerɛ wɛbsaet no so ahwɛfo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so, titiriw sɛ ɛto mpɔtam hɔfo akwankyerɛ anaa dwumadie ho nhyehyɛeɛ so a. Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka wo suahu no ho asɛm, titiriw sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ nsɛm a wuhyiae no haw wo a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara no kyerɛkyerɛ pene a wɔpene so wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho nsɛm mu, na nneɛma bɛn na wosusuw ho bere a wɔrekyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so anaa daabi ?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so, sɛnea mmara kyerɛkyerɛ mu no, kyerɛ apam a wofi wɔn pɛ mu, wɔde nimdeɛ, na wɔde anigye pene so sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu. Nneɛma a wosusuw ho bere a wɔrekyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛpene so no bi ne: Nhyɛso, ahunahuna, anaa ahoɔden a wɔde di dwuma de nya nna mu mmara sodi a ɛwɔ hɔ. Tumi a nnipa no wɔ sɛ ɔbɛpene so, a osusuw nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wadi, adwene mu tumi, asabow, ne tumi a ɛsakra ho. Nkitahodi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so, baabi a afã horow no nyinaa da ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu pefee na wɔde nsiyɛ adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun bɛtumi afa so akasa atia awo ho ntɛnkyea ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa atia awoɔ mu ntɛnkyea ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam ɔsɔretia ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ, adesrɛ a wɔde bɛsrɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe mu, ɔmanfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nne a wɔde to nkyɛn a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, ne mpɔtam hɔfo nkɔmmɔbɔ ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsoeɛ bɛn na ɛda mmarima ne mmaaa awoɔ akwaa ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima: barima dua, hurutu, hwewa (barima ho nsuo). Mmaa: Etwɛ ba, awo nkesua, awodeɛ, akosua kumaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn atorɔ anaa anansesɛm ahorow bɛn na wɔtaa nya wɔ mmara  ɛfa awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua ne nhumu so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atorɔ adwene  anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ mmara mu afã ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun ho no betumi ayɛ gyidi ahorow a ɛne sɛ bere nyinaa hwehwɛ sɛ mmofra nkumaa hwehwɛ awofo pene na wɔahwɛ wɔn, sɛ mmara bara nnwuma bi ma mmerante ne mmabaa, anaasɛ ɛyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asɛyɛde sɛ wɔda kokoam nsɛm adi kyerɛ awofo a mmabun mpene so. Wobetumi adi saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi ho dwuma wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu mmɔdenbɔ a ɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fa mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho, hyɛ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya kokoam hwɛ ne pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran, na ɛkasa tia animtiaabu anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa mmabun awo akwahosan ho no so. Ɛnam nhumu ne ntease a yɛbɛma akɔ soro so no, yebetumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya mmoa ne ɔhwɛ a wohia na ama wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aguade ho dawurubɔfo de kasa, mfonini, ne nneɛma a wɔde aniwa hu di dwuma de nsɛm a ɛfa nna, nipadua mfonini, ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow ho ma?
answer_twi_source: Kasa: Kasa a ɛkanyan adwene, nsɛm a wɔka, anaa nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma de ka nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma anaa nnwuma ho, na mpɛn pii no wosi mfaso horow so dua anaasɛ wodi ahobammɔ a enni hɔ ho dwuma. Mfonini: Mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ anigye anaa mfonini ahorow a ɛkanyan anigye a wɔde twetwe adwene na ɛkanyan atenka mu mmuae, na mpɛn pii no wɔde nipadua mfonini ne nna ho mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ nea ɛfata anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nokware na ɛba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ebetumi aha mmarima awo?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii betumi aka mmarima awo, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mfe a wɔadi: Nkwaboaa su betumi akɔ fam bere a obi nyin no. Akwahosan tebea horow: Ayaresa mu tebea horow bi betumi aka mmadwoa a wɔyɛ anaa awo. Asetra kwan a wobɛpaw: Sigaretnom, nsa a wɔnom boro so, ne nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa betumi aka awo. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia: Sɛ obi nya awuduru anaa nnuru bi a, ebetumi aka mmadwoa akwahosan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na afotufo, nteteefo, ne adwumayɛ ho afotufo betumi adi wɔ mmaabun adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ, akannifo nkɔso, ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔboa no mu?
answer_twi_source: Afotufoɔ, nteteefoɔ, ne adwumayɛ ho afotufoɔ bɛtumi aboa mmabun adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ ne akannifoɔ nkɔsoɔ denam: Akwankyerɛ ne afotuo a wɔde bɛma: Wɔde nteteeɛ a wɔde ma obiara, adwumayɛbea, ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛma de aboa mmabun ma wɔasiesie adwumayɛ ho adwene, ayɛ adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ, na wɔad ɔhaw ho dwuma. Nimdeɛ ne nkitahodi a wɔbɛkyɛ: Mmabun ne nnwuma mu abenfo, nnwumayɛfo a wodi yie, ne wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ ahokafo a wɔbɛka abom de atrɛw wɔn nimdeɛ, hokwan ahorow, ne nneɛma a wobenya mu. Tebea a ɛboa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Mmeae a wɔbɛbɔ ama atipɛnfo adesua, adwumayɛkuw, ne nkitahodi a mmabun betumi asesa adwene, asua biribi afi wɔn ho wɔn ho suahu mu, na wɔanya ahotoso wɔ wɔn adwumayɛ tumi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn dijitaal nsɛm no yɛ nokware, wotumi gye di, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma adwene ahorow, amammerɛ, ne nipasu ahorow, titiriw bere a wɔde ma atiefo pii wɔ Intanɛt so no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae pii mu nokwasɛm, fa nsɛm a wotumi gye di, na wɔka nsɛm a wonya fi mmeae a ɛfata na ama wɔakɔ so ayɛ nokware na wɔagye adi. Amammerɛ mu nsɛm nketenkete ne adwene ahorow ho nkate ho hia kɛse; ɛsɛ sɛ adebɔfo de wɔn ho hyɛ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ntetee mu na wɔhwehwɛ mmuae fi ankorankoro a wogyina hɔ ma mmusua ahorow hɔ. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu no hwɛ atiefo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no so na wɔyɛ wɔn ade wɔ nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ so, wɔkɔ so bue wɔn ani ma nkɔmmɔbɔ na wodi nea ɛhaw adwene anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ biara ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ kokoam a m’awofo nnim (egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara so)?
answer_twi_source: Ebia akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so asiw nyinsɛn ano wɔ kokoam a egyina akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo no so: Ghana akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow: Wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ma, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne kokoam nyinsɛn ano aduru ma mmabun. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wo ne wɔn bedi nkitaho tee abisa wɔn nhyehyɛe ahorow ho asɛm. ahyehyɛde afoforo te sɛ Mariestops, PPAG nso de nyinsɛn ano aduru ma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yareɛ anaa sɛ apɔmdensɛm bɛn na ɛtumi si awoɔ ahoban mu kwan?
answer_twi_source: Mogya a abɔ ntoa. Mogya mmorosoɔ a wontumi nsɔ ano.Deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no sɛ 'migraines' Ti-paeɛ. Ɛne adɔkotafoɔ nkasa anaa sɛ susu ho kyerɛ adɔkɔtafoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ dɛmdi ho no bi?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm ne nokwasɛm bi ni: Atosɛm: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no ntumi nyɛ hwee. Nokwasɛm: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ tumi ne talente ahorow pii. Atosɛm: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ binary (a wɔadi dɛm/ɛnyɛ dɛmdi). Nokwasɛm: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm wɔ hɔ wɔ akwan horow so, na osuahu ahorow gu ahorow kɛse. Atosɛm: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ntumi ntra ase a abotɔyam wom. Nokwasɛm: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm betumi adu wɔn botae ahorow ho na wɔatra ase anigye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a metumi  de adi adwennwen ne dadwen a, ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ho dwuma? (akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, journaling, ɔpanyin a wogye no di a wɔne no bɛkasa)
answer_twi_source: Akwan a Wɔfa so Gye Ahome: Ahomegye a emu dɔ, ntini a ɛma obi dwo nkakrankakra, ne nsusuwii betumi aboa ma wɔadi adwennwen ne dadwen so. Wo nsusuwii ne wo atinka a wobɛda no adi no betumi ayɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so adi nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ho dwuma. Ɔpanyin a Wogye No Di a Wobɛkasa: Sɛ woka wo haw ahorow kyerɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa oduruyɛfo bi a, ebetumi ama woanya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ aware, awo nhyehyɛe, ne nyinsɛn ho nya mmabun nna ne awo ho gyinaesi so nsusuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ aware, awo nhyehyɛe, ne nyinsɛn ho nya mmabun SRH gyinaesi so nsunsuanso. Atetesɛm mu akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa aware ne mma awo ho no betumi ahyɛ mmabun mawɔayɛ aware ne nyinsɛn ntɛm, bere a nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya no betumi asiw wɔn awo ho nhyehyɛe ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna mu anigye ho no bi ne dɛn, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm no bi ne sɛ, ɛyɛ nhyɛ sɛ wodi nna mu agorɛ wɔ mpenatweɛ mu. Wei ɛɔnnyɛ nokware. Wo ne wo hokafoɔ betumi adi dɔ mapa sɛ moanni nna mpo a, ɛnnsɛe hwee koraa. Bi so ne sɛ, kwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obia fa di nna mu agorɔ. Nokwaresɛm no ne sɛ, nea ɛyɛ obi no, ɛnnyɛ mma obi. Obia ne nea ɛbɛboa no. Binom so ka sɛ, mmerɛ obia ho besan no 'orgasm' no na ahia paa. Nanso nna mu akɔnnɔ deɛ, obia deɛ yɛ soronko, na orgasm betumi asi wɔ kwan pii so. Sɛ biribi kyer w'adwene fa nna mu agodie a, hu apɔwmuden mu mpaninfo na ne wɔn di ho nkɔmmɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa kasa ho nsusuwii bi wɔ hɔ a wosusuw ho wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe  mu de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe pii de amammerɛ ne kasa mu nkabom di kan de hwɛ hu sɛ nnipa ahorow ahorow betumi anya nnwuma. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ: Adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛfa wɔn a wɔda mpɔtam a wɔsom wɔn no amammerɛ ne kasa ahorow adi. Kasa nkyerɛaseɛ dwumadie a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro a ebia wɔnka kasa a ɛwɔ hɔ titire no. Nneɛma a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔbɛhyehyɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛfa amammerɛ ho na ayɛ nea ɛfa atinka ho. Dwumadie ne dwumadie a ɛfata amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma mpɔtam ahodoɔ gyinapɛn ne atetesɛm a wɔde bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ho na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya aduruyɛ mu mmoa a ɛho hia na wɔde wɔn akɔ ma wɔn bere a wohyia ɔhaw bi a ɛfa wɔn nna anaa awo akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ho wɔ akwanya ahorow a wɔwɔ ho asɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn, nsɛm a wobebisa, na wɔada wɔn ahiade ahorow adi pefee akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo no so. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ hɔ sɛ wohyia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya ayaresa mmoa wɔ ɔhaw bi mu a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma wɔpene so wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nkitahodi mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔ pene a wɔpene so wɔ anim ne anim nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw a ɛma wɔpene so wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nkitahodi mu no te sɛ nea ɛwɔ anim ne anim nkitahodi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Mpaemuka a Ofi ne pɛ mu yɛ: Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no fi ne pɛ mu pene so sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ nkitahodi no mu a ɔrenhyɛ no anaasɛ ɔnyɛ nsakrae. - Nteaseɛ: Afanu mmienu no nyinaa wɔ nteaseɛ a ɛda adi pefee wɔ deɛ wɔrepene so na wɔpene so wɔ nimdeɛ ne wɔn pɛ mu. - Mpene a ɛkɔ so: Wobetumi atwe pene bere biara, na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bu wɔn ho wɔn ho gyinaesi ne ahye. - Nkitahodi a emu da hɔ: Nkitahodi a etu mpɔn ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ afã horow no nyinaa te wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene, wɔn akɔnnɔ, ne wɔn ahye ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina nyiyimu tia dɛmdifoɔ SRH hokwan ano?  Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so de nsɛntwerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no bɛyɛ adwuma atia nyiyimu na yɛkasa ama nna ne awoɔ akwanma ama wɔn a wɔresi sɔ a sɛbi wadi dem?
answer_twi_source: Kasa pefee (di nokorɛ). Kyerɛw deɛ asisi no (nsɛm a wɔakora so). Hwehwɛ mmoa (nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so anaa OPDs).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nsɛm anaa nyansahyɛ ahorow ama de ama asasesin a wobetumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de nsɛm anaa nyansahyɛ ama de ama asasesin mu kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, anaa afotuo agyinatukuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si akwahosan ho dwumadie ne mmabun akwahosan so. Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ayaresabea ahodoɔ, anaa aban nnwumakuo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔka wɔn suahunu ne wɔn adwene a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔsoɔ. Mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfa akwahosan ho a wɔbɛnya ho nkitahodie na wɔama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛseɛ denam mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom bɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban so. Intanɛt so akwan anaa sohyial media a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ nsɛm, osuahu, ne nyansahyɛ ahorow akyerɛ atiefo a wɔdɔɔso na wɔama nkurɔfo ate hia a ehia sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ anim ma mmabun no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nnwuma kɔ so yɛ nea wobetumi ayɛ wɔ wimu nsakraeɛ mmerɛ nyina mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ sɛ SRH dwumadie no bɛtumi ayɛ adwuma wɔ ntɛmpɛ a ɛfa wim tebea ho no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ ntɛm ara, nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔbɛdi kan de asi hɔ, wɔbɛtete apɛwmuden adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ atoyerɛnkyɛm ho ahosiesie mu, wɔde akwahosan ho mfiridwuma a wɔde fa telefon so bedi dwuma, na wɔne mpɔtamfoɔ adi nkitaho de ahunu na wɔadi SRH ahiadeɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mahwehwɛ na mate amammerɛ ne ankorankoro adwene a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ase?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ Mmeae: Mpɔtam pii wɔ amammerɛ mmeae anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde nneɛma ne nhyiam ahorow ma. Nhomasua Wɛbsaet: Wɛbsaet te sɛ UNESCO, Planned Parenthood, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ pɔtee bi ho de nhomasua ho nneɛma ma. Nhomakorabea ahorow: Nhomakorabea ahorow taa wɔ nhoma, video, ne intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho. Atipɛnfo Akuw: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ atipɛnfo akuw ahorow mu a, ebetumi ama woahu adwene ahorow na ama woanya ntease. Amammerɛ Nhyiamu: Kɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a ɛtwe adwene si amammerɛ ahodoɔ ne mmabunbereɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ so. Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Sukuu ahorow bi de nhyehyɛe anaa adesua ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ma. Mpɔtam hɔ Nsɛm a Ɛsisi: Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a esisi, afahyɛ ahorow, anaa amammerɛ afahyɛ ahorow mu na woasua ade ankasa. Afotufoɔ anaa Afotufoɔ: Mpanyimfo, afotufoɔ, anaa sukuu afotufoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama. Intanɛt so Nhyiamu: Kɔka intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa nkɔmmɔdie akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si amammerɛ ahodoɔ ne mmabunbereɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo m’ankasa apomuden ho ahiade ne nea m’ani gye ho wɔ bere a yɛreyɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho no?
answer_twi_source: Siesie Wo Ho: Di kan kyerɛw nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wo to hɔ na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wobɛka biribiara ho asɛm. Di Nkitaho Pii: Ka wo nsusuwii ne w'atenka kyerɛ w’apomuden ho yaresafo no pefee. Bisa Nsɛm: Sɛ biribi mu nna hɔ a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛbisa nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaa nsɛm pii. Kyɛ Nea Wopɛ: Ma nea ɔhwɛ wo no nhu sɛ wowɔ ayaresa akwan anaa akwan horow a wopɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhyehyɛeyɛfo, adwumawuranom, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi adi wɔ adwuma hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔabɔ ho ban no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe no betumi ahyɛ adwumayɛ ho mmara a ɛbɔ adwumayɛfo a wonnii mfe aduonu hokwan ahorow ho ban na wɔadi so, ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhwɛ mmara so, na wɔakyekyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛhwɛ sɛnea wɔhyɛ mmara so na wɔhwɛ sɛnea wodi mmara so. Adwumawuranom betumi adi adwumayɛ gyinapɛn ahorow so, ama adwumayɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom, akatua a ɛfata, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔso wɔ adwumayɛfo mu, na wɔde akwan horow a wɔfa so di anwiinwii ho dwuma a wɔde bedi adwumam nsɛm ho dwuma asi hɔ. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi de adwumayɛfoɔ hokwan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ahyɛ sukuu adesua mu, de adwumayɛ ho akwankyerɛ ama, na wɔama adwumayɛ ho nteteeɛ anaa adwuma-adesua nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma wɔte adwuma mu hokwan ne asɛdeɛ ho nteaseɛ ho nkuran. Ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi akamfo nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ, de mmara mu mmoa ne mmoa dwumadie ama, ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ adwumayɛfoɔ hokwan a wɔbu so ho, na wɔama mmabun adwumayɛfoɔ tumi denam nwomasua ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow de asetena mu atɛntrenee nnyinasosɛm ahorow, nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛko tia nhyɛso, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho bom de ma mmabun tumi ma wɔkasa tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu animhwɛ, nyiyim, ne nhyehyɛe mu ntɛnkyea wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu Atɛntrenee Nnyinasosɛm a Wɔde Bɛka Abom: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow de asetena mu atɛntrenee nnyinasosɛm ahorow, nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛko tia nhyɛso, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho bom de ma mmabun tumi ma wɔkasa tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu animhwɛ, nyiyim, ne nhyehyɛe mu ntɛnkyea wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri. Ɛdenam nne ahorow a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wɔde besi mfinimfini, adwene a ɛkasa tia a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne tema ne biakoyɛ a wɔma wonya so no, nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ma mmabun nya nnwinnade a wɔde bɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu na wɔakamfo asetra mu nsakrae akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya tema ne adwene a wɔde fa nneɛma ho nimdeɛ denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ so, na ama wɔate adwene ne osuahu ahorow a egu ahorow wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo nkitahodi mu ase, na wɔabu wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya tema ne adwene a wɔfa ho nimdeɛ denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ so denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a egyina hɔ ma adwene ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne nipasu ahorow mu. Sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm betumi anya ankorankoro a wofi amammerɛ anaa asetena mu tebea horow so nkɛntɛnso no ho a wosusuw. Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu kyɛfa a wobenya ne mpɔtam hɔfo kyɛfa dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ tema ne ntease a wonya wɔ afoforo adwene ho nkuran. Nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma a ɛhyɛ tema ne asetra mu nhumu ho nkuran, te sɛ abasɛm a wɔka ho nhyehyɛe a ɛtwe adwene si nne ne osuahu ahorow so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛeyɛfo, sikasɛm ho mmarahyɛfo, ne nkɔso adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ama tebea a ɛbɛma sikasɛm nketewa ne nnwuma nketewa nkɔso ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmabun so no ayɛ yiye?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ, ne nkɔsoɔ adwumakuo bɛtumi ayɛ tebea a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ adwuma denam: Mmara nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa a wɔde besi hɔ: Mmara a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a ɛbɛma sikasɛm asoɛeɛ nketewa (MFIs) ne nnwuma nketewa adwumayɛ ayɛ mmerɛ berɛ a wɔhwɛ ma adetɔfoɔ ahobanbɔ ne sikasɛm mu ahotɔ. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne adwumayɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛma: Sikasɛm ho adesua a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ho de ama mmabun ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ sikasɛm ho adwene ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ ho no ayɛ kɛse. Nkannyan a wɔde ma: Towtua ho nkuranhyɛ, mmoa, anaa mmoa a wɔde ma MFI ne nnwuma nketewa a wɔde wɔn ani si mmabun a wɔyɛ adwuma so anaasɛ wɔsom mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa yiye. Nkɔmmɔdie a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: MFI ahodoɔ, aban nnwumakuo, ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne ankorankoro nnwumakuo ntam nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ de anya nneɛma ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun adwumayɛ ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nhyehyɛeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn  anansesɛm anaa atorɔ  a ɛfa afotu adwuma a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: "Nnipa a wɔwɔ ɔhaw ahorow a emu yɛ den nkutoo na wohia afotu." Nokwasɛm: Afotu so wɔ mfaso ma obiara a ɔrehwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ, ɛmfa ho sɛnea nneɛma a ɛhaw no no mu yɛ den. Atosɛm: "Afotufo bebu me atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ me nea ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ." Nokwasɛm: Afotufo de tebea a ɛnyɛ atemmu na ɛboa ma, na wɔne wo bom yɛ adwuma de hwehwɛ nneɛma a wubetumi apaw mu na woasi gyinae ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow hyia. Atosɛm: "Afotu yɛ adwenemyare ho nsɛm nkutoo, ɛnyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm." Nokwasɛm: Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi adi nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow pii ho dwuma, efi abusuabɔ ho nsɛm so kosi gyinaesi ahorow a wosiw siw nyinsɛn ano so kosi sɛnea wogyina nna mu yareɛ (STI) a wobehu no ano so. Nea ɛka saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi ho dwuma a wobedi ho ne sɛ wɔde nsɛm a edi mu ne awerɛhyem bɛma wɔ afotu adwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no su ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ho, a sika a wɔde ma, mmoa, ne adwuma a wɔde ma ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa nhomasua a ɛwɔ hɔ ne `adesuade yɛtwa so ka no STEM ntetee hokwan ahorow ho denam akwan horow so. Eyinom bi ne sukuu afotufo, adwumayɛbea ahorow, aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow. Wobetumi nso de nneɛma te sɛ wɛbsaet, nhomawa, sohyial media, ne nsɛm ho nhyiam ahorow adi dwuma de asua sika a wɔde ma, mmoa, ne adwuma a wɔde ma a nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, adwumawuranom, ne wɔn a wɔde adwumayɛ ho ntetee ma de ma ho ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne masturbation na apɔwmuden wom?
answer_twi_source: Masturbation yɛ ɔkwan a ɔbaako fa so ma ne ho sane no. Ɛyɛ nna mu nkɔso ne nhwehwɛmu fã a ɛyɛ daa anaa ɛnyɛ hwee (ɛka abrabɔ ho), na ɛde apɔwmuden ma nnipa a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa. Nea enti a ɛyɛ apɔwmuden ni: Adwennwen ano aduru: Ebetumi aboa wo ma woagye w’ahome. Wo ho a wubehu: Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a wobɛfa so asua wo nipadua ne nea ɛyɛ wo dɛ ho ade. Nna mu dwumadi a ɛfata: Ebetumi aboa wo ma woate wo nna ho mmuae ase na wo ho atɔ wo kɛse sɛ wo ne ɔhokafo bi bɛbɛn akyiri yi. Mfomso biara nni masturbation ho bere tenten a: Wɔyɛ no kokoam na ɛnhaw wo da biara da asetra. Ɛnyɛ nguamansɛm a ɛkyerɛ basabasayɛ anaa tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ na ɛredi dwuma. Ɛnyɛ sɛ worebu w’ani agu w’asetra mu nneɛma afoforo a ɛho hia te sɛ nnamfofa, sukuu dwumadi, anaa nneɛma a wode gye w’ani so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aman de amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ASRR ahorow ho di dwuma? (Ɔman nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow no) .
answer_twi_source: Aman no kyerɛ amanaman ntam nhyehyeɛ ase kɔ adeyɛ mu nam: Ɔman Nhyehyɛeɛ: Saa nhyehyeɛ yi kyerɛ sɛdeɛ aban no bɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ASRH hokwan ahodoɔ ho ban. Dwumadi ahorow: Aban nhyehyɛe ahorow de nhomasua, akwahosan ho nnwuma, ne mmoa ma mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsusuansoɔ bɛn na nnuane a yɛdi debrɛ nsabuo mu apɔmden ne nkwammoa a ɛwɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Aduan pa di dwuma titiriw wɔ brayɛ akwahosan ne nkwammoa a ɛwɔ mmabun mu.Aduannuru a ɛfata a wodi no boa ma brayɛ no kɔ so daa, ɛboa ma ɛma nipadua no mu ahoɔdennuru dodow yɛ yiye, na ɛtew asiane horow te sɛ nsabuo a ɛnkɔ so daa, amenorrhea ( brayɛ a enni hɔ) ne ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ebetumi de nna mu ɔhaw aba mmabun mu, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkwammoaa a atɔkyema kakra 'hormonal imbalance'. Nnuru (te sɛ nnuru a ekum adwenemhaw).Kɔannkɔ nyarewa  (te sɛ asikreyareɛ 'diabetes'). Nnuro bɔne so ka ho. Adwene mu Nneɛma a Ɛde Ba: Adwennwen, dadwen, anaa adwenemhaw. Nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm. Ahodwiriw anaa osuahu ahorow a atwam. Abusuabɔ mu haw ahorow. Ayaresa: Afotuo boa. Nnuro (te sɛ Viagra a wɔde ma ɔbarima nna mu ɔhaw). Asetena mu nsakraeɛ (di aduane a ahoɔden wom, tentenne w'apɔw mu daa). Nhomasua a ɛfa nna mu ayaresa ne nkitahodie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho, te sɛ pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano, nipadua mfonini a wotumi gyina ano, ne LGBTQ+ ananmusifo, di nkitaho, na mɛyɛ dɛn de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ aka nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nsɛmti ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no twam denam: Mpene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ boa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ pene a wɔpene so ho mfonini ahorow mu yiye wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, hu nkɔso a ɛyɛ papa ne nea ɛnyɛ papa na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa mfonini ahorow a edi mu wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun tumi hu na wɔkasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne asɛm a epira a ɛma mmonnaato amammerɛ kɔ so tra hɔ na ɛma wonya adwene pa wɔ pene ne abusuabɔ a obu wom ho. Nipadua mfonini a wotumi gyina ano: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun tumi sesa ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware na wɔhyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ho nkuran denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛboa ma wonya nipadua mfonini ho adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔhwehwɛ mu na wɔkasa tia no so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛka nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mu ho no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ nna ho su ne nneyɛe so, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ne ne yɛ a ɛfata ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a wodi wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho haw ne wɔn ahokyere ho dwuma pɔtee?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a wodi nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho haw ne ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma denam akwan horow so: Intanɛt so hwehwɛ: Wobetumi de nhwehwɛmu mfiri adi dwuma de ahwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ anaa intanɛt so atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti so. Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo: Mmabun betumi abisa wɔn apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, te sɛ nnuruyɛfo, ayarehwɛfo, anaa afotufo, sɛ wɔmma wɔn nyansahyɛ anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn nkɔ atipɛnfo akuw a wɔboa wɔn nkyɛn. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow: Mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa nna mu apɔwmuden ayaresabea ahorow betumi agye atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaasɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nsɛm bɛma. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow: Intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, sohyial media akuw, ne wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama a wɔde atipɛnfo mmoa ma wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo sika ne nneɛma a wɔbɛma akɔ soro de aboa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfo ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bedi nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo sika ne nneɛma a wɔbɛma akɔ soro de aboa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛbɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde di nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma denam hia a nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ho hia a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔn ankasa nsɛm anaa osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ de asi nsunsuanso a nnwuma a wɔboa no nya so dua, ne wɔn a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bedi nkitaho de sika a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nhyehyɛe ahorow no adi kan. Wobetumi nso de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo mu, de wɔn nsa ahyɛ krataa ase, na wɔakɔka akuw a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow so no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwene mu ndaho ɛfa yɛn ho hwe anidaho ne yɛn ho a yɛbɛgye atum?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu nsusuwii ma wuhu wo ho denam nkuranhyɛ a ɛhyɛ wo sɛ hwɛ w’adwene, wo atinka, ne wo nipadua mu atinka horow a wunsusuw ho no so. Ɛnam adwene a wode bedi dwuma so no, wubetumi anya wo ho ntease a emu dɔ, a w’ahoɔden, wo mmerɛwyɛ, ne wo nneyɛe ho nhyehyɛe ka ho. Wo ho a wugye tom no fi wo suahu ahorow a wode ayamye ne ayamhyehye gye tom mu, sen sɛ wobɛkasa atia wo ho anaasɛ wobɛkwati.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun betumi ne wɔn a wɔ ma ayaresa ne mmrahyɛfo ɛnnya nkitahodie sɛnea HIV ahobanmmɔ ne ayaresa aa ɛyɛ mmabun-adamfofa a aborɔfo frɛ no ́youth-friendly' ne ammamerɛ mu nkate?
answer_twi_source: Ma adwenkyerɛ wɔ wonya suahunu, edi mu bi wɔ afotow boyikuw, kasa ma nnwuma kɔ n'anim, na yɛ adwuma bɔm wɔ nkitahodie ahyehyɛde a wɔka no wɔ aborɔfo mu sɛ 'advocacy organizations'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama me hokafo de ne ho ahyɛ awo ho nhyehyɛeho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu na yɛabom asi gyinae wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano?
answer_twi_source: Wo Hokafo a Wobɛka Ho: Nkitahodi a Wobɛbue Mu: Fi ase ne wo hokafo no bɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware wɔ awo nhyehyɛe ho. Nhomasua a Wɔbom Yɛ: Mommom nkɔ awo nhyehyɛe ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow ase na moasua akwan horow a wobetumi afa so na moasi gyinae ahorow a ɛfata. Asɛyɛde a Wɔbom Yɛ: Si so dua sɛ abusua nhyehyɛe yɛ asɛyɛde a wɔbom yɛ ma ahokafo baanu no nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ no di nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mbaa ntam wɔ sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a mmaabun nya mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a wɔne ankorankoro adwumayɛkuo ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ no betumi adi nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam no ho dwuma denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a ɛma wonya sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ, a nhomasua, ntetee, adwumayɛ, ne adwumayɛ ka ho a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Wobetumi akasa ama mmarima ne mmea a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ aguadi mu nneyɛe mu, akasa atia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, na wɔaboa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so tumi ma wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mmeae a mmarima na wɔdɔɔso wɔ atetesɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmra kwan so ahobammɔ ahorow a wɔde ahwɛ ahu sɛ, mmabun benya ɔhwɛ a ayamhyehye wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn bere a wɔreyi nyinsɛn agu ne bere a woayi agu awei no?
answer_twi_source: Mmra kwan so ahobammɔ gu ahorow wɔ ɔman biara mu, nanso amansin pii wɔ mmra anaa akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔde hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun benya ɔhwɛ a ayamhyehye wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn bere a wɔreyi nyinsɛn agu ne bere a wɔayi agu akyi. Ebia eyinom bi ne ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, kokoamsɛm, animtiaabu, ne mmoa a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn adi afahyɛ na yɛasi so dua sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nnipa su ne nna ho nkyerekere a wɔ atwa yɛn ho ahyia no mu?
answer_twi_source: Eyi hyia wɔ Ghana mmra mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnuru a wɔde di dwuma nya mmabun adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ, abusuabɔ, ne asetra pa nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma betumi anya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ mmabun asetra mu nneɛma ahorow so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ: Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma betumi ama obi adwene so atew, akae ho haw, na adwene mu dwumadi asɛe, na ama wɔanya abasobɔde a ɛba fam ne adesua mu nkɔso. Abusuabɔ: Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma betumi ama abusuabɔ a ɛda wɔne abusuafo, nnamfo, ne atipɛnfo ntam no ayɛ basaa, na ɛde ntawntawdi, ntease a ɛnteɛ, ne nnipa a wɔbɛtew wɔn ho afi afoforo ho aba. Asetra pa: Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma betumi anya yiyedi, nkate fam akwahosan, ne asetra mu abotɔyam nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso bɔne, na ama wate afobu, aniwu, anaa ahonu nka. Ɛdenam nnuru a wɔde di dwuma a wodi ho dwuma ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn adesua atu mpɔn, ahyɛ abusuabɔ mu den, na wɔama wɔn asetra nyinaa ayɛ yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛka ɛhaw mmabun nyinsɛn ne awoɔ (maternal health), na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn asiw ano?
answer_twi_source: Nwomasua ne ayaresa. Sika tebea. Mmoa a wɔnnya. Akwansideɛ (nimdeɛ/sika/nyiyimu). Yɛbɛgyina ano te sɛ: Dahuruɔ a ɛfa nna mu nsɛm ho 'CSE', yɛbɛtew awo ka pii so, ne mmoa ma mmabun a wɔyinsɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na apɔwmuden ho ahwɛfoɔ betumi asusu apɔwmuden ho nimdeɛ ahiade a ɛwɔ ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no ho na wɔadi ho dwuma bere a wɔresusu nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Fa nsɛmmisa a emu da hɔ dwuma susu ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho. Hwɛ sɛnea mmabun nim akenkan ne akyerɛw ne nea wɔpɛ sɛ wonya nsɛm. Fa nsɛm ma denam akwan horow ne akwan horow pii te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde ano ka, nkrataa, ne mfoni so. Hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wommisa nsɛm na wɔnhwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Fa wɔn beebi foforo wobenya mmoa nnwuma sɛnea ɛho hia. Akwahosan ho dwumayɛni no nnya aso ntie, na ɔmma ɔbabun no kwan ma ne nkasa pii so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde ma mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden no aka mmɔden a ɛtrɛw a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee anya nkɔso no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde ma mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden no aka mmɔden a ɛtrɛw a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee anya nkɔso denam nneɛma a ɛde nyiyim ba ntini a wobedi ho dwuma, nipadua mu ahofadi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow a epira a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne hwɛ a wɔbɛma mmabun nyinaa anya hokwan ne hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne ɔmanfo su nya mmabun a wobenya asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso ?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne ɔmanfo su betumi anya asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a mmabun nya wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso wɔ adwene a wɔsakra wɔ animtiaabu, aniwu, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho no so. Amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi anya ankasa-ho-nteaseɛ (self-awareness) ne adwene a ɛmu dɔ (critical thinking) de ahwehwɛ nea enti a mfɛfoɔ hyɛ me nkuran, te sɛ sɛnea mɛhunu sɛ ayeyi anaa mmoa a wɔde ma me no firi wɔn yam nokorɛm, anaasɛ wɔreyɛ saa de adaadaa me anaa wɔwɔ biribi a wɔhwehwɛ firi me hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ankasa-ho-nteaseɛ ne adwene a ɛmu dɔ (critical thinking) a wobɛnya no bɛtumi aboa wo na woasusu nea enti a mfɛfoɔ hyɛ wo nkuran pa:Bisa atirimpɔw ho asɛm (Question motivations): Dwen nea enti a mfɛfoɔ beyi wo ayɛ anaa wɔbɛpene wo so no ho; susu ho hwɛ sɛ ɛfiri wɔn yam nokorɛm na wɔreboa wo, anaasɛ wɔreyɛ saa de adaadaa wo anaa wɔwɔ biribi a wɔhwehwɛ firi wo hɔ.Gye wo nkaeɛ di (Trust your instincts): Tie w’adwene mu nkaeɛ ne nea wo yam kyerɛ wo fa nkitahodie ho; hunu sɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛkyerɛ adaadaa anaa nhyɛsoɔ, na gye wo ho di sɛ wobɛsi gyinaeɛ a ɛde w’akwahosan bɛdi kan.Hwehwɛ adwene horow (Seek diverse perspectives): Hwehwɛ mmoa anaa afutuo firi mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, afotugyefoɔ, anaa nnamfo a wɔmfiri wo mfɛfoɔ kuo no mu, na woanya adwene ne nteaseɛ horow afa nkitahodie ne nkuranhyɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne 'body positivity' na adɛn nti na ɛho hia ma awoasɛm ho apɔmuden (SRH)?
answer_twi_source: Body positivity' ne sɛ wogye wo nipadua tom na w'ani sɔ, ɛmfa ho sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ. Ɛkyerɛ ɔdɔ a wowɔ ma wo ho. Ɛho hia efisɛ ɛma wonya gyidie (self-esteem), adwene mu apɔwmuden, na ɛboa ma woyɛ nneɛma a ɛbɔ wo ho ban wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so anya ahobammɔ ne asɛyɛde bere a mede me ho ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) ho mu no? (ahye a ɛho hia, adwuma a wɔne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di yɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Wo ne Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di Yɛ Adwuma: Fa ɔpanyin, ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ kannifo a wogye no di bere nyinaa bere a wode wo ho hyɛ bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) dwumadi ahorow mu no. Ma wonhu wo ho a wode bɛhyɛ mu no ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri. Hu Wo Anohyeto: Paw dwumadi ahorow a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo na ahobammɔ wom. Mma nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wobɛyɛ biribiara a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo. Set Boundaries: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ "dabi" wɔ nnwuma anaa tebea horow a ɛte sɛ nea ahobammɔ nni mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwaahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛho hia no bi ne: Mmabunbere ne nipadua mu nsakrae a wɔbɛte ase. Nimdeɛ a ɛfa nna mu agodie wɔ twe ho firi mu, akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma ho. Nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho nimdeɛ ne sɛnea wobesiw ano. Mpene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛte ase. Nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw ne awo hokwan ahorow ho. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa ne afotu a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ nkwamoa nti meko tia nipadua mu nka bɔne?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua mu nka bɔne fi mfifire a ɛne mmoawa a wɔwɔ wo honam ani di afrafra. Nkwamoa ahodoɔ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'Hormones', titiriw wɔ nsabuo mu ma wɔte mfifire beberee. Sɛ mfifire yi ne mmoawa fra a, ɛde nka bɔne bi ba. Nkwamoa bi te sɛ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'testosterone' ne 'estrogen' betumi ama mfifire a efi nipadua mu no ayɛ kɛse, titiriw wɔ mmeae te sɛ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no sɛ 'underarms ne groin'. Ahonidie yɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na 'COVID-19' ɔyaredɔm no anya nsusuasoɔ wɔ 'STI/HIV' ano sie mmɔdenmɔ wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no anya nsusuasoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsiw 'STI/HIV' ano wɔ wiase nyinaa, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛso twa yɛ no, a 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde siw ano ka ho, ɛnam nnipa a wɔatoto mu, akwantuo anohyetoɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔbɛsan akyekyɛ ama mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛdi dwuma wɔ ɔyaredɔm no ano nti. Kɔndɔm, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo a ɛho hia a wonya so tew, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ne nea wɔkyekyɛ mu a wɔsɛe no, na ɛde asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya 'STI ne HIV' a wɔde bɛkɔ nnipa mu no kɔ soro. Ohaw a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu ama ankorankoro a wɔwɔ 'HIV' no mu, a nea ɛka ho ne nnuru a wobenya no mu ɔhaw ahorow, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔbɛto mu, ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ankorankoro fie hwɛ mu no ho. Nsakrae a ɛba nna mu nneyɛe ne esiane nneɛma te sɛ nsakrae wo nna mu nneɛma, Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a wɔde di dwuma kɛse a wode bo afeku na wotwe mpena, ne nneyɛe a asiane wom a ebetumi akɔ soro esiane adwennwen, tew a wɔtew wɔn ho, ne sikasɛm mu ahokyere nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a wɔfa so gyina adwennwen ne dadwen a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho ano? (akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, akuw a wɔboa) .
answer_twi_source: Akwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔfa so gyina ano ni: Akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome: Fa ahome a emu dɔ yɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, adwennwen. Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho kɛse sɛ wo ne w’atipɛnfo anaa nnipa a wɔboa wo no mu. Akuw a Wɔboa: Sɛ wo ne mmabun afoforo a wɔyem bɛkasa a, ebetumi ama yɛate ase na yɛaboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnuru ahorow bɛn na wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru ahodoɔ a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ Ghana ne: Honam mu nkawmmoa akwan: nnuru, mpanea, nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ implant barrier akwan: barima kɔndɔm, mmaa kɔndɔm, nnuru a ɛkum mmerima ho nsuo (spermicide),nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  cervical cup Mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu: Honam mu nkwammoa  ne kɔbere mfiri yɛ paneɛ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Sterilization: nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Vasectomy (mmarima) ne nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ tubal ligation (mmea). Eyinom yɛ akwan a ɛtra hɔ daa ma enti wontumi nsakra
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minnim obi edinnsiananmu a, ɛdɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ghana mu se, mmra no gye edinnsiananmu mmiemu yi tum, se wo yɛ  ɔbaa anaa ɔbarima
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne ahwɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho no mu na wɔakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma: Fa akwankyerɛ ne hwɛ ma bere a mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho mu, na ɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nsɛmmisa ho mmuae yɛ mmerɛw. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Hyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a wobɛka ho asɛm, a wobɛboa mmabun ma wɔahu animhwɛ, nsusuwii hunu, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nhwɛso: Fa nhwɛso di anim denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho su a ɛfata a wobɛda no adi ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ abusua anaa adesuadan mu no so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho adesua a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Ko ma na kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua nkyerɛkyerɛ nka sukuu adesua ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masi gyinae wɔ twetiatwa ho na madi asetra mu nhyɛso ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔhwɛfo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo nkasa mfa wo haw ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa twe a wobɛtwe wo ho afi ho ho. Hwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa fi mmeae a agye din, te sɛ nhomasua wɛbsaet, nhoma, YMK App ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw. Susuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ nhyiam ahorow ase, wobɛkɔ akɔka mmabun akwahosan akuw ho, anaa nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si abusuabɔ pa, twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho, ne nna ho gyinaesi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua nea broni ka no 'media literacy education' betumi adi wɔ tumi a ɛbɛma mmabun asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan, abusuabɔ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ma mmabun tumi sɛ: Wohu na wɔkasa tia nsusuwii hunu, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho mfonini a epira wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. Nya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so fi mmeae ahorow. Nya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wode bɛsɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasem ahwɛ na woasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho. Kamfo kyerɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mfa nneɛma a wɔyɛ ne ne kyekyɛ a ɛyɛ asɛyɛde nni kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mesusu adwenepɔ a mewɔ ma wɔn a w'aduru mmabun berɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Bisa Wo Ho: Bisa nea enti a wususu saa fa afoforɔ ho anaa wote nka wɔ ɔkwan pɔtee bi so.  Bisa wo nnamfofoɔ anaa w’abusuafo nsɛm wɔ wo suban yi ho. Kenkan nhoma anaa nsɛm a ɛkasa tia nsusuiɛ hunu.  Ma wo ho kwan sɛ wubesua na woasesa w’adwene a egyina nsɛm foforɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe afoforo a ɛnyɛ nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi akɔ wɔn nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa bere a wɔrekɔ adwenemyare nhyehyɛe no mu no?
answer_twi_source: Aane, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ne nkitahodibea afoforo a ɛnyɛ ɔkwan pa so wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi akɔ wɔn nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa berɛ a wɔrekɔ adwenemyare nhyehyɛe no mu no. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ma wonya tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a mmabun betumi ne afoforo a ebia wɔrehyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Ebia adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow na wɔbɛhwɛ akuw yi so, anaasɛ ebetumi ayɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔnyɛ nhyehyɛe a atipɛnfo hyehyɛ. Bio nso, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow ne itanɛte so nkitahodie mmeaeɛ akuw betumi ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no anya mpɔtam hɔfo ne abusuabɔ ho adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So awofo anaa abusuafo betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa anaa afotu ama wɔn ho sɛ wɔrepere sɛ wobegyina ɔbabun bi nna anaa awo mu akwahosan ho haw ano a?
answer_twi_source: Aane, awofo anaa abusua mufo betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa anaa afotu afi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ayaresa ho animdefo, mmoa akuw, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ sɛ wɔrepere sɛ wobegyina ɔbabun bi nna anaa awo mu akwahosan ho haw ano a. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wɔn ankasa yiyedi di kan bere a wɔboa wɔn mmabun no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mewɔ ho kwan sɛ mɛka nea ɛkyere m'adwene fa me sexual health ne mental health ho kyerɛ me sukuu afutufoɔ counselors''?
answer_twi_source: Aane, wubetumi. Counselors ne nurses wɔ kokoam-yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, nanso bisa (sɛ abusuyɛ bi wom a). Wɔbɛboa wo na wɔakyerɛ wo kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa dadwen a wɔtaa nya a mmabun nya wɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmeae a mmabun bɛtumi adi nsɛm yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ: Atemmu ho suro, kokoamsɛm a wonni. Address by (biribi akyiriakwan): Kokoam nsɛm, Ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu, Nsɛm a edi mu, Akwaaba tebea.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na awofoɔ di wɔ pene mmra 'informed consent' a ɛwɔ mmabun so 'informed consent' mu na nsosonoe b3n na 3da mmra ne ammaer3 ntam?
answer_twi_source: Ɛgyina mmara anaa amammerɛ so. Ɛtɔ da a awofoɔ na wɔpene so. Mmabun wɔ kokoam hokwan. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbu wɔn ahofadi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ betumi adi de ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ mu den, de ama nteaseɛ akɔ anim afa nna ne awoɔ ho kyɛfa ho, na wɔasɛe amammre mu akyiwadeɛ, komm-yɛ, ne aniwu a ɛda nsɛm te sɛ mmaa kyima, awoɔ nsiwadeɛ nnuro, yafunutu, ne nna mu nyarewa so?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ betumi adi dwuma kɛseɛ de apuepue bɔne ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, denam nkurɔfoɔ adwene a wɔbɛkanyan afa nna ne mmawoɔ ho kwan ne deɛ ɛfata ho, na wɔasɛe akyiwadeɛ, kommyɛ, ne aniwuo a ɛda nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu ho. Ɛdenam mfoni ahorow a edi mu na ɛka obiara ho so no. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ betumi aboa ma wɔyi aniwuo no firi hɔ fa nsɛm te sɛ kyima, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne nna mu nna ho nsɛmmɔne, na ama wɔatumi asusuw ho na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ɔsatu ahorow, sohyial media so nkɛntɛnsofo, ne anigyede nhyehyɛe ahorow nyinaa betumi aboa ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ayɛ nea ɛfata na wɔahyɛ gyinaesi a nyansa wom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na botaeɛ si hia wɔ kwan a wɔfa so gyina mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ a ɛnyɛ pa ano, na wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya akwahosan pa wɔ nna mu ne awoɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Botaeɛ si hia wɔ kwan a wɔfa so gyina mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ a ɛnyɛ pa ano na wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya akwahosan pa wɔ nna mu ne awoɔ ho, efisɛ ɛma obi nya akwankyerɛ ne atirimpɔw a emu da hɔ. Denam botaeɛ a wɔde bɛsi wɔn ani so so no, mmabun bɛtumi akyerɛ nea wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ, wɔbɛtumi ato ahyeɛ, na wɔade wɔn yiyedi adi kan wɔ amansan nneyɛeɛ ne nhyɛsoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si ɔkwan abien a ɛda nna ne awo akwaahosan ne adwenemyare ntam no so dua.
answer_twi_source: Wo nna ne awo akwaahosan betumi aka w’adwene mu akwaahosan, na nea ɛne no bɔ abira. Adwennwen anaa dadwen a wobɛte nka no betumi aka wo nna mu osuahu ahorow, na nna mu akwaahosan ho dadwen betumi ama woayɛ dadwen anaa adwenemhaw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔhaw obi wɔ Intanɛt so anaa wɔde kɔmputa so ayayade a wobetumi abu no sɛ bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV)? (ɔtan kasa, ahunahuna, kokoam nsɛm a wɔtow hyɛ so)
answer_twi_source: Ɔtan kasa: Wɔde animtiaabu anaa ahunahuna a egyina abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nea ɛkeka ho so de wɔn ani si wo so. Ahunahuna: Basabasayɛ ho ahunahuna anaasɛ wo ho nsɛmmɔne a wɔbɛtrɛw mu wɔ Intanɛt so. Invasion of Privacy: Wo ho mfoni anaa wo ho nsɛm a wobɛkyɛ a wompene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɔ ma mmabun ho ka yɛ den, titiriw nea ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii na ɛma wɔbɔ ka kɛse wɔ apɔmuden ho nnwuma a wɔyɛ ma mmabun ho, titiriw nea ɛfa nna ne awo apɔmuden ho: Mfiridwuma mu nkɔso ne nneɛma foforo a wɔayɛ wɔ ayaresa ne akwan horow a ɛma ɛka kɔ soro. Adwumayɛ ho ka a ɛbata sikatua, insurance ho dwumadie, ne mmara a wɔdi so ho. Mfaso a nnwumakuw a wɔyɛ nnuru ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nya. Apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma no mu apaapae ne nkitahodi a enni wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ntam, na ɛde nnwuma a ɛnyɛ adwuma yiye ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ no mprenu ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ne atetesɛm nya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho wɔ mpɔtam ne aman ahorow mu so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidie ne amanneɛ ahorow wɔ tumi kɛseɛ wɔ sɛnea nnipa bu bɔberɛ (gender) ne nna ho nsɛm (sexuality). Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, wobɛtumi ahunu bɔberɛ ho asɛdeɛ ne nea wɔhwɛ kwan firi obi nkyɛn a emu yɛ den paa, nanso afoforɔ fam no, wobɛtumi abu bɔberɛ sɛ adeɛ a ɛbɛtumi asesa. Saa ara na nsusuieeɛ a ɛfa nna ho nso bɛtumi agya pii gyina amammerɛ mu mmara, nneɛma a wɔakyiri (taboos), ne nyamesom mu nkyerɛkyerɛ so. Nhwɛsoɔ ne sɛ, amammerɛ bi bɛtumi asi nna a wɔbɛtwentwɛn ho kɔsi awareɛ mu so dua, mmerɛ a afoforɔ nso bɛtumi ama kwan ama abusuabɔ a nna wom ansa na awareɛ reba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside anaa ɔhaw a ɛtaa ba wɔ nna mu ateetee ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, te sɛ animtiaabu, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abom adi akwanside ahorow yi so na wɔayɛ tebea a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside anaa ɔhaw a ɛtaa ba wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no bi ne: Animtiaabu ne Aniwu: Animtiaabu ne aniwu a ɛbata nna mu basabasayɛ ho a wobedi ho dwuma, a ebetumi ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no abam abu sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wɔbɛda wɔn suahu ahorow adi. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ: Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛteɛteɛ ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔkasa tia wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe, pene a wɔpene so, ne su horow a wɔde to obi a wɔato wɔn mmonnaa so a ebetumi ama asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a epira akɔ so atra hɔ no. Amammerɛ mu Nneɛma a Wɔbara: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne nkate a ebetumi asiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho wɔ mpɔtam bi kwan no ho dwuma, na wɔhyɛ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho nkuran. Nneɛma a Wonnya: Wɔbɛkamfo nneɛma, sika, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no akɔ soro, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besiw ano wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhomasua, ntetee, ne afotu betumi adi wɔ tumi a wɔbɛma mmabun ma wɔatumi akɔ adwumayɛ gua so, wɔabɔ akatua a ɛfata ho nkitaho, na wɔakamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ adwumam akyi?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua, ntetee, ne afotu betumi ama mmabun tumi denam: Ahokokwaw ne nimdeɛ a wɔhia a wɔde bɛma wɔn na wɔatumi akɔ adwumayɛfo gua so no so. Adwumayɛbea anaa nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nkitahodi akwan ne akatua ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho a wɔde bɛma. Wɔn ne afotufoɔ a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ mu a wɔde bɛka abom. Wɔn a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔadi mfuw a efi tete no bɔbeasu a ɛne no bɔ abira na wodi so akyi. Wɔn ahotoso a wɔbɛma akyerɛ sɛ wɔsom bo na wɔkamfo akatua a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsunsuanso bɔne anaa asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn ano sie aduru ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a Ɛfa awo mu nkwamoa Ho: Nnuru a Wɔde Siw Awo ano: Akisikuru, tiyɛ, adwene mu nsakrae. Nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'Patch/Ring': Wora a ɛyɛ hyew, nufu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw. Nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'Implant/IUD': Mogya a ɛntɔ daa, akisikuru, Nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'Fainting,rregular anaa Heavy Periods,Ovarian Cysts, Nyinsɛn, Ectopic nyinsen, Infection. Perforation', Akwanside nhyenhye: Kɔndɔm: Nneɛma a ɛma obi ho yɛ no hyew, nkate a ɛso tew. Nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'Diaphragm/Cervical Cap': Asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya ɔyare mmoawa wɔ nsu mu. Akwan Nyinaa: Asiane ahorow a ɛntaa nsi te sɛ mogya a ɛtɔ anaasɛ akisikuru, a ɛsono sɛnea obiara te.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ate nka sɛ me ho tɔ me sɛ mɛba wo nkyɛn abɛka nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw me wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho, te sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa nneyɛe bi a mɛte nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ?
answer_twi_source: Hu sɛ wubetumi aba me nkyɛn bere nyinaa de nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wo wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho a wunsuro sɛ wobebu wo atɛn anaasɛ wobɛtɔ wo so ka. Yɛ tebea a ɛda adi na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wobɛte nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa nneyɛe bi ho a wobɛda no adi sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ. Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran denam nsiyɛ a wode betie wo haw ahorow na woagye wo nkate horow atom, na woahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi wo kokoam nsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwen mu haw bɛn na mmabun taa hwehwɛ mmoa wɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hwehwɛ mmoa ma adwen mu haw ahohorow, nea eka ho: hahaahayɔ 'depression': awerɛhoɔ, anidasoɔ a enni hɔ, anaa wohwere anigyie wɔ dwumadie ahorow nkate a ɛso ntwa. Ayɛmhyehyeɛ haw: atetee denden, ɔsuro, ehu tu hyɛ soɔ aa ɛteetee wodaadaa adwuma yɛ. Nea aborɔfo ka no 'attention-deficit/ hyperactivity disorder (ADH): haw wɔ adwen nsisoɔ, 'hyperactivity' anaa 'impulsivity'. Didie mu haw: Nnipadua mfoni a ɛnnyɛ 'distorted body image' ne  edidie suban a ɛnnyɛ tesɛ 'anorexia nervosa', 'bulimia', nervosa, anaa 'binge' edidie bɔne. 'Substance use disorders': haw wɔ sɛnea yefa nsa, nnuru, ne nsunsu tumi yekɔ bɔne nsusuasuo ahohorow. Woho a wopira anaa wokum wo ho: wode woho ahyɛ woho pira mu suban mu, anaa wokum woho adwendwen. 'Trauma-related disorders': PTSD anaa adwen mu haw bɔ wo nkae sɛ wofa nneɛma bia ɛha adwen no. Anyɔnkofa anaa abusua bɔ nsemsem: Ɔhaw wɔ  tipɛn abusuabɔ, abusua ntawantawa, ateetee. Nneɛma a ɛfa nnipa su nsem ho: barima ne mma asɛdeɛ anaa amammerɛ ho nsem nsem. Nwomasua anaa sukuu ho nsem mu ɔbrɛ: nhyɛsoɔ wo adesua mu, ateetee, anaa ɔhaw dwumadie ne sukuu nsesae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nnwuma a ɛhwɛ mmaa apɔwmuden nsɛm (gynecological services), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Gynecological services yɛ aduro mu nnwuma a wɔhwɛ mmaa awoɔ mu nsɛm ne wɔn awodeɛ ho nsɛm.  Wɔyɛ nhwehwɛ mu soronko ahorow bi sɛ: preventive, diagnostic, ne therapeutic measures, ma mmabun. Saa nwuma yi ho hia ma mmabun awoɔ ho apɔwmuden nsɛm, brayɛ, ahobammɔ, nna mu yareɛ (STIs) ne wɔn yieyɛ nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabunbere sesa nipadua no na dɛn ne osuahu ahorow bi a wɔtaa nya wɔ saa bere yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere yɛ bere a nipadua ne nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae ntɛmntɛm na esiesie wo nipadua ma awo. Osuahu ahorow bi a wɔtaa nya ni: Onyin a ɛyɛ hu: Wobɛyɛ tenten na wo mu duru ayɛ kɛse. Nipadua mu nhwi nyin: Nwi pue wɔ w’amotuem ne w’asen mu. Nufu nyin (mmea): Nufu befi ase anyin na anyin. Kyimabea (mmea): Wubefi ase ebu wonsa. Ɛnne sesa (mmarima): Wo nne bɛkɔ akyiri. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ a ɛkɔ soro: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya nna ho nkate ne ɔpɛ sɛ wubehu nneɛma pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsusuanso bi wɔ hɔ a efi mu ba wɔ amanneɛbɔ ho mmara a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma no so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔanni mmara a ɛfa ɔhyɛ amanneɛbɔ mmra no so a, ebetumi de mmara mu nsunsuanso aba onipa a ɔmmɔ amanneɛ no so, a asotwe a ebetumi aba wɔ ɔmanfo anaa nsɛmmɔnedi mu ka ho. Saa nsunsuansoɔ yi betumi ayɛ soronko agyina sɛdeɛ mmara sobuo no mu yɛ den ne mmara pɔtee a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ tumidi a wɔmmɔ amanneɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ mmoa a mmabun wɔ wɔ apene so ne gyinaesi no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae no mu denam: Mmabun ahofadi a wobebu wɔn na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu no so. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a wɔde bɛma de aboa mmabun ma wɔapaw nea ɛfata. Tebea a ahobammɔ wom na wɔmfa atemmu nka ho a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ adi. Kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ a wɔbɛkura mu de ahyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ahotoso ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wohyia nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayade, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya mmoa nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wohyia nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayade no bi ne telefon a wɔde boa, afotu adwumayɛbea, mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne mmoa akuw a wɔboa mmubuafo pɔtee. Wobetumi afa nnipa a wogye wɔn di, mmubuafo ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa mmarahyɛ bagua ahorow so anya saa nnwuma yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ mmoa nkitahodi ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔadi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nneɛma ne nnwuma a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho a wobenya no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadie a εfa Nkɔmmɔbɔ Ho: Mpɔtam hɔ mmoa ntam nkitahodiɛ bɛtumi de ayɔnkofa nhyehyeε adi dwuma de adu nnipa dodoɔ a wɔnnya mmoa yie nkyɛn. Ayaresabea Ahorow a Wɔde Fa Akwantu So: Ebia wɔbɛhyehyɛ ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa nnipa a wɔde mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwahosan ho nnwuma bɛma wɔ mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaa mmeae a wonnya sika pii. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ sukuu ahorow, nhomakorabea ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ biako a, ebetumi atrɛw baabi a wobetumi akɔ no mu na wɔde nneɛma ama wɔ mmeae ahorow. Sikasɛm mu Mmoa: Sika fam mmoa anaa sika a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwuma no betumi aboa ma sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe asiw ano. Nhyehyɛ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Telemedicine adwumayɛbea ahorow
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Ma nimdeɛ pa. Kyerɛ adwene mu hwehwɛ. Hyɛ suban pa nkuran. Ma kwan ma yɛkasa pefee. Ma ahooden ma wɔko ma wɔn hokwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔne ahokafo di nkitaho fa nna mu akwahosan ne nna mu yarewa ano a wosiw ho so dua.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi yɛ ade titiriw a ɛma obi nya nna mu asetra a ahoɔden wom, titiriw bere a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ ho no. Sɛnea wo ne wo hokafo (wo hokafo) bɛkasa ni: Pae mu ka na Di Nokwaredi: Ka wo hokafo (hokafo) pefee na di nokware wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ne nna mu yarewa ho dadwen ho. Ansa na da: Ka sɛnea mobɛbom asɔ ahwɛ ansa na moayɛ nna mu abusuabɔ ho asɛm. Ka akwan a wopɛ sɛ wofa so bɔ wo ho ban (kɔndom) ne akwan a wobɛfa so atew asiane so ho asɛm. Tie na Bu Nidi: Tie wo hokafo no haw ahorow na bu wɔn ahyeɛ. Ɛnyɛ Atemmu: Kae sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ nkitahodi yɛ nea ɛnyɛ atɛn na ɛkyerɛ obu. Ɛfa wɔn ho wɔn ho akwahosan a wɔbɛhwɛ so ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ahorow a wɔde asiw nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbeasu ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm mu, na etu mpɔn dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ghana mmara nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho no yɛ den na ɛrenya nkɔsoɔ. Bere a afe 2006 Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Mmara no bara nyiyim a egyina dɛmdi so no, ahobammɔ biara nni hɔ a ɛda adi pefee a egyina nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ me werɛ fi aduro (pill) baako a ɛbɔ me ho ban nyinsɛn ho a, metumi ayinsɛn ntɛm ara anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛntaa nyɛ asiane mmere wɔ hɔ 'grace period'. Di akwankyerɛ so. Sɛ wo werɛ fi pii a, fa bammɔ foforo ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nna anaa bere nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmaabun hu bere a wɔrebisa sika fam mmoa de ahwehwɛ nhomasua ne ntetee no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɛn pii no, nna anaa bere nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu bere a wɔrebisa sika fam mmoa de asua nhomasua ne ntetee no. Saa nna a etwa to yi betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nhyehyɛe pɔtee anaa sika a wɔde ma no so, enti ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hwɛ akwammisa akwankyerɛ ne ahwehwɛde ahorow mu yie na wɔde wɔn akwammisa nkrataa no kɔ ansa na bere a wɔakyerɛ sɛ wobesusuw ho sɛ wobenya sika no adu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabunbɛtumi aboa wɔn mfɛfoɔ a nsa anaa nnubɔne ama wɔayɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ? Yei bi ne sɛnea wɔbɛkyekye wɔn werɛ, sɛnea wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔanya mmoa firi nnwumakuo a ɛfata hɔ, ne sɛnea wɔbɛsiw afɔbu suban ne nsɛm a nkurɔfoɔ de gu oyarefoɔ no so no kwan.
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa atipɛnfo a ebia nsa anaa nnubɔne ama wɔayɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ so denam: Nkate fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma na wɔagye wɔn nkate atom a wɔremmu atɛn anaasɛ wɔmfa asodi nto wɔn so. Wɔn a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔakɔhwehwɛ ayaresa na wɔanya mmoa nnwuma te sɛ afotu, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo wɔ ɔhaw mu, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo. Boa a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔafa akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so abɔ amanneɛ, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛkɔ mmarahyɛ baguafo nkyɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde mmara kwan so asɛm bɛkɔ atia nea ɔyɛɛ wɔ bɔne no a. Su ne nneyɛe a wɔde to nea wɔayɛ no bɔne so a wɔbɛkasa atia denam si a wobesi so dua sɛ asɛyɛde no da nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no so, na ɛnyɛ nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no so, ne tema ne ntease a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mpanyimfoɔ ne akyerɛfo ne mpanyin afoforo bɛboa nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'media literacy skills', aboa nkitahodie a efa peneeɛ so ne abusuabɔ a emu da hɔ, na a si mpɔtam a eho dwo na wɔboaboa wɔn ho aa ɛte na ɛbu ɛne biara?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛ, ne mpanyinfo afoforo betumi aboa mmabun wɔ 'media literacy skills' mputuo wɔ nkurae hyɛ wɔ adwen dwen mu, nkitahodie, ne abusuabɔ a ɛte. Ɔmo betumi ama akwankyerɛ wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan akwankwan wɔ nyansa kwan so, edi wɔn agye akwan foforo ahorow, na ahu nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'harmful stereotypes ne biases'. Wɔ sisi mpɔtam a wɔboa na ehodwo aa mmabun bɛnnya ahoto wɔ mpanyisɛm nkitahodie, mpanyinfo betumi ahyɛ mmabun tumi sɛ wɔde abɛɛfo ntetan edi dwuma sɛ akadeɛ a ɛde nsakrae pa ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn abusua ntete yɛ, gyedie,  amammerɛ ne amaneɛ di hɔ mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛɛ mu sɛ ba no nna mu, ayɔnkofa ne awoɔ apɔmden mu deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'reproductive health' ɛna ɔkwan bɛn so na saa nneɛma a mabobɔ so yi danso wɔ mmusuakuo ahodoɔ nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Abusua gyidie ne amammerɛ ka sɛdeɛ mmabun hu nna, nkitahodie ne awoɔ apɔmden mu nsɛm ho.Sɛ nneɛma a m'abɔ so yi danso wɔ mmusua mu. Wɔ mmusua a wɔdi nyamesom akyi pii no, wɔbetumi aka sɛ nna ne nna mu ahobammɔ yɛ akyiwadeɛ gye sɛ awareɛ akyi. Wɔ afoforo mu no, wɔkasa fa ho pefee. Amammerɛ nso kyerɛ deɛ wɔhwehwɛ firi mmarima ne mmaa hɔ, awareɛ, ne awoɔ na abetumi anya nsunsuansoɔ ho mmabun agyinaeɛsie mu a afa nna mu dwuamadie ne nkitahodie ahodoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara kwan so akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔate hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ ase na wɔanya mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ama wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ate wɔn hokwan ahorow ase na wɔanya mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ama wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan denam nsɛm, ntetee, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmara, hokwan ahorow, ne mmara kwan a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛfa ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ sukuu tebea a ɛboa kɛse a wɔmma GBV ho kwan? (akwan a wɔfa so bɔ amanne, obu a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran) .
answer_twi_source: Amanneɛbɔ akwan: Hyɛ wo sukuu nkuran sɛ wɔmfa amanneɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe a emu da hɔ nni dwuma wɔ GBV ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a asuafo bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho bɛtɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛkasa. hyɛ obu, nkitahodi pa, ne abusuabɔ papa ho nkuran wɔ w’atipɛnfo ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna, ne abusua mu asɛde "family obligations" ahorow ho no nya ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn hokwan ne asɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmusua betumi asiesie gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛbɔ abira?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna, ne abusua mu asɛyɛde ahorow ho betumi anya ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan "reproductive health" ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Ebia mmusua kura gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛkyerɛ mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ saa mmeae yi. Ɛho hia sɛ mmusua de wɔn ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na obu wom mu fa saa nsɛmti yi ho, gye tom na wɔma adwene ahorow a ɛsonosonoe tom bere a wɔhyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease ne tema ho nkuran. Mmusua betumi asiesie gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛbɔ abira denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, obu a wɔde ma ahofadi "autonomy", ne ahofama a wɔbom de bɛhyɛ abusua mufo nyinaa yiyedi ne hokwan ahorow ho nkuran a wɔde bedi kan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ boa a wɔboa mmabun ma wosiw awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ano na wodi ho dwuma, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wɔn nkitahodie?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ boa a wɔboa mmabun ma wosiw awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ano na wodi ho dwuma denam: Awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam ne nea ɛnyɛ atɛn a wɔde bɛma, a afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Nsɛm a edi mu ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, brayɛ akwahosan, awo ho nimdeɛ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe ho. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa de hwɛ awo akwahosan na wɔahu nsɛm biara ntɛm. Mmabun a wɔne mmabun bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ankasa de asiw ano, adi nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, na wɔasusuw ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho. Mmabun betumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho denam: Nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ daa akɔ awo akwahosan mu nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu ahorow so. Nsɛmmisa a wobebisa na wɔahwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow, akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, ne STI ano a wosiw ho bere a wɔahyiam no. Nokware a wɔbɛka wɔn nna ho abakɔsɛm, wɔn nneyɛe, ne wɔn haw ahorow ho asɛm pefee. Awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmere anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a, ɛfata yiye ma nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho nkɔmmɔ, baabi a yebetumi anya kokoam nsɛm na yɛde yɛn adwene asi biribi so a biribiara ntwetwe yɛn adwene?
answer_twi_source: Paw mmere ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wo ne w’awofo nyinaa betumi anya kokoam nsɛm na wode w’adwene asi biribi so a biribiara ntwetwe w’adwene "distractions". Susuw ho sɛ mobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ bere a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn wɔ fie, te sɛ bere a yɛrekɔ nantew, bere a yɛbom renoa aduan, anaa ansa na yɛada. Hwɛ hu sɛ mo baanu nyinaa benya bere a ɛdɔɔso a mode bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu koraa a monte nka sɛ mopere mo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ di wɔ nna a ahoɔden wom, nipadua ho mfoni pa, ne abusuabɔ a obu wom a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua aka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna a ahoɔden wom, nipadua ho mfoni pa, ne abusuabɔ a obu wom a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu denam: Nsusuwii a emu yɛ den a wɔde bɛma wɔn de asɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne abusuabɔ ho ahwɛ. Boa a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔahu na wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu a epira, ahoɔfɛ ho adwene a enni mu, ne nna ne abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ho mfonini a wɔakyinkyim wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodi, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde bɛma denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ afã horow a wɔde bɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de adi nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya wɔ mmabun suban, gyidi, ne wɔn nneyɛe so no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nnamfofa ne asetra mu mmoa nkitahodi ahorow di wɔ abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkate mu Mmoa: Nnamfo de nkate fam mmoa ne ntease ma wɔ mmere a emu yɛ den mu. Abɔnten so Adwene: Nnamfo betumi de adwene ne afotu ahorow ama wɔ abusuabɔ ho nsɛm ho. Asetra a Ɛkari pɛ nea broni ka no 'Balanced Life': Nnamfo a wokura mu a ɛnyɛ ɔdɔ abusuabɔ no ma ɛkari pɛ na ankorankoro nyin. Ayɔnkofa mu Dwumadi: Kuw mu dwumadi ahorow a wo ne wo nnamfo bɛyɛ no betumi ama abusuabɔ a ɛda wo ne wo hokafo ntam no mu ayɛ den. Ntawntawdi Ho Nsiesiei: Nnamfo betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ ntamgyinafo wɔ ntawntawdi mu na wɔde akwankyerɛ ama wɔ nsɛm a wobesiesie ho. Nanso ɛsɛ sɛ wobɔ wo amanneɛ sɛ mmabun binom nnamfo anya wɔn so nkɛntɛnso ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu abusuabɔ ne nneyɛe a ɛmfata mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene a wɔpene so di wɔ nkitahodi a ɛyɛ papa mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde pene bere nyinaa na wobu no?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so yɛ ade titiriw a ɛma obi nya nkitahodi pa. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa de fahodi ne anigye pene so sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi anaa nkitahodi afoforo mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ pene a wɔpene so no kɔ so na wobetumi atwe bere biara. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛma pene na wɔabu no bere nyinaa no, wo ne wo hokafo nni nkitaho pefee wɔ ahye, akɔnnɔ, ne awerɛkyekye dodow ho. Bere nyinaa bisa na gye pene a ɛda adi pefee ansa na wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara mu, na sɛ wo hokafo no ka sɛ dabi anaasɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ ne ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, bu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ mmabun a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne asɛde ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne asɛde ahorow a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho no mu. Wobetumi de mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho ho nsɛm ama, akyerɛkyerɛ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya kokoam hwɛ ne pene a wɔpene so, asusuw akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so anya nnwuma ho, na wɔde akwankyerɛ ama wɔ mmara mu nsɛm anaa nsɛnnennen a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ ho. Ɛdenam mmabun a wɔma wɔn tumi ma wonya wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho nimdeɛ so no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo boa ma wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa betumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi ahyɛ nkitahodiɛ a ɛda nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden dwumadie ne apɔmuden dwumadie biara  ɛhia, te sɛ adwene mu apɔmuden mmoa, nna mu yareɛ  (HIV/AIDS) banbɔ ne ayaresa, ne yareɛ a ɛnyɛ nea wɔde yare mmoawa ba?
answer_twi_source: Apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ betumi ahyɛ nkitahodiɛ a ɛda nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden dwumadie ne apɔmuden dwumadie biara a ɛhia ntam no den denam kwan a wɔbɛfa so de mmabun apɔmuden aka abom. Eyi kyerɛ nkabom a wɔne nna mu ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden (SRH) adwumayɛfoɔ ne adwene mu apɔmuden mmoa, nna mu yareɛ  (HIV/AIDS)  banbɔ ne ayaresa, ne yareɛ a ɛnsan nkurɔfoɔ sohwɛ adwumayɛfoɔ bɛyɛ. Dwumadie a wɔaka abom, te sɛ mmabun apɔmuden ayaresabea anaa mmabun apɔmuden mmeae a ɛkɔ akyiri, betumi aboa ma wɔanya dwumadie pii wɔ baabiako na wɔahwɛ sɛ mmabun bɛnya mmoa a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛdi wɔn ahiadeɛ ahorow ho dwuma. Afei nso, ɛsɛ sɛ apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ de nteteeɛ ne tumi a wɔde bɛma apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ di kan de adi apɔmuden nsɛm a ɛka bom ho dwuma na wɔama mmoa a ɛka bom a ɛfa mmabun tebea pɔtee ne wɔn apɛdeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
