question_twi_source: Sɛ minyinsɛn na misi gyinae sɛ menyɛɛ krado sɛ mɛyɛ ɔwofo a, dɛn ne akwan horow a mɛfa so, na sɛ ɛho hia a, mɛyɛ dɛn anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wobɛfa so: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu: Sɛ wonyɛɛ krado sɛ wobɛyɛ ɔwofo a, nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ mmara kwan so kwan wɔ mmeae pii. Aduruyɛ mu Afotu: Hwehwɛ afotu fi akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo hɔ na woasusuw akwan horow a wobɛfa so na woanya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho. 5100 (MTN users), ne PPA’s Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) bɛboa wo ma woanya nhumu wɔ nnwuma no ho ne baabi a wubetumi anya bi Mmara mu Nsusuwii: Te mmara ne nhyehyɛe a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ Kae: Kokoamyɛ: Awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, a nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho, yɛ kokoamsɛm. Mmoa: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmantam nnwumakuo ne apam ahorow te sɛ Afrika Aman Nkabom no Maputo Apam no boa ma ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow kɔ anim wɔ beaeɛ pɔtee bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam nnwumakuo ne apam ahodoɔ, te sɛ Afrika Aman Nkabom Kuo no Maputo Apam no, boa ma ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ kɔ anim wɔ beaeɛ pɔtee bi mu denam mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn a wɔde besi hɔ, kamfo a wɔbɛkafo sɛ aman ne aman nni dwuma mmom, ne mfiridwuma ho mmoa ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di nkitahodie a ɛda adwene mu yiyedi ne nna mu nkɔso a ɛfata ntam ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu yiyedi a ɛfata ma wunya ɔkwan pa ne apɔwmuden a wobɛfa so anya nna mu nkɔso. W’adwene mu akwaahosan a wobɛhwɛ so no betumi ama wo nna mu akwahosan ho osuahu nyinaa atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de obu abisa obi ne edinnsiananmu ho asɛm a meremma ɔnte nka bone?
answer_twi_source: Wɔnsusuw nneɛma ahorow a ɛte saa ho wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu ne nyiyim afoforo te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho tan, mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan, transfobia, ne mmusua mu nyiyim di nkitaho wɔ mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho tan, mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan, transphobia, ne mmusua mu nyiyim di nkitaho wɔ ASRH mu denam: Nyiyim ne animtiaabu a ankorankoro a wɔka akuw pii a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu hyia no a ɛma ɛyɛ kɛse. Akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a wɔde ma nnipa a wɔn kɔla gu ahorow, ne mpɔtam afoforo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no na wonnye ntom. Nsusuwii hunu a epira ne tumi mu nkɔso a ɛma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kɔ so tra hɔ, na esiw akwan horow a ɛka obiara ho, a egyina hokwan ahorow so a wɔfa so hyɛ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkuran ne ɔhwɛ ano no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya nna ho atenka anaa nneɛma a ɛtwetwe wo wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata. Bere a wo nipadua ɛsesa no , ebia wubefi ase ate nka sɛ wopɛ afoforo anaasɛ wubenya nna ho adwene. Eyi yɛ onyin no fa. Wubetumi agyina saa atenka yi ano yiye denam apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, tebea ne...
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo ntentanfidie platform ahorow betumi ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho abenfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ SRH suban pa ho nkuran na ɛma mmabun tumi ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn nkitahodie ho na wɔde adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie platforms betumi ne ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan ho abenfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mmabun akamfofoɔ ayɛ adwuma abom de ahyɛ SRH suban pa ho nkuran: Nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu a wɔreka abom ayɛ: Wɔne SRH abenfoɔ ne mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ SRH nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛfata mfeɛ a wɔadi wɔ digyital platforms so. Mpɔtam hɔ akwankyerɛ: Fa mpɔtam hɔ akwankyerɛ a ɛde SRH nsɛm a wotumi gye di a wɔbɛkyekyɛ di kan, ko tia nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, na ɛbɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ho ban fi nneɛma a epira ho. Nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ: Fa nteteeɛ ne mmoa ma ahwɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no na ama nkɔmmɔdie a ahobanbɔ ne nea ɛka obiara ho a ɛfa SRH nsɛmti ho wɔ abɛɛfo ntentanfidie platforms so no ayɛ mmerɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛnteɛ mu aba, te sɛ ɛka a wɔbɛtɔ, sɛ wobehyia sɛ wobetu obi afi fie anaasɛ wobegye obi afi ne nsam, anaasɛ sikasɛm mu nhyɛso ne adwenemyare a obehyia?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye no betumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba mmabun so, a nea ɛka ho ne ɛka a wɔbɛtɔ, wobehyia sɛ wobetu wɔn afi fie anaasɛ wobegye wɔn afi wɔn nsam, anaasɛ wobehyia sikasɛm mu nhyɛso ne adwenemyare. Ɛka a mfɛntom kɛse wom a wɔboaboa ano, betumi de sikasɛm mu adesoa a ɛyɛ den sɛ wobedi so aba. Wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu no, sikasɛm mu nhyehyɛe a ɛnteɛ betumi ama wɔabɔ ka anaasɛ mmara mu nsunsuanso ahorow aba. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun de sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde, sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de akwati saa nneɛma bɔne yi na wɔakura wɔn sikasɛm mu yiyedi mu no di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu mfɛfo a wɔwɔ nsunsuanso pa wɔ me suban ne gyinaesi so?
answer_twi_source: Suban a ɛboa: Hwehwɛ atipɛnfo a wɔda tema, ayamye, ne mmoa adi wɔ wɔne afoforo nkitahodi mu, titiriw wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho. Obu a wubenya ama ahye: Hwɛ sɛnea w’atipɛnfo bu w’ahye ne wo ahofadi, ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na wofi nokwaredi mu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no yiye. Gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbom yɛ: Hwehwɛ nnamfo a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn ne gyidi koro wɔ nna mu akwahosan, abusuabɔ, ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne afoforo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mifi ase nya akisikuru 'acne' wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Acne yɛ ade a ɛtaa ba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu esiane nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu nti. Anamɔn a wobɛfa so adi akisikuru ho dwuma ni: Ahohoro a Ɛyɛ Dwo: Fa aduru a wɔde tew w’anim brɛoo a ɛnyɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw anaa samina hohoro w’anim mprenu da biara. Kwati sɛ wobɛhohoro wo ho denneennen dodo, efisɛ ebetumi ahyɛ wo were no abufuw. Kwati sɛ Wobɛka Wo Ho: Kwati sɛ wobɛka wo ho anaasɛ wobɛtetew wo akisikuru no, efisɛ ebetumi ama ɔfe no ayɛ kɛse na ama woanya akuru. Nneɛma a Ngo Nni Mu: Fa nnuru a wɔde hwɛ honam ani a ngo nnim anaasɛ ɛnyɛ comedogenic di dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne nea ɛma honam ani yɛ hyew ne aduru a wɔde yɛ wo ho. Ayaresa a Wɔtɔn: Susuw ho sɛ wode nnuru a wɔtɔn a wɔmfa nnuru nhyɛ mu a 'benzoyl peroxide', 'salicylic acid', anaa 'sulfur' wom bedi dwuma. Di akwankyerɛ a ɛfa nneɛma a wɔyɛ ho akyi. Sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ na fa nneɛma a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ a esiw akisikuru ano te sɛ tumeric ne 'aloe vera', Adidi a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Kura aduan pa a nnuaba, nhabannuru, ne nsu pii wom mu. Nhwehwɛmu ahorow bi kyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ bi da aduan ne akisikuru ntam. Sesa Pillowcase Daa: Sɛ wosesa sumii nkataho 'pillowcase' daa a, ebetumi asiw mmoawa a wɔbɛboaboa ano no ano. Kɔ Honam ani Ho Oduruyɛfo nkyɛn: Sɛ akisikuru no mu yɛ den anaasɛ ɛkɔ so tra hɔ a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ honam ani yare ho oduruyɛfo nkyɛn. Wobetumi akyerɛw nnuru anaa ayaresa a ano yɛ den ama wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma intanɛt so mpɔtam, mmoa akuw, anaa telefon a wɔde di dwuma so a ɛtwe adwene si nna mu akwahosan so na ɛtew animtiaabu so.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛyɛ intanɛt so mpɔtam, mmoa akuo, anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ a ɛtwe adwene si nna mu akwahosan ne animtiaabuo a wɔtew so nie: Nea woka no borɔfo mu sɛ 'Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana' (PPAG): https://www.ppag-gh.org/nu/ de intanɛt so nneɛma ma na ebia ɛwɔ mmoa kuw ho nsɛm. Nea woka no borɔfo mu sɛ 'Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health' (GYARH): https://ghanasrhralliance.org/ betumi anya intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa. Nea woka no borɔfo mu sɛ 'Ghana AIDS Commission': https://www.ghanaids.gov.gh/pages/fact-sheets-reports de mmoa dwumadie ma na ebia ɛwɔ intanɛt so nneɛma. Nea woka no borɔfo mu sɛ 'Ghana Adolescent Health social media platforms', GHS-YMK Nea woka no borɔfo mu sɛ 'mobile app' no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mahwehwɛ na masi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ akwan horow a mɛfa so apaw nyinsɛn no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn Ho Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Saa mmeae yi de afotu ne nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho akwan horow a wobetumi apaw ho ma. Adoption Agencies: Adoption agencies de nsɛm a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho ma sɛ ɔkwan a wobetumi afa so. Akwahosan Ho Dwumadibea: Wobetumi de nsɛm, afotu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow ama. Afotufo anaa Ayaresafo: Afotufo a wɔyɛ adwumaden betumi de nkate fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama. Aman pii wɔ telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ma nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw ne mmoa. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kokoamsɛm ho mmara ne akwankyerɛ ahorow gu ahorow wɔ akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe anaa aman ahorow mu, na dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmeae ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm ho mmara ne akwankyerɛ betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe anaa aman ahorow mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu saa nsakrae ahorow yi bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmeae ahorow no na wohu mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nneyɛe a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho no yiye. Sɛ mmabun rehwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ amannɔne a, wobetumi abisa kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan horow a wɔfa so hwɛ hu sɛ wɔabɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahu na yɛayɛ akwan a wɔfa so twetwe nkurɔfo adwene ne nneɛma a wɔde twetwe adwene a wɔde di dwuma wɔ aguadie ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi ɔsatu ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma anaa nnwuma ho mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkate mu anigyede: Nkate mu mmuae te sɛ anigye, ehu, anaa ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wobenya nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso anaa gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma anaa nnwuma ho a wɔkanyan. Nea broni ka no 'Bandwagon effect': Sɛ wɔma obi te nka sɛ ɔyɛ obi a ɔka ho anaasɛ wogye no tom wɔ asetra mu denam kyerɛ a wɔkyerɛ sɛ obiara de ade anaa suban pɔtee bi redi dwuma anaasɛ ɔrepene so. Adansedi ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Adansedi a efi adetɔfo a wɔn ani gye ho anaasɛ nnipa a wɔagye din akyigyina a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama wɔagye adi na wɔadaadaa mmabun ma wɔanya ade anaa adwuma no mu ahotoso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma adwumayɛku a ɛda social media nkɛntɛnsofo, ASRH ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow ntam de ASRH ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛyɛ anigye, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho bɛma atiefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔsoɔ a ɛda social media nkɛntɛnsoɔfoɔ, ASRH ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ ntam no ma hokwan sɛ wɔde ASRH ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛyɛ anigyeɛ, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho bɛma atiefoɔ a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so denam: nkɛntɛnsoɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn nsa ka ne wɔn agye din a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyekyɛ nsɛm a egyina adanseɛ so, ahyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa ho nkuran, na wɔama nkurɔfoɔ ate ASRH nsɛm ho. Nsɛm a wɔbom yɛ a ɛne atiefo ahorow hyia, di amammerɛ tebea pɔtee bi, kasa a wɔpɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfo ahiade ahorow ho dwuma. Nhyiamu a wɔbɛma mmabun anya nneɛma a wɔtumi de ho to so, ahwehwɛ mmoa, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a nteaseɛ mu wɔ ASRH nsɛmti ho wɔ tebea a ahotɔ ne nnipa nyinaa ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nneɛma a ɛfa nsɛmti pɔtee a ɛfa SOGI ho, te sɛ nea wopue, nyɔnkofa nkitahodie anaa nna mu akwahosan ho? (Nneɛma pii twe adwene si nsɛmti pɔtee bi so, enti wubetumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa wo ho kɛse.)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wobetumi de social media ne digital platforms adi dwuma de ako atia animtiaabu na wɔabɔ STI ne HIV ho dawuro?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de social media ne digital platforms adi dwuma de ako atia animtiaabu na abɔ STI ne HIV ho dawuro denam: - Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ankorankoro nsɛm, ne adansedi a efi ankorankoro a wɔwɔ STIs anaa HIV so a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn suahun wɔakasa atia nsusuii hunu. - a wɔbɛhyehyɛ intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔboa ne atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ a ankorankoro a STI anaa HIV aka wɔn no bɛtumi abɔ, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔanya mmoa. - wɔbɛyɛ kasamafo ama, akwahosan ho adwumayfo, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma de ahyɛ animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so ne HIV/AIDS ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran no nne kɛseɛ. - a wode hashtags, ɔsatuo, ne intanɛt so nsɛm a ɛsisi di dwuma de nya atiefoɔ, kanyan nkɔmmɔdie, na wɔkasa tia animtiaabuo. - a wode bɛma ankorankoro a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa anaa nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne HIV/AIDS ho no anya intanɛt so nneɛma, afotuo dwumadie, ne sɔhwɛ ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na aban ahorow, NGO ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ nwomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a mmabun nya no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ eyi mu?
answer_twi_source: Aban ahorow, NGO ahorow, ne mpɔtam ahyehyɛde ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a mmabun nya no mu. Wɔhyehyɛ na wɔde nhyehyɛɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛma nwomasua mu pɛyɛ ne nkabom atu mpɔn, wɔkyekyɛ sika ma sika a wɔde ma wɔ adesua mu, mmoa, ne adwumayɛ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, na wɔde mmoa dwumadie te sɛ adwumayɛ ho afotuo, afotuo, ne adwuma a wɔde ma. Mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow wɔ eyi mu denam ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ asuafo agyinatukuw anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu, na wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no adi nkitaho de asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a ɛfata so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mayɛ mmofra a wɔbɛfa wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma ho nhyehyɛe? (adwumakuo ahorow a wɔhwɛ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, afotufo) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woatumi akɔfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma: ka kuo a efa kuro hohwe so: https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/ betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ho wɔ Ghana. Ɔfotufo: Sɛ wo ne ɔfotufo bi kasa a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woahwehwɛ wo atinka mu na woasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ mmofra a wobɛfa wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo di wɔ mmoa a wɔboa wɔn mma wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkate mu Mmoa: Awofo ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛda nkate ne nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn adi. Sɛ yɛde nsem a efata wɔn mfe ho, ɛfa wɔn, brayɛ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho ama. Nkuranhyɛ: Awofo betumi ahyɛ suban pa te sɛ ahotew, aduan pa, ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ho nkuran. Ahye a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Mmara a wɔde besi hɔ a ɛfa  abɛɛfo ntentan dwumadie a wɔde di dwuma ne intanet so nkratuo ho no betumi aboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn betumi aka me nkate ne m’adwene mu apɔwmuden? (adwennwen, dadwen, adwene a ɛsakra) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn betumi de nkate ne adwene mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛnnennen aba esiane nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae nti: Adwennwen: Daakye ho adwennwen a wobɛte nka anaasɛ sɛnea wubetumi ayɛ ɔwofo no yɛ ade a ɛfata. Dadwen: Ebia awo, sikasɛm, anaa abusuabɔ ho haw wo. Adwene mu Nsakrae: Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu ntɛmntɛm no betumi ama obi adwene asakra, ne bo afuw, anaasɛ nenisu asu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ akwan horow a afotufo betumi afa so ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakyerɛ wɔn ahye, gyinapɛn, ne gyidi ahorow wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu, ako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu, na wɔakamfo wɔn ankasa nna ne awo hokwan ne yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Mfatoho horow a afotugyefoɔ (mentors) bɛtumi afa so ama mmabun tumi na wɔatumi apere ama wɔn ahyeɛ, wɔn gyinapɛn, ne wɔn gyidi wɔ amansan nkitahodie mu, na wɔatumi agyina mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ ano wɔ asiane nneyɛeɛ ho, na wɔapere ama wɔn ankasa nna mu ne awoɔ ho akwahosan mmara ne wɔn yiyedi bi ne:Sɛnea wɔbɛyɛ suahunu ho dwumadie (Role-playing scenarios): Afotugyefoɔ bɛtumi ne mmabun abom ayɛ suahunu ho dwumadie ahorow na wɔasua kwan a wɔfa so kasa a awerɛhyem wom ne sɛnea wɔbɛpo mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ.Mmoa nneɛma a wɔde bɛma (Providing resources): Afotugyefoɔ bɛtumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nneɛma te sɛ adesua mmoa krataa, mmoa akuo, anaa afutuguo nnwuma na ama wɔatumi asi gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom na wɔanya mmoa berɛ a ɛhia wɔn.Ankasa-ho-adwenedwene a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran (Encouraging self-reflection): Afotugyefoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛ mmabun kwan na wɔasusu wɔn gyinapɛn, wɔn gyidi, ne wɔn botaeɛ ho, na wɔama wɔn tumi ma wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛne wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ne nea wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asua sika ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu nkyerɛkyerɛ. Workshops/Intanɛt. Afotufoɔ (Mentors). Adwuma ketewa a wobɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam a wɔde wɔn kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, te sɛ akwantu, animtiaabu, anaasɛ nimdeɛ a wonni ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi adi akwansideɛ a ɛmma obi ntumi nkɔ hɔ ne kyɛfa a obi nya no ho dwuma denam: Kar a wɔde ma (transportation): Kar ho dwumadie a wɔde bɛma anaa akwantuo ho ka a wɔbɛsan atua no bɛtumi aboa ama wɔadi akwansideɛ a ɛfa akwantuo ho so. Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛma: Sɛ wɔde mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ na wɔma akwaaba besi hɔ a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho asɛm a, ebetumi atew animtiaabu so na ahyɛ wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu ho nkuran. Nhumu a wɔbɛma akɔ soro: Sɛ wɔyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde wɔn ani asi so sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfo, te sɛ nkrataa a wɔde kyekyɛ, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, anaasɛ wɔne sukuu ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ biako a, ebetumi ama nkurɔfo ate nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn a ɛwɔ hɔ ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ so. Amammerɛ mu nkate: Sɛ wɔhwɛ sɛ dwumadi no mu nneɛma ne dwumadi ahorow no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛka adwene ahorow ho a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔadi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a ɛfa amammerɛ anaa nyamesom gyidi ahorow ho no ho dwuma. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Sɛ wo ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔgye wɔn di wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no bɛyɛ adwuma abom a, ɛbɛtumi aboa ama wɔadi ɔsɔretia so na ama kyɛfa a wonya wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn mu no akɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛnya m'adwene wɔ asiane a ɛwɔ nneyɛeɛ anaa tebea bi mu, te sɛ me mfɛfoɔ abrabɔ, m'ankasa me gyinapɛn, nneɛma a mafe mu pɛn, m'atenka, ne nimdeɛ a mewɔ wɔ nna mu ahoɔden ho nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii nya sɛnea ankorankoro hu asiane ahorow a ɛbata nneyɛe anaa tebea horow bi ho no so nkɛntɛnso: Atipɛnfo gyinapɛn ahorow: Asetra mu nkɛntɛnso ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi akyerɛ adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nea wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom anaasɛ wogye tom wɔ atipɛnfo akuw mu no ho. Ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow: Ankorankoro gyidi, suban, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne akwahosan ho no nya sɛnea wohu asiane ahorow na wɔkari no so nkɛntɛnso. Osuahu ahorow a atwam: Osuahu ahorow a atwam, a eye ne nea enye nyinaa, na ɛkyerɛ asiane ho adwene na ɛma wosi gyinae wɔ tebea horow a ɛte saa ara mu. Nkate: Nkate te sɛ ehu, anigye, anaa akɔnnɔ betumi anya asiane ho adwene ne gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso, na mpɛn pii no ɛde asiane ho nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ animhwɛ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu sɛ obi rekyekyɛ adagyaw mfoni anaasɛ ɔresɛe obi foforo ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhu sɛ obi rekyekyɛ adagyaw mfoni anaasɛ ɔresɛe obi foforo ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so a: Hyɛ onipa a ɔrekyekyɛ nsɛm no nkuran sɛ onnyae na onsusuw ɔhaw a ebetumi de aba no ho. Fa mmoa ma nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no, na boa wɔn ma wɔnyɛ anammɔn biara mfa yi emu nsɛm no mfi hɔ anaasɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɛho hia a. Bɔ asɛm no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow na amma wɔantrɛw emu nsɛm no mu bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wɔde ankorankoro sisi hɔ na wokura womu, titiriw wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wode w’ankasa wo ho nnema bi sisi hɔ na di no kwasura mu, titiriw wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna ne awo apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho mu, efisɛ ahye bɔ wo nipadua, nkate, ne adwene mu yiyedi ho ban. Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nea wogye tom na ɛyɛ ahotɔ ma wo wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi mu, na ɛboa wo ma wokyerɛ sɛ wowɔ ahofadi, paw nneɛma a wunim, na wukura obu a wowɔ ma wo ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nipasu af horow te sɛ dɛmdi, mmusuakuw, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea, twam de hyehyɛ ankorankoro osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm betumi aka nipadua mu abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den anaa nkitahodie, na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae wɔ nna mu nsɛm mu. Mmusuakuw: Ebia amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ho no bɛyɛ soronko ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wofi mmusuakuw ahorow mu. Asetra ne Sikasɛm Gyinabea: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe anaa nna ho nhomasua a wonnya pii betumi aka mmabun a wonni sika pii a wɔadi dɛm no wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow hyehyɛ adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahobrɛase: Amammerɛ ahorow betumi asi ahobrɛase anaa adwempa so dua wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ho. Nhomasua: Amammerɛ mu gyidi betumi anya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma no so nkɛntɛnso. Animtiaabu: Amammerɛ ahorow bi de animtiaabu bata nsɛmti te sɛ brayɛ anaa nna ho, na ɛka sɛnea wobue wɔn ani. Awofo a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow na ɛkyerɛ dwuma a awofo di wɔ nna ho ade a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmofra mu. Nyamesom mu Gyidi: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ taa nya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So hyeto bi wɔ mmoa ahorow a sukuu mu ɔhaw mmoa nnwuma nhyehyɛe de ma wɔ nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Anohyeto ahorow betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nhyehyɛe pɔtee ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ so. Nanso, ɛsɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no de si wɔn ani so sɛ wɔde mmoa ne nnwuma a edi mũ bɛma bere a wodi kokoamsɛm ne abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ahorow so no. Anohyeto ahorow bi betumi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia, mmara kwan so asɛde ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow nhyehyɛe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anammɔn bɛn na ɛfa Partner Notification Services a wode bedi dwuma no ho?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a wɔfa so de Ɔhokafoɔ Amanneɛbɔ Dwumadie di dwuma no betumi ayɛ soronko agyina nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ so, nanso mpɛn pii no nea ɛka ho ne: -Sɛ wɔbɛbɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie anaa ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea no amanneɛ wɔ hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔbɔ ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛ. - a wode nsɛm a ɛfa nna anaa nnade a wɔde kyɛ ahokafoɔ a ebia wɔanya STI anaa HIV ho bɛma. - a wo ne fotufoɔ anaa akwahosan ho nimdefoɔ a wɔatete no bɛyɛ adwuma de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛbɔ ahokafoɔ amanneɛ wɔ kokoam na wɔremmɔ wɔn din. - a wode mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro ne wɔn ahokafoɔ ama nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne dwumadie a wɔde siw ano. - a wo ne ankorankoro ne ahokafoɔ di akyi de hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanya ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wobenya adwuma mu osuahu ne ahokokwaw a mfaso wɔ so denam adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwuma a wɔde sua adwuma, anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ adwumam so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ akwanya ahorow a wɔde benya adwuma mu osuahu ne ahokokwaw a mfaso wɔ so denam adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwuma a wɔde sua adwuma, anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ adwumam so. Saa osuahu ahorow yi ma wotumi de adesuadan mu adesua di dwuma wɔ wiase ankasa tebea horow mu, nya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a ɛsom bo, kyekye adwumayɛfo nkitahodi, na wɔhwehwɛ adwumayɛ akwan mu. Mmabun betumi anya saa hokwan ahorow yi denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so, wɔn a wɔde adwumayɛ ho ntetee ma, mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow, ne adwumawuranom nkabom a wɔde nsaano adesua mu osuahu ahorow ma wɔ nnwuma ne nnwuma ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: HIV banbɔ ne ayaresa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata mmabun ho nhwɛsoɔ bi ne dɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abɔ akyi dɔm ma wɔahyɛ ase wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: HIV banbɔ ne ayaresa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata mmabun no bi ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔn tipɛnfoɔ di anim, apɔmuden mmoa a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn, intanɛt so afotu dwumadie, (te sɛ YMK a ɛfi Ghana Apɔmuden Dwumadibea - Ghana Health Service), nna mu apɔmuden mmoa a wɔde ka sukuu nhyehyɛeɛ ho, ne mpɔtam hɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ. Mmabun betumi agyina nhyehyɛeɛ yi akyi denam apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu, ne mpɔtam ne ɔmanfoɔ akuo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmu, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde boaboa nsɛm ano betumi aboa ma wɔasusuw sɛnea asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun no tu mpɔn, nkɛntɛnso, ne pɛyɛ ho na wɔahu nhyehyɛe a egyina adanse so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm ano no ho hia na ama wɔatumi ahwɛ sɛnea asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun no tu mpɔn, nkɛntɛnso, ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ. Nsunsuansoɔ nhwehwɛmu a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛyɛ, a sɔhwɛ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔde bere tenten ayɛ ka ho, de asusu nea ɛfiri mu ba ne ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ asetena mu ahobanbɔ ho dwumadie mu. Nsɛm a wɔakyekyɛ mu a wɔbɛboaboa ano sɛdeɛ mfeɛ, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, asetena mu sikasɛm tebea, ne nsakraeɛ foforɔ a ɛfa ho de asusu nhyehyɛeɛ no mu nsɛm ho, de wɔn ani asi pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ so, ne nea ɛbɛfiri mu aba ama mmabun dodoɔ ahodoɔ. Nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ kuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, de kyere mmabun adwene, osuahu, ne nsɛm a wɔka fa asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahoɔden a mede begyina tebea horow ano na matumi adi atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow a enye ho dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Hu wo ho (Self-awareness). Sua asɛm siesie (Problem-solving). Nya mmoa kuo. Nya adwene pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne nea ebefi mu aba bɛn na ɛwɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho anaa nea ɛmfata a wɔde di dwuma wɔ media mu, ma mmabun titire?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔhwɛ nna ho nsɛm a ɛmfata wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu a, ebetumi ama mmabun ahu nna ho mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ ɛnyɛ papa, na ebetumi ama wɔanya: Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ho. Nna mu nsɛm a wɔmpɛ, a ɛka adwene a nkorɔfo kura wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den. Wei ma wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom pii mu anaasɛ wɔbɛsan ayɛ nneyɛe a wohu wɔ media mu a wɔnte nea ebetumi afi mu aba no ase. Atenka ne adwene mu ahokyere, titiriw sɛ emu nsɛm no yɛ basabasayɛ, ɛnyɛ nea wɔpene so, anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛfa biribiara ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ɔmanfo adwene, ne animtiaabu ka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow bedi dwuma wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ɔmanfo adwene, ne animtiaabu betumi aka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow bedi dwuma wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho denam nyiyim a wɔbɛma akɔ so, nsɛm ne nnwuma a ɛfata ne nea ɛfata a wɔbɛto ano hye, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ahwehwɛ mmara kwan so nsiesie no so. Saa ɔhaw yi ho dwuma a wobedi hwehwɛ sɛ wonya amammerɛ mu nkate, wɔkasa ma kyerɛ, na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ ɔmanfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun fa kokoam nsɛm, pene a wɔpene so, ne dijitaal ahobammɔ ho so bere a wɔrekyekyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm anaa nsɛm a ɛho hia denam dijitaal nneɛma a wɔyɛ so no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ ahwɛyiye bere a wɔrekyekyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so no, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔte kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so pene so wɔ digital akwan so no ase. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ntetee mu de asua intanɛt so ahobammɔ nneyɛe ho ade, a nea ɛka ho ne password ahobammɔ, nkitahodi a ahobammɔ wom, ne intanɛt so ayayade anaa ɔhaw a wohu na wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ asuafo a wɔadi dɛm no benya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nnwuma, ne mmoa a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ nhomasua nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahodoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ asuafoɔ a wɔadi dɛm no bɛnya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm, dwumadie, ne mmoa a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho denam dabere ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma a wɔayɛ ama ankorankoro ahiadeɛ so. Eyi betumi ayɛ nneɛma a wotumi nya wɔ akwan horow so (te sɛ anifuraefo, nkyerɛwee akɛse, anaa ɔdio), mfiridwuma a ɛma wotumi sesa nneɛma, mum kasa nkyerɛase, honam fam dabere, ne mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo titiriw anaa abɔnten so adwumayɛbea ahorow hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa tebea horow a obi rehyɛ me sɛ me ne no nna anaasɛ onni obu mma m’ahyeɛ so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsuro sɛ wobɛyɛ te sɛ nea wommu ade: W’ahobammɔ ho hia sen obi foforo nkate. Ma wo nne so na yɛ pintinn: "Gyae! Mekaa sɛ daabi!", frɛ mmoa sɛ wote nka sɛ wunni ahobammɔ Gyae tebea no ntɛm ara: Nsuro sɛ wobɛkɔ anaasɛ wubeguan sɛ ɛho hia a. Ka kyerɛ obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso sɛ: Wo ne ɔwofo, ɔfotufo, adamfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa no nkasa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho bɛtumi ama wɔanya tema ne ntease wɔ atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyim ho no betumi ama wɔanya tema ne ntease: Mmofra a Wɔadi  dɛm Ho Nhumu Nhyehyɛe: Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo mmubuafo ne nna ho ade. Nsusuwii a Nsɛnnennen: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa osuahu ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nya ho nkuran. Nhwɛso Pa: Fa ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm na wɔrenya nkɔso ho nsɛm kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasua wɔn ankasa sikasɛm, sika a wɔde sie, ne sika a wɔde bɛto mu kwan ahorow ho ade?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ne nnwinnade ahorow a wɔde besua ankorankoro sikasɛm, sikakorabea akwan, ne sikasɛm hokwan ahorow ho ade, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so adesua ne nkyerɛkyerɛ: Website,  app ahorow, ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔde adesua a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua a ɛfa sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne sikasɛm mu mfitiasesɛm ho ma. Nhoma ne nhoma ahorow: Nhomasua nhoma, nsɛm, ne nhoma ahorow a ɛma wonya nhumu wɔ ankorankoro sikasɛm, sika a wɔde hyɛ mu, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so nya ahonyade ho. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe: Nhyiam, nhyiam ahorow, anaa adesua ahorow a sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow de ma a wɔde wɔn adwene si sika sohwɛ ho nimdeɛ so. Sikasɛm ho afotufo ne afotufo: Akwankyerɛ ne afotu a wɔhwehwɛ fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, adwumayɛfo, anaa afotufo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ sikasɛm ne sikasɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow di wɔ nkate fam mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde ma mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso so, apaw nneɛma a ntease wom, na makamfo me nna ne awo akwahosan ahiade ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ntam nkitahodiɛ di dwuma titire wɔ nkateɛ mu mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde ma mu sɛ wɔbɛfa atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ so na wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ a ɛfa SRH ahiadeɛ ho denam: Atenaeɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmuo a wɔde bɛma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn suahunu, wɔn haw, ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa SRH ho. Nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ SRH nsɛmti ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ adamfofa su na atipɛnfo betumi anya bi so. Ankorankoro tumi a wɔbɛma wɔakamfo wɔn SRH ahiade ne hokwan ahorow wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa twaka 'relationship' ne ayɔnko fa mu bere a merehwehwɛ me nna mu nsɛm mu no?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi: Wo ne ɔhokafo nni nkitaho pefee. Wo Ho a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Gye bere hwehwɛ w’ankasa nna mu. Mmoa Nhyehyɛe: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo, ɔpanyin a wogye no di, abusua muni anaa atipɛnfo hɔ Obu ne Ahye: Hwɛ sɛ wobɛkyerɛ obu ama wo ho wo ho na woate wo ho wo ho ahye ase. Hwehwɛ Akwankyerɛ: Susuw afotu anaa ayaresa ho de hwehwɛ mmoa wɔ abusuabɔ ana ayɔnkofa a wobɛfa so akɔ mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nyisɛn yiguo ho nhyehyeɛ a ahobammɔ wom sɛ wɔhia a?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi akɔhu dɔkota anaa ayaresabea a wɔwɔ tumi krataa. Ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam na kɔhu nkurɔfoɔ wonimde a wɔdi mmara so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ nyinsɛn ho akwankyerɛ a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden anaa ahomatorɔfo  apps a ebetumi aboa ma wɔadi bere a wɔahyɛ ne nkokoaa nkɔso akyi ma.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛyɛ nyinsɛn akwankyerɛ a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden ne ahomatorɔfo afiri ni: Ghana Health Service mmabun akwaahosan nhyehyɛe ne ne mmabun akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Akuo a wɔfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ World Health Organization (WHO): https://www.who.int/activities/promoting-healthy-pregnancy Wɔn abɛɛfo ntentan no wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn asetra a ahoɔden wom ho. Ahomatorɔfo Apps: Nyinsɛn akontaabu afiri (pregnancy tracker) pii betumi aboa wo ma woahwɛ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wobɛkɔ, ahwɛ nkokoaa nyin, na woasua nyinsɛn ho nneyɛe a ahoɔden wom ho ade. Hwehwɛ app ahorow a agye din a nsɛm pa wom mu ansa na woatwe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔbɛtumi de adi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ nwomasua ne tumi a wɔbɛma ayɛ adwuma no adu nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ den nkyɛn, a mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so, LGBTQ+ mmabun, ne wɔn a wɔte nkuraase anaa akyirikyiri mmeaeɛ ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe a Ɛhwehwɛ Mpɔtam Titiriw (Targeted Outreach):Akwan horow a wɔfa so kɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ayaresabea a ɛnantɛ (mobile clinics), ne ntetee a mbabaa ankasa di anim (peer-led workshops) na wɔde hwehwɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nni kyɛfa no wɔ mbeaeɛ a wɔwɔ no pɛɛ.Ntetee a Ɛne Amammerɛ Hyia (Culturally Tailored Content):Adesua nneɛma ne dwumadi ahorow no yɛ nea ɛbu amammerɛ na ɛdi ahiadeɛ ne nsɛnnennen titiriw a nnipa a wɔn ho nni kyɛfa no hyia ho dwuma, na ama wɔatumi ate aseɛ na ama wɔanya bi ayɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene bɔne bɛn na nkurɔfoɔ kura fa Adwene si so (mindfulness) ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a Ɛnteɛ (Misconception): Sɛ woyi adwene biara firi wo ti mu. Nokware: Sɛ wohu w'adwene (acknowledge) na wosan de w'adwene ba nea woreyɛ no so. Adwene a Ɛnteɛ (Misconception): Sɛ yɛ de twentwam abisade (stress) anaa yɛde ma yɛn ho gye ahuru. Nokware: Ɛboa ma w'adwene tena adeɛ so (focus) na ɛboa w'ateka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn  ɔhaw ne akwanside ahorow  na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia ɔhaw  ahorow a ɛfa wɔn nna ho, a nea ɛka ho ne , ayayade a efi abusua anaa atipɛnfo hɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔde boa wɔn a wonnya. Saa akwanside ahorow yi betumi aka adwenemyare ne yiyedi kɛse. Saa ɔhaw yi a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ, de nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛko tia nna ne mmarima ne mmea basabasayɛ di dwuma, na wɔma wonya akwahosan ne mmoa nnwuma a ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu ase?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no bi ne: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho ma te sɛ Agoo SHE+ online platform by dialing 5100, YENKASA The toll-free number(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne ade. Afotuo dwumadie ne mmoa akuo a wɔyɛ adwuma titire wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho ma mmabun. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde ayarefo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu ma wɔ gyinaesi a nyansa wom ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow betumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nipadua mu nneɛma pa ne obu, a obi wɔ ma ne ho no ahyɛ nna ho adesua nhyehyɛe a edi mũ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nipadua mu nneɛma pa ne obu a, obi wɔ ma ne ho no ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua nhyehyɛe a edi mũ mu denam nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua ahorow, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ankasa ho a wogye tom, ne nipadua mfonini a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden a wɔde bɛka ho no so. Wobetumi ayɛ eyi denam adesua a wɔde di nkitaho, kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, ahɔho akasafo, ne multimedia nneɛma a ɛhyɛ ankasa ho mfonini pa ho nkuran na ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a epira. Afei nso, eyi betumi aka Mmabun Akwahosan akuw dwumadi ahorow ho wɔ sukuu ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nsɛm a ɛfa akwannya ahorow a mewɔ wɔ mmara kwan so a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afa mmeae ahorow so anya wo mmara kwan so akwannya ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho ho nsɛm: Wɛbsaet ahorow a wotumi de ho to so ne intanɛt so nneɛma a ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din a wɔyɛ mmabun akwahosan, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho adwuma titiriw de ma. Akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn betumi de nsɛm, afotu, ne mmoa ama a ɛfa wo mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho. Nhomasua nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ de mae no twee adwene sii mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsiesie ahodoɔ (initiatives) anaa kuo ahodoɔ bɛn (community-based organizations) na ɛwɔ mmabun bɔbeasu ne awo ho apomuden nsɛnnennen (adolescent sexual and reproductive health crises) ho nhyiam ne edukashin (outreach and education) ho?
answer_twi_source: mfatoho: PPAG, Alliance for Reproductive Health Rights (ARHR), Youth Advocates Ghana (YAG), apomuden dwumadibea ahodoɔ, mmabun abɔnten so nneɛma ahodoɔ. Wɔde adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ, afotuo, ne mmeae a wɔbɔ anamon no ma. Nnipa a wɔwɔ nkurow nketewa / gyidi mu nso de wɔn ho bɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna dodow ahe na mihia sɛ ɔbabun a merekɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun dodow no ara hia nnɔnhwerew 8-10 nna anadwo biara na ama wɔanya akwahosan ne yiyedi a eye sen biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɔnhwere sɛn na ɛhia sɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa da? na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma nna mu apɔmuden?
answer_twi_source: Dae a ɛdɔɔso ho hia na ama nkwaadɔm a ɛma obi nya nna mu ahoɔden a edi dwuma wɔ nna mu nkɔso ne akɔnnɔ mu no yɛ adwuma yiye. Ɛho hia sɛ ɔbabun da nnɔnhwerew awotwe kosi du da biara. Nna a wonnya betumi aka adwene, ahoɔden dodow, ne adwene a wɔde si biribi so, na ama ayɛ den sɛ wobenya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu anigye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne nsɛnnennen bɛn na ɛbetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi atew so?
answer_twi_source: Asiane a Ebetumi Aba: Asiane ahorow bi a ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu ne mogya a nyuu, ɔyare mmoawa, nyinsɛn a wontumi ɛnyi awie, ne nnuru a wonom aa woho tumi kyerɛ sɛ nnye. Asiane a Wɔbɛtew So: Ɔhwɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔfata hɔ. Hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ adeyɛ no wɔ tebea a wɔagye atom mu Di akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi nyinaa akyi. Kɔ a wobɛkɔ akɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi akyi sɛnea wɔkamfo kyerɛ no. Twe woho firi dwumadi ahorow a emu yɛ den wɔ oprehyɛn no akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ no boa mmabun ma wonya sikasɛm mu nnwuma, a sikakorabea, boseabɔ, ne insurance ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ayɔnkofa a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛyɛ no bɛtumi ama mmabun anya sikasɛm mu nnwuma te sɛ sikakorabea, boseabɔ, ne insurance denam sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mpɔtam sikakorabea dwumadie so. Wobetumi nso de ntetee, afotu, ne mmoa ama de aboa mmabun ma wɔanya sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn sikasɛm sohwɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata dabere ne adan a wobenya ho, na akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebia wonni sika a wɔde bɛtua saa ade yi?
answer_twi_source: Ebia wobetumi anya dabere ne adan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho ka sua anaasɛ wɔrentua hwee ma mmabun a wontumi ntua ho ka. Dabere a aban de sika boa ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso taa ma wɔn a wohia mmoa no dabere a wɔde sika boa anaasɛ wontua hwee. Bio nso, sika fam mmoa nhyehyɛe, mpɔtam hɔ ntoboa, ne mmoa betumi atua ɛka a ɛfa adan, aduan, kar, ne ahiade afoforo a ɛho hia ma mmabun a wɔrehyia ɔhaw bi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So anohyeto ahorow wɔ hɔ wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn gu a egyina nyinsɛn mfe so a broni frɛ no 'gestational age'?
answer_twi_source: Atumfoɔ pii wɔ anohyeto ahorow wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho akwan horow a ɛwɔ hɔ a egyina nyinsɛn mfe so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wɔ nyinsɛn no fã a edi kan no mu no, nnuru a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu (a wɔde nnuru di dwuma de kanyan nyinsɛn gu) betumi ayɛ ɔkwan a wobetumi afa so, bere a wɔ nyinsɛn no fã a edi akyiri mu no, ebia ɛho behia sɛ wɔyɛ oprehyɛn a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu. Bio nso, mmeae bi bara nyinsɛn a woyi gu wɔ nyinsɛn mfe pɔtee bi akyi gye sɛ ɛho hia wɔ aduruyɛ mu anaasɛ awotwaa mu ade a ɛnteɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛte nyinsɛn a broni frɛ no 'gestational age' anohyeto ne akwan a ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so ayi nyinsɛn a woyi gu wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de akasa atia nsusuwii hunu a epira ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a epira. Sukuu ahorow, apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de nna ne awo ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma nsɛm a edi mu ma na ɛma wonya adwene pa wɔ nna ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ɔsatu ahorow, ne sohyial media so dwumadi ahorow nso betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ anansesɛm ahorow a wɔbɛma ayɛ nokware ne nsɛm pa a wɔka fa mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wɔde ma mmabun mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ne wɔn adi nkitaho de anya mmoa no bi?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ: Sɔhwɛ a Wɔyɛ: Wɔyɛ STI nhwehwɛmu, nea efi mu ba no nkyerɛase, ne ayaresa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya bi no. Afotu: Afotu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ STI a wosiw ano, nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, ne ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho. Ɔhwɛ a Wɔde Siw Ano: Wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ STI nhwehwɛmu daa a egyina asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ ankorankoro ne nna ho abakɔsɛm so. Wubetumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho de anya mmoa ne nsɛm denam: Nhyehyɛe a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma STI nhwehwɛmu, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde bɛka nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho asɛm. Nsɛmmisa a Wobebisa: Te nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wubebisa nsɛm afa STI nhwehwɛmu, akwan a wɔfa so siw ano, ne ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho bere a woakɔ nhyiam no. Akwankyerɛ a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne afotu fi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow a wɔbɛfa so, nneɛma a wobenya, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene a wobedi ho dwuma no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm mu mmoa betumi ama mmabun tumi a wɔde besiw nyinsɛn ano, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu mmoa ma mmabun tumi nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo denam sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow a wɔtew so, nneɛma a wɔde bɛkɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, na ɛma wotumi tɔ nnuru ne nneɛma a ɛho hia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akuo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a asuafo di anim betumi adi wɔ adwenem apɔwmuden ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ne atipɛnfo mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akuo anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a asuafoɔ di anim bɛtumi adi dwuma titire wɔ adwenem apɔwmuden ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ sukuu mpɔtam hɔ denam: Nhyiamu, dwumadiɛ, ne ɔsatuo a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene asi adwenemyareɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, animtiaabuo, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi so. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo anaa nnamfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛma a asuafoɔ bɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔrehyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ osuahu ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano. Hokwan a wɔbɛma asuafoɔ anya akannifoɔ nimdeɛ, anya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, na wɔama atenka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea denam wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ adwenew apvwmuden ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu a nteaseɛ wom so. Mmeae a ahotɔ wɔ a wɔbɛbɔ ama asuafoɔ a wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi, ahwehwɛ mmoa, na wɔanya nneɛma a wɔrensuro atemmuo anaa animtiaabuo. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, afotumafoɔ, ne adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ mmɔdenbɔ a asuafoɔ di anim no ne sukuu no nneɛma a ɛhia paa no hyia na wɔboa mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛhyɛ adwenem apɔwmuden ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusuw wɔn adwuma ho apam ne wɔn adwuma ho nhyehyɛe ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔyɛ nea ɛfata na wɔyɛ pɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ wɔn adwuma ho apam denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ: Adwumayɛ ho mmara, nnwuma gyinapɛn ahorow, ne adwumayɛ ho gua a wɔbɛte ase de ahu akatua a ɛfata, mfaso horow, ne adwumayɛ tebea horow. Ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛka ho asɛm: Wɔn akwanhwɛ, nea wɔpɛ, ne nea wɔhwehwɛ a wɔbɛka no pefee bere a wɔrebisabisa adwuma ho nsɛm ne apam ho nkitahodi no. Afotu a wobɛhwehwɛ: Wo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa mmara ho afotufo a wo ne wɔn besusuw ho de anya akwankyerɛ wɔ adwumayɛ ho nsɛm a wɔbɛka ho asɛm na wɔahu frankaa kɔkɔɔ a ebetumi aba. Apam ahorow a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu: Adwuma ho apam ahorow a wɔbɛkenkan na wɔasan ahwɛ mu yiye, hwehwɛ sɛ wɔma emu da hɔ wɔ nsɛm a emu nna hɔ ho, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛsrɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nsakrae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo ho apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a awofo mpene ho ɛrenhia anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a awofo mpene ho ɛrenhia anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Ahintasɛm ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow taa bɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ wɔn apɔmuden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho ho ban, a nsɛm a ɛho hia a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔmuden ho ka ho. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko anaasɛ anohyeto ahorow wɔ kokoamsɛm mu, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho haw ahorow mu. Wɔ aman foforɔ mu no mmabun a wɔn mfeɛ akɔ anim (15-19)mfeɛ tumi nya nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden ho dwumadie a awofoɔ mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, berɛ a mmabun nkumaa (10-14)mfeɛ ntumi
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm, nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm, nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no bi ne: Akwahosan ho asoɛeɛ anaa ayaresabea a ɛwɔ sukuu mu a wɔde awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam ma, a afotuo a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Mpɔtam akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow, abusua nhyehyɛe mmeae, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔde awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a edi mũ ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ahorow ma. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne mobile apps (GHS - YMK App) a ɛde nsɛm, nnwinnadeɛ, ne mmoa ma awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, brayɛ kyinhyia akyi di, nyinsɛn ano aduru a wonya, ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔhwehwɛ. Hotlines (Agoo SHE+), nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadie, ne text-based support networks a ɛde kokoam afotuo, nsɛm, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ awoɔ akwahosan ho haw ahorow ma. Mmoa akuw a atipɛnfo di anim, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo mmabun, ne nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛde nkyerɛkyerɛ, tumi, ne atipɛnfo mmoa ma mmabun a wɔredi awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ne nhyɛso ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho, te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi anaa abusua mu nkɔso ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Sua w’amammerɛ mu gyidi ne atetesɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho na ama woate akwanhwɛ ahorow ase yiye. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wobue: Wo ne mpanyimfo anaa w’atipɛnfo a wugye wɔn di nni nkitaho fa wo nkate ne wo haw ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ mu nhyɛso ho. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ne wɔn ntam akasakasa a, wo ne sukuu afotufoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ nkasa na woanya akwankyerɛ. Hwehwɛ Kari pɛ: Gye amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow tom na bu no bere a wosan si w’ankasa gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow so dua no. Wo Ho Nsusuwii: Susuw w’amammerɛ gyinapɛn ahorow no afã horow a ɛne w’ankasa de hyia ne nea ebia wobɛpɛ sɛ wokasa tia anaa wosakra no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma kokoam telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo anaa wɛbsaet ahorow a ebetumi de nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara kwan so ne sɛnea wobetumi akɔ hɔ wɔ wɔn beae pɔtee no ama.
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma ahintasɛm ni: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG Helpline): Frɛ kokoam wɔ 0244312151 (Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-awia 5). Wobetumi de nsɛm ama na wɔde wɔn akɔ ayaresabea ahorow a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan a woyi nyinsɛn gu. Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health (GYARH): https://ghanasrhralliance.org/ Ebia wɔn wɛbsaet no wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa kokoam intanɛt so nneɛma anaa akuw a wɔboa mmabun a wɔyem ho. Mariestops Ghana-0302241517 di wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa adolescnet frind akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ho nkɔmmɔ na woanya mmoa pii wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nnipa hokwan ahorow di wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne nyiyim ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so, a nna mu ɔbrasɛe, nna mu atetee, ne ɔhokafo a wɔbɛn wɔn ho basabasayɛ ka ho no ho dwuma a wodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa hokwan ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran na wodi nyiyim ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so di ho dwuma, a nna mu ɔbrasɛe, nna mu ateetee, ne ɔhokafo a wɔbɛn wɔn ho basabasayɛ ka ho denam: Wɔasi hokwan ne nidi a ɛyɛ pɛ a ankorankoro nyinaa wɔ so dua, a mmarima ne mmea nipasu anaa nsɛm a wɔka mfa ho. Nyiyim ne basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so a wɔbɛbara, a nneyɛe a epira te sɛ mmofra aware ne mmea awotwaa a wotwitwa ka ho. Nhyehyɛe, mmara, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a ɛma ankorankoro a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa tumi ma wɔde wɔn hokwan ahorow di dwuma na wonya nnwuma ne nneɛma a ɛboa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Wɔn a wɔyɛ basabasa a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so no a wobebu wɔn akontaa na wɔbɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no anya atɛntrenee, mmoa, ne nsiesie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asesa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no ma ɛde mmabun nne, osuahu, ne ahiade asi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, de adi dwuma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ aberante biara benya hokwan anya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata, ne bo nyɛ den, na ɛyɛ nea ɛkɔ akyiri?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan nhyehyɛe no a wɔbɛsakra no ma ayɛ nea ɛwɔ mfinimfini no hwehwɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔabom: Mmabun-Hwɛhwɛ: mmabun nne, osuahu, ne ahiade Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma, nhyehyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow de mmabun nsɛm a wɔde bɛma ne wɔn kyɛfa a wonya wɔ wɔn nhyehyɛe, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu mu di kan. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu wɔ m gyinabea nyinaa, hwɛ hu sɛ nnwuma no di wɔn ahiade soronko ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma. Amammerɛ mu Nimdeɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ nya nteteeɛ ne mmoa wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfata mmabun ne nneyɛeɛ mu na ama wɔasom mmabun ahodoɔ yie. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne mmabun amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, wɔn nipasu, ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛte ase na wɔabu wɔn. Nhyehyɛeɛ ho Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ. Mmabun ne wɔn ayɔnkofo betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛhyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran, adi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ ho dwuma, na ama pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee akɔ anim. Ebia eyi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔkamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ so a wɔbɛtew so, na wɔatrɛw nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun mu Nhwehwɛmu ne Nhwehwɛmu mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmu mmɔdenbɔ di kan sɛ wɔbɛte sɛnea nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu aba atu mpɔn no tu mpɔn, ne sɛnea wɔbɛhwehwɛ nkɛntɛnso a nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne nhyehyɛe mu nhyehyɛe ahorow anya no di kan. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nhwehwɛmu ho nsɛm di dwuma de bɔ daakye dwumadie ho amanneɛ na wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma no yie
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ mpenatwe anaa awareɛ a enni apɔwmuden nni mu anaa basabasayɛ wɔ mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ nipa no taa hyɛ ne hokafoɔ suban ne nneyɛe so, anaa ɔtaa twe ninku. Sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɛ twe wo afi nnamfoɔ, abusua ne wɔn a wɔboa nkyɛn. Sɛ ɔpɛ atɛmdidie anaa obu ne hokafoɔ animtia. Sɛ onni obuo, ma n'atenka anaa ne gyinasie.Anaa ɔbɛpɛ sɛ ɔbepira no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma awofoɔ anaa abusua mufoɔ a wɔpɛsɛ wɔte mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ase yie na wɔboa?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahodoɔ ne mmoa dwumadie ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ, a nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea, mmoa akuo, ne intanɛt so nhyiamu a wɔayɛ ama awofoɔ anaa abusua mufoɔ titire ka ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ayaresa ho animdefo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow nso betumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ntease ne mmoa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ne afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow adi dwuma, de asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa ama mmabun a wɔredi nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛnnennen mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi de asetena ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a ɛsom boɔ ama mmabun denam akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma, osuahu a wɔbɛkyɛ, abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, obuo a wɔbɛnya ama wɔn ho, ne nneyɛeɛ pa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne abusua betumi adi wɔ animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo ho nsɛm, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mmoa ne agyinaesie a wɔasi so dua ama wɔn mma?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne abusua di dwuma titiriw wɔ animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo ho nsɛm a wɔsɔre tia denam mmoa, si so dua, ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔde ma wɔn mma no so. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma ofie tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka nna ne awo ho nsɛm, ada wɔn nipasu adi, na wɔabisa nsɛm a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaa sɛ wɔbɛpow wɔn. Awofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no bɛtumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne awoɔ ho nsɛm , akasa atia wɔn ankasa animhwɛ ne nsusuiɛ, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛka obiara ho wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Wobetumi nso ama wɔagye atom na wɔabu nnipa ahorow ahorow wɔ wɔn abusua mu denam suban ne nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛso ne wɔn mma nipasu ne nea wɔpaw a wɔasi so dua no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama mehokwan a ɛfa kokoamsɛm (confidentiality) ho wɔ ayaresabea mmeaeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sua wo hokwan. Bisa ayaresabea hɔ adwumayɛfo fa akwan ne mmara a wɔahyehyɛ afa asumasɛm nsie ho. Ka sɛdeɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔda wo ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu adi kyerɛ afoforo. Bisa kwan a wobɛfa so ne dɔkota akasa wɔ kokoam. Kasa sɛ wɔredi wo nsɛm ho fɛw a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mede akwan abien a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm ne nnuru a wɔde kum nyinsɛn) redi dwuma a, so ɛbɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye mpo?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwan abien a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano (ɔkwan abien) a wɔde bedi dwuma no betumi ayɛ adwuma yiye asen biako pɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Nhwɛso: Sɛ wɔde kɔndɔm ne awo ano aduru bom a, ɛma wonya ahobammɔ a ɛkorɔn yiye wɔ nyinsɛn ho. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa: Wobetumi aboa wo ma woasi gyinae sɛ ebia akwan abien a wode bedi dwuma no fata wo ne nea wɔaka abom a ebetu mpɔn kɛse. Kae: Ɛnyɛ nea ɛkyerɛ sɛ akwan abien a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no ma ahobammɔ no mmɔho abien. Nanso, wobetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da no so kɛse sɛ ɔkwan biako antumi anyɛ yiye a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ amammerɛ a ɛne sɛ wobesusuw nneɛma ho yiye, adwenem naayɛ, ne nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ mu wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so mpɔtam hɔfo mu na ama nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware so atew?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ amammerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, adwenem naayɛ, ne nokwasɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so mpɔtam hɔfo mu de atew nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a ɛtrɛw so. Wobetumi de nhwɛso adi anim denam nokwasɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu ansa na wɔakyekyɛ, wɔne atipɛnfo nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ fibea ahorow mu, na wɔhyɛ afoforo nkuran ma wogye nsɛm a wohyia wɔ intanɛt so no ho kyim na wɔmfa nsusuw ho yiye. Ɛdenam tebea a ɛboa a ɛma nsusuwii a egyina adanse so ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛne sɛ wobesusuw nneɛma ho yiye wɔ wɔn mfɛfo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ anim bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ me ansa na m'awo no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ no ansa na wɔawo no, akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo taa: Hwɛ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn no akwaahosan ne ne yiyedi nyinaa so, Aduandi ho nhwehwɛmu Sua mogya mmoroso, ne mu duru, ne ne yafunu kɛse de hwɛ sɛnea nyinsɛn no rekɔ so. Yɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa ansa na wɔawo no de ahwɛ sɛnea onyinsɛn no ne wɔn ba no akwahosan te. Munsusuw dadwen anaa nsemmisa biara a ebia ɔbabun a onyinsɛn no benya wɔ nyinsɛn, awo, ne awofoyɛ ho. Fa nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu ma wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ aduan pa, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, awo ho ahosiesie, ne mmofra a wɔawo wɔn foforo hwɛ ho. Fa nkate fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ma de di nipadua ne nkate mu nsakrae a ɛbata nyinsɛn ho no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ nna mu yareɛ nso ɛ, mɛyɛ dɛn adi nkate fam nsusuaso a animtiaabu no de ba no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ ɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ a, ebetumi ayɛ hu na ama wate aniwu anaa wɔatew ne ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wokae: Ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo:nna mu yareɛ abu so Ɛyɛ nea wobetumi asa: Sɛ wɔsa wo yare yiye a, wo ho bɛtɔ wo. Ɛnkyerɛkyerɛ wo mu: Woboro wo nna mu yareɛ a wɔahu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne nsɛnnennen bɛn na ɛwɔ Intanɛt so nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma mu, a nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔde di dwuma, kɔmputa so ayayade, nnipa a wɔkyere nkurɔfo we wɔ Intanɛt so, ne kokoam nsɛm a wobu so ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so no ma mmabun hyia asiane ne nsɛnnennen ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware: Nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware anaa ɛdaadaa obi betumi atrɛw ntɛmntɛm wɔ Intanɛt so, na ɛde adwene mu naayɛ ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ aba. Intanɛt so ayayade: Intanɛt so ayayade ne asisifo betumi aba denam sohyial media, nkrasɛm app ahorow, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow so, na ɛka mmabun adwenemyare ne wɔn yiyedi wɔ ɔkwan a enye so ma ɛde nsɛnnennen te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho ba. Intanɛt so mmoa a wɔkyere mmoa we: Ebia mmoa a wɔkyere mmoa we de wɔn ani asi nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ so, a mmabun ka ho, denam sohyial media nhyehyɛe ne Intanɛt so agodie akuw so. Kokoam nsɛm a wobu so: Nnipa a wɔyɛ adwemmɔne betumi asɛe ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔde kyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so, na ama wɔabu kokoam nsɛm so na wɔawia wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn akwannya ne asodie ahorow na mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn kyɛfa a wonya wɔ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ akwannya ahorow wɔ saa tebea horow yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan ne asɛdeɛ a mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ mu no bi ne: Akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya nsɛm: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔnya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a ɛfata wɔn mfeɛ a ɛfa awoɔ akwahosan ne mmoa a wɔbɛnya ho. Akwannya  a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie na wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie bere a wɔne dwumadi no mu adwumayɛfo resusuw ankorankoro anaa nsɛm a ɛho hia ho no. Akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyehyɛe no dwumadi ahorow mu denneennen, da wɔn adwene adi, na wɔboa ma wosi gyinae. Asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wobebu afoforo: Ɛyɛ mmabun asɛyɛde sɛ wɔkyerɛ obu ma wɔn atipɛnfo ne nhyehyɛe no mu adwumayɛfo hokwan ne kokoam nsɛm, na wɔboa ma tebea pa na ɛka obiara ho. Asɛdeɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔde nsɛm bɛma: Mmabun wɔ asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔde nokwaredi mu nsɛm, nyansahyɛ, ne nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene bɛma nhyehyɛeɛ no so ahwɛfoɔ de aboa ama nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn no atu mpɔn na wɔatumi anya bi. Akwannya ahorow a wɔkyerɛ: Mmabun betumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow  wɔ  nkitahodi a wɔne nhyehyɛe no mu adwumayɛfo bedi nkitaho pefee, nsɛmmisa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, nhyehyɛe no ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu ntease, ne wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama sikasɛm nketewa ho nnwuma a wobenya no atu mpɔn, nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ne sika a wɔde bɛto mmabun adwumayɛ ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ɔman no mu, ne amanaman ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo sikasɛm nketewa dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛnya no yie denam: Nhumu a wɔbɛma akɔ so: Atipɛnfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn wɔ hia a mmabun adwumayɛ ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho hia ma nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa. Mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano: Ɔsatuo, adesrɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛbɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban ho nhyehyɛeɛ de anya ɔmanfoɔ ne amammuisɛm mu mmoa ama sika a wɔde bɛto mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne sikasɛm nketewa nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Nhyehyeɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔdie ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no nhyiamu mu de akamfo nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a ɛhyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ, sikasɛm mu ahoɔden, ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ pa mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu bi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde abusuabɔ pa gyina obu, ahotoso, nkitahodi, ne mmoa so. Ahokafo baanu no nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wɔte wɔn ase, na wɔwɔ ahobammɔ bere a wɔda wɔn adwene adi pefee no. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ pa wɔ hɔ no bi ne nkitahodi pa, gyinaesi a wɔbom yɛ, ahotoso a obi wɔ wɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho mu, ne tumi a wotumi siesie ntawntawdi wɔ obu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ pene ne nkitahodi ho no nya nna mu nkitahodi ne abusuabɔ so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nsunsuanso: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi akyerɛ adwene a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nkitahodi, ne pene a wɔpene so ho. Akwanside: Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ adwene a emu yɛ den wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa pene a wɔpene so ho. Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a emu yɛ den betumi ama ankorankoro tumi akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so. Nhomasua: Nna ho adesua a ɛkɔ akyiri betumi aboa ma wɔakasa atia amammerɛ mu su horow a epira.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na kokoamsɛm ho hia wɔ akwahosan ho, titire ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm ho hia ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe efisɛ: Ɛhyɛ ahotoso ho nkuran: Ɛda adi sɛ mmabun bɛhwehwɛ ayarehwɛ sɛ wɔwɔ ahotoso sɛ wɔbɛkora wɔn nsɛm so a. Ɛhyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran: Ahintasɛm ma mmabun tumi susuw nsɛm a ɛho hia ho a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaa nea ebefi mu aba. Ɛbɔ kokoam nsɛm ho ban: Ɛbɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya kokoam nsɛm ne ahofadi wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ yɛsusu nneɛma ahorow a ɛbom ka nnipa ho ho bere a yɛrepere ama LGBTQ+ nnipa ho kwan ne wɔn nkabom? (hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ obiara bɛka ho, a wobedi nsɛnnennen soronko ho dwuma)
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛni bɛne wo abɔ bɔbeasu mu nneyɛe ne su ho nkɔmmɔ. Wɔbu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so de anigye ne nkitahodieɛ a emu yɛ den di kan wɔ nna mu mu, bere mpo a nyinsɛn ano a wosiw anaa nna mu yareɛ  a wosiw ano yɛ ade a ɛhaw adwene no?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wobɛpaw a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Paw akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a ɛnsiw anigye kwan, te sɛ kɔndɔm. Kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma yiye na ɛkɔ so daa no ma wonya ahobammɔ abien fi nna mu yarewa (STI) ne nyinsɛn ho. Hwɛ hu sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa ho bɛtɔ wɔn na wɔama wɔn nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wɔde siw ano ho. Fa nna mu agodie a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Foreplay di dwuma: Fa w’adwene si foreplay a ɛtrɛw so na ama woanya nkannyan na woanya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den. Sɔ atenka mu nsa a wɔde ka obi, atuu, ne aduru a ɛkanyan akɔnnɔ hwɛ. Atenka mu Nkitahodi: Hyɛ atenka mu abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a ɛnyɛ nna mu dwumadi ho nkuran na ama abusuabɔ no mu ayɛ den. Kyerɛ ɔdɔ ne anisɔ ma mo ho mo ho. Agoru a Ahobammɔ ne Nea Wɔpene So: Hwehwɛ nna mu dwumadi ahorow a ahobammɔ wom na wɔpene so a ɛde anigye di kan. Munsusuw nsusuwii hunu anaa akɔnnɔ ahorow ho pefee na mo nyinaa nyɛ adwene wɔ ahye ahorow ho. Wɔn a Wɔbɛkɔ Daa: Mommɔ anigye ne abotɔyam ho nkɔmmɔ na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobedi ahokafo baanu no nyinaa ahiade ho dwuma. Yɛ nsesae na sɔ nneɛma foforo hwɛ a egyina nsɛm a wɔka ne nea wopɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan horow bɛn na wɔfa so siw STI ano, te sɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne nkitahodi a wɔne ahokafo di?
answer_twi_source: STI a wosiw ano no hwehwɛ sɛ: Kɔndɔm a Wɔde Di Dwuma Bere Nyinaa: Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye wɔ berɛ biaa a worekɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu, sabi turum, ne anom na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya STI no so atew. To ahyeɛ ho Nna mu: Te nipa dodoɔ a wone wɔn da so na wonna mu abakosɛm kyerɛ wɔn ansa na moadi mpa so agorɔ. Nkitahodi: Wo ne wɔn a wɔne wɔn da no mmɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na fa nokwaredi mfa STI nhwehwɛmu, tebea, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ho. STI Nhwehwɛmu a Wɔyɛ Daa: Yɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu daa, titiriw bere a wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi a ahobammɔ nnim mu anaasɛ woasesa wo hokafo a ɔne wo da no. Hwehwɛ ayaresa ntɛm na edi mũ ma STIs Mutual Monogamy: Fa wo ho hyɛ nkitahodie a wɔn ho wɔn ho yɛ biako mu ne ɔhokafo a wayɛ nhwehwɛmu ahu sɛ STIs nni hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ na ɔboa mmabun a wɔyem ahiade soronko ne wɔn haw ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ɔdemafo a Ɔboa Wo a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Din a Wogye: Bisa akwankyerɛ pa ahorow fi mmeae a wogye di te sɛ nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa wo oduruyɛfo titiriw hɔ. Adwuma titiriw: Hwehwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun ne awo akwahosan ho. Nsɛmbisa: Wo ne wɔn a wobetumi de mmoa ama wo no nhyia na susuw w’ahiade ho na hwɛ sɛ ɛfata yiye anaa. Ayaresabea anaa Ayaresabea: Susuw ayaresabea anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔwɔ osuahu wɔ mmabun nyinsɛn ho. Nea ɛho hia: Awerɛkyekye ne Ahotoso: Ɛho hia sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na wode wo ho to w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo so, efisɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ wo kwan wɔ wo nyinsɛn akwantu no mu. Nkitahodi a Wobue: Obi a ɔboa wo betie wo haw ahorow na ɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu ama wo. Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Ɔdemafo a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ betumi de tumi nsɛm ama wo de asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ w’akwahosan ne nyinsɛn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan a etu mpɔn a mɛfa so ahwɛ me ho a, metumi de adi adwennwen ne dadwen a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no  dwuma? (akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, journaling) .
answer_twi_source: Akwan a Wɔfa so Gye Ahome: Ɔhome a emu dɔ, dwennwen, "yoga", anaa nnwom a ɛma obi dwo a wutie no betumi aboa ma, adwennwen ne dadwen so atew. "Journaling": Wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate horow a wobɛkyerɛw ato hɔ no betumi ayɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so adi ho dwuma na woahu nneɛma a ɛkanyan adwennwen anaa dadwen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden ne akwansidie 'limitations' bɛn na mna ɛwɔ sesia anaa mprempren ɛfa nipa mu ne sikasɛm mu mmoa ntotoeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ  ma mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho, na akwan bɛn so na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛsiw kwan: Sika a ɛnni h. Mmeammea a ɛwɔ nkuraaseɛ a nnipa ntumi nkɔ hɔ pii. Yɛn tumi nhye nipa kuo a wɔn ho nhia ansoa no yie. Nyiyimu, Aniwu anaa ahoɔhia. Nkabom anaa nhyehyɛeɛ mu ahinkahinka. Yɛ bɛtumi ayɛ no sɛɛ: yɛdi Sika gu mu a, Nkabom anaa nhyehyɛeɛ, ne Mmoa anaa Akwantuo a yɛde hia nyimpa kuo bi
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne 'crisis counseling services' na sɛn na ɛboa mmabun a wɔ kɔ ɔhaw mu wɔ nna mu nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ mmoa a yɛde ma ntɛm so ara (immediate support) wɔ asiane bere mu. ɛma nateka mu mmoa (emotional support), hwɛ sɛ bammɔ wɔ hɔ, ne akwankyerɛ (referrals).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛmti anaa nsɛm a wɔtaa ka ho asɛm a mmabun betumi asusuw ho wɔ afotu nhyiamu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apomoden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asusuw nsɛmti ne nsɛm ahorow ho wɔ afotu nhyiam ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Abusuabɔ ne ayɔnkofa a wɔbɛfa so ate pene a wɔpene so ne ahye a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden ase Nkate horow a ɛfa nyinsɛn mu ehu anaa gyinaesi ahorow ho a wobedi ho dwuma Nsusuwii akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne nea wɔde di dwuma ho nna mu yareɛ a wohu anaa nea ɛhaw adwene a wobedi ho dwuma Nipadua mfonini ne nsɛm a ɛfa obu a obi wɔ ho a wobedi ho dwuma a wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa ama osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayade ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na me gyinapɛn ne me gyidie ahorow ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow anaa atipɛnfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ne abusuabɔ ho hyia anaasɛ ɛbɔ abira?
answer_twi_source: Ebia wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow bi anaa atipɛnfo akwanhwɛ ahorow bi a ɛfa nna ho dwumadi ne abusuabɔ ho no bɛyɛ pɛ, bere a ɛne afoforo bɔ de abira no. Ɛtaa ba sɛ mmabun behyia nhyɛso sɛ wɔnyɛ gyinapɛn ahorow bi, nanso ɛho hia sɛ wokae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubekura gyidi ahorow mu na woasi gyinae ahorow a ɛne w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow hyia, sɛ ɛsono w’atipɛnfo anaa ɔmanfo de mpo a. W’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow a wobɛte ase na woabu no betumi aboa wo ma woadi saa ntawntawdi ahorow yi so na woasisi gyinae ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware ma w’ankasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atosɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenem ahokwasan ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn atew nokwasɛm ne ayɛsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ pii wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenem ahokwasan  ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Atosɛm: Nnuru a wɔde di dwuma yɛ mmerɛwyɛ anaa abrabɔ pa ho huammɔdi ho sɛnkyerɛnne "Sign of Weakness or Moral Failure". Atosɛm: Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma yɛ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so gyina adwennwen anaa adwenemyare ano. Atosɛm: "Nnubɔne a emu yɛ den" te sɛ "heroin" anaa "cocaine" nkutoo na epira, bere a nsa anaa wii a wɔnom no nyɛ asiane biara. Atosɛm: Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma yɛ amanne a wɔyɛ wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu anaasɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛbɛtetew nokwasɛm ne ayɛsɛm mu denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a yɛbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, afotufo, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyare mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ho adesua a edi mũ wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi: Wɔahyehyɛ asuafo akuw anaa aku de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔakasa nna ho adesua a edi mũ akyerɛ. Kyerɛw nkrataa kɔma sukuu so ahwɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ananmusifo. Yɛ nhyiamu, nhyiamu, anaa nsɛm a wɔbɛka ho nhyehyɛeɛ de akyerɛkyerɛ atipɛnfoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ. Fa abɛɛfo ntetan di dwuma de kyɛ nsɛm na boaboa mmoa ano. Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔsatu anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awoɔ apomoden hokwan ahorow so no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so ahu na wɔako atia nkrasɛm a epira a ɛma basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, nhyɛso, ne abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa a ɛkɔ so wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hu na wɔko tia nkrasɛm a epira wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no bi ne: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wobenya de agye nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ho kyim na wɔayɛ mu nhwehwɛmu. Tumi mu nkɔso ne nkrasɛm ahorow a ɛhyɛ ase a ɛma basabasayɛ anaa nhyɛso yɛ nea ɛfata wɔ abusuabɔ mu a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Bɔbeasu ne nna ho mfonini a edi mu na obu wom a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne awofo bɛbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ suban ne nneyɛe so ho.
