Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ɔsatu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a epira na ɛhyɛ abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran a wɔbɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ migyaw nna mu nyarewa (STI) bi a wɔansa a, dɛn na ɛba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wogyaw nna mu nyarewa (STI) a wɔansa no a, ebetumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba, a nea ɛka ho ne: "Pelvic inflammatory disease" (PID) wɔ mmea mu, a ebetumi ama wontumi nwo na wɔate ɛyaw a enni sabea. Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya kokoram ahorow bi. Nnna mu nyarewa (STI) no a wɔde bɛma wo hokafo ne wɔn akwahosan ho haw ahorow a ebetumi aba. Nsɛnnennen a ɛba wɔ nyinsɛn mu ma ɛnanom a wɔwɔ nna mu nyarewa (STIs).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmeae bi a ɛsi so dua na ɛka obiara ho a mmabun a wɔte ase a wɔadi dɛm betumi ne afoforo adi nkitaho na wɔanya mmoa ama wɔn adwenemyare?
answer_twi_source: Mmeaeɛ bi a wobɛtumi ne afoforɔ abɔ mu (Places to connect):Akuo a wɔpere ma nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ho kwan (Disability rights organizations): Mpɛn pii no, wɔwɔ mmoa akuo anaa nhyehyɛeɛ soronko ma mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ.Nsraban anaa abɛfo ntentan so mpɔtam ma nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm (Disability-specific camps or online communities): Fa wo ho bɔ afoforɔ a mo nyinaa wɔ dɛm koro no ara.Afotu akuo (Therapy groups): Akuo a wɔasiesie wɔn ho titiriw ma mmaayewa a wɔwɔ dɛm bɛtumi ayɛ baabi pa a wobɛnya mmoa kɛseɛ.Abɛfo ntentan so nkɔmɔdie (Online forums): Fa abɛfo ntentan so nkɔmɔdie (forums) bɔ afoforɔ a wɔwɔ dɛm bi mu a ɛnkyerɛ wo din.Sɛnea wobɛhwehwɛ mmeaeɛ a nkabom wom (Finding Inclusive Spaces):Hwehwɛ no abɛfo ntentan so (Search online): Hwehwɛ akuo anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam a wɔsi dɛm ne adwene mu apɔwmuden so dua.Kasa kyerɛ wo dɔkota anaa afotufoɔ (Talk to your doctor or therapist): Wobɛtumi ahu mmoa mmeaeɛ a ɛbɛn wo a wɔn nim ho asɛm.Dwene abɛfo ntentan so mpɔtam ho (Consider online communities): Sɛ wote baabi a ɛkyiri na kwan nni hɔ a, yei bɛtumi ayɛ kwan pa a wobɛfa so anya mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ pii wɔ anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa ɔbaabun, anigye, ne brayɛ ho. Adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne STI (nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu) ho abu so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, brayɛ yɛ nnome a efi aguamammɔ mu, eyi yɛ anansesɛm. Mpɛn pii no, brayɛ ba titire wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mihu berɔ a meresisi gyinae no?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: "Worentumi nnyinsɛn bere a edi kan a wo ne obi bɛda no." Nokwasɛm: Nyinsɛn betumi aba berɔ biara a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nna a wommɔ ho ban mu, a nna mu osuahu a woadi kan anya mfa ho. Atosɛm: "Awoɔ ho nnuro ma wo mu duru yɛ kɛse." Nokwasɛm: Bere a ankorankoro binom betumi anya nsakrae wɔ wɔn mu duru mu wɔ nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde hormone di dwuma mu no, ɛnyɛ amansan nyinaa mu nkɛntɛnso bɔne ma obiara. Atosɛm: "Kɔndɔm ntumi nsiw STI ano." Nokwasɛm: Kɔndɔm ma bɔmmɔ kɛse wɔ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ, sɛ obi benya STI no so tew mu bere a wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kwan pa ho nsusuii ne nsɛnnennen a ɛbata mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe mu, te sɛ data kokoamsɛm, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, anaa digital mpaapaemu ho?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe mu no ma kwan pa ho nsusuwii ne nsɛnnennen sɔre, a nea ɛka ho ne: Data kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ: Mmabun ankasa akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban afi hokwan a wonni ho kwan, data a wobu so, ne nea wɔde bedi dwuma ho no ho hia na ama wɔakura ahotoso ne kokoamsɛm mu. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne digitall akenkan ne akyerɛw: Sɛ wɔhwɛ hu sɛ digital akwan horow so de nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu a egyina adanse so bɛma no boa ma wɔko tia nsɛm a ɛnteɛ na ɛhyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu. Digitals mpaepaemu: Nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ mfiridwuma, intanɛt nkitahodiɛ, ne digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ nnipa akuo ahodoɔ mu a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma no hwɛ ma wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ASRH dwumadie a mfiridwuma tumi ma mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow betumi adi de aboa na wɔde nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim no adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi ama asɛnka agua ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim denam baabi, nneɛma, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ adwumayɛ mu no so. Wobetumi de nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim aka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho, na ama asuafo anya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ afi wɔn atipɛnfo hɔ. Sukuu ahorow betumi ama ntetee a wɔde ma atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo no ayɛ mmerɛw na wɔde akwankyerɛ ama wɔ adesua nhyehyɛe ne nhyiam nhyehyɛe ho. Wobetumi nso ne abɔnten so ahyehyɛde ahorow ne abenfo ayɛ biako de ahwɛ ahu sɛ nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim no bɛyɛ adwuma yiye na akɔ so atra hɔ daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho afa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ne ne di ho, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ nsɛm a edi mu na wobetumi asi gyinae a tumi wom wɔ wɔn nna mu apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho afa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho denam nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a wobenya te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din, nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wobenya so. Ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware de asi gyinae a tumi wom wɔ nna mu apomoden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne animtiaabu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛhaw ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV"?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu kyerɛ suban bɔne, gyidi, ne nneyɛe bɔne a wɔde kyerɛ ankorankoro anaa akuw a egyina su ahorow bi te sɛ wɔn akwahosan tebea so. Animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV" ho no betumi ama wɔayɛ nyiyim, adwemmɔne, na wɔapow nnipa a wɔte saa tebea horow yi wɔ asetra mu. Ebetumi aka wɔn adwenemyare, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne wɔn asetra pa wɔ ɔkwan a enye so. Animtiaabu nso betumi ama ankorankoro abam abu sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɔhwɛ, ayaresa, anaa mmoa adwuma esiane suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaa nyiyim nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma m'asua pii afa nkitahodi a etu mpɔn a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a obi wɔ sɛ wotu nyinsɛn gu ho? (adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so akwankyerɛ ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo bɛma wo ɛho nneɛma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi a wɔbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow de ɔkwan a egyina nnipa akwannya ahorow so ho, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wodi akwannya ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm, kokoam nsɛm, nidi, ne fahodi a wɔwɔ no so na wodi so?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi a Wɔde Nimdeɛ Yɛ: Nhyehyɛe ahorow si akwannya a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm a edi mu, kokoam nsɛm, ne fahodi wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho no so dua. Nyiyim a Wɔnyɛ: Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no hyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa ahorow ahorow ho nkuran, na ɛhwɛ hu sɛ akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nya nhomasua ne nnwuma a nyiyim biara nni ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya tema ne ntease wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu de aboa wɔn ankasa ne afoforo adwene mu apomoden?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya tema denam afoforo a wɔde nsiyɛ tie wɔn, wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ obi foforo mpaboa mu, na wɔahu afoforo atinka na wɔagye atum no so. Sɛ yɛte ase sɛ ɛsono sɛnea obiara nya nsɛnnennen ne atenka ahorow a, ebetumi aboa ma wɔaboa wɔn ankasa ne afoforo nyinaa adwenemyare.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, wɔn a wɔnya nipa so nsunsuanso, ne content creators betumi aka wɔn ho abom adi dwuma de boa nna mu akwahosan, nipadua ho mfonini, ne nkitahodie pa ne deɛ wodebɛko atia nsɛmmɔne ne animtiaabu su wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ atitiriw mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a wɔne Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔfo ne Wɔn a Wɔnya nipa so Nsunsuanso: Mmabun ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, wɔn a wɔnya nipa so nsunsuanso, ne content creators betumi aka wɔn ho abom adi dwuma de boa nna mu akwahosan, nipadua ho mfonini, ne nkitahodie pa. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako so no, wobetumi abom ayɛ nsɛm a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu, de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, na aka osuahu ahorow a obiaa wo abom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahobammɔ abien ma wonya ahobammɔ koraa fi nyinsɛn ne STI ho? (Ka anohyeto ahorow ho asɛm)
answer_twi_source: Ɛwom sɛ banbɔ mmienu (dual protection) no boa paa, nanso ɛnyɛ nea ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ a mfomsoɔ biara nni mu. Anohyeto ahorow bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Di a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye: Sɛ wɔamfa ɔkwan abien no mu biara nni dwuma yiye bere biara a, ne mmɔdenbɔ so tew. Nnipa mfomso: Mfomso betumi asi, te sɛ nea wo werɛ befi aduru a wɔde kum ɔyare mmoawa anaa kɔndɔm a ɛhwe ase. STI ahorow bi: Ɛnyɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano nyinaa na ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban fi STI nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ho mfonini ahorow bi a wɔtaa yɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka ntease a mmabun wɔwɔ nsɛm yi ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa de nna, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho mfonini a ɛyɛ teateaa na ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ katee a broni ka no sɛ ɛkyerɛ 'narrow and stereotypical' ma, na ɛhyɛ atetesɛm mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow mu den. Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne: 'Heteronormative' mfonini ahorow a ɛfa ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ ho. Bɔbeasu ho adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔyɛ mmarima ho mfonini sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa a wodi tumi na wɔyɛ mmea sɛ wɔnyɛ hwee anaasɛ wɔyɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ biribiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi abom ayɛ akwan horow a yɛbɛfa so ahwɛ yɛn ho ne nkate mu nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛboa me ma makura m’adwene ne nkate fam akwahosan mu bere a merenyin na manyin no?
answer_twi_source: Hu dwumadi anaa anigyede ahorow a ɛde anigye ne ahomegye brɛ wo, na fa bere a wode bɛhwɛ wo ho no di kan daa. Yɛ nhyehyɛe a wode bɛhwɛ wo ho so, te sɛ journaling(W'adwene mu nsɛm kyerɛw), adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔka, anaa berɛ a wode bɛtra abɔde mu. Fa nkate mu nhyehyɛe ho akwan te sɛ adwene mu nsusuwii, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde si fam, anaa adwinni a wɔde da nsɛm adi di dwuma. Hwehwɛ animdefo akwankyerɛ anaa ayaresa sɛ worepere sɛ wubedi wo nkate horow ho dwuma anaasɛ wobɛkura w’adwene ne nkate fam akwahosan mu yiye a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wɔn nnamfo adi nkitaho yiye wɔ ahye a wɔde besi hɔ ne atipɛnfo su bɔne a wɔbɛko atia a wɔrensɛe wɔn nkitahodie?
answer_twi_source: Di Nokware na Ka deɛ ɛwom: Ka wo nkate, wo hye, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw wo ho asɛm pefee na fa nokwaredi kyerɛ wo nnamfo. Fa "Me" Nsɛm Di Dwuma: Fa "Me" nsɛm da wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate adi na woakwati sɛ wobɛbɔ afoforo sobo. Fa Nneɛma Foforo Ma: Fa akwan foforo a mobɛfa so anya bere abom a ɛne mo gyinapɛn ne nea w’ani gye ho hyia ho nyansahyɛ ma. Fa Ahye Si Hɔ Pii: Ka w’ahye ne gyinaesi ahorow ho asɛm pefee, na hwɛ sɛ wode bedi dwuma bere nyinaa mu. Paw Bere ne Beae a Ɛfata: Mommɔ nkɔmmɔ fa ahye ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho wɔ kokoam mmeae a wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na wowɔ ahobammɔ. Tie na Gye Mu: Tie wo nnamfo adwene ne wɔn haw ahorow yie, na sɛ wo ne wɔn adwene nhyia mpo a, si wɔn nkate so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asi gyinae sɛ ebia ankorankoro ayaresa, kuw ayaresa, anaa mmoa foforo eye ma me anaa?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro ayaresa ma wɔde adwene si obiara so, bere a kuw ayaresa ma atipɛnfo mmoa ne osuahu ahorow a wɔkyɛ. Susuw w’awerɛkyekye dodow, ne nsɛnnennen pɔtee a worehyia no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow nya adwene a mewɔ wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow, nipasu, ne nsɛm a wɔda no adi wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ ho no so nsusuansobɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow na ɛkyerɛ wo nsusuwii wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nipasu, ne nsɛm a woda no adi wɔ nna mu nkitahodie ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, sɛ wugye di sɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne obu ma ankorankoro ahofadi a, wubetumi abu abusuabɔ sɛ fekubɔ a egyina wɔn baanu nyinaa pene ne nkitahodi so sen sɛ wubebu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so. Wo gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nea wɔda no adi ho nso nya sɛnea wote nipasu ahorow a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu ase na wubu no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna ho gyinaesi a mesi no yɛ nea obuo wom, mepenee so, na ɛhyɛ m’ankasa ne afoforo ahofadi ne wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no so dua?
answer_twi_source: Mpene so ntease: Fa pene di kan bere nyinaa wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu. Mpene a wɔpene so kyerɛ sɛ wɔde ma kwa, wotumi dane no, wɔde amanneɛbɔ ma, wɔde anigye, na wɔyɛ no pɔtee. Nkitahodi: Wo ne wo hokafo nka akɔnnɔ, ahye, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Bu wɔn ahye na ka wo de ho asɛm pefee. Bu a Wobebu Ahofadi: Hu sɛ obiara wɔ hokwan sɛ ɔpaw nea ɔpɛ wɔ ne nipadua ho. Kwati sɛ wobɛhyɛ obiara anaasɛ wobɛhyɛ no ma wakɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ ne ho. Sɛnea Wobɛkɔ: Sɛ worekɔ nna mu a, wo ne wo hokafo kɔ hɔ na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn ho atɔ no. Sɛ w’adwene mu yɛ wo naa a, gyae na susuw biribiara a ɛhaw wo ho ansa na woatoa so. Wo Ho a Wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ: Sua abusuabɔ pa ne nna mu akwahosan ho ade. Te hia a ɛho hia sɛ wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho na wɔyɛ pɛ wɔ abusuabɔ mu no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu anigyeɛ, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwehwɛ m’ankasa m’akɔnnɔ mu na mate ase
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu anigye yɛ anigye ne abotɔyam ho atenka a ebetumi afi dwumadi ahorow mu aba, a nea ɛka ho ne honam fam nsa a wɔde ka obi, nkate mu abusuabɔ, ne ne ho a ɔhwehwɛ mu. W’akɔnnɔ ahorow a wobɛhwehwɛ mu no yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛma wonyin. Ɛfa nea ɛte sɛ nea eye ma wo, honam ne nkate fam nyinaa a wobɛte ase ho. Akwan bi a wobɛfa so ahwehwɛ w’ankasa akɔnnɔ ne nea wopɛ mu wɔ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom so ni: Fa w’adwene si wo ho a wode bɛka wo ho so: Hwɛ wo nipadua no afã horow a sɛ woka wo ho a, ɛma wo ho ye. Sɛ obi de ne nsa ka obi a, ɛte sɛ nea ɛma ahomegye anaa ɛyɛ anigye? Hwehwɛ wo nsusuwii hunu mu: Fa w’adwene bu tebea horow a ɛte sɛ nea ɛyɛ anigye anaa anigye. Eyi betumi aboa wo ma woate nea ebia w’ani begye ho wɔ daakye abusuabɔ mu ase. Wo ne wo nnamfo a wotumi de ho to wo so anaa akwahosan ho ɔbenfo nkasa: Wobetumi de nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu nkɔso a ɛfata ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkamfo nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛbɛkɔ nnipa nyinaa nkyɛn pɛpɛɛpɛ so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ɛfata sɛ obiara nya nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma. Sɛ yɛbɛ kasa ama obiara womu ɛfa nna mu apomoden adesua ho wɔ sukuu so ekyerɛ w’atipɛnfo: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nkuran. Boa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ yɛ adwuma: Fa wo bere ma anaasɛ ma nkurɔfo hu wɔn adwuma. Kasa tia nyiyim: Sɛ wuhu sɛ wɔrebu obi atɛn wɔ ne nna mu apomoden ho a, twa saa suban ahorow no mpoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asiesie akasakasa yie wɔ kwan pa so?
answer_twi_source: Brɛ wo ho ase 'Stay Calm'. Fa 'me' anodisɛm 'I Statements' di dwuma. Tie yie. Hwehwɛ sɛ monyinaa kɔ bɛnkoro (Common Ground). Twentwɛn so 'break' sɛ ɛhia a na hwehwɛ ntamgyinafo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so akyerɛ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ase anaasɛ wɔasan akyerɛ ase ma ɛka LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana, amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuakuo de wɔn gyidi ne wɔn amammerɛ atifi kyerɛe sɛ LGBTQ+ ne amanmra nhyehyɛe mmɔ mu, sɛnea wɔn gyidi atitiriw ne nneyɛe nnyinaso kyerɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee di ahiade pɔtee anaa nsɛnnennen a mmabun a wɔato wɔn sintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa yie hyia no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee di ahiade pɔtee anaa nsɛnnennen a mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa yie hyia no ho dwuma denam: Ntetee a wɔde ma wɔ ahosiesie a wɔde yɛ adwuma ho: Nhyehyɛe ahorow no de ntetee ma wɔ nimdeɛ a ɛho hia te sɛ nkitahodi, kuw adwuma, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne adwumayɛbea abrabɔ pa ho de siesie mmabun ma adwuma. Afotuo ne mmoa a wɔde ma: Adwumayɛ mu nteteeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ taa ka afotuo afã ahodoɔ a wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya akwankyerɛ, nteteeɛ, ne mmoa firi adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa hɔ. Nkɔsoɔ ne obiara a wɔbɛka ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ: Nneɛma a wɔayɛ no botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun a wɔfiri mmusua ahodoɔ mu anya adwumayɛ hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ, a wɔn a wɔrehyia akwansideɛ te sɛ ohia, nyiyim, anaa nwomasua a wɔnnya ka ho. Nnwuma a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata ankorankoro ahiade: Dwumadi ahorow betumi de mmoa nnwuma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn, te sɛ kasa mu mmoa, dabere a wɔde ma mmubuafo, anaa akwantu ho mmoa ama, de adi wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ahiade soronko ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw bɛn na ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a etu mpɔn a wɔde siw ano no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛma ankorankoro tumi ma wohu nna mu basabasayɛ na wɔyɛ ho biribi?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn a wɔde siw ano no mu bi ne: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodie pa, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ no a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no ahiade ne wɔn nkɔso. Ntetee a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wobehu, de wɔn ho gye mu dwoodwoo na etu mpɔn, ne mmoa a wobenya ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ho. Hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ ahokokwaw ne dwumadi a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi nkitahodi, asɛm a wɔka no denneennen, ne ahye a wɔde si hɔ wɔ nnipa ntam nkitahodi mu. Amammerɛ mu nkate ne ahodwiriw ho nimdeɛ akwan a ɛhu na ɛdi wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no nipasu ne suahunu a ɛtwam no ho dwuma. Nkɔmmɔdie ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛda wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ahodoɔ ntam, a sukuu ahodoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo, mmarahyɛ bagua, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ka ho. Nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so de susuw nsunsuanso a mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw ano no nya, kyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn, na wɔsakra akwan horow a egyina nsɛm a wɔka ne nsɛm a wɔde ma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔde redi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ASRH mu no yɛ nea ɛfa nhyiamu ho na ɛdi ahiadeɛ ne nsɛnnennen pɔtee a LGBTQ+ mmabun, aborɔfoɔ mmabun, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, ne akuo foforɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua hyia no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ ama mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ASRH mu a ɛwɔ nhyiamu ahodoɔ mu no bi ne: Wɔbɛma mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ ne nnipa nyinaa bɛka ho ama LGBTQ+ mmabun, aborɔfoɔ mmabun, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, ne akuo foforɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wɔbɛka wɔn haw ne wɔn nneɛma a ɛhia paa. Adwene ahodoɔ a wɔde bɛka gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ ho denam nkɔmmɔdie a mmabun di anim, afotufoɔ bagua, ne nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ a atipɛnfoɔ di anim so. Mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde asi wɔn ani so a wɔde bɛma ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim ne nnwuma a ɛtwe adwene si ahiadeɛ pɔtee ne nsɛnnennen a akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua hyia no ho dwuma. Tumi a wɔbɛkyekyere wɔ mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no mu sɛ wɔbɛkamfo akwan a wɔfa so yɛ ASRH a ɛfa ntam denam ntetee, afotu, ne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne m’awofo anaa m’abusua mufo adi nkitaho wɔ m’adwene mu apomuden ho nsem ho haw ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Paw bere a wo ho dwo na woyɛ kokoam de fi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase. Di nokware na da wo atenka ne osuahu ahorow ho asɛm pefee. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma de da wo nsusuwii adi, te sɛ "Mate nka..." Fa nhwɛso pɔtee bi ma na aboa wɔn ma wɔate nea worefa mu no ase. Kyerɛ mmoa ko a wuhia fi wɔn hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔadi abrabɔ pa ɔhaw ne nsɛnnennen a wohyia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu a wɔde di dwuma a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho ɔhaw a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no so. Ebia eyinom bi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ nokwasɛm ahorow wɔ Intanɛt so, wɛbsaet ahorow a wogye di ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ nna ho apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ titiriw, ne atipɛnfo mmoa akuo. Mmabun nso betumi ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, a wobetumi de afotu ne mmoa ama wɔ abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Ɛdenam saa nneɛma ne nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow yi a mmaabun nya so no, wobetumi anya wɔn nimdeɛ ne ahotoso wɔ abrabɔ pa a wɔbɛpaw wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa akwankyerɛ 'resorces or guidance' bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma madi nsɛnnennen anaa ntawntawdi a ɛwɔ atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow mu, te sɛ adwene a enhyia, ahotoso a wobu so, anaa kokoamsɛm anaa ahobammɔ ho dadwen, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa bere a ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛdi nsɛnnennen anaa ntawntawdie a ɛwɔ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ mu no bi ne: Afotuo ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afiri mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di, afotufoɔ, anaa akwankyerɛfoɔ a wɔhwɛ nkitahodiɛ no so, akwankyerɛ ne ntamgyinafoɔ a wɔde bɛma wɔ ntawntawdie a wɔbɛsiesie mu. Akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ ne mmara a ɛwɔ fam a wɔde besi hɔ ama nkitahodi, kokoamsɛm, ne ntawantawadi ano aduru wɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe no mu, a wɔbɛhyɛ obu ne akontaabu amammerɛ ho nkuran. Afotuo dwumadie anaa adwenemyareɛ mmoa a wɔbɛnya sɛ ɛho hia a wɔde bedi nsɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a ɛka kuw no nkɔsoɔ ne ankorankoro yiedie ho dwuma. Intanɛt so nneɛma, nhyiamu, anaa mmoa nhama a wɔde ama atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ne ntawntawdie ano aduru a wɔde bedi dwuma, de mmoa a wɔmmɔ din ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛfa tebea a emu yɛ den mu ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kokoamsɛm ne kokoam yɛ adwuma wɔ afotu ne mmoa adwuma a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm: Ahintasɛm kyerɛ sɛ nea wo ne wo fotufo susuw ho no da so ara yɛ kokoam. Wɔmfa nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ nhyiam ahorow ase no nkyerɛ obiara a wunnyaa ho kwan. Mmara kwan so nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayi afi mu, te sɛ sɛ asiane wɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛpira wo ho anaa afoforo. Kokoamsɛm: Wɔyɛ nhyiam ahorow no wɔ kokoam tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom mu na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie. Wɔde w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm ne wo kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow sie kokoamsɛm na ahobammɔ wom. Anohyeto Ahorow a Ɛwɔ Ahintasɛm Mu: Afotufo bɛkyerɛkyerɛ anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm mu wɔ ayaresa no mfiase. Wɔbɛkyerɛ tebea horow a ebia ebehia sɛ wobu kokoam nsɛm, te sɛ sɛ ayayade anaa asiane bi wɔ hɔ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne ɔmanfo nsɛm ho ɔsatu ahorow adi dwuma de ahyɛ nna ne dɛmdifo ho nsɛm pa ho nkuran, na wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne ɔmanfoɔ ho ɔsatuo bɛtumi ahyɛ nna ne dɛmdiɛ ho nsɛm pa ho nkuran na wɔakasa atia adwene a ɛnteɛ ne adwene a ɛnteɛ denam nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini ahodoɔ a wɔbɛda no adi, wɔn suahunu ne wɔn nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so, ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden hokwan ne dwumadie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛtaa kyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛnteɛ anaa ayayade "unhaelthy or abusive relaionship", na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu frankaa kɔkɔɔ anaa kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtaa ba a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade no bi ne: Ahyɛde: Ɔhokafo biako bɔ mmɔden sɛ obedi ɔfoforo no nneyɛe, ne gyinaesi, anaa ne nneyɛe so. Ahoɔyaw: Ahoɔyaw a ɛboro so anaasɛ obi a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu, a ɛma wɔbɔ ɔfoforo no sobo anaasɛ ɔhwɛ ne dwumadi so. Tew a Wɔtew ne Ho "Isolation": Ɔhokafo biako tew ne ho fi nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow ho. Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so: Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so te sɛ afobu a wɔde to obi so, gaslighting, anaa nhyɛso. Honam fam, Atinka fam, anaa kasa mu ayayade: Honam fam basabasayɛ, atinka mu nsakrae, anaa kasa mu ntua biara. Mmabun betumi ahu frankaa kɔkɔɔ anaa kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne denam wɔn nkate a wɔde wɔn ho bɛto so, afotu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne ahwɛfo no betumi aboa ma wɔde CSE aka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ ne ahwɛfo no bɛtumi aboa CSE a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ho denam nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛfata wɔn mfeɛ a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn gyidie hyia a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so. Wɔbɛtumi ne sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ yɛfoɔ adi nkitaho de akyerɛ wɔn mmoa a wɔde ma CSE ne hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛka obiara ho ma asuafoɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne mmofra nya wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho wɔ fie nso betumi ahyɛ nkrasɛm ne ahokokwaw a wɔnam CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow so sua no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de abɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a wɔde Intanɛt so ahokyere ho dwumadie ho dwumadie redi dwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu adwumayɛbea ahorow de akwan horow di dwuma de bɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ho ban, te sɛ nkitahodi akwan a wɔabɔ no kokoam, data a wɔde sie a ahobammɔ wom, ne kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den. Ebia wɔbɛma akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi nkitaho a wɔmmɔ wɔn din nso de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm bɛto hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na sukuu horow betumi atu de ayɛ mmeae a obiara bɛka ho ama LGBTQ+ asuafo asusuw nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ, ne abusuabɔ a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adesua mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi atu anammɔn pii de ayɛ mmeae a ɛka obiara ho ama asuafo asusuw nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, ne abusuabɔ a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Eyi betumi ayɛ, mmoa kuw anaa akuw a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama asuafo a wɔwɔ ahiade soronko, ntetee a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfo a wɔde nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛko tia ayayade a ɛfa ɔhaw ho pɔtee di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na kasa di wɔ animtiaabu a ɛkɔ so wɔ nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ho no mu, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn de kasa a ɛka obiara ho adi dwuma de atew so?
answer_twi_source: Kasa di dwuma titiriw wɔ animtiaabu a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ wɔ nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ho no mu denam: - Nsɛmfua a ɛyɛ animtiaabu anaa atemmu a ɛhyɛ nsusuwii bɔne ne aniwu mu den, te sɛ "fĩ," "ɔyare mmoawa," anaa "ɔyarefo" a wɔde bedi dwuma. - a wode bɛbata STI anaa HIV ho ne abrabɔ pa ho atemmu anaa asodi, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ankorankoro fata wɔn tebea no esiane nneyɛe a wosusuw sɛ ɛyɛ "asiane" nti. - a wode kasa tia a esi ehu, akyide, anaase mmɔborohunu so dua, sene tema, nteasee, ne mmoa a wode bedi dwuma. Kasa a ɛka obiara ho a wɔde bedi dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ: - Kasa a onipa di kan a esi ankorankoro no so dua sen akwahosan tebea a wɔde bedi dwuma, te sɛ "onipa a ɔwɔ HIV" sen sɛ wɔde "onipa a ɔwɔ HIV" bedi dwuma. - a wobekwati nsem a ebu animtiaa anaase atemmuo na mmom wode kasa a enni afã biara anaase obuo bedi dwuma de akyerkyer STI anaa HIV mu. - a wobɛhyɛ kasa a ɛma wonya tema, nteaseɛ, ne gye a wɔgye tom ma ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI anaa HIV , berɛ a wɔkasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Suban bɛn na mmabun a wɔyɛ adwuma di yie wɔ na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya saa su ahorow yi na ama hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wobedi yiye no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Su ahorow: Adebɔ, nneɛma foforo, nsakrae, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, bo a wɔasi, asiane a wɔde to obi so, akannifo, nkitahodi, anigye, adesua a ɛkɔ so. Fa: Nsa mu osuahu, afotu, nkitahodi, nhyehyɛe/akansi
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a nkitahodi ne obu a wobedi hokafo apɛde ho hia bere a worepaw akwan horow no so dua.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wo ne wo hokafo benya no ho hia bere a worepaw akwan abien a wobɛfa so abɔ wo ho ban no. Bu nea wɔpɛ na munsusuw nea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma mo baanu nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔbɛfa so akyerɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛko ama nsakrae a ɛtena hɔ daa, a wɔde bɛba nhyehyɛe, anaa asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa "ASRR" ahorow ho mu? (Akwan ne botae ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma bere tenten)
answer_twi_source: Susuw nneɛma ho kɛse! Akwan bi a wobɛfa so ama wo mmɔdenbɔ a wode bɛbɔ wo ho ban no akɔ so atena hɔ ni: Fa Bere Tenten Botae Si Hɔ: Hu nsakrae pɔtee bi a wopɛ sɛ wuhu na yɛ nhyehyɛe a wode bedu ho bere tenten. Yɛ Nkitahodi: Wo ne ahyehyɛde afoforo anaa wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm a ɛte saa ara ho no nyɛ biako. Di Wo Nkɔso akyi: Hwɛ nsakrae a aba wɔ nhyehyɛe anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na di wo nkonimdi ahorow ho afahyɛ wɔ kwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfe a obi adi anohyeto anaa ahwehwɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ telefon so akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu bere a ɔbabun?
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ anohyeto a wɔde ma wɔ telefon so akwahosan ho dwumadie ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nea ɔde ma, atenaeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmara so. Mpɛn pii no, mmabun betumi de akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so adi dwuma wɔ wɔn ankasa mu, titiriw wɔ awo ne nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, a enhia sɛ awofo pene so. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ telehealth service anaa akwahosan ho dwumadie pɔtee no nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mfeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ ne pene a wɔpene so ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Afotu ne mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun wɔ nna mu nsɛm ne awo mu apɔwmuden 'sexual health' ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne: Nkitahodi ne adɔkotafo 'Individual Counseling' . W'atipɛnfo nkitahodi 'Peer Support Groups'. Ahomatrofo so nkitahodi 'Hotlines'. Abɛɛfo ntentan nkitahodi 'Online Forums'. Abusua nkyerɛkyerɛ ne adesua 'Family Counseling'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya suban ne nneyɛe pa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho 'SRH' wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Fa nna mu akwahosan ne nneyɛe pa ho nsɛm a, edi mu na ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma. Hyɛ Nsɛmmisa Ho Nkuran: Yɛ tebea a mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wobebisa nsɛm. Suban a Ɛma Apɔwmuden Ho Nhwɛso: Awofo betumi ayɛ abusuabɔ a ɛfata, nkitahodi, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho ho nhwɛso. Hyɛ Asɛde Ho Nkɔso: Kyerɛkyerɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so, nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano. Munsusuw Gyinapɛn Ho: Ka gyinapɛn ahorow te sɛ obu, tema, ne asɛde wɔ abusuabɔ mu ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm pa a wɔde si so dua ahorow bi a metumi de akae me ho sɛ mesom bo ne m’ahoɔden bere a mihyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye no?
answer_twi_source: Mefata obu ne gye tom sɛnea mete no ara pɛ. "Mewɔ ahotoso wɔ m'atinka ne gyinaesi ahorow mu, bere mpo a ɛsono no wɔ me tipɛnfo de ho no." "Me ho yɛ den na metumi gyina nea megye di no akyi." "Ɛnyɛ afoforo adwene anaa wɔn akwanhwɛ na ɛkyerɛ me bo a ɛsom." "Mepaw nokware ne nokwaredi sen sɛnea ɛne ne ho hyia ne nea wɔpene so."
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ nyinsɛn, awoɔ, ne awofoyɛ ho di wɔ ɛnanom apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi anya mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo adwene betumi anya ɛnamu apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya so nkɛntɛnso kɛse: Animtiaabu: Animtiaabu a ɛfa mmabun nyinsɛn ho no betumi ama wɔasuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, na asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ. Abusua mu Nkɔso: Ebia amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow bɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobu nyinsɛn wɔ abusua bi mu, na ɛbɛka mmoa ne gyinaesi. Kasa mu Akwanside: Kasa mu nsonsonoe betumi de nsɛnnennen aba akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu. Nyamesom mu Gyidi: Gyidi a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awo ho betumi anya gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa ɔhwɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho so nkɛntɛnso. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma: Amammerɛ mu Ɔhwɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ ahorow. Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Mpɔtam hɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi amammerɛ mu anansesɛm ahorow ho dwuma na ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔabue ano ho nkuran. Mmoa Nkitahodi: Mmoa akuw a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ amammerɛ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi ama mmabun a wɔyem anya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ. Mmabun nso betumi adi dwuma bi denam nsusuwii hunu a epira a wɔbɛkasa atia, amammerɛ mu ntease a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmusua ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no so. Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔahwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a wohia na ama wɔanya nyinsɛn ne awo a ahoɔden wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ne awo a wɔbɛkora so ho sɛ ɔbabun a merenyin?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi a nyansa wom a wubesi wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ne awo a wobɛkora so ho no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛboaboa nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a wubetumi apaw ho ano, asusuw wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow ho, na wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wogye  di asusuw wo haw ahorow ho. Wubetumi afi ase denam akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a wubesua na woate sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma no ase so. Sɛ w’ani gye awo a wɔbɛkora so ho, te sɛ nkesua anaa mmadwoa a wɔbɛkora so daakye a, wubetumi ne awo ho ɔbenfo bi a obetumi de ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ho nsɛm pii ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne pene a wɔpene so, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so kyerɛ kwan anaa pene a wɔde ma wɔ adeyɛ pɔtee bi ho, titiriw wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodi ho. Ɛho hia efisɛ ɛhwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa fi wɔn pɛ mu de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi biara mu, na wɔakura obu, ahobammɔ, ne ahofadi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ nyiyim, aniwu, ne kokoamsɛm a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho osuahu ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu boa ma: Nnipa mu nyiyim ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn a egyina wɔn nna anaa awo akwahosan tebea anaa wɔn nneyɛe so. Aniwu, aniwu, anaa asodi a wɔde to wɔn ho so a wɔte nka wɔ mmabun mu, na ɛma wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛda wɔn ahiade adi. Kokoamsɛm ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho osuahu ahorow ho, a ɛma gyinapɛn ahorow a epira kɔ so tra hɔ na esiw nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ntease a ɛboa ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem, a adan, sikasɛm mu mmoa, ne awofoyɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wobɛnya: Asetena mu Nnwuma: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ asetena mu nnwumakuo nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa adan ho mmoa, sikasɛm mu mmoa, ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔyem ho. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a Wɔnyɛ Mfaso: Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Planned Parenthood, March of Dimes, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a wɔhwɛ nyinsɛn ho nneɛma taa de nneɛma ne mmoa ma ankorankoro a wɔyem. Akwahosan ho Ɔhwɛfoɔ: W’akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ bɛtumi de wo abata nneɛma ho, te sɛ adesua a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo, awofoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmoa akuo. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ne wɛbsaet ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a wɔde ama sɛ wɔde nsɛm ne mmoa bɛma ankorankoro a wɔyem. Hwehwɛ mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow, nnwumakuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a agye din, ne nnuruyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nhyehyɛe: Mpɔtam pii de nhyehyɛe ahorow ma ankorankoro a wɔyem titiriw, te sɛ yoga adesua a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo, aduan pa ho adesua, ne akuw a wɔboa. Hwɛ mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae anaa akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow. Sikasɛm mu Mmoa: Sɛ wuhia sika fam mmoa a, bisa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ebetumi aboa wɔ ɛka a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awo ho no ho. Eyinom betumi ayɛ Medicaid, Mmea, Nkokoaa, ne Mmofra (WIC) nhyehyɛe, anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmoa nhyehyɛe. Awofoɔ Nhomasua: Hwehwɛ awofoɔ adesua anaa adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Eyinom betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo a ɛfa sɛnea wɔhwɛ abofra a wɔawo no foforo, nufu a wɔde ma, ne mmofraase nkɔso ho. Mmoa Akuw: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ kuw a wɔboa ankorankoro a wɔyem anaa awofo nkumaa mu a, ebetumi ama woanya mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ adwene ne afotu a ɛsom bo afi afoforo a wɔrefa osuahu a ɛte saa ara mu hɔ. Bisa W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no nyansahyɛ ahorow. Mpɛn pii no, wɔne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma wɔ abusuabɔ pa na wobetumi akyerɛ wo ɔkwan pa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na m’ankasa me ho, obuo a mewɔ ma me ho, ne ahotoso a mewɔ wɔ me ho di wɔ sɛnea meyɛ m’ade wɔ nhyɛso pa a m’atipɛnfo de ma no mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn anya adwene a emu yɛ den a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mesom bo na matumi agyina nkɛntɛnso bɔne ano?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wususuw wo ho, obuo a wubu wo ho, ne ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ wo ho no di dwuma titiriw wɔ sɛnea woyɛ w’ade wɔ nhyɛso pa a efi w’atipɛnfo hɔ ho no mu. Wo ho a wobɛte nka a emu yɛ den na woatumi agyina ano no betumi aboa wo: Ko tia nkɛntɛnso bɔne: Wo ho adwene pa betumi ama woatumi asi w’ahye so dua, asi gyinae ahorow a wode wo ho, na woako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa nsakrae. Hwehwɛ abusuabɔ pa: Obu ne ahotoso a ɛkorɔn ma wutumi hwehwɛ atipɛnfo a wɔboa wo a wobu w’ahofadi ne wo ankorankoro su, na ɛma wonya asetra mu abusuabɔ pa a ɛhyɛ wo yiyedi ne wo botae ahorow mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Ma Nhumu: Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam anaa nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe de ma nkurɔfo hu hia a nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia. Fi Nkɔmmɔbɔ ase: Wo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu so ahwɛfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akannifo mmɔ nkɔmmɔ mu wɔ hia a ehia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Bɔ na hwehwɛ mmoa: Wo ne mfɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa awofo a wɔwɔ adwene koro nyɛ apam na mombom nkamfo nsakrae nkyerɛ. Adesrɛ anaa Ɔsatu: Fi ase kyerɛw adesrɛ anaa ɔsatu bi fa kyerɛ sɛ mpɔtam hɔfo boa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ. Kyɛ Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Fa nneɛma ne nsɛm ma akyerɛkyerɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a ɛfa mfaso a ɛwɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodi di wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso "peer pressure" tebea horow a wɔde di dwuma yiye mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne atipɛnfo di no ma wonya ntease, obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, na wotumi da nea ɛhaw wɔn anaa ɛhye adi. Ka wo gyinapɛn "values" ahorow, nea wopɛ, ne wo hye ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ wo nnamfo, na ma ɛnyɛ mmerɛw mma wɔn sɛ wobebu wo gyinaesi ahorow. Fa nnamyɛ a wode betie asɛm no di dwuma: Tie wo nnamfo adwene ne wɔn dadwen bere a woda w’ankasa de nso adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi ne wɔn mmabun ayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dwumadi ahorow a wɔbom yɛ, te sɛ sini hwɛ,  nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ video so agodie, anaa abɛɛfo ntentan so nsɛm a wɔbom hwehwɛ mu, na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ntease wom ne osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ ayɛ mmerɛw?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ bɛtumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dwumadiɛ a wɔbom yɛ mu wɔ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛne mmabun anigyeɛ, wɔn gyinapɛn, ne wɔn nkɔsoɔ ahiadeɛ hyia a wɔbɛkyɛ na wɔasusu ho, te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nsɛm a wɔbɛhwɛ, nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  video so agodie a asɛmti pa wom, anaa  so nneɛma a wɔbɛbom ahwehwɛ mu. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa ho, abɛɛfo ntentan ɔman ba, Abɛɛfo ntentan so ahobammɔ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow ka ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔpaw na wɔhwɛ so, wɔn adwene a wɔbɛda no adi, na wɔasusuw wɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ne nea wɔpɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bi wɔhɔ ma me sɛ mesi gyinaeɛ bi a ɛde nsunsuansoɔ bɔne ba anaa?
answer_twi_source: Afotufoɔ, sukuu nurse, ne doktafoɔ betumi aboa wo wɔ mmerɛ ɛte saa mu. Wobetumi so ne mmabun a afa nyinsɛn pɛn adi ho nkɔmmɔ. Wɔbɛhyɛ wo nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow nya mmabun paw ne hokwan ahorow a ɛfa asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso ho so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi saa nneɛma yi ho dwuma de ahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne asetena mu nkabom ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow nya mmabun paw ne hokwan ahorow a ɛfa asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, na ɛkyerɛ wɔn adwuma ho apɛde, nhomasua akwan, ne nneɛma a wobenya. Mpɛn pii no, mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn ahorow na ɛkyerɛ atetesɛm mu dwumadi ne asɛyɛde ahorow, na ɛto mmeawa a wobetumi anya nhomasua, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow ano hye bere a wɔde toto mmarimaa ho no. Bɔbeasu mu nsusuwii hunu, animhwɛ, ne nyiyimu a wobedi ho dwuma no ho hia na ama mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne asetena mu nkabom anya nkɔso wɔ asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso mu, ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nyinaa benya nhomasua, ntetee, ne sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no yɛ kokoamsɛm na ahobammɔ wom, titire bere a wɔresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, Intanɛt so ahokyere ho dwumadie ahodoɔ de kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ di kan, titire berɛ a wɔresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no. Wɔde encryption ne nkitahodie akwan a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma de bɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kokoam nsɛm ho ban na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoamsɛm wɔ onipa no ne adwumayɛfo anaa atuhoamafo a wɔatete wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa ma adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ ne mmoa wɔ me sukuu, mpɔtam, anaa m’atipɛnfo kuw mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu Akwahosan yɛ asɛm a ɛho hia na wobɛtumi ayɛ akuo wɔ wo sukuu mu ne mpɔtam hɔ nso de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ. Wobetumi anya nneɛma pii afi Adwene ne Nkate Ho Akwahosan Aban hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu amma mmabun mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Nsunsunaso a ebefi mu aba no bi ne: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obenya nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ne nna mu yareɛ (STI) ahorow. Nna mu nhyɛso, ayayade, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so dodow a ɛkɔ soro. Ntease a wonni wɔ pene a wɔpene so, nyɔnkofa nkitahodie  pa, ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Animtiaabu ne nyiyim kɛse a wɔde ba akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua so. Awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmoa a wobetumi anya kakraa bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa tebea ahorow a ebia me kokoam nsɛm ne hia a ehia sɛ wohwɛ hu sɛ me ho bɛtɔ me ne me yiyedi abira, te sɛ me dwumadi a meyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so a yɛbɛhwɛ anaasɛ baabi a mewɔ akyi a yɛbɛhwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Gye tom sɛ ebia tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a wo kokoam nsɛm ne hia a ehia sɛ mehwɛ ma wo ahobammɔ ne wo yiyedi no bɔ abira. Kura nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow ho na fa ahye ahorow a ɛma kokoam nsɛm ne ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow kari pɛ sisi hɔ. Munsusuw ho na monpene akwan a ɛfata a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ intanɛt so dwumadi so anaasɛ wɔbɛhwɛ baabi a wowɔ no so, hwɛ hu sɛ ɛda adi pefee na ɛkyerɛ obu ma wo ahofadi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa  ama sɛnea wogyina  nnuho, fɛreɛ, anaa aniwuo a ɛfa nna ho ano?
answer_twi_source: Hu sɛ ɛyɛ ne kwan so nanso ɛnkyerɛ sɛ wonsom bo. Gye wo ho tom. Mfomsoɔ ka nyin h. Dɔ wo ho na kasa ma wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu apene, na sɛ manpene nna mu nneyɛe so a, hokwan bɛn na mewɔ? (Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde anigye pene so) .
answer_twi_source: Nna mu pene yɛ "yiw" a wɔde ma kwa, a wɔde anigye yɛ wɔ nna mu dwumadie ho. Ɛnyɛ "dabi" a enni hɔ. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi bere biara, na ɛsɛ sɛ wodi wo gyinaesi no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atorɔ adwene a wɔtaa nya wɔ LGBTQ+ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmebun betumi aboa ma wɔakyerɛkyerɛ afoforo ma wɔayi saa atorɔ  adwene yi afi hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmebun betumi aboa ma wɔakyerɛkyerɛ afoforo na wɔayi adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ LGBTQ+ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho afi hɔ denam: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow ne mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ho denam nkɔmmɔbɔ, nsɛm a wɔbɛka, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma so. Nsusuwii hunu ne anansesɛm a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ho a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ denam ankorankoro nsɛm, osuahu, ne adwene a wɔbɛkyɛ so. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nteaseɛ a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa LGBTQ+ mmara mu nsɛm ho a wɔde nokwasɛm adanseɛ ne nsɛm a ɛfiri mu ba. Tema, ntease, ne obu a wɔde ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro hokwan ne nidi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nkitahodi pa ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban so. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran de ahyɛ ɔman a ɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ pɛ ma LGBTQ+ nnipa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow kyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ahorow, nsusuwii hunu, ne atɛntrenee wɔ nna mu akwahosan (SRH) ho nsɛmti mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe boa mmabun ma wɔte sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ kyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne abusuabɔ ase. Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ asuafo ma wɔhyɛ nsusuwii hunu ne nkrasɛm a epira nsow. Dwumadi ahorow no bi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde hyɛ nsɛm ho nkuran na ɛbɔ amanne a ɛfata. Wɔde adesua ahorow no ka nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho. Sukuu ahorow ne akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akuw yɛ adwuma de nneɛma a ɛboa ma na wɔhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm pa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma, a ohia, atutra, ne nhomasua ne adwumayɛ hokwan a wonnya ka ho, ne mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) mmerɛwyɛ ahorow wɔ ntawntawdi ne ntawantawadi akyi tebea horow mu no di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Ohia: Sikasɛm a entumi nnyina ne ohia ma nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) ho mmerɛwyɛ yɛ kɛse wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeae a ntawntawdi wom, na ɛma wonnya SRH nnwuma a ɛho hia, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nhomasua. Tumi: Sɛ wɔhyɛ mmabun a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wotu fi wɔn afie mu no sɛe akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nhomasua, ne asetra mu mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow a wobetumi anya, na ɛma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ, wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, aware ntɛm, ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da no yɛ kɛse. Hokwan ahorow a wonni: Nhomasua, adwuma, ne asetrade hokwan ahorow a enni hɔ no ma ohia ne mmerɛwyɛ kyinhyia kɔ so, na esiw mmabun kwan sɛ wobesi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) ne daakye anidaso ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama m'abusua aboa me aduane ema apomuden kɔsɔ (nutrition) bere a mereyɛ anyin?
answer_twi_source: Metumi de m'abusa a ka me aduane apomuden ho sɛ, me Kasa mehiade. Ebi te sɛ, mekyerɛ ɔmɔ sɛ ɛkɔm de me. Yɛbɛtumi atɔ anaa so sɛ yɛbɛnoa abomu.  sɛmɛboa ama yɛnoa apomuden aduane p). Kyerɛkyerɛ so wɔhɔ; sɛmɛ ka nea measua kyerɛ wɔn. Hwehwɛ mmoa. sɛ yebisa aduane pa a ɛwɔ fie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔde nea broni ka no 'telehealth' bedi dwuma de anya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw a broni ka no 'conveniece': 'Telehealth' ma akwantu ho nhia na ɛtew bere a wɔde twɛn so, na ɛma wotumi nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe kɛse, titiriw ma wɔn a wɔwɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a wonnya mmoa pii. Nneɛma a wobetumi anya: Ɛnyɛ den sɛ ankorankoro a wɔwɔ akwantu ho haw anaa akwantu ho akwanside betumi afi wɔn afie mu ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho. Bere a wɔde yɛ adwuma: a broni ka no 'Telehealth' ma wotumi kɔ anim ntɛmntɛm na wonya aduruyɛ ho afotu, a ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse wɔ akwahosan ho haw ahorow a egye ntɛmpɛ ho dwuma a wodi mu. Ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so: Ayarefo betumi ne wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho daa, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so adi tebea horow a enni sabea ho dwuma ne ɔhwɛ a wodi akyi. Ɛka a wɔbɔ: 'Telehealth' a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ no taa gye ɛka kakraa bi bere a wɔde toto ankorankoro nsrahwɛ ho, a nea ɛka ho ne sika a wɔkora so wɔ kaa ho ne bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome wɔ adwuma anaa sukuu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makyerɛkyerɛ afoforo SOGI ho asɛm na makasa atia nsusuwii hunu? (wɛbsaet ahorow, nhomasua nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na efi nyiyimu a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so ba mmabun adwene ne wɔn nipadua akwahosan so?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyimu a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so betumi de nsunsuanso kɛse aba mmabun adwene ne wɔn nipadua akwahosan so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya adwenemhaw, dadwen, ne adwennwen. Bu wɔn ho ne ahotoso a ɛba fam. Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ne nneyɛe a asiane wom dodow a ɛkɔ soro. Nkɛntɛnso bɔne a ɛwɔ nipadua akwahosan so, te sɛ awo mu akwahosan ho haw anaa opira a efi basabasayɛ mu ba
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛe a etu mpɔn a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a mmabun betumi de ahyɛ wɔn da biara da dwumadi mu de ahyɛ adwene mu yiyedi ho nkuran?  Dɛn na ɛboa ma adwene mu akwahosan yɛ yiye,
answer_twi_source: Susuade pa a ɛbɛtumi aboa wo ma wo adwene mu atsea na wo ho atɔ wo bi ne: Adwene a Wɔde Si Adwene ne Adwendwene:: Sɛ wodwen adwepa ho na wopɛ bere ma wo ho a, ɛte adwene mu haw so na ɛma nipadua no home.Anigye Dwumadi mu Kyɛfa: Sɛ woyɛ nneɛma a w’ani gye ho a, ɛma wotiatia wo ho so na ɛma wo koma tɔ wo yam.Hyeɛ a Wode bɛto nneɛma mu: Sua sɛ wobɛka "abi" (dabi) akyerɛ nneɛma a ɛde adwene mu haw ba, na fa wo ho asɛm di kan bere biara.Ahomgye Bere: Gye bere fi afidie ne abɛɛfo nneɛma (te sɛ fon ne kɔmputa) ho, na kɔ babi a mframa pa wɔ na w’adwene mu ada hɔ.Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa. Kasa kyerɛ nnamfo, abusua, anaa animdifo a wobɛtumi aboa wo.Sɛ wode saa nneyɛe yi bɔ wo bra a, ɛbɛboa wo ma woatumi adi adwene mu haw so na ama w’adwene mu atsea bere biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na hormone di wɔ mmabunbere, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi adwene a ɛsakra anaa nkate a ɛsakrasakra no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkwammoaa (hormones) di dwuma titire wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, efisɛ ɛkanyan nipadua mu nsakrae na ebetumi aka adwene ne nkate nso. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na woadi adwene mu nsakrae ho dwuma no, ɛho hia sɛ wode wo ho a wobɛhwɛ te sɛ nna a ɛfata, aduan a ɛkari pɛ a wobedi, ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛyɛ daa di kan. Bio nso, sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ akwan pa a wobɛfa so ada wo nkate adi, te sɛ journaling anaa wo ne w’adamfo anaa w’abusua muni bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wobɛkasa a, ebetumi aboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so denam nsa anaa nnubɔne so, te sɛ sɛnea wɔbɛhwɛ sɛnea wɔnom nsa, wɔbɛn wɔn nnamfo a wogye wɔn di, na wɔakwati mmeae anaa tebea horow a ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wonni ahobammɔ no so?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ nsa anaa nnubɔne mu basabasayɛ so denam nsa dodoɔ a wobɛnom a wobɛhwɛ na woakwati nsa pii a wobɛnom so, titiriw wɔ mmeae a wonnim hɔ yiye. Twa wo nnamfo a wogye wɔn di ho hyia na fa nhyehyɛeɛ a mobɛhwɛ mo ho mo ho so di dwuma. Gye nsa fi nkurɔfoɔ a wonnye wɔn nni hɔ da, na nom nsa a wohui sɛ wɔresiesie nko ara. Tie wo nne a ɛwɔ wo mu—sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛnyɛ anaa ɛnyɛ dwoodwoo a, fi hɔ kɔ, sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛkɔ fie ntem mpo a. Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ fa sɛnea wobɛkɔ fie ansa na woafiadi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a worensie baabiara, na sua nsa ne nnubɔne asiane ho ade sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛbɔ wo ne wo nnamfo ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne nsɛnnennen a ebetumi aba a ɛbata nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔmfa anohyeto biara nni ho no bi ne dɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi adi saa haw ahorow yi ho adwuma bere a wobu mmabun ahofadi ne ahofadi no?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi adi asiane ahorow a ɛbata nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma a anohyeto nni mu ho dwuma denam: Akwankyerɛ ne ahye a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde di dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne bere anohyeto a wɔde besi screen so, mmeae anaa mmere a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nnim a wɔbɛkyerɛ, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔbɛka ho asɛm wɔ Intanɛt so nneyɛe a ɛyɛ asɛyɛde ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ne nea efi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu dodo anaasɛ ɛmfata mu ba, te sɛ kɔmputa so ayayade, Intanɛt so ayayade, nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a wɔde di dwuma, ne nsunsuanso bɔne a ɛwɔ adwenemyare ne yiyedi so. Mmabun a wɔne mmabun bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde di dwuma ho dwuma, ahu nneyɛe a ɛde ɔhaw ba ho kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne, na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa anaa akwankyerɛ bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ meyɛ babun yi, akwan pa bɛn na metumi afa so de ayɛ ntotoyɛ asi atenka mu ɔhaw a ɛwɔ nyisen mu?(akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, kasa a wɔne ɔyaresafo bi kasa)
answer_twi_source: Akwan a ɛfata a wobɛfa so agyina ano ni: Akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome: Fa ahomegye a emu dɔ yɛ apɔ mu ateneatene ne nsusuwii. Ayaresa: Sɛ wo ne adwenemuhwɛfo bɛkasa a, ebetumi aboa kɛse ma wɔadi adwennwen, dadwen, ne nkate mu nsakrae ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma kokoam mmoa akuo ne intanɛt so mpɔtam ma wɔn a wɔpere wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho.
answer_twi_source: YMK abɛɛfo beae a broni ka no 'app' ""filla"" ɔfa kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bi wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm ho nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK ɔfotufoɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517""
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nna mu basabasayɛ ahorow anaa akwan ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔn wɔ nneyɛe, adwene, ne nea efi mu ba no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu basabasayɛ ahorow anaa ahorow ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu, na emu biara yɛ nea ɛda nsow wɔ nneyɛe, adwene, ne nea efi mu ba. Eyinom bi ne: Mmonnaato: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔhyɛ obi anaasɛ ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ mu, a nea ɛka ho ne ɔbea a ɔhyɛ awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo, anaa anom. Nna mu Ɔbrasɛe: Nna mu nkitahodi anaa suban biara a wɔmpɛ a ɛba a wɔmpene so, efi nea wɔde wɔn nsa sosɔ mu kosi nea wɔde hyɛ mu so. Nna mu Ɔhaw: Nna mu nkɔso a wɔmpɛ, nna mu adɔe a wɔsrɛ, anaa nneyɛe foforo a wɔde ano ka, kasa, anaa honam fam nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ho a ɛma tebea a ɛyɛ ɔtan anaa ehu ba. Nhyɛso: Wɔhyɛ obi so anaasɛ ɔsakra no ma ɔde ne ho hyɛ nna mu a ɔmpɛ, denam ahunahuna, ahunahuna, anaa nkate mu nsakrae so. Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma: Ɔbabun bi mmerɛwyɛ anaa tumi a onni sɛ ɔde pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma esiane nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wadi, nea ɔde ne ho to so, anaa tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ nti a wɔde di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ afotuo ne adwenemyare ho no nya ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa adwenemyare ho no betumi de animtiaa ne aniwu aba. Aman bi bu mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ama adwenemyare no sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛwyɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne. Akwanside ahorow: Adwene ne nneyɛe ho nhyehyɛe ho nimdeɛ a wonni anaasɛ suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee ho nso betumi ayɛ akwanside. Abusua Nkɛntɛnso: Abusua su wɔ afotu ho betumi akɛntɛn mmabun pɛsɛ wɔbɛ pɛ mmoa. Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, abusua betumi abu wɔn abam sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi abɔnten esiane kokoam nsɛm ho dadwen anaa animtiaabu nti. Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ soro wɔ adwenemyare ne nna mu akwahosan ho no betumi atew animtiaabu so. Baguam ɔsatu ne mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ betumi ama mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ no ayɛ nea ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atu me ho ama anaasɛ mede me ho ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a, ɛboa mmabun bere a wɔadu mpanyin afe so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam Hɔ Asoɛe: Bisa atuhoama hokwan ahorow ho asɛm wɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmabun mmeae anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu. Akwahosan Ayaresabea 'health clinics': Ayaresabea ahorow bi gye atuhoamafo akwaaba ma wɔboa wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe anaa nhyiam ahorow mu. Ɔmantam Akwahosan Dwumadibea ahorow taa de wɔn ho to Mpɔtam Akwahosan Tuhoamafo so sɛ wɔde mmabun ne wɔn awofo bɛka nsɛm a ɛfata a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho ho nkɔmmɔ. Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Ka sɛ wobɛboa wɔ mmabunbere ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe anaa mmoa akuw a egyina sukuu so no mu. Intanɛt so Nhyiam Ahorow: Hwehwɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛfa atuhoama ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so wɔ nhyiam ahorow a ɛtwe adwene si mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ebia ebehia sɛ mmabun nya bi, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu, anaa nyinsɛn ho afotu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebia ebehia sɛ mmabun nya nnwuma ahorow bi, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nnuro anaa ahobammɔ nneɛma a wodebesi mprewa nyinsɛn ano. STI nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne siw ano ho nkyerɛkyerɛ. Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu, te sɛ afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn ho. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodie pa, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo adi nkitaho de ama nkorɔfo ate hia a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛnnyɛ wɔ wim tebea nyina ho hia no ase?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne nhyehyeɛ a wɔyɛ ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ adi nkitaho de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate hia a ɛhia sɛ, SRH dwumadie a ɛtumi gyina wimu tebea ano denam ɔsatuo a wɔbɛyɛ de abɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban, ɔmanfoɔ nhyiamu ne nkɔmmɔdie a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ wim tebea ho nsunsuansoɔ ho, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔn adwene yɛ pɛ a wɔbɛyɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa asetena mu nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ awoɔ mu apɔmuden nsɛm nteaseɛ so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛbɛtumi aka nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔbɛnya?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa asetena mu nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ awoɔ mu apɔmuden nsɛm nteaseɛ so no bi ne: animtiaabu ne akyiwadeɛ a ɛwɔ nsɛm te sɛ nna, awoɔ nnuru, ne nna mu yareɛ  (STI)  ho, a ebetumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ no ayɛ den. Ɔsom gyidie ne nneɛma a wɔbu a ɛhyehyɛ adwene wɔ nna, awoɔ nnuru, nyinsɛnyiguo, ne awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ho, a ɛka nsɛm ne apɔmuden mmoa a wɔbɛnya. Mmarima ne mmaa amanneɛ ne nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan a ebetumi aka awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa a wɔbɛnya, titiriw ma wɔn a wɔato wɔn atwene wɔ asetena mu. Apɔmuden mmoa a ɛnim amammerɛ anaa ɛyɛ mmerɛ a ɛdi nnipa ahorow ahiadeɛ ne dadwen pɔtee ho dwuma a enni hɔ. Saa nkɛntɛnsoɔ yi betumi aka nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔbɛnya denam akwansideɛ te sɛ nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware, atemmuo suro, ne mmoa a ɛfata amammerɛ a enni hɔ pii a ɛbɛba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de adwenemyare ho nneɛma ne mmoa nnwuma aka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de adi asuafo nkate ne adwene mu ahiade ahorow ho dwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Wobɛtumi de adwenemyareɛ ho nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie aka nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho denam module ahodoɔ a ɛfa adwennwene a wɔdi hyɛm wɔ, obuo a wɔde ma wɔn ho, abusuabɔ pa, ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano a wɔde bɛka ho no so. Sukuu ahorow betumi ama wɔanya afotufo, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, ne nhomasua nneɛma a ɛfa nkate ne adwene mu ahiade ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa kwan a wɔfa so de pene ho ntease ma wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nnwuma ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛboa ma wɔafa pene ho ntease ma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho dwumadie ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Mmabun akwahosan ayaresabea anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔde kokoam dwumadie ne mmoa ma. - hotlines anaa online platforms a wode akwankyerɛ ma wɔ apɔwmuden ho hokwan ne gyinaesi ho. - mmara mmoa ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa mmabun akuo a wɔyɛ adwuma titire wɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne hokwan ahodoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne nkitahodie ho no nya mmabun adwene, wɔn suban, ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde kyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne nkitahodie betumi anya mmabun adwene, wɔn suban, ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho so nsunsuanso kɛse. Mmabun betumi de ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔayɛ ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ahyɛ wɔn mu, na akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow, nna mu nneyɛe, ne nkitahodie mu nkɔso ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho betumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu a ɛha, ahyɛ nneɛma ahorow a egu ahorow ne nea ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho nkuran, na ama wɔanya nna mu akwahosan ho adwene pa. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm mu yiye na ama wɔahu sɛnea ebia ɛrenya wɔn ankasa gyidi ne wɔn nneyɛe so nsunsuanso
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ betumi aka mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi 'disability' adwene mu apɔmuden ne yiedie wɔ kwan pa ne bɔne so?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ betumi aka adwene mu apɔwmuden wɔ kwan pa ne bɔne so: Nsunsuansoɔ Bɔne: Adwene bɔne ne deɛ wɔnhu a ebetumi ama dadwen, awerɛhow, ne ankonamyɛ nkaeɛ ayɛ kɛse. Nsunsuansoɔ Pa: Nneɛma pa a wɔbɛkyerɛ betumi atew dadwen so, ama nkaeɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔgye wɔn tom ayɛ kɛse, na ahyɛ nipadua ho adwene pa nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi ne me hokafoɔ adi nkitaho yiye wɔ nna mu apɔmuden ne asane nsoano so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne wo hokafoɔ  rekasa fa nna mu apɔmuden ne asane nsoano ho a, ɛho hia sɛ: wo hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase wɔ baabi a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo na ɛyɛ kɔkoam. Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na enni atemmuo kyerɛ wo dadwen ne w’apɛdeɛ. Tie wo hokafoɔ no adwene yiye na bu ne nteaseɛ ne n’ahyeɛ. Ka nokware na bue w’ano wɔ wo nna ho abakɔsɛm, nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu, ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ ho ban ho. Mommom nyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mma nna a asane nni mu, a kondɔm (condom) a wɔde di dwuma, nhwehwɛmu, ne obi baako a wɔne no bɛda ka ho. San kɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ no so bere ne bere mu de hwɛ sɛ mo mmienu nyinaa adwene yɛ pɛ na mo ani gye nhyehyɛeɛ a moapene so no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee ahwɛ sɛnea atipɛnfo adwene ne afotu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woresusu atipɛnfoɔ adwenekyerɛ ne afotuo a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho a, akwan a wɔfa so susu nneɛma ho yie betumi aboa wo ma woahu akwankyerɛ a ɛboa ne nsɛm a ebetumi ayɛ nea wontumi mfa ho nto so. Susu nimdeɛ no farabae ne osuahun ho, sɛ́ ebia wɔn afotuo no gyina ankorankoro adwenkyerɛ anaa nhwehwɛmu a egyina adanse so, ne sɛ ebia ɛne nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a efi mmeae a agye din no hyia anaa. Kae sɛ ɛwom sɛ atipɛnfo adwene betumi ama woanya nhumu a ɛsom bo de, nanso ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ sɛnea ɛyɛ nokware mu yie ansa na wode ahyɛ wo gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awosu (genetics), abɔde a nkwa wom (biology),nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ne asetra mu osuahu ahorow di wɔ adwene mu yadeɛ anaa adwene mu ahoɔden ho?
answer_twi_source: Awosu, abɔde a nkwa wom, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ne asetra mu osuahu ahorow nyinaa di dwuma titiriw wɔ adwenemyare a wɔhyehyɛ mu: Awosu mu nneɛma: Adwene mu akwahosan tebea horow bi betumi akɔ so wɔ mmusua mu, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ awosu mu ade bi wɔ hɔ. Abɔde a nkwa wom ho adesua: Amemene no mu nnuru a ɛnkari pɛ anaa nsakrae a ɛba amemene no nhyehyɛe mu no betumi ama obi anya adwenemyare. Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia: Nneɛma te sɛ mmofraberem ahodwiriw, adwennwen, basabasayɛ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, anaa asetra ne sikasɛm tebea betumi aka adwenemyare. Asetra mu osuahu ahorow: Osuahu pa te sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛboa anaa osuahu bɔne te sɛ ayayade anaa anibiannaso betumi anya adwenemyare a efi mu ba so nkɛntɛnso. Saa nneɛma yi a wɔbɛte ase no betumi aboa ankorankoro ne mpɔtam hɔfo ma wɔaboa adwenemyare ne yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti STI nhwehwɛmu yɛ kokoamsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ Ghana no yɛ kokoamsɛm. Wei kyerɛ sɛ wɔde w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm ne sɔhwɛ mu aba no sie. Mmara kwan so no, ɛyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asɛyɛde sɛ wɔbɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma pa bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso ho, na sɛ ɛte saa a, mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda atipɛnfo nhyɛso pa ne nea ɛnnyɛ ntam?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa betumi ahyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran, te sɛ adesua mu nkannyan, dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi mu kyɛfa a wonya, anaa ɔmanfo som mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nsonsonoe a ɛda atipɛnfo nhyɛso pa ne nea enye ntam no hwehwɛ sɛ wususu ho sɛ ebia nkɛntɛnso no ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow hyia, ɛma wo yiedi nya nkɔso, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma wo ahye anaa. Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa ma wonya nkɔso, mmoa, ne nkuranhyɛ, bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye betumi ayɛ nhyɛso, nsakrae, anaa ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow a wobu ani gu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa akuw anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama nnipa a woredi (reko) nkate fam nsunsuanso a STI de aba ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woagyina nkateɛ mu nsunsuansoɔ a STIs de ba no ano: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): https://www.ppag-gh.org/nu/ betumi de mmoa akuo anaa afotuo a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma wo bɛma. Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health (GYARH): https://ghanasrhralliance.org/ betumi anya intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a wubetumi ne afoforo adi nkitaho. Hotlines: Susuw hotlines a yɛadi kan aka ho asɛm (PPAG Helpline & Ghana AIDS Commission Helpline) no ho ma mmoa a wɔmmɔ din. Afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ YMK app no so de wɔn kɔma kɔ afotuo foforɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ mmoa akuo foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na media nya atipɛnfo nkitahodi so nkɛntɛnso wɔ mmabun mu, a nkitahodi kwan, asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Media nya atipɛnfo nkitahodi so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ mmabun mu denam nkitahodi akwan, asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a wɔhyehyɛ no so. Nhyiam ahorow te sɛ social media, nkrasɛm apps, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow ma akwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho, ne media nsɛm a wɔkyɛ bere nyinaa, a ebetumi anya sɛnea mmabun ne wɔn mfɛfo di nkitaho no so nkɛntɛnso. Mediafo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa adamfofa, ɔdɔ, ne asetra mu nkɔso ho no taa de gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow si hɔ ma atipɛnfo nkitahodi, na enya mmabun nneyɛe, wɔn suban, ne wɔn adwene wɔ asetena mu abusuabɔ ho so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi asua pii afa wɔn mmra kwan so hokwan ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, a intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde boa, ne mmra kwan so dwumadi ahorow a ɛfata mmabun ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a mmabun betumi asua pii afa wɔn mmra kwan so hokwan ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no bi ne: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nsɛm, nsɛm a wobisabisa nkurɔfo, ne nnwinnade a wɔde di nkitaho a ɛfa mmra kwan so hokwan ahorow ho ma, te sɛ mmra kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, mmabun akuw a wɔkamfo mmabun, ne aban adwumayɛbea ahorow wɛbsaet ahorow. Mmoa nhama, nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadie, ne mmoa ntam nkitahodiɛ a egyina nsɛm so a ɛde kokoam mmoa ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔ mmara mu nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho. Mmra ayaresabea anaa nnwuma a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su a ɛde mmra mu afotu, afotu, ne ananmusifo a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma mmabun a wohyia mmara mu nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Nhomasua nneɛma, nhomawa ahorow, ne nhomawa ahorow a wɔkyekyɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho mmeae, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, a ɛde akwankyerɛ a mfaso wɔ so ma wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow, asɛyɛde ahorow, ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'assertiveness training' (akokoduro nteteeɛ) bɛtumi aboa me?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma ahoɔden. Ɛboa ma wogyina anngyeanntum (rejection) ano. Hwɛ wo ho so yie. Ma w'apɔwmuden di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm a ɛfa intanɛt so ne nsɛm ho nimdeɛ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa intanɛt so banbɔ, intanɛt so hokwan, ne mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma yiye wɔ asetena mu no hyia?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan so ɔmanba pa (digital citizenship) kyerɛ nneyɛe pa, kyɛfa, ne mmuaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛda no adi wɔ ntentan so; na abɛɛfo ntentan so nyansa (media literacy) nso si hia a ɛhia sɛ yɛdwene nneɛma ho yie na yɛhunu sɛnea yɛne afoforɔ bɛkasa wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so. Nsɛm a ɛfa obi kokoam nsɛm (privacy), ntentan so ahobammɔ (data security), ne atorosɛm (misinformation) ho no ka ɔmanba biara ntentan so asetena ne mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa ntentan so ahobammɔ ne ntentan so kyɛfa ho no si hia a ɛhia sɛ yɛbɔ nnipa ho ban na yɛma obiara kwan ma ɔnya ntentan so mmoa ne kwan a ɔbɛfa so anya nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotufo betumi ayɛ nhwɛso pa ama mmabun denam nneyɛe pa, nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina atipɛnfo nhyɛsoɔ ano, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wodi ho dwuma mu no so?
answer_twi_source: Afotubɔfoɔ betumi ayɛ nhwɛso pa ama mmabun denam nneyɛe pa, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina atipɛnfo nhyɛsoɔ ano ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wodi ho dwuma mu no so. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Ahyeɛ a wɔto: Afotubɔfoɔ yɛ nhwɛsoɔ wɔ asɛm a wɔka ne ahyeɛ a wɔde si hɔ ho, na wɔkyerɛ mmabun sɛdeɛ wɔbɛka dabi wɔ atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ ho na wɔde wɔn ankasa yiedie adi kan. Nkitahodi a etu mpɔn: Afotufo da nkitahodi a ɛmu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware adi, na wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔda wɔn nsusuii, atenka, ne wɔn haw ahorow adi wɔ obuo mu. Mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ: Afotubɔfoɔ kyerɛ suban a wɔde hwehwɛ mmoa, na wɔkyerɛ mmabun sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpaninfo, atipɛnfo, anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ bere a wohyia nsɛnnennen no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi adi dwuma wɔ aduan a wonnya nni ne adan a entumi nnyina wɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi adi dwuma wɔ aduan a wonnya nni ne adan a entumi nnyina pintinn wɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma a wobedi mu denam: Nneɛma a wɔde bɛma so: Sukuu ahorow betumi de nnuan, nnuan nketenkete, anaa nnuan a wɔkora so a wontua hwee anaasɛ wɔatew ne bo so ama asuafo a wɔrehyia aduan a wonnya nni, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so ne asetra mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobenya. Mmoa dwumadie a wɔde ma: Sukuu afotufoɔ, asetena mu adwumayɛfoɔ, ne asuafoɔ mmoa adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de asuafoɔ ne mmusua abata mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma, adan ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ, anaa adwenemyareɛ dwumadie ho de adi adan a entumi nnyina ne nsɛm a ɛfa ho ho dwuma. Nhomasua ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Sukuu ahorow betumi de adesua nhyehyɛe ne nhomasua dwumadi ahorow a ɛma nkurɔfo hu aduan ne adan a wonnya nni ho, hyɛ adidi pa ho nkuran, na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asetra mu nimdeɛ a ɛfa sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, aduannoa, ne adan ho nhyehyɛe ho no aka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi me akwannya ne fahodi a me ne afoforo wɔ wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no so na makura mu?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro Ahye: Ka w’ahye ho asɛm pefee na bu afoforo ahye. Mpene: Hwehwɛ na bu pene bere nyinaa wɔ nkitahodi nyinaa mu, sɛ́ ɛyɛ honam fam anaa atenka fam. Tema: Susuw sɛnea wo nneyɛe ka afoforo ho na bɔ mmɔden sɛ wode tema ne ntease bɛyɛ ade. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Gyina wo akwannya ahorow ne akwannya ahorow a afoforo wɔ sɛ wɔpaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn akwahosan ho no akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmara a ɛhyɛ sɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ (mandatory reporting) no mu nsonsonoeɛ te wɔ amantam anaa mpɔtam ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛgyina nkurɔfoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ kɔkɔ, ne sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ no so. Ɛho hia sɛ wohu wo mpɔtam mmara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nhyɛso ka di wɔ adwene mu apomoden wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi aka mmabun kɛse wɔ adwene mu apomoden mu denam nsusuwii, nkate, ne nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso so. Mmabun betumi anya adwennwen, dadwen, ne obu a ɛba fam wɔ wɔn ho bere a wɔte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ nea wɔn mfɛfo akwanhwɛ hyia anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu na ama wɔafata no. Saa nhyɛso yi betumi ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho, wɔn ho yɛ basaa, na wɔahaw wɔ nkate fam, na awiei koraa no aka adwene mu yiyedi nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de ahokokwaw a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka sie ho adi dwuma wɔ asetena mu tebea horow ankasa mu, te sɛ nkɔso a mempɛ a mɛka sɛ dabi, nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a mɛka ho asɛm, anaasɛ me nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ahiade ahorow a mɛkamfo akyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de ahokeka a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka sie ho adi dwuma wɔ asetena mu tebea horow ankasa mu denam tebea horow a wobɛyɛ so, te sɛ nkɔso a wompɛ a wobɛka sɛ dabi, nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wobɛka ho asɛm, anaasɛ wo nna ne awo apomoden ho ahiade ahorow a wobɛkamfo akyerɛ no so. Fi ase denam tebea pɔtee bi a ɛho hia sɛ woka no pen a wobɛkyerɛ so, afei fa nkitahodi akwan a ɛyɛ den te sɛ "Me" nsɛm a wode bedi dwuma, ahye a emu da hɔ a wode besi hɔ, ne afoforo adwene a wode nsiyɛ tie no di dwuma. Fa nkakrankakra fa wo ho to tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu na fa ahokokwaw a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka sie ho di dwuma wɔ tebea a ɛboa na wɔhwɛ so mu na ama woanya ahotoso ne ahokokwaw bere tenten.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
