question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo, te sɛ kaa anaa sikasɛm mu nsɛm a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside ahorow wɔ ɔhwɛ a wobenya ansa na wɔawo wɔn, te sɛ kaa anaa sikasɛm ho nsɛm a, wobetumi akɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa. Ebia nea ɛka eyi ho ne akwantu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaa ɔhwɛ a ɛho ka sua anaasɛ wontua hwee a wobetumi apaw ansa na wɔawo a wobetumi anya wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi afa so de wɔn adwene ama, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔ ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma no ayɛ biako de ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a wobetumi anya, agye atom, na ɛyɛ papa no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun afotufoɔ agyinatukuo, nhyiamu, anaa akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so a wɔde mmabun hyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, nhwehwɛmu, ne gyinaesie mu. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so, nkrataa a wɔde ma mmuae, anaa nea broni ka no 'mobile application' ahorow a ɛboaboa nsɛm fi mmabun hɔ wɔ wɔn suahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ho. Nhwehwɛmu adwuma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛfa mmabun ho sɛ ahokafoɔ wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ na wɔyɛ de hunu akwansideɛ ne ano aduru. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ntam nkitahodi a wɔbom yɛ de bom yɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa nnamfo anaa me mfɛfo a wɔregye wɔn bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ ho kyim?
answer_twi_source: Nnamfo anaa atipɛnfo a wɔregye wɔn bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ ho kyim a wɔbɛboa wɔn no hwehwɛ sɛ wobenya tema, ntease, ne obu. Tie wɔn suahu ahorow no yiye na bua a wommu atɛn. Fa mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ma, na ma wonhu sɛ wowɔ hɔ ma wɔn ɛmfa ho nea ɛbɛba biara. Bu wɔn kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn kokoam nsɛm, kwati sɛ wobɛfa nsusuwii ahorow, na mmom hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnkɔhwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata nkɔhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na adwene mu ahoɔden ho ayaresa ne nneɛma a wɔde boa, di wɔ sɛnea yɛbesiesie adwene mu yadeɛ haw wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wobenya no di dwuma titiriw wɔ adwenemyare a ɛwɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma a wodi mu. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne ayaresa ho animdefo, afotufo, adwenemyare ho animdefo, akuw a wɔboa, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne nhomasua nneɛma a wobenya. Sɛ wonya mmoa a ɛfata wɔ bere ano a, ebetumi ama ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ntɛm, atew sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a emu yɛ den so, na ama nea efi mu ba nyinaa atu mpɔn ama mmabun a wɔrepere wɔ adwenemyare ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa betumi aboa ma mmabun anya nna ne awo mu yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa betumi aboa ma mmabun anya nna ne awo mu yiyedi wɔ nneɛma te sɛ nsɛm, afotu, akwahosan ho nnwuma, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, sikasɛm mu mmoa, ne nkate fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn so, na ama wɔatumi asi gyinae a ɛfata na wɔanya ɔhwɛ a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nyinsɛn sɛnkyerɛnne a obroni ka no 'symptoms' bɛn na ɛtaa ba?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne, anopa yare ne ɔfe. Dwensɔ pii. Aduane kɔnnɔ/kyi. Akyi yaw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so no nnwuma a wɔde bedi dwuma no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, ɛka biara nni hɔ pɔtee a ɛbata ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so no nnwuma a wɔde bedi dwuma no ho. Mpɛn pii no, sukuu anaa aban mpanyimfo na wɔde sika boa saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi na wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma asuafo a wohia mmoa a wontua hwee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na media kyerɛ 'gender' ne 'sexuality'?
answer_twi_source: Wɔfa kwan bi so (Stereotypes). Mmarima: sɛdeɛ wɔde tumi/ahoɔden di dwuma. Mmaa: sɛdeɛ wɔhwɛ nkurɔfoɔ, brɛ wɔn ho ase ne wɔn ahoɔfɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na mmabun di wɔ ASRH nhwehwɛmu ne nhyehye3 mu na s3n na ɔkwan b3n so na y3de wɔn b3hy3 wɔn nhwehw3mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔka wɔn ahiasɛm (Advocate). Wɔka nhwehwɛmu ho (surveys/focus groups). Wɔboa ma yɛhyehyɛ nhwehwɛmu no (Co-design). Wɔkyɛ nimdeɛ no (Disseminate).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de mfiridwuma adi dwuma de ama mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ, wɔde di dwuma, ne ne nhwehwɛmu mu denneennen, na wɔama nneɛma foforo ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo a mmabun di anim no anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mfiridwuma adi dwuma de ama mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no nhyehyɛe, ne di mu, ne ne nhwehwɛmu mu denneennen denam: Wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛbom ayɛ ade ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛbom ayɛ: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnwuma a egyina mfiridwuma so no mu no hwɛ hu sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no fata, ɛyɛ nea wɔde di dwuma yiye, na ɛfata amammerɛ. Mmabun nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse: Social media, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, ne dijitaal abakɔsɛm a wɔka ho nsɛm ma mmabun nya akwan a wɔbɛfa so aka wɔn suahu ahorow, akamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama ASRH nsɛm. Atipɛnfoɔ ntam nkitahodi a wɔboa: Intanɛt so mpɔtam ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo ma mmabun tumi ne atipɛnfoɔ di nkitaho, kyɛ nsɛm, na wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ SRH nsɛmti ho. Digitals ho nsɛm a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran: Mmabun ntetee a wɔde ma wɔ digyital afotu ho nimdeɛ mu, te sɛ sohyial media ɔsatu ne intanɛt so adesrɛ, ma wɔn tumi ma wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne asetra mu atɛntrenee wɔ ASRH.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nhumu a ɛkɔ soro ne aduannuru ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu bi?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu a wɔbɛma: Kyerɛkyerɛ atipɛnfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo hia a aduannuru mmoa ho hia ma mmabun awo akwahosan. Yɛ nhyiam ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase ho nhyehyɛe de asi abusuabɔ a ɛda aduan pa ne awo mu yiyedi ntam so dua. Mpɔtam hɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow, sukuu ahorow, ne aban adwumayɛbea ahorow nyɛ biako mfa nkamfo mma mmabun nya aduannuru ho mmoa adwuma a ɛkɔ soro. Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa akwahosan ho guasodeɛ mu de kyekyɛ nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa aduane pa ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Nhyehyɛeɛ a Wɔkamfo: Kamfo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhyɛ aduane pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne akwahosan ho nsɛm mu, ne sika a wɔde bɛboa aduane pa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmabun so. Kyerɛw nkrataa kɔma nhyehyɛeyɛfo anaa fa wo ho hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ de kamfo mmabun awo akwahosan bedi kan wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne ɔman nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ PMTCT a edi mu so bere tenten ma ɛna ne abofra no nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ a ɛwɔ PMTCT a edi mu so ma ɛna no ne abofra no nyinaa yɛ kɛse. Wɔ ɛna no fam no, PMTCT a edi mu no betumi ama ɛnanom akwahosan atu mpɔn, a nea ɛka ho ne nkwa tenten ne asetena pa. Wɔ abofra no fam no, PMTCT a edi mu no brɛ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obenya HIV no ase kɛse na ɛma akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa tu mpɔn. Bio nso, PMTCT a edi mu no betumi aboa ma wɔagyae HIV a ɛkɔ mmusua ne mpɔtam mu no kyinhyia, na awiei koraa no aboa ma wɔadu awo ntoatoaso a wonni AIDS botae ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ wɔn ho, na wɔde wɔn adwene mu yiyedi adi kan, de wɔn ho ayamhyehye adi dwuma, de ahye ato hɔ, na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa ntɛm bere a wɔrepere wɔ atimka fam no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn Ho a Wɔhwɛ ne Adwene mu Yiyedi a Wɔde Di Kan: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ wɔn ho na wɔde wɔn adwene mu yiyedi adi kan denam ayamhyehye a wɔde bɛyɛ wɔn ho, ahye a wɔde besi hɔ, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ntɛm bere a wɔrepere wɔ atinka fam no so. Ebia eyi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnwuma a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho mu, wɔbɛkɔ nnamfo anaa abusuafo a wɔboa wɔn nkyɛn, na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ afi ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu nsɛm a ɛho hia anaa nsɛntitiriw bi wɔ LGBTQ+ hokwan ne pɛyɛ a ako wɔ ɔman no mu no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔagye nnipa nna mu kwan 'Human Sexual Rights' ne abusua 'Value Bill' no atumu wɔ 28th February, 2024 wɔ Ghana wɔ adwendwene a ɛkyɛ a ɛbu LGBTQ+ akuo ne ankorankoro dwumadiɛ nyinaa sɛ nsɛmmɔnediɛ akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu ahorow mu no hyɛ asuafo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, adebɔ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ te sɛ dijitaal nsɛm a wɔka, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nhwehwɛmu adwuma, ne nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu nsɛm pii ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ sukuu ahorow mu no nam dwumadi ahorow so hyɛ asuafo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, adebɔ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran, a nea ɛka ho ne: Digitals abasɛm a wɔka a ɛma asuafo tumi da wɔn adwene, wɔn adwene, ne wɔn suahu adi denam multimedia nhyehyɛe te sɛ video, podcast, ne blog so. Media nhwehwɛmu dwumadie a asuafoɔ deconstruct na wɔkyerɛ media texts ase, kyerɛ asɛmti, motifs, ne asɛm a wɔka kyerɛ akwan a wɔde di dwuma wɔ sini, television, aguade ho dawurubɔ, ne intanɛt so nsɛm mu. Multimedia nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nnwuma a ɛhyɛ asuafo nkuran ma wɔboaboa nsɛm ano, di nkitaho yiye, na wɔde nea wɔahu no kyerɛ wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ anigye so. Ɛdenam akwan ahorow a ɛma wɔde nsa yɛ adesua ne adebɔ mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu so no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma asuafo tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu denneennen, sen sɛ wɔbɛyɛ adetɔfo a wɔnyɛ hwee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nketesie ne gyidie wɔ nsakrae bere wɔ mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Hyehyɛ botaeɛ. Kasapa ma wo ho. Gyina haw ano. Hwehwɛ mmoa. Yɛ nneɛma a wopɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde besiw nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso a efi ahokafo anaa akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho gyinaesi ahorow ho no ano?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ wɔ hɔ a wɔde besiw nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso a efi ahokafo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho gyinaesi ahorow ho no ano. Mpɛn pii no, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye afi ayarefo hɔ ansa na wɔayɛnna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu anaasɛ wɔde ayaresa ama. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun bɛte nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresa no atirimpɔw ase, asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba, ne akwannya  a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpow anaasɛ wɔpene nnwuma no so no ase. Bio nso, mmara betumi abara nhyɛso nneyɛe te sɛ ahunahuna anaa nsakrae a wɔyɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, wotu ayarefo fo ansa na wɔafa nhwɛsode ahorow de ayɛ STI nhwehwɛmu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ ho wo bere tenten mu sɛ migyina m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye ano, titiriw wɔ m’ankasa yiyedi ne daakye abusuabɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Pagya wo ho ɛkɔ anim: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye a wubegyina ano no hyɛ ahotoso a wowɔ wɔn gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow mu no mu den, na ɛma wunya wo ho adwene pa na wote nka sɛ wosom bo. Abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɔne a wɔko tia no ma wonya abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ nokware a egyina obu ne ntease a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho wɔn ho so, na ɛde abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom na ɛma abotɔyam ba. Gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wudi so nkonim no ma wutumi gyina tebea horow ano na ɛma wutumi susuw nneɛma ho yiye, na ɛma wutumi paw nneɛma a ɛfata a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia. Ahotoso a ɛkɔ soro: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow a wobɛfa so yiye no ma wunya ahofadi ne wo ho a wode bɛto wo ho so, na ɛma wunya asetra mu nimdeɛ a ɛsom bo a wode bedi daakye nsɛnnennen ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ nna mu nyarewa 'STI' anaa 'HIV'?
answer_twi_source: Afotu boa wɔn (Counseling). Akwankyerɛ firi atitiriw hɔ 'specialists'  wɔ s3nea wɔb3fa nnuru afa. Mmoa ma ayaresa. Kokoam-yɛ (Confidentiality).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Afutuo bɛn na wobɛtumi de ama na obiatumi de awoɔ ho aduro adi dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ?
answer_twi_source: Di akwankyerɛ so (Follow instructions). Yɛ no daa (Be consistent). Kora no yie (Store properly - mfa nnto awia mu). Hwɛ dɔnhwere a nnoɔma no mmerɛ bɛtwam (expiration dates). Kasa kyerɛ dɔkota anaa Sukuu nɛɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya mmara kwan so mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi, na anammɔn bɛn na ɛsɛsɛ wɔfa so hwehwɛ mmoa wɔ ɔhaw bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya mmara kwan so mmoa ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ intanɛt so anaa mpɔtam hɔ nsɛmma nhoma ahorow so de ahu mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, nnwumakuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, anaa mmaranimfo a wɔmfa hwee mma a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu. Sɛ wobɛfa telefon, email, anaa w’ankasa wo ne saa ahyehyɛde ahorow yi adi nkitaho tẽẽ de abisa nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma ho asɛm. Wɔn tebea a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu na wɔasrɛ mmoa wɔ ɔhaw bi mu, a wosi sɛnea wɔn ahiade ahorow gye ntɛmpɛ ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmara mu wɔ bere ano so dua. Nwoma anaa adanseɛ biara a ɛfata a wɔde bɛma de afoa wɔn asɛm no so na ama agyedeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no ayɛ mmerɛ. Akwankyerɛ pɔtee biara a mmara kwan so dwumadibea no de ama a wobedi akyi, te sɛ intake nkrataa a wɔhyehyɛ nea broni ka no 'completing intake forms', bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wobɛkɔ, anaa nsɛm foforo a wode bɛma sɛnea wɔsrɛ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso ahorow a ɛtaa ba a ebetumi aka yɛn yiedi no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nhyɛso A Esi Wo So, 'Direct Pressure': Nhyɛso a ɛda adi pefee fi atipɛnfo hɔ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nneyɛe anaa dwumadi pɔtee bi mu, te sɛ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, sukuu a wohuruw, anaa nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nhyɛso a ɛnni woso pefee: Nkɛntɛnso a ɛnyɛ anifere a efi atipɛnfo anaa asetra mu akuw ahorow hɔ a ebia wɔmfa nni nkitaho tẽẽ nanso ɛnam asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a ɛkɔ so, anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow so na ɛkyerɛ. Asetra mu Nnipa a Wɔayi Wɔn Mu: Nhyɛso a wɔde ma wɔn sɛ wɔne kuw gyinapɛn anaa nneyɛe hyia na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛpow wɔn, wɔayi wɔn afi asetra mu, anaasɛ wɔbɛhwere asetra mu dibea. Abɛɛfo Ntentan Nhyɛso, nea broni frɛ no 'Cyber Pressure': Nkɛntɛnso a efi sohyial media anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛhyɛ nneyɛe anaa asetra kwan bi ho nkuran na ɛde nhyɛso ba sɛ ɔne intanɛt so nnipa anaa gyinapɛn ahorow bɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi atoa me nhomasua so anaasɛ medi daakye botae ahorow akyi bere a merenyin ayɛ awofo no? (nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nneɛma, mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: W’akwahosan ho yaresafoɔ bɛma wo nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nhomasua akyi na ɔde wo ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔboa wo bɛbata ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne pene a wɔpene so, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene kyerɛ apam anaa kwan a ankorankoro bi fi ne pɛ mu de ma sɛ ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ dwumadi anaa ayaresa pɔtee bi mu. Wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkitahodi mu no, pene a wɔpene so ho hia efisɛ ɛma ankorankoro nya wɔn nipadua, gyinaesi, ne osuahu ahorow so tumi. Ɛhyɛ ahofadi, nidi, ne obu ho nkuran denam hokwan a obiara wɔ sɛ ɔpaw nea ɛfata wɔ ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho a egye tom no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn asane ne nsunsuanso  na ebetumi aba sɛ mɛkyɛ kokoam nsɛm a anaa m’ankasa me ho nsɛm wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so, na mɛyɛ dɛn asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nea mɛkyɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam Nsɛm a Wɔbu So: Sɛ wɔkyɛ wie a, ebetumi ayɛ den sɛ wobɛhwɛ nea ohu emu nsɛm no so, na ɛde kokoam nsɛm a wobetumi abu so aba. Intanɛt so ayayade: Wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛbɛn wo adi dwuma atia wo wɔ kɔmputa so ayayade anaa ɔhaw tebea horow mu. Mmara mu Nsɛm: Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛkyɛ, titiriw sɛ wonnii mfe aduonu a, ebetumi de mmara mu nsunsuanso aba. Daakye Nsunsuanso: Nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so no betumi anya wo din, wo nyɔnkofa nkitahodi, ne daakye akwannya ahorow mpo so nsunsuanso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ. Gyinaesi a Wonim: Ansa na wobɛka ho asɛm no, susuw asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ne sɛnea wo ho tɔ wo sɛ afoforo hu no ho. Sɛ w’adwene mu yɛ wo naa a, nkyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na "hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde kokoamsɛm sie" kyerɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu no kyerɛ sɛ ankorankoro wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm sie. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne wɔn nna mu dwumadi, sɛnea wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu, nyinsɛn, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ ɛwɔ sukuu/mpɔtam a ɛboa nnamfo pa ne nna ho gyinaberɛ pa (sexual health)?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Mmabun nteteeɛ a egyina mmabun nanso (Peer-led workshops), mmoa kuo, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ (campaigns), nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛmu dɔ (CSE). Dɔm deɛ nkuo a ɛwɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia nyiyim anaa ɔhaw a egyina medɛmdi so a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a Wobɛyɛ Ntɛm ara: ɛbɛtumi a, firi saa tebea no mu kɔ baabi a ahobammɔ wom. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi ayɔnkofoo, abusua, anaasɛ opanyin bi a wogye no di nkyɛn. Bɔ amanneɛ: Bɔ nyiyim anaa ɔhaw ho amanneɛ kyerɛ sukuu mpanyimfo, adwumayɛbea HR, anaa mpɔtam hɔ atumfoɔ. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne nea ebetumi aboa ama woanya nsɛm a mfasoɔ wɔ so. Hu Wo Hokwan: Hu mmara a ɛko tia nyiyim wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Susuw ho sɛ wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo bɛkasa de ahwehwɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ne nkate fam mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛkyerɛ me ho ne afoforɔ afa sabi dɛmdi ho nsɛm ne abakɔsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Kenkan nwoma a ɛfa dɛmdi ho : Hwehwɛ nwoma, nsɛm, ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmubua a sabi wodi dɛm abakɔsɛm ne osuahunu ahodoɔ ho. Kɔ Nhyiamu anaa Ɔkasa: Fa wo ho hyɛ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a ɛtwe adwene si mmubua a sabi woadi dɛm nsɛm ne hokwan ahodoɔ so. Ntentansofidie so Nneɛma: Kɔ wɛbsaet ahodoɔ a agye din ne ntentanfidie so dwumadibea ahorow a wɔde ama nhomasua titiri. Di adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne ekuo ahodoɔ akyi wɔ ntentanfidie so a wɔboa na wɔma ankorankorɛ a sabi wɔadi dɛm tumi. Fa Wo ho hyɛ Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu: Wo ne wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafoɔ nsusu sabi wɔn a woadi dɛm nsɛmti ho pefee. Kamfo dɛmdifoɔ Hokwan ahodoɔ: Boa dɛmdifoɔ nsɛm, fa wo ho hyɛ nhyiam ahodoɔ mu, na kyɛ nsɛm wɔ ntentanfidie nyinaa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw ne ahotoso a wɔde de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu yiye sɛ ahwɛfo, na nneɛma anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔasua ahwɛfo asɛdeɛ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho na wɔde saa nimdeɛ yi adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw ne ahotoso a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu yiye sɛ ahwɛfo denam nhomasua, ntetee nhyehyɛe, ne adeyɛ so. Ahyehyɛde pii de adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so nneɛma, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si wɔn a wɔhwɛ no a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano so ma. Ɛdenam nhyehyɛe ahorow yi mu kyɛfa a mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so no, wobetumi asua akwan horow a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ ahwɛfo mu no ho ade, de wɔn ho hyɛ tebea horow mu, na wɔanya ahokokwaw a mfaso wɔ so a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu dwoodwoo na wɔatu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ m’awoɔ apomoden so?
answer_twi_source: W’awo apomoden a wobɛhwɛ so no ho hia wɔ w’asetena nyinaa mu. Afotu bi ni: Kura asetena kwan a ahoɔden wom mu: Di nnuan a ahoɔden wom, teɛteɛ w’apɔw mu daa, na da sɛnea ɛsɛ. Fa ahotew pa di dwuma: Fa nsu a ɛyɛ hyew ne samina a ɛyɛ brɛoo hohoro wo awotwaa mu da biara. Kwati nneɛma a emu yɛ den anaasɛ nsu a wɔde gu nsu mu a ebetumi asɛe w’abɔde mu kari pɛ. Hu wo kyinhyia: Di wo nna akyi na te wo kyinhyia ne ovulation nhyehyɛe ase. Kɔhwɛ wo ho daa: Yɛ nhyehyɛe yɛ afe afe nhwehwɛmu a wo ne wo duruyɛfo bɛyɛ na woasusuw nneɛma biara a ɛhaw wo ho na woanya ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano. Fa nna a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma: Fa kɔndɔm anaa akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw kwan di dwuma de siw nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STIs) ne nyinsɛn a wonhyɛ da ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma a yɛyɛ wɔ intanɛt so betumi anya yɛn ankorankoro kokoam nsɛm ne asɛm a ɛfa yɛn mmawoɔ ne yɛn nna mu akwahosan ho nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nneyɛe betumi aka ankorankoro kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho kɛse. Nsɛm a ɛho hia a wode bɛkyɛ wɔ sohyial media anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea afoforo so no betumi asɛe kokoam nsɛm sɛ wɔanyɛ no yiye a. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun ma wɔn adwene si wɔn a wobetumi anya wɔn dwumadi ahorow a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no so na wɔde kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow adi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛnea wohu wɔn nsɛm no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mfaso a ɛwɔ wɔn nhwehwɛmu no so no boro asiane anaa adesoa biara a ebetumi aba mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmufo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mfaso a ɛwɔ wɔn nhwehwɛmu no so no boro asiane anaa adesoa biara a ebetumi aba mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no so denam: Asiane ho nhwehwɛmu a edi mu a wɔbɛyɛ na wɔatew ɔhaw ahorow a ebetumi aba so denam pene a wɔde ma a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, kokoamusɛm ho banbɔ, ne asiane a wɔbɛtew so ho akwan horow so. Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no yiedie ne ahobanbɔ a wɔde bedi kan wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya mmoa dwumadie, wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ, ne nsɛm a wɔbɛbisabisa wɔn nsɛm. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ahokafoɔ wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛɛ ne ne di mu, hwɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmu botaeɛ ne wɔn nneɛma a ɛdi kan, wɔn anigyeɛ, ne wɔn ahiadeɛ hyia. Nkɛntɛnso a nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nya wɔ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no so a wɔbɛhwɛ na wɔasusuw ho, nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu sɛnea ɛho hia na ama wɔanya mfaso kɛse na wɔatew asiane ahorow so bere a bere kɔ so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn nipasu ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne wɔn adwene ahorow adi dwuma de akamfo akwan horow a ɛka obiara ho, a egyina hokwan ahorow so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho a ɛde pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee di kan?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoeɛ a wɔbɛgye atom, ahunu deɛ ɛkyerɛ ankorankoro suahunu ne nneɛma a wɔbɛnya. Akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni gyinabea pa no nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte adwene ahorow na wɔabu no sɛ ɛsom bo wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Ayɔnkofa ne biakoyɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ nsonsonoe ahorow mu, a wogye botae koro ne apereperedi a wɔkyɛ wɔ asetra mu nsakrae akyi di mu. Tumi a ɛnkari pɛ a ɛyɛ den ne nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a ɛma nyiyim ne nnipa a wɔayi wɔn afi nnipa mu kɔ so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan nhyehyɛe ne aman mu. Tema, ayamhyehye, ne amammerɛ mu ahobrɛase a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nkitahodi a wɔne afoforo di mu, a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho obu, ntease, ne biakoyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa ka fa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho a ɛsɛse wohu no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya fa mmubuafo ne mmabun ho ni: 1. Atesɛm: Mmabun a sabi wɔadi dɛm ntumi ntra ase wɔ ahofadi mu. Nokwasɛm: Sɛ wɔboa mmabun pii a sabi wɔadi dɛm na wɔma wɔn dabere a ɛfata a, wobetumi atra ase wɔ wɔn ho na wɔasi wɔn ankasa gyinae. 2. Atesɛm: Mmofra a sabi wɔadi dɛm yɛ awerɛhosɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsa. Nokwasɛm: Mmofra a sabi wɔadi dɛm yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu, na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no "nsɛe" anaasɛ wonhia "aduru." 3. Atesɛm: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ntumi nnya nna ho nkate anaa nkitahodie. Nokwasɛm: Mmabun a sabi wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ahiade te sɛ wɔn atipɛnfo na wɔfata sɛ wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa a edi mũ. 4. Atosɛm: Mmofra a sabi wɔadi dɛm yɛ honam fam nkutoo. Nokwasɛm: Nea ɛka dɛmdi ho ne dɛmdi a aniwa nhu te sɛ adwenemyare, nyarewa a enni sabea, ne neurodiverse haw ahorow. 5. Atesɛm: Mmabun a sabi wɔadi dɛm ntumi nni nkonim wɔ adesua mu. Nokwasɛm: Sɛ wɔboa mmabun a sabi wɔadi dɛm na wɔma wɔn dabere a ɛfata a, wobetumi anya adesua mu nkonimdi na wɔakɔ sukuupɔn. 6. Atesɛm: Mmofra a sebi wɔadi dɛm yɛ obi ankasa huammɔdi anaa nea efi awofo a wɔnyɛ no yiye mu ba. Nokwasɛm: Mmofra a sebi wɔadi dɛm yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu na ɛnyɛ nea efi ankorankoro anaa awofo huammɔdi mu ba. 7. Atesɛm: Mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ntumi nsi wɔn ankasa gyinae. Nokwasɛm: Mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm wɔ hokwan sɛ wodi wɔn ho so na wosi wɔn ankasa gyinae, na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn ma wosi wɔn ankasa gyinae. 8. Atesɛm: Mmofra a sebi wɔadi dɛm yɛ akwansideɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi so. Nokwasɛm: Mmofra a sebi wɔadi dɛm yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu, na ɛsɛ sɛ wobu mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm na wɔde wɔn ka ho sɛnea wɔyɛ. 9. Atesɛm: Mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ntumi mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ agumadi anaa ahomegye dwumadi ahorow mu. Nokwasɛm: Mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ agumadi ne ahomegye dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wotumi sesa wɔn ho mu a wɔde mmoa ne dabere a ɛfata ma wɔn. 10. Atesɛm: Mmofra a sebi wɔadi dɛm yɛ aduruyɛ mu asɛm, na ɛnyɛ asetra mu asɛm. Nokwasɛm: Mmofra a sebi wɔadi dɛm yɛ aduruyɛ ne asetra mu asɛm, na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔfa so ka wɔn ho na wotumi nya bi. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔkasa tia saa anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ yi na ama wɔanya tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so di atipɛnfo nhyɛso so wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu bere a yɛde yɛn adwene mu akwahosan si kan?
answer_twi_source: Hunu Wo Kyerɛ (Know Your Limits): Te wo hyeɛ ne wo gyinapɛn nkyerɛaseɛ ase, na fa wo ho si hɔ dennen sɛ wobɛdi so, sɛ ebia afoforo repɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ wo ma woyɛ nea ɛne wo gyidi nnyɛ pɛ mpo a.Sua Sɛ Wobɛkasa Atia (Practice Assertiveness): Fa obu ne gyinapɛn pa kpo nsafrɛ anaa dwumadi biara a ɛma wote nka sɛ wo ho ntɔ wo, anaa ɛne wo gyidi bɔ abira.Hwehwɛ Nnamfo Pa (Find Supportive Friends): Fa wo ho bɔ nnamfo a wobu wo nneyɛe na wɔbɛboa wo ma woatumi agyina wo nan so atia mfɛfo nhyɛso.Siesie Wo Ho Ansa (Plan Ahead): Dwene mberɛ a mfɛfo nhyɛso bɛtumi aba ho, na siesie wo ho kɛse wɔ sɛnea wobɛbua anaa wobɛyɛ wo ho ansa na saa bere no adu.Pɛ Mpaetia Sɛ Ɛhia A (Use Excuses if Necessary): Sɛ ɛyɛ den ma wo sɛ wobɛka daabi, pɛ asɛm bi ka de mpaetia; te sɛ woayɛ nhyehyɛe foforo anaa wo ho nnyɛ wo dɛ.Hwehwɛ Dwumadi Foforo (Seek Alternative Activities): Sɛ mfɛfo rehyɛ wo ma woyɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛtumi de wo ato asiane mu a, kyerɛ wɔn nneɛma pa foforo a mobɛtumi ayɛ a ɛne wo gyidi hyia.Sɛ wopɛ mmoa anaa afutuo foforo a ɛfa sɛnea wobɛgyina mfɛfo nhyɛso ano a, wobɛtumi akɔ National Youth Authority (NYA) anaa Ghana Education Service wɛbsait so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwuma mu osuahu a ɛsom bo denam adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwuma a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ, adwuma a wɔde bere fã yɛ, anaa adwuma a wɔde sua adwuma so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na osuahu ahorow yi betumi aboa ma wɔadi yiye daakye wɔ adwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya adwuma mu osuahu a ɛsom bo denam adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwuma a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ, adwuma a wɔde bere fã yɛ, anaa adwuma a wɔde sua adwuma wɔ mmeae a wɔn ani gye ho no so. Saa osuahu ahorow yi ma hokwan ahorow de adesuadan mu adesua di dwuma wɔ wiase ankasa tebea horow mu, nya nimdeɛ a mfaso wɔ so, kyekye adwumayɛfo nkitahodi ahorow, na wonya nhumu wɔ nnwuma ahorow ne adwumayɛ akwan ahorow ho. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ saa hokwan ahorow yi denam adwumayɛfo a wɔne adwumayɛfo bɛyɛ adwuma, nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde adwumayɛ ho ntetee anaa atuhoama nhyehyɛe ahorow ma, na wɔde nsiyɛ hwehwɛ adwuma a wɔde bere fã yɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara kwan so ahobammɔ anaa kwan ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho pɔtee a ɛsɛ sɛ mihu ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ gu ahorow wɔ ɔman ne ɔmantam biara mu nanso ebetumi ayɛ mmara a ɛko tia nyiyimu, aware mu pɛyɛ, ne ahobammɔ a wɔde ma wɔ ɔtan nsɛmmɔnedi ho. Hwehwɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow ho, a adwuma, adan, akwahosan, ne nhomasua ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn te sɛ mmoa akuo, afotu, anaa ayaresa nhyehyɛe na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho ato nnurobɔne so na wɔwɔ adwenemyare haw?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa no bi ne: Afotuo mmoa wɔ sukuu mu anaa adwene mu haw ho nhyehyɛe ahorow. Mmoa akuo a ewɔ mpɔtam anaa ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma mmabun titiriw. Telefon a wɔde boa a ɛde kokoam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho. Intanɛt so mmoa ne websites ahorow a ɛma nkyerɛkyerɛ, nnwinnade a wɔde boa wɔn ho, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma so ma. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo te sɛ afotumafoɔ, ayaresa ho animdefoɔ, anaa adwenemyare ho animdefoɔ a wobetumi de nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa akwan a wɔayɛ ama ankorankoro ahiade ahorow ama. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa afi wɔn wotumi de wo ho to wɔn so hɔ, sɛ wo anaa obi a wunim no wɔ nnurobɔne nom ho haw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside anaa nsɛnnennen berɛ a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun: Wɔhwehwɛ ayaresabea foforo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Di mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ na woanya nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ne mmoa dwumadie ho. te sɛ Agoo SHE+ online platform by dialing 5100, YENKASA The toll-free number(0800202010), GHS-YMK etc. Kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ anim denam akwansideɛ a wɔhyia no ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn na wɔne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ ayɛ adwuma de adi nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsɛm ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu, na mmara ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ me man anaa me mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ aduruyɛ mu kwan a wɔfa so ma nyinsɛn ba awiei. Wobetumi de nnuru (pill) anaa ayaresa bi ayɛ. Mmara ne Nhyehyɛe: Ɛsono nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara wɔ ɔman ne ɔmantam biara mu. Mmeae bi wɔ mmara a emu yɛ den, bere a afoforo nso wɔ mmara a ɛma ahofadi kɛse. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Wobu nyinsɛn a woyi gu sɛ asiane biara nni ho bere a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wɔatete no na ɔyɛ wɔ beae a wɔagye atom no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside ahorow bi a ebetumi aba, a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔreyɛ dijitaal nneɛma, te sɛ mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ a wobenya, dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw mu nsonsonoe, intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow, anaa nsɛm a ɛfa akyerɛwfo hokwan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi saa nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma anaa wɔadi so?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ akwan a wɔfa so nya kwan no a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma denam mfiridwuma ne intanɛt nkitahodiɛ a wɔde bɛma denam mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ, nwomakorabea, anaa mobile outreach nhyehyɛeɛ so. "Digitals" akenkan ne akyerɛw mu nsonsonoe a wɔbɛto mu denam ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ nneyɛe a wɔde bɛma so. Intanɛt so mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa bɛbɔ, nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma ne amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma, ne dijitaal ɔman ba a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran de ako atia intanɛt so ayayade. Mmabun a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn afa mmara a ɛfa akyerɛwfo hokwan ne nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔkyerɛ obu ma hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ adwene mu bere a wɔreyɛ dijitaal nneɛma (Digital Content) no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma ankorankoro a wɔyem nyinaa anya nyinsɛn ne awo ho hwɛ a edi mũ, a mfe a wɔadi mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma nyinsɛn ne awo ho hwɛ a edi mu a wobenya no atu mpɔn denam hia a mmabun awo hokwan ahorow ho hia a wɔbɛma wɔate ase, wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu, nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban, ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ de ahyɛ mmara mu nsakrae ho nkuran na wɔakyekyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bedi akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ mu no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow a mmabun hyia berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a ɛka a ɛfa ayaresabea nsrahwɛ, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ho, ne nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatua saa ka ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow de nsɛnnennen kɛse ba mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no so. Saa akwanside ahorow yi bi ne: Nnwuma Ho Ka: Ka a wɔbɔ wɔ ayaresabea nsrahwɛ, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ho no betumi ayɛ nea wɔabara ama mmabun, titiriw wɔn a wonni akwahosan ho insurance. Ɛka a Wɔde Ahintaw. Ka foforɔ te sɛ akwantuo, mmofra hwɛ, ne ahomegyeɛ a wɔde firi adwuma anaa sukuu mu no bɛtumi asiw mmabun tumi a wɔde bɛhwɛ wɔn no ano bio. Insurance ho sika: Akwahosan ho insurance a ɛyɛ kakraa bi anaasɛ enni hɔ biara betumi ama wɔabɔ ka a efi wɔn kotoku mu wɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma ho, na ama mmabun binom ntumi ntua. Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Nneɛma ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatua saa ka yi, a nhyehyɛe ahorow a aban de sika boa ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde sika fam mmoa anaasɛ sika a ɛkɔ fam a egyina sika a wonya so ma ka ho. Bio nso, Ya akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow bi betumi de nnwuma a wɔatew so anaasɛ wontua hwee ama mmabun a wohia mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ ano te sɛ nna a ahobammɔ wom ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ daakye adwene mu apomoden bɛba no so atew so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ɛdenam akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano te sɛ nna a ahobammɔ ho nneyɛe ne nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ daa, kyerɛ sɛ, sɛ woyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a, wubetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya ɔyare mmoawa daakye no so na woabɔ w’adwene mu apomoden ho ban: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a Ahobammɔ: Kɔndɔm a wode di dwuma bere nyinaa na woto wo nna mu ahokafo dodow ano hye no brɛ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yareɛ so no ase kɛse. Sɔhwɛ a Wobɛyɛ Daa: Sɛ wo ne obi da a, sɛ woyɛ wo ho nhwehwɛmu daa, mpo a wunhu sɛnkyerɛnne biara a, ɛma wotumi hu ntɛm na wosa yareɛ, na esiw nsɛnnennen ano na ɛtew dadwen so. Kae sɛ wo nna mu apomoden a wobɛhwɛ so no yɛ asɛyɛde ne wo ho dɔ ho sɛnkyerɛnne. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa sɛ wuhia a. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa wo ma wunya apɔwmuden na w’ani gye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu sɛ wɔyɛ obi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ anaa obu a ɛnteɛ so esiane nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ ne mmabunbere mu nti a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Kasa tia deɛ ɛnyɛ pɛ, na kɔbɔ panin a wogye no di anaa obi a ɔwɔ tumi amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho na wɔama wɔn ho so wɔ ɔman a mmarima ne mmea nyinaa yɛ pɛ na ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho a wɔbɛbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi: Wɔayɛ atipɛnfo nkitahodi a ɛboa a ankorankoro betumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow, de nntinka fam mmoa ama, na wɔakamfo mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ akyerɛ. Ma akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ho nkuran. Wɔkasa tia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ ne nyiyim wɔ wɔn asetra mu akuw ne mpɔtam hɔfo mu. Fa wo ho hyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ de di basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so, nyiyim, ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ho dwuma mu. Kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho ne afoforo wɔ mmarima ne mmea ntam nsɛm ho na wɔbom nyɛ adwuma de nsakrae pa ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na wotu de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm bɛto mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, titiriw bere a wɔresusuw awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ (community outreach) de kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ si mpanim, na ama mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) anya baabi a ahobammɔ wom:Kokoamsɛm ho mmara (Confidentiality policies): Nhyehyɛeɛ yi wɔ mmara a emu da hɔ a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde nnipa ho nsɛm bɛsie; yei kyerɛ sɛnea wɔboaboa nsɛm ano, baabi a wɔde sie, ne sɛnea wɔkyɛ amanneɛbɔ.Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn (Trained staff): Wɔatete adwumayɛfoɔ no sɛnea wɔbɛdi nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu ho dwuma wɔ kokoam mu, na adwumayɛ mu bra kwan hyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnbɔ afoforɔ ho nsɛm ban.Baabi a ahobammɔ wom (Safe spaces): Wɔyɛ mpɔtam nteteeɛ ne nnwuma ahorow no wɔ baabi a obiara nhunu, baabi a mmaayewa bɛtumi ate wɔn ho yie de adi nkɔmɔ fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho a wonni suro sɛ obi bɛbu wɔn atɛn anaa ɔbɛda wɔn nsɛm adi.Nteaseɛ mu tumidie (Informed consent): Wɔbɔ mmaayewa no amanneɛ fa kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no ho, na wobisa wɔn tumidie ansa na wɔakyɛ wɔn ho nsɛm anaa wɔadi nkɔmɔ fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho.Mmoa a yɛnnim wo din (Anonymous services): Nhyehyɛeɛ no ma kwan ma wɔnya mmoa a yɛnnim wɔn din, te sɛ telefon namba (hotlines) anaa abɛfo ntentan so nkɔmɔdie (online chat support), baabi a mmaayewa bɛtumi ahwehwɛ amanneɛbɔ ne mmoa a wɔmfa wɔn din nkyerɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo ne m’abusuafo akasa afa adwenemyare ho wɔ ɔkwan bi so a ɛbɛtew animtiaabu so na ahyɛ obi a obebue n’ano ho nkuran? (nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyɛ, tema a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso) .
answer_twi_source: Kyɛ Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Kyerɛ nnamfo ne abusuafo kwan kɔ abɛɛfo ntentan, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, anaa mmoa akuo a wobetumi de nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ ama. Tema Yɛ Ade Titiriw: Fa w’adwene si tema ne ntease a wobɛma anya nkɔso so. Ma wonhu sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ worennyɛ yiye na mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no yɛ ahoɔden ho sɛnkyerɛnne. wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo betumi aboa ma wo ne w’atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ sukuu mu akasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na kwan a wɔfa so gye mmofra sɛ wɔn mma no te? (agyede ahorow, bere nhyehyɛe, ɛka a wɔbɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Adoption ahodoɔ: Open Adoption: Ɛma kwan ma wɔne abusua a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma no di nkitaho wɔ kwan bi so. Closed adoption: Wɔne abusua a wɔagye wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma no nni nkitaho bere a wɔde wɔn akɔto hɔ akyi. Domestic Adoption: Abofra a wɔfa no sɛ wɔn mma wɔ U.S. mu. Amanaman Ntam Agyede: Abofra a wofi ɔman foforo so a wɔbɛfa no ayɛ wɔn ba. Bere nhyehyɛe: Ɛsono sɛnea wɔfa no sɛ wɔn mma, nanso ebetumi agye asram anaa mfe mpo. Ɛka a wɔbɔ: Ɛsono sika a wɔbɔ wɔ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ne mmara kwan so ka, nanso wobetumi anya nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfata, ɛtra hɔ daa, na ɛyɛ den a ɛboa sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetra mu atɛntrenee?
answer_twi_source: Ma mmabun tumi na nya nhyehyɛe so nkɛntɛnso denam sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ne ɔmanfo nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi nna ho akɔnnɔ "sexual desire" a mewɔ no ho dwuma sɛ ɔbabun a wadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Hwehwɛ akwan a ahoɔden wom a wobɛfa so ada wo nna ho akɔnnɔ adi, te sɛ wo ho a wobɛhwehwɛ anaasɛ wobɛyɛ w’adwene. Wo ne Ɔpanyin a Wogye No Di Nkasa: Wo ne ɔpanyin anaa ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nsusuw wo atinka ho. Abusuabɔ a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Sua abusuabɔ a ɛfata na obu wom ho ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina akwansideɛ bi te sɛ sika a wɔnnya, dwadie mu kwan a ɛnni hɔ, akansie ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm ano wɔ adwumayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi agyina ano denam: Wɔbetumi anam wɔn nimdeɛ ne akwan akwan foforo so apɛ sika. Wɔbɛhwehwɛ adwuma foforo a obiara nnyɛɛ bi. Wɔbetumi de nneɛma foforo aba wɔn adwuma mu. Wɔbɛko atia amammerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ bi a ɛnmoa. Wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri namfofoɔ ne afotufoɔ hɔ na wakɔso asua adeɛ. Wɔnam saa yɛ yie so betumi ako atia ɔhaw ne akwansideɛ ɛwɔ adwumayɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛda adi wɔ mmabun, nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan mu nsonsonoe kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu wɔ nnipa akuw ahorow ntam, a mpɛn pii no efi asetena, sikasɛm, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia mu. Pɛyɛ a enni hɔ yɛ nsonsonoe a ɛnteɛ wɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu a efi nhyehyɛe mu nyiyim ne nneɛma a wɔkyekyɛ a ɛnteɛ mu. Wɔ wiase nyinaa no, akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ da adi wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu denam nsakrae a ɛba wɔ nsɛm a ɛfata, nnwuma, ne mmoa a wonya mu, na ɛde nsonsonoe ba wɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) dodow, nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, ne ɛnanom a wowuwu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mfiridwuma anaa kwan foforo bi a wɔde redi dwuma de asiw STI/HIV ano wɔ wiase mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma foforɔ ne akwan foforɔ bi a wɔde redi dwuma de asiw STI/HIV ano wɔ wiase mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ no bi ne: Telemedicine ne mobile health (MHealth) platforms a wɔde yɛ STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ virtual, afotuo, ne ayaresa dwumadie, a nea ɛka ho ne nneɛma a wɔde sɔ wɔn ho hwɛ, akyirikyiri anim a wɔbɛbisa, ne nnwinnadeɛ a ɛboa ma wɔdi dwuma wɔ dijitaal so. HIV ankasa nhwehwɛmu nnwinnade ne ofie nhwɛsode a wɔboaboa ano de yɛ STI nhwehwɛmu, a ɛma ankorankoro akwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛyɛ kokoam kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nhwehwɛmu na wɔanya nea efi mu ba a wɔnkɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Social media ɔsatu ahorow, mobile applications, ne gamified nkyerɛkyerɛ nnwinnade a ɛde dijitaal platform ahorow di dwuma de kyekyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, hyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho nkuran, na ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa de wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu. Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) nhyehyɛe ne biomedical interventions afoforo a wɔde besiw HIV ano a wɔde bedi dwuma, a PrEP nnuro a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu a ɛyɛ adwuma bere tenten, ɔbea awotwaa mu nkaa, ne HIV vaccines ka ho, de atrɛw akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano na wɔadu nnipa ahorow ahorow nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu sɛ manyinsɛn a, dɛn ne nneɛma a metumi apaw? (awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, nyinsɛn a woyi gu - egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe so)
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhu sɛ woanyinsɛn a, wowɔ akwan horow a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛte mmara ne nhyehyɛɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana a ɛfa saa akwan yi ho ase. Nsɛm bi a ɛfa nneɛma nyinaa ho ni: Awofoyɛ: Wubetumi apaw sɛ w’ankasa wobɛtete abofra no. Abofra a Wɔbɛfa no Agye: Wubetumi apaw sɛ wode abofra no bɛkɔ abusua a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma a ɔdɔ wom nkyɛn. Abortion (nyinsɛn a wɔtwa): Eyi yɛ aduruyɛ mu gyinaesi na ne mmara kwan so tumi gyina Ghana mmara so. Wubetumi ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo akasa afa mmara kwan so ne ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu wɔ Ghana ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi aboa ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ na nokware wom akɔ so a ɛfa adwene mu apɔmuden ho wɔ me abusua mu?
answer_twi_source: Dikan fa w’ankasa adwene mu apɔmuden mu suahunu yɛ nhwesodeɛ na hyɛ afoforo nkuran ma wɔnyɛ saa ara. Yɛ tebea a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo a atemmuo nnim ma abusuafoɔ, ama wɔatumi aka wɔn atenka ne wɔn dadwen. Tie afoforo yie na da ɔpɛ ne ayamhyehyeɛ adi berɛ a afoforo reka wɔn nsɛm akyerɛ wo. Ma adwene mu apɔmuden ho nkɔmmɔbɔ nyɛ ade a ɛyɛ wɔ da biara da nkɔmmɔbɔ ne abusua dwumadie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abawo, na ɛne awo akwahosan wɔ abusuabɔ dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Abawo kyerɛ tumi a obi tumi nyinsɛn na ɔwo mma. Ɛyɛ awo akwahosan fã titiriw efisɛ ɛfa honam fam, adwene, ne asetra mu nneɛma a ɛfa sɛnea wubetumi awo akokoaa bere a woasiesie wo ho no ho. Nanso awo akwahosan de, ɛka biribiara a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe ho, a awo, nna mu akwahosan, ne tumi a obi betumi anya abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne abotɔyam wom ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ ayɔnkofo na wɔnkasa ama mmoa nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ahu.
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi afa sukuu mmabun akwahosan akuw ahorow so akasa ma GBV mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de abɛɛfo ntentanfidie adi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan pa so de ama m’adwene mu akwahosan ayɛ kɛse na me ne mpɔtam a wɔboa me no adi nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de abɛɛfo ntentanfidie adi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan pa so de ama w’adwene mu akwahosan ayɛ kɛse na wo ne mpɔtam a wɔboa wɔn no adi nkitaho denam: Akontaabu ne nkratafa a ɛhyɛ adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ, nneɛma pa, ne ankasa hwɛ ho nneyɛe ho nkuran a wubedi akyi. Nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ, nsɛm a ɛkanyan adwene, ne nsɛm a wosi so dua a ɛka wo koma na ɛma wo nkate yɛ kɛse a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu. Intanɛt so nsusuanso, ɔsatu, anaa nsɛm a esisi a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ no twee adwene sii adwenemyare ho nsɛm a wɔka de tae akyi, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmoa so. Wobɛka intanɛt so mmoa akuo anaa mpɔtam a wobɛtumi ne mfɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ anigyeɛ, osuahu, anaa adwenemyareɛ a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Ahye a wode besi wo abɛɛfo ntentanfidie a wode bedi dwuma no ho, te sɛ bere a wode bedi dwuma wɔ platform ahorow so a wobɛto ano hye, wo feed a wobɛhwɛ so de nneɛma pa adi kan, ne ahomegye a wubegye bere a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔsatu ahorow anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wodi hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam na wɔmfa atemmu biara ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɔsatu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, akwahosan ho nnwumakuo ahorow, ne aban nnwumakuo ahorow di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene asi hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam na wɔmfa atemmu biara nni ho. Saa ɔsatu ahorow yi taa si mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ de bɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ho ban so dua na ɛhyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkuran ma wodi abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow akyi wɔ wɔn adwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na afotufo 'counseling' boa ma wɔsɔw adwene mu yare 'mental health' ho nsɛm wɔ nna mu nsɛm 'SRH' mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a atɛmmuo nni mu. Therapies (CBT). Ahooden. Ayemhyehye 'Trauma' mmoa. Nkabom a efi afotufo nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun tumi nya ahokyere mu awoɔ nnwura (emergency contraception) wɔ kɔkoam a wɔn awofoɔ nnim?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ pii de kɔkoam di kan na wɔbu mmabun hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ kɔkoamunsɛm. Mmabun betumi akɔ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ, nnuruyɛfoɔ, anaa awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ayaresabea akɔgye ahokyere mu awoɔ nnwura wɔ kɔkoam, na wɔbetumi ahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nkasa fa wɔn akwan ne dadwen biara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɔhaw mu afutufo de boa mmabun wɔ afotu a edi kan no akyi a ɛhwɛ boa ma ayarehwɛ kɔ so wɔ berɛ tenten mu ananehunu anaa ɔhaw?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a Ɛkɔ So ne Ɔhwɛ a Wɔdi Akyi: Wɔ afotuo a ɛdi kan no akyi no, ɔhaw ho afotufoɔ de mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne ɔhwɛ a ɛdi akyire ma mmabun, hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ahwɛ wɔn na wɔboa wɔn ma wɔdi ɔhaw a ɛkyɛ anaa ahotɔ nhyehyɛeɛ so. Eyi betumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛkɔ hɔ daa, wɔde wɔn akɔ nnwuma afoforo mu, anaa mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmoa a wɔbɛkɔ so anya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔyɛ amammerɛ ho nkate bere a wɔne mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow reyɛ adwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ama amammerɛ mu atinka ayɛ kɛse denam mmabun a wɔde nsiyɛ tie wɔn, amammerɛ ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a wobebu, amammerɛ mu nkitahodi anaa nsɛm asekyerɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu bere a ɛho hia, ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔbɛsakra no ma ɛne amammerɛ a wɔpɛ ahyia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne mfaso bɛn na ebetumi aba sɛ obi bɛda ne sebi dɛmdi adi bere a ɔyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ wo paw! Ka bere a wo ho tɔ wo ne bere a ɛfata kyerɛ nkurɔfo. Wubetumi apaw sɛ wobɛda wo dɛmdi no afã horow bi adi, nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa. Fa w’adwene si sɛnea wo dɛmdi no ka w’asetra so, na ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛnkyerɛkyerɛ wo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, te sɛ sika a wɔde ma, asetra mu banbɔ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  insurance, aduan ho mmoa, nhomasua ho mmoa, akwahosan ho sikatua, adan ho mmoa, ne adwumayɛ ho nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sika a Wɔde Kɔma: Sika fam mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun anaa wɔn mmusua tẽẽ na ama ohia so atew na ama afie yiyedi atu mpɔn. Social Insurance: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ ma fi asiane ahorow te sɛ yare, dɛmdi, adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, anaa onyin denam ntoboa ne mfaso horow so. Aduan Mmoa: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde aduan mmoa, aduannuru ho mmoa, anaa aduan ho mmoa ma de hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya aduan a ɛfata na wɔako atia ɔkɔm ne aduan pa a wonnya nni. Nhomasua ho Mmoa: Nneɛma a wɔde tua sukuu ka, adesua nhoma, ntade, anaa kar ho ka de hyɛ nhomasua ne adesua hokwan ahorow a ɛfata ho nkuran. Akwahosan Ho Ka: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma akwahosan ho insurance, ayaresa, anaa sika a wɔde boa akwahosan ho ka de hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne ayaresa a ɛho hia. Dabere Mmoa: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ma wonya adan a ahobammɔ wom na ne bo nyɛ den, dabere, anaa nnwuma a ɛfa adan ho. Adwumayɛ mu Nnwuma: Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛma mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ adwuma mu, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ahokokwaw nkɔso, anaa adwumayɛ ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun adwumayɛ ne sika a wonya no nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa de akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ telefon so anaa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ma mmabun a ebia wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wobisabisa wɔn nsɛm wɔ akyirikyiri?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow bi a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa de aduruyɛ wɔ telefon so anaa Intanɛt so dwumadi ahorow ma de ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wobisabisa wɔn nsɛm wɔ akyirikyiri no. Saa nnwuma yi ma mmerante ne mmabaa nya akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nya aduruyɛ ho afotu, na mpo wonya nnuru a wɔakyerɛw ama wɔn a wɔn ankasa nkɔ ayaresabea hɔ, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw na wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛmti te sɛ sikasem ho nimdeɛ, adwuma ho nhyehyɛe, ne botae ahorow a wɔde besisi hɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no de module ahorow a ɛfa sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ, adwuma ho nhyehyɛe, ne botae ahorow a wɔde si hɔ ho bom de siesie mmabun ma daakye nkonimdi. Mmabun sua sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sika a wɔde sie, sika a wɔde bɛto mu, ne sikasɛm mu ahonyade a wɔde di dwuma yie ho ade. Wɔhwehwɛ adwumayɛ akwan ahorow mu, kyerɛ wɔn anigye ne wɔn ahoɔden, na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma de adi wɔn nhomasua ne adwumayɛ botae ahorow akyi. Botae a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ boa mmabun ma wɔn apɛde mu da hɔ, de botae ahorow a wobetumi adu ho si hɔ, na wɔyɛ akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi akwanside ahorow so na wɔadi wɔn nkɔso akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu kokoamsɛm so berɛ a wɔde ahokyere mu mmoa ne mmoa rema mmabun no?
answer_twi_source: Ebia wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu kokoam nsɛm so sɛ ɔhaw bi wɔ ɔbabun no anaa afoforo ahobammɔ ho a. Ebia nea ɛka eyi ho ne tebea horow a asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobepira obi ntɛm, te sɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ obekum ne ho, ayayade, anaa basabasayɛ ho ahunahuna.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, ne atipɛnfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya wɔn dijitaal nsɛm a wɔde yɛ nneɛma ho nimdeɛ, de nsɛm a wɔka, ne abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen anaa nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ adebɔ nhyehyɛe no mu no sohwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne atipɛnfoɔ bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ, nneɛma, ne nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ ama de aboa mmabun ma wɔayɛ wɔn digyital nsɛm a wɔyɛ no yie. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma tebea a ɛboa ma mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi, abisa nsɛm, na wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen ho dwuma. Nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ ne atipɛnfo adesua hokwan ahorow betumi ama ahokokwaw nkɔso akɔ anim na ama adebɔ ne nneɛma foforo a wɔyɛ no anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de wo ahyɛ m’akwantu a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no mu, na wobɛyɛ dɛn aboa me wɔ saa bere yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de me ahyɛ mu wɔ nsɛm a wubebisa, wo suahu ahorow a wobɛka, ne nsɛm a ɛhaw wo anaa dadwen biara a ebia wowɔ a wobɛda no adi so. Mewɔ ha sɛ mede nsɛm, akwankyerɛ, ne mmoa bɛma bere a worekɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no. Sɛ́ ebia wuhia obi a wo ne no bɛkasa, mmoa a wode bɛte nsakrae a ɛba wo nipadua mu ase, anaasɛ wobɛboa ma woanya nneɛma foforo no, mewɔ ha sɛ mɛboa wo wɔ anammɔn biara a wobɛtu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛfa so yɛhyehyɛ abusua na yesidɛn ma ne ba mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan no bi ne: Awoɔ, ebi nso ne 'ART' (IVF) a ɛne mmoa a dɔkota de ma de gye nyinsɛn. Sɛ wogye abofra bi yɛ wo ba mmara kwan so anaa sɛ obi foforo yinsɛn ma wo a wofrɛ no 'surrogacy'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama abrabɔ mu nimdeɛ 'life skills' nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu mu ne wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ. Dɔm mmabun dwumadie. Twerɛ nkrataa. Ka wo suahunu kyerɛ afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a ɛsono nna ho akɔnnɔ nya ayɔnkofa ne twetwe "attraction"?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔwɔ nna ho adesua pa no nya abusuabɔ anaa twaka pa bere a wo nyin no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow, na gyinapɛn anaa tebea horow bɛn na wɔtaa hwehwɛ na ama wɔafata mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow denam aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, mpɔtam ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa nnwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe no so na wɔde ma so. Nneɛma a wɔde fata no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nhyehyɛe pɔtee no so nanso ɛtaa ka nneɛma te sɛ ofie sika, abusua kɛse, mfe a obi adi, tenabea, dɛmdi, anaa mmerɛwyɛ tebea ho. Ebia ɛho behia sɛ mmabun anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no de nkrataa ma anaasɛ wodu tebea horow bi te sɛ sukuukɔ, akwahosan mu nhwehwɛmu, anaa ntetee dwumadi ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho, na ama wɔafata sɛ wonya mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw awo ano a ɛnyɛ kɔndɔm bɔ obi ho ban fi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho? (ɔfã bi ma ebinom) .
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano dodow no ara, te sɛ aduru, "IUD", anaa ade a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu no, mmɔ wɔn ho ban mfi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho. Wɔyɛ papa ma nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nanso kɔndɔm nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so a wɔfa so siw nna mu nyarewa (STI) dodow no ara a ɛbɛtrɛw ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem bere a wɔde wɔn ho rehyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔka de kyerɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔda no adi pefee: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun da wɔn adwene ne wɔn fekubɔ ahorow adi pefee bere a wɔrekamfo sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow rekyerɛ no. Nnipa a wɔka ho: Hwɛ sɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nnipa nyinaa ka ho na wosusuw ankorankoro ne mpɔtam a ɛka wɔn nyinaa ahiade ne adwene ahorow ho. Nokwaredi: Gyina nokwaredi ne nokwaredi akyi wɔ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi nyinaa mu, kwati nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsakrae a wɔde bedi dwuma de adu botae ahorow ho. Akontaabu: Ma nhyehyɛeyɛfo bu wɔn nneyɛe ho akontaa na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun nyinaa yiyedi di kan, titiriw wɔn a wofi mmusua a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi bɛhwɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so yie, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wobedi ho dwuma ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛhwɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so no kyerɛ sɛ wubehu akwan horow a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna nya ankorankoro suahu, wɔn nipasu, ne wɔn nkitahodi so nkɛntɛnso na wɔyɛ ho biribi. Ɛho hia kɛse wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wobedi ho dwuma ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran mu efisɛ egye tom sɛ mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ taa yɛ basabasayɛ ne nyiyimu ho nsɛm ase. Ɛdenam ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam atinka a yɛbɛte nka so no, yebetumi ate sɛnea tumi mu nkɔso, nsusuwii hunu, ne ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ boa ma wɔpira no ase yiye na yɛayɛ adwuma de ayɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na ɛsi so dua ma nnipa a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahye a ɛfata a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde si ɔdɔ ne platonic nkitahadie mu? (obu a wɔde ma ankorankoro atenae, nkate mu ahye nhyehyɛɛ ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro Atenae a Wobebu: Obiara hia bere ma ne ho. Bu wo hokafo (ne w’ankasa) ahiade a ɛne sɛ wobɛma wo nkutoo bere. Nkate mu Anohyeto: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi wɔ biribi a wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ wɔ nkate anaa honam fam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a ebia mmabun behia awofo anaa ɔhwɛfo pene ma wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Aane, tebea horow bi betumi aba a mmabun hia awofo anaa ɔhwɛfo pene ma nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, titiriw sɛ wonnii mfe a wɔpene so sɛnea mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow kyerɛkyerɛ mu no a. Nanso, mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow gu ahorow wɔ tumidi/ɔman biara mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛtumi afa so ayɛ 'peer educators' anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Nkuo anaa 'organizations; pii ma nteteeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ. Hwehwɛ akwanya ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma wɛbsaet, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne intanɛt so mpɔtam a ɛde mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho bɔbea ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbeasu ho ma.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo bɛsusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe no de adwenemyare ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asuafo nsɛmti te sɛ adwennwen ano aduru, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu adesua nhyehyeɛ no de adwenemyareɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asuafoɔ nsɛmti te sɛ adwennwene ho dwumadie, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ berɛ a ɛhia denam: Akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua a ɛfa adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛmti te sɛ adwennwene ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔhunu, nkateɛ ho dwumadie, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔbɛnya. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde bɛka nsɛm a ɛfa ho te sɛ adwene ne nneyɛe ho adesua, abɔde a nkwa wom ho adesua, anaa asetra ho adesua ho. Ahɔho akasafo, nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ, anaa nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa adwenemyare ho a sukuu afotufo, adwene ne nneyɛe ho animdefo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow hyehyɛe. Adwene mu nneyɛe, ahomegye ho akwan, ne adwennwen a wɔtew so dwumadi ahorow a wɔde bɛka da biara da dwumadi ne adesuadan mu dwumadi ahorow ho. Hokwan a asuafoɔ de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnwuma anaa dwumadiɛ a ɛhyɛ wɔn ho a wɔbɛdwene, wɔn ho a wɔbɛda wɔn ho adi, ne adwenemyareɛ ho nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ wɔn ankasa ne afoforɔ mu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwenem apɔwmuden ho nnwuma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titire?
answer_twi_source: Binom ne: Mmabun adwenem apɔwmuden ho animdefoɔ anaa adwene ho animdefoɔ a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun adwenem apɔwmuden ho. Mmabun akuo pɔtee a wɔboa wɔn anaa atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so a edi mmabun nkɔso ne atenka ahiade ahorow ho dwuma. Intanɛt so ayaresa nhyehyɛe anaa mobile App ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔde di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ɛwɔ ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ anaa nna ho nkɔmmɔ wɔ Intanɛt so mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase?
answer_twi_source: Ebetumi ama wɔahwere kokoam nsɛm, Intanɛt so asisifo, ayayadefo, anaa ‘online predators’  so adi nkitaho. Ebia wubehu nsɛm a epira anaa ɛmfata nso, anaa nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee anaasɛ nnwuma a mmara mma ho kwan a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma nketewa anaa nnwuma ahohorow bɛn na ɛfata mmabun, bere a wosusuw wɔn ahokokwaw, wɔn anigyede, nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne gua so hokwan ahorow ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a ɛfa ɔsom ho a broni ka no 'Service-oriented businesses': Nnwuma te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ, afieboa hwɛ, nhyiam ho nhyehyɛe, anaa adwuma a wɔde wɔn ho ma a egyina mmabun ahokokwaw, wɔn anigyede, ne wɔn ahoɔden so ma. Nnwuma a wɔyɛ adebɔ: Adwinni ne nsaanodwuma, mfoniniyɛ, mfoninitwa, nnwom adesua, anaa dijitaal nneɛma a wɔyɛ akyi di sɛ nneɛma a wobetumi anya sika na wɔada wɔn ho adi. Kuadwuma mu nnwuma: Kuayɛ, turoyɛ, mmoayɛn, anaa nea broni ka no 'agro-processing' dwumadi ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ayɛ kuayɛ mu nneɛma anaa nneɛma a ɛsom bo na wɔatɔn wɔ mpɔtam hɔ gua ahorow so. Adetɔnbea anaa e-commerce nnwuma: Nneɛma a wɔtɔn wɔ Intanɛt so anaasɛ ɛnam mpɔtam hɔ gua ahorow, sotɔɔ ahorow a ɛba, anaa sohyial media so, a nsaanodwuma, ntade, nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma, anaa nneɛma titiriw a wɔde ma gua a ɛyɛ soronko ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mekɔ oduruyɛfo nkyɛn bere a manyinsɛn no?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wobɛkɔ hɔ no gyina wo nyinsɛn no fã ne wo duruyɛfo nyansahyɛ ahorow so. Mpɛn pii no, wobɛtaa akɔ wo duruyɛfo nkyɛn wɔ ɔsram abiɛsa a edi kan ne ɔsram abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa me ma makɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw me a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho wɔ mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a Ɛnyɛ Atemmu: Wɔma wonya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi abisa nsɛm a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn. Nsɛm: Fa nsɛm a edi mu ma wɔ nna mu nipadua, abusuabɔ, pene a wɔpene so, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ɛfata ho. Sɔhwɛ ne Ayaresa: Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no betumi de nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea wobesiw ano ho ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mmoa nhyehyɛe pa a wobenya no ho hia ma adwene mu yiedi? (wɔte nka sɛ wɔwɔ abusuabɔ, ankonamyɛ a wɔtew so, obi a wo ne no bɛkasa)
answer_twi_source: Mmoa nhyehyɛe pa te sɛ ahobammɔ afiri ma w’adwene mu akwahosan: Nkitahodi a wobɛte nka: Sɛ wonim sɛ wowɔ nnipa a wodwen wo ho a, ɛtew ankonamyɛ ne tew a wobɛtew wo ho ho nkate so. Ankonamyɛ a Ɛtew: Sɛ wowɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe a ɛboa wo a, ɛboa ma wote nka sɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ hɔ, titiriw wɔ mmere a emu yɛ den mu. Obi a Wobɛkasa Akyerɛ: Obi a wobetumi aka wo kokoam asɛm akyerɛ no a wobenya no ho hia na ama woadi nkate horow ho dwuma na woatumi afa asetra mu nsɛm a ɛkɔ soro ne nea ɛba fam mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa tebea ahorow a ebia wɔbɛkasa atia wɔn awo hokwan ne fahodi a wɔwɔ no anaasɛ wɔabu so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi ɔhaw a ɛwɔ wɔn awo hokwan ne fahodi ho no so denam: - a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ wɔn hokwan ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. - a wohwehwe mmoa firi mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkamfo wɔn ho. - a wobesi won hokwan so dua na woakamfo nsakraee denam dwumadie, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛkamfo so. - a woakyerɛw nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a wɔabu so ho na wɔahwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a. - a wo ne atipɛnfoɔ a wɔne wɔn wɔ osuahu ne wɔn haw a ɛte saa ara bɛhyehyɛ nkitahodiɛ a ɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ ne asetena mu mmoa di wɔ boa a wɔboa mmabun ma wogyina nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ano no mu?
answer_twi_source: Gyidi a Wɔde Ma: Sɛ wɔde adansedi, ntease, ne tema ma wɔ osuahu ne dadwen ahorow a wɔkyɛ a ɛfa  mmaabun ho. Adwene a Wɔde Ma: Osuahu ne nhumu a wɔka fa mmabunbere mu nsakrae ho, boa mmabun ma wohu sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn nkutoo na wɔwɔ wɔn suahu ahorow mu. Osuahu ahorow a ɛma ɛyɛ nea ɛfata: Atinka horow a ɛma obi yɛ nea wontumi nsi pi, fɛre, ne ne ho a ɔde ba a ɛbata mmerantebere ne mmaabun mu nsakrae ho a ɛyɛ nea ɛfata. Nkuranhyɛ a Wɔde Ma: Nkuranhyɛ, awerɛhyem, ne nsɛm pa a wɔde bɛma de ama obu ne ahotoso akɔ anim wɔ nsakrae bere yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma m'anante abrabɔ pa ne amammerɛ ho nsusuiɛ pa ahorow no mu wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ Mmeae: Mpɔtam pii wɔ amammerɛ mmeae anaa akuokuo ahorow a wɔde nneɛma ne mmoa ma de te amammerɛ mu adwene ahorow ase. Afotubɔfoɔ: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ firi sukuu afotubɔfoɔ, mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, anaa obia a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ ho. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Websites ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn botaeɛ si amammerɛ ahorow, mmabunbere mu nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nna mu nsɛm so no betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo ne mmoa. Hotlines anaa Helplines: Akuokuo binom de hotlines anaa helplines ma a wubetumi abisa nsɛm na woanya akwankyerɛ wɔ amammerɛ ne abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ntawantawa ano atwa ho nhyehyɛe nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmabun di anim wɔ wɔn mpɔtam anaa intanɛt so a ɛdi mu, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔatumi akyɛ wɔn nsɛm, akwan, ne asuadeɛ a wɔasua de akanyan afoforo na wɔahyɛ nsakraeɛ pa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa mmɔdenbɔ anaa nnwuma a mmabun a wɔwɔ wɔn mpɔtam anaa intanɛt so di anim a ɛdi mu no bi ne: Atipɛnfoɔ ntamgyinafoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ: Mmabun a wɔatete wɔn wɔ ntawntawdie ano aduru ho nimdeɛ mu no yɛ ntamgyinafoɔ wɔ ntawantawadie a ɛwɔ wɔn mfɛfoɔ ntam, na ɛma nteaseɛ ne mpata ba. Abɛɛfo ntentan ɔsatu "Social Media Campaigns": Abɛɛfo ntentan mfidie "Social media platforms" a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nkuran, ahyɛ tema ho nkuran, na wɔakyɛ ankorankoro nsɛm a ɛfa ntawntawdi a wodi so nkonim ho. Nnwuma a mmabun di anim: Nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ nkurɔfo ho ban ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn adwene sii asomdwoe, abodwokyɛre, ne ntease a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam hɔ so. Intanɛt so nhyiamu: Intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa mmoa akuo a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a mmabun bɛtumi akyɛ wɔn suahunu, de afotuo ama, na wɔahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ wɔ ntawntawdie a wɔbɛsiesie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahunu na wɔako atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkɔ so kyerɛ amanneɛ bɔne, adwene bɔne, ne tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahunu na wɔagyina atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛhyɛ adwene bɔne anaa tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho denam adwene a wɔde bɛsua sɛ wɔbɛdwene deɛ wɔhu na wɔte ho yie. Wɔbetumi abisa nsɛmmisa afa nsɛm no ho, ahwehwɛ sɛnea ɛboa anaa ɛsɔre tia amanneɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ, na wɔakasa ama nneɛma a ɛteɛ na ɛka obiara ho. Sɛ wɔne afoforɔ resusu nsɛm yi ho, kyɛ adwene ahodoɔ, na wɔboa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛhyɛ nnipa ahodoɔ ne obu nkuran a, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔako atia nsɛm bɔne na wɔahyɛ nsakraeɛ pa nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmara a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa amanneɛbɔ mma no di wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma wɔ mmabun mu a wosiw ano na wodi ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛyɛ ahyɛde a ɛfa amanneɛbɔ ho di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ne wɔn a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so wɔ mmabun mu a wosiw ano na wodi ho dwuma mu denam hwehwɛ a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ adwumayɛfo binom bɔ nsɛm a wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ ayayade anaa ɔtow hyɛɛ wɔn so ho amanneɛ, na ɛnam so ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ntɛm, abɔ wɔn ho ban, na wɔanya mmoa nnwuma ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no. Saa mmara ahorow yi boa ma wohu wɔn a wɔayɛ bɔne no, ma wobu wɔn nneyɛe ho akontaa, na esiw ɔhaw foforo a ɛbɛba wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no ano. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔde amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ ahyɛde bedi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahobammɔ, yiyedi, ne hokwan ahorow adi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ahorow bu ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna subea, ne abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ahorow wɔ nna ho adwene ahorow. Ebinom abue, ebinom nso yɛ kokoamu de. Wɔ Ghana no, mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ katee kɛse. Abusua ho hia, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne ɔbaabun betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma sɛnea wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu wɔ adwenemyare ho no nyɛ nea ɛfata.
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a wubenya ama adwenemyare ho nsɛm yɛ ahoɔden ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, na ɛnyɛ mmerɛwyɛ. Ɛfata sɛ wote anigye ne apɔwmuden nka!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho ama awo akyi bere no na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya awo akyi hwɛ ne mmoa adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ahosiesie a wɔbɛyɛ ama awo akyi bere no ho hia. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun: Sua awo akyi osuahu ahorow a ɛtaa ba te sɛ adwene mu nsakrae, ɔbrɛ, ne nufu a wɔde ma ho haw ho ade. Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma mmoa fi abusuafo anaa nnamfo hɔ. Kyerɛ awo akyi hwɛ a wobɛpaw te sɛ bere a wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛdi akyi. Hwehwɛ awo akyi mmoa akuw anaa nnwuma a wɔyɛ ma awofo foforo wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Nea ɛka awo akyi hwɛ a wobenya no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkɔ bere a wɔhwɛ wɔn akyi, wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo susuw biribiara a ɛhaw adwene ho, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ awo akyi adwenemhaw anaa dadwen ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animdefo mmoa te sɛ ayaresa anaa afotu a wɔhwehwɛ no boa ma wodi adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" ho dwuma na ɛma ɛyɛ yiye?
answer_twi_source: Abenfoɔ Akwankyerɛ "Expect Guidance": Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn bɛtumi de mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne dwumadie a egyina adanseɛ so a wɔayɛ ama ankorankoro ahiadeɛ ama. Ntease ne Gyinabea: Ayaresa ma wonya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi ahwehwɛ nsusuwii, nkate, ne nneyɛe mu, na ɛboa ankorankoro ma wɔte nsɛnnennen ase na wogyina ano. Ahokokwaw a Wɔde Si Ahokokwaw: Ayaresa kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wogyina ano, nkitahodi ho akwan, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho akwan a wɔfa so di nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba no ho dwuma na wɔma yiyedi tu mpɔn. Normalization: Ayaresa boa ankorankoro ma wohu sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn nkutoo na wɔrepere wɔn ho, na ɛtew atinka a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho ne animtiaabu so. Mfaso a Ɛtra Hɔ Bere Tenten: Sɛ wonya nhumu ne sɛnea wogyina ano wɔ ayaresa mu a, ebetumi ama wɔanya nkɔso bere tenten wɔ adwenemyare ne asetra nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma abusuabɔ anaa twaka obu wom ba, na ɛne pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodi, ne ahye ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ a obu wom mu ne: Mpene: Hwɛ sɛ nkitahodi nyinaa yɛ nea wɔpene so na egyina wɔn baanu nyinaa adwene so. Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a emu da hɔ, nokwaredi, ne obu wom de da atinka, ahiade, ne ahye adi. Ahye: Ankorankoro ahye a wobebu ne afoforo ahye a wɔbɛte ase na wɔadi wɔn ni. Saa nneɛma yi ho hia na ama abusuabɔ pa aba na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nkitahodi ahorow no yɛ nea obu wom, ahobammɔ wom, na ɛma obiara nya abotɔyam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho wɔ yɛn man mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ pene a wɔpene so, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so, ɔhaw, ne nsɛmfua afoforo a ɛfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa nna ho mmonnaatoɔ ho gu ahorow gyina baabi a onipa firi, nanso mpɛn pii no ɛkyerɛ deɛ kwan mma (consent), nna ho mmonnaatoɔ (assault), nhyɛsoɔ (harassment), ne nsɛmfua afoforɔ a ɛho hia kyerɛ.Kwan mma (Consent) kyerɛ obi pɛ mu gyinaesi, nimdeɛ a obi wɔ wɔ deɛ ɔreyɛ ho, ne anigyeɛ mu panyin-gye a obi gye tom sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nna ho nneyɛeɛ bi.Nna ho mmonnaatoɔ (Assault) fa nna ho nneyɛeɛ anaa honam mu nkitahodi biara a kwan mma nnim ho, berɛ a nhyɛsoɔ nso fa nsɛm, nneyɛeɛ, anaasɛ nkuranhyɛ biara a obi mpɛ a ɛfa nna ho.Saa mmara mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu yi a yɛbɛte aseɛ ho hia pa ara na ama yɛatumi ahu na yɛasiesie nna ho mmonnaatoɔ nsɛm wɔ yɛn mpɔtam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na telefon a wɔde boa wɔn no hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun a ebia wɔwɔ asiane mu sɛ wobepira wɔn, wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayade, anaa wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa, a wɔn a wosusuw sɛ wobekum wɔn ho anaasɛ wohia mmoa a egye ntɛmpɛ ka ho no ahobammɔ ne yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Ahobanbɔ ne Yiyedi: Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo no wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun a ebia wɔwɔ asiane mu sɛ wobepira wɔn, wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayade, anaasɛ wɔbɛfa wɔn di dwuma no ahobammɔ ne yiyedi. Wɔatete afotufo sɛ wɔnhwɛ asiane dodoɔ a ɛwɔ mu na wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu a ɛfata, a sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔne wɔn a wɔhwɛ ntɛmpɛ so bɛdi nkitaho ka ho, na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ deɛ ɔfrɛ no no ahobanbɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi asua sɛnea wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn sika, ɛka, ne sika a wɔde asie so yiye na ama wɔadu wɔn sikasɛm botae ahorow ho, sɛ́ ɛyɛ sika a wɔbɛkora so ama nhomasua, adwuma bi a wobefi ase, anaa sikakorabea a wɔbɛkyekyere ntɛmpɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sika a wonya, ɛka a wɔbɔ, ne sika a wɔde sie a wɔbɛhwɛ so yiye no ho hia na ama wɔadu sikasɛm botae ahorow ho. Mmabun betumi ayɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛhwɛ wɔn sika a wonya ne wɔn ka, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobedi kan akyekyɛ sika de akɔ sikakorabea ne nneɛma a wohia. Sɛ wɔde wɔn sika a wonya no fã bi sie di kan, sɛ ɛyɛ ketewaa mpo a, ɛboa ma wonya ahobammɔ afiri ma tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ anaa daakye botae ahorow.
