Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so ama wɔn sika akɔ soro denam bere fã adwuma, adwuma a wɔyɛ a wɔde wɔn ho, anaa nnwuma a wɔyɛ de ma wɔn sika a wɔde sie no anya nkɔanim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ me nyinsɛn no ho, a mɛte nka sɛ eye ma me?
answer_twi_source: Gyinae a wubenya wɔ wo nyinsɛn no ho a wubesi no hwehwɛ sɛ wususuw wo gyinapɛn ahorow, wo tebea ahorow, ne akwan ahorow a wubetumi afa so no ho. Sɛ wo ne ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di bɛkasa a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woahwehwɛ akwan horow a wubetumi afa so na woasi gyinae a ɛte sɛ nea eye ma wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow di wɔ awo akwahosan hokwan (SRH) a mmabun nya ho banbɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmara Nhyehyɛe: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow de kwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho no si hɔ. Wobetumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nsɛm, nnwuma, ne ahobammɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi nyiyim ho. Akwahosan Dwumadie: Nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi ahyɛ mmabun ne mmabun adamfofa dwumadie, kokoamsɛm, ne kwan a wɔfa so nya nnwuma a ɛsua koraa a nea ɛka ho ne , akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, nyinsɛn ano aduru, adwenemyareɛ, SGBV dwumadie. Nhomasua: Mmara betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ sukuu ahorow de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ma, na ɛho hia na ama wɔatumi asi gyinae a ɛfata. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no ho hia kɛse ma awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban na wɔahyɛ ho nkuran wɔ ɔkwan a ɛtrɛw so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ bragorɔ de ahyɛ wɔn ho animonyan wɔ nkɔsɔ, ntotoyɛ pa ne ahwɛyie a wɔyɛ wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔso a Wogye Tom: Ankorankoro nkɔso, yeedie, ne nea watumi ayɛ, sɛ́ ɛyɛ honam fam, nkate fam, anaa asetra mu a wobehu na wɔadi ho afahyɛ. Aseda a Wɔda no Adi: Anisɔ a wɔda no adi wɔ mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne osuahu ahorow a aboa wɔn nsabuo berɛ mu. Wɔrehyɛ fa: Sɛ wɔde afahyɛ a ahorow a ntease wom a ɛbɛkyerɛ mmabun nkɔsoɔ wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu bɛba a wɔde bɛhyɛ mmabun animonyam te sɛ awoda di anaa ankorankoro suahunu bi. Onyin Ho Nsusuwii: Bere a wobegye de asusuw nsakrae, ɔhaw, ne asuade ahorow a wonyae wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu no ho na wɔda anisɔ adi wɔ hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ obenyin na woanya nkɔso no ho. Osuahu a Wɔkyɛ: Osuahu ne nhumu a wɔde bɛkyɛ atipɛnfo, nnamfo, anaa abusua mufo de adi nnipa dodow a wɔbom nyin na wotumi gyina tebea horow ano wɔ asetra mu nsakrae bere yi mu ho afahyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Su titiriw bɛn na ɛwɔ abusuabɔ pa ne obu mu? (sɛ nhwɛso no, ahotoso, obu, nokwaredi, nkitahodi, ahye)
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso: Wubetumi de wo ho ato wo hokafo so na woate nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ sɛ wobɛka wo kokoam nsɛm akyerɛ wɔn. Obu: Mommu mo ho mo ho atenka, adwene, ne ahye sɛ ɛsom bo. Nokwaredi: Mubetumi aka nokware akyerɛ mo ho mo ho na mo ho atɔ mo sɛ mobɛda mo ho adi pefee. Nkitahodi: Wubetumi aka biribiara ho asɛm pefee na woadi nokware, a w’ahiade, nea wopɛ, ne nea ɛhaw wo ka ho. Ahye: Mo baanu nyinaa bu mo ho mo ho mo honam ne atenka fam ahunmu. Mmoa: Mohyɛ mo ho mo ho botae ahorow ho nkuran na mohyɛ mo ho mo ho nkonimdi ho afahyɛ. Pɛyɛ: Abusuabɔ no te nka sɛ ɛkari pɛ, na obiara nte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn so anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa kuo bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma me ne atipɛnfo akuw a wɔwɔ adwempa adi nkitaho na manya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma wo ne atipɛnfo akuw a wɔyɛ papa adi nkitaho na woanya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Ebia wo sukuu no de afotuo dwumadie anaa asuafoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ so bɛma. Bio nso, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, mmabun akuw, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ adwumaden na wɔhwɛ so no betumi ayɛ mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, suban ahorow, ne nneyɛe a ɛboa ma wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ, te sɛ asodi a wɔde to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa, mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, anaa su horow a ɛmma aniberesɛm a ɛwɔ ɔhaw anaa nhyɛso mu no nyɛ ketewaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu na wɔakasa atia asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, suban ahorow, ne nneyɛe a ɛboa ma wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ denam: Nhumu a wɔbɛma akɔ so: Mfɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn sɛnea nna mu basabasayɛ abu so ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so, ne dwuma a asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a epira di ma ɛkɔ so tra hɔ no so. Mmarima ne Mmea Pɛyɛ a Wɔbɛhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ na wɔakasa atia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛyɛ nyiyim a ɛhyɛ tumi a ɛnkari pɛ mu den na ɛboa ma wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ. Kasa a Wɔkasa Tia Wɔn a Wɔabɔ Wɔn Sobo Ho: Su a wɔbɛpow asodi a wɔde to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no so na wɔabu wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no ho akontaa wɔ wɔn nneyɛe ho sen sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo wɔ basabasayɛ a wohyia no ho. Tema ne Obu a Wɔbɛma Anya: Tema ne obu a wobenya ama afoforo ahye, osuahu, ne hokwan ahorow, ne amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so na wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ abusuabɔ nyinaa mu. Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔbɛboa wɔn: Mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu, a afotu, nsɛm a wɔka de gyina wɔn akyi, ne mmara mu mmoa a wobenya ka ho, ne adwuma a wɔbɛyɛ de atew animtiaabu a ɛbata nna mu basabasayɛ ho nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ etia amammerɛ anaa abrabɔ pa mu gyidi ahorow a ɛbɔ abira a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛte adwene ahorow ase denam nhomasua ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu womu: Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a obu wom a egye gyidi ahorow tom na ɛma ɛyɛ nokware mu. Hwɛ Nneɛma a Wogye Di: Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa afotufo a wobetumi de nsɛm a enni afã biara na ɛyɛ nokware ama. Ankorankoro Nsusuwii: Dwene w’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ho na ama woatumi de ntease akɔ nsusuwii ahorow a ɛbɔ abira so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihia mmoa wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho, te sɛ awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu mu a, dɛn ne akwan ahorow a mɛfa so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem a wɔrehyia gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho no betumi ahwehwɛ akwan ahorow a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ saa na wɔanya mmoa nnwuma de apaw nea ɛfata a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn, botae, apɛde ne tebea horow hyia. Ebia akwan bi ne mmoa dwumadie bi ne: Awofoɔ: Awofoɔ adesua, mmoa akuo, ne nneɛma a wɔbɛnya ama awofoɔ a wɔrehwɛ kwan ne wɔn foforɔ a wɔbɛsua mmofra hwɛ, awofoɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmoa dwumadie ho adeɛ. Abofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma: Wɔhwehwɛ mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow, afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne mmoa akuw mu de sua mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho nhyehyɛe, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma akyi no ho ade. Nyinsɛn a wotu gu: Kokoam afotu, nsɛm, ne aduruyɛ ho nnwuma a wobenya afi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, abusua nhyehyɛe ayaresabea ahorow, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwumayɛfo hɔ de asusuw akwan horow a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn a woyi gu, akwan horow, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhwɛ akyi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmaranimfo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ di wɔ mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu no mu, na ahwehwɛde anaa osuahu bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ho adwumayɛfo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmara kwan so mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de ma mmabun mu denam: Mmara ho afotu, ananmusifo, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina asɛnnibea anaa adwumayɛ ho nsɛm a wɔde ma so. Afotu a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ, nea wobetumi apaw, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ de abɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow ho ban na ama atɛntrenee a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Sɛ mmabun rehwehwɛ mmoa a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmara ho adwumayɛfo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔwɔ osuahu ne nimdeɛ wɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow, nna ne awo akwahosan ho mmara, ne adeyɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde adwumayɛfo a wobu wɔn ahofadi, wokura wɔn kokoamsɛm mu, na wɔde wɔn yiyedi di kan di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn dwumadi na digital ne online media di wɔ mmabun (adolescents') apomuden ho nimdeɛ (health literacy) a wɔnya fa bɔbeasu ne awo ho apomuden ho (sexual and reproductive health) no nsiesiei mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔnya nsɛm / mmoa fi mu. Ɛtumi ma ananansesɛm / nsɛm a ɛnteɛ tena hɔ. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ nneɛma a wɔnya nsɛm fi mu no mu pau.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow anaa nnwuma a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nkɔso a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu dwumadiɛ a wɔde bɛma  mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) nsunsuansoɔ atu mpɔn ho nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Nhyiamu a mmabun di anim a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano, nna mu yareɛ (STI) ano aduru, ne nyɔnkofa nkitahodi  papa ho. Mpɔtam akwahosan ho guasodeyɛ ahorow a wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma, a afotu, sɔhwɛ, ne nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔkyekyɛ ka ho. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho adesua a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun akwannya ahorow ne fahodi ho ban. Adwinni adwuma, te sɛ agoprama so agodie, afasu ho mfonini, anaa nsɛm a wɔka ho asɛm, a ɛma nkurɔfo hu mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) nsɛm na ɛkasa tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na media nkrasɛm a ɛfa adidi, mu duru nteso, ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ho no nya mmabun adwene wɔ wɔn ankasa nipadua ne wɔn apɔwmuden ho nneyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa adidi, mu duru a wɔtew so, ne apɔw-mu-tentenne ho betumi aka mmabun adwene wɔ wɔn nipadua ne akwahosan ho nneyɛe ho denam: Adwene a ɛnyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ papa a ɛfa teateaa anaa ntini a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, a ɛbɛma wɔanya adidi mu nneyɛe a ɛnkɔ yie, nipadua mu abotɔyam a wonni, ne wɔn ho akokudro a a ɛba fam. Adwene a ɛne sɛ mu duru a nteso anaasɛ nipadua bi a wobenya ho hia na ama obi anya anigye anaa nkonimdi no a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den, na wɔama aduan amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a epira akɔ so atra hɔ. Mmabun apɔw-mu-tentennee, aduan a wɔpaw, ne nipadua mfonini ho dadwen a egyina ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ne nhyɛso a wosusuw sɛ ɛwɔ so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn na mɛfa so abɔ kɔkɔ (report) afa GBV ho akyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi akɔ ayaresabea anaa akwahosan asoɛe akɔhwehwɛ mmoa na wo ne mmara adwumayɛbea ahorow abɔ nkɔmmɔ. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wogye wɔn di a, bɔ apolisifo amanneɛ. Wubetumi nso adi kan anya mmoa afi kokoam adwumayɛbea bi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abɛɛfo ntentanfidie di wɔ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu a wɔma ɛkɔ so tra hɔ na wɔhyɛ ntotoho ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie platform ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware a wɔma ɛkɔ so tra hɔ na wɔhyɛ ntotoho ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu denam: Mfonini ahorow a wɔayɛ no yiye, a wɔayɛ no yiye a ɛkyerɛ nokwasɛm a wɔayɛ no yiye a wɔbɛkyɛ na wɔakyekyɛ no a ɛbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. ntotoho amammerɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam nea wɔpɛ, nsɛm a wɔka, ne akyidifo so, baabi a ankorankoro gyina abɔnten so adansedi so susuw wɔn bo. Mmabun adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ ahoɔfɛ ne wɔn ho a wɔsom bo ho a wobenya denam wɔn a wonya nsunsuanso, nnipa a wɔagye din, ne wɔn atipɛnfo a wɔne ahoɔfɛ ho adwene atitiriw hyia a wɔbɛda wɔn ho adi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ nna ne nna mu apomoden ho nya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu ɔhaw ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu: Amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo mu animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nsɛm ho no betumi ama obi ani awu na wampɛ sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Bɔbeasu Ho Nsusuwii: Akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima anaa ɔbea ho betumi aka sɛnea wohu nna mu ɔhaw ne sɛnea wodi ho dwuma no. Nhomasua: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wonnya no betumi ama wɔanya adwene a ɛnteɛ ne nna mu apomoden n ho nimdeɛ a wonni. Apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ apomoden ho, a nna mu apomodenn ka ho, betumi anya nnwuma ne mmoa a wobenya so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwumayɛbea anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ase yie?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebia nhyiam ahorow anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ase yiye. Akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a wɔkasama kyerɛ, anaa nhomasua asoɛe ahorow na wobetumi de saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ama na ebetumi aka nsɛmti te sɛ hokwan ahorow a ayarefo wɔ, pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛfa so akɔ, ne obi ho a ɔbɛkamfo ho asɛm. Wubetumi abisa nhyehyɛe a ɛtete saa ho asɛm wɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, anaa denam intanɛt so nneɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea a wɔredi mfe aduonu ho no kyerɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya mfaso afi mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ wɔ sikasɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho no boa mmarimaa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔadu mpanyin mfe so denam mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sikasɛm mu no so, na ɛma nkɔsoɔ a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛkɔ so daa ba ma obiara. Wɔkasa tia atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ne dwumadi ahorow, na wɔma mmarimaa ne  mmeranteɛ nya hokwan ahorow de wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhwɛ ne ofie asɛyɛde ahorow mu, di nnwuma a ɛnyɛ atetesɛm mu de akyi, na wɔboa mmea sikasɛm mu ahoɔden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so di adwennwen ne dadwen ho dwuma denam nkitahodi mapa a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusua, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo di so?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodie pa betumi aboa ma wɔadi adwennwen ne dadwen so denam atenka horow a wɔbɛda no adi ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi atipɛnfo, abusua, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo hɔ no so. Fa nkitahodi a emu da hɔ a ɛfa wo haw ne w’ahiade ho di dwuma, fa akwanhwɛ a ɛfata sisi hɔ, na fa nnwuma hyɛ afoforoɔ nsa berɛ a wote nka sɛ woayɛ basaa no. Fa akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa adwene a wɔde si biribi so di dwuma na ama woatumi agyina adwennwen ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɛnyɛ me dɛ sɛ me ne m’awofo bɛka m’adwene mu akwahosan ho asɛm a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Susu ho sɛ wobɛka wo kokoam nsɛm akyerɛ ɔpanyin foforo a wogye no di, te sɛ wo busuani, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu fotumafo. Kyerɛw wo nsusuii ne wo atenka wɔ nhoma mu hyehyɛ wo nsusuii ansa na woasusu ho akyerɛ. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔbenfo a obetumi akyerɛ wo kwan a wobɛfa so akasa akyerɛ w’awofo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmabun mu so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ mmabun mu denam: Nea wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ nea wogye tom anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea wɔabara wɔ nna mu nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, ne awo ho paw a wɔkyerɛ so. Sɛnea mmabun hu wɔn ankasa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow, ne afoforo de nso so nkɛntɛnso. Akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ amammerɛ tebea bi mu. Nimdeɛ ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔde bɛma kwan afi awo ntoatoaso biako mu akɔ foforo mu. Nsiesiei a wɔde bɛma ama wɔate osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nkɔso, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, ne nipasu ho ase na wɔakyerɛ ase wɔ amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobetumi akyerɛm ama mate aseɛ nsunsuansoɔ a ebetumi afiri me nneyɛɛ mu aba a ɛfa nna mu dwumadie ahodoɔ a wɔde si nyisɛn ne yareɛ mmoawa a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no sɛ 'STI' ano no ase?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu dwumadie: Nyinsɛn, nna mu nyarewa, adwene mu haw. Ahoban mmɔ ho nsɛm: Ɛsi nyinsɛn kwan, ɛwɔ nsusuanso bɔne. nna mu nyarewa mu ahoban mmɔ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu no wɛfrɛ no 'condom': Ɛte esan so, nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa na yɛsi ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi aboa me ma mate sɛnea mɛbɔ m’ankasa me ho nsɛm ne me kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a mede sohyial media ne intanɛt so dwumadibea afoforo redi dwuma no ase?
answer_twi_source: Fa kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe di dwuma de hwɛ nea obetumi ahu wo nsɛm, mfoni, ne w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm wɔ sohyial media so. Hwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia te sɛ wo din nyinaa, address, telefon nɔma, anaa mfoni ahorow a ɛfa wo ho a wobɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no ho. Kwati sɛ wode w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm a wobetumi de ahu wo anaa woahu wo wɔ Intanɛt so no bɛto hɔ anaa wobɛkyɛ. Hwɛ wo kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe no mu daa na yɛ foforo na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm bɛkɔ so abɔ ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, ahwɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun nya no yɛ mmerɛw anaasɛ wosiw kwan mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahyɛ abusua nkitahodi, mmoa, ne wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu mu den na ama wɔanya akwahosan pa?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ ne mpanyimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ mmofra so wɔ dwumadie titiriw bi wɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛboa anaasɛ wɔbɛsi kwan ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa anya nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan nnuro ne nteteeɛ. Awofoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun a wɔboa wɔn na wɔwɔ nimdeɛ bɛtumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔahwehwɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie denam akwantuo, sikasɛm mu mmoa, ne nkateɛ fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn so. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nso betumi ama wɔanya akwahosan hwehwɛ nneyɛe pa na aboa mmabun ma wɔafa akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu. Nanso, awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no binom betumi de akwanside ahorow ato akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, esiane amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, kokoamsɛm ho dadwen, anaa hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya kokoam hwɛ ho nimdeɛ a wonni nti. Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, mmabun betumi ahyia ɔsɔretia anaa atemmu afi abusua mufo hɔ, na ebetumi asiw wɔn kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ. Sɛ abusua mu nkitahodiɛ, mmoa, ne dɔm bɛyɛ den a, ɛma akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ pa ba: Ɛyɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ nkuran ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛmu da hɔ na obi mmu obi fɔ kɔ so wɔ awofoɔ ne mmofra ntam fa nna ne awoɔ ho nsɛm ho. Ebi ne sɛdeɛ yɛsi si awoɔ kwan, nna mu nyarewa, ne pene ahorow ansa na nna aba. Bio sɛ yɛɛbma awofoɔ kwan ma wɔka gyinaeɛ a mmofra si wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho, bere a yɛbu mmofra no ahofadi ne wɔn kokoamsɛm ho kwan nso ni. Ebi ne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ abusua nhyehyɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔ, ayaresabea kɔ a awofoɔ apene so, ne nea mmofra no bɛsua wɔ sukuu mu. Sɛ yɛde nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nneɛma bɛma awofoɔ na wɔanya nimdeɛ afa sɛdeɛ mmofra nyini, nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan, ne akwan pa a wɔfa so ne mmofra bɔ nkɔmmɔ. Eyi bɛma abusua mu ayɛ dɛ na aboa mmofra no yiedie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na wɔn a wɔresi sɔ  bɛtumi aboa ama intanɛt so adeyɛ ayɛ safe na ɛka obiara ho pɛpɛɛpɛ denam digital adɔeɛ, adɔeɛ ankasa, ne digital ɔmanfoɔ gyinapɛn a wɔde bɛbɔ bra so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn wɔresi sɔ betumi akyerɛkyerɛ digital adɔeɛ (empathy) ne ɔmanfoɔ a wɔbɔ bra pa wɔ intanɛt so mu de aboa ma intanɛt so adeyɛ ayɛ safe na ɛka obiara ho denam akwan a edidi soɔ yi so: Wɔbɛyɛ adɔeɛ na wɔabu nnipa afoforo a wɔwɔ intanɛt so, na wɔahwɛ yie sɛ wɔn nsɛm ne nea wɔyɛ ka afoforo ho. Wɔbɛtumi agyina kyerɛwtohɔ so nsɛm, ahyɛ nnipa bi so, ne nnipa nteteeɛ mu nsɛm a ɛnnye ho denam kasakyerɛ ne abuafoɔ so. Wɔbɛka wɔn ho abɔ mu ama nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfata ne ntoboa a ɛbɛkɔ anim na wɔahyɛ intanɛt so suban a ɛfata ho nkuran. Wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hohoahoafoɔ wɔ digital nsɛm, intanɛt so bammɔ, ne digital ɔmanfoɔ ho mmara mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ basabasayɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ntam abusuabɔ anaa obi a wadi dɛm ntam abusuabɔ mu? (akwan a wɔfa so di so, atenka mu nsakrae) .
answer_twi_source: Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana ha.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenemhaw bammɔ betumi aboa mmabun a wafa ɔhaw ɛwɔ nna ne awɔ mu apɔmden mu pɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a atɛmmuo nni mu. Wɔgye wo tom. Wɔhu adwenemhaw mu nsɛnkyerɛnne. Wɔma bammɔ ne nkuranhyɛ.Wɔboa wɔ ɔkwan pa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu, nyiyimu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn no ka mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabiara no kwan a wɔfa so nya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi so?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu, nyiyimu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn no ka mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔ baabiara no kwan a wɔfa so nya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma denam akwanside ahorow a ɛde ba wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ho ne ɔsom a wɔde ma a wɔto ano hye so. Wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi so denam nhomasua ne atinka a wɔde bɛma, ntetee a wɔde ma apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu bɛma, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛbɔ mmabun nyinaa hokwan ahorow ho ban a wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ, a wɔn atutra tebea mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, asetra, ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma nya dawurubɔ ne aguadie ho nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a wɔyɛ ne nea wogye so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ, asetra, ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma nya dawurubɔ ne aguadi ho nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a wɔyɛ ne nea wogye so nkɛntɛnso denam gyinapɛn ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nea adetɔfo pɛ a wɔhyehyɛ no so. Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, ɔmanfo adwene, ne sikasɛm mu anigye betumi anya aguade ho dawurubɔ ɔsatu ahorow mu nsɛm, ɛnne, ne akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ani si so, ne sɛnea ankorankoro kyerɛ nkrasɛm yi ase na wɔyɛ ho biribi no so nsusuaso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetra mu nneyɛe pa a ebetumi ama nipadua ho mfonini pa ne obu ama yɛn ho, te sɛ apɔ mu ateneatene daa, adidi yie, ne nna a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Apɔ mu ateneatene a Wobɛyɛ Daa: Apɔ mu ateneatene a ɛyɛ anigye na ɛma ahoɔden, wo gyena wo nan so yie, ne nipadua no nyinaa mu. Aduan a Ɛkari pɛ: Nnuan ahorow a ahoɔden wom a ɛma nipadua no nya ahoɔden na ɛboa ahoɔden dodow ne adwene a ɛwɔ nipadua no mu a wubedi. Dae a Ɛfata: Nna a wobɛda no yie de aboa nipadua ne adwene mu akwahosan, adwene a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne adwene mu dwumadi. Adwennwen Ho Dwumadi: Akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, anaa yoga a wɔde bedi dwuma de atew adwennwen so na ama nkate fam yiyedi anya nkɔso. Wɔn Ho a Wobɛhwɛ: Dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wohwɛ wɔn ho ne ayamhyehye a wonya wɔ wo ho mu, te sɛ nsɛmma nhoma kyerɛw, anigyede ahorow, anaa bere a wo ne w’adɔfo nya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na mmabun betumi anya STI nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow, na dɛn ne akwan a wobetumi afa so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya STI nhwehwɛmu dwumadie denam nneɛma ahodoɔ so, a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, abusua nhyehyɛeɛ ayaresabea, mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛeɛ, STI ayaresabea, ne akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu mu ka ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow pii de STI nhwehwɛmu adwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam na ne bo nyɛ den a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade pɔtee ma. Bio nso, ahyehyɛde ahorow bi ne ɔmanfo akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow de STI nhwehwɛmu a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyiam ahorow anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa nnipa mu. Mmabun nso betumi asusuw ho sɛ wɔde mfiri a wɔde sɔ nneɛma hwɛ wɔ fie bedi dwuma, a ɛma wotumi boaboa nhwɛsode ahorow ano wɔ wɔn ankasa fie kokoam na wɔde kɔ aduruyɛdan mu ma wɔhwehwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de abɛɛfo ntentanfidie ne dijitaal akwan adi dwuma ahyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ho nkuran sane nso akasa tia ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ wɔ mmabun ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de abɛɛfo ntentanfidie ne dijitaal akwan adi dwuma sɛ adeɛ a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ho nkuran na wɔkasa tia ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enyɛ wɔ mmabun ho denam ahoɔfɛ ho mfonini ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, nipadua mu nhwɛso pa a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so, ne intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔboa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso no so. Mmabun betumi ahwɛ wɔn ntentanfidie so feeds anaa nsɛm de nneɛma pa a ɛhyɛ nkuran aka ho, de wɔn ho ahyɛ intanɛt so ɔsatu ne anammɔntuo ahorow a ɛhyɛ nipadua a wogye tom ho nkuran mu, na wɔde wɔn ankasa nhyiam ahorow adi dwuma de atrɛw nkrasɛm a ɛfa wɔn ho dɔ ne nnipa a wɔka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔhaw ahorow ba nyinsɛn mu a ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ yie? (mogya a ɛretu, ɛyaw a emu yɛ den) .
answer_twi_source: Bere a nyinsɛn taa yɛ anigye bere no, hu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne yi: Mogya a ɛba ɔbea awotoa mu: Mogya biara a ɛbɛtɔ bere a nyinsɛn no yɛ ade a ɛhaw adwene na ehia sɛ wokɔ ayaresabea ntɛm ara. Yafunu mu yaw a emu yɛ den: Ɛyaw a emu yɛ den a ɛrenkɔ no betumi akyerɛ sɛ ɔhaw bi wɔ hɔ. Atiridiinini: Atiridiinini a ano yɛ den betumi apira obi wɔ nyinsɛn mu. Awotoa no kankyee a ɛso tew: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wuntumi nkɔ baabiara kɛse a, Kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn bere a wote nka anaa wuhu sɛnkyerɛnne anaa sɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛyɛ soronko ara pɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nksunsuanso bɛn na abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so influencers nya wɔ adwene a mmabun kura wɔ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn, nipadua mfonini, ne nna ho gyinapɛn ahorow ho no so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako atia nkɛntɛnso bɔne na wɔama nipadua mu adwempa anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so influencers betumi anya mmabun adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn, nipadua mfonini, ne nna mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho so nsunsuanso denam: Ahoɔfɛ ho adwene a ɛnyɛ nokware ne nipadua gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam mfonini ahorow a wɔasiesie, nneɛma a wɔde yiyi nneɛma mu, ne akwan a wɔfa so siesie so. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a emu nnɔ a ɛfa sɛnea obi ho yɛ fɛ ne nea ɔpɛ a ebetumi ama mmabun anya nipadua mu abotɔyam ne obu a ɛba fam ama wɔn ho a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den. Mmabun betumi ako atia nsunsuanso bɔne na wɔahyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ho nkuran denam: Nsunsuanso ahorow a wodi akyi a wodi nipadua ahorow ahorow ho afahyɛ, hyɛ wɔn ho dɔ ho nkuran, na wɔkasa tia atetesɛm mu ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo ne ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a wosi hia a ankorankoro ne wɔn ho a wogye tom ho hia so dua. Wɔkamfo ananmusifo a wɔka ho ne nipadua ahorow ho mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu, nokware ne gye a wogye tom ho nkuranhyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nyiyimu afoforo te sɛ abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, anaa asetra ne sikasɛm mu gyinabea di abom?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no ne nyiyim afoforo di nkitaho, na ɛde akwanside ne ɔhaw ahorow a emu yɛ den ba ankorankoro a wohyia nnipa pii a wɔato wɔn hintidua no so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, mmea a wɔn kɔla yɛ kɔkɔɔ anaasɛ wɔn asetra mu sikasɛm tebea sua no betumi anya nyiyimu ahorow a ɛtwam a ɛka wɔn nneɛma, hokwan ahorow, ne hokwan ahorow a wonya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awoɔ nhyehyɛe ɛfa apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn awoɔ ne awo akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so daakye ase?
answer_twi_source: Adesua a ɛfa awoɔ nhyehyɛe apomosen ho betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn awo ne awo akwan horow ase denam: Nsɛm a ɛfa brayɛ, ovulation, ne awo ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛma ho. Dwuma a nyinsɛn ano a wosiw di wɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da a wosiw ano mu a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu na wɔama ankorankoro tumi ma wɔapaw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo daakye ho. Awo a wɔbɛkora so a wɔbɛpaw ama ankorankoro a wɔrehyia ayaresa a ebetumi aka awo te sɛ nnuru anaa mframa a wɔde sa yare no ho nkɔmmɔbɔ. Abusua nhyehyɛe ho akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma, a nea wosusuw ho te sɛ bere a wɔde nyinsɛn, abusua kɛse a wɔpɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete ɛyaw anaa me ho nyɛ me dɛ bere a merenya nna mu nkitahodie a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Gyina ho na Di Nkitahodi: Sɛ wote ɛyaw anaa wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, gyae dwumadi no ntɛm ara. Wo ne wo hokafo nni nkitaho fa nea wote nka no ho. Nea Ebetumi De Ba: Ɛyaw a ɛba bere a ɔne obi reda no betumi afi srade a wɔmfa nhyɛ mu, nea ɛnkanyan no sɛnea ɛsɛ, anaa nneɛma afoforo. Ɛyaw a Wodi Ho Dwuma: Fa srade di dwuma na ama akasakasa ne nea ɛnyɛ dɛ no so atew. Susuw ho sɛ wobɛsɔ gyinabea ahorow ahwɛ anaasɛ wobɛtew mmirikatu no so. Aduruyɛ mu Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Sɛ ɛyaw no kɔ so a, kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn na ɔnyi ayaresa tebea biara a ɛde ba no mfi hɔ. Tebea horow te sɛ ɔyare mmoawa anaa endometriosis betumi ama obi ate ɛyaw na ehia sɛ wokɔ ayaresabea.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so susuw nkate, akɔnnɔ, apadeɛ ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ho na wodi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho Dwen: Gye bere fa te w’ankasa wo nkate ne w’akɔnnɔ ase. Susuw nea wopɛ fi nna mu abusuabɔ mu no ho. Nkate mu Nhwehwɛmu: Hwɛ wo ho daa wɔ nea wopɛ wɔ wo nkate tebea ho. Te sɛnea nkate betumi anya wo gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso no ase. Nkitahodi a wo ne ɔhokafo di: Wo ne wo hokafo nsusuw nkate ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho pefee. Hwɛ hu sɛ mo baanu nyinaa te mo ho mo ho akɔnnɔ ase yiye. Adwene mu Nsusuwii ne Ahomegye: Fa adwene mu nhumu akwan horow di dwuma de di adwennwen ne nkate horow ho dwuma. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wode gye w’ahome betumi aboa wo ma woakɔ so ayɛ adwuma na woayɛ nea ɛne wo nkate hyia. Hwehwɛ Akwankyerɛ: Wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔpanyin a wogye no di nkasa mfa sɛnea wubedi nkate horow ho dwuma ho. Wobetumi de akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so anya nkate fam yiyedi ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma ne nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ wɔn mmara kwan so akwan horow, te sɛ mmara kwan so mmoa ayaresabea ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa, mmaranimfo a wɔmfa hwee nto mu, ne mmara kwan so nsɛm a wɔde kɔ intanɛt so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a nna ho mmonnaatoɔ ato wɔn na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmara mu kwan a wɔbɛfa so no bɛtumi anya mmoa mbea ahodoɔ, a ebi ne mmara mu mmoa adwumayɛbea nketewa, ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔgyina ama wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne, mmaranimfoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma kwa a wonnye sika (pro bono), ne intanɛt so amanneɛbɔ mbea a ɛfa mmara ho. Saa mmoa mbea yi bɛtumi ama mmara mu afotu ne nnipa a wɔbɛgyina ama wɔn wɔ asɛnniiɛ, mmoa wɔ ɔkwan a mmara no fa so mu, amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa obi kwan ne akwan ahodoɔ a ɛda ne dɔm so, ne nnipa a wɔbɛtumi de wɔn akɔ wɔn nkyɛn ama mmoa afoforɔ te sɛ afotu ne ayaresa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akari pɛ wɔ ASRR ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne me bɔhyɛ foforo ho na mahwɛ m’ankasa m’adwene ne atennka fam akwahosan so wɔ adeyɛ no mu? (Bere a wɔde di dwuma yiye, nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho) .
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi ho hia, nanso wo yiyedi nso ho hia! Sɛnea wobɛkari pɛ ni: Bere a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Yɛ mmere pɔtee a wode bɛyɛ adwuma a wode bɛkamfo asɛm no ho nhyehyɛe na bata ho. Eyi boa ma wɔkwati sɛ obi bɛhyew. Nneyɛe a Wɔde Hwɛ Wo Ho: Gye bere ma dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, te sɛ bere a wode bɛbɔ wo nnamfo anaa anigyede ahorow a wode gye w’ahome ho. Fa nna a ɛdɔɔso ne adidi pa di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa nkitahodibea anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae ase na wɔde adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma denam: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne nkitahodie pa a wɔde bɛma so. Akwahosan asoɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu a asuafo betumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam a wɔbɛma wɔn kwan. Mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, wɔ sukuu tebea no mu ne akyi nyinaa ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmuo a asuafoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nneɛma anaa nsɛm a ɛkɔ so wɔ sini ahorow, TV so dwumadi ahorow, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ afoforo mu a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛe a wɔhyɛ nkurɔfo anaasɛ wɔmpene so, na wɔate nkɛntɛnso "impact"a saa mfonini ahorow yi nya wɔ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu ne ɔmanfo nyinaa so no ase?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm anaa nsɛm a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ "media" mu a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ nkurɔfo anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nea wɔpene so mu na wɔabubu denam tumi a ɛkɔ so no mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye, ahu nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so nni hɔ anaasɛ wobu wɔn ani gu so, ne nkɛntɛnso a saa mfonini ahorow yi nya wɔ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu ne ɔmanfo so a wɔbɛka ho asɛm. Ɛdenam nkɛntɛnso bɔne a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo de ba a wobehu so no, mmabun betumi akamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ mfonini a edi mu na asɛyɛde wom a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔpene so a ɛma abusuabɔ pa nya nkɔso na esiw nna mu basabasayɛ "sexual violence" ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nnwuma ne ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim a edi mu a ɛde tumidi ho nkuran yiye wɔ kyɛfa a wonya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔkasa ho ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Kuw ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔkasa fa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu kyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a ɛde nsɛm, afotu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho ma. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nhyiamu ahorow a ɛkasa tia animtiaabu, hyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ho nkuran, na wɔkasa ma nna ne awo akwannya ahorow . Nhwehwɛmu adwuma a mmabun di anim a ɛkyerɛw mmabun ahiade ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmɔdenbɔ anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ so a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛma mfe a wɔadi a wɔpene so ho mmara ahorow no foforo anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae na ama wɔada nnɛyi ntease ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna mu apomoden ne ahofadi ho adi yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mmɔdenbɔ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ so wɔ hɔ a wɔn botae a no ne sɛ wɔbɛma mfe a wɔadi a wɔpene so ho mmara ahorow no foforo anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae na ama wɔada nnɛyi ntease ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna mu apomoden ne ahofadi ho adi yiye. Mmabun betumi aboa mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi denam ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kasa ama nkurɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho, na wɔama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ne mmara ahorow a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, a egyina adanse so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so brɛ ntawntawdi ase wɔ asomdwoe mu, te sɛ bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome, kommyɛ, "Me" nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma, kasa bɔne a wɔsan hyehyɛ, nsɛm a wɔbom hwehwɛ, ne adwene a wɔde besi ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru so sen sɛ wɔde asodi anaa ɔkasatia bɛto wɔn so?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so brɛ ntawntawdi ase wɔ asomdwoe mu no bi ne: Bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome: Twe wo ho fi tebea no mu bere tiaa bi na ama wo ho adwo na woanya adwene. Dwo a wobɛkɔ so ayɛ komm: Su a wobɛkɔ so ayɛ nea ɛyɛ den na woakwati sɛ wobɛma ayɛ kɛse denam kasa a wobɛkasa brɛoo ne nipadua mu kasa a ɛnyɛ ahunahuna a wode bedi dwuma so. "Me" nsɛm a wɔde bedi dwuma: Nsusuwii ne nkate a wɔde nsɛmfua te sɛ "Mete nka" anaa "Mesusuw" a ebetumi atew ahobammɔ so na ahyɛ tema ho nkuran. Kasa a ɛnteɛ a wɔsan hyehyɛ: Kasa pa anaa afã biara a wɔbɛpaw de ayɛ nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe na wɔakwati sɛ wobɛbɔ afoforo sobo anaasɛ wobɛbɔ wɔn sobo. Nkitahodi a wobehu: Nneɛma a wɔn nyinaa ani gye ho anaa botae ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛ de akyekye abusuabɔ na wɔayɛ adwuma de ate wɔn ho wɔn ho ase. Ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so: Sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi so fi asodi a wɔde bɛma so akɔ ano aduru a wobenya a edi obiara ahiade ne n’adwennwen ho dwuma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi afa so asua nneɛma pii afa amammerɛ mu adwene ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho (SRH)?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow: Hwehwɛ nhoma, sini, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, ne intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛka amammerɛ mu adwene ahorow a ɛfa mmabunbere ne nna mu akwahosan ho ho asɛm. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Kɔ amammerɛ mu nhyiamu, adwumayɛbea, anaa nhyiamu a wɔde adwene ahodoɔ ka saa nsɛmti yi ho. Atipɛnfo Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne atipɛnfo a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu mmɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na woasua wɔn suahu ne wɔn adwene. Nhomasua Nhyehyɛe: Fa wo ho hyɛ sukuu anaa mpɔtam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ ahorow ne ntease ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahotoso a mewɔ wɔ me ho, obu a mewɔ ma me ho, ne sɛnea meyɛ me ho yiye no nya nsusuansoɔ wɔ sɛ nea a metumi asusuw asane ahorow ho pɛpɛɛpɛ, asi m’ahye so dua, na masi gyinae ahorow a ɛde me yiyedi ne me gyinapɛn ahorow di kan no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ wo ho, obu a wowɔ wɔ wo ho, ne wo ho a wotumi yɛ no betumi anya tumi a wubetumi asusuw asane ahorow ho pɛpɛɛpɛ, asi ahye so dua, na woasisi gyinae ahorow a ɛde wo yiyedi ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow di kan denam: Ahotoso a ɛkɔ soro a wubenya wɔ wo ho ne obu a wowɔ wɔ wo ho no betumi aboa ma woatumi agyina ano kɛse wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso anim, na ama woatumi asi anohyeto ahorow so dua na asi gyinae ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow hyia. Gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma akɔ anim: Wo ho a wobɛma ayɛ yiye kɛse no betumi ama woanya ahotoso kɛse wɔ tumi a wubetumi apaw nneɛma a wunim na woafa tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu yiye no mu. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na woama saa su ahorow yi anya nkɔso no, fa wo ho hwɛ, nya wo ho asɛm pa, de botae ahorow a wubetumi adu ho sisi w’ani so, na hwehwɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma w’ankasa wo nyin na woanya nkɔso. Fa ankorankoro a wɔboa wo a wɔhyɛ w’ahoɔden ho nkuran na wodi wo nkɔso ho afahyɛ, na wɔhyɛ wo ho a wobɛte nka sɛ wosom bo na woama wo tumi no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi de adi dwuma de akɔ so agyina pintinn na mewɔ ahotoso "confident" wɔ me gyinaesi ahorow mu, bere mpo a ebia ɛbɛyɛ soronko wɔ m’atipɛnfo de ho esiane m’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow nti?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛkɔ so agyina wo gyinaesi ahorow ano na woanya ahotoso, bere mpo a ɛsono w’atipɛnfo de no, hwehwɛ sɛ wunya ahotoso na wunya wo gyinapɛn "values" ne wo gyidi ahorow mu ahotoso. Fa nnamfo a wɔboa wo a wobu nea wopaw na wɔhyɛ wo nkuran no twa wo ho hyia. Fa w’adwene ne w’ahye a wode ahotoso bɛda no adi no di dwuma, wɔ ɔsɔretia mpo mu. Fa w’adwene si w’ankasa wo nkɔso ne wo yiyedi so, na kae wo ho sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wode wo gyinapɛn ne w’ahiade ahorow bedi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ minnya nnim me nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa me bɔbeasu ho nimdeɛ? (kora, ɛyɛ akwantu a ɛma wohu wɔn ho yie)
answer_twi_source: wo ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho ɔyarehwɛfo kasa na ɔmmoa wo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmeae a ahobammɔ  wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan  so anaa sɛ mmoa kuo ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde boa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a ebia wontumi nnya nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ankasa?
answer_twi_source: Bere a ebia nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ankorankoro mu no sua wɔ Ghana de, nanso nneɛma bi a wobetumi ahwehwɛ mu ni (fa ahwɛyiye ne adwempa di dwuma): Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Hokwan Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Ebia ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow anaa sohyial media akuw a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm. Amanaman Ntam Mmoa Akuo: Hwehwɛ intanɛt so mmoa akuo a wɔde ma nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+  mmabun a wɔadi dɛm titire (ma w’adwene nkɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ahobanbɔ so). Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Nneɛma: Ebia adwenemyare ho akuw a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so nyinaa de mmoa bɛma, ɛwom sɛ ebia ɛnyɛ dɛmdi pɔtee bi de.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ ho kwan wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu bere, na bere tenten sɛn na mɛ hwen ansana manya mbuayɛ ɛfii mu baeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu bere: W’apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ bɛhwehwɛ wo nna ho abakɔsɛm, eyikyereɛ, ne dadwen mu. Ebia wɔbɛyɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu, a ebetumi ayɛ wo bɔbe, ano, anaa wo to mu nsuo a wɔbɛfa, dwensɔ a wɔbɛgye, anaa mogya a wɔbɛtwe. W’apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ betumi ama wo afotu wɔ nna a asiane nni mu, STI banbɔ, ne ayaresa akwan ho. Bere a ɛgye na woanya nea ɛfii mu baeɛ no gu ahorow a egyina nhwehwɛmu ko a wɔyɛɛ ne laboratori bere so. Nneɛma bi betumi aba wɔ nna kakra mu, bere a ebi betumi agye bere tenten. W’apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ bɛbɔ wo amanneɛ wɔ bere a wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ wobɛnya wo nsunsuansoɔ no ho na wɔasusu anammɔn a edi hɔ ho, a ayaresa ka ho sɛ ehia a. Agye laboratori nhwehwɛmu no, w’apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ betumi afa sɛnkyerɛnne a woda no adi no so de ahunu sɛnea wɔbɛsa wo yareɛ anaa wɔbɛhwɛ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne me mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ a ɛfa awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a menya ho, na sɛ ɛho hia a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi so dua?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so Hokwan ahorow: Ahintasɛm: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmofra nkumaa wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam. Mpene: Mmara betumi ama mmofra nkumaa kwan ma wɔapene so akɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi mu a wonnyaa awofo kwan. Akwan a wobɛfa so: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wunya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu, ne nna mu yare (STI) ho nhyehyɛe. Wo Hokwan Ahorow a Wobɛka: Hu Mmara no: Hwehwɛ mmara a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a mmofra nkumaa wɔ wɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho no mu. Di Nkitahodi pefee: Kyerɛ hokwan ahorow a wowɔ no pefee kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wɔpow wo hokwan ahorow a, kɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ mmara kwan so akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔka nsɛmti a ɛyɛ sensitive na ɛde akyinnyegye, te sɛ nyinsɛn yi guo, adwaman ho mfoni 'pornography', anaa nna mu anigye ho dwuma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho adesua nhyehyɛe mu, na so hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ pefee na wɔasusu nneɛma ho yie?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ na wommu atɛn a asuafoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛsusu saa nsɛmti yi ho pefee na wɔabisa nsɛm. Adesua nhyehyeɛ no betumi de nsɛm a ɛfa adwene ahodoɔ, abrabɔ pa ho nsusuiɛ, ne mmara nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa saa nsɛm yi ho bɛma. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ, asusuw nneɛma ho, ne akyinnyegye a obuo wom ma asuafo tumi hwehwɛ nsɛm a emu yɛ den mu, nya wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow, na wɔpaw nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ paw wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako atia adwene mu yareɛ nyiyimu wɔ me mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ! .Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni:Nkitahodi a Wɔabue Mu: wo ne wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafo di nkitaho pefee wɔ adwenemyare ho. Ankorankoro Nsɛm (Wɔma ho kwan na wɔmmɔ wo din!) Ka wo suahu ahorow (a worenda nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛkyerɛ) adi na akanyan afoforo na woakyerɛ sɛ adwenemyare ho nsɛnnennen abu so. Afoforo a Wobɛboa: Yɛ nnamfo anaa mfɛfo sukuufo a wɔrepere wɔn ho no yɔnko. Ma wonhu sɛ wudwen wo ho na fa mmoa ma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun de digital nneɛma a wɔyɛ di dwuma de kasa tia nsusui hunu, hyɛ ahorow ahorow ho nkuran, na wɔkamfo asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho kyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun de digital nsɛm a wɔyɛ no di dwuma de kasa tia nsusui hunu, hyɛ ahorow ahorow ho nkuran, na wɔkamfo asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne awo hokwan ahorow ho kyerɛ. Ɛnam blogs, videos, social media ɔsatuo, ne podcasts so ma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ, wɔhyɛ nkɔmmɔdie ase, na wɔboaboa mpɔtamfoɔ ano ma wɔde nsakraeɛ pa ba na wɔdi nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsɛm a ɛka mmabun akwahosan ne hokwan ahodoɔ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bi wɔ hɔ ma CSE wɔ sukuu? Bra pa bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmara wɔ hɔ (Ghana deɛ nni hɔ yie). Bra pa: Nokware nimdeɛ, Obu ma ahofadi (tumi yi wo ho), Bammɔ, Mmoa ma wɔn a wɔahunu amane.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa boa ma wosiw nna mu nyarewa "STI' ne 'HIV" a ɛtrɛw ano?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa boa ma wosiw nna mu nyarewa "STI" ne "HIV" a ɛtrɛw no ano denam asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya bi bere a wɔreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa no so. Kɔndɔm yɛ akwanside a ɛmma nipadua mu nsuo a ɛsesa, a mmadwoa, awotwaa mu nsuo, ne mogya a ɛtumi de nneɛma a ɛde ɔyareɛ ba te sɛ mmoawa, mmoawa, ne mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbaeɛ ka ho no ntumi nkɔ. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ma ankorankoro hu wɔn nna mu nyarewa "STI" ne "HIV" tebea na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔhwehwɛ ayaresa wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔde nyarewa bɛkɔ wɔn a wɔne wɔn da mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn adwenkyerɛ aba de aboa mantɔw mu outreach programs a agyina wɔn hia so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn adwenpɔw ama mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow atu mpɔn na wɔadi wɔn ahiade ho dwuma yie denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe no mu nhwehwɛmu anaa focus groups so mu de akyɛ wɔn suahun ahorow mu. Dwumadi ne adwumayɛfo anaa ntamgyinafo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho tẽẽ de asusu mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso anaa nsusuwii foforo ho. Afotufoɔ bagua anaa mmabun agyinatukuo a nhyehyɛeɛ no de asi hɔ sɛ wɔmfa mmabun bɛhyɛ gyinaesie mu a wɔbɛka ho. Social media platforms anaa intanɛt so feedback forms a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyerɛ wɔn adwene ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din sɛ wɔpɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ahorow bɛn na wɔde ka mmea ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa ma wɔahu awo akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔasiw ano?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne sɔhwɛ ahorow a wɔde ka mmea ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ho no betumi ayɛ: Pap smears a wɔde hwehwɛ awotwaa mu kokoram mu. STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu te sɛ chlamydia, akisikuru, ne HIV. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ akyi berɛmo mu de hwɛ awo akwahosan na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ ebia nneɛma bi a ɛnteɛ anaa. Nufu mu nhwehwɛmu de hwɛ sɛ nufu no mu nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaasɛ nufu mu kokoram ho sɛnkyerɛnne bi wɔ hɔ anaa. Saa nhwehwɛmu ne sɔhwɛ ahorow yi boa ma wohu awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ntɛm, na ɛma wotumi sa yare ntɛm na wosiw nsɛnnennen ano nso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nnipa a ɛsono wɔn nna ho bɔbea a broni ka no 'orientation' ne wɔn bɔbeasu aka ho kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛka obiara ahyɛm ho kɛse ni: Fa kasa a ɛka obiara ho di dwuma: Kwati sɛ wubesusuw sɛ obi wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ anaasɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea. Fa nsɛmfua te sɛ "wɔn" di dwuma ma edinnsiananmu biako ne "ɔhokafo" sen sɛ wobɛfa no sɛ obi wɔ abarimaa/adamfo. . Da obu adi: Fa nidi ne obu di obiara nni, ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Twa adwene a ɛnteɛ so: Nnyina wɔn bɔbeasu ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu so nsusuw nnipa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneyɛ pa ho nsusuii bɛn na ɛwɔ media gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no mu, na kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ media nnwuma mu wɔ kwanpa so?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛ pa ho nsusuii a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho media nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden ho no bi ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, hia tema,  ɛka obiara ho, ne kwati a wɔbɛkwati atenkasɛm anaa animtiaabu so ka ho. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ media a wɔde di dwuma wɔ kwan pa mu mu denam nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yie ahwɛ sɛ ebia ɛyɛ animhwehwɛ, ahwehwɛ adwene ahorow, na wɔahwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a wotumi gye di no yɛ nokware anaa. Wɔ nneɛma a wɔyɛ ho no, mmabun betumi akamfo media nneyɛe a ɛfata akyerɛ denam nsɛm a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma ankorankoro hokwan ahorow, ɛhyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran, na ɛkasa tia nsusuii hunu anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a epira.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awo akwa apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ di wɔ tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi paw nea ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo ne abusua kyekye ho akwan ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun tumi a wɔde ma mu denam awo, abusua nhyehyɛe, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛmu dɔ a wɔde ma so. Sɛ mmabun nya saa nimdeɛ yi a, wobetumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho, a abusua nhyehyɛe ne awo a wɔbɛkora so ka ho. Nhomasua nso boa mmabun ma wɔte wɔn nipadua ase, wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di nkitaho yiye, na wɔkamfo wɔn ankasa akwahosan ahiade ahorow kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya no mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ayaresabea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde kokoam nnwuma ne mmoa ma. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma, a mfaso wɔ so ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa nya so. "Hotlines" anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛde nsɛm, mmoa, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ma. Akwahosan asoɛeɛ anaa afotufoɔ a ɛwɔ sukuu mu a wɔde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma asuafoɔ wɔ nnwuma a wɔbɛnya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛyɛdeɛ bɛn na mmabun betumi adi de agye atene ama abasɛm ntentan so nsɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ (regulation), na ama yaahu sɛ ɛdi abrabɔ pa ne nokwaredie ho mmara so, ɛhyɛ nnipa ahorow ne wɔn gyinabea nkuran, na ɛmfa amanneɛmmoɔ a ɛpira nkurɔfoɔ anaa atorɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan (ASRH) ho mma?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho Mmara a Wɔkamfo: Mmabun betumi adi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ho mmara a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ edi abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow so, ɛhyɛ ahorow ne ananmusifo ho nkuran, na ɛremma nsusuwii hunu a epira anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho nkɔ so. Wobetumi de adesrɛ akɔma wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe, de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔmanfo nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nnwuma a ɛwɔ fam mu de ahyɛ mmara a emu yɛ den ne akwan a wɔfa so di so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi atumi agyina sikasɛm mu haw a ebetumi aka wɔn aduan ne adan a wobenya no ano?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi akyekye ahoɔden a wɔde gyina sikasɛm mu haw ano denam: Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ so: Sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma te sɛ aduankorabea, dabere, anaa asetra mu nnwuma adwumayɛbea ahorow bɛbɔ a, ebetumi ama bere tiaa mu mmoa ne nneɛma a ɛho hia a wobenya wɔ mmere a wohia mmoa mu. Ahokokwaw a wobenya: Sika a wɔde bɛto nhomasua, adwuma ntetee, anaa adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no betumi ama adwumayɛ hokwan ne sikasɛm mu ahotɔ ayɛ kɛse, na ama mmabun tumi adi sikasɛm mu nsɛnnennen so bere tenten. Sohyial networks a wɔbɛkyekyere: Sɛ wo ne nnamfo, abusua mufo, afotufo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo nya abusuabɔ a ɛboa a, ebetumi ama wɔanya nkate fam mmoa, mmoa a mfaso wɔ so, ne nkitahodi a ɛsom bo wɔ mmere a emu yɛ den mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wohia mmoa a wɔde bɛfa mmra nhyehyɛe no mu na wɔanya mmra kwan so mmoa ne nnwuma a ɛfata a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan ahorow so anya nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmra kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow ne wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn ho. Mmabun akuw anaa nnwumakuw a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde mmra mu mmoa ne nsɛm ma. Sukuu afotufoɔ, asetena mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne nneɛma a ɛde mmra ho nsɛm ne nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde boa wɔn ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho no ma adi mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow ahiade ne osuahunu ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho no ma ɛne mmabun ahiade ne osuahunu ahorow adi denam: Kasa a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛka obiara ho, mfonini, ne nhwɛso ahorow a ɛda nnipa a wɔyɛ, tebea horow, ne osuahu ahorow adi a wɔde bɛka ho no so. Akwan ahodoɔ pii a wɔfa so de ma, te sɛ nneɛma a wɔatwerɛ, video, nkitahodiɛ nhyiamu, ne intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔde bɛma, de agye adesua akwan ahodoɔ ne nea wɔpɛ. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii pɔtee bi a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho, te sɛ gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, brayɛ, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho a wobedi ho dwuma. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma ma nkɔmmɔbɔ ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ ankasa nsusuwii, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom a ɛfa adwene ne osuahu ahorow ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, amammerɛ akuo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ nwomasua nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛtumi anya, ɛfata, na ɛdi nnipa ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na awofo ne ahwɛfo betumi ne mmusua afoforo a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ adi nkitaho de akyɛ osuahu ahorow na wɔaboa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ Akuo: Kɔka awofoɔ akuo anaa adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ a ɛtwe adwene si mmabun nkɔsoɔ so no ho. Mpɔtam Nhyiamu: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu te sɛ guasodeɛ, piknik, anaa adwumayɛbea a mmusua hyiam na wɔtumi di nkitaho. Intanɛt so Nhyiamu: Fa wo ho hyɛ intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa sohyial media akuo mu ma awofoɔ a wɔbɛtumi akyɛ suahunu ne afotuo. Sukuu mu kyɛfa: Wo ne sukuu no awofoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ fekuo (PTA) nni nkitaho anaa tu wo ho kɔhyia awofoɔ foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow, ne mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow nya SRH nsɛm a wɔhwɛ so wɔ sohyial media so nsunsuanso, na nsunsuanso bɛn na eyi nya wɔ mmabun a wobenya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ (CSE) ne mmoa nnwuma so?
answer_twi_source: Censorship: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn, ɔmanfoɔ gyinapɛn, ne mmara nhyehyɛeɛ gu ahodoɔ wɔ wiase nyinaa na ɛbɛtumi anya SRH nsɛm a wɔhwɛ so wɔ social media platforms so nsunsuansoɔ, na ɛde censorship anaa ahyeɛ nhyehyeɛ aba wɔ nsɛmti anaa nkɔmmɔdie bi so. Nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ CSE so: Ahyeɛ nhyehyeɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ SRH mu nneɛma so no betumi asiw mmabun kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ (CSE) ne mmoa nnwuma ano, na asiw wɔn kwan sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛsiesie akasakasa wɔ abusuabɔ mu a ɛrenha wɔn adwene na ɛde nteaseɛ bɛba?
answer_twi_source: Brɛ wo ho ase: Nya aboterɛ wɔ akasakasa mmerɛ mu na ɛmmoa kasa mmapa. Tie asɛm yie: Tie nea ɔreka no na nntwa n'ano anaasɛ mmu na tɛn. Ka wakoma so asɛm: Ka sɛ "Me" wɔ berɛ worekyerɛ wadwene anaa deɛ ɛhia wo . Hwehwɛ nteaseɛ: te aforɔforɔ ase wɔ berɛ ɔrekyrerɛ wɔn adwene na ɔreka deɛ aha wɔn. Hwehwɛ nkabom: Hwehwɛ baabi a mo yɛ adwene na monso ɔhao no ano. Gye tum: nya ɔpɛpɛ no sɛ mobɛkɔ adwene korɔ na mo mmienu nyinaa nnyɛ adwene korɔ mfa nso ɔhao no ano. Gye wahome wɔ berɛ a ɛsɛ mu : Sɛ bo fuo ba a, gyae nkɔmɔ no kakra nanso mma wo werɛ mfi sɛ mobɛ sɔ ɔhoa no ano. Hwehwɛ mmoa: To wonsa ferɛ obi a wogye no di ma wɔnbra mu berɛ wonkoaa ntumi nso ɔhoa no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wohu wɔ abɛɛfo kuro ntetan sohyial media platform ahorow, wɛbsaet ahorow, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no yɛ nokware?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wohu wɔ abɛɛfo ntetan dwumadiebea ahorow, wɛbsaet ahorow, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no yɛ nokware no bi ne nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu wɔ mmeae pii, ahwehwɛ sɛ abenfo adwene hyia, na wɔyɛ ahwɛyiye wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa anaasɛ ɛkanyan nkate ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔasi so dua kyerɛ, titiriw ma LGBTQ + ankorankoro?
answer_twi_source: Apomuden a ɛhyɛ nkuran kyerɛ sɛ apomuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bu, gye tumu, na wɔboa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro wɔ wɔn ho kwan ne wɔn suahunu mu. Ɛfa sɛ wɔbɛma tebea a ɛma akwaaba na ɛka obiara ho a LGBTQ+ ayarefo te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn apomoden ahiade ho asɛm a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nyiyim anaa atemmu. Apomoden ho dwumadie a wɔsi so dua nso ka ho ne sɛ wɔde nnwuma ne ayaresa a wɔayɛ ama LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ahiadeɛ soronko bɛma, te sɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛsi ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa so dua ma nnipa a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ nnipa mmienu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmra bɔ nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow ho kokoamsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Mmara taa bɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow ho kokoamsɛm ho ban de bɔ ankorankoro kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Mpɛn pii no, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow sie, na mpɛn pii no mmara bara sɛ wɔbɛda saa nsɛm yi adi a wɔmmpene so. Saa kokoamsɛm yi boa ma ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm a wonni tumi krataa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de m'ahokafo, m'abusuafo, anaa afoforo aba me nkyerɛkyerɛ a efa nna mu ne awoɔ ahokwasan apɔmmuden?
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ nea aborɔfo fre no 'counselor'. Kyerɛ wɔn mfasoɔ no. Gye wɔn kwan. Hyehyɛ hyeɛ. Ma kwan ma obiara nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ afotu ama afa nna mu yareɛ ano aduru?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wohwehwɛ afotuo wɔ nna mu yareɛ ano aduru ho a, ɛde mfasoɔ pii ba, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhomasua: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wobɛsua afa nna mu yareɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ho. Asiane nhwehwɛmu: Ankorankoro asiane ahorow a wobehu na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ ama obiara de asiw ano. Mmoa: Atinka fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wobenya wɔ nna mu apomoden ho haw ahorow a wɔde di dwuma mu. Ahokokwaw a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso: Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, nkitahodi akwan, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wobesua. Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ wɔama no tumi sɛ obedi ne nna mu apomoden so na wasi gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma manya akwan pa a mɛfa so agyina ano bere a mahyia nna mu basabasayɛ akyi? no
answer_twi_source: Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Nea esii ho asɛm a wobɛka no betumi aboa wo kɛse. Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu: Ayaresa ho animdefo betumi de mmoa ne akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ama. Nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wo ho so: Da sɛnea ɛsɛ, di aduan pa, na teɛteɛ w’apɔw mu na ama woatumi adi adwennwen so. Adebɔ mu nneɛma: Adwinni, nnwom, anaa nkyerɛwee betumi aboa ma wɔadi atinka ho dwuma. Akuw a wɔboa: Sɛ wo ne wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu di nkitaho a, ebetumi aboa kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne amammerɛ a agye din di wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔma ɛkɔ so tena hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne amammerɛ a agye din betumi ama mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ akɔ so denam mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow a ɛyɛ katee a wɔbɛda no adi, ne gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a epira a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den no so. Nanso, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nso betumi akasa atia ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsusuwii hunu denam ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a wɔbɛda no adi so. Mmabun betumi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo adi nkitaho denneennen denam nneɛma ahorow a wobedi, nsusuwii hunu a wobegye ho kyim, na wɔakamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho mfonini ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ka ho na ɛyɛ nokware kɛse wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne amammerɛ a agye din mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɛyɛ den ma me sɛ mɛsɔre anɔpa wɔ mmabunyɛ berɛ mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Pɛ berɛ a wobɛsɔre to hɔ, kwati sɛ wobɛbɔ snooze button no, bue wo ntama mu ma abɔde mu hann ntumi ntɔ wo dan mu hɔ, na tenetene w'apɔw mu ansaana wo apue.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atwe meho efiri atoroasem ne adwene bɔne efa intanɛt nna mu?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mu yie. Nnye nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ kɛkɛ. Hwehwɛ nokware asem kyɛn ano asem. Ma nneɛma a ɛnyɛ nokware ɛnnyɛ wohu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Henanom ne mpanyimfo, adwumayɛfo, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di a mmabun betumi akɔ wɔn nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa sɛ wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ a, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ne saa nneɛma yi adi nkitaho wɔ kokoam a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mpanyimfo a wugye wɔn di, adwumayɛfo, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun betumi akɔ wɔn nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa sɛ wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ no bi ne sukuu afotufo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ayaresa ho animdefo, asetra mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo ne mmoa mu. Mmabun betumi ne saa nneɛma yi adi nkitaho wɔ kokoam a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn denam wɔn nsa a wɔbɛkɔ tẽẽ anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn afi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma ahorow bɛn na wɔde hwɛ mmabun a wɔnyem ansa na wɔawo?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔnyem nya ɔhwɛ ahorow ahorow a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ansa na wɔawo a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛboa wɔn apɔwmuden ne wɔn ba no apɔwmuden. Saa dwumadie yi betumi ayɛ: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa wɔ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ. Ultrasound scans a wɔde hwɛ awotwaa no nkɔsoɔ so. Aduandi ho afotuo. Vitamin ne nnuru a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ nyinsɛn mu asikreyareɛ nyarewa. Mogya a ɛwɔ nipadua mu a wɔhwɛ ne apɔwmuden tebea foforɔ. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awoɔ. Awoɔ akyi hwɛ ne ɔba tete akwan. Awoɔ ho ahosiesie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi ayɛ tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara bom ma mmabun a wɔwɔ adwenemyare?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi ayɛ tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara bom ma mmabun a wɔwɔ adwenemyare denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ adwenemyare ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran ne nneɛma ne mmoa nnwuma a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Ebia eyi bɛka afotu adwuma a wɔde bɛma, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, adwenemyare ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia asisifo, ne mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma wɔabɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔada wɔn adwene adi pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam nhyiam a ɛfa nnipa dodoɔ ne nkɔsoɔ ho nhyehyeɛ a wɔde yɔ adwuma no di mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔmden deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' no ho ahiadeɛ ne akwanya ahodoɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɔgye tum sɛ kwan wo hɔ sɛ ɔyɛ nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ nteaseɛ wom, apɔmden ho bammɔ, pɛyɛ, ne kwan a wɔwɔ sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na me nya erections/wetness (egyina gender) bere a me nnya nna ho akɔnnɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, ɔbarima a ɔsɔre anaasɛ ɔbea awotwaa mu nsu betumi aba bere mpo a wo nnya nna ho akɔnnɔ no. Eyi yɛ ade a ɛfata anaa nnyɛ hwee! Ebia wo nipadua bɛyɛ n’ade wɔ nneɛma te sɛ ntade a ɛyɛ tight(ahokyere wom), nipadua mu nkate, anaa nkate mpo ho. Ɛnkyerɛ ankasa sɛ w’ani gye nna ho, nea ɛkyerɛ ara ne sɛ wo nipadua reyɛ n’ade wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nea ɛfata koraa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anohyeto "limitations" bɛn na ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm a wɔde sie wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu ma mmabun, sɛ ebi wɔ hɔ a?
answer_twi_source: Bere a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm so no, anohyeto ahorow wɔ hɔ: Mmra mu ahwehwɛde ahorow: Aman bi wɔ mmara ahorow a ebia ɛbɛhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu kokoamsɛm so wɔ tebea pɔtee bi mu, te sɛ nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade anaa ɔhaw a obi yɛ anaa afoforo ho. Nsiakyibaa "Insurance" ho ka: Wobetumi de nsɛm a wɔde ma bere a wɔrekɔsra akwahosan ho no aka insurance ho sikatua ho nkrataa ho, na sɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no betumi anya bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmara si gyinae sɛ wobegyae anaa wɔremma mmabun nnya nna mu ne awoɔ mu ayaresa a, dɛn na ebetumi afi mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmara bi si gyinae sɛ wobegyae anaa wɔremma wɔn kwan mma wɔnnya apɔwmuden mu nnwuma a, ebetumi nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ mmabun so. Ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔretwɛn anaa wɔnnhwɛ wɔn yie, nyinsɛn a wɔn ani nna ho anaa nna mu yareɛ (STI) bɛkɔ soro , wɔrenya nyinsɛn a wɔkwati anaa wɔrennya nyinsɛn a wotu gu ho kwan pii, na wɔrennya mmabun honam fam ne adwene mu apɔwmuden. Bio nso, mmara mu nneɛma betumi ama obi abu ne ho fɔ, de nyiyimu aba, ne hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ho yie wɔ ayaresa mu ne nipadua mu ahofadi ho nsɛm so, ebetumi asɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ adwumawuranom de ma adwumayɛfo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin mfe so?
answer_twi_source: Adwumawuranom wɔ mmara kwan so nnwuma ma adwumayɛfo a wonnii mfe aduonu, te sɛ akwahosan ho insurance a wɔde bɛma, akwamma a wotua ho ka, ne sika a wɔde sie bere a wɔakɔ pɛnhyen ho nhyehyɛe, a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne sɛnea wɔfata so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na  tumidi nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya wɔ mmabun akuw ahorow mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo tumidi nhyehyeɛ bɛtumi adi nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie a ɛwɔ mmabun akuo ahodoɔ mu no ho dwuma wɔ : abɛɛfo ntentan ahodeɛ ne mfiridwuma ho kwan a ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nnwuma te sɛ abɛɛfo ntentan akenkan ne akyerɛw nteteeɛ,abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn a wɔboa, ne mobile health apps so. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nsɛm ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de adi mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua ahiade ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne amammerɛ ahorow ho dwuma. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, sukuu, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de akɔ nnipa dodoɔ a wɔnnya mmoa no nkyɛn na wɔahwɛ sɛ ahoɔden nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛka obiara ho na mmabun nyinaa bɛtumi anya bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no nya adwene a mmabun kura wɔ pɛyɛ ne nyiyim ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ (media) kyerɛ bɔbeasu (gender) ho nsɛm no bɛtumi asesa mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adwene. Wei ba denam nneyɛeɛ bi a yɛahyɛ da de ato hɔ ama bɔbeasu biara (stereotypes) a wɔsi so dua, nnipa a wɔbu wɔn sɛ nneɛma kɛkɛ a wonni nteaseɛ, ne ahoɔfɛ anaa abrabɔ ho gyinapɛn bi a ɛnyɛ nokorɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran.Saa nneyɛeɛ yi bɛtumi de pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ ne nyiyim ba, ɛfiri sɛ ɛma gyidie ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ bɔne fa bɔbeasu dwumadie ne nnipa suban ho kɔ so tra hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na awofoɔ bɛtumi afa so abue kwan ama nkitahodeɛ pa ne mmoa a ɛfa mmeranteɛ ne mmabaewa berɛ mu nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wode mmere pɔtee bi si hɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho a, ebetumi ate nehu pii no so. Sɛ mobɛnya kokoam berɛ de abɔ nkɔmmɔ a, ɛbɛma mmabun no koma atɔ wɔn yam paa. Nhoma, wɛbsaet, anaa video ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ a wode bedi dwuma no betumi aboa ma wɔakyerɛkyerɛ nsɛmti a emu yɛ den mu. Sɛ wɔka wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow fi wɔn ankasa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu a, ebetumi ama adeyɛ no ayɛ nea ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nkɔmmɔbɔ si hɔ sɛ ɛma mmabun tumi ma wogyina nokwasɛm ahorow so paw nneɛma a ɛfata, na ɛnyɛ adwene a ɛnteɛ.
answer_twi_source: Fa nsɛm a edi mu a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho ma wo ho tumi na ama woasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mmeae a wobetumi de wo ho ato so, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ din pa hɔ, na woasua akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, sɛnea etu mpɔn, ne sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma yiye ho ade. Fa wo ho to nsɛm a egyina adanse so na fa wo ho to nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so so de kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, sen sɛ wode wo ho bɛto anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwan horow a wɔfa so hu adwenemhaw di wɔ su horow a wɔde to obi a wɔato wɔn mmonnaa no sobo, mmonnaato ho anansesɛm, ne gyidi ahorow a ɛkasa tia nna mu basabasayɛ ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo ayamhyehye ne nea ɛka obiara ho mmuae a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no akyi?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so de adwenemhaw ho nsɛm di dwuma titiriw wɔ su horow a wɔde to obi a wɔato wɔn mmonnaa so, mmonnaato ho anansesɛm, ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho a wɔde bu animtiaa denam wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no osuahu, wɔn adwene, ne wɔn ahiade ahorow a wɔde besi so no mu. Ɛnam nsusuanso a adwenemhaw nya wɔ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no mmuae ne wɔn nneyɛe so a wohu so no, saa akwan yi dan adwene fi wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no mu ahotoso a wogye ho kyim so kɔ wɔn suahu ahorow a wogye tom na wɔde mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde ma so. Mmebun betumi akamfo mmuae a ayamhyehye ne nea ɛka obiara ho kɛse ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam nna mu basabasayɛ a abu so ne nea efi mu ba ho a wɔbɛma wɔahu, nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a epira a wɔbɛkasa atia, tema ne ntease a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛe, ne nnwuma a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dawurubɔ kurro ntentan, nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mfiridwuma nya ɔkwan a mmabun fa so di nkitaho fa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa akwan yi hyehyɛ kasa a wɔde di dwuma ne ntease?
answer_twi_source: Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan nkitahodi akwan, ne mfiridwuma asakra ɔkwan a mmabun fa so di nkitaho fa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho, na ayɛ kasa a wɔde di dwuma ne ntease wɔ akwan horow so: Nsɛm a wobenya: Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan ne intanɛt so akwan ma mmabun nya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ne nneɛma ahorow pii, na ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ nsɛm wɔ wɔn ankasa mu. Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso: Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan nkitahodi ma mmabun tumi kyɛ osuahu ahorow, bisa nsɛm, na wɔhwehwɛ afotu fi atipɛnfo hɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti ho, na ɛka kasa a wɔde di dwuma ne nkitahodi ho gyinapɛn ahorow wɔ atipɛnfo akuo mu. Kokoamu nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene: Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow ma wonya kokoamu nsɛm ne nnipa a wɔmmɔ wɔn din, na ɛma mmabun tumi susuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho pefee na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ: Nanso, Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow nso de asiane ahorow ba wɔ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne nneɛma a epira a wɔbɛda no adi ho, na esi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran na wonya nsɛm fibea ahorow a wotumi gye di so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mpɔtam kuo a  wɔn botae si nna mu yarewa (STI/HIV) ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ so, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me ho ahyɛ mu anaa anya wɔn dwumadie
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ahunu mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛtwe adwene si STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ so denam: Hwehwɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ayaresabea, anaa akwahosan dwumadibea a ɛde STI/HIV ano aduru dwumadie ne mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ ma. Ɔman anaa ɔmantam ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama nna mu akwahosan te sɛ kuo wɔfrɛ wɔn wɔ broɔfa kasa mu sɛ; Planned Parenthood anaa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nsɛm. Bisa w’akwahosan ho dwumayɛni, sukuu ɔfotufoɔ, anaa ɔpanin a wogye no di sɛ ɔmma wo nyansahyɛ a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho. Mpɔtam hɔ amanneɛbɔ kyerɛwpon, social media platforms, ne nhyiamu kalenda a wobɛhwɛ mu ama nsɛm a wɔde bɛto gua ne nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ a ɛfa nhyiamu a ɛreba a ɛfa asɛnka, adwumayɛbea, anaa mmoa akuo ho. Ahyehyɛde anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a w’ani gye ho a wobɛkɔ tẽẽ akɔbisa nsɛm fa kyɛfa a wobenya, hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma wo atuhoama, anaa wɔn nnwuma a wobenya, te sɛ STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu, afotu, anaa nhomasua nneɛma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na obi nna ho akɔnnɔ (sexual orientation) ne ne su a ɔda no adi (gender identity) nya nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ ne nna mu nkɔsoɔ so
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a obi fa so da ne dɔ adi ne sɛnea obi bu ne ho sɛ ɔbaa anaa ɔbarima yɛ nsonsonoeɛ nanso ɛne ne ho wɔ abusuabɔ. Sɛnea wobetumi anya nna mu nkɔso so nkɛntɛnso ni: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ: Eyi nka nipadua mu adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no, nanso ɛkyerɛ onii a w’ani gye ne ho wɔ ɔdɔ anaa nna mu. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ na woahu w’ankasa nea ɛtwetwe wo berɛ kɔ so no. Bɔbeasu: Eyi betumi anya sɛnea wunya wo nipadua ne nna ho osuahu no so nkɛntɛnso. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ebia obi a ɔsakra ne bɔbeasu rennya ahotɔ wɔ nea wɔtaa hwɛ kwan wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde ama no ho wɔ awo mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho nneɛma anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a, mmabun betumi ate wɔn hokwan ne akwan horow a wobetumi apaw wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ase yiye?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, amammerɛ mu ahokokwaw ho nneɛma ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi ate wɔn hokwan ne akwan ahorow a wobetumi apaw ase yiye wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhomasua wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu titiriw. Nkratawa, nhomawa, ne nhomasua nneɛma a akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow de ma a ɛfa amammerɛ mu atinka ne hokwan ahorow a ayarefo wɔ ho. Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde nsɛm a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ne mmoa dwumadie ma mmabun a wɔrefa akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. Akwahosan adwumayɛfo taa de nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun hokwan ne akwan horow a wobetumi apaw ho ma bere a wɔne wɔn redi nkitaho wɔ sukuu -akwahosan ho adesua ho no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
