question_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ hokwan a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ sɛ wɔpene ayaresa, a ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ka ho, a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu no ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi bɔ hokwan a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ sɛ wɔpene ayaresa so, a ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ka ho, a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu no ho ban denam: Wogye tom sɛ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn no wɔ ahofadi ne mmara kwan so tumi a ɔde si akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn nyinsɛn ne awo ho, a wɔn mfe anaa wɔn aware tebea mfa ho. Akwankyerɛ anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besi hɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoam ne nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun a ɛkyerɛ obu ma hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm, ahofadi, ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma mmabun a wɔyem.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi aboa me ma mate dwuma a nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm di ne berɛ a ebia ɛho behia ase?
answer_twi_source: Emergency contraception (EC) yɛ 'backup' a yɛde siw nyinsɛn kwan bere a yɛnni bammɔ wɔ nna mu. Ɛyɛ aduro a yɛnom ntɛm (dɔnhwere 72 mu). Ɛnyɛ aduro a yɛnom daa; ɛyɛ ma asiane (emergencies) nko ara. Kɔhu dɔkota anaa pharmacist ma wɔnkyerɛ wo kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan ahorow bɛn so na metumi ayɛ kasamafoɔ ma wɔn adi dɛm bi ne wɔn a w'ani efira wɔ me mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ahyehyɛ dwumadie de ama ho nkyerɛkyerɛ abɔ ho dawuro. Fa wo ho dɔm kuo a wɔ de saa nsɛm yi yɛ wɔn botaeɛ. Na fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadie ɛɔtete saa so mu. Wobetumi so abɔ dawuro wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, adwumayɛbea, ne social media so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aka sɛnea ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano a wɔapaw no tu mpɔn? (wɔmfa nni dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛmfata so, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛmfata so, ne nea ɛkeka ho).
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a ebetumi aka sɛnea kwan a woapaw no yɛ adwuma yiye nie: Deɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye: Sɛ woanni akwankyerɛ so yiye a, ebetumi atew sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma no so kɛse (e.g., awoɔ nnwura nnuro a wɔammɔ, kondɔm a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye). Nnuro a wɔammɔ: Wɔ awoɔ nnwura a wɔde hormone yɛ adwuma te sɛ awoɔ nnwura nnuro no, sɛ wommɔ nnuro no a ebetumi atew sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma no so. Nnuro nkitahodiɛ: Nnuro bi ne hormone awoɔ nnwura di nkitaho, a ɛtew sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma no so. Ne w’apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nkasa fa nnuro biara a worenom ho. Kwan a wɔmfa nni dwuma bere biara a wɔne obi bɛda: Akwan te sɛ kondɔm yɛ adwuma yiye s ɛ wɔde di dwuma bere biara a. Deɛ wɔde di dwuma daa na ɛteɛ ne ade titiriw!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛ yɛ dɛn atumi atoa me nhomasua so anaasɛ masiesie me ho ama daakye botae ahorow bere a manyinsɛn anaa mereyɛ awofo bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Wo nhomasua a wobɛtoa so no betumi ayɛ yie! Wo ne wo sukuu fotufo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔpɛ mmabun nkasa fa akwan horow a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Wubetumi nso atra sukuu bere a wonyinsɛn efisɛ wɔma ho kwan wɔ Ghana anaasɛ wobɛhwehwɛ adwumayɛ ho ntetee mu anaasɛ wobɛtwentwɛn wo nhomasua ase de w’adwene asi awofoyɛ so, nanso kae sɛ wo daakye botae ahorow da so ara tumi du ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuanso bɛn na ayayade nya wɔ adwenemyare, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne yiyedi nyinaa so?
answer_twi_source: Asisifo betumi anya adwenemyare, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne yiyedi nyinaa so nsunsuanso kɛse. Ebetumi ama wanya ehu, dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne ankonamyɛ. Ebia wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn basabasa no benya obu a ɛba fam wɔ wɔn ho, wɔn ho a wɔbɛtew wɔn ho afi afoforo ho, ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ abusuabɔ a ahotoso wom. Asisifo nso betumi aka adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ na ebetumi ama wɔanya adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛne sɛ obekum ne ho wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ ahorow bɛn na ɛboa mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm wɔ Ghana?
answer_twi_source: Esiane akwansideɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ mmeae pɔtee bi a wobɛkɔ wɔ intanɛt so nti, sɛnea wobɛhwehwɛ nneɛma wɔ Ghana ni: Hwehwɛ wɔ intanɛt so: Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet anaa ntentanfidie a ɛwɔ nnwumakuo ahorow a ɛhwɛ mmubuafo hokwan ahorow so wɔ Ghana. Di Aban Nnwumakuo ho nkɔmmɔ: Ghana Asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ mmaa ne mmarima nsɛm so, Children and Social Protection anaa Department of Social Welfare betumi anya nneɛma anaa mmubuafoɔ hokwan nnwumakuo a wɔbɛtumi ne wo abɔ. Bisa Mpɔtam hɔ NGO ahorow: Ebia nnwumakuo ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ akwahosan anaa asetra mu nsɛm ho no betumi akyerɛ wo kwan akɔ nnwumakuo ahorow a ɛhwɛ mmubuafo hokwan ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo sɛ wobenya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pa akyerɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo denam: Wɔnam nhomasua ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma nkurɔfo so ama nkurɔfo ate hia a nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho hia no so. Atipɛnfoɔ ne mpɔtamfoɔ a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano ma wɔaboa nnwuma a ɛma nnwuma a wɔbɛnya no tu mpɔn, te sɛ sika a wɔde bɛma ayaresabea a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adamfofa anaa nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ anohyetoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Nkitahodi a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bedi nkitaho de akamfo mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nipadua ne nipadua ho nimdeɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Atoro a Ɛtaa Kɔ So: Atoro: "Mmaamma ntumi nyinsɛn bere a edi kan a wɔne obi da." Nteɛsoɔ: Nyinsɛn betumi aba bere biara a wɔne obi bɛda a banbɔ nni mu. Atoro: "Twe a wɔtwe fi mu (withdrawal method) yɛ awoɔ nnwura kwan a wɔbetumi de ho ato so." Nteɛsoɔ: Twe a wɔtwe fi mu no nyɛ deɛ wɔbetumi de ho ato so 100%; asabo betumi awɔ nsuo a edi kan a ɛba no mu. Atoro: "Worentumi nnya STI sɛ wone obi da pɛn koro pɛ a." Nteɛsoɔ: STI betumi afa nna baako pɛ so aba. Atoro: "Wo brayɛ mu mogya 'ye fi' anaa enni mu." Nteɛsoɔ: Wo brayɛ mu mogya yɛ nipadua dwumadie a ɛyɛ, ɛnyɛ fi anaa deɛ enni mu. Nteɛsoɔ Akwan: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a efi mmeae a wogye di ma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran de adi adwene bɔne ho dwuma. Nsɛm ne akontaahyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛma de atu atoro ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi dɛmdi ne nnipa afoforo a wɔato wɔn hintidua te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna, abusuakuw, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ a ɛda ntam no ho dwuma wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi adi dɛmdi ne nnipa afoforɔ a wɔato wɔn sintidua, te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna, abusuakuw, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ntam nkitahodi ho dwuma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ma mmabun mu denam hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde ananmusifo, amammerɛ mu ahoɔden, ne osuahu ahorow, ahiade, ne adwene ahorow a wɔbɛte nka so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na makyerɛkyerɛ m’ankasa me gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo suahu ahorow a wo afamu, ntetee, ne w’ankasa wo gyidi ahorow a wususuw ho no betumi aboa wo ma woahu na woama wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna ho no mu ada hɔ. Susuw nna ho afã horow a ɛho hia wo, ahye a wopɛ sɛ wode si hɔ wɔ abusuabɔ mu, ne nneɛma a ɛboa ma wote nka sɛ wowɔ nna mu yiyedi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia ɔhaw ahorow a ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ mede nnuru a wɔde si nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma bere nyinaa a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, nsunsuanso bɔne betumi ama dwumadie a wɔde di dwuma daa no ayɛ den. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ni: Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa: Wobetumi adi wo haw ahorow ho dwuma na wobetumi ahyɛ nsakrae ahorow te sɛ: Awo ano aduru foforo a wobɛsɔ ahwɛ a nsunsuanso bɔne kakraa bi na ɛbɛsɔ ahwɛ. Nsakrae wɔ dodow a wode fa ɔkwan a wofa so mprempren no mu (sɛ ɛfata a). Nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma obi de di nsunsuanso bɔne pɔtee bi ho dwuma. Kae: Mpɛn pii no, ɔkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɛnyɛ nea ɛde ɔhaw ba kakraa bi na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma wo. Nhu amane wɔ kommyɛ mu – wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa! Esiane sɛnea akwankyerɛ ahorow no yɛ den nti, mintumi mfa akwankyerɛ pɔtee mma wɔ nnuru ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ yi mu ho. Kae sɛ, w’akwahosan ho yaresafo no ne wo ade a eye sen biara a wode bɛma wo akwankyerɛ a ɛfata wɔ sɛnea wode nyinsɛn ano aduru a wode bedi dwuma dwoodwoo na etu mpɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen ne akwanside ahorow bi a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia wɔ ɔmanfo mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a yɛhu (Physical Barriers): Adan, akwantuo nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mmeaeɛ a ɔmanfoɔ hyia bɛtumi ayɛ den sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm bɛtumi afa hɔ.Nkitahodie mu Akwansideɛ (Communication Barriers): Nkyerɛkyerɛmufoɔ a wɔde nsa kyerɛ adeɛ (sign language interpreters), abɛfo nneɛma a ɛboa nkitahodie, anaa nhoma a anyifrafoɔ kura (Braille) a ɛnni hɔ.Nteteeɛ mu Akwansideɛ (Educational Barriers): Sukuu ahorow bɛtumi anya nneɛma anaa mmoa a ɛfata a wɔde bɛboa nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm.Mpɔtam Aniwu ne Nyiyim (Social Stigma and Discrimination): Nsusuieeɛ bɔne ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛmfata fa dɛm a obi wɔ ho bɛtumi ama wɔatwa no asuo anaa wɔayi no afiri nneɛma mu.Apɔwmuden mmoa a ɛyɛ den (Limited Access to Healthcare): Aduyɛbea anaa ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ a wɔntetee wɔn mmaa nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ahiadeɛ pɔtee.Sɛnea Yɛbɛdie Ho Dwuma (Addressing Challenges)Pere ma Nnipa a Wɔwɔ Dɛm Ho Kwan (Advocate for Disability Rights): Boa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, nkabom, ne kwan a obiara bɛfa so anya mpɔntuo.Trɛw Amanneɛbɔ mu (Spread Awareness): Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforɔ fa dɛm a obi wɔ ho na popa nsusuieeɛ bɔne biara a ɛwɔ hɔ.Hwehwɛ Mmoa (Seek Support): Ne akuo a wɔpere ma nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ho kwan anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde kyerɛ kwan bɔ mu yɛ adwuma.Ahoɔdenhyɛ (Empowerment): Sua sɛnea wobɛgyina ama w'ankasa ho kwan na nya nyansa wɔ sɛnea wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ nea ɛhia wo mu yie
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi atu na ama nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ayɛ nea ne bo yɛ den na mmabun betumi anya bi?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ nneɛma pii de ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ayɛ nea ne bo yɛ den na mmabun betumi anya bi: Wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu a wontua hwee anaasɛ ne bo nyɛ den bɛma denam mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Trɛw telehealth dwumadie ne virtual care options mu na ama nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ akɔ soro ama mmabun a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔnyɛ adwuma yie. Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo, akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne aban nnwumakuo nyɛ adwuma bom mfa nhunu na wɔdi akwansideɛ a ɛmma nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ no ho dwuma na wɔmfa nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ani asi so bedi dwuma de ama sika a wɔtumi tɔ ne pɛyɛ atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo ntentan "algorithms" ne ho dawurubɔ nneyɛe boa ma wotumi hu nkɛntɛnsofo  awo ne nna akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm na ɛkɔ hɔ, na nsunsuanso bɛn na mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan "algorithms" ne dawurubɔ nneyɛe boa ma wotumi hu na wotumi du nna ne awo akwahosan nkɛntɛnsofo ho nsɛm (influencers’ ASRH content) denam: Nsɛm a ɛma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu kɛse, na ɛma wotumi hu kɛse na ɛda adi wɔ atiefo pii nkyɛn. Nnipa dodow anaa wɔn anigyede pɔtee bi a wɔde wɔn ani si wɔn so a egyina wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ho nsɛm so, nya nsɛm a mmabun hyia wɔ wɔn feeds so nkɛntɛnso. Eyi wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ho, efisɛ ebia ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobehyia awo ne nna akwahosan (ASRH) mu nsɛm a ɛne wɔn anigyede anaa nnipa dodow ho nsɛm hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan foforo wɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so asesa akwan a wɔ fa lɔre wɔ tete bere mu so, te sɛ ahomatrofo (telephone) so akwahosan anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa ahomatrofo so, a wobetumi anya ama mmabun a wonni lɔre pii?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwan foforo wɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so ayɛ akwan foforo a wɔfa so fa lɔre a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so a mmabun a wonni akwantu ho nhyehyɛe pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: "Telehealth" nnwuma a ɛma mmabun tumi nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ akyirikyiri denam "video" so frɛ, telefon so nkɔmmɔbɔ, anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow so, na ɛtew hia a ehia sɛ wɔde lɔre kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so. Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde akwahosan ho nnwuma ba mpɔtam hɔ tẽẽ, a sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, anaa mmeae afoforo ka ho, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw ma mmabun sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ a ɛbɛn fie. Dwumadie a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn a ɛde akwantuo ho mmoa anaa mmoa dwumadie ma mmabun a ebia wɔbɛhyia akwansideɛ wɔ atetesɛm akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛnya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: me nipadua mu nsakrae bɛsesa berɛ koro mu a me nnamfonom?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ nea ɛho hia ankasa. Ɛsono obiara mmabunbere, enti ebia wo nipadua mu nsakrae bɛba ntɛmntɛm sen wo nnamfo de. Nnipa binom fi ase mmabunbere ntɛm anaa akyiri sen afoforo. Eyi yɛ ade a ɛfata na ɛnyɛ biribiara a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛhaw yɛn ho. Wo nipadua no bɛfa nsakrae yi mu wɔ n’ankasa ahoɔhare so, na ɛho hia sɛ wokae sɛ obiara nyin wɔ n’ankasa ahoɔhare so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ awoɔ apɔmden mu haw a yɛnsaa yɛ ne mmabun nipdua nkaeɛ no nyinaa so?
answer_twi_source: Wontumi nwo, yaw, honam akwaa sɛeɛ. nna mu nyarewa betumi akɔ soro. Animtiabuo, adwene mu haw ne apɔwmuden haw kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔadi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ ASRH nnwuma mu, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wobenya, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, anaa awoɔ apomode]n ho nhyehyɛe ho dwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛfa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔadi nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ ASRH dwumadie mu ho dwuma yie ne: atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a mmabun di anim a ɛma nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛhyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ atipɛnfoɔ mu. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kasa ama nkurɔfo a mmerante ne mmabaa di anim ma wɔma nyinsɛn ano aduru, awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne nna mu yareɛ ano aduru ho nnwuma a wobenya no akɔ soro. Nhwehwɛmu adwuma a mmabun di anim a ɛkyerɛ akwansideɛ a ɛwɔ ASRH dwumadie mu na ɛkasa ama nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu de adi nhyehyɛeɛ mu pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ ho dwuma. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne abɛɛfo ntetan nhyehyeɛ a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ayɛ de ama nsɛm, mmoa, ne nneɛma a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi agyina m'atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ (peer pressure) ne nneɛma a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ hwɛ kwan firi me hɔ wɔ me nnyin mmere mu?
answer_twi_source: ɛbetumi ayɛ den, nanso akwan wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so adi so nkunim: Di Wo Ho Nokorɛ: Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛyɛ soronko na woanya w’ankasa w’anigyede, gyidi ahorow, ne gyinapɛn ahorow. Fa Ahye Si Hɔ: Mma obiara nnhyɛ wo sɛ kɔyɛ adeɛ a ɛmma wo ho nntɔ wo anaa ɛtia wo suban pa. Fa Nnamfoɔ Pa: Fa nnamfo a wogye wo tom sɛnea woteɛ. Nkitahodi: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo anaasɛ wo ho akyere wo a, wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa. Wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama. Fa W’adwene Si Wo Botae So: ne nneɛma a w’ani gye ho so, sɛ́ ɛyɛ adesua, anaa w’asetena. Sɛ wunya ahotoso wɔ wo ho na wubu wo ho a, etumi aboa wo ma woko tia nkɛntɛnso bɔne na woapaw nneɛma pa. Kae sɛ woyɛ soronko, na w’ankorankoro su yɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ wogye tom. Sɛ wote nka sɛ nsɛm anaa ɔhaw bi abu wo so wɔ nnyinuo (puberty) mmere yi mu a, mma w’adwene nnyɛ wo na sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri mpanyimfoɔ anaa ayaresafoɔ hɔ. Wɔwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛboa wo na woatumi afa saa asetena mu mmere titiriw yi mu yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea bi a ɛwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no yɛ nea ɛfata mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ wɔ intanɛt so nhwehwɛmu ne dodow a wɔde ma mu de ahwɛ sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo anya osuahu pa anaa. Nkamfo a wobebisa afi mpaninfo a wogye wɔn di, atipɛnfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmabun kuo ahorow hɔ. Adwumayɛbea no a wɔbɛkɔ tẽẽ abisa wɔn kwan a wɔfa so hwɛ mmabun akwahosan ne sɛ ebia wɔde nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ma anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi adi kan atu de wim tebea a wɔde gyina ano no wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ma wɔadi wim nsakraeɛ ne SRH ntam nkitahodiɛ ho dwuma no bi ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfiri amanaman ntam nnwumakuo (WHO, UNICEF, ne nea ɛkeka ho), wɔretete module ahodoɔ a ɛfa akwahosan a ɛtumi gyina wimu tebea ano, akadeɛ a wɔde siesie wɔn ho wɔ atoyerɛnkyɛm ho, nhwehwɛmu amanneɛbɔ, ne sika a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma a wɔde bɛyɛ wim tebea mu nsakraeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma matoa me nhomasua so, bere a manyinsɛn anaasɛ mereyɛ awofo no? (sukuu a wobetumi apaw a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, nkyerɛkyerɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wode bɛtoa wo nwomasua so nie: di wo Sukuu Fotufoɔ/ɔyarehwɛfoɔ ho nkɔmmɔ na wɔbɛtumi aboa ama wɔahwehwɛ akwan te sɛ; nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ama mmabun a wɔyem. ahyehyɛde ahorow bi a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ nso betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔanyinsɛn mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na apɔwmuden nhyehyɛeɛ (health systems) siesie 'stigma' ne kokoam-yɛ haw?
answer_twi_source: Dɔkotafoɔ nteteɛ. Kokoam mmara nhyehyɛ. Mpɔtam nkabom. Nimdeɛ ma. Yɛɛma obiara kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi bɛnya mmoa wɔ wɔn amammerɛ anaa wɔn som mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi anya: Mpanyimfoɔ ne kuo a wɔwɔ ayamye a wɔbɛbɛn wɔn. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadie a ɛgye obiara tom (inclusive activities) mu. Abusua mmoa ne nkɔmmɔbɔ pa nso boa ma wɔte nka sɛ yɛpɛ wɔn asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛboa mmabun ma wɔabu wɔn nipadua ne tumi a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔsi wɔn ankasa gyinaeɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu mu no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate aseɛ na wɔabu tumi a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔsi wɔn ankasa nipadua ho gyinaeɛ no. Nhyehyɛeɛ pa kyerɛkyerɛ pene a wɔpene so, obu, ne gyinaeɛ pa sisuo. Wɔde nneɛma a ɛfata mfeɛ, deɛ enni atemmuo, ne deɛ ɛfa amammerɛ ho di dwuma, wɔhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ nkuran, wɔbu kɔkoamunsɛm, na wɔboa asukuufoɔ ma wɔbisa nsɛm na wɔsi gyinaeɛ pa wɔ wɔn apɔmuden ho. Nanso, wɔ Ghana no, mprɛmpren mmara mma ho kwan sɛ wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri bɛka sukuu nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo, ahokafoɔ, anaa apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ akasa yiye fa me asiane nteaseɛ, me dadwen ho, pɛ a mɛpene so a yɛbɛsusu ho, ne mmoa anaa akwankyerɛ a mɛhwehwɛ de asi gyinaeɛ pa ka ho?
answer_twi_source: ɛbi ne: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware: Kyerɛ w’adwene, wo nkaeɛ, ne w’ahyeɛ pefee na di nokware, ma ahotosoɔ ne nteaseɛ a mo mmienu nyinaa bɛnya mmra nnamfofa no mu. Asotie pa: Tie afoforo adwene ne wɔn dadwen yiye, da ayamhyehyeɛ ne obu adi ma wɔn adwene. Kasa a ahotosoɔ wom: Kyerɛ w’apɛdeɛ, ne wo dadwen wɔ kwan a ahotosoɔ ne obu wom so, na bu afoforo nso hokwan ne wɔn ahyeɛ. Mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ: Ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri nkurɔfoɔ a wogye wɔn di hɔ, bere a wohyia gyinaesio a emu yɛ den anaa dadwen wɔ nna mu apɔmuden asiane ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asiane anaa nsunsuanso bɔne bi wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma wɔ "PMTCT" mu no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wodi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Bere a nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ "PMTCT" mu no taa yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom na wotumi gyina ano yiye no, ebia ɛne asiane ne nsunsuanso bɔne bi wɔ abusuabɔ. Nneɛma bɔne a ɛtaa ba no bi ne akisikuru, ɔfe, akisikuru, ɔbrɛ, ne tiyɛ. Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, nsunsuanso bɔne anaa nneyɛe bɔne a emu yɛ den kɛse betumi aba, ɛwom sɛ eyinom ntaa mma de. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ mmea a wɔyem ne nkokoaa a wɔregye PMTCT nnuru no yiye de ahu na wɔadi nsunsuanso bɔne anaa nsɛnnennen biara a ebetumi aba ho dwuma. Mpɛn pii no, mfaso a ɛwɔ "PMTCT" so wɔ HIV a wɔde siw ano mu no boro asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu mmara kwan so anohyeto ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nsɛm ho wɔ mmeae bi (hwɛ hu sɛ wode bɛkɔ mmeae a agye din).
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so anohyeto biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔanya nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ Ghana. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ wunya nsɛm fi mmeae a agye din.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɛka a ɛbata apɔwmuden ho insurance a mmabun tua ho, a premiums, deductibles, ne co-payments ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka a ɛbata apɔwmuden ho insurance a mmabun tua no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nhyehyɛe ko ne akwan horow a wɔfa so tua ho ka so. Ka a wɔtaa bɔ no bi ne: Premiums: Sika a wotua bosome biara wɔ apɔwmuden ho insurance ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so tibɔnkoro, ayamhyehye, ne obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nnipa ntam abusuabɔ mu wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so tibɔnkoro, ayamhyehye, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ho nkuran wɔ nnipa ntam abusuabɔ mu wɔ mmabun mu no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛma tema anya nkɔso denam apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde fa adwene so, atie a wɔde yɛ nnam ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, nkitahodi pa ne ntawntawdi ano aduru akwan a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, na wɔama hokwan ahorow ama dwumadi ahorow a wɔbom yɛ ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde kyekye kuw. Dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di agoru, kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho nso betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔate adwene ahorow ase na wɔanya tema ama afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwahosan ho tebea anaa nsɛm a ɛtaa ba a ɛfa awo ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ mu ahoɔden ho ɔhaw ahorow a ɛsɛ sɛ mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) hu ne:Ɔkyere a ɛmma pɛpɛɛpɛ (Irregular menstrual cycles): Nsakyeraeɛ a ɛba wo bosome mu nsa kɔ mu (menstrual cycle) bɛtumi akyerɛ sɛ apɔwmuden mu ɔhaw bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛtumi aka wo daakye awoɔ.PCOS (Polycystic ovary syndrome): PCOS yɛ nipadua mu nkwaadɔm (hormonal) mu ɔhaw bi a ɛbɛtumi aka sɛnea mmaa fofona (eggs) fifi ne awoɔ mu ahoɔden.Nna mu nyarewa (STIs): Nna mu nyarewa a wɔannsa no bɛtumi de yareɛ a ɛma mmaa awoɔ dan mu hye (PID) aba, na yei bɛtumi ama awoɔ ayɛ den (infertility).Endometriosis: Yei yɛ tebea bi a nipadua mu ntini a ɛte sɛ deɛ ɛwɔ awoɔ dan mu no fifi wɔ awoɔ dan no akyi, na ɛbɛtumi aka awoɔ mu ahoɔden.Mmarima awoɔ mu ɔhaw (Male factor infertility): Ɔhaw biara a ɛfa awaba (sperm) yɛ anaa ne dwumayɛ ho bɛtumi aka mmarima awoɔ mu ahoɔden
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nea wɔda no adi ma mmabun ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu nsɛm a ɛfa bɔberɛ mu nteaseɛ (gender identity) ne ne ndaadi ho ma mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ gu ahorow gyina baabi a mmara yɛ adwuma, na ɛbi ne:Mmara mu nnyigyeiɛ ma bɔberɛ mu nteaseɛ: Mmeaeɛ bi ma kwan ma nnipa sesa wɔn din ne bɔberɛ nkyerɛwee wɔ nkrataa a mmara gye tom so, te sɛ awoda krataa (birth certificate) ne "ID cards," na ama ɛne bɔberɛ a wɔde te nka no ahyia.Nyiyim ne ntɛnyɛ (Discrimination and harassment): Mmeaeɛ pii wɔ mmara a ɛbɔ nnipa ho ban firi nyiyim ne ntɛnyɛ ho gyina wɔn bɔberɛ mu nteaseɛ ne ne ndaadi so wɔ nnwuma, nteteeɛ (education), afie, ne apɔwmuden mu.Apɔwmuden mmoa nsa aka: Mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ bɛtumi ahyia mmara mu akwansideɛ mmerɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ apɔwmuden mmoa a ɛhyɛ wɔn bɔberɛ mu nteaseɛ den (gender-affirming healthcare), te sɛ "hormone therapy" anaa oprehyɛn, a ɛgyina wɔn mfeɛ ne wɔn awofoɔ tumidie so.Ghana Apɔwmuden Dwumadibea (Ghana Health Service) ma nnipa nyinaa apɔwmuden mmoa, a ɛmfa ho obi kɔla, ne gyidie, ne gyinabea wɔ asetena mu, anaa ne bɔberɛ (gender).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne ahwɛfo betumi ahyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nkate ho nkuran wɔ wɔne mmabun nkitahodi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nneyɛe a obu wom ho nhwɛso, mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma wɔanya wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne ahwɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam atenka ho nkuran wɔ wɔne mmabun nkitahodiɛ mu denam: - Suban a wɔde obuo ma ho nhwɛsoɔ: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa obuo suban ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛkasa tia atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ne adwene a ɛnteɛ. -Woreko atia bosu Bias: Twa mmarima ne mmaa animhwɛ ne nyiyim wɔ wɔn ankasa suban ne wɔn kasa mu, na wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ saa ara. - Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Wɔbɛma nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho nsɛm, nna mu basabasayɛ, ne nkitahodie a ɛyɛ papa ho, na ama mmabun anya hokwan abisa nsɛm na wɔada wɔn adwene ne wɔn nkateɛ adi wɔ tebea a ɛboa mu. - Nneɛma a Wɔde Ma: Fa nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho, pene, ne nkitahodie pa ho ma mmabun, na hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho ne afoforɔ wɔ saa nsɛm yi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwanside ahorow te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔreyɛ nna mu dwumadie so ti siane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ a wɔde bɛka obi no so tew?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔreyɛ nna mu dwumadi no brɛ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ a wɔde bɛkɔ nnipa mu no ase denam nipadua mu akwanside a ɛba a ɛmma nipadua mu nsu ntumi nsesa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ ahokafo ntam no so. Kɔndɔm yɛ adwuma sɛ akwanside a esiw ɔyare mmoawa a mmoawa, mmoawa, ne mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbae ka ho a ebetumi aba mmadwoa, ɔbea awotwaa mu nsu, ne mogya mu no kwan. Sɛ wɔde kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye na wɔyɛ no daa a, etu mpɔn kɛse wɔ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu atinka ne nna my yareɛ no so. Wɔyɛ nea wobetumi anya ntɛm, ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma, na ɛma ahobammɔ abien fi nna mu yareɛ ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da nyinaa ho, na ɛma ɛyɛ adwinnade a ɛho hia a wɔde yɛ nna a ahobammɔ wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusu sɛnea nsɛm a wɔka wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow, nnwum a wɔdeboa, ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho nneɛma ne nnwuma ho mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛnea nsɛm a wɔka wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow mu, nneɛma a wɔdeboa, ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma ne nnwuma ho no yɛ nokware na wotumi de wɔ ho to so denam adanse a wɔde ama de foa nsɛm no so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yie, ahwɛ sɛ ebia akasakasa anaa sikasɛm mu abusuabɔ biara nni aguade ho dawurubɔfo no ne ade anaa adwuma a wɔrehyɛ ho nkuran no ntam, a wosusuw sɛ ebia nsɛm no ne aduruyɛ ho akwankyerɛ a wɔde asi hɔ ne nyansahu mu adanse a ɛde ne ho hyia anaa nhwehwɛmu anaa animdefo adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmarima ne mmea   bɔbea ho nsusuii a ɛnyɛ  nokware  ne animhwɛ boa ma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nnwuma, ne hokwan ahorow a wobenya mu, na dɛn na wobetumi ayɛ de adi nsonsonoe ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɛde adwene bɔne (te sɛ atɛmmuo) ba. Nyiyimu tia dɛmdifoɔ. Siesie wɔ  : Ko tia nsusuii a ɛnyɛ nokware , ma  nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛdi mu, ma obiara nya ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dodow ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ midi bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, na mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ midi?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono sɛnea obiara hia sradeɛ a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wadi, ɔbarima anaa ɔbea, dwumadi dodow, ne sɛnea onyin so. Wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no, ebia wubehia calories pii sen kan no. Fa yɛ wo botae sɛ wubedi aduan ne nnuan nketenkete daa da mũ no nyinaa na ama woakɔ so anya ahoɔden. Sɛ wodidi nnɔnhwerew mmiɛnsa-nnan biara a, ebetumi aboa ma woasiw ahoɔden a ɛbɛkɔ fam no ano. Tie wo nipadua no ɔkɔm ne nea ɛyɛ ma ho nsɛnkyerɛnne. Didi bere a ɔkɔm de wo na gyae bere a wo ho atɔ wo no. Ɛsɛ sɛ protein, aburow a wɔayam, nnuaba, nhabannuru, ne srade a ahoɔden wom a ɛkari pɛ ka nneɛma a wɔde ma no kɛse ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma anaa mmoa akuo ama  mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa   a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ kasamafo dwumadie  a  wɔ sɔ haw ano  na wɔdi nkonim? (Afotu nhyehyɛe, abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so mpɔtam) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛho nhia sɛ wo nkutoo kɔ hɔ! Nneɛma a wode bɛboa nie: bisa w’akwaahosan ho dwumayɛni anaa sukuu mu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ a wɔhwɛ ayarefoɔ, wɔbɛtumi aboa ama woanya mmoa akuo Afotuo Dwumadie: Hwehwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde mmebun a kasamafoɔ  ne afotufoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa bom ma akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn Mpɔtam: bea te sɛ https://advocatesforyouth.org/ anaa abɛɛfo ntentan akuo a wɔde wɔn botae si mmebun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH )so no bɛtumi de wo ne kasamafo mmebun  faoforɔ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo mfidie bɛtumi aboa ma pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ wɔ mmaa ne mmerima ntam ne kwan a yɛfa so ka bɔbea deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'gender' mu ahuntasɛm fa mmabun nna mu apɔmden dwumadie ho?
answer_twi_source: Ma nimdeɛ pa. Kenya anaa sɛ boa mmaa. Ko tia amammerɛ ne nneyɛɛ bɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma nna mu apomoden ho ahomotrofo a wɔde di dwuma wɔ kokoamu anaa ayaresabea ahorow a mmaabun betumi anya afotu wɔ akwan abien a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban ho.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wubetumi anya kokoamu afotu a ɛfa akwan abien a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban ho ni: akpomoden adwumayɛbea anaa mmeae a mmaabun adamfofa su (ɛtaa de kokoam nnwuma ma mmabun) Saa nneɛma yi betumi ama nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na aboa nna mu osuahu a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Awoɔ akwahosan ne hokwan a ɛho hia a wɔbɛma wɔn atipɛnfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ ate ase. a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatuo a mmabun di anim mu de ahyɛ nhyehyɛɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa ma wɔnya awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ho nkuran, a wobeka won suahunu ne won haw a wobeka akyere nhyehyeee ne akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ de anya gyinaesie ne nneɛma a wɔde kyekyɛ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ. ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nkabomkuo a wɔreyɛ adwuma de ama awoɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ atu mpɔn ama mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho adesua betumi akyerɛ obu ama mpɔtam hɔfo amammerɛ ne gyidi ahorow bere a wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia no?
answer_twi_source: na ho nkyerɛkyerɛ de nsɛmfua ahorow di dwuma wɔ mmeae ahorow. Amammerɛ ahorow bi wɔ n’ankasa nsɛmfua a wɔde frɛ nipadua akwaa, abusuabɔ, anaa nna ho nsɛm, na nyamesom nso betumi anya kasa a wɔde di dwuma no so nkɛntɛnso. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔabu mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ de nsɛmfua a wonim na ɛkyerɛ obu di dwuma, ɛde mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ka ho, na ɛka obiara ho. Eyi boa ma nsɛm no mu da hɔ, ɛfata, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa awofo anaa ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ebia ɛne awoɔ apɔmuden hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ awo mu no bɔ abira no so?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wobɛka Abue Mu: Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wo ne w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo bɛbɔ wo atenka ne wo gyidi ahorow a ɛfa awo akwaahosan ho no ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na wofi nokwaredi mu. Kyerɛkyerɛ: Fa nea enti a nneɛma bi a wobɛpaw ho hia wo ho nsɛm kyerɛ wɔn, a nokwasɛm ahorow ne nneɛma a agye din gyina akyi. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wohyia nsɛnnennen a ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wogye no di a obetumi aboa ma wɔayɛ ntamgyinafo wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow mu anaasɛ wɔde nsɛm ama no hɔ. Hu Hokwan a Wo Ho: Sɛ wote wo hokwan ahorow ase a, ebetumi ama woanya tumi ma wo ne w’awofo abɔ nkɔmmɔ afi nimdeɛ gyinabea bi mu. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa Abɛɛfo ntentan  beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan pa bɛn na yɛbɛtumi afa so ne mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ayɛ adwuma sɛ ayɔnko, na wɔaboa yɛn ma yɛahyɛ aseɛ, yɛadru amansan nkyɛn, na yɛahwɛ sɛ nna ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden nnwuma no rekɔ so yie, na ama yɛahu sɛ saa nnwuma yi kura deɛ wɔhia ne deɛ wɔpɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun mu sɛ ahokafoɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan (SRH) dwumadie ho nhyehyɛɛ, awoɔ, ne nhwehwɛmu mu no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmabun afotuo bagua anaa agyinatukuo a mmabun bɛtumi de wɔn adwene ama wɔ ɔsom nkɔsoɔ ne dwumadie ho. Akwahosan nhyehyeɛ nso tumi yɛ nhwehwɛmu, akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, ne nhyiamu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mmabun de boaboa wɔn adwene ano wɔ wɔn apɛdeɛ, wɔn ahiadeɛ, ne wɔn suahunu wɔ SRH dwumadie ho. Bio nso, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakamfo wɔn ankasa akwahosan ahiade ahorow na wɔayɛ sɛ nkitahodifo wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntam. Ntetee ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ nkitahodi a ɛfata mmabun ne ɔsom adwuma a wɔde ma ho no ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nnwuma no di mmabun ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asetena mu nimdeɛ pɔtee bɛn na wɔtaa ka ho asɛm wɔ asetena mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe taa fa ahokokwaw ahorow a wɔakyekyɛ mu akuw ahorow ho: Ankorankoro nimdeɛ: Ne ho a obehu yie(self-awareness), obu a ɔwɔ ma ne ho, ahoɔden a ɔde gyina ano, atenka horow a wogyina ano. Nnipa ntam nkitahodi: Nkitahodi, tema, atie a wɔyɛ no nnam, nkitahodi, ntawntawdi ano aduru. Gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ: Nneɛma a wobetumi apaw a wobehu, nea ebefi mu aba mu nhwehwɛmu, asiane ahorow a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ, nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ apaw. Nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee: Ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, adebɔ, gyinaesi mu nhwehwɛmu, nsusuii a ntease wom. Asetea mu nimdeɛ: Abusuabɔ a wɔbɛkyekye, kuo adwuma, akannifo, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ. Ahokokwaw a wɔde gyina ano: Adwennwen a wɔde di dwuma, bere a wɔde di dwuma, asɛm a wɔka sie, pow a wɔpow ho nimdeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammerɛ mu anansesɛm, adwene a ɛnteɛ, ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne abusuabɔ ho di wɔ sɛnea wɔhyehyɛ adwene a ɛfa pene, nhyɛso, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akasa atia gyidi ahorow a epira yi na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu anansesɛm, adwene a ɛnteɛ, ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne abusuabɔ ho no boa ma wonya adwene a epira wɔ pene a wɔpene so, nhyɛso, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho: Bɔbeasu mu nsusuwii hunu: Gyidi a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ho no betumi ama adwene a epira a wɔwɔ wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho no akɔ so, na wɔtaa yɛ mmarima ho mfonini sɛ wɔyɛ katee na wodi tumi, na mmea yɛ wɔn a wɔnyɛ hwee ne obi a ɔbrɛ ne ho ase. Wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo: Amammerɛ mu nsɛm a ɛde asodi to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa wɔ nna mu wɔ wɔn suahu ahorow ho no betumi ama gyidi a epira a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne nhyɛso ho no akɔ so ayɛ kɛse, na ama wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu ho abam abu sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaa atɛntrenee. Amammerɛ mu Kommyɛ: Nneɛma a wɔabara wɔ nna ne pene a wɔbɛpene so ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho no betumi asiw ankorankoro kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm anaa mmoa bere a wohyia nsɛm a ɛfa nhyɛso anaa nna mu basabasayɛ ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne daakye nneɛma ne ɔhaw  a ɛbɛba wɔ obi a onim abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn ɔman ba ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛfa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn tebea a ɛrenya nkɔso no mu wɔ asɛyɛde ne abrabɔ pa mu?
answer_twi_source: Ebia nneɛma a ɛbɛba daakye no bi ne mfiridwuma mu nkɔso, nsakrae a ɛbɛba wɔ abɛɛfo akwan horow so, ne nsɛm a ɛreba te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ deepfakes ne algorithmic bias. Haw betumi afi abɛɛfo pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, intanɛt so nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne abrabɔ pa ho haw a ɛrekɔ so wɔ abɛɛfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma mu. Mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho denam nsɛm a wɔbɛkɔ so anya, adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye a wobenya, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ abɛɛfo  akenkan ne akyerɛw ho adesua ne abɛɛfo hokwan ahorow ho nkuran a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔhaw bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ atɛntrenee ne akontaabu a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwannya ahorow a wobu so, a nna mu basabasayɛ, nhyɛso, ne aware a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔware ho nsɛm ka ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hyia haw pii wɔ atɛntrenee a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wobu so no ho, a nea ɛka ho ne suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa na wɔatua wɔn so ka, mmara kwan so mmoa a wonnya, ne amanneɛbɔ akwan a ahobammɔ wom a wonnya. Ebia ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne amammerɛ mu su ahorow bɛma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no ayɛ komm bio na ama wɔn abam abu sɛ wɔrenhwehwɛ nsiesie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na ayaresafoɔ di wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn anya bi?   Helafo a wɔde ayaresa ma no di dwuma bɛn wɔ apam a wɔde ma mmerante ne mmabaa no mu, na ɛyɛɛ dɛn na metumi anya apam a wɔde ma ho afotu ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresafo  di dwuma titiriw wɔ apam a wɔde ma mmerante ne mmabaa no mu denam: Apam a wɔde ma ho afotu a edi mũ, a nsɛm fa apam a wɔde ma ho akwan ahorow, nea mfaso wɔ so, asiane ahorow, ne nea ɛfata ho ka ho. Akwan a wɔfa so de apam a wɔde ma a ɛfata yiye a egyina onipa no ahiade, nea ɔpɛ, ne apɔwmuden ho nsusuwii ahorow so a wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wonya no a wɔde hwɛ apɔwmuden, nhwehwɛmu, ne nsɔhwɛ ahorow yɛe. Apam a wɔde ma, te sɛ awo a wɔde siw ano, nkataso, bɔtini, dua, IUD, anaa condom a wɔde siw ano, a egyina adanse so akwankyerɛ ne nneyɛe pa so na wɔde ma anaa wɔde ma. Nkɔso a edi hɔ, ahotɔ, ne apam a wɔde ma a wɔde siw ano a wɔapaw no ahotɔ ho nhyehyɛe ne nea ɛwɔ so no a wɔde hwɛ so na wɔde hwɛ so bere nyinaa. Wubetumi anya apam a wɔde ma ho afotu ne nnwuma denam bere a wode bɛhyehyɛw helani, te sɛ ayaresafo a ɔhwɛ obiara, ɔbea helani, anaa abusua nhyehyɛe adwumayɛbea, baabi a wubetumi anya ahintasɛm ne mmerante ne mmabaa apɔwmuden nnwuma a wɔayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ ama w'ahiade ne nea wopɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpanyimfo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi adi wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a ebia wɔrepere wɔ adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di Dwuma: Mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awoɔfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a ebia wɔrepere wɔ adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho no mu. Wobetumi ama aso a etie, akwati sɛ wɔbɛbu atɛn, wɔakwati sɛ wobehu no sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de wɔn adwene si so, de akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma bɛma, aboa ma wɔde mmabun abata mmoa adwuma a ɛfata ho, na wɔakasa ama wɔn yiedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe anaa mmoa akuw bi wɔ hɔ a metumi asua nna mu akwahosan ho ade pii afi mmabun afoforo hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Aane, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne mmoa akuw bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi asua nna mu akwahosan ho ade pii afi wɔn atipɛnfo hɔ. Wobetumi de saa nhyehyɛe ne akuw yi ama denam sukuu akwahosan akuw, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so na ama mmabun anya hokwan: Wɔasusuw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom mu. Nya nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ a ɛyɛ nokware fi atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo anaa akwankyerɛfo a wɔatete wɔn hɔ. Kyɛ osuahu ahorow, bisa nsɛm, na nya atipɛnfo mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadi ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STIs, abusuabɔ pa, ne pene a wɔpene so mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurofoɔ akyi mu bɛboa ama wɔde awoɔ   atɛntenenee a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive justice' aka asetena mu atɛntenenee anammɔmtuo ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi ayɛ yie wɔ berɛ a: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛ dɔm mmabun akuo ahodoɔ, nhyiam ahodoɔ ne ɔyɛkyerɛ. Wɔbetumi afrɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahodoɔ ne asetena mu atentenenee akuo afoforɔ bɛyɛ baako na wɔbetumi nso adaadaa mmerahyɛfoɔ na wɔsan so betumi afa abɛɛfo kasafidie nyinaa so abɔ dawuro ama obiaa ahu ɔhaw awo awoɔ atɛntenenee a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive justice' mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ sɛnea wɔma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔne mmabun bedi nkitaho wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam akannifoɔ, ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne asoɛeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ sɛnea ɛbɛma mmabun nkitahodiɛ a nteaseɛ wom wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ho denam: Nneɛma, sika, ne nhyehyɛeɛ mmoa a wɔde bɛma ama ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde mmabun kyɛfa ne tumidi di kan. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma anya nkɔmmɔ, adwumayɛ, ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun ne mpanyimfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ntam denam afotu bagua, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow so. Nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ mmabun hokwan ahorow, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kokoam nsɛm bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu berɛ a wɔrenya wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so na wɔrekyekyɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun renya wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔrekyekyɛ wɔ intanɛt so a, ɛsɛ sɛ wohu kokoam nsɛm a wosusuw te sɛ asiane a ɛwɔ data(Nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ) a wɔabu so mu, tumi a wobetumi de nsɛm akyɛ a wɔmpene so, ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔte kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe ne kwan a wɔde ma wɔ dijitaal akwan so no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo afotufo, nhwɛsofo, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso pa betumi adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw nneyɛe ho nhwɛso ne nsusuwii a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ afotufoɔ, nhwɛsoɔ, ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ pa bɛtumi adi dwuma titire wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ suban a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu denam: Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ adwene a ɛyɛ den ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛdeɛ mu wɔ wɔn ankasa nkitahodiɛ a ɛwɔ intanɛt ne intanɛt so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ atipɛnfo adesua ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso ne dijitaal ɔman bayɛ ho nkuran a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Nneɛma, nyansahyɛ, ne nnwinnade a wɔde bɛkyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu na wɔadi nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne atipɛnfo nkitahodie ho dwuma. Wɔn nhyiam ase ne nkɛntɛnso a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahyɛ nkrasɛm pa a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho no mu den na wɔakamfo intanɛt so mpɔtam a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden na obu wom akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa ntam nkitahodi ahorow bɛn na yebetumi abom anya so sɛ mihia nkate fam mmoa anaa akwankyerɛ foforo a?
answer_twi_source: Yebetumi abom ahwehwɛ nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow mu sɛ wuhia nkate fam mmoa anaa akwankyerɛ foforo a. Ebia eyi bɛka sukuu afotufo, mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, mmoa akuw, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔyɛ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi ho titiriw. Sɛ yɛbom kɔ saa mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow yi so a, yebetumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wowɔ nneɛma ne mmoa a wuhia na wode adi nsunsuanso ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anammɔn a wɔfa so yɛ ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ma tebea horow, te sɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho a wobedi ho dwuma, nkate horow a ɛboro so a wobedi ho dwuma, anaasɛ ntawntawdi anaa ayayade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abusuabɔ mu no?
answer_twi_source: Ahobanbɔ Nhyehyɛe a Wɔbɛyɛ: Ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ no hwehwɛ sɛ wohu nneɛma a ɛkanyan, kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne mmoa ntam nkitahodi ahorow ma tebea horow, te sɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho a wobedi ho dwuma, nkate horow a ɛboro so a wobedi ho dwuma, anaasɛ ntawntawdi anaa ayayade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abusuabɔ mu a wɔbɛfa so. Ɛho hia sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛhyia obiara ahiadeɛ ne ne nsɛm pɔtee a ɔfa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wotu fi wɔn afie mu, atutra, ne asetra mu tebea horow a nnipa ahyɛ mu ma dodo wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ mu no boa ma asiane a ɛkɔ soro wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ, wɔn a wɔde wɔn di dwuma, ne aware a wodi ntɛm wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wotu fi wɔn afie mu, atutra, ne asetra mu tebea horow a nnipa ahyɛ mu ma dodo wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu no boa ma asiane ahorow a ɛkɔ soro a ɛne nna mu basabasayɛ, nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma, aduan pa a wonnya nni, asetra mu ka a ɛkɔ soro, wɔ tebea horow a enye koraa mu no owu, ne aware a ɛba ntɛm wɔ mmabun mu no kɔ soro. Dabere, nhomasua, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wonnya no ma asiane ahorow yi yɛ kɛse bio, na esi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so de abɔ mmabun hokwan ne wɔn yiyedi ho ban no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na enni animhwɛ berɛ a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na enni animhwɛ denam nnwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔagye din hɔ, nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae pii, nsɛm a wobebisa, ne sɛnea wɔbɛsɔ intanɛt so nneɛma a wogye di no ahwɛ yiye. Wobetumi nso anya nhomasua nneɛma a ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di ne aban ahyehyɛde ahorow de ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw bɛn na ɛwɔ sikasɛm nketewa a wɔde ma mmabun mu, te sɛ ɛka a wɔbɔ boro so, bosea a wontua, gua so akansi, nea adetɔfo pɛ a ɛresakra, ne sikasɛm a entumi nnyina?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka a ɛboro so: Bosea a obi bɛbɔ bosea a ɛboro nea obetumi atua, na ɛde sikasɛm mu ahokyere, ɛka afiri, ne boseabɔ a ɛso tew ba. Boa a wɔmfa mma: Sɛ wɔantumi anni asɛde a ɛne sɛ wobetua ho dwuma esiane adwuma a entumi nyɛ yiye, sikasɛm mu ɔhaw, anaa tebea ahorow a wontumi nhu nti, na ɛde asotwe, agyapade a wogye, ne mmra kwan so asɛm ba. Guadi mu akansi: Nsɛnnennen a efi nnwuma a wɔatew so, gua a ɛdɔɔso, nneɛma bo ho akodi, ne nea adetɔfo pɛ a ɛresakra, a ɛka mfaso ne nea ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa no hyia. Sikasɛm mu a entumi nnyina: Nsakrae, nneɛma bo a ɛkɔ soro, sika bo a ɛkɔ fam, amammui mu basabasayɛ, anaa abɔde mu asiane ahorow a ɛka adwumayɛ, nea wɔhwehwɛ, ne sikasɛm mu ahotɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ayaresabea pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ahohiahia (crisis) mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Awoɔ ne nna ho akwahosan ayaresabea (Sexual health clinics), family planning, mmabun akwahosan mmoa ayaresabea (adolescent health centers). Hwehwɛ intanɛt so/bisa mpanyimfoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna mu apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ne awoɔ hokwan koro a obiara so wɔ no bi. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne kwanho a obi wɔ sɛ onya nna mu apomoden, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne abusuabɔ pa ho nsɛm a edi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa nna mu akwahosan, adwenem akwahosan, ne nipasu a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho hyia no so wɔ wɔn asetra mu?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ Ɔhwɛ a Wɔaka abom "Integrated Care": Nya akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde ɔhwɛ a wɔaka abom ma mmabun, a wodi nna mu akwahosan ne adwenemyare nyinaa ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛsi so dua so. Wɔn ho a wobɛhwɛ no nyinaa: Fa wo ho hwɛ ho nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne adwenemyare ho ahiade nyinaa ho, te sɛ adwene a wɔde si biribi so, adwennwen ano aduru, ne mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi nnamfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ no di kan. Mmoa Nkitahodi: Yɛ atipɛnfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa mmoa akuo a wɔte nna mu akwahosan, adwenemyareɛ, ne nipasu ntam nkitahodiɛ ase na wɔgye tom, na wɔde si so dua ne baakoyɛ ma. Adwumayɛfoɔ Mmoa: Hwehwɛ mmoa firi adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm mu na wɔbɛtumi adi nsɛnnennen soronko ne nhyiamu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne adwenemyareɛ, ne nipasuo a ɛwɔ w’abrabɔ mu ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan (ASRH) ho, na wɔako atia aniwu ne nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadi (Peer education). Intanɛt so nkitahodi dwumadi anaa nkyerɛwee (Social media/blogs). Dɔm mmabun kuo. Kyɛ wo suahunu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ sɛ wonnim sɛ ebia wɔn tebea no fata sɛ ɔhaw na ehia sɛ wɔboa wɔn wɔ aduruyɛ mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun nnim sɛ ebia wɔn tebea no fata sɛ ɔhaw na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn wɔ aduruyɛ mu a, ɛho hia sɛ wodi mfomso wɔ ahwɛyiye afã na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔayɛ basaa, ehu aka wɔn, anaasɛ wɔn honam fam ahotɔ mu a. Wobetumi akɔ ɔpanyin anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wogye no di nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmmisa bɛn na metumi abisa obi a obɛtumi ayɛ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo de ahwɛ sɛ wɔatete wɔn wɔ SOGI-a ɛka ho mu anaa? (osuahu a ɔwɔ wɔ LGBTQ+ ayarefo ho, apɔmuden ahiade pɔtee bi ho ntease)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ntetee nhyehyɛe bi wɔ hɔ ma apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔne mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu yɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow pii de amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛma apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo ntease ne wɔn ahokokwaw a wɔwɔ wɔ sɛnea wɔne mmabun ahorow ahorow bɛyɛ adwuma mu no ma. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi betumi aka nsɛmti te sɛ amammerɛ mu ahobrɛaseɛ, nkitahodiɛ akwan a ɛtu mpɔn, ne akwan a wɔfa so di amammerɛ mu animhwɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ ɔhokafo a ɔboa obi a ɔrehwehwɛ ne nna anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu?
answer_twi_source: Tie denneennen: Kyerɛ wɔn akwantu no ho anigye ankasa na yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔde wɔn ho nto wo so. Nya abotare na te ase: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nhwehwɛmu betumi ayɛ adeyɛ a ɛma adwene tu fra. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho: Sua LGBTQ+ nipasu ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho ade na ama woate wɔn suahu ase yiye. Twa w’ankasa animhwɛ ho mpoa: Yɛn nyinaa wɔ animhwɛ a yennim. Bue w’ani ma adesua na nyin. Si wɔn ho so dua: Fa edinnsiananmu ne din a wɔpaw no di dwuma. Bu wɔn kokoam nsɛm: Ɛyɛ wɔn akwantu, ɛnyɛ wo de sɛ wobɛkyɛ wɔ baguam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne ahwɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa Intanɛt so abusuabɔ mu dwoodwoo, a nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, ahye, ne nkitahodi a ɛfata ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmabun bɛtumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa intanɛt so abusuabɔ mu dwoodwoo denam: Nkitahodi pa: Nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi na ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, a nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene, ahyeɛ, ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛyɛ papa ka ho. Ahye a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Mmabun a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔde ahye a emu da hɔ ama wɔn nkitahodi wɔ Intanɛt so na wɔakyerɛ wɔn kwan wɔ sɛnea wɔde obu besi saa ahye ahorow yi so dua ho. Digitals Literacy Education: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho, a afotu a wɔde behu na wɔayɛ ho biribi wɔ nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ nea wɔpene so anaa ɔhaw ho ka ho. Nhwehwɛmu ne Hwɛ: Wɔbɛhwɛ mmabun dwumadi ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ intanɛt so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ nea wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu so, na wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama bere a ɛho hia. Dwumadie a Wɔde Yɛ Akwahosan Suban: Intanɛt so nneyɛe a ɛyɛ papa ne nkitahodi a obu wom ho nhwɛsoɔ wɔ wɔn ankasa nkitahodiɛ mu, a ɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa ma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛsuasua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Suban pa ne abrabɔ mu nsusuiaɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ sɛnea yɛbɛkari pɛ wɔ mbabun kyɛfa a ɛma wodi wɔn ho so, wɔn kokoam nsɛm, ne gyinaesi a egyina nteaseɛ so, ne adwene a yɛdwene fa wɔn banbɔ, wɔn yiyedi, ne wɔn suban pa onyin ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan a egyina nnipa hokwan ahorow so adi dwuma de ako ama nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ denam: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia ɛhia a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so. Dwuma a nhomasua di wɔ tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi te wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ase na wɔde di dwuma, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, kokoam nnwuma, ne mmoa a ɛnyɛ nyiyim ka ho a wosi so dua. Nkitahodi a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bedi nkitaho de ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina adanse so, ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, na ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi, wɔn ahorow ahorow, ne nidi ho nkuran. Ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi a wɔbɛboaboa ano de ahwehwɛ sɛ wobu akontaa, wɔyɛ no pefee, na wɔyɛ pɛ wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nnwuma ne nneɛma a wɔde ma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ ayaresa hwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sika (Financial). Kwan (Geographical). Amammerɛ (Sociocultural). Mmara (Legal).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne aduru a wodi si nyisɛn ano ntɛm ntɛm, na ɛyɛ adwuma sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Aduru a wodi si nyisɛn ano ntɛm ntɛm  (Emergency contraception (EC))  kyerɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban, nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye, anaa nna mu ɔbrasɛe akyi. EC yɛ adwuma denam ovulation a esiw ano anaasɛ ɛkyɛ, ɛwo a wɔde mmadwoa nyinsɛn, anaasɛ ɛwo a wɔahyɛ no ma a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu, a egyina ɔkwan pɔtee a wɔfa so yɛ ne bere a wɔde ma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ no hyɛ asetrade a ɛtra hɔ daa ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wonya sika ho nkuran ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ no hyɛ asetrade a ɛtra hɔ daa ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wonya sika ho nkuran ma mmabun denam adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ahokokwaw nkɔso nhyehyɛe, ne gua ne sikasɛm mu nnwuma a wɔde ma so. Wɔboa nnwuma a ɛhyɛ adwumayɛ, nneɛma foforo a wɔyɛ, ne adwumayɛ ho nneyɛe a ɛtra hɔ daa ho nkuran, na ɛma mmabun nya hokwan ahorow sɛ wɔbɛkyekye asetrade a ɛboa ma sikasɛm mu nkɔso ne mpɔtam hɔfo nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebia wobenya ntawntawdi anaa pow afi wɔn nyamesom mpɔtam hɔ esiane wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa awo a wɔpaw nti?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wobetumi anya ntawntawdi anaa pow afi wɔn nyamesom mpɔtam hɔ esiane wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa awo a wɔpaw nti. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ayɛ mmoa akuo, intanɛt so mpɔtam, ne afotuo dwumadie a ɛma nkateɛ mu mmoa, si so dua, ne akwankyerɛ. Bio nso, wiase nnwumakuo ahorow ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ betumi de nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow, akwahosan ho akwan horow, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmoa nkitahodi ahorow ho ama ankorankoro a wohyia nyiyim anaa nyiyim a egyina nyamesom gyidi ahorow so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ ankorankoro ne mpɔtam a wɔboa wɔn a wɔsi wɔn nipasu so dua na wɔma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wogye wɔn tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na social media platform ahorow boa ma nna mu akɔnnɔ mu nsɛm nya nkɛntɛnso wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm so?
answer_twi_source: Ma nkɔsoɔ mmra w'amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wode bɛhwehwɛ sɛnea social media da nna ne dɛmdi adi no mu yiye. Wo ne wo nnamfo nsusu saa nneyɛe ahorow yi ho wɔ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ, twa nsusuii hunu a ɛyɛ katee ho mpoa na hyɛ gyinabea ahorow a obuo wom ho nkuran. Curate Your Feed: Di nkorɔfoɔ a Ghanafo a wɔadi dɛm ne amanaman ntam adebɔfo a wɔhyɛ mmubuafo nkabom ho nkuran na wɔhwɛ so no akyi. Eyi ma wuhu gyinabea pa ne bɔne. Gyina mu soronko: Sɛ wuhu sɛ wɔreyɛ obi basabasa wɔ Intanɛt so esiane ne dɛmdi anaa nna ho a, bɔ amanneɛ wɔ platform no so\ na fa mmoa ma nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no (sɛ asiane biara nni ho sɛ wobɛyɛ saa a).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si 'informed consent' (nimdeɛ mu kwan-gye) so dua ma anamɔntu biara.
answer_twi_source: Adoption gye berɛ. Ɛhia sɛ wote aseɛ yie. Social Welfare ma akwankyerɛ. Wubetumi afa 'open' anaa 'closed' adoption.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de abɛɛfo ntentan adi dwuma sɛ adwinnade a, wɔde bɛko ama nna ne awo hokwan ahorow (SRR) na wɔakasa atia animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wɔde tia akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua, a "LGBTQ+" ankorankoro ne mmabun a wɔwɔ "HIV/AIDS" ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu ɔsatuo: Mmabun betumi de abɛ akwan adɛɛfo ntentan dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate nna ne awo hokwan ahorow (SRR) ase na wɔakamfo hokwan ahorow a akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua te sɛ ankorankoro a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ankorankoro ne mmabun a wɔwɔ "HIV/AIDS" wɔ. Asɛm a wɔka: Ankorankoro nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ no betumi ama nna ne awo hokwan (SRR) nsɛm ayɛ nnipa de, akasa atia nsusuwii hunu, na ama atenka ne ntease aba atipɛnfo ne ɔmanfo a wɔdɔɔso mu. Mpɔtam-dansi: Intanɛt so mpɔtam ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ no ma akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no tumi di nkitaho, kyɛ nneɛma, na wɔde mmoa ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) nsɛnnennen a wɔbɛdi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ mɛhwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwene mu apomoden yare ho nsɛm mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi animtiaabu a ɛbata mmoa a mɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi hwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwene mu apomoden ho a, ebetumi ama wɔanya mfaso pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhwehwɛmu a egyina adanse so a wobenya, yare a wobehu, ne ayaresa a wɔayɛ ama ankorankoro ahiade ahorow. Akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ne adwenemyare mu. Nkɔso a ɛbɛma wɔatumi agyina ɔhaw ano, sɛnea wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, ne akwan pa a wɔfa so di adwennwen ne nkate horow ho dwuma. Nkitahodi a ɛda mmoa akuo, atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa ne nkuranhyɛ a ɛkɔ so. Nea ɛka animtiaabu a ɛbata mmoa a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ ho no so nkonimdi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ, nsɛm a edi mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, na wɔahu sɛ mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ no yɛ ahoɔden ne akokoduru ho sɛnkyerɛnne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛtumi afa so ayɛ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ tebea a ɛyɛ pa na ɛma kwan a ɛsi doka ne animahyɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ tebea a ɛyɛ pa na ɛma kwan a ɛsi doka ne animahyɛ ano a wɔbɛyɛ no hia mmɔdenbɔ a asukuufoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛbom ayɛ. Akwan a wɔbetumi asusu ho no bi ne: Doka banbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛyɛ de akyerɛkyerɛ asukuufoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ doka ho, ahyɛ ayamhyehyeɛ ne obu nkuran, na wɔama akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ de adi nsɛm a esisi ho dwuma. Ayamye, ogye a wɔgye nkurɔfoɔ tom, ne nkabom a wɔbɛhyɛ nkuran denam sukuu mu nhyehyɛeɛ, te sɛ nnamfo afotu nhyehyɛeɛ, nneɛma ahorow akuo, ne suban pa a wɔhyɛ den. Nkitahodiɛ a emu da hɔ ne nkabom a wɔbɛhyɛ nkuran wɔ asukuufoɔ, awofoɔ, ne sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ ntam de adi doka ho dadwen ho dwuma ntɛm na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye. Nteteeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔbɛma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ de ahunu, asiw, na wɔasi doka ho dwuma ano. Asukuufoɔ a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔadi dwuma titiriw wɔ mpɔtam hɔ suban pa nkuranhyɛ mu na wɔagyina atia doka suban denam nnamfo akyigyina ne akanni nhyehyɛeɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'reproductive justice' (awoɔ ho atɛntrenee) fa asetena mu nneɛma nyinaa ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛwɔ sɛ ɔmo hwɛ ohia, nyiyimu, efi, ayaresa a ɛnkɔ yie, ne akwansidie a ɛwɔ nwomasua/adwumasɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi ayɛ ɔyɔnko a ɔka obiara ho kɛse a osusuw sɛnea nnipa ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛ nnipa ahorow a ɛwɔ mmaa ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da a broni twa so ka no 'LGBTQ+' mpɔtam hɔ no mu no hyia no ho? (osuahu ahorow a wɔte ase) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da a broni twa so ka no 'LGBTQ+'  sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me mmea ho hwɛ yɛ kokoamsɛm, na dɛn akwannya ahorow na  mewɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wo mmea hwɛ yɛ kokoamsɛm wɔ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobɛpaw wɔn a wɔde ayarefo kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm di kan. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no nsusuw kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ho ansa na woayɛ nhyehyɛe. Ɔhwɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ wɔ akwahosan asoɛe a ɛdi kokoam nsɛm ho mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ so, te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). Nim a wunim hokwan ahorow a wowɔ wɔ kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho, a nea ɛka ho ne hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wunya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ne w’ankasa akwahosan ho nsɛm ho banbɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ka nneɛma ne nnwuma a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho a wobenya wɔ mpɔtam ahohorow?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow a Ɛmma Wonnya: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow betumi ama akwanside ahorow aba wɔ nsɛm anaa nnwuma a wobenya ho, titiriw sɛ wobu nsɛmti sɛ ɛyɛ musuo. Animtiaabu a Wɔtew So: Amammerɛ mu animtiaabu a wɔde di dwuma denam nhomasua ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi so no betumi ama mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa anya nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no atu mpɔn. Nnwuma a Wɔasiesie: Nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow betumi ama wɔanya bi na wɔatu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi akɔ akɔyi nyinsɛn a asiane biara nni ho na mmara ma ho kwan? (ayaresabea ahorow, Planned Parenthood) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ yɛte mmara kwan so gyinabea a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ Ghana ase. Nsɛm a edi mu a wobenya afa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a mmara ma ho kwan na ahobammɔ wom ho no ho hia yie. wobɛtumi akɔ ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea biara akɔnya nyinsɛn a wɔyi gu ho dwumadie a ahotɔ ne mmara kwan so wɔ Ghana mmara mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan 'SRH' ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Obu: Fa obu a wɔwɔ ma gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow di nsonsonoe ho dwuma. Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ w’ankasa wo amammerɛ mu gyidi ne afoforo nso ho. Sɛ yɛte adwene ahorow ase a, ebetumi ama wɔanya tema. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a obi tumi kyerɛ n'adwene: Wo ne abusua mufoɔ anaa mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee na ɛnyɛ atemmuo wɔ w’adwene wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ne wɔn ntam akasakasa a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa amammerɛ ho ɔfotufo a wogye no di a obetumi de akwankyerɛ ama no hɔ. Kamfo: Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na makwati abɛɛfo ntenten anaa Intanɛt so nsisi, mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyere nkurɔfo, ne kɔmputa so ahunahuna afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ Akyinnyegye: Hwɛ yiye wɔ abɛɛfo nkyerew nteten, nkrasɛm, anaa link ahorow a efi mmeae a wunnim ho, titiriw sɛ wobisa wo ho nsɛm a. Hwɛ URLs: Hwɛ sɛ wɛbsaet URL ahorow no yɛ nokware ansa na wode nsɛm a ɛho hia ahyɛ mu na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛfata. Nhwehwɛmu: Sɛ ɛte sɛ nea biribi yɛ adwenem naayɛ a, hwehwɛ mu wɔ Intanɛt so anaa bisa ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso ma ɔmma no afotu. Bɔ Sikasɛm Ho Nsɛm Ho Ban: Mfa sikasɛm ho nsɛm nkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so da gye sɛ wowɔ wɛbsaet ahorow a ahobammɔ wom na wogye di so. Update Security Software: Hwɛ sɛ wo afedie no ho hwe ye ɛfa  software ho no yɛ foforo na ama woabɔ wo ho ban afi malware ne virus ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen bɛn na mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu no betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Osuahu a wonni: Ebia mmabun pii nni adwuma mu osuahu a edi kan, na ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ wobesi akan wɔ adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow ho anaasɛ wɔbɛfa adwuma mu akwanhwɛ ahorow so. Hokwan ahorow a wobenya kakraa bi: Mmabun binom, titiriw wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa pii no betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe pa anaasɛ adwumayɛ ho ntetee esiane nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ nti. Adwuma ne asɛyɛde afoforo a wɔbɛkari pɛ: Mmabun a wɔde adwuma mu bɔhyɛ ahorow ne sukuu, abusua asɛyɛde ahorow, anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi di dwuma no betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ wɔn bere ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan a wɔde bedi dwuma yiye no mu. Adwumayɛbea mu nkɔso: Ebia adwumayɛfo nkumaa behyia nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nkitahodi, kuw adwumayɛ, ntawntawdi ano aduru, anaasɛ nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ahyehyɛde amammerɛ mu wɔ wɔn adwumayɛbea ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na me nne reyɛ kɛse saa?
answer_twi_source: Wo nne adaka (larynx) te sɛ sanku, na mmerantebere ne mmabaabere te sɛ nea ɛrenya tune-up! Nkwammoaa (hormones) ma wo nne nhama ware, na ɛma wo nne te sɛ nea emu dɔ. Ebia ɛbɛpaapae anaasɛ ɛbɛyɛ te sɛ nea ɛyɛ nwonwa bere tiaa bi, nanso ɛno yɛ bere tiaa mu de.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na aguade ho dawurubɔ, aguadi, ne nneɛma a wɔde si hɔ di wɔ adwene a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow, ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ a mmabun nya ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Dawurubɔ, aguadi, ne nneɛma a wɔde si hɔ di dwuma titiriw wɔ adwene a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ a mmabun nya ho no mu. Mpɛn pii no, aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow da mmarima ne mmea ho mfonini ahorow a wɔayɛ no yiye adi, na ɛhyɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn teateaa ho nkuran na ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsusuwii hunu mu den. Nneɛma a wɔde si nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu no hyɛ saa nsɛm yi mu den bio wɔ nneɛma bi a wɔde bata ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna pɔtee bi anaa asetra mu dwumadi ahorow ho no so. Eyi betumi ama nipadua mu abotɔyam a enni hɔ, ahobammɔ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, ne abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmabun mu no aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotuo botaeɛ, na mɛyɛ dɛn ehu sɛ ɛreboa me?
answer_twi_source: Afotuo botaeɛ taa gyina ankorankorɛ biara ahiasɛm so. Obia yɛ soronko. Mmoa no bi ne sɛ; nsesaeɛ papa bɛba adwene apɔwmuden mu, na wobenya akokoduro wɔ wo mu, anaa sɛ wommu wo ho abomfia. Wei boa wo dɔ mu nsɛm na wotumi nyin yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwan ne nnyinasosɛm ahorow a egyina nnipa hokwan ahorow so, te sɛ nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, pɛyɛ, ne kyɛfa a wonya no ma wohu amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Akwan ne nnyinasosɛm a egyina nnipa hokwan ahorow so, te sɛ nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, pɛyɛ, ne kyɛfa a wonya no, ma amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow hu. Saa akwan yi si hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, akwahosan ho nnwuma, ne nsɛm a nyiyim biara nni ho so dua, na ɛhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛn amammerɛ anaa nyamesom a yefi mu no nya adwene a yɛwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom nkyi nsɛm taa kyerɛ sɛdeɛ yɛbu nna ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden, yɛn suban, ne yɛn nneyɛeɛ wɔ saa nneɛma yi ho. Ebia saa nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi bɛkyerɛ gyinapɛn ahorow, akwanhwɛ ahorow, ne nneɛma a yɛn amammerɛ mma ho kwan (akyiwadie) ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nna a edi aware anim, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho. Yɛn amammerɛ anaa nyamesom ntetee betumi anya sɛnea yɛdi nkitaho fa saa nsɛmti yi ho wɔ yɛn mmusua ne yɛn mpɔtam hɔ so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu no ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow "community organization", adwenem ahokwasan ho adwumayɛfo "mental health professionals", ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no yɛ biako de ma adwenemyare ho mmɔdenbɔ a wɔhyɛ no nya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahodoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ yɛ adwuma bom de ma adwenemyareɛ ho nkɔsoɔ mmɔdenbɔ nya nkɔsoɔ denam: Wɔne mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛkuo, ayaresabea, ne nnwumakuo a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma de nneɛma foforɔ, dwumadie, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ama asuafoɔ. Nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ, nhyiamu, ne nhyiamu a ɛfa adwenem ahokwasan ho nsɛmti ho na ɛboa asuafoɔ yiedie a wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Awofoɔ, mmusua, ne ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwenemyareɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ mu denam mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn ne mpɔtam hɔ fekubɔ so. Nkitahodi a wɔde kɔma asuafoɔ ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ sukuu nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛde asuafoɔ adwenemyareɛ ne yiedie di kan no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu ka mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu betumi anya sɛnea mmabun hu nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma na wɔhwehwɛ no so nkɛntɛnso. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Ebia mmarimaa dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no asiw mmarimaa kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho, a wɔfa no sɛ ɛyɛ mmea nkutoo asɛyɛde. Ebia mmeawa behyia animtiaabu anaa atemmu bere a wɔrenya nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no, efisɛ ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow taa kyerɛ akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmea ahotew ne ahobrɛase ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ di wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ ne atwetwe mu?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu ne nna ho akɔnnɔ yɛ nneɛma a ɛfa ho nanso ɛda nsow wɔ nipasu biara ho. Bɔbeasu kyerɛ sɛnea wote nka sɛ woyɛ ɔbarima, ɔbea, abien no nyinaa a wɔadi afra, anaasɛ emu biara nni hɔ, bere a nna ho akɔnnɔ kyerɛ bɔbeasu (ɔbarima anaa ɔbea) a w’ani gye ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ebia ɔbarima a ɔsakra ne bɔbeasu no bɔbeasu yɛ soronko wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde maa no bere a wɔwoo no no ho, na ebia wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ bɛtwetwe nnipa a wɔyɛ bɔbeasu pɔtee bi. Nanso, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna nkyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, na nnipa a wɔwɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna nyinaa mu betumi anya nna ho akɔnnɔ biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne nnamfo, ahokafo, ne abusuafo anya abusuabɔ a ɛfata na obu womu de asiw GBV ano? (nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ahye a wɔde besi hɔ, ahotoso) .
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi Ho Nimdeɛ: Sua sɛ wobɛda wo nsusuwii adi pefee na tie wo nnamfo, w’abusuafo, ne wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ wo hokafo no denneennen. Ahye a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Hu wo anohyeto ahorow na fa obu mu ka ho asɛm kyerɛ afoforo. Eyi betumi afa nneɛma te sɛ kokoamu nsɛm, sɛnea wopɛ sɛ wɔne wo di, anaa honam fam nkitahodi ko a wo ho tɔ wo ho. Ahotoso: Fa ahotoso, nokwaredi, ne wo bɔhyɛ ahorow a wubedi so no so nya ahotoso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mefa nea wɔ taa fre no 'insurance' a wɔde tua ho ka anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow so de boa ma wotua awo apomoden  ho nnwuma ho ka?
answer_twi_source: Insurance ne Sikasɛm mu Mmoa a Wobɛfa So: Apomoden Insurance: Hwɛ sɛ w’awofo insurance nhyehyɛe no tua awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no ho ka anaa. Kyerɛw wo din wɔ Ɔman apomoden insurance nhyehyɛe no mu apomoden adwumayɛbea dodow no ara de awo apomoden ho nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den ma. Dwumadie te sɛ Medicaid betumi atua awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie ho ka ama wɔn a wɔfata. Awofoyɛ a Wɔayɛ Ho Nhyehyɛe: Wɔde sika a ɛkɔ fam a egyina sika a wonya wɔ nnwuma ahorow ho, a nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho so ma. Mpɔtam Hɔ Ayaresabea: Ayaresabea ahorow bi de sika fam mmoa nhyehyɛe anaasɛ wɔatew sika so ma wɔn a wohia mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne atipɛnfo ayɛ biako de ayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm pa a ɛhyɛ atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ pa, tema, nnipa a wɔka ho, ne nneɛma ahorow a egu ahorow ho nkuran na wɔakyekyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne atipɛnfo ayɛ biako de ayɛ na wɔakyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm pa a ɛhyɛ atipɛnfo nyɔnkofa nkitahodie a ɛyɛ papa, tema, nkabom, ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ kuw nnwuma anaa ɔsatu ahorow a ɛfa asetra mu nsɛm a ɛfa ho ho anaasɛ wɔkamfo suban pa mu nsakrae wɔ atipɛnfo akuw ne mpɔtam hɔ. Ankorankoro nsɛm, osuahu, ne adwene a wɔde bɛkyɛ denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan horow so, te sɛ video, blog, anaa sohyial media so nsɛm, de ama atenka ne ntease aba atipɛnfo mu. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyiamu anaa nnwuma a ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔyɛ na wɔkyɛ nsɛm a ɛda wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn apɛdeɛ adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow hyehyɛ nna ho mfonini wɔ media mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow di dwuma titiri wɔ nna ho mfonini a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no mu, na enya abusuabɔ, nneyɛe, ne nipasu ahorow a wɔayɛ ho mfonini no so nkɛntɛnso. Saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi betumi anya mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow so nkɛntɛnso wɔ ɔkwan soronko so, efisɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow betumi ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow bi ahyia kɛse bere a ɛne afoforo bɔ abira no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
