question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo suban, gyidie, ne amammerɛ di wɔ wɔn adwene a wɔhyehyɛ wɔ nsɛm te sɛ ayɔnkofa, nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI a wosiw ano ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn de me ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ mu de adi nsonsonoe anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ biara ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Awofo suban, gyidie, ne amammerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ wɔn adwene a wɔhyehyɛ wɔ nsɛm te sɛ ayɔnkofa, nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI a wosiw ano ho denam: Awofo gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde di kan, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nneyɛe ne gyinaesi ho wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu a wonya so nkɛntɛnso, a gyinapɛn ne amammerɛ mu atetesɛm a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho ka ho. Nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛte nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne awoɔ ho nsɛm ase na wɔakyerɛ aseɛ, a wɔbɛkyerɛ awofoɔ kwan a wɔfa so ne wɔn mma susuw saa nsɛmti yi ho. Awofoɔ nkitahodi akwan ne wɔn akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nkɛntɛnsoɔ, a wɔn ahotɔ dodoɔ a ɛwɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia a wɔbɛka ho asɛm ne tumi a wɔtumi de nsɛm ma wɔn mma yie ka ho. Nsonsonoe anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ a awofo ne mmabun ntam wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a wɔbɛboa, a wɔtwe adwene si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ a wɔda no adi pefee na wɔte wɔn ho wɔn ho ase wɔ nsɛm yi ho dwuma a wodi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ a wobu Nnipa a Wɔadi M dɛm na wɔde wɔn ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Boa ahyehyɛde ahorow. Intanɛt so mpɔtam hɔfo. Akuw a wɔboa. Mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a esisi. Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow.Ntrɛwmu/app ahorow (YMK/Yenkasa)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aduan pa nya awo ne awo akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso "impact"ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Aduan pa nya awo ne awo akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso pa nneɛma te sɛ nkwaadwom "hormone" a ɛkari pɛ, brayɛ a ɛkɔ so daa, ovulation, mmadwoa su, ne awo dwumadi nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso so. Aduan pa a wonnya nni, a aduannuru bi a wonnya nni anaasɛ ɛboro so ka ho no betumi asɛe awo akwahosan na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa benya awo ho haw no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammerɛ (rites of passage) guasodeyɛ, ne amanne ahorow ka mmabun nna ho nhyehyɛe, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ, na mfaso ne asiane bɛn na ɛwɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de mmoa ne nipasu ama nanso ebetumi apira nso. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsesa nneyɛe a epira, na wɔkyerɛ obu ne pene ne nea obi ankasa paw no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kokoam-yɛ ne kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ a wɔde ma mmabun  a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe no sesa wɔ mmeammea ahorow te sɛ ayaresabea, sukuu anaa abɛɛfo ntentan  so anaa? kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ a wɔde ma mmabun
answer_twi_source: Aane. Ayaresabea ho taa yɛ den. Sukuu nhyehyeɛ  deɛ ɛsesa. Abɛɛfo ntentan so deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'mentorship' (mmoayɛ nhyehyɛe/ afotu) boa mmabun sika nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ a enni hɔ: Akwankyerɛ. Nkitahodi a ɛda fam: Wɔne nkurɔfoɔ bɔ. Sika haw: Sika a yɛhyehyɛ/sie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde hwɛ adwenemhaw ho n, na ɛne mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan wɔ nkitaho bɛn?
answer_twi_source: Adwenemhaw hwɛ ho nsɛm yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so hu sɛnea adwenemhaw abu so ne nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ ankorankoro so na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛma tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛboa ma wɔasa yare. Egye adwenemhaw a mmabun betumi anya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu, te sɛ nna mu ayayade, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so, anaa awo mu nhyɛso no tom. Adwenemhaw hwɛ  ho nsɛm kyerɛ no botae ne sɛ wobedi osuahu ahorow yi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nkate so na etu mpɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mesesa me ntade ne me ntade ase bere a meyɛ mmerante ne mmabaabere?
answer_twi_source: Ntade ne ntade ase a wobɛsesa daa no ho hia na ama wo ho atew. Akwankyerɛ ahorow bi ni: Ntade ase: Sesa ntade ase da biara na ama asen no ho atew na ayɛ kusuu. Ntade: Ɛdenam wo dwumadi dodow ne wim tebea so no, sesa ntade da biara da anaasɛ mpɛn pii sɛ fifiri anaasɛ efĩ ba a. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ akyi: Bere nyinaa sesa ntade a fifiri ayɛ anaasɛ ɛyɛ nwini bere a woateɛteɛ w’apɔw mu awie no na amma wo honam ani yare ne hua ankɔ. Pajamas: Sesa pajamas a ɛho tew daa, titiriw sɛ wo ho fifiri bere a woada a. Sɛ wudi ahotew ho nhyehyɛe ahorow yi akyi a, wubetumi akura nipadua a ɛyɛ foforo na ɛwɔ apɔwmuden mu wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔde amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne atenka ka nnwuma a wɔde ma wɔ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa de no ho?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee wɔde adwumayɛfoɔ ma wɔte amammerɛ, gyidie, ne nneyɛeɛ ahodoɔ ase na wɔbu wɔn. Nsɛm asekyerɛfoɔ dwumadie a wɔde bɛma ayarefoɔ a wɔwɔ kasa mu akwansideɛ na ama wɔatumi adi nkitaho yie. Nhomasua nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔde bɛma. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akannifo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de adi amammerɛ mu ahiade pɔtee ne nea ɛhaw wɔn a wɔma mmabun no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmu a wɔbɛma aba wɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmu a wɔbɛma aba wɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa mu denam: Wɔde nsiyɛ ne tema tie mmabun haw ahorow, nsɛmmisa, ne wɔn ahiade ahorow a wonni atemmu anaasɛ animhwɛ. Mmabun ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, ne kokoam hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyiam no nyinaa mu. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne afotu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV a wosiw ano, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛma. Ɔhwɛ a ayamhyehye wom na ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wosusuw mmabun ankorankoro asetra, osuahu ahorow, ne nea wɔpɛ ho a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun akwaahosan ne yiyedi a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ denam wɔn nipadua, nkate, ne adwene mu akwahosan ahiade ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na mmabun yɛ sɛ wɔwɔ asiane mu na wɔn banmɔ nhyehyeɛ ɛnnyɛ a,na ɛkwan bɛn so na ɔmo bɛfrɛ mmoa ntɛmtɛm so?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mmoa wɔ ahohiahia mu: Sɛ mmabun hu ɔmo ho wɔ ahohiahia mu aa ɔmo banmɔ- nhyehyeɛ ɛnnyɛ aa, ɛho hia sɛ wɔ frɛ gye mmoa ntɛmtɛm so. Wei betumi ayɛ sɛ wofrɛ panyin a wogye no di, wo frɛ ahohiahia torɔfo ahoma, wokɔ ayaresabeae a ɛbɛn, anaa wo frɛ ntɛmtɛm mmoa dwumadimafo gye mmoa ntɛmtɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya etumpɔn ahotoso a ne ahotoso wɔ me nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ mu bere a meresi sɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wobɛ  taa ayɛ : Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a wo ne wo nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa mpo wɔ ahwehwɛ anim. Ankasa Ho Nkasa Pa: Fa nsɛm a wɔde si so dua te sɛ "Metumi" anaa "Mewɔ nsusuwii a ɛsom bo" si ankasa ho adwenem naayɛ ananmu. Nipadua Kasa: Gyina hɔ anaa tra ase tẽẽ, hwɛ w’ani, na fa nsateaa di dwuma de kyerɛ ahotoso. Hu Nkonimdi: Di nkonim nketenkete a woadi wɔ nkitahodi mu ho afahyɛ, te sɛ asɛm bi a wubebisa wɔ adesua mu. Fi Awerɛkyekye Beae: Twa wo ho mpoa sɛ kasa wɔ kuw tebea horow mu anaasɛ tu wo ho ma mma nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ. Hwehwɛ Nsɛm a Wobɛka: Bisa ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di ma wɔmma wɔn nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ wɔ wo nkitahodi kwan no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wɔagye din, wɔn a wɔwɔ tumi, ne ɔmanfo mu nnipa nam wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu so nya adwene a mmabun kura wɔ nipadua mfonini ho no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔagye din, wɔn a wɔwɔ tumi, ne ɔmanfo mu nnipa nya mmabun adwene wɔ nipadua mfonini ho so nsunsuanso denam wɔn ho a wɔde gyina hɔ ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu so wɔ: Wɔsom sɛ nhwɛsofo ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ebia mmabun bɛpɛ sɛ wosuasua a wɔde besi hɔ no so. Nneɛma bi, asetra kwan, anaa ahoɔfɛ ho adwene ahorow bi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nneɛma a wɔboa anaasɛ nea wɔkamfo kyerɛ so, a wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe. Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mfonini, ahoɔfɛ, ne wɔn ho a wɔsom bo ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata anaasɛ wɔbɛkasa atia denam wɔn baguam mfonini ne nsɛm a wɔka so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a yɛbɛfa so de ɛhye asi hɔ wɔ ayɔnkofa mu a ɛbɔ yɛn adwenem mu ahokwasan "mental health" ho ban na ɛma nkitahodi a ɛfata nya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi: Ahye ho hia na ama wɔakura adwene mu akwahosan mu na wɔama nkitahodi a ɛfata anya nkɔso. Mmabun betumi de ahye asi hɔ denam wɔn ahiade ne anohyeto ahorow a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee, afoforo ahye a wobebu, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa nnamfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ wobu ahye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka wɔn nneyɛeɛ anaa nsɛm a wɔfa mu wɔ intanɛt so mmoa (online crisis intervention) ho asɛm na ama mmoa no anya mpuntuo?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de nsɛm ama anaasɛ wɔde wɔn suahu akyerɛ wɔ intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nnwuma mu denam nsɛm a wɔde ma ho nkrataa, nhwehwɛmu, anaa nkitahodi tee a wɔne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma no so. Nnwuma pii gye nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ no tom na wɔde di dwuma de ma wɔn mmoa no tu mpɔn na wodi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ama anigyeɛ ne abusuabɔ papa atu mpɔn wɔ nna mu asetena mu?
answer_twi_source: Kasa pefee . Ne nyimpa a wɔ ne no wo ho nsusu ho deɛ ɛyɛ anigyeɛ na mo nyinaa mopɛ ho asɛm. Mo ne mo ho nkye nkra anaa agyinasoɔ nneɛma foforɔ a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ bom mo betumi ayɛ. Mfiaseɛ Nna: Di mfiaseɛ nna a ɛpagya anigyeɛ ne ahoɔden munwɔ mo abusubɔ mu. Sɔ ano honam, honam nnesoɔ, ne nsisi foforɔ hwɛ. Nsisi Ahorow: Sɔ nna ho nsisi ahorow, mmeaeɛ, anaa nnawɔtwe mu berɛ hwɛ fa nkatenkatee ho. Fa agoro ahodoɔ, nnesoɔ, anaa dwuma a wɔbɛdi mu ka ho sɛ mo nyinaa mopɛ. Nkatenkatee Nkabom: Hyɛ nkatenkatee mu nkabom mu den wɔ adan mu dwuma ahodoɔ a mo nyinaa mopɛ so. Kyerɛ ɔdɔ ne adom ma mo ho. Suahu fa abɔdeɛ mu nna ne sɛntrefoɔ nna ho nsisi te sɛ kondom a wɔde di dwuma yie ne daa, ne nsɛm a ɛfa nkitahodie mu nokorɛdie ho asɛm, STI a wɔde sɔ ho hwɛ, STI aduro a wɔde wie, ne STI abɔdeɛ mu aduro a wɔde asiw ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔayɛ wɔn ade wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ wɔn ankasa, wɔn atipɛnfo, anaa wɔn mpɔtam hɔ, na anammɔn bɛn na wobetumi atu de ahwehwɛ mmoa, abɔ nsɛm a esisi ho amanneɛ, na wɔanya mmoa nnwuma bi?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu nna mu basabasayɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne na wɔayɛ ho biribi denam nneɛma a wɔtaa de kyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔtaa hu ne wɔn awosu mu ahotoso a wobenya so. Nsɛnkyerɛnne betumi ayɛ nsakrae a ɛba suban, adwene, anaa nipadua mu hwɛbea mu, twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ayɔnkofa dwumadi ahorow ho, ehu a wosuro mpofirim anaasɛ wɔkwati ankorankoro anaa mmeae bi, opira a wontumi nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, anaa wɔn ho a wopira. Sɛ wosusuw sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa, wɔn atipɛnfo, anaa wɔn mpɔtam hɔ a, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ nneɛma a edidi so yi: Gye wɔn nkate ne wɔn haw ahorow di, na kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Kɔ ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ awofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn, na ka nea wɔahu ne nea ɛhaw wɔn ho asɛm. Hyɛ onipa a ɔrehyia nna mu basabasayɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi ɔpanyin anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye no di te sɛ ɔfotufo, ɔyaresafo, anaa ɔkamfofo bi hɔ. Fa mmoa ne nokwaredi ma nea onyaa ne ti didii mu no, tie a wunmmu atɛn, na bu wɔn gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ anaasɛ asɛm no a wɔbɛbɔ ho amanneɛ ho. Hu mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no yiye, na hyɛ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no nkuran ma wonnya saa nneɛma yi nkɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a ɛyɛ kokoam. Sɛ obi wɔ asiane mu ntɛm ara anaasɛ ohia mmoa a egye ntɛmpɛ a, frɛ adwumayɛbea a ɛhwɛ ntɛmpɛ anaa mpɔtam hɔ ɔhaw ho telefon so ma wɔmmoa no ntɛm ara na wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na wobu nna ho adesua a ɛkɔ akyiri sɛ hokwan titire a mmabun wɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ ade titiriw efisɛ: Ɛma mmabun tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Ɛboa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, STI, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ano. Ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, obuo, ne ntease ho nkuran. Ɛma wonya adwene pa wɔ nneɛma ahorow ho, a nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma makyerɛkyerɛ m’abusua adwenemyare ne nna mu apɔmuden ho ade? (wɛbsaet ahorow, nhomasua nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: YMK app ""filla"" ɔfa kasa kyerɛ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bi wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm ho nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK ɔfotufoɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517""
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma bɛn na wɔtaa de ma mmabun wɔ awo akwahosan ho ayaresabea ahorow anaa mmeae hwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a Wɔde Ma: Nyinsɛn a Wosiw: Akwan ahorow te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, nnuru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu, nea wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, ne mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUDs). STI Nhwehwɛmu ne Ayaresa: STI ho nhwehwɛmu te sɛ nea broni ka no 'chlamydia, gonorrhea, HIV', ne ayaresa sɛ ɛho hia a. Nyinsɛn mu Sɔhwɛ ne Afotu: Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu, afotu a wɔde ma wɔ akwan horow a wobetumi afa so, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo sɛ wonyinsɛn a. Mmea Ho Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔyɛ akyi berɛmo mu nhwehwɛmu, Pap smears, ne nufu mu nhwehwɛmu de hwɛ awo akwahosan. Nhomasua ne Afotu: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotu a wɔde ma wɔ abusuabɔ, nneyɛe pa, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ho. Nnwuma Foforo: Nyinsɛn a Wosiw Ntɛmntɛm: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm a wobenya (anɔpa-akyi aduru). Wɔde Kɔma: Wɔde kɔma animdefo ma nsɛm a emu yɛ den kɛse. Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Dwumadibea: Ayaresabea ahorow bi de adwenemyare ho afotu ne mmoa ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmantam mu nsonsonoe nya nsunsuanso a abɛɛfo ntentan nkɛntɛnsofo ASRH nsɛm nya wɔ mmabun suban, gyidi, ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmantam mu nsonsonoe betumi anya nsunsuanso kɛse wɔ tumi a abɛɛfo ntentan nkɛntɛnsofo ASRH nsɛm nya wɔ mmabun so denam: Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn, gyinapɛn, ne adwene a ɛfa nna, awo akwahosan, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, a ebetumi ayɛ soronko wɔ amammerɛ ne mpɔtam ahorow mu. Nsunsuanso a mmabun nya nkrasɛm bi a wogye tom, a egyina amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, ne asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wɔ amammerɛ a ɛyɛ katee mu no, ASRH mu nsɛm betumi ahyia ɔsɔretia kɛse anaasɛ wɔbɛhwɛ so, bere a wɔ aman a wɔanya nkɔso kɛse mu no, ebia wobebue wɔn ani kɛse sɛ wɔbɛka saa nsɛmti yi ho asɛm pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi asua sɛ wɔbɛkari pɛ wɔ bere tiaa mu sikasɛm mu ahiade ne akɔnnɔ ne bere tenten mu sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ a broni ka no 'short-term financial needs and desires with long-term financial security' ne daakye ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asua sɛ wɔbɛkari pɛ wɔ bere tiaa mu sikasɛm mu ahiade ne akɔnnɔ ne bere tenten mu ahobammɔ mu denam sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ho nimdeɛ a wobenya, sikasɛm mu botae ahorow a wɔde bɛsisi wɔn ani so, ne sika a wɔsɛe no a wogyina wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ so di kan no so. Wobetumi de wɔn sika a wonya no fã bi ayɛ sika a wɔde sie ne sika a wɔde bɛto mu, te sɛ sika a wɔde boa ntɛm anaa pɛnhyenkɔ akontaabu, bere a wɔda so ara ma wɔn ho kwan ma wonya nnuan anaa nneɛma a wɔtɔ bere ne bere mu no. Sɛ mmabun nya su a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ akomatɔyam na wɔasi sikasɛm ho gyinae a ɛfata a, ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya bere tiaa mu abotɔyam ne bere tenten mu sikasɛm mu ahotɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside ahorow bi a ebetumi aba a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi so?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu: Suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Nea ɛka animtiaabu a wobedi so no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee, nhomasua, ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔsɔre tia ho nkuran. Nneɛma a wobetumi anya ne nea wobetumi atɔ: Adwene ne nneyɛe ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya pii, sikasɛm mu ahokyere, anaa insurance a wonnya no betumi ayɛ akwanside ahorow. Sɛ wohwehwɛ nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee denam sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma so a, ebetumi aboa. Kar: Sɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wubenya kar akɔ baabi a wɔahyɛ sɛ wobɛkɔ no betumi de nsɛnnennen aba. Telehealth akwan horow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nnwuma a ɛbɛn fie no betumi aboa ma wɔadi akwanside yi so. Amammerɛ anaa Kasa mu Akwanside: Amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe anaa kasa mu akwanside betumi asiw ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wobenya wɔ amammerɛ mu no kwan. Sɛ wohwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔte amammerɛ ase na wobu wɔn anaasɛ wɔde kasa nkyerɛase adwuma ma a, ebetumi aboa. Awofo Mpene: Ebia mmabun binom behyia akwanside ahorow esiane hia a ehia sɛ awofo pene so ma wɔsa wɔn yare nti. Ebia akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ kokoam nnwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu anaasɛ ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adeyɛ no mu no betumi aboa ma wɔadi akwanside yi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aban ahorow, ɔmanfo nnwumakuo ahorow, ankorankoro nnwumakuw, nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, ne amanaman ntam nnwumakuw ntam nkabom ne biakoyɛ betumi ahyɛ asetra mu nimdeɛ nkɔso akwanya ahorow mu den ama mmabun na ahyɛ sikasɛm mu nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa ne asetra mu nkabom ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Aban ahodoɔ, ɔmanfoɔ nnwumakuo, ankorankoro nnwumakuo, nwomasua asoɛeɛ, ne amanaman ntam nnwumakuo ntam nkitahodiɛ ne adwumayɛkuo di dwuma titire wɔ asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔsoɔ akwanya a mmabun nya mu den no mu. Nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nnipa ahodoɔ ho no de nimdeɛ ahodoɔ, nneɛma, nkitahodiɛ, ne tumi ahodoɔ di dwuma de yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, ɛtumi sesa, na ɛkɔ so daa a ɛdi mmabun ahiadeɛ ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so na ɛde ma. Aban nnwumakuo betumi de nhyehyeɛ mmoa, sika, mmara nhyehyɛeɛ, ne nnwuma a ɛbɛma mmabun adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ nteteeɛ, ne adwumayɛ nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛ mmerɛ. Ɔmanfoɔ nnwumakuo de nnwuma a ɛfa nnipa a wɔte aseɛ, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔboaboa wɔn ano, tumi a wɔbɛma wɔanya, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho nimdeɛ ma de hwɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛka obiara ho, ɛyɛ adwuma, na egyina akwanya ahodoɔ so. Ankorankoro nnwumakuo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no de nnwuma mu nhumu, adwuma a wɔde ma, afotuo, ne sika a wɔde bɛto mu ba pon no so, na ɛma nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne gua so ahwehwɛdeɛ, sikasɛm mu nkɔsoɔ, ne adwumawuranom ahiadeɛ hyia. Nhomasua asoɛe ahorow de adesua nhyehyɛe, mfiridwuma ho ntetee, adansedi nhyehyɛe, ne akwanya ahorow a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔyɛ adwuma ma mmabun de ahokokwaw, adansedi nkrataa, ne osuahu a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfata ma adwumayɛ ho gua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si sɛ wubenya nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wo wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ ho ma wɔn a wɔresi sɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si koraa sɛ wubenya nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wo wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Mmabunbere yɛ bere a wohwehwɛ wo nipadua, wo nkate, ne nneɛma a ɛtwetwe wo a ɛresakra no mu na wote ase. Nea enti a ebia wubenya nsɛmmisa ni: Apɛde a ɛne sɛ wubehu nneɛma pii: Mmabunbere de nkate ne osuahu foforo ba, na ɛma obi nya nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ, ne nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo Nkɛntɛnso: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, a sini, TV so dwumadi, ne sohyial media ka ho, taa da abusuabɔ ne nna ho mfonini wɔ akwan horow so, na ɛkanyan nsemmisa anaa ɔpɛ sɛ wohu nneɛma pii. Atipɛnfo Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wo ne w’atipɛnfo bɔ fa wɔn suahu anaa wɔn nkate ho no betumi akanyan nsɛmmisa ne anigye a ɛfa w’ankasa wo nna ho. Ankorankoro a Wohu: Mmabunbere yɛ bere a wuhu wo ho, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobɛte wo nna ho akɔnnɔ, wo bɔbeasu, ne nea wo ho tɔ wo wɔ abusuabɔ mu ase. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu sɛ obiara akwantu a ɔde hu ne nna na ɔhwehwɛ abusuabɔ mu no yɛ soronko. Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ nsɛm afi mmeae a wogye di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din. Abusuabɔ mu a wobɛfa so akɔ so na woate wo nna ho ntease ase wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no yɛ ade a ɛfata wɔ onyin mu. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubenya nsɛmmisa, na nsɛm ne mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no betumi aboa wo ma woafa wo nkɔso fã a ɛho hia yi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wonya nsusuwii a ɛmu yɛ duro wo bere a ɛhyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa abusuabɔ, nna, ne awo ho paw ho no?
answer_twi_source: Fa bere susu wo nneyɛɛ ho a wubenya no hia wo bere a wuhyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa abusuabɔ, nna, ne awoɔ ho paw ho no efisɛ ɛma wunya tumi sɛ wugye nsusuwii ahorow ho kyim, kasa tia nsusuwii hunu, na wugyina adanse ne atemmu a ntease wom so si gyinae sen sɛ wubegyina nkɛntɛnso a efi afoforo hɔ nkutoo so. Ɛma wutumi si so dua sɛ wowɔ ahofadi na wopaw nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ m’amammerɛ mu gyidi anaa atetesɛm ne ntease a mewɔ wɔ nna a ahoɔden wum ho bɔ abira nso ɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛnya nsɛmmisa: Hwehwɛ nteaseɛ a ɛwɔ w’amammerɛ mu gyidie ne wo atetesɛm akyi. Fa w’adwene si nea ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow hyia so: So wubetumi anya w’amammerɛ no afa horow a ɛfoa nna a ɛfata so (sɛ nhwɛso no, nkitahodi, obu)? Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa nyamesom kannifo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso betumi de akwankyerɛ ama. Kae sɛ w’apomoden ho hia: Fa nna mu nneyɛe a ɛfata te sɛ pene ne ahobammɔ di kan, sɛ mpo amammerɛ mu ntawntawdi bi wɔ hɔ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a ɛhyɛ LGBTQ+ nnipa a wɔwɔ mmusua ne wɔn nipasu ahorow suahu ho afahyɛ? (nhoma, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, wɛbsaet ahorow).
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hyeɛ pa a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛtena nnamfofa anaa awareɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi akyerɛ nea mehwɛ kwan ne me penedie mu pefee a obu wom akyerɛ me dɔfo?
answer_twi_source: Ahye a ɛfata wɔ ɔdɔ kwanso anaa nna mu abusuabɔ mu bi ne sɛ obiara bu wɔn ho wɔn ho, wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nkitaho, na pene pa. Ka w’akwanhwɛ ne w’ahye ho asɛm pefee na fa obu kyerɛ wo hokafo, susuw nsɛmti te sɛ honam fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, nkitahodi a wopɛ, ne abusuabɔ mu botae ahorow ho. Tie wo hokafo no ahye ne nea ɔpɛ denneennen, na fa nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware di kan na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn na wobu wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me nne akasa akyerɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ me mpɔtamu hɔ? (ɔkɔ nhyiam ahorow ase, ɔkyerɛw nkrataa kɔma mmarahyɛ baguafo)
answer_twi_source: Fa sukuu ayarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmaabun adamfofa anaasɛ mmabun apomoden akuo a ɛwɔ sukuu ahorow mu no so kasa ama kyerɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya pɛpɛpɛ yɛ wɔ m’ankasa m’ahiade ne ahofadi ne me hokafo a ɔwɔ ayɔnkofa mu no de mu?
answer_twi_source: Nim wo ho: Te w’ankasa w’ahiade, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneɛma a wode di kan no ase. Nkitahodi a Wobue: Wo ne wo hokafo nni nkitaho pefee fa w’ahiade ho na tie wɔn de. Nsiesiei: Hwehwɛ sɛnea wobɛkari pɛ denam nsɛm bi a wobɛma wo ho so na woabu wo ho mo ho ahofadi so. Kura Ankorankoro Su Mu: Di w’ankasa w’anigyede, w’anigyede, ne nnamfofa a ɛnyɛ abusuabɔ no ho nkuran. Bu Nsonsonoe: Bu obu sɛ ebia wo ne wo hokafo no wɔ ahiade ne adwene soronko.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ nimdie ne ntease a ɛho hia na ama wɔapene aduroyɛ mu akwan horow ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a wobebisa na wɔahwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wobenya afi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ wɔ sɛnea wɔahu wɔn yare, ayaresa a wobetumi apaw, ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba no so. Nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wotumi gye di, te sɛ akwahosan ho akuo ahorow a agye din, nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu, ne website ahorow a wogye di. Wɔn a wo ne mpanyimfo, atipɛnfo, anaa afotufo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobetumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama no asusuw wɔn haw ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow ho. Bere a wobegye de asusuw nea wɔpaw ho na wosusuw nkɛntɛnso a wɔn gyinaesi ahorow betumi anya wɔ wɔn akwahosan, yiedi, ne daakye botae ahorow so no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen anaa anohyeto ahorow bi a ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no hyia wɔ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu dwumadiɛ a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen betumi ayɛ: Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobedu nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ nkyɛn. Nneɛma kakraa bi a wɔde boaboa nsɛm ano na wɔhwehwɛ mu. Nkate a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti ho. Adwumayɛfoɔ tumi ne nteteeɛ ahiadeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu. Nnwinnade ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu no fata amammerɛ ne kasa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛkyerɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdi mu a ɛfa STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔaka abom ho wɔ mpɔtam anaa aman ahodoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun-Ayarehwɛbea ahorow: Saa ayarehwɛbea yi ma mmabun nsa ka mmoa ahorow a ɛfata wɔn mfeɛ, te sɛ nna mu yareɛ (STI) ne HIV sɔhwɛ, afutuo a ɛfa kwan a wɔfa so si awoɔ kwan ho, adwene mu akwahosan ho mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ mu wɔ honam mu daa; ne nyinaa kɔ so wɔ beaeɛ a mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔgye wɔn tom. Sukuu mu Ayaresabea ahorow: Saa ayaresabea yi ma nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa kwan a wɔfa so si STI ne HIV kwan, sɔhwɛ, ne afutuo dwumadie wɔ sukuu mu, na ama asuafoɔ atumi anya akwahosan ho mmoa ntɛm. Mpɔtam Akwahosan Adwumayɛfo Dwumadie: Akwahosan adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn kɔ afie-afie kɔma nkyerɛkyerɛ, sɔhwɛ, ne afutuo dwumadie; eyi ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔte mmeaeɛ a ɛhɔ yɛ sum anaa mmeaeɛ a mmoa nni hɔ no nsa ka nkyerɛkyerɛ. Abɛɛfo ntentan so dwumadie ma kwan ma dɔkotanom ne nkurɔfoɔ di nkɔmmɔ kɔ akyiri, ɛma nkurɔfoɔ nsa ka sɔhwɛ-nnaka a wɔde sɔ wɔn ho hwɛ, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mmoa; eyi trɛw STI ne HIV ahobammɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, titiriw wɔ nkuraaseɛ mmeaeɛ a mmoa nni hɔ. Nna mu ne Awoɔ mu Akwahosan Mmoa a Wɔaka abom: Awoɔ ho ayaresabea ahorow ma ayaresa a ɛka abom a ɛfa STI ne HIV ho, awoɔ si kwan, awoɔ ho ahosiesie, mogyagu (abortion) dwumadie, ne ɛnanom akwahosan ho mmoa; na eyi ama mmabun anya mmoa a ɛmu dɔ wɔ akwan biara mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ma atenka sesa sesa  bere a meyɛ bra?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ wo babunbere mu no, wo nipadua no nya nipadua mu nsesae kɛse esiane nkwaadɔm a ɛsakrasakra nti. Saa nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae yi nso betumi aka wo atenka ne wo atenka. Nkwammoaa a ɛma nipadua no nya ahoɔden te sɛ   nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ estrogen ne testosterone a ɛkɔ soro no betumi ama obi ate nka sɛ ne ho yeraw no, ne bo fuw, na ne nkate mu yɛ den. Saa adwene mu nsesae yi yɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere fã a ɛfata bere a wo nipadua no yɛ nsesae wɔ nsakrae no mu no. Akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano no bi ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔyɛ daa, ahomegye ne nna, aduan a aduannuru pii wom a wobedi, ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde home a emu dɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so de mfididwuma ne abɛɛfo mfidie nkitahodi di dwuma wɔ asɛdeɛ ɛsɛ mu wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe: Hwɛ kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so no mu daa na yɛ nsakraeɛ. Susu ho Ansa na Wobɛkyɛ: Gyina kakra na hwɛ nsusuansoɔ a wo nsɛm anaa nkrasɛm ahodoɔ no betumi de aba . Kasa a Obu wom: Fa ayamye ne obu kasa di dwuma wɔ ntentanfidie so, na kwati ayayade anaa ɔhaw. Ahyeɛ: To ahyeɛ fa wɔn a wobetumi ne wo adi nkitaho ne nsɛm a wokyɛ ho. Hwɛ Nsɛm a Ɛyɛ Nokwasɛm: Yɛ ahwɛyie wɔ w’ankasa ho nsɛm a wobɛka anaa sɛ worehyia nkurɔfoɔ wɔ Intentanfidie no so ho. Kari pɛ: Hwɛ sɛ nkitahodi a ɛwɔ ntentanfidie so ne nea ɛnyɛ ntentanfidie so no yɛ pɛ ma asetena mu nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpanyimfo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ tebea horow a ɛboa a ɛma mmabun nya kyɛfa a ntease wom ne akannifo hokwan ahorow wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee, afotu, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma de ama mmabun nimdeɛ ne ahotoso anya nkɔso. Mmabun nne a wɔde nsiyɛ tie, obu a wɔde ma wɔn adwene, na wobu wɔn ntoboa ahorow no sɛ ɛsom bo. Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛbɔ ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee, baabi a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔate wɔn asɛm, wobu wɔn, na wɔboa wɔn. Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ mmabun ananmusifoɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ gyinaesie akuo, nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛɛ a ɛfa wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bɛn na mmabun hyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ, wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛko ama nna ne awo hokwan ahorow mu no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow te sɛ nsɛm ne nneɛma a wonnya, animtiaabu ne nyiyim, tumi a ɛnkari pɛ, hokwan kakraa bi a wobenya sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne ɔsɔretia a efi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ katee anaa agyanom mpanyimfo de hɔ. Wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan bi te sɛ; nhomasua, tumi a wɔbɛma, nkitahodi ahorow a ɛboa a wɔbɛkyekye, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi anya mfe a obi adi ho mmara a wɔde bedi dwuma anaa wɔakyerɛ ase wɔ tebea horow bi mu no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow betumi anya mfe a obi adi ho mmara a wɔde bedi dwuma anaa wɔakyerɛ ase so nsunsuanso wɔ tebea horow bi mu, a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ɔmanfo adwene wɔ nna ho, ne mmarahyɛfo ne mmarahyɛ baguafo adwempa ka ho. Wobetumi asusuw mfe a wɔbɛn wɔn ho a wɔayi afi mu, a wɔsan frɛ no Romeo ne Juliet mmara, ho wɔ nsɛm a mfe a nsonsonoe a ɛda ahokafo ntam no sua na ankorankoro baanu no nyinaa bɛn mfe a wɔadi no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na metumi de nkitahodie asiesie akasakasa bere a mereyɛ anyin?
answer_twi_source: Tena dinn: home denden senea woho bɛdwo, enma watenka enfa woso. Da watenka adi a wobɔ ɔbi suborɔ. nhwɛso: 'me te apɔ sɛ...' hwehwɛ ntease wɔ wohwere adeɛ: hwehwɛ anosɔ bom, hwehwɛ fam koro. Twe woho firi ntorɔ: teka asem no so, ɛni nnipa no nko. Nnipa a w'aso asi na ɔm'ani ɛfiratumi siesie wɔn ntawatawa sɛ nkitahodie ne wɔn hiade fa bere a wotena dinn, obuo mu n'adwen si ano sɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛhyehyɛ ɔmanfoɔ bammɔ dwumadie  a ɛma mmabun nya kwan ka wɔn asɛm na wɔsisi gyinaeɛ wɔ wɔn brabo ho?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyeɛ bɛtumi ahyɛ mmabun kyɛfa, nne, ne dwumadie ho nkuran wɔ: Wɔde akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho akwan bɛka nhyehyɛeɛ , dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Mmabun afotufoɔ kuo, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, anaa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de ama mmuaeɛ, adwene, ne akanni wɔ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Ntetee, tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, ne akannifoɔ nkɔsoɔ hokwan a wɔde bɛma mmabun de ahokokwaa ne ahotosoɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn hokwan ne wɔn anigyeɛ ho ban Hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nnoɔma a ɛda adi pefee, wɔbɛbu akontaa, ne mmuaeɛ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no sohwɛ ne dwumadie mu de anya ahotosoɔ ne mmara kwan so amor mmabun a wɔnya mu mfasoɔ. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde mmabun ne mmerante ne mmabaa ka ho fi mfiase
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛe no susu mmabun a wɔde ne nnwuma adi dwuma no abotɔyam dodow?
answer_twi_source: Wosusu abotɔyam denam: Abotɔyam nhwehwɛmu a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔne nhyehyɛe no adi nkitaho akyi. Nsɛm a wɔka fa akwan a ɛnyɛ ɔkwan pa so te sɛ telefon so frɛ anaa email so a wɔbɛhwɛ so. Nea efi mu ba te sɛ nsrahwɛ a wɔsan kɔ anaa nkamfo fi wɔn anya ɔhwɛpa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛtaa ba a, mmabun betumi ahyia, na dɛn ne nea ɛde ba ne  asiane ɛwɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛtaa ba mmabun so no bi ne: Nna mu Nyarewa (STIs): Mmoawa, anaa mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbae a wɔnam nna mu nkitahodi so de ba. Nneɛma a ɛde asiane ba ne nna a wɔmfa ahobammɔ mma, nna mu ahokafo pii, ne kɔndɔm a wɔmfa nni dwuma bere nyinaa. Brayɛ mu Nsɛnnennen: Tebea horow te sɛ nna a ɛnkɔ so daa, mogya a ɛtɔ kɛse (menorrhagia), ne bra a ɛyɛ yaw (dysmenorrhea). Ebia nea ɛde ba no bi ne hormone a ɛnkari pɛ, aduruyɛ mu tebea horow a ɛhyɛ ase, anaa asetra mu nneɛma. Nyinsɛn a Wɔanhyɛ da: Ɛba bere a nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no ntumi nyɛ adwuma yiye anaasɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye no. Nneɛma a ɛde asiane ba ne nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban, nyinsɛn ano a wonnya, nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ nnim ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu a 'HIV/AIDS' ka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfomso bɛn na nkurɔfo taa di berɛ a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano redi dwuma no bi?
answer_twi_source: Mfomso ahorow bi a nkurɔfo taa di bere a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano redi dwuma ni: Wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa: Ɔkwan bi a wɔmfa nni dwuma bere biara a wo ne obi bɛda, titiriw wɔ akwanside akwan te sɛ kɔndɔm ho. Sɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛmfata so: Akwankyerɛ a wonni akyi yiye, te sɛ kɔndɔm ano a worenkura anaasɛ worennom nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano bere koro mu da biara. Nna a ɛbɛba awiei a wɔrenhwɛ: Ebia kɔndɔm anaa nnuru a wɔde kum mmadwoa a ne bere atwam no rentumi nyɛ adwuma. Kɔndɔm a wɔde kum mmadwoa nni dwuma: Nnuru a wɔde kum mmadwoa nkutoo ntumi nyɛ adwuma yiye. Fa di dwuma ne kɔndɔm ho na ama woanya ahobammɔ foforo. Nnuru afoforo a wɔne nnuru afoforo bedi nkitaho ho a wonsusuw ho: Nnuru bi betumi ne awo ano aduru a ahoɔdennuru wom adi nkitaho, na ɛtew sɛnea etu mpɔn no so. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa na woakwati saa mfomso ahorow yi na hwɛ hu sɛ wode ɔkwan a woapaw no redi dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa akuo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmoa akuw, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a wɔde wɔhwɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne hokwan ahorow so wɔ hɔ. Saa akuo yi betumi de nsɛm, atipɛnfo mmoa, afotu, nsɛm a wɔka de akyerɛ, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ovaries, uterus, fallopean tubes, awotwaa, vagina, ne vulva dwumadi?
answer_twi_source: Mmea awo nhyehyɛe no wɔ akwaa ahorow pii a ɛbom yɛ adwuma ma awoɔ ne brayɛ (bere). Hwɛ yie: Ovaries: Saa akwaa abien a ɛte sɛ almond yi ma nkosua (ova) ne hormone te sɛ estrogen ne progesterone. Awotwaa: Saa akwaa a ɛte sɛ pear yi ne baabi a nkosua a wɔahyɛ no ma de nkosua hyɛ nipadua mu na akokoaa nyin bere a wanyinsɛn no. Awotoa no mu ntini no tew bere a obi rekɔ brayɛ mu sɛ nyinsɛn ansi a. Fallopian Tubes: Saa ntini yi na ɛka ovaries ne uterus no bom. Mpɛn pii no, awotwaa, baabi a mmadwoa hyia nkesua no, wɔ awotwaa mu. Vagina: Saa ntini mu kwan yi ne awo kwan ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya nna mu kyɛfa ne brayɛ. Vulva: Eyi ne ɔbea awotoa no akyi fã, a nea ɛka ho ne clitoris (anigye mfinimfini), labia (honam ani a wɔabobɔw), ne ɔbea awotoa a mbueyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ne asɛyɛde bɛn na mmabun wɔ bere a wɔrenya adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" ho nhyehyɛe no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ ahofadi "autonomy" wɔ gyinaesi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan ahorow bere a wɔrenya adwenem ahokwasan ho nhyehyɛe "mental health services" ahorow no, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm sie ka ho. Wɔwɔ hokwan nso sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn amanneɛ wɔ ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn hwɛ ho mu. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ mmabun te ase sɛ wɔwɔ asɛyɛde ahorow nso, te sɛ nokwaredi a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn adwenemyare ho ɔyaresafo, ayaresa ho nyansahyɛ ahorow a wobedi akyi, ne obu a wobedi afoforo hokwan ahorow. Mmabun betumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ ahofadi wɔ gyinaesi mu denam nsɛm a wobebisa, nea wɔpɛ ne nea ɛhaw wɔn a wɔbɛda no adi, ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wonni wɔn hokwan ahorow so a. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa na wɔde obu ne nidi di wo ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ atumfoɔ anaa nhyehyɛefo betumi adi wɔ asasesin mu akwanside "geographical barriers" ahorow a ɛmma mmabun nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ atumfoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ asasesin mu akwansideɛ a ɛmma mmabun nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ no ho dwuma wv ɔkwan bi sei so: Sika a wɔde bɛto nnwuma ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma mu de ama akwantuo akwan a wɔbɛfa so atu mpɔn, titire wɔ nkuraaseɛ anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔnyɛ adwuma yie. Nhyehyeɛ ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de aboa ayaresabea a wɔde fa ahomatrofo so, ahomatrofo so akwahosan ho dwumadie, ne akwan foforɔ foforɔ a wɔbɛfa so ama akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya no akɔ soro. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mmabun ananmusifoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahunu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya mu na wɔayɛ ano aduru a wɔde asi wɔn ani so. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun akwahosan ne pɛyɛ di kan wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, a sika a wɔbɛkyekyɛ ne mmara mu nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ de adi asasesin mu nsonsonoe ho dwuma ka ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ obi atenka bɛdanedane berɛ a w'adru mmabunyɛ berɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si. Saa nsesaeɛ tumi ma w'tenka di adaneadane. Mmerɛ bi wɔ hɔ w'ani bɛgye, berɛ bi so wo bo befu. Te wo ho ase sɛ wei ɛnnyɛ ade bɔne. Hwɛ wo nipadua so yiye, didi yiye, na mmannom coffee so wɔ berɛ ɛte saa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden na wɔn a wɔresi sɔ bɛ yɛ sɛ wɔn awofo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu dodo anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn so wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔdie; Dan ɔdɔ atinka bɔkɔ di ne obu so, na kyerɛkyerɛ hiadeɛ a ehia sɛ obi yɛ kokoamu nsɛm pii no mu. Ahye a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Munsusuw ahye a ntease wom a ɛbɛma woanya kokoam nsɛm ne ahofadi ho ho nkɔmmɔ. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Wo ne ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa na woanya afotu ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’abusuafo ne me nnamfo aka kwan foforo a meresusu ho no ho asɛm? (nkitahodi ho afotu) .
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi Ho Afotu: Paw bere ne beae a wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho bɛtɔ wo sɛ wobɛda wo nsusuii adi pefee na woadi nokware. Fa W’adwene Si Wo Atenka So: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo tebea no mu ne sɛnea wote nka wɔ ɔkwan biara a wubetumi afa so no ho. Tie Wɔn Dadwen: Ma w’adɔfo kwan ma wɔnka wɔn nsusuwii ne wɔn atenka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne osuahu anaa nsɛnnennen a mmabun a wɔn nnipadua atɔ sin hyia, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Asisifo ne Nyiyimu: Sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi de nhyehyɛe ne nhomasua a ɛko tia asisifo adi dwuma. Abusua Pow: Mmoa nkitahodi ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm no betumi aboa sɛ wohyia pow a. Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Apereperedi: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nnwuma ne mmoa akuw a wobenya no ho hia. Mmara kwan so Hokwan ahorow: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ne hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm wɔ ho a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no betumi adi nyiyim ho dwuma. Ananmusifoɔ a Wɔnni: Sɛ wɔhyɛ ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ ho nkuran wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nwomasua mu a, ɛbɛtumi ama tebea a ɛbɛka nnipa nyinaa aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahyeɛ a ɛfata a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde si ɔdɔ anaa honam fam abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Physical boundaries: Obu a wobɛkyerɛ wɔ ankorankoro atenae ne nsa a obi bɛka wo ho, a wo ho tɔ wo (atuu, woso nsam, mfeano). Atenka mu ahyeɛ: Wo atenks a wobɛka ho asɛm nanso woanya kokoamsɛm nso ama w’ankasa nsusuwii ne nkate ahorow. Berɛ mu hyetoɛ: Bere a wubenya ama wo ho, nnamfo, abusua, ne dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, bere a wo ne wo hokafo nso nya bere pa. Nkitahodi ahyɛ: Nim a wobehu sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ wodi nkitaho ne bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi nkitaho, na wɔkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho hia a wohia baabi a ɛtɔ mmere bi. Social media hye: Wobesi dodow anaa kakraa bi a wobɛka afa w’abusuabɔ ho wɔ Intanɛt so ho gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim a ama nkurɔfo ate ase, aboaboa mmoa ano, na anya ɔmanfo kasa so nkɛntɛnso wɔ ASRH nsɛmti te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, awo hokwan ahorow, ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ho nhwɛso ahorow bi a edii yiye?
answer_twi_source: Ɔsatuo a Ɛdi Mu: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdi mu wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho ɔsatuo a mmabun di anim a ama nkurɔfo ate ase, aboaboa mmoa ano, na anya ɔmanfoɔ kasa so nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ ASRH nsɛmti te sɛ pene, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ, awo hokwan, ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔsiw ano ho. Nhwɛsoɔ, ɔsatu ahorow te sɛ #MeToo ne #TimesUp ama wiase nyinaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe ne ɔtowhyɛ ho aba, na ama wɔn a ɛto wɔn no tumi kasa na wɔhwehwɛ nsakrae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna mu yareɛ  (STI ) a wobehu no betumi aka m’adwene mu akwahosan? (dadwen, aniwu, ehu) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wohu sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ  (STI) a, ebetumi aka w’adwene akwahosan wɔ akwan horow pii so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Dadwen: Ebia wobɛhaw wo ho wɔ w’akwahosan, daakye, anaasɛ wobɛka akyerɛ wo hokafo (hokafo) ho. Aniwu: Ebia wobɛte aniwu nka anaasɛ wɔabu wo atɛn, ɛwom mpo sɛ STI abu so kɛse de. Ehu: Ebia wusuro sɛ wubehyia nsɛnnennen, ayaresa, anaa pow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne asɛyɛde ahorow a wɔn a wɔkamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ wɔ hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔn mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo no ka nnipa nyinaa ho, ɛkyerɛ obu, egyina adanse so, na ɛfa mmabun nyinaa ahiade ne hokwan ahorow ho, a wɔn a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ mu ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ Pa Ho Nsusuwii: Wɔn a wɔkamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw no wɔ abrabɔ pa ho asɛyɛde ahorow sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔn mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo no ka obiara ho, ɛkyerɛ obu, egyina adanse so, na ɛfa mmabun nyinaa ahiade ne hokwan ahorow ho, a wɔn a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ mu ka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nneɛma ahorow, pɛyɛ, ne nkabom di kan wɔ wɔn nkrasɛm ne nkitahodi mmɔdenbɔ mu, bere a wɔsan nso kura abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nea ɛda adi pefee, akontaabu ne amammerɛ mu nkate ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmɔdenbɔ a yɛdima amanneɛbɔfo adinkanfo  ɛfa mmaabun a wɔadi dɛm nna ho mfonini atu mpɔn na wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu a epira?
answer_twi_source: Bere a mmara mu anohyeto ahorow wɔ Ghana no, mmɔdenbɔ ahorow bi a ɛkɔ so sɛ wɔbɛma mmubuafo ananmusifo atu mpɔn wɔ wiase nyinaa ni: Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Ntetee: Nhyiam a wɔyɛ ma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo de yɛ dɛmdi ho mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware. Crowdfunding Platforms: Wɔboa sini ne ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow a ɛfa agoruyɛfo a wɔadi dɛm ne nsɛm ho. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Sini Afahyɛ: Nhyiam ase a wɔde sini ahorow a mmubuafo yɛ ne nea ɛfa ho kyerɛ (sɛ nhwɛso no, ReelAbilities Sini Afahyɛ). Wobɛyɛ Dɛn Atumi De aboa? Boa Nnwuma a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Dedaw: Di ɔsatu ahorow yi akyi na sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a, kyɛ wɔn nkrasɛm. Wɔhwehwɛ Nsakrae: Ma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nhu sɛ wopɛ sɛ wuhu dɛmdi ho mfonini ahorow a egu ahorow na ɛka obiara ho. Kamfo Nhyehyɛe mu Nsakrae: Boa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma mmara kwan so tebea a ɛbɛma ananmusifo atrɛw wɔ Ghana aba. Ɛdenam adwuma a yɛbom yɛ so no, yebetumi apiapia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea a ɛhyɛ mmubuafo nne ne wɔn nsɛm ho afahyɛ wɔ baabiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwankyerɛ ahorow bi a awofo betumi de asi hɔ de aboa mmaabun ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow a wɔde di dwuma ho, a nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, bere a wɔde ahyɛ wɔn nsa, ne ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwankyerɛ a awofo betumi de asi hɔ no bi ne: Mmara ne akwanhwɛ a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ a ɛfa bere anohyeto a wɔde ma wɔ screen so, mfiri a wɔde di dwuma, ne intanɛt so nneyɛe ho, a wosusuw mmabun mfe, wɔn ho akokwaw, ne ankorankoro ahiade ahorow ho. Awofo nhyehyɛe ne kokoamu nsɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwɛ na wɔahwɛ sɛnea wobetumi anya Intanɛt so nsɛm, ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nneɛma a ɛfata wɔn mfe mu na wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban afi nneɛma a ebetumi apira wɔn anaasɛ ɛmfata ho. Abusua apam anaa apam ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a ɛkyerɛ akwanhwɛ, asɛyɛde, ne nea efi mu ba a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ho, a mmara a ɛfa nkitahodi a obu wom, abɛɛfo ntetan abrabɔ pa, ne kɔmputa so ahobammɔ ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de ahye a ɛfata asi hɔ na wɔakura mu wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu de abɔ wɔn ho ban afi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de ahye a ɛfata asi hɔ na wɔakura mu denam wɔn ankasa ahiade, nkate, ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu a wobehu na wɔabu wɔn no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wɔne ahokafo bedi nkitaho pefee na wofi nokwaredi mu, de ahye a emu da hɔ atwa honam fam ne nkate fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ho ahyia, na wɔayɛ katee wɔ nea wɔpɛ ne wɔn ahye a wɔbɛda no adi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nsonsonoe anaa abirabɔ a ɛda amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne ɔman mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ntam ano die?
answer_twi_source: Nsonsonoeɛ anaa nneɛma a ɛntwa kwan mu a ɛda amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne ɔman mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ ntam no bɛtumi de nsunsuansoɔ kɛseɛ aba, a nea ɛka ho ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma kakraa bi, nnwuma a wɔmfa nni dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ, ne nnipa hokwan a wɔbu so. Ɔman mmara a wɔbɛma ne amanaman ntam gyinapɛn ahorow ahyia no ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔabɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow ho ban na wɔadi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na ɛsono mmara a ɛfa GBV ho a egyina beae a mewɔ (kurow, ɔman, ɔman) so? (hia a mpɔtam hɔ mmara ho hia) .
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛfa GBV ho no gu ahorow wɔ mmeae ahorow. Nea enti a ɛho hia ni: Hokwan ahorow a Wobɛhu: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo kurow, mantam, ne ɔman mu a wobɛte ase no ho hia yie. Nneɛma a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie ma ɛne mmara pɔtee a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no ahyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo me ho na maka m’ahiade ne nea mepɛ ho asɛm wɔ afotu anaa ayaresa bere mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo ho a wobɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ afotu anaa ayaresa bere mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛka w’ahiade, nea wopɛ, ne ahye ahorow ho asɛm pefee na woayɛ no pen. Wubetumi afi ase denam botae ahorow a wode besisi w’ani so wɔ ayaresa ho na woada nea wohwɛ kwan wɔ adeyɛ no ho adi no so. Di nokware wɔ nea ɛreyɛ adwuma ama wo ne nea ɛnyɛ adwuma no ho, na sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa, nsɛm a ɛhaw wo, anaa adwene a enhyia a, nsuro sɛ wobɛkasa. Wo fotufo anaa ɔyaresafo wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa wo, na wo nsɛm a wode bɛma no som bo wɔ w’ayaresa nhyehyɛe a wobɛhyehyɛ na woahwɛ ahu sɛ ayaresa no tu mpɔn ma wo no mu. Kae sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde obu ne nidi di wo ho dwuma, na wo nne ho hia wɔ ayaresa no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma bi a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anaa akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua titiriw?
answer_twi_source: Mmeaeɛ pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ, a abɛfo ntentan so mmoa (digital safe space), nkɔmɔdie (chat), ne telefon namba (hotlines) ka ho ma mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa ne amanneɛbɔ fa nna mu apɔwmuden ne yiedie ho:Agoo she+: (Abɛfo nneɛma a UNICEF ayɛ).UNICEF hotline: Frɛ 5100 (ma wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma).PPAG hotline: Frɛ 0800202010.WhatsApp: Twa krataa tiawa kɔ 0245118228.Ghana Apɔwmuden Dwumadibea (Ghana Health Service):Wɔma nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa, nneɛma, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ fa nsɛm te sɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu, nyinsɛn ho banbɔ (contraception), nteaseɛ mu tumidie (consent), ne abusuabɔ pa ho.Marie Stopes/UNFPA:Wɔma nna mu apɔwmuden ho amanneɛbɔ a emu dɔ, nkrataa, ne mmeaeɛ a wɔbɔ nkɔmɔ a wɔasiesie no titiriw ma mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ, a ɛfa nsɛm te sɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na me nna mu akwaa te soronko?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si sɛ nna mu akwaa bɛyɛ soronko wɔ mpanin mu kɔ mu. Ma mmarima no, wɔn hwoa ne kɔte bɛyɛ kɛse na ayɛ tenten. Ma mmaa no, wɔn labia (awotwaa no akyi ne mu "anofafa") no kɛse ne ne tebea betumi asesa. Obiara nna mu akwaa yɛ soronko, te sɛ yɛn nipadua afa afoforo no ara. Mpanin mu kɔ yɛ berɛ a nsakraeɛ yi da adi kɛse, nanso ne nyinaa yɛ wo nipadua a ɛrenyin na ɛreyɛ panyin no fa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnuru bɛn na ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi de adi dwuma, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka amemene ne nkate fam yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru a wɔtaa de di dwuma a mmabun betumi de adi dwuma no bi ne nsa, wii, tawa, nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, ne nnubɔne a mmara mma ho kwan te sɛ cocaine anaa ecstasy. Ade biara wɔ n’ankasa nkɛntɛnso wɔ amemene no ne nkate mu yiyedi so. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Nsã betumi ama ntini a ɛwɔ nipadua no mfinimfini no ayɛ basaa, na ama obi ntumi nhu nneɛma yiye, n’adwene sakra, na asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obenya adwenemhaw no akɔ soro. Wii betumi aka nkae, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, ne nea ɛkanyan obi, na ebetumi ama obi ayɛ basaa anaasɛ wayɛ basaa. Nicotine a ɛwɔ tawa mu no betumi ama adwennwen ne dadwen dodow akɔ soro, na bere tenten a wɔde di dwuma no ne adwenemhaw ho asiane a ɛkɔ soro wɔ abusuabɔ. Nnuru a ɛkanyan adwene te sɛ cocaine anaa amphetamines betumi ama obi anya anigye na ahoɔden akɔ soro mfiase no, nanso ebetumi ama obi ayɛ basaa, ne ho yeraw no, na wayɛ basaa nso bere a ɔde di dwuma bere tenten no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ahorow nya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (sexual health reproductie) ne wɔn nneyɛe so nsunsuanso wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ahorow nya nsunsuanso wɔ ankorankoro gyidi, gyinapɛn ahorow, , ne atetesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo ho nhyehyɛe no so. Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe yɛ soronko wɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu, na ɛda suban ne nneyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, aware, ne nna ho adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim betumi adi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛko tia wim tebea a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di wɔn anim no bɛtumi adi dwuma titire wɔ SRH dwumadie a ɛtumi gyina wimu tebea ano a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam denam atipɛnfoɔ a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano, wɔayɛ nhyiamu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, ano aduru foforɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma, ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔbɛma ayɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mekɔ oduruyɛfo hɔ anaa ayaresabea a, ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔbɔ me kokoam nsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde kokoam nsɛm ho mmara ne adwumayɛfo mmara bɔ kokoam nsɛm ho ban wɔ akwahosan ho. Wɔatete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo  sɛ wɔmfa ayarefo ho nsɛm nsie na wonni abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ahorow akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ (anɔpa-akyi aduru) na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn? (Hyɛ no nsow: Si so dua sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano daa)
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm a broni ka no 'emergency contraception' a wotawso ka no (EC), a wɔsan frɛ no "anɔpa akyi aduru" yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi. Ɛnyɛ nea wɔahyɛ da ayɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano daa. Sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma: 'EC' yɛ adwuma denam broni ka no 'ovulation' a ɛkyɛ (nkesua mugyae) anaasɛ 'fertilization' a esiw ano (mmoadowa ɛhyia awo nkesua) so. Ɛyɛ nea etu mpɔn kɛse bere a wofa no ntɛm wɔ nna akyi, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye no, ɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 72 (nnafua 3). Ɛho hia sɛ wokae: 'EC' ntumi nyɛ adwuma yiye sɛ woanyinsɛn dedaw a. Ɛremmɔ wo ho ban mfi nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho. Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa nnuruyɛfo nkasa na woanya nsɛm pii na woanya 'EC'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nipadua ho mfonini a enye betumi aka adwenemyare, abusuabɔ, ne asetra pa ho nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ho mfonini a enye betumi anya nsunsuaso kɛse wɔ adwenemyare, abusuabɔ, ne asetra pa nyinaa so: Adwene mu Akwahosan: Nipadua ho mfonini a enye no ne asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obi benya adwenemhaw, dadwen, adidi mu haw, ne adwenemyare afoforo wɔ abusuabɔ. Abusuabɔ: Nipadua ho mfonini a enye betumi aka abusuabɔ denam nnipa a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi afoforo ho, ɔhaw ahorow a ɛba wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mu, ne nkitahodi mu nsɛnnennen a ɛde ba no so. Asetra Pa: Nipadua ho mfonini a enye betumi asɛe da biara da dwumadi, atew anigye a obi wɔ wɔ dwumadi ahorow mu no so, na ama asetra mu abotɔyam nyinaa so atew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea dijitaal tumidi nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan, na asuade bɛn na yebetumi asua afi mu?
answer_twi_source: Digitals tumidi nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne: YOLO TV so dwumadi ahorow, a ɛde video ahorow a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi na ɛyɛ anigye a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho ma mmerante ne mmabaa. Intanɛt so atipɛnfo mmoa nhyiam ahorow a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn na wɔhwɛ so, a ɛma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ sɛ wobebisa nsɛm na wɔanya mmoa. Asuadeɛ a wɔnya firi saa nhyehyɛeɛ yi mu no bi ne hia a ɛhia sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔne abenfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom, ne nhwehwɛmu ne nsakraeɛ a ɛkɔ so de adi ahiadeɛ a ɛrekɔ so no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ papa wɔ amammerɛ ahohorow bi mu betumi aboa ma basabasayɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmabun mu wɔ ayɔnkofa mu? (wɔkasa tia nsusuwii hunu, pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran) .
answer_twi_source: Atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛhyɛ tumidi ho nkuran no betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ basabasa wɔ ayɔnkofa mu. Sɛnea wobɛkasa atia wɔn ni: Hyɛ Pɛyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Kasa ma abusuabɔ pa a wɔde asi obu ne nkitahodi so kyerɛ. Nea broni ka no 'Challenge Stereotypes': Bisa adwene a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ho a ɛto nkitahodi a ahoɔden wom ano hye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm 'emergency contraception' (EC)?
answer_twi_source: Nnuroyɛfo, ayarehwɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo afoforɔ betumi akyerɛw EC bere a wɔrekɔ adwumayɛbea hɔ anaasɛ wɔrekɔ ayaresabea. Nnurotɔnbea: Nnurotɔnbea pii kura nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm a wobetumi atɔ a wɔmfa nnuro nhyɛ mu a wonkyerɛw krataa mma. Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe: Mmabun betumi akɔ ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe anaa awo ho akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow akɔhwehwɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm na wɔanya afotu wɔ sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mate hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano mu ase?
answer_twi_source: Bere a ɔman no mu ahwehwɛde biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ awofo pene so wɔ Ghana no, eyi mu a wobɛfa so no betumi ayɛ basaa. Nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wo ma woate wo hokwan ahorow ase ni: wo ne wo mmabun adamfofa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa wɔ ehalyh adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo Ghana Legal Aid Commission: Wɔde mmara ho afotu ma kwa ma Ghanafo, a mmofra nkumaa ka ho, wɔ tebea horow bi mu. Wubetumi ahu wɔn nkitahodi ho nsɛm ne wɔn a wɔfata ho nhyehyɛe wɔ wɔn wɛbsaet (https://www.lac.gov.gh/).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛboa abusua sikasɛm ho ne sika a wɔbɛsie so?
answer_twi_source: Sie wo sika no bi. Kɔ sukuu na nya adwuma pa yɛ. Boa fie sika nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Aane, aman pii wɔ mmara a ɛbɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no. Saa mmara ahorow yi taa ma mmabun nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔn apɔwmuden ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow anaa mpɔtam hɔ. Wɛbsaet ahorow a wogye di ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma. Nhomasua nneɛma ne nkratawa a wobetumi anya wɔ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Ntrɛwmu anaa telefon a wɔde boa a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi de kokoam nsɛm ne mmoa ama. Nneɛma a atipɛnfo di anim ne akuw a wɔboa no twee adwene sii nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti so. Apps ne dijitaal nnwinnade a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun na wɔama wɔn tumi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔhwɛ a menya wɔ nyinsɛnyigu akyi no yɛ kokoamsɛm, na hokwan bɛn na mewɔ wɔ asumasɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ ɔhwɛ a wonya no nyinsɛnyigu akyi no bɛyɛ kokoamsɛm no: Fa Ɔhwɛfo a Wogye No Di: fa ɔyaresafoɔ anaa ayaresabea a ɛde ayarefoɔ kokoamsɛm di kan na ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Ka Nea Ɛhaw Wo kyerɛ: Ka kokoam nsɛm a ɛhaw wo ho asɛm kyerɛ ɔyaresafo na bisa wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho nhehyɛeɛ. Hu Hokwan a Wowɔ: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, a nyinsɛnyigu aky mui hwɛ ka ho, a awofoɔ pene so wɔ mmeae pii. Hu wo mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa kokoamsɛm a wɔde sie wɔ apɔwmuden ho no yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmɔden bɛn na wɔrebɔ sɛ wɔbɛma ɔman no mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ne akwankyerɛ ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a egyina adanse so a efi amanaman ntam apomoden ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Wiase Nyinaa Apomoden Ahyehyɛde (WHO) ne Amanaman Nkabom Nnipa dodow Foto (UNFPA) hɔ no ahyia?
answer_twi_source: Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma ɔman no mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ne akwankyerɛ ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a egyina adanse so a efi amanaman ntam apomoden ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ no ahyia no bi ne: Nhyehyɛe mu Nhwehwɛmu: Aban ahorow no hwɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no mu de hu nsonsonoe ne nea ɛne amanaman ntam gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia. Akwankyerɛ a Wɔgye tom: Nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ gye akwankyerɛ ne nyansahyɛ a egyina adanseɛ so a ɛfiri ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ WHO ne UNFPA hɔ sɛ nea wɔbɛgyina so ayɛ ɔman no mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ. Tumi a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Aban ahorow de wɔn sika hyɛ tumi a wɔbɛma ayɛ yiye ama nhyehyɛeyɛfo, mmarahyɛ baguafo, ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn amanneɛ wɔ amanaman ntam nneyɛe pa ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho. Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ ne Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛgye amanaman ntam akwankyerɛ atom na wɔde adi dwuma denam nhyehyɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔdie, nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛkyekyɛ, ne nkabom a wɔne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma titire bɛsi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhaw ho afotufo hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun a wɔwɔ ahokyere mu no ahobammɔ ne yiyedi bɛba, a nea ɛka ho ne asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobepira wɔn no ho nhwehwɛmu, nkate fam adanse a wɔde ma, akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano a wɔde ma, na wɔde wɔn bata nneɛma a ɛfata anaa wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ hɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Di Ahotɔ ne Akwahosan Ho Dwuma: Wɔn a wɔkyerɛ afutuo wɔ ahohia berɛ mu (crisis counselors) hwɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ amanehunu mu no ahotɔ ne akwahosan ho, denam wɔn asetena a ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛ anaa asiane mu no ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ so. Wɔma wɔn koma tɔ wɔn, kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi haw no so, na wɔde wɔn kɔ mmoa anaa afutuo ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛfata mu.Wɔde nneɛma a ɛho hia no di kan de si baabi a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo na ɛboa ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa no nya akwanya ka wɔn nsɛm na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa a ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ menom nnuru anaa 'vitamins' biara bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, ɛsɛ sɛ aduan a ɛkare pɛ ma wonya aduannuru a ɛho hia wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Nanso, mmabun binom betumi anya mfaso afi nnuru a wɔde ka aduan ho no mu sɛ wɔwɔ aduan pɔtee bi anohyeto anaa sintɔ ahorow a. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkasa ansa na woafi nnuru biara a wɔde ka aduan ho ase na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛgye wo ansa woanom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na ɛsɛ sɛ mitu kwan na ama manya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan tenten a ɛsɛ sɛ wutu na ama woanya nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina baabi a wote ne akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ so. Wɔ nkurow akɛse mu no, ebia wubehu nnwuma a ɛbɛn fie, bere a wɔ nkuraase no, ebia ebehia sɛ wutu kwan kɔ akyirikyiri. Ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu anaasɛ wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di bɛkasa na woahu beae a ɛbɛn wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma nhomasua ne ntetee boa ma wogyae ohia kyinhyia no na wɔhyɛ asetra mu nkɔso ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma nhomasua ne ntetee boa ma wogyae ohia kyinhyia no denam hokwan ahorow a ɛma mmabun a wofi mmeae a wonnya sika pii nya nhomasua pa, nya nimdeɛ a wobetumi atɔn, na wɔama wɔn adwumayɛ ho anidaso atu mpɔn no so. Ɛdenam sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ nhomasua mu a woyi fi hɔ so no, nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ma mmabun tumi kɔ nhomasua a ɛkɔ soro, nya nnwuma a akatua pa wom, na wonya sikasɛm mu ahotɔ, na ɛnam so ma awo ntoatoaso ahorow ntam ohia so tew na ɛma asetra mu akwantu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw me fa nipadua asisie a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no akasa afa m’ankasa ahotew ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne w’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo bɛkasa afa w’ankasa ahotew ho a, ebetumi ate nka sɛ ɛyɛ hu, nanso ɛho hia ma w’akwahosan. Afotu bi ni: Paw Bere a Ɛfata: Paw bere a w’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ w’ahome no ho adwo wɔn na wonni adagyew, na ama wɔatumi de wɔn adwene asi wo so koraa. Di Nokware: Fa nokwaredi bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no. Ma wonhu sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nneɛma bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ w’ankasa ahotew ho wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Fa "Me" Nsɛm di dwuma: Fa nsɛmfua te sɛ, "Mahyɛ no nsow..." anaa "Me dwene ho..." di dwuma de da wo nkate ne wo haw adi. Bisa Kokoam Nsɛm: Sɛ wote nka sɛ ɛnyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wobɛbɔ nsɛmti bi ho nkɔmmɔ anim ne anim a, bisa sɛ wubetumi akyerɛw wo nsɛmmisa anaa wobɛkasa wɔ kokoam anaa. Bue w’ani Ma Tie: Ma w’awofo kwan ma wɔnka wɔn ankasa suahu ne afotu. Ebia wɔwɔ nhumu a ɛsom bo. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Ansa na wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ no, kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ ankorankoro ahotew ho nsɛmti ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi abisa nsɛm pɔtee bi. Hwehwɛ Mmoa a Ɛma Nnwumayɛfo: Sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wo ne w’awofo bɛkasa a, susuw ho sɛ wo ne sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, ɔfotufo, atipɛnfo afotufo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo bɛkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotu bi a mede besi mede nhyehyɛe hɔ daadeye ansa na mada a ɛboa me ma meda yiye wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa nna ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so daa si hɔ, fa dwumadi ahorow a ɛma ahomegye te sɛ akenkan, kwati mfoni hwe anyɛ yiye koraa no dɔnhwerew biako ansa na woada, na yɛ baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ fɛ a wobɛda.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhyehyɛe mu nsɛm atitiriw a ɛfa mmaabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka mmerante ne mmabaa asetena?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua pa a wobenya: Nhomasua ho nneɛma ne hokwan ahorow a ɛnnɔɔso betumi asiw mmabun a wontumi nnya ahokokwaw ne nimdeɛ a wohia na ama wɔadi yiye wɔ adwumayɛ mu no ano. Mmabun adwuma a wonnya nyɛ: Adwuma a wonnya nyɛ ne adwuma a wonnya nyɛ kɛse wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa mu no betumi asiw wɔn sikasɛm mu ahofadi ne sikasɛm mu ahotɔ kwan. Nyiyimu ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ: Nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a egyina nneɛma te sɛ abusuakuo, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, mmusuakuw, ne asetena mu sikasɛm tebea so betumi ama sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no akɔ so na asiw hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anya no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ minnim me nna ho akɔnnɔ nso ɛ, so ɛnyɛ hwee?
answer_twi_source: Okay koraa! Mmabun pii nnim. Ɛyɛ bere a wohwehwɛ nneɛma mu, na bere kɔ so no, ebia wo nkate bɛsakra. Ɛno yɛ ade a ɛfata koraa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwene mu nhumu betumi aboa adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" ho akwan afoforo te sɛ ayaresa anaa nnuru?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu Akwahosan "mental health strategies" Ho Akwan a Wɔde Adwene a Wɔde Bɛboa: Adwene mu Nsusuwii betumi aboa ayaresa denam nnwinnade foforo a wɔde bɛma de adi adwennwen, dadwen, anaa adwenemhaw ho dwuma wɔ nhyiam ahorow ntam no so. Ebetumi ama ayaresa no atu mpɔn denam ne ho a obehu ne nsusuwii ne nkate ahorow ho nhumu a ɛbɛma wanya so. Sɛ wɔde ka nnuru ho a, adwene a wɔde si biribi so betumi aboa ankorankoro ma wɔanya nimdeɛ a wɔde gyina ano na wɔatew wɔn ho a wɔde to nnuru so de di sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ho dwuma no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi bu me nipadua mu fahodie so anaasɛ ɔma mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho to w'atenka so na sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, yi wo ho fi tebea no mu. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu fotufo hɔ. Sɛ mmara so bu no yɛ aniberesɛm a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛbɔ atumfoɔ amanneɛ anaasɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a wobu so, te sɛ aware a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔware, mmofra aware, mmea awotwaa a wotwitwa, ne awoɔ a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ awoɔ no nya wɔn apomoden, ahofadi, ne yiyedi so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a wobu so, te sɛ aware a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔware, mmofra aware, mmea awotwaa a wotwitwa, ne awoɔ a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ awoɔ no de nsunsuanso a emu yɛ den ba wɔn akwahosan, ahofadi, ne yiyedi so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Honam fam ne adwene mu ɔhaw ahorow, a asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ ɛnanom bewuwu ne ɔyare ka ho. Nhomasua a wɔpow, sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow, ne kyɛfa a wonya wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ wɔ adwene mu apomoden, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne nnipa ntam abusuabɔ so. Ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne asetena mu nyiyimu kyinhyia a wɔbɛma akɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsunsuanso bɔne anaa apɔmuden ho asiane bi bɛtumi afiri aduro a wɔnom de si awoɔ kwan wɔ mpofirim nna akyi no mu aba anaa?
answer_twi_source: Bere a nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm no taa yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn no, ankorankoro binom betumi anya ɔhaw ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: ɔfe. Ɔbrɛ anaa eni-so-kyin. Tipae. Nufoo mu mmerɛwyɛ anaa ɛyɛ ya. Mogya a ɛba brayɛ mu a ɛnkɔ so daa. Yaase yaw. Saa nsunsuanso bɔne yi taa yɛ nea ɛnyɛ den na ɛyɛ bere tiaa mu de na ɛtaa fi nna kakraa bi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa mpɔtam hɔ dwumadi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a metumi akɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ so yɛ nnam na nya nkitahodi denam amammerɛ dwumadi ahorow yi so: Amammerɛ mu Asaw: Kɔka adesua ahorow ho ma asaw te sɛ Adowa, Agbadza, Kpanlogo, anaa Borborbor. Afahyɛ: Fa wo ho hyɛ parades, mmirikatu, tug-of-war, anaa amammerɛ agodie mu. Agumadi & Akodi: Kɔka mpɔtam hɔ akuw ho anaasɛ fa su ahorow te sɛ Tai Chi ne Capoeira di dwuma. Abɔde & Abɔnten: Fa wo ho hyɛ turoyɛ, akwantu, anaa ahyɛmma a wɔde fa amanne kwan so mu. Amammerɛ Mmeae: Hwehwɛ akuw a wɔde amanne asaw, amanne agodie, anaa amammerɛ kwan so aduannoa adesua a ahoɔden wom di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ mfe a wɔn hokafo adi de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi mfe a wɔde pene so wo mmara so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ mfe a wɔn hokafo adi denam bisa a wɔbɛsrɛ sɛ wɔmma no krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi te sɛ karka tumi krataa anaa akwantu tumi krataa, ɛwom sɛ ebia ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na saa kwan yi bɛyɛ nea mfaso wɔ so anaasɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye de. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne ahokafo bɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware fa mfe a wɔadi ho na wubu wɔn nokwaredi ne wɔn ahye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ɔsatuo, mamtam nhyehyeɛ, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfoɔ a mmabun di anim a wɔadi asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ho dwuma, akasa atia adwene a ɛnteɛ, na wɔahyɛ nsakraeɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ ASRH ne nneɛma foforɔ a ɛhaw adwene a ɛtwa ho hyia ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa Nnwuma a Mmabun Di Anim ho: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ɔsatuo a mmabun di anim, mantam nhyehyeɛ, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nnipa adi asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ho dwuma, akasa atia adwene a ɛnteɛ, na wɔahyɛ nsakraeɛ pa a ɛfa ASRH ne nneɛma foforɔ a ɛhaw adwene a ɛtwa ho hyia ho nkuran. Sɛ nhwɛso no, nnwumakuo ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa di anim afi ntentanfidie so ɔsatu ahorow ase de ama nkurɔfo ate awo hokwan ahorow ho asɛm, wɔayɛ ɔsɔretia ho nhyehyɛe de ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho adesua a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, na wɔayɛ dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma ahorow a wɔde bɛko atia animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne mmarima ne mmea ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi atwe mpena ne na m'afa ayɔnkoɔ, sɛ ɔbabun a wadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a amu da hɔ: Wo ne wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ wo hokafo no nni nkitaho pefee na fa nokwaredi di nkitaho wɔ wo dɛmdi ne w’ahiade ahorow ho. Ahotoso a Wowɔ: Gye wo ho ne wo bo a ɛsom di. Adwempa a obi benya no yɛ nea ɛtwetwe adwene. Hwehwɛ Dating Options: Kɔka intanɛt so mpɔtam anaa fekubɔ akuo a wɔde ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, anaa fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛka obiara ho a wubetumi ahyia nnipa foforo mu. Nhwɛsoɔ pa: Hwehwɛ nsɛm ne nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa mpenatwe a ɛdi mu a ɛfa nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonni ananmusifo pii no atumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa ASRH ho wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonni ananmusifoɔ yie no bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn wɔ ASRH ho nkɔmmɔdie mu wɔ wiase nyinaa denam: Wɔne ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nkitahodiɛ a mmabun di wɔn anim a wɔde ahodoɔ ne nkabom di kan, ahwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene gyina hɔ ma wɔ mmeaeɛ a wɔsi gyinaeɛ. Nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbo ama wɔ wiase nyinaa ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow a ehu na edi ahiade soronko ne nsɛnnennen a mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua hyia no ho dwuma. Abakɔsɛm ne digyital advocacy platforms a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn suahu na wɔama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse, ama nkurɔfo ate nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ntam a ɛka wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo ho. Wɔn a wɔne mpaninfoɔ ayɔnkofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma a wɔasi wɔn bo sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu ne wɔn ananmusifoɔ wɔ ASRH nsɛm a wɔka ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu no di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne anaa nneyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a metumi ahwehwɛ wɔ m’abusua mufo mu de ahu sɛ ebia wɔrepere wɔn adwenemyare anaa?
answer_twi_source: Nsakrae a ɛba adwene mu, te sɛ abufuw, awerɛhow, anaa adwene a ɛsakra. Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi fekubɔ dwumadi ahorow ho anaasɛ bere pii a obi nkutoo bɛtra. Nsakrae a ɛba sɛnea obi da, aduan ho akɔnnɔ, anaa ahoɔden dodow mu. Anidaso a enni hɔ, nea wontumi nyɛ ho hwee, anaa mfaso a enni so a wɔda no adi. Nneɛma a asiane wom anaa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wode w’adwene besi biribi so, ɔhaw a ɛma wokae ade, anaasɛ wontumi nsi gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwenemyare ho nnwuma bi wɔ hɔ a m’akwahosan ho insurance tua ho ka?
answer_twi_source: adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie no, ɔman no akwahosan ho insurance na ɛtua ho ka. wo ne wo healthcare provider no nni nkitaho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nnamfoɔ ne abusua bɛboa mmabun ma wɔagyina 'stress' ano?
answer_twi_source: Wɔma 'emotional support' (atenka mu mmoa) ne mmoa pa. Wɔtie wɔn. Sɛ mmabun ne wɔn bɔ a, wɔtumi kyɛ wɔn haw na wɔhwehwɛ kwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So atipɛnfo nhyɛso ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ebia mmabun bɛfa mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛda adi pefee ɛfa a adesrɛ, nea wɔhwehwɛ, anaa nkuranhyɛ a efi atipɛnfo hɔ ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe pɔtee bi mu ho. Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛnteɛ nam asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow, akwanhwɛ ahorow, anaa suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛyera (FOMO) so yɛ adwuma wɔ anifere kwan so kɛse. Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa wɔn ankasa si wɔ bere a ankoranko no afa kuro nhyɛso no  nomuu  na wɔte nka sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ade a abɔnten nhyɛso nka ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nnubɔne anaa nnubɔne a nkorɔfoɔ de wɔn ho to so ne adwene mu yareɛ hyia, na nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma ɛho ayaresa?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu haw kɛseɛ wɔ hɔ ma wɔn taa faa nnubɔne na wonntumi nnyae, wei tumi ha ayaresa a yɛde ma ɔmo. Nnubɔne bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsa yareɛ nkretewa nanso etumi de ɔhaw kɛseɛ ba akyire. Saafoɔ yi, dɔktafoɔ bɔ mmɔden de ɔmo kasa nnubɔne nsunsuansoɔ ho wɔ berɛ a ɔsa adwene mu yareɛ so ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu adwenem naayɛ di wɔ ankorankoro a wɔasakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu no suahu ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ate ase na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: barima ne ɔbea nna mu adwenem naayɛ di kyerɛ ahoyera anaa ahoyera a ebetumi afi ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde ama no bere a wɔwoo no ne wɔn bɔbeasu a ɛnsɛ mu aba. Ebetumi ada adi wɔ akwan horow so, a nkate fam ahokyere, nipadua mu abotɔyam a enni hɔ, ne asetra mu nsɛnnennen ka ho. Adwene mu akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo gye tom sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu adwenemhaw yɛ aduruyɛ tebea a ɛfata, na ebetumi aka nnipa a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu no yiyedi ne wɔn asetra pa kɛse.
