Ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne ayaresa, honam mu nkwammoa ayaresa, anaa oprehyɛn no betumi aboa anaasɛ ɛrentumi mmoa mma ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho adwenem naayɛ so tew na ɛma adwenemyare a efi mu ba no atu mpɔn ama ankorankoro a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ abien no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwannya ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ pene ne kokoamsɛm ho bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ akwannya pɔtee bi a ɛfa pene ne kokoamsɛm ho bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no. Ɛdenam mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so no, mmabun betumi anya hokwan apene ayaresa ne akwan horow bi so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, a nea ɛka ho ne STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu. Ahintasɛm ho banbɔ hwɛ hu sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi mfa mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm nkyerɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no a wɔmpene so, gye sɛ tebea horow a mmara a ɛhyɛ sɛ wɔde ma amanneɛbɔ no di dwuma anaasɛ ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow wɔ hɔ ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ako nkrasɛm anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛbɔ abira a efi amammerɛ anaa asetena mu tebea horow mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii a Ɛyɛ Den: Nya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ den a wode bɛsɔ nsɛm ne nkrasɛm a efi mmeae ahorow ahwɛ. Hwehwɛ Nsɛm: Boaboa nsɛm ano fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so na kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa adwene ahorow ho. Wo ne Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di Nkasa: Wo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di a wɔwɔ nhumu anaa akwankyerɛ nsusu nkrasɛm a ɛbɔ abira ho. Susuw Gyinapɛn Ho: Dwennwen w’ankasa wo gyinapɛn ne gyidie ahorow ho na ama woakyerɛ wo gyinaesi ahorow kwan. Obu a Wɔde Ma Nneɛma Ahorow: Te ase sɛ gyidi ne adwene ahorow a egu ahorow no yɛ ade a ɛfata na fa obu ma adwene ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne daakye akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde di kan ma 'ASRH' nhwehwɛmu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no na wɔayɛ nneɛma foforo wɔ saa asɛm yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Daakye akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bedi kan ama 'ASRH' nhwehwɛmu no bi ne: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ sɛnea 'ASRH' ne nneɛma atitiriw afoforo a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan ne yiyedi te sɛ nhomasua, ohia, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ di nkitaho. Akwan ne mfiridwuma foforɔ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, te sɛ nea broni ka no 'mobile health applications', 'social media analysis', ne 'big data analytics', de ama data a wɔboaboa ano, nhwehwɛmu, ne kyekyɛ akɔ anim wɔ 'ASRH' nhwehwɛmu mu. Nsunsuansoɔ a ɛkyɛ a dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ nya wɔ 'ASRH' nsunsuansoɔ so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ ɛtu mpɔn wɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da so tew, ɛnanom akwahosan a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn, ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu sɛ ahokafo ne adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ adwuma bom, efi adesua nhyehyɛe ne ne di so kosi data nhwehwɛmu ne nkyerɛase so, de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔadi wɔn nneɛma a wɔde di kan no ho dwuma. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔde bedi kan wɔ ahiade ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ ho, a mma ne mma da ne mmarima ne mmarima da,aborɔfo ka no  mma ne mma da ne mmarima ne mmarima da, 'LGBTQ+' mmerante ne mmabaa, aborɔfo mmabun, aguanfo ne atubrafo mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadi dɛm, ne mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ka ho, na ama wɔahu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so kɛse na ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm a ɛfa adwumayɛ ho, te sɛ adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, aguadi, ne nkitahodi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmabun nya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ adwumayɛ mu nneɛma ahodoɔ mu, a adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ, aguadi ho akwan, ne nkitahodiɛ ka ho. Afotufoɔ kyɛ wɔn suahunu, de afotuo a mfasoɔ wɔ so ma, na wɔde nsɛm ma de boa afotufoɔ ma wɔnya wɔn adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ, na wɔdi nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ wɔn nnwuma a wɔbɛhyɛ aseɛ ne wɔn nkɔsoɔ mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiw ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ano wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so si ano no bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nnamfofa pa ne pɛ a wɔpene so ho, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne obu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, nkitahodiɛ ne nteaseɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ, nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa a wɔbɛma, basabasayɛ nsunsuansoɔ a wɔbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ahu, ne suban ne nneyɛeɛ bɔne a wɔbɛsɔre atia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so de abɛɛfo mfiridwuma nea broni ka no 'technology' ne sohyial 'media' ahorow di dwuma de kyekyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔne mmabun di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ de abɛɛfo mfiridwuma nea broni ka no 'technology'  ne 'sohyial media' akwan di dwuma de kyekyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔne mmabun di nkitaho. Wɔyɛ wɛbsaet, nea broni ka no 'mobile apps', ne intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛde SRH ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, nkitahodi nnwinnade, ne kokoam mmoa dwumadie ma. Nea broni ka no 'CBOs de social media' akwan di dwuma de kyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm, hyɛ nsɛm a esisi ho nkuran, na wɔma atipɛnfo nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa SRH nsɛmti ho no yɛ mmerɛw. Wɔde dijitaal akwan nso di dwuma de yɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo, wɔyɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so ho nhyehyɛe, na wɔde du mmerante ne mmabaa a ebia wɔatew wɔn ho anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wobenya wɔn nkyɛn denam atetesɛm akwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtamfo a wɔde wɔn kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔfo no taa de nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa a edi mũ ma wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho. Eyi betumi ayɛ: Nhyiam ne nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma, kokoamsɛm, ne akwan ahorow a ayarefo wɔ ho. Amanneɛbɔ nneɛma ne nneɛma a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ne sɛnea wɔbɛfa akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Wɔde kɔma mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmmoa wɔn wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahyehyɛde ne akuw a mmabun di anim di, wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wɔko ma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ɔman no mu, ne wiase nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ne akuw a mmabun di anim di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wɔko ma no mu denam mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔboaboa wɔn ano, wɔma nkurɔfo hu, wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu a egyina adanse so, nya nhyehyɛe ho gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso, na wɔma aban ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bu akontaa sɛ wobedi wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuanso bɛn na adwenemyare a ebetumi afi nna mu basabasayɛ anaa nhyɛso mu ba deba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tebea horow yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi nya nna mu basabasayɛ anaa nhyɛso a, ebetumi de adwenemyare a emu yɛ den aba, a nea ɛka ho ne adwenemhaw, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw a ɛba wɔ ahodwiriw akyi (PTSD). Mmabun betumi anya mmoa ne nneɛma wɔ tebea horow yi mu denam mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mmoa mu a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn no so. Kokoam telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, afotu adwuma, ne nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo betumi de ɔhwɛ, mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛsa yare na wɔasan anya ahoɔden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo nhyɛsoɔ ahorow bi a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho adwene so bi kyerɛ me, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi asi nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma ho kwan?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho betumi anya nsusuansoɔ wɔ sɛnea wohu awo akwahosan na wɔka ho asɛm no so. Nyamesom mu Gyidi: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi akyerɛ su horow wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho. Animtiaabu ne Taboo: Animtiaabu ne bara a wɔabara a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI ho betumi asiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a wobenya no kwan. Bɔbeasu a Ɛnyɛ Pɛyɛ: Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛde mmarima awo akwahosan di kan sen mmea awo akwahosan no betumi ama wɔanya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛnyɛ pɛ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmea, mmarima, mmarimaa ne mmeawa a wofi mmusuakuw nyinaa mu de wɔn ho hyɛ mu sɛ nnipa a wɔyɛ pɛ na wɔn bo yɛ pɛ. Wɔn ani gye nneɛma, ahofadi ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka kokoam akwan a wobetumi afa so anya nnuru a wɔ de siw nyinsɛn ano ho asɛm, a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara so.
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm ahorow wɔ hɔ a wubetumi apaw, a egyina beae a wowɔ so: Akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ mmabun adamfofa anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow no de kokoam nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma mmabun. Sukuu my beae a wohwɛ yareɛ : sukuu ahorow wɔ akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ kokoam nnwuma a ɛfa afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nea wɔde kɔma baabi foforo enam nnwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me suahu ne nsɛm a meka no boa ma nkɔso wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔaka abom a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛhwɛ sɛ wo suahu ne wo nsɛm a wobɛka no boa ma nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ so wɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔaka abom mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne ahyehyɛdeɛ bedi nkitaho denneennen, wode nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛma denhyɛ bɛma, na woakamfo nsakraeɛ a ɛda mmabun ahiadeɛ adi. Wubetumi de wo ho ahyɛ ayarefo afotu akuw anaa mmabun afotu bagua mu, akyɛ wo suahu ahorow denam nhwehwɛmu anaa akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so so, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho tẽẽ wɔ nea wopɛ ne nea ɛhaw wo ho, na wo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɛ biako de ama wo nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔanya gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow so nkɛntɛnso. Ɛdenam sɛ wobɛyɛ nnam na woakɔ so ayɛ adwuma so no, wubetumi aboa ma wɔanya nkɔso a ntease wom wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔaka abom a wɔde ma mmabun mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadi beae ahorow bere a meyɛ ɔbabun, na ɛhe na metumi akɔ akɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ ɔbabun no, wubetumi afa akwan horow so anya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo: Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wo ne wo oduruyɛfo titiriw, mmea ho ɔyaresafo, anaa mmabun akwahosan ayaresabea nkɔhwɛ. Mpɔtam Akwahosan Asoɛe: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe, abusua nhyehyɛe ayaresabea, anaa awo akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde STI nhwehwɛmu ne afotu adwuma ma. Akwahosan Asoɛe a Ɛgyina Sukuu So: Sukuu binom nam akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu so so de STI nhwehwɛmu ne afotuo a ɛyɛ kokoam ma. Ofie Sɔhwɛ Nneɛma: Susuw ho sɛ wode ofie nhwehwɛmu nneɛma a FDA apene so bedi dwuma ama STI ahorow bi, a ɛma wutumi boaboa nhwɛsode ahorow ano wɔ fie na wode mena aduruyɛdan mu ma wɔyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow nya tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wogye awo ho atɛntrenee di dwuma no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow no nya tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya awo ho atɛntrenee bedi dwuma no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse denam nnwuma ne nsɛm a ɛho hia a wobenya ho nkuran anaasɛ wobesiw ano, abɔ wɔn ho ban afi nyiyim ne nhyɛso ho, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobebu akontaa wɔ awo hokwan ahorow a wobu so ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ anaasɛ minnim sɛ mɛbɔ nsɛmti bi ho nkɔmmɔ wɔ afotu bere mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ wuntumi susuw nsɛmti bi ho wɔ afotu bere mu a, wubetumi: Wo ne wo fotufo no aka wo nkate ne wo haw ahorow ho asɛm pefee. Gye w’ahome anaa gyae nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu kakra sɛ wuhia bere de adi wo nkate horow ho dwuma a. Hwehwɛ akwan foforo a wobɛfa so adi asɛmti no ho dwuma anaasɛ wobedi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a ɛfa ho ho dwuma. Susuw ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi ɔfotufo foforo hɔ sɛ wote nka sɛ wo mprempren fotufo no mfata wo a. Kae sɛ afotuo yɛ adwuma a wɔbom yɛ, na ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛhyehyɛ ahyeɛ na woakamfo w’ahiadeɛ wɔ berɛ mu Nanso, sɛ obi te nka sɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ kɛseɛ sɛ ɔbɛka asɛmti pɔtee bi ho asɛm a, yei betumi ayɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ onsiesiee ne ho sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ mu bio Ebia ɛbɛgye berɛ kakra ansa na wɔate nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahotɔ a ɛdɔɔso sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa Wobetumi ama kwan ma wɔanya nkɔsoɔ wɔ afotuo nhyiamu ase
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama 'consent' (pene) ne obu?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa. Kasa tia nneyɛeɛ bɔne. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo nnamfo. Boa dwumadie a ɛfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ nna mu nsɛm 'SRH' nimdeɛ hwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne: Animtiabu ne akyiwade 'Stigma' ne 'taboo'. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a enni sukuu mu. Mmeammea a ayaresabea nni. Amammerɛ ne gyidie a ɛsiw nkɔmmɔbɔ kwan. Kokoamu yɛ ne hu. Nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ abɛɛfo nnkitahodi so 'social media' so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me hokafo abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa kɔndɔm anaa nneɛma afoforo a ɛbɔ me ho ban a mede bedi dwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne wo hokafo kasa fa kɔndɔm anaa ahobammɔ afoforo a wode bedi dwuma ho a, ebetumi ayɛ fɛre, nanso ɛyɛ abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom fa titiriw. Afotu bi ni: Nya Ahotoso: Ahotoso boa kɛse. Fa odwo ne ahotoso bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no. Berɛ a Wobɛhyehyɛ no Yɛ Ade Titiriw: Paw bere a mo baanu nyinaa ho bɛtɔ mo na mowɔ kokoam nsɛm. Fi Nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase: Wubetumi afi ase aka biribi te sɛ, "Me;akwahosan ne wo de ho hia me, enti mepɛ sɛ meka ahobammɔ ho asɛm." Fa W’adwene Si Mfaso So: Kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea kɔndɔm a wode bedi dwuma no bɔ mo baanu nyinaa ho ban fi STI ne nyinsɛn a wɔmpɛ ho mu. Ma Da Ada hɔ: Ka pefee sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode kɔndɔm bedi dwuma. Tie na Bu Nidi: Tie wo hokafo no haw ahorow na bu wɔn ahye. Siesie Wo Ho: Ɛboa sɛ wubedi kan anya kɔndɔm ntɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔate wɔn akwannya ahorow ase sɛ adwumayɛfo, a abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma, mmoa telefon, anaa mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ahorow a wɔde bɛte wɔn akwannya ahorow ase sɛ adwumayɛfo, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so nneɛma: Aban adwumayɛfo dwumadibea ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, ne akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo no wɛbsaet ahorow taa de akwankyerɛ ahorow, nsɛm a wobisabisa nkurɔfo, ne nsɛm a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow mu ma. Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Telefon nhama a wontua hwee a aban mpanyimfo anaa mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow de di dwuma no de mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a obi wɔ wɔ adwuma mu ho ma. Mmara mmoa dwumadie: Mmara kwan so ayaresabea ahodoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne mmara kwan so mmoa akuo a wɔboa obiara betumi de mmara kwan so mmoa a wontua hwee anaa ne boɔ nyɛ den ne ananmusifoɔ ama wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa adwumayɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi de me ho ato nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ social media so a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Bere a ebia social media platform ahorow bɛma wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm no, ɛho hia sɛ wodi saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma yiye. Ɛnyɛ nneɛma a wɔkyɛ wɔ sohyial media so nyinaa na ɛyɛ nokware anaasɛ egyina adanse so, na ebia nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa adwene a ɛyɛ animhwɛ wɔ hɔ. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wobɛhwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din no yɛ nokware na wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di bɛkasa sɛ wunni ahotoso wɔ nsɛmti pɔtee bi ho a. Bio nso, ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw kokoam nsɛm ho bere a wɔresusuw ankorankora akwahosan ho nsɛm ho wɔ sohyial media so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne ɔhaw pɔtee ne asiane 'risks' a mmabun ahyia mmere Nsɛnnennen ne asiane bɛn na mmabun hyia bere a ewiase nyinaa apommuden ntɛmtɛm asem a broni bɛkasɛ 'global health emergencies', titiriw fa wɔn nna mu ne awoɔ apommuden mmoa ne hokwan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hyia ɔhaw pɔtee ne asiane 'risks' bere a ewiase nyinaa apommuden ntɛmtɛm asem a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'global health emergencies', ne ayaresa dwumadie a emu etwetwa, sɛnea mmabun no bɛnya adeɛ yɛde si nyinsɛn ho kwan no yɛtwa no tia ne STI nsɔhwɛ, asiane a ɛda nyinsɛn a w'ani ndaso adɔɔso ne nyinsɛn yi guo aa banbɔ ɛni ho, ne mrɛyɔ a ano yɛ den kosi nna mu basabasayɛ ne kwan bɔne a wɔfa so gye nneɛma firi wɔn kyen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn 'resources' ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ mmoa na ɛda hɔ wɔ mpɔtam no mu na asiesie mmabun nna mu ne awoɔ mu apɔmmuden ahiade, ne nea eka ho ne nyinsɛn ano sie, nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'STI testing' ne ayaresa, afutow, ne nwomasua?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfo tae ma nea aborɔfo ka no sɛ 'resources' ahohorow ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ boa de adrɛse mmabun nna mu ne awoɔ apɔmmuden ahiade.Wei nyinaa betumi aka ayaresabea, anaa ayaresa nnwuma wɔyɛ beae ma nea yɛdi si nyinsɛn ano kwan, 'STI testing' ne ayaresa, afutuw, ne nwomasua dwumadi. Mpɔtam hɔfo kuokuo betumi ama kuo a wɔboa, ne aborɔfo ka no sɛ 'outreach programs' ne 'advocacy', kasa ma mmɔdenmɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmmuden. Ebiom, nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'hotlines', 'online resources' ne nsem ho akadeɛ ɛkyekyɛ ma wɔn a wɔwɔ mpɔtam no mu tumi ma mmabun hokwan wɔ asem a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmra mu nkyerɛase ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho, a mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho a ɛbɔ obi ho ban fi nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ɔhaw, ɔsa, anaa ayayade ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nkyerɛase ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu nanso mpɛn pii no ɛka nneyɛe a ɛto obi nna mu ahofadi ne ne mudi mu kura ho. Mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛbɔ ankorankoro ho ban afi nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ɔhaw, ayayade, anaa ayayade ho. Mpɛn pii no, saa mmra ahorow yi kyerɛkyerɛ mfomso pɔtee a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho mu, ɛkyerɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔapene so, de asotwe ahorow a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔyɛ saa no sisi hɔ, na ɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ atɛntrenee ne mmoa. Mmara nhyehyɛe a ɛfata ho nhwɛso ne: Nsɛmmɔnedi ho mmara a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nna mu mfomso te sɛ efĩ, mmonnaato, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, nna mu ayayade, ne nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu na ɛbara. Ɔman mmara a ɛma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no kwan ma wɔhwehwɛ akatua anaa nneɛma a wɔsɛee no denam ɔmanfo mmara mu asɛm a wɔde kɔdan wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛyɛ wɔn asɛyɛde sɛ wɔantumi asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow, apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de amammerɛ mu ntinka ho ntetee ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma nkurɔfo hu nkurɔfo no ahyɛ wɔn nhyehyɛe ne wɔn nneyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow, apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de amammerɛ mu atinka ahyɛ mu denam: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ntetee ne adwumayɛfo nkɔso a wɔde bɛma adwumayɛfo no anya nimdeɛ, nimdeɛ, ne ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu. Amammerɛ mu ahokokwaw gyinapɛn, akwankyerɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛka ahyehyɛde no nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe ho. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, amammerɛ ho afotufoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ahodoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma bom wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu mu. Kasa nkyerɛaseɛ, nkyerɛaseɛ dwumadie, ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ no amammerɛ mu a wɔde bɛma de ama nnwuma no a wɔbɛtumi anya na ɛfa ho atu mpɔn. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so, mmuaeɛ, ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛfa nneɛma pa ho mu de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi amammerɛ ahiadeɛ ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn saaa na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔpɛ SRH nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne: YMK, YENKASA (Ghana ahyehyɛdeɛ). Hwehwɛ 'sexual health resources in Ghana' wɔ intanɛt so na wobenya mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyimu ho ahyɛ mmɔden a ɛtrɛw a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow, pɛyɛ, na wɔde aka ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri: Fa nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu, mmubuafo hokwan ahorow, ne nna mu hokwan ahorow bɛka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtrɛw ho. Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm ho Nsusuwii Pɔtee: Hwɛ sɛ wobetumi anya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nneɛma na di mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiade pɔtee ho dwuma. Dwumadie Pa: Fa ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini pa ka nhomasua nneɛma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ho no nya ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm so nsunsuanso, na mmara mu ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔanya hokwan ne ahobammɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu Ahobammɔ: Mmara bɔ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ho ban fi nna mu ayayade ne ateetee ho. Mpɔtam bi wɔ mmara pɔtee bi a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm nya dabere na ama wɔanya nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma. Mpene a Wɔde Ma: Mmara ahorow si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nimdeɛ ne nea wofi wɔn pɛ mu pene so so dua, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔrenhyɛ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ma wɔnyɛ nna mu kyɛfa. Ebia ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ahwɛfo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no benya mmara kwan so asɛyɛde ahorow sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ne wɔn yiyedi ho ban. Nna mu Akwahosan Ho Dwumadibea: Ebia mmara bɛhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛfata ma ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm na ama wɔanya nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo ne mmara kwan so nneɛma betumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ pɔtee bi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no ho dwuma wɔ mmeae a egye ntɛmpɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a wohia?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho a wobedi ho dwuma wɔ mmeae a egye ntɛmpɛ no ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a wohia. Eyi betumi aba denam nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate nka a ɛkasa tia gyidi ahorow a epira na ɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa SRH nsɛm ho nkuran no so. Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛtete wɔn ma wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu ne amammerɛ ho nimdeɛ ama no ho hia yiye, te sɛ kokoam nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne ahofadi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa nna mu ɔhaw ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw yɛ onyin fã a efi awosu mu. Nteɛso: Bere a nsakrae betumi aba nna mu dwumadi mu bere a obi nyin no, ɛnyɛ nea wontumi nkwati na mpɛn pii no wobetumi asa. Atosɛm: Nna mu ɔhaw ka nnipa a wɔn mfe akɔ anim nkutoo. Nteɛso: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw betumi aba wɔ mfe biara mu esiane nneɛma ahorow nti. Atosɛm: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw yɛ adwene mu de bere nyinaa. Nteɛso: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw betumi de honam fam, adwene mu, anaa n’abien nyinaa aba. Atosɛm: Sɛ mewɔ nna mu ɔhaw a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ biribi asɛe wɔ me ho. Nteɛso: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw abu so na wotumi sa, na mpɛn pii no ɛfa honam fam anaa adwene mu nneɛma ho. Atosɛm: Nnuru bedi nna mu ɔhaw ahorow nyinaa ho dwuma. Nteɛso: Ebia nnuru betumi aboa, nanso ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na ɛno nkutoo ne ano aduru. Adwene mu nneɛma ne asetra mu nsakrae nso ho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi afa so ahyehyɛ wɔn bere yie (time management) de ate 'stress' so?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de 'schedule' anaa 'planner' de ahyehyɛ wɔn dwumadie. Kyɛ adwuma kɛseɛ mu nketewa. Hyehyɛ botaeɛ a wubetumi adru ho (realistic goals). Ɛwɔ wo gyae ɛmmɔtohɔ (avoid procrastination). Fa 'apps' te sɛ Calendar di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun sesa wɔn adwene anaa wonya nsɛmmisa foforo a, wobetumi asane nso aka akyerɛ aduruyɛfoɔ anaa dɔkotani no sɛ wontwaso anaase worenyɛ bio?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔtwe wɔn pene a wɔpene so wɔ aduruyɛ anaa ayaresa ho no mu sɛ wɔsakra wɔn adwene anaasɛ wonya nsɛmmisa foforo a. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bu mmabun gyinaesi ahorow na wɔma hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔama emu ada hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dijitaal tumi a wɔde ma no ne mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, animtiaabu a wɔtew so, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya no di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma kwan ma yɛnya nimdeɛ. Ɛtew animtiaabu so (nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛka ho). Ɛma nnwuma a wonya (telemedicine) tu mpɔn. Asɛnka agua ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama aduane pa ne fie pa wɔ wɔn mpɔte?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya no atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Nhumu a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn: Atipɛnfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hia a nsɛm yi ho hia ne nsunsuanso a enya wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi so no so. Ɔsatuo a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfoɔ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Ɔsatuo a wɔde bɛka ho anaa wɔbɛyɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ de akamfo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa aduane a wonnya nni, afie a wɔnni, ne adan a ne boɔ yɛ den ho. Nhyehyɛeyɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Wɔn a wɔne mpaninfoɔ a wɔapaw wɔn bɛhyia, akyerɛw nkrataa, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de aka wɔn haw ho asɛm na wɔakamfo nsakraeɛ akyerɛ wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne ɔman no mu. Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi ako ama  wɔn haw ho asɛm, de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a ɛka obiara ho mu na wɔde nhyiam ahorow a wotumi kɔ hɔ adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔdi  nsakrae aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛyɛ ayaresabea ama na gye mmebun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Aban mmoa (sika/nteteeɛ). Mpɔtam nkabom. Amanaman mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bu social media nkɛntɛnsofo sɛ nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ fibea ahorow a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho bere a wɔde toto atetesɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bu sohyial media nkɛntɛnsofo sɛ nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ fibea ahorow a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho no yɛ soronko wɔ atetesɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ho denam: Wobu nkɛntɛnsofo (influeners) sɛ nnipa a wotumi ka ho asɛm na wotumi nya bi a wɔkyɛ osuahu ne afotu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ aniberesɛm na ɛnyɛ atɛn so. Atetesɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so ma wonya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so nanso wɔdan kɔ nkɛntɛnsofo nkyɛn ma wonya adwene a atipɛnfo na ɛkanyan wɔn ne asetra mu nhumu ankasa. Sohyial media nkɛntɛnsofo anohyeto ahorow a wobehu wɔ nimdeɛ ne ahotoso mu sɛ wɔde toto adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn ho nanso wobu wɔn tumi a wɔde atipɛnfo mmoa ne nea wogye tom ma no sɛ ɛsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amanneɛbɔ akwan horow a mmabun a wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ wɔ hɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa saa akwan yi so dwoodwoo na etu mpɔn yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ no wɔ akwan horow pii a wɔfa so bɔ amanneɛ, a nea ɛka ho ne amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ma mmarahyɛ baguafo, sukuu mpanyimfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa mpanyimfoɔ a wogye wɔn di. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ mmoa afi ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ mmeae a wɔhwɛ mmonnaato ho haw, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, anaa akuw a wɔboa wɔ Intanɛt so. Saa akwan yi a wɔbɛfa so dwoodwoo na wɔatu mpɔn no hwehwɛ sɛ wobenya obi a wogye no di sɛ ɔbɛboa wɔn, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, wɔbɛboaboa adanse biara ano, na wɔahu wɔ hokwan ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ merehyia GBV wɔ nyɔnkofa mu a, dɛn ne akwannya ahorow a mewɔ? (mmara kwan so ahobammɔ, ahyɛde ahorow a wɔde siw kwan) .
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ na wobu wo wɔ nyɔnkofa biara mu. Ahobanbɔ ahorow bi ni: Mmara kwan so Ahobammɔ: Mmara taa bara ofie basabasayɛ, a ebetumi aka honam fam, kasa, atenka   fam, anaa nna mu ayayade. Ahyɛde a Wɔde Siw Ano: Asɛnnibea ahyɛde ahorow yi siw nea ɔyɛ ayayade no ne wo nni nkitaho na ebetumi aboa ma woanya ahobammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no kyerɛ mmeae a ebia ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no reyɛ akɔ fam wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho haw a wɔboa wɔn no mu a, anammɔn bɛn na wɔtu?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn betumi ayɛ: Nhwehwɛmu foforo a wɔbɛyɛ de ate nea ɛde sintɔ ahorow no ba. Nsiesiei akwan te sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ nteteeɛ anaa ɔsom mu nkɔsoɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma. Wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ne ahokafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ma wɔadi nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsɛm ho dwuma. Dwumadie no akwan a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu daa na wɔasan ahwɛ mu a egyina nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi nyiyim, ayayade, ne ayayade a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho akɔnnɔ so wɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ no ho dwuma na yɛakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Fa nhyehyɛe a emu da hɔ a ɛko tia nyiyim ne ayayade di dwuma wɔ sukuu ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu. Fa nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ntetee ma de ma nkurɔfo hu LGBTQ+ nsɛm na wɔhyɛ obu suban ho nkuran. Hyɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ no nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nnye mu mfa mmoa wɔn a wɔrehyia nyiyim, ayayade, anaa ayayade. Fa amanneɛbɔ akwan ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde boa ankorankoro si hɔ ma ankorankoro ma wɔbɔ nyiyim ho amanneɛ na wɔanya mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho media ho nimdeɛ ma me tumi ma mihu na mekasa tia nna, mpenatwe, ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a media adwuma no kɔ so twa ho mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ epira na, ɛhyɛ mfonini ahorow a ɛde nkabɔm ba, na ɛhyɛ papa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Media ma wo tumi ma wuhu na wokasa tia nna, abusuabɔ, ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow ho mfonini ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ epira denam: Nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee a wobenya de agye nna ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ nea ɛfata anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ katee wɔ media mu ho kyim. Sɛ wokamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa mfonini ahorow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom, egu ahorow, na ɛyɛ papa a ɛda nokwasɛm ahorow ne nnipa osuahun ahorow adi. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne dwumadi a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ahyɛ media nsɛm a ɛhyɛ nnipa ahorow, nipadua ahorow, ne abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne adebɔfo a wɔde asɛde ne abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm a wɔka a ɛma nne a wɔato wɔn sintidua so na ɛma wonya adwene pa wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ ho no di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi afa so ama mmaabun a wofi mbeae ahorow anya tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nnipa ahodoɔ ne wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔn ho nkuran: Ɛsɛ sɛ atipɛnfoɔ afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ de nsiyɛ fa afotufoɔ ne wɔn a wɔkyerɛ wɔn a wɔfiri mmusua ahodoɔ mu, a mmusuakuo ahodoɔ, mmarima ne mmaa, asetena mu sikasɛm tebea, ne tumi ahodoɔ ka ho. Fa amammerɛ mu ahokokwaw ntetee ma: Tete afotufo ma wɔnte wɔn atipɛnfo amammerɛ, wɔn nipasu, ne wɔn suahu ase na wonni obu, na ama tebea a ɛma akwaaba na ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho. Ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee nyɛ mmerɛw: Yɛ hokwan ahorow ma afotufo ne wɔn a wɔrekyerɛ wɔn kwan sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn adwene ho nkɔmmɔ mu, akyɛ wɔn nsɛm, na wɔasua biribi afi wɔn ho wɔn ho suahu mu, na ama ntease, tema, ne obu ama wɔn ho wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi afa so afiri nna mu abusuabɔ mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ a wode bɛba awiei betumi ayɛ den, afotu bi ne sɛ: Di nokware na ka no senea ɛte, Ka wo atinka ho asɛm pefee. Bu ɔfoforo no nkate: Tie wɔn adwene. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Wo ne w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, anaa ɔyaresafo bi nkasa. Fa w’adwene si wo ho a wobɛhwɛ so: Fa wo yiyedi di kan wɔ saa bere yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya ahotoso sɛ wɔn apɔwmuden ho ahwɛfoɔ bɛkora wɔn nsɛm so, titirie bere a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu dwumadi ne nyinsɛn nnuro ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, mmabun betumi anya ahotoso sɛ wɔn apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo de wɔn nsɛm sie, titire bere a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu dwumadi ne nyinsɛn nnuro ho. Adwumayɛfo nneyɛ pa ne mmara kwan so asɛde ahorow na ɛkyekyere akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo sɛ wɔbɛkora ayarefo kokoamsɛm so, na wobu kokoamsɛm a wobu so no aniberesɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetra mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama adesua tebea a ɛboa na ɛma tumi a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun hokwan ahorow, nidi, ne wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ asetra mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow no di kan sɛ wɔbɛbɔ adesua tebea a ɛboa na ɛma tumi a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun hokwan ahorow, nidi, ne wɔn dwumadibea. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na wogye mmabun fibea ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne wɔn apɛde ahorow tom. Ɛsɛ sɛ obu a wɔde ma mmabun ahofadi, tumi a wɔde si gyinae, ne nea wɔpɛ no yɛ ade titiriw wɔ nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu mu, na ɛma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya atenka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wuranom, wɔyɛ wɔn ho yie, na wɔma wɔn tumi. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no de nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pɛyɛ, nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, ne mmarima ne mmea ho nkate ka ho, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun nyinaa nya hokwan ahorow, nneɛma, ne mmoa a ɛyɛ pɛ, a wɔn a wofi mmusua a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wonni ahotɔ mu ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea bɛn na ɛma hia aba sɛ wɔbetumi ayɛ obi biribi wɔ berɛ a wɔammpene so (consent)?
answer_twi_source: Wei si mmerɛ a asiane ato obi (Emergency - de gye nkwa). Sɛ onipa no ntumi nsi gyinaeɛ (te sɛ ɔhwe ase). Sɛ panyin a ɔhwɛ no (guardian) ma ho kwan a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asua sɛdeɛ yɛka sɛ 'daabi' ansa na 'peer pressure' aba?
answer_twi_source: Role-play (Wo ne nnamfo nsuasua). Fa w'adwene bu (Visualize). Hyehyɛ mmara ma wo ho na di so (Personal rules).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka wɔn amammerɛ mu nneɛma a wɔpɛ ne wɔn ahiade ho asɛm akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ tebea a emu yɛ den mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asusuw wɔn amammerɛ mu apɛde, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nea ɛhaw wɔn ho pefee, akyɛ amammerɛ mu nneyɛe anaa gyidi ahorow a ɛfata a ebetumi aka wɔn ɔhaw mu suahu, na wɔada nea wɔpɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a ɛfa amammerɛ ho adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi asua sɛnea wobehu sikasɛm mu nsisi, ne nnaadaa nneyɛe a ebetumi de wɔn ani asi mmerante ne mmabaa ne wɔn a wonni osuahu so na wɔakwati?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi abɔ wɔn ho ban afi sikasɛm mu nsisi, ne nnaadaa nneyɛe ho denam nsɛm a wɔbɛkɔ so ahu na wɔn ani ada hɔ no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ahwɛyiye berɛ a wɔde wɔn ankasa anaa sikasɛm ho nsɛm rekyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no na wɔhwɛ sɛ nneɛma biara a wɔde ma anaa hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma no yɛ mmara kwan so de ansa na wɔayɛ ho biribi. Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ afotu fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa sikasɛm ho abenfo hɔ a, ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa nsisi a ebetumi aba no mu na wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata. Bio nso, sɛ mmabun kɔ so nya nsisi ho akwan a wɔtaa fa so ne frankaa kɔkɔɔ ho nsɛm a, ɛma wohu nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ nnaadaa na wɔkwati.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na mmabun bɛtumi anya, te sɛ sikakorabea, akontaabu a wɔde hwɛ sika so, sika a wɔde gye sika, bosea, insurance, ne sika a wɔde bɛto mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun nya sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Sikakorabea: Ma baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔde sika bɛto na wɔanya mfɛntom. Checking accounts(akontaabu a wɔde hwɛ sika so): Ma kwan ma wɔyɛ da biara da nnwuma te sɛ sika a wotua ne nneɛma a wobɛtɔ. Credit cards: Fa tumi a wode bɛbɔ bosea a wubetumi atua berɛ kɔ so ma. Boa: Fa sika ma de tɔ nneɛma akɛse te sɛ nhomasua anaa lɔre. Insurance: Bɔ wo ho ban fi sika a wobɛhwere esiane nsɛm a wɔnhwɛ kwan te sɛ yare anaa akwanhyia nti. Sika a wɔde bɛto mu: Ma sika a wɔde asie no nkɔanim denam sikakorabea, bonds, mutual funds, anaa pɛnhyen akontaabu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wobɛkɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn akɔka ankorankoro ahiade ho asɛm, na woanya nyinsɛn nnuro ho boa so dua.
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo ne wo mmoa kɛseɛ paa fa nyinsɛn nnuro ho. Wobetumi de: Afotuo a ɛfa wo ho a egyina w’akwahosan ne w’asetena so. Nsɛm a ɛfa akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so siw awoɔ ano ne mfasoɔ/asiane a ɛwɔ so. Boa ma wɔdi nsunsuansoɔ bɔne ho dwuma na wɔhunu deɛ ɛfata wo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow ho ban, na etu mpɔn dɛn wɔ nneyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ nhyehyeɛ wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahodoɔ ho ban, a mmara a ɛtia nyiyimu, mmubuafoɔ hokwan ho mmara, ne apomoden ho mmara a ɛhyɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya kwan akɔ hɔ na wɔnyɛ nyiyimu ka ho. Nanso, sɛnea saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi tu mpɔn wɔ nneyɛe mu no gu ahorow, na ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛkasa ama nkurɔfo na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena mu nneɛma bi te sɛ aduane a wodie, apɔw-mu-ntentenneɛ, ne nna a ebetumi aha nna mu agodie ne ne dwumadie?
answer_twi_source: Adidi: Aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuro, aburow, ne lean proteins yɛ ma apɔwmuden, a nna mu agodie ka ho. Kwati nsa ne caffeine a ɛboro so a ebetumi aka akɔnnɔ ne nna mu mmɔdenbɔ ahyɛ. Tentenne w'apɔw mu yie na yɛ w'akoma ho adwuma daa, na boa wɔ nna agodie mu. Bio so ɛma wo akokoduro. Nna ho hia kɛse ma hormone ahorow, a nea ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ho ka ho. Sɛ w'anna yie a, wobrɛ, na w'tenka so kɔ fam. Kwati wee anaa cigarette nom, efi sɛ ɛde nsunsuansoɔ bɔne ba nipadua ne so. Wei tumi ha wo nna mu apɔwmuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi anya sikasɛm nketewa ho nhyehyɛe ahorow de afi nnwuma nketewa ase anaasɛ wɔatrɛw mu, adi adwumayɛ ho ntetee akyi, anaasɛ wɔde wɔn sika ahyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wonya sika mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm nketewa dwumadie denam: Sikasɛm asoɛeɛ nketewa (MFIs): Sikasɛm asoɛeɛ a ɛnyɛ sikakorabea a wɔyɛ adwuma titire wɔ bosea nketewa, sikakorabea, ne sikasɛm mu nnwuma foforɔ a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔn sikasɛm tebea nye, a mmabun ka ho. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de (NGOs): Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde sikasɛm nhyehyɛe nketewa, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne adwumayɛ nkɔso mmoa ma de ma mmabun tumi wɔ sikasɛm mu. Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ (CBOs): Mpɔtam hɔ akuo anaa fekuo a wɔde sikasɛm nketewa ho dwumadie, sikasɛm ho nteteeɛ, ne asetena mu mmoa ma mmabun ne wɔn mbusua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wobenya STI/HIV ano aduro ne nhomasua ho nnwuma a annhia awofoɔ mpeneso ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Atumfoɔ bebree wɔ mmara anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛgye hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam, a STI/HIV ano aduro ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ka ho. Saa mmara ahorow yi botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun anya ahofadi na wɔabɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban, na ama wɔatumi ahwehwɛ saa nnwuma yi a awofo pene so. Saa mmara ahorow yi taa da abrabɔ pa ho nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ obuo a wɔde ma mmabun ahofadi, kokoam nsɛm, ne nidi adi, ne tumi a mmabun tumi sakra a wɔde besisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho a wogye tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nea me nna akɔnnɔ ho yɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmuae a ɛfata anaa bere nhyehyɛe biako biara nni hɔ a wɔde besusuw eyi ho. Nnipa binom nim fi wɔn mmofraase, na afoforo nso gye bere pii. Nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Henanom na wuhu sɛ wɔn ani gye wɔn ho? Hwɛ wo atinka ne wo a worebɔ wo ho ban no yiye. So woyɛ w’adwene sɛ wo ne obi a ɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea pɔtee bi renya ɔdɔ? Nhyɛso biara nni hɔ a wode bɛhyɛ wo ho din. Wubetumi ahwehwɛ wo atinka mu a wunhia asɛmfua pɔtee bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa tebea horow a ebia wobehyia ɔsɔretia anaa akyigyina esiane sɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ no nti, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so akɔ so anya ahobammɔ na wɔatumi agyina ano bere a wɔreyɛ ade de abɔ afoforo ho ban na wɔama ahobammɔ ne obu anya nkɔso no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa tebea horow a ebia wobehyia ɔsɔretia anaa akyigyina esiane sɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ no nti denam: Ahobammɔ a Wɔde Di kan: Asane ahorow a ɛwɔ mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ankasa ahobammɔ adi kan bere a wɔresi gyinae sɛ ebia wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ wohyia ɔsɔretia anaa akyigyina a, mpanyimfo, nnamfo, anaa atumfoɔ a wogye wɔn di no mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ. Adanse a Wɔkyerɛw: Sɛ ɛyɛ nea asiane biara nni ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa a, wɔbɛkyerɛw tebea no ne adanse biara a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔayɛ bɔne de aboa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no. Ahoɔden a Wɔde Bɛboa: Nneɛma a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de adi nneyɛe bɔne biara a wɔbɛyɛ anaa nea ebefi mu aba bere a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ho dwuma. Nsakrae a Wɔkamfo: Wɔn suahu a wɔde bedi dwuma de akamfo nhyehyɛe ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛboa ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu na ɛma wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no bu wɔn nneyɛe ho akontaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun nso ?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun betumi ayɛ: Ankorankoro ayaresa: Nhyiamu a wɔne adwenemyareɛ ho ɔbenfoɔ yɛ mmiako mmiako de di nsɛm pɔtee bi a ɛhaw adwene anaa nsɛnnennen ho dwuma. Kuw mu ayaresa: Ayaresa nhyiam ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ kuw tebea mu a wɔne atipɛnfo a ebia wɔwɔ osuahu anaa nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn a ɛte saa ara. Abusua ayaresa: Afotu nhyiam ahorow a abusua mufo ka ho de di abusua mu nkɔso ho dwuma na wɔma nkitahodi tu mpɔn. Adwene ne nneyɛe ho nhwehwɛmu ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma: Nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a adwenemyare ho oduruyɛfo yɛ, a nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma ka ho bere a ɛho hia. Ɔhaw mu dwumadie: Mmoa ne mmoa a wɔde ma ntɛm ara wɔ adwenemyareɛ a ɛhia ntɛm anaa ɔhaw mu. Adwene mu akwahosan ho dwumadi a egyina sukuu so: Afotuo ne mmoa dwumadie a adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn de ma wɔ sukuu tebea mu. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a egyina mpɔtam hɔ: Mmoa akuw, atipɛnfo afotu, ne nnwuma afoforo a mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde anaa nnwumakuw de ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun yɛ soronko wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ no daa no ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun no yɛ soronko wɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔyɛ no daa ho wɔ akwan pii so: Wɔayɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛdi mmabun nkɔsoɔ, asetena, ne amammerɛ ahiadeɛ ho dwuma, na wɔde nnwuma ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa wɔn mfeɛ ne wɔn nkɔsoɔ gyinabea ho. Wɔde kokoamsɛm di kan, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no. Wɔde nnwuma ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun akwahosan ho nsɛm titiriw te sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan, adwenemyare, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano ma. Wɔde adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛnea wɔne mmerante ne mmabaa bedi nkitaho, anya ahotoso, na wɔde nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛyɛ nokware ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de anya adwuma a wobetumi de adi nsɛm a ɛfa awo ho nneɛma ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ GHS-YMK app. Kɔ mmeae a mmabun ani gye ho/sukuu. Hwehwɛ mmoafoɔ a wɔremmu wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata Intanɛt so nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention' dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ho, na so akwan bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛtumi apaw a wontua hwee?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho adwumayɛbea pii yɛ nea wontua hwee mma mmabun. Nanso, ebia nea aborɔfo ka no 'platform' ahorow bi de nnwuma a ɛyɛ fɛ anaasɛ nkrataahyɛ a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma foforo bɛma. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛhwɛ ɔsom no wɛbsaet anaasɛ wo ne wɔn di nkitaho tẽẽ de si ɛka a wɔbɔ no so dua na wobisa nneɛma biara a ɛwɔ hɔ a wontua hwee ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ na yɛakura tebea horow a ɛboa a ɛma wogye tom, obu, ne nkabom ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana amammra ne mmara mu asɛm a ɛfa LGBTQ+ nneyɛeɛ ho nti, wɔmma kwan mma nkabom anaa mmoa biara a ɛda adi wɔ bagua mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa kwan so no de nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ma bere a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ no ma ɛne sukuu anaa adwuma nhyehyɛe hyia?
answer_twi_source: Aane, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa taa de nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ma bere a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ no ma ɛne mmabun sukuu anaa adwuma nhyehyɛe hyia. Wɔte hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ase na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw ama mmerante ne mmabaa sɛ wobenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔrensɛe wɔn da biara da dwumadi ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ebehia sɛ mekɔ afotu anaa ayaresa nhyiam ahorow, na bere tenten ahe na mmere tenten ahe na no begye?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow ne bere tenten a wɔde ma afotu anaa ayaresa no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina w’ahiade ne w’atirimpɔw ahorow so, ne wo fotufo anaa wo ayaresa ho ɔbenfo nyansahyɛ ahorow so. Mfiase no, wubetumi akɔ nhyiam ahorow dapɛn biara anaa dapɛn abien biara de anya kwan atumi aka w'adwene na woayɛ nneɛma a ɛhaw wo ntɛm ara ho adwuma. Bere kɔ so no, ebia nhyiam ahorow no nyɛ nea ɛntaa nsi bere a wunya nkɔso na wunya ahoɔden a wode begyina ano no. Adeyɛ no tenten nso betumi ayɛ soronko, efi nhyiam kakraa bi so kosi asram pii anaa nea ɛboro saa, a egyina sɛnea wo nsɛm no mu yɛ den ne nkɔso a woanya wɔ ayaresa mu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuansoa ɛda edi ne ahorow a ɛtaa ba wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, na bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusu ho sɛ mɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuanoso a ɛtaa ba wɔ nna mu yareɛ ho no gu ahorow gyina ɔyare no so nanso ebetumi ayɛ: Nsu a ɛba ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu a ɛnyɛ nea wɔtaa hu. Ɛyaw anaa ɔhyew bere a ɔreto nsu. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu akisikuru, akuru, anaa akisikuru. Ɛyaw a ɛba bere a obi renya nna mu kyɛfa. Yafunu ase yaw anaasɛ ɛnyɛ dɛ. Susuw ho sɛ wobɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu ahwɛ sɛ ebia wowɔ nna mu yare bi: Bere a wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi a ahobammɔ nnim mu anaasɛ woanya nna mu ahokafo pii akyi. Sɛ wo anaa wo hokafo nya sɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ a. Ansa na wubefi nna mu abusuabɔ foforo ase. Sɛ nna mu yareɛ ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa no fa, titiriw sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo ne akwahosan ho ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ahyɛ mmabun nyinaa agye atom, na wɔaka wɔn nyinaa ho nkuran, a wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ, bɔbeasu, anaa awo a wɔpaw mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam ne akwahosan ho ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ biako ayɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho a ɛde hokwan ne yiyedi a mmabun nyinaa wɔ no di kan. Wobetumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ama nhyiam ahorow, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu ahorow de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wogye tom na wobu nneɛma ahorow tom wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ada nea ɛhaw me adi anaa mabisa nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛho hia ho a menhaw me ho sɛ wobebu me atɛn anaa wɔbɛtwe me aso?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ tebea a wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wobɛda wo haw ahorow adi anaasɛ wubebisa nsɛm a wunsuro sɛ wobebu wo atɛn anaa wobɛtwe wo aso. Fi ase denam wo nkate a wobɛda no adi wɔ nokwaredi ne obu mu, fa "me" nsɛm di dwuma de da wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate adi. Si ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubesua na woate asɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate no ase pii so dua, na si ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware mu no so dua. Sɛ ɛhaw wo sɛ wobebu wo atɛn anaa wɔbɛtwe wo aso a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛka wo haw ahorow akyerɛ ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso anaasɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi ɔfotufo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a obetumi aboa ma nkɔmmɔbɔ no ayɛ mmerɛw hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so siw HIV a ɛna de ma abofra no ano?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde akwan pii di dwuma de siw HIV a ɛna de ma ne ba ano. Eyinom bi ne: Wɔde nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa (ART) bɛma ɔbaa a onyinsɛn a ɔwɔ HIV no de asiw yare mmoawa no ano na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛkɔ akokoaa no mu no so atew. Nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde bɛma akokoaa no wɔ n’awo akyi na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obenya ɔyare no so atew bio. Awo a wɔpaw (C-section) a wɔbɛyɛ ama mmaa a wɔwɔ HIV a mmoawa pii wom na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya HIV bere a wɔrewo no so atew. Nufuo nkutoo a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran bere a ɛna ne akokoaa nyinaa wɔ Prophylaxis so wɔ akyi nsɛm mu no ɛnanom kwati nufu a wɔde ma na wɔde wɔn ho to Formula Feedi so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ɔyare no denam nufusu so no so bɛtew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na m’abusua atumi ayɛ tebea a animtiaabu nnim a wodi adwenem akwahosan ho nsɛm ho dwuma pefee na wonni atɛn "judgement"?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ abusuafo adwenem apowmuden "mental health" ho asɛm na kasa tia adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu. Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran na yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asusuw adwenemyare ho a wonni atɛn. Hyɛ tema ne ntease ho nkuran ma ankorankoro a wohyia adwenemyare ho nsɛnnennen. Fa nhwɛso di anim denam w’ankasa w’adwene mu akwahosan ho osuahu ahorow a wobɛda no adi pefee na woahwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no so. Kamfo adwenemyareɛ ho nimdeɛ ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ w’abusua ne mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mewɔ wɔ mmara kwan so sɛ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn anaasɛ meyɛ ɔwofo? (awofo pene, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya) .
answer_twi_source: Ghana mmara a ɛfa mmabun nyinsɛn ho no betumi ayɛ nea emu yɛ den. Nneɛma bi a ɛbɛma woasua pii afa wo mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho ni: Ghana Legal Aid Commission: Ebia wɔde mmara mu afotu anaa nneɛma bɛma. di sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa mmabun adamfofa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni a ɔwɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no nkyɛn na ɔne nnwumakuo ahorow a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a wɔde mmara kwan so nnwuma ma mmabun anaa asetra mu yiyedi dwumadibea a ɛwɔ ɔmantam no mu no nni nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow nya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a mmabun nya no so nsusuaso?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi anya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a mmabun betumi anya so nsusuaso wɔ akwan horow so. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara a anohyeto wom betumi asiw mmabun a wontumi nnya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan no ano, na ɛde akyɛde anaasɛ akwanside ahorow aba wɔ ɔhwɛ a wobenya wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu no mu. Bio nso, saa mmara ahorow yi betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ animtiaabu ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho a ɛtrɛw, na ebetumi aka sɛnea mmabun nya nsɛm a edi mu, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nnwuma afoforo a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abɔ wɔn ho ban afi adwumam nyiyimu a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wɔadi, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuakuw, anaa abusuakuw a wofi mu so no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi abɔ wɔn ho ban afi adwumam nyiyim ho denam: Hokwan ahorow a wobehu: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛko tia nyiyimu a ɛbara nyiyim a egyina mfe, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuakuw, abusuakuw, anaa su afoforo a wɔabɔ ho ban so a wobehu wɔn ho yiye. Nsɛm a esisii a wɔbɛkyerɛw: nyiyim suban anaa nneyɛe biara a wɔahu anaa wɔahu wɔ adwumam ho kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛyɛ. Amanneɛbɔ a ɛhaw adwene: nyiyim ho nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ kyerɛ nnipa, adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ no mu, di akwan a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ a wɔfa so de anwiinwii kɔdan no akyi. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ: Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ nyiyim ho de hwɛ amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe no so na wodi nyiyim ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenemyare nya da biara da asetra, nkitahodie, ne yiyedi nyinaa so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu yare betumi aka da biara da asetra, nkitahodie, ne yiyedi nyinaa kɛse. Ebia ɛbetumi aha sukuu adwumayɛ, nnipa ntam nkitahodi, ne abusua mu nkɔso, na ɛde tew a wɔatew wɔn ho, ntawntawdi, ne ɔhaw ahorow aba wɔ asɛyɛde ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma mu. Bio nso, adwenemyare betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya nipadua mu akwahosan ho haw no ayɛ kɛse na sɛ wɔansa a, asetra pa so tew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmaa a wɔyem a wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ na ama PMTCT ayɛ yie?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa dwumadie ahodoɔ  wɔ hɔ ma mmaa a wɔyem a wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a PMTCT bɛdi nkonim. Eyinom betumi ayɛ: Ɔhwɛ a edi mũ a wobenya ansa na wɔawoɔ ne nna mu yareɛ ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe, a ART a wofi ase ne mmoa a wɔde di akyi ka ho. Afotu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa PMTCT, nkokoaa aduan a ahobammɔ wom ho nneyɛe, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho. Adwene ne asetra mu mmoa ne atipɛnfo afotu a wɔde bedi nkate ne asetra mu haw ahorow a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ ne nyinsɛn ho ho dwuma. Aduan pa ho mmoa ne mmoa a wobenya de adi aduan a wonnya nni anaa aduan pa a wonnya nni ho dwuma. Wɔde kɔ mmoa dwumadie foforɔ te sɛ asetena mu nnwuma, adan ho mmoa, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛhia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔ awo so ma nea onyinsɛn ne akokoaa no nyinaa? (nsɛnnennen a ɛso tew, awo a ɛma apɔwmuden) .
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde hwɛ ansa na wɔawo no so ba wo ne wo ba no nyinaa so mfaso: Ma Wo: Asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nyinsɛn mu nsɛnnennen te sɛ nea broni frɛ no 'preeclampsia' anaa nyinsɛn mu asikreyare no so tew. Ma Wo Ba: Asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛwo ntɛm, awo mu duru a ɛba fam, ne awo mu dɛmdi so tew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nyamesom di wɔ nkorɔfoɔ suban a ɛda adi fa mmabunyɛ mmerɛ ne nna mu agorɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Abrabɔ Pa Ho Akwankyerɛ: Ɔsom ahorow pii de abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nna ho, na mpɛn pii no ɛboa ma nkorɔfoɔ de wɔn ho sie ma awareɛ. Nhomasua: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ so tumi kyerɛ sɛdeɛ nna mu agorɔ ho adesua besi afa. Animtiaabu anaa Gye a Wogye Tom: Ebia nyamesom ahorow bi bɛbɔ nna mu nneyɛe bi animtiaa, bi so gye to mu. Abusua mu Nkɔso: Nyamesom mu gyidi betumi aha abusua nkɔmmɔ ne gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna ho. Ankorankoro Gyidi: Ankorankoro betumi anya awerɛkyekye anaa akasakasa wɔ wɔn nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wɔn ankasa suahunu ahorow ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛmti bi a wɔtaa ka ho asɛm wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, a atipɛnfo di anim mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛmti a wɔtaa ka no bi ne: Awo nhyehyɛe no nipadua ne nipadua ho adesua. Akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne sɛnea etu mpɔn. Nnna mu nyarewa (STI) a wosiw ano, a nsɛm a ɛfa ɔyare mmoawa ne sɔhwɛ ho ka ho. Mpene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa. Nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw, a awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho. Bɔbeasu ne nna mu nsonsonoe, a ɛhyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa a wɔyɛ nyinaa ho nkuran. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne gyinaesi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa adwuma bɛn na wɔtaa de ma mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu no betumi anya mmoa nnwuma ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ntetee ne ahokokwaw nkɔso: Nhyehyɛe ahorow no ma adwuma ho ahosiesie ntetee, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne afotu hokwan ahorow de boa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma wonya adwumayɛbea ho nimdeɛ a ɛho hia te sɛ nkitahodi, kuw adwuma, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne bere nhyehyɛe. Afotuo ne akwankyerɛ: Wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ bi no bɛtumi anya akwankyerɛ ne mmoa afiri nhyehyɛeɛ no adwumayɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa afotufoɔ hɔ de adi wɔn ankasa, adesua, anaa adwuma ho nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn daakye ho. Sikasɛm mu mmoa: Nhyehyɛe ahorow bi de sika a wɔde boa, akwantu ho nkrataa, anaa sikasɛm mu nkuranhyɛ ma de boa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma wotua ɛka a ɛfa wɔn kyɛfa a wonya ho, te sɛ akwantu, adwuma ntade, anaa mmofra hwɛ ho. Nkitahodi hokwan ahorow: Nkitahodi ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe betumi ama nkitahodi ho nhyiam ahorow, nnwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa nsɛm a wobisabisa nkurɔfo de aboa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma wɔatrɛw wɔn adwumayɛfo nkitahodi mu na wɔne wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ afotufo ne adwumawuranom adi nkitaho. Nnwuma a wɔde kata so: Dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri betumi de nnwuma a wɔde kata so te sɛ adesua mu mmoa, akwahosan ho dwumadie, mmofra hwɛ, anaa adan ho mmoa ama de adi wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no ahiadeɛ nyinaa ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ wɔn yiedie nyinaa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow boa ma wɔtew nkɛntɛnso a sikasɛm mu ahodwiriw, abɔde mu asiane, ntawntawdi, ɔyaredɔm, anaa nneɛma afoforo a egye ntɛmpɛ nya wɔ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua so no ase?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow yɛ adwuma sɛ nea ɛma obi ho dwiriw no wɔ ɔhaw ahorow mu denam mmoa a wɔde ma ntɛm ara, sikasɛm mu mmoa, anaa mmoa a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔde ma mmabun a ɛka wɔn ne wɔn mmusua no so. Wɔboa ma sikasɛm mu ahodwiriw, abɔde mu asiane, ntawntawdi, ɔyaredɔm, anaa tebea afoforo a egye ntɛmpɛ de ba no so tew denam afie sika a wɔma ɛyɛ den, hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya nnwuma a ɛho hia, ne nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ a wɔbɔ wɔn ho ban na wɔanhwe ase kɛse wɔ ohia anaa ohia mu no so. Asetena mu ahobanbɔ ho nhyehyɛe nso boa ma wɔhyɛ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, hyɛ mpɔtam hɔfo biakoyɛ mu den, na wɔhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsan asiesie wɔn ho na wɔasan akyekye wɔ ɔhaw ahorow akyi, na ɛma nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa ne yiyedi a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ ma mmabun ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ apɔwmu teɛteɛ a wɔyɛ no daa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu so?
answer_twi_source: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔyɛ no daa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no de mfaso pii ba: Nipadua mu Akwahosan: Ɛma koma ne ntini mu ahoɔden tu mpɔn, ɛhyɛ ntini ne nnompe den, na ɛboa ma obi mu duru kɔ so yɛ papa. Adwene mu Akwahosan: Ɛtew adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw so. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ma nea aborɔfo ka no 'endorphins' a ɛyɛ nnuru a "ɛte nka sɛ wo ho ye" no fi adi. Ahoɔden a Ɛwɔ Hɔ: Ɛma ahoɔden kɔ soro na ɛma nna tu mpɔn, na ɛma obiara nya yiyedi pa. Nnompe Akwahosan: Nneɛma a wɔde soa mu duru hyɛ nnompe mu den, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya nnompe mu yare akyiri yi wɔ nkwa nna mu no so. Bu a Wobu Wɔn Ho a Ɛkɔ Anim: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho yɛ den na wotumi yɛ ade a, ebetumi ama obi anya ahotoso wɔ ne ho na wayɛ nipadua ho mfonini kɛse. Ayɔnkofa mu Nkitahodi: Sɛ obi de ne ho hyɛ kuo agumadi anaa kuo dwumadi ahorow mu a, ebetumi ama asetra mu nimdeɛ ne nnamfofa ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea atipɛnfo ne atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a wɔde wɔn adwene si sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde ma mmabun so?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun di anim: Atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwumayɛ so no ma ntetee, afotu, ne sikasɛm hokwan ahorow ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔyɛ adwuma no ma wofi wɔn nnwuma ase na wonyin. Adwuma a wɔhwehwɛ mu nhyiamu: Atipɛnfoɔ afotufoɔ hyehyɛ adwumayɛbea, adwumayɛ ho nhyiamu, ne nsɛm ho nhyiamu de boa wɔn atipɛnfoɔ ma wɔhwehwɛ adwumayɛ akwan ahodoɔ mu, wɔne adwumayɛfoɔ di nkitaho, na wɔnya nhumu wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ ho. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ɔsatuo: Atipɛnfoɔ afotufoɔ di nnwuma a wɔde bɛhyɛ sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ  nkuran wɔ wɔn atipɛnfoɔ mu denam nhyiamu, nkitahodiɛ dwumadiɛ, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne nsusuwii bɛn na ɛwɔ dijitaal sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma mu, te sɛ data kokoam nsɛm, kɔmputa so ahobammɔ, anaa dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw?
answer_twi_source: Bere a dijitaal sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ma mfaso pii no, ɛde asiane ahorow te sɛ: Data kokoam nsɛm ho haw ahorow a ɛfa ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano ne nea wɔde di dwuma ho nso ba. Cybersecurity ahunahuna te sɛ hacking anaasɛ identity theft. Digitals akenkan ne akyerɛw ho akwansideɛ, titiriw ma wɔn a wonnim mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ. Digitals platform ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho to so dodo, a ebetumi ama ankorankoro a wonni mfiridwuma anaa intanɛt nkitahodi no agyae sikasɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi atwe meho efiri akɔnnɔ nnuan a ahoɔden nnim ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnuan a ahoɔden nnim ho akɔnnɔ a wobɛhwɛ so wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no betumi ayɛ den, nanso ebetumi aba wɔ akwan horow bi so: Di kan yɛ nhyehyɛe: Ma nnuan a ahoɔden wom a wode besiw akɔnnɔ ano. Sɛ nnuan a ɛnyɛ papa sɔ wo hwɛ a, fa wo nsa ka nnuaba, nhabannuru, nnuaba, anaa nea aborɔfo ka no 'yogurt' no. Nkɔso: Ma wo ho kwan ma w’ani nnye aduan a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so. Sɛ wosiw nnuan ano koraa a, ebetumi ama wanya akɔnnɔ a emu yɛ den kɛse. Adidi a Ɛwɔ Adwene Mu: Yɛ aso wɔ wo kɔm ho nsɛnkyerɛnne ho. So ɔkɔm de wo ampa anaasɛ mfonoe anaa nkate nti na wodidi? Nom nso mmere biaa: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, wobetumi adi mfomso abu sukɔm sɛ ɔkɔm. Di kan nom nsu bere a wote nka sɛ wo kɔn dɔ no. Twe W’adwene: Fa wo ho hyɛ nneɛma a w’ani gye ho te sɛ nantew, nhoma a wobɛkenkan, anaa nnwom a wobɛtie mu, na ama w’adwene afi akɔnnɔ so. Nsesa a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ahoɔden wom a wode besi nnuan a ahoɔden nnim a w’ani gye ho no ananmu. Sɛ nhwɛso no, sesa nea aborɔfo ka no 'chips de popcorn anaa soda' de nsu a ɛyɛ hyew a nnuaba ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ahoɔden agyina nyin mu nsesaeɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: Esi pitinn 'building resilience': Kasa pa ma wo ho. Gye wo nsesaeɛ tom. Hwehwɛ nnamfo pa (Nnipa wɔ boa).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ne wɔn mmusua betumi agye wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ atom?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna yɛ ankorankoro akwantu. Sɛnea mmusua betumi afa so ni: Yɛ Beae a Ahobammɔ: Ma wo ba nhu sɛ obetumi aba wo nkyɛn de nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen a ɛfa wɔn nna ho a ɔremmu atɛn. Bu Wɔn Nipasu: Ma wo ba no kwan ma ɔnhwehwɛ wɔn nna mu wɔ n’ankasa nsɛm ne n’ankasa ahoɔhare so. Di Nneɛma Ahorow Ho Afahyɛ: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna yɛ ade a ɛkɔ so, na ankorankoro biara akwantu yɛ soronko.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ adetɔfo a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ, adebɔfo, ne akamfofo a, wɔde nsiyɛ hyehyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nsase ma ɛda nokwasɛm ahorow ne osuahu ahorow a, ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho adi?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ adetɔfo a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ, adebɔfo, ne akamfofo a wɔde nsiyɛ hyehyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsase ma ɛda nokwasɛm ahorow ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho adi denam: Nsusuwii a emu yɛ den a wobenya de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu na wɔasɔ ahwɛ na wɔahu animhwɛ, nsusuwii hunu, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ. Digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ a wobenya de ayɛ na wɔakyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu na ɛhyɛ gyinabea pa ho nkuran. Nkitahodi ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyekye de ne atipɛnfo, abusuafo, ne mpɔtam akannifo adi nkitaho wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo ne asetra mu nsakrae ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a ɛma hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya ahokokwaw, adwumayɛkuw, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Adeyɛ a wɔbɛyɛ de ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nneyɛe a ɛfa abrabɔ pa ne nea ɛka obiara ho ho nkuran, akamfo ananmusifo ahorow ahorow, na wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛda wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn suahu adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛfa nsɛm te sɛ mmofra aware, mmea awotwaa a wotwitwa/twitwa (FGM/C), ne awo a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ awo ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe te sɛ mmofra aware, mmea awotwaa a wotwitwa/twitwa (FGM/C), ne awo a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ no nya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ mmabun SRH so. Saa nneyɛe yi bu nnipa hokwan ahorow so, ɛma mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ kɔ so, na ɛde asiane ba mmabun nipadua ne wɔn adwene mu akwahosan so, a asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya nsɛnnennen bere a wɔrewo ne adwene mu ahodwiriw a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi akyerɛkyerɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔde anigye bɛ pene so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Anigye a wɔde pene so no kyerɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa ani agye ankasa na wɔn ho pere wɔn sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi no mu. Ɛsi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen, wɔ ɔkwan pa so ne wɔn ho wɔn ho akɔnnɔ so dua, sen sɛ wobegye atum a wɔnyɛ hwee anaasɛ wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na wɔde sie wɔ ahokyere bere mu, na bere bɛn na wobetumi asɛe kokoamsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, wɔde nsɛm a wɔkyɛ wɔ ɔhaw mu dwumadi nhyiamu ase, a nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho haw ho nsɛm ka ho, bɛsie. Nea ɛka kokoamsɛm ho no betumi ayɛ tebea horow a asiane a ɛreba a ɛbɛma wɔapira obi, a wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ no ayayade anaa wɔabu ani agu so, anaa bere a mmara hwehwɛ no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu nsɛm a wotumi gye di, a egyina adanse so ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho wɔ dijitaal nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu nsɛm a wotumi gyedi, a egyina adanse so ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho wɔ dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu denam fibea ahorow a wɔatwe adwene asi so no a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, ahwɛ sɛ ebia animhwɛ anaa akasakasa wɔ hɔ, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa abenfo a wɔagye din wɔ adwuma no mu a wobebisabisa wɔn nsɛm no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn m'ate mmara nsesaeɛ ho nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔmden nhyehyeɛ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfra no sɛ 'sexual and reproductive health policies' a ebetumi de ɔhaw aberɛ me?
answer_twi_source: M'awani nkɔ nsɛmkaeɛ anaa kaseɛboɔ ne aban ntetntanfidie ahodoɔ ho deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'websites'. Kyerɛ wo din nsɛmtwerɛfoɔ mfidie ahodoɔ so. Kɔ mpɔtam nhyiamu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɔkota betumi akyerɛ me m' ayaresa hokwan ahorow  anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Ɛyɛ wɔn asɛdeɛ. Bisa wɔn ma wɔnkyerɛ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na etu mpɔn wɔ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne adwene ne asetena mu yiyedi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun a ahodwiriw ne amanehunu a ɛfa ntawntawdi ho aka wɔn no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa: Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ne kuo afotu ma mmabun nya hokwan ne afoforo a wɔakyɛ osuahu ahorow di nkitaho, na ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ biako na wɔyɛ biako. Mpɔtamu hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, mpaninfoɔ, ne atetesɛm mu ayaresafoɔ a wɔne wɔn di nkitaho no bɛtumi ama mmabun anya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ foforɔ, ahyɛ wɔn ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano no mu den. Adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi: Adwinni mu ayaresa, agumadi, ne adebɔ dwumadi ahorow ma mmabun nya akwan foforo a wɔfa so da wɔn ho adi na wɔma adwennwen so tew, na ɛma adwene ne nneyɛe mu yiyedi ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ɔhaw ne amanehunu a ɛfa ntawntawdi ho no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ sɛ mete nka sɛ wɔabu m'apɔmuden hokwan so a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔabu m'apɔmuden hokwan so a, wubetumi afa akwan yi so: Kyerɛ wo haw kyerɛ w'apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ anaa adwumakuo no ɔyarefoɔ ututufoɔ 'facility's patient advocate'. Kyerɛw asɛm no ho nsɛm nyinaa to hɔ, a nla, bere, ne nkurɔfoɔ a asɛm no fa wɔn ho ka ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi panyin a wogye no di hɔ, te sɛ awofoɔ, ɔhwɛfoɔ, anaa sukuu mu ofotufoɔ. Susu sɛ wobɛbɔ soboɔ akyerɛ apɔmuden adwumakuo no anaa tumidi a ɛhwɛ so no. Ne akuo a wɔkasa ma nkurɔfoɔ anaa mmara mu mmoa ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔnim apɔmuden hokwan ho yiye nkasa na nya mmoa a ɛkɔ akyiri.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho nsɛmti ho no, haw mmabun a wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, mmoa, ne nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfo animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no betumi anya mmabun a wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, mmoa, ne nnwuma kɛse. Animtiaabu ne nyiyim betumi ama wɔate aniwu anaa aniwu nka, na asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma a ɛho hia anaasɛ wobebisa nsɛm afa wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔtrɛw wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi ama atosɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a epira akɔ so, na ɛde adwene mu naayɛ "confusions" ne nneyɛe a asiane wom aba. Bio nso, suro a wosuro sɛ wɔn atipɛnfo, abusua, anaa mpɔtam hɔfo bebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛpow wɔn no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wobenya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, na ama nsonsonoe aba nimdeɛ ne ɔhwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akasa yie akyere me nimpa ma ede abusuabɔ pa adeyɛ aba?
answer_twi_source: Apam a edi mu wɔ abusuabɔ mu no hwehwɛ sɛ obi yɛ nokware, obu onipa, na ɔda ayamye adi. Ɛho hia sɛ woda wo ho adi pefee na woyɛ komm, na wode 'Me' nsɛm di dwuma de kyerɛ w'adwene ne w'ahomegyefo a wunni fɛw anaa wunni adwene. Tie w'ahomegyefo no adwene na si wɔn ahomegyefo so dua. Fa ayamye di dwuma na bɔ mmɔden yiye sɛ wubehu wɔn adwene. Yɛ okyinnsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm a esisi ho nsɛmti no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa wɔn honam ani hwɛbea ho no so bere a wɔkɔ so kura adwene a ɛfata mu sɛ wɔsom bo?
answer_twi_source: Ɛhyeɛ a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Ahye a wɔde besi hɔ atwa nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nneyɛe a ɛfa animhwɛ ho ahyia na wɔasi wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow so dua. Abusuabɔ a Ɛboa a Wɔpaw: Wɔde mfɛfo ne nnamfo a wogye wɔn tom na wɔkyerɛ wɔn ho anisɔ wɔ onipa ko a wɔyɛ a ɛboro honam ani hwɛbea so atwa wɔn ho ahyia. Ɛsi Pintinn Gyinae, nea broni ka no 'Developing Assertiveness': Pitinn gyinae nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma de ada wɔn ahiade, nea wɔpɛ, ne wɔn ahye adi wɔ ahotoso ne obu mu. Su horow a ɛwɔ mu a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so: Adwene a wɔbɛdan afi akyi hwɛbea so akɔ mu su horow, ahoɔden, ne nneɛma a wotumi yɛ a ɛboa ma obi bu ne ho ne nipasu. Hwehwɛ a Wobɛhwehwɛ Sɛ Wogye Di Wɔ Wo Mu: Wodua wo ho a wohu no mmɔbɔ, ne wo ho a wobɛgye atom sene sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ abɔnten so adansedie anaa pene afiri afoforo hɔ a egyina sɛnea wo ho yɛ fɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abusuabɔ bɛn na ɛda mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne basabasayɛ anaa nhyɛso afoforo ntam, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmarima ne mmea ho atinka a wobedi ho dwuma no betumi aboa ma wɔabɔ asetena mu atɛntrenee ho mmɔdenbɔ a ɛtrɛw?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ a ɛda mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne basabasayɛ ne nhyɛso afoforo ntam no wɔ abusuabɔ kɛse. Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no ma tumi a ɛnkari pɛ a ebetumi de basabasayɛ ahorow aba, a nna mu basabasayɛ, ahokafo a wɔbɛn wɔn ho basabasayɛ, ne nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmarima ne mmea a wɔato wɔn hintidua ka ho no kɔ so tra hɔ. Bɔbeasu ho atinka a wobedi ho dwuma no ho hia efisɛ ɛnyɛ sɛ edi nneɛma a ɛde nna mu basabasayɛ ba no ntini ho dwuma nko, na mmom ɛboa ma asetena mu atɛntrenee mmɔdenbɔ a ɛtrɛw nso denam nhyehyɛe mu nhyɛso a ɛkasa tia ne pɛyɛ a ɛhyɛ ho nkuran ma mmarima ne mmea nyinaa so. Ɛdenam nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so ne animhwɛ a wɔbɛte ase na wɔadi ho dwuma so no, mmabun betumi ayɛ mpɔtam a obiara ka ho na ɛyɛ pɛ a obiara te nka sɛ ɔwɔ ahobammɔ, obu, na ɛsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi afahyɛ na m'agye m’amammerɛ mu nipasu atom bere a merehwehwɛ adwene foforo nso mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho hyɛ amammerɛ mu nhyiamu, atetesɛm, anaa afahyɛ a ɛde wo bata w’agyapadeɛ ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ nhoma, sini, anaa adwinni a efi amammerɛ ahorow mu mu na ama wo ntease atrɛ. Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie a, hwehwɛ amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu ankasa denam akwantuo anaa nsakraeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ so. Gye w’amammerɛ kasa tom anaa sua kasa foforo na ama wo ne adwene ahorow adi nkitaho. Fa wo ho ma anaa wo ne mpɔtam hɔ akuw a wodi amammerɛ ahorow ho afahyɛ no nni nkitaho. Fa anigyeɛ ne pefeeyɛ bɛn adwene foforɔ, na hu osuahu ahodoɔ a ɛdɔɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mehyia sɛnkyerɛnne anaa ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho a minnim ho hwee a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne Wo Demafo no Nkasa: Sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛyɛ wo yaw anaasɛ ɛhaw wo a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛyɛ nhyehyɛe akɔhwɛ wo. Fa Nsɛmma Nhoma: Kyerɛw sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow, bere a ɛba, ne nhwɛso biara a wo ne wo ɔyarehwɛfo no bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ. Frɛ ma Akwankyerɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo binom wɔ ayarehwɛfo nhama a wubetumi afrɛ akɔhwehwɛ afotu wɔ bere a wɔahyɛ no ntam. Fa mmabun akwahosan ho dwumadie di dwuma: dwumadie bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma nsɛm a mfasoɔ wɔ so fa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho. Nhwɛso ''YMK app Gye Wo 'Instincts': Sɛ biribi te nka sɛ egye ntɛmpɛ anaasɛ emu yɛ den a, hwehwɛ oduruyɛfo ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan pa bɛn na mɛfa so ada m'atenka adi na m'atumi nso ahyɛ meho so wɔ ntawatawa berɛ mu wɔ berɛkro a mesane nso rebu mensa?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woresua akwan pa a wobɛfa so ada suban pa adi wɔ berɛkro a worebu wɔnsa ho hia pa ara yei. Akwan no bi ni: Ka woboso asɛm: Ka woatenka kyerɛ wo nnamfo, w’abusuafoɔ, anaa ɔfotufoɔ anaa obi a wowɔ ne mu gyedie. Journaling: Twerɛ wo nsusuiɛ ne woatenka wɔ journal mu. Yie betumi ayɛ kokoam kwan a wɔfa so di atenka ahodoɔ ho dwuma. Adwene ne Ahomegye: Fa adwene mu nhumu ho akwan, home a emu dɔ, anaa adwendwen di dwumadie ahodoɔ ɛboa te ɔberɛ ne atenka so.
