Apɔ-mu-tenetene: Fa wo ho hyɛ apɔmuateneatene a w’ani gye ho mu na ebetumi aboa. Ɔhaw Ahosiesie: Sɛ wuhyia ntawantawa a, bɔ mmɔden sɛ wode adwene a ɛbɛma woasiesie adi dwuma. Pɛ anoyie na ɛnyɛ deɛ ɛbɛtwem anaa ɛbɛma ɔhaw no akɔ soro. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ woatenka kɔ soro a anaa sɛ ayɛ kɛse a hwehwɛ mmoa ntɛm so firi ahwɛfoɔ, sukuu ayarehwɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ anaa adwenemyareɛ ho abenfo hɔ. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛte nka ahodoɔ wɔ berɛ a worebu wonsa na wapɛ kwan pa a wobetumi de asɔ ano. Sɛ woredi saa haw yi ho dwuma wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu ɛnyɛ ade foforɔ koraa. Woapɔmden ho nsɛm hia na mmoa nso wɔ ho akwanasa nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn nneyɛe ne wɔn nhyehyɛe ahorow ne nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow hyia na wɔkyerɛ obu ma mmabun nidi, kokoamsɛm, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnyɛ nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn nneyɛe ne wɔn nhyehyɛe ahorow ne nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow hyia na wɔkyerɛ obu ma mmabun nidi, kokoamsɛm, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnyɛ nyiyim denam: Adwumayɛfo abrabɔ pa ho mmara ne nneyɛe ho gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde obu ma ayarefo ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, ne amammerɛ mu nkate a wɔde di kan no so. Nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adamfofa, ɛnyɛ atemmuo, na ɛka obiara ho a ɛyɛ mmerɛ, ne boɔ yɛ den, na ɛkyerɛ obuo ma mmabun hokwan ne wɔn apɛdeɛ. Ntetee ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ so mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ama wɔn nimdeɛ ne wɔn ahokokwaw akɔ anim wɔ ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so ahiade soronko ne wɔn haw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma mu, titiriw wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa yiye. Nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne ahyehyɛde mu nsakrae a ɛhyɛ nnipa hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi afa so asusuw ho wo sɛnea me nneyɛe ne me gyinapɛn ne me gyidi atitiriw hyia no ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo suahu ahorow a wo afamu ɛfa wo nneyɛe ne wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi atitiriw a wubesusuw na woasusuw ho no yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma w’ankasa wo nyin. Akwan baako a wobɛtumi de adi dwuma ne journaling, baabi a wokyerɛw wo suahunu, nsusuiɛ, ne nkateɛ a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho gyinaesie ho. Gye bere hwehwɛ wo nneyɛe mu na susuw ho sɛ ebia ɛda wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow adi anaa. Hwehwɛ nsɛm fi afotufo anaa nnamfo a wogye wɔn di a wɔne wo gyinapɛn ahorow yɛ pɛ hɔ na ama woanya adwene foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akari pɛ wɔ nnwuma a wɔhwehwɛ ne wɔn asɛyɛde afoforo te sɛ; nhomasua, abusua mu asɛde ahorow, anaa asetra mu bɔhyɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛ ne asɛde afoforo te sɛ nhomasua, abusua asɛyɛde, anaa asetena mu bɔhyɛ ahorow a wɔbɛkari pɛ no hwehwɛ bere a wɔde di dwuma yiye, nneɛma a wɔde di kan, ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ. Mmabun betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, de ahye a emu da hɔ asi hɔ, na wɔakyekyɛ bere pɔtee bi ama dwumadi ahorow. Wobetumi de abusua mufo anaa atipɛnfo aka wɔn adwumayɛ ho mmɔdenbɔ mu de akyɛ asɛyɛde ahorow na wɔanya mmoa. Bio nso, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu di nkitaho no boa ma wodi akwanhwɛ ahorow ho dwuma na wodi ntawntawdi ahorow a ebetumi aba no ho dwuma denneennen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na sikasɛm nhumu ne nimdeɛ 'financial literacy' boa mmabun w4 biribiara mu?
answer_twi_source: Ma nimdeɛ fa sika di ho. Wotumi sisi gyinaeɛ pa. Ɛma ahofadi ne ahotɔ. Ɛboa ma wotumi yɛ botaeɛ wode si w'ani so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun bere a wɔrehwehwɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu na wɔresisi nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinae no?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ tumi a obi tumi nya, hwehwɛ mu, susuw ho, na ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛmudɔ. Ɛho hia kɛse ma mmabun bere a wɔrehwehwɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu na wɔresisi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho efisɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ di dwuma titiriw wɔ suban, gyidi, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa saa nsɛmti yi ho a wɔhyehyɛ no mu. Ɛnam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wobenya so no, mmabun betumi abɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔwɔ nhumu kɛse, a wotumi hu animhwɛ, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne nna ne nkitahodie ho mfonini anaa nsɛm ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ gyinae a misisi no boa me ma mitumi sisi gyinae pa, mitumi gyina atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ a ɛmfata ano, na mayɛ m'apɔwmuden ne m'asetena yie wɔ nna agodie ne awoɔ nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaesi ahorow a atwam a wubesusu ho na wode nea efi mu aba a wode bɛtoto ho ansa na wode gyinaesi nhwɛso ahorow adi dwuma ne bere a wode bedi dwuma akyi. Sɛ́ wobɛhwɛ sɛ ebia gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow boaa wo ma wususu akwan horow a wubetumi afa so ho, asusu nea ebefi mu aba ho, na woapaw nneɛma a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia anaa. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ wɔ wo gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a enya wɔ wo nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ne yiedie so no ho. Nsakrae a ɛba wo ahotoso, wo ka a woka denneennen, ne sɛnea wotumi gyina ano wɔ atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛso tebea horow mu a wobɛhwɛ so bere a wode gyinaesi akwan horow adi dwuma akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotu ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi ɔhaw a ɛfa nna ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Gye a wogye tom: Afotufo de tebea a ɛnyɛ atemmu ma a wɔde hwehwɛ nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu. Wɔboa wo ma wogye wɔn ho tom na wote wo ho ase. Nhomasua ne Nsɛm: Afotu de nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛboa ma adwene mu naayɛ mu da hɔ ho ma na ɛma ɔkwan a wobɛfa so apue anaa wobɛte wo nipasu ase. Akwan a Wɔfa so Gyina Ano: Ayaresa ho animdefo kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wogyina nyiyim, pow a wɔpow, anaa animtiaabu a wɔde hyɛ obi mu ho dwuma. Akwan horow no bi ne ntetee a wɔde ma obi a ɔyɛ nkatee, adwennwen ano aduru, ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho. Mmoa Nkitahodi: Mmoa akuw anaa afotu a wɔne atipɛnfo a wohyia ɔhaw a ɛte saa ara ma no ma wonya mpɔtam hɔfo ho adwene. Afoforo nsɛm a wobɛte na woaka w’ankasa de akyerɛ no betumi ama wo tumi. Abusua Ntamgyinafo: Afotufo betumi ama abusua nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ho no ayɛ mmerɛw. Wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ sɛnea kwan a wɔbɛ fa so aba abusua mufo nkyɛn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nipadua mu kasa ne nkitahodie a ɛnyɛ kasa di wɔ akokodruo ne aniɔden a wɔda no adi mu berɛ a wɔresusu nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua mu kasa ne nkitahodi a ɛnyɛ kasa di dwuma titiri wɔ ahotoso ne asɛm a wɔka no denneennen a wɔda no adi mu ber a wɔresusu nsɛmti a ɛyɛ ɛfa atenka ho sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho no. Nipadua mu kasa pa, te sɛ aniwa a wobɛkɔ so ahwɛ, gyinabea anaa tena a wobɛtena hɔ tẽẽ, ne nsa a wɔde yɛ ade a ɛda adi pefee no betumi akyerɛ sɛ wowɔ akokoduro. Sɛ wokwati sɛ wobɛbɔ wo ho ban anaasɛ wobɛbrɛ wo ho ase, te sɛ nsa a wobɛtwa anaasɛ wobɛkwati sɛ wobɛhwɛ w’ani a, ebetumi aboa ma woaka wo nkrasɛm no yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɔne bɛn na mmabun fa so siesie wɔn haw, na kwan pa bɛn na wɔbetumi afa so?
answer_twi_source: Bɔne: Nnubɔne, Deɛ wode wo ho sie (Avoidance), Wo ho a wopira (Self-Harm). Pa: Mmoa hwehwɛ, Anigyeɛ (nsa nu dwuma/nnwom), Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ,Sɛ wobenya adwene pa afa biribi ho .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛn na ɛkɔ so wɔ mpɔtam fa SRH ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie ahodoɔ, yɛkyerɛ, atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ. Ti nsɛm: Nna mu ahobammɔ, nna mu nyarewa bammɔ, nkitahodie pa, penee ne ɔhaw nsoanoo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ Ghana? (sɛ nhwɛso no, awofo pene ho mmara, mfe a obi adi) .
answer_twi_source: Ghana mmara a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho no renya nkɔso. Nea yenim mprempren ni: Ɔman no mu hyeɛto biara nni mfe a obi adi a ɛbɛma wanya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano. Mpɛn pii no, ɛho nhia sɛ awofo pene so na ama wɔanya nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano wɔ Ghana. Nanso, ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo binom wɔ wɔn ankasa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmofra nkumaa mu ho, titiri wɔ akwan bi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛfa akwan pa so asie sika ama daakye ne nneɛma pa wɔde sika no bɛ yɛ ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde sika no bɛhyɛ nneɛma pii mu ' diversification'. Te nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ mu no ase. Yɛ nhwehwɛmu. Dwen bere tenten ho. Hyɛ aseɛ ketewa. To sika daa. Hyehyɛ botaeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So Intanɛt so nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ anaa ahomatrofo (telephone) a wɔde boa a ɛde mmoa a ɛfa ahodwiriw ho ma mmabun a wɔrehyia nna anaa awo mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, Intanɛt so nneɛma ne ahomatrofo (telephone) a ɛboa wɔ hɔ a ɛde mmoa a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho ma mmabun a wɔrehyia nna anaa awo mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow. Ebia eyinom bi ne ɔhaw ho ahomatrofo so, Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadibea ahorow, ne wɛbsaet titiriw anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwenemhaw ne nna mu akwahosan so. Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ "RAINN" (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) ne "The Trevor Project" de mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam ne ahodwiriwde ma mmabun a wɔrehyia nna mu basabasayɛ, ayayade, anaa ɔhaw afoforo a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne nnwuma a ɛwɔ fam no boa mmabun ma wonya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma, de atipɛnfo mmoa ma, na wɔkyekye akannifo ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne famfo nnwuma di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun ma wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, atipɛnfo mmoa a wɔde ma, ne akannifo ho nimdeɛ a wɔkyekye mu. Saa ahyehyɛde ahorow, nea broni ka no 'organisations' yi taa ma mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a mmabun betumi anya nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa. Ebia wɔde atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, mmoa akuw, ne afotu adwuma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ama. Bio nso, ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so taa kamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, na ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa nne yɛ kɛse na wodi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a wohyia no ho dwuma. Ɛnam sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ saa ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nnwuma yi mu a, wɔbɛtumi anya mmoa nkitahodiɛ a ɛsom boɔ, anya akannifoɔ nimdeɛ, na wɔaboa ama nsakraeɛ pa aba wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan pa anaa ahobammɔ ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a metumi afa so ahwehwɛ nna mu bɔbeasu a menigye ho, wɔ m'ankasa kwan so?
answer_twi_source: Mepa wo kyɛw, mintumi mmoa wo wɔ saa asɛm no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nnipa dodow ntam nkitahodie anaa adwumayɛfo nhyehyɛe afoforo mu de ama wɔn adwumayɛ tebea ne wɔn akatua atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nnipa dodow ntam nkitahodi anaa adwumayɛfo nhyehyɛe afoforo mu de ama wɔn adwumayɛ tebea ne akatua atu mpɔn denam: Nnwumakuw a wɔbɛkɔ mu: Adwumayɛfo akuw anaa akuw a mmerante ne mmabaa di anim a wɔkamfo adwumayɛfo a wogyina hɔ ma adwumayɛfo anigyede na wɔne adwumawuranom di nkitaho hwehwɛ akatua, mfaso, ne adwumayɛbea tebea a eye no mufo. Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Wɔne atipɛnfo a wɔbɛyɛ biako ayɛ nhyehyɛe ama nnipa a wɔbom yɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛban mu adwumayɛ, anaa ɔsɔretia de ama nkurɔfo ate adwuma mu nsɛm ase, de nhyɛso aba adwumawuranom so, na wɔakamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ adwumayɛfo nneyɛe mu. Ananmusifo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Ananmusifo anaa ananmusifo a wɔpaw wɔn ma wogyina wɔn anigye ananmu wɔ nkitahodi, nnipa dodow ntam nkitahodi, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne adwumawuranom bɛbɔ wɔ adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na animtiaabu pii wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho? (abakɔsɛm, nyamesom, amammerɛ mu nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: Ntease ahorow a emu yɛ den wɔ hɔ a enti wɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho animtiaabu ba: Abakɔsɛm mu Nneɛma: Mmara ahorow a ɛbara nyinsɛn a woyi gu no bae nkyɛe koraa wɔ abakɔsɛm mu. Nyamesom mu Gyidi: Ɔsom ahorow bi bu nyinsɛn a woyi gu sɛ ɛyɛ bɔne wɔ abrabɔ fam. Amammerɛ mu Su horow: Amammerɛ ahorow bi betumi ahyɛ mmea ma wɔde nyinsɛn akɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa nnamfo, atipɛnfo, anaa adɔfo a wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ denam nkuranhyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn ma wɔakɔ ahomatrofo "telephone" a wɔde boa wɔn wɔ ɔhaw mu na wɔaka sɛ wɔne wɔn bɛkɔ anaasɛ wɔde atinka fam mmoa bɛma wɔ bere a wɔreyɛ saa no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔn nnamfo, wɔn atipɛnfo, anaa wɔn adɔfo a wɔahyia nna mu basabasayɛ denam nkuranhyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn ma wɔakɔ ahomatrofo "telephone" a wɔde boa wɔ ɔhaw mu no nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa wɔ kokoam so. Wobetumi aka sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn ho wɔ ɔfrɛ no mu anaasɛ wɔde nkate fam mmoa bɛma ansa na wɔabɔ wɔn nsa akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne bere a wɔawie no. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun tie wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wonni atemmu, wɔma wɔn nkate yɛ nokware, na wɔma wɔn awerɛhyem sɛ mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ no yɛ anammɔn a ɛyɛ akokoduru na ɛma tumi a ɛkɔ ayaresa ne ahoɔden mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ me nipadua no hua yɛ soronko mprempren?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebia wo nipadua hua bɛsakra esiane fifiri ntini ahorow a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma kɛse wɔ wo babunbere mu nti. Ahotew pa a wode bedi dwuma bere a wode wo ho gu mu daa ne deodorant a wode bedi dwuma no betumi aboa wo ma woate nka sɛ wo ho ayɛ foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abɛɛfo ntentanfidie ho nimdeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ne nea ɛboro saa ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛaseɛ ne Nea Ɛho Hia: Abɛɛfo ntentɛnfodie ho nimdeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia ho nkuran na wɔama mmabun tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm mu denneennen wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ne nea ɛboro saa ho. Ɛho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma wonya ahokokwaw ne nimdeɛ a wohia na wɔde afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, akyerɛ nkrasɛm ahorow a ɛfa ASRH ho ase, na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua betumi ama mmabun anya tema, ntease, ne obu ama nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne amammerɛ ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ma mmabun nya tema, ntease, ne obu ma nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne amammerɛ ahorow wɔ mmabun mu denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa saa nipasu ahorow yi ho nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ma wɔabɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔasusuw nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm nya wɔ ankorankoro adwene ne wɔn suahu so no ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo adebɔ ne nsɛm a wɔka a ɛma nne ne osuahu ahorow a wɔatoto wɔn hintidua no yɛ kɛse a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔakasa atia nyiyim na wɔakamfo nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne ananmusifoɔ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene-si-so ho mmɔdenbɔ ben na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛde adwene mu dwoodwoo (mindfulness) betumi aboa me ama matumi adi abufuw anaa awerɛhoɔ a emu yɛ den so?
answer_twi_source: Home dwee (Deep breaths): Twe mframa kɔ mu na yi ba. Ma woadwene nkɔ ahome a ɛba ne dea ɛfriri ɔmu kɔ. To ateka no ho din (Label emotions): Gye ateka a worehunu no to mu na frɛ no din a woremmu wo ho, gye tom sɛ ateka no yɛ berɛ tiaa mu deɛ na ɛbɛtwa mu.Hu sɛ 'wei yɛ abufuo' na ka kyerɛ wo ho sɛ ɛbɛtwa mu. ɔdɔ ayemyɛ 'Loving-kindness': dɔ wo ho na dɔ afoforo;  a ɛbɛtumi aboa ama abufuo anaa abammuo ano adwo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de "Me" nsɛm ne etie akwan a ɛyɛ nnam adi dwuma de me mfɛfo, nnamfo, ne ɔdɔ ahokafo adi nkitaho denneennen, titiriw bere a meresusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho anaasɛ meresiesie ntawntawdi ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Fa "Me" nsɛm (sɛ nhwɛso no, "Mete nka...") di dwuma de da w'adwene, wo nkate, ne w'ahiade adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ den so ne w'atipɛnfo, nnamfo, ne ɔdɔ ahokafo, titiriw bere a woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate ho anaasɛ woresiesie ntawntawdi ahorow no. Fa atie akwan a ɛyɛ nnam te sɛ nsɛmfua a wobɛka no foforo, nsusuwii, ne nsɛm a ɛma emu da hɔ a wobɛbisa de ada tema ne ntease adi bere a woda so ara si w’ankasa w’adwene ne w’ahye so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn nne ne wɔn asɛnka agua so akasa atia nsusuii hunu, ahyɛ nneɛma ahorow ho nkuran, na wɔakamfo media mu nsɛm a ɛda nnipa osuahu ne nipasu ahorow adi na ɛkyerɛ obuo ma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn nne ne wɔn nhyiam akasa atia nsusuii hunu, ahyɛ nneɛma ahorow ho nkuran, na wɔakamfo media a asɛyɛde wom denam nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ na wɔakyɛ a ɛda wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, osuahun ahorow, ne wɔn nipasu adi no so. Wobetumi ne nkɛntɛnsofo, ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ayɛ biako de ama wɔn nkrasɛm no ayɛ kɛse, akanyan asetena mu nsakrae, na wɔapia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo a wobu nnipa osuahu ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na dɛmdi ho abakɔsɛm ne asetena mu atɛntrenee akuo te sɛ ɔmanfo hokwan ahorow ne mmaasɛm ho kuo di ahyia?
answer_twi_source: Wɔaka nnipa hokwan ahorow pii ama nnipa a wɔadi dɛm a ɛne asetena mu atɛntrenee akuo afoforo a ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ no abɔ mu. Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ho abakɔsɛm ne asetena mu atɛntrenee akuw afoforo, te sɛ ɔmanfo hokwan ne mmea ho adwene afrafra kɛse. Sɛnea ɛte ni: Nkannyan: Ɔmanfo hokwan kuo no nkonimdi na ɛkanyan mmubuafo hokwan ahorow no. Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm huu sɛnea akuw a wɔato wɔn sintidua betumi ako ama pɛyɛ ne wɔn a wɔka ho. Akwan a Wɔkyɛ: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm hokwan ho adwumayɛfo faa akwan horow a efi ɔmanfo hokwan ahorow kuw no hɔ, te sɛ sit-ins ne protests, de ma nkurɔfo hu nyiyimu: Nkitahodi akuo abien no nyinaa ko ma ɔmanfo a wobu nnipa nyinaa, a dɛmdi, anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna mfa ho mmea nyinaa mu, a wɔn a wɔadi dɛm ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm mu su pa wɔ wɔn mmofraase de asiesie wɔn ho ama sikasɛm mu ahotɔ ne nkonimdi bere atenten?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm mu su pa ntɛm denam sika a wɔde sie, sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, n'awodi sika a ɛsɛ wo asetra mu a wobetumi de adi kan no so. Wobetumi afi ase denam sika a wɔde besie ho botae pɔtee bi a wɔde besisi hɔ, te sɛ sika a wɔde bɛto wɔn sika anaa sika a wonya no fã bi a wɔbɛkora so ɔsram biara no so. Sɛ wosua sɛnea wobehu nsonsonoe a ɛda ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ntam a, ɛboa wɔn ma wosisi sika a wɔsɛe no ho gyinae a ɛfata. Bio nso, akwankyerɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, anaa sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ hɔ no betumi ama woanya nhumu a ɛsom bo wɔ sika a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛde pa mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi akyerɛkyerɛ nea enti a mmabunbere ba ne hia a ɛho hia wɔ me nkɔso mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere yɛ adebɔ mu adeyɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nipadua no resakra afi mmofraase akɔ mpanyin mfe so. Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm "hormones" mu a ɛkanyan nipadua ne nkate mu nkɔso, a awo akwaa ahorow a ɛnyin ne tumi a ɛma wotumi wo awo ka ho na ɛkanyan no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na sɛ ɛsono sɛnea me ne me hokafo no pɛ sɛ wosiw nyinsɛn ano nso ɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɛsono nea wo ne wo hokafo pɛ wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho a, nneɛma bi ni a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho: Fa wo ho to wo ho so: Hwɛ sɛ ɔkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma woanya ahobammɔ bi ama wo baanu nyinaa (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm a wɔde kum mmadwoa). Bu ahye: Worentumi nhyɛ obi ma ɔmfa ɔkwan bi a ne ho nyɛ no dɛ nni dwuma. Susuw ho sɛ ebia wo nna mu akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow hyia bere tenten anaa. Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa: Wobetumi asusuw akwan horow a wubetumi afa so ho na wɔaboa mo ma woanya ano aduru a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma ama mo baanu nyinaa. Nea ɛho hia sen biara no, fa w’akwahosan ne w’ahobammɔ di kan. Mfa wo ho nhyɛ nna mu gye sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na woabɔ wo ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan foforo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so siw 'STI/HIV' ano a kɔndɔm nka ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwan foforo wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so siw 'STI/HIV' ano a kɔndɔm nka ho, ɛwom sɛ kɔndɔm da so ara yɛ ɔkwan a wɔkamfo kyerɛ kɛse de. Akwan foforo bi a wɔfa so siw ano ne: Nea broni frɛ no 'Dental dams': 'Latex anaa polyurethane' a wɔde yɛ nkratafa a ɛyɛ tratraa a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔyɛ ano nna mu 'oral sex' de siw 'STI' ahorow ano. Mmea kɔndɔm: Wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu ansa na wɔada, na ɛma nipadua mu akwanside a ɛko tia 'STI ne HIV'. Nnuru a ekum mmadwoa: Nnuru a wobetumi de adi dwuma nkutoo anaasɛ wɔde akwanside akwan a wɔfa so kum mmadwoa na ɛtew nyinsɛn ho asiane so, nanso ɛmma ahobammɔ kakraa bi fi 'STI ne HIV' ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nhyɛso a ɛfata "healthy persuasion", nkitahodi, ne nsakrae anaa nhyɛso wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, nnamfofa, ne fekubɔ mu ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda apɔwmuden a wɔde gye nkurɔfo adwene, nkitahodi, ne nsakrae anaa nhyɛso ntam wɔ ɔkwan wei so; susuw a wobesusuw ho sɛ ebia onipa foforo no bu wɔn ahye, di nkitaho pefee na odi nokware, na ɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔn baanu nyinaa pene so na wɔte ase anaa. Wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu no, ankorankoro de obu di nkɔmmɔ, tie wɔn ho wɔn ho haw ahorow, na wɔde pene ne ahofadi di kan. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, nsakrae anaa nhyɛso hwehwɛ sɛ obiako nam nnaadaa, ahunahuna, anaa nkate mu nsakrae so di ɔfoforo so, a onsusuw onipa foforo no ahofadi anaa ne yiyedi ho ankasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne obi adi nkitaho denneennen a menyɛ basabasa anaasɛ menyɛ hwee bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere anaa me resi sɔ ?
answer_twi_source: Fa "Me" Nsɛm di dwuma: hwe wo ahiade ne watinka so dua a wommɔ sobo, s.e., "Mepɛ sɛ..." gyena pintinn fa watinka ne bebia wo ntumi nkɔ ho anaa wakɔnnɔ ahorow mu da hɔ, s.e., "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ..." Obu Nne: Fa nne a ahotoso ne obu wom di dwuma, kwati nteɛteɛm anaa asɛm a ɛyɛ sereserew. Fa Asɛm a Woka Kyerɛ: Wo ne w’adamfo bi di agoru anaa wɔ ahwehwɛ anim na ama woanya ahotoso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ betumi ne sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no, ayɛ biako de adi mmabun ahiade ahorow a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ (CBOs) bɛtumi ne sukuu ahodoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne afoforɔ a wɔdi dwuma no ayɛ adwuma abom de adi mmabun ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ ho dwuma denam: Wɔne sukuu ahodoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri aka adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no ho, de nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ama wɔ beaeɛ hɔ, na wɔde dwumadiɛ a ɛka adesua akyi a wɔde wɔn adwene asi mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) so bɛma. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun, a afotu, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa ka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ aban ahorow, "NGO" ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina gyidi so, ne nnwumakuw a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan, te sɛ sika a wɔde bɛma mmabun mmeae, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, ne mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na nimdeɛ ho hia ma mmaabun nna ne awoɔ mu apomoden ho ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma wosusuw nsɛm ho ansa na woayi bi. Nsɛm a ɛfa nipadua/asiane/dwumadie ho. Ɛbɔ wo ho ban fi asiane ho. Ɛboa ma wote wo ho nneɛma ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam sɛ wɔ teetee wɔ kokoamsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so anya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmabun akwahosan ayaresabea anaa mmeae a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ kokoam hwɛ a wɔde ma mu. Atorɔfo ahoma 'Hotlines' anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde kokoam mmoa ne nsɛm ma. Akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow a egyina sukuu so anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde kokoamsɛm di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si sɛ wubenya nsakrae wɔ akɔnnɔ anaa aduan a wɔpɛ mu ma wɔn a wɔresi sɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa si koraa sɛ wubenya nsakrae wɔ akɔnnɔ ne aduan a wopɛ mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu no betumi aka w’akɔnnɔ, sɛnea wopɛ, ne sɛnea wodidi. Ebia ɛtɔ mmere bi a wubehu sɛ ɔkɔm de wo sen sɛnea wotaa yɛ, anaasɛ w’ani bere nnuan bi. Ɛho hia sɛ wutie wo nipadua no ɔkɔm ne nea ɛyɛ ma ho nsɛnkyerɛnne na wudi nnuan a ɛkari pɛ de boa wo nyin ne wo nkɔso. Sɛ wowɔ nneɛma bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ w’akɔnnɔ anaa aduan a wobɛpaw ho a, wo ne ɔwofo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa na ama woanya akwankyerɛ. Nneɛma a ɛnyɛ aduan te sɛ dɔte, pɛnsere, krataa, abotan, nsukyenee, krayon a wubedi no betumi anya w’akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, na ɛsɛ sɛ wokwati
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ ɔbea vagina ne vulva mu?
answer_twi_source: Vagina ne vulva nyinaa yɛ w’awo nhyehyɛe no afã horow a ɛho hia, nanso ɛsono! Vagina: Eyi yɛ ntini kwan a efi awotwaa mu kɔ awotwaa mu. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a nna, awo, ne brayɛ mogya fa so fi nipadua no mu. Vulva: Eyi ne w’akyi fã a ɛwɔ akyi. Nea ɛka ho ne mons pubis (srade a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa), labia (honam ani a wɔabobɔw), clitoris (anigye beae), ne ɔbea awotwaa a wobue.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛmti anaa nsusuwii hunu a wɔtaa ka wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, a ebetumi ama ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware, mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho akɔ so atena hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛmti ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔtaa ka wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu a ɛma nkrasɛm a epira kɔ so no bi ne: Ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware a ɛde teateaa, ntini, ne nipadua mu pɛyɛ di kan. Bɔbeasu dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ atetesɛm mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbeayɛ ho mu den, na ɛtaa da mmarima adi sɛ wodi tumi na mmea yɛ wɔn a wɔnyɛ hwee anaasɛ wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne abusuabɔ ho mfoni ahorow a ɛma ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔanhyɛ da yɛ fɛ, ɛhyɛ tumi a ɛnyɛ papa ho nkuran, anaasɛ ɛma ankorankoro gyina wɔn honam ani hwɛbea so bu wɔn ani.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ne ɔyaresafoɔ no akasa afa nsɛmti a ɛho hia a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho denam: Fa ɔhwɛfoɔ a wogye no die. Nkɔmmɔbɔ no a wubefi ase denam wo haw nsɛmmisa a wobɛda no adi wɔ ɛkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmuo ne na ɛyɛ obuo so. Nokware a wobɛka na woaka wo suahu ahorow, wo haw ahorow, ne nna mu apɔwmuden ho abakɔsɛm ho asɛm. Nsɛm a wubebisa fa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI, nna mu dwumadi, anaa awo akwahosan ho nsɛm foforo biara a ebia wowɔ ho. Sɛ yɛbɛkae sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo yɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔde mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne aduruyɛ ho nimdeɛ bɛma a wommu atɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Gye nsakrae a ɛwɔ mmara mu wɔ mfe a obi adi ne awofoɔ pene a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho wɔ mmeae ahorow no tom.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wuhu mmara ahorow a ɛwɔ mmeae afoforo a, wubetumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm afi akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din a ɛfa saa mmeae no pɔtee ho. Kae: Wo nna mu akwahosan ho hia. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ama wo tumi ma w’ankasa asi gyinae ahorow a ɛfata na ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe  ne nnwuma ahorow a ɛhyɛ akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya fahodi fi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyeɛ ne nnwuma a wɔayɛ wɔ nhumu a wɔbɛma, wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim mu, wɔbɛbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, wɔn suahunu a wɔbɛkyɛ, na wɔne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ abom ayɛ adwuma de ahyɛ mmara mu nsakraeɛ ho nkuran na wɔakyekyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bedi asɛm no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow, sukuupɔn ahorow, ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee asoɛe ahorow betumi adi wɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho ɛfiri nhomasua ne ntetee so a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu, sukuupɔn, ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee asoɛe ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran firi nhomasua ne ntetee so denam mmarima ne mmea adwene a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛe ho, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne adesua akwan a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ akannifo ne gyinaesi mu no so. Wɔma mmeawa ne mmarimaa nya hokwan nya ahokokwaw, nimdeɛ, ne suban ahorow a ɛkasa tia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, hyɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ ho nkuran, na wosiesie wɔn ma wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwumayɛfo ne ɔmanfo mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen a kuw a wɔhwehwɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu no hyia no bi ne dɛn? (mmara, animtiaabu, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, mprempren nyinsɛn a woyi gu hokwan kuw biara nni hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm bɛkɔ so ayɛ kokoam bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa anaa ayaresa no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm no yɛ kokoamsɛm wɔ ɔkwan bi sei: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpaw wɔn a wɔwɔ wɔn mu ahotoso na wɔte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn no so. Wɔn a wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛbɔ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ho nkɔmmɔ ansa na wɔada nsɛm a ɛho hia adi. Nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ ne henanom a wɔbɛkyerɛ mu ada hɔ, titiriw bere a ɛfa awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn ho no. Kokoam nnwuma te sɛ nea wɔde ma wɔ mmabun akwahosan ayaresabea anaa kokoam telefon so telefon so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ ahofadi, nidie, ne pɛyɛ ne mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho nsɛm di nkitaho wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ ahofadi, nidi, ne pɛyɛ ne ASRH di nkitaho denam hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ho, wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ, na wonni nyiyim ne nhyɛso a wosi so dua no so. Saa nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛ obuo ma mmabun adwumayɛbea, wɔkura wɔn nidi mu, na wɔhyɛ ASRH nnwuma ne nsɛm a mmerante ne mmabaa nyinaa nya pɛ wɔ wiase nyinaa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so kasa ma LGBTQ+ nkabom ne gye a wogye tom wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuw ahorow no nnye LGBTQ+ dwumadi ahorow ntom wɔ Ghana, nanso wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ ma wɔn tumi ma wogye nnipa sɛnea wɔte bere a wɔde nkakrankakra kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ ho ade. Nanso nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔyɛ wɔ nsakrae nkyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ Ghana no nyɛ atɔsom wɔ nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi m’ahye ne mehokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ m’ankasa nipadua so no so dua wɔ tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛ si w’ahye ho dua ho a, ɛwo sɛ, wobɛka wo anohyeto ahorow ho asɛm pefee na woagyina pintinn wɔ wo gyinaesi ahorow mu, sɛ afoforo bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ wo anaasɛ wɔbɛma wote afobu nka mpo a. Fa yɛ wo ho sɛ wobɛka nsɛmfua a ɛyɛ den te sɛ, "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ saa asɛm no ho," anaa "Mesrɛ wo bu me nhyehyeɛ so."
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow no twam wɔ nsɛm a ebia mmabun reyɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔpene so nanso ebetumi ayɛ asiane wɔ STI a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ nsɛm a ebia mmabun reyɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔpene so nanso ebetumi de asiane aba wɔ STI a wɔde ma ho no, mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow twam. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔ STI ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ho, na wɔboa mmabun ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho. Eyi betumi afa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ STI nhwehwɛmu, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya ne nea wɔde di dwuma yiye ho. Abrabɔ pa ho nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ ahofadi, mfaso, ne nea ɛnyɛ bɔne kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kwan ma wɔkari pɛ wɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wosi wɔn ankasa gyinae a botae no ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi ho nkuran no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ menya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe afoforo a ɛho hia nyinaa bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no mu a wobɛfa so no betumi ayɛ den, nanso anammɔn pii wɔ hɔ a wubetumi ayɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wubenya ɔhwɛ a wuhia ankasa. Fi ase denam akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ayaresabea a wogye no di a wode nnwuma a wɔaka abom ma mmabun a wubehu no so. Wubetumi abisa nyansahyɛ ahorow afi nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa sukuu afotufo hɔ. Sɛ wonya nya ɔyarehwɛfoɔ wie a, yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ kɔhwɛ w’akwahosan ho ahiadeɛ ne nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo. Ka w’awoɔ akwahosan ahiadeɛ ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ wo dwumadiefoɔ no, na ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛbisa nsɛm anaa wobɛhwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛfa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na me ne me hokafoɔ bedi nkɔmɔ afa nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm 'sexual health' na yetumi adi ho dwuma abɔ mu yie?
answer_twi_source: Kasa pefee (Open/Honest): Hwehwɛ kokoam na monni nkɔmɔ. Fa 'me' di wo nsɛm ano nea abrɔfo frɛ no 'I statements'. Tie no yie. Boa no (Be Supportive): Hyɛ no den. Hwehwɛ mmoa (Professional Help): Sɛ ɛyɛ den a, hu 'counselor'. Hotlines: 0540-118-999, 5100, 0800202010.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɔsom ahorow ka fa nneɛma te sɛ nna ansa na awareɛ, awoɔ nnwura, nyinsɛyiguo, ne mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na gyidie yi betumi aka mmabun gyinaesio ne wɔn su?
answer_twi_source: Ɔsom ahorow wɔ adwene ahorow. Ebinom hyɛ nkuran sɛ yɛntwɛn kɔsi sɛ yɛbɛware, na ebia wɔmmoa yafunu-tuguo, nanso ebinom nso pene so. Saa gyidie yi taa fi sɛnea nkurɔfoɔ kyerɛ ɔsom nwoma, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne amammerɛ mu amanneɛ ase, na ebetumi aka sɛnea mmabun dwene, te nka, na wosi gyinaeɛ wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛka awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ apɔwmuden ho a ɛnnyɛ aduane nko ara?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yeyi aduane si nkyɛn a, ɛwɔ yɛhyɛ y'apɔw mu den, yegyae adwendwen na yɛgye y'ahome. Nna so hia paa yie. Nsa ne sigaret so ɛwɔ sɛyi no akwa .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu anaa nhomasua asoɛe ahohorow di wɔ adwenemyare ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nwomasua asoɛeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun mu denam: Afotuo dwumadie a egyina sukuu so anaa adwenemyareɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn, te sɛ sukuu afotufoɔ anaa adwene ne nneyɛeɛ ho animdefoɔ, na wɔde ma. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu a wɔde bɛma denam adesuadan mu adesua, adwumayɛbea, anaa nhyiam ahorow so. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahyɛ adwenemyare pa ho nkuran na wɔasiw ayayade, ayayade, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛde adwennwen ano. Mpɔtam a ahotɔ ne mmoa bɛbɔ a asuafoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa ama adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm. Yɛne mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne awofoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛboa asuafoɔ adwenemyareɛ ahiadeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛma ne nea wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie ma asuafoɔ a wohia mmoa foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso bɛn na nnipa a wɔagye din amammerɛ ne anigyede ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya wɔ sɛnea mmabun kura wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ ho no so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔtaa hu nnipa a wɔagye din sɛ nhwɛsofo, na wɔn nneyɛe ne wɔn abusuabɔ betumi anya mmabun adwene so nkɛntɛnso. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa da nnipa a wɔagye din ntam abusuabɔ adi sɛ ɛyɛ pɛ na ɛyɛ fɛ, na ɛde akwanhwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware ba. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna: Nnipa a wɔagye din amammerɛ betumi aboa ma ankorankoro, titiriw mmabaa, akɔ nna mu. Ebia mmabun besuasua nneyɛe a wohu wɔ nnipa a wɔagye din mu, sɛ́ ɛfa abusuabɔ anaa wɔn honam ani hwɛbea ho no. Nnipa a wɔagye din amammerɛ ne anigyede ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ betumi akyerɛ sɛnea mmabun bu nna, abusuabɔ, ne wɔn ankasa nipasu, na mpɛn pii no ɛde asetra mu nneɛma yi ho adwene a ɛyɛ nea ɛfata na ɛtɔ mmere bi a ɛnyɛ nokware ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa ne nneɛma bɛn na mpɛn pii no wɔde ma wɔ berɛ a yɛnhwɛ sɛ obi ho atɔ no (aftercare) no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ berɛ a yɛdi asɛm no akyi na yɛma mmoa a ɛtwa toɔ no mu no, mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi anya mmoa ahodoɔ ne nneɛma bi a ɛboa. Wei bɛtumi ayɛ afutuo anaa ayaresa a ɛkɔ so daa, kwan a wɔfa so kɔ mmoa kuo (support groups) anaa atipɛnfoɔ nkyɛn, akwankyerɛ a wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmoa ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa adwumayɛbea pɔtee bi, mmoa a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so di haw so ne wɔn ho a wɔhwɛ yie ho, ne wɔn nkɔsoɔ ne ahotɔ ho nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ hokwan a mewɔ sɛ mede kokoamsɛm sie bere a merehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ aman pii mu no, mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi mfa w’aduroyɛ ho nsɛm nkyerɛ obiara, a w’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo no ka ho, a wompene so, gye sɛ nsɛm a ɛfa ɔhaw a ɛreba anaa mmara kwan so ahwehwɛde ahorow ho. Wɔ Ghana no, awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ no bɔ ankorankoro bi boɔ ne kokoamsɛm ho ban berɛ a wɔregye akwahosan ho dwumadie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmebun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn ho a wosusuw ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee mu de ahu na wɔakasa atia wɔn ankasa animhwɛ ne nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne tumi mu nkɔso ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmebun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn ho nsusuwii ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee mu de ahu na wɔakasa atia wɔn ankasa animhwɛ ne nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne tumi mu nkɔso ho denam: Ankorankoro Gyidi a Wosusuw Ho: Gye bere susuw ankorankoro gyidi, suban, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne tumi ho, na wosusuw sɛnea eyinom betumi anya nkitahodi a wɔne afoforo di so nkɛntɛnso no ho. Adwene Ahorow a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Hwehwɛ adwene ne osuahu ahorow denam nhoma a wobɛkenkan, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a wobɛhwɛ, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a wo ne ankorankoro a wofi mmeae ahorow ne nipasu ahorow bɛbɔ so. Asɛmmisa a ɛfa adwene a ɛnteɛ ho: Bisa nsusuwii hunu ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho, na twa ne ho mpoa sɛ onsusuw akwan horow a saa nsusuwii hunu yi boa ma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nyiyim ba no ho yiye. Wobue w’ani ma Adesua: Bue w’ani ma adesua ne nkɔso, na hu sɛ obi ankasa animhwɛ a ɔbɛkasa atia no yɛ adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so a ɛhwehwɛ ahobrɛase, tema, ne ne ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu nsakrae wɔ m’abusua muni suban anaa n’adwene mu a ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ adwen mu ka yare bi wɔ hɔ a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ abusuani  no nkyɛn wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ akasakasa ne mmoa so. Da wɔn yiyedi ho dadwen adi na sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkasa a, ka sɛ wubetie. Fa nyansahyɛ ma sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ mfi ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo hɔ. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔmfa wɔn ho hwɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, ne asetra mu nkitahodi nni kan. Fa mmoa a mfaso wɔ so ma wɔ da biara da nnwuma anaa asɛyɛde ahorow ho sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, asetra, ne ankorankoro nneɛma nya mmabun a wɔyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛgye nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ adi na wɔatrɛw mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ, asetra, ne ankorankoro nneɛma betumi anya sɛnea mmabun tumi gye di na wɔtrɛw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne ahyɛde ahorow betumi akyerɛ adwene a nkurɔfo wɔ wɔ nea wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ nea wogye tom anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea wɔabara sɛ wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee ho, bere a asetra mu nkɔso a ɛwɔ atipɛnfo akuw ne Intanɛt so mpɔtam hɔ bɛtumi ahyɛ gyidi anaa nneyɛe bi mu den. Ankorankoro nneɛma te sɛ nimdeɛ a wɔadi kan anya, ankorankoro osuahu ahorow, ne adwene mu animhwɛ nso di dwuma wɔ sɛnea mmabun kyerɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ase na wɔyɛ wɔn ade wɔ ho no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atipɛnfo atipɛnfo afotu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma mmabun nya sikasɛm mu ahoɔden?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo atipɛnfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no fa mmabun a wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho na wɔkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho kwan wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nneɛma ahorow te sɛ adwuma a wɔasiesie wɔn ho, sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ, adwumayɛ, ne adwuma a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Ɛboa ma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden denam tebea a ɛboa a mmabun betumi asua biribi afi wɔn ho wɔn ho osuahu mu, akyɛ nneɛma, na wɔanya ahotoso ne ahokokwaw a wohia na ama wɔadi nkonim wɔ adwumayɛfo mu anaasɛ sɛ nnwumayɛfo no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛ nipadua mu no ma mmabun tumi sisi wɔn ankasa nipadua ho gyinae?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a ɛwɔ nipadua ahofadi mu no ma mmabun tumi denam: Tumi a wogye tom sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne akwahosan ho Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi wɔn ankasa gyinae ne nipadua mu nokwaredi a wɔbɛhyɛ so dua Mmara ne abrabɔ pa nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛma de akyerɛ sɛ wodi aduruyɛ ne akwan horow so Ahofadi, ahofadi, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔ ankorankoro paw ne nea wɔpɛ ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a, ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho denam mmeae ahorow so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nhomasua nneɛma a ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ din pa ne aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, de ma Intanɛt so nneɛma ne wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw. Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de osuahu ahorow a wonya fi mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee mu no adi dwuma de ama wɔn daakye adwuma anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn suahu ahorow a wonya fi mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu no adi dwuma de ama wɔn daakye adwuma anya nkɔso denam: Adwumayɛfo nkitahodi a wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Nkitahodi a wɔne adwuma so ahwɛfo, afotufo, ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo a wofi adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe anaa adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe mu a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu no betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu, wɔde wɔn akɔma wɔn, ne adwuma hokwan ahorow ho nhumu. Ahokokwaw ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ a wɔda no adi: Sɛ wɔtwe adwene si nnwuma pɔtee bi, nea wɔatumi ayɛ, ne ahokokwaw a wɔanya wɔ bere a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ adwumayɛ mu anaa adwumayɛ mu osuahu ahorow mu wɔ krataa a wɔde kɔ adwuma mu, portfolio, anaa LinkedIn profile ahorow so a, ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ wɔasiesie wɔn ho ama daakye dwumadi ahorow. Hokwan foforo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri, ntetee, anaa adansedi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn anigyede ho a wobedi akyi no betumi ama wɔn ahokokwaw, nimdeɛ, ne ahwehwɛde ahorow akɔ anim, na ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ayɛ akansi kɛse wɔ adwumayɛ mu. Adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ a wɔtoa so: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ adesua, nkitahodiɛ, ne ahokokwaa nkɔsoɔ dwumadiɛ a ɛkɔ so mu denam nnwumakuo fekuo, intanɛt so adesua, anaa adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ so a, ɛbɛtumi aboa adwuma mu nkɔsoɔ ne nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a mede besua pii afa nkitahodi a ahoɔden wom ho ama abusuabɔ? (adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo, kasa kyerɛ apɔwmuden ho dwumayɛni bi wɔ nkitahodi a ɛyɛ papa ho. Nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ bi, frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn, Marie frɛ 0302242517.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔbea atitiriw da mma ne mma da ne mmarima ne mmarima da 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro ne abusuabɔ adi, na dɛn ne nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi anya wɔ LGBTQ+ mmabun a wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn de ne wɔn yiyedi so?
answer_twi_source: Mma ne mma da ne mmarima ne mmarima da 'LGBTQ+' yɛ mmara so bu wɔ ɔman no mu na anka wɔrenyɛ ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dwumadibea atitiriw so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛfa dijitaal nsɛm a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ɔsatuo, anaa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔadi 'ASRH' nsɛm ho dwuma, wɔakamfo nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ, anaa wɔakasa atia asetena mu gyinapɛn ne suban ho mpoa?
answer_twi_source: #MeNnipaduaM'ahokwan a broni ka no 'MyBodyMyRights': Social media ɔsatu a mmabun kyɛ adwinni, nsɛm, ne video ahorow a ɛkamfo nna ne awo hokwan ahorow kyerɛ. Woka no borɔfo sɛ 'Podcast Series': Mmabun yɛ woka no borɔfo sɛ 'podcast' ahorow a ɛka ASRH nsɛmti a wɔabara ho asɛm, te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne 'LGBTQ+' nsɛm, na ɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nhomasua nya nkɔso. Dijitaal Abakɔsɛm Nhyiamu a woka no borɔfo sɛ 'Digital Storytelling Workshops': Mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nhyiamu a wɔyɛ digyitaal nsɛm fa wɔn 'ASRH' suahunu ho, twa animtiaabuo mpoa na wɔhyɛ nteaseɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw a ɛtaa ba wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu no bi?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw a ɛtaa ba wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ ASRH ho wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu no bi betumi ayɛ: Amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ anaa tema a ɛnni nhwehwɛmufoɔ mu, a ɛde nsɛm a wɔahu no nkyerɛaseɛ a ɛntene a wɔde bedi dwuma. Kasa mu akwansidie ahorow a esiw nkitahodi ne abusuabɔ a wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ adesua mu no nya kwan, ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu nnwinnade ne nneɛma a wɔkyerɛ ase pɛpɛɛpɛ mu. Tumi a ɛnkari pɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmufo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ntam, titiriw wɔ nhwehwɛmu tebea horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ahorow ho, a ebetumi anya nsɛm a wɔaboaboa ano no mudi ne ahotoso so nkɛntɛnso. Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛfa pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma, kokoam nsɛm, ne kokoamsɛm ho, titiriw wɔ amammerɛ ahorow a ebia nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ bɛyɛ nea wɔabara anaasɛ wɔabɔ no animtiaa no mu. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔato wɔn sintidua anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛduru wɔn nkyɛn no ananmusifoɔ na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu wɔ amammerɛ mpɔtam, a ɛde animhwɛ a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ nhwehwɛmu no mu nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka no 'media literacy' boa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkrasɛm ahorow a wɔayɛ ho mfonini wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu no mu yie na wɔsɔ hwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka no 'media literacy' ma mmabun nya ahokokwaw a wɔde begye nsɛm a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no pɛpɛɛpɛ, wogye di, na ebetumi ayɛ animhwɛ ho kyim na wɔasusuw ho. Ɛma wotumi hu akwan horow a wɔtaa de di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu te sɛ nea broni ka no 'framing, stereotyping, ne sensationalism' na wɔpaapae mu, na ɛma wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ketenketen ho ntease.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden ne enfatoho bi a ɛfa dawurubɔ nnwuma ho nimdeɛ 'Media literacy', nkɔsɔndwumadie, ne adwumadie a sukuu adeseua ho nhyehye fa yɛ de boa asuafoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne sɛ, yɛbɛdwen akɔmu afa dawurubɔ agyinafɔ ma ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipadua ho mfonini adi wɔ amammerɛ a gyedin, adwumayɛ ho dawurubɔ, ne intanɛt mpɔtem dawurubɔ so nkitahodi. Sɛyɛ dawurubɔ atrɔsɛm a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ nsusuwii hunu, hyɛ ahorow ahorow ho nkuran, na wɔbɔ mmɔden ma amansan atɛntrenee no ho banbɔ ho dawurubɔ yɛ.Media atesɛntia ne atesɛka nkrataa a ɛyɛ nokware, wogyina so, ne nea enni mmara mu no nhwehwɛmu ne susuw. Nsɛm a atwam, amansan nsɛm, ne amammui mmirikatu a media de bɔ amanneɛ no mu nsɛm ho asɛm ho asɛm yɛ. Mmerante ne mmabaa ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔpɛ sɛ wodi media so nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no ho nsɛmbisa ne nhwehwɛmu yɛ. Kɔmputa so nneɛma te sɛ sini, podcast, blog, ne intanɛt so nkitahodi ho adwuma a ɛfa mmerante ne mmabaa apɔwmuden ne ahoɔden ho a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ. Media nnwuma ho nimdeɛ ho akansi ahorow, sini afahyɛ ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma ahorow a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ mmerante ne mmabaa media nnwuma ho nimdeɛ ne adwene a emu da hɔ mu kyɛ. Mpɔtam hɔ media ahyehyɛde ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ akuw, ne mmɔdenbɔ kuw ahorow a ɛfa media nnwuma ho nimdeɛ ho adwuma a wɔbom yɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bɛn na mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow wɔ aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Sikasɛm mu ahokyere: Sikasɛm a enni hɔ betumi ama ayɛ den sɛ wobenya aduan a ahoɔden wom anaasɛ wobenya adan a ɛyɛ den. Asase ho akwanside ahorow: Sɛ obi tra mmeaeɛ a aduane ho yɛ den anaa  mmeae a adan a ne bo nyɛ den pii nni hɔ a, ebetumi asiw kwan a wɔbɛfa so akɔ hɔ no kwan. Nyiyim: Akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no betumi ahyia nyiyim wɔ adan ne adwumayɛ mu, na ɛbɛka wɔn nneɛma a wobenya. Kaa a wonni: Kaa a wonnya pii betumi asiw mmabun a wontumi nkɔ sotɔɔ ahorow a wɔtɔn nnuan anaa adan ho akwanya ahorow ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammere ne nneyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ fa nna ahyɛaseɛ, hyeɛ a yɛhyehyɛ, ne pene a yɛde ma ho, na sɛn na saa amammere yi sesa wɔ aman, asɔre, ne mmusuakuo ahodoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammere ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ahyɛaseɛ, hyeɛ a yɛhyehyɛ, ne nnyinam a yɛde ma ho no sesa wɔ aman, asɔre, ne mmusuakuo ahodoɔ mu. Amammere na ɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ wɔhyɛ nna ase. Aman bi mu no, wɔsi so dua paa sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde anofafa kyerɛ paa sɛ yɛpɛ ansa, bere a aman foforɔ mu no, wɔnam nneyɛeɛ anaa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a obiara te aseɛ so kyerɛ. Hyeɛ a Yɛhyehyɛ: Sɛdeɛ yɛka nea yɛpɛ ne nea yɛmpɛ wɔ nna mu ho no nso sesa. Aman bi mu no, wɔhyɛ nkuran sɛ kyerɛ nea wopɛ ne nea wompɛ pefee wɔ kasa mu, nanso aman foforɔ mu no, wɔnam nneyɛeɛ anaa nteaseɛ a ɛda hɔ so kyerɛ. Na akwan a yɛfa so kyerɛ sɛ yɛpene nna so no sesa yie wɔ amammere ahodoɔ mu. Aman bi si so dua sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde kasa kyerɛ pefee sɛ aane, nanso aman foforɔ mu no, wɔnam nneyɛeɛ ne amammere kwan so atetesɛm so kyerɛ nnyinam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kokoamusɛm ho banbɔ ahorow di dwuma bere a mmabun hwehwɛ ɔhaw ho mmoa fi sukuu afotufo, ahomatroofo a wɔde boa, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde afoforo hɔ no?
answer_twi_source: Ahintasɛm ne kokoamu nsɛm ho banbɔ ahorow no di dwuma saa ara wɔ ɔhaw ahorow mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Nanso, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun bisa nhyehyɛe ne akwan pɔtee bi a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho bere a wɔrenya mmoa a ɛfa ɔhaw ho afi sukuu afotufo, ahomatrofo a wɔde boa, anaa mpɔtamu hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛhu sɛ ɔhaw nsiesie dwumadie no reyɛ adwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Yɛhwɛ nneɛma te sɛ: Mmabun dodoɔ a yɛaboa wɔn. Bere a yɛde gyinaa asɛm no ano (Timeliness). Nkonim a yɛdiiɛ. Sɛdeɛ wɔn ani gyeeɛ (Satisfaction). Sɛdeɛ haw no so teaeɛ. Nsakraeɛ wɔ nimdeɛ ne suban mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahwɛ sikasɛe, ahwɛ wɔn sikasɛm mu nkɔso, na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn sikasɛm nhyehyɛe mu sɛnea ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sikasɛe so denam nneɛma a wɔtɔ ne ɛka a wɔbɔ ho kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛyɛ so. Wobetumi de budgeting apps anaa spreadsheets adi dwuma de akyekyɛ ɛka ahorow mu na wɔahu mmeae a wobetumi atew sika so anaasɛ wɔbɛsan akyekyɛ. Sɛ wɔsan hwɛ wɔn sikasɛm mu nkɔso mu daa de toto wɔn botae ahorow ho a, ɛma wotumi yɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn sikasɛm nhyehyɛe mu sɛnea ɛho hia. Bere a wɔde si hɔ ɔsram biara de hwɛ wɔn sikasɛm mu no boa mmabun ma wobu akontaa na wɔfa kwan so kɔ wɔn sikasɛm botae ahorow ho.Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ sikasɛm ho abenfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfe bɛn na mmabun betumi asi gyinae wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ wɔn ankasa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Mfe a mmabun tumi si gyinae wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ wɔn ankasa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho no gu ahorow wɔ ɔman ne tumidi mu. Wɔ mmeae pii no, wɔma mmabun hokwan sɛ wɔpene akwahosan ho nnwuma bi so, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho, a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu bere a wɔadi mfe pɔtee bi no, Wɔ ghana no, mmara ma kwan sɛ wɔadi mfe 10-19.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmara ahorow a mpenesoɔ mfe, awofo mpenesoɔ, ne kokoamsɛm ho no nya tumi a mmabun ma wonya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, titiri wɔ tebea horow a animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow abu so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ahorow a ɛfa mpeneso mfe, awofoɔ mpenesoɔ, ne kokoamsɛm ho no ha kwan a mmabun fa so nya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe kɛse, titiri wɔ tebea horow a animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow wom mu. Wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa mu: Mfe a wɔde pene so ho mmara betumi asiw mmabun kwan wɔ nnwuma nya ho, na ɛbɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔpene so. Awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbenya ɔhwɛ, titiriw sɛ wosuro sɛ awofo rempene so. Ahintasɛm ho ahobammɔ ho hia kɛse ma mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne ahofadi a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban, na ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ ɔhwɛ a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛda wɔn ho adi. Amammerɛ ne asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi ahyɛ animtiaabu a ɛfa mmabun nna ho no mu den, na ama mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmɔden a wɔbɔ de ko tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim no ne akuo a ɛtrɛw a ɛhwehwɛ asetena mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan ahorow no hyia, na hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma biakoyɛ ne biakoyɛ wɔ mpɔtam ahorow ne ayɔnkofo ahorow ntam?
answer_twi_source: Ɛdenam sɛ wobehu sɛnea saa apereperedi ahorow yi wɔ abusuabɔ so no, mpɔtam ahorow ne ayɔnkofo betumi ayɛ biako na wɔakyekye biakoyɛ de adi nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ asetena mu nsakrae ho nkuran. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde gyina nnipa ntam, aboa mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn sintidua no akannifo ne wɔn ankasa gyinaesi, na wɔama wɔn a animtiaabu ne nyiyim aka wɔn kɛse no nne ayɛ kɛse. Ɛdenam adwuma a wɔbom yɛ wɔ akuo ahorow mu so no, mmabun ne wɔn ayɔnkofo betumi ayɛ aman a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔyɛ pɛ a wobu ankorankoro nyinaa sɛ wɔsom bo, wobu wɔn, na wotumi de wɔn hokwan ne ahofadi ahorow di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa ma mmabun betumi abisa nsɛm afa GBV ho a wonni atɛn.
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ yi ho hia! Wowɔ akokoduru sɛ wubebisa nsɛm afa GBV ho. Sɛnea yebetumi abɔ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ni: Atemmu biara nni hɔ: Nsɛmmisa a ɛnteɛ biara nni hɔ. Ɛfata sɛ obiara te ahobammɔ nka bere a ɔka GBV ho asɛm no. Ahintasɛm: Nea wokyɛ wɔ ha no tra ha, gye sɛ ahobammɔ ho asɛm bi wɔ hɔ. Obu: Yɛtie yɛn ho yɛn ho suahu ne yɛn adwene pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun akannifo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no betumi ne mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo, a nhyehyɛeyɛfo, nhwehwɛmufo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ka ho, ayɛ biako de ahyɛ awo ntoatoaso ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne biakoyɛ ho nkuran wɔ ASRH mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun akannifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no bɛtumi ne mpaninfoɔ ayɔnkofoɔ ayɛ adwuma abom de ahyɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ntam nkɔmmɔdie ne adwumayɛkuo ho nkuran wɔ ASRH denam: Afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛsi hɔ a ɛde mmeranteɛ akannifoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwa wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu bom. Nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, nhwehwɛmufoɔ, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatuo ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim mu de ahwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene ne wɔn nimdeɛ bɛka gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ ho. Awo ntoatoaso ntam nhyiam, nhyiam, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma hokwan ma wɔn ho wɔn ho adesua ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔbɛboa. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnisoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne gyinaesie akuo a ɛfa ASRH ho wɔ gyinabea ahodoɔ nyinaa mu a nteaseɛ wom a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu pene, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ne nna mu nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu pene gyina ma apam a nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu nyinaa fi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi pɔtee bi mu. Ɛho hia efisɛ ɛkyerɛ obu ma ankorankoro ahofadi, nipadua mu nokwaredi, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn ankasa nipadua ne nna ho. Mpene a wɔpene so hwɛ hu sɛ nna mu nkitahodi gyina ɔpɛ, obu, ne akɔnnɔ a wɔbom yɛ so, sen sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ obi, nhyɛso, anaa Nnaadaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen bɛn na LGBTQ+ mmabun hyia wɔ wɔn nkitahodiɛ anaa dɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen bi a LGBTQ+ mmabun betumi ahyia ne: Homophobia ne transphobia: Ɛnyɛ obiara na ogye tom, na ebia wubehyia adwemmɔne afi afoforo hɔ. LGBTQ+ ahokafoɔ a wobɛhwehwɛ: Ɛgyina baabi a wote so no, ebia ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛnya ahokafoɔ a wobɛtumi ayɛ ayɔnkofoɔ a wɔne wo nipasu yɛ pɛ. Wobepue akɔ ahokafo nkyɛn: Bere ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so apue akɔ ɔhokafo nkyɛn no betumi ayɛ adwennwen. Kae: Wofata sɛ wɔdɔ wo na wobu wo, ɛmfa ho nna ho akɔnnɔ a wowɔ anaa wo bɔbeasu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no kokoamsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ kokoamsɛm ho ban, a nea ɛka ho ne: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act): Ɔman mmara a ɛbɔ ankorankoro akwaaazhosan ho nsɛm kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ ho ban, a mmabun de ka ho. Ɔman mmara: Aman pii wɔ mmara ahorow a ɛfa kokoam ahobammɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo ho akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho pɔtee, te sɛ mmara a ɛma mmofra nkumaa kwan ma wɔpene nnwuma bi so a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi ntawntawdi a wontumi nsiesie anaasɛ ntawntawdi ho nhyehyɛe a ɛnyɛ papa mu aba wɔ mmabun adwenem apvwmuden, abusuabɔ, ne yiedi nyinaa so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asua biribi afi osuahu ahorow a atwam mu de ama wɔn ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ atu mpɔn daakye?
answer_twi_source: Ntawntawdi a wontumi nsiesie no betumi de adwennwen ne dadwen a enni sabea aba, na ɛka adwenem apɔwmuden wɔ ɔkwan a enye so. Abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den: Ntawntawdi a wontumi nsiesie no yie betumi asɛe abusuabɔ a ɛda wɔne atipɛnfo, abusua mufo, ne ɔdɔfo ntam, na ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho anaasɛ wɔayɛ ankonam. Bu a wobu wɔn ho a ɛso tew: Mmabun betumi anya wɔn ho adwene a ɛnteɛ sɛ wɔpere sɛ wobesiesie ntawntawdi anaasɛ wɔte nka sɛ wonni tumi biara wɔ nnipa ntam haw ho dwuma a wobedi mu a. Ntawntawdi a ɛkɔ soro: Ntawntawdi a wontumi nsiesie no betumi ayɛ kɛse bere mu, na ɛde akasakasa a ɛho nnhia kɛse anaasɛ nkitahodi mu asɛe aba. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ gyinaesi so: Ebia mmabun bɛpere sɛ wobesi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho sɛ ntawntawdi si wɔn kwan ma wotumi susu nneɛma ho yiye anaasɛ wotumi di nkitaho yiye a. Sua a wosua fi osuahu ahorow a atwam mu betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔn ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ atu mpɔn denam: Nea ebefi mu aba ho a wobesusuw ho: Ntawntawdi a atwam a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu de ahu nea ankɔ yiye ne sɛnea wobetumi adi tebea horow a ɛte saa ara ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan soronko so daakye. Nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Bisa ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di sɛ wɔmma wɔn nsɛm wɔ wɔn ntawntawdi ano aduru ho akwan ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso ho. Akwan foforo a wɔde bedi dwuma: ntawntawdi ano aduru ho akwan a ɛma denhyɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma denneennen wɔ da biara da nkitahodi mu de anya ahotoso ne ahokokwaw. Adesua a wobɛkɔ so asua: N’adwene a wobɛkɔ so abue na woagye nsusuii ne adwene foforo atom, wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mpo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a, wɔne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho nkuran.
answer_twi_source: Ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wobɛkasa afa wo nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho no ho hia. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Mpanyimfo ntease: Ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa oduruyɛfo betumi de nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ a ɛyɛ nokware ama. Dadwen a Ɛtew So: Sɛ obi bɛkasa pefee a, ebetumi atew dadwen ne adwene a ɛyɛ basaa a, ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no so. Te a Wote nka sɛ Woama Wo Tumi: Sɛ wunim sɛ wubetumi ne obi akasa a, ɛma wunya ahotoso na ɛma wutumi si gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wɔfa obi din ananmusɛm/ asɛmfua (pronouns) pa di dwuma, na sɛ wɔanfa nea ɛfata anni dwuma a, ɛbɛtumi aka ne ho asetena ne n'apomuden sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana amansan mmara mu no, nnipa mma mmienu pɔtee (ɔbarima ne ɔbaa) nko na wɔgye tom, na asɛmfua a wɔde gyina wɔn ananmu nso ne 'ɔno' (ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa nko).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu anaasɛ wɔanya insurance ne sikasɛm mu mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa wɔ NHIS dinkyerɛw, nkrataa a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ hɔ kɔhwehwɛ sikasɛm anaa asetra mu mmoa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me hokafoɔ wɔ pɛ sɛ sɛ ɔbɛda n’ahyeɛ ne n’akɔnnɔ adi?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wo hokafo bɛte nka sɛ wobu no na wɔsom bo. Hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa nsiyɛ nyɛ atie na di wo hokafo atenka ne ne haw ahorow ho adanse a nhyɛso anaa atemmu biara nka ho. Bu wo hokafo no ahyeɛ ne nea ɔpɛ, na ma ɛda adi pefee sɛ wɔn ahotɔ ne wɔn yiedie yɛ ade titiriw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nsɛntitiriw (critical thinking skills) bɛn na m'ahunu bɔbeasu nneyɛe (sexual activity), awodeɛ ano nsi (contraception), ne STI ho banbɔ (STI prevention) ho paw ahodoɔ (different choices) mfomsoɔ ahodoɔ (potential risks) ne mfasoɔ ahodoɔ (benefits) no?
answer_twi_source: Susu adansedi ho, hwehwɛ ne mfua mu, susu sɛnea wɔhwehwɛ mu pau ho. Hwehwɛ sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yie / ne ho nhyɛsoɔ mu. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ mu / apene so ho hia mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano biara so?
answer_twi_source: kwan biara wɔ mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow. Here’s a brief breakdown (depending on the method): Hormonal akwan Mfaso: Ɛyɛ mmerɛw, hormone regulation, period control (akwan bi) Cons: Ebia ɛwɔ nsunsuanso bɔne, ɛnyɛ nea etu mpɔn ma obiara, ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde di dwuma da biara da/daa (akwan bi) Condoms: Pros: Ɛnyɛ den sɛ wode bedi dwuma, ɛbɔ ho ban fi STIs ho Cons: Ebia ebetumi abubu anaasɛ ahwe ase, ebetumi atew atenka so Intrauterine contraceptive device Pros: Ɔhaw a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ, etu mpɔn kɛse: Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo de hyɛ mu, ebia ɛnyɛ nea wotumi dannan sterilization Mfaso: Ɛtra hɔ daa, etu mpɔn kɛse Ɔhaw: Oprehyɛn kwan, wontumi nsakra Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔwɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no susuw mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow yi ho na ama woahu nea ɛfata wo yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne international human rights gyinapɛn ne apam ahorow a ɛbɔ ankorankoro ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi ma wohu ɔman no mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa akwansidie, asɛm a wɔde kɔdan wɔn, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa ho?
answer_twi_source: International human rights gyinapɛn ne apam ahorow bɔ ankorankoro ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ ho na ɛbɔ ɔman no mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa akwansidie, asɛm a wɔde kɔdan wɔn, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa ho amanneɛ. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women (CEDAW), ne Convention on the Rights of the Child. Saa nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi si hokwan a ankorankoro nyinaa wɔ sɛ wɔtra ase a basabasayɛ ne nyiyim nnim, atɛntrenee ne ano aduru a wobenya ama wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa, ne asɛde a aman wɔ sɛ wosiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔyɛ ho biribi yie so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo ne me sukuufo akasa afa abusuabɔ pa ne GBV a wobesiw ano ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkyerɛ obu ne anigye so? (nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔabue ano, nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodie a Wobue: Fi ase ne wo nnamfo bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛnyɛ aniberesɛm fa abusuabɔ pa, pene a wobɛpene so, ne obu ho. Ka nea woasua afa GBV ne nkɛntɛnso a enya ho asɛm. Nneɛma a Wobɛkyɛ: Kyerɛ nnamfo kɔ nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ Ɔdɔ yɛ Resp Lead by Example: Kyerɛ obu ma wo ho ne afoforo wɔ w’abusuabɔ mu. Hyɛ wo nnamfo nkuran ma wɔnyɛ saa ara. Kae: Tena Dwoodwoo: Fa ɔpanyin a wogye no di ka ho bere nyinaa a ɛho hia no, titiriw wɔ ankorankoro dwumadi ahorow mu. Fi ase Ketekete: Ɛho nhia sɛ woyɛ biribiara prɛko pɛ. Paw dwumadi ahorow a wote nka sɛ wubetumi adi ho dwuma na fa wo nkonimdi ahorow no si so. Trɛw Adwempa mu: Fa w’adwene si abusuabɔ pa a wobɛma anya nkɔso ne obu amammerɛ a wobɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu nsunsuanso bɔne a animtiaabu nya wɔ mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa wɔ adwenemyare ho haw ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no so.
answer_twi_source: Atemmu ho suro betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho, titiriw nea ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwenem ahokwasan ho nhyehyɛe "mental health services" pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade, te sɛ ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa anaa Intanɛt so nneɛma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade. Ebia eyinom bi ne ayaresabea anaa mmeae a mmerante ne mmabaa nya adamfofa su a ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa nya baabi a ahotɔ ne akwaaba wom. Intanɛt so nneɛma nso wɔ hɔ, te sɛ wɛbsaet, "apps", ne "forum" ahorow, a ɛma nsɛm, mmoa, ne "virtual" therapy nhyiam mpo. Wɔtaa yɛ saa nneɛma yi a mmabun ahiade soronko ne nea wɔpɛ wɔ wɔn adwenem.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna ho mfonini ne nna ho mfonini ahorow bɛn na wɔtaa da no adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow te sɛ aguade ho dawurubɔ, nnwom video, sini, television so dwumadi, ne abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so?
answer_twi_source: Dawurubɔ: Mpɛn pii no, wɔde nna ho mfonini di dwuma de hyɛ nneɛma ho nkuran, na wɔde bata nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa akɔnnɔ, nea ɛtwetwe adwene, ne nea ɛyɛ fɛ ho. Nnwom Video ahorow: Wɔtaa de asaw a ɛkanyan akɔnnɔ, ntade a ɛkanyan adwene, ne nneɛma a ɛfa nnipa a wɔbɛn wɔn ho adi, na wɔda nna ho nsɛm adi sɛ ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛyɛ anigye. Sini ne Television so Dwumadi: Kyerɛ ɔdɔ mu nkitahodie, nkitahodie a emu yɛ den, ne nna mu nkitahodi wɔ akwan horow so a ɛma akɔnnɔ ne honam fam nneɛma di kan sen nkate mu nkitahodie ne pene a wɔpene so. Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie Platforms: Kyerɛ nipadua ne asetra kwan a wɔayɛ no yiye, a nnipa a wɔwɔ nsunsuanso ne nnipa a wɔagye din taa kyɛ nna ho nsɛm na ama wɔanya adwene ne akyidifo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma metumi adi awo akwahosan ho dwumadie na masɔ nsɛm biara a ɛhaw me ano anaa nsɛmmisa biara a mewɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne Mmoa: Ntrɛwmu: Planned Parenthood ne ahyehyɛde afoforo de telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ma awo akwahosan ho nsɛmmisa ne mmoa. Intanɛt so Nsɛmma Nhoma: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Bedsider.org de nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a wobetumi apaw, ne ayaresabea ahorow a ɛbɛn wo ho ma. Mpɔtam Hɔ Ayaresabea: Mpɛn pii no, awo akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow no wɔ afotufo anaa asetra mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama. Atipɛnfo Mmoa Akuw: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ anaa intanɛt so mmoa akuw ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wohyia awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛte saa ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na wɔfa so yɛ STI nhwehwɛmu, na sɛn na ɛyɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu Akwan: Dwensɔ Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔde hwɛ STI te sɛ chlamydia ne gonorrhea mu. Woma dwensɔ, na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ mmoawa nketenkete wom a. Mogya Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔde yɛ HIV, syphilis, ne hepatitis. Wɔtwe mogya, na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ antibodies anaa mmoawa no ankasa wom a. Nsuo a Wɔfa (Swab Test): Wɔde yɛ STI te sɛ herpes ne HPV. Wɔfa nsuo fi nna mu akwaa no so de hwehwɛ sɛ mmoawa no wom. Nhwehwɛmu Mmeae: Wɔbetumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ ayaresabea, apɔmuden mmeae, dɔketa adwumam, anaa wɔde ofie nhwehwɛmu nneɛma ayɛ. Nhwehwɛmu bi betumi ama nsunsuansoɔ ntɛm (nhwehwɛmu ntɛm), bere a ebi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkɔ laboratori.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn 'resources', akadeɛ,ne nteteeɛ hokwan no bi aa eho da hɔ sɛ mmabun aa wopɛsɛ wɔsua sɛnea yɛsi beae a ehodwo, tipɛnfo mmoa ntrɛwmu ahohorow, ne senea yɛkasa ma nea w'annya ne ti adidi mu hokwan ahorow ne yiedi?
answer_twi_source: Resources', akadeɛ, ne nteteeɛ hokwan da hɔ ma mmabun aa wopɛsɛ wosua sɛnea yesi beae a ehodwo, tipɛnfo mmoa ntrɛwmu ahohorow, ne sɛnea yɛkasa ma nea w'annya ne ti adidi mu hokwan ahorow ne yiedi. Intanɛt asoɔyɛ te sɛ wɛbsaet a broni twerɛ no 'websites', 'blogs', ne 'social media channels' ɛma nwomasua nneɛma, n'akadeɛ, ne nkitahodie wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ efa nna mu akokobensɛm ano sie, nimdeɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ wɔ adwenemhaw, ne tipɛnfo mmoa a aborɔfo ka no sɛ 'trauma-informed care, ne peer support'. mpɔtam kuo 'local organizations', 'community center' ne sukuu aa ɛbetumi ama nteteeɛ, kuo ɛboaboa, ne atuhomafo hokwan ahohorow ma mmabun ɔm'ani wɔ sɛ ɔmobɛyɛ kasamafo ma tiriwdidifo ne mfɛfo 'allies' wɔ nna mu akokobensɛm ano sie.  Sɛ wohwehwɛ saa nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'resources' ne 'opportunities' a yɛde adesua ne kɔkɔɔkɔ bɔ aa mmabun betumi de nimdeɛ, 'skills' ne akukuduru anyin abɛyɛ nsusuasuo pa wɔ wɔn mpɔtam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwaa bɛn na ɛwɔ mmarima awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive system', na dɛn na ɛyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'Testes'(deɛ ma nkwamoa), 'Epididymis', (ɛkora nkwamoa),'Vas Deferens' (de nkwamoa kɔ nipadua akwaa no mu nyinaa), 'Seminal Vesicles/Prostate' (ma nipa akwaa no nsuoyɛ nsuo). Urethra (fa dwonsɔ anaa nkwamoa). Sebi kɔte deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no sɛ 'Penis' (nipadua akwaa wɔde di dwuma).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma m'ahwehwɛ me SOGI mu? (wɛbsaet, telefon a wɔde di dwuma, intanɛt so mpɔtam dwumadibea ahorow)
answer_twi_source: wo ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo nkasa na ɔmmoa wo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ abusuabɔ ne pene a wɔpene so ho a ebia mmabun bɛhyia, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua so abu no agu?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya wɔ abusuabɔ ne pene a wɔpene so ho no bi ne gyidi ahorow te sɛ "Dabi kyerɛ yiw," "Ɛnyɛ mmonnaato sɛ wowɔ abusuabɔ mu a," anaa "Sɛ obi anko atia a, ɛnyɛ ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so nea broni ka no 'assault'." Nhomasua betumi abu saa anansesɛm ahorow yi agu denam nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde bɛma wɔ pene a wɔpene so, ahye, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho no so, na esi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho, nkitahodi, ne pene a wɔde anigye gye tom so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atetesɛm mu nimdeɛ, mpɔtam hɔ nneyɛe, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wotumi gyina tebea horow ano no boa mmabun ma wogyina wim nsakrae ano na wɔboa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde aborɔfo nimdeɛ ne amammerɛ atetesɛm di dwuma de yɛ nsakrae wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia mu na wɔhyɛ asetra a ɛtra hɔ daa ho nkuran. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe te sɛ kuayɛ a nyansa wom, nsu a wɔhwɛ so yiye, ne ahosiesie a asi asiane ahorow ano boa mmabun ma wodi wim tebea ho nsɛnnennen ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ merehyia adwennwen, dadwen, anaa adwenemhaw a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na m’abusua atumi aboa me?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ ho nkuran na tie a wunsusuw ho bere a woda wo nkate adi no. Fa nkate fam mmoa ne awerɛhyem ma sɛ wɔwɔ hɔ ma wo. Boa wo ma wunya mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ, te sɛ ayaresa anaa afotu. Fa mmoa a mfaso wɔ so ma wɔ da biara da nnwuma anaa asɛyɛde ahorow ho bere a ɛho hia no. Mommɔ mu nyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma ahomegye ne adwennwen so tew, te sɛ nantew a wobɛkɔ, adwene a wode bedi dwuma, anaa anigyede ahorow a wobom nya mu anigye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe anaa nsakrae ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo yɛ den ho wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyeɛ anaa nsakraeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ne boɔ yɛ den ho wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatuo a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ fam, mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mmɔdenbɔ, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ne boɔ yɛ den na wɔhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ ho nkuran wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne ɔman no mu. Wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe, mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de akamfo sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun, insurance a wɔbɛtrɛw mu ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛtew ka a wɔbɔ wɔ kotoku mu so na ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛma nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua no atu mpɔn a wɔde bedi dwuma. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodie, sohyial media platforms, ne intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔka de boa wɔn nnwinnadeɛ a wɔbɛboaboa ano de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛseɛ, akyɛ ankorankoro nsɛm, na wɔaboaboa nnipa a wɔbom yɛ adwuma ano atwa nsɛm a ɛfa akwahosan ho sika a wɔtua ne pɛyɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa aduan pa ne nsɛm a ɛnnyɛ nokware a enya wɔ mmabun awo apomoden so ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa nhomasua ne nhumu so adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atrosɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ pii wɔ hɔ a ɛfa aduan pa ne nsɛm a ɛnnyɛ nokware a enya wɔ mmabun awoɔ apomoden so no ho.
