Atosɛm ahorow bi a wɔtaa ka no bi ne gyidi a ɛne sɛ nnuan anaa nnuan bi betumi ama awo anaa nna mu mmɔdenbɔ atu mpɔn ntɛm ara, anaasɛ aduan a ɛtra so ho hia na ama awo apomoden pa. Wobetumi adi saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi ho dwuma denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔ dwuma a aduannuru di wɔ awo apomoden mu no so. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔhyɛ akwan horow a egyina adanse so a wɔfa so nya aduan pa ho nkuran no betumi aboa ma wɔayi anansesɛm afi hɔ na ama mmabun tumi apaw wɔn aduan ne wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea mpɔtam hɔfo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano a adi nna mu basabasayɛ, a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmabun mu no ho dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne nea wɔde siw ano nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a adi nna mu basabasayɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmabun mu ho dwuma yiye no bi ne: Sukuu mu nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asuafo sɛnea wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ no de wɔn ho gye mu. Nnwuma a mmabun di anim a ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ma nkurɔfo hu, na wɔboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Ɔsatu "Campaigns" ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nyinaa a ɛkasa tia gyinapɛn ne suban a epira a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, tumi, ne nna ho, bere a ɛhyɛ abusuabɔ a obu ne pɛyɛ ho nkuran no. Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom bɔ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, mmarahyɛ baguafo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow ntam de hyehyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw yare ano ne mmoa adwuma a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no. Nnwumakuw a ɛwɔ fam a ɛboaboa mpɔtam hɔfo ano ma wɔyɛ ade tia nna mu basabasayɛ, te sɛ nantew, nhyiam, ne sika a wɔboaboa ano ma nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano ne mmoa dwumadi ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne yerekatee nneɛma, adwumayɛbea, anaa mmoa akuw bi a ɛwɔ me mpɔtam anaa sukuu mu a ebetumi aboa me ma me katee ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim na makyekye mfɛfo ne afotufo a wɔboa me?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nneɛma ketee, adwumayɛbea, anaa mmoa akuw a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam anaa sukuu mu na ama wo ketee nimdeɛ akɔ anim na woakyekye atipɛnfo ne afotufoɔ a wɔboa. Hwehwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde tete nneɛma a ɛma obi yɛ ade tra so, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene asi ahotoso a wɔbɛma wɔanya, nkitahodi a wɔka sie, ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔbɛfa so akɔ so yiye so. Hwehwɛ mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, sukuu afotufoɔ, anaa mpɔtam akannifoɔ ma wɔn nyansahyɛ ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ nneɛma a ɛfata ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛtrɛw mu, atu mpɔn, na wɔakɔ so atra hɔ daa na ama wɔadi wɔn ahiade ne hokwan ahorow ho dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow denam: Nhumu a wɔbɛma wɔahu hia a asetra mu ahobammɔ ho hia ma mmabun yiyedi ne hokwan ahorow denam ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim, nsɛm a esisi, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo so. Atipɛnfo, mpɔtam hɔfo, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano ma wɔahwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae wɔ nhyehyɛe mu, sika a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, na wɔama mmabun asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Wɔn a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, mmarahyɛ baguafo, ne aban mpanyimfo bedi nkitaho de akamfo asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun ahiade ne hokwan ahorow di kan no ntrɛw, wɔma ɛkɔ anim, na ɛtra hɔ daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nyiyimu ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so Hokwan ahorow: Ɛsono mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow, nanso aman pii wɔ mmara a ɛbɔ ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ho ban fi nyiyimu ho wɔ adwuma, adan, ne ɔmanfo dabere mu. Nna mu Akwahosan: Ɛsono sɛnea mmara kwan so gye ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna tom, na mmeae bi ma kwan ma wɔyɛ nsakrae wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea agyiraehyɛde ahorow mu wɔ nkrataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea so. Mmara a ɛko tia nyiyim betumi abɔ ankorankoro a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu ho ban afi nyiyim a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne asetra mu sikasɛm mu nneɛma nya mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ sika a wɔde di dwuma ne sikasɛm ho gyinaesi ho so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne asetra mu sikasɛm betumi anya mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe so nsunsuaso kɛse wɔ sika a wɔde di dwuma ne sikasɛm ho gyinaesi ho. Nneɛma te sɛ abusua ntetee, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a wobenya, ne sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow betumi akyerɛ mmabun sikasɛm mu gyidi, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneyɛe. Mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow anaa asetra mu sikasɛm mu tebea horow mu betumi anya adwene ahorow wɔ sikakorabea, sika a wɔsɛe no, boseabɔ, ne sika a wɔde hyɛ mu ho, na esi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔte osuahu ahorow ase na wɔsakra sikasɛm ho adesua ma ɛne ahiade pɔtee bi hyia no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ abrabɔ pa ho nkuran wɔ Intanɛt so, na ɛbɔ hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro a wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm anaa mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ no ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ abrabɔ pa wɔ intanɛt so nneyɛe ho nkuran na ɛbɔ hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm anaa mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ no ho ban denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatu ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ intanɛt so dwumadibea ne sohyial media ho mmara yiye de siw kɔmputa so ayayade, ayayade, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔtrɛw ano mu. Wɔne sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, Ɔmanfo Ahyehyɛde ahorow(CSOs) ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛhyɛ dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw, intanɛt so ahobammɔ, ne mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nkuran. Nhumu a wɔbɛma wɔahu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛ obu ma kokoam nsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne pene a wɔpene so wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu na wɔhyɛ atipɛnfo nkuran sɛ wonni abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow akyi wɔ wɔn dijitaal nneyɛe "digital conduct" mu. Ankorankoro osuahu ne nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ de asi nkɛntɛnso a intanɛt so ayayade anaa nyiyim nya wɔ ankorankoro adwenemyare ne wɔn yiyedi so dua, a ɛbɛma wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpanyimfo anya tema ne ntease.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan a etu mpɔn a mɛfa so ne m’atipɛnfo adi nkitaho bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere no so bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ krado tie obiara asɛm: Tie a wunmmu atɛn. Bu: Bu wɔn adwene sɛ ɛsono mpo a. Ma Da Ada hɔ: Ka nokwaredi na kwati ntease a ɛnteɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi mensabuo bere akyi?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wohwɛ wo brayɛ ana nsabuo so a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woahu bere a wo nna befi ase na woate wo nipadua ase yiye. Sɛnea wubetumi ayɛ ni: Kalenda: Hyɛ da a edi kan a wobɛkɔ nna no agyirae sɛ da edikan. Kan nna no kosi sɛ wo nna a edi hɔ no befi ase. Eyi bɛma woanya wo kyinhyia tenten ho adwene. Apps: Period tracking apps pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma ama smartphones. Saa app ahorow yi ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛkyerɛw wo nna no mfiase ne n’awiei, adi yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow akyi, na woakyerɛ bere a edi hɔ a wo nna no bɛba. Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Hwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ nufu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, adwene mu nsakrae, ne nsakrae a ɛba wɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu no yiye. Eyinom nso betumi aboa wo ma woahu wo bra. Wo kyinhyia a wobɛdi akyi no betumi aboa wɔ nhyehyɛe a wobɛyɛ na woasiesie wo ho ama wo nna mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua nna mu akwahosan ho ade pii na mapaw nneɛma a ɛfata ama me ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ɔfotufo betumi de kokoam mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ama. Ayarehwɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa su wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea anaa sukuu ayarehwɛfo betumi de afotu mmoa ama. YMK app (android app) a Ghana Health Service yɛeɛ no, wɔ nneɛma a wobɛtumi akenkan anaa wo ne service providera a wɔatete wɔn nkasa mfa nsɛm foforɔ ho. Mmabun akwahosan akuw a ɛwɔ wo sukuu mu no susuw nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw bɛn na mmerante ne mmabaa betumi ahyia, bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) ho no? (bere a wɔde ma, te nka sɛ wɔaboro so) .
answer_twi_source: Woayɛ no yie, nsɛnnennen betumi aba: Bere a Wɔde Ma: Kari pɛ wɔ bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) dwumadi ahorow ne sukuu adwuma ne ankorankoro yiyedi mu. Fi ase ketewaa bi na nkakrankakra ma wo ho a wode bɛhyɛ mu no nkɔ soro. Te a Wote nka sɛ Wo Ho Ahyɛ Wo So: Mmɔ mmɔden sɛ wo nkutoo wobɛyɛ ne nyinaa! Fa nnwuma hyɛ afoforo nsa, kyɛ asɛde ahorow ma afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, na gye w’ahome bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'social media' anaa dijitaal akwan afoforo adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow (ASRRs) ho asɛm? (Nkyerɛkyerɛ mu nsɛm a wɔreyɛ, de Nea aborɔfo ka no 'hashtag' ahorow a ɛfata adi dwuma)
answer_twi_source: Nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'Social media' yɛ adwinnade kɛse a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu. Akwan bi a wobɛfa so de adi dwuma ni: Yɛ Nhomasua Nsɛm: Yɛ nsɛm anaa mfoni ahorow a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho (hwɛ nhwɛso no, pene, abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa). Fa Nea aborɔfo ka no 'Hashtags' a Ɛfa Ho Hia: Fa nea aborɔfo ka no 'hashtags' te sɛ #ASRH anaa #NnaApɔmudenNhomasua Nea aborɔfo ka no 'SexualHealthEducation' ka ho na ama woatumi adu nnipa pii nkyɛn. Trɛw Nsɛm a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Dedaw Mu: Kyɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a efi ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye di te sɛ nea aborɔfo ka no 'Planned Parenthood' anaa Amanaman Nkabom Nnipa dodow Foto a aborɔfo ka no 'United Nations Population Fund'(UNFPA) hɔ. Nanso kae sɛ ɛnyɛ nea aborɔfo ka no 'social media' nkutoo ne asɛnka agua! Susuw ho sɛ wobɛbɔ Nea aborɔfo ka no 'blog' anaa wɛbsaet de akyɛ wo nkrasɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so dwumadibea ahorow betumi de nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho ahyɛ wɔn nhyehyɛe, adesua nhyehyɛe, anaa atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow mu de ahyɛ mmabun den wɔ nnwinnade ne nneɛma a wohia na ama wɔanya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, atenka mu nyansa, ne wɔn ankasa nhyehyɛe ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Atwerɛ (Journaling), Sɛ wobenya adwene pa afa biribi ho (Mindfulness), Nkɔmmɔbɔ, Agodie. Mmeammea a wɔma afotuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Na atenka bɛn na mmabun nyinaa taa nya, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn ahu ate aseɛ?
answer_twi_source: Anigyeɛ, Awerɛhoɔ, Abufuo, Ehu, Akyiwadeɛ ne Nwanwa. Hu denam: Ahwɛyie, Kasatwitwe, deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'Reflection' ne mmoa hwehwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn afa nna mu nkɔso so na mahwehwɛ me nna mu wɔ ɔkwan a ahoɔden wom na ahobammɔ wom so wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Sua adeɛ fa nna mu apɔmuden, ne akwan a yɛfa so si nyinsɛn kwan ho. Wo ne ahokafo nni nkitaho pefee, na hu sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka dabi wɔ biribiara a ɛmma w'akoma ntɔ wo yam. Da wo nna mu atenka adi wɔ akwan a ɛrennyae wo anaa obiara hwee so. Sɛ́ wobɛyɛ ɔbaabun a ɔtwi ne ho firi mpa mu agoro a, ɛyɛ ahobammɔ pa fi nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu a HPV ne HIV ka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ de ma, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam ahorow betumi anya saa nnwuma yi?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so de SRH nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma ahorow pii a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ahorow ma. Ebia eyinom bi ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ, ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su a wɔde kokoam akwahosan ho nnwuma ma, atipɛnfo afotu ne mmoa akuo, ne nnwuma a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma SRH hwɛ a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Ɛsono sɛnea wobetumi anya saa nnwuma yi a egyina nneɛma te sɛ beae a ɛwɔ, sika a ɛwɔ hɔ, ne fekubɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne asoɛe ahorow yɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asiane wɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛsan anya nna mu yareɛ koro no ara bere a wɔasa no yare awie no?
answer_twi_source: Bere a wɔasa no yiye akyi mpo no, asiane da so ara wɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛsan anya nna mu yareɛ koro no ara bio. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Ade foforo a wobɔda no adi: Sɔ wo ne obi a ɔwɔ no d a a wommɔ ho ban a, wubetumi asan anya ɔyare no bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi aka wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow na wɔasi gyinae ahorow a ɛne wɔn adwene apɔwmuden ho ahiade ahorow hyia, wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso mpo mu?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro Ahyeɛ a Wubehu: Te w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne ahyeɛ ahorow ase, na fa di kan berɛ a woresisi gyinaeɛ no Fa w’ahyeɛ, nea wopɛ, ne gyinaesi ahorow kyerɛ w’atipɛnfo, sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔkasa atia kuo no mpo a. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di a wobu na wɔboa ankorankoro si gyinaesi ahorow hɔ. Ahotoso a Wobɛnya: Fa wo ho a wobɛhwɛ mu nneyɛeɛ, nsɛm pa a wosi so dua, ne w’ahoɔden a wobɛhunu so nya wo ho mu ahotosoɔ ne obuo. Nea Efi Mu Ba Ho Nsusuii: Susu nea ebetumi afi gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa adwene apɔwmuden ne yiedi ho mu aba ho ansa na woatu anamɔn bi, na fa nneyɛe a ɛne bere tenten botae ne gyinapɛn ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mmabun nnya nna ne awo akwahosan ho hokwan a edi mũ bere nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ/asetra mu gyidi ahorow (stigma). Mmara/nhyehyɛe ahorow (restrictions). Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ kakraa bi (sika a wɔde ma/ayaresabea ahorow). Ɔsɔretia a efi nyamesom akuw ahorow hɔ. Nkitahodi a enye wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpotam 'Outreach programs' ma akwankyerɛ nea aborɔfo fre no 'referrals' kɔ ayaresa mmeammea foforo anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Wɔkyerɛ wo kwan kɔ nea aborɔfo fre no 'specialists', ayaresabea ketewa, anaa ayaresabea keseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina sika a wonya, ɛka a wɔbɔ, ne sika a wɔbɛpɛ daakye so de sika a wɔbɛkora so botae ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware asi hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de sikakorabea botae ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware asi hɔ denam: Sika a wonya ne ɛka a wɔbɔ ho nhwehwɛmu: Wɔn mprempren sikasɛm tebea a wɔbɛte ase denam sika fibea ne ɛka a wɔbɔ a wobedi akyi no so. Botae ahorow a wɔde besi bere tiawa ne bere tenten mu a wobehu: Ahiade ahorow a ehia ntɛm te sɛ nneɛma a egye ntɛmpɛ anaa nneɛma a wɔbɛtɔ, ne bere tenten botae ahorow te sɛ nhomasua anaa ofie wurayɛ a wɔde besi hɔ. Sikasɛm paoa ho nhyehyɛe: Sika a wonya no fã bi a wɔbɛkyekyɛ de akora sika so ɔsram biara na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ sika a wɔsɛe no mu ma ɛne sikakorabea botae ahorow ahyia. Sikasɛm mu apɛde ahorow a yebesusu daakye ho: Sikasɛm a wobɛka daakye, te sɛ nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri, akwantu, anaa abusua a wobɛhyehyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, na wode sika asie sɛnea ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛka nkɔso ho nneɛma afoforo ho, te sɛ apɔmuden nhyehyɛe, nhomasua nhyehyɛe, anaa asetra mu mmoa ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkabom ho kwan ahodoɔ: Nkabom a ɛde ahoɔden foforɔ baNkabom a ɛbɛba asetena mu banbɔ (social protection) ne apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ ntam na ama kwan kwan ayaresa, aduane pa, ne mmaa ne mmofra apɔmuden anya nkɔsoɔ.Asetena mu banbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛka nwomasua ho na ama woatumi adi akwansideɛ a ɛmma mmabun a wɔn ho nni mmoa ntumi nnuru sukuu, wɔntumi nkɔ sukuu daa, anaa wɔntumi nten sukuu mu no so.Asetena mu banbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛka asetena mu mmoa ne adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho na ama sika ne adwumayɛ ho kwan anya nkɔsoɔ ama mmabun ne wɔn mmusua.Nkabom ho nsɛnnennen (Challenges of integration):Nkitahodiɛ ne nkabom a ɛbɛba nnwumakuo ahodoɔ ne wɔn a asɛm no kafa wɔn ho ntam no betumi ayɛ den ɛnam botaeɛ, asɛdeɛ, ne sɛnea nnwumakuo no mu nhyehyɛeɛ te a ɛnyɛ pɛ nti.Sika a ɛdɔɔso, nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne ntsetsee a wɔde bɛboa na ama nkabom adwumayɛ no atumi ayɛ adwuma yie na asi pi daa.Nneɛma a ɛbɛtumi de mpaapaemu anaa ntaawee bɛba botaeɛ ahodoɔ ne anidadoɔ a ɛnhyia a ɛda nnwumakuo ahodoɔ a wɔka nkabom nhyehyɛeɛ yi ho ntam no ho dwumadie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa tebea ahorow a ebia nhyɛso bɛba sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ nna mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho to woatinka so na fa w’ankasa ahotɔ ne yiyedi di kan. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi wɔ dwumadi biara a ɛma wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wo so no ho. Si w’ahye so pintinn na emu da hɔ, na sɛ ɛho hia a, siesie wo ho sɛ wubeyi wo ho afi tebea no mu. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo, abusua mufo, anaa adwumayɛfo a wugye wɔn di hɔ sɛ wote nka sɛ wunni ahobammɔ anaasɛ wunnim sɛnea wubedi tebea no ho dwuma a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na Partner Notification Services betumi aboa ma wɔasiw STI ne HIV a ɛretrɛw ano?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhokafoɔ Amanneɛbɔ Dwumadibea no bɛtumi aboa ama wɔasiw STI ne HIV a ɛtrɛ ano denam: - Hwehwɛ anaa hu nnipa a wɔbetumi anya yareɛ no bi efisɛ wɔne obi a ɔyɛ ɔyarefoɔ na abɔ mu atena  - Wobɛhyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu ntɛm, ayaresa, ne suban mu dwumadie a ɛbɛma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛnya ɔyareɛ no so ate. Wode nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa bɛma ankorankoro ne wɔn ahokafoɔ wɔ nna mu nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ mu, kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, ne akwan a wɔfa so tew asiane so. Wobebubu yare no kyinhyia a ewo nna anaase nnade a wode kyɛ nkitahodi mu denam ankorankoro a wobetumi ayɛ wɔn ho a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn na wɔde sɔhwɛ ne ayaresa nnwuma ama so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ no ase?
answer_twi_source: Adesua nneɛma: Wɔnam website ahorow, ayaresabea nneɛma, video ahorow, social media, sukuu nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne atipɛnfo nhomasua so nya nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ntam?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu pɛyɛ kyerɛ nnyinasosɛm a ɛfa atɛntrenee ne atɛntrenee ho wɔ sɛnea wɔne ankorankoro di mu, a wɔn bɔbeasu mfa ho. Ɛkamfo akwannya ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ, hokwan ahorow, ne sɛnea wɔne nnipa a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa nni no kyerɛ. Nanso, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ gye tom sɛ ankorankoro betumi afi ase afi gyinabea ahorow mu esiane abakɔsɛm mu ɔhaw ahorow anaa asetra mu animhwɛ nti. Ɛde asi n’ani so sɛ ɛbɛma nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde bedi saa nsonsonoe ahorow yi ho dwuma, ahwɛ ahu sɛ obiara benya akwannya koro sɛ obenya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu animtiaabu ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna mu apomden ho no ma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wobenya nsɛm anaa nnwuma? (Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne animtiaabu a ɛyɛ den ho hia)
answer_twi_source: Aseten mu animtiaabu betumi ama ayɛ den sɛ wobenya nsɛm ne nnwuma: Nkitahodi a Wɔabue Mu: Kommyɛ ma nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ba. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu apomoden ho asɛm a wɔbɛka pefee no ho hia yiye. Animtiaabu a Ɛyɛ Ɔhaw: Kyɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so na yɛ nhwɛsode ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na obu wom a ɛfa nna ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow so bere a meresi gyinae wɔ me nna ne awo akwahosan ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nyinsɛn a mɛpaw, ne awofoyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woresisi gyinae wɔ wo nna ne awo akwahosan ho, a nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a wobɛpaw, ne awofoyɛ ka ho a, ɛho hia sɛ wususuw mmara ne abrabɔ pa nyinaa ho: Hu mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ, a mfe a woadi a wode pene so, kokoamsɛm, ne hokwan ahorow a wowɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma mu ka ho. Susuw w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne w’ankasa tebea horow ho bere a woresusuw akwan horow a wubetumi afa so ho no, na hwɛ hu sɛ wo gyinaesi ahorow ne ahofadi, ne yiyedi hyia. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa afotufo a wobetumi de nsɛm, mmoa, ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware ama de aboa wo ma woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata a ɛda wo mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ 'sexual health screenings' (nhwehwɛmu)?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wofiri ase ne obi hyia a. Ansa na wo ne obi foforo nso bɛhyia mpa so. Sɛ wone obi hyia mpa so a ahobammɔ nni mu a. Afe biara. Dɔkota bɛkyerɛ wo mpre dodow a ɛfata sɛ woyɛ nsɔhwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa kasa a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu di dwuma na kwati nsɛmfua a ɛkasa tia bere a woresusuw STI ho no.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ anka yɛde nsɛmfua a ɛyɛ animtiaabu bedi dwuma no, akwan a ɛyɛ nokware bi a wɔfa so ka STI ho asɛm ni: Nna mu nyarewa(infections) (STIs) Nna mu nyarewa(diseases) (STDs) - nsɛmfua abien no nyinaa yɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ mmabun hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho mmoa ho ban anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ mmabun hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho mmoa ho ban. Eyi bi ne: Mmara a ɛma mmabun kɔkoamunsɛm ho awerɛhyem bere a wɔrehwehwɛ awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho mmoa. Mmara a ɛma mmabun kwan sɛ wɔpene awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho mmoa bi so a awofoɔ nntumi nnsi ho kwan, te sɛ awoɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ sɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ma mmabun mmoa a ɛyɛ, na ɛfata amammerɛ, a wɔmmu wɔn tumi ne wɔn kɔkoamunsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ nhwehwɛmu ahorow a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo ne nhwehwɛmu ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ (wɔpaw ne nea wɔkamfo kyerɛ).
answer_twi_source: Sɔhwɛ a Wɔkamfo Kyerɛ: Wɔhwehwɛ akwahosan ho haw ahorow mu (mogya a ɛtɔ kɔ nipadua mu, ɔyare mmoawa, nkwaadɔm a ɛnteɛ).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ STI ano aduro ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyeɛ betumi akyerɛ STI ano aduro ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam. Saa mmara yi botae taa ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmerante ne mmabaa anya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, nna mu akwahosan, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so no betumi ahyɛ ɔman anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmara a ɛkyerɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu nsɛm ne nea wɔde ma, a STI a wosiw ano ka ho ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adanse bɛn na wogye tom wɔ asɛnnibea de kyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no betumi akora adanse te sɛ aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ, asɛnnibea nhwehwɛmu, adansefo nsɛm, ne kɔmputa so nkitahodi so na wɔakyerɛw?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea nkrataa, 'forensic nhwehwɛmu adansefoɔ nsɛm a wodi fa abɛɛfo ntentan so. Kɔ ayaresabea ntɛm, kora nneɛma so, twerɛ nea ɛsisiiɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ɛsi gyinae a ɛfata, fawohodie, ne asɛyɛde wɔ me nna mu apɔmuden ne yiyedi ho?
answer_twi_source: A kyerɛkyerɛ: Kɔ so kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nna mu yare (STI) ho. Kɔ so nya wo nipadua ne n’ahiade ho nsɛm. Nneɛma a Wobɛnya: Fa mmeae a wotumi de ho to so di dwuma de nya nsɛm, te sɛ nna ho ayaresabea ahorow ne wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din. Bisa nsɛm na hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Di a Wobɛhyɛ So: Di wo nna mu akwahosan so wɔ nna mu yare (STI) nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ daa ne ahobammɔ a wode bedi dwuma no so. Hwehwɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano mu na paw nea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma wo. Wo Ho a Wobɛka Abɔ: Kamfo w’ahiade ahorow kyerɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Bisa nsɛm, ka nea ɛhaw wo ho asɛm, na yɛ obi a ɔde ne ho hyɛ wo hwɛ mu denneennen. Nkate mu Yiyedi: Fa wo nkate mu yiyedi di kan wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu. Fa w’adwene si wo nkate ne wo nkate horow so, na fa wo ho to so. Ahotoso a Wobɛma Anya: Fa wo ho a wobɛhwɛ ne obu a wode bɛma wo ho a wode bedi dwuma no so nya ahotoso wɔ wo gyinaesi ahorow mu. Fa ankorankoro a wɔboa wo na wɔte wo ase twa wo ho hyia. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi afotufo, mmoa akuw, anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo hɔ. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ama wo akwankyerɛ ne awerɛhyem wɔ wo gyinaesi mu. Tumi a wode bɛma wo ho wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wubebu wo ho ne afoforo, wo ne afoforo adi nkitaho yiye, wode ahye besi hɔ na woabu no, na woakɔ so ahu nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anammɔn a wɔfa so bɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ kyerɛ mmarahyɛ baguafo, sukuu mpanyimfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa atumfoɔ afoforo a ɛfa ho, na nsɛm anaa adanse bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun boaboa ano de foa wɔn asɛm no so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wɔbɔ nna ho mmonnaatoɔ ho amanneɛ no gyina mmarahyɛ ne baabi a obi firi so. Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi abɔ amanneɛ akɔ mmarahyɛfoɔ hɔ denam polisifoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn, anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ amanneɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu mu, ayaresabea, anaasɛ mpanyimfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so nkyɛn. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔboaboa nsɛm ne nyansakwan a ɛbɛboa wɔn asɛm no ano, te sɛ asɛm a ɛsii no a wɔbɛkyerɛw ato hɔ, adanseɛ biara a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔbɛsie, ne nnipa a wɔhunuiɛ anaasɛ baabi a mmoa bɛtumi afiri aba a wɔbɛhu. Ɛho hia pa ara sɛ wɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ firi animdefoɔ a wɔwɔ osuahu wɔ nna ho mmonnaatoɔ nsɛm mu, na ama wɔadi asɛm no ho dwuma yiye wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu nneyɛe anaa atetesɛm ahorow a ebetumi aka mmaabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu nsunsuanso, wɔ ɔkwan pa ne bɔne so no ho nhwɛso ahorow bi?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe anaa atetesɛm a ebetumi aka mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu nsunsuanso no bi ne: Amanne anaa amanne ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabunbere, aware, anaa awoɔ agyirae, a ebetumi anya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu onyin ne asɛyɛde ho so nkɛntɛnso. Bɔbeasu mu mpaapaemu anaa ahobrɛase ho gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛka nsɛm, nneɛma, anaa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun a ɛsono wɔn bɔbeasu nya no. Amanne kwan so ayaresa nneyɛe anaa nnuru a wɔde di nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm anaa awo ho haw ahorow ho dwuma. Aware a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe anaa amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa abusua nhyehyɛe, awoɔ, ne awoɔ ho. Taboos anaa bara a wɔbara sɛ wɔbɛka ho asɛm anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ayaresa ama nna mu yareɛ, adwene mu apomoden, anaa awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ɛnam animtiaabuo anaa aniwuɛ nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyekye nkitahodie pa na ɛboa a ɛma ahobammɔ ne yiyedi nya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde nkitahodie a ɛfata gyina ahotoso, obu, ne nkitahodi so. Hwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne yi: Bu mo ho mo ho: Mo baanu nyinaa te nka sɛ ahobammɔ wɔ sɛ mobɛda mo adwene adi na momfa ahye sisi hɔ. Nokwaredi ne pefeeyɛ: Wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ pefee. Pɛyɛ: Ahokafo baanu no nyinaa wɔ asɛm ka wɔ gyinaesi ahorow mu na wɔte nka sɛ wɔboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneyɛe bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma mehwɛ me ho a ebetumi aboa me ma manya obu ne ahotoso a ɛfa me nna mu akwahosan ho? (nhomasua, abusuabɔ pa) .
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ (nipadua/nyin). nyɔnkofa nkitahodi papa (obu/mmoa). Kasa nimdeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe ahorow di ahiade ne hokwan pɔtee a mmabun akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua, a LGBTQ+ mmerante ne mmabaa, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, aguanfo ne atubrafo, ne aborɔfo ka ho ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne policy nhyehyeɛ gye ahiadeɛ ne hokwan pɔtee a mmabun akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua wɔ no tom denam: Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho: Aban ahodoɔ hyehyɛ nhyehyeɛ a ɛka obiara ho a ɛfa LGBTQ+ mmabun, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, aguanfoɔ ne atubrafoɔ, ne aborɔfoɔ hokwan ne wɔn haw ho pefee. Nyiyim a Ɛnyɛ: Mmara nhyehyɛe bara nyiyim a egyina nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, sebi dɛmdi, atutra tebea, anaa ɔmanfo a wofi hɔ so, na ɛhwɛ ma mmabun nyinaa nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pɛpɛɛpɛ. Dwumadie a wɔde asi wɔn ani so: Nhyehyɛeɛ boa de nneɛma ne mmoa ma nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so a ɛdi akwansideɛ soronko a akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua hyia no ho dwuma, a amammerɛ mu nkateɛ ho nteteeɛ a wɔde ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akwan a wɔayɛ ama ayɔnkofa a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn ka ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mmara nhyehyɛeɛ hyɛ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua no kyɛfa wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ, wɔde bedi dwuma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu, na ɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔadi wɔn ahiadeɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde gyina hɔ ma ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nkitahodie ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow boa ma mmabun nya nnipa nyinaa ka ho, wogye tom, na wɔte ase?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nkitahodie ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ho di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, agye wɔn atom, ne ntease a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu. Ɛdenam osuahu ahorow ne nnipa a wɔyɛ ho mfonini ahorow so no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛhyɛ so dua kɛse ama mmabun atumi ahwehwɛ wɔn ankasa nipasu mu na wɔada wɔn ho adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amannebɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nipadua mfonini ho mu yiye na wɔasɛe no, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobehu mframa a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, mfonini a wɔsesa, ne nneɛma afoforo a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow pii adi dwuma de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nipadua mfonini ho no mu yiye na wɔabubu mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mfonini ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu ahwɛ sɛ ebia mframa a wɔde hyɛ mu, mfonini a wɔsesa, anaa digital a wɔde di dwuma, te sɛ nea ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ honam ani hwɛbea a mfomso biara nni ho. Nsɛm a ɛfa ho a wɔde mfonini ahorow kyerɛ, a aguade ho dawurubɔfo anaa wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no adwene ne nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi anya wɔ wɔn a wɔhwɛ no so ka ho. Nneɛma a ɛkanyan nipadua mfonini a wɔayɛ no yiye akyi a wobegye ho kyim na wɔasusuw ɔhaw a ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu betumi de aba no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu bere a m’atipɛnfo anaa m’ahokafo retwa m’ahye 'crossing boundaries" anaasɛ wɔrebu so, na anammɔn bɛn na metumi atu de asi me anohyeto ahorow so denneennen 'assertively assert my limits" na mabɔ me yiyedi ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Hu nsɛnkyerɛnne "signs" a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔretwa w’ahye anaa wɔrebu so, te sɛ wo ho a wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ, wommu wo, anaa wɔhyɛ wo so. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na tie wo atinka. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔretwa w'ahye a, fa "me" nsɛm di dwuma de ka wo anohyeto ahorow ho asɛm denneennen, da wo haw anaa wo haw ahorow adi, na srɛ sɛ wonni w'ahye so. Fa nea ebefi mu aba wɔ ɔhye a wobu so no si hɔ na siesie wo ho sɛ wode bedi dwuma sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhomasua, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne amammerɛ a agye din di wɔ suban ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ahyeɛ ne obuo ho a wɔhyehyɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mfonini anaa nkrasɛm a epira mu yiye na wɔakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ne amammerɛ a agye din di dwuma titiriw wɔ suban ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ahye ne obu ho a wɔhyehyɛ no mu. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mfonini anaa nkrasɛm a epira mu yiye na wɔakasa atia denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wobenya ne gyinabea ahorow a wohyia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu, TV, sini, nkitaho abɛɛfo ntetan, ne aguade ho dawurubɔ ka ho a wobegye ho kyim no so. Ɛdenam sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya abusuabɔ, pene, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ho adwene a wɔte ase so no, mmabun betumi apow nsusuwii hunu a epira na wɔama wɔanya adwene pa wɔ ahye, pene, ne obu ho. Wobetumi akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛda abusuabɔ pa ne nkitahodi a obu wom adi, ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ nsɛm a ɛda osuahu ahorow adi na ɛhyɛ asetra mu gyinapɛn pa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi asusuw hia a ɛho hia sɛ yenya yɛn ho yɛn ho mu ahotoso ne obu wɔ yɛn abusuabɔ mu ne sɛnea obu a yɛde ma yɛn ho yɛn ho kokoam nsɛm no boa ma yenya ahotoso na yɛkɔ so nya nyɔnkofa nkitahodie a emu yɛ den no ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ yɛde yɛn ho to yɛn ho yɛn ho so na yebu yɛn ho yɛn ho wɔ yɛn nyɔnkofa nkitahodie mu ne sɛnea obu a yɛde ma yɛn ho yɛn ho kokoam nsɛm no boa ma yɛnya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den na yɛkura mu no so dua. Hu sɛ obu a yɛde ma kokoam nsɛm no ma yenya ahotoso, nokwaredi, ne ahofadi ho adwene wɔ yɛn abusuabɔ mu. Fa mo ho hyɛ mu sɛ mobɛdi nkitaho pefee, nokwaredi, ne obuo mu, na moadi mo ho mo ho ahyeɛ ne kokoam nsɛm a ɛhaw mo ho ni.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo di amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ akwaahosan ho gyidi ne nneyɛe mu ho dwuma bere a wɔne mmabun resusuw nna ne awo akwaahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ di amammerɛ mu nsonsonoeɛ ho dwuma wɔ : Ɔkwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔfa so, gye akwaahosan ho gyidie ne nneyɛeɛ ahodoɔ tom na wɔbu so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛnyɛ atemmu mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ate mmabun amammerɛ mu adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho ase. Nhomasua ne afotu a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a ɛka amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nneyɛe bom wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne awo ho paw ho a wɔde bɛma. Wɔn a wɔne nsɛm asekyerɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ amammerɛ mu anaa mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛyɛ biako bere a kasa anaa amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow wɔ hɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmoa a yenya fi yɛn mpɔtam, na adɛn nti ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Saa mmoa yi yɛ mmoa ahorow a akuokuo, ne ndwuma de ma wɔ yɛn mpɔtam. Brɔno pii yɛ krado boa mmabun wɔ berɛ nsesaeɛ hyɛ aseɛ da adi. Wɔma wɔn bammbɔ ne mmoa ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi agyina pintinn na wɔapɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmara a ɛbɛma obiara anya kwan afa intanɛt ne afidie so anya nna ne awoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayaresabea mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi agyina pintinn na wɔapɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmara a ɛbɛma obiara anya kwan afa intanɛt ne afidie so anya nna ne awoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayaresabea mmoa denam nneɛma a edidi soɔ yi so: Wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ahu hia a digyital ho hia ma mmabun nyinaa, a wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔadi dɛm ka ho. Nhyehyeɛ a wɔyɛ ne aban nnwumakuo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn sika nsi nnwuma a ɛbɛma digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw, intanɛt nkitahodi, ne digyital nneɛma a wɔbɛnya no tu mpɔn mu. Yɛne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔko ma nkurɔfo, apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ dijitaal akwan ne nnwinnade a ɛka obiara ho a edi mmabun ahiade ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia ɔhaw anaa ayayade wɔ adwumam a, anammɔn bɛn na wobetumi atu, na mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia ɔhaw anaa ayayade wɔ adwumam a, wobetumi ayɛ nneɛma a edidi so yi: Kyerɛw nsɛm a esisii: Yɛ ayayade, anaa nyiyim biara ho kyerɛwtohɔ, a nna, mmere, ne nsɛm a esisii ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ka ho. Bɔ amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ: Ma adwuma so ahwɛfoɔ, nnipa adwumakuo, anaa atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho amanneɛ wɔ ɔhaw anaa ayayadeɛ no ho, di amanneɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ no akyi. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Kɔ mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa wɔn a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn ma wonya akwankyerɛ, nkate fam mmoa, ne mmoa wɔ amanneɛbɔ ne ano aduru nhyehyɛe no mu. Hu wɔn hokwan ahorow: Hu mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbara adwumam ayayade ne nyiyim no yiye, na sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmara mu afotu de bɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow ho ban na hwehwɛ sɛ wobesiesie wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ahoɔden agyina ano ne sɛnea wogyina tebea horow ano de adi tebea horow a emu yɛ den te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, ɔhaw, anaa nkɔso a wɔmpɛ mu, na wɔakura wɔn ho a wɔte nka sɛ wɔsom bo ne nidi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne sɛnea wugyina ano de di tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu denam: Mmoa Nkitahodi a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Abusuabɔ a wɔne wɔn nnamfo, abusua mufo, anaa afotufo a wɔboa wɔn a wɔde nkuranhyɛ ne akwankyerɛ ma no benya. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Mmoa a wobɛsrɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ bere a wohyia tebea horow anaa nkate horow a emu yɛ den no. Akwan a Wɔfa so Gyina Ano a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ: Nneɛma a ɛfata a wɔde gyina ano a wobesua, te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, anaa nsɛmma nhoma a wɔkyerɛw, de di adwennwen ne nkate a emu yɛ den ho dwuma. Botae a Ɛyɛ Nokware a Wode Besi Hɔ: Botae ahorow a wubetumi adu ho a wode besisi w’ani so na wode w’adwene asi anammɔn nketenkete a wobɛfa so anya nkɔso so sen sɛ wode bɛyɛ pɛyɛ. Ankasa Mmɔborɔhunu: Sɛ obi de ne ho hyehye no ne ayamye a ɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ ne ho, na ohu sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ obedi mfomso na wahwehwɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wanyin na wasua ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nsem ama akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea bi de aboa wɔn ma wɔatu mpɔn wɔ wɔn nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nsɛm ama akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea bi de aboa wɔn ma wɔatu mpɔn wɔ wɔn nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun mu denam: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa adwumayɛfo a wobɛkasa pefee afa wo suahu ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛbɛma woanya nkɔso ho. Abotɔyam ho nhwehwɛmu anaa nsɛm a wɔka ho nkrataa a adwumayɛbea no de ama a wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Sɛ wobɛkɔ adwumayɛbea no ayarefo anaa adetɔfo som dwumadibea hɔ abɛka wo nsusuwii. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so anaa afotufo akuw a adwumayɛbea no hyehyɛ de boaboa nsɛm ano fi ayarefo nkumaa ne wɔn mmusua hɔ. Intanɛt so nhwehwɛmu akwan anaa nea broni ka no 'social media' a wode bedi dwuma de agyaw nsusuwii ahorow na woakyɛ wo suahu ahorow akyerɛ afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma pɔtee bɛn na ɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu a wɔde ma mmabun ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔde ma mmabun no, nea ɛka ho ne nnwuma ahorow te sɛ: Afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nea wɔde ma. Nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu. Afotu a wɔde ma ansa na wanyinsɛn. Brayɛ mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. 'HIV' nhwehwɛmu ne dwumadie a wɔde siw ano. Nea broni ka no 'HPV' a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu. Wɔde wɔn kɔ ayaresabea titiriw bere a ɛho hia, te sɛ mmea ho adwumayɛbea anaa adwenemyare ho mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne SMART botae ahorow no su ahorow (Pɛtɛ, Wotumi Susuw, Wotumi Du ho, Ɛfata, Bere a Wɔde Toto Ho), na mɛyɛ dɛn de adi dwuma de asi botae ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware na wobetumi adu ho ama me nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: SMART botae ahorow no yɛ Pɛpɛɛpɛ, Wotumi Susuw, Wotumi Du ho, Ɛfata, na Bere a Wɔde Bɛhyɛ Mu. Wubetumi de adi dwuma de asi botae ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware na wubetumi adu ho ama wo nna mu akwahosan ne wo yiyedi denam: Pɛpɛɛpɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea wopɛ sɛ wunya mu pefee, te sɛ "Fa nna a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma denam kɔndɔm a wode bedi dwuma bere nyinaa so." Wobetumi asusuw: Fa gyinapɛn ahorow si hɔ a wode bɛhwɛ nkɔso ne nkonimdi, te sɛ "Hyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STIs ho bosome asia biara." Nea wubetumi adu ho: Hwɛ hu sɛ botae ahorow no yɛ nea ɛfata na wubetumi adu ho, na susuw wo nneɛma, nea wubetumi, ne tebea horow ho. Nea ɛfa ho: Fa botae ahorow ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a wode di kan, ne w’apɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa ho no hyia. Bere a wɔde ahyɛ mu: Fa bere a wɔde bɛma anaa bere nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛma woanya ntɛmpɛ ne akontaabu ho adwene, te sɛ "Fa hye ahorow si nkitahodie mu wɔ bosome a edi hɔ no mu."
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ akyi bere a wɔde nnwuma rema no?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi akura nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ mu denam: Mmabun ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, a wɔbɛkyerɛ bere a wɔrebisabisa wɔn nsɛm na wɔresa wɔn yare no so. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛnyɛ atemmu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho a wɔde bɛma. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma nyinaa a wɔde ma, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu yare nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawoɔ akyi, a nyiyimu anaa nhyɛso biara nni mu. Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nnwuma no yɛ nea wotumi nya, ne bo nyɛ den, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho de di mmabun ahiade ahorow ho dwuma. Abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ne adwumayɛfo abrabɔ a wobedi akyi sɛnea mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm ahorow kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na metumi atu de asiw kɔmputa so ayayade ne ɔhaw ano wɔ sohyial 'media' ne dijitaal akwan so?
answer_twi_source: Si ano na bo amaneɛ: Fa si ano na bo amaneɛ 'features' a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so no siw nea broni ka no 'account' ahorow a ɛde wɔn ho hyɛ ayayade anaa ateetee mu no ano na bɔ amanneɛ. Mma Mmuae: Kwati sɛ wo ne wɔn a wɔyɛ basabasa wɔ Intanɛt so bedi nkitaho; mmuae a wɔde bɛma no betumi ama tebea no ayɛ kɛse. Sie Adanse: Fa nkrasɛm anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw adwene sie sɛ adanse. Wo ne Obi Nkasa: Sɛ wɔreyɛ wo basabasa wɔ Intanɛt so a, wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu fotufo nkasa. Hyɛ Adwempa Ho Nkɔso: Ma w’adwene nkɔ w’ankasa wo nneyɛe so wɔ Intanɛt so na hyɛ adwempa ne ayamye ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti obi betumi anya STI a ɔrenkyerɛ (ɔrenna) yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne biara?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebetumi aba sɛ obi benya STI a ɔrenkyerɛ yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne biara. Yie na wato din sɛ asymptomatic (nna sɛnkyerɛnnɛ biaa adi). Ankorankoro a wonni sɛnkyerɛnne biara da so ara tumi de ɔyare no kɔ wɔn a wɔne wɔn da mu, na wɔboa ma STI ahorow trɛw a wonnim. STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ho hia, titiriw ma nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu, na ama wɔahu nyarewa a enni sɛnkyerɛnne biara na wɔasiw ɔyare mmoawa a ɛbɛkɔ so no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee adi dwuma de ahu ɔmanfo gyinapɛn anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow a ebetumi anya me gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ho so nkɛntɛnso na makasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ma wutumi hu ɔmanfo gyinapɛn anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow a ebetumi anya wo gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ho so nkɛntɛnso na woakasa atia. Bisa nsusuwii ahorow a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow ase a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna, anaa abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ho. Hwɛ sɛ ebia saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi ne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no hyia anaa, na susuw adwene foforo a ɛhyɛ ahofadi, pene, ne obu ma nneɛma ahorow ho nkuran ho. Kamfo nsakrae kyerɛ denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu, nhumu a wobɛma anya nkɔso, ne nnwuma a ɛkasa tia gyinapɛn ahorow a epira na ɛhyɛ adwene a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho a wobɛboa no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan bi wɔ hɔ a mɛfa so akyrɛ m'adwen akyerɛ me nnamfo anaa m’atipɛnfo a wɔrehyɛ me sɛ memfa me ho nhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: Fa nsɛmfua te sɛ "Mete nka sɛ m'ani nngye..." anaa "Memmpɛ sɛ meyɛ..." Da wo atenka ne wo hyeɛ adi kyerɛ na yɛ pintinn: Ka wo pow no pefee a wompa kyɛw anaasɛ womfa anoyi mma. Tie wo nnamfo adwene nanso kura wo gyinabea mu, gye wɔn adwene tom berɛ a wogyina pintinn wɔ w’ankasa wo gyidi ahorow mu no. Fa akwan foforo ma: Fa dwumadi foforo anaa ntamgyinafo a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne ahotɔ gyinabea hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahye a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ papa a mede besi hɔ no betumi aboa ma ayɛ yiyedi ne obu ama me ho nyinaa, titiriw wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a mede bɛfa nna mu dwumadi anaa nneyɛe a asiane wom ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahye (boundaries) a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ papa a wode besi hɔ no boa ma wo yiyedi ne obu a wubenya wɔ wo ho nyinaa ba, titiriw wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wode bɛfa nna mu dwumadi anaa nneyɛe a asiane wom ho no mu. Ahye ma wo tumi sɛ wode w’ankasa ahiade ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow di kan, ka wo anohyeto ahorow ho asɛm yiye, na wokyerɛ sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ wusi gyinae ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia. Ɛdenam obu a afoforo bu w’ahye so no, ɛda adi sɛ wobebu wo ne nea wopaw, na ɛde abusuabɔ pa ne obu kɛse ba wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmara a ɛfa pɛ a wɔpene so ho fa tebea a nsa anaa nnubɔne nom ho, na mmara mu nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma nna mu dwumadie a nsa anaa nnubɔne nom ho?
answer_twi_source: Pɛ a wɔpene so ne nsa a wɔabow mmara ma no da hɔ sɛ obi ntumi mpene so sɛ wabow nsa anaa ɔwɔ nnubɔne mu. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ wo ne obi a ɔwɔ nsa anaa nnubɔne mu a bɛda betumi ayɛ nna mu ɛhyɛ, efisɛ wɔntumi nsi gyinaeɛ a nimdeɛ anaa anigyeɛ wom. Ɛho hia sɛ bere biara wohwɛ sɛ obiara a ɔka ho no nim, otumi, na ɔde ne pɛ repene so. Nna mu dwumadie a wo ne obi a ɔntumi mpene so esiane nsa a wabow nti bɛyɛ betumi de mmara mu nsunsuansoɔ a emu yɛ den aba, enti ɛho hia sɛ wobu ahyeɛ na wokwati nna mu dwumadie bere a nsa anaa nnubɔne wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne abofra ntam abusuabɔ ne asesa asesa nya nsusuasoɔ wɔ mmabun ahotɔ ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛka nsɛmti a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho asɛm, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo ne abofra ntam abusuabɔ ne nkɔso nya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ mmabun ahotɔ ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛka nsɛmti a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho asɛm no so. Abusuabɔ a ɛboa na ahotoso wom a ɛda awofo ne mmabun ntam betumi ama nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee ayɛ mmerɛw na ama wɔanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den anaa akyirikyiri betumi ama obi ho ayɛ no yaw anaasɛ wampɛ sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛtete saa mu. Awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ne akwankyerɛ betumi anya mmabun nimdeɛ, wɔn suban, ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso pa, bere a awofo mmoa anaa akwankyerɛ a wonni no betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaasɛ gyinaesi a wonni nimdeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asusuw nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ akyiri ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ etu mpɔn na edi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ nneɛma mu no betumi ayɛ: Nimdeɛ ne suban a wɔsɔ hwɛ ansa na wɔasɔ ahwɛ ne berɛ a wɔasɔ ahwɛ akyi. Nhwehwɛmu ne akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so a wɔne asuafo, awofo, ne akyerɛkyerɛfo yɛ. Adesua nhyehyɛe mu nneɛma ne akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ no mu nhwehwɛmu. Akwahosan mu nsunsuanso te sɛ nyinsɛn ne STI dodow a wɔhwɛ so. Nsɛm a ɛfiri mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma ne ahokafoɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ mede nnuru a wɔde hwɛ honam ani te sɛ nea ɛma honam ani yɛ nɔmenɔme anaa nea ɛbɔ me ho ban fi awia ho, na sɛ ɛte saa a, mesi dɛn ayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Aane , saa nnuro weinom ho hia ma mmabun. Sɛ wo honam taa wo a, fa nnuro a ɛɔbɛma no ayɛ nɔmee sraa ho. Fa sunscreen so sra wo ho minutes du enum ansaana w'apue. Fa nnuro a ɛmmfa ɔhaw biara mberɛ nipadua no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne sukuu ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ denam: Ɔsatu a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de akasa atia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ na wɔahyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho no ho nkuran. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnwuma a asuafoɔ di anim de di nyiyim a ɛgyina mmarima ne mmaa so ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ mu. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de akamfo nhyehyɛɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho a ɛdi mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa ahiadeɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho so, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛma wɔn suahu ahorow ayɛ nokware, obu wɔn ahofadi "autonomy" ne nea wɔpaw, na wɔbɛma wɔanya nneɛma a ɛfata ne mmoa adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho denam: - Tie ne Gyidi: Tie wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no suahu ahorow denneennen, agye wɔn nkate atom, na wɔde mmoa a ɛnyɛ atemmu ama. - a wode bu ahofadie: Bu wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahofadie ne nea wɔpaw, a wɔn gyinaesie a ɛfa sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn suahunu adi anaasɛ wɔrenhwehwɛ mmoa ka ho. - Nneɛma a Wɔde Ma: Fa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no bata nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛfata ho, a ɔhaw ho ahomatrofo "telephone" so, afotuo dwumadie, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛkamfo wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu ka ho. - Ahobammɔ Beaeɛ a Wɔbɛbɔ: Kamfo sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmeaeɛ a ahobanbɔ wɔ a wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no te nka sɛ wɔboa wɔn na wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa ne ayaresa a wonsuro atemmuo anaa nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛtɔ mmere bi a mete nka sɛ mayɛ ankonam anaasɛ matew me ho wɔ me mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ wayɛ ankonam anaasɛ watew ne ho wɔ ne babunbere mu a, ebetumi aba esiane nneɛma ahorow nti: Nsesae a ɛba Nnamfofa mu: Nnamfofa betumi asesa bere a ɛsono sɛnea obiara fa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a eyi betumi ama woate nka sɛ woayɛ ankonam sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔagyaw wo hɔ a. Asetra mu Nhyɛso: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wobɛfata no betumi ama woate nka sɛ woatew wo ho sɛ woanni gyinapɛn ahorow bi so a. Wo Ho a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Bere a worehwehwɛ wo nipasu mu no, ebia wobɛte nka sɛ afoforo nte wo ase, na ɛbɛma woate nka sɛ woatew wo ho. Nneɛma a edidi so yi betumi aboa wo ma woadi ankonamyɛ ho dwuma: Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wo ne wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafo bɔ no betumi aboa ma woasi ankonamyɛ ho atenka ahorow no ano. Ka w’adwene ne wo atenka kyerɛ obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso. Kɔ Dwumadie Ahorow mu: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ akuw, agumadi akuw, anaa akuw a wɔn ani gye ho a ɛte saa ara mu a, ebetumi aboa wo ma wo ne afoforo a wɔn nso w’ani gye ho no adi nkitaho. Adwumayɛfo Mmoa: Sɛ ankonamyɛ ho nkate kɔ so na ɛka wo yiyedi a, susuw ho sɛ wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo bi bɛkasa. Wobetumi de mmoa ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so ama asetra mu nkitahodi atu mpɔn ama. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛte nkate ahorow bi nka wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wunya saa nkate ahorow yi. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo, nnamfo, anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ no betumi ama nsesae kɛse aba wɔ atenka fam afa ahorow a ɛwɔ asetra yi mu a wobɛfa so no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Intanɛt so nsɛm bɛn na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ hokwan (ASRRs) ho? (mfonini 'Video', nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ, ankorankoro nsɛm)
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ahorow yɛ adwuma ma nkurɔfoɔ ahorow. Ne mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu nie: 'Video' ahorow: Ɛyɛ ma adwene a wɔtwe ne nsɛm a wɔka. Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ (Infographics): Mfonini a ɛnyɛ den a wɔte aseɛ a ɛfata nsɛm a emu yɛ den. Ankorankoro Nsɛm: Ɛne nkurɔfoɔ di nkitaho wɔ nkateɛ mu na ɛkyerɛ nneɛma a esisi ankasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi pow anaa adwemmɔne a efi afoforo hɔ a ɛfa me SOGI ho no ho dwuma? (wɔbɛma nkurɔfo anya obu ama wɔn ho, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛboa a wobenya) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmabunbere wɔ mmarima mu, na ɛka mmarima awo nhyehyɛe dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima Mmabun: Mmabunbere yɛ bere a abarimaa nipadua sesa yɛ ɔbarima nipadua a wanyin a etumi wo awo. Mpɛn pii no, nipadua mu nsakrae ne nkwaadɔm a ɛsakra na ɛhyɛ no agyirae. Nkɛntɛnso a Enya wɔ Mmarima Awo Nhyehyɛe So: Nkwaboaa: Nkwaboaa no fi ase nyin na ɛma mmadwoa, adeyɛ a wɔfrɛ no spermatogenesis. Penis: Penis no nyin na enyin. Prostate Gland: Prostate gland no trɛw na efi ase yɛ nsu a ɛma mmadwoa nya ahoɔden na ɛbɔ ho ban. Nna mu Su a Ɛto so Abien: Mmarima nya nna mu su a ɛto so abien te sɛ anim nhwi, nne a emu dɔ, ntini a ɛkɔ soro, ne Adam apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ nyin . Nsakrae a ɛba nkwaadɔm mu, titiriw testosterone a ɛma mmarima awo akwaa ne nna mu su a ɛto so abien nyin no na ɛde nsakrae yi ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu, te sɛ ayaresa anaa afotu, de adi adwennwen ho dwuma na ama adwene mu yiyedi atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi animdefo mu, te sɛ ayaresa anaa afotu, betumi ayɛ nea mfaso wɔ so kɛse wɔ adwennwen a wobedi ho dwuma ne adwene mu yiyedi a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn mu. Ayaresa ho animdefo ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛnyɛ nea wobu atɛn ma wɔhwehwɛ wɔn nkate mu, sua sɛnea wogyina ano, na wonya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano. Ayaresa betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba no ho nhumu, anya akwan pa a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano, na wɔanya ahotoso wɔ ɔkwan a wobedi ho dwuma yiye mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ne nea enni apɔmuden ntam?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ pa hwehwɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, obuo a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ahotoso, pɛyɛ, mmoa, ntawntawdi ano aduru a ɛma denhyɛ, ankorankoro nkɔso, ne ahobammɔ, bere a abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa nni saa su ahorow yi na ebetumi afa nkitahodi a enye, obu a wonni, ahotoso a wonni, tumi a ɛnkari pɛ, mmoa a wonnya, ntawntawdi a ɛsɛe ade, gyinabea, ne ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mɛtumi asiesie me ho na me ne ayaresafoɔ abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa ababunbere mu nsakyeraeɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛw Nsɛmmisa: Twere wo dadwen anaa wo nsɛmmisa nyinaa to hɔ na ama woatumi abisa nea ɛhia wo nyinaa bere a woahyia dɔkota no. Fa panin a wogye no di ka wo ho ba: Sɛ ɛbɛboa wo a, fa w’awofoɔ anaa panin biara a wogye no di ka wo ho ba bere a woreba wo nhyiamu (appointment) no mu, na ama wanya mmoa na wo werɛ amfi nsɛm nketewa no. Hyɛ no Nsow: Kyerɛw nea ɔyarehwɛfo no ka, titiriw fa ayaresa anaa anammɔn a edi hɔ ho. Di Nokware: Ka nsɛm a ɛfa ho nyinaa, sɛ ɛyɛ wo yaw mpo a. Wo dwumadiefoɔ hia nsɛm a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na aboa wo yie. Bisa Nteaseɛ: Sɛ biribi mu nna hɔ a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛbisa sɛ wɔmma wɔn mu nna hɔ anaa nsɛm pii. Ɛyɛ wo hokwan sɛ wote w’apɔmuden (akwahosan) ase yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi hyɛ obi ma ɔne no da, na mɛyɛ dɛn akwati sɛ mɛyɛ bi?
answer_twi_source: Obi a wɔbɛhyɛ no ma wada no yɛ suban biara a ɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛma wada bere a ɔmpɛ. Eyi betumi ayɛ: Afobu ho akwantu: Wɔma wɔte nka sɛ wɔnyɛ bɔne esiane sɛ wɔaka sɛ dabi nti. Anwiinwii anaa srɛsrɛMmɔden a wobɛbɔ sɛ wobɛbrɛ wɔn ase kosi sɛ wɔbɛpene so. Ahunahuna: Ahunahuna a ɛne sɛ sɛ wɔannya nna a, wobegyae abusuabɔ no anaa biribi foforo. Nipadua mu nhyɛso: Sɛ wɔka sɛ dabi mpo a, wobɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ wode wo nsa bɛka wɔn anaa wobɛfew wɔn ano yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abusua a wogye tum di wɔ LGBTQ+ mmabun yiyedi mu?
answer_twi_source: Abusua gye a wogye atum no boa kɛse ma LGBTQ+ mmerante ne mmabaa nya adwene mu apomoden ne yiedi, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya adwenemhaw, dadwen, ne adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho no so. Sɛ wohyia ɔhaw wɔ abusua gye a wogye tum ho a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di, nnamfo, anaa LGBTQ+ mmoa akuo hɔ. Kae sɛ abusua gye a wobegye atum no betumi agye bere, na w’ahiade ne w’ahye a wobɛkasa ama akyerɛ no ho hia ma wo yiedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atenka ne adwene mu nneɛma a ɛwɔ nna mu akɔnnɔ a wɔhwehwɛ mu ma ɔbabun?
answer_twi_source: Wo nna mu nhwehwɛmu berɛ a woyɛ ɔbabun no betumi ayɛ anigye na ayɛ den. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobegye wo berɛ ate w’ankasa nipadua ase denam wo ho a wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nkɔso a ɛfata ho no so. Fa ankorankoro a wɔboa wo a wɔma wo atenka ne osuahu ahorow yɛ nokware twa wo ho hyia. Afotu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a ɛsom bo ama wɔ saa nhyehyɛe yi mu hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minni nsɛnkyerɛnne biara mpo a, so ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STI ho anaa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ STI ho nhwehwɛmu sɛ wunni nsɛnkyerɛnne biara mpo a. STI pii betumi ayɛ nea enni sɛnkyerɛnne biara, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia wowɔ ɔyare mmoawa bi a wunhu sɛnkyerɛnne anaa sɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛda adi. STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ho hia na ama wɔahu ntɛm, asa, na wɔasiw ɔyare mmoawa a ɛbɛkɔ so ama wɔn a wɔne wɔn ho da no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho mu bere a wɔrehwehwɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu na wɔresisi gyinae ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma no ho hia ma mmabun a wɔrefa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow mu efisɛ ɛma wohu wɔn ho, wosusuw nneɛma ho yiye, na wosi gyinae a wonya nimdeɛ. Ɛdenam adwene a mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ mu so no, wobetumi ate wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan no ase yiye, na ɛma wotumi paw nneɛma a ɛne wɔn yiyedi ne wɔn ankasa botae ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwumadie bɛn na mpanyimfoɔ, mpasua so akannifoɔ, ne amammere mu adwumakuo ahodoɔ di wɔ amammere mu afahyɛ ne abrabɔ mu nsakraeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne emu dwumadie mu, na sɛn na wɔn nneyɛeɛ ka mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa nteaseɛ a wɔwɔ fa wɔn nna ne awoɔ ho kwan ne wɔn asɛdeɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpanyimfoɔ, mpasua so akannifoɔ, ne amammere mu adwumakuo ahodoɔ na mpɛn pii no wɔdi dwuma titiriw wɔ amammere mu afahyɛ ne abrabɔ mu nsakraeɛ ho amammere nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Wɔn na wɔhwɛ yɛn amammere ne yɛn atetesɛm so, na wɔkyerɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa nyansa, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛeɛ a yɛhwɛ kwan firi wɔn hɔ. Denam saa dwumadie yi so no, wɔka amammere mu gyidie ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho kyerɛ mmofra, na eyi ka sɛdeɛ saa mmofra yi te wɔn nna ho kwan ne wɔn asɛdeɛ ase. Wɔn akwankyerɛ bɛtumi akura amammere a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no mu, anaasɛ ɛbɛtumi ama kwan ama mpɔtam hɔfoɔ abɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔadwene ho yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsonsonoe wɔ nna ne awo ho apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den a wobenya a egyina nneɛma te sɛ abusuakuw, anaa bɛbia wote so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nsonsonoe wɔ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den a wobenya a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mmusuakuw, ne bɛbia wote so: Abusuakuw ne mmusuakuw nketewa, titiriw Abibifo ne Hispanicfo mmabun, taa hyia nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow wɔ apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den a wobenya mu, esiane nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ nti, a apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a enni hɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, asetra ne sikasɛm a ɛba fam ka ho gyinabea, ne nyiyim a ɛwɔ apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe no mu. Mmabun a wɔte nkuraase anaa mmeae a wonnya mmoa pii no betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu esiane bɛbia wote mu akwanside ahorow nti, a nea ɛka ho ne akwantu tenten a wɔde kɔ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wonni hɔ pii, ne ɔmanfo kar a ɛnnɔɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ minni ahobammɔ anaa manya nna mu basabasayɛ a, ɛhe na metumi akɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara: Nnipa pii hyia nna mu basabasayɛ. Mmoa wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya. Wo ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa: Eyi betumi ayɛ ɔwofo, ɔfotufo, oduruyɛfo, adamfo, anaa obiara a, wote nka sɛ wo ne no wɔ ahobammɔ. Kɔ ayaresa: Sɛ wɔato wo mmonnaa a, ɛho hia sɛ wokɔ ayaresabea ntɛm ara sɛnea wubetumi. Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no ntɛm ara. Bɔ mmonnaato no ho amanneɛ: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wode nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho amanneɛ kyerɛ polisifo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ nhyɛ ho mmara mu na ama wɔabɔ victims no ho ban yie na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya mmoa a wɔde ma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ amanneɛbɔ ho mmara a ɛyɛ ahyɛde mu de abɔ victims ho ban yie na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya mmoa a wɔde ma denam nkɛntɛnso a mmara yi nya wɔ victims no ahofadi, kokoamsɛm, ne yiedi so a wɔbɛma wɔate ase no so. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkorɔfo mu, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo adi nkitaho, na wɔaboa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔreyɛ adwuma de ayɛ nsakrae wɔ amanneɛbɔ ho mmara a ɛyɛ ahyɛde mu de akari pɛ wɔ ankorankoro a wonni ahobammɔ a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ne obu a wobebu wɔn hokwan ahorow ne ahofadi ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de akwan ahorow a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no dodow ne nea efi mu ba no atoto ho?
answer_twi_source: Afotusɛm bi a wode bɛtoto akwan horow a etu mpɔn ne nea efi mu ba ho ni: Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo nkasa: Wobɛtumi akyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea ɔkwan biara tu mpɔn ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba no mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛte ase so. Nsɛntitiriw a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho no mu nkyekyem ni: Mfaso: Hwehwɛ "a wɔde di dwuma daa" a etu mpɔn dodow ma mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware kɛse. Nsunsuanso bɔne: Susuw sɛnea nsunsuanso bɔne a ebetumi aba no abu so na ɛhaw adwene no ho. Kae: Ɛsono sɛnea obiara nya ɔhaw ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de wɔn ho to so de asi gyinae a ɛfata na matew dadwen so? (wɛbsaet, telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so, nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho yarehwɛfo a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa no wɔ nneɛma a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmara kwan so ahobammɔ betumi abɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow ho ban, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm, nnwuma, ne nyinsɛn ho nnuro ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ betumi abɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow ho ban denam hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wobenya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ne nea ɛnyɛ nyiyim, nyinsɛn ho nnuro, ne ahobammɔ a wobenya afi nhyɛso, nyiyim, ne basabasayɛ ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama STI/HIV bammɔ?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛwto/sobo a wɔbɔ. Asotwe/sɔhwɛ a wɔde ma. Sukuu a wɔgyae/pam wɔn. Nsɛmmɔnedi ho kyerɛwtohɔ (ɛka kɔlege/nnwuma). Boa wɔn a wɔwɔ asiane mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bɛn na ɛsɔre bere a wɔde mmabunu nna mu nsem   ne nnwuma ma mmabun wɔ mmeae a wɔboa nnipa anaa mmeae a ntawntawdi, nnipa a wɔatu afi wɔn afie mu, anaa abɔde mu asiane aka wɔn no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunu nna ne akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ nnipa mmoa tebea anaa mmeaeɛ a ntawntawdie, atutena, anaa abɔdeɛ mu asiane aka wɔn no ma abrabɔ pa ho nsusuiɛ ahodoɔ sɔre, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akontaabuo ne kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛhwɛ ama: Mmabun kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban no ho hia paa wɔ nnipa mmoa tebea mu, baabi a ebia ahobanbɔ ne ahobanbɔ ho nsɛm bɛkɔ soro. Ahofadi a wobu: Hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho bere a wosusuw haw soronko a wohyia wɔ nnipa mmoa tebea horow mu ho no ho hia. Tumi mu nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma: Tumi a ɛnkari pɛ a ɛwɔ nnipa mmoa adwumayɛfoɔ mu a wɔbɛhunu na wɔadi ho dwuma, a nsɛm a ɛfa nhyɛsoɔ, dwumadie, ne ayayadeɛ ho ka ho no ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde ɔsom adwuma a ɛfata bɛma. Ɔhwɛ a edi mũ a wɔde ma: ASRH dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ma, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu yare te sɛSTI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ɔhwɛ a ahobammɔ wom no boa ma wodi mmabun ahiade ahorow ho dwuma wɔ nnipa mmoa tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ boa mmabun ma wɔpaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho denam nimdeɛ, suban, ne ahokokwaw a wohia a wɔde bɛma wɔn na ama: Wɔne wɔn ahokafo, abusua, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho yiye wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no so. Si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI a wosiw ano, ne nna ho dwumadi ho. Fa ahye sisi abusuabɔ mu na kura mu, hu abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa ho sɛnkyerɛnne, na sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa. Fa atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu, di nkitaho sɛ wobɛpene so, na kyerɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi ho. Di nkate horow ho dwuma, gyina nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba ano, na paw nneɛma a ɛfata a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn botae ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne abusuafo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nna mu awo akwahosan "sexual reproductive health" ho ade na wɔaboa wɔn mma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wotumi de Ho To So "Reliable Sources": Hwehwɛ nsɛm fi ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde "World Health Organization" (https://www.who.int/health-topics/sexual-health) anaa akuw a wɔhwɛ mmubuafo hokwan ahorow hɔ. Nkitahodi a Wobue: Fi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase ntɛm na ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nipadua mu nsakrae, abusuabɔ, ne nna ho no nyɛ nea ɛfata. Fa W’adwene Si Tumi So: Ɛnyɛ dɛmdi na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nna mu. Di wo ba no ahoɔden ne ne ankorankoro su ho afahyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhaw anaa akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ nna mu yareɛ ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka apomoden ho nnwuma afoforo ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi so?
answer_twi_source: ɔhaw no bi ne: Nnwuma a wɔkyekyɛ mu: Dwumadibea ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ adwuma wɛ wɔn ankasa mu, na asiw nkitahodi kwan. Animtiaabu ne nyiyimu: Ebia apomoden ho adwumayɛfo nni ntetee anaasɛ wonni nnipa pɔtee bi ahiade ho nimdeɛ, na ɛde atemmu su anaa nyiyimu nneyɛe aba. Nneɛma a ɛho hia: Sika a wɔde bɛma kakraa bi, adwumayɛfo a wonni, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho di asi no betumi asiw mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nnwuma a wɔaka abom mu na wɔakɔ so atra hɔ no kwan. Nhyehyɛe ne mmara mu akwanside ahorow: Mmara kwan so anohyeto ahorow, kokoamu nsɛm ho haw, ne adwumayɛfo akwanside ahorow betumi asiw biakoyɛ ne data a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ntam no kwan. Saa ɔhaw yi a wobedi so no hwehwɛ sɛ: Nnwuma ahorow ntam biakoyɛ: Wɔbɛka wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wofi nnwuma ahorow mu abom ma wɔayɛ botae ahorow a wɔkyɛ, nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn kɔ. Ntetee ne tumi a wɔbɛma: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa a ɛkɔ so ma apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ de ama wɔn amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne nteaseɛ a ɛfa mmabun apomoden ahiadeɛ ho no akɔ anim. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae: Mpɔtam hɔfo mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano, wɔbɛbɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe, ne nsakrae a wɔbɛka akasa akyerɛ de ayi akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe mu no afi hɔ na wɔahyɛ ɔhwɛ ho nhwɛso ahorow a wɔaka abom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi anya aduan ho mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow, te sɛ SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) anaa sukuu aduan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi anya aduane mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ te sɛ SNAP anaa sukuu aduane nhyehyɛeɛ denam: Mpɔtam hɔ asetena mu nnwumakuo, sukuu, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ akwammisa ho. Aban wɛbsaet anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ akwammisa krataa wɔ intanɛt so anaa w’ankasa wo nkyɛn. Nneɛma a egyina sukuu so a wɔde bedi dwuma, te sɛ aduan ho akwammisa krataa a wontua hwee anaasɛ wɔatew ne bo so a sukuu no kyekyɛ anaasɛ sukuu anɔpa ne awia aduan nhyehyɛe ahorow mu kyɛfa a wonya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na tumi nsonsoeɛ (power dynamics) ka mmabun SRH hokwan?
answer_twi_source: Ɛte ahofadi so. Ɛde nsonsoeɛ ɛnnyɛ pɛ ba. Ɛsɛ sɛ mpanyimfoɔ hyɛ pɛyɛ den na wɔma mmabun ahooden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɛntɛnso a wim nsakrae betumi anya wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛka ASRH so, te sɛ nsu a ɛho yɛ na, aduan a wonnya, abɔde mu asiane ahorow, ne nnipa a wotu kɔtena bea foforɔ asian biribi nti?
answer_twi_source: Nsuo a Ɛho Ho yɛ na: Nsuo a ɛso tew esiane wim nsakrae nti no betumi aka ahotew ho nneyɛe, nsu pa a wobenya anom, ne ahotew ho nhyehyɛe, na aka awoɔ akwahosan na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyarewa a efi nsu mu no ayɛ kɛse. Aduan a Wonnya: Wim tebea a ɛde ɔhaw ba kuayɛ mu no betumi ama aduan ho ayɛ na, a wonnya aduanea nni, na aka mmabun aduan pa ne awoɔ apɔwmuden, a awo ne nea efi nyinsɛn mu ba ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ kokoamsɛm bere a wɔne akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo resusuw nna ne awo akwaahosan ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ kokoam bere a wɔne akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo resusuw nna ne awo akwaahosan ho no betumi ayɛ nna mu dwumadi, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nsɛm. Wɔatete akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔadi nsɛm a ɛtete saa ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ anifere ne kokoamsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wobetumi akyerɛ me kwan ma mayɛ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata wɔ nea broni ka no 'socila media accounts' so de ahwɛ onii a obetumi anya m’ankasa nsɛm ne me nsɛm a mede bɛto gua no so?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ nea aborɔfo ka no 'social media platform' biara a wode bedi dwuma no kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe mu na yɛ nsakrae wɔ mu na ama woahwɛ nea obetumi ahu wo nsɛm, mfonini, ne w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm so. Fa atiefo a wobɛkyerɛw wo nsɛm no ano hye ma nnamfo anaa akyidifo a wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso nkutoo, na susuw ho sɛ wobɛto nsɛm a ɛho hia te sɛ wo nkitahodie ho nsɛm anaa beae a wowɔ no ano hye. Hwɛ wo kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow no mu na yɛ nsakrae daa na hwɛ hu sɛ ɛne wo ahotɔ ne ahobammɔ a wopɛ hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Digital nneɛma ahorow bɛn na mmabun betumi ayɛ, na akwan anaa nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ada wɔn adwene adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwonwa so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ dijitaal nneɛma ahorow: Blog ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw Podcast ne Audio a wɔakyere agu hama so Video ne vlog Social media so nsɛm ne nsɛm Wobetumi de akwan te sɛ YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, blogging wɛbsaet, ne podcast hosting platforms adi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn nsɛm na wɔne atiefo adi nkitaho wɔ wiase nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwumakuo anaa mmoa ekuo foforo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔboa hwɛ sɛnea amanehunu mu mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ no kɔ so yie, na sɛ mmoa bi wɔ hɔ a, adwuma bɛn na wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Aane, abɔnten so adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ayɛ: Aban ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔhwɛ akwahosan anaa asetra mu nnwuma so. NGO ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu mu. Nhomasua asoɛe ahorow a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho. Wɔn dwumadie no betumi ayɛ mfiridwuma ho mmoa, nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho, anaa afotuo a wɔde bɛma wɔ nneyɛeɛ pa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ɛho hia a ɛsɛ sɛ LGBTQ+ ankorankoro susuw ho bere a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nhwehwɛmu ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ho no?
answer_twi_source: Bere a ebia Ghana wɔ mmara kwan so anohyeto ahorow a ɛfa LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho no, sɛnea yebetumi akɔ apomuden ho dwuma ni: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no nyinaa: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa wɔ apomuden ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn no ho hia ma obiara, a nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Nneɛma a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wosusuw Ho: Ebia wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ STD nhwehwɛmu a egyina nna mu nneyɛe so. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛnya ɔdemafoɔ a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ LGBTQ+ apomuden ho haw ho na ɔbɔ beaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ a wobɛka wo nna ho abakɔsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asuade bɛn na yebetumi asua afi wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ a atwam kɔ no mu wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma yie no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ a atwam no ama yɛahu hia a ɛho hia sɛ yɛde mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho ahiade di kan wɔ ɔhaw ahorow mu. Akwan a etu mpɔn no bi ne nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ntɛm, nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma a wɔde bɛka mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ntɛm ara ho, ne asetena mu nneɛma a ɛhyɛ ase te sɛ mmarima ne mmaa ntam pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne animtiaabu a wobedi ho dwuma. Sɛ wusua biribi fi osuahu ahorow a atwam mu a, ebetumi aboa ma daakye sɛnea wɔyɛ wɔn ade wɔ ɔhaw ahorow ho no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi akasa ama LGBTQ+ nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho na ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so dua wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ ankorankoro nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ, wobu wɔn, na wɔsom bo?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ma mmea ne mmea da ne mmarima ne mmarima da, 'LGBTQ+' nhyehyeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na ɛsi mmarima ne mmaa so dua wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ denam: - Nhumu a wɔbɛma akɔ soro: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ 'LGBTQ+' nimdeɛ nhyiamu, adwumayɛbea, anaa ɔsatuo de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ fa hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔka bom ne mmarima ne mmaa a wɔbɛsi so dua. - Nsakraeɛ a ɛfa Nhyehyɛeɛ ho: Fa adesrɛ bɛto sukuu mpanyimfoɔ, mpɔtam aban ahodoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ so sɛ wɔmfa 'LGBTQ+' nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho nni dwuma, te sɛ aguareeɛ a ɛnyɛ mmarima ne mmaa, adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu nneɛma a ɛka obiara ho, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛnyɛ nyiyim. - Ahobanbɔ Mmeaeɛ a Wɔbɛbɔ: Fa 'LGBTQ+' mmoa akuo, akuo, anaa apam ahodoɔ besi hɔ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ de ama 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro ne wɔn ayɔnkofoɔ anya ahobanbɔ ne mmoa tebea. - 'Amplifying LGBTQ+' Voices: Ma 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro nne ne osuahu ahorow yɛ kɛse denam nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ, nhyiam ahorow, anaa panel ahorow a 'LGBTQ+' ankorankoro betumi akyɛ wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn adwene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
