question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinaepa fa nnipadua ne akwankyerɛ mu faahodie, ɔhwɛ, ne ahobammɔ fi mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di anaa tumidifoɔ hɔ wɔ tebea horow a ebia m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa ɔbra mu nhyɛsoɛ ahorow a ɛbɛma asiane ho adwene ayɛ me naa?
answer_twi_source: Nnipadua ne akwankyerɛ mu ahofadi a wobɛkari pɛ ne hia a ehia sɛ wonya akwankyerɛ, hwɛ, ne ahobammɔ fi mpanyimfo anaa tumidifo a wogye wɔn di ho no hwehwɛ sɛ: Akwankyerɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ: Hu berɛ a akwankyerɛ, ɔhwɛ, anaa mmoa a efi mpanyimfo anaa tumidifo a wogye wɔn di hɔ betumi ayɛ nea mfaso wɔ so wɔ tebea horow a ebia atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa ɔbra mu haw betumi ayɛ asiane ho adwene a wowɔ no ayɛ naa. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee: Wo ne mpaninfo a wogye wɔn di nni nkitaho na pefee fa wo nsusuii, wo haw, ne osuahu ahorow ho, hwehwɛ wɔn afotu, wɔn adwene, ne mmoa wɔ gyinaesi mu. Fa ahyeɛ a emu da hɔ si hɔ ne mpaninfo a wogye wɔn di, si so dua sɛ wowɔ faahodie a wo hia a akwankyerɛ. Ahotosoɔ a wɔbɛnya: Ma ahotosoɔ ne obuo a obiara wɔ ne mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di wɔ abusuabɔ mu denam nkitahodie a ɛyɛ nokware, nkitahodie a emu da hɔ, ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔbɛyɛ de adi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene anaa nsɛnnennen a ɛfa asiane ho adwene ne gyinaesie ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfo betumi de adi dwuma de ayɛ tebea horow a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom ama mmabun ma wɔasusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho pefee a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfo betumi de akwan horow pii adi dwuma de ayɛ tebea horow a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom ama mmabun ma wɔasusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho pefee a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka. Sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmaa ne mmarima nkumaa mmoa mmeae, te sɛ baabi a wobetumi akɔ akwahosan ho nyansa anaa sukuu mu ayaresabea mma wɔn. Ɛha na wobetumi anya nna mu akwahosan ho mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoamsɛm na obiara mmu wɔn fɔ, na yei bɛboa ama nea ɛmma wonnya saa mmoa yi ayɛ mmerɛw. Mpanyimfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo nso betumi ahyehyɛ nhyiam ne adesua ahorow a ɛbɛma mmabun atumi abue wɔn ano akasa afa nna mu akwahosan, ne wɔnpene asɛm. Wei bɛma wɔanya nokware amaneɛbɔ na etu atoro nsɛm. Bio nso, sɛ wɔtete ayaresabea adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo ma wonya obu ne nimdeɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ ne nneyɛe pa ho a, ɛbɛma mmabun ate nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wɔbu wɔn, na wɔboa wɔn wɔ mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ afa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So hormone bɛsakra me suban anaa me nipasu?
answer_twi_source: Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu no betumi aka nneyɛe ne nipasu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na ama obi anya adwene mu nsakrae, na n’atenka asesa, anaasɛ wayɛ katee. Saa nsakrae yi yɛ ade a ɛfata onyin nere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ meyɛ babun, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi ahu me gender (Sɛ meyɛ aberante anaa ababaa)?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afi ase de w'adwene asi w'akɔnnɔ ne nsusuiɛ a wowɔ wɔ mmarima ne mmaa ho so, na woabisa wo ho sɛnea wo ne afoforo di. Ebetumi nso aboa wo ma woahwehwɛ mmarima ne mmaa ho nsɛm mu denam akenkan, video a wobɛhwɛ, ne wone nnipa nkitahodie soronko.. Kae sɛ, sɛ bere rekɔ no wo gender betumi asesa..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwahosan ho asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nyinsɛn mu ama mmabun no bi ne dɛn? (awo a ɛba ntɛm, awoɔ mu duru a ɛba fam, nyinsɛn mu nsɛnnennen) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn biara de asiane ahorow bi ba, nanso mmabun betumi ahyia asiane a ɛkɔ soro kakra wɔ nsɛnnennen bi ho: Awo a Ɛnkyɛ a broni ka no 'Premature birth': Akokoaa no a wɔbɛwo ansa na wɔadi adapɛn 37. Awo mu duru a ɛba fam: Nkokoaa a wɔwo wɔn a wɔn mu duru nnu nkaribo 5.5 (kg 2.5) betumi anya akwahosan ho haw. Nyinsɛn mu Nsɛnnennen: Eyinom betumi ayɛ nea broni ka no 'preeclampsia' (mogya mmoroso), nyinsɛn mu asikreyare, anaa mogya so teɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmoa a dɛmdifo a wɔyɛ adwumaden ne akannifo de ma wɔ asetra mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan ahorow ho ɔko a ɛtrɛw no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu ne Nhomasua: Wɔn a wɔadi dɛm ho adwuma no ma nkurɔfo hu nsɛnnennen a mmubuafo hyia na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ ɔmanfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ. Nhyehyɛeɛ mu Nsakraeɛ: Adwumayɛfoɔ yɛ adwuma de nya nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmara so nkɛntɛnsoɔ de hyɛ pɛyɛ ne akwannya a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm nya ho nkuran. Nnipa a Wɔka Wɔn Ho ne Wɔn Ananmusifoɔ: Ɛdenam nkamfo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu so no, mmubuafoɔ a wɔyɛ adwumaden no hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛgyina nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ ɔmanfoɔ mu mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ, a nwomasua, adwumayɛ, ne ɔmanfoɔ asetena ka ho. Mmoa ne Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm akannifoɔ de mmoa nkitahodiɛ ma na wɔma ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm tumi ma wɔkamfo wɔn ho ne wɔn hokwan ahodoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me suahu ne nsɛm a meka no boa ma nkɔso kɔ so wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛhwɛ sɛ wo suahunu ne wo nsɛm a wobɛka no boa ma nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ so wɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun mu no fa anammɔn a ɛdidi soɔ yi ho: Fa nsɛm a wobɛka: Fa wo suahunu, nyansahyɛ, ne wo dadwen kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, ne adwuma so ahwɛfoɔ. Di nokware na ka nsɛm pɔtee wɔ akwahosan ho osuahu no afã horow a na ɛyɛ papa anaa bɔne ho na fa nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ ma na ama woanya nkɔso. Fa wo ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so mu: Fa hokwan ahorow a wode bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, anaa afotufo akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun akwahosan so no di dwuma. Wo nsɛm a wode bɛba no betumi aboa ma wɔahu mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn na ɛkyerɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow kwan. Kamfo nsakrae: Kamfo nsakrae a egyina wo suahu ne nsɛm a woka so denam akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ayaresabea so ahwɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wo ne wɔn bedi nkitaho no so. Fa wo nne kamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛde ɔhwɛ a ɛfata mmabun di kan. Kɔ so nya nsɛm: Kɔ so nya nkɔso a aba wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nneyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ho nsɛm. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa nneyɛe pa a, ɛfa mmabun adamfofa hwɛ ho na ka saa nimdeɛ yi kyerɛ w’atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo. Yɛ nsi: Si ne bo sɛ wobɛkamfo nkɔso a ɛba wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun mu, sɛ mpo nkɔso yɛ brɛoo a. Wo kɔ so kamfo ne wo ho a wode hyɛ mu no betumi aboa ma nsakrae a ntease wom aba bere a bere kɔ so no. Ɛdenam akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wo ne wɔn di nkitaho denneennen, wo suahu ahorow a wobɛka, ne nsakrae a wobɛkamfo akyerɛ so no, wubetumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wo nne na akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun kɔ so nya nkɔso ma edi mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ anaasɛ m’ani nnye me fotufo anaa ɔyaresafo ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ w’ani nnye wo fotufo anaa wo ɔyaresafo ho a, ɛho hia sɛ wuda wo haw ahorow no adi pefee na wudi nokware. Wubetumi afi ase denam wo nkate horow a wo ne wo fotufo anaa ɔyaresafo bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ na woama wɔn nsɛm a ɛfa nea ɛnyɛ adwuma mma wo ho no so. Ebia wobetumi ayɛ nsakrae anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwan foforo a wɔbɛfa so adi w’ahiade ho dwuma yiye. Sɛ woda so ara te nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ w’ani nnye bere a woasusuw wo haw ahorow ho awie no a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo foforo a ɔfata wo yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mehu akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bere a manyinsɛn no?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wɔkɔ hu ansa na wɔawo no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn no akwahosan, ayaresa ho abakɔsɛm, ne nyinsɛn mfe so. Nanso, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo taa kamfo nhyehyɛe a edidi so yi kyerɛ: Nsrahwɛ a wɔkɔ no bosome biara wɔ bosome abiɛsa a edi kan no mu (adapɛn 4-12). Nsrahwɛ a wɔkɔ no dapɛn abien biara wɔ bosome abiɛsa a ɛto so abien mu (adapɛn 13-27). Nsrahwɛ a wɔkɔ no dapɛn biara wɔ bosome abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa mu (adapɛn 28-awo). Mmabun a wɔwɔ nyinsɛn a asiane kɛse wom no betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛtaa akɔ akɔhwɛ woapɔmden ne abɔfra a woda yɛfunu no mu nso apɔmden aberɛ biaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ miguare bere a merenyin?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a woguare anaa woguare bere a wɔadu mpanyin afe so no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nea n’ankasa pɛ ne dwumadi ahorow so. Akwankyerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa ni: Da biara: Nnipa pii hu sɛ mfaso wɔ so sɛ wobeguare atleast mprenu da biara ( anɔpa ne anwummere), titiriw sɛ woyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, wo ho fifiri pii, anaasɛ wote baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ hyew a. Hwɛ yiye wɔ honam ani ntini a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne mmeae a fifiri ne mmoawa boaboa ano te sɛ abasa ase, w'ase mu, ne wo nan ntamu so bere a woreguare no. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ akyi: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu a, guare. Ansa na Wobɛda: Sɛ woguare ansa na woada a, ebetumi aboa ma woayi efĩ, ngo, ne fifiri a aboaboa ano awiabere no afi hɔ. Nwi a Wohohoro: Wubetumi apaw sɛ wobɛhohoro wo ti nhwi da biara anaa nna kakraa biara a, egyina wo ti nhwi ko (a srade wom, ɛyɛ nwunu, ne nea ɛkeka ho) so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wo gyidie gye to mu a, susuu nneɛma a wɔbetumi ayɛ w4 nyinsɛn yi gu ho wɔ kwan a ɛnyɛ atemmuo anaa afa bi so.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woresusu mpopɔ ho a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ w'akwan nyinaa mu. Nneɛma a wubetumi ayɛ de asi ananmu no bi nie: Awoɔ: Wubetumi asi gyinaeɛ sɛ wobɛtetew abofra no. Nneɛma wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa wo. Abofra a Wɔfa No Yɛ Wo Ba (Adoption): Abofra a wɔfa no yɛ wo ba yɛ kwan a wubetumi afa so. Ne wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nkasa na wɔmmoa wo ma woasi gyinaeɛ pa pa a nyansa wom na wɔne asetena mu yiedie dwumadibea no nkasa ma wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔ yɛ mrɛ a broni bɛkasɛ 'vulnerable adolescents' ahyia ɔhaw suronko wɔ nsem a efa nna mu ne reproductive health ho.
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ayaresa dwumayɛnni ne wo bɛkasa afa nsem a ɛfa nna ho. LGBTQ+ yɛ adeɛ a mmara ngye ntum wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi akɔ so anom PrEP sɛ wɔn nna mu nneyɛe anaa nsusuanso ahorow sesa a?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi akɔ so anom PrEP sɛ wɔn nna mu nneyɛe anaa asiane ahorow sesa mpo a. PrEP yɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw na wobetumi afi ase anaasɛ wɔagyae a egyina ankorankoro bi tebea mprempren ne asiane dodow a ɛwɔ mu so. Sɛ mmabun hu wɔn ho wɔ tebea bi a wonni asiane kɛse mu bio sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ a, wobetumi ne wɔn apomoden ho ɔyaresafo asusuw ho sɛ ebia ɛda so ara hia sɛ wɔkɔ so nom PrEP anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho sɛnkyerɛnne pa na ɛma tumi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔkasa tia atetesɛm mu gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu ne nna ho mfonini a ɛyɛ papa na ɛma tumi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no twa atetesɛm mu gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu ho mpoa denam osuahu ahorow ne nnipa a wɔda no adi so. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu mfonini a ɛkyerɛ mmaa a wɔyɛ den na wɔde wɔn ho, ɛkasa tia mmarima ne mmaa gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ. Saa gyinabea ahorow yi de asɛm foforo a esi nnipa osuahu ahorow so dua na ɛhyɛ gye a wogye atum, tumi, ne asetena mu nsakrae ho nkuran ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne aban ahorow, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no asɛyɛde ahorow wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu na wɔabɔ ho ban no mu?
answer_twi_source: Aban ahorow, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no wɔ asɛyɛde ahorow wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wokura mu na wɔbɔ ho ban denam: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmabun nya awo ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne akwahosan ho nnwuma a nyiyim, nhyɛso, anaa basabasayɛ nnim a wɔbɛhyɛ na wɔadi so. Ntetee ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma wɔde nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nsɛm a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adamfofa, na egyina adanseɛ so bɛma. Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun benya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ne nea ɛnyɛ atemmu a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ahofadi, kokoam nsɛm, ne nidi. Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe a wobedi ho dwuma, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ nhomasua, adwumayɛ, ne akwahosan ho a ɛka mmabun akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnsɛ so a wobeyi afi hɔ. Nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim, ne ɔmanfo mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow na wɔabu aban ne ahyehyɛde ahorow ho akontaa wɔ wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asiesie me ho ama awofoyɛ ho nsɛnnennen bere a meyɛ ɔbabun ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopaw sɛ wobɛyɛ ɔwofo a, akwan a wobɛfa so asiesie wo ho ni: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo nkasa: Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ne suban pa ho de ahyɛ nyinsɛn ne akokoaa a ahoɔden wom ho nkuran. Nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa awofoyɛ ho: Sua mmofra hwɛ, nufuo a wɔde ma, ne mmofra nyin ho ade. Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfo a wɔboa: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi abusua, afotufo, anaa mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ma awofo nkumaa hɔ. Susu wo nhomasua ho: Hwehwɛ akwan a wobetumi afa so akɔ so asua nhoma bere a woretete abofra no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne m’amammerɛ anaa ɔsom mufo adi nkitaho de adi nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma anaasɛ mɛhyɛ ntease ne gye a wogye tom ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Fi ase bɔ nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nkɔmmɔ wɔ obu  kwan so, na si hia a ntease ne mmoa ho hia so dua. Yɛ nhyehyɛe anaa fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a ɛtwe adwene si nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu so. Wo ne nyamesom anaa mpɔtam akannifo a wɔabue wɔn ani sɛ wɔbɛbɔ saa nsɛmti yi ho nkɔmmɔ na wɔama ntease ne gye a wogye tom no nyɛ adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ (anɔpa akyi aduru) sɛ me ne obi nna a woankura wo ho anaa sɛ nuro a wode siw awoɔ kwan no anyɛ adwuma yie
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobenya aduru a wɔnom na woanyinsɛn wɔ mmerɛ a ɛsɛ ntɛm mu: Nnurutɔnbea ahorow: Wobetumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔtɔn wɔ nnurutɔnbea dodow no ara. Akwahosan Ho Dwumadifo: Sɛ wopɛ a, kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ nnuru a wɔakyerɛw ama wo. Intanɛt so Nnwuma: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow bi de akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abɛɛfo mfoni so ma de nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ara. Bere: Yɛ Ade Ntɛmntɛm: Nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm no tu mpɔn kɛse berɛ a wɔfa no ntɛm ara bereɛ a wɔammɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaasɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no adi nkogu akyi no. Wɔ dɔnhwere aduɔson mmienu mu (72) Mu: Wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ fa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ara wɔ dɔnhwere aduɔson mmienu mu (72) ntam, nanso ebetumi atu mpɔn akosi nnafua (5) wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so asɛde ahorow a sukuu ahorow, kɔlege ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde afoforo wɔ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano na wɔyɛ ho dwuma mu, a nea ɛka ho ne amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ ahyɛde, nea broni ka no 'Title IX' a wobedi so, ne nteɛso a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow, kɔlege ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde afoforo wɔ mmara kwan so asɛde ahorow wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano na wɔyɛ ho biribi no mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ nsɛm a wɔka no ho amanneɛ na wɔhwehwɛ mu, mmoa adwuma a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, ne adwumayɛfo ne asuafo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ne nea wɔyɛ ho. Nea broni ka no 'Title IX', ɔman mmara, hwehwɛ sɛ nhomasua asoɛe ahorow a wonya aban sika no di basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so, a nna mu ɔbrasɛe ne ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ obi so ka ho ho dwuma na wosiw ano, na wɔde mmoa ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akasa atia animtiabu anaa nyiyimu a ɛbata nna mu agodie anaa awoɔ apɔwmuden nsɛm ho wɔ amammerɛ ne gyedie kwan so?
answer_twi_source: Etwa sɛ dodoɔ noa nya nimdiɛ a ɛsɛ fata wɔ saa nsɛm yi ho, ama ntrosɛm ne nyiyimu aba fam. Hyehyɛ dwumadie wɔ wo mpotam fa bɔ ho dawuro. Kasa tia nyiyimu ne kasa bɔne, nanso ka no obuo kwan so. Yɛ kasamafoɔ wɔ wo mpɔtam ne gyedie kou a wo dɔm mu biara. Te anaa dɔm kuo a ɛbɛboa wɔn y'ayu wɔn asi nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahyɛ nnipa hokwan ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ ASRH denam nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, ne adwene ne nne ahorow a wɔde bɛka ho so?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua nhyehyeɛ bɛtumi ahyɛ nnipa hokwan ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ ASRH denam nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) so wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ a ɛsi nnipa hokwan nnyinasosɛm, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ, ne obuo a wɔde ma nnipa ahodoɔ so dua. Ɛdenam adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho, akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho, ne adwene ahorow a wɔde bɛka ho so no, nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ate wɔn hokwan ahorow ase, akasa atia adwene a ɛnteɛ, na wɔakamfo atɛntrenee wɔ ASRH mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu, kɔlɛgye, nsa ano-adwuma nteteeɛ mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne adwumawura di wɔ mmabun asetena mu nimdeɛ mpontuo a wɔma anaa wɔboa mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu, kɔlɛgye, nsa-ano-adwuma nteteeɛ mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne adwumawura di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun asetena mu nimdeɛ mpontuo a wɔma anaa wɔboa mu. Sukuu ne kɔlɛgye ma adesua ne nsa-ano-adwuma, adwuma afotuo, ne sukuu akyi dwumadie a ɛma mmabun nneɛma a wɔde fi ase, adwuma ho nimdeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so kɔ adesua anaa adwuma a ɛkɔ akyiri mu. Nsa-ano-adwuma nteteeɛ mmeae ma nteteeɛ pɔtee, adwuma nteteeɛ, ne adanseɛ krataa a ɛne adwuma ahiadeɛ hyia, a ɛsiesie mmabun ma adwuma pɔtee, anaa adwuma a wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ hyehyɛ nimdeɛ nteteeɛ nhyiam, afotu nhyehyɛeɛ, ne adwuma mmoa de boa mmabun adwuma hwehwɛ, nimdeɛ a wɔma ɛkɔ soro, ne adwuma a wɔbɛkɔ mu. Adwumawura ma nteteeɛ wɔ adwuma mu, nteteeɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ sukuu mu, ne adwuma a wɔde fi ase a ɛma wɔnya osuahu, adwumam tebea ho nimdeɛ, ne nkitahodiɛ hokwan ma mmabun a wɔrekɔ adwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ  dwumadie a ɛdi mu, dawurubɔ wɔ sukuu, sukuupɔn anaa mpɔtam hɔ ne sɛn na  mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu de ahyɛ saa dwumadi ahorow yi ho nkuran de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie a wɔyɛe wɔ sukuu, sukuupɔn, anaa mpɔtam so a ɛma obi nya nkɔso no bi ne : Ntetee Nhyehyɛe: Wɔyɛ nhwehwemu ne ntetee a ɛfa ɔkwan a wɔfa so boa obi ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie: Nhyiam dwumadie, nhyiam ahorow, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie a  wɔyɛ de kyerɛkyerɛ nnipakuw no ma wohu nea enti a ɛsɛ sɛ obi yɛ ade.  Nnwuma a mmebun di anim: Wɔma sukuufo tumi ma wodi anim de siesie nneɛma a wɔn mfɛfo betumi ayɛ de aboa wɔn. Nkabom kuo: wɔne mpɔtam kuw ahorow ne kasamafo kuo a wɔbɛka abom de nneɛma ne nimdeɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano no bedi dwuma. Nnyinasosɛm ho nkuranhyɛ: Wɔhyɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ asoɛe ahorow mu a ɛboa wɔn a wɔhwɛ nneɛma so no ho nkuran na wɔde mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔgyina hɔ no di kan no ho nkuran. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛte saa ara mu denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a wɔbɛyɛ so, atuhoama wɔ  nnwumakuw a wɔde wɔn adwene asi nna mu basabasayɛ ho banbɔ  wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow mu anaa wɔn man mu, ne nhyiamu a wɔbɛhyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ nneɛma so no ho ntetee no bɛbom akɔ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkabom ne akwan a wɔfa so si nneyɛeɛ bɔne kwan bɛtumi afa so adi nneɛma a ɛde awudisɛm ne amumuyɛ ba no ho dwuma? Nneɛma te sɛ tumi mu kuram a nmpaapaemu wɔm a ɛmfata, asetena mu nyiyim, ne amanmerɛ mu nneyɛeɛ a ɛgye amumuyɛ tom.
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkabom ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde siw amumuyɛ kwan bɛtumi adi awudisɛm ne amumuyɛ ntini ho dwuma denam:Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ na wɔdi nneɛma titiriw a ɛde awudisɛm ne amumuyɛ ba no ho dwuma, te sɛ tumi mu nyiyim, asetena mu nhyɛsoɔ, ne amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛgye amumuyɛ tom. Sɛ wɔhyɛ suban a ɛma pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, obu, ne adwene a ɛgye pene tom wɔ abusuabɔ ne mpɔtam mu, na wɔkasa tia suban a ɛhyɛ amumuyɛ ne nyiyim nkuran. Sɛ wɔde nteteeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛhia ma mpɔtam hɔfoɔ wɔ nneɛma te sɛ abusuabɔ pa, sɛnea wɔbɛgye obi afi asiane mu, ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ho, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ankorankoro bɛnya ahoɔden de asiw amumuyɛ kwan. Sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ foɔ te sɛ sukuu ahodoɔ, ayaresabea, asɔre ne som ahodoɔ, ne aban adwumayɛfoɔ bɛbom ayɛ adwuma na wɔabɔ pɔ kɛseɛ a ɛbɛsiw amumuyɛ kwan. Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a ɛdi amumuyɛ ntini ho dwuma koraa, te sɛ mmoa a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛdu obiara nkyɛn, akwan a wɔbɛfa so abu amumuyɛfoɔ atɛn, ne atɛntrenee ma nnipa nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn abɔ pene soɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ho dawuro wɔ me sukuu anaa me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Hyehyɛ dwumadie a ɛkasa fa penesoɔ ne nkitahodie pa ho dawuro, na ma ho nkeyrɛkyerɛ. Wei wobetumi de social media so ayɛ. Hwehwɛ adesua mu mpaninfoɔ de saa nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛba nwomasu mu. Te kuo anaa dɔm kuo a ɛbɛyɛ kasamafoɔ ma saa nsɛm yi. Wobetumi aserɛ mpaninfoɔ akukudam ma w'abɛyɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ asiane bi si mpofirim a ɛhia sɛ wɔgye obi nkwa ntɛm ara a, ɛdeɛn na wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma wɔ intanɛt so no yɛ de di saa asɛm no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa nnwuma a wɔnam intanɛt so yɛ wɔ amanehunu mu no taa wɔ nhyehyɛe pɔtee a wɔde di nsɛm a ɛhia mmoa mpofirim ho dwuma kan. Wobetumi ama woanya mmoa ntɛm ara afi abenfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi ahwɛ sɛnea amanehunu no yɛ kɛse anaa nea ɛhia, na wɔayɛ nea ɛfata, a ebi ne sɛ wɔbɛfrɛ aban mmoa nnwuma te sɛ polisifo anaa ayaresabea mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛka ho wɔ ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so a wɔde bedi dwuma mu no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde nimdeɛ pene so, wɔde kokoamsɛm sie, na wɔkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi ne wɔn dwumadibea. Ɛfa nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim a wɔnyɛ, pɛyɛ, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho a wobedi akyi, bere a wohu tumi a ɛnkari pɛ ne mmerɛwyɛ ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ abusuabɔ ne mpɔtam ahorow mu nso na wɔadi ho dwuma. Bio nso, nea ɛka ho ne mmabun yiyedi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, de wɔn yiyedi adi kan, na wɔasusuw amammerɛ, nyamesom, ne abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ahorow ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a wɔde ma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so di adwennwen adidi anaa atenka mu adidie ho dwuma wɔ mmabunyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Adikan, hyɛ nea ɛde ba nso, ebetumi ayɛ anihaw, atenka, anaa tebea pɔtee bi ntia. Sɛ saa akɔnnɔ no baa pɛ kwan foforɔ bi so ka no hyɛ. Wobetumi ne nnamfoɔ adi nkɔmmɔ, atie nwom, twerɛ nkrataa, anaa pue nante kakra. Susu didi so. Wobetumi agye ho afotuo afi mpaninfoɔ so hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) anaa "HIV" ano aduru ne nhomasua dwumadi ahorow a wobenya wɔ aman anaa mpɔtam ahorow mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) anaa "HIV"  ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ho no gu ahodoɔ wɔ wiase nyinaa nanso ɛtaa ka ho ne: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ kokoam, a "STI" anaa "HIV" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho, a awofoɔ mpene so. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛfata mfe a obi adi, na ɛka nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow ho. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛfa "STI" anaa "HIV" ano aduru ne nna mu akwahosan ho, a ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa, nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa asetena mu sikasɛm tebea mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abɛɛfo nimdeɛ ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ di wɔ nkitahodi a obu wom, tema, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nkitahodi ne abɛɛfo ntentan  hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo nimdeɛ ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ ho hia ma nkitahodi a obu wom, tema, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nkitahodi mu: Sɛnea wotumi di nkitaho yiye na obu wom wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn tebea ahorow mu, te sɛ abɛɛfo ntentan,  apps, ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nhyiam ahorow ase. Tema ne ntease a wobenya ama afoforo adwene ne osuahu ahorow wɔ intanɛt so. Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a wɔde bedi dwuma na ama wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ntease wom na obu wom mu. Intanɛt so ayayade, kɔmputa so ayayade, ne ɔtan kasa a wobehu na wɔakasa atia. Boa a wɔbɛboa ama abɛɛfo kwantenpɔnso mpɔtam pa denam ayamye, nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ne abodwokyɛre a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi aka hia a ehia sɛ yɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛkɔ so daa na yɛde yɛn ho to yɛn ho a yɛbɛkɔ hɔ daa no mu sɛ ɔkwan a yɛbɛfa so ahyɛ yɛn abusuabɔ mu den na yɛama ahotoso ne ntease aba yɛn ntam no ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Ka hia a ɛho hia sɛ yɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛkɔ so daa na yɛde yɛn ho to yɛn ho a yɛbɛkɔ hɔ daa no mu ho asɛm sɛ ɔkwan a yɛbɛfa so ahyɛ yɛn abusuabɔ mu den na yɛama ahotoso ne ntease aba yɛn ntam. Fa yɛn ho hyɛ mu sɛ yɛde yɛn check-ins bedi kan na yɛama ayɛ yɛn nhyehyɛe no fa daa, bere mpo a asetra yɛ nea adagyew nnim anaasɛ ɛyɛ den no. Hu sɛ nkitahodie a ɛkɔ so daa no ma ahotoso ba na ɛma abusuabɔ a emu dɔ ba yɛn ntam, na ɛma yetumi bom di nsɛnnennen ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ afofro ho betumi ayɛ akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a ɛfata ho nhwɛso ama wɔn mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho hwɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ apɔw-mu-teneteneɛ, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, ne akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome di dwuma, na hyɛ w’awofo nkuran ma wɔmmɛka wo ho. Ka akwan a wobɛfa so agyina ano no kyerɛ w’awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo no na to nsa frɛ wɔn ma wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ yiyedi ho nkuran mu. Fa bere si hɔ ma abusua dwumadi ahorow a ɛde ahomegye, abusuabɔ, ne adwennwen a wɔbɛtew so di kan. Munsusuw hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ho na wodi adwennwen ho dwuma sɛ abusua na mommoa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ suban pa a wɔde bedi dwuma no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya tema ne ntease bere a me ne mfɛfo a ebia ɛsono wɔn gyidi anaa osuahu ahorow resusuw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ wubenya tema ne ntease bere a wo ne w’atipɛnfo a ebia wɔwɔ gyidi anaa osuahu ahorow susuw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no hia sɛ wobɛ sutie ama  wɔn adwenekyerɛ, gyae atemmu, na wɔkyerɛ obu ma wɔn adwene. Fa wo ho hyɛ wɔn mpaboa mu (fa no sɛ anka ɛyɛ wo a) na wususuw wɔn nkate ne osuahu ahorow ho fa kyerɛ tema. Bisa nsɛm a emu da hɔ fa hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔnka wɔn nsusuwii ne wɔn nkate horow, na tie a wommɔ wɔn atɛn biaa. Ɛdenam tema ne ntease a wode bɛbɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow so no, wubetumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ ne obu ama mo ho mo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne mmara mu asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛbata ahwɛfo bɛn na wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho, na hokwan ne asɛyɛde bɛn na mmabun wɔ bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ɔhaw afoforo ho mu no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho gye mu sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ no a, ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw abrabɔ pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne mmara mu asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛbata wɔn nneyɛe ho no ho. Bere a ebia mmara kwan so ahobammɔ wɔ hɔ ma ankorankoro a wɔde adwempa de wɔn ho gye mu de siw ɔhaw ano no, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu wɔn hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow na wɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo anaa atumfoɔ a wogye wɔn di hɔ bere a wonni ahotoso no. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no ahobammɔ ne yiyedi di kan na yɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ wɔn basabasa no ahofadi ne nidi bere a wɔreyɛ ade de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔhyɛ ahobammɔ ho nkuran no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa me ma madi nea menpɛ so na madi m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu tebea horow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kasa ma wo ho, fa wo ho nsɛm pa di dwuma, nya ahotoso wɔ wo ho, hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnipa a wugye wɔn di hɔ, na sua sɛnea wubetumi agyina ano a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na ɔbarima ne ɔbea awo nhyehyɛe no bom yɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima ne mmaa awoɛ nhyehyɛe no yɛ adwuma sɛ kuo de bɔ ɔkra foforo! Mmarima awoɔ nhyehyɛe no ma mmadwoa nkwammoaa, na ɔbea awo nhyehyɛe no ma wonya nkosua nkwammoaa (ovary). Wɔ nna mu no, mmadwoa fi ɔbarima no akyi berɛmo mu kɔ ɔbea no awotoa mu. Sɛ tebea horow no yɛ a, mmadwoa nkwammoaa betumi ama nkosua nkwammoaa bi awo, na ɛno ne akokoaa nyin mfiase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyehyɛe anaa akwankyerɛ ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde hwɛ hu sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow di nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pɛyɛ, nidi, ne obuo a wɔde ma ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so nyinaa akyi?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow pii wɔ nhyehyɛe ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a wɔde bedi nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pɛyɛ, nidi, ne obu a wɔde ma ayarefo nyinaa, a mmabun ka ho, akyi. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi betumi ayɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nyiyimu a wɔnyɛ, kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ nteteeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne nkateɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so gyina nkate ahorow a ebetumi asɔre bere a wɔresi nyinsɛn ho gyinae no ano?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne Obi Nkasa: Ka wo nkate ho asɛm kyerɛ w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso. Atwerɛtwerɛ: Kyerɛw wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate ahorow na boa ma wodi ho dwuma. Adwene mu Nsusuwii ne Nsusuwii: Fa wo ho hyɛ adwene mu nneyɛe anaa nsusuwii mu na ama adwene no adwo na woatew adwennwen so. Mmoa Akuw: Kɔka kuw a wɔboa ankorankoro a wohyia gyinaesi a ɛte saa ara ho na ama wo ne afoforo a wɔte ase no adi nkitaho. Adwinni anaa Adebɔ mu Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Fa adwinni, nnwom, anaa adebɔ mu nsɛm afoforo a wɔde da no adi di dwuma sɛ akwan a wobɛfa so ada wo nkate adi. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ne ahome a emu dɔ : Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ betumi aboa ma adwennwen afi hɔ na ama adwene atu mpɔn. Gyinaesi a wobɛfa so afa akwan horow a wobɛfa so nyinsɛn ho no betumi ayɛ nkate fam asɛnnennen, na ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ w’adwene yiyedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ nsa a wɔde ka obi a efata ne nea ɛmfata ntam, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu?
answer_twi_source: Asomu a ɛfata te nka sɛ ahobammɔ , ahotɔ, na wɔpene so wɔ mu. Ebia nea ɛka ho ne atuu a efiri abusua no mufo anaa nnamfo a wogye wɔn di, nsa a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho, anaasɛ nkyia. Ka a wɔde ka wo ho a ɛmfata yɛ nipadua mu nkitahodi biara a ɛma wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ, wosuro, anaasɛ wɔabu wo so. Nea ebetumi aka eyi ho ne nsa a wɔde bɛka obi a ɔmpɛ, ɔde ne nsa bɛmiamia obi, anaa nna mu nkitahodi biara a wompene so. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛnteɛ a, kasa. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi na woayi wo ho afi tebea horow a ɛma wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hc a ɛbɛboa me ma mahwehwɛ nna mu apɔmuden mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛte nka sɛ ɛyɛ papa na ɛfoa me SOGI so? (nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nneɛma, LGBTQ+ adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si so)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo ne wo bɛsusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama wɔn a sebi wɔn ho ato kyema kakra wɔ me sukuu mu, mpatam ne beaɛ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ apɔmden mu nsɛm nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nam kuo ahodoɔ so bɔ dawuro fa anidaho. Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ. Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ baabiaa fa anidaho. Fa abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn na mmabun betumi ahu sɛ wɔn nkutahodie ɛhote?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbɛhu wɔ berɛ a: Ɔte nka sɛ wɔn ahokafoɔ bu wɔn, ɔsom wɔn bo na ɔtumi ne wɔn di nkɔmmɔ ɛsane so nya mmoa firi wɔn hɔ wɔ berɛ wɔn bu wɔn aten biaa. Wɔbu wɔn ahyeɛ na wɔsane so gye wɔn ahofadie tom. Ɔwɔ ahotosoɔ, pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ne atɛntenenee wɔ agyinaeɛ sie mu. Ne berɛ a ɔhunu sɛ ɔwɔ ahobammɔ wɔ honam, atenkam ne nna mu nkitahodie nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ sɛ wɛbsaet anaa abeifo ntetan so boafo nneɛma a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho yɛ nokware na ɛteɛ?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ ɔkyerɛwfoɔ anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ kuo a wɔde nsɛm no rema no din ne wɔn nkrataa na hwehwɛ adanseɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mu. Hwehwɛ nsɛm ne nokware no mu wɔ mmeae a wogye di te sɛ aban apɔmuden wɛbsaet, adɔketafoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, anaa nhwehwɛmu nsɛm a wɔahwɛ mu yiye. Hwehwɛ mmeae a wɔafa nsɛm no afiri ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu a emu da hɔ a ɛgyina nsɛm a wɔde ama wɔ wɛbsaet no so akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneyɛeɛ bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi mmu me hyeɛ a broni bɛkasɛ 'boundaries'?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛeɛ aa ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi mmu wohyeɛ bi ne: Sɛ wɔntie wo nea borɔfo fre no 'verbal' anaa 'non-verbal cues' sɛ ngyae sɛ ɛhyɛ woso sɛ yɛ nna mu nneɛma aa wonpɛ, na ɛbo wura nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'personal space' ne nea eka ho be tesɛ nsonso mu a ɛmfata aa wopenee so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a ebia wonni mbusuafo a wɔboa wɔn anaasɛ wɔn a webusua apo wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ho ahyehyɛdeɛ): Saa akuo yi betumi ama mmoa a ɛfa mmoafoɔ ho anaa resources (nhyehyɛeɛ) ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm. Trusted Adults (Nnipa a woatumi agyina mu): Kasa kyerɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, counselor (ɔfotufoɔ), anaa trusted adult (obi a woatumi agyina mu) a ɔbɛtumi ama wo akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma titire bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun susu ho wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun benya asetena, atenka, ne sikasɛm mu ahiade soronko a ɛhwehwɛ mmoa ne nneɛma foforo bere a wɔyem no. Ɛsɛ sɛ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo yɛ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atemmu de di mmabun haw ahorow ho dwuma na wɔde ɔhwɛ a edi mũ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ankorankoro ahiade ahorow ma. Ebia ɛho behia sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so susu nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, abusua nhyehyɛe, ne abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ne daakye nyinsɛn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛde amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ 'cultural sensitivity'  bɛyɛ ama nkabom ne obu anaa yɛbɛya nidi ama afoforow a wɔ dwene fa akwan ahorow so ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden nsɛm a yɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ 'cultural sensitivity'  de nkabom ne obu anaa nidi ba ma afoforow a wɔ dwene fa akwan ahorow so ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden nsɛm a yɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ. Eyi nam so ma wɔhu senia afoforo adwene, osuahu ne nna ho nsɛm; ɛsan nso boa ma wɔhyehyɛ mmeammea a bammɔ wɔ 'safe spaces'  a mmaabun betumi akɔ akohu na aka wɔn amammerɛ mu gyidi, gyinapɛn ne nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn wɔ nna ho apɔwmuden ho asɛm.  Bio nso, sɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ ne kasa mu nhewhwe mu, nhwɛso ahorow, ne nneɛma a wɔde boa ho nsɛm aka nna ho adesua ne afotubo ho asɛm no ho a, ɛboa kɛse. Sɛ wɔhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ, aso a wobetie afoforo yiye, ne ayamhyehye ho nkuran a, ɛboa ma wosiw amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe ano na wosiesie nsusuwii hunu anaa nsɛm a atoro wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamu nsɛm  sie wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm  sie wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe mu denam: Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ wɔn hokwan ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ kokoam apomoden ho nnwuma ho Sɛ wɔbɛkasa na wɔabisa nsɛm afa kokoam nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe ho bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nnwuma Wɔn suahu ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ akyerɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ de hyɛ mmara mu den mu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho ban wɔ apomoden ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya aduane die pa su a ɛbɛboa me mmabunbere ne daa?
answer_twi_source: Di aduane a ɛyɛ atosode ne nnuaba (fruits, vegetables, protein). Di aduane bere a ɛkɔm de wo na gyae bere a woamee (Mindful Eating). Sua aduane noa. Te sukye ne nneɛma a yɛayɛ wɔ abɔnten so (Processed foods). We aduane dɛɛdɛɛde. Nom nsuo pii. Di aduane bere pa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na metɛ yaw wɔ me brayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ mu yaw fi ntini a ɛwɔ w’awotwaa mu a ɛtwetwe (ɛyɛ den). Eyi boa ma wo awotwaa no mu nneɛma a ɛwɔ wo ho no hwie gu bosome biara. Ɔyaw betumi ayɛ nea ɛnyɛ dɛ, nanso akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so de heating pads, nnuru a wɔde kum ɛyaw, anaa aguare a ɛyɛ hyew adi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne osuahu ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nya wɔ adwenemu apomoden, atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ, ne abusua a wogye wɔn tom ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu apomoden: Ebia mmabun a wɔadi dɛm behyia adwenemhaw, dadwen, ne tew a wɔatew wɔn ho kɛse esiane asetana mu animtiaabu ne mmoa a wontumi nnya nti. Atipɛnfo Abusuabɔ: Ebia adamfofa a wobenya no bɛyɛ den esiane asetra mu akwanside ahorow ne dɛmdi ho nimdeɛ a wonni nti. Abusua Gye a Wogye Tom: Ɛnyɛ mmusua nyinaa na wɔte dɛmdi ase anaasɛ wogye tom, na ɛde ntawntawdi ne ntetewmu ba mmabun so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya saa nnwuma yi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔhwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi de di honam fam anaa atenka fam ahiade biara ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no akyi. Saa dwumadie yi betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛdi akyire, afotuo, afotuo ne nsiesiei a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, ne sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔde wɔn kɔ mmoa dwumadie mu. Mmabun betumi anya ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi denam nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de akɔ wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ sɛ wohyia nsɛnnennen anaa dadwen biara a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom tumi si bayiguo ho kwan ma mmabun anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Gyidie ne amanneɛ tumi yɛ akwansidie. Ɛka sɛdeɛ wɔsi gyinaeɛ ne sɛdeɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so de abɛɛfo mfiridwuma di dwuma anya nsɛm pa a wubetumi de wo ho ato so na wonnya mmoa a  ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan nhomasua: Abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow te sɛ dwumakuo  a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Planned Parenthood anaa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) de nna mu akwahosan ne mmabunbere ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ma. Akwahosan Apps: Apps bi wɔ hɔ te sɛ "Flo" a wɔde di brayɛ akyi anaa "MindShift" a wɔde di dadwen ho dwuma a ebetumi ama mmoa. Intanɛt so Nhyiamu: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ intanɛt so nhyiamu a wɔhwɛ so anaa mpɔtam a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabunbere ne akwahosan so a, ɛbɛtumi ama woanya atenaeɛ a wobɛbisa nsɛm na woanya afotuo. Nhyehyɛeɛ a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛTelehealth Services: Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo binom de telehealth services ma a wubetumi ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bi akasa afa nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho denam video so nkɔmmɔbɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ayayaade 'bullying' ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne, ɛhwe 'physical'. Ayeyawayeyaw 'verbal'. Nkɔnkɔnsa ne nnipa woyi ma 'social'. Intanɛt so ayayaade 'cyberbullying.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya akwannya ahorow de anya asetrade ho nimdeɛ, te sɛ adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, afotu nhyehyɛe, intanɛt so adesua, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe: Fa wo din hyɛ mfiridwuma anaa adwumayɛ ho adesua a sukuu, sukuu pɔn, anaa ntetee mmeae a wɔyɛ adwuma anaa nnwuma pɔtee bi mu titiriw de ma no mu. Adesua: Fa wo ho hyɛ adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ a ɛka adwumam ntetee ne adesuadan mu nkyerɛkyerɛ bom wɔ adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw hwɛ so mu. Adwumayɛ mu ntetee: Nya adwumayɛ mu osuahu a mfaso wɔ so, nnwuma mu nneyɛe a wobɛda no adi, ne nkitahodi hokwan ahorow wɔ adwumayɛ ho adwumayɛ a wo ne nnwumakuw, ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa aban adwumayɛbea ahorow bɛyɛ so. Afotu nhyehyɛe: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ, afotu, ne mmoa fi afotufo anaa nhwɛsofo a wɔwɔ nnwuma a ɛfa ho a wobetumi de adwumayɛ ho nhumu, afotu, ne nkuranhyɛ ama hɔ. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so adesua: Nya abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so adesua nhyiamu a ɛde adesua, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nneɛma ahodoɔ pii ma wɔ nsɛm ahodoɔ ho, a mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ, nimdeɛ a ɛfa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nnwumadie ho (soft skills) , ne adwumayɛ ka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu: Kɔ ahokokwaw a wɔkyekyere ho nhyiamu, nhyiamu, anaa nteteeɛ a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, nnwumakuo (NGO), anaa aban nnwumakuo hyehyɛ de ma ahokokwaa anaa nimdeɛ mmeaeɛ pɔtee bi nya nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na GBV betumi aha mmabun pɔtee? (asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obi benya adwenemhaw, dadwen, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so).
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wonya GBV no wɔ asiane kɛse mu sɛ: Adwenemhaw ne Dadwen: Awerɛhow a wɔte, anidaso a wonni, anaasɛ wɔn ho yɛ den bere nyinaa. Nnubɔne a Wɔde Di Dwuma Ɔkwammɔne so: Sɛ obi dan kɔ nnubɔne anaa nsa so na ama ɛyaw no ayɛ mmerɛw. Adesua mu Nkɔso a Ɛnyɛ Yiye: Ɔpere sɛ ɔde n’adwene besi biribi so wɔ sukuu mu. Nna mu Suban a Asiane: Nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ nnim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atoro nsɛm bɛn na nkurɔfoɔ wokum wɔn ho (suicide) ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ wɔn ho yiye na sɛn na yebetumi ako atia saa nsɛm no?
answer_twi_source: Atoro: Sɛ wudi yɛ pɛsɛmenkominya (selfish act). Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ sɛ nkurɔfoɔ hu wɔn (attention seekers). Sɛ wokasa fa ho a, ɛbɛma obi akɔyɛ. Nokware: Wudi yɛ yareɛ mu nsunsuansoɔ. Yɛbetumi ayi atoro no firi hɔ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ wɔ adwene mu apɔwmuden pa, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmoa a yɛbɛhwehwɛ ama wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bu ankorankoro gyidie ne gyinapɛn ahorow bere a wusi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nimdeɛ pene so wɔ ɔkwan biara a wɔapaw so no.
answer_twi_source: Yɛkyerɛ obu ma w’ankorankoro gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow. Ɛmfa ho sɛnea wo gyinaesi a etwa to no, ɛho hia sɛ wunya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye atumu, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wote akwan horow ne asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba no ase yiye ansa na woatoa so. Kae: Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa. Gye wo bere na susuw nneɛma a wubetumi apaw nyinaa ho yiye ansa na woasi gyinae. Ahintasɛm mmoa adwuma wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo wɔ saa bere a emu yɛ den yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw HIV ano, a kɔndɔm, PrEP, ne akwan a wɔfa so tew ɔhaw so ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya akwan a wɔfa so siw nna mu yare (HIV) ano ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow a agye din, ne nhomasua nneɛma a ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di de ma no so. Wobetumi nso de wɔn ho ahyɛ atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na wɔakɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nhyiam ahorow. Mmabun nso betumi akyerɛw wɔn din wɔ Abɛɛfo ntentan a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Ghana Health Service YMK app no mu wɔ abɛɛfo beae a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ google playstore . Wɔayɛ app no sɛ ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔadi wɔn ahiade ahorow a ɛyɛ soronko no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nipadua mu adwempa ne obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho ma wɔate nka yiye wɔ wɔn nipadua ho na wɔanya obu ama wɔn ho denam wɔn ho a wogye tom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔbɛka atia wɔ sɛnea obi hwɛ ade ho, nkamfo a wofi nokwaredi mu de ma, tie a wotie na wɔda tema adi, gyina nipadua mu aniwu ne ayayade a wɔsɔre tia, ne mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma wɔaka nsɛm a ɛfa nipadua ho ho asɛm pefee no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow ne mpɔtam betumi de nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano a ɛfa nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ne nna mu basabasayɛ ntam nkitahodi ho dwuma na ɛhyɛ asetra mu tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom ho nkuran ama mmabun nyinaa adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne mpɔtam betumi de nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔde siw ano a ɛfa nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ne nna mu basabasayɛ ntam no adi dwuma denam: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛma wɔ ɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ no a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu fi mmofraase. Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun asiane ne nea efi nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma mu ba, a dwuma a wobetumi adi wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw mu ka ho a wɔde bɛma. Akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛtete wɔn ma wɔahu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛfa nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛ obi so ho na wɔayɛ ho biribi yiye. Asetra mu tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛbɔ denam nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ nsanom a ɛfata ho nkuran, ɛmma asanom boro so abam, na ɛma amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho no so. Wɔn a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nnwumakuo bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no anya mmoa dwumadie a ɛyɛ ne berɛ mu na ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn  nhwɛso ahorow  na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea dɛmdi ka nnipa a wofi abusua ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua a Wonya: Sukuu ahorow a ɛka obiara ho, adesua nneɛma a wɔayɛ no foforo, anaa mfiridwuma a ɛboa a enni hɔ kakraa bi no betumi asiw adesua mu nkɔso kwan. Asetra mu Nnipa a Wɔka Wɔn Ho: Animtiaabu, nyiyim, anaa amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛnteɛ a wonya wɔ dɛmdi ho no betumi ama wɔatew wɔn ho na wɔatew wɔn ho wɔ atipɛnfo dwumadi ahorow mu. Akwahosan Ho Nkɔso: Akwanside ahorow te sɛ mmeae a wontumi nkɔ hɔ, ɛka kɛse, anaasɛ wɔn a wɔatete wɔn a wonni no betumi asiw nna, awo, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so no ano. Sikasɛm mu akwannya ahorow: Ebia mmusua a wonni sika pii no bɛpere sɛ wɔbɛtɔ nneɛma a wɔde boa ma wɔde tu kwan, ayaresa, anaa ntetee titiriw bi, na ɛbɛka anidaso a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ. Haw a Ɛbe Nnipa Ntam: Bɔbeasu, mmusuakuw, beae a wofi, ne ohia betumi ama ɔhaw ahorow ayɛ kɛse, na mpɛn pii no mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔwɔ nkuraase anaa kakraa bi mu no hyia nnipa a wɔayi wɔn afi mu kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So apomoden ho adwumayɛfo nim akwantu ho ɔhaw a mmabun hyia wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo pii nim akwantu ho ɔhaw a mmabun hyia wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, titiriw wɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no betumi abisa akwantu ho ahiade ho asɛm bere a wɔrekɔ na wɔne ayarefo ne wɔn mmusua ayɛ adwuma de ahu ano aduru, te sɛ akwantu ho mmoa a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhyehyɛe anaasɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ bere a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔ mmere a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya kar no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahyehyɛde kuo ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛwɔ fam di wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu yaareɛ ano wɔ wiase nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ (CBOs) ne akuo a ɛwɔ fam di dwuma titire wɔ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw nna mu yareɛ ano wɔ wiase nyinaa denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde wɔn ani asi so a wɔde bɛma nnipa a wɔnnya mmoa yie, a mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua, mmabun, ne nnipa titire te sɛ nna ho adwumayɛfoɔ, mmarima a wɔne mmarima da (MSM), ne nnipa a wɔde nnubɔne gu wɔn mu ka ho. Nnwuma a wɔde siw ano a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata kasa ho a wɔde bɛma, a nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, afotuo, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ amannɔne ka ho, de adi ahiadeɛ soronko ne akwansideɛ a mpɔtam ahodoɔ hyia no ho dwuma. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano ma wɔakasa ama nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ, nneɛma a wɔde bɛma, ne nnipa hokwan ahobanbɔ a wɔde bɛboa nna mu yareɛ ano aduru a ɛtu mpɔn ne apomoden ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛnya. Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ne asetena mu biakoyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso de atew animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne asetena mu tew a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ nya no so. Nhwehwɛmu a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ di anim, nhyehyɛeɛ mu nhwehwɛmu, ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛkyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akwan a egyina adanseɛ so ne nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ ano ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo akasa afa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho sɛ minnya nnyaa nni nna mu agodie mpo a?
answer_twi_source: Pɛpɛɛpɛ! Wubetumi ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo akasa afa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho sɛ mpo wunnya nyɛɛ nna mu agodie a. Nea enti a ɛyɛ adwene pa ni: Ma wohu: Sɛ wusua nneɛma a wubetumi apaw ho ade ntɛm a, ɛma wutumi si gyinae a ɛfata daakye. Bisa nsɛm: Di nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo wɔ nna anaa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho dwuma wɔ kokoam ne kokoam tebea mu. Di kan yɛ nhyehyɛe: Munsusuw daakye nhyehyɛe ahorow ho na hwehwɛ akwan horow a ebia ɛbɛfata wo bere a woanya nna mu kyɛfa no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ebetumi afi amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛkasa atia anaasɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi ho mu aba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nea ebetumi afi amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛkasa atia anaasɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi ho no bi ne: Asetra mu a wɔayi wɔn afi nnipa mu, animtiaabu, ne nyiyim a efi abusua mufo, atipɛnfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔfo a wodi atetesɛm mu gyidi ne suban akyi. Asetra mu mmoa a wɔhwere, a nea ɛka ho ne nneɛma, hokwan ahorow, ne nkitahodi ahorow a ɛbata amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a wodi so ho. Ntawntawdi ne nhyɛso a ɛba mmusua ne mpɔtam hɔ, titiriw sɛ wobu ankorankoro paw anaa nneyɛe sɛ ɛde amammerɛ anaa nyamesom atetesɛm to asiane mu a. Mmara ne ahyehyɛde akwanside ahorow a ɛto ankorankoro hokwan ne ahofadi ano hye, titiriw wɔ aman a wɔde amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow ahyɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Nkate fam ahoyeraw, animtiaabu a wɔde hyɛ obi mu, ne aniwu anaa afobu ho nkate a ɛbata amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nneyɛe a agye ntini kɛse a wɔkasa tia ho. Mmabun betumi adi animtiaabu ne nyiyim ho dwuma denam: Atipɛnfo, ayɔnkofo, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔne wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn gyidi koro no ntam nkitahodi a ɛboa a wɔbɛkyekye, de agye atom, na wɔayɛ biako wɔ amammerɛ mu nsunsuanso a wɔbɛfa so adi dwuma mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a nna ne awo hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne amammerɛ ahorow a egu ahorow wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ho hia. Nsusuwii hunu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a epira a wɔbɛkasa atia denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom, abasɛm a wɔka, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛka wɔn ho so, ntease ne tema a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ adwene ahorow mu. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, afotufo, ne mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wobu wɔn nipasu, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne osuahu ahorow na wɔsi so dua a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ ahorow, nkabom, ne pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nnwuma, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne wiase nyinaa a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me hokafo akasa afa kɔndɔm  (Banbɔ adeɛ) ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a mede bedi dwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Bue Mu na Di Nokwaredi: Fa nokwaredi ne obu bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no. Normalize Protection: Fa nkɔmmɔbɔ no hyehyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho akwahosan ne yiyedi ho. Fa Nsɛm Ma: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa STIs, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne mfaso a ɛwɔ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma so. Fa Mmoa Ma: Ma wo hokafo no awerɛhyem sɛ ahobammɔ a wode bedi dwuma no yɛ asɛyɛde a wɔbom yɛ. Fa di dwuma: Fa nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ di dwuma wɔ tebea a ɛnyɛ nna mu na ama woate nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aka me nsɛm a nni sɛ nka obi te 'boundaries' akyerɛ afoforo yie?
answer_twi_source: Kasa pefee (clear and direct). Nsuro sɛ wobɛsan aka bio sɛ ehia a. Hwɛ wɔn anim (eye contact), ma wo nne so, na gyina hɔ pintinn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ dadwen wɔ me nna mu akwahosan ho nanso mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ sɛ me ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkasa afa ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun bi te nka sɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ sɛ ɔne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi bɛbɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔ a, wobetumi: Kyerɛw wɔn nsɛmmisa anaa nea ɛhaw wɔn ansa na woako hu apɔmuden dwumayɛni bi na ama ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobesusuw ho. Susuw ho sɛ wode w’adamfo, wo nua, anaa ɔpanyin foforo a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso bɛba ma waboa wo. Hwehwɛ ayaresabea anaa ɔyarehwɛfo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ho. Fa intanɛt so nneɛma anaa telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ntentanfidie so di dwuma ma nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔmmɔ din. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛkae sɛ wɔatete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔasusuw saa nsɛmti yi ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nkate so na ɛnyɛ atɛn. Sɛ wobɛbue w’ani na woadi nokware akyerɛ obi a ɔde mmoa ma no a, ɛma wotumi hwɛ no yiye na wɔboa no. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmuae ahorow yi boa mmabun ma wɔte sɛnea wobetumi anya nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, asiesie wɔn ho, na wɔafa so, na ama wɔatumi adi wɔn awo akwahosan so tumi ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa bi fa me nna anaa awo akwahosan ho nanso mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ sɛ mebisa m’awofo a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Susuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ sukuu mu ɔfotufo, ɔyarehwɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo, a obetumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne mmoa ama wɔ kokoam tebea mu nkyɛn. Fa intanɛt so nneɛma anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm titiriw di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu na akwan horow bɛn na ɛwɔ mu? (egyina bosome abiɛsa so) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ Ghana no gyina tebea pɔtee bi so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wokɔ akwahosan ho ɔbenfo nkyɛn na ama woate mmara kwan so afa horow a ɛfa wo tebea no ho ase. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ nyinsɛn a wogyae. wobetumi akanyan a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no denam nnuru a wɔnom anaasɛ adeyɛ bi anaasɛ nea ɛba ara kwa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛba wɔ abɔde mu. Oprehyɛn ko no gyina nyinsɛn no fã so: Mfiase Abiɛsa: Wobetumi de nnuru anaa oprehyɛn a ɛnyɛ den pii adi dwuma. Akyiri yi Mfe Abiɛsa: Eyi yɛ adeyɛ a ɛyɛ den kɛse na ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho ɔbenfo a ɔfata nkutoo na ɔyɛ wɔ ayaresabea.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛnyɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara ahorow wɔ mmonnaato, abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da, awotwaa mu nneɛma a ɛnteɛ, anaa ɛnanom akwahosan ho asiane ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Ebia nneɛma a ɛnyɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara ahorow wɔ hɔ wɔ mmonnaato, abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da, awotwaa mu nneɛma a ɛnteɛ, anaa ɛnanom akwahosan ho asiane ahorow mu wɔ aman bi mu. Saa nneɛma a wɔayi afi mu yi gye tebea soronko a ankorankoro betumi ahwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow no tom na wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ɔhwɛ a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan. Ɛdenam mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ so no, ebia ankorankoro betumi atu nyinsɛn agu wɔ tebea horow yi mu a wɔrenhyia mmara mu nsunsuanso anaa anohyeto ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na kwan a wɔfa so si awoɔ ano ntɛm (emergency contraception) ne kwan a wɔtaa fa so si awoɔ ano (regular birth control) yɛ soronko, na berɛ bɛn na ɛfata paa sɛ wɔde emergency contraception bɔ so sɛ mmoa kwan foforo (backup option)?
answer_twi_source: Mpofirim nnubɔne a ɛsi awoɔ kwan (Emergency contraception) yɛ soronko wɔ nnubɔne a yɛde di dwuma daa no ho. Nea nti a ɛte saa ne sɛ, wɔayɛ saa aduro yi sɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma mberɛ kakra bi pɛ, titiriw wɔ berɛ a obi ne ne yɔnko ada a wɔammɔ wɔn ho ban, anaa berɛ a kwan a wɔde si awoɔ kwan no ankɔ yie.Kwan a ɛfata pa ara sɛ yɛfa so de saa mpofirim aduro yi di dwuma ne sɛ yɛbɛyɛ no sɛ mmoa a ɛtwa toɔ wɔ berɛ a kwan a yɛde si awoɔ kwan no agyae yɛ anaa yɛammɔ so yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem bere a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu no?
answer_twi_source: Gyinapɛn a ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmubeafoɔ di so berɛ a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu fa mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan (ASRH) ho wɔ amammere ahodoɔ mu ne eyi: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmubeafoɔ hwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu no mu no te nea nhwehwɛmu no kyerɛ, emu asiane, ne emu mfasoɔ ase yie. Titiriw no, wɔ amammere a nna ne awoɔ ho nkɔmmɔbɔ yɛ akyiwadeɛ anaasɛ ɛde aniwuo ba mu. Ɛhia sɛ wɔhwɛ nhwehwɛmufoɔ no nsɛm so yie na wɔama ayɛ kokoamsɛm. Ɛsɛ sɛ kwan a wɔfa so boaboa nsɛm ano no bɔ wɔn nneyɛeɛ ho ban, titiriw wɔ mmeaeɛ a sɛ nsɛm bi fi adi a, ɛbɛtumi ama nkurɔfoɔ abu wɔn animtiaa anaasɛ mmara bɛtumi aka wɔn. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmubeafoɔ gye amammere mu gyidie, atetesɛm, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkyɛn no tom na wɔbu no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkwati nneyɛeɛ biara a ɛbɛtumi ne saa amammere yi abɔ abira anaasɛ ɛbɛkyerɛ obu-pa-so. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmubeafoɔ yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ biara a ɛbɛtumi ama mmoa anaasɛ ɔhaw biara a ɛbɛba nhwehwɛmufoɔ no so no so tew. Ebi ne sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔn mmeaeɛ a wɔbɛnya adwene mu nkuranhyɛ ne mmoa sɛ nhwehwɛmu no ma wɔn adwene mu yɛ wɔn yaw a. Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmubeafoɔ ma wɔn ani kanyan wɔ amammere mu nteaseɛ ne tumi a ɛda wɔne nhwehwɛmufoɔ no ntam ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsesa nhwehwɛmu no nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no na ama ɛne amammere no ahyia na ayɛ nea obu wɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ahofadi ne ho adwene wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi mu, na wɔako atia nhyɛso anaa nsakrae a efi afoforo hɔ a ebetumi asɛe wɔn ahobammɔ anaa yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya ahofadi ho adwene ɛfa  wɔn abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi mu denam: Wɔn ho a wobehu: Wobehu wɔn ho ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, botae ahorow, ne ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wobesi gyinae ahorow a ɛfata a ɛne ankorankoro ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ hyia. Adwenemteɛ nteteeɛ 'Assertiveness Training': Sua Adwenemteɛ ho nimdeɛ a wode ahotoso bɛda nsusuwii, atinka, ne ahye adi bere a wubu afoforo hokwan ahorow. Nsusuwii a Ɛyɛ Katee: Hwɛ asetra mu nkɛntɛnso ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu yiye, na gye nkrasɛm ahorow a ɛbrɛ ahofadi ne ahofadi ase no ho kyim. Wɔn Ho a Wɔkamfo: Kamfo wo ho denam kasa a wobɛkasa atia nhyɛso, nsakrae, anaa nhyɛso a efi afoforo hɔ so na wode ahye a wobɛka denneennen no so. Abusuabɔ a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Fa abusuabɔ a ɛboa, a obu wom a ɛde ne yɔnko pene, obu, ne nkitahodi di kan twa ne ho hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na tumi mu nkɔso, nhyɛso, nsakrae, ne nhyɛso di wɔ pene a wɔpene so mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔadi saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma wɔ wɔn nyɔkonfa nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Tumi a ɛkɔ so, nhyɛso, nsakrae, ne nhyɛso betumi anya pene a wɔpene so so nsusuansoɔ kɛse denam tumi a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a wontua hwee na wofi wɔn pɛ mu sisi wɔ wɔn nipadua ne nna mu dwumadi ahorow ho a ɛbɛsɛe no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu nsɛm yi wɔ wɔn nyɔnkofa nkitahodie mu na wohu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔnkari pɛ anaasɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae a ebetumi aka pene a wɔpene so. Wobetumi adi nsɛm yi ho dwuma denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, obu a wɔde bɛma ahye, ne pɛyɛ ne obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so. Ɛho hia sɛ wode ahokafo baanu no nyinaa yiyedi ne ahofadi di kan na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ nna mu dwumadi ahorow a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, asetra mu su horow, ne mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow nya ASRH nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ne nea wɔtrɛw mu wɔ wiase mmeae ahorow so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn, asetena mu adwene, ne mmara nhyehyɛe nya ASRH nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ne ne trɛw so nsunsuanso kɛse wɔ wiase nyinaa, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahye nhyehyeɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia a ɛfa nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho a wɔbɛka ho asɛm anaa wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu esiane nyamesom anaa amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow nti, na ɛde nhwehwɛmufo a wɔhwɛ so na wɔhwɛ wɔn ho so. Mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow a ɛma nna mu nneyɛe bi yɛ nsɛmmɔnedi anaasɛ esiw awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobetumi anya ano hye, na ɛto ASRH nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ akyiri ne emu dɔ wɔ mmeae a ɛka no ano hye. Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛde aware ne atetesɛm mu ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi di kan no betumi ama wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ animhwɛ a wobu ani gu mmabun osuahu ne wɔn nipasu ahorow so. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛfa saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi so: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo di abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ mu nkate ho akyi, na wɔkyerɛ obu ma mpɔtam hɔ amanne ne gyidi ahorow bere a wɔreyɛ ASRH nhwehwɛmu no. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, nyamesom mu nnipa, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de anya mmoa ne kwan ama nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow wɔ tebea horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho mu. Nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu ne mmara mu nsakraeɛ a ɛbɔ nhwehwɛmufoɔ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ ASRH nhwehwɛmu a wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn anaa wɔbɛtaa wɔn ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma wɔ akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no kyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama akwannya a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma wɔ akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu denam: - a wobehu wɔn hokwan ahorow na wɔate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wosi gyinae a wɔde nimdeɛ si gyinae no ase. - a wobebisa, nsem a wobehwehwe, na woada nea wope adi wo bere a wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo rebɔ nkɔmmɔ. - a wosi won ahofadie ne nea wɔpɛ a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔpaw ho no so dua. - a wobehwehwe mmoa afiri mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di, ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkamfo wɔn, anaa mmara kwan so nneɛma sɛ wɔhyia ɔsɔretia anaa nsɛnnennen wɔ pene nhyehyɛeɛ no mu a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minnim sɛ ebia me hokafo no ho bɛtɔ no anaasɛ ɔpene so sɛ ɔne me bɛda a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Gyina kakra na bisa: Gyae dwumadi no na bisa tẽẽ sɛ, "So wo ho ye?" Tie Nsiyɛ: Tie nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde ano ka ne nea wɔmfa ano nka ho. Bu Wɔn Mmuae: Sɛ wo hokafo no kyerɛ sɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ anaasɛ ɔtwentwɛn ne nan ase a, gyae na mommɔ ho nkɔmmɔ. Dabi Kwan Dabi: Bu "dabi" a emu da hɔ anaa sɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wotwentwɛn wo nan ase bere nyinaa. Hwehwɛ Akwankyerɛ: Sɛ wuntumi nsi pi a, kɔ w’adamfo, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ afotu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom na ɛteɛ wɔ ahobammɔ ho a egyina me ara me gyidie so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛsi gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom na ɛteɛ wɔ ahonammɔ ho nie: Hwehwɛ Nsɛm: Yɛ nhwehwɛmu fa akwan ahodoɔ so, sɛdea ɛyɛ adwuma, ne nsunsuansoɔ a ebetumi de aba ho, na ne wo dɔketa nkasa. Susu Wo Gyidie Ho: Dwene deɛ ɛhia wo wɔ bammɔ mu, tumi a ɛwɔ, ne yɛ a ayɛ ho. Ne Panyin Bi A Wogye No Di Nkasa: Wo ne adɔkotafoɔ, ofotufoɔ, anaa panyin bi a wogye no di nkasa fa wo nsɛmmisa ne dadwen ho. Bu Afoforɔ Gyidie: Bere a woresi wo ankasa gyinaeɛ no, bu afoforo gyidie, ne wo awofoɔ nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de me nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de ako ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nimdeɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, adesua nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma de akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, adesua nhyehyɛe mu nsesae, ne ɔsatu ahorow no hwehwɛ sɛ: Nhumu a wɔbɛma wɔahu hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho hia wɔ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no mu. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim, akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Ɔsatu ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde yɛ adwuma a ɛkamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, adesua nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛka abom, ne sika a wɔde bɛma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho adesua a edi mũ ka ho bi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso ahorow ho nhwehwɛmu a emu yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mifi ase nya ti nhwi a srade wom anaasɛ tiri nwii efi mmoa bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nwi a srade wom ne akisikuru betumi aba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu esiane nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu nti. Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ so ni: Nwi a srade wom: Fa tiri nwii samina Daa: Fa tiri nwii samina a ɛyɛ brɛoo hohoro wo ti nhwi daa na ama ngo a ɛboro so no afi hɔ. Fa nea broni fre no 'Conditioner' Di Dwuma: Ɛsɛ sɛ wode nea broni fre no 'conditioner' gu wo ti nhwi ano na amma srade ankɔ wo ti nhwi so. Kwati sɛ Wohohoro Wo ti nhwi dodo: Bere a ɛho hia sɛ woma wo ti nhwi ho tew no, sɛ wohohoro wo ti nhwi boro so a, ebetumi ama abɔde mu ngo afi ne ti nhwi mu, na ama ngo pii ayɛ. tiri nwii samina awo: Nna a wonhohoro wo ti nhwi no, tiri nwii samina awo betumi aboa ma ngo a ɛboro so no akɔ mu. Adwumayɛfo Afotu: Sɛ ti nhwi a srade wom kɔ so a, susuw ho sɛ wo ne honam ani yare ho oduruyɛfo anaa oduruyɛfo a ɔhwɛ ti nhwi so bɛkasa ama woanya nyansahyɛ pɔtee bi.  Tiri nwii mu mmoa, nea broni fre no 'Dandruff': 'Anti-Dandruff Shampoo': Fa aduru a ɛko tia akisikuru a nneɛma te sɛ nea broni fre no 'zinc pyrithione, selenium sulfide, anaa ketoconazole' wom di dwuma. Mia Ti nhwi: Sɛ woreyɛ shampoo a, fa brɛoo twitwiw ti nhwi no na ama nsensanee no ayɛ mmerɛw na ama mogya no akɔ so yiye. Kwati Nneɛma a Ɛyɛ Den: Kwati nneɛma a wɔde yɛ ti nhwi a ebetumi ahyɛ ti nhwi abufuw, te sɛ gel a emu yɛ duru a wɔde yɛ ti nhwi anaa nnuru a wɔde petepete so. Hohoro Daa: Hohoro wo ti nhwi daa na amma ngo ne honam ani nkwammoaa a awuwu anboaboa ano. Kɔ Honam ani Ho Oduruyɛfo nkyɛn: Sɛ akisikuru kɔ so anaasɛ emu yɛ den a, kɔ honam ani yare ho oduruyɛfo nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ ayaresa titiriw a wubetumi apaw. Sɛ wudi ahotew ho nhyehyɛe ahorow yi akyi a, wubetumi akura nipadua a ɛyɛ foforo na ɛwɔ apɔwmuden mu wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, ama nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no nyɛ nea ɛfata.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ worepere nsɛnnennen a ɛfa wo nna mu akwahosan ho a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi adwenem apɔwmuden ho ɔbenfo hɔ. Wɔwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛboa wo wɔ baabi a ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm wɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ awo ntoatoaso nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nnwuma a mpɔtam hɔfo di anim mu de ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom na ɛka obiara ho a ɛfa atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ awo ntoatoaso nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nnwuma a mpɔtam hɔfo di anim mu de ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom na ɛka obiara ho a ɛfa atetesɛm mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ho nkuran. Ɛdenam mmeae a wɔbɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ ne wɔn ho wɔn ho asesa wɔ awo ntoatoaso ahorow ntam so no, mmabun betumi asua biribi afi mpanyimfo nyansa ne osuahu ahorow mu bere a wɔrekyɛ wɔn adwene ne wɔn nhumu no. Nnwuma a mpɔtam hɔfo di anim, te sɛ amammerɛ afahyɛ ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne nsɛm a wɔka ho asɛm no betumi ama mmabun anya hokwan ahwehwɛ wɔn amammerɛ agyapade mu, abisa nsɛm, na wɔakasa atia nneyɛe a epira wɔ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn mu. Ɛdenam adwumayɛkuw ne adeyɛ a wɔbom yɛ so no, mmabun betumi adi dwuma denneennen wɔ amammerɛ mu atetesɛm a ɛsom bo a wɔbɛkora so mu bere a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wonyi nneyɛe a epira a ɛde wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi to asiane mu no mfi hɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so no,  akwan bɛn na mmabun a wɔyem wɔ nhyɛso so, wɔyɛ wɔn ayayade, anaa wɔn ahokafo, abusua ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo  bu wɔn animtiaa, betumi afa so ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem a wonya nhyɛso, ayayade, anaa anibiannaso fi wɔn ahokafo, abusua mufo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ no wɔ mmara kwan so akwan horow pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ sukuu afotufo, asetra mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa nyamesom akannifo hɔ, a wɔhyɛ wɔn sɛ amanneɛbɔfo na wobetumi aboa ma wɔde wɔn abata mmoa nnwuma ne nneɛma ho. Mpɔtam hɔ mmarahyɛfoɔ anaa mmofra ahobanbɔ adwumayɛbea a wɔbɛkɔ akɔbɔ ayayadeɛ, anibiannasoɔ, anaa ofie basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ, ahwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ahobanbɔ ne wɔn yiyedie bedi kan. Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ ofie basabasayɛ ho mmara, ahyɛde ahorow a wɔde siw ano, anaa ahobammɔ ahyɛde ahorow ase a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu de anya ahobammɔ ntɛm ara afi ankorankoro a wɔyɛ wɔn ayayade ho na wɔasiw ɔhaw foforo ano. Kokoam afotu anaa mmoa dwumadie a mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, dabere, anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ ɔhokafoɔ a wɔbɛn wɔn ho basabasayɛ anaa abusua mu ntawntawdie mu de ma a wɔbɛnya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apɔ mu ateneatene di wɔ ɛberɛ ho ntoto yɛ anaa ɛboa adwenemhaw wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔ mu ateneatene ho hia paa yie na ebetumi anya nsusuanso pa wɔ dwene mu apɔmden so wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu. Adwendwen a wɔte so: Apɔ mu ateneatene yi endorphins firi hɔ, a ɛyɛ abɔde mu nneɛma a ɛte adwenedwen ne ehu so. Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ apɔ mu ateneatene dwumadie mu a ebetumi ate abufuo ntɛntɛm ne ntɔkwapɛ so. Adwene a Ɛtu Mpɔn: Apɔ mu ateneatene a wɔyɛ no daa betumi aboa nipadua akwaa no nyinaa na asane nso ate adwenedwen sɛnkyerɛnne ahodoɔ so. Dae Yiye: Sɛ wotenetene wapɔm a a ɛboa ma wotumi da yie. Ahotoso a Ɛkɔ Anim: Sɛ wotenetene wapɔm dabiaa a ɛma wo ahoɔden mapa ɛsane nso etumi ma wo akukuduro soroko. Sɛ wotenetene wapɔm dabiaa a ɛboa ma wotumi toto watenka yie sane nso boa si ɔhaw a nsabuo deba ho. Nnipa Nkitahodi: Apɔ mu ateneatene dwumadie pii fa nipa nkitahodie boa atipɛnfoɔ ayɔnkofa a ɛbetumi aboa yi ankonam afiri hɔ. Adwene mu Akwahosan: Sɛ wotenetene wapɔm a ɛboa ma wadwene ayɛ adwuma yie na abetumi aboa ama wanin akɔ deɛ woreyɛ biaa so ne adwene mu dwumadie nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwene mu apomoden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi adi nsɛmsɛm a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, adwene mu apomoden dwummadie ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi adi nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho dwuma, efisɛ adwene mu apomoden yare ne nna mu apomoden wɔ abusuabɔ. Adwene mu apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ama: Adwene mu nneɛma a ɛde nna mu apomoden ho haw ahorow te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa adwenemhaw a wobedi ho dwuma. Atinka ne adwennwen a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa abusuabɔ ho a wobedi ho dwuma. Awoɔ apomoden ho  te sɛ ɔhaw nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, awoɔ a wontumi nwo, anaa nyinsɛn a wɔhwere no a wogyina ano. Afotu ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro a wɔrekɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, nna mu yareɛ a wosiw ano, ne nyinsɛn ho akwan horow. Nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm anaa obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho a ebetumi aka nna mu apomoden ne abusuabɔ ho dwuma a wobedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi ammɔ wɔn din bere a wɔde Intanɛt so ahokyere ho nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma de hwehwɛ nna ne awo apomoden ho haw ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɛn pii no, mmabun betumi ammɔ wɔn din bere a wɔde Intanɛt so ahokyere ho nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma de hwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho haw ahorow no. Saa nnwuma yi taa de kokoamusɛm ne kokoam nsɛm di kan, na ɛma ankorankoro tumi hwehwɛ mmoa a wɔmfa wɔn ho nsɛm nkyerɛ gye sɛ wɔpaw sɛ wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfeɛ bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun kɔhu dɔkota a ɔhwɛ mmea nsɛm mu 'gynaecologist', na adɛn nti na mmabun taa hu no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wanyin mfe nwotwe kosi du miensa (8-13), wote nna mu, anaa wowɔ haw. Nti: Adesua, bosome-buo haw, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, nna mu nyarewa 'STI' nhwehwɛmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn apaw nnuan a ahoɔden wom bere a meredidi wɔ abɔnten anaa sukuu mu bere a merebɔ mpanyin afe so no?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Kari pɛ (protein/veg/grains). Kwati Nnuan a Wɔayam. Ɔfã a Wɔde Di Dwuma. Nnuaba/Nnuadewa. Nsu (twa nsã a asikre wom so). Fa awia aduan gu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan pa bɛn na wɔbɛtumi afa so de kuro intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ anaa nkitahodiɛ nneɛma foforo adi dwuma de ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa Mmabun Nna ne Awoɔ Hokwan ho? (Nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ne nkra a wɔbɛtrɛw mu)
answer_twi_source: Kuru abeifo ntetan so nkitahodiɛ yɛ adwinnade a ɛwɔ tumi! Akwan pa a wɔbɛtumi afa so de adi dwuma nie: Trɛw Nkyerɛkyerɛ Nsɛm Mu: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden (ASRH) ho (e.g., pɛ a wɔpene so, nnamfofa pa). Yɛ Nsɛm a Ɛkanyan: Fa mfonini a ɛyɛ fɛ, nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ, anaa ankorankoro nsɛm (sɛ wopɛ a) di dwuma de twe adwene. Di Afoforo Nkitaho: Bua nsɛmmisa ne adwene a nkurɔfoɔ kyerɛ wɔ obu mu de hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asusuw anaa wɔasusuw digyital nsɛm a wɔde yɛ adwuma ne nnwuma ho wɔ nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ wɔ mmabun adesua, tumi a wɔde ma, ɔmanfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ne asetra mu nsakrae mmɔdenbɔ a ɛfa ASRH ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsakraeɛ a ɛba nimdeɛ, suban, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔayɛ ne akyi, akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, ne nsɛmbisa so. Monitoring engagement metrics te sɛ adwene, kyɛfa, ne nsɛm a wɔka fa digyital nsɛm ho de susuw reach ne resonance. Nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu anaa nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa su ho a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwehwɛ osuahu ahorow a wɔatra ase ne asɛm a wɔka fa dijitaal nsɛm a wɔde yɛ adwuma so kyɛ. Nsɛm a wɔbɛbisa afiri wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu, wɔn a wɔdi dwuma, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ hɔ de ate nkɛntɛnsoɔ a wɔsusu sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ ne mmeaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtu mpɔn ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aka mmabun awoɔ, na mɛyɛ dɛn ama m’awo ayɛ yiye ama daakye?
