answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ebetumi aka mmabun awoɔ  ne asetra kwan a wɔpaw te sɛ aduan, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne sigaretnom, ne aduruyɛ mu tebea horow a ɛhyɛ ase. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na w’awo atumi ayɛ yiye daakye no, fa w’adwene si asetra pa a wobɛkɔ so akura mu, kwati nneyɛe a asiane wom, na sɛ wowɔ w’awo apomoden ho dadwen a, hwehwɛ ayaresa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma, a mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ a wobenya, abɛɛfo ntentan akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ, ne abɛɛfo nkwantenpɔn  nkitahodi ka ho, nya mmabun tumi a wɔde nya mfaso fi abɛɛfo nkwantenpɔn so  nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow mu so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu sikasɛm mu nneɛma nya mmabun a wɔbɛnya nna ne awo ho akwaa nneɛma a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so no so nkɛntɛnsoɔ na wɔanya so mfasoɔ: Akwansideɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛnya: Mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ a ɛsua, abɛɛfo nkwantenpɔn akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nimdeɛ, ne abɛɛfo ntentan nkitahodiɛ a wotumi de ho to so betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛnya awo ne nna ho nsem nneɛma a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo nkwantenpɔn so. Abɛɛfo nkwantenpɔn mpaapaemu: Asetena mu sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe ma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ wɔ abɛɛfo nkwantenpɔn so nna ne awo ho nsem a wonya mu no yɛ kɛse, na mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya sika pii hyia haw akɛse wɔ mfaso a wobenya afi abɛɛfo nkwantenpɔn ne nna ne awo ho nsem  mmoa nkitahodi ahorow mu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no bɛtumi aboa ma nna ne awo akwahosan a efi mu ba no atu mpɔn wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma mmoa a ɛka obiara ho. Ɛma mmabun ahoɔden ma wɔsisi gyinaeɛ. Ɛma apɔwmuden yɛ yie. Ɛma bammɔ ne obu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔhwɛ a menya wɔ me nyinsɛn berɛ mu  no yɛ kokoamsɛm, na hokwan bɛn na mewɔ wɔ asumasɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho sɛ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn?
answer_twi_source: Confidentiality Rights: HIPAA Laws: Sɛ wokɔ United States a, mmara bi yɛfrɛ no Health Insurance Portability and Acountability Act (HIPAA) bɔ w'apɔwmuden nsɛm ho ban. Etwa sɛ ayaresafoɔ bɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Minor Laws: Amanaman bebree wɔ mmara ɛma mmabun kwan ma wonnya ɔhwɛ berɛ a wɔnyem, na w'awofoɔ mpo nntumi nnsi wɔn kwan.Confidentiality Policies so hwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo nntumi fa wo nsɛm nnto abɔnten gye asɛm pɔtee bi as te sɛ 'Child abuse', mmofra yɛyɛ wɔn basabasa. Sɛ wokɔ nsrahwɛ wɔ ayaresabea, bisa wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho mmara wode di dwuma. Wobetumi akyerɛkyerɛ wo mu. Wo bisa wo records so a wɔde bɛma wo mpo wɔ kokoam. Hyɛ ne nsew sɛ ɛtɔ dabi a, ayaresafoɔ behia w'awofoɔ sɛ wohu sɛ wo nkwa ho aba asɛm a. Te sɛ ebia wɔyɛ wo basabasa anaa wɔnnhwɛ wo so yie.Wopɛ wobetumi ama ɔmo ehu obia sɛ biribi to wo a, wotumi frɛ no. Kae sɛɔ HIPAA mmara no bɔ wo ban, nti etwa sɛ wɔdi so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Sɛ wonnte biribi ase a, bisa wɔn. Wɔbɛkyerɛ wo kwan a fa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpaninfo ne doktafoɔ a ogye wɔn die hɔ a, mfasoɔ bɛn na obenya efi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mfasoɔ no bi ne sɛ; saa mpaninfoɔ yi ma afotupa ne akwankyerɛ pa, na ɔmo kyerɛ sɛnea wobetumi agyina wo nan so wɔ mmerɛ a ɛyɛ den mu. Wɔma bammbɔ na afei so mawo kwan ma woda atenka adi. Bio so wɔkyerɛ sɛnea wo bɛhyɛ wo ho so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na aduan a wonnya ne ofie a enni hɔ ka mmabun nipadua ne wɔn adwene mu akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Aduan a wonnya nni betumi ama obi anya aduan pa, nipadua no mu tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ne akwahosan ho haw ahorow. Sɛ obi nni afie a, ebetumi ama wayare, wapira, na ne ho atew. Nneɛma abien no nyinaa betumi de adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw aba, na ama ayɛ den ama mmabun sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi sukuu so anaasɛ wɔbɛte ahotoso ne abusuabɔ nka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛfa technology so asie sika nea aborɔfo ka no 'asset-building efforts'?
answer_twi_source: Susu nea aborɔfo ka no 'Apps (Mint/YNAB)' a yɛde hwɛ sika die. Intanɛt sika sie ne yie dwumadi.akadeɛ ɛhwɛ sikasem.  nwomasua nneɛma. Intanɛt so adesua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Apɔmuden nteetee bɛn na ɛye ma me paa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔmuden nteetee a ɛyɛ paa ne deɛ w’ani gye ho na wobɛtumi ayɛ no daa. Ebi ni: Akuw Agumadi: Bɔɔlbɔ, basketball, volleyball, ne tɛnis yɛ nneɛma pa a ɛboa ma yɛn honam mu ne yɛn koma ho yɛ den na yɛyɛ adwuma bom. Ankorankoro Agumadi: Mmirikatu, asuguare, baisikel so tene, ne akodi bɛtumi ama wo ahoɔden na woatumi agyina pintii. Asa anaa 'aerobics' dwumadie yɛ akwan a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ a yɛfa so ma yɛn koma bɔ ntɛmntɛm.  Honam mu nteeteeɛ (bodyweight exercises), 'resistance bands', anaa 'weightlifting' (sɛ obi kyerɛ wo yie a) bɛtumi ama wo nnompe ne wo honam mu ayɛ den. Yoga anaa Pilates betumi ama wo honam mu ayɛ mmerɛw (flexibility). Abɔnten So Dwumadi: Nantew, abotan a wɔforo, anaa nturo mu adwuma yɛ (gardening) mpo betumi ayɛ nea mfaso wɔ so wɔ nipadua mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne  sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛtaa ba a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi anya nna mu yareɛ kyɛfa? (nsu a ɛyɛ soronko, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu akuru, ɛyaw a ɛba bere a wɔreto nsu, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne ne sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtaa ba wɔ nna mu yareɛ ho betumi ayɛ: Nsuo a ɛtaa ba wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu Nkwammoaa mu akuru anaa akuru Ɛyaw anaa ɔhyew a ɛba bere a ɔreto nsu mu Ɛyaw anaa ɛyaw a ɛyɛ hyew wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu Ɛyaw anaa ahotɔ a ɛyɛ yaw bere a obi reda Yafunu ase yaw anaa akyi berɛmo mu yaw Ntini a ɛho ahonhon wɔ akyi berɛmo mu Akisikuru anaa akisikuru a ɛba ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu anaa honam ani a atwa ho ahyia no so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi abisa mmoa anaa mmoa afi apomoden ho ɔkamfofo anaa mmara kwan so mmoa hɔ sɛ mihyia ɔhaw a ɛfa m’apomoden hokwan ahorow ho a?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wubetumi abisa mmoa afi apomoden ho ɔkasamafo anaa mmara kwan so mmoa hɔ sɛ wuhyia ɔhaw a ɛfa w’apomoden hokwan ahorow ho a. Apomoden ho akasamafo anaa mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow no yɛ wɔn ho titiriw wɔ ayarefo hokwan ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu na sɛ ɛho hia a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne ananmusifo ama. Wubetumi akɔ saa ahyehyɛde ahorow yi nkyɛn tee anaasɛ wobɛhwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ apomoden ho adwumayɛfo anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi de nhwɛso ahorow bi ama me a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea mmabun afoforo ne wɔn awofo afi nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho ase yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mekenkanee asɛm bi a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ ho wɔ apomoden adesua mu nnɛ, na ɛmaa misusuw ho. Mihui sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa bi fa sɛnea mɛbɔ me ho ban ho, na na mewɔ anidaso sɛ yebetumi aka ho asɛm. "Ná me ne me nnamfonom resusuw abusuabɔ ho, na mihui sɛ minnim pii fa ahye a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden ho. ;ani begye ho sɛ mɛte w;adwene wɔ ho." "Metee ɔkwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho asɛm wɔ atesɛm nkrataa mu, na mepɛ sɛ mihu sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma. So yebetumi abom aka ho asɛm?" Saa nhwɛso ahorow yi kyerɛ sɛnea mmabun afoforo afi ase ne wɔn awofo abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa nna mu apomoden ho wɔ obu ne ahunahuna kwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nim hokwan ahorow a, wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nnwuma mu na wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔmfa saa hokwan ahorow yi nni dwuma a wonsuro nyiyim anaa atemmu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan nhyehyɛe betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nim hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma mu denam hokwan ahorow ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛka nna ne awo akwanhosan (ASRH) nhomasua ne afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow ho no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya kokoam ɔhwɛ a wɔmfa atemmu, pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, kokoam nsɛm, ne kokoamsɛm ho asɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn. Akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow nso betumi atete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔne mmabun adi nkitaho yiye, wɔakyerɛ obu ama wɔn ahofadi, na wɔakura hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ mu. Bio nso, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun hokwan ahorow ho ada adi pefee na wɔde nneɛma te sɛ nkrataa,ne nhomawa, anifuraefo, krataa a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkenkan, nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm, "video" ne "jingle" ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ saa hokwan ahorow yi mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmbun betumi afa so akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛde ankorankoro ahobammɔ ne yiyedi di kan wɔ asetra mu mmeae a ebia nsa ne nnubɔne wɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmebun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛde ankorankoro ahobammɔ ne yiyedi di kan wɔ asetra mu tebea horow a ebia nsa ne nnubɔne wɔ hɔ denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ahu asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nsa ne ntua a nnubɔne ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw mu na wɔhyɛ apontow mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho nkuran. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de akamfo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so a wɔde siw ano, te sɛ nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne nea ɛfiri mu ba a ɛyɛ katee a wɔde bɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ. Nhyiam ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wonya akwan foforo a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ fekubɔ a wɔde nsa di dwuma, te sɛ apontow ahorow a wɔmfa nnuru nni dwuma wom, sini anadwo, anaa abɔnten dwumadi ahorow ho nhyehyɛe. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne mmeaeɛ a wɔakyerɛ sɛ ahotɔ wɔ hɔ a ankorankoro bɛtumi ahwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ anaasɛ wɔrehunahuna wɔn wɔ asetena mu tebea mu a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ anaa ɔhaw bɛn na mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ HIV ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wodi so no mu, na mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔakɔ so agye ayaresa ayarehwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia ɔhaw wɔ HIV ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow a woredi so no mu esiane nneɛma te sɛ animtiaabu, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho nsunsuanso bɔne, mmoa a wonnya, adwenemyare, ne asetra mu nsɛm nti. Mmoa nam afotuo, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho nhyehyɛeɛ, ne ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so na ɛba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu no di nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade, ayayade, ne nyiyim ho, a ebetumi aka asuafo adwenemyare ne wɔn yiyedi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow no di nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade, ayayade, ne nyiyim ho dwuma denam: Nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ko tia ayayade ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano a ɛma obu, tema, ne abusuabɔ pa a ɛda asuafo ntam no di dwuma. Ntetee ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, adwumayɛfoɔ, ne asuafoɔ wɔ ayayadeɛ, ayayadeɛ, ne nyiyim a wɔbɛhunu na wɔayɛ ho biribi. Amanneɛbɔ akwan ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛsi hɔ ama asuafoɔ de abɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ayayadeɛ anaa ayayadeɛ ho amanneɛ dwoodwoo ne kokoam. Nhwehwɛmu ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de adi ayayade nneyɛe ho dwuma na wɔaboa wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa, a afotu ne atɛntrenee akwan a wɔfa so san de wɔn ho hyɛ mu ka ho. Amammerɛ a ɛfa nnipa a wɔka wɔn ho, ahorow ahorow, ne gye a wogye tom a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ baabi a asuafo nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wobu wɔn, na wɔboa wɔn wɔ wɔn sukuu mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ehia sɛ awofoɔ benya berɛ ama mmabun wɔ mmerɛ nsesaeɛ rehyɛ aseɛ?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ tumi mawɔ akwankyerɛ a ɛho hia wɔ saa mmerɛ yi mu. Nteaseɛ so boa mmabun hu sɛnea  wɔ bɛbɔ wɔn bra. Adesua bɛma ɔmo anya nimdie a ehia fa ho. Awofoɔ bɛma wɔn nneɛma wohia so wɔ saa mmerɛ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wɔn apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo asusuw kokoam nsɛm ho ansa na wɔanya nna ne awo ho apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn kokoamsɛm ho haw ahorow akyerɛ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo pefee denam: Nsɛm a wobebisa: Nsɛm a wobebisa fa ɔyarehwɛfo no kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne sɛnea wodi nsɛm a ɛho hia ho dwuma ho. Nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛda no adi: Nsɛm a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde sie wɔn awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no a wɔbɛka no pefee. Awerɛhyem a wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Awerɛhyem a wɔbɛsrɛ afi apɔmuden ho ɔyaresafo no hɔ sɛ wɔbɛdi wɔn kokoamsɛm so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye wɔ mmara no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi de LGBTQ+ mmabun ahyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne ne wɔn ahiade na wɔabu wɔn sɛ ɛsom bo?
answer_twi_source: Wɔabara LGBTQ+ dwumadie wɔ Ghana enti nhyehyɛeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛboa a ɛka wɔn nnipa hokwan titire ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na akwannya a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu na ɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwannya a ɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan mu na wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ mmabun nya hokwan de wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu denneennen, kamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow, na wɔboa ma wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ne yiyedi na wɔde di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma ankorankoro a wɔrehyia animtiaabu a ɛfa STI anaa HIV ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma ankorankoro a wɔrehyia animtiaabu a ɛfa STI anaa HIV ho no bi ne: - Afotuo dwumadie: Kokoam mmoa ne afotuo a ɛfiri adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn hɔ de di aniwuo, wɔatew wɔn ho, anaa nyiyim ho nkateɛ ho dwuma. - mmoa akuo: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ma ankorankoro a wɔte STI anaa HIV sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ suahunu, anya mmoa, na wɔakamfo animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne mmoa nhama: Intanɛte so nhyehyɛeɛ ne tɛlifono so mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a ankorankoro bɛtumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm, akwankyerɛ, ne nkateɛ mu mmoa a wɔmmɔ wɔn din. Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛbɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ ne akuo a wɔkamfo wɔn ho a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate ase, wɔbɛko atia animtiaabuo, na wɔbɛhyɛ hokwan ne nidie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nnipa a STI anaa HIV aka wɔn no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi anya hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ kasa anaa ɔkwan a mete ase mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde akwahosan ho hokwan ahorow ho nsɛm bɛma wɔ kasa anaa ɔkwan a ankorankoro te ase mu. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wobisa nsɛm wɔ kasa bi a ɛyɛ wo dɛ mu anaa nsɛm a wotumi nya mu, te sɛ braille anaa nkyerɛwee akɛse mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di saa abisade ahorow yi ho dwuma, de hwɛ hu sɛ wubetumi ate wo hokwan ahorow ase yiye na wode adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa ka fa STI ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm a Wɔtaa Ka: Atosɛm: Wubetumi ahu sɛ obi wɔ STI denam hwɛ a wobɛhwɛ so. Nteɛso: STI ahorow pii nni sɛnkyerɛnne biara a wotumi hu, enti nhwehwɛmu ho hia yiye. Atosɛm: Nnipa a wɔyɛ aguaman nkutoo na wonya STI. Nteɛso: Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ nna mu no betumi anya STI, a ahokafo dodow mfa ho. hu sɛ nna mu dwumadi biako pɛ a wommɔ ho ban betumi betumi de wo ato asiane mu sɛ wubenya STI. Atosɛm: STIs nyɛ aniberesɛm na enhia ayaresa. Nteɛso: STI ahorow betumi de akwahosan mu nsɛnnennen a emu yɛ den aba sɛ wɔansa a. Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Fa nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma so de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔ STI ho. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran na ama wɔayi anansesɛm afi hɔ na ama ntease anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ akannifo dwumadi ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho mu paa ara wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ɔman no mu, ne amanaman ntam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ akannifo dwumadi ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ASRH ho mu kɛse denam: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim ne akuw a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔde wɔn adwene si ASRH so a wɔbɛka ho, baabi a wobetumi anya akannifo ho nimdeɛ, anya ntetee hokwan ahorow, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ adwumayɛkuw mu. Mmabun agyinatukuo, afotufoɔ kuo, anaa boayikuo a mpɔtam, ɔman, anaa amanaman ntam ASRH ahyehyɛdeɛ hyehyɛeɛ de hwɛ sɛ mmabun adwene bɛgyina hɔ ama wɔ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Nhyiamu, nhyiamu, ne nhyiamu a ɛfa ASRH ho a mmabun bɛtumi ne wɔn atipɛnfoɔ adi nkitaho, akyɛ wɔn nhumu, na wɔaboa ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm titire ne nsɛnnennen ho. Social media platforms ne digital nnwinnade a wɔde bedi dwuma de ne mmabun afoforo a wɔyɛ adwuma ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso adi nkitaho, aboaboa mmoa ano ama ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow, na wɔama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ho ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na IAL (afiri a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu) ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu no yɛ adwuma, na ɛkyɛ ahe sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUD): Mfiri a ɛte sɛ T a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo de hyɛ awotwaa no mu. Mfeɛ 8-12 a atwam (egyina ne su so). Yɛ adwuma denam awotwaa mu nsu a wobɛma ayɛ den na woasiw sɛ wode bɛhyɛ mu no so. IUD yɛ honam mu nkwammoa anaa kɔbere. Nneɛma a Wɔde Gu Wo nsa: Poma a ɛyɛ tratraa a apomoden ho ɔyaresafo de hyɛ wo nsa ho were ase. Mfeɛ 3-5 a atwam (ɛgyina ne su so). Yi honam mu nkwammoa ahorow fi hɔ bere nyinaa na ama woatumi asiw nyinsɛn ano. IUD ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu nyinaa tu mpɔn kɛse (bɛboro 99%) wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow, aban ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu di wɔ sikasɛm mu nkabom a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne sikasɛm mu nnwuma a wɔtrɛw mu ma mmabun, titire wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonnya mmoa pii no mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu di dwuma wɔ sikasɛm mu nkabom a mmabun nya nkɔso mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow a ɛde sikakorabea nneɛma ne nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade ahorow ma. Aban ahorow a wɔde nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa sikasɛm ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow na eyi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ no redi dwuma. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ma mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua ma. Sukuu ahorow a wɔde sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ka wɔn adesua nhyehyɛe ne adesua akyi dwumadi ahorow ho de du mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya telehealth services bere a meyɛ ɔbabun?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so anya apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe wɔ tetefon so, te sɛ: Wɔn apɔwmuden ho ɔyarehwɛfo adwumayɛbea a wɔbɛkɔ akɔbisa nsɛm afa tetefon so apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ho. Telehealth platforms a apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe anaa insurance nnwumakuw de ma a wɔde bedi dwuma. Mobile apps a wobɛtwe apps te sɛ YMK App a wɔayɛ ama telehealth animka. Telehealth wɛbsaet ahorow a wobɛkɔ na woakyerɛw wo din ama virtual appointments
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan pa bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ada yɛn ateka (te sɛ abufuo, awerɛhoɔ, ehu, anaa anigyeɛ) adi?
answer_twi_source: Abufuo: sɛ wobɛgye ahome kɛse (deep breathing) ama w'adwene adwo, wobɛda w'ateka adi pefee a wannyeyɛ obiara, anaa wobɛyɛ agumadi (exercise). Awerɛhoɔ: Kasa kyerɛ adamfo, twerɛ wo nsɛm ne w'adwene (journaling), anaa hwehwɛ mmoa. Ehu: Fa ahomegyeɛ kɛse (relaxation) di dwuma na hwehwɛ mmoa. Anigyeɛ: Kyɛ asɛmpa no, yɛ nneɛma a ɛma w'ani gye, na da ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ di wɔ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo apomuden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ne nea efi mu ba wɔ mmabun a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonnya mmoa pii mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya wɔ mmabun a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu na wonnya mmoa yiye mu no ho dwuma a wobedi mu. Ɛdenam ayarefo amammerɛ ahorow a wɔbɛte ase na wɔabu wɔn so no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi adi akwanside ahorow te sɛ kasa, ahotoso a wonni, ne animtiaabu so, na wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa mpɔtam ahorow ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho ama. Ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu betumi aboa ma nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonya mu no so atew, ama ayarefo abotɔyam ne wɔn ho a wɔde hyɛ mu atu mpɔn, na awiei koraa no ɛde akwahosan pa aba mmabun a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun besi dɛn abisa nsɛm a ne mfoni bi a wohu wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan no so?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware. Hwehwɛ adwene a ɛwɔ akyi. Hwehwɛ media foforo. Hyɛ 'body positivity' nkuran. Ko ma amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ 'media literacy'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn nne ne wɔn atenae ahorow adi dwuma de ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm pa ayɛ kɛse, akasa atia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛm a ɛha, na wɔahyɛ asetra mu atɛntrenee, pɛyɛ, ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo mu ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn nne ne wɔn atenae ahorow adi dwuma de ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm pa mu den, akasa atia asɛm a ɛha, na wɔahyɛ asetra mu atɛntrenee, pɛyɛ, ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ananmusifo mu ho nkuran denam: Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie, blog, vlog, ne dijitaal nhyiam afoforo a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm, akamfo nneɛma a wodwen ho, na wɔama nne ne adwene ahorow ayɛ kɛse. Nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ na wɔakyɛ a ɛhyɛ nipadua ho mfonini pa, nkitahodie pa, pene amammerɛ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne amammerɛ ahorow ho gyinabea a ɛka obiara ho nkuran. Intanɛt so ɔsatu ahorow, hashtags, ne nhyiam ahorow a ɛkasa tia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛha mu kyɛfa a wonya, ɛma nkurɔfo hu asetra mu nsɛm, na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne nnwuma mu nsakrae kyerɛ. Yɛne atipɛnfoɔ, wɔn a wɔnya nsunsuansoɔ, wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden, ne nnwumakuo bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ama nnipakuo nne ayɛ kɛseɛ na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama asetena mu nsakraeɛ pa ho nhyehyɛeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu denam mmeae a obiara bɛka ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, kasa a wɔka denneennen, wɔn ankasa osuahu ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛka, ne wɔn ayɔnkofo a wɔma wɔn nne yɛ kɛse a wɔbɛyɛ biako no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun a wɔyem wɔ wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn ankasa apɔwmuden ne wɔn ba akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem wɔ hokwan sɛ wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn ankasa akwahosan ne wɔn ba akwahosan ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nea wɔpaw wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, awoɔ, aduroyɛ mu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho, sɛnea wɔn apɛde, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nea eye sen biara te.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi de ahotoso ne nkɔmmɔ a ɔhaw nni mu asi hɔ a mete nka sɛ me ho tɔ me sɛ mɛba mo nkyɛn de nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw adwene, ɛmfa ho sɛnea ebia ɛyɛ den fa?
answer_twi_source: Ma ahotoso ne nea wobue w’ani mu tebea nhyɛ mu den wɔ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobɛbɔ a wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wobɛda wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne nsɛmmisa adi a wunsuro sɛ wobebu wo atɛn anaasɛ wobɛtɔ wo so ka no so. Si hia a kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm ho hia so dua, na ma w’awofo awerɛhyem sɛ wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso sɛ wobedi w’ahye so na wɔama wo nkɔmmɔbɔ no ayɛ kokoamsɛm. Hyɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ asɛmti biara nni hɔ a ɛnyɛ nea wɔahyɛ da ayɛ na wubu wɔn mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ den a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wobɛfa so no mu no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu aba bere a mɛhwehwɛ ahoɔden pa afi atipɛnfo hɔ wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu, te sɛ asiane a ɛkɔ soro, ahofadi a ɛkɔ soro, anaasɛ obu a obi wɔ ma me ho a ɛso tew, na mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw saa aguadi ahorow yi ho?
answer_twi_source: Nea ebetumi afi bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu aba wɔbɛhwehwɛ ahoɔden pa afi atipɛnfo hɔ wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu no bi ne: Asiane a wɔde to wɔn ho so a ɛkɔ soro: Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ pene anaasɛ wogye tum fi atipɛnfo hɔ a, ebetumi ama wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu, te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, de ne kuo gyinapɛn ahorow ahyia. Ahofadi a ɛba fam: Sɛ wode wo ho to abɔnten so adansedi anaa pene a m’atipɛnfo hwehwɛ so a, ebetumi atew tumi a wubetumi asi gyinae ahorow a wode wo ho, a wowɔ ahofadi wɔ wo nna mu apomoden ne wo yiyedi ho no so. Obu a wowɔ ma wo ho a ɛso tew: Sɛ wohwehwɛ ahoɔden pa a wobɛhwehwɛ bere nyinaa afi w’atipɛnfo hɔ de agye nea woapaw no atom a, ebetumi anya obu a wowɔ ma wo ho ne sɛnea wosom wo ho no so nkɛntɛnso bɔne sɛ wuhu sɛ saa pene no gyina nneyɛe bi so anaasɛ egyina nneyɛe bi so a. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosusuw saa aguadi ahorow yi ho a, susuw mfaso a ɛwɔ so bere tiaa bi a ɛwɔ so sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ ahoɔden pa a wode bɛto nea ebetumi afi mu aba bere tenten wɔ w’apomoden, w’abusuabɔ, ne wo yiyedi nyinaa so no ho. Fa gyinaesi ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow hyia, hyɛ w’apomoden ne ahobammɔ ho nkuran, na ɛboa ma w’ani gye bere tenten ne abotɔyam di kan, sɛ ebia ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na wobenya asetena mu pene anaa wogye tum ntɛm ara mpo a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so aboafo nneɛma anaa ahyehyɛde bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde mmoa ne akwankyerɛ wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmara mu nsɛm a ɛfa awo apomoden ho dwumadie ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahyehyɛde ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bɛma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmara mu nsɛm a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho dwumadie ho. Ebia eyinom bi ne mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a wɔkamfo mmabun, awo hokwan ahorow ho ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ mmabun apomoden  ho adwuma titiriw. Saa nneɛma yi betumi de mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho ho nsɛm ama, de mmara kwan so mmoa ama anaasɛ wɔde wɔn akɔma afoforo, na wɔakamfo hokwan ne anigye a mmabun wɔ wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa awo apomoden ho no kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mifi ase nya nsakrae wɔ nipadua hua mu anaa ahotew ho nsɛm a ɛma m’ani awu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛte aniwu nka wɔ nsakrae a ɛba nipadua hua anaa ahotew mu bere a woadu mpanyin afe so no ho. Nea wubetumi ayɛ ni: Gure anaa nguare: Gure anaa aguare daa, titiriw bere a woayɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ awie no, na ama wo nipadua ho atew. Hwɛ mmeae a mmoawa ne fifiri boaboa ano te sɛ honam ani ntini, axilla, nufu ase, ne nan ase bere a woreguare no yiye. Fa Deodorant Di Dwuma: Fa deodorant anaa antiperspirant di dwuma de hwɛ nipadua hua so. Fa gu honam ani a ɛho tew na ɛyɛ nwunu so. Hwehwɛ na fa deodorants a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ te sɛ lime nsu anaa nsõ a wɔde gu honam ani simma 10-15 ansa na woaguare no di dwuma. Kwati nneɛma a ɛhyɛ wo honam ani abufuw. Sesa Ntade: Sesa ntade ne ntade ase da biara na amma hua antra hɔ. Ɛho hia sɛ wosakra kɔ ntama a ɛho tew mu bere a woaguare awie no. Hyɛ nneɛma a ɛma ahome na ɛtwe nsu te sɛ ntama a wɔde kotoku ayɛ ne ntade a ɛhyɛ ase. Yiyi: Sɛ woyiyi wo awotwaa mu nhwi daa a, ɛboa ma nipadua hua ntumi nkasa kyerɛ Ɔpanyin a Wogye No Di: Sɛ worepere wɔ nipadua hua anaa ahotew ho a, wo ne ɔwofo, ɔhwɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama. Fa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Siesie: Fa deodorant, popa, anaa ntade foforo a wode bɛsesa gu w’akyi bag anaa locker mu ma tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ. Hwehwɛ Afotu: Sɛ wunnim sɛnea wubedi ahotew ho nsɛm ho dwuma a, susuw ho sɛ wo ne sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi bɛkasa akɔhwehwɛ afotu ne mmoa. Sɛ wudi ahotew ho nneyɛe yi akyi a, wubetumi akura w’ankasa ahotew pa mu wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmabun ma wonni wɔn ho ewu, te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma, mmoa a ekuo bi de ma, anaa afotufoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Community-Based Suicide Prevention Programs: Mpɔtam nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmabun ma wonni wɔn ho ewu, te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma, mmoa a ekuo bi de ma, afotufuo, ne sukuu mu adwene mu apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛeɛ. Nhyehyɛeɛ yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ahunu nneɛma, ama mmoa, na atew aniwuo a ɛkɔ so wɔ adwene mu apɔmuden haw ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahyɛ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho a ɛhia sɛ wɔma ani kɔ  ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den na ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ne hokwan ahorow ahyia yiye?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ahyɛ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho a ɛhia sɛ wɔma ani kɔ ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛka abom no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma bedi kan wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nneɛma  ɛhia sɛ wɔma ani kɔ ho mu, wɔbɛtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔadi mmabun ahiade pɔtee ho dwuma, ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka wɔn a wɔbɛyɛ mu wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ ade a egyina nnipa so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho ne nkate fam yiyedi wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi bere no mu, a nea ɛka ho ne anuho, awerɛhow, anaa ahotɔ ho nkate a wobedi ano?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi bere no mu no, ɛho hia sɛ wode wo ho a wobɛhwɛ ne nkate mu yiyedi di kan: Hu na gye wo nkate horow tom, sɛ́ ɛyɛ anohu nkate, awerɛhow, ahotɔ, anaa eyinom a wɔaka abom. Ne obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka wo nkate ho asɛm. Fa Mmɔborɔhunu Di Dwuma: Da ayamye adi kyerɛ wo ho na te ase sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya nkate horow a adi afra bere a woatu nyinsɛn agu akyi. Fa ahomegye akwan te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ, adwennwen, anaa adwene a wɔde si biribi so di dwuma na aboa ma adwennwen ne dadwen so atew. Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma w’ani gye na ɛboa ma wotwetwe w’adwene fi nsusuwii bɔne so. Susuw Adwumayɛfo Mmoa Ho: Sɛ worepere sɛ wubegyina wo nkate horow ano a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ afotu anaa ayaresa de adi wo nkate horow ho dwuma wɔ tebea a ɛboa wo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so ne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ adwempa bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛma denhyɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan "sexual health", pene a wɔpene so "consent", ne ahye "boundaries" ho?
answer_twi_source: Fi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase: Di kan ne w’atipɛnfo fi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase fa nna mu akwahosan "sexual health" ho nsɛmti ho, na si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wusi gyinae a wubenya nimdeɛ, pene so, ne abusuabɔ pa so dua. Bisa nsɛm a wɔabue ano: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wosusuw ho nkuran denam nsɛmmisa a wɔabue ano a wobɛbisa a ɛto nsa frɛ adwene ne osuahu ahorow so. Yɛ beae a ɛnyɛ atemmuo a obiara bɛte nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no sɛ ɔbɛka ne nsusuiɛ ne ne n'atinka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ ofie basabasayɛ anaa ɔtan nsɛmmɔnedie mu?
answer_twi_source: Ofie Basabasayɛ: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ ofie basabasayɛ mu no wɔ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ wɔ mmara ahorow a ɛfa ofie basabasayɛ ne ɔhokafo a wɔbɛn wɔn ho basabasayɛ ho no ase. Nsɛmmɔnedi Ɔtan ka ho: Aman pii wɔ mmara a ɛma asotwe a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi a wɔyɛ tia ankorankoro a egyina wɔn dɛmdi anaa wɔn a wofi akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu so no yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe pa a wɔde gye abusua tom anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, na ne mpontu te dɛn?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ abusua agye atom nhyehyeɛ anaa nhyehyeɛ biara nni Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa sɛnea wobesiw nna mu yareɛ( STI ) ano ho bere a wɔrekɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa adwumayɛbea ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa sɛnea wobesiw nna mu yareɛ (STI) ano ho bere a wɔrekɔ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa adwumayɛbea ahorow no. Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo taa de afotu ma wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho, a nea ɛka ho ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde kɔndɔm di dwuma, sɛ wɔbɛtew wɔn a wɔne wɔn da no so, na wɔne wɔn ahokafo adi nkitaho wɔ STI tebea ne nhwehwɛmu ho. Wobetumi nso de nkyerɛkyerɛ ama wɔ akwan a wɔfa so siw STI ano ho, te sɛ ayersa dwumadie a wɔfrɛ wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) a wɔde siw nna mu yareɛ (HIV) ano ne HPV paneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma aboa mfɛfo ne yɛn nkitahodie ahodoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn ne botae koro a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ho hia na ama wɔne atipɛnfo, ayɔnkofo, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn ne botae koro a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no nya nkitahodie a ɛboa na ɛka obiara bom. Fa nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware di dwuma, tie afoforo adwenekyerɛ yie, na yɛ biako wɔ botae ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbom yɛ ho.Kyerɛ obuo, ahotoso, ne nteaseɛ ho adwene denam nneɛma ahodoɔ a wobɛbu no sɛ ɛsom boɔ, nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, ne ankorankoro nyinaa hokwan ne yiedie a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so. Ɛnam nkitahodie a ɛboa a egyina nkitahodi a etu mpɔn so a mobɛhyehyɛ so no, mubetumi abom ayɛ adwuma de nsakrae pa aba na aboa ama obiara anya nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛhu wɔn hokwan ne 'boundaries' na wɔde asi gyinaeɛ pa a ɛfata ?
answer_twi_source: Sua ade fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, susuw w’atenka ho, hyehyɛ ahye a emu da hɔ, bu afoforo, na hwehwɛ afotu fi mpanyimfo a wugye wɔn di hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen anaa akwansideɛ bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm (disability-inclusive) anya kyɛfa wɔ sikasɛm mu no ho, na sɛn na yɛbɛtumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen: nsakraeɛ a nnipa bɛka sɛ wɔmpɛ, amanyɔfoɔ a wonni pɛ (political will) sɛ wɔbɛyɛ adwuma no, ne sika a enni hɔ. Yɛbɛgyina ano denam: Nkyerɛkyerɛ (awareness), nnyigyeiɛ (advocacy), nteteeɛ, ne nkabom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua  betumi aboa ma wɔadi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu aba mu wɔ mmabun akuw ahorow mu, a nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ ka ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua  betumi: De mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde asi wɔn ani so ama akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua, te sɛ nnipa a w'adi dɛm, asuafoɔ a wɔadi dɛm, anaa asuafoɔ a wɔfiri mmusua a wɔn sikasɛm tebea nye mu, de ahwɛ sɛ wɔdi wɔn nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH) ahiadeɛ ho dwuma. Kasa tia nsusuwii hunu, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne adwemmɔne a epira a ɛma nsonsonoe ba nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH) mu nsunsuanso mu. Ma asuafo a wofi mmeae ahorow nya tema, ntease, ne biakoyɛ, na ɛtew animtiaabu ne nyiyim so. Ma asuafoɔ tumi ma wɔmfa nhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ, akwannya, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwaahosan nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na obiara a ɔka ho kyerɛ wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔka bom wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm mu kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ tebea horow a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna nyinaa mu te nka sɛ wɔma wɔn akwaaba, wɔsom bo, na wobu wɔn. Ɛho hia efisɛ obiara fata sɛ ɔtra ase nokwarem a onsuro sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nyiyim anaasɛ wɔbɛtow no agu nkyɛn. Atenaeɛ a ɛka obiara ho no hyɛ adwene ne nkateɛ mu yiedie ho nkuran na ɛma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ɛbata nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware anaa ɛdaadaa a wodi na wɔka wɔ Intanɛt so no ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi bi ase?
answer_twi_source: Asiane ahorow a ɛbata nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa ɛdaadaa a obi di na ɔde ma wɔ Intanɛt so no bi ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛde gyinaesi a wonni nimdeɛ, anansesɛm anaa animtiaabu a ɛkɔ so tra hɔ, ne nea ebetumi apira obi honam fam anaa nkate fam yiyedi. Mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase nam nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu ansa na wɔakyɛ emu nsɛm, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛho hia a wɔne mpanyimfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di bɛbɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ne nkitahodi ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ne mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo reyɛ biako de ahyɛ wɔn nne mu den na wɔakasa ama nsakrae a ntease wom wɔ ASRH mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nkitahodiɛ a mmabun di wɔn anim ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ne mpaninfoɔ ayɔnkofoɔ yɛ adwuma bom de ma wɔn nne yɛ kɛseɛ na wɔkamfo nsakraeɛ a nteaseɛ wɔ mu wɔ ASRH mu denam: Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma, nneyɛeɛ pa, ne asuadeɛ a wɔnya denam nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ, ɔsatuo a wɔbom yɛ, ne nimdeɛ a wɔkyɛ so. Nkabom ne apam ahorow a wɔde mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo bom di dwuma na ɛma nkɛntɛnso a nnwuma a mmabun di anim nya wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so no yɛ kɛse. Nkitahodi a wɔne mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo, a nhyehyɛeyɛfo, nhwehwɛmufo, ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ka ho, bedi nkitaho de akyekye mmoa ne ahoɔden ama nsɛm a wɔkasa kyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan a mmabun di anim. abɛɛfo ntentan ne dawurubɔ kuro ntetan bea a wɔde bedi dwuma de ne ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nkitahodiɛ foforɔ a mmabun di anim adi nkitaho, ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛseɛ, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama botaeɛ ne botaeɛ a wɔbom yɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwumayɛ ho adwene na wɔanya adebɔ, nneɛma foforo a wɔyɛ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne asiane a wɔde to asiane mu ho nimdeɛ na ama wɔadi yiye sɛ adwumayɛfo?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya adwumayɛ ho adwene denam adebɔ, nneɛma foforo a wɔyɛ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne asiane a wɔde to wɔn ho a wobenya so. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ adebɔ mu nsusuwii ho nkuran, te sɛ adwene mu nkɔmmɔ, adwinni ho adwuma, anaa anigyede foforo a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Wobetumi ama ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ ayɛ kɛse denam wiase ankasa mu nsɛnnennen a wobedi ho dwuma, nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, ne ano aduru a wɔbɛsan aka bio so. Asiane a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom mu no ma mmabun tumi fi wɔn ahotɔ mmeae, gye huammɔdi tom sɛ adesua hokwan, na wonya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma anaa nnwinnade bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi de anya asetena mu nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Eyinom bi ne nhoma ahorow a wɔde boa wɔn ho, intanɛt so adesua, mobile applications, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow, ne mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si dwumadi ahorow a wɔde kyekye ahokokwaw so. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow de nkitahodi module ahorow a ɛfa asetena mu nimdeɛ ho nsɛmti ahorow ho ma, a nkitahodi, gyinaesi, atenka mu nyansa, ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ ka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, nhomakorabea ahorow, ne mmabun mmeae taa yɛ nhyiam anaa nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔsoɔ ho, a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ akannifo, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ bɛn na wɔbetumi afa so ahyɛ awoɔ mu apɔmuden pɛyɛ ne ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa a mmabun nyinaa bɛnya nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Eyi bi ne: Awoɔ mu apɔmuden nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam. Awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa ne afotu a ne bo nyɛ den, na ayaresa ka ho. Asetena mu nneɛma a ɛka apɔmuden, te sɛ ohia, mmusuakuo nyiyim, ne nyiyim a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma. Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyi akwansideɛ a ɛwɔ mmoa a wɔbɛnya mu, te sɛ insurance a ɛtua awoɔ ayaresa ne mmoa ho ka. Nkurɔfoɔ ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma, a nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ, apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ mpanyimfoɔ ka ho, de ahyɛ awoɔ mu apɔmuden pɛyɛ nkuran na wɔadi nsonsonoeɛ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nnwumakuw asetra mu asɛyɛde (CSR) nhyehyɛe ahorow di wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔma mmabun nya nkɔso mu, na etu mpɔn dɛn?
answer_twi_source: CSR nhyehyeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔbɛma mmabun anya nkɔsoɔ mu denam sika a wɔde bɛto nwomasua, akwahosan, ne asetena mu nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ na ɛboa ma nkɔsoɔ a ɛkɔ so daa ba no so. Wɔma nnwumakuw din, nokwaredi a ɛfa ahyɛnsode ho, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nya nkɔso bere a wɔde asetra mu nkɛntɛnso pa ba na wodi ɔmanfo nsɛnnennen ho dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi afa so ama adwene anaa wɔakyerɛ dadwen wɔ suban pa a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu adesua a wɔyɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ hyehyɛ akwan a mmabun betumi afa so ama adwene anaa wɔakyerɛ dadwen wɔ suban pa a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu adesua a wɔyɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mu ho denam: Akwan a wɔbɛde aka nhwehwɛmu ahyɛdeɛ ho ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ama adwene, a ɛma mmabun kwan ma wɔka wɔn adwene, wɔn apɛdeɛ, ne wɔn dadwen wɔ adesua no nyinaa mu. Nhwehwɛmu adwumayɛfoɔ anaa mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodifoɔ a wɔbɛpaw wɔn sɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu betumi ne wɔn adi nkitaho abisa nsɛm, abɔ nsɛm amanneɛ, anaa ahwehwɛ mmoa a ɛfa nhwehwɛmu no mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ho. Nhyiam a wɔbɛyɛ daa anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛkɔ so ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ayɛ de ahwehwɛ adwene wɔ wɔn suahunu ho na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔdi suban pa ahyɛdeɛ so wɔ nhwehwɛmu no nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi bɛnya nna mu ayɔnkofa ho nimdeɛ wɔ mmoa kwan so pa?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ hokafoɔ pa a ɔboa wo . Kasa pefee. Hwehwɛ akwan foforo a mobɛfa so akyerɛ ɔdɔ. Fa w'adwene si anigyeɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abakɔsɛm ne ɔmanfo mu nneɛma bi a ama wɔakɔ so anya adwene a ɛnteɛ ne nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmabun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuieeɛ bɔne a ɛfa dɛm (disability) ne nna (sexuality) ho no firi abakɔsɛm ne asetena mu nneɛma ahorow mu:Dɛm a Wɔbu no sɛ Akwansideɛ (Disability as a Deficit): Amanneɛ mu nsusuieeɛ a ɛfa dɛm ho sɛ ɛyɛ anidie anaa akwansideɛ bi no kanyan nsusuieeɛ bɔne fa nna mu apɔwmuden ho.Bɔberɛ mu Nyiyim ne Ahoteɛ a Ɛnni Hɔ (Sexism and Intolerance): Mpɔtam mu nyiyim a ɛfa mmaa ne LGBTQ+ foɔ ho no bɛtumi ama mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔwɔ dɛm no ayɛ nnipa a wɔahyɛ wɔn so kɛseɛ na wɔatwa wɔn asuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahodoɔ bɛn na wobetumi afa so anya ahotoso ne gyedie wo nkitahodie mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wobuem: Ka w’adwene, wo nkate, ne mmerɛyɛ ahodoɔ ho asɛm kyerɛ wo hokafoɔ. Nsɛm a ɛkɔ so daa: Yɛ nea wotumi de ho to so na yɛ nea ɛkɔ so daa wɔ wo nneyɛeɛ ne wo nsɛm mu. Obuo ne Mmoa: Kyerɛ obuo ma mo ho mo ho adwene, ahyeɛ, ne botaeɛ ahodoɔ. Bere a Ɛyɛ Pa: Monni berɛ pa mmom, na momfa mo ho nhyɛ dwumadi ahodoɔ a mo mmienu nyinaa ani gye ho mu. Nokwaredi: Monni nkware mma mo ho mo ho na momfa biaa nsie mo ho, titiri wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia ho. Ɔdɔ ne Anisɔ: Da ɔdɔ ne anisɔ adi kyerɛ mo ho mo ho daa. Ntawantawadi Ho Nsiesiei: Fa obu ne nkɔso di ntawantawadie ho dwuma, na mobom hwehwɛ ano yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi adi wɔ mmɔden a mmabun bɔ sɛ wobesiw awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ano na wɔadi ho dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, ahwɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi adi dwuma a ɛboa wɔ mmɔden a mmabun bɔ sɛ wobesiw awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ano na wɔadi ho dwuma no mu denam: Nkitahodi akwan a ɛda hɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne ahotoso a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti, nna, ne nkitahodie ho no ayɛ mmerɛw. Nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI a wosiw ano, brayɛ akwahosan, ne awo akwahosan ho haw afoforo ho. Mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn ahofadi a wobebu wɔn bere a wɔde mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ma sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bere a ɛho hia no. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ a ɛma mmabun nya nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware. Suban pa,ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛfa awo akwahosan, nna, ne nkitahodie ho nhwɛso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmere bɛn na ɛwɔ sɛɛ wohwehwɛ futuo wɔ ayaresa mu anaa kwankyerɛ wɔ anyin mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ahwehwɛ mmoa bere biara wɔ ayaresabea aa wogye ɔmo di aa wɔwɔ awoɔ apɔmmuden beae, sɛ wowɔ apɔwmuden mpo a. Nnoɔma a ebɔ wonkae a ɛyɛ nwonwa: Sɛ wote nkae nwawasuo bi tesɛ yaw denden, mogya ba pii, anaa woresesa ntɛm. Adwene mu haw: Se wote Awerɛhoɔ anaa dadwen aa etoatoa so. Nna mu apɔmmuden: Ansa na woahyɛ nna ase anaa sɛ wowɔ asɛmmisa fa nna mu apɔmuden. Nyin a eka akyi: Sɛ wonyin eka akyi anaa anyin ntem dodo rekyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadi ahorow ho? So akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so ayɛ nnwuma a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua?
answer_twi_source: Ebia ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho, nanso apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo ne ayaresabea ahorow pii de akwan horow a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma, titiriw ma mmabun a wonni sika pii. Nneɛma a wobetumi apaw ama STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa adwuma a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua no betumi ayɛ: Ɔmanfo apɔmuden ayaresabea anaa STI ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde sika a wɔde tua ho ka a ɛkɔ fam a egyina sika a wonya so ma. Planned Parenthood ayaresabea ne awo apɔmuden asoɛe afoforo a wɔde STI dwumadie ma wɔ boɔ a wɔatew so anaasɛ wontua hwee ma ankorankoro a wɔfata. Apɔmuden ho dwumadie a egyina sukuu mu anaa mpɔtam hɔ apɔmuden asoɛeɛ a wɔde STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ma mmabun kwa anaa ɛho ka sua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwahosan ho adesua nhyehyɛe no ne ɔman ne amanaman ntam gyinapɛn, akwankyerɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ nea ɛfa nnipa ho, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ho no hyia?
answer_twi_source: Nna ne awo akwahosan ho adesua nhyehyɛe no botae ne sɛ ɛne ɔman ne amanaman ntam gyinapɛn, akwankyerɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ nea ɛfa nnipa hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ho no bɛyɛ pɛ. Saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, na egyina adanse so ma asuafo no so dua. Adesua nhyehyɛe no betumi afa nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ Amanaman Nkabom no Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botae ahorow, Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde no akwankyerɛ a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho, ne ɔman mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nhomasua ne akwahosan ho so. Ɛnam gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ a wodi so no so no, adesua nhyehyɛe no hyɛ nea ɛkɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛyɛ papa, ne akontaabu ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ama me nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne ahotosoɔ a mewɔ wɔ nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti a me ne afoforɔ bɛbɔ mu no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa ne nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma wo nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ ne ahotosoɔ a wowɔ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti a wo ne afoforɔ bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ no mu atu mpɔn. Eyinom bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ website, nhoma, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne nna mu akwahosan so, atipɛnfo mmoa akuo anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne afotuo adwuma a sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ kuo ahorow de ma. Mpaninfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nso betumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama wɔ wo nkitahodie ho nimdeɛ ne ahotoso a wobenya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bedi asisifo ho dwuma, na hokwan bɛn na mewɔ sɛ obi a wɔayɛ no ayayade?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bedi ayayade ho dwuma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Saa mmara yi gu ahorow wɔ mmeae ahorow nanso mpɛn pii no ɛka nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ ayayade ho amanneɛ na wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besiw ano a wɔde bedi dwuma ho. Sɛ́ obi a wɔayɛ no basabasa no, wowɔ hokwan sɛ wunya ahobammɔ, mmoa, na wode wo ho gye mu. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu hokwan ahorow a wowɔ na wohwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa atumfoɔ a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ wuhyia ayayade a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wɔagye din, wɔn a wɔwɔ tumi, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nya mmebun suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaa ahosan ho so nsunsuanso, na asɛyɛde bɛn na wɔwɔ wɔ nkrasɛm pa ne nhwɛsode a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔagye din, wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so betumi anya mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaa ahosan ho so nsunsuanso kɛse. Mmebun pii hwɛ nnipa yi sɛ nhwɛsofo na ebia wobesuasua wɔn nneyɛe ne wɔn suban. Sɛnea ɛte no, nnipa a wɔagye din ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔhyɛ nkrasɛm pa ne nhwɛso a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran. Ɛdenam wɔn nhyiam ase a wɔde bedi dwuma de akamfo nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ananmusifo a obiara ka ho, ne obu a wɔde ma nneɛma ahorow kyerɛ so no, saa ankorankoro yi betumi adi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ ɔkwan pa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na mmabun betumi ayɛ de akamfo sɛ wɔmfa STI/HIV ano a wɔsiw ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nka akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ anaa akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi: Wɔakamfo nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a edi wɔn ahiade ahorow ho dwuma. Kɔka mmabun afotufoɔ bagua, akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, anaa atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho na ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛseɛ, akyɛ wɔn suahunu, na wɔanya gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ. Wo ne nhyehyeɛyɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ nni nkitaho na ama nkurɔfoɔ ate hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔhwɛ ɔhwɛ a wɔaka abom na wɔkamfo sika, nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ mmoa. Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu, sohyial media dwumadi, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow mu de hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuran, kasa tia animtiaabu, na ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi ho no nyɛ nea ɛfata. Kyɛ wɔn nsɛm, wɔn adwene, ne nyansahyɛ ahorow denam baguam kasa mu nkitahodie, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛmbisa, ne abasɛm a wɔka ho nhyiamu so de kanyan nsakraeɛ na wɔboaboa mmoa ano ma STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔaka abom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu na wɔahu mmeae a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, te sɛ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae "community centers", ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, a ɛde ahobammɔ, nea ɛka obiara ho, ne kokoamsɛm di kan ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ "sexual violence" mu ne wɔn ayɔnkofo no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ "safe spaces" denam sɛnea mmeae yi de ahobammɔ, obiara a wɔbɛka ho, ne kokoamsɛm di kan a wɔbɛhwɛ so. Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ beaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ no bi ne nhyehyɛeɛ a emu da hɔ a ɛtia ɔhaw ne nyiyim, adwumayɛfoɔ anaa atuhoamafoɔ "volunteers" a wɔatete wɔn a wɔte nka wɔ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahiadeɛ ho, ne nneɛma a wɔtumi nya a wɔde bɛboa na wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛwɔ kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe, "moderation" nhyehyɛe, ne atipɛnfo mmoa ntam nkitahodi nso betumi ayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ ayɔnkofo no sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn ho na wɔakyɛ osuahu ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din "anonymously" sɛ wɔpɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusu ahotoso ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ intanɛt so nsɛm ho denam: Ɔkyerɛwfo no ahwehwɛde ne ne nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so. Da a wɔde tintim nhoma no mu nhwehwɛmu ne sɛ ebia nsɛm no yɛ nea ɛyɛ foforo na egyina nhwehwɛmu ne adanse a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren so anaa. Fibea no din a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware ne sɛ ebia ɛne ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din wɔ abusuabɔ anaa. Nsɛm a wɔde gyina hɔ ma nsɛm a wɔde fibea ahorow pii di dwuma de hwɛ hu sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so. Sɛ́ wobɛhwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ animhwɛ anaasɛ ɛyɛ nwonwa ne nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ mu ansa na woagye atom sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ dwumadi ne nnwuma a ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ adetɔfo a wɔyɛ katee, adebɔfo, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ digitl bere yi mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de saa nimdeɛ yi adi dwuma wɔ wɔn asetra mu nneɛma ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ dwumadi ne nnwuma a ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ adetɔfo a wɔyɛ katee, adebɔfo, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ dijitaal ahunmu denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyiam ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, ne intanɛt so adesua ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ ahokokwaw te sɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nhwehwɛmu, dijitaal abakɔsɛm a wɔka, ne abrabɔ pa ho nkitahodi mu. Wɔn a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma a ɛdi asetena mu nsɛm ho dwuma, ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu, na ɛhyɛ nnipa ne osuahu ahodoɔ ho gyinabea pa ho nkuran. Digitals nnwinnade ne platform ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ multimedia nsɛm, podcasts, documentaries, ne ɔsatu ahorow a ɛma nkurɔfo hu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ na ɛkamfo asetra mu nsakrae. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ wɔn asetena mu nneɛma ahorow mu, a sukuu nnwuma, mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma, dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi, ne ankorankoro abusuabɔ ka ho, de ahyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom, tema, ne ɔman ba a asɛyɛde wom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi afa nkitahodi akwan horow te sɛ telefon so frɛ, text message, Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ, anaa mobile apps so anya telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so ne telefon a wɔde boa wɔn na ama wɔatumi ayɛ nea wɔpɛ ne ahotɔ dodow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa telefon so, nsɛm a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm, intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ (YMK app wɔ Google Play Store), anaa mobile app ahorow so akɔ telefon a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so ne telefon so. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ wubetumi apaw ɔkwan a wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo kɛse na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma wo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne afoforo anya ahyepa a ɛfata wɔ me nipadua ho?
answer_twi_source: Ahye a ɛfata a wubenya no kyerɛ sɛ wubehu honam fam nsa a wode bɛka wo ho tɔ wo ne nea wonyɛ. Afotu bi ni: Ka wo ho pefee: Susuw sɛnea woka wo ho a ɛyɛ wo dɛ ne nea ɛnte nka no ho. Ka ;ahye ho asɛm: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ "dabi" wɔ atuu, atuu, anaa biribi foforo biara a wode bɛka wo ho a ɛma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ no ho. Wubetumi aka nsɛm te sɛ: "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ saa asɛm no ho." "Mesrɛ wo, yebetumi agyae?" "Mepɛ sɛ meyɛ atuu/high five/wave kɛkɛ." "Me nipadua yɛ me dea, na minya kwan si nea ɛbɛto no ho gyinae." Bu afoforo ahye: Bisa kwan ansa na wode wo nsa aka obi foforo, na tie wɔn nipadua kasa. Sɛ ɛte sɛ nea wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ a, gyae wo nsa a wode bɛka wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmarima ne mmea ntam gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu ka nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a mmeawa ne mmarimaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so nya no so nkɛntɛnso, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so ahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ saa beae yi?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu taa nya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a mmeawa ne mmarimaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so nya no so nkɛntɛnso. Wɔ aman pii mu no, mmeawa bɛtumi ahyia amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛde ofie nnwuma di kan sen nhomasua anaasɛ ɛto adwuma a wobetumi apaw ano hye. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, mmarimaa bɛtumi ahyia nhyɛso sɛ wobedi mfuw anaa adwumayɛ akwan a wɔtaa yɛ no akyi. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ anya nkɔso wɔ saa beae yi no, akwan horow no bɛtumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a ɛyɛ pɛ a mmarima ne mmea nyinaa mfa ho, akasa atia nsusuwii hunu denam nhomasua ne nhumu ɔsatu ahorow so, afotu ne nhwɛsode ahorow a wɔde bɛma de ada adwuma ahorow a wobetumi apaw adi, ne tebea horow a ɛboa a ɛbɛma mmabun tumi adi wɔn anigye ne wɔn talente akyi a wonni anohyeto ahorow a egyina mmarima ne mmea so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ahorow wɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya GBV no na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm? (kokoamnsɛm mmara, adansefo ahobammɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma woanya ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm: Ahintasɛm ho Mmara: Nsɛm a wo ne adwumayɛfo binom (te sɛ nnuruyɛfo anaa wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa) kyɛ no taa yɛ kokoamsɛm. Adansefo Ahobammɔ: Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, mmara kwan so nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔabɔ adansefo hoban afi aweredi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu nya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom na mmara mma ho kwan a mmabun nya no so nsunsuanso? (ehu, aniwu, ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa) .
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu betumi ama ayɛ den ama mmabun sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan: Ehu: Suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛbrɛ wɔn aniwu no betumi asiw mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ano. Aniwu: Sɛ wote aniwu nka a, ebetumi ama ayɛ den sɛ wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di bɛkasa afa akwan horow a wubetumi afa so ho. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ Mmoa: Animtiaabu betumi ama adwene mu ayɛ naa na ama ayɛ den sɛ wobenya nsɛm anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wotumi de ho to so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so de wɔ ho hwɛ na wokura atinka fam yiyedi mu bere a wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi betumi akyerɛ suban, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho. Dwene w’ankasa wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho, na susuw sɛnea ɛne amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ hyia ho. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di wɔ w’amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mpɔtam hɔ a wobetumi de nhumu ne mmoa ama. Kae sɛ ɛyɛ yie sɛ wobɛma amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidie ne ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne nea wopɛ ahyia denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee, nhomasua, ne wo ho a wobɛdwennwen so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ di wɔ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne ahotoso a obi nya wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye,  mpɔtam hɔ nneyɛeɛ, ne ne ho a ɔde bɛtoto afoforo ho (social comparisons) a mfoni ne nra mfonini ahorow a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo nkitahodie mmeaeɛ na ɛhyɛ mu no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne ahotoso a obi nya mu denam: Nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee ne nsusuwii a wɔde susuw nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm ho a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran na ama atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye ne asetra mu ntotoho a wɔyɛ no so atew. Tumi ne ahofadi ho adwene a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso de akasa atia ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo de kɔ so tra hɔ no. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran sɛ adwinnade a wɔde kyekye tumi a wɔde gyina nkɛntɛnso ahorow a epira ano na wonya wɔn ho adwene pa a egyina nokware ne wɔn ho a wogye tom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na animtiaabu ne nyiyim ka ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nnwuma, ne mmoa, na akwansidie bɛn na wohyia wɔ ɔhwɛ a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne nyiyim tumi ha ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nnwuma, ne mmoa kɛse. Suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, wɔbɛpow wɔn, anaa basabasayɛ betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ, na ama wɔakyɛ wɔ hwehwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ nnwuma a ɛho hia te sɛ nyinsɛn ho nnuro, STI nhwehwɛmu, anaa ɔhwɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho no mu. Nneyɛe a ɛyɛ nyiyim wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne nnwuma a wɔpow, ayaresa mu animtiabuo, anaa kokoamsɛm a wobu so no ma akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ mu no yɛ kɛse bio, ɛma ahotoso a wɔwɔ wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo mu no sɛe, ma mmabun mmpɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ, na ɛma nsonsonoe kɔ so wɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuanso mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan pa ahorow bɛn na wɔbɛfa so akasa ama dɛmdiefoɔ anya akwannya ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ a Wɔkamfo: Wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmara a ɛbɔ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm akwannya ahorow ho ban, a wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ka ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ ɔsatuo a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nhyiamu de ahyɛ mmubuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn bɛka ho no ho nkuran na wɔakasa atia nyiyim. Grassroots Organizing: Yɛ mmoa nkitahodi ahorow na wɔma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm tumi ma wɔkasa am wɔn ho ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ mmabun a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hokwan ne asɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hokwan ne asɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu. Wobetumi: Wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn hokwan ahorow, pene a wɔpene so, ne kokoamsɛm ho nsɛm ka ho ama. Fa adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, anaa mmoa akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow so ma. Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne mmara ho abenfo nyɛ adwuma bom de nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware ma. Yɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wobebisa nsɛm na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa. Kamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun ne obu a wɔde ma kokoam nsɛm ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔhaw bɛn na mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ dɛm bi wɔ wɔn nipadua mu no hyia berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa wɔn bɔbeasu ne mna ne mmarima ntam abusuabɔ (sexuality) ho firi wɔn awofoɔ anaa wɔn abusuafoɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhaw ahorow a awofoɔ anaa abusuafoɔ hyia wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho:Nteaseɛ a Ɛnyɛ Mmerɛ (Discomfort with the Topic): Awofoɔ anaa abusuafoɔ bɛtumi ate nka sɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho (sexuality) yɛ den anaa ɛnyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛka ho asɛm, a ɛfiri amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidie ho.Amanneɛbɔ a Ɛnnɔɔso (Lack of Awareness): Abusuafoɔ bɛtumi anya nsɛm anaa nteaseɛ a ɛnnɔɔso fa nna mu nsɛm ne dɛm a obi wɔ ho.Suro ne Nsusuieeɛ Bɔne (Fear and Stereotypes): Nneɛma a nnipa taa fom dwene fa dɛm ne nna ho (misconceptions) bɛtumi ama suro ne atemmuo aba abusua no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono adwuma hokwan ahorow ma mmaabun a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ adwuma a ɛnyɛ mmara kwan so anaasɛ ɛnyɛ den mu bere a wɔde toto wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ho no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono adwuma hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔwɔ adwuma a ɛnyɛ ɔkwan biara so anaa nea asiane nnim mu de toto wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma a ɛnyɛ den ho wɔ akwan horow pii so: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ: Mmabun a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so no betumi anya mfaso afi mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a emu yɛ den mu, a akatua a ɛba fam ho mmara, akatua a wɔde yɛ adwuma boro so, ne adwumam ahobammɔ ho mmara ahorow ka ho, a ebia ɛremfa adwuma nhyehyɛe a ɛnyɛ ɔkwan biara so anaa nea asiane nnim ho. Mfaso ne hokwan ahorow: Adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ adwumaden no taa nya mfaso horow te sɛ apomoden ho insurance, akwamma a wotua ho ka, ne pɛnhyenkɔ nhyehyɛe, bere a ebia mmabun a wɔyɛ adwuma a ɛnyɛ ɔkwan pa so no rennya mfaso horow yi. Gyinabea ne ahobammɔ: Adwuma a wɔyɛ wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so no ma wotumi gyina pintinn kɛse, adwuma mu ahobammɔ, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya adwuma mu nkɔso bere a wɔde toto adwuma a ɛnyɛ nea wɔahyɛ da ayɛ anaa nea asiane nnim ho, a ebia ɛbɛyɛ bere tiaa mu de, entumi nnyina pintinn, na enni anidaso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo mmonnaa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔn wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ afoforɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsa a wɔnom ne nnubɔne ma obi yɛ mmerɛw no ne sɛ wɔde nneɛma bi di dwuma de ma obi ntumi nyɛ adwuma anaasɛ ɛsɛe sɛnea obetumi ako atia na w'abɔ ne ho ban afi nna mu nneyɛe a ɔmpɛ ho. Saa nneyɛ bɔne yi de nnadaa kwan so ma obi nom nsa anaa nnuro bɔne. Victims no rentumi nkae anaasɛ nte nea esiɛ yie esiane nnuro no nkɛntɛnso nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ada yie wo berɛ merebu mensa?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ fa berɛ a wode bɛda ho, Te deɛ wohwɛ so, ma wo dan mu nyɛ nwunu na emu nyɛ sum, kwati caffeine, na sɔ akwan a wɔfa so gye w’ahome te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa kenkan ansa na woada.Di wo mpa so nni na to wo mpa yie.Gyae sɛ wonom nsuo pii ne nnuane a emu duro wɔ berɛ worebɛda no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔntu bɛn na mmabun betumi atu ɛde adi animtiaabu anaa aniwu a ɛbata adwene mu apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ ho no so nkonim?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu anaa aniwu a ɛbata adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ ho a wobedi so no betumi ayɛ den, nanso anammɔn bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi atu de adi saa nkate ahorow yi ho dwuma. Wobetumi afi ase denam wɔn ho ne afoforo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn adwene mu apomoden yare ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a wɔbɛkasa atia so. Ebetumi aboa nso sɛ wo ne wo nnamfo, abusua mufo, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di bɛka adwene mu apomoden ho asɛm pefee de atew nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho ne aniwu so. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi adwene mu apomoden ho adwumayɛfo anaa akuw a wɔboa hɔ no betumi ama woagye atom na woahyɛ nkuran. Kae sɛ mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no yɛ ahoɔden ho sɛnkyerɛnne, na obiara fata mmoa bere a ohyia nsɛnnennen no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri nea broni ka no 'comprehensive sexuality education' (CSE) nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun anya tumi a wɔde besisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa Nkɔso: Honam ne nkate mu nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu a wɔbɛte ase. Abusuabɔ: Abusuabɔ pa, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne pene a wɔpene so a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Nna mu Akwahosan: Nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI a wosiw ano, ne awo nipadua ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛma. Ɔmanfoɔ Nsɛm a Ɛfa Ho: Bɔbeasuo gyinapɛn, LGBTQ+ hokwan ahodoɔ, ne amammerɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ nna mu a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma nyamesom ahorow ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne biakoyɛ de di nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a wɔkyɛ ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ asetena mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan "social justice and human rights" ahorow ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow a ɛho hia wɔ hɔ ma nyamesom ahorow ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne biakoyɛ de di nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a wɔkyɛ ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ asetra mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan ahorow ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Nyamesom ahorow ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboaboa nyamesom akannifo, nhomanimfo, wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden, ne mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow abom ahwehwɛ gyinapɛn ahorow, nnyinasosɛm ahorow, ne abrabɔ pa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbom yɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne biakoyɛ so no, nyamesom ahorow akuw betumi ayɛ adwuma de akasa atia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne nneyɛe a epira "harmful practices" wɔ nyamesom akuw mu, bere a wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛsan nso gyina hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nhomasua a edi mũ so. Nyamesom ahorow ntam mmɔdenbɔ betumi ama wɔanya ntease, tema, ne biakoyɛ wɔ nyamesom mu mpaapaemu nyinaa mu, na ama wɔanya aman a wɔka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho no so ba mmabun so mfaso?
answer_twi_source: Nkabom a wɔde nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa bɔ apɔwmuden nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa ho no de mmoa pii ba mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) asetena mu.Nea ɛdi kan, ɛma wɔn kwan ma wonya apɔwmuden mmoa ahorow pii a ɛboro nna mu apɔwmuden nko ara so; yei bi ne banbɔ ayaresa, adwene mu mmoa, ne ayaresa a wɔde ma nyarewa afoforɔ. Saa nkabom nhyehyɛeɛ yi di mmaayewa ahiadeɛ ahorow ho dwuma na ɛhyɛ wɔn apɔwmuden ne wɔn yiedie nyinaa mu den.Bio nso, nkabom mmoa yi bɛtumi atew aniwu a ɛtaa bata nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa hwehwɛ ho no so. Ɛma nnipa hu sɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ho hwɛ yɛ apɔwmuden nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛda hɔ mmerɛ biara no fa bi, na yei hyɛ mmaayewa nkuran sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa a ɛhia a wonni mmaa mmienu biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne nneɛma a ɛkanyan wɔn a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia wɔde wɔn ani kyerɛ ɔhaw bi, na anammɔn bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ de wɔn ho gye mu na wɔde wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no di dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ Nsɛnkyerɛnne ne Nneɛma a ɛkanyan a wobehu: Mmabun betumi ahu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa nneɛma a ɛkanyan wɔn a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia wɔde wɔn ani kyerɛ ɔhaw bi denam nsakrae a ɛba wɔn adwene, nneyɛe, anaa nsusuwii te sɛ nnamfo/abusua a wɔbɛkwati, a wɔrennya anigye wɔ dwumadi ahorow a na wɔn ani gye ho kan no so. Wɔbetumi de wɔn ho agye mu na wɔde wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no adi dwuma denam akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano a wɔde bedi dwuma, wɔn nsa a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa, ne mmoa a wobenya afi animdefo mu bere a ɛho hia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi ɔmanfo nhyɛso ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Afotuo bi a ɛfa sɛdeɛ wobɛdi ɔmanfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ a ɛfa nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho no ho dwuma nie: 1. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho: Sua ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho adeɛ na ama woate aseɛ yie sɛ ɔkwan baako biara nni hɔ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho. 2. Fa nnipa a wɔboa wo twa wo ho hyia: Hwehwɛ ankorankoro kuo bi a wobu wo na wogye wo tom sɛnea woyɛ, a ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow mfa ho. 3. Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Fa ahye sisi hɔ ne nnipa a ebia wɔbɛhyɛ wo ma woayɛ nea ɛne atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi anaa akwanhwɛ ahorow hyia. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi na wogyina w’ankasa akyi. 4. Fa wo ho hwɛ: Hwɛ wo ho wɔ adwene ne nipadua mu denam dwumadi ahorow a ɛbɛma w’ani agye na wo ho atɔ wo wɔ w’ankasa wo honam ani a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. 5. Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ: Sɛ ɔmanfo nhyɛso ahorow de ahoyeraw kɛse reba a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ ayaresa anaa afotu a ɛbɛboa ma woafa akwan so na woagyina ɔhaw yi ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde mmoa telefon so taa de ma, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi, a telefon so telefon so nkitahodi nhyehyɛe, Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ akwan, nea aborɔ ka no 'text message', ne ankorankoro mmoa ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ahokyere mmoa nhama taa de nnwuma ahodoɔ ma de boa ankorankoro a wɔwɔ ahokyere mu, a nkateɛ mu mmoa, ahokyere mu dwumadie, ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ, nsɛm ne wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma te sɛ afotuo dwumadie, ayaresa, mmara mu mmoa, ne mmoa akuo ka ho. Mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi denam mmoa telefon nɔma a wɔbɛfrɛ, intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ kwan a ɛwɔ wɔn wɛbsaet no a wɔde bedi dwuma, nkrasɛm a wɔde bɛmena mmoa telefon nɔma a wɔakyerɛ no so, anaasɛ sɛ ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ a wɔbɛkɔ mmoa beae a wɔnantew-ba 'a aborɔfo ka no 'walk-in center' no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na intanɛt so nimdeɛ di wɔ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nna mu akwahosan, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nimdeɛ boa wo ma wohwɛ sɛnea wogye wɛbsaet, nsɛm, ne akwahosan ho nsɛm di dwuma. Na hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae pii a wotumi de ho to so no yɛ nokware ansa na woagye atom sɛ ɛyɛ nokware. Nteaseɛ a ɛfa animhwɛ ho: Hu animhwɛ wɔ intanɛt so nsɛm mu na hwehwɛ adwene ahodoɔ. Hwehwɛ mmeae a agye din te sɛ akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow, aban wɛbsaet ahorow, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow na woanya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware. Intanɛt so nimdeɛ boa wo ma wokwati sɛ wobɛhwe ase wɔ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho.  Nya nsusuwii a ɛyɛ den a wode begye nsɛm a wubehu wɔ Intanɛt so no ho kyim na woahwehwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu yareɛ yɛfrɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba a ɛsɛ sɛ mmebun yɛ ho nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu yareɛ yɛfrɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba a ɛsɛ sɛ mmebun susuw ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwehwɛmu no bi ne nna mu yarewa yɛfrɛ  wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  chlamydia, akisikuru, akisikuru, HIV, ne human papillomavirus (HPV). Saa Nna mu yarewa ahorow yi abu so wɔ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu, titiriw mmabun ne mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadu mpanyin afe so mu, na sɛ wɔansa a, ebetumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba. Wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ saa STI ahorow yi mu nhwehwɛmu sɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ daa no fã na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobehu ntɛm na wɔasa wɔn yare ntɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bosome-buo nsuo no dodoɔ aa ɛyɛ nea broni bɛkasɛ 'normal' tesɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsesa (pii/kakra). Etumi sesa bosome biara. Ɛnkyɛ nntra nna awotwe. Kasa kyerɛ dɔkota sɛ wusuro a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo hwɛ hu sɛ wɔn nhwehwɛmu akwan no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun gyinapɛn ne wɔn gyidi ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmufoɔ hwɛ sɛ wɔn nhwehwɛmu akwan no yɛ amammerɛ mu nkateɛ na ɛkyerɛ obuo ma mmabun gyinapɛn ne wɔn gyidie denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hyɛ nkɔsoɔ mu a wɔbɛyɛ de ate amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn, gyidie, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwaahosan ho ase wɔ mpɔtam a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so no mu. Wɔn a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, amammerɛ ho abenfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no bɛyɛ adwuma abom de kasa, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, ne akwan a ɛfata amammerɛ ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu nneɛma ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Nhwehwɛmu akwan ne akwan horow a wɔbɛsakra no ma ayɛ nea ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔkyerɛ obu ma amammerɛ mu adwene ahorow, a wɔkwati nsusuwii ne nsusuwii hunu a ebetumi ama animhwɛ anaa ɔhaw akɔ so. Abrabɔ pa ho nhwehwɛmu bagua no taa hwɛ nhwehwɛmu ho nyansahyɛ ahorow mu hwɛ hu sɛ nhwehwɛmu akwan no yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛrempira ɔbabun no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wɔde telefon a wɔde boa wɔ ɔhaw mu wɔ hɔ 24/7, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya telefon a wɔde asi hɔ so titiriw sɛ wɔde bɛboa victims wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ wɔn mantam anaa wɔn man mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mpɛn pii no, wɔde telefon a wɔde boa ɔhaw ahorow wɔ hɔ 24/7 de boa ankorankoro a wɔwɔ ɔhaw mu ntɛm ara, a victims ka ho. Mmabun betumi anya mmoa nhama a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛboa victims wɔ wɔn mantam anaa ɔman mu denam nsɛm atitiriw te sɛ "nna mu basabasayɛ ho telefon," "mmonnaato ho haw beae," anaa "mmoa a wɔde ma victims". Wobetumi nso akɔ mpɔtam hɔ akuo ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu ahorow, anaa afotubea ahorow nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ nsɛm na wɔde wɔn akɔ mmoa nhama a ɛfata so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma mmabun de nyansahyɛ anaa nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔatu mpɔn wɔ ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no mu a egyina wɔn suahunu so?
