answer_twi_source: Yiw, dwumadi no betumi: Abisa mmuae denam akwan a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ te sɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so so. Ma mmabun hokwan ahorow ma wɔnsom wɔ afotu bagua anaa boayikuo ahorow mu. Hyɛ nkitahodi tee a wɔne dwumadi no mu adwumayɛfo nni ho nkuran denam nyansahyɛ nnaka anaa mmuae a wɔde ma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ ahorow bɛn na wɔde ka mmea ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aboa mmabun awo akwahosan ne yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Mmaa ayarehwɛ mmoa (Gynecological services) a wɔde ma mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ taa fa nneɛma yi ho:Ɔkyere ne Ahotew ho Hwɛ (Menstrual Health Management): Nkɔmɔdie a ɛfa ɔhaw ahorow te sɛ ɔkyere a ɛmma pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛyaw a ɛba mmerɛ a obi kɔ ne nsa so, ne ahotew ho nneyɛeɛ mmerɛ a obi kɔ ne nsa so.Nyinsɛn ho Afotu ne Banbɔ Nnuru (Contraceptive Counseling and Services): Amanneɛbɔ ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya banbɔ nnuru ahorow de akwati nyinsɛn a anyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ.Nna mu Nyarewa (STI) Nhwehwɛmu ne Ayaresa: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hwehwɛ nna mu nyarewa ne ayaresa a wɔde ma sɛ wohu yareɛ bi a.Awoɔ Dan mu Nhwehwɛmu (Pelvic Exams and Pap Smears): Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ mmaa awoɔ dan mu (Pelvic exams) ne "Pap smears" de hwehwɛ kansa a ɛba awoɔ dan ano ne nna mu apɔwmuden mu ɔhaw afoforɔ.Nna mu Apɔwmuden Nteteeɛ (Reproductive Health Education): Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwankyerɛ a emu dɔ a wɔde ma fa nipadua mu akwaa, nna mu apɔwmuden, ne asetena pa a obi bɛpaw ho.Saa mmoa yi boa mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ nna mu apɔwmuden ne wɔn yiedie denam ɔhaw ahorow a wohu no ntɛm so. Ɛma wɔn tumi si gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom fa wɔn nna mu apɔwmuden ho, na ɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwɛ wɔn mmaa apɔwmuden (gynecological wellness) so yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ m’awofo ani nnye nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ a, mɛyɛ dɛn afi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase?
answer_twi_source: Fi ase  wɔ ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wobɛka w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi ho asɛm pefee na woadi nokware adi, na ma wɔn awerɛhyem sɛ wubu wɔn akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a wode ma no sɛ ɛsom bo no so fi ase. Sɛ ɛte sɛ nea wɔtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase a, wubetumi de nsɛmti a ɛkɔ akyiri te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere anaa abusuabɔ afi ase ansa na wode nkakrankakra akɔ nsɛmti pɔtee te sɛ STI ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atosɛm 'myth' anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm a wɔtaa ka fa nna mu akwahosan ' sexual health' ho nhwehwɛmu ho no bi ne: Atosɛm: "Nnipa a wɔwɔ yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne nkutoo na wohia nhwehwɛmu." Nokwasɛm: Mpɛn pii no, Nna mu nyarewa 'STI's nni sɛnkyerɛnne biara, enti wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu mma nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu nyinaa. Atosɛm: "Sɛ wosɔ wo hwɛ a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ woyɛ ɔbrasɛefo." Nokwasɛm: Sɔhwɛ a obi bɛyɛ no yɛ asɛyɛde na ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata a ɛma obi hwɛ n’akwahosan. Atosɛm: "Screenings yɛ yaw na ɛyɛ aniwu." Nokwasɛm: Mpɛn pii no, wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu ntɛmntɛm, na wɔtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔhwɛ ma ahotɔ ne kokoamsɛm. Wobetumi adi saa anansesɛm ahorow yi ho dwuma denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, denam ɔmanfo ɔsatu ahorow so, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ wɔn bere a wɔapaw wɔn no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔkamfo hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu? (Awofo a Wɔayɛ Nhyehyɛe, NARAL Pro-Choice America)
answer_twi_source: Mariestope Ghana, PPAG, Ghana Akwahosan Dwumadibea kamfo nyinsɛn a woyi gu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia na wɔde abɔ wɔn ho ban afi nna mu yarewa ( STI ne HIV ) ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom kyerɛ nneyɛe ne ahwɛyiye a wɔyɛ bere a wɔreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa de tew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne mmoawa a wɔko tia nyarewa (HIV) so. Nea ɛka ho ne akwanside akwan te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde bedi dwuma, wɔbɛto wɔn a wɔne wɔn bɛda no dodow ano hye, wɔyɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu daa sɛ ebia wɔwɔ STI ne HIV, na wɔne wɔn ahokafo di nkitaho pefee wɔ nna mu akwaahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ wim tebea ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban na wɔahyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ wim tebea ho adeyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn SRH hokwan ahorow ho ban na wɔama anya nkɔso mu denam nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nsɛm a ɛfa wim tebea ho mu, mpɔtam hɔ ahotew ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ, ne SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka wim tebea ho nsɛm ho ɔsatu ahorow ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya akwan pa a mede begyina ano de adi adwennwen ne dadwen ho dwuma wɔ me da biara da asetra mu? (akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, adwene mu apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ woayɛ basaa a, ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata, nanso akwan a ɛfata a wobɛfa so agyina ano no betumi aboa wo ma woadi ho dwuma: Akwan a wobɛfa so agye w’ahome: Ahomegye a emu dɔ, ntini a wode bɛhome nkakrankakra, ne adwennwen betumi ama w’adwene ne wo nipadua adwo. Adwene mu apɔmtene: Adwene mu nneyɛe te sɛ wo home anaa mprempren bere a wode w’adwene besi so no betumi aboa ma adwennwen ne dadwen so atew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne intanɛt ne abɛfoɔ kwan so ayaresa ho nneɛma, na ɛwan kwan so na eyi bɛtumi aboa wɔ babaso ne HIV ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ho ban bɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛte ne mfiridwuma so apɔmuden ho nneɛma kyerɛ wɛbsait (websites), tɛlifono so nhyehyɛeɛ (apps), ne mfiridwuma afoforɔ a ɛma yɛnya nsɛm, akwan, ne ɔsom pa a ɛfa ayaresɛm ho, a nna mu nyarewa (STI/HIV) ho banbɔ ne ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ka ho. Saa nneɛma yi tumi boa nam: Saa nneɛma yi betumi aboa denam: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ foforo a ɛfa STIs, HIV, ne nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho a wɔbɛma akɔ soro. Nnwinnade a wɔde di nkitaho, nsɛmmisa, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛma de ahyɛ ntease ne nimdeɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw STI/HIV ano ho nkuran. Intanɛt so afotuo, mmoa akuo, ne telefon so ayaresa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro a wɔrehwehwɛ kokoam mmoa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ho. Nkitahodi ne adwumayɛ a ɛbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nhwehwɛmufo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ntam de akyɛ nimdeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde besiw STI/HIV ano ne nkyerɛkyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɔ mmabun ho ban fi nyiyimu a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, aman pii wɔ mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun ho ban fi nyiyimu a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so wɔ tebea horow mu, a nhomasua, adwumayɛ, apomoden ho nhyehyɛe, ne ɔman nnwuma ka ho. Saa mmara yi betumi abara nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna anaa nsɛm a wɔka so na ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne nyiyimu a wɔnyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ m’awofo anaa m’abusua mufo foa me bɔbeasu ne nna mu nipasu so sɛ ɔbabun a wadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Wotie wo haw ne nsemmisa a ɛfa nna ho no yiye a wonni atɛn. Wɔkyerɛ obu ma hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wohwehwɛ wo nna mu wɔ w’ankasa wo nsɛm mu. Na wɔboa wo ma wunya nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne dɛmdi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu yarewa (STIs), na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛbetumi aka awo nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔtaa frɛ Nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu sɛ Nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu. Wɔyɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so nya. Nsunsuanso a Enya wɔ Awo Nhyehyɛe So: Yare a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Chlamydia: Ebetumi de yare a ɛma obi ho hyehye no (PID), na ɛma obi ntumi nwo. Babaso (Gonorrhea): Asane a ɛte sɛ chlamydia, a ɛka awo akwaa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ cervix, uterus, ne fallopian tubes. Yare a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ HPV (Human Papillomavirus): Ebetumi ama ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu akisikuru ne awotwaa mu kokoram aba. Yare a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛHerpes: Ɛde akuru a ɛyɛ yaw ba, sɛ ɛtrɛw kɔ awo akwaa mu a, ebetumi aka awo. HIV/AIDS: Ɛma nipadua no mu tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa no yɛ mmerɛw, wotumi di ho dwuma nanso enni aduru biara, ɛka akwaahosan nyinaa na ebetumi anya bi wɔ nna mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu afotufo, adwene ne nneyɛe ho animdefo, ne asetra mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ adwenemyare a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne afotu adwuma a wɔde ma asuafo no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu afotufoɔ, adwene ne nneyɛeɛ ho animdefoɔ, ne asetena mu adwumayɛfoɔ di dwuma titire wɔ adwenemyareɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ne afotuo dwumadie a wɔde ma asuafoɔ denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ de ahunu asuafoɔ adwenemyareɛ ahiadeɛ na wɔayɛ mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho. Ankorankoro afotu nhyiam ahorow a wɔde bɛma de adi nkate, suban, anaa adesua mu haw ahorow ho dwuma. Kuw afotu anaa mmoa akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si nsɛmti pɔtee te sɛ adwennwen ano aduru, asetra mu nimdeɛ, anaa awerɛhow mmoa so a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, ne nnwumakuo a ɛwɔ abɔnten a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ mmoa dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri ama asuafoɔ no ho nhyehyɛeɛ. Ɔhaw mu dwumadie ne adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa a ɛdi kan a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ a wɔrehyia ahoyeraw a emu yɛ den anaa ɔhaw tebea. Asuafoɔ, awofoɔ, ne sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn adwenemyareɛ ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa ne ayaresa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aboa mmabun ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ama wɔasua sɛnea wiem nsakraeɛ ka nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ne deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ betumi de nneɛma ahodoɔ adi dwuma de ate sɛnea wiem nsakraeɛ ka nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ase. Ebi ne akwankyerɛ a efi nwumakuo te sɛ deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu no wɔtwa no tia sɛ 'WHO' ne 'UNICEF', nteteeɛ nneɛma a ɛfa sɛnea wɔma apɔmuden mmoa wɔ dwoodwoo mu berɛ a wiem tebea yɛ den anaa asane aba, ne nneɛma a wɔde siesie wɔn ho ma ahokyerɛ berɛ. Nhwehwɛmu amanneɛbɔ nso wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wiem nsakraeɛ, te sɛ nsuo a ɛtɔ kɛse, ɔpɛ, anaa fĩ, betumi aka apɔmuden, na ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a sika wɔ hɔ a wɔde boa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa mpɔtam ma wɔtena apɔmuden mu berɛ a nsakraeɛ yi rekɔ so mpo. Nneɛma yi boa ma wɔhwɛ sɛ mmabun betumi anya mmoa ne boa a wɔhia, mfa ho ne asetena mu haw biara a wɔbɛhyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow, te sɛ United Nations agencies, di wɔ wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛku a wɔyɛ ma ASRH no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔhyehyɛ mmɔdenbɔ ahorow wɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam akuo ahorow te sɛ United Nations Populatio Fund (UNFPA), World Health Organization (WHO), ne United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) di dwuma titiriw wɔ wiase nyinaa fekubɔ a wɔde ma ASRH no mu. Wɔde mfiridwuma ho mmoa, sika, nkitahodi akwan, ne nhyiamu ne nkitahodiɛ kwan ma, hwɛ sɛ nhyiamu ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛwɔ wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no mmɔdenbɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu dwumadi ne nsɛm a wɔka de hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran mu de ahyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ papa ho nkuran wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ankorɛankorɛ asɛm a wɔka: Ka wo suahunu a ɛfa mmaninyɛ ne mmaa-yɛ akwahosan ne ho kwan ho asɛm kyerɛ nnipa de ma wɔanya nimdeɛ, na kã nneɛma a nkurɔfoɔ ka a ɛnyɛ nokware no gu.Nnwuma ne nkrataa a wɔyɛ: Yɛ nneɛma na kyekyɛ nkitahodie mfidie so nsɛm a ɛde nimdeɛ pa, ne nea ɛka obiara bɔ mu, ne nea ɛhyɛ mmaninyɛ ne mmaayɛ ho nkuran ba pɛpɛɛpɛ.Akwan ahorow a wɔde bɔ ho dawuro mu kyɛfa: Di kan anaa kɔka nneyɛeɛ pa ho mmoa akuo (advocacy campaigns) ho na kanyan nkitahodie mfidie ne mmara-hyɛfoɔ ama wɔayɛ nsɛm a ɛfa akwahosan ho yie.Sesei nkitahodie mfidie (Social media) a wɔde di dwuma: Fa Facebook, TikTok, Instagram ne nea ɛkekaho di dwuma de ma nnipa nne so, kyekyɛ nimdeɛ mmoa nkrataa mu, na hwehwɛ nsakyeraeɛ pa wɔ sɛnea nkitahodie mfidie ka mmaninyɛ ne mmaayɛ ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na tumi a wɔde ma denam kyɛfa a wonya so kyerɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Tumi a wɔde ma denam kyɛfa a wonya so kyerɛ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi ne nneyɛe a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho denneennen mu. Ɛfa wɔn hokwan ahorow, wɔn dwumadibea, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛe, ne nnwuma a ɛka wɔn a wɔbɛhyehyɛ mu a wobegye atum.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔhyehyɛ dwumadie betumi ahwɛ sɛ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden dwumadie bu na ɛfa amammerɛ mu gyidie ne amanneɛ ahorow?
answer_twi_source: ɛnam mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛkasa, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ nteteeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ ama adwumayɛfoɔ, dwumadie nneɛma ne akwan a wɔbɛsakra no, ne nkabom a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akuo bɛyɛ na wɔahwɛ na wɔasusu sɛnea nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛka nkurɔfoɔ no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun di wɔn nne bɛko atia 'gender norms' (ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam gyinapɛn ahorow) bɔne wɔ adwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Speaking out: Kasa tia nyiyimu. Modeling behavior: Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa. Educating others: Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo. Advocating: Ko ma pɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ. Using platforms: Fa intanɛt ne wo kwan so yɛ kasa ma nkorɔfo (advocacy).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka hia a ɛho hia sɛ wohu wo ho mmɔbɔ na sɛ wohu sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ a, wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa ho asɛm.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wohu sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ a, da ayamye adi kyerɛ wo ho: Ɛnyɛ wo mfomso: nna mu yareɛ ahorow si, na ɛnkyerɛ wo ase. Fa w’adwene si ayaresa so: Sɛ wobɛsa wo yare a, ɛno ne ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so akɔ w’anim. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Wo ne w’adasa ama a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso, w’abusua muni, mmabun apomoden ho ɔyaresafo, ɔfotufo bi a ɔwɔ YMK app no so, anaa ahomotrofo  so ɔfotufo nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn sɛ mete nka sɛ wɔrehyɛ me ma made me ho ahyɛ nna mu nneyɛeɛ a mempɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Tie wo 'instincts' (wo mu nne): Fa w'apɔwmuden di kan.Si wo pɛ so dua/ Hyehyɛ 'boundaries': Kasa pefee kyerɛ wo nnamfo fa deɛ wopɛ ne deɛ wompɛ ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Kasa kyerɛ panyin a wogye no di (awofoɔ/akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ). Hu wo hokwan: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wosisi gyinaeɛ fa wo nipadua ho a obiara nnhyɛ wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwannya  ne ɔhaw bɛn na ɛbata sikasɛm nhyehyɛe foforo, te sɛ asetra mu nsunsuanso nkitahodie anaa sikasɛm a egyina nea efi mu ba so, a wɔde boa mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH)  nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow: Sikasɛm akwan foforo te sɛ asetra mu nsunsuanso nkitahodie anaa sikasɛm a egyina nea efi mu ba so no betumi akanyan ma wɔanya nea wobetumi asusuw wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH) nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Wɔtwetwe ankorankoro sika a wɔde bɛto mu, wɔde sika a wɔde di dwuma, na wɔhyɛ akontaabu ho nkuran denam sikasɛm a wɔde bata nhyehyɛe no adwumayɛ ho no so. ɔhaw: Saa akwan yi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ den a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma so na wɔde susuw nneɛma ho na ama wɔatumi asusuw nea ebefi mu aba no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ebia wɔde nea ebefi mu aba bere tiaa mu a wobetumi akyerɛ dodow adi kan sen bere tenten mu nkɛntɛnso ne nea ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa. Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma a ɛyɛ den ne nnwuma ho ka kɛse nso betumi de ɔhaw aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa adwumayɛbea ahorow no yɛ kokoamsɛm dɛn, na nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de abɔ kokoam nsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa adwumayɛbea ahorow de kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm di kan de bɔ ankorankoro akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛho hia ho ban. Mmara kwan so no, ɛyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asɛyɛde sɛ wɔde ayarefo ho nsɛm sie, na wɔayɛ nneɛma te sɛ ankorankoro sɔhwɛ dan ne aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma de abɔ kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Bio nso, mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔsrɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa wɔ kokoam a wɔn awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nna mu atinka a emu yɛ den di wɔ nna mu anigye ne abotɔyam a wonya mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso Fapem: Nna mu atinka wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ma ahotoso ne abusuabɔ ba ahokafo ntam, na ɛma nna mu osuahu ahorow yɛ kɛse. Sɛ obi te nka sɛ ɔbɛn wo ho wɔ atinka fam a, ebetumi ama wayɛ mmerɛw kɛse na wabue n’ani bere a ɔne obi rebɛn no. Nkitahodi a Ɛkɔ Anim: Nkate fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ma nkitahodi a emu da hɔ a ɛfa akɔnnɔ, ahiade, ne ahye ho no nya nkɔso. Ahokafo betumi ate nea ɛkanyan wɔn ho wɔn ho anigye ne nea wɔpɛ ase yiye. Nkitahodi a emu dɔ: Nkitahodi a emu dɔ ma wonya abusuabɔ a emu dɔ sen honam fam nsa a wɔde ka obi, na ɛde nna mu nkitahodi a ɛma abotɔyam kɛse ba. Sɛ yɛte nka sɛ ɛne nkate mu abusuabɔ wɔ abusuabɔ a, ebetumi ama honam fam anigye ne abotɔyam ayɛ den. Mmoa a Wɔboa Wɔn Ho Wɔn Ho: Nkate fam a wɔbɛn wɔn ho wɔn ho no ma ahokafo tumi boa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nna mu nhwehwɛmu ne nyin mu. Sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔte wɔn ase na wogye wɔn tom a, ebetumi ama wɔanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi ada nna ho nsɛm adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na CSE nhyehyɛe dwuma betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nimdeɛ a wɔde benya nkitahodi ne gyinaesi a etu mpɔn wɔ abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow boa mmabun ma wonya nimdeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔatumi adi nkitaho ne gyinaesi a etu mpɔn wɔ abusuabɔ mu denam nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde kyerɛ sɛnea wɔka wɔn adwene, tie a wɔyɛ nnam, tema, ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ so. Wɔma hokwan ahorow ma dwumadi, adesua a egyina tebea horow so, ne kuo nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde sua nkitahodi ne gyinaesi wɔ abusuabɔ tebea ahorow mu. CSE nhyehyeɛ no si hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔbu wɔn ho wɔn ho, ahotosoɔ, ne nkitahodiɛ a ɛda adi pefee wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa mu so dua na ɛma akwan a wɔbɛfa so de ahyeɛ ato hɔ, adi ntawntawdie ho dwuma, na wɔapaw nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ ayɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihu sɛ me hokafo anaa m’ankasa meyɛ obi a ɔhyɛ obi so anaasɛ ɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ Nsɛnkyerɛnne no nsow: Hwɛ nneɛma te sɛ ahoɔyaw, wo a wobɛtew wo ho afi nnamfo ho, anaa gyinaesi ahorow a wobɛyɛ ama wo ho.Kasa penpen: Fa odwo ka nea ɛhaw wo ho asɛm kyerɛ wo hokafo a wunnye akyinnye.Fa Ahye Si Hɔ: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea wogye tom ne sɛnea wohwɛ kwan sɛ wɔne wo bedi no mu pefee.Nya Mmoa: Hwehwɛ afotu firi w’adamfo, w’abusua, anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ.Susuw Wo Ho Ho: Susuw w’ankasa nneyɛe ho na yɛ adwuma de sesa suban biara a ɛhyɛ wo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne mpɔtam hɔfo, nnwumadie ahorow, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo abom ayɛ adwuma de ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔfo, nnwumakuo ahorow, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ayɛ adwuma abom de ama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow anya nkɔso denam: Wɔne nnwumakuo ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu ahorow, ne nnwumakuw a wɔsom mmabun a wɔbɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛma wɔabɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban na wɔakyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma. Mpɔtam aban mpanyimfo, ananmusifo a wɔapaw wɔn, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho denam nhyiam ahorow, kurow no mu asa ahorow, ne ɔmanfo atiefo so de akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa ASRH hokwan ne nnwuma. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne ɔsatuo a ɛwɔ fam a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ase, aboaboa mmoa ano, na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Wɔbɛyɛ ayɔnkofa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔne mpɔtam akannifoɔ, nyamesom asoɛeɛ, ne amammerɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ abom de adi amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne nkateɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho ho dwuma. Mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwumayɛbea ne mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodi ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyekyɛ nsɛm, ahyɛ nsɛm a esisi ho nkuran, na wɔama nne ahorow a wɔkamfo ASRH kyerɛ no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔhaw ne nhyɛso bɛn na ɛwɔ amammerɛ mu atetesɛm ne nnɛyi gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no ntam, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi saa ntawntawdi ahorow yi ho dwuma de ahyɛ nkɔso a ɛfata ne yiyedi ho nkuran wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, ɔhaw ne nhyɛso sɔre wɔ amammerɛ mu atetesɛm ne nnɛyi gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no ntam. Sɛ nhwɛso no, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow bi betumi asiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ho ano anaasɛ ɛde ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow a emu yɛ den a ɛto ankorankoro ahofadi ne tumi a wɔde besi gyinae ano hye. Saa ntawntawdi ahorow yi betumi ama wɔanya aniwu, kokoamsɛmu, anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nsɛm ho, na ama ayɛ den ama mmerante ne mmabaa sɛ wobenya nsɛm ne mmoa a edi mu. Saa nhyɛso ahorow yi ho dwuma a wobedi no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ, mpɔtam hɔfo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu, na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wobesiw nsonsonoe a ɛda atetesɛm ne nnɛyi nneɛma ntam no ano. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma adwene ahorow na ɛde mmerante ne mmabaa yiyedi di kan a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi ayɛ adwuma de afa akwan a ahoɔden wom na ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ho ma adwene mu yiedi no ho nkuran.
answer_twi_source: W’adwene mu apomoden a wobɛhwɛ so no ho hia te sɛ wo nipadua apomoden a wobɛhwɛ so no ara pɛ. Fa dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wo ho tɔ wo na ɛtew adwennwen so di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wobenya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm afi nnurutɔnbea anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo hɔ a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ, na akwan foforo anaa nneɛma bɛn na wobetumi afa so ayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wobenya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm a, wobetumi asɔ ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ nnurutɔnbea foforo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo foforo nkyɛn. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ mmoa afi ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe, awo akwahosan ho nnwumakuo ahorow, anaa nhomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔde nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho ma no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ reyɛ bɔne (abusive)?
answer_twi_source: Suban a Wodi So (nea wohu/ɔhyɛ). Possessiveness (aniberesɛm). Ahunahuna (basabasayɛ/pira).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm ne dwumadie ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛnam intanɛt ne digyital akwahosan ho nneɛma so nya de siw nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa HIV ano?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt ne digyital akwahosan ho nneɛma a wɔde siw nna mu nyarewa "STI" anaa "HIV" ano de nsɛm ne dwumadie ahodoɔ ma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhomasua nsɛm, video, ne infographics a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nna mu nyarewa "STI", akwan a wɔfa so nya "HIV", akwan a wɔfa so siw ano, ne ayaresa a wɔbɛpaw. Nnwinnade ne akontaabu mfiri a wɔde susuw asiane ahorow ho, kyerɛ sɔhwɛ ho nyansahyɛ ahorow, na wodi nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe akyi. Intanɛt so nna mu nyarewa (STI) anaa "HIV" nhwehwɛmu dwumadie, baabi a ankorankoro bɛtumi akra nhwehwɛmu nneɛma, anya nea ɛfiri mu ba, na wɔanya afotuo ne mmoa wɔ akyirikyiri. "Chatbots" anaa "virtual assistants" a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa obi ankasa ho, afotu, ne referrals a egyina ankorankoro ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ so ma. Mobile applications a wɔde di nna mu akwahosan akyi, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, ɔhokafo amanneɛbɔ, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa (STI) anaa HIV ano a wosiw ne ne di ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodie ne nhomasua dwumadi ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din anaasɛ wɔde sie sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ baguam?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɔtam hɔfo nea broni ka no 'community outreach' ne nhomasua adwumayɛbea ahorow pii ma mmabun akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so anya mmoa a wɔmmɔ wɔn din anaasɛ wɔ kokoam sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa pefee a. Ebia eyi bi ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔmmɔ wɔn din, Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadibea ahorow, anaa mmeae a mmabun betumi anya nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa a wɔrenka wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm adi. Mpɛn pii no, wɔyɛ kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow de bɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ho ban na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde wɔn nsɛm sie gye sɛ asiane bi wɔ hɔ sɛ wobepira anaasɛ mmara hwehwɛ sɛ wɔda no adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi anya abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma sɛ ɔbabun, na dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ kwan wɔ awoɔ nhyehyɛe ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a Wobɛnya: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ: Kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ te sɛ oduruyɛfoɔ, ɔyarehwɛfoɔ, anaa ayaresabea a wɔn ho akokwa wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu. Ahintasɛm: Nnwuma yɛ kokoamsɛm, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo ho nsɛm yɛ kokoam nsɛm wɔ wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo no ntam. Awofoɔ Mpene: Ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara so no, ebia worenhia awofoɔ pene wɔ abusua nhyehyɛeɛ ho dwumadie mu. Akwanhwɛ: Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no bɛka wo nna ho abakɔsɛm, wo abusuabɔ tebea, ne nea wopɛ ho asɛm. Nneɛma a wubetumi apaw: Wubesua akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ awoɔ nhyehyɛe, sɛnea etu mpɔn, mfaso a ɛwɔ so, ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba ho ade. Gyinaesi: Wo ne nea ɔde mmoa ma no bɛbom agyina w’ahiade so asi ɔkwan a ɛfata sen biara ho gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a mmabun betumi afa so de wɔn suahu ahorow adi dwuma yiye wɔ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu na wɔama wɔn adesua ne nkɔso hokwan ahorow ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn suahu ahorow adi dwuma yiye wɔ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu denam: Botae ahorow a emu da hɔ a wɔde besisi hɔ: Adesua botae pɔtee ne adwumayɛ botae ahorow a wɔde besi hɔ no betumi aboa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma wɔde wɔn adwene asi wɔn mmɔdenbɔ so na wɔadi wɔn nkɔso akyi wɔ nhyehyɛe no nyinaa mu. Nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ne akwankyerɛ: Sɛ wɔde nsiyɛ hwehwɛ nsɛm fi adwuma so ahwɛfo, afotufo, ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo hɔ a, ebetumi aboa wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma wɔahu mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso na wɔama wɔn adesua hokwan ahorow ayɛ kɛse. Nkitahodi a wɔbɛma: Sɛ wo ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo, nnwuma mu adwumayɛfo, ne afotufo di nkitaho a, ebetumi atrɛw wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no adwumayɛfo nkitahodi mu na ama wɔanya nhumu a ɛsom bo wɔ adwumayɛ akwan ne hokwan ahorow ho. Nneɛma a wodi kan yɛ: Tuhoama a wode bɛma nnwuma a emu yɛ den, adesua hokwan foforo a wobɛhwehwɛ, ne adwumayɛ ho su a emu yɛ den a wobɛda no adi no betumi ada wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nimdeɛ ne wɔn nhyehyɛe adi akyerɛ adwumawuranom. Osuahu ahorow a wobesusuw ho: Sɛ wosusuw nkonimdi, nsɛnnennen, ne asuade ahorow a wɔanya ho a, ebetumi ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ wɔn ahoɔden, mmerɛwyɛ, ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wonya nkɔso no mu ayɛ den, na ama wɔahu wɔn daakye adwuma ho gyinaesi ne wɔn apɛde ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ankasa ne adwenemyare, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma yiyedi ?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan kyerɛ yɛn atenka, adwene, ne asetra mu yiyedi. Ɛfa sɛnea yesusuw nneɛma ho, te nka, na yɛyɛ yɛn ade ho. Adwene mu akwahosan pa ma yetumi gyina asetra mu nhyɛso ahorow ano, nya nyɔnko nkitahodi  papa, na yɛboa ɔmanfo. Ɛho hia ma yiyedi nyinaa efisɛ ɛka sɛnea yedi adwennwen ho dwuma, ne afoforo di nkitaho, na yɛpaw nneɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyehyɛe anaa akwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛhwɛ sɛ kokoam kɔmputa so nkitahodi (sɛ nhwɛso no, nea aborɔfo fre no 'text message', intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ) di dwuma wɔ nea aborɔfo fre no 'crisis intervention' ne mmoa mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, Nea aborɔfo fre no 'Data' ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana no yɛ nhyehyɛe ma saa. Ahokyere mu dwumadie ne mmoa dwumadie binom a wɔde nea aborɔfo fre no 'telcos' di dwuma no de nea aborɔfo fre no 'data' ahobanbɔ mmara no mu nsɛm di dwuma. Ebia nea ɛka eyi ho ne nea aborɔfo fre no 'encryption, platform' ahorow a ahobammɔ wom, ne akwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ katee de bɔ mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Bio nso, nea aborɔfo fre no 'electronic platform' ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow no ama adwumayɛfo a wɔho hia nkutoo ntumi nkɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea amammui adwene, amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe, ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow kyerɛ wɔ amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wogye tom na wɔde di dwuma wɔ aman ahorow so no so?
answer_twi_source: Amammui adwene, amammerɛ mu nsonsonoe, ne nyamesom mu gyidi betumi anya amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobegye atom na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ aman ahorow so no so nkɛntɛnso. Saa nneɛma yi betumi ama wɔagye nhyehyɛe ahorow atom na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan soronko so, na aka sɛnea mmabun nya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ne nnwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na CSE (Comprehensive Sexuality Education) di de bɔ wɔn a wɔresi sɔ nyimpadua anyin no mfonini pa ne wo ho a wobɛpɛ asetena mu?
answer_twi_source: CSE boa titire  ɛboa ma mmabun nya wɔn nipadua ho adwene pa ne wɔn ho a wɔde hyɛ wɔn ho (self-esteem), denam ahosiesie, obu, ne anisɔ a ɛfa nipadua ahorow ne sɛnea wɔte no ho. Ɛboa ma mmabun nya wɔn nipadua ho ntease pa, sɛnea wɔbɛsi atia ahoɔfɛ ho gyinapɛn a ɛnteɛ, na wɔakyekyere wɔn akoma atia amanneɛbɔ a ɛfiri ɔmanfoɔ mu a ɛnteɛ. CSE nhyehyɛeɛ hyɛ nipadua ho dwuma a wɔyɛ, nipadua ho adwene pa, ne mmɔborɔhunu ho nkuran, a ɛboa ma adwene ne atenka mu yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo intanɛt ahobammɔ ne dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho adesua wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ wɔ me mmarimabere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Fi Nkɔmmɔbɔ ase: Wo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu afotufo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akannifo nkasa fa hia a dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia ho. Nhyehyɛeɛ Nhyiamu: Wo ne mpaninfoɔ nyɛ adwuma hyehyɛ adwumayɛbea anaa nhyiamu a ɛfa intanɛt ahobanbɔ ne digyital akenkan ne akyerɛw ho. Yɛ nea broni ka no 'Awareness Campaigns': Yɛ ɔsatu ahorow a ɛbɛma nkurɔfo ate asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ intanɛt so ne nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho ase. Hyɛ Nneɛma a Wɔde Di Dwuma Ho Nkɔso: Fa nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ne intanɛt ahobammɔ ho ma w’atipɛnfo ne mpanyimfo. Kɔka Kuo anaa Akuo ho: Fa wo ho hyɛ akuo anaa akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si intanɛt so ahobanbɔ so mu na kamfo nkyerɛkyerɛ pii wɔ sukuu mu. Kasa: Sɛ wuhyia nneyɛe a ahobammɔ nnim wɔ Intanɛt so anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a, kasa na kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo. Fa nea broni ka no 'Social Media' Di Dwuma Ma Yiye: Fa social media platform ahorow di dwuma de kyɛ afotu ne nsɛm a ɛfa dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ho de aboa mmabun, ma wɔafa nneɛma pii a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so ne nea ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi de akwankyerɛ ama denam: Akwanhwɛ ne ahye a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ho, a bere anohyeto a wɔde bɛma wɔ screen so ne mmara a wɔde benya nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a obi adi ka ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu yiye na wonsusuw nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi anya wɔ wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne wɔn nneyɛe so no ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow a, wɔbɛbom ahwehwɛ mu, asusuw emu nsɛm ne nsɛmti ho, na wɔahu nhwɛso pa ne nkrasɛm ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene mu apɔwmuden mmoa (mental health services) bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun na nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda wɔn ntam?
answer_twi_source: Ebi ne: Kasakyerɛ ne afutusɛm 'Counseling/Therapy', aduru ma "Medication", Nkuo a ɛboa 'Support Groups', ne adwene mu apɔwmuden mmoa 'Psychiatric care'. Afutusɛm  betumi ayɛ wo nko ara, kuo, anaa abusua. Wɔyɛ wɔ sukuu, mpɔtam clinics, anaa ayaresabea.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo betumi ne amammerɛ ne nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a egyina adansedi so aka amammerɛ afahyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔfa so twa ho, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa benya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo betumi de amammerɛ ne nyamesom asoɛe ahorow ayɛ biako de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a egyina adanse so aka amammerɛ afahyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔfa so twa ho. Ɛnam sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ne mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di yɛ adwuma a, wɔbɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛnya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne mmoa wɔ saa nsɛm a ɛho hia yi mu. Ebia eyi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhyiam ahorow, anaa nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛmti atitiriw te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho asɛm bɛma. Ɛdenam nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛhyɛ amammerɛ mu so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi ama ntease kɛse, agye atom, na wɔama wɔn tumi wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na me nne resesa?
answer_twi_source: Wo nne resesa esiane nkwaadɔm 'hormones' a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu nti, titiriw 'testosterone' ma mmarimaa ne 'estrogen' ma mmeawa. Saa nkwaadɔm yi ma wo nne nhama (wo menewam afã horow a ɛwosow na ɛyɛ nnyigyei bere a worekasa) nyin na ɛyɛ den. Eyi ma wo nne mu dɔ na ɛho akokwaw. Ebia ɛtɔ mmere bi a ɛbɛpaapae anaasɛ ɛbɛyɛ te sɛ nea ɛyɛ gyegyeegye, nanso eyi yɛ ade a ɛfata na ɛtaa tra nne a emu dɔ mu bere a worekɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bedi nyiyim ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmaa so ho dwuma, na kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo mmara ahorow yi a wɔde bedi dwuma na wɔahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobanbɔ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bedi nyiyim ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmaa so ho dwuma, a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔabɔ ankorankoro ho ban afi ɔhaw ho. Eyinom bi ne mmara ahorow a ɛko tia nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna so wɔ adwumayɛ, nhomasua, ne ɔmanfo dabere mu, ne mmara a ɛfa nna mu ɔbrasɛe ne basabasayɛ ho. Mmabun betumi akamfo mmara yi a wɔde bedi dwuma ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma wɔate ase, nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ mpɔtam ne ɔman no mu, ne wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ dwumadi ne ɔsatu ahorow a ɛkasa tia nyiyim ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so no mu. Wobetumi nso aboa ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nnwuma a wɔreyɛ adwuma de ama mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ anya nkɔsoɔ na wɔama aban ne ahyehyɛdeɛ abu akontaa sɛ wɔdi nnipa hokwan gyinapɛn ahodoɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’atipɛnfo, m’awofo, anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ me no abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ho wɔ me mpanyin afe so?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wɔabue Mu: Fi ase bɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛkyerɛ obu fa abrabɔ pa ho nsɛmti te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, ahye, ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho. Atie a Wode Nsi: Tie afoforo adwene a wommu wɔn fɔ, na hyɛ wɔn nso den sɛ wɔnyɛ saa ara.. Bisa nsɛm na a ema woate adwene horow ase, na ɛno bɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛsi pi (anaa ɛma mpontu) akɔ so.. Fa Nhwɛsode Di Dwuma: Ka asetena mu nsɛm anaa mfatoho horow a ɛsisi mpafe de kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a ntease mu yɛ den mu, na monhwehwɛ akwan horow a yɛbɛfa so adi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwansidie ahorow bi a ɛmma temanmufoɔ mmfa wɔn ho nnhyɛ prevention programs mu ?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma de bɔ ɔmanfo ho ban no mu bi ne: Sika ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛboro so a ebetumi atwetwe nneɛma a wɔde bɔ ɔmanfo ho ban, titiriw wɔ mmeae a wonni sika pii mu. Nhyehyɛmu mu nsɛnnennen te sɛ amansɛm ho nhyehyɛe, nneɛma a ɛho hia paa a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde di dwuma, ne nhyehyɛe a ɛho nhia a ebetumi ama nnipa a wɔabobɔ wɔn ho mmɔden ne wɔn a wɔboa wɔn no ayɛ den. Stigma, animguase, ne nneyɛe a ɛma obi di fɔ a ebetumi ama victims ampɛ mmoa anaa wɔayi wɔn ho adi wɔ basabasayɛ ho, na ɛma ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wobedi stigma ho dwuma na na w'aboa victims yie.Wobɛtumi adi nsɛnnennen yi so nkonim denam fekubɔ ne apam a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔfã ne ɔfã ahorow nyinaa mu de atoto nneɛma ho, de abɔ mmɔdenbɔ ho dawuru, na ama obiara atumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛboa ama wɔayɛ amanyɔsɛm mu nsakrae, sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ ananmu, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛsi ananmu de asiw mmarato ho ban ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma, de asiw nsɛnnennen ne ntɛnkyea a ɛrekɔ so no ano. Nhomasua, nimdeɛ a wɔdi ho dwuma, ne amansɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔde ma nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ no. Ɛma wɔn tumi ma wotumi nya nkɔso; ɛma wotumi nya ahoɔden, wotumi yɛ adwuma yie. Ɛma wotumi yɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so, wonya wɔn ho adwempa, na wotumi de wɔn ho toto nneɛma ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, wɔn nsa bɛka wɔn botae no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea efi akatua mu nsonsonoe a egyina mmarima ne mmea so ba bere tenten wɔ mmabun sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ, adwuma mu abotɔyam, ne yiyedi nyinaa so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo betumi adi nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akatua mu nsonsonoe a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbeasu so no betumi anya nea ɛbɛkyɛ wɔ mmabun sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ, adwuma mu abotɔyam, ne yiyedi nyinaa so denam: Wɔn sika a wobetumi anya ne sikasɛm mu ahofadi a wɔbɛto ano hye wɔ wɔn nkwa nna mu no so. Ɛboa ma wɔte abasamtu, adwenemhaw, ne adwuma mu abotɔyam a wonni. Pɛyɛ a enni ahonyade a wɔboaboa ano, sika a wɔde sie bere a wɔakɔ pɛnhyen, ne nneɛma a wobenya mu a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse. Wɔn a wɔasiw wɔn kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn sika bɛto nhomasua, ntetee, anaa adwumayɛfo nkɔso hokwan ahorow mu. Wɔn ahotoso ne wɔn ho a wɔte nka sɛ wɔsom bo a wɔsɛe no, na ɛde adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen ne adwenemhaw ba wɔ tebea a enye koraa mu, owu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi anya ntentanfidie so nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwan a wɔfa so gyina dadwen ano ne ɔkwan a ankorankoro fa so boa ne ho de di dadwen ho dwuma na ɛma adwene mu yiedie tu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Aane, wubetumi anya ntentanfidie so nneɛma a ɛkyɛrɛ akwan a wɔfa so gyina dadwen ano ne ɔkwan a ankorankoro fa so boa ne ho de di dadwen ho dwuma na ɛma adwene mu yiedie tu mpɔn. Saa nneɛma yi bi ne: Ntentanfidie a ɛma nsɛm, hwɛtie, ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa dadwen sohwɛ, ahomegyeɛ akwan, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, ne adwene ne suban mu nsakraeɛ akwan a wɔfa so gyina dadwen ahodoɔ ano. Fon so dwumadie (apps) a ɛma akwankyerɛ wɔ adwene a wɔde si biribi so, ahome a wɔgye, apɔmu atenetene, ne dadwen so te akwan foforɔ a wɔbetumi anya berɛ biara, baabiara. Ntentanfidie so adesua anaa nhyiam a ɛkasa fa nsɛm te sɛ gyina a wɔbɛgyina pintinn, nkateɛ sohwɛ, asɛm siesie nimdeɛ, ne akokoduru nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛhyɛ tumi a wɔde gyina nneɛma ano den na wɔahyɛ adwene mu apɔmuden nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so susuw mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow ne wɔn nipasu ahorow ahiade ne osuahu ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so gye tom sɛ mmabun fi wɔn asetra mu, wɔn nipasu, ne osuahu ahorow a wɔde tra ase no gu ahorow, na wogye tom sɛ nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, dɛmdi, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea no twa wɔn ho hyia de kyerɛ sɛnea wobetumi anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho kwan ne osuahu ahorow. Ɛsi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔka obiara ho, amammerɛ mu atenka, ne mmuaeɛ a wɔde ma wɔ ahiadeɛ ne apɛdeɛ ahodoɔ ho so dua, hwɛ sɛ nnwuma, nsɛm, ne nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ nea wotumi nya, ɛfa ho, na ɛkyerɛ obuo ma mmabun nipasu ne wɔn tebea soronko.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asɛde bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wotua ka a ɛbata sikasɛm mu mmoa ahorow bi a wɔde ma wɔ nhomasua ne ntetee ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane, sikasɛm mu mmoa ahorow bi a wɔde ma wɔ nhomasua ne ntetee ho no betumi de asɛde ahorow a wɔde tua ho ka aba, te sɛ sukuufo bosea anaa adesua ho mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a nhomasua asoɛe ahorow anaa aban mpanyimfo de ma. Saa asɛde ahorow a ɛfa sikatua ho yi taa hwehwɛ sɛ wɔn a wogye sika no tua sika fam mmoa no, mpɛn pii no wɔde mfɛntom, bere a wɔawie wɔn nhomasua anaa ntetee nhyehyɛe no anaasɛ bere a wɔakɔ adwuma mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneyɛeɛ bɛn na ɛkyerɛ  nna mu basabasayɛ 'sexual violence'?
answer_twi_source: Ahooden a wɔde di dwuma. Hunahuna. Wɔde wo di dwuma bere a w'ani so tɔ wo. Nhyɛsoɔ ne awerɛto  'Revenge porn'. Tumi a wɔde di dwuma bɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfomso bɛn na nkurɔfo taa di berɛ a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano redi dwuma no, na mɛyɛ dɛn akwati?
answer_twi_source: Mfomso bi a nkurɔfo taa di bere a wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano redi dwuma no bi ne: Wɔde di dwuma a ɛnteɛ anaasɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma: Akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no a wonni akyi, te sɛ awo ano aduru dodow a wɔyera anaasɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so. Awo ano aduru a wɔde siw ano a wɔmfa nni dwuma: Wo werɛ fi sɛ wode nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔde siw ano (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm) bedi dwuma bere a ɛho hia, te sɛ bere a worefi awo ano aduru foforo ase anaasɛ sɛ ɔkwan bi di nkogu (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm a ɛpaapae). Nna a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobebu wɔn ani agu so: Akwan a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ne bere atwam te sɛ kɔndɔm anaa nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano a wɔde bedi dwuma, na ebetumi atew nea etu mpɔn no so. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na woakwati mfomso ahorow yi: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa ɔkwan a wobɛfa so asiw nyinsɛn ano a woapaw no a wode bedi dwuma yiye no ho, a sɛnea wode bedi dwuma bere nyinaa na etu mpɔn ka ho. Di akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no akyi yiye, na bisa w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa nnuruyɛfo sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo. Fa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, te sɛ kɔndɔm, di dwuma sɛnea ɛho hia na ama ayɛ adwuma yiye na wɔatew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ne STI ahorow mu no so. Hwɛ nna a w’akwan a wode siw nyinsɛn ano no twam daa na sesa sɛnea ɛho hia na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ etu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna ne nna mu nneyɛe ho bere a meresisi gyinae ahorow a ɛne m’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow hyia no?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu: Te amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ho no ase. Hu sɛnea saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi betumi anya wo gyidi ne gyinaesi ahorow so nsusuansoɔ. Nsusuwii a Ɛyɛ Katee: Bisa ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia no ho nsɛmmisa. Susuw sɛ ebia akwanhwɛ ahorow yi yɛ nea ɛfata anaasɛ epira. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Fa nnamfo ne w’atipɛnfo a wobu wo gyinapɛn ahorow no twa wo ho hyia. Wo ne mpɔtam anaa akuw a wɔwɔ gyidi koro no nni nkitaho. Nkitahodi a Wobue Mu: Wo ne wo hokafo nsusuw amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ahorow ho. Ka wo gyinapɛn ahorow ne sɛnea ɛka wo gyinaesi ahorow ho asɛm pefee. Ankorankoro Tumi: Kae sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ wopaw nneɛma a ɛte sɛ nea ɛfata wo. Wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow no yɛ nea ɛfata, a ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so nya abusuabɔ ne ahotoso a wonya wɔ abusuabɔ mu denam nkitahodi so wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Tie a Wode Nsi So: Kyerɛ anigye ankasa denam nea wɔreka a wode w’adwene besi so no so. Tema: Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte wɔn nkate ne wɔn adwene ase a wunni atɛn. Bue mu: Ka wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate ho asɛm wɔ nokwaredi mu na ama moanya ahotoso. Nsɛm a ɛkɔ so daa: Di bɔhyɛ ahorow akyi na yɛ nea wotumi de ho to so wɔ wo nkitahodi mu. Bu: Fa obu di afoforo, na sɛ wo ne wɔn adwene nhyia mpo a, gye wɔn adwene tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi anya ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya kokoam hwɛ, hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi wɔn ankasa akwahosan ho gyinae, ne ahobammɔ a wɔde ma fi nyiyim a egyina mfe a wɔadi anaa nneɛma afoforo so. Wɔtaa kyerɛkyerɛ saa hokwan ahorow yi mu wɔ mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ ɔman ne ɔmantam no mu, ne amanaman nyinaa nhyehyeɛ a wode di dwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano a wɔde hormone(nipadua mu nsuo) di dwuma (aduru, nkatabo, tuo) yɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: "Hormone" adutoɔ (Hormonal birth control) fa nnuru a ɛte sɛ nipadua mu nsuo (hormones) na ɛsi awoɔ kwan wɔ akwan ahodoɔ bi so:Mpaapaemu a ɛsiw kwan (Ovulation suppression): Saa akwan yi ma wo mmaa mu (ovaries) gyae kosua mpaapaemu bosome biara.Awoɔ baa mu nsuo a ɛyɛ den (Thickening cervical mucus): Eyi kyerɛ sɛ ɛma nsuo a ɛwɔ awoɔ baa no mu yɛ den na ama ayɛ den ama ɔbarima mu aba (sperm) sɛ ɛbɛduru ɔbaa kosua no ho.Awoɔ baa mu honam a ɛyɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ (Thinning the uterine lining): Eyi ma ɛyɛ den sɛ ɔbaa kosua a aba aka no bɛtumi akɔtena awoɔ baa no mu na anyini."Hormone" adutoɔ akwan ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana (Types in Ghana):Adutoɔ aduro (Birth control pills): Wɔnom no daa; ebi wɔ hɔ a "estrogen" ne "progestin" (nipadua mu nsuo) nyinaa wom, na ebi nso wɔ hɔ a baako pɛ na ɛwom.Adutoɔ nkatia (Patch): Wɔde tare honam ani nnawɔtwe biara, na ɛnam honam no so gyae nnuru no gu nipadua no mu.Adutoɔ nnua (Implants): Dua mmienu anaa baako a wɔde hyɛ nsa mu honam ase; ɛgyae nnuru a ɛma awoɔ baa mu nsuo yɛ den.Adutoɔ paneɛ (Injectables): Wɔwɔ paneɛ no wɔ nsa mu abasɛm so bosome mmiɛnsa biara; ɛgyae nnuru no nkakra-nkakra kɔ nipadua no mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrepere wɔ nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm anaasɛ obu a wonni ma wɔn ho no?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa adwuma ahorow wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔrepere wɔ nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm anaasɛ obu a wonni ma wɔn ho no. Eyinom betumi ayɛ afotu adwuma, mmoa akuw, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, nhoma ahorow a wɔde boa wɔn ho, nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow, ne adwumayɛbea anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho, nipadua mu nneɛma pa, ne adwenemyare ho nkɔso so. Mmabun betumi akɔ mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, sukuu afotufo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na ɛfa affirmative consent nhyehyɛeɛ, ɔsatuo, ne nnwuma a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ amammerɛ a ɛfa pene ne obuo ho wɔ sukuupɔn mu, wɔ adwumayɛbea, ne mpɔtam, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Affirmative consent nhyehyeɛ, ɔsatuo, ne nnwuma botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛma amammerɛ a ɛfa pene ne obuo ho wɔ sukuupɔn mu, wɔ adwumayɛbea, ne mpɔtam hɔ denam nkitahodiɛ a emu da hɔ, ɛyɛ anigyeɛ, na ɛkɔ so a ɛfa nna mu dwumadiɛ ne ahyeɛ ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne "Yiw Kyerɛ Yiw" nhyehyɛeɛ, ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu nhyehyɛeɛ, ne ɔsatuo a wɔde ma nkurɔfoɔ te a ɛkasa tia mmonnaato ho anansesɛm na ɛboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ saa mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi mu denam akuw a asuafo di anim a wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho, a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyiam anaa ntetee ahorow a wɔde pene so mu, nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, ne wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔbɛboa wɔn denam atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne wɔn a wɔko ma afoforonne ahyehyɛde ahorow afoforo ayɛ biako de anya nkɛntɛnso a emu yɛ den wɔ mmabun bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ne wɔn ho kwan (ASRR) ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no mu? (Nkitahodi, nkabom a wɔbɛkyekye) .
answer_twi_source: Nkabom adwumayɛ ma w’adwuma nsunsuansoɔ kɔ anim mpɛn pii! Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Nkitahodi: Wo ne mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa foforɔ a wɔko ma afoforo no nni nkitaho wɔ intanɛt so anaa ɛnam mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ so. Nkabom Kuo a Wobɛkyekyere: Wo ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm a ɛte saa ara ho nyɛ adwuma na ama wo nne ayɛ kɛseɛ na woadu wo ho. Nneɛma a Wɔde Bɛkyɛ: Sua biribi firi mo ho mo ho suahunu ne ahokokwaa mu na ama moahyɛ mo mmɔdenbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm a wɔka fa ho no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma so sen nyinsɛn a wosiw ano? (STI ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano akyi no, kɔndɔm nkutoo ne ɔkwan a ɛboa nso ma wosiw nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ano. STI yɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so trɛw. Kɔndɔm yɛ akwanside a ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya: Chlamydia Gonorrhea HIV HPV (human papillomavirus) STI afoforo so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: nsusuanso bɛn na atipɛnfo nhyɛso nya wɔ adwenemyare so bere tenten, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano no adi kan de abrɛ saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi ase?
answer_twi_source: Dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne obu a wonni yɛ kɛse. Ɔhaw a ɛkɔ so daa a ɛko tia akitahodie pa ne ankorankoro ahye. Wɔkɔ so de wɔn ho to abɔnten so adansedi ne nea ɛne ne ho hyia so, na ɛde ɔhaw ahorow ba wɔ wɔn ho a wɔbɛda no adi ne gyinaesi mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔabrɛ saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi ase no, mmabun betumi de wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano no adi kan denam: Akwahosan Ho Akwan a Wɔfa so De Agyina Ano a Wɔbɛma Anya: Nneɛma a wɔde gyina ano te sɛ adwene a wɔde gyina ano, adwennwen ano aduru, ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ so, nneyɛe a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de atew ɔhaw a atipɛnfo nhyɛso nya wɔ adwene mu yiyedi so no so. Mmoa Nkitahodi a Wobɛkyekye: Sika a wode bɛhyɛ nkitahodie a ɛboa mu ne nnamfo, abusuafo, ne afotufo a wɔde nkuranhyɛ, ntease, ne adansedi ma. Nkate mu Nyansa a Wobɛma Anya: Nkate mu nhumu, nhyehyɛe, ne tema a wɔbɛma akɔ anim de akyerɛ atipɛnfo nkitahodi na wɔadi nkate a emu yɛ den ho dwuma yiye. Adwumayɛfoɔ Mmoa a Wɔhwehwɛ: Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afiri adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa afotufoɔ hɔ sɛ atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ anaa adwenemyareɛ a ɛfa ho kɔ so anaasɛ ɛyɛ kɛseɛ bere kɔ so a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu fa ɔhwɛ a wɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo ho, a nhwehwɛmu, ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ka ho, na ama wɔatumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu sɛ ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo no befiri akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo daa wɔ nyinsɛn no bere mu. Nea ɛka ɔhwɛ yi ho ne akwahosan tebea ahorow te sɛ nyinsɛn mu asikreyare, HIV, ne awosu mu haw ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Sɔhwɛ ahorow te sɛ ultrasound hwɛ sɛnea akokoaa no nyin ne ne nyin. Ebia nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no bi ne vitamin ahorow a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban, ne akwahosan tebea biara a ɛba bere a wɔyem no a wobedi ho dwuma. Sɛ wokɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo nyinaa na woadi akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no afotu akyi a, ebetumi aboa ma woanya nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no, boa mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin mfe so a wɔsakra fi nhomasua mu kɔ adwumayɛ mu no?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu, sukuupɔn, ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee asoɛe ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam; nhomasua ne ntetee so denam mmarima ne mmea adwene a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛe ho, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne adesua akwan a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ akannifo ne gyinaesi mu no so. Wɔma mmeawa ne mmarimaa nya hokwan nya ahokokwaw, nimdeɛ, ne suban ahorow a ɛkasa tia mmarima ne mmea ho adwene a ɛnteɛ, hyɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ ho nkuran, na wosiesie wɔn ma wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwumayɛfo ne ɔmanfo mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sɛ wohwɛ w’akwahosan so ansa na woanyinsɛn a, ɛtew nyinsɛn mu asiane ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa tebea horow te sɛ asikreyare anaa mogya mmoroso a wobedi ho dwuma na woadi aduan pa a aduannuru a ɛho hia wom no betumi atew asiane ahorow so na aboa ɛna no ne abofra no nyinaa apomuden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ yɛka sɛ obi yɛ 'transgender'(Obi a ne su a ɔda no adi nhyia nipadua a wɔde woo no)anaa 'non-binary'(bi a ɔnhu ne ho sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima pɔtee anaa ɔbaa pɔtee) a, ɛkyerɛ sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Transgender: Obi a ɔde ne ho to ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a ɛsono ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde ama wɔn wɔ awo mu. Ebia wɔbɛpaw sɛ wɔbɛsakra wɔ aduruyɛ anaa asetra mu (edinnsiananmu a wɔsakra, ntade, ne nea ɛkeka ho) na wɔatra bɔbeasu a wɔte nka sɛ ɛfata wɔn mu. Non-binary: Obi a ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea nkutoo mu. Wɔn bɔbeasu ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ hɔ wɔ atetesɛm mu akuw ahorow no akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo akasa afa nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ 'STI anaa HIV' ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne wo hokafo bɛkasa afa sɛnea wobɛyɛ 'STI anaa HIV' ho nhwehwɛmu ho a, wobetumi de nokwaredi, tema, na woabue w’ani adi. Nneɛma bi a wubetumi ayɛ ni: Paw bere ne beae a ɛfata a mobɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a mo baanu nyinaa bɛte nka sɛ mo ho bɛtɔ mo na mo ho adwo mo. Fa "Me" nsɛm no da wo haw ne wo nkate adi a wommɔ wo hokafo no sobo anaasɛ wommɔ sobo. Fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔ 'STI ne HIV' ho, na si hia a ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi nyinaa ho so dua. Tie wo hokafo mmuae denneennen, si wɔn nkate horow so, na di nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ebia wɔwɔ ho dwuma. Ka sɛ wobɛka wo hokafo ho akɔ beae a wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo de akyerɛ mmoa ne biakoyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de awoɔ nhyehyɛe ahyɛ m’awo asetra nhyehyɛe ne daakye botae ahorow nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a Wobɛfa so De Awoɔ Nhyehyɛe Ka Ho: Dwennwen Botae Ho: Susuw wo nhomasua, adwuma a wopɛ sɛ woyɛ, ne w’ankasa botae ahorow ho. Di Kan Yɛ Nhyehyɛe: Hwɛ bere a wopɛ sɛ wufi abusua ase, anaa sɛ wopɛ sɛ wufi ase ne mma dodow a wopɛ. Nhwehwɛmu Akwan: Hwehwɛ abusua nhyehyɛe akwan horow mu na ama ɛne wo bere nhyehyɛe ne w’asetra kwan ahyia. Hwɛ Akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusuw wo nhyehyɛe ho na ama woanya afotu a ɛfata wo. Nea ɛho hia: Tumi a wɔde ma: Abusua nhyehyɛe ma wunya awo a wobɛpaw ne daakye so tumi. Akwahosan: Ɛboa w’akwahosan nyinaa denam nyinsɛn a woanhyɛ da a esiw ano ne awo a ɛda ntam no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nyamesom anaa gyidi so di wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun bere a wɔadu mpanyin afe so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Afotu Dwumadibea: Nyamesom ahyehyɛde kuo ahorow bi de afotu ma a mubetumi asusuw nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a ɛfa mmabunbere mu ho. Mmoa Akuo: Ebia akuo a egyina gyidie so benya mmoa akuo ama mmabun a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔn suahunu na wɔanya akwankyerɛ. Nhomasua a Egyina Gyinapɛn So: Ebia wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛma wɔ wɔn gyidi ahorow mu, na wɔasi gyinapɛn ne abrabɔ pa so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔde nkɔso a aba wɔ mfiridwuma ne dijitaal akwan horow mu no, redi dwuma de ama akwan a wɔfa so boaboa nsɛm ano no atu mpɔn na ama nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhwehwɛmu no ayɛ papa na ɛyɛ ne bere mu de?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔsoɔ a aba wɔ mfiridwuma ne digyital akwan mu no resakra nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nhwehwɛmu denam: Nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano a ɛbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ: Mobile health (mHealth) applications, intanɛt so nhwehwɛmu, ne social media platforms ma nhwehwɛmufoɔ tumi kɔ mmabun dodoɔ a wɔn ho gu ahodoɔ nkyɛn, boaboa nsɛm a ɛwɔ berɛ ankasa mu ano, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ akwan foforɔ so. Data yiedie a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn: Digitals nnwinnadeɛ ma nneɛma te sɛ skip logic, multimedia content, ne built-in validation checks a ɛma data no yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ɛtew mfomsoɔ ne animhwɛ so wɔ ASRH nhwehwɛmu mu. Nkyekyɛmu ne nimdeɛ a wɔde di dwuma a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ: Digitals platforms ma nhwehwɛmufoɔ tumi kyekyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no mu ntɛmntɛm, wɔduru wiase nyinaa atiefoɔ nkyɛn, na wɔde wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no de wɔn ho hyɛ nkitahodiɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nimdeɛ a wɔde sesa mu, na ɛma nhwehwɛmu nkyerɛaseɛ kɔ nneyɛeɛ mu ntɛmntɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm fi mmeae a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titiriw?
answer_twi_source: Aane, nsɛm a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titiriw no betumi aboa efisɛ wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi wo nsɛmmisa ne wo haw ahorow ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata wo mfe a woadi na ntease wom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi aboa me ma manya nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu nyarewa "STI" ano a wosiw, ne awo akwahosan "RH" ho nsɛmti afoforo ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmabun nya nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware fa nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu nyarewa "STI" ano aduru, ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmti foforɔ ho denam akwan ahodoɔ so: Nhomasua nhyiamu: Dwumadie no de nhyiamu ne nsɛm a wɔka fa awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛmti ahodoɔ ho ma, a akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, akwan a wɔfa so siw nna mu nyarewa (STI) ano, ne abusuabɔ pa ka ho. Nneɛma a wɔde kyekyɛ: Mpɛn pii no, nhyiam ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nhomawa ahorow, ne nhomawa ahorow a nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STIs, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne baabi a wobetumi anya awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho a wɔkyekyɛ. Afotu a wɔde ma obiara: Adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn ne atuhoamafo de afotu a wɔde sie ma a mmabun betumi abisa nsɛm, asusuw nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn ho, na wɔanya awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho. Nnwuma a wɔde kɔma nkurɔfo: Dwumadi ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no de mmabun bata akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ayaresabea ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma afoforo a wobetumi anya nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu, afotu, ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma mmoa akuo anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a broni ka no 'online communities' a ɛhyɛ abusuabɔ pa ne mmabun nkɔsoɔ pa (sɛ ɛfata a).
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii boa abusuabɔ pa ne mmabun nkɔso: Nea broni kasa mu no yɛka no 'Ghana Health Service Adolescent health programme', 'PPAG' mmeae, Marie stopes ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde afoforo a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. YMK app no wɔ nneɛma nso, kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no kɔhwehwɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ pii
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo mfidie 'digital technologies' boa wo nna nkyerɛkyerɛ 'sexual education' mu?
answer_twi_source: Accessibility: Internet ne abɛɛfo mfidie boa ma obiara tumi nya nimdeɛ wɔ baabiara. Privacy: Wubetumi asua adeɛ kokoam a wonsuro. Interactivity: Apps ne websites ma adesua yɛ dɛ. Examples: YMK, Planned Parenthood, ne Social Media campaigns.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa ma ahobammɔ adi bim ama me ne afoforɔ wɔ internet so?
answer_twi_source: Nya pɛ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a obuo ne nnidie wom, nkankan nea agyin nna mu akɔnnɔ, gender ne nkorɔfoɔ su ho 'identity'. Kasa tia nyiymu ne basabasayɛ ho. Ma kwan ma obia nkyerɛ n'adwen wo anidi kwan so. Ne afoforɔ nkyɛ  nimdiɛ mfa bammɔ ho. Wobetumi de reporting tools wɔ social media so atwe mpaninfo adwen asi obia ɔda suban bɔne bi adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na amammerɛ mu nkate ho hia wɔ ɔhaw mu dwumadie ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nkate ho hia efisɛ egye gyidi, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu no tom na ɛkyerɛ obu ma. Ɛhwɛ sɛ ɔhaw mu dwumadie ne mmoa dwumadie no fata, ɛkyerɛ obuo, na ɛtu mpɔn ma mmabun nyinaa, a wɔn amammerɛ mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne awoɔ dodoo nhyehyɛeɛ (family planning), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa (adolescents) dwene ho?
answer_twi_source: Abusua Nhyehyɛeɛ: Abusua nhyehyɛeɛ kyerɛ tumi a ankorankoro ne awarefoɔ tumi hwɛ mma dodoɔ a wɔpɛ kwan na wɔnya ne wɔn awoɔ ntam kwan ne berɛ a wɔbɛwo. Nea ɛho hia: Tumi a wɔde ma: Ɛma ankorankoro tumi pa sɛ ebia wɔbɛwo mma ne bere a wɔbɛwo, na ɛma wɔn tumi wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan mu. Akwahosan: Ɛhyɛ nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom ho nkuran, ne ɛnanom ne mmofra akwahosan nso, denam nyinsɛn ntam kwan a ɛfata a ɛma wotumi de di dwuma no so. Nhomasua ne Adwuma: Ɛma mmabun tumi di nhomasua ne adwuma ho botae ahorow akyi a awofoyɛ ho asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ntɛm ara no nka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo su ne animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho no betumi anya ɔpɛ a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa no so nsusuanso?
answer_twi_source: Ɔmanfo su ne animtiaabu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho no betumi de akwanside ahorow aba wɔ mmoa anaa mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Gyidi ahorow bi a wɔtaa gye di ne: Animtiaabu: Suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaa wɔayɛ nyiyim atia no esiane sɛ ɔwɔ adwenemyare bi nti. Aniwu: Aniwu a wobɛte nka sɛ wuhia mmoa wɔ adwenemyare ho. Ntease a ɛnteɛ: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wonni ho ntease anaasɛ wonnim no betumi ama wɔanya adwene a ɛnteɛ ne adwemmɔne. Sɛ wodi animtiaabu ho dwuma denam nhomasua so, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee, ne gye a wogye tom ne tema a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no betumi ahyɛ ankorankoro nkuran ma wɔahwehwɛ mmoa a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so de ahye 'bounddaries" sisi hɔ na wɔka pene a wɔpene "consent' so wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu, wɔ ano ne nea wɔmfa ano nka ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a etu mpɔn "eefective stategies" a wɔfa so de ahye sisi hɔ na wɔka pene a wɔpene so wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu no bi ne sɛ wobɛma wo ahye ne nea wopɛ ho asɛm a emu da hɔ na woayɛ pefee, wode nsiyɛ atie wo hokafo no nsɛnkyerɛnne ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɔde ano ka, na woabu wɔn ahye ne ahofadi. Fa nkitahodi a wɔde ano ka di dwuma fa kyerɛ sɛ wopene so anaasɛ wopow pefee, na tie nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa te sɛ nipadua mu kasa ne w’anim yɛbea. Obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ne nkitahodi a ɛkɔ so yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma wɔanya nna mu abusuabɔ a ɛfata na wɔpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no bɛkɔ so ayɛ nea obu wom na ɛnyɛ atɛn, sɛ ɛsono yɛn adwene mpo a?
answer_twi_source: Fa adwene a emu tew ne pɛ a wopɛ sɛ wotie afoforɔ adwene hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase, a wohmmu obiara atɛn. Fa kasa a ɛka obiara bom, ɛdi mu ni, na ɛnhyɛ mmoa kwan (non-confrontational) adi dwuma; fa w’adwene si nteaseɛ hwehwɛ so mmom, na mmɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛhyɛ obi ma w’agye w’adwene atom anaa wobɛdaadaa no ma w’asɛsa n’adwene.Suasua asotie pa (active listening). Yei kyerɛ sɛ wobɛfa w'adwene nyinaa asi asɛm no so, woagye afoforɔ nkateɛ atom, na woaka nea woate no mmuaeɛ de akyerɛ sɛ woate asɛm no ase yie. Gye tom sɛ sɛ ɛho hia a, wo ne wɔn adwene nhyia wɔ nsɛntitiriw bi ho, na hu sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubenya adwene ahorow bere tenten a nkɔmmɔbɔ no kɔ so yɛ nea obu ne nkɔso wom no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de ahyɛ biakoyɛ ne ayɔnkofa a wɔne akuw foforo a wɔkamfo asetra mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan ahorow kyerɛ no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ama biakoyɛ ne ayɔnkofa a wɔne akuw afoforo a wɔkamfo asetra mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan ahorow kyerɛ denam nsiyɛ a wobetie na wɔasua ade afi adwene ahorow mu, nhyɛso ahorow a ɛtwam a wobehu na wɔakasa atia, a wɔbɛboa nnipa dodow a wɔbom yɛ nneyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow, na wɔagyina biakoyɛ mu ne mpɔtamfo a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wɔreko ama awo mu atɛntrenee ne ahofadi no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi ama mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nyiyimu akɔ so wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidei ahorow bi betumi ama mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ akɔ so denam atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den no so. Saa gyidie ahorow yi betumi ama wɔayɛ nyiyimu, wɔnyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ, na wɔato ankorankoro hokwan ne hokwan ahorow a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu so anohyeto ahorow aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna ne awo ho akwaahosan ho nnwuma ne nsɛm fa amammerɛ ho na mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow betumi anya bi?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ nea ɛfata na wɔtumi nya bi wɔ: Mmabun amammerɛ, kasa, gyidie, ne nneyɛeɛ a wɔbɛte aseɛ na wɔabu wɔn berɛ a wɔde nnwuma anaa nsɛm rema no. Ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu a egye adwene, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneɛma ahorow a wɔpɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho tom na ɛma wogye tom. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, amammerɛ ho afotufo, ne nsɛm asekyerɛfo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de asiw kasa ne amammerɛ akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu no ano. Amammerɛ mu atenka nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛka adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ho de ama wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nimdeɛ ne wɔn nimdeɛ akɔ anim wɔ nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔbɛsom wɔn mu. Nhomasua nneɛma, mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn, ne afotu akwan a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de ada amammerɛ ahorow ne ahiade pɔtee a mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne dwumadi anaa nsɛm a esisi a sukuu ahorow hyehyɛ de ma nkurɔfo hu adwenemyare ho nsɛm na ɛtew animtiaabu so no bi?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow hyehyɛ dwumadi ahorow ne nhyiam ahorow de ma nkurɔfo hu adwenemyare ho nsɛm na ɛtew animtiaabu so. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ adapɛn anaa asram a asɛmti nhyiamu, nhyiamu, anaa ahɔhoɔ akasafoɔ ka ho. Nhyiam anaa nsɛm a wɔka fa nsɛmti te sɛ adwennwen ano aduru, wɔn ho a wɔhwɛ, ne nkate mu ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ho. Adwinni anaa adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho adwuma no twee adwene sii adwenemyare ho nsɛmti so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a atipɛnfo di anim anaasɛ akuw a wɔkyɛ ankorankoro osuahu ne nhumu a ɛfa adwenemyare ho. Amanneɛbɔ dan anaa nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho guasodeyɛ a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie ne mmoa a wɔpaw ho ma. Akwahosan nna anaa adwenemyare ahomegye a wɔde dwumadi ahorow a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ ahomegye ne yiyedi ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma wosiesie ntawantawadi yiye, te sɛ atie a wɔyɛ no nnam, tema "empathy", asɛm a wɔka no denneennen "assertiveness", ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, apam, ne nkitahodi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de saa ahokokwaw ahorow yi adi dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ asetra mu tebea horow ankasa mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma wotumi siesie ntawantawadi yiye no bi ne: Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ "active Listening": Wɔde wɔn adwene si nea afoforo reka so, bisa nsɛm a ɛma emu da hɔ, ne nsɛm a wɔka no foforo de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔte ase. Tema "empathy": Obi a ɔde ne ho to afoforo mpaboa mu, gye wɔn nkate tom, na ɔda ntease ne ayamhyehye adi. Asɛm a ɔka: Obi ankasa nsusuwii, nkate, ne ahiade a ɔde ahotoso ne obu da no adi, a ɔnyɛ hwee anaasɛ ɔnyɛ basabasa. Ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru: Afoforo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ahu nsɛm a ɛwɔ ase, de ano aduru a ebetumi aba, na wɔasusuw nea ebetumi aba ne nea ebefi mu aba ho. Nsiesiei: Mfinimfini kwan anaa ano aduru foforo a wɔbɛhwehwɛ a ɛfa afã horow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa anigye ho, sɛ mpo ɛrentumi nyɛ yiye mpo a. Nkitahodi: Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ayɛ apam anaa ntamgyinafo a wɔn baanu nyinaa gye tom a edi afã horow nyinaa ahiade ne wɔn anigye ho dwuma. Mmabun betumi de saa ahokokwaw ahorow yi adi dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ asetra mu nsɛm ankasa mu denam dwumadi ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, na wɔasusuw wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow ne wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo nkitahodi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na m'ani aba me ho so wɔ me nipadua a ɛresakra no ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtaa ba sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ wo ho yɛ wo den wɔ wo nipadua a ɛresakra no ho wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Wo nipadua no refa nsakrae atitiriw mu, na ebetumi agye bere ansa na woatumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ nsakrae ahorow yi mu. Nneɛma te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde nipadua mfonini kyerɛ, ntotoho a wɔde toto atipɛnfo ho, ne ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ nso betumi ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ho. Kae sɛ obiara fa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu wɔ n’ankasa ahoɔhare so, na nipadua ahorow ne ne kɛse gu ahorow. Ɛho hia sɛ wode w’adwene si wo ho a wobegye atom ne nipadua ho mfonini pa a wobɛkyekye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne awo akwahosan (SH) ho nsɛm anaa tebea horow a ɛtaa ba a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ mu Nsɛnnennen: Bere a ɛnkɔ so daa, mogya a ɛtɔ kɛse (menorrhagia), brayɛ a ɛyɛ yaw (dysmenorrhea). Nna mu Nyarewa (STIs): Chlamydia, pimples, HPV, akisikuru, HIV/AIDS. Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID): Nyarewa a ɛba awo akwaa mu, a mpɛn pii no efi STI ahorow a wɔansa no yare mu. Endometriosis: Ntini a ɛte sɛ awotwaa no mu nneɛma nyin wɔ awotwaa no akyi, na ɛde ɛyaw ba. Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS): Nkwammoaa a ɛnkari pɛ a ɛka ovulation ne brayɛ kyinhyia. Ntini mu Nyarewa: Varicocele (ntini a ɛtrɛw wɔ awotwaa mu), hydrocele (nsu a atwa awotwaa no ho ahyia).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhyehyɛe ahorow, ɔsatu ahorow, anaa akuw ahorow a edi mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ adwumam no bi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ɔsatu ahorow, anaa akuw ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran mu denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, nhyiam ahorow, anaa ɔsɔretia ahorow a akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ yɛ ho nhyehyɛe mu. Nnwuma te sɛ "Equal Pay Day" anaa "Amanaman Ntam Mmea Da" a wɔbɛboa de ama nkurɔfo ate akatua mu nsonsonoe ho asɛm. Kuw anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a sukuufo di anim a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu anaasɛ wofi ase a wɔde wɔn adwene sii mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne adwumayɛbea hokwan ahorow so. Wɔde wɔn nsa bɛhyɛ adesrɛ nkrataa ase, nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw kɔma nhyehyɛeyɛfo, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ intanɛt so dwumadi mu de boa mmara mu nsakrae. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa nnwumakuw a wɔbɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho ban wɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa ma akuo ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma awoɔ apɔmuden hokwan ahorow ama mmabun nyinaa no anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Kɔka adwumakuo ahorow ho: Fa wo ho hyɛ adwumakuo ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si awo akwaahosan akwannya ahorow so no mu. Pii wɔ mmabun ti anaa akwan a wɔfa so tu wɔn ho ma. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Kyerɛw nkrataa, de wo nsa hyɛ adesrɛ ase, na fa wo ho hyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a ɛkamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a wobenya mu. Kyerɛkyerɛ Afoforo: Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ wo mpɔtam anaa sukuu mu na ama nkurɔfo ate ase. Fa Social Media Di Dwuma: Kyɛ nsɛm, nsɛm, ne nneɛma a wode bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ social media platform ahorow so na ama woatumi akɔ nnipa pii nkyɛn. Kɔ Nhyiam Ahorow: Fa wo ho hyɛ nhyiam ahorow, nantew, anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow so no mu. Fa wo ho hyɛ Amanyɔsɛm mu: Kɔ so hu nhyehyɛe ne amammuifo gyinabea wɔ awo akwahosan ho, na fa wo nne kamfo nsakrae kyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodi mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aman pii wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ pɔtee sɛ wɔde bɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho, a mmara a ɛko tia nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ofie basabasayɛ, mmofra ayayade ka ho. Bio nso, ebia nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtamu hɔ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wobesiw nsɛm a ɛtete saa ano na wɔadi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobɛtumi ama nhwɛsoɔ a ɛyɛ pa a ɛfa dawurubɔ animdeifoɔ mpaemuka, anaa nnwuma a ɛpia nna mu apɔwmuden ho adesua, nipadua adwene pa ho, pene ho amammerɛ, ne nna ho adwene ho nna ne sɛnea wɔka bom di dawurubɔ ho nimdie ne ahoɔden ɛba wɔ a wɔresi sɔ no a sɛbi wadi dem?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadiɛ ahodoɔ ('Speechless'). Sini ('Everything, Everything'). Asraafoɔ ('The Ruday Project'). Boa mmaabun ma wɔhu wɔn ho nhwɛsoɔ/bɔ wɔn ho adwene pa. Kyerɛkyerɛ nnipa a wɔn endi dem. Sɛ yɛ pagya dawurubɔ nimdie wɔ asembisaa so fa nyinyimu ne nipa kasatia
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amanaman ntam sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ ɔman ASRH mmra nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwankyerɛ ahorow boa ma apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ den na mmoa dwumadie tu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ ɔman ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwankyerɛ mu hyɛ apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ den na ɛma mmoa dwumadie tu mpɔn denam nteaseɛ, adwuma a ɛyɛ yiye, ne mfasoɔ a ɛde bɛba so. Sɛ wɔboa ɔman nneɛma a ɛhia a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma ne mpɔtam hɔ tumi a wɔbɛhyɛ den na akye, amanaman ntam sika boa ma ASRH nsunsuansoɔ ne apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa tu mpɔn a ɛtena hɔ daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛbɔ mmaabun a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ yɛn man anaa yɛn mantam mu hokwan ahorow ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ adwumayɛfo a wonnii mfe aduonu ho ban no gu ahorow wɔ ɔman anaa ɔmantam biara mu nanso ɛtaa fa nneɛma te sɛ akatua a ɛba fam koraa, adwumayɛ bere, adwumayɛbea ahobammɔ, ne ahobammɔ a wɔbɔ fi nyiyimu ho. Wɔ yɛn man anaa mantam mu no, wobetumi de mmara te sɛ Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), a ɛde akatua a ɛba fam koraa, akatua a wɔde yɛ adwuma boro so, ne mmofra adwumayɛ ho gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛwɔ United States, anaa mmara a ɛte saa ara a ɛwɔ aman afoforo so abɔ mmabun ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ hwehwɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya saa nimdeɛ yi?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a ehia na wɔde asi gyinae a ɛfata na etu mpɔn wɔ sika a wɔde di dwuma ho. Wɔ mmabun fam no, sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wobenya no ho hia kɛse ma wɔn sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne sikasɛm mu yiyedi a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ. Ɛma wotumi de ahotoso di sikasɛm tebea ahorow mu, kwati afiri a ɛtaa ba te sɛ ɛka a wɔboaboa ano, na wosi gyinae pa wɔ sikakorabea, sika a wɔde bɛto mu, ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na nnamfo anaa adofoɔboafoɔ kuo bɛtumi afaso sɛ kwan ma nnafo kuo adesua ne nna ho nkeyane, ne awoɔ apomoden kasanhyehyei nsɛm ho, a nsɛmbisa ne nna mu nsɛm nso bɛka ho, de nsɛm pɔtee ne adwene bɔne akyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nnamfoɔ nkitahodie kuo tumi fa so yɛ adwuma mbea ma nnamfoɔ sua adeɛ, nteteɛ, ne tumi a wɔde ma nnipa wɔ nna mu ne awodeɛ ho apɔwmuden ho asɛmti ahodoɔ. Edianim wɔ  nhyehyɛ fa adesua ho nnwuma, ahɔhoɔ kasa, anaa nteteɛ ho dwuma a ɛfa SRH ho asɛmti ahodoɔ te sɛ awodeɛ ano nsisi, apene, ne STI a wɔde siw ano. Yedi anim wɔ nkɔmmɔ na yɛ kyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma fa SRH ho nsɛm ho.  Yɛko atia adwene bɔne denam nkɔmmɔbɔ so.
