Yɛka nkuranhyɛsɛm akyere yɛ amanfo se nam yɛ betumi aka ama SRH hokwan na yɛ eya ho kwan wɔ yɛn mpɔtamu, na ede kuru mu nsakyerayɛ bea ne bua nsuomu adwuma aba
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, adwumawuranom, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no, di hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee ho no so na wodi so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee ho no so na wɔabu wɔn nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ, akyerɛkyerɛfo, adwumawuranom, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nhomasua ho nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛe, ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wotumi nya bi ho asɛm. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmabun nhyiam ahorow, asuafo agyinatukuw ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow mu de aka wɔn haw ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee ho. Bio nso, wobetumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛhwɛ nnipa hokwan ahorow so de adi mmara so bu anaa akwanside biara a ɛwɔ hokwan a, wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee mu no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asiane biara nni ho sɛ wubefi ase abɛma nneɛma a emu yɛ duru so anaasɛ wode ahoɔden atete wo ho bere a woadu mpanyin afe so no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebetumi ayɛ nea ahobammɔ wom na mfaso wɔ so, nanso ɛho hia paa sɛ woyɛ no wɔ kwan pa so denam akwankyerɛ pa so: Ɔhwɛ: Sɛ worehyɛ ase foforɔ a, ɛye paa sɛ wofa sukuu mu apɔmuden kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ akwankyerɛ ase. Fa Ahobammɔ Nneɛma Di Dwuma: te sɛ 'helmets' (dadeɛ kyɛ), 'knee pads' (kotodwe ho banbɔ), ne 'wrist guards' (nsafufua ho banbɔ). Ɔkwan a Ɛfata: Hyɛ aseɛ fa wo honam ahoɔden nko ara (bodyweight exercises) ansa na woadi kan akɔ dadeɛ a ɛmu yɛ duru so. Hyɛ aseɛ fa nneɛma a ɛmu nnyɛ duru paa ansa na woakɔ deɛ ɛmu yɛ duru boro saa so. Ma bere ma ahomegye ne ahotɔ . Sɛ wote nka sɛ biribi nnkɔ yie anaa ɛyɛ wo yaw a, gyae na hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ firi mpanyimfoɔ hɔ. Fa ahoɔden nteteeɛ yi fra apɔmuden nteetee afoforɔ mu na woanya ahoɔden pa wɔ baabiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow boa ma mmabun nya atenka fam yiyedi ne tumi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow ma obi te nka sɛ ɔyɛ ne de ne ntease, na ɛtew nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔatew ne ho nea broni ka no 'feelings of isolation' ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so. Mmabun betumi anya mmoa a efi tema mu, afotu a mfaso wɔ so, ne nkuranhyɛ afi wɔn atipɛnfo a wɔahyia nsɛnnennen anaa osuahu a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Atipɛnfo mmoa boa ma wonya tumi denam mmabun nkate ne nea wɔpaw a wɔma ɛyɛ nokware, ahotoso a wɔde ma wɔn ho, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛma wɔbom si gyinae na wɔkamfo kyerɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne Nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde nsɛm a wohia na ama mmabun anya nna ne awo asetra a ɛfata na wɔakwati akwahosan ho nneɛma bɔne a ebefi mu aba no. Wɔada no adi sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wogye tom sɛ nna mu dwumadi a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmabun mu no yɛ ade a ɛfata, a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun de nna a ahobammɔ wom adi dwuma, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no de wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen, na ɛtwe adwene si kwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne tumidi so no nya nkɛntɛnso pa wɔ mmabun asetra mu nneɛma pii so. Ghana aban no ada ahofama a emu yɛ den adi ama SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde adi dwuma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa so. Nanso, sɛnea amanaman ntam gyinapɛn ahorow kyerɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ka nsɛmti ahorow ho, a ɛfata wɔ akuw atitiriw anum a nhwehwɛmu kuw no akyerɛ mu: nna ne awo nipadua ho adesua; HIV/STI a wɔde siw ano; nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da; gyinapɛn ahorow ne nnipa ntam nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ; ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ne awo hokwan ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔde nhwehwɛmu kwan a ɛfa su ho, te sɛ nsɛmbisa, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, anaa akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu di dwuma de kyere osuahu ne adwene a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu akwan a ɛfa su pa ho, te sɛ nsɛmbisa, kuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu no som bo kɛse ma mmabun osuahu ne wɔn adwene a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) ho a wɔkyere. Nsɛmbisa: Nhwehwɛmufoɔ bisabisa mmabun mmiako mmiako de hwehwɛ wɔn ankasa suahunu, gyidie, ne wɔn adwene wɔ ASRH nsɛmti ho wɔ kokoamsɛm ne mmoa tebea mu. Kuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so nkɔmmɔbɔ: Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka mmabun kuw ketewaa bi abom abɔ nsɛmti pɔtee bi a ɛfa ho ho nkɔmmɔ a ɛma wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo di nkitaho na wɔkyɛ wɔn adwene wɔ ASRH nsɛm ho, na ɛnam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nsusuwii a wɔbom yɛ so nya nhumu a ɛyɛ fɛ. Akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu: Mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow mu denneennen, te sɛ mfonini nne adwuma anaa mpɔtam asase mfoniniyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, de bom yɛ nimdeɛ na wɔda wɔn adwene adi wɔ ASRH ho wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ adebɔ ne tumi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn atorɔ anaa anansesɛm ahorow  na wɔtaa nya wɔ sɛ obi asesa ne dibea afi ɔbaa anaa ɔbarima akɔ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa  (transgender) ne sɛ obi nhunu neho sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa  (non-binary)ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu?
answer_twi_source: Atorɔ adwene anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya fa bɔbea wo sesa no fi ɔbaa anaa ɔbarima kɔ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa  (transgender) ne sɛ obi nhunu neho sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa  (non-binary)  ho no bi ne gyidi a ɛne sɛ ɛyɛ awosu.Nyansahu mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔagye atom sɛ ɛyɛ awosu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama mpanyimfo a yɛ ato aba ama wɔn anaa nhyehyɛeyɛfo no abu akontaa wɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu na wɔabɔ ho ban no ho? (Ananmusifo a wo ne wɔn di nkitaho, baguam asɛnnibea a wɔbɛkɔ)
answer_twi_source: Ma wɔn a wɔwɔ tumi no nte wo nne: Ananmusifoɔ a wobɛdi nkitaho: Kɔ wo mpaninfoɔ a woato aba ama wɔn nkyɛn na ka wo haw wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ho. Baguam Atiefoɔ a Wobɛkɔ: Kɔ atiefoɔ ne baguam nhyiamu a ɛfa ASRH nsɛm ho na kasa fa wo nsusuiɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wobedi nna ho dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu no boa ma wɔhyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa, pene a wɔpene so amammerɛ, ne nna ho su pa ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔyɛ a ɛfa nna ho nsɛm ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no boa ma wɔhyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa, pene a wɔpene so amammerɛ, ne nna ho su pa ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu denam ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu a wɔkasa tia, gyina hɔ ma nneɛma ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene, ahye, ne obu ho a wɔma ɛkɔ so no so. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi yɛ nhyiam ahorow ma nne ahorow a wɔato wɔn hintidua, ɛma ankorankoro tumi ma wɔsan nya wɔn asɛm no, na ɛhyɛ nna ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a ɛka obiara ho ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a wobetumi de adi dwuma de aka kɔndɔm ho, de abɔ wɔn ho ban kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Hormone Akwan: Wobetumi de awo ano aduru, aduru, anaa nkaa adi dwuma de aka kɔndɔm ho de asiw nyinsɛn ano bio. Nnuru a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ano a Ɛyɛ Adwuma Bere Tenten (LARCs): Mfiri a wɔde si awotwaa mu (IUDs) anaa 'hormone' a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu no ma wotumi siw nyinsɛn ano bere tenten na enhia sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene si so da biara da. 'Diaphragms' anaa 'Cervical Caps': Wobetumi de akwanside akwan yi adi dwuma de akum mmadwoa de abɔ wɔn ho ban kɛse afi nyinsɛn ho. Nkwammoaa a wɔde kum mmadwoa: Wobetumi de nnuru a ekum mmadwoa aka kɔndɔm anaa akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho dwuma de asiw nyinsɛn ano kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Henanom ne adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ nea broni ka no 'school-based crisis intervention programs' mu, na ahwehwɛde ahorow bɛn na wɔwɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ebia adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bi ne sukuu afotufo, ayarehwɛfo, adwene ne nneyɛe ho animdefo, asetra mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfo, ne ahokyere mu ayaresa ho abenfo a wɔatete wɔn. Mpɛn pii no, wɔwɔ adwenemyare anaa afotu ho nimdeɛ na wonya ntetee titiriw wɔ nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention' mu..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na m’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow nya gyinaesi ahorow a misi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: W’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow yɛ adwuma sɛ kɔmpase a ɛkyerɛ wo gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho kwan. Wɔhyehyɛ wo suban wɔ abusuabɔ, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, pene, ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ho, na wonya sɛnea wofa gyinaesi ahorow mu wɔ saa mmeae yi so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkasa ama nkurɔfo de adi abɛɛfo ntetan nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw mu nsonsonoe ahorow ho dwuma, te sɛ intanɛt so ahobammɔ, kokoamu nsɛm ho banbɔ, kɔmputa so asisifo a wosiw ano, ne abɛɛfo ntetan nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ mu yiye, titiriw wɔ ASRH nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanneɛbɔ ho abɛɛfo netatan nimdie kuo Wodi Ho Dwuma: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛdi amanneɛbɔ ho abɛɛfo netatan akenkan ne akyerɛw mu nsonsonoe ho dwuma, te sɛ intanɛt so ahobammɔ, kokoam nsɛm ho banbɔ, kɔmputa so ayayade a wosiw ano, ne abɛɛfo netatan nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ mu yiye, titiriw wɔ ASRH nsɛm mu. Wobetumi akasa ama dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw ho adesua a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛbɛma mmerante ne mmabaa anya ahokokwaw ne nimdeɛ a wohia na wɔde akɔ dijitaal mmeae ahorow dwoodwoo ne asɛyɛde.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho no ma afa nnipa ahorow ahiade ne osuahu pɔtee ho dwuma, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, mmusuakuw ne mmusuakuw nketewa, ne akuw afoforo a wɔato wɔn hintidua ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nkɔmmɔdie no bɛka nnipa ahodoɔ, suahunu, ne adwene ahodoɔ ho, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, mmusuakuo ne mmusuakuo nketewa, ne akuo foforɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua ka ho. Nkitahodi: Nneɛma a ɛka bom a ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ obi so, te sɛ abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, tumi, ne asetena ne sikasɛm tebea a wobehu. Cultural sensitivity: Sɛ obi wɔ atenka ma amammerɛ soronkoyɛ ne akwansideɛ a mpɔtam ahodoɔ hyia berɛ a wɔredi nna mu basabasayɛ ho dwuma na wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ manyinsɛn na mesusuw ho sɛ mɛma nyinsɛn no aba awiei a, dɛn ne akwan foforo bi a wobetumi afa so asi nyinsɛn a woyi gu ananmu? (adoption, awofoyɛ ho nneɛma) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woanyinsɛn na woresusuw ho sɛ wobɛma nyinsɛn no aba awiei a, akwan foforo bi ni: Fa wo ba no ma: Wo ba a wode bɛto abusua a wɔwɔ ɔdɔ a wobetumi atete no nkyɛn. Ɔwofoyɛ: W’ankasa wobɛtete wo ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ me rebɛbu me nsa?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne no bi ne: Nufoɔ a ɛyɛ yaw anaa ɛyɛ kɛseɛ. Adwene nsesaeɛ.  ayaase yaw (cramps). Aduane a wopɛ, tipae, anaa ɔbrɛ. Nsuo a ɛfiri mmaa fam (discharge) no sesa. Mpɔmpɔ. Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛhwɛ wo nsabuo nna no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ, asetena, ne nhyehyɛe mu nneɛma a ebetumi anya mmabun gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo betumi abom adi nsɛm a ɛhyɛ ase yi ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛfa akontaabu ne mmoa ho ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Gyinae a mmabun si sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa no betumi afi amammerɛ, asetena, ne nhyehyɛe mu nneɛma so nkɛntɛnso. Ebia eyinom bi ne suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn animtiaa anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka, ahotoso a wonni wɔ atumfoɔ mu, mmoa adwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni, ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛmma wonsusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi adi saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma denam nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, asodie a ɛfa wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa ho a wɔbɛkasa atia, nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛma wɔ pene ne abusuabɔ pa ho, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya na ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu. Ɛdenam akontaabu ne mmoa amammerɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔate ahobammɔ nka na wɔanya ahotoso kɛse wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, a nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de aboa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔadi mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo amammerɛ mu ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu denam hia a amammerɛ ahorow ne nea wɔde ka ho ho hia a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ahu, a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa amammerɛ mu ahoɔden ntetee ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ wɔn suahu ahorow a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a ɛne amammerɛ hyia ho. Bio nso, mmerante ne mmabaa betumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako ayɛ nnwuma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a ɛfa ayarefo a wonnii mfe aduonu a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu ahiade soronko ne nea wɔpɛ ho. Ɛdenam ɔhwɛ a ɛfata amammerɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa nyinaa benya ɔhwɛ a obu wom, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ papa a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me hokafo adi nkitaho yiye afa ahobammɔ ne mmoa ahiade ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne wo hokafo a wobɛkasa pefee no yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma woanya abusuabɔ pa. Ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ayɛ no ni: Fa tebea no si hɔ: Paw bere a wo ho dwo wo a wobɛkasa. Ma emu nna hɔ na kasa tẽẽ: Kyerɛ w’ahiade ne ahye a wode bedi dwuma ama ahobammɔ, pene, ne obu. Tie no denneennen: Tie wɔn adwene na hwehwɛ nea wogye tom. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: "Mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ bere a..." sen sɛ wode kasa a ɛbɔ sobo bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ me ne m’atipɛnfo a wɔde obu, tema, ne ntease di kan wɔ wɔne afoforo nkitahodi mu atwa me ho ahyia?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne w’atipɛnfo a wɔde obu, tema, ne ntease di kan atwa wo ho ahyia a, ebetumi anya mfaso pii: Wo ho a wubenya a ɛkɔ soro: Atipɛnfo ntam nkitahodie pa betumi ama woanya obu ama wo ho denam nea ɛbɛma woagye atom na woaboa wo no so. Gyinaesi a ɛkɔ anim: Sɛ wo ne atipɛnfo a wobu obu na wɔwɔ tema no di nkitaho a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woanya gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ a eye, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu. Adwene mu yiyedi a ɛkɔ anim: Atipɛnfo ntam nkitahodie pa boa ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wɔwɔ nkitahodie, a ɛho hia ma adwene mu yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma ne STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, wɔ m’abusuabɔ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Hokafo: Ka hia a nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho hia ho nsɛm kyerɛ. Kyerɛkyerɛ mfaso a ɛwɔ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma ne STI nhwehwɛmu so ma ahokafo baanu no nyinaa. Di anim denam Nhwɛso so: Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma bere nyinaa na w’ankasa fa nna a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma. Kyerɛ sɛ wofa wo nna mu akwahosan ho asodi. Nkitahodi a Wobue: Wo ne wo hokafo nsusuw nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho pefee. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa STI nhwehwɛmu ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho nkuran. Mmoa a Wɔde Ma: Fa Ma sɛ mobɛbom akɔyɛ STI nhwehwɛmu sɛ adeyɛ wo di kan yɛ. Kyerɛ sɛ wudwen wo hokafo ne w’ankasa akwahosan nyinaa ho. Fa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Di Dwuma: Kyɛ nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho fi mmeae a agye din. Twe adwene si wo hokafo no so kɔ nsɛm a ɛfa STI ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho denam: Nhyehyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim de ma nkurɔfo hu hia a amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho hia wɔ akwahosan ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de akamfo sɛ wɔmfa adesua nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie nka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, afotufoɔ kuo, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔkamfo mmɔdenbɔ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛgyina hɔ ama amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuo ahodoɔ ahiadeɛ na wɔadi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nufu a wɔma no ka asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ HIV betumi afi ɛna mu akɔ abofra mu, na dɛn ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma ɛnanom a wɔwɔ HIV wɔ nufu a wɔde ma ho?
answer_twi_source: Nufu a wɔma no betumi de asiane aba sɛ HIV betumi afi ɛna mu akɔ abofra mu, efisɛ HIV betumi aba nufusu mu. Nanso, wɔ mmeae a wontumi nnya aduan a wɔde besi ananmu a ahobammɔ wom na ne bo nyɛ den no, Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Dwumakuo (WHO) kamfo nufu nkutoo a wɔde ka nnuru a wɔde siw ɔyare mmoawa ano ma ɛna no ne/anaasɛ akokoaa no kyerɛ sɛ ɔkwan a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔfa so ma nkokoaa aduan ma ɛnanom a wɔwɔ HIV. Saa kwan yi a wɔfrɛ no "Option B+" no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nkwa nna nyinaa ART bɛma mmea a wɔyem ne wɔn a wɔma nufu a wɔwɔ HIV nyinaa, a CD4 dodow anaa ayaresabea gyinabea mfa ho, na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ HIV bɛkɔ akokoaa no so no so atew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan pa bɛn na mebetumi afa so ahu me nipadua mu yie a asiane biara nni mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa w’adwene si wo ho a wubehu so: Hwehwɛ wo nipadua mu wɔ kokoam baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ. Bu wo nipadua no nsɛnkyerɛnne: Ma w’ani si nea wote nka sɛ wo ho ye ne nea ɛnte nka no yiye. Nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so: Sua nna mu nkɔso a ahoɔden wom ho ade fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ sukuu ayarehwɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa ɔsomfo a ɔyɛ mmabun adamfofa su no Bu ahye: Nhyɛ wo ho anaa afoforo ma wɔnyɛ biribiara a ɛnyɛ dɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ sɛ amammerɛ mu akyiwadeɛ anaa akwansideɛ ma ɛyɛ den sɛ yɛbɛkasa afa mpaninyɔ anaa awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asua mpanin mu kɔ ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho ade wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo so denam nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata amammerɛ a wɔde bɛdi dwuma, ne intanɛt so nneɛma anaa mmoa ntelefon a wɔmmfa wɔn din nto dwa a wɔbɛkɔ so. Nnamfo akuo anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkasa fa nsɛm yi ho wɔ obu mu a wɔbɛkɔ mu no betumi ama mmoa ne nteaseɛ. Ɛboa sɛ wɔfi ase nketewa, nkakrankakra wɔkasa fa nsɛm a emu yɛ den ho, na bere nyinaa wɔde kasa a obu wom na atemmuo nnim di dwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nso hunu sɛ wɔbetumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afiri mpanyimfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, afotufoɔ, anaa apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbetumi ama kɔkoam mmoa hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoeɛ bɛn na ɛda nna mu nyarewa a mmoawa (bacteria) de ba ne deɛ mmoawa nketenkete (virus) de ba ntam? Na sɛn na eyi ka ayaresa ne akwankyerɛ a yɛde si saa nyarewa yi kwan?
answer_twi_source: Mmoawa (bacteria) na ɛde 'bacterial STIs' ba, na mmoawa nketenkete (viruses) nso na ɛde 'viral STIs' ba. Nsonsonoeɛ titiriw a ɛda wɔn ntam ne sɛdeɛ yɛsa wɔn yareɛ ne sɛdeɛ yɛsi wɔn kwan. Nna mu nyarewa a mmoawa de ba (bacterial STIs), te sɛ klamidia, 'gonorrhea', ne 'syphilis' no, yɛbɛtumi asa wɔn yareɛ koraa denam 'antibiotics' aduro so sɛ yɛhu no ntɛm a. Nna mu nyarewa a mmoawa nketenkete de ba (viral STIs), te sɛ HIV, 'herpes', ne HPV nso, yɛntumi nsa wɔn yareɛ koraa mfi hɔ, nanso yɛbɛtumi anya nnuro (antiviral medications) de ahwɛ so na anhyɛ yɛn so. Saa nsonsonoeɛ yi kyerɛ sɛ bacterial STIs deɛ, antibiotics bɛtumi asa no koraa, nanso viral STIs deɛ, ɛhia sɛ yɛhwɛ so daa yɛn nkwa nna nyinaa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankoro a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu anaa wɔn a wɔnyɛ abien no betumi asusuw nyinsɛn ano a, wosiw ho wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ nnipa baanu no wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow. Nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Nnipa a wɔnom "hormone therapy": Wo ne wo duruyɛfo nsusuw nkitahodi a ebetumi aba wɔ awo ano aduru ne wo nnuru a wode di dwuma dedaw no ntam ho. Nnipa a wɔnyɛɛ wɔn oprehyɛn (operation) a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea: Ebia akwan horow a wɔfa so siw awo ano a egyina wo nipadua ne nna mu nneyɛe so. Nnipa a wɔpɛ sɛ wonyinsɛn: Munsusuw akwan horow a wobɛfa so agyae hormone ayaresa anaasɛ wubegyae hormone ayaresa sɛ moyɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wubenyinsɛn a. Kae: Wo duruyɛfo wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ wo kwan na wabua wo nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne nna mu akwahosan ho nyinaa. Wobetumi aboa wo ma woanya ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn a ɛfata w’ahiade ne w’asetena kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonni insurance anaa sika?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi anya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wonni insurance anaa sika. Ayaresabea ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo pii de nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee ma, na ebia nhyehyɛe ahorow anaa mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow a aban de sika boa a wɔde mmoa ma ankorankoro a wontumi ntua akwahosan ho ka wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na awofoɔ di de boa mmabun wɔ ammaneɛbɔ adesua ho nsɛm mu (media literacy) ne sɛnea wɔde adesua no di dwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ boa ma ammaneɛbɔ adesua no kɔ so wɔ ɔkwan bi te sɛ: Wɔhwehwɛ ammaneɛbɔ nsɛm mu ansa na woagye adi. Wɔne mmabun no hwɛ nneɛma bom na wɔbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ. Wɔkyerɛ wɔn kwan bere a wɔahu nsɛm bi a ɛyɛ den, na wɔboa wɔn ma wɔsisi gyinaeɛ pa. Wɔboa mmabun na wohu ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so ate ammanneɛbɔ nsɛm no ase. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyehyɛ mmara ma bere ne nneɛma a wɔhwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhaw  ne akwanside ahorow bi a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no hyia nsɛnnennen ne akwanside ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne: 1. Animtiaabu anaa nyiyimu ne asetra mu tew a wɔtew wɔn ho 2. Mmeae ne mmeae a wontumi nkɔ hɔ 3. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne ahosiesie ho nnwuma a wonnya kakraa bi 4. Nyiyim ne ayayade 5. Nhomasua ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛka obiara ho a wonni 6. Asetra ne nkate mu apereperedi 7. Ahomegye ne ahomegye dwumadi ahorow a wonnya 8. Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne akwanhwɛ a ɛba fam 9. Ananmusifo ne nne a wonni 10. Adwene mu akwahosan ho haw 11. Aniwu ne pow Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi nsɛnnennen ne akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma: 1. Wɔbɛhyɛ kasa a ɛka obiara ho ne nhumu ho nkuran 2. Wɔbɛma honam fam ne mfiridwuma mu nneɛma a wobetumi anya no atu mpɔn 3. Hwɛ sɛ wobenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmoa nnwuma a ɛyɛ pɛ 4. Wɔde nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛko tia nyiyim ne ayayade a wɔko tia bedi dwuma . Hyɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ne asetena mu nkabom ho nkuran - Fa nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔtumi nya ma - Yɛ nhyehyɛɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmubuafoɔ pɔtee bi ho - Yɛde yɛn ho hyɛ nsɛm a wɔka de boa ne dwumadie mu Ɛdenam saa nsɛnnennen ne akwansideɛ yi a yɛbɛdi ho dwuma so no, yɛbɛtumi ayɛ tebea a ɛbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na yɛaboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, ama wɔatumi adu wɔn tumi nyinaa ho na wɔadi yie
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa na wɔayɛ biribi de ahwɛ sɛ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden nhyehyɛeɛ de akwan a wɔfa so di wiem nsakraeɛ  ne ho nsunsuansoɔ  dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aka ama  wɔde wim nsakrae bɛka nna mu ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden (SRH)  nhyehyɛeɛ ho  wɔ  bere a wɔbɛma  nnipa ahunu wiem nsakraeɛ nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ  nna mu ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden so, mmoa ne kasamafo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ, nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ adwene, ɔsom akuo, mpɔtam hɔ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ din a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho na wɔahwehwɛ sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ apɔmuden mmeae ne mmoa dwumadie a etumi gyina wiem nsakraeɛ ano mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛe pa ne akwan pa bi a adwumawuranom betumi afa so ahyɛ akatua a ɛda adi pefee, akontaabu, ne atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ wɔn akatua ho nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛeyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwumawuranom betumi ahyɛ akatua a ɛda adi pefee, akontaabu, ne atɛntrenee ho nkuran denam: Akatua ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ daa de ahu na wɔadi akatua mu nsonsonoe a ɛda mmarima ne mmea ntam no ho dwuma. Akatua ho nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma. Ntetee a wɔde bɛma adwuma so ahwɛfo ne nnipa ho adwumayɛfo wɔ animhwɛ a wonnim ne akatua a ɛfata ho nneyɛe ho. Akwan a adwumayɛfo bɛfa so de akatua mu nsonsonoe ho haw ahorow akyerɛ. Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ adwuma ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne akatua ahorow no da adi na adwumayɛfo nyinaa betumi anya bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so akwan pɔtee bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono wɔ aman anaa mmeae ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so akwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi ayɛ: kwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene ayaresa so, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho, a egyina mfe a wɔadi ne wɔn onyin so. Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie wɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm mu, a akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho ban ka ho. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a edi mu na ɛkɔ akyiri. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya nyinsɛn ano aduru ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ obenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan wɔ tebea horow bi mu, sɛnea mmara ma ho kwan no. Saa hokwan ahorow yi betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ aman anaa mpɔtam ahorow mu esiane amammerɛ, nyamesom, ne mmara mu nsonsonoe nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛ tumi asua pii afa adwenemyare ho na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a mmabun betumi asua pii afa adwenemyareɛ ho na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa no bi ne: Sukuu Afotufoɔ: Sukuu pii wɔ afotufoɔ a wɔatete wɔn sɛ wɔbɛboa asuafoɔ adwenemyareɛ ahiadeɛ. Ahomatrɔfo ne Mmoa asoeɛ: Mmoa ahomatrɔfo te sɛ ahokyere ahomatrɔfo anaa abɛɛfo mmoa dwumakuo  de kokoam mmoa ne nsɛm ma. Frɛ 0800111222 na woanya mmoa afi BOAME hɔ. abɛɛfo ntentan ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so Nneɛma: Wobetumi atwe BOAME App no na wɔde adi dwuma bere a ɛho hia no. Ayaresa ne Afotu: Mmabun betumi anya ayaresa anaa afotu denam nnwuma a egyina sukuu so, mpɔtam hɔ adwenemyare ho mmeae, anaa ankorankoro nnuruyɛfo so. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa sɛ worepere wɔ w’adwene mu akwahosan ho anaasɛ woreboa w’adamfo bi a ɔte saa a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ bere a ɛfa wɔn ankasa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho gyinaesi ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ: Wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛkɔ akyiri. Fa aduruyɛ ne akwan horow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ho kwan ma anaasɛ gyae. Hwehwɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu wɔ nsɛm pii mu. Fa wo ho hyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, awo, ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe afoforo ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow hyehyɛ mmabun abɛɛfo ntetan osuahu ne wɔn nneyɛe, na ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo ntetan akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi ama amammerɛ mu atinka, ahorow ahorow, ne nnipa a wɔka ho wɔ intanɛt so no anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow na ɛkyerɛ mmabun dijitaal osuahu ne wɔn nneyɛe: Amammerɛ mu nkate ne adwene ahorow a wɔte ase no boa mmabun ma wɔde obu ne tema fa intanɛt so nkitahodi mu. Digitals akenkan ne akyerɛw nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi ama amammerɛ mu nkate, ahorow ahorow, ne nnipa a wɔka ho wɔ intanɛt so no anya nkɔso denam ntease ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya amammerɛ ahorow, nnipa a wɔyɛ, ne adwene ahorow ho no so. Ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ ne nkɔmmɔdie a ɛka obiara ho nkuran a wɔhyɛ wɔ dawurubɔ kuro ntetan mmeaeɛ no boa ma wɔyɛ intanɛt so tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛma akwaaba ma mmabun nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asiesie amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a menya fi mmeae afoforo, te sɛ sukuu anaa mfɛfo, a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Te ase sɛ ebia nsɛm ahorow a wonya fi mmeae ahorow benya adwene ahorow. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wɔte w’amammerɛ/nyamesom gyidi ne nnɛyi nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm nyinaa ase. Hwehwɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ w’amammerɛ/nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a wunya wɔ mmeae afoforo ntam, fa w’adwene si afã horow te sɛ obuo, asɛde, ne obi ho ne afoforo a wobɛhwɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn sɛ mete nka sɛ wɔmmu me anaa m'ani nnye wɔ ayaresabea esiane me dɛmdi nti?
answer_twi_source: Ka kyerɛ wɔn wɔ obu kwan so. Bisa dɔkota foforo anaa bɔ kɔkɔ kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ a wɔ wɔ ayresabea hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammerɛ ne mpɔtam mmra kammabun wɔ adebu ne pene yɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmarima wɔ tumi pii a, ɛyɛ den. Nkyerɛkyerɛ boa ma yɛhu pɛyɛ na yetumi bisa nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na m’abusua atumi ayɛ tebea a ɛboa wɔ fie a, ɛma obiara nya adwenem akwahosan pa?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi a emu da hɔ ho nkuran na hyɛ abusua no mufo nkuran ma wɔnka wɔn atinka a wonni atɛn. Momfa bere pa a mobom nya di kan na momfa mo ho nhyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma abusuabɔ ne ahomegye ho nkuran mu. Fa adidi pa, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne nna ho nhyehyɛe ahorow si hɔ de boa yiyedi nyinaa. Yɛ beaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ma obiara sɛ ɔbɛkyɛ wɔn aperepereɛ na hwehwɛ mmoa berɛ a ɛhia. Kyerɛkyerɛ abusua no mufo adwenemyare ho ade na fa nneɛma a wɔde bɛhwɛ wɔn ho ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi nya mmebun gyinaesi ne wɔn nneyɛe so nsusuanso?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfo amammerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow kyerɛ suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmebun mu kɛse. Ebia amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow bɛkyerɛ akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow, nna mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wɔ mpɔtam bi no, wobetumi abu nna a edi aware anim no animtiaa, bere a wɔ mmeae afoforo no, wobetumi agye atom kɛse. ɔsom mu gyidi, atetesɛm, ne ahyɛde ahorow nso di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo ho no so nkɛntɛnso mu. Saa amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi betumi anya nsɛm a mmabun nya, ahotɔ a wonya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ mu, ne sɛnea wotumi si gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na botae a mede besisi m’ani so betumi aboa me ma makɔ so de m’adwene asi me gyinapɛn ahorow, mehiade kɛse, ne nneɛma a mepɛ bere tenten so, bere mpo a mihyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa asetra mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow a ebia ɛne wɔn bɔ abira no?
answer_twi_source: Botae a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so boa mmabun ma wɔde wɔn adwene si wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, wɔn hiade kɛse, ne wɔn apɛde a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ so, bere mpo a wohyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa asetra mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow a ebetumi ne wɔn abɔ abira denam: Ahofama a wɔhyɛ mu den: Botae ahorow a wɔde si hɔ no hyɛ mmabun ahofama a wɔwɔ wɔ wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn apɛde ahorow ho mu den, na ɛkanyan wɔn ma wɔtra wɔn ho nokware wɔ abɔnten nhyɛso ahorow anim. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma: Botae ahorow yɛ kɔmpase, na ɛkyerɛ mmabun kwan ma wɔyɛ nneyɛe ne gyinaesi ahorow a ɛne wɔn botae ahorow a wɔde bere tenten asi no hyia, wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mpo mu. Sɛ mmabun nya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano: Botae ahorow a emu da hɔ a wobenya no ma wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, na ɛma wotumi di akwanside ahorow so bere a wɔde wɔn adwene si wɔn ankasa nkɔso ne yiyedi so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ kwan wɔ afotu bere mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn asiesie me ho ama no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ afotu bere mu no, wubetumi ahwɛ kwan sɛ: Tebea a ɛma kwan na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wubetumi asusuw wo haw ahorow ho pefee. Hokwan a wode bɛka wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Sɛ wore aso atie ne ɛmoa a efiri ɔfofufoɔ no ho yie. Sɛ wobɛsiesie wo ho ama afotuo bi a, wobɛtumi: Susuw deɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɔ ho nkɔmmɔ ne nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo ho. Susuw wo botae ahorow a wode bɛyɛ nhyiam no ho ne nea wowɔ anidaso sɛ wubedu ho. Bue w’ani sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ wo nkate ne osuahu ahorow mu nokwarem.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka biribi fa nyinsɛn mu haw ne mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn mu akwahosan ho nhwɛsoɔ 'prenatal care' so de hyɛ mmabun den.
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn mu haw betumi aba, nanso nyinsɛn mu akwahosan ho nhwɛsoɔ 'prenatal care' te so. Ntɛm a yɛhu yadeɛ (Early Detection): boa ma yɛhu haw no ntɛm. Hwɛso (Management): Ntɛm a yɛhu yadeɛ boa ma yɛsa yareɛ ntɛm. Asomdwoeɛ  (Peace of Mind): Ayaresabea nhwehwɛmu boa ma wote nka sɛ wo ne wo ba ho tɔ wo efisɛ dɔkota rehwɛ wo. Nsuro; kɔ 'antenatal' (berɛ a ɛdi awoɔ  anim) daa na kasa kyerɛ dɔkota.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ na makyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛda m’ankasa me gyinapɛn, osuahu, ne adwene a mewɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan, pene, nneɛma ahorow, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho, na maboa ma asetra mu nsakrae pa ne tumi a ɛwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Fa social media (asetenam dawurobɔ) (ne blogs kyɛ wo suahunu. Ne wo nnamfo nyɛ 'podcasts' anaa videos. Fa wo ho hyɛ adeɛ bi a wɔ fre no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛ 'digital activism' mu de ko tia nyiyimu na hyɛ pɛyɛ nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna ho akɔnnɔ? (Obi a ɔpɛ ne bɔbeasu foforo da, Obi a ɔpɛ ne ne bɔbeasu koro da, wɔn ɔpɛ mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa., Obi a ɔnni bɔbeasu mu anigye biara, ne nea ɛkeka ho)
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ kyerɛ onipa a w’ani gye ne ho wɔ ɔdɔ ne/anaasɛ honam fam. Nsɛmfua bi a wɔtaa de di dwuma ni: Heterosexual (straight): Obi a n’ani gye nnipa a wɔne no nni bɔbeasu koro ho. Homosexual (gay/lesbian): Obi a n’ani gye nnipa a wɔne no wɔ bɔbeasu koro ho (gay ma mmarima, lesbian ma mmea). Bisexual: Obi a n’ani gye mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa ho. Asexual: Obi a ɔnte bɔbeasu mu anigyeɛ biara nka kɛseɛ anaa ɔnte nka koraa mma obiara. Nsɛmfua afoforo nso wɔ hɔ, na sɛ woanhyɛ label biako biara mu fɛfɛɛfɛ a, ɛnyɛ hwee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim ne akuw a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ betumi adi wɔ amanaman ntam sikasɛm ho gyinaesi ahorow a wobenya ne sika a wɔde bɛto ASRH mu a wɔbɛma akɔ soro a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ amanaman ntam sikasɛm ho gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso ne sika a wɔde bɛto ASRH mu a wɔbɛma akɔ soro no mu. Ɛdenam mmabun a wɔkasa ama nne a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ASRH nsɛm ho nsɛm a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, ne mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano afi atipɛnfo ne wɔn ayɔnkofo hɔ so no, saa akuo yi betumi asiesie sikasɛm mu nneɛma a ɛho hia, akasa ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, na wɔabu wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no akontaabu wɔ mmabun ahiade ahorow ho dwuma a wobedi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ne amanneɛ a wɔyɛ de twa kwan kɔ mpanin mu no ka nteaseɛ a yɛwɔ wɔ mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie, nna mu su, ne nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ nna, nnamfofa, ne awareɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ne amanneɛ a wɔyɛ de twa kwan kɔ mpanin mu no di dwuma titiriw wɔ nteaseɛ a yɛwɔ wɔ mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie, nna mu su, ne nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ nna, nnamfofa, ne awareɛ ho. Amanneɛ yi taa hyɛ mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ne nneɛma a wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ wɔn ho no den, na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie ne suban a ɛfata ma mmarima ne mmaa wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Ebetumi nso ada amammerɛ mu adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ awareɛ, abusua, ne mpɔtam koroyɛ ho adi, na aka sɛnea ankorankoro hu wɔn ho ne wɔn ntam abusuabɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Aboafo nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm pii afa nna mu yareɛ ne nna mu apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntenten anaa Intanɛt so aboafo nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ CDC’s Division of STD Prevention, ahyeda sɛ wo bɛyɛ a awofo 'Planned Parenthood', anaa ASHA (American Sexual Health Association) de nsɛm a edi mu ma wɔ nna mu yareɛ ho. Ahomatrofo ne Mmoa kwanso: Ahomatrofo kwan a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ CDC INFO line (1-800-CDC-INFO) betumi de nsɛm ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ. Mpɔtam Hɔ Akwahosan Dwumadibea: Kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea anaa di nkitaho na woanya nneɛma ne nsɛm. Sukuu Afotufoɔ: Sukuu afotufoɔ bɛtumi de nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma nneɛma a ɛfata. Mpɔtam Hɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ mmeae anaa mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow bi de nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma ma. Mmoa Akuo: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ anaa intanɛt so mmoa akuo ma ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ so. Social Media: Di nna mu akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din akyi wɔ social media so na woanya nsɛm foforo ne nsɛm. Nna mu Akwahosan Apps: Apps bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akyidi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛkyerɛ me ho ne afoforo afa mmara kwan so afa horow a ɛfa nna ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ me nkitahodi ahorow no yɛ nea wɔpene so, obu wom, na ɛne mmara hyia?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ so tie nsɛm foforɔ: ɛma wohu mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna ho dwumadi ho wɔ wo man anaa wo mantam mu. Mmara tumi gu ahorow, enti sɛ wubehu nneɛma pɔtee no ho hia yiye. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ din pa te sɛ aban wɛbsaet ahorow, mmara kwan so ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma. Mpene so Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho ne afoforo fa adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔpene so no ho. Te ase sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde pene ma kwa, wɔde anigye, na ɛkɔ so. Kyɛ nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛfa sɛnea wobebisa na wɔabu pene wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu ho. Hu Hokwan a Wo Ho: Te wo hokwan ne w’asɛyɛde ahorow ase bere a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ho, titiriw wɔ mfe a woadi a wobɛpene so, kokoamsɛm a wode besie wɔ akwahosan ho, ne ahobammɔ a wode bɛbɔ wo ho ban afi nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Fa wo ho hyɛ adwumayɛbea, nhyiamu, anaa nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nna mu hokwan ne mmara a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho. Pere ma nna ho adesua a ɛkɔ akyiri mma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu na ama asuafo nyinaa anya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne mmara ho abenfo, ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛhwɛ nnipa hokwan ahorow so, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ayɛ biako de ahyɛ mmara mu ahobammɔ ne akontaabu akwan a wɔfa so bu wɔn nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne mmara ho abenfo, nnipa hokwan ahyehyɛde ahorow, apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ayɛ biako de ahyɛ mmara mu ahobammɔ ne akontaabu akwan a wɔfa so bu wɔn nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow no mu den. Saa adwumayɛkuo yi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu, wɔbɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na wɔahwɛ sɛdeɛ wɔde bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi ho ɔsatu ahorow de nna ho mfonini ahorow di dwuma de tɔn nneɛma, na nkrasɛm bɛn na saa mfonini ahorow yi de kɔma mmaabun wɔ mfaso ne bo a ɛsom ho?
answer_twi_source: Dawurubɔ ne aguadi ɔsatu ahorow taa de nna ho mfonini ahorow di dwuma de tɔn nneɛma denam anigye, anigyede, ne anigyede ho nsɛmti a wɔde bata ho no so. Saa mfonini ahorow yi de nkrasɛm kɔma mmaabun sɛ wɔn bo a ɛsom ne wɔn bo a ɛsom no ne wɔn honam ani hwɛbea ne wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ wɔ abusuabɔ, na ɛhyɛ nsusuwii hunu a epira mu den na ɛma ankorankoro bu wɔn ani.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛkwan bɛn na mmabun bɛfa so akɔ ayaresabea wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Amansan hyɛn (trotro/bus). Sukuu hyɛn. Amansan hyɛn (Uber/Bolt) . Nante/sakre. Bisa awofoɔ anaa mpanyimfoɔ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa akwannya ahorow a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ sɛ wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, awofo mmoa, ne asetra mu nnwuma a wobenya ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi akwannya ahorow a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ sɛ wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, awofo mmoa, ne asetra mu nnwuma a wobenya ho dwuma denam: Wɔbɛhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, a egyina adanse so nka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho, a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, awo, awofoyɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Sika a wɔbɛkyekyɛ ama nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina mpɔtam hɔ, mmoa akuo, anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔde awofoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotuo, mmofra hwɛ mmoa, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ asetena mu nnwuma ma mmabun a wɔyem ne awofoɔ nkumaa. Akwankyerɛ anaa nhyehyeɛ a wɔde besi hɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu de ahwɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔyem no bɛnya afotuo, wɔde wɔn akɔma wɔn, ne mmoa dwumadie wɔ tebea a ɛnyɛ atemmuo mu a ɛdi wɔn honam fam, nkateɛ, ne asetena mu ahiadeɛ ho dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn, awoɔ, ne awoɔ akyi ahotɔ nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho bere a merepaw ɔkwan a, mɛfa so asiw nyinsɛn ano no? (sɛ nhwɛso no, sɛnea etu mpɔn, nea efi mu ba, asetena kwan, ɛka) .
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so asiw awo ano a wobɛpaw ama wo no gyina nneɛma pii so. Nneɛma a wɔakyekyɛ mu a ɛbɛboa wo ma woasi gyinae ni: Nea etu mpɔn: Ahobammɔ a ɛkorɔn yiye a efi nyinsɛn ho ho hia dɛn? Susuw "typical use" a ɛyɛ adwuma ho, ɛnyɛ dwumadie a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛkɛ. Nsunsuanso bɔne: So nneɛma bɔne a ebetumi afi hormone mu aba no haw wo? Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusuw eyi ho. Asetena kwan: Wo ho tɔ wo dɛn wɔ da biara da a wode bedi dwuma, akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma bere tenten, anaa akwanside akwan a wode di dwuma bere biara a wo ne obi bɛda no ho? Ka: Susuw ɛka a wodi kan tua, sika a wɔde bɛka ho, anaa insurance a wotua ho. Ɛnyɛ den sɛ wode bedi dwuma: Susuw sɛnea wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wode ɔkwan no redi dwuma yiye na woayɛ no daa no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STI ho no so dua, sɛ mpo nsɛnkyerɛnne biara nni hɔ a.
answer_twi_source: STI ahorow pii betumi akɔ so bere tenten a obiara nhu a ɛremfa nsɛnkyerɛnne biara mma. Ɛno nti na ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa, sɛ wo ne obi da a, sɛ wote nka sɛ wowɔ apɔwmuden mpo a. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Hu a Wohu Ntɛm: Sɛ wohu yare no ntɛm na wosa a, ebetumi asiw akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen a emu yɛ den ano ama wo ne wo hokafo (hokafo) no. Siw Ntrɛwmu Siw: Sɛ wohu ntɛm a, ɛboa ma wogyae nyarewa no nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no na ɛbɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ɔhokafo (hokafo) ho ban. Asomdwoe: Sɛ wunim wo gyinabea a, ɛma wunya asomdwoe na ɛma wutumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho. hyɛ no nsow sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wo ne ɔhokafo biako a odi nokware saa ara wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ a ɔde ne ho ama
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee yɛ nnwuma a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛma mmerante ne mmabaa anya akwanya anya adwuma mu osuahu, anya nimdeɛ, na wɔahwehwɛ adwumayɛ akwan mu. Wɔho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma hokwan ahorow a ɛsom bo ma: Wonya adwuma mu osuahu a mfaso wɔ so: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee ma mmabun nya osuahu ankasa wɔ adwumayɛ tebea ankasa mu, na ɛboa wɔn ma wɔte adwumayɛbea akwanhwɛ ne nkɔso ase. Nya nimdeɛ a ɛho hia: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no nya hokwan nya nimdeɛ a wobetumi de akɔ baabi foforo te sɛ nkitahodi, kuw adwumayɛ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru, ne bere a wɔde di dwuma, a ɛho hia kɛse ma nkonimdi wɔ daakye adwuma mu. Hwehwɛ adwuma mu anigyede mu: Adwumayɛ mu ntetee ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ma mmabun tumi hwehwɛ nnwuma ahorow, dwumadi ahorow, ne adwumayɛ akwan horow mu, na ɛboa wɔn ma wosisi gyinae ahorow a ɛfata wɔ wɔn daakye nhomasua ne adwumayɛ botae ahorow ho. Yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ nkitahodiɛ: Sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ adwumayɛ mu nteteeɛ anaa adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu a, ɛma wɔne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ wɔn anigyeɛ mu nkitahodiɛ, na ɛbɛtumi ama wɔanya afotuo hokwan, adwuma a wɔde ma, anaa nkitahodiɛ a ɛsom boɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow so nkɛntɛnso wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ahorow bi si ahobrɛase so dua, na ɛka sɛnea ankorankoro fa wɔn nipadua ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho dwuma.  Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho betumi anya akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nneyɛe ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Ebia amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow bɛkyerɛ sɛnea mmusua di nkitaho fa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nna mu akwahosan, ne abusuabɔ ho. Nyamesom Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow taa kyerɛ abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii kwan, na enya adwene ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna a edi aware anim, ne nea ɛkeka ho so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ hu sɛ kɔmputa so apomoden ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow a ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so ho nsɛm a ɛho hia wom no yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom na wɔabɔ ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo de akwan horow di dwuma de bɔ kɔmputa so apomoden ho kyerɛwtohɔ (EHRs) a nsɛm a ɛho hia wom ho ban: Encryption: Wɔtaa de nsɛm a wɔde asie EHR ahorow mu no siw nsɛm a wɔde asie na amma obiara antumi ankɔ mu. Akwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ: Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no de akwan a emu yɛ den a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ di dwuma, na ɛto wɔn a wobetumi ahwɛ ayarefo kyerɛwtohɔ na wɔasesa no ano hye. Nkitahodi a ahobammɔ wom: Wɔtaa de EHR nhyehyɛe ahorow gu nkitahodi nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom a ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ anim wom so de bɔ wɔn ho ban fi kɔmputa so ahunahuna ho. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo yɛ nhwehwɛmu daa de hwɛ sɛnea wobetumi anya EHR ahorow no na wɔahu ahobammɔ ho mmara biara a ebetumi abu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm di mmabun a wonni sika a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban, wɔn boseabɔ ho abakɔsɛm, anaasɛ wonni sikakorabea dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no sikasɛm ho ahiade ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kuw boseabɔ: Boseabɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina kuo so a mmabun bom hyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho boseabɔ ho bɔ na wɔkyɛ asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wobetua no mu kyɛfa, na ɛtew hia a ehia sɛ wɔde boseabɔ ho ban no so. Sikakorabea nketewa: Sikakorabea a wobebue a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde sika sie mfiase no kakraa bi anaasɛ wonhia biara, sika a wɔbɔ wɔ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho a ɛba fam, ne akwan a wɔfa so yi sika a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔbɛfa so ahyɛ sika a wɔde sie daa ho nkuran na wɔakyekye boseabɔ ho abakɔsɛm. Boa ho nhwehwɛmu foforɔ: Akwan a ɛnyɛ atetesɛm mu nkontabuo te sɛ asetena mu nkontabuo, mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a wɔde gyina hɔ ma, anaa adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma de asusu bosea a ɛfata ho na wɔagyina boseabɔ ho abakɔsɛm a atwam so akyerɛ sɛ ɛfata sɛ wɔbɔ bosea. Boseabɔ a egyina agyapade so: Boa a wɔde bɔ bosea a wɔde bɛbɔ agyapade a ɛsow aba, te sɛ nnwinnade, nneɛma a wɔakora so, anaa sika a wobenya daakye, sen sɛ wɔde bɛbɔ bosea a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so, na ama mmabun anya sika de ayɛ adwuma anaa sika a wɔde bɛto mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛhyɛn adwuma mu anaasɛ wɔafi wɔn ankasa nnwuma ase?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow boa mmabun ma wonya nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a wɔde bɛhyɛn adwumayɛ mu anaasɛ wobefi wɔn ankasa nnwuma ase denam hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma ma wonya ahokokwaw, nkitahodi, ne nsaanodwuma mu osuahu so. Afotufoɔ de akwankyerɛ ma wɔ krataa a wɔde kyerɛw wɔn krataa a wɔde kɔ adwuma mu, nsɛmmisa ho ahosiesie, nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ, ɔhaw ano aduru, gyinaesie, ne ahokokwaa foforɔ a ɛfa adwumayɛ ne adwumayɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi bɛyɛ lesbian, gay, bisexual, axesual anaa pansexual? (nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne spectrums a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea nneɛma twetwe adwene) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu yarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nyinsɛn a wɔ siw ano ne awoɔ akwaa apɔmuden dwumadie (reproductive health services) mmoa boa mpa so agodie a banbɔ wɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano (Pills/kɔndoms/IUDs) siw nyinsɛn ano. Ɛma wotumi si gyinae pa. Nea ɛka ho ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nna a ahobammɔ ne nna mu yarewa (STI) a wosiw ano ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma anaa aboafo ahyehyɛde bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde kar ho mmoa ma mmabun a wohia apomoden ho nnwuma?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi abom adi akwantuo akwansideɛ ho dwuma na wɔama mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie a wɔbɛtumi anya no atu mpɔn denam: Wɔbɛyɛ adwuma abom wɔ nnwuma a wɔde bɛtrɛ akwantuo akwan a mmabun bɛtumi apaw mu, te sɛ akwantuo a wɔde fa nnipa, kar a wɔde fa nnipa mu nhyehyɛeɛ, anaa ahomatrofo so apomoden ano aduru a wɔde bedi dwuma. Sika ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa akwantuo ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun, a mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ɔmanfoɔ kar ho, nkrataa a wɔde ma wɔ kar a wɔde fa nnipa mu, anaa nkannyan a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwantuo nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina atuhoama so ka ho a wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ. Kar akwantuo ho nsusuiɛ a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ ho, ahwɛ sɛ wɔdi akwantuo akwansideɛ ho dwuma sɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛtrɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun apomoden mu nsunsuansoɔ atu mpɔn no fa. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, sukuu, ne mmabun ananmusifoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de ahunu akwantuo ahiadeɛ na wɔayɛ ano aduru a wɔde asi wɔn ani so a ɛdi mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka m’ahye ho asɛm na madi me hokafo ahye?
answer_twi_source: Ahye yɛ limit (ahyeɛ nhyehyeɛ) ahorow a wode si hɔ de bɔ wo ho ban wɔ nkate ne honam fam. Ahye a wobɛka ho asɛm: Ma nea woyɛ ne nea wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ no mu nna hɔ na ka no tẽẽ. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: "Me te nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ..." Bu wo hokafo no ahye nso. Ahye betumi asesa bere a bere kɔ so no, enti kɔ so ne wo hokafo nni nkitaho pefee na fa ahofadi bere nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ayɛ na ama asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn mu no so atew? (ɔhwɛ a wɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo, suban pa, nhomasua) .
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wobɛfa so atew asiane ahorow so ni: Ɔhwɛ a Wɔhwɛ Ansa na Wɔawo: Sɛ wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wo daa no ho hia kɛse na ama woahwɛ w’apɔmuden ne wo ba no nkɔso so. Suban a Ɛma Apɔmuden: Kura asetra a ɛfata mu ansa na woanyinsɛn ne berɛ a woanyinsɛn no. Nhomasua: Sɛ wusua nyinsɛn ho ade a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woasisi gyinae a ɛfata de adi asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba no ho dwuma. Wo ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa obi a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa adwuma wɔ apɔmuden adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no nkasa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi a wɔbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, betumi adi animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm ho no ho dwuma, ahyɛ tebea a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa mmabun nyinaa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua a Ɛkɔ Akyiri: Dwumadi ahorow betumi ama nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nna ne awo akahosan (ASRH) nsɛmti ho, abɔ anansesɛm ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware, na ama ntease ne tema anya nkɔso de ako atia animtiaabu ne nyiyim. Mmeae a Ahobammɔ: Mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a wɔbɛma mmabun ate nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho nkɔmmɔ a wonsuro atemmu anaa nyiyim ho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma ne gyinaesi a wɔkyɛ di, wɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wodi wɔn ho so wɔ nipadua mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma ne gyinaesie a wɔkyɛ ho hia wɔ hokwan a, mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nipadua mu no mu denam: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabun wɔ nsɛm a wohia na wɔde asi wɔn nipadua ne akwahosan ho gyinaeɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛma Hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesie a ɛfa wɔn hwɛ ne ayaresa akwan a wɔbɛfa so ho a wɔbɛhyɛ mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ntam adwumayɛ ne ahotosoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran Nnyinasosɛm a ɛwɔ ahofadi, obu, ne nidi wɔ akwahosan ho nkitahodi mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so akamfo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne akwahosan ho insurance a wobenya no atu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu, ne adwumayɛbea ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ma nkurɔfo nhu: Mmabun betumi ayɛ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu, adwumayɛbea, anaa nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu, ne adwumayɛbea ahorow de asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne akwahosan ho insurance a wɔde tua ho ka no so dua. Lobby nhyehyɛeyɛfo: Kyerɛw nkrataa, adesrɛ, anaa email kɔma mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo, mmarahyɛ baguafo, anaa akwahosan ho mpanyimfo a wɔkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun akwahosan di kan, trɛw akwahosan ho nnwuma mu, na ɛma insurance akwan horow no tu mpɔn. Hyehyɛ mmabun afotuo akuo: Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, insurancefoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ nyɛ adwuma hyehyɛ mmabun afotufoɔ bagua anaa boayikuo a wɔde wɔn adwene ma wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ, nnwumadie ahodoɔ, ne dwumadie a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiadeɛ ho. Fa abɛɛfo ntentanfidie di dwuma: Fa abɛɛfo ntentanfidie akwan di dwuma de kyɛ ankorankoro nsɛm, adansedi, ne nkrasɛm a wɔde gyina nkurɔfo akyi, ne w’atipɛnfo, wɔn a wɔwɔ nsunsuanso, ne wɔn a wosi gyinae di nkitaho, na boaboa mmoa ano ma akwahosan ho nsakrae mmɔdenbɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne animtiabu a ɛbata STI ho, na dɛn nti na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Animtiabu yɛ adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa atemmu a ɛbata nnipa kuw pɔtee bi anaa tebea bi ho. Wɔ STI ho no, aniwu ne asodi pii betumi aba wɔ ɔyare no a obi anya ho, ɛwom mpo sɛ ɛtaa ba kɛse na wotumi sa de. Nea enti a animtiaabu wɔ hɔ ni: Nimdeɛ a wonni: Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne anansesɛm a ɛfa STI ho betumi ama obi asuro na wɔate ase. Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho adwemmɔne: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, nkurɔfo gyina wɔn nna mu nneyɛe so bu afoforo atɛn, na ɛnteɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi asiane ahorow a ɛkɔ soro a ɛwɔ mmofra aware ho, ne nna mu ateetee a mmabun hyia wɔ ntawntawdi ne ntawntawdi akyi tebea horow mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Nhomasua ne nhumu nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma titiri wɔ asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ aware a wɔyɛ no ntɛm, ɔhyɛ aware, ne nna mu ateetee mu no ho dwuma a wobedi mu, denam mmabun a wɔde wɔn hokwan ahorow, nea efi nneyɛe a ɛtete saa mu ba, ne mmoa a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nsɛm a wɔde ma wɔn no so. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, nyamesom akannifoɔ, ne atetesɛm mu ayaresafoɔ bɛkasa atia gyinapɛn ne nneyɛeɛ a epira, ahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran, na wɔama mmabun tumi ma wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn SRH ho a, ɛbɛboa ama asiane a ɛwɔ awareɛ ntɛm ne nna mu ɔbrasɛeɛ mu wɔ ntawntawdie ne ntawntawdie akyi tebea mu no so ate.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me hokafo (hokafo) nso bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa wɔn yare?
answer_twi_source: Wo hokafo (hokafo) a wobɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ wɔn nhwehwɛmu na wɔnsa wɔn yare no ho hia kɛse bere a woahu sɛ ɔwɔ STI a ɛyɛ papa akyi. Afotu bi ni: Kyerɛkyerɛ Hia a Ɛho Hia Mu: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea enti a nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ na wɔasa wɔn yare ho hia ma wɔn akwahosan ne sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔrentrɛw bio no mu. Fa Mmoa Ma: Ka sɛ wobɛka wɔn ho akɔ Mmabun ne Mmabun Akwahosan Dwumadibea a ɛbɛn wɔn. Di kɔmputa so ɔfotufo bi nkitaho wɔ GHS-YMK mobile app no so. Bu Wɔn Paw: Awiei koraa no, nea wɔpaw sɛ wɔbɛsɔ wɔn ahwɛ na wɔasa wɔn yare no yɛ wɔn dea. Nanso, ma emu nna hɔ wɔ nea ebetumi afi mu aba no ho sɛ wɔanyɛ saa a. Sɛ wo hokafoɔ no ho nyɛ no dɛ sɛ wobɛdi nkitaho tẽẽ a: W’akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ bɛtumi de ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛbɔ dwumadie a wɔmmɔ din ama. Wɔbɛdi wo hokafoɔ (hokafoɔ) ho nkɔmmɔ wɔ kokoam a wɔrenka wo ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ahyɛ amammerɛ mu atinka ne obu ho nkuran wɔ wɔn nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe mu ama ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne mmoa mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi de amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ nteteeɛ ahyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu, ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔde amammerɛ mu nkitahodifoɔ anaa nsɛm asekyerɛfoɔ adi nkitaho, de amammerɛ mu nhwehwɛmu ahyɛ ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na wɔde mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ ahyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhwehwɛmu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho adesua betumi aboa ma wɔako atia nyiyim ne animtiaabu a mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe hyia no?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so hokwan ho adesua boa ma wɔko tia nyiyim ne animtiaabu a mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nnwuma hyia denam: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbara nyiyim a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wɔadi, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa HIV tebea so a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase. Mmara kwan so ayaresa ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔhyia nyiyim anaa animtiaabuo wɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔakasa atia nyiyim nneyɛe, ako ama wɔn hokwan ahorow, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔnam mmara kwan so hwehwɛ asiesie. Ɛdenam mmara kwan so ahobammɔ ho nimdeɛ ne ntease a wɔma ɛkɔ so no so no, mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma amammerɛ a ɛfa nnipa nyinaa bom, obu, ne pɛyɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ama ankorankoro nnwumakuw ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow, abu akontaa wɔ wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a wɔde ahyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nkuran no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan te sɛ nea ɛda adi pefee, nea wɔhwɛ so, ne amanneɛbɔ adi dwuma de ama ankorankoro nnwumakuw ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow abu akontaa wɔ wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a wɔde hyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nkuran no ho. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo mu, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no abɔ nkɔmmɔ, na wɔde abɛɛfo ntentan (Social Media) ne nkitahodi akwan afoforo adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔahwehwɛ akontaabu afi ahokafo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaa ayaresa ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho amanneɛbɔ ma mu wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɔkwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne ayaresa ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho amanneɛbɔ ma mu wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne ayaresa a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwenemhaw so, adwene ne nneyɛe ho ayaresa, akwan horow a egyina adwene so, adwene mu nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne akuw a wɔboa. Sɛnea wɔpaw nea wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no gyina onipa no ahiade ne nea ɔpɛ, ne sɛnea adwenemhaw no mu yɛ den ne sɛnea ɛte so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ nyamesom tebea horow mu, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so akasa ama akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nsɛmti yi a ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ nyamesom tebea horow mu denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi afotufo anaa nyamesom akannifo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nsɛmti yi a ɛka obiara ho na ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛkasa ma akyerɛ no so. Wobetumi asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyɛ gyinapɛn ahorow te sɛ pene, obu, ne nipadua mu ahofadi ho nkuran wɔ nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneyɛe mu so dua. Ebia akwan horow a wɔfa so kasa ma nkurɔfo no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe, wɔbɛhyehyɛ atipɛnfo akuw a wɔboa wɔn, na wɔne nyamesom akannifo bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a obu wom de adi adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa ntease mu nsonsonoe ahorow ho dwuma. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun de nkate ne tema kɔ saa nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow yi so, na wohu gyidi ne osuahu ahorow a egu ahorow wɔ nyamesom akuw mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu mu nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ nkitahodi a ɛda wim nsakrae ne ASRH ntam no ntease mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa nnwuma ahorow ntam ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm ano no betumi ama wɔahu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a egyina adanse so ne nhyehyɛe ho mmuaeyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodiɛ ho nteaseɛ: Nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa nnwuma ahodoɔ ho ho hia na ama yɛate nkitahodiɛ a ɛyɛ den a ɛda wim nsakraeɛ ne ASRH ntam no ase, a nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛwɔ apomoden mu nsunsuansoɔ so, akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nsakraeɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ho mmuaeɛ ka ho. Nsɛm a Wɔboaboa Ano: Mmɔdenbɔ a emu yɛ den a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm ano no betumi ama wɔahu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a egyina adanse so ne nhyehyɛe ho mmuae denam nhumu a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmabun ahiade pɔtee ne wɔn mmerɛwyɛ ahorow ho wɔ wim nsakrae anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ho bere a merehwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wode sie: HIPAA Mmara: Wɔ U.S. no, Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) bɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Mmara a Ɛfa Mpene Ho: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmofra nkumaa wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam, a awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ka ho. Nea ɛka ho: Ebia mmara bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade anaa ɔhaw a ɛreba ho. Kokoamsɛm a Wobɛhwɛ: Bisa Nsɛm: Bisa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow. Ankorankoro Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Bisa kokoam nkɔmmɔbɔ bere a woato nsa afrɛw no. Hu Hokwan a Wowɔ: Hu mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ketewaa bi ho no yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun a wofi amammerɛ, mmusuakuw,  ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea ahorow mu  ayɛ biako, na wɔayɛ biako de ama asetra mu atɛntrenee botae ahorow anya nkɔso na ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea horow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛyɛ pɛ aba?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne Biakoyɛ a Wɔbɛhyɛ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun a wofi amammerɛ, mmusuakuw, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea ahorow mu ayɛ biako, wɔakyekye nkabom, na wɔayɛ biako denam mmeae a wɔbɛma wɔn nkɔmmɔbɔ, asusuw nneɛma ho yiye, ne wɔn ho wɔn ho adesua so. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo ne tumi mu nkɔso a wɔbɛbom ahwehwɛ so no, mmabun betumi anya ntease a wɔkyɛ wɔ asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm ho na wɔabom ayɛ adwuma de akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea horow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me nnamfo anaa m’abusuafo a ebia wɔnte me nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa me bɔbeasu ase anaasɛ wonnye ntom no adi nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Paw baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ komm na kokoam bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ. Fa nokwaredi ne obu da wo nkate ne osuahu ahorow adi, na si hia a ehia sɛ wogye wo tom na woboa wo no so dua. Fa nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ma anaa to nsa frɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ LGBTQ+ nhyiamu anaa mmoa akuo ase na wɔasua mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ho nsɛm pii. Fa ahye sisi hɔ sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no bɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ ɔtan anaasɛ ɛnsow aba a, fa wo yiyedi ne ahobammɔ di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwantuo kwan pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛtumi afa so akɔ ayaresabea ahorow anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ɔkwantuo kwan pɔtee bi bɛtumi aba hɔ a mmabun bɛtumi afa so akɔ ayaresabea ahorow, a ebi ne: Sukuu akwantu adwuma a ɛma sukuufo de kar kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Kar nhyehyɛe anaa nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a mpɔtam hɔ aban ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow de ma. Kar ho nkrataa anaa mmoa a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wonnya sika pii anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ akwantu ho akwanside ahorow. Kar nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina atuhoamafo so a ɛma wɔn a wohia mmoa kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne aduan ho akwankyerɛ anaa nyansahyɛ ahorow bi a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔn awo akwahosan ayɛ papa?
answer_twi_source: Aduan ho akwankyerɛ ahorow bi a ɛbɛma awo akwahosan ayɛ papa ne: nnuan ne nnuan nketenkete a wubedi daa na ama w’ahoɔden akɔ so ayɛ den, ne nnuan a calcium ne vitamin D pii wom ma nnompe akwahosan ka ho (te sɛ nufusu mu nneɛma, aburow a wɔahyɛ no den, nhaban momono), dade a ɛdɔɔso a wubenya afi nnuan te sɛ nam a ɛnyɛ den, bankye, ne aburow a wɔahyɛ no den mu de asiw mogya a ɛtɔ kɔ nipadua mu ano, ne omega-3 srade acid fibea ahorow a wode bɛka ho (te sɛ salmon, walnuts, flaxseeds) ma amemene akwahosan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen a LGBTQ+ mmabun hyia wɔ nna mu apɔwmuden ho no bi?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyim anaa ayayade a wonya wɔ wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ, anaa wɔn bɔbeasu ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔte wɔn ahiade ase a wobenya. Nhyɛso a wɔte nka sɛ ɔne heteronormative akwanhwɛ ahorow (straight ne cisgender) bɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ mɛsɔ me nna ho akɔnnɔ ahwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Saa pɛpɛɛpɛ! Nhwehwɛmu yɛ ade a ɛfata a ɛma wuhu onipa ko a woyɛ ne onii ko a w’ani gye ne ho. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ ɔdɔ ho nkate horow mu, wobɛda akɔda, anaasɛ mpo wo ne nnipa ahorow bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ kɛkɛ. Nea ɛho hia ne sɛ wobɛkyerɛ obu ne adwempa ama wo ho ne afoforo, na woahwɛ ahu sɛ honam fam nkitahodie biara a emu yɛ den no yɛ nea wopene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ Intanɛt so a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ hɔ a ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho asɛm a wonsuro atemmu anaa nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ intanɛt so mpɔtam a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wɔ hɔ a ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho asɛm denam: Mpɔtam hɔ akwankyerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow a emu da hɔ a wɔde obu, obiara a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ne tema di kan, na wɔhyɛ so bere nyinaa na ama wɔakura tebea pa ne akwaaba mu ama asɔremma nyinaa. Atipɛnfo mmoa ne biakoyɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wobetumi anya ɔhaw, nyiyim, anaa nsɛm a enye wɔ intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, de nkuranhyɛ, agye atom, ne afotu a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfa akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ho ama. Nne ahorow a efi akuw a wonni ananmusifo anaasɛ wɔato wɔn hintidua mu a wɔma ɛyɛ kɛse na wɔde nsiyɛ kasa tia nsusuwii hunu, animhwɛ, ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nipasu ho denam nkyerɛkyerɛ, nsɛm a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmra anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔnyem wɔ sɛ, wɔpene so sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresabea sɔhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awo ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmra anaa nhyehyeɛ betumi akyerɛ hokwan a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ sɛ wɔpene so sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresabea sɔhwɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awo ho mu denam: Abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne ahwehwɛde a ɛfa pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ahyɛ mu a wɔde besi hɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun ahu asiane, mfaso, ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu no yiye, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi nhwehwɛmu no mu bere biara a wɔrentwe wɔn aso ka ho. Nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ abrabɔ pa ho nhwehwɛmu a emu yɛ den na ahyehyɛde ahorow nhwehwɛmu bagua ahorow pene so de bɔ hokwan ahorow, yiyedi, ne nidi a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu no ho ban. Ahobanbɔ foforo a wɔde bɛma nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ, te sɛ mmabun a wɔyem, na ama asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nhyɛso, dwumadie, anaa ɔhaw a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu tebea mu no so ate, a ahobanbɔ a wɔde bɛma wɔ kokoamsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔbɛnya ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amanaman ntam akwan horow a wɔfa so hwɛ nnipa hokwan ahorow so na wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ, te sɛ apam ahyehyɛde ahorow ne amanneɛbɔfo titiriw, di wɔ aban ahorow a wobu akontaa wɔ wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a wɔde ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ nnipa hokwan ahorow so na wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ, te sɛ apam ahyehyɛde ahorow ne amanneɛbɔfo titiriw, di dwuma titiriw wɔ nniso ahorow a wobu akontaa wɔ wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a wɔde ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu denam: Aman a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ sɛnea aman no adi amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan ho apam ahorow so ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔde ma sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya nkɔso no so. Aman nsrahwɛ ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwɛ nnipa hokwan tebea a ɛwɔ fam no na wɔahu mmeae a ɛhaw adwene. Ankorankoro anwiinwii ne adesrɛ ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔabu nna ne awo hokwan ahorow so no ho mmuaema ne ayaresa ne ano aduru a wɔde bɛma. Amanneɛbɔ ne baguam nsɛm a wɔde bɛma de ama nkurɔfo ate nnipa hokwan ho nsɛm a ɛka mmabun ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ ɔman ne amanaman ntam. Ɔmanfoɔ nnwumakuo, mmabun a wɔyɛ adwumaden, ne mpɔtam a ɛka wɔn a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de aboaboa nsɛm ano na wɔama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛseɛ wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nnipa hokwan ahodoɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow gyina hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ HIV/AIDS ho kwan, a ebi ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya ayaresa, nhwɛsoɔ, ne mmoa nnwuma, ne ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ wɔn ho ban afi animtiaabu ne mmuatwa ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow de di mmabun a wɔwɔ HIV/AIDS ho nsɛm ho dwuma denam: Kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya HIV ho nhwɛsoɔ, ayaresa, ne mmoa a ɛyɛ papa a ɛne mmabun su hyia, ɛyɛ kokoam, na enni nyiyim biara. Mmara a ɛbara nyiyim a egyina HIV anaa AIDS gyinabea so, ne mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ HIV/AIDS no ho ban na ɛbu wɔn anim. Mmara mu mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ a wɔde ma mmabun na wɔatumi asiw animtiaabu anaa wɔn ho kwan a wɔde gye wɔn afi wɔn nsam a ɛfa HIV/AIDS ho no kwan. Ɔman mu HIV/AIDS ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwan a wɔde di dwuma a ɛdi mmabun ahiadeɛ ho dwuma titiriw, na ɛma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi ahorow mu yie. Apɔwmuden ne asetena mu nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔhyɛ no den na ama wɔatumi de mmoa a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ a ɛdi mmofra a wɔwɔ HIV/AIDS ahiadeɛ ho dwuma, a ebi ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya nwomasua, adwene mu apɔwmuden mmoa, ne nna ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ho nhwɛsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu ne wɔn a wɔnyɛ mmarima ne mmea a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu wɔ wɔ bɔbeasu a wogye tom, din a wɔbɛsakra, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho?
answer_twi_source: Jurisdictions bi ma ankorankoro a wɔsakra wɔn bɔbeasu kwan ma wɔyɛ wɔn mmara kwan so bɔbeasu agyiraehyɛde no foforo wɔ nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea so no ma ɛne wɔn bɔbeasu ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu hyia. Nanso, wɔ yɛn wiase no fã no, wobu nsɛm a ɛtete saa sɛ ɛne ɔman mmara nhyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi aguare nsu anaa mɛteɛteɛ m’apɔw mu bere a merebu nsa (mensatruate)?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wubetumi aguare nsu na woateɛteɛ w’apɔw mu.  Nnipa pii hu sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ boa ma 'pimples' so tew na ɛma adwene tu mpɔn. Afotu bi ni: Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Bra: Fa tampon, brayɛ nkuruwa, anaa fa asuguare ntade a nsu ntumi nkɔ w'ase di dwuma na ama wo ho atɔ wo bere a woreguare no. Mpɛn pii no wɔnhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wonguare wɔ nsu a wɔde yɛ ofie dwumadi ahorow wɔ mpɔtam hɔ mu na wɔasiw efĩ ne ɔyare mmoawa ano. Ahotew: Sesa wo brayɛ aduru ansa na woaguare anaa woateɛteɛ w’apɔw mu ne bere a woawie no. Sɛ wode tampon redi dwuma a, hwɛ hu sɛ wode ahyɛ mu yiye na amma nsu ankɔ mu. Awerɛkyekye: Hyɛ ntade a ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛma ahome, titiriw sɛ woreteɛteɛ w’apɔw mu a. Ntama a ɛtwetwe nsu betumi aboa ma woatumi ahwɛ fifiri so. Asuguare ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ betumi aboa wo ankasa ma wo ho atɔ wo wɔ wo brayɛ mu, enti mma ɛnsiw wo kwan sɛ wubenya dwumadi ahorow mu anigye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mfe a obi adi ho nhyeso anaa ahwehwɛde bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma wanya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm, na nkrataa anaa adansedi krataa bɛn na ebia ebehia na ama obi anya bi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mfe a obi adi ho nhyeso biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛma wanya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm, na mpɛn pii no wobetumi anya bi a wɔmfa nnuru a wɔakyerɛw ama no. Nanso, ebia aman  bi wɔ mfe a wɔadi ho nhyeso anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ mmabun di mfe pɔtee bi ansa na wɔatɔ wɔ aduruyɛdan mu. Ebia ɛho renhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw nkrataa anaa nea ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi hu no wɔ nsɛm dodow no ara mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ nna ne awoɔ apommuden mmoa a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'sexual and reproductive healthcare services' ne sɛn na akwansideɛ yi ɛsesa wo mfeɛ, 'gender', abusuakuo, w'asetena mu sikasem, beaeɛ a wɔ wɔ, ne atubrafo gyinabea?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hyia akwansideɛ ahohorow bere a wɔgye nna ne awoɔ apommuden mmoa a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'sexual and reproductive healthcare services. Ebi ne: Mmra akwasideɛ: Mmra a  ɛgye awofoɔ peneeɛ(parental consent). Sika Akwasideɛ: ɛka dwumadie 'cost of services'. Stigma ne fɛreɛ. Beae akwasideɛ: Kwan ne tenten ayɛde kɔ ayaresabea ketewa 'clinic'. Wei sesa wɔ mfeɛ, gender ne beaeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho di wɔ nnwuma ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wonya no mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne Ɔmanfo Nsunsuanso: Animtiaabu: Ebia adwene a ɛnteɛ bɛma animtiaabu aba abusua nhyehyɛe ho, na ama ɛnyɛ nea wobetumi anya bi. Nyamesom mu Gyidi: Amammerɛ mu gyidi anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ahorow bi betumi anya adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no so nkɛntɛnso. Nhomasua: Ɔmanfo su betumi aka abusua nhyehyɛe ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nea ɛyɛ papa. Nkɛntɛnso: Akwanside ahorow a ɛma wonya kwan: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi asiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa abusua nhyehyɛe ho ano, na asiw nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya no kwan. Mmoa: Amammerɛ mu su horow a ɛboa betumi ama wɔagye abusua nhyehyɛe atom na wɔanya kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwennwen ne osuahu soronko a ebia LGBTQ+ ankorankoro behyia, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama wɔn adwenemyare?
answer_twi_source: Pow ne Nyiyim: Ebia LGBTQ+ ankorankoro behyia pow afi abusua, atipɛnfo, anaa ɔmanfoɔ hɔ, na te nka sɛ wɔyɛ ankonam na wɔn akokudru aba fam.
