Adwennwen a Ɛwɔ Nnipa Kakraa Mu: Sɛ obi nya nyiyim, basabasayɛ nketenkete, anaa basabasayɛ esiane ne gender anaa nna mu akɔnnɔ nti no betumi ama wanya adwennwen a enni sabea ne adwenemyare ahorow. Adeyɛ a wɔde hwehwɛ ne bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ mu na wosi so dua no betumi ayɛ den na ebetumi de emu ntawntawdi ne adwenem naayɛ aba. Nanso, mmoa wɔ hɔ ma saa nnipa yi wɔ yɛn asoɛeɛ ahodoɔ no mu - nyamesom akannifoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ne asetena mu akuo foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi ayɛ tebea ahorow a obiara ka ho a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu na ɛhyɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ne wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ 'sexuality a wogye tom no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi ayɛ tebea horow a obiara ka ho denam: Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm ho Ntetee: Tete adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ho. Adesua Nhyehyɛe a Wobetumi Anya: Fa nsɛm a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho. Nhyehyɛe a Ɛko Tia Ayayade: Fa nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den a ɛko tia ayayade a ɛfa nyiyim a egyina dɛmdi ne nna ho akɔnnɔ so di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo awoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ sukuu ahorow ne apomoden kwan so ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ  ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne apomoden ho nhyehyɛe mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate hia a awo apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ mmabun yiyedi so no ase. Wubetumi afi ase denam ɔsatu ahorow a wobɛyɛ anaa wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu de ahyɛ awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran, te sɛ nkrataa a wobɛkyerɛw akɔma sukuu so ahwɛfo anaa mmarahyɛ baguafo, adesrɛ ahorow a wobɛhyehyɛ, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow anaa nhyiam ahorow a wobɛhyehyɛ. Wubetumi nso ne apomodenn ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo adi nkitaho de akamfo awo ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa awo apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu ma mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi sikasɛm ho gyinaesi ahorow te sɛ sika sɛeɛ , boseabɔ basabasa, anaa sikasɛm mu nsisie mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔsɛe sika boro so a, ebetumi ama wɔaboaboa ɛka ano, sikasɛm mu ahokyere, na ayɛ den sɛ wobedi ɛka a ɛho hia ho dwuma. Sika a wɔbɔ bosea a asɛyɛde nnim no betumi ama wɔatua interest kɛse, boseabɔ ho nkontaa a asɛe, na wɔrennya bosea pii daakye. Sɛ obi hwe ase wɔ sikasɛm mu nsisie mu a, ebetumi ama wahwere sika, identity theft, na wanya atenka fam ahokyere, na aka ne sikasɛm mu ahotɔ ne ne yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wim nsakrae nya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) mu nsunsuanso, a awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, awo nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma, ne ɛnanom akwahosan a wobenya ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya: Wim nsakrae betumi asɛe akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, na asiw mmabun a wobenya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, awo nhyehyɛe, ne ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ano, titiriw wɔ mpɔtam a wonni ahobammɔ. Akwahosan mu Asiane: Wim tebea a emu yɛ den a ɛdɔɔso ne nyarewa a ɛsakra esiane wim nsakrae nti no betumi de akwahosan ho asiane aba wɔ nyinsɛn ne awo mu, na aka ɛnanom ne mmofra akwahosan mu nsunsuanso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn pɔtee na ɛma ban a wɔbɔ no ntɛn so de bɔ nyisen ho ban yɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ahobanboɔ adeɛ a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm so no di dwuma yie wɔ berɛ a wɔfa no ntɛm so ara wɔ berɛkro a wɔne obi ada awie a woammɔ ne ho ban. Levonorgestrel-based emergency contraception pills no yahwɛ ahunu sɛ ebetumi ate esane a  ɛwɔ nyisen so bɛyɛ 75% dekɔ pem 89% sɛ wofa no bɛyɛ nnɔnhwere aduoson mmienu mu wɔ berɛ a wo ne obi ada a woammɔ wo ho ban. Ulipristal acetate nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm (ella) yɛ nea etu mpɔn kakra, na wobu akontaa sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru dodow yɛ 85-95% bere a wɔnom wɔ nnɔnhwerew ɔha ne akyire aduonu (120) mu wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware efisɛ: Ɛma wɔn tumi ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua ne wɔn abusuabɔ ho. Ɛboa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔani ndaso ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STIs) ano. Ɛhyɛ abusuabɔ pa, nkitahodi, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho nkuran. Ɛtew animtiaabu ne aniwu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no so. Ɛma mmabun tumi hwehwɛ ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a ɛfata bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na tolisɛm, anansesɛm, ne atetesɛm a wɔde ano ka betumi adi wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun wɔ akwan horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ anigye so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde abakɔsɛm, anansesɛm, ne atetesɛm a wɔde ano ka adi dwuma fi bere tenten sɛ nnwinnade a tumi wom a wɔde bɛma wɔanya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nimdeɛ wɔ akwan horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ anigye so. Ɛdenam anansesɛm, anansesɛm, ne anansesɛm so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi de nkrasɛm a ɛho hia a ɛfa mmabunbere, brayɛ, awoɔ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne awoɔ ho ama. Mpɛn pii no, asuade ahorow a ɛsom bo, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho wɔ saa nsɛm yi mu, na ɛma mmabun tumi nya bi na wɔka ho asɛm. Ɛdenam atetesɛm mu abakɔsɛm a wɔde bɛka nna ho nkyerekyere nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu so no, mmabun betumi asua saa nsɛmti yi ho ade wɔ tebea a ɛne wɔn amammerɛ agyapade ne osuahu ahorow hyia mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia mihia mmoa foforo anaa adwumayɛfo mmoa ma m’adwene mu akwahosan sɛ ɔbabun a ɔte ase a wadi dɛm
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia wubenya mfaso afi adwumayɛfo mmoa mu ni: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho yeraw wo anaasɛ wunni anidaso biara da no fã kɛse no ara, bɛboro adapɛn abien. Nsakrae a ɛba nna anaa aduan ho akɔnnɔ mu: Ɔhaw wɔ nna mu, anaa nsakrae kɛse a ɛba wɔ adidi mu. Dwumadi ahorow a kan no na w’ani gye ho a wobɛtwe wo ho afi ho. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wode w’adwene besi biribi so anaasɛ wubesi gyinae. Dadwen anaa ehu a ɛkɔ soro. Adwene a ɛne sɛ wobepira woho anaasɛ wobekum woho. Sɛ worehyia saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi bi a, ɛho hia sɛ wopri hwehwɛ mmoa. Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo, anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo wɔ ɔhaw ahorow mu nkasa. Kae sɛ mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no yɛ ahoɔden ho sɛnkyerɛnne, na ɛnyɛ mmerɛwyɛ. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa w’adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwumayɛfo anaa afotufo pɔtee bi wɔ sukuu mu a wɔatete wɔn sɛ wonni ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nhyehyɛe ahorow pii a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu a egyina sukuu so no atete adwumayɛfo anaa afotufo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wodi ho dwuma mu. Ebia saa nnipa yi benya ntetee titiriw wɔ nsɛm te sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ, ayayade, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI ano a wosiw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmti bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔka ho asɛm, wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔyɛ ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛmti atitiriw no bi ne: Anatomy ne physiology. Awo ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano.  nnamu nyarewa (STI) a wosiw ano ne ne di. Mpene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa. Bɔbeasu ne nna ho akɔnnɔ. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne gyinaesi. Hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ yɛde yɛn ho hyɛ anom anaa akyi nna mu a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me ho ne me hokafo ho ban afi nna mu yareɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Wɔde Ano: Fa kɔndɔm anaa a wɔde bɔ wo ho ban 'dental dams' di dwuma de bɔ wo ho ban fi nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho bere a wode anom rebɔ. Fa kɔndɔm a ɛyɛ papa sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ dɛ ma nna a wɔde ano ka di dwuma na ama ayɛ anigye kɛse. Akyi nna, nea broni ka no Anal Sex: Fa kɔndɔm a srade pii a wɔde nsu ayɛ wom di dwuma ma akyi nna mu na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛtetew ne nna mu yareɛ a wɔde bɛma obi no so atew. Susuw ho sɛ wode kɔndɔm a ɛyɛ den a wɔayɛ ama ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna wɔ akyi berɛmo mu bedi dwuma de abɔ wo ho ban kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun siw nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye anaasɛ wɔhaw adwene wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw awoɔ ano no ho a, anammɔn bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun tu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun nya awoɔ ano aduru a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye anaasɛ wɔhaw wɔn ho wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nneɛma a edidi so yi: Kɔ apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun kɔ wɔn apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn sɛ wonya nyinsɛn ano aduru a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye, te sɛ kɔndɔm a abubu, awo ano aduru a wɔantumi, anaa ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ anammɔn a edi hɔ a wɔbɛyɛ ho, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, ne nsakrae a wɔbɛdan akɔ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano so. Susuw nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho ntɛm ho: Wɔ nsɛm a esiw nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye anaasɛ nna a wɔmfa ahobammɔ nni dwuma mu no, mmabun betumi asusuw ho sɛ wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm (EC) bedi dwuma de asiw nyinsɛn ano. EC akwan te sɛ Lydia(levonorgestrel) anaa Ella (ulipristal acetate) wɔ hɔ a wɔtɔn wɔ nnurutɔnbea ahorow na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de ama bere a wɔrekɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu no. Wo ne apomoden ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusuw nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ne apomoden ho ɔyaresafo bi susuw nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wɔn anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ɛfa ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw awoɔ ano ho. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nsɛm, mmoa, ne akwankyerɛ ama wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, nea efi mu ba, ne akwan a wɔfa so di ho dwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ sɛ me gyinaeɛ a masi wɔ me nyinsɛn ho no ne me gyidie, nneɛma a memu, ne daakye botaeɛ di nhyia?
answer_twi_source: Susu Wo Gyidie Ho: Gye bere susu deɛ ɛhia wo paa ne sɛnea kwan biara ne wo gyidie hyia ho. Hwehwɛ Akwankyerɛ: Ne nkurɔfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ abusuafoɔ, nnamfo, anaa afotufoɔ, a wɔbetumi aboa wo ma woahwehwɛ sɛnea kwan biara ne wo gyidie hyia nkasa. Susu Daakye Botaeɛ Ho: Dwene wo daakye anisoadeɛhu ne sɛnea kwan biara betumi aboa wo botaeɛ no. Nneɛma a Wɔkyerɛw anaa Adwene a Wɔde Si Biribi So: Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadie te sɛ nkrataa-twerɛ anaa adwene a wɔde si biribi so mu de boa ma wo nsusuuiɛ ho. Fa Daakye Tebea Ahorow Yɛ Mfonini: Twa wo daakye daakye ho mfoni wɔ wo tri mu na hwɛ sɛ wo anamɔntu no bɛboa anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadie ahodoɔ bɛn na wɔbɛtumi afa ahomatrofo so akwahosan "telehealth" ne "digital platforms" so anya?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi afa ahomatrofo "telephone" so akwahosan ne dijitaal akwan so anya akwahosan ho dwumadie ahodoɔ pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nnuruyɛfoɔ a wɔdi kan anaa animdefoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ. Adwene mu akwahosan ho afotu ne ayaresa nhyiam ahorow. Prescription refills ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma. Nyarewa a enni sabea a wɔhwɛ so ne nea wɔhwɛ so. Nhyiam a wɔde di akyi ne oprehyɛn akyi hwɛ. Akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayaresa a wɔde siw yare ano ho nnwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na yɛn abusua gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow nya kwan a yɛfa so di nkitaho fa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ne abusuabɔ ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Yɛn abusua gyinapɛn ne gyidie ahorow yɛ fapem ma nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ ho. Yɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ yɛbɛma tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛnyɛ atemmu a yebetumi asusu saa nsɛmti yi ho pefee, akyɛ nsɛm, na yɛaboa yɛn ho yɛn ho adwene ne nea yɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmu ne akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ nneɛma so, betumi aboa ma wɔasusuw sɛnea asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun no tu mpɔn, ɛfa ho, ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so no ho, na wɔabɔ nhyehyɛe no mu nkɔso ho amanneɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ nneɛma so daa ho hia na ama wɔatumi ahwɛ sɛnea asetena mu nimdeɛ nkɔso nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun no tu mpɔn, ɛfa ho, ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ so. Nhwehwɛmu gyinapɛn betumi ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛfa ahokokwaw a wobenya, adwumayɛ mu nsunsuanso, sika a wobenya, adwumayɛ a ɛbɛkɔ so atena hɔ, asetena ne sikasɛm mu ahoɔden, ne yiyedi nyinaa ho. Akwan a wɔadi afra, a nhwehwɛmu, nsɛmbisa, kuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so nkɔmmɔbɔ, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no hwɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu ka ho no betumi ama wɔanya nhumu a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ nhyehyɛe no adwumayɛ, ahoɔden, nsɛnnennen, ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn ho. Nsɛm a wɔde ma a ɛkɔ so a ɛfa mmabun, nhyehyɛe no mu adwumayɛfo, wɔn a wonya mu mfaso, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ma adesua, nsakrae, ne nneɛma foforo a ɛkɔ so yɛ mmerɛw, na ɛhwɛ hu sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no kɔ so di ahiade ne tebea horow a ɛrekɔ so no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi nya suahunu wɔ nna nna mu, na nsunsuasuo bɛ na wɔnya wɔ wɔn abrabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nkatahodie yɛ 'spectrum', na nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛmdi anya suahunu wɔ akwan ahorow so. akɔnnɔ pɛ: mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi nna mu akɔnnɔ tesɛ obiara. ɔhaw ahohorow: anisoɔ eso ɛtwetwa a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'physical limitations' anaa asetena mu animguaseɛ a yɛdi a atare woho a broni bɛkasɛ 'social stigma' betumi edi ɔhaw wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ye wɔ nna nkatahodie. nkitahodie ho mfasoɔ: Nkitahodie a woabue ano a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'open communication' ho hia wɔ nna suahunu a ema abotɔyem. Nna nkitahodie nya nsusuasuo ahohorow wɔ abrabɔ mu baabiara, nea eka ho: abusuabɔ: ɛhwehwɛ nkitahodie a emu yɛ den na esisi abusuabɔ pa. Honam mfoni: Wo ma honam mfoni pa ne w'ankasa wogyetom a aborɔfo bekase 'self-acceptance' ekɔ so. Adwen mu apɔmmuden: nna nkatahodi betumi ayɛ beaɛ a wonya wo gyidie anaa ayemhyehyeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛhyɛ mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi gyinamafo kena wɔ amanneɛbɔ mu, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Anum nsem asa nea broni ka no "Speechless" (sine): Ababun bi a ɔwɔ yareɛ abroni frɛ no 'cerebral palsy' fa nkitahodiɛ ahomaso 'app' di dwuma de kyerɛ n'atenka ne n'apɛdeɛ. "Biribiara nnyɛ" nea broni ka no "Everything Sucks!" (TV so dwumadie): Ɛwɔ obi a ɔde nan a ɛnyɛ no de twe mpena na ɔfa abusuabɔ mu. "Ehia sɛ yɛkasa fa Kevin ho" (sine): Efa maame ne ba barima demdi abusuabɔ aa wɔfa nyiyimu haw mu. "Zaare Zameen Par" (a ɛkyerɛ "Nsoromma a ɛwɔ Asase So" wɔ Borɔfo mu): India Hindi sine a agye din a ɛfa abofra bi a ɔwɔ adesua mu haw ne sɛnea ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ boa no ma ɔnya ahotosoɔ ne adwene pa ho. Kwan pa a wɔfa so kyerɛ nneɛma ho hia efisɛ: Ɛma Ɛyɛ Ade a Ɛtaa Si: Ɛkyerɛ nna sɛ asetena fa a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo ma mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi. Tumi a wɔde ma: Ɛma mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi hu wɔn ho wɔ kwan pa so. Ɛhyɛ Nteaseɛ Nkuran: Ɛboa nkurɔfoɔ a wɔnni dɛmdi ma wɔte aseɛ na wɔne mmabun a wɔwɔ dɛmdi no te nka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ankasa ne nhyehyɛe a egyina anaa ɛwɔ sukuu mu de wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu, na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu mu ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ nhomasua asoɛeɛ mu a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi ɔhaw ahodoɔ a asuafoɔ hyia ho dwuma, a deɛ ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho ka ho. Ɛtaa yɛ adwuma denam afotu a wɔde ma, wɔde kɔ mmeae a wɔde nneɛma kɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛboa asuafo a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Afotufoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, na nteteeɛ bɛn ne dwumadi ben na wɔwɔ?
answer_twi_source: Adwen mu hwɛfo nea broni kano 'psychologists' (wɔwɔ adokota nteteeɛ). 'LPC (Master's degree)'. 'Social Workers (MSW)'. Adwen mu hwɛfo 'Psychiatrists'' (Dɔkotafoɔ a wɔtwerɛ nnuro).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na PrEP firi mu ba HIV kwan-si akwan horow a wɔaka abom no mu, a kondom deɛ ne nna mu yareɛ (STI) sɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ no daa nso ka ho?
answer_twi_source: PrEP yɛ adwinnade biako pɛ wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔfa so siw HIV ano mu. Kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma ne STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa nso yɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia na ama obi anya nna mu apɔwmuden. PrEP betumi ama ankorankoro a ebia wɔwɔ asiane kɛse mu no abɔ wɔn ho ban foforo afi HIV ho, nanso ɛmmɔ wɔn ho ban mfi STI afoforo ho. Enti, ɛho hia sɛ mmabun de kɔndɔm di dwuma bere nyinaa na wɔyɛ wɔn nhwehwɛmu daa sɛ ebia wɔwɔ STI, sɛ wɔrenom PrEP mpo a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nkabom (partnerships) bɛboa ma yɛanya sika ama ASRH?
answer_twi_source: Wɔkabom de nneɛma/nimdeɛ ba. Ɛma dwumadie no kɔ akyiri. Sika firi mmeammea pii. Nkabom mu ahoɔden.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na awofoɔ ne mmabun betumi afa so aka abom ako atia amammerɛ anaa gyidie ɛha nsabuo ne nna mu apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ: mommɔ dawuro,moka kasa a ɛhoteɛ fa amammerɛ mu gyedie ho na mokyerɛ sɛ amammerɛ ntia nsabuo. Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Monsua amammerɛ anaasɛ gyidie mu nsɛm mmom na mokyerɛ sɛdeɛ amammerɛ ne gyedie hu asabuo ne nna mu nsɛm si fa. Nteaseɛ: Mohwehwɛ baabi a mo nyinaa yɛ adwene na mokyerɛ obuo mma nsonsoeɛ, na monfa m'ani nsi apɔwmuden ne asetenapa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia adwene a ɛne sɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) a obi wɔ no kyerɛ sɛ ne "ho agu fĩ" anaasɛ onni asɛde?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛne sɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) a obi wɔ no kyerɛ sɛ ne "ho agu fĩ" anaasɛ onni asɛde no nyɛ nokware kɛkɛ. Sɛnea wobɛkasa atia ni: nna mu nyarewa (STI) abu so: Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ nna mu no betumi anya nna mu nyarewa (STI), a ne nneyɛe mfa ho. Akwanhyia sisi: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, sɛ wɔbɔ ho ban mpo a, wobetumi de nna mu nyarewa (STI) akɔ. Sɔhwɛ a wobɛyɛ no yɛ asɛde: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ wudwen w’akwahosan ne wo hokafo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minyinsɛn anaa mewo abofra bere a meyɛ ɔbabun a, dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛde ahorow a mewɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wunyinsɛn anaa wowo abofra bere a woyɛ ɔbabun a, hokwan ne w’asɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ: Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wunya ɔhwɛ a edi mũ ansa na woawo, akwan a wobɛfa so awo, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ awo akyi de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wo ne wo ba no akwahosan ne yiyedi. Mmara kwan so asɛde ahorow a ɛfa mmofra mmoa, awofo asɛde, ne gyinaesi ahorow a ɛka wo ba ntetee ne ne yiyedi mu kyɛfa a wonya, sɛnea abusua mmara ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow kyerɛ no. Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wugyina w’ankasa tebea horow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow so si gyinae ahorow a ɛfata wɔ awo ho gyinaesi ahorow ho, a awofoyɛ, mmofra a wogye wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ka ho. Asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma hɔ de adi nyinsɛn anaa awofoɔyɛ mu ɔhaw ne asɛdeɛ ho dwuma berɛ a wode w’akwahosan, nwomasua, ne daakye botaeɛ di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa di wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ na a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ: Ɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne osuahu ahorow a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran. Ɛma asuafo nya ahotoso ne abusuabɔ a ɛda wɔn ntam. Ɔde nhwɛsode ahorow a ɛfa ho ne mmoa fibea ahorow ma. Ɛhyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔpa PrEP dodow bi anaasɛ wɔhaw wɔn ho wɔ sɛnea wɔbɛbata ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hwere PrEP dodow bi a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnom bere a wɔkae ara pɛ. Nanso, sɛ ɛkame ayɛ sɛ bere aso sɛ wɔde dodow a edi hɔ no di dwuma a, ɛsɛ sɛ wohuw dodow a wɔapa no so na wɔnom nea edi hɔ no wɔ bere a wɔtaa de di dwuma no mu. Ɛho hia sɛ woremfa nnuru dodow a wɔde di dwuma no nkɔ soro mmɔho abien na ama woatumi asiesie nea woayera no. Sɛ mmabun haw wɔn ho wɔ batare ho anaasɛ ɛyɛ den ma wɔn sɛ wɔbɛkae sɛ wɔbɛnom wɔn nnuru no a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo kasa. Akwan ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔadi akyi, te sɛ nkaebɔ apps anaa pill nhyehyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a efata sɛ mɛte nka sɛ m’adwene atu afra anaasɛ m’akasakasa wɔ me nna mu akwahosan ho wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata koraa sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ w’adwene atu afra anaasɛ wo ne w’akasakasa wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Eyi yɛ bere a wohwehwɛ onipa ko a woyɛ mu, a wo gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, nneɛma a w’ani gye ho, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ka ho. Ebia wubegye nea w’ani gye ho ne nea w’ani nnye ho, wo gyinabea wɔ fekubɔ akuw mu, anaa wo daakye botae ahorow ho kyim. Saa nhwehwɛmu yi yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛma wonyin na wohu wo nipasu soronko. Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ worennya mmuae no nyinaa ntɛm ara, na ɛho hia sɛ woma wo ho bere de hwehwɛ nneɛma mu na wonyin.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abusua ne mpanyimfoɔ di wɔ sɛnea nnipa bu nna ho nsɛm ne awoɔ ho akwahosan, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama awo ntoatoaso ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso: Abusua ne mpɔtam hɔ mpanyimfo taa nya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ho no mu. Nhomasua: Sɛ wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu ma mpanyimfo a, ebetumi aboa ma gyidi ahorow ayɛ foforo na atew animtiaabu so. Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ma nhyiamu anaa nkɔmmɔdie a ɛka mpaninfoɔ ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nkumaa bom ma wɔkyɛ wɔn adwene. Abakɔsɛm: Hyɛ abasɛm ka nhyiamu a mpaninfoɔ bɛtumi akyɛ wɔn suahunu na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nkumaa atumi asua adeɛ no ho nkuran. Ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom a awo ntoatoaso a wɔanyinyin ne nkumaa nyinaa betumi atie na wɔasua biribi afi wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene mu no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma ahorow bɛn na wɔde ka nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aboa mmabun nipadua ne nkate fam yiyedi wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ adwuma no bi ne: Aduruyɛ mu Nhwehwɛmu: Hwɛ sɛ ebia nipadua mu nsunsuanso bɔne biara a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu no mu aba anaa. Ɛyaw ano aduru: Nnuru anaa nneɛma afoforo a wɔde bɛma de adi ɔhaw anaa ɛyaw biara ho dwuma. Afotu: Nkate fam mmoa ne afotu a wɔde ma de di awerɛhow, afobu, anaa dadwen biara ho dwuma. Afotu a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ho: Nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔbɛfa so asiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da daakye ano. Ɔhwɛ a Wɔde Di Akyi: Yɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwɛ sɛnea obi ho bɛtɔ no na wɔadi nsɛm biara a ɛhaw adwene a ɛkɔ so ho dwuma. Saa nnwuma yi boa mmabun nipadua ne nkate fam yiyedi denam wɔn ayaresa ahiade ahorow a wodi ntɛm ara ne nkate fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ bere a ebetumi ayɛ den mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsonsonoe wɔ nna a wɔde ano ka a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho, nna mu basabasayɛ, ne nna mu nneyɛe afoforo ntam?
answer_twi_source: Bere mpɛn pii no, twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi nna ho no kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi nna mu nneyɛe nyinaa ho no, ankorankoro binom betumi apaw sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi nneɛma pɔtee bi te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaa wɔn akyi berɛmo mu, bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna ho nsɛm afoforo te sɛ nna a wɔde ano ka anaasɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu mu no. Awiei koraa no, ebia nkyerɛase a wɔde ma wɔ twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho no bɛyɛ soronko a egyina ankorankoro gyidi, gyinapɛn, ne ahye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔagyina nyinsɛn ho haw ahorow ano, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wɔbɛpaw, ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, ne awofo ho gyinaesi ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔagyina nyinsɛn ho haw ahorow ano denam: Nsɛm ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwan horow a wobetumi afa so apaw nyinsɛn ho, a nyinsɛn a woyi gu, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, ne awofoyɛ ka ho. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ ɔhwɛ a wobenya ansa na wɔawo no ne akwahosan ho gyinaesi a ɛfata a wosi wɔ nyinsɛn mu ho. Nkate mu nneyɛe, dadwen, ne ehu a ɛfa nyinsɛn ne awofoyɛ ho a wobedi ho dwuma. Akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a wɔde bedi adwennwen ne adwenem naayɛ ho dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa awofoyɛ ho gyinaesi ahorow, asɛyɛde ahorow, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso betumi ayɛ kɛse abɛyɛ biribi a epira anaa asiane wom?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ anaasɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ wɔ tebea horow bi mu, titiriw bere a atipɛnfo hyɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu no. Suban anaa suban mu nsakrae a wohu, te sɛ dadwen anaa adwennwen a ɛkɔ soro wɔ asetra mu tebea horow a atipɛnfo nhyɛso abu so no. Nipadua mu sɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ koma a ɛretu ntɛmtɛm, fifiri, anaa yafunu mu yaw a wubenya bere a wohyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso tebea horow no. Nsakrae a ɛba adamfofa anaa atipɛnfo nkɔso mu a wobɛhwɛ, te sɛ sɛ woanni atipɛnfo akwanhwɛ so a, wobɛte nka sɛ wɔatew wo ho anaasɛ wɔayi wo afi afoforo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn kwan so na mpɔtam dwumadie (community engagement) bɛtumi aboa ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa, awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, mmara-hyɛfoɔ, ne afoforo a asɛm yi fa wɔn no abɔ mu ayɛ adwuma de adi mmaninyɛ ne mmaa-yɛ ho akwahosan (sexual and reproductive health) haw ahorow ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam dwumadie (Community engagement) bɛtumi aboa ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa, awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, mmara-hyɛfoɔ, ne afoforo a asɛm yi fã wɔn no abɔ mu ayɛ adwuma denam:Nkitahodie ne abusuabɔ a wɔma ɛyɛ mmerɛ: Wɔnam nnwumakuo pii so, dwumadie titire so, ne afotufoɔ kuo a wɔhwɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa mmaninyɛ ne mmaayɛ akwahosan ho nsɛm (ASRH issues) so na ɛyɛ saa.Gyinaeɛ a wɔde bɛto nnipa pii so: Wɔhyɛ gyinaeɛ a wɔbom yɛ, pefee-yɛ, ne akontabuo ho nkuran wɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ, ne ne yɛ, ne ne nhwehwɛmu mu.Nneɛma pa a nnipa ahodoɔ de ma a wɔde di dwuma: Wɔde nnipa ahodoɔ ahoɔden ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ no di dwuma de siesie nsɛm bɔne a ɛwɔ hyehyɛeɛ mu, ma dwumadie yɛ papa, na wɔbɔ mmɔden ma mmara sesa.Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu: Wɔhyɛ awofoɔ ne mma nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔkyekyɛ mu no ho nkuran de siesie nsɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ, na ama wɔanya anidie ne mmoa a wɔde ma obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ mmeae a, mmerante ne mmabaa nya adamfofa su a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow pii a ɛfata mmabun wɔ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Wɔatete saa wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma yi ma wɔadi mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade soronko ne wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ, wɔde kokoam ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna ho nsɛm, ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛe a ɛfata a mede hwɛ me ho a ebetumi ama m’adwene mu yiyedi atu mpɔn wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu? (apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, adidi pa).
answer_twi_source: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ma endorphins, abɔde mu nneɛma a ɛma w’adwene yɛ adwuma yiye a ɛma w’adwene tu mpɔn. Akwan a Wɔfa so Gye Ahome: Ɔhome a emu dɔ, adwennwen, yoga, anaa nnwom a ɛma obi dwo a wotie betumi aboa ma wɔadi adwennwen ne dadwen so. Adidi a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Sɛ wode nnuan a ahoɔden wom ma wo nipadua no ma wunya ahoɔden a wode bedi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na woate nka sɛ wo ho ye sen biara. Adebɔ mu Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Kyerɛw, yɛ mfonini, yɛ mfonini, saw, anaa bɔ nnwom de da wo nkate adi na nya ahomegye. Wo ne Afoforo Nkitahodi: Nya bere ne wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafo a wɔboa wo na wɔma wo ho tɔ wo .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan a etu mpɔn a wɔfa so di ankasa ho nsɛm a enye ne emu nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ pefee a ɛfa nipadua mfonini ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu: Nsusuwii bɔne ne ankasa kasa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobehu na wɔahu. Asɛnnennen: Gyidi ahorow a ɛnteɛ na ɛyɛ nokware a wobegye ho kyim na wɔde adwene a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ ayamhyehye kɛse asi ananmu. Ne Ho Mmɔborohunu: Obi a ɔde ayamye ne ntease di ne ho dwuma, gye sintɔ ahorow tom a onni atɛn. Nsɛm a Wɔde Si Adi Pa: Nsɛm a wɔde si so dua pa ne nsɛm a wɔka fa wɔn ho a wɔde di dwuma de ko tia ankasa ho nsɛm a enye na wɔhyɛ ankasa bo a ɛsom mu den. Nkate mu Suban Ho Akwan: Nhumu nhyehyɛe foforo akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma de akasa atia na wɔasan asiesie nsusuwii a wɔakyinkyim a ɛfa nipadua mfonini ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahotoso ne obu ama me ho de ahotoso ahyɛ m'ahyeɛ so na menni ɛfobu anaasɛ minsuro sɛ afoforo bebu me atɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso ne obu a wubenya wɔ wo ho a wobenya no betumi aboa wo ma wode ahotoso asi w’ahyeɛ so na wunnim afobu anaasɛ wunsuro sɛ afoforo bebu wo atɛn. Fa wo ho a wobɛsi so dua di dwuma denam w’ahoɔden ne nea woatumi ayɛ a wubegye atom, botae ahorow a wubetumi de asisi w’ani so, ne wo ho a wobɛka a enye a wobɛkasa atia no so. Fa nnamfo ne afotufo a wɔboa wo a wɔma wo nkate ne nea wopaw no twa wo ho hyia, na fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wote ahotoso ne tumi nka mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛ boa ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) botae ahorow ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan wɔ amanaman ntam no nya nkɔsoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuo boa denam nneɛma, nimdeɛ, ne osuahu a ɛfiri nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔdi dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa a wɔboaboa ano no so, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ na wɔde akwan a ɛtu mpɔn a wɔbɛfa so ama 'ASRH' nsunsuansoɔ atu mpɔn. Saa adwumayɛkuo yi boa nimdeɛ a wɔkyɛ, tumi a wɔde hyɛ mu, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfoɔ, na ɛma nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛwɔ nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no nya no yɛ kɛseɛ na ɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ ho nkuran wɔ ɔman ne amanaman ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya gyidie ne ahotɔsoɔ wɔ nna mu dwumadie mu?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ wo ho. Pɛ nimdeɛ. Kasa nsɛm pa ma wo ho. nipada mu adwenepa. Hwehwɛ pene anaa sɛ ahyeɛ ahodoɔ. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi ayɔnkofoɔ anaa adwenemhwɛfo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛnanom a wonnii mfe aduonu a wɔwɔ 'HIV' no betumi anya ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ne ''PMTCT dwumadie ma?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnanom a wɔadu mpanyin afe so a wɔwɔ 'HIV' no betumi anya ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo ne 'PMTCT' dwumadie denam akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ so, a ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan ayaresabea, ayaresabea, mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛeɛ, ne HIV hwɛbea titire ka ho. Aman bebree de nhyehyeɛ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so titire sɛ wɔbɛma ɛnanom ne mmofra akwahosan ho dwumadie a 'PMTCT' ka ho no atu mpɔn ama mmabun ne ɛnanom nkumaa a wɔwɔ 'HIV' no adi dwuma. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi betumi de nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun, atipɛnfo mmoa, ne afotu a wɔayɛ ama wɔn de adi ɛnanom nkumaa ahiade soronko ho dwuma ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma anaa afutuo bɛn na ɛhyɛ awoɔ ntotoeɛ ho afutuo mu?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ ntotoeɛ ho afutuo mu no, nnwuma pii na ɛwom a wɔayɛ ama nnipa atumi asi gyinaeɛ a nyansa wom fa wɔn awoɔ ne wɔn apɔmuden ho. Ebi ne: Nsɛm a ɛfa akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho. Nhomasua a ɛfa awo nipadua ne nipadua ho nimdeɛ ho. Afotu a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so hu awo ho. Akwankyerɛ a ɛfa awo ho ayaresa a wɔpaw ho. Nyinsɛn nhyehyɛe ne afotu a wɔde ma ansa na wɔanyinsɛn. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu apɔmuden ne STI ano a wosiw ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ne awo apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a awofoɔ mpene so anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun betumi anya awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a awofo mpene so anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu. Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow gu ahorow wɔ ɔmantam biara mu, nanso wɔtaa yɛ kokoam nnwuma de bɔ mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne ahofadi ho ban. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayi afi mu anaasɛ anohyeto ahorow wɔhɔ, titiriw wɔ akwan horow bi so anaasɛ wɔ tumidi pɔtee bi mu. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hu wɔn hokwan ahorow ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde benya ɔhwɛ wɔ kokoam sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm so bere a wɔde ahokyere mu nea aborɔfo fre no 'intervention' ne mmoa ma mmabun no?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm so akosi ase bere a wɔde nea aborɔfo fre no 'crisis intervention' ne mmoa ma mmabun no. Nanso, ebia ebehia sɛ wɔda nsɛm adi wɔ tebea horow bi mu, te sɛ bere a asiane wɔ hɔ sɛ obepira ɔbabun no anaa afoforo ntɛm ara no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun so, te sɛ ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne mmerɛwyɛ a wɔtew so, nnwuma a ɛho hia a wobenya atu mpɔn, nhomasua ne apɔmuden mu nkɔso a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne mmusua a wɔboa wɔn wɔ ahokyere anaa ahokyere bere mu?
answer_twi_source: Ohia a Wɔtew So: Asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow boa ma wɔma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua fi ohia mu denam sika fam mmoa a wɔde ma, nnwuma a ɛho hia a wonya, ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma asetra ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso so. Nnwuma a Wonya a Ɛtu Mpɔn: Asetra mu ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow hwɛ ma wonya nhomasua, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, aduan pa, ne nnwuma afoforo a ɛho hia, na ɛma akwahosan ne yiyedi pa ba mmabun. Hokwan a Ɛkɔ Anim: Ɛdenam mmerɛwyɛ ahorow a wɔtew so ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano a ɛkɔ soro so no, asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma mmabun nya hokwan ahorow sɛ wɔbɛkɔ nhomasua, ntetee, adwuma, ne adwumayɛ, na ɛde asetra mu hokwan ahorow ne sikasɛm mu anidaso ahorow a ɛkɔ anim ba. Ɔhaw Mmoa: Wɔ sikasɛm mu ahodwiriw, abɔde mu asiane, ntawntawdi, anaa tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu no, asetra mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma ahobammɔ afiri a ɛbɛboa mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ma wɔagyina bere tiaa mu ahokyere ano na wɔakura asetra gyinapɛn atitiriw mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan adi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ne osuahu ahorow, na dɛn nti na eyi ho hia?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ anohyeto ahorow mpo wɔ hɔ a, Ghana mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akwan adi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn suahu ahorow na wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Social Media: Yɛ nsɛm (te sɛ posts, videos, blogs) a ɛfa w’asetra, ne w’anigyede ho. Di adebɔfo afoforo a wɔadi dɛm ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛhwɛ mmubuafo hokwan ahorow so akyi na wo ne wɔn di nkitaho. Fa hashtags a ɛfata di dwuma de ne atiefo a wɔdɔɔso di nkitaho (#DisabilityRights #DisabilityIsDiversity). Intanɛt so Mpɔtam: Kɔka intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa akuo a wɔyɛ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ Ghana (sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a) na wɔnkyɛ osuahu na wɔaboa wɔn ho wɔn ho. Susuw ho sɛ wubefi w’ankasa intanɛt so atenae ase (a egyina ahotɔ dodow so) de asusuw dɛmdi ne nna ho wɔ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom so. Adebɔ Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Fa platform ahorow te sɛ YouTube anaa Instagram kyɛ adebɔ mu nsɛm te sɛ nnwom, adwinni, anaa nkyerɛwee a ɛda wo suahu ahorow adi. Dɛn Nti na Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ Ho Hia? Nea Wohu ne Nea Wogyina Hɔ: W’asɛm no betumi aboa afoforo ma wɔnate nka sɛ ɛyɛ wɔn nkutoo na wɔwɔ hɔ. Mpɔtam a Wɔbɛkyekye: Osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no betumi ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔne mmabun afoforo a wɔadi dɛm wɔ abusuabɔ. Nsusuwii a Ɛyɛ Nsɛnnennen: Ɛdenam w’ankorankoro ne wo talente a wobɛda no adi so no, wubetumi akasa atia nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa dɛmdi ho. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Wo nne betumi aboa ma wɔabɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛtrɛw a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a mmubuafo wɔ ne nea wɔde wɔn ka ho. Kae: Ahobammɔ Di kan: Fa w’ahobammɔ ne ahotɔ di kan bere a worekyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so no. Fa w’adwene si Tumi so: Fa w’ankasa nsɛm ka w’asɛm na si w’ahoɔden ne w’adwene so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ngyina sie bi ma me adwene sesasesa (mood swings) anaa m'aba mu abu (depression) a mɛyɛ dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Honam mu nkwammoa (Hormones) aduru a wɔnom te sɛ 'pill' tumi de adwene nsesae (mood swings) ba. Sɛ wohu saa nsakrae yi a Kasa kyerɛ wo dɔkota. Wɔbetumi asesa wo aduro no, akyerɛ wo kwan foforo, anaa wɔaboa wo ma woagyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia wɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa mmoa akuw a wobenya mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi eyinom ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhaw Ahorow a Ɛwɔ Hɔ (Challenges)Ahoɔden ne Nneɛma a Ɛnnɔɔso (Limited Resources): Mmoa mmeaeɛ a wobɛtumi akɔ hɔ ankasa (in-person) wɔ Ghana ha bɛtumi ayɛ den anaa ɛnnɔɔso.Akwantuo (Transportation): Mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔnyɛ mmerɛ wɔ nanteɛ mu (mobility limitations) bɛtumi ahyia ɔhaw mmerɛ a wɔrekɔ nhyiamu ahorow ase.Abɛfo Ntentan mu Akwansideɛ (Technology Access): Sɛ obi nnya kwan mmra "internet" so anaa onni afidie te sɛ fon (phone) a, ɛbɛtumi asi no kwan sɛ ɔbɛde ne ho bɛhyɛ abɛfo ntentan so nkabom mu.Sɛnea Yɛbɛdie Ho Dwuma (Addressing Challenges)Abɛfo Ntentan so Nhyiamu (Virtual Options): Pere ma abɛfo ntentan so mmoa akuo (online support groups) anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbom mmienu nyinaa (online ne anim-ne-anim nhyiamu).Akwan a Obiara Bɛtumi Afa So (Accessibility): Hwɛ na mmeaeɛ a wɔhyia no yɛ baabi a obiara bɛtumi afa hɔ, na sɛ ɛbɛtumi ayɛ yie a, mo mmoa mma wɔnnya akwantuo mmoa.Mpɔtam Nteteeɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ (Outreach Programs): Hyehyɛ mpɔtam nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ nkuro mu na ama mo nsa aka mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ a wɔnni kwan mmra abɛfo ntentan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔde redi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ASRH mu no yɛ nea ntease wom, nea ɛka obiara ho, na ɛtra hɔ daa, sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne kwan so de anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛwɔ soro?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ASRH mu a nteaseɛ wom, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛkɔ so daa no bi ne: Hokwan a wɔbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesie akwan nyinaa mu, ɛfiri nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde besi hɔ so kɔsi dwumadie ne nhwehwɛmu so. Nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama nkɔmmɔdie ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmabun ne wɔn a wɔsi gyinaeɛ ntam, hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛbu mmabun adwene sɛ ɛsom boɔ na wɔde ahyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ nkɔsoɔ mu. Ntetee ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ hokwan a wɔde bɛma mmabun de ahokokwaa ne nimdeɛ a ɛhia na wɔatumi akamfo wɔn nneɛma a ɛhia paa no yie na wɔaboa ASRH nnwuma. Kwan a wɔbɛfa so abu akontaa ne mmuaeɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa mmabun ntoboa aniberesɛm na ɛde nsunsuansoɔ a ɛda adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina nyiyim anaa adwemmɔne a nkorɔfoɔ wɔ ma wɔn a wɔwɔ mmabunyɛ berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Kasa bere a wuhu sɛ wɔreyɛ deɛ ɛnteɛ de tia afoforɔ. Fa wo nne kasa tia nsɛm anaa nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ yaw so. Boa wɔn a wɔato wɔn agu nkyɛn anaasɛ wɔyɛ nyiyim tia wɔn no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abɔ amanne sɛ wɔabu kokoam nsɛm so anaasɛ wɔabu wɔn kokoam hokwan ahorow so bere a wɔrenya ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mmoa ho nnwuma mu no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi abɔ kokoam nsɛm a wɔabu so ho amanneɛ akyerɛ atumfoɔ anaasɛ wɔde adwumayɛbea no amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe te sɛ anwiinwii pon, telefon nɔma, email, nyansahyɛ adaka, anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ adwumayɛbea no panyin amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na afei de nnwumakuw a wɔboa nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ Ghana yɛ de hwehwɛɛ hokwan de ma wɔn, a mmabun betumi akyi anaa wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ghana Federation of Disability Organizations (GFD): GFD yɛ nnwumakuw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ho nhyehyɛe mu wɔ Ghana, na wɔbom yɛ adwuma de hwehwɛ hokwan de ma wɔn . Wɔyɛ mmɔdenbɔ ho ɔsatu ahorow, nhomasua ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mmoa ho nnwuma . Special Olympics Ghana: Wɔhyɛ nnipa nyinaa nkuran na wɔde akwammɔne kwan ma mmofra ne mpanyimfo a wɔn adwene nni nipadua mu yiye, denam agodie so . Wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow de hyɛ obiara nkuran ma ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu na wosoma nsɛm fa ho.  Nkabom Ghana:Wɔde wɔn adwene si mmɔdenbɔ a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔn adwene nni nipadua mu yiye nya ho, ne sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛka obiara ho so  Wɔyɛ nsɛm ho ɔsatu ahorow na wɔde mmoa ma mmusua.  ɔkasamafokuo ne Kyerɛ ne Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Fa wo ho kɔhyɛ afahyɛ ahorow te sɛ Amanaman Ntam Da a Wɔahyira so ama Nnipa a Wɔadi Dɛm, a wɔyɛ nnwuma ahorow ne mmɔdenbɔ ho ɔsatu ahorow wɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nkabom a wɔne ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo bɛyɛ no de wɔn ahiade ne wɔn anigyede di kan?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nkabom ahorow de wɔn ahiade ne wɔn anigye di kan denam gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen, wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, ne ahokafo a wɔbɛma wɔabu wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow ho akontaa no so. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, de nsɛm ama, na wɔne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no ayɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe na wɔasɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛne wɔn tebea soronko ne wɔn apɛde ahorow hyia no ahwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya dabere a ahobammɔ wom wɔ ɔhaw bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya dabere anaa dan denam telefon a wɔde boa anaa asetra mu nnwuma a wɔbɛkɔ akɔsra wɔn, adan anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a wɔbɛkɔ, abisa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di sɛ wɔmmoa wɔn, ne nkrataa anaa nhwehwɛmu biara a wɔhwehwɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de anya mmoa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na aban ahorow, amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow, ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de (NGOs), ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu di wɔ asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun, die di dwuma, na wɔhwɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Aban ahorow: Aban ahorow no asɛde ne sɛ wɔhyehyɛ nhyehyɛe, mmara, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho na wɔkyekyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma. Amanaman Ntam Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Amanaman Ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow de mfiridwuma ho mmoa, sika, ne mmoa a wɔde kyekye tumi a wɔde hyɛ ɔman no asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den na wɔhyɛ wiase nyinaa gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho nkuran. NGOs: NGOs di dwuma titire wɔ asetena mu ahobanbɔ dwumadie a wɔde ma, ɛkamfo nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ, ne tumi a wɔma mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne di mu. Ahyehyɛdeɛ a Ɛgyina Mpɔtam Hɔ: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ so de mmoa a ɛfiri mpɔtam hɔ ma, wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn, na wɔyɛ adwuma bom de hwɛ sɛ asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no di mpɔtam hɔ ahiadeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛhia titire ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma anaa mmoa bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow taa de ma mmabun wɔ ASRR ahorow ho? (Akwahosan ho dwumadi a ɛyɛ kokoamsɛm, nwomasua nhyiamu, mmoa akuo)
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam ahyehyɛde ahorow de mmoa ahorow ma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan Ho Dwumadibea a Ɛwɔ Ahintasɛm Mu: Ebinom betumi de nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, awo ano aduru a wobetumi apaw, anaa STI nhwehwɛmu ama (ne nyinaa yɛ kokoam!). Nhomasua Nhyiamu: Saa nhyiamu yi fa nsɛmti te sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa, pene a wɔpene so, ne nipadua mfonini ho. Mmoa Akuw: Akuw ma baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi ne mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo a wohyia osuahu ahorow a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya wɔn adwuma hokwan ne wɔn asɛde ahorow ho nsɛm, a  aban ahyehyɛde ahorow, adwumayɛfo akuw, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ nso ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn adwuma hokwan ne asɛde ahorow ho denam: Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow: Adwumayɛ dwumadibea ahorow, adwumayɛ adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne mmabun adwumayɛbea ahorow de nsɛm a ɛfa adwumayɛ ho mmra, adwumayɛbea hokwan ahorow, ne mmra mu ahobammɔ a wɔde ma mmabun adwumayɛfo ho ma. Adwumayɛfo akuw: Adwumayɛfo akuw anaa adwumayɛfo ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔne wɔn di nkitaho no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasua adwumayɛfo kuw apam, adwumayɛkuw hokwan ahorow, ne akwan a wɔfa so di adwumam anwiinwii ho dwuma. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, akuw a wɔkamfo mmabun, ne ayaresabea ahorow a wɔboa mmra ma wɔde nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛfa adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wɔfa so kamfo nkurɔfo ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsoeɛ bɛn na ɛda aban amanenya (criminal) ne ankorankoro amanenya (civil)  ntam wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ (sexual violence) mu na mmra kwan so mmoa te sɛ asɛm a wɔde kɔdan asɛnnibea (criminal prosecution), ahyɛde ahorow a ɛbɔ ho ban (protective orders), ne  mmara mu nsɛm (civil lawsuits) bɛn na wɔdi boa wɔn a wowɔ sa tebea nu mu ?
answer_twi_source: Aban amanenya (criminal): Ɔman na ɛbɔ no sobo (asotwe afiase/asotwe). Ankorankoro amanenya: Mmara mu asɛm a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu de kɔdan wɔn de gye nneɛma a wɔsɛee no (akatua). Ahyɛde ahorow a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban no siw nkitahodi ano
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔrehyia abusuabɔ mu ayayade anaa basabasayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Aane, nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔrehyia abusuabɔ mu ayayade anaa basabasayɛ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ntrɛwmu ne mmoa nhama a wɔde boa kokoam mmoa ne afotu Afotu adwuma ne mmoa akuw a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ ayayade mu Dabere ne afie a ahobammɔ wom ma ankorankoro a wɔreguan ayayade tebea horow Mmara mu mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde mmoa ma wɔ ahobammɔ ahyɛde ne mmara kwan so de ho Intanɛt so nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛfa abusuabɔ pa ne ayayade ho kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne ho. online platforms: Agoo SHE+ online platform denam 5100 a wobɛfrɛ so, YENKASA Nnɔmba a wontua hwee(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu de adi sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwanya ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu denam sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano, ne mmara mu nsakrae ne aban nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma sikasɛm mu atɛntrenee ne akwanya ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ ama mmerante ne mmabaa nyinaa a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so. Eyi betumi ayɛ ɔsatu ahorow ho nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban, ɔmanfo nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, na wɔne nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ayɛ biako de ahyɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a edi nea ɛde sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe ba no ntini ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu abusuabɔ pa ne mpeneso ma mmabun ho? (nkyerɛkyerɛ wɛbsaet ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Websitet ahorow: Planned Parenthood: https://www.plannedparenthood.org/ (nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm) Scarleteen: https://www.scarleteen.com/ (nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma mmabun) Adwumayɛbea ahorow: Planned Parenthood ne ahyehyɛde afoforo taa de nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nna mu abusuabɔ pa ne mpeneso ho ma. YMK app "filla" ɔfa kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bi wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm ho nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ayɛ, nsakrae wɔ wim nsakrae ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ wim nsakrae mu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ  nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) dwumadie no bɛkɔ so ama mmabun denam wɔne Mpɔtam Akwahosan Ho Dwumadie Boayikuo (CHMC) a wɔbɛyɛ biako wɔ akwan a wɔbɛfa so atew asiane a ɛba wɔ atoyerɛnkyɛm so, nnwuma a wɔde gyina ano no a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn, ahoɔden fibea ahodoɔ a wɔbɛfa so, nneyɛeɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa a wɔbɛgye atom, ne wim tebea a wɔbɛsakra no a wɔde bɛka akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dɛmdi ne akwahosan tebea ahorow a enni sabea ne nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ mmabun mu no hyia?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ne akwahosan tebea ahorow a enni sabea ne nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ mmabun mu esiane nipadua, adwene, ne nkitahodi mu akwanside ahorow, ne ɔmanfo animtiaabu ne nyiyimu nti no twam. Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ nsɛm, nnwuma, ne mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wobenya ho, na ɛde nsonsonoe bɛba akwahosan mu aba ne yiyedi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ menya STI no so? (kɔndom, nkitahodi a wɔne ahokafo di, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer_twi_source: Condoms (Kapue): Sɛ wode "condom" bɛdi dwuma berɛ biara a wobɛnya nna (fa awoɔ baa mu, mmarima mu, anaa ano so) no ne kwan a ɛyɛ paa a wɔfa so te asiane a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa (STIs) pii mu. Paw "latex condom" na ama wanya banbɔ a ɛyɛ papa. Sɛ "latex" nnye wo nipadua (allergy) a, ne akwahosan ho adwumfoɔ nkasa na wɔakyerɛ wo akwan afoforɔ.Nkitahodiɛ (Communication): Wone wo dɔfo(nom) mmɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛmu da hɔ na nokware wom fa nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho ansa na moahyɛ nna ase. Siesie mo nna mu asetena a atwam ho nsɛm ne dadwene biara a wowɔ. Mfomsoɔ biara nni mu sɛ wobɛbisa wo dɔfo sɛ ne ho bɛtumi atɔ no sɛ mobɔ mu kɔyɛ nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho nhwehwɛmu a.Nkitahodiɛ a ɛfa nnipa mmienu pɛ ho (Mutually Monogamous Relationship): Sɛ wobɛtena nkitahodiɛ a ɛkyɛ mu a wo dɔfo baako pɛ na ɔne wo nya nna (na wo nso wo ne no pɛ nya nna) no bɛtumi ate nna mu nyarewa (STIs) asiane no so kɛseɛ. Nanso, mpo wɔ nkitahodiɛ a ɛte saa mu no, wɔtu fo sɛ monyɛ nhwehwɛmu berɛ ne berɛ.Te nna mu dɔfonom dodoɔ so (Reduce Number of Sexual Partners): Dodoɔ a wo nna mu dɔfonom dɔɔso no, saa ara na asiane a ɛwɔ sɛ wobɛnya nna mu yareɛ (STI) no kɔ soro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne na ɛkyerɛ sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso renya yɛn adwene mu kwan a enye, na bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Nsakrae a Ɛba Suban Mu: Nsakrae a ɛda adi wɔ suban, adwene, anaa atenka mu, te sɛ abufuw a ɛkɔ soro, twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho, anaa nneyɛe a wɔmfa nyɛ hwee. Nipadua mu Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Nipadua mu sɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ ti pae, yafunu mu yaw, nsakrae a ɛba wɔ adidi anaa nna mu, anaasɛ ɛyaw ne ɛyaw a wontumi nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Adesua mu Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ fam: Adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, anaa nea ɛkanyan obi a ɛso tew esiane adwennwen anaa nsɛm a ɛfa atipɛnfo ho a wɔde wɔn adwene si so nti. Tew a Wɔtew Wɔn Ho Anaasɛ Wɔtwe Wɔn Ho: Asetra mu tebea horow a wɔkwati, dwumadi ahorow ho anigye a wɔhwere, anaasɛ wɔn nnamfo ne abusuafo a wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi afoforo ho. Sɛ saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi kɔ so anaasɛ ɛsiw da biara da dwumadi anaa yiyedi kwan kɛse a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma wɔ hɔ wɔ kokoam, a awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no nka ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mpɛn pii no, wɔde STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe ma mmabun wɔ kokoam a wɔnma awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no nka ho. Apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo de ayarefo kokoamsɛm di kan na wobu hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ awo ne nna mu apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda mmuae a ɛyɛ katee "assertive", nea ɛnyɛ hwee 'passive', ne nea ɛyɛ basabasa "agressive" ntam wɔ asetena anaa nnipa ntam tebea horow mu, na dɛn nti na wobu asɛm a wɔka no denneennen "assertiveness" sɛ nkitahodi kwan a etu mpɔn sen biara?
answer_twi_source: Mmuae a ɛyɛ den hwehwɛ "assertive response" sɛ wode ahotoso ne obu bɛda w’ahiade ne w’adwene adi, mmuae a ɛnyɛ hwee hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛkwati ntawntawdi na woabu w’ani agu w’ankasa w’ahiade so de agye afoforo atom, na mmuae a ɛyɛ hu hwehwɛ sɛ woka w’ahiade ahorow a ɛyɛ den a wode bɛsɛe afoforo hokwan ne wɔn nkate. Wobu asɛm a wɔka no denneennen sɛ nkitahodi kwan a etu mpɔn sen biara efisɛ ɛma wutumi si hokwan ne w’ahiade ahorow so dua bere a woda so ara bu afoforo hokwan ne wɔn atinka, na ɛma wunya obu ma wo ho wo ho, abusuabɔ pa, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru a etu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi dwuma, nsɛmma nhoma, anaa ankoranko a ho nsusuye ahorow dwuma  ma m’ahye mu ada hɔ, de nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ den adi dwuma, na matumi agyina ano wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɔne a mɛko atia no mu?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadie a wobɛdi, nsɛmma a woma, ne wo ho a wobɛdwene ho apɔmuden foforɔ bɛtumi aboa ama w’ahyeɛ mu ada hɔ, de nkitahodiɛ a ɛyɛ den adi dwuma, na ama woatumi agyina ano wɔ atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ bɔne a wobɛko atia no mu. Dwumadi a wodi no ma wutumi yɛ asetena mu tebea horow ankasa ho mfonini na wode mmuae a ɛyɛ katee a wɔde ma wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho no di dwuma wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na wɔahyɛ so. nsɛmma a woma betumi aboa wo ma woahwehwɛ na woaka wo nsusuwii, nkate, ne ahye, ahu nhwɛso anaa nea ɛkanyan, na woadi wo nkɔso akyi bere a bere kɔ so no. Fa wo ho hyɛ wo ho adwennwen mu daa na ama wo nteaseɛ a wowɔ wɔ wo ahyeɛ ho no mu ayɛ den, ahyɛ wo nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ mu den, na woanya ahotosoɔ wɔ wo ho a wobɛsi so dua wɔ tebea a emu yɛ den mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa nneɛma bɛn na yebetumi de adi dwuma de ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nhoma, nsɛm, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma ho ayɛ mmerɛw?
answer_twi_source: Bom hwehwɛ nhoma, nsɛm, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛfata mfe a woadi a ɛka nsɛmti a ɛho hia a wopɛ sɛ wosusuw ho no mu. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛma wonya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, adwene ahorow, ne afotu a mfaso wɔ so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Fa saa nneɛma yi di dwuma sɛ nsɛm a wubefi ase abɔ nkɔmmɔ, na ama woatumi ahwehwɛ nsɛmti no mu kɔ akyiri na woadi nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen biara a ɛbɛsɔre ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a egyina gyidi so, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde afoforo di wɔde boa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw yare ano na wɔde di dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a egyina gyidi so, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde afoforo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano a wɔde di dwuma mu de nam nhyiam ahorow a wɔde ma ma nhomasua, nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi, ne mmoa so. Saa asoɛe ahorow yi taa nya kwan kɔ mmabun nkyɛn tẽẽ na wobetumi de mmeae a wɔahyehyɛ ama de nkrasɛm a wɔde siw yare ano ama, ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw, na wɔde ankorankoro ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma abɔ. Wobetumi nso ayɛ mmeae a mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, mmarahyɛ baguafo, ne mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo bɛyɛ biako, a 'coordinate' nsi ano mmɔdenmɔ na wɔakyɛ nneyɛe pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nkitahodie ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obu ne ɛnteaseɛ wom na ɛka obiara bom wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nkitahodie ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa obu ne nteaseɛ ho na ɛka obiara bom wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ denam ɔsatu ahorow a asuafo di anim a wɔbɛyɛ, adesrɛ a wɔde bɛkɔ sukuu mpanyimfo anaa nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akuw a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban, ne sukuu baguafo nhyiam anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Wobetumi nso ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho denam abɛɛfo ntentanfidie, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobɛma mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa ate.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsunsuanso a wim nsakrae de ba mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe so?
answer_twi_source: Wim nsakrae betumi anya asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsunsuanso kɛse wɔ mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwaahosan (SRH) nnwuma so, a nea ɛka ho ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔsɛe no, tu a wotu fi wɔn afie mu esiane wim tebea a emu yɛ den nti, asetrade a wɔhwere, aduan a wonnya nni, ne mmerɛwyɛ a ɛkɔ soro wɔ nnipa a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ne basabasayɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ sɛ wonnim sɛ ebia wɔn tebea no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn wɔ mmara mu anaasɛ nkamfoɔ kwan so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun nnim sɛ ebia wɔn tebea no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn wɔ mmara kwan so anaasɛ wɔkamfo wɔn a, wobetumi: Ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi mpaninfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa afotubɔfoɔ hɔ, a ebia wobetumi de mmoa ama na wɔaboa ma wɔasusu hia a ehia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmara mu no ho. Di mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkorɔfo, anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde wɔn kɔ hɔ no nkyɛn na woasusu wɔn haw ahorow ho na woanya akwankyerɛ wɔ sɛ ebia wɔn tebea no fata mmara kwan so mmoa anaa. Yɛ nsɛm a esisi, nkitahodi, anaa nkitahodi biara a ɛfa wɔn ahokyere tebea ho ho nkrataa to hɔ, a ebetumi aboa ma wɔahu hia a ehia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmara mu a, ɛde adanse a ɛsom bo bɛma. Di mfomso wɔ ahwɛyiye afã na hwehwɛ mmara mu afotuo sɛ wɔwɔ adwenem naayɛ anaa dadwen bi wɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow, ahobammɔ, anaa yiedi ho wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan tebea horow ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso ne nsunsuanso bɔne bɛn na ɛwɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔban wɔ nyisen ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso: Nyinsɛn a Wosiw Ano: Mfaso titiriw a ɛwɔ akwan horow nyinaa so. Mfaso a Ɛnyɛ Nyinsɛn a Wosiw: Akwan bi, te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde hormonal bammɔ nneɛma a wode di dwuma no betumi ama wo acne atu mpɔn, ama woatumi abu wonsa yie na ate nsabuo mu yaw so. Nsunsuanso bɔne: Nsakrae a ɛba nkwaadɔm mu: Ebetumi ama nsakrae aba mogya a ɛba brayɛ mu, adwene a ɛsakra, anaa nufu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw no mu. Akwan a Ɛnyɛ Hormone: Kɔndɔm betumi ama ankorankoro binom abufuw. Adwumayɛ: Nkitahodi a Wobue: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusuw nsunsuanso bɔne ho. Akwan a Wɔfa so Sesa: Sɛ worehyia ɔhaw ahorow a wontumi nnyina ano a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛdan akɔ ɔkwan foforo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi nkanyan nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakamfo wɔn nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ mantɔw mu, ɔman no mu, ne amanaman ntam?
answer_twi_source: Nimdeɛ Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Mmabun a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ bɛma wɔn de aka wɔn ahiade ne hokwan ahorow. Mmabun Akannifoɔ: Nteteeɛ ne hokwan a wɔde bɛma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛdi dawurbɔ anim, wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na wɔne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne amanaman ntam nkitahodiɛ. Wiase Nyinaa Nkitahodi: Mmabun a wɔde bɛka wiase nyinaa nkitahodi ne nhyiam ase a wobetumi ama wɔn adwenmu ayɛ kɛse, akyɛ osuahun ahorow, na wɔabom akamfo SRH hokwan ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti bi ho, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho dwuma de ma mmabun ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu na ɛboa?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti bi ho, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho dwuma, denam tebea horow a ɛnyɛ atemmu na ɛboa a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ a wɔde bɛka wɔn haw ne nea wɔpɛ ho asɛm no so. Ebia eyi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde kokoam hwɛ a wɔde ma, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu a wɔde bɛma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho so, na wɔakyerɛ obu ama ayarefo ahofadi ne gyinaesi. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nso betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ntetee a ɛkɔ so mu de ate amammerɛ mu nneɛma a ɛka ayarefo suban ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ase yiye na wɔadi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So botae anaa botae pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de si wɔn ani so sɛ wobedu ho wɔ bere a wɔde di akyi ne bere a wɔde hwɛ akyi no?
answer_twi_source: Botae ne botae pɔtee a ɛwɔ bere a wɔde di akyi ne nea wɔde hwɛ akyi no mu no bɛsono a egyina ɔbabun no ankorankoro ahiade ne ne tebea so. Nanso, botae ahorow a wɔtaa de di dwuma no betumi ayɛ nea ɛbɛma wɔatu mpɔn wɔ sɛnea wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, nsɛm a ɛhyɛ ase a ɛde ɔhaw no ba no ho dwuma a wobedi, yiedi ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano nyinaa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, na wɔatew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ daakye ɔhaw ahorow bɛba no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho a wɔde di dwuma mu aba, a nsunsuanso a enya wɔ adwenemyare, nipadua mfonini, ne nna ho adwene a ɛfata a wonya?
answer_twi_source: Nsunsuanso a Ɛnya wɔ Adwene mu Akwahosan So: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho a wɔbɛda no adi no betumi ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔmfata, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw, titiriw wɔ mmabun a ebia wɔde ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ne nna mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware bɛhyɛ wɔn mu no mu. Nipadua Mfonini: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho a obi di no betumi ama n’ani nnye ne nipadua mfonini ho bere a ankorankoro de wɔn ho toto mfonini ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ho no, na ɛde obu a ɛba fam ma wɔn ho ne nipadua ho mfonini a enye aba. Nna mu Su a Ɛma Apɔwmuden a Ɛba: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa nna ho a wɔde di dwuma no betumi akyinkyim ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ a ɛfata, pene a wɔpene so, ne ahye ahorow ho, na ebetumi anya wɔn suban ne wɔn nneyɛe so nsunsuanso wɔ mmeae a ɛbɛn wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwene a ɛne sɛ wobesua ade wɔ wɔn nkwa nna nyinaa mu na wɔakɔ so anya ahokokwaw mu nkɔso na ama wɔakɔ so ayɛ akansifo na wɔatumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ wiase a ɛrenya nkɔso ntɛm ntɛm no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya adwene a ɛne sɛ wobesua ade wɔ wɔn nkwa nna nyinaa mu na wɔakɔ so anya ahokokwaw mu nkɔso denam anigye a wɔ pɛ sɛ wohu nneɛma pii, sɛnea wotumi sesa wɔn ho, ne sɛnea wotumi gyina tebea horow ano a wobegye atom wɔ wɔn ankasa ne adwumayɛ asetra mu no so. Nkɔso adwene, adesua a wɔn ankasa kyerɛ kwan, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no hyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so di kan nya ahokokwaw nkɔso ne adwuma mu nkɔso ho nkuran, na ɛma mmabun tumi fa nneɛma a wontumi nsi pi mu na wɔfa hokwan ahorow wɔ wiase a ɛresakra ntɛmntɛm no mu. Adesua mu osuahu ahorow, afotu abusuabɔ, ne nhwɛsofo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no kanyan mmabun ma wodi wɔn akɔnnɔ akyi, hwehwɛ nneɛma foforo a wɔn ani gye ho, na wogye nsɛnnennen tom sɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde benyin na wɔanya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me nipadua bɛ yɛ soronko wɔ me nnamfo de ho?
answer_twi_source: Yɛn nyinaa nya nkɔso wɔ yɛn ankasa ahoɔhare so. Ebia ɛbɛyɛ te sɛ nea nnamfo binom anyin kɛse, bere a afoforo nso nyin akyiri yi. Ne nyinaa yɛ ade a ɛfata koraa! Fa w’adwene si w’ankasa akwantu so na di ɔkwan soronko a wo nipadua resakra no ho afahyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so akura wɔn yiyedi mu na wɔakɔ so anya ahoɔden bere a wɔrehwɛ wɔn ho wo ayaresa akyi no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akura wɔn yiyedi ne wɔn ho atɔ wɔn mu wɔ wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho dwumadi ahorow te sɛ adwene a wɔde si nneɛma so, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔde da adi, ne bere a wɔne wɔn nnamfo anaa abusuafo a wɔboa wɔn a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma no so. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ adwumayɛfo afotu, akɔ akuw a wɔboa wɔn, de wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ahoɔden wom a wɔn ani gye ho mu, na wɔaka wɔn nkate ne wɔn ahiade ho nkɔmmɔ pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan pa bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ama tema, obu, ne ayamye wɔ nyonkofa ne nkitahodi a yɛne afoforo adi mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan pa bi a wɔfa so hyɛ tema, obu, ne ayamye ho nkuran wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi a wɔne afoforo nya mu ne: Tie a wɔde nsiyɛ sua na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte afoforo adwene ne wɔn suahu ase. Mmɔborohunu ne mmoa a yɛbɛda no adi ama wɔn a wɔrebrɛ anaasɛ wohia mmoa no. Sɛ́ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔagye nsonsonoe atom, na wɔadi ahorow ahorow ho afahyɛ wɔ ne ahorow nyinaa mu. Gyina a wubegyina atia ntɛnkyea, nyiyim, ne asisifo nneyɛe bere biara a wubehu. Adɔe ne ayamye nneyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, te sɛ atuhoama, afoforo a wohia mmoa, anaa anisɔ ne naase a wɔda no adi. Ɛdenam tema, obu, ne ayamye a wobɛhyɛ ho nkuran so no, wubetumi aboa ma wɔayɛ amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ ayamhyehye ne nea ɛka obiara ho a obiara te nka sɛ ɛsom bo na wobu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nhyɛso, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho dwuma, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛhyɛ ahokokwaw a wɔde di nkitaho a ɛfata, gyinaesi, ne ahye a wɔde besi hɔ wɔ nyɔnofa nkitahodi mu ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua nhyehyɛe ne adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nhyɛso, ne nna mu basabasayɛ ho dwuma denam nsɛm a ɛfata a wɔde bɛka nna ne awo akwahosan ho adesua ho no so. Asuafoɔ sua nnyinasosɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔdi obuo ma ahyeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so fa abusuabɔ pa mu. Adesua nhyehyɛe no betumi ayɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nhyɛso anaa ayayade ho sɛnkyerɛnne a wobehu na wɔayɛ ho biribi, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa nneɛma a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne nnwuma a wobenya ama wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no ho. Ɛdenam ahokokwaw a wɔhyɛ ma nkitahodi a ɛfata, gyinaesi, ne ahye a wɔde si hɔ so no, adesua nhyehyɛe no ma asuafo tumi ma wɔde obu, tema, ne ahofadi fa abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi afa so ama adwene mede sus asiane ho a ayɛ kɛse, te sɛ nsɛm a mɛboaboa ano afi mmeae pii, mpaninfo anaa m’atipɛnfo a wogye wɔn di adwene a wobesusu ho, ne nea ebetumi afi nea mepaw mu aba no ho a mɛsusu ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wfa so ma asiane ho nhumu ho nimdeɛ kɔ anim no bi ne: Nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano: Hwehwɛ nsɛm fi mmeae pii a wotumi gye di, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, website ahorow a wotumi de ho to so, ne nhomasua nneɛma, na ama woanya ntease a edi mũ wɔ asiane ahorow a ɛbata nneyɛe pɔtee bi ho. Adwene a wobɛhwehwɛ: Susu mpaninfo, atipɛnfo, anaa afotubɔfoɔ a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de nhumu ne afotuo a egyina wɔn suahu ne wɔn nimdeɛ so ama no adwenekyerɛ ho. Nea ebefi mu aba ho a wubesusu ho: Dwen nneɛma a ebetumi afi nneɛma a wopaw no mu aba bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu no ho, susu sɛnea ɛne wo gyinapɛn ahorow, botae ahorow, ne yiedi hyia no ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi a wɔde di agoru anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a egyina asiane ahorow a na hwehwɛ mu, susu anamɔn a wobetumi etu, ne gyinaesi a ɛfata wɔ tebea horow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia ayayade esiane nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa me gender nti a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛw nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade ho, a nna, mmere, ne ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu ka ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, anaa sukuu afotubɔfoɔ hɔ, a wobetumi de wɔn ho agye mu na wɔde mmoa ama. Fa nneɛma te sɛ LGBTQ+ mmoa hotlines anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow di dwuma ma akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ hɔ, na nnipa ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woafa ayayade no adi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne 'transgender' anaa 'non-binary' na nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda wɔn ntam?
answer_twi_source: Transgender': Obi a ne bɔbeasu a wɔwoo no ne deɛ ɔte nka sɛ ɔyɛ no nhyia. 'Non-binary': Obi a ɔnte nka sɛ ɔyɛ barima anaa ɔbaa. 'Cisgender': Obi a ne bɔbeasu ne deɛ ɔte  bere a wɔwoo no no hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi akamfo saa hokwan ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan ahorow a ɛfa aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata a wobenya ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: kwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya aduan: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya aduan a ɛdɔɔso, ahobammɔ wom, na ahoɔden wom a ɛbɛma wɔadi wɔn aduan ahiade ho dwuma na wɔaboa wɔn nipadua ne adwene mu akwahosan. Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya dan: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya adan a ahobammɔ wom, ahobammɔ wom, na ne bo nyɛ den a ɛma wonya dabere a ɛfata, kokoam, ne ahobammɔ fi nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho asiane ahorow ho. Hokwan ahorow yi a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no betumi ayɛ: Nhumu a wɔbɛma: Atipɛnfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya aduan a ahoɔden wom ne adan a ɛfata ma mmabun yiyedi. Mmoa a wɔboaboa ano: Ɔsatuo, adesrɛ, anaa nsɛm a wɔka de boa nkurɔfoɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ de ma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ na wɔboaboa mmoa ano ma nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnwuma a ɛfa aduane ne adan a enni ahobammɔ ho. Nhyehyɛeyɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Nhyiamu a wɔne mpaninfoɔ a wɔapaw wɔn, kyerɛw nkrataa, anaa kyɛfa a wobenya wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo mmara, sikasɛm ho gyinaesie, ne aban nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa aduane ne adan a wɔbɛnya ho no so nkɛntɛnsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ nipadua ho mfonini pa ne obu a mewɔ ma me ho no ho nkuran na ama nna mu ahotoso ne abotɔyam ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Kasa Pa a Wode Kyerɛ Wo Ho bɔ mpae anaa nsɛm pa a ɛhyɛ nkuran (affirmations) ho nteteeɛ na fa w’adwene si w’ahoɔden ne wo tumi so.Po nsusuieeɛ bɔne biara a wowɔ fa wo nipadua ho. Wo Ho So Hwɛ: Yɛ nneɛma a ɛma wo ho tɔ wo, te sɛ apɔwmuden nteteeɛ (exercise), anigyedeɛ ahorow (hobbies), anaa mmerɛ a wode bɛne nnamfo pa a wɔhyɛ wo nkuran.Hyɛ ataadeɛ wɔ kwan a ɛbɛma woanya wo ho so ahotosoɔ (confidence) na wo ho atɔ wo. Abɛfoɔ Nkitahodie mu Nyansa (Media Literacy): Hwɛ yie wɔ nsɛm a amanneɛbɔ ne abɛfoɔ ntentan (media) ka fa nipadua ne ahoɔfɛ ho.Fa nnipa ahorow a wɔn nipadua gu ahorow twa wo ho hyia na ama woahu sɛ nipadua biara yɛ fɛ. Adwene a Ɛdi Mu (Mindfulness): Yɛ adwene a ɛdi mu (mindfulness) ne wo ho mmɔborohunu ho nteteeɛ. Fa w’adwene si mmerɛ a yɛwɔ mu yi so na ma wo nipadua ne ne tumi nsom bo mma wo. Hwehwɛ Mmoa (Seek Support): Kasa kyerɛ nnamfo, abusua, anaa afotufoɔ (therapist) fa wo nipadua ho dadwen biara a wowɔ ho.Kɔ mmoa akuo (support groups) anaa abɛfoɔ ntentan so mpɔtam a wɔsi nipadua mu anigyeɛ so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a yɛbɛfa so ahyɛ ahwɛfoɔ ho nkuran na wɔakyekye amammerɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia GBV wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Bystander Intervention Training: Hwehwɛ adwumayɛbea anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛfa bystander intervention ho ma GBV. Sua sɛ wobehu tebea horow na wode wo ho agye mu dwoodwoo. Fi Nkɔmmɔbɔ Fi ase: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma kuw nketewa nkɔmmɔ a wo ne w’atipɛnfo bɛbɔ wɔ abusuabɔ pa, mwɔpeneso, ne GBV ho. Trɛ Nhumu mu: Yɛ posters, flyers, anaa social media nsɛm (a mpanyimfo hwɛ so) a ɛtwe adwene si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkasa tia GBV.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwanside ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛmma wontumi nnya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bere a meyɛ ɔbabun, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi so nkonim?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow: Nimdeɛ kumaa pɛ bi a ɛfa nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ne baabi a wobetumi anya ho. Sikasɛm: ɛka, titiriw sɛ insurance ntua ho ka anaasɛ sɛ kokoamsɛm ho haw ahorow siw insurance a wɔde bedi dwuma ano a. Animtiaabu ne Atemmu: Suro a wosuro sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa abusuamufo bebu wɔn atɛn. Kwan tenten twa: Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobedu akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, titiriw wɔ nkuraase. Akwanside ahorow a Wobedi So: Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ nnwuma ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Ahintasɛm: Hwehwɛ ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhwɛ ma mmofra nkumaa de kokoamsɛm sie. Sikasɛm mu Mmoa: Hwehwɛ ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde sliding scale fees anaasɛ nnwuma a wontua hwee ma mmabun. Mmoa: Susuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, sukuu afotufo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animhwɛ, atinka, ne nsɛm a egyina nhyehyɛe so nya nna mu apomoden ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛtrɛw wɔ atetesɛm ne abɛɛfo ntetan nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Animhwɛ, atinka, ne nsɛm a egyina nhyehyɛe so betumi anya nna mu apomodenho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛtrɛw wɔ atetesɛm ne abɛɛfo ntentan nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no so nkɛntɛnso denam nokwasɛm ahorow a ɛkyinkyim, asɛm a ɛkanyan atinka anaa nea ɛtwetwe adwene a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, ne nhyehyɛe anaa adwene pɔtee bi a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Eyi betumi ama anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ adɔɔso, na ama wɔanya nna ne awo apomoden ho gyidi ahorow a ɛyɛ ahohorabɔ anaa epira no daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a ɛhyɛ nkate fam yiyedi ho nkuran, a dwumadi ahorow te sɛ apɔ mu ateneatene, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, anaa akwan a wɔfa so nya ahoɔden ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Apɔ mu ateneatene: Apɔ mu ateneatene anaa anammɔn a wɔde bɛka wɔn daa ho na ama adwennwen so atew, ama wɔn adwene atu mpɔn, na ama ahoɔden akɔ soro. Akwan a Wɔfa so Gye Ahome: Akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ ne ade a wɔde bedi dwuma de atew dadwen so na ama obi agye ahome yie. Adebɔ mu Nneɛma: Dwumadi ɛdanso ahorow te sɛ adwinni, nnwom, akyerɛw, anaa turoyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so da wɔn ho adi na wɔma adwennwen so tew. Suban a Ɛma Akwahosan: Da a ɛfata, adidi a ahoɔden wom, ne nsu a wɔde di dwuma daa a wɔde bedi kan de aboa yiyedi nyinaa. Asetra mu Nkitahodi: Nkitahodie a ɛboa a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu na wɔahwehwɛ asetra mu mmoa bere a ɛho hia na ama wɔatumi agyina ano ne nkate mu nhyehyɛe ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ me brayɛ remma yiye wɔ bere a me bu me nsa edi kan no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ɛtaa si sɛ wo bra nsisi so daa bere a wudi kan fi ase kɔ brayɛ mu no. Nna a ɛnkɔ so daa no betumi akyerɛ nneɛma ahorow: Kyinhyia Tenten: Ebia wo brayɛ bere tenten nyɛ pɛ ɔsram biara. Eyi yɛ ade a ɛfata bere a wo nipadua reyɛ nsakrae no. Bra no mu duru: Ebia wo bra no mu duru bɛyɛ soronko wɔ ɔsram biara mu. Bere Tenten: Wo bra nna dodow  no nso betumi ayɛ soronko. Ebetumi agye mfe kakraa bi ansa na wo brayɛ ayɛ daa. Sɛ wohaw wo ho wɔ wo nna a ɛnkɔ so daa ho anaasɛ emu yɛ duru yiye, emu yɛ hare yiye, anaasɛ ɛde ɛyaw kɛse ba a, ɛyɛ papa sɛ wo ne akwaahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkasa. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama na wɔaboa ma woahu sɛ ebia biribiara yɛ nea ɛfata ma wo anaa. Kae sɛ brayɛ yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛfata ma nnipa pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ hwehwɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Digitals media ho nimdeɛ fa tumi a obi tumi nya, hwehwɛ, hwehwɛ mu, na ɔyɛ media mu nsɛm wɔ dijitaal kwan so. Ɛho hia ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm mu efisɛ ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ nsɛm pii a ɛwɔ intanɛt so no mu, hwehwɛ fibea ahorow mu yiye, na wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn apɔwmuden ho.
