attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow di nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a, ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ sukuu ahorow mu ho dwuma, a adesua nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ, akyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee, ne awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmra ne nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) ho wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu no taa fa: Adesua Nhyehyɛeɛ Nkɔsoɔ: Aban ahodoɔ hyehyɛ akwankyerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ ma nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri, kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛmti, mfeɛ a ɛfata, ne adesua botaeɛ. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi taa hwehwɛ sɛ wɔne abenfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne mmabun besusuw ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛfa ho na wɔte nka. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ: Nhyehyɛeɛ hyɛ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ na wɔde nimdeɛ, ahokokwaa, ne suban a ɛhia na wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) ama yie. Ntetee no ka nsɛmti te sɛ nna mu akwahosan, nkitahodi akwan, ne adesuadan mu nhyehyɛe ho, na esi akwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu, a ɛka obiara ho so dua. Awofo a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Ebia mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo besusuw ho na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔagyae adesua no mu, na ama awofo atumi ahwɛ adesua nhyehyɛe no mu nneɛma mu na wɔasi gyinae sɛ ebia wɔn mma de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu anaa. Nanso, wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ awofo bɛte hia a CSE ho hia wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ama wɔn a wosi gyinae ne ahyehyɛde ahorow abu akontaa wɔ nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a wodi akyi no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ama wɔn a wosi gyinae ne ahyehyɛde ahorow abu akontaa wɔ nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a wodi ho dwuma ho denam nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma a wɔbɛhwɛ so, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo bɛbɔ, ɔmanfo atiefo ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ɔmanfo mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano, ne mmara kwan so akwan horow a wɔde bɛkasa atia hokwan ahorow a wobu so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn betumi ayɛ tebea horow a ɛboa wɔ fie a ɛhyɛ nipadua ho nkuran sɛ ɛyɛ nea broni ka no 'body positivity' na ɛma wɔn mma a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so no te nka sɛ wɔsom bo?
answer_twi_source: Awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn betumi ayɛ tebea horow a ɛboa wɔ fie denam nipadua ho mfonini pa nea broni ka no 'positive body image' ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛso, nipadua ho nsɛm a enye anaa aduan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho efiri mu, mmɔdenbɔ ne suban a wɔbɛkamfo mmom sen sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho, ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nipadua ho no so. Beae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔbɛma mmabun ada wɔn adwene adi, atenka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wogye wɔn tom a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne ɔdɔ ne mmoa a enni nnyinaso a wɔde bɛma no ho hia wɔ nipadua mu adwempa ne wɔn ho a wɔsom bo a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso no mu a broni ka no 'fostering body positivity and self-worth'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi abɔ wɔn kokoamsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrenya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so denam: Ahobammɔ ne kokoam browsing akwan a wɔde bedi dwuma so. Kwati sɛ wobɛkyɛ wo ho nsɛm gye sɛ ɛho hia. Wɛbsaet anaa app ahorow a wogye di na ɛwɔ din pa a ɛwɔ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu da hɔ a wode bedi dwuma. Ahwɛyiye a wobɛyɛ bere a worekyɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia anaasɛ worebɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ Intanɛt so no. Nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so na wɔahwɛ sɛ wogye intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow di.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wɔasiesie intanɛt so ɔhaw nnwuma ahorow a wɔde mmoa anaasɛ ɔhwɛpa ama mmabun a wohia mmoa bere tenten?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so ahokyere mu dwumadie ahodoɔ bi betumi de mmoa ama anaasɛ wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ mmabun a wɔhia mmoa a ɛkyɛ. Ebia wɔde nneɛma, afotu, anaa mmoa akuw a wɔde boa mmabun a wɔde boa mmabun ma wɔadi wɔn haw ahorow so na wɔanya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara mu nsusuwii ka ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, na akwanside ahorow bɛn na ebetumi aba?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nsusuwii betumi aka ɔpɛ a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa wɔ akwan horow so. Suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu kokoam nsɛm so, nyiyim a egyina 'ST'I tebea so, anaa mmara kwan so nsunsuanso a efi nna mu dwumadi mu ba no betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Bio nso, akwanside ahorow te sɛ nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni, sikasɛm mu ahokyere, ne animtiaabu a atwa 'STI' ho ahyia no betumi asiw ɔhwɛ a wobenya no kwan bio. Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobedi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma no betumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho, 'STI' ahorow a wɔbɛbu wɔn animtiaa, nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den a wobenya a ɛkɔ soro, ne akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛyɛ kokoam ne nea wɔmfa atemmu nni dwuma a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya wɔn nsɛm ho nimdeɛ ne a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun de kyekye wɔn nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ne nimdeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho no bi ne internet so adesua, webinars, nnwinnade, afotu nhyehyɛe, ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim, atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow, ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛkɔ nhyiam ne adwumayɛbea ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn adi nnipa ne osuahu ahorow a ɛtwam ho dwuma wɔ "LGBTQ+" mpɔtam hɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔaboa ankorankoro nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Wɔabara "LGBTQ+" dwumadie wɔ Ghana enti nhyehyɛeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛboa a ɛka wɔn nnipa hokwan titire ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ nsɛm a mihu wɔ Intanɛt so, anaa nhoma ahorow mu no yɛ nea wotumi de ho to so na ɛyɛ nokware ma obi a ɔne me bɔ tipɛn?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nsɛm fi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet (website) ahorow, nnuruyɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa nhomasua asoɛe ahorow. Hwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nsɛm no foforo daa na nyansahu mu adanse foa so anaa. Hwɛ yiye wɔ wɛbsaet anaa nneɛma a ɛhyɛ adwene a ɛyɛ animhwɛ ho nkuran anaasɛ enni fibea a wotumi gye di ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, afotufoɔ, anaa adwumayɛfo a wɔboa wɔn di wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ bere a wɔredi akyi ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn akyi no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔboa wɔn di dwuma titire wɔ mmoa ne mmoa a ɛkɔ so ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ akyire ne akyihwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. Ebia wɔde afotu, ayaresa, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ adwumayɛbea titiriw, nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention' sɛnea ɛho hia, ne ɔbabun no nkɔso ne ne yiyedi a wɔbɛkɔ so ahwɛ ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nipadua mfonini, na ɔkwan bɛn so na enya yɛn ho a yɛwɔ ne yɛn adwene mu yiyedi so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua mfonini kyerɛ sɛnea ankorankoro hu wɔn ankasa nipadua, susuw ho, na wɔte nka wɔ ho. Ɛka suban, gyidi, ne nkate horow a ɛfa obi honam ani hwɛbea ho, a ne kɛse, ne nsusuwii, ne ne nyinaa honam ani hwɛbea ka ho. Nipadua ho mfonini nya adwene mu yiyedi so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, efisɛ adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa abotɔyam a obi wɔ wɔ ne nipadua ho no betumi ama wanya obu a ɛba fam wɔ ne ho, nipadua ho mfonini a enye, ne adwenemyare te sɛ adwenemhaw, dadwen, ne adidi mu haw ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia ɔhaw ahorow  wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wotu: Kɔ Akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo nkyɛn: Munsusuw sɛnkyerɛnne anaa nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho. Susuw Akwan Afoforo Ho: Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo hwehwɛ akwan foforo a wubetumi afa so. Ma No Bere: Bere kɔ so no, nsunsuanso bɔne bi betumi atu mpɔn. Kɔ so Fa Ahobammɔ Di Dwuma: Fa akwan a wɔfa so de sie te sɛ kɔndɔm di dwuma kosi sɛ wubesiesie. Ntɛmntɛm: Hwehwɛ ayaresafo mmoa ntɛm ara wɔ nneyɛe a emu yɛ den anaa ntɛmpɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ne amammerɛ mu nkate di nkitaho wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi mu nipasu, te sɛ abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne amammerɛ mu nkate di nkitaho wɔ ASRH mu denam: Ankorankoro osuahu, gyidi, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɛntɛnso wɔ amammerɛ tebea pɔtee bi mu so. Tumi mu nkɔsoɔ, asetena mu gyinapɛn, ne nneɛma anaa nnwuma a wɔbɛnya a egyina nipasuo a ɛtwa wɔn ho hyia ne gyinabea a wɔato wɔn hintidua so a wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ wohu na wodi nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne pɛyɛ a enni nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma mu a ɛne ne ho di nsɛ ho dwuma. Ɛsi hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔfa akwan a ɛka obiara ho ne nea ɛfa nnipa ntam a ɛhyɛ nnipa a wɔda wɔn ho adi, adwene, ne osuahu ahorow a wɔatra ase a ɛsono emu biara anuonyam so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a merenya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so anaa nea ɛnyɛ Intanɛt so no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na woabɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a worenya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so anaa offline no, susuw nneɛma a edidi so yi ho: Fa kokoam nkitahodie nhyehyeɛ di dwuma anaa popa wo nkitahodie abakɔsɛm bere a woanya nna ho nsɛm wɔ intanɛt so awie no. Hwɛ sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a wokɔ no yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom na ɛwɔ din denam HTTPS encryption a wobɛhwɛ na woahwɛ sɛ fibea no yɛ nokware anaa. Hwehwɛ nsɛm fi mmeae a wogye di te sɛ aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow, nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔwɔ din pa, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Sɛ worenya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm wɔ intanɛt so, te sɛ nkrata a ɛso anaa nhoma ahorow a, fa sie baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛyɛ kokoam na amma afoforo ankɔ ho wɔ berɛ womma ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na edi mũ no ka amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu adwene ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ akyiri bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛka amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu adwene ahorow ho denam: Gyidi, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne atetesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna, nkitahodie, ne awo akwahosan ho a wobegye atom na wɔabu no so. Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa ho, nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu, ne nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ asuafoɔ no tebea ahodoɔ a wɔde bɛma. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma ma nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nsusuwii a ɛfa sɛnea amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi anya ankorankoro suban ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ nna ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ho so nsunsuanso ho. Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm bɛma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ nyiyim so a ɛremma amammerɛ anaa nyamesom kuw pɔtee biara nhyɛ ho nkuran anaasɛ ɛremmu animtiaa. Adwene a ɛbue, abodwokyɛre, ne nteaseɛ a ɛfa adwene ahodoɔ ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ asuafoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛm bi a ɛhaw me wɔ afotuo anaa ayaresa a mefi ase anaasɛ mɛtoa so ayɛ ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ afotu anaa ayaresa a wobefi ase anaasɛ wobɛtoa so ho a, ɛho hia sɛ wudi ho dwuma pefee na wudi nokware. Wubetumi afi ase denam wo fotumafo anaa wo ɔyaresafo a wobɛbɔ wo haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ na woahwehwɛ ehu anaa adwenem naayɛ biara a ebia wowɔ mu no so. Obetumi de nsɛm, mmoa, ne awerɛhyem ama wo de aboa wo ma woate nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na wowɔ ahotosoɔ kɛse wɔ adeyɛ no mu. Wubetumi nso ne mpanyimfoɔ a wogye wɔn di te sɛ w’awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, anaa wo nnamfoɔ akasa de aboa wo na woanya adwene foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye de ka mmabun mmarima ne mmarima nkumaa ho asɛm sɛ wɔn a wɔboa na wɔboa ma mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ, awo ho hokwan ahorow, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee wɔ Mmabun Nna ne Awo Apomoden (ASRH) mu?
answer_twi_source: Kyere mmarima suban pa. Ko tia nneyses bone. mpanyinfo ne atipenfo nkyerekyere ne adesua
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ama LGBTQ+ mmabun a wɔwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no ate nka sɛ yɛyɛ nnipa?
answer_twi_source: Ghana mmara nngye LGBTQ+ nnntu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nnipadua pa ne ahohoahoa bere a me nipadua resesa?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ deɛ wo nipadua tumi yɛ. Mmpɛ sɛ woyɛ sɛ afoforo yɛ. Dɔ wo ho. Yɛ nneɛma a ɛboa apɔwmuden. Hwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛfa so hwɛ sɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ rekɔ so yie?
answer_twi_source: Akwan: wogyegye nsɛmfua , woyɛ nhwehwɛmu aberɛ biara, ne akorakora nhwehwɛ mu. Mmabun betumi aboa denam: wɔbɛka nea wɔhu, sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhwehwɛ yɛ mu ne sɛ wɔbɛko ama nokwaredie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kuro amanɛbɔ ntentan ne Intanɛt so nkitahodi boa ma atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ adwene mu apomoden so no ba?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yɛbɛhye Mfonini nson: Mpɛn pii no, amanɛbɔ kuro ntentan so de asetena kwan, nipadua, ne abusuabɔ ho mfonini ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ adi, na ɛde nhyɛso ba sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nea ɛne gyinapɛn ahorow yi hyia. Ntotoho a Wɔbɛhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Sɛ obi de ne ho hyɛ nsɛm a wɔakora so ne atipɛnfo nsɛm foforo mu bere nyinaa a, ebetumi ama wayɛ ntotoho a ɛnyɛ papa na wate nka sɛ ɔmfata anaa FOMO (suro a wosuro sɛ wobɛyera). Suban a asiane wom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Intanɛt so mpɔtam hɔfo anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso betumi ahyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom te sɛ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, wɔn ho a wopira, anaa adidi a ɛtra so ho nkuran, na wɔanya ankorankoro a wonni ahobammɔ so nkɛntɛnso ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nneyɛe a ɛte saa ara mu. Intanɛt so ayayade: Nkitahodi a enye, kɔmputa so ayayade, anaa Intanɛt so ayayade betumi ama atipɛnfo nhyɛso ayɛ kɛse na ama adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa obu a wonni ma wɔn ho no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene mu apomoden yareɛ a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwehwɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia dadwen, adwene a ɛyɛ basaa, aniwu, anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho. Wobetumi nso anya adwennwen anaa nhyɛso afi wɔn atipɛnfo, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, anaa abusua akwanhwɛ ahorow hɔ. Sɛ mmabun hia mmoa a, wobetumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, sukuu afotufo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa nsɛm a wɔde boa wɔn wɔ kokoam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu bere a mehyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a efi m’adamfo anaa m’atipɛnfo hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ ne ho nyɛ no yiye anaasɛ ɔbɔ abira wɔ gyinaesi bi a enam afoforo nkɛntɛnso nti. Nsakrae a ɛba suban anaa gyinapɛn ahorow mu ma ɛne kuw no hyia a wobɛhyɛ no nsow. Sɛ obi anni nea n’atipɛnfo akwanhwɛ so a, dadwen anaa suro a osuro sɛ wɔbɛpam no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akasama akwan horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛka obiara ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Ma Nnipa Nhu: Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo ɛfa hia wɔ amammerɛ mu ma mmaabun mu nkyerɛkyerɛ na ama wɔaka nnipa nyinaa ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo nyɛ adwuma de yɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ. Ananmusifoɔ: Kamfo ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ a wɔbɛnya wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma mu de ada amammerɛ ne tebea ahodoɔ adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma te sɛ kasa mu akwanside, mmara kwan so gyinabea, nyiyim, ne asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe ka mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔyɛ kakraa bi no nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma te sɛ kasa mu akwanside, mmara kwan so gyinabea, nyiyim, ne asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe ka nna ne awo akwahosan a efi mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne kakraa bi mu ba no kɛse. Kasa mu akwanside betumi asiw nkitahodi a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nsɛm a wobenya no kwan, bere a mmara kwan so gyinabea ho nsɛm betumi asiw akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa a ɛfata ano. Nyiyim ne animtiaabu a egyina abusuakuw, abusuakuw, anaa atubrafo tebea so no betumi ama wɔakwati akwahosan ho mmeae anaasɛ wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ. Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ asetra ne sikasɛm mu, a ohia ne nhomasua anaa adwumayɛ hokwan a enni hɔ ka ho, betumi ama nsɛnnennen yi ayɛ kɛse bio na ama akwahosan ho nkɔso a enye aba.nn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabunbere ka me nna mu nkɔsoɔ sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere kanyan nkwaadɔm a ɛde nipadua mu nsakrae a edidi so yi ba mmeawa mu: nufu nyin ne brayɛ mfiase. mmarimaa: anim nhwi nyin wɔ mmarimaa mmadwoa mu. Ɛkanyan nna ho nkate nso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu adwene a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ wɔn ankasa mmusua ne mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ amammerɛ ne nyamesom adwene mu wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ wɔn mmusua ne mpɔtam hɔ denam: Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn mmusua ne mpɔtam hɔfo amammerɛ ne nyamesom gyidi ase denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na obu wom so. Adwene ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ mu na wɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo, nyamesom akannifo, anaa amammerɛ mu afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow. Adwene a wɔbom yɛ na wosi gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbom yɛ so dua, te sɛ hia a akwahosan, yiyedi, ne gyinaesi a wonya nimdeɛ ho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya hokafoɔ a ɔbu me na ɔboa nea mmra ma me kwan wɔ me dɛmdi?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ennya ahokafo a ɔboa wo sɛ wopae mu ka nea ahia wo, ɛtwe kwan a obi tie na obu wohyeɛ, na wokabɛn nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ beae a ɛma nkabom ne obuo. Ahokafoɔ pa kyerɛ hwɛso a ɛyɛ korogyee, obu wohodisoɔ, na obu w'anyonyam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmu a egyina adanse so ne nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano no ma wohu amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛe ne nsusuiɛ ahorow a wɔyɛ ne ne nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a egyina adanseɛ so ne nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano no ma amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa amanaman ntam ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ ne nsusuiɛ a wɔyɛ ne ne nhwehwɛmu ho denam nhumu a wɔde ma wɔ ahiadeɛ, akwansideɛ, ne nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so a ɛha mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no so. Saa nsɛm yi boa nhyehyɛeyɛfoɔ ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ mu na wɔsiesie nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛdi mmabun ahiadeɛ ho dwuma yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ minnim sɛ ebia obi apene so a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wunnim sɛ ebia obi apene so a, gyae dwumadi no na wo ne wo hokafo no nni nkitaho pefee. Bisa ma emu nna hɔ na kyerɛ ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubebu wɔn ahye ne wɔn akɔnnɔ. Hwɛ yie na mpere wo ho nyɛ biribiara kɔsi sɛ wobɛnya kwan a emu tew na obi de anigyeɛ apene so ama wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛnam so pɔtee a ɛde animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo su ne amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow nya sɛnea ɛbɛkɔ so atena hɔ no so nkɛntɛnso "influence"?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw a ɛde animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ba ne: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow a ɛkyerɛ gyinapɛn, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe, awo, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ho. Ɔmanfo ahyɛde ahorow ne kommyɛ a atwa nna ho ahyia, a ɛma nimdeɛ a wonni, ehu, ne atemmu kɔ so. Nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, te sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wonnya, akwahosan ho nnwuma, ne mmeae a wɔboa, a ɛma animtiaabu ne nyiyim yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a ebia wɔahyia ɔhye a wɔabu so anaa obu a wonni, a afotu adwuma, mmoa ahomatrofo, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, ne atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔahyia ɔhyeɛ a wɔabu so anaasɛ wɔabu wɔn animtiaa no bɛtumi anya nneɛma ahodoɔ ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ ahodoɔ de anya mmoa. Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow, mmoa ahomatrofo, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo de kokoam mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nneɛma ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔne afoforo a wɔanya osuahu a ɛte saa ara di nkitaho na wɔde mmoa ne ntease ma wɔn ho wɔn ho. Intanɛt so nneɛma te sɛ wɛbsaet ne app ahorow nso betumi de nsɛm, afotu, ne mmoa ahomatrofo a wɔde boa mmabun a wohia mmoa ama. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hu sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn nkutoo na wɔwɔ hɔ na mmoa ne mmoa wɔ hɔ ma wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu a ɛfa STI ne HIV ho no ka sɛnea nkurɔfo nya nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabuo a atwa STI ne HIV ho ahyia no betumi de akwansideɛ aba wɔ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie a wɔbɛnya mu denam: - Suro a wɔsuro sɛ wɔbɛbu no atɛn anaa nyiyim afiri akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ hɔ, a ɛbɛma wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ayaresa. - Dadwen a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho, a ɛbɛtumi asiw ankorankoro kwan sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn akwahosan tebea adi anaasɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadie. - Aniwuo a etumi siw ankorankoro kwan se wobegye won yare no atom anaase wobehwehwe ayaresa bere ntɛm so. - Asetena mu animtiaabu ne nyiyim, a ebetumi ama obi atwe ne ho afi afoforo ho, anaase wahwere asetena mu mmoa ntam nkitahodi ahorow, na ama aniwu nkate ne ɔpɛ a wonni sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne mo akasa afa m'atenka ahorow a ɛfa abusuabɔ, nna, ne awo akwahosan ho a mente nka sɛ wɔabu me atɛn anaasɛ wɔante ase yiye?
answer_twi_source: Hu sɛ wobɛtumi aba me nkyɛn a worensuro atemmuo anaa nteaseɛ a ɛntene. Mewɔ ha sɛ mɛtie na maboa wo. Fi ase ka wo atenka a wobɛda no adi pefee ne nokwaredi so, fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma de da wo nkate ne wo suahu ahorow adi. Gye di sɛ mede tema ne ntease betie, na ade a ɛho hia me paa ne sɛ mɛboa wo ma woate nka sɛ wɔate wo na wɔboa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammerɛ ne nyamesom kyerɛ mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie?
answer_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ yɛbu mmarima ne mmaa. Ɛhyɛ amammerɛ kwan so nneyɛeɛ den. Nsakraeɛ aba, nanso nyiyimu da so wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na digyital mfiridwuma ne intanɛt so akwan boa, ma nhomasua ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛhyɛ tumi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH)ho no mu, na nsɛnnennen bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ digyital nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Digitals platform ahorow ma nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobenya na ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nkitaho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛmti ho, na ɛkɔ mmabun nkyɛn wɔ mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri mpo. Pɛyɛ a Wɔbɛnya: Nsɛnnennen no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛdi digyital mpaepaemu no ho dwuma denam mfiridwuma ho kwan a wɔbɛma wɔanya ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no wɔ kasa ne akwan a nnipa ahodoɔ bɛtumi anya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn nkitahodi a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so ne dijitaal akwahosan ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow mu kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmaabun wɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ wɔn kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ ho wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi ne akwahosan ho nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ kɔmputa so (digital health records) ho, eyinom bi ne:Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔkyerɛ nea obetumi ahwɛ wɔn nsɛm: Wɔwɔ tumi sɛ wɔpaw wɔn a wobetumi anya wɔn kokoam nsɛm ne nea wɔyɛ wɔ intanɛt so ho kwan.Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn akwahosan nkyerɛwee ho ban: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ kɔmputa so ho ban na ankorankoro a wonni ho kwan antumi anhwɛ anaa wɔampasua ammma abɔnten.Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ atɛntrenee: Sɛ obi pɛtɛ wɔn kokoamsɛm mu a, wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔfa mmara kwan so anaa wɔbɔ atumfoɔ ne nkitahodi mmeae (platforms) a ɛsɛ amanneɛ.Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa: Wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔnya nkyerɛkyerɛ fi mpanyimfo a wɔgye wɔn di, sukuufo, anaa akuw a wɔn ho akwan wɔ intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho, na ama wɔahu sɛnea wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom atetesɛm di wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ aman anaa mmeae ahorow mu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu amanneɛ bɛtumi aka mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ho kwan ne dɛm (disability) ho wɔ akwan pii so:Mmara mu Nkyekyereɛ (Legal Restrictions): Aman bi a nyamesom wɔ wɔn so tumi kɛseɛ no bɛtumi anya mmara a ɛbu LGBTQ+ nneyɛeɛ sɛ nsɛmmɔnedie. Yei ma ɛyɛ den ma LGBTQ+ foɔ a wɔwɔ dɛm nso sɛ wɔn nsa bɛka wɔn ho kwan ne ayaresa pa.Mmoa a Ɛnnɔɔso (Limited Support): Amammerɛ mu mmara a ɛngye LGBTQ+ nneyɛeɛ ntum bɛtumi ama aban mmoa ama LGBTQ+ ho kwan anaa nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ho kwan ayɛ mmerɛ.Nkuranhyɛ Pa (Positive Influence): Nyamesom mu nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛhyɛ nkabom ne mmɔborohunu ho nkuran bɛtumi ayɛ baabi pa a mmoa wom ama LGBTQ+ foɔ a wɔwɔ dɛm. Nsakyeraeɛ yi gu ahorow gyina amammerɛ pɔtee ne nyamesom ko a ɛwɔ hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan a ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ nna mu yarewa yɛfrɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  STI ne HIV ho, na ɛhe na mmebun betumi anya nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ akwan pii a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nna mu yarewa yɛfrɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV nhwehwɛmu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ɔmanfoɔ akwaahosan ayaresabea - Mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛeɛ - Akwahosan ayaresabea a egyina sukuu so - Awofoɔ ayaresabea a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ - Ankorankoro akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ - Nsɔhwɛ akuo a wɔde fa baabiara - Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ fie (ma STIs binom) - Saa nhwehwɛmu dwumadie yi betumi de nhwehwɛmu ahodoɔ ama, a mogya mu nhwehwɛmu, nsuo mu nhwehwɛmu, swab nhwehwɛmu, ne ntɛmntɛm ka ho sɔhwɛ ahorow. Bio nso, sɔhwɛ adwumayɛbea pii de afotu ne mmoa ma ansa na wɔayɛ sɔhwɛ ne bere a wɔawie no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mehu sɛ obi resisi obi foforo anaa ɔrehaw no wɔ Intanɛt so a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa mensuro? (amanneɛbɔ akwan horow,  nea broni ka no 'de-escalation' akwan horow) .
answer_twi_source: Amanneɛbɔ a Wobɛpaw: Nea broni ka no 'Social media platform' dodow no ara wɔ amanneɛbɔ akwan. Bɔ ayayade no ho amanneɛ kɔ asɛnka agua no so na fa screenshots sie sɛ adanse. nea broni ka no 'De-escalation Strategies': Mma wo ne osisifo no nni nkitaho. Bu w’ani gu wɔn so, siw wɔn kwan, na bɔ wɔn amanneɛ. Fa w’adwene si w’ahobammɔ so na mfa abufuw nyɛ ho biribi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi akamfo nna mu hokwan ahorow ne nea wohu wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne Intanɛt so mmeae ahorow
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua/Ntetee (adwumayɛbea ahorow). Sukuu/Mpɔtam hɔ Nkitahodi (akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ). Intanɛt so Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ (social media). Adwumakuw a wɔne Ahyehyɛde ahorow (ɔhokafo a ɔne mmubuafo hokwan ahorow orgs yɛ).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nyinsɛn ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔyɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ so kura afu no: Wei kyerɛ sɛ wubue akwan mma nyinsɛn no nyin kosi sɛ wobɛwo. Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wonya ayarehwɛ bere a wuyem no, na ɛfa nyinsɛn no gyinabea horow nyinaa mu kosi awo bere. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow de akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun ne mmabun ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn nyinsɛn kɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu. Bisa mmoa dwumadie te sɛ SAFETY NET nhyehyɛeɛ no ho asɛm firi w’akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ hɔ. Akokoaa a Wogye Wo: Sɛ wopaw sɛ wobɛfa akokoaa no a, anka wode nyinsɛn no bɛkɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu na afei wode akokoaa no akɔ awofo a wɔagye no ayɛ wɔn ba nkyɛn. Agyede ahorow wɔ hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne nea wɔabue, nea wɔabue fã, ne nea wɔato mu. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ aduruyɛ mu kwan a wɔfa so ma nyinsɛn ba awiei. Ahorow atitiriw abien na ɛwɔ hɔ: nyinsɛn a wɔde nnuru gu (a wɔde nnuru di dwuma) ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu wɔ ayaresabea (aduruyɛ a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo yɛ). Wobu nyinsɛn a woyi gu sɛ asiane biara nni ho bere a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wɔatete no na ɔyɛ wɔ beae a wɔagye atom no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akɔ so anya mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyiamu ahorow a ɛreba, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan so no ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akɔ so ahu mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow a ɛreba, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awo akwahosan so denam ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfa ho, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wodi akyi wɔ sohyial media akwan te sɛ Instagram, Facebook, anaa Twitter so. Wobetumi nso akyerɛw wɔn din wɔ email amanneɛbɔ nkrataa mu, akyerɛw wɔn din wɔ nkrataa a wɔde mena ho, anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow wɛbsaet ahorow so akɔgye nsɛm foforo a ɛfa nsɛm a esisi ne hokwan ahorow a ɛreba ho. Bio nso, sukuu ahorow, mmabun mmeae, ne mpɔtam hɔ amannebɔ pon ahorow betumi de nkrataa anaa nkrataa a wɔde abɔ nsɛm a ɛreba ho dawuru akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asua mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mfe a obi adi sɛ ɔpene nna mu dwumadi so wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosua mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mfe a obi adi sɛ ɔpene nna mu dwumadi so wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho a, wubetumi: Hwɛ mpɔtam hɔ mmra kwan so nneɛma, te sɛ aban wɛbsaet ahorow, mmra kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa mmrahyɛ bagua ahorow, na woanya nsɛm a ɛfa mmara a ɛfa ho, mfe a obi adi, ne mmara kwan so nkyerɛase ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, a wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama na wɔaboa wo ma woate mmara kwan so nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛwɔ mfe a obi adi ho mmara a ɛwɔ wo man mu no ase. Fa wo ho hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe anaa nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa nna mu hokwan ahorow, asɛyɛde ahorow, ne mmra mu nsusuwii ahorow ho, a mfe a obi adi ho mmra ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ nna mu dwumadi ho ka ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma anaa mmoa sɛ mehyia nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ me so, anaa wɔde di dwuma a? (ahomatorofo, afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo, kasa kyerɛ akwaahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi sɛ wuhyia nna mu ateetee . nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ bi frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkyerɛ pɛ a wɔpene so, ahyeɛ, ne nnamfofa pa ka mmabun nteaseɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ saa nsɛm yi ho wɔ asetena mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkyerɛ pɛ a wɔpene so, ahyeɛ, ne nnamfofa pa betumi aka mmabun nteaseɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ saa nsɛm yi ho wɔ asetena mu. Nkitahodiɛ pa, obu, ne pɛ a wɔpene so a wɔkyerɛ wɔ kwan pa so wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu betumi aboa ma wɔahyɛ nnamfofa pa nkuran na ama mmabun tumi ma wɔahyehyɛ ahyeɛ na wɔahwehwɛ pɛ a wɔpene so wɔ wɔn ankasa nkitahodiɛ mu. Nanso, nnamfofa a ɛnyɛ nokware anaa deɛ wɔde ɔdɔ aka ho a wɔbɛkyerɛ betumi ahyɛ adwene bɔne ne nteaseɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware a ɛfa pɛ a wɔpene so ne ahyeɛ pa ho den, a ɛde adwene mu sakasaka anaa nteaseɛ bɔne bɛba mmabun ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan bɛn na mewɔ sɛ sebi dɛmdifoɔ fa kokoam-yɛ ho wɔ berɛ merehwehwɛ apɔmden mu mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan. Mmara bɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban gye sɛ asane bi wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu, ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho denam akwan horow pii so, a sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne abɛɛfo ntentan akwan horow ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu, ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho denam akwan horow pii a ɛbɛn wo so. Eyi ka ho ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho, atete akyerɛkyerɛfo ne sukuu adwumayɛfo ma wɔde SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ a egyina adanse so ama, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma wɔ kasa ne akwan horow pii mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow nso de dijitaal akwan te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow, mobile apps, ne social media di dwuma de kyekyɛ nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na mmabun betumi anya bi so. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔde mmabun ka ho wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ  ne nhwehwɛmu mu na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛfata na etu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛ yɛ sɛn na amammerɛ abakɔsɛm betumi aka wɔ a wɔresi sɔ no brabɔ ho adeɛ anaa suban, gyidie, ne nneyɛeɛ ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ abakɔsɛm wɔ nsusuansoɔ nsɛm pii a ɛfa  wɔn a wɔnfeɛ ɛkɔ anim a wɔwɔn suban mu, gyidi, ne nnwuma ho ɛfa nna mu ne awodeɛ ho apɔwmuden ho.  Adwene a ɛfa mmarima ne mma dwumadie, nna mu suban, ne abusua mu nneɛma nsesaiyɛho. Nyamesom anaa honhom mu gyidi a ɛfa nna ho, abrabɔ pa, ne awodeɛ ho gyinaesiɛ ho. Taboos, animia, anaa amaneɛbɔ a ɛfa nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ, awodeɛ ano nsisi, ne STIs ho. Atetesɛm, rituals, ne afahyɛ a ɛfa kwan a wɔfa so nyini, awareɛ, ne awodeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna mu yareɛ yɛfrɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ HIV a efi ɛna mu kɔ abofra mu ba, na nyinsɛn anaa awo fã bɛn na ebetumi aba?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu yareɛ yɛfrɛ nu wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  HIV a efi ɛna mu kɔ abofra mu no betumi aba bere a wɔyem, wɔwo (awo), anaa wɔma nufu. Wɔ nyinsɛn mu no, HIV tumi twa awotwaa no mu na ɛka akokoaa no. Wɔ awo mu no, akokoaa no betumi anya HIV denam ɛna no mogya ne nipadua mu nsu afoforo a ɛbɛka no so. HIV nso betumi afa nufusu so anya bere a wɔma nufu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa adwenemyare ho nsɛm a ɛfa adwenemyare ho wɔ mmusua, sukuu, ne mpɔtam hɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa adwenemyare ho no ma wonya ntease, mmoa, ne gye a wogye tom wɔ mmusua, sukuu, ne mpɔtam hɔ. Ɛtew animtiaabu so, ɛma wonya tema, na ɛhyɛ ankorankoro nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no. Ɛdenam mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a yɛbɛma abɔ nkɔmmɔ so no, yebetumi abubu akwanside ahorow na yɛaboa yɛn ho yɛn ho adwene mu yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me ankasa betumi ahyehyɛ ahonidie mapa a ebetumi aboa me wɔ me daadaa asetena mu?
answer_twi_source: Daadaa mu ahonidie nhyehyeɛ ho hia paa ma apɔmden na ɛma wo akokuduro. Ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ayɛ bi ni: Daa Daa Adeyɛ: Fi ase fa samina ne nsuo dware dabiaa. Anɔpa Dwumadi: Wosɔre anopa a twitwi wose, wanim, fa deodorant yɛ wo ho na hwɛ ntaadeɛ a yasi. Anwummere Adeyɛ: Dware, twitwi wose bio, hohoro wanim fi ne anwa ansa wada. Eti adeyɛ: Hunu ɔkwan wobɛ fa so ahohoro wotirim, fa shampoo ne ade sɛ ehia. Ɔhwɛ a Wobɛhwɛ wɔ Brayɛ Ho: Sɛ woreyɛ bra a, sesa nneɛma a wode bɔban berɛ biaa na kyekyere no yie to twene baabi pa. Hwe wo nneɛma so yie. Ahobammɔ soroko: Sɛ wowɔ haw soroko bi te sɛ honam mu nka bɔne ne ade a hwɛ sa sɛ ehia nkoaa deɛ. Hwɛ so di wonhyehyeɛ so: Nya berɛ fa ma ahonidie. Wobetumi ayɛ ansa wakɔ sukuu anaa sɛ wo wie apɔmateneatene a anaa sɛ wobɛda a. Kɔ so Yɛ Nneɛma Nyinaa: Adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so daa di mu. Bata wo nhyehyɛe ho na ma no ɛnyɛ deɛ woyɛ no daa. Yɛ Wo Daa: Ɛsɛ sɛ wodaa daa dwumadie yɛ wahiadeɛ  ne deɛ wopɛ. Sɔ nneɛma ne nneyɛɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa hwɛ na woahu dea ɛyɛ ma wo. Bisa Mmoa: Sɛ wunnim ahodie ho nyehyeɛ a ɛbɛboa wo a ntwentwɛn wo nan ase bisa ɔwofoɔ, ɔhwɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ bi akwankyerɛ. Sɛ wotumi yɛ anaa sɛ di akwankyerɛ yie nyinaa so a ɛbɛnoa wahonidie wo berɛ a worebu wonsa. Kae sɛ ɛsono obiara nipadua, enti yɛ deɛ ɛbɛboa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmra ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a, ɛbɛma wɔadi akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho dwuma wɔ adwumayɛbea hɔ, na etu mpɔn dɛn wɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ma wɔyɛ adwumayɛfo nyinaa yiye na wotua wɔn ka no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmra, nhyehyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow pii botae ne sɛ wobedi akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho dwuma wɔ adwumayɛbea. Eyinom bi ne mmara a ɛko tia nyiyim te sɛ Akatua a Ɛyɛ Pɛ Mmara, Ɔmanfo Hokwan Ho Mmra no "Title VII", ne "Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act" a ɛwɔ "United States", ne amanaman ntam nnwinnade te sɛ Apam a Ɛfa Nyiyim a Wɔyɛ Tia Mmea Nyinaa a Wobeyi Afi Hɔ (CEDAW) ho. Bere a saa mmra ahorow yi ma mmra nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛhyɛ akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran no, sɛnea etu mpɔn no gyina akwan a wɔfa so di mmara so ne ahyehyɛde no bɔhyɛ a ɛne sɛ wobedi mmara so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na asetra mu abusuabɔ di wɔ adwenemyare ne yiedi pa a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu abusuabɔ ma obi te nka sɛ ɔyɛ ne de, gye tom, na ɔboa, a ɛho hia ma adwenemyare ne yiedi nyinaa. Nkitahodi pa ne abusuabɔ pa a wonya no brɛ ankonamyɛ, tew a wɔtew wɔn ho, ne adwenemhaw ho nkate ase. Asetra mu mmoa ma wonya nkate mu ahotoso, nkuranhyɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔde gyina ano wɔ adwennwen anaa amanehunu bere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi ahwɛ me ho so yie wɔ me kyima (menstruation) mmere mu, anaa sɛ meyɛ ɔbarima a mewɔ kɔtɛ (penis)?
answer_twi_source: Fa Kyima Nneɛma Di Dwuma te sɛ pads, 'tampons', 'menstrual cups', anaa 'period panties' siesie wo ho. Fa deɛ ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo. Mmabaawa a wɔn mmaayewasɛm (hymen)  no ɛntii nntumi mfa 'tampons' anaa 'cervical cups' nndi dwuma. Sesa wo 'pads' anaa 'tampons' dɔnhwere nan kɔsi dɔnhwere nsia (4-6 hours) biara, anaa mpo mpɛn pii sɛ ɛho hia a. Dware daa, titiriw wɔ wo kyima mmere mu, na w'ase mu atew. Sɛ wogya wonan anaa dwonsɔ wiea, popa wo ho firi anim kɔ akyi (front to back) na mmoawa (bacteria) ammɛhyɛ w'ase mu. Hohoro wo nsa yie ansa woasesa wo 'pad' na wowie nso a.   Kɔtɛ Ho Ahoteɛ (Penis Care): Fa samina mmerɛw ne nsuo a ne mu yɛ mmerɛw hohoro wo kɔtɛ. Yɛ no mmerɛw so na wo honam ampaapae. Sɛ wɔantwa wo dɔn (uncircumcised) a, pia kɔtɛ honam no mmerɛw so na hohoro ne nsaase. Ewie a, pia honam no ba ne beaeɛ a ɛsɛ. Sɛ wohohoro wo ho wie a, fa mpopaho (towel) a ɛho tew popa hɔ ma ɛhɔ wo yie. Fa samina mmerɛw a ne hwam nnyɛ den di dwuma. Sɛ wohu sɛ biribi asesa te sɛ ɛyaw, nsaa, pɔmpɔ, anaa nsuo bɔne bi repue firi mu a, kɔhu dɔkota anaa ayaresafoɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔadi nna mu ɔhaw ne akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfa ho ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan Ho Nnurumafo: Nnuruyɛfo, mmea ho animdefo, ne ntini ho animdefo betumi de aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ama. Nna mu akwahosan ho ayaresabea ahorow de ɔhwɛ titiriw ma wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho. Afotu Dwumadibea: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo betumi aboa ma wɔadi adwene mu nsɛm ho dwuma. Adwene mu akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa wɔ nkate fam afã horow ho. Mmoa Akuw: Intanɛt so anaa ankorankoro mmoa akuw ma ankorankoro a wɔwɔ nsɛm a ɛte saa ara. Ntrɛwmu ne Ntrɛwmu a Wɔde Mmoa: Aman pii wɔ telefon a wɔde boa wɔn ma wonya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmmisa ne nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) betumi aboa ma wɔadi wo haw ahorow ho dwuma Nhomasua mu Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ne nhoma ahorow a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, dwumadi a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye, ne ayaresa ho. Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtwe adwene si nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri so. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi saa nneɛma yi hɔ no betumi ama mmabun a wɔredi nna mu ɔhaw anaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfa ho ho dwuma no anya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a ɛsom bo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a ebia wɔbɛpere sɛ wɔbɛtɔ akwahosan ho ka wɔ mmeae a mmerante ne mmabaa nya adamfofa su?
answer_twi_source: Aane, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow bi a ɛfata mmabun de sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow ma de boa mmabun ma wotua akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi abu nnipa a wɔwɔ nna bɔbeasu mu anigye ne su ahorow foforo no yie?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛyɛ adamfo/ɔyɔnko a ɔka obiara ho ni: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho: Sua nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho ade. Fa kasa a obu wom di dwuma: Bisa obi sɛnea wɔpɛ sɛ wɔka ne ho asɛm (edinnsiananmu) na kwati sɛ wubegyina sɛnea ɔte so asusuw nneɛma ho. Twa adwene a ɛnteɛ: Bisa adwene teateaa a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ mu. Yɛ ɔyɔnko: Kasa tia nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Aboafo neɛma anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ kuo bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔ a wadi dem wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a wɔde mmoa akuw ne nneɛma a wɔde boa ma. Hotlines ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Ahomatrofo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne the betumi aboa ama wɔanya nsɛm a mfasoɔ wɔ soAfotuo Nnwuma: Ayaresafoɔ anaa afotufoɔ bɛtumi de mmoa ama wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho. Mmoa Akuw: Kɔka mmoa akuw ho na wo ne w’atipɛnfo nni nkitaho. Online Platforms: Wɛbsaet ne YMK app de mmoa ma. Sukuu Nneɛma: Sukuu ahorow wɔ akuw anaa afotufo a wɔatete wɔn wɔ dɛmdi ho nsɛm ho. Akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow: Akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow de mmubuafo akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nneɛma ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si so dua sɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asɛde wom ne gyinaesi a wɔde nimdeɛ sisi, yɛ nneɛma atitiriw a ɛbɛma wɔde nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano adi dwuma yiye.
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ɛwɔ Asɛde: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano yɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asɛde wom no fã titiriw. Ɛboa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da na ɛbɔ ho ban fi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho. Gyinaesi a Wonya: Hwehwɛ akwan horow mu, te sɛnea etu mpɔn no ase, na wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusuw nneɛma bɔne a ebetumi afi mu aba ho na ama woapaw ɔkwan a ɛfata w’ahiade ne w’abrabɔ ahorow yiye. Tumi a Wɔde Ma: Gyinaesi a wonya wɔ nimdeɛ mu wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no ma wutumi di wo nna mu akwahosan ne wo yiyedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So gyinapɛn bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi fata anaa mfe a obi adi a ɔde bɛka atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ho, na anammɔn bɛn na ɛka ho na ama obi de ne ho ahyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde fata ne mfe a obi adi anohyeto betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina atipɛnfo mmoa kuw pɔtee no so. Ebia akuw binom betumi abue ama mmabun nyinaa, bere a afoforo nso betumi de wɔn ani asi mfe pɔtee bi anaa nnipa dodow pɔtee bi so. Sɛ mmabun de ne ho bɛhyɛ mu a, mpɛn pii no ɛsɛ sɛ wɔda anigye adi sɛ wɔbɛka ho, hyehyɛ nkrataa biara a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛw wɔn din anaasɛ wɔgye wɔn din, na wɔkɔ akwankyerɛ nhyiam anaa nhyiam a edi kan bi ase na wɔahu kuw no akwankyerɛ ne akwanhwɛ ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi, ma wɔakamfo wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ne nnwuma a wobenya?
answer_twi_source: Fa nkyerɛkyerɛ ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho, a nsɛm a ɛfa mmra, nhyehyɛe, ne amanaman ntam apam ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun ho ban ka ho. Hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho nkuran no mu denneennen. Fa ntetee ma wɔ nkitahodi ne akannifo ho nimdeɛ ho na aboa mmabun ma wɔaka wɔn ahiade ahorow ho asɛm yiye na wɔakamfo nsakrae. Ma nnipa nyinaa tumidi ho adwene nhyɛ nkuran denam nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim ne adwumayɛ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne nhyehyɛefo bɛyɛ so. Ma mmabun a wohyia akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie mu no nya mmoa nkitahodiɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na ama wɔn tumi a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ mmoa na wɔahwehwɛ akontaabuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no tumi ka wɔn nsɛm, hwehwɛ nneɛma ne mmoa, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ayaresa ne ahotɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, wɔbɛbɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo, anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka?
answer_twi_source: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wom ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no tumi ma wɔka wɔn nsɛm, hwehwɛ nneɛma ne mmoa, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ayaresa ne ahotɔ nhyehyɛe mu a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, wɔbɛbɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo, anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka. Saa mmeae yi ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no suahu ahorow no yɛ nokware, ɛma wonya ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm, na ɛma wonya hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛboa wɔn na wɔakamfo wɔn. Ɛdenam mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɔ so no, mpɔtam hɔfo da wɔn ahofama adi wɔ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no yiyedi ho na wɔyɛ adwuma de bubu nhyɛso nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔntuo bɛn na ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi atu na ama wɔayɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛgye obiara tom na ɛma mmabun a wɔfiri amammerɛ ahorow mu, te sɛ LGBTQ+ mmofra, atubrafoɔ, atukɔfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ankasa, te nka sɛ wɔsom bo?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi atu anamɔntuo pii na ama wɔayɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛgye obiara tom na ɛma mmabun a wɔfiri amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu, wɔn a wɔwɔ nna mu su ahodoɔ, atubrafoɔ, atukɔfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ankasa te nka sɛ wɔgye wɔn tom. Yei bi ne sɛ wɔbɛsinsɛn mfoni ne nkrataa a ɛkyerɛ amammerɛ ahodoɔ obu, ɛwɔ mmeaeɛ a wɔtwɛn dɔkota, na wɔayɛ nkrataa a ɛma obiara tumi kyerɛ ne bɔbeasu a ɔpɛ, ne ntetee a wɔbɛma adwumayɛfoɔ afa sɛnea wɔbɛgye LGBTQ+ foɔ ne amammerɛ ahodoɔ atom wɔ obu mu. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nso betumi abɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma wɔanya beae a ahobammɔ ne atemmu nnim a mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho asɛm na wɔanya ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn nipasu, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nea wɔpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so fi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu, anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Paw tebea a ahotɔ ne bere a wode befi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase, na hwɛ hu sɛ nneɛma kakraa bi na ɛtwetwe adwene. Fi ase denam w’anigye anaa nea ɛhaw wo wɔ asɛmti no ho a wobɛda no adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ akasakasa so. Fa "Me" nsɛm no da wo nkate ne wo suahunu adi sen sɛ wode asodi bɛto wo so anaasɛ wobɛbɔ wo sobo. Siesie wo ho sɛ wode nsiyɛ ne obu betie w’awofo adwene, sɛ ɛsono wo de mpo a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa anya nsɛmsɛmbisa ne nneɛma a wɔde besua pii afa awo apomoden ho nsɛm a wobesiw ano na wɔadi ho dwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din ne abɛɛfo ntentan so dwumadibea ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ titiriw, te sɛ nea akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ wahye da sɛ wobɛyɛ awofo 'Planned Parenthood 'anaa aban apomoden dwumadibea ahorow de ma no a wɔde bedi dwuma. Akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, a wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiade ahorow ama. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu mu a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa awo akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI ano a wosiw, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Mpɔtam hɔ apomodden asoɛe ahorow, ayaresabea ahorow, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, afotu adwuma, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ma no a wɔbɛkɔ. Mmabun a wɔbɛkɔ akɔsra wɔn wɔ sukuu ahorow mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a mede besua pii afa GBV, ne su ahorow, ne sɛnea mɛsiw ano ho? (wɛbsaet ahorow, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ nhoma, nkratawa, anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a efi nnwumakuo ahorow a wogye wɔn di mu a ɛfa GBV ne nkitahodie pa ho. Kɔ nhyiam ahorow wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, anaa mmabun nnwumakuo ahorow mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na mmabun betumi akɔ akɔhwehwɛ adwenem apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe, na akwan horow bɛn na wobetumi afa so ahwehwɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ akwan pii a wɔbɛfa so anya adwenem apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe. Wobetumi afi ase denam ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu fotubɔfoɔ, anaa abusua oduruyɛfo a obetumi aboa wɔn ma wɔanya nneɛma a ɛfata. Mpɛn pii no, sukuu ahorow wɔ afotumafoɔ anaa adwene ne nneyɛe ho animdefoɔ a wobetumi de mmoa ama, na mpɔtam pii wɔ adwenem apɔwmuden ho mmeae anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔboa mmabun titiriw. Bio nso, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ ne intanɛt so nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de aboa ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ sikakorabea a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ahomatrofo (telephone) so, dijitaal sika kotoku, atipɛnfo sikatua, ne sikasɛm mu mfiridwuma foforo a wɔde di dwuma ma mmabun sikasɛm mu nkabom ne tumidi so?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu mfiridwuma foforo ma mmabun nya mfaso pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya, titiriw ma wɔn a wɔwɔ mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri. Ɛka a wɔbɔ a ɛho ka sua a wɔde toto sikakorabea a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amannek wan so ho a. Tumi a wɔde bɛma denam wɔn sikasɛm so tumi a, ɛkɔ soro ne sikasɛm mu nnwuma ahorow pii a wobenya so. Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔama anya nkɔso denam nnwinnade a wɔde di nkitaho ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusuafoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bɔ nkɔmmɔ fa nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nsɛm a wɔka fa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm nya wɔ wɔn asetra ne wɔn abusuabɔ so no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusuafoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa nkɛntɛnso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nya wɔ wɔn asetra ne wɔn abusuabɔ so denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ akuw, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa nsɛm a esisi a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm mu na wɔakyɛ wɔn ankasa osuahu ne adwene ahorow. Sukuu anaa mpɔtam nhyiamu a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ, ahodoɔ, ne ananmusifoɔ ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne abusuafoɔ ne mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ wɔn mu ahotoso fi ase fa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ suban ne nneyɛe so ho. Mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de akamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ananmusifoɔ a wɔka ho wɔ mpɔtam hɔ sukuu ne asoɛeɛ ahodoɔ mu. Abɛɛfo ntentan mmaeɛ ne ntentan so nkɔmmɔbɔ mmaeɛ (online forums) a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahyɛ nne ahorow mu den na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nsakrae pa wɔ media ananmusifo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, aman pii wɔ mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛma mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Ebia mmara yi bi ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho, pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, kwan a wɔfa so nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne ahobammɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi nyiyim ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ hu sɛ wɔte m’amammerɛ ne me gyidi ase na wɔkyerɛ obu ma bere a merekɔhu no no?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛte amammerɛ ase na wɔabu wɔn denam: Nsɛmmisa a wɔabue ano a wobɛbisa de asua wo amammerɛ, wo gyidie, ne nea wopɛ. Tie a wode nsiyɛ ne aso tie wo haw ne osuahu ahorow a worensusuw ho. Wo amanne, atetesɛm, ne nea wopɛ wɔ akwahosan ho gyinaesi ne ayaresa a wobɛpaw ho a wubebu. Wɔn nkitahodi kwan ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma a wobɛsakra no ma ɛne w’amammerɛ gyinapɛn ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow ahyia. Ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nso bɛma mmabun awerɛhyem wɔ nsɛm a wɔde sie no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow a ɛkyerɛ nnwuma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a ɛde nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho adi dwuma yiye, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ayɛ saa nhwɛso ahorow yi bi anaasɛ wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ tebea afoforo mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nnwuma ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi mu a ɛde nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ho adi dwuma yie bi ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ aman te sɛ Ghana, Netherlands, Sweden, ne Denmark, a ɛde akwan a ɛfa biribiara ho, obiara a wɔbɛka ho, ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu di kan. Saa nhwɛsoɔ yi si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nsɛm a egyina adanseɛ so, atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nteteeɛ, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛda sukuu ahodoɔ, apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔsom mmabun ntam so dua. Wobetumi ayɛ no foforo anaa wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ tebea afoforo mu denam akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ no sɛnea mpɔtam hɔ tebea horow, ahiade, ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma no hyia, ne denam wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ne dwumadie nhyehyɛe no mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi ahaw awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan wɔ mmabun mu, te sɛ asetra kwan a wɔpaw, nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii betumi aka awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan 'reproductive system health' wɔ mmabun mu: Asetra kwan a Wɔpaw: Aduan a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wonnya, nnuru a wɔmfa nni dwuma, ne sigaretnom betumi aka awo akwahosan denam hormone dodow a ɛbɛsɛe ne asiane a ɛbɛma tebea horow te sɛ kɛseyɛ mmoroso ne asikreyare akɔ soro no so. Nyinsɛn a Wosiw Ano a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Nyinsɛn ano a wɔde siw ano a wɔmfa nni dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ anaasɛ ɛnteɛ betumi ama wanyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obenya STI no ayɛ kɛse. Nna mu Nyarewa (STI): 'STI' a wɔansa no betumi de nsɛnnennen te sɛ pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), awo a wontumi nwo, ne awotwaa mu kokoram aba. Adwene mu Akwahosan: Adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw betumi aka awo akwahosan denam hormone dodow ne nna mu dwumadi a ɛbɛka so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no bi ne dɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie?
answer_twi_source: ANANSESƐM 1: NNA MU NSƐM A WƆDE ANO NO YƐ ƆBƆBƆ NO NOKWARE: Ebia nna a wɔde ano ka no remma nyinsɛn nanso nna mu nyarewa (STI) da so ara tumi denam anom nna so. ANANSESƐM 2: ƐNYƐ MMƆBƆ SƐ WƆBƐKA SƐ OBI WƆ NYANKƆSƐM A ƐFA NNA MU NKYERƐKYERƐMU: Ɛyɛ nokware sɛ ebia obi benya nna mu yare ho sɛnkyerɛnne nanso ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa. Wɔ nsɛm pii mu no ɔkwan biako pɛ a obi betumi afa so ahu sɛ wɔwɔ ɔyare bi a efi nna mu ne nhwehwɛmu. ANANSESƐM 3: KONDOM (CONDOM) KYERƐ NKYERƐKYERƐMU A ƐYƐ AHOHYEƐ WƆ ƆBƆBƆ HO NOKWARE: Ɛyɛ nokware sɛ kɔndɔm a wode bedi dwuma bere a woreda no remma wunnyinsɛn nanso bere a wohyɛ no yiye nkutoo. Sɛ kɔndɔm no pae wɔ nna mu a, nyinsɛn nso betumi aba. Enti ɛho hia saa ara sɛ wobɛpaw kɔndɔm a ɛfata na woahyɛ no yiye. Sua sɛnea wɔde kɔndɔm bedi dwuma ANANSESƐM 4: MMARIMA A WODI MPA MU AGORU NE MMARIMA "GAY MEN" NKUTOO NA WƆBETUMI ANYA "HIV" NOKWARE: Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ nna mu no betumi anya "HIV" anaa ɔyare mmoawa a efi nna mu, a nna ho akɔnnɔ mfa ho. ANANSESƐM 5: ANSA NA WOBETUMI AFIRI NO YƐ NOKWARE A AKWANKYERƐ: Mmarima yi nsu fi awotwaa mu ansa na wɔatow ne ho na mmea nso yi nsu a ɛwɔ ɔbea no awotwaa mu no fi mu bere a wɔkanyan no, na ebia nsu a wɔde sesa yi remma nyinsɛn nanso ebetumi ama obi anya nna mu nyarewa mpo sɛ obi twe ne ho ansa na watu a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔte ankorankoro akwannya ahorow ase na wo ne awofo bɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ obu mu no ho asɛm.
answer_twi_source: Akwannya Wo Nim: Wɔ Ghana no, wowɔ hokwan sɛ wusi w’akwahosan ho gyinae a ɛfata, a nea wosiw nyinsɛn ano ka ho, a awofo mpene so. Nanso, nidi mu nkitahodi a wɔne awofo bɛda so ara ho hia. Nkitahodi a obu wom: Sɛ ɛsono w’awofo gyidi mpo a, wo ne wɔn nkasa brɛoo ne pefee fa ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubenya nna a ahobammɔ wom ne nyinsɛn ano a wode bedi dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu no ho. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo nhwehwɛmu ne wo nsusuwii mu. Nea Wobɛhwehwɛ: Fa w’adwene si gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔkyɛ te sɛ akwahosan ne asɛyɛde so. Ebia kɔndɔm yɛ mfiase pa efisɛ enhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw nnuru ma na ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛkyerɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ɛfata ma me? (mfe a obi adi wɔ nyinsɛn mu, aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ɛfata wo no gyina nneɛma pii so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mfe a woadi wɔ nyinsɛn mu (bere a woakɔ akyiri wɔ wo nyinsɛn no mu): Wɔtaa de nnuru a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu di dwuma ntɛm wɔ nyinsɛn mu, bere a wɔde oprehyɛn a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu di dwuma akyiri yi. Aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm: Wo duruyɛfo bɛka ayaresa tebea biara a wowɔ ho asɛm na ama wahu ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom sen biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nyinsɛn a woyi gu wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ baabi a mete? (Eyi ho hia sɛ wobua a egyina beae a wowɔ so)
answer_twi_source: Aane, nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ mmara kwan so wɔ Ghana wɔ tebea horow bi mu. kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn na woanya nsɛm pii
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya abusua nhyehyɛe a awofo mpene so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun betumi anya abusua nhyehyɛe a awofo mpene so. Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so nketenkete ma awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu, nanso akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo pii de kokoam nnwuma ma mmabun, a afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano a wobenya ka ho, a enhia sɛ awofo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Mmara a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho bɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho sisi gyinae wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho no ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho a wogye tum na wɔde hyɛ wɔn mu a wɔankasa ntia no mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho a wogye tum na wɔde hyɛ wɔn mu a wɔankasa ntia no betumi ama: Wɔahyehyɛ akwanhwɛ ne gyidi ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ne abusuabɔ ho. Nipadua ho mfonini a enye ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ho nsɛm, sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ taa da ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn teateaa adi no. Nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne ntease a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nsɛmti ho, na ɛde nneyɛe anaa gyinaesi ahorow a asiane wom ba. Nsusuwii hunu ne animtiaabu a epira a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den, nyiyim ne animtiaabu a wɔbɛma akɔ so. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ abusuabɔ pa a egyina pene, obu, ne pɛyɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ntawntawdi a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nna mu nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, ne awo gyinaesi a a wobesi ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ntawntawdi ne haw ɛkeka ho no ano?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia ntawntawdi ahorow a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nna mu nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, ne awo ho nneɛma a wɔpaw ho, te sɛ adwene a enhyia wɔ nna mu ahyeɛ ho, nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu, ntawntawdi a wɔne wɔn nnamfo anaa wɔn a wɔdɔ wɔn, ne nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru anaa awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu. Ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a betumi ayɛ ho biribi denam nkitahodi, ntease, ne biakoyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so, na ɛnam so ama ɔhaw anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ a ebetumi aba no so atew.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ne nsɛnnennen bɛn na mmabun hyia wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a, ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi eyinom ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmeae a wɔboa a wonnya. Animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne mmabunbere ho. Tumi mu nkɔso ne mfe a wɔadi a ɛto mmabun, a wɔde wɔn ho bɛka ho ne nkɛntɛnso ano hye. Wobetumi adi nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma denam mmeae a mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa su a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu a wɔde bɛma, awo ntoatoaso ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu di kan a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ntease a edi mu na ɛkari pɛ wɔ asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nna mu dwumadi ahorow mu, a mprewa nyinsɛn, STI, nkate mu nsunsuanso, ne nkitahodie mu nkɔso ka ho, de asi gyinae a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobenya ntease a edi mu na ɛkari pɛ wɔ asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nna mu dwumadi ahorow mu no ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Nhomasua ne nsɛm: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so, a egyina adanse so a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI a wosiw ano, ne nkitahodie mu nkɔso ho fi mmeae a wotumi gye di te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din, ne nhomasua nneɛma. Nsusuwii a emudɔ: Hwehwɛ nsɛm mu yiye, susuw faako a nsɛm no fi, nea ɛfa ho, ne sɛnea wotumi de ho to so ho na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wobɛte asiane ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ so no ase yiye. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee: Wo ne mpanyimfo, atipɛnfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di nsusuw nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ho na ama woanya adwene ne nhumu ahorow. Adeyɛ a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho: Dwennwen osuahu ahorow a atwam ne nea efi nna ho gyinaesi mu ba ho na ama woasua biribi afi nkonimdi ne mfomso ahorow mu na woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata daakye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa akuw betumi adi wɔ atenka fam mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔredi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn atenka adi, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔanya nokwaredi ne tema afi atipɛnfo a wɔte wɔn apereperedi ase hɔ. Kuw no mufo betumi de afotu a mfaso wɔ so, akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa wɔn ho wɔn ho ama wɔadi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen ho dwuma ama. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw hyɛ ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne tumidi ho nkuran denam mpɔtam hɔfo ho adwene, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne adeyɛ a wɔbom yɛ wɔ nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene a wɔtaa di ho dwuma ne nsakrae a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan te sɛ sika a wonnya nyɛ pɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ a wonya, ne adan a ɛyɛ den di wɔ mmabun awo mu nkɔso a wɔhyehyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan te sɛ sika a wonnya nyɛ pɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ a wobenya, adan a ɛyɛ den, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma nya mmabun awo mu nkɔso so nsunsuannso kɛse. Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ saa nneɛma yi mu no betumi ama nsonsonoe aba akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, ne mmoa a wɔde ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ midwen nipadua mfonini anaa sɛnea ɛte ho bere a ɛfa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛtaa ba sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn nipadua ho adwene wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu, titiriw bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu no. Nneɛma bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw ho ni: Fa W’adwene Si Akwahosan So: Sɛ́ anka wode w’adwene besi sɛnea wo ho yɛ fɛ nkutoo so no, susuw sɛnea apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ so ba w’akwahosan, w’ahoɔden, ne w’ahoɔden so mfaso ho. Di Ahoɔden Ho Afahyɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ betumi aboa wo ma woate nka sɛ wo ho yɛ den na wutumi yɛ adwuma. Fa w’adwene si nea wo nipadua betumi ayɛ so sen sɛnea ɛte. Hyɛ Ntade a Ɛyɛ Fɛ: Paw ntade a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo na woanya ahotoso. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ntade a ɛfata betumi aboa wo ma woatu akɔ baabiara, ate nka sɛ wo ho ye na wowɔ ahobammɔ. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ de gye w’ani: Paw dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho na ɛma wo ho tɔ wo. Sɛ woregye w’ani a, ɛnyɛ den koraa sɛ wobɛhaw wo ho wɔ sɛnea wo ho te ho. Nipadua mu Nneɛma Pa: Fa nkrasɛm pa a ɛfa nipadua ahorow ne sɛnea wogye wo ho tom ho twa wo ho hyia. Ɛsono obiara nipadua, na ɛno yɛ ade a ɛfata. Adwene a Wɔde Si Adwene: Fa w’adwene di dwuma bere a woreteɛteɛ w’apɔw mu. Fa w’adwene si sɛnea wo nipadua te nka ne anigye a ɛwɔ kankyee mu no so sen sɛ wubebu atɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bɛn na ɛtaa ba a atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye betumi asɔre, titiriw wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Obi a wɔbɛhyɛ no ma ɔde ne ho ahyɛ nna mu nndwuma ansa na wasiesie ne ho. Nneyɛe a asiane wom te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ansa na wɔrenya nna mu kyɛfa anaa bere a wɔrenya nna mu kyɛfa, anaasɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu bere a nnubɔne anaa nsa a wɔnom no ho nkuranhyɛ. Obi ho fɛwdi anaa aniwu a wɔpaw wɔ nea ɔpaw wɔ nna mu dwumadi anaa abusuabɔ ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nnipa a wɔagye din, nkɛntɛnsofo, ne ɔmanfo mu nnipa di wɔ nna ho mfonini ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔde kɔ so tra hɔ denam wɔn a wɔde wɔn gyina hɔ ma wɔ nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu no so?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔagye din, nkɛntɛnsofo a broni ka no 'influencers', ne ɔmanfo mu nnipa betumi ama nna ho mfonini ne nsusuwii hunu atra hɔ daa denam wɔn a wɔde wɔn gyina hɔ ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no so denam: Mfonini ahorow a ɛkanyan akɔnnɔ a wɔbɛkyɛ anaasɛ wɔda no adi wɔ sohyial media so de atwetwe adwene na wɔakura wɔn baguam mfonini mu. Nnwuma te sɛ sini anaa nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn ho to mfonini ahorow a ɛfa nna ho so de twetwe atiefo anaa adetɔfo mu kyɛfa a wonya. Mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie ne akwanhwɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den denam wɔn suban, wɔn honam ani hwɛbea, ne wɔn nkitahodie wɔ ɔmanfoɔ ne intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dɛmdi ne nipasu  afoforo, te sɛ mmusuakuw ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea hyia?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ne nipasu afã afoforo, te sɛ mmusuakuw ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea di nkitaho, na ɛde osuahu soronko ba: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ne Mmusuakuw: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa dɛmdi ho betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ mmusuakuw ahorow mu. Ɔbabun a wadi dɛm a ofi nnipa kakraa bi mu betumi ahyia ɔhaw foforo esiane amammerɛ mu animhwɛ nti. Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ne Asetena mu Sikasɛm Gyinabea: Ebia mmabun a wonni sika pii a wɔadi dɛm no ntumi nnya nhomasua pa, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, anaa mfiridwuma a ɛboa, na ɛbɛma wɔato nkyɛn bio Saa nhyiam ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase no ho hia kɛse na ama wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho ankasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na awo mu ahofadi kyerɛ, na ɛne awo hokwan ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Awo mu ahofadi kyerɛ tumi a ankorankoro wɔ sɛ wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ne wɔn asetra ho a afoforo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn. Ɛka hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔpaw sɛ ɔbɛwo mma, bere a nyinsɛn ne ntam kwan a ɛda ntam, ne hokwan a obenya de asiw nyinsɛn ano ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na tumi mu nkɔsoɔ, mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ mmusua ne mpɔtam mu no da adi wɔ amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa nkɔsoɔ yi nya ankorankoro tumi a wɔde si wɔn ahyeɛ so dua na wɔsi gyinaeɛ wɔ wɔn nipadua ho wɔ ahofadie mu no so nsunsuansoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Tumi mu nkɔsoɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa dwumadie, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ mmusua ne mpɔtam mu no nya amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho so nsunsuansoɔ: Bɔbeasu ho akwanhwɛ: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn taa kyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa dwumadie ne akwanhwɛ, a ɛtumi nya ankorankoro tumi a wɔde si wɔn ahyeɛ so nsunsuansoɔ. Nhwɛso te sɛ, wɔ aman anaa sɛ mpɔtam a wodi agya adeɛ no, ebia wɔbɛma mmarima tumi ne ahofadi kɛse wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu, bere a mmea betumi ahyia nhyɛso sɛ wɔnyɛ nea ɛne atetesɛm mu dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow hyia no. Abusua mu Nkɔso: Abusua nhyehyɛe ne nkɔso di dwuma titiriw wɔ ntease a ankorankoro wɔ wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho no mu. Amammerɛ ahorow a ɛde abusua mu biakoyɛ ne osetie di kan no betumi abu ka a wɔbɛka abom wɔ ahye a wɔde besi hɔ anaasɛ tumidifo a wɔbɛkasa atia wɔn no abam. Mpɔtam Nsunsuansoɔ: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi ahyɛ tumi mu nkɔso ne nniso ahorow mu den, na aka ankorankoro dwumadibea wɔ wɔn pene ne ahofadi a wɔkyerɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn abisa m'awofoɔ nna mu akwahosan (sexual health) nsɛmmisa a emu yɛ duru?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛ sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosua adeɛ. Bisa sɛ ebia ɔpɛ sɛ mo mmienu bɔ ho nkɔmmɔ. Bu wɔn mmuaeɛ. Bisa baabi foforo a wubetumi asua adeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama wim nsakrae tebea mu atɛntrenee ne pɛyɛ, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde mpɔtam a wonni ahobammɔ kɛse, a mmabun ka ho, di kan wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsakra wim nsakrae ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtew so no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu Ɔsatu: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow, ɔsɔretia, ne sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow a wɔyɛ de ma nkurɔfo hu nkɛntɛnso a wim nsakrae de ba nnipa a wonni ahobammɔ so. Nhyehyɛeɛ mu Nkitahodiɛ: Wɔbɛhwehwɛ nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ wim nsakrae tebea ho nkitahodiɛ mu de ako ama nhyehyɛɛ a ɛde mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua, a mmabun ka ho, ahiadeɛ di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn no di animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa STI ne HIV ho no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ di animtiaabuo ne nyiyim a ɛfa STI ne HIV ho dwuma denam: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛma na wɔama nkurɔfoɔ ate nokwasɛm a ɛwɔ STI ne HIV a wɔbɛtena mu no ho asɛm de ayi anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ afiri hɔ. Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo de ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛtew animtiaabu ne nyiyim so wɔ akwahosan ho mmeae, sukuu, adwumayɛbea, ne mpɔtam hɔ ho nkuran. Mmoa akuo ne atipɛnfoɔ afotuo dwumadie a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro a STI ne HIV aka wɔn de ama wɔanya atenka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wɔama wɔn tumi. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, adwumayɛbea, ne ɔsatuo a ɛkasa tia animtiaabuo na ɛhyɛ tema, nteaseɛ, ne gye a wɔgye nnipa a wɔwɔ STI ne HIV tom ho nhyehyɛeɛ. Yɛne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma, a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, nyamesom asoɛeɛ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ka ho, bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ama nkrasɛm a ɛfa abodwokyɛreɛ ne obiara a wɔbɛka ho no ayɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ na wɔatumi aka nsɛm a ɛnyɛ merɛ ka anaa nsɛm a ɛde akasakasa ba wɔ awoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa nipa biara ho na ɛbu amammere nso?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma no bi ne: Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ ɔkwan pa a wɔfa so kyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa adeɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, amammere ho nimdeɛ, ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ nipa a asiane bi ato no so yie. Nnwoma a nnwumakuo a wɔwɔ din na wɔayɛ, a ɛsi pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ne obiara a wɔde no bɛfra mu so dua. Wɔne sukuu mu afotufoɔ, apɔwmuden ho akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ayɔnkofoɔ bɔ mu yɛ adwuma na ama wɔanya nimdeɛ ne mmoa a ɛka ho. Akwan a wɔfa so kɔ intanɛt so hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatumi aka nsɛm a ɛyɛ mmerɛ ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so. Hokwan a wɔnya berɛ ne berɛ de sua nneɛma foforɔ, wɔne wɔn mfɛfoɔ nkyekyɛ nimdeɛ, na wɔahwehwɛ akwan a ɛbɛhyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nkuran na ama wɔanya akokoɔduo ne nyansa de aka awarene ne awoɔ ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow (CBOs) di wɔ SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔkyɛ nsɛm a wogye di, wɔyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔma nkurɔfo hu, wɔyɛ nhyiam ahorow ne atipɛnfo nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nhyehyɛe, wɔde afotu ne nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ma, na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a eye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na "hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya nsɛm ne nnwuma a obenya" kyerɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm ne nnwuma a wonya no hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun nya nimdeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛho hia na wɔde asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho. Eyi ka ho ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu yareɛ, nyinsɛn, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho a wobenya, ne tumi a wobetumi anya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a nyiyimu anaa akwanside biara nni ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So asiane anaa nsunsuanso bɔne bi wɔ afotusɛm anaa ayaresa mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Bere a mpɛn pii no afotu anaa ayaresa yɛ nea asiane biara nni ho na mfaso wɔ so no, asiane anaa nsunsuanso bɔne bi betumi aba a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wubetumi anya bere tiaa mu ahokyere anaa atinka mu ahokyere bere a worehwehwɛ nsusuwii anaa atinka ahorow a emu yɛ den mu no. Wɔ tebea horow a ɛntaa nsi mu no, ayaresa betumi ada nsɛm a ɛda adi a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔboa anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu foforo adi. Sɛ wowɔ asiane anaa nsunsuanso bɔne a ebetumi aba ho dadwen a, wo ne wo fotufo anaa wo ɔyaresafo no nsusuw ho. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama de aboa wo ma woadi nsɛnnennen biara a ɛbɛsɔre bere a wɔreyɛ ayaresa no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mu ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan, na asuade bɛn na yebetumi asua afi mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a edi mu a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no bi ne: ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɛhyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, awoɔ hokwan ahorow, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun a wobenya ho nkuranhyɛ. Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom bɔ wɔ mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne nnwumakuw a wɔsom mmabun ntam de mmara ne akwahosan ho nnwuma a wɔaka abom ama mmabun. Dwumadi ahorow a egyina sukuu so a nkitahodi nhyiam ahorow, atipɛnfo afotuo, ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun wɔn hokwan ne wɔn asɛde ahorow ka ho. Asuadeɛ a wɔnya firi saa nnwuma yi mu si hia a ɛhia sɛ mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔbɛkyekyere ayɔnkofa, ne akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahodoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a ɛda ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim ne 'NGO' ahorow a wɔatew wɔn ho anaa aban adwumayɛbea ahorow ntam no ma mmabun nne, wɔn adwene, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan wɔ wiase nyinaa 'ASRH' nhyehyɛe ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no yɛ kɛse?
