answer_twi_source: Saa nkitahodi yi ma mmabun nne, wɔn adwene, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan wɔ wiase nyinaa 'ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow mu yɛ kɛse denam atenae a ɛma mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu a ntease wom no so. Ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde asi hɔ no bɛtumi de nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ titire 'NGO' a ɛwɔ akwahosan fã, afotuo, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ mmoa ama nnwuma a mmabun di anim, berɛ a mmabun de adwene foforɔ, ahoɔden, ne osuahu a wɔatena ase ba pon no so, na ɛkanyan nnwuma foforɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛkamfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛwɔ bere tiaa mu abotɔyam "short-term gratification" ne bere tenten mu mmamu "long-term fulfillment" ntam, na ɔkwan bɛn so na botae a mede besi hɔ betumi aboa me ma masusuw akatua a mfɛfo nhyɛso de ba ntɛm ara no atoto nea ebetumi afi mu aba ne bere tenten mu mfaso a ɛwɔ gyinaesi a egyina nimdeɛ so, a egyina gyinapɛn ahorow so no ho?
answer_twi_source: Bere tiaa mu abotɔyam kyerɛ akatua anaa anigye a wonya ntɛm ara, bere a bere tenten mu abotɔyam hwehwɛ sɛ wonya abotɔyam ne abotɔyam a emu dɔ bere tenten. Botae ahorow a wode besisi w’ani so boa ma wosusuw akatua a atipɛnfo nhyɛso de ba ntɛm ara no ho de toto nea ebetumi afi mu aba ne mfaso a wubenya bere tenten ho denam: Gyinapɛn ahorow a wode bedi kan: Botae ahorow a wode besi w’ani so a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne bere tenten mu apɛde ahorow hyia no boa wo ma woko tia bere tiaa mu abotɔyam a ebetumi asɛe wo yiyedi anaa wo gyinapɛn ahorow. Nea ebefi mu aba a wubesusuw ho: Botae a wode besisi w’ani so no hyɛ nkuran sɛ wubesusuw nneɛma a ebetumi afi gyinaesi ahorow mu aba no ho, na ɛboa wo ma wopaw nneɛma a wunim a ɛde bere tenten mu mmamu di kan sen bere tiaa mu abotɔyam. Sɛ wubenya ahoɔden a wode begyina tebea horow ano: Botae ahorow a ɛboa w’akwahosan ne w’anigye nyinaa a wubedi akyi a, ɛma wutumi gyina tebea ahorow ano wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wobɛko atia ne gyinaesi ahorow a egyina nea ɛma abotɔyam ankasa na ntease wom ma wo so si no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw a ɛfa sika dwumadie, sika a wɔde sie, ne sɛnea yɛhwɛ yɛn sika so yie sɛ mmabun ho no, ne deɛn?
answer_twi_source: Sika dwumadie anaa budgeting yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a obi yɛ fa ɔkwan a ɔbɛfa so asɛe ne sika ne sɛnea ɔbɛkora ne sika so, a egyina ne sika a ɔnya ne ne ka so. Mmabun bɛtumi afi aseɛ de nsɛm a edidi soɔ yi ayɛ adwuma: Ma weni nnkɔ baabi a wo sika taa kɔ pɔtii. Hwɛ nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda deɛ ɛhia wo ne deɛ wopɛ ntam. Kyɛ wo sika no mu ma w'ahiade ho te sɛ aduane, kar, agorɔ, ne sika a wɔde sie. Sika a wɔde sie yɛ sɛ wobɛfa sika bi ahyɛ baabi ama daakye anaa biribi a ɛbɛsi mpofirim. Mmabun bɛtumi di sika ato hɔ berɛ ne berɛ mu, na si gyinaeɛ wɔ botaeɛ ho a wobɛfa sika no ayɛ wɔ daakye. Hwɛ sɛ wobɛfa savings accounts anaa investment accounts ayɛ adwuma. Sika so nhwɛso pa hwehwɛ sɛ; Hwɛ baabi a wo sika kɔ nyinaa. Wo kwati ka a ɛho nhia. Wode deɛ ɛhia wo di kan. Wohwehwɛ akwan a wobɛfa so anya sika pii anaa watew ka so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛma obi nya obu ne ahotoso wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmaabun betumi anya saa su ahorow yi wɔ wɔne afoforo nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Obu ne ahotoso a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho yɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia wɔ abusuabɔ pa mu, na mmabun betumi anya saa su ahorow yi denam: Ahye a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye ne pene a wɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ no afa horow nyinaa mu no so. Bɔhyɛ Ahorow a Wodi: Bɔhyɛ ne bɔhyɛ ahorow a wobedi akyi, na bere kɔ so no, wonya ahotoso. Anisɔ a Wɔbɛda no adi: Wɔbɛda aseda ne anisɔ adi wɔ ntoboa ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔn ho wɔn ho yɛ ho. Ahofadi ho nkuranhyɛ: Wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho ankorankoro nkɔso ne ahofadi a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ no akyi. Tema a Wobɛkyekye: Tema ne ntease a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho suahu ne wɔn adwene ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a merehwehwɛ nna ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛma wo nhwehwɛmu no ayɛ kokoam ni: Incognito anaa private browsing mode: Eyi boa ma woto cookies a wodi akyi no ano hye. Popa wo nhwehwɛmu abakɔsɛm: Popa wo browsing abakɔsɛm ne cache daa. Kwati baguam Wi-Fi: Fa Wi-Fi a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma bere a worehwehwɛ nsɛmti a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no atumi akura wɔn amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu nipasu ho adwene mu bere a wogye wɔn nna mu nsɛm nso tom no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm te sɛ afoforo nyinaa kura nea wogye di no mu bere nyinaa Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ nyamesom kuw no nkyerɛkyerɛ mu na ama wɔate nneɛma a ɛfa wɔn nna ho ase yiye na ama wɔatumi atena ase sɛnea ɛte.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahodoɔ bɛn so na wɔbɛfa so ayɛ tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: 1. Nneɛma a Wɔde Kɔ ne Dabere: Hwɛ sɛ wobetumi akɔ hɔ wɔ honam fam ne mfididwuma mu, na ma dabere a ɛho hia, te sɛ bere foforo a wɔde bɛyɛ dwumadi ahorow anaa mfididwuma a ɛboa a wɔde bedi dwuma. 2. Kasa a ɛka obiara ho: Fa kasa a ɛkyerɛ obu ne nea ɛka obiara bom di dwuma, na kwati ɛnne a ɛkasa tia anaasɛ ɛmmoa. 3. Mmofra a sebi wɔadi dɛm ho nimdeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ: Fa nteteeɛ ne nneɛma ma adwumayɛfoɔ, asuafoɔ, ne awofoɔ na ama wɔate sebi mmubuafoɔ ase. 4. Nhyehyeɛ ne akwan a wɔfa so boa: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwan a ɛboa ma wɔde wɔn ka ho, te sɛ mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ankorankoro ho ne ayayadeɛ a wɔsiw ano na wɔde di dwuma. 5. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa ne Asetra mu Nkabom: Hyɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ne asetena mu nkabom ho nkuran denam akuo akuo, ne dwumadiɛ a ɛma ayɔnkofa ne adamfofa nya nkɔsoɔ so. 6. Adwene mu Akwahosan Mmoa: Ma kwan ma wonya adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie ne mmoa, a wɔhunu sɛdeɛ sebi dɛmdiɛ ne adwenemyareɛ hyia. 7. Abusua ne Ɔhwɛfoɔ a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Wo ne mmusua ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no nni nkitaho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛbom aboa na wɔadi nkitaho. 8. Dwumadie a ɛfa nsakraeɛ ne nea ɛka obiara ho: Fa dwumadiɛ a ɛtumi sesa na ɛka obiara bom ma wɔ adesua akyi dwumadiɛ, agumadiɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu. 9. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm ananmusifoɔ ne Nhwɛsoɔ: Wɔda dɛmdifoɔ ananmusifoɔ adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, adesua nhyehyɛeɛ, ne akannifoɔ dibea mu de hyɛ deɛ wɔhunu ne tumidi ho nkuran. 10. Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ So ne Nsɛm a Wɔde Ma: Hwehwɛ nsɛm fi mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ne wɔn mmusua hɔ daa na ama woahu mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wunya nkɔso na .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu de hu sɛnea kwan a wɔfa so si awoɔ-ano-kwan amanehunu mu (sexual and reproductive health crisis intervention) no rekɔ so, na nnipa bɛn na wɔyɛ saa adwuma yi?
answer_twi_source: Wɔtaa hwehwɛ ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no mu daa, a ɛbɛtumi afiri afe biara kɔsi mfeɛ kakra biara, a egyina nhyehyɛeɛ no nneɛma ne n’ahiadeɛ so. Ebia adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ adwuma no mu, abɔnten so nhwehwɛmufo, anaa abien no nyinaa a wɔaka abom na wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na brayɛ no yɛ adwuma,na ne nkyekyɛ mu ne sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ mu nsɛm no yɛ den na nsonsonyɛ wom ɛnam nkwammoa ahodoɔ a edi dwuma wo nipadua no mu nti. Emu nkyekyɛ mu no gu ahodoɔ nnan na ɛyɛ nsabuo berɛ, follicular berɛ mu, nkosua to berɛ mu ne luteal berɛ mu. Nsabuo mu nkyekye mu: Nsabuo: Ɛyɛ berɛ a ɛbɔ awotwaa no ho ban, mpɛn pii no edi nnafua mmiɛnsa de kɔpem nna nson so. Follicular Phase: Ɛyi nkosua firi awotwaa no mu de ba, na awotwaa no mu ntini no yɛ den. Nkosua to berɛ: Ɛyi nkosua a anyiyi fi awotwaa no mu, ɛba bɛyɛ kyina no mfinimfini. Luteal Phase: Sɛ wɔantumi annye nkesua no a, nkwammoaa no so tumi te, na awotwaa no mu ntini no sɛeɛ. Saa yɛ yi tɔkɔ so bio na mpɛn pii no ɛkyɛ bɛyɛ nnafua 28, ɛwom sɛ ebetumi ayɛ soronko dɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mɛtumi afa so ahwɛ sɛ manya nna mu nyarewa 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa mmoa sɛ ehia a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛhwɛ sɛ woanya nna mu nyarewa a 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa mmoa: Hunu mpɔtam hɔ apɔmuden mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ apɔmuden ayaresabea, anaa nna mu apɔmuden mmeae a wɔyɛ nnaq mu nyarewa 'STI' nhwehwɛmu na wɔma ayaresa. Bisa w’apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ fa nhwehwɛmu bere a wɔakyerɛ a egyina wo nna mu dwumadie ne asiane nneɛma so. Bisa kɔkoam nhwehwɛmu akwan, sika mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ, anaa mmabun mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam. Sua 'STI' sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtaa kɔ so ho ade na kɔhwehwɛ ayaresa ntɛm sɛ wote nka sɛ woanya yareɛ bi a. Gyina nna mu apɔmuden nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ne 'STI' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa mmoa akyi wɔ wo mpɔtam de boa mmabun nyinaa apɔmuden ne yiedie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama awoɔ akwaa apɔmuden atɛntrenee (reproductive justice) ɛnam ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa so, abasɛm a wɔka ne mpɔtam mputuo?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam dwumadie. to anansesɛm (Ka wo suahunu). Ne ahyehyɛdeɛ nyɛ adwuma. Hwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodie di wɔ ntease ne gye a wogye tom wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ne wɔn awofo anaa abusua mufo nna ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wɔabue Mu: Nkitahodi a nokwaredie ne obu wom yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma wɔanya ntease ne gye a wogye tom. Tie a Wɔyɛ no Nsi: Ɛsɛ sɛ awofo ne mmabun nyinaa tie wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene denneennen. Kasa a Wɔkyɛ: Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na wotumi nya bi di dwuma fa susuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate a ɛfa nna ne dɛmdi ho ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ayɛ de ayɛ tebea a ɛbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho ama me nnamfo ne mfɛfo sukuufo a wɔ wɔ SOGI osuahu ahorow? (de kasa a ɛka obiara di dwuma, de obu ma edinnsiananmu) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu mmaa ne mmaa da ne mmarima ne mmarima da a broni ka no 'LGBTQ+' sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi ahyehyɛ hyeɛ (boundaries) ama me nnamfo anaa me mfɛfoɔ na ama manya ahotɔ na wɔabu me?
answer_twi_source: Ma emu nna hɔ na ka no pen: Kyerɛ nea wopɛ ne nea wompɛ no mu pefee a akokoduru wom, a wompa kyɛw anaasɛ womfa anoyi mma. Fa "Me" fiti wo nsɛm ase: Kyerɛ wo hyeɛ de gyina w'atenke ne wo mmoa a wuhia so, na mmɔ afoforo soboɔ anaa mmu wɔn atɛn. San hwɛ wo nnamfofa mu yiye: Fa wo ho bɔ nnamfo a wobu wo na wɔboa wo hyeɛ ahorow no, na tew wo ho firi wɔn a wɔmpɛ sɛ wobu wo hyeɛ no koraa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu de di adwennwen anaa nkate horow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma? (ɛyɛ den sɛ wubegyina ano, te nka sɛ woayɛ basaa) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ den sɛ wubegyina ano: Sɛ w’ankasa worepere sɛ wubedi adwennwen, dadwen, anaa nkate bɔne ho dwuma a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa a efi oduruyɛfo anaa ɔfotufo a wowɔ animde hɔ. Sɛ wote nka sɛ woayɛ basaa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo nkate rehaw wo da biara da asetra a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛtrɛw wo nsam akɔhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akɔ so ahwɛ anaa akasa fa nsɛmmisa a ɛfa me nna ho hiadeɛ anaa mmeranteɛ ne mmaa ho hia adeɛ a m'abusua, nnamfo, ne mmofra a wɔn mfeɛ nkɔ ɛkaho?
answer_twi_source: Kasa pefee  (di nokorɛ/yɛ komm). aboafoɔ (ahomatorofoɔ: 0540-118-999). Hwehwɛ Mmoa (afutufoɔ/ɔpanyin a wɔgye no di) nkyerɛkyerɛ (ma nsɛm).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛma nokorɛdie ne nkontabuo (transparency/accountability) ayɛ den wɔ ASRH sika mu?
answer_twi_source: nokorɛdie ne nkontabuo nsɛm bɛyɛ papa berɛ  a wɔbɔ amanneɛ pefee no(clear reporting), 'audits', ne sika ho nsɛm a yɛbɛda no adi. Mmabun a wɔbɛka adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛ 'oversight committees' ho de ahwɛ sɛ sika no kɔ baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne abusuabɔ ho no nya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ne ɔhwɛ a wobenya?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne abusuabɔ ho betumi anya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ne ɔhwɛ a wobenya so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Ebia mmabun behyia nhyɛso sɛ wɔnyɛ nea wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam atetesɛm mu, na ebetumi aka sɛnea wobetumi anya nsɛm ne nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no. Pɛyɛ a enni mmarima ne mmea ne tumi a ɛkɔ so wɔ abusuabɔ mu no betumi aboa ma nsonsonoe aba wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma, nna mu yareɛ 'STI' a wosiw ano, ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu. Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛma mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nyiyim kɔ so no ho dwuma a wobedi no ho hia na ama wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata na wɔaboa abusuabɔ pa a ɛda mmabun ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ma wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ne nhyehyɛe no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ma wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow denam: Wɔnam atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛka wɔn ho asɛm, ne sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow so ama nkurɔfo ate wɔn hokwan ahorow ne hia a ɛho hia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so. Mmabun a wodi anim a wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho nhyehyɛe, te sɛ nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne adesrɛ ahorow a wɔde kɔma nkurɔfo, a wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wonya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, akwahosan ho nnwuma, ne mmeae a mmerante ne mmabaa nya adamfofa su kɛse. Nkitahodi a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, mmarahyɛ baguafo, ne aban mpanyimfo bedi nkitaho de akamfo mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban na ɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔmfa nni dwuma. Apam ne nkabom a wɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ adwene koro, wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden, ne ayɔnkofo bɛyɛ de ahyɛ wɔn nne mu den na wɔakasa ma nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ɔman no mu, ne amanaman ntam. Nhyiamu te sɛ mmabun agyinatukuo, afotuo bagua, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwɛ sɛ wɔde mmabun adwene ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan no bɛka gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kari pɛ wɔ, hia a ehia sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie ne asɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afi ɔhaw ho wɔ ɔhaw tebea ahorow mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo susuw tebea biara ho yiye na ama wɔakari pɛ wɔ hia a ehia sɛ, wɔde kokoamsɛm sie ne asɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmabun ho ban afi asiane ho no mu. Wodi adwumayɛfo akwankyerɛ ne mmra mu ahwehwɛde ahorow akyi sɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm adi bere a ɛho hia nkutoo, na wɔasiw ɔhaw ano, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm biara adi wɔ nea ɛho hia kakraa bi pɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so nya tema, ntease, ne ayamhyehye ma wɔ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Ho Nsusuiɛ: Yɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde yɛ mfonini wɔ baabi a nkurɔfo betumi anya nsɛnnennen a ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm hyia. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Hokwan Nhomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ fa hokwan ne ahiadeɛ a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ ho. Nkitahodi Ho Nsusuiɛ: Hyɛ nkitahodi ne adamfofa a ɛda nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ne wɔn a wonni dɛm ntam ho nkuran na ama wɔabubu akwansidie ahorow na ama wɔanya tema.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyarewa a ɛfiri nna mu a, ɛtaa ba mmabun mu, na dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no?
answer_twi_source: STI  (nyarewa a ɛfiri nna mu): Babaso (gonorrhea) ne Chlamydia yɛ mmoawa (bacteria) nyarewa a ɛfiri nna mu a ɛtaa ba mmabun mu, na ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ baako ne nsuo a ɛyɛ hu a ɛfiri awo akwaa mu., ɔhyew berɛ a ɔreto nsu, ne ɛyaw a ɛba akyi berɛmo mu. Genital herpes ne HPV yɛ nyarewa a mmoawa (agenital warts) de ba ɛnam nna so; ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi ne akuro, nsuo-pɔmpɔ, anaa pɔmpɔ nketewa (warts) a ɛpue wɔ awo akwaa ho.HIV yɛ mmoawa (virus) yadeɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛ anaa ɛsɛe nipadua no ahoɔden a ɛko tia nyarewa (immune system) no; Mfitiaseɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no bɛtumi ayɛ sɛ huraeɛ (flu) anaa atiridii mu nkaeɛ. Mpɛn pii no, enni sɛnkyerɛnne biara: Ebia STI pii, titiriw wɔ ne mfiase no, renda sɛnkyerɛnne biara adi, na ɛma ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwene a ɛfa tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma wɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma ho, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Tumi kyerɛ tumi a ankorankoro bi tumi te nsɛm a ɛfa ho ase, kyerɛ nea ebefi ne gyinaesi ahorow mu aba no ho anisɔ, na ɔka nea ɔpɛ ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛne ne ho hyia so. Wɔ tumi a mmabun tumi de pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma akwahosan ho nnwuma a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho no mu no, tumi no fa wɔn adwene mu nkɔso, nkate mu onyin, ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ ho. Bere a ebia mmabun betumi anya tumi a ɛsono nea egyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wɔadi, onyin, ne asetena mu osuahu ahorow so no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn ma wonya tumi a wɔde besisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso bi a ɛkyerɛ wɔn a wɔdi dwuma titire a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wiase nyinaa fekubɔ mu ma ASRH, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔyɛ adwuma bom de di nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔde ano aduru di dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔdi dwuma titire no bi ne aban, Amanaman Nkabom no nnwumakuo, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ aban de (NGOs), adesua asoɛeɛ, ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di wɔn anim, ankorankoro nnwumakuo, NGO a ɛwɔ akwahosan ne ahyehyɛde a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ so. Wɔnam nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ, adwumayɛkuo, adwumayɛkuo, ne afotuo boayikuo so yɛ adwuma bom de di nsɛnnennen te sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔnnya sua, animtiaabuo, ne amammerɛ mu akwansideɛ ho dwuma, de ano aduru a wɔayɛ ama tebea pɔtee ne nnipa dodoɔ di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sen na mmabun betumi agyina hɔ ama nhwehwɛmu atumi ayɛ nea ɛka obiara ho, nea ɛyɛ ntɛm, na ɛda trenee adi a ɛde wɔn nne, hokwan, ne nkwa pa sii hɔ ana?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ afutufo kuo mu. Pae mu ka ma nne ahorow pii. Ma nhwehwɛmu mmara (consent) ho adwene nsan. Bɔ nhwehwɛmufo ka wɔ wɔn nhwehwɛmu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia mmabun yie?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ nimdeɛ, ahokokwaw, ne ntease a ɛho hia na ama wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ sika a wɔde di dwuma ho, sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sikakorabea, sikasie, ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ho. Ɛho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma wɔn tumi ma wodi sikasɛm mu haw ho dwuma, si sikasɛm ho gyinae a ɛfata, kwati boseabɔ, na wodu wɔn sikasɛm botae ahorow a wɔ bere tiaa ne bere tenten mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɔhaw atorɔ adwene anaa adwene  a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde ahye bɛhyɛ  mu na wɔahyɛ no den no bi ne ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi so?
answer_twi_source: ɔhaw anaa atorɔ adwene  a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde ahye besi hɔ na wɔahyɛ mu den wɔ abusuabɔ mu no bi ne ntawntawdi ho suro, afobu a wodi sɛ wɔka sɛ wɔka wɔn ho asɛm, ne nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔnyɛ nea wɔn atipɛnfo hwɛ kwan no. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na woadi akwanside ahorow yi so no, fa wo ho a wobɛte ase ne wo ho a wobɛkamfo no di dwuma, di nkitaho denneennen na fa obu mu, na hwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa nneɛma a wowɔ mu ahotoso hɔ. Kae sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wode wo yiyedi bedi kan na woagyina w’ahye akyi, sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wubehyia bere tiaa mu ɔhaw anaa adwene a enhyia mpo a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na apɔwmudenn ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔde hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nipadua mu no bedi dwuma bere a wɔrenya nna ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe no?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi denam: Hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm, ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma ho nsɛm a emu da hɔ na wotumi nya bi a wɔde bɛma wɔ nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ne ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho Ɔhwɛ a ɛnyɛ atemmu ne ayamhyehye a wɔde bɛma, a nhyɛso biara nni ho Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔabisa nsɛm, ada wɔn haw adi, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn hwɛ ho mu denneennen Mmabun adamfofa tebea a wɔbɛgye atom na ɛka nnipa a wɔyɛ ne osuahu ahorow ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa asetra mu nkɛntɛnso ka senea misusuw asiane ho, te sɛ sɛnea mete nka sɛ wɔhyɛ me sɛ memfa me ho nhyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu na ama mafata anaasɛ mɛtwe meho efiri asetra mu animtiaabu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ako atia nhyɛso ahorow yi bere a meda so ara kura asetra mu abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso anaa asetra mu nkɛntɛnso betumi aka sɛnea wususuw asiane ho denam: Nneyɛe a asiane wom a wobɛhyɛ ho nkuran so: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo sɛ wo ne kuw gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia anaasɛ wotwe woho firi asetra mu animtiaabu a, ebetumi ama woabu asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nneyɛe bi mu, te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho no adewa anaasɛ woabu w’ani agu so. Suro a wusuro sɛ wɔbɛyi wo afi asetra mu: Suro a wusuro sɛ w’atipɛnfo bɛpam wo anaasɛ wɔbɛpow wo no betumi anya asiane ho adwene so nkɛntɛnso, na ama ayɛ den sɛ wobɛko atia nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ebetumi asɛe wo yiyedi mu. Sɛ wobɛko atia nhyɛsoɔ yi bere a wokura ayɔnkofa mu abusuabɔ mu a, fa w’adwene si ahokokwaw a wode bɛkyekyere wo ho so, de ahye asisi hɔ, na wode nnamfo a wobu wo gyinaesi ahorow na wɔboa wo no atwa wo ho ahyia. Wo ne w’atipɛnfo nni nkitaho pefee fa wo gyinapɛn ne wo hye ho, hwehwɛ sohyial network ahorow a ɛboa wo, na fa pow a wobɛka sɛ wobɛpow no di dwuma bere a wuhyia nhyɛso sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ ho ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔdi wɔn dwuma nyinaa kokoam na wɔsan so pɛ kwan wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔmdenhwɛ nhyehyeɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam nteaseɛ nwuma.Hwehwɛ ayaresabea a wɔboa ka kokoam. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi abɛɛfo mfidie afa apɔnden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de ahye ato hɔ na wɔakyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ akwannya ahorow wɔ  nyɔnkofa nkitahodie mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de ahye ato hɔ na wɔakyerɛ wɔn akwannya ahorow wɔ nyɔnkofa nkitahodie mu wɔ: Wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, anohyeto ahorow, ne ahotɔ dodow a wobehu Wɔn ahye a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn hokafo no pefee na wɔayɛ no denneennen Sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ahiade ne wɔn akɔnnɔ ahorow a afobu anaa ehu nnim Wɔn hokafo ahye a wobehu na wɔabu no de atua wɔn ka a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo anaa nnamfo a wotumi de wɔn ho to so hɔ sɛ wobu wɔn ahye so a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde hyɛ sikakorabea ne agyapade a wɔbɛkyekye (build) ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa wɔn sikasɛm mu ahoɔden?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ sikakorabea ne agyapade a wɔbɛkyekye ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mfɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo mu wɔ: Akuw a mmabun di anim a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ so a wɔbɛka ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, adwumayɛbea, anaa nhyiamu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkora sika ne agyapadeɛ a wɔboaboa ano. Wɔn a wɔne nhyehyɛe yɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa mmabun sikakorabea, adwumayɛ, ne agyapadeɛ a wɔbɛkyekyere ho nhyehyɛeɛ na wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia ɔhokafo bi de STI resie?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wohu suban bi a ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ hokafoɔ bi de STI rehinta: Sɛ wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu: Hokafoɔ a ɔmpɛ sɛ mo mmienu kɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu betumi de biribi rehinta. Kondɔm a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye: Sɛ wo hokafoɔ rehyɛ wo sɛ mo nna a kondɔm nka ho a, ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne bɔne. Nna mu suban a asiane wom: Hokafoɔ a ɔne nkurɔfoɔ pii ada a banbɔ nni mu pɛn betumi awɔ asiane kɛse wɔ STI ho. Kae: Gye wo nne a ɛwɔ wo mu di. Sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛnyɛ a, ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ. Nsuro sɛ wobɛdi wo banbɔ akyi na woafi tebea a ɛmma wonte nka yiye mu kɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nipadua ho mfonini a enni mu ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu no betumi aka mmabun nipadua ho mfonini, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ho mfonini a ɛnyɛ nokware ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amannebɔ mu no betumi aka mmabun nipadua ho mfonini, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe wɔ ɔkwan a enye so. Ahoɔfɛ ho mfonini ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa no betumi ama mmabun anya nipadua mu abotɔyam, adidi mu nneyɛe a ɛnteɛ, na wɔabu wɔn ho a ɛba fam, na aka wɔn adwene ne nkate fam yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi a wɔbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no de mmabun ankasa adwene ne wɔn nne bom wɔ SRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no nhyehyɛe, ne di, ne ne nhwehwɛmu mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun Kyɛfa: Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe, ne di, ne nhwehwɛmu mu no hwɛ hu sɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no fata na etu mpɔn. Akwan no betumi ayɛ nhyiam ahorow a mmabun di anim, afotu bagua ahorow, ne atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ. Akwan a wɔfa so de nsɛm ma: Akwan a wɔfa so de mmuae ma a wɔde besi hɔ no ma mmabun tumi ka wɔn suahu ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne nea ɛhaw wɔn ho asɛm, na ɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe no mu nkɔso kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde amanaman ntam sika a wɔde ma ASRH no bedi dwuma yiye na adu mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua na wonni ahobammɔ kɛse no nkyɛn?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a amanaman ntam sika a wɔde bɛma ASRH no bɛduru nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua nkyɛn no, akwan te sɛ nkɔmmɔdie a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne tumi a wɔde bɛma no ho hia. Mpɔtam hɔ fekubɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den, sika a wɔde bɛto nnwuma a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ di anim mu, na wɔde nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a egyina adanseɛ so di kan no bɛtumi ama nkɛntɛnsoɔ ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛwɔ sikasɛm mmɔdenbɔ mu no ayɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ di wɔ adwene a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, aware, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya mmabun ahofadi ne agyinaeɛ so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ adwene a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, aware, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nneyɛe ho wɔ amammerɛ mu nsɛm pii mu no mu. Nhwɛsoɔ, nyamesom atetesɛm ahorow bi si adwene a ɛne ne ho di nsɛ wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho so dua, baabi a wɔma mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne asɛyɛde ahorow wɔ abusua ne ɔmanfo mu. Ebia afoforo nso bɛhyɛ nkyerɛase ahorow a ɛfa pɛyɛ ho a ɛfoa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nkitahodie mu so dua. Saa nkyerɛkyerɛ ahorow yi betumi anya mmabun ahofadi so nsunsuanso wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho paw a wɔde nimdeɛ paw mu denam wɔn gyidi ahorow a ɛfa aware, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne mma awo ho a ebenya so nsunsuanso no so. Mmabun betumi afa saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi so denam nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye a wogyina wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne daakye ho apɛde ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akɔka atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ho a wɔmmɔ wɔn din anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ Intanɛt so sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ nhyiam a wɔn ankasa bɛkɔ a?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmoa kuo pii ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa kwan ma wɔtumi de wɔn ho dɔm a wɔnkabi mma obiara nnhu wɔn, anaa wɔtumi fa ntentan (internet) so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu sɛ wɔnfɛre anaa wɔnyɛ komm wɔ nhyiamu a amansan bɛhu wɔn anim hɔ a.Ntentan so nhyiamu ma obi tumi de ne ho sie (anonymity), na wei ma ɛyɛ mmerɛ ma obiara sɛ ɔbɛka nea ɔfamu na wakɔhwehwɛ mmoa a anim-ne-anim nkɔmmɔbɔ mu pressure biara nni mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔde fa kwan so no ma wonya hokwan ahorow ma wonya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwankyerɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti te sɛ brayɛ, awo, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne nna mu pene ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔde twa kwan no taa ma wonya hokwan ahorow a ɛsom bo ma nhomasua ne akwankyerɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho.Nhwɛso bi ne, amanne ahorow a wɔde hyɛ mmabunbere anaa mpanyin afe so agyirae no betumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa brayɛ, awo, ne nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛba wɔ nsabuo mu ho. Mpanyimfo ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo betumi de saa mmere yi adi dwuma de nimdeɛ a ɛfa atetesɛm akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ano, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho ama. Bio nso, wobetumi anwene nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu pene ne nkitahodie a obu wom ho wɔ nsɛm a esisi yi ntama mu, na asi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔte wɔn ho wɔn ho ase na wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nkitaho wɔ nhyiam a ɛbɛn mu so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ bɛtumi ayɛ mmoa ne nsɛm foforɔ a wɔde ma, te sɛ abusua, sukuu, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne intanɛt so nneɛma, wɔ akwan a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkɔsoɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ bɛtumi ayɛ mmoa ne nsɛm foforɔ a wɔde bɛma denam: Akwan foforɔ a wɔde bɛma ama atipɛnfoɔ akwankyerɛ, nkuranhyɛ, ne nkateɛ mu mmoa a ɛboro deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ te sɛ abusua, sukuu, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ so. Beae a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bɛma wɔasusuw nsɛmti anaa nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene a ebia wɔrenni ho dwuma wɔ mmeae afoforo ho, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ atipɛnfo ntam. Asɔremma a wɔde bɛka nneɛma a ɛfata, wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ, ne dwumadie a ɛnam sukuu, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo so bɛka ho, a ɛbɛma mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛnya no ayɛ mmerɛ. Yɛne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ ne nnwumakuo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkɔsoɔ mu a wɔbɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ adwuma abom na wɔahyia mmɔdenbɔ, ama nsunsuanso ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛwɔ nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no anya kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ aduan a ɛkari na ahoɔden wom a ɛboa m’awo akwahosan sɛ ɔbabun?
answer_twi_source: Aduan a ɛkari na ahoɔden wom a wobɛbɔ a ɛboa w’awo akwahosan no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi nnuan ahorow a efi nnuan akuw nyinaa mu. Fa w’adwene si nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, protein a ɛnyɛ den (te sɛ akokɔ, mpataa, tofu, bankye), ne srade a ahoɔden wom (te sɛ avocado, nnuaba, ngodua ngo) a wode bɛka w’aduan ho no so. Hwɛ hu sɛ wobɛnom nsu pii na tew anonne a asikre wom ano so. Afei nso, bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛtew nnuan ne nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwade so sɛnea wubetumi biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, amammerɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne akuw a egyina gyidi so adi nkitaho na wɔate amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mpɔtam pɔtee bi mu ase yie?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, amammerɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne akuo a egyina gyidie so adi nkitaho na wɔate amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne nneyɛeɛ a efa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho wɔ mpɔtam pɔtee bi mu ase yie. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne amammerɛ afahyɛ ahorow mu, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔne wɔn yɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn. Ɛdenam fekubɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔdi dwuma no bɛyɛ so no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi anya nhumu a ɛsom bo wɔ wɔn ayarefo amammerɛ mu gyidi, suban, ne nea wɔpɛ ho, na ama wɔatumi de ɔhwɛ a etu mpɔn na ɛyɛ amammerɛ kwan so de ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside bɛn na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia akwanside ahorow bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no, a nea ɛka ho ne nipadua mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow akwasidie, nkitahodi akwanside ahorow, nyiyim a efi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, ne ɔmanfo animtiaabu. Wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma denam honam fam akwan a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ntetee a wɔde bɛma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ɔsatu a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ de ahyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho no ho nkuran so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi nsɛm a ɛfa ayayade, ne nyiyim a egyina dɛmdi so wɔ yɛn akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ne mpɔtam hɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi ayayade, ne nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna ho akɔnnɔ so ho dwuma no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi de nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛko tia asisifo adi dwuma wɔ sukuu ne adwumayɛbea ahorow, de mmoa nnwuma ama wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no, na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ nkurɔfo nneɛma bɔne a nyiyim de ba no ho ade. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛbɔ amammerɛ a ɛfa gye a wɔgye tom na wɔka obiara ho a obiara bɛte nka sɛ ɔwɔ ahotɔ ne obuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ɛtaa ma mmabun hwehwɛ afotu anaa mmoa adwuma a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu: Nna mu yareɛ a wɔahu foforo a wogyina ano, a ayaresa ne nea wɔde siw ano ka ho. Abusuabɔ Ho Nsɛm: Ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ, awaregyae, anaa ntawntawdi mu a wobɛfa so. Ahye, nkitahodi, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa mu nkɔso a wɔbɛte ase. Nipadua Mfonini ne Obu a Wobu Ho: Nipadua mfonini ho haw ahorow a ɛka nna mu ahotoso a wodi ho dwuma. Bu a obi benya ama ne ho ne ne ho a obegye atom. Nna mu Nhumu: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Nyiyim anaa gye a wonnye ntom a wogyina ano. Awo Ho Gyinaesi: Afotu a wɔde ma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so nyinsɛn ho, a nyinsɛn a woyi gu, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, anaa awofoyɛ ka ho. Gyinaesi a wɔyɛ wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho. Nna mu Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw anaa nna mu mmɔdenbɔ ho dadwen a wodi ho dwuma. Ahodwiriw anaa Ayayade: Nna mu ahodwiriw anaa ayayade a atwam anaa mprempren ho dwuma. Nkɛntɛnso a adwenemhaw nya wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ so a wobedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn nkaeɛbɔ dwumadie di de boa nkitahodie na ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛbetumi afa so de aboa afoforɔ nkitahodie?
answer_twi_source: Ɛboa ma wote atenka anaa sɛ nyiyimu ase. Ɛma wokasa yie. Ɛyɛ nhwɛsodeɛ, ɛma anidahɔ na ɛboa ma afoforɔ nso kyerɛ woadwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na awoɔ nhyehyɛe no yɛ adwuma, a nneɛma te sɛ brayɛ, ovulation, ne nyinsɛn ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Bɛrima ne ho nkwammoa ne ɔbaa ne nkosua di nhyia wɔ awodeɛ ne mu. Wei ma kosua dane bɛyɛ Zygote. Zygote no so nyin bɛyɛ Embryo, na ɛno so nyin bɛyɛ Fetus. Sɛ ɔbaa  bu ne nsa a, bosome bia awotoa no yɛ ketewa ɛnam hormones nti nkankane berɛ kosua no nne nkwammoa bia nni nhia. Ovary no bobɔ kosua wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu. Sɛ nkwammoa ne kosua no di nhia wɔ fallopian tube no mu a, ɛde nyinsɛn ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ne mmara bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ɔman no mu, ne amanaman ntam de hyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔbɔ mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ne mmara ahorow no bi ne: Mmara a ɛbara nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so na ɛhyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ, akwahosan, ne adwumayɛ a ɛyɛ pɛ ho nkuran. Mmara a ɛbɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ban, a nea ɛka ho ne kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ. Amanaman apam anaa nhyehyeɛ ahorow te sɛ nhyehyeɛ a Ɛfa Hokwan a Mmofra Wɔ ne Beijing Platform a wode tu anammɔn, a ɛkyerɛ hokwan a mmabun wɔwɔ akwahosan, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ tom ho. Ɔman ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran, asiw basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so ano, na wɔama mmabun tumi ma wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔahu nokwasɛm ahorow, atew anansesɛm ahorow mu, na wɔanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Eyinom bi ne wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din te sɛ Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO), Guttmacher Asoɛe, ne Planned Parenthood, a ɛde nsɛm a egyina adanse so ma wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ Snopes ne FactCheck.org na  aboa ama wɔahu sɛ nsɛm a wɔka no yɛ nokware, bere a intanɛt so nsɛm a wɔkora so te sɛ PubMed ma wotumi nya nhwehwɛmu nsɛm a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam nkitahodi ne fekubɔ betumi ahyɛ mmɔden a, wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nnipa hokwan ne asetrena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) mu no mu den, titiriw wɔ mpɔtam anaa aman a hokwan ahorow a wobu so abu so anaasɛ ɛyɛ nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nkitahodi ne fekubɔ hyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban mu den denam atenae biako a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ahorow, a aban ahorow, "NGO" ahorow, ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow ka ho, sɛ wɔbɛbom adi nnipa hokwan ahorow a wobu so wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) no ho dwuma. Wɔma nne yɛ kɛse, wɔde nneɛma di dwuma, na wɔde nhyɛso a wɔbom yɛ di dwuma wɔ aban ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo so sɛ wonni nnipa hokwan gyinapɛn ahorow akyi, wɔde nsakrae ahorow di dwuma, na wodi nhyehyɛe mu nsɛm a ɛboa ma wobu hokwan ahorow so no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn na mmabun bɛsua wɔn sikasɛm, sika kora na wɔate boseabɔ ase?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm mu su pa denam nea boseabɔ, mfɛntom, ne boseabɔ ho nsɛm kyerɛ bere a wɔrebɔ bosea anaasɛ wɔde nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ credit card redi dwuma no a wɔbɛte ase no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde sika a wobetua wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu, sika a wɔde gye sika wɔ credit card so no sua, na wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛsɛe sika no di kan. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho fa boseabɔ apam mu nsɛm ne tebea horow ho, a nea ebefi mu aba bere a wotua ka akyiri, sika a wɔantumi atua, anaasɛ bosea a wɔantumi antua ka ho. Sɛ wonya boseabɔ ho abakɔsɛm pa fi wɔn mmofraase a, ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafata ama boseabɔ ho nhyehyɛe pa, mfɛntom a ɛba fam, ne boseabɔ nsiho a ɛkɔ soro daakye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne mfaso bɛn na ebetumi aba bere a wobɛpene so na wayɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI nhwehwɛmu, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu?
answer_twi_source: Asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba bere a wobɛpene so na wayɛ nna ne awo mu akwahosan mu no gu ahorow gyina ɔkwan pɔtee anaa ayaresa pɔtee no so. Wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no, asiane ahorow betumi ayɛ nea ɛka ho ne, nsunsuanso bɔne te sɛ nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae anaa haw a ebetumi aba, bere a mfaso horow no betumi ayɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ko kwan. Wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu mu no, asiane ahorow betumi ayɛ adwene mu haw a ebetumi afi nea efi mu ba te sɛ wohu sɛ mmoawa no wɔ wo mu a, na, bere a mfaso horow no bi ne sɛ wobehu ɔyare mmoawa ntɛm na wasiw haw no ano. Wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu fam no, asiane ahorow no betumi ayɛ nipadua mu haw ne nkate mu nsɛm, bere a mfaso horow no betumi ayɛ tumi a wotumi di awo mu paw ahorow so na wɔkwati nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyiam ahorow ntam nsɛm a wɔka de di mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua ahiade ne osuahu ahorow ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyiam ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu denam nneɛma a ɛka bom a ɛka nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuakuw, asetra mu sikasɛm tebea, dɛmdi, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne beae a ɛwɔ a wobehu na wɔadi ho dwuma no so. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne ayɛ kɛse, wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛka obiara ho, na wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ahorow ayɛ biako de adi nneɛma a ɛde akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ba no ntini ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi de nsɛm anaa nsusuii ahorow ama sukuu mu ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nhyehyɛe no atu mpɔn wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nsɛm anaa nsusuii ama wɔ : Wo ne sukuu afotufo anaa adwumayɛfo bɛkasa. Asuafoɔ mmuaeɛ nhyiamu anaa afotuo akuo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nhwehwɛmu anaa nyansahyɛ nkrataa a wɔmmɔ wɔn din a wɔbɛhyehyɛ. Awofoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nhyiamu anaa sukuu bagua nhyiamu a wobɛkɔ akɔka wo adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔde fa kwan so kasa tia .ɔmanfo gyinapɛn "values" ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho, a adwene a ɛfa ɔbaabun, ahotew, ne abusua nidi ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ ne amanne ahorow a wɔde twa kwan no betumi ahyɛ ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu den na akasa atia. Bere a atetesɛm ahorow bi betumi agyina nsusuwii ahorow a ɛyɛ katee te sɛ ɔbaabun, ahotew, ne abusua nidi akyi no, afoforo betumi ama wɔanya hokwan ahorow a wɔde begye saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi ho kyim "renegotiating" na wɔasan asusuw ho. Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, amanne ahorow betumi akasa atia ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw anaasɛ ɛbɛma gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ahofadi, pene a wɔpene so, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ abusuabɔ ahorow mu ho nkuran. Nanso, wobetumi ama nneyɛe a epira nso akɔ so anaasɛ wɔahyɛ pɛyɛ a enni hɔ mu den, a egyina amammerɛ mu nsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so gyina nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne ayayade a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ ho ano?
answer_twi_source: Nya Ahoɔden a Wobɛtumi Agyina Ano: Nya ahokokwaw a ɛbɛma woatumi agyina ano, te sɛ adwene a wɔde si biribi so, sɛnea wobɛka wo ho denneennen, ne ɔhaw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma, na ama woadi adwennwen ho dwuma na woadi tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ atinka fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a woredi nyiyim anaa ayayade ho dwuma no. Hu Hokwan a Wowɔ: Hu ɔman no mmra a ɛfa ho yiye Fa w’adwene si Nneɛma Pa so: Fa nneɛma pa twa wo ho hyia
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ayaresa mmoa ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ bere a wohyia ɔhaw bi, bere a wɔkyerɛ obu ma wɔn ahofadi ne kokoamu nsɛm nso?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔfo, ahwɛfo, anaa mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ayaresa mmoa ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn denam atinka fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn, a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔafa apomoden ho nhyehyɛe no mu, ne obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ahofadi ne kokoamu nsɛm so. Ɛho hia sɛ mpanyimfo tie mmabun haw ahorow na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn apomoden ho bere biara a ɛbɛyɛ yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma anaa mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nnwuma a wɔde ma mmabun mu denam nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu nyarewa (STI) ano a wosiw, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa a wɔde ma so. Sukuu ahorow nso betumi ama wɔanya nna mu akwahosan ho nneɛma, afotu adwuma, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ tebea horow a mihyia nyiyim a egyina me SOGI ne me nipasu fã foforo nyinaa so no mu? (sɛ nhwɛso no, sɛ́ ɔyɛ ɔbea a ne kɔla yɛ ɔbea a ɔne ɔbarima da) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nsɛmho amanebɔfo ananmusi, nkekae, ne broni ka no 'stereotypes' ɛnya nsunsuasuoɔ wɔ mpɔtam a wɔnbu ne nea aborɔfo ka no sɛ 'perpetuate systemic inequalities', nyiyimu, ne basabasayɛ, nkankan ASRH mu nsem?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nea aborɔfo kano 'stereotypes' haw mu kena ne nyiyimu. 'Perpetuate' nea aborɔfo frɛ no 'stigma', animguase ne nsem a enni mu aa efa nea yɛdi si nyinsɛn ho kwan ne nyinsɛn yi guo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwenemyare a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi anya, na dɛn ne wɔn yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu haw ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi anya bi ne adwenemhaw, dadwen yare (te sɛ dadwen a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so anaa asetra mu dadwen yare), adwene a wɔde si biribi so/adeyɛ a ɛtra so (ADHD), adidi mu haw (te sɛ anorexia nervosa anaa bulimia nervosa), ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw. Nsɛnkyerɛnne no gu ahorow gyina ɔhaw no so nanso ebia nea ɛka ho ne awerɛhow a ɛkɔ so, dadwen a ɛtra so, ɛyɛ den sɛ ɔde n’adwene besi biribi so, nsakrae a ɛba aduan ho akɔnnɔ anaa nna mu, ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotufo betumi ama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na efi nokwaredi mu ne mmabun adi nkitaho wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ pene, ahye, ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nkitahodie, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho, bere a wɔkyerɛ obu ma wɔn kokoam nsɛm, ahofadi, ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Afotufoɔ betumi ama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokwaredi ne mmabun afa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate te sɛ pene, ahye, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho bere a wobu wɔn kokoam nsɛm, ahofadi, ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow denam: Tebea a wɔbɛboa: Afotufo de ahotoso ne gye a wogye tom tebea bi si baabi a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ bere a wɔresusuw nsɛm a ɛho hia ho a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ fɛwdi. Nsɛm a wɔabue ano a wobebisa: Afotufo hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuran denam nsɛm a wɔabue ano a wobisa a ɛto nsa frɛ mmabun ma wɔka wɔn nsusuwii, wɔn nkate, ne wɔn haw ahorow ho asɛm pefee no so. Ahye a wobu: Afotufo bu mmabun ahye denam ma a wɔma wɔn kwan ma wɔkyerɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no kwan na wɔda nsɛm adi wɔ wɔn ankasa ahoɔhare so, a nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso biara nni mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow ma nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, osuahu ahorow a wɔkyɛ, ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease yɛ mmerɛw wɔ mmabun a wohyia ɔhaw anaa dadwen a ɛte saa ara a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow ma nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, osuahu ahorow a wɔkyɛ, ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease yɛ mmerɛw wɔ mmabun a wohyia ɔhaw anaa dadwen a ɛte saa ara a ɛfa SRH ho no mu denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a atipɛnfo di anim ne kuw dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nimdeɛ a wɔkyɛ wɔ SRH nsɛmti ho nkuran no so. Tebea a ɛboa a ankorankoro bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi na wɔahwehwɛ afotu afi wɔn atipɛnfo hɔ a wɔbɛbɔ. Tema ne biakoyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ asɔremma mu denam wɔn ho wɔn ho suahu ne wɔn adwene a wobehu na wɔagye atom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho, na dɛn ne akwan a metumi afa so abɔ amanneɛ? (Mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne amanneɛbɔ akwan ho ntease)
answer_twi_source: Nna mu basabasayɛ yɛ nsɛmmɔnedi. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ wuhu ni: Mpɔtam Hɔ Mmara: Mmara a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho no gu ahorow wɔ mmeae ahorow. Ɔman Nna mu Ɔhaw Hotline no betumi aboa wo ma woate hokwan pɔtee a wowɔ no ase. Amanneɛbɔ a Wobɛpaw: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wobɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ kyerɛ polisifo, mpo a wommɔ soboɔ a emu yɛ den mpo. Wubetumi nso abɔ ho amanneɛ akyerɛ sukuu fotufoɔ anaa ɔpanyin a wogye no di. Ɔman Nna mu Ɔhaw Hotline no betumi akyerɛ wo wɔ wo amanneɛbɔ akwan horow no mu a wɔmmɔ wo din sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa akwankyerɛ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ nsɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma mmabun ansa na wɔanya wɔn pene wɔ aduruyɛ anaa ayaresa ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne akwankyerɛ ahorow bi kyerɛ nsɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma mmabun ansa na wɔanya wɔn pene wɔ aduruyɛ anaa ayaresa ho. Eyinom betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ tumidi ahorow mu nanso mpɛn pii no nea ɛka nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ aduruyɛ mu abrabɔ pa ne mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛ hokwan ahorow a ayarefo ne akwahosan ho nneyɛe kwan no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama wɔn hokwan ahorow ne wɔn yiyedi sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ nhwehwɛmu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔmuden ho mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama wɔn hokwan ne yiyedi sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ nhwehwɛmu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu denam: Nhwehwɛmu abrabɔ pa a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho, a hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, akwan a wɔfa so pene so a wɔde nimdeɛ ma, ne kokoamsɛm ho ahobammɔ ka ho. Nhwehwɛmu afotufoɔ akuo anaa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de wɔn adwene ama wɔ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ, adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu ho akwan, ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuiɛ ho. Wɔkasa tia nhwehwɛmu nneyɛe a ɛnteɛ na wɔnko mma nhwehwɛmu a ɛda adi na wobu akontaa wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu no mu. Nhwehwɛmufoɔ, nhyehyeɛyɛfoɔ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ kuo a wɔko ma afoforo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwankyerɛ a ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa mmabun ho na wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ne nsɛm a ɛtrɛw te sɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho atɛntrenee, wiase nyinaa akwahosan mu pɛyɛ, atubrafo hokwan ahorow, mmubuafo hokwan ahorow, ne sikasɛm mu tumidi di nkitaho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo akwan horow a ɛfa 'ASRH' ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho a ɛfa ntamgyinafo ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a Wɔfa so Yɛ Nkitahodi: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ne nsɛm a ɛtrɛw te sɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho atɛntrenee, wiase nyinaa akwahosan mu pɛyɛ, atubrafo hokwan ahorow, mmubuafo hokwan ahorow, ne sikasɛm mu tumidi di nkitaho. Mmabun betumi akamfo akwan horow a wɔfa so di 'ASRH' ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho dwuma de nam nhyɛso ahorow a ɛwɔ nkitahodi a wohu, nne a wɔde to nkyɛn a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma pii a ɛhaw adwene a ɛtrɛw ho a wɔbɛkasa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ self-compassion(tema a wowɔ ma woankasa wo ho) ne ntease a ɛne sɛ wobetumi asa STIs na ɛnkyerɛkyerɛ personal worth (som a wo som bo).
answer_twi_source: Nya tema ne odɔ ma woankasa wo ho na kae sɛ: STIs yɛ nea wobetumi asa: Sɛ wɔsa wo yare yiye a, wo ho bɛtɔ wo. Ɛnkyerɛ onni korɔ a woyɛ: Woyɛ obi a wosom bo, na STI a wohu no ntumi nsesa no da.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam sika mmoa a ɛwɔ hɔ no nya ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma ne nea ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ wɔ aman a wɔn sikasɛm tebea nnyɛ so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam sika a ɛwɔ hɔ no nya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma ne nea ɛbɛkɔ so atena hɔ wɔ aman a wɔn sikasɛm tebea nnyɛ no mu. Ɛma aman tumi trɛ wɔn akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu, tete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, nya nneɛma ne nnuru a ɛho hia, na wɔde nnwuma a ɛho hia kɔ nnipa a wonnya mmoa yie nkyɛn. Nanso, nsakraeɛ a ɛba sika a wɔde ma, nneɛma a wɔde di kan wɔ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma, ne asase ho amammuisɛm mu no bɛtumi aka ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ so na ɛtu mpɔn wɔ berɛ mu. Sika a wɔde bɛma a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛboaboa nneɛma ano wɔ ɔman no mu ho hia na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ASRH nnwuma no bedi nkonim bere tenten.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho ne afoforo nsunsuanso a animtiaabu ne nyiyim nya wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a agye din, wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu no so. Wobetumi nso ama nkurɔfo ate ase wɔ wɔn ankasa suahu ahorow a wɔbɛka, ahyɛ nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne obu a wɔde ma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ho nkuran, ne nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfata mmabun wɔ mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɔtam pii de nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔayɛ no pɔtee sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma ma. Saa nnwuma yi betumi ayɛ kokoam afotu, atipɛnfo mmoa, nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ne nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfata mfe a obi adi. Mmabun betumi abisa saa nnwuma yi ho asɛm wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, apɔwmuden asoɛe ahorow, anaa mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me kokoam nsɛm ne m’ankasa ho nsɛm ho ban wɔ ntentenfidie so berɛ a merɛyɛ bra?
answer_twi_source: Fa Asɛmfua a Ɛyɛ Den Di Dwuma: Yɛ asɛmfua a ɛyɛ den a ɛyɛ soronko ma wo account nyinaa. Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe: Yɛ nsakrae wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe mu wɔ ntentanfidie no so. Susuw Ho Ansa na Wobɛkyɛ: Hwɛ yiye wɔ wo ho nsɛm te sɛ wo din nyinaa, address, anaa telefon nɔma a wode bɛkyɛ no ho. Kwati Gyae Badwam Wi-Fi : Ɔmanfoɔ Wi-Fi so ahobammɔ nsɛm betumi ayɛ nea ahobammɔ nnim, enti kwati sɛ wode bedi dwuma ama nnwuma a ɛho hia. Update Software: Ɛyɛ a update app anaa sɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ wofon no so aberɛ biaa ama woabɔ wo ho ban afi mmerɛyɛ ahodoɔ ho. Two-Factor Authentication: Ma wo two factor authentication nyɛ adwuma ɛma wo ahobammɔ foforɔ. Hu Phishing: Hwɛ yie wɔ email anaa nkrasɛm a ɛbisa wo ho nsɛm ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na awofoɔ bɛtumi afa so ahyɛ mmabun nkuran na wɔanya anigyeɛ ne nidi ama wɔn nipadua wɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaewa berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Kamfo mmabun wɔ su pa ne nkɔso a wɔanya mu (Praise non-physical qualities). Kyerɛkyerɛ mu kyerɛ wɔn sɛ mfoni a wɔhu wɔ intanɛt so no, mpɛn pii no wɔayɛ mu nsakrae (editing/filters). Hyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa ne aduan a ɛkari pɛ ho nkuran na ama woanya yiyedi nyinaa. Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nipadua mu nsakrae ne atenka horow ho.  Ka ho asɛm sɛ nipadua ahorow wɔ ahorow ne ne kɛse nyinaa, na emu biara yɛ soronko na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atetesɛm mu gyidi ahorow a ɛfa ɔbaabun, ahotew, ne ahotew ho no nya mmabun nna mu nneyɛe, abusuabɔ, ne adwene a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne STI ano a wosiw ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammere mu gyidie a ɛfa mmabunbaasuro, nipadua ho ahotew, ne abrabɔ pa ho taa nya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa nna ho nneyɛeɛ, nnamfofa, ne wɔn adwene wɔ awogyeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nna mu nyarewa ho banbɔ ho. Wɔ amammere pii mu no, wɔbu mmabunbaasuro sɛ adeɛ a ɛsom bo kɛse na wɔde toto nipadua mu ahotew ne suban pa ho, titiriw ma mmabaa. Saa gyidie yi bɛtumi ama mmabun apia wɔn ho sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho firi nna ho kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛware, na ayɛ den nso sɛ wɔbɛka anaa wɔbɛhwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa awogyeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nna mu nyarewa ho banbɔ ho. Atɛmmuo anaa animguaseɛ a ɛfiri nna a ɛdi awareɛ anim mu ba ho suro nso bɛtumi atia mmerante ne mmabaa sɛ wɔbɛnya nna mu apomuden ho mmoa anaa wɔde awogyeɛ ho nnuru bɛdi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Frankaa kɔkɔɔ anaa kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi de nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso redi dwuma de anya nna ho pene, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ ho biribi denneennen na wɔabɔ wɔn ahye ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Frankaa kɔkɔɔ anaa kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia obi de nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso redi dwuma de anya nna mu pene no bi ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ daa sɛ wɔbɛdaadaa onipa foforo no anaasɛ wɔbɛdan no, nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde ano ka anaa nea wɔmfa ano nka a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ne ho nyɛ no dɛ anaasɛ ɔmpɛ, ne ahunahuna a wɔde ma sɛ obi foforo no pow a, obetua so ka anaasɛ obepira no. Mmabun betumi ayɛ ho biribi denneennen denam wɔn ahye a wɔbɛka akyerɛ, wɔn pow a wɔbɛka no pefee na wɔanya ahotoso, na sɛ ɛho hia a wobeyi wɔn ho afi tebea no mu no so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya wɔn nkate mu ahotoso na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa nneɛma a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wonni ahobammɔ anaasɛ wonni ahotoso a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi ɔhaw anaa nkate fam ahokyere a emu yɛ den bere ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛase ne Botae: Ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe yɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ma wɔadi ɔhaw anaa nkate fam ahoyeraw kɛse bere ho dwuma. Ɛma ɔkwan a wɔahyehyɛ a wɔfa so hu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne, akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano, ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a ɛbɛboa ma wɔasiw wɔn ho apira anaa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobekum wɔn ho ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmti bɛn na wɔtaa ka ho asɛm wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) nhyehyɛe ne adesua ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: CSE nhyehyeɛ no taa ka nsɛmti ahodoɔ pii ho, a nipadua ne nipadua ho nimdeɛ, mmabunbere, nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu nyarewa (STI) ne "HIV/AIDS", pene, abusuabɔ pa, nkitahodiɛ ho nimdeɛ, awoɔ hokwan, gyinaesie, ne afoforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa awofo nkumaa? (mmofra hwɛ, sika fam mmoa, nhomasua nhyehyɛe) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa awofoɔ nkumaa: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): https://www.ppag-gh.org/nu/ betumi de nhyehyɛeɛ ama awofoɔ nkumaa. Department of Social Welfare: https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/ bɛtumi anya nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa mmofra anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe. Mpɔtam Ahyehyɛde: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde awofo adesua, mmoa akuw, anaa mmofra hwɛ ho nnwuma ma. ɔmanfo apɔmuden adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no wɔ apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔboa wɔn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkitahodi yɛ nkɛntɛnso wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, mmoa nnwuma "support services" ne nneɛma ma "LGBTQ+" ankorankoro?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ nnyɛ amansan mmara wɔ Ghana. Nnipa nyinaa a wɔn asetena anaa wɔn gyidie mfa ho no wɔ akwahosan ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkitahodi a ɛda me ne me hokafoɔ fa nna a ahobammɔ wom (safe sex) ho bɛboa apɔwmuden?
answer_twi_source: Ɛma nteaseɛ, ahotosoɔ, ne obu. Ɛma yɛsisi gyinaeɛ pa. Yɛtumi kyerɛ deɛ yɛpɛ ne deɛ yɛmpɛ. Ɛboa ma yɛbɔ yɛn ho ban yie. Ɛtew aniwu ne fɛreɛ  (stigma) so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm mu yiye na wɔate nsɛm anaa mfonii a etwa guo wɔ aabɛɛfu ntentan ahodorɔ no so (sexualized media messages) a ɛkyerɛ nna ho nsɛm ho ase, na ama wɔahu nea ɛhyɛ ase ankasa (motives) ne sɛnea ɛka nnipa (implications)
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi abisa: Adɛn nti na wɔde saa asɛm yi too hɔ? Saa kwan no so no wɔtumi hwehwɛ mu eyi nea ɛyɛ 'stereotypes' (Nipa ho adwene ahyɛdeɛ/ adwene bɔne) ne 'objectification' (sɛ wɔde onipa ayɛ adeɛ/ ade kwan sohwɛ), Tumi nhyehyɛe (Power dynamics) ne ɔbea/ɔbarima dwumadie (gender roles) ho nhwehwɛmu. Sɛ yɛbɛte ase yiye (deconstruction) no hwehwɛ sɛ yɛdwene amammerɛ ne asetena mu nnyinaso ahorow ho, yɛhunu sɛ dwadie mfaso (commercial interests) nti na wɔyɛɛ saa nsɛm no, na yɛasusuw sɛnea ɛbɛtumi aka obi ankorɛankorɛ ne ɔmanfo nyinaa. Ɛsɛ sɛ ababun no kura ne gyidi ne ne suban pa mu dennen.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ woannya ayaresa mma nyarewa a ɛnam nna so ba (STIs) a, dɛn na ebetumi ato w'akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛtra Hɔ Bere Tenten: STI ahorow a wɔansa no betumi de akwahosan mu nsɛnnennen a emu yɛ den aba. Chlamydia ne gonorrhea, sɛ wɔansa a, ebetumi de pelvic inflammatory yedeɛ (PID) aba mmea so, na ama wontumi nwo. HPV betumi ama mmea anya awotwaa mu kokoram ne kokoram ahorow afoforo. HIV ma nipadua no mu tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa no yɛ mmerɛw, na sɛ wɔansa a, ɛde AIDS ba. Nea Ɛbɛtumi Anya: Sɛ obi nya STI na wɔansa no a, ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔde bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn a wɔne wɔn ho da no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho nnwuma ne nsɛm bi yɛ nea ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma gyidi ne mmusua ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ ama amammerɛ mu nidie ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ no akɔ so denam nneɛma a ɛdidisoɔ yi so: Wɔde amammerɛ mu nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛhyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ nteteɛ mu na ama wɔahu amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu yiye. Wɔbɛyɛ mmawoɔ ne nna mu apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayaresa horow no wɔ kwan a ɛne amammerɛ ne nyamesom ahodoɔ pɔtee bi bɛhyia na ɛsɔ wɔn ani. Wɔbɛhyehyɛ kasa nkyerɛaseɛ ho mmoa ne nkrataa wɔ kasa ahodoɔ pii mu na ama nnipa a wɔka kasa horow nyinaa anya nkyerɛkyerɛ no bi. Wɔbɛyɛ ayaresabea mmeaeɛ a wɔnhyehyɛeɛ kyerɛ sɛ wɔgye amammerɛ ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no tom, na obiara bɛtumi akɔ hɔ a akukuduro wom. Wɔne mpɔtam mpanyinfoɔ, amammerɛ nkabom akuo, ne nyamesom ahodoɔ bɛbɔ mu ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nkrataa ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛka mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nyinaa abom wɔ kwan a nidi wom so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwan a wɔfa so hu adwenemhaw betumi aboa ma wɔasiw wɔn wɔyɛ bone a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ayayade a wɔsan yɛ, ahodwiriw a wɔsan yɛ, ne ayayade a ɛto so abien ano, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de ayɛ tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom, ɛboa, na ɛma tumi ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no da wɔn suahu ahorow adi?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hu adwenemhaw no betumi aboa ma wɔasiw wɔn wɔyɛ bone a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ayayade a wɔsan yɛ, ahodwiriw a wɔsan yɛ, ne ayayade a ɛto so abien ano denam wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahobammɔ, ahofadi, ne yiyedi a wɔde bedi kan no so. Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ, mmoa, na ɛma tumi ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no da wɔn suahu adi no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛma akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so abɔ amanneɛ na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa, wɔbɛkyerɛ obu ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm a wɔbɛda no adi ne nea wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho, wɔde nnwuma ne mmoa a wɔde nimdeɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho bɛma, wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ adwumayɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ adwenemhaw ne ne nkɛntɛnso ho, na wɔadi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ne animhwɛ a ebetumi asiw wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no kwan sɛ wobenya mmoa ne atɛntrenee ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa ne nsɛm bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ne awo apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: UNFPA: Ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu apomuden ne awo hokwan ahorow ho ma, a nneɛma a wɔde ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ka ho. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Hokwan Ahyehyɛde: Ebia saa ahyehyɛdeɛ yi wɔ nneɛma anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm (Coaliton of Persons with Disability in Ghana). Akwahosan Ho Dwumadifo: Nnuruyɛfo, ayarehwɛfo a wɔwɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na wɔfa so yɛ nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu, na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Akwan ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so yɛ nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu, a egyina nna mu nyarewa "STI" ko a wɔresɔ ahwɛ ne tebea pɔtee a ɛwɔ mu so. Akwan a wɔtaa fa so no bi ne nsu mu nhwehwɛmu, mogya mu nhwehwɛmu, swab nhwehwɛmu (sɛ nhwɛso no, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, menewa, anaa akyi berɛmo mu nhwehwɛmu), ne nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu. Wɔtaa de nsu mu nhwehwɛmu di dwuma de hwehwɛ STI te sɛ chlamydia ne gonorrhea, bere a wɔde mogya mu nhwehwɛmu di dwuma de hu nyarewa te sɛ "HIV" ne "syphilis". Swab nhwehwɛmu hwehwɛ sɛ wɔboaboa nhwɛsode ahorow ano fi baabi a yare no, te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, menewa, anaa akyi berɛmo, na wɔde hu STI ahorow te sɛ chlamydia, akisikuru, ne "HPV". Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu de ahwɛ sɛ ebia  Nnna mu nyarewa "STI" ho sɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu akisikuru anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu akisikuru anaa. Ɔkwan biara a wɔfa so yɛ sɔhwɛ no wɔ n’ankasa mfaso ne anohyeto ahorow, na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi akamfo nhwehwɛmu kwan a ɛfata sen biara a egyina ankorankoro tebea horow so akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi aboa mmusua ma wɔadi amammerɛ, kasa, ne asetra mu sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ho dwuma, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nyinaa benya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu na ɛka obiara ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi aboa mmusua ma wɔadi amammerɛ, kasa, ne asetena mu sikasɛm mu akwansideɛ a ɛmma wɔnnya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie ho dwuma denam ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu na ɛka obiara ho a wɔde bɛma so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nnwuma a wɔde bɛma wɔ kasa ahorow pii mu, obu a wɔde bɛma amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nneyɛe ahorow, ne abusua biara asetra ne sikasɛm tebea a wobesusuw ho. Akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ bɛtumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ nteteeɛ a ɛkɔ so mu de ate nnipa ahodoɔ ase yie na wɔasom wɔn, berɛ a akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛda asuafoɔ nyinaa suahunu ne wɔn adwene adi. Ɛnam sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne akannifoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma abom nti, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nso bɛtumi de nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ a ɛdi wɔn ahiadeɛ ne hawpɔtee ho dwuma abɔ mmusua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔwɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ no nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea mmabun nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu no gu ahorow wɔ ɔman ne ɔmantam biara mu. Wɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ no, ɛho hia sɛ yehu mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow yiye denam: Aban wɛbsaet ahorow, mmara kwan so nneɛma, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a yɛbɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho no so. Akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa mmara ho abenfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow mu hɔ. Mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu a wɔde wɔn adwene sii nna ne awo akwahosan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa nhoma bɛn na wokamfo ɛma woasua pii efa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nsakrae a ɛba mu ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛyɛ so bi ne nhoma te sɛ "Wo Hwɛ ne Wo Sie: Nipadua Nhoma a Wɔde Ma Mmabaa nkumaa" ne "Wo Hwɛ ne Wo Sie 2: Nipadua Nhoma a Wɔde Ma Mmabaa a Wɔanyinyin" a Valorie Schaefer kyerɛwee, ne "Mmarima nneɛma": Nipadua Nhoma a Wɔde Ma Mmarimaa a Oduruyɛfo Cara Natterson kyerɛwee. Saa nhoma ahorow yi de nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma wɔ nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ho na ɛde afotu a ɛboa ma sɛnea wobɛfa asetra fã yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu nneyɛe anaa atetesɛm ahorow a ebetumi aka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ahorow bi ama mmabun, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma bi?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Nneyɛe: Mfitiase Aware: Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu no, aware ntɛm abu so, na ɛma mmabun nyinsɛn na wonnya nhomasua pii. Eyi ho dwuma a wobedi hwehwɛ sɛ mpɔtam hɔfo bɔ nkɔmmɔ fa mfaso a ɛwɔ aware a wɔtwentwɛn so ne hia a nhomasua ho hia. Nneɛma a Wɔbara wɔ Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna Ho: Ebia amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow siw nna mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ano, na ɛde nsɛm a ɛnteɛ aba. Nhomasua ɔsatu ahorow betumi aboa ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no ayɛ nea ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔ ma ayaresa bɛboa mmabun ama wɔanya honam mfoni pa ne obuo kese ma wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Honam peneeɛ ahohyɛ kuran a aborofo ka no sɛ 'Promoting body acceptance': Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa nnsi nipadua ne peneeɛ so, ɛtwe woho firi sɛ woka nsem bɔne fa sɛnea obi teɛ, na yɛ si sɛnea nnipa tie wɔ ne mu so dua. Nkitahodie a ye buebue ano a aborɔfo fre no 'Open Communication': Erebɔ mpɔtam a eho dwo na ɛboa mmabun kwan ma wɔkasa fa wɔn nipadua ho dadwen. Nwomasua: Ɛma kyerɛkyerɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ fa bra ho, nnipadua nsakrae, ne mpotam nkɛntɛnso a broni frɛ no 'societal influences' a sɛnea yɛhu nnipa dua no. Nkurae hyɛ: Kamfo na hyehyɛ nkurae ma mmɔden bɔ, nea woatumi anya, ne su ahorow a enfa sɛnea nnipa teɛ. Nnwinade a wɔde ma: ɛkeka mmabun a wɔwɔ nnwinade a ɛfata tesɛ ayaresa 'therapy', nkuo a woboa, anaa nwomasua nneɛma wɔ twe adwen si sɛnea nnipa ahuofɛ teɛ ne obuo a wowɔ ma woho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu gyidie ne nneyɛe a abu so a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne abusuabɔ ho no bi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛkyerɛ ankorankora ntease wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nneyɛe a abu so a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne abusuabɔ ho no bi ne: Akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbaabun, ahotew, ne ahobrɛase ho, titiriw ma mmeawa ne mmabaa, a ebetumi anya gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ne aware ho so nsunsuanso. Amanne kwan so ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛe ne asɛyɛde pɔtee bi a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wofi awosu mu so, te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ho adwene. Amammerɛ mu amanne ne amanne ahorow a ɛfa awaregyae, aware, ne abusua a wɔhyehyɛ ho, a ebetumi akyerɛ su horow a wɔwɔ wɔ nna a edi aware anim, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne awo ho gyinaesi ho. Animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ a ɛnyɛ heteronormative ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho, a ebetumi aka ankorankoro osuahu ahorow a ɛfa gye a wogye tom, wɔde wɔn ka ho, ne nneɛma a wɔde boa a wobenya ho. Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nkyerɛase ahorow a ɛma wohu abrabɔ pa ne abrabɔ pa ho gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna, awo, ne nnipa asetra kronkronyɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de akasa atia nyiyim mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a ɛmma wontumi nnya nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nnwuma afoforo a ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi ne dwumadi mu denam ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ɔmanfo ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne sohyial media a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim ho no so. Wobetumi nso ne mmara ho abenfo, nnipa hokwan ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho no ayɛ biako de akasa atia mmara a ɛnteɛ denam asɛnnibea, ɔmanfo ɔyɛkyerɛ, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ nkurɔfo hɔ, na wɔako ama nsakrae a ɛbɛma wɔanya hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya SRH nnwuma a ɛho hia a nyiyim biara nni ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun kɔ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛboa wɔn adwenemyare?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ adwenemyare ho mmoa no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina onipa no ahiade, sɛnea yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne no mu yɛ den, ne ayaresa nhyehyɛe so. Mmabun m betumi akɔ ayaresa nhyiam ahorow dapɛn biara, dapɛn abien biara, anaa ɔsram biara, a egyina wɔn ayaresa ho ɔbenfo no nyansahyɛ ne nkɔso a wɔn ayaresa no anya so. Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, mmabun betumi akɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔtaa kɔ hɔ wɔ bere a ahokyere anaa sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a emu yɛ den wom mu, a botae no ne sɛ wɔbɛdan akɔ nhyiam horow a wɔntaa nkɔ so bere a sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no tu mpɔn no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ na wɔboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nna ho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wobetumi Apaw 'Limitations': Ebia mmabun nna mu akwahosan ho abenfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ dɛmdi ho no ho yɛ na. Fi ase Nyinaa: Fi ase denam hwehwɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛsa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm yare wɔ akwahosan ahiade ahorow nyinaa ho. Bisa Wɔn a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia: Wo ne mmubuafo hokwan ahorow ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akuw a wɔkamfo ayarefo (sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a) nkasa na woanya nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔte nka wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abusua nhyehyɛe ho akwan horow bɛn na mmabun betumi anya, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛyɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔnom a nkwaadwom 'hormone' ahorow wom a wɔde siw ovulation ano. Kɔndɔm: Akwanside kwan a ɛmma mmadwoa 'sperm' ntumi nkɔ nkesua no mu. Ɛsan nso bɔ obi ho ban fi nna mu nyarewa ho Long-Acting Reversible Contraceptives (LARCs): Nea ɛka ho ne mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUD) ne hormone a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, na ɛma wotumi siw nyinsɛn ano bere tenten. Nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu: Nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua no mu a esiw ovulation ano. Akwan a Wɔfa so Hu Awo Ho: Wɔhwɛ brayɛ akyi na wɔakwati nna a wɔde bɛwo awo. Ɔkwan a Wɔfa so Twe: Wotwe ɔbarima no akyi ansa na woabɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na awofo nkitahodi ho hia wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔde di dwuma ne gyinaesi a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo nkitahodi ho hia kɛse wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔde di dwuma ne gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no mu efisɛ: Awofo betumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ama de aboa mmabun ma wɔapaw nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ ayɛ na wɔako atia nkɛntɛnso bɔne a efi atipɛnfo hɔ. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne awofo bɔ no ma wonya ahotoso ne ahobammɔ ho adwene, na ɛma mmabun tumi susuw nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn ho, bisa nsɛm, na wɔhwehwɛ afotu a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛte wɔn ase. Awofo betumi akyɛ wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne wɔn adwene wɔ nna ne abusuabɔ ho, na aboa mmabun ma wɔanya gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow fapem a emu yɛ den a ɛbɛkyerɛ wɔn gyinaesi kwan. Ɛdenam akwanhwɛ ahorow, ahye, ne nea ebefi mu aba a wɔne awofo susuw ho so no, mmabun betumi ate asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ne nea ebefi wɔn nneyɛe mu aba no ase yiye na wɔapaw nneɛma a ɛne wɔn botae ahorow a wɔde asi wɔn ani so bere tenten ne wɔn yiyedi hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asiane ne nea efi mu ba a ebetumi afi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛma anansesɛm kɔ so tra hɔ, anaasɛ ɛhyɛ akwanhwɛ a enni mu a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ne abusuabɔ ho nkuran a wɔde di dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛma anansesɛm kɔ so tra hɔ anaasɛ ɛhyɛ akwanhwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ne abusuabɔ ho ho nkuran a wɔde di dwuma no betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ntease a ɛnteɛ, ne suban anaa nneyɛe a ɛmfata. Mmabun betumi anya akwanhwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ nipadua mu ahosiesie, nna mu mmɔdenbɔ, ne abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ho, na ebetumi ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔmfata, obu wɔn ho a wonni, ne abotɔyam a wonni.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ɛwɔ kɔmputa anaa dijitaal mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu mu?
