answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so asisi nsɛm: Sɛ wo mfɛfoɔ bɛka nsɛm bɔne anaa wɔbɛhyɛ wo so wɔ intanɛt so . Nsɛm a Ɛmfata: Sɛ wobɛhunu mfonini anaa nneɛma bi a ɛmfata wo mfeɛ (te sɛ mmonnaa mfonini). Kokoamsɛm ho nsɛm: Sɛ wobɛda wo kokoamsɛm adi a afoforɔ bɛtumi de ayɛ wo bɔne. Intanɛt so nnebɔneyɛfoɔ: Sɛ wo ne ananafoɔ a wɔbɛtumi apira wo bɛdi nkitaho wɔ intanɛt so. Addiction (Sɛ ɛka wo hɔ): Bere a wɔde hwɛ screen so dodo na ɛtwe w'adwene firi dwumadie titiriw ho. Nnaadaasɛm ɛkɔ so wɔ intanɛt so a wobetumi agye edi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na nhomasua a ɛka obiara ho kyerɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua a ɛka obiara ho wɔ ASRH mu kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun nyinaa anya nna ne awoɔ apomoden (SRH) ho nsɛm, nnwuma, ne mmoa a edi mu pɛpɛɛpɛ, a wɔn bɔbeasu, abusuakuw, tumi, asetena mu sikasɛm tebea, anaa su afoforo mfa ho. Ɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛma adesua tebea a ɛkyerɛ obuo na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛsom boɔ, ɛhyɛ nkabom ho nkuran, na ɛdi mmabun nyinaa ahiadeɛ ne hokwan pɔtee bi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka hokwan a mewɔ sɛ mede kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ tebea ahorow a, mete nka sɛ wɔrebu m’ahye so anaasɛ wɔrekyekyɛ m’ankasa ho nsɛm a, mempene so mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wode kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ tebea horow a wote nka sɛ wɔrebu w’ahye so anaasɛ wɔrekyekyɛ w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm a wompene so no so dua. Fa nkitahodi akwan a ɛyɛ den di dwuma fa da wo haw adi na ka wo hye ahorow no pefee. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa nneɛma bi hɔ sɛ wohia mmoa wɔ kokoam nsɛm a wobu so anaasɛ wubegyina wo hokwan ahorow akyi a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua aka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu denneennen?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ahyɛ sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe mu denam adesua ahorow a wɔatu wɔn ho ama, adwumayɛbea ahorow, anaa nnwuma ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma ahorow ho a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛho hia, ɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso "influences" ho nkuran, na ɛma hokwan ahorow ma wɔde nsa yɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyiam ahorow, sini ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun anigye ne wɔn ahiade ahorow ama, na ama wɔayɛ biako na ama wɔn tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde nimdeɛ di dwuma ne adebɔfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Henanom na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ telefon a wɔde boa wɔ ɔhaw mu, na ntetee bɛn na wonya na ama wɔadi nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔda no adi ho dwuma yiye, de atenka fam mmoa ama, na wɔde wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no ne nneɛma a ɛfata ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ hɔ no bata ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn anaa atuhoamafoɔ a wɔanya nteteeɛ kɛseɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma yie wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔda no adi ho na wɔde mmoa a ɛwɔ tema ne atemmuo mu ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ahokyere mu mmoa telefon so. Nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔboa mmoa no taa ka nsɛmti te sɛ ɔhaw mu dwumadie, atie a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen, ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm, ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw wɔn ho ano, akwan a wɔfa so ma wɔn ho yɛ den, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, ne amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ. Mmoa adwumayɛfoɔ nya ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so, mmoa, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ so de hwɛ sɛ wɔasiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔde mmoa a ɛkorɔn bɛma wɔn a wɔfrɛ wɔn no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe ne akyiwade bɛn na ɛfa bɔbeasu ahorow, mmea kyima, ne awo mu akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho wɔ yɛn mpɔtam, na ɛkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi afa saa nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu yi mu de ahwehwɛ amaneɛbɔ ne mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nneyɛe ne akyiwade a ɛfa bɔbeasu ahorow, mmea kyima, ne awo mu akwahosan no gu ahorow kɛse wɔ mpɔtam hɔ na ebetumi aka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ne mmoa. Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu no, wobu saa nsɛmti yi sɛ ɛyɛ kokoam anaa nea wɔabara, na ɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee yɛ den. Mmabun betumi ahyia animtiaabu, anaa aniwu bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm anaa mmoa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔafa saa nkate ahorow yi so no, mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so, te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, a wɔwɔ abadayɛ ma amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho na wɔde kokoam mmoa a atemu enni mu no ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛma akatua mu nsonsonoe ba wɔ mmarima ne mmea mu, te sɛ adwuma mu mpaapaemu, animhwɛ a wonnim, akatua ho nkitahodi a wɔnyɛ pefee, anaasɛ nhomasua ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a wontumi nnya?
answer_twi_source: Akatua mu nsonsonoe a egyina mmarima ne mmea so betumi aba esiane nneɛma ahorow nti, a nea ɛka ho ne: Adwumayɛ mu mpaapaemu: Mmea ne mmarima taa yɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma ne nnwuma ahorow mu, na wɔn a mmea na wodi so fi tete no taa tua akatua a ɛba fam. Animhwɛ a Wonnim: Nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne nea wotumi yɛ ho betumi anya gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa adwumayɛfo a wɔfa wɔn adwuma mu, dibea a wɔde di dwuma, ne akatua ho so nkɛntɛnso, na ɛde nsonsonoe aba wɔ akatua mu. Nneɛma a Wɔnyɛ no Nteaseɛ: Sɛ wɔanhu akatua ho nkitahodi ne akatua nsenia mu kakraa bi a, ebetumi ama wɔatua adwuma a ɛte saa ara ho akatua a ɛnyɛ pɛ. Nhomasua ne Adwuma Hokwan: Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nhomasua, ntetee, afotu, ne nkɔso hokwan ahorow mu no betumi ama akatua a ɛnsɛ wɔ mmarima ne mmea ntam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛtumi asa STI ne HIV nyinaa, na ayaresa ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ STI ne HIV nyinaa na wotumi sa, nanso wobetumi de ayaresa a ɛfata asa pii. Ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ama STIs betumi ayɛ nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, anaa nnuru a ekum fungal, a egyina ɔyare mmoawa no ko a obi anya so. HIV yɛ tebea a enni sabea a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde aduru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa (ART), nnuru a wɔaka abom a esiw mmoawa no ano na esiw ne nkɔso ano kɔ nipadua no mu tumi a ɛko tia nyarewa (AIDS) a wɔde sa yare no nkwa nna nyinaa. Sɛ wɔsa wɔn yare yie a, nnipa a wɔwɔ HIV no tumi tra ase kyɛ wɔ akwahosan pa mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mfe a wɔadi ho anohyeto anaasɛ awofo pene a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma wɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mfe a wɔadi anohyeto ne awofo pene a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu no gu ahorow wɔ ɔmantam ne ɔman biara mu. Ebia mmeae bi wɔ mmara a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo de wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔpene so ma mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu, bere a afoforo nso betumi ama mmabun kwan ma wɔapene adeyɛ no so wɔ wɔn ankasa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne brayɛ anaa nsabuo na dɛn nti na ɛba?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ anaa brabuo a wɔtaa frɛ no nsabuo yɛ adebɔ mu adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔbea nipadua mu. Ɛyɛ awotwaa no mu ntini a ɛhwie gu, a ɛba bɛyɛ pɛnkoro ɔsram biara.Eyi taa si bɛyɛ pɛnkoro ɔsram biara nnansa kosi ason a ɛsono ɔbea biara. Sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, , brayɛ bere tenten yɛ nnafua 28, nanso mpɛn pii no eyi gu ahorow wɔ ɔbea biara mu . Kyinhyia a wɔyɛ no daa a ɛware anaa ɛyɛ tiaa sen eyi, efi nnafua 21 kosi 35 no yɛ nea ɛfata. Brayɛbea ba esiane nsakrae a ɛba nipadua no mu, titiriw estrogen ne progesterone, nti. Saa nkwaadɔm yi ma awotwaa no mu nneɛma yɛ den ɔsram biara de siesie ne ho ma nyinsɛn a ebetumi aba. Sɛ nyinsɛn ansi a, wɔhwie nkataso no gu, na eyi ne nea wuhu sɛ ɛyɛ brayɛ mogya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen anaa asiane ahorow a ɛtaa ba a ɛbata "dijitaal" akwan a wɔde di dwuma de nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen anaa asiane ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba a ɛbata dijitaal akwan a wɔde di dwuma de nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho ne: Nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ ɛdaadaa. Kokoam nsɛm a wɔabu so anaasɛ data ahobammɔ ho haw. Nsɛm a ɛmfata a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu anaasɛ "kɔmputa" so ayayade. Nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wobetumi anya kakraa bi. Mmabun betumi adi nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma denam nsɛm a wonya fi mmeae a wogye di a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye, nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ din pa hɔ, dijitaal ahotew a wɔde bedi dwuma (te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma ne ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔbɛkwati sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ), ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne mpanyimfo anaa atipɛnfo a wogye wɔn di bedi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere tenten ahe na ɛtaa gye ansa na sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no ada adi bere a woanya nna mu yareɛ akyi?
answer_twi_source: Bere a egye ansa na sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no ada adi bere a obi anya nna mu yareɛ akyi no gu ahorow gyina ɔyare no ko ne ankorankoro nneɛma so. Nna mu yareɛ ahorow bi te sɛ nea broni ka no 'chlamydia' ne 'gonorrhea' betumi ama wanya yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne wɔ nna kakraa bi kosi adapɛn bi akyi wɔ bere a wɔde adi dwuma no akyi. Ebia nna mu yareɛ afoforo te sɛ nea broni ka no 'HIV' ne 'syphilis' bɛtra hɔ akyɛ, na sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no betumi ada adi adapɛn, asram, anaa mfe mpo wɔ ɔyare no akyi. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow sɛ ebia nna mu yareɛ ahorow bi rennya sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛda adi ntɛm ara, na esi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu daa ma ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nkɔmmɔbɔ yɛ mmara kwan so na ɛfata wɔ mo mantam mu a, hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu ama.
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ mmara kwan so ne aduruyɛ mu kwan a wɔfa so nya wɔ Ghana wɔ tebea pɔtee bi mu, nsɛm bi a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa ni: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn na wɔyɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ wom na ɛyɛ mmara kwan so de wɔ ayaresabea anaa ayaresabea ahorow a wɔwɔ tumi krataa. Ɔkwan pɔtee a wɔfa so yɛ no gyina nyinsɛn no fã so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na dɛmdie kasamafo ne wɔn ayɔnkofo adi wɔ dɛmdie akwannya  ahorow ne pɛyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ akwannya ahorow a dɛmdifo wɔ no aboa kɛse ma wɔanya nkɔso. Wɔayɛ: Wɔayɛ ɔsɔretia ne ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow ho nhyehyɛe de ama nkurɔfo ate dɛmdi ho nsɛm ase. Wɔhwehwɛɛ mmara a ɛka obiara ho a ɛbɛma wɔanya hokwan ne hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ. Wɔkyekyɛɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm de twaa nsusuwii hunu ho mpoa na wɔkanyan nsakrae. Ayɔnkofo, nnipa a wonni dɛm a wɔboa asɛm no nso adi dwuma titiriw: Wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho. Nyiyim a wɔsɔre tia wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Nneɛma a wobetumi anya wɔ asetra mu nneɛma ahorow mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden ne wɔn a wɔyɛ ayɔnkofo abom anya nkɔso kɛse wɔ mmubuafo hokwan ahorow ne pɛyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahotoso ne obu ama me ho na matumi agyina nsusuansoɔ  bɔne a efi m’atipɛnfo hɔ ano?
answer_twi_source: Hu sɛ wosom bo: Si w’ahoɔden, wo su ahorow, ne nea woatumi ayɛ so dua, na hyɛ wo ho mfonini pa ne wo ho a wobɛte nka sɛ wosom bo no mu den. Fa botae ahorow a wubetumi adu ho si hɔ: Fa w’ankasa botae ahorow si hɔ na yɛ adwuma du ho, di nkɔso ne nea woatumi ayɛ ho afahyɛ, na ɛma wunya obu ne ahotoso kɛse. Fa wo ho hwɛ: Fa dwumadi ahorow a ɛma nipadua ne atenka fam yiyedi te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, nneɛma a wode gye w’ani, ne bere a wode bɛtra wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafo a wɔboa wo nkyɛn no di kan. Twa nsusuwii bɔne ho mpoa: Hu na twa wo ho asɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa gyidi ahorow a ɛsɛe ahotoso ase, na fa nsɛm a wosi so dua ne nhyehyɛe pa a wɔsan yɛ no foforo si ananmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ titire ma awofoɔ anaa abusuafoɔ a wɔyɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa dwumadie biara nni hɔ a wɔde ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ne mmusua pɔtee wɔ Ghana. Nanso ankorankoro ne mmabun nyinaa ma saa asɛm no betumi anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ adwumaden ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den anaa ntawatawadi a ɛwɔ me ne mfɛfo anaa ahokafo ntam wɔ nna mu akwaa apɔmuden  ho gyinaesi ahorow ho dwuma bere a mekura nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne obu a mabu wɔn ho wɔn ho mu no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ worekɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den anaa ntawatawa  wo ne w’atipɛnfo anaa ahokafo ntam wɔ nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho mu a, ɛho hia sɛ wode nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho di kan. Fa tema ne ntease bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no, tie ɔfoforo no adwene denneennen, na ka wo nsusuwii ne wo nkate ahorow no ho asɛm denneennen na obu wom. Fa nkitahodi akwan a ɛma denhyɛ te sɛ atie a wɔde nsiyɛ, tema, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru di dwuma de di ntawntawdi ho dwuma na hwehwɛ ano aduru a obiara begye atom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim, mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi adi wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛda wim nsakrae ne ASRH ntam no ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛnya ne ano aduru ne nneɛma foforo a mmabun di anim a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu Ɔsatuo: Nhomasua nhyiamu, ɔsatuo, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban ho nhyehyɛeɛ de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate nkɛntɛnsoɔ a wim nsakraeɛ de ba ASRH so na wɔhyɛ ano aduru a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ho nkuran. Ano aduru Foforo: Nhwehwɛmu, nnoɔma foforɔ, ne adwumayɛ a mmabun di anim a wɔbɛhyɛ nkuran ma wɔayɛ ano aduru a wɔde yɛ adebɔ ama ASRH nsɛnnennen a ɛfa wim tebea ho. Atipɛnfoɔ Nhomasua: Wɔtete atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfo ma wɔkyekyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wɔhyɛ suban mu nsakraeɛ a ɛfa ASRH nneyɛeɛ a ɛtumi gyina wim tebea ano ho nkuran wɔ wɔn atipɛnfoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi kɔ/ toa sukuu so kɔ akyi bere a mawo anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Kasa kyerɛ sukuu mu afutumafoɔ (School Counselor). Adwuma nteteeɛ (Vocational Training). Hyehyɛ botaeɛ. Hwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ adi dwuma de akɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so ayɔnkofa app ahorow, sohyial media nkitahodi, ne dijitaal akwan afoforo so wɔ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ ne asɛyɛde wom so?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe: Te kokoam nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan mmeae ahorow so ase na fa di dwuma. Nhwehwɛmu a Ɛho Hia: Fa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nkitahodi ahorow mu wɔ intanɛt so, gye nokware ne atirimpɔw ahorow ho kyim. Mpene so wɔ Intanɛt so: Hu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so wɔ Intanɛt so nkitahodi mu mpo, sɛ́ ɛyɛ w’ankasa ho nsɛm a wobɛkyɛ anaasɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu no. Ahobanbɔ Akwankyerɛ: Di ahobanbɔ akwankyerɛ a platform ne ahyehyɛde ahorow de ama akyi bere a wohyia obi fi abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so. Gye Wo atenka Ho Ahotoso: Sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛyɛ wo yaw a, fa wo ho to wo atenka so na yɛ nneɛma bi de bɔ wo ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na m’amammerɛ, nyamesom mu gyidi, anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow hyehyɛ adwene a mewɔ wɔ nna mu asiane ahorow ho na nya me gyinaesi kwan so nsunsuanso, na mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi ho yiye de asi gyinae ahorow a ɛne me gyinapɛn ne me botae ahorow hyia?
answer_twi_source: W’amammerɛ mu nsɛm, nyamesom mu gyidi, anaa ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow betumi akyerɛ wo adwene wɔ nna mu asiane ahorow ho na anya gyinaesi so nsunsuanso denam: Nhyehyɛe a wode bɛma so: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi akyerɛ adwene a wowɔ wɔ nna, nkitahodie, ne awo akwahosan ho, na ɛbɛkyerɛ wo asiane ho adwene na akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ gyinaesi ho. Akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔde hyɛ obi so: Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, nna mu nneyɛe, ne nkitahodie ho no betumi anya asiane ne nneyɛe a wogye tom ho adwene so nsunsuanso. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohwehwɛ nsunsuanso ahorow yi mu yiye a, susuw sɛnea amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo mu nneɛma nya wo gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no so nsunsuanso no ho. Susuw ho sɛ ebia saa gyidi ahorow yi ne w’ankasa gyinapɛn ne w’atirimpɔw ahorow hyia anaa, na hwehwɛ adwene foforo a wode bɛma wo gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ahu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔn a wɔwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so nkɛntɛnso di ASRH nsɛmti a wɔabara anaasɛ wɔabɔ no animtiaa ho dwuma, te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne nna mu yareɛ ahorow, na dwuma bɛn na wodi wɔ nsɛm yi a wɔsɛe no mu?
answer_twi_source: Dawurubɔ kuro ntetan nkɛntɛnsofo  di dwuma titiriw wɔ ASRH nsɛmti a wɔabara anaasɛ wɔabɔ no animtiaa ho dwuma a wodi mu denam: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne nna mu yare ho a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ, ankorankoro nsɛm, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu nsɛm so. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛkyɛ, anansesɛm ahorow a wɔbɛpow, ne nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma mmaabun a wɔredi nsɛm a ɛho hia yi mu. Wɔma saa nsɛmti yi bu animtiaa denam: Wɔma mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ animtiaabu, a wɔtew aniwu anaa aniwu nkate a ɛbata ASRH nsɛmti ho no so. Mmabun a ebia wɔrehyia ɔhaw  anaa osuahu a ɛte saa ara a wɔbɛma wɔanya tema, ntease, ne biakoyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ngyinaso bi a enti obi betumi afa sɛ ɔbɛtwe ne ho afi nna ho? (nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, ahosiesie a wonnya yɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow nti na obi betumi afa sɛ ɔbɛtwe ne ho afi nna ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nyamesom mu gyidi anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛde kwati a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho di kan kosi sɛ wɔbɛware anaa abusuabɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu. Ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔtwɛn kosi sɛ wɔbɛte nka sɛ wɔasiesie wɔn ho wɔ nkate ne adwene mu ama nna ho dwumadi ho. Nneɛma a ebetumi afi nna mu aba ho dadwen, te sɛ nyinsɛn, nna mu yareɛ, anaa nkate fam a wɔde bata obi ho. Ɔpɛ a obi pɛ sɛ ɔde n’adwene si ankorankoro botae ahorow, apɛde ahorow, ne aho-nkosoɔ a enni adwen a atwe firi so anaa asɛde bi wo nna abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe pa ho nkuran wɔ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahorow mu, berɛ a yehu wɔn ahiade ne osuahu soronko na yebu wɔn no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wɔbɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho nkuran ni: Nneɛma a wobetumi anya: Hwɛ sɛ honam fam mmeae, nkitahodi akwan ( mum kasa, Braille), ne apɔwmuden ho nneɛma a mmubuafo ahorow betumi anya. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm ho Nimdeɛ: Tete apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ mmubuafoɔ abrabɔ pa, ahiadeɛ pɔtee, ne nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔde bɛdi nkitaho a ɛka obiara ho. Ɔhwɛ a Ɛfa Ɔyarefo Ho: Fa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn apɔwmuden ho no mu. Nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri: Fa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa dɛmdi ne LGBTQ+ nipasu ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde tew animtiaabu so anaasɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmabun so ayɛ yiye, na asuade bɛn na yebetumi anya afi nea wɔde di dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔsatu anaa nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde tew animtiaabu so a edi mu a wɔde wɔn ani si mmabun so no bi ne: Nneɛma a mmabun di anim a wɔde akwan a wɔfa so yɛ ade, te sɛ adwinni, nnwom, agoru, ne abɛɛfo ntentan nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ di dwuma de di dwuma na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ atipɛnfo nna ne awo akwahosan ho ade wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu, a ɛka obiara. Dwumadie a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa adwumayɛkuo a ɛda akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ ntam de di animtiaabuo ho dwuma, hyɛ gye a wɔgye tom no ho nkuran, na ɛma nnwuma a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa adamfofa ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ tu mpɔn. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nsɛmma nhoma ne abɛɛfo ntentan satu ahorow a ɛde abasɛm, adansedi, ne atipɛnfo mmoa di dwuma de kasa tia animtiaabu, ma nkurɔfo hu, na ɛma akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no nne yɛ kɛse, a nea ɛka ho ne, nnipa a wɔwɔ nnam mu yareɛ  a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ HIV/AIDS, ne wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi nyiyim anaa adwemmɔne a egyina me nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa me bɔbeasu so no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Hu hokwan ahorow a wowɔ na hwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa sɛ wohyia nyiyim anaa ɔhaw a. Fa nnamfo, abusuafo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔboa wo a wosi wo nipasu so dua na wogye tom no twa wo ho hyia. Fa wo ho hwɛ na hwehwɛ mmoa fi adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo anaa akuw a wɔboa wo hɔ sɛ worepere wɔ nkate fam nsunsuanso a nyiyim de ba no ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi wɔ suban a ɛma ɔbɛn mmabun ɛnam ade bɔne a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ nti a, dɛn na ɛbɛma m'ahu?
answer_twi_source: Frankaa Kɔkɔɔ anaa Red flags: Hwɛ nneyɛe te sɛ adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm a ɛboro so, wo ho nsɛm a wɔsrɛ, anaa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛte wo afi afoforo ho. Gye wo ho di: Sɛ biribi yɛ wo naa, fi ne nkyɛn. Kwati sɛ wode w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm bɛma ahɔho wɔ internet so, titiriw nsɛm a ɛho hia. Sɛ wususu sɛ obi anya wo ho adwene bɔne a, ka kyerɛ opanin bi.  Wobetumi abɔ amanneɛ wɔ online platforms so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkɛntɛnsofo, nnipa a wɔagye din, ne amammerɛ a agye din di wɔ adwene a mmabun kura wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔagye nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi ho kyim na wɔakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Nkɛntɛnsofo, nnipa a wɔagye din, ne amammerɛ a agye din taa ma nna ne awoɔ apomoden afã horow bi yɛ fɛ, de adwene a enni mu ba anaasɛ wɔhyɛ nneɛma ho nkuran a nyansahu mu adanse a ɛfata nnim. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun tumi ma wogye saa nkɛntɛnso ahorow yi ho kyim na wɔkasa tia denam kyerɛkyerɛ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ma wohu akwan a wɔfa so twetwe nkurɔfo adwene a nnipa a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso ne nnipa a wɔagye din de di dwuma, hwehwɛ sɛnea wɔn nkrasɛm no mu ahotoso te mu yiye, na wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so no so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mesusuw ho berɛ a merehwɛ sɛ mmanfoɔ amanneɛbɔ anaa akontabuo a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woresusuw mmanfoɔ amanneɛbɔ anaa akontabuo a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a wotumi de wo ho to so na ɛfata ho a, susuw nneɛma te sɛ faako a nsɛm no fi, ɔkwan a wɔfaa so boaboaa nsɛm no ano na wɔhwehwɛɛ mu. Hwɛ yiye wɔ akontaabu ahorow awɔayɛ no sika-sɛm de retwetwe nnipa, anaa deɛ wɔayi afiri n'asɛm mu de reboa adwene pɔtee bi. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhwehwɛmu asoɛe ahorow, anaa nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu, na susuw sɛnea ɛfa wo tebea pɔtee ne w’ahiade ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmabun betumi adi wɔ ko a wɔbɛko ama sɛ wonnye wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ntom na wɔbɔ ho ban wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, aman, ne wiase nyinaa mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ sɛnea wɔbɛko ama wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wobegye atom na wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, aman, ne wiase nyinaa no mu denam afoforo a wɔbɛma ate mu ase, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, ne gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Wobetumi de akwan horow adi dwuma, a sohyial media, ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow ka ho, de ahyɛ wɔn nne mu den na wɔako ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfoa wɔn hokwan ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua mmɔdenbɔ ne tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu no betumi adi amammerɛ, nyamesom, ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow a ebetumi asiw SRH ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun a wɔwɔ wiase mmeae ahorow nya kwan no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Atenka: Nhomasua nneɛma ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobebu amammerɛ, nyamesom, ne ɔmanfo gyidi ahorow. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Awofoɔ, nyamesom akannifoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ mpaninfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔdie ne nhyiamu mu de adi adwene a ɛntene ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ mmoa a wɔde ma SRH nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ assertive (asi nkete/asi mebo) na maka sɛ dabi wɔ nna ho bere a me ho nyɛ me dɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Wo "dabi" no dɔɔso: Womfa nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara ka obiara. Fa ɛnne a emu yɛ den ne nipadua kasa di dwuma: Fa w’ani hwɛ, gyina hɔ tenten, na kasa pefee. Nhwɛso ahorow bi ni: "Dabi, me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ saa asɛm no ho." "Mempɛ sɛ me ne obi bɛda." "Gyae." Di wo nneyɛe akyi: Sɛ woka sɛ dabi a, fi tebea no mu .ntɛm ara. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wo a, bɔ ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso amanneɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, atetesɛm mu nneyɛe, ne asetra mu su ahorow nya mmabun 'SRH' nneyɛe ne nnwuma a wonya wɔ mpɔtam a ntawntawdi aka wɔn no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne nneɛma a wɔabara a broni ka no 'Stigma and taboos': Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne atetesɛm mu nneyɛe betumi abɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ho no animtiaa, na ama mmabun a wɔwɔ mpɔtam a ntawntawdi aka wɔn no nnya 'SRH' ho nsɛm ne nnwuma pii. Bɔbeasu dwumadi ahorow: Mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ahorow ne asetra mu akwanhwɛ ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no betumi asiw mmabun ahofadi ano wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn 'SRH' ho no mu, titiriw wɔ mmeawa fam, a ebia wobehyia akwanside akɛse wɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru, awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne nhomasua a wobenya mu. Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔso: Asetra mu adwene wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho betumi aka mmabun tumi a wɔde hwehwɛ 'SRH' nnwuma, a suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛpam wɔn afi hɔ no siw wɔn kwan sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ a ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na yebetumi ayɛ de adi kokoam nsɛm a wɔabu so biara a ebetumi aba ho dwuma, te sɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia a yɛbɛda no adi wɔ aberɛ a y'annhyɛda annyɛ anaasɛ ankorankoro nneɛma a wɔmma ho kwan a yɛbɛka so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobu kokoam nsɛm so te sɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia a wɔda no adi wɔ akwanhyia mu anaasɛ obi a onni ho kwan sɛ obenya ankorankoro nneɛma a, di ho dwuma ntɛm ara na di ho dwuma tẽẽ. Munsusu nea esii, sɛnea ɛmaa obiara tee nka, na kyerɛ anammɔn a wobɛfa so asiw nsɛm a ɛte saa ara ano daakye. Sɛ ɛho hia a, mompa kyɛw na san si mo bo a moasi sɛ mobɛkyerɛ obuo ama mo ho mo ho kokoam nsɛm ne ahyeɛ so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nnwuma anaa ɔsatu ahorow a edi yie a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma nkorɔfo ate nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ho asɛm na wɔabu anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho wɔ mmabun mu no agu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔyɛ ne ɔsatu ahorow a edi mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma nkorɔfo ate nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ho ase na wɔabu anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho wɔ mmabun mu no bi ne social media so ɔsatu ahorow a ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ Planned Parenthood ne WHO di anim, a wɔde nkrasɛm a egyina adanse so di dwuma de ko tia anansesɛm na wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma. Digitals media akenkan ne akyerɛw nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam ahyehyɛde ahorow mu nso de nkitahodi nhyiam ne nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛnea wɔbɛsɔ intanɛt so nsɛm ahwɛ yie ma. Bio nso, ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nsɛmti pɔtee te sɛ HIV/AIDS anosie anaa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano so no taa de nkrasɛm a ɛpopa anansesɛm ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ka ho de di adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asua pii afa m’ankasa awo ho bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wusua w’ankasa wo awo ho ade a, wubetumi afi ase denam w’ababere a wobɛte ase no so. Hu berɛ a woyɛ bra, ebetumi ama woanya wo awo ho nsɛnkyerɛnne. Wubetumi nso ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wogye no di a obetumi de nsɛm ama na wabua nsɛmmisa biara a wowɔ wɔ awo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma te sɛ abusuakuw, asetena ne sikasɛm mu tebea, anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) no ayɛ kɛse? (intersectionality ne identities a ɛka bom) .
answer_twi_source: Fa no sɛ nipasu ahorow te sɛ abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, asetena ne sikasɛm mu tebea, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ a ɛka bom. Saa nhyiam ahorow yi betumi ama obi ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ obenya bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene bɛn na ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm ahorow a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia na wɔabu saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi agu de ahyɛ nhumu, tema, ne akontaabu ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho no ma suban a epira, asodi a wɔde to nea wɔayɛ no bɔne so, ne gyidi a wonni kɔ so, na ɛboa ma wonya kommyɛ ne asotwe biara ho amammerɛ. Mmabun betumi akasa atia na wɔabu saa nsusuwii a ɛnteɛ yi agu de ahyɛ nhumu, tema, ne akontaabu ho nkuran. Anansesɛm a wɔtaa ka no bi ne: Atesɛm: Nna mu basabasayɛ to nnipa ahorow bi nkutoo anaa wɔ tebea pɔtee bi mu. Atesɛm: Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no nam wɔn nneyɛe, ntade, anaa nneyɛe a atwam so kanyan nna mu basabasayɛ anaasɛ "bisa". Atesɛm: Ahɔho titiriw na wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ wɔ mmɔnten a esum wom so. Atesɛm: Sɛ obi ansɔre atia honam fam anaasɛ wanka sɛ dabi a, ɛnyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ. Atesɛm: Nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛnyɛ nokware abu so na abu so. Mmabun betumi ako atia saa anansesɛm ahorow yi denam wɔn ho ne afoforo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn, wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔbɛboa wɔn, asodi a wɔde to wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne so a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne amammerɛ a wɔde pene so ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ no a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne ahwɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ dawurubɔ ne aguadi ho nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho na wɔakasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne ahwɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ wɔ akwan ahorow a wɔbɛma ama wɔasusuw nneɛma ho yiye na wɔasusuw aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi ho nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no so. Wobetumi ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ho nkuran, abisa nsɛm a ɛhwehwɛ nneɛma mu, na wɔaboa mmabun ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm mu nhwehwɛmu na wɔapaapae mu ma wɔate wɔn adwene ne nea efi mu ba a ɛhyɛ ase no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm ahorow bɛn na ntentanfidie so influencers taa ka fa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, pene a wɔpene so, ne ASRH nsɛmti afoforo ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na saa nkrasɛm yi nya mmabun ntease ne wɔn gyinaesi so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie influencers kyɛ nsɛm ahodoɔ pii a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano, pene, ne ASRH nsɛmti foforɔ ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ankorankoro nsɛm, osuahu, ne afotuo a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nkitahodie ho. Nhomasua mu nsɛm, afotuo, ne nneɛma a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔde nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ bɛma wɔ ASRH nsɛmti ho. Nneɛma anaa nnwuma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ho nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran, te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano anaa nneɛma a wɔde hwɛ nna mu yiyedi. Saa nkrasɛm yi nya mmabun ntease ne wɔn gyinaesi so nsunsuanso denam nsɛm, akwankyerɛ, ne adwene a ebetumi anya wɔn suban ne wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho a ɛde ma wɔn no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɔsatu a mmabun di anim a wɔkasa kyerɛ, asetra mu akuw, ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi adi wɔ 'ASRH' nhyehyɛe a broni ka no 'policies', nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a egyina nnipa hokwan ne asetra mu atɛntrenee nnyinasosɛm ahorow so a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔsatuo a mmabun di anim, asetena mu akuo, ne ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ a broni ka no 'policies', nhyehyɛeɛ, ne nneyɛeɛ a egyina nnipa hokwan ne asetena mu atɛntrenee nnyinasosɛm so a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ mu. Wɔma mmabun nya akwan a wɔbɛfa so aboaboa wɔn ho ano, ayɛ adwuma abom, na wɔakamfo nsakraeɛ, na wɔma wɔn tumi ma wɔde ahyɛ ASRH nsakraeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ no mu na wɔma wɔn a wɔsi gyinaeɛ no bu akontaa sɛ wɔde mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa hokwan ne wɔn yiedie bedi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow hyɛ suban pa ne nneyɛe pa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ma wonya tebea a ɛboa a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho nkɔmmɔ na wɔahwehwɛ nsɛm. Atipɛnfo betumi ayɛ nhwɛsofo, akyɛ nneyɛe pa ne adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho a ɛne wɔn atipɛnfo hyia. Ɛdenam nkitahodi ne kyɛfa a wonya so no, nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim hyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ho nkuran na ɛma mmabun tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho. Atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow ma nkate fam mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ, na ɛtew nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho ne animtiaabu a ɛbata nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen bɛn na ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa ahodwiriw ho bɛma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nsɛnnennen ne akwanside ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛmma wontumi mfa ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm bedi dwuma ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan, a nea ɛka ho ne sika ne sika kakraa bi, ntetee ne nhomasua a ɛnnɔɔso mma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, animtiaabu ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ adwenemhaw ho, ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Saa nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma a wobedi no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa ɔkwan a ɛwɔ afa horow pii a ɛfa nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ntetee nhyehyɛe, ne mpɔtamfo a wɔbom yɛ adwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia ɔhaw bi wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe kwan bi ho, te sɛ nea ɛma ɔhaw bi ba me nipadua so 'side effects' anaa sɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ mede bedi dwuma a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Anamɔn a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wotu: Kɔ Akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo nkyɛn: Sɛ wuhyia ɔhaw bi a, kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn. Susu anamɔn foforɔ ho: Sɛ ɔkwan biako mfata a, wo ne nea ɔde ma wo no nsusu akwan foforo a wobɛfa so ayɛ ho. Di Akwankyerɛ Akyi: Fa abusua nhyehyɛe ho akwan horow di dwuma berɛ nyinaa sɛnea wɔakyerɛ wo no na atumi aboa wo. Asianesɛm: Nyinsɛn a Wosiw Ano Ntɛmntɛm: Sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban ba a, susu nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ (anɔpa-akyi aduru, morning after pill) yɛ ho adwuma. Nya websites a wotumi de ho to so , apps ne hotlines ma adwumayɛfo akwankyerɛ. Wotumi frɛ; 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ mu de akasa ma mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ne hokwan ahorow di kan?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ mu de akasa ma mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ne hokwan ahorow di kan denam: Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔkasa ma: Ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛbɔ ho nhyehyɛe de ama nkurɔfo ate nsɛm atitiriw ho asɛm, aboaboa mmoa ano, na wɔanya ɔmanfo adwene ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso. Nhyehyɛeɛ ho Nkɔmmɔdie a broni ka no 'Policy consultation': Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔdie, atiefoɔ, ne nhyiamu mu de wɔn adwene ama, akyɛ osuahu, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata mmabun. Tumi a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ a broni ka no 'Capacity building': Mmabun tumi a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm a wɔka de boa ne nhyehyɛe mu denam ntetee, afotu, ne akannifo nkɔso nhyehyɛe so. Nkabom dwumadi a broni ka no 'Patnership': Wɔne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma foforɔ, a ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, aban nnwumakuo, ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ ka ho, bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ama mmabun nne ayɛ kɛseɛ na wɔde mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nnipa bom no adi dwuma. Nhwehwɛmu ne Akontaabuo: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a wɔde bedi dwuma no sohwɛ, wɔbɛma nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ abu wɔn bɔhyɛ ho akontaa, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛhia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusui bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aka hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Aane, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuii betumi anya hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow bi betumi asi abusua a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu so dua kɛse anaasɛ ebetumi anya adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mfe a obi adi ho anohyeto anaa ahwehwɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, ɛbɛma obi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔde "Levonorgestrel" ayɛ a wɔtɔn no aduruyɛdan mu a wɔmfa mfe a wɔadi ho anohyeto biara nni ho, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔadi mfe biara betumi atɔ a wonkyerɛw nnuru a wɔakyerɛw ama wɔn. Nanso, ebia "ulipristal acetate" no wɔ mfe a obi adi ho anohyeto anaasɛ ɛho behia sɛ wɔkyerɛw nnuru ma, a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nhyehyɛe ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi de akwankyerɛ ahorow asi hɔ a yɛde bɛkyɛ nsɛm akyerɛ abusua no mufo afoforo anaa abɔntensofo de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɔ me kokoam nsɛm ho ban?
answer_twi_source: Fa akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ si hɔ a wode bɛkyɛ nsɛm akyerɛ abusua no mufo afoforo anaa abɔntensofo na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔabɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia na ɛfa ho nkutoo, na nya pene ansa na woada wo ho nsɛm adi. Munsusuw hia a ɛho hia sɛ wudi kokoamsɛm ne adwempa ho bere a wo ne afoforo resusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu ayaresa a ɛfata mmabun (youth-friendly) wɔ me mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Bisa awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ anaa 'counselors' (afotufoɔ). Kɔ mpɔtam ayaresabea kɔbisa. Hwehwɛ 'online' (ntanɛt so) fa 'youth-friendly clinics' ho. Fa ntanɛt so nhyehyɛeɛ a ahyehyɛdeɛ ahorow no de ma di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛbɛn hɔ no de nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nnwuma ma kodu he, na kaa bɛn na wobetumi afa so akɔ wɔn nkyɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a ɛda akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛbɛn hɔ a wɔde nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nnwuma ma no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina baabi a wote so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wuhu kwan a ɛda ntam ne akwantu a ɛwɔ hɔ a, wubetumi: Fa intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma anaa nneɛma a akwahosan ho ahyehyɛde ahorow de ma no ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ma no mu. Hwɛ akwantuo nhyehyɛeɛ ne akwan a wobɛfa so ama ɔmanfoɔ akwantuo a wobɛtumi apaw te sɛ bɔs anaa keteke. Bisa sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ fa sukuu akwantuo dwumadie anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma asuafoɔ de kaa kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkyɛn na woanya nsɛm a ɛfa akwantu ho mmoa nhyehyɛe anaa nnwuma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔyem a ebia wɔrehyia adwenemyare anaa atenka fam ahokyere?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa dwumadie a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem a wɔrehyia adwenemyareɛ anaa nkateɛ mu haw no bi ne afotuo, ayaresa, mmoa akuo, ne adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ awoɔ akyi hwɛ mu a wɔbɛnya. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi de nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ nea broni ka no 'referrals' ne mmoa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ayaresa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhunu na ɛbu wɔn a wɔafa akwanhyia anaa ahohiahia mu (trauma-informed approaches) bɛtumi aboa ma wɔadi nsɛm a ɛfa nnipa kuo a wɔn ani nnye wɔn ho anaa wɔadi wɔn so animtiaa ho? Nnipa kuo te sɛ mmarima a wɔne mmarima da anaa mmaa a wɔne mmaa da (LGBTQ+), nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ tuntum (people of color), atubrafoɔ (immigrants), akwanfoɔ a wɔrepɛ ahobammɔ (refugees), nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛmdi (people with disabilities), ne nnipa afoforɔ a atetesɛm kyerɛ sɛ wɔahyɛ wɔn so. Na sɛn na saa nhyehyɛeɛ yi bɛtumi ama atɛntenenee ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ akɔ anim wɔ asetena mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwankyerɛ a ɛfa ayaresa a ɛhwɛ nkateɛ mu nyadeɛ (trauma-informed approaches) bɛtumi aboa ama yɛadi nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn a nna ho mmonnaatoɔ ato wɔn a wɔfiri mpɔtam a mmoa nante hɔ anaasɛ wɔbu wɔn abamfoɔ no ho dwuma. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ yɛbɛhu na yɛadi ɔhaw ahorow ne amansan ntɛnkyeɛ a saa nnipa yi hyia no ho dwuma.Ebi ne sɛ yɛbɛte aseɛ sɛnea nhyehyɛeɛ mu mpanneɛ, nhyɛsoɔ, nyiyim, ne asetena mu mpapahwee bɔ mu de nkateɛ mu nyadeɛ ne mmonnaatoɔ ba. Ɛhia nso sɛ yɛma yɛn ani kanyan wɔ amammere mu ahobrɛaseɛ ho, na yɛasi yɛn bo sɛ yɛbɛdwiriw mpanneɛ biara a ɛsi mmoa kwan na yɛahyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ne atɛntrenee nkuran wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi teɛ me so wɔ wɔn edinnsiananmu ho a, mɛyɛ dɛn abua wɔ obu mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana amammra (constitution) mu no, bɔberɛ mmienu (binary gender) pɛ na wɔgye tom, na nsɛmfua "ɔno" (a ɛfa ɔbaa anaa ɔbarima ho) nko ara na wɔde di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na atipɛnfo mmoa akuw hyia, na dɛn ne ɔkwan a wɔtaa fa so yɛ saa nhyiam ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wɔyɛ atipɛnfo mmoa kuo nhyiam no gu ahorow a egyina ahyehyɛde no ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ahiade so. Ebia akuw bi behyiam dapɛn biara, dapɛn abien, anaa ɔsram biara. Mpɛn pii no, ɔkwan a wɔtaa fa so no yɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, kuw dwumadi ahorow, nhyiam ahorow a wɔkyɛ, ne ɛtɔ mmere bi a ahɔho akasafo anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a wɔka. Nhyiamu betumi akɔ so wɔ wɔn ankasa anaa wɔ intanɛt so, na ama wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ bi no anya ahofadi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu a egyina wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ ne nea wɔpɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛyɛ daa daa ade  sɛ minnim me ho bere a meyɛ ɔbabun anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane paa. Ɛyɛ bere a woresua wo ho. Obiara te nka saa. Sua akwan a wode bɛnya gyidie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ntetee, nneɛma, ne mmoa a ɛkɔ so bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde "organization" ahorow a wɔn ani gye ho, sɛ wɔde akwan horow a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm bedi dwuma de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi, na wɔabɛyɛ wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ho nsɛm pa na wɔatu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee, nneɛma, ne mmoa a ɛkɔ so wɔ hɔ ma ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔde akwan horow a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho bedi dwuma de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano. Mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi wɔ intanɛt so adesua, adwumayɛbea, "webinars", ne ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, sukuupɔn ahorow, ne aban adwumayɛbea ahorow de ma so. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa afiri adwumayɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ a wɔwɔ osuahu wɔ adeyɛ ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina adwenemhaw ho nsɛm mu. Bio nso, mmabun betumi ne wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo ayɛ biako de akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho akyerɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na hormones nnuro te sɛ birth control pills (awoɔ ho nnuro) ne patches ha nipadua no?
answer_twi_source: Saa hormones nnuro yi si nkosuatoɔ ano kwan, na ɛnnyɛ ɛno nko. Bi so si nkosua kwan sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wonnyini wɔ awodeɛ no mu. Nnuro no ma no yɛ den sɛ bɛrima ne nkwammoa no bɛdru kosua no hɔ. Wei nti ɛtwɛ no mu kwan bɛyɛ ketewa. Saa nnuro wei de nsesa ba wɔn brayɛ mu. Mpɔmpɔ nketewa so ba w'anim. ɛmma wɔnntaa nnya kokoram anaa 'cancer' wɔ bea wɔto kosua no. Mmom wotumi nya tipaeɛ, nausea; wɔn bo so fono wɔn, na nufoɔ no sɛ yɛ mmerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mpofirim mereyɛ tenten ntɛmntɛm saa?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no, wo nipadua no renya nkɔso kɛse. Ntini a ɛma onyin ntɛmntɛm yi fi nkwaadɔm, titiriw nea wɔfrɛ no onyin hormone. Saa hormone yi na ɛma wo nnompe nyin tenten na wo ntini mu yɛ den. Ɛno nti na ebia wubehu sɛ woreyɛ tenten ntɛmntɛm koraa no! Ɛyɛ onyin fã a ɛyɛ daa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen pɔtee bɛn na ewiem nsakrae de ba wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen pɔtee a wim nsakrae de ba wɔ SRH dwumadi a wɔde ma mmabun mu no bi ne wim tebea a ɛyɛ den a ɛkɔ soro na ɛyɛ den, nsakraeɛ a ɛba wɔ nyarewa nhyehyɛeɛ mu, aduane a ɛnni hɔ, atutra, asetena mu nneɛma a wɔhwere, ne anohyetoɔ a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie mu ɛnam nneɛma a ɛho yɛ na ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma a wɔsɛe no nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne nsɛm pa a wɔde si so dua anaasɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano a mmabun betumi de adi dwuma de ama obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho no ayɛ kɛse na wɔne wɔn nipadua anya abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de nsɛm pa a wɔka de si so dua te sɛ ‘Mefata,’ ‘Megye me soronkoyɛ tom,’ ne ‘Meyɛ pii sen me honam ani hwɛbea’ adi dwuma de ama obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho no ayɛ kɛse na wɔne wɔn nipadua anya abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa. Ebia akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano no bi ne adwene a wɔde bedi dwuma, dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigye ne abotɔyam ba mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, botae ahorow a wobetumi adu ho a wɔde besisi hɔ, asetra mu mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, nsɛm a wɔde si so dua pa a wɔde bedi dwuma, nneɛma a wobehu wɔ ɔkwan pa so, ne ɔfã pa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ tebea horow nyinaa mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, na etu mpɔn sɛn wɔ nyinsɛn ne STI ahorow a wosiw mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima Kɔndɔm: Nhoma (latex) anaa roba bi a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔhyɛ kata kɔteɛ so.Sɛ wɔde di dwuma yiye a, ɛsiw awoɔ kwan bɛyɛ ɔha biara mu aduonwɔtwe-num (85%). Ɛbɔ ban firi nyarewa a ɛnam mmarima ne mmaa nna so ba te sɛ HIV, babaso (gonorrhea), ne chlamydia ho. Mmea Kɔndɔm: Kotokuo bi a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛhogo a ɛwɔ kawa. Sɛ wɔde di dwuma yiye a, ɛsiw awoɔ kwan bɛyɛ ɔha biara mu aduonwɔtwe-nkron (79%). Ɛno nso bɔ obi ho ban firi nyarewa a ɛnam nna so ba ho. Diaphragm/Cervical Cap: Mfiri a ɛte sɛ dome a wɔde hyɛ ɔbea no awotwaa mu de kata awotwaa no so. Ɛsiw awoɔ kwan bɛyɛ ɔha biara mu aduonwɔtwe-nwɔtwe (88%). Ɛmmɔ obi ho ban mfi STI ho; fa kɔndɔm di dwuma de siw STI ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankoro betumi abɔ wɔn ho ban ne wɔn ahokafo ho ban afi nna mu yareɛ nom a wobenya ho?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro betumi abɔ wɔn ho ban ne wɔn ahokafo ho ban afi nna mu yareɛ ho denam nna a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma, kɔndɔm a wɔde bedi dwuma daa na ɛteɛ, a wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu daa wɔ nna mu yareɛ ho, wɔne wɔn a wɔne wɔn ho da adi nkitaho pefee na wɔadi nokware wɔ nna mu apomoden ne emu yareɛ tebea ho, na wɔakwati nna mu nneyɛe a asiane kɛse wom te sɛ nna mu ahokafo pii a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔne wɔn ahokafo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban mu tebea a wonnim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi, suban, ne nneyɛe nya mmabun gyinaesi a wɔde hwehwɛ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe na wɔde wɔn din bɛhyɛ apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, animtiaabu, anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa apomoden ho nsɛm bi ho (sɛ nhwɛso no, awoɔ apomoden, adwene mu apomoden) betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛda wɔn apomoden ho haw ahorow adi akyerɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfo. Abusua mu nkɔso: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛkyerɛ abusua dwumadi ne asɛyɛde ahorow betumi anya mmabun gyinaesi a ɛfa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ayaresa a wɔpaw, ne akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ abusua mufo no so nkɛntɛnso. Bɔbeasu gyinapɛn: Ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, mmarimayɛ, ne ɔbeayɛ ho betumi aka mmabun nneyɛe a wɔhwehwɛ apomodenn ho nhyehyɛe, na mmarimaa ne mmeawa behyia akwanside ahorow ne hokwan ahorow a ɛfa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ne ne di ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so yɛ tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa mmabun nna ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea yɛbɛyɛ baabi a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom ama mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) nyinaa firi nteteeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne ayaresabea ahorow bɛtumi ahyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma amanneɛbɔ a ɛfata yɛn man asetena mu (our country's context) nsa aka. Yei bi ne sɛ wɔbɛtete adwumayɛfoɔ ne mmaayewa no nnamfo fa saa nsɛm yi ho, na wɔama kwan ma wɔanya mmoa ne akuo a wɔhyɛ nkuran, na wɔakanyan obu mu amammerɛ. Hyɛ nkuran na ma nkitahodie a ɛmu da hɔ mmra, na yɛ baabi a obiara bɛtumi ate ne ho yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔyɛ ne nipadua deɛ ɔpɛ ho asɛm no kyerɛ dɛn, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Kwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔyɛ ne nipadua deɛ ɔpɛ. Ma wɔbu wo gyinaesie. Ɛho hia ɛfiri sɛ: Ɛma wobetumi ahyɛ ahyeɛ. Yɛ gyinaesie. Gyina wo ho ananmu ma wo ho yɛ yie/yɛ asomdwoe
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea broni ka no 'intersection' a ɛda nna mu ateetee ne basabasayɛ, nyiyim, anaa nhyɛso afoforo te sɛ wofiribea nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho tan, mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan, nea broni frɛ no 'transphobia', anaa 'ableism' ntam, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma a ɛtwam yi ma mmerɛwyɛ ne ɔhaw yɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu ateetee ne basabasayɛ, nyiyim, anaa nhyɛso afoforo te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho tan, mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan,nea broni frɛ no 'transphobia', anaa 'ableism' di nkitaho, na ɛde osuahu ahorow a ɛyɛ den na ɛyɛ kɛse a ɛfa ɔhaw ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn ba. Nkitahodi gye tom sɛ nneɛma pii a ɛka bom na ɛkyerɛ ankorankoro nipasu ne osuahu ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, dɛmdi, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne atubrafo tebea. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ankorankoro a wɔato wɔn hintidua betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow a emu yɛ den a ɛbɛma wɔanya mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ahyia nyiyim anaa basabasayɛ afoforo, na wɔahyia nsɛnnennen soronko wɔ mmara ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛfa so no mu. Nna mu basabasayɛ a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa ɔkwan a ɛda ntam a egye nhyɛso ne pɛyɛ a enni nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka bom yi tom na edi ho dwuma, na ɛde wɔn a ɛka wɔn kɛse no nne ne osuahu ahorow besi mfinimfini.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ asisifo ho amanneɛ wɔ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn na ahobammɔ wom so, na anammɔn bɛn na metumi atu de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔfa m’amanneɛbɔ no aniberesɛm?
answer_twi_source: Ayayade ho nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho amanneɛ yiye na ahobammɔ wom no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nneɛma a edidi so yi: Wɔkyerɛw ayayade no ho nsɛm, a nna, mmere, mmeae, ne ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu ka ho. Asɛm no a wɔbɛbɔ akyerɛ ɔpanyin a wogye no di te sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa sukuu sohwɛfo ntɛm ara sɛnea wobetumi. Nsɛm pii a wubetumi de ama afa ayayade suban ne nsunsuanso a enya wɔ wo anaa afoforo so no ho. Amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe anaa nhyehyɛe biara a wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔfo de asi hɔ de adi ayayade ho nsɛm a esisi ho dwuma a wubedi akyi. Mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma hɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔfa w’amanneɛbɔ no aniberesɛm na wodi ho dwuma ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo, wɔn a wɔkasama , ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo di wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu de anya nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo, wɔn a wɔkasama , ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ ne hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ma wonya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ɔhwɛ a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan no mu. Akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo gyina nneyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina adanse so a ɛde ayarefo akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow di kan, a awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wobenya ka ho kyerɛ. Wɔn a wɔkasama  no yɛ adwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nyinsɛn a woyi gu, kasa tia animtiaabu ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, na wɔboa ankorankoro a wɔrehwehwɛ ɔhwɛ. Wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe no wɔ tumi sɛ wɔhyehyɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho kwan na wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔdenbɔ mu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ awo hokwan ahorow ho ban na wɔatrɛw mu. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo denam nkurɔfo a wɔbɛte ase, wɔn suahu ahorow a wɔbɛka, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde wɔn akwaahosan, ahofadi, ne akwannya ahorow di kan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na insurance nnwumakuw di wɔ sɛnea wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛnea nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi atɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Insurance nnwumakuw di dwuma titiriw wɔ sɛnea wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobetumi atɔ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi atɔ: Akwahosan ho insurance a wɔde tua ho ka, a ankorankoro insurance nhyehyɛe, Medicaid, ne CHIP (Mmofra Akwahosan Insurance Dwumadi) ka ho, betumi aboa ma wɔatua akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho ka denam ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw yare ano, ayaresa, nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, ne ayaresabea a wɔde wɔn kɔ no nyinaa anaa ne fã bi a wɔbɛtua so. Insurance nnwumakuw ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne mmeae ahorow di nkitaho wɔ sika a wɔbɛsan de ama ho, hyehyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde tua ho ka ne mfaso nhyehyɛe ahorow, na wɔde bo a wɔbɔ ne ɛka a wɔbɛkyɛ ho ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛma mmabun nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ne bo nyɛ den sisi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfe bɛn ankasa na obi adi sɛ ɔpene so, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ yɛte saa mmara ahorow yi ase?
answer_twi_source: Mfe a obi adi a ɔde pene so no kyerɛ mfe a ɛba fam koraa a wobu obi sɛ obetumi apene so wɔ nna mu wɔ mmara kwan so. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛte saa mmara yi ase na ama yɛahwɛ sɛ nna mu nkitahodi nyinaa yɛ nea wɔpene so na ɛyɛ mmara kwan so de, na yɛbɔ ankorankoro ho ban fi ayayade ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwan a wɔfa so siw kwan (kɔndom, nnuru a wɔde kum mmadwoa, ntini a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu) yɛ adwuma, na etu mpɔn dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so siw mmadwoa kwan wɔ honam fam sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu: Mmarima kɔndɔm: Eyɛ nkotokuo a mmarima de fura wɔn gyapade a agyina so no ho de akyere emu nsuo na ankɔ ɔbaa no mu. Mmea kɔndɔm: Eyɛ nkotokuo a wɔde hyɛ ɔbaa gyapade mu de siw berima no mu nsuo kwan. Spermicide: Cream, gel, anaa foam a nnuru a ekum mmadwoa wom. Diaphragms: Nkuruwa a ɛnyɛ den a ɛte sɛ dome a wɔde nnuru a ekum mmadwoa ahyɛ mu, a wɔde ahyɛ awotwaa no ano. eyi siw mmadwoa kwan sɛ ɛnkɔ nkosua no mu. Mfaso: Kɔndɔm yɛ adwuma yiye (bɛboro 98% bere a wɔtaa de di dwuma) sɛ wɔde di dwuma yiye bere biara a. Akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw ano no tu mpɔn wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so (71-86%) bere a wɔtaa de di dwuma no. Kae: Sɛ wode di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ a, ɛyɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma woatumi ayɛ adwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mpɔtam nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow wapaw sɛ wɔ siw ɔbea ne ɔbarima nna mu awudisɛm anu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi denam: Akuw anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a sukuufo di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a wɔde wɔn adwene asi nna mu basabasayɛ ho nsɛm a wɔbɛma ɛto etwa, amammerɛ a wɔpene so a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne a wɔbɛboa wɔn. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ntetee ahorow a ɛma wonya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ a wobesiw ano, ne wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne a wɔbɛboa wɔn ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Atuhoama a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfo akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo kyerɛ, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo wɔ ɔhaw ahorow mu, anaa dabere a wɔde nnwuma ma wɔn a yɛɛ wɔn bɔne wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no bɛyɛ adwuma. Sohyial media ɔsatu ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a ɛma nne yɛ kɛse, kyɛ nneɛma, na ɛboaboa mmoa ano ma mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw ano no mu kyɛfa. Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ne mpɔtam hɔ aban ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛde nna mu basabasayɛ ba ntini ho na ɛhyɛ ahobammɔ ne pɛyɛ ho nkuran ma mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn nkitahodie wɔ Intanɛt so no yɛ nea wɔpene so na ɛkyerɛ obuo, titiriw bere a wɔrebɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nna ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn nkitahodi a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no yɛ nea wɔpene so na ɛkyerɛ obuo denam nkitahodi a wɔde bedi kan, obu a wɔde bɛma ahye, ne apam a ɛda adi pefee a wobenya afi wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa hɔ ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadi anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ biara mu, titiriw nea ɛfa nna ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no bɛma wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ayɛ kokoam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no bɛma wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ayɛ kokoam denam: Akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo no a wobebisa wɔn kokoam nhyehyɛe ne wɔn nneyɛe ho Ayaresabea no kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛkenkan anaasɛ wɔbɛbisa nsɛm a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho ansa na wɔanya nnwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ayaresabea anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm titiriw na wɔbɔ kokoam nnwuma ho dawuru
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne awotowaa, awotowaa, ɔbarima akyi berɛmo, ne prostate gland no dwumadi?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima awoɔ nhyehyɛe no bom yɛ mmadwoa na wɔde ma bere a wɔreda. Afa atitiriw no mu mpaapaemu ni: Nkwaboaa: Eyinom ne akwaa a ɛte sɛ kurukuruwa a ɛwɔ awotwaa no mu a ɛma mmadwoa ne testosterone, mmarima nna mu nkwaadɔm titiriw no. Scrotum: Saa honam ani kotoku yi ma mmadwoa no kɔ so yɛ nwini, na ɛno na ɛho hia na ama mmadwoa ayɛ. ɔte: ɔte yɛ ɔbarima akwaa a wɔde tow nsu ne nna mu kyɛfa. Ɛwɔ urethra a ɛde mmadwoa ne nsuo fi nipadua no mu. Prostate Gland: Saa ntini yi a ɛwɔ akisikuru no ase no ma nsu bi a ɛma mmadwoa nya aduan na ɛbɔ ho ban bere a wɔretu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na pene a wɔpene so kyerɛ wɔ Intanɛt so nkitahodi te sɛ nkrasɛm, sohyial media, ne agodie abɛɛfo ntetan beae so?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu kyerɛ apam a wɔfi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease a ɛda ankorankoro ntam sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ pɔtee bi mu. Eyi ka nkrasɛm, sohyial media nkitahodi, ne agodie akwan a ankorankoro di nkitaho na wɔne wɔn di nkitaho wɔ dijitaal kwan so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw hu betumi aboa ma nneɛma pa aba mmabun a wɔrenya ahoɔden afi nna anaa awo mu apɔwmuden ho haw ahorow mu no?
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho betumi aboa ma nneɛma pa aba mmabun a wɔrenya ahoɔden afi nna anaa awo mu apɔwmuden ho haw ahorow mu denam ayaresa, ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano, ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so. Ɛboa mmabun ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔboa wɔn, wɔte wɔn ase, na wɔgye tom, na ɛno betumi ama wɔn ho atɔ wɔn no ayɛ mmerɛw. Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm nso tew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛsan anya adwenemhaw no so na ɛhyɛ yiyedi a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm ahorow a wɔtaa nya wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho ?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Nnipa Taa Fom Dwene ne Nea Ɛyɛ Nokorɛ (Myths and Reality):Atoro (Myth): Nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ntumi nnya nna mu akɔnnɔ anaa anigyeɛ.Nokorɛ (Reality): Obiara tumi nya asetena pa wɔ nna mu, a ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔwɔ dɛm anaa da.Atoro (Myth): Nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm yɛ nnipa a wɔnni nna ho akɔnnɔ koraa (asexual).Nokorɛ (Reality): Adwenem a obi nnya nna ho akɔnnɔ (asexuality) yɛ gyinabea a ɛyɛ nokorɛ wɔ nna ho, nanso ɛnyɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm nko ara na ɛfa wɔn ho.Atoro (Myth): Nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm ntumi nnya nna a ahobammɔ wom (safe sex).Nokorɛ (Reality): Sɛ obi nya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nkitahodie pa a, nna a ahobammɔ wom yɛ adeɛ a ɛbɛtumi aba ama obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene bɛn na ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a wɔtaa nya wɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ STI anaa HIV ho, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a wɔtaa nya wɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ STI anaa HIV ho no bi ne: - Sɛ yɛfa no sɛ akuw bi a "asiane kɛse wom" nkutoo na STI anaa HIV ka wɔn. - a wode asodi to ankorankoro so wo won yare no ho anaase wofa no se woye aguamafoo anaase wonni asodie. - a wode bɛbata STI anaa HIV ho ne abrabɔ pa ho atemmuo, te sɛ nea wobu no sɛ asotwe a wɔde ma wɔ "abrabɔ bɔne" suban ho. - a wogye di se STI anaase HIV ye bere nyinaa a wotumi hu anaase wotumi hu. - a yɛbɛkasa atia saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi hwehwɛ sɛ yɛbɛkyerɛkyerɛ yɛn ho ne afoforɔ fa nokwasɛm a ɛfa STI ne HIV ho, yɛbɛhyɛ tema ne nteaseɛ ho nkuran, na yɛakamfo ayamhyehyeɛ ne atemmuo adwene a ɛfa nnipa a wɔte saa tebea yi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ sikakorabea ne sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu ho akwan horow so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asi gyinae a ɛfata de atew asiane ahorow yi so?
answer_twi_source: Sikakorabea ne sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu no de asiane ahorow ba a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Guadi mu asiane: Sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ sikakorabea, bonds, anaa mutual funds mu no betumi ayɛ nea gua so nsakrae bɛba, na ebɛtumi ama woabɔka. Mfaso ho asiane: Sɛ worekora sika wɔ fixed-income investments, te sɛ bonds, emuduro so betumi akɔfom anaa ate sɛ nsiho kɔsoro a. Asiane a ɛwɔ sika a wɔde asie mu: wɔ sikakora nhyehyeɛ bi mu no sɛ woresesa sika ama ayɛ cash no ɛnnafam nkora wɔ aberɛ a woremmɔ ka anaa sɛ worehyia delays. Mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase denam: Wɔn sikakorabea ahorow a wɔbɛma ayɛ ahorow: Sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu a wɔbɛtrɛw mu wɔ agyapade ahorow ne nnwuma ahorow mu de atew asiane biako biara a wɔbɛda no adi no so. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ akwan a wɔbɛfa so de sika ahyɛ mu: Nhwehwɛmu a edi mũ a wɔbɛyɛ anaasɛ afotu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi sikasɛm ho abenfo hɔ ansa na wɔasi sikasɛm ho gyinae. Akwanhwɛ a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde besi hɔ: Ntease a wɔbɛte ase sɛ sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu nyinaa kura asiane bi ne mfaso a ebetumi aba ne asiane a wotumi gyina ano a wɔbɛkari pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ahobammɔ wom, na mmara ma ho kwan na ama wɔakwati akwahosan ho asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba no so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea a woyi nyinsɛn gu a ahobammɔ wom, na mmara ma ho kwan a wɔde bedi dwuma no ho hia kɛse na ama akwahosan ho asiane ahorow so atew. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ nnim betumi de nsɛnnennen a emu yɛ den aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne dwuma ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ankorankoro, mmusua, sukuu ahorow, akwaa apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo, mmarahyɛ baguafo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu, ne akontaabu ne atɛntrenee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu basabasayɛ a wobesiw ano no hwehwɛ sɛ ankorankoro, mmusua, sukuu ahorow, akwaa apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo, mmarahyɛ baguafo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow bom yɛ ade na wɔyɛ biako. Wɔn mu biara di dwuma soronko wɔ siw ano a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, wɔboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu, na wɔhwɛ ma wobu akontaa na wobu atɛntrenee: Ankorankoro betumi akasa atia suban a epira, de wɔn ho agye mu sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ, na wɔde pene ne obu adi kan wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu. Mmusua betumi ama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, akyerɛkyerɛ ahye a ɛfata, na wɔayɛ nneyɛe a obu wom ho nhwɛso. Sukuu ahorow betumi de nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ adi dwuma, ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia ayayade, na wɔde ntetee ama adwumayɛfo ne sukuufo wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wobehu na wɔayɛ ho biribi ho. Akwaa apɔmuden  ho adwumayɛfo betumi de kokoam mmoa, ayaresa, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ adwumayɛbea titiriw bi ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no ama. Mmarahyɛ baguafo betumi ahwehwɛ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu, adi wɔn a wɔyɛɛ saa no asɛm, na wɔde wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no abata nnwuma a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano, akuw a wɔboa, nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu, ne hokwan ahorow a wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no ho nsɛm bɛma. - ɔsom akannifo betumi de abrabɔ pa ho mmoa ne afotu ama wɔn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn gu? (aduru a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu, oprehyɛn a wɔde yi nyinsɛn gu - kyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri mu)
answer_twi_source: Akwan titiriw abien na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn gu: Nnuru Nyinsɛn a woyi gu: Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔnom nnuru na ama nyinsɛn no aba awiei. Wɔtaa de di dwuma kosi adapɛn 10 wɔ nyinsɛn mu. Oprehyɛn a Wɔde Tu Yafunu Mu: Eyi yɛ oprehyɛn ketewaa bi a apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo a ɔfata yɛ. Wɔtaa de di dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn adapɛn 10 akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu yɛ kokoamsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nna mu yareɛ (STI )nhwehwɛmu yɛ kokoamsɛm. Wɔde ayaresa mu kokoamsɛm ho mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ahorow kyekyere akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ayarefo kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn kokoamsɛm ho ban. Wɔrenkyɛ wo nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu aba no nkyerɛ obiara a wo mpene so, a awofoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo so ka ho, gye sɛ mmara hwehwɛ anaa wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia sɛ wɔda no adi wɔ ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ me ho nyɛ me dɛ anaasɛ me ho yeraw me sɛ me ne afoforo bedi nkitaho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho a Wosusuw Ho: Te nea ɛma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ pɔtee ase. Fa di dwuma: Fa nkɔmmɔ nketenkete fi ase na ama woanya ahotoso. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne w’adamfo, ɔfotufo, anaa ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka wo nkate ho asɛm. Ɔhome a Ɛyɛ Den: Fa ahomegye apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ di dwuma na ama ntini ahorow no adwo ansa na woabɔ nkɔmmɔ. Nsɛm Pa a Wɔka: Kae wo ho sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛte ehu nka na adeyɛ no ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mehyia nsakrae wɔ me nipadua mu nkwammoa ho bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere yɛ bere a obi nyin ntɛmntɛm na onyin, wɔ nipadua ne nkate fam nyinaa. Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwammoa mu no yɛ adebɔ mu ade, nanso ɛtɔ mmere bi a ebetumi ate nka sɛ ɛyɛ den wɔ biribiara a worehyia no so. Nea enti a nsakrae yi ba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ne sɛ wo nipadua resiesie ne ho ama mpanyin afe so, awo, na ayɛ nea ɛde ne ho. Bere a ebia ɛbɛyɛ te sɛ emu yɛ den no, kae sɛ obiara fa saa tebea yi mu, na ɛyɛ bere tiaa mu fã wɔ w’akwantu a ɛkɔ mpanyin afe so no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden ne nsunsuansoɔ a ɛbɛba me so sɛ megye na mɛsanfa mu numu, na mebɔ ho dawuro 'advertising', sansɔ tɔn ho asɛm a ɛfa sexual health ho adi ntɛm?
answer_twi_source: Anidaso ɛnyɛ nokware: wɔn a wɔresi soɔ betumi anya anidaso ɛnyɛ nokware fa nna mu apomuden ho adwadee ne nnwuma a yɛ efi atoro nsɛm anaa wɔatu ho ban boro wɔ dawurubɔ mu ba na ede awerɛhow na waningyeho ba. Adwene bɔne fa wo ho: sɛ wo taa hwɛ dawurubɔ atrɔsɛm a ɛnyɛ betumi ama woate nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ fɛ anaa wonfata. Suban a ɛyɛ hu: sɛ mmaabun taafa no ntɛm dawurubɔ atrɔsɛm a efa nna mu apomuden ho na wanhwɛ nsusansɔ tebea ahorow anaa nea ɛbɛba akyi a, ebetumi ama wɔn ayɛ nsakrae a ɛnteni. Eyinom nyinaa betumi aka mmaabun adwenem apomudenmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya na wɔaboa ASRH nhwehwɛmu databea ne nneɛma a wɔkora so dedaw no na wɔakɔ so ahu nea wɔahu nnansa yi ne nneyɛe a egyina adanse so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya na wɔaboa ASRH nhwehwɛmu databea ne adekorabea ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no denam akwan horow so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow: Website ahorow te sɛ PubMed, Google Scholar, ne WHO Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ho Nhwehwɛmubea ma wonya kwan kɔ ASRH nhwehwɛmu nsɛm, amanneɛbɔ, ne nsɛm a wɔkora so ahorow pii so. Nneɛma a ɛfata mmabun: Akuo ahorow te sɛ Advocates for Youth ne YouthTechHealth de intanɛt so nsɛmma nhoma ne mobile application ahorow a ɛhwɛ ASRH nhwehwɛmu ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun atiefo titiriw so ma. Nhwehwɛmu nkitahodi: Mmabun betumi akɔka nhwehwɛmu nkitahodi ne mmabun afotufo akuo a wɔne ASRH ahyehyɛde ne asoɛe ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ ho ma wɔakɔ so ahu nea wɔahu nnansa yi ara na wɔde wɔn nhumu aboa nhwehwɛmu adwuma a ɛrekɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi awura abusuabɔ bi mu sɛ mihu sɛ me hokafo no wɔ STI a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhu sɛ wo hokafo wɔ STI a, ebetumi ayɛ hu na ayɛ basaa. Sɛnea wobɛfa tebea no mu ni: Mmoa ne Nsɛm: Fa mmoa ma wo hokafo na hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnkɔhwehwɛ aduruyɛ mu nkɔhwɛ ne ayaresa. Nya Sɔhwɛ: Ɛho behia sɛ wosɔ wo hwɛ sɛ wowɔ STI Open Communication: Wo ne wo hokafo nka wo nkate ne wo haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na wodi nokware. Paw: Tebea yi betumi asakra wo nkate wɔ abusuabɔ no ho. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubegye bere asi nea eye ma wo ho gyinae. Ebia mobɛpaw sɛ mobɛbom na moanya nna a ahobammɔ wom (kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa) kosi sɛ mo baanu nyinaa befi STI no ho. Anaasɛ, wubetumi asi gyinae sɛ wubegyae abusuabɔ no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛma wonya nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne ano siw ho nnwuma a ɛfata bere a wobu hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne ahofadi ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛma wonya nna mu nyarew "STI" nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne nea wɔde siw ano ho nnwuma a ɛfata bere a wobu hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne ahofadi ho no. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no bɛyɛ adwuma abom, de wɔn ho ahyɛ nnwuma a mmabun di anim mu, na wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo adi nkitaho de akamfo nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, sika a wɔde bɛma nna mu nyarewa "STI" dwumadi ahorow, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nyɛ ɔhwɛ no fi hɔ. Ɛdenam hia a mmabun nhu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wosiw nna mu nyarewa "STI" ano na wɔsa no ase so no, wobetumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ankorankoro nyinaa benya nneɛma a wohia de abɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow nya nsunsuanso wɔ dɛmdieɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwene Ahorow: Amammerɛ ne ɔsom ahorow wɔ adwene ahorow wɔ nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Gye a wogye tom ne animtiaabu: Amammerɛ ahorow bi gye nneɛma ahorow tom, bere a afoforo nso betumi abɔ dɛmdi ho animtiaa. Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛwɔ Gyinapɛn So: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi akyerɛ sɛnea ankorankoro tra ase a wɔadi dɛm. Ntamgyinafo: Ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm betumi afa baabi a wɔn nipasu ne amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow hyia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn ntam abusuabɔ gyina obuo ne pene a wɔpene so so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn abusuabɔ gyina obu ne pene a wɔn ho wɔn ho di so denam: Wɔn hokafo a wɔbɛdi nkitaho pefee ne nokwaredi afa ahyeɛ ne akɔnnɔ ho a wɔbɛkyerɛ obuo ama wɔn hokafo ahofadi ne hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔka sɛ dabi. Wɔbɛhwehwɛ pene a wɔde anigye ne nea ɛkɔ so daa wɔ nna mu dwumadi nyinaa mu. Wɔn hokafo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ daa sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobenya ahotɔ ne abotɔyam a wɔbɛhwɛ tumi a ɛyɛ nnam na wɔakwati nhyɛso anaasɛ nneyɛe a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn metumi ayɛ de ako atia LGBTQ+ nyiyimu?
answer_twi_source: Wo 'school nurse' anaa ayaresafoɔ ne wo bedi ho nkɔmɔ. LGBTQ+ yɛ mmara-to wɔ Ghana; enti akwanya nni hɔ a yɛfa so ko ma wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow a wɔde siw awo ano no tu mpɔn dɛn, na dɛn ade na ebetumi afi mu aba?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano no gu ahorow wɔ sɛnea etu mpɔn ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba no mu. Akwan bi a wɔtaa fa so no bi ne: Akwan a wɔde hormone di dwuma (sɛ nhwɛso no, nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu): Sɛ wɔde di dwuma yiye a, etu mpɔn kɛse, nanso nea ebetumi afi mu aba no bi ne akisikuru, tiyɛ, adwene a ɛsakra, ne mogya a ɛnkɔ so daa. Akwan a wɔfa so siw akwanside (sɛ nhwɛso no, kɔndɔm, diaphragms): Etu mpɔn bere a wɔde di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ no, nanso ebetumi adi nkogu kɛse sɛ wɔde toto akwan a wɔde hormone di dwuma ho a. Nneɛma bɔne a efi mu ba no sua, nanso ankorankoro binom betumi anya akisikuru anaasɛ wɔn bo afuw. Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ɛyɛ adwuma bere tenten a wotumi dannan mu (LARCs) (sɛ nhwɛso no, IUD, nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu): Etu mpɔn kɛse na enhia sɛ wɔhwɛ so yiye, nanso nea ebetumi afi mu aba no betumi ayɛ mogya a ɛnkɔ so daa, pimples, anaa nsakrae a ɛba brayɛ mu. Akwan a ɛtra hɔ daa (sɛ nhwɛso no, akwan a wɔfa so de nyinsɛn gu): Etu mpɔn kɛse wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw mu nanso wobu no sɛ wontumi nsakra no. Nneɛma bɔne a ebetumi afi mu aba no bi ne asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ oprehyɛn mu ne nsɛnnennen a ɛde ba. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi susuw akwan horow a wobetumi afa so ho na ama wɔate ɔkwan biara a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma, nea efi mu ba, ne sɛnea ɛfata wɔn ankorankoro ahiade ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no, ma amammerɛ a ɛfa nsɛmmisa a ɛyɛ katee, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ asuafo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no hyɛ amammerɛ a ɛfa nsɛmmisa a ɛyɛ katee, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denam: Asuafo a wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wogye nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm, asɛm a wɔka, ne gyinabea ahorow ho kyim, twa ho mpoa, na wɔsɛe no wɔ tebea a ɛboa na ɛkanyan adwene mu. Hokwan a wɔbɛma asuafoɔ ne wɔn atipɛnfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne abɔnten ahokafoɔ ayɛ adwuma abom wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nnwuma, ɔsatuo, ne mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma mu. Asuafoɔ a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ananmusifoɔ a wɔma nkurɔfoɔ te aseɛ, wɔhyɛ nkɔmmɔdie ho nkuran, na wɔkamfo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Ɛdenam mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi so no, sukuu ahorow nya amammerɛ bi a wobu nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ɔman ba a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ ɛsom bo na wodi ho afahyɛ sɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia wɔ afeha a ɛto so aduonu-biako (21) nhomasua mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma nkate mu nsɛnnennen a ɛbata STI a wohu ho no nyɛ nea ɛfata.
