answer_twi_source: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata koraa sɛ wobɛte ehu, aniwu, anaa dadwen nka berɛ a wɔahu sɛ wowɔ STI akyi. Eyinom yɛ abɔde mu nneyɛe, na ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wowɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan pɔtee bɛn na wɔakyerɛw wɔ amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan ho nkrataa te sɛ Amansan Mpaemuka a Ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ Ho ne Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam no mu, a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan ho nnwinnade, te sɛ Amansan Mpaemuka a Ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ ho ne Mmofra Hokwan Ho Apam no, ka hokwan pɔtee a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho, te sɛ: Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔtra ase, ahofadi, ne ahobammɔ (UDHR, Ahyɛde 3). Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya nkyerɛkyerɛ, a nna ho adesua a edi mũ ka ho (CRC, Ahyɛde 28). Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya akwahosan gyinapɛn a ɛkorɔn sen biara a wobetumi anya, a nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ka ho (UDHR, Ahyɛde 25). Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho fi nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa su afoforo so (UDHR, Ahyɛde 2).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahye a wɔde besi hɔ ne nkitahodie a emu yɛ den a wɔde bedi dwuma betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi adwennwen so wɔ wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusua, ne afoforo ntam abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahye a wɔde besi hɔ na wɔde nkitahodie a ɛyɛ den adi dwuma no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi adwennwen ho dwuma wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu denam ahye a ɛfata a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ntawntawdi a wɔbɛtew so, ne obu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so. Ɛdenam wɔn ahiade, anohyeto, ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee so no, mmabun betumi akyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ ɔkwan bi so a ɛbɔ wɔn yiyedi ho ban na ɛmma asetra mu nhyɛso nhyɛ wɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua no osuahu ne wɔn ahiade ahorow asi awoɔ mu atɛntrenee ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de mpɔtamu a wɔato wɔn hintidua no osuahu ne wɔn ahiade asi awoɔ mu atɛntrenee ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu denam wɔn nne a wɔde nsiyɛ tie, wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde di nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ho dwuma a wɔbɛkasa ama akyerɛ, ne akwan horow a wɔfa so kamfo nsɛm ne dwumadi a wɔde di kan a wɔde di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nsɛm ne nneɛma a edi mu a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi ho?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nsɛm ne nneɛma a edi mu a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho denam afotu a edi mũ a wɔde bɛma, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwan a wotumi nya mu, ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ Intanɛt so mmeae a agye din ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa wɔn no so. te sɛ SHE + intanɛt so platform denam 5100 a wobɛfrɛ so, YENKASA Nnɔmba a wontua hwee(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya mmara mu afotu anaa mmoa pa sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa fa hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ nyinsɛn mu ho a?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wode bɛma mmara ho afotu anaa mmoa ni: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa sukuu fotufo betumi de wo abata mmara mu nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wo ho. mmaabun adamfofa apomoden ho dwumayɛni a ɔwɔ apomoden adwumayɛbea hɔ no betumi aslo mmoa a ɛne nkitahodi ma mmara kwan so nnwuma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo nya ntetee anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho na ama wɔatumi asom mmabun ahorow yie?
answer_twi_source: Saa ntetee yi betumi ayɛ: nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho nimdeɛ, tema, ne ahobrɛase ho. Adesua ahorow a ɛfa apɔwmuden mu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu ntease ne nea wodi ho dwuma ho. Ayaresa mu nsakrae anaa osuahun ahorow a ɛma wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no hu ayarefo dodow ne amammerɛ mu nneyɛe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abusuabɔ a ɛboa, a nnamfo, abusua, ne afotufo ka ho, di wɔ apomoden a ɛfa adwenemu ne yiyedi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnnyɛ amansan mmara ɛho hyia wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya mmoa efiri abusua mepe ne mpanyinfo a woboa sɛ me dɛmdi nti m'abusua mmoa me?
answer_twi_source: Nnamfo ne tipɛnfo. Afotufoɔ (mpanyimfoɔ a wɔwɔ dɛmdi).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ mmoa nkitahodibea ahodoɔ betumi aboa me ma manya nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔde wo kɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ mmoa nkitahodibea ahodoɔ betumi de wo akɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ayaresabea ahodoɔ anaa nnwumakuo ahodoɔ a wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma ma. Nhomasua Nhyehyɛe: Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahodoɔ pii de nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosi ano, ne nna mu yarɛ wosi ano ho ma. Nneɛma a Wɔkyekyɛ: Saa nkitahodibea ahodoɔ yi betumi akyekyɛ nsɛm ne nhomawa ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nsɛmti a ɛfa nsabuo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, telefon a wɔde boa, wɛbsaet, anaa app ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔanya nna mu basabasayɛ anaasɛ wɔaka wɔn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ kokoam, ɛnyɛ atɛn, ne amammerɛ a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔanya nna mu basabasayɛ anaa wɔaka wɔn no tumi nya mmoa ne nsɛm a ɛfa kokoam, a ɛnyɛ atemmuo, ne amammerɛ a ɛfata denam nneɛma ahodoɔ, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ,  telefon so mmoa, wɛbsait anaa mfonini so nhyehyɛeɛ (apps) a ɛwɔ hɔ no, wobɛtumi anya mmoa ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛyɛ ahintideɛ, a ɛnyɛ animka, na ɛdi amammereɛ ni. Saa mmoa yi bi ne Akwankyerɛ ne Mmoa a ɛfa: Ofie Basabasayɛ ne Victim Support Unit (DOVVSU) Ɛde kokoam mmoa ne de kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma so ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ Ɔman Nna mu basabasayɛ mu. - Abuse relief Corp(ARC): Ɛma nneɛma, mmoa, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu, a intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadie ka ho. - Amanaman Nkabom Nnipa dodow Foto.(UNFPA HOTLINE) : 055-1000-900 - The Pearl Safe-Haven: Ma mmea ne Mmofra a wɔayɛ wɔn ayayade no dabere. - mpɔtam hɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛeɛ ho ahokyere mmeaeɛ anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa: Fa kokoam mmoa, afotuo, mmara ho nsɛm, ne nnwuma foforɔ a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ ahiadeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ betumi adi wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wohyia mmara mu ɔhaw a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akuw a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun a wohyia mmara mu ɔhaw a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho denam mmara mu afotu, ananmusifo, nsɛm a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔde ma a wɔde bɛfa mmara nhyehyɛe no mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ ɔkwan a nyinsɛn fa so ba?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn: Sɛ nkwamoa no ne kɔsua kɔhyia awodeɛ mu. Ɛkɔatena awodeɛ mu na ɛyɛ abofra.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri "Comprehensive Sex Education" di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ho dwuma te sɛ: Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so, nea ɛkyerɛ, ne sɛnea wobebisa na wɔabu no wɔ nna mu nkitahodi mu. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛkyekye na wɔakura mu, a nkitahodi, ahotoso, ne obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho ka ho. Ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛma ma nkitahodi a etu mpɔn, nkitahodi, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ahye, ne gyinaesi a wɔne ahokafo besi ho nkuran. Mmabun tumi a wɔbɛma wɔahu na wɔayɛ wɔn ade wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaa ayayade ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ho na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ho ne wɔn atipɛnfo wɔ mfe a wɔpene so ho mmara a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔadi so wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ho ne wɔn atipɛnfo denam mfe a wɔpene so ho mmara a wɔbɛma wɔahu na wɔadi so wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no so. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe, wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ mma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, na wɔkasa tia suban a epira anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ mmabun nna ne pene a wɔpene so ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne peneeɛ na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ bere medi npa mu agoro?
answer_twi_source: Pene a ɛfiri komam a aborofo ka no 'Freely given, Enthusiastic permission'. Ɛnyɛ nhyɛsoɔ. Wubetumi asesa w'adwene. Komm nyɛ 'aane'. Kasa pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobɛfa so ne nnipa a wo danso anaa ɛsono wɔn amammerɛ adi nkitaho na woasua biribi afi wɔn hɔ wɔ bere a meresi sɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nhyehyeɛ : Kɔ amammerɛ afahyɛ ahorow, afahyɛ ahorow, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow ase na wode wo ho ahyɛ amammerɛ ahorow mu. Kasa Nsesa: Fa wo ho hyɛ kasa mu nsakrae nhyehyɛe mu na woasua biribi afi wɔn a wɔka kasa ahorow ankasa hɔ. Akwantuo ne Nsesa: Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie a, tu kwan kɔ mmeaeɛ anaa aman ahodoɔ so kɔhunu amammerɛ ahodoɔ a w’ankasa wohu. Amammerɛ Nhyiamu: Kɔka adwumayɛbea anaa adesua a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ amammerɛ mu adwinni, asaw, anaa nneyɛeɛ a ɛfiri amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, sohyial media akuw, anaa nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si amammerɛ mu nsakrae so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow: Hwɛ sini ahorow, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, anaa kenkan nhoma ahorow a akyerɛwfo a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu kyerɛwee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ awo akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa ho nkuran, a asetra kwan a wɔpaw ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wobɛfa so akanyan nna mu apɔwmuden ne yiedie nyinaa ne:Nna a ahobammɔ wom: Denam "condoms" anaa banbɔ nneɛma afoforɔ a wobɛde adi dwuma de atew nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne nyinsɛn a anyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho asiane so.Nkitahodie a ɛmu da hɔ: Kasa kyerɛ wo nna mu akunneaba (partner) mu fann na fa nokorɛyɛ kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu apɔwmuden, baabi a wope sɛ mo nkitahodie no kɔsi (boundaries), ne nyinsɛn ho banbɔ (contraception) mu.Kwati tawa, nnubɔne, ne nsa pii: Kwati tawa, nnubɔne (drugs), ne nsa a wobɛnom no dodo, ɛfiri sɛ yeinom bɛtumi aka wo nna mu apɔwmuden bɔne pa ara.Asetena pa a ahoɔden wom: Ma wo ho atɔ wo denam apɔwmuden nteteeɛ (exercise) a wobɛyɛ mmerɛ biara, aduane pa a ahoɔden wom a wobɛdie, ne ahomegyeɛ (sleep) a ɛfata.Hwehwɛ mmaa ayarehwɛ mmoa mmerɛ biara: Kɔ ayaresabea hwehwɛ mmaa apɔwmuden mu mmoa (gynecological care) mmerɛ biara, a nhwehwɛmu ahorow (screenings), paneɛ a wɔbɔ de bɔ ban (vaccinations), ne banbɔ nneyɛeɛ afoforɔ ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ mmea ho dwumadie "gynecological services" a wɔde ma mmabun mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ne wɔn adi nkitaho ama mmoa ne nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmea ho dwumadie a wɔde ma mmabun mu te sɛ: Awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ma, a nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotuo, nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa ka ho. Mmabun haw ahorow, nsɛmmisa, ne akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn so. Nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, Nna mu nyarewa "STI" a wosiw ano, brayɛ akwahosan, nna mu dwumadi, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne akwahosan ho botae ahorow hyia. Wubetumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho de ahwehwɛ mmoa ne nsɛm denam: Mmea ho nhyehyɛe a wobɛyɛ daa de asusuw awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho. Nsɛm a wubebisa na woada dadwen anaa adwenem naayɛ biara a ebia wowɔ wɔ w’awo akwahosan ho adi. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ aduruyɛ mu nsɛmfua, ayaresa a wobetumi apaw, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ho. W’ankasa akwahosan ahiade ne nea wopɛ a wobɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyiam ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri mu, sen sɛ wɔbɛfa nhyehyɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho no ma wonya mfaso pii sen nhyehyɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow a ɛsono emu biara. Nea edi kan no, ɛboa ma wotumi kɔso hwɛ mmubun yie woberɛ a woregye ayarehwɛ wɔ beaɛ kro mu.Yie te su bi a ɛmmoa apɔmden te sɛ mereyɛ krakra na magyae na aboa apɔmden pa. Bio nso, awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ baabi baako a wɔn nhyehyeɛ yɛ ɛboa ma wohu adekro pɔtee a ɛreha mmabun woberɛ woreyɛ nhwehwɛ mu afa apɔmden ne adwenem mu nyinaa ahu wohiadeɛ anaa wohaw. Ɛboa nso ma wodi akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ mu, te sɛ animtiaabu anaa nhyehyɛe mu haw so, denam awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ daa no fã so. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, nkabom ma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun no tu mpɔn na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa ma nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho animtiaabu a, ɛwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no so atew? (ntease ne tema a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran) .
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu betumi ama ayɛ den ama nkurɔfo sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ a ahobammɔ wom a woyi nyinsɛn gu. Ɔkwan a wobɛfa so aboa ni: Hyɛ Ntease Ho Nkɔso: Ka nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nea enti a, nkurɔfo paw ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware. Tema ne Obu: Tie adwene ahorow a wunni atɛn. Fa w’adwene si nnipa osuahu ne nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ho no so. Ankorankoro Nsɛm (sɛ ɛyɛ wo dɛ a): W’ankasa w’asɛm a wobɛka, sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a, ebetumi ayɛ nea tumi wom wɔ animtiaabu a wobɛsɛe no mu, na woaboa afoforo ma wɔate nka sɛ wɔnyɛ ankonam kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ pa mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu fekubɔ pa ne obu su ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ pa yɛ nea ɛda adi wɔ obu, ahotoso, nkitahodi, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho. Mmabun betumi ahu fekubɔ pa na obu wom denam: Obu: Ɔhokafo biara bu ɔfoforo no adwene, n’ahye, ne ahofadi so. Ahotoso: Ahotoso ne nokwaredi wɔ ahokafo ntam, a wonsuro sɛ wobeyi wɔn ama anaa wɔbɛdaadaa wɔn. Nkitahodi: Wɔhyɛ nkitahodi a emu da hɔ na wofi nokwaredi mu ho nkuran, na ɛma wotumi da nsusuwii, nkate, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene adi. Mmoa: Ahokafo boa wɔn ho wɔn ho botae, apɛde, ne nkate fam yiyedi. Pɛyɛ: Ahokafoɔ mmienu no nyinaa wɔ tumi ne ahofadie a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ abusuabɔ no mu, na wɔbom si gyinaeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne intanɛt so nnwinnade, broni frɛ no te sɛ 'apps', anaa nneɛma bi a ɛwɔ hɔ a wode besisi botae ahorow, nkɔso a wodi akyi, ne nsɛm ne mmoa a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wobenya, na mɛyɛ dɛn de ahyɛ m’ankasa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so nnwinnade, broni frɛ no te sɛ 'apps', ne nneɛma a wɔde besisi botae ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne mmoa a wobenya no bi ne: Bere a wɔde di akyi apps: 'Apps' te sɛ nea broni frɛ no 'Clue anaa Flo' boa ma wodi brayɛ kyinhyia, 'ovulation', ne awo akyi, na ɛma nsɛm a ɛsom bo ma awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Apps a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano: Apps a broni frɛ no te sɛ 'Planned Parenthood Direct' anaa 'Nurx' ma wonya akwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔfa so siw awo ano, nsɛm, ne mmoa a efi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Nna mu akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow: Wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ 'Scarleteen anaa Planned Parenthood' de nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mũ, nneɛma, ne nnwinnade a wɔde di nkitaho ma mmabun. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe apps: Apps te sɛ Mapomudenadamfo, broni bɛka no 'MyFitnessPal' anaa 'Apple Health' ma wotumi di w’akwahosan afã horow akyi, a apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, aduan pa, ne awo akwahosan ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔahu mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ na wɔakɔ, nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛfa so, na wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina amanehunu, nyiyim, ne basabasayɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔahu mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ na wɔanya denam nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛma, atie wɔn haw ahorow, ne wɔn suahu ahorow a wɔbɛma ayɛ nokware so. Wobetumi nso ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho no ayɛ mmerɛw, na wɔaboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina amanehunu, nyiyim, ne basabasayɛ ano. Ɛdenam obu ne nneyɛe a ɛka obiara ho nhwɛso so no, mpanyinfo betumi bue akwan a mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa bere a ɛho hia na wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔgyiena mu ma wɔn hokwan ahorow ne wɔn yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere tenten botae ne anisoadehu ahorow bɛn na wɔde bɛbɔ mpɔtam a ahobammɔ wom, a ɛka obiara bom a obiara te nka sɛ ɛsom bo, wɔama no tumi, na wɔboa no wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano ne ankorankoro nyinaa akwahosan ne yiyedi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu, a mfe a wɔadi, wɔn bɔbeasu, abusuakuw, anaa abusua a wofi mu mfa ho?
answer_twi_source: Botaeɛ ne anisoadehunu a ɛbɛkyɛ a wɔde bɛbɔ mpɔtam a ahotɔ wɔ mu, a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ ayɔnkofa wɔ ankorankoro, nnwumakuo de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔahyɛ ankorankoro nyinaa akwahosan ne yiedie ho nkuran, a wɔn mfeɛ, wɔn bɔbeasu, abusuakuo, anaa wɔn a wɔfiri mu mfa ho. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina adanse so a wɔde siw yare ano a wɔde bedi dwuma, mmoa a edi mũ a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, ne nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya hokwan no ho dwuma. Ɛnam adwuma a wɔbom yɛ de kasa tia gyinapɛn ahorow a epira, kamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, na wɔhyɛ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so na wobu no ho nkuran so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi ayɛ tebea horow a obiara bɛte nka sɛ ɔsom bo, wɔama no tumi, na wɔboa no wɔ asetra a ahoɔden wom na abotɔyam wom mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ na wɔama wɔn ho tumi sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn ho adi ankasa wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Esiane sɛ LGBTQ+ dwumadi ahorow no yɛ nsɛmmɔnedi nkoaa wɔ Ghana nti, mmabun a wɔte saa no tumi ne nnipa a wogye wɔn di ne adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn nkutoo betumi akasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ato ahyeɛ ɛne me hokafoɔ akasa afa ho?
answer_twi_source: Hu woahyeɛ. Kasa pefee. Bu wo hokafoɔ nso ahyeɛ. Fa nneyɛeɛ so. Kasa ansa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyamesom akuo di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nna mu basabasayɛ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nyamesom tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Nyamesom akuo ahorow nam akwan horow so di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nna mu basabasayɛ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma, a nhomasua, ahwɛfo hwɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi ka ho. Nyamesom atetesɛm pii si nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa atɛntrenee, ayamhyehye, ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa nidi ho so dua, na ɛno betumi ama wɔahu mmuae a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm yi ho. Nyamesom akannifo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de mmoa nnwuma, afotu, ne nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no ama. Bio nso, nyamesom nhomatrofo ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ahorow bi kasa tia nna mu basabasayɛ na ɛhyɛ ankorankoro a wonni ahobammɔ ho ban. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ yehu sɛ nyamesom akuo nso betumi ahyia ɔhaw a\ wɔ saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma a wobedi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne animtiaabu, amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow, ne nyamekyerɛ mu nkyerɛase ahorow a ebetumi ama suban a epira anaa gyidi ahorow a wɔde bɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo no akɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi aboa me ma mahu gyidi anaa suban bɔne biara a ebia mewɔ wɔ me ho anaa me nipadua ho a ɛreka me atenka fam yiyedi na masɔ ahwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Hu gyidi anaa suban bɔne a ɛfa wo ho anaa wo nipadua ho na twa mpoa wɔ ne mfiase a wobɛhwehwɛ mu na woagye ne nokware a wubegye ho kyim no so. Fa ayamhyehye ne gye a wogye tom di dwuma, na hu sɛ obiara wɔ sintɔ ne sintɔ ahorow. Fa nsunsuanso pa ne nsɛm a wosi so dua a ɛhyɛ nipadua mfonini a ɛte apɔw ne obu a wowɔ ma wo ho mu den twa wo ho hyia. Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi adwumayɛfo hɔ fi afotufo anaa ayaresa ho animdefo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm anaa obu ho nsɛm mu sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ sɛn, sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ wonya ntiasɛa emu dɔ efa dea abroɔfo taa frɛ no 'sexuality' ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛdi mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yɛya hokwan yɛ nkyerekyere a emu dɔ fa nna mu adesua, epakyere se, wɔn a wɔresi soɔ, mmaabun no, bɛnya nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ nokware a, ɛfata wɔn mfeɛ a, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛwɔ nnyinasoɔ pa ahorow fa nna ho nsɛm, abusuabɔ, ne awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi afa de m’adwene ama ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ anaa ayaresabea ahorow no, na wɔatumi atu mpɔn wɔ amammere mu nimdeɛ ho wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubɛtumi afa akwan yi so de wo nsɛm anaa wo mmoa ama ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ na wɔatumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ pa wɔ amammere mu nimdeɛ ho: Kasa kyerɛ ɔyaresafoɔ no anaa obi a ɔhwɛ ayaresabea hɔ no fa nnoɔma a woahyia ho, na kyerɛ wɔn akwan a wobɛtumi afa so ayɛ nsakraeɛ. Hyɛ krataa biara a ayaresabea no de ma de gye ayaresafoɔ adwene no ma na kyerɛ wo mmoa. De wo ho bɔ akuo a wɔdi ayaresafoɔ nsɛm ho dwuma anaa ekuo a wɔhyɛ da susue amammere mu nimdeɛ ne nsusuiɛ ahorow ho wɔ ayaresa mu. Fa social media so kwan de kyerɛ wo nsusuiɛ na kyɛ nea woahyia no mu kyerɛ afoforɔ. Kasa ma wɔnyɛ amammere mu nimdeɛ ayaresa adwuma na boa dwumadie biara a ɛhyɛ mmaapɛ ne amammere ahorow mu nkabom ho nkuran wɔ ayaresa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na si wɔ dɔkotani  a ɔhwɛ apemfuo  nsrae hɔ? (nhwehwɛmu, mu duru a wɔhwɛ, mogya mu nhwehwɛmu, ultrasounds) .
answer_twi_source: Nsrahwɛ a wɔtaa yɛ no bi ne: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ: Mogya mmoroso, mu duru, ne akwahosan nyinaa mu nhwehwɛmu. Muduro hwɛ: Hwɛ sɛnea obi mu duru kɔ soro na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ ɛwɔ baabi a ɛfata. Mogya mu Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔhwɛ sɛ mogya a ɛtɔ kɔ nipadua mu, glucose, nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu ne tebea afoforo bi wɔ hɔ anaa. Nsu mu Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔhwɛ sɛ aduane mu nnuru bi te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ nu wo broɔfo kasa mu sɛ protein dodow ne ɔyare mmoawa a ebetumi aba anaa. Ultrasounds: Mfonini a wɔbɛyɛ de ahu akokoaa no nyin ne ne nyin (ebia wɔrenyɛ wɔ nsrahwɛ biara mu).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na m’adwene mu akwahosan betumi aka me ne me nnamfo, m’abusuafo, ne ɔdɔfo ntam abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Bu a Ɛba Fam: Wo ho a wobedi ho kyim no betumi ama ayɛ den sɛ wobenya afoforo mu ahotoso na woanya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den. Adwennwene: Adwennwene a ɛkɔ so daa no betumi ama ayɛ den sɛ wobɛgye w’ahome na wo ne w’adɔfo anya bere mu anigye. Nkitahodi mu Nsɛnnennen: Sɛ wopere sɛ wobɛda wo nsusuii adi a, ebetumi de ntease a ɛnteɛ ne ntawntawdi aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwehwɛ mmofra ayɛ me mma (adoption) de ase me nyinsɛn anan mu, na mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma me?
answer_twi_source: Afotu: Hwehwɛ afotu fi nnwumakuw a wɔfa mmofra sɛ wɔn mma anaa afotufo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma mu no hɔ. Adoption Agencies: Di nkitaho wɔ mpɔtam adoption agencies na sua ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ne akwan a ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so. Mmoa Nnwuma: Nnwumakuw pii a wɔhwɛ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma no de mmoa ma wɔ adeyɛ no nyinaa mu, a nkate fam mmoa ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ mmara mu nsɛm ho ka ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, mmeaeɛ a wɔhwɛ nyinsɛn ho nneɛma ne asetena mu nnwuma nso bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛma akuw binom yɛ mmerɛw kɛse sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ? (asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, nhomasua a wonnya) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pii betumi ama akuw bi ayɛ mmerɛw kɛse wɔ nna mu yareɛ ahorow ho: Asetra ne Sikasɛm Gyinabea: Ohia betumi asiw akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, nhomasua, ne adan a ahobammɔ wom a wobenya no ano, na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nkitahodi a ahobammɔ nnim, a ebetumi ama wɔanya nna mu nkitahodi ahorow no ayɛ kɛse. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe te sɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wobenya kakraa bi no betumi atwe yare no a wobehu no akyɛ na ama ɔyare mmoawa no akɔ soro. Nhomasua a Wonnya: Sɛ wonni nimdeɛ a ɛfata wɔ nna mu yareɛ ho a, ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ wobesiw ano na wɔahu ntɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ m’afotu nhyiam ahorow no yɛ kokoamsɛm, na dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ asumasɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ahwɛ sɛ w’afotuo nhyiam ahorow no yɛ kokoamsɛm denam: Bisa a wobebisa ɔfotubɔfoɔ no kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne sɛnea ɛbɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban no so. Hokwan ahorow a wowɔ a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho a wobɛte ase, a nea ɛyɛ soronko ne sɛ asiane bi ato wo anaa obi foforɔ. Ɔfotubɔfoɔ a odi abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ ne mmara ahorow a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho akyi. Wo ne wo fotubɔfoɔ no nsusu nsɛm biara a ɛha wo anaa nsɛmmisa biara a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho no ho pefee na woadi nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ ASRR ahorow ho a metumi asua ho ade pii anaasɛ mede me ho ahyɛ mu mpo? (UNFPA, Mmabun Tumi Dwumadi Nkitahodi)
answer_twi_source: Pɛpɛɛpɛ! Nhwɛsoɔ bi nie: UNFPA (United Nations Population Fund): https://www.unfpa.org/ Fa w’adwene si nna ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden ne nnipa kyɛfa so wɔ wiase baabiara. Youth Power Action Network: https://www.amnesty.org/en/youth/ Ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa tumi sɛ wɔbɛkasama SRHR. Saa ahyehyɛde ahorow yi de nneɛma ne hokwan ahorow ma sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ wɔrebu me awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow so anaasɛ wɔrepow me a, dɛn na ɛsɛsɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔrebu wo awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow so anaasɛ wɔrepow a, anammɔn a wubetumi ayɛ ni: Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa. Hu Hokwan a Wowɔ: Hu hokwan ahorow a wowɔ no yiye, sɛnea amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow anaa wo man mmara kyerɛ no. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wo ne wɔn di nkitaho: Ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ, te sɛ mmabun akuo, NGO ahorow, anaa telefon a wɔde boa nkurɔfo, a wɔyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho adwuma titiriw. Hotlines te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN dwumadiefoɔ), PPA Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne 'YMK app' the betumi aboa ama wɔanya nsɛm a mfasoɔ wɔ so. Kamfo Wo Ho: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a, kamfo hokwan ahorow a wowɔ. Ebia eyi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wokasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, sukuu so ahwɛfo, anaa nhyehyɛeyɛfo. Kyerɛw Nea Ɛhaw Wo: Yɛ nsɛm biara a wote nka sɛ wɔabu wo hokwan ahorow so no ho kyerɛwtohɔ. Sɛ wusi gyinae sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa a, eyi betumi aboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ me ho ban afi nnipa a wonni adwene pa wɔ Intanɛt so anaa ahosiesie ne ntetewee nneyɛe ho bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe: Fa kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den di dwuma wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan no so na ama woato nea ahɔho betumi ahu no ano hye. Yɛ Ahwɛyiye wɔ Nnamfo Ho Abisade Ho: Gye adamfofa adesrɛ a efi nnipa a wunim wɔn wɔ asetra ankasa mu nkutoo. Kwati sɛ Wobɛkyɛ Ankorankoro Nsɛm: Kwati sɛ wobɛka wo din nyinaa, w’address, sukuu din, anaa wo nkitahodi ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so. Gye Woahonim 'instints' Di: Sɛ obi a ɔwɔ Intanɛt so ma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ obisa wo ho nsɛm a, siw no kwan na bɔ ho amanneɛ. Hu Ntetewee Ho Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Nea ɛka ahosiesie suban ho ne sɛ wubenya ahotoso a adwene ne sɛ wobɛfa wo ho adi dwuma. Hwɛ yiye wɔ adamfofa su dodo anaa kokoam nkitahodi ahorow a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so no ho. Wo ne Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di Di Nkitaho: Sɛ wunnim obi adwene a, wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di nka nsɛm a ɛhaw wo ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa akuw anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔbrɛ wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, ne adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow pii de mmoa akuw anaa afotu adwuma ma mmabun a wɔrepere wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho. abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nhyiam ahorow ne mmoa telefon ahorow de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔmmɔ din ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu. Dwumadi anaa nhyiam ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim betumi ama mmabun tumi akyɛ osuahu ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so agyina atipɛnfo nhyɛso ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun fa penyɛ ho 'consent' ne hokwan ho na sɛ obi tia wɔn faahodie so a, henfa na ɔmo bɛkɔ akɔ pɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Wobenya mmoa wɔ beebi te sɛ: Intanɛt so mmoa ne 'helplines'. Youth-friendly clinics a wɔma afotu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma (Educational materials) ne mfidie. Mmara mu mmoa (Legal aid) ne mmabun kuo. Sukuu mu apɔwmuden nkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (School health workers).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa m’adamfo bi a wahyia nna mu basabasayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Gye wɔn di. Ma wonhu sɛ wodwen wɔn ho na wowɔ hɔ. Tie a wommu atɛn. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi ɔpanyin anaa kokoam adwumayɛbea bi a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Wubetumi nso anya nneɛma wɔ intanɛt so de asua pii afa sɛnea wobɛboa obi a onyaa ne ti didii mu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne 'rites of passage' (amanneɛ a yɛyɛ de twa kwan kɔ mpanyinyɛ mu) ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ wo brɔno mu, na ɛboa sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Yɛwɔ amanneɛ bi te sɛ 'puberty rites' (bragoro), 'initiation' (ahyaseɛ), ne awareɛ amanneɛ. Wei kyerɛ sɛ woabɛyɛ panyin na eho hia sɛ wobehu wo dwumadie foforo wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo denam: Nnwumakuo ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene asi mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Sɛ wode wɔn ho bɛhyɛ asatu/yɛkyerɛ de asɔre atia. A wɔbɛhwehwɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo ama woayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho. Nsɛm a wɔbɛka ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de ama nkurɔfo ate ase. Abɛɛfo ntentanfidie a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ne wɔn nkrasɛm ayɛ kɛse
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina honam mu nkwammoa (hormones) nsunsuansoɔ so wɔ me nipadua ne m'atenka so?
answer_twi_source: Afotu bi a wode bedi nea honam mu nkwammoa mu nsesae de ba no ho dwuma ni: Asetra a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Aduan a ɛkari pɛ a wubedi, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛkɔ so ayɛ, ne nna a ɛfata a wobɛda no betumi aboa ma hormone dodow akɔ soro na ama wo yiyedi nyinaa atu mpɔn. Wo honam ani hwɛbea: Sɛ woredi nsawa anaa honam ani a srade wom ho dwuma a, honam ani hwɛbea a ɛyɛ bɔkɔɔ betumi aboa. Fa aduru a wɔde tew ho a ɛnyɛ den ne nneɛma a oduruyɛfo a ɔhwɛ honam ani yare kamfo kyerɛ di dwuma. Adwennwen a Wobedi Ho Adi: Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu no betumi ama adwennwen aba, enti akwan pa a wobɛfa so adi adwennwen ho dwuma a wobɛhwehwɛ no ho hia. Eyi betumi ayɛ ahomegye a emu dɔ, yoga, ɔpanyin anaa w’adamfo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wo ne no bɛkasa, anaasɛ dwumadie  ahorow a w’ani gye ho a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ Daa: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ betumi aboa ma adwene atu mpɔn, atew adwennwen so, na ama akwahosan nyinaa anya nkɔso. Hwehwɛ dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, sɛ ɛyɛ agumadi, asaw, akwantu. anaa yoga. Da Wo Nsusuwii Adi. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛda wo atenka ne wo nkate adi. Sɛ́ ebia ɛnam nkyerɛwee so. adwinni, nnwom, anaa obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wo ne no bɛkasa, ada no adi no betumi ayɛ ayaresa kɛse. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ worebrɛ wɔ nea efi honam mu nkwammoa  nsesae a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi ɔpanyin, sukuu ɔfotufo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ, mmoa, ne nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wo ma woafa saa fa yi mu ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahobammɔ abien a mede bedi dwuma no kyerɛ sɛ mintumi nnya nna mu anigye kɛse saa?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa binom haw sɛ ebia ahobammɔ abien bɛma nna mu anigye so atew. Nanso, kɔndɔm ahorow ne srade ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a ebetumi ama wo suahu no ayɛ kɛse. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wo ne wo hokafo bɛbɔ no betumi aboa wo ma woanya akwan a ɛyɛ adwuma ma mo baanu nyinaa na ɛnsɛe anigye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na pene a wɔpene so no fa tebea ahorow te sɛ atuu, nsa a wɔde ka wɔn ho, ne nna ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔde ma no fa nna mu dwumadi ahorow nyinaa ho, efi atuu ne anofe ne nsa a wɔde ka obi so kosi nna mu. Dwumadi foforo biara hwehwɛ sɛ n’ankasa pene so. Esiane sɛ obi pene dwumadi biako so nti, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ wapene afoforo so. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne wo hokafo (hokafo) di nkitaho pefee na wokyerɛ obu fa ahye ne akɔnnɔ ahorow ho ansa na wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na yɛadi nokware afa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho, sɛ ɛsono yɛn gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow mpo a?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wode tema, obu, ne ɔpɛ sɛ wubetie nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow yi. Fa w’adwene si mo ho mo ho adwene a mobɛte ase so sen sɛ mobɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ mobɛgye mo ho mo ho gyidi adi anaasɛ mobɛsesa. Fa "Me" nsɛm no da wo nkate ne wo suahu adi a womfa asodi no nto hɔ, na yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ a obiara bɛte nka sɛ ne ho tɔ no sɛ ɔbɛka ne nsusuwii pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so afi akwanside anaa tebea horow a ɛhaw adwene mu na wɔakɔ so agyina nsɛnnennen ano?
answer_twi_source: Adwene Pa: Ahoɔden, nkɔso hokwan ahorow, ne tebea no afã horow a eye a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so. Ɔhaw Ahosiesie: Nsɛnnennen a wɔbɛkyekyɛ mu ayɛ no anammɔn a wobetumi adi ho dwuma na wɔahu ano aduro a mfaso wɔ so. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Ankorankoro a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ, nkuranhyɛ, ne nkate fam mmoa. Wɔn Ho a Wɔhwɛ: Nneɛma a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, ne nneɛma a wɔde gye wɔn ani a wode bedi kan na ama woanya ahoɔden foforo na woatew adwennwen so. Nsakrae: Nsakrae a wobɛsakra, asua biribi afi akwanside ahorow mu, na woayɛ nsakrae wɔ botae anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow mu sɛnea ɛho hia. Anidaso: Anidaso a wubenya na woakura anidaso sɛ nea ebefi mu aba pa mu, wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mpo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodi betumi adi wɔ ntawntawdi a wɔne atipɛnfo ntam siesie mu, a nea ɛka ho ne nsusuwii, nkate, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene a wɔbɛda no adi pefee ne nokwaredi, nsɛmmisa a ɛma emu da hɔ a wobebisa, na wɔahwehwɛ ano aduru a obiara gye tom a ɛma obiara nya obu ne ntease?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi di dwuma titiriw wɔ ntawntawdi a wɔne atipɛnfo ntam no siesie mu denam: Nsusuwii ne nkate horow a wɔbɛda no adi pefee ne nokwaredi mu: Obi adwene, nea ɛhaw no, ne n’ahye a ɔbɛka ho asɛm a onsuro sɛ wobebu no atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔ no so ka. Nsɛmmisa a ɛma emu da hɔ a wobebisa: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaa nsɛm foforo a wobɛhwehwɛ na ama woate afoforo adwene ne wɔn adwene ase yiye. Ano aduru a wɔn nyinaa gye tom a wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkitahodi a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de hwehwɛ ntamgyinafo anaa ano aduru a ɛkyerɛ obu ma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa ahiade ne wɔn anigye. Obu ne ntease a yɛbɛkɔ so akura mu: Sɛ yɛde tema, ayamye, na yesusuw afoforo ho, bere mpo a adwene a enhyia sɔre no, na yɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ yɛbɛkora abusuabɔ ne ahotoso a obi wɔ wɔ ne yɔnko so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛ (ovulation), na berɛ bɛn na ɛsi?
answer_twi_source: Ovulation yɛ nkesua a ɛho akokwaw a woyi fi wo mmadwoa biako mu. Ɛsisi wɔ wo kyima mmerɛ no mfimfini; sɛ wo kyima no kyere nna aduonu nwɔtwe (28) a, ɛnneɛ ɛbɛba wɔ ɛda a ɛtɔ so dunan (14) no mu. Ba-fua (egg) no fa kwan a ɛkɔ awo-ba (fallopian tube) no mu, ɛhɔ na ɛne barima aba (sperm) bɛtumi ahyia ayɛ ba bɛyɛ dɔnhwere dunan-nan kɔsi dɔnhwere aduonu-nan (12-24) mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo anaa mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ di wɔ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi aboa m’awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ne mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow mu: Afotufo a wɔfata: Wɔtaa bɛn wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no mfe a wɔadi, na ɛma wɔyɛ nnipa a wobetumi de awo akwahosan ho nsɛm adi nkitaho yiye na wɔadi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo de nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI ano a wosiw, ne nkitahodie pa ho ma wɔ atipɛnfo, a ebetumi ate nka sɛ ɛyɛ ahotɔ kɛse na ɛnyɛ hu kɛse mma mmabun. Nhwɛsofo: Wɔyɛ nhwɛso pa, wɔhyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran na wɔma mmabun tumi ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwahosan ho. Nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo kamfo wɔn atipɛnfo awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow kyerɛ, na wɔma nkurɔfo hu nsɛm a ɛka mmabun na wɔhyɛ nneɛma ne nnwuma a wobenya ho nkuran. Ahintasɛm mu mmoa: Ebia mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn kɛse sɛ wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo besusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho, a wonim sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm so na wɔde mmoa a ɛnyɛ atemmu bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne "warning signs" a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia nnuru a wɔde di dwuma reka m’adwene anaa obi a minim no adwenem ahokwasan "mental health"?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia nnuru a wɔde di dwuma reka adwenem ahokwasan no bi ne: Nsakrae a ɛba adwene anaa nneyɛe mu, te sɛ abufuw a ɛkɔ soro, basabasayɛ, anaa adwene a ɛsakra. Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi asetra mu dwumadi ahorow ho anaa nsakrae a ɛba atipɛnfo kuw mu. Adesua anaa adwuma mu mmɔdenbɔ a ɛso tew. Nipadua mu sɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ aniwa a mogya ayɛ no, wosow, anaa nsakrae a ɛba aduan ho akɔnnɔ anaa nna mu. Nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ho kokoamsɛm anaa ahobammɔ a ɛkɔ soro. Nsakrae a ɛba ahotew anaa sɛnea obi te mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm ho adwene te sɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sika a wɔde sie, sika a wɔde hyɛ mu, ne ɛka a wɔde di dwuma ho ntease titiriw?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm ho adwene ho ntease titiriw denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneyɛe so. Wobetumi afi ase denam sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wobesua so, a nea ɛka ho ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de akyekyɛ sika a wobenya de ayɛ ɛka ahorow, sika a wɔde sie, ne botae ahorow. Sɛ wɔte hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkora sika so daa, adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mfɛntom a wɔaka abom, ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔde wɔn sika hyɛ mu ntɛm no ase a, ebetumi aboa wɔn ma wɔanya ahonyade bere tenten. Ɛka ɛka ho nhyehyɛe ho adesua hwehwɛ sɛ wɔte ɛka ahorow, mfɛntom, akwan a wobetumi afa so atua, ne nea efi boseabɔ mu ba no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama atipɛnfo nkitahodi a ɛboa a ɛhyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ: Fa mmeae a atipɛnfo te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho nkɔmmɔ a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wobedi wɔn ho fɛw. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne obu a wɔde ma adwene ne osuahu ahorow ho nkuran. Fa nhwɛso di anim: Yɛ suban pa ne suban pa ho nhwɛso wɔ wo ne w’atipɛnfo nkitahodi mu, da obu, tema, ne nea ɛka obiara ho adi. Wo nneyɛe betumi akanyan afoforo ma wɔasuasua nneyɛe a ɛte saa ara na aboa ma atipɛnfo nkitahodi a ɛboa wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa abɛɛfo ntentan mmeae ahorow akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a ɛka obiara ho na ɛnyɛ atɛn wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ahiade ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmaabun betumi akɔ abɛɛfo ntentan mmeae ahorow akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a ɛka obiara ho na ɛnyɛ atemmu ma wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ahiade denam: Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ intanɛt so mpɔtam a agye din anaa nhyiam ahorow a ɛde nnipa nyinaa ka ho ne obu di kan. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde kokoamu mmoa ne nneɛma ma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. nhwenhweɛ nnyiyimu anaa nsɛmfua ɛho hia a wode bedi dwuma de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛda nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow adi. Sɛ wobɛma w’adwene akɔ intanɛt so ahobammɔ ne ahye so bere a worekyɛ w’ankasa osuahu anaa worehwehwɛ afotu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi asusuw mfitiase mmra anaa akwankyerɛ biara a ɛfa yɛn check-ins ho, te sɛ kokoamsɛm, atie a yɛde nsiyɛ, ne obu a yɛde bɛma yɛn ho yɛn ho ho, na ama yɛahwɛ ahu sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛsow aba na ntease wom?
answer_twi_source: Munsusuw mmra anaa akwankyerɛ atitiriw a ɛfa yɛn "check-ins" ho, te sɛ kokoamsɛm, atie a yɛde nsiyɛ, ne obu a yɛbɛma yɛn ho yɛn ho no ho nkɔmmɔ na mopene so. Hwɛ sɛ afã mmienu no nyinaa benya hokwan ada wɔn adwene ne wɔn nkate adi a wɔrentwitware mu, na hyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm so wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia a wɔkyɛ wɔ yɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ mu no ho. Fa tema ne ntease di kan, na kwati kasa a wobɛbɔ sobo anaasɛ wobɛhyɛ aniwu, na hwɛ hu sɛ yɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no sow aba na ntease wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna mu yareɛ 'STIs' bɛn na wɔsɔ ho hwɛ mpɛn pii, na edie  nhwehwɛmu pɔtee bɛn na ɛwɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Yɛhwehwe ɛfa: Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, Syphilis, HIV, Hepatitis B/C. Nsɔhweɛ: dwonsɔ, Mogya, Swabs, Nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asusu mfasoɔ ahorow a ɛwɔ nhyɛso pa a m’atipɛnfo de ma, te sɛ asetena mu mmoa, ne adamfofa su, ne hia a ehia sɛ mekɔ so kura ahofadi, ankorankoro, ne gyinaesi ahorow metumi atu a ɛka me nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu no ?
answer_twi_source: Mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ nhyɛso pa a efi atipɛnfo hɔ ne hia a ehia sɛ wokura ahofadi mu no sɛ: Hu wo faahodie berɛ wosi gyinaeɛ mu, wɔ atipɛnfo kuo a wɔboa mu mpo mu, na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ nea wobɛpaw no ne wo gyinapɛn ne wo yiedi hyia. Adwene ahodoɔ a wobɛhwehwɛ: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a wobɛka afiri w’atipɛnfoɔ a wɔwɔ adwene ne osuahu ahodoɔ hɔ, berɛ a awieeɛ koraa no wosi gyinaeɛ a ɛda w’ankasa gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a ɛhia paa adi. Nkitahodei a emu da h: Nkitahodi a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware a wo ne w’atipɛnfo bɛkɔ so akura w’ahiade, nea wopɛ, ne w’ahyeɛ ahorow ho, na ama woanya ntease ne obu ama wo ho wo ho wɔ abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu ne nyiyimu ka mmabun a wonya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne nyiyimu: Fa akwanside ahorow ba wɔ nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu esiane suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛpow wɔn nti. To nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu na ɛkɔ akyiri a wobenya wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ ano hye. Kan mmabun ma wɔde wɔn ho to nneɛma a wontumi mfa ho nto so anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ so, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya apomoden ho nneɛma bɔne. Yi akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no mfi nsɛm ne mmoa nnwuma a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wobenya no mu, na ama nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu aba mu no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛeɛ bɛtumi de adi dwuma de ahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔama asuafoɔ nyinaa tumi?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow betumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran denam: Adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔde bɛka abom ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu na ɛhyɛ nnipa nyinaa ka ho. Nhyehyeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma asuafo nyinaa anya hokwan ne ayaresa a ɛyɛ pɛ, a ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa mfa ho a wɔde bedi dwuma. Nteteeɛ a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho ne animhwɛ ne nyiyim a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma. Nneɛma a ɛboa a wɔbɛbɔ a ɛhyɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ ho afahyɛ na ɛma asuafoɔ tumi ma wɔkasa tia mmarima ne mmaa gyinapɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa a wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛ wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmea, abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne dɛmdi, nya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn wɔ ASRH ho no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne sebi dɛmdi betumi ama nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne animtiaabu a ɛfa ASRH ho no ayɛ kɛse. Mmabun a wɔka akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua ho no taa hyia akwanside ahorow pii wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfata, ne mmoa adwuma a wobenya mu, na esi hia a ehia sɛ wɔfa akwan horow a wɔfa so di wɔn ahiade ahorow ho dwuma no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛfa abɛɛfo mfiridwuma a wɔde di dwuma ho ma wɔn a wɔresi sɔ mbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Kokoamu Nsɛm Ho Mmara: Te kokoam nsɛm ho mmara ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛfa ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so ho ase. hwe nea  yɛfre no 'copyright' Bu mmara a ɛfa copyright ho denam afoforo adwuma a woremfa nni dwuma a wunnyaa kwan no so. Intanɛt so asisifo ho Mmara: Hu mmara kwan so nea efi kɔmputa so ayayade anaa ɔhaw mu ba. Intanɛt so Ahobammɔ: Di ahobammɔ ho akwankyerɛ akyi na abɔ wo ho ne afoforo ho ban afi Intanɛt so ahunahuna ho. Abrabɔ Pa a Wɔbɛkyɛ: Susuw nea ebefi ankorankoro ho nsɛm anaa mfonini ahorow a wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so mu aba no ho. Digitals Footprint: Hu sɛ wo intanɛt so dwumadi ahorow no gyaw digital footprint a ebetumi aka wo daakye. Afoforo Hokwan a Wobebu: Kwati sɛ wobɛkyɛ kokoam nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa mfonini ahorow a wompene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya kokoam adwenemyare ho mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun? (ahomatorɔfo, ayaresa ho animdefo,  abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma)
answer_twi_source: YMK app ""filla"" ɔfa kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bi wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm ho nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK ɔfotufoɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517""
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwannya ahorow bɛn na wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu wɔ wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi no ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde bɛbɔ mmarahyɛ baguafo ne ayaresa ne mmara mu mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu no wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔbɔ nsɛmmɔnedi no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ mmarahyɛ baguafo na wɔhwehwɛ ayaresa ne mmara kwan so mmoa. Wobetumi apaw sɛ wɔde mmarahyɛ baguafo bɛka ho anaasɛ wɔremfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu na wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie na wɔboa wɔn wɔ nhyehyɛe no nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na metumi de adi dwuma de abua abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ɔhaw anaa nsɛm a enni obu ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛho akokwaw so? (wɔabu wɔn ani gu nneɛma bɔne so, siw wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kwan)
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bɔne a wobu ani gu so: Mfa wo ho nhyɛ nneɛma bɔne mu. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a mmuae a eye sen biara ne mmuae biara. Siw Wɔn a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Siw wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wɔrehaw wo no kwan na amma wɔasiw wɔn kwan sɛ wɔne wo nni nkitaho bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsabuo betumi aha me nipadua mu ahoɔden ne sɛnea me ho yɛ den?
answer_twi_source: Wɔberɛ a worebu wo nsa no, wo nipadua no resakra ntɛmntɛm. Saa nsakraeɛ yi betumi aha wo nipadua mu ahoden wɔ akwan hodoɔ pii so: Nyini a Ɛma Wo Ho Nkɔso: Onyin ntɛntɛm betumi aha sɛdea wo nipadua no di dwuma wɔ berɛ a nsakraeɛ a ɛba wo tenten mu no. Honam mu a ɛreyɛ kɛse: Nkwammoa mu nsakraeɛ betumi ama honam ayɛ kɛse, na ebetumi ama ahoɔden ne boasetɔ atu mpɔn. Ahoɔden: Akwammoa mu nsakraeɛ betumi nso ama wayɛ mmerɛ anaa sɛ wani bɛha wɔ apɔmtenetene ho. Ɛho hia sɛ wutie wo nipadua na wohome berɛ a ɛho hia. Nsakrae: Sɛ wotene wo ho na  sɛ wotentene wapɔm a ebetumi aboa wɔ berɛ a worebu wonsa a ɛyɛ ma honam akwaa nkayɛ no nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene, obu, ne nidi di wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu abrabɔ pa ho mfoni ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusuw ho sɛ ebia wodi nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi so anaa?
answer_twi_source: Mpene, obu, ne nidi yɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛho hia wɔ abrabɔ pa ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfoni ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no mu. Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ ebia wodi nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi akyi denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu sɛ ebia ankorankoro a wɔyɛ wɔn ho mfoni wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no wɔ ahofadi ne ahofadi wɔ wɔn nipadua ne nea wɔpaw so, sɛ ebia wobu wɔn nipasu na wɔde gyina hɔ ma pɛpɛɛpɛ, ne sɛ ebia wɔde nkate ne tema na ɛyɛ wɔn suahu ahorow ho mfoni anaa. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔde hwɛ sɛnea wɔpene so, obu, ne nidi so no, mmabun betumi ate abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow ase yiye na wɔakasa atia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sɛ meyɛ den tie obi a ebɛma  matumi ate afoforo adwene ase na madi wɔn nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene anaa osuahu ahorow ho dwuma wɔ tema mu?
answer_twi_source: Atie yiye  ma  wotumi te afoforo adwene ase na wode tema bua wɔn haw anaa osuahu ahorow no yɛ kɛse. Fa atie a wode nsiyɛ di dwuma denam w’adwene a wode besi ɔkasafo no so koraa, w’ani a wobɛma akɔ so ahwɛ no, wo ti a wobɛbɔ na wode ano akyerɛ sɛ wode wo ho ahyɛ mu, ne wɔn nkrasɛm a wobɛka no foforo anaa wobɛbɔ no mua de ada ntease adi no so. Sɛ wutie wo ho yiye na wunya tema a, wubetumi ama ahotoso, tema, ne obu ama mo ho mo ho wɔ mo abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ yɛ yi nna ne awoɔ ho honam akwaa si nkyɛn a, nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na mmabunyɛ de ba nipadua no so?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima mmabun Hormones: Testosterone: Ɛma ntini nyin, ɛma nne no mu dɔ, ne anim ne nipadua mu nhwi so. Growth 'Onyin' Hormones: Ɛma nipadua ne fa bia nyin, a nnompe ne ntini ka ho. Androgens: Ɛde nsakraeɛ ba honam ani, te sɛ mpɔmpɔ ketewa asi wɔ nipa anim a broni frɛ no 'acne'. Mmea Mmabun Hormone: Estrogen: Ɛkanyan nufoɔ nyin, ɛhwɛ brayɛ so, ɛma nnompe no yɛ den. Progesterone: Ɛsiesie awotoa no ma nyinsɛn, ɛhwɛ awotoa no mu. Nkwammoaa a Ɛma Onyin: Ɛboa nso ma honam akwaa bia nyin. Beyond Reproductive System: Growth Spurt: Nipadua no yɛ tenten na ɛmu so yɛ dru ntɛm. Nsakrae a ɛba Nipadua mu: Ntini (mmarima) ne srade a ɛdɔr wɔ  mmaa mu kɔ soro. Honam ani Nsakrae: Ngo a ɛba no kɔ soro, akisikuru. Adwene mu Nsakrae: Nkwammoaa a ɛdanedane no betumi aka atenka ne nneyɛe.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wɔwɔ HIV a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya HIV ayaresa, na hokwan bɛn na wɔwɔ wɔ ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a ɛfata ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wɔwɔ HIV no wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe, a nea ɛka ho ne nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa (ART), afotu, ne mmoa adwuma. Wobetumi afa apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow, HIV ayaresabea ahorow titiriw, anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ so anya saa nnwuma yi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Metumi abisa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔne me amammerɛ yɛ pɛ anaasɛ ɔwɔ osuahu a ɔne mmabun a wofi m’amammerɛ mpɔtam hɔ yɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Aane, wubetumi abisa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔne wo amammerɛ yɛ pɛ anaasɛ ɔwɔ osuahu a ɛne mmabun a wofi w’amammerɛ mpɔtam hɔ yɛ adwuma. Bere a ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na wɔahyɛ ho bɔ no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow taa bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobedi abisade a ɛtete saa ho dwuma bere biara a ɛbɛyɛ yiye na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛne amammerɛ hyia na wɔama ayarefo ne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nkitahodi ayɛ yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia ahoɔfɛ ho gyinapɛn ahorow a enni mu?
answer_twi_source: Kasa (wo ne nnamfo/abusua kasa). Yɛ w’ankasa nhwɛsofo (gye ahoɔfɛ soronko tom). Gye wo ho tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ mmabun te wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ase?
answer_twi_source: Nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a wɔte ase no ma mmabun tumi: Si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nipadua, nna, ne abusuabɔ ho. Kamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a ɛho hia a wobenya. Bɔ wɔn ho ban fi nhyɛso, nyiyim, asisifo ne basabasayɛ ho. Nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wunsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn na wɔabɔ wɔn animtiaa. Si wɔn ahofadi ne nipadua mu nokwaredi so dua wɔ nna ne awo ho nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na bra pa (ethics) ne mmara di nsra wɔ SRH mu ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Consent: Mmara hwehwɛ sɛ wopene so ansa. Confidentiality: Mmara bɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Age of Consent: Mfeɛ a mmara ma kwan ma nna. Reproductive Rights: Mmara kyerɛ kwan a yɛfa so nya awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ. Dɛmdifoɔ: Mmara bɔ wɔn ahofadi ne kwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔsisi gyinaeɛ ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ankorankora ahotew pa ma m’akyi akwaa ne m’akwahosan nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankora ahotew kyerɛ nneyɛe a ankorankoro di akyi de kura ahotew mu na wɔhyɛ akwahosan pa ho nkuran. Saa nneyɛe yi boa ma wosiw yare ne ɔyare mmoawa a ɛtrɛw ano na ɛboa ma wodi yiyedi nyinaa na wogye tom wɔ asetra mu. Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛfa ankorankoro ahotew ho ne: Guare daa: Hwɛ w’akyi akwaa so, nanso kwati samina a ano yɛ den. Hohoro wo nsa ansa na wode wo nsa aka w’akyi akwaa ne bere a woaka awie no. Hyɛ ntade a ɛho tew na ɛma ahome na sesa da biara da. Mmea: Popa fi anim kosi akyi bere a woakɔ tiafi awie no na amma yare mmoawa ankɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ahorow ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ, fa kokoamyɛ ho sɛ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nhomasua nhyehyeɛ betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho denam: Nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho a wɔde bɛka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu ho Nsɛm a ɛfa mmra ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ho a ɛfa ayarefoɔ kokoamsɛm ho a wɔde bɛma Nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ne nea wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bedi wɔn ahofadi so na wɔama wɔn nsɛm a wohia na ama wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bɛkyerɛ obu ama wɔn ahofadi na wɔde nsɛm a wohia ama wɔn denam: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so a wɔde nimdeɛ agye atom na wɔabisa nsɛm afa wɔn akwahosan ho akwan horow ho. Adwene a ɛto so abien a wɔbɛhwehwɛ anaasɛ wɔne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma afoforo a wobesusuw ho sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔrenni wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma a. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata mmabun a ɛde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa ayarefoɔ ho ne obuo a wɔde ma ahofadie di kan a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ di wɔ nkitahodie a obu wom a ɛde nkɔso ba mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔne afoforo nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Pɛyɛ a ɛwɔ bɔbeasu mu ne nkitahodie mapa nyinaa fapem woberɛ a ɛkotia anaa ɛkasa tia atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne tumi mu nkyekyɛmu mu a ɛde  nyiyim ba. Mmabun betumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran wɔ wɔne afoforo nkitahodi mu denam nsusuwii hunu a wɔbɛkasa atia, obu a wɔde ma mmarima ne mmea nipasu ne nsɛm a wɔda no adi ahorow, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, ne mmarima ne mmea ho adwene ne nneyɛe a wɔbɛko atia no so. Ɛnam mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran so no, mmabun aboa ma wɔyɛ ɔman a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wobu wɔn kɛse a wobu ankorankoro nyinaa sɛ wɔsom bo na wɔde nidi ne obu di wɔn ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo amammerɛ mu nsakrae ne asetena mu atɛntrenee akyerɛ de akasa atia gyinapɛn ne nneyɛe a epira a ɛma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ daa na ɛboa ma nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ba?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo amammerɛ mu nsakrae ne asetena mu atɛntrenee de akasa atia gyinapɛn ne nneyɛe a epira a ɛma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kɔ so na ɛboa ma nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ba denam: Nhyehyɛe ne ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim de ma nkurɔfo hu nkɛntɛnso a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so, atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano ma wɔadi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow ho dwuma na wɔakamfo nsakrae. Social media platforms ne digital advocacy nnwinnade a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahyɛ nne ne asɛm ahorow a wɔka no mu den, ankorankoro nsɛm, osuahu, ne adwene a wɔde bɛkyɛ de akasa atia nsusuwii hunu na wɔhyɛ ntease ho nkuran. Awo ntoatoaso ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de asusuw amammerɛ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nna ntam nkitahodie ho, a wɔbɛhyɛ tema, tema, ne biakoyɛ wɔ mmusua ne nipasu ahorow mu. Yɛne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a ɛwɔ fam, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkitahodi ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ, nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu. Ɔmanfoɔ kyɛfa ne amammuisɛm mu dwumadie a wɔde bɛma ahyehyɛdeɛ ne wɔn a wɔsi gyinaeɛ no abu akontaa wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma ne nnipa hokwan ahodoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, a nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri a obiara bɛnya ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mete nka sɛ me fotufo anaa ɔyaresafo mmoa me anaasɛ ɔmfata me yiye a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo fotufo anaa oduruyɛfo no mmoa wo anaasɛ ɔmfata wo yiye a, ɛho hia sɛ wuda no adi ntɛm ara so. Wubetumi afi ase denam wo nkate horow a wo ne nea ɔde ma wo no bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ na woama wɔn nsɛm a ɛfa nea ɛnyɛ adwuma mma wo ho. Ebia wobetumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so sa yare no mu anaasɛ wɔde wo bɛkɔ oduruyɛfo foforo a ebia ɔfata yiye nkyɛn. Sɛ woda so ara te nka sɛ wunnya abotɔyam bere a woadi wo haw ahorow ho dwuma akyi a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo foforo a odi w’ahiade ahorow ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi nkitahodi a enye mu aba wɔ adwenem ahokwasan "mental health" so, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ adwuma de ama nkitahodi nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn na yɛasiw nneɛma bɔne a ebefi mu aba no ano?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛnteɛ betumi de ntease a ɛnteɛ, ntawatawa, ne atenka a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho aba, na ɛka adwenemyare wɔ ɔkwan a enye so. Ebia ɛbɛma adwennwen, dadwen, ne ɔhaw a ɛbɛma wanya abusuabɔ a ntease wom akɔ soro. Ɛdenam nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow a yɛbɛma atu mpɔn, te sɛ atie a yɛde nnamyɛ yɛ, nea obi bɛda ne ho adi pefee, ne nea yɛbɛhwehwɛ mu ama emu ada hɔ bere a ɛho hia no so no, yebetumi asiw nneɛma bɔne a efi mu ba yi ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo anaa abusuafo betumi aboa ɔbabun a wahyia ahodwiriw anaa ayayade a ɛfa nna anaa awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo anaa abusuafo betumi de mmoa ama wɔ: Tema a wobetie na wɔagye wɔn atenka atom no so. Wɔma wɔn awerɛhyem sɛ wogye wɔn di na wɔtaa wɔn akyi. Wɔn a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ mfi ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ adwenemhaw ho no hɔ. Wɔn akwannya ahorow a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ahobammɔ wɔ hɔ. Tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a wɔbɛma aba wɔ fie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asuafoɔ bɛtumi de nsɛm ne wɔn adwene ama wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho na wɔakamfo nsakraeɛ anaa nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛba wɔ sukuu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Asuafoɔ bɛtumi de wɔn adwene ama wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho na wɔakamfo nsakraeɛ anaa nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛba wɔ sukuu no mu denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ asuafoɔ aban, afotufoɔ kuo, anaa akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ne yiedie so. Nhwehwɛmu, abatow, anaa nhyiam ahorow a asuafo di anim ho nhyehyɛe de boaboa wɔn adwene ano wɔ adwenemyare ho nsɛm, ahiade, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan ho. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a asuafoɔ di so na wɔde adi dwuma. Sika, nneɛma, ne mmoa a wɔbɛma akɔ soro a wɔde bɛma adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ denam adesrɛ, ɔsatuo, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ nneyɛe a wɔbɛma ayɛ animtiaabu denam atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔsatu a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu, ne abɛɛfo ntantanfidie nkɔmmɔbɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɛntɛnso a asetena ne sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ nya wɔ mmabun awoɔ dodow, nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, ne nea efi ɛnanom akwahosan mu ba so?
answer_twi_source: Asetena ne sikasɛm mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no nya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ mmabun awoɔ dodow, nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, ne nea efi ɛnanom akwahosan mu ba no so. Ebia mmabun a wofi asetena ne sikasɛm tebea a ɛba fam mu no ntumi nnya nyinsɛn ano aduru, abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma, ne ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pii, na ɛde nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, nyinsɛn a woyi gu a ahobammɔ nnim, ne ɛnanom a wowuwu bɛdɔɔso bere a wɔde toto wɔn mfɛfo a wɔwɔ sika no ho no. Saa pɛyɛ a enni hɔ yi ma ohia kɔ so tena hɔ na esiw asetena ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa anaa nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a di boa awofoɔ a wɔyɛ mmabun anaa mmabun a wɔwɔ asiane mu ma wɔkɔ so kɔ sukuu na wɔdi nsɛnnennen a wɔhyia ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmabun ma wɔdi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma. Wo mpɔtam hɔ Asetena Mu Yiedie Dwumadibea (Department of Social Welfare) ma aban mmoa, sika a wɔde boa awofoɔ a wɔyɛ mmabun, ne sika a wɔde boa ma wɔkɔ so kɔ sukuu. Wubetumi nso ne wo sukuu mu ofotufoɔ anaa sukuu nɛɛse akasa afa adesua akwan a ɛsakra ho sɛ wowɔ abofra anaa wohyia nsɛnnennen foforo a. Wɔ mansini bi mu no, Ghana Apɔmuden Dwumadibea (Ghana Health Service) yɛ  kwan pa dwumadie "Safety Net Program" a ɛboa mmaamma a wɔawoɔ ma wɔsan kɔ sukuu anaa nsa-ano-adwuma nteteeɛ a egyina deɛ wɔpɛ so. Sɛ wopɛ nsɛm pii a, kɔ apɔmuden asoɛeɛ a ɛbɛn wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛe anaa atetesɛm pɔtee bi a ɛfa mmabunbere, brayɛ, ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma foforo ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa saa osuahu ahorow yi so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛhyɛ wɔn amammerɛ agyapade anuonyam so bere a wɔhyɛ wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi nso ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛe anaa atetesɛm pɔtee bi a ɛfa amammerɛ mu a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, brayɛ, ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo ho nhwɛso bi ne: Amanne anaa amanne ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabunbere anaa brayɛ mfiase agyirae, a ebetumi ayɛ soronko kɛse wɔ amammerɛ ne mpɔtam ahorow mu. Atetesɛm mu gyidi ahorow a ɛfa brayɛ ho, te sɛ ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa ankorankoro a wɔrekɔ brayɛ ho anaa amanne pɔtee bi a ɛfa brayɛ mu ahotew ne ne di ho. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔaware, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho, a ebetumi anya mmabun suban ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso. Mmabun betumi afa saa osuahu ahorow yi so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛhyɛ wɔn amammerɛ agyapade anuonyam bere a wɔhyɛ wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi ho nkuran denam: Nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee na obu wom a wɔne abusua mufo ne mpɔtam hɔ mpanyimfo bedi nkitaho de ate nea amammerɛ mu nneyɛe ne atetesɛm ho hia ase. Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so, a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ka ho. Wɔn ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a wobesusuw ho de asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho bere a wobu amammerɛ ne nyamesom akwanhwɛ ahorow no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mefa so agyina tipenfo nhyeso bone ano n'asi fahodi gyinasie?
answer_twi_source: Hu wo nneɛma esom bo. Yɛ pintinn. Hwehwɛ mmoa. Kyerɛ akwan foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhen na menya mmoa a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ adwenemhaw wɔ nna mu apɔmden mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu adɔkotafoɔ anaa afutofoɔ. PPAG mmoa kwanso (0244312151). Ghana adwumakuo a ɛhwɛ adwene mu deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔtwa no tia sɛ 'Ghana Psychology Association'. Awenemhawkuo ne kase paa deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔtwa no tia sɛ 'Mental Health Authority' (0800678678). Mpɔtam ayaresabea ahodoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu dwumadi ne nsɛm a wɔka de hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran mu de ahyɛ nsusuaso bɔne a nna mu ɔbrasɛe de ba no ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran na wɔahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo a asɛyɛde wom kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu dwumadi ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi denam nkɛntɛnso bɔne a nna mu ɔbrasɛe de ba no a wɔbɛma wɔahu denam sohyial media so ɔsatu ahorow, adesrɛ ahorow, ne ɔsɔretia a wɔahyehyɛ so. Wobetumi ne ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔwɔ adwene koro ayɛ biako de ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo a wɔwɔ asɛyɛde kɛse denam nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ nea wɔbara a broni ka no 'boycotts', nkrataakyerɛw ɔsatu, ne nhomasua nhyiam ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuii hunu a wɔtaa nya wɔ adwenemyare ho a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm yɛ mmerɛwyɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne. Nokwasɛm: Adwene mu akwahosan ho haw nyɛ mmerɛwyɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne na mmom ɛyɛ aduruyɛ mu tebea horow a ebetumi aka obiara. Adwene a ɛnteɛ: Nnipa a wɔwɔ adwenemyareɛ no yɛ asiane. Nokwasɛm: Nnipa dodow no ara a wɔwɔ adwenemyare no nyɛ basabasa na ɛda adi sɛ wɔtaa yɛ wɔn basabasa. Adwene a ɛnteɛ: Adwene mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow yɛ ade fã bi kɛkɛ na ɛno ankasa bɛkɔ. Nokwasɛm: Ebia adwenemyare ho nsɛm behia ayaresa ne mmoa, te sɛ nipadua mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow no ara pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ yɛfa mpamu agodie, nyinsɛn ne abawoɔ mu apomuden ne ayaresa a, nneɛma bɛn saa na adɔktafoɔ gyina so de gye sika, na deɛn na yɛbɛtumi ayɛ ma ɛka no aba fam?
answer_twi_source: Sika a ɔmo gyeɛ no gyina nneɛma bi te sɛ  : Adwumayɛfoɔ, nneɛma ɔmo de di dwuma, ne nnuro so. Sɛdeɛ yɛbɛte so: Mmoa (Subsidies) - aban mmoa. Task Shifting - sɛ wɔbɛma afoforo nso nyɛ adwuma no bi. Bulk Purchasing -  sɛ wɔbɛtɔ nnuro pii sen sɛ wobɛtɔ no nkonkorɔ. Prevention - sɛ yɛbɛnam adesua ne nkerɛkyerɛ so besiw ano kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛtaa ba a ɛkyerɛ animtiaabu ne nyiyimu a mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan hyia no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔtaa yɛ ne atemmuo su a ɛfiri akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ hɔ, nnwuma a wɔpow a egyina wɔn ankasa gyidie so, ne kokoamsɛm a wɔbu so. Nea ɛka animtiaabu ne nyiyim a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow bedi dwuma ama akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, wɔhyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo atease de akasa atia nsusuwii hunu, na wɔde akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so abɔ nyiyim ho amanneɛ na wɔadi ho dwuma sisi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmra nhyehyɛe anaa akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛma ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow abu akontaa sɛ wɔabu mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Mmra nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so bu akontaa no bi ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ hokwan ahorow a wɔabu so ho amanneɛ, te sɛ nnipa hokwan ahorow ho bagua ahorow, ɔmanfo a wɔhwɛ wɔn so adwumayɛbea ahorow, atemmu nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan ahorow ho ahyehyɛde ahorow. Saa akwan yi botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow abu akontaa sɛ wɔabu mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so asiw akwanside a 3wɔ nna mu ns3m ho adesua bi te s3 ohia ne ɔkwan a wɔde b3kɔ akurase no?
answer_twi_source: Ko tia ohia. Ahomatrofo so ayaresa 'Mobile clinics'. Lɔɔre sika (vouchers). Sika mmoa. Nkabom a yɛne dwumadibea foforo bɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛ mmaabun kwan wɔ sɛnea wobetumi anya adwune mu ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ wɔn ahiade pɔtee mu ne nea wɔbɛhwɛ kwan wɔ ayaresa bere mu no ho.
answer_twi_source: Bisa wo duruyɛfo anaa sukuu fotufo no ma ɔmma wo nyansahyɛ ahorow. Hwehwɛ ayaresa ho animdefo a wɔwɔ wo mpɔtamu hɔ ho nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ wɔ Intanɛt so. Hwehwɛ ayaresa ho animdefo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun adwene mu apomoden yareɛ anaa nna mu apomoden ho sɛ ɛho hia a. ALTERNATIVELY " Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo kasa kyerɛ apomoden ho dwumayɛni bi wɔ adwene mu apomoden yareɛ ho nsɛm ho nya mmoa fi GHS-YMK ɔfotufo bi hɔ frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (toll free) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517".
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun ne wɔn awofo adwene anaa afotu a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho nhyia a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Fa Obu Kyerɛ: Mmabun betumi ada wɔn adwene adi wɔ obu mu na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ wɔn adwene mu. Hwehwɛ Ntamgyinafo: Sɛ adwene a enhyia kɔ so a, ntamgyinafo a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔfotufo, betumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw. Hwehwɛ Nneɛma a Wotumi De Ho To So: Mmabun betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ wɔn ankasa mu de aboaboa nsɛm pii ano de afoa wɔn adwene so. Susuw Nsiesiei Ho: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, sɛ wubenya mfinimfini kwan a afa abien no nyinaa betumi apene so a, mfaso wɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi ahwɛ wɔn ho so yiye (self-care) de ahyɛ wɔn apɔwmuden den?
answer_twi_source: Hu deɛ ɛha wo (identify Triggers). Yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛma adwene gye ahome (Relaxation). Wo ho so hwɛ pa (Self-Care): Da yie, di aduane pa. Hyehyɛ wo hye (Boundaries): Te social media so. Hwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma a yɛde fa nnipa tu kwan pɔtee ma mmabun a ebia wɔbɛhia sɛ wɔkɔ hwehwɛ mmoa ntɛm wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nneɛma mu no wɔ hɔ anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Ambulance dwumadie. ahomatrofo  dwumadie a ɛde mmoa/kar kwan boa. Sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ no gyina baabi a wogye toom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asusuw ahotoso a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no ho denam ɔkyerɛwfo no adansedi nkrataa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, da a wotintimii no mu nhwehwɛmu, nsɛm a wɔatwe adwene asi so no a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛtoto mmeae a agye din te sɛ aduruyɛ nnwumakuo ahorow anaa nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama nyinsen yi guo a wowo hokwan a wonhyia nyiyimu biara?
answer_twi_source: Dɔm kasama 'campaign' ahorow. Kasa kyerɛ mpanyimfoɔ a y'ato wonso aba. Dɔm mmabun kuo. Ka wo suahunu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mete nka sɛ mabrɛ mmerɛ nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbrɛ a wote wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu no nnyɛ adi bɔne, na ɛnam nneɛma pii so na ɛba. Honam mu nkwammoa a aborɔfo frɛ no 'hormones' mu nsakraeɛ tumi sesa wo nna tebea. Mmerɛ a wonyin no na nipadua ne ndwuma so ɛɛkɔ soro. Wei so tumi ha w'ahoɔden. Sɛ nti taa gye w'ahome, didi yiye na yɛ adwuma a ɛbɛhyɛ nipadua no den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyehyɛeɛ anaa dwumadie bi wɔ ma akwantu mu haw a mmabun hyia  wo mmere a wɔrehwehwɛ apɔmuden mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie wɔ hɔ a ɛdi ɛhyɛn a wɔbɛnya ho haw a mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ apɔmuden mmoa hyia ho dwuma, a ebi ne: ɛhyɛn mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a mpɔtam hɔ aban, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnhwehwɛ mfasoɔ, anaa apɔmuden mmeae ma a wɔde fa nkurɔfoɔ anaa wɔtua ɛhyɛn ka ma apɔmuden nhyiam. Nkabom a ɛda apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ne ɛhyɛn adwumakuo ntam de ma ɛhyɛn a mmabun bɛnya tu mpɔn. Sukuu ɛhyɛn mmoa anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde fa asukuufoɔ kɔ apɔmuden nhyiam. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so apɔmuden mmoa (Nhyehyɛeɛ a yɛ frɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Telehealth) a ɛma mmabun kwan ma wɔnya apɔmuden mmoa wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so, a ɛtew ɛhyɛn a wɔbɛfa akɔ apɔmuden mmeae so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de atetesɛm mu ayaresa, mpɔtam hɔ mpanyimfo, ne amammerɛ mu apon ano ahwɛfo afoforo adi nkitaho de ahyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease, ahotoso, ne biakoyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun yiyedi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso mu?
answer_twi_source: ASRH nhyehyeɛ no bɛtumi ne atetesɛm mu ayaresa, mpɔtam hɔ mpaninfoɔ, ne amammerɛ apon ano ahwɛfoɔ foforɔ adi nkitaho de ahyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho nteaseɛ, ahotosoɔ, ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔde bɛhyɛ mmabun yiedie ho nkuran denam: Nkitahodi a wɔbɛkyekyere: Nkitahodiɛ a obuo wom a wɔne amammerɛ apon ano ahwɛfoɔ bɛhyehyɛ no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi nkɔmmɔdie a ɛda adi pefee, obuo a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne wɔn nimdeɛ ne wɔn nkɛntɛnsoɔ a wɔbɛgye atom wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Amammerɛ mu atenka ho nteteeɛ: Amammerɛ mu nkateɛ ho nteteeɛ a wɔde ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ no mu adwumayɛfoɔ boa ma nkitahodi a ɛtu mpɔn ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔne atetesɛm mu ayaresa ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ yɛ no yɛ mmerɛ. Amammerɛ mu nneyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛka ho: Nneyɛeɛ ne gyidie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔde bɛka ASRH dwumadie ho no kyerɛ obuo ma mpɔtam hɔ atetesɛm na ɛma nhyehyɛeɛ no gye tom na ɛtu mpɔn. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ wurayɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Amammerɛ apon ano ahwɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu mu no ma mpɔtam hɔfoɔ wurayɛ ne ASRH nnwuma a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa no nya nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama me hokafo  de ne ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho na mahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn baanu nyinaa de yɛn nna mu akwaa apɔmuden  yiyedi bedi kan?
answer_twi_source: Wo hokafo a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho no hwehwɛ sɛ wo ne wɔn ho di nkitaho pefee na wosi wɔn ho wɔn ho gyinae: Fi Nkɔmmɔbɔ ase: Fi ase ne wo hokafo bɔ nkɔmmɔ fa nna mu akwahosan, akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, ne asɛyɛde ahorow a wɔkyɛ wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho. Tie na Gye Mu: Tie wo hokafo haw ahorow, nea ɔpɛ, ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho, na si wɔn nkate ne wɔn adwene mu den. Munsusuw Botae Ahorow a Woakyɛ Ho: Munsusuw botae ahorow a mobom yɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi ho ho, na si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wubenya obu, ahotoso, ne biakoyɛ wɔ gyinaesi a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano ho so dua.
