Bom Hwehwɛ Nneɛma a Wobetumi Apaw: Bom hwehwɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano mu, susuw nneɛma te sɛ nea etu mpɔn, nea efi mu ba, ne sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma no ho, na mobom si gyinae a egyina nea wɔpɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan a wɔkyɛ so. Mmoa Wɔn Ho Wɔn Ho: Mmoa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma daa ne nea ɛteɛ mu, bom nsusuw haw anaa dadwen biara ho na wodi ho dwuma sɛ kuw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnnennen 'complications' anaa asiane ahorow a ɛtaa ba wɔ mmabun nyinsɛn mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahwɛ so na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen anaa esiane a ɛtaa ba wɔ mmabun nyinsɛn mu ne awo a ɛba ntɛm, awo mu duru a ɛba fam, mogya mmoroso (preeclampsia), mogya a ɛtɔ kɔ nipadua mu, ne awo mu nsɛnnennen. Wobetumi ahwɛ asiane ahorow yi denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa ansa na wɔawo, ultrasound, ne mogya mu nhwehwɛmu so. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne mmabun bɛyɛ adwuma de adi asiane ahorow yi ho dwuma, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne asetra mu nsakrae, aduan a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne ɛtɔ mmere bi a nnuru. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun kɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo nyinaa na wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho kuw no adi nkitaho pefee na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho 'Abstinence' no siw nyinsɛn ano, na dɛn nti na ɛmmɔ wɔn ho ban mfi STI ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ obi twe ne ho fi ho a, esiw nyinsɛn ne STI ano koraa. Sɛ wo ne obi da a, fa kɔndɔm di dwuma na yɛ nhwehwɛmu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie bere a wɔrenya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho hwɛ no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ nneɛma pii de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkora wɔn kokoamsɛm so berɛ a wɔrenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ayaresabea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde kokoamsɛm di kan a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobebisa wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma ansa na wɔada wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm adi. Hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ho a wɔbɛte ase wɔ mmara ase na wɔakamfo saa hokwan ahorow yi berɛ a ɛho hia no. Hwehwɛ akwan a wobetumi afa so adi nkitaho a ɛyɛ kokoam, te sɛ telefon so akwahosan anaa nkrasɛm nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom. Nim a wubehu sɛnea wobɛkɔ nnwuma ahorow a wɔmmɔ wo din, sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a, de abɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo ntam nyonkofa papa  di wɔ obu a mewɔ ma me ho ne ahotoso a menya wɔ gyinaesi a ntease wom wɔ me nna mu akwaa apɔmuden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Gye a wogye tom ne nea wogye tom: Atipɛnfo ntam nkitahodie pa ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wogye wɔn tom, na ɛno betumi ama obu ama wɔn ho na wɔanya ahotoso wɔ tumi a mmabun betumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwaahosan ho no mu. Mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho: Atipɛnfo a wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho de nkuranhyɛ ne nea wogye tom ma, na wɔma mmabun tumi ma wonya wɔn nkate mu ahotoso na wɔkamfo wɔn ankasa yiyedi kyerɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo akuw nya wɔn ho wɔn ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma, nea wɔpɛ, ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka 'media literacy' betumi ama mmabun tumi apaw nea ɛfata na wɔako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo akuw nya wɔn ho wɔn ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ su, nea wɔpɛ, ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso kɛse denam atipɛnfo nhyɛso, asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho a wɔbom yɛ so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun nea broni ka 'media literacy' tumi paw nneɛma a wɔde nimdeɛ paw na wɔko tia atipɛnfo nhyɛso denam: Nsusuwii a emu yɛ den a wobenya de asɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ahwɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa mu na wɔahu nneɛma a wotumi gye di fi nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ animhwɛ mu. Ankorankoro apɛde ne ahye ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ho a wɔbɛka so dua, a egyina ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a wɔn ani gye ho, ne botae ahorow so. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ gyinapɛn a ɛte saa ara na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ho denneennen mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, na dɛn na ɛka ho bio?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ahorow pii a wɔyɛ ma mmabun no bi ne: STI Nhwehwɛmu: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba te sɛ chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, ne HIV. Mpɛn pii no, eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa nsu anaa mogya, ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔde nsu a wɔde hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu. Pap Smear: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu awotwaa mu kokoram, mpɛn pii no efi ase bere a wadi mfe 21 anaasɛ sɛnea akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo kamfo kyerɛ wo no. Nea ɛka ho ne nkwammoaa a wɔboaboa ano fi awotwaa no mu. HPV Sɔhwɛ: Ɛhu human papillomavirus (HPV), STI a ɛtaa ba a ebetumi ama obi anya awotwaa mu kokoram. Wobetumi ayɛ eyi aka Pap smear ho. Pelvic Exam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hwɛ awo akwaa no mu sɛ ebia ɔyare mmoawa anaa nea ɛnteɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne biara nni hɔ anaa. Ebia nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛte awotwaa ne awotwaa no nka na wɔahwehwɛ awotwaa ne awotwaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna ne awo hokwan ahorow (SRH) a mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛfata mfeɛ a obi adi, na ɛka nna ho akɔnnɔ ahodoɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ ho. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya nyinsɛn ano aduru ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma afoforo, a nsɛm a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho ka ho. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ obenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a, ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan wɔ baabi a mmara ma ho kwan. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nnwuma de siw nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STI) ano, hwehwɛ, na wɔsa. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛnyɛ atemmu, a afotu ne sɔhwɛ ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu, boa ma nhwehwɛmu mu nsɛm a wɔahu wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu boa ma nhwehwɛmu mu nsɛm a wɔahu wɔ mmabun nna ne awo mu akwahosan (ASRH) mu no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so denam: Nhwehwɛmu akwan ne nsɛm a wɔboaboa ano ho nhyehyɛe a ɛma ahotoso ne ahotoso kɔ soro, efisɛ nhwehwɛmufo tumi de abusuabɔ si hɔ yiye, te nsɛm a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ho ase, na wonya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fi nhwehwɛmu no mufo hɔ. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no ho hia na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ nnipa dodow a wɔresua ho ade no ho a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, efisɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛfa amammerɛ ho no taa yɛ nea ɛne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no hyia na edi wɔn ahiade pɔtee ne nea wɔpɛ ho dwuma. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no nkyerɛaseɛ ne nkyekyɛmu a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ wɔ ɔkwan a nteaseɛ wom na nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no bɛtumi anya bi, a nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ka ho, a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ na wɔagye nneyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a egyina adanseɛ so. Pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu denam nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wonni gyinabea pa no nne ne osuahu ahorow a wɔde besi mfinimfini so, na wɔnam saayɛ so ahwɛ ahu sɛ nhwehwɛmu mu aba no bɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na egyina hɔ ma amammerɛ mu adwene ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda ho ɛfa awerɛhow anaa dadwen a wobɛte nka sɛ ɛwɔ mu a ne bere a wɔ afa adwene mu apomoden yareɛ ntam a wɔbɛhyia no?
answer_twi_source: Awerɛhow anaa dadwen a obi te nka bere ne bere mu no yɛ asetena mu ade a ɛfata na ebia nsɛm pɔtee bi a esisi anaa tebea horow bi na ɛkanyan no. Nanso, adwene mu apomden yareɛ a obi benya no hwehwɛ sɛ obi nya awerɛhow, dadwen, anaa nsusuanso afoforo a ɛkɔ so siw da biara da dwumadi kwan kɛse na ɛtra hɔ kyɛ. Adwene mu apomoden ho adwumayɛfo gyina gyinapɛn pɔtee bi a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ nhoma ahorow a wɔde hwehwɛ yare te sɛ DSM-5 mu so na ɛkyerɛ adwene mu apomden yareɛ, Sɛ wunnim sɛ ebia nea worehyia no yɛ nea ɛtaa ba anaasɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wowɔ adwene mu apomden yareɛ a, mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ɔpanyin anaa adwene mu apomden yareɛ adwumafo  ho ɔbenfo a wogye wo di hɔ no betumi ama emu ada hɔ na woanya akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmabun betumi adi wɔ nna mu apɔmuden pɛyɛ ne nna mu nyarewa 'STI' asiane a wɔbɛtew so, ama obiara ho nkamfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi adi dwuma titiriw: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware: Wo ne nnamfo nkasa fa nna mu apɔmuden ho na hyɛ suban a asɛdeɛ wom nkuran. Sɔre tia adwene bɔne: Kasa tia animguase ne nyiyim. Kamfo nsakraeɛ: Hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a obiara bɛnya ho kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so bere tenten sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmaabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu ma mmaabun adwumayɛ mu nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no betumi ama wɔanya mfaso pii a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ ama mmabun adwumayɛ mu nkɔso, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahokokwaw nkɔso: Ahokokwaw a wɔde yɛ adwuma ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ma mmabun nya hokwan nya nsaanodwuma, nya adwuma pɔtee ho nimdeɛ, na wɔkyekye ahokokwaw a adwumawuranom bu no sɛ ɛsom bo. Adwumayɛfo nkitahodi: Sɛ wo ne afotufo, adwuma so ahwɛfo, ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo di nkitaho a, ebetumi atrɛw mmabun adwumayɛfo nkitahodi mu, na ama wɔanya adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow, afotu, ne mmoa wɔ wɔn adwuma nyinaa mu. Adwuma mu nhwehwɛmu: Adwumayɛ mu ntetee ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ma mmabun tumi hwehwɛ nnwuma ahorow, dwumadi ahorow, ne adwuma akwan horow mu, na ɛboa wɔn ma wosisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn daakye adwuma botae ne wɔn apɛde ahorow ho. yɛbɛ hye asea bio sɛ yɛsi: Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ adwumayɛ ho ntetee anaa adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe mu a, ɛma mmabun resume yɛ yiye, na ɛda wɔn adwuma mu osuahu, wɔn ahokokwaw, ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ adi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ adwumawura no. Ahotoso ne wɔn ho a wotumi yɛ: Sɛ mmabun tumi wie adwumayɛ ho ntetee anaa adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow yiye a, ebetumi ama wɔanya ahotoso, obu ama wɔn ho, na wɔanya gyidi wɔ tumi a wotumi di yiye wɔ adwumayɛfo mu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔhaw ahorow ba nyinsɛn mu a ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ yiye? (mogya a ɛtɔ, ɛyaw a emu yɛ den) .
answer_twi_source: Hu saa kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne yi na frɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo ntɛm ara: Mogya a ɛba wɔ ɔbea no awotwaa mu: Mogya biara a ɛbɛtu wɔ nyinsɛn mu no yɛ ade a ɛhaw adwene. Yafunu mu yaw a emu yɛ den: Ɛyaw a emu yɛ den a ɛrenkɔ no betumi akyerɛ sɛ ɔhaw bi wɔ hɔ. Atiridiinini: Atiridiinini a ano yɛ den betumi apira obi wɔ nyinsɛn mu. Nhumu a ɛsakra mpofirim, tiyɛ a emu yɛ den, anaasɛ ɔfe a ɛkɔ so: Eyinom betumi akyerɛ sɛ preeclampsia, nyinsɛn mu ɔhaw a emu yɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Animtiaabu ne nyiyim bɛn na mmabun hyia a ɛfa nna ho bɔbea, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, awo a wɔpaw, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na osuahu ahorow yi nya wɔn yiyedi ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya so nsusuasoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun hyia animtiaabu ne nyiyim ahorow a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, awo a wɔpaw, ne nna mu nneyɛe ho. Saa nyiyim yi betumi ada adi sɛ ayayade, ayayade, nnipa a wɔayi wɔn afi nnipa mu, anaa basabasayɛ, wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne wɔn ahyehyɛde ahorow nyinaa mu. Saa osuahu ahorow yi betumi anya wɔn adwenemyare, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne sɛnea wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn de no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Bio nso, animtiaabu ne nyiyim betumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wobenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛka obiara ho, na ama wɔakyɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, wɔ atwe wɔn ho efiri nnwuma a ɛho hia, anaasɛ ayaresa a ɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ne mmoa akuw betumi de nneɛma ne mmoa ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a ebia wɔrehyia haw bi te sɛ afie a wonni, abusua a wɔpow wɔn, anaa ɔhaw afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ betumi ama mmoa ama mmabun a wofa afie a wonni, abusua a wɔpow wɔn, anaa ɔhaw afoforo: Nnwuma a Wɔde Kɔma: Fa mmabun bata nneɛma te sɛ dabere, adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, anaa mmara kwan so mmoa ho. Asetra mu Nimdeɛ Nhyiamu: Fa nhyiamu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ, adwuma hwehwɛ, ne ahofadie asetena ho ma. Afotu Nhyehyɛe: Fa mmabun ne mpanyimfo a wɔboa wɔn a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo ama no atoto ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wobetumi de media ho adesua aka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho de ama mmabun tumi ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho media ahorow mu yie?
answer_twi_source: Adesua ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asuafo sɛnea wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a ɛfa ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn, nipadua ahorow, ne obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho mu na wɔapaapae mu no a wɔde bɛka ho. Hokwan a wɔbɛma asuafoɔ ayɛ wɔn ankasa media mu nsɛm a ɛkasa tia ahoɔfɛ ho adwene a ɛnyɛ nokware na ɛhyɛ nipadua mu adwempa ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nneɛma a ɛfata mfeɛ ne adesua nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa nkɛntɛnsoɔ a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nya wɔ nipadua mfonini ne wɔn ho adwene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ misusuw sɛ ebia manyinsɛn a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun bi susuw sɛ ebia wanyinsɛn a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu de si wɔn adwenem naayɛ no so dua. Sɛ nea efi sɔhwɛ no mu ba no yɛ papa a, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi yɛ nhyehyɛe ntɛm ara sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye biara na wɔasusuw akwan horow a wobetumi afa so ho na wɔanya ɔhwɛ anaa mmoa a ɛfata a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na media content a ɛfa mpeneso ho betumi ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan, adwenem apɔwmuden, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ne nna mu nipasu, ne asetena mu atɛntenee ho no atwa, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wodi nsɛm a ɛka bom yi ho dwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw a ɛfa mpeneso ho no ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan, adwenem apɔwmuden, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ne nna mu nipasu, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho no di nkitaho efisɛ saa nsɛm yi wɔ abusuabɔ na ɛka wɔn ho wɔn ho. Ɛdenam pene a wɔdi ho dwuma wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛtrɛw mu so no, mmabun nya ntease a edi mũ wɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow, ahye, ne asɛde ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Media ho nimdeɛ nso ma mmerante ne mmabaa tumi hwehwɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna, nna, ne tumi mu nsesae ahorow mu yie wɔ media mu na wɔte sɛnea saa mfonini ahorow yi boa ma asetra mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne ntɛnkyea a ɛtrɛw ba no ase. Ɛdenam nsɛm a ɛka bom yi a wobedi ho dwuma ara yie so no, mmabun betumi akamfo asetena mu nsakrae na wɔahyɛ nkabom nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow boa mmabun ma wɔsakra fi nhomasua mu kɔ adwuma mu, anaasɛ wɔtoa nhomasua so?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow boa mmabun ma wɔsakra fi nhomasua mu kɔ adwuma mu anaasɛ wɔtoa nhomasua  so denam akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ adwuma a wɔhwehwɛ, adwuma hwehwɛ ho akwan horow, krataa a wɔde kyerɛw wɔn krataa a wɔde kɔ adwuma mu, ne nsɛmbisa ho nimdeɛ a wɔde ma so. Afotufoɔ de nkuranhyɛ, afotuo, ne nneɛma ma de boa wɔn a wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔn no ma wɔhunu wɔn botaeɛ, hwehwɛ wɔn anigyeɛ mu, na wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nwomasua ne adwumayɛ akwan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa obu ne nnamfofa pa ho bɛtumi aboa ama wɔasiw nna mu ayayade, mmonnaatoyɛ, ne atirimɔdensɛm kwan wɔ mmabun ntam?
answer_twi_source: Obu ne nnamfofa pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ dwumadie titiriw wɔ sɛnea wɔsiw nna mu ayayade, mmonnaatoyɛ, ne atirimɔdensɛm kwan wɔ mmabun ntam. Ɛnam nkyerɛkyerɛ yi so ma mmabun hu wɔn kyɛfa ne nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ, wɔhunu sɛ obi repɛ sɛ ɔhyɛ wɔn anaa ɔdaadaa wɔn, na ɛhyɛ wɔn den ma wɔtumi si nnyinasoɔ a ɛfata na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa berɛ a ɛhia. Ɛdenam obu ne pene ho amammerɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran so no, abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obu wom ma tebea bi a wɔmma ɔhaw, ayayade, ne basabasayɛ ho kwan kɛse na wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no te nka sɛ wɔboa wɔn ma wɔba anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden akwan a wo fa so nya nna mu anigye?
answer_twi_source: Mepa wo kyɛw, mintumi nyi anaa mmoa wo wɔ asɛmmisa yi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di adwenem apɔmden, nkitahodie, ne nna mu nkɔso a ɛfa mmabun ntam no ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodie pa boa w’adwene mu yiyedi na nea ɛne no bɔ abira.Nkitahodie a ɛnteɛ betumi de dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adwenemyare afoforo aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma mmabun tumi ma wɔkasa wɔn ho ne wɔn SOGI ahiade ahorow, berɛ a wɔsan nso ma wɔn ho a wobu ne ahotoso.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nsɛm a edi mu na ɛka obiara ho a obi nya no boa ma ɔte nka sɛ ɔwɔ ahobammɔ, fahodi, ne ne nipadua ne gyinaesi ahorow so tumi?
answer_twi_source: Awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nsɛm a edi mu a obi nya no boa ma ɔte nka sɛ ɔwɔ ahobammɔ, ahofadi, ne ne nipadua ne gyinaesi ahorow so tumi. Sɛ mmabun nya wɔn nipadua, akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne STI ano a wosiw ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a, wɔte nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔbɛpaw nneɛma a ɛfata, akamfo wɔn ahiade ahorow, na wɔde ahotoso akɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dɛmdi a wɔda no adi no betumi aboa ɔbabun a wadi dɛm ma wanya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pa wɔ Ghana?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, dɛmdi bi a wɔbɛda no adi no betumi ayɛ nkrante anofanu a wɔde nya nna mu akwahosan. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Mfaso a ɛwɔ so: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ ɔhwɛ ma ɛne w’ahiade pɔtee ahyia. Wubetumi anya nneɛma ne mmoa akuw a wɔde ma mmubuafo. Nsɛnnennen: Animtiaabu: Ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo binom nni osuahu pii anaasɛ wɔyɛ animhwɛ a wonnim. Kokoam nsɛm a ɛhaw wo: Ebia ɛbɛyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wobɛda wo ho nsɛm adi. Afotu a Wɔde Da Nsɛm Adi: Kari mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ so: Si gyinae sɛ ebia mfaso a ɛwɔ so no dɔɔso sen asiane ahorow no anaa. Fi ase fi ɔyarehwɛfo a wogye no di so: Hwehwɛ obi a ɔwɔ osuahu wɔ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ayaresa mu. Siesie wo ho sɛ wobɛkamfo wo ho: Hu hokwan ahorow a wowɔ na ka w’ahiade ahorow ho asɛm pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akuo anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde boa mmaabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu? (ahomatrofo, abwɛɛfo ntetan so dwumadibea ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: kɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa wɔ apomoden adwumayɛbea hɔ. wɔwɔ nneɛma a wobetumi de adi w’ahiade ho dwuma. Wɔbɛtumi ne mmoa akuo a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ mpɔtamu hɔ Awofoɔ a wagye atumu kuo a ɛwɔ Ghana 'Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana'(PPAG Helpline) adi nkitaho: Frɛ kokoamu wɔ 0244312151 (Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-awia 5). Ebia wɔwɔ akuo a wɔboa anaasɛ wonim nneɛma bi wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Ghana Mmabun Apam a Ɛhwɛ Awoɔ Apomoden So (GYARH): https://ghanasrhralliance.org/ T
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔfa so kasa tia nyiyim su anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛma denhyɛ so? (Tema ne ntease a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran) .
answer_twi_source: Adwemmɔne a ɛyɛ den hia ɔkwan pa: Hyɛ tema ho nkuran: Ka ankorankoro nsɛm (sɛ ɛyɛ ahotɔ a) anaa afoforo suahu ahorow na ama ntease aba. Fa W’adwene Si Nokwasɛm So: Fa nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ko tia nsɛm a, ɛnteɛ na fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo. Fa Nhwɛso Di Anim: Da obu adi na kwati (avoid) atemmu bere mpo a wo ne obi adwene nhyia no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ntetee a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban "self-defense" di wɔ tumi a wɔde ma mmabun ma wɔbɔ wɔn ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ "sexual violence" ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya nneɛma anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besua ahobanbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne akwan horow?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban no di dwuma wɔ tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi bɔ wɔn ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ ho bi ne: Ahokokwaw a Wɔde Di Dwuma a Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ "training practical skills": Nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nipadua mu akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so abɔ wɔn ho ban afi ahunahuna 'threats" a ebetumi aba ho na wɔaguan afi ho no so. Ahotoso a Wɔbɛma Anya: Ahotoso a obi wɔ wɔ ne ho ne ne ho a ɔde di dwuma yiye a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam akwan horow a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban a wɔde bedi dwuma ne ne nimdeɛ a wɔde di dwuma yiye so. Nhumu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso 'ehance awareness": Nneɛma a atwa ne ho ahyia ne asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, a ɛma wotumi di asiane ho dwuma ntɛm ne akwan horow a wɔfa so kwati. Assertiveness Instilling: Assertiveness ne ɔhye a wɔde si hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran de asiw wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ bɔne no kwan na wɔakyerɛ sɛ obi di n’ankasa baabi ne ahobammɔ so. Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besua wɔn ho banbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne akwan horow denam mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, akodi sukuu ahorow, wɔn ho banbɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow, intanɛt so nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho banbɔ ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow ma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dɛmdi ho ntease betumi aboa yɛn ma yɛadi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuanso "health outcomes" mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ho ntease boa yɛn ma yedi nsonsonoe ahorow ho dwuma efisɛ: Akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ akwahosan "health" ho: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm betumi ahyia honam fam, sikasɛm, anaa suban mu akwanside ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho. Nhumu a wonni: Ebia akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo renhu ayarefo a wɔadi dɛm ahiade pɔtee bi. Asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan: Ohia, nyiyim, ne nhomasua a wonnya betumi ama akwahosan mu nsunsuanso asɛe kɛse. Ɔkwan a Yɛbɛto Mu: Ɛdenam nsɛm yi a yɛbɛte ase so no, yebetumi ayɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ pɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nna mu apomoden ho nsɛm so wɔ abɛɛfo ntetan nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mmeae?
answer_twi_source: Mmaabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ ne nsɛm a wɔka fa nna mu apomoden ho nsɛm ho wɔ abɛɛfo ntetan nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mmeae denam adwene ahorow a wɔde nsiyɛ tie, nsɛmmisa a wobebisa de ama ntease a emu dɔ, nsɛm a egyina adanse so ne wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow a wɔde adwene bɛkyɛ, ne nsɛm a epira anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a wɔde akyinnyegye a obu wom na ntease wom a wɔde bɛkasa atia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun paa?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua a ɛfa awo nhyehyɛe akwahosan ho ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so de nsɛm ne nneɛma ma mmabun fa wɔn awo akwaa, wɔn dwumadi, ne akwahosan nyinaa ho. Ɛka nsɛmti te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, brayɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI a wosiw ano, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho asɛm. Ɛho hia kɛse ma mmabun efisɛ: Ɛma wɔn tumi ma wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Ɛboa ma wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun biara nna ne awo akwahosan ho ade. Ɛhyɛ suban ne nneyɛe pa a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran. Ɛboa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, STI, ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm afoforo ano. Ɛtew animtiaabu, aniwu, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa awo akwahosan ho so, na ɛhyɛ nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wɔhwehwɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyeɛ bi wɔ a ɛfa adan ne daberɛ ho sɛ ɛfa no mfeɛ ne ade ho ɛna mmabun wɔ ho kwan sɛ deɛ ɛdi kan wɔgyetum na biaa nso yɛ kokoamsɛm wɔ berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ daberɛ no anaa?
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ ne ahyehyɛdeɛ sesa. Pii boa mmabun a wɔwɔ mfeɛ du dekɔpem du nkono a wɔwɔ esane mu. Hokwan: Wɔpene mmoa no so sɛ ɔfata nkoaa deɛ. Wɔhwɛ boa kokoam mu nsɛn wɔberɛ ahoban ho nsɛm yɛ. Wɔka gyinaesie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nyiyimu a ɛfa adwene mu yare ho 'mental health' ho siw nkurɔfoɔ kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaa wɔbɛka wɔn nsam akyerɛ afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyimu ne animtiabu ma nkurɔfoɔ suro sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa. Atɛmmuo, nyiyimu, ne aniwuo tumi ma wɔtena anikonam mu. Ɛma mmoa a wɔbɛnya no kyɛ anaa ɛyɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahokyere afotu mmeae yɛ kɔkoam?, na so mmabun betumi anya ahotosoɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn kɔkoamunsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ den anaa ankorankoro haw ho?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkoamunsɛm: Ahokyere afotu mmeae taa yɛ kɔkoam, na mmabun betumi anya ahotosoɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn kɔkoamunsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ den anaa ankorankoro haw ho. Mmara ne susuw pa a ɛfa kɔkoamunsɛm ho hyɛ afotufoɔ sɛ wɔnhwɛ wɔn a wɔboa wɔn no kɔkoamunsɛm so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ehia sɛ m’awofoɔ pene so ansa na matumi de awoɔ ho aduro bi adi dwuma wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wɔntaa nhwehwɛ. Deɛ ɛtena hɔ kyɛ (LARCs) no, wɔbetumi ahyɛ wo nkuran sɛ fa panyin ka ho, nanso ɛnyɛ ɛhyɛ (mandatory).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow ntamu fekubɔ boa ma mmaabun nya sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow ntam no boa ma mmabun nya sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow denam nneɛma, nimdeɛ, ne nkitahodi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma de di ɔhaw a emu yɛ den ho dwuma na wɔyɛ ano aduru a ɛka obiara ho na ɛtra hɔ daa so. Wɔka ahoɔden a ɛwɔ nnwuma mmienu no nyinaa mu, a akwan a wɔfa so di gua so, asetena mu nkɛntɛnsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho akwan ka ho, de hyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetena mu nkabom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ metwɛn ma m’awofoɔ de asɛmti a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ba, anaasɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ m’ankasa mefi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ hwee koraa sɛ w’ankasa wobefi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase, titiriw sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho a. Sɛ wotwɛn ma w’awofo de asɛmti no bɛba a, ebetumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ no akyɛ, na ebia wɔrenhu sɛ wopɛ sɛ woka ho asɛm gye sɛ wodi kan da no adi. Kae sɛ ɛda adi sɛ w’awofo pɛ nea ehia ma wo na ebia wɔbɛkyerɛ ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wobefi nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛho hia ase afa w’akwahosan ne wo yiedi ho no ho anisɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ɔbrɛ 'stress' ne atenka ka adwene mu apɔwmuden 'mental health', na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn agyina ano?
answer_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ: Dadwen (Anxiety/Depression). Akwan: Home dɛɛdɛɛde tenetene wonpɔw mu, Mindfulness, Anigyeɛ, Kasa fa wo haw ho, Hwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobenya tebea a ɛboa ankorankoro a wɔn bɔbeasu ahorow ne wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ yɛ ahorow ?
answer_twi_source: Tebea a wɔboa ankorankoro ne nea nkurɔfo te nka sɛ wogye wɔn tom, wobu wɔn, na wɔsom bo wɔ onipa ko a wɔyɛ ho. Ɛyɛ beae a wɔsi obiara nipasu so dua, na wɔde nsiyɛ kasa tia nyiyimu ne adwemmɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, awofoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne stakeholders ayɛ adwuma abom de ahyɛ abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa ama mediafoɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nsɛm ne ASRH nkɔsoɔ, ayɛ apam na wɔakyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa wɔ nnwumakuo ne nteɛsoɔ ahodoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne stakeholders ayɛ biako de ahyɛ abɔde a nkwa wom nhyehyɛe a ɛboa ma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nsɛm ne ASRH nkɔso ho nkuran. Ɛdenam apam a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ nnwuma ne nteɛso ahorow mu so no, wobetumi de nsakrae a ɛtra hɔ daa aba na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ media ho nimdeɛ da so ara yɛ ade titiri wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiedi afã horow nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanya bɛn na mmabun wɔ sɛ wobetu wɔn ho ama, ayɛ adwuma, anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ akannifo dwumadi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ akuw a wɔyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan (Sexual reproductive health) ho adwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: CBOs taa de mmabun afotufoɔ bagua anaa atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi de wɔn adwene, wɔn nimdeɛ, ne wɔn ahoɔden ahyɛ SRH nnwuma mu ba. Wɔde nteteɛ ne afotu ma de kyekye mmabun tumi wɔ nsɛm a wɔka ne nhyehyɛe mu. Ɛdenam mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ne akannifo dwumadi mu so no, CBO ahorow ma wɔn tumi ma wɔbɛyɛ nsakrae ho adwumayɛfo wɔ SRH akwan ahorow a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne wɔn atipɛnfo ahiade ahorow a wodi ho dwuma mu. PPAG yɛ mmeaeɛ a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ, tu wɔn ho ma anaa wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ akannifoɔ dwumadie mu wɔ mmabun awoɔ akwahosan mu wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ akuwakuw mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ apɔmden nsɛm ho betumi afa so aka ewiem nsakraeɛ ne nhyehyeɛ abom aboa ma mmabun anya nteaseɛ ne nwientaaso deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no sɛ 'resilent' ahobambɔ nhyehyeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ahwɛyie mapa: Wɔbɛhwɛ nyarewa a eweim nsakraeɛ de ba bi te nsaayareɛ. Nwentaasoɔ nhyehyeɛ: Wɔbɛsiesie ayaresabea ama asane a ewiem nsakraeɛ de ba na mmoa no akɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de mfiridwuma ne digitall nnwinnade adi dwuma de adi kan hwɛ me ho na makura ɔkwan a ɛkari pɛ so wɔ m’adwene mu akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi de mfiridwuma ne digital nnwinnade adi kan de wo ho a wobɛhwɛ adi kan na woakura ɔkwan a ɛkari pɛ so wɔ w’adwene mu akwahosan ho denam: Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ ho apps anaa dijitaal platform ahorow a wode nnwinnade a wode bedi adwene akyi, de botae ahorow sisi w’ani so, ne nneɛma a wode bɛboa wo ho a wode bedi adwennwen ho dwuma, agye w’ahome, ne yiyedi a wode bedi dwuma no so. Adwene ne ahomegye apps a wode bɛka wo da biara da dwumadi ho de adwennwen nneɛma ho, ahome a emu dɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, anaa mfonini a wɔkyerɛ kwan de ahyɛ ahomegye ne adwennwen ano aduru ho nkuran. Nkaebɔ anaa alarm a wode besisi wo mfiri ahorow so na ama woanya wo ho a wobɛhwɛ no daa, te sɛ ahomegye a wubegye, aseda a wode sua ade, anaa anigyede ahorow a ɛma w’ani gye a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu. Mfiri a wotumi hyɛ anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ trackers a wode bedi dwuma de ahwɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, sɛnea woda, ne akwahosan ho nsɛnkyerɛnne afoforo a ebetumi aka w’adwene mu yiyedi. Sɛ wode w’adwene besi wo intanɛt so su ne sɛnea wode di dwuma wɔ dijitaal so, na woahyɛ da apaw nneɛma a wode bedi kan de dwumadi ahorow a ɛboa w’adwene akwahosan ne wo yiyedi nyinaa bedi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so daa ne nhwehwɛmu  "continued monitoring and evaluation" (nhwehwɛmu a ɛkɔ so daa) wɔ ɔhaw nsiesie ne nna ne awo akwahosan  mmoa mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛne sɛ yɛbɛhwɛ dwumadie no mu daa ahu sɛ ɛrekɔ yie. Yɛhwehwɛ data (nsɛm) mu na yɛyɛ nsakraeɛ de boa ma dwumadie no tu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa nnamfo anaa m’adɔfo a ebia wɔredi nnamu nyare 'STI' a woanya no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Fa Mmoa Ma: Ɛnyɛ atɛn na fa nkate fam mmoa ma. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ aduruyɛ mu mmoa na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔne wɔn nkɔ. Ka nsɛm kyerɛ: Fa nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ma wɔ ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma ho. Kura Ahintasɛm So: Bu wɔn kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm a ɛfa sɛnea wɔahu wɔn yare no ho. Hyɛ Nkitahodi Ho Nkuran: Boa wɔn ma wɔne wɔn ahokafo nni nkitaho wɔ nea wɔahu ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu no ho. Hyɛ Wɔn Ho a Wɔhwɛ Ho Nkɔso: Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wonni wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo afotu akyi na wonwie ayaresa no. Hwɛ Mmoa Nnwuma: Fa nsɛm a ɛfa mmoa akuo anaa afotuo dwumadie ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua abakɔsɛm, awosu, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia betumi anya asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun benya nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ne adwenemyare no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Abusua abakɔsɛm, awosu, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia betumi anya asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun benya nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw ne adwenemyare no so nsunsuanso kɛse. Nneɛma bi ne: Abusua abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw anaa adwenemyare, a ebetumi ama awosu mu su ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔde nnubɔne di dwuma no ayɛ kɛse. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, awofo adwene wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne adwenemhaw anaa adwennwen a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Abɔde mu nneɛma te sɛ brain chemistry, neurotansmitter dwumadi, ne nsakrae a ɛba nkwaadɔm mu wɔ nsabuo mu ka ho. Asiane ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase no betumi aboa mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ma wɔatu anammɔn a edi kan de abrɛ asiane ahorow ase na wɔahyɛ nneɛma a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ma adwenemyare ne yiyedi ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa awofo ne mmabun ma w'abom adi nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Nneɛma: Sukuu afotufo anaa ayarehwɛfo betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama. Mpɔtam Hɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae betumi de adwumayɛbea anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow ama awofo ne mmabun. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ahorow wɔ borɔfo mu te sɛ 'Planned Parenthood' anaa ASHA de nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Awofoɔ ne Mmabun Nhyiamu: Monkɔ nhyiamu anaa adesua ahodoɔ mu bom sua na wɔnsusu nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Ayaresa Mmoa: Abusua ayaresa anaa afotu betumi aboa ma nkitahodi ne ntease atu mpɔn. Awofoɔ Nhoma ne Akwankyerɛ: Nhoma wɔ borɔfo mu te sɛ "The Care and Keeping of You" series ma mmeawa anaa "Guy Stuff: The Body Book for Boys" betumi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a ebia ɛremfata anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nea asiane biara nni ho sɛ wɔde awofo anaa abusua mufo bɛhyɛ mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, tebea ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a sɛ wode awofo anaa abusuafo ɛrehyɛm ɛnya anaa ɛyɛ hu, titiriw sɛ obi betumi ayɛ wɔn bɔne anaa wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayade, wobebu wɔn ani agu so, anaa sɛ hyɛ a wode wɔn ɛhyɛ mu betumi de ɔhaw foforɔ aba. Wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa mu no, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa nnwumakuo ahorow a wobetumi de mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam ama no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne PMTCT, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ HIV ano aduro ho?
answer_twi_source: Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission (PMTCT) kyerɛ nneɛma ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛna a ɔwɔ HIV de bɛma ne ba wɔ nyinsɛn mu, awo, ne nufu mu no so. PMTCT ho hia kɛse wɔ HIV ano aduru ho efisɛ ɛboa ma wosiw HIV foforo a ɛba nkokoaa mu ano, na ɛnam so boa ma botae a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛma HIV ɔyaredɔm no aba awiei no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akɔ so anya nsɛm a wɔahu ne nea efi mu ba wɔ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow a nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention programs' na ahyehyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akɔ so anya nsɛm denam: Nsɛm foforo a wobenya denam dwumadi no ho amanneɛbɔ nkrataa, wɛbsaet ahorow, anaa nea broni ka no 'social media' akwan so. Mpɔtam nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a wɔde nhwehwɛmu aba a wɔde bɛkɔ. Sɛ wɔbɛnya amanneɛbɔ anaa nwoma a wode aba no de nam abɔnten nnwumakuo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee bɛn na mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa: Nyinsɛn ano aduru (Nhwɛsoɔ; awo ano aduru, kɔndɔm, nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu) STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu. Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde ma apemfoɔ ansa na ɔwoɔ. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho dwumadie (baabi a mmara ma ho kwan). Afotuo a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden , abusuabɔ, ne pene a wɔpene so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛdeɛ ahorow a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ, wɔ ɛnanom apɔwmuden ho gyinaesie ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem wɔ hokwan sɛ: Wogye wɔn akwahosan ne ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho nsɛm wɔ kwan a wɔbɛte ase so. Si gyinae wɔ wɔn apɔwmuden nsɛm ho, a ayaresa a wobɛpaw anaasɛ wobɛpow ka ho. Mpene so anaasɛ pow ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow berɛ a wɔabɔ asiane ne mfasoɔ ahorow a ɛwɔ so amanneɛ akyerɛ wɔn. Asɛdeɛ no bi ne: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akwahosan ho gyinaesie mu sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi biara. Nsɛm a wobebisa na woahwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu berɛ a ɛho hia mu. Wɔn akwahosan ne wɔn asetena kwan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahyɛ me nnamfo anaa m’atipɛnfo nkuran ma wɔabɛka me ho ma wɔasua adwene pa nhyehɛe, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ meka saa akwan yi akyerɛ afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Fa nhwɛso di anim: Fa adwene mu nhumu ka wo daadaa dwumadi ho na ka wo suahu ahorow kyerɛ wo nnamfo, na da mfaso a ɛwɔ so no adi ankasa. Fa akwankyerɛ ma: Fa adwene mu apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa nneɛma a ɛnyɛ den ma w’atipɛnfo, kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobetumi de adwene mu nhumu aka wɔn asetra ho. Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ho so dua: Si sɛnea adwene a wɔde si biribi so betumi ama adwene mu yiyedi atu mpɔn na ama ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano no ayɛ kɛse, na ama afoforo tumi de wɔn ankasa nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho adi kan no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ ayaresabea bi yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom na agye din sɛ wotu nyinsɛn gu? (hwehwɛ tumi krataa, agyede, ayarefo nsusuwii pa)
answer_twi_source: Tumi krataa: Hwɛ sɛ ayaresabea no wɔ tumi krataa a ɛfata a efi wo man akwahosan dwumadibea hɔ. Gye a Wogye tom: Hwehwɛ ayaresabea ahorow a ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ The Joint Commission agye atom. wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo betumi de wo abata ayaresabea ahorow a ahobammɔ wom a woyi nyinsɛn gu ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun adwuma ma nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee hyɛ nnipa ahorow ahorow ne adwumayɛfo a wɔka ho ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun adwuma ma nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee boa ma nnipa ahorow ahorow ne wɔn a wɔka ho wɔ adwumayɛfo mu denam: Hokwan ahorow a wɔde ma akuw a wonni ananmusifo no so: Nhyehyɛe ahorow no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wonni gyinabea pa no ananmusifo akɔ soro wɔ adwumayɛfo mu denam adwumayɛfo a wɔbɛfa wɔn adwuma mu, ntetee, ne mmoa adwuma a wɔde ma a ɛka obiara ho no so. Nneɛma a ɛfa nnipa nyinaa ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Adwumayɛ mu ntetee ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe hyɛ ahorow ahorow ne nnipa a wɔka ho ho nkuran denam adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔma akwaaba, wɔboa, na ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wobu wɔn, na wɔama wɔn tumi no so. Nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ a wɔdi ho dwuma: Nneɛma a wɔyɛ no yɛ adwuma de di nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ a ɛmma adwumayɛfoɔ de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua hyia no ho dwuma, te sɛ nyiyim, animhwɛ, nneɛma a wɔnnya, ne nkɔsoɔ hokwan kakraa bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne mpanyimfo a wɔyɛ ayɔnkofo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako de ahyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ de kamfo nna ne awo hokwan ahorow no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako wɔ fekubɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, mmabun afotufo bagua ahorow a wɔbɛka ho, nkabom a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, ne awo ntoatoaso ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no so. Mpanyimfo ayɔnkofo betumi de akwankyerɛ, nneɛma, ne afotu ama, bere a ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de nhyiam ahorow, sika, ne nimdeɛ ama de ama mmabun nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔahyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nna ne awo hokwan ahorow no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɔso a ɛma obi nyin, na dɛn nti na ɛba?
answer_twi_source: Onyin a ɛyɛ hu yɛ mmere a nipadua no nyin ntɛmntɛm, a onyin hormone na ɛkanyan no. Mmabaa taa nya bi bɛyɛ mfe 10–14, na mmarimaa bɛyɛ mfe 12–16, nanso ɛsono obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn na mɛfa so maka me SRH ahiasɛm akyerɛ ayaresafoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sua adeɛ fa SRH ho. Kasa pefee a wonsuro. Hwehwɛ mmoa a obu ne nteaseɛ wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsonsoeɛ bɛn na ɛda nna ho nsɛm 'sexual', ɔdɔ ho nkitahodie 'romantic', ne adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛ 'emotional' attraction ntam?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ ɔtwetwe obi wɔ honam fam. Ɔdɔ ho akɔnnɔ: Ɔdɔ ho akɔnnɔ a wobɛte nka, te sɛ ɔpɛ a wopɛ sɛ wo ne obi bɛbɔ anaasɛ wo ne obi bɛbɔ. Nkate mu twetwe: Nkate fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a wo ne obi wɔ, a ɛho nhia sɛ ɛfa honam fam anaa ɔdɔ ho nkate ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nneyɛe a ɛfata ne nea ɛnyɛ papa ntam wɔ nyɔnkofa  bi mu?
answer_twi_source: Suban pa a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye, ahofadi, ne atenka ahorow. Ebia nneyɛe a ɛmfata no bi ne tumidi, nsakrae, obu a wonni, anaa nhyɛso. Hwɛ sɛnea wote nka wɔ abusuabɔ no mu yiye —sɛ wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ, wobu wo, na wosom bo a, ɛda adi sɛ ɛyɛ apɔwmuden. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wodi wo so, wobu wo animtiaa, anaa wosuro a, ebia ɛnyɛ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaahosan ho nimdeɛ nya tumi a mmabun tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwaahosan ho no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Akwaahosan ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no yɛ kɛse, na ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ nneɛma a wonya fi mu no mu yiye, susuw asane ahorow ho, na wosi gyinae a ɛfata. Ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔne akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo di nkitaho yiye, te aduruyɛ mu afotu ase, na wɔkamfo wɔn ahiade ahorow kyerɛ, na awiei koraa no ɛma wonya akwaahosan pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwannya ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nneyɛe a ɛfata ho nkuran na wɔama nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ayɛ papa na wɔde aka ho no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ akwannya  ahorow de wɔn ho hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ de kamfo nsɛm a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nneyɛe a ɛfata ho nkuran na wɔama nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ayɛ papa na wɔde aka ho no atu mpɔn. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim anaasɛ wɔafi ase, de wɔn nsa ahyɛ adesrɛ ase, de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsɔretia anaa nhyiam ahorow mu, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo adi nkitaho, na wɔde sohyial media akwan adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho. Ɛdenam nsakrae a wɔde nsiyɛ kamfo kyerɛ so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse, anya gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow so nkɛntɛnso, na wɔaboa ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea a ɛda wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛka ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, te sɛ abɔde a nkwa wom, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ne amammerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ (Sexual education anaa Orientation) yɛ asɛm a emu yɛ den a nneɛma pii bɛtumi aka ho asɛm, a nea ɛka ho bi ne:Nipadua mu nneɛma (Biological factors): Te sɛ sɛnea nipadua no teɛ (genetics), nipadua mu nkwaadɔm (hormones), ne adwene no nhyehyɛeɛ.Baabi a obi firi (Environmental factors): Te sɛ sɛnea wɔtetee wo, mpɔtam nkitahodie, ne nsɛm a woahunu pɛn.Amammerɛ mu nneɛma (Cultural factors): Afei nso mpɔtam mmara, nneɛma a wɔbu no som bo, ne sɛnea nnipa dwene fa nna ho (sexuality).Ankorankoro nsɛm (Personal experiences): Afei nso abusuabɔ ne nea ɛtwetwe obi.Ɛhia sɛ yehu sɛ nna ho gyinabea yɛ soronko ma obiara, na yɛntumi mfa asɛm baako pɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Ɛyɛ nneɛma pii a ɛbom yɛ adwuma, a nipadua mu tebea, baabi a yɛfiri, ne sɛnea obi hu ne ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na awoɔ mu nkwammoa ahorow sesa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ mu nkwammoa ahorow sesa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu efisɛ wo nipadua resiesie ne ho ama mpanyin afe so ne tumi a ɛbɛma awo. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a efi amemene no mu, titiriw nea broni ka no 'pituitary gland', a ɛma nkwaadɔm a ɛka kyerɛ ntini afoforo (te sɛ awodeɛ kosua ne tɔhwɛ) ma wɔyɛ awoɔ mu nkwammoa pii na ɛkanyan nsakrae yi. Saa awoɔ mu nkwammoa a ɛkɔ soro yi ne nea ɛde nipadua mu nsakrae a worehyia no ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne nyiyim a wɔnyɛ ho nkuranhyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho denam: Nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ. Obu ne pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ abusuabɔ mu Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho. Nsɛm a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmeae a wɔbɛte nne nyinaa a wɔbɛtete nne nyinaa a wobegyina hɔ atia nyiyim ne ntɛnkyea a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na biribi tumi yɛ akwansidie ma obi faahodie a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔbɛ wo ho? Ma nhwɛsoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ no bi ne: Sɛ wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru anaa STI nhwehwɛmu/ayaresa a nteaseɛ pa biara nni ho. Awo a Wɔhyɛ: Eyi ne bere a wɔma obi nyinsɛn a wɔmpene so, na ɛno yɛ nipadua mu ahofadie a wobu so. Nsɛm a Wonnya: Wɔmma wɔnnya ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ sukuu anaa ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe mu. Nyinsɛn a Wɔhyɛ: Wobɛhyɛ wo ma woatu nyinsɛn a ɛnyɛ wo pɛ. Wobetumi adi saa mmara sobu yi ho dwuma denam: Amanneɛbɔ a wɔde bɛma Atumfoɔ: Sɛ wuhyia mmara sobu bi wɔ ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe mu a, wubetumi abɔ ho amanneɛ akyerɛ aduruyɛ bagua anaa aban kuo a ɛfa ho no. Mmara kwan so Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ wobu mmara so denneennen a, ebia mmara kwan so mmoa ho behia. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Sɛ wɔde adwene si nsɛm yi so denam akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ so a, ebetumi ama nsakraeɛ ho nhyɛso aba. Nhomasua: Mpɛn pii no, mmara so bu fi nimdeɛ a wonni, enti nhomasua dawurobɔ ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔasiw mmara so bu daakye ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm sɛ wɔde wɔn bɛka ho na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Adesrɛ ne Ɔsatu 'campaigns': Fi ase anaa boa adesrɛ ne ɔsatu a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo pii. Di Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔfoɔ Nkitaho: Twerɛ nkrataa anaa 'email' kɔma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a ɛkyerɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ di dwuma. Social Media Activism: Fa social media platforms di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu na wɔkamfo nsakrae kyerɛ. Boa Nsɛm a Ɛsono: Boa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkamfo ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm dedaw te sɛ hwɛ, kyɛ, na wɔhyɛ ho nkuran so. Nhomasua Dwumadie: Wo ne sukuu ne ahyehyɛdeɛ nyɛ adwuma de nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini a ɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ho ka nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi adi kasa mu akwanside ahorow, akenkan ne akyerɛw ho haw, ne nsɛm afoforo a ɛfa nneɛma a wobetumi anya ho dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ asuafo nyinaa betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu denneennen?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi: Wɔde nneɛma a wɔakyerɛ aseɛ, aniwa hu mmoa nea aborɔfo ka no 'visual aids', ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahodoɔ bɛma de agye adesua akwan ahodoɔ ne kasa a wɔpɛ. Fa mmoa foforo, te sɛ obiakofo nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa kuw nketewa nhyiam ahorow ma asuafo a wɔwɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nsɛnnennen anaa kasa mu akwanside ahorow. Fa nkitahodi ne osuahu mu adesua dwumadi ahorow a ɛma asuafo a wɔn ahoɔden ne wɔn tebea gu ahorow de wɔn ho hyɛ mu ka ho. Yɛ adesuadan mu tebea a ahotɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho a asuafoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛbisa nsɛm na wɔahwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Wo ne nwomasua soronko akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, kasa ho abenfoɔ, ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔboa no nyɛ adwuma mfa nni ankorankoro adesua ahiadeɛ ho dwuma na wɔsesa nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan sɛdeɛ ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na mmeaɛ a wasisi ayaresabea a ɛhwɛ sa nyarewa bi te sɛ nna mu yareɛ debrɛ mmabun wɔ wɔn apɔmden nhyehyeɛ ho so?
answer_twi_source: Mmeammea a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri anaa sɛ nkurase ma mmabun nnya mmoa ntɛm. Mmoa wɔ nkuropɔn mu nanso sika betumi ayɛ haw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atoro bɛn na nkurɔfoɔ di fa 'prenatal care' (nyinsɛn mu ayaresa) ho?
answer_twi_source: Atoro: 'Sɛ woyare nko ara na kɔ.' 'Scan sɛe abofra.' 'Aduro-bidie yɛ papa.' Adwabɔ ase kasakyerɛ: Nhomasua ho dɛworo, afotu, na yɛne mpanyimfoɔ bom yɛ adwuma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mbabun a asiane anaa ɔtan bi betumi ato wɔn no, kwan bi wɔ hɔ a yebetumi apa wɔn kokoamsɛm asɛm mu a yɛnkora so koraa?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ma kwan sɛ yɛpae mbabun kokoamsɛm kyerɛ afoforo sɛ asiane anaa ɔtan bi rebɛto wɔn a. Ebi ne nsɛm a ɛfa mbofra atirimɔdensɛm, mmofra a wɔnhwɛ wɔn yiye, anaa asiane biara a ɛbɛtumi apira saa ababaa anaa aberante no. Ɛyɛ adwuma ne mmara mu asɛdeɛ ma ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ sɛ, sɛ wɔhu anaa wɔnya adwene sɛ obi repira abofra bi a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ atumfoɔ a wɔhwɛ saa nsɛm yi so amanneɛ ntɛm pa ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na ayersa adwumayefo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfoɔ bɛkyerɛkyerɛ adamfofa papa ne nna ho gyinaesi wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Ahokokwaw Ntetee. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ (wɔne akannifoɔ yɛ adwuma bom). Nneɛma a Wɔayɛ no Amammerɛ mu. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amanaman ntam anaa ɔman no mu akwankyerɛ ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya nna ho adesua a edi mũ?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ UNESCO ne WHO ayɛ akwankyerɛ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a esi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho adesua a edi mu sɛ hokwan a nnipa wɔ ma mmabun so dua. Nanso wɔsakra eyi bere a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Ghana no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛfa nna mu pene, akɔnnɔ, ne anigye ho da ɔmanfo su ne gyidi ahorow a ɛtrɛw adi wɔ nna ho, titiri wɔ nsɛm te sɛ pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nna mu tumi a wɔde ma ho?
answer_twi_source: Media mfonini ahorow a ɛfa nna mu pene, akɔnnɔ, ne anigye ho da ɔmanfo su ne gyidi ahorow a ɛtrɛw wɔ nna ho adi. Berɛ a ebia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo binom bɛkyerɛ nna mu abusuabɔ a ɛfata na wɔpene so no, afoforo betumi ama anansesɛm a epira anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa mpeneso ne nna mu tumi a wɔde ma ho no akɔ so. Mpɛn pii no, wɔmfa nsɛm te sɛ mpeneso ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nna mu ahofadi, ne anigye nni dwuma yie anaasɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma yie wɔ media mu nsɛm mu, na ɛka mmabun ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu nneyɛe ne abusuabɔ a ɛfata ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside anaa haw a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho, te sɛ nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene, wɔn ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, fekubɔ mu ntotoho, anaa suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de boasetɔ, ne mmoa a efi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di hɔ adi akwanside ahorow yi so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside anaa haw ahorow wɔ nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, te sɛ nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene, wɔn ho a wɔka wɔ ɔkwan a enye so, fekubɔ mu ntotoho, anaa atemmu ho suro a wosuro mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi akwanside ahorow yi so no, wobetumi anya adwene mu nhumu na wɔde wɔn adwene asi biribi so denam; akwan horow te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa adwene mu nsusuwii a wɔde bedi dwuma so. Mmabun a wonya wɔn ho ayamhyehye ne wɔn ho a wogye tom no boa ma wotumi ko tia wɔn ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ na wodi nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔmfata anaasɛ wɔn ho adwenem naayɛ so nkonim. Mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ fi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa afotufo hɔ no betumi ama wɔanya nkuranhyɛ, akwankyerɛ, ne nea wɔagye atom, na aboa mmabun ma wɔadi haw so na wɔakɔ so de wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn ba, na dɛn na ɛba bere a wɔnyem?
answer_twi_source: Nkwaboaa: Nwotwaa ba bere a mmadwoa nkwammoaa bi hyia nkesua nkwammoaa a ɛwɔ awotwaa no mu biako mu no. Eyi taa ba bere a obi renya nna mu. Sɛ mmadwoa bi hyɛn nkesua no mu a, wɔn awosu mu nneɛma bom yɛ nea broni frɛ no 'zygote', a ɛyɛ onipa foforo nkwammoaa a edi kan. Nyinsɛn: Bere a wɔawo awo akyi no, 'zygote' no fi ase paapae ntɛmntɛm bere a ɛnam fallopian tube no mu kɔ awotwaa no mu no. Ɛbɛyɛ nea broni frɛ no 'blastocyst' na ɛde ne ho hyɛ awotwaa no mu. Afei 'blastocyst' no nyin bɛyɛ awotwaa na akyiri yi ɛbɛyɛ awotwaa. Nyinsɛn no kɔ so kosi sɛ akokoaa no bɛyɛ krado ama awo, na mpɛn pii no ɛba bɛyɛ adapɛn 40 fi brayɛ bere a etwa to no mu. Wɔ nyinsɛn mu no, ɔbea nipadua no yɛ nsakrae pii de boa akokoaa a ɔrenyin no, a nea ɛka ho ne nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae, mogya dodow a ɛkɔ soro, ne nsakrae a ɛba awotwaa no mu ma akokoaa a ɔrenyin no betumi atra mu. Saa nneɛma yi ho hia na ama nnipa awo na wɔakɔ so atra ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ di wɔ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ne wɔn abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho bɔbea betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ mu nkɛntɛnso a ebenya so de nam: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nipasu nkɔso ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho no so. Nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwahosan ho nnwuma a wobenya. Abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ne nkitahodi a wɔne ɔhokafo di. Osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne nnipa kakraa bi adwennwen ho. Boa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodi. Mpene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛte ase na wɔafa so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛdi wɔn ahiadeɛ ne suahunu soronko ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔama mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so tumi, ma wɔadi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nhomasua, akwahosan, ne sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyeɛ bɛtumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran, na wɔama mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so tumi denam: Hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ mmabaa bɛnya nwomasua, akwahosan, ne sikasɛm mu hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ denam wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani asi so ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so agye atom so. Basabasayɛ ne nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna so a wobedi ho dwuma denam ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, mmara mu nsakrae, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no so. Afotuo, akannifoɔ nteteeɛ, ne asetena mu nimdeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛma de ama mmabaa tumi ma wɔakasa atia atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie, na wɔadi wɔn apɛdeɛ akyi. Mmaa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu wɔ gyinabea ahorow nyinaa mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne mmea hokwan ahorow anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ma mmoa mmeaeɛ a ɛfa LGBTQ+ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nkitahodiɛ nɔmba (hotlines) a wɔde akwankyerɛ pɔtee bɛma afa nna mu akwahosan ho ama saa mpɔtam yi
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mprempren berɛ yi mu no, LGBTQ+ nneyɛeɛ tia mmara wɔ Ghana. Nanso, akwahosan ho adwumfoɔ ne ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛboa wo wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan akwantuo mu a animtiaabu anaa mpaapaemu biara nni mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so ahu nsakrae a aba wɔ mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a ebetumi aka sɛnea metumi anya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi akɔ so ahu nsakrae a aba wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a ebetumi aka wo tumi a wode benya awo akwahosan ho nnwuma sɛ ɔbabun denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wogye di, aban wɛbsaet ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ (UNICEF/WHO)a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun akwahosan ne hokwan "rights" ahorow so no akyi. Saa mmeae yi betumi de nsɛm foforo ama wɔ mmara a ɛfa ho, nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ne mmara mu nkɔso a ɛka awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho. Bio nso, wobɛtumi de wo ho ahyɛ ɔsatuo a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban mu, akɔ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu ahodoɔ, na woakɔka ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene asi awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm so na woakɔ so de wo ho ahyɛ mu na woanya nsɛm a ɛfa wo hokwan ne ɔhwɛ a wobɛnya ho amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya hokwan ahorow ne nea wobetumi apaw ho nsɛm sɛ wɔanya nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa wonim obi a wato wɔn mmonnaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan ahorow ne nea wobetumi apaw ho sɛ wɔanya nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaasɛ wonim obi a wafa mu, ɛnam nneɛma ahorow so. Ebia eyinom bi ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, Intanɛt so nneɛma, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na aduan pa di wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu?
answer_twi_source: Aduane pa som bo pa ara de boa apɔwmuden nyinaa, a nna ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden mmerɛ a obi yɛ ababaawa anaa aberanteɛ (adolescence) ka ho.Aduane a ahoɔden wom ma kwan ma nna mu akwaa, "hormones," ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ nipadua mu nyini na ɛyɛ adwuma yie. Aduanepa bɛtumi aka awoɔ mu ahoɔden (fertility), ɔkyere (menstrual health), "hormones" mmerɛ, ne tumi a nipadua no wɔ sɛ ɛbɛtumi akura nyinsɛn pa mu wɔ daakye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no boa ma nsonsonoe ba ɔhwɛ a mmabun nyamu, na nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ebetumi aboa ma wɔayi anansesɛm afi hɔ, ama nimdeɛ akɔ soro, na wɔahyɛ nneyɛe pa a ɛhwehwɛ akwahosan ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi anya ɔhwɛ a mmabun nya so nkɛntɛnso kɛse: Nsonsonoe a Ɛwɔ Nneɛma a Wonya Mu: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ betumi ama wɔabu wɔn animtiaa wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, na asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ esiane atemmu anaa aniwu ho suro nti. Ebia anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yarewa 'STI', ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no bɛma mmabun abam abu sɛ wobenya nnwuma a ɛho hia, na ɛde nsonsonoe aba ɔhwɛ mu. Nnwuma a Egyina Mpɔtam Hɔ: Nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ anansesɛm a wobeyi afi hɔ, nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ soro, ne akwahosan hwehwɛ nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun mu. Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw, na wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: GBV bɛtumi asi wɔ ayonkofa biara mu anaa ɔbaa ne barima nkitahodeɛ nkutoo?
answer_twi_source: GBV betumi asi wɔ ayonkofa biara mu, ɛnyɛ ɔdɔ mu nkutoo. Ebetumi aba wɔ: Abusua mu: Awofo, anuanom, anaa abusuafo afoforo. Nnamfo: Nnipa a wususuwii sɛ wubetumi de wɔn ho ato wɔn so. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔnso nkitahodi: Wo ne ahɔho anaa nnipa a wunim wɔn mpo
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ di wɔ boa a wɔboa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a ɛka wɔn atipɛnfo abusuabɔ ne wɔn nkitahodi mu yiye na wɔhwehwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho hia kɛse na ama wɔaboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nkrasɛm a ɛka wɔn atipɛnfo abusuabɔ ne wɔn nkitahodi ho yiye na wɔahwɛ so. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wobenya so no, mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm mu, ahu akwan a wɔfa so gye nkurɔfo adwene, na wɔte sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea nya wɔn adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe so nkɛntɛnso wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi mu no ase. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ma mmabun tumi ma wogye mfɛfo nkitahodi ho mfonini ahorow a epira anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nokware ho kyim, twa mpoa, na wɔko tia, na ɛma wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo nya abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa na ɛyɛ nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ne mfiridwuma foforo bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de adi wim nsakrae ne ASRH ntam nkitahodi ho dwuma, te sɛ tele so aduruyɛ, mobile health application, ne mfidie ahorow a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma so a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Telemedicine ne Mobile Health: Telemedicine ne mobile applications a wɔde bedi dwuma de akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri, a ASRH ho nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛyɛ papa ka ho, ama mmabun a wɔwɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛduru hɔ na wɔnyɛ adwuma yie a wim nsakraeɛ aka wɔn. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nhwehwɛmu: Sɛ wɔde nhyehyeɛ a ɛyɛ mfidie a wɔde bɛdi dwuma de ahwɛ mantam apɔmden ho nsɛm na watumi de ahu akwan a wobɛfaso de asi ewiem tebea so nsunsuanso ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So apɔw-mu-tenteneeyɛ dwumadie anaa agodie bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ mmabun anaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmara pɔtee bi nni hɔ ɛhyɛ sɛ mmarma ne mmaa nni agorɔ bi, na mmom nea obia ani gye ho na ɔbɛyɛ. Mmabun betumi abɔ bɔɔl, basketball anaa tennis. Mirakatuo ne asudwareɛ, cycling ne martial arts so yɛ paa ma wɔn. Wobetumi so asa aka ho, Yoga ne Gymnastics so wɔhɔ ma wɔn. Bio so fie agorɔ te sɛ ampe, sack race, lime and spoon, tug of war, ne musical chairs so yɛ ma wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu nimdeɛ ho adesua betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano na wɔagyina nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ano?
answer_twi_source: Ɛdenam ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ so no, mmabun sua sɛnea wobedi nsɛnnennen te sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da anaasɛ STI a wobehu ho dwuma. Wɔyɛ akwan ahorow a wɔfa so gyina ɔhaw ano de di adwennwen, abasamtu, anaa pow a wɔpow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho gyinaesi anaa abusuabɔ ho no ho dwuma. Asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua ma wotumi yɛ wɔn ho yiye na wotumi sesa wɔn ho, na ɛma mmabun tumi san wɔn akyi fi akwanside ahorow mu na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no. Mmabun sua sɛnea wɔde botae ahorow sisi wɔn ani so, de wɔn nneyɛe ho asodi to wɔn ho so, na wokura mu wɔ amanehunu mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de m’afotu anaa ayaresa berɛ no adi dwuma yiye, na dɛn na metumi ayɛ wɔ nhyiam ahorow no akyi de aboa m’adwene mu akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubenya mfasoɔ kɛseɛ afiri wo afutuguo anaa ayaresa nhyiamu no mu no, ɛho hia sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ mu kɛseɛ na woyɛ adwumaden wɔ dwumadie no mu. Ma w'ani nna hɔ na di nokorɛ kyerɛ wo fotufoɔ anaa wo dɔkota (therapist) fa w'adwene, wo nkaeɛ, ne wo suahunu ho. Fa botaeɛ si w'ani so ma ayaresa no, na wo ne wo mmoafoɔ no mmɔ mu nyɛ adwuma na moayɛ akwan a mo bɛfa so aduru saa botaeɛ no ho.Wofiri nhyiamu no mu a, fa nimdeɛ ne akwan foforɔ a wosuaeɛ wɔ ayaresa no mu no yɛ adwuma, te sɛ ɔpɔ mu nnyigyeɛ (relaxation exercises), akwan a wɔfa so hyia haw (coping strategies), anaa nkitahodie mu nimdeɛ. Hwɛ wo honam mu akwahosan so denam nna a ɛdɔɔso a wobenya, aduane pa a wubedi, nante ne honam mu ngyigyeɛ a wobɛyɛ daa, ne nneyɛeɛ a w'ani gye ho a wobɛyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atoyerɛnkyɛm a efi wim tebea mu, te sɛ ahum, nsuyiri, ne ɔpɛ betumi aka sɛnea mmabun nya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Atoyerɛnkyɛm a ɛfa wim tebea ho te sɛ ahum, nsuyiri, ne ɔpɛ betumi aka mmabun a wobenya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe denam akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛsɛe no, nneɛma a wɔde ma a ɛbɛsɛe, nnipa dodow a wobetu afi wɔn afie mu, asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyarewa a nsu mu ba no ayɛ kɛse, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛhyɛ nhyɛso dedaw no mu den no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabunbere ne nipadua mu nsesae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no nya nipadua su ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho sesa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabunbere de nipadua mu nsakrae atitiriw te sɛ onyin a ɛyɛ hu, nna mu su foforo a ɛba, ne nsakrae a ɛba nipadua no nsusuwii ne nea ɛwom mu ba. Saa nsakrae yi betumi aka nipadua no mfonini ne obu a ɔwɔ ma ne ho wɔ akwan horow so: Nipadua mu Abotɔyam a Wonnya: Ebia mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ho anaasɛ wɔn ani nnye wɔn nipadua a ɛresakra no ho, titiriw sɛ wohu wɔn ho sɛ wɔatwe wɔn ho afi ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ ho adwene ahorow ho a. Ntotoho: Sɛ obi de ne ho toto n’atipɛnfo anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ho a, ebetumi ama nipadua ho mfonini ho dadwen ayɛ kɛse wɔ ne babunbere mu. Bu a Wobu Wɔn Ho: Nsakrae betumi aba wɔ obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho mu bere a mmabun reyɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn nipadua a ɛresesa no mu na wɔfa asetra mu nhyɛso ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mu hwɛbea ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a mɛfa so ama nkurɔfo ate adwenem akwahosan ho asɛm na wɔama mmoa a, wɔhwehwɛ wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ no ayɛ nea ɛfata? (nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nhyiam ahorow, sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhyehyɛe anaa fa wo ho hyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam ahorow a, ɛfa adwenem akwahosan ho wɔ wo sukuu mu a wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo ne mmabun akwahosan akuw ahorow boa wo Abɛɛfo Ntentan (Social Media) Ɔsatu ahorow: Fa abɛɛfo ntentan "platform" ahorow di dwuma wɔ asɛde mu de trɛw nkrasɛm pa a ɛfa adwenem akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nokware di wɔ sɛnea social media (Abɛɛfo ntentan)  nkɛntɛnsofo nkrasɛm a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho no tu mpɔn mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun hu nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware ne nsɛm a wɔboa anaasɛ ɛdaadaa nkurɔfo?
answer_twi_source: Nokwaredi ma abɛɛfo ntentan nkɛntɛnsofo nkrasɛm a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho no tu mpɔn denam: Ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so ama atiefoɔ anya wɔn mu gyidie ne nokwaredie; efisɛ atiefoɔ no ani sɔ nsɛm a ɛfiri koma mu na ɛyɛ nokware kyen nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ no so anaa nsɛm a wɔde bɔ dwa. Nkɛntɛnsofo a wɔbɛma wɔne wɔn atiefo adi nkitaho wɔ wɔn ankasa gyinabea, a wɔbɛma wɔanya tema, ntease, ne mmoa. Mmabun hu nsɛm a wɔde to gua a ɛyɛ nokware ne nea wɔboa anaasɛ ɛdaadaa obi denam: Wɔhwɛ nneɛma bi te sɛ sɛnea obi bue ne ho ano pefee wɔ nnwumakuo a ɔne wɔn bɔ mu yɛ adwuma ho, ne sɛ ɔda mfasoɔ biara a ɛyɛ ahintadeɛ adi. Bio nso, wɔhwɛ sɛ ne nsɛm a ɔka no kɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ anaa. Wɔde nsɛm a wɔatua ho ka de abɔ dwa no toto ne nsɛm a ɔdaa ɔkyerɛw no ho, de hwɛ sɛ ne kasa kwan ne ne kyerɛw kwan no hyia ne nokwaredie a wɔnim no ho anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na wɔsa nna mu yareɛ (STI), na dɛn na mɛyɛ sɛ sɛ minya  bi a?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa: Wɔde  nnuru a ekum yareɛ mmoawa (antibiotics)   te sɛ  nna mu yareɛ a wɔfrɛ no borɔfo kasa  mu sɛ  chlamydia, babaso (gonorrhea) anaa nnuro a ekum HIV mmoawa. Nna mu yareɛ no bi a wɔfrɛ no borɔfo kasa  mu sɛ herpes ne HPV nni ayaresa nanso wɔbetumi de nnuro abrɛ no asi. Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ no sɛ,  wo bɛ hwehwɛ ayaresa mmoa ntɛmntɛm na di wo dɔketa ayaresa nhyehyɛeɛ no so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Fa w’aduru nyinaa na bɔ wo nna mu ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛ sɛnea  wɔbetumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔanya ayaresa sɛ ɛhia a. Twe wo ho fi nna ho kosi sɛ ayaresa no bɛwie na yareɛ no afi wo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so nkyerɛase ahorow a ɛfa GBV ahorow te sɛ honam fam ayayade, nna mu ɔbrasɛe, anaa kɔmputa so ayayade ho? (nea ɛyɛ nsɛmmɔnedie a wɔbɛte ase) .
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nkyerɛase ahorow a ɛfa GBV ho no betumi ayɛ soronko, nanso nhwɛso ahorow bi a wɔtaa yɛ ni: Nipadua mu Ɔtow: Ɔhyɛ da de honam fam pira ba onipa foforo so (ɔbɔ, piapia, piapia). Nna mu Ɔhaw: Nna mu nkɔso a wɔmpɛ, nsɛm a wɔka, anaa nneyɛe a ɛde ɔtan tebea ba. Intanɛt so asisifo: Ɛlektrɔnik nkitahodi a wɔde bedi dwuma de asisi obi foforo, abɔ no hu, anaa wahaw no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi de ‘digital’ nkitahodi nnwinnade te sɛ ‘texting’ anaa ‘social media’ adi dwuma de aboa adwenemyare na yɛn ne afoforo anya nkitahodi?
answer_twi_source: Fa di dwuma ma wo ne wo nnamfo nkɔ so di nkitaho, ka osuahu ahorow, na nya afotu anaa mmoa. Nanso, hwɛ yiye na woansɛe bere pii wɔ Intanɛt so na bɔ mmɔden sɛ wode bere pii ne nkurɔfo bɛkasa ankasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛe pa ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so hyɛ pene a wɔde nimdeɛ ma ne tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun a wɔwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan tebea horow mu no bi?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pa ne akwan foforo pii na wɔayɛ de ahyɛ mmabun nkuran na wɔatumi asi gyinae a ɛfata na wɔanya nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ awo ne aware ho akwahosan (sexual and reproductive health) ho, eyinom bi ne:Nkyerɛkyerɛ kwan a ɛma mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ mu: Sɛnea wɔbɛma mmabun ate adepa a ɛne pɛne (consent), gyinaesi, ne hokwan ahorow ase no, wɔyɛ nneyɛe bi te sɛ drama (role-playing), mpanyimfo ne mmabun nkɔmmɔbɔ, ne sukuufo mfɛfo nkitahodi mmeae.Mmabun nnamfo ayaresabea a wɔasi ama wɔn: Wɔasi ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde mmabun kokoamsɛm ne wɔn ahotɔ di kan, na wɔde adwumayɛ ahorow a ɛne mmabun nneyɛe ne nea wɔpɛ hyia ma wɔn.Akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde kɔ mpɔtam hɔ: Wɔde dwumadi ahorow kɔ mpɔtam hɔ, na wɔde akwahosan ho mmoa kɔ mmabun nkyɛn wɔ wɔn afie mu ne intanɛt so, na ama mmabun anya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne afotu a ɛfa aware ne awo ho akwahosan ho ntɛm.Nkabom a wɔne sukuu ne mmabun akuw yɛ: Wɔne sukuu ahorow ne mpɔtam hɔ akuw bom yɛ adwuma na ama mmabun nne ne wɔn adwene akɔ anim wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ de boa mmabun hokwan ahorow ne wɔn yiedie wɔ aware ne awo ho akwahosan mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun fata sɛ wonya akwahosan ho insurance, na dɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔafata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi afa akwan horow so afata ama akwaahosan ho insurance: Sika a wɔde tua ho ka a egyina so: Mmabun betumi afata sɛ wonya akwaahosan ho insurance wɔ ɔwofo anaa ɔhwɛfo akwaahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ase kosi mfe pɔtee bi. Nneɛma a wɔde hwehwɛ sɛ wɔfata: Mmabun betumi de wɔn din ahyɛ Natoional health insurance Scheme no mu Bere a wɔde wɔn din bɛhyɛ mu a wɔabue mu na ɛfata, nanso ebia bere titiriw bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde kyerɛw wɔn din wɔ asetra mu nsɛm bi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi anya telehealth services ama nhyehyɛe a wɔde di akyi anaa apɔwmuden ho ahiade a ɛkɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wobetumi de telehealth services adi dwuma de ayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde di akyi ne apɔwmuden ho ahiade a ɛkɔ so, te sɛ atetesɛm mu nsrahwɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ ankorankoro nkyɛn no. Telehealth so wɔ mfaso titiriw ma nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, afotu, ne tebea horow a enni sabea a wɔhwɛ a enhia sɛ wɔtaa kɔsra wɔn ankasa. Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so ama denam telefon so akwahosan so, de mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ so ama sɛnea ɛho hia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me nna mu akwaahosan ne awo mu osuahu ahorow betumi aka m’adwene mu akwahosan? (adwennwen, dadwen, adwenemhaw) .
answer_twi_source: Wo nna mu akwahosan ne awo mu osuahu ahorow betumi aka w’adwene akwahosan, ne nea ɛne no bɔ abira. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Adwennwen ne Dadwen: Nyinsɛn, nna mu nyarewa (STIs), anaa nipadua mfonini ho dadwen betumi de adwennwen ne dadwen aba. Adwenemhaw: Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛnnennen te sɛ adwenemhaw betumi aka w’ahoɔden dodow ne nea ɛkanyan wo, na aka wo ho a wobɛhwɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Su ahorow bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ wɔ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa mmoa kuo bi mu na ama mahwɛ ahu sɛ meyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa ne nna mu nipasu sɛ mmabun a mete dɛmdi?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ saa su ahorow yi wɔ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa kuo a wɔboa: Fa w’adwene si Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm so: Ɛsɛ sɛ kuw no di mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiade pɔtee ne osuahun ahorow ho dwuma. Hwɛ sɛ beae no yɛ nea ɛma akwaaba na ɛboa nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna. Tebea a Obuo wom: Ɛsɛ sɛ kuo no nya akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ a ɛhyɛ nkitahodie a obu wom ne kokoamsɛm ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho ɔhaw a ɛfa abɛɛfa ntentan so nkitahodi ne apomoden mfiridwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho ɔhaw ne na ɛfa abɛɛfa ntetan anaa abɛɛfa ntetan intanɛt so nkitahodi ne apomoden ho mfiridwuma ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho akwankyerɛ, nnwinnade, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din, te sɛ UNESCO, UNICEF, ne Wiase Apomoden Ahyehyɛde no ayɛ, a ɛde afotu a mfaso wɔ so, akwan horow, ne nneyɛe pa a wɔfa so tra ahobammɔ ne ahobammɔ mu wɔ intanɛt so ma. Afotuo dwumadie, ɔhaw ho telefon so, ne mmoa akuo a wɔyɛ wɔn ho titire wɔ intanɛt so ayayadeɛ, kɔmputa so ayayadeɛ, ne abɛɛfa ntetan ayayadeɛ mu, a wɔde kokoamu mmoa, nkateɛ mu mmoa, ne sɛ ɛho hia a wɔde wɔn kɔ nneɛma foforɔ anaa mmara kwan so mmoa ma. Abɛɛfa ntetan so nhyiamu ahorow, nkɔmmɔbɔ akuw, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a mmabun betumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow, asesa afotu, na wɔahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi afoforo a wɔahyia ɔhaw a ɛte saa ara wɔ intanɛt so mmeae a wɔbɛkɔ na wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho ɔhaw ho dwuma no hɔ. Wɔhyɛ mmabun nso nkuran sɛ wɔnka ɔhaw a wohyia wɔ Intanɛt so nkyerɛ wɔn awofo, anaa ɔpanyin a wogye wɔn di mfa mmoa wɔn
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi anya nna ho apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow pii de nna ho apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ma, a adwumayɛbea ahorow, nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔde ma ka ho. Ebia wo sukuu no de nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua akwaa, mmabunbere, STIs, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom bɛma. Bio nso, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow taa yɛ nhyiam ahorow anaasɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti ho ma. Wubetumi abisa wo sukuu apɔwmuden ho adesua dwumadibea anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow de asua pii afa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi akasa na wɔayɛ mmara pa a ɛbɛboa me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa GBV ho na ɛboa wɔn a wɔ te ase (wɔde mpɔtam hɔ ananmusifo di nkitaho, fi adesrɛ ahorow ase)
answer_twi_source: Hu W’Ananmusifoɔ: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa wo mpɔtam hɔ sukuu baguafoɔ anaa kuropɔn agyinatukuo ananmusifoɔ ho.
