Nhwehwɛmu Nhyehyɛe a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Dedaw Mu: Sua wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa GBV a wosiw ano ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔ te ase. Fi Adesrɛ ase: Yɛ adesrɛ krataa wɔ intanɛt so anaa krataa so a wo ne wo mfɛfo sukuufo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔkamfo nsakrae pɔtee bi kyerɛ, te sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia ayayade anaa adwenemyare ho nneɛma a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu. Kasa! Kɔ baguam nhyiamu anaa sukuu bagua nhyiamu na fa obuo ko ma nsakraeɛ a ɛfa GBV ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi towtua, ayaresa ho banbɔ a ySSSinsurance, ne sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde afoforo a ɛyɛ den no mu bere a wɔdan kɔ mpanyin afe so na wɔde wɔn ho kɛse wɔ sikasɛm mu no?
answer_twi_source: Bere a mmabun dan kɔ mpanyin afe so na wɔde wɔn ho kɛse wɔ sikasɛm mu no, wobetumi ahyia  a ɛfa towtua, broɔfo kasa a yɛfrɛ no sɛ insurance, ne sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde afoforo ho. Akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa sikasɛm ho afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ no betumi aboa wɔn ma wɔate saa nsusuwii ahorow yi ase na wɔafa wɔn sikasɛm sohwɛ mu nsɛnnennen no mu. Bio nso, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne intanɛt so nkyerɛkyerɛ betumi ama wɔanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ towtua a wɔde bɛkɔ, brofo kasa a yɛfrɛ no  sɛ insurance nhyehyɛe a wɔpaw, ne sikasɛm mu apam ahorow a wɔbɛte ase ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na metumi ahwɛ kwan afi mmrahyɛfo hɔ, sɛ mebɔ bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) ho amanneɛ a? (nhwehwɛmu, nea wɔayɛ no bɔne a wɔkamfo kyerɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Mmrahyɛ baguafo betumi: Wɔahwehwɛ Nsɛmmɔnedi no mu: Wɔbɛboaboa adanse ano na wɔabɔ mmɔden sɛ wobehu nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no. Wɔn a Wɔkamfo Wɔn a Wɔayɛ Wɔn Ayayade: Mmrahyɛ bagua ahorow bi wɔ wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa a wobetumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama wɔ adeyɛ no nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu no, dɛn na menyɛ sɛ me te nka a ɛne me pɛ ne me gyedie bɔ bira?
answer_twi_source: Si wo gyedie, wo pɛ ne wo hyeɛ pi sɛdeɛ sɔbɛyɛ a obi nntwi mmfa wo so. Wo ne mpaninfoɔ te sɛ awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufobɔfoɔ nni ho nkɔmmɔ mfa nea wo fa mu. Fa nnamfoɔ wobu wo na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔ boa mmabun. Wobetumi ayɛ saa so ama afoforɔ. Sua sɛdeɛ yɛka daabi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, amammerɛ a agye din, ne abɛɛfo ntentan "social media" di wɔ suban ne adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe "sexual assult" ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nkrasɛm ne nsusuwii hunu a epira mu yiye na wɔakasa atia "harmful messages and stereotypes"?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ "creating Awareness", amammerɛ a agye din, ne sohyial media di dwuma titiriw wɔ suban ne adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe "sexual assult" ho no mu. Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nkrasɛm ne nsusuwii hunu a epira mu yiye na wɔakasa atia denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wobenya de ahu na wɔasɛe nna mu basabasayɛ ho mfonini a epira wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu. Asɛm a Ɛko Tia "Counter Narratives": Asɛm a ɛne ne ho bɔ abira a ɛkasa tia su horow a ɛde asodi a wɔde to nea wɔayɛ no bɔne so, nsusuwii hunu, ne wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu ho mfonini a epira a wɔkyɛ na wɔhyɛ ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔde nna mu ɔbrasɛe ne pene a wɔpene so ho mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware na obu wom di kan no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no de nsɛm a wɔaboaboa ano afiri nhwehwɛmu di dwuma de kamfo nneɛma foforɔ anaa mmoa a ɛfiri wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛde data di dwuma denam: Nea egyina adanse so a wɔde bɛkyerɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no so de akyerɛ dwumadi no nsunsuanso ne mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mpɔn. Data a wɔde bedi dwuma de abɔ nhyehyɛe ho nyansahyɛ ne sika a wɔsrɛ ho amanneɛ. Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ase mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nea wotumi nya wɔ yɛn nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu, na so nsonsonoe wɔ nea wonya mu a egyina nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, beae a wote tebea, anaa amammerɛ a efi mu ba so?
answer_twi_source: Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wobetumi anya wɔ yɛn nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma pii so, a nea ɛka ho ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, beae a wote tebea, ne amammerɛ a efi mu ba. Wɔ mmeae bi no, ebia nsonsonoe bɛba nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wobenya mu, na akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no hyia akwanside akɛse. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun nyinaa anya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛmfa ho sɛnea wofi mu anaa wɔn tebea te.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mobile apps anaa ‘digital apps’   bi wɔ hɔ a ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔayɛ wɔn ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma, ama wɔanya nneɛma ne mmoa daa?
answer_twi_source: Mobile apps wɔ hɔ. Saa ‘apps’  yi betumi ama wɔanya nneɛma, akwan a wɔfa so gyina nsɛm ano, ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow na aboa wɔn ma wɔadi wɔn adwenemyare ne ahobammɔ ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwennwen nya yɛn nna ne awo akwahosan so nsusuaso, na akwan bɛn na yebetumi afa so adi adwennwen ho dwuma wɔ tebea yi mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwennwen betumi aka nna ne awo akwahosan denam akɔnnɔ, brayɛ, ne awo a ɛbɛka no so. Bio nso, adwennwen betumi anya gyinaesi a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe ne nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma ho no so nkɛntɛnso. Akwan a wɔfaso di adwennwen ho dwuma wɔ saa tebea yi mu no bi ne sɛ wɔde akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome bedi dwuma, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔne ahokafo bɛkɔ so adi nkitaho, na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa afi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mfiridwuma ne digital nnwinnade betumi adi wɔ sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne gyinaesi a ɛbɛma mmabun anya mu, na ahwɛyiye bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ de bɔ wɔn ankasa ne sikasɛm ho nsɛm ho ban wɔ Intanɛt so?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma ne digital nnwinnade betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ne gyinaesi a ɛbɛma mmabun ayɛ mmerɛw no mu. Mobile banking apps, sikasɛm nhyehyɛe softwea, ne intanɛt so sikasɛm ho akontaabu betumi aboa wɔn ma wɔadi ɛka a wɔbɔ, de sikakorabea botae ahorow asi hɔ, na wɔahwɛ wɔn sikasɛm akwahosan wɔ bere ankasa mu. Nanso, ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ ahwɛyiye de bɔ wɔn ankasa ne sikasɛm ho nsɛm ho ban wɔ Intanɛt so denam password ahorow a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bedi dwuma, kwati sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia wɔ ɔmanfo ne sohyial network so, na wɔahwɛ wɔn akontaabu so daa sɛ ebia dwumadi biara a ɛyɛ hu anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yebetumi afa so anya ahotoso ne obu ama yɛn ho yɛn ho wɔ nkitahodi a yɛne nnamfo, atipɛnfo, ne ɔdɔ ahokafo di wɔ nna mu apomoden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso ne obu a wobesi ama wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ nkitahodi a wɔne nnamfo, atipɛnfo, ne ɔdɔ ahokafo di wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi nokware, obu, na wɔboa wɔn. Tie wɔn dadwen ne wɔn adwene kyereɛ a wummbu aten, si wɔn atinka ne osuahu ahorow so dua, na di nkitaho pefee na ɛnyɛ atɛn. Ahye a emu da hɔ a wode besi hɔ na woakura kokoamu nsɛm mu nso betumi aboa ma wɔanya ahotoso wɔ mo abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dɛmdi ho ntease betumi aboa yɛn ma yɛadi nsɛm a ɛfa pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, nyiyimu, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn ho dwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ho nteaseɛ boa yɛn ma yɛdi pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ, nyiyimu, ne nnipa a wɔto wɔn sintidua ho dwuma yie denam asetena, amammerɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ a ɛto wɔn kyɛfa a wɔbɛnya ano hyeɛ a yɛbɛda no adi, hwɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛka obiara ho, akasa atia adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛyɛ hu, ne hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ a yɛbɛhyɛ ho nkuran sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ankorankoro nyinaa bɛtumi de wɔn hokwan ne wɔn tumi adi dwuma koraa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi ayɛ adwuma abom de akasa atia ɔmanfo nsusuwii hunu ne animtiaabu a ɛbata abusua nhyehyɛe ho, na wɔhyɛ nnipa ahorow ahorow, ne wɔn a wɔka bom wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi abom akasa atia ɔmanfo nsusuwii hunu ne animtiaabu a ɛbata abusua nhyehyɛe ho denam sɛ a wopia agyetom kɛse, nneɛma ahorow, ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no so. Eyi betumi ayɛ nea ɛfa ankorankoro osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, afoforo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ abusua nhyehyɛe ne nkɔso ahorow ho, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ ne obu a wɔde ma mmusua nyinaa ho nkuran. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ, tema, ne ntease a wɔbɛma anya sɛ enkɔso so no, mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi aboa ma wɔabubu akwanside ahorow na wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛhyɛ abusua asetra mu ahonyade ne ahorow ahorow ho afahyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi me mmara kwan so ahorow so na wodi so bere a merenya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ahwɛ sɛ wodi wo mmara kwan so ahorow so na wokura mu bere a worenya awo akwahosan ho nnwuma denam wo hokwan ne w’asɛyɛde ahorow a wobɛbɔ wo amanneɛ, wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho pefee wɔ w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ ho, sɛ wuhyia akwanside anaa nyiyim a wobɛkamfo wo ho, sɛ ɛho hia a, wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne nneɛma anaa mmara kwan so mmoa a wubenya sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wo wɔ wo hokwan ahorow ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛfa so ahyɛ awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ apɔwmuden mu den na y'asi ɛho yareɛ ano kwan?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a (Sex education) ɛfa nyin mu nsesaeɛ, awo ho nyehyɛɛyɛ, kwan a yebesi yareɛ ano kwan ne penyɛ ho nkyereɛkyerɛ wɔ sukuu mu. Ayaresa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛfata mmabun (Youth-friendly services). Yɛbɛko atia amammerɛ a ɛsiw kwan. Mmabun a wɔbɛdi anim (Peer-led initiatives). Nkabom a yɛne awofoɔ ne dɔkotafoɔ bɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi anya afotu anaa ayaresa dwumadi ahorow wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so anaa telefon so, na mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ afotu a wɔde ma wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, wubetumi anya afotu anaa ayaresa dwumadi ahorow wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so anaa telefon so, a ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wubenya, titiriw sɛ wowɔ akwanside ahorow te sɛ kwan wɔbɛ fa so akɔ ayersabea  anaa nhyehyɛe mu ntawaatawadi a. Mfaso a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri afotu mu ne sɛnea wotumi yɛ nsakrae, sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ne sɛnea wubetumi anya nnwuma afi w’ankasa fie. Nanso, ebia anohyeto ahorow te sɛ haw a ebetumi aba wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nkitahodi ho, kokoam nsɛm ho haw, ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ ayaresa osuahu no mu sɛ wɔde toto ankorankoro nhyiam ahorow ho a. Ɛho hia sɛ wokari mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow no na wopaw ɔkwan a ɛne w’ahiade ahorow hyia yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama wɔagye me atom yie wɔ Ghana sɛ ɔbabun  a me nnipadua atɔ sin?
answer_twi_source: Sua na Kyɛ: Wo ne wo nnamfo ne w’abusuafo nkasa fa dɛmdi ho na kasa tia nsusuwii a ɛnteɛ.Connect: Kɔka akuw anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ Ghana ho.Gye wo ho tom: Wo dɛmdi no yɛ wo fã nanso ɛnkyerɛkyerɛ wo mu.Kasa: srɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no.Resurces: Ghana Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Ahyehyɛde Fekuw (GFD) .Ɔman Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Nnipa a Wɔadi dɛm So (Ghana) .Wubetumi nso abisa mmoa a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ NGO ahorow anaa asetra mu yiyedi adwumayɛbea ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene mu mmoa (emotional support) bɛn na mebehia berɛ a mayɛ "abortion" (apɔn afuru) akyi? (afotuo adwumfoɔ, anaa mmoa akuo bi)?
answer_twi_source: Gyinaeɛ biara a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho a wobɛsi no bɛtumi ayɛ den ama w’adwene. Mmeaeɛ bi a wubetumi anya adwene mu mmoa a kokoamsɛm wom nie: Ayaresabea ahoroɔ no bɛma wo afotuo (counselling) ansa na woayi nyinsɛn no, ne ɛno akyi nso. Sɛ wowɔ ɔhaw biara a, wubetumi ne apɔmuden ho adwumfoɔ no anaa ɔpanyin biara a wode wo ho to no so akasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsɛm pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmudenn ho a ebetumi aka adwenem apɔwmuden sen afoforo? (nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, STI, nna mu ayayade) .
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm bi a esisi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho betumi anya adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso kɛse: Nyinsɛn a Wɔanhyehyɛ: Atenka ne nhyehyɛe mu nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyehyɛ mu no betumi de dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adwennwen aba. STI: Sɛ wohu sɛ ɔwɔ STI a, ebetumi ama wanya aniwu, afobu, ne dadwen. Nna mu Ayayade: Nna mu ayayade betumi anya adwene apɔwmuden so nkɛntɛnso bɔne a emu yɛ den na ɛtra hɔ daa. Ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa fi animdefo hɔ sɛ woanya nna mu ayayade a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so gyina ano anaa akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho a mmabun betumi de adi nkate horow a ɛboro so anaa adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho ho dwuma mprempren?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a Wɔfa so Gyina Ano ne Akwan a Wɔfa so Hwɛ Wɔn Ho: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ne akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho adi dwuma de adi nkate horow a ɛboro so anaa adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho no ho dwuma mprempren. Ebia eyinom bi ne ahomegye a emu dɔ, adwene mu nneyɛe, anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a wɔn ani gye ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nnamfo anaa abusua mufo a wɔboa wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn, anaasɛ adwumayɛfo mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ sabi dɛmdi hokwan nkamfoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Kɔka Nkamfo Akuo Ho: Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam anaa ɔman sabi dɛmdi nkamfo ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa akuo mu. Kɔ nhyiam, dwumadie, ne ɔyɛkyerɛ a saa akuo yi hyehyɛ no mu. Yɛ Otuhoakyɛ Adwuma: Fa wo berɛ ne wo nimdeɛ boa nkamfo mmɔdenbɔ, sɛ ɛnam dwumadie a wobɛhyehyɛ, nimdeɛ a wobɛtrɛ mu, anaa adwuma mmoa a wobɛma so. Fa Wo Nne Di Dwuma: Kasa fa sabi dɛmdi hokwan nsɛm ho wɔ wo mpɔtam ne ntentanfidie nyinaa so. Kyɛ w’ankasa abakɔsɛm na kamfo nsakraeɛ. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne Nteteeɛ: Kɔ nhyiam, nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam, ne nteteeɛ dwumadie a ɛfa sabi dɛmdi hokwan ne nkamfo ho. Sua ade na kyerɛ afoforɔ fa hokwan a nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ sabi dɛmdi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kyerɛ senia yebetumi ama obi ehunu sɛ ɛho hia sɛ yɛyɛ  bammɔ bia ɛyɛ na ɛka obiara ho ama yen mmabun a  sɛbi wɔadi dɛmdi.
answer_twi_source: Mmeɛa bambɔ wɔ na ɛka obiara ho hia ma yen mmaabun a sɛbi wɔadi dɛm efisɛ ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wɔnya ahoɔden, na wɔtumi de wɔn ho hyɛ mpɔtam nneɛma mu na ɛte aniwurusem anaa akekaawa 'stigma' so na ɛboa wɔn brabo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma mmabun tu kɔ mmeae foforo, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛne nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ahorow di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma mmabun tu kɔ mmeae foforo no bi ne; sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow, abusua a wɔbɛsan ayɛ biako, nhomasua ho anidaso, ntawntawdi anaa ɔtaa a woguan, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ wim nsakrae. Eyinom ne nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ di nkitaho ɛfiri sɛ atubrafoɔ bɛtumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ SRH dwumadie a wɔbɛnya wɔ mmeaeɛ foforɔ na wɔbɛtumi ahyia asiane foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akwati abɛɛfo ntetan so nsisi anaa mmoa a wɔkyere mmoa we a wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛ obi foforo?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛbɛyɛ na woakwati abɛɛfo ntentan anaa Intanɛt so nsisi anaa mmoa a wɔkyere mmoa we a wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ho sɛ obi foforo no, susuw nea edidi so yi ho: Hwɛ sɛ ankorankoro yɛ wɔn ho ansa na woakyɛ wɔn ho nsɛm anaa woabɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu yɛ den. Hwɛ yiye wɔ sika anaa w’ankasa ho nsɛm a wobisa fi nnipa a wonnim wɔn hɔ wɔ Intanɛt so no ho. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na sɛ biribi te nka sɛ ɛyɛ adwenem naayɛ anaasɛ ɛnyɛ wo dɛ a, gyae nkitahodi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mewɔ hokwan sɛ menya akwaa apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔmuden  ho? (Kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm) .
answer_twi_source: Aane! Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam a ɛfa SRH ho. Wei kyerɛ sɛ: Wo duruyɛfoɔ anaa akwaahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ ntumi nkyɛ w’aduruyɛ ho nsɛm a wo mpene so (gye ebinom, te sɛ ayayadeɛ a wobɛbɔ ho amanneɛ). Wubetumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo asusuw ho wɔ kokoam a w'awofo nni hɔ .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛfa so aka wɔn suahu ne wɔn adwene akyerɛ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow de abɔ wɔn adwuma a ɛfa mmabun bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ne wɔn ho kwan (ASRR) ahorow ho amanneɛ? (Nhwehwɛmu, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, mmabun nhyiam ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Wo suahu ahorow no som bo! Sɛnea mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow boaboa mmabun nsɛm ano ni: Nhwehwɛmu: Ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu de ate w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ ase. Akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so: Saa nkɔmmɔbɔ nketewa a wɔayɛ no mmerɛw yi ma wotumi ka osuahu ahorow a emu dɔ. Mmabun Nhyiam: Nhyiam a wɔabue ano ma wutumi ka w’adwene kyerɛ atiefo pii.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya abusuabɔ pa ne adamfofa bere a mereyɛ anyin?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ Wo Ho. Nkutahodie. Anigyede a Wɔkyɛ. Bu. Supa sen Dodow. Ntawntawdi Ho Nsiesiei. Tema.

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ne mmoa dwumadi ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din de abɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ebia mmabun betumi anya ɔhaw ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mmoa ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din de abɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔhaw mu ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow bi de akwan horow a wɔmmɔ din ma de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie na wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa a wonsuro sɛ wobehu wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de digital adi dwuma de asiw awo ntoatoaso, amammerɛ, ne kasa mu mpaapaemu ano, na wɔne atiefo, mpɔtam, ne mpɔtamfo adi nkitaho wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH ho?
answer_twi_source: Digital content creation projects a ɛfa kasa ahodoɔ ne amammerɛ ho no ma mmabun tumi du atiefoɔ ahodoɔ nkyɛn, na ɛma amammerɛ ahodoɔ ntam nteaseɛ ne nkɔmmɔdie nya nkɔsoɔ. Digitals abasɛm a wɔbom yɛ no ka mmabun a wofi mmeae ahorow bom ma wɔkyɛ wɔn adwene ne wɔn suahu ahorow, na ɛhyɛ tema, obiara a wɔka ho, ne biakoyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛmti te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI ho adesua betumi aka yɛn ho a yɛwɔ ne yɛn nipadua ho mfonini, na dɛn ne akwan horow bi a yɛbɛfa so adi nkate bɔne biara a ebetumi asɔre ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wosua mmabunbere, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI ho ade a, ebetumi aka obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho ne nipadua ho mfonini, efisɛ mmabun betumi anya aniwu, aniwu, anaa ahobammɔ a wonni wɔ wɔn nipadua anaa nna mu akwahosan ho nkate. Akwan a wɔfa so di nkate bɔne ho dwuma no bi ne nipadua mu nneɛma pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, osuahu ahorow a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata, nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ atemmu a wɔde bɛma, na wɔama nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee de adi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma na wɔayi anansesɛm afi hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmɔden bɛn na aban ahorow, amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akuw rebɔ de adi mmabun a, wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ahosiesie, ne wɔn a wɔtɔn wɔn wɔ Intanɛt so no ho dwuma, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ahobammɔ ne yiyedi wɔ dijitaal mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Aban ahorow, amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akuw reyɛ adwuma de adi mmabun nna mu ɔbrasɛe ne wɔn a wɔtɔn wɔn wɔ Intanɛt so ho dwuma: Mmra ne nea wɔde di dwuma: Mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de ako atia nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ahosiesie, ne aguadi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so, ne akwan a wɔfa so hyɛ mmra no mu den de di wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no asɛm. Nhumu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu ɔsatu a wɔde bɛma de ama mmabun tumi anya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw ma wɔahu na wɔabɔ amanneɛ wɔ intanɛt so dwumadie ne ayayadeɛ ho. Mmoa dwumadie: Mmoa dwumadie ne mmoa nhama a wɔde besi hɔ de mmoa, afotuo, ne ahobanbɔ ama mmabun a wɔanya osuahu wɔ intanɛt so a wɔde wɔn di dwuma anaa wɔtɔn wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na ɛsɛ sɛ mefa ntɛmtɛm nnuru a wodi si nyinsɛn ano bere a mensi ano kwan ansan na medi mpa mu agoru?
answer_twi_source: Nea broni ka no 'Levonorgestrel': Dɔnhwere 72 (nna 3) mu. Nea broni ka no 'Uliristal aceteta (ella): Dɔnhwere 120 (nna 5) mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ manya nyinsɛn ne awo a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔyem betumi ayɛ nneɛma bi de ahyɛ nyinsɛn ne awo a ahoɔden wom ho nkuran denam: Wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ daa ansa na wɔawo wɔn na wɔadi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nyansahyɛ ahorow akyi. Aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, protein a ɛnyɛ den, ne calcium pii wom a wubedi. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛkɔ so ayɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛnyɛ den pii a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo apene so. Kwati nneɛma a epira te sɛ nsa, tawa, ne nnubɔne a wɔde gye wɔn ani. Adwennwen a wobedi ho dwuma denam akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, asetra mu mmoa, ne afotu a wɔde ma sɛ ɛho hia a. Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ awo, nufu a wɔde ma, ne mmofra a wɔawo wɔn foforo hwɛ ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛte nka sɛ wɔasiesie wɔn ho na wɔama wɔn tumi ama awofoyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a mmabun hyia bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu,nna mu yare a yɛtwa no tia sɛ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mfe a wɔadi anohyeto: Mmara betumi ahyɛ mfe a ɛba fam koraa a wɔde benya nnwuma bi, asiw mmabun ahofadi ne gyinaesi ano. Awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ: Aman ahorow bi hyɛ awofo pene ma mmabun na ama wɔanya nnwuma ahorow, na ebetumi asiw wɔn kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ na wɔabu wɔn kokoam hokwan ahorow so. Ahintasɛm a wonni: Wɔ mmeae a kokoam ahobammɔ  yɛ mmerɛw no, mmabun betumi asuro sɛ wobebu kokoam nsɛm so na wɔayɛ nyiyim, na ama wɔagyae nnwuma a ɛho hia a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Anohyeto ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho: Mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nyinsɛn a woyi gu, te sɛ mmara nhyeso wom ne animtiaabu betumi de mmabun akwahosan ne wɔn yiyedi ato asiane mu, na ɛde nneyɛe a ahobammɔ nnim ne nea enye a efi mu ba aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma kokoam mmoa akuw, telefon so frɛ, anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔyɛ awofo titiriw.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wɔde boa kokoam ni: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG Helpline): 0244312151 (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8am-5pm) na woanya kokoam mmoa ne nsɛm. marie stopes Ghana :marie frɛ -0302241517 de mmoa ma mmabun . YMK App wɔ cyber counselor a wɔatete wɔn a wɔde kokoam mmoa ma mmabun a wɔyem. Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa 'adoelscent frinedly servive provider' wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea no betumi de wo abɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ no ho de mmoa ama mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ betumi adi anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Fa nsɛm a edi mu a nhwehwɛmu a egyina adanse so gyina akyi ma na ama anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no ayera. Hyɛ nsusuii a ɛmu dɔ ho nkuran denam nsɛm a wubebisa ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkasa tia gyidi ahorow. Fa nhwɛso ahorow a wotumi ka ho asɛm ne ankorankoro nsɛm di dwuma kyerɛkyerɛ nsusuii atitiriw mu na yi anansesɛm ahorow fi hɔ. Ma hokwan ahorow ma atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ma wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa abenfoɔ nsusu ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔwɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛkyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa nkate ne asetra mu nsunsuanso a nyinsɛn a woyi gu nya ho? (nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu betumi anya nkate ne asetra mu nsunsuanso ahorow. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛma nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ni: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): Ebia wɔn wɛbsaet anaa mmoa telefon no wɔ nneɛma a ɛfa nkate ne asetra mu nsunsuanso a nyinsɛn a woyi gu de ba ho. Frɛ kokoam wɔ 0244312151 (Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-awia 5). Marie stopes Ghana:0302241517, kɔ wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa mmabun akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ a ɔwɔ akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛbɛn wo no nkyɛn na woanya nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu nneɛma a ɛkanyan wɔn a ebetumi ama wɔanya atenka a emu yɛ den, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so agyina nneɛma a ɛkanyan wɔn yi ano?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu: Nhwɛsoɔ ne nneɛma a ɛtaa kanyan no a wɔbɛhunu denam wɔn ho a wɔbɛdwene ne journaling so. Kwati Anaasɛ Nea Wɔtew So: Nneɛma a wonim sɛ ɛkanyan obi a wɔbɛte so anaasɛ tebea horow a ɛkanyan atenka a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛkwati. Ahokokwaw a Wɔde Gyina Ano: Akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene si biribi foforɔ so, anaa ɔhaw ahorow a wodi ho dwuma a wɔbɛyɛ de adi nkate a emu yɛ den ho dwuma bere a nneɛma a ɛkanyan obi  no sɔre. Mmoa a Wɔhwehwɛ: Ɔpanyin, ɔyaresafoɔ, anaa kuo a wɔboa obi a wogye no di a wo ne no bɛkasa de anya akwankyerɛ ne adansedie wɔ sɛnea wogyina nneɛma a ɛkanyan no ano no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mafa nyinsɛn ano sie akyi ayaresa mu na madi haw anaa dadwen biara ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie pii wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woafa mpopɔ akyi ayaresa mu: Mmoa Ntelefon: Ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ Planned Parenthood anaa mpɔtam hɔ awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa ntelefon ma kɔkoam mmoa ne nsɛm. Mmoa ntelefon no bi ne 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN deɛ), ne PPA Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228). Afotu Dwumadie: Ayaresabea ne ahyehyɛdeɛ pii ma afotuo dwumadie titiriw ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔapɔ wɔn yafunu. Mmoa Akuo: Susu mmoa ekuo a wobɛkɔ, baabi a wubetumi ahyia afoforo a wɔafa tebea a ɛte saa mu na wɔama wo afotu ne nkuranhyɛ. Intanɛt So Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ mmeae pii wɔ hɔ a wubetumi ahunu nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa a ɛfa mpopɔ akyi ayaresa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma ne nea wobenya ho, na makamfo awo hokwan ne ahofadi a ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Edi kan, Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua amammerɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ adwene ahodoɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano ne awoɔ hokwan ho, na te sɛdeɛ ɛbɛtumi anya suban ne nneyɛeɛ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ ase. Nsɛnnennen a Wɔde Di Dwuma: kasa tia animtiaabu ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, anansesɛm a wobeyi afi hɔ, ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso no so. Fa wo ho hyɛ Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu: Wo ne abusua mufo, atipɛnfo, mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo mmɔ nkɔmmɔ a obu wom de kamfo awo hokwan ahorow, ahofadi, ne nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya. Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri kyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam a ɛde nsɛm a edi mu ma wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho. Kɔka ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, nnwuma a mmabun di anim, anaa awo hokwan ho ɔsatu ahorow a ɛyɛ adwuma de ma ankorankoro nyinaa nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie kɔ anim, a amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfoɔ suban mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛboa ma wonya adwene mu akwahosan pa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akura wɔn adwene mu yiyedi mu anaasɛ wɔama atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ Pa: Abusuabɔ a ɛboa a wo ne abusuafo ne nnamfo benya. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛyɛ no daa betumi ama adwene atu mpɔn na ama adwennwen so atew. Asetra a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Aduan a ahoɔden wom a wubedi, nna a ɛfata, ne nneɛma a epira te sɛ nnubɔne ne nsa a wobɛkwati. Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ: Bere a wubegye ama dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, akwan horow a wobɛfa so agye w’ahome a wode bedi dwuma, na woadi adwennwen ho dwuma. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ worepere a, wo ne ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di bɛkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ka deɛn nti a intersectionality wo hia na susuw sɛnea nnipasu ahorow betumi anya osuahu ahorow a ɛfa GBV ho so nsunsuanso no ho.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa sukuu ɔfotufoɔ bɛtumi aboa wo ama woadi GBV nsɛm ho dwuma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne ɔpanyin bi a megye no adi akasa afa GBV ho a mente nka sɛ wɔabu no atɛn anaasɛ m’ani awu? (nnipa a wɔbɛboa wɔn, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wɔde sua) .
answer_twi_source: di w’akwahosan ho dwumayɛni anaa sukuu ayaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo di nkitaho, ɛsɛ sɛ saa nkurɔfo yi te ase na wonni atɛn. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wode bedi dwuma: Wubetumi de afi ase: "Biribi bi wɔ hɔ a ɛho hia a ɛsɛ sɛ meka ho asɛm, na mete ehu/aniwu nka." Fa wadwene si suban no so, ɛnyɛ wo ho (sɛ nhwɛso no, "Ɔkwan a X fa so ma mete ehu nka").
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mpɔtam bɛboa 'marginalized groups' (te sɛ dɛmdifoɔ/ Odwannifoɔ (refugees)) wɔ SRH mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔhyia nyiyimu, kasa haw, ne aniwuo kam (stigma). Mpɔtam betumi aboa denam: Mmoa a ɛka obiara ho (inclusive services). Nteteeɛ ma ayaresafoɔ. Kasa mmoa (Interpretation). Mpɔtam amanneɛbɔ ne mmoa (Outreach programs). Akasamafo-mmoa (Advocacy) ma mmara pa. Nkabom a yɛne mpɔtam mpanyimfoɔ bɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ nya m’adwene akwahosan ne m’akwahosan so nsunsuannso?
answer_twi_source: Wo nna betumi aka w’adwene akwahosan ne wo yiyedi kɛse. Osuahunu pa te sɛ gye a wogye tom ne nea wosi so dua betumi ama adwenemyare pa anya nkɔso, bere a nyiyim ne animtiaabu betumi de adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw aba. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na wogye wo tom wɔ wo nipasu mu a, ebetumi ama obu ama wo ho na woanya asetra mu abotɔyam nyinaa, bere a sɛ wunya pow anaasɛ woyɛ nea enni mu a, ebetumi ama woanya aniwu, tew a wobɛtew wo ho, ne ahoyeraw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm anaa tebea ahorow a ebetumi afa nna mu ɔbrasɛe, nhyɛso, anaa ɔhaw ho nhwɛso ahorow bi ne dɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu tebea horow yi na wɔayɛ ho biribi wɔ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom na ɛboa so?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm anaa tebea horow a ebetumi afa nna mu ɔbrasɛe, nhyɛso, anaa ɔhaw ho nhwɛso bi ne: Nkɔso a Wɔmpɛ: Bere a obi nya nna mu nkɔso anaa ɔde ne nsa ka obi foforo a ɔmpene so. Nsa anaa Nnubɔne Ho Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Bere a wɔde nsa anaa nnubɔne di dwuma de sɛe obi adwene anaa tumi a obetumi apene so sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nna mu dwumadi no. Nneyɛe a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Bere a obi de nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, ahunahuna, anaa nhyɛso di dwuma de hyɛ obi ma ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ nna mu. Intanɛt so Ɔhaw: Sɛ obi de nna ho nkrasɛm anaa mfonini ahorow mena a ɔmpene so, anaasɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛ Intanɛt so ahosiesie anaa ɔde di dwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi aboa me ma me ne LGBTQ+-adamfofa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no adi nkitaho? (LGBTQ+ akwahosan asoɛe, akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ).
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi ayɛ tebea ahotoso wom na wɔboa a ɛhyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔasusuw wɔn suahu ahorow, wɔn haw ahorow, ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi ayɛ tebea a ahoto wom denam: Mmabun haw, nsɛmmisa, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma ho a wɔde nsiyɛ ne aso tie wɔn a wɔremmu atɛn anaasɛ wɔrenkasa ntia wɔn. Mmabun nkate ne wɔn adwene a wobegye atom, nsunsuanso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm betumi anya wɔ wɔn nkate, obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho, ne nkitahodie so a wobegye atom. Akwankyerɛ, afotu, ne awerɛhyem a egyina wɔn ankasa osuahu ne gyinapɛn ahorow so a wɔde bɛma, bere a wɔkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi ne gyinaesi tumi nso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya mmoa ntɛm wɔ intanɛt so (online crisis intervention) anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, pii wɔ hɔ a wubetumi ne wɔn akasa (chat) seesei ara. Ɛma wonya mmoa ntɛm wɔ haw bere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ma mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔreyɛ awofo wɔ STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nnwuma a wobenya ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔreyɛ awofo ho esiane asɛyɛde afoforo ne mmerɛwyɛ ahorow nti: Mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔyɛ awofo betumi ahyia atemmu anaa nyiyim a ɛfa wɔn awo ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, na ɛbɛka wɔn kwan a wɔfa so nya nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛnyɛ atemmu. Ebia nea ɛka abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow ho ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔkari pɛ wɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wodi wɔn ho so ne kokoamsɛm ne asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn mma akwahosan ne yiyedi ho ban no ho. Mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma awofo de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔpene so wɔ tebea horow bi mu, titiriw wɔ aduruyɛ mu akwan horow anaa nea wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ma mmofra nkumaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama akyerɛkyerɛ hyeɛ hyehyɛ ama nnamfo, hokafoɔ ne afoforo  aa wɔnni m'abusua mu senea wɔ bɛ bu mekokoam abrabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Hyehyɛ ahyeɛ ɛbu wokokoam/w'ahodeso. Kyerɛ deɛ wopɛ ne deɛ wompɛ. Kasa pintinn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ama mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ntease wom?
answer_twi_source: Bu mmabun ahofadi ne akwannya  a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔde ama no yɛ nokware, egyina adanse so, na enni animhwɛ anaa atemmu biara. Bu mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn kokoam nsɛm bere a woresusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate ho no. Sesa nsɛm ma ɛne mmabun ankorankoro amammerɛ, kasa, ne nkɔso ahiade ahorow hyia. Ma mmabun tumi ma wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu denneennen na wɔkamfo wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow. Ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so a wɔbɛfa so na wɔabu sɛnea wobetumi anya bi no sɛ adum atitiriw no mu biako
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow nya mmabun a wobenya nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidie ahorow betumi anya mmabun kwan a wɔfa so nya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma so nkɛntɛnso denam adwene a wobenya wɔ nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ho nneyɛe ho so nkɛntɛnso so. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidie ahorow bi betumi abɔ nna mu apomoden ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho animtiaa anaasɛ asiw nnwuma bi a wobenya ano, bere a afoforo betumi aboa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔhwɛ a edi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na metumi ahwɛ kwan wɔ bere a matu nyinsɛn agu akyi no? (honam ne nkate fam) .
answer_twi_source: Nipadua mu Ahotɔ: Ebia wobɛte akisikuru (cramping), mogya a ɛbɛtɔ wo, na wo ho ayɛ wo yaw kakra nna kakraa bi. Wo duruyɛfo de akwankyerɛ bɛma wɔ ɛyaw ano aduru ne sɛnea wo ho bɛtɔ wo ho. Nkate mu Ahotɔ: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya nkate ahorow bi bere a woatu nyinsɛn agu akyi, te sɛ ahotɔ, awerɛhow, anaa afobu. Sɛ wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo bi kasa a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woadi wo nkate horow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ,wɔ ahomegye, ahomegye bere, ne bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome wɔ adwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ ahomegye bere, ne bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome wɔ adwuma ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahomegye bere: Ɛdenam mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛfo ho mmara ne nnwuma gyinapɛn ahorow so no, adwumayɛfo a wonnii mfe aduonu wɔ hokwan sɛ wogye wɔn ahome daa wɔ bere a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ adwuma mu no mu na ama wɔatumi asiw ɔbrɛ ano na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn yiyedi. Adidi mu ahomegye: Wɔtaa hwehwɛ sɛ adwumawuranom de ahomegye bere anaa awia aduan ma adwumayɛfo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so bere a wɔde nnɔnhwerew dodow bi ayɛ adwuma awie no, na wɔma wonya bere de gye wɔn ahome na wonya aduan. Bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome: Mmabun betumi anya hokwan sɛ wogye wɔn ahome esiane nneɛma te sɛ yare, abusua mu emergency, anaa wɔn ankasa ntease ahorow nti, sɛnea wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ adwumayɛ ho apam, adwumayɛfo apam, anaa adwumayɛ ho mmara mu no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na kuro manfoɔ betumi afa so de mboa ama wɔn a wɔresi sɔ a sɛbi wɔn ho a didem a so benya bambɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛhɔ yɛ fɛ na woanya mboa kuo a ɛbɛkɔ so daa?
answer_twi_source: Atuhoamafoɔ Berɛ (wɔn a wɔboa/wɔn a wɔkyerɛ kwan). Sika a yɛ boano.ɔkasama dwuna a tia nyiyimu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahoɔden ne ahotoso a mede bɛko atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso bere a meda so ara ne m’atipɛnfo nya abusuabɔ pa?
answer_twi_source: Nya wo ho a wobɛte ase: Te wo gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a wode di kan, ne ahye ahorow a ebetumi akyerɛ gyinaesi kwan na ama woatumi agyina ano no ase. Ntetee a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka sie ho: Fa nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ den di dwuma na ama woatumi de ahotoso ada wo hye ne nea wopɛ adi akyerɛ w’atipɛnfo. Hwehwɛ abusuabɔ a ɛboa: Fa nnamfo a wobu wo gyinaesi ahorow na wɔboa no twa wo ho hyia, na ma w’atipɛnfo tebea pa. Fa w’adwene si w’ankasa nkɔso so: Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wunya obu, ahofadi, ne ahotoso wɔ wo ho mu, te sɛ anigyede, agumadi, anaa adebɔ mu nneɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adɛn nti na nkitahodie pa ho hia ma adwene mu apɔwmuden 'mental health'?
answer_twi_source: Ɛboa ma woka w'adwene. Wote afoforo ase. Siesie asɛm. Hyɛ ahotosoɔ den. Te ɔhaw 'stress' so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Wɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Dua ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho adwuma titire te sɛ "Agoo SHE+" intanɛt so atenaeɛ denam (5100, YENKASA) Nnɔmba a wɔmfa hwee nto mu(0800202010), "GHS-YMK" ne nea ɛkeka ho ne hokwan a wowɔ ma akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abɛɛfo mfidie 'Technology' di de boa mmabun ma wonya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata, a telehealth ne online resources ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo mfidie te sɛ telehealth ma mmabun kwan ma wonya ɔhwɛ fi wɔn fie. Wei yi akwansidie te sɛ lore a wobɛfo ɛnam beebia wɔte nti. Telehealth boa ma wo ne ayaresafoɔ do nkɔmmɔ denam video consultations, messaging, ne phone calls. Wei boa wɔn a wɔtete nkurase paa. Online resources te sɛ websites so ma nimdie a ɛfata. Mmabun betumi ne ayaresafoɔ adi nkɔmmɔ wɔ online (appointment scheduling) na wagye mmoa ɛhia. Na ɛte mmerɛsɛeɛ so. Wɔde elcvtronic health records (EHRs) sie mmabun apɔwmuden ho nsɛm so yie. Wei ma yehu sɛ abɛɛfo mfidie di dwuma yie wɔ mmabun apɔwmudenhwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ma wɔate wɔn nna mu ne awo hokwan ahorow ase?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so aboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ase ni: Nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee: Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne mpenatwe ho. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware: Ma obi nya nna mu akwahosan ne dɛmdi ho nimdie a wotumi de ho to so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom: Tsɔre tia nsusuii hunu na fa tema di nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma. Nhwɛso pa: Ka nnipa a wɔadi dɛm a wɔwɔ nna mu asetena a ahoɔden wom na ɛma abotɔyam ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsakraeɛ bɛn na ɛba mmaa awoɔ mu wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkosua: Wɔ mmabun berɛ mu no, nkosu no fi ase nyin na ɛma nkosua fi mu ba. Wɔfrɛ saa adeyɛ yi sɛ ovulation. Awotoa: Awotoa no nyin na enyin de siesie ne ho ma nyinsɛn a ebetumi aba. Fallopian Tubes: Saa ntini yi nyin kɛse na edi dwuma titiriw wɔ nkosua a efi awotoa mu kɔ awotoa no mu no mu. Vagina: ɛtwɛ no nyin yie. Ɛsan nso yi nsuo a ɛboa nna mu agorɔ. Nufoɔ: Nufoɔ fi ase nyin nkakrankara hyehyɛ nsuo. Nkwammoa bi yɛfrɛ ɔmo estrogen ne pregesterone na adi saa dwuma yi nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ nkabom akuo (community-based organizations) ne sukuu ahodoɔ, ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, aban mpanimfoɔ, ne afoforɔ a asɛm no fa wɔn bɔ mu yɛ adwuma de hyɛ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ den na ama eduru mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa pii nkyɛn?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkabom akuo (CBOs) ne nnipa ahodoɔ a asɛm no fa wɔn ho bɔ mu yɛ adwuma de hyɛ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ den ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa. Wɔne sukuu ahodoɔ yɛ adwuma bɔɔ, de nna ho nteteeɛ a ɛdi mu ma, ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nneɛma ne nteteeɛ, na wɔkasa ma wɔde SRH adesua to adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu. CBOs ne ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ nso yɛ adwuma bom de hwɛ sɛ mmofra benya ayaresa a ɛfata a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛnya, denam akwankyerɛ, nteteeɛ, ne mmoa a wɔde ma so. Bio nso, wɔne aban adwumakuo ahodoɔ hyia de kasa ma mmara a ɛboa mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa SRH ho kwan na wɔkyekyɛ sika de boa SRH nhyehyɛeɛ. Sɛ wɔne afoforɔ yɛ adwuma a, ɛma CBOs tumi nya nimdeɛ, sika, ne nkabom ahodoɔ a ɛboa ma wɔn adwuma no yɛ kɛseɛ na ɛda so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so ama mmabun a wontumi nnya awofo pene sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wontumi nnya awofo pene sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu no betumi anya akwan foforo a wobetumi afa so a egyina mmara ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ wɔn mantam mu so. Ebia saa akwan yi bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa atemmufo kwan so anaasɛ wobenya kokoam ɔhwɛ afi wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔde nnwuma ma mmofra nkumaa a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a ɛda aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, insurance adwumakuw ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne amanaman ntam mmoa a wɔde ma ntam no betumi aboa ma wɔatrɛw apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ne apɔwmuden ho insurance a mmabun nya mu na wɔahyɛ wɔn sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetra mu nkabom ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de nhyehyɛe ahorow adi dwuma de ama apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn, atrɛw insurance a wɔde tua ho ka mu, aboa sika a wɔbɔ ma mmusua a wonnya sika pii, na wɔayɛ apɔwmuden ho ka ho nhyehyɛe na ama nnwuma no ayɛ nea ne bo yɛ den na wobetumi anya bi. Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nnwuma a wɔatew ne bo so anaasɛ wɔmfa hwee mma, hyehyɛ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow anaa apɔwmuden akuw a wɔde fa baabiara, na wɔne sukuu ahorow, mmabun mmeae, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako de adu nnipa a wonnya mmoa yiye nkyɛn. Insurance adwumakuw ahorow betumi ayɛ apɔwmuden ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔde sika a wɔde tua ho ka nyinaa, sika a wɔbɔ a ne bo nyɛ den, ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano ho mfaso, ne adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne amanaman ntam mmoa a wɔde ma no betumi de sika ama apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, aboa mpɔtam hɔ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, na wɔde wɔn sika ahyɛ ano aduru foforo mu de adi akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ mmabun yiyedi ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa me hokafo yiyedi bere a mehwɛ m’ankasa de nso?
answer_twi_source: Wo hokafo yiyedi a wobɛboa bere a wode w’ankasa de di kan no hwehwɛ sɛ wokari pɛ na wo ne afoforo di nkitaho. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ a ɛfa wɔn ho wɔn ho ahiade, nea ɛhaw wɔn, ne nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba ho nkuran. Fa tema, adansedi, ne atie a wode nsiyɛ ma bere a wo hokafo no rehyia nsɛnnennen no. Nanso, kae sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wobɛhwɛ wɔn yiyedi, na ɛho hia sɛ wukura ahye mu na wohwɛ w’ankasa w’adwene, nkate, ne nipadua akwahosan so. Hyɛ suban pa, nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho, ne sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na nna ho hia wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho hia kɛseɛ ma onyin, nkɔsoɔ, ne apɔwmuden. Ɛboa ma adwene no yɛ adwuma yie, ɛma obi nya tumi wɔ n'atenka so, ne nipadua so nyin.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka no 'media literacy skills' a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu wɔ kwan pa mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nea broni ka no 'media' nkɛntɛnso ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ yiye ho, na wɔahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wonbisa nsɛm na wɔnhwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so. Wobetumi nso ankasa ayɛ nsusuwii a ɛmu dɔ ho nhwɛso na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka 'media literacy' ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi na ɛnyɛ atɛn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de meho ahye mu a ɔka obiara ho kɛse na mede mmoa ama obi a ɔwɔ GBV a ne nipasu anaa ne fibea yɛ soronko wɔ me de ho? (ahiade ahorow a wɔte ase, osuahu ahorow a wobu) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛboa obi a ɔrehyia GBV a ɛsono ne deɛ nie: Ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ a wobɛte aseɛ: Hu sɛ osuahu a ɛfa GBV ho no bɛtumi ayɛ soronko kɛseɛ a egyina onipa ko a ɔyɛ ne baabi a ɔteɛ so. Nhwehwɛmu na sua ɔhaw pɔtee a nnipa ahorow hyia no ho ade. Osuahu ahorow a Wobebu: Tie a wunni atɛn na gye wɔn asɛm no di. Mfa no sɛ wote biribiara a wɔafa mu no ase. Fa Mmoa Ma: Boa wɔn ma wɔne nneɛma a ɛfata amammerɛ a ebetumi de mmoa a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ama wɔn no nni nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na mayɛ kɔmputa so ayayade anaa Intanɛt so ayayade ho biribi?
answer_twi_source: Hu Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Intanɛt so ayayade betumi ayɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ yaw, anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ yaw a wɔde bɛto hɔ. Mma Mmuae: Kwati sɛ wo ne osisifo no bedi nkitaho anaasɛ wubebua nsɛm a enye. Sie Adanse: Fa kɔmputa so asisifo no ho mfonini anaa kyerɛwtohɔ sie na ama woanya adanse. Block and Report: Platform dodow no ara wɔ akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so asiw nea ɔde di dwuma no kwan na wɔabɔ nneyɛe a ɛyɛ ayayade ho amanneɛ. Wo ne Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di Nkasa: Ka wo suahu kyerɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa ɔfotufo bi na ama woanya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ. Ma wo ho nwwo: Wɔn a wɔyɛ basabasa wɔ Intanɛt so no taa pɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ade, enti sɛ wobɛyɛ komm na woantua so ka a, ɛho hia. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Sɛ tebea no mu yɛ den anaa wote nka sɛ worehunahuna wo a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade bi betumi ayɛ: Nhyɛ anaasɛ tumi a obi de di wo so. Anibere anaasɛ pɛ-sɛ-wode-obi-yɛ-wo-dea-nkutoo. Nipadua anaasɛ nkateɛ mu basabasayɛ. Nhyɛ sɛ wɔne obi bɛda. Sɛ wosiw wo kwan na wo ne wo nnamfo anaa w'abusuafoɔ ankasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu, nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa ho wɔ yɛn man anaa mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu, hu, ne ayaresa ho no gu ahorow gyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Mpɛn pii no, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi a wɔde bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu, ahu, na wɔasa 'STI' ahorow akyi, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobenya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye afi onipa no hɔ ansa na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu anaasɛ wɔde ayaresa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma ama LGBTQ+ mmabun mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, mprempren LGBTQ+ mmeae anaa akuw biara nni hɔ a wogye tom
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ, de adi dwuma, na wɔasusuw akwan a wɔfa so siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, te sɛ wɔn nhumu, osuahu, ne nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔahyɛ nsakrae ho nkuran mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ akwan horow a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho a wɔde besiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano wɔ akwan horow so, de adi dwuma, na wɔasusuw ho. Wobetumi de wɔn nhumu, suahu, ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔka akyerɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma de ahwɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no di mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ne nokwasɛm ahorow ho dwuma. Mmabun nso betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim de ma nkurɔfo hu na wɔhyɛ nsakrae a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ne adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ho nkuran. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhyiam ahorow anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo, wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa ahodwiriw ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu, na wɔde atipɛnfo mmoa ne biakoyɛ ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no. Ɛnam wɔn nne ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse so no, mmabun betumi adi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ akwan a wɔfa so siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano a ɛka obiara ho, ɛyɛ nea etu mpɔn a wɔbɛfa so asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔaboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma titiriw a ɛwɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ den na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de saa nneɛma yi adi dwuma wɔ amammerɛ ne asasesin ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den na ɛyɛ adwuma ma mmabun SRH no wɔ nneɛma atitiriw pii: Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ a Ɛkɔ Akyiri: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a ɛfata mfe a obi adi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a wɔde ma. Nnwuma a Wotumi Nya: Hwɛ sɛ SRH dwumadie no wɔ hɔ, ne boɔ yɛ den, na mmabun betumi anya wɔ asasesin mu. Mmabun Mmabun Ɔhwɛ: Nnwuma a wɔde ma wɔ mmeae a ammu atemmu, kokoamsɛm, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun hokwan ne nea wɔpɛ. Ahintasɛm ne Kokoam Nsɛm: Mmabun kokoam nsɛm  a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban bere a wɔrekɔ SRH nnwuma mu no. Ntetee a Wɔde Ma a Wɔde Ma: Wɔbɛtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu, a ɛnyɛ nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun ahiade soronko ho ama. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mpɔtamfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ SRH dwumadie no nhyehyɛɛ, wɔde bɛma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu de ahwɛ sɛ ɛfata amammerɛ na wɔgye tom. Nhyehyɛe ne Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Nhyehyɛe ne sikasɛm akwan a ɛde mmabun SRH di kan na edi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nya ɔhwɛ pa ne ɔhwɛ pa ho dwuma ho kamfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nea broni ka no 'community outreach programs' no ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ yɛ adwuma bom de ma mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsiw 'STI/HIV' ano no anya nkɔsoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nea broni ka no 'community outreach programs'  ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ yɛ adwuma bom de ma mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw 'STI/HIV' ano no nya nkɔsoɔ denam: Wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma bom de 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne afotuo dwumadie ma wɔ nhyiamu a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn, mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ, ne ayaresabea ahodoɔ a wɔde fa nnipa mu. Sukuu ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua nhyehyɛe, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ahɔho kasa ahorow a ɛfa 'STI/HIV' ano a wosiw, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne abusuabɔ pa ho bɛma. Yɛne ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina gyidi so, mmabun akuw, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a wɔyɛ adwuma bom de du nnipa ahorow ahorow nkyɛn na wɔhyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran denam nneɛma ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata kasa ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ, ne asetena mu nkɛntɛnsoɔfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de ama nkrasɛm a ɛfa 'STI/HIV' a wɔsiw ano, sɔhwɛ, ne ayaresa ho no ayɛ kɛseɛ denam ɔmanfoɔ som ho amanneɛbɔ, sohyial 'media' ɔsatuo, ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a ɛsisi so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na etumi aboa paa yie wɔ nhunu mu, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nkuranhyɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔmden a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' ho wɔ mmabun a watu akɔtena mmeammea foforɔ ne wɔn a wɔtutututu akwan kɔ baabi foforɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Yɛbɛfa akwan bi te sɛ: Nnwuma a atipɛnfoɔ di anim, mpɔtam nkyerɛkyerɛ ahodoɔ, nhyehyeɛ emu yɛ mmerɛ a ɛma kwan mma babun biaa nya akwanya kɔhwɛ wɔn awoɔ apɔmden a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' mu ne amammerɛ nwoma sua ho nneɛma. Yei boa wɔn ma wɔsisi gyinaeɛ pa wɔ apɔmden ne asetena ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara kwan so nsunsuanso bi wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobu mmabun kokoam hokwan ahorow so no so?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobu mmabun kokoam hokwan ahorow so no betumi ahyia mmara mu nsunsuanso, a nea ɛka ho ne nteɛso a wɔn tumi krataa bagua no de bɛma wɔn, ɔmanfo mmara mu asɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ asɛnnibea wɔ nneɛma a wɔsɛee no esiane kokoamsɛm a wɔabu so nti, ne nsɛmmɔnedie ho sobo a wobetumi de abɔ wɔn sobo sɛ mmara so bu no yɛ kokoam nsɛm ho mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔabu so a. Bio nso, wobetumi de akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow asodi ato wɔn so wɔ kokoamsɛm a wɔn adwumayɛfo anaa wɔn ananmusifo abu so no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'advertising' (dawurobɔ) ka sɛdeɛ yehu ahoɔfɛ ne nna mu akɔnnɔ?
answer_twi_source: Gyinapɛn: Nsɛm a wɔde bɔ dawuro fa ahoɔfɛ ho no tumi ma nnipa nya adwen a ɛnnyɛ nokorɛ.Sɛ nea obi hu ne nipadua : Ɛma wɔn te nka sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ fɛ titiriw mmofra a wɔanyin no. Products: Wɔkyerɛ sɛ nneɛma de kyerɛ sɛ ɛbɛma wɔn ho ayɛ fɛ. Mmarima ne mmaa asɛyɛdeɛ : Wɔkyerɛ mmarima ne mmaa wɔ kwan bi so. Wei tumi ka sɛdeɛ yɛte nka fa yɛn ho ne yɛn ahoɔden (self-esteem) ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmfua ahorow bɛn na wɔde di dwuma ma nnipa a wɔne wɔn ho da (LGBTQ+)?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ yɛ asɛmfua a wɔde kata nnipa a wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ /anaasɛ wɔn bɔbeasu nyɛ heterosexual anaa cisgender (a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a wɔde ama wɔn wɔ awo mu). Nkyekyɛmu ni: Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual: Wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ atifi hɔ wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ mu. Transgender: Obi a ɛsono ne bɔbeasu wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde maa wɔn bere a wɔwoo no no ho. Queer: Wobetumi de adi dwuma sɛ asɛmfua a ɛtrɛw ama obiara a ɔnyɛ heterosexual anaa cisgender.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho mmoa ne afotu adwuma de adi ɛnanom akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma, a adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho mmoa denam: Wɔn a wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo bɛkasa afa wɔn nkate ne wɔn haw ahorow ho. Hwehwɛ a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, te sɛ ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo. Hotlines anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma de aboa ntɛm ara. Awofo nkumaa a wɔboa akuw a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a ebia adwenemyare ho nneɛma ka ho. Sukuu afotufo anaa mpanyimfo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ wɔn akwankyerɛ. Ɛnsɛ sɛ mmabun twentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ adwennwen, dadwen, anaa adwenemhaw ho wɔ nyinsɛn anaa awo akyi..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de abɛɛfo ntentan, intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, ne dijitaal nnwinnade adi dwuma de ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse na wɔako ama sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde bɛma?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo ntentan (Social media) ho nsɛm: Mmabun betumi de akwan te sɛ "Twitter", "Instagram", ne "TikTok" adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akyɛ nsɛm, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, akɔ atiefo pii nkyɛn na wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso adi nkitaho. Intanɛt so adesrɛ ne ɔsatuo: Digitals nnwinnadeɛ te sɛ "Change.org" ne "Avaaz" ma mmabun kwan ma wɔyɛ na wɔhyɛ adesrɛ, ɔsatuo, ne intanɛt so nneyɛeɛ ho nkuran de kamfo nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nsɛm kyerɛ, na ɛma wɔn nne yɛ kɛseɛ na wɔkyekye nkɔsoɔ. Dwumadi bi te sɛ "YOLO TV" so dwumadi ahorow di mmabun nsɛm pii ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ obi a ne bɔbeasu yɛ pɛ, ne bɔbeasu foforo, anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna pii ani begye wo ho? (yiw, nna ho akɔnnɔ nyinaa yɛ nea ɛfata) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛte nka sɛ woani gye  bɔbeasu foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun bɛtumi afa so ne wɔn ahokafo asusuw nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow adi dwuma de wɔn ahokafo asusuw nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware, obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne gyinaesi a wɔbom si. Ɛho hia sɛ ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔne wɔn ahokafo besusuw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho na wɔada nea wɔpɛ ne wɔn ahye a ɛfa nna a ahobammɔ wom ho adi. Sɛ wɔde akwanhwɛ ne ahye a emu da hɔ sisi hɔ, susuw akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so asiw nyinsɛn ano ho, na wɔabom apene akwan a wɔbɛfa so asiw ano so no betumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa wɔ kratafa koro wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Bio nso, sɛ wɔde nnamyɛ tie, tema, ne ntease di dwuma a, ebetumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛsow aba a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho na ahyɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda ahokafo ntam no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofoɔ, ahwɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo betumi adi wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛboa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran bere a wobu amammerɛ mu atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ bɛtumi adi dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔdi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛboa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran berɛ a wɔbu amammerɛ atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ denam: Wɔbɛma mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkateɛ a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, ne abusuabɔ a ɛwɔ mmusua, sukuu, ne mpɔtam hɔ tebea mu. Nkitahodi, ahotoso, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ho hia wɔ awofo ne mmofra ntam abusuabɔ mu a wosi so dua, na wɔma tebea a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Mmabun amammerɛ mu nipasu ne osuahu ahorow a wɔtraa ase a wobegye atom na wɔagye atom, nkɛntɛnso a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya wɔ wɔn adwene ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wobehu. Nhomasua a ɛkɔ so ne wɔn ho a wosusuw ho de kasa tia ankorankoro animhwɛ ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho, a wɔyɛ adwene a abue ne gye a wogye tom ho nhwɛso ma awo ntoatoaso a wɔyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam a ɛka obiara ho, ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛfata mfe a obi adi, a ɛne amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nea wɔpɛ hyia bere a wɔhyɛ nneyɛe ne gyinapɛn ahorow a egyina adanse so ho nkuran no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmabun ma wɔte wɔn kɔkoamunsɛm hokwan ase bere a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ahorow de ate wɔn kɔkoamunsɛm hokwan mu ase: Gye Apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wogye wɔn di: Mmabun betumi ne wɔn apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ akasa afa kɔkoamunsɛm dadwen ho, a wɔbetumi ama nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ. Nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma: Ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ Apɔmuden Nkyerɛkyerɛ Dwumadibea (Health Promotion Division) ne mmoa akuo taa ma nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛkasa fa kɔkoamunsɛm hokwan a ɛfata mmabun ho pɔtee. Intanɛt so nneɛma: Wɛbsaet te sɛ GHS.gov.gh
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa ɔhyɛ ne nhyɛso a wobehu ho no aka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, adwene mu apomoden  ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw basabasayɛ ano de ama mmabun tumi na wɔama wɔn yiyedi ne ahobammɔ anya nkɔso no ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nhyɛso a wobehu ho no aka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw basabasayɛ ano de ama mmabun tumi na wɔahyɛ wɔn yiyedi ne ahobammɔ ho nkuran. Sukuu ahorow betumi de adesua ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa ho ahyɛ wɔn adesua nhyehyɛe mu, de ntetee ama akyerɛkyerɛfo ne adwumayɛfo wɔ sɛnea wobehu na wɔayɛ ho biribi wɔ nhyɛso anaa nhyɛso ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ho, na wɔde mmoa nnwuma ama wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ nso bɛtumi de nhyiamu, mmoa akuo, ne nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene asi pene so nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔasiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So anohyeto anaa nsɛnnennen bi wɔ telehealth ho a wɔde bedi dwuma ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma mu akwanside ahorow: Intanɛt anaa mfiri a ɛfata a wonni no betumi asiw ankorankora binom kwan sɛ wɔmfa telefon so akwahosan ho nnwuma nni dwuma yiye. Nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔnyɛ: Ebia aduruyɛ mu tebea horow bi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ankasa nhwehwɛmu anaasɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hu yare a wontumi nyɛ wɔ akyirikyiri. Kokoam nsɛm ho haw: Ebia ayarefo bɛhaw wɔn ho wɔ wɔn ankasa akwahosan ho nsɛm ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm ho bere a wɔde dijitaal akwan redi dwuma de abisabisa wɔn nsɛm no. Insurance a wɔde tua ho ka: Ebia ɛnyɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma nyinaa na insurance tua ho ka bere a wɔde fa telehealth so de ma no, na nhyehyɛe a wɔde tua ho ka no betumi ayɛ soronko.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw ne asetra mu akuw mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa atia ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho gyinapɛn ahorow a epira denam: Kasa ne nneyɛe a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran a ɛkyerɛ obu ma ankorankoro bɔbeasu ne nea wɔda no adi no so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nhyiam ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho nhyehyɛe. Aseresɛm, nsɛm a wɔka, ne nneyɛe a ɛkyerɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho frɛ na wɔhyɛ afoforo nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ saa ara. Atipɛnfo a wɔkasa tia atetesɛm mu ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow na wɔda wɔn adwene adi nokwarem no a wɔbɛboa. Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwumayɛ ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi de di mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne nyiyim ho dwuma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Intanɛt ne digital adwenemyareɛ ho nneɛma ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt ne digital adwenemyareɛ ho nneɛma ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, a nea ɛka ho ne: Amanneɛbɔ wɛbsaet ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛde nsɛm, video, ne nkitahodiɛ nnwinnadeɛ a ɛfa adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛmti ho ma. Adwene mu akwahosan apps a ɛde nnwinnade a wɔde dwennwen nneɛma ho, adwene a wɔde si biribi so, adwene a wɔde di akyi, ne adwennwen ano aduru ma. Intanɛt so afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde virtual therapy nhyiam ahorow a ayaresa ho abenfo anaa afotufo a wɔwɔ tumi krataa ma. Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde boa wɔn ho a egyina wɛbsaet so ne akwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde bedi adwenemyare pɔtee bi te sɛ dadwen anaa adwenemhaw ho dwuma. Intanɛt so nhyiamu ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo a mmabun bɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔrehyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ osuahu ne afotuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo ne m’abusuafo anya abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den na ɛboa yie? (nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, atie a wɔde nsiyɛ, ahiade ahorow a wɔda no adi) .
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a emu yɛ den ho hia ma adwene mu yiedi: Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ: Sua sɛ wobɛda wo nsusuwii adi pefee na woatie afoforo denneennen. Atie a Wode Nsi: Tie nea afoforo reka no yiye na bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte wɔn adwene ase. Ahiade a Wobɛda Adi: Nsuro sɛ wobɛma w’adɔfo ahu nea wuhia afi wɔn hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nyinsɛn ho bammɔ nnuro ne mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛfata mmabun a, ɛho  nhia awofoɔ hɔ kwan wɔ mmea pii.  Na w'hwɛ wɔn wɔ obuo mu.  Asɛdeɛ: Sɛ wobɛsisi gyinaeɛ pa, wode bɛdi dwuma yie, na woahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛhia. Sɛdeɛ wubegye wo hokwan: Sua wo hokwan ho ade ne nyinsɛn ho bammɔ nnuro, suasua mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ mo mpɔtam hɔ no. Kasa pefee kyerɛ ayaresafoɔ no. Bɔ woho mmɔden ka deɛ ɛyɛ wo ɛne nea wopɛ kyerɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ berɛ a wobɛhyia wɔn.  Hwehwɛ akwan a wobɛfa so anya nkɔmmɔ ne nsɛm ho adesua. Sanso hwehwɛ akwan a wo ne awofoɔ bɛfa so anya adwene baako, na siesie nsɛm a ɛda mo ntam. Sɛ woko ɔhaw mu a, bisa wo mpanyimfoɔ ne nkyerɛkreɛfoɔ a ɔbɛtumi aboa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, a nhwehwɛ mu ne ayaresa ka ho, nya mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ano wɔ wiase nyinaa no so nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya, a nhwehwɛ mu ne ayaresa ka ho, nya mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsiw nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ano wɔ wiase nyinaa so nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ denam: Ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhunu STI, HIV, ne nyarewa foforɔ a ɛfiri nna mu ntɛm na wɔasa, a ɛtew yareɛ no so na ɛsiw nsɛnnennen ano. Nhumu, nimdeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano a wɔde di dwuma kɛse, a nea ɛka ho ne kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, PrEP, aduru a wɔde siw ano wɔ aduru a wɔde siw ano akyi (PEP), ne akwan a wɔfa so tew ɔhaw so wɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ asiane mu no mu. Mmoa dwumadie a ɛho hia te sɛ afotuo, atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne abusuabɔ a ɛda ɔhwɛ ntam a wɔde bɛma, de ama ankorankoro tumi ma wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne wɔn yiedie ho. Akwahosan ho nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ wɔ nnwuma a wobenya wɔ nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu, a mmea, mmabun, LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, ne nnipa a wɔte nkuraase anaa akyirikyiri mmeae ka ho no ho dwuma a wobedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ sɛ ɔbabun bere a merehwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a kokoamsɛm ne pene ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ ɔbabun a worehwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no, wowɔ hokwan ahorow a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ne pene nsɛm ho. Eyi betumi ayɛ hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wonya kokoam hwɛ, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi mfa w’akwahosan ho nsɛm nkyerɛ a wompene so, gye sɛ wɔ tebea horow bi a mmara kyerɛ mu (te sɛ bere a w’ahobammɔ ho nsɛm bi wɔ hɔ). Wowɔ hokwan nso sɛ wopene w’ankasa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe so, a awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ka ho, a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nsɛm pii mu, a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mede nnuro biara a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma yie? (akwankyerɛ pɔtee a ɛfa nnuro, kɔndɔm, ne nea ɛkeka ho)
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wɔde akwan bi a wɔtaa fa so siw nyinsɛn ano di dwuma yie no mu nsɛm ni: Nnuru a Wɔde Siw Awo ano: Fa no sɛnea w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo kyerɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ, mpɛn pii no bere koro mu da biara. Nnuru a wɔde yɛ nnuru a ɛyera betumi atew sɛnea etu mpɔn no so. Wo ne wo ɔyarehwɛfo nkasa mfa nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ sɛ wopa aduru bi a wɔde hyɛ wo mu a. Kɔndɔm: Fa kɔndɔm foforo di dwuma ma nna mu adeyɛ biara. kura ano no mu denneennen na ama mframa akɔ mu na bue kɔndɔm no mu akɔ fam wɔ ɔbarima no akyi a ɛteɛ no so. Kura kɔndɔm no ano wɔ ɔbarima no akyi bere a woabɔ wo ho ban awie no na twe fi mu bere a woda so ara gyina hɔ no. Kwati sɛ wode ngo anaa srade (te sɛ petroleum jelly) a ebetumi ama kɔndɔm ayɛ mmerɛw no bɛka ho. Patch: Fa patch foforo gu wo nan ase, yafunu, w’akyi atifi, anaa wo nsa so (egyina brand no so) honam ani a ɛho tew na ɛyɛ nwunu dapɛn biara. Di akwankyerɛ a ɛfa baabi a wode besi ne nea woyi fi hɔ ho no akyi yiye. Ring: Fa ring no hyɛ wo vagina mu wɔ wo brayɛ mu na hyɛ no daa adapɛn 3. Yi ring no dapɛn 1, a mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ wo bra. San fa ring foforo hyɛ mu bere a woagye dapɛn no akwamma awie no. Injectables: Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo de tuo no gu wo nsa anaa wo akyi asram 3 biara. Kae: Kenkan akwankyerɛ pɔtee a ɛka ɔkwan a woapaw no ho bere nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asi nyinsɛn a mempɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn a wɔmpɛ ano. Akwan titiriw bi ni: Nkwammoaa a wɔde siw awo ano: Saa akwan yi de hormone di dwuma de siw ovulation (egg release) ano. nhwɛsoɔ ne nnuru a wɔde kum mmadwoa, nnuru a wɔde twitwiw ne nea wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu Akwan a wɔfa so siw ano: Saa honam fam akwanside ahorow yi siw mmadwoa kwan sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu. Nhwɛsoɔ ne kɔndɔm Mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUD): Mfiri nketewa a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu de siw nyinsɛn ano. Sterilization: Oprehyɛn a wɔyɛ daa ma mmarima (vasectomy) anaa mmea (tubal ligation) de siw nyinsɛn ano. Ɛho hia sɛ wokae: Ɔkwan biara nni hɔ a etu mpɔn 100%, nanso ebinom tu mpɔn kɛse sen afoforo. Kɔndɔm nkutoo ne ɔkwan a ɛboa ma wosiw nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne nyinsɛn ano. Kɔsra akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn hɔ no na woasusuw ho bio
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa adwumayɛbea bi anya adwenemhaw ho amanneɛbɔ anaa nhumu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ɔsom adwuma bi wɔ adwenemhaw ho nsɛm bi ne sɛ wobebisa nsɛm a wɔabue ano, wɔde nsiyɛ tie a wonni atɛn, obu a wɔde ma ahye ne ahofadi, de akwan horow ne nea wɔpaw ma, amammerɛ mu nkate a wɔda no adi, ne ahobammɔ ne ahotoso a wɔde di kan. Nnwuma a wɔde ahodwiriw ho amanneɛbɔ ma, nso taa fa adwumayɛfo ntetee ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛboa nneyɛe a wɔde ahodwiriw ho amanneɛbɔ ma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa ɔdɔ ahokafo de ahye a ɛfata asi hɔ na ama m’adwene mu yiedi adi kan? (ka sɛ dabi, de anohyeto ahorow si hɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Dabi a Wobɛka: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi wɔ biribiara a ɛbɛma wo ho atɔ wo, mpo afi nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa ɔdɔfo a wɔne wɔn ho da hɔ no ho. Anohyeto a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Ka w’ahiade ne w’akwanhwɛ ho asɛm pefee na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi w’adwene mu yiedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn nsrahwɛ a yɛkɔ daa no bɛkɔ so ayɛ beae a atemmu biara nni hɔ a mete nka sɛ wɔboa me na wobu me, bere mpo a meresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa ɛyɛ den ho no?
answer_twi_source: Si so dua sɛ ɛho hia sɛ yɛbɔ beaeɛ a obiara ntumi nhu mmusu bɔne anaa nneɛma a ɛmfata ho ban berɛ a yɛreyɛ nsusuasua a yɛtaa yɛ no, baabi a wobɛte nka sɛ yɛboa wo na yɛbu wo, hwɛ sɛnea nsɛm a yɛka ho teɛ. Yɛ kasa tie a ɛyɛ nokorɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu ho mmaranimfoɔ, na yɛnam so ma gyidie ne nteaseɛ ba, na yɛkyerɛkyerɛ w'adwene ne w'anim nsɛm ho nneɛma a yɛnni apɛdeɛ biara, na yɛfa tema ne nteaseɛ yɛɛ nsensɔm a ɛyɛ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ebetumi afi nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔammɔ ho amanneɛ mu aba, ama nea onyaa ne ti didii mu ne ɔmanfo a wɔdɔɔso nyinaa, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wodi nsɛm yi ho dwuma ntɛm na wosiw daakye ɔhaw ano?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔremmɔ ho amanneɛ no betumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba nea onyaa ne ti didii mu no ne ɔmanfo a wɔdɔɔso no nyinaa so. Wɔ nea onyaa ne ti didii mu no fam no, sɛ wɔremmɔ amanneɛ a, ebetumi ama wɔn amanehunu no akyɛ, akyɛ mmoa a ɛho hia a wobenya, na ama wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no aguan akontaabu, na ebetumi de afoforo ato asiane mu sɛ wobepira wɔn. Wɔ ɔkwan a ɛtrɛw so no, nna mu basabasayɛ a wonni ho dwuma no ma amammerɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ komm, asotwe biara nni ho, na wɔayɛ ayayade sɛnea ɛsɛ, a ebetumi asɛe ahotoso, ahobammɔ, ne yiyedi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no kɔ so. Ɛho hia sɛ wodi nsɛm yi ho dwuma yiye denam mmoa a wɔbɛboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, a wobebu wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no akontaa, na wɔde akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano bedi dwuma de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano ansa na aba no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea awo nhyehyɛe no mu (mfinimfini) ne akyi (akyi), na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛbom yɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima: Ɔbarima akyi berɛmo, awotwaa, awotwaa (nkwaboaa). Ɔbea: Vulva, ovaries (nkwaa), awotwaa. Mommɔ mu nyɛ adwuma: Nkwaboaa hyia egg (fertilization)  Asabo ne kesua hyia (nyinsɛn).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu yɛ aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hwɛ sɛ ebia nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm afoforo wɔhɔ anaa. Wɔho hia kɛse ma mmabun efisɛ ɛboa ma wohu STI ahorow ntɛm, ɛma wotumi sa yare wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu, na ɛma nna mu akwahosan nyinaa nya nkɔso. Saa nhwehwɛmu ahorow yi nso ma wonya hokwan kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atetesɛm mu bɔbea dwumadi "traditional gender roles" ne akwanhwɛ ahorow wɔ yɛn man mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka nneyɛe, nea wɔpaw , ne hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu "gender identity" so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Atetesɛm mu bɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow wɔ ɔmanfo mu no taa de nneyɛe pɔtee, dwumadi ahorow, ne asɛyɛde ahorow ma ankorankoro a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu nipasu so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ebia ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow a ɛyɛ katee no bɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ mmarima bɛyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ katee, wɔyɛ den, na wodi tumi, bere a wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ mmea bɛyɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, wodwen wɔn ho, na wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase. Saa dwumadi ahorow yi nya asetra mu nneɛma ahorow so nkɛntɛnso, a nhomasua, adwuma, abusua mu nkɔso, ne asetra mu nkitahodi ka ho. Wobetumi asiw nneɛma a ankorankoro betumi apaw ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no ano, na ahyɛ pɛyɛ a enni hɔ mu den na wɔama nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so akɔ so.
