attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na nkabom adesua a yɛfrɛ no *inclusive education* wɔ pɔtɔ kasa mu no, bɛboa ma mmabun ako atia 'stereotypes' (adwene bɔne)  ne nyiyimu?
answer_twi_source: Nkabom adesua kenya mmabun ma wotumi dwen yie, wotumi ne afoforɔ di nkitaho, na afei so ɛboa ma wonya ntease fa nea ɔman agye ato mu, ne tumi mu nsonsonyɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔman biara mu. Wei ma ɔmo nya tema ne ne nteaseɛ ma obia. Wei boa ma wonya akokoduro kasa tia nyiyimu ne suban a ɛnnsɔ ani, na wɔ sanso de wɔn ho hyɛ ndwumapa a ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn brɔno mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nhyɛso, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho nsɛm, na wɔama wɔn tumi ma wɔahu nsɛm yi na wɔayɛ ho biribi yie?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nhyɛso, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho nsɛm denam nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde bɛma, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne nneyɛe a obuo wom a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛso so. Wobetumi asusu nsɛmti te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, ahyeɛ, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wohu wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa ho wɔ akwan horow a ɛfata mfe a obi adi so. Nneɛma a wɔde ma, te sɛ nhoma, nsɛm, websites, ne adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si abusuabɔ pa ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wosi ano so no nso betumi ama mmabun atumi ahu nhyɛso na wɔayɛ ho biribi yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Awo ano aduru ahorow no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde awo ano aduru a wɔsan frɛ no nyinsɛn ano no di dwuma de siw nyinsɛn ano. Ahorow ahorow pii wɔ hɔ, na emu biara wɔ mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow. Nhwɛso kakraa bi ni: Akwan a wɔfa so siw kwan: Te sɛ kɔndɔm ne diaphragm no, eyinom siw mmadwoa kwan wɔ honam fam sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu. Akwan a wɔfa so de hormone di dwuma: Eyinom de hormone di dwuma de siw ovulation (nkesua a ɛba) ano anaasɛ ɛsakra awotwaa no mu nneɛma ma ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ mu. Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, ne IUD. Abusua nhyehyɛe a efi awosu mu: Eyi yɛ sɛ worehwɛ wɔ fertile window (bere a ɛda adi kɛse sɛ wubenyinsɛn) na woakwati nna wɔ saa bere no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu akyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ho denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfata wɔn mfe a wɔde bɛma wɔn a ɛfa hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so ho no so. Wobetumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, ne sɛnea wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Ɛnam nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow, dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ so no, CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne wɔn ho mu ahotoso de asi wɔn hokwan ahorow so dua yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ sɛ wɔne wɔn awofo bɛkasa afa nsɛmsɛm a ɛfa nsubuo ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di: Mmabun betumi akɔ ɔpanyin afoforɔ a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ sukuu fotufoɔ, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, anaa abusua muni bi nkyɛn. Fa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Di Dwuma: Nhoma a ahotosoɔ wom, ntentanfidie ahodoɔ, anaa ahomatorofoɔ a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wotumi de ho to so betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Sɛ wuhu nnamfo a wɔrefa osuahunu a ɛte saa ara mu na wo ne wɔn bɔ nkɔmmɔ a, ebetumi akyekye wo werɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi afa so akasa de agyina hɔ ama akwanya a ɛbɛma kwan a wɔfa so kɔ ayaresabea wɔ wɔn mpɔtam atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun bɛtumi akasa agyina hɔ ama akwanya a ɛbɛma kwan a wɔfa so kɔ ayaresabea wɔ wɔn mpɔtam atu mpɔn denam akwan yi so: Wɔn suahu ne nsɛnnennen a ɛfa akwantu akwanside ahorow ho a wɔbɛka akyerɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow so. Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ kasafre dwumadie anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu ase a wɔasi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛtu kwantuo ho mpɔn ama mmofra a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkɔ ayaresabea. Nkrataa anaa adesrɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛw akɔma mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo de ahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn sika nsie wɔ akwantu nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a edi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma yiye mu. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwantuo ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiadeɛ na wɔde adi dwuma. Nhumu a wɔbɛma wɔahu hia a ɛho hia sɛ akwantuo nya apɔmuden ho dwumadie ma mmabun na wɔtwe adwene si nkɛntɛnsoɔ a akwantuo akwansideɛ nya wɔ apɔmuden mu nsunsuansoɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ bea a ɛboa na wommu atɛn wɔ fie ma m'ate nka sɛ me ho tɔ me sɛ mɛbɔ me atenka ho nkɔmmɔ na m'ahwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛmu da hɔ ne atie yie wɔ abusua no mu, na hyɛ obiara nkuran sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ne nsusuii ne ne atenka a onsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn. Fa bere a pa so si hɔ ma abusua nkɔmmɔbɔ anaasɛ check-in a obiara betumi akyɛ ne suahun na waboa ne yɔnko. Fa nhwɛso di anim denam tema, ntease, ne obuo a wobɛda no adi ama mo ho mo ho atenka ne ne nsusuii so. Fa ahyeɛ ne akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ ma nkitahodi si hɔ na ama obiara anya tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ɛde nyinsɛn mu ɔhaw ba a ɛsɛ sɛ mihu? (mfe a obi adi, ayaresa tebea horow a na ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw, abusua abakɔsɛm) .
answer_twi_source: Asane ahorow bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wohu ni: Mfe a wɔadi: Mmabun nkumaa paa (a wonnii mfe du nnum) betumi ahyia asiane kɛse. Aduruyɛ mu Tebea horow a Ɛwɔ Hɔ dedaw: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ eyinom so bere a wɔyem no. Abusua Abakɔsɛm: Abusua abakɔsɛm a ɛfa tebea horow bi ho no betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na misi gyinae sɛ ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛfata ma me a, mɛyɛ dɛn anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ngene Ho Ɔhwɛfo: Ade a edi kan a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ne sɛ wobɛkɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a ɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwuma ma no nkyɛn. Afotu: Wɔne wo besusuw ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no, asiane ahorow, ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so ho. Ebia afotu nso wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woasisi gyinae a ɛfata. Mmara mu Ahwehwɛde: Ɛdenam beae a wowɔ so no, ebia mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow te sɛ bere a wɔde twɛn anaa awofo pene a wɔde bɛma mmofra nkumaa wɔ hɔ. Mmoa Nnwuma: Ayaresabea ahorow pii de mmoa adwuma ma ansa na wɔayɛ oprehyɛn no ne bere a wɔayɛ no akyi, a afotu ne nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho ka ho. Sɛ wusi gyinae sɛ nyinsɛn a wotu gu ne ɔkwan a ɛfata ma wo a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ ɔhwɛ fi akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔfata hɔ wɔ beae a wɔagye atom
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne abusua mufo betumi akamfo nna ne awo hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wɔ nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho mmeae, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae afoforo?
answer_twi_source: Fi Ase Wɔ Fie: Wo ne wo ba nsusuw hia a nna ne awo akwahosan ho hia ho. Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho kyerɛ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu a ɛfa sukuufo a wɔadi dɛm ahiade ho. Akwahosan Ho Nhyehyɛe: Bisa ntetee ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo wɔ dɛmdi ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nhumu: Wɔtrɛw nhumu a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne haw ahorow a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro taa hyia, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyim ne adwemmɔne: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam ne nneɛma a wɔboa, na susuw nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho de kasa tia nsusuwii hunu na wɔhyɛ gye a wogye tom ho nkuran. Wobepue: Gye wo bere, fa w’ahobammɔ di kan, na paw bere ne beae a ɛfata a wode bɛka wo nipasu akyerɛ afoforo. Kae sɛ sɛ wubepue a, ɛyɛ w’ankasa gyinaesi, na wumfa nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara ka obiara. Adwene mu akwahosan ho haw: Kɔ adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa mmoa akuo a wɔyɛ LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho titire nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwanside anaa nsɛnnennen bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nhomasua ho nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho haw ahorow ho a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow anaa nsɛnnennen ahorow wɔ mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn ne nhomasua ho nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho haw ahorow ho a wobenya no mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho, nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni, akwantu ho nsɛm, sikasɛm mu ahokyere, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu akwanside ahorow, ne kokoamsɛm ho dadwen. Bio nso, nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden betumi aka mmabun a wobenya mmoa a wɔde ma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ migye m’ahome wɔ awoɔ ano aduru a wɔde honam mu nkwammoa di dwuma ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛno betumi aka sɛnea etu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano a wɔde honam mu nkwammoa di dwuma nyinaa na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wogye wɔn ahome. Nea ɛpaapae ni: Nnuru a wɔde siw awoɔ ano/nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu a wɔaka abom (estrogen ne progestin): Pii wɔ pack a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma bere nyinaa mu, na ɛmma enhia sɛ obi kɔ nna mu. Wo ne nea ɔde mmoa ma wo no nkasa mfa akwan horow a wubetumi apaw ho. Nnuru a wɔde progestin nkutoo na ɛyɛ (minipills)/aduru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu: Wɔnom eyinom da biara da a wonnye wɔn ahome, na ebia nna a ɛkɔ so no nyɛ nea ɛkɔ so daa anaasɛ ebegyae koraa. Patch ne ring: Wɔtaa de eyinom di dwuma daa adapɛn pii a dapɛn biako ahomegye wɔ wo nna mu. Ahomegye a wubegye no betumi atew sɛnea etu mpɔn no so. Wo ne w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nsusuw nea wopɛ wɔ nna ho. Wobetumi akasa ama ɔkwan bi a ɛne w’ahiade hyia akyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsusuiɛ a ɛmu dɔ boa ma obi bu atɛntenenee, otumi siesie ɔhaw, na ohu sɛ ne ho hia?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a emu yɛ den, ɔhaw a edi mu, ne wɔn ankasa ho nimdeɛ yɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔde di dwuma yie de gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow si gyinae sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobegyina atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛmfata ano na woadi wo ankasa suban ne wo nsunsuanso so. Adwene a emu yɛ den no kyerɛ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ nsɛm mu yie, na woasusuw nneɛma ho, na woasusuw akwan foforo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne dwumadi ahorow anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ahorow bi a ɛma metumi de me ho hyɛ mu daa de hyɛ me katee ntini mu den na manya ahotoso kɛse sɛ mɛhyɛ me ho so dua wɔ asetra ne nnipa ntam tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneyɛeɛ horow pii na ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi ayɛ no daa de ahyɛ wo gyinabea so pintinn gyina (assertiveness) den. Dwumadie a ɛfa suahunu a wobɛyɛ (role-playing) a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobɛbua mfɛfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ ho nsɛm a ɛtaa ba no betumi aboa wo paa.Afei nso, wo suahunu a wobɛkyerɛw afa kwan a wofaa so gyinaa wo gyinabea so pintinn ho (journaling), botaeɛ nketewa a wode bɛsi w'ani so sɛ wobɛda wo ho adi wɔ tebea horow mu, ne wo ho a wode bɛhyɛ akuo mu nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa nteteeɛ (workshops) a ɛsi gyinabea so pintinn gyina so dua mu no, nyinaa betumi aboa ma woanya awerɛhyem kɛseɛ wɔ kwan a wofa so gyina wo gyinabea so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akye mu pɛ wɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ne asɛyɛde afoforo anaa nneɛma a m’ani gye ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛkari pɛ ne asɛyɛde ne nneɛma afoforo a w’ani gye ho no ho hia ma yiyedi nyinaa: Fa Di kan na Yɛ Nhyehyɛe: Yɛ nhyehyɛe a bere a wode bɛteɛteɛ w’apɔw mu, sukuu adwuma, anigyede, fekubɔ, ne ahomegye ka ho. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ Tiatiaa a Ɛyɛ Den: Sɛ bere sua a, susuw ntetee a emu yɛ den kɛse (HIIT) anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ tiawa a emu yɛ den ho na ama woatumi ayɛ adwuma yiye. Fa Dwumadi Ka Ho: Hwehwɛ akwan a wobɛfa so de dwumadi ahyɛ da biara da dwumadi ahorow mu, te sɛ nantew anaa sakre a wobɛfa akɔ sukuu, antweri a wobɛfa, anaa afie mu nnwuma. Nnwuma pii: Fa dwumadi ahorow te sɛ adesua bere a wote sakre a egyina hɔ so anaasɛ nipadua mu duru apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ bere a worehwɛ mfoni 'TV' no bom. Quality Over Quantity: Wonhia sɛ wode nnɔnhwerew pii teɛteɛ w’apɔw mu da biara. Fa w’adwene si apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛyɛ papa a ɛsɔ wo nsɛnnennen so. Nsakrae: Yɛ nsakrae wɔ wo nhyehyɛe mu. Sɛ biribi ba a, yɛ nsakrae wɔ wo nhyehyɛe mu sen sɛ wubegyae apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ koraa. Wo Ho a Wobɛhwɛ: Kae sɛ wode wo ho a wobɛhwɛ no bedi kan, a nea ɛka ho ne ahomegye, ahomegye, ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wo ho tɔ wo wɔ adwene ne nkate mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wodi wɔn ho so wɔ nipadua mu wɔ tebea ahorow a, ebia wobehyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim a egyina nna anaa awo a wɔpaw so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akyerɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔwɔ nipadua mu ahofadi denam: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mmeae a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔbɛboa wɔn na wɔabu wɔn atɛn Ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ wɔn hokwan ne nea wobetumi apaw ho a wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nkitahodi mu denneennen a wɔne atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ de nya akwankyerɛ ne biakoyɛ a wɔbɛbɔ amanneɛ a ɛfa animtiaabu anaa nyiyim ho a wɔbɛka akyerɛ atumfoɔ a ɛfa ho anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasiesie. kɔsra mmoa ahomatrofo (telephone) ahorow no so kɔhwehwɛ nsɛm pii: (YANKA SA Toll-free number 0800202010)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ mfiridwuma ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneyɛe nya nsunsuanso  wɔ mmabun suahunu ne wɔn adwene wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ahobammɔ ne obi a ɔnim mfididwuma ho nyansa (digital citizenship)                                                                                                                                                                                                         so?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma a Wɔfa: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ mfiridwuma ho betumi anya sɛnea mmabun de abɛɛfo  mfiri di dwuma na wɔde wɔn ho to so no so nsunsuanso. Nhomasua: Adwene a ɔmanfo wɔ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneyɛe ho no betumi akyerɛ sɛnea wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛ wɔmfa nkɔ  wiase no mu. Animtiaabu anaa Mmoa: Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi bɛbɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneyɛe bi animtiaa, bere a afoforo nso betumi aboa. Abɛɛfo nimdeɛ: Amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛfa abɛɛfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ne nhomasua ho betumi anya sɛnea mmabun te intanɛt so ahobammɔ nneyɛe ase na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu yiye no so nkɛntɛnso. Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Dadwen: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho betumi anya sɛnea mmabun yɛ ahwɛyiye wɔ wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm a wɔde ma wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so no so nsunsuanso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi mfɛfo nhyɛso a ɛfa mpa so agodie wo bere a merepaw sɛ mɛtwe me ho afi ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Kae sɛ sɛ woansiesie wo ho anaasɛ wo ho ntɔ wo a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi wɔ nna ho. Nya ahotoso wɔ gyinae a woasi sɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi nna ho no mu na ka w’ahye ho asɛm denneennen akyerɛ w’atipɛnfo. Fa nnamfo a wɔboa wo a wobu nea wopaw ne wo gyinapɛn ahorow twa wo ho hyia. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ, sɛ worepere wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden sika ho nsunsuansoɔ nsɛm bɛn na ɛwɔ wɔ sɛ yɛdi abeifo nnwuma ewura ASRH dwumadie, ne na sɛnea wobɛtumi anya sika a ɛbɛkɔ so adaa ne deɛ wobɛtumi atrɛ mu de aboa nnwuma no yɛ dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Ka wowɔ: Mfiaseɛ sika gu mu (nsiesie), Dwumadie ɛfa nsiesie yɛ.  Nketahodie a wɔne mmoayɛfo anaa ahintasɛm kuo no bɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛka sɛnea atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye abu so wɔ mmabun mu no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne akwanhwɛ: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne atetesɛm betumi akyerɛ su ahorow a ɛfa nea ɛne ne ho hyia ne ankorankoro ho, na anya atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɔne a abu so wɔ mpɔtam bi mu no so nkɛntɛnso. Asetra mu nniso: Ebia ɔmanfo nhyehyɛe ne nniso a ɛkɔ soro no bɛboa ma tumi a ɛkɔ so wɔ atipɛnfo mu, na ɛde nhyɛso bɔne a ɛbɛma wɔadi nneyɛe anaa gyinapɛn ahorow bi ahyia aba. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow a ɛfa asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow ne nneyɛe a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ho no betumi anya mmabun adwene wɔ nea wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ nea wogye tom anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea wɔpɛ ho nkɛntɛnso, na anya sɛnea atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye abu so no so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya  nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma sɛ ɛho hia a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo hia nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie a, sɛdeɛ wobɛtumi anya bi nie: - Kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ nkyɛn: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ bi, te sɛ oduruyɛfoɔ, ɔyarehwɛfoɔ, anaa ayaresabea a wɔn ho akokwa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho, nkɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ. - de nna mu akwahosan ayaresabea di dwuma: Ayaresabea bebree de kokoam nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ma wɔ tebea a ɛboa mu, mpɛn pii no awofoɔ mpene mma mmabun. - hwehwe mpɔtam akwahosan ho nneɛma mu: Mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛeɛ anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi de nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ama mmabun, ɛtɔ da bi a wɔrentua hwee anaasɛ wɔbɛtew ka so. - Fa intanɛt so nneɛma di dwuma: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow bi de nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho ma na ebetumi ama akwan horow a wobɛfa so ayɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) sɔhwɛ nneɛma a wɔde anifere ne kokoamsɛm ayɛ a wɔde bɛkɔ wo fie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na wɔfa so hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na obu wom a ɛfa amammerɛ ne ankorankoro adwene wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Tie yiye: Tie aso a wunni atɛn na ama woate afoforo adwene ase. Kasa a Obu: Fa kasa a ɛkyerɛ obu ma adwene ahorow na kwati nsusuwii hunu di dwuma. Yɛ Mmeae a Ahobammɔ: Fa mmeae a obiara bɛte nka sɛ ne ho bɛtɔ no sɛ ɔbɛka n’adwene asi hɔ. Hyɛ Nkɔmmɔbɔ Ho Nkuran: To nsa frɛ mfɛfo ma wɔnka wɔn amammerɛ mu atetesɛm anaa osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Ma Nkɔmmɔbɔ Ho Nkɔmmɔ: Bisa nsɛm a emu da hɔ de hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu dɔ ho nkuran. Gye Nsonsonoe Tom: Si so dua sɛ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ adwene mu no yɛ ade a ɛfata na ebetumi ama obi asua ade. Nhomasua Nhyiam: Yɛ nhyiam anaa nsɛm a wɔka fa amammerɛ ahorow ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere so ho nhyehyɛe. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a atipɛnfo di anim a obiara betumi aboa na wasua biribi afi ne yɔnko hɔ ho nkuran. Dwumadi a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Fa dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma di dwuma de hwehwɛ sɛnea wɔde obu bua adwene ahorow. Di Nneɛma Ahorow Ho Afahyɛ: Yɛ nhyiam ahorow a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ ahorow ho afahyɛ, hyɛ ntease ne gye a wogye tom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmarima ne mmea awo nhyehyɛe no afa horow, na dɛn ne wɔn dwumadi ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Hwaa (Testes): Wɔyɛ ɛhwa (sperm) ne nipadua mu aduru a ɛma ɔbarima ahoɔden (testosterone). Hwaa-kyi-fofonii (Epididymis): Ɛhɔ na wɔsie ɛhwa (sperm) na ɛno nso na ɛkanyan wɔn kɔ nipadua no afã horow. Vas Deferens: Ɛde ɛhwa (sperms) fi hwaa-kyi-fofonii (epididymis) no mu kɔ (urethra) no mu. prostate Gland:  ɛde dwensɔ ne ɛhwa (semen) fi nipadua no mu pue. Seminal vesticle: Ɛma nsu a ɛma mmadwoa nya ahoɔden na ɛbɔ ho ban. Seminal Vesicles: Ɛyɛ nsuo bi a ɛma ɛhwa (sperm) no aduane na ɛbɔ ho ban. Mmea Awo Nhyehyɛe: Ovaries: Ɛyɛ nkesua (eggs) ne nipadua mu aduru (hormones) te sɛ estrogen ne progesterone.Fallopian Tubes: Ɛfa nkesua (eggs) no fi nkesua-adaka (ovaries) no mu de kɔ awo-baatannua (uterus) no mu. Awotwaa (Awotwaa): Baabi a nkesua a ayɛ nyinsɛn no hyɛ na ɛnyin bɛyɛ abofra (fetus). Cervix: Awotwaa no fã a ɛwɔ fam a ɛne ɔbea awotwaa no di nkitaho. Vagina: Ɛka awotwaa no bata nipadua no akyi; nso awo kwan no. Clitoris ne Labia: Abɔnten so nneɛma a ɛka nna mu anigye ne ahobammɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ mehia mmara mu mmoa (legal assistance) ntɛm?
answer_twi_source: Ebia mmabun behia mmara kwan so mmoa ntɛm ara sɛ wɔrehyia tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ te sɛ ayayade, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ wɔn so, anaa nyiyim a ɛfa wɔn nna anaa awo akwahosan ho a. Sɛ wonni ahotoso a, wobetumi ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa w'afrɛ  ahomatorofɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea asɛde ne nea wɔ hwehwɛ ahorow, broni ka no 'expectations' ho no boa ma wonya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so tra hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho no boa ma wonya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so denam tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ a wɔhyɛ mu den ne ankorankoro ahofadi ne wɔn ahofadi a wɔto ano hyeɛ so, broni ka no 'agency'. Sɛ nhwɛso no, atetesɛm mu adwene ahorow a ɛfa mmarimayɛ ho no betumi ama basabasayɛ ne tumidi anya nkɔso, bere a ebia ɔbeayɛ ho akwanhwɛ ahorow bɛma obi a ɔnyɛ hwee ne ɔbrɛ a ɔbrɛ ne ho ase adi kan. Saa nsusuwii hunu ahorow yi betumi ama basabasayɛ ayɛ nea ɛfata na wɔanya gyidi sɛ wogye nneyɛe bi tom a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne nwomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ obi ho hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔma mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ho no mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wɔne ahyehyɛde afoforo a mmabun di anim, mpɔtam hɔ akuw, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkitahodi ahorow bɛyɛ biako de ahyɛ nne ahorow mu den na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae. Fa nhyehyɛeyɛfo di nkitaho: Wo ne mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn nhyia, kyerɛw nkrataa, na fa wo ho hyɛ ɔmanfo nhyiam ahorow ase de kamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nkuran. Media ne social media: Fa traditional media ne social media akwan di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nsɛm na wɔboaboa mmoa ano ma nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwehwɛ kasa, mfonini, ne sɛnkyerɛnne kwan so nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu  de ahu nsɛm ne adwene a ɛda adi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ kasa, mfonini, ne sɛnkyerɛnnede a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ  mu de ahu nsɛm ne atirimpɔw ahorow a ɛwɔ ase denam: Aso a wɔde besi kasa a ɛhyɛ nsusuwii hunu mu den anaasɛ ɛhyɛ adwene a enni mu ho nkuran no so. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde aniwa hu ne sɛnkyerɛnnede ahorow a ɛda ntease ahorow a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho adi a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Amammerɛ ne asetra mu nsɛm a ɛtrɛw a wɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm na wɔde di dwuma no ho a yebesusuw. Nhwɛso anaa trope ahorow a ɛma nsɛm a epira a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho kɔ so tra hɔ a wobehu. Nsunsuanso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo  nya wɔ ankorankoro gyidi, suban, ne nneyɛe so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Awoɔ hokwan bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hunu?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ hokwan no bi ne: - Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri. - Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya awoɔ nnwuru ne awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mmoa. - Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ayinsɛn anaa sɛ wobeyi. - Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu a ahobammɔ wom na mmara ma ho kwan. - Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya apɔmuden mmoa a nyiyim nnim a dɛmdi anaa awoɔ mu gyinaesio mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no, afã pɔtee bɛn na wɔhwɛ so na wɔhwehwɛ mu daa?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw a wɔhwɛ so na wɔsɔ hwɛ daa no bi ne: Nnwuma a wobetumi anya ne nea wobetumi anya. Ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wɔde ma. "Client" abotɔyam ne nsɛm a wɔka. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma so. Nneyɛe ne akwankyerɛ a eye sen biara a wobedi so. Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no mu mmɔdenbɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na pene di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mu, na dɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ nna mu dwumadi bi yɛ nea wɔpene so, fi wɔn pɛ mu, na egyina wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene, ntease, ne obu so?
answer_twi_source: Mpene di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mu mu efisɛ egyina hɔ ma nna mu abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom na obu wom no tweatibo. Mpene a wɔpene so yɛ anpam a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ, wɔde anigye, na wɔde nimdeɛ di dwuma sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma kwa, a wɔmfa nhyɛso, nsakyera, anaa nhyɛso biara nni mu, na wobetumi atwe bere biara. Nea ɛka pene a wɔpene so ho ne nkitahodi a emu da hɔ, wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease, ne obu a wɔde ma ahye ne nea wɔpɛ. Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ nnipa baanu no nyinaa de wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu denneennen na wɔda ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so. Wontumi mfa ahoɔden, ahunahuna, nnaadaa, anaa tumi a wontumi nyɛ esiane asabow anaa adwenem naayɛ nti nnya pene. Ma ɛntra w’adwenem sɛ bere biara wɔ nna mu dwumadi mu no, wobetumi atwa pene a w'apene so no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene di wɔ Intanɛt so nkitahodi mu, te sɛ nna ho nsɛm a wɔde mena anaasɛ nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a wɔkyɛ mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene yɛ Ade Titiriw: Te sɛ nea ɛte wɔ nkitahodi a ɛnyɛ intanɛt so no, ɛsɛ sɛ afa horow no nyinaa pene so pefee na wɔde anigye ma wɔ nna mu dwumadi biara anaa nsɛm a ɛbɛn ho a wɔbɛkyɛ ho. Bisa Na Bu: Bere nyinaa bisa na bu pene a ɛda adi pefee ansa na wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara mu, a nna ho nsɛm a wɔde mena ka ho. Nhyɛso biara: Nhyɛ obi da sɛ ɔnka nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee anaa ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ nna mu dwumadi ahorow mu wɔ Intanɛt so. Nkitahodi a Wɔabue Mu: Hwɛ sɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware wɔ ahye, akɔnnɔ, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho. Hwɛ Mfe a obi adi: Sɛ wunnim mfe a obi adi a, kwati nna ho nsɛm anaa nkitahodi biara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛtwam a ɛka ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so nkɛntɛnso ne te sɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, animtiaabu, awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso, nyiyim, ne asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nkabom ahorow. Fa nsɛm a egyina adanse so a wɔkamfo kyerɛ.. Nhyehyɛe ho nkɔmmɔbɔ. Ka ayɛsɛm (storytelling). Yɛ nkabom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsɛnnennen pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun hyia wɔ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ne nyiyim ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmabun betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen pɔtee bi a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ne nyiyim ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Asisifo ne ayayade a egyina nna ho akɔnnɔ so. Mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nkrataa a ɛgye mmarima ne mmaa su tom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ abusuabɔ a enni  apɔwmuden anaa ayayade mu?
answer_twi_source: Suban a wobɛhyɛ so: Wo hokafo bɔ mmɔden sɛ obedi onii ko a wuhu, nea wohyɛ, anaa nea woyɛ so. Ahoɔyaw ne nneɛma a obi wɔ: Wo hokafo ani bere wo nnamfo anaa wo dwumadi ahorow a ntease nnim. Nsɛm a wɔde to fam ne animtiaabu: Wo hokafo no ma wote nka bɔne wɔ wo ho denam din a ɔbɔ anaa ɔkasa tia wo so. Ahunahuna  ahunahuna: Wo hokafo no de basabasayɛ anaa ɔhaw hunahuna wo, anaasɛ ɔma wote ehu nka. Nhyɛso a wɔde ma wɔ nna ho: Wo hokafo no hyɛ wo ma wo nna mu dwumadi a wompɛ. Wo hye a wubebu w’ani agu so: Wo hokafo no mmu w’apɛde anaasɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ obebu wo fɔ ma woayɛ nneɛma a ɛnyɛ wo dɛ. Honam fam basabasayɛ anaa basabasayɛ ho ahunahuna
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan nhyehyɛe ahorow, amanaman ntam apam ahorow, ne abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa ahofadi a wɔde ka wɔn adwene, hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya nsɛm, hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya akwahosan, hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya nhomasua, ne hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔnyɛ nyiyim ho, titiri ma mmabun ne akuo a wɔato wɔn sintidua ho no hyia?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛne Nnipa Hokwan Nhyehyɛe ahorow: media ho nimdeɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ne nnipa hokwan nhyehyɛe ahorow, amanaman ntam apam ahorow, ne abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa ahofadi a wɔde ka wɔn adwene, hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya nsɛm, hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya akwahosan, hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya nhomasua, ne hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔnyɛ nyiyim ho no di nkitaho, titiri ma mmabun ne akuo a wɔato wɔn sintidua. Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu denneennen ne nyiyim ho nsɛm a wɔka tia a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so no, media ho nimdeɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan ahorow na wɔabu mediafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no akontaa sɛ wodi nnipa hokwan gyinapɛn ahorow so. nanso, ɛne amansan mmara nhyia wɔ Ghana sɛ Mmabun bɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan wɔ LGBTQ+ mmara no ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de aguadi ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi adi dwuma sɛ adwinnade a wɔde hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan mu pɛyɛ, nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi adi dwuma sɛ adwinnade a wɔde hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan mu pɛyɛ, nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu denam nne ahorow a wɔbɛda no adi, mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wogyina hɔ ma, ne nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a wobedi ho dwuma so. Dawurubɔfo ne aguadifo "marketers" betumi ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ayɛ biako de ayɛ ɔsatu ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma akwahosan mu pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee akɔ anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtamu hɔ, nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim, ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi betumi adi wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden a wɔbɛboa wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtamu hɔ, nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim, ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden a wɔboa wɔ wiase nyinaa apomoden ho tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu no mu. Wobetumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, atipɛnfo mmoa, na wɔanya nnwuma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade. Saa ahyehyɛde ahorow yi nso kamfo hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ na wɔyɛ adwuma de tew animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi atu de ama nneɛma ahorow ne nea wɔde ka ho akɔ soro wɔ wɔn nsɛm a wɔyɛ ne nea wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛemu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahohorow wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔda wiase no mu nneɛma ahorow adi wɔ wɔn nsɛm mu. Anamɔn a wobetumi atu ni: Nnipa a wɔfa nnipa ahorow: Ɛsɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow de talente ahorow a wɔbɛfa wɔn adwuma mu di kan, wɔ mfoninitwa afiri no anim ne akyi nyinaa, a nnipa a wofi mmusua ne amammerɛ nyinaa mu ka ho. Ntetee ne Nkateɛ Nhyiamu: Nteteeɛ ne nhyiamu a ɛfa amammerɛ ahodoɔ ho a wɔde bɛma no bɛtumi aboa adwumayɛfoɔ ma wɔate hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde ananmusifoɔ di dwuma no ase na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛma nsusuwii hunu a epira akɔ so. Mpɔtam Ahorow a Wobesusuw Ho: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ahorow, ne akuw afoforo a wɔato wɔn hintidua asusuw ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn mfonini ahorow no yɛ nokware na ɛkyerɛ obu. Asɛm a Wɔka Ka Ho: Wɔhyɛ akyerɛwfo ne adebɔfo nkuran sɛ wɔnka nsɛm a ɛda ankorankoro osuahu ahorow adi wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ nsɛm nketenkete so. Ananmusifoɔ wɔ Akannifoɔ mu: Sɛ ankorankoro ne akuo foforɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua ananmusifoɔ wɔ akannifoɔ dibea mu wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ mu a, ɛbɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔde adwene ahodoɔ bɛka gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na metumi abɔ me ho ban afi nna mu ɔbrasɛe "sexual abuse" ho sɛ ɔbabun a wadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne Nhumu: Sua hokwan ahorow a wowɔ ho ade na te nea ɛyɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ase. Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ sɛnea wobɛka wo ho a ahobammɔ wom ne nea ahobammɔ nnim ho. Nkitahodi: Wo ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no nka wo atinka ne osuahu ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Sɛ ɛho hia a, fa nkitahodi mfiri a ɛboa di dwuma na ama woada wo nsusuwii adi pefee. Ahobammɔ Ho Akwan: Yɛ ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe na fa di dwuma, te sɛ obi a wugye no di a ɔbɛfrɛ no wɔ tebea a egye ntɛmpɛ mu. Hwɛ yiye wɔ w’ankasa ho nsɛm a wode bɛma ahɔho a wunnim wɔn, wɔ Intanɛt so ne nea ɛnyɛ Intanɛt so nyinaa ho. Mmoa Nkitahodi: Kɔka mmoa akuw anaa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho. Wo ne nnamfo ne abusuafo a wobetumi de mmoa ne ahobammɔ ama no nkɔ so nya abusuabɔ. Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ ne Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma: Hu mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ma no yiye. Fa nneɛma a ahyehyɛde ahorow yi de ama di dwuma na sua pii fa sɛnea wobɛbɔ wo ho ban afi ayayade ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So LGBTQ+ nsɛm ne nnipa a wɔda wɔn ho adi no ka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ho, na sɛ ɛte saa a, ɔkwan bɛn so na wodi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Wɔde LGBTQ+ nsɛm ne nnipa a wɔda wɔn ho adi no ka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri ho kɛse sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ ma wɔaka obiara ho na ɛfata ama asuafo nyinaa. Woi betumi aka nneɛma bi te sɛ: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde bɛma. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa akwahosan mu nyiyim a LGBTQ+foɔ hyia ne yareɛ akɛseɛ te sɛ HIV ne nna mu yareɛ (STIs) a wobetumi anya ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ne mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma LGBTQ+ asuafoɔ abisa nsɛm na wɔasusu wɔn suahunu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn ankorankoro nsɛm bɛyɛ kɔkoam berɛ biaa a wɔakɔhwehwɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden dadwen ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn nsɛm bɛyɛ kɔkoam denam: Wɔn hokwan a wɔbɛhunu: Mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa kɔkoamunsɛm ne kokoam a ɛwɔ wɔn mantam mu a wɔbɛhunu. Apɛdeɛ a wɔbɛka: Kɔkoamunsɛm ho dadwen a wɔne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ bɛkasa ho na wɔabisa kɔkoam nkitahodie akwan, te sɛ ntentanfidie so amanneɛbɔ mmom sen krataa a wɔde bɛsoma.Sɛ woreyi apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wogye wɔn di: Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afiri apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔde ɔyarefoɔ kɔkoamunsɛm di kan na wɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ mmabun apɔmuden ahiadeɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So aboafo nneɛma anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ kuo bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛhyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ase?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ UNESCO, Planned Parenthood, ne kasamafo ma mmaabum ma aboafo nneɛma, nteteeɛ, ne mfiridwuma mmoa ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ, ne nkamfofoɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma de ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so ahyɛ HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nkuran sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyɛ HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nkuran sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe fã a ɛyɛ daa denam hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa ho nkuran a wɔbɛma wɔahu, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛka afa nna mu akwahosan ho, ko tia animtiaabu, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ne nsɛm a ɛnyɛ a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne nnwuma a wobetumi anya na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na mebu mensa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono bere a abeawa biara betumi ebu nensa. Ɛtaa fi ase bere a wɔadi mfe 8 kosi 13, nanso ebetumi asi ntɛm anaa akyiri yi. Ɔkwan biara nni hɔ a wobɛfa so ahu bere pɔtee a ɛbɛba, nanso nufu a ɛbobɔ no taa yɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo kyima reba ɛntsɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ anaa ayɔnkofa pa mu, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ anaa ayɔnkofa pa yɛ nea egyina obu, ahotoso, nkitahodi, ne mmoa so. Nea ɛho hia: Ɛhyɛ nkate fam yiyedi ne anigye ho nkuran. Ɛhyɛ ankorankoro nkɔso ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ho nkuran. Ɛma ahokafo baanu no nyinaa nya tebea a ahobammɔ ne ahoɔden wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina na wɔatumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn sikasɛm so, titiri bere a nsɛm a wɔnhwɛ kwan anaa sikasɛm mu nsɛnnennen hyia no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi agyina ayɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn sikasɛm sohwɛ mu denam sikakorabea su pa a wobenya, asiane fotuo, ne sikanya bea ahorow so. Wobetumi nso akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ho akwan horow te sɛ asiane ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ nneɛma a ebetumi asi ho, de asiesie wɔn ho ama nsɛm a wɔnhwɛ kwan anaa sikasɛm mu nsɛnnennen. Abusua, nnamfo, anaa sikasɛm ho abenfo mmoa kuw a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛhyehyɛ no betumi ama wɔanya nkate ne mfasoɔ mu mmoa wɔ mmere a emu yɛ den mu na aboa mmabun ma wɔde ahoɔden ne ahotoso adi sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akamfo obu ne ntease a ɛfa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ho wɔ m’atipɛnfo kuw ne mpɔtam a ɛtrɛw mu?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi apere ama obu ne nteaseɛ aba gyinapɛn ne gyidi horow mu wɔ wo mfɛfoɔ kuo ne wo mpɔtam nyinaa mu, denam kwan a wobɛkyerɛ (leading by example) ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ adwenem-mue (open-mindedness) ne obiara a wɔbɛgye no atom a wobɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a obu wom a ɛfa adwene ahorow ho mu, kasa tia nsusuwii hunu anaa animhwɛ, na hyɛ tema ne gye a wogye tom ho nkuran. Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi anaa nnwuma a ɛhyɛ ahorow ahorow ne nkabom ho nkuran, te sɛ adwumayɛbea ahorow, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne mmoa bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde ma na ama mmofra a wɔrenyin a wɔwɔ dɛmdi anya kwan adi dwuma wɔ awogyee ne mmofra ayaresa dwumadie mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi anya bi no, ɛsɛ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm no ma dabere te sɛ mmubuafo akongua a wɔde fa kwan so, sɔhwɛ pon a wotumi kɔ hɔ, mum kasa asekyerɛfo, nneɛma a wɔakyerɛw wɔ akwan a wotumi nya mu te sɛ braile, nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkenkan, bere tenten a wɔde paw wɔn ma nkitahodi ahiade, ne adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn wɔ mmubuafo ho nimdeɛ ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne osuahu ahorow a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm nya wɔ wiase mmeae ahorow, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛnea egyina amammerɛ ne asetena mu nneɛma so?
answer_twi_source: Aman a wɔanya nkɔso no betumi anya mmoa ne nneɛma a ɛkyɛn so ama wɔn a wɔadi dɛm sen aman a wonni nkɔsoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi kɔmputa so ayayade anaa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ayayade a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho nsɛmti ho aba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ wɔn ade wɔ abrabɔ pa mu wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa ho?
answer_twi_source: Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ayayade a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho betumi de nea emu yɛ den aba, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nkate mu ahokyere, dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adwenemyare afoforo a ɛfa wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no ho. Din a wɔsɛe no, nnipa a wɔtew wɔn ho fi afoforo ho, ne nsunsuanso bɔne a ɛba wɔ obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne yiyedi so. Mmara kwan so nsunsuanso sɛ suban no yɛ ɔhaw, ahohorabɔ, anaa ɛto kokoam nsɛm ho mmara so a. Mmabun betumi ayɛ wɔn ade wɔ abrabɔ pa mu wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa ho denam: Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wɔyɛ wɔn basabasa ne emu nsɛm a wobesiw ano anaa wɔbɛbɔ amanneɛ akyerɛ asɛnka agua no so ahwɛfo anaa atumfoɔ no so. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo, nnamfo, anaa adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ na ama wɔatumi agyina nea efi kɔmputa so ayayade mu ba no ano. Kwati sɛ wobɛtua so ka anaasɛ wobɛma tebea no ayɛ kɛse na mmom wode w’adwene asi wo ho a wobɛhwɛ so na woahwehwɛ mmoa so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne kokoamsɛm a mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ SRH ho nsɛm ne nnwuma wɔ Intanɛt so no kyerɛ, na nneɛma bɛn na wobetumi ayɛ de abɔ wɔn kokoamsɛm ne wɔn ankasa data ho ban?
answer_twi_source: SRH ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ intanɛt so no betumi ama mmabun kokoam nsɛm ho haw aba: Ahintasɛm ho asiane: Ebia mmabun bɛhaw wɔn ho sɛ wɔn kokoam nsɛm bɛpue bere a wɔrenya SRH ho nsɛm a ɛho hia anaasɛ wɔrehwehwɛ nnwuma wɔ intanɛt so no. Data ho banbɔ: Ankorankoro data a wɔkyɛ wɔ SRH wɛbsaet anaa sohyial media so no betumi ayɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobebu so anaasɛ wɔde adi dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, na ɛde ɔhaw anaa animtiaabu a ebetumi aba. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛbɔ ho ban: Nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de abɔ kokoamsɛm ho ban no bi ne sɛ wɔde platform ahorow a ahobammɔ wom na wɔde encrypted bedi dwuma, wɔde kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a emu da hɔ ama, na wɔde akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahwehwɛ nsɛm anaa mmoa a wɔmmɔ din bɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi ntawntawdi a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata ma ahokafo baanu no nyinaa adwene mu yiedi so? (nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, asɛm a wɔka sie) .
answer_twi_source: Asɛm a Woka: Fa ahotoso ka w’ahiade ne wo atinka ho asɛm bere a wubu wo hokafo adwene no. Nkitahodi Ho Nimdeɛ: Muntie no denneennen, kwati asodi, na momfa mo adwene nsi ano aduru a mobɛbom ahwehwɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi anya kɔkoam ne atemmuo a ennim apɔmuden akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama mpanyin mu kɔ ho nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Kɔkoamunsɛm: Kɔkoamunsɛm mmara hyɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ, enti wo nkɔmmɔbɔ ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ kɔkoam. Ayaresabea ne Mmoa Ntelefon: Ayaresabea bi ma mmabun mmoa pɔtee a kɔkoam akwan wom. Mmoa ntelefon ne intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ nso wɔ hɔ. Sukuu Nneɛma: Sukuu mu afotufoɔ anaa anɛɛsefoɔ betumi ama akwankyerɛ na ebia wɔwɔ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wogye wɔn di a wɔbetumi de wo akɔ wɔn nkyɛn. Intanɛt So Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet 'website' ne intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ mmeae a wogye di pɔtee ma mmabun apɔmuden nsɛmmisa wɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mfe a obi adi ho anohyeto anaa ahwehwɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma wanya nna ne awoɔ ho akpomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mfe a obi adi anaa nea wɔhwehwɛ no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Ebia nnwuma bi te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano anaa nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu, betumi ama mmabun a wɔadi mfe biara a awofo mpene so, bere a afoforo te sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma, betumi anya mfe pɔtee bi anaa pene a wɔhwehwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm a wohu wɔ Intanɛt so a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm a wohu wɔ intanɛt so a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no yɛ nokware na wotumi de ho to so denam nsɛm no fibea a wɔbɛhwɛ mu, ahwɛ sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo anaa ahyehyɛde no adansedi nkrataa ne ne ho akokwaw, nsɛm a wɔde bɛtoto mmeae a wɔagye din te sɛ aban akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa nnuruyɛ fekuw ahorow ho, na wɔagyina akwankyerɛ ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a egyina adanse so ahwɛ sɛnea emu nsɛm no yɛ nokware no mu yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnwuma ahorow a aka bom boa  nkɔsoɔ a  ɛwɔ akwaa apɔmuden  ho adwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ mmabun ?
answer_twi_source: Nkabom ma ɔhwɛ kɔ so wɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ sɛ mmabun benya akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so daa a edi wɔn ahiade ahorow a ɛrekɔ so bere tenten ho dwuma no so. Ɛdenam nnwuma ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe biako mu so no, mmabun betumi anya mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne ɔhwɛ a wodi akyi sɛnea ɛho hia. Nkabom nso boa ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ yɛ adwuma bom wɔ nkitahodi ne nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ nnwuma titire ne nteɛsoɔ ahodoɔ ntam a ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ so. Saa kwan a ɛfa nneɛma ahorow ho yi hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun nya ɔhwɛ a wɔayɛ no biako a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ne yiyedi afã horow nyinaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn atorɔ adwene  anaa anansesɛm ahorow na ɛfa adwenemyare ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Atorɔ adwene anaa anansesɛm ahorow bi a ɛfa adwenemyare ho no bi ne sɛ wobegye adi sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛwyɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne anaasɛ ankorankoro betumi “afiri mu” kɛkɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun te ase sɛ adwenemyare yɛ aduruyɛ mu tebea horow a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔsa no yare yiye na wɔboa. Atosɛm foforo ne sɛ nnipa a "wɔbɔ dam" anaa "basabasayɛfo" nkutoo na wɔwɔ adwenemyare, a ɛnyɛ nokware na ɛboa ma wɔyɛ animtiaabu ne nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneyɛe pɔtee bi a metumi ayɛ de akamfo ASRR ahorow, a egyina m’anigye ne m’ahokokwaw so? (Nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw kɔma ananmusifo, adesrɛ a wofi ase, nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a wɔyɛ).
answer_twi_source: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so akamfo, a egyina wo nimdeɛ ne w’anigye so: Krataa a wobɛkyerɛw akɔma Ananmusifo: Kyerɛ wo haw wɔ ASRH nsɛm ho kyerɛ wo mpɔtam, ɔman, anaa ɔman ananmusifo. Adesrɛ a Wobɛhyɛ aseɛ: Yɛ intanɛt so adesrɛ a wode bɛboaboa mmoa ano ama ASRH asɛm bi a wodwene ho. Nhomasua mu Nsɛm a Wɔbɛbɔ: Yɛ nsɛm a ɛma nsɛm anaa video ahorow a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho wɔ sohyial media anaa blog so .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, ne asetena mu nkitahodi ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow so, a asetena mu nkitahodi ahorow, intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow, ne atetesɛm nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ka ho. Atosɛm ahorow bi a wɔtaa ka no bi ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho, te sɛ sɛnea twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho no tu mpɔn (ɔkwan a wɔfa so twe wɔn ho fi ho), nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa dwuma a mmarima ne mmea di wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu, ne gyidi ahorow a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa "STI" a wɔde ma ho, te sɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ sɛ wowɔ ɔyere biako abusuabɔ mu a, wuntumi nnya nna mu nyarewa (STI).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne nyamesom akannifo ka mmabun nna mu akwahosan, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne wɔn adi nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔkyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ adwene. Kasa kyerɛ wɔn. Kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ nkuran. Ne wɔn nyɛ adwuma. Wɔbɛyɛ biako wɔ akwan horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi asusuw sɛnea yebedi atenka a emu yɛ den te sɛ dadwen, adwennwen, anaa adwenem naayɛ ho dwuma bere a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho no ho?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa atenka ahorow a emu yɛ den te sɛ dadwen, adwennwen, anaa adwene a ɛyɛ basaa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaahosan ho ho nkuran. Fa akwan horow a mfaso wɔ so a wobɛfa so agyina saa nkate horow yi ano ma, te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wɔde home a emu dɔ, akwan a wɔfa so de adwene si nneɛma so, anaasɛ mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Gye wo atenka ahorow no mu den na ma wo awerɛhyem sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya nkate ahorow bere a woredi nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow ma mmabun, titiriw mmeawa, mmerɛwyɛ ahorow yɛ kɛse wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu, na nneɛma bɛn na wobetumi ayɛ de adi nsonsonoe ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima ne mmea ntam pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi ama mmabun, titiriw mmeawa, mmerɛwyɛ ahorow ayɛ kɛse wɔ wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu. Nneyɛe a ɛma nyiyim te sɛ mmofra aware ne basabasayɛ a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so betumi akɔ soro, aduan pa a wonnya nni, na ɛbɛma mmeawa anya nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bio. Nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de adi nsonsonoe yi ho dwuma bi ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmarima ne mmea nyinaa ayɛ pɛ, wɔbɛma mmeawa anya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ, na wɔde nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde besiw mmofra aware ne basabasayɛ a egyina mmarima ne mmea so ano bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa afa biara yɛ wo botae bere a woresusuw nyinsɛn mu nneɛma a wobɛpaw ho no, fa w’adwene si nsɛm ne nneɛma a wode bɛma de asi gyinae a ɛfata so.
answer_twi_source: Yɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ yɛde nsɛm a ɛnyɛ afa biara na ɛnyɛ nea ɛfa biribiara ho bɛma, na yɛde yɛn adwene si nneɛma a yɛde bɛma de asi gyinae a ɛfata so. Nea etwa to a wobɛpaw wɔ wo nyinsɛn no ho ne wo de. Kae sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wo nkutoo fa eyi mu. Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wodwen wo ho na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa. Yɛsrɛ sɛ kɔ ɔpanyin a wogye no di, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo, akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea bi nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de sikasɛm nketewa adi dwuma de adi asetra ne sikasɛm mu nsɛm pɔtee bi ho dwuma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ, te sɛ adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, ohia, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne asetra mu nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Adwuma a wonnya nyɛ ho dwuma a wobedi: Adwuma hokwan ahorow, wɔn ankasa adwuma, ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wonya sika a wɔbɛma aba denam nnwumakuw a sikasɛm nketewa boa, adwumayɛkuw ahorow, ne nneɛma a ɛsom bo so. Ohia a wɔbɛtew so: Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔanya sika, ahokokwaw ntetee, ne adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho ne wɔn mmusua afi ohia mu. Mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Wɔde sikasɛm nketewa dwumadie, akannifoɔ nteteeɛ, ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛboa mmaa ne mmabaa de ama sikasɛm mu kyɛfa, gyinaesie, ne tumidie akɔ anim. Asetra mu nyiyim a wɔbɛtew so: Sikasɛm mu nkabom, asetena mu mmoa, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua, te sɛ nkuraase mmerante ne mmabaa, aguanfo, anaa nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, de ahyɛ asetra mu biakoyɛ ne nnipa a wɔka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ nna mu ɔhaw a ɛba mmabun so?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo yɛ nhwehwɛmu a edi mu, a aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm ne nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Ebia wɔbɛhyɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ lab mfa nhwɛ sɛnea hormone dodow anaa akwahosan ho agyiraehyɛde afoforo te. Wobetumi ayɛ adwene mu nhwehwɛmu de asusuw nkate mu nneɛma ho. Ayaresa: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kyerɛw nnuru (te sɛ Viagra a wɔde sa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw). Ebia wɔbɛkamfo ayaresa te sɛ adwene ne nneyɛe ho ayaresa (CBT) akyerɛ wɔ adwene mu nneɛma ho. Wɔde asetra mu nsakrae ne afotu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe ho ma. Nhomasua: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nipadua akwaa, ne nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne STI ano a wosiw ho. Nea wodi akyi: Wɔbɛkɔ hɔ daa ahwɛ sɛnea ɛrekɔ so na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ ayaresa no mu sɛnea ɛho hia. Wɔde wɔn kɔ animdefo nkyɛn wɔ nsɛm a emu yɛ den ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔnyem a wohyia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe, te sɛ insurance, kar, anaa sika a wonnya?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔnyem a wohyia akwanside ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya apɔmuden ho nnwuma no wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ akwan pii a wobetumi afa so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ɔman apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe anaa nnwuma a ankorankoro a wonnya sika pii betumi anya, te sɛ Medicaid anaa apɔmuden ho ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde sika boa, a ebetumi de ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ awo, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ awo akyi a wɔatew so anaasɛ wɔrentua hwee. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afiri asetena mu nnwumakuo anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde mmoa ma wɔ akwantuo, sikasɛm mu mmoa, anaa insurance a wɔde wɔn din hyɛ mu de boa ma wɔtua apɔmuden ho ka na wɔdi akwansideɛ a mfasoɔ wɔ so a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ mu no ho dwuma. Mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim a wɔnyɛ ne apɔmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ ɔman mmara ase, a ɛbara apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo sɛ wonnyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a wɔadi, nyinsɛn tebea, anaa asetra mu sikasɛm tebea so pow nnwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ne ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ayayade mu, na sɛ mihia a, mɛyɛ dɛn anya mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so Hokwan ne Ahobammɔ: Wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa ayayade mu no wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne: Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɔ mmonnaato no ho amanneɛ kyerɛ mmarahyɛ baguafo. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wonya ayaresa ne adanse a wɔboaboa ano (rape kit). Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde ahobammɔ ahyɛde ma nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no. Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔde kokoam nsɛm sie. Mmoa a Wobɛnya: Wubetumi anya mmoa ne nneɛma a wode bɛyɛ adwuma denam: Mpɔtam hɔ mmonnaato ho haw ho mmeae anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo. Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ adwenemhaw ho. Wɔn a wɔkamfo wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no kyerɛ a wobetumi akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ mmara kwan so nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Aduruyɛ ho adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de ɔhwɛ ama na wɔaboaboa adanse ano. Amanneɛbɔ: Nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde bɛma mmarahyɛ baguafo no yɛ nea obi ankasa paw. Wobetumi akora adanse so denam aguaree, ntade a wɔrensesa, anaa ahohoro bere a wɔatow ahyɛ obi so akyi no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa Intanɛt so nneyɛe ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ medi mmara so?
answer_twi_source: Te mfe a wɔde pene so ho mmara a ɛwɔ wo mantam mu, a ɛkyerɛ mfe a mmara ma ho kwan sɛ  wotumi di mpamu agorɔ. Mmeae bi wɔ mmara a ɛbara sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ Nipadua mfonini a ɛkyerɛ aniwudeɛ a onipa no mmaa ho kwan, a wɔfrɛ no aweredi nguamansɛm ho mmara (revenge porn laws). Mmofra Nguamammɔ Ho Mmara: Te ase sɛ ankorankoro a wonnii mfe pɔtee bi (mpɛn pii no mfe 18) ho nsɛm a wɔda no adi pefee a wɔbɛkyɛ no yɛ mmara so bu. Intanɛt so Ayayade Ho Mmara: Mmara a ɛko tia Intanɛt so ayayade ne kɔmputa so ayayade nso fa nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho. Daa kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa Intanɛt so nneyɛe ne nna ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu wɔ adwenemyare ho haw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho? (dadwen a emu yɛ den, adwenemhaw, ɛyɛ den sɛ obegyina ano) .
answer_twi_source: Sɛ nkate mu nsɛnnennen yɛ den a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa: Dadwen a emu yɛ den: Dadwen a ɛkɔ so daa a ɛsiw wo kwan wɔ wo daadaa dwumadie mu. Adwenemhaw: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ wayɛ basaa anaasɛ onni anidaso biara da no fã kɛse no ara, bɛboro adapɛn abien. Ɔhaw a Wobegyina Ano: Ɔpere a ɔpere sɛ obedi nkate anaa nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me nna mu nkitahodi no yɛ nea mepene so, ɛkyerɛ obu, na ɛyɛ anigye ma me ne me hokafo no nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Mpene: Hwɛ sɛ afã abien no nyinaa pene so pefee na ɛyɛ anigye ansa na wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara mu. Bu a Wobɛma Wo Ho Wo Ho: Bu wo hokafo ahye ne n’akɔnnɔ, na di nkitaho pefee wɔ nea wohwɛ kwan ho. Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ahobammɔ: Fa kɔndɔm anaa ahobammɔ foforo di dwuma bere nyinaa de siw STI ne nyinsɛn a wonhyɛ da ano. Check-In: Wo ne wo hokafo kɔ hɔ bere a worekɔ nna mu ne bere a woawie no na ama woanya awerɛkyekye ne anigye. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua abusuabɔ pa, pene a wɔpene so, ne nna mu akwahosan ho ade na ama woanya osuahu ahorow a ɛma wohu nneɛma pii na ɛyɛ anigye. Kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma no ma wonya ahobammɔ abien fi nyinsɛn ne STI ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna mu yareɛ nya nsunsuansoɔ  wɔ awo ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden?
answer_twi_source: Nsunsunaso a Ɛwɔ Awo So: nna mu yarewa (STI) ahorow bi, sɛ wɔansa a, ebetumi ama obi ntumi nwo anaasɛ ɔhaw ahorow a ɛba bere a nyinsɛn no aba. Sɛ nhwɛso no, nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ chlamydia anaa gonorrhea a wɔansa no betumi de yare a ɛma obi ho hyehye no (PID) aba mmea so, na ebetumi ama wontumi nwo. Nyinsɛn mu haw: nna mu yarewa  te sɛ nea a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ syphilis anaa HIV betumi afi ɛna mu akɔ abofra mu wɔ nyinsɛn anaa awo mu, na ɛka akokoaa no akwahosan a mmofra a wɔawo no foforo anifurae ka ho. Ntɛm a Wohu na Wɔsa: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ne ayaresa a wɔyɛ no ntɛm betumi asiw asiane ahorow yi ano anaasɛ ɛbɛtew so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne ahokokwaw a wɔde gyina ano, de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu osuahu ahorow a enye te sɛ kɔmputa so ayayade, Intanɛt so ayayade, nipadua mfonini ho dadwen, ne asetra mu ntotoho mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne ahokokwaw a wɔde gyina nsɛm so de afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu osuahu ahorow a enye mu denam: Atinka mu mmoa ne nokwaredi a wɔde bɛma bere a mmabun hyia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene, ne boa a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔadi wɔn nsusuwii ne wɔn nkate ho dwuma wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom mu. Mmabun akwan horow a mfaso wɔ so a wɔbɛfa so adi nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho ho dwuma, te sɛ ahomegye a wobegye afi sini ahorow so, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa anigyede ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma, akwan horow a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa atipɛnfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn. Mmabun tumi a wɔde bɛma wɔn ma wɔakamfo wɔn ho ne afoforo wɔ intanɛt so mmeae ahorow, te sɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ ayayade anaa nea epira a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ, nkɛntɛnso bɔne a wosiw ano anaasɛ wonni akyi, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi atumfoɔ a wɔhwɛ wɔn so anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow hɔ bere a ɛho hia no. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn ho a wobu, wɔn ho mu ahotoso, ne wɔn ho ayamhyehye a wɔbɛkyekye denam ahoɔden pa a wɔde hyɛ wɔn mu den, wɔn bo a ɛsom ne wɔn bo a wosi so dua, ne hokwan ahorow a wobenya ama wɔn ankasa nkɔso ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛda no adi a ɛboro nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne akenkan ne akyerɛw ahorow afoforo te sɛ akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ne dijitaal akenkan ne akyerɛw di ahyia wɔ mmabun ntease ne yiyedi nyinaa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔboa no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne blog ahodoɔ a mmabun di anim, abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so ɔsatuo, ne mpɔtam nnwumakuo ahodoɔ a wɔyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm, wɔyɛ nhyiamu, anaa wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nsɛm mu de ma nkurɔfoɔ te nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho na wɔhyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, a ɛka obiara bom nkuran. Mantam nhyehyeɛ nso betumi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, sukuu ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ayɛ biako de ahyɛ wɔn nkrasɛm no mu den na wɔakamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe mu na ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔka ho asɛm no atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hu na mekasa tia animhwɛ anaa nsusuwii ahorow a ebetumi anya me gyinaesi nhyehyɛe so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛhunu na woapere atia animia-hwɛ anaa susuhunu a ɛtumi ka wo gyinaesi ho no yɛ adwene mu dɔ (critical thinking) fa titiriw baako. Susuw w’ankasa wo gyidi, osuahu ahorow, ne amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow a ebetumi akyerɛ w’adwene wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho no ho. Susuw adwene foforo ho, hwehwɛ adwene ahorow, na gye nsusuwii ahorow a ɛwɔ wo paw ahorow ase no ho kyim. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a w’adwene mu abue mu ne ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di a wobetumi de adwene ahorow ama na wɔaboa wo ma woakasa atia animhwɛ ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi de meho ahyɛ amanebɔn kuo ahodoɔ mu, akyitaeɛ anammɔntuo deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔka no 'advocacy' ne ɔmanmusɛm anammɔntuo a wɔtu no wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so de bɛko atia abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so nsɛm bɔne, apɛ nsakraeɛ na aboa ma abɛɛfo ntentan fidie so dwuma ho ate na bio nso aboa ama mmabun anya asetena pa?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔhyɛkyerɛ a wɔyɛ no wɔ ntentanfidie so mu anaa pɛ sɛ wɔbɛkasa afa nna mu apɔmden ho nsɛm. Woankasa kasa fa nna mu apɔmden nsɛm ho na kyɛ ma afofoɔ nso. Dɔm sukuu kuo a wɔko ma ntentanfidie so nkyerɛkyerɛ na pɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsakraeɛ wo ntentanfidie so nsɛm ne dwumadie a enyɛ ho. Ne mpanyimfoɔ ne mmrahwɛfoɔ nyɛ adwuma mfa hwehwɛ nsakraeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ me hokafo no hyɛ me sɛ me ne no ɛnda a mempɛ a, mɛyɛ dɛn abua?
answer_twi_source: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi, bere nyinaa. Mma nte nka sɛ ɛyɛ w’asɛyɛde sɛ wo ne obi bɛda de asɔ obi foforo ani. Ma emu nna hɔ na pintinn: "Dabi" kɛkɛ yɛ. Ɛho nhia sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ wo ho mu. Fa nipadua mu kasa a emu yɛ den di dwuma: Fa w’ani hwɛ, gyina hɔ tenten, na ma wo nne yɛ den. Gyae tebea no: Sɛ wo hokafo no mmu wo dabi a, fi hɔ ntɛm ara na dont feel bad for doing that. Ka kyerɛ ɔpanyin a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso: Wo ne ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔwɔ adamfofa su ma mmabun a ɔwɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea, w’awofo, w’akyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo, anaa ɔpanyin biara a wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ wɔ ne nkyɛn no nkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ kuma mmusua, mmusua a wɔatrɛw mu, ɔwofo biako mmusua, ne mmusua a wɔadi afra, nya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nkitahodi, ne gyinaesi ho so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi anya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden  ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nkitahodi, ne gyinaesi ho so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Wɔ mmusua kuma mu, baabi a awofo ne mmofra bom tra no, ebia nna mu apomoden ho nkɔmmɔbɔ bɛyɛ tee na ɛtaa ba, efisɛ mpɛn pii no awofo di dwuma titiriw wɔ wɔn mma ntetee mu. Mmusua a wɔatrɛw mu, a awoɔ ntoatoaso pii te bom anaasɛ ɛwɔ abusuabɔ kɛse no betumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ foforo ama nanso ebetumi nso de amammerɛ anaa awoɔ ntoatoaso mu nsonsonoe aba wɔ adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no mu. Ebia mmusua a ɔwofo biako na wɔwom no behyia ɔhaw  soronko, te sɛ awofo asɛyɛde ahorow a wɔbɛkari pɛ nkutoo, nanso ebetumi ama awofo ne abofra ntam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛda nsow nso aba. Mmusua a wɔadi afra, a wɔnam aware foforo anaa ayɔnkofa so hyehyɛ no betumi ama nneɛma a ɛyɛ den aba a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔne mpenafo ne mpena nuanom nya abusuabɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri, a ebetumi anya mmabun ahotɔ dodow so nkɛntɛnso wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti a wɔresusuw ho no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabunberɛ (puberty) ka me ne nnamfo/abusua ntam abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nsakraeɛ a ɛba abusuabɔ mu. Anigyeɛ ne osuahu foforo.. Akasakasa tumi ba. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu da hɔ hyɛ abusuabɔ den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na abɛɛfo ntentanfidie di de boa adwene bɔne a afa nna mu dwumadie ne ɔkwan a mmabun betumi adi nkitaho wɔ ntentanfidie no so na watumi ako atia nneɛma bɔne na waka nneɛma pa afa akitahodie pa ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛkyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ adwene. Ɛhwehwɛ deɛ wohu mu yie. Ko tia atoro ne nneyɛeɛ bɔne. Kasa fa pene ne obu ho. Kyɛ nimdeɛ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhyɛsoɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ nneyɛe a wɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka nhyɛso ho ne ahunahuna, nnadaa, anaa ahoɔden a wɔde hyɛ obi ma ɔde ne ho hyɛ nna mu a ɔmpɛ anaasɛ ɔmpene so koraa. Ɛsono ne nneyɛe a wɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodi mu efisɛ nhyɛso fa akwan horow a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi obi a ɔsɔre tia anaasɛ ɔmpɛ so nkonim ho, beɛr a nneyɛe a wɔpene so hwehwɛ sɛ ahokafo nyinaa pene s wɔ pɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si so dua deɛn nti a dwumadie a wodi no mpɔtam sɛ wodebesi GSV ano na ayɛ ɔkwan a wɔfaso deboa nkorɔfoɔ.
answer_twi_source: Tumi a Wɔde Siw Ano: Ɛdenam adwuma a wɔbom yɛ so no, mpɔtam hɔfo betumi ayɛ amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu na wɔasiw GBV ano ansa na aba. Mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya nkwa: Mpɔtam a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no betumi de mmoa nkitahodi ne nneɛma ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ GBV mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ne nsɛm ho ananmusifo ne wɔn a wotumi hu wɔn di wɔ tebea horow a ɛboa a wɔbɛbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana amammra ne mmara mu no, wɔabra LGBTQ+ nneyɛeɛ ahorow, enti nhyehyɛeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛgyina mmoa ma saa nneyɛeɛ yi gye nnipa nyinaa ho kwan a ɛhia (basic human rights) nko ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn  nkitahodi ho akwan na ɛyɛ ketee, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa yɛn ma yɛada yɛn ahiade ne yɛn ahye adi bere a yɛkɔ so nya obu ma afoforo no?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ fann hwehwɛ sɛ yɛbɛda yɛn ahiade, yɛn nsusuwii, ne yɛn atenka adi pefee na yɛkyerɛ obu bere a yɛkyerɛ obu ma afoforo apedeɛ  ne ahye nso. Saa nkitahodi kwan yi ma wonya ahotoso wɔ wɔn ho, obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne ahye a ɛfata wɔ anyonkofa mu. Akwan a wɔfa so ka asɛm no bi ne "Me" nsɛmfoa a wɔde bedi dwuma, ahyeɛ  a wɔbɛka no pefee, ne obi a ogyina hɔ ma ne ho a ɔnyɛ basabasa anaasɛ ɔnyɛ hwee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mmebun bɛko atia dɛmdifoɔ nyiyimu?
answer_twi_source: Kasa ma woho wɔ obuo mu. Ka nokware. Boa nnamfo. Dɔm kuo. Fa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn di dwuma. Sua mmara. Sua abusuabɔ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: M'awofoɔ bɛtumi ahu sɛ m'ayi nyisen agu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana ha, mmara  biara ni wɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ w'awofoɔ gyeto mu ansa na wayi nyisen agu. Enti wɔrenhu gye sɛ woankasa woka. Nanso, sɛ woyɛ abofra yi, ɛtɔ da a ɛhia sɛ panyin bi pene so ma wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi de nsɛm a ɛfa amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, adi dwuma de akamfo "ASRR" ahorow wɔ m’ankasa me mpɔtam hɔ? (Nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu ahorow, a ɛtwe adwene si amanaman ntam apam ahorow so)
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛfa nhyehyeɛ ho no bɛtumi ama wo mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔkamfo no tumi: Nhomasua Ɔsatuo: Fa saa nhyehyeɛ yi kyerɛkyerɛ afoforɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) hokwan ahodoɔ. Mpaemuka a Wɔde Kyerɛw Nsɛm: Sɛ worekamfo nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe mu kyerɛ a, fa amanaman ntam apam ahorow a ɛfata a wo man de ne nsa ahyɛ ase no ka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama adwene mu apɔwmuden nnwuma atumi asom mmaabun hia adeɛ wɔpɛ gu ahorow, a ne ho nsɛm fa amammerɛ ne kasa ho nimdie nso ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu ahwɛdeɛ a ɛfata. Kasa mu hwehwe ho nsusuhoɔ, linguistics (akasakyereasɛmfoɔ). Bu gyidie mmra so. Nteteeɛ ma adwumayɛfoɔ..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ayaresabea anaa akwahosan asoɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde ma mmabun titiriw a wɔde nnuru a wɔde si nyinsɛn ano ma?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma! Nneɛma no bi ni: akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow no de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma mmabun, na mpɛn pii no, wɔde kokoam akwan horow ma. Ɔmanfo akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow: Mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow pii de nna ho he Sukuu ayaresabea ahorow: Sukuu ahorow bi wɔ akwahosan ayaresabea ahorow a wobetumi de afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ nnwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia asetra mu animtiaabu a ɛboa ma akuw binom yɛ mmerɛw wɔ Nna mu Nkɔmmɔbɔ ho no?
answer_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodeɛ a ɛda adi (open communication) ho nkuran, kyerɛkyerɛ afoforɔ, Ko ma nkabom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ho, na so akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka a ɛbata 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ beaeɛ, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ ko, ne nea broni ka no 'insurance' a wɔde tua ho ka so. Nanso, ayaresabea ahorow pii de nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma, titiriw ma mmabun a ebia wonni insurance anaa sika a wɔde betua. Ɔmanfo akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ nea broni ka no 'Planned Parenthood' taa de nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mɛtumi afa nidi ne akwanya pa so ne me hokafoɔ abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa m'akɔnnɔ, nea mehwɛ kwan, ne m'ahyɛeɛ (limitations) ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wobue: Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware. Tie a Ɛyɛ Nna: Tie wo hokafo akɔnnɔ ne n’ahye a wunsusuw ho. Fa "Me" Nsɛm Di Dwuma: Fa nsɛmfua te sɛ "Mete nka" anaa "Mepɛ" da w'ankasa w'akɔnnɔ ne anohyeto ahorow adi. Bisa Nsɛm: "Dɛn na w'ani gye ho?" "Dɛn na wo ho tɔ wo wɔ ho?" Nkitahodi: Hwehwɛ adwene a ɛne ne ho hyia na mo ne mo yɔnko te ase. Bu: Bu wo hokafo ahye na ka wo de ho asɛm pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu boa ma wɔyɛ nyiyimu tia nnipa a wɔwɔ STI anaa HIV?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu boa ma wɔyɛ nyiyimu tia nnipa a wɔwɔ STI anaa HIV denam: - Ɛhyɛ adwene a ɛnteɛ ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛwɔ saa tebea horow yi ho mu den, na ɛde ehu, kwati, ne ankorankoro a ɛka wɔn no fi mu ba. - a wobeto akwahosan, adwuma, nwomasua, ne asetena mu hokwan ahorow ano hye esiane adwemmɔne ne nyiyimu a egyina akwahosan tebea so nti. - a wde asetena mu animtiaabu ne tew a wde tew obi fi afoforo ho, a ebetumi aka adwenemyare, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne yiyedi nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso bɔne. - a wobebubu mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ sɔhwɛ, ayaresa, ne yareɛ ano aduru ho nkuran denam akwansideɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ nsɛm a wɔbɛda no adi, ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔbɛnya so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka nea wɔpɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ akyi nnwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ada wɔn apɛde adi na wɔde wɔn adwene ama denam akwan horow so, te sɛ nhwehwɛmu, nsɛm a wɔde ma ho nkrataa, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne afotufo,mpanyimfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di, anaasɛ akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so mu kyɛfa a wonya. Ahyehyɛde ahorow bi nso betumi anya intanɛt so dwumadibea anaa telefon a wɔde boa a mmabun betumi aka wɔn suahu ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a yɛbɛma atu mpɔn no betumi aboa yɛn ma yɛada yɛn nkate ne yɛn nsusuwii adi yiye, na ama yɛanya adwene mu yiedi?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a yetu mpɔn no ma yetumi da yɛn nkate ne yɛn nsusuwii adi yie, na ɛma yenya adwene mu yiyedi pa. Sɛ yetumi ka yɛn ahiade, yɛn nkate, ne yɛn ahye ho asɛm pefee a, ɛda adi sɛ yɛbɛte nka sɛ afoforo te yɛn ase, wobu yɛn, na wɔboa yɛn, na ɛno boa ma nkate fam yiyedi nyinaa ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɔsom di wɔ su ahorow a wɔda no adi wɔ nna ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho wɔ mmeae ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow nya nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe so nsunsuansoɔ?
answer_twi_source: ɔsom mu nsunsuanso: Adwene a Ɛyɛ Katee: ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow a ɛyɛ katee betumi ama wɔafa akwan horow a wɔfa so twe wɔn ho fi ho nkutoo ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho. Abrabɔ Ho Gyinapɛn: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ taa si abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne abusuabɔ ho so dua. Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛwɔ Nhyehyɛe So: Wɔ aman a ɔsom nya nsunsuanso kɛse mu no, ebia nhyehyɛe ahorow ne ɔsom nkyerɛkyerɛ hyia, na ɛbɛma wɔanya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ. Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛwɔ Adeyɛ So: Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: ɔsom sukuu ahorow bi de ɔsom nkyerɛkyerɛ ka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho. Nsɛm a Wɔkamfo: ɔsom akuw betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi akyerɛ, na akyerɛ sɛnea wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ te. ɔhaw: ɔsom mu gyidi ne hia a ehia sɛ wonya nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛkari pɛ no betumi ɔhaw. Amammerɛ, mmara, ne ɔsom mu nneɛma yi a yɛbɛte ase no ho hia kɛse na ama wɔatumi ayɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn a ɛkyerɛ obu, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mpɔtam hɔ tebea horow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adan a entumi nnyina anaasɛ adan a enni hɔ ka tumi a ɔbabun betumi de n’adwene asi ne nhomasua ne daakye botae ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Dabere a entumi nnyina anaasɛ adan a enni hɔ betumi anya tumi a ɔbabun betumi de n’adwene asi nhomasua ne daakye botae ahorow so nsunsuanso kɛse denam: Adwennwen ne dadwen a ɔde bɛba so: Baabi a wɔbɛda anaa wɔbɛtra ho adwenem naayɛ betumi de chronic adwennwen aba, na aka adwenem apɔmden ne adwene a wɔde si biribi so wɔ sukuu mu. Nneɛma a wɔyɛ daa a wɔsɛe no: Tu a wɔtaa tu kɔtra baabi foforo anaa adan a entumi nnyina no betumi asɛe adesua ho su, sukuukɔ, ne kyɛfa a wonya wɔ adesua akyi, na asiw adesua mu nkɔso ne nkɔso kwan. Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma kakraa bi: Ebia adan a enni hɔ no nni nneɛma a ɛho hia te sɛ intanɛt, mmeae a wosua ade a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn, anaa nneɛma atitiriw a wɔde di dwuma, na ɛma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wobewie fie nnwuma anaasɛ wobesua ade yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ nsɛm a merenya afa nna mu akwahosan ho no fata me nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a woadi ma wɔ ɔkwan a wubetumi afa so ate ase na woanya abusuabɔ a egyina wo mprempren nimdeɛ ne osuahunu ahorow so. Hwehwɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun anaa mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadu mpanyin afe so titiriw na ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ Planned Parenthood, American Academy of Pediatrics, anaa wo man akwahosan dwumadibea apene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea community outreach programs anya nsunsuanso so pa mmabun nna mu agodie ne awoɔ apɔwmuden nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi mu ho nhwɛsoɔ bi ne: Atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ: Wɔtete mmabun ma wɔbɛyɛ atipɛnfoɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne mmoa ma wɔn atipɛnfoɔ wɔ nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI a wɔsiw ano, ne mpenatwe pa ho. Mmabun ne Mmabun Akwahosan Dwumadibea: Ayaresabea anaa akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a wɔhwɛ mmabun titiriw, a wɔde awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛnyɛ atemmu bɛma. Nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua akwaa, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ho.
