Mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu: Nhyiamu, nhyiamu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ a mmabun bɛtumi anya nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwuma a ɛfa awoɔ akwahosan ho. Digitals outreach: Internet so akwan, social media, ne mobile apps a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyekyɛ awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, de afotuo a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nokware so ama, na wɔde mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun abata ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de akamfo wɔn kokoam hokwan ahorow bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhaw mu wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn kokoam hokwan ahorow denam nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛka akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw ahorow mu pefee no so. Sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a, wobetumi abisa sɛ wɔmmɔ wɔn din, abisa kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe, na wɔabisa sɛnea wobedi wɔn nsɛm ho dwuma na wɔabɔ ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara mu nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde nsa ne nnubɔne yɛ basabasayɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka ama mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a emu yɛ den de akyere wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no?
answer_twi_source: Asotwe no gu mu ahorow a egyina beaeɛ a asɛm no siiɛ ne sɛnea asɛm no kɔɔ so. Mpɛn pii no, wɔbu nneyɛe yi sɛ bɔne a emu yɛ duru na ebetumi de mmaratodoɔ asɛm te sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ anaa mmonnaa aba. Mmabun betumi apiri ama mmara a emu yɛ den denam: Nsɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ fa nsa ne nnubɔne mu basabasayɛ ne ne nsunsuansoɔ ho. Mmoa a wɔbɛma wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne (survivors) no na wɔanya atɛntrenee. Wɔbɛgyina hɔ ama nkyerɛkyerɛ a emu dɔ a ɛfa "pene-so" (consent) ho wɔ sukuu. Wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ mmarahyɛfoɔ na wɔnsesa mmara no mma ɛnhyɛ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn bɔne no animuonyam, na wɔanya mmoa a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwati sɛ wode aduruyɛ ho afotu pɔtee bɛma na kyerɛ wɔn akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata ma wɔahu ayaresa ne asane ahorow ho nsɛm.
answer_twi_source: nya nsɛm fi akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata hɔ wɔ wo sukuu ayaresabea anaa akwaahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho hia efisɛ ɛhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun nyinaa, a wɔn bɔbeasu mfa ho, nya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho ɔhwɛ, nnwuma, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ. Ɛboa ma wobubu ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam nsusuii hunu ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira a ebetumi asi mmabun ahofadi, gyinaesi, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia a wobenya ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na yebetumi ayɛ de atew animtiaabu a ɛwɔ STI ho no so? (nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, nhomasua) .
answer_twi_source: Yɛn nyinaa betumi adi dwuma bi wɔ animtiaabu a ɛfa STI ho a yɛbɛtew so denam: Nkitahodi a Ebue Mu: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna mu apɔwmuden ho asɛm a yɛbɛka pefee na yɛadi nokware no boa ma wɔsɛe anansesɛm na ɛma sɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ no yɛ nea ɛfata. Nhomasua: Sɛ yesua nsɛm a edi mu fa STI ho a, ɛboa yɛn ma yɛte ase sɛ wotumi sa na ɛnyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛfɛre.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkwammoa ahodoɔ di wɔ awo nhyehyɛe no sohwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmaa: Estrogen: Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ awotwaa mu, estrogen na ɛma mmaa nna mu su a ɛto so mmienu nya nkɔso, ɛhwɛ brayɛ so, na ɛsiesie awotwaa no ma nyinsɛn. Progesterone: Ɛdi dwuma wɔ ovulation akyi, na progesterone siesie awotwaa no ma nyinsɛn na ɛboa ma awotwaa no mu ntini no kɔ so tena hɔ. Mmarima: Testosterone: Ɛwɔ testes mu, testosterone na ɛyɛ mmarima nna mu nkwaadɔm titiriw a ɛboa mmarima nna mu su a ɛto so mmienu, mmadwoa a wɔyɛ, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ nya nkɔso. Saa nkwaammoa yi bom yɛ adwuma ma mmaa brayɛ ne mmadwoa a wɔyɛ wɔ mmarima mu no yɛ adwuma. Wɔsan nso di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna mu nkɔso, awoɔ, ne awoɔ akwahosan mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene ne atenka famu nkɛntɛnso a wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ nya wɔ mmabun so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyinom ka wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nneyɛe ne nea efi mu ba?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ betumi anya mmabun so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ adwene ne atenka famu, a adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw a ɛkɔ soro ka ho. Saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi betumi aka mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nneyɛe ne nea efi mu ba denam gyinaesi, ɔhwɛ a wobenya, ne adwene mu yiedi a ebenya so nkɛntɛnso so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛbɛyɛ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ mu ama mmebun ate nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo sɛ wobɛka nna mu awo akwaa apɔmuden ho asɛm a ehu ne atemmu anaa nyiyim biara nni mu ?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ a emu dɔ . Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛko tia nyiyimu. Ayaresa a ɛfata mmabun. Mmabun mmoa kuo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ne afotu a ɛfa sɛnea wobesiw nna mu nyarewa (STI) ano ho denam abusua nhyehyɛe ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ne afotu a ɛfa sɛnea wobesiw nna mu nyarewa (STI) ano ho denam abusua nhyehyɛe ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so. STI a wosiw ano yɛ ade titiriw a ɛwɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ mu, na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotu, ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne akwan a wɔfa so tew asiane so ama wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho ama aduruyɛ mmoa a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn, na nsɛm bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asiesie wɔn ho ama ayaresa mmoa a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn denam wɔn yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne, ayaresa ho abakɔsɛm, ne nnuru biara a wɔnom ho nsɛm a ɛfata a wɔbɛboaboa ano no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wosiesie wɔn ho nso sɛ wɔne wɔn apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo bɛka wɔn haw ahorow ho asɛm pefee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkrasɛm a epira wɔ media mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛha sɛnea mmabun bu wɔn ho, wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkrasɛm a epira a ɛwɔ media mu no kyerɛ nsɛm a ɛhyɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware ho nkuran, ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam nsusuii hunu mu den, anaasɛ ɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nneyɛe a ɛmfata. etc. Saa nkrasɛm yi betumi anya mmabun so nkɛntɛnso bɔne denam wɔn adwene a wɔkyinkyim ho, wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho so. Ebia ɛbɛma wɔate nka sɛ wɔmfata, obu wɔn ho a wonni, nipadua mu abotɔyam a wonni, na wɔhyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ nea ɔmanfo hwɛ kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mmabun betumi afa so de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo mu wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho hia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu nkɔso pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow adi dwuma de ahyɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu a ɛfa hia a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho hia wɔ mmabunu nna ne awo akwahosan  nsunsuanso pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran ho. Wobetumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe de akamfo ɔsatu ahorow, akyerɛw nkrataa akɔma nhyehyɛeyɛfo, de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔmanfo nhyiam ahorow mu, na wɔde abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nhyehyɛe ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛden ma mɛ yɛ sɛ menni gyedie  ɛfa me hokafo ho nna abakɔsɛm anaa  ne nna tebea?
answer_twi_source: Di nkitaho: nya bue ne nkoreɛ nkitahodie kwan so a wo ne wo hokafo nkasa fa sɛ mobɛ sɔ ahwɛ ne nna ho abakɔsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na fa nokwaredi mu. Yɛ Sɔhwɛ: Susuw ho sɛ mobɛbom ayɛ nhwehwɛmu ahwɛ sɛ obi anya nna mu kyɛfa ansa na mode mo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu. Fa Ahobammɔ Di Dwuma: Fa kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye anaa akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw ano bere nyinaa kosi sɛ wɔbɛsɔ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa ahwɛ na wɔagye adi sɛ wɔn tebea te.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa mu akwanside "language barrier" haw mmabun tumi a wɔde nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ntease, na nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ama kasa nkyerɛase ne nkyerɛase?
answer_twi_source: Kasa mu akwanside betumi anya mmabun tumi a wɔde nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ntease no kɛse. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi saa asɛnnennen yi ho dwuma no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de kasa nkyerɛase ne nkyerɛase adwuma ama, a aduruyɛ mu nsɛm asekyerɛfo a wɔatete wɔn, adwumayɛfo a wɔka kasa abien, ne kasa mmoa nnwinnade te sɛ nkyerɛase "app" anaa 'ahomatrofon "telephone" so dwumadi ahorow ka ho. Saa nneɛma yi boa ma wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi ne wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho yiye, ate ɔhwɛ a wobetumi apaw ase, na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ ayaresa anaa nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmabun mu a wɔmpene so?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi nyɛ aduruyɛ anaa nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmabun mu a wɔmfa wɔn ani nnye ho, gye sɛ tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ anaa tebea horow a ɔbabun no ntumi mfa pene mma na ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ntɛm ara na wɔasiw ɔhaw ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo akasa afa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna anaa adwenemyare ho?
answer_twi_source: Paw Bere a Ɛfata: Hwehwɛ bere a ɛyɛ komm, kokoam bere a obiara ho adwo no na woamfa ahopere anyɛ. Di Nokware na Bue Mu: Ka w'atenka ne wo nsusuwii nokwarem, fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma na woanbɔ sobo. Fa Nhwɛsoɔ Di Dwuma: Sɛ ɛboa a, fa nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfiri nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ anaa nnamfo suahunu mu di dwuma fa hyehyɛ wo nsɛmmisa. Bisa Mmoa: Ma wonhu sɛ wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso na wuhia wɔn akwankyerɛ, nanso wopɛ sɛ wobɔ saa nsɛmti yi ho nkɔmmɔ pefee nso. Siesie Wo Ho Ma Nsɛmmisa: Ebia wɔn nso wɔ nsɛmmisa, enti momma mo ani nnye ho mma mommɔ nkɔmmɔ na munsua ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenemyare a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho botae ahorow a ɛtrɛw ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma yiyedi nyinaa atu mpɔn na wɔatew adwenemyare ho adesoa so wɔ ɔmanfo mu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu akwahosan a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho botae ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtrɛw a wɔde bɛma yiyedi nyinaa atu mpɔn na wɔatew adwenemyare ho adesoa so wɔ ɔmanfo mu no hyia denam: Mmabun tumi a wɔde gyina tebea horow ano, sɛnea wotumi gyina ano, ne adwenemyare ho nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa mu, a ɛbetumi asiw adwenemyare a ebefi ase anaasɛ ɛbɛma ayɛ kɛse akyiri wɔ asetra mu no ano. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ne nhumu fapem a wɔbɛkyekyere a ɛma ankorankoro tumi hu ahoyeraw ho sɛnkyerɛnne, hwehwɛ mmoa, na wonya mmoa nnwuma a ɛfata. Animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛbata adwenemyare ho a wɔbɛtew so, a ebetumi de akwanside ahorow aba ayaresa ne mmoa mu na ama asetra mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no akɔ so. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ayɔnkofa ne adwumayɛkuo a ɛda sukuu ahodoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ntam a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den de ayɛ mmeaeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛboa a ɛhyɛ adwenemyareɛ ne yiedie ho nkuran ma obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na "hokwan a wɔ wɔ sɛ wosiw HIV ano na wɔsa no yiye" kyerɛ ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ wosiw HIV ano na wɔsa no yiye ma mmabun no kyerɛsɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, akwan a wɔfa so siw ano, nhwehwɛmu adwuma, ayaresa, ne mmoa a wɔnyɛ nyiyim. Nea ɛka ho ne nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de asiw HIV yareɛ ano, ntɛm a wɔbɛhunu, ɔhwɛ pa a wɔbɛnya, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔwɔ HIV.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Susu nhwehwɛmu akwan ahorow, ho a kɔkoam ayaresabea ne ofie nhwehwɛmu (sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a) ka ho.
answer_twi_source: Akwan kakra wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so yɛ STI nhwehwɛmu, a ne nyinaa yɛ kɔkoam na atemmuo nnim: Ayaresabea: mmabun mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ apɔmuden ayaresabea, ma kɔkoam STI nhwehwɛmu. Ayaresabea yi wɔ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn yie a wɔbetumi abua wo nsɛmmisa nao, ayɛ nhwehwɛmu, na wɔama wo ayaresa ɛsɛ. Ofie Nhwehwɛmu (baabi a ɛwɔ hɔ): Mmeae bi ma ofie STI nhwehwɛmu nneɛma. Nneɛma yi taa kyerɛ sɛ wobɛfa wo anom nsuo anaa dwensɔ na woasoma akɔ laboratori ma wɔahwɛ. Nsunsuansoɔ no betumi agye nna kakra. Asɛm a Ɛhia: Ofie nhwehwɛmu no rentumi nyɛ STI nyinaa nhwehwɛmu, na ebi hia sɛ wokɔ ayaresabea kɔhwɛ yareɛ no ne ayaresa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnuane bɛn na ɛboa ma menyin wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wubenyin wɔ apɔwmuden mu wɔ mmabunbere mu a, fa w’adwene si nnuan atitiriw yi so: Protein (Ntini): Di nam, mpataa, nkesua, bankye, atoko, ne agushie. Calcium (Nnompe): Nom nufusu na di nhaban mono anaa almond. Iron(Ahoɔden): Di nam kɔkɔɔ, bankye, ne akutu. (Ebia mmeawa nso behia nnuru a wɔde iron ma wɔn). Fruits & Veggies: Di nnuaba ahorow na woanya vitamin. Ahoɔden a Wɔde Di Dwuma: di bayerɛ, borɔde, oats, aburow, ne atoko. Srade a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Fa paya, nnuaba, ne ngo di dwuma ma amenmen wo. Nom Nsu: Kɔ so nya nsu na kwati soda a asikyire wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa mu akwanside ne kasa ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no haw mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwuma, titiriw ma atubrafo "immigrant" anaa mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua "marginalized" no?
answer_twi_source: Kasa mu akwanside ne kasa ahorow betumi aka mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwuma kɛse, titiriw ma atubrafo anaa mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua. Kasa titiriw a ɛwɔ ɔmantam pɔtee bi mu a wonnim no yiye no betumi asiw ankorankoro kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nsɛm, wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho, anaasɛ wɔbɛfa akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu yiye. Bio nso, amammerɛ ne kasa ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no betumi ama nsonsonoe aba nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu na kasa a wobetumi anya mu. Sɛ yɛbɛdi saa nsɛnnennen "challenges" yi ho dwuma a, ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyɛ kasa ahodoɔ ho nkuran na wɔde kasa nkyerɛaseɛ dwumadie, nneɛma a wɔakyerɛ aseɛ, ne nkitahodiɛ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ma na ama ankorankoro nyinaa anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbea, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono  wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔwoo no ho?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu yɛ adwene a wokura mu kɛse sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima, ɔbea, abien no nyinaa afrafra, anaasɛ emu biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ sɛnea wuhu wo ho ne nea wofrɛ wo ho wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu. Nanso ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a efi abɔde mu no kyerɛ nipadua mu su ahorow te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ chromosomes, honam mu nkwammoa, ne awo akwaa ahorow a wɔtaa de bata ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a obi yɛ ho. Bere a wogyina nipadua mu su so de ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wofi mu ma wɔ awo mu no, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna yɛ biribi a onipa biara hu na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ mu ma n’ankasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a metumi ayɛ de akura adwene mu apomoden pa mu bere a merekɔ nna ne awoɔ mu nkɔso mu no? (abusuabɔ pa, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, wɔn ho a wɔhwɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Abusuabɔ Pa: Fa sika hyɛ nkitahodi pa a wo ne nnamfo ne abusuafo a wɔyɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee mu. Nkitahodi a Ebue: Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka nsɛm a ɛhaw wo wɔ nna mu apomoden ho no ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Wo Ho Hwɛ: Fa dwumadi ahorow a ɛma obi nya adwene mu yiedi, te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, adidi pa, akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, ne bere a wode bɛtra abɔde mu no di kan. di wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho ɔyarehwɛfo nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ nneɛma a mfaso wɔ so :
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma de adi bɔbea mubasabasayɔ (GBV) ho dwuma wɔ amammerɛ tebea pɔtee bi mu anaasɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm? (wɔhwehwɛ mmoa ntam nkitahodi ahorow a ɛfata) .
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa sukuu ɔfotufoɔ bɛtumi aboa wo wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ a ɛdi bɔbea mu basabasayɔ (GBV) nsɛm ho dwuma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wosusu ho sɛ wo ne obi a ɔwɔ bɔbeasu mu anigyeɛ anaasɛ bɔbeasu mu su foforo na ɛrehyehyɛ hɔ? (nkitahodiɛ pa, ne anidie a wɔde bɛma ahyeɛ ho)
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛni bɛne wo abɔ bɔbeasu mu nneyɛe ne su ho nkɔmmɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nipadua no wɔ kwanpa so ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn abom akyerɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne asetena mu akuo ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu a wɔbɛma: Nhyiam, adwumayɛbea, anaa ɔsatu a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfoɔ, atipɛnfo ne manmufoɔ ate nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm ne ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow ase. Wɔn ho wɔn ho anisɔ: Afoforo a wobegye wɔn atom sɛnea wɔte na wɔasɔ ahoɔfɛ ho adwene teateaa ahwɛ denam nipadua ahorow ne ne nsusuii ahorow a wɔbɛda no adi so. Ahobammɔ Beae a Wɔbɛbɔ: Mpɔtam a ahobammɔ ne mmoa a wɔde besi hɔ ama ankorankoro ate nka sɛ wogye wɔn tom na wɔsom bo, a ɛmfa ho sɛnea wɔn ho te. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Ɛhyɛ Nkuran: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nipadua mfonini, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkɛntɛnso ho wɔ sukuu, akuo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akuo mu a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde di anim: Nipadua mu adwempa, wɔn ho a wɔgye tom, ne wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho nyinaa ho nhwɛsoɔ wɔ wɔn ankasa suban, wɔn nneyɛeɛ, ne wɔne afoforo nkitahodie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn adi pɔtee na ɛde animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma te sɛ amammerɛ, nyamesom, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, ne asetra ne sikasɛm tebea nya saa su ahorow yi so nsusuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛde animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ba no pɔtee yɛ  nea ɛyɛ den na ɛwɔ afã horow pii. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, ne atetesɛm ahorow hyehyɛ adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne awo ho nneɛma a wɔpaw ho, na ɛka abrabɔ pa, ahotew, ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho adwene. Asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne nhomasua a wonnya betumi ama animtiaabu ne nyiyim ayɛ kɛse denam hokwan ne nneɛma a wɔbɛtew ama ankorankoro a wɔato wɔn hintidua no so. Bio nso, nyiyim a wɔyɛ wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe, mmara nhyehyɛe, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow mu no ma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kɔ so na ɛmma mmabun nya hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a edi mũ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwuma ho kwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn ahu na wɔanya bi ayɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma bi te sɛ; bere-fã adwuma (part-time jobs), adwuma nteteɛ (internships), nsa-ano-nnwuma (apprenticeships), nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu (freelance work), ne wɔn ankasa nnwuma nketewa a wofi ase (entrepreneurship). Wobetumi anya saa akwanya ahorow yi denam adwuma ahorow a wobesua, adwumayɛfo a wobehyia wɔn, afotu a wobebisa afi afotufo hɔ, ne adwumayɛ ho guasodeyɛ anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛbɛtumi ayɛ sɛ adwenemu apomoden ho nnuru ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nkwammoa nnuru  (hormonal birth control) bi bɛtumi adi nsia anaa?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a ɛfa adwene mu apɔwmuden ho aduro betumi ne honam mu nkwammoa 'hormone' a wɔde si awodeɛ ano akabom anaa asia. Wo ne dɔkota bɔ nkɔmmɔ, fa awodeɛ ano nsisi ho a, ka aduro nyinaa a wunom kyerɛ no pefee, mmfa nsie no. Obetumi aboa wo ama woanya akwan a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma yie ama wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nipadua mu kasa, ɛnne a wɔde di dwuma, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu de di wɔ asɛm a wɔka de kyerɛ ne ahotoso a wɔde ma wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi ne gyinaesi mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua kasa, nne a wɔde kasa, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu de di dwuma titiriw wɔ asɛm a wɔka no denneennen ne ahotoso a wɔda no adi wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi ne gyinaesi mu no mu. Nea ɛka nipadua mu kasa a wɔka no denneennen ho ne sɛ wobɛkɔ so ahwɛ wo ho, wode nne a ɛyɛ komm na ɛyɛ pintinn bedi dwuma, na woagyina hɔ anaasɛ wobɛtra ase tẽẽ. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu te sɛ anim yɛbea, nsa a wɔde yɛ ade, ne sɛnea obi gyina hɔ no betumi ada ahotoso, nokwaredi, ne asɛm a wɔka no pen adi, na ɛhyɛ nkrasɛm a wɔde ano ka no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wodi abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow ho dwuma berɛ a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu nneyɛe, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, anaa STI ho no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔdi abrabɔ pa ne nneyɛe trenee (ethical considerations) ho dwuma bere a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ mmerɛ te sɛ aware mu nneyɛe, awogyeɛ ano aduru (contraception), anaa nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho kwan yi so:Nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe a atumfoɔ hwehwɛ mu: Wɔhwɛ hu sɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumakuw a ɛhwɛ abrabɔ pa so (IRBs anaa ethics committees) hwehwɛ nhyehyɛe no mu na wɔgye tom, na ama wɔatumi ahu sɛ akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu no yɛ nea ɛtene na ɛremfa asiane biara mma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no.Obu, pɛ ne pɛ, ne atɛntrenee: Wɔde nnyinasosɛm a ɛfa obu, tumi a obi wɔ sɛ osi ne gyinae, mmoa a ɛbɛba, ne atɛntrenee hyɛ nhwehwɛmu no mu, na ama wɔahu sɛ wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu no wɔ kwan a ɛtene na ɛyɛ nea ɛsɛ so.Akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ ma pɛne ne kokoamsɛm: Wɔde akwankyerɛ ne nneyɛe a emu da hɔ ma, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobepue obi pɛ mu (informed consent), wɔbɛbɔ kokoamsɛm ho ban, na wɔadi mfomso anaa abrabɔ pa ho nkitahodi biara a ebetumi aba nhwehwɛmu no mu no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nkamfo nhyehyɛe boa ma asetena mu nsakrae a ɛtrɛ ne sikasɛm mu atɛntrenee ba mmabun ne mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn sintidua so?
answer_twi_source: Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim no boa ma asetena mu nsakrae a ɛtrɛ ba denam dawuro bɔ, wɔboaboa mpɔtam hɔfo ano, na wonya wɔn a wosi gyinae so nkɛntɛnso ma wodi nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne ntɛnkyea ho dwuma no so. Sikasɛm mu atɛntrenee ma mmabun ne mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn sintidua no nam nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛma wonya nhomasua, adwumayɛ, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛho hia a ɛyɛ pɛ so, na ɛtew nsonsonoe so na ɛma ankorankoro tumi ma wɔyɛ nea wobetumi nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hwan na metumi ahwehwɛ mmoa firi ne hɔ wɔ SGBV mu?
answer_twi_source: Bɔ polisifo amanneɛ sɛ ahobammɔ wom a,  sukuu mu ɔfotufo,  nɛɛseni, anaa dɔkota.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua Ɔsatu: Yɛ nhyehyɛe anaa boa ɔsatu ahorow wɔ wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ de hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ho nkuran. Kyerɛw adesrɛ anaa nkrataa kɔma sukuu so ahwɛfo anaa mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo a wɔkamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ anim kyerɛ. Kɔka ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm so, te sɛ Planned Parenthood mmabun nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmabun akwahosan akuo a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Wubetumi ne sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo no adi nkitaho na woanya nsɛm pii afa sɛnea akuw a ɛtete saa no wɔ hɔ ho. Ntrɛwmu te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae(0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a ɛhyɛ nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ho nkuran. Fa sohyial media anaa akwan foforo di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ayɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe bere a wɔbɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban no?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ayɛ nneɛma pii de abɔ mmabun kokoamsɛm ho ban, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahintasɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan a emu yɛ den a wɔde bedi dwuma. Kokoam mmeae a wɔbɛma wɔasusuw nsɛm ne nhwehwɛmu ho. Ntetee adwumayɛfo wɔ hia a kokoamsɛm ne nidi mu nkitahodi ho hia a wɔde akwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ kokoam nkitahodi ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma, te sɛ nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔmmɔ wɔn din. Mmabun a wobu wɔn ahofadi ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ankasa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a wɔda no adi so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+  nnipa ho a ensusuw nneɛma afoforo a ɛfa nipasu ho? (a wɔhyɛ nsɛm a ɛda ntamgyinafo adi) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na enya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun a ɛwɔ hɔ ne emu nsɛm so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho no gu ahorow kɛse wɔ mpɔtamu ahorow mu na ebetumi anya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ne emu nsɛm a wɔde ma mmabun no so nkɛntɛnso. Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi de ahobrɛase ne ahobrɛase di kan, bere a afoforo nso betumi akasa ama nhomasua a edi mu a nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nsɛm ka ho. Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu no, wobu nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ sɛ ɛyɛ ahyɛde anaasɛ ɛmfata wɔ amammerɛ mu bere a ebinom ma kwan ma wɔbɔ nna ho nkɔmmɔ. Saa adwene ahorow yi ntease ne obu a wɔde ma no ho hia na ama wɔatumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a etu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na awofoɔ, ahwɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de wɔn adwene fa pem ne wɔn adwene aka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, ahwɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no mu. Wɔn adwene fapem ne wɔn adwene a wɔde ma no betumi ama wɔanya nhumu a ɛsom bo wɔ mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn ahorow, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔfo akwanhwɛ ahorow ho. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de awofoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ adi nkitaho denam nkɔmmɔdie, nhwehwɛmu, ne awofoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ fekuo so de aboaboa nsɛm ano na wɔahwɛ sɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no da ahiadeɛ ne wɔn haw a ɛwɔ nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no adi. Sukuu ne mpɔtam a wɔbom yɛ adwuma no ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wuranom na wobu akontaa wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ mɛhwehwɛ afotu adwuma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi ama me yiyedie atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Afotu a wobɛhwehwɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho no betumi ama woanya mfaso pii na ama wo yiyedi atu mpɔn denam: Beae a ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm wom a wobɛma woasusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho a worensusuw ho no so. Nkate fam mmoa ne w'atenka ne osuahu ahorow a wogye tom a wode bɛma. Nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wode besi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ne wo abusuabɔ ho. Boa a ɛbɛboa wo ma woafa tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wonhyɛ da, STI a wobehu, anaa abusuabɔ ho nsɛm. Wɔn ho a wobehu, ahotoso, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ berɛ a mewɔ nna mu ho ansɛmbisa anaa m'adwene yɛ me nyaa ɛfa nnamudwuma kwan pa, a mentumi nka nkyerɛ m'awofoɔ mpo, anaasɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ me so?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔde Sie Kokoamu: Hwehwe nneɛma a wɔde sie kokoamu aboafo, te sɛ  sukuufoɔ a afutufoɔ anaa ayeraɛhosa adwumayɛfoɔ. Ahomatorofoɔ bi te sɛ . 0540-118-999, 5100 (MTN users), PPA's Yenkasa digital center (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) bɛtumi aboa ama woanya nsɛm a ɛhohia. Abeifo ntetan so Nneɛma: ebi te sɛ wɛbsaet te sɛ Planned Parenthood, Teen Health Source, anaa Scarleteen ne YMK app ma kokoamu nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho apomoden ho. Nnamfoɔ a Wɔboa: Kasa kyerɛ adamfo a wotumi de wo ho to ne so a ebia ɔwɔ nsɛm anaa osuahu a ɛtete saa, na ɔde mmoa a ɛda hɔ ma. Apomoden ho Adwumayɛfoɔ: Hyehyɛ bere a wo ne apomuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛhyia de asusuw wo nsɛm ne w'ahwɛyiye ho kokoamu. Kokoamu ahomatorofoɔ: Fa Kokoamu ahomatorofoɔ 'anonymous hotlines' di dwuma de hwehwɛ nna ho apomuden ho nsɛm, te sɛ nea Planned Parenthood anaa mpɔtam hɔ apomudenfo adwumayɛbea ahorow de ma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho no mu yiye?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye no nhwɛ sɛ: Nsusuwii ne animhwɛ a ɛwɔ emu nsɛm no mu a wobegye ho kyim. Nsɛm a wɔde mae no fibea ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Atiefo a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔka ne nkrasɛm no atirimpɔw a yebesusuw ho. Nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti a wɔahyehyɛ ne ne mfonini a wɔyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu. Fibea ahorow pii a wɔde toto ho na ama wɔanya adwene a ɛtrɛw. Ɛdenam saa akwan yi a mmabun de di dwuma no so no, wobetumi anya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ho ntease a ɛyɛ nketenkete.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ahye di wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye a wɔko tia mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de asi hɔ na makura mu?
answer_twi_source: Hunu wo ahyeɛ: Fa w'adwene si wo gyinapɛn, wo gyidi, ne wo nkaeɛ a ɛyɛ dɛ anaa ɛyɛ den wɔ nsɛm horow mu so, na hwehwɛ baabi a wobɛto ahyeɛ no.Di wo ahyeɛ ho asɛm: Di wo ahyeɛ no ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ wo mfɛfo, na ka pɛpɛɛpɛ nea wo ho tɔ wo wɔ ho ne nea wo ho ntɔ wo wɔ ho.Gyina wo ahyeɛ so: Kura wo ahyeɛ no mu daa, ɛmfa ho sɛ afoforo bɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛtwe anaa wɔbɛsɔ wo ahwe anaa.Hwehwɛ mu bio na sesa: Hwehwɛ wo ahyeɛ no mu daa, na sesa no sɛnea ɛho hia, a egyina wo suahunu ne wo ankasa wo nyini so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nimdie a ɛfa nna mu agodie apɔwmuden mu nsɛm ne nyinsɛn ho nnuro a ɛyɛ nokware na metumi de asi gyinaeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu Nneɛma: Bisa wo sukuu ɔyaresafoɔ ma ɔmma wo nsɛm a ɛfata. Mpɛn pii no, sukuu ahorow wɔ nneɛma a wɔde bɛma asuafo. Yɛ nhyehyɛe kɔ oduruyɛfo anaa ɔyarehwɛfoɔ nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Bio so fa websites ahorow a agye din te sɛ Planned Parenthood, CDC, anaa NHS Choices di dwuma. Hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi akuo ahorow a wɔyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw hɔ. Nhoma: Kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ nhomakorabea kɔhwehwɛ nhoma a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ne nyinsɛn nnuro ho nsɛm. Hwehwɛ nhoma ahorow a wɔn a wonim adwuma no mu abenfoɔ akyerɛw. Hotlines ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Frɛ wɔn adwumayɛfoɔ na wonntu wo fo wɔ kokoam, nnyi wo nsɛmmisa ano. Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ apɔwmuden no asoɛe bi kɔhwehwɛ nhomawa, nkratawa, ne nneɛma a wɔde boa. Wɔtaa kyekyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nneɛma. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua Nhyehyɛe: Fa wo ho hyɛ nna mu agodie ho nkyerɛkyerɛ kuo a atipɛnfo di anim mu. Atipɛnfo betumi aka wɔn suahun ahorow na wɔde nsɛm a ɛsom bo ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nnipa a wɔwɔ intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ mmaeɛ so nkɛntɛnso, nnipa a wɔagye din, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Intanɛt so di wɔ mmabun suban ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛso a wɔyɛ: Intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ mmaeɛ so nkɛntɛnsofo ne nnipa a wɔagye din taa yɛ nhwɛsofo ma mmabun, na wonya wɔn suban ne wɔn gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna, pene, ne abusuabɔ pa ho so nkɛntɛnso denam wɔn nneyɛe, wɔn a wɔpene so, ne nkrasɛm a wɔde mena so. Nneɛma a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran: Wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso ne nnipa a wɔagye din bɛtumi ahyɛ nneɛma anaa asetra kwan a ɛfa SRH ho ho nkuran, a ebetumi akyerɛ mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ saa mmeae yi. Nhomasua mu nsɛm: Nnipa bi a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso ne nnipa a wɔagye din de wɔn nhyiam ase kamfo SRH ho nimdeɛ, nhomasua, ne animtiaabu a wɔde bɛma wɔn, na wɔma mmabun nya nsɛm a edi mu ne nhwɛso pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena mu dwumadi, na ɛne mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan wɔ abusuabɔ sɛn?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu dwumadi fa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔde asetena anaa amammui mu nsakrae bɛba denam ankorankora anaa akuw a wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano ma wɔadi nsɛm a ɛfa ntɛnkyea, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, anaa nyiyim ho dwuma ho. Wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) mu no, asetena mu dwumadi twe adwene si hokwan ahorow, yiyedi, ne tumi a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan a wɔpaw ne nnwuma a wobenya ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so. Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛkasa atia animtiaabu, ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ho nkuran, ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn ano aduru ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, na adi asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ nea ɛka ASRH aba no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi ahorow mu, te sɛ asetra mu nkitahodi a ɛkɔ soro, atenka a ɛba sɛ wɔatew ne ho anaasɛ animtiaabu a ɛso tew, ne obu a mewɔ ma me ho a ɛkɔ soro, na mɛyɛ dɛn ama mfaso horow yi ayɛ kɛse bere a meboa kuw no wɔ ɔkwan pa so no?
answer_twi_source: Mfaso a ɛwɔ atipɛnfo mmoa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bi ne nkitahodi a ɛkɔ soro wɔ ayɔnkofa mu, atenka a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho anaasɛ wɔabɔ wɔn animtiaa no so tew, ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho a ɛkɔ soro. Wubetumi anya mfaso horow yi kɛse bere a woreboa kuw no yiye wɔ: Kuw no dwumadi ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen, wo suahu, nhumu, ne mmoa a wode bɛma afoforo. Nyɔnkofa a wɔne mfɛfo asɔremma benya a egyina ahotoso, obu, ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho so, na wɔama wɔanya atenka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn de ne mpɔtam hɔfo. Sɛ́ wobebue w’ani sɛ wobenya mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔka fi atipɛnfo hɔ, a wohu sɛ mmerɛwyɛ yɛ ahoɔden a ɛma wonya nkitahodi a emu dɔ. Akannifoɔ dwumadie anaa asɛdeɛ a wɔbɛfa wɔ nkitahodiɛ no mu, te sɛ nhyiamu anaa nnwuma a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, de aboa ama ne nkɔsoɔ ne ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti mpɔtam nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde nsɛm ma afoforɔ betumi de nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, STI ano a wosiw, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ama?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow taa de nsɛm ne nneɛma a edi mũ ma wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, STI ano a wosiw, ne nsɛmti a ɛfa ho ho. Ebia wɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne afotu a wɔde ma obiara bɛma de adi mmabun nsɛmmisa ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ nnwuma anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a edii yiye a ɛde asetra ne sikasɛm mu mmoa ama mmabun wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a wodi ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a ɛdi mu no bi ne akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun a ɛde afotuo ma, atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkuran, adwumayɛ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nya nkɔsoɔ, ne nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ a ɛde asetena mu mmoa ne afotuo ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa na wɔama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna ne awoɔ hokwan ahorow a wɔabu so no nne ayɛ kɛse, ama wɔn nsɛm ayɛ kɛse, na wɔakasa ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ de asiw daakye ɔhaw ano na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobu atɛntrenee na wobu akontaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no denam baabi a ahobammɔ ne mmoa a wɔbɛma wɔn akyɛ wɔn nsɛm, anya awoɔ apomoden ho nneɛma, na wɔahwehwɛ atɛntrenee so. Ɛdenam ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔboaboa wɔn ano so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no nne ayɛ kɛse, ama nkurɔfo ate hokwan ahorow a wobu so abu so no ase, na wɔakasa ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ de asiw ɔhaw a ɛbɛba daakye ano na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobebu wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no ho akontaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mahwehwɛ me nna ne me bɔbeasu mu sɛ minnim a?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ mmabun adamfofa su wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wɔn no nkasa na woanya nsɛm pii
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na akuo ahorow a egyina mpɔtam ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi ahorow betumi aboa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ne hokwan ahorow a mmabun a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo ne wɔn a wɔnntena faako wɔ?
answer_twi_source: Akuo a ɛwɔ mpɔtam ne atipɛnfoɔ nkitahodiɛ di dwuma titire wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa mmabun a wɔtu kɔtena mmeaeɛ foforɔ no nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ne hokwan ahodoɔ denam nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie a ɛyɛ mmerɛ na ɛyɛ amammerɛ mu nsɛm a wɔde ma na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa, ne hokwan a mmabun wɔ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no so. Wɔsan nso yɛ nsɛm ne mmoa fibea ahorow a wotumi de ho to so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmu ne amammrɛ mu nneyɛe ne amanneɛ ahorow ho nkrataa betumi aboa ma wɔanya amammerɛ ahorow ho ntease a emu dɔ na ama wɔanya nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata amammerɛ mu wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu ne amammrɛ mu nneyɛe ne amanne ahorow ho nkrataa betumi aboa ma wɔanya amammerɛ ahorow ho ntease a emu dɔ na ama wɔanya nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata amammerɛ mu wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden mu. Ɛdenam amammrɛ mu nimdeɛ, amanneɛ, ne gyidie ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛkyerɛw so no, nhwehwɛmufo betumi akora amammerɛ agyapade a ɛsom bo so na wɔahyɛ amammerɛ ahorow ntam ntease ho nkuran. Saa nhwehwɛmu yi betumi ama yɛanya asetena, sikasɛm, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛkanyan atetesɛm mu nneyɛe, ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiedi so no ho nhumu. Ɛnam sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛdi nkitaho wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne nimdeɛ a wɔbom yɛ mu no, nhwehwɛmufoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔde amammerɛ mu adwene ne nneɛma a ɛhia titire bɛka nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ mu nhyehyɛeɛ, ne akwahosan ho dwumadie ho. Ɛdenam akwan horow a obu wom na ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho a wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu ne nkrataa so no, mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔagye wɔn amammerɛ mu nipasu atom na wɔadi ho afahyɛ bere a wɔkamfo nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ wɔn akwahosan, nidi, ne hokwan ahorow ho nkuran no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo anaa mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, di wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun mu, sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo anaa mmabun a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no taa di dwuma titiriw wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata mmabun mu wɔ ɔkwan bi te sɛ: Atipɛnfo mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrekɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma mu no so. Nhomasua nhyiamu anaa nsɛm a wɔka fa nsɛmti te sɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan, adwene mu yiedie, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde bɛma. Ayarefo nkumaa a wɔwɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea no ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Ɔsom sɛ ɔkwan a ɛda akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so ntam, na ɛboa ma nkitahodi ne ahotoso tu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi obu a wonni ma wɔn ho no mu aba wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso so, te sɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu anaasɛ adwene apɔwmuden mu haw?
answer_twi_source: Akokudro wɔ fam no betumi de nsunsuanso kɛse aba mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso so. Mmabun a wonni obu mma wɔn ho no betumi ayɛ mmerɛw kɛse sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu, te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaa ahokafo pii, hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nna mu dwumadi wɔagye atom bɛma , wɔahyia ɔhaw ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ pa a wobenya mu, na wɔahyia nsɛnnennen a ɛfa adwenem apwɔagye atomwmuden ho, a adwenemhaw ne dadwen ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne mmabun di nkitaho de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, wɔde adi dwuma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hwehwɛde ahyehyɛde ahorow (Community-based organizations) de mmabun hyɛ SRH nhyehyɛe ahorow (Sexual and Reproductive Health programs) ho adwuma mu pɛpɛɛpɛ, fi sɛnea wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, kosi sɛnea wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma yie, de hwɛ sɛ ɛfata na ɛyɛ nea ɛsom bo.Wɔma nnipa kwan ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi mu, ma wɔn adwene ne wɔn nimdeɛ, na wosusuw akannifo dwuma a ɛsom bo wɔ wɔn mpɔtam mu. Eyi betumi afa mmabun afotufo kuw a wɔhyehyɛ, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hwehwɛ nnipa adwene, ne ntetee a wɔhyehyɛ de hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnkasa mma wɔn ho anaa wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mfɛfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akuw betumi ama mmabun wɔn ho yɛ mmerɛ anya tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa bere a wobu atetesɛm mu gyidi ahorow no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔbɛtumi abɔ tebea horow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔboa no no, ɛhia sɛ wɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ, nkyerɛkyerɛ, na wonya ɔpɛ sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne adwemmɔne a epira. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akuw betumi ahyɛ gye a wogye tom ho nkuran denam ntease ne tema a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam nhomasua ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase so. Hyɛ akannifoɔ a wɔwɔ saa mpɔtam yi mu nkuran sɛ wɔnkamfo hokwan a nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua wɔ na wɔnkasa ntia nyiyim. Fa nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom ahyehyɛdeɛ mu, te sɛ mmoa akuo, afotuo dwumadie. Awiei koraa no, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a obiara bɛka ho a wɔbɛbɔ no hwehwɛ sɛ wobu nneɛma ahorow sɛ ɛsom bo na wɔhyɛ ɔdɔ ne gye a wogye tom ma ankorankoro nyinaa ho nkuran, a mfe anaa dɛmdi mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, ebetumi aka sɛnea awofo anaa abusuafo yɛ wɔn ade wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya sɛnea awofo anaa abusuafo yɛ wɔn ade wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Amammerɛ anaa ɔsom ahorow bi betumi asi ahobrɛase, twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho ansa na wɔaware, anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi pɔtee bi so dua, a ebetumi aka nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu nsɛm a wɔde da, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: SRH nsɛm bɛn na mmabun betumi de akɔ 'online crisis' akɔpɛ ho mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, STI, Nyinsɛn, Abusuabɔ, Basabasayɛ, Nyin.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ma mmerante ne mmabaa hokwan ahorow, ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wɔn gyinaesi nhyehyɛe anaa akannifo dwumadi mu? (Mmabun afotu bagua ahorow, mmabun agyinatukuw ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow pii bu mmabun adwene sɛ ɛsom bo! Akwan bi a wobɛfa so de wo ho ahyɛ mu ni: Mmabun Afotufoɔ Badwa: Saa adwumakuo yi ma mmabun kwan ma wɔde wɔn adwene, ma wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie ho. Mmabun Bagua: Te sɛ adwumakuo no, agyinatukuo ma mmabun akannifoɔ ne gyinaesie kwan wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nti mmoa dwumadie anaa afotu bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ne ayaresabea pii ma mmoa dwumadie ne afotu ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresa. Eyi bi ne: Afotu a ɛfa nna a asiane nni mu ne asiane so teew akwan ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa STI, ayaresa akwan, ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ ho ban ho. Mmoa foforo a wɔbɛkyerɛ, te sɛ adwene mu apɔmuden afotu, nnubɔne ho ayaresa, anaa asetena mu mmoa. Mmoa akuo anaa afotu dwumadie a nnamfo de ma mmabun a wɔne STI te anaa wɔwɔ nna mu apɔmuden ho dadwen. Kɔkoam torɔfo ahoma, mmoa torɔfo ahoma, anaa intanɛt so mmeae ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm anaa mmoa a ɛfa STI ne nna mu apɔmuden ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne nsɛmti anaa nsɛm a wɔtaa di ho dwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no bi?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ no di nsɛmti ne nsɛm ahodoɔ pii a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmabunbere ne mmabun nkɔsoɔ Nyinsɛn ano sie aduru akwan ne awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nna mu yarewa ano siw, sɔhwɛ, ne ayaresa Abusuabɔ pa, pene, ne nkitahodiɛ nna ho akɔnnɔ a nna ho akɔnnɔ ka ho Nyinsɛn ano aduru ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so afotuo Akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nneɛma a wɔbɛtumi afa so Di animtiaabuo, nyiyim, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nyɛ so ɔhwɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amanneɛbɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛka 'sexual health' (baanu ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ahoɔden) ho asɛm no, sɛn na yɛbɛyɛ ahu nnaadaasɛm te sɛ asɛm a wɔama ano ayɛ kɛse dodo, obi ankasa ne suahunu a ɔde kyerɛ, anaa nea enni baabi pɔtee a asɛm no firi?
answer_twi_source: Berɛ a mmofra ne mmabun rehwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa "sexual health" (baanu ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ahoɔden) ho wɔ Intanɛt so anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mmeaeɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔwɛn wɔn ho yie wɔ "mfomso" (red flags) anaa nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ sɛ asɛm no nyɛ nokware yi ho:Asɛm a wɔama ano ayɛ kɛse dodo anaa bɔhyɛ ahorow: Asɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ "eduru bi yɛ anwanwasɛm" anaa ɛbɛsa yadeɛ ntɛm so.Obi ankasa ne suahunu anaa anansesɛm so a wɔde ho to so: Sɛ obi de ne ho asɛm di dwuma sen sɛ ɔde adwene anaa nhwehwɛmu a ɛfiri nnuruyɛfoɔ hɔ bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu.Baabi pɔtee a asɛm no firi (citations) a enni mu: Sɛ asɛm no nni nhyehyɛeɛ anaa baabi a wɔnyaa nsɛm no firi, titiriw mmeaeɛ a agye din a wɔde ho to so.Kasa anaa mfoni a ɛma abufuo ba mu (sensationalized language/imagery): Mfoni anaa kasahorow a ɛyɛ basabasa a wɔde twa adwene anaa ɛpɛ sɛ ɛma w’abam bu ntɛm.Sikasɛm ho anohyeto anaa adwene a ɛkɔ afa baako pɛ (commercial interests/biases): Sɛ asɛm no botaeɛ titiriw ne sɛ ɛbɛtɔn adeɛ bi sen sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm mu nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Awo akwahosan ho dwumadie ka ayaresa, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmoa dwumadie ahodoɔ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ awoɔ yiedie ho nkuran na wɔakura mu. Saa dwumadie yi ho hia ma mmabun berɛ a wɔdi wɔn ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma wɔ nkɔsoɔ fã a ɛho hia mu, hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nneyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe "healthcare policies" ahorow mu ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wobetumi anya: Hwɛ sɛ mmeae a wotumi kɔ hɔ, akwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho ( mum kasa, "Braille"), ne akwahosan ho nneɛma a mmubuafo ahorow betumi akɔ hɔ. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm ho Nimdeɛ: Tete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ mmubuafoɔ abrabɔ pa, ahiadeɛ pɔtee, ne nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔde bɛdi nkitaho a ɛka obiara ho. Ɔhwɛ a Ɛfa Ɔyarefo Ho: Fa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho no mu. Ahintasɛm: Ma nkɔmmɔbɔ ne aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow nyɛ kokoamsɛm, titiriw wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn ɛwɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mehia apɔwmuden akwankyerɛ wɔ me babunberɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu pii wɔ ayaresafoɔ wɔ ɔmo asoɛyɛ wɔ betumi ama saa akwankyerɛ no. Bi so wɔ mpɔtam a wɔnya berɛ de hwɛ mmabun ho nsɛm. Internet so mmoa wɔ sites bi te sɛ HealthFinder.gov anaa local health departments so ma mmoa. Mmabun kuo so tumi boa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako atia nna mu nsɛm ho nneɛma a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ amaneɛbɔ nsɛm so?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nea wohu mu yie. Kasa kyerɛ nnamfo ne abusua. Fa w'adwene si suban pa wo wɔ so. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ nipadua ahorow nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ne anohyeto ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (mfe a wɔadi anohyeto, awofo pene) .
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ mmara kwan so berɛ a: Nyinsɛn no fi mmonnaato, abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da, anaa ɔkwasea a ɔyɛ ɔbea a ɔsɛee no. Ɔbea no nkwa anaa n’akwahosan da asiane mu. Asiane kɛse wɔ hɔ sɛ awotwaa no bɛyɛ nea ɛnteɛ. Mfeɛ ne Awofoɔ Mpene: Mfeɛ a ɛsua koraa biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obi di ansa na watu nyinsɛn agu wɔ Ghana. Nanso, wɔtaa kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ɔwofo anaa ɔhwɛfo bi ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho, titiriw ma mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako tia 'gender roles' basabasayɛ na mahyɛ pɛyɛ den?
answer_twi_source: Sua na dwen ho. Kasa tia (Speak up). Hyɛ pɛyɛ nkuran. Bu nsonsoeɛ ɛda obia ntam. Fa wo ho hyɛ dɔm dwumadie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛm bi a ɛhaw me anaa nsɛmmisa bi fa sɛnea me ho bɛtɔ me bere a mayi nyinsɛn agu a anaa sɛ mihu nsesae ahorow a ɛhaw me a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo anaa nsɛmmisa bi fa wo ho a wobɛsan anya wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi anaasɛ wunya sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛhaw adwene a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Wo ne W’akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo di nkitaho: Kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a oyii nyinsɛn no gui anaa akwahosan ho ɔbenfo foforo nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Ka sɛnkyerɛnne anaa dadwen biara a worehyia no kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no pefee. Hwehwɛ Aduruyɛ mu Ahwɛyiye Ntɛm: Sɛ wote ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, mogya tu kɛse, wohu ɔyare mmoawa ho sɛnkyerɛnne, anaa sɛnkyerɛnne afoforo a egye ntɛmpɛ a, hwehwɛ aduruyɛ ntɛm ara denam frɛ a wobɛfrɛ anaa wobɛkɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn anaasɛ wobɛkɔ baabi a wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ baabi a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ ayaresa a egye ntɛmpɛ a ɛbɛn wo no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn na wɔhwɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuo so, anaasɛ atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ osuahu a ɛte saa ara na wodi wɔn anim?
answer_twi_source: Ebia adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn, te sɛ afotufoɔ, asetena mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ apomoden ho akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, a wɔde akwankyerɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ, ne ɔhwɛ ma wɔ akuo nkɔmmɔdie ho na wɔbɛboa atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ foforo no, atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ osuahu a ɛte saa ara na wonya ntetee anaa mmoa a wɔde bɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw, ahwɛ ahu sɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom, na wɔde nneɛma a ɛfata ma na wodi akuw binom anim. Akwan abien no nyinaa ma mmoa ne nhumu a ɛsom bo, a ahwɛfo a wɔatete wɔn no hwɛ hu sɛ kuo no mu nkɔso no tu mpɔn na ahobammɔ wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI ) a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI )a, ɛho hia sɛ wo bo dwo na wohwehwɛ mmoa. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ni: Mma Nsuro: Wɔde nnuru sa nna mu yareɛ (STI) dodow no ara. Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo: Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo betumi asusuw ayaresa a wubetumi apaw ho na wabua nsɛmmisa biara a wowɔ. Ayaresa: Ɛdenam nna mu yareɛ ( STI) so no, ebia ayaresa no bɛfa nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, nnuru, anaa ayaresa afoforo ho. Ɔhokafoɔ Amanneɛbɔ: Ɛho hia sɛ wobɔ wo nna mu ahokafoɔ (wɔn) amanneɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn nso bɛtumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa wɔn yareɛ. Eyi boa ma ɔyare mmoawa no ntrɛw. W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ ɔhokafoɔ a wɔmmɔ wo din ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wobɛdi nkitaho tee a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea mmabun benya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne awo ho apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano: Mmara ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea mmabun betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho no gu ahorow. Mpɔtam bi ma mmofra nkumaa kwan ma wonya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a awofo mpene so, bere a afoforo nso hwehwɛ. Apomoden asoɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu taa de kokoam nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma. Nyinsɛn a wotu gu: Mmara a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ma mmabun no gu ahorow pii. Mmeae bi hwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so anaa wɔbɔ amanneɛ, bere a afoforo nso ma kwan ma wɔde kokoam kwan. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ na wohwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi apomoden ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Awo Apomoden Ho Nhyehyɛe: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nya awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho. Mpɔtam bi wɔ mmara ahorow a ɛbɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ho ban. Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Planned Parenthood de nsɛm ne nnwuma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma anaa wɛbsaet ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, wokamfo kyerɛ sɛ wubenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so?
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ "Planned Parenthood" "Teen Talk" anaa Nna "Sex", de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ "Centers for Disease Control and Prevention" (CDC) anaa Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO) de nneɛma a ɛkɔ akyiri ne nokwasɛm nkrataa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe nea broni ka no 'frameworks' ahorow di nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, mfe a wɔadi, asetra mu sikasɛm tebea, ne asasesin a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ nkitahodi a ɛda mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu aba no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nhyehyeɛ ne nhyehyeɛ di nneɛma wɔ nea broni ka no 'intersectionality of factors' te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, mfeɛ a wɔadi, asetena mu sikasɛm tebea, ne asasesin a ɛwɔ ntam wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ a wɔhyehyɛ mu denam ɔkwan a ɛfa biribiara ho na egyina hokwan so a ɛhyɛ mmabun ahiadeɛ ne suahunu ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ na ɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ahyia sɛdeɛ wɔn tebea ne wɔn tebea pɔtee teɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne mfaso bɛn na ɛbetumi aba wɔ asetra mu nsakrae anaa aduruyɛ mu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn bɔbeasu mu?
answer_twi_source: Asiane ne mfasoɔ a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ asetena mu nsakraeɛ anaa aduruyɛ mu dwumadie mu ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn bɔbeasu mu no gu ahodoɔ gyina ankorankoro tebea ne ahiadeɛ so. Mfasoɔ bi a ɛbɛtumi aba no bi ne: Adwene mu akwahosan ne yiedie a mmabun nya atu mpɔn Nsunsuanso bɔne anaa asiane ahorow a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ aduruyɛ mu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, te sɛ hormone ayaresa anaa oprehyɛn mu. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe anaa mmoa nnwuma a ɛsi so dua a wonnya. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn Nna akwahosan mu no ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata ne adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de ɔhwɛ ne mmoa a edi mũ ama no yɛ adwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw wɔn ankasa ahiade, nea wɔpɛ, ne botae ahorow nso ho bere a wɔresisi gyinae wɔ asetra mu nsakrae anaa aduruyɛ mu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mfe a obi adi ahwehwɛde bi wɔ hɔ na ama obi anya nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho dwumadie?
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ na ama obi anya nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ so. Wɔ mmeae pii no, wonni mfe pɔtee biara ho anohyeto biara, na mmabun a wɔadi mfe biara betumi anya nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfe bɛn na wɔahyɛ ato hɔ sɛ obi betu nyinsɛn agu wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obi di ansa na watu nyinsɛn agu wɔ Ghana ha. Nanso, wɔtaa kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ɔwofo anaa ɔhwɛfo bi ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho, titiriw ma mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw bi wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ? (hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ obi a wodi akyi) .
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma akyi no ho hia yiye. Sɛ wuhu sɛnkyerɛnne biara a ɛyɛ soronko te sɛ atiridiinini, ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, anaa mogya a ɛtu wo dodo a, kɔ ayaresabea ntɛm ara fi w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na amanaman ntam nkɔso adwumayɛbea ahorow, wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma, ne aman pii ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma aman ma wɔayɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran na wɔde adi dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanaman ntam nkɔsoɔ adwumakuo, wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma, ne aman ahodoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ di dwuma titire wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa aman ma wɔhyehyɛ na wɔde mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ  a ɛhyɛ mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkuran denam: Mfiridwuma ho mmoa a wɔde bɛma, tumi a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde bɛma de ahyɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ tebea mu den ama mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan. Nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne mmara mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ de ayi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ no fi hɔ na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun bedi nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho dwuma. Nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa ne nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ aman ntam de ahyɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina adanse so ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma ho nkuran. Ɔmanfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban sɛ wɔbɛboa aban ahodoɔ wɔ wɔn bɔhyɛ a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no ho. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan a wɔde bɛka nkɔso ho nhyehyɛe a ɛtrɛw te sɛ Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botae ahorow ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobedi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so a ɛfa awofo pene ne amanneɛbɔ ho ase?
answer_twi_source: ahyehyɛde ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow pii a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so a ɛfa awofo pene ne amanneɛbɔ ho ase wɔ ha. Eyinom betumi ayɛ: Mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow a Ɔmanfo Ahyehyɛde ahorow (CSOs) a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ mmabun hokwan ne akwahosan ho mmara mu ka ho. Akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun so a wɔde nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho. Akwahosan asoɛe anaa afotufo a wɔwɔ sukuu mu a wɔatete wɔn sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm ne mmoa mma wɔ hokwan ahorow ne nea wobetumi apaw ho. Intanɛt so nhyiam horow ne nhyiam ahorow a mmabun betumi anya nsɛm, ne wɔn atipɛnfo adi nkitaho, na wɔahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ hɔ. Akwahosan adwumayɛbea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfata mmabun a ɛboa mmabun ma wɔte wɔn hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so no ase
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne nkurɔfo adi nkitaho yie na makyerɛ obu wɔ Intanɛt so afa nna ne abusuabɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Di nkitaho pefee ne nokwaredi mu bere a wobu afoforo ahye ne awerɛkyekye dodow no. Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛkyerɛ obu di dwuma bere a woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ atenka a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho no. Tie afoforo adwene yie na kwati sɛ wubesusu nneɛma ho anaasɛ wobebu atɛn. Kwati nsusuii na bisa pefee sɛ wo nte biribiara ase a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya ayamhyehye ne gye a wogye tom su wɔ wɔn nipadua ho, na wɔagye nneɛma ahorow ne soronkoyɛ atom?
answer_twi_source: Aseda a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Wɔn nipadua dwumadi ne nea wotumi yɛ ho anisɔ mmom sen sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi wɔn honam ani hwɛbea nkutoo so. Nsonsonoe a wɔkyerɛ ho anisɔ "Appreciating Differences": Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nipadua nsɛso, ne kɛse, ne sɛnea ɛte mu a wobehu na wɔakyerɛ ho anisɔ. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma a ɛhyɛ nneɛma pa ho nkuran. Mmɔborɔhunu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho "Self Compassion": Wɔde ayamye ne ayamhyehye di wɔn ho dwuma, titiriw wɔ bere a wɔn ho adwenem yɛ wɔn naa anaasɛ wonni ahobammɔ no. Nipadua a Ɛnyɛ Akyi "Body Neutrality": Wɔn adwene a wɔdan fi sɛnea wɔn nipadua te so kɔ nea wɔn nipadua betumi ayɛ ne osuahu ahorow a ɛma wotumi yɛ so. Ɛdenam nsonsonoe ne soronkoyɛ ho anisɔ so no, mmabun betumi adɔ wɔn ho sɛnea wɔte na wɔremmu wɔn ho wɔn ho animtiaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, gyedie ne nneyɛe kyerɛ nkorɔfoɔ deɛ wɔndwene mfa nna ne nna mu ayaresa ho wɔ me mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Amammrɛ mu gyedie kyerɛ amanfoɔ sɛ ahia sɛ yɛde yɛn ho sie, sanso kata yɛn ho sie. Binom so nnhu no saa. Amammrɛ bi so bu nna mu agodie ne akɔnnɔ no animtia, ne saa nti pii na suro sɛ wɔbɛpɛ mmoa. Wɔ nwomasua mu so, amammrɛ pii pɛ sɛ nkatahosie 'abstinence'yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ adi kan. Nanso binom nnhu no saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ nkitahodi a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmabun ne wɔn awofo anaa abusua mufo ntam wɔ nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ ntamgyinafo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo, na wɔde nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ama mmabun ne wɔn awofo anaa abusua mufo nyinaa. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ sɛnea wobefi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase na wɔahwɛ so, adi nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, na wɔama ntease ne mmoa anya nkɔso wɔ abusua no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne awofoyɛ, na sɛ me si gyinae sɛ mɛtoa me nyinsɛn no so na mabɛyɛ ɔwofo a, nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɔwofoyɛ: Nea ɛka awofoyɛ ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ abofra na wɔatete no. Nneɛma a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wususuw Ho: Sikasɛm mu Gyinabea: Susuw wo sikasɛm tebea ne sɛnea wobɛhwɛ abofra no ho. Mmoa Nhyehyɛe: Hwɛ mmoa a wunya fi w’abusua ne wo nnamfo hɔ. Atenka mu Ahosiesie: Hwɛ sɛ ebia wote nka sɛ woasiesie wo ho wɔ atenka fam sɛ wubegye awofoyɛ ho asɛyɛde ahorow atom anaa. Mmofra hwɛ: Sɛ ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ adwuma anaa wusua ade a, susuw akwan horow a wobɛfa so ahwɛ mmofra ho. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe: Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma wo ne abofra no hwɛ ansa na wɔawo ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so. Dabere: Hwɛ sɛ wowɔ dan a ɛfata ma abofra.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔfa so ma aban ahorow ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bu akontaa sɛ wobedi wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho wɔ amanaman ntam apam ne apam ahorow ase no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan te sɛ amanaman ntam apam, nhyiam ahorow, ne amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma aban ahorow ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no abu akontaa sɛ wobedi wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no so. Eyinom bi ne Apam a Ɛfa Hokwan a Mmofra Wɔ Ho, Amanaman Ntam Nhyiam a Ɛfa Nnipa Dodow ne Nkɔso Ho, ne Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botae ahorow. Mmɔden a ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow bɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ so, abɔ amanneɛ, na wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban nso di dwuma titiri wɔ aban ahorow a wobu akontaa no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so wɔ nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ ho ase?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya denam sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn, awo, awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya awo ho hwɛ a edi mũ ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfo fa so ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa akyinnyegye ho wɔ ntentanfidie so adesua ahorow mu, te sɛ nna ho nsɛm, basabasayɛ, asɛm a wɔka kyerɛ, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ho yɛ mmerɛw?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ de akwan ahodoɔ di dwuma de boa nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkateɛ anaa akyinnyegyeɛ ho wɔ ntentanfidie so adesua mu, te sɛ nna ho nsɛm, basabasayɛ, botaeɛ, ne nsɛm a ɛntene, a nea ɛka ho ne: Fapem mmara a wɔde besi hɔ ama nkɔmmɔdie a obuo wom ne adesua tebea a ahotɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho a asuafoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi na wɔabisa nsɛm. Nsɛm a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛma ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔahyehyɛ no wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma adwene a ɛyɛ den na egu ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate ho no tom. Nneɛma a ɛfata mfeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛfa asuafoɔ suahunu ne wɔn anigyeɛ ho a wɔde bedi dwuma. Adwene ne nne ahorow pii a wɔde bɛka nkɔmmɔbɔ ho de ahyɛ nsusuwii a ɛmu dɔ ne tema ho nkuran. Asuafoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔhwɛ anaa wɔsusu sɛ deɛ (media) mfidie so nsɛm hu asetena mu nsɛm, gyedie ne amammerɛ fa . Akwanya a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ akyerɛw a ɛfa adwene ho, nsɛmma nwoma, anaa akuo nketewa nkɔmmɔdie mu de adwenedwene wɔn a susuiɛ ne atenka wɔ nsɛmti a emu yɛ duru ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔagyina haw a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ano?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ pefee : Tebea a wɔabue na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wɔbɛma mmabun asusuw nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Nsɛm a Wɔde Ma: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi a ɛfa nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ho a wɔde ma, a nipadua ne nkate fam afã horow ka ho. Awerɛhyem a Wɔde Ma: Awerɛhyem ne nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmabun nkate ne osuahu ahorow ho wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu. Kokoam Nsɛm a Wobebu: Mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn ahye a wobu bere a wɔda so ara wɔ hɔ ma mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a ɛho hia no. Ankasa Ho Hwɛ ho Nhwɛso: Nhwɛso a wɔde gyina apɔwmuden ano ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho so de hyɛ yiyedi ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina tebea wɔ nsakrae bere ahorow ano mu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa so ako ama nyinsɛn mmoa a nyiyimu nni mu?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ fa asɛdeɛ ho. Ko tia animtiabuo. Fa wo ho hyɛ anammɔntuo ako ma fahodie mu. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi nwumakuo ahodoɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ada me haw anaa me suro a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti ho akyerɛ wo, na wobɛyɛ dɛn ama m'ahu sɛ wɔbɛboa me na wɔte me ase?
answer_twi_source: Fa fahodi ka wo haw anaa wo suro a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti ho kyerɛ me bere biara. Mede tema ne nokwaredi bebua, agye wo nkate atom na mede mmoa ne awerɛhyem ama. Yɛbɛbom ahwehwɛ wo haw ahorow mu, aboaboa nsɛm ano, na yɛasiesie ɔhaw ahorow ano aduro de adi ɔhaw biara a ebia worehyia no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na media ho nimdeɛ ho nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim betumi adi wɔ nhumu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Asɛnka agua a wɔbɛma mmabun atumi aka wɔn haw ahorow, akyɛ osuahu ahorow, na wɔahwehwɛ nsɛmti a ɛfa media ho mu wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom mu. Atipɛnfoɔ akannifoɔ tumi a wɔde bɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛ, ayɛ nhyiamu ho nhyehyɛeɛ, na wɔayɛ nneɛma a ɛma media ho nimdeɛ ne nkitahodiɛ pa wɔ wɔn atipɛnfoɔ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne adwuma a wɔbom yɛ de di nsɛnnennen a ɛfa media ho dwuma a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔakamfo media ho adesua ho adesua wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atwe me ho afi nkitaho a ɛde nsunsuanso bɔne bɛba m'asetena mu (toxic relationships)?
answer_twi_source: Nnaadaa (Manipulation). Ninkunutwe. Obu a enni hɔ. Basabasayɛ (Abuse).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tu mpɔn Akwan bɛn so na Abusua nhyehyɛe ho horow a  wɔde si nyinsɛn ano mu, na nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aka sɛnea etu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Etu mpɔn: Deɛ edi Dwuma yie ne Nea Wɔtaa di Dwuma: Akwan no tu mpɔn kɛse bere a wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ (de di dwuma sɛnea wɔakyerɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ) sen sɛnea wɔde di dwuma mpɛn pii (a wosusuw nnipa mfomso ho). Nnuru a Etu mpɔn: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano: Sɛ wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ a, etu mpɔn bɛboro 90%, bere a wɔtaa de di dwuma no yɛ nea etu mpɔn bɛyɛ 91%. Kɔndɔm: Bɛyɛ 98% tu mpɔn bere a wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɛyɛ 85% tu mpɔn bere a wɔtaa de di dwuma no. LARCs (IUDs, implants): Bɛboro 99% tu mpɔn bere a wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nea wɔtaa de di dwuma no nyinaa. Nneɛma a Ɛka Sɛnea Etu mpɔn: Nea ɛkɔ so daa: Ɔkwan no a wɔde di dwuma daa na ɛteɛ. Bere: Akwan bi te sɛ aduru no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi bere a wɔde yɛ no so denneennen. Akwahosan Tebea: Nnuru anaa apomoden ho nsɛm bi betumi aka sɛnea honam mu nkwammoa 'hormone' akwan no tu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso pa betumi aboa ma wɔatew animtiaabu so na wɔahyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti a wɔde bu animtiaabu ho nkuran wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mfɛfoɔ nneyɛeɛ pa betumi aboa kɛseɛ ama aniwu a ɛda nna mu akwahosan nsɛm ho no so ate. Denam saa nsɛm yi ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ badwam wɔ tema ne nteaseɛ mu no, wubetumi aboa na woapo nneyɛeɛ ne nteaseɛ a ɛnyɛ nokorɛ, na woahyɛ ogyeɛ a wɔgye afoforo tom ho nkuran wɔ wo mpɔtam. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a nokwaredi wom ho nkuran,  kyerɛ afoforo nea enti a animmguaseɛ a wɔbɛyi afiri hɔ (destigmatization) ho hia, na kyerɛ kwan denam obu a wobɛda no adi akyerɛ obiara suahunu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mpɔtam dwumadie mu no betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ wɔn a wɔkasama nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nnwuma a wobenya, ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae wɔ mpɔtam ne ɔman no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam dwumadie a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no bɛtumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho akasamafo wɔ: akwannya a wɔde bɛma ama nwomasua, ahokokwaa a wɔbɛnya, ne akannifoɔ nkɔsoɔ denam nhyiamu, nteteeɛ nhyiamu, ne afotuo nhyehyɛeɛ so. Hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔsatuo a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, ne nhyehyɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔdie mu denneennen de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ, aboaboa mmoa ano, na wɔanya wɔn a wɔsi gyinaeɛ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ. Mmabun nne ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse denam abasɛm, adwinni, dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, ne nhwehwɛmu a mmabun di anim so de asi hia mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH ) nsɛm ho hia so dua na ama asetra mu nsakrae aba. Ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim, Nnumakuo (NGO  )ahodoɔ, adesua asoɛeɛ, ne aban nnwumakuo ntam nkitahodiɛ ne apam a ɛbɛma ayɛ mmerɛ de akamfo nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ, nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi afa so ayɛ adwuma de ama awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun nya no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi abom ama awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a mmabun anya no atu mpɔn denam: Sika a wɔde bɛto nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri mu wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ a ɛde awoɔ akwahosan ne hokwan ahodoɔ ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma mu. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ntrɛmu a wɔbɛboa, a akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ka ho. Nhyehyɛe ne sika a wɔde bɛma a ɛbɛma wɔanya kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo a mmabun bɛkamfo. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no mu denam wɔn adwene ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka wɔn tẽẽ ho no so. Nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow te sɛ ohia, nyiyim, ne kar a wonni a ebetumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wonnya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no ho dwuma a wobedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne nna mu basabasayɛ (sexual assault) wɔ mmara mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nneyɛeɛ a pene (consent) nni mu. Nhyɛso nna, ne nsa a wɔde keka obi nipadua ho. Ɛka nna mu mpoatwa anaa nhyɛso (sexual harassment) ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi nhyɛso a m’atipɛnfo anaa m’ahokafo de ma me sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhyɛ me wo nna mu dwumadi?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Ɛyɛ Den: Ka w’ahye ne anohyeto ahorow kyerɛ w’atipɛnfo anaa wo hokafo pefee. Fa nsɛmfua te sɛ "Minsiesiee me ho mmaa saa" anaa "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ eyi ho" di dwuma. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Fa nnamfo a wobu nea wopaw no twa wo ho hyia. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Yɛ Akwan a Wobɛfa so Fi Mu: Di kan yɛ nhyehyɛe ma tebea horow a ebia wobɛte nka sɛ wɔahyɛ wo. Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wubefi hɔ anaasɛ wubeyi wo ho afi tebea horow a ɛnyɛ dɛ mu. Gye watinka di 'Trust Your Instincts': Fa wo ho to wo gut feeling so sɛ biribi nte nka sɛ ɛnteɛ a. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi na wode w’awerɛkyekye ne wo yiyedi adi kan. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ gyinaesi mu ho ade. Te ase sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubegyina w’ankasa akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akura ahye a ɛfata mu na makwati nkɔso a mempɛ wɔ internet so abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubekura ahye a ɛfata mu na woakwati nkɔso a wompɛ wɔ Intanɛt so abusuabɔ mu nyi,  Ka w’ahye ne nea wopɛ kyerɛ afoforo pefee. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na fa w’ahotɔ ne ahobammɔ di kan wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu. Fa anohyeto ahorow hyehyɛ ankorankoro ho nsɛm dodow a wɔde bɛma afoforo wɔ Intanɛt so no ho. To adamfo/ abusuabɔ adesrɛ a wogye tom a efi nnipa a wonnim hɔ no ano hye
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hu na wɔkwati Intanɛt so nsisi anaa mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wonsia saa nkurɔfo ayayade  ma wɔn a wɔresi sɔ mbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nya Akyinnyegye: Bisa abɛɛfo ntetan nkrataa anaa nkrasɛm a ɛte sɛ nea ɛyɛ adwenem naayɛ, titiriw sɛ wobisa wo ho nsɛm a. Hwemuyie nea ɔsomayɛ. Hwɛ email address anaa nea ɔde kɔmaa no ho nsɛm sɛ ɛyɛ mmara kwan so de anaa. Mma Links: Kwati sɛ wobɛkliki link ahorow a ɛwɔ email anaa nkrasɛm a wɔammisa mu no so. Hwɛ Wɛbsaet URL ahorow: Hwɛ sɛ wɛbsaet URL no yɛ nea ɛfata na ahobammɔ wom ansa na wode nsɛm biara ahyɛ mu. Nhwehwɛmu: Sɛ w’adwene mu yɛ wo naa a, hwehwɛ adwumakuw anaa ahyehyɛde no mu wɔ Intanɛt so hwɛ sɛ afoforo abɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nsisi anaa. Amanneɛbɔ: Bɔ abɛɛfo ntetan krataa anaa nkrasɛm a ɛyɛ adwenem naayɛ ho amanneɛ kyerɛ platform anaa service provider no. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Kɔ so nya Intanɛt so nsisi ne nsisi a wɔtaa fa so no ho nsɛm. Fa Security Software Di Dwuma: Fa antivirus software a agye din a ebetumi aboa ma wɔahu nsisi na asiw ano hyehyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so hwehwɛ asiane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano mu na wɔpaw nea ɛfata me?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne sɛnea etu mpɔn, mfaso a ɛwɔ so, ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba no mu. Susuw nneɛma te sɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ɛnyɛ den sɛ wode bedi dwuma, ɛka a wɔbɔ, ne ayaresa tebea anaa nea wopɛ biara ho. Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bi nsusuw nneɛma a wubetumi apaw ho na woahu ɔkwan a ɛne w’ahiade ne w’asetra kwan hyia yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnuru a wɔde di dwuma betumi ne nnuru a wɔde di adwene mu apomoden ho dwuma no adi nkitaho, na asiane bɛn na ebetumi afi mu aba?
