answer_twi_source: Nnuru a wɔde di dwuma no betumi ne nnuru a wɔde di adwene mu apomoden ho dwuma no adi nkitaho wɔ akwan horow so, na ebetumi ama nnuru no anya nkɛntɛnso bɔne anaasɛ ɛbɛtew ne mmɔdenbɔ so. Asiane ahorow bi a ebetumi aba ne: Nnuru a ɛyɛ adwuma yiye a ɛso tew esiane sɛnea ɛne nneɛma di nkitaho nti, na ɛde yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a wontumi nni ho dwuma yiye. Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obenya nsunsuanso bɔne anaasɛ nneɛma bɔne a ɛbɛba bere a wɔde nneɛma ka nnuru ho no. Atemmu ne gyinaesi a asɛe, a ɛde nnuru a wɔde di dwuma a wɔmfa nni dwuma anaasɛ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma a ahobammɔ nnim ba. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛkɔ apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn ansa na wode nnuru adi dwuma bere a worenom nnuru a wɔde sa adwene mu apomoden bi, efisɛ ebetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ne nkitahodi ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa tebea horow a ebia wɔn kokoam nsɛm anaa wɔn kokoamsɛm bɛda asiane mu esiane ɔmanfo anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow nti no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akɔ tebea horow a wɔn kokoamsɛm betumi akɔ asiane mu denam: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mmeae a wɔde kokoamsɛm ne obu a wɔde ma ayarefo kokoam nsɛm di kan a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn Ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn hokwan ahorow ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ kokoam akwahosan ho nnwuma a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama Nsakrae a ɛbɛba wɔ ɔmanfo anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛbrɛ kokoam nsɛm ase ne hokwan ahorow a wɔde sie kokoam nsɛm
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛbɛboa me ma mayɛ mmabun anaa nnamfofoɔ mmoa kuo (peer support group)?
answer_twi_source: Akwankyerɛ nkrataa (Tip sheets). Nteteeɛ (Orientations).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhoma anaa nhomasua nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wokamfo kyerɛ mmabun na ama wɔasua nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho ade pii?
answer_twi_source: It's Perfectly Normal a Robie H. Harris ne Michael Emberley kyerɛwee no yɛ nhoma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma mmabun. "The Care and Keeping of You: The Body Book for Younger Girls" ne "The Care and Keeping of You 2:The Body Book for Older Girls" a Valorie Schaefer kyerɛwee no ka nneɛma akɛse a wɔde ma mmeawa a wɔrefa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu titiriw. Planned Parenthood "The Get Real About Sex" nsɛm a ɛtoatoa so no de nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ahorow a ɛfa mmabun ho ma. Teen Passport.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotu bi a wode bɛkasa akyerɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa ɔpanyin foforo a wogye no di wɔ mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ wɔ adwenemyare ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wote nka ne nea enti a wopɛ mmoa mu. Ma wonhu sɛ wuhia wɔn mmoa. wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa betumi aboa wo ma wo ne mpanyimfo aka wo nkate ho asɛm yiye
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mahwehwɛ na mahyɛ ntease a mewɔ wɔ m’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu den?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woahwehwɛ na woahyɛ wo ntease a wowɔ wɔ w’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu den. Ebia eyinom bi ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne intanɛt so nsɛm a agye din, nhoma ahorow, ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titiriw. Bio nso, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan so betumi ama wɔanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔasua ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na afotuo, nkitahodi, ne biakoyɛ betumi adi wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyɛ nnwuma, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi ne adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw, afotufo, ne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ wɔn adwuma mu adi nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Afotuo, nkitahodi, ne adwumayɛkuw di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyɛ nnwuma no mu. Afotufoɔ de akwankyerɛ, afotuo, ne nhumu a ɛsom boɔ a egyina wɔn ankasa suahunu so ma, na ɛboa mmabun ma wɔdi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata. Nkitahodi ma mmabun tumi ne adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw, afotufo, ne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ wɔn adwuma mu di nkitaho, na ɛma nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa, fekubɔ hokwan ahorow, ne nneɛma a wobenya no yɛ mmerɛw. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ma mmabun a wɔyɛ nnwuma no tumi de ahokokwaw ne ahoɔden a ɛka ho di dwuma, boaboa nneɛma ano, na wodu botae ahorow a wɔbom yɛ ho yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside anaa nsɛnnennen bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden, sɛ wobenya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a, anammɔn bɛn na wobetumi atu?
answer_twi_source: Akwanside ne Nsɛnnennen a wobedi ho dwuma: - Mmabun a wohyia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no betumi atu anammɔn pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Wɔhwehwɛ nnwuma foforo a wɔde ma, te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ - akwahosan ayaresabea anaa akwahosan asoɛe a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, a ebetumi de kokoam hwɛ ama mmabun. - a wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho denam wɔn ho a wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ pefee wɔ wɔn hokwan ne wɔn haw ho, na wɔabisa nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun. - a wode bɛkɔ mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di, te sɛ sukuu afotufoɔ anaa mmabun adwumayɛfoɔ, nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. - a wode bma nyiyim anaase nnwuma a wopow biara ho amanneɛ akyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a edi mu wɔ mpɔtam ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ɔman Mmabun Adwumayɛ Dwumadie (NYEP): Aban nhyehyɛɛ yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun anya nimdeɛ nteteeɛ ne adwuma a wɔde bɛto hɔ wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ mu wɔ Ghana. African Internship Academy: Saa ahyehyɛdeɛ yi ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ Ghana nya adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ ne adwumayɛ hokwan, boa wɔn ma wɔnya osuahu a mfasoɔ wɔ so, na wɔnya nkitahodie wɔ wɔn nnwuma a wɔapaw mu. Youth Employment Accelerator: Saa nhyehyɛe yi de mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ Ghana bata adwuma hokwan ahorow ho denam fekubɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ so, na ɛboa ma mmabun a wonnya adwuma nyɛ dodow so tew wɔ ɔman no mu. Meltwater Entrepreneurial School of Technology (MEST): MEST de afe baako adwumayɛ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ Ghana, na ɛma wɔn nimdeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛhia na wɔatumi ahyɛ wɔn ankasa nnwuma ase. African Youth Initiative on Climate Change (AYICC): Saa ahyehyɛde yi ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ Ghana a wɔn ani gye nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa ne wim nsakrae ho hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na ɛboa wɔn ma wonya osuahu wɔ saa adwuma a ɛrenya nkɔso yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn betumi annya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ matenka ne me tebea mu?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn mu nkwaadɔm betumi ama obi su asakra, adwennwen, anaa anigye (excitement) ne anigye (joy) atenka. Sɛ wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo bɛkasa a, ɛboa sɛ wo nkate yɛ den a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama mmabun ankasa tumi ma wɔakamfo wɔn SRH hokwan ne wɔn ahiade ahorow wɔ ntawntawdi ne ntawntawdi akyi tebea horow mu, na akwanside bɛn na wohyia wɔ saayɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua ne nhumu: Sɛ wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn hokwan ahorow ho ma mmabun a, ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔkamfo wɔn SRH ahiade ne hokwan ahorow, na ɛkasa tia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ. Mmabun kyɛfa: Mmeae a wɔbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu a ntease wom no ma mmabun tumi ka wɔn haw ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde di kan, ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa SRH nnwuma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ho wɔ mmeae a ntawntawdi aka no. Akwanside ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma: Ebia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkamfo wɔn no bi ne nsɛm a wonnya, suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka anaa basabasayɛ, ne hokwan kakraa bi a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wobedi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma na wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu na wɔakamfo wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow nya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nsabuo, nna, ne ɔdɔ mu nkitahodie ho so nsunsuanso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankoro betumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow nya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nsabuo, nna, ne ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ so nsunsuanso wɔ akwan horow so. Nhwɛso, ɔmanfo akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmarimayɛ ho no betumi ahyɛ mmarimaa ma wɔayɛ wɔn ade wɔ atetesɛm mu adwene a ɛfa mmarima nna ho, te sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ anaa tumidi ho. Ɔkwan foforo so no, ebia mmeawa behyia akwanhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ ade a wɔnyɛ hwee na wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase wɔ wɔn nna mu. Saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi betumi de akwanside ahorow aba wɔ nkitahodi a wɔabue mu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nkitahodie ho, na ɛde ntease a ɛnteɛ ne nkɔso a ɛnyɛ papa aba. Ankorankoro betumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira denam mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ nna ne nkitahodie ho, ne nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛka obiara ho na ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛkyerɛ obu na esi so dua sɛ mmarima ne mmea ntam nkitahodie ne osuahu ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me wɔ atenka ne asetra mu bere a manyinsɛn no? (akuw a wɔboa, ayaresa ho animdefo) .
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo wɔ atenka ne asetena mu: Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): https://www.ppag-gh.org/nu/ de kokoam afotuo ne mmoa dwumadie ma mmabun. Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health (GYARH): https://ghanasrhralliance.org/ , Ghana akwahosan adwumayɛbea no wɔ ahobammɔ afiri nhyehyɛe ma mmabun a wɔyem , mmoa akuw wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔyem. Wo ne wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa helthcare provider a ɔwɔ mmabun adamfofa akwahosan adwumayɛbea no nkasa Ɔfotufo anaa Ɔyaresafo: Sɛ wo ne oduruyɛfo bi bɛkasa a, ebetumi ama woanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobɛda w'atenka ne wo haw ahorow adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo akuw ne mpɔtamfo a wɔsɔre tia suban ne nneyɛe a ɛyɛ animtiaabu na wɔko tia no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi: adi nkɔmmɔ a ɛda adi pefee, a ɛboa wɔ atipɛnfo akuw ne mpɔtam hɔ, ahyɛ tema, ntease, ne osuahu ahorow ne nipasu ahorow a wogye tom ho nkuran. Kasa tia kasa, nneyɛe, ne suban a wɔde bu obi animtiaa, kasa tia gyinapɛn ahorow a epira na kamfo akwan a wɔfa so di nna ne awo akwahosan a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom, a egyina hokwan ahorow so kyerɛ. Yɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ, te sɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, a mmabun betumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow, ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ, na wɔanya nneɛma a wonsuro atemmu anaa nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔpɛ LGBTQ+ na wɔde akasa ama SOGI nteteeɛ a ɛkɔ anim wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu ma.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na digital platforms horow no hyehyɛ ntease a mmabun wɔ wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa dwumadi, nipadua mfonini, ne obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho no ho, na dɛn na eyi kyerɛ wɔ wɔn SRH ho?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, social media ma ahoɔfɛ, mmarimayɛ, ne ɔbeayɛ ho gyinapɛn a ɛnyɛ nokware kɔ so tena hɔ, na ɛka sɛnea mmabun kura wɔ wɔn nipadua ho na ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam nsusui hunu mu den. Suban a wɔde toto ho: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho atoto mfonini ne asetena kwan a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a wɔayɛ ho mfonini wɔ social media so ho, na ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔmfata, wonni obu mma wɔn ho, na wonni nipadua mu abotɔyam. Bɔbeasu ho gyinapɛn: Digitals platform ahorow te sɛ YMK app no betumi ahyɛ atetesɛm mu mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow mu den, asiesie mmabun ntease wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nsakrae, tumi a ɛkɔ so wɔ abusuabɔ mu, ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa pene ne nna mu nneyɛe ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi de asetra mu nimdeɛ adi dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ wiase tebea horow ankasa mu, te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma anaa adwumayɛ ho ntetee?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, asetra mu nimdeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe pii ka osuahu mu adesua afã horow te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, anaa atuhoama hokwan ahorow ho. Saa osuahu ahorow a mfaso wɔ so yi ma mmabun tumi de wɔn asetra mu nimdeɛ di dwuma na wɔhyɛ mu den wɔ wiase tebea horow ankasa te sɛ kuw adwuma, akannifo, nkitahodi, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru mu. Mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma ahorow ma mmabun nya hokwan ahorow de boa wɔn mpɔtam, nya tema, na wonya asetra mu asɛyɛde ho adwene. Adwumayɛ mu ntetee ne adwuma a ɛyɛ sunsuma mu osuahu ahorow ma mmabun hu adwumayɛbea mu nkɔso, adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ, ne nimdeɛ a ɛfa adwuma ho, na ɛma wɔn ahoboa ma daakye mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔabɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho haw, wɔanya nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na wɔafa mmoa ne ayaresa a ɛyɛ den wɔ ahodwiriw akyi no mu?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforɔ a wogye wɔn di di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun ma wɔbɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ, nneɛma a wonya, ne mmoa ne ayaresa a wɔhwehwɛ mu nsɛnnennen no mu. Wobetumi de nkate fam mmoa ama, agye victims suahu ahorow atom, de wɔn abata kokoam mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow ho, na wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔate wɔn hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi apaw ase. Ɛdenam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, atie a wɔmfa wommu atɛn, ne victims ahiade a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so no, mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔahwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa na wɔde ahoɔden ne ahoɔden afa ahotɔ nhyehyɛe no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sohyial media platforms ne digital media nya mmabun adwene wɔ nna, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, ne atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ ho so nkɛntɛnso, na dɛn ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ wɔn nna mu apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso ho?
answer_twi_source: Social media platforms ne digital media hyehyɛ mmabun adwene wɔ nna, abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, ne atipɛnfo abusuabɔ ho denam: Wɔde wɔn ma wohu mfoni ne asɛm a wɔayɛ a ɛfa abusuabɔ ne nna ho a efi atipɛnfo, wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo hɔ. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti a ɛyɛ papa ne nea enye nyinaa a wɔbɛkyɛ. Atipɛnfo nhyɛso a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse, asetra mu ntotoho, ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn anaa abusuabɔ ho adwene a enni mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ho ne: Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, nipadua mfoni, ne adwene a ɔwɔ wɔ ne ho so. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu nkɔso, nkitahodi nhyehyɛe, ne nna mu nneyɛe so. Hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, mmoa, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ntentan fidie a wɔde di dwama no ho gyedie ne ahotosoɔ ansa na wɛahwehwɛ mmoa afiri hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Yɛ nhwehwɛmu fa dwumakuo no mu. Hwɛ sɛ wɔwɔ tumi krataa. Kenkan deɛ afoforo aka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ mmoa a mmabun wɔ, wɔ wɔn awoɔ hokwan ne ahofadi a wɔwɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ di dwuma titire wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun awoɔ hokwan ne ahofadie denam: - Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛnyɛ animhwɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden akwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ ho. - a wobedi mmabun kokoamu hokwan ahorow ho. - a wode apomoden ho dwumadie a efa mmabun adamfofa ne nea ennye atemmuo ho ma. - a wobekasa ama nhyehyee a ebo mmabun awo hokwan ho ban na ehwehwe se wobenya awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie a edi mu. - a wde ma mmabun tumi ma wosi gyinae a ewo ho yiye fa won awo apomoden ho na woboa won ma wode won hokwan ahorow bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a atemmu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho so wɔ adwenemyare ho nkɔso pa a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛnyɛ atɛn a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no hyɛ adwenemyare ho nkɔso pa ho nkuran denam animtiaabu a ɛtew so, ɛma wogye wɔn ho tom, ne tumi a ɛma ankorankoro tumi paw nneɛma a ntease wom no so. Saa nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow yi ma mmabun nya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi abisa nsɛm, ada nea ɛha wɔn adi, na wɔanya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahofadi ne yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotu bi a wode bɛsɔ nsɛm a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so no mu ahotoso ahwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Nya akyinnyegye wɔ abɛɛfo ntentannkyerɛe (social media posts) ho: Fibea: Hwɛ "poster no profile" na hwɛ sɛ wɔwɔ nimdeɛ bi a ɛfa ho anaa. Nokwasɛm ne Adwene: Hwehwɛ adanse a ɛbɛfoa nsɛm biara a wɔka so. "Cross-reference information": Mfa wo ho nto abɛɛfo ntentan nkutoo so – hwɛ nokwasɛm ahorow wɔ baabi foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo adwene nya mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde di dwuma ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ adwene yɛ ɔman pɔtee bi na ɛbɛtumi anya nkɛntɛnsoɔ bɔne anaa papa wɔ mmara kwan so ahobanbɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma ne ne di a wɔde bedi dwuma ama LGBTQ+ ankorankoro no so. Adwene pa ne LGBTQ+ nnipa a wogye wɔn tom no betumi ama wɔaboa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho ne mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a emu yɛ den kɛse. Nea ɛne no bɔ abira no, adwene a ɛnteɛ, animtiaabu, ne nyiyim betumi asiw mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a wɔde bedi dwuma no kwan na aboa ma nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛto LGBTQ+ ankorankora hokwan ne ahofadi ano hye aba
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Gyinapɛn ne gyidi bɛn na yɛn amammerɛ, anaa yɛn som kyerɛkyerɛ fa abusuabɔ, aware, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebia amammerɛ ne nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ besi hia a aware, awo, ne abusua biakoyɛ ho hia so dua. Wɔtaa kyerɛw dwumadi ne asɛyɛde pɔtee bi ma ankorankoro wɔ abusuabɔ anaa twaka ne mmusua mu. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa asetra kronkronyɛ ne bere a wɔwo awo ho no betumi anya abusua nhyehyɛe akwan ne gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmara mmoa sɛ wohu sɛ wommma wɔn ho kwan nsi gyinae wɔ nna nsɛm mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Wɔbetumi akɔhu 'clinics' foforo. Kasa kyerɛ 'health departments'. Wobetumi abɔ dahuru ama nkurofo ate anaa mpanyimfoɔ ne mmrahyɛfo a wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ wɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ndwuma sɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ da biara?
answer_twi_source: Dɔnhwere baako (60 minutes) da biara. Ebi ne: Mmirika, asuogu, asaw (Aerobic). Push-ups (Muscle-strengthening). ne ahurihuri 'Jumping rope'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma titiriw a ɛma wosiw HIV ano yiye ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: HIV a wɔsiw ano a ɛkɔ akyiri ma mmabun no bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so nya HIV ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano (te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, nnuru a wɔde siw ano ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu anaa PrEP, ne akwan a wɔfa so te ɔhaw so), HIV nhwehwɛmu dwumadie a wɔbɛnya, nna mu nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, animtiaabuo a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma, ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya mmoa a wɔde bɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ mɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ nna my yarenna mu yareɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan adwumayɛbea dodow no ara de nnwuma a wɔde nantew wura mu hɔ ma. kasa kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo na woanya nsɛm pii
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no bi ?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo pii te sɛ nnuruyɛfo, mmea ho animdefo, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe, ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow na wɔde nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ma. Nkurɔfo nso betumi atɔ nyinsɛn nhwehwɛmu nneɛma afi nnuruyɛ sotɔɔ ahorow mu na wɔasɔ ahwɛ wɔ fie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn a wosiw ano yɛ adwuma, na akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano siw nyinsɛn ano denam mmadwoa anaa ovulation a egyae so. Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ no bi ne kɔndɔm, nnuru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, IUD, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm, nyinsɛn a wɔsɛe no, ne abɔde mu akwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn agyina 'online harassment' (intanɛt so basabasayɛ) ano?
answer_twi_source: Block/Report onipa no. Kora adanseɛ (screenshots) so. Hwehwɛ mmoa. pa so ka ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛmfua ne nsusuwii ahorow bɛn na wɔtaa de di dwuma a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mehu?
answer_twi_source: Transgender: Obi a ne bɔberɛ a ɔde te nka wɔ ne mu nyɛ mma ne bɔberɛ a wɔde woo no no (Obi a ne "gender identity" yɛ soronko).Non-binary: Obi a ɔnhu ne ho sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima pɔtee anaa ɔbaa pɔtee.Genderqueer: Obi a ne bɔberɛ mu nteaseɛ mma no nyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa pɔtee; ɛbɛtumi ayɛ mmienu no nyinaa nkabom anaa emu biara.Gender expression (Bɔberɛ mu Ndaadi): Kwan a obi fa so da ne bɔberɛ adi kyerɛ wiase denam ntarahyɛ, ne bɔberɛ, ne ne ho nsiesieeɛ so.Cisgender: Obi a ne bɔberɛ a ɔde te nka wɔ ne mu hyia ne bɔberɛ a wɔde woo no no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amamerɛ ne kasa-pɔtee nneɛma nea borɔfofoɔ fre no 'cultural anaa language-specific resources' bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun wɔ wɔ mpɔtam afoforo ahorow anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Amamerɛ ne kasa-pɔtee nneɛma nea borɔfofoɔ fre no 'cultural anaa language-specific resources' bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun wɔfiri mpɔtam afoforo ahorow. Akuo ne intanɛt asoe tesɛ Ghana apɔmmuden adumadie nea aborɔfo fre no Ghana health services' ne ahokafoɔ ma nna mu apɔmmuden nsem ne ho akadeɛ wɔ kasa afoforo ahohorow aa hwɛ wo mpɔtam so ahyehyɛ de ma ɔmo. Ebiom, mpɔtam mu kuokuo ne ayaresamafo tumi ma ammamerɛ mu nna mu apɔmmuden akadeɛ nea borɔfofoɔ ka no ' culturally sensitive health services' ne mmoa dwumadie  ma mmabun a wofiri mpɔtam ahohorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu ɔhaw na dɛn na ɛbɛtumi de aba?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nsɛnnennen (sexual dysfunction) yɛ ɔhaw biara a ɛba wɔ berɛ a obi rekɔ nna mu (akɔnnɔ, anigyeɛ, anigyeɛ a ɛkɔ soro paa, ne berɛ a nipadua no dwiriw ne ho). Ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛtaa si na ɛnam nneɛma ahodoɔ pii so na ɛba. Bi ne mmoa yi:Nipadua mu nneɛma (Physical factors): Yareɛ ahodoɔ, nnuru a obi nom, anaa nipadua mu nsuo (hormones) a ɛnyɛ pɛ.Adwene mu nneɛma (Psychological factors): Dadwene, suro, awerɛhoɔ a ɛmu dɔ (depression), nkitahodiɛ mu nsɛm, anaa nna mu suahu a ɛnyɛ papa a obi anya atwam.Nnuru ne nsa (Substance use): Nnuru a ɛyɛ den ne nsa betumi asɛe kwan a nipadua no yɛ adwuma wɔ nna mu.Sɛ worehyia nna mu nsɛnnennen a, ɛho hia sɛ:Wone akwahosan ho adwumfoɔ bɛkasa (dɔkota, nɛɛse, anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔhwɛ nna mu akwahosan so) na woatumi ahwehwɛ nea ɛde ba ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so asiesie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ anaa dwumadie bɛn na ayɛ yie a ɛma amammerɛ mu obu kɔ anim wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu akwahosan ho, na ɛkwan bɛn so na wobɛtumi asusu saa nhwɛsoɔ yi ayɛ bi anaa wɔasesa mu afata mmeaeɛ foforɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ anaa dwumadie a ɛdi mu a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ mu obu ho nkuran wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu akwahosan mu no, mpɛn pii no ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ akuo, ne amammerɛ mu akannifoɔ bɔ mu yɛ adwuma. Saa nhyehyɛeɛ yi bi ne akwahosan ho ntetee nhyiamu a wɔayɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛfata amammerɛ bi, ntoboano dwumadie, anaa atipɛnfo ntetee nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ amammerɛ anaa mmusuakuo bi titire ahiadeɛ ne nea wɔpɛ. Nea ɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ ne sɛ, dwumadie bi de amammerɛ mu anansesɛm anaa mfoni ne nnyigyei (multimedia) di dwuma de twe mmabun ne mmusua ba nkɔmmɔbɔ mu fa nna ne awoɔ mu akwahosan ho. Wobɛtumi asusu saa nhwɛsoɔ yi ayɛ bi anaa wɔasesa mu afata mmeaeɛ foforɔ denam nneyɛeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ no sɛnea ɛne mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ ne wɔn ahiadeɛ bɛhyia pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ wɔde toto anansesɛm ahorow bi a w'ate ho a, kwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn ho nnuro boa paa?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wohu nsonsonoe a ɛda nokwasɛm ahorow a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya ntam. Akwan pii a wɔfa so siw awo ano no tu mpɔn kɛse wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw mu bere a wɔde di dwuma yie na wɔde di dwuma daa no, a akwan a wɔde hormone di dwuma (sɛ nhwɛso no, birth control pills, patches, injections), mfiri a wɔde fa awotoa mu (IUD), ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu ka ho. Atosɛm bi a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano ho, te sɛ gyidi a ɛne sɛ akwan bi ma obi ntumi nwo anaasɛ ɔma ne mu duru yɛ kɛse no, nyansahu mu adanse ntumi nnye ntom. Ɛho hia sɛ wode wo ho to nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a efi mmeae a agye din so de si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma a ebetumi akanyan anaa adwennwen a ebetumi ama adwenemhaw ho sɛnkyerɛnne ayɛ kɛse wɔ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankora ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi atew nneɛma a ɛkanyan yi so denam nneyɛe a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho ne dabere so?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ebetumi akanyan anaa adwennwen a ebetumi ama adwenemhaw ho sɛnkyerɛnne ayɛ kɛse wɔ wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no bi ne nkaebɔ ahorow a ɛfa ɔtowhyɛ no ho, te sɛ nea wohu, nnyigyei, hua, anaa tebea horow a ɛte sɛ ahodwiriw no; atenka a ɛne sɛ wonni tumi anaasɛ wontumi nni wɔn ho so; asetra mu animtiaabu, adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔde asodi a wɔde to nea wɔayɛ no bɔne so, anaa nsɛm a wɔmfa nkate nka; ne nkitahodi a wɔne ankorankoro anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔnte wɔn suahu ahorow ase anaasɛ wɔnnye ntom. Ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi atew saa nneɛma a ɛkanyan yi so denam nneyɛe a ɛfa ahodwiriw ho, ne dabere a wɔde bɛma denam tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom na wotumi hyɛ ho nkɔm a wɔbɛma, nkitahodi ne nsɛm a emu da hɔ a wɔde bɛma, akwan horow ne nea wobetumi apaw a wɔde bɛma, obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no ahye ne nea wɔpɛ, ne mmoa ne nea wogye tom a wɔde bɛma so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na wɔfa so di adwennwen ho dwuma wɔ nsakrae bere mu, te sɛ ntoaso sukuu a wobefi ase anaasɛ wɔasiesie wɔn ho akɔ ntoaso sukuu a wɔfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ college?
answer_twi_source: Nsakrae bere te sɛ ntoaso sukuu a wubefi ase anaasɛ ahosiesie a wobɛkɔ sukuu pɔn  betumi ayɛ adwennwen. Akwan a wɔfa so di adwennwen ho dwuma no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ nhyehyɛe, wɔbɛkyekyɛ nnwuma mu ayɛ no anammɔn a wobetumi adi ho dwuma, wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, asetra a ɛkari pɛ a wɔbɛkɔ so ada ne aduan pa a ɛfata wom, na wɔde akwan horow a wɔfa so gyae adwennwen te sɛ adwene a wɔde si biribi so anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwahosan ho asiane ahorow wɔ hɔ a, menkɔsra akwahosan ho yaresafo a ɔntete no wɔ LGBTQ+ hwɛ mu anaa?
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu yarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasua hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ nipadua mu ahofadi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no ho nsɛm pii?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma te sɛ: Nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ne adwumayɛbea ahorow a nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔwɔ din pa de ma Intanɛt so nneɛma ne wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛtwe adwene si nna ne awo hokwan ahorow so Sukuu-gyinabea: wɔmfa nsɛm a ɛfa nipadua mu ahofadi ho nkaa sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho efisɛ ɛne ɔman mmara nhyia wɔ Ghana Afotu adwuma ne mmoa akuw a wɔyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwuma titiriw
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ, asetra, anaa nsɛm a ɛfa ho bɛn na ebetumi anya me botae a mede besisi hɔ ne gyinaesi a mesi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho no so nsunsuanso, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi so bere a mekɔ so di nokware wɔ m’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow mu no?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ, asetena, anaa nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ebetumi anya wo botae a wode besisi w’ani so ne gyinaesi a wusi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho so nsunsuanso no bi ne: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn  ahorow: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi, ne nkitahodie ho no betumi anya wo botae ne gyinaesi wɔ saa beae yi so nsunsuanso. Atipɛnfo nkɛntɛnso: Asetra mu nhyɛso a efi atipɛnfo anaa ntentanfidie so nkitahodie ahorow hɔ betumi aka botae a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so ne gyinaesi a wɔyɛ wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe ho, a adwene a wogye wɔ nea wogye tom ne gyinapɛn ahorow ka ho. Nneɛma a wobenya: Asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi anya tumi a wubetumi de botae ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho sisi hɔ na woadu ho no so nsunsuanso. Saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi a wobɛba bere a wokɔ so di wo gyinapɛn ne wo gyidi ahorow mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ ɔmanfo nkrasɛm mu yiye, ahwehwɛ mmoa afi ankorankoro a wugye wɔn di hɔ, na wusi gyinae ahorow a ɛne w’ankasa yiyedi ne w’apɛde ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara kwan so nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ ma nnipa pɔtee bi a wɔreyɛ GBV, te sɛ nna mu dwumadi a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LGBTQ+ mmerante ne mmabaa anaa atubrafo? (mmara kwan so mmoa titiriw, nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho) .
answer_twi_source: Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana. Ghana Polisifoɔ Dwumadibea no di GBV nsɛm ho dwuma ma nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ den
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie titiriw bi wɔ Ghana ma mmabun a wɔfiri mmusua ahodoɔ mu, te sɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun anaa atubrafoɔ mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadi titire bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔfiri mmusua ahodoɔ mu, te sɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun anaa atubrafoɔ mpɔtam. Wɔayɛ saa dwumadie yi sɛ wɔde bedi akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wɔn a wɔadi dɛm ka ho ahiadeɛ ne suahunu soronko ho dwuma na ɛbɛtumi ayɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu, mmoa akuo, anaa nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee a wɔayɛ ama wɔn ahiadeɛ. Ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ nnwuma fi adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn hɔ bere a wɔasiesie wɔn sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi nnipa nyinaa ho dwuma a wonni adwemmɔne biara. Wubetumi abisa wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow no wɔn suahu a wɔne nnipa a wofi akuw ahorow a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu yɛ adwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wo ho tɔ wo na wɔboa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛfa so ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ afa hia a ehia sɛ mmabun bɛpɛ mmoa afiri baabi te sɛ atipɛnfoɔ hɔ,sukuu mu, mpɔtam, ntentanfidie so na wahyɛ aforoɔ nkuran ama wapɛ mmoa wɔ berɛ a wɔwɔ ɔhaw bi mu anaa sɛ nneɛma nkɔyie wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmden ho?
answer_twi_source: Kyɛ nsɛm wɔ ntentanfidie so, sukuu mu ne mpɔtam dwumadie nyinaa ase. Hyɛ afoforɔ nkuran ma wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anammɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de asusu ahotosoɔ a ɛwɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔmuden a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' ho nsɛm a wohyia no mu yie?
answer_twi_source: Hwɛ baabi a ɛfiri: Hwehwɛ nsɛm firi nwumakuo ahodoɔ a agye din, dɔkotafoɔ ne aban nwumakuo ahodoɔ hɔ. Yɛ nhwehwɛ mu fa adanseɛ no ho: Fa nyansahunu mu nhwehwɛmu di nsɛm a wɔka no ho adanseɛ. Hwehwɛ ntenkyia mu: Susu atwerɛfoɔ no adwenekyerɛ ne deɛ ɛbɛ abira nyinaa ho. Saa hwehwem bio: Fa nsɛm a efiri mmeaeɛ beberee toto ho na ama woahwɛ ahu ɛyɛ nokware. Bisabisa animdefoɔ: Hwehwɛ afotuo firi mpaninfoɔ a wogye wɔn di, adokotafoɔ anaa sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ hɔ berɛ a wonye nsɛm bi nni.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne 'PrEP', na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛyɛ adwuma de siw 'HIV' yareɛ ano?
answer_twi_source: PrEP' gyina hɔ ma nea broni ka no 'Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis'. Ɛyɛ aduru a nnipa a wonni 'HIV' nom de tew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya HIV no so. 'PrEP' yɛ adwuma denam 'HIV' a esiw ano sɛ ɛbɛkɔ so na atrɛw wɔ wo nipadua nyinaa mu sɛ wo nya mmoawa no a. Ɛte sɛ kyɛm a ɛboa ma wobɔ wo ho ban fi 'HIV' yareɛ ho.'
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛyɛde bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, aguade ho dawurubɔfo, ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ wɔ nna ho mfonini a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no wɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi abu wɔn akontaa wɔ abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ne nneyɛe ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, aguade ho dawurubɔfo, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔda nna ho mfonini adi wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu wɔ abrabɔ pa, pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ɛka obiara ho. Wobetumi abu wɔn akontaa wɔ abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ne nneyɛe ho denam nnwuma ho mmara, adetɔfo nsɛm a wɔka, ne ɔmanfo nhwehwɛmu so, na ahyɛ wɔn mfonini ahorow a wɔyɛ no pefee, nneɛma ahorow, ne atenka a wɔde yɛ nneɛma ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho ama nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow? ( abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow, awofoyɛ ho nneɛma a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na adesua asoɛe ne nhwehwɛmu nnwumakuo ahorow betumi adi wɔ wiase nyinaa fekubɔ ne adwumayɛkuw a wɔbɛma anya nimdeɛ foforo, adanse, ne nneɛma foforo a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ASRH mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Adesua asoɛe ne nhwehwɛmu nnwumakuo ahorow boa wiase nyinaa kabom denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ, adanse a wɔde ba, ne ano aduru foforo a wɔyɛ de di ASRH akwansideɛ ho dwuma so. Wɔsan nso ma nimdeɛ a wɔde sesa wɔn ho wɔn ho no yɛ mmerɛw denam nhyiam ahorow, nhoma ahorow, ne nhwehwɛmu adwuma a wɔbom yɛ so, na ɛma wiase nyinaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa ASRH ho no yɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ada no adi akyerɛ m’awofo sɛ mepɛ sɛ mebɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware fa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a memma wɔnte nka sɛ wɔahyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ?
answer_twi_source: Fa nkate ne obu bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no, na si ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubesua ade na woasisi w’akwahosan ho gyinae a ɛfata so dua. Ma w’awofo awerɛhyem sɛ wubu wɔn akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn no sɛ ɛsom bo, na wopɛ sɛ wo ne wɔn di nkitaho pefee de di nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne akwanside anaa nsɛnnennen a ɛtaa ba wɔ nkitahodi a ɛyɛ katee mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn adi akwanside ahorow yi so de ahyɛ me ho mu ahotoso kɛse wɔ asetra mu tebea horow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwansideɛ: Ehu, Gyidie a ɛkɔ fam, Amammerɛ. Gyina ano: Hu wo ho, Ko tia adwene bɔne, Sua, Hwehwɛ nteteeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no mu sɛ wɔmpene so a?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho betumi ayɛ den, titiriw sɛ w’awofo mpene so a. Afotu bi ni: Yɛ wo nhwehwɛmu: Boaboa nsɛm fi mmeae a agye din. Fi ase ketewaa bi: Di kan susuw kɔndɔm ho, a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya na enhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw nnuru ma. Ka sɛ mobɛbom akɔ: Munsusuw ho sɛ mobɛhyɛ nyansa sɛ mombom nkɔ ayaresabea anaa apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo bi na ama wɔanya adwene a ɛyɛ nokware kɛse. Kae: Wo nna mu apɔwmuden ho hia. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wusi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nipadua ho. Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo, sɛ mpo w’awofo mpene so mfiase no a. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛkɔ so ahu mmara kwan so nsɛm a aba foforo a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru a wobenya wɔ Ghana ho. Ebia saa nneɛma yi betumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ foforo sen biara ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na metumi ayɛ de anya ahotoso ne obuo ama me ho sɛ LGBTQ+ ɔbabun? (akuw a wɔboa, nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho) .
answer_twi_source: Wo sukuu yarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden a ɛka mmabun nna ne awo mu yiyedi te sɛ ohia, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya no ho no dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri: Dwumadi ahorow no fa ɔkwan a ɛfa biribiara ho, ɛnyɛ SRH nsɛm nko na edi ho dwuma na mmom nneɛma a ɛhyɛ ase te sɛ ohia, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne nhomasua a wonni a ɛka mmabun yiyedi nso ho dwuma. Tumi a wɔde ma: Nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ mmabun tumi ma wɔko ma wɔn hokwan ahorow, nya nneɛma, na wɔkasa tia asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ daa no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a mɛfa so ama nkurɔfo ate hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu no ase na wɔatew animtiaabu so wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu ahorow, sohyial media so dwumadi ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua Ɔsatu: Yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu ho nhyehyɛe wɔ wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ de kyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa hokwan ahorow a obi wɔ sɛ wotu nyinsɛn gu ho. Social Media Activism: Fa social media platforms di dwuma de kyɛ nkrasɛm pa na fa nhwehwɛmu ne nokwasɛm ahorow twa animtiaabu ho mpoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mehyia atemmu, nyiyim, anaa animtiaabu bere a merehwehwɛ awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Atemmu anaa Nyiyim a Wobedi Ho Dwumadi: Hu Hokwan a Wowɔ: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wunya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wommu atɛn anaa nyiyim biara. Kasa: Fa nidi nanso fa pintinn si hokwan ahorow a wowɔ so dua na kyerɛ sɛ wohwɛ kwan sɛ wɔ bɛhwɛ wo obuo mu. Bɔ Nyiyim Ho Amanneɛbɔ: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wɔayɛ wo ayayade a, bɔ ayaresabea sohwɛfo anaa aban panyin bi amanneɛ. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Wo ne ɔpanyin, w’adamfo, anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nkasa mfa osuahu a wunyae wɔ nkate fam mmoa wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammuisɛm ne wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nneɛma a ɛho hia no nya amanaman ntam sika a wɔde bɛma ASRH no so nsunsuanso, na dɛn na eyi kyerɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nkurɔfo no ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammui tebea ne wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nneɛma a ɛho hia no nya amanaman ntam sika a wɔde bɛma ASRH no so nsunsuanso kɛse. Amammui nhyehyɛe a wɔsakra, nsakrae a ɛba nneɛma a wɔde ma wɔ nneɛma a wɔde ma mu, ne akwahosan ho haw ahorow a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho di asi no betumi adan adwene ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma no afi ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow so, na aka nhyehyɛe ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi yie ne apam a ɛfa akwankyerɛ ho no ho hia paa na ama wɔahwɛ sɛ ASRH da so ara yɛ ade titire wɔ amanaman ntam sika a wɔde ma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ma LGBTQ+ mmabun bere a wɔrepaw nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu mu Anigye: Ɛnyɛ bɔbeasu koro mmienu ntam abusuabɔ nyinaa mu na nyinsɛn ho dadwen wɔ, nanso ahobammɔ firi nna mu nyarewa ho hia paa. Wo ne wo dɔkota nni nkitaho fa kɔndɔm ne dental dams (nneɛma a wɔde kata ɔbaa ho bere a wɔregyee n'ani) ho. Bɔbeasu mu Su: Nnipa ahorow wɔ apɔwmuden mu ahiadeɛ pii a ɛsono obiara dea. Kasa kyerɛ w’apɔwmuden  mu dwumayɛni fa sɛnea wo nipadua, nipadua mu nsuo a wogye (sɛ ɛbi wɔ hɔ a), ne sɛnea wobɔ wo bra no betumi aka awoɔ ntentenee kwan a wobɛpaw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono mfe wɔde pene ho mmra a yɛ sononko firi nkurow nkurow mu, na dɛn ne akwankyerɛ titiriw a ɛwɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mfe a obi adi ho mmra betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ tumidi biara mu, wɔ aman mu ne aman ahorow ntam. Akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ nyinaa kyerɛ mfe a ɛba fam koraa a obi betumi apene so wɔ mmara kwan so sɛ ɔne no bɛda, a ebetumi adi mfe du-nsia (16) kosi du-nwɔtwe (18) a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmara so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aka sɛ mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu no nya mmea ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ soro ma wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi aka ama sɛɛ mmabun nya mmea ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ soro de anam: Mmabun awo akwahosan ho hia a wobɛma wɔahu denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatuo, mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu, anaa sohyial media akwan so. Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de asusuw hia a ehia sɛ wɔtrɛw mmea ho dwumadie mu ma mmabun ho. Akuw a mmabun di anim a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si awo akwahosan ne hokwan ahorow so a wɔbɛka wɔn ho anaasɛ wɔbɛboa wɔn. Baguam nhyiam ahorow, kurow no mu asa ahorow nhyiam ahorow, anaa mmarahyɛ bagua atiefo a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu de aka wo haw ahorow ho asɛm na woakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛde mmabun awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe di kan. Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne akwahosan ho asoɛe ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun, titiriw wɔn a wofi mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn agyae gyae mu anaasɛ wonnya mmoa pii no, atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim, mmabun afotufo bagua ahorow, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodie ahorow betumi adi wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan di kan, di nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ ho dwuma, na ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a mmabun di anim ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodie ahorow ho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan a wɔkamfo kyerɛ mu: Mmabun afotu bagua ahorow ma mmabun nya ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so aka wɔn ahiade, nea wɔpɛ, ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa akwahosan ho nnwuma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ho. Saa bagua yi betumi de afotu ama wɔ nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ ho, akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wosusuw mmabun adwene ho wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa Nkitahodiɛ: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ ma mmabun nya mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ho adwene, wɔgye tom, na wɔma wɔn tumi. Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no betumi adi dwuma titirie wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛtrɛ mu, akasa atia animtiaabu, ne akwahosan ho nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mpɔtam-mpɔtam nkitahodie dwumadie, na ɛwan kwan so na eyi boa wɔ babaso ne HIV ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ho ban bɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ nnwuma a ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ, wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne aban nnwumakuo hyehyɛ de nkyerɛkyerɛ, mmoa, ne nneɛma ma ankorankoro a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi boa ma wɔsiw STI/HIV ano na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ denam: Wɔnam nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu, nsɛm a wɔka, ne nhyiamu a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn so. Nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwinnade a wɔde besiw STI/HIV ano, asɔ ahwɛ, ne ayaresa a wɔde bɛma. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de adi amammerɛ, asetena, ne sikasɛm mu nsɛm a ɛka STI/HIV a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu ne akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔnya no ho dwuma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no bɛkyekyere, a sukuu ahodoɔ, ahyehyɛdeɛ a egyina gyidie so, ne nnwuma ka ho, de akɔ nnipa ahodoɔ nkyɛn na wɔanya nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mpanyimfoɔ foforo bɛboa yɛn SRH nkɔmmɔbɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wɔboa (Support). Wɔma nimdeɛ ne awerɛkyekye. Paw mpanyimfoɔ a wɔte asɛm/ wɔgye nsɛm tom. Wɔma nkɔmmɔdie yɛ mmerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya adwenem akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a awofo mpene so anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe a awofo mpene so anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmra ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho taa bɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ wɔn adwenem akwahosan ho hwɛ ho ho ban, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ afotu anaa ayaresa a awofo mpene so. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko anaasɛ anohyeto ahorow wɔ kokoamsɛm mu, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho haw ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim di wɔ nhomasua ne tumi a wɔde bɛma mmabun anya akwannya ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwaahosan (ASRH)  ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Dwumadie a egyina Sukuu so: CSE a wɔde bɛka nwomasua nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ho, de adesua kwan a wɔahyehyɛ na ɛyɛ mmerɛ ma. Mpɔtam hɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu de akɔ mmabun nkyɛn wɔ sukuu tebea akyi, ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛka nnipa nyinaa ho na wɔanya kwan akɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn saa na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun akannifoɔ anaa mpaninfoɔ wɔ ASRH advocacy mu?
answer_twi_source: Sika mmoa (Funding/grants). Afotu ne nteteɛ (Mentorship). Intanɛt so nneɛma (Online platforms). Nhyiamu (Networking events).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu kyerɛ tumi a nhwehwɛmufoɔ tumi te ankorankoro ne mpɔtam ahodoɔ a wɔfiri amammerɛ ahodoɔ ase, wɔbu wɔn, na wɔne wɔn yɛ adwuma yie. Wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) mu no, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ho hia efisɛ ɛhwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa nnipa dodow a wɔresua ho ade no amammerɛ mu gyidie, gyinapɛn, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛe ho. Ɛboa ma wɔkwati animhwɛ, nsusuwii hunu, ne ntease a ɛnteɛ a ebetumi aba bere a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu, na awiei koraa no ɛde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ntease wom kɛse a ebetumi ama wɔahu nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔde siw ano a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔn botae ne sɛ wobedi nneɛma a ɛde nna mu basabasayɛ ba ntini ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ abusuabɔ pa ne amammerɛ a wɔpene so ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnwuma a wɔde siw ano a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho no bi ne: - Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri: Wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, tumi mu nkɔsoɔ, pene, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho di dwuma. - Bystander Intervention Training: Fa bystander intervention training a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛdeɛ wɔbɛhunu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho, a wɔde wɔn adwene si so wɔ mmarima ne mmaa ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu na madi m’ankasa me nyiyi mu ne nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nna ho, no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wubehu w’ankasa wo nyiyimu: Wo Ho a Wosusuw Ho: Susuw wo nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho no ho. Nsɛnnennen Ho Nsusuwii hunu: Fa nsiyɛ gye mfonini ahorow a enye a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne ɔmanfo mu ho kyim. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho fi mmeae a wotumi gye di.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ m’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu den na ɛfoa so mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ ma wo sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ w’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu den na ɛfoa so mu. Hwehwɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, nwomasua nhyiamu, anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu a wobɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa ɔsatuo a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn adwene si su pa a wɔbɛnya wɔ nna ne obuo mu abusuabɔ ho no mu. Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ hokwan ahorow yi mu denneennen a, wubetumi ahyɛ wo gyinapɛn ahorow ho ntease mu den na woanya mmoa afi ankorankoro a wɔwɔ adwene koro hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ma nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛde kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm di kan wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ma kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm denam: Mmabun a wɔkamfo akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si akwahosan ho nsɛm so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ kokoamsɛm hokwan ahorow ho nkuran mu. Wɔn suahu ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo. Ahyehyɛde ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ adwuma de bɔ mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛyɛ kokoam ho ban no a wɔbɛboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw bɛn na mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu na ɛkɔ akyiri a wobenya mu esiane amammerɛ anaa Nyamesom mu ahyɛde anaa anohyeto ahorow nti?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu na ɛkɔ akyiri a wobenya mu esiane amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu ahyɛde anaa anohyeto ahorow nti. Ebia mpɔtam binom bɛbɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho animtiaa, na ɛde nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wonni ne nsɛm a wonnya pii aba. Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow betumi ahyɛ gyidi anaa nneyɛe bi ho nkuran bere a ɛbu afoforo abam, na ebetumi asiw mmabun a wobetumi apaw nneɛma a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho no kwan. Mmabun betumi anya nkrasɛm a ɛbɔ abira wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa nhomasua asoɛe ahorow de ma ntam, na ɛde adwene mu naayɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu sɛ ebia wɔn apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe no tua nnwuma te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhwehwɛmu ho ka?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu sɛ ebia wɔn apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe no tua nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ka denam: Wɔn insurance nhyehyɛe ho nkrataa a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu, a mfaso ne sika a wɔde tua ho ka (SBC) ho nsɛm tiawa ka ho, na wɔate nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ka, sika a wɔtew fi mu, sika a wɔde bom, ne insurance a wɔde bom yɛ no ase. Wɔn insurance dwumadiefoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ insurance adwumakuo no wɛbsaet hɔ akɔnya nsɛm a ɛfa mfasoɔ a wɔabɔ ho ka, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ne nkitahodiɛ anohyetoɔ ho. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea adwumayɛfo a wo ne wɔn besusuw ho de ahwɛ sɛ wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ nnwuma pɔtee bi ho na wɔabisa ɛka biara a wɔbɔ wɔ kotoku mu anaasɛ tumi krataa a wɔadi kan ama ho ahwehwɛde ahorow ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ ansa na mapaw awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ aduru?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma yie (Effectiveness). Sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wobenya (Convenience). Apɔwmuden (Health). Sɛ ɛsiw STI kwan (Condoms).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ afofro, akyerɛkyerɛfo, apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasua nna mu pene ho ade, adi nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma, na wɔahyɛ suban pa ne nneyɛe a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ afofro so, akyerɛkyerɛfo, apomoden ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun ma wosua nna mu pene ho ade na wɔhyɛ suban pa ne nneyɛe a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho nkuran no mu. Wobetumi afi nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛfata mfe a wɔadi ase a ɛfa pene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho, de nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware ama, atie mmabun nsɛmmisa ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔmfa atɛn, na wɔayɛ obu ne nneyɛe a wɔpene so ho nhwɛso wɔ wɔn ankasa abusuabɔ mu. Mpanyimfo nso betumi akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ahorow mu, anya ntetee a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ho, na wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa sɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm ne afotusem adwuma bɛn na wɔde ma mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu no nya nsɛm ne afotu a ɛkɔ akyiri. Ebia eyi bɛka nsɛm a ɛfa ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ho, asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba, mmoa a ɛwɔ hɔ, ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so yi nyinsɛn a woyi gu ananmu. Ɛsɛ sɛ afotu yɛ nea ɛnyɛ akwankyerɛ na ɛboa, na ɛma mmabun ebetumi gyina wɔn ankorankoro tebea so sisi gyinae a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nyiyim ho no ka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm?
answer_twi_source: Mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a ɛkyerɛ nyiyim betumi asiw mmabun tumi a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan (SRH) ho nnwuma ne nsɛm ano denam akwanside ahorow te sɛ mfe a wɔadi, awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ, ne animtiaabu a wɔde bɛba so. Eyi betumi ama nsonsonoe aba wɔ akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wobenya mu, na aka mmabun akwahosan mu nsunsuanso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsonsonoe wɔ akwahosan ho insurance a wɔde tua nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma mu a egyina nneɛma te sɛ mfe a obi adi, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, anaa beae a obi wɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Aane, nsonsonoe betumi aba; na eyi dodow no ara wɔ ankorankoro sikakorabea a wɔde sika ma no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina mfe a wɔadi so, a nhyehyɛe ahorow bi de sika a wɔde tua ho ka nyinaa ma wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ho. Bɔbeasu nso betumi adi dwuma, efisɛ wobetumi ayɛ nnwuma bi ma ɛne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna pɔtee bi ahyia. Asasesin a ɛwɔ hɔ no betumi anya nkɛntɛnso wɔ akwan a wɔbɛfa so akatua ne nnwuma bi a wobetumi anya esiane ɔmantam mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow nti.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho a ɛsɛsɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm bi a wɔtaa nya wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no bi ne atoro nsɛm a ɛfa ahobammɔ, mmara kwan so, ne akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi na wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔ wɔ din pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi adi wɔ pene, abusuabɔ pa, ne nna mu nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu so?
answer_twi_source: Mma a Wɔpene Ho Ntease: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ boa mmabun ma wɔte nea pene ne nea enti a ɛho hia ase. Suban a Ɛnyɛ Pa a Wobehu: Ɛboa ma wohu nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ papa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow mu na wɔte nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ so no ase. Nsusuwii a Ɛyɛ Den a Wɔhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ hyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ne nea ɛyɛ abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho nkuran. Tumi a Wɔma: Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a mmabun nim so no, wobetumi ako atia nkrasɛm a epira na wɔapaw wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfata. Nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ pa ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ papa. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa digital beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma woanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho . Ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo hɔ no yɛ nokware anaa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: so mfe dodow anaa ahwehwɛde bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun di nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ a wɔmfa mfeɛ anohyetoɔ katee biara mma. Bisa kokoamsɛm/pene ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛtena hɔ kyɛ a ɛwɔ animtiaabu a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛtew so wɔ ankorankoro yiyedi, mpɔtam hɔfo a wotumi gyina tebea horow ano, ne nea efi ɔmanfo akwahosan mu ba no so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔtew animtiaabu a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho a, ebetumi ama: Ankorankoro yiyedi atu mpɔn denam aniwu, tew a wɔtew wɔn ho, ne nyiyim ho atinka a wɔbɛtew so, a wɔbɛhyɛ obu ma wɔn ho, sɛnea wotumi gyina tebea ahorow ano, ne adwenemyare ho nkuran no so. Mpɔtam hɔfo ahoɔden a wɔde gyina tebea horow ano a ɛkɔ anim denam tema, biakoyɛ, ne asetena mu biakoyɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so, a wɔbɛma tebea horow a ɛboa a mmabun te nka sɛ wogye wɔn tom, wɔsom bo, na wɔama wɔn tumi. Ɔmanfo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso pa denam nnwuma a wɔde siw yare ano, ayaresa a wɔde ma ntɛm, ne ɔhwɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, a ɛbɛtew adesoa a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa "STI", nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, ne nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso afoforo a enye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena mu nimdeɛ ho nhwɛso bi, a mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, kɔmputa ho nimdeɛ, duadwumfo, ntamapam), ahokokwaw a ɛyɛ mmerɛw (sɛ nhwɛso no, nkitahodi, kuw adwumayɛ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru), ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ (sɛ nhwɛso no, adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, aguadi, sikasɛm sohwɛ) ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ: Kɔmputa ho nimdeɛ: Software applications, intanɛt nhwehwɛmu, ne programming kasa atitiriw a wɔde di dwuma ho nimdeɛ. Duadwumfo adwuma: Tumi a wɔde nsa ne anyinam ahoɔden nnwinnade yɛ na wosiesie nnua adan, dan mu nneɛma, ne nneɛma a wɔde si dan mu. Nwene: Nwene mfiri a wɔde pam ade, nsusuwso a wɔkyerɛ ase, ne ntade anaa ntama a wɔboaboa ano ho nimdeɛ. Soft Skills: Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a wɔde ano ka ne nea wɔkyerɛw mu da hɔ na ama woatumi de nsusuwii, akwankyerɛ, ne nsɛm adi yiye. Akuw adwuma: Nkɔmmɔbɔ, biakoyɛ, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ biakoyɛ mu ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo anaa kuw no mufo. Ɔhaw ano aduro: Nsusuwii a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu, adebɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma de hu nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside ahorow na wodi ho dwuma. Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ: Adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe: Nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a ɛkyerɛ adwumayɛ botae ahorow, akwan ahorow, aguadi ho akwan horow, ne sikasɛm ho nkɔmhyɛ ahorow. Aguadi: Nneɛma anaa nnwuma a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, hu gua a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran de twetwe adetɔfo. Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, akontaabu, ne sikasɛm ho gyinaesi a wɔde hwɛ ɛka a wɔbɔ, di sika a wonya no akyi, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ adwuma no bɛkɔ so atra hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobɛtumi ama me nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfata mfeɛ anaa nneɛma a mede bɛsua nna mu apomoden ho adeɛ bebree?
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Planned Parenthood's 'Teen Talk' anaa nna Etc.' ma nsɛm a ɛfata mfeɛ pɔtee bi fa nna mu apɔwmuden ho asɛmti ahodoɔ ho. Nhoma te sɛ brebiara de ho pɛpɛɛpɛ 'It's Perfectly Normal' a Robie H kyerew ye. Harris kyerɛw anaa 'Changing Bodies, Changing Lives' a Ruth Bell kyerɛw nso betumi ama mmofra a wɔn mfeɛ nkɔ anim nsɛm pii. Video a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ adeɛ wɔ YouTube tebea horow so no betumi de aniwa so nkyerɛkyerɛma a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho asɛmti ho ama wɔ kwan bi so a ɛyɛ anigye na ɛyɛ bɔkɔɔ sɛ wobɛte aseɛ. Hwehwɛ kanbia te sɛ Amaze.org anaa Sexplanations. Wo skuul nso betumi de nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua anaa nnwuma a akyerekyerɛfoɔ a wɔfata di so anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Honam fam nsakrae bɛn na ɛba nipadua so bere a wanyinsɛn no? (hormone mu nsakrae, mu duru a ɛkɔ soro, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn hwehwɛ sɛ nsakrae a ɛyɛ nwonwa ba wo nipadua mu, na ne nyinaa fi hormone ahorow! Nea ɛtaa ba no bi ni: Mu duru a Ɛkɔ soro: Wo mu duru bɛkɔ soro de ama wo ba a ɔrenyin no aduan pa. Eyi yɛ apɔwmuden na ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata. Nufu mu Nsakrae: Ebia wo nufu bɛyɛ mmerɛw na ayɛ kɛse de asiesie wo ho ama nufu. Yafunu Nnyin: W’awotwaa no trɛw ma akokoaa no nya baabi. Ɔbrɛ: Ebia ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛte ɔbrɛ nka, titiriw wɔ ɔsram abiɛsa a edi kan no mu. Adwene mu Nsakrae: Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu no betumi ama obi anya adwene mu nsakrae, te sɛ nkate a ɔte nka kɛse anaasɛ ne bo fuw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nhyiam ase ne sohyial media nnwumakuw di wɔ pene a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano wɔ Intanɛt so mmeae ahorow no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo Intanɛt so mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ?
answer_twi_source: Platforms ne social media nnwumakuw di dwuma titiriw wɔ pene a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ne nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano wɔ intanɛt so denam: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma: Mpɔtam hɔ akwankyerɛ ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbara ɔhaw, ɔtan kasa, ne nneyɛe a wɔmpene so a wɔde bedi dwuma. Nneɛma a Wɔde Ma: Nneɛma, nnwinnade, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔrehyia ɔhaw anaa ayayade. Nhomasua Ɔsatuo: Nhomasua ɔsatuo ne nnwuma a wɔbɛhyɛ aseɛ de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate adwene a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, intanɛt so ahobanbɔ, ne suban a ɛkyerɛ obuo ho. Nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee ne Akontaabuo: Wɔbɛda adi wɔ wɔn nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu no nneyɛeɛ ne akontabuo akwan a wɔfa so di amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa ayayadeɛ anaa ayayadeɛ ho dwuma. Mmabun betumi akamfo intanɛt so mmeae a ahobammɔ wom denam: Nsakrae ho Ɔsatu: Nsakrae a wɔde kɔdan adesrɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma wɔn nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho no atu mpɔn. Atipɛnfoɔ a Wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ: Nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ne pene a wɔde bɛma atipɛnfoɔ a wɔbɛkyɛ de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ na wɔahyɛ intanɛt so nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ asɛdeɛ ho nkuran. Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Intanɛt so nkɔmmɔbɔ, nhyiam ahorow, anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn adwene si pene a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran na wɔasiw intanɛt so ayayade ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan "Rights" ahorow bɛn na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ, wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, na sɛ mihyia nyiyim anaa ayayade a, mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ hokwan ahorow yi?
answer_twi_source: Ghana Amanyɔ Mmra "Constitution of Ghana" no ma ɔman mma nyinaa nya hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ, a akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ka ho. Sɛnea wobɛka wo hokwan ahorow ni: Hu Wo Hokwan: Hwehwɛ Ghana mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmubuafo hokwan ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho. Ayarefoɔ a Wɔkamfo Akuo: Sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a, wo ne ayarefoɔ a wɔkamfo nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no di nkitaho. Ebia wɔde akwankyerɛ bɛma wɔ sɛnea wobɛka hokwan ahorow a wowɔ ho. Kyerɛw Biribiara: Sɛ wuhyia nyiyim a, yɛ da, bere, asɛm no ho nsɛm, ne adansefo (sɛ ebi wɔ hɔ a) ho kyerɛwtohɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi anya ankorankoro bi ahyeɛ so nkɛntɛnso, te sɛ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, n’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, osuahu ahorow a atwam, ne ahotɔ dodow, na kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi saa nneɛma yi so wɔ ahyeɛ a wɔbɛto na wɔakura mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow betumi anya ankorankoro bi ahyeɛ so nkɛntɛnso, a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, n’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, osuahu ahorow a atwam, ne ahotɔ dodow ka ho. Mmabun betumi afa saa nneɛma yi mu denam wɔn amammerɛ mu ntetee a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn gyidi ahorow a wɔbɛte ase, osuahu ahorow a atwam a wobedi ho dwuma, na wɔde nkakrankakra atrɛ wɔn ahotɔ mmeae mu denam wɔn ho a wobehu ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo so. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpaninfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ nso betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɔhyeɛ a wɔde besisi hɔ no so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem berɛ a wɔreyɛ abɛɛfo nneɛma, titiriw bere a wɔredi nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa akyinnyegye a ɛfa ASRH, nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipasu ho dwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de obu, nokwaredi, ne nokware di kan bere a wɔreyɛ bɛɛfo ntentan nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wonya pene berɛ a wɔde ankorankoro di dwuma wɔ wɔn nsɛm mu no na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie, titiriw berɛ a wɔresusuw wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow ho no. Pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nokwasɛm mu nokwaredi na ɛho hia sen biara; ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din no yɛ nokware na wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a epira mu. Obu a wɔde ma adwene, amammerɛ, ne nipasu ahorow ho hia; ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu no kwati sɛ wɔbɛma nsusuwii hunu a ɛwɔ hɔ no akɔ so anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nyiyim nneyɛe mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun bi yɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ ɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ a, ayaresa bɛn na wobetumi apaw, na ɛhe na wobetumi anya ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ ɔbabun bi yɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ ɔwɔ nna mu yareɔa, ayaresa a wobetumi apaw no bi ne: - Nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde sa ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu te sɛ chlamydia, gonorrhea, ne syphilis. - a wode ko tia mmoawa a wode sa virus STI te se HIV ne herpes. - ayaresa nhyehyɛe betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ɔyare mmoawa pɔtee ne ankorankoro nneɛma so. - ayaresa dwumadie wo mmeaeɛ korɔ no ara bebree a wɔyɛ sɔhwɛ, a ɔmanfoɔ apomoden ayaresabea, mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛeɛ, ne ankorankoro apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm akyerɛ wɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama, ɔhwɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho akyerɛ wɔ apomoden nhyehyɛe ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu denam wɔn suahu ahorow a wɔbɛka, ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nneyɛe a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu. Wobetumi nso de nsɛm ama apomoden ho adwumayɛfo ne asoɛe ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛhyɛ ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ho nkuran ayɛ biako, na wɔakasa ama nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛde akwan a wɔfa so hu adwenemhaw di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ mmabun betumi anya ‘sexual reproductive health’ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa nnipa, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn, ne ayaresa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so boa ma wodu nkuraase. Akwahosan adwumayɛfo, mpɔtam hɔ akuw, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo bom yɛ adwuma de ma nneɛma a wonya no tu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ako ama sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a, wɔbɛtrɛw mu ama nhomasua ne ntetee wɔ wɔn mpɔtam anaa nhomasua asoɛe ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ako ama sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛtrɛw mu ama nhomasua ne ntetee wɔ wɔn mpɔtam anaa nhomasua asoɛe ahorow mu denam hia a ɛho hia sɛ wonya nhomasua, mfaso a ɛwɔ sikasɛm mu mmoa so, ne akwanside ahorow a asuafo a, wohia mmoa hyia no ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya so. Wobetumi ayɛ ɔsatuo, adesrɛ, ne nhyiamu a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate ase, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛɛ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma wɔ nwomasua mu no adi nkitaho, na wɔakyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ne adansedie de akyerɛ nkɛntɛnsoɔ a sikasɛm mu mmoa nya wɔ wɔn asetena ne wɔn daakye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw awo ano a ɛnyɛ kɔndɔm, bɔ obi ho ban biara fi nna ho yareɛ ho? (ebinom yɛ saa, nanso ɛnyɛ wɔn nyinaa) .
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano dodow no ara, te sɛ aduro, IUD, anaa ade a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu no, mmɔ wɔn ho ban mfi STI ho. Wɔyɛ papa ma nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nanso kɔndɔm nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so a wɔfa so siw STI dodow no ara a ɛbɛtrɛw ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma matete abofra bere a meyɛ ɔbabun? (sikasɛm mu mmoa, mmofra hwɛ a wobetumi apaw, nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow) .
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa akwahosan ho dwumadiefoɔ bɛka wo ho ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ de aboa wo ama woatete wo ba
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen bɛn na 'mentors' (afotufoɔ) hyia bere a wɔreboa mmabun wɔ SRH mu?
answer_twi_source: Nteteeɛ a enni hɔ. Nneɛma a yɛde yɛ adwuma (resources) a enni hɔ. Amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ. Siesie denam: Hwehwɛ nteteeɛ. Ne ahyehyɛdeɛ nyɛ adwuma. Sua nneɛma foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan ne nneɛma bɛn na wɔde di dwuma de ma mmabun, de wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔhyɛ adesua a ɛyɛ nna, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow de nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan ne nneɛma ahorow di dwuma de ma mmabun de wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho ammmanneɛbɔ ho adesua mu, nea ɛka ho ne: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne akyinnyegye a ɛfa nkitahodi ho, de hyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee ne kyɛfa a wɔde hyɛ mu denneennen ho nkuran. Nsɛm ho ammaneɛbɔ nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow a asuafo "deconstruct" na wɔhwehwɛ ammaneɛbɔ nkrasɛm negyinabea ahorow mu. Nnwuma a wɔde nsa yɛ te sɛ nsɛm ho ammane3bɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ, digyital abasɛm a wɔka ne "multimedia" nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu ne wiase ankasa nhwɛso ahorow a wɔde kɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nnyinasoahorow mu. Ahɔho kasafo, adwumayɛbea ahorow ne afuw mu akwantu ahorow a wɔde kɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu. "Multimedia" nneɛma a "video", nsɛm a woakyerɛw ne intanɛt so nso ka ho. Dwumadi a wɔde di dwuma ne nsusui a wɔde a wɔde hwehw3 adwene ahorow mu. Adesua dwumadi ahorow a wɔbom yɛ te sɛ kuw nnwuma, atipɛnfo nhwehwɛmu a wɔbom yɛ. Saa akwan yi hyɛ adesua a ɛyɛ nnam, adwene a ɛyɛ katee, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho nkuran ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkyerɛwee mu pɔtee, de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow so da wɔn ankasa adwene adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So intanɛt so nhyiamu anaa mpɔtam bi wɔ hɔ a metumi ne me mfɛfoɔ adi nkitaho na masusuw STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, intanɛt so nhyiamu ne mpɔtam bi wɔ hɔ a wobɛtumi ne w’atipɛnfoɔ adi nkitaho na woasusu STI/HIV ano aduro ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: - YMK a ankorankoro bɛtumi abisa nsɛm, akyɛ suahunu, na wɔanya mmoa afiri afoforo hɔ. - a ewo intanɛt so mmoa akuo ne nhyiamu a ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ na ɛhwɛ so. - Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana(PPAG) - Marie Stopes International - Social media akuo ne nkratafa a wɔde ama nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedie, baabi a mmabun bɛtumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie mu, anya nneɛma, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatuo a wɔde ma nkurɔfoɔ a ahyehyɛdeɛ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ hyehyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dawurobɔfoɔ ne amanneɛbɔfoɔ de kasa, mfonini, ne nneɛma di dwuma de kyerɛ nsɛm pɔtee a ɛfa nna mu apɔmuden ne suban ho?
answer_twi_source: Dawurobɔfoɔ ne amanneɛbɔfoɔ de kasa, mfonini, ne nneɛma di dwuma de kyerɛ nsɛm pɔtee a ɛfa nna mu apɔmuden ne suban ho denam: Kasakoa 'euphemisims' anaa nsɛm a ɛkanyan nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma anaa mmoa a ɛfa nna mu apɔmuden ho. Wɔyi mfoni a ɛkyerɛ ahoɔfɛ a ɛwɔ amammrɛ ne gyedie mu. Nna mu apɔmuden nsɛm a wɔbɛka no ɔkwan a ɛkanyan atenka pɔtee bi, te sɛ anigyeɛ, akɔnnɔ, anaa ehu. Sɛ mmabun te saa akwan yi ase a, wɔbetumi ate nsɛm a ɛwɔ dawurobɔ no akyi no ase yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atoro bɛn na ɛwɔ pene a  ɛwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan ho, na mmabun bɛyɛ dɛn asiesie?
answer_twi_source: Atoro: Sɛ pene wɔ hɔ dada, Kokoam-yɛ kyerɛ pene'. Siesie denam: Nkyerɛkyerɛ, Atoro a yɛbɛyi firi hɔ, Nsɛm pa a yɛbɛtwerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a nea broni ka no 'social media' so nkɛntɛnsofo taa fa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun atiefo mu na wonya wɔn so nkɛntɛnso wɔ 'ASRH' nsɛmti ho, na saa akwan yi tu mpɔn dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Nea broni ka no 'Social media' nkɛntɛnsofoɔ de akwan ahodoɔ di dwuma de de wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun atiefoɔ mu na wɔnya wɔn so nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ ASRH nsɛmti ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Abasɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne ankorankoro asɛm a ɛka wɔn akyidifoɔ na ɛma nkateɛ mu nkitahodiɛ ba. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne brands, ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa nkɛntɛnsofo afoforo yɛ de ma nkrasɛm ahorow no yɛ kɛse na wɔadu atiefo pii nkyɛn. Nkitahodi nneɛma te sɛ abatow, nsɛmmisa, ne nsɛmmisa ne mmuae nhyiam ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nkuran ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Ɛsono sɛnea saa akwan yi tu mpɔn no gyina nneɛma te sɛ nea ɔde nkɛntɛnso no di dwuma no mu ahotoso, nokware a ɔyɛ, ne sɛnea otumi ne wɔn atiefo di nkitaho so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wɔm, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛase: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom kyerɛ nneyɛe ne akwan a ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da bere a wɔreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nea broni ka no  'Abstinence', Wo ne wo hokafo di nkitaho pefee fa wo nna mu akwahosan ho, to wo nna mu ahokafo dodow ano hye, fa kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye na daa, yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STIs ho. Sɛ wowɔ STI a, kɔ ayaresa. Sɛ obi rehyɛ wo sɛ wo ne obi nna anaa ɔma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, ka kyerɛ no. Nea ɛho hia: Ɛbɔ ho ban fi nna mu yarewa 'STI' ho: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom boa ma wosiw STI a ebetumi de akwahosan ho haw a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ no ano. Siw Nyinsɛn a Wɔnhyɛɛ Ho Nhyehyɛe Siw: Wɔtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da nso so, na ɛma ankorankoro tumi paw awo ho nsɛm a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ menhyehyɛ ahhye wɔ abusuabɔ mu titiriw wɔ me nkate mu yiyedi obu a mewɔ ma me ho ne m'ankasa ahobanmmɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbu wo. Dadwen/adwennwen.Ahobammɔ ho asiane ahorow.Ɛho hia ma abusuabɔ ahoɔden wɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo (Health workers) di wɔ nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ne Akwankyerɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri ma. Wɔka sɛnea etu mpɔn, nea efi mu ba, akwankyerɛ a wɔde di dwuma, ne sɛnea ɛfata ma ankorankoro ahiade ho asɛm. Nnuru a Wɔkyerɛw ne Nea Wɔde Ma: Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo betumi akyerɛw nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a hormone wom te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nnuru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, anaa nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nyinsɛn mu. Wobetumi nso afata anaasɛ wɔde akwankyerɛ ama wɔ akwanside akwan te sɛ kɔndɔm ne akwan a ɛkyɛ te sɛ mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUDs) ho. Akyidi ne Nhwehwɛmu: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ sɛnea nyinsɛn ano aduro reyɛ adwuma yiye na wodi nsɛm biara a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma. Wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ sɛ wɔpa nnuro anaa nsɛm afoforo bi a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
