question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotu bi a ɛbɛma woanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ na ɛyɛ asɛdeɛ wɔ intanɛt so, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobɛhwɛ kokoam nsɛm so, wobɛsɔ nneɛma a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no agye adi, na woahyɛ digyital ɔman mma pa ne intanɛt so mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Afotu a ɛbɛma woanya intanɛt so dwumadi a onim nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ na ɛyɛ asɛyɛde no bi ne: Kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a wobɛhwɛ so: Hwɛ kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe mu na yɛ foforo daa wɔ social media so na ama woahwɛ onii a obetumi anya w’ankasa wo ho nsɛm ne w’asɛm no so. Gyidi a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ: Hwɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ nea wotumi de ho to so na wotumi de ho to so denam nsɛm a wɔde bɛtoto mmeae a wɔwɔ din pa ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ nokwasɛm ahorow mu no so. Digitals ɔman ba pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran: Fa wo ho hyɛ intanɛt so nkitahodi a obu ne abrabɔ pa wom mu, di mpɔtam hɔ akwankyerɛ ne gyinapɛn ahorow so, na boa ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ ne intanɛt so mpɔtam. Intanɛt so mpɔtam a wɔbɛdɔ: Fa wo ho hyɛ intanɛt so mmeae a ɛhyɛ anigyeɛ a wɔkyɛ ho nkuran, boa wo yɔnko adesua, na ɛma ayɔnkofa pa nya nkɔsoɔ, na ɛboa ma intanɛt so tebea a ahotɔ wɔ mu na ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ ɛnanom akwahosan ho nkuran na ɛboa mmabun a wɔyem wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo denam: Wɔn Ho a Wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ: Ɛnanom akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobesua. Nhumu a wɔbɛma: Nhyiam ahorow, ntentanfidie so ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ sukuu mu. Akuw a Wɔkamfo Wɔn a Wɔbɛka Ho: Nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si ɛnanom akwahosan so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Krataa a Wɔkyerɛw: Nkrataa anaa email a wɔde bɛmena mpɔtam hɔ ananmusifoɔ a ɛfa hia a ɛnanom akwahosan ho dwumadie ho hia ho. Nhyiam Ahorow a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Kurow no mu anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ akɔka wɔn adwene. Mmabun betumi aboa kɛse denam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pa ne mmoa a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔyem wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun betumi anya afotu anaa mmoa dwumadie a ɛfa  nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa ?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmabun taa tumi nya afotu anaa mmoa dwumadie sɛ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa. Saa dwumadie yi bi ne: Afotu a ɛfa awoɔ nnwura akwan, nyinsɛn banbɔ, ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden gyinaesio ho. Mmoa ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔrehyia nna mu basabasayɛ, anaa atenka mu haw. Adwene mu apɔmuden afotu ne mmoa ma nsɛm te sɛ dadwen, awerɛhow, anaa nipadua ho dadwen. Mmoa akuo anaa nnamfo afotu nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden nsɛm so. Mmoa a wɔde kɔma afotufoɔ anaa mmoa dwumadie foforo a ɛwɔ apɔmuden asoɛeɛ no akyi sɛ ehia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛfata, pene a wɔpene so, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ womu ho nkuran wɔ LGBTQ+ abusuabɔ mu.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apomoden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam biakoyɛ betumi aboa ma wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a etu mpɔn adi dwuma wɔ ahye so?
answer_twi_source: Mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ adwumayɛkuo mu: Nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛkyɛ: Aman bɛtumi asua biribi afiri wɔn ho wɔn ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi mu no mu na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa tebea mu. Nneɛma a Wɔkyɛ: Amanaman biakoyɛ betumi ama sika ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ mmeae a nneɛma kakraa bi na ɛwɔ hɔ. Nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom yɛ betumi ama nne ahorow a ɛkamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ kyerɛ wɔ wiase nyinaa asɛnka agua so no ayɛ kɛse. Nhwehwɛmu: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ma nhwehwɛmu mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom yɛ no tumi te ɔhaw a akwan horow nya no ase. Nhwɛsoɔ: UN Nnwumakuo: Nnwumakuo te sɛ UNICEF ne UNFPA yɛ adwuma wɔ ahyeɛ so de boa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ. NGO Nkɔmmɔbɔ: NGO ahorow taa yɛ biako de nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma wɔ aman pii so, na ɛde nimdeɛ ne nneɛma ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma nna mu akwahosan ho ahomatrofo mmoa anaa mmoa akuw a, wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama wɔ nkitahodi a ɛfa nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho.
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho asɛm a yɛbɛka ne ahye a yɛde besi hɔ no betumi ayɛ den, nanso nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa! Ghana "hotline" ne mmoa akuw bi a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama ni: Kɔ ɔmanfo akwahosan adwumayɛbea biara anaa coummunity adolescent friendly center a ɛbɛn wo kɔhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho "Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana" (PPAG Helpline): (0244312151) (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-5pm) "PPAG" afotufo betumi abua wo nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nna ho akwahosan, nkitahodi, ne nkitahodi. Wobetumi nso de wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔyɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a ɛyɛ kokoam ama. "Ghana Youth Alliance for Reproductive Health" (GYARH): "https://ghanasrhralliance.org/" (website) "GYARH" de nneɛma ne mmoa ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho. Ebia wɔn wɛbsaet no wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nkitahodi a ɛfa nna a ahobammɔ wom ho. "BasicNeeds Ghana": "https://basicneedsghana.org/" (website) "BasicNeeds Ghana" de nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma ma mmabun. Ebia wɔn wɛbsaet no wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nkitahodi ne ahye a wɔde besi hɔ ho. Kae: Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara! Nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi aboa wo ma woafa nna mu abusuabɔ mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ papa na ahobammɔ wom so. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛtrɛw wo nsam akɔhwehwɛ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awo ho atɛntrenee de mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua, wɔn a wofi BIPOC (Abibifo, Abibifo, ne Nnipa a Wɔyɛ Kɔla) mpɔtam, LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, ne wɔn a wɔadi dɛm ka ho no nne ne osuahu ahorow si so?
answer_twi_source: Awo ho atɛntrenee de mmabun a wɔato wɔn hintidua, wɔn a wofi BIPOC mpɔtam, ne nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ka ho, nne ne osuahu ahorow si wɔn ani so denam wɔn ahiade a wɔde di kan, nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a wodi ho dwuma, ne nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkamfo nnipa nyinaa ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma pa a ɛwɔ social media so wɔ SRH ho nimdeɛ, nhomasua, ne nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun nya wɔ wiase nyinaa no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a wobetumi anya: Social media platform ahorow ma ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛyɛ mmerɛw ma mmabun a wɔbɛfa so anya SRH ho nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa nnwuma, titiriw wɔ mpɔtam a wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa: Intanɛt so mpɔtam ne mmoa akuo a ɛwɔ sohyial media so ma mmabun nya baabi a wɔbɛkyɛ osuahu, ahwehwɛ afotuo, na wɔanya mmoa afiri atipɛnfoɔ a wɔrehyia SRH nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Nhomasua ne nhumu: SRH ahyehyɛde ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ de sohyial media di dwuma de ma nkurɔfoɔ te SRH nsɛm ho, hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) ho nkuran, na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛɛ mu nsakraeɛ a ɛbɛma mmabun SRH aba atu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu nkyerɛase ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho, a mmara, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho a ɛkyerɛ nna mu nneyɛe na ɛbɔ ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nkyerɛase ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho no gu ahorow gyina tumidi so, nanso mpɛn pii no, wɔkyerɛkyerɛ pene a wɔpene so no mu sɛ apam a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ, wɔde nimdeɛ, na wɔde anigye yɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu. Mmara, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ho no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛbɔ ankorankoro ho ban afi nna mu ayayade, ne nneyɛe bɔne ho. Saa mmara ahorow yi kyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde pene ma kwa na wofi wɔn pɛ mu, a wɔmfa nhyɛso, ne ndaadaa so. Wobu nna mu dwumadi a wɔmpene so sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ anaa mmonnaato, na wɔn a wɔyɛ saa no betumi ahyia mmara mu nsunsuanso a emu yɛ den, a nsɛmmɔnedi ho sobo ne afiasenna ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu sɛ ebia wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ, titiriw sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn dodow a wɔyɛ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu no gyina asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ ankorankoro ne nna mu dwumadi so. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu, titiriw wɔn a wɔwɔ ahokafo pii anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane kɛse wom mu no susuw ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu daa sɛ ebia wɔwɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu. Akwankyerɛ taa kamfo sɛ wɔnyɛ afe afe nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu mma nnipa a wonnii mfe 25 a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu, anaasɛ mpɛn pii sɛ wɔwɔ ahokafo foforo anaa pii a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi anadwo bree anaasɛ berɛ a endi nhyehyɛeɛ so, na megusɔ ma meda ho hia me bere merenyini?
answer_twi_source: Te anadwo nneɛma so. Da awia (naps) anaa da si ananmu. Hyehye berɛ a ɛkɔ so daa sɛ ɛho hia anaa sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de me nne ne me nimdeɛ ako ama nsakraeɛ ne bammɔ ama obiara?
answer_twi_source: Social Media: Yɛ abɛɛfo dwumadie (content) wɔ Instagram anaa TikTok a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ pa nɛ  si GBV hokwan. Nhomasua nhyiamudie  'Educational Workshops': Yɛ nhyiamu nketewa ne wo nnamfo na mokasa ne adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ 'consent' ho. To nsa frɛ panyin ma ɔmmɛkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda atipɛnfo nhyɛso "peer pressure" pa ne nea enye ntam?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhyɛso pa hyɛ wo nkuran sɛ, paw nneɛma a ahoɔden wom, ahobammɔ wom, na asɛyɛde wom a ɛne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia, bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye piapia wo kɔ nneyɛe a ebetumi apira, asiane wom, anaasɛ ɛne w’adwene a eye ahyia so. Mpɛn pii no atipɛnfo nhyɛso pa boa wo yiyedi ne w’ankasa nkɔso, bere a atipɛnfo nhyɛso a enye no bu w’ani gu w’ahye so na ebetumi de nneɛma bɔne aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wubetumi aka w’ankasa osuahu anaa nhumu biara a efi w’ankasa wo mmaabunberemu a ebetumi aboa me ma mate me atinka ase yiye na magyina ano?
answer_twi_source: Metumi akyɛ m’ankasa mesuahu ne m'adwene kyereɛ a efi m’ankasa me mmerantebere mu de aboa wo ma woate wo atinka ase yiye na woagyina ano. Bere a obiara suahu yɛ soronko no, m’ankasa osuahu ahorow a mɛka akyerɛ no betumi ama manya adwene, tema, ne awerɛhyem sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wuhyia . Ɛdenam kyɛfa a mɛkyɛ so no, mewɔ anidaso sɛ mɛhyɛ ntease, nkitahodi, ne mmoa a yɛde ma yɛn ho yɛn ho wɔ yɛn abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ awoɔ mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran na edi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nna ne awo apomoden ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa ama nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ awo mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran denam nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ fam a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔhwehwɛ wɔn, nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase, aboa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho, ne apomoden ho nhyehyɛe a edi mu a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wonya no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne afotu adwuma, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa mmabun wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan 'SRH' ho?
answer_twi_source: Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛboa ma wɔne oduruyɛfo a wɔatete no susuw wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow, atinka ahorow, ne osuahu ahorow ho. Saa nnwuma yi betumi aboa mmabun te sɛ: Kokoam tebea a wɔde bɛma de ahwehwɛ nsɛmti a ɛho hia mu. Atinka fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow a wɔde fa kwan so no mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu nyarewa 'STI's, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔanya nimdeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔne ahokafo adi nkitaho yiye na wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So LGBTQ+ ankorankoro wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow a ɛfa akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ne ayaresa ho?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ ankorankoro wɔ mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow a ɛfa akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ne ayaresa ho, ɛwom sɛ hokwan ahorow yi betumi ayɛ soronko de. Wɔ aman pii mu no, mmara bara nyiyim a egyina nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu. LGBTQ+ ankorankoro wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔrenhyia nyiyim anaa atemmuo, na wɔtaa hwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ de ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu na ɛsi so dua ma LGBTQ+ ayarefoɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkrasɛm pa a yebetumi aka afa nna mu apomoden ho no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Momma yɛntrɛw nkrasɛm pa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho, te sɛ: Nna mu akwahosan ho hia ma obiara. Sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ nna mu yareɛ ho a, ɛyɛ asɛyɛde ho sɛnkyerɛnne. nna mu yareɛ yɛ nea wotumi sa na ɛnkyerɛkyerɛ wo mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow, nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun so betumi adi wɔ nneɛma a, atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, nneyɛe a, ɛnyɛ nea ɛmma nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, ne sɛnea mmabun tumi gyina tebea ahorow ano wɔ nsɛnnennen a ɛfa wim nsakrae ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Adesua nhyehyeɛ a wɔde bɛka abom: Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua ho de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate wim nsakraeɛ, ne nea ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ho. Mmabun a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi denam dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua ho, akuw, ne nnwuma a wɔde wɔn adwene si nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔbɛkora so ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano so. Mpɔtam Hɔ Nnwuma: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛyɛ adwuma abom de nneyɛeɛ ne nnwuma a ɛnyɛ nea ɛmma nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, te sɛ nnua dua ne nwura a wɔde di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na awofo betumi afa so adi nsɛmti a ɛhia tema anaa akyinnyegye nsem ho mfonini wɔ media mu, te sɛ nna, basabasayɛ, nnuro a wɔde di dwuma, ne adwenemyare ho dwuma wɔ akwan a ɛfata mfe a mmabun adi na ɛma denhyɛ so?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wobefi ase ne wɔ abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛmu da hɔ na ɛnyɛ atɛnbu, nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma, na wɔabua nsɛmmisa wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata wɔn mfe a wɔadi na ɛyɛ nokware so. Nsusuii a ɛyɛ katee ne adwene a wɔfa ho nkuranhyɛ denam adwene ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne amammerɛ ahorow a wɔayɛ ho mfonini wɔ media mfonini ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu no so. Mmabun media a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn so na wɔakyerɛ wɔn kwan akɔ nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi a ɛne wɔn nkɔso ahiade ne abusua gyinapɛn ahorow hyia so. Nkitahodi akwan a emu da hɔ a wɔde besi hɔ na wɔahyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔada wɔn nsusuii, atenka, ne wɔn haw ahorow adi wɔ media a ɛho hia ho a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a eye na ɛnya nkɛtɛnso pa wɔ nna mu apɔwmuden ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ mfoni ahorow a ɛyɛ animtiaabu anaa epira ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsempa ne nkuranhyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho nkwa mu nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔ dawuro: Pene a obi pene so ne nnamfofa a ɛmu yɛ den. Obi ho a ɔgye to mu ne animuonyam a ɛda nkyekyem foforo adi wɔ ahoɔfɛ ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ na ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna ho nkwa mu asɛmti horow ho. Saa nsɛm yi hyɛ nnipa nyinaa baakoyɛ, obu ne anigyeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu den, na ɛyɛ soronko koraa wɔ nsɛm a ɛde aniwu ba anaa ɛsɛe nnipa din a ɛhyɛ nyiyim ne aniwu nkyerɛkyerɛ mu den no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ sɛ mepa eduro no nom bi, anaasɛ kɔndɔm no mu pae, anaasɛ mehyia ɔhaw foforo biara bere a merefa awoɔ ntentenee kwan biara so no?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ sɛ wuhyia nsɛm bi wɔ wo nnuru a wode siw nyinsɛn ano ho ni: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn a wannom bere bi: Di akwankyerɛ pɔtee a ɛwɔ aduro no krataa so no akyi, anaasɛ hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ firi w'apɔwmuden  mu dwumayɛni hɔ fa aduro a woannya amnom no ho. Sɛ kɔndɔm mu pae: Twa wo ho firi mu ntɛm ara na fa foforo hyɛ mu. Sɛ wosuro sɛ wobɛnyinsɛn a, fa aduro a wɔnom ntɛm ara de siw nyinsɛn kwan ho adwene. Nsɛm afoforo: Sɛ wowɔ dadwen biara fa kwan a woapaw so no ho a, kasa kyerɛ w'apɔwmuden mu dwumayɛni. Kae: Aniwu biara nni ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa. W’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafoɔ wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa wo na wadi nsɛm biara a wobɛhyia ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan horow bɛn na wɔfa so hyɛ nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ne amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akuw ahorow ntam?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wobɛyɛ ahwɛyie na wakyerɛ obuo. Afotu bi ni: Fa Adwene a Wobom Fi ase: Fa w’adwene si gyinapɛn ahorow a wokyɛ te sɛ ɔdɔ, obu, ne abusua so. Fa Nidi Kyerɛkyerɛ: Kyɛ nna a ahoɔden wom ne sebi dɛmdi hokwan ahorow ho nsɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu so. Hwehwɛ Ayɔnkofo: Wo ne nyamesom akannifo anaa amammerɛ mu nnipa a wɔabue wɔn ani ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ne sebi dɛmdi ho no nni nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwanside ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛmma wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe esiane akyirikyiri anaa beae a akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ nti?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akyirikyiri anaa beae a akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow wɔ no betumi de akwanside ahorow pii aba akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi anya mu, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwan ahodoɔ a anaa kaa a wodebɛkɔ hɔ no yɛ asɛm, titiriw wɔ nkuraase anaa mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri. Akwantu tenten ne ɛka a ɛbata ho, te sɛ kaa ho ka. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobenya ayaresabea a won dwumadie yɛ soronko a ɛbɛn wɔn gye deɛ ɛwɔ akyirikyiri nkutoo. Ɔhaw a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wonni wɔn ankasa kaa anaasɛ wɔde wɔn to akwan foforɔ so a wɔde bɛkɔ so, te sɛ awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ma wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe bere a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn wɔ bere a wobetumi anya no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw bi a ɛma obi nya abusuabɔ pa, te sɛ nkitahodie, ahotoso, ne obu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi, ahotoso, ne obuo yɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia ma abusuabɔ pa. Nkitahodi a etu mpɔn hwehwɛ sɛ wobɛda wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne w’ahiade adi pefee bere a woretie wo hokafo na wote ase no. Wɔnam nokwaredi, ahotoso, ne nea ɛda adi pefee so na ɛma ahotoso. Nea ɛka obu ho ne sɛ yɛbɛma yɛn ho yɛn ho adwene, ahye, ne ahofadi a obi wɔ sɛ ɛsom bo. Saa nneɛma yi na ɛyɛ fekubɔ a emu yɛ den na ɛyɛ papa fapem.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ aduroyɛ mu yare bi a na ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a, so metumi akɔ so anyinsɛn dwoodwoo? (wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusu ho)
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ ayaresa tebea bi a woadi kan anya a, wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa. Sɛ wohwɛ wo yie a, ebia wobɛda so ara anya nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom: Afotuo a wɔde ma ansa na woanyinsɛn: Sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo di kan susuw w’akwahosan ne nyinsɛn nhyehyɛe ho a, ebetumi aboa ma woahu asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba na woayɛ nyinsɛn ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu mmabun mmoa kuw 'peer support groups' wɔ me sukuu mu ne me mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Bisa sukuu afotufoɔ (counselors) anaa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Kɔhu mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa mmabun mmeammea (youth centers). Hwehwɛ intanɛt so ne abɛɛfo ntentan so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de m’awofoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no ahyɛ m’akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu bere a meda so ara kura me ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: W’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo a wode wɔn ho bɛhyɛ w’akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu bere a wokura w’ahofadi ne kokoam nsɛm mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi nkitaho pefee nna wode ahyeɛ sisi hɔ. Akwan bi ni: Di nkitaho pefee: Wo ne w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo nsusuw w’akwahosan ho ahiade ne nea wopɛ ho wɔ obu ne ɔkwan a ɛda adi pefee so. Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a wote nka sɛ ɛyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wode bɛma w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo ne baabi a wobɛpɛ sɛ wokora kokoam nsɛm so no mu pefee. Kamfo wo ho: Fa hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wusi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ w’akwahosan ho no so dua na kyerɛ nea wopɛ wɔ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ ɛnyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wo ne w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo bɛbɔ nsɛmti bi ho nkɔmmɔ a, susuw ho sɛ wode ɔpanyin foforo a wugye wo di te sɛ wo busuani, w’abusua adamfo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛka ho. Hwehwɛ kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow mu: Hu kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun na wo ne w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo nsusuw ho na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ mo ne mo ho mo ho bɛte ase. Fa wo ho hyɛ mu nkakrankakra: Fa w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo ka w’akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho nkakrankakra, fi ase fi nsɛmti a ɛnyɛ den pii so na bere kɔ so no, wubenya ahotoso. Awiei koraa no, ɛsɛ sɛ dodow a awofo de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ w’akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu no gyina w’ankorankoro ahiade, nea wopɛ, ne ahotɔ dodow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nsɛm ne nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa nna mu nkɔso ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet ahorow: Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a wogye di te sɛ Planned Parenthood, Scarleteen, anaa Sex, Etc. Nhoma: Nhomakorabea ahorow taa wɔ nhoma ahorow a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Sukuu: Sukuu afotufo anaa ayarehwɛfo betumi de nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware ama. Hotlines: Kasedibea te sɛ 'Teen Health Source' ma mmoa ne nsɛm a wɔmmɔ din ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nwomasua ne adwuma nteteeɛ boa akuo a eye mmabun a wɔ hia neaɛma sokoronko ne ohaw ahorow, atubrafo, anaa wɔn a wɔte beae a ntawantawa wɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛeɛ aa ama ne mu so te sɛ senea aborɔfo ka no 'STEM' ne 'vocational training' se ɛbɛ adrɛse mmabun kuokuo ahohia soronko ne ɔhaw. Nea wokaho yɛ: atufrafo a bronni bɛkasɛ 'refugee anaa immigrant' ne wɔn a wɔte beae a ntawantawa wɔ mu.Dwumadie suronko betumi ama kasa mmoa a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'language support',  'trauma-informed education', ne amammerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwan a yɛbetumi di mmabun ahyɛ adesua ne broni bɛkasɛ 'vocational systems' kɛseɛ no mu. Ebiom, mpɔtɛm nkuokuo ne 'NGOs' a wɔwɔ apɔmmuden mu tan mma mmoa ne nkitahodi ma mmabun a ɔmo ani si so a ɔmo hwehwɛ nwomasua ne 'vocational training' ho kwannya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ tiawa ma wɔ sɛnea wɔde nnuru ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano bedi dwuma ho.
answer_twi_source: Mmarima Kɔndɔm: Hwɛ da a ɛbɛtwam ne nea wɔde ahyɛ mu no sɛ ebia biribiara asɛe ansa na wode adi dwuma. Fa ahwɛyiye tetew ade a wɔde ahyɛ mu no mu, na hwɛ yiye na woamfa nneɛma a ano yɛ nnam ansɛe kɔndɔm no. Kura kɔndɔm no ano na woanya baabi ama mmadwoa na woabobɔw akɔ akyi berɛmo a ɛteɛ no so. Bue kɔndɔm no mu kosi ase kosi ɔbarima no dua asore. Sɛ wo ho ba a, kura kɔndɔm no mu wɔ ne nnyinaso na fa ahwɛyiye twe ɔbarima no akyi berɛmo no bere a ɛda so ara gyina hɔ no. Tow kɔndɔm a wode adi dwuma no gu nwura mu. Mfa nsu nkɔ tiafi mu. Mmea Kɔndɔm: Hwɛ da a ɛbɛtwam ne nea wɔde ahyɛ mu no sɛ ebia biribiara asɛe ansa na wode adi dwuma. Fa n’awiei a wɔato mu no kura kɔndɔm no mu na pia mu nkaa no wɔ wo nsateaa kɛse ne wo nsateaa ketewa ntam. Fa kɔndɔm no hyɛ ɔbea no awotwaa no mu, hwɛ hu sɛ emu mprɛte no te awotwaa mu na akyi nkaa no bɛkɔ so atra abɔnten wɔ awotwaa no atifi. Hwɛ sɛ kɔndɔm no nkyinkyim na ɛkata awotwaa no ne akyi awotwaa no fã bi so. Sɛ wo ne obi da wie a, kyinkyim akyi nkaa no ma ɛkata kɔndɔm no so na twe no brɛoo fi ɔbea no awotwaa no mu. Tow kɔndɔm a wode adi dwuma no gu nwura mu. Mfa nsu nkɔ tiafi mu. Nnuru a Wɔde Siw Awo ano: Nom aduru biako bere koro mu da biara, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, fa aduan anaa nsu ka ho na aboa ma woatwe wo ho. Di akwankyerɛ a ɛwɔ aduru adaka no so anaa w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo akwankyerɛ akyi. Sɛ wopa aduru bi a, nom bere a wokae ara pɛ, sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛnom nnuru abien da koro mpo a. Fa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano (te sɛ kɔndɔm) di dwuma nnanson a edi hɔ no. Sɛ wopa nnuru abien anaa nea ɛboro saa a, di akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama wo nnuru a wɔde hyɛ wo ho no akyi anaa kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn. Awo ano aduru: Fa aduru no gu honam ani a ɛho tew na ɛyɛ nwunu wɔ yafunu, akyi, abasa akyi atifi, anaa wo honam ani atifi. Sesa patch no dapɛn biara da koro no ara na ama woakɔ so atu mpɔn. Kwati sɛ wode aduru no bɛto mmeae a nwi, aduru, anaa powder wɔ so. Sɛ aduru no mu yɛ hare anaasɛ ɛhwe ase a, fa foforo si ananmu ntɛm ara. Fa aduru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano (te sɛ kɔndɔm) di dwuma sɛ aduru no adum bɛboro nnɔnhwerew 48 a. Awo a Wɔde Siw Awo So: Ma akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wɔatete no mfa aduru no nhyɛ wo nsa atifi. Nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua no mu no ma wotumi siw nyinsɛn ano mfe abiɛsa kosi anum. Ɛho nhia sɛ wɔyɛ ade da biara da bere a wɔde aduru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua no mu no ahyɛ mu pɛn no. Hwɛ sɛ nea wɔde ahyɛ honam ani no wɔ honam ani hwɛbea no ase daa na ama woatumi atu akɔ baabi foforo anaa. Intrauterine Device (IUD): Ma akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wɔatete no mfa IUD no nhyɛ awotwaa no mu. IUD no ma wosiw nyinsɛn ano mfe pii, a egyina ɔkwan a wɔfa so nyinsɛn no so. Ɛho nhia sɛ wɔyɛ ade da biara da bere a wɔde IUD no ahyɛ mu pɛn no. Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wo daa na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ IUD no da so ara wɔ hɔ na etu mpɔn. Nyinsɛn a Wosiw Ano Ntɛmntɛm (Anɔpa-Akyi Aduru): Fa nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ ntɛm ara bere a woanya nna a wommɔ ho ban akyi, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, wɔ nnɔnhwerew 72 mu. Di akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama wɔ aduru no ho no akyi anaa kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn. Ɛnyɛ nea wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ nni dwuma daa, na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde di dwuma wɔ tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu nkutoo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asuadeɛ bɛn na yɛbɛtumi asua afiri SRH dwumadie a ɛdi mu a wɔde adi dwuma wɔ mmeaeɛ foforɔ a ntawntawdie aka no mu, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔatumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ na wɔayɛ no kɛseɛ de adi mmabun ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsakraeɛ: Wobetumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ SRH dwumadie a ɛdi mu a ɛfiri mmeaeɛ foforɔ a ntawntawdie aka wɔn no mu de adi ahiadeɛ pɔtee ne nsɛnnennen a mmabun hyia wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu no ho dwuma, a wɔsusu amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn, asetena mu nkɔsoɔ, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Nkitahodiɛ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛnya, a mmabun ankasa ka ho, hwɛ sɛ SRH dwumadie no fa nsɛm a ɛfa ho, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ wɔ mmeaeɛ a ntawntawdie aka. Tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu: Sika a wde bɔto ntetee ne tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛfo mu no ma wonya nimdeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma SRH dwumadie no yie, wɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛyɛ den mpo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mihu fa awoɔ nhyehyɛe nipadua ne nipadua ho, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea awo akwaa ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ yɛbɛte awo nhyehyɛe no nipadua ne nipadua mu nkwaadɔm ase a, nea ɛka ho ne sɛ yebehu nea ɛfa: Mmarima Awo Akwaa: Nea ɛka ho ne mmadwoa (a ɛma mmadwoa), awo akwaa yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ epididymis (beae a mmadwoa nyin), vas deferens (a ɛde mmadwoa kɔ), ne ɔbarima akyi berɛmo (a ɛde mmadwoa ma bere a ɔreto mma). Mmea Awo Akwaa: Nea ɛka ho ne mmadwoa (a ɛma nkesua),  awo akwaa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ fallopian tubes (a ɛde nkesua kɔ awotwaa mu), awotwaa (beae a nkesua a wɔahyɛ no ma de nkesua hyɛ nipadua mu na enyin), awotwaa (awotwaa no bue), ne awotwaa (awo kwan ne baabi a ɔne obi da).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwvso fo "mentors" betumi ama mmabun anya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ na wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔasusuw wɔn haw ahorow, nsɛmmisa, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho a wonsuro atemmu, animtiaabu, anaa nyiyim?
answer_twi_source: Afotufo betumi ama mmabun anya baabi a ahobammɔ ne mmoa betumi asusuw wɔn haw ahorow, nsɛmmisa, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, animtiaabu, anaa nyiyim denam: Ahotoso a wɔde besi hɔ: Afotufo nya ahotoso denam kokoamsɛm, tema, ne obu a wɔda no adi ma mmabun nsusuwii ne wɔn atinka ahorow so. Tebea a wɔmfa atemmu nnim a wɔbɛbɔ: Afotufo ma tebea bi a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi pefee, a wonim sɛ wobetie wɔn a wɔrenkasa tia wɔn no nya nkɔso. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata: Afotufo ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no yɛ nea ɛfata, na wɔma mmabun awerɛhyem sɛ wɔn suahu ne wɔn nsɛmmisa no yɛ nea ɛfata na ɛfata sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene si so. Awerɛhyem a wɔde ma "Offering Reassurance": Afotufo de awerɛhyem ma sɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ no yɛ ahoɔden ho sɛnkyerɛnne, na ɛnyɛ mmerɛwyɛ, na wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnkɔ wɔn nkyɛn bere a wohia mmoa no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa akuo anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmoa akuo, afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow, nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa nyinsɛn ne awo hwɛ mu. Saa nneɛma yi de nsɛm, akwankyerɛ, ne atenka fam mmoa ma mmabun a wɔyem ne awofo nkumaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛboa wɔ asetena mu mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ (social protection programs) ho nhwehwɛmu, nsusuwii, ne nnyigyeiɛ (advocacy) mu, na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no hyia wɔn haw ne wɔn hokwan a ɛresakra daa no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi aboa denam: Dɔm mmabun kuo anaa 'boards'. Kɔ nhyiamu (forums) a aban anaa aban ananmusifoɔ akuw (NGOs) yɛ de ma adwene. Fa social media yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne 'advocacy'. Wɔne nhwehwɛmufoɔ (researchers) nnyɛ adwuma de hwɛ sɛdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no rekɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu amanneɛ bɛn na ɛfa mpanin mu kɔ ho a ɛsɛ sɛ menya ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Amanneɛ: Amammerɛ bi wɔ amanneɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛkyerɛ mpanin mu kɔ, te sɛ Dipo, bragoro, quinceañeras anaa bar/bat mitzvahs. Afahyɛ: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ betumi ayɛ aduane anaa nhyiam a wɔde kae obi nsakraeɛ. Ntadeɛ: Wɔbetumi ahyɛ amammerɛ mu ntadeɛ anaa ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ mpanin mu kɔ amanneɛ bere mu. Honhom Mu Nneyɛeɛ: Amanneɛ a ɛfa honhom anaa mpaebɔ ho betumi aka mpanin mu kɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ bi mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, mpanyimfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ nimdeɛ ne nyansa a ɛfa mpanin yɛ ho bere a wɔreyɛ panyin.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔka nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne nneɛma ahorow a egu ahorow ho mfonini pa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahyɛ mfonini ahorow a ɛtete saa ho nkuran na wɔaboa?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne nneɛma ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ho mfonini pa betumi ayɛ: TV so dwumadi anaa sini ahorow a ɛkyerɛ nkitahodie pa, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, ne pene a obiara pene so. Social media ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ne pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu na ɛka obiara ho ma a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmabun so. Mmabun betumi ahyɛ mfonini ahorow a ɛte saa ho nkuran na wɔaboa denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm pa a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a ɛkasa tia na ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho adwene pa a wɔbɛkyɛ na wɔama ayɛ kɛse no so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ de gyina nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkuran sɛ wɔmfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini a edi kan na obu wom nni kan. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee na ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nkuran mu kyɛfa a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛkasa yie fa nna mu apɔwmuden 'sexual health' ho bere a obiara kasa kwan yɛ soronko sso de akyerɛ wɔn awofo, ahwɛfo, wɔn yɔnko ne obiara.
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi ayɛ wei wɔ ɔkwan bi te sɛ : Wobetie afoforo adwene kyerɛ na woahu sɛ obiara ne ne kasa kwan. Bisa nteaseɛ (Seeking clarification) - sɛ wonte aseɛ a, wobebisa bisa nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Fa mmoa di dwuma (Resources) - fa nwuma anaa abɛɛfo dwumadi so nneɛma anaa kasa nkyerɛkyerɛmufo aboa nkitahodi a wobedi no ayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi abom adi akwantu akwanside ahorow ho dwuma na wɔama nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi anya no atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi abom adi akwantuo akwansideɛ ho dwuma na wɔama mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛtumi anya no atu mpɔn denam: Wɔbɛyɛ adwuma abom wɔ nnwuma a wɔde bɛtrɛ akwantuo akwan a mmabun bɛtumi apaw mu, te sɛ shuttle ne kaa a wɔde fa nnipa, anaa telehealth a wode bɛn dwuma. Sika ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa akwantuo ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun te sɛ kaa boa a wobɛte so ne ade. Kaa akwantuo ho nsusuiɛ a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ ho, ahwɛ sɛ wɔdi akwantuo akwansideɛ ho dwuma sɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛtrɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ atu mpɔn no fã. Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo, sukuu, ne mmabun ananmusifoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de apɛ mmabun akwantuo ho ahiade ho mmuaeɛ na aboa mmabun wɔberɛ a worehwehwɛ mmoa ɛwɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na pintinn gyinae kyerɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ sɛ obi yɛ anaasɛ ɔyɛ basabasa wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi ne gyinaesi mu?
answer_twi_source: Pintinn gyinae yɛ nkitahodi kwan a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wobɛda w’adwene, wo nkate, ne w’ahiade adi wɔ ɔkwan a emu da hɔ, tẽẽ, na obu wom so bere a wobu afoforo hokwan ne ahyeɛ nso. Ɛsono sɛnea wobɛyɛ obi a ɔnyɛ hwee, baabi a ebia wobɛkwati sɛ wobɛda w’ahiade anaa w’adwene adi na ama ntawntawdi ankɔ so, ne sɛnea wobɛyɛ basabasa, baabi a wubetumi ada w’ahiade adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma woabu w’ani agu hokwan anaa nkate a afoforo wɔ so no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwene a mede si biribi so betumi aboa me ama m’adwene atu mpɔn na mede m’adwene asi biribi so, titiriw bere a wɔreyɛ sɔhwɛ anaa tebea horow a nhyɛso kɛse wom?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu nneyɛe tete w’adwene a wode si biribi so denam kyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo sɛ wode wo nhumu bɛhyɛ mprempren bere yi mu no so. Adwene a wɔde di dwuma daa no betumi ama adwene mu dwumadi ahorow te sɛ adwene a wɔde si biribi so, nkae, ne gyinaesi atu mpɔn. Akwan te sɛ adwene mu home anaa nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu apɔ mu ateneatene betumi aboa ma w’adwene adwo na wode w’adwene asi baabi, na ama ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wode w’adwene besi biribi so bere a woreyɛ sɔhwɛ anaa nhyɛso kɛse tebea horow no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwanside ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba a mmabun hyia wɔ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wobenya ama wɔn nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho no, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow te sɛ hokwan ahorow a wonni ho nimdeɛ, amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, animtiaabu, nyiyim, mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow te sɛ mfe a wɔadi, ne mmara kwan so mmoa a wontumi nnya. Saa akwanside ahorow yi a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ, wɔko ma nkurɔfo, wɔyɛ mmara mu nsakrae, na wɔhyɛ mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So atipɛnfo mmoa akuw yɛ kokoamsɛm, na akwankyerɛ bɛn na wɔde asi hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no yɛ kokoam ne ahobammɔ?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuo taa kura kokoamsɛm mu de ayɛ tebea a ahobammɔ ne ahotoso wom ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no. Wɔayɛ akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ bɛto hɔ, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne apam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de abɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ kuw no mu, adi wɔn ho wɔn ho kokoamsɛm so, na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ ankorankoro ho nsɛm wɔ kuw no akyi. Ahwɛfoɔ nso de mmara a ɛwɔ aseɛ di dwuma de kura kokoamsɛm mu na wɔde anifere di mmara sobuo biara ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STIs) na mɛ yɛ dɛn asiw ano?
answer_twi_source: Nna mu nyarewa (STIs), a broni atwa so sanso frɛ no (STDs) yɛ nyarewa a mpɛn pii no ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so trɛw, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu, akyi berɛmo, anaa anom ka ho. Saa nyarewa yi betumi afi mmoawa, mmoawa, anaa mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbae mu aba, na sɛ wɔansa a, ebetumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba. Nna mu yareɛ 'STI' a ɛtaa ba no bi ne nea broni ka no 'chlamydia', 'gonorrhoea', 'syphilis', 'genital herpes', 'human papillomavirus' (HPV), ne nea broni atwaso ka no 'HIV/AIDS' ayo Akwan bi a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ 'STIs' no ano ni: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho: Ɔkwan a etu mpɔn sen biara a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ  ano ne sɛ wɔne ɔhokafo a ɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ anaa nea wonnim ne STI tebea no bɛtwe ne ho afi nna mu dwumadi (wɔn awotwaa mu, akyi, anaa ano). Fa Kɔndɔm Di Dwuma: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ bere a woreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a, ebetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ  'STI' no so kɛse. Fa nea broni ka no 'latex' anaa 'polyurethane' kɔndɔm di dwuma ma ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna wɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu anaa akyi berɛmo mu, na fa kɔndɔm anaa nsensan a wɔde hyɛ mu di dwuma ma nna a wɔde ano ka. To Nna mu Ahokafo ano hye: Sɛ wunya nna mu ahokafo kakraa bi a, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yareɛ  'STI' ahorow no so. Ɔyere biako a wo ne ɔhokafo a wayɛ nhwehwɛmu ahu sɛ onni 'STI', nna mu yareɛ nso betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ no so. Nkitahodi: Wo ne w’ahokafo a wo ne wɔn da no nkasa pefee na wodi nokware fa nna mu yareɛ, sɔhwɛ, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Hyɛ mo ho mo ho nkuran sɛ wɔnkɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa wɔ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho. Yɛ Sɔhwɛ: Yɛ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho nhwehwɛmu daa, titiriw sɛ wo ne ahokafo pii renya nna mu kyɛfa anaasɛ woanya nna a wɔammɔ ho ban a. 'STI' pii mfa sɛnkyerɛnne biara mma, enti nhwehwɛmu nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ahu wo nna mu yareɛ  'ST'I tebea. Nea broni ka no 'Vaccination': 'Vaccines' a broni ka no wɔ hɔ a wɔde besiw nna mu yareɛ  'STI' ahorow bi ano, te sɛ nea broni ka no 'HPV ne hepatitis B'. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa ho sɛ ebia vaccination no fata wo anaa. Kwati sɛ Wobɛkyɛ Nhama: Sɛ wode nnubɔne a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu di dwuma a, ɛnkyɛ nnade anaa nnubɔne ho nneɛma afoforo da. Nnade a wɔkyɛ no betumi de nna mu yareɛ 'STI' te sɛ 'HIV' ne 'hepatitis B ne C'. Fa Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ahobammɔ De Di Dwuma: Kwati nna mu nneyɛe a asiane kɛse wom, te sɛ nna a wo ne wo hokafo pii bɛbɔ a wommɔ ho ban anaasɛ wo ne obi bɛda bere a woanom nnubɔne anaa nsa. Fa w’adwene a eye sen biara di dwuma na fa w’akwahosan ne ahobammɔ di kan. Akwahosan Ho Nhwehwɛmu a Wɔyɛ Daa: Kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn kɔhwɛ wɔn daa na wɔnyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano. Sɛ wohu nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho sɛnkyerɛnne anaasɛ woahyia nna mu yareɛ 'STI' a, hwehwɛ aduruyɛ ntɛm ara. Ɛdenam nna a ahobammɔ wom a wobɛyɛ, nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ daa, na wo ne w’ahokafo a wo ne wɔn da no adi nkitaho pefee so no, wubetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yareɛ 'STI' so no so na woabɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho ban. Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ano aduru ho a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa nna mu akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bɛkasa de agye akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ mantɔw mu a wɔyɛ de mmabun nna ne awo apwmuden nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mpɛn pii no, nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔyɛ de ma mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden so. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi betumi de kokoam nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade soronko a nea ɛka ho ne afotuo fa nyinsɛn ho nnuro, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmudenn ho nsɛmti ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ den sɛ yɛbɛka a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma me gyinapɛn, gyidie, ne nipasu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobɛnya nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ nkateɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ de nnwuma a ɛfata na ɛyɛ pɛ ma a onipa no bɔbeasu, abusuakuo, asetena mu gyinabea ne afoforo mfa ho. Nhwehwɛmufoɔ: Hwehwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa ayaresabea ahodoɔ a wonim sɛ wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ma nnipa ahodoɔ. Bisa Nsɛm: Ansa na wobɛyɛ nhyehyɛe akɔhwɛ no, bisa osuahu a nea ɔde mmoa ma no wɔ bere a ɔne ankorankoro a wofi wo amammerɛ mu yɛ adwuma ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔte nka wɔ gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ho. Da W’ahiade adi: Ka wo gyinapɛn, wo gyidi, ne wo nipasu kyerɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ayaresabea adwumayɛfo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi asiesie wɔn kwan no ma ɛne w’ahiade ahorow ahyia. Hwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ: Hwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wodi ankorankoro a wofi wo akuw ahorow mu a wɔwɔ ahiade ahorow ho dwuma no hɔ. Fa Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Ma: Sɛ wuhyia amammerɛ mu nkate a enni hɔ wɔ wo nsrahwɛ no mu a, fa nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ ma akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ayaresabea mpanyimfo no de hyɛ nkɔso a ɛba wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara mu nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa awo ho ayaresa ne abusua sie ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa awo ho ayaresa ne abusua sia ma mmabun ho no gu ahorow gyina tumidi ne tebea pɔtee bi so. Wɔ mmeae pii no, ebia mmofra nkumaa bɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu na ama wɔanya awo ho ayaresa anaa abusua kyekye ho akwan horow. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsono mmabun a wɔama wɔn ahofadi anaasɛ wobu wɔn sɛ mmofra nkumaa a wɔn ho akokwaw. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua te mmara mu ahwehwɛde ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ awo ho ayaresa anaa abusua sie akwan ahorow, a nsɛm a ɛfa pene, kokoamsɛm, ne sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde ahorow ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ hwee sɛ megye m’ankasa nna ho akɔnnɔ tum anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho bɔbea kyim?
answer_twi_source: Pɛpɛɛpɛ! Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wobɛpɛ sɛ wuhu wo nna ne wo bɔbeasu. Nhyɛso biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛma woahu ne nyinaa ntɛm ara. Wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa no nkasa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmabun a wokum wɔn ho abu so deɛ, na asiane ahorow bɛn na ebetumi ama mmerante ne mmabaa anya adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛbɛma wɔakum wɔn ho?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wokum wɔn ho yɛ ade titiri a ɛhaw mmabun, na ɛsono sɛnea wɔyɛ no wɔ ɔmantam ne nnipa dodow mu. Asiane a ɛtaa ba ma mmerante ne mmabaa nya adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛma wokum wɔn ho ne adwenemyare (te sɛ adwenemhaw anaa dadwen), nnuro a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, osuahu ahorow a ɛyɛ awerɛhow (te sɛ ayayade), abusua mu ntawntawdi, anaasɛ dwumadi a ɛnkɔ yiye, abusuabɔ mu nsɛm, LGBTQ+ nipasu, ne akwan a wɔfa so kum wɔn ho a wobenya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa awo akwahosan "reproductive health" ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri ka nneɛma ahodoɔ ho, te sɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛdi kan, dwumadie a wɔde siw ano (te sɛ nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban ne nhwehwɛmu), adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa, nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotuo, ne asetena mu nnwuma (te sɛ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so anaa adan ho). Saa dwumadie yi boa awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma mmabun denam nneɛma a ɛka wɔn awoɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ, te sɛ adwenemyareɛ, asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan, ne nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛnya no so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, adwenemyare ho mmoa betumi adi nsɛm te sɛ adwenemhaw anaa dadwen a ebetumi aka awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ho dwuma, bere a nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma mmabun nya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛpaw wɔn awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛka wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan mu, ankorankoro ne kuw nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro, mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu denam nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, wɔn akwahosan ho nneɛma a wɔde nea broni ka no 'informed choices', ne wɔn ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛkasa ma akyerɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no so. Sɛ wɔka bom a, wobetumi akɔka ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di anim ho, de wɔn ho ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo adi nkitaho, na wɔaboa ma wɔayɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow na wɔde adi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ akuo ahorow di mmabun akuw ahorow ahiade pɔtee ho dwuma, te sɛ LGBTQ+ mmabun anaa wɔn a wofi mmusua a wonnya sika pii mu? (Fa w’adwene si nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ne pɛyɛ so)
answer_twi_source: Nnwuma a εfa Amammerɛ mu: Wɔde dwumadie a εfa amammerɛ ahodoɔ, nyamesom ahodoɔ ho Nkɔmmɔdie Dwumadie: Wɔde nsiyɛ kɔ mpɔtam a wɔnnya mmoa yie de hwɛ sɛ obiara bɛnya ASRH ho nsɛm ne nneɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mma ne mma nna ne mmarima ne mmarima nna 'LGBTQ+'?
answer_twi_source: mma ne mma nna ne mmarima ne mmarima nna 'LGBTQ+' yɛ ntiatia-mu-sɛm a ɛgyina hɔ ma mmaa a wɔne mmaa da, mmarima a wɔne mmarima da, wɔn a wɔne mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa da, wɔn a wɔasesa wɔn bɔbe, ne nea broni ka no 'Queer' ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ su foforo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ sɛ ababun, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mede bɛsua pii?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woyɛ ababun no, wubetumi anya awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ afiri mmeae ahohoɔ: Sukuu Mu Nhyehyɛeɛ: Sukuu pii wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛfata mfeɛ a ɛkasa fa nneɛma bi te sɛ nsabuo, nna mu ahobammɔ mu nneɛma, nna mu yareɛ ho bammɔ, ne penee a wɔpene so ho nsɛm. Mpɔtam Hɔ Apɔmuden Mmeae: Ayaresabea ne apɔmuden mmeae betumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam, afutuo dwumadie, ne nneɛma a ɛfa awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho. Ntentanfidie So Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet (Websites), hwɛtie, ne nkitahodie mmeaeɛ ma awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho nsɛm wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo na ɛyɛ mmerɛ so (GHS -YMK app no a wɔde di dwuma). Nwoma ahodoɔ: Nwoma pii wɔ hɔ a wɔatwerɛ ama mmabun a ɛfa awoɔ mu apɔmuden, mpanin mu kɔ, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahotoso sɛ megyina m’ankasa me ne me gyinapɛn akyi bere a m’atipɛnfo nhyɛso ahyia no?
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso a wubenya wɔ wo ho ne wo gyinapɛn a wubegyina akyi no gye sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu na woahu wo ho. Fi ase denam wo gyinapɛn ahorow ne nea ɛho hia wo kɛse a wubehu so. Fa nnamfo a wɔboa wo a wobu w’ahye no twa wo ho hyia. Fa asɛm a wɔka sie di dwuma denam tebea horow a wo ne ɔpanyin anaa w’adamfo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wobɛyɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ HIV anaasɛ wɔwɔ asiane mu sɛ wobenya HIV, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya saa nneɛma yi?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ HIV anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ asiane mu sɛ wobenya HIV no bi ne apɔwmuden ho dwumadie, afotuo, mmoa akuo, HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa mmeaeɛ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ telefon so, intanɛt so nneɛma te sɛ YMK app, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔko ma apɔwmuden ho asɛm. Saa nneɛma yi a wobɛnya no betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wode apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛkɔ akɔma wo, mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ wɔn, anaa wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ intanɛt so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nea efi abusuabɔ a ɛnteɛ mu ba, a nkate, nipadua, ne adwene mu akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso ka ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn yiyedi ne ahobammɔ adi kan?
answer_twi_source: Nea efi abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa mu ba no betumi ayɛ: - Nkate mu Nsunsuanso: Awerɛhow, dadwen, obu a ɛba fam wɔ ne ho, ne tew a ɔtew ne ho esiane nsakrae, tumidi, anaa nkate mu ayayade nti. - Nipadua mu Nsunsuansoɔ: Nipadua mu opira a ɛfiri basabasayɛ anaa basabasayɛ mu ba wɔ abusuabɔ no mu, ne akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfa adwennwene ho. - Adwene mu Akwahosan Nsunsuansoɔ: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obi bɛnya adwenemhaw, adwenemhaw a ɛba wɔ adwenemhaw akyi (PTSD), ne adwenemyareɛ foforɔ a ɛnam bere tenten a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneɛma a ɛnyɛ papa mu nti. - Asetena mu Nsunsuansoɔ: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi asetena mu dwumadiɛ ho, nnamfofa a ɛyɛ den, ne ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛgye afoforo adi ɛnam osuahu bɔne a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ no mu nti. Mmabun betumi de wɔn yiyedi ne ahobammɔ adi kan denam abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa ho sɛnkyerɛnne a wobehu, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne ahye a wɔde besi hɔ de abɔ wɔn ho ban afi ɔhaw foforo ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne me nnamfo, m’atipɛnfo, anaa m’adɔfo atena wɔ asomdwoe mu berɛ a yɛnkɔ tipɛn koro a ɛrenha me gyiedie?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ w’ahye ne wo nnamfo, w’atipɛnfo, anaa w’adɔfo de bɔ abira a, ɛho hia sɛ wode wo gyinapɛn ne wo ahofadi di kan bere a wususuw afoforo adwene nso ho no. Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte nea enti a wɔyɛ wɔn ahye no ase na fa obu ka w’ankasa w’ahiade ne ahye ho asɛm. Hwehwɛ apam anaa ano aduru foforo a ɛkyerɛ obu ma obiara ahofadi ne ne yiyedi. Sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa nneɛma a wowɔ mu ahotoso hɔ na ama woatumi adi tebea no mu yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho no betumi ahaw me ne afoforo ntam abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Animtiaabu a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho no betumi aka wo ne afoforo ntam abusuabɔ wɔ akwan bi so: Suro a wusuro sɛ wɔbɛpow: Ebia wobɛhaw wo ho sɛ wo hokafo bebu wo atɛn. Abusuabɔ mu nhyɛso: Nna mu nyarewa (STI) a wɔbɛda no adi no betumi de adwennwen aba abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na yɛbɛtumi afa so afi nna mu apɔmuden ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ase a ɛrenyɛ aniwuo anaa ɛremma wonnyɛ basaa?
answer_twi_source: Fa aserew sɛe tebea no, nanso hwɛ yiye na woammubu nkɔmmɔbɔ no hia a ɛhia no. Fa nsɛm a ɛfa ho anaa amanneɛbɔ bi di dwuma de fi asɛm no ase na hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase. Fa anigyeɛ ne adwene a ebue kɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu, gye tom sɛ ebetumi ama wo ayɛ basaa mfiaseɛ no nanso si nkitahodiɛ no hia a ɛhia no so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi akasakasa a me ne m’abusuafo anaa me nnamfonom ntam wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Wobue Mu: Fa obu bɔ nkɔmmɔ ahorow, tie na te ase sen sɛ wubegye akyinnye. Hwehwɛ Nneɛma a Wɔbom Yɛ de de siw nsonsonoe ano. Nhomasua mu Nneɛma: Kyɛ nsɛm anaa nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so de boa w’adwene. Tema: Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wubehu tebea no wɔ wɔn adwene mu, na gye tom sɛ obiara wɔ osuahu soronko. Mpene so sɛ Worennye Ntom: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ yebegye nsonsonoe atom a yɛmmɔ mmɔden sɛ yɛbɛsakra yɛn ho yɛn ho adwene. Boundaries: Sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no yɛ nea ɛnyɛ dɛ a, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubegye w’ahome anaasɛ wobɛsan ahwɛ asɛmti no akyiri yi. Ntamgyinafo: Sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ na ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ntetee ne nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nya na ama wɔate amammerɛ mu nneɛma a ebetumi anya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so nkɛntɛnso no ase na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ hwɛ sɛ wɔn dwumadie no yɛ amammerɛ mu nkateɛ na ɛbu amammerɛ ahodoɔ, gyidie, ne nneyɛeɛ ahodoɔ denam amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ nteteeɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔbɛfa so. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn ayarefo amammerɛ ahorow ase na wɔabu wɔn, ahu nkɛntɛnso a amammerɛ nya wɔ akwahosan ho gyidi ne nneyɛe so, na wɔasakra wɔn nkitahodi ne ɔhwɛ ho akwan horow ma ɛne no ahyia. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhomasua a ɛkɔ so ne wɔn ho a wosusuw ho mu na ama wɔate wɔn ankasa amammerɛ mu animhwɛ ne adwemmɔne ase yiye na wɔayɛ adwuma de ɔhwɛ a ɛka ayarefo nyinaa ho na wobu wɔn nyinaa ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ho hia wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi pa boa ma wɔda nkate adi, srɛ mmoa, na ɛma wonya abusuabɔ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na media nsɛm bɔne tesɛ mpa mu agorɔ bɔne, didie basabasa, nnipdua ho fɛw bu ne abusuabɔ bɔne sɛe mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ fɛ anaa didie bɔne. Gyidie wɔ woho a ɛkɔ fam. nna mu nnema bɔne. Atoro efa nna ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn na wobetumi de adi dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ amanaman ntam sika a wɔde ma ASRH no bɛkɔ so atra hɔ na akɔ so aboa akwahosan mu nkɔso a ɛbɛkyɛ ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi aboa sika a wɔde bɛma ASRH a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa denam sika a wɔde bɛma no ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma, bɔhyɛ ahorow a wɔde bɛma bere tenten, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den no so. Kasa ne sikasɛm a wɔde yɛ nneɛma foforo nso betumi aboa ma nhyehyɛe ahorow akɔ so bere tenten.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ehu anaa nneɛma a ɛhaw nkurɔfo a wɔtaa suro wɔ sɛnea wobepue no ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Suro anaa dadwen a wɔtaa suro wɔ sɛ wobepue ho ne abusuabɔ a wɔbɛhwere ne ahobammɔ ho haw. Ɛho hia sɛ wudi saa dadwen ahorow yi ho dwuma denam mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro ne afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wodwen wo yiyedi ho ankasa hɔ no so. Bio nso, sɛ wode nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo ho no gu ahorow wɔ atubrafo ne ahɔho mpɔtam ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka mmabun SRH nneyɛe ne wɔn gyinaesi ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne ahyɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo ho no gu ahorow wɔ atubrafo ne ahɔho mpɔtam ahorow mu na ebetumi anya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneyɛe ne gyinaesi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Amammerɛ mu nkɔso ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase na wɔabu wɔn no ho hia na ama wɔadi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma yiye na wɔama akwahosan pa aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn na ɛsɛ se me yɛ wɔ berɛ a wɔrehyɛ me ama madi mpaso agorɔ a mempɛ?
answer_twi_source: Hu tebea no : Tie woakoma.Sɛ ɛnyɛ a ɛnyɛ. So wo ho dua: Ka sɛ 'daabi' anaa sɛ 'gyae' . Firi hɔ: firi adi wɔberɛkuro a wahu basabasayɛ betumi asi. Hwehwɛ mmoa: hwehwɛ mmoa firi nnamfoɔ a wowɔ wɔn mu gyedie, abusua, apɔmdenfoɔ anaasɛ afutufoɔ hɔ. Amanebɔ: Ma mpayinfoɔ aso nte sɛ nneɛma nko yie a. Sɛ sabi wo ho te kyema kakra a bɔ wo ho ban, hwehwe mmoa firi afoforɔ hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wɔbɛtrɛw mu na wɔatu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a wɔbɛtrɛw mu na wɔatu mpɔn wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam: Nhumu a wɔbɛma akɔ so: Mmabun, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn wɔ hia a mmabun adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow ho hia ne mfaso a ɛde ma mmerante ne mmabaa ne ɔmanfo a wɔdɔɔso no ho. Wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Yɛne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, nnwuma, sukuu, ne aban nnwumakuo bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ahunu ahiadeɛ, nneɛma a ɛhia titiriw, ne hokwan ahodoɔ a ɛbɛma mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne adwumayɛ ho nteteeɛ atu mpɔn. Nsɛm a wɔde bɛma: Wɔn adwene, wɔn suahunu, ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no so ahwɛfoɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔyɛ, ne wɔn a wɔde sika ma no de abɔ mmabun adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho nhyehyɛɛ, dwumadie, ne nhwehwɛmu ho amanneɛ. Mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano: Mmoa a wɔbɛboaboa ano afiri atipɛnfoɔ, awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ hɔ denam ɔsatuo a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban, adesrɛ, nkrataa a wɔde kɔma nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, anaa ɔmanfoɔ nhyiamu ne nhyiamu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Pɛyɛ a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban: Nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ, nkabom, ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran wɔ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu ntetee mu, a wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ mmerante ne mmabaa nyinaa benya hokwan ahorow pɛpɛɛpɛ, a tebea a wofi mu anaa tebea horow mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na apɔmuden mu nyiyim ne pɛ a wɔnnyɛ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mu wɔ, wɔ wiase apɔmuden ne mpontuo botaeɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Apɔmuden mu nyiyim ne pɛ a wɔnnyɛ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mu wɔ nsunsuansoɔ kɛse wɔ wiase apɔmuden ne mpontuo botaeɛ ho, a apɔmuden mmoa a obiara bɛnya, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ, ne mpontuo a ɛtena hɔ daa ka ho. Ebetumi ama nkurɔfoɔ anya apɔmuden, atew apɔmuden ka so, ama adwumayɛfoɔ ayɛ adwuma yiye, na ama asetena mu nkabom ne pɛyɛ ayɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ HIV anaa STI foforɔ so?
answer_twi_source: Mmara gu ahorow. Pii hwehwɛ sɛ woka kyerɛ wo hokafoɔ. Sɛ obi di nkogu a, ebetumi ama wɔabɔ wɔn sobo wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho. Asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ sɛ wɔyɛ ahwɛyie (kɔndɔm/nnuru/aduruyɛ ho afotuo). Bɔ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no amanneɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkuran na wɔte awoɔ mu haw so ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hyɛ awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkuran na wɔte awoɔ mu haw ho nsɛm a ɛba mmabun mu so no bi ne: Wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mũ bedi dwuma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ bragorɔ, nyinsɛn ano siw, STI a wosi ano, ne peneyɛ. Awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔanya, a kokoam afotuo, nyinsɛn a anosiw, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ahokokwaw, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma asi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu agodie ne yiedie ho. Asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden te sɛ ohia, nhomasua a wonnya, ne animtiaabu a ɛma nsonsoneɛ ba awoɔ mu no ho dwuma a wobedi. Mpɔtam a wɔboa, a abusua mmoa, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nnwumapa mu, a ɛhyɛ suban ne nneyɛe pa a ɛfa nna, mpenatweɛ, ne awoɔ pa ho nkuran a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso. Peer eductaors a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ awoɔ pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ ho nkuran na edi nneɛma a ɛde apomoden mu nsonsonoe ba wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan mu no ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa afa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ ho nkuran na edi nea ɛde apomoden mu nsonsonoe ba wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu no ho dwuma denam nhumu a wɔbɛma anya, wɔn suahu ahorow a wɔbɛkyɛ, ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu, wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛbɔ, mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mpɔtam hɔfo adwene akannifo bɛyɛ, ne akontaabu a wɔhwehwɛ fi aban ne ahyehyɛde ahorow hɔ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akokoaa nyin wɔ awotwaa/ yafunu mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkosua a ɛne bɛrima mu nsuo ehyia no, fa fallopian tube no mu kɔtɔ awotwaa no mu. Akokoaa a ɔnhyɛɛ aseɛ nnyiniiɛ yie no (Embryo) nya aduane firi ɛna no mogya mu nam akwaa titiriw bi a yɛfrɛ no placenta (nyinsɛn mu nsuo anaa ntonko) so. Bɛyɛ nnawɔtwe aduanan mu no, embryo no nyin na ɔsesa bɛyɛ akokoaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdena kwan so na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a yɛde sie no mu bere a wɔde mmoa ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo apomoden ho nsɛm mu no?
answer_twi_source: Asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ sɛ yɛde nsɛm sie. Mmfa nsɛm nkyerɛ obiara gye sɛ obi bɛyɛ obi bɔne.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye atum afi mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhwehwɛmu mu no hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo nya pene a wɔanya nimdeɛ fi mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn  mmara kwan so no hɔ ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu: Wɔde nsɛm a emu da hɔ na ntease wom ma wɔ atirimpɔw, akwan horow, asiane ahorow, ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu no so ho, na ama mmabun atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn kyɛfa a wobenya no ho. Fa kasa ne akwan horow a ɛfata mfe a obi adi di dwuma de di nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ, hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛte ase na brɛ nhyɛso anaa nkɛntɛnso a ɛnsɛ ase. Di hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpow anaasɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho bere biara wɔ adesua no mu, a ɛho nhia anaasɛ nea enye biara nni ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo mmoa ne nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim betumi adi wɔ adwenemyare ho nkɔso pa a ɛbɛba wɔ nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden  ho nkyerɛkyerɛ tebea horow mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa ne atipɛnfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ dwuma titire wɔ adwenemyareɛ pa a ɛfiri mu ba wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwaa apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ tebea mu. Atipɛnfo betumi de tema, ntease, ne mmoa a wɔde ka ho ama, na ɛtew nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔatew wɔn ho no so na ama wɔate nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea. Nneɛma a atipɛnfo di anim, te sɛ mmoa akuw anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde ma nkurɔfo te ase no ma mmabun tumi ma wɔkamfo wɔn adwenemyare ho ahiade ahorow kyerɛ na wɔyɛ mpɔtam a wɔboa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ menya nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ (anɔpa-akyi aduru) sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru no adi nkogu anaasɛ me ne obi bɛda a wɔmfa ahobammɔ nni dwuma a?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wunya anɔpa aduru a wɔde di dwuma akyi no ntɛmntɛm a, wubetumi akɔ nnurutɔnbea dodow no ara mu wɔ mmɔnten so na woatɔ wɔ aduruyɛdan mu. Wɔtaa de Levonorgestrel (ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔfrɛ no Levonelle) ne ellaOne nyinaa ma. Ɛsɛ sɛ wo ne nnuruyɛfo bi kasa fa w’akwahosan ho ansa na woanya wo nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ. Akwahosan Ho Dwumadifo: Kɔ ayaresabea ahorow, ayaresabea ahorow, anaa nnuruyɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛ mu. Akwahosan adwumayɛbea dodow no ara de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ara ma. Awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, yɛ kokoamsɛm. Mmoa: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ ɛho hia a. Di adwumayɛfoɔ di nkitaho wɔ telefon a wɔde telefon so a 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma) ne PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beaeɛ (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Atosɛm akɛse a nkurɔfo gye di wɔ awo nhyenhyɛe a broni frɛ no 'birth control' ano aduru ho no bi ne dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Atosɛm a wɔtaa ka no bi ni: Awo ano aduru ma wo mu duru a broni frɛ no 'birth control' yɛ kɛse. (Ɛnyɛ nokware bere nyinaa) Kɔndɔm brɛ anigye ase. (Asɛmti, hwehwɛ akwan horow a wobɛfa so!) "Twe-firi mut" kwan no tu mpɔn. (Ɛnyɛ nea wotumi de ho to so koraa, paw ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so!) Sɛ woyera aduru biako a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ nyinsɛn betumi aba ntɛm ara. (Mpɛn pii no ɛnte saa, di a broni frɛ no "missed pill" akwankyerɛ akyi.) Awo ano aduru ma ɛyɛ den sɛ wubenyinsɛn akyiri yi. (Akwan dodow no ara yɛ nea wotumi dannan.)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asetena mu mmoa ahorow bɛn na ɛho hia ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a wobenya mu?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu mmoa ahodoɔ a ɛho hia a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nsɛm a wɔbɛnya mu no bi ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, abusua nkitahodiɛ ne akwankyerɛ, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ, ne afotuo dwumadie a ɛde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma a wɔmfa atemmuo mma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea obi bɛtumi anya mmoa, mmara kwan so  ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfoɔ ho dwumadie bi wɔ hɔ, na hokwan bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ peneɛ ne kokoamsɛm ho berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mfeɛ a ɛhyɛ anohyira ne kyɛfa a obi wɔ sɛ ɔnya mmara mu mmoa ne kwan-ma-ho (advocacy) dwumadie no gyina ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa dwumadie biara ne ne mmara so. Mpɛn pii no, mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔn ara hwehwɛ mmara mu mmoa sɛ wɔadi mfeɛ dodoɔ bi a mmara piri (titiriw sɛ wɔadi mfeɛ dudu-nsia (16) anaa deɛ ɛboro saa a). Nanso, mmara a ɛfa obi penedie ne kokoam nsɛm ho no bɛtumi asesa wɔ aman ahodoɔ mu. Sɛ yɛhwɛ no nyinaa a, mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔn nsɛm yɛ kokoam wɔ berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ mmara mu mmoa, na ɛyɛ mmaranimfoɔ asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn akwanhwefoɔ kokoam nsɛm ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne yiyedi?
answer_twi_source: Asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyeɛ yɛ nnwuma a aban, ahyehyɛdeɛ, anaa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ de di dwuma de mmoa a egyina sikasɛm, honam fam, anaa dwumadi so ma ankorankoro anaa akuo a wɔn ho yɛ den wɔ ɔmanfoɔ mu. Wɔho hia ma mmabun bere a wɔde mmoa akwan horow ma de di sikasɛm ne asetra mu nsɛnnennen ahorow a wohyia te sɛ ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, adwuma a wonnya nyɛ, ne akwahosan ho asiane ahorow ho dwuma no. Asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow boa ma mmabun nya sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne yiyedi denam hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ma wonya nnwuma a ɛho hia, ɛtew mmerɛwyɛ ahorow so, ne wɔn hokwan ne nidi a wɔma ɛkɔ so no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ pɛyɛ ne nnipa nyinaa nkabom ho nkuran wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu na makamfo abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa a ɛkɔ so wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Pɛyɛ ne nkabom a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no hwehwɛ sɛ wohunu na wobu nnipa ahodoɔ, suahunu, ne adwene ahorow a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ ne mpɔtam mu. Kasa tia nsusuwii hunu ne adwemmɔne, na yɛ adwuma denneennen de yɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho a obiara te nka sɛ ɛsom bo na wobu no. Ko tia nyiyim, na bɔ mmɔden pa ara sɛ wobɛyɛ baabi a ɛyɛ na obiara nka bi na ɔnte nka sɛ ɔsom bo na wɔbu no. Di nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwan a ɛma mmaa ne mmarima pɛyɛ, nna mu kyɛfa ne atɛntrenee ba amansan mu no akyi. Kasa tia nyiyim, ɔtaa, ne amumɔyɛ, na boa mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kyerɛ afoforo nneyɛe a ɛma ayɔnkofa mu yɛ den, ɔpɛ ne anidahɔ, ne obu a ɛwɔ obiara mu. Fa wo ho yɛ nhwɛsoɔ pa wɔ w’ankasa w’ayɔnkofa mu na hyɛ afoforo nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ saa ara.a
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara bɛn na ɛfa awofo pene anaa amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ awo ho akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛnea tumidi te?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛfa awofoɔ tumidie anaa amanneɛbɔ ho mmerɛ a mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) rehwehwɛ nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa no gu ahorow gyina baabi a wowɔ.Mmeaeɛ bi hwehwɛ sɛ awofoɔ ma kwan anaa wɔbɔ wɔn amanneɛ ansa na wɔanya mmoa bi, te sɛ nyinsɛn-tu anaa nyinsɛn ho banbɔ nnuru. Nanso, mmeaeɛ afoforɔ nso ma kwan ma mmaayewa nya saa mmoa yi wɔ kokoam mu a awofoɔ nnim. Saa mmara yi bɛtumi nso ama mmaa a wɔnyini koraa (minors) kwan ma wɔafa kɔɔto (judicial bypass) so anaa wɔahwehwɛ kwan foforɔ a wɔbɛfa so anya tumidie, a ɛgyina obiara tebea pɔtee so. Ɛhia paa sɛ wosua mmara a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ na ama woate wo ho kwan ne akwan a wobɛtumi afa so aseɛ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa afã biara nni dwuma na yɛ botae bere a woresusuw nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no, na fa w’adwene si nsɛm ne nneɛma a wode bɛma so.
answer_twi_source: Mariestopes Ghana: 030 2241517 YMK App a wode bɛduru cyber counsellor, sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ nkyɛn bɛtumi de nneɛma a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wɔtu gu ho ama
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so siw nnuru bɔne a wɔde di dwuma ano na wɔhyɛ adwenemyare a wɔde gyina ano no ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so siw nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ano na wɔhyɛ adwenemyare a wɔde gyina ano wɔ mmabun mu no bi ne: Wɔnam nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so, mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun asiane ne nea efi nnuru a wɔde di dwuma mu ba ho. Senea wɔkyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wogyina ano ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina tebea horow ano de boa mmabun ma wodi adwennwen ho dwuma, wogyina nsɛnnennen ano, na wɔfa nkate a emu yɛ den so. Atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ pa ne sohyial network ahorow a ɛboa a ɛhyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran na ɛmma nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ho nkuran a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma, a afotuo, ayaresa, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo ka ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho na wɔde wɔn adwenemyare ne wɔn yiedi adi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa akuw, atipɛnfo nkitahodie, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya wɔ bere a wɔde di akyi ne bere a wɔde hwɛ akyi no mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mpɛn pii no, mmoa akuw, atipɛnfo nkitahodi, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya wɔ bere a wɔde di akyi ne bere a wɔde hwɛ akyi no mu. Saa nneɛma yi ma mmabun nya hokwan ne afoforo a wɔahyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara di nkitaho, kyɛ wɔn suahunu, nya adansedi ne mmoa, na wonya nneɛma ne nsɛm foforo a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔn ho atɔ wɔn na wɔanya yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara ahorow bɛn na ɛkwan da ho ma mmabun aa wɔ fa nna mu ne awoɔ mu apɔmmuden haw?
answer_twi_source: Mmara mu gyinafoɔ. Mmoa wɔ awoɔ hokwan mu (nyinsɛn ano sie/nyinsɛn ano sie). Ko tia nyiyimu. Mmoa wɔ ɔhwɛ mu. Mmoa a wɔnya a awofoɔ nnim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no hyɛ mmarimayɛ pa ho nkuran na ɛkasa tia mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn a epira "harmful gender norms" ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so tra hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no hyɛ mmarimayɛ pa ho nkuran na ɛkasa tia ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira denam: Ɛho hia sɛ abusuabɔ pa ne obu wom a egyina pɛyɛ, pene, ne nkitahodi so si so dua, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu a wɔde bɛma wɔ nkɛntɛnso bɔne a atetesɛm mu mmarimayɛ gyinapɛn ahorow te sɛ basabasayɛ, tumidi, ne nkate mu nhyɛso a ɛba ankorankoro yiyedi ne abusuabɔ so no ho. Mmarima a wɔpow mmarimayɛ a awuduru wom na wɔda tema, mmerɛwyɛ, ne obu ma afoforo adi ho nhwɛso pa ne nhwɛso ahorow a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so. Mmarimaa ne mmerante a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ayɔnkofo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano mu, na wɔama wɔn tumi ma wɔakasa atia nneyɛe ne suban a epira wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo mu. Ahokokwaw ne akannifo hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma mmarimaa ne mmerante ma wɔanya asetra mu nkate mu nimdeɛ pa, te sɛ tema, nkitahodi, ne ntawantawadi ano aduru, a ɛma mmarimayɛ a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛden ne nsɛm titiriw bi a esisii ne bi wɔ wɔn a wɔadi dem abakɔsɛm mu wɔ Ghana a asiesie hokwan ne sɛnea wotumi hu ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ Ghana no, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm anya abakɔsɛm a ɛfa animtiaabu ne nyiyimu ho akyɛ. Nanso, mmɔdenbɔ ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ wɔ mfeɛ no mu, na wɔda so ara rebɔ de ahyɛ wɔn hokwan ahodoɔ ho nkuran na wɔabɔ ho ban. Nsɛntitiriw bi ni: 1960 mfeɛ no: Wɔde Ghana Fekuo a ɛhwɛ wɔn a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nipadua mu no sii hɔ. 2006: Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no gye UN Apam a ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa a Wɔadi M dɛm wɔ (CRPD) no toom. 2007: Wɔhyɛɛ Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Mmara (Act 715) no sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ hokwan a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ no ho nkuran. Wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu, wɔ akwahosan ho atenaeɛ no mu, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi abisa mmoa wɔ apomoden asoɛe ahorow mu na aboa wɔn ma wɔaka wɔn ahiade ho asɛm yiye akyerɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛboa ma yesua ade fa pene so (consent) ne nnamfofa pa ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Planned Parenthood, Scarleteen, ne Love is Respect ma nsɛm  a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ pene so, nnamfofa pa, ne nna mu apɔmuden ho. Nwoma te sɛ "The Consent Guidebook" a Erin Tillman kyerɛwee ne "Yes Means Yes!: Visions of Female Sexual Power and A World Without Rape" a Jaclyn Friedman ne Jessica Valenti kyerɛwee ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu dɔ wɔ pene so ne nna mu basabasayɛ banbɔ ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne sukuu betumi ayɛ nhyiam, mmoa akuo, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodie akwan horow, te sɛ direct anaa indirect communication, di wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn ho nnuro, ne nna mu mpenesoɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi akwan horow, te sɛ direct anaa indirect communication, di dwuma titiriw wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn ho nnuro, ne nna mu mpeneso ho no mu. Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow a wobu nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ sɛ ɛyɛ kokoam anaa sensitive mu no, ankorankoro betumi de indirect language anaa nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw so aka nsɛm yi ho asɛm, na wɔde wɔn ho ato nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛda adi pefee so de ada ntease adi. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, amammerɛ ahorow a nkitahodie kwan a ɛkɔ tẽẽ kɛse wom no betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa saa nsɛmti yi ho, na ama ntease ne nkitahodi a emu da hɔ ayɛ mmerɛw. Saa nsɛm nketenkete yi a wɔbɛte ase wɔ nkitahodi akwan horow mu no ho hia na ama wɔatumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho ade a etu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn afi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase afa nna ne abusuabɔ a me ne me hokafo wɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ bere ne beae pa: Paw bere a mobɛhome bere a mo baanu nyinaa nni nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene. Fi ase ketewaa bi: Ɛho nhia sɛ wuhuruw kɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu dɔ mu ntɛm ara. Ka nsɛm a ɛreba, sini ahorow a woahu, anaa nneɛma a nnipa nyinaa ani gye ho ho asɛm. Eyi betumi ama awerɛkyekye ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a, emu dɔ akyiri yi. Bue w’ano na di nokware: Ka wo nsusuwii, wo atinka ne wo botae ahorow ho asɛm ankasa. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: Eyi boa ma wokwati sɛ ɛbɛyɛ te sɛ nea ɛyɛ sobo. Sɛ nhwɛso no, "Mete nka sɛ mewɔ abusuabɔ kɛse bere a yɛyɛ atuu" sen sɛ "Wompɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ atuu da." Bisa nsɛm a wɔabue ano: Eyi hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛboro "yiw" anaa "dabi" mmuae ho nkuran. Bɔ mmɔden sɛ "Dɛn na w'adwene wɔ ho...?" anaa "Wo te nka dɛn wɔ... ho?" Afei nso, hyɛ wo hokafo (hokafo) nkuran sɛ wɔne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di nsusuw eyi ho sɛ mo baanu nyinaa da so ara rebɔ mmɔden sɛ mubehu nea mobɛyɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ɛyɛ nokware sɛ akwan bi a wɔfa so siw awo ano nso, betumi abɔ wɔn ho ban afi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho?
answer_twi_source: Bere a akwan bi a wɔfa so siw awo ano, te sɛ mmarima ne mmea kɔndɔm, bɔ wɔn ho ban fi nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho no, Ɛho hia sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma daa, na ɛteɛ na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) no so atew, bere mpo a wɔde akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano redi dwuma de asiw nyinsɛn ano no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu kwan bɛn ne nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛ (indicators) bɛn na wɔde gyina so bu dwumadi a ɛfa ntetee ne tumi a wɔhyɛ mu (capacity building) ho ntɛm, sɛ ɛreboa ama mbabaa baabaayɛ ne awo mu akwahosan (ASRH) atu mpɔn?
answer_twi_source: Nhwehwɛmu Akwan: Nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔtaa fa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu no bi ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔayɛ ne akyi, nhwehwɛmu, akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, ne nsɛmbisa de susu nsakraeɛ a ɛba nimdeɛ, suban, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho. Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Ebia nsɛnkyerɛnne no bi ne nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ soro wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wɔde siw ano ho, animtiaabu a ɛso tew, SRH nnwuma a wɔde di dwuma kɛse, ne nna mu dwumadi a wofi ase a wɔkyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
