question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi asiesie adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow ma adi mmabun ahiade pɔtee ne wɔn anigyede ho dwuma, a wɔn a ebia wɔahyia ahodwiriw, wɔatu afi wɔn afie mu, anaa nsɛnnennen afoforo ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi asiesie adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow ma adi mmabun ahiade ne wɔn anigye pɔtee ho dwuma, a wɔn a ebia wɔahyia ahodwiriw, wɔatu afi wɔn afie mu, anaa nsɛnnennen afoforo ka ho. Wobetumi ayɛ eyi denam ɔhwɛ ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm bɛma, nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde bɛma de agye tebea ahodoɔ, adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔde bɛka ho, ne afotuo ne adwenemyareɛ ho nneɛma a wɔde bɛma sɛdeɛ ɛhia. Bio nso, adwumayɛ ho nteteeɛ, ne STEMS nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, adwumawuranom, ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma no ayɛ adwuma abom de ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma na wɔama wɔn nimdeɛ ne hokwan a ɛfata ama nkonimdie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ayaresafoɔ a me mfɛre sɛ mɛka me babunyɛ ho asɛm akyerɛ wɔn?
answer_twi_source: Bisa abusuafoɔ anaa nnamfoɔ na wɔnkerɛ wo. Hwehwɛ ayeresafoɔ a wɔhyɛdaa hwɛ mmabun ho nsɛm akyikwan. Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ na mo nhyia nni ho nkɔmmɔ ansaana wo atu anamɔn biara. Gye wo ho di na pɛ ayaresafoɔ a obetie wo, abu w'asumasɛm na ɔmma wo mfɛre.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmeae a ahobammɔ "safe space" wɔ ne mmoa akuw ma hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛkyekye "building" adamfofa ne asetra mu nkitahodi wɔ mmabun a woadi dɛm mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmeae a ahobanbɔ wɔ "Safe Space" ma hokwan ahorow ma: Osuahu ahorow a wɔkyɛ: Nkitahodi a wɔne afoforo a wɔte nsɛnnennen ne nkonimdi ahorow a ɛwɔ dɛmdi asetra mu ase. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Nnamfo a wɔbɛkyekye na wɔate nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea. Asetra mu Dwumadi ahorow: Kuw mu nhyiam ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu na wɔma asetra mu nkitahodi nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnwinnade anaa nhwehwɛmu bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu wɔ abɛɛfo ntetan anaa Intanɛt so a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw wɔn adwene mu apomoden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nnwinnade anaa nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu wɔ intanɛt so wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw wɔn adwene mu apomoden ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ adwenemyare a ɛtaa ba te sɛ adwenemhaw, dadwen, adwennwen, ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, a ɛma nsɛmmisa a wɔn ankasa de hwehwɛ yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne na wɔde nsɛm ma. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ma adwene mu apomoden pɔtee te sɛ adidi mu haw, adwenemhaw, ADHD, anaa PTSD, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne gyinapɛn a wɔde hwehwɛ yareɛ, sɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde hwɛ, ne asiane ho nhwehwɛmu. Adwene ne nneyɛe ho ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din pii de nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu wɔ Intanɛt so ma wɔ wɔn wɛbsaet ahorow so, na saa nnwinnade yi taa de nsɛm a ɛfa anammɔn a edi hɔ a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa a egyina nea efi mu ba so ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nneyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ wiase mmeae ahorow ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa ASRH nneyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ wiase nyinaa: Adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna ho: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ nna ho no gu ahorow kɛse, na ɛka adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho. Nneɛma a wɔabara ne atetesɛm: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne atetesɛm mu nneyɛe betumi akyerɛ nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo ho, na aka nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya. Nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ho so: Amammerɛ mu nneɛma ne nnipa afoforo te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nyamesom, ne asetena mu sikasɛm tebea di nkitaho, na ɛka ASRH nnwuma a wobenya ne ahofadi a wɔde si gyinae.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛba bere a wɔadu mpanyin afe so te sɛ nyin a ɛyɛ hu, akisikuru, ne nipadua mu nhwi no ano?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm hwehwɛ: Mmabunbere ne nea efi mu ba ho ade a wobesua denam nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ nhoma, wɛbsaet, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di so. Ahotew Ho Nhyehyɛe a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Ahotew ho su pa a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi nipadua hua, akisikuru, ne ahotew ho haw ahorow ho dwuma. Ntade a Ɛyɛ Fɛ a Wobɛpaw: Ntade a ɛyɛ fɛ a wobɛhyɛ a ɛbɛma nsakrae a ɛba nipadua no kɛse ne ne nsusuwii mu. Aduruyɛ mu Afotu a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ afotu ne ayaresa a wobɛpaw wɔ nneɛma pɔtee bi a ɛhaw adwene te sɛ akisikuru anaa nipadua mu nhwi a ɛboro so ho. Mmɔborɔhunu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho: Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyehye wɔn ho na wogye tom sɛ nipadua mu nsakrae yɛ ade a ɛfata wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so di nna mu ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma wɔ nketahodi a ɛyɛ papa na ɛboa no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a Emu da hɔ: Wo ne wo hokafo nka nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na fi nokwaredi mu. Munsusuw akɔnnɔ, ahye, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu so. Monhwehwɛ Mmoa bom: Munsusuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo sɛ awarefo. Obi a onim adwuma no betumi ama nkitahodi ayɛ mmerɛw na ɔde akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi nna mu ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma ama. Nhomasua ne Ntease: Bom sua nna mu akwahosan ne nneɛma a ɛma obi ntumi nyɛ adwuma yiye ho ade. Sɛ yɛte ase sɛ nna mu ɔhaw abu so na wotumi sa a, ebetumi atew animtiaabu so. Tema ne Mmoa: Monte mo ho mo ho nkate ne ne suahu ase na mommoa. Fa boasetɔ ne ahwɛyiye bɛn nna mu abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den. Hwehwɛ Nneɛma a Wobɛfa So: Fa w’adwene si nna mu dwumadi ahorow a ɛnyɛ nea ɛhyɛn mu a ɛyɛ anigye na ɛma abotɔyam so. Sɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ne abusuabɔ ahorow a ɛsonosonoe hwɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri di wɔ awo ho atɛntrenee a, wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri di dwuma titiriw wɔ awo mu atɛntrenee a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ma mmabun te sɛ; nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde ma, tumi a ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa tumi si gyinae a ɛfata, obu a wɔde ma wɔ nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow ho, ne mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira a wɔsɔre tia no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na sika a wɔbɛkora so ho hia mmabun, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma wonya sikasɛm mu ahoɔden?
answer_twi_source: Sika a wɔbɛkora so ho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nya nkɔso denam: Sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ a wɔbɛkyekye so: Sika a wɔbɛkora so no ma wonya ahobammɔ ma ɛka anaa tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔnhwɛ kwan, ɛtew ahotoso a wɔde to afoforo so na ɛma ahofadi ho nkuran. Sikasɛm mu botae ahorow a wobedu ho: Sikakorabea ma mmabun tumi di wɔn apɛde te sɛ nhomasua, akwantu, adwumayɛ, anaa ofie wurayɛ akyi, na ɛma wonya ahofadi kɛse na wonya abotɔyam. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛbɔ: Sika a wɔbɛboaboa ano no bue apon ma daakye akwanya ahorow, te sɛ sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri mu, adwuma bi a wobefi ase, anaasɛ ahonyade a wobenya bere tenten, sikasɛm mu nkɔso ne yiyedi a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ama me ho mfoni pa wɔ me mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii papa ma wo ho.  Fa w’adwene si Ahoɔden (talente) so. nyɔnkofa nkitahod a ɛboa)
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asua sɛnea wɔbɛsakra wɔn asetrade ho nimdeɛ ma ɛne adwumayɛfo gua so nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ, mfiridwuma mu nneɛma foforo, ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso a ɛresakra no ahyia?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asua sɛnea wɔbɛdannan wɔn asetrade ho nimdeɛ ma ɛne adwumayɛfo gua so ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛresakra, mfiridwuma mu nneɛma foforo, ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso ahyia denam adesua a ɛkɔ so, ahokokwaw a wɔbɛma akɔ soro, ne ahokokwaw a wɔsan nya so. Adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne job shadowing akwanya ahorow mu kyɛfa a mmabun nya no ma wohu nnwuma a ɛrenya nkɔso, mfiridwuma foforo, ne adwuma mu dwumadi ahorow a ɛrenya nkɔso, na ɛboa wɔn ma wohu gua so nkɔso. Intanɛt so adesua, adwumayɛbea, webinars, ne adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ nneɛma a wɔbɛnya no ma mmabun nya nimdeɛ foforɔ, adansedie, ne adansedie nkrataa a ɛfa nnwuma a ɛreba, digyital nhyiamu, ne akyirikyiri adwumayɛ akwanya ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu, a ɔhwɛ a wobenya ne ahobammɔ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nyiyim ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa a Ɛsɛ sɛ Obiara Nya (Access to Care)Nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm (disability) ne akuo afoforɔ a wɔadi wɔn abira no wɔ mmara mu kwan sɛ wɔnya ayaresa, a oprehyɛn ne adwene mu apɔwmuden mmoa ka ho; ɛmfa ho sɛ mmeaeɛ bi bɛtumi anya akwansideɛ no. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmeaeɛ a wɔfa kɔ adan mu ne mmeaeɛ a wɔpue firi mu yɛ baabi a ɛfata nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm na ama wɔn a wɔde nneɛma te sɛ "wheelchair" di dwuma ne afoforɔ anya kwan pa.Banbɔ firi Nyiyim Ho (Protections Against Discrimination)Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔne nnipa nyinaa di no pɛpɛɛpɛ a nyiyim biara nnim. Wɔatete ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ (health professionals) sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma mma obiara, ɛmfa ho sɛnea nnipa no gu ahorow fa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina m’ananmu ahwɛ ahu sɛ menya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a madi afiri m’awofo, sukuu ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wo ne w’awofo nni nkitaho pefee wɔ ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a woadi no ho, na bisa wɔn mmoa wɔ nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a wubenya mu. Boa ma wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho apɔmuden ho adeɛ yie wɔ wo sukuu mu. Wo bɛtumi ayɛ eyi sɛ wo de wo ho bɛhyɛ sukuufoɔ mpanimfoɔ kuo mu, anaa wo bɛtwerɛ krataa akɔma sukuu no adwumayɛfoɔ mpanimfoɔ, anaa wo bɛdɔm mmoakuo a wɔgyina hɔ ma nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛte saa. Sɛ wo kɔ ayaresabea nso a, paem sɛ wo hia nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna ho apɔmuden ho, na bisa wo dɔkota anaa ayarehwɛfoɔ no sɛ wɔmma wo nhoma anaa mmoa biara a ɛbɛboa wo ma woasua pii afa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia nyiyim anaa mmara mu haw a ɛfa me bɔbeasu anaa dɛmdi ho a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmara kwan so mmoa?
answer_twi_source: Mmara Dwumadibea: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi mmara anaa nnipa hokwan ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa mmara kwan so mmoa fekuw ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ mmara kwan so mmoa a wɔde ma akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wohyia nyiyim anaa mmara mu nsɛnnennen no hɔ. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma ne mmoa nhama a ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛbɔ nkurɔfo amanneɛ de ma, a ebetumi ama wɔanya nsɛm, mmoa, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa. Nhwɛso bi ne, dwumakuo a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ the Ark Foundation no de mmara kwan so mmoa ma akuw a ɛtete saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu? (ɔbarima, ɔbea,bɔbeasu ho nsesae- transgender , sɛ wonnyɛ ɔbaa anaasɛ ɔbarima- non-binary, ne nea ɛkeka ho)
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu yɛ wo mu atenka a ɛne sɛ woyɛ ɔbarima, ɔbea, abien no nyinaa, anaasɛ wonyɛ emu biara. Ɛsono ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde ma wɔ awo mu, a egyina nipadua mu nipadua so. Nsɛmfua bi a ebia wubehyia ni: Ɔbarima/Ɔbea: Atetesɛm mu akuw ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Bɔbeasu ho nsesae: Obi a ɛsono ne bɔbeasu wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde maa no bere a wɔwoo no no ho. sɛ wonnyɛ ɔbaa anaasɛ ɔbarima: Obi a ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea nkutoo mu. Ebia wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ abien no nyinaa, wɔ baabi a ɛda ntam, anaasɛ wonni ɔbarima anaa ɔbea koraa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔde STI/HIV akwansidie nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie ka mmabun akwahosan ho dwumadie foforɔ te sɛ awoɔ akwahosan ne adwenem apɔwmuden dwumadie ho?
answer_twi_source: Wɔtaa de STI/HIV akwansidie nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie ka mmabun akwahosan ho dwumadie foforɔ ho denam: Nnwuma a wɔde bɛbom: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ bɛtumi ama mmabun akwahosan ayaresabea a ɛkɔ akyiri a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi anya nnwuma ahodoɔ bi, a STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu, afotuo a ɛfa nyinsɛn mu nnuro ho, adwenem apɔwmuden ho mmoa, ne akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ beaeɛ baako a ɛfata ka ho. Ntetee a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a nnuroyɛfo, ayarehwɛfo, afotubɔfoɔ, ne atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ka ho, betumi anya ntetee wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nneɛma pii mu de ama ɔhwɛ a edi mũ na wɔadi mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ahorow a ɛka bom ho dwuma. Nkitahodi a wɔde kɔma wɔn: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ, sukuu ahorow, ne adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo ayɛ biako de akwan a wɔbɛfa so de wɔn akɔma mmabun a wohia nnwuma titiriw a ɛboro ɔhwɛ a edi kan no so, te sɛ ayaresa a wɔde sa adwenemyare ho nsɛm anaa mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ no biako: Akwahosan akuw betumi ayɛ ankorankoro hwɛ nhyehyɛe ama mmabun a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho haw soronko ho, a STI/HIV ano aduru ho akwan horow, awo akwahosan botae ahorow, ne adwene mu yiyedi ka ho, a wɔne aberante ne wɔn mmoa kuw no abom ayɛ adwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akuo ahorow anaa ayaresabea ahorow bi wɔ mantɔw mu a wɔde nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma mmabun titire?
answer_twi_source: Planned Parenthood ayaresabea ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ apɔwmuden asoɛe ahorow taa de sika a ɛwɔ fam anaasɛ wɔatew so a egyina obia ahoɔden so ma. Apɔwmuden asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, mmabun ayaresabea ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛfata mmabun betumi de nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nnwuma a edi mũ ama, a afotuo fa nyinsɛn nnuro ho, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu, ne afotuo ka ho, a wɔatew ka so anaasɛ wɔrentua mma mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔato wɔn mona wɔ mmara kwan so?
answer_twi_source: Nhumu: Nna mu ɔbrasɛe a abu so no ntease boa mmabun ma wohu sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm a atrɛw a ebetumi aka obiara. Asiane a Wɔtew So: Sɛ mmabun nim nneɛma a ɛde nna mu ɔbrasɛe ba a, ɛma wotumi tu anammɔn de bɔ wɔn ho ne afoforo ho ban. Atosɛm a Wɔbɔ no Bum: Sɛ wosua anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho a, ɛboa ma woyi gyidi ne suban a epira fi hɔ. Mmoa: Nhomasua ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no nya adansedi, mmoa, na wonya nneɛma a wɔde bɛsa yare na wɔn ho atɔ wɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa ntamgyinafo hɔ bere a ntawaawdi ahorow bɛyɛ den dodo anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔn ankasa besiesie, na nneɛma anaa mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔanya wɔn ntawatawadi ano so ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa ntamgyinafo hɔ bere a ntawatawdi bɛyɛ den dodo anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔn ankasa besiesie wɔ: Ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di a wobehu wɔn: Akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wotumi bɛn wɔn, wɔboa wɔn, na wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ ntawatawdi ano so mu no hɔ. Mmoa a wɔbɛsrɛ: Wɔbɛyɛ nnam wɔ mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ mu na wɔada wɔn hia a wohia mmoa adi wɔ ntawatawdi a emu yɛ den a wodi mu no adi. Nneɛma a wɔbɛnya: Mmoa dwumadie te sɛ sukuu afotufoɔ, atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, anaa mpɔtam ntam ntamgyinafoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma wɔ ntawatawdie ano so ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛnya mu a wɔde bedi dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne brayɛ no fã ahorow, na ɛtaa di bere tenten ahe?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛ mmere: Wɔkyekyɛ brayɛ no mu akwan horow pii: Brayɛ Fa: Da a edi kan a ɛba brayɛ mu no na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wofi ase. Saa fã yi taa di nnafua mmiɛnsa kosi nnafua nson.   Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu  Follicular Phase: Sɛ obi kɔ brayɛ akyi a, nipadua no fi ase siesie ne ho ma  nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ ovulation. Nkwammoaa a ɛma awotwaa no kanyan awotwaa no ma ɛyɛ ntini (nkotoku a nkesua wom).   Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu Ovulation: Bɛyɛ kyinhyia no mfinimfini (mpɛn pii no da a ɛto so du-nan  wɔ nnafua aduonu-nwɔtwe mu) no, woyi nkesua biako a ɛho akokwaw fi awotwaa mu. Wɔfrɛ eyi ovulation.   Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Luteal Phase: Bere a ovulation akyi no, follicle a hwee nni mu no dan biribi a wɔfrɛ no  wɔ broɔfo kasa mu corpus luteum, a ɛma honam nu nkwammoa ahorow siesie awotwaa no ma nyinsɛn a ebetumi aba. Sɛ Nyinsɛn Ba a: Sɛ wɔde mmadwoa ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu na ɛma ɛwo no yɛ frɔmfrɔm a, nyinsɛn no fi ase. Sɛ ɛnte saa a, corpus luteum no sɛe, honam mu nkwammoa  dodow so tew, na brayɛ mmere  no fi ase bio.  Brayɛ mmere: Brayɛbea no tenten betumi ayɛ soronko, nanso mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ bɛyɛ nnafua aduonu-nwɔtwe. Nanso, ebetumi adi nnafua aduonu-baako kosi aduasa-nnum na wɔda so ara bu no sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Aboafo nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrebusa mu afa wɔn nna ne akɔnnɔ ho ?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun nna mu apomodenn ne abusuabɔ mu denam nkɛntɛnso a ebenya so: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nipasu nkɔso ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho no so. Nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne apomoden ho nnwuma a wobenya. Abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ne nkitahodi a wɔne ahokafo di. Osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne nnipa kakraa bi adwennwen ho. Boa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodi. Mpene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛte ase na wɔafa so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu na ɛyɛ ne mmoa adwuma a ɛfa wɔn ahiade ne osuahu soronko ho .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ di wɔ adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho a wɔma ɛkɔ so tra hɔ no mu na ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa ma wɔako atia saa ade yi?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa yɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ pefee so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa: Nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee: Bisa sɛnea wɔde dɛmdi ne nna gyina hɔ ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. Hwehwɛ Ananmusifoɔ Ahodoɔ: Boa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkyerɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛka obiara ho. Kasa: Kasa tia mfonini ahorow a enye wɔ sohyial media so anaasɛ denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wobɛkɔ so adi nkitaho tẽẽ no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ obi a minim no rehaw anaa wɔreyɛ no basabasa wɔ Intanɛt so esiane ne nna ho akɔnnɔ, bɔbeasu, anaa ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo nti a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ma onipa a ɔrehyia ɔhaw anaa asisifo no, na ma wonhu sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno nkutoo na wowɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛboa no. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wonsiw nea ɔhaw no anaa osisifo no kwan anaasɛ wɔmfa mmɔ ne amanneɛ, na sɛ wuhu suban no wɔ Intanɛt so a, w’ankasa susuw ho sɛ wobɛyɛ saa. Kyerɛw adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔahaw anaa ayayade no te sɛ "screenshots" anaa nkrasɛm, na bɔ amanneɛ kyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata anaa asɛnka agua so ahwɛfo. Hyɛ onipa no nkuran sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa mmoa ahyehyɛde a wogye no di a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow anaa intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodibea bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua pii afa digital akenkan ne akyerɛw ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Common Sense Media, NetSmartz, ne StaySafeOnline de afotuo, video, ne nsɛm a ɛfa intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ho ma. Ntrɛwmu: Nnɔmba te sɛ Cyberbullying Hotline (1-800-420-1479) anaa National Runaway Safeline (1-800-786-2929) betumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama. Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Sukuu pii wɔ nhyehyɛe anaa afotufo a wobetumi akyerɛkyerɛ digital akenkan ne akyerɛw ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho ade. Awofoɔ Akwankyerɛ: Awofoɔ anaa ahwɛfo bɛtumi ayɛ adeɛ a ɛsom bo a wɔde bɛsua intanɛt nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de me berɛ anaa m’ahokokwaw ama de aboa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔreyɛ ASRR ahorow no ho adwuma? (Sika a wɔboaboa ano ho nhyiam ahorow, adwumayɛ ho nnwuma, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ)
answer_twi_source: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a yebetumi afa so atu yɛn ho ama! Nneɛma bi a wubetumi ayɛ ni: Sikakorabea Nhyiam: Boa ma wɔnyɛ nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe de boaboa sika ano ma ahyehyɛde no. Nnwuma a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Fa mmoa ma wɔ akyerɛwfo adwuma anaa sohyial media sohwɛ mu. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Sɛ wɔtete wo a, wubetumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo ASRH nsɛmti ho ade.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn na mahye asi hɔ na makura mu wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Hunu anaa nim wo bebiaa woano si: Hu nea ɛma wo ho tɔ wo ne nea ɛmma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ. Di Nkitaho a emu da ho pii: Ka wo hye ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ wo hokafo. bebiaa woano si: Bu wo hokafo ahye na bisa sɛ wɔmma no ntease bere a ɛho hia no. Mmara a Wɔde Di Dwuma Daa: Di w’ahye so bere nyinaa na hwɛ kwan sɛ wobebu no. San Susuw Ho Sɛnea Ɛho Hia: San susuw w’ahye ho bere a abusuabɔ no rekɔ so anaasɛ tebea horow sesa no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ankasa ne adwene pa  a ɛfa biribi ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa m’adwene apɔmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobenya adwene pa afa biribi ho yɛ adeyɛ a ɛne sɛ wobɛtena hɔ wɔ bere no mu, ahwɛ nsusuwii ne atenka ahorow a wunsusuw ho. Mfaso ahorow no bi ne adwennwen a ɛso tew, adwene a wɔde si biribi so ne adwene a wɔde si biribi so yiye, sɛnea obi hu ne ho kɛse, ne atenka mu nhyehyɛe pa. Ebetumi ama adwene mu yiyedi nyinaa anya nkɔso denam kommyɛ ne nea emu da hɔ a ɛbɛma obi anya nkɔso no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe bɛn na mmabun betumi anya, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow yi bɛma wɔanya adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a mfaso wɔ so na wɔanya sikasɛm mu ahofadi?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya adwumayɛ ho ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina wɔn anigyede, wɔn ahokokwaw, ne adwuma botae ahorow so. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi betumi ayɛ adesua, STEM sukuu, mpɔtam kɔlege nhyehyɛeɛ, ne adwuma mu nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a adwumawuranom de ma. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow yi bɛma wɔanya adwumayɛ hokwan ahorow a ntease wom ne sikasɛm mu ahofadi no, mmabun betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow de ama, gyinabea a wogye tom, ne adwuma a wɔde ma ho nhwehwɛmu, ahwehwɛ afotu afi adwumayɛ ho afotufo anaa nnwuma mu adwumayɛfo hɔ, na wɔasusuw nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde nsaano adesua mu osuahu ahorow, nnwuma mu adansedi ahorow, ne akwan a wɔfa so kɔ nhomasua nkɔso a ɛkɔ akyiri ma. Bio nso, mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ hokwan ahorow wɔ adwuma mu, job shadowing, ne nkitahodi a ɛbɛma wɔanya osuahu a mfaso wɔ so na wɔanya adwumayɛfo nkitahodi wɔ adwuma a wɔapaw no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛnea etu mpɔn, nea efi mu ba, ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi afa mmeae ahorow a wotumi de ho to so so anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware: Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi, te sɛ oduruyɛfo, ɔyarehwɛfo, anaa mmea ho ɔyaresafo, a obetumi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛfata ama, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye, nea ebetumi afi mu aba, ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho. Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din fi ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Planned Parenthood, anaa nna mu akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow, a wɔde akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a edi mũ ma, a mfaso, asiane, ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ka ho. Nhomasua Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nkratawa, anaa nhoma ahorow a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, anaa sukuu ahorow. Nhoma ne Nwoma: Hwehwɛ nhoma, nsɛmma nhoma, anaa nhoma ahorow a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa awo akwahosan ho abenfo akyerɛw, a ebetumi ama woanya nhumu a emu dɔ wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho. Ntrɛwmu te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) de nsɛm a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na sukuu ahorow di wɔ sɛnea wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu animhwɛ, nsɛmmɔnedi, aguade ho dawurubɔ akwan, adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ digital citizenship ba, ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ahorow di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adwene te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu animhwɛ, nsɛmmɔnedi, aguade ho dawurubɔ akwan, adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ digital citizenship ba, ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua nhyehyɛe ho wɔ adesua ahorow mu, te sɛ yɛn kasa ho adwinni, asetra mu adesua, nyansahu, ne akwahosan ho adesua, de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛka ho asɛm yiye na ɛne adesua gyinapɛn ne adesua botae ahorow ahyia. Adwumayɛfoɔ nkɔsoɔ hokwan a wɔde bɛma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ama wɔn nteaseɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adwene ne nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan ho no ayɛ kɛseɛ, na wɔayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan a ɛtu mpɔn a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ wɔ adesuadan mu. Wɔn a wɔne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow, nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahokafo, ne nnwuma mufo a wɔyɛ adwuma bom yɛ na wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe, nneɛma, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina adanse so a edi mmabun ahiade ne wɔn anigye ahorow ho dwuma. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛka nnwuma a ɛtrɛw a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ digital citizenship bayɛ, asetra mu nkate mu adesua, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne nsɛm ho nimdeɛ ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran, de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun nya nkɔso a edi mu ne yiyedi wɔ nnɛyi abɛɛfo ntentan berɛ yi mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo ne m’abusuafo aka me nyinsɛn no ho asɛm?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wo ne w’adɔfo bɛkasa afa wo nyinsɛn ho a, ebetumi ayɛ den, nanso wɔn mmoa a wubenya no ho hia. Afotu bi ni: Paw obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso: Wo ne w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, anaa ɔpanyin foforo a ɔboa wo nkasa. Di nokware na ka w’ani: Ka wo nkate ne wo haw ahorow no pefee ne nokwaredi mu. Fa nea wopɛ sɛ woka no di dwuma: Eyi betumi aboa wo ma woanya ahotoso kɛse wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma, nnwinnade, ne ntetee hokwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho akamfofo ne nsakrae pa ho akasamafo wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu ahorow, ne intanɛt so mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne Ntetee Hokwan: Nneɛma ahorow, nnwinnade, ne ntetee hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw ho akamfofo ne nsakrae pa ho akamfofo. Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ nea broni ka no 'UNESCO, MediaSmarts, ne The News Literacy Project' de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne intanɛt so adesua ahorow a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nkɔso ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na nyinsɛn a woyi gu betumi anya wɔ awo akwahosan so bere tenten, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi betumi aboa ma wɔadi saa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Bere a wɔtaa bu nyinsɛn a woyi gu sɛ asiane biara nni ho no, ebetumi anya nkɛntɛnso bere tenten wɔ awo akwahosan so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Daakye Awo: Mpɛn pii no, nyinsɛn a wotu gu no nnya daakye awo so nkɛntɛnso. Nanso, nsɛnnennen a efi oprehyɛn no mu ba anaasɛ ɔyare mmoawa betumi aka awo. Atenka mu Yiyedi: Ankorankoro binom betumi anya atenka mu nkɛntɛnso wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi, te sɛ awerɛhow, afobu, anaa ahotɔ. Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi no betumi ama wɔanya afotu ne mmoa de adi nkate mu haw ahorow yi ho dwuma. Nipadua mu Akwahosan: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi no boa ma wɔhwɛ nipadua mu nsɛnnennen anaa nsunsuanso bɔne biara a efi adeyɛ no mu ba, na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ bere ano. Afotu a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ho: Mpɛn pii no, nea ɛka ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi ho ne afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano na aboa ma wɔasiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ansi daakye ano na wɔama awo akwahosan nyinaa anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsɛm bɛn na wubu no sɛ ɛyɛ kokoam de, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi apene nsɛmti a wɔabue ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nsɛmti a wɔmfa anohyeto "of-limits" mma ho?
answer_twi_source: Ebia kokoam nsɛm bi ne ankorankoro osuahu ahorow, atinka ahorow, anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Yebetumi apene nsɛmti a wɔabue ama nkɔmmɔbɔ so denam nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee ne yɛn ho yɛn ho ntease a yɛwɔ wɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho ahye ne awerɛkyekye dodow ho no so. Bu mo ho mo ho kokoam nsɛm denam kwati a wobɛkwati sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ nsɛm a wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ kokoam nsɛm anaasɛ wobɛhyɛ wo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na me nipadua hua mprempren yi?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua hua fi fifiri ne mmoawa a ɛwɔ wo honam ani a ɛfrafra. Wɔ wo babunbere mu no, wo nipadua no ma fifiri pii fi awoɔ mu nkwamoa ahorow nti, titiriw bere a woreyɛ nnam anaasɛ wo ho yeraw wo no. Fifiri no ankasa nni hua biara, nanso mmoawa a wɔwɔ wo honam ani no bobɔ mu ma ɛbɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ hua. Ɛno nti na ebia wubehu nipadua hua, titiriw wɔ wo nsateaa ase no. Ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo nipadua no renyin. Wobetumi adi nipadua hua ho dwuma denam samina a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde guare mprenu (anɔpa ne anwummere) daa aa wode mmoa sa samina. Hyɛ ntade a wɔde assawa ayɛ a ntade ase ka ho na sesa bere a woaguare awie. Fa 'deodrant', akenkantwadeɛ nsu, anaa nsõ gu abasa no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa kuo bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm pii afa nyinsɛn ne awoɔ nnuro ho?
answer_twi_source: Dɔktafoɔ, nurses ne abusua nhyehyeɛ ayaresabea ma kokoam afotuo. Wɔma nkrataa ne kyerɛ websites a ɛbɛma wo anya saa nimdeɛ no. Websites no bi ne, Adolescent Health Programme Social Media Handles, YMK App, Planned Parenthood, Besider, TeenSource. Hotlines no bi te sɛ Planned Parenthood 1-800-230-PLAN, ma afotuo. Sukuu mu nurses ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ so tumi yɛ saa. Mpɔtam ayaresabea so saa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ amammerɛ mu tema ne obu ma adwene ahorow wɔ hɔ bere a wɔde ASRH nnwuma rema mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ amammerɛ mu tema ne obuo ma adwene ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ, berɛ a wɔde ASRH dwumadie rema denam: Amammerɛ mu ahoɔden: Amammerɛ mu gyidie ahodoɔ, gyinapɛn, ne nneyɛeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho a wɔbɛte aseɛ na wɔabu. Nkitahodie pa: Kasa ne nkitahodi akwan a ɛne amammerɛ ahorow hyia a wɔde bedi dwuma, a wosusu nneɛma te sɛ kasa, akenkan ne akyerɛw, ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow ho. Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛboa obiara a ɛbɛma amammerɛ mu nneɛma a wɔpɛ, nyamesom mu nneyɛe, ne atetesɛm mu ayaresa akwan hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hu mmabun a wɔfi mmeae ahorow ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ahiade ahorow.
answer_twi_source: Obiara wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho ahiade soronko! W’akwahosan ho yaresafo susuw nneɛma te sɛ: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna Amammerɛ mu nsɛm Mfe ne akwahosan ho abakɔsɛm
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm betumi akamfo hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma a mmubuafo ka ho wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm betumi akamfo hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a mmubuafoɔ ka ho wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne akyirikyiri denam wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ nnwumakuo a ɛhwɛ mmubuafoɔ hokwan so, wɔn suahunu a wɔbɛkyɛ, wobɛtwe adwene asi akwansideɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔbɛtumi akɔ hɔ no, ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ ne dwumadie mu nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne apaɔwmuden ho ahiade pɔtee bi anaa nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo abɔ ho dawuro?
answer_twi_source: Wo Nipadua Ho Ntease: Ka nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen biara a wowɔ wɔ nna mu nkɔsoɔ ne nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛfa wo dɛmdi ho ho asɛm. Hwehwɛ awoɔ nhyɛsoɔ nnuro na susu wo daakye nyinsɛn ho, susuw wo dɛmdie so ho. Adwene mu Apɔwmuden: Wo ne wo ayaresafoɔ nkasa fa adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie a wobɛnya ho sɛ ɛhia a. Yɛ Wo Nhwehwɛmu: Sua nna mu akwahosan ne dɛmdie hokwan ahorow ho ade wɔ Ghana. Eyi ma wo tumi sɛ wo ne nea ɔde mmoa ma wo no bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom. Siesie Ɔkasa Nsɛntitiri: Di kan kyerɛw nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm pɔtee bi a ɛhaw adwene to hɔ na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔadi ho dwuma. Fa Obi a Ɔboa no Bra: Susu ho sɛ wobɛma w’adamfo anaa w’abusuani bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso bɛka wo ho akɔ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛboa wo ma woabɔ w’ahiade ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ahorow, ɔhaw, ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow bɛn na ebetumi aba a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm, intanɛt so, ne nkitahodie site ahorow a mede me ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, kokoam nsɛm, mfidie so ayayade, ne ntentanfidie so ahobammɔ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa me ma madi nsunsuanso yi so?
answer_twi_source: Asiane, haw, ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ebetumi aba a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ne intanɛt so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho no bi ne: Kokoam nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ ahwɛyiye wɔ ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ intanɛt so ho na wɔhu kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ nkitahodie site ahorow so de abɔ wɔn ntentanfidie so nipasu ho ban. Intanɛt so ayayade: Intanɛt so ayayade betumi aba wɔ abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so anaa ntentanfidie nkitahodie beaeɛ ahodoɔ, enti ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ ayayade nneyɛe ho amanneɛ na wohwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Digitals ahobammɔ: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de Intanɛt so su horow a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma, te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a asiane wom a wɔbɛkwati, ahwɛyiye a wɔbɛyɛ bere a wɔne ahɔho di nkitaho wɔ Intanɛt so, ne nsɛm anaa mfonini ahorow a ɛho hia a wɔbɛkwati. Atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne dijitaal nsunsuanso: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw intanɛt so nsɛm ho yiye na wɔako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɔne anaa nkɛntɛnso a epira, na ahyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ne abɛɛfo ntentanfidie nkitahodie a asɛyɛde wom ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So adwenem apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow de afotuo a wɔde ma wɔ telefon so anaa intanɛt so ma mmabun a ebia ɛbɛyɛ den ama wɔn sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ?
answer_twi_source: Aane, adwenem apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea pii de afotu a wɔde ma wɔ telefon so anaa intanɛt so ma, na ebetumi aboa mmabun a ɛyɛ den ma wɔn sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ ankasa esiane nneɛma ahorow te sɛ akwantu ho nsɛm, nhyehyɛe mu ntawntawdi, anaa kokoam nsɛm ho dadwen nti. Telehealth ma wo kwan ma wo ne adwenem apɔwmuden ho ɔbenfoɔ di nkitaho wɔ akyirikyiri denam video so frɛ anaa telefon so frɛ so, na ɛma wonya mmoa firi w’ankasa wo fie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne akuo ahorow mu de ayɛ tebea horow a ahobammɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho ama mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne asoɛeɛ mu denam: - Wɔbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ nhyiamu, ɔsatuo, anaa nhyiamu a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate aseɛ wɔ hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔma mmarima ne mmaa ho atenka wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wɔsi ano na wɔhyɛ pɛyɛ ho nkuran. - Nsakraeɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Fa adesrɛ bɛto sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, mpɔtam akannifoɔ, anaa nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho nni dwuma, te sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ko tia ayayadeɛ. - Ahobammɔ Beaeɛ a Wɔbɛbɔ: Wɔbɛkamfo sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mmeaeɛ a ahobanbɔ wɔ a ankorankoro a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa te nka sɛ wɔbu wɔn, wɔboa wɔn, na wɔde wɔn ka nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho. - LGBTQ+ Hokwan a wɔbɛboa: Wɔbɛkamfo LGBTQ+ hokwan ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛka sukuu nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, a nea ɛka ho ne aguaree a obiara ka ho, edinnsiananmu a ɛnyɛ barima ne ɔbaa, ne mmoa a wɔde ma LGBTQ+ asuafo akuw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me kasa ho  'communication skills'? bere m'aduru me mpanyinfi so?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu afotufoɔ (Counselors). Kabi ma me nka bi akuo 'Debate clubs'. Intanɛt so adesua. Nwoma. Nnamfo kuo. Awofoɔ mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia nsɛm a ɛmfata anaa epira wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan  so bere a meyɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Fi beae no mu: Sɛ wuhu nneɛma a ɛmfata a, to abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn bease anaa app no mu ntɛm ara. Mmɛ Nkyɛ: Kwati sɛ wobɛkyɛ anaa wode nsɛm a ɛmfata akɔma afoforo. Bɔ amanneɛ: abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn mmea dodow no ara wɔ akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so abɔ nneɛma a ɛmfata anaa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma ho amanneɛ. Wo ne Ɔpanyin Kasa: Sɛ emu nsɛm no haw wo a, wo ne ɔpanyin bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso nka nea wuhui no ho asɛm. Bɔ W’Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Ban: Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo te sɛ wo nnamfo a wo ne wo bɛkasa anaa biribi a wode gye w’ani mu. Kwati Sɛ Wobɛda Wo Ho Adi Mpɛn Adi: Bɔ mmɔden sɛ worenhwehwɛ emu nsɛm no mu anaasɛ worenkɔ mu bio, efisɛ ebetumi apira adwene mu yiyedi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mihyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim a ɛfa STI a wɔahu ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Kɔ nnamfo, anaa mmoa akuw a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobetumi de ntease ne mmoa a ɛnyɛ atemmu ama no nkyɛn. Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo STI ho asɛm na yi anansesɛm ahorow fi hɔ na ama animtiaabu so atew. Adwumayɛfo Mmoa: Susuw ho sɛ wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a obetumi aboa wo ma woagyina animtiaabu anaa nyiyim ho nkate ahorow ano akasa. Te ase sɛ wowɔ hokwan sɛ wode wo kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ w’akwahosan tebea ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma de tew animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa STI ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne akwansideɛ bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ sikasɛm mu nnwuma a wɔde di dwuma mu, te sɛ sika a wɔbɔ, mfɛntom a wɔbɔ, sika a wɔbɔ boro so, ɛka, nsisi, nnipa a wowia, anaa nsisi?
answer_twi_source: Bere a sikasɛm ho adwumayɛ ma mfaso horow no, ɛde asiane ahorow nso ba te sɛ: Ka a wɔbɔ: Sikakorabea ahorow betumi agye sika wɔ akontaabu a wɔde siesie, sika a wɔbɔ boro so, anaa nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho. Mfaso: Sɛ wobɔ bosea denam bosea anaa credit card so a, ebetumi ama woagye mfɛntom. Sika a Wɔbɔ boro So: Sɛ wɔsɛe sika pii sen nea ɛwɔ akontaabu no mu a, ebetumi ama wɔabɔ ka kɛse wɔ sika a ɛboro so ho. Ɛka: Sɛ obi bɔ bosea boro nea obetumi so a, ebetumi ama wabɔ bosea na ne sikasɛm mu ahokyere aba. Nsisi, nnipa a wowia, ne nsisi: Ebia nsɛmmɔnedifo de wɔn ani si ankorankoro so de sikasɛm mu nsisi anaa korɔnbɔ, na ehia sɛ wɔma wɔn ani da hɔ na wɔyɛ ahwɛyiye bere a wɔrehwɛ akontaabu ne ankorankoro ho nsɛm so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na nea broni ka no 'intersectionality' kyerɛ wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ho nsɛm mu?
answer_twi_source: Nea broni ka no 'Intersectionality' kyerɛ sɛnea asetra mu nkyekyem ahorow te sɛ abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, kuw, ne nna ho nsɛm a ɛka bom, a ebetumi ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka bom na egyina wɔn ho wɔn ho so a ɛfa nyiyim anaa ɔhaw ahorow ho aba. Wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ne nna mu nipasu ho no, 'intersectionality' gye tom sɛ ankorankoro osuahu ahorow no nam nipasu afã horow pii so na ɛyɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ nkutoo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmoa efi mpɔtamfoɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun a ɔwɔ dɛmdi?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ́ ɔbabun a ɔte ase a wadi dɛm no, mmoa ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a wubenya no betumi ayɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse ma wo yiyedi ne wo tumi. Akwan bi a wobɛfa so anya mmoa ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ni: 1. Ɔman Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Hwehwɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfa wo dɛmdi ho pɔtee, te sɛ Ɔman Autism Fekuw anaa Ntini mu Ntini a Ɛyɛ Fɛ Fekuw. 2. Mpɔtam Hɔ Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Akuo: Hwehwɛ intanɛt so anaa kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ mmubuafoɔ adwumayɛbea hɔ kɔhwehwɛ mmoa akuo a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Wɔ Ghana wobetumi ne Disability Council adi nkitaho ama mmoa dwumadie 3. Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ho nsɛm ho Ahyehyɛdeɛ: Ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ Disability Rights Education and Defence Fund anaa National Disability Rights Network betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama. 4. Intanɛt so Mpɔtam ne Nhyiamu: Kɔka intanɛt so nhyiamu, sohyial media akuo, anaa intanɛt so mmoa akuo ho na wo ne afoforɔ a wɔwɔ suahunu a ɛte saa ara nni nkitaho. 5. Afotu ne Ayaresa: Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ fi ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ adwuma a wɔne mmabun a wɔadi dɛm yɛ mu hɔ. 6. Atipɛnfo Afotu Nhyehyɛe: Hwehwɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛne wo ne atipɛnfo afotufo a ɔwɔ dɛmdi anaa osuahu a ɛte saa ara hyia. 7. Ahomegye ne Ahomegye Dwumadi: Hwehwɛ agodie a ɛma wotumi sesa wɔn ho, adwinni ho nhyehyɛe, anaa dwumadi afoforo a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm. 8. Nsraban ne Dwumadie a ɛfa Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm ho: Kɔ ahuhuro nsraban anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔayɛ ama wo dɛmdi, na ama woanya tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho. 9. Mpɔtam hɔ Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Dwumadibea: Kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ mmubuafoɔ adwumayɛbea hɔ kɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma, dwumadie, ne mmoa a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. 10. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ: W’akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie. Kae sɛ, sɛ wubenya mmoa ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a, egye akokoduru ne wo ho a wobɛkamfo. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wubetumi anya mu bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa te sɛ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere, brayɛ, anaa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano a, sɛn na mekɔ m’awofo nkyɛn?
answer_twi_source: Paw bere bi a wo ne w’awofo nyinaa ho adwo mo, na mo ho bɛtɔ mo, na fa obu mu ka asɛmti no ho asɛm. Fi ase denam w’anigye ne ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubesua ade a wobɛda no adi so, na bisa sɛ ebia wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔne wo bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ afa asɛmti pɔtee no ho anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔne ahyehyɛde afoforo bɛyɛ biako na wɔakyekye mmoa ntam nkitahodie.
answer_twi_source: Wo ne Kuo Nkabom:Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ Kuo ahorow a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ GBV ano aduru ho no nkyɛn. Fa wo mmoa ma na sua biribi fi wɔn suahu no mu. Wo ne Afoforo Nkitahodi: Wo ne mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wobesiw GBV ano no nni nkitaho. Mobom a, mobetumi ama mo nne ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsi wɔ berɛ a ɔbarima rema ne ho so (ejaculating)
answer_twi_source: Berɛ a ɔbarima rema ne ho so (ejaculation) no, ɛyɛ berɛ a "semen" pue firi ne mu; eyi yɛ nsuo a "sperm" (ɔbarima mu nsuo/aba) wom. Ɛtaa si wɔ berɛ a ɔbarima no nya anigyeɛ a ɛkɔ soro paa (orgasm). Wɔ saa berɛ yi mu no, aba no fa akwan ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ ɔbarima no mu kɔsi sɛ ɛpue firi ne kɔteɛ (penis) ano
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam, ɔman, ne aban a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu di wɔ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔhyɛ na wɔhyɛ ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro no mu?
answer_twi_source: Aman, mpɔtam, ɔman ne aban a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu no dwumadi ahorow gu ahorow. Mpɔtam bi, ne aban a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu no di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔhyɛ na wɔhyɛ ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro no mu. Wobetumi ahyɛ mmara anaasɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ ne sɛ worenyɛ nyiyim a wɔnyɛ ho nkuran, ayɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ amanneɛ na wɔadi LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow a wɔabu so ho dwuma, na wɔakyekyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa LGBTQ+ mpɔtam hɔfo. Bio nso, aban ahorow betumi ne akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo, mmara ho abenfo, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ayɛ adwuma de ama LGBTQ+ hokwan ahorow anya nkɔso na wɔadi nsɛm ne nsunsuanso a ɛreba no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mihia m’awofo 'consent' na mayi nyinsɛn agu wɔ baabi a mete no? So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho nhia sɛ awofo ma kwan. Mmabun betumi anya nnwuma wɔ wɔn ankasa so, nanso wɔhyɛ nkuran sɛ wobenya obi a wogye no a ɔboa no. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahyɛ nyansa sɛ wɔmfa ɔpanyin bi nka ho mfa mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de akwan ahorow a egyina nnipa hokwan ahorow so adi dwuma, de akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de akwan a, egyina nnipa hokwan ahorow so adi dwuma de akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ denam: Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho hia a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so sɛ hokwan titiriw a nnipa wɔ a ɛhyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom, abusuabɔ pa, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nkuran. Dwuma a nhomasua di wɔ tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi te wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ase na wɔde di dwuma, a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, kokoam nnwuma, ne mmoa a ɛnyɛ nyiyim ka ho a wosi so dua. Nkitahodi a wɔne nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, awofo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bedi nkitaho de ahyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina adanse so, ɛfata mfe a wɔadi, na ɛka obiara ho a ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun ahofadi, wɔn ahorow ahorow, ne nidi ho nkuran. Ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi a wɔbɛboaboa ano de ahwehwɛ sɛ wobu akontaa, wɔyɛ no pefee, na wɔyɛ pɛ wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nnwuma ne nneɛma a wɔde ma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So telehealth adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de mmoa ama wɔ nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu, nyinsɛn, ne nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, telehealth dwumadie taa fa apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbɛtumi ama nimdie, akwankyerɛ, ne mmoa ama wɔ nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti ahodoɔ pii ho, a nea ɛka ho ne awoɔ ho nnuro, STI nhwehwɛmu, nyinsɛn ho dadwen, brayɛ akwahosan, ne nea ɛkeka ho. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi asusu saa nsɛmti yi ho, abua nsɛmmisa, de nkyerɛkyerɛ ama, de afotu ama, na mpo wɔakyerɛw nnuro ama obi anaasɛ wɔakra nhwehwɛmu sɛnea ɛho hia, ne nyinaa denam telefon so akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔbea ne dijitaal nsɛmka adi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow, adwene, ne nhumu wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na wɔama nne ahorow a wɔtaa de to nkyɛn anaasɛ wɔma ɛyɛ komm no ayɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔbea ne dijitaal nsɛm a wɔka adi dwuma de akyɛ wɔn suahu, adwene, ne nhumu wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Wobetumi ayɛ nea broni ka no 'blogs, vlogs, social media posts, anaa digital artwork' de ada wɔn adwene adi na wɔama nkurɔfo ate nsɛm a ɛho hia ho asɛm. Ɛdenam wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛka so no, mmabun betumi ama nne ahorow a wɔtaa de wɔn to nkyɛn anaasɛ wɔyɛ komm no ayɛ kɛse, na ama wɔanya tema ne ntease wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Dijitaal ahorow abasɛmka nso betumi ayɛ adwinnade a wɔde bɛkasa, ama tumi, ne asetra mu nsakrae, na ama mmabun ne afoforo adi nkitaho, akasa atia animtiaabu, na wɔahyɛ asɛm pa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwansideɛ ahorow bɛn na mmabun taa hyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔne awofo bɛkasa afa nna mu nsɛm, atipɛnfo nhyɛso,atemmu ho suro, aniwu ne sɛn na metumi adi akwanside yi so?
answer_twi_source: Akwansideɛ a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔne wɔn awofo bɛkasa afa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu nsɛm ho no bi ne: Atemmu ho suro; mmabun betumi ahaw wɔn ho wɔ sɛnea wɔn awofo bɛyɛ wɔn ade wɔ wɔn nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn ho, suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia wɔn anaa sɛ wɔrempene so. Aniwu: Nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo mu nsɛm ho a wɔbɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ no betumi ayɛ nea ɛnyɛ dɛ anaa sɛ ɛyɛ fɛre ma mmabun ne awofo nyinaa, na ɛma wɔn mpɛ sɛ wɔbɛka asɛm no ho asɛm. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wonni: Ebia mmabun binom bɛpere sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn nsusuii ne wɔn atenka horow ho asɛm yiye, na ama ayɛ den sɛ wɔne wɔn awofo befi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ so abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛho hia ho Akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi akwanside ahorow yi so no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛpaw bere ne beae a ɛfata a wɔbɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ kokoam nsɛm na wɔatew nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene so na ama wɔanya tebea a ahotɔ ne ahobammɔ wom. Sɛ wode anammɔn nketenkete te sɛ asɛmmisa tiawa bi a wubefi ase anaa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi abɔ m’ankasa me ho nsɛm ne me kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a mede intanɛt so dwumadibea ne sohyial media redi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe: Hwɛ na yɛ nsakrae wɔ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ sohyial media platform ahorow so no so na ama woahwɛ nea obetumi ahu wo nsɛm no so. Kwati sɛ wobɛkyɛ wo ho nsɛm te sɛ wo din nyinaa, bebia wote, telefon nɔma, anaa wosukuu wɔ baguam. Na ansa na wode bɛto gua no, susuw nkɛntɛnso a ebetumi aba ne nea ebia obehu no ho. Hwɛ yiye wɔ adamfofa abisade anaa nkitahodi a efi ahɔho hɔ a wubegye atom no ho. Fa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhwehwɛ akwan mmienu ansa na woatumi abue w'akaunt no di dwuma na ama w'akaunta no abɔ ne ho ban paa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw anaa ahokokwaw a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ mu, te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a wɔte ase, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wobisabisa ho, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a wɔkyerɛ ase, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a wɔyɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi wɔ abusuabɔ?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw anaa ahokokwaw a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ mu, te sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm a wɔte ase, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wobisabisa ho, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a wɔkyerɛ ase, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a wɔyɛ no ne atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi wɔ abusuabɔ kɛse denam: Mmabun a wɔma wɔn tumi ma wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nkrasɛm mu yiye na wɔsɔ hwɛ a ebetumi ama akwanhwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware, nsusuwii hunu, anaa nneyɛe a epira aba. Ahokokwaw a wɔde begye nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛma anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, abusuabɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho no kɔ so gye ho kyim na wɔkasa tia. Wɔn tumi a wɔde bɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo gyinabea ahorow a ɛyɛ den a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ti ho ase na wɔafa so akɔ anim wɔ akwan horow a ɛhyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ne nneɛma pa a efi mu ba ho nkuran so. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛma mmabun ayɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkrasɛm a ɛda adwene ahorow, osuahu ahorow, ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ pa ne obuo wom?
answer_twi_source: Ahotoso ne obuo: Wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ na wo ho tɔ wo sɛ woyɛ wo ho. Wo hokafo (hokafo) tie wo, wobu w’adwenkyerɛ sɛ ɛsom bo, na wɔnhyɛ wo mma wonyɛ biribiara. Nokwaredi ne nkitahodi a emu da hɔ: Mobetumi ne mo ho mo ho abɔ biribiara ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na momfa nokwaredi afa biribiara ho, a mo nkate ne mo ahiade ka ho. Pɛyɛ ne atɛntrenee: Wote nka sɛ wowɔ asɛm a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ abusuabɔ no mu. Wɔbom si gyinae, na suban biara nni hɔ a ɛhyɛ so. Mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ: Mokyekye mo ho mo ho na mohyɛ mo ho mo ho nkonimdi ho afahyɛ. Wote nka sɛ wɔboa wo ma wodi wo botae ahorow akyi. Ahye a ɛfata: Mo baanu nyinaa bu mo ho mo ho mo honam ne nkate fam ahunmu. Wote nka sɛ ɛyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi wɔ nneɛma a wunsiesiee wo ho mmaa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ dɛmdi ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ yehu na yɛkasa tia saa anansesɛm ahorow yi, na mmom yegye nokwasɛm ahorow no tom de yɛ ɔman a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wogye tom kɛse ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm. 1. ANANSESƐM:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no ntumi nyɛ adwuma anaasɛ wonni nyansa pii. NOKWARE:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no tumi yɛ adwuma na wɔn ani da hɔ te sɛ obiara. 2.MYTH: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm da adi bere nyinaa. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm pii yɛ nea wontumi nhu, te sɛ adwenemyare anaa nyarewa a enni sabea. 3.MYTH: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no wɔ akokoduru a ɛkanyan adwene. .NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm nyɛ abran anaasɛ nhyɛsofo esiane wɔn dɛmdi nkutoo nti. 4. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ ankorankoro awerɛhosɛm. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu 5.ANANSE: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm yɛ adesoa ma ɔmanfo. NOKWARE:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm yɛ ɔmanfo a wɔboa. 6. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ "wodi so nkonim". NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm nyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ "wodi so nkonim", na mmom ɛyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ wogye tom. 7.ANANSE: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no nyɛ wɔn a wɔn ani gye nna ho anaasɛ wɔn ani nnye wɔn ho. NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ ne wɔn ho a ɛyɛ fɛ te sɛ obiara 8. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm fi awofo a wɔnyɛ papa anaa awosu mu nkwaadɔm bɔne. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm no mfi awofo a wɔnyɛ papa anaa awosu mu nkwaadɔm bɔne, na mmom ɛyɛ awosu mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu 9. ANANSESƐM:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ntumi nsi wɔn ankasa gyinae. NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm tumi si wɔn ankasa gyinae ne nea wɔpaw 10. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ aduruyɛ mu asɛm, ɛnyɛ asetra mu asɛm. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ aduruyɛ ne asetra mu asɛm, na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so de ka obi ho na wotumi nya bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ m'adwene ne me hyeɛ akyerɛ nnamfo, hokafoɔ ne ahokafo a  me ne wonwɔ nna mu nkitahodi ɛfa nna mu nsɛm a  m’ani gye  ho?
answer_twi_source: Fa "me"kasafua  di dwuma . Ka nokware/kasa pefee. Hyehyɛ ahyeɛ a emu da hɔ. Tie wɔn yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsunsuansoɔ bɔne a mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu adwennwen (puberty stress) bɛtumi de aba adwene mu ahoɔden so wɔ bere tenten mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi de wɔn ho hwɛ ne atenka mu yiedie adi kan?
answer_twi_source: Asiane a Ɛkɔ Anim a Ɛwɔ Adwene ne Nkate Mu: Adwennwen a ɛkyɛ anaa enni sabea wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obenya adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa adidi mu haw no ayɛ kɛse. Nkɛntɛnso a Enya wɔ Bu a Wobu Ho: Adwennwen a ɛkɔ so ne osuahu ahorow a enye a wonya wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no betumi anya obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, nipadua ho mfonini, ne yiyedi nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso akosi mpanyin afe so. Abusuabɔ mu Nsɛnnennen: Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobegyina adwennwen a efi mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ano no betumi aka abusuabɔ a ɛda wɔne abusuafo, nnamfo, ne ɔdɔfo ntam. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ne nkate mu yiyedi adi kan denam: Wɔn ho a wɔde bedi dwuma: ayamye ne ntease a wɔde bedi wɔn ho dwuma, titiriw wɔ mmere a adwennwen anaa ɔhaw wom mu. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di te sɛ nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa afotufo a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a ɛho hia no. Akwan a Wɔfa so Gyina Ayaresa Mu a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ahomegye, adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi, ne asetra mu abusuabɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ na wɔde adi dwuma de adi adwennwen ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ nkate mu yiyedi ho nkuran. Ahye a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Ahye a wode besi hɔ wɔ tebea horow anaa abusuabɔ a ɛhaw adwene ho na wode dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigye, abotɔyam, ne ahomegye ba di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ntetee anaa nhomasua bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo hia na wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho ama mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo hia ntetee anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, adwenemhaw ho nhwehwɛmu ne, nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwenemhaw so, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, nnipa ntam nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ahyeɛ a wɔde besi hɔ, ne wɔn ankasa hwɛ ho. Nhomasua ne ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ nso ho hia na ama wɔakura ahokokwaw ne tema mu wɔ adwuma a wɔne mmabun a wɔahaw no yɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ ayɔnkofa pa?
answer_twi_source: Obu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho Wɔn Ho: adwene, wɔn atenka, ne wɔn ahye. Ahotoso: Wɔn ho a wogye di na wɔte nka sɛ wogye wɔn di. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn. Pɛyɛ: Asɛyɛde ne gyinaesi a wɔkyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mmoa: Wɔboa wɔn ho wɔn ho botae ne wɔn apɛde. Ahobammɔ: Sɛ́ wobɛte nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ wɔ nipadua ne ntenka fam wɔ ayɔnkofa no mu. Akasakasa a wobesiesie wɔ obu mu a wonni nitan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne intanɛt ne "digital" abrabɔ pa, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Intanɛt ne digyital abrabɔ pa ka nnyinasosɛm ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa asɛdeɛ ne obuo nneyɛeɛ ho wɔ digyital mmeaeɛ"digital spaces". Wɔho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne ahobammɔ so bere a wɔrenya nsɛm, wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu wɔ Intanɛt so no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a  ɛmma wɔmfa ɔman sika nni dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa sika a ɔman de boa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no gu ahorow egyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Mmeae bi wɔ mmara a ɛbara anaasɛ ɛbara sɛ wɔmfa ɔman sika te sɛ Medicaid nni dwuma mma nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwuma gye sɛ wɔ mmonnaato, abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da, anaa wɔde wɔn nkwa to asiane mu. Saa anohyeto ahorow yi betumi de sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow aba ankorankoro a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho hwɛ so, titiriw wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to ɔman insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow so de tua apomoden ho ka no. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ɔman sika a wɔde boa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ne sɛnea ebetumi anya ɔhwɛ a wobenya so nkɛntɛnso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo ntetan nsɛm a wɔbɔ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsakrae ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ nnam, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo asetena mu nsakrae pa kyerɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu ahorow, ne ɔmanfo a wɔtrɛw mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhyiamu a wɔbɛma mmabun atumi akyɛ wɔn nsɛm, akasa ama wɔn hokwan ahorow, na wɔaboaboa afoforo ano atwa ASRH nsɛm ho ahyia denam abɛɛfo ntetan ɔsatu ne dwumadi so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkitahodi hokwan ahorow a wɔne atipɛnfo, afotufo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bɛhyɛ ho nkuran de ama nne ahorow ayɛ kɛse na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae. Abɛɛfo ntetan dwuma adebɔ a wɔde bɛka mmabun akannifoɔ a wɔtrɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu de ayɛ adwuma, tumi, ne asetena mu asɛdeɛ ho adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STIs), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu?
answer_twi_source: STI yɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a efi ɔbea no awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo mu, anaa anom ka ho. Ebetumi afi mmoawa mmoawa ahodoɔ. STI a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwehwɛmu no ho hia efisɛ: Ebia STI pii remfa sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛda adi mma, na ɛde ɔyare a wonim ho hwee aba. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu wo tebea no ma wonya hokwan hu ntɛm na wɔsa no yare ntɛm a ebetumi asiw akwahosan mu nsunsuanso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ, te sɛ awo a wontumi nwo, yare a ɛma obi ho hyehye no wɔ akyi berɛmo mu ne ade. Nhwɛhwɛ mu ma wotumi sa yare wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw STI mu akɔ wɔn a wɔne wɔn da mu no so, na ɛma nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa kuo nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mehu nyinsɛn ho haw ahorow  na manya ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ne Mmoa: Akwahosan ho dwumayɛni: W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no yɛ ade titiriw a wode bedi dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn ho haw ahorow ho. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama, abua nsɛmmisa, na wɔadi nsɛm biara a ɛbɛsɔre ho dwuma. Adesua a Wɔyɛ Ansa na Wɔawo: Ayaresabea ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae pii de adesua a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo ma. Saa adesua ahorow yi ka nsɛmti te sɛ awo, nufu a wɔde ma, ne mmofra a wɔawo wɔn foforo hwɛ ho asɛm. Mpɔtam Hɔ Akwahosan Dwumadibea ahorow: Akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow taa wɔ nneɛma a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔyem, a nsɛm a ɛfa ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, aduan pa, ne mmoa a wɔde ma ho ka ho. Ntrɛwmu ne Mmoa Ntrɛwmu: Ebia ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  Planned Parenthood anaa mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow benya telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ma nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so Nneɛma: Abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  American Pregnancy Association, BabyCenter, ne What to Expect de nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn, hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo, ne awo ho ma. Mmoa Akuw: Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ kuw a wɔboa ankorankoro a wɔyem mu a, ebetumi ama wɔate mpɔtam hɔfo nka na wɔanya baabi a wɔbɛkyɛ osuahu ahorow. Hwehwɛ mpɔtam hɔ akuw anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow. Ɔhwɛ a Wobɛnya Ansa na Awo: Insurance Coverage: Sɛ wowɔ insurance a, bisa wo deɛ ɔhwɛ wo no nkyɛn na ɔte wo coverage wɔ prenatal care ne nnwuma a ɛfa ho no ase. Medicaid anaa CHIP: Sɛ wunni insurance a, nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Medicaid anaa Mmofra Akwahosan Insurance Program (CHIP) betumi atua ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo no ho ka. Hwɛ sɛ wofata na sɛ ɛho hia a, fa wo ho hyɛ mu. Mpɔtam Akwahosan Asoɛe: Saa mmeae yi de ɔhwɛ a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee ma wɔn a wɔfata a egyina sika a wonya so. Mpɔtam Hɔ Ayaresabea ne Ayaresabea kɛseɛ: Di mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea anaa ayaresabea ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ na bisa wɔn hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo ne akwan a wɔfa so tua sika ho asɛm. Ahyehyɛde Ahorow a Wɔnyɛ Mfaso: Ahyehyɛde ahorow bi a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso de sika fam mmoa anaa nnwuma a ɛho ka sua de hwɛ wɔn ansa na wɔawo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na tumi mu nkyekyem, mfe a obi adi mu nsonsonoe, asetra mu gyinabea, ne nneɛma afoforo di wɔ tebea horow a ebia nhyɛso betumi aba mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi saa nkɔso ahorow yi so nkunim denneennen na ahobammɔ wom?
answer_twi_source: Tumi a nkyekyem wɔ mu, mfe a obi adi mu nsonsonoe, asetra mu gyinabea, ne nneɛma afoforo betumi anya tebea horow a nhyɛso betumi aba no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Mmabun betumi ahyia tumi a ɛnkari pɛ wɔ abusuabɔ a wɔne wɔn ahokafo a wɔn mfe akɔ anim, tumidifo, anaa atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso kɛse anaa asetra mu dibea kɛse wɔ mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na mmabun atumi afa saa nneɛma a ɛyɛ den yi so denneennen na ahobammɔ wom no, wobetumi aka wɔn ahye ho asɛm, aka wɔn anohyeto ahorow ho asɛm pefee, na sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ a, wɔahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo anaa wɔn atipɛnfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So yebetumi de botae ahorow asi yɛn ani so wɔ check-ins ho, te sɛ nsɛmti pɔtee bi ho nkitahodie a yɛbɛma ayɛ kɛse anaasɛ tumi a yɛde bedi ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma na yɛabom asi gyinae yie?
answer_twi_source: Fa botae ahorow sisi yɛn ani so wɔ yɛn nsrahwɛ a yɛkɔ hɔ daa no mu, te sɛ nkitahodi a yɛbɛma akɔ soro wɔ nsɛmti pɔtee bi ho anaasɛ tumi a yɛde bedi ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma na yɛabom asi gyinae a ɛbɛma atu mpɔn. Kyerɛ mmeae a yɛpɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn adwene si yɛn mmɔdenbɔ so na yɛde anammɔn a yebetumi de adi dwuma de adu yɛn botae ahorow ho si hɔ. Hwɛ yɛn nkɔsoɔ mu daa na yɛbom nni nsɛntitiriw ho afahyɛ, hyɛ yɛn bo a yɛasi sɛ yɛbɛbue nkitahodie na yɛaboa yɛn ho yɛn ho no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma nsaano-adesua anaa dwumadi ahorow a mfaso wɔ so wɔ asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua taa de osuahu mu adesua dwumadi ahorow te sɛ asɛde agorɔdi, kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne asetra mu nsusuwii ankasa ka ho. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ ankorankoro nkɔso nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn a wɔde bedi dwuma denam dwumadi ahorow a wɔyɛ so, ne mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nsaano mu adesua ma nteaseɛ, akoraeɛ, ne asetena mu nimdeɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu no yɛ kɛseɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu akwan pa a mɛfa so agyina nkate bɔne te sɛ aniwu anaa awerɛhow a ebetumi aba bere a nna mu akɔnnɔ epegya ne mu no? (adebɔ ho aguadidan ahorow, ɔne w’adamfo bi kasa)
answer_twi_source: Adebɔ Ho Nneɛma: Sɛ woda wo ho adi denam nkyerɛwee, mfoni-drɔɔ, nnwom, anaa asaw so a, ebetumi ayɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so adi nkate bɔne ho dwuma. Wo ne Adamfo a Wogye Wo Di Nkasa: Sɛ woka wo nkate ho asɛm a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woante nka sɛ wonyɛ ankonam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwene a wɔde si biribi so betumi aboa me ma madi adwennwen, dadwen, anaa nkate horow a ɛboro so so?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a wode susuw nneɛma ho betumi aboa wo ma woakɔ so ayɛ wo ho wɔ mprempren bere yi mu, na ɛbɛtew adwenem naayɛ ne nea atwam anaa daakye ho dadwen so. Ɛma wonya nnwinnade a wɔde bedi nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba ho dwuma wɔ kommyɛ ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano kɛse so, sen sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ade ntɛmntɛm. Adwene mu adwene hyɛ nkate a emu yɛ den a wubegye atom ho nkuran, na ɛma wutumi hwɛ a worenhyɛ wo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pa a ɛkyerɛ obu, ɛboa, na ɛfa amammerɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pa denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mmeae a wɔhwɛ mmabun nsɛm ho titiriw no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wonim mmabun akwahosan ho nimdeɛ, wobu wɔn haw ahorow, na wɔde kokoam ɔhwɛ ma. Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ma mmerante ne mmabaa titiriw a wɔbɛhwehwɛ nso betumi ayɛ nea mfaso wɔ so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn wɔ wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn na wɔka amammerɛ anaa wɔn ankasa pɛ biara a wɔpɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na honam mu nkwammoa ahorow ka m’ahoɔden ne sɛnea meda?
answer_twi_source: Nkwammoaa betumi anya w’ahoɔden ne sɛnea woda bere a worekɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu so nkɛntɛnso kɛse: Estrogen a ɛkɔ soro ma mmeawa nya ahoɔden kɛse sen sɛnea wɔtaa yɛ bere a testosterone dodow a ɛkɔ soro wɔ mmarimaa mu no betumi ama wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkɔ akyi no akɔ soro. Onyin a Ɛma Wonyin: Onyin hormone a ɛba bere a woadu mpanyin afe so no betumi ama woate ɔbrɛ nka kɛse bere a wo nipadua nyin ntɛmntɛm no. Melatonin: Nsakrae a ɛba hormone dodow mu nso betumi aka wo nna. Ebia melatonin, hormone bi a ɛma woda no yɛ adwuma wɔ mmere ahorow mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na ɛde nsakrae aba bere a wote nka sɛ woada anaasɛ woanyan no mu. Circadian Rhythm: Nsakrae a ɛba wo nipadua mu no betumi asɛe wo nipadua no awosu mu nna ne ɔsɔre kyinhyia no bere tiaa bi, na ama ayɛ den sɛ wobɛda anaasɛ wobɛsɔre wɔ mmere a wɔtaa nya no mu. Sɛ wode nna ho nhyehyɛe si hɔ daa, kwati caffeine ne ɛlɛtrɔnik mfiri ansa na woada, na woayɛ baabi a wobɛda a, ebetumi aboa ma nna atu mpɔn wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa adwuma bi a ɛwɔhɔ ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛ wɔn so mu, na sɛ ɛho hia a, ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛɛ wɔn so no betumi ayɛ: Ɔhaw ho telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ ne mmoa telefon a wɔde akasamafo a wɔatete wɔn a wɔbɛtumi de mmoa ne nsɛm ama ntɛm ara na ɛyɛ adwuma. Afotu ne ayaresa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ adwenemhaw a wɔsan nya ne wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu ho. Aduruyɛ adwuma ma nneɛma ahorow, broni ka no 'Medical services', baabi a wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no betumi anya ayaresa, asɛnnibea adanse a wɔbɛboaboa ano, ne mmoa a wɔde di akyi. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne akuw a wɔboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu titiriw, a wɔde atipɛnfo mmoa, mmara kwan so mmoa, ne nneɛma foforo a wobenya ma. Mmara kwan so mmoa ayaresabea ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde mmoa ma wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho atɛntrenee nhyehyɛe no mu a wɔbɛfa so, a polisifo amanneɛbɔ a wɔde bɛma ne ahyɛde a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban a wɔhwehwɛ ka ho. Mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi denam mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu afotufo a wobetumi aboa ma wɔde wɔn abata nnwuma a ɛfata ho no so. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so denam wɛbsaet ahorow ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mɛtumi afa so ama m’adwene mu apɔmuden ne yiedie atu mpɔn wɔ mpanin mu kɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: W’adwene mu akwahosan ne wo yiyedi a wobɛhwɛ so wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ho hia kɛse ma yiyedi nyinaa. Akwan bi ni: Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ: Gye bere ma dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, mu te sɛ anigyede, adwinni, nnwom, anaa akenkan. Nipadua mu Akwahosan: Fa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa, nnuan a ahoɔden wom, ne Mm nna a ɛfata di kan. Nipadua akwahosan boa ma obi nya adwene mu yiyedi. Adwene ne Ahomegye: Fa adwene mu nhumu akwan, ahome a emu dɔ, anaa adwennwen nko di dwuma na ama adwennwen so atew na ama w’adwene atu mpɔn. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Ka wo nkate ne wo haw ho asɛm kyerɛ mpanyimfo a wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso, nnamfo, anaa ɔfotufo bi. Ɛho nhia sɛ wo nkutoo na wofa nsɛnnennen mu. To Screen Time: Tew screen bere so wɔ mfiri ahorow so na gye w’ahome wɔ sohyial media so. Bere pii a wɔde hwɛ screen so betumi aka adwenemyare.Fa Daa Si Hɔ: Sɛ wowɔ da biara da dwumadi a, ebetumi ama woayɛ nhyehyɛe na woagyina pintinn, na ɛno betumi ama adwene mu yiyedi atu mpɔn. Anigyede ne Adebɔ: Fa wo ho hyɛ adebɔ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma w’ani gye te sɛ akyerɛw, mfoniniyɛ, anaa nnwom a wobɛbɔ mu. Sua Nneɛma a Wobɛtumi Agyina Ano: Yɛ akwan pa a wobɛfa so agyina ano a wobɛfa so adi adwennwen ho dwuma, te sɛ ahome a wobɛhome a emu dɔ, kyerɛwtohɔ a wobɛkyerɛw, anaa wo ne w’adamfo bi a wobɛkasa. Anamɔn a wobɛyɛ ntɛm de ahwɛ w’adwene mu akwahosan no betumi anya w’anigye ne sɛnea wubetumi agyina ano nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛdeɛ bɛn na awofoɔ yɛ de boa mmabun ma wɔkɔhu dɔkota sɛ woduru wonyin bere a?
answer_twi_source: Wɔboaboa 'facilitators' (nhyehyeɛ/akwantuo). Nateka mu mmoa. Wɔkasa ma wo. Hyɛ wo nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn na m'anya SRH mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛfata mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya saa mmoa yi afi skuul ne mpɔtam ayaresabea. Hotlines ne abɛɛfo ntentanfidie a yɛfrɛ no ''internet'' so tumi boa. Youth-friendly clinics so boa ma mmabun ka wɔn haw a fɛreɛ biara nnim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsɛnnennen pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a LGBTQ + mmabun, mmabun a wonni afie, anaa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia bere a ɛfa bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) ho no? (mmerɛw a ɛkɔ soro, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde boa a wonni) .
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔn ho nni banbɔ anaa wɔnhwɛ wɔn yie no na bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) tumi to wɔn paa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi m’ankasa me gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow akyi bere a meda so ara ne m’atipɛnfo anya ayɔnko pa?
answer_twi_source: Paw wo adwumakuw no nyansam: Fa nnamfo a wobu wo gyinapɛn ahorow na wɔboa no twa wo ho hyia, na hyɛ nneyɛe pa ne gyinaesi ho nkuran. Di wo ho nokware: Fa wo gyidi ne wo gyinapɛn "values" ahorow di kan, sɛ ɛsono w’atipɛnfo de mpo a, na kwati sɛ wubegyae mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi apɛ m’ankasa adwenemyare ho ahiade ahorow a mɛkamfo akyerɛ no mu berekro a meboa ɔbabun a ɔte ase a sebi wɔadi dɛm no nso?
answer_twi_source: Ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ wo ho bere a woreboa ɔbabun a wadi dɛm no. Sɛnea wobɛkari pɛ ni: Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi bere a wuhia ahomegye no. Fa wo ho hwɛ: Gye bere ma dwumadi ahorow a ɛboa wo ma wugye w’ahome na wunya ahoɔden bio. Hwehwɛ mmoa ma wo ho: Wo ne ɔyaresafo, ɔfotufo, anaa kuw a wɔboa nnipa a wɔhwɛ afoforo nkasa. Di nkitaho pefee: Ka w’ahiade ne nea wuntumi nyɛ ho asɛm kyerɛ ɔbabun no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahu na yɛayɛ ho biribi wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu wɔ nkitahodi mu, te sɛ nipadua mu kasa ne anim yɛbea, na ama ntease ne nkitahodi awie ntease?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa te sɛ nipadua mu kasa ne n’anim yɛbea betumi ada nneɛma pii adi afa sɛnea obi te nka ho. Tie saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi bere a worebɔ nkɔmmɔ na ama woate ɔfoforo no atinka ase yiye. Da tema adi denam wɔn nipadua kasa a wobɛda no adi, a wobɛkɔ so ahwɛ wɔn ani so, na woayɛ nneɛma a ɛboa te sɛ wo ti a wobɛbɔ anaasɛ wobɛka a ɛma awerɛhyem.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ meyɛ LGBTQ +?
answer_twi_source: Fa w'adwene si wo nkateɛ, obi a w'ani gye ne ho, ne wo nnamfofa so berɛ biara. Hunu sɛ nna mu su ne sɛdeɛ obi hunu ne ho (sexual orientation and gender identity) bɛtumi asesa wɔ w'abrabɔ nyinaa mu. Hwehwɛ mmoa firi mpɔtam hɔfoɔ anaa ankorɛankorɛ a wɔbɛtumi akyerɛ wo kwan na wɔate wo aseɛ berɛ a worehwehwɛ sɛ wobɛhunu wo su paa no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ mu a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho adwene titiriw te sɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sikakorabea, sika a wɔde bɛto mu, ne boseabɔ ho ntease. Nim a wonim sɛnea wɔkenkan sikasɛm ho amanneɛbɔ na wɔkyerɛ ase, a sikakorabea nkrataa, sika a wɔde gye sika, ne sika a wɔbɔ ka ho. Sikasɛm mu nneɛma ne nnwuma te sɛ sikakorabea akontaabu, sika a wɔde gye sika, boseabɔ, ne insurance ho nimdeɛ a wubehu. Ahokokwaw a wobenya wɔ botae a wɔde besisi wɔn ani so, sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, ne asiane ho nhyehyɛe mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ sɛ wɔrehyia awo ho nsɛnnennen anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn a?
answer_twi_source: Nea ɛka eyi ho ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ awofo, ahwɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobetumi de mmoa ama na wɔde nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma abɔ wɔn ho nkɔmmɔ. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow nso betumi ama mmabun a wɔrefa osuahu ahorow a ɛte saa ara mu no anya mpɔtam hɔfo ne ntease. Bio nso, afotu anaa ayaresa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi adwumayɛfo a wɔfata hɔ no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi wɔn nkate ho dwuma na wɔanya akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so agyina ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia saa nsusuwii a ɛnteɛ yi na wɔakamfo ntease a ɛyɛ nketenkete wɔ adwuma a wɔn a wɔhwɛ no betumi adi wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano no ho?
answer_twi_source: Anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho no bi ne: Atosɛm: Sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ wɔ awerɛhyem wɔ tebea no ho nkutoo a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu. Atosɛm: Bere nyinaa na nea ɔhwɛ no de ne ho gye mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wohyia nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no tee. Atosɛm: Asiane wɔ hɔ a obi a ɔhwɛ no de ne ho gye mu na entu mpɔn. Atosɛm: Ɛnyɛ m’asɛyɛde sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ obi foforo tebea mu.
