Mmabun betumi akasa atia saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi denam ntease nketenkete a wɔbɛma anya wɔ wɔn a wɔhwɛ no de wɔn ho gye mu ho, si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔbom yɛ ade so dua, boa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu, na wɔde ahobammɔ di kan bere a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So kasasin anaa kasa pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a metumi de afi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase wɔ obu ne bɔkɔɔ kwan so?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afi ase denam biribi te sɛ, "Madwen m'akwahosan ho pii nnansa yi, na na mepɛ sɛ me ne wo kasa fa nsɛmmisa bi a mewɔ fa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho." "Me" nsɛm a wode bedi dwuma no betumi aboa ma woada wo atinka ne w'adwene adi a woremfa asodi no nto so anaasɛ wommɔ sobo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de me ho ahyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nkuran na wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no mu? (Wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow tu wɔn ho ma, nhyiam ahorow a wɔkɔ)
answer_twi_source: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so de wvn ho ahyɛ mu: Wo ne Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wotu wɔn ho ma: Ebia mpɔtam hɔ ASRH ahyehyɛde ahorow behia mmoa wɔ nsɛm a esisi, sohyial media, anaa adwumayɛ ho nnwuma mu. Nhyiam anaa Nhyiam Ahorow a Wobɛkɔ: Kyerɛ wo mmoa na wo ne afoforo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ baguam nhyiam ahorow ase no nni nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na 'hormone' nti me nya akisikuru 'acne' mpofirim?
answer_twi_source: Hormone' ahorow, titiriw 'testosterone', betumi akanyan wo honam ani ngo ntini ahorow no ma ayɛ ngo pii. Saa ngo a ɛboro so yi, ne honam ani nkwammoaa a awuwu no betumi asiw (akyere) ntini no mu na ama obi anya akisikuru. Akisikuru taa ba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu efisɛ hormone dodow sakra, na ngo a ɛkɔ soro no betumi ama akisikuru, akisikuru tuntum, ne fitaa aba. Sɛ wohwɛ wo honam ani denam samina a ɛnyɛ den anaa ade a wɔde tew ho a wode bɛhohoro brɛoo so, na wode nneɛma a oduruyɛfo a ɔhwɛ honam ani yare kamfo kyerɛ a wode bedi dwuma no betumi aboa ma woadi akisikuru ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa nnamfoɔ anaa sɛ tipɛnfoɔ a wɔwɔ nnipadua mu haw?
answer_twi_source: Tie wɔn a wummu wɔn atɛn na hyɛ wɔn nkuran. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔnhu wahyeɛ na boa wɔn ma wɔnsua sɛdeɛ yɛkasa. Kyerɛ wɔn baabi a wɔbɛnya mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnwuma anaa mmoa foforo bɛn na wɔtaa de ma ka dabere ne adan ho mmoa ho de di mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu ahiade ahorow nyinaa ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ebia wobetumi anya dabere ne adan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho ka sua anaasɛ wɔrentua hwee mma mmabun a wontumi ntua ho ka. Mpɛn pii no, aban banyɛbea ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔnyɛ adwuma mfa hwehwɛ mfasoɔ (nonprofit organizations) ma atenaeɛ a yɛntua hwee anaa yɛtua sika kakra bi ma wɔn a wɔhia mmoa.Bio nso, sika mmoa ahyehyɛdeɛ, mpɔtam hɔ nneyɛeɛ, ne mmoa sika a ɛfiri mmaa mmaa bɛtumi atua ɛka a ɛfa atenaeɛ, aduane, akwantuo, ne nneɛma titiriw foforɔ a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ ahohia mu hia ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn abɔ me ho ban sɛ efri enyinsen ho ne nna mu ayaereɛ  hokafoɔ nneyɛeɛ a sɛ mengyi nipa na me neneda wɔ hɔ no di?
answer_twi_source: Fa 'condoms' di dwuma. Ɛno na ɛyɛ kwan paa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So wobetumi de nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ adi dwuma sɛ awo ano aduru a wɔde siw ano daa, anaasɛ wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma bere ne bere mu wɔ tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu nkutoo?
answer_twi_source: Wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ bedi dwuma bere ne bere mu wɔ tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu, te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaasɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a entumi nyɛ adwuma yiye. Ɛnyɛ nea wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde besi nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano daa ananmu, na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo hwehwɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so asi nyinsɛn ano bere tenten de asiw nyinsɛn ano a ɛkɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ahye a ɛfata a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde si hɔ wɔ abusuabɔ a wɔne nnipa a wɔwɔ nna mu osuahu ahorow gu ahorow mu?
answer_twi_source: Bu wɔn akwantu no: Obiara hwehwɛ nna mu wɔ n’ankasa ahoɔhare so. Kwati nhyɛso anaa atemmu. Di nkitaho pefee: Ka w’anidaso ne ahotɔ dodow ho asɛm. Tie wɔn de na bu wɔn ahye nso. Fa w’adwene si nea wokyɛ so: Sɛ́ anka wobɛtwe adwene asi nsonsonoe ahorow so no, fa w’adwene si nea mobom ani gye ho ne nea ɛma mo abusuabɔ mu yɛ den no so. Mommom sua ade: Momma mo ani nnye ho sɛ mubesua wɔn nna mu osuahu ahorow a momfa mo ho nhyɛ mu. Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ohu nneɛma pii a, ebetumi ama yɛanya ntease. Fa ahye a mo nyinaa hyia: Monnye ntom wɔ obu suban a ɛfa obiara ho, a osuahu mfa ho (e.g., pene, nkitahodi).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam nkitahodi ne nkabom ahorow boa ma adwumayɛ ne nimdeɛ sesa wɔ aman a wohyia ASRH nsɛnnennen ne hokwan ahorow a ɛte saa ara mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam nkitahodi ne nkabom boa ma adwumayɛ ne nimdeɛ sesa wɔ aman a wohyia ASRH nsɛnnennen ne hokwan ahorow a ɛte saa ara mu. Saa nkitahodibea ahorow yi ma wonya akwan a wɔbɛfa so akyɛ nneyɛe pa, ayɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nhyehyɛe, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛhyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STIs) na mɛyɛ dɛn asiw bi ano?
answer_twi_source: STI yɛ nyarewa a efi onipa biako hɔ kɔ foforo mu denam nna mu nkitahodi biara a ɛyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a efi awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo mu, anaa anom. STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba no bi ne chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis, HPV (onipa papillomavirus), HIV/AIDS (nnipa nipadua mu nkwammoaa a ɛko tia nyarewa mmoawa), ne herpes. Sɛ obi nya STI a, obetumi ada sɛnkyerɛnne ne nsɛnkyerɛnne adi anaasɛ ɔrenkyerɛ sɛnkyerɛnne biara ntɛm ara. Sɛ ɛhaw wo sɛ ebia wowɔ STI a, ɛho hia sɛ wokɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no kɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu foforo. STI a Wobesiw Ano: Ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so sen biara a wobɛfa so asiw STI ano ne sɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi nna mu nkitahodi biara ho. Nanso, sɛ wo ne obi da a, fa kɔndɔm di dwuma. Sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma a, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya STI ne nyinsɛn nso so. Kɔndɔm: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm (latex anaa polyurethane) di dwuma bere nyinaa na wode di dwuma bere nyinaa wɔ nna mu adeyɛ biara mu a, ebetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya STI so kɛse. Dental dams: Dental dams yɛ plastic ahinanan a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔde ano reda de ayɛ akwanside wɔ w’ano ne wo hokafo no hokafo awotwaa ntam. ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya STI bere a wɔde ano reda no so. Nkitahodi: Wo ne wo hokafo (hokafo) nkasa pefee ne nokwaredi mu fa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ sɛ ebia wowɔ STI ho. Sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wowɔ STI a, ɛho hia sɛ wodi ayaresa no so na wowie na woma wo hokafo nso gye ayaresa. Vaccination: Vaccines betumi abɔ wo ho ban afi STIs binom te sɛ HPV ne Hepatitis B. Kɔ akwahosan asoɛe a ɛbɛn wo na wo ne mmabun akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkasa ma wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne vaccination.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtew animtiaabu so a metumi aboa? (akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, nnwuma a mmabun di anim) .
answer_twi_source: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so a ebia wobɛtumi aboa (hwɛ wɔn mfeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu ni): Ghana Healthn Service, Mariestopes Ghana Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): Ebia wɔwɔ mmabun nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛdi nkitaho ne afoforɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so. Ghana Mmabun Apam a Ɛhwɛ Awo Akwahosan So (GYARH): https://ghanasrhralliance.org/
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asɛyɛde bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma no wɔ wɔ hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ ma wɔayɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini a edi mu na obu wo mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ wɔ asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ ma wɔyɛ mfonini a ɛyɛ pɛ na ɛkyerɛ obuo: Nhwehwɛmu ne Nkɔmmɔdie: Wɔne mmubuafoɔ ne mmubuafoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛbisabisa nnipa a wɔyɛ nokware ne nsɛm a wɔka. Diversity in Casting and Production: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm a wɔde wɔn bɛka adebɔ nhyehyɛe no ho de adwene ahorow aba. Nsusuwii hunu a ɛyɛ den: Wɔbɛkɔ akyiri asen tropes a wɔabrɛ na wɔayɛ dɛmdi ne nna mu nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho mfonini.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi mmabun ahiade ne nokwasɛm ahorow a ɛrekɔ so wɔ wiase a ɛresakra ntɛmntɛm mu, a nsɛm a ɛrepue a ɛfa abɛɛfo ntetan apomoden mfiridwuma, wim nsakrae, ne wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyeɛ nhyehyeɛ bɛtumi adi mmabun ahiadeɛ ne nokwasɛm a ɛrekɔ so wɔ wiase a ɛresakra ntɛmntɛm mu no ho dwuma denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ daa wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no mu de ahunu nsonsonoeɛ, nsɛm a ɛnhyia, ne nsɛm a ɛrepue a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho. Mmabun, ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim, ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu de ahwehwɛ wɔn adwene ne wɔn adwene wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa no ho. Ɔkwan a egyina nnipa hokwan so a wɔde bɛka mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ na wɔde adi dwuma ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ egyina nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pɛyɛ, nyiyimu a wɔnyɛ, ne kyɛfa a ntease wom so. Nsunsuansoɔ a mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu nya wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu nsunsuansoɔ so a wɔbɛhwɛ na wɔasusu ho na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no mu sɛdeɛ ɛfata. Nneɛma foforo a wogye tom na wɔde abɛɛfo ntetan akwahosan ho mfiridwuma di dwuma de trɛw nna ne awo apomoden ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya mu, ama ɔsom adwuma a wɔde ma no atu mpɔn, na wɔama mmabun tumi ma wɔapaw wɔn apomoden ne yiedi a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi atenka fam nsɛnnennen a ɛba bere a me ne obi bɛbɔ ne ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no ho dwuma? (pow, ahoɔyaw, nkitahodi) .
answer_twi_source: Pow yɛ asetena fã a ɛfata. Sua biribi fi mu na kɔ w’anim. Fa w’adwene si obuo a wubenya wɔ wo ho so. Ahoɔyaw: Wo ne wo hokafo nkasa mfa ahobammɔ a wunni ho. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee betumi aboa ma wɔanya ahotoso. Nkitahodi: Fa nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛfata di dwuma de siesie ntawntawdi na fa fapem a ɛyɛ den ma mo abusuabɔ. kasa kyerɛ mmabun akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ intanɛt so anaa ankasa
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama  nhyehyɛe ne mmara ahorow a ɛbɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ ano aduru ne nhomasua ho nnwuma a edi mũ ho ban bere a wobu abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ ahofadi ne kokoamsɛmu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akasa afa wɔn hokwan ahorow denam: Mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ne mmabun hokwan ahorow ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho no so. Akuo a mmabun di anim a wɔkasa akyerɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatuo mu, na wɔde wɔn suahunu ne wɔn adwene akyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ. Mpanyimfo a wɔboa, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne mmara ho abenfo a wɔbɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ho nyansahyɛ ahorow a egyina adanse so ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun a wobenya nna mu apomoden ho nnwuma a edi mu di kan. Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan, abasɛm, ne nhyiamu afoforo a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akasa atia animtiaabu, na wɔaboaboa ɔmanfo mmoa ano ama nna mu apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔne apomoden ho ɔbenfo bi nsusuw asiane ahorow ne nea ɛhaw wɔn ankorankoro ho mfa nkyerɛ wɔn ankasa akwankyerɛ.
answer_twi_source: Onipa biara ne nyinsɛn yɛ soronko. Ebia nea ebetumi ayɛ asiane ama obiako no renyɛ obi foforo. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bi susuw w’ankorankoro asiane ne nea ɛhaw wo ho. Wobetumi: Asusuw wo tebea pɔtee no ho: Wɔbɛsusuw w’aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm, w’asetena mu su, ne w’abusua abakɔsɛm ho na wɔate w’ankorankoro asiane ahorow ase. Fa akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wo ho ma: Wobetumi agyina asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ wo so so akasa ama nneyɛe pɔtee bi anaa nsakrae a wobɛyɛ na ama nsɛnnennen a ebetumi aba no so atew. Bua wo nsɛmmisa: Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa nsɛm a ɛfa dadwen biara a wowɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu na wɔboa no kyerɛ obu ma mmabun ne wɔn mmusua amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya amammerɛ mu obu denam amammerɛ mu ahobrɛase a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, kwati nsusuwii anaa nsusuwii hunu, nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu a wɔayɛ ama amammerɛ kwan so, ne mmabun ne wɔn mmusua a wɔne mmabun ne wɔn mmusua bɛyɛ biako de adi wɔn amammerɛ mu apɛde ne gyidi ahorow anuonyam so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho bere a merepaw ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nea ɛfata me?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ repaw kwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ wɔn ho ban afiri nyinsɛn ho (contraceptive method) a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔdwene nneɛma yi ho:Sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yie: Sɛnea saa kwan no bɛtumi akwati nyinsɛn paa.Sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛ: Sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔde bɛdi dwuma na ɛrenha wɔn.Nneɛma a ɛba akyire ne apɔwmuden mu asiane: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ afa sɛnea ɛbɔ ban firi nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho.Sɛnea ɛne wo gyinabea hyia: Sɛnea ɛne nea wopɛ, w’asetena, wo mfeɛ (Age), ne w’apɔwmuden ho abakɔsɛm hyia.Ne boɔ ne sɛnea wobenya bi: Sɛnea aduro no boɔ teɛ ne baabi a wobenya bi mmerɛ biara.Sɛ wobɛhu kwan pa a ɛfata wo a, ɛhyehyɛ nkɔmɔdie a wo ne w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ bɛdi fa nneɛma yi ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ mmoa ne ɔhaw a ɛwɔ kwan biara mu, na woadwene nea wosusu sɛ ɛyɛ papa, nea ɛhia wo paa, ne botaeɛ a wowɔ fa wo nna mu apɔwmuden ne nyinsɛn ho banbɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛfa abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obuo wom ho, titiriw wɔ nsɛm te sɛ pene, kokoamsɛm, ne amanneɛbɔ a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ɛka ho wɔ abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a obu wom mu no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wobedi mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, kokoamsɛm, ne ayayade anaa basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma ho no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nya nimdeɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne sukuu nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho, wɔte wɔn asɛdeɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ayayadeɛ anaa basabasayɛ a wɔsusu sɛ wɔayɛ ho amanneɛ, na wɔde asuafo ahobanbɔ ne wɔn yiedie di kan berɛ a wɔkora kokoamsɛm so kɔsi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhaw anaa akwanside ahorow a atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi ahyia bere a wɔde nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm rekɔma wɔn atipɛnfo no?
answer_twi_source: Ebia ɔhaw no bi ne: Nsɛm anaa nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware a wonnya. Animtiaabu ne adwenem naayɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti ho. Ɔsɔretia anaa ɔsɔretia a efi atipɛnfo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ. Ntetee anaa mmoa a anohyeto wom a wɔde ma atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo. Amammerɛ anaa asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow a esiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun a wɔayi nyinsɛn agu?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ (PAC) kyerɛ aduruyɛ ne atinka fam mmoa a wɔde ma ankorankoro bere a wɔayi nyinsɛn agu akyi. Ɛho hia kɛse ma mmabun a wɔayi nyinsɛn agu efisɛ: Ɛboa ma wɔn nipadua ne nkate fam yiyedi. Ɛde ayaresa a ɛho hia ma de di nsɛnnennen anaa nsunsuanso bɔne biara ho dwuma. Ɛde mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ma de boa mmabun ma wɔkyerɛ wɔn atinka ne atinka ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho osuahu no ho. Ɛma wɔn ho tɔ wɔn na ɛboa mmabun ma wɔsan fi wɔn dwumadi ahorow a wɔtaa yɛ no ase a biribiara nhaw wɔn. Ɛboa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdeɛn ne kokoam yɛ a yɛka no brɔfo mu 'confidentiality'  wɔ ayaresa mu, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Kokoam mu nsɛm 'confidentiality' yɛ asɛdeɛ a ɛda ayaresafoɔ so sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ayarefoɔ kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Ɛho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma wɔtumi kɔ ayaresabea kɔhwehwɛ mmoa (te sɛ awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ho) a wɔnsuro sɛ obi bɛte wɔn asɛm. Nanso, hyɛ no nsow sɛ mmara tumi ma kwan ma wɔpae mu ka kokoam nsɛm bi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi nnipa ne osuahu ahorow a ɛda ntam, a abusuakuo, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea ka ho ho dwuma, de ahyɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛka obiara ho na ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu ama mmabun nyinaa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no di nnipa a wɔyɛ ne osuahu ahorow a ɛda ntam, a abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea ka ho ho dwuma, de hyɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛka obiara ho na ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu ho nkuran ma mmabun nyinaa denam: Ahorow a wogye tum: Mmabun nipasu ne osuahu ahorow a ɛtwam a wogye tum no hwɛ hu sɛ wɔayɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no sɛnea ɛne wɔn soronko no hyia ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ. Nsonsonoeɛ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma: Nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ ASRH dwumadie ne nea ɛfiri mu ba a wɔbɛhunu wɔ akuo ahodoɔ mu na wɔadi ho dwuma no boa ma pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ no so tew na ɛma apomoden mu pɛyɛ nya nkɔsoɔ. Nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ahyɛ mu: Mmeae a mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wobu wɔn, na wɔte wɔn ase no hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, na ɛde apomoden mu nkɔso pa ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene wɔ STI ho no nya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ sɛdeɛ yɛsa ho yareɛ?
answer_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, dodoɔ noa suro animtiabuo ne aniwuo a saa yareɛ yi de brɛ wɔn.Amammerɛ bi wɔ a hɔ saa nsɛm yi yɛ akyiwadeɛ ma wɔn, ne saa nti wooni ho nkɔmmɔ. Wei nti ɛsɛ sɛ adesua bebree kɔ so wɔ saa yareɛ yi ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So afotu anaa ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe "counseling and therapy sessions" ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn wɔ Intanɛt so no?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, virtual afotu anaa ayaresa dwumadie bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔpɛ intanɛt so mmoa. Saa dwumadie yi taa de: "Video" anaa telefon so nhyiamu a wɔne ayaresa anaa afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi krataa yɛ, a ɛma kokoamsɛm ne kwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa. Intanɛt so akwan a ahobanbɔ wom a wɔde bɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔakɔ, wɔne ayaresa ho adwumayɛfoɔ adi nkitaho, na wɔanya ayaresa ho nneɛma ne nnwinnadeɛ. Flexible options for therapy modalities, including individual afotu, abusua ayaresa, ne kuw ayaresa, a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ. Beae te sɛ "Tranquil Therapeutic Consult" wɔ Adjiriganor, Accra (Tel: 0244 956 907/ 054 715 0192 / 027 299 8593) de ankorankoro ne virtual afotuo dwumadie ma nnipa a wɔadi mfeɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa. Afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ ɔman ahokwasan nhwehwɛmu "Ghana Health Service" nso abue wɔn ani ama virtual nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ client pɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun taa tua ho ka?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ma mmabun taa tua nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho ka, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne afotu. Nhwehwɛmu, nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho. Awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, a wɔn baabi baabi (pelvic) mu nhwehwɛmu ne Pap smear ka ho. Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, awo ho adwumayɛbea, ne awo. Afotu ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wɔpaw, ne awoɔ ho gyinaesie ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na m’adwene mu apɔmuden ka me nna ne awo apɔmuden a mepaw? (adwenemhaw a ɛka sɛnea wɔhwɛ wɔn ho, nipadua mfonini a ɛka nna mu abusuabɔ)
answer_twi_source: Adwenemhaw: Sɛ w’abamu abu a, ɛbɛtumi ayɛ den sɛ wobɛde w’adwene asi wo nna mu apɔmuden so nneyɛe a ɛfata te sɛ nna a ahobammɔ wom anaa nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa bedi kan. Nipadua Mfonini: Nipadua ho mfonini a ɛnyɛ betumi aka w’ahotoso ne ahotɔ dodow a wowɔ wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnuru anaa nea broni ka no 'supplements' nnuru ne awo ano aduru a ɛma nipadua a aborɔfo ka no 'hormonal birth control' no yɛ adwuma di nkitaho?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru anaa a aborɔfo ka no 'supplements' nnuru bi a wɔde ka ho betumi ne awo ano aduru a ɛma nipadua no yɛ adwuma a aborɔfo ka no 'hormonal birth control' di nkitaho, na ɛtew sɛnea etu mpɔn no so. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ni: Ka nnuru ne nnuru a wɔde ka aduan ho a wonom nyinaa ho asɛm kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma obi, nnuru a wɔtɔn, ne nhabannuru a wɔde ma. Wobetumi ahwɛ sɛ ebia nkitahodi ahorow betumi aba na wɔakamfo nnuru foforo anaa akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano sɛ ɛho hia a. Nnyae nnuru anaa nnuru a wɔde ka aduan ho biara nom a wonkɔ wo duruyɛfo nkyɛn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn sɛ obi mmu me  senea broni ka no bodily autonomy'?
answer_twi_source: Ka ndea wo pɛ. Hwehwɛ mmoa (mpanyimfoɔ/mmara). Sua ade m'awoho. Bɔ mmrato kɔkɔ. Ko ma nsakraeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so di wɔ hwɛ a wɔhwɛ ma mmabun tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho, a STI/HIV a wosiw ano ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so ho no de mmara nhyehyɛe a ɛfa hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho, a STI/HIV a wosiw ka ho no si hɔ: Wɔ aman pii mu no, mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔpene so sɛ wɔbɛyɛ STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu bere a wɔadu mfe pɔtee bi anaa onyin gyinabea bi no. Mmara a ɛfa pene a wɔpene ho no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun tumi ahwehwɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma wɔ kokoam, na ahyɛ wɔn ahofadi, wɔn dwumadi, ne asɛyɛde a wɔwɔ wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho no ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, asetra, ne mfiridwuma mu nneɛma hyehyɛ mmabun osuahu ahorow wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, asetra mu nkɔso, ne mfiridwuma mu nkɔso na ɛkyerɛ mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ nna ho betumi anya nsɛm a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ne sɛnea wobu no so nsunsuanso. Asetra mu nneɛma te sɛ atipɛnfo nsunsuanso ne mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn ahorow nya mmabun nkitahodi wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn mmeae so nsunsuanso. Mfiridwuma mu nneɛma te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ  algorithms ne kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow ka nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wobetumi anya ne kokoamsɛm wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi no mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ne wɔn adi nkitaho de ahwehwɛ mmoa ne nsɛmbisa?
answer_twi_source: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ a wɔde ma mmabun mu: Aduruyɛ mu Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔhwɛ wo nipadua apomoden na wodi nsɛnnennen anaa dadwen biara a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe no ho dwuma. Nkate mu Mmoa: Wɔde afotu ne mmoa ma de boa wo ma wudi wo nkate ne nkate horow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no ho dwuma. Afotu a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ho: Wɔde nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ ma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde besiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ansi daakye ano ho. Ɔhwɛ a Wodi Akyi: Wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ma wobedi akyi de ahwɛ sɛnea wo ho atɔ wo na wodi nsɛm anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo ho dwuma. Sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛdi nkitaho ama mmoa ne nsɛm a: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ wobɛdi akyire: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ wobɛsusu nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen biara a wowɔ wɔ wo ho a wobɛnya ho. Di Nokware na Bue Mu: Di nokware kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ wo nkate, yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne, ne nsɛnnennen biara a ebia worehyia no ho. Bisa Nsɛm: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa nsɛm afa nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, anaa nsɛm foforo biara a ɛfa ho ho. Hwehwɛ Wɔn a Wɔde Wɔn Kɔma: Sɛ wuhia mmoa anaa nneɛma foforo a, bisa w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo no ma wɔmfa wɔn nkɔ afotu adwumayɛbea anaa mmoa akuw mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo (prenatal care), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun a wɔnyem?
answer_twi_source: Prenatal care: Nkyerɛase: Ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo no fa aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔnyem de hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn ne awo a ɛfata. Nea ɛho hia: Hwɛ Apɔwmden so: Ɛboa ma wɔhwɛ nea onyinsɛn no ne akokoaa a ɔrenyin no nyinaa apɔwmuden. Sɛ wohu ɔhaw anaa yareɛ bi a ntɛm a, ɛma ahwɛfoɔ tumi de wɔn ho gye mu wɔ berɛ a ɛsɛ mu. Nhomasua ne Mmoa: Ɛma nkyerɛkyerɛ pa fa wɔ aduane, apɔw-mu-tentennee, malaria ano siw ne nsɛmti a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho. Te Asiane So: Ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔhaw ahorow bi ba berɛ a wɔnyem, ne awoɔ mmerɛ mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a wɔtaa de di dwuma, mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn ahorow, ne amammerɛ mu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a wɔma ɛkɔ so tra hɔ wɔ aguadi ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi mu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no bi?
answer_twi_source: Bɔbeasu ho nsusuwii hunu: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so ho mfonini anaasɛ wɔhyɛ adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ho a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe ne asɛde ahorow ho no mu den. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn atitiriw a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho a ɛda adi, a ebia ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na ɛne mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu osuahu ahorow hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi aboa ma nkurɔfo ate nsɛmti ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne Nhyiamu: Akannifoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ama nhyiamu wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ de akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho. Baguam Ɔkasa: Baguam ɔkasa anaa nhyiam ahorow a abenfo susuw mmabunbere, nna mu akwahosan, ne nsɛmti a ɛfa ho ho a wɔyɛ. Nneɛma a Wɔkyekyɛ: Nkratawa anaa nhomawa ahorow a ɛma nsɛm pii kyekyɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ayaresabea ahorow, ne sukuu ahorow mu. Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn dawurubɔ: abɛɛfo ntentan ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so dwumadibea ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de akyɛ nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ada me nsusuwii, atenka, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw me adi wɔ ɔkwan a emu da hɔ na obu wom so wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa "Me" Nsɛm di dwuma: "Mete nka..." anaa "Mesusuw sɛ..." Ka wo akoma to wo yam: Gye w’ahome paa na wo bo amfu. Ma w'asɛm mu nna hɔ: Kyɛre deɛ ɛresie no mu yie
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ a ɛfa akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ wɔ adwumam ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛfa wɔn hokwan ahorow a ɛfa akatua a ɛyɛ pɛ ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho wɔ adwumayɛbea denam: Nneɛma te sɛ aban website ahorow, adwumayɛfo ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a agye din a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Nhyiamu, nhyiamu, anaa webinar a ɛfa adwumayɛfoɔ hokwan ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho a wɔbɛkɔ. Akwankyerɛ a wobɛhwehwɛ afi sukuu afotufo, mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow, anaa mmara kwan so mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow hɔ. Intanɛt so akwan ne social media akwan a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ adwumayɛbea hokwan ne mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran a wɔde bedi dwuma. Akuo anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no twee adwene sii sɛnea wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ wɔn ade wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so ne hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ adwumam so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na mɛtumi afa so akyerɛ sɛ mepo anaa mepene asɛm bi so wɔ dwoodwoo ne obu kwan so bere a me mfɛfoɔ rehyɛ me so sɛ mefa nna mu nneyɛeɛ a asiane wom mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wuhyia atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛhwɛ sɛ wodi ho bɛhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu a, ɛho hia sɛ wopow adi no wɔ odwo ne obu mu. Fi ase denam onipa foforo no adwene a wubegye atom so, kyerɛ wo hyeɛ (boundaries) ne nea nti a worepo asɛm no mu pefee. Fa akokoduru ne 'Me' fiti wo nsɛm ase. Wo ne wo nnamfo anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di nni dwumade di fa agoru ahorow mu  na ama woanya ahotoso wɔ wo ho a wobɛka wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo afotufo boa wɔn atipɛnfo ma wodi nhaw bi te sɛ nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu animhwɛ, ne nneɛma a wonnya pii wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden akyi di mu?
answer_twi_source: Fa nkate mu mmoa ma: Atipɛnfo afotufo ma wɔn atipɛnfo beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma wɔda wɔn nkate adi, hwehwɛ afotu, na wonya nkuranhyɛ bere a wohyia nyiyimu, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu animhwɛ, anaasɛ nneɛma a wonnya pii no. Fa akwankyerɛ a mfaso wɔ so ma: Afotufo kyɛ akwan ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa wɔn a wɔrekyerɛ wɔn kwan no ma wɔadi nsɛnnennen so, adi akwanside ahorow so, na wɔanya hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden, te sɛ adwuma hwehwɛ akwan, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsusuasɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ nna mu dwumadi a wɔmmɔ ho ban, te sɛ nyinsɛn ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu yareɛ (STI) mu?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban, baabi a wɔmfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano nni dwuma no betumi ama wanyinsɛn. Eyi ba bere a mmadwoa ma ɛwo bi nyinsɛn wɔ ɔbea awo nhyehyɛe mu no. Nyinsɛn betumi de nipadua, nkate, ne asetra mu nsakrae aba, na ehia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe na wosiesie wɔn ho yiye. Nna mu Nyarewa (STI): Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban nso de ankorankoro to asiane mu sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ' STI'. Eyinom yɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so nya. STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba no bi ne chlamydia, akisikuru, akisikuru, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu akisikuru, HIV/AIDS, ne HPV (Human Papillomavirus). Sɛ wɔansa STI ahorow no betumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba, a nea ɛka ho ne awo a wontumi nwo, yare a ɛma obi ho hyehye no wɔ akyi berɛmo mu, awotwaa mu kokoram (a efi HPV mu), ne asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya HIV. Ɛho hia sɛ wode ahobammɔ (te sɛ kɔndɔm) bedi dwuma bere a woreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn ne STI nyinaa so atew. STI nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa ne nkitahodi a wɔne wɔn a wɔne wɔn da nso ho hia ma nna mu akwahosan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ me nna ne awo akwahosan ho, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho bere a meresisi saa gyinae yi?
answer_twi_source: Fa nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma so kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Susuw w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, gyidi ahorow, ne botae ahorow ho bere a woresisi gyinae wɔ nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne STI ano a wosiw ho no. Fa nneɛma te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, nkitahodi, nkate mu ahoboa, ne nkitahodie mu nkɔso ho bere a woresisi gyinae wɔ dwumadi ahorow a ɛbɛn ho no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na akwan abien a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano betumi atu mpɔn sen biako pɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Fa no sɛ ahobammɔ afiri. Sɛ ɔkwan biako di nkoguo (te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔbubu) a, ɔkwan foforo (te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano) wɔ hɔ sɛ akyigyina a wɔde besiw nyinsɛn ano. Saa ara nso na kɔndɔm ma STI ahobammɔ a awo ano aduru ntumi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ankorankoro ne ɔmanfo ntam fekubɔ a edi mu a wɔde asi wɔn aniso sɛ wɔbɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden a wɔde bɛma mmabun anya nkɔso?
answer_twi_source: Ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow a nnwumakuw boa: Ankorankoro nnwumakuw ne ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ biako de adwumayɛ ho ntetee, adwuma a wɔde ma, ne afotu hokwan ahorow ma mmabun, na wosiesie wɔn ma wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mmeae a wɔhwehwɛ pii. Asetena mu nnwuma nhyehyeɛ: Ankorankoro nnwuma ne nea broni atwaso ka no 'NGO' ahodoɔ ntam nkitahodiɛ boa asetena mu nnwuma a ɛma mmabun tumi denam ahokokwaa a wɔnya, nnwuma a ɛma wonya sika, ne gua ne sikasɛm mu nnwuma a wɔbɛnya so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi hwehwɛ sika ho afotuo firi adwumfoɔ hɔ, na ɛkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi anya saa nnwuma yi bi sɛ ɛho hia wɔn a?
answer_twi_source: Sika ho afotuo anaa mmoa a obi bɛhwehwɛ afiri adwumfoɔ hɔ betumi ama mmabun anya akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wɔn ho, nneɛma a ɛyɛ papa a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne nimdeɛ a ɛfiri adwumfoɔ hɔ de aboa wɔn ma wɔasi sika ho gyinaeɛ a ɛfata.Sika ho afotufofoɔ tumi de mmoa ma wɔ nneɛma ahodoɔ mu te sɛ:Sika a wɔde yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ (budgeting)Sika a wɔde hyɛ adwuma mu (investing)Ɛka a wɔbɛtumi atua anaa wɔahwɛ so (debt management)Pɛnkyina ho nhyehyɛeɛ (retirement planning)Ɛno nyinaa gyina obiara botaeɛ ne tebea sononko so.Mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi denam:Banka ahodoɔ (banks)Sika korabea ahodoɔ (credit unions)Sika ho nhyehyɛeɛ nnwumakuo (financial planning firms)Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfasoɔ (nonprofit organizations) a ɛde sika ho afotuo anaa mmoa a ɛnni sika anaa ne boɔ yɛ den ma.Nea ɛka ho ne sɛ, nwomasua asoɛeɛ pii ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ yɛ nhyiamu anaa ntsetsee a ɛfa sika ho nimdeɛ ne nehwɛso ho nsɛm, a ɛtumi yɛ mmoa a ɛho hia paa ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn sika ho nimdeɛ ne nsaano adwuma kɔ so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma kokoam mmoa akuw ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ma mmabun a wodi nsɛm yi ho dwuma titiriw.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfoɔ anaa apɔmuden ho dwumadiefoɔ bɛtumi de nneɛma ama wo anaasɛ ɔbɛka wo ne mmoa akuo a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ mmabun awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow a wokura mu na wodi mu?
answer_twi_source: Nhomasua: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ betumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosi ano, ne nna mu nyarewa ho. Nnwuma a Wonya: Wɔma wonya akwan a wɔfa so si nyinsɛn ano, nna mu nyarewa nhwehwɛmu, ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe. Ahintasɛm: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no kura kokoamsɛm mu, titiri ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nnwuma a ɛho hia. Obu: Ɛsɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de obu ma mmabun, tie wɔn haw ahorow, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ aduroyɛ mu mmoa ne nkamfo ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea mu no mu, na ntetee anaa ahwehwɛde bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ bere a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa no?
answer_twi_source: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ aduroyɛ mu mmoa ne nkamfo ma mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu no mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔatete wɔn na wɔfata wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuen ho na wɔde kokoamsɛm ne obuo a wɔde ma wɔn ahofadi di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofoɔ ne abusuafɔ betumi adi wɔn ankasa animhwɛ ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ gender ho nna ne mu akɔnnɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Susu w’ankasa wo gyidi ahorow ho: Hu na kasa tia animhwɛ anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ biara a ebia wowɔ wɔ gender ho ne nna mu aknnɔɔ ho. Hwehwɛ nhomasua ne nneɛma a wode bɛboa: Kenkan nhoma, kɔ nhyiam ahorow ase, anaa fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu na ama wo ntease a wowɔ wɔ mmabun nna ho no mu atrɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kɔndɔm boa ma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya STI ne HIV bere a ɔne obi reda no so tew?
answer_twi_source: Kɔndɔm yɛ akwanside bi a ɛmma nipadua mu nsu ntumi nfra. Sɛ wɔde di dwuma yiye bere biara a, ɛyɛ adwuma yiye. Fa kɔndɔm foforo di dwuma bere nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, nnuru ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no bo yɛ ahe?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no gyina ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ne wo insurance a wode tua ho ka so. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa fa ɛka ne insurance a wotua ho. Kae sɛ wo nna mu akwahosan ho hia. Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woanya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a ahobammɔ wom na etu mpɔn, a anohyeto biara nni ho mpo. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ kokoam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na etu mpɔn wɔ Kesee Fam ne Kesee Fam biakoyɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔkyɛ wɔ aman a, wɔwɔ mpɔtam ahorow mu de di nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm a wɔtaa di ho dwuma no mu?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so ahyɛ Kesee Fam ne Kesee Fam biakoyɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ aman ntam no bi ne atipɛnfo adesua a wɔbɛsesa, nhwehwɛmu adwuma a wɔbom yɛ, ne mfiridwuma mu mmoa nhyehyɛe. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne biakoyɛ a ɛbɛboa aman a wɔwɔ mpɔtam ahorow ntam so no, Kesee Fam ne Kesee Fam biakoyɛ betumi aboa ma wɔahu nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nsɛm a ɛtaa ba, akyɛ akwan a edi mu, na ayɛ ano aduru foforo a ɛbɛma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nkɔso atu mpɔn wɔ wiase nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam mu nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ a ɛfiri amansan mu boa nhyehyɛeɛ mu nkuranhyɛ a emu botaeɛ ne sikasɛm mu tumi hyɛden?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam mu nhyehyɛeɛ hwehwɛ sɛ wɔboaboa ankorankoro ne mpɔtamfoɔ ano wɔ baabi a wɔteɛ no ara na wɔapere ama nsakyeraeɛ. Mpɔtam mu mmɔdenbɔ ma baakoyɛ ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛbom ka mpɔtamfoɔ a wɔn botaeɛ yɛ pɛ no ano.Mpɔtam mu mmɔdenbɔ ma wɔn a wɔnhwɛ wɔn yie no nne kɔ anim, na ɛma mpɔtamfoɔ kwan ma wɔpere ma wɔn ahiadeɛ a ɛfa sikasɛm mu tumi hyɛden ho tẽẽ. Ɛnam mpɔtam mu nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ so no, mmabun betumi ama nteaseɛ kɛseɛ aba, wɔanya mmoa afi afoforo hɔ, na wɔahyɛ mmara hyɛfoɔ so ma wɔadi sikasɛm mu tumi hyɛden nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛboa mmofra no ho dwuma edi kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ me hokafoɔ dɔɔso a, kwan bɛn so na mɛbɔ me ho ban efi nna mu yareɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Fa akwan a ɛsiw nneɛma mmienu kwan. Condoms siw nyinsɛn ne STIs kwan ano. Kasa kyerɛ wo 'nurse'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de me gyidie ne me me nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan (SRH) gyinaesie anante?
answer_twi_source: Dwen wo gyidie ho. Gye afotu firi nkurɔfoɔ a wɔte mmienu nyinaa ase hɔ. Sisi gyinaeɛ a ɛne wo gyidie hyia na ɛbɔ wo ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran sɛ akadeɛ atitiriw a wɔde bɛtew animtiaabu so.
answer_twi_source: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ akadeɛ atitiriw a wɔde tew animtiaabu so: Kasa a wɔka no pefee boa ma STI ne sɔhwɛ yɛ nea ɛfata. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wosua no yi anansesɛm fi hɔ na ɛtew ehu so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na metumi anya nneɛma a ɛhyɛ asɛm pa na ɛka obiara ho a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ma mmabun ho nkuran? (Wedsite ahorow, nhomasua nneɛma, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ɔsatu ahorow)
answer_twi_source: Kasa kyerɛ wo sukuu yaresabea ɔyarehwɛfo, kasa kyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. nya mmoa firi GHS-YMK fotufoɔ bi frɛ PPAG yenkasa wɔ 0800202010 (wɔntua hwee) UNICEF Agoo SHE+ wɔ 5100 wɔ mtn Marie frɛ 0302242517.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛden ne nipa a wɔyɛ adwuma yi akyɛ ne wɔn a wɔboa nnipa wɔ abeifo ntetan nsɛm 'online crisis' mmbamu dwumadie mu, na ɛden nso nɛ wɔn tumiyɛ nfɛsɔdi?
answer_twi_source: Ammamfo, adwene ho animdefoɔ, nnipa ho adwumayɛfoɔ, nɔɔsi. Nteteeɛ pɔtee wɔ asiane ho mmoa, aso tie, ayamye, amammerɛ ho nteaseɛ mu. Sini kwan so nhyehyɛeɛ..
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛhe na mmabun betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ara, na akwan horow bɛn na wobetumi afa so, te sɛ nea broni ka no 'over-the-counter pills', nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, anaa kɔbere IUD  nea broni ka no 'copper IUD' a wɔde hyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ara afi mmeae ahorow, a nnurutɔnbea ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe, ne ɛtɔ mmere bi mpo a sukuu anaa kɔlege akwahosan asoɛe ahorow ka ho. Nneɛma a wubetumi apaw bi ne nnuru a wɔtɔn a wɔmfa nnuru nhyɛ mu (te sɛ nea broni ka no 'Plan B One-Step anaa Next Choice'), nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma obi (te sɛ nea broni ka no 'ulipristal acetate'), anaa kɔbere IUD a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo de bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun tumi siesie ntawntawdi biara a ɛda wɔn ankasa gyidi ne wɔn som mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne deɛ wɔn som mu mpaninfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ fa nna ne awoɔ ho nyansafuɔ gyinaeɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi asiesie ntawntawdi a ebetumi aba wɔn ankasa nyamesom gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ne ne deɛ wɔn som mu mpaninfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ fa nna ne awoɔ ho nyansafuɔ gyinaeɛ ho denam, adwenem nhwehwɛmu, ne nkɔmmɔdie a wɔbɛfa mu. Eyi bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afiri som mu akannifoɔ hɔ, wɔbɛkenkan honhom mu nhoma ahorow, wɔne wɔn mfɛfoɔ anaa wɔn akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nneyɛe pa ho, na wɔasusu sɛnea adwene horow yi bɛka wɔn yiedie ne wɔn nnamfofa. Nea ɛkɔ akyiri koraa no, mmofra yi tumi siesie saa ntawantawae yi denam mmɔden a wɔbɛbɔ sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn som mu gyidi ne wɔn nteaseɛ a ɛrenyin fa nnipa nna ne awoɔ ho kwan ho no abom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ atenka ahohyɛsoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Boa nkitahodie pa. Gye woahome. Boa agyinaesie pa. Boa asetena pa .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkwammoaa bɛn na ɛka ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na dɛn na ɛyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Ntini ahorow pii na ɛka ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na emu biara wɔ dwumadi pɔtee bi: Estrogen: Saa hormone yi na ɛma mmeawa nufu nyin, wɔn asen trɛw, ne mmea nna mu su afoforo a ɛto so abien. Ɛsan nso di dwuma wɔ brayɛ a ɛhwɛ so no mu. Testosterone: Saa hormone yi na ɛma ɛnne no mu dɔ, anim ne nipadua mu nhwi nyin, ntini nyin, ne mmarima nna mu su afoforo a ɛto so abien. Nkwammoaa a Ɛma Onyin: Sɛnea edin no kyerɛ no, onyin hormone na ɛma onyin ntɛmntɛm wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Ɛkanyan nnompe, ntini, ne akwaa ahorow nyin. Adrenal Hormones: Nkwammoaa a adrenal glands no yɛ te sɛ cortisol ne DHEA nso kɔ soro wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Saa nkwaadɔm yi betumi aka adwene, ahoɔden dodow, ne sɛnea nipadua no yɛ n’ade wɔ adwennwen ho. Saa nkwaadɔm yi bom yɛ nsakrae a ɛkɔ so wɔ wo nipadua mu wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ho nhyehyɛe. Bere a ɛtɔ mmere bi a nsakrae yi betumi ate nka sɛ ɛyɛ den dodo no, ne nyinaa yɛ adeyɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛma obi nyin no fã.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na pene a wɔpene so di wɔ ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ a wosiw ano wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodie mu?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so di dwuma titiriw wɔ ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ a ɛba wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodi mu a wosiw ano no mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun te ase sɛ wɔde pene a wɔde ma kwa, wotumi dannan, wɔma wɔn nsɛm, wɔde anigye, ne nea broni ka no 'reversible, informed, enthusiastic na wɔyɛ no pɔtee wɔ nkitahodi biara ho. Ahye a wobu na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔpene so no betumi aboa ma wɔasiw ɔhaw ano na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nkitaho a obu wɔn ho wɔn ho na wɔpene so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi ahu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda berɛ tiaa ne berɛ tenten sika ho botaeɛ ntam, na akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so akora sika ama biara?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda berɛ tiaa ne berɛ tenten sikasɛm botae ahorow ntam denam: Berɛ a wɔde behu: Mpɛn pii no, berɛ tiaa mu botae ahorow no wɔ berɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ afe biako anaa nea ennu saa, te sɛ sika a wɔbɛkora so ama telefon foforo anaa akwamma, berɛ a berɛ tenten botae ahorow no trɛw kɔ akyiri sen afe biako, te sɛ sika a wɔbɛkora so ama kɔlege anaa pɛnhyenkɔ. Botae ahorow a wɔde bedi kan: Botae biara a wɔde hia a egyina ntɛmpɛ, hia a ehia, ne ankorankoro apɛde so, na wɔkyekyɛ nneɛma mu sɛnea ɛfata. Botae pɔtee bi a wɔde besisi hɔ: Botae ahorow a wobɛtumi asusuw ho a wɔde besi hɔ ama botae biara, te sɛ sika dodow bi a wɔbɛkora so ansa na da pɔtee bi adu, ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adu ho. Nsakrae ne nteɛso a wɔbɛkari pɛ: Nsakrae a wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ de asiesie botae ahorow berɛ a tebea horow sesa berɛ a wokura nteɛso mu wɔ sikakorabea nhyehyɛe ne sikasɛm mu akwan horow a wɔbɛbata ho no mu. Mmabun behia nhomasua a edi mu ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ akwantu a ɛte saa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na amammerɛ mu nnyinasosɛm ne gyinapɛn nya nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ho apene so (consent), nna mu atirimɔdensɛm (sexual violence), ne nna mu mogyahyehyɛeɛ anaa ɔtaa (harassment) ho wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Amammere mu atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ nya nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa kwan mma (consent), nna ho mmonnaatoɔ, ne nhyɛsoɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu so tumi denam: Sɛnea wɔbu mmarima ne mmaa dwuma, tumi, ne ayɔnkofa a ɛde ba akyerɛ (Dictating attitudes): Eyi bɛtumi aka sɛnea nkurɔfoɔ te kwan mma ne suban a ɛfata ase no.Amuo anaa animguaseɛ a atwa nna ho nsɛm ho ahyia so tumi (Influencing stigma): Eyi bɛtumi aka sɛnea wɔn a asɛm no ato wɔn pɛ sɛ wɔba abɔ amanneɛ na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa no.Akwan a mpɔtam fa so yɛ nna ho nsɛm ho biribi a wɔayɛ no (Shaping responses): Ebi ne sɛ, ebia wɔbɛgye nea asɛm no ato no adi, wɔbɛboa no, na wɔabɔ no ho ban, anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ no soboɔ na wɔabu no animguaseɛ.Kwan a wɔfa so te kwan mma, nna ho mmonnaatoɔ, ne nhyɛsoɔ ase a nnyinasoɔ ne amammere, nyamesom, ne atetesɛm (Providing frameworks): Wɔde saa nnyinasoɔ yi na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahye a ɛfata wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu na makura mu? ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi aka ho asɛm yiye?
answer_twi_source: Wo Ho a Wosusuw Ho: Te w’ankasa ahotɔ dodow, w’akɔnnɔ, ne anohyeto ahorow ase. Susuw osuahu ahorow a atwam ho na ama woahu nea wo ho tɔ wo. Ahye a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ nea wo ho tɔ wo ne nea wonyɛ no mu pefee. Ahye betumi ayɛ honam fam, atenka fam, ne nna mu nneɛma a ɛfa abusuabɔ bi ho. Nkitahodi: Ka w’ahye ho asɛm pefee na fa pintinn. Fa "Me" nsɛm no da wo nkate ne wo ahiade adi a asodi biara nni ho. Afoforo Ahye a Wobebu: Bu wo hokafo ahye sɛnea wohwɛ kwan sɛ wobebu wo de no. Bisa na bu pene a ɛda adi pefee ansa na wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara mu. Ahye a Wobɛsan Ahwɛ: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛsan akɔhwɛ na woayɛ nsakrae wɔ w’ahye so bere a worenyin na wosakra no. Ma wo ne wo hokafo nni nkitaho pefee wɔ ahye ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne atipɛnfo nhomasua, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma mmabun nyinaa nya nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo nhomasua kyerɛ sɛ mmabun sua nna ne awo akwahosan ho ade fi wɔn ho wɔn ho hɔ na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho. Ɛboa efisɛ mmerante ne mmabaa te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛkasa pefee, abisa nsɛm, na wɔanya mmoa afi afoforo a wɔne wɔn bɔ tipɛn hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ kwan ahorow sɛ ɔbabun a wadi dɛm wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛkyerɛ wo hokwan ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ni: Yɛ wo nhwehwɛmu: Hu w'akwan ahorow wɔ Ghana Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Mmara ne mmara afoforo a ɛfa ho no ase. Bra siesie wo ho: Di kan kyerɛw wo nsɛmmisa ne nea ɛhaw wo no to hɔ. Ka w’asɛm: Ka w’ahiade ne nea wohwɛ kwan pefee. Fa obi a ɔkamfo wo bra: Obi betumi aboa wo na waboa ma wɔaka w’ahiade ho asɛm. Fa nsɛm kɔdan aban: Sɛ wɔanni hokwan ahorow a wowɔ no so a, wubetumi de asɛm akɔdan aban mpanyimfo a wɔfata no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ, nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention programs' a egyina sukuu so no ne abɔnten so nnwumakuo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ yɛ adwuma bom de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛboa asuafoɔ no nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Nkɔmmɔbɔ betumi awɔ: Sɛ wɔne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow bɛyɛ biako. Nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ no a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛma abɔnten so nnwumakuo. Asɛm ho dwumadie nhyiamu a ɛfa nneɛma ahodoɔ ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Ntetee a wɔde bɛma sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ abɔnten so nneɛma a wɔbɛnya ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama  mmoa ne nhyehyɛe ɛwɔ  nyinsɛnyiguoɔ akyi  akɔ soro ama mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ako ama sɛ  wɔanya nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho nnwuma a akɔ soro wɔ: Nhumu a wobɛma akɔ soro: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo mpɔtam hɔfo hia a nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho hia ne hia a ehia sɛ wonya nnwuma a wobetumi anya ama mmabun. Fa nsɛm ma wɔ baabi, bere ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so anya nnwuma a ɛtete saa Ho a wo ne Ahyehyɛde ahorow no bedi nkitaho: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ awo akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no nyɛ biako na ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛbɛma nyinsɛn a woyi agu akyi hwɛ a wobenya no tu mpɔn. Mpɔtam Hɔ Ananmusifoɔ a Wobɛdi Dwuma: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ anaa ananmusifoɔ nkyɛn ma wɔnkyerɛ wo haw ahorow na wɔkamfo sika anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛkɔ soro ama nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ adwuma. W’asɛm a Wobɛka: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a, ka w’ankasa osuahu ahorow wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ a wubenya ne nkɛntɛnso a enyaa w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi so de maa nkurɔfo hui na ɛtew animtiaabu so. Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ a Ɛkɔ Anim a Wobɛboa: Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, a nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi ho ka ho, na ama wɔatumi asi gyinae a ɛfata na wɔatew nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na dijitaal akwan ne mfiridwuma nya ɔkwan, a mmabun fa so nya nsɛm, kyɛ, na wɔde di dwuma no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Digitals platforms ne mfiridwuma so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ sɛnea mmabun nya nsɛm, wɔkyɛ, na wɔde di dwuma no so. Abɛɛfo ntentan asoeɛ (Social media platforms), "search engines", ne "algorithms" gyina nea ɔde di dwuma no pɛ, nneyɛe, ne nkitahodi so na ɛyɛ nea ɛfa obiara ho, na ɛkyerɛ ankorankoro osuahu ahorow a ɛwɔ intanɛt so ne nsɛm a wɔda no adi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ 'CSE' ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya wɔ 'CSE' ho no bi ne gyidi a ɛne sɛ ɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi a edi kan ho nkuran anaasɛ ɛne amammerɛ anaa nyamesom gyinapɛn ahorow nhyia. Nanso, nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ma nna ho adesua a edi kan no kyɛ ankasa na ɛma nna mu nneyɛe a ɛma apɔwmuden nya nkɔso. Adwene a ɛnteɛ foforo ne sɛ 'CSE' fa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nkutoo ho, bere a nokwarem no ɛfa nsɛmti ahorow pii a ɛboro nna mu akwahosan so, a abusuabɔ, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne gyinaesi ka ho. Nea ɛka saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi ho dwuma a wobedi ho ne sɛ wɔde 'CSE' botae ahorow ne emu nsɛm ho nsɛm a edi mu bɛma, na wosi dwuma a edi wɔ akwahosan, yiyedi, ne gyinaesi a wonya ho nimdeɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, ne abusuabɔ ahorow,  gyinabea ahorow a ɛwɔ media mu no boa ma wɔhyɛ gye a wogye tom, visibilty, ne ntease ho nkuran, anaasɛ ɛhyɛ animtiaabu ne nyiyim mu den?
answer_twi_source: LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, abusuabɔ ahorow ananmusifo wɔ media mu betumi anya nkɛntɛnso pa ne nkɛntɛnso bɔne. kwan baako so no, wobetumi aboa ma wɔama wɔagye atom, wɔahu, na wɔate ase denam LGBTQ+ asetena ne abusuabɔ mu nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔbɛkyerɛ so. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛte saa betumi aboa ma wɔatew animtiaabu ne nyiyim so denam nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata so. Ɔkwan foforɔ so no, media no nso betumi ahyɛ animtiaabu ne nyiyim mu den denam nsusuii hunu a wɔbɛma akɔ so anaasɛ LGBTQ+ ankorankoro a wɔbɛda wɔn ho adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnnyɛ so no so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ saa gyinabea ahorow yi mu yiye na wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛda nnipa osuahu ahorow adi nokwarem.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhaw ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔde nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛka nnwuma a ɛtrɛw a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmabun apomoden, yiyedi, ne nkwa nna nyinaa adesua ho nkuran wɔ yɛn nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde bɛka nnwuma a ɛtrɛw a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmabun apomoden, yiyedi, ne nkwa nna nyinaa adesua ho nkuran wɔ nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu ho no de ɔhaw ne hokwan ahorow nyinaa ba. Ebia ɔhaw no bi ne sɛ wobedi ɔsɔretia a efi wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wobu nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ akyinnyegye anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nea wɔde di dwuma wɔ atetesɛm mu adesua mu no so nkonim. Bio nso, nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma kakraa bi, nneɛma a wɔde di kan a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho di asi, ne nhyehyɛe mu anohyeto ahorow betumi ayɛ akwanside ahorow wɔ dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri mu. Nanso, hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ sɛ wɔde nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw te sɛ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, dwumadi ahorow a ɛka adesua akyi, ne mpɔtam hɔ fekubɔ ahorow bedi dwuma de abɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ abom wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so. Ɛdenam saa nsɛm yi a wɔde bɛhyɛ nnwuma a ɛtrɛw a wɔde wɔn adwene asi mmabun nkɔso a edi mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so no, nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ama nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa ho, a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa, ne nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ hɔ ama asuafo nyinaa no ayɛ kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛnyɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so, te sɛ nkratawa anaa nhoma ahorow, a wobetumi anya wɔ akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a wɔhwɛ mmabun?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, akwahosan ho mmeae pii, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow de nneɛma a ɛnyɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so te sɛ nhomawa, nhomawa, nhoma, ne nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ma. Saa nneɛma yi taa wɔ mmeae a wɔtwɛn, afotu dan, anaa mmeae a wɔde nneɛma ma wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu. Mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi bere a wɔrekɔsra akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ne nhomakorabea ahorow so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Gyinaɛ bɛn na amammerɛ wɔ fa SRH ayaresa hwehwɛeɛ ho, na dɔkotafoɔ bɛyɛ dɛn aboa?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ no kenya wɔn ma wɔhwehwɛ mmoa. Ɛsɛsɛ Dɔkotafoɔ hu nsonsoeɛ a ɛda nipa ntam, na wɔhu sɛdeɛ wɔ ne wɔn bɛkasa yie, na wobu amammerɛ, gyidie, na afei so wɔma mmoa a nyiyimu biara nni mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban te sɛ HPV aduru no di wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne STI a wosiw ano mu?
answer_twi_source: Nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban te sɛ human papillomavirus (HPV) aduro no di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne STI a wosiw ano mu. HPV aduro no boa ma wɔbɔ obi ho ban fi mmoawa ahorow a ɛde nyarewa ba. Ɛdenam HPV a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu so no, ankorankoro betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya mmoawa no na wɔde akɔ wɔn ahokafo nkyɛn no so. Bio nso, sɛ wɔde nnuru a wɔde bɔ obi ho ban fi ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nyarewa afoforo te sɛ hepatitis B ho a, ebetumi ama ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ ɔyare mmoawa a wobetumi de akɔ nna mu no ayɛ kɛse bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho no susuw nneɛma a ɛwɔ ntam te sɛ abusuakuw, dɛmdi, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho wɔ sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe a wodi ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho susuw nneɛma a ɛwɔ ntam te sɛ abusuakuw, dɛmdi, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho denam gye a wogye tom sɛ mmea ne mmeawa hyia nyiyim ne ɔhaw ahorow pii a egyina wɔn nipasu a ɛka bom so. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi de akuo a wɔato wɔn hintidua ne wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ den no ahiadeɛ di kan, na ɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛdi wɔn nsɛnnennen pɔtee ne akwansideɛ a ɛmma wɔnnya sikasɛm mu kyɛfa no ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛsiesie wɔn ho ama 'shelter' (baabi a wɔbɛda) anaa fie hwehwɛ, ɛdeɛn nsɛm na wo bɛkakyerɛ nkorɔfoɔ a woma wo mboa?
answer_twi_source: Wɔbetumi afa: Helplines (telefon so mmoa). Mpɔtam ahyehyɛdeɛ (Community organizations/shelters). Social services (Aban mmoa). Abɛɛfo ntetan (Online platforms) a ɛkyerɛ baabi a mmoa wɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatua nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ka ma mmabun a ebia wontumi ntua sika no?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ mmeae bi no, ebia sika fam mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa ma wɔatua nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ka ma mmabun a wontumi ntua. Ebia aban mpanyimfo, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow na ɛde nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ma. Mmabun betumi abisa sikasɛm mu mmoa a wobetumi apaw bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nipadua mu akwaa mu haw ahorow bi a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi anya, na ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaa ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi adi nsɛm yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwaa ho haw ahorow a ɛtaa haw mmabun ne: Brayɛ a Ɛnyɛ Daa: Te sɛ mogya a ɛtɔ kɛse, nsabuo a ɛnkɔ so daa, anaasɛ brayɛ mu yaw. Pelvic Pain: Ɛyaw a ɛba bere a obi rebu ne nsa anaa nna mu dwumadie, a akyerɛ nsɛm a yabobo so yie. Ahiade a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ho: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano ho nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ na wɔanya bi de asiw nyinsɛn a wonnim ho hwee. Nna mu Nyarewa (STI): Adwennwene a ɛfa STI a wosiw ano, nhwehwɛ mu, ne ayaresa ho. Awo Akwahosan Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wobenya nsɛm a edi mũ a ɛfa apɔmden mapa a ɛwɔ awoɔ mu nipadua, nna mu akwahosan, ne asetra kwan a ahoɔden wom a wɔpaw ho. Mmea ho adwumayɛbea ahorow di saa nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene yi ho dwuma denam: Nhwehwɛmu ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ brayɛ a ɛnkɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ ne ɛyaw a ɛwɔ baabi baabi (pelvic) mu no so. Afotu a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne akwan a wɔayɛ ama ankorankoro ahiade ne nea ɛbɛboa no. STI nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne siw ano ho nkyerɛkyerɛ. Awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwankyerɛ a edi mũ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So afotu nhyehyɛe anaa nnwuma pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade a ɛfa STI/HIV ano a wosiw ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, afotu nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade pɔtee a ɛfa STI/HIV ano a wosiw ho. Wobetumi de saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi ama denam sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaa intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow so. Dwumadi ahorow bi twe adwene si nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ so, bere a afoforo nso yɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ HIV a wosiw ano, STI nhwehwɛmu, anaa nnwuma a ɛma mmabun adamfofa su titiriw. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi taa de nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow, atipɛnfo mmoa, ne akwan horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun mu na wodi wɔn ahiade soronko ho dwuma ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ mmeae a wɔboa anaa mpɔtam a wɔbu nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho sɛ ɛsom bo, hyɛ ho nkuran, na wodi ho afahyɛ sɛ ɔkwan a ɛfa biribiara ho a wɔfa so hyɛ adwenemyare, yiedi, ne mmabun nkɔso pa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ayɛ mmeae a wɔboa anaa mpɔtam a wɔbu nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho sɛ ɛsom bo, hyɛ ho nkuran, na wodi ho afahyɛ denam amammerɛ a ɛma wobue wɔn ani, tema, ne obu ma wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Eyi bɛtumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwenemyare, yiyedi, ne mmabun nkɔso pa so. Sɛ wɔyɛ mmeae a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi, akyɛ wɔn suahu ahorow, na wɔaboa wɔn ho wɔn ho a, ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wɔama wɔn tumi. Mpanyimfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wonhu mmabun mmɔdenbɔ wɔ nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a wɔde bedi dwuma mu na wɔagye atom no hyɛ hia a ɛho hia no mu den na ɛhyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nyɛ wɔn mma kɛse wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma aboa ma abɛɛfo ntetan , ahomatrofo a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, anaa apomoden ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho.
answer_twi_source: Kɔ apomoden adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no na wo ne apomoden ho ɔyarehwɛfoɔ no nkasa, anaa sukuu no yareɛ dan
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn asiesie me pia mu ma nna pa bere a mere nyin no?
answer_twi_source: Ma wo pia mu nyɛ nwunu, esum, na ma hɔ nyɛ komm. Yi nneɛma te sɛ TV anaa phones firi hɔ. Fa nneɛma a ɛyɛ dɛ te sɛ sumii ne ntama siesie wo mpa no so.. Nya bere a woda daa na di so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛnna mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom kyerɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa mmara mu nsakrae so adi eyinom ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom betumi anya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so nkɛntɛnso bɔne denam nsɛm a ɛfata a wobenya, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛto ano hye so. Mmara mu nsakrae ho hia na ama wɔadi kwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan, nhomasua, ne ahofadi no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛtete dɔkotafoɔ ma wɔboa dɛmdifoɔ wɔ nna mu nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: Nteteeɛ (Workshops) fa dɛmdi, nkitahodie, ne obu ma ahofadi ho ne ɔhwɛ pa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua nhyehyɛe ne nna ho nkɔmmɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa ɔbea ne ɔbarima nna ho, ne abusuabɔ pa ho hyia?
answer_twi_source: Ma nkurɔfo nhu hia a abusua nhyehyɛe ho hia ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so ma mmabun. Nhomasua Ɔsatu: Yɛ ɔsatu anaa nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe de hyɛ nhomasua ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma a wobenya ho nkuran. Fa Atumfoɔ Di Dwuma: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ atumfoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe no kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma: Mmoa akuw: Kɔka anaa yɛ mmoa akuw a wɔkamfo awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow kyerɛ. Ahyehyɛde Ahorow a Wɔnnyɛ Mfaso: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo so no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama mmabun aa wɔwɔ dɛmdi nne ada adi na ɛka ho sɛ wɔ di SRH nkɔmmɔ?
answer_twi_source: Tie wɔn. Ma nsem nya nnyɛ fo (kasa emu da ho). Ma wɔnka nhyehyeɛ ho. Yɛ beae a ehodwo. Tete mpanyinfoɔ. Tipɛnfoɔ nwomasua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔabɔ mmɔden sɛ wobesiw "HIV" ano na wɔasa mmabun yiye?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu ne nwomasua asoɛeɛ bɛtumi aboa ama wɔanya "HIV" ano aduru ne ayaresa mmɔdenbɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri ama mmabun denam nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa mfeɛ pɔtee a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no ho, ama wɔanya nna mu akwahosan ho dwumadie wɔ beaeɛ hɔ anaa ɛnam nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn so, ɛsɛ sɛ SHEP Ntamgyinafoɔ di anim wɔ nteteeɛ a ɛfa adwumayɛfoɔ ne asuafoɔ ho wɔ HIV ho nimdeɛ ho, ne sukuu tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyiyim ahorow a ɛka bom, te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, tumidi, ne adesuakuw mu nyiyim ma nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn mu ba no yɛ kɛse, na akwan bɛn na wɔfa so di pɛyɛ a enni hɔ yi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyim ahodoɔ a ɛbom ba, te sɛ abusua-nyiyim (racism), dɛm-die nyiyim (ableism), ne ohia ne ahonyadeɛ mu mpapahwee (classism), hyɛ mmaa ne mmarima nyiyim ne anim-mmanneɛ mu den. Eyi ma nnipa a wɔhyia nyiyim ahodoɔ pii no hyia mpanneɛ ne mpapahwee foforɔ a ɛboro deɛ ankorankorɛ hyia so.Ɛhia sɛ yɛfa akwan a ɛka asɛm ahodoɔ yi bom (intersectional approaches) na yɛatumi adi saa nneyɛeɛ a emu yɛ duru yi ho dwuma, na yɛahwɛ sɛ mmɔden a yɛbɔ de hyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ nkuran no ka obiara bom na pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ wom. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ yɛhu na yɛdi nipasu ne osuahu ahodoɔ a ɛbom ba onipa so ho dwuma, na yɛadwene sɛnea tumi ne kwan pa a binom wɔ no kyekyɛ wɔ asetena mu ahodoɔ mu, na yɛahyɛ mmara ne dwumadie a ɛbɛdi nyiyim ne mpapahwee nnyinasoɔ titiriw ho dwuma.Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi agyina ama saa nkabom kwan yi de atia mmarima ne mmaa nyiyim ne anim-mmanneɛ denam mpɔtam a wɔbu wɔn abamfoɔ nne a wɔbɛma so, mmoa a wɔde bɛma dwumadie a ɛdi nyiyim nkabom ho dwuma, ne nhyɛsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma mpapahwee kɔ so dabiara a wobɛtia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra betumi ne mmabun akasa afa asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tohyɛ wɔn so  wɔ ɔkwan a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn so?
answer_twi_source: Awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra betumi ne mmabun akasa afa asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛ obi so mu ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn so denam: Nkitahodi akwan a ɛda adi na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛma mmabun ate nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho asɛm. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nkɛntɛnso a nsa ne nnubɔne nya wɔ atemmu, gyinaesi, ne sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ obi so no ho a wɔde bɛma. Ankorankoro ahye, pene a wɔpene so, ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ahobammɔ a wɔhwɛ wɔ asetena mu tebea horow mu ho hia a wosi so dua. Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔde wɔn ho ato wɔn nkate so na sɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ anaasɛ wɔrehunahuna wɔn wɔ tebea biara mu a, wɔnkasa. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ asanom nneyɛe a ɛfata ne akwan horow a wɔfa so tra ahobammɔ mu bere a wɔne atipɛnfo rebɔ fekuw no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne telehealth(akwahosan mmoa a yɛnam mfiridwuma so nya), na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn?
answer_twi_source: Telehealth kyerɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma a wɔde telefon so nkitahodi mfiridwuma di dwuma wɔ akyirikyiri. Ɛma ayarefo tumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo susuw ho denam video so frɛ, telefon so frɛ, anaa nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom a enhia sɛ wɔkɔsra wɔn ankasa. Telehealth ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ obi benya aduruyɛ ho afotu, ahwehwɛ yare no, ayaresa, na wahwɛ so afi ne fie anaa beae biara a intanɛt anaa telefon so nkitahodi wɔ hɔ. Nanso, ebia ɛho behia sɛ ɔbabun kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea hɔ kɔyɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu bere a ɛho hia no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde kamfo nkorɔfo ne nea wɔma nkorɔfo hu betumi adi wɔ biakoyɛ kɛse a wɔbɛma akɔ so wɔ ankorankoro adwumayɛbea ahorow, ɔmanfo, ne mmabun ntam wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho mmɔdenbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɔsatuo a wɔde kamfo nkorɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔma nkorɔfoɔ te aseɛ di dwuma titire wɔ adwumayɛkuo kɛseɛ a ɛbɛba ankorankoro adwumayɛkuo, ɔmanfoɔ, ne mmabun ntam wɔ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden mmɔdenbɔ mu denam hia a mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ho hia a wɔbɛma wɔate aseɛ, nkɔmmɔdie ne fekubɔ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no so. Wobetumi asi nkonimdie ho nsɛm so dua, akyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa, na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nnwuma a ɛhyɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetena mu nkabom ho nkuran, ahyɛ wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma bom nkɔ botaeɛ a wɔbom yɛ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen nea broni ka no 'dilemma' anaa nsemmisa a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer_twi_source: Peneeɛ: Nea pene kyerɛ ne sɛnea wɔbɛka ahye ahorow ho asɛm wɔ abusuabɔ mu ntease. Ahintasɛm: Kokoam nsɛm a ehia ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa anaa akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo hɔ a wɔbɛkari pɛ. Nyamesom mu Ntawntawdi: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ankorankoro gyidi anaa osuahu ahorow ntam ntawntawdi a wɔde di dwuma. Atipɛnfo Nhyɛso: Sɛnea wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ade wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe anaa sɔhwɛ ho ho gyinaesi. Intanɛt so Suban: Abrabɔ pa a wosusuw ho wɔ Intanɛt so, te sɛ ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔde ma anaasɛ nkitahodi a obu wom a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, asetra, ne nhyehyɛe mu nneɛma nya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi anya, ɛka obiara ho, ne sɛnea etu mpɔn wɔ tebea horow ne mpɔtam ahorow mu no so nsusuanso, na anammɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de adi akwanside ahorow ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ pɛyɛ ne ahorow ahorow a ɛwɔ saa mmeae yi mu no ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ, asetena, ne nhyehyeɛ mu nneɛma bɛtumi anya nsusuansoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ mmeaeɛ a ahobanbɔ wɔ a wɔbɛtumi anya, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ adwuma yie wɔ tebea ahodoɔ ne mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu. Mmabun betumi adi akwanside ahorow ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ pɛyɛ ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran wɔ saa mmeae yi mu denam nneyɛe a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa ahodwiriw ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, nyiyim ne adwemmɔne a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse no so. Wɔbɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma ayɛ adwuma abom de ahunu na wɔadi nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ a ɛmma obi nya kwan ne kyɛfa a ɔnya, te sɛ kasa mu akwansideɛ, sikasɛm mu nsonsonoeɛ, ne ananmusifoɔ a wɔnni ho dwuma. Ɛdenam akwan horow a wɔfa so di nkitaho ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so no, mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ no yɛ nea ankorankoro nyinaa gye akwaaba na ɛyɛ nea wobetumi akɔ hɔ, a wɔn fibea anaa wɔn nipasu mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne adwuma ahorow anaa akuw afoforo a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ ayɛ adwuma de ayɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw GBV ano? (adwumayɛ ne fekubɔ) .
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ nnwumakuo Ahorow a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Dedaw: Hwehwɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so anaa bisa wɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow sa nnwumakuo ahorow reyɛ adwuma wɔ GBV ano aduru ho. Kɔ hu wɔn na ka sɛ wobɛboa! Wo ne Sukuu ahodoɔ nyɛ adwuma: susu nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa GBV ano aduru ho ma asuafoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Mmabun ne Mpanyimfo Nkitahodi: Fa nyansahyɛ ma sɛ wo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mpanyimfo di wɔn anim nyɛ biako mfa nyɛ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri (mpanyimfo akwankyerɛ + wo mmabun adwene).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ebetumi afi nna ho gyinaesi mu aba, nea eye ne nea enye nyinaa, na mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw ho?
answer_twi_source: nsunsuanso pa: Nkate fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ne abusuabɔ a ɛda wo ne wo hokafo ntam. Obu a wubenya wɔ wo ho ne ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ wo nna mu. Abusuabɔ a ɛda wo ne wo hokafo ntam no mu ayɛ den denam osuahu ahorow a wobɛkyɛ so. Nsunsuanso a enye: Asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ ne sɛ obi benya STI ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da. Nkate mu nsunsuanso te sɛ nnuho anaa afɔdifɛɛ. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ so, a ntawntawdi anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ ka ho. Nsunsuanso no mu nsusuwi: Dwene nneɛma a ebefi wo gyinaesi ahorow mu aba mprempren ne daakye ho. Susuw sɛnea asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba no ne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia no ho. Nsɛm a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ ho ban ho. Te asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nna mu dwumadi ahorow mu no ase. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa asiane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so ho. Hwehwɛ afotu fi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di a wɔwɔ osuahu wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na wɔfa so hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo fibea ahorow mu pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, ahotoso, ne animhwɛ a ɛyɛ nokware, nea wogye di, ne animhwɛ a wɔde hwehwɛ mu na wɔkasa tia, a nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ, nsɛm a wɔde gyina nsɛm so, ne nsɛnm ho amanneɛnbɔfo a wɔyɛ  ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ fibea ahorow a ɛyɛ nokware, ahotoso, ne animhwɛ a ɛyɛ nokware, ne animhwɛ mu nhwehwɛmu na wɔkasa tia no bi ne: Nokwasɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu: Hwɛ sɛ nsɛm no yɛ nokware  wɔ nsɛm a wɔde fi mmeae a wotumi de ho to so anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔagye din a wɔhwehwɛ nokwasɛm ahorow a wɔde bɛka ho no so. Mmeammea Nhwehwɛmu : Hwɛ mmeae pii na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ nsɛm no hyia na adanse foa so. Nimdeɛ a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ: Susuw nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo anaa wɔn a wɔwɔ nsunsunaso no ahwehwɛde, adansedi nkrataa, ne wɔn nimdeɛ ho de ahwɛ sɛnea wɔn nsɛm no yɛ nokware. Dwumadie a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ: Hwehwɛ animhwɛ a ɛbɛtumi aba, nea ɛkanyan, anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm akyi na ama woate n’adwene anaa n’atirimpɔw a ɛwɔ aseɛ no ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So akwan anaa dwumadi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a m’abusua betumi abom ayɛ de ama yɛn adwenemyare ahorow atu mpɔn na ahyɛ yɛn abusuabɔ mu den?
answer_twi_source: Mobom sua aseda denam nneɛma a moda ase wɔ ho da biara a mobɛkyɛ so. Monyɛ abusua nhyiam daa ho nhyehyɛe na mo ne mo ho mo ho nhwɛ na moasusuw nsɛnnennen anaa dadwen biara ho. Mombom nyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, te sɛ agumadi, yoga, anaa akwantu, na ama nipadua ne adwene mu yiyedi anya nkɔso. Yɛ nhyehyɛe kɔ anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛma nkate pa nya nkɔso na ɛma nkae a ɛyɛ anigye sɛ abusua. Mommom tuu mo ho mma mommoa adwuma bi a modwene ho na hyɛ mo atirimpɔw ne abusuabɔ a mo ne mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ no mu den.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan ne nneɛma bɛn na wɔfa so de nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma, na so ɛfata mfe a obi adi, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na egyina adanse so?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ akwan a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma de ma nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ no fata mfe a obi adi, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na egyina adanse so. Akwan a wɔtaa fa so no betumi ayɛ adesuadan mu ɔkasa, kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow, multimedia nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne ahɔho akasafo. Ɛsɛ sɛ nwomasua nneɛma da amammerɛ mu adwene ahodoɔ, kasa ahodoɔ, ne adesua akwan adi. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nneɛma foforo daa ma ɛne mprempren nyansahu mu adanse ne nneyɛe pa a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no hyia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na yɛtete akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbetumi ahunu nsɛnkyerɛne wɔ adwenemyareɛ mu na watumi aboa asuafoɔ wɔ berɛ a ɛsɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Akyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnkyerɛnne ho. Kwan a wɔfa so kasa. Nwuma a wɔne afutufoɔ bom yɛ. Sukuu hyehyeɛ mu akwankyerɛ. Sukuu mu bammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ STI a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ, na ayaresa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI) bi a:Hwehwɛ Ayaresabea Hwɛ: Kasa kyerɛ w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ ntɛm pa ara na moadi akwan a wobɛfa so asa yareɛ no ne anamon a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu ho nkɔmɔ.Di Aduroyɛ Akwankyerɛ So: Di akwankyerɛ a w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ de bɛma wo no so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
