Yei bɛtumi aka nnuru te sɛ "antibiotics," "antivirals," anaa "antiretrovirals," a ɛgyina nna mu yareɛ pɔtee a wowɔ no so.Bɔ Wo Nna mu Akunneaba (Partners) Amanneɛ: Bɔ obiara a wo ne no ana mmoa nna mu nkitahodie mmerɛ tiawa bi a atwam yi amanneɛ fa yareɛ no ho, na ama wɔn nso akɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu, na sɛ ɛhia a, wɔanya aduro na yareɛ no ammɛtrɛ kɔ baabiara.Yɛ Nna a Ahobammɔ Wom: Twentwɛn wo ho firi nna ho anaa fa "condoms" di dwuma yie mmerɛ biara na ama yareɛ no ammɛtrɛ ankɔ afoforɔ so mmerɛ a worenye aduro no.Aduroyɛ ahorow gu ahorow a ɛgyina nna mu yareɛ ko a wowɔ ne nneɛma afoforɔ so, enti ɛhia paa sɛ wo ne w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ bɔ mu yɛ adwuma na moanya aduro nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata wo paa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa tebea horow a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae no betumi ne ɔmanfo anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow abira mu?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm ne nnwuma a wonya no mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne: Ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa anaa apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde kokoam nnwuma ne mmoa ma mmabun. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ de wɔn adwene sii nna ne awo apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa nya so. Hotlines anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛde nsɛm, mmoa, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ma. te sɛ Agoo SHE+ online platform denam 5100 a wobɛfrɛ so, YENKASA Nnɔmba a wontua hwee(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho Sukuu mu apɔwmuden asoɛe anaa afotufoɔ a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama asuafoɔ wɔ nnwuma a wɔbɛnya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan bi a mɛfa so ama ahotoso ne obuo ama yɛn ho yɛn ho wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu, ahyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, na me ne m’ahokafo anaa m’atipɛnfo abom asusuw asiane ahorow ho na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan a wɔfa so nya ahotoso ne obu ma wo yɔnko wɔ abusuabɔ mu, hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, na wo ne ahokafo anaa atipɛnfo bɛbom asusuw asiane ahorow ho na wɔadi ho dwuma no bi ne: Ahye a emu da hɔ a wode besi hɔ: Ka w’ahye ho asɛm na di afoforo de ho asɛm, na woayɛ fapem a ɛbɛma ahotoso ne obu ama wo ho wo ho wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Tie a wode nsiyɛ: Tie wo hokafo anaa w’atipɛnfo adwene, nea ɛhaw wo, ne nea ɔpɛ, na da tema ne ntease adi. Nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee: Di nokware na da adi pefee wɔ wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne w’atirimpɔw ho, na hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ abusuabɔ mu ho nkuran. Gyinaesi a wɔkyɛ: Fa wo hokafo anaa w’atipɛnfo ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho, bom nsusuw asiane ahorow ho, nsusuw akwan horow a wobetumi afa so ho, na hwehwɛ ano aduru a wɔn baanu nyinaa pene so. Adwene a enhyia a wɔde obu ma: Gye adwene a ɛsonsonoe tom na bu no, de wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ mu na wɔyɛ apam bere a ɛho hia de siesie ntawntawdi anaa nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ asiane ho adwene mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wohia mmoa a wɔde bɛfa ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya dabere ne adan ho dwumadie no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow de aboa wɔn ma wɔafa ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya dabere ne adan ho nnwuma mu: Mmoa ahomatrofo: Mpɔtam hɔ mmoa telefon anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo betumi de mmoa, nsɛm, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ dabere ne adan ho nnwuma a ɛfata mu ntɛm ara. Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahorow: Nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, mmabun atrae, ne akuw a wɔkamfo nkurɔfo taa de nsɛm a wɔhwɛ so ne mmoa ho nnwuma ma de boa mmabun ma wonya dabere ne adan ho nneɛma. Asetra mu nnwuma ahorow: Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa asetra mu nnwuma dwumadibea ahorow betumi de mmoa ama wɔ adan ho akwammisa, sikasɛm mu mmoa, ne mmoa afoforo a wɔde ma mmabun a wohia mmoa no ho. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow: Wɛbsaet ne intanɛt so directories  betumi akyerɛw dabere ne adan ho nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ, ne nsɛm a wobetumi de adi nkitaho ne nea wɔde hwehwɛ sɛ obi fata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan ahorow bɛn na yɛbɛfa so agyina nyiyimu ne osuahunu bɔne a ɛfa awoasɛm ho apomuden ho ano?
answer_twi_source: Hwehwɛ Mmoa: kɔ nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa afotufo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wɔte ase na wonni atɛn nkyɛn. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow betumi ama biakoyɛ ne ntease ama. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua hokwan ahorow a wowɔ ne nneɛma a wubetumi anya ho ade. Sɛ wunim hokwan ahorow a wowɔ a, ebetumi ama woanya tumi a wode bɛkasa atia nyiyim. Wo Ho Hwɛ: Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma obi nya yiyedi te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, anigyede, ahomegye anaa adwennwen mu. Fa ayamhyehye ne nsɛm pa a wɔde si so dua di dwuma. Kamfo Nsakrae: Fa wo ho hyɛ akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔko tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim mu. W’asɛm a wobɛkyɛ no betumi ama nkurɔfo ate ase na ɛde nsakrae aba. Adwumayɛfo Mmoa: Afotu betumi ama wɔanya akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ne baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi adi osuahu ahorow ho dwuma. Fa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), ne PPA Yenkasa abɛɛfo ntentan beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) so ne afotufo di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ne me kyɛ adwene a ɛfa asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden, ne sɛnea ebetumi anya STI asiane so nkɛntɛnso ho asɛm.
answer_twi_source: Asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden yɛ asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma a ɛka apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso. Wɔ STI ho no, eyinom betumi ayɛ: Ohia: Akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano a wonnya pii. Nhomasua: Nimdeɛ a wonni wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Adan: Asetra tebea a entumi nnyina betumi ama nneyɛe a asiane wom no ayɛ kɛse. Asetra mu Mmoa: Asetra mu mmoa a wonnya no betumi ama wapaw nna a asiane wom. Sɛ yɛdi saa asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ nneɛma yi ho dwuma a, yɛbɛtumi abɔ ɔman a obiara wɔ hokwan sɛ ɔbɛbɔ ne nna mu apɔwmuden ho ban.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn betumi aboa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ wɔ abusua no mu na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Awofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no bɛtumi aboa mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ wɔ: Suban a ɛyɛ pɛ a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ ne ofie asɛdeɛ a wɔbɛkyɛ a mmarima ne mmaa mfa ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nsusuwii hunu ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Mmofra a wɔbɛma wɔn nhwɛsoɔ ahodoɔ ne mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie a ɛnyɛ atetesɛm mu dwumadie. Mmofra ahofadi ne gyinaesi a wɔbɛboa a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a wɔbɛma mmofra ada wɔn adwene adi wɔ ahofadi mu a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ pene a wɔde ma a nimdeɛ wɔ mu ne gyinaesi wɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow a wowɔ wɔ pene a wɔde ma wɔ nimdeɛ mu ne gyinaesi a wosi wɔ apɔwmuden ho no bi ne: Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wɔbɔ wo amanneɛ wɔ w’ayaresa tebea, ayaresa a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa, ne asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba ho. Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wubisa nsɛm na wohwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu fa w’apɔwmuden  ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho. Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wusi gyinae wɔ w’apɔwmuden ho, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobɛpene ayaresa so anaasɛ wobɛpow, bere tenten a wobu wo sɛ wofata sɛ woyɛ saa no. Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wode ɔpanyin anaa ɔkamfofo a wogye no di bɛka w’apɔwmuden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho, sɛ wopɛ anaasɛ ɛho hia a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa LGBTQ+ nneɛma a wɔahyehyɛ, a wɛbsaet, telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, ne ɔman nnwumakuo ahorow ka ho ma.
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ nna ho nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma LGBTQ+ mmabun a ebia wɔbɛhyia haw anaa nitan wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wobu obi nnipa ahokwan so, mfa ho ne wɔn nna bɔbea enti polisifo wɔ hɔ ma obiara a ɔte nka sɛ onni ahobammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nnyinasosɛm titiriw bɛn na ɛwɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ wɔn sika a wobenya ho nhyehyɛe de ayɛ sikakorabea de adi kan?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn no hwehwɛ sɛ: Sika a wonya ne ɛka a wɔbɔ no akyi di: Wɔkyerɛw sika a wonya fi mu nyinaa na wɔkyekyɛ sika a wɔsɛe no mu akuwakuw de ate sika a wɔsɛe no ase na wɔakyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae. Sika a wɔsɛe no: Sika a wɔbɛkyekyɛ ama ɛka a ɛho hia (ahiade) ne sika a wɔsɛe no wɔ wɔn pɛ mu (nea wɔpɛ) bere a wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛkora sika a ɛdɔɔso a wɔde bedu sikasɛm botae ahorow ho no. Nhwehwɛmu ne nsakraeɛ: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ mu daa, nsakraeɛ a ɛhia a wɔbɛyɛ, na wɔakɔ so abu akontaa wɔ sikasɛm botaeɛ ho. Nneɛma a egye ntɛmpɛ ho nhyehyɛe: Sikakorabea a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de atua ɛka anaa ɔhaw ahorow a wɔnhwɛ kwan, na ama sikasɛm mu ahotɔ ne asomdwoe aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne abusua mufo betumi abɛyɛ wɔn a wɔboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm mpɔtam hɔfo na wɔakamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Trɛw Nhumu mu: Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo hokwan ne ahiade ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wɔ nna ho. Nsɛnnennen Ho Nsusuwii hunu: Kasa tia nyiyim na hyɛ adwene a ɛka obiara ho wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ho nkuran. Boa Nhyehyɛeɛ a Ɛka Nnipa Ka ho: Kamfo nhyehyɛɛ a ɛbɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de saa nneɛma yi adi dwuma yie?
answer_twi_source: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee. Eyinom bi ne sika a wɔde ma, mmoa a wɔde ma, sukuufo bosea, adwuma-adesua nhyehyɛe, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, aban ahyehyɛde ahorow, 'NGO' ahorow, ne ankorankoro ahyehyɛde ahorow de ma. Mmabun betumi afa saa nneɛma yi so yiye denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ akwan a ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so, ntease a wɔbɛte wɔ fata a wɔfata ne akwammisa nhyehyɛe ho, akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi sukuu afotufo anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa ho afotufo hɔ, ne akwammisa nkrataa a wɔde bɛma wɔ bere ano na wɔawie no so. Bio nso, wobetumi ahwehwɛ sika foforo a wobenya te sɛ nnipadɔm sika ho nhyehyɛe, mpɔtam hɔ sika a wɔde ma, ne adesua mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a adwumawura boa a broni ka no 'employer-sponsorship tuition assistance programs'.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔyem a wɔpaw sɛ wɔbɛfa wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ awofo, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwan horow ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔayem na wɔapaw sɛ wɔbɛma obi agye wɔn ba no ayɛ ne dea (adoption) anaa wɔbɛtete wɔn ba no ara no wɔ mmara mu ahobammɔ a ɛma wɔn kwan sɛ wɔsi wɔn ara wɔn gyinae, na wɔnya mmoa dwumadi ahorow, eyinom bi ne:Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔsi wɔn ara wɔn pɛ so gyinae: Wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔsi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ kwan a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔfa so wɔ wɔn awo ho (reproductive options), sɛ ɛyɛ obi a obegye ba no ayɛ ne dea (adoption), wɔn ara wɔn mma ntetee, anaa mpopae (abortion). Ɛsɛ sɛ wosi saa gyinae yi wɔ wɔn pɛ mu a obiara nhyɛ wɔn, mpiar wɔn, anaa nnye wɔn nkyim.Akwanya a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya afotu, mmara mu mmoa, ne asetena mu mmoa: Wɔwɔ kwan sɛ wɔnya afotu ne mmara mu mmoa a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔate wɔn hokwan ahorow ase, na wɔahu akwan horow a wobetumi afa so anya mmoa a ɛbɛma wɔatumi asi gyinae pa. .
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na hormone yɛ wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔkanyan onyin, wɔsesa nne, wonya nipadua mu nneɛma te sɛ nufu anaa anim nhwi nsunsuanso, na ɛka adwene ne atenka nso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ (consent) kyerɛ wɔ mmaa ne mmaa anaa mmarima ne mmarima ntam abusuabɔ mu, anaa obi a ɔnyɛ ɔbarima pɔtee anaa ɔbaa pɔtee (non-binary) ntam abusuabɔ mu? (Ɛkyerɛ anigye mu pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkɔ so daa?)
answer_twi_source: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa apɔmuden ho dwumayɛni ne wo bɛbɔ peneɛ ho nkɔmmɔ. Wobu LGBTQ+ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana. pene a wɔpene so ho hia wɔ asetra mu biribiara mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na nna a yɛtwe yɛn ho fi ho ayɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano?
answer_twi_source: Ɛyi nyinsɛn ne nna mu yarewa (STI) asiane firi hɔ korakora. Ɛsiw nyinsɛn ne yareɛ kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔkasa ma mmofra (youth advocates), ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim betumi adi wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ na ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan atu mpɔn no mu?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔkasa ma mmofra (youth advocates), ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim di dwuma titiriw wɔ apɔmuden nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhyɛ mu den ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ na ama ASRH atu mpɔn no mu. Wɔbɛtumi de atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne mmoa ama, ayɛ nnwuma a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam, na wɔakamfo ASRH nsɛmti a wɔde bɛka sukuu adesua ne mpɔtam nhyehyɛeɛ ho. Saa akannifoɔ nkumaa yi nso bɛtumi ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no adi nkitaho de ama nkurɔfoɔ ate ASRH nsɛm ho asɛm, akamfo sɛ wɔmfa nneɛma mma ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ, na wɔhyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nsakraeɛ a ɛde nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma afotuo a wɔde ma ansa na wɔanyinsɛn a ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasiesie wɔn ho ama nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom sɛ wɔresusuw ho a.
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woresusuw nyinsɛn ho a, afotu a wode ma ansa na woanyinsɛn no betumi aboa wo ma ɛyɛ nwonwa. Nneɛma bi ni: Nea broni ka no 'Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana' (PPAG): Ebia wɔde afotuo a wɔde ma ansa na wɔanyinsɛn (ebia ɛsono sɛnea ɛwɔ hɔ). Frɛ wɔn mmoa telefon (0244312151) na bisa (Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8am-5pm). Nea broni ka no 'Ghana Health Service' akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ne sukuu yareɛbea no de afotuo ma mmabun ansa na wɔanyinsɛn a wontua hwee. Ka w’akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo kasa Awo a wɔde hwɛ ansa na wɔayɛ no ho hia ma nyinsɛn nyinaa, nanso ɛho hia titiriw sɛ wowɔ asiane bi a. Sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bɛkasa a, ɛma wotumi de akwankyerɛ a ɛfata ma wɔn na wodi asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ho dwuma. Sɛ woresusuw ho sɛ wubenyinsɛn a, afotu a wode ma ansa na woanyinsɛn no betumi ama woanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛso ɛreha wɔn ne nsunsuansoɔ a ɛde ba adwenemyare so?
answer_twi_source: Sukuu akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ: Sukuu akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ betumi aboa, akyerɛkyerɛ kokoam ne nneɛma ahodoɔ bi so betumi aboa asuafoɔ a watipɛnfoɔ rehyɛ wɔn so ne wɔn a wɔwɔ adwenemhaw. Asoeɛ a wɔhwe adwenemhaw so ahomatorofo: Asoeɛ ahomatorofo bi te sɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra ho nsɛm, kokoam mmoa a wɔde boa mmabun wɔ ɔhaw mu (0800678678). Kuo a wɔboa: Sɛ wode woho bɛhye atipɛnfoɔ kuo a wɔn a wɔnimde wɔ adwenemhaw mu da ano, ɛbetumi aboa ama woatumi akyɛ suahunu, anya mmoa asane nso asua akwan ahodoɔ a wobetumi ako tipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ so. Ntentanfidie so mmoa:Ntentanfidie so kuo ahodoɔ a ɛhwɛ adwenemhaw na wɔboa atipɛnfoɔ betumi aboa wɔ ama wonsɛm a ɛho hia, afutusɛm ne ntipɛnfoɔ nkitahodie ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa afiri wɔn atipɛnfoɔ hɔ ne adwenem apɔmden ho nyinaa. Mpɔtam kuo: Mpɔtam kuo ahodoɔ te se asɔrekuo ne ade betumi aboa aso nhyɛsoɔ a tipɛnfoɔ deba ne mmabun adwenem apɔmdensɛm ho nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa na wɔakamfo wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu "survivors" wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ 'sexual violence" mu, ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so na wobu wɔn ho nkuran, na wɔkasa tia suban ne nneyɛe a epira 'harmful attitudes" a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so wɔ wɔn sukuu, mmusua, ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi aboa na wɔakamfo wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu "sexual violence", ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so na wobu wɔn ho nkuran, na wɔkasa tia suban ne nneyɛe a epira denam: Gyidi ne wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔbɛboa wɔn: Tie wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no a wonni atɛn, de mmoa ne nea wɔagye atom ama, na wɔahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow hɔ. Atipɛnfo Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Fa atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, nsɛm a wɔka, anaa sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow so ma nkurɔfo nhu nna mu basabasayɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Mmonnaato Amammerɛ a Ɛyɛ Nsɛnnennen "Challenging Rape Culture": Kasa tia mmonnaato :"rape" ho asodi a wɔde to wɔn so, aguaman a wɔhyɛ wɔn aniwu, ne mmonnaato amammerɛ afoforo a ɛwɔ sukuu, mmusua, ne mpɔtam hɔ. Mpene a Wɔhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, ahye, ne abusuabɔ a obu wom ho. Wo ho a wode bɛhyɛ mu: Kɔka nhyehyɛe ahorow a sukuufo di anim ho, tu wo ho ma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no, na fa wo ho hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ de siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔhyɛ tumidi ho nkuran no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahobammɔ ho haw bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa akwantu a mmabun betumi apaw bere a wɔrenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Aane, ebia ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa akwantu a mmabun betumi apaw bere a wɔrenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Asiane a ɛwɔ akwanhyia anaa opira mu bere a wɔde ɔmanfo kar anaa kar a wɔde fa nnipa di dwuma, titiriw ma mmabun a wɔn nkutoo tu kwan. Nneɛma a wobetumi de akɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ nnim anaasɛ wonnim bere a wɔnantew anaa wɔde sakre rekɔ akwahosan ho mmeae ahorow, titiriw wɔ mmeae a nsɛmmɔnedi dɔɔso anaa kar akwan a ɛyɛ kyenkyenenn no. Ankorankoro ahobammɔ ne kokoam nsɛm ho dadwen, titiriw ma mmabun a wotu kwan kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ mmeae a wonnim anaasɛ wɔde kar ho nhyehyɛe di dwuma ne ahɔho. Asiane a ɛwɔ ɔhaw anaa nyiyim mu, titiriw ma mmabun a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ a ebia wobehyia adwemmɔne anaa ayayade bere a wɔde akwantu ho nhyehyɛe redi dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna mu akwahosan pɔtee no bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho a egyina dɛmdi pɔtee no so. Nsɛntitiriw bi ni: Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ɔhokafo ho hia na ama wɔanya nna mu osuahu a ahobammɔ ne anigye wom. Sɛnea Wotumi Nya: Susuw nipadua mrɛ bere ahorow ne hia a ehia sɛ wonya mmeae a wotumi kɔ hɔ ma wo ne obi bɛbɔ abɛn no ho. Ɛyaw ano aduru: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm bi betumi ama obi ate ɛyaw bere a ɔne obi reda. Wo ne oduruyɛfo nkasa mfa akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ɛyaw ano ho. Mfiri a ɛboa: Ebia mfiri a ɛboa wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔ nna mu dwumadi mu. Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bi hwehwɛ akwan horow a wobetumi apaw mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka m’ahiadeɛ ne m’ahyeɛ ahorow ho asɛm atwa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho ahyia, berɛ a mimmu w’awerɛkyekye ne ahyeɛ nso?
answer_twi_source: Ka w’ahiade ne w’ahye ahorow ho asɛm wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia a wo ne w’awofo besusu ho pefee ne nokwaredi mu no ho. Fa "Me" nsɛm no da w'atenka ne nea wopɛ adi, si so dua sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ mu berɛ a wobu mo ho mo ho ahotɔ nso. Gye w’awofo ahiadeɛ ne n’ahyeɛ nso tom, na mombom  hwehwɛ kari pɛ a ɛbɛma wɔatumi adi nkitaho pefee berɛ a wodi mo ho mo ho atenka ne ahyeɛ ni.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate kwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no ase?
answer_twi_source: Aane, nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho ase, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhomasua nneɛma ne wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho mmara ne hokwan ahorow ho ma Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so a ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho Afotu adwuma ne mmoa akuw a wɔyɛ wɔn ho titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho ma mmabun Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan horow a wɔfa so sie ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a emu da hɔ ma
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mebu me nsa berɛ a minni fie a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wobu wo nsa bere a wunni fie a, mma ne ɛnhaw wo! Nea wubetumi ayɛ ni: Sɛ wowɔ pad anaa ntama a, fa di dwuma. Sɛ wunni brayɛ ho nnuru biara a, bisa w’adamfo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo bi sɛ wɔwɔ bi anaa. Sɛ wuntumi nnya pad anaa ntama a , wubetumi de tiafi krataa a wɔabobɔw adi dwuma sɛ bere tiaa mu adeyɛ kosi sɛ wubetumi anya nneɛma a ɛfata a wode bɛkɔ brayɛ mu. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wode kotoku anaa bag ketewa bi a wɔde ntama kakraa bi a bɛhyɛ mu, enti woasiesie wo ho bere nyinaa. Wubetumi nso ne sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ɔfotufo bi akasa afa nnuru a wɔde bɛyɛ wo ho yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hena na metumi ne no akasa wɔ me sukuu mu sɛ mete nka sɛ minni ahobammɔ anaasɛ mihyia GBV fi osuani foforo hɔ a? (afotufo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di) .
answer_twi_source: Sukuu sickbay ayarehwɛfo anaa Sukuu afotufo bɛtumi de mmoa ama na wɔaboa wo ama woabɔ GBV amanneɛ sɛ ɛno ne deɛ wopɛ a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne bɛn saa na ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ adwene mu haw (mental health struggles)?
answer_twi_source: Adwene nsesaeɛ (awerɛhoɔ/abufuo). Suban nsesaeɛ (anikonam, aduanedie/nna). Adwene a entumi ntena adeɛ so. Tiyaw. Wudie adwene.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn na matumi ahwɛ sɛnea me ba no rekɔ so anyin wɔ me yafunu mu (akokoaa no keka ne ho) bere a mewɔ fie?.
answer_twi_source: Ma w’adwene nsi sɛnea wo ba no keka ne ho (sɛ ɔrepempem anaasɛ ɔrebuebue) so bere a woahyɛ aseɛ rete nka (mpɛn pii no ɛfiri nnawɔtwe 18 kɔsi 20 ntam). Sɛ abofra no keka-ne-ho no so tew a, ɛbɛtumi ayɛ asiane ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, enti kɔhu w’apɔwmuden mu dwumayɛni ntɛm ara sɛ ɛba saa a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu  sɛ nimdiɛ bi a ɛfa nna mu agodie ho ayaresa ɛyɛ nokware anaa sɛ ntorɔ ɛnam nhwehwɛanim bi nti ?
answer_twi_source: Aban Apɔwmuden ntetanmmea 'websites' bi te sɛ; Centers for Disease Control (CDC), anaa World Health Organization (WHO), ɛma nimdiɛ a ɛfata. Hwehwɛ nimdiɛ fi akuo bi te sɛ; Planned Parenthood ne nkrataa a adesua mu akukudam agye ato mu. Wobenya bi so wɔ Suapon 'University' websites anaa wɔn nwoma mu. Hwɛ yie wɔ nimdiɛ a agyina nhwehwɛanim 'baised' soɔ. Hwehwɛ nimdiɛ a obia nntumi nni akyinie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm di dwuma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so hwɛ mmabun akwahosan ho wɔ amanne kwan so no ho?
answer_twi_source: Ayaresa a ɛhyɛ amanehunu nso (Trauma-informed care) yɛ soronko wɔ kwan a yɛfa so hwɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa akwahosan daa no ho. Deɛ ɛma ɛyɛ soronko ne sɛ, saa kwan yi hu na ɛdi nsunuansoɔ a nnyigyeɛ ne amanehunu kɛseɛ bi (trauma) de ba obi asetena ne n'akwahosan so ho dwuma.Ɛsi so dua sɛ yɛbɛte obiara nea ɔfamu ne n'ahiadeɛ ase wɔ ne mmerɛ a ɔfaa amanehunu mu no ho, mmom nnyɛ sɛ yɛbɛdwene yadeɛ no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nkoara ho. Saa ayaresa kwan yi nso de ahotɔ, gyidie, ne nkabom di kan wɔ kwan a yɛfa so sa yadeɛ anaa yɛma obi ho dwo no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahunu mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nteteeɛ (internships) wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahunu mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nteteeɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam denam akwan ahorow so, a ebi ne: Sukuu ne kɔlɛgye adwuma mmoa: Sukuu pii ma nneɛma, nhyiam, ne adwuma ho amanneɛbɔ de boa asukuufoɔ ma wɔhunu nteteeɛ ne adwuma hokwan a ɛfa wɔn adesua ho. Intanɛt so adwuma mmeae ne wɛbsaet: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor, ne Idealist kyerɛ nteteeɛ ne adwuma ho amanneɛbɔ a efi adwumawura, adwuma, ne mmeae ahorow pii. Nkitahodiɛ: Adwuma nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ denam abusua, nnamfo, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ so betumi ama akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛfa nteteeɛ hokwan ne adwumawura a wɔbɛtumi ayɛ adwuma ama wɔn ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne adwuma: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnhwehwɛ mfasoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, aban adwumadibea, ne adwuma a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ betumi ama nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, adwuma nhyiam, anaa adwuma hokwan a wɔayɛ ama mmabun pɔtee.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wubetumi aka sɛnea yɛn abusua no gyinapɛn ahorow asiesie wo gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho no ho nhwɛso ahorow bi akyerɛ me?
answer_twi_source: Nhwɛsoɔ ne sɛ, sɛnea yesi obu ne nkitahodi so dua no anya ɔkwan a mefa so di abusuabɔ ho dwuma, baabi a mede ntease ne pene a me yɔnko bedi kan di kan no so nkɛntɛnso. Yɛn bo a yɛasi wɔ nhomasua ne asɛyɛde ho nso akyerɛ me gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata a mɛhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia no kwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan foforo bi a wɔfa so di dwuma wɔ aman ahorow so de di nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ pene, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Akwan foforɔ: Nkitahodiɛ Nhyiamu: Dwumadie binom de nkitahodiɛ nhyiamu di dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛ pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ne app ahorow de kokoam nsɛm ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa wɔn bɔbeasu mu. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim betumi ama wɔanya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde nipadua mfoni kyerɛ no so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nipadua mfoni ahorow so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, na ɛka mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu wɔ akwan horow so denam: Ahoɔfɛ ho adwene ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ebia ɛsono wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu a wɔhyehyɛ, na ɛde nipadua ahorow, ahoɔfɛ, ne nea wɔpɛ ho mfoni ahorow ba wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. Boa a ɛboa ma nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a ɛfa abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛfa nnipa ho no kɔ so tra hɔ, a ɛka sɛnea wogyina hɔ ma nipadua ahorow ne sɛnea wohu no so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ mu ahokokwaw ne nkate a ɛho hia bere a wɔrekyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nipadua mfoni ho ase no so dua, a wobehu sɛnea nipasu ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow no di nkitaho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn bere a me ho asɛe?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wodi bra nkekae ho dwuma a, ebetumi ayɛ abofu, nanso afotu bi ni: Yɛ ade ntɛm: Fa nsuonwini hohoro nkekae no ntɛm ara sɛnea wubetumi. Kwati nsu a ɛyɛ hyew, efisɛ ebetumi ama nkekae no ayɛ kɛse. Adi a wɔde yi nkekae: Fa ade a wɔde yi nkekae anaa samina gu nkekae no so na ma ɛntra hɔ simma kakraa bi ansa na woahohoro. Ahwɛyiye: Hyɛ ntade ase a ɛyɛ tuntum anaa nsusuwso ne ase wɔ wo nna mu na ama nkekae no renhu kɛse. Ahiade kotoku: Fa kotoku ketewaa bi a ɛwɔ ntade ase ne pioto a ɛho nhia sie wo baage anaa adaka mu ma tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ. Kae sɛ obaa biaa ho tumi sɛe, enti bɔ mmɔden sɛ w'an nniwu . Ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛwɔ brayɛ mu, na sɛ woyɛ ahwɛyiye kakraa bi a, ɛnyɛ den sɛ wubedi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya adwenemyare ho nsɛm a edi mu na ahotosɔ wɔ mu wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wunya adwenemyare ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so na wotumi de ho to so wɔ Intanɛt so a, susuw afotu a edidi so yi ho: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow hɔ. Hwɛ sɛ ebia nsɛm a egyina adanse so a nhwehwɛmu afoa so na adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata akyerɛw anaa wɔasan ahwɛ mu anaa. Hwɛ sɛ wogye  ahorow abɛɛfo ntentan no di denam nsɛm a wɔde ama no akyerɛwfo, nsɛm a wofi mu kae, ne nna a wotintimii a wobɛhwehwɛ mu no so. Hwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa ho na hwehwɛ mmeae a wonya fi mu yiye ansa na wode wo ho ato so ama adwenemyare ho nsɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Su anaa nneyɛɛ ahorow bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ wɔ ɔfotufo bi mu bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwankyerɛ wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi ho, te sɛ ahotoso, tema, adwene a enni atɛn, ne nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nimdeɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ mmebun rehwehwɛ akwankyerɛ wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi ho a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ afotufo a wɔwɔ su ahorow te sɛ: Ahotoso: Ɛsɛ sɛ afotufo yɛ nea wotumi de ho to wɔn so na wodi nokware, wɔkora kokoamsɛm so na wobu mmebun kokoam nsɛm. Tema: Ɛsɛ sɛ afotufo da tema ne ntease adi, na wɔma mmebun atenka ne osuahu ahorow yɛ nokware a wonni atɛn. Su a ɛnsɛ sɛ wobu atɛn: Ɛsɛ sɛ afotufo yɛ tebea a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛka nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho asɛm. Nimdeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho: Ɛsɛ sɛ afotufo nya nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden  ho nsɛmti ho ntease a emu yɛ den, a nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa ma nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia asisifo wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi akasa ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia ayayade wɔ wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ denam: Ayayade a abu so ne nkɛntɛnso a wobɛma wɔahu denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔsatu, nsɛm a esisi, anaa nsɛm a wobɛka so. Akuw anaa boayikuw ahorow a sukuufo di anim a wɔko tia asisifo a wɔbɛhyehyɛ anaasɛ wɔbɛka ho de ahyɛ atipɛnfo abusuabɔ pa ho nkuran na wɔakamfo nsakrae. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam akannifoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde siw ayayadeɛ ano na wɔde adi dwuma. Nhyiam anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ ayamye, tema, ne obiara a wɔka ho ho nhyehyɛe, te sɛ ayamye ho nsɛnnennen, tema ho nhyiam, anaa afahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa nnipa ahorow ho. Wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, anaa ɔman no mu de boa mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ayayade ho na ɛhyɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ ne mmoa ma asuafo nyinaa ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu fa awo a wobetumi apaw ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a ɛyaw ano aduro, awo mmoa, ne awo a wɔde oprehyɛn yɛ ka ho?
answer_twi_source: Awosu mu Awo: Awo a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso a nnuruyɛfo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, mpɛn pii no awogyefo anaa doula boa. Ɛyaw ano aduru: Nneɛma a wubetumi apaw bi ne nnuro (te sɛ epidurals) anaa akwan a ɛnyɛ nnuru (te sɛ ahomegye apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, aduru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua no, ne aguare a ɛyɛ hyew). Adwumayɛfo Mmoa: Awogyefo, doula, anaa abusua muni bi a ɔboa no betumi de nkate ne honam fam mmoa ama bere a ɔrewo no. Cesarean Birth (C-Section): Oprehyɛn a wɔyɛ bere a wontumi mfa awo a wɔde fa ɔbea no awotwaa mu no ntumi nyɛ yiye anaasɛ asiane biara nni ho no. Wobetumi ayɛ eyi ho nhyehyɛe anaasɛ wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe bere a wɔrewo no. Mmabun betumi ne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo asusuw akwan horow yi ho na wɔayɛ awo nhyehyɛe a ɛkyerɛ nea wɔpɛ wɔ awo ne awo ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm nya adwene ne su ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmabun mu no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm bɛtumi anya adwene ne suban ahorow a ɛfa nna, abusuabɔ, ne awo akwahosan ho wɔ mmabun mu so nkɛntɛnso denam: Ahoɔfɛ, mmarimayɛ, ne ɔbeayɛ ho adwene a wɔbɛhyehyɛ so. Suban ahorow bi anaa abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata. Nsusuwii hunu ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den. Ebia mmabun de saa nkrasɛm ahorow yi bɛhyɛ wɔn mu, na ɛde adwene ne nneyɛe a ɛsakra aba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmabun a wɔyem betumi anya awo ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔn atubrafo tebea anaa sikasɛm tebea mfa ho saa?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, mmabun a wɔyem wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya awo ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔn atubrafo tebea anaa sikasɛm tebea mfa ho. Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow hwɛ hu sɛ ankorankora nyinaa nya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia, a ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo, awo, ne awo akyi hwɛ ka ho, a ɔman ba anaa tumi a wobetumi atua mfa ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde bi wɔ hɔ a wɔkamfo hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wom?
answer_twi_source: Aane, mmoa nkitahodi ne ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔkamfo hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ abusuabɔ a ahobammɔ ne apɔwmuden wɔ ho, te sɛ: Ofie basabasayɛ ho telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne dabere Mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si abusuabɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne tumidi so. Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ mmabun abusuabɔ ho nsɛm titiri. Mmara mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde mmoa ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ abusuabɔ mu basabasayɛ mu
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ne nnwuma a wobenya ho?
answer_twi_source: Ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho afotu ne nnwuma a wobenya ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ insurance a wotua, apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo ka, ne nnwuma pɔtee a wonya so. Akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow na ɛbɔ abusua nhyehyɛe ho adwuma pii ho ka, a nea ɛka ho ne afotu a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn ano, akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, ne nsrahwɛ a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano. Bio nso, ayaresabea ahorow ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow bi de sika a ɛkɔ fam anaasɛ nnwuma a wontua hwee a egyina sika a wonya anaasɛ fata a wɔfata ma aban mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow so ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn nnuro ho wɔ mmeae anaa aman ahorow mu ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia yi ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ho no gu ahorow wɔ ɔmantam anaa ɔman biara mu. Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ a ɛfata denam nkorɔfo a wɔbɛma wɔ ate ase, mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo mpɔtamfoɔ, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa ma wɔma awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun no tu mpɔn no akyi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ wɔn ankasa ne afoforo akyigyinafo denam nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee ne ntease a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so.
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi ayɛ ɔkamfofo a ɔwɔ tumi: Nkitahodi a Ebue: Wo ne wo nnamfo ne w’atipɛnfo nka nna ne awo akwahosan ho asɛm pefee. Ntease: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a obuo wom ho nkuran na hyɛ afoforo nkuran ma wontie adwene ahorow a ɛsono emu biara a wonni atɛn. Kae: Animtiaabu betumi ayɛ asɛnnennen kɛse, nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ wo nkutoo wuhyia. Ɛdenam ntease a wobɛma anya nkɔso, wo nne a wobɛkyɛ, ne afoforo a wobɛboa so no, wubetumi aboa ama tebea pa aba ama obiara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So metumi ako ama akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho adesua a edi mũ nka adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ me sukuu mu no ho? (Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so kamfo nkurɔfo ase) .
answer_twi_source: Wɔda so ara resusu ho anaasɛ wɔda so ara ridi ho nkɔmmɔ sɛ wɔde Bɔbeasu mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛmu dɔ (CSE) bɛhyɛ nwomasua nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ Ghana anaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ ahobammɔ abien a wɔde di dwuma so sen nyinsɛn a wobesiw ano kɛkɛ? (STI ho asiane a ɛso tew)
answer_twi_source: Bere a nyinsɛn a wobesiw ano ho hia no, ahobammɔ abien de mfaso titiri foforo ba: asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) no so tew. STI betumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba, a awo a wontumi nwo ka ho. Sɛ wode kɔndɔm ne akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw kwan di dwuma a, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya STI te sɛ chlamydia, gonorrhea, ne HIV no so kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: ɛdɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a abu so wɔ nyinsɛn ano si naduru ho?
answer_twi_source: Atorsɛm: Atorsɛm: Nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano ma wo mu duru yɛ kɛse. Senea emu te: Nsakrae a ɛfa wo mu duru mu no ntaa mma saa; aduan pa ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ho hia kɛse. Atorsɛm: Sɛ wowɔ aduru foforo a wɔde siw awo ano a, ɛho nhia sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma. Senea emu te: Kɔndɔm nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so bɔ obi ho ban fi STI ho. Atorsɛm: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano no yɛ nea wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano nkutoo. Senea emu te: Wɔboa nso wɔ brayɛ mu yaw, akisikuru, ne nsɛm a ɛfa hormone ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe, ne nnwuma a ɛhyɛ ɔhye so nkyerɛkyerɛ, pene amammerɛ, ne abusuabɔ a obu wom ho nkuran wɔ sukuu, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so mmeae ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a ɛhyɛ ɔhye so nkyerɛkyerɛ, pene amammerɛ, ne abusuabɔ a obuo wom ho nkuran wɔ sukuu, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so mmeae ahorow. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ asuafo agyinatukuw, mmabun akuw, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu de akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa ahye, pene, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Wobetumi nso ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so amammerɛ ne nkitahodi a obu wom denam sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow, nsɛm a wɔma nkurɔfo hu, anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow so. Ɛdenam akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako so no, mmabun betumi ayɛ adwuma de ayɛ mmeae a wɔde obu, ahobammɔ, ne ahofadi di kan ma ankorankoro nyinaa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa kasa a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu di dwuma, na kwati atemmu nsɛm bere a woresusuw nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no.
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ aduruyɛ mu adeyɛ, na gyinae a wosi sɛ wobɛwo bi no yɛ obi ankasa de. Nneɛma bi a ɛde kasa a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ aduruyɛ mu di dwuma, na ɛkwati atemmu nsɛmfua ni: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo bɛka nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nsɛm ho asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane ne ɔhaw bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ nna ho nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma, kɔmputa so ayayade, ne abɛɛfo ntentan so ayayade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so no ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abrɛ asiane ahorow yi ase?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho: Nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so no betumi ama nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom ayɛ nea ɛfata, ama mmabun ayɛ wɔn adwene wɔ nea ebetumi afi nna a ahobammɔ nnim mu aba no ho, na aboa ma wɔanya nna ne abusuabɔ ho akwanhwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware. Abɛɛfo ntentan so ayayade ne: Mmabun betumi anya kɔmputa so ayayade,  anaa abɛɛfo ntentan so aniwu a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo hho nsem a wɔpaw anaa wɔn nipasu ho, na ɛde adwene mu ahokyere, nnipa a wɔtew wɔn ho fi afoforo ho, ne obu a ɛnteɛ aba wɔn ho so. Kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ: SRH ho nsɛm a wɔde bɛkyɛ anaasɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu yɛ den a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ sohyial media so no betumi de asiane aba mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne ahobammɔ so, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛnea wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, abɔ wɔn sobo, anaasɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm a ɛho hia adi wɔ ɔkwan a wɔmpɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na atipɛnfo afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow de intanɛt ne ‘social media’ akwan di dwuma de ma nkitahodi ne biakoyɛ yɛ mmerɛw wɔ mmabun ntam?
answer_twi_source: Fa virtual platforms (video frɛ, nkrasɛm) di dwuma. Fa wo ho hyɛ ‘social media’ akuo mu ma nkitahodi kyɛ nyɛ mmerɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔafa amammerɛ ne nyamesom ho nsusuii ahorow mu wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhomasua mu?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔafa amammerɛ ne nyamesom ho nsusuii ahorow mu wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhomasua mu no bi ne: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ amammerɛ mu a wɔatete wɔn sɛ wɔmfa ɔhwɛ a obu wom na ɛka obiara ho mma ankorankoro a wofi mmeae ahorow. Nhomasua nneɛma ne intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔyɛɛ no titiriw maa nnipa a wɔn amammerɛ ne nyamesom gu ahorow, a ɛma nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ akwan horow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne akuo a wɔboa a wɔde nnwuma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ma ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɔ nkorɔfo ho ban a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Adwumayɛfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne adesua asoɛeɛ a wɔde nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneɛma ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwannya ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoam  ho bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma no?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun wɔ akwannya  ahorow wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoam ho bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwumayɛbea ahorow no. Mpɛn pii no, wɔde kokoamsɛm ho mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho akwankyerɛ kyekyere akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de bɔ ayarefo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ awerɛhyem sɛ wɔbɛkora wɔn ho nsɛm so na wɔadi wɔn kokoam nsɛm so wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu no nyinaa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nhomasua nhyehyɛe anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔte hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so afa ahofadi a wobenya afi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho ase?
answer_twi_source: Aane, nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya denam sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan ahorow, abusuabɔ pa, pene, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne sɛnea wobehu basabasayɛ na wɔayɛ ho biribi ho ma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun kari pɛ wɔ ɔpɛ a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔbɛda adebɔ mu nsɛm adi na wɔayɛ nokware ne hia a ehia sɛ wosusuw wɔn dijitaal nan ase, din a wɔwɔ wɔ Intanɛt so, ne nea ebetumi afi wɔn dijitaal nneɛma mu aba bere tenten no ho?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔada wɔn adwene adi nokwarem bere a wɔrekyerɛ wɔn kwan ma wɔasusuw nea ebetumi afi mu aba ne abrabɔ pa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛwɔ wɔn dijitaal anammɔntu mu no ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn wɔ intanɛt so din a wɔbɛhwɛ so, kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe, ne dijitaal ɔman bayɛ ho de ama wɔn tumi ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn intanɛt so a wɔbɛba no ho. Digital ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina ano ho hia a wɔde bɛfa ɔkasatia, nsɛm a wɔka, ne intanɛt so nhwehwɛmu mu a wosi so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na mmabun bɛko ama 'mentorship' sɛ wɔmfa afotu nhyehyɛe ne mmoa dwumadi ahorow nka sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na ama wɔadi mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ahorow ho dwuma yiye wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wodi ho dwuma mu?
answer_twi_source: Ma nkurɔfo nhu. Fa wo ho hyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde gyina nkurɔfo akyi mu. Fa mmuae ma. Yɛ fekubɔ ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma ahodoɔ, a mmusuakuo, dodoɔ a etumi yɛ adwuma bom anaa esia, ne sikasɛm gyinabea ka ho, ka mmabun a wɔwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer_twi_source: . Ɛma asiane/nsonsonoeɛ soronko ba. Nnipakuo a wɔayi wɔn afi nnipa nkyɛn no hyia nyiyimii ahodoɔ, ɔhaw ahorow, ne amammerɛ mu dwumadie a ɛfata a enni hɔ. Ɛhia sɛ wohu nneɛma pii a ɛka bom na wɔma pɛyɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ tu mpɔn.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ hokwan ma mmabun sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ara wɔn nipadua ho gyinaeɛ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu a wobedi akyi?
answer_twi_source: Hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔma wɔn nipadua mu ahofadi wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu: Ɛhyɛ obu a wɔde ma ankorankoro ahofadi ne wɔn dwumadi wɔ wɔn nipadua so no ho nkuran Ɛma ahotoso ne ahotoso ba akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu Hyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ne kyɛfa a wɔde bɛhyɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu denneennen ho nkuran Ɛma asiane a ɛwɔ nhyɛso, ayayade, ne hokwan ahorow a wobu so mu no so tew Ɛboa akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa denam tumi a wɔde ma so ankorankoro sɛ wɔbɛpaw nneɛma a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ne nea wɔpɛ hyia
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hyɛ  ahosohwɛ ho nkuran sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so di adwennwen ne atenka horow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho dwuma.
answer_twi_source: Ɛnyɛ ɔhaw ahorow ho a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn ho kɛkɛ —ɛfa adwennwen ne nkate horow a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a wobedi kan adi ho dwuma ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa nkabom ne adwumayɛkuw ahorow boa mmɔden a wɔbɔ de gyina nnipa hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Wiase nyinaa nkabom ne adwumayɛkuo ma mmoa ma mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban a wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nnipa hokwan, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛeɛ, nnwumadie, ne nneyɛeɛ mu. Ɛdenam nimdeɛ a wɔbom yɛ, nneɛma, ne nkitahodi ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma so no, saa nkabom ahorow yi betumi ama nkrasɛm a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfo no ayɛ kɛse na wɔanya nhyehyɛe ho gyinaesi ahorow so nsunsuanso wɔ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne amanaman ntam, na ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow anya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ama obu, ahotoso, ne biakoyɛ aba wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛfata amammerɛ mu de ma mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ama obu, ahotoso, ne biakoyɛ anya nkɔso wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛfata amammerɛ mu denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bedi dwuma, atie wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene denneennen, ne obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow so. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no betumi ahyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔabisa nsɛm, aka wɔn haw ahorow, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn hwɛ ho mu denneennen. Saa ara nso na mmabun betumi aka wɔn ankasa ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho asɛm, de wɔn apomoden ho osuahu ahorow ho nsɛm ama, na wɔne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ayɛ biako de ayɛ ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho a ɛda wɔn amammerɛ mu nipasu ne gyinapɛn ahorow adi. Ɛnam adwuma a wɔbom yɛ sɛ ahokafoɔ so no, mmabun ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie bɛdi obuo, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mpɛn pii no, sika ahe na wɔbɔ wɔ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ho? (ka akwan horow a wontua hwee anaa nea ne bo nyɛ den ho asɛm sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a)
answer_twi_source: Nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ho ka betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina beae ne nhwehwɛmu ko a wɔyɛ so. Nkyekyɛmu bi ni: Aban Ayaresabea ne Ayaresabea: Eyinom taa yɛ nhwehwɛmu a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua. Awoɔfoyɛ a Wɔayɛ Ho Nhyehyɛe: PPAG de sɔhwɛ a ne bo nyɛ den a wobetumi atew sika so ama mmerante ne mmabaa ma. Di wɔn ho nkɔmmɔ na woanya bo pɔtee ho nsɛm. Ankorankoro Ayaresabea: Mpɛn pii no, eyinom bo yɛ den sen nea aban no betumi apaw. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wubedi kan afrɛ ayaresabea hɔ abisa wɔn bo ho asɛm.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde sliding scale, awofoyɛ mmeae a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, anaa ahyehyɛde foforo a wɔde nyinsɛn ano aduru a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee ma.
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam no de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma wɔ ɔman no insurance so
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo wɔn ho ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ayaresa a obu ne animhwɛ nnim afi akwaahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun di kan kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho akwannya ahorow ho asɛm, na wɔkyerɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde obu ne animhwɛ nnim di dwuma denam wɔn ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛka akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo pefee no so. Wobetumi ahwehwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wonim wɔn sɛ wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfata mmabun ma na wɔakamfo hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wonni atemmu anaa nyiyim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ nea ɛka obiara ho kɛse na ayɛ nea ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, a wofi nkurow nketewa mu, anaa wɔte nkuraase no adesua ahiade ahorow ne nea wɔpɛ ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ama nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ nea ɛka obiara ho kɛse na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata ma mmabun adesua ahiade ahorow ne nea wɔpɛ denam nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛde ahorow ahorow, pɛyɛ, ne nnipa a wɔka bom di kan a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Eyi ka ho bi ne dabere ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ a wɔadi dɛm, wɔde adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛda suahunu ne adwene a ɛwɔ mpɔtam a nnipa kakraa bi mu adi, ne sika a wɔde bɛto mfiridwuma ne nnwuma mu de ama nwomasua a wɔbɛnya wɔ nkuraaseɛ ne mmeaeɛ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no atu mpɔn. Bio nso, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi asi nkyerɛkyerɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ne akwan a wɔfa so boa asuafoɔ ahodoɔ wɔ adesuadan mu so dua.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na obi atumi ahu sɛ ɔwɔ STI anaa HIV, na sɛ osusuw sɛ wanya bi a, anammɔn bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Obi betumi ahu sɛ ɔwɔ STI anaa HIV denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ so. Mpɛn pii no, STI nhwehwɛmu no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu, ne mogya, nsu, anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ aduruyɛdan mu de hu sɛ ɔyare mmoawa bi wɔ hɔ anaa. Mpɛn pii no, HIV nhwehwɛmu hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ mogya mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛma wohu nnuru a ɛko tia mmoawa no. Sɛ obi susuw sɛ wanya ɔyare no a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu ntɛm ara sɛnea obetumi. Sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wɔwɔ STI anaa HIV a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo di akyi de nya afotu, ayaresa, ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow di nkitaho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi nsɛm a emu yɛ den a ɛwɔ wɔn nipasu ho nkitahodi mu wɔ ɔsom ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm mu no so?
answer_twi_source: ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow ne amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow di nkitaho wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ den so, na ɛkyerɛ ankorankoro nipasu, wiase adwene, ne asetra mu nneyɛe. Mmabun betumi adi saa nsɛm a ɛyɛ den yi mu denam nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne amammerɛ mu nneyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu denneennen so, a wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛte abakɔsɛm ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm a ɛwɔ nyamesom nkyerɛwee ne atetesɛm nkyerɛase so nkɛntɛnso no ase. Wobetumi ahwehwɛ sɛnea wɔn nyamesom ne amammerɛ mu nipasu ahorow no twam na ɛdannan bere a bere kɔ so no mu, na wɔahu adwene ahorow a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ. Mmabun nso betumi anya mmoa wɔ mpɔtam a wogye dodow kabea ne obu a wɔde ma gyidi ne nipasu ahorow tom, na ɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease ba nyamesom ne amammerɛ ahye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotu adwuma betumi aboa me ma makɔ ayɔnkofa, nkitahodi, ne gyinaesi a ɛfa nna ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Afotuo dwumadie bɛtumi aboa wo ma woafa abusuabɔ, nkitahodiɛ, ne gyinaesie a ɛfa nna ho dwumadie ho te sɛ: Beaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma woatumi ahwehwɛ nkateɛ, dadwen, ne akɔnnɔ a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ de ada ahye, akɔnnɔ, ne nea ɛhaw adwene adi wɔ ahokafo nkyɛn. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ gyinaesi a wɔde nimdeɛ asi wɔ nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne pene a wɔpene so ho. Abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a ɛyɛ papa, ahye, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Nsɛnnennen te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ nna mu nneyɛe/dwumadi ahorow so a wobedi ho dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, na dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ kwan wɔ bere a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ansa na wɔawo ne awo no?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea Mmaayewa bɛnya Nyinsɛn mu Ayaresabea HwɛMmaayewa (adolescents) bɛtumi anya nyinsɛn mu ayaresabea hwɛ (maternal health services) afiri ayaresabea ahorow ne aduyɛbea a wɔhwɛ mmaa a wɔnyinsɛnee so. Wɔbɛtumi nso ahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afiri sukuu mu ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ (school nurses), mpɔtam ayaresabea ahorow (community health centers), anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔhwɛ ɔmanfoɔ apɔwmuden so.Nea Ɛsiekɔ wɔ Ayaresabea Kɔ muMmerɛ a wɔkɔ ayaresabea mmerɛ a wɔnyinsɛn mu no, mmaayewa bɛtumi ahwɛ kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn nipadua mu, wɔbɛyɛ mogya mu nhwehwɛmu, "ultrasound" (mfoni a wɔde yi abofra no wɔ yafunu mu), na wɔadi nkɔmɔ fa wɔn apɔwmuden ne abofra no nso apɔwmuden ho. Saa ayaresabea kɔ yi yɛ kwan pa a wɔbɛtumi afa so abisa nsɛm, asua nneɛma fa nyinsɛn ho, na wɔaka biribiara a ɛhaw wɔn kyerɛ.Awoɔ Mmerɛ muWɔ awoɔ mmerɛ mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ mmaayewa hwɛ kwan sɛ wɔbɛnya mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ afiri ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ te sɛ awoɔgyefoɔ (midwives) anaa adɔkotafoɔ hɔ. Saa nnipa yi bɛkyerɛ wɔn kwan wɔ awoɔ no mu nyinaa na wɔahwɛ sɛ wɔn ho bɛtɔ wɔn na wɔanya ahobammɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo betumi de mmabun ahyɛ wɔn nhyehyɛe mu sɛ ahokafo wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ. Nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan nsɛmti ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ woagye wɔn gyinapɛn ato mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun a wɔbɛto nsa afrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nhwehwɛmu no fã nyinaa mu, efi nhwehwɛmu nsɛmmisa a wɔbɛhyehyɛ so kosi nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu ne nea wɔahu a wɔbɛkyerɛ ase so. Nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so nkɔmmɔbɔ, nsɛmbisa, anaa adeyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, a ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔkyɛ wɔn suahu ne wɔn nhumu a wɔde bedi dwuma. Abusuabɔ a ahotoso wom a wɔbɛma anya, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, na wɔanya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi. Ntetee ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma mmabun ma wɔanya nhwehwɛmu ho nimdeɛ, adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye, ne ahotoso a, wɔwɔ wɔ tumi a wɔde bɛboa nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu. Hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no mu wɔ akwan ne nhyiamu a ɛyɛ mmerɛ a ɛkɔ mmabun ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nkyɛn na ɛka wɔn ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abɛɛfo mfidie a yɛfrɛ no 'technology' bɛn na ɛboa SRH ho adesua ne nkyerɛkyerɛ?
answer_twi_source: Bi te sɛ; mHealth (apps/websites). Gamification (agorɔ). VR/AR (nneɛma a yɛhu wɔ intanɛt so te sɛ nea ɛwɔ hɔ 'live').
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛtumi si mmabun kwan ma wɔntumi nnya mmoa a ɛho hia wɔ berɛ a wɔresiesie wɔn ho (aftercare) no mu, na akwan bi nso wɔ hɔ a yɛbɛtumi afa so asiesie
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahyia nsɛnnennen te sɛ animtiaabu, anaa sika a wonnya, ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so akura nea ɛkanyan wɔn mu, anaasɛ wɔbɛsan akɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu. Wobetumi adi saa nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma denam mmoa a wɔbɛkɔ so de ama, nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde bɛma wɔ berɛ a wɔbɛpaw wɔn, mmabun a wɔde bɛka mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ho, ne akwan horow a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi animtiaabu ho dwuma na wɔama wɔatumi agyina ano no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nkitahodie pa ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔbɛbu me na wɔagye me dɛm (disabilities) atom?
answer_twi_source: Wubetumi afa 'social media' so ne afoforo adi nkitaho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne apɔwmuden ho nimdeɛ mu nneɛma atitiri a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer_twi_source: Nipadua ne nipadua mu nneɛma a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwaa ho ntease. Nimdeɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so si nyinsɛn ano, STI, nyinsɛn, ne awoɔ ho. Nna mu hokwan ahorow, mpeneso, ne nkitahodie pa ho nimdeɛ. Ahokokwaw a wɔde nya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔsɔ hwɛ mu. Tumi a wotumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne n’atipɛnfo di nkitaho yie wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na pene a wɔpene so kyerɛ wɔ abusuabɔ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ nkitahodie nyinaa yɛ nea wɔpene so na egyina wɔn baanu nyinaa adwene so?
answer_twi_source: Mpene a wɔpene so wɔ abusuabɔ ho nsɛm mu no kyerɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu nyinaa fi wɔn pɛ mu pene so sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi anaa nneyɛe biara mu a wɔrenhyɛ wɔn, wɔredaadaa wɔn, anaasɛ wɔrenkɛntɛn wɔn so. Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ nkitahodi nyinaa yɛ nea wɔpene so na egyina wɔn baanu nyinaa adwene so denam: - Mpene a Wɔhwehwɛ a Wɔpene So: Wɔsrɛ na wonya pene a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ anigye ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa nna mu dwumadi biara mu. - a wobebu ahye: Wode adwene besi won ho won ho won ho ahye ne anohyeto so, na wonsusuw da se wobepene so a egyina nneyɛe a atwam anaa abusuabɔ tebea so. - a wodi nkitaho pefee: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa akɔnnɔ, ahye, ne awerɛkyekye dodow ho a wɔne wɔn hokafo bɛbɔ. - Ehwɛ mu nea broni bɛka sɛ 'Checking In': Wɔkɔ so ne wɔn hokafoɔ kɔ mu wɔ mmerɛ a ɛbɛn wɔn ho mu de hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛpene so na wɔakyekye wɔn werɛ. - Ebu Penneeɛ watwe asae a broni bɛka sɛ  'Respecting Withdrawn Consent': Wode obuo na wodi pene biara a woatwe afiri mu anaase ahokyere a won hokafo ada no adi, na wogyae dwumadie biara ntɛm ara.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nsɛmti anaa afa ahorow pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwaahosan ho a ɛfa mmabun a wɔn mfe akɔ anim ho kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, nsɛmti te sɛ mmabunbere mu nsakrae, pene a wɔpene so ne ahye a wobɛte ase, abusuabɔ pa a wubenya, nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho ntease ahorow a wobɛte ase, ne w’ankasa gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna ho a wobɛhwehwɛ mu no fata titiriw wɔ wo mfe mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa bi a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nanso mete nka sɛ me ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ me no bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa bi fa nna mu apomoden ho nanso wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wo ne w’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo no bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ sukuu fotufo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn. Wubetumi nso ne kokoam telefon anaa mmoa telefon a adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn a wobetumi de nsɛm, mmoa, ne akwankyerɛ ama a wonni atɛn na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ no adi nkitaho. Bio nso, nsɛm a wobɛhwehwɛ afi Intanɛt so nneɛma a agye din ne nhomasua nneɛma mu no betumi aboa ma woabua wo nsɛmmisa na woadi wo haw ahorow ho dwuma wɔ kokoam kwan so. Kae sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wode w’apomoden ne wo yiyedi di kan, na mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ no yɛ anammɔn a wobɛyɛ ansa na woanya nsɛm a wuhia.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, nneɛma a wɔyɛ, ne nnwuma mufoɔ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ abrabɔ pa ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no mu?
answer_twi_source: Amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, wɔn a wɔyɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu, ne nnwuma mufoɔ wɔ asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ abrabɔ pa ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho gyinabea a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ho nkuran denam: Wɔn adebɔ akuo ne gyinaesie akwan ahodoɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ ahodoɔ de ahwɛ sɛ wɔde adwene ne suahunu ahodoɔ bi gyina hɔ ma. Mpɔtam hɔfo, akuo a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ, ne abenfo a wo ne wɔn besusuw ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ mfonini ahorow a edi mu na obu wom. Kwati a wɔbɛkwati nsusuwii hunu a epira, tropes, ne atinka a ɛma animtiaabu ne nyiyimu kɔ so. Nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma kɛse ho nkuran. Wɔn ankasa ne afoforo a wobebu akontaa wɔ abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ahorow a wodi akyi na wɔhyɛ asetena mu nsakrae pa ho nkuran denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyim ho betumi ama mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm no tumi ma wɔakamfo wɔn ho ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo?
answer_twi_source: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyim ho no betumi ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anya tumi wɔ akwan horow pii so: Obu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho a Ɛkɔ Anim: Sɛ wɔte wɔn hokwan ahorow ase a, ebetumi ama wɔanya ahotoso ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho nimdeɛ. Nyiyim a Wobehu: Wobetumi ahu nyiyim nneyɛe na wɔakasa atia. Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Nhomasua ma wɔn tumi ma wɔkamfo wɔn ho ne wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho no mu?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn denam: Nsɛm a wobebisa ne nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Nea wɔpɛ, nea ɛhaw wɔn, ne ahyeɛ a wɔbɛda no adi pefee. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔboa wɔn a wɔde ɔhwɛ a egyina ayarefo so di kan a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Ɔpanyin anaa ɔkamfofo a wogye no di a wobɛto nsa afrɛ no aba berɛ a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mmoa mma sɛ ɛho hia a. Wɔn hokwan ne nea wɔpɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a wɔkamfo kyerɛ denneennen. Geeting a ɔde ne ho hyɛ gyinaesi mu wɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhyehyɛ a ɛboa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne atetesɛm mu ayaresa di wɔ abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ne adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ ASRH ho a wɔhyehyɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu no adi dwuma de ahyɛ apɔmuden mu nkɔso pa ho nkuran?
answer_twi_source: Mpɔtam akannifoɔ, nyamesom ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne atetesɛm mu ayaresa di dwuma titire wɔ abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ne suban a wɔda no adi wɔ ASRH ho: Amammerɛ mu apon ano ahwɛfoɔ: Wɔnam nkyerɛkyerɛ, amanne, ne asetena mu gyinapɛn so nya mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn, suban, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ ho so nkɛntɛnsoɔ. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma abom: Mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔne wɔn bedi nkitaho de ahyɛ ASRH ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran, akasa atia nneyɛe a epira, na wɔama mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwahosan mu nkɔso pa ho. Nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔbɛbu wɔn: Adwene ahodoɔ a wɔbɛhunu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ na wɔde nne a ɛwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ adi dwuma de ahyɛ akwan a ɛka obiara ho, a egyina hokwan so wɔ ASRH ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sikakorabea ahorow te sɛ sikakorabea ne boseabɔ akuw ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔyɛ adwuma?
answer_twi_source: Sikakorabea ahorow bi ne sikakorabea ahorow, boseabɔ akuw, ne sikakorabea ahorow a ɛwɔ Intanɛt so. Sikakorabea ahorow yɛ nnwumakuo ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ mfaso a wɔdi nnwuma ahorow te sɛ sikakorabea, boseabɔ, ne sika a wɔde hyɛ mu ma. Boa akuw yɛ adwumayɛkuw ahorow a wodi dwumakro nanso ebia wobetumi agye nsiho kumaa bi a ɛboa wɔn a wɔ ne wɔn di dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ho nkyerɛkyerɛ aka nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛtrɛw a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa a mmabun nya ho?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa awo apomoden ho nsɛm aka nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛtrɛw a ɛfa nna mu apomoden, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ma mmabun ho denam: Si a wobesi hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔte awo nipadua, brayɛ akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne STI ano a wosiw ano wɔ nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no so dua. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene, ahye, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ho a wɔde bɛka awo apomoden ho adesua ho de ahyɛ abusuabɔ pa ne gyinaesi ho nkuran. Nkitahodi a ɛda awo akwahosan, nkate mu yiyedi, ne asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nna, ne tumi a ɛkɔ so ntam no mu nhwehwɛmu. Hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma ma nkitahodi adesua, dwumadi, ne asetra mu nsɛm ankasa de adi ahokokwaw a ɛfa awo akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so ho nkitahodi, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho dwuma. Asetra ne amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow a ɛwɔ awo apomoden ho nneyɛe ne suban ahorow so a wobedi ho dwuma, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam gyinapɛn ahorow, atipɛnfo nhyɛso, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow, ne amammerɛ mu akwanhwɛ ahorow ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Abrabɔ pa ho nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun susuw ho bere a wɔreka wɔn ankasa nsɛm, osuahu ahorow, anaa nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so no?
answer_twi_source: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun susuw hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔpene so, kokoam nsɛm, ne obu ma afoforo bere a wɔreka wɔn ankasa nsɛm, osuahu ahorow, anaa nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho wɔ Intanɛt so no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔwɔ kwan sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ afoforo nsɛm, wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm a ɛbɛma wɔahu a ebetumi asɛe kokoam nsɛm adi, na wɔde wɔn adwene si nkɛntɛnso a ebia wɔn kyɛfa no betumi anya wɔ wɔn ankasa ne afoforo so no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bɛn na ɛtaa ba awo apɔmden nsɛmsɛm nyinaa ho, na bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ ayaresa wɔ saa dadwen ahorow yi ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛtaa ba no bi ne: Nsu a ɛba ɔbea no awotwaa mu a ɛnyɛ ne kwan so, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nkekayɛ, ne ɛyaw a ɛba bere a ɔrebu nsu anaasɛ ɔne obi ada no betumi akyerɛ sɛ ɔwɔ STI. Nsakrae a ɛba brayɛ nhyehyɛe mu, te sɛ nna a ɛnkɔ so daa, mogya a ɛtɔ kɛse, ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, anaa brayɛ a enni hɔ no betumi akyerɛ sɛ obi anya brayɛ mu yare. Nyinsɛn ho sɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ nna a ɛnkɔ, nausea, nufu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ne ɔbrɛ betumi akyerɛ sɛ wanyinsɛn a wɔanhu. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ ayaresa wɔ saa dadwen ahorow yi ho sɛ wonya sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkɔ so daa anaasɛ emu yɛ den, wonnim wɔn awo akwahosan tebea, anaasɛ wɔada a wɔammɔ wɔn ho ban anaasɛ wonim sɛ wɔanya STI ahorow a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne ɔhaw ne akwanside ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apomoden mu yiye no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛnnennen ne akwanside ahorow bi a ebetumi ama mpɔtam hɔfo de wɔn ho ahyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu yiye no bi ne: Nneɛma kakraa bi, sika, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛyɛ CBO ne nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so, titiriw wɔ mmeae a nneɛma pii nni hɔ anaasɛ mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa pii. Asetena, amammerɛ, ne nyamesom mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛbɔ nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw, ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho animtiaa anaasɛ ɛto ano hye, na ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ wobefi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase na wɔadi nsɛmti a wɔabara ho dwuma. Nhumu, nimdeɛ, anaa ahotoso a wonni wɔ mpɔtam hɔfo mu wɔ nnwuma, nneɛma, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awo apomoden ho. Tumi mu nkɔsoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ a ɛbɛtumi de akuo binom ato nkyɛn anaasɛ ɛbɛto wɔn kyɛfa a wɔbɛnya wɔ gyinaesie nhyehyɛeɛ mu no ano hye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Bere bɛn na wɔde si nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ di dwuma wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛnea etu mpɔn a egyina sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ntɛm so?
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm no tu mpɔn kɛse bere a wɔfa no ntɛm ara wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye no, wɔ nnɔnhwere 72 mu, ɛwom sɛ akwan horow bi betumi ayɛ nea etu mpɔn kosi nnanu de. Ne mmɔdenbɔ so tew bere a bere kɔ so no, enti dodow a wɔnom no ntɛm no, dodow no ara na hokwan a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobesiw nyinsɛn ano no yɛ papa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na wɔsa STI ahorow? (nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer_twi_source: Ɛsono sɛnea wɔsa STIs a egyina ɔyare mmoawa pɔtee no so: Bacterial STIs (Chlamydia, Gonorrhea): Wɔde nnuro a ekum ɔyare mmoawa sa eyinom yare. Viral STIs (HPV, Herpes): Aduru biara nni hɔ a wɔde sa ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde yare mmoawa ba, nanso nnuru betumi adi sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no ho dwuma na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ɔyare no so. Parasitic STIs (Trichomoniasis): Wɔde nnuru sa eyinom yare.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne adwenemyare, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ atinka mu osuahu ahorow a ɛfata ho?
answer_twi_source: Adwene mu yare yɛ tebea horow a ɛka nsusuwii, atinka, ne nneyɛe, na ɛde ahoyeraw ne da biara da dwumadi a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ba. Wɔyɛ soronko wɔ atinka mu osuahu ahorow a ɛyɛ daa ho wɔ sɛnea emu yɛ den, bere tenten a egye, ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ da biara da asetra so no mu. Bere a ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ obi benya awerɛhow, adwennwen, anaa dadwen bere ne bere mu no, adwenemyare no fa sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkɔ so daa na emu yɛ den a ɛmma ontumi nyɛ adwuma yiye ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nyamesom akannifo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer_twi_source: Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛnyɛ atemmu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mu. Ma kwan ma wonya nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi. Hyɛ nsɛmmisa ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho nkuran. Kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ mma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Boa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma na wɔmfa akwahosan nhyehyɛe no mu. Yɛ suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfata a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwɛso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne gyidie ahorow bi a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom fekuw mu, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuw kura gyidi ahorow pii a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho. Nhwɛsoɔ bi a wɔtaa yɛ nie: Afɔbuo: Nyamesom binom nnye mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ntom na Nyamesom Afoforo gye LGBTQ+ nipasu tom kɛseɛ. Kommyɛ: Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi renka LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho asɛm pefee. Saa Gyidie Yi a Wodi Ho Dwuma: Nkɔmmɔdie a amu da hɔ: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a obuo wom a ɛfa LGBTQ+ hokwan ahodoɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuo mu. Nhomasua: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ ahunahuna so. Fa W’adwene Si Gyinapɛn Ahorow a Wɔbom Yɛ So: Si gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbom yɛ te sɛ ɔdɔ, obuo, ne ayamhyehye so dua. Ayɔnkofoɔ a Wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Kyerɛ nyamesom akannifoɔ anaa amammerɛ mu nnipa a wɔabue wɔn ani ama nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa LGBTQ+ a wɔde wɔn bɛka ho ho. Nkɔso yɛ nkakrankakra, na atenka yɛ ade titiriw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan pa a yebetumi afa so agyina adwennwen anaa dadwen a atipɛnfo nhyɛso de ba no ano?
answer_twi_source: Akwan bi ne: Sɛ gye w'ahome yie, ebetumi aboa ma wo ntini adwo na woatew adwennwen so. Anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu: Nneɛma a w’ani gye ho a wobɛyɛ no betumi atwetwe w’adwene afi nsusuii bɔne so na ama w’adwene akɔ so. panin a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wo ne no bɛkasa: Sɛ woka w'atenka kyerɛ ɔpanin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa ɔfotufo a, ebetumi ama woanya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ. Adwene mu nsusui anaa nsusuii a wode bedi dwuma: Adwene mu akwan horow betumi aboa wo ma woakɔ so atena hɔ na wode w’adwene asi biribi so, na ɛbɛtew dadwen nkate so. Botae ahorow a wobetumi de asi w’ani so: Botae ahorow a wobetumi adu ho a wode besisi w’ani so no betumi ama woate nka sɛ wotumi di so na woatumi ayɛ biribi.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so ahu nsakrae anaa nsɛm foforo a aba wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu akwankyerɛ ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer_twi_source: Sɛnea wobɛkɔ so anya amanneɛbɔ foforɔ fa nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne akwankyerɛ foforɔ ho:Di Mmeaeɛ a Wɔdie Wɔn Ho To Won So Akyi: Ma w’ani nna hɔ na hwehwɛ nsɛm foforɔ firi mmeaeɛ a atentenenee wom te sɛ aban apɔwmuden adum (government health agencies), ayaresabea akɛseɛ a wɔagye din, ne nhoma a adɔkotafoɔ akyerɛw.Kyerɛw Wo Din na Nya Amanneɛbɔ: Kyerɛw wo din na ama woanya nsɛm foforɔ afiri akuo a wɔapaw wɔn ho ama nna mu apɔwmuden anaa mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm.Bisa Ayaresabea Hwɛfoɔ: Mmerɛ biara a wobɛkɔ ayaresabea nhwehwɛmu no, bisa ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ no sɛ nsakyeraeɛ anaa akwankyerɛ foforɔ bi aba nna mu nyarewa nhwehwɛmu ho anaa.Fa Amanneɛbɔ Mmeaeɛ (Hotlines) Di Dwuma: Telefon namba ahorow te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), ne PPAG Yenkasa Digital Center (0800202010, anaa WhatsApp 0245118228) ma akwankyerɛ a emu dɔ fa nna mu nyarewa nhwehwɛmu ho.Fa Abɛfo Ntentan So Nyansa Di Dwuma: Hwehwɛ aban apɔwmuden adum anaa ayaresabea akɛseɛ ntentan so kratafa (websites) a wɔtumi tintim akwankyerɛ foforɔ mmerɛ biara.Kɔ Nteteeɛ ne Nhyiamu Ahorow: Kɔ nteteeɛ (workshops) anaa nhyiamu (seminars) a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho, baabi a animdefoɔ bɛtumi adi nkɔmɔ fa nna mu nyarewa nhwehwɛmu ne akwankyerɛ foforɔ a aba ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na 'gender inequality' (pɛyɛ a enni mmarima ne mmaa ntam) ne nyiyimu foforo bɔ mu kanyan SRH?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ woyɛ ɔbaa na woyɛ ohiani, anaa wofiri abusua bi mu a, wuhyia nsɛnnennen mmɔho mmienu. Wei siw wo kwan sɛ wonya ayaresa, nwomasua, ne mmoa. Ɛma SRH apɔwmuden kɔ fam ma wɔn a wɔwɔ tebea saa mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ mmoa anaa nhyehye a sukuu node wɔn ho gye mu no mu ɔhaw ahorow de ma mmabun a wɔrehyia nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayade no?
answer_twi_source: Mmoa anaa nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho nhwɛso betumi ayɛ: Kokoam afotu ne atinka fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma. Ayaresa ne asɛnnibea nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Boa a wɔbɛboa ma wɔabɔ nsɛm a esisi ho amanneɛ akyerɛ atumfoɔ. Ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛe ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde ma. Nhomasua nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne ankorankoro ahobammɔ ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wobɛyɛ dɛn adi ntawntawdi anaa adwene a enhyia ho dwuma wɔ nkitahodie a ɛfata mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔ nkitahodie a ɛyɛ papa mu no, wobu ntawntawdi sɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔso na wɔate ase. Fi ase denam nsiyɛ a wode betie mo ho mo ho adwene a wontwa na no anaasɛ mmu atɛn so. Fa "Me" nsɛm da wo nkate ne wo ahiade adi, na bom nyɛ adwuma hwehwɛ ano aduru a edi wo haw abien no nyinaa ho dwuma. Kae sɛ wobɛkɔ so akyerɛ obu, kwati soboɔ bɔ, na yɛ woadwene sɛ mobɛtumi ayɛ adwenekro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ankorankoro a wɔma mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, wɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abu wɔn ho ne afoforo akontaabu wɔ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, kokoamsɛm, ne obu a wɔwɔ ma nnipa ahorow ne ahofadi ho a wodi akyi no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nnipa a wɔhyehyɛ mbea a banbɔ wom, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, wɔ abrabɔ pa ho dwumadie ne asodie sɛ wɔbɛma kwan mma (consent), asɛm-sie, ne obu ama nnipa ahodoɔ ne obiara ne ne ho so tumi ayɛ adwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ beaeɛ a nkɔmhyɛfoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔwɔ banbɔ, mmoa, ne ahoɔden na wɔatumi akyɛ wɔn osuahu na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛhia a.Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔne afoforɔ bɛyɛ nea ɛtene denam kwan mma amammuo a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, nneyɛeɛ anaa adwene bɔne a wɔbɛtia, ne obu ne nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛgyina ama no wɔ saa mbea yi.
