Bio koraa no, wɔbɛtumi akasa sɛ wɔhunu sɛ obi abu kwan mma so, wɔapa asɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsie mu, anaasɛ nyiyim bi rekɔ so; na wɔne mpanyimfoɔ ne wɔn mfɛfoɔ abom ayɛ adwuma de asiesie saa nsɛm yi na wɔahwɛ sɛ obiara kwan ne n'animuonyam wɔ hɔ dabiara
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi anya awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe denam nneɛma ahorow so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow. Planned Parenthood ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho ahyehyɛde afoforo a wɔde kokoam nnwuma ma mmabun. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛma nsɛm, mmoa, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ awoɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ebia wɔde nneɛma ne mmoa bɛma wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wobenya mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri di nsɛm te sɛ pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ ho dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Ɛdi nsɛm yi ho dwuma denam: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a ɛde ma ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛhyɛ ho nkuran no so. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nimdeɛ ma nkitahodi, ne obu. Nnipa a ɛsono wɔn su ahorow ho abodwokyɛre a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran. Susuw ho kɔ stereotypes ne tema ne ntease a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwahosan ho nimdeɛ, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ tumi a obi tumi nya akwahosan ho nsɛm, te ase, na ɔde di dwuma de si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ n’akwahosan ho. Wɔ mmabun fam no, nna ne awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ho hia efisɛ ɛma wɔn tumi ma wotumi di nsɛm a emu yɛ den te sɛ abusuabɔ, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nna mu nsɛm, ne pene a wɔpene so ho dwuma. Ɛma wotumi te wɔn nipadua ase, paw nneɛma a ɛfata, na wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama nhyehyeɛ ne mmra a etu nna mu apɔmmuden, kwan ma, ne awo ahokwasan kwan ma mmabun ne mpɔtam aa wɔn mmu?
answer_twi_source: Ka kasa mafo kuo. nea aborofo ka no 'Campaigns'. nea aborofo ka no 'social media'. Kyerɛkyerɛ nnamfo. Nkabom. Ko ma CSE.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne insurance nnwumakuw adi nkitaho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ nea broni ka no 'insurance' nhyehyɛe ahorow no di wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow ho dwuma yiye?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu denam: Nsɛm a wobebisa: Nsɛm a wobebisa fa sika a wɔde tua nnwuma pɔtee bi ho ne ɛka biara a wofi wɔn kotoku mu a wɔbɛte ase. Wɔn ankasa ho a wɔbɛkasa ama: Wɔn akwahosan ho ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee akyerɛ wɔn a wɔde ma ne nea broni ka no 'insurance' nnwumakuw. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ: Nneɛma te sɛ ayarefo a wɔkasa ma wɔn anaa akwahosan ho akwankyerɛfo a wɔde bedi dwuma de ahwehwɛ nea broni ka no 'insurance' ho na wɔasiesie nsɛm biara a ɛfa insurance ho. Nsɛm a wobɛkɔ so ahu: Nsakrae a aba wɔ nea broni ka no 'insurance' nhyehyɛe ne akwahosan ho mmara mu a ebetumi aka sika a wɔbɔ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho no ho nsɛm a wobɛkɔ so ahu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn nti na mereyɛ tenten anaa nwi refuw wɔ mmeae foforo?
answer_twi_source: Onyin a ɛyɛ hu ne nwi foforo a enyin no fi nkwaadom (hormone) ahorow a ɛba bere a obi reba mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Saa nnuru yi ka kyerɛ wo nipadua sɛ "nnyin"! Nnompe atenten, nhwi foforo wɔ w’abasa ne wo akyi berɛmo mu – ne nyinaa yɛ ɔpanyin a wobɛyɛ no fã.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma ne nnwinnade bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a, ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔn sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim, te sɛ nhomasua wɛbsaet ahorow, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɛbsaet te sɛ "Investopedia", ama nsɛm, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne nnwinnade a wɔde di nkitaho a ɛfa sikasɛm ho nsɛmti ahorow ho. Adwumayɛbea ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a mpɔtam hɔ sikakorabea ahorow, boseabɔ akuw, ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so, anaa sukuu ahorow de ma no betumi ama wɔanya nsaano adesua mu osuahu ahorow, animdefo akwankyerɛ, ne nkitahodi hokwan ahorow de ama sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ akɔ anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu nkɛntɛnso a digital media a ɛhyɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware, nsusuii hunu a epira, anaa abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a ɛnyɛ papa ho nkuran ho nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ahu na wɔako atia nkɛntɛnso a digital media a ɛhyɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware, nsusuii hunu a epira, anaa abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa ho nkuran denam media wɔbɛyɛ ho ahwɛyie, mfonini ahorow a ɛte sɛ nea ɛnyɛ nokware anaasɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛfata a, wobegye ho kyim, hwehwɛ gyinabea ahorow, ne nsɛm a ɛkamfo nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa awofo pene/bɔ amanneɛ a wɔde ma mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ho no nya tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa awofo pene/bɔ amanneɛ a wɔde ma mmofra nkumaa a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ho no betumi anya tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wobenya ɔhwɛ no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Ɛdenam mpɔtam hɔ mmara so no, saa mmara ahorow yi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ mmabun nya awofo pene anaasɛ wɔbɔ wɔn awofo amanneɛ ansa na wɔanya nnwuma bi, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu yareɛ  nhwehwɛmu, anaa nyinsɛn a woyi gu. Saa ahwehwɛde ahorow yi betumi de akwanside ahorow aba mmabun a wosuro sɛ awofo bebu wɔn atɛn, wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka, anaasɛ wonni abusua mu abusuabɔ a ɛboa wɔn no. Bio nso, mmara a ɛtete saa no betumi asɛe hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm, ne ahofadi wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn ankasa nipadua ne akwahosan ho no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: kwan bɛn so na nimdie a obia nntumi nnya betumi aha mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm a wonnya pii betumi ama woasi gyinae a wonni nimdeɛ, asiane kɛse a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, STI, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ nnim. Ebia ɛbɛma wɔate aniwu, animtiaabu, ne adwene a ɛyɛ basaa wɔ nna ho, na asi mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa anaasɛ wɔanya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho hia. Bio nso, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a efi mmeae a wontumi mfa wɔn ho nto so no betumi ama anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ akɔ so, na ama asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan so no ayɛ kɛse bio.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nneɛma pa anaa mfaso horow bi a efi nkitahodi a emu gyinaeɛ yɛ pintinn mu ba wɔ abusuabɔ mu, te sɛ obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho a ɛkɔ anim, obu a obi wɔ ma ne yɔnko, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma pa a efi nkitahodi a ɛyɛ katee mu ba wɔ abusuabɔ mu bi ne, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne ahotoso a ɛkɔ anim, obu ne ntease a ɛwɔ ankorankoro ntam, ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim, ne sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye sɛ wobenya nneɛma a ɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho abotɔyam a ɛkɔ soro. Nkitahodi a emu gyinaeɛ yɛ pintinn hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware ho nkuran, ɛma ahotoso ne tema nya nkɔso, na ɛhyɛ nnipa ntam abusuabɔ mu den, na ɛde abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom na ɛma abotɔyam ba.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi de mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nne ne osuahu ahorow asi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu?
answer_twi_source: Akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so ne nhwehwɛmu: Yɛ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ho de ate wɔn ahiade pɔtee ne wɔn haw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ase. Mmabun Afotu Bagua: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmabun afotu bagua ahorow wɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow mu na wɔde mmabun nne aka gyinaesi ho. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua Nhyehyɛe: Tete mmabun a sebi wɔadi dɛm ma wɔbɛyɛ atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho ɛma wɔn atipɛnfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nneɛma titiriw bɛn na ɛwɔ awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu na nsɛm pɔtee bɛn na wɔtaa di ho nkɔmɔ?
answer_twi_source: Puberty (mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu). Menstrual Health (Bosome-buo). Contraception (Awoɔ ho nhyehyɛyɛ). STI Prevention (nna mu yareɛ ho bammɔ). Reproductive Rights (Hokwan a yɛwɔ wɔ awoɔ ho).
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So anohyeto awɔ apomoden ho insurance a wɔde tua nna ne awoɛ ho apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bi te sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu anaa ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so dua no ho?
answer_twi_source: Yiw, anohyeto anaa anohyeto ahorow betumi aba: Apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow bi betumi anya anohyeto anaasɛ wɔayi afi mu wɔ nnwuma bi te sɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu anaa ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna yɛ ho. Ebia ɛsono sika a wɔde tua saa nnwuma yi ho ka a egyina ɔman no mmara, insurance nhyehyɛe ko, ne ankorankoro nhyehyɛe ho nsɛm so. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ wɔn insurance nhyehyɛe ho nkrataa mu anaasɛ wɔne wɔn insurance dwumayɛni no susuw ho na ama wɔate anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ insurance ho ase na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔhwehwɛ akwan foforo a wɔbɛfa so atua ho ka.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotu anaa ayaresa betumi aboa me wɔ nsɛm pɔteee anaa nsɛnnennen a merehyia te sɛ adwennwen, dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa abusuabɔ mu haw ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Afotu anaa ayaresa betumi aboa wo wɔ nsɛm pɔtee anaa nsɛnnennen te sɛ adwennwen, dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa abusuabɔ mu haw ahorow ho denam mmoa, ahokokwaw a wode begyina ano, ne akwan horow a wobɛfa so adi sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow ho dwuma a wode bɛma so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ayaresa betumi aboa wo ma woahu nneɛma a ɛkanyan adwennwen anaa dadwen, enya akwan a wobɛfa so agye w’ahome, akasa atia nsusuwii bɔne, ama nkitahodi ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ atu mpɔn wɔ abusuabɔ mu, na woanya ahoɔden a wode begyina asetra mu nsɛnnennen ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Asiane bɛn na ɛwɔ nkitahodie a ahobammɔ nnim anaasɛ ɛnyɛ papa mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Asiane ahorow a ɛbata nkitahodie a ahobammɔ nnim anaasɛ ɛnyɛ papa mu a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no bi ne: Nipadua ne nkate fam ayayade. Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs). Nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm te sɛ adwenemhaw ne dadwen. Asetra mu tew a wɔtew wɔn ho ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow a wɔhwere.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ansa na wɔawo wɔ asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba a wobehu na wɔadi ho dwuma no so dua.
answer_twi_source: Ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo no ne nea eye sen biara a wode bɛbɔ wo ho ban afi nyinsɛn mu yaw a ebetumi aba, a nea ɛfa asiane ahorow ho ka ho. Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Wohu ntɛm: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ma nnuruyɛfo hu asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ntɛm. Akwan a Wɔfa so Di Dwuma: Sɛ wohu asiane ahorow wie a, wo duruyɛfo no betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛfata a ɔde bedi ho dwuma na ama hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wubenyinsɛn yiye no atu mpɔn. Asomdwoe: Sɛ wuhu sɛ wɔrehwɛ w’akwahosan ne wo ba no nyin yiye a, ebetumi atew dadwen so kɛse.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee "critical thinking" adi dwuma de asusuw nea ebetumi afi me nneyɛe mu aba wɔ m’ankasa yiyedi ne afoforo yiyedi so no ho?
answer_twi_source: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee "critical thinking" ma wutumi susuw nea ebetumi afi wo nneyɛe mu aba wɔ w’ankasa yiyedi ne afoforo yiyedi so no ho. Susuw nneɛma te sɛ nipadua ne nkate fam akwahosan, abusuabɔ mu nkɔso, ne asetra anaa mmara mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu ho bere a woresusuw nea ebetumi afi mu aba ho no. Dwene wo gyinapɛn "values" ne wo botae "goals"ahorow ho, Fa mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ nneɛma ahorow a wobɛpaw mu, na susuw sɛnea wo gyinaesi ahorow ne wo botae ne gyinapɛn ahorow a wode bere tenten ayɛ no hyia ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔhaw mu dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ no hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛda adi na wɔabu akontaa wɔ ne nhwehwɛmu dwumadiɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Ɛhwɛ ma nneɛma a ɛda adi pefee na wobu akontaa denam: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wodi dwuma ne ɔmanfoɔ no so. Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma, akwan a wɔfa so boaboa nsɛm ano, ne nea efi mu ba ho nkrataa a emu da hɔ a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu. Nsɛm a wɔbɛbisa ne nsɛm a wɔbɛka afiri wɔn a wodi dwuma no hɔ, wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa mu. Nhyiam anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ daa de asusuw nkɔso ne nsɛnnennen ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Si so dua sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔpaw no yɛ gyinaesi a ɛma tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi di wɔn awo akwahosan so.
answer_twi_source: Nyinsɛn ano a wobɛpaw no yɛ gyinaesi a ɛma tumi! Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Awo akwahosan sohwɛ: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ma wutumi di w’awo akwahosan so na woyɛ wo daakye ho nhyehyɛe. Asiane a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da mu a ɛso tew: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano boa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da, a ebetumi de nkate ne mfaso a ɛho hia aba no ano. Kɔndɔm brɛ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛnya STI nso ase Asomdwoe: Sɛ wunim sɛ wɔabɔ wo ho ban a, ɛma wunya nna mu osuahu a ɛyɛ ahomegye na ɛyɛ anigye kɛse (sɛ wopaw sɛ wobɛyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a). Nyinsɛn ano a wobɛpaw no yɛ gyinaesi a ɛyɛ asɛyɛde a ɛma w’akwahosan ne w’akwahosan di kan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na dijitaal anansesɛmka ne sohyial 'media' so dwumadi betumi adi wɔ nsɛm a wɔma nkurɔfo hu na wɔkasa ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho?
answer_twi_source: Dijitaal abasɛm ne sohyial media dwumadie di dwuma titire sɛ wɔpɛgya nhumu ne wɔkasa ma awoɔ akwahosan hokwan denam: Nne a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛseɛ ne ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ de akasa atia animtiaabuo na wɔahyɛ obiara a wɔbɛka ho no ho nkuran. Mmoa ne biakoyɛ a wɔbɛboaboa ano denam intanɛt so ɔsatu, nea broni ka no 'hashtag', ne kankabi ahorow so. Nhyiamu a wɔbɛma ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkamfo wɔn ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden no akyɛ nsɛm, nneɛma, ne ɔfrɛ a wɔde frɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ. Ɛne nhyehyeɛ ayɛfo ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no di nkitaho de nya nhyehyeɛ gyinaesie so nkɛntɛnsoɔ na wɔhyɛ nsakraeɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ 'ASRH' nnwuma mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔkɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de kokoam nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ama?
answer_twi_source: Aane. Adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛboa. Wɔkyerɛ obu ma kokoam nsɛm. Wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn a wɔwɔ ahiade titiriw.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nna ho akɔnnɔ na ɛyɛ dɛn na ɛba? (kyerɛkyerɛ mu yie, a ɛnyɛ nea ɛmu da hɔ so)
answer_twi_source: Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho akɔnnɔ yɛ anigye anaa anigye a obi nya wɔ nna mu dwumadi ho. Ebetumi aba esiane nneɛma pii nti, te sɛ honam fam nsa a wɔde ka obi, emotional connection, anaa mpo sɛ wuhu biribi a ɛyɛ anigye. Ebia wo nipadua no bɛyɛ ho biribi denam nsakrae te sɛ koma a ɛbɔ kɛse, ahome a ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm, anaa mogya a ɛkɔ w’akyi berɛmo mu no so. Eyi nyinaa yɛ ade a ɛfata na ɛyɛ nna mu mmuae kyinhyia no fã.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua mu de asusuw ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho mfonini ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu no mu yie?
answer_twi_source: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho hia kɛse ma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛfa nkrasɛm a ɛyɛ den a wonya fi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo hɔ no mu. Sɛnea wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua mu ni: Nsɛmmisa ne Nhwehwɛmu: Mmabun betumi asua sɛ wobegye akyinnye na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho mfonini ahorow a wohu wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ho, a wosusuw nkrasɛm a wɔde rema ne nsunsuanso a ebetumi anya wɔ wɔn a wɔhwɛ no so no ho. Adwene Ahorow a Wɔhwehwɛ: Sɛ wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a egyina hɔ ma osuahu ahorow a egu ahorow a, ebetumi aboa wɔn ma wɔanya ntease nketenkete wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Nokwasɛm a Wɔhwehwɛ ne Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no mu nokwasɛm na wɔhwehwɛ mmeae a agye din a wobenya nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Ahokokwaw a Wɔde Hwɛ Nneɛma a Ɛyɛ Den: Mmabun betumi anya ahokokwaw a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpanyimfo bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ, ahu nneɛma a ɛyɛ katee ne animhwɛ a wobehu, ne adwene foforo a wobesusuw ho no so. Wɔn Ankasa Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ a Wɔbɛbɔ: Sɛ wɔhyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnyɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, sɛ́ ɛyɛ nsɛm a wɔkyerɛw, video a wɔyɛ, anaasɛ blog a wofi ase no betumi ama wɔn tumi ma wɔakasa atia nsusuwii hunu na wɔagyina hɔ ama wɔn ankasa osuahu ne wɔn nipasu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Fa nneɛma ma nna mu akwaahosan ho telefon anaa ayaresabea ahorow a mmabun betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa wɔn yare wɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI ) ho wɔ kokoam.
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛyɛ kokoam nna mu yareɛ  (STI ) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ Ghana ni: Akuo a wfrɛ wɔ broɔfo  kasa mu sɛ Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG ahomatorɔfo): 0244312151 (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-5pm) Ghana AIDS Commission Helpline: 0800123456 (Toll-Free) GHS-YMK mobile app Public Health facilities /Akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ mmabun ne Mmabun adamfofa Ministry of Health : https://www.moh.gov.gh/ (Saa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn yi wɔ akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ no sɛnea ɔmantam biara te) Kae sɛ, sɛ wobɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu na woasa  nna mu yarewa (STIs) a, ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wode wo nna mu akwahosan ho asodi to wo ho so. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wogye no di anaa saa nneɛma yi nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ kokoam ne adwumayɛfo mmoa. Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara!
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyiyim ahorow a ɛka bom, te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nyiyim, "ableism", ne mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan no ma animtiaabu a akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmoa a wonya mu no yɛ kɛse?
answer_twi_source: Nyiyim ahorow a ɛka bom, te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nyiyim, "ableism", ne mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho tan no ma animtiaabu a akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua nya wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne mmoa a wonya mu no yɛ kɛse wɔ akwan horow pii so. Nea edi kan no, ankorankoro a wɔka akuw pii a wɔato wɔn hintidua ho no hyia akwanside ahorow a ɛtwam, a nea ɛka ho ne sikasɛm mu nsonsonoe, akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wonnya, ne nhomasua hokwan ahorow a enni hɔ, a esiw wɔn tumi a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no kwan bio. Bio nso, nyiyim a egyina abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, dɛmdi, anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ so no betumi ama wɔanya akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wonni ahotoso, wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayade, na wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔbɛda nsɛm a ɛho hia adi, na ama wɔakyɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔhwehwɛ anaasɛ wɔkwati nnwuma a ɛho hia mu. Bio nso, nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne asetra mu a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn no ma akwahosan mu nsonsonoe yɛ kɛse na ɛma asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso bɔne bɛba wɔ nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu no yɛ kɛse, na ɛma animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akwahosan a enye a efi mu ba no kɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne nhyehyɛe anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi a atipɛnfo di anim "pre-led initiatives" a ɛhyɛ atipɛnfo ntam twaka "relationships" pa ne adwenem ahokasan ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Atipɛnfoɔ Afotuo Nhyehyɛeɛ "Peer Mentoring": Asuafoɔ a wɔn mfeɛ akɔ anim ne atipɛnfoɔ nkumaa a wɔde bɛka abom de mmoa, akwankyerɛ, ne nhwɛsoɔ pa ama. Atipɛnfoɔ Mmoa Akuo: Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo anaa akuo a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a asuafoɔ bɛtumi asusu adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm, akyɛ suahunu, na wɔde mmoa ama wɔn ho wɔn ho. Adwene mu Akwahosan Ho Nhumu Ɔsatuo: Nhyiamu, nhyiamu, anaa ɔsatuo a asuafoɔ di anim de ma nkurɔfoɔ te adwenemyareɛ ho nsɛm, tew animtiaabuo so, na wɔhyɛ mmeaeɛ a wɔboa. Mmabun Akwankyerɛ Kuo: Wɔhyehyɛɛ akuo a asuafoɔ di wɔn anim a wɔde wɔn adwene sii adwenemyareɛ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nneɛma, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛn na wɔde yɛn amammere ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm fra nketekete (life skills) ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Wɔyɛ no ma ɛfata amammerɛ. Wɔde nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ di dwuma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ fa gyidie ho. Afotufoɔ firi mmeammea ahorow.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wɔhwɛ yɛn adesua nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm mu a ɛdeɛn na yɛde akaho sɛ yɛnkyerɛkyerɛ no wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu a afa nna ne awoɔ apɔmden ho deɛ pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no sɛ 'sexual and reproductive health' ɛna nteaseɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ deɛ wɔkyerɛ bi te sɛ nsabuo, nna mu ahobammɔ, nna mu mmoawa a wɔde nyarewa ba, peneeɛ ne nkitahodie a ɛhote?
answer_twi_source: Nsabuo, ahoban mmɔ, mmoawa a wɔde nyarewa ba anaa sɛ nna mu nyarewa, penee, nkitahodie pa. Sɛ ɛba no nteaseɛ mu a ebi di mu sene bi. Fa si w'ani so sɛ wɔbɛma nimdeɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔhaw mu no susuw nsunsuanso a enya wɔ nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho haw a ɛsan ba mmabun mu no so tew so?
answer_twi_source: Wɔnam: Ɔhaw dodow a ɛsan ba mpɛn pii wɔ wɔn a wɔkra no mu a wodi akyi na ɛsusuw nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔbɛtew nea ɛsan ba no so. Nsakrae a ɛba asiane nneyɛe anaa tebea horow mu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu. Nnwuma a wɔde di akyi ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ hɔ a wɔbɛhwɛ so. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no bere tenten de ahwɛ nea ebefi mu aba bere tenten.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho nsɛm bɛkɔ asɛnnibea, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka tumi a wɔn a woannyaa wɔn ti andidii mu 'victims' no wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ atɛntrenee?
answer_twi_source: Mmara a ɛfa bere a wɔde yɛ adwuma no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu na ebetumi asiw bere a wobetumi de nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho nsɛm adi dwuma no ano hye. Saa anohyeto ahorow yi betumi aka tumi a victims no wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ atɛntrenee, efisɛ sɛ wɔkyɛ wɔ nsɛm a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ anaa wodi ho dwuma mu a, ebetumi ama mmara a wɔde ma no atwam.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na insurance a wɔtua ho ka di wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛsi so dua a wobenya mu, na akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro a wonni insurance?
answer_twi_source: Nneɛma a Wɔtua ka: Insurance a wɔde ma wɔ LGBTQ+-akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi ho no betumi ayɛ kakraa bi wɔ Ghana. Hwehwɛ akwan horow te sɛ: Aban Ayaresabea: Ebia aban ayaresabea ahorow bi de nnwuma a ɛho hia bɛma a ne bo nyɛ den. Amanaman Ntam NGO ahorow: Ebia NGO ahorow bi de nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma anaa nneɛma bɛma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a ebia ɛho renhia sɛ wɔbɔ obi ho ban abien? (nkitahodie a ɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho yɛ biako ne sɔhwɛ) .
answer_twi_source: Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, ebia ahobammɔ abien ho renhia. Nhwɛso biako ni: Nkitahodie a ɛda ɔyere biako ntam ne nnansa yi STI nhwehwɛmu: Sɛ wo ne ɔhokafo biako wɔ nkitahodie a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ, a wɔde wo ho ahyɛ mu, na wɔayɛ mo baanu nyinaa nhwehwɛmu nnansa yi sɛ wowɔ STI ho nhwehwɛmu a, ebia asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya ɔyare no bɛyɛ ketewaa koraa. Nanso, wo ne wo duruyɛfo nkasa na ɔnhwɛ wo tebea pɔtee no na hwɛ sɛ ebia wɔda so ara kamfo ahobammɔ abien kyerɛ anaa. Kae sɛ, wɔ nkitahodie a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu mpo mu no, tebea horow a wɔnhwɛ kwan betumi asɔre. Ɛyɛ papa bere nyinaa sɛ wo ne wo hokafo no susuw w’awerɛkyekye dodow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho no ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na  ho so hwɛ di wɔ adwennwen ano aduru mu, na dɛn nneyɛe bi na wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a mmabun betumi de ahyɛ wɔn nneyɛe mu?
answer_twi_source: Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ no ho hia na ama woadi adwennwen ho dwuma efisɛ ɛboa ma wo nipadua, atenka, ne w’adwene mu ahoɔden san di mu . Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho hwɛ ho nneyɛe ahyɛ wɔn dwumadi ahorow mu denam dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigye ne ahomegye brɛ wɔn a wɔde bedi kan te sɛ bere a wɔde bɛtra abɔnten, anigyede a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu, nna a ɛfata a wɔbɛda, ne mfiridwuma ne abɛɛfo ntentan a wɔbɛkura ahye a ɛfata mu no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ ayɔnkofo ama akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaasɛ wonni ananmusifo pii wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer_twi_source: Tie na Sua: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ wɔn suahu ne wɔn haw ho. Kasa: Gyina hɔ tia nyiyim ne nneyɛe a ɛnteɛ. Mmoa: Kamfo nhyehye ne nneyɛe a ɛhyɛ pɛyɛ ne nnipa a wɔka bom ho nkuran. Ma yɛnte wo nne: Kyɛ wɔn nsɛm ne wɔn adwene na ama nkurɔfo ate ase.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow anaa nhyehyɛe mu nsɛnnennen bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wɔbenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer_twi_source: Mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow pii ne nhyehyɛe mu nsɛnnennen wɔ hɔ a ebetumi ama ayɛ den ama mmabun sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe. Ebia eyinom bi ne awofo pene anaa amanneɛbɔ a wɔhwehwɛ, bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde twɛn, mfe a nyinsɛn betumi adi, wɔn a wɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu a wonni hɔ pii, ne sikasɛm mu ahokyere. Bio nso, animtiaabu ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nsɛm a edi mu a wonni no betumi ama mmabun twentwɛn wɔn nan ase anaasɛ wontumi nsi pi wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ ho. Akwanside ahorow yi a wobedi ho dwuma no hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden kɛse de hwɛ hu sɛ mmabun betumi anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho dwumadi ahorow dwoodwoo, a ne bo nyɛ den, na akwansidie ahorow a ɛho nhia nni hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi anya awerɛhyem sɛ mmabun bɛbɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrehwehwɛ ɔhaw mu mmoa wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu ho no?
answer_twi_source: Wobetumi ama mmabun awerɛhyem sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban bere a wɔrehwehwɛ ɔhaw mu mmoa wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu ho denam kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa mmoa adwumayɛfo a wobedi kan asusuw ho no so. Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo na wofi eyi ase. Nanso mmabun betumi abisa sɛnea wobedi wɔn nsɛm ho dwuma ne tebea horow a wobetumi ada no adi wɔ mu no ho asɛm. Bio nso, sɛ wɔpaw ɔhaw mu dwumadie a ɛwɔ din pa na wotumi de ho to so a ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde asi hɔ a, ɛbɛtumi ama wɔanya awerɛhyɛmu foforɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwene a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wogye wɔn atom na wɔanya tema berɛ a wɔrefa nipadua ne atenka mu nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmabunberɛ mu?
answer_twi_source: Practicing self awareness: Sɛ obi yɛ saa a, ɔbɛte n'adwene, n'tenka, ne nsakrae a ɛba berɛ a wabɔ mmabun berɛ mu, a ɔnni ho adwemmɔne.Sɛ obi nya ne ho ayamyie a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ne ho fɛw na ɔte ne ho ase; ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ saa titiriw bere a ɔrennya ahobammɔ anaa ne ho akyinnye; ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhwɛ ne ho yie, na ohu sɛ  ɔsombo kyɛn n'ahoɔfɛ. Mmoa a Wopɛ Mfɛfo, abusuafo, anaa adwenkyerɛfo a wubetumi de wo ho ato wɔn so a wobetumi ahyɛ wo nkuran na ama woahyɛ wo ho nkuran.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dwuma bɛn na mpanyimfo anaa nyamesom akannifo di wɔ akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm ho wɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mpanyimfo ne nyamesom akannifo taa yɛ nyansa, akwankyerɛ, ne tumidi fibea wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho. Wobetumi de afotu, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmoa ama ankorankoro ne mmusua a wɔrehwehwɛ saa nsɛmti yi mu wɔ wɔn amammerɛ anaa nyamesom gyidi ahorow mu. Ɛho hia sɛ wode obu ne ahobrɛase kɔ saa akontaabufo yi nkyɛn, hwehwɛ wɔn afotu bere a ɛfata bere a wosusuw ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne osuahu ahorow nso ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ahokokwaw pɔtee bɛn na wobu no sɛ ɛho hia na ama mmabun adi yie wɔ adwumayɛ mu anaasɛ wɔafi wɔn ankasa nnwuma ase?
answer_twi_source: Ahokokwaw a ɛho hia a ɛbɛma adwumayɛfo adi yie no bi ne mfiridwuma ne brɛoo ho nimdeɛ: Mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ: Eyinom yɛ adwuma pɔtee bi ho nimdeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ ma adwuma pɔtee bi anaa nnwuma bi, te sɛ kɔmputa ho nimdeɛ, duadwumfo adwuma, nsu ho adwuma, anyinam ahoɔden ho nimdeɛ, ntadepam, aduannoa ho nimdeɛ, ne kar a wosiesie. Ahokokwaw a ɛyɛ mmerɛw: Eyinom yɛ nnipa ntam nkitahodi, ne nneyɛe ho nimdeɛ a ɛma nkitahodi a etu mpɔn, biakoyɛ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru yɛ mmerɛw wɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow mu. Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne nkitahodiɛ, akuo adwumayɛ, akanni, nsakraeɛ, adwene a ɛyɛ katee, ne berɛ a wɔde di dwuma.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Akwan bɛn na wɔde redi dwuma de ahyɛ nnwuma ahorow ntam adwumayɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa ho nkuran wɔ nhwehwɛmufo a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ASRH mu no?
answer_twi_source: Sεdeε εbεma nnoɔma ahodoɔ ntam adwumayɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa wɔ nhwehwɛmufoɔ a wɔwɔ ASRH mu no anya nkɔsoɔ: Wɔbɛhyehyɛ nhwehwɛmu ntam nkitahodiɛ ne akuo a ɛka abenfoɔ a wɔfiri nnwuma ahodoɔ mu, a ɔmanfoɔ akwahosan, asetena mu nsɛm, nnipa ho adesua, ne sikasɛm ka ho, bom de di ASRH nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho dwuma. Yɛ nhyehyɛe ma nhyiamu a ɛfa nnwuma ahodoɔ ho, nhyiamu, ne nhyiamu a ɛbɛma nkɔmmɔdie ne adwumayɛ ayɛ mmerɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmufoɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ ASRH afã ahodoɔ ho, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano, nna mu yareɛ ano aduru, ne basabasayɛ a ɛfa mmarima ne mmaa ho. Boa ntetee nhyehyɛe a ɛfa nnwuma ahorow ho ne fekubɔ a wɔde ma nhwehwɛmufo a wɔreyɛ adwuma mfiase no ma wɔanya nimdeɛ ne adwene a ɛho hia na wɔde adi ASRH ɔhaw ho dwuma. Hyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde tintim nhoma ne nsɛm a wɔkyɛ ho nhyehyɛe a wɔabue ano ho nkuran na ama nhwehwɛmu mu nsɛm a wɔahu no atrɛw na wɔahyɛ biakoyɛ ho nkuran wɔ nteɛso ahye so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi nya su horow a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho so nkɛntɛnso, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu a ɛsonsonoe a me ne me hokafo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ no so?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ mu Nkɛntɛnso: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse, na ɛka adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Ntease: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho sɛnea amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow kyerɛkyerɛ su horow a ɛfa nna ne nyinsɛn ano ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wobue Mu: Wo ne wo hokafo nka wo gyidi ne sɛnea ebia ɛsono no ho nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛkyerɛ obu. Nsiesiei: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a adwene hyia na hwehwɛ apam mu sɛ nsonsonoe wɔ adwene mu a, te sɛ akwan a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban a wogye tom wɔ amammerɛ mu a wobɛhwehwɛ. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa nyamesom akannifo 'religious elders' a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ nsonsonoe ahorow yi a wobɛfa so adi mu no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn na ɛde nsakrae a ɛfa honam mu nkwammoaa 'hormone' ho ba me nipadua mu, te sɛ nufu nyin anaa nne a ɛsakra?
answer_twi_source: Honam mu nkwammoaa te sɛ estrogen (mmeawa) ne testosterone (mmarimaa)na ɛma nsakrae a wuhu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ba: Estrogen: Saa hormone yi na ɛma mmeawa nufu nyin. Ɛma nufu no mu ntini ne ntini no nyin na srade hyɛ mu ma. Estrogen nso di dwuma wɔ brayɛ a ɛhwɛ so no mu. Testosterone: Saa hormone yi na ɛma mmarimaa nne sesa. Testosterone ma ɛnne nhama no ware na ɛyɛ den, na ɛma ɛnne a emu dɔ ba. Ɛsan nso ma anim ne nipadua mu nhwi nyin, ntini nyin, ne mmarima nna mu su afoforo a ɛto so abien.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ\ akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, nhyiam anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akannifo a wɔbɛyɛ biako so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Di ɛka a ɛbɛhaw wo ho dwuma na si akwan horow te sɛ sliding scale fees anaa nneɛma a wontua hwee so dua.
answer_twi_source: Akwahosan adwumayɛbea pii gye NHIS krataa no. Hwɛ sɛ wowɔ NHIS kratasin a ɛfata bere a worekɔ akwahosan asoɛe no
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwehwɛ m’ankasa nna ho akɔnnɔ ne me nipasu mu na mate ase?
answer_twi_source: Gye bere fa susuw wo ho hwehwɛ w'atenka, nneɛma a ɛtwetwe wo, ne osuahu ahorow mu. Hwehwɛ nneɛma te sɛ nhoma, nsɛm, ne intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow a ankorankoro kyɛ wɔn suahu ahorow wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ ne nipasu ho. Susuw ho sɛ wo ne wo nnamfo a wogye wɔn di, abusua mufo, anaa mpanyimfo a wɔboa wɔn a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne ntease ama no bɛkasa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɛdɛn ne nna ho akɔnnɔ pagyya ho mmuae a mmarima ne mmea nya?
answer_twi_source: Mmarima Nna mu Mmuae: Anigye: Mogya a ɛkɔ soro wo ɔbarima no ne sɛbi 'kɔti' mu ma no pagya, na ɛma ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔsɔretia. Plateau: Wɔma ɛsɔre no kɔ so, na ebia awotwaa no bɛbɛn nipadua no. Orgasm: Nkwammoaa a ɛnam ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so fi adi, na anigye a emu yɛ den ka ho. Nsiesiei: San kɔ tebea a na ɛte kan no mu, refractory bere ansa na arousal betumi aba bio. Ɔbea Nna mu Mmuae: Anigye: Mogya a ɛkɔ soro kɔ awotwaa ne ɔbea awotwaa afasu mu, srade a wɔde gu mu. Asasetaw: Clitoris no yɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw kɛse, ɔbea no awotwaa afasu hohoro, na nufu no betumi ayɛ kɛse. Orgasm: Ntini a ɛwɔ akyi berɛmo mu a ɛtwetwe denneennen, nhyɛso ne anigye a ɛba. Nsiesiei: San kɔ tebea a ɛfata mu nkakrankakra, clitoris ne vagina san kɔ tebea a edi kan a ɛkanyan no mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne brayɛ, na dɛn nti na mmaa nya?
answer_twi_source: Brayɛbea: Brayɛ a wɔsan frɛ no bere a ɛba no yɛ adebɔ mu adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmea a wɔadu awo mfe mu no mu. Nea ɛka ho ne awotwaa no mu ntini a ɛfa awotwaa no mu fi nipadua no mu no a wɔhwie gu. Mpɛn pii no, brayɛ ba bɛyɛ pɛnkoro ɔsram biara. Botae: Brayɛ botae ne sɛ ebesiesie awotwaa no ama nyinsɛn a etumi aba. Ɔsram biara, awotwaa no mu ntama yɛ den de hwɛ kwan sɛ nkesua bɛhyɛ mu ma. Sɛ nyinsɛn amma a, wɔhwie ntama no gu bere a obi rekɔ brayɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a mɛfa so akari pɛ wɔ m’ankorankoro botae ne gyinapɛn ahorow ne m’atipɛnfo kuo, sukuu atenaeɛ, amammerɛ, anaa ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow akwanhwɛ, gyinapɛn, ne nhyɛso ahorow mu, na makura m’ahofadi ne me mudi mu kura mu wɔ gyinaesi mu?
answer_twi_source: Ankorankoro botae ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛkari pɛ ne atipɛnfo kuw, sukuu, amammerɛ, anaa ɔsom akwanhwɛ ahorow no hwehwɛ sɛ: Ankorankoro gyinapɛn ahorow a wubesusuw ho: Gye bere susuw w’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a ɛho hia, ne w’apɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho no ho, na susuw sɛnea ɛne abɔnten so akwanhwɛ ahorow hyia ho. Ahye a wode besi hɔ: Fa ahye a emu da hɔ a ɛhyɛ wo gyinapɛn ne nneɛma a ɛho hia wo anuonyam si hɔ, sɛ ɛsono w’atipɛnfo kuw anaa w’amammerɛ mu de mpo a. Mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ: Fa ankorankoro a wobu wo ho na wɔboa wo ahofadi ne nokwaredi wɔ gyinaesi mu no twa wo ho hyia, na hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ bere a wohyia nhyɛso ahorow a ɛbɔ abira no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmeae a wɔhwɛ mmabun akwahosan so (youth-friendly centers) hyɛ asumasɛm nsie mu den?
answer_twi_source: Policies: Wɔwɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɔ kokoam-yɛ ho ban. Training: Wɔtete adwumayɛfoɔ. Private Spaces: Wɔwɔ mmeammea a a wobɛtumi ne dɔkota akasa wɔ kokoam a obiara nnim. Confidential Communication: Wɔde kwan a ɛyɛ kokoam ne wo di nkitaho. Consent: Wɔbu wo hokwan.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ne mpanyimfo, ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ayɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe, ne nhyiam ahorow, a ɛde ahobammɔ, pɛyɛ, ne atɛntrenee di kan ma mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa, titiriw wɔn a wɔato wɔn hintidua kɛse anaasɛ wɔyɛ mmerɛw kɛse wɔ basabasayɛ ho, na wɔde adi dwuma?
answer_twi_source: Mmabun betumi ne mpanyimfo, ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ayɛ biako denam mpɔtam hɔ nhyiam ahorow, mmabun agyinatukuw ahorow, ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu basabasayɛ a wobesiw ano ne mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma wɔayɛ so denneennen so. Wobetumi de wɔn adwene, wɔn suahu, ne wɔn adwene ama wɔ nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛe, ne nnwuma a ɛde ahobammɔ, pɛyɛ, ne atɛntrenee di kan ma mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa, titiriw wɔn a wɔato wɔn hintidua kɛse anaasɛ wɔyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ basabasa no, na wɔde adi dwuma. Ɛdenam nkɔmmɔbɔ, nhwehwɛmu, ne mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe mmɔdenbɔ a mmabun de wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so no, wobetumi anya gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow so nkɛntɛnso na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobedi mmabun ahiade ne wɔn haw ahorow ho dwuma yie.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: So nnipa akuo pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wohyia nsɛnnennen soronko wɔ STI ahorow ano sie ho? (mmabun, nna ho adwumayɛfo, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm) .
answer_twi_source: Akuo binom hyia nsɛnnennen soronko wɔ STI ahorow ano sie ho: Nna mu Adwumayɛfo: Tebea horow a asiane kɛse wom a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu esiane wɔn adwuma nti. Nnipa a Wɔadi dɛm: Nkitahodi akwanside ahorow a ebetumi aba ne afoforo a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so de nya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ne ɔhwɛ. Afei nso, animtiaabu ne nyiyim betumi asiw akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhomasua a wobenya no ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Anamɔn bɛn na metumi atu de asiw Intanɛt so ayayade anaa nkɔso a mempɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho ano?
answer_twi_source: Siw ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe a ɛhaw adwene anaa ɛmfata mu wɔ Intanɛt so no kwan anaasɛ yi wɔn adamfo. Bɔ ɔhaw anaa kɔmputa so ayayade ho amanneɛ kyerɛ asɛnka agua no so ahwɛfo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na kwati sɛ wo ne ankorankoro a wɔma wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ wonni ahobammɔ no bedi nkitaho. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ sɛ wunya ɔhaw wɔ Intanɛt so anaa nkɔso a wompɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn de abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn adi dwuma de ne mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo a wɔn ani gye ASRR ahorow ho no adi nkitaho na mayɛ wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no ntam nkitahodi? (Intanɛt so mpɔtam, sohyial media akuw)
answer_twi_source: Wo abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so mpɔtam a wubehu no yɛ ade titiriw! Akwan bi a wobɛfa so abɔ nie: so abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn Mpɔtam: abɛɛfo ntentan te sɛ https://www.amnesty.org/en/youth/ betumi de wo ne mmabun a wɔko ma nna ne awo akwaahosan abom (ASRH). Abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn Akuo: Hwehwɛ akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene asi ASRH nsɛm so wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn mmea p te sɛ Facebook anaa Reddit so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia nyiyimu anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo apomoden ho nsɛmti ho wɔ me mpɔtamu hɔ? (Wɔhyɛ nnipa nyinaa bom ne obu a wɔde ma) .
answer_twi_source: Kasa mu: Sɛ wote nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ nyiyimu a, fa nokwasɛm ahorow twa ho mpoa wɔ obu mu. Fa Nhwɛso Di Anim: Fa obu di obiara, ɛmfa ho sɛnea ofi mu anaa gyidi a ɔwɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Sɛ yɛhwɛ tetefon so mmoa mmeae a wɔboa nnipa wɔ ahokyere mu yi a, aso wɔgye nnipa biara tom na wɔbu obiara nneyɛeɛ ne n'asetena mu nsɛm (LGBTQ+ foɔ, abibifoɔ ne mmusuakuo ahorow, atubrafoɔ, atuofofoɔ, nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm, ne nnipa a wɔbu wɔn animtiaa wɔ amansan mu no nyinaa) anaa?
answer_twi_source: Aane, tetefon so mmoa mmeae a wɔboa nnipa wɔ ahokyere mu no asi wɔn bo sɛ wɔbɛgye nnipa biara atom na wɔabu obiara nneyɛeɛ, n'asɛm ne n'asetena mu nsɛm ni. Mmoa adwumayɛfoɔ nya nteteeɛ wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne nkateɛ ho de hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛtumi de mmoa a ɛfata ama ankorankoro a wɔfiri mpɔtam nyinaa, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, nnipa a wɔn kɔla yɛ kɔkɔɔ anaa tontom, atubrafoɔ, aguanfoɔ, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, ne nnipa foforɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua ka ho. Mmabun betumi abisa mmoa afiri adwumayɛfoɔ amammerɛ mu ahoɔden ho asɛm anaa wɔahwehwɛ mmoa nhama a ɛka wɔn botaeɛ pefee sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho wɔ wɔn asɛmpatrɛ nsɛm anaa nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfoɔ nkuran mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow nya awofoɔ adwene wɔ pene ne amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ma wɔ mmabun apɔwmuden ho nnwuma ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer_twi_source: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya awofoɔ adwene wɔ pene ne amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ma wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nnwuma ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Ebia awofoɔ binom de abusua gyinapɛn ahorow, nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akwahosan ho gyinaesi a ɛfa ɔbabun no ho no bedi kan, bere a afoforɔ nso betumi asi ankorankoro ahofadi ne kokoam nsɛm so dua. Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu adwene ahorow a wɔbɛte ase na wɔabu no ho hia ma akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo bere a wɔredi nsɛm a ɛfa awofo pene ne amanneɛbɔ ho dwuma no.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Wiase Nyinaa Mpontuo Botaeɛ (SDGs) bɛn na ɛfa ASRH ho?
answer_twi_source: Goal 3 (Apɔwmuden), Goal 4 (Nwomasua), Goal 5 (Pɛyɛ), Goal 10 (Pɛyɛ a yɛhwehwɛ), Goal 17 (Nkabom). Ɛkyerɛ kwan ma yɛko ma mmoa, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne pɛyɛ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a mmabun betumi afa so aka wɔn ahye ho asɛm pefee na wɔahwehwɛ pene wɔ Intanɛt so nkitahodi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne kasa a emu da hɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma, wɔne onipa foforo no akɔhwɛ, na wɔabu wɔn ahofadi?
answer_twi_source: ɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi aka wɔn hyeɛ ho asɛm pefee na wɔahwehwɛ kwan mma (consent) wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu no, wobɛtumi ayɛ eyinom:De Kasa a ɛmu da hɔ adi dwuma (Use Explicit Language): Kyerɛ deɛ wopɛ, deɛ w'ani gye ho, ne wo hyeɛ pefee denam kasa a ɛkɔ asɛm no mu tẽẽ na ɛnyɛ nnaadaa so.Hwɛ mu dabiara (Check-In Regularly): Kɔ so ara bisa onipa a ne ho asɛm wɔ hɔ no dabiara na hwɛ sɛ n'ani gye ho na wagye atom sɛ ɔbɛkɔ so anae.Bu Obiara ne ne ho so tumi (Respect Autonomy): Bu obiara tumi a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔsi ne gyinaeɛ denam ne gyinaeɛ ne ne hyeɛ a wobɛdi no ni, mpo sɛ ɛne wo deɛ nyɛ pɛ a.Si Hyeɛ na Bu Hyeɛ (Set and Respect Boundaries): Ka wo hyeɛ ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ afoforɔ na bu afoforɔ nso wɔn hyeɛ; twe wo ho firi obiara nhyɛsoɔ ho kɔ nneyɛeɛ a ɔnte nka sɛ n'ani gye ho mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question_twi_source: Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ebetumi aba sɛ wɔannkora apɔmuden mu asumasɛm so yie, ma mmabun ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa?
answer_twi_source: Sɛ wɔannkora apɔmuden mu asumasɛm mu yie, ebetumi de nsunsuansoɔ a emu yɛ den aba ma mmabun ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa. Ma mmabun no, sɛ wɔankora kɔkoamunsɛm so a, ebetumi ama wɔahwere ahotosoɔ, wɔn ani awu, wɔahyia animguase, anaa wɔapira mpo sɛ wɔda nsɛm a ɛyɛ den adi a wɔampene so a. Apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ betumi ahyia asotwe, mmara mu nsunsuansoɔ, na wɔn adwuma din asɛe sɛ wɔbu ɔyarefoɔ asumasɛm so a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge
